examples.en: Regular exercise keeps your body strong.
examples.zh: 規律運動能保持身體強健。

examples.en: Water makes up about sixty percent of the human body.
examples.zh: 水分大約佔了人體重量的百分之六十。

examples.en: Good posture keeps your body and spine healthy.
examples.zh: 良好的體態能維護身體與脊椎健康。

examples.en: Sumatran Mandheling delivers a rich, buttery body with earthy cocoa notes that coats the entire tongue.
examples.zh: 蘇門答臘曼特寧展現出厚實如融化奶油般的醇厚口感油脂感，深沉可可風味包覆整個舌頭。

examples.en: Light-roast Geisha lots are prized for a delicate, tea-like body rather than heavy syrupy thickness.
examples.zh: 淺度烘焙的高海拔藝伎精品豆，以其宛如大吉嶺紅茶般清透空靈的茶感質地見長，而非濃郁厚重。

examples.en: French press immersion brewing allows natural oils to pass into the cup, producing an exceptionally round body.
examples.zh: 法式濾壓壺全浸泡沖煮能讓咖啡生豆豐富的未乳化天然油脂完全保留在杯中，營造極致圓潤的醇厚口感。

entries.definition: 身體；身軀；絲滑醇厚、如奶油般之油脂醇厚度

explains.en: This is the whole physical part of a person or animal. It includes the head, arms, and legs. People also use this word for the main part of an object.
It names the physical parts of a living thing. Food, rest, and exercise help keep it healthy. The word can also mean the main part of a written work.
This word means the physical form of a person or animal. It can also name the main part of something. People care for it with food and sleep.

examples.en: I like to read a story book before bedtime.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在睡前讀故事書。

examples.en: Don't forget to book the train tickets in advance.
examples.zh: 不要忘記提前預訂火車票。

examples.en: This library contains thousands of rare English books.
examples.zh: 這座圖書館藏有數千本珍貴的英文書籍。

examples.en: Book your high-speed rail tickets early to enjoy early-bird discounts.
examples.zh: 提早預訂高鐵車票以享受早鳥折扣優惠。

examples.en: We managed to book a boutique hotel overlooking the tranquil ocean.
examples.zh: 我們幸運地預訂到了一間能俯瞰寧靜湛藍海景的精品渡假飯店。

examples.en: She loves curling up in an armchair on weekends to read a captivating book.
examples.zh: 她週末最愛窩在舒適扶手椅裡，靜靜閱讀一本扣人心弦的好書。

explains.en: It is a set of pages joined together with a cover. People read the words or pictures inside. As a verb, it can mean saving a place for a service or event.
This item may tell a story or teach facts. It can be opened and read one page at a time. A person may also reserve a room or seat using the same verb.
It can name something people read for fun or learning. It may contain many pages. As an action, it can mean arranging a place to stay or travel.

examples.en: He felt bored staying home all day on a rainy day.
examples.zh: 雨天整天待在家裡讓他感到很無聊。

examples.en: Children quickly get bored during lengthy adult social gatherings.
examples.zh: 在冗長的大人社交聚會中小孩很快就會感到厭倦無聊。

examples.en: If you ever feel bored, pick up an engaging novel to read.
examples.zh: 如果你感到無聊，不妨拿一本引人入勝的小說來讀。

explains.en: It describes how someone feels when there is little to do. The person may want an interesting activity. A long wait can cause this feeling.
Use this word for a person who does not feel interested. A slow class may cause that feeling. A game or talk can make the time more fun.
This word tells that someone wants more to do. It describes a feeling, not the thing causing it. People may look for a game or book when they feel this way.

examples.en: That long speech was so boring that I fell asleep.
examples.zh: 那場冗長的演講太無聊了，以至於我睡著了。

examples.en: Doing repetitive data entry tasks all day can become quite boring.
examples.zh: 整天做重複性的資料輸入工作可能會變得相當枯燥乏味。

examples.en: Waiting in an endless airport delay line is thoroughly boring.
examples.zh: 在無休止的機場航班延誤隊伍中等候極其無聊。

explains.en: It describes something that does not hold someone’s interest. A long talk may feel this way. The person listening may want a new activity.
Use this word for a task or show that feels dull. It does not make people curious or excited. A change may make the time more fun.
This word tells that something is not interesting. A lesson may feel this way when it goes on too long. People may wish to do something different.

examples.en: The child was born in Taipei on a warm spring day.
examples.zh: 這個孩子在溫暖的春日出生於台北。

examples.en: She was born into a family of teachers.
examples.zh: 她出生在一個教師家庭。

examples.en: My grandfather was born in 1940.
examples.zh: 我的祖父出生於1940年。

explains.en: It means that someone has come into life. A person may have a place where this happened. The word is often used when giving a date or place.
This describes the start of a person’s life. People may share the day it happened each year. It can also tell where someone first lived.
Use this word for someone who has started life outside the mother’s body. The day may be written in family records. The place may be a town or country.

examples.en: May I borrow your umbrella? It is pouring.
examples.zh: 我能借用你的雨傘嗎？外面正下著傾盆大雨。

examples.en: Students can borrow up to ten books at a time from our school library.
examples.zh: 學生一次最多可以從我們學校圖書館借閱十本書。

examples.en: English has borrowed many useful words from French, Latin, and German.
examples.zh: 英語從法語、拉丁語與德語中借用了許多實用詞彙。

examples.en: Can I borrow your umbrella until tomorrow afternoon?
examples.zh: 我可以借用你的雨傘到明天下午嗎？

examples.en: University students frequently borrow academic textbooks from the library.
examples.zh: 大學生經常向圖書館借閱學術教科書。

examples.en: He had to borrow money from close friends to start his bakery business.
examples.zh: 他不得不向摯友借錢來開設他的烘焙坊。

examples.en: Can I borrow your English grammar reference book for the weekend?
examples.zh: 這個週末我可以借用一下你的英文文法參考書嗎？

examples.en: Startups often borrow capital from commercial lenders to purchase new machinery.
examples.zh: 新創企業經常向商業銀行借貸營運資金，以購置升級生產機具設備。

examples.en: Writers sometimes borrow motifs from ancient mythology to enrich their novels.
examples.zh: 作家有時會巧妙借用遠古神話傳說的母題，以豐富長篇小說的內涵層次。

entries.definition: 借入；借用；借用（向他人借）

explains.en: It means taking something for a short time and planning to return it. A student may take a pencil from a friend. The owner expects to get it back later.
Use this word when you take something that belongs to someone else for a while. You should return it when you finish. A library lets readers do this with books.
This verb means using another person’s item for a time. The item still belongs to its owner. It should be given back later.

examples.en: The boss praised our team for exceeding this quarter's goal.
examples.zh: 老闆讚揚我們團隊超越了本季目標。

examples.en: A great boss leads by positive example and listens attentively to employee ideas.
examples.zh: 一位卓越的主管會以身作則、樹立典範，並專注傾聽基層同仁的想法。

examples.en: Don't boss people around; cooperation works far better than giving harsh commands.
examples.zh: 別對別人頤指氣使發號施令，平等的相互協作遠勝於生硬強勢的命令。

examples.en: Memorize attack telegraphs to defeat the terrifying dragon final boss.
examples.zh: 仔細觀察並熟記關底首領魔王的大招前搖起手動作，即可在頭目戰中輕鬆化險為夷。

examples.en: She reported her quarterly marketing progress directly to her department boss.
examples.zh: 她在每週一的大部門例會上，直接向部門主管老闆匯報本季度的行銷推廣推進成效。

examples.en: The difficult boss battle requires players to manage cooldowns and dodge area-of-effect spells.
examples.zh: 這場艱苦卓絕的關卡頭目戰役，要求全隊玩家嚴密控管技能冷卻時間並精準走位閃避大範圍傷害。

entries.definition: 老闆；主管；發號施令；關底首領；頭目；老闆 (Boss)

explains.en: This is a person who leads workers or gives them tasks. The person may run a shop or office. As a verb, it can mean giving someone orders in a strong way.
A worker may report to this person. The leader helps decide what the team should do. The verb can describe acting as if others must obey you.
This word names someone in charge at work. The person may guide a group. It can also mean speaking to others in a forceful way.

examples.en: Both of my parents are hardworking teachers.
examples.zh: 我的父母兩位都是辛勤敬業的老師。

examples.en: Taiwan is famous for both modern semiconductor technology and rich traditional culture.
examples.zh: 台灣以頂尖的現代半導體科技以及深厚的傳統文化兼美著稱。

examples.en: Both candidates presented compelling policy proposals during the televised debate.
examples.zh: 兩位候選人在電視辯論會中皆提出了引人注目的政策建言。

explains.en: It means two people or things together. The same idea applies to each one. It can answer a question about two members of a group.
Use this word when talking about two members of a pair. It shows that each one is included. The sentence may use it before a plural noun.
This word includes two things at the same time. It can describe two people who share an action. It points to the pair as a whole.

examples.en: Bring a reusable water bottle to reduce plastic waste.
examples.zh: 攜帶可重複使用的水瓶以減少塑膠垃圾。

examples.en: She opened a fresh bottle of milk for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她開了一瓶新鮮牛奶當早餐。

examples.en: Remember to recycle glass bottles properly.
examples.zh: 記得妥善回收玻璃瓶。

explains.en: This is a container with a narrow top. It is often made of glass or plastic. As a verb, it can mean putting a drink into such a container.
People keep water, juice, or milk inside this container. A lid may close its small opening. The same word can describe filling containers with a drink.
This word names a vessel for holding liquid. It may have a cap on top. A factory can use the verb when it fills many of them.

examples.en: Sign your full name at the bottom of the page.
examples.zh: 在頁面底部簽上你的全名。

examples.en: Colorful sea coral thrives at the bottom of the shallow reef.
examples.zh: 色彩繽紛的珊瑚在淺礁底部茂盛生長。

examples.en: The bottom line of business negotiation is reaching mutual profitability.
examples.zh: 商業談判的底線是達成互利雙贏。

explains.en: This is the lowest part of something. It may also describe the least high position in a group. As a verb, it can mean putting something in the lowest position.
It can name the part under everything else. It may also describe the last position in a list. A person can place an item there.
This is the lowest part of something. It may also describe the least high position in a group. As a verb, it can mean placing something in the lowest position.

examples.en: The dancers took a bow after the show.
examples.zh: 表演結束後，舞者們鞠躬致意。

examples.en: She tied a red bow on the birthday gift.
examples.zh: 她在生日禮物上綁了一個紅色蝴蝶結。

examples.en: The actor bowed to the audience.
examples.zh: 演員向觀眾鞠躬。

explains.en: People may tie this shape on a gift or in someone’s hair. It can also mean bending the head or upper body to show respect. The way it is said helps show the meaning.
This word can name two loops of ribbon tied in the middle. It can also mean lowering the head to show thanks or respect. A person may do this after a performance.
A ribbon can be folded into this shape. A person may also bend forward in a polite way. Context tells which meaning is intended.

examples.en: I had a hot bowl of wonton soup for lunch.
examples.zh: 我中午吃了一碗熱騰騰的餛飩湯。

examples.en: Mix the eggs and sugar in a large ceramic bowl.
examples.zh: 在大瓷碗裡將雞蛋和糖攪拌均勻。

examples.en: She poured fresh milk into the cat's feeding bowl.
examples.zh: 她把新鮮牛奶倒進貓咪的食盆裡。

explains.en: This is a deep, round dish used for food. People may eat soup or cereal from it. It can also hold a single serving of food.
It is a round container with curved sides. A person can use it for soup, rice, or fruit. The word may also mean the amount held inside.
This dish is deeper than a plate. It can hold liquid or small pieces of food. People often eat a meal from one.

examples.en: Please put your toys in the box.
examples.zh: 請把玩具放進箱子裡。

examples.en: He boxed the books before moving day.
examples.zh: 搬家前，他把書裝進箱子。

examples.en: The gift came in a small blue box.
examples.zh: 禮物裝在一個藍色小盒子裡。

explains.en: This is a container with firm sides and a lid. People keep toys or tools inside it. As a verb, it can mean placing things into such a container.
It is often square or rectangular and used to hold items. It may be made from paper, wood, or plastic. A person can put things inside it for storage.
This word can name a container used for moving or storing things. It usually has flat sides. The verb can mean packing items in one.

examples.en: The little boy is playing with a toy car.
examples.zh: 那個小男孩正在玩玩具車。

examples.en: The boy won first prize in the speech contest.
examples.zh: 那個男孩在演講比賽中獲得第一名。

examples.en: Three boys are riding their bicycles by the riverside.
examples.zh: 三個男孩正在河濱騎腳踏車。

explains.en: This is a male child or young person. He may be someone’s son or brother. The word usually describes a person who has not yet grown into an adult.
A young male person has this name. He may go to school or play with friends. His family may use the word for him while he is a child.
This word names a male child. He may live with parents or other family members. As he grows older, people may use a different word.

examples.en: The little boy was brave when getting a vaccination.
examples.zh: 小男孩打預防針時非常勇敢。

examples.en: Firefighters are remarkably brave heroes who risk life to save others.
examples.zh: 消防員是冒生命危險拯救他人的無比英勇英雄。

examples.en: It takes brave determination to admit fault and apologize sincerely.
examples.zh: 承認錯誤並誠懇道歉需要無比的勇氣與決心。

examples.en: Firefighters are brave heroes who protect our neighborhoods.
examples.zh: 消防隊員是保衛我們社區安全的英勇英雄。

examples.en: It was a brave decision to leave her stable corporate job and pursue painting.
examples.zh: 毅然辭去穩定的大企業高薪職務全心追逐純藝術繪畫夢想，需要極大勇氣。

examples.en: The brave little girl did not shed a single tear while getting her flu vaccine shot.
examples.zh: 這位勇敢堅強的小女孩在接受流感疫苗針劑注射時，連一滴眼淚都沒有掉。

entries.definition: 勇敢的；勇敢面對；英勇的

explains.en: It describes someone who faces danger without giving up. The person may help someone in need. A hard task may feel less scary to someone this way.
Use this word for someone who acts even when afraid. The person may protect another child. It can also describe a choice that takes courage.
This word tells that someone is not easily stopped by fear. They may speak up when something is wrong. They may also try a difficult task.

examples.en: We bought fresh toast bread from the bakery.
examples.zh: 我們從麵包店買了新鮮吐司麵包。

examples.en: He spread strawberry jam on a slice of bread.
examples.zh: 他在一片麵包上抹了草莓果醬。

examples.en: Whole wheat bread is a healthy choice for breakfast.
examples.zh: 全麥麵包是早餐的健康選擇。

explains.en: This is a common food made from flour and water. It is baked in an oven. People may eat it with soup or use it to make a sandwich.
People may toast this food for breakfast. It can be soft or crisp. A baker makes it from flour, water, and other ingredients.
This word names a baked food made from grain. It may have a soft inside and a firm outside. Many people serve it with meals.

examples.en: Installing a thermal break between the balcony slab and living room floor eliminates cold bridging condensation.
examples.zh: 在陽台樓板與客廳之間加裝斷熱隔熱層，能消除冷橋效應並根絕牆面結露發霉。

examples.en: High-performance aluminum window profiles incorporate a polyamide thermal break to reduce conductive heat flow.
examples.zh: 高性能斷橋鋁合金門窗在型材中穿入聚醯胺隔熱條，大幅切斷金屬框體傳導的戶外熱量。

examples.en: Without a structural thermal break, winter cold travels directly into concrete interior walls.
examples.zh: 若未在結構交接處設計斷熱熱阻隔層，冬季刺骨凍氣會沿著鋼筋混凝土樓板直接傳導進室內牆面。

entries.definition: 消除冷橋效應之斷熱熱阻隔層；打破

explains.en: It can mean making two pieces separate. A toy may come apart when it falls. It can also mean resting for a short time.
Use this word when something is split or damaged. It may also name a short rest during work or school. The sentence tells which sense is used.
This verb can mean causing something to stop working or stay in one piece. It can also mean pausing an activity. People may take one between lessons.

examples.en: I usually eat egg pancakes for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐通常吃蛋餅。

examples.en: Breakfast is the most important meal of the day.
examples.zh: 早餐是一天中最重要的一餐。

examples.en: Dad made us a delicious breakfast with toast and eggs.
examples.zh: 爸爸為我們做了包含吐司和雞蛋的美味早餐。

explains.en: This is the first meal of the day. People often eat it in the morning. Eggs, fruit, or toast may be served.
People eat this meal after waking up. It gives them energy for the day. Some families enjoy it together before work or school.
This word names a morning meal. A person may eat cereal or bread during it. The name is linked to ending the night without food.

examples.en: The bridge connects the two riverbanks together.
examples.zh: 這座橋樑將兩座河岸連接在一起。

examples.en: Cultural exchange programs help bridge misunderstandings between different nations.
examples.zh: 文化交流計畫有助於消除各國之間的誤解並搭建溝通橋樑。

examples.en: The scenic suspension bridge sways gently in the mountain breeze.
examples.zh: 這座風景秀麗的吊橋在山谷微風中輕輕搖曳。

examples.en: The Danjiang Bridge will be a stunning landmark across the river.
examples.zh: 淡江大橋將成為橫跨河面的迷人地標。

examples.en: Pedestrians can cross the busy avenue using the elevated foot bridge.
examples.zh: 行人可利用高架人行陸橋跨越繁忙的大街。

examples.en: Cultural exchange programs help bridge misunderstandings between nations.
examples.zh: 文化交流計畫有助於消除各國之間的誤解隔閡。

examples.en: The carved rosewood bridge anchors the nylon strings and transfers vibrations directly into the soundboard.
examples.zh: 精雕細琢的玫瑰木「琴橋」（Bridge），牢牢固定尼龍琴弦並將振動能量瞬時傳導至共鳴面板。

examples.en: Pedestrians crossed the historic stone bridge to enter the cobblestone market square.
examples.zh: 絡繹不絕的散步遊客緩步穿過古老的石拱橋，漫步走入鋪滿鵝卵石的熱鬧傳統市集廣場。

examples.en: Learning a foreign language serves as an empathetic bridge connecting distinct cultures together.
examples.zh: 認真學習一門外國語言，是連結不同文化背景人群、消弭偏見與增進同理心的美好心靈橋樑。

examples.en: Solid German silver bridges secure moving wheels while showcasing flawless parallel striped decorations.
examples.zh: 德國銀打造的「機芯夾板」（Bridges）牢牢固定旋轉齒輪，表面展示著一絲不苟的日內瓦波紋飾面。

examples.en: The majestic Golden Gate suspension bridge spans the entrance to San Francisco Bay with iconic orange towers.
examples.zh: 巍峨聳立的舊金山金門大橋懸索橋以其標誌性的國際橘橋塔橫跨海灣入口，是全球建築史上永恆的地標。

examples.en: Skilled diplomatic translators bridge language barriers to foster genuine mutual trust during summits.
examples.zh: 技藝卓越的資深外交同步口譯員，以精準傳神的翻譯跨越各國語言藩籬，在高峰會談中奠定互信基石。

examples.en: Language acts as a powerful bridge that connects hearts across oceans, continents, and cultures.
examples.zh: 語言是一座無堅不摧的「心靈溝通橋樑」（Bridge），跨越大洋與大洲，將世界各地的人心緊緊相連。

examples.en: International cultural exchange programs help bridge the understanding gap between generations.
examples.zh: 跨國青年文化交流計畫，有效協助消弭不同世代與文化背景之間的認知與理解隔閡。

examples.en: The new suspension bridge drastically reduced travel time between the mountain village and the city.
examples.zh: 這座嶄新落成的壯麗吊橋，大幅縮短了山區偏遠聚落與都會中心之間的往返通勤時間。

entries.definition: 橋樑；架橋；跨越；將琴弦振動高效傳導至面板之玫瑰木琴橋；橋；飾以日內瓦波紋之機芯夾板與擺輪夾板；成為連結台灣與世界各國友好往來之溝通橋樑

explains.en: This is a structure built over water or a road. It lets people cross from one side to another. It can also mean joining two places or ideas.
People walk or drive across this structure. It may stretch over a river or valley. The same word can describe making a link between separate groups.
This word names a way to cross an open space. Strong supports hold it up. It can also mean connecting two things.

examples.en: Sunshine is bright and warm on a sunny spring morning.
examples.zh: 春天陽光普照的早晨，陽光明媚又溫暖。

examples.en: She has a bright mind and constantly invents creative solutions to puzzles.
examples.zh: 她思維敏捷聰穎，總是能針對難題提出極富創意的解方。

examples.en: Diligent study today lays the foundation for a bright and successful future.
examples.zh: 今日勤奮用功的研讀為光明燦爛且成功的未來奠定基石。

explains.en: It describes something that gives off much light. It can also describe a quick mind. A clear and happy color may have this quality.
Use this word for a light that is easy to see. It may also describe someone who learns quickly. It can tell that colors look fresh and strong.
This word can describe a place full of light. It can also describe a clever person. A cheerful day may look this way.

examples.en: Don't forget to bring your textbook tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天別忘了帶你的課本來。

examples.en: The spring rain brings green life back to dry mountain hills.
examples.zh: 春雨讓乾燥的山丘重現翠綠生機。

examples.en: You can bring a friend along to our weekend study session.
examples.zh: 你可以帶一位朋友一起參加我們週末的讀書會。

explains.en: It means carrying something toward a person or place. A friend may take food to a picnic. The thing moves closer to the person speaking.
Use this word when someone takes an item to a place where they are going. A child may carry a book to school. The item comes closer to the speaker or listener.
This verb tells that someone takes something along to a place. It may be food, a gift, or a tool. The thing ends up near the person being spoken to.

examples.en: My elder brother is studying in college.
examples.zh: 我的哥哥正在念大學。

examples.en: I often play video games with my younger brother.
examples.zh: 我經常和我弟弟一起玩電動遊戲。

examples.en: Does your brother work in Taipei or Kaohsiung?
examples.zh: 你哥哥在台北還是高雄工作？

explains.en: This is a boy or man who has the same parents as you. He may be older or younger. The word can also mean a close male friend in some groups.
A family may have two or more sons. One son can use this word for another. It may also be used kindly for a fellow member of a group.
This word names a male child in the same family as you. The person may share one or both parents. Friends may also use it to show closeness.

examples.en: The puppy has lovely brown eyes.
examples.zh: 這隻小狗有一對可愛的棕色眼睛。

examples.en: Dry leaves turned brown and fell gently from the trees.
examples.zh: 枯葉變成了褐色，從樹上輕輕飄落。

examples.en: He wore a stylish pair of dark brown leather shoes.
examples.zh: 他穿了一雙時髦的深棕色皮鞋。

explains.en: It names the color of tree bark or soil. It can describe a color between red and yellow. As a verb, it can mean cooking food until its surface turns this color.
This warm color can be seen in wood and many animals. It may describe a person’s hair or eyes. Food can change to this color when it cooks.
Use this word for a dark earth color. It can describe clothes, fur, or furniture. As an action, it means making food turn darker in a pan.

examples.en: Programmers worked through the night to fix the critical software bug.
examples.zh: 程式設計師徹夜奮戰以修復關鍵的軟體程式錯誤。

examples.en: Users discovered an unexpected bug that caused the app to close abruptly.
examples.zh: 使用者發現了一個導致應用程式突然閃退的意外錯誤。

examples.en: A thorough testing phase helps detect nasty software bugs before release.
examples.zh: 全面的測試階段有助於在軟體發布前找出棘手的程式漏洞。

explains.en: This is a small insect. It can also mean a mistake in a computer program. A hidden listening device may have this name too.
A tiny creature may crawl on the ground. In computer work, the same word names an error that makes a program behave wrongly. It can also name a small device that listens secretly.
This word can mean a small crawling creature. It may also describe a problem in computer code. In another use, it names a secret listening device.

examples.en: Workers will build a new bridge over the river.
examples.zh: 工人將在河上建造一座新橋。

examples.en: The children built a sandcastle on the beach.
examples.zh: 孩子們在海灘上堆了一座沙堡。

examples.en: We want to build a strong friendship.
examples.zh: 我們想建立深厚的友誼。

entries.definition: （動）建造；建立；逐步培養或形成。

explains.en: It means making or putting parts together. People may use wood to create a table. A team can also make trust over time.
Use this word when creating something by joining pieces. Workers may make a house from many materials. It can also mean growing a skill or relationship.
This verb tells that someone makes something that did not exist in that form. It may be a toy, road, or home. It can also mean growing something step by step.

examples.en: We waited at the bus stop for twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 我們在公車站牌等了二十分鐘。

examples.en: You can tap your transportation card when you board the bus.
examples.zh: 上公車時你可以感應交通卡。

examples.en: The number 285 bus takes you directly to the museum.
examples.zh: 285 路公車可以直接載你到博物館。

explains.en: This is a large road vehicle that carries many people. It follows a set route and stops to let riders on or off. Students often ride one to school.
People pay to ride this vehicle through town. It has seats for many passengers. It stops at marked places along its route.
This word names public transport with many seats. A driver takes riders between stops. It may carry children to school or workers across a city.

examples.en: Taiwan is famous for its friendly small-business environment.
examples.zh: 台灣以其友善中小企業的經商環境著稱。

examples.en: She decided to start an online boutique business selling handmade ceramics.
examples.zh: 她決定開創一家線上選品店生意，專門販售手工陶瓷藝品。

examples.en: It is none of your personal business how he spends his weekend leisure time.
examples.zh: 他週末休閒時間究竟如何度過，純屬個人隱私，與你毫無關係。

explains.en: It can mean buying and selling goods or services. It can also name a company or a person’s work matters. A shop is one kind of this activity.
People earn money by selling things or doing work for customers. A company may have many workers. The word can also mean a person’s own matters.
This word names work done to earn money. A store or company may do it. It can also refer to tasks that need attention.

examples.en: Dad is busy preparing for his morning presentation.
examples.zh: 爸爸正忙著準備早上的簡報。

examples.en: Zhongxiao East Road is one of the busiest streets in Taipei.
examples.zh: 忠孝東路是台北最繁忙熱鬧的街道之一。

examples.en: I am too busy this week to join the weekend hiking trip.
examples.zh: 我這週太忙了，無法參加週末的登山行程。

explains.en: It describes someone who has many things to do. A person may not have much free time. A shop can also have many customers.
Use this word when a person is working or doing tasks. It can describe a place with many people. A full day may leave little time to rest.
This word tells that someone has a lot to do. It may describe a street full of activity. People may say they are this way during a hard week.

examples.en: He worked hard, but he still needs more practice.
examples.zh: 他很努力，但仍需要更多練習。

examples.en: The shoes look stylish, but they feel rather uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 這雙鞋看起來時髦，但穿起來相當不舒服。

examples.en: She was nervous before giving her presentation, but she performed exceptionally well.
examples.zh: 她在簡報前很緊張，但她表現得非常出色。

explains.en: It joins two ideas that do not agree. It can also mean except for one thing. A sentence may use it to show a difference.
Use this word to show a contrast. It may also leave one thing out of a group. The next words help show the meaning.
This small word can connect an idea with a different one. It may mean that one thing is the only exception. It often changes the direction of a sentence.

examples.en: Spread a thin layer of butter on warm toast.
examples.zh: 在熱吐司上抹上一層薄薄的奶油。

examples.en: Melt the unsalted butter in a skillet before frying pancakes.
examples.zh: 煎鬆餅前先將無鹽奶油放在平底鍋中融化。

examples.en: Fresh homemade cookies smell rich because of high-grade butter.
examples.zh: 剛出爐的手工餅乾因使用頂級奶油而散發濃郁香氣。

examples.en: Using churned French AOP cultured butter gives puff pastry its signature nutty aroma and golden flakiness.
examples.zh: 選用正統法國 AOP 產區天然發酵奶油，賦予千層酥皮招牌的濃郁榛果香與金黃酥脆度。

examples.en: High fat content in European dry butter makes it pliable for rolling without breaking under cold temperatures.
examples.zh: 歐洲高乳脂天然發酵無水奶油具備優異的延展韌性，在低溫壓延時不易斷裂融化破皮。

examples.en: Slow churning fresh cream develops probiotic lactic aromas that elevate the flavor of plain brioche.
examples.zh: 慢速木桶攪乳發酵鮮奶油產生獨特乳酸微酸香氣，讓樸實無華的布里歐麵包風味昇華至新高度。

entries.definition: 奶油；塗奶油；法國 AOP 產區認證天然發酵奶油

explains.en: This is a soft yellow food made from milk. People spread it on bread or use it in cooking. As a verb, it can mean covering food with it.
It is made by turning cream into a smooth food. A cook may melt it in a pan. People may spread it on toast.
This word names a dairy food used in many meals. It can make baked goods soft. A person may coat bread with it.

examples.en: Taiwan is famously known as the Kingdom of Butterflies.
examples.zh: 台灣以「蝴蝶王國」的美譽聞名。

examples.en: A brightly colored butterfly landed gently on the blooming rose petal.
examples.zh: 一隻色彩鮮豔的蝴蝶輕盈地停在盛開的玫瑰花瓣上。

examples.en: Caterpillars transform miraculously into gorgeous winged butterflies.
examples.zh: 毛毛蟲奇蹟般地蛻變為美麗的彩蝶。

explains.en: This insect has broad wings that are often colorful. It begins life as an egg. A caterpillar hatches from the egg and later changes into the flying adult.
The adult often visits flowers to drink nectar. Its wings may have bright patterns or dull colors. Different patterns can help it hide or warn other animals away.
The young caterpillar often eats leaves and grows quickly. It later forms a hard covering called a chrysalis. Inside, its body changes before the winged adult comes out.

examples.en: Press the green button to start the game.
examples.zh: 按下綠色按鈕開始遊戲。

examples.en: My coat has three buttons on the front.
examples.zh: 我的外套前面有三顆鈕扣。

examples.en: She buttoned her shirt before leaving.
examples.zh: 她離開前扣好了襯衫鈕扣。

explains.en: This is a small part on clothing or a machine. People press it to close a shirt or start a device. As a verb, it can mean fastening something this way.
A shirt may have several round pieces used to keep it closed. A device may have one that a person presses to choose an action. This word can also name the act of fastening clothes.
It can name a small fastener on a coat. It can also be a part that someone presses on a machine. The verb means closing something with such a fastener.

examples.en: I want to buy a new pencil case.
examples.zh: 我想買一個新的鉛筆盒。

examples.en: Where did you buy those cool white sneakers?
examples.zh: 你在哪裡買那雙酷炫的白色球鞋？

examples.en: Many people prefer to buy daily necessities online.
examples.zh: 許多人偏好在網路上購買生活必需品。

examples.en: I want to buy some fresh fruit at the market.
examples.zh: 我想在市場買些新鮮水果。

examples.en: Where did you buy that comfortable ergonomic backpack?
examples.zh: 你在哪裡買那個符合人體工學的舒適背包？

examples.en: Many consumers prefer to buy eco-friendly products to reduce waste.
examples.zh: 許多消費者偏好購買環保產品以減少浪費。

explains.en: It means giving money to get something. A person may pay for food at a shop. It can also name the thing someone gets with money.
Use this word when trading money for goods. A child may get a toy at a store. It may also mean a good deal or bargain.
This action means paying to own or use something. People may do it in shops or online. The word can also name the thing that was obtained.

examples.en: We travel around Taipei easily by MRT.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘捷運輕鬆暢遊台北。

examples.en: The cozy cafe is located by the picturesque riverside walkway.
examples.zh: 那家溫馨的咖啡館就座落在風景如畫的河畔步道旁。

examples.en: Please submit your final project reports by five o'clock on Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 請在週五下午五點以前繳交你們的期末專案報告。

explains.en: It can tell how something is done. It may also show that one thing is beside another. When used with a time, it can mean no later than that time.
Use this word to name a method or tool. It can point to a place beside something. It can also set a latest time for an action.
This short word may tell who made something or what tool was used. It can show a position close to an object. It may also mean before a stated deadline.

examples.en: We bought a chocolate birthday cake for Lucy.
examples.zh: 我們為露西買了一個巧克力生日蛋糕。

examples.en: Solving this basic algebra problem is a piece of cake for him.
examples.zh: 解開這道基礎代數題目對他來說簡直易如反掌。

examples.en: She decorated the strawberry shortcake with whipped cream and fresh mint leaves.
examples.zh: 她用鮮奶油與新鮮薄荷葉點綴草莓蛋糕。

explains.en: This is a sweet baked food. It may be made for a birthday or other special day. People often cut it into slices.
A baker mixes flour, eggs, and sugar to make this treat. It may have cream or fruit on top. Families often share it at parties.
This word names a soft sweet food from an oven. It may be round or square. A person can add frosting to its top.

examples.en: I will call my grandmother after school.
examples.zh: 放學後我會打電話給祖母。

examples.en: The teacher called the students into the room.
examples.zh: 老師叫學生們進入教室。

examples.en: We heard a call for help near the river.
examples.zh: 我們聽見河邊有人呼救。

entries.definition: （動）打電話；呼叫；叫作；邀請；（名）電話；呼喊；拜訪

explains.en: It means speaking to someone or using a phone to reach them. It can also name a short visit or a loud shout. The sentence gives the sense.
Use this word when asking someone to come or when contacting them by phone. It can also name a decision made by a judge. A loud voice may use it to get attention.
This word can mean trying to reach someone with your voice or phone. It can name a short visit to a place. It may also mean giving something a name.

examples.en: He bought a new digital camera for photography.
examples.zh: 他買了一台新的數位相機來攝影。

examples.en: Smile and look directly at the camera lens!
examples.zh: 微笑並直視相機鏡頭！

examples.en: Security cameras are installed throughout the school hallways for safety.
examples.zh: 學校走廊各處皆安裝了監視攝影機以維護安全。

explains.en: This is a device that takes pictures. It may use a phone or a separate machine. The picture can be saved or printed.
People use this tool to capture a moment. It has a lens that lets light in. Some models can also record moving pictures.
This word names a device for making photographs. A person looks through it or at a screen. Pressing a control saves the image.

examples.en: We camped near the lake for two nights.
examples.zh: 我們在湖邊露營了兩晚。

examples.en: The children set up a camp under the tall trees.
examples.zh: 孩子們在高大的樹下搭起營地。

examples.en: Our class will camp in the mountains next week.
examples.zh: 我們班下週要到山上露營。

explains.en: This is a place where people sleep in tents. It may be set up in a forest or near a lake. As a verb, it means staying overnight outdoors.
Families may stay in tents at this outdoor place. They can cook meals over a small flame. The verb describes spending a night in such a place.
This word names a temporary outdoor place for sleeping. People may bring tents and sleeping bags. It can also mean staying outdoors overnight.

examples.en: You can borrow up to ten books from the library.
examples.zh: 你可以在圖書館借多達十本書。

examples.en: Open a can of tuna to make delicious sandwiches for lunch.
examples.zh: 開一罐鮪魚罐頭做美味的三明治當午餐。

examples.en: With sufficient determination and practice, anyone can learn a foreign language.
examples.zh: 只要有足夠的決心與練習，任何人都能學會一門外語。

explains.en: This helper verb shows that an action is possible for someone. The same spelling names a metal container for food or drink. The related action means preserving food inside such a container.
Use this small verb to talk about skill or permission. The same word names a metal vessel. People may preserve food inside one.
This word may tell that an action is possible. It may also name a container with a lid. A factory seals food inside one.

examples.en: Many baseball fans wear team caps.
examples.zh: 許多棒球迷都會戴球隊的棒球帽。

examples.en: Twist the bottle cap tightly to avoid leaking water.
examples.zh: 旋緊瓶蓋以防漏水。

examples.en: He pulled his black baseball cap down low over his forehead.
examples.zh: 他把黑色的棒球帽壓低到額頭前。

explains.en: This is a soft hat with a rounded top. It may have a flat part that shades the eyes. A container’s cover may also have this name.
People wear this head covering in sunny weather. It can have a short front edge. The word can also mean putting a limit on something.
This word names a simple hat or lid. It can shade someone’s face. As a verb, it can mean setting a highest amount.

examples.en: My dad washes his car every Sunday.
examples.zh: 我爸爸每週日都洗車。

examples.en: It is difficult to find a parking space for your car downtown.
examples.zh: 在市中心很難為你的車找到停車位。

examples.en: We decided to rent a car for our road trip across the island.
examples.zh: 我們決定租一輛車在島上展開公路旅行。

explains.en: This is a road vehicle with an engine. It usually carries a small number of people. Families use one to travel from place to place.
People sit inside this vehicle while a driver steers it. It has four wheels and usually runs on fuel or power. It can take a family on a trip.
This word names a private road vehicle. It often has seats for four or more people. A driver uses it to carry passengers or goods.

examples.en: We made a handmade card for Mother's Day.
examples.zh: 我們在母親節做了一張手作卡片。

examples.en: You can tap your transport card to ride buses, trains, and the MRT.
examples.zh: 你可以感應交通卡搭乘公車、火車與捷運。

examples.en: The referee showed the soccer player a yellow warning card.
examples.zh: 裁判向該名足球運動員出示了一張黃牌警告。

explains.en: This is a small piece of stiff paper or plastic. It may carry a message or picture. People can also use it to play games.
A person may send one to a friend for a holiday. It may show a name or account number. A deck of these is used in many games.
This word can name a greeting with a written note. It may also be used to pay or prove identity. Players use special ones for games.

examples.en: We care deeply about animal welfare and nature.
examples.zh: 我們非常關心動物福利與大自然。

examples.en: Thank you for your thoughtful advice; take care of yourself!
examples.zh: 謝謝你貼心的建議，請多保重身體！

examples.en: Excellent medical care saved the critically injured patient's life.
examples.zh: 精湛的醫療照護挽救了重傷病患的生命。

examples.en: Teachers care about their students' growth and safety.
examples.zh: 老師們關心學生的成長與安全。

examples.en: I don't really care whether we go by train or bus as long as we arrive early.
examples.zh: 只要能早點抵達，我並不在意我們是搭火車還是搭公車。

examples.en: Take good care of your health by exercising and eating a balanced diet.
examples.zh: 透過運動與均衡飲食好好照顧自己的健康。

entries.definition: 在意；照顧；關心；在乎；照料

explains.en: It can mean feeling that something matters to you. It can also mean helping someone or looking after them. As a noun, it can name attention or worry.
Use this word when someone feels concern for another person. It can also describe giving help. A person may show it by listening or sharing.
This word may describe being interested in what happens to someone. It can mean giving help or protection. It can also name a feeling of concern.

examples.en: Be careful when pouring hot boiling water.
examples.zh: 倒滾燙熱水時要小心。

examples.en: A careful driver always keeps a safe following distance on highways.
examples.zh: 謹慎的駕駛在高速公路上總是保持安全車距。

examples.en: She did a careful inspection of the contract before signing her name.
examples.zh: 在簽名前，她對合約進行了仔細審慎的檢查。

explains.en: It describes someone who thinks before acting. The person tries not to make a mistake. They may check their work twice.
Use this word for a person who takes time to avoid danger or errors. A driver should pay close attention. A student may handle glass gently.
This word tells that someone is not careless. They notice risks and act with thought. It may describe work done with thought or safe behavior.

examples.en: Carrots are rich in vitamin A, which is good for vision.
examples.zh: 胡蘿蔔富含維生素 A，對視力有益。

examples.en: Rabbits enjoy nibbling on fresh crunchy raw carrots.
examples.zh: 兔子喜歡啃食新鮮爽脆的生胡蘿蔔。

examples.en: Chop the carrots into bite-sized cubes for vegetable soup.
examples.zh: 把胡蘿蔔切成適口的小丁塊放進蔬菜湯裡。

explains.en: This is a long orange root vegetable. People may eat it raw or cooked. It grows under the soil.
A crunchy vegetable has orange skin and a green top. It can be added to soup or salad. Rabbits are often shown eating one.
This word names a sweet root that people cook or eat fresh. It is usually orange. Farmers grow it underground.

examples.en: Let me help you carry those heavy grocery bags.
examples.zh: 讓我幫你提那些沉重的採買袋。

examples.en: Most airline passengers are permitted to carry one bag onto the plane.
examples.zh: 大多數航空公司的乘客都被允許隨身攜帶一件行李上飛機。

examples.en: She always carries an umbrella in her backpack just in case it rains.
examples.zh: 她背包裡總是隨身帶著一把傘，以防下雨。

explains.en: It means holding something and taking it to another place. A child may move books in their arms. A bag can hold items while someone travels.
Use this word when moving an object with your hands or on your body. A person may take groceries home. It can also mean supporting an idea or message.
This verb tells that someone moves something from one place to another. They may hold it or put it in a bag. A vehicle can also take people or goods.

examples.en: The police are looking into the case.
examples.zh: 警方正在調查這個案件。

examples.en: She put her glasses in a hard case.
examples.zh: 她把眼鏡放進硬盒子裡。

examples.en: The lawyer spoke about the case in court.
examples.zh: 律師在法庭上談論這個案件。

entries.definition: （名）案件；情況；盒子或保護套；法律案件。

explains.en: It can mean a situation or event that needs attention. It may also name a container or cover for an object. In law, it can mean a matter brought before a judge.
Use this word for one example of a problem or event. It can also describe a cover that holds something. A lawyer may speak about a matter in court.
This word can name a particular situation. It may refer to a container or covering. It can also mean a legal matter being heard by a judge.

examples.en: The black cat is resting on the windowsill.
examples.zh: 那隻黑貓正趴在窗台上休息。

examples.en: My cat purrs softly whenever I gently stroke its fur.
examples.zh: 每當我輕撫我家的貓咪時，牠便發出輕柔的呼嚕聲。

examples.en: Stray cats in the neighborhood are fed by kind residents.
examples.zh: 社區裡的流浪貓受到好心居民的餵食照顧。

explains.en: This is a small furry animal often kept in a home. It has sharp claws and whiskers. It may make a soft purring sound.
The animal has pointed ears and a long tail. It may chase mice or play with string. Many people keep one as a pet.
This word names a common pet with fur. It can climb and land on its feet. It may sleep for many hours each day.

examples.en: Hurry up! We can still catch the 7:30 train.
examples.zh: 快點！我們還趕得上七點半的火車。

examples.en: Put on a warm coat so you don't catch a cold in the freezing wind.
examples.zh: 穿上保暖大衣，以免在刺骨寒風中感冒。

examples.en: The goalkeeper leaped sideways to catch the high-speed shot.
examples.zh: 守門員側身飛撲接住了高速射門。

explains.en: It means to stop and take hold of something that moves toward you. A player may stop a thrown ball with both hands. It can also mean getting onto a bus in time.
Use this word when grabbing or holding something before it falls. It may also mean reaching a train before it leaves. As a noun, it can name a hidden problem.
This verb means stopping something and taking hold of it. It can describe reaching a ride or a person. A surprise problem may also be called this.

examples.en: Families gather happily together to celebrate the Moon Festival.
examples.zh: 各個家庭歡聚一堂共同慶祝中秋佳節。

examples.en: How do you and your best friends usually celebrate your birthdays?
examples.zh: 你和最要好的朋友們平時通常都如何歡度慶祝生日？

examples.en: Neighbors cheered and celebrated together when our team won the baseball finals.
examples.zh: 當我們球隊贏得棒球總決賽時，街坊鄰居齊聲歡呼並共同熱烈慶祝。

explains.en: It means doing something special for a happy event. People may share food and music. A family can remember a birthday this way.
Use this word when people show joy about a success or holiday. They may have a party or meal. Friends can gather to mark the event.
This verb means marking an important day with joy. People may sing, eat, or spend time together. It can also mean praising a person’s success.

examples.en: I use my cellphone to call my parents.
examples.zh: 我用手機打電話給父母。

examples.en: Please turn off your cellphone during the movie.
examples.zh: 看電影時請關掉手機。

examples.en: Her cellphone has a bright red case.
examples.zh: 她的手機有一個鮮紅色的保護殼。

explains.en: This is a small phone that people can carry in a pocket. It uses signals to make calls away from home. Many also take pictures or send messages.
People use this device to talk while they are outside. It may fit in one hand. It can also connect to the internet.
This word names a phone that travels with its owner. It can send calls, texts, and pictures. A battery gives it power.

examples.en: This notebook costs ninety-nine cents.
examples.zh: 這本筆記本要九十九美分。

examples.en: I found a coin worth one cent.
examples.zh: 我找到一枚價值一美分的硬幣。

examples.en: The price went up by five cents.
examples.zh: 價格上漲了五美分。

entries.definition: 美分；分（美元或加幣的百分之一）

explains.en: This is a small unit of money in the United States and Canada. One hundred of them make one dollar. The coin is worth very little by itself.
People use this money unit when paying a small amount. It is one part of a dollar. A price may end with this unit.
This word names a small amount of money. Many shops show prices using it. A hundred of these equal one dollar.

examples.en: Taichung is situated in central western Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台中位於台灣中西部。

examples.en: The modern civic sports center offers swimming pools and fitness gyms.
examples.zh: 這座現代化的國民運動中心提供游泳池與健身房。

examples.en: Place the birthday cake right in the center of the dining table.
examples.zh: 把生日蛋糕端正地擺放在餐桌正中央。

explains.en: It is the middle point or main part of a place. A town may have shops grouped there. As a verb, it means putting something in the middle.
Use this word for a point with the same distance from the sides. It can also name the most important part of a place. A person may put an object there.
This word can mean the middle of a space. It may name a busy part of town. As an action, it means placing something at the middle point.

examples.en: I am certain that we left the keys at home.
examples.zh: 我確定我們把鑰匙留在家裡了。

examples.en: Certain birds fly south in winter.
examples.zh: 某些鳥類冬天會飛往南方。

examples.en: She felt certain about her answer.
examples.zh: 她對自己的答案很有把握。

entries.definition: （形）確定的；肯定的；某些的；（代）某些人／事物

explains.en: It means known or chosen, but not named exactly. A person may have a particular reason for doing something. The word can also show that someone feels sure.
Use this word when you mean one specific thing without naming it. It may also describe a person who feels sure about an idea. Context tells which sense fits.
This word can mean one particular person or thing. It can also show that someone has no doubt. The sentence gives the intended meaning.

examples.en: Please sit down on that wooden chair.
examples.zh: 請在那張木椅上坐下。

examples.en: There are not enough chairs for all the guests.
examples.zh: 沒有足夠的椅子給所有客人坐。

examples.en: He pulled out a chair and sat down next to me.
examples.zh: 他拉開一張椅子並坐在我身旁。

explains.en: This is a seat with a back, usually made for one person. It may have four legs. As a verb, it can mean leading a meeting.
People sit on this furniture at a table. A person in charge may also lead a group meeting. The same word names that leadership role.
This word names a common piece of furniture. It often has a seat and a back. It can also describe guiding a meeting.
These nouns can name a person who leads a meeting or group. The shorter form is often used for the role. A leader guides discussion and helps the group make decisions.
A committee meets to discuss a new plan. One person keeps the talk in order and invites each member to speak. That person leads the meeting.
A group may choose someone to guide its work for a year. The person may set meeting topics and speak for the group. The role can be held by anyone.

examples.en: We have a chance to win the game.
examples.zh: 我們有機會贏得這場比賽。

examples.en: There is a good chance of rain tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚很有可能下雨。

examples.en: He chanced upon an old friend at the market.
examples.zh: 他在市場偶然遇見一位老朋友。

explains.en: It means a possibility that something may happen. It can also mean a time when someone may try to do something. A lucky event may happen without a plan.
Use this word for an opening to try or succeed. It may describe something that could happen by luck. The sentence tells which sense is meant.
This word points to a possible result. It may also name a good time to act. Some events happen without anyone planning them.

examples.en: Keep the change, thank you very much!
examples.zh: 找零不用找了，非常感謝！

examples.en: He wants to change his career and enter the technology industry.
examples.zh: 他想要轉換職業跑道，進入科技產業發展。

examples.en: The unpredictable mountain climate can change from sunny to rainy in minutes.
examples.zh: 變化莫測的山區氣候可能在幾分鐘內由晴轉雨。

examples.en: Here is your product, and here is your five dollars change.
examples.zh: 這是您的商品，這是找您的五元零錢。

examples.en: Do you have small change for a one-thousand-dollar bill?
examples.zh: 你有一千元大鈔找得開的零錢嗎？

examples.en: Moving to a bustling new city brought a huge change to her lifestyle.
examples.zh: 搬到熱鬧繁華的新城市給她的生活方式帶來了巨大轉變。

explains.en: It means making something different. It can also name coins returned after paying. A person may switch clothes or plans.
Use this word when one thing becomes different. It may name small coins given back at a shop. As a verb, it can mean swapping one item for another.
This word can describe a difference from before. It may also name money returned after a purchase. A person may use the verb when replacing one thing with another.

examples.en: Street food in Taiwan is both delicious and cheap.
examples.zh: 台灣的街頭小吃既美味又便宜。

examples.en: Booking airline flights months in advance helps you secure cheap tickets.
examples.zh: 提早數個月預訂機票能幫你搶到便宜的機票票價。

examples.en: Cheap products sometimes break easily and cost more to replace later.
examples.zh: 劣質便宜的商品有時很容易損壞，日後更換反而花費更多。

explains.en: It describes something that does not cost much money. A small toy may have this price. The word can also mean low in quality.
Use this word for a price that is low. It can help someone save money. It may sometimes describe a thing made with poor materials.
This word tells that something is not expensive. People may look for such items when saving money. The word can also describe poor quality.

examples.en: Double check your test answers before handing it in.
examples.zh: 交卷前仔細核對你的測驗答案。

examples.en: Hotel guests can check in at the reception desk starting from 3:00 PM.
examples.zh: 飯店住客可自下午三點起在接待櫃台辦理入住登記。

examples.en: The technician arrived early to check the building's fire alarms.
examples.zh: 技術人員很早就抵達以檢查大樓的火災警報器。

explains.en: It means looking at something to see if it is right. It can also name a mark placed beside a correct answer. In some places, it names a paper used to pay money.
Use this word when you inspect a list or answer. A small mark may show that something is done. It may also name a way to pay from a bank account.
This word can mean examining something closely. It can name a tick mark on a form. A written payment paper may have this name too.

examples.en: Say cheese before taking the photo!
examples.zh: 拍照前說 cheese（笑一個）！

examples.en: The pizza is topped with melted mozzarella cheese.
examples.zh: 披薩表面鋪滿了熱騰騰融化的莫札瑞拉起司。

examples.en: Gouda and Cheddar are two well-known varieties of cheese.
examples.zh: 高達與切達是兩款著名的起司乳酪品種。

explains.en: This is a food made from milk. It can be soft or hard. People put it on crackers, bread, or pasta.
Milk is turned into this food using special steps. It may have holes or a strong smell. People eat it by itself or with other foods.
This word names a dairy food that comes in many shapes and tastes. It may be sliced or melted. A sandwich often has some inside.

examples.en: Fried chicken cutlet is a famous night market snack.
examples.zh: 炸雞排是著名夜市小吃。

examples.en: Mom is roasting a whole chicken in the oven.
examples.zh: 媽媽正在烤箱裡烤一整隻雞。

examples.en: The farmer feeds the chickens grain every morning.
examples.zh: 農夫每天早上用穀物餵雞。

explains.en: This is a bird people raise for food. Its meat is also eaten in many meals. A young one is called a chick.
The farm bird has feathers and a beak. People may cook its meat for dinner. It lays eggs in a safe place.
This word can name a farm bird or the meat from it. The bird has two legs and wings. Many families eat it in soup or roast meals.

examples.en: Every child loves going to the night market.
examples.zh: 每個小孩子都喜歡逛夜市。

examples.en: The child fell asleep while listening to a bedtime story.
examples.zh: 那個孩子聽著床邊故事睡著了。

examples.en: Parents should spend more quality time with their child.
examples.zh: 父母應該多花有質量的時間陪伴孩子。

explains.en: This is a young person who is not yet an adult. They may go to school and live with family. The word can mean a son or daughter.
A young person needs care from adults. They may learn new things at school. This word is used for someone who has not grown up yet.
This word names a young human. They may play, learn, and grow each day. Adults help keep them safe.

examples.en: Hot chocolate is wonderful on a cold rainy day.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的雨天喝杯熱巧克力真是太棒了。

examples.en: Dark chocolate contains antioxidants that are beneficial to health.
examples.zh: 黑巧克力含有對人體健康有益的抗氧化物質。

examples.en: He gifted a heart-shaped box of artisan chocolates to his sweetheart.
examples.zh: 他送給心上人一盒精緻的手工心型巧克力。

explains.en: This is a sweet food made from cocoa. It may be a bar, a drink, or part of a cake. The color is often dark brown.
People make this treat from seeds that grow in warm places. It may taste sweet or slightly bitter. A person may melt it for a dessert.
This word names a popular sweet food. It can be mixed into cookies or milk. Some kinds are dark, while others have more milk and sugar.

examples.en: You have a choice between tea and juice.
examples.zh: 你可以選茶或果汁。

examples.en: This is a good choice for a rainy day.
examples.zh: 這是雨天的一個好選擇。

examples.en: The choice is yours.
examples.zh: 由你來選擇。

explains.en: It means one thing picked from several possibilities. A person may decide between two paths. The word can also describe something selected.
Use this word for a decision or item picked from a group. A menu may offer several things to select. The sentence may describe the act or the item.
This word points to what someone selects. It can name a decision made after thinking. It may also describe one available item.

examples.en: It is hard to choose between mango ice and bubble tea.
examples.zh: 在芒果冰和珍珠奶茶之間很難做選擇。

examples.en: You can choose from a dozen different fresh pizza toppings.
examples.zh: 你可以從十幾種新鮮的披薩配料中自由選擇。

examples.en: Take your time to carefully choose your college major based on your interests.
examples.zh: 根據自己的興趣，從容且審慎地選擇你的大學主修科系。

explains.en: It means deciding which person or thing you want. Someone may pick a book from a shelf. Thinking about the options can help.
Use this word when selecting one item from several. A student may pick a topic for a project. The selection can be made quickly or after thought.
This verb means picking one possibility. People use it when deciding what to buy or do. It can also mean taking someone for a role.

examples.en: Many people attend morning service at church on Sunday.
examples.zh: 許多人每週日在教堂參加早晨禮拜。

examples.en: The wedding ceremony was held in a picturesque white countryside church.
examples.zh: 婚禮在一座風景如畫的鄉間白色教堂內舉行。

examples.en: The church community organizes charity food drives for needy families.
examples.zh: 教會團體為貧困家庭組織了慈善物資募集活動。

explains.en: This is a building where some people meet for worship. It may have a tall tower or a bell. A group of people may gather there each week.
People visit this place for prayer or a religious service. It may have rows of seats. The building can be old or new.
This word names a place used by a Christian community. People may sing and pray inside. A cross may stand on top of the building.

examples.en: Draw a circle around the correct answer.
examples.zh: 在正確答案周圍畫一個圈。

examples.en: The children circled the playground.
examples.zh: 孩子們繞著遊樂場走。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to sit in a circle.
examples.zh: 老師請我們圍成一圈坐下。

explains.en: This is a round line or shape with every point the same distance from its middle. A child can draw one with a round tool. As a verb, it means drawing a ring around something.
It is a closed curved shape. A clock face often has this form. A person may mark an item by drawing around it.
This word names a round shape with no corners. It can also mean moving around something. A person may draw a ring on a page to show an answer.

examples.en: Taipei is a busy city with many shops.
examples.zh: 台北是一座有許多商店的繁忙城市。

examples.en: My uncle moved to the city for work.
examples.zh: 我的叔叔為了工作搬到城市裡。

examples.en: The city built a new park near the river.
examples.zh: 市政府在河邊建了一座新公園。

explains.en: This is a large place where many people live. It has streets, homes, shops, and offices. Some people travel there for work or school.
A busy place with many buildings and residents has this name. It may have buses, parks, and tall towers. People often move there for jobs.
This word names a large town with many people. It may have hospitals, schools, and stores. Roads connect its different parts.

examples.en: Class begins at eight o'clock.
examples.zh: 八點準時上課。

examples.en: Pay attention in class so you can get good grades.
examples.zh: 上課時要專心，才能拿到好成績。

examples.en: We have six classes every day from Monday to Friday.
examples.zh: 我們從星期一到星期五每天有六節課。

explains.en: It can mean a group of students who learn together. It can also name a lesson or school subject. As a verb, it may mean sorting things into groups.
Use this word for a group that meets to learn. It can also mean a teaching period. A scientist may place items in groups with the verb.
This word may name a school group or one lesson. It can also describe putting similar things together. The meaning depends on the sentence.

examples.en: Let's help clean the classroom after school.
examples.zh: 放學後我們一起幫忙打掃教室吧。

examples.en: Keep your study area clean and organized for better focus.
examples.zh: 保持學習環境整潔有條理有助於提高專注力。

examples.en: Drinking clean boiled water is essential for your body health.
examples.zh: 飲用潔淨的開水對身體健康至關重要。

examples.en: Keep your desk neat, tidy, and clean.
examples.zh: 保持你的書桌整齊又乾淨。

examples.en: Remember to clean the bathroom thoroughly every weekend.
examples.zh: 記得每個週末把浴室徹底打掃乾淨。

examples.en: Drink plenty of clean water to maintain good health.
examples.zh: 多喝純淨的水以維持身體健康。

explains.en: It describes something without dirt. It can also mean making a place free of dirt. A person may wash a table or sweep a floor.
Use this word for something neat and free from stains. It may also name the work of removing dirt. A fresh shirt may look this way.
This word tells that something is not dirty. As an action, it means washing or removing marks. People often do this to rooms and clothes.

examples.en: The sky was clear after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨後天空很晴朗。

examples.en: Please clear the table after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐後請清理桌子。

examples.en: Her explanation made the rule clear.
examples.zh: 她的解釋讓規則變得清楚。

entries.definition: （形）清楚的；晴朗的；（動）清理；清除。

explains.en: It means easy to see through or understand. A glass window may let someone see outside. It can also mean making a space empty or removing things.
Use this word for a view without anything in the way. An explanation may be easy to follow. As an action, it can mean moving items out of a place.
This word can describe water that is not cloudy. It may describe words that are easy to understand. As a verb, it can mean making a path free of objects.

examples.en: The convenience store clerk gave me the receipt.
examples.zh: 便利商店店員把發票遞給了我。

examples.en: The friendly bank clerk helped my father open a new savings account.
examples.zh: 親切的銀行行員協助我父親開立了新的儲蓄帳戶。

examples.en: The hotel desk clerk checked us into our room within minutes.
examples.zh: 飯店櫃檯接待員在數分鐘內便為我們辦理好入住手續。

explains.en: This is a person who works in an office or shop. The person may keep records or help customers. They often answer questions.
A worker with this job helps with papers, money, or forms. People may speak with them at a store counter. The work can involve writing down information.
This word names an office worker who handles records or serves customers. They may answer calls or file papers. A school may have one in its main office.

examples.en: We climbed the hill before sunset.
examples.zh: 我們在日落前爬上山丘。

examples.en: The cat climbed onto the roof.
examples.zh: 貓爬上屋頂。

examples.en: The climb to the top took an hour.
examples.zh: 爬到頂端花了一個小時。

explains.en: It means moving upward using hands and feet. A person may go up a tree or hill. It can also name an upward journey.
Use this word when going up a steep place. A child may use a ladder to reach a treehouse. The action needs hands, feet, or both.
This verb means going higher on a surface. People may do it on a mountain or staircase. The noun can name the act or trip upward.

examples.en: The clock on the wall says 3:00 PM.
examples.zh: 牆上的時鐘顯示下午三點。

examples.en: My alarm clock rang loudly at six this morning.
examples.zh: 我的鬧鐘今天早上六點大聲響起。

examples.en: The convenience store is open around the clock.
examples.zh: 那家便利商店全天候二十四小時營業。

explains.en: This device shows the time. It may hang on a wall or sit on a desk. Some make a sound each hour.
People look at this object to know the hour and minute. It may have hands or a digital screen. A large one may stand in a town square.
This word names something that measures time. It can be worn, hung, or placed on a desk. Its face may show numbers.

examples.en: Please close the window before you leave.
examples.zh: 離開前請把窗戶關上。

examples.en: Amy and Emily have been close friends since elementary school.
examples.zh: 艾咪和艾蜜莉從小學起就是親密好友。

examples.en: The local clinic closes at eight o'clock in the evening.
examples.zh: 在地診所在晚間八點整結束看診。

explains.en: As a verb, it means shutting an opening. As an adjective, it can mean near in distance or feeling strongly connected. The sentence tells which use fits.
Use this word when a door or shop is being shut. It may also describe a place that is not far away. Friends can feel strongly connected too.
This word can mean not open. It can describe a nearby place or a strong friendship. The sound of the word may change with its meaning.

examples.en: She packed warm clothes for the trip.
examples.zh: 她為旅程準備了保暖衣物。

examples.en: The children put on clean clothes.
examples.zh: 孩子們穿上乾淨的衣服。

examples.en: My clothes are in the closet.
examples.zh: 我的衣服在衣櫃裡。

explains.en: These are items people wear on their bodies. Shirts, trousers, and coats belong to this group. They help protect people from weather.
People put these things on when getting dressed. They may be made from cotton, wool, or other materials. A closet often holds many of them.
This word names things worn to cover the body. They can show a person’s style. People wash them when they get dirty.

examples.en: White clouds are floating across the sky.
examples.zh: 白雲在天空中飄浮。

examples.en: Dark clouds gathered quickly before the summer storm.
examples.zh: 夏日暴風雨來臨前，烏雲迅速聚攏。

examples.en: You can store your documents and photos securely in the cloud.
examples.zh: 你可以將文件與相片安全地儲存在雲端。

explains.en: This is a white or gray shape made of tiny drops high in the sky. It may bring rain. Wind can move it across the sky.
A soft-looking mass floats above the ground. It may hide the sun or turn dark before a storm. Some are thin, while others look large and puffy.
This word names a group of water drops in the sky. It can shade the ground. Dark ones may bring rain or snow.

examples.en: I joined the English speaking club this semester.
examples.zh: 我這學期加入了英語演講社。

examples.en: The high school robotics club designed a prize-winning automated machine.
examples.zh: 高中機器人社團設計出了一部榮獲大獎的自動化機器設備。

examples.en: Golfers select the appropriate golf club according to the distance to the hole.
examples.zh: 高爾夫球手會根據與球洞的距離選取適當的球桿。

explains.en: It can mean a group of people who meet for a shared activity. It may also name a heavy stick used in some sports. As a verb, it can mean hitting with such a tool.
A group of friends may meet each week to share an interest. A player may use a wooden tool to hit a ball. The word has both meanings.
This word can name a team or social group. It may also mean a hard stick used in a game. As an action, it can describe striking with that object.

examples.en: Put on a warm coat; it is chilly outside.
examples.zh: 穿上一件保暖大衣，外面很涼。

examples.en: Hang your winter coat on the rack by the entrance.
examples.zh: 把你的冬天大衣掛在玄關旁的衣架上。

examples.en: The doctor put on his white laboratory coat.
examples.zh: 醫生穿上了他的白色實驗大衣。

explains.en: This is a warm piece of clothing worn over other clothes. It usually has sleeves and opens at the front. As a verb, it can mean covering something with a layer.
People wear this garment outdoors when the weather is cool. It may have buttons or a zipper. A layer of paint can also cover an object.
This word names an outer garment that covers the upper body. It may be long or short. As a verb, it means putting a layer around something.

examples.en: My mother drinks a cup of black coffee every morning.
examples.zh: 我媽媽每天早上喝一杯黑咖啡。

examples.en: The smell of freshly brewed coffee filled the kitchen.
examples.zh: 剛煮好的咖啡香氣瀰漫了整個廚房。

examples.en: I prefer iced coffee over hot coffee in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天我喜歡喝冰咖啡勝過熱咖啡。

explains.en: This is a dark drink made from roasted seeds. Many people drink it in the morning. It can be served hot or cold.
People make this drink by pouring hot water through ground seeds. It may taste strong or mild. Milk or sugar can be added.
This word names a popular drink from a tropical plant. The roasted seeds give it a rich taste. It may help people feel more awake.

examples.en: Drink warm water when you have a cold.
examples.zh: 感冒時請多喝溫水。

examples.en: Winter nights in the mountains can get extremely cold.
examples.zh: 山區冬天的夜晚會變得極度寒冷。

examples.en: Catching a cold can be prevented by washing hands regularly.
examples.zh: 經常洗手有助於預防感冒。

examples.en: Detectives reopened the 1985 cold case murder after new microscopic DNA technology became available.
examples.zh: 隨著次世代微量 DNA 鑑識技術問世，警方正式重啟偵辦這起沉冤四十年之久的重大冷案懸案。

examples.en: The veteran investigator spent weekends reviewing dusty boxes of cold case evidence files.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的資深老刑警犧牲週末休假，反覆重新翻閱封存在檔案室角落佈滿灰塵的冷案卷宗。

examples.en: Breakthrough fingerprint matches breathed fresh hope into a thirty-year-old cold disappearance case.
examples.zh: 指紋庫比對技術的重大突破，為這樁塵封長達三十年的失蹤冷案注入了破案的全新曙光。

entries.definition: 冷的；寒冷的；感冒；重啟偵辦沉冤多年之歷史冷案懸案的

explains.en: It describes a low temperature. It can also name an illness that makes someone cough or sneeze. A person may wear a coat on a day like this.
Use this word for weather that feels chilly. It may also mean a common illness of the nose and throat. The sentence makes the meaning clear.
This word tells that something has little heat. It can describe a drink, room, or winter day. It may also name a mild illness.

examples.en: We collect old stamps from many countries.
examples.zh: 我們收集許多國家的舊郵票。

examples.en: The teacher collected our homework.
examples.zh: 老師收齊了我們的作業。

examples.en: They collect money for the animal shelter.
examples.zh: 他們為動物收容所募款。

explains.en: It means bringing many things together. People may pick up stamps or shells as a hobby. A worker may also receive money from customers.
Use this word when gathering items into one place. A museum may bring old objects together. A company may receive fees or payments.
This verb means getting things from different places and putting them together. It can also mean receiving money that is owed. A child may gather stickers.

examples.en: What is your favorite color?
examples.zh: 你最喜歡什麼顏色？

examples.en: The garden is full of vibrant flowers in every color imaginable.
examples.zh: 花園裡開滿了各式各樣顏色鮮豔的花朵。

examples.en: The artist mixed blue and yellow to create a new green color.
examples.zh: 畫家將藍色與黃色調和以創造出嶄新的綠色。

explains.en: It names how something looks, such as red or green. As a verb, it means adding paint or marks to a picture. A rainbow shows many of them.
People use this word for shades seen by the eyes. Painters choose one for a wall. The verb means putting paint on something.
This word names a quality like yellow or purple. It may describe clothing or a flower. As an action, it means making something have a shade.

examples.en: Welcome! Come in and sit down.
examples.zh: 歡迎！請進來坐下。

examples.en: Where do you come from originally?
examples.zh: 你最初來自哪裡？

examples.en: Dreams come true if you work persistently towards them.
examples.zh: 只要持之以恆努力，夢想就會實現。

explains.en: It means moving toward the place where the speaker is. A friend may arrive at your home. It can also mean happening or becoming true.
Use this word when someone moves nearer to you. It may describe reaching a place. It can also tell that a time or event has arrived.
This verb tells that someone arrives at a place. It may also mean that an event happens. The direction is toward the person speaking or listening.

examples.en: This memory foam mattress provides a comfortable night's sleep.
examples.zh: 這款記憶棉床墊能提供整晚極致舒適的睡眠品質。

examples.en: Wear loose, comfortable clothing when taking long-distance international flights.
examples.zh: 搭乘長途跨國長途航班時，請穿著寬鬆舒適的衣物。

examples.en: Are you feeling comfortable with the proposed project timeline?
examples.zh: 您對目前擬議中的專案執行時程感到自在滿意嗎？

explains.en: It describes something that feels easy and pleasant. A soft chair may help someone relax. A person may feel at ease with close friends.
Use this word for a seat or bed that feels good. It can also describe feeling calm with another person. Soft clothes may feel nice on the skin.
This word tells that someone feels relaxed or free from pain. It may describe furniture or clothing. A friendly place may make a guest feel this way.

examples.en: It is common to see birds in the park.
examples.zh: 在公園看到鳥很常見。

examples.en: The two teams have a common goal.
examples.zh: 兩隊有共同的目標。

examples.en: A common garden is shared by the neighbors.
examples.zh: 共用花園由鄰居們共同使用。

entries.definition: （形）常見的；共同的；（名）公地；公共空間。

explains.en: It means usual or found often. Many people may share the same idea or habit. It can also name land owned by a group.
Use this word for something that happens often. It may describe an idea shared by many people. It can also name land held by people together.
This word can mean ordinary or shared by many. It may describe something that is not rare. As a noun, it can name land used by a community.

examples.en: We use computers in our information technology class.
examples.zh: 我們在資訊科技課上使用電腦。

examples.en: Cloud computing allows people to work on computers from anywhere.
examples.zh: 雲端運算讓人們可以在任何地方透過電腦工作。

examples.en: He learned computer programming to create his own video game.
examples.zh: 他學習電腦程式設計以打造屬於自己的電玩遊戲。

explains.en: This is an electronic machine that works with information. People use it to write, learn, or play games. It can connect to the internet.
A person can use this device to store files and do many tasks. It has a screen and keyboard or touch controls. It may be small enough to carry.
This word names a machine that follows instructions and handles information. People use it at school or work. It can show pictures and sound.

examples.en: The store is convenient because it is near our home.
examples.zh: 這家商店離我們家很近，很方便。

examples.en: Online banking is convenient for busy people.
examples.zh: 網路銀行對忙碌的人很方便。

examples.en: A bus stop nearby makes travel convenient.
examples.zh: 附近有公車站讓出行更便利。

explains.en: It describes something that is easy to use or near the place you need. A nearby shop may save time. A simple tool may help with a task.
Use this word for something that makes life easier. A close bus stop may be helpful. A small feature may save effort.
This word tells that something is handy or easy to reach. It may save time or work. A well-placed service can help many people.

examples.en: My mother is a wonderful cook.
examples.zh: 我媽媽是一位手藝精湛的廚師。

examples.en: Dad is cooking fragrant fried noodles in the wok for lunch.
examples.zh: 爸爸正在鍋子裡炒香氣四溢的炒麵當作午餐。

examples.en: Learning how to cook simple meals teaches young people independence.
examples.zh: 學習烹煮簡易餐點能培養年輕人的獨立能力。

explains.en: As a verb, it means preparing food with heat. A person may use a pan or oven. As a noun, it can name the person who makes meals.
Someone with this job prepares meals for others. The verb means heating food until it is ready. A kitchen is the usual place for this work.
This word can name a person who makes food. It can also mean using heat to prepare a meal. A family member may do it at home.

examples.en: Freshly baked chocolate chip cookies smell great.
examples.zh: 現烤的巧克力豆餅乾聞起來好香。

examples.en: We baked buttery sugar cookies together during the Christmas holidays.
examples.zh: 聖誕假期我們一起烤了濃郁奶油糖霜餅乾。

examples.en: Keep your cookies in an airtight jar so they stay crunchy and fresh.
examples.zh: 把餅乾保存在密封罐裡，才能保持酥脆新鮮。

examples.en: Clear browser tracking cookies periodically to protect online privacy.
examples.zh: 定期清理瀏覽器中的網站追蹤 Cookie 能有效保護您的個人線上隱私。

examples.en: Websites must display a banner asking users to accept or decline cookie tracking.
examples.zh: 網站必須顯示橫幅提示框，詢問使用者是否接受或拒絕 Cookie 追蹤。

examples.en: Grandma baked a fresh batch of chocolate chip cookies for the children.
examples.zh: 祖母為孩子們烤了一批剛出爐的新鮮巧克力碎片餅乾。

explains.en: This is a small sweet baked treat. It may have chocolate chips or nuts inside. People often eat one with milk.
A baker makes this treat in an oven. It may be crisp or soft. The snack is often round and easy to hold.
This word names a sweet snack made from dough. It may be flavored with fruit or chocolate. People may pack one for lunch.

examples.en: Autumn evenings are pleasantly cool.
examples.zh: 秋天的夜晚涼爽宜人。

examples.en: That leather motorcycle jacket looks extraordinarily cool.
examples.zh: 那件騎士皮夾克看起來酷極了。

examples.en: Keep your cool and think logically when unexpected problems arise.
examples.zh: 發生意想不到的問題時，保持冷靜並理性思考。

explains.en: It describes a low but pleasant temperature. It can also mean stylish or calm. As a verb, it means making something less warm.
Use this word for shade on a warm day. It can describe a person who seems calm and confident. A drink may be placed in a fridge to lower its heat.
This word can mean slightly cold. It may also describe something fashionable. As an action, it means letting heat leave a thing.

examples.en: Make a copy of this important certificate.
examples.zh: 把這份重要證書影印一份副本。

examples.en: Do not copy answers from your classmate during the quiz.
examples.zh: 隨堂測驗時不要抄襲同學的答案。

examples.en: The best-selling novel sold over one million copies worldwide.
examples.zh: 這本暢銷小說在全球銷售超過一百萬冊。

explains.en: It means making the same thing again. It can also name one item from a set of printed items. A student may write words from a board this way.
Use this word when you make a second version of something. It may be a paper or file that matches the first one. A learner may write text from a book.
This word can name a matching version of an item. It also means making one. People may do it by writing, printing, or saving a file.

examples.en: There is a 7-Eleven on the street corner.
examples.zh: 街角處有一家 7-Eleven 便利商店。

examples.en: We sat in the quiet corner of the café reading our textbooks.
examples.zh: 我們坐在咖啡廳安靜的角落裡閱讀課本。

examples.en: Good news is just around the corner if you remain persistent.
examples.zh: 只要堅持下去，好消息就在轉角不遠處。

examples.en: Hand-finished internal corners with razor-sharp junctions distinguish true haute horlogerie from CNC work.
examples.zh: 鋒利如刀刃、線條完美交會的「內尖角手工倒角」（Internal Corners），是頂級製錶區別於機器量產的終極殿堂。

examples.en: A cozy wooden coffee shop on the street corner serves pour-over coffee and fresh cinnamon rolls.
examples.zh: 開在陽光灑落街角的溫馨木質風獨立咖啡館，午後總是飄散著手沖精品咖啡與剛出爐肉桂捲的誘人香氣。

examples.en: Drivers must slow down when approaching blind mountain road corners to avoid head-on collisions.
examples.zh: 駕駛人在行駛於蜿蜒的高山林道時，每逢視野受阻的盲彎轉角必須提早降速鳴笛，以防止對向會車碰撞。

entries.definition: 街角；角落；轉角；機芯夾板極致考驗功力之尖銳內尖角倒角

explains.en: This is the place where two lines or walls meet. It may also mean a street turn. A person may put a chair there.
A room has this part where two walls join. Cars may turn at one in a road. A small shop may stand there.
This word names a point where two sides meet. It can describe a turning place on a street. People may sit in one of a room.

examples.en: Your answer is correct.
examples.zh: 你的答案是正確的。

examples.en: Please correct the spelling mistake.
examples.zh: 請改正拼字錯誤。

examples.en: The teacher corrected my math work.
examples.zh: 老師訂正了我的數學作業。

explains.en: It means right or free from mistakes. A teacher may say that an answer is good. As a verb, it means fixing an error.
Use this word when an answer matches the facts. It can describe a rule or spelling that is right. The verb means changing a mistake to make it right.
This word tells that something is true or done well. It can describe a good answer. As an action, it means fixing what is wrong.

examples.en: How much does a ticket to Kaohsiung cost?
examples.zh: 一張去高雄的車票要多少錢？

examples.en: The heavy typhoon damage cost the city millions of dollars to repair.
examples.zh: 猛烈的颱風災情讓這座城市花費數百萬元進行修復。

examples.en: High living costs in big cities encourage people to budget carefully.
examples.zh: 大城市高昂的生活成本促使人們必須審慎規劃預算。

examples.en: How much does this box of pineapple cakes cost?
examples.zh: 這盒鳳梨酥要花費多少錢？

examples.en: The total cost of repairing the damaged car was over two thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 修理受損車輛的總成本超過了兩千美元。

examples.en: The delay cost the firm both valuable time and client trust.
examples.zh: 這次延誤使該事務所損失了寶貴的時間與客戶的信任。

entries.definition: 花費；代價；費用；成本；值…錢

explains.en: It means the money needed to buy or do something. It can also name a loss or effort. As a verb, it tells how much money something needs.
Use this word for the price of an item. It can also describe what someone gives up to get a result. The verb may tell the amount of money needed.
This word names the amount paid for something. It may also mean a sacrifice or loss. A shop label shows what an item will take from your money.

examples.en: We sat on the couch and watched a movie.
examples.zh: 我們坐在沙發上看電影。

examples.en: The old couch is soft and comfortable.
examples.zh: 這張舊沙發柔軟又舒適。

examples.en: The dog jumped onto the couch.
examples.zh: 狗跳上了沙發。

entries.definition: （名）沙發；長沙發；（動）用言語表達；措辭

explains.en: This is a long soft seat for two or more people. It may have cushions and arms. People often put it in a living room.
A family may sit together on this wide piece of furniture. It can be covered with cloth or leather. It is made for resting.
This word names a comfortable seat that can hold several people. It often sits in a living room. A person may stretch out on it.

examples.en: Count the apples in the basket.
examples.zh: 數一數籃子裡的蘋果。

examples.en: Your kindness counts more than money.
examples.zh: 你的善意比金錢更重要。

examples.en: The final count was twenty students.
examples.zh: 最後統計共有二十位學生。

entries.definition: （動）數數；計算；重要、有價值；（名）總數；伯爵。

explains.en: It means saying numbers in order. It can also mean that something matters. The total number may be found by adding items.
Use this word when you say how many things there are. It may also mean that an issue is important. A teacher may ask students to add items one by one.
This verb means finding a number of items. It can also describe being important. The noun may name the final number or a report.

examples.en: Canada is a large country.
examples.zh: 加拿大是一個幅員遼闊的國家。

examples.en: They live in the country near a small farm.
examples.zh: 他們住在鄉間一座小農場附近。

examples.en: Our country has many beautiful mountains.
examples.zh: 我們的國家有許多美麗的山。

explains.en: This is a large area with its own people and government. It may have towns, farms, and cities. People may travel to visit another one.
A nation has borders and a government. People who live there may share laws. The word can also mean land outside a busy town.
This word names a nation such as Japan or Canada. It can also describe open land with farms and small towns. A map shows its borders.

examples.en: The six-course wedding banquet concluded with bird's nest sweet soup.
examples.zh: 長達六道佳餚的豪華婚宴在熱騰騰上桌的養生燕窩紅棗甜湯中圓滿落幕。

examples.en: For our second course, the server brought out pan-seared sea scallops in butter.
examples.zh: 在我們的第二道出菜佳餚中，服務生端上了以奶油香煎的頂級鮮甜生食級干貝。

examples.en: A formal Western banquet typically progresses from light soup to the hearty main course.
examples.zh: 一場正式的西式宴席出菜程序通常由清爽溫暖的濃湯逐步推展至豐盛厚實的主菜。

explains.en: It can mean a set of lessons about one subject. It may also describe the direction someone follows. In a meal, it can name one part served at a time.
Students attend this series of lessons to learn a subject. A river follows its path. A meal may have a first and final part with this name.
