This word may name a class or study program. It can mean the path something follows. It may also describe one dish served during a meal.

examples.en: My cousin and I were born in the same year.
examples.zh: 我表弟和我出生在同一年。

examples.en: We spent our childhood summer vacations playing at our cousins' farm.
examples.zh: 我們童年的暑假都在表堂兄弟姊妹的農場裡嬉戲玩耍度過。

examples.en: Her first cousin works as a successful pediatric doctor in Kaohsiung.
examples.zh: 她的親堂兄在高雄擔任一位成功的出色小兒科醫生。

explains.en: This is the child of your aunt or uncle. You may play with this family member at a gathering. The person may be older or younger than you.
A person with this family relation shares grandparents with you. They may live nearby or far away. Many people meet them during family visits.
This word names the son or daughter of your aunt or uncle. The person is part of your wider family. You may share holidays with them.

examples.en: She covered the pot while the soup cooked.
examples.zh: 湯煮的時候，她把鍋子蓋起來。

examples.en: The report covered our school trip.
examples.zh: 這份報告涵蓋了我們的校外教學。

examples.en: A blanket covered the sleeping child.
examples.zh: 一條毯子蓋住了正在睡覺的孩子。

entries.definition: （動）覆蓋；遮住；涵蓋；（名）封面；遮蓋物

explains.en: It can mean placing something over another thing to protect it. It can also name a report in a book or a blanket on a bed. Context shows which sense is meant.
Use this word for hiding or protecting something from view. It may also name the front or back part of a book. A roof gives shelter from rain.
This word may mean putting something over an object. It can also name a story or report in a newspaper. A lid keeps food safe.

examples.en: Cows provide us with fresh milk.
examples.zh: 乳牛為我們提供新鮮的牛奶。

examples.en: Dairy cows grazed peacefully in the lush green pasture.
examples.zh: 乳牛在翠綠茂盛的牧場上悠閒地吃草。

examples.en: Holy cow, look at the size of that giant watermelon!
examples.zh: 我的天哪，快看那顆巨型西瓜有多大！

explains.en: This is a large farm animal that gives milk. It has four legs and a long tail. It eats grass and hay.
The animal lives on a farm and may have spots. People drink the milk it gives. Its young one is called a calf.
This word names a female farm animal. It may chew grass for a long time. People may raise it for milk or meat.

examples.en: The funny hat made him look crazy.
examples.zh: 那頂有趣的帽子讓他看起來很古怪。

examples.en: The crowd went crazy when the team won.
examples.zh: 球隊獲勝時，群眾興奮極了。

examples.en: That is a crazy idea, but it might work.
examples.zh: 那是個瘋狂的點子，但也許行得通。

entries.definition: 瘋狂的；不理智的；極度熱衷／興奮的（口語）

explains.en: It describes a person or idea that seems very strange. It can also mean extremely excited or upset. The word is informal.
Use this word when someone acts in a surprising or unusual way. It may describe strong excitement. In friendly speech, it can mean that something is wonderful.
This word tells that something does not seem normal. It may describe a person’s actions or feelings. People also use it casually for great fun.

examples.en: Look both ways before you cross the street.
examples.zh: 過馬路前請向兩側看清楚。

examples.en: Walk safely across the pedestrian crosswalk when the walk signal turns green.
examples.zh: 當行人通行號誌變綠燈時，請安全走在斑馬線上過馬路。

examples.en: The red cross on the white ambulance is an international medical symbol.
examples.zh: 白色救護車上的紅十字是國際通用的醫療象徵。

explains.en: It means moving from one side to the other. It can also name a shape with two lines that meet. As a verb, it may mean putting one line across another.
Use this word for going over a road or space. It may name a religious symbol or a mark shaped like two lines. Context tells the sense.
This word can describe passing from one side to another. It can also name a symbol worn around the neck. A person may draw two lines over one another.

examples.en: The touching movie scene made her cry.
examples.zh: 那個感人的電影場景讓她哭了。

examples.en: The lost little boy started to cry and called out for his mother.
examples.zh: 迷路的小男孩開始哭泣，大聲呼喊著媽媽。

examples.en: A loud cry for help echoed through the quiet midnight street.
examples.zh: 一聲響亮的呼救聲在寧靜的午夜街道上迴盪。

explains.en: It means making tears because of sadness, pain, or strong feelings. It can also name the sound a person makes. A baby may do this to show it needs help.
Use this word when tears come from the eyes. A person may do it when hurt or upset. It can also mean calling out loudly.
This word describes tears and the sounds that may go with them. People may do it when they feel very sad. It can also be a loud shout.

examples.en: Would you like a hot cup of black tea?
examples.zh: 你想來一杯熱紅茶嗎？

examples.en: He won first prize and proudly held the championship cup.
examples.zh: 他贏得第一名，自豪地舉起冠軍獎盃。

examples.en: Place a cup of water beside the bed before sleeping.
examples.zh: 睡前在床邊放一杯水。

explains.en: This is a small container for drinking. It often has a handle. A winner may also receive a metal prize with this name.
People fill this container with tea, water, or juice. It may be made of glass or ceramic. Sports winners may hold a prize shaped like one.
This word names a drinking vessel with sides. It can also mean a prize given to a winning team. The vessel may have one handle.

examples.en: Cut the apple into four equal slices.
examples.zh: 把蘋果切成四等份切片。

examples.en: He went to the barbershop on Saturday to get a neat hair cut.
examples.zh: 他週六去理髮店剪了一個俐落的髮型。

examples.en: The government announced plans to cut public transportation fares for seniors.
examples.zh: 政府宣布了調降長者大眾運輸票價的計劃。

explains.en: It means separating something with a sharp tool. It can also name a small wound in the skin. A cook may do this to vegetables.
Use this word when scissors or a knife divide something. It may also mean a mark made by a sharp edge. A person should handle sharp tools safely.
This word can mean dividing material into pieces. It can name a small opening in skin. It can also mean reducing the amount of something.

examples.en: Look at that cute little stray kitten!
examples.zh: 快看那隻可愛的小流浪貓！

examples.en: She bought a pair of cute cartoon socks yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天買了一雙可愛的卡通襪子。

examples.en: The baby made a cute face whenever hearing sweet music.
examples.zh: 寶寶每當聽到悅耳音樂時都會擺出可愛表情。

explains.en: It describes something small and pleasant to look at. A kitten or puppy may seem this way. People may smile when they see it.
Use this word for a person, animal, or thing that looks sweet. A baby animal may make people feel happy. It can also describe a charming style.
This word tells that something looks charming or lovable. It may describe a tiny toy. A friendly face may seem this way.

examples.en: Many teenagers practice street dance after school.
examples.zh: 許多青少年放學後練習街舞。

examples.en: The traditional indigenous dance celebrated the annual autumn harvest.
examples.zh: 傳統原住民舞蹈慶祝著一年一度的秋季豐收。

examples.en: She danced gracefully across the stage during the ballet recital.
examples.zh: 她在芭蕾舞發表會上在舞台間優雅翩翩起舞。

explains.en: It means moving the body to music. People may do it alone or with a partner. It can also name a set of steps performed for others.
Use this word for moving in time with a song. People may learn steps in a class. A celebration may include music and movement.
This word names a way of moving to music. It can describe one performance or the activity itself. People may do it for fun or exercise.

examples.en: It is dangerous to cross the road while using your phone.
examples.zh: 邊滑手機邊過馬路是危險的。

examples.en: Driving on mountain roads during heavy rain is extremely dangerous.
examples.zh: 豪雨期間在山路上開車是極其危險的。

examples.en: Do not touch exposed electrical wires because they are dangerous.
examples.zh: 請勿觸碰裸露的電線，因為它們非常危險。

explains.en: It describes something that may hurt people or cause harm. A sharp knife should be handled with care. A storm can make travel unsafe.
Use this word for a situation that is not safe. Fire and fast cars may cause harm. People should stay far from such things.
This word tells that someone could be hurt. It may describe an animal, road, or action. A warning sign may use it to keep people safe.

examples.en: It gets dark early in winter evenings.
examples.zh: 冬天的傍晚天黑得特別早。

examples.en: She wore a sophisticated dark navy blue suit to the corporate conference.
examples.zh: 她穿著一套典雅穩重的深深藍色套裝出席企業高峰論壇。

examples.en: Citizens were kept in the dark regarding the secret municipal construction plans.
examples.zh: 市民對於這項機密市政建設計畫起初完全被蒙在鼓裡。

explains.en: It describes a place with little light. Night may make a room this way. It can also name a color that is not light.
Use this word for the time when the sun has gone down. It may describe a deep shade of a color. A lamp helps people see in such a room.
This word tells that a place is hard to see in. It can describe black or deep colors. It may also name the evening time.

examples.en: Please write the date at the top of the page.
examples.zh: 請在頁面上方寫上日期。

examples.en: They went on a date to the new cafe.
examples.zh: 他們去新咖啡館約會。

examples.en: Please date the letter before you send it.
examples.zh: 寄出信件前請寫上日期。

entries.definition: （名）日期；約會；（動）註明日期；和人約會。

explains.en: This is a day and month written on a calendar. It can also mean a planned meeting with someone. As a verb, it can mean writing the time on an item.
Use this word for the day when an event happens. It may also name a friendly or romantic meeting. A person can mark a letter with the day it was written.
This word can tell when something happens. It may also describe going out with someone. As an action, it means adding the day to a record.

examples.en: Their daughter loves reading comic books.
examples.zh: 他們的女兒喜歡看漫畫書。

examples.en: My daughter wants to learn how to play the piano.
examples.zh: 我的女兒想學彈鋼琴。

examples.en: They threw a lovely birthday party for their daughter.
examples.zh: 他們為女兒辦了一場溫馨可愛的生日派對。

explains.en: This is a girl or woman who has the same parents as you. She is someone’s female child. A family may have one or more.
A parent may have a girl in the family. She may be older or younger than her brothers. This word names her family role.
This word means the female child of a parent. She may share a home with other family members. Parents may use it when talking about their girl.

examples.en: Have a nice day!
examples.zh: 祝你有美好的一天！

examples.en: I practice playing the violin for an hour every day.
examples.zh: 我每天練習拉小提琴一個小時。

examples.en: Sunday is my favorite day of the week.
examples.zh: 星期日是我一週中最喜歡的一天。

explains.en: This is the time from one midnight to the next. It can also mean the light part of that time. People use it when talking about a date or a period of time.
A calendar has many of these units. The sun shines during its bright part. People may remember a special one each year.
This word names a unit of time with twenty-four hours. It may also mean the time when the sun is up. People count them on a calendar.

examples.en: The old tree is dead after the long drought.
examples.zh: 長期乾旱後，那棵老樹枯死了。

examples.en: The battery is dead, so the toy will not move.
examples.zh: 電池沒電了，所以玩具不會動。

examples.en: We felt sad when the fish was dead.
examples.zh: 魚死掉時，我們感到很難過。

explains.en: It describes a living thing that has stopped living. The body no longer grows or moves. People may feel sad when someone they love is this way.
Use this word for a plant or animal that no longer lives. It can also describe a battery with no power. The opposite idea is being alive.
This word tells that life has ended. A flower may reach this state when it dries up. People treat the body with respect.

examples.en: The two tech giants signed a multi-million-dollar trade deal.
examples.zh: 兩大科技巨頭簽署了一份數百萬美元的貿易協議。

examples.en: You got a fantastic deal buying that refurbished laptop at half price.
examples.zh: 你以半價優惠買下那台原廠整新優質筆電，真是撿到了一個大便宜。

examples.en: Experienced team leaders know how to deal with unexpected customer complaints calmly.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的團隊主管懂得如何從容冷靜地應對處理突如其來的顧客客訴。

explains.en: It can mean an agreement between people. It can also mean handling or sharing something. In a card game, it may mean giving cards to players.
Use this word for a plan accepted by two sides. It can also describe how someone handles a task. A card player may give one card to each person.
This word may name an arrangement or agreement. As a verb, it can mean managing a problem. It can also describe giving out playing cards.

examples.en: My dear friend gave me a warm hug.
examples.zh: 我親愛的朋友給了我一個溫暖的擁抱。

examples.en: Dear Grandma, I hope you are well.
examples.zh: 親愛的奶奶，希望您一切安好。

examples.en: That small bag is dear, but it is well made.
examples.zh: 那個小包包很貴，但做工很好。

entries.definition: （形）親愛的；珍貴的；昂貴的；（名）親愛的人；（信件稱呼）親愛的；（副）高價地

explains.en: It describes someone loved or valued. It may be used at the start of a letter. As an adverb, it can mean at a high price.
Use this word when speaking warmly to someone you love. It can also describe something that costs a lot of money. A letter may begin with it.
This word can mean loved and important to someone. It is often used in a friendly greeting. It may also describe an expensive item.

examples.en: The family mourned the death of their grandfather.
examples.zh: 這家人哀悼祖父的逝世。

examples.en: The plant’s death came after weeks without water.
examples.zh: 那株植物在數週沒有水之後枯死了。

examples.en: The story tells of a hero who escaped death.
examples.zh: 這個故事講述一位逃過死亡的英雄。

entries.definition: 死亡；逝世；終結；（比喻）消失

explains.en: This is the end of a living thing’s life. It may happen after a long illness or old age. People may feel grief when someone passes away.
Use this word for the time when a person or animal stops living. It can be a sad event for family and friends. Many people remember the one who has passed.
This word names the end of life. It may follow sickness, age, or an accident. People often gather to support one another after it.

examples.en: We decided to take the High Speed Rail to Chiayi.
examples.zh: 我們決定搭乘高鐵前往嘉義。

examples.en: Take your time to carefully decide which career path suits you best.
examples.zh: 從容且審慎地決定哪條職業道路最適合你。

examples.en: The judges will decide the winner of the national speech contest tonight.
examples.zh: 評審團將在今晚決定這場全國演講比賽的優勝者。

explains.en: It means choosing what to do after thinking. A person may select one of two paths. A clear goal can help with the choice.
Use this word when making up your mind. You may think about two or more options. Then you act on the one you picked.
This verb tells that someone makes a choice. A family may talk before picking a place to visit. It may take time to settle on one plan.

examples.en: The pool is deep near the diving board.
examples.zh: 跳水板附近的泳池很深。

examples.en: She took a deep breath before the test.
examples.zh: 考試前她深深吸了一口氣。

examples.en: The roots grow deep into the soil.
examples.zh: 根深深地長進土裡。

explains.en: It means going far down from the top or surface. A lake may be hard to see through near its middle. It can also describe a strong thought or feeling.
Use this word for a large distance from the top to the bottom. It may describe water or a hole. It can also mean serious or thoughtful.
This word tells that something has great distance downward. It may describe a strong idea or feeling. A pool may have a shallow end and a lower part.

examples.en: Can you define this new word for me?
examples.zh: 你可以為我解釋這個新單字嗎？

examples.en: The teacher defined the rules before the game.
examples.zh: 老師在比賽前說明了規則。

examples.en: This line defines the edge of the shape.
examples.zh: 這條線界定了形狀的邊緣。

explains.en: It means saying exactly what a word or idea means. A teacher may explain a new term. The description helps people understand it.
Use this word when giving a clear meaning for something. A dictionary tells what words mean. A person may explain a rule in simple terms.
This verb means explaining the meaning of a word. It can also set the limits of an idea. A short description may help readers learn.

examples.en: Put your textbook on the desk.
examples.zh: 把你的課本放在書桌上。

examples.en: I always keep my study desk organized.
examples.zh: 我總是保持我的書桌井井有條。

examples.en: He found an old photograph inside his desk drawer.
examples.zh: 他在書桌抽屜裡找到了一張泛黃的舊照片。

explains.en: This is a table used for reading or writing. It often has drawers for pencils and papers. Students sit at one in a classroom.
People keep books or a computer on this piece of furniture. It is made for work or study. A chair usually sits beside it.
This word names a table for a student or office worker. It may have a flat top and drawers. People sit behind it to write.

examples.en: Look up new vocabulary words in the online dictionary.
examples.zh: 在線上字典中查詢生字。

examples.en: A bilingual English-Chinese dictionary is essential for language learners.
examples.zh: 英漢雙語字典對語言學習者來說是不可或缺的。

examples.en: She consults the dictionary to verify accurate word pronunciations.
examples.zh: 她查閱字典以確認單字的精確發音。

explains.en: This is a book that tells what words mean. It may show how to say each word. People use it when learning a language.
A reader can look up a word in this book. It may list words in alphabetical order. Some kinds also give example sentences.
This word names a book used to find meanings and spellings. It may include pictures or sound guides. Students often use one during language study.

examples.en: Many people die peacefully in old age.
examples.zh: 許多人在年老時安詳地離世。

examples.en: Plants may die without enough sunlight.
examples.zh: 植物沒有足夠陽光可能會枯死。

examples.en: The flowers died after the frost.
examples.zh: 霜凍過後，花朵枯萎了。

explains.en: It means that a living thing stops being alive. Plants may do this when they lack water. People may use a gentle phrase when someone has passed away.
Use this word for the end of life. A plant may stop living after a long dry season. People speak softly when telling sad news about a person.
This verb means that life has ended. It can describe a plant, animal, or person. Some people use a kinder phrase when talking about a human.

examples.en: Everyone has different learning paces and goals.
examples.zh: 每個人都有不同的學習步調與目標。

examples.en: Cultural traditions in eastern and western countries are quite different.
examples.zh: 東西方各國的文化傳統截然不同。

examples.en: A small act of kindness can make a huge positive difference in someone's life.
examples.zh: 一點小小的善行就能為某個人的人生帶來巨大的改變。

explains.en: It describes something that is not the same as another thing. Two people may have unlike ideas. The word helps point out how they do not match.
Use this word when comparing two things that are not alike. A red shirt and a blue shirt have unlike colors. People may have their own ways of thinking.
This word tells that one thing is not like another. It may describe size, color, or ideas. A comparison can show the changes.

examples.en: The math problem was difficult for me.
examples.zh: 這道數學題對我來說很難。

examples.en: It is difficult to hear in a noisy room.
examples.zh: 在吵鬧的房間裡很難聽清楚。

examples.en: Learning a new language takes time because it can be difficult.
examples.zh: 學習新語言需要時間，因為可能很困難。

entries.definition: 困難的；費力的；不容易的

explains.en: It describes something that takes a lot of effort. A hard puzzle may need time and thought. Practice can make the task easier.
Use this word for work that is not easy. A new game may take time to learn. Asking someone for help can make it less hard.
This word tells that someone may struggle with a task. It may need skill or patience. A person can learn through practice.

examples.en: The dog dug a hole in the garden.
examples.zh: 狗在花園裡挖了一個洞。

examples.en: They dug for shells on the beach.
examples.zh: 他們在海灘上挖貝殼。

examples.en: We will dig a small pond for the frogs.
examples.zh: 我們要為青蛙挖一個小池塘。

explains.en: It means making a hole in the ground with a tool or hands. A gardener may do this to plant seeds. It can also name the hole made.
Use this word when moving soil to make a hole. A dog may use its paws to uncover a toy. The action can leave a pile of dirt nearby.
This verb means moving earth away from one place. People may do it with a shovel. The noun can name a place where soil has been removed.

examples.en: We had hot pot for dinner last night.
examples.zh: 我們昨晚晚餐吃了火鍋。

examples.en: Mom is cooking a wonderful dinner in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 媽媽正在廚房煮一頓豐盛的晚餐。

examples.en: What would you like to have for dinner tonight?
examples.zh: 你今晚晚餐想吃什麼？

explains.en: This is the main meal eaten in the evening. A family may share it after work or school. Rice, vegetables, and soup may be served.
People often eat this meal at the end of the day. It may be shared with family or friends. Someone may cook it at home.
This word names an evening meal. A restaurant may serve many kinds of food for it. Families often sit together during it.

examples.en: Wash your dirty hands after playing outside.
examples.zh: 在戶外玩耍後要把髒手洗乾淨。

examples.en: Put your dirty clothes into the laundry basket.
examples.zh: 把你的髒衣服放進洗衣籃裡。

examples.en: Muddy boots will dirty the clean living room floor.
examples.zh: 沾滿泥巴的靴子會把乾淨的客廳地板弄髒。

explains.en: It describes something that has dirt or marks on it. Shoes may get this way after a walk in mud. As a verb, it means making something unclean.
Use this word when an item needs washing. A shirt may get this way while a child plays outside. The verb means putting dirt on something.
This word tells that something is not fresh or neat. Mud can make a floor this way. A person may wash the item to fix it.

examples.en: Please wash each dish after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐後請把每個盤子都洗乾淨。

examples.en: The restaurant serves a tasty fish dish.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳供應美味的魚料理。

examples.en: She dished the rice onto our plates.
examples.zh: 她把飯盛到我們的盤子裡。

entries.definition: （名）盤子；一道菜；（動）把食物盛盤

explains.en: This is a plate or bowl used for serving food. It can also mean a kind of food made in one way. As a verb, it can mean putting food onto a plate.
People eat meals from this piece of kitchenware. A restaurant may offer a special meal with this name. The verb means placing food ready to serve.
This word can name a shallow container for food. It may also mean one prepared meal. A person may put the meal on a plate.

examples.en: Do your best, and don't worry about mistakes.
examples.zh: 盡你最大努力，別擔心犯錯。

examples.en: What do you do on quiet Sunday mornings?
examples.zh: 在寧靜的週日早晨你通常做些什麼？

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise will do wonders for your mental health.
examples.zh: 規律的有氧運動對你的心理健康大有裨益。

explains.en: This small helper verb appears in questions and negative statements. It can also mean carrying out an action. The sentence shows which use is meant.
This word can help turn a statement into a question about an action. It also helps speakers say that an action never happens. As a main verb, it means to perform a task.
This word helps form questions in English. It can help make a negative statement. It also means carrying out work or an activity.

examples.en: You should see a doctor if your fever continues.
examples.zh: 如果你發燒持續，應該去看醫生。

examples.en: The doctor examined the patient's throat and prescribed medicine.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查了病人的喉嚨並開立處方藥。

examples.en: My elder sister wants to become an eye doctor.
examples.zh: 我的姊姊想成為一名眼科醫生。

explains.en: This is a person trained to help sick or injured people. The person may work in a hospital or clinic. The title can also mean someone with a high degree.
People visit this health worker when they are ill. The worker can examine them and suggest care. At a university, the same title may follow someone’s name.
This word names a trained health professional. The person helps find and treat illness. It can also be a title for someone who has earned an advanced degree.

examples.en: Dogs are loyal human companions.
examples.zh: 狗是人類忠實的伴侶。

examples.en: I take my pet dog for a twenty-minute walk every evening.
examples.zh: 我每天傍晚帶我的寵物狗去散步二十分鐘。

examples.en: The friendly golden retriever wagged its tail happily.
examples.zh: 那隻友善的黃金獵犬高興地搖著尾巴。

explains.en: This is a common animal kept as a pet. It has four legs and often barks. Some help people find things or protect a home.
A loyal animal may follow its owner on a walk. It can learn to sit or fetch a toy. Many families keep one at home.
This word names an animal with fur and a strong sense of smell. It may be small or large. People often call it a faithful friend.

examples.en: The little girl takes her favorite doll to bed.
examples.zh: 小女孩帶著她最愛的洋娃娃上床睡覺。

examples.en: Her grandmother handmade a beautiful porcelain doll for her.
examples.zh: 她祖母親手為她縫製了一個精美的瓷娃娃。

examples.en: The shelves were filled with vintage dolls in delicate lace dresses.
examples.zh: 架子上擺滿了穿著精緻蕾絲洋裝的復古娃娃。

explains.en: This is a toy shaped like a person or baby. Children may dress it or pretend to care for it. It can be made from cloth or plastic.
A child may play with this toy and make up stories. It often has a face and clothes. Some are soft enough to hug.
This word names a figure used as a plaything. It may look like a person. Children can brush its hair or change its clothes.

examples.en: The toy costs five dollars.
examples.zh: 這個玩具要五美元。

examples.en: I found a dollar on the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 我在人行道上找到一美元。

examples.en: The dollar is used in many countries.
examples.zh: 許多國家都使用美元。

explains.en: This is a unit of money used in the United States and some other places. It is often shown with a special sign. One hundred cents make one of them.
People use this money to buy things. A paper note or coin may show its value. Shops list prices in this unit.
This word names a kind of money. It may be made as coins or printed notes. People use it to pay for goods and services.

examples.en: Please close the door when you leave.
examples.zh: 離開時請關上門。

examples.en: Someone is knocking loudly on the front door.
examples.zh: 有人在前門大聲敲門。

examples.en: Remember to lock the door before you go to bed.
examples.zh: 睡覺前記得把門鎖上。

explains.en: This is a flat piece that opens or closes an entrance. It may have a handle or lock. People knock on it before entering a home.
A room or building has this part at its entrance. It swings or slides to let people pass. It can be locked for safety.
This word names a movable panel in a wall. People open it to enter or leave. A handle helps someone move it.

examples.en: Sit down and enjoy a cup of hot green tea.
examples.zh: 坐下來喝杯熱綠茶放鬆一下吧。

examples.en: Rain poured down heavily throughout the stormy subtropical afternoon.
examples.zh: 暴風雨襲來的亞熱帶午後，傾盆大雨不停地下著。

examples.en: Write down your personal reflections in your journal before going to sleep.
examples.zh: 在就寢前把你的個人心得體悟記錄在手記中。

examples.en: 850 fill-power goose down offers the ultimate warmth-to-weight ratio for sub-zero bivvies.
examples.zh: 填充 850FP 高蓬鬆度頂級白鵝絨的輕量羽絨外套，在零度以下雪地高山營地提供極致防寒保暖。

examples.en: Compressible down sleeping bags pack down into tiny bundles inside your backpack.
examples.zh: 壓縮比極高的高蓬鬆羽絨睡袋能被緊密擠壓塞入壓縮袋中，在背包內僅佔據極小微量空間。

examples.en: Keep your down jacket protected from rain because wet down clumps and loses all insulating loft.
examples.zh: 務必妥善保護羽絨外套免受雨水浸濕，因為羽絨一旦遇水結塊便會瞬間喪失所有蓬鬆保暖絕緣能力。

examples.en: Pulling on a high-fill-power goose down jacket restores cozy warmth the minute you arrive at the cold camp.
examples.zh: 一抵達氣溫逼近冰點的露營地，立即套上一件極輕高蓬鬆度羽絨外套，瞬間驅散刺骨寒氣。

examples.en: Compressible down jackets pack into tiny sacks, saving precious room inside your hiking bag.
examples.zh: 高壓縮比的羽絨衣可壓縮收納進微小收納袋中，為登山背包省下寶貴的收納空間。

examples.en: Keep your down garments inside a waterproof dry bag, as wet down loses all insulating loft.
examples.zh: 務必將羽絨衣物裝在防水袋內保存，因為潮濕的羽毛會完全塌陷並喪失所有隔熱保暖能力。

entries.definition: 向下；朝下；沮喪的；鵝絨羽絨；羽毛；800FP 高蓬鬆度極輕鵝絨羽絨外套

explains.en: It can describe movement toward a lower place. It may also mean sad or not working. As a noun, it names soft feathers under a bird’s outer feathers.
Use this word when someone moves from a higher point to a lower one. It can describe a low mood or a quiet time. Soft feathers may fill a warm coat.
This word can mean below a place. It may describe feeling unhappy. It can also name the soft feathers that keep birds warm.

examples.en: A dozen eggs filled the carton.
examples.zh: 一打雞蛋裝滿了紙盒。

examples.en: We bought a dozen roses for Mom.
examples.zh: 我們買了一打玫瑰花送給媽媽。

examples.en: There are a dozen months in a year.
examples.zh: 一年有十二個月。

explains.en: This means twelve items or people. A shop may sell eggs in a group of this size. The number is often used when counting food.
Use this word for a group with twelve members. A box may hold this many eggs. The amount is larger than ten by two.
This word names the number twelve when talking about a group. Bakers may make this many rolls at once. It is a common way to count some goods.

examples.en: Children like to draw pictures with crayons.
examples.zh: 小朋友喜歡用蠟筆畫畫。

examples.en: The street magician drew a huge crowd of curious spectators.
examples.zh: 街頭魔術師吸引了一大群好奇的圍觀群眾。

examples.en: The thrilling basketball championship game ended in a draw.
examples.zh: 這場精彩刺激的籃球冠軍賽以平手收場。

explains.en: It means making a picture with a pen or pencil. It can also mean pulling something toward you. As a noun, it can mean a game that ends with equal scores.
Use this word when making lines to show an image. It may also describe pulling curtains or a cart. In sports, it can mean that neither team wins.
This word can mean creating a picture on paper. It may describe pulling something closer. It can also name an equal result in a game.

examples.en: Follow your dream and never give up easily.
examples.zh: 追隨你的夢想，絕不要輕言放棄。

examples.en: I had a strange and vivid dream about flying across towering mountain ranges.
examples.zh: 我做了一個奇特且栩栩如生的夢，夢見自己在高聳的山脈上空翱翔。

examples.en: She dreams of traveling around the globe after completing her degree.
examples.zh: 她夢想著在取得學位後能踏上環遊世界的旅程。

explains.en: This is a story or picture in the mind during sleep. It can also mean a strong hope for the future. People may talk about what they want to do one day.
A person may see this while sleeping. The word can also describe a goal someone hopes to reach. A child may hope to travel around the world.
This word names images in the mind at night. It may also mean a wish for the future. People may work hard to make one come true.

examples.en: She wore a pretty red dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件漂亮的紅洋裝去參加聚會。

examples.en: Remember to dress warmly because it is cold outside.
examples.zh: 外面很冷，記得穿暖和一點。

examples.en: Everyone dressed up for the annual school graduation ball.
examples.zh: 大家盛裝打扮參加一年一度的學校畢業舞會。

explains.en: This is a one-piece garment often worn by women or girls. It covers the body and may have sleeves. As a verb, it means putting clothes on.
People wear this garment for school, work, or a party. It has a top joined to a skirt. The verb can mean putting clothes on yourself or someone else.
This word names clothing that covers the upper and lower body in one piece. It may be short or long. As an action, it means putting on clothing.

examples.en: Do not drink cold drinks too fast.
examples.zh: 不要太快喝冷飲。

examples.en: Would you like something warm to drink?
examples.zh: 你想喝點溫熱的飲品嗎？

examples.en: You should drink plenty of water after exercising.
examples.zh: 運動後你應該多喝水。

explains.en: It means taking liquid into the mouth and swallowing it. It can also name the liquid people have with a meal. Water is a common one.
Use this word for swallowing water, juice, or milk. It may also mean a cup of liquid. People need enough of it each day.
This verb describes taking liquid into the body. The noun names something people may have with food. It can be hot or cold.

examples.en: My mother learned to drive last year.
examples.zh: 我媽媽去年學會了開車。

examples.en: Always drive carefully and obey the local speed limits.
examples.zh: 開車務必謹慎，並遵守當地的速限。

examples.en: We went for a scenic drive along the northeast coast.
examples.zh: 我們開車沿著東北角海岸進行了一趟風景兜風。

explains.en: It means controlling a vehicle such as a car. A person uses a wheel and pedals to guide it. It can also name a trip in such a vehicle.
Use this word when making a vehicle move along a road. A trained person controls where it goes. The noun may mean a short trip by road.
This verb means operating a car or other machine. It can also mean forcing something to move. A pleasant trip in a car may use the noun form.

examples.en: The bus driver was friendly and waited for us.
examples.zh: 公車司機很親切且特地等了我們。

examples.en: A cautious driver always maintains a safe following distance on highways.
examples.zh: 謹慎的駕駛在高速公路上總是保持安全跟車距離。

examples.en: The taxi driver shared interesting historic stories about old Taipei neighborhoods.
examples.zh: 計程車司機分享了關於台北老街區有趣的歷史掌故。

explains.en: This is a person who controls a car, bus, or other vehicle. The person follows roads and traffic signs. A passenger may sit beside or behind them.
Someone with this job takes people from one place to another. The person must watch the road. A bus or taxi may have one.
This word names a person who steers a vehicle. They may take passengers to work or school. A license is often needed for the job.

examples.en: Be careful not to drop the delicate ceramic bowl.
examples.zh: 當心別把精緻的陶瓷碗摔落了。

examples.en: Temperatures are expected to drop sharply tonight as a cold front arrives.
examples.zh: 隨著冷氣團報到，今晚氣溫預計將驟降。

examples.en: A single drop of rain fell softly onto her cheek.
examples.zh: 一滴雨水輕輕滴落在她的臉頰上。

explains.en: It means letting something fall. A person may lose a coin from a pocket. It can also name one small amount of liquid.
Use this word when an object falls from a hand or a high place. It may also mean a tiny bit of water. A glass may let a small amount fall.
This verb means moving from a higher place to a lower one. The noun may name one small round bit of liquid. A person may let a toy fall by accident.

examples.en: The drummer keeps a steady beat for the song.
examples.zh: 鼓手為整首歌曲維持穩定的節拍。

examples.en: Thunder rolled in the distance like the pounding of giant drums.
examples.zh: 遠處傳來的雷聲猶如巨鼓的轟鳴敲擊。

examples.en: Traditional lion dances are accompanied by loud drum rhythms.
examples.zh: 傳統舞獅表演伴隨著響亮振奮的鼓聲節奏。

examples.en: The energetic drummer kept the beat tight throughout the song.
examples.zh: 活力十足的鼓手在整首歌曲中維持著精準穩定的節拍。

examples.en: Heavy thunder rattled the windows like a giant war drum in the sky.
examples.zh: 沉悶的雷聲如天空中的巨大戰鼓般震動著窗戶玻璃。

examples.en: Soldiers marched in sync to the rhythmic cadence of the snare drums.
examples.zh: 士兵們在小軍鼓富有節奏的鼓點節奏下一步調一致地行軍。

explains.en: This is a musical instrument with a hollow body. A player hits it with sticks or hands to make a beat. The verb means playing it.
People strike this instrument to keep time in a song. It may be part of a band. A player can make loud or soft sounds.
This word names an instrument that makes a deep beat. It may have a skin stretched over a frame. As an action, it means playing that instrument.

examples.en: The clothes are dry after an hour in the sun.
examples.zh: 衣服在陽光下曬了一個小時後乾了。

examples.en: Please dry your hands with a towel.
examples.zh: 請用毛巾擦乾雙手。

examples.en: The dry season lasts for several months.
examples.zh: 旱季會持續好幾個月。

entries.definition: （形）乾的；乾燥的；（口腔或喉嚨）乾渴的；（動）弄乾；使乾涸。

explains.en: It describes something without water or moisture. The sun may make wet clothes this way. As a verb, it means removing water.
Use this word for land with little rain or food that has no liquid. A towel can make hands this way. The verb means letting water leave something.
This word tells that something is not wet. It can describe weather or a towel. As an action, it means taking moisture away.

examples.en: Roast duck is a famous Chinese delicacy.
examples.zh: 烤鴨是著名的中華美食。

examples.en: Several yellow ducklings swam gracefully behind their mother.
examples.zh: 幾隻黃色小鴨優雅地游在鴨媽媽身後。

examples.en: Duck your head when entering this low-ceiling cave.
examples.zh: 走進這座低矮洞穴時請低頭彎腰。

explains.en: This is a water bird with a wide bill. It may swim on a pond. As a verb, it can mean lowering the head quickly to avoid something.
The bird has webbed feet and feathers. It may live near a lake. A person may bend down fast to avoid a flying object.
This word names a bird often seen on ponds. It may eat plants or small animals. The verb can mean bending quickly to stay out of the way.

examples.en: Keep your cell phones silent during the concert.
examples.zh: 音樂會進行期間請將手機調為靜音。

examples.en: Many families visit scenic national parks during the Lunar New Year holiday.
examples.zh: 許多家庭在農曆春節連假期間造訪風景優美的國家公園。

examples.en: Students took notes attentively during the informative guest history lecture.
examples.zh: 在內容豐富的客座歷史講座期間，學生們專注地做筆記。

explains.en: It points to a time within an event or period. People may watch a movie while the story unfolds. The word tells when something happened.
Use this word for an action that takes place while another activity is going on. A child may sleep through a trip. It links the action to a period of time.
This word shows that two events take place within the same period. It can point to a class, visit, or trip. The sentence gives the time frame.

examples.en: Each student received a souvenir stationery set.
examples.zh: 每一位學生都收到了一份紀念文具組。

examples.en: The teammates encourage each other whenever training gets tough.
examples.zh: 每當訓練變得艱苦時，隊友們總是彼此互相打氣勉勵。

examples.en: Each of the hotel rooms features a scenic balcony overlooking the sea.
examples.zh: 飯店的每一間客房都設有俯瞰大海的景觀陽台。

explains.en: This means every single member of a group when considered one at a time. A teacher may give one paper to all students. The word points to members separately.
Use this word when thinking about members one by one. A rule may apply to all people on a team. It can describe one item separately.
This word means all members of a group. It may point to one thing at a time. The same idea applies to the full group.

examples.en: Rabbits have long, cute ears.
examples.zh: 兔子有著長長可愛的耳朵。

examples.en: Whisper the secret softly into my ear so no one else hears.
examples.zh: 悄悄把秘密對我耳語，這樣別人才聽不到。

examples.en: He listened to music through his wireless earphones.
examples.zh: 他透過無線耳機聆聽音樂。

explains.en: This is the body part used for hearing. It is found on each side of the head. Some animals can turn it toward a sound.
People use this part to hear music and speech. It may have an outer shape that catches sound. Wearing headphones covers it.
This word names one of the parts that helps people hear. It is near the side of the head. A doctor may look inside it.

examples.en: The early morning air is crisp and fresh.
examples.zh: 清晨的空氣清新宜人。

examples.en: Getting up early gives you plenty of time to enjoy a healthy breakfast.
examples.zh: 早起讓你有充裕的時間享用一頓健康的早餐。

examples.en: The train arrived ten minutes early at the terminal station.
examples.zh: 火車提前十分鐘抵達了終點站。

explains.en: It means near the start of a time or event. A student may arrive before the other children. It can also describe someone who wakes near sunrise.
Use this word when something happens sooner than usual. A bus may leave before sunrise. It can describe a person who does things at the start of the day.
This word points to a time close to the beginning. It may mean sooner than expected. It can describe someone who wakes before sunrise.

examples.en: We all need to protect our Mother Earth.
examples.zh: 我們大家都需要保護我們的地球母親。

examples.en: Earth travels around the sun once every 365 days.
examples.zh: 地球每 365 天圍繞太陽公轉一次。

examples.en: Gardeners dig rich black earth to plant spring flowers.
examples.zh: 園丁們挖掘肥沃的黑泥土來種植春季花卉。

explains.en: This is the planet where people, animals, and plants live. It can also mean the ground or soil. People walk on its surface.
The round world moves through space around the sun. It has land and water. The same word can mean dirt used for growing plants.
This word names our home planet. It can also mean the solid ground under our feet. Farmers use the word for soil.

examples.en: The Pacific Ocean lies to the east of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 太平洋位於台灣的東方。

examples.en: Early risers gather at Sanxiantai on the east coast to watch the sunrise.
examples.zh: 早起的人們齊聚在東海岸的三仙台觀賞日出。

examples.en: The morning sun rises reliably in the east every new dawn.
examples.zh: 晨曦的太陽在每個黎明準時從東方升起。

explains.en: It is the direction where the sun rises. It can name a place or describe movement that way. Maps often show it on a compass.
Use this word for one of the four main directions. It is opposite west. A person may travel toward the morning sun.
This word names the direction of sunrise. It can describe a place on a map. Travelers may use it to find their way.

examples.en: This math puzzle is easy to solve.
examples.zh: 這個數學謎題很容易解開。

examples.en: Take it easy over the weekend and get plenty of rest.
examples.zh: 週末放輕鬆點，好好充分休息。

examples.en: With modern apps, booking travel tickets is very easy and convenient.
examples.zh: 透過現代應用程式，預訂旅遊票券變得非常輕鬆便捷。

explains.en: It describes something that does not need much effort. A short puzzle may be simple to solve. A person may feel relaxed while doing a light task.
Use this word for a task that is not hard. A tool may make work simple. A gentle walk can feel restful.
This word tells that something is simple to do. A clear rule may help people understand quickly. It can describe a relaxed pace.

examples.en: Let's eat lunch together at noon.
examples.zh: 我們中午一起吃午餐吧。

examples.en: Remember to wash your hands before you eat.
examples.zh: 吃東西前記得要先洗手。

examples.en: We decided to eat out at a nearby noodle shop tonight.
examples.zh: 我們決定今晚到附近的麵店外食。

explains.en: It means putting food into the mouth and swallowing it. People do this to get energy. A meal is a time when they may do it.
Use this verb when someone has food. A person may chew fruit or bread. The body uses food to grow and stay strong.
This action means taking food into the body through the mouth. People may do it at set times each day. Good food helps the body work well.

examples.en: I eat a boiled egg every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上吃一顆水煮蛋。

examples.en: Crack two eggs into the frying pan to make an omelet.
examples.zh: 在平底鍋打入兩顆蛋來做煎蛋捲。

examples.en: Birds lay eggs in safe nests high up in trees.
examples.zh: 鳥兒在高高的樹上安全築巢產卵。

explains.en: This is something laid by a bird. It has a shell and food inside. People may cook it for breakfast.
A hen lays this oval food. Its shell may be white or brown. A young bird can grow inside when it stays warm.
This word names a food with a shell. People may boil or fry one. It comes from birds such as chickens.

examples.en: You can take either the red line or the blue line MRT.
examples.zh: 你可以搭紅線捷運或藍線捷運。

examples.en: Either coffee or black tea is fine with me for breakfast.
examples.zh: 早餐喝咖啡或紅茶對我來說都可以。

examples.en: I haven't watched that new historical documentary either.
examples.zh: 我也還沒有看過那部新的歷史紀錄片。

explains.en: It can mean one of two choices. It may also mean not one and not the other in a negative sentence. The sentence pattern shows its use.
Use this word when talking about one member of a pair. It can refer to both possible choices in questions. In a negative sentence, it may mean not one or the other.
This word points to two possible things. A person may pick one of them. It can also join two choices or agree with a negative idea.

examples.en: Elephants have very long trunks and big ears.
examples.zh: 大象有著長長的鼻子和大大的耳朵。

examples.en: An Asian elephant can live for more than sixty years.
examples.zh: 亞洲象可以存活超過六十年。

examples.en: Let's address the elephant in the room and discuss the budget problem.
examples.zh: 我們來正視這個大家心照不宣卻避而不談的預算問題吧。

explains.en: This is a very large animal with a long trunk. It has big ears and thick legs. It eats plants and lives in groups.
The animal uses its long nose to pick up food and water. Its skin is gray and thick. It may live in a warm grassland or forest.
This word names the largest land animal. Its long nose can lift objects. The young stay near their family group.

examples.en: Would you like anything else to drink?
examples.zh: 你還想喝其他東西嗎？

examples.en: Who else is coming to the party?
examples.zh: 還有誰要來派對？

examples.en: I have no other plans or anything else to do.
examples.zh: 我沒有其他計畫或事情要做。

explains.en: It means something or someone in addition to the one already mentioned. A person may ask what more is needed. The word can point to a different person or thing.
Use this word for another person, thing, or place. It may ask for more information. It can also mean someone different.
This word points to an extra or different thing. It may come after a question word. People use it when the first thing is not enough.

examples.en: I received an email from my teacher today.
examples.zh: 我今天收到了一封老師寄來的電子郵件。

examples.en: Please check your email inbox for the registration confirmation link.
examples.zh: 請查看你的電子郵件收件匣以獲取註冊確認連結。

examples.en: I will email you the updated lecture slides before noon.
examples.zh: 我會在中午前將最新的上課簡報透過電子郵件寄給你。

explains.en: This is a message sent through the internet. It may contain words, pictures, or files. People use it to communicate quickly.
A person types a message and sends it to someone’s address online. The same word can mean sending such a message. It may arrive in seconds.
This word names a written message sent by computer or phone. It can include attached files. As a verb, it means sending the message.

examples.en: The movie will end at nine o’clock.
examples.zh: 電影將在九點結束。

examples.en: We walked to the end of the street.
examples.zh: 我們走到街道的盡頭。

examples.en: This is the end of the story.
examples.zh: 這是故事的結尾。

entries.definition: （名）末端；結尾；結束；（動）結束；終止

explains.en: It means the final part of something. A road may stop there. As a verb, it means bringing an activity to its finish.
Use this word for the point where something finishes. A book has a final page. It can also mean stopping an event or action.
This word names the last part of a period or object. A meeting reaches this point when it is over. The verb means making something finish.

examples.en: Many software engineers work in Hsinchu Science Park.
examples.zh: 許多軟體工程師在新竹科學園區工作。

examples.en: Civil engineers designed earthquake-resistant structures for the high-speed rail.
examples.zh: 土木工程師為台灣高鐵設計了卓越的耐震耐震工程結構。

examples.en: The clever technician managed to engineer a cost-effective solution to the power leak.
examples.zh: 這位機靈的技術人員成功策劃出了一套經濟高效的漏電防護解方。

explains.en: This is a person who designs or builds machines, roads, or other systems. They use science and math to solve problems. Their work may help many people.
Someone with this job plans how things should work. They may design a bridge, phone, or machine. Careful testing helps keep the result safe.
This word names a trained worker who uses science to make or improve things. They may work with machines or buildings. Their plans solve practical problems.

examples.en: We really enjoyed our trip to Kenting.
examples.zh: 我們非常享受去墾丁的旅行。

examples.en: Did you enjoy reading that fantasy mystery book?
examples.zh: 你喜歡閱讀那本奇幻懸疑小說嗎？

examples.en: Please enjoy yourselves at the evening welcome party!
examples.zh: 今晚的迎新派對請大家盡情玩得開心！

explains.en: It means feeling happy while doing something. People may like music, food, or a game. The noun form names that good feeling.
Use this word when someone likes an activity or thing. A person may feel glad during a visit. The related noun means pleasure.
This verb means taking pleasure in an activity. It can describe a good meal or a fun day. The noun names the feeling of pleasure.

examples.en: Make sure you drink enough water during sports activities.
examples.zh: 運動期間務必確保喝足夠的水。

examples.en: We arrived at the station early enough to catch the first express train.
examples.zh: 我們抵達車站的時間足夠充裕，剛好趕上了首班自強號列車。

examples.en: That is more than enough food to feed all ten party guests generously.
examples.zh: 那些食物非常豐盛充裕，足夠款待所有十位派對賓客。

explains.en: It means as much as needed. A person may have the right amount of food. It can also name the amount that is sufficient.
Use this word when something meets a need. The amount may be neither too much nor too little. It can describe having sufficient time or money.
This word tells that the amount is right for a purpose. It may describe food, space, or time. As a noun, it means the needed amount.

examples.en: Please enter your name on the form.
examples.zh: 請在表格上填入你的姓名。

examples.en: The players entered the field together.
examples.zh: 選手們一起進入球場。

examples.en: You must enter through the front door.
examples.zh: 你必須從前門進入。

explains.en: It means going inside a place. A person may pass through a door into a room. It can also mean putting information into a form.
Use this word when someone moves from outside to inside. A player may join a contest. A clerk may type a name into a record.
This verb tells that someone goes into a place. It may also mean joining a race or event. A person can type words into a computer form.

examples.en: Seal the red envelope carefully before giving New Year blessings.
examples.zh: 在送出新年祝福前把紅包袋仔細封好。

examples.en: Write the mailing address clearly on the front of the white envelope.
examples.zh: 在白色信封正面將郵寄地址書寫清晰。

examples.en: Open the letter opener carefully to avoid tearing the envelope contents.
examples.zh: 小心使用拆信刀，避免劃破信封內的信件內容。

examples.en: A highly insulated building envelope prevents indoor conditioned air from leaking out through walls.
examples.zh: 施作縝密斷熱保溫的建築外殼圍護結構，能防止室內冷暖氣透過牆面縫隙流失。

examples.en: Thermal imaging cameras detect thermal leaks across the building envelope during energy audits.
examples.zh: 在建築能效查核檢驗中，紅外線熱顯像儀能精準揪出整棟建築外殼上存在的漏熱破口。

examples.en: Continuous air barriers wrapped around the building envelope eliminate unwanted drafts and moisture infiltration.
examples.zh: 環繞包裹在建築外皮周圍的連續性氣密隔汽防水層，能徹底杜絕冷風滲漏與濕氣入侵。

entries.definition: 信封；高氣密建築外殼圍護結構

explains.en: This is a paper cover used to hold a letter. It has a flap that can be sealed. A name and address are written on the front.
People put a letter inside this folded paper holder. They close it before sending the letter. A stamp goes on one corner.
This word names a flat paper holder for a message. It protects the pages while they travel. The receiver’s address is written on the outside.

examples.en: I lost my eraser under the desk.
examples.zh: 我的橡皮擦掉在桌子下了。

examples.en: Can I borrow your eraser to correct this mistake?
examples.zh: 我可以借你的橡皮擦來更正這個錯誤嗎？

examples.en: Make sure you bring a clean eraser to the exam.
examples.zh: 考試時務必帶一塊乾淨的橡皮擦。

explains.en: This is a small tool used to remove pencil marks. It is often made from soft rubber. Students keep one with their pencils.
When a pencil mark is wrong, this item rubs it off paper. It may be pink or white. It is useful during writing or drawing.
This word names an object for rubbing away pencil lines. It can fit in a pencil case. Artists use one to fix small mistakes.

examples.en: Quantum error correction encodes fragile information across multiple physical qubits to detect phase flips.
examples.zh: 量子糾錯技術，將資訊分散編碼至多顆物理位元中以即時揪出相位翻轉錯誤。

examples.en: Without continuous error suppression, quantum calculations quickly degenerate into meaningless noise.
examples.zh: 若缺乏全天候持續運轉的主動量子糾錯機制，精密的量子運算將在瞬間退化為毫無意義的雜訊。

examples.en: Syndrome measurement circuits detect bit-flip errors without directly measuring the protected data qubit.
examples.zh: 伴隨測量校驗電路能在完全不直接觀測受保護資料位元的前提下，神不知鬼不覺揪出位元翻轉錯誤。

entries.definition: 量子容錯糾錯編碼技術 (QEC)；錯誤

explains.en: It means something done incorrectly. A student may make one while solving a problem. Finding it can help people learn.
Use this word for a mistake in writing, speech, or work. A computer may show a message when something goes wrong. The person can try to fix it.
This word names a wrong action or result. It may happen when someone is learning. A careful look may help find the cause.

examples.en: Even small children know how to use smartphones today.
examples.zh: 如今連小小孩都知道如何使用智慧型手機。

examples.en: Even if it storms tomorrow, the charity indoor race will proceed as planned.
examples.zh: 即使明天暴風雨來襲，這場慈善室內路跑仍將按原定計畫舉行。

examples.en: Two, four, six, and eight are familiar examples of even numbers.
examples.zh: 二、四、六和八都是大家熟知的雙數（偶數）範例。

entries.definition: 甚至；即使；平坦的；偶數的

explains.en: It can mean more than expected. It may also show surprise. As an adjective, it can describe a flat surface or a number divisible by two.
Use this word when something is surprising or added to what was expected. It may describe a level surface. In math, it may mean a number that divides by two with nothing left over.
This word can add emphasis to an idea. It may describe something smooth or level. It can also name a number divisible by two.

examples.en: My family watches TV together in the evening.
examples.zh: 我們全家晚上一起看電視。

examples.en: I will finish my English homework this evening.
examples.zh: 我今晚會完成我的英文作業。

examples.en: We took a relaxing walk along the river in the cool evening.
examples.zh: 我們在涼爽的傍晚沿著河邊愜意散步。

explains.en: This is the part of the day after the sun goes down. People may eat a meal or relax then. It comes after afternoon.
The sky grows darker at this time. Families may return home from work or school. Some people take a walk before bedtime.
This word names the later part of the day. It often begins when daylight fades. People may meet friends or eat together then.

examples.en: Have you ever seen snow?
examples.zh: 你曾經看過雪嗎？

examples.en: I hardly ever eat sweets.
examples.zh: 我幾乎不吃甜食。

examples.en: If you ever need help, call me.
examples.zh: 如果你哪天需要幫忙，打電話給我。

entries.definition: 曾經；在任何時候；究竟（用於疑問或強調）。

explains.en: It means at any time, often in a question. It can also mean at all times in a sentence about experience. The surrounding words show its meaning.
Use this word when asking whether something has happened at any time. It can also add emphasis to a statement. It points to time without naming a date.
This word asks about an unknown time. It may describe any point in a person’s life. It can also make a question sound stronger.

examples.en: We practice English conversation every single day.
examples.zh: 我們每一天都練習英語會話。

examples.en: The bullet train departs on time every fifteen minutes during rush hours.
examples.zh: 高鐵列車在尖峰時段每隔十五分鐘便準點發車一班。

examples.en: Every vote in a democracy plays a meaningful part in shaping society.
examples.zh: 在民主體制中，每一張選票在塑造社會未來時都發揮著重要作用。

explains.en: It means all members of a group, considered separately. A teacher may greet the students one by one. The word can come before a singular noun.
Use this word for all members one at a time. It often comes before a person or thing named in singular form. The idea applies to the full group.
This word means all members without leaving one out. It points to them one at a time. A rule may apply to all people in a room.

examples.en: Good morning, everyone! Let's begin our English lesson.
examples.zh: 大家早安！我們開始上英文課吧。

examples.en: Everyone deserves equal opportunities to learn and achieve their goals.
examples.zh: 每個人都應享有平等學習與實現目標的機會。

examples.en: In Taiwan, almost everyone is familiar with the taste of bubble tea.
examples.zh: 在台灣，幾乎每個人都熟悉珍珠奶茶的滋味。

explains.en: It means all the people in a group. No person is left out. It can describe a crowd or a whole family.
Use this word when talking about all people together. A teacher may ask the full group to listen. It does not name one person in particular.
This word refers to all people in a place or group. It can stand alone as the subject of a sentence. It means no person is left out.

examples.en: Everything is ready for the school sports day tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天學校運動會的一切都準備就緒了。

examples.en: Money cannot buy everything in human life, especially genuine happiness.
examples.zh: 金錢無法買到人生中的所有事物，特別是真正的快樂。

examples.en: Take a deep breath; everything will turn out fine in the end.
examples.zh: 深吸一口氣，最後一切都會好起來的。

explains.en: It means all things that are being talked about. Nothing is left out. A person may gather their belongings before leaving.
Use this word for the full set of things. It may refer to objects, events, or ideas. The speaker does not name each one separately.
This word points to all the things in a situation. It can mean the whole amount. A person may say it when every item matters.

examples.en: The teacher gave an example of a kind action.
examples.zh: 老師舉了一個善良行為的例子。

examples.en: This picture is a good example of modern art.
examples.zh: 這張圖片是現代藝術的好例子。

examples.en: Can you give me an example?
examples.zh: 你可以給我一個例子嗎？

explains.en: This is one thing used to show how another thing works. A teacher may give one to help students understand. It can be a sentence, picture, or object.
Use this word for a sample that makes an idea easy to see. A book may show one after a rule. It helps people learn what to do.
This word names something that shows a type or rule. A teacher may use one during a lesson. It makes an idea easier to understand.

examples.en: Her English pronunciation and accent are excellent.
examples.zh: 她的英語發音與腔調非常優秀。

examples.en: The hotel provides excellent customer hospitality and first-class amenities.
examples.zh: 這家飯店提供卓越貼心的待客之道與一流的設施配備。

examples.en: Fresh seasonal ingredients are the secret behind the chef's excellent cooking.
examples.zh: 新鮮當令的食材是主廚卓越廚藝背後的美味祕訣。

explains.en: It describes something of a very high quality. A student may do very good work. The word can also show strong praise.
Use this word for work that is much better than expected. A team may have a wonderful result. People say it to praise someone.
This word tells that something is extremely good. It can describe a skill or result. A person may use it to show approval.

examples.en: Everyone came except Tom.
examples.zh: 除了Tom之外，大家都來了。

examples.en: The shop is open every day except Sunday.
examples.zh: 除了星期日之外，商店每天都營業。

examples.en: I like all fruit except grapefruit.
examples.zh: 除了葡萄柚之外，我喜歡所有水果。

explains.en: It means leaving one person or thing out. A rule may apply to everyone with one exception. The word often comes before a noun.
Use this word to show that something is not included. A group may go to the park with one person staying home. It points to the one left out.
This word means not including someone or something. It can connect a rule with a limit. The sentence tells what is left out.

examples.en: Students are excited about the upcoming school field trip.
examples.zh: 學生們對即將到來的校外教學感到很興奮。

examples.en: She felt thrilled and excited when her visa was approved.
examples.zh: 當簽證獲准時，她感到無比激動與興奮雀躍。

examples.en: Fans waited excitedly outside the airport terminal to greet their idol.
examples.zh: 粉絲們興奮地在機場航廈外等候迎接偶像。

explains.en: It describes how someone feels when something fun may happen. A person may feel this way before a trip. Their voice may sound lively.
Use this word for a happy and eager feeling. A child may have it before a party. The feeling comes from thinking about something good.
This word tells that someone feels eager and full of energy. A game or visit may cause it. People may smile or speak quickly.

examples.en: Riding the rollercoaster was an exciting adventure.
examples.zh: 坐雲霄飛車是一場刺激的冒險。

examples.en: The championship soccer final was one of the most exciting games this year.
examples.zh: 這場足球冠軍決賽是今年最扣人心弦的比賽之一。

examples.en: Moving to a vibrant new city presents exciting career opportunities.
examples.zh: 搬到充滿活力的新城市會帶來令人振奮的職涯機會。

explains.en: It describes something that makes people feel eager or full of energy. A close game may be this way. People may look forward to it.
Use this word for an event that brings strong happy feelings. A fast ride may seem this way. The people watching may cheer.
This word tells that an activity makes people feel eager. A new trip may have this quality. It can make people want to take part.

examples.en: We exercise in the park every morning.
examples.zh: 我們每天早上在公園運動。

examples.en: The students did a math exercise in class.
examples.zh: 學生們在課堂上做了一道數學練習題。

examples.en: Walking is good exercise for your heart.
examples.zh: 走路對心臟來說是很好的運動。

entries.definition: （名）運動；練習題；（動）運動；鍛鍊；行使

explains.en: This is movement that helps keep the body strong. People may walk, stretch, or play a sport. As a verb, it means using the body or mind for practice.
Use this word for activity done to build health or strength. A person may lift weights or take a run. The verb can also mean practicing a skill.
This word names work done to train the body. It can also mean practicing the mind with questions. People may do it each day to stay healthy.

examples.en: We expect a sunny day for our school field trip.
examples.zh: 我們期盼校外教學當天是個大晴天。

examples.en: As expected, our school basketball team advanced to the finals easily.
examples.zh: 不出所料，我們學校的籃球隊輕鬆晉級了決賽。

examples.en: Parents expect their children to do their best and stay honest.
examples.zh: 父母期許孩子們全力以赴並常保誠實正直。

explains.en: It means thinking that something will happen. A person may look for a friend to arrive soon. The idea may come from what they know.
Use this word when someone thinks a result is likely. A student may look for a test next week. It can describe hope or belief about the future.
This verb tells that someone believes something may happen. A person may wait for a visitor. It can also mean asking someone to behave a certain way.

examples.en: High-end luxury brands are very expensive.
examples.zh: 高級奢侈品牌非常昂貴。

examples.en: Renting an apartment in central Taipei can be quite expensive.
examples.zh: 在台北市中心租公寓價格可能相當昂貴。

examples.en: Dining at five-star restaurants is reserved for rare, expensive celebrations.
examples.zh: 在五星級餐廳用餐是專為少見而隆重的奢華慶祝而留的。

examples.en: Imported luxury brand bags are usually very expensive.
examples.zh: 進口精品名牌包通常非常昂貴。

examples.en: Dining out every evening can become quite expensive over time.
examples.zh: 每天晚上都在外用餐時間久了會變得相當花錢。

examples.en: Making a hasty investment decision proved to be an expensive mistake.
examples.zh: 倉促做出投資決策事後被證明是一個代價高昂的錯誤。

explains.en: It describes something that needs a lot of money. A large house may have a high price. People may save before buying it.
Use this word for an item with a high price. A fancy meal may cost more than a simple one. Shoppers may compare prices first.
This word tells that something is not cheap. It may describe travel, clothing, or food. A person may need to save money to get it.

examples.en: Traveling alone was a new experience for her.
examples.zh: 獨自旅行對她來說是全新的經驗。

examples.en: He experienced great joy at the concert.
examples.zh: 他在音樂會上感到非常快樂。

examples.en: Work experience can help you learn new skills.
examples.zh: 工作經驗可以幫助你學習新技能。

explains.en: This is knowledge gained from doing or seeing something. It may help a person learn a skill. As a verb, it means living through an event.
Use this word for what someone learns by taking part in an activity. A person may gain it at work. The verb can mean going through an event or feeling.
This word names lessons learned from real life. It may help someone do a task better next time. As an action, it means feeling or living through something.

examples.en: The science teacher explained how solar eclipses occur naturally.
examples.zh: 自然老師解釋了日食在自然界中是如何發生的。

examples.en: Can you explain why the software update broke backward compatibility?
examples.zh: 你能否詳細說明一下，為什麼本次軟體版本更新會破壞向後相容性？

examples.en: Let me explain the rules of the board game before we begin playing.
examples.zh: 在我們正式擲骰開局之前，先由我來為大家詳細解說這款桌遊的遊玩規則。

explains.en: It means making an idea easier to understand with words. A teacher may give reasons or details. A picture can help too.
Use this word when telling how something works. A speaker may give clear steps. The listener can ask questions if they still do not understand.
This verb means giving information about an idea. It may answer the question why or how. Simple words help the listener follow.

examples.en: Close your eyes and make a wish.
examples.zh: 閉上你的眼睛並許個願。

examples.en: She looked into my eyes and smiled warmly.
examples.zh: 她注視著我的眼睛並溫暖地微笑了。

examples.en: Please keep an eye on my backpack while I buy a drink.
examples.zh: 我去買杯飲料時，請幫忙照看我的背包。

explains.en: This is the body part used for seeing. It has a pupil that lets light enter. People blink to keep it moist.
People use this part to look at colors and shapes. It sits in the face. A doctor may test how well someone sees.
This word names one of the two parts that help us see. It can show feelings through a look. A pair of glasses may help it focus.

examples.en: Wash your face with warm water.
examples.zh: 用溫水洗洗你的臉。

examples.en: A cheerful smile appeared on her face when she saw the gift.
examples.zh: 當她看到禮物時，臉上露出了開朗的笑容。

examples.en: We must stay brave and face whatever challenges lie ahead.
examples.zh: 我們必須保持勇敢，勇於面對眼前的一切挑戰。

explains.en: This is the front part of a person’s head. It has eyes, a nose, and a mouth. As a verb, it can mean meeting a problem directly.
People recognize one another by looking at this part. It can show feelings with a smile or frown. The verb means turning toward or dealing with something.
This word names the front of the head. It may show joy, fear, or surprise. As an action, it means looking at or dealing with a challenge.

examples.en: It is a fact that water freezes in cold weather.
examples.zh: 水在寒冷的天氣會結冰，這是事實。

examples.en: The book is full of interesting facts about space.
examples.zh: 這本書有許多有關太空的有趣事實。

examples.en: Please check the facts before sharing the story.
examples.zh: 分享這個故事前請先確認事實。

explains.en: This is something known to be true. A person may use one to support an idea. It can be learned from evidence.
Use this word for information that is real and correct. A book may give one about an animal. It is different from a guess or opinion.
This word names a true piece of information. It may help answer a question. A good report supports its ideas with information that can be checked.

examples.en: Modern robotic factories operate with automated assembly lines.
examples.zh: 現代化機器人工廠採用全自動化組裝流水線運作。

examples.en: The shoe factory implements strict safety protocols to protect workers from accidents.
examples.zh: 這座製鞋工廠落實執行嚴格的安全衛生準則，全力保護產線作業員工安全。

examples.en: Solar panels installed across the factory roof supply green power for machinery.
examples.zh: 工廠平頂屋頂上鋪設的太陽能集熱板，為廠內重型機械運作供應綠色電力。

explains.en: This is a building where goods are made. Workers may use machines there. The finished items are sent to stores.
A large workplace makes products from materials. It may produce toys, food, or cars. Many workers help with different steps.
This word names a place where things are made in large amounts. It often has machines and work areas. Raw materials go in and products come out.

examples.en: Anyone scoring below sixty points will fail the course.
examples.zh: 任何得分低於六十分者該課程將被評為不及格。

examples.en: Don't be afraid to fail, because failure is a valuable stepping stone to success.
examples.zh: 不要害怕遭遇挫敗，因為失敗是通往成功的寶貴墊腳石。

examples.en: The old water pump failed during the coldest night of winter.
examples.zh: 那台老舊抽水馬達在寒冬最冷的一夜徹底停止運轉故障了。

explains.en: It means not reaching a goal. A student may get a low mark on a test. A plan may also not work.
Use this word when someone does not succeed. A machine may stop working as planned. It can also mean not passing a school test.
This verb tells that an attempt did not work. It may describe a test result or a broken plan. A person can try again and learn.

examples.en: Autumn leaves turn golden and red in fall.
examples.zh: 秋天時落葉會變成金黃與紅色。

examples.en: Be careful on the wet hiking trail so you do not slip and fall.
examples.zh: 潮濕的登山步道上請小心行走，以免滑倒摔跤。

examples.en: Apples and pears ripen and fall from branches when autumn arrives.
examples.zh: 秋天到來時，蘋果與梨子在枝頭熟成掉落。

explains.en: It can mean moving down from a higher place. It also names the season when leaves turn color. A person may trip and land on the ground.
Use this word when someone loses balance and goes to the ground. It can also name autumn in some places. The leaves often change color then.
This word can describe dropping from a height. It may name one of the four seasons. It can also mean becoming less in number or level.

examples.en: I have a warm and happy family.
examples.zh: 我有一個溫暖且幸福的家庭。

examples.en: My family usually gathers together on Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 我們全家通常在農曆新年團聚。

examples.en: Family is the most important thing in my life.
examples.zh: 家庭是我生命中最重要的事情。

explains.en: This is a group of people related to one another. They may live together or meet often. Parents, children, and grandparents may be part of it.
People in this group care for one another. They may share a home or have the same parents. Some members live far apart.
This word names people joined by birth, marriage, or care. They may have parents, children, or cousins. Many gather for holidays.

examples.en: Alishan is famous for its sunrise and tea.
examples.zh: 阿里山以其日出和高山茶聞名。

examples.en: Taiwan is world-famous for its high-tech semiconductor manufacturing.
examples.zh: 台灣以其頂尖高科技半導體製造技術聞名遐邇於世。

examples.en: The famous Taiwanese author was invited to give a keynote literary speech.
examples.zh: 那位著名的台灣作家受邀發表文學專題演講。

explains.en: It describes someone many people know about. A singer or sports player may be this way. Their work or actions are known by many.
Use this word for a person or place known by many people. A well-known actor may have fans. The word can also describe a special landmark.
This word tells that many people have heard of someone or something. It may describe a star or a city. News and stories can make a person widely known.

examples.en: Turn on the fan to cool the room.
examples.zh: 打開電風扇讓房間涼爽一點。

examples.en: Thousands of screaming sports fans filled the baseball stadium.
examples.zh: 數萬名熱情尖叫的球迷擠滿了棒球場。

examples.en: An oscillating electric fan keeps the bedroom comfortable on warm nights.
examples.zh: 擺頭電風扇讓溫熱的夜晚臥室保持涼爽舒適。

explains.en: It can name a machine with turning blades that moves air. It can also mean someone who likes a team or performer. As a verb, it can mean moving air with a hand-held object.
People use this device to feel a breeze in warm weather. A sports lover may follow a team closely. The verb means making air move toward someone.
This word can mean a person who strongly likes a singer or team. It may name a device with blades. The action means moving air with a hand.

examples.en: The school is far from my house.
examples.zh: 學校離我家很遠。

examples.en: How far is the station from here?
examples.zh: 車站離這裡有多遠？

examples.en: The birds flew far across the sea.
examples.zh: 鳥兒飛越大海到很遠的地方。

explains.en: It means a long distance from here. It can also describe something that is not close in time or degree. The opposite idea is near.
Use this word when a place takes a long time to reach. It may describe a large gap between two things. A sound may seem quiet when it comes from a great distance.
This word tells that something is not nearby. It can describe a long distance or a large difference. A person may travel for hours to reach such a place.

examples.en: My grandparents work on a small farm.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母在一座小農場工作。

examples.en: They farm the land near the river.
examples.zh: 他們在河邊耕種土地。

examples.en: The farm has cows, chickens, and a garden.
examples.zh: 農場裡有乳牛、雞和一座菜園。

entries.definition: （名）農場；（動）耕種；務農；飼養（動物）

explains.en: This is a place where people grow crops or raise animals. It may have fields, barns, and tools. As a verb, it means growing food or raising animals.
Workers may plant seeds in fields at this place. Animals such as cows or chickens may live there. The verb means producing food from the land.
This word names land used to grow plants or keep animals. A family may live there. It can also mean working the land to produce food.

examples.en: Local farmers grow delicious guavas and wax apples.
examples.zh: 當地農夫種植美味的芭樂和蓮霧。

examples.en: The hardworking farmer starts working in the paddy fields at daybreak.
examples.zh: 辛勤的農民破曉時分就開始在稻田裡辛勤耕作。

examples.en: Organic farmers avoid synthetic pesticides to protect soil and wildlife.
examples.zh: 有機農夫避免使用化學農藥，以守護土壤與野生動植物。

explains.en: This is a person who grows food or raises animals. They may work outside in fields. Their work helps provide food for others.
Someone with this job plants crops or cares for animals. They may use machines and tools. The work changes with the seasons.
This word names a worker who produces food from land or animals. They may grow rice, fruit, or vegetables. Their work often starts early in the day.

examples.en: The Taiwan High Speed Rail travels very fast.
examples.zh: 台灣高鐵行駛得非常快。

examples.en: Cheetahs can run remarkably fast when chasing prey.
examples.zh: 獵豹在追捕獵物時能跑得極為飛快。

examples.en: Fast food tastes delicious but should not be eaten every single day.
examples.zh: 速食雖然美味，但不應該天天食用。

explains.en: It describes something that moves with great speed. A runner may reach the finish line quickly. It can also mean firmly fixed or not changing.
Use this word for a person or thing that moves quickly. It may describe a quick meal. As an adjective, it can also mean steady or firmly joined.
This word tells that something happens in little time. A train may travel this way. It can also describe a person who does not eat for a period.

examples.en: The cat is getting fat because it eats too much.
examples.zh: 這隻貓因為吃太多而變胖了。

examples.en: This soup has very little fat.
examples.zh: 這碗湯的脂肪含量很低。

examples.en: Trim the fat from the meat before cooking.
examples.zh: 烹調前先把肉上的脂肪修掉。

entries.definition: （名）脂肪；肥肉；（形）肥胖的；豐滿的。

explains.en: This is a soft substance stored in the bodies of people and animals. It gives energy and helps keep the body warm. As an adjective, it describes someone with a larger body shape.
People and animals need some of this substance for energy. Too much may affect health. The word can also describe food with a rich, oily quality.
This word names a body substance that stores energy. It can describe meat or dairy food with much of it. Used to describe a person, it may sound unkind.

examples.en: My father cooks delicious dinner for us.
examples.zh: 我父親為我們煮美味的晚餐。

examples.en: His father drives him to school every morning.
examples.zh: 他的父親每天早上開車送他上學。

examples.en: My father taught me how to ride a bicycle.
examples.zh: 我父親教我如何騎腳踏車。

explains.en: This is a male parent. He may help raise a child. The word can also be used warmly when speaking to him.
A child may have this family member at home. He may teach, care for, or play with the child. Some people call him Dad.
This word names the man who is a child’s parent. He may be related by birth or care. Families may use it with a name.

examples.en: Scroll down your news feed to discover trending stories and friends' updates.
examples.zh: 向下滑動你的社群動態牆以探索熱門話題與好友最新動態。

examples.en: Farmers wake up at dawn to feed livestock in the barn.
examples.zh: 農夫們黎明時分就早早起床到牲口棚舍裡餵食牲畜家禽。

examples.en: The RSS feed automatically pulls fresh news articles into the reader app.
examples.zh: RSS 資訊摘要源能自動將最新出版的新聞文章抓取至閱讀器中。

explains.en: It means giving food to someone or an animal. A parent may serve a meal to a child. It can also name a stream of new posts online.
Use this word when placing food before someone. A person may give seeds to birds. It can also mean a flow of updates on a phone or site.
This verb means providing food. It can describe a parent helping a child eat. The noun may name a stream of messages.

examples.en: I feel energetic after a good night's sleep.
examples.zh: 睡了個好覺後，我感到精力充沛。

examples.en: Feel the fabric of this coat; it is remarkably soft and thick.
examples.zh: 摸摸看這件大衣的布料，非常柔軟且厚實。

examples.en: I feel that we should double-check all calculations before submission.
examples.zh: 我覺得我們在繳交之前應該再次仔細核對所有計算。

explains.en: It means noticing something with the body or emotions. A person may touch a soft blanket. The noun can describe the mood of a place.
Use this word for noticing heat, cold, or touch. It can also mean having an emotion. A room may have a warm and welcoming quality.
This verb tells what someone notices through touch or emotion. A person may sense joy or pain. The noun can name the mood of a place.

examples.en: The Pingxi Sky Lantern Festival is famous worldwide.
examples.zh: 平溪天燈節享譽全球。

examples.en: Our town hosts an annual mango jazz festival every July.
examples.zh: 我們小鎮每年七月都會舉辦一年一度的芒果爵士音樂節。

examples.en: Visitors from overseas enjoyed traditional dances during the harvest festival.
examples.zh: 來自海外的遊客在豐年祭慶典期間欣賞了精采的傳統舞蹈。

examples.en: The Golden Horse Film Festival showcases cutting-edge contemporary Chinese-language cinema.
examples.zh: 台北金馬影展是華語影壇歷史最悠久、最具前瞻性與國際影響力的頂級當代電影盛會。

examples.en: Submitting their debut feature film to independent film festivals opens doors for young creators.
examples.zh: 將導演處女長片投件至各大國際獨立影展競賽，是青年新銳創作者叩關國際影壇的重要敲門磚。

examples.en: Thousands of passionate film buffs flock to movie theaters all day during the annual film festival.
examples.zh: 每年國際影展期間，全台數萬名熱血文青影迷起個大早穿梭於各大戲院間展開馬拉松式狂熱趕場。

entries.definition: 節慶；節日；慶典；國際影展；節慶慶典

explains.en: This is a public event with music, food, or shows. It may last one day or several. People gather to enjoy a shared activity.
Families may visit this event to see shows or try food. A town may hold one each year. It can celebrate music, books, or a season.
This word names a special event with many activities. People may sing, dance, or look at art. A town brings people together for it.

examples.en: He has a few good friends in his hometown.
examples.zh: 他在家鄉有幾位好朋友。

examples.en: Very few people know about this hidden mountain trail.
examples.zh: 極少數人知道這條隱密的山間小徑。

examples.en: We arrived at the station a few minutes before departure.
examples.zh: 我們在發車前幾分鐘抵達了車站。

explains.en: It means a small number of people or things. The amount is more than zero but not many. It is used with items that can be counted.
Use this word for only a small number. A person may have several friends, but not a large group. It often comes before a plural noun.
This word tells that there are not many. It can describe a small group of people. It may also stand alone when the noun is clear.

examples.en: The two players had a fight over the ball.
examples.zh: 兩位選手為了那顆球打了起來。

examples.en: They fought bravely to protect their home.
examples.zh: 他們勇敢奮戰，保護自己的家園。

examples.en: The fight ended when the coach arrived.
examples.zh: 教練到場後，打鬥就結束了。

explains.en: It means trying to hurt another person or animal. It can also name a struggle between people. The noun and verb have related meanings.
Use this word when people use force against one another. It may describe a disagreement that turns physical. Someone may try to stop the struggle.
This word can mean using force to harm someone. It can name the struggle itself. People may work together to prevent it.

examples.en: Save the file on your computer.
examples.zh: 把檔案存到電腦裡。

examples.en: Please file these papers by date.
examples.zh: 請依日期把這些文件歸檔。

examples.en: He used a file to smooth the wooden edge.
examples.zh: 他用銼刀把木頭邊緣磨平。

entries.definition: （名）電腦檔案；文件夾；銼刀；（動）歸檔；銼平

explains.en: This is a set of papers or information kept together. It can also mean shaping material with a rough tool. An office worker may keep one on a computer.
Use this word for a document saved on a computer. A folder may hold many of them. The verb can mean smoothing a rough edge with a tool.
This word names an organized paper or computer record. People store it to find information later. A small rough tool can smooth things.

examples.en: Fill the glass with cold water.
examples.zh: 把玻璃杯裝滿冷水。

examples.en: Please fill in your name on this form.
examples.zh: 請在這張表格上填寫姓名。

examples.en: The room was filled with music.
examples.zh: 房間裡充滿了音樂。

entries.definition: 填滿；填寫；充滿；（名）足夠的量；飽足感

explains.en: It means putting something into a space until no room is left. A cup may hold water. It can also name a feeling of satisfaction after a meal.
Use this word when adding items or liquid to a container. A person may add details to a form. The noun may describe feeling satisfied after eating.
This verb means making a space or container hold more. It can refer to liquid, people, or information. The noun may describe someone who has eaten enough.

examples.en: Finally, the bus arrived at the station.
