examples.zh: 最後，公車抵達了車站。

examples.en: She finally finished her homework.
examples.zh: 她終於完成了作業。

examples.en: The team finally won after many tries.
examples.zh: 嘗試多次後，這支隊伍終於獲勝。

explains.en: It means after a long wait or at the last point. A person may reach home after a trip. It can show that something happened at last.
Use this word when something happens after other things are done. It points to the final step. People may say it when they feel relief.
This word tells that an event comes at the end of a process. It may follow many earlier steps. A speaker can use it to show that waiting is over.

examples.en: I cannot find my student ID card anywhere.
examples.zh: 我到處都找不到我的學生證。

examples.en: Scientists hope to find new renewable energy solutions.
examples.zh: 科學家希望能找到新的再生能源解決方案。

examples.en: Did you find it easy to adapt to the new school routine?
examples.zh: 你覺得適應新的學校日常步調容易嗎？

explains.en: It means discovering something that was lost or not known. A person may see a key under a chair. The noun can name something discovered.
Use this word when someone locates an item. It may also mean learning a fact. A good search can reveal what was hidden.
This verb means coming upon something after looking. It can describe learning the truth. A discovery may also have this name.

examples.en: I am doing fine, thank you for asking.
examples.zh: 我過得很好，謝謝你的關心。

examples.en: The weather forecast predicts fine sunny skies for the weekend.
examples.zh: 氣象預報指出週末將會是陽光明媚的晴朗好天氣。

examples.en: Drivers who park illegally will be forced to pay a hefty financial fine.
examples.zh: 違規停車的駕駛將被迫繳納高額罰款。

examples.en: You will get a fine for parking in a red-line zone.
examples.zh: 在紅線違規停車會收到罰單。

examples.en: The weather looks perfectly fine for an outdoor picnic.
examples.zh: 天氣看起來非常晴朗良好，很適合戶外野餐。

examples.en: The court imposed a heavy fine on the illegal dumping company.
examples.zh: 法院對非法傾倒廢棄物的公司處以重罰。

examples.en: Drivers who run red lights face a heavy traffic fine.
examples.zh: 汽機車駕駛人闖紅燈者將面臨交通違規高額行政罰鍰。

examples.en: The environmental protection bureau slapped the chemical plant with a massive fine for discharging untreated wastewater.
examples.zh: 環保局針對這家涉嫌私自暗管偷排未經處理有毒工業廢水的化學工廠，祭出了破紀錄的高額巨額重罰。

examples.en: We enjoyed a leisurely walk through the park under fine, clear autumn weather.
examples.zh: 在秋高氣爽、萬里無雲的晴朗好天氣下，我們一家人在市區生態公園的林蔭小徑上愜意漫步散心。

entries.definition: 很好；晴朗；精細；罰款；罰金；處以罰款；罰鍰；好的

explains.en: It can mean good or acceptable. It may describe the weather or a thin detail. As a noun, it can name money paid for breaking a rule.
Use this word to say that something is okay. It may describe sunny weather or high quality. A person may pay one after a parking mistake.
This word can mean well or in good condition. It may describe small details. As a noun, it is money paid as a penalty.

examples.en: Each hand has five fingers.
examples.zh: 每隻手有五隻手指。

examples.en: Be careful not to cut your finger while slicing vegetables.
examples.zh: 切蔬菜時請小心不要切到手指。

examples.en: Keep your fingers crossed that our school team wins the final match.
examples.zh: 祈求好運，祝願我們校隊能贏得決賽。

explains.en: This is one of the long parts at the end of a hand. People use it to hold small things. It can also mean naming someone who did wrong.
A hand has several of these parts. They help people touch, point, and pick up objects. The verb can mean secretly naming someone as responsible.
This word names a part of the hand. A person may use one to press a button. As a verb, it can mean accusing or identifying someone.

examples.en: I always finish my homework before having dinner.
examples.zh: 我總是在吃晚餐前把功課寫完。

examples.en: The marathon runner crossed the finish line with triumphant tears.
examples.zh: 馬拉松跑者熱淚盈眶、滿懷勝利喜悅地衝過終點線。

examples.en: How long will it take our team to finish the quarterly audit?
examples.zh: 我們團隊需要花多久時間才能完成本季度的稽核作業？

examples.en: A sweet, cooling finish lingering in the throat is the hallmark of great tea.
examples.zh: 飲下熱茶後喉頭湧現一股甘涼生津、久久不散的甜美喉韻回甘，是頂級好茶的標誌。

examples.en: He used fine sandpaper to achieve a glossy, satin finish on the wooden tabletop.
examples.zh: 他用極細的水砂紙細細打磨，使手工原木餐桌表面呈現出如絲緞般溫潤光滑的表面質感。

examples.en: The long marathon runners sprinted with all their remaining energy toward the finish line.
examples.zh: 馬拉松長跑選手們使出渾身剩餘的每一分體力全力衝刺，奔向眼前萬眾矚目的終點線。

explains.en: It means doing the last part of a task. A person may reach the last page of a book. The noun can name the final look or taste of something.
Use this word when an activity is done. A runner reaches the end of a race. The noun may describe the surface of wood or the taste that remains.
This verb means bringing work to its final point. It can also mean using all of something. The noun may name how a product looks or tastes at the end.

examples.en: The global FIRE movement advocates aggressive saving to retire in your forties.
examples.zh: 風靡全球白領青年的「FIRE運動」提倡透過極簡高儲蓄率與被動投資，實現在四十歲提早退休。

examples.en: Practicing FIRE principles requires keeping fixed living expenses lean while investing the surplus.
examples.zh: 踐行 FIRE 財務自由精神的核心在於將每月固定生活開銷維持精簡，並將所有結餘全數滾入指數。

examples.en: Achieving 'Lean FIRE' means living on minimal expenses funded entirely by investments.
examples.zh: 達成所謂的「極簡式財務自由（Lean FIRE）」，意味著過著質樸簡約、完全由投資被動收入支應的生活。

explains.en: It is heat and light that can burn things. It may start when something dry gets very hot. People must keep it away from things that can catch easily.
As a verb, it can mean making a gun send out a bullet. It can also mean telling a worker that their job is over. Context shows which meaning is meant.
This word can name a bright, hot flame. It can also describe using a gun or ending someone’s job. The nearby words make the sense clear.

examples.en: Safety always comes first.
examples.zh: 安全永遠排在第一位。

examples.en: This is my very first time visiting Sun Moon Lake.
examples.zh: 這是我第一次造訪日月潭。

examples.en: She won first prize in the national speech competition.
examples.zh: 她在全國演講比賽中勇奪第一名。

explains.en: It means coming before all others in time or order. A person may arrive at the start of a line. It can also name the top position.
Use this word for the one that comes at the start. It can describe the earliest time. It may also mean the top place in a contest.
This word points to the start of a list or race. It can name someone who finishes ahead of others. It can also mean doing something before anything else.

examples.en: Fish is rich in healthy oils.
examples.zh: 魚肉富含健康的油脂。

examples.en: My grandfather likes to go fishing by the river on weekends.
examples.zh: 我爺爺週末喜歡去河邊釣魚。

examples.en: We saw colorful tropical fish while snorkeling.
examples.zh: 我們浮潛時看見了五彩繽紛的熱帶魚。

explains.en: This is an animal that lives in water and has fins. People may also eat it. As a verb, it means trying to catch these animals.
The animal breathes through gills and swims with its tail. It may live in a river or the sea. People can use a line and hook to catch one.
This word can name a water animal or food made from it. It has scales or smooth skin. The verb means trying to catch one from water.

examples.en: Our classroom is on the third floor.
examples.zh: 我們的教室在三樓。

examples.en: The wet floor is very slippery, so walk carefully.
examples.zh: 潮濕的地板非常滑，所以請小心行走。

examples.en: He dropped his glasses on the floor and broke them.
examples.zh: 他的眼鏡掉在地上摔破了。

explains.en: This is the surface people walk on inside a room. It may also mean one level of a building. As a verb, it can mean covering a space with boards.
People stand or walk on this part of a building. A tall office may have many levels. The verb can mean adding a surface underfoot.
This word names the bottom surface of a room. It can also refer to one storey in a building. A worker may cover a room with wood or tiles.

examples.en: She put fresh flowers in the vase.
examples.zh: 她在花瓶裡插上新鮮的花朵。

examples.en: Cherry blossom flowers attract thousands of photography lovers every spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天盛開的櫻花都會吸引成千上萬的攝影愛好者。

examples.en: The local flower market sells orchids, roses, and sunflowers.
examples.zh: 在地的花市販售蘭花、玫瑰以及向日葵。

explains.en: This is the colorful part of a plant that may make seeds. People give it as a gift. As a verb, it means opening into a blossom.
A plant grows this bright part during the right season. Bees may visit it for sweet liquid. It can also mean opening and showing new petals.
This word names a part of many plants. It may have petals and a pleasant smell. As an action, it means producing blossoms.

examples.en: Birds can fly high in the blue sky.
examples.zh: 鳥兒能在藍天中展翅高飛。

examples.en: We will fly to Tokyo for our vacation next Monday.
examples.zh: 我們下週一將搭飛機前往東京度假。

examples.en: The children love to fly kites on windy autumn afternoons.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡在多風的秋日午後放風箏。

explains.en: It means moving through the air with wings or an aircraft. It can also name a small insect with wings. A pilot may do this across a country.
Birds do this by moving their wings. A person may travel through the sky in a plane. The word also names a tiny insect that buzzes.
This verb means traveling above the ground through the air. It can describe a bird or plane. The noun may name a small insect with wings.

examples.en: Follow the signs to the museum.
examples.zh: 沿著標誌前往博物館。

examples.en: The little duck followed its mother.
examples.zh: 小鴨跟著媽媽。

examples.en: Please follow the teacher’s directions.
examples.zh: 請遵照老師的指示。

entries.definition: 跟隨；跟在……後面；遵循；明白

explains.en: It means going after someone or something. A person may walk behind a guide. It can also mean obeying directions or understanding a story.
Use this word when moving along the same path as someone ahead. It may mean doing what a rule says. Readers may use it when working through steps in a book.
This verb can mean going behind a person. It may also mean paying attention to directions. A person may keep doing the same practice.

examples.en: Taiwanese street food is world famous.
examples.zh: 台灣街頭小吃舉世聞名。

examples.en: Never waste food because many people don't have enough to eat.
examples.zh: 絕不要浪費食物，因為世界上很多人缺乏糧食。

examples.en: Japanese food such as sushi and ramen is very popular here.
examples.zh: 像壽司和拉麵這樣的日本料理在這裡很受歡迎。

explains.en: This is what people and animals eat to live. It may come from plants or animals. A meal gives the body energy.
People cook and eat this every day. It can be sweet, salty, or plain. The body uses it to grow and stay healthy.
This word names meals and snacks. Fruits, rice, and meat are kinds of it. People need it to get energy.

examples.en: The fool forgot his hat on the bus.
examples.zh: 那個傻瓜把帽子忘在公車上了。

examples.en: Do not fool your little brother.
examples.zh: 不要捉弄你的弟弟。

examples.en: He felt like a fool after the silly mistake.
examples.zh: 犯下那個愚蠢的錯誤後，他覺得自己像個傻瓜。

explains.en: This can mean a person who acts without good sense. Someone may ignore a clear warning and make a poor choice. Calling a person this can be unkind.
The verb means to make someone believe something that is not true. A trick may be a playful joke. It can also be meant to cheat or harm someone.
Someone may play a small trick on a friend for fun. The friend believes the story at first. Later they learn that it was made up.

examples.en: My feet hurt after standing all day.
examples.zh: 站了一整天後我的雙腳很痛。

examples.en: We explored the old mountain village entirely on foot.
examples.zh: 我們完全徒步探索這座古老山城。

examples.en: The basketball player stands over six feet tall.
examples.zh: 這位籃球運動員身高超過六英呎。

explains.en: This is the part of the body below the ankle. People stand and walk on two of them. It can also mean a unit of length.
A shoe covers this body part. It has toes and a sole. A ruler may use this old length unit, equal to twelve inches.
This word names the end part of a leg. It helps a person stand. It can also measure length in some places.

examples.en: This handmade birthday card is specially for you!
examples.zh: 這張手作生日卡片是特別為你製作的！

examples.en: Regular cardiovascular exercise is exceptionally good for heart health.
examples.zh: 規律的有氧心肺運動對心臟健康格外有益。

examples.en: For example, bananas and apples are rich in essential dietary vitamins.
examples.zh: 舉例來說，香蕉和蘋果富含人體不可或缺的膳食維生素。

explains.en: It can show who receives something or why an action happens. It may also tell the length of time. The meaning depends on the sentence.
Use this short word to name a person who will get a gift. It can show a purpose or reason. It may also tell how long something lasts.
This short word can point to a goal, receiver, or cause. It may describe a period of time. The surrounding words tell how it is used.

examples.en: She enjoys foreign films from many countries.
examples.zh: 她喜歡來自許多國家的外國電影。

examples.en: We tried foreign food at the festival.
examples.zh: 我們在節慶活動中品嚐了異國料理。

examples.en: He studies a foreign language at school.
examples.zh: 他在學校學習一門外語。

entries.definition: 外國的；異國的；非本地的。

explains.en: It describes something that comes from another country. A language may sound new to a visitor. A person may travel to learn about another culture.
Use this word for a place, language, or object from outside your own nation. The item may seem unfamiliar. People learn about other ways of life when they travel.
This word tells that something is linked to another nation. It may describe food or a language. It can also mean strange or unfamiliar to someone.

examples.en: Many foreigners enjoy the vibrant atmosphere of Taiwanese night markets.
examples.zh: 許多外國人喜愛台灣夜市熱鬧的氛圍。

examples.en: Taiwanese people are famous for being warm and hospitable toward foreigners.
examples.zh: 台灣人以對外國人士熱情好客、友善親切而著稱於世。

examples.en: It takes courage to move abroad and live as a foreigner in a distant culture.
examples.zh: 隻身移居異國、在陌生的異域文化中生活需要莫大的勇氣。

explains.en: This is a person who comes from a country different from the one where they now live. The person may speak another language. They may visit for work or study.
Someone with this name was born or lives in another nation. They may be a guest in the place they visit. People should welcome visitors kindly.
This word names a person from another country. They may be traveling, studying, or working abroad. Their home may be far away.

examples.en: Don't forget to bring your umbrella today.
examples.zh: 今天出門別忘了帶雨傘。

examples.en: I will never forget the breathtaking sunrise we saw on Alishan.
examples.zh: 我永遠不會忘記我們在阿里山看見那令人屏息的壯美日出。

examples.en: He wrote down the important appointment details so he wouldn't forget them.
examples.zh: 他把重要預約細節寫下來，以免自己遺忘。

explains.en: It means not remembering something. A person may leave a book at home by mistake. A reminder can help bring the memory back.
Use this word when an idea or event slips from memory. A student may not remember a name. Writing a note can help.
This verb tells that someone no longer remembers. It may happen with a small task or an important date. A calendar can help prevent it.

examples.en: Use a fork and knife to eat your steak.
examples.zh: 用叉子和刀子吃你的牛排。

examples.en: She picked up a piece of melon with a small fruit fork.
examples.zh: 她用小水果叉叉起了一塊甜瓜。

examples.en: Set the table with forks on the left side of the plates.
examples.zh: 擺好餐具，把叉子放在餐盤的左側。

explains.en: This is a tool with several pointed parts used for eating. People hold it in one hand at a meal. It may also help turn soil in a garden.
The utensil has short points that hold food. A person may use it with a knife. Garden workers use a larger tool with similar points.
This word names a common eating tool. It can also mean a branch in a road or path. Farmers use a larger one to move soil.

examples.en: Are you free to grab a cup of coffee this afternoon?
examples.zh: 你今天下午有空喝杯咖啡嗎？

examples.en: Children under six years old enjoy free admission to the museum.
examples.zh: 六歲以下兒童可免費參觀這座博物館。

examples.en: Birds flying high in the sky are wild and free.
examples.zh: 在高空中翱翔的鳥兒狂野且自由自在。

explains.en: It can mean having no work at a certain time. It may also mean costing nothing. As a verb, it can mean letting someone go.
Use this word when a person has time to relax. A ticket may cost no money. As an action, it can mean setting someone or something loose.
This word can describe a person who is not busy. It may describe an item given at no price. It can also mean removing a person from control.

examples.en: These organic vegetables were picked fresh this morning.
examples.zh: 這些有機蔬菜是今天早上剛採摘的新鮮貨。

examples.en: Open the bedroom window to let in some crisp fresh morning air.
examples.zh: 打開臥室窗戶讓清爽的早晨新鮮空氣流通進來。

examples.en: After taking a cold shower, he felt completely refreshed and ready to work.
examples.zh: 沖完冷水澡後，他感到通體舒暢且充滿幹勁準備工作。

explains.en: It describes food picked or made recently. It can also describe clean air or new ideas. A new flower may have this quality.
Use this word for something not old or stale. A cool breeze may feel nice. It can describe a new way of thinking.
This word tells that something is recent or lively. Food may taste good soon after it is made. Air may feel cool and clean.

examples.en: She is my best friend in class.
examples.zh: 她是我班上最好的朋友。

examples.en: I made many new friends during summer camp.
examples.zh: 我在夏令營期間交了許多新朋友。

examples.en: A true friend will always stand by your side.
examples.zh: 真正的朋友總會站在你身邊支持你。

examples.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
examples.zh: 患難見真情。

examples.en: Joining campus clubs is a great way to make lifelong friends.
examples.zh: 參加校園社團是結交一生摯友的絕佳途徑。

examples.en: My best friend always listens patiently and offers thoughtful, honest advice.
examples.zh: 我最好的朋友總是耐心傾聽，並提供體貼而真摯坦率的建議。

explains.en: This is a person you like and trust. You may play or talk together. A good one helps when times are hard.
People spend time with this person because they care about one another. They may share secrets or games. The relationship can last for many years.
This word names someone kind and trusted. The person may visit or help you. People often enjoy doing things together.

examples.en: The local Taiwanese villagers are exceptionally friendly.
examples.zh: 台灣當地的村民格外友善親切。

examples.en: The user-friendly interface makes the mobile app easy for elderly users to navigate.
examples.zh: 友善易用的人機介面讓年長的使用者能輕鬆操作這款手機 APP。

examples.en: A warm and friendly greeting sets a welcoming atmosphere for newcomers.
examples.zh: 一聲熱情友好的問候能為新來者營造賓至如歸的融洽氛圍。

examples.en: Purchasing eco-friendly rice grown without pesticides preserves a pesticide-free feeding ground for leopard cats.
examples.zh: 選購無農藥、無化肥耕作的「石虎友善米」（Eco-Friendly Rice），能為石虎保留一片生機盎然的獵食棲地。

examples.en: Wildlife-friendly tea plantations install perches that attract insect-eating birds naturally.
examples.zh: 推廣猛禽友善茶園的農民在茶園中架設高立棲架，吸引黑翅鳶自然飛臨捕捉田間害鼠害蟲。

examples.en: Friendly neighborhood volunteers rescue injured raptors and transport them to wildlife rehabilitation clinics.
examples.zh: 熱心的社區愛心志工在發現受傷的猛禽時，會第一時間小心妥善後送至野生動物救傷中心。

entries.definition: 友善的；親切的；不用農藥化肥之石虎米友善農作的

explains.en: It describes someone who is kind and easy to talk to. A warm smile may show this quality. It can also describe a place or service that welcomes people.
Use this word for a person who treats others well. A helpful worker may have this manner. A town may make visitors feel welcome.
This word tells that someone is warm and kind. It may describe an animal that is gentle. It can also mean good for the natural world.

examples.en: Frogs croak loudly near the pond after rain.
examples.zh: 雨後池塘邊的青蛙呱呱大聲叫著。

examples.en: The green tree frog blended perfectly into the wet tropical leaves.
examples.zh: 綠色樹蛙完美融入了潮濕的熱帶樹葉之中。

examples.en: Tadpoles hatch from eggs in freshwater and gradually turn into frogs.
examples.zh: 蝌蚪在淡水卵中孵化，並逐漸長成青蛙。

explains.en: This is a small animal that lives near water. It has strong back legs for jumping. It catches insects with a long tongue.
The animal may sit on a lily pad or rock. It has smooth skin and webbed feet. Its young begins life as a tadpole.
This word names a green or brown animal that hops. It may live in a pond or wet field. It makes a croaking sound.

examples.en: This letter is from my best friend.
examples.zh: 這封信是我最好的朋友寄來的。

examples.en: The train travels from Taipei to Tainan.
examples.zh: 這班火車從台北開往台南。

examples.en: She made a doll from old cloth.
examples.zh: 她用舊布做了一個娃娃。

explains.en: It tells the place, person, or time where something starts. A letter may have a named sender. It can also show what material was used.
Use this short word to point to a starting place. It can name who sent a message. It may also tell what material made an object.
This word can show where something began. It may identify the person who gave an item. A recipe may name the ingredients used.

examples.en: The front of the house faces the garden.
examples.zh: 房子的正面朝向花園。

examples.en: Please sit in the front row.
examples.zh: 請坐在前排。

examples.en: The front door was painted red.
examples.zh: 前門漆成了紅色。

explains.en: This means the part that faces forward. It may be the area closest to the entrance. It can also describe a position at the start of a line.
Use this word for the side seen first when looking at an object. It may describe the area near an entrance. A person at the start of a group stands there.
This word names the part that faces outward or forward. It may describe the start of a building. It can also mean acting in a false way to hide the truth.

examples.en: Taiwan is famous for delicious fresh fruit.
examples.zh: 台灣以美味的新鮮水果聞名。

examples.en: Eating fresh fruit every day provides essential vitamins.
examples.zh: 每天吃新鮮水果能提供人體必需的維生素。

examples.en: We made a colorful fruit salad with mangoes and apples.
examples.zh: 我們用芒果和蘋果做了一道色彩繽紛的水果沙拉。

explains.en: This is a sweet part of many plants that people eat. It may have seeds inside. Apples, grapes, and pears are kinds.
People may eat this food fresh or use it in a pie. It grows on trees, vines, and bushes. It often has a sweet taste.
This word names food that grows from a flower on a plant. It may be juicy and sweet. Many kinds contain seeds.

examples.en: I am full after eating three bowls of noodles.
examples.zh: 吃了三碗麵後我已經飽了。

examples.en: The library reading room was completely full during exam week.
examples.zh: 考試週期間圖書館自習室座無虛席。

examples.en: She was full of excitement before setting off on her foreign exchange program.
examples.zh: 在出發前往海外交換學生計畫之前，她心中充滿了興奮與期待。

explains.en: It describes a container with no space for more. It can also describe someone who has eaten enough. A bus may have no empty seats.
Use this word when every space is taken. A person may feel satisfied after eating. A schedule may have no free time.
This word means holding as much as possible. It may describe a person who has had enough food. It can also mean complete.

examples.en: Learning English through pop songs is real fun.
examples.zh: 透過流行歌曲學習英語真的很有趣。

examples.en: Have fun at the water amusement park with your classmates!
examples.zh: 和你的同班同學在水上樂園玩得盡興開心喔！

examples.en: Don't make fun of others when they make innocent pronunciation slips.
examples.zh: 當別人無心念錯發音時，不要取笑他們。

explains.en: This is enjoyment or a happy activity. People may have it while playing a game. The word can describe something that makes people laugh or smile.
Use this word for a good time with friends. A party may bring laughter. A trip may be enjoyable even when it is tiring.
This word names pleasure and enjoyment. It may describe a game or joke. People often seek it in their free time.

examples.en: The comedian told a hilarious and funny joke.
examples.zh: 那位喜劇演員講了一個非常滑稽好笑的笑話。

examples.en: My little brother makes funny facial expressions when he gets angry.
examples.zh: 我弟弟生氣時會做出滑稽好笑的面部表情。

examples.en: There is a funny noise coming from the car engine.
examples.zh: 汽車引擎發出一種古怪異常的聲音。

explains.en: It describes something that makes people laugh. It may also mean strange in a surprising way. A person may tell a joke that has this quality.
Use this word for a story or show that causes laughter. It can describe an unusual event. The speaker may mean silly or odd.
This word tells that something is amusing. It can also describe a strange feeling or situation. A joke may make a whole room laugh.

examples.en: Building with wood and sunshine creates a regenerative green architectural future for all life on Earth.
examples.zh: 用溫暖原木與燦爛陽光蓋房子，正在為地球上的每一種生命開創一個生生不息、淨零永續的美好未來。

examples.en: Investing in clean construction technologies today secures a livable, climate-resilient future for our children.
examples.zh: 勇於在當下投資潔淨低碳營建工法，正是為我們的下一代守護一個宜居、具備抗氣候衝擊的永續未來。

examples.en: The visionary zero-carbon masterplan paints an inspiring portrait of tomorrow's eco-friendly urban future.
examples.zh: 這座前瞻遠見的零碳智慧城市整體規劃大綱，為人類明日綠色環保的都會新生活描繪出振奮人心的美好願景。

examples.en: Putting on spatial optics is like stepping across a magical threshold into the vibrant computing future.
examples.zh: 戴上空間光學眼鏡，如同跨越一道神奇的科技門檻，自信昂首邁向虛實交融的「璀璨空間未來」（Future）。

examples.en: Financial planners recommend saving early to guarantee financial security for your future family.
examples.zh: 理財規劃顧問建議及早展開定期定額儲蓄與投資，為未來家庭生活打下堅實的經濟後盾。

examples.en: Smart grid technology will serve as the backbone for future carbon-neutral power distribution.
examples.zh: 智慧電網技術將扮演未來零碳排電力輸送與智慧配電的關鍵核心骨幹。

examples.en: Harmonizing engineering with biology will build a sustainable, disease-free future for all coming generations.
examples.zh: 將精密工程技術與自然生命完美結合，將為全人類後代子孫打造出遠離病痛、生生不息的「繁榮未來」（Future）。

examples.en: Young parents establish dedicated college tuition savings funds to secure their children's future education.
examples.zh: 年輕新手父母及早成立專款專用的高教教育基金存簿，為子女未來的求學之路奠定無後顧之憂的經濟基礎。

examples.en: Artificial intelligence and renewable clean energy systems will undeniably shape future urban infrastructure.
examples.zh: 人工智慧運算與永續潔淨能源系統的深度融合，毫無疑問將深刻塑造與引領未來的智慧城市基礎建設。

entries.definition: 邁向生生不息、淨零永續的明日綠色未來；昂首跨步邁入虛實融合同在之璀璨空間運算未來；攜手昂首邁入生物製造引領文明之繁榮未來

explains.en: This is the time that has not happened yet. People may make plans for it. It can also describe a person or idea aimed at what comes later.
Use this word for the days or years ahead. Students may think about work they want to do. It points to time after now.
This word names what will happen later. A person may hope for good things then. It can also describe plans made for later times.

examples.en: Let's play a board game together tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚我們一起玩桌遊吧。

examples.en: Our school basketball team won the championship game yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們學校籃球隊昨天贏得了冠軍賽。

examples.en: Playing puzzle games can stimulate your brain and logical thinking.
examples.zh: 玩益智遊戲能刺激大腦思考與邏輯能力。

explains.en: This is an activity with rules that people play. It can also mean a contest between teams. Players try to reach a goal or score points.
People may use cards, balls, or boards for this activity. It often has winners and losers. A school may hold a contest between teams.
This word names something people play for fun. It can be done alone or with others. It may also mean a match or contest.

examples.en: My grandma grows roses in her garden.
examples.zh: 我奶奶在她的花園裡種玫瑰花。

examples.en: We sat in the rooftop garden enjoying the gentle breeze.
examples.zh: 我們坐在頂樓花園享受著徐徐微風。

examples.en: She loves to garden during her free time on weekends.
examples.zh: 週末有空時她很喜歡從事園藝。

examples.en: Sunken rain gardens planted with native irises hold excess storm surges during heavy typhoons.
examples.zh: 種植耐濕耐旱台灣原生鳶尾的下凹式雨水花園，在颱風暴雨時能暫時蓄積大量洪水。

examples.en: Incorporating a rain garden in your front yard handles roof downspout runoff naturally.
examples.zh: 在透天別墅前院規劃一座下凹式雨水花園，能將屋頂排水管排出的暴雨自然導流吸收滲透。

examples.en: Layered beds of compost and gravel inside the rain garden trap pollutants while supporting flowering plants.
examples.zh: 雨水花園內層層鋪設的腐殖有機土與碎石濾料層，在鎖定重金屬污染物的同時滋養爛漫花卉。

entries.definition: 花園；菜園；從事園藝；都會雨水花園 (下凹式蓄水淨水綠地)

explains.en: This is an outdoor space where people grow flowers or vegetables. It may have paths and a fence. As a verb, it means taking care of plants.
People plant seeds in this area. They may water and weed it. The verb describes growing and caring for plants.
This word names a place for growing plants. It can be small beside a home or large in a park. A person may work there to help plants grow.

examples.en: Please meet me right at the school gate.
examples.zh: 請就在校門口跟我碰面。

examples.en: Flight CI100 is boarding immediately at departure gate B5.
examples.zh: 華航 CI100 班機正在 B5 號登機門立即開始登機。

examples.en: Always remember to lock the iron garden gate securely when leaving.
examples.zh: 離開時務必記得將花園鐵門妥善上鎖。

examples.en: Passengers boarding for Tokyo should proceed to Gate B7.
examples.zh: 前往東京的登機旅客請前往 B7 號登機門。

examples.en: Don't forget to close and lock the front garden gate.
examples.zh: 別忘了將前花園大門關好並上鎖。

examples.en: Boarding will conclude ten minutes before the flight gate closes.
examples.zh: 登機手續將在登機門關閉前十分鐘結束。

examples.en: Boarding gate B7 has announced the final call for passengers on flight CI008.
examples.zh: 位於第二航廈的 B7 登機門廣播正對搭乘華航 CI008 班機的全體旅客進行最後登機呼叫。

examples.en: Check the electronic departure board frequently because your flight departure gate might change.
examples.zh: 請隨時留意航廈內的航班資訊大螢幕，因為班機的登機門位置偶爾可能會臨時調度異動。

examples.en: Passengers gathered near the boarding gate as priority boarding for families with toddlers began.
examples.zh: 當地勤人員宣布攜帶幼童的家庭與輪椅旅客開始優先登機時，旅客們紛紛在登機閘口前依序集合。

examples.en: Executing a two-qubit CNOT gate creates maximum entanglement between neighboring superconducting loops.
examples.zh: 執行一個雙量子位元受控反相量子邏輯閘，能在相鄰的超導電路間建立最強糾纏態。

examples.en: Applying a single-qubit Hadamard gate puts an initialized zero qubit into an equal superposition.
examples.zh: 施加一個單量子位元阿達馬（Hadamard）邏輯閘，能將初始為 0 的純態位元瞬間轉化為完美等權重的疊加態。

examples.en: Minimizing gate execution duration prevents ambient thermal noise from corrupting delicate computations.
examples.zh: 極致壓縮每個量子邏輯閘的執行秒數，能在周圍環境熱雜訊侵入前火速完成脆弱的量子運算。

entries.definition: 大門；柵門；登機門；閘口；雙量子位元受控反相量子邏輯閘

explains.en: This is a movable barrier at the entrance to a fence or wall. It can control who enters. An airport uses the same word for the place where people board a plane.
People open this entrance to go into a yard. It may have a lock. At a travel terminal, signs point to the area where passengers wait to board.
This word names a door in a fence. It may also mean a boarding area at an airport. A guard may open or close it.

examples.en: What time do you get up in the morning?
examples.zh: 你早上通常幾點起床？

examples.en: Get ready quickly, or we will be late for the opening ceremony.
examples.zh: 快點準備好，否則我們要趕不上開幕典禮了。

examples.en: She was excited to get a high score on her English listening test.
examples.zh: 她在英文聽力測驗中拿到高分，感到非常興奮。

explains.en: It means receiving or obtaining something. It can also mean becoming a certain way or reaching a place. The exact sense depends on nearby words.
Use this verb when someone receives a gift. It may also describe a person changing into a new state. A traveler may reach a town.
This common verb can mean obtaining an item. It may describe becoming tired or happy. It can also mean arriving at a destination.

examples.en: Volunteer diving teams cut loose deadly ghost fishing nets tangled around delicate coral heads.
examples.zh: 熱心環保潛水志工團隊手持專用潛水刀，深入海底割除並清除纏繞在脆弱珊瑚上的幽靈漁網。

examples.en: The old coal mining town in the hills slowly turned into an empty ghost town after the mines closed.
examples.zh: 在礦場關閉停產之後，山區這座昔日的採煤聚落逐漸變成了一座荒無人煙的鬼城。

examples.en: He had a ghost of a smile on his face as he remembered fond memories from his rural childhood.
examples.zh: 當他回憶起鄉村童年的美好溫馨往事時，嘴角不禁泛起了一絲若有若無的微笑。

entries.definition: 沉底廢棄幽靈刺網；鬼魂

explains.en: This is the spirit of a dead person in stories. People may imagine it moving through an old house. It is not a living human.
A tale may include a person who has died appearing again. Some people tell stories about a pale shape at night. The idea can frighten children.
This word names a spirit in old stories. It may seem to float or pass through walls. Many tales place one in a haunted home.

examples.en: A giant tree stood beside the old house.
examples.zh: 一棵巨大的樹矗立在老房子旁。

examples.en: The story tells of a friendly giant.
examples.zh: 這個故事講述一位友善的巨人。

examples.en: They saw a giant wave near the shore.
examples.zh: 他們在岸邊看到一個巨浪。

explains.en: It describes something much larger than normal. It can also name a person or creature of huge size in stories. A very tall building may seem this way.
Use this word for something far larger than usual. A tale may have a person of great size and strength. The word may describe a company or success too.
This word tells that a thing is enormous. It can name a huge person in a fairy tale. It may also describe an important or powerful thing.

examples.en: She received many wonderful gifts on her birthday.
examples.zh: 她在生日時收到了許多很棒的禮物。

examples.en: The box of chocolates was wrapped as a lovely gift.
examples.zh: 那盒巧克力被包裝成一份精美的禮物。

examples.en: He has an extraordinary musical gift for composing songs.
examples.zh: 他擁有創作歌曲的非凡音樂天賦。

explains.en: This is something given to another person without payment. It may be wrapped for a birthday. The word can also mean a natural skill.
People give this item on a special day. It shows kindness or care. A person may also have a special talent from birth.
This word names something freely given. It may bring joy to someone. It can also mean a natural ability, such as drawing well.

examples.en: The girl over there is my younger sister.
examples.zh: 在那邊的女孩是我妹妹。

examples.en: That smart girl solved the difficult math problem quickly.
examples.zh: 那個聰明的女孩很快解開了那道數學難題。

examples.en: Many little girls dream of becoming dancers.
examples.zh: 很多小女孩夢想成為舞者。

explains.en: This is a female child or young person. She may be someone’s daughter or sister. The word describes someone who has not yet grown into an adult.
A young female person has this name. She may go to school and play with friends. Her family may use it while she is growing up.
This word names a female child. She may be older or younger than a boy in the same home. Adults help keep her safe.

examples.en: Give me a hand with these heavy boxes.
examples.zh: 幫我搬一下這些重箱子吧。

examples.en: She gave her younger brother an inspiring storybook for his birthday.
examples.zh: 她送給弟弟一本充滿啟發性的故事書作為生日禮物。

examples.en: Never give up on your dreams no matter how tough things get.
examples.zh: 無論處境多麼艱難，絕不要放棄你的夢想。

explains.en: It means handing something to another person. Someone may pass a book to a friend. It can also mean offering help or sharing information.
Use this verb when one person lets another have something. A teacher may offer advice. A parent may hand a snack to a child.
This word means transferring something to another person. It may be an object, a chance, or a message. People can also offer time or help.

examples.en: I am glad you came to visit.
examples.zh: 我很高興你來拜訪。

examples.en: She was glad to help her friend.
examples.zh: 她很樂意幫助朋友。

examples.en: We are glad that the rain stopped.
examples.zh: 我們很高興雨停了。

explains.en: It describes feeling pleased or happy. Someone may feel this way when a friend visits. The word can also show that a speaker welcomes an idea.
Use this word for a cheerful feeling. A person may feel it after hearing good news. It can also mean being willing to do something.
This word tells that someone feels happy about a situation. It may follow a kind greeting. It can show that a person is willing to help.

examples.en: He drank a glass of fresh orange juice.
examples.zh: 他喝了一杯新鮮柳橙汁。

examples.en: Be careful because broken glass can easily cut your hand.
examples.zh: 小心點，碎玻璃很容易割傷你的手。

examples.en: He wears reading glasses when working on the computer.
examples.zh: 他用電腦工作時會戴老花眼鏡。

explains.en: This is a hard, clear material that may break if dropped. It is used for windows and drinking cups. People may wear two lenses in a frame to help them see.
A window is often made from this smooth material. A cup may also be made from it. A pair of lenses can help someone read.
This word names a material that lets light pass through. It can also name a cup made from that material. People wear lenses in a frame to improve sight.

examples.en: She wears glasses when she reads.
examples.zh: 她閱讀時會戴眼鏡。

examples.en: My glasses fell off the table.
examples.zh: 我的眼鏡從桌上掉下來了。

examples.en: He put on his glasses to see the sign.
examples.zh: 他戴上眼鏡看那個標誌。

explains.en: These are two lenses set in a frame. People wear them to see better or protect their eyes. Some kinds have dark lenses for sunlight.
A person may wear this pair on the face. The lenses can help with reading or seeing far away. Some people wear them to block bright sunlight.
This word names two lenses held in a frame. They sit in front of the eyes. A doctor may suggest them for clearer sight.

examples.en: The gardener wore gloves to protect her hands.
examples.zh: 園丁戴著手套保護雙手。

examples.en: Please put on your gloves before going outside.
examples.zh: 出門前請戴上手套。

examples.en: These gloves are warm and soft.
examples.zh: 這副手套溫暖又柔軟。

explains.en: These are coverings worn on the hands. They keep the hands warm or safe. Some kinds are used for sports or cleaning.
A pair of these covers protects fingers and palms. They may be made of wool, leather, or rubber. Workers wear them to keep their hands safe.
This word names hand coverings. They may keep fingers warm in winter. A builder may wear them to avoid scratches.

examples.en: Let's go home together after class.
examples.zh: 放學後我們一起回家吧。

examples.en: Do you want to go shopping at the department store this weekend?
examples.zh: 這個週末你想去百貨公司逛街嗎？

examples.en: Time goes by so quickly when you are having fun.
examples.zh: 玩得開心時時間過得真快。

explains.en: It means moving from one place to another. It can also mean working or functioning. A person may leave home and travel to school.
Use this common verb for traveling somewhere. It may describe how a machine works. A light may turn on or off with this word.
This verb can mean leaving for a place. It may also mean happening or working well. The noun can name a turn or attempt.

examples.en: Mazu is revered as the compassionate goddess of the sea.
examples.zh: 媽祖被尊崇為慈悲護佑眾生的海上女神。

examples.en: In Greek mythology, Athena was venerated as the goddess of wisdom and strategic war.
examples.zh: 在希臘神話中，雅典娜被尊奉為掌管智慧與軍事策略的女神。

examples.en: Fisherman offer prayers and thanksgiving whenever they return safely to the goddess's shrine.
examples.zh: 漁民每次平安返港靠岸，總會向女神的神龕敬獻虔誠的祈禱與感恩。

explains.en: This is a powerful being worshipped in some religions. Stories may describe such a being with special powers. A female one may have a different name.
People may pray to this being. Many stories tell of a male or female one. Beliefs differ across cultures.
This word names a being that some people believe made or rules the world. Myths may tell stories about such beings. Different faiths describe them in different ways.

examples.en: Have a good day at school!
examples.zh: 祝你在學校有美好的一天！

examples.en: She is very good at playing badminton and table tennis.
examples.zh: 她非常擅長打羽毛球和桌球。

examples.en: Brainstorming with teammates is a great way to generate good ideas.
examples.zh: 與隊友集思廣益是產生好點子的絕佳方式。

explains.en: It describes something that is kind, useful, or of high quality. A pleasant meal may taste this way. It can also name a benefit.
Use this word when something works well or treats people kindly. A helpful idea may be very valuable. It can also mean a positive result.
This word tells that something is right or pleasing. It can describe a person who is kind. As a noun, it may mean something useful or valuable.

examples.en: Say goodbye to your classmates before leaving.
examples.zh: 離開前跟你的同班同學說再見。

examples.en: It was hard to say goodbye to our exchange student friends at the airport.
examples.zh: 在機場與交換學生好友依依惜別令人感到萬分不捨。

examples.en: We waved goodbye as the train slowly pulled away from the platform.
examples.zh: 當火車緩緩駛離月台時，我們揮手告別。

explains.en: This is a word people say when leaving. It lets others know that they will go now. It may be used in person or in a message.
People use this parting word at the end of a visit. It can sound warm or sad. Friends may say it when they leave one another.
This word names a way to say that a meeting is over. It may be said when someone leaves. A note may end with it.

examples.en: Ken is in the seventh grade at junior high school.
examples.zh: 肯恩就讀國中七年級。

examples.en: She was delighted to receive top grades in mathematics and physics.
examples.zh: 她在數學和物理上獲得優異成績，感到非常高興。

examples.en: The teacher spent Sunday afternoon grading student test papers.
examples.zh: 老師在週日下午批改學生的測驗試卷。

examples.en: She worked hard and earned straight-A grades this semester.
examples.zh: 她用功讀書，這學期拿下了全科滿分 A 的優異成績。

examples.en: The teacher spent all weekend grading history essay assignments.
examples.zh: 老師花了一整個週末為歷史申論題作業批改評分。

examples.en: Grade school students are eager to participate in science fairs.
examples.zh: 小學年級的小學生們熱切期盼參加自然科學展覽會。

explains.en: It can mean a school year or level. It can also mean a mark showing how well someone did. As a verb, it means judging work on a scale.
A student moves up through school levels. A teacher may give a mark for an assignment. The verb means judging how strong the work is.
This word can name a level in school. It may also mean a score on work. A teacher can judge answers using a scale.

examples.en: My grandfather goes for a walk every morning.
examples.zh: 我爺爺每天早上都會去散步。

examples.en: My grandfather loves telling stories about his youth.
examples.zh: 我爺爺喜歡講述他年輕時的故事。

examples.en: We celebrated my grandfather's eightieth birthday last month.
examples.zh: 我們上個月幫我爺爺慶祝了八十大壽。

explains.en: This is the father of your mother or father. He may tell stories about when your parents were young. Families may call him Grandpa.
A child’s parent has a father, who is this older family member. He may live nearby or far away. Children may visit him on weekends.
This word names the father of one of your parents. He may be called by a special family name. He is part of the older generation.

examples.en: My grandmother makes the best dumplings.
examples.zh: 我奶奶包的水餃最好吃。

examples.en: I love spending weekends at my grandmother's house.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在奶奶家度過週末時光。

examples.en: My grandmother tends to her rooftop flower garden every day.
examples.zh: 我奶奶每天都在頂樓花園整理花草。

explains.en: This is the mother of your mother or father. She may cook special meals for the family. Families may call her Grandma.
A child’s parent has a mother, who is this older family member. She may tell stories or give advice. Children may visit her during holidays.
This word names the mother of one of your parents. She may be called by a warm family name. She belongs to the older generation.

examples.en: Children are playing soccer on the green grass.
examples.zh: 小朋友們正在綠油油的草地上踢足球。

examples.en: We spread out a red picnic blanket on the fresh grass in the park.
examples.zh: 我們在公園清新的草地上鋪開了一條紅色的野餐墊。

examples.en: The morning dew sparkled like tiny diamonds on the grass blades.
examples.zh: 清晨的露珠在草葉上閃爍著猶如細小鑽石般的光芒。

explains.en: This is a short green plant that covers fields and lawns. Animals such as cows may eat it. People may sit or play on it in a park.
Many thin green plants grow together over the ground. A lawn mower cuts them. Parks and gardens often have this soft covering.
This word names a small plant with narrow leaves. It grows in yards and fields. A person may walk on it without shoes.

examples.en: The sky turned gray before the thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 雷陣雨前天空變成了灰色。

examples.en: My grandfather has distinguished silver-gray hair.
examples.zh: 我爺爺有一頭顯眼的銀灰色頭髮。

examples.en: Concrete buildings lined both sides of the gray city street.
examples.zh: 灰暗的城市街道兩旁矗立著混凝土建築。

entries.definition: 灰色的；灰色（英式常用 grey）

explains.en: It names a color between black and white. Clouds may look this way before rain. As a verb, it can mean becoming older or losing color.
Use this word for a shade made by mixing black and white. A stone or sky may look this way. It can also mean turning pale or old.
This word describes a color with no strong hue. It can name the sky on a cloudy day. As an action, it means making something this shade.

examples.en: You did a great job on your final presentation!
examples.zh: 你的期末簡報表現得非常棒！

examples.en: Dr. Sun Yat-sen is remembered as a great historical leader.
examples.zh: 孫中山先生被後人銘記為一位偉大的歷史領袖。

examples.en: Exercising regularly has a great positive impact on mental wellbeing.
examples.zh: 規律運動對心理健康有著極為顯著的正面助益。

explains.en: It describes something very good or important. A large mountain may seem this way. It can also name an important person in a story.
Use this word for something that deserves praise. It may describe a major success. A story may include a respected leader with this name.
This word tells that something is excellent or very large. It may describe a person admired by many. It can also mean very much.

examples.en: Eat more green vegetables to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 多吃綠色蔬菜以保持健康。

examples.en: The hills turn vibrant green during springtime.
examples.zh: 春天時山丘轉變為生機盎然的翠綠色。

examples.en: Many people choose public transit to support green living.
examples.zh: 許多人選擇大眾運輸來支持綠色環保生活。

examples.en: The world's top foundry signed massive offshore wind green power purchase agreements (PPA) toward RE100.
examples.zh: 全球晶圓代工龍頭與離岸風場簽署大規模綠電購售合約（PPA），全力朝向 RE100 全綠能運作目標邁進。

examples.en: Investing in green public transportation options like metro rail improves air quality and lowers road accidents.
examples.zh: 大力投資興建捷運與低地板純電公車等大眾綠色交通運具，能顯著改善都會空氣品質並減少交通事故傷亡。

examples.en: Environmental activists encourage corporate offices to reduce paper waste and adopt eco-friendly green policies.
examples.zh: 環保倡議團體呼籲企業落實無紙化數位公文簽核，在各營運部門積極推動節能減碳的各項綠色政策。

entries.definition: 綠色的；綠色；環保的；簽署長期綠電購電契約 (PPA) 的

explains.en: It names the color of leaves and many plants. It can also describe someone new or not experienced. As a verb, it means making a place this color.
Use this word for a color between yellow and blue. It may describe a beginner. It can also mean caring for nature.
This word names a color found on trees in spring. It may describe food that is not ripe. It can also mean friendly to the natural world.

examples.en: The children sat on the ground under a tree.
examples.zh: 孩子們坐在樹下的地面上。

examples.en: The ground was wet after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨後地面是濕的。

examples.en: The pilot grounded the plane during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，飛行員讓飛機停飛。

entries.definition: （名）地面；土地；場地；理由；（動）使停飛；使停飛行

explains.en: This is the solid surface under our feet. It can also mean a reason for an idea. As a verb, it may mean keeping someone from flying.
People walk or stand on this surface. A reason can support a rule. A coach may stop a player from joining a game.
This word names the surface of the land. It can also mean a reason or cause. As a verb, it may mean making a plane stay on the runway.

examples.en: We worked in small groups for the science project.
examples.zh: 我們在自然科學專題中分組合作。

examples.en: Our class set up a dedicated LINE discussion group for sharing study notes.
examples.zh: 我們班設立了一個專門的 LINE 討論群組以分享讀書筆記。

examples.en: A group of wild dolphins leaped playfully alongside the scenic whale-watching ferry.
examples.zh: 一群野生海豚在風景優美的賞鯨渡輪旁歡快地躍出水面。

explains.en: This is a number of people or things together. They may share a purpose. As a verb, it means putting people or items together.
A team or set of friends may have this name. The members may share an interest. A person can put several things together.
This word names several people or objects seen as one set. It can also mean sorting things together. A study may focus on one set.

examples.en: Sunflowers grow quickly in sunny weather.
examples.zh: 向日葵在陽光普照的天氣裡生長迅速。

examples.en: Organic farmers grow luscious strawberries without artificial chemical pesticides.
examples.zh: 有機農民不使用人工化學農藥培育鮮美多汁的草莓。

examples.en: Demand for eco-friendly electric vehicles continues to grow worldwide.
examples.zh: 全球對環保電動車的需求持續強勁增長。

explains.en: It means becoming larger or older over time. A seed may turn into a plant. A gardener can raise vegetables.
Use this word when a living thing gets bigger. A child changes as years pass. It can also mean planting and caring for crops.
This verb tells that something develops over time. A plant may become tall. A farmer may raise food for people.

examples.en: Guess what? We are going to Kenting this weekend!
examples.zh: 你猜怎麼著？我們這週末要去墾丁！

examples.en: Can you guess how old this ancient banyan tree is?
examples.zh: 你能猜得出這棵古老榕樹有多少歲了嗎？

examples.en: That was a very close guess, but the real answer is forty-two.
examples.zh: 那是一個非常接近的猜測，但真正的答案是四十二。

explains.en: It means giving an answer without knowing for sure. A person may use clues to make one. The noun can name the answer itself.
Use this word when trying to say what may be true. A student may make one on a quiz. Looking at clues can make the answer closer.
This word can mean making an estimate. It may be a thought offered without proof. The verb and noun share a meaning.

examples.en: He learned to play acoustic guitar in high school.
examples.zh: 他在高中學會了彈木吉他。

examples.en: She sang a gentle folk song while playing her guitar.
examples.zh: 她彈著吉他，輕聲唱著一首溫柔的民謠。

examples.en: Playing an electric guitar requires regular practice and patience.
examples.zh: 彈奏電吉他需要持之以恆的練習與耐心。

examples.en: Learning to play the guitar is a popular hobby among teenagers.
examples.zh: 學習彈吉他是青少年間非常熱門的興趣嗜好。

examples.en: He replaced the nylon strings on his classical guitar before the audition.
examples.zh: 他在面試試音前更換了古典吉他上的尼龍琴弦。

examples.en: She sat on the grass strumming popular pop chords on her guitar.
examples.zh: 她坐在草地上，用吉他輕輕彈奏著耳熟能詳的流行和弦。

explains.en: This is a wooden instrument with strings. A player plucks or strums them to make music. It often has a long neck and a round body.
Musicians hold this instrument and use their fingers to play chords. It can sound soft or loud. A band may use one in a song.
This word names a string instrument. It may have six strings. A person can play it with fingers or a small pick.

examples.en: The guy at the door is my cousin.
examples.zh: 門口那位男生是我的表哥。

examples.en: Hey, guys, are you ready to play?
examples.zh: 嘿，大家準備好玩了嗎？

examples.en: He is a nice guy from our class.
examples.zh: 他是我們班一位友善的男生。

explains.en: This is an informal word for a man. It may be used when speaking to a friend. The plural can mean a group of people.
People may use this casual word for a male person. Friends may use it when greeting one another. It can also mean people of any gender in a group.
This informal word may mean a man or fellow. It can sound friendly in casual speech. People sometimes use its plural for a group.

examples.en: Reading every day is an excellent habit to build.
examples.zh: 每天閱讀是值得培養的極佳習慣。

examples.en: It takes deliberate daily practice to break a bad habit like staying up late.
examples.zh: 需要持之以恆的每日實踐才能戒除像熬夜這樣的壞習慣。

examples.en: Drinking a glass of warm water upon waking is a healthy morning habit.
examples.zh: 早晨起床後喝一杯溫開水是一項健康的晨間習慣。

examples.en: Making English reading a lifelong habit enriches your mind with global knowledge every day.
examples.zh: 將閱讀英文養成一種「終身良善習慣」（Habit），每天都能用來自全球的第一手資訊豐富你的心靈。

examples.en: She developed a morning habit of reviewing fifty flashcards while enjoying her hot coffee.
examples.zh: 她養成了每天清晨一邊品嘗熱咖啡、一邊複習五十張單字卡片的好習慣。

examples.en: Replacing unproductive digital scrolling with purposeful reading is a transformative personal habit.
examples.zh: 用有目標的閱讀取代漫無目的的滑手機，是一項能深刻改變個人生活的優良習慣。

entries.definition: 習慣；嗜好；養成每日閱讀與吸收英文新知之終身良善習慣

explains.en: This is something a person does often. It may happen at the same time each day. A regular routine can be hard to stop.
Use this word for an action repeated over time. Brushing teeth at night is one example. A small action can become part of daily life.
This word names a repeated way of acting. It may be helpful or harmful. Doing something regularly can make it feel automatic.

examples.en: Her hair is long and curly.
examples.zh: 她的頭髮又長又捲。

examples.en: The dog has brown hair around its ears.
examples.zh: 那隻狗耳朵周圍有棕色的毛。

examples.en: He brushed his hair before school.
examples.zh: 他上學前梳了頭髮。

explains.en: These are thin strands that grow from the skin. People wash, cut, or brush them. Animals may have fur made of similar strands.
A person may have long or short strands on the head. A brush can keep them neat. Some animals have thick fur over the body.
This word names the fine strands on a person’s head or body. They can be straight or curly. A barber can trim them.

examples.en: Half of the cake is for you.
examples.zh: 一半的蛋糕是給你的。

examples.en: The bottle is half full.
examples.zh: 瓶子裡裝了半瓶。

examples.en: She read half the book on the train.
examples.zh: 她在火車上讀了半本書。

explains.en: It means one of two equal parts. If a sandwich is split evenly, each piece is this amount. It may also mean partly.
Use this word for an amount that is fifty percent of a whole. One side of a pair may be one such part. It can also mean partly finished.
This word names an equal part of a whole split into two. It may describe a time that is partly over. The amount is less than the complete whole.

examples.en: We had ham and eggs for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我們早餐吃了火腿和蛋。

examples.en: He made a ham sandwich for lunch.
examples.zh: 他做了一份火腿三明治當午餐。

examples.en: The ham was cooked with honey.
examples.zh: 火腿用蜂蜜烹調。

entries.definition: 火腿；醃製或煙燻豬腿肉

explains.en: This is meat from a pig’s leg. It may be served in a sandwich. People often cook it for breakfast.
The meat can be smoked or salted to keep it longer. It may be sliced thinly for a meal. Some people serve it with eggs.
This word names pork that comes from the back leg of a pig. It may be cooked whole or cut into slices. A sandwich may contain it.

examples.en: Always wash your hands before meals.
examples.zh: 飯前務必記得洗手。

examples.en: Raise your hand if you know the answer to this question.
examples.zh: 如果你知道這道題目的答案，請舉手。

examples.en: Please hand in your assignment before noon tomorrow.
examples.zh: 請在明天中午前繳交你的作業。

examples.en: Blued steel Breguet hands with hollow moon tips glide silently across the enamel face.
examples.zh: 頂端帶有鏤空偏心月形月牙的「寶璣藍鋼指針」（Breguet Hands），在琺瑯面盤上方無聲滑過。

examples.en: The surgeon's steady hand showed complete confidence throughout the delicate brain aneurysm clipping.
examples.zh: 在長達數小時極其兇險的腦動脈瘤夾閉顯微手術過程中，主刀神經外科名醫那沉穩如山的雙手毫無一絲顫抖。

examples.en: Grandfather took his young grandson by the hand as they walked along the sunlit sandy beach.
examples.zh: 滿頭銀髮的慈祥老爺爺牽著蹦蹦跳跳的小孫子那溫暖的小手，祖孫倆悠閒漫步在灑滿金色陽光的沙灘上。

entries.definition: 手；遞交；交給；高溫炭火烤藍淬火寶璣鏤空偏心月形指針

explains.en: This is the body part with fingers and a palm. People use it to hold, touch, and lift things. As a verb, it can mean passing something to someone.
A person has two of these parts at the ends of the arms. They help with writing and eating. The verb means giving an item directly to another person.
This word names a part of the body with five fingers. It is useful for gripping objects. As a verb, it means delivering something to someone.

examples.en: Hang your coat on the hook.
examples.zh: 把你的外套掛在掛鉤上。

examples.en: The picture hangs above the sofa.
examples.zh: 那幅畫掛在沙發上方。

examples.en: We like to hang out at the park.
examples.zh: 我們喜歡在公園閒逛。

entries.definition: （動）懸掛；掛起；（非正式）閒逛；（名）懸掛方式。

explains.en: It means putting something on a hook or high place. A picture may be placed on a wall. It can also mean staying together casually.
Use this word when a coat is placed on a hook. A person may put a picture on a wall. Friends may spend time together without a plan.
This verb can mean suspending an object from a point. It may describe putting art on a wall. People may also spend time together informally.

examples.en: What happened to your bicycle tire?
examples.zh: 你的腳踏車輪胎發生了什麼事？

examples.en: Accidents happen when people drive carelessly on wet slippery roads.
examples.zh: 當人們在濕滑路面上粗心駕駛時，交通事故便容易發生。

examples.en: It just so happened that we both booked seats on the same morning train.
examples.zh: 恰巧巧合的是，我們兩人都預訂了同一班晨間列車的座位。

explains.en: It means taking place or coming to pass. A sudden storm may start in the afternoon. It can also mean meeting someone by accident.
Use this word when an event takes place. A change may occur without warning. Someone may meet an old friend by luck.
This verb tells that something took place. It can describe an event or an accident. It may also mean that something was found by chance.

examples.en: She was very happy to receive the gift.
examples.zh: 收到那份禮物她非常開心。

examples.en: Wishing you a very Happy Birthday filled with joy and laughter!
examples.zh: 祝你生日快樂，充滿歡笑與喜悅！

examples.en: Reading bedtime stories with their children makes parents truly happy.
examples.zh: 與孩子共讀床邊故事讓為人父母者由衷感到幸福。

explains.en: It describes a person who feels pleasure or joy. A gift may make someone smile. The feeling can come from spending time with friends.
Use this word for a cheerful feeling. Good news may cause it. A person may show it with a smile.
This word tells that someone is pleased. A fun day may make a person feel this way. It can also describe a lucky event.

examples.en: If you work hard, you will succeed.
examples.zh: 如果你努力付出，你就會成功。

examples.en: Diamonds are among the hardest natural materials known on Earth.
examples.zh: 鑽石是地球上已知最堅硬的天然物質之一。

examples.en: It was a hard decision to move away from my hometown.
examples.zh: 搬離家鄉是一個艱難的抉擇。

examples.en: Diamond is the hardest natural mineral known.
examples.zh: 鑽石是已知最堅硬的天然礦物。

examples.en: Work hard today so you can harvest rewarding results tomorrow.
examples.zh: 今日辛勤耕耘努力付出，明日方能收穫豐碩甜美的回報。

examples.en: The challenging university physics examination was exceptionally hard to pass.
examples.zh: 那場具挑戰性的大學物理測驗極難通過。

explains.en: It can mean needing much effort. It may also describe a solid thing that is not soft. As an adverb, it can mean working with great effort.
Use this word for a task that is not easy. A rock may feel firm. A student may study with strong effort.
This word can mean tough or solid. It may describe a long task. It can also tell that someone works with energy.

examples.en: He wore a straw hat to protect from the sun.
examples.zh: 他戴了一頂草帽來防曬。

examples.en: Take off your hat when you enter the church.
examples.zh: 進入教堂時請脫下帽子。

examples.en: The colorful knit hat kept her ears warm during the hike.
examples.zh: 健行時，這頂色彩繽紛的針織帽保護她的雙耳免受風寒。

explains.en: This is a piece of clothing worn on the head. It usually has a shaped edge all around. People may wear one to keep the sun off.
Someone may wear this item outside. It can be made of straw, cloth, or felt. A brim helps shade the face.
This word names a head covering with an edge. It may protect someone from sun or rain. People wear it for style too.

examples.en: I hate getting up early on rainy mornings.
examples.zh: 我討厭在下雨的早晨起大早。

examples.en: She hates crowded night markets on scorching summer evenings.
examples.zh: 她討厭在炎熱夏夜逛擁擠的夜市。

examples.en: There is no room for hatred and prejudice in our school community.
examples.zh: 我們的校園群體容不下仇恨與偏見。

explains.en: It means feeling a very strong dislike. A person may feel this way about cruelty. The noun names that feeling.
Use this word for a deep angry feeling toward someone or something. It is stronger than simply not liking. People should try to speak kindly even when upset.
This word tells that someone strongly dislikes something. It can describe anger that lasts a long time. The noun names the emotion.

examples.en: Have a great time at the amusement park!
examples.zh: 在遊樂園玩得開心喔！

examples.en: We have three classes in the morning and three in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們上午有三節課，下午也有三節課。

examples.en: Do you have a spare pencil that I could borrow for the exam?
examples.zh: 你有一支多餘的鉛筆可以借我考試用嗎？

explains.en: This verb can show ownership. It also helps form sentences about actions completed in the past. People may use it when talking about food or experiences.
Use this word to say that something belongs to someone. It can also be a helper in certain verb forms. It may describe taking food or drink.
This common verb can mean owning or holding something. It helps build some past-tense ideas. It may also describe eating or drinking.

examples.en: He is my English teacher.
examples.zh: 他是我的英文老師。

examples.en: He plays soccer every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 他每個星期六早上都踢足球。

examples.en: He always helps his mother with the housework.
examples.zh: 他總是幫媽媽做家事。

examples.en: He learned computer programming all by himself.
examples.zh: 他完全靠自學學會了電腦程式設計。

examples.en: He looked at himself in the mirror and adjusted his necktie.
examples.zh: 他看著鏡子裡的自己並整理好領帶。

explains.en: This pronoun points to a boy or man already named. Other forms show that the person receives an action or owns something. One form can also point back to that person.
Use this pronoun when speaking about a male person. Its forms may act as a subject, object, or possessive word. A reflexive form points back to the same person.
This word group refers to a male person. One form can take the place of a name in a sentence. Other forms show ownership or receive an action.

examples.en: Wear a helmet to protect your head.
examples.zh: 戴上安全帽以保護你的頭部。

examples.en: He nodded his head in agreement with the teacher's suggestion.
examples.zh: 他點頭贊成老師的建議。

examples.en: After dinner, we decided to head for the night market.
examples.zh: 晚餐後，我們決定前往夜市。

explains.en: This is the part of the body above the neck. It contains the brain, eyes, and mouth. It can also mean a leader or the top part of something.
People use this part to think, see, and speak. A group may have someone in charge with this name. The verb can mean moving toward a place.
This word can name the top part of the body. It may also mean a person leading a group. As an action, it means going in a direction.

examples.en: Take a short break if you have a severe headache.
examples.zh: 如果你頭痛劇烈，稍微休息一下吧。

examples.en: Working in front of glare screens without breaks often triggers painful headaches.
examples.zh: 長時間在刺眼螢幕前工作不休息常會引發令人難受的頭痛。

examples.en: A warm cup of chamomile tea helped relieve her tension headache.
examples.zh: 一杯溫熱的洋甘菊茶幫助緩解了她的緊繃型頭痛。

examples.en: Staring at screens for too long often causes a headache.
examples.zh: 盯著螢幕太久經常會引起頭痛。

examples.en: She took two aspirin tablets to relieve her throbbing headache.
examples.zh: 她吃了兩顆阿斯匹靈藥錠來舒緩劇烈陣痛的頭痛。

examples.en: Solving this unexpected server bug has been a real headache for the team.
examples.zh: 解決這個突發的伺服器錯誤對團隊而言真是個令人頭痛的大難題。

explains.en: This is pain felt in the head. It may come from being tired or sick. Rest and water may help someone feel better.
A person with this pain may feel pressure near the eyes or forehead. A loud sound can make it worse. Some people take medicine for it.
This word names an ache in the upper part of the body. It may last a short or long time. A quiet room may help.

examples.en: Good health is the greatest wealth.
examples.zh: 良好的健康是最大的財富。

examples.en: Drinking clean water and sleeping well protect your overall health.
examples.zh: 飲用潔淨水與充足睡眠能守護你的整體健康。

examples.en: Public health guidelines helped keep the school safe.
examples.zh: 公共衛生指引有助於維護校園的安全。

explains.en: This is the state of a body and mind. Sleep, food, and movement help keep it strong. A doctor may give advice about it.
People care for this by eating well and resting. It can affect how someone feels each day. A checkup can help protect it.
This word names how well a person’s body works. Good habits can support it. Doctors help people improve it.

examples.en: Eating vegetables helps you stay healthy.
examples.zh: 多吃蔬菜能幫助你維持健康。

examples.en: Maintaining a healthy diet gives you abundant energy throughout the day.
examples.zh: 維持健康的飲食能讓你在整天保持充沛活力。

examples.en: Regular jogging is a very healthy lifestyle habit.
examples.zh: 規律慢跑是一項非常健康的生活習慣。

explains.en: It describes someone whose body is strong and well. Good food and movement can help. A person may feel full of energy.
Use this word for someone who is not ill. A walk and fresh food can support this state. A strong body may fight sickness better.
This word tells that someone feels well. It can describe a meal that supports the body. Good sleep may help a person stay this way.

examples.en: Did you hear that strange sound?
examples.zh: 你有聽見那個奇怪的聲音嗎？

examples.en: I haven't heard from my elementary school classmate for years.
examples.zh: 我已經多年沒有收到國小同班同學的音訊了。

examples.en: Speak louder so that the students in the back can hear you clearly.
examples.zh: 講大聲一點，好讓後排的學生能聽得清楚。

explains.en: It means noticing sounds with the ears. A person may notice a bird singing. It can also mean learning news from someone.
Use this word when sound reaches someone’s ears. A listener may notice a bell from far away. It can also mean learning about an event.
This verb means noticing speech, music, or noise. It may describe learning a story from another person. A person can listen closely to do it.

examples.en: Exercise makes your heart pump faster.
examples.zh: 運動能讓你的心跳加速。

examples.en: She thanked her teacher from the bottom of her heart.
examples.zh: 她由衷地打從心底感謝她的老師。

examples.en: The student drew a small pink heart next to her friend's name.
examples.zh: 這位學生在好友的名字旁畫了一顆小小的粉紅愛心。

explains.en: This is the organ that sends blood around the body. It beats faster during exercise. The same word can mean love or kindness.
The organ inside the chest keeps blood moving. People may draw its shape to show love. A brave person may be said to have courage in this place.
This word names an organ that beats inside the chest. It can also mean a person’s feelings. People use its shape as a sign of love.

examples.en: The heat from the sun warmed the garden.
examples.zh: 太陽的熱能讓花園暖和起來。

examples.en: Please heat the soup before lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐前請把湯加熱。

examples.en: The heat made the room uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 熱氣讓房間變得不舒服。

explains.en: This is warmth that comes from a fire, sun, or stove. It can also mean making something warm. A person may feel it on a sunny day.
Use this word for high temperature. A cook may apply it to food. It can also mean passion or strong feelings.
This word names warmth or a high temperature. The sun gives it to the land. As a verb, it means making something warmer.

examples.en: The backpack is too heavy for the little boy.
examples.zh: 這個書包對小男孩來說太重了。

examples.en: Heavy rain caused localized flooding on the downtown streets.
examples.zh: 豪大雨導致市中心街道出現局部積水。

examples.en: Heavy traffic on Friday afternoon delayed our trip to Taichung.
examples.zh: 週五下午的沉重車潮延誤了我們前往台中的行程。

examples.en: Heavy traffic delayed our arrival at the station.
examples.zh: 壅塞繁重的車流耽誤了我們抵達車站的時間。

examples.en: Heavy rains during monsoon season replenished the island's water reservoirs.
examples.zh: 梅雨季節豐沛的豪雨及時蓄滿了這座島嶼各大水庫的蓄水量。

examples.en: The student carried a heavy backpack filled with science textbooks and supplies.
examples.zh: 這名學生背著一個裝滿了理科教科書與用具的沉重書包。

entries.definition: 重的；沉重的；劇烈的；大量的；嚴重的

explains.en: It describes something that weighs a lot. A large box may need two people to lift it. It can also mean a large amount or strong force.
Use this word for a bag that is hard to carry. Rain may fall in a large amount. A person can feel burdened by serious work.
This word tells that an object has much weight. It can describe strong traffic or rain. A large responsibility may feel this way too.

examples.en: The height of the tree is ten meters.
examples.zh: 這棵樹的高度是十公尺。

examples.en: She is afraid of great heights.
examples.zh: 她害怕高處。

examples.en: The wall is about six feet in height.
examples.zh: 這面牆大約有六英尺高。

explains.en: This is how tall someone or something is. A ruler can measure it. A mountain has a greater measurement than a hill.
Use this word for the distance from bottom to top. A person may stand beside a wall to measure it. A ladder helps someone reach a raised place.
This word names a measurement upward. It may describe a person, tree, or building. The number is often given in feet or meters.

examples.en: Hello! Nice to meet you today.
examples.zh: 哈囉！今天很高興認識你。

examples.en: Don't forget to say hello to your grandparents when you visit.
examples.zh: 去拜訪祖父母時，別忘了向他們親切問好。

examples.en: She gave a friendly wave and yelled hello across the street.
examples.zh: 她友善地揮了揮手，隔著街大聲打招呼。

explains.en: This is a word people say when meeting someone. It can begin a friendly talk. A wave may go with it.
Use this greeting when you first see someone. It can be spoken in person or answered on the phone. A smile often makes it warmer.
This word names a friendly greeting. People may use it at the start of a conversation. It is often followed by someone’s name.

examples.en: Thank you so much for your kind help!
examples.zh: 非常感謝你的熱心幫忙！

examples.en: Eating fresh fruits can help strengthen your immune system.
examples.zh: 多吃新鮮水果能有助於強化你的免疫系統。

examples.en: Don't hesitate to ask for help if you encounter any difficulties.
examples.zh: 如果遇到任何困難，請毫不猶豫地尋求協助。

examples.en: Can you give me some help with this suitcase?
examples.zh: 你能幫我提一下這個行李箱嗎？

examples.en: Volunteers offered valuable help at the community animal shelter.
examples.zh: 志工們在社區動物收容所提供了非常寶貴的協助。

examples.en: Do not hesitate to ask for help when facing overwhelming emotional stress.
examples.zh: 當面臨難以承受的心理壓力時，切莫猶豫尋求專業協助。

entries.definition: 幫忙；協助；援助；幫助；求救

explains.en: It means making a task easier for someone. A friend may carry a heavy box. As a noun, it can mean support or aid.
Use this word when someone gives support. A teacher may explain a hard lesson. A sign can also give useful information.
This word means giving aid to a person. It can describe support during a hard time. The noun names the aid itself.

examples.en: This English grammar chart is extremely helpful.
examples.zh: 這張英語文法圖表非常有幫助。

examples.en: The hotel concierge gave us helpful travel tips for navigating the historical city.
examples.zh: 飯店禮賓人員給了我們遊覽這座歷史名城非常實用的旅遊秘訣。

examples.en: He is a polite and helpful young man who always assists senior citizens.
examples.zh: 他是個有禮貌且熱心助人的年輕小伙子，總是主動攙扶協助長者。

entries.definition: 有幫助的；有益的；樂於助人的

explains.en: It describes someone or something that makes a task easier. A map may show the way. A kind person may offer support.
Use this word for a person who likes to assist others. A clear note may be useful to a reader. It describes something that provides help.
This word tells that someone is ready to support others. A tool may make work easier. A useful answer may have this quality.

examples.en: The hen laid three eggs this morning.
examples.zh: 母雞今天早上生了三顆蛋。

examples.en: A brown hen walked across the yard.
examples.zh: 一隻棕色母雞走過院子。

examples.en: The hen kept her chicks warm.
examples.zh: 母雞讓小雞保持溫暖。

explains.en: This is an adult female chicken. It lays eggs in a nest. Farmers may keep several in a yard.
The bird has feathers and a beak. It may cluck while looking for food. Its eggs are gathered for people to eat.
This word names a female farm bird. It may care for chicks. People often raise it for eggs.

examples.en: Please sign your name right here.
examples.zh: 請就在這裡簽名。

examples.en: Here is the library book that you wanted to borrow.
examples.zh: 這是你想借閱的圖書館書籍。

examples.en: Spring has arrived, and warm weather is finally here.
examples.zh: 春天到了，溫暖的天氣終於來臨了。

explains.en: It means in this place near the speaker. A person may point to a chair beside them. It can also be used to welcome someone.
Use this word when someone or something is close to where you are. A teacher may call a student over. It may also introduce a person or thing.
This word points to a place near the speaker. It can show where an item is. A person may say it while offering something.

examples.en: The children hide behind the tree.
examples.zh: 孩子們躲在樹後面。

examples.en: She hid the gift in a drawer.
examples.zh: 她把禮物藏在抽屜裡。

examples.en: He tried to hide his surprise.
examples.zh: 他試著藏起自己的驚訝。

explains.en: It means keeping something out of sight. A child may put a toy under a bed. A person may also keep feelings private.
Use this word when placing an object where others cannot see it. Someone may stay behind a tree during a game. It can also mean not showing the truth.
This verb means making something hard to see. A person may cover an object. It can also describe keeping a feeling private.

examples.en: The kite flew high above the houses.
examples.zh: 風箏飛得比房子高。

examples.en: The mountain is very high.
examples.zh: 這座山非常高。

examples.en: She heard a high sound from the bird.
examples.zh: 她聽見鳥兒發出高音。

entries.definition: （形）高的；高級的；（副）高高地；（名）高點

explains.en: It means far above the ground or at a great level. A bird may sit on a tall tree. The word can also describe a large amount or position.
Use this word for something near the top. A plane travels well above buildings. It may describe a number or sound that is strong.
This word points to a place far from the ground. It can describe a tall mountain. A score may be greater than most others.

examples.en: Elephant Mountain is an easy hill to climb for night views.
examples.zh: 象山是一座很容易攀登觀賞夜景的小山。

examples.en: Rolling green hills surrounded the peaceful countryside village.
examples.zh: 綿延起伏的綠色丘陵環繞著這座寧靜的鄉村聚落。

examples.en: We rode our bicycles up the steep hill with great effort.
examples.zh: 我們費力地騎著腳踏車衝上陡峭的小山坡。

explains.en: This is a raised area of land smaller than a mountain. People may walk up it. Grass or trees may grow on its sides.
The land rises above the area around it. A path may lead to the top. Children may roll down its grassy side.
This word names a small natural rise in the ground. It is not as tall as a mountain. Farms and homes may sit nearby.

examples.en: Taiwan has a rich and multicultural history.
examples.zh: 台灣擁有豐富且多元的歷史。

examples.en: We visited the National Palace Museum to learn about ancient Asian history.
examples.zh: 我們參觀國立故宮博物院以了解古代亞洲歷史。

examples.en: Studying history allows us to understand the past and build a better future.
examples.zh: 研讀歷史讓我們了解過去，進而開拓更美好的未來。

explains.en: This is the study of things that happened in the past. People learn about earlier people and places. Old letters and objects can give clues.
A school subject teaches how people lived long ago. It may tell about wars, inventions, or rulers. Books and museums help people learn it.
This word names the record and study of past events. People learn how towns and nations changed. Stories and documents help tell what happened.

examples.en: The ball hit the window and broke it.
examples.zh: 球打中窗戶，把它打破了。

examples.en: She hit the drum with a stick.
examples.zh: 她用鼓棒敲鼓。

examples.en: The team got a hit in the final inning.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍在最後一局擊出安打。

explains.en: It means striking someone or something. A ball may touch a wall and move away. It can also name a successful blow or result.
Use this word for making contact with force. A hand may strike a drum. The noun can name the forceful touch itself.
This verb means touching or striking a target. A player may send a ball toward another person. It can also describe reaching someone by phone.

examples.en: Photography is my favorite weekend hobby.
examples.zh: 攝影是我最喜歡的週末嗜好。

examples.en: What hobbies do you enjoy pursuing in your free time?
examples.zh: 你在空閒時間喜歡從事哪些嗜好？

examples.en: Reading and baking are both relaxing hobbies.
examples.zh: 閱讀與烘焙都是令人放鬆的嗜好。

explains.en: This is an activity someone likes doing during free time. It may be collecting stamps or drawing. People often do it for fun.
Use this word for a favorite activity done outside work or school. A person may enjoy making models. It can help someone relax.
This word names a regular activity done for pleasure. It may use a special skill or tool. People may share it with friends.

examples.en: Please hold my hand while crossing the busy street.
examples.zh: 過熱鬧馬路時請牽著我的手。

examples.en: The school will hold its annual sports day next Friday.
examples.zh: 學校將在下週五舉辦一年一度的運動會。

examples.en: Could you hold the elevator door for a moment, please?
examples.zh: 可以請你幫忙按住電梯門稍等一下嗎？

explains.en: It means to grasp something with your hands. You might do this to a cup before taking a drink. It can also mean keeping something in one place for a time.
Use this word when a person grips an object. It may also mean keeping an item safe. As a noun, it can mean a place to put something.
This verb may mean carrying or gripping something. It can describe keeping a promise or plan. The noun can name a space or position.

examples.en: National Day is a designated public holiday across the island.
examples.zh: 國慶日是全台灣法定的國定假日。

examples.en: We plan to spend our winter holiday hiking in Taitung.
examples.zh: 我們計畫在寒假期間前往台東登山健行。

examples.en: Bank branches and government offices are closed during the national holiday.
examples.zh: 銀行分行與政府機關在國定休假日期間均暫停營業。

explains.en: This is a day or period when people do not work or attend school. It may mark a special event. Families often travel or meet then.
People may take time off during this period. A national day or religious event may be celebrated. Students may have several days away from class.
This word names a special day or time for rest. People may visit relatives. It can also mean a trip away from home.

examples.en: Welcome home! Dinner is ready.
examples.zh: 歡迎回家！晚餐準備好了。

examples.en: I usually stay at home and relax on Sunday afternoons.
examples.zh: 星期天下午我通常待在家裡放鬆。

examples.en: Taiwan is home to many unique endemic animal species.
examples.zh: 台灣是許多獨特特有種動物的家園。

explains.en: This is the place where someone lives. It may be an apartment, house, or room. The word can also mean being at that place.
People often feel safe where they live. A family may return there after work or school. As an adverb, it can mean toward that place.
This word names a person’s living place. It may be where family members gather. It can also describe moving to that place.

examples.en: Finish your homework before playing computer games.
examples.zh: 玩電腦遊戲前先把作業寫完。

examples.en: The English teacher assigned reading homework over the weekend.
examples.zh: 英文老師交代了週末的閱讀家庭作業。

examples.en: She organized her study desk so she could do her homework with full concentration.
examples.zh: 她整理好了書桌，以便全神貫注地寫作業。

explains.en: This is school work that a student does outside class. It may include reading or math problems. A teacher may ask for it the next day.
Students complete this work after school. It helps them practice a lesson. A notebook may hold the answers.
This word names learning tasks to be done at home. A student may write, read, or solve problems. A teacher may review it in class.

examples.en: Honest communication builds mutual trust.
examples.zh: 誠實的溝通能建立彼此的信任。

examples.en: To be completely honest, I didn't enjoy that mystery thriller movie.
examples.zh: 老實說，我並不是很喜歡那部懸疑驚悚電影。

examples.en: The store owner rewarded the honest student who returned the lost wallet.
examples.zh: 店家老闆獎勵了拾金不昧、送還遺失皮夾的誠實學生。

explains.en: It describes someone who tells the truth. The person does not try to trick others. People can trust what they say.
Use this word for someone who speaks truthfully. They may admit a mistake. Trust grows when people act this way.
This word tells that a person is not lying or cheating. They try to be fair. Friends may trust such a person.

examples.en: Lemon honey water is very soothing for a sore throat.
examples.zh: 檸檬蜂蜜水對喉嚨痛非常具有舒緩效果。

examples.en: Honey never spoils if kept sealed in a cool, dry place.
examples.zh: 蜂蜜密封存放在陰涼乾燥處時永遠不會變質。

examples.en: 'Honey, could you please pass me the car keys?' she asked.
examples.zh: 「親愛的，可以請你幫我遞一下車鑰匙嗎？」她問道。

examples.en: Yellow and black honey processing leaves varying amounts of sweet fruit mucilage on parchment during drying.
examples.zh: 蜜處理法，在日曬乾燥時保留不同比例的黏稠果膠層，賦予咖啡飽滿蜜糖甜度。

examples.en: Black honey coffees undergo prolonged shade drying to maximize complex sweetness and heavy body.
examples.zh: 黑蜜處理咖啡豆在遮陰網下經歷更緩慢的低溫乾燥，將深層複雜的焦糖甜感與醇厚油脂感發揮至極致。

examples.en: The sticky sugary coating on honey processed parchment requires frequent turning under open skies.
examples.zh: 附著在蜜處理內果皮外層黏稠如果醬的果膠糖分，在陽光下曝曬時需要工人極具耐心地頻繁翻拌。
