examples.en: The long examination period is finally over, and summer vacation has begun!
examples.zh: 漫長的考試週終於結束了，暑假正式展開囉！

examples.en: More than five thousand runners crossed over the scenic coastal bridge.
examples.zh: 超過五千名長跑跑者跨越了這座壯觀的跨海大橋。

explains.en: It can mean higher than something. A lamp hangs above a table. It may also show that one thing crosses a line or covers a surface.
Use this word for a time that has ended. A game may be finished. It can also mean more than a number or amount.
This word can describe movement across a wall or road. A blanket may cover a bed. It may also tell that an event is finished.

examples.en: I made my own lunch today.
examples.zh: 我今天自己做了午餐。

examples.en: The dog has its own bed by the door.
examples.zh: 狗在門邊有自己的床。

examples.en: She owns a small shop near the school.
examples.zh: 她在學校附近有一家小店。

entries.definition: （形）自己的；（代）自己的東西；（動）擁有

explains.en: It means belonging to one person. A child may have a room for personal use. It can also mean doing something without help.
Use this word for something a person has. A student may finish a task alone. It can also mean to say that an idea is true.
This word tells that something belongs to the speaker. A family may live in its personal home. It can also describe acting by oneself.

examples.en: Pack your bags the night before your school trip.
examples.zh: 在學校校外教學的前一晚把行李打包好。

examples.en: Don't forget to pack comfortable walking shoes and sunscreen.
examples.zh: 別忘了把舒適的步行鞋和防曬乳打包進行李。

examples.en: A pack of stray dogs wandered quietly along the river embankment.
examples.zh: 一群流浪狗沿著河堤安靜地漫步。

explains.en: It means putting clothes and other things into a bag for a trip. A group of dogs can also be called this. It may name a set of items wrapped together.
Use this word when getting ready to travel. A student may put books into a school bag. It can also mean placing many things close together.
This word can describe a group of animals. It can also mean preparing a suitcase for travel. A store may sell a set of items together.

examples.en: The postman delivered a heavy online shopping package.
examples.zh: 郵差送來了一個沉甸甸的網購包裹。

examples.en: The hotel offers a weekend spa package including dinner and massage.
examples.zh: 飯店推出了包含晚餐與按摩的週末水療套裝行程。

examples.en: Handle this delicate glass package with extra care.
examples.zh: 搬運這件易碎玻璃包裹時要格外小心。

explains.en: A shop may send an item inside a box. The box and its contents can have this name. It can also mean a set of services sold together.
This is something wrapped or boxed for sending. A person may wait for it to arrive. A computer plan may include several tools in one set.
A delivery may bring this to a home. It can hold a gift or books. The word can also describe a group of things offered as one deal.

examples.en: Turn to page fifty-five of the storybook.
examples.zh: 翻到故事書的第五十五頁。

examples.en: The web page failed to load properly due to a weak internet connection.
examples.zh: 由於網路連線不穩，該網頁無法正常載入。

examples.en: She bookmarked the final page before turning off the reading lamp.
examples.zh: 在關掉床頭閱讀燈前，她在最後一頁夾上了書籤。

explains.en: A book has a flat sheet with words on it. A reader turns to one to continue. A person on a loudspeaker may use this word to ask someone to come.
This is one side of a sheet in a book. A child may read several before bed. A worker can use a loudspeaker to call a person.
A web site can show a screen with facts and pictures. A printed book has many of these. Someone may also be called through a speaker.

examples.en: They painted the kitchen yellow.
examples.zh: 他們把廚房漆成黃色。

examples.en: My brother paints pictures of birds.
examples.zh: 我哥哥畫鳥的圖畫。

examples.en: The paint on the fence is still wet.
examples.zh: 柵欄上的油漆還是濕的。

explains.en: It means putting color onto a wall or picture. An artist may use a brush. It can also name the colored liquid used for this work.
Use this word for making a picture with colored liquid. A family may cover a room wall with a new shade. The word can also mean a picture made this way.
A person can make a scene with a brush and colors. A house may get a fresh wall covering. The material comes in a can.

examples.en: Pair your smartwatch with your health app.
examples.zh: 將您的智慧手錶與健康 App 進行配對。

examples.en: She bought a stylish pair of black leather boots for winter.
examples.zh: 她為冬天買了一雙時髦亮麗的黑色真皮靴。

examples.en: The teacher asked students to pair up for the conversational role-play.
examples.zh: 老師要求學生們兩人一組進行會話角色扮演練習。

explains.en: Two things that belong together can be called this. A person may buy two gloves that look alike. It can also mean joining two people or things.
Use this word for two matching items. Shoes are often sold together. It can also describe a couple working as a team.
This word means two that go together. A person may match a sock with its mate. As an action, it can mean bringing two things together.

examples.en: These black pants fit me very well.
examples.zh: 這條黑長褲我穿起來非常合身。

examples.en: He rolled up his pants while walking along the beach.
examples.zh: 沿著海灘漫步時，他捲起了長褲褲管。

examples.en: You need to iron your dress pants before the ceremony.
examples.zh: 典禮開始前，你需要先熨燙你的西裝長褲。

explains.en: These are clothes that cover both legs. People wear them over underwear. They may be made from cloth or denim.
A person puts one leg in each opening. The garment can be short or long. It often has pockets at the front.
This clothing has two leg sections. Many people wear it with a shirt. It can be made from soft cloth or strong denim.

examples.en: Do you have a blank piece of paper for me?
examples.zh: 你有一張空白紙可以給我嗎？

examples.en: Please recycle waste paper to save trees and protect our planet.
examples.zh: 請回收廢紙以保護樹木與珍惜地球資源。

examples.en: The university professor published an influential academic research paper.
examples.zh: 那位大學教授發表了一篇具有影響力的學術研究論文。

explains.en: A thin sheet made from trees can be used for writing. A student may draw or do homework on it. It can also mean a school test or a set of news.
This material is often white and light. People use it to print words and pictures. A writer may hand in a report made from several sheets.
A newspaper is made from this material. A child can fold a sheet into a plane. The word may also describe a test given in class.

examples.en: Being a good parent requires lots of patience and love.
examples.zh: 做一個稱職的父母需要很多的耐心與愛心。

examples.en: Every caring parent desires to provide a nurturing and safe home for their children.
examples.zh: 每位關愛孩子的為人父母者，都渴望為孩子提供一個溫馨而安全的家庭。

examples.en: Each parent was invited to join the parent-teacher association gathering this evening.
examples.zh: 每位家長都受邀參加今晚舉行的家長與教師座談聯誼會。

entries.definition: 雙親之一；父母親（常用複數）

explains.en: A mother or father has this role in a family. This person cares for a child. Two people with this role are a child’s mother and father.
This word describes an adult who raises a child. The person may teach, feed, and protect the young one. A child can have one or two people in this role.
A child depends on this grown person for care. The person may help with school work. The word often refers to both the mother and father together.

examples.en: Many people jog in Daan Forest Park.
examples.zh: 許多人在大安森林公園慢跑。

examples.en: You cannot park your car in front of the emergency exit.
examples.zh: 你不能把車停在緊急出口前。

examples.en: Children laughed and played on the park swings.
examples.zh: 孩子們在公園鞦韆上歡笑玩耍。

explains.en: It is a public green area where people can walk and play. Children may use swings there. The word can also mean leaving a car in a space.
Families may eat lunch on the grass in this place. A city may have many trees and paths there. Drivers may also leave a car for a short time.
This outdoor area is open to the public. People may walk dogs or play ball there. A driver may leave a car in a marked space.

examples.en: A large part of the road was closed.
examples.zh: 道路很大一段都封閉了。

examples.en: She played an important part in the show.
examples.zh: 她在表演中扮演重要角色。

examples.en: Please part the curtains so we can see outside.
examples.zh: 請把窗簾分開，這樣我們就能看到外面。

explains.en: It can mean one piece of a whole. A cake may be cut into several pieces. It can also mean a role in an activity.
Use this word for one section of something larger. A person may help with a task. It can also describe a body area or a share.
This word can name a piece of a whole. It may also mean a role someone has. As a verb, it can mean leaving from a place.

examples.en: We had a surprise birthday party for Jenny.
examples.zh: 我們為珍妮辦了一場驚喜生日派對。

examples.en: Are you going to attend the company's annual year-end party?
examples.zh: 你會參加公司的年度尾牙派對嗎？

examples.en: The host prepared plenty of tasty food and drinks for the dinner party.
examples.zh: 主人為這場晚餐聚會準備了豐盛美味的食物與飲料。

examples.en: Taiwan has a dynamic multi-party democratic political system.
examples.zh: 台灣擁有充滿活力的多黨競爭民主政黨體系。

examples.en: We threw a surprise birthday party for our favorite teacher.
examples.zh: 我們為最受敬愛的老師舉辦了一場驚喜溫馨的生日慶生派對。

examples.en: Both legal parties signed the contract in the presence of an attorney.
examples.zh: 法律合約雙方當事人在執業律師的共同見證下正式簽署協議。

entries.definition: 派對；聚會；黨派；政黨；當事人

explains.en: Friends may meet for food, games, or music. This gathering often happens on a special day. The same word can name a group that works in politics.
A family may invite guests to a home for fun. People eat snacks and talk together. It can also mean a political group or one side in an agreement.
This is a social gathering with guests. People may celebrate a birthday there. In politics, it is a group with shared ideas.

examples.en: I studied late every night and finally passed the GEPT test!
examples.zh: 我每晚苦讀，終於通過了全民英檢（GEPT）！

examples.en: Show your security pass at the entrance gate before entering the premises.
examples.zh: 進入廠區前請在大門警衛處出示您的安全通行證識別證。

examples.en: Time passes remarkably fast when you are immersed in engaging work.
examples.zh: 當你全神貫注沉浸在引人入勝的工作中時，時間過得飛快。

explains.en: It can mean going from one side to another. A student may also get a good result on a test. A small card can give permission to enter.
Use this word when someone moves by a guard or place. It can describe doing well enough on an exam. A ticket may let a person enter a bus or event.
This word may mean giving an item to someone else. It can also mean getting a good result at school. A card may allow a person to go through a gate.

examples.en: Walk past the bookstore and turn right at the corner.
examples.zh: 走過書店並在轉角處右轉。

examples.en: In the past, letters took weeks to travel across the oceans.
examples.zh: 在過去，信件漂洋過海需要耗費數週的時間。

examples.en: We cannot change the past, but we can actively build a brighter future.
examples.zh: 我們無法改變過去，但我們能夠積極開創更加光明的未來。

explains.en: It means the time before now. A person may talk about a day that has gone by. It can also mean moving by someone or something.
Use this word for a time that has ended. A bus may go by a house. It can also describe something that is no longer current.
This word can mean earlier than the present. A runner may move beyond another runner. It can also describe a time that has ended.

examples.en: You can pay with an EasyCard here.
examples.zh: 你可以在這裡用悠遊卡付款。

examples.en: How much did you pay for that concert ticket?
examples.zh: 你那張演唱會門票花了多少錢？

examples.en: Hard work will always pay off in the end.
examples.zh: 辛勤的付出最終總會有回報的。

examples.en: You can pay with mobile payment apps here.
examples.zh: 你可以在這裡使用行動支付應用程式付款。

examples.en: Pay close attention to the lab safety instructions given by the teacher.
examples.zh: 密切注意老師所說的實驗室安全注意事項。

examples.en: Persistent practice will ultimately pay off when exam results arrive.
examples.zh: 持續不懈的練習在考試放榜時終將獲得回報。

explains.en: It means giving money for something. A worker gets money for doing a job. The money itself can also be called this.
Use this word when buying food at a shop. A company may send money to a worker each month. It can also mean the amount a worker receives.
A person may give coins or a card to a seller. A worker receives money for a job. The word can name that action or the money received.

examples.en: Can I borrow your blue pen?
examples.zh: 我可以借你的藍色原子筆嗎？

examples.en: The black pen has run out of ink.
examples.zh: 那支黑色原子筆已經沒水了。

examples.en: Sign your signature here with this black ink pen.
examples.zh: 用這支黑墨水筆在這裡簽上你的名字。

explains.en: A person uses this tool to write with ink. It may have a cap to keep the tip clean. Some people use it to sign a letter.
This writing tool has a small point. Dark liquid comes from it onto a page. Students may carry one in a bag.
A person holds this tool and moves it across paper. It leaves a colored line. A cap may cover its small writing tip.

examples.en: You need a 2B pencil for the test.
examples.zh: 你考試需要用 2B 鉛筆。

examples.en: Please sharpen your pencil before the examination starts.
examples.zh: 考試開始前請先把你的鉛筆削好。

examples.en: She drew a lovely cat sketch using a pencil.
examples.zh: 她用鉛筆畫了一幅可愛的貓咪素描。

explains.en: This writing tool has a dark center inside a wooden case. A person can use an eraser to remove its marks. Students often use it for math.
A child can draw lines with this tool. Its center leaves a gray mark on paper. A small rubber piece can erase the mark.
This tool is used for writing and drawing. It has a long, narrow shape. A sharpener makes its point ready to use.

examples.en: Many people in Taiwan drink bubble tea.
examples.zh: 台灣有許多人喝珍珠奶茶。

examples.en: Hundreds of people gathered to watch the New Year fireworks.
examples.zh: 數百人聚集在一起看跨年煙火。

examples.en: Polite people always remember to say thank you.
examples.zh: 有禮貌的人總是記得說謝謝。

explains.en: This word means more than one person. A crowd may gather to watch a game. It can also refer to a nation’s citizens.
A family, class, or crowd can be called this. These members may share a place or activity. The word is usually used for a group.
Many human beings together are described this way. A town may have residents from many homes. The word can also mean the citizens of a country.

examples.en: Perhaps we can visit Grandma tomorrow.
examples.zh: 也許我們明天可以去看奶奶。

examples.en: It will perhaps rain later this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午晚些時候也許會下雨。

examples.en: Perhaps he forgot to bring his book.
examples.zh: 或許他忘了帶書。

explains.en: It means something may happen, but a person is not sure. A child may think rain could come later. It is close in meaning to maybe.
Use this word when giving a possible answer. A friend may come to dinner, but the plan is uncertain. The speaker does not know for sure.
This word shows that an idea could be true. A team may win, though the result is unknown. It can make a guess sound gentle.

examples.en: Ken is a very kind person.
examples.zh: 肯恩是一個非常善良的人。

examples.en: Only one person can enter the room at a time.
examples.zh: 一次只有一個人可以進入房間。

examples.en: She is the most hardworking person I know.
examples.zh: 她是我認識最努力認真的人。

explains.en: This word means one human being. A child is one, and an adult is one too. It can describe someone without naming who they are.
A single human has this meaning. A doctor may talk with one at a time. The word can also describe the body or character of someone.
This word refers to one member of a group. It can mean a man, woman, or child. A form may ask for details about someone.

examples.en: Keeping a pet requires love, time, and responsibility.
examples.zh: 飼養寵物需要愛心、時間和責任感。

examples.en: The kind girl gently pet the sleeping golden retriever.
examples.zh: 善良的女孩溫柔地撫摸著熟睡的黃金獵犬。

examples.en: Do you have any pets at home, like a dog or bird?
examples.zh: 你家裡有養任何寵物嗎，像是狗或鳥？

explains.en: A family may keep this animal at home. A dog or cat can have this role. The word can also mean gently touching an animal.
This is an animal cared for in a home. A child may feed it and play with it. As an action, the word means stroking an animal gently.
A bird, fish, or cat may live with a family. The animal depends on people for care. A person may softly stroke its fur.

examples.en: Let's take a group photo together!
examples.zh: 我們大家一起拍張大合照吧！

examples.en: She framed the vacation photo and hung it on her bedroom wall.
examples.zh: 她把度假照片裝裱起來掛在臥室牆上。

examples.en: Modern smartphones can take stunning high-resolution photos in low light.
examples.zh: 現代智慧型手機在微光環境下也能拍出令人驚豔的高畫質照片。

explains.en: This is an image made with a camera. People may keep one to remember a trip. The short form is often used in casual speech.
A camera can make a picture of a person or place. A family may put one in a frame. The shorter word is common in daily talk.
This word means a picture made by taking a camera shot. It can show a face or scene. People often share one with friends.

examples.en: My sister practices playing the piano every evening.
examples.zh: 我妹妹每天晚上都練習彈鋼琴。

examples.en: The soft piano melody echoed through the empty concert hall.
examples.zh: 柔和的鋼琴旋律在空曠的音樂廳內迴盪。

examples.en: He has been taking classical piano lessons since age five.
examples.zh: 他從五歲起就一直在上古典鋼琴課。

examples.en: She has practiced playing classical piano since age five.
examples.zh: 她從五歲起就開始練習彈奏古典鋼琴。

examples.en: The technician was hired to tune the concert grand piano before the recital.
examples.zh: 調音技師受聘在獨奏會開始前為演奏級平台大鋼琴進行調音。

examples.en: Learning to play the piano develops strong rhythmic awareness and finger strength.
examples.zh: 學習彈鋼琴能培養強烈的節奏敏銳感與手指獨立指力。

explains.en: This musical instrument has black and white keys. A person presses them to make sounds. It can be large and stay in a room.
A musician can play songs on this instrument. Its keys make high and low sounds. Some homes have one for music lessons.
This instrument is often found in a music room. A player uses both hands on the keys. It may be upright or very large.

examples.en: Please pick a card from the box.
examples.zh: 請從盒子裡挑一張卡片。

examples.en: She picked flowers for her mother.
examples.zh: 她摘花送給媽媽。

examples.en: He plays the guitar with a blue pick.
examples.zh: 他用藍色的彈片彈吉他。

explains.en: This action means choosing one item from a group. A child looks at several colored cards. The child selects the blue one.
This can mean removing flowers or fruit from a plant. A gardener holds a ripe apple. A gentle twist separates it from the branch.
This noun can mean a small tool used to play a guitar. The player holds it between a thumb and finger. Its tip strikes the strings.

examples.en: We had a picnic under the cherry blossom trees.
examples.zh: 我們在櫻花樹下野餐。

examples.en: Let's pack sandwiches and cold drinks for tomorrow's park picnic.
examples.zh: 我們為明天的公園野餐準備三明治和冷飲吧。

examples.en: The sunny weekend weather is perfect for a family picnic.
examples.zh: 晴朗的週末天氣非常適合全家出遊野餐。

explains.en: Friends may eat food outside on a blanket. They can bring sandwiches and fruit. This meal is often shared in a park or field.
A family may carry a basket to a grassy place. They sit and eat in the fresh air. This activity is a fun meal outdoors.
People bring food to eat away from home. They may sit under a tree or near a lake. The meal often includes easy foods to carry.

examples.en: The picture shows a quiet beach at sunset.
examples.zh: 這張圖片呈現日落時安靜的海灘。

examples.en: I drew a picture of our family.
examples.zh: 我畫了一張我們家的圖畫。

examples.en: This story paints a clear picture of village life.
examples.zh: 這個故事清楚描繪了鄉村生活。

explains.en: This can be a drawing or a photo that shows a person or place. A child may hang one on a wall. It can also mean a scene in a book.
A camera can make this kind of image. An artist can also draw one. It helps people see what a person or place looks like.
A page may have one of these next to words. It can show a real view or an imagined scene. People may use it to remember a day.

examples.en: We shared an apple pie after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐後我們一起吃了一個蘋果派。

examples.en: The pie is filled with fresh blueberries.
examples.zh: 這個派裡裝滿新鮮藍莓。

examples.en: Grandma baked a meat pie for lunch.
examples.zh: 奶奶烤了一個肉派當午餐。

explains.en: This food has a crust around a sweet or savory filling. It is often cut into slices. Apple is a common kind.
A baker may put fruit inside a pastry shell. The top may have a cover or strips of dough. People often eat a slice for dessert.
This baked dish can hold meat or fruit. It has a bottom crust and sometimes a top crust. A round one may be shared after dinner.

examples.en: May I have a piece of cake?
examples.zh: 我可以吃一塊蛋糕嗎？

examples.en: He played a piece of soft music.
examples.zh: 他演奏了一段輕柔的音樂。

examples.en: Each piece fits into the wooden puzzle.
examples.zh: 每一片都能拼進木製拼圖。

entries.definition: （名）一片；一件；一段音樂；（動）拼湊；修補。

explains.en: It means one small amount cut or taken from a larger thing. A person may eat a slice of bread. It can also mean a short bit of music or art.
Use this word for one section of a whole. A child may break a toy into parts. It can also describe one item that belongs in a larger set.
This word can mean a small slice of food. It may also refer to a bit of news or music. A person can put one section into its proper place.

examples.en: Pigs are actually very smart animals.
examples.zh: 豬其實是非常聰明的動物。

examples.en: The farmer feeds the mother pig fresh vegetables and corn.
examples.zh: 農夫用新鮮蔬菜和玉米餵養母豬。

examples.en: He has been collecting coins in his ceramic piggy bank for a year.
examples.zh: 他把硬幣存在他的陶瓷小豬撲滿裡已經一年了。

explains.en: This farm animal has a round body and a short nose. It may live in a pen. It often makes a snorting sound.
A farmer may raise this animal for food. It has four legs and a curly tail. Young ones are called piglets.
This animal is often pink or brown. It looks for food with its nose. A mother may care for many small babies.

examples.en: She used a pin to hold the note on the board.
examples.zh: 她用圖釘把紙條固定在板子上。

examples.en: A safety pin kept his coat closed.
examples.zh: 一枚別針讓他的外套保持扣好。

examples.en: The map has a pin at our hotel.
examples.zh: 地圖上在我們的旅館位置有一個標記。

entries.definition: （名）別針；圖釘；識別碼；標記點；（動）別住；固定。

explains.en: This small metal item can hold cloth together. It has a sharp point and a round head. People may also use it to attach a note to a board.
A map may use this small object to mark a place. It can fasten two pieces of fabric. The pointed end must be handled with care.
This little tool has a narrow metal body. It may go through paper to hold it on a wall. A person may put one in a shirt to close a tear.

examples.en: Cherry blossoms are lovely shades of pink.
examples.zh: 櫻花呈現出可愛的粉紅色調。

examples.en: The baby girl was wrapped in a soft pink blanket.
examples.zh: 女嬰被包裹在一條柔軟的粉紅色毛毯裡。

examples.en: Flamingos get their bright pink color from the food they eat.
examples.zh: 紅鶴明亮的粉紅色澤源自牠們所吃的食物。

explains.en: It is a light color made from red and white. Many flowers have this shade. It is often linked with love and kindness.
This color can be pale or bright. A flamingo has feathers in this shade. People may use it for clothes or paint.
It describes a color between red and white. A rose may have this soft shade. It is also the name of that color.

examples.en: The water supply pipe was upgraded to durable stainless steel.
examples.zh: 自來水供水管線已升級為耐用不鏽鋼材質。

examples.en: Freezing winter temperatures can cause uninsulated outdoor water pipes to burst.
examples.zh: 寒冬嚴寒低溫可能會導致缺乏保溫的戶外自來水管破裂。

examples.en: The old grandfather sat quietly smoking tobacco from a carved wooden pipe.
examples.zh: 老爺爺靜靜地坐著，抽著雕刻精美的木製菸斗。

explains.en: Water moves through this long hollow tube. It can be made from metal or plastic. A plumber may repair one in a house.
This tube carries water or gas from one place to another. Some musicians blow into a simple kind. It can also be a long passage inside a machine.
A house may have one behind a wall. It lets water flow to a sink. A person can blow air through a narrow kind to make music.

examples.en: Taiwan is a wonderful place to live and travel.
examples.zh: 台灣是一個非常適合居住與旅遊的好地方。

examples.en: Place the fragile glassware carefully on the bottom shelf.
examples.zh: 將易碎的玻璃器皿小心地放置在底層架子上。

examples.en: In the first place, we should consider everyone's safety before proceeding.
examples.zh: 首先，在進行之前我們應該優先考量每個人的安全。

explains.en: It means a space or area where something is. A person may visit a town or room. As an action, it means putting something somewhere.
This word can name a spot on a map. A child may sit in a seat. It can also mean setting an object down.
A city, home, or classroom can be described this way. People may choose one for a meeting. The action means putting an item in its proper spot.

examples.en: What are your plans for the summer vacation?
examples.zh: 你的暑假有什麼計畫？

examples.en: We made a detailed emergency evacuation plan in case of natural disasters.
examples.zh: 我們制定了一份詳細的緊急疏散計畫以防發生天然災害。

examples.en: The architect presented a comprehensive floor plan for the new community library.
examples.zh: 建築師展示了新社區圖書館的全面平面規劃設計圖。

explains.en: It is a set of steps for reaching a goal. A family may decide what to do on a trip. As a verb, it means thinking ahead and choosing steps.
A person may make one before starting a large task. It can show what will happen first and next. As an action, it means deciding how to reach a goal.
This word can mean an idea for the future. A team may discuss its next steps. The verb means arranging what to do.

examples.en: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun and target for human colonization.
examples.zh: 火星是太陽系中由內向外的第四顆行星，也是未來人類移居探索首選。

examples.en: Astronomers have identified thousands of exoplanets orbiting distant stars beyond our galaxy.
examples.zh: 天文學家運用凌日法在我們銀河系各處，迄今已探測並確認了數以千計繞行遙遠恆星的太陽系外行星。

examples.en: Earth is a rare and precious living planet blessed with liquid water and an oxygen-rich atmosphere.
examples.zh: 地球是一顆極其罕見且得天獨厚、孕育萬千生命的蔚藍奇蹟行星，坐擁豐沛的液態水與充沛氧氣大氣層。

explains.en: This large round body moves around a star. Earth is one example. Some have rings or many moons.
It is a large object in space that travels around a star. Earth is one of these bodies. A telescope can help people see distant ones.
A star has large bodies moving around it. One of them is the home of all people. Some are hot, cold, rocky, or made of gas.

examples.en: Many people enjoy keeping green indoor plants.
examples.zh: 許多人喜歡在室內擺放綠色植栽。

examples.en: Water your potted plants once every two days.
examples.zh: 每兩天為你的盆栽植物澆一次水。

examples.en: The local government plans to plant more trees along the street.
examples.zh: 地方政府計劃在街道兩旁種植更多樹木。

explains.en: A living thing with roots can grow in soil. It may have leaves, flowers, or fruit. As an action, it means putting seeds or young trees into the ground.
This living thing often needs water and sunlight. A farmer may grow food from it. The same word can mean a place where goods are made.
A tree is one kind of this living thing. It takes in water through roots. As a verb, it means placing seeds in the earth.

examples.en: Put the sliced fruit on a clean white plate.
examples.zh: 把切好的水果放在乾淨的白盤子上。

examples.en: She dropped the ceramic plate and it shattered onto the floor.
examples.zh: 她摔落了陶瓷盤子，盤子在地上碎裂開來。

examples.en: He finished everything on his plate without wasting food.
examples.zh: 他吃光了盤裡的所有食物，沒有浪費半點糧食。

examples.en: Automatic license plate reader networks flagged the stolen SUV within two minutes of passing the toll bridge.
examples.zh: 自動車牌辨識系統在贓車通過收費大橋後兩分鐘內，立即發出警報通報攔截。

examples.en: Highway patrol vehicles are equipped with rooftop cameras that read every passing car license plate automatically.
examples.zh: 國道公路警察巡邏車頂部搭載了專用紅外線車牌辨識鏡頭，能自動高速掃描掠過的每輛過路車輛車牌。

examples.en: The suspect swapped stolen plate tags onto his vehicle to mislead roadside automated reader networks.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人在作案車輛上懸掛懸掛偷來的假車牌以混淆視聽，企圖誤導沿路佈設的智慧車辨雲端監控。

examples.en: The mainplate serves as the structural foundation supporting all micro-mechanical components.
examples.zh: 經過嚴密銑削的「機芯主底板」（Mainplate），是支撐數百個微型機械零件平穩運作的結構基石。

examples.en: Waiters cleared empty porcelain dinner plates from the dining table before serving rich chocolate dessert.
examples.zh: 訓練有素的餐廳服務生在為客人端上濃郁的手工熔岩巧克力甜點前，優雅地撤走餐桌上用完的骨瓷餐盤。

examples.en: Geological tectonic plates shifting along the fault line trigger periodic earthquakes across the island.
examples.zh: 位於板塊交界處的板塊擠壓運動，造就了這座島嶼高聳雄偉的山脈與頻繁釋放地底能量的週期性地震。

entries.definition: 盤子；碟子；ALPR 自動辨識車牌車辨系統；車牌；打磨魚鱗紋珍珠圓點之主機芯底板 (Mainplate)

explains.en: People eat food from this flat dish. It may be made of glass or clay. A car also has a metal tag that shows its letters and digits.
A meal may be served on this round object. It can be put in a cupboard after washing. The same word can mean a metal part in a machine or vehicle tag.
This dish holds food at a table. It may be round and shallow. In a car, the word can refer to the tag fixed at the front or back.

examples.en: We often play basketball on Friday afternoons.
examples.zh: 我們經常在週五下午打籃球。

examples.en: She plays the piano with great skill and emotion.
examples.zh: 她彈鋼琴技巧純熟且充滿情感。

examples.en: Our school drama club will put on a Shakespeare play next month.
examples.zh: 我們學校話劇社下個月將上演莎士比亞戲劇。

explains.en: Children may do this with toys or games for fun. Musicians do it with songs and instruments. The word can also mean a show in a theater.
A child can move around for fun with friends. A band may make music for an audience. A story acted on stage can also have this name.
This action can mean having fun with a game. A musician may make notes on an instrument. A theater may show a story with actors.

examples.en: Every player on the court gave their best effort.
examples.zh: 球場上的每位球員都全力以赴。

examples.en: He is regarded as the most talented soccer player in the league.
examples.zh: 他被公認是該聯賽中最有天賦的足球選手。

examples.en: In multiplayer online games, players need to communicate clearly.
examples.zh: 在多人線上遊戲中，玩家們需要清晰地保持溝通。

explains.en: This person takes part in a game or sport. A team may have many people in this role. A musician who performs can also be called this.
A person on a sports team has this role. The worker may practice and compete. Someone who performs music has the same kind of title.
This word names a person who takes part in a match. A soccer team needs several. It can also mean someone who performs music.

examples.en: Please have a seat and wait a moment.
examples.zh: 請坐下稍等片刻。

examples.en: Could you please lower the volume of the television?
examples.zh: 能否請你把電視音量調小一點？

examples.en: He worked tirelessly to please his demanding music instructor.
examples.zh: 他不知疲倦地努力，希望能讓嚴格的音樂指導老師滿意。

explains.en: People say this to make a request sound kind. It can also mean making someone happy. A gift may bring joy to a friend.
This polite term often comes before a request. It asks another person in a gentle way. As a verb, it means giving joy to someone.
A speaker may use this word when asking for help. It can make a request sound gentle. The verb means making someone feel happy.

examples.en: It was a pleasure to meet your family.
examples.zh: 很高興認識你的家人。

examples.en: She takes pleasure in reading after lunch.
examples.zh: 她喜歡午餐後閱讀。

examples.en: The children shouted with pleasure at the party.
examples.zh: 孩子們在派對上高興地大叫。

explains.en: It is a happy feeling that comes from something good. A child may smile after a kind visit. The word can also mean something that gives joy.
A person may feel this during a fun day. Kind words can bring this feeling. It can also name an enjoyable thing.
This warm feeling can come from music or time with friends. A person may say a visit brought joy. The word can mean a source of happiness.

examples.en: The train leaves at 7 p.m.
examples.zh: 火車在晚上七點離開。

examples.en: The store closes at 9 p.m.
examples.zh: 商店晚上九點打烊。

examples.en: Our movie starts at 8:30 p.m.
examples.zh: 我們的電影在晚上八點半開始。

entries.definition: 下午；午後（時間標記，中午後至午夜前）

explains.en: This short form tells the time from noon until midnight. It is often written after a clock time. It helps show which half of the day is meant.
A clock may show a time in the evening. This mark after the digits tells that it is after noon. It is often used in schedules.
A person can use these letters to show an evening time. They follow the hour and minute digits. The mark helps separate day from night.

examples.en: He put his keys in his pocket.
examples.zh: 他把鑰匙放進口袋裡。

examples.en: The jacket has a small pocket inside.
examples.zh: 這件外套裡面有一個小口袋。

examples.en: She found a coin in her coat pocket.
examples.zh: 她在外套口袋裡找到一枚硬幣。

explains.en: A small cloth space sewn into a shirt can hold coins. A jacket may have several. This word can also mean a small bag in clothing.
People keep keys in this part of a coat. It is made to hold small things. Some pants have one at the back.
This little space is part of clothing. A person may put a phone or coins inside. A pair of pants may have several.

examples.en: A three-point shot in basketball can change the game rapidly.
examples.zh: 籃球裡的三分球能迅速改變比賽局勢。

examples.en: She raised an important point during the board meeting discussion.
examples.zh: 她在董事會議討論中提出了一個至關重要的觀點。

examples.en: The guide pointed toward the historic lighthouse standing on the cliff.
examples.zh: 導遊指向佇立在懸崖上的歷史悠久燈塔。

examples.en: The movable point frog closes the wheel gap completely, eliminating the bumpy shock of traditional switches.
examples.zh: 專利「可動心軌道岔」（Movable Point），在轉轍時完全閉合輪軌空隙，徹底消弭傳統道岔的顛簸衝擊。

examples.en: The keynote speaker made a brilliant and persuasive point regarding the ethics of artificial intelligence.
examples.zh: 開場專題主講人在人工智慧技術倫理規範議題上，提出了一項發人深省且極具說服力的獨到見解。

examples.en: The tour guide raised her umbrella to point out the historic architecture of the ancient temple roof.
examples.zh: 專業文史導覽員高高舉起手中遮陽傘，向身旁遊客熱情指引介紹百年古廟屋脊剪黏與交趾陶精髓。

entries.definition: 分數；點；指向；消除軌面有害空間之高錳鋼可動鼻軌心軌

explains.en: It can mean a small dot or a score in a game. A person may use a finger to show a place. It can also mean a main idea.
A game may give a team one for a goal. A pencil can make a small mark. A speaker may explain the main idea of a story.
This word can name a score or a sharp tip. A person may show a direction with a finger. It can also mean the reason for doing something.

examples.en: The police helped the lost child.
examples.zh: 警察幫助了那個迷路的孩子。

examples.en: Police officers closed the road after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨後，警察封閉了道路。

examples.en: Call the police if you see smoke in the building.
examples.zh: 如果你看到大樓裡有煙，請打電話報警。

explains.en: These workers help keep people safe and enforce laws. They may wear uniforms and drive marked cars. A station is often their place of work.
A group of officers may help during an emergency. They can investigate when a law is broken. Their job includes protecting a town.
These public workers may guide traffic. They help people follow the law. A person can call them when someone is in danger.

examples.en: Saying 'please' and 'thank you' is polite.
examples.zh: 說「請」和「謝謝」是有禮貌的表現。

examples.en: The hotel clerk was exceptionally polite and attentive to guests.
examples.zh: 飯店櫃台人員對待客人格外有禮貌且體貼周到。

examples.en: It is polite to listen patiently before offering your opinion.
examples.zh: 在發表自己的意見之前耐心傾聽是有禮貌的作法。

examples.en: It is polite to say 'excuse me' before asking directions.
examples.zh: 問路前先說聲「不好意思」是有禮貌的。

examples.en: The young hotel receptionist greeted international guests with a polite bow.
examples.zh: 年輕的飯店櫃檯接待員以彬彬有禮的鞠躬迎接外國貴賓。

examples.en: Always remember to be polite and respectful to elders and teachers.
examples.zh: 請始終記得對長輩與師長保持禮貌與敬意。

explains.en: It describes a person who uses kind words and good manners. Such a person may say thank you. The word can also describe an action done with care.
A child may wait for a turn and speak gently. These actions show good manners. The describing word has this meaning.
This word means acting with care for others. A person may hold a door open for someone. Kind speech can show this quality.

examples.en: A frog jumped into the small pond.
examples.zh: 一隻青蛙跳進小池塘。

examples.en: The ducks swim across the pond each morning.
examples.zh: 那些鴨子每天早上游過池塘。

examples.en: We sat beside the pond and watched the fish.
examples.zh: 我們坐在池塘旁看魚。

explains.en: A small body of still water may be found in a garden. Ducks can swim there. It is smaller than a lake.
Rain may collect in a low area of land. Frogs and fish may live in it. People can sometimes see their faces on its surface.
This little water place can be natural or made by people. A farm may use it for fish. It is often calm and not very deep.

examples.en: Clear tidal rock pools act as natural aquariums teeming with juvenile fish, anemones, and hermit crabs.
examples.zh: 退潮後留在礁岩凹陷處的天然潮池宛如一座座露天水族箱，生氣勃勃擠滿了小幼魚、海葵與寄居蟹。

examples.en: Children crouched beside the calm rock pool to marvel at a translucent glass shrimp darting through seaweed.
examples.zh: 孩童們興奮地蹲在風平浪靜的岩礁潮池邊，聚精會神觀察一隻晶瑩剔透的小玻璃蝦在翠綠海石蓴間敏捷穿梭。

examples.en: Never disturb stones inside a fragile tide pool, as they shelter shy octopuses and sea urchins.
examples.zh: 走訪天然潮池時請隨手將翻動的石頭歸位，因為每一塊岩石底層都可能是害羞章魚與海膽賴以安居的避難所。

entries.definition: 潮間帶天然潮池；水池；匯集

explains.en: People swim in this large area of water. It may be built in a yard or at a sports center. The word can also mean a shared amount of money.
A hotel may have one for guests to enjoy. Children can splash in the water. A group may also join its money together for a goal.
This water area is made for swimming. It can be indoors or outdoors. The same word may describe a group sharing resources.

examples.en: The charity raises money to support poor families.
examples.zh: 該慈善機構募款以資助貧困家庭。

examples.en: Poor eye posture can lead to severe nearsightedness in children.
examples.zh: 不良的用眼姿勢可能導致兒童高度近視。

examples.en: The poor stray puppy shivered in the cold winter rain.
examples.zh: 可憐的流浪小狗在寒冷的冬雨中瑟瑟發抖。

explains.en: It can describe someone with little money. It can also mean low in quality or skill. A person may feel sorry for someone in trouble.
A family with little money may be described this way. A weak result can have this quality too. The word may also show care for someone who has a hard time.
This describing word can mean not good enough. It can also refer to a person who needs help. It may describe a place without much money.

examples.en: Eating sweet popcorn while watching movies is fun.
examples.zh: 邊看電影邊吃甜爆米花很有樂趣。

examples.en: The movie theater smelled delightfully of warm buttered popcorn.
examples.zh: 電影院裡瀰漫著溫熱奶油爆米花的怡人香氣。

examples.en: We made fresh popcorn at home using a microwave popper.
examples.zh: 我們用微波爐專用鍋在家爆了熱騰騰的新鮮爆米花。

explains.en: This light snack is made from dried corn. Heat makes each kernel burst open. People often eat it at a theater.
A cook warms corn seeds until they puff up. The snack is often covered with salt or butter. People may eat it during a show.
Each kernel grows larger when heated. The crisp snack can be sweet or salty. It is often sold in a movie theater.

examples.en: Bubble tea is popular among people of all ages.
examples.zh: 珍珠奶茶深受各年齡層民眾的喜愛。

examples.en: Japanese anime is immensely popular with teenagers across the globe.
examples.zh: 日本動漫在全世界的青少年族群中極受歡迎。

examples.en: Hiking Elephant Mountain has become a popular weekend fitness trend.
examples.zh: 攀登象山已經成為極為風靡的週末健身熱門風尚。

explains.en: Many people like this thing or person. A song may be heard by lots of listeners. It can also mean well liked by a group.
A well liked singer may have many fans. A store can be busy because many shoppers like it. This word describes something many people enjoy.
This word describes a thing lots of people choose. A game may be played by many children. A singer with many fans has this quality.

examples.en: Is it possible to finish this work today?
examples.zh: 今天有可能完成這項工作嗎？

examples.en: It is possible that the bus will be late.
examples.zh: 公車有可能會晚到。

examples.en: A quiet room makes it possible to study well.
examples.zh: 安靜的房間讓人可以好好讀書。

explains.en: It means something can happen or be done. A door may be able to open. A person may have a way to solve a problem.
Use this word when an outcome may happen. A child can learn a new skill. The result is not certain, but it can occur.
This word tells that an idea could work. A team may finish a task in time. It describes something that can be done.

examples.en: Put the beef chunks into the hot pot to simmer.
examples.zh: 把牛肉塊放入熱湯鍋中慢火燉煮。

examples.en: She planted colorful petunias in a large ceramic flower pot.
examples.zh: 她在大陶花盆裡栽種了色彩繽紛的矮牽牛。

examples.en: Keep the heavy lid firmly on the pot while cooking rice.
examples.zh: 煮飯時請將厚重的鍋蓋緊緊蓋在鍋子上。

explains.en: A cook uses this deep container to heat soup. It often has a handle on each side. A flower may grow in one made from clay.
This container can hold water or food. It may sit on a stove. A gardener can use a small one for a flower.
A kitchen has this item for cooking. It is deeper than a plate. A clay one can hold soil and a plant.

examples.en: Mashed potatoes go well with roast chicken.
examples.zh: 馬鈴薯泥與烤雞非常搭。

examples.en: Baked potatoes topped with sour cream are delicious.
examples.zh: 淋上酸奶醬的烤馬鈴薯美味可口。

examples.en: Farmers harvest fresh potatoes from the soil in autumn.
examples.zh: 農夫們在秋天從泥土裡採收新鮮的馬鈴薯。

explains.en: This vegetable grows under the ground and stores food for the plant. Its skin may be brown, red, or yellow. The inside is often white or yellow.
People can bake, boil, or mash this food. Thin pieces can be cooked to make chips. Long pieces can be used to make fries.
A farmer digs into the soil to collect this crop. The part we eat is a thick piece of stem that grows underground. Small spots on its surface can grow into new shoots.

examples.en: The sudden storm caused a power outage in the village.
examples.zh: 突如其來的暴風雨造成村莊停電。

examples.en: Taiwan is actively investing in offshore wind and solar power.
examples.zh: 台灣正積極投資離岸風電與太陽能發電。

examples.en: Knowledge is power that enables individuals to overcome life challenges.
examples.zh: 知識就是力量，賦予人們克服人生挑戰的能力。

explains.en: It can mean the strength to do work. Electricity gives a lamp energy. A person may have the right to make a choice.
A storm may knock out the electricity in a home. A strong person may lift a heavy box. The word can also mean control or authority.
A machine needs energy to run. A leader may have control over a group. The word can describe strength or the right to act.

examples.en: Good Clinical Practice guidelines safeguard human rights and ensure data integrity worldwide.
examples.zh: 國際「藥品優良臨床試驗規範」（Good Clinical Practice GCP），在全球範圍內捍衛受試者權益與數據真實性。

examples.en: Daily piano practice helps young musicians develop finger agility and musical sensitivity.
examples.zh: 堅持不懈的每日鋼琴指法練習，能協助年輕琴童奠定敏捷的指尖觸鍵技巧與細膩音樂感受力。

examples.en: Sustainable farming practices preserve rich topsoil and prevent nutrient runoff into waterways.
examples.zh: 採用環境永續的友善農耕實踐工法，能長效涵養表土有機質並避免化肥營養過度流失沖刷入河流。

entries.definition: 國際藥品優良臨床試驗規範 (GCP 標準)；實踐

explains.en: Doing the same skill many times can help a person improve. A student may repeat a song each day. The word can also mean a way of doing something.
A team may work on a skill before a match. Repeating an action can make it easier. The word can also name a usual habit.
A person may train many times to get better. A doctor can work in a clinic as a job. The same word can mean the act of using a skill.

examples.en: We need to prepare food for the guests.
examples.zh: 我們需要為客人準備食物。

examples.en: The students prepared for the big test.
examples.zh: 學生們為大型考試做準備。

examples.en: Dad is preparing dinner in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 爸爸正在廚房準備晚餐。

explains.en: It means getting things ready for an event. A student may gather books before class. A cook may wash vegetables before dinner.
Use this word when making ready for something. A family may pack before a trip. A person may think about what to say before a talk.
This action means arranging what is needed ahead of time. A team may get tools ready. A cook may make food before guests arrive.

examples.en: Every team member must present their ideas today.
examples.zh: 每位團隊成員今天都必須發表自己的想法。

examples.en: Only eight members were present at the morning roll call.
examples.zh: 早晨點名時只有八名成員出席。

examples.en: He bought a wonderful birthday present for his wife.
examples.zh: 他為妻子買了一份很棒的生日禮物。

explains.en: It can mean happening now. A person may also give a gift to someone. As a verb, it can mean showing work to a group.
A child may give a card to a friend. A speaker can show a report to the class. The same word may describe the time at this moment.
This word can name a gift. It may also describe a person who is here now. As an action, it means showing something to others.

examples.en: This English reading passage is pretty easy to understand.
examples.zh: 這篇英語閱讀文章相當容易理解。

examples.en: The coastal village looked pretty under the golden glow of twilight.
examples.zh: 在金色暮光的映照下，這座濱海漁村顯得格外秀麗迷人。

examples.en: I am doing pretty well on my university coursework this semester.
examples.zh: 我這學期在大學課業上的表現相當不錯。

explains.en: It can mean pleasing to look at. A flower may have a lovely shape. It can also mean fairly or very, as in a small amount.
A person may wear a lovely dress. A view can be nice to see. This word can also make an amount sound not too large.
This word may describe a person or thing that looks lovely. It can also mean fairly. A singer may have a sweet voice.

examples.en: The price of this t-shirt is very reasonable.
examples.zh: 這件 T 恤的價格很合理。

examples.en: House prices in big cities have increased significantly.
examples.zh: 大城市的房價已經顯著上漲。

examples.en: Always check the price tag before making a purchase.
examples.zh: 購買前務必先看一下價格標籤。

explains.en: A shop shows how much money an item costs. A buyer may compare this amount at two stores. It can also mean setting the cost.
This amount tells what a person must pay. A label may show it on a toy. A store owner can choose how much an item should cost.
A buyer may ask how much an item costs. The money asked for is shown on a tag. As an action, the word means deciding the cost.

examples.en: It will probably rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
examples.zh: 今天下午很可能會下雨，所以出門記得帶傘。

examples.en: He is not answering his phone; he is probably driving on the highway right now.
examples.zh: 他一直沒接電話，現在這個時間點八成很可能正開車行駛在高速公路上。

examples.en: Learning a musical instrument is probably one of the most rewarding hobbies in life.
examples.zh: 學會演奏一門樂器，大概是人生中最能滋養心靈且最具成就感的美好嗜好之一。

explains.en: It means something is likely to happen. Dark clouds may mean rain will come. The speaker is not fully sure.
Use this word when an event seems likely. A bus may arrive soon. It shows a strong guess, not a sure fact.
This word describes something that may well be true. A team has a good chance to win. The result is still uncertain.

examples.en: No problem! I am always glad to help you.
examples.zh: 沒問題！我很樂意幫你的忙。

examples.en: Engineers worked tirelessly overnight to solve the technical network problem.
examples.zh: 工程師們整夜不眠不休地工作以解決網路技術難題。

examples.en: Climate change is a global problem requiring worldwide international collaboration.
examples.zh: 氣候變遷是需要全球各國攜手合作應對的世界級難題。

explains.en: It is something that is hard to solve. A math task may have a tricky answer. It can also mean a matter that needs care.
A broken toy can create a hard situation. A student may ask a teacher for help. The word can describe a question with no easy answer.
This word names something that causes trouble. A person may work to find an answer. It can also mean an issue people discuss.

examples.en: Public Television Service (PTS) produces high-quality educational programs.
examples.zh: 公共電視（PTS）製作許多高水準的教育節目。

examples.en: The community center offers an after-school tutoring program for kids.
examples.zh: 社區中心為學童開辦了豐富充實的課後課業輔導計畫課程。

examples.en: Engineers program microcontrollers to regulate smart home appliances automatically.
examples.zh: 工程師編寫微控制器程式，以全自動調控智慧居家各類電器。

examples.en: Collectors cherish the souvenir program containing cast autographs, costume sketches, and lyrics.
examples.zh: 許多資深戲迷特地珍藏這本精裝紀念節目冊，裡面收錄了主演親筆簽名、服裝設計手稿與完整歌詞。

examples.en: Volunteers distributed printed performance programs to patrons arriving at the concert hall doors.
examples.zh: 親切的青年藝文志工在音樂廳各大檢票入口處，主動向每位持票進場的愛樂朋友發放精美的演出場刊。

examples.en: The cultural center announced an exciting autumn program of experimental dance and choral concerts.
examples.zh: 市立文化中心正式公布了本季精彩紛呈的秋季系列節目檔期，涵蓋先鋒實驗當代舞與大型合唱管弦音樂會。

entries.definition: 節目；計畫；程式設計；演出精裝節目冊；場刊

explains.en: A TV show may have a set of parts for each day. A computer can also use a set of coded steps. The word can mean a list of events.
A theater may show a list of acts and songs. A computer follows written steps to do a task. A schedule for an event may also have this name.
This word can mean a show on TV or radio. It can also name coded steps used by a computer. A school may have a set of activities for a day.

examples.en: Parents are always proud of their children's achievements.
examples.zh: 父母總是為子女的成就感到無比自豪。

examples.en: The Olympic gold medalist felt proud to represent Taiwan on the global stage.
examples.zh: 奧運金牌得主為能在世界舞台上代表台灣而深感榮耀自豪。

examples.en: She stood tall with a proud smile as she received her college diploma.
examples.zh: 在領取大學畢業證書時，她昂首挺胸、臉上洋溢著自豪的笑容。

explains.en: A person may feel happy about doing a hard task well. A parent may smile at a child’s work. The word can also mean acting too sure of oneself.
This feeling can come after reaching a goal. A team may feel good about a win. It can also describe someone who thinks too highly of themselves.
A student may feel this after finishing a project. A family may share joy in one another’s work. The word can also describe too much self regard.

examples.en: The library is open to the public.
examples.zh: 圖書館對大眾開放。

examples.en: She works for a public school in town.
examples.zh: 她在鎮上的公立學校工作。

examples.en: The public park closes at sunset.
examples.zh: 公園在日落時關閉。

entries.definition: （形）公共的；公開的；（名）民眾；大眾

explains.en: It means open for everyone to use or see. A library serves the whole town. It can also mean related to the government.
A park is open to people in a town. A meeting may let anyone attend. The word can also describe a service run by the government.
This word describes something shared by the whole community. A road can be used by all drivers. News may be shared for everyone to see.

examples.en: Pull the handle gently toward yourself.
examples.zh: 朝自己的方向輕輕拉手把。

examples.en: He pulled a stack of old documents out of the wooden desk drawer.
examples.zh: 他從木製書桌抽屜裡拉出了一疊舊文件。

examples.en: The dentist had to pull the patient's infected wisdom tooth.
examples.zh: 牙醫不得不將該名病患發炎感染的智齒拔除。

explains.en: It means using force to bring something closer. A person may move a chair toward them. A rope can help with this action.
A child may move a wagon by holding its handle. A door can be opened this way. It may also mean attracting someone toward an idea.
This action brings an object nearer. A person can use a string to move a toy. It can also describe drawing a crowd.

examples.en: Push the door to open it.
examples.zh: 推門即可打開。

examples.en: Parents push baby strollers gently through the neighborhood park.
examples.zh: 父母親推著嬰兒車輕輕漫步在社區公園裡。

examples.en: A good coach pushes athletes to challenge their own limits.
examples.zh: 優秀的教練會激勵運動員挑戰自我極限。

explains.en: It means using force to move something away. A person may move a door shut with a hand. A button can make a message go to a friend.
A child may move a toy car across the floor with a hand. A person may move a box away from them. The word can describe encouraging change too.
This action sends something away from the body. A person may move a cart forward. It can also mean making someone accept an idea.

examples.en: Please put the book on the shelf.
examples.zh: 請把書放在架子上。

examples.en: Put your shoes by the door.
examples.zh: 把你的鞋子放在門邊。

examples.en: She put the letter in her bag.
examples.zh: 她把信放進包包裡。

explains.en: It means placing something in a spot. A child may set a cup on a table. It can also mean writing words on paper.
Use this word when setting an item somewhere. A person may place books on a shelf. It can also mean making a choice.
This action can mean moving an object to a place. A worker may set tools in a box. It can also mean saying something in a certain way.

examples.en: One quarter of the cake is gone.
examples.zh: 四分之一的蛋糕不見了。

examples.en: The lesson lasts for a quarter of an hour.
examples.zh: 這堂課持續十五分鐘。

examples.en: He paid with a quarter at the store.
examples.zh: 他在商店用一枚二十五分硬幣付款。

entries.definition: 四分之一；一刻鐘；（美國、加拿大）二十五分硬幣；區域

explains.en: This means one of four equal parts. Cut a sandwich into four pieces of the same size. Each piece is this share of the whole.
Fifteen minutes is this part of an hour. Four groups of fifteen minutes make sixty minutes. A clock can help you see these equal parts.
In the United States, a coin worth twenty-five cents has this name. Four of these coins make one dollar. Two of them make fifty cents.

examples.en: The queen waved to the people.
examples.zh: 女王向民眾揮手。

examples.en: The chess queen can move in many directions.
examples.zh: 西洋棋的皇后可以往許多方向移動。

examples.en: The young queen lived in a large castle.
examples.zh: 年輕的女王住在一座大城堡裡。

explains.en: A woman who rules a kingdom has this title. She may wear a crown. The word can also mean the strongest piece in a game of chess.
A king’s wife may have this royal title. A person in this role may live in a palace. In chess, the most powerful piece has the same name.
This royal leader may rule a country. A crown is often a sign of the role. A chess player can move a powerful piece with this title.

examples.en: Does anyone have any question about this grammar rule?
examples.zh: 有人對這個文法規則有任何疑問嗎？

examples.en: Remember to put a question mark at the end of every question sentence.
examples.zh: 記得在每個疑問句句末加上問號。

examples.en: The interviewers asked several thought-provoking questions about his leadership experience.
examples.zh: 面試官針對他的領導經驗提出了幾個發人深省的問題。

explains.en: A person asks this to get information. It may begin with who, what, or where. A mark shaped like a hook and dot goes at the end in writing.
A teacher may ask one during class. It can help someone learn a fact. Written words often end with a curved mark and a dot.
This is a sentence that asks for an answer. A child may raise a hand to ask one. It can also mean doubt about something.

examples.en: The quick rabbit ran across the grass.
examples.zh: 那隻動作敏捷的兔子跑過草地。

examples.en: We ate a quick lunch before class.
examples.zh: 上課前我們快速吃了午餐。

examples.en: She gave me a quick answer.
examples.zh: 她很快地回答我。

explains.en: It means happening in a short time. A runner may move with great speed. It can also describe a meal that takes little time to make.
A child can run with great speed. A short answer may come soon. This word can describe something that does not take long.
This word means fast. A car may go along a road in little time. A simple meal can be ready soon.

examples.en: Please be quiet while studying in the library.
examples.zh: 在圖書館讀書時請保持安靜。

examples.en: We spent a quiet afternoon sipping tea in the yard.
examples.zh: 我們在院子裡喝茶度過了一個寧靜祥和的下午。

examples.en: She is a quiet girl who prefers reading over talking.
examples.zh: 她是個文靜的女孩，比起聊天更喜歡看書。

explains.en: It describes a place with little sound. A child may sit and read without noise. It can also mean calm and still.
A library asks visitors to keep their voices low. A lake may have no waves. This word tells that a place is peaceful.
This word means not noisy. A person may speak softly in a room. It can also describe someone who does not talk much.

examples.en: The weather in Hualien is quite pleasant today.
examples.zh: 花蓮今天的天氣相當宜人舒適。

examples.en: That math problem was quite difficult, but she solved it independently.
examples.zh: 那道數學題目相當困難，但她獨自一人解開了它。

examples.en: There were quite a few enthusiastic international tourists visiting the museum.
examples.zh: 有相當多熱情的外國觀光客前來參觀這座博物館。

explains.en: It means fairly or to a great degree. A person may feel fairly sure about an answer. It can also mean completely in some phrases.
Use this word to make a describing word stronger. A bag may be fairly heavy. It can sometimes mean fully.
This word may mean very or fairly. It can make a statement sound strong. In some cases, it means fully or entirely.

examples.en: Rabbits love munching on crisp carrots and lettuce.
examples.zh: 兔子喜歡啃食香脆的胡蘿蔔和生菜。

examples.en: The fluffy white rabbit hopped swiftly into its underground burrow.
examples.zh: 毛茸茸的白兔靈巧迅速地跳進了地下地洞。

examples.en: According to the Chinese zodiac, the Rabbit symbolizes gentleness and peace.
examples.zh: 在十二生肖中，兔象徵著溫和與和平。

explains.en: This small animal has long ears and soft fur. It can hop across a field. It likes to eat plants.
A child may keep this animal as a pet. Its back legs help it jump. It may live in a burrow.
This animal has a short tail and a soft coat. It eats leaves and grass. Its ears can stand up or fall down.

examples.en: The children had a race around the field.
examples.zh: 孩子們繞著操場賽跑。

examples.en: Our school will race against the next town.
examples.zh: 我們學校將和隔壁城鎮比賽。

examples.en: The human race has lived on Earth for a long time.
examples.zh: 人類在地球上生活了很久。

entries.definition: （名）比賽；人種；人類；（動）參賽；飛奔

explains.en: Two or more teams may try to reach a goal before the others. A runner can move fast in such an event. The word can also mean a group of people with shared family roots.
A contest may ask who can finish first. People can run, swim, or drive in it. The word can also describe groups of humans by family history.
This event tests speed. A person may compete on foot. The word can also refer to the human family or a group with shared background.

examples.en: My grandfather listens to the morning radio news.
examples.zh: 我爺爺收聽早晨廣播新聞。

examples.en: We tuned the car radio to our favorite music station during the drive.
examples.zh: 行車途中我們將車用收音機轉到了最喜愛的音樂電台。

examples.en: Emergency radio broadcasts provide vital typhoon alerts to citizens.
examples.zh: 緊急廣播為民眾提供了至關重要的颱風警報資訊。

explains.en: This device receives signals and changes them into sound. People use it to listen to music and news. Many cars have one built in.
You can choose a station to hear a program. One station may play songs while another has people talking. A small set can run on batteries.
People can send messages by using special waves that travel through space. These waves can carry voices over long distances. The receiving device turns the signals into sounds we can hear.

examples.en: It started to rain in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午開始下雨了。

examples.en: Heavy rain caused flash flooding on some low-lying streets.
examples.zh: 豪大雨導致部分低窪街道發生積水。

examples.en: Plants grow quickly after receiving fresh spring rain.
examples.zh: 植物在接受了春雨滋潤後迅速生長。

explains.en: Water falls from clouds onto the ground. People carry umbrellas to stay dry. This word can also mean water coming down in drops.
Dark clouds may bring drops of water. A wet day can make roads shiny. Farmers need this water for crops.
This is water that falls from the sky. A roof may make a tapping sound when drops hit it. People may wait inside during a heavy shower.

examples.en: A magnificent rainbow appeared after the afternoon rain shower.
examples.zh: 午後陣雨過後天空中出現了一道壯麗彩虹。

examples.en: Look at the vibrant double rainbow arching over the misty valley!
examples.zh: 快看那道跨越雲霧繚繞山谷的絢麗雙彩虹！

examples.en: Children love drawing bright rainbows with seven colored wax crayons.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡用七彩蠟筆在畫紙上畫出燦爛美麗的彩虹。

examples.en: Legend says our departed furry angels play joyfully across the Rainbow Bridge without any pain.
examples.zh: 傳說所有離世的毛孩天使都會前往美麗無憂的彩虹橋彼端（Rainbow Bridge），在青草地上健康奔跑。

examples.en: A rainbow appeared in the quiet sky on the very afternoon we laid our faithful companion to rest.
examples.zh: 就在我們送走相伴多年的忠誠老狗的那天午後，雨過天晴的天空中悄然浮現了一道燦爛彩虹。

examples.en: The Rainbow Bridge poem brings profound solace to heartbroken pet parents during times of grief.
examples.zh: 膾炙人口的「彩虹橋之約」詩篇，在哀悼期為無數心碎的毛孩父母帶來了深刻無比的心靈慰藉。

explains.en: It is a colorful arc that may appear after a storm. Sunlight shines through tiny drops in the air. People can see red, yellow, green, and blue bands.
The sky may show this curved band after wet weather. It has many colors. It appears when sunlight meets drops of water.
This bright curve can show up while the sun is out and rain is falling. It has colors in a set order. Many children enjoy looking for one.

examples.en: Keelung is famous for its rainy days.
examples.zh: 基隆以多雨的天氣聞名。

examples.en: I enjoy staying indoors with a good book on rainy afternoons.
examples.zh: 在多雨的午後，我喜歡待在室內讀一本好書。

examples.en: Drivers should slow down and maintain extra distance on rainy days.
examples.zh: 雨天開車時駕駛人應減速慢行並保持安全車距。

explains.en: It describes a day with falling water from clouds. A person may bring an umbrella. The ground may become wet.
A forecast can use this word for weather with showers. People may wear boots outside. Clouds often cover the sky.
This word means full of rain. A gray sky may bring wet streets. Plants can grow well after such weather.

examples.en: Hardworking employees negotiated a 5% salary raise during appraisal.
examples.zh: 辛勤付出的員工在年度績效考核時爭取到了 5% 的調薪幅度。

examples.en: Raise your hand politely if you have a question during the presentation.
examples.zh: 簡報發表進行期間若有任何疑問，請先禮貌性地舉手示意提問。

examples.en: My loving grandparents worked tirelessly on the tea farm to raise four children.
examples.zh: 慈祥辛勞的祖父母早年在茶山茶園裡日曬雨淋、揮汗勞作，拉拔撫養了四個子女成才。

explains.en: It means moving something higher. A child may lift a hand in class. A company may also give a worker more money.
A person can lift a box from the floor. A teacher may move a flag up a pole. It can also mean caring for a child as they grow.
This action moves something upward. A family can care for a child from a young age. A manager may increase a worker’s pay.

examples.en: We finally reached our mountain cabin before sunset.
examples.zh: 我們終於在日落前抵達了山間小屋。

examples.en: Can you reach the top shelf to hand me that ceramic bowl?
examples.zh: 你夠得到最頂層的架子幫我拿下那個瓷碗嗎？

examples.en: The company aims to reach one million active users by year end.
examples.zh: 該公司的目標是在今年底前達成一百萬名活躍用戶大關。

examples.en: Organic social reach has declined due to algorithm updates.
examples.zh: 受到演算法頻繁調整影響，社群媒體粉專的免費自然觸及人數有所下滑。

examples.en: Paid advertising campaigns can help local restaurants reach diners across the entire metropolitan area.
examples.zh: 策略性投放社群付費廣告，能有效協助在地特色餐飲名店觸及橫跨整座大都會區的潛在老饕食客。

examples.en: The charity foundation aims to reach at-risk youth in remote rural schools with educational supplies.
examples.zh: 該慈善基金會立下宏願，致力於將充足的愛心課外學習物資全面觸及送達偏遠偏鄉學校的弱勢學童手中。

entries.definition: 到達；伸出；伸手可及之處；觸及人數；觸及範圍；接觸到

explains.en: It means arriving at a place. A hand may stretch toward a high shelf. The word can also describe how many people a message touches.
A traveler may come to a town after a long trip. A person may stretch out an arm to touch something. It can also mean having an effect on many listeners.
This word means getting to a goal. A child may extend a hand toward a toy. It can describe the farthest point someone can touch.

examples.en: I love to read English novels before bed.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在睡前閱讀英文小說。

examples.en: The teacher asked the students to read the dialogue aloud.
examples.zh: 老師要求學生們大聲朗讀這段對話。

examples.en: I read an inspiring article about marine conservation in today's paper.
examples.zh: 我在今天的報紙上讀到了一篇關於海洋保育的鼓舞人心的文章。

explains.en: This action means looking at written words and understanding them. A child follows the words in a storybook. The story becomes clear in the child’s mind.
This action can also involve saying written words aloud. A parent speaks the words on a page. A younger child listens to the story.
This can mean understanding information shown by something. A person looks at a clock. Its hands tell the person what time it is.

examples.en: Are you ready for the big sports match?
examples.zh: 你為那場大型體育比賽做好準備了嗎？

examples.en: Dinner is ready; please wash your hands and come to the table.
examples.zh: 晚餐準備好了，請洗洗手過來餐桌用餐。

examples.en: The rescue team stands ready to respond to natural disaster emergencies.
examples.zh: 搜救隊伍隨時嚴陣以待，迅速應對各類自然災害緊急情勢。

explains.en: It means prepared for something. A child may have shoes by the door. A meal can also be available to eat.
Use this word for a person who can begin now. A bag may be packed for a trip. It can also describe food made to eat.
This word tells that someone is set to start. A team may wait for a signal. It may describe a thing that can be used now.

examples.en: True friends show real care during difficult times.
examples.zh: 真正的朋友會在困難時期展現真誠關懷。

examples.en: Is that shimmering jewel made of real diamonds or synthetic glass?
examples.zh: 那顆閃閃發光的珠寶是真鑽還是合成玻璃？

examples.en: Reading literature gives readers profound insight into real human life.
examples.zh: 閱讀文學作品能讓讀者深刻洞察真實的人生百態。

explains.en: It describes something that is not pretend. A true story tells what happened. It can also mean someone sincere.
A living animal is not a toy. A person may give an honest answer. This word can mean actual or genuine.
This word tells that something truly exists. It may describe a sincere feeling. It can also mean actual rather than imagined.

examples.en: I really appreciate your timely help.
examples.zh: 我真的很感謝你及時的幫忙。

examples.en: It is really hot and humid outside today, so drink plenty of water.
examples.zh: 今天外面真的很熱很潮濕，所以要多喝水。

examples.en: Did you really finish that five-hundred-page novel in two days?
examples.zh: 你真的在兩天內讀完了那本五百頁的小說嗎？

explains.en: It means truly or in fact. A person may use it to show surprise. It can make a statement stronger.
Use this word when something is true. A child may be very happy about a gift. It can show that a speaker is sure.
This word can mean in truth. A friend may say it to show strong feeling. It can also make an idea sound more certain.

examples.en: What is the main reason for your school absence?
examples.zh: 你請假沒來上學的主要原因是什麼？

examples.en: For this reason, doctors strongly recommend washing hands regularly.
examples.zh: 基於這個原因，醫生強烈建議必須勤加洗手。

examples.en: He gave a logical, convincing reason for adjusting the project timeline.
examples.zh: 他為調整專案時程表提出了合乎邏輯且令人信服的理由。

explains.en: It tells why something happened. A child may give an explanation for being late. It can also mean the ability to think clearly.
A person may ask why a door is open. The answer can be this. It may also mean careful thought.
This word means an explanation or cause. A teacher may ask for one in class. It can also name good thinking.

examples.en: The traffic light turned red, so we stopped.
examples.zh: 紅綠燈變紅燈了，所以我們停了下來。

examples.en: She wore a bright red coat that stood out in the snow.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件亮紅色的外套，在雪地中格外顯眼。

examples.en: Red apples taste sweet and crisp in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天的紅蘋果吃起來又甜又脆。

explains.en: This color is like the skin of a ripe tomato. It may be dark or light. It is one of the main colors in a rainbow.
A stop sign has this bright color. Strawberries may have the same shade. A person may wear a shirt of this color.
This is the color of many apples. It is made by mixing light from certain parts of the rainbow. A warm face may show this shade.

examples.en: We visited all our relatives during Chinese New Year.
examples.zh: 我們在農曆新年期間拜訪了所有的親戚。

examples.en: Close relatives gathered from across the island for my grandfather's ninetieth birthday.
examples.zh: 至親親屬從全台各地齊聚一堂慶祝我祖父的九十大壽。

examples.en: The cost of living in southern Taiwan is relatively lower than in Taipei.
examples.zh: 南台灣的生活物價開銷相較於台北而言相對較為親民。

explains.en: An aunt or cousin belongs to the same family group. It can also mean connected to a topic. A person in this group may live far away.
A family member has this relationship to someone else. One idea can be linked to another. The word can also compare one thing with a different thing.
This word can describe a family connection. It may also mean linked to a topic. A cousin is one example of this kind of person.

examples.en: Remember to turn off the lights before leaving.
examples.zh: 離開前記得要關燈。

examples.en: I still clearly remember the first time I traveled abroad with my family.
examples.zh: 我依然清晰記得第一次和家人出國旅遊的情景。

examples.en: Please remember me warmly to your lovely parents when you visit home.
examples.zh: 你回家探親時請代我向你親愛的雙親致上由衷的問候。

explains.en: It means keeping an idea in your mind. A person may know where they left a key. It can also mean bringing a past event back to thought.
Use this word when you do not forget someone or something. A child may keep a birthday in mind. It can also mean sending kind thoughts to another person.
This action means holding facts in the mind. A photo may help bring back an old day. A person may ask someone to send greetings.

examples.en: CRISPR clustered regularly interspaced repeats originated as a bacterial adaptive immune system.
examples.zh: 「CRISPR 規律間隔重複序列」（CRISPR Repeats），源自細菌用來抵禦並摧毀外來噬菌體病毒的免疫武器。

examples.en: The music teacher asked the choir to repeat the chorus until their harmonies sounded perfectly balanced.
examples.zh: 合唱團指導老師要求團員反覆重唱副歌段落，直到各聲部的和聲達到無瑕的和諧平衡。

examples.en: The television network scheduled a prime-time repeat of the critically acclaimed documentary series.
examples.zh: 電視台特別在黃金時段安排重播該部深獲各界口碑讚譽的旗艦人文紀錄片影集。

entries.definition: 規律間隔重複短回文序列 (CRISPR 基因剪刀)；重複

explains.en: It means doing or saying something again. A teacher may ask a student to try once more. The same word can name a set of events that happens again and again.
A singer may do a song again for the audience. A child can tell a story one more time. It can also mean saying what another person just said.
This action happens another time. A class may work on a sound many times. The noun can mean a pattern that returns.

examples.en: Please submit your quarterly sales report by Friday.
examples.zh: 請在週五前提交你的季度銷售報告。

examples.en: The weather report predicts heavy rain this afternoon.
examples.zh: 天氣預報預測今天下午會有大雨。

examples.en: He reported the stolen bicycle to the local police.
examples.zh: 他向當地警方通報了腳踏車失竊一事。

explains.en: A written account may tell what happened at a meeting. A journalist may share news. The word can also mean telling someone about a problem.
A student may write this for class. It can describe facts from a trip. As a verb, it means giving information to a person in charge.
This word can mean a written summary. A TV worker may share news from a place. A person may tell a manager about an issue.

examples.en: The reporter asked the singer about her new song.
examples.zh: 記者詢問歌手關於她新歌的事。

examples.en: A reporter shared the news from the town hall.
examples.zh: 記者分享了市政廳的消息。

examples.en: The young reporter wrote about the school concert.
examples.zh: 那位年輕記者報導了學校音樂會。

explains.en: A person who gathers news for a newspaper or TV show has this job. The worker may ask questions. They share facts with others.
This worker may write stories about events. A camera operator may work nearby. The job includes finding out what happened.
A newspaper may have this person on its staff. The worker talks with witnesses. Then the story is shared with readers or viewers.

examples.en: You need plenty of bed rest to recover quickly.
examples.zh: 你需要多臥床休息以迅速康復。

examples.en: Take a five-minute rest after studying continuously for an hour.
examples.zh: 連續專注研讀一小時後，請休息五分鐘。

examples.en: We will finish reviewing the rest of the project slides tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我們明天早晨會把剩餘的專案投影片全部檢視完畢。

examples.en: The doctor advised me to get bed rest for three full days.
examples.zh: 醫生建議我必須臥床充分靜養整整三天。

examples.en: Let's rest our tired legs on that wooden park bench for a moment.
examples.zh: 我們在那張公園木椅上讓疲累的雙腿休息片刻吧。

examples.en: You eat this sandwich, and I will pack the rest of the picnic food.
examples.zh: 你吃這份三明治，我來收拾其餘的野餐食物。

entries.definition: 休息；其餘的人事物；靜養；其餘

explains.en: It means taking a break from work. A tired person may sit down for a while. It can also refer to what is left after some things are taken away.
A person may sleep to regain energy. The word can also mean the remaining part of a group. A hand may lie gently on a table.
This word may describe a calm break. The remaining food can be saved for later. As a verb, it means lying on something for support.

examples.en: This restaurant serves delicious seafood.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳供應美味的海鮮。

examples.en: We celebrated Dad's birthday at a fancy Italian restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們在一家高級義大利餐廳慶祝爸爸的生日。

examples.en: The restaurant is always crowded during weekend dinner hours.
examples.zh: 這間餐廳在週末晚餐時段總是高朋滿座。

explains.en: People go here to buy a meal. A cook prepares food in the kitchen. A waiter brings it to the table.
A family may choose a place to eat dinner. The menu shows what is available. Guests sit down and order food.
This business serves meals to customers. People may meet friends there. Someone working there may bring drinks and dishes.

examples.en: Fried rice is very popular in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 炒飯在台灣非常受歡迎。

examples.en: Rice is the staple food for most people in Asia.
examples.zh: 米飯是多數亞洲人的主食。

examples.en: Would you like another bowl of steamed rice?
examples.zh: 你想要再來一碗白飯嗎？

explains.en: These small grains are cooked in water. Many families eat them with dinner. They grow in wet fields.
A farmer grows this food plant in flooded land. Its grains can be white or brown. A bowl may be served with vegetables.
People in many countries eat these cooked grains. They come from a grass-like plant. A person may use chopsticks to eat a bowl.

examples.en: Taiwan is rich in diverse fruits and delicious snacks.
examples.zh: 台灣富含多樣的水果和美味小吃。

examples.en: He became rich through decades of hard work and investments.
examples.zh: 他經過數十年的辛勤工作與投資致富。

examples.en: Dark chocolate has a rich, deep, and satisfying flavor.
examples.zh: 黑巧克力具有濃郁、深沉且令人滿足的風味。

explains.en: It means having a lot of money or valuable things. It can also describe food with a deep, strong taste. A place may have many plants or animals.
A person with many possessions may have this quality. Chocolate can have a full flavor. The word may also mean full of useful things.
This word can mean having great wealth. A sauce may taste deep and full. A story can have many details.

examples.en: Children love to ride bikes in the yard.
examples.zh: 小朋友們喜歡在院子裡騎腳踏車。

examples.en: Can you give me a ride to the train station tomorrow?
examples.zh: 你明天可以順路載我一程去火車站嗎？

examples.en: He learned how to ride a horse during summer camp.
examples.zh: 他在夏令營期間學會了騎馬。

explains.en: It means sitting on an animal or bicycle and moving along. A person may travel in a car or bus. The same word can name a short trip.
A child may travel on a horse. A family can go in a car to town. This word may also mean a journey in a vehicle.
A person can sit on a bike and travel. People may go in a bus together. The action can also describe moving on a horse.

examples.en: The post office is on your right.
examples.zh: 郵局就在你的右手邊。

examples.en: You got all the answers right on today's vocabulary quiz.
examples.zh: 你在今天的單字小考中答對了所有題目。

examples.en: Everyone has the right to receive a good quality education.
examples.zh: 人人都有享有優質教育的權利。

examples.en: You gave the right answer to that question!
examples.zh: 你回答了那個問題的正確答案！

examples.en: Turn right at the convenience store to reach the train station.
examples.zh: 在便利商店處向右轉即可抵達火車站。

examples.en: Everyone has the fundamental human right to receive free education.
examples.zh: 每個人都享有接受基本免費教育的人權權利。

examples.en: Every child has the basic human right to receive free education.
examples.zh: 每個孩童都享有接受免費教育的基本人權權利。

examples.en: Double-check your calculation to ensure you have the right total answer.
examples.zh: 請再次仔細核算確認算式，以確保你計算出的最終總額答案完全正確。

examples.en: Turn right at the convenience store and walk straight for two blocks.
examples.zh: 在那家便利商店路口右轉，接著筆直向前步行兩個街區即達。

entries.definition: 右邊的；正確的；權利；向右；右邊

explains.en: It can mean the side opposite the left. It may also describe an answer that is correct. A person can have a freedom to do something.
A hand on one side is often used for writing. A good answer is not wrong. The word can also name something a person is allowed to do.
This word can describe a true answer. It can mean the direction opposite left. A law may protect a freedom people have.

examples.en: She wore a gold ring on her finger.
examples.zh: 她手指上戴著一枚金戒指。

examples.en: The phone began to ring during dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐時電話開始響起。

examples.en: A silver ring lay inside the small box.
examples.zh: 一枚銀戒指放在小盒子裡。

entries.definition: （名）戒指；環狀物；（動）響鈴；打電話。

explains.en: A small circle of metal can be worn on a finger. A phone may make a sound when someone calls. The word can also mean putting a circle around something.
A wedding band is worn on a hand. A bell may make a clear sound. As an action, this word can mean making a telephone sound.
This round item may have a jewel. A phone makes a tone to show a call. A person may draw a circle around an answer.

examples.en: Managing a steadily declining rate of rise (RoR) avoids baking the beans and ensures lively cup acidity.
examples.zh: 精準掌控平穩下降的升溫速率曲線，能避免把豆子烤平並鎖住活潑明亮果酸。

examples.en: A sudden spike in the rate of rise near first crack can scorch bean exteriors, causing harsh bitterness.
examples.zh: 一爆前後升溫速率曲線若發生突發反彈飆升，會直接燙傷豆表並產生令人難受的焦苦雜味。

examples.en: Experienced roasters read subtle changes in RoR to anticipate thermal momentum shifts inside the drum.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的烘豆師敏銳洞察 RoR 升溫斜率的微小起伏，提前調整瓦斯風門以掌控鍋爐熱動能。

entries.definition: 烘焙升溫速率曲線 (Rate of Rise RoR)；上升

explains.en: It means moving upward. The sun appears higher in the sky each morning. Bread dough can grow larger before baking.
A person may stand up from a chair. Water can go higher in a glass. This word can also mean becoming more important.
This action moves from a lower place to a higher one. Prices may go up over time. A person can get up from bed.

examples.en: The Keelung River flows through Taipei City.
examples.zh: 基隆河流經台北市。

examples.en: Many people enjoy riding bicycles along the scenic river bank.
examples.zh: 許多人喜歡沿著風景秀麗的河岸騎腳踏車。

examples.en: Dragon boats raced fiercely on the calm river during the festival.
examples.zh: 節慶期間，龍舟在平靜的河面上展開激烈競渡。

explains.en: A long stream of water flows across land toward a lake or sea. Fish may live in it. People can travel along it by boat.
Water moves from hills toward lower land. A bridge may cross it. Its path can pass through a town.
This natural waterway may be wide or narrow. Rain and small streams feed it. It flows toward a larger body of water.

examples.en: Be cautious of motorcycles when crossing the road.
examples.zh: 過馬路時請當心機車。

examples.en: We embarked on an unforgettable scenic road trip along the east coast.
examples.zh: 我們踏上了一趟沿著東海岸令人難忘的公路之旅。

examples.en: The road to achieving mastery requires persistent dedication.
examples.zh: 通往精通熟練的道路需要堅持不懈的投入。

explains.en: Cars and buses travel along this paved path. People walk beside it on a sidewalk. It connects one place with another.
A driver follows this way to reach a town. A sign may show its name. It can pass through a city or countryside.
This path is made for cars and other vehicles. A person may cross it at a marked place. It links homes, shops, and towns.

examples.en: Therapeutic AI seal robots purr and respond to pats, reducing agitation among Alzheimer's nursing home residents.
examples.zh: 柔軟毛茸茸的 AI 智慧陪伴海豹機器人，撫摸時會發出撒嬌聲，溫柔撫平失智長輩的焦躁不安。

examples.en: The modern assembly line utilizes high-precision robotic arms to weld automotive chassis around the clock.
examples.zh: 現代化智慧組裝生產線運用高精度機械手臂機器人，全天候不間斷進行車體底盤焊接。

examples.en: Delivery robots navigate university campuses autonomously to drop off takeout food packages at dormitory doors.
examples.zh: 外送無人機器人靈活穿梭於大學校園步道中，自主將外賣餐點精準送到宿舍門口。

entries.definition: AI 智慧陪伴療癒海豹機器人 (Paro)

explains.en: This machine can do tasks by following instructions. Some look like people or animals. A worker may use one in a factory.
A computer can control this machine. It may move boxes or help clean a room. Some are built to look like a person.
