This machine can move and act by itself after receiving directions. It may help people build cars. A toy version can walk or talk.

examples.en: The children skipped a flat rock across the lake.
examples.zh: 孩子們讓一塊扁石頭在湖面上打水漂。

examples.en: A rock fell from the hill onto the road.
examples.zh: 一塊石頭從山坡掉到路上。

examples.en: Their band plays rock music every Friday.
examples.zh: 他們的樂團每週五演奏搖滾樂。

explains.en: A hard piece of the earth can lie by a path. It may be small enough to hold. The word can also mean a style of music.
This material is found in mountains and on beaches. A person may skip a flat one over water. Loud electric guitars are used in a music style with this name.
A cliff is made from this hard earth material. A child may collect a smooth one. A band can perform a loud kind of music using electric guitars.

examples.en: Please roll the ball toward me.
examples.zh: 請把球滾向我。

examples.en: She rolled the dough into a long shape.
examples.zh: 她把麵團揉成長條狀。

examples.en: He ate a warm bread roll with soup.
examples.zh: 他喝湯時吃了一個熱麵包捲。

explains.en: A round object can move along while turning over and over. A ball does this as it travels down a hill. A wheel moves in a similar way.
You can wrap a sheet of paper around a pencil to make a tube. Each part of the sheet curves around the layer beneath it. A flat sheet becomes a long round shape.
As a noun, this can mean a small piece of bread for one person. A baker may make several together on a tray. People often cut one open to add butter or cheese.

examples.en: My bedroom is clean and bright.
examples.zh: 我的臥室乾淨又明亮。

examples.en: Please make sure there is enough room for everyone to sit.
examples.zh: 請確保有足夠的空間讓大家坐下。

examples.en: We booked a comfortable hotel room near the train station.
examples.zh: 我們在火車站附近預訂了一間舒適的飯店房間。

explains.en: People sleep or work in this part of a building. It may have a door and a window. A hotel lets guests stay in one.
A home has separate spaces for different uses. A bed may be inside one. A hotel guest may stay there for a night.
This enclosed area may hold a table or bed. People meet in it at home. A family may have several of these spaces.

examples.en: The tree has a deep root under the soil.
examples.zh: 那棵樹在土壤下有一條很深的根。

examples.en: A good question gets to the root of the problem.
examples.zh: 好問題能找出問題的根源。

examples.en: Carrots grow as roots beneath the ground.
examples.zh: 胡蘿蔔以根的形式長在地底下。

entries.definition: （名）根；根源；根本原因；（動）使生根；扎根

explains.en: A tree takes in water through this part below the ground. It can also mean the first source of an idea. Some vegetables grow beneath the soil.
This part holds a plant in the earth. It takes in water and food from the ground. A word may have a beginning source with this name.
A plant uses this part to stay in place. It can spread under the dirt. It may also mean the basic cause of a problem.

examples.en: The sailor tied the rope to the boat.
examples.zh: 水手把繩子綁在船上。

examples.en: We used a strong rope to pull the box.
examples.zh: 我們用一條堅固的繩子拉箱子。

examples.en: The climber held the rope tightly.
examples.zh: 攀岩者緊緊握著繩子。

explains.en: It is a thick cord made from twisted strands. People tie things with it. A climber may use one for safety.
This long strong cord can hold a boat. A person can tie a knot in it. Workers may use it to lift something heavy.
Many thin strands are twisted together to make this. It may help pull a bucket from a well. A sailor uses it to secure a boat.

examples.en: He gave his mother a red rose.
examples.zh: 他送給媽媽一朵紅玫瑰。

examples.en: A rose grew beside the garden gate.
examples.zh: 花園門旁長了一朵玫瑰。

examples.en: The pale rose dress matched her shoes.
examples.zh: 淡粉紅色的洋裝和她的鞋子很搭。

entries.definition: （名）玫瑰；薔薇；玫瑰色（淡粉紅色）。

explains.en: A flower with soft petals may grow on a bush. It can have a sweet smell. The name is also used for a color close to red.
This garden flower may have thorns on its stem. It is often given as a gift. A pale color like its petals shares its name.
A florist may place this flower in a vase. It can be red, white, or yellow. Its bush may have sharp points.

examples.en: The children sat around a round table.
examples.zh: 孩子們圍著一張圓桌坐著。

examples.en: The earth is almost round.
examples.zh: 地球幾乎是圓的。

examples.en: We played one round of the card game.
examples.zh: 我們玩了一回合紙牌遊戲。

entries.definition: （形）圓形的；（名）一輪；一回合；（副／介）環繞；（動）使成圓形

explains.en: It means shaped like a circle or ball. A wheel has this shape. It can also mean moving around something.
A ball is not flat or square. A person may draw a circle. This word can also describe going around a place.
This describing word means curved with no corners. A plate can have this shape. A game may have a turn called this.

examples.en: We sat in the front row at the show.
examples.zh: 我們坐在表演場地的前排。

examples.en: They rowed the boat across the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 他們划船穿過平靜的湖面。

examples.en: The two friends had a row about the game.
examples.zh: 兩位朋友為了比賽吵了一架。

explains.en: People sit side by side in this line at a theater. A canoe can also move using an oar. The same spelling has another sound and means an argument.
A table may hold things arranged from side to side. A person can move a boat through water with an oar. A loud disagreement can be called this too.
This word can mean a line of seats. A person in a boat may use an oar to move forward. It can also describe a serious disagreement.

examples.en: Students must follow the school and library rules.
examples.zh: 學生必須遵守學校和圖書館的規定。

examples.en: The golden rule of good friendship is treating others as you wish to be treated.
examples.zh: 深厚友誼的黃金法則就是以你希望被對待的方式去對待他人。

examples.en: The wise emperor ruled the ancient prosperous empire justly for forty years.
examples.zh: 英明的君主公正仁慈地統治了這座繁榮古帝國長達四十年。

explains.en: A class may have directions everyone must follow. A game has directions for how to play. A king may lead a country.
This instruction tells what is allowed. A teacher may set one for the class. As a verb, the word can mean governing a place.
People follow these directions in a game. A leader may govern a nation. A person may use a tool to measure a line.

examples.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
examples.zh: 用尺畫一條直線。

examples.en: She measured the length of the box with a thirty-centimeter ruler.
examples.zh: 她用一把三十公分的尺測量盒子的長度。

examples.en: The king was considered a wise ruler by his people.
examples.zh: 那位國王被人民視為一位英明的統治者。

explains.en: A student uses this long tool to draw straight lines. It often has small marks for measuring. A person in charge of a country can also have this title.
This object helps make a straight mark. It can show how long something is. The same word can describe a king or other leader.
An art box may have this measuring tool. It is often made of wood or plastic. The word can also mean a leader who governs.

examples.en: He runs three kilometers every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早上跑三公里。

examples.en: Don't run in the school hallway, or you might trip and fall.
examples.zh: 不要在學校走廊奔跑，否則可能會絆倒受傷。

examples.en: His uncle has run a successful family restaurant for twenty years.
examples.zh: 他的叔叔經營一間成功的家族餐廳已有二十年。

explains.en: A person moves quickly using their legs. Water can also flow through a pipe. A business may be managed by someone.
Children may do this around a field. A machine can work for many hours. The word may also mean leading a shop or company.
This action is faster than walking. A stream can flow over stones. A person may manage a small business.

examples.en: Don't be sad; everything will be fine.
examples.zh: 別難過，一切都會好起來的。

examples.en: The movie had a very sad ending that brought tears to our eyes.
examples.zh: 這部電影有一個非常令人感傷的結局，讓我們潸然淚下。

examples.en: Listening to the sad song reminded him of his departed childhood pet.
examples.zh: 聽這首憂傷的歌曲讓他想起了離開的兒時寵物。

explains.en: It describes how a person feels after a loss. Someone may cry or feel alone. A dark story can also have this mood.
A child may feel unhappy when a friend moves away. This word can describe a face that shows sorrow. A song may have a gloomy feeling.
This feeling can come when something bad happens. A person may need a friend to talk to. It is the opposite of happy.

examples.en: Taiwan is widely considered a very safe place to travel.
examples.zh: 台灣普遍被認為是一個非常安全的旅遊勝地。

examples.en: Fasten your seatbelt securely to stay safe during the flight.
examples.zh: 在飛行途中繫好安全帶以策安全。

examples.en: Store important documents and cash in a fireproof safe.
examples.zh: 將重要文件和現金存放在防火保險箱中。

explains.en: It means free from danger. A seat belt helps keep a person from harm. The word can also name a strong box for money.
A place with no danger can be described this way. A helmet helps protect a rider. A locked metal box can hold money.
A child may stay this way when holding an adult’s hand near traffic. A password can protect a computer. A metal box may hold valuable things.

examples.en: I usually have a fresh fruit salad for brunch.
examples.zh: 我早午餐通常吃一份新鮮水果沙拉。

examples.en: A crisp vegetable salad with olive oil dressing makes a light dinner.
examples.zh: 淋上橄欖油醬汁的爽脆蔬菜沙拉是一頓清爽的晚餐。

examples.en: The chef tossed the salad with crunchy croutons and parmesan cheese.
examples.zh: 主廚在沙拉中拌入了香脆的麵包丁與帕瑪森起司。

explains.en: This meal is made with leafy greens and other foods. It may have tomato, egg, or cheese. People often add a sauce.
A bowl can hold cut vegetables for lunch. Lettuce is often used. A light sauce may be poured over it.
This dish can be served cold. It may contain fruit or meat too. A fork is used to eat it.

examples.en: The anniversary sale starts this coming Thursday.
examples.zh: 週年慶特賣活動將於本週四正式開跑。

examples.en: Car sales reached a record high across the island last month.
examples.zh: 上個月全島汽車銷售量創下了歷史新高紀錄。

examples.en: All winter coats and jackets are currently on sale at forty percent off.
examples.zh: 目前所有冬季大衣與夾克皆以六折特價優惠促銷中。

explains.en: A store lowers the cost of items during this event. People may buy clothes at a lower cost. The word can also mean the act of selling something.
A shop may offer special low costs for a short time. Many buyers come to look. It can also mean how many items a store has sold.
During this event, some goods cost less than usual. A sign may show the reduced cost. The word may describe a shop’s amount of business.

examples.en: Add a pinch of salt to the vegetable soup.
examples.zh: 在蔬菜湯裡加一小撮鹽。

examples.en: Traditional salted duck eggs taste rich with warm congee.
examples.zh: 傳統鹹鴨蛋配熱粥吃起來風味濃郁。

examples.en: Salt was once as valuable as gold in ancient trading routes.
examples.zh: 在古代貿易路線上，鹽曾一度如同黃金般珍貴。

explains.en: People add this white grain to food for taste. It comes from the sea or mines. Too much can be bad for health.
A cook may shake this seasoning over soup. It makes some food taste stronger. Small grains can be white or pink.
This seasoning is found in many kitchens. People may use it with pepper. A person should not eat too much of it.

examples.en: We go to the same junior high school.
examples.zh: 我們就讀同一所國中。

examples.en: The two identical twins wear the exact same bright yellow shirts.
examples.zh: 這對雙胞胎兄弟穿著完全一模一樣的亮黃色上衣。

examples.en: Although it was raining, they went hiking all the same.
examples.zh: 儘管下著雨，他們依然照樣去登山健行。

explains.en: It means not different. Two shirts may look alike in color and shape. One person can be compared with another using this word.
Use this word when two things match. Twins may wear matching hats. It can mean one exact item or person.
This word describes things that are alike. A pair of shoes may have a matching look. It can also mean unchanged.

examples.en: Remember to turn off lights to save electricity.
examples.zh: 記得隨手關燈以節約用電。

examples.en: She saves a portion of her pocket money in the bank every month.
examples.zh: 她每個月都將部分零用錢存入銀行。

examples.en: The brave lifeguard jumped into the water to save the struggling swimmer.
examples.zh: 英勇的救生員跳入水中解救了載浮載沉的溺水者。

explains.en: It means keeping money for later. A person may help someone in danger. A computer button may keep a file.
A child can put coins aside for a toy. A lifeguard may help a swimmer. The word can mean keeping something from being lost.
This action can protect a person from harm. It can also mean storing money for the future. A computer user may keep a document with this action.

examples.en: What did the teacher say about the test?
examples.zh: 老師說了什麼關於考試的事？

examples.en: Remember to say thank you whenever someone assists you.
examples.zh: 每當有人協助你時，記得說聲謝謝。

examples.en: It goes without saying that health is more valuable than money.
examples.zh: 不用說，健康自然比金錢更加珍貴。

explains.en: It means using words to share an idea aloud. A person may tell the truth. The word can also mean giving an opinion.
A child may tell what happened at school. A teacher can speak a sentence. Someone may give their view about a book.
This action uses the voice to share thoughts. A person may repeat a phrase. It can also mean naming or stating something.

examples.en: I walk to school every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上走路上學。

examples.en: Our school will hold an annual sports day next month.
examples.zh: 我們學校下個月將舉辦一年一度的運動會。

examples.en: What time does your school finish in the afternoon?
examples.zh: 你們學校下午幾點放學？

explains.en: Children go here to learn with teachers. A building may have many classrooms. Students read, write, and study there.
A teacher works with a group of children in this place. It may have a playground. Students go there on weekdays.
This learning place can be large or small. A class may meet in one room. People study many subjects there.

examples.en: Science experiments in the lab are fascinating.
examples.zh: 實驗室裡的自然科學實驗很吸引人。

examples.en: Advancements in medical science have cured many previously deadly diseases.
examples.zh: 醫學科學的進步治癒了許多過往致命的疾病。

examples.en: Our school science club won the regional innovation championship.
examples.zh: 我們學校的自然科學社贏得了區域創新競賽冠軍。

explains.en: It is the study of the world through tests and facts. People may learn about plants, stars, or animals. Experiments can help explain how things work.
A student may use tools to learn about nature. A lab can be part of this subject. It is based on asking questions and checking ideas.
People study matter, life, and space in this field. They use tests to learn facts. A classroom may have a special lab for it.

examples.en: We took a scenic ferry ride across the sea.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘風景優美的渡輪橫越大海。

examples.en: The blue sea sparkled brilliantly under the bright sunlight.
examples.zh: 蔚藍的海洋在燦爛陽光下閃閃發光。

examples.en: Many fishermen depend on the sea for their livelihood.
examples.zh: 許多漁民依靠大海維持生計。

explains.en: A huge body of salt water covers much of Earth. Ships travel across it. Fish and whales live in it.
Waves move along this wide body of water. A beach may be beside it. Many kinds of fish live there.
This large water body is salty. It may look blue or gray. A boat can carry goods across it.

examples.en: Taiwan has four distinct but mild seasons.
examples.zh: 台灣有四季分明但溫和的氣候。

examples.en: The rainy season usually lasts from May through June.
examples.zh: 梅雨季節通常從五月持續到六月。

examples.en: Football season kicks off with exciting opening matches.
examples.zh: 足球賽季以精彩刺激的開幕戰揭開序幕。

examples.en: Netflix announced that season two of the sci-fi drama is coming.
examples.zh: Netflix 宣布這部熱門科幻影集的第二季即將上線。

examples.en: Autumn is the best season to go hiking in the Taiwanese mountains.
examples.zh: 秋天是造訪台灣壯麗高山健行登山的最佳季節。

examples.en: The basketball team had an undefeated record throughout the regular season.
examples.zh: 這支籃球隊在整個例行賽季期間保持著全勝不敗紀錄。

explains.en: In many places, a year has four parts with different weather. Spring and winter are two examples. These changes affect plants and animals.
This can also mean a period when a certain activity often happens. A sport may have games during one part of the year. A fruit may be ready to pick during a certain period.
As a verb, this means to add things that give food more flavor. A cook might add salt, pepper, or herbs to a pot of soup. A small amount can change how the food tastes.

examples.en: Please fasten your seatbelt and take your seat.
examples.zh: 請繫妥安全帶並在座位就座。

examples.en: She kindly gave up her subway seat to an elderly pregnant woman.
examples.zh: 她親切地將捷運座位讓給了一位年邁的孕婦。

examples.en: You can reserve your cinema seat online to get the best viewing angle.
examples.zh: 你可以事先在網路上劃位電影院座位以獲取最佳觀影視角。

explains.en: People sit on this object in a room. A bus has many of them. As a verb, it can mean helping someone sit down.
A chair has a place for one person. A theater may have many in lines. A host may help a guest sit.
This object may be found at a table. A person can sit in it. It can also mean giving someone a place to sit.

examples.en: Wait for a second, please.
examples.zh: 請稍等一秒鐘。

examples.en: The library is located on the second floor of the building.
examples.zh: 圖書館位於這棟大樓的二樓。

examples.en: He finished the race in second place.
examples.zh: 他在比賽中獲得第二名。

explains.en: It means number two in a list. A minute has sixty of these small time parts. It can also mean one extra or a helper.
A runner who finishes after the winner is in this place. A clock counts this unit of time. It may also describe something of lower importance.
This word can mean next after first. A clock uses it for a small time amount. A person may work as a helper.

examples.en: The executive secretary scheduled tomorrow's board meeting.
examples.zh: 執行秘書排定了明天董事會的時間。

examples.en: The legal secretary prepared all court documents meticulously for the trial.
examples.zh: 法務秘書為即將開庭的審判一絲不苟地備妥了所有訴訟文件。

examples.en: Call the department secretary if you need assistance submitting your university application.
examples.zh: 如果你在繳交大學入學申請資料時需要任何協助，請聯繫系辦秘書。

explains.en: This worker helps with letters, calls, and schedules. A school may have one in its main office. The job often includes organizing records.
A manager may ask this worker to set a meeting. The person can answer the phone. An organization may choose one to keep notes.
This person helps a team stay organized. The worker may write letters and keep files. A club can have someone with this role.

examples.en: I see what you mean.
examples.zh: 我明白你的意思了。

examples.en: Let me see the test results before we celebrate.
examples.zh: 在我們慶祝之前，先讓我看一下考試成果。

examples.en: It was so foggy that we could hardly see the road ahead.
examples.zh: 霧太濃了，以致於我們幾乎看不見前方的道路。

explains.en: It means using the eyes to notice something. A person may look at a bird in a tree. It can also mean understanding an idea.
A child may look at a picture. Someone can visit a friend. The word may mean knowing what a speaker means.
This action uses the eyes. A person may meet a doctor. It can also mean understanding a fact.

examples.en: The farmer planted a seed in the soil.
examples.zh: 農夫在土裡種下一顆種子。

examples.en: A tiny seed grew into a tall sunflower.
examples.zh: 一顆小種子長成了一株高高的向日葵。

examples.en: The bird carried a seed in its beak.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥用喙叼著一顆種子。

explains.en: A small part of a fruit can grow into a new plant. Birds may eat them. A farmer may put them in soil.
This tiny part can grow into a tree or flower. It is often found inside fruit. People plant it in the ground to grow food.
A plant begins life from this small object. It may be carried by wind or animals. A gardener puts it in soil and adds water.

examples.en: Convenience stores in Taiwan sell almost everything.
examples.zh: 台灣的便利商店幾乎什麼都賣。

examples.en: That bakery sells out of egg tarts very quickly every morning.
examples.zh: 那家麵包店每天早上蛋塔很快就賣光了。

examples.en: The bookstore sells stationery and art supplies as well.
examples.zh: 那家書店也販售文具和美術用品。

explains.en: A shop gives an item to a buyer for money. A person may offer fruit at a market. It can also mean convincing someone to accept an idea.
A worker may trade a book for payment. A store can offer toys to customers. A person may try to persuade a friend.
This action means giving goods to a buyer. A farmer may offer eggs at a market. It can also mean persuading someone to agree.

examples.en: Please send me the file via email.
examples.zh: 請透過電子郵件把檔案寄給我。

examples.en: I sent a postcard to my best friend while traveling in Kyoto.
examples.zh: 我在京都旅行時寄了一張明信片給最好的朋友。

examples.en: The school will send text message notifications in case of typhoons.
examples.zh: 學校在遇颱風時會發送手機簡訊通知。

examples.en: Did you send the meeting invitation to all participants?
examples.zh: 你把會議邀請函寄給所有與會者了嗎？

examples.en: I will send you a postcard from Tokyo during my vacation.
examples.zh: 我在東京度假期間會寄一張明信片給你。

examples.en: Press the blue button to send your text message.
examples.zh: 按下藍色按鈕即可發送你的文字簡訊。

explains.en: It means moving something to another person. A child may place a note in a friend’s hand. A phone can also carry a message.
A person can place a gift in someone’s hands. A worker may mail a box to a home. The word can also mean making a sound or signal go out.
This action moves a thing from one place to another. A teacher may ask a student to pass a book. A radio can carry a voice far away.

examples.en: The convicted fraudster received a five-year prison sentence.
examples.zh: 經判決定讞的詐欺犯被依法判處有期徒刑五年之宣告刑。

examples.en: The judge will officially pronounce sentence on the convicted embezzler next Friday.
examples.zh: 承審法官定於下週五上午正式對這名挪用公款被定罪的貪污犯開庭宣判最終刑期。

examples.en: Please write a complete, grammatically correct sentence using the newly learned vocabulary word.
examples.zh: 請運用剛在課堂上學會的全新英文單字，在作業本上造出一個結構完整且符合文法規範的句子。

explains.en: A group of words with a full idea ends with a mark. A child may write one about a pet. It can also mean a group of words used together.
People use words to share an idea. A teacher may ask for one about a book. It begins with a capital letter and ends with a mark.
This is a group of words that tells or asks something. A writer may make many in a story. Each one helps explain a thought.

examples.en: The doctor gave us serious news about his health.
examples.zh: 醫生告訴我們關於他健康的嚴重消息。

examples.en: She had a serious talk with her teacher.
examples.zh: 她和老師進行了一次嚴肅的談話。

examples.en: The storm caused serious damage to the road.
examples.zh: 暴風雨對道路造成了嚴重損害。

explains.en: It describes something important and not meant as a joke. A doctor may talk about a strong illness. A person can have a thoughtful face.
A matter that needs care has this quality. A parent may speak in a firm way. The word can also mean earnest.
This word describes a deep or important matter. A person may give a careful answer. It can also mean not playful.

examples.en: The hotel offers good service to its guests.
examples.zh: 這家飯店為住客提供良好的服務。

examples.en: The bus service stops near our school.
examples.zh: 公車服務在我們學校附近停靠。

examples.en: She works in the food service at the hospital.
examples.zh: 她在醫院的餐飲部工作。

entries.definition: 服務；公共交通班次；部門

explains.en: It is work done to help people. A bus carries riders from place to place. A worker may clean a room.
A shop may help a buyer after a sale. A person may work for a town. The word can mean help given to others.
A meal may be brought to a table as part of this work. A doctor gives care. The word can also mean a time of worship.

examples.en: Rest for ninety seconds between each heavy compound exercise set.
examples.zh: 在進行高強度大重量複合動作的每一組（Set）之間，建議充分休息九十秒鐘。

examples.en: The workout protocol calls for four sets of ten repetitions for each core exercise.
examples.zh: 該訓練課表要求每項核心動作都要完成四組、每組十次反覆。

examples.en: On his final set, he performed a drop set by instantly reducing the resistance by twenty percent.
examples.zh: 在最後一組時，他透過立即將重量減輕兩成的方式進行了遞減組訓練。

explains.en: A group of objects can be arranged together. A person may place dishes on a table. The same word can mean a fixed time or place.
A movie can happen in a certain place and time. A person may arrange cups for tea. It can also mean a group of items sold together.
This word can mean a group of things that belong together. A person may adjust a clock or machine. A fixed collection can have this name.

examples.en: Several birds sat on the fence.
examples.zh: 幾隻鳥停在柵欄上。

examples.en: We waited several minutes for the bus.
examples.zh: 我們等公車等了幾分鐘。

examples.en: Several students helped clean the classroom.
examples.zh: 幾位學生幫忙打掃教室。

explains.en: It means more than two but not a great many. A few children may wait in line. The word describes an amount.
Use this word for a count that is greater than two. A handful of apples may be on the table. It does not mean a huge amount.
This word tells that there are a few, but not very many. A group of chairs may fill a room. A teacher may ask a few children to help.

examples.en: The dog shook water from its fur.
examples.zh: 狗把毛上的水甩掉。

examples.en: Please shake the bottle before you drink it.
examples.zh: 喝之前請先搖一搖瓶子。

examples.en: Her hands began to shake in the cold.
examples.zh: 她的手在寒冷中開始發抖。

explains.en: It means moving something quickly from side to side. A person may do this to mix a drink. A dog may move its tail when happy.
A person can move a bottle back and forth. A leaf may move in the wind. This action can also mean trembling with fear.
This action moves something quickly many times. A cook may mix a sauce in a jar. A person may move their head to say no.

examples.en: I shall call you after school.
examples.zh: 我放學後會打電話給你。

examples.en: We shall meet at the park tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天將在公園見面。

examples.en: You shall have a turn after your brother.
examples.zh: 你哥哥之後就輪到你了。

entries.definition: （助）將；應該；（正式用法）表示提議或承諾

explains.en: It is a helper word used when talking about the future. A speaker may use it in a promise. It also appears in formal rules.
This word can mean that something will happen. A person may use it to make a promise. It is common in formal speech.
A rule may use this word to tell what someone must do later. A person can use it to make a strong offer. It is a helper verb.

examples.en: The cloud had the shape of a horse.
examples.zh: 那朵雲的形狀像一匹馬。

examples.en: She shaped the clay into a small bowl.
examples.zh: 她把黏土塑成一個小碗。

examples.en: The cookie cutter makes a star shape.
examples.zh: 這個餅乾模具可以做出星星形狀。

explains.en: It means the outer look or form of something. A square and circle are different kinds. A person may make clay into one.
A cloud can have a changing outline. A box has a clear form. This word can also mean giving something a certain form.
This word describes how an object looks from the outside. A person can draw an outline. As an action, it means forming something.

examples.en: Sharing snacks with classmates creates happy memories.
examples.zh: 和同班同學分享零食能創造快樂回憶。

examples.en: She posted a blog entry to share her backpacking travel experiences in Europe.
examples.zh: 她發表了一篇部落格文章，分享她在歐洲背包自助旅行的寶貴經驗。

examples.en: The two leading smartphone brands hold the largest share of the domestic market.
examples.zh: 這兩大智慧型手機巨頭品牌佔據了國內市場最大的市佔份額。

examples.en: Share this helpful English learning guide with your classmates.
examples.zh: 將這份實用的英語學習指南轉發分享給你的同班同學。

examples.en: The two sisters always share their snacks and favorite toys.
examples.zh: 這對姊妹總是互相分享彼此的零食小吃與心愛玩具。

examples.en: Tech shares rose sharply following news of impressive quarterly earnings.
examples.zh: 在公布亮眼的季度財報消息後，科技類股股價應聲大漲。

explains.en: It means giving some of what you have to another person. Friends may use the same toy. People can also divide food into parts.
A person may let a friend use a book. A family may eat one meal together. This word can mean telling others about an idea.
This action means using something together. A child may give a snack to a friend. People may also tell others about their thoughts.

examples.en: Be careful with that sharp knife.
examples.zh: 小心那把鋒利的刀。

examples.en: The pencil has a sharp point.
examples.zh: 這枝鉛筆有一個尖尖的筆尖。

examples.en: A sharp wind blew across the beach.
examples.zh: 一陣刺骨的風吹過海灘。

entries.definition: （形）鋒利的；尖銳的；突然的；敏銳的；（副）準時地；急轉地

explains.en: It describes an edge that can cut. A knife may have one. It can also mean easy to notice or understand.
A pencil with a fine tip can make clear lines. A cold wind may feel biting. This word may describe a clear mind.
A blade may have an edge that cuts well. A person may feel a sudden pain. It can also describe a strong change in taste.

examples.en: She lives in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她住在台北。

examples.en: She wants to be a doctor in the future.
examples.zh: 她未來想成為一名醫生。

examples.en: She speaks English very fluently.
examples.zh: 她的英語說得非常流利。

examples.en: She made a beautiful beaded bracelet for herself.
examples.zh: 她為自己做了一條漂亮的串珠手鍊。

examples.en: She taught herself how to play acoustic guitar through online video tutorials.
examples.zh: 她透過線上影片教學自學學會了彈奏木吉他。

examples.en: She took great pride in herself after passing the advanced certification exam.
examples.zh: 在通過高階檢定考試後，她為自己感到無比驕傲與自豪。

explains.en: This word refers to a female person or animal. The word may be used when talking about someone already known. It can also refer to an object or animal linked to a female.
A girl may be spoken about with this pronoun. It takes the place of a female name in a sentence. The form for something owned by that person is different.
This pronoun points to a female person. It may be used after a verb or before something owned. A speaker uses it to avoid saying a name again.

examples.en: Tourists love watching the sheep shearing show at Cingjing Farm.
examples.zh: 遊客喜歡在清境農場觀看剪羊毛秀。

examples.en: A large flock of white sheep grazed peacefully on the green hillside pasture.
examples.zh: 一大群白綿羊在綠色山坡牧場上悠閒地吃草。

examples.en: If you struggle to fall asleep, try counting sheep in your mind.
examples.zh: 如果你輾轉難以入眠，試著在腦海中數綿羊吧。

explains.en: This farm animal has thick wool. It may live in a field with a group. A young one is called a lamb.
A farmer may raise this animal for wool and meat. It has four legs and a soft coat. It often eats grass.
This animal makes a baa sound. Its coat can be cut and used to make warm cloth. A baby has a special name.

examples.en: A huge cargo ship entered the harbor.
examples.zh: 一艘巨大的貨輪駛入了港口。

examples.en: The company will ship your order within two business days.
examples.zh: 公司將在兩個工作天內運送您的訂單。

examples.en: We took a luxury cruise ship to explore the Mediterranean islands.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘豪華郵輪探索地中海群島。

explains.en: A large boat carries people or goods across water. It can travel across the sea. A sailor may work on one.
This vessel can move across an ocean. It may carry cars or boxes. A crew helps it travel safely.
A boat of great size may take a long trip. A captain leads its crew. It can carry many people or goods.

examples.en: He wore a clean white shirt for the interview.
examples.zh: 他穿了一件乾淨的白襯衫去面試。

examples.en: This cotton shirt is breathable and comfortable to wear.
examples.zh: 這件純棉襯衫透氣且穿起來很舒適。

examples.en: Don't forget to button up your shirt before going on stage.
examples.zh: 上台前別忘了把襯衫釦子扣好。

explains.en: This piece of clothing covers the upper body. It may have sleeves and buttons. A person wears it with pants or a skirt.
A child may wear this clothing to school. It can be made of cotton. A clean one may be folded in a drawer.
This garment covers the chest and arms. It may have a collar. A team may wear matching ones.

examples.en: Please take off your shoes before entering the house.
examples.zh: 進屋前請脫鞋。

examples.en: I need a pair of supportive running shoes for track practice.
examples.zh: 田徑練習時我需要一雙支撐良好的跑步鞋。

examples.en: Make sure your shoes are tied tightly before the race.
examples.zh: 比賽前請確保你的鞋帶已繫緊。

explains.en: People wear these over their feet outside. A pair often has a sole and laces. They help keep feet clean and safe.
A runner ties these before a race. They can be made from leather or cloth. A person usually wears one on each foot.
This footwear protects the feet. Some pairs are made for sports. A store may sell many colors and styles.

examples.en: We bought fresh fruit at the shop.
examples.zh: 我們在商店買了新鮮水果。

examples.en: The shop closes at six o’clock.
examples.zh: 這家商店六點打烊。

examples.en: She works at a book shop near home.
examples.zh: 她在家附近的書店工作。

explains.en: People buy food and other things here. A worker may help a customer. Items are arranged on shelves.
A small business may sell books or toys. A person enters and pays for an item. The owner may open it each morning.
This place sells things to customers. A person may look around before buying. It can be in a mall or on a street.

examples.en: Take a short rest after studying for fifty minutes.
examples.zh: 讀書五十分鐘後，稍微休息片刻。

examples.en: She decided to cut her long hair into a stylish short haircut.
examples.zh: 她決定將長髮剪成時髦俐落的短髮造型。

examples.en: In short, regular practice is the secret to mastering any skill.
examples.zh: 簡而言之，規律練習是掌握任何技能的秘訣。

explains.en: It means not long in length or time. A person may have a haircut above the neck. A small talk may take only a minute.
A pencil can be this when much of it has been used. A trip may last only a few minutes. It describes limited length.
This word can mean brief. A child may wear pants that end above the knee. A tall object is the opposite.

examples.en: He wore shorts on the hot summer day.
examples.zh: 炎熱的夏日裡他穿著短褲。

examples.en: The runner wore blue shorts.
examples.zh: 那位跑者穿著藍色短褲。

examples.en: My new shorts have deep pockets.
examples.zh: 我的新短褲有很深的口袋。

explains.en: This clothing covers the legs and ends above the knees. People often wear it in warm weather. A sport uniform may include it.
A person may wear this garment at the beach. It has two openings for the legs. It is cooler than long pants.
This summer clothing can be made from cotton. A runner may wear it for exercise. It leaves much of each leg uncovered.

examples.en: My shoulder hurts after carrying the bag.
examples.zh: 背了包包後我的肩膀很痛。

examples.en: She rested her head on his shoulder.
examples.zh: 她把頭靠在他的肩膀上休息。

examples.en: The child shrugged one shoulder.
examples.zh: 那個孩子聳了一下肩膀。

explains.en: This body part joins an arm to the upper body. A bag strap may rest there. People can lift an arm from it.
A person carries a backpack on each one. It helps the arm move. A jacket often covers this body part.
This joint sits between the neck and arm. A person may shrug it to show doubt. It can hurt after carrying a heavy bag.

examples.en: Please don't shout in the library hallway.
examples.zh: 請不要在圖書館走廊上大聲喊叫。

examples.en: Fans shouted with wild excitement when the winning goal was scored.
examples.zh: 當打進致勝球的那一刻，球迷們欣喜若狂地高聲吶喊。

examples.en: He had to shout over the roar of the rushing waterfall to be heard.
examples.zh: 他不得不蓋過奔騰瀑布的轟鳴聲大聲喊話才能讓別人聽見。

explains.en: It means speaking very loudly. A person may do this across a busy road. A crowd may make a loud sound.
A child may call loudly from the yard. A fan may make a loud sound at a game. This action can show anger or excitement.
This action uses a loud voice. A person may call for help. It can also mean making a loud sound together.

examples.en: The children watched a puppet show.
examples.zh: 孩子們看了一場木偶戲。

examples.en: Can you show me how to use this tool?
examples.zh: 你可以示範如何使用這個工具嗎？

examples.en: The shop will show new toys in the window.
examples.zh: 商店會在櫥窗展示新玩具。

entries.definition: （動）展示；表明；帶領；演出；（名）表演；節目；展覽

explains.en: People watch a story, event, or skill. A teacher may use pictures in class. It can also mean guiding something to someone.
A theater lets people watch a performance. A chart can make facts clear. The word may also mean guiding a guest to a seat.
This word can mean a performance for an audience. A person can use it to explain how a tool works. A store may put goods in a window.

examples.en: I took a warm shower after the game.
examples.zh: 比賽後我洗了個熱水澡。

examples.en: A light shower fell during the walk.
examples.zh: 散步時下了一場小雨。

examples.en: The shower is next to the bath.
examples.zh: 淋浴間就在浴缸旁邊。

explains.en: Water falls from above in a bathroom. A person can wash their hair there. A short rain may also be called this.
This place has warm water and a drain. A person may use it to get clean. Drops from a cloud can make a brief outdoor version.
A bathroom may have a curtain around this washing place. Water comes down from a head above. A quick fall of rain has the same word.

examples.en: If you feel sick, stay home and rest.
examples.zh: 如果你感到不舒服，請留在家中休息。

examples.en: He took two days of sick leave because of a high fever.
examples.zh: 他因為高燒請了兩天的病假。

examples.en: I felt car sick on the winding mountain roads.
examples.zh: 在蜿蜒的山路上我感到有些暈車。

explains.en: It means not feeling well. A person may have a fever or cough. A doctor can help.
A child may stay home from class when unwell. The person may need rest. Food can also be called this when it makes someone unwell.
This word describes a person with an illness. A nurse may check them. It can also describe feeling upset by something.

examples.en: Please walk on the sidewalk to stay safe.
examples.zh: 請走在人行道側邊以確保安全。

examples.en: Flip the fried egg over to brown the other side evenly.
examples.zh: 把荷包蛋翻面，使另一面也均勻煎成金黃色。

examples.en: True friends will stand by your side through joyful and challenging moments.
examples.zh: 真正的朋友會在歡樂與困難的時刻陪伴在你身邊。

explains.en: It can mean one area beside another. A person may stand next to a friend. It can also mean an opinion or position.
A box has several flat surfaces. A town may have a part near a river. The word can describe a person’s view in a disagreement.
This word can mean a place beside something. A left hand is one of two. It can also name a position in a team or discussion.

examples.en: The mountain was a beautiful sight.
examples.zh: 那座山是一道美麗的景色。

examples.en: Her sight is very good without glasses.
examples.zh: 她不戴眼鏡時視力也很好。

examples.en: The bright lights hurt my sight.
examples.zh: 強光讓我的視覺不舒服。

explains.en: This is the ability to see with the eyes. You use it to notice colors, shapes, and movement. Darkness can make seeing difficult even when your eyes work well.
A bright lamp helps people use their eyes. A mountain may be lovely to look at. This word can name what a person notices.
This can name something beautiful or unusual that a person sees. A mountain at sunrise may be a lovely example. People also use the plural when talking about places they visit.

examples.en: Please sign your name on the dotted line.
examples.zh: 請在虛線上簽署你的大名。

examples.en: Dark clouds in the sky are a sure sign of rain.
examples.zh: 天空中的烏雲是下雨的明確徵兆。

examples.en: He didn't see the stop sign and ran through the intersection.
examples.zh: 他沒看見停車標誌就衝過了十字路口。

explains.en: A mark can give information or directions. A person may write their name on paper. The same word can mean making a mark with a hand.
A road has a board with words for drivers. A shop may put a notice in its window. As an action, this word can mean writing a name.
A symbol may tell people where to go. It can show a rule or warning. A person may use a hand to show an idea.

examples.en: This is a simple way to make bread.
examples.zh: 這是做麵包的一種簡單方法。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a simple task.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們一項簡單的任務。

examples.en: A simple dress can look very nice.
examples.zh: 簡單的洋裝也可以很好看。

entries.definition: 簡單的；容易理解或完成的；樸素的

explains.en: It means easy to understand or do. A child may use a basic tool. The opposite idea is hard or complex.
A clear rule may have only a few steps. A person can explain it with easy words. This word describes something without much detail.
This word means plain and easy. A meal may use only a few foods. A design can have no extra parts.

examples.en: I have studied English since elementary school.
examples.zh: 我從小學就開始學英文了。

examples.en: Ever since they met in college, they have remained inseparable friends.
examples.zh: 自從在大學相識以來，他們便一直是形影不離的摯友。

examples.en: Since the weather is pleasant and cool, let's have our dinner outdoors.
examples.zh: 既然天氣宜人且涼爽，我們就在戶外享用晚餐吧。

examples.en: Since you are already here, let's have dinner together.
examples.zh: 既然你都已經來了，那我們就一起吃頓晚餐吧。

examples.en: He has lived in Kaohsiung ever since he graduated from university eight years ago.
examples.zh: 自從八年前從大學順利畢業之後，他就一直長年定居生活在陽光明媚的高雄。

examples.en: Since the mountain path is muddy and slick, watch your footing carefully.
examples.zh: 既然雨後的陡峭山徑十分泥濘濕滑，健行時請務必步步為營、留心腳下安全。

entries.definition: 自從…以來；既然；自從；因為

explains.en: It means from a past time until now. A person may live in one town for many years. It can also introduce a cause.
A child may know a friend from an earlier day. The word can mean because. It also tells how long something has lasted.
This word points to a time before now. A person may have been busy all day. It can also give the reason for an action.

examples.en: Taiwanese people love to sing together at KTV.
examples.zh: 台灣人喜歡一起去 KTV 唱歌。

examples.en: Birds sing melodic tunes in the trees to welcome the morning sunshine.
examples.zh: 鳥兒在樹上唱出悅耳的曲調，迎接清晨的陽光。

examples.en: The choir sang the national anthem with immense pride and harmony.
examples.zh: 合唱團帶著無比的自豪與和諧的合聲演唱國歌。

explains.en: People make music with their voice. A bird can make notes in the morning. A group may perform a song together.
A child can use a voice to make a tune. A person may do this in a choir. The action can be happy or sad.
This action uses the voice to make music. A bird may do it from a tree. People can do it alone or as a group.

examples.en: Jay Chou is an extremely famous Mandopop singer.
examples.zh: 周杰倫是一位極具知名度的華語流行歌手。

examples.en: The lead singer captivated the audience with her powerful vocal range.
examples.zh: 主唱以其極具爆發力的音域震撼了全場觀眾。

examples.en: Aspiring young singers auditioned for the national televised music show.
examples.zh: 抱有夢想的年輕歌手們參加了全國電視音樂節目的海選試鏡。

explains.en: This person performs music with a voice. They may stand on a stage. A band can work with one.
A person who makes tunes with the voice has this role. Fans may listen to their songs. The performer may record music.
This artist uses the voice to make music. A concert may have one as its main act. A person can become famous for this work.

examples.en: The boy said, “Yes, sir,” to the teacher.
examples.zh: 男孩對老師說：「是的，先生。」

examples.en: Excuse me, sir, is this seat free?
examples.zh: 不好意思，先生，這個座位有人嗎？

examples.en: The waiter called the customer sir.
examples.zh: 服務生稱呼那位顧客為先生。

entries.definition: 先生（對男性的禮貌稱呼）；爵士（英國授勳者稱號）

explains.en: People use this polite title when speaking to a man. It may come before his family name. It is common in formal settings.
A waiter may address a male customer with this word. It shows respect. A letter may begin with it.
This is a respectful way to speak to an adult man. It can come before a name. A person may use it with a stranger.

examples.en: I share a room with my sister.
examples.zh: 我和我妹妹共用一間房間。

examples.en: My elder sister helped me practice my English conversation.
examples.zh: 我姊姊幫我練習英語會話。

examples.en: Her little sister is starting kindergarten next week.
examples.zh: 她的小妹妹下週要開始上幼兒園了。

explains.en: A girl who has the same mother or father is this family member. She may be older or younger. Two girls in one family can have this relation.
A boy may have this female family member. They can grow up in the same home. She may be a twin or have a different age.
This word names a girl in a family who shares a parent. She may help a younger child. A person can have more than one.

examples.en: Please sit down and make yourself comfortable.
examples.zh: 請坐下，請放輕鬆。

examples.en: We sat by the window watching the raindrops fall into the garden.
examples.zh: 我們坐在窗邊看著雨滴落在花園裡。

examples.en: Sit up straight during class to prevent back pain and fatigue.
examples.zh: 上課時坐姿端正可以預防背部痠痛與疲勞。

explains.en: It means resting on a chair with the body upright. A person may do this at a desk. A dog can do it when told.
A child can be on a chair during a lesson. The body is lower than when standing. A cat may stay in this position by a window.
This position uses a chair or bench. A person may stay still during a meal. A teacher may ask a class to do this.

examples.en: What shoe size do you wear?
examples.zh: 你穿幾號尺碼的鞋子？

examples.en: Do you have this woolen sweater in a larger size?
examples.zh: 請問這件羊毛毛衣有大一號的尺碼嗎？

examples.en: The download size of the new video game update is ten gigabytes.
examples.zh: 這款電玩遊戲新更新檔的下載檔案大小為 10 GB。

examples.en: Do you have this stylish winter coat in size medium?
examples.zh: 請問這件時髦冬季大衣有 M 號的嗎？

examples.en: The island is roughly equal in size to the state of Maryland.
examples.zh: 這座島嶼的面積大小大致相當於馬里蘭州。

examples.en: Please consult our online size chart before ordering shoes.
examples.zh: 訂購鞋子之前請先參閱我們的線上尺碼對照表。

entries.definition: 尺寸；尺碼；按大小排列；大小

explains.en: It means how large or small something is. A child may need a larger coat. A box can have a certain amount of space inside.
A shoe store asks which kind fits a foot. A shirt may be too large or too tiny. This word describes its dimensions.
This word tells how big an object is. A person may compare two boxes. Clothes are sold in different kinds.

examples.en: The school uniform includes a pleated skirt.
examples.zh: 學校制服包含一件百褶裙。

examples.en: She twirled around happily in her new floral skirt.
examples.zh: 她穿著新買的花裙開心地轉圈。

examples.en: Long skirts are popular among high school girls this summer.
examples.zh: 長裙今年夏天在女高中生之間非常受歡迎。

explains.en: A person may wear this garment over a shirt. It covers the waist and legs. It may be long or reach above the knee.
This clothing is often worn by girls and women. It can have folds or buttons. A belt may go around its top.
A dancer may wear this garment on stage. It covers the lower body. Many styles have a soft, flowing shape.

examples.en: The sky turned beautiful orange at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落時天空變成了美麗的橘紅色。

examples.en: Stars sparkled brightly in the clear night sky away from the city.
examples.zh: 遠離城市的喧囂，星星在晴朗的夜空中燦爛閃耀。

examples.en: A colorful rainbow arched gracefully across the blue sky after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後，一道色彩斑斕的彩虹在藍天中優雅劃過。

explains.en: A wide open area above the ground can look blue during the day. Clouds move through it. At night, stars appear there.
Birds fly high above the trees. The sun and moon appear in this space. Clouds may bring rain from above.
People look up to see clouds or stars. Airplanes travel through this area. Its color may change at sunrise.

examples.en: You should sleep at least seven hours a day.
examples.zh: 你每天應該至少睡七個小時。

examples.en: I was so tired that I fell asleep quickly.
examples.zh: 我太累了，很快就睡著了。

examples.en: Adequate sleep helps improve your memory and focus.
examples.zh: 充足的睡眠有助於提升記憶力與專注力。

explains.en: A person closes their eyes and rests at night. A baby may do this for many hours. The body needs this rest.
A tired person may lie in bed and become unaware of the room. A quiet place can help. Most people do this each night.
This action gives the body time to rest. A person may dream during it. A soft bed can make it easier.

examples.en: The slim cat slipped through the small gate.
examples.zh: 那隻苗條的貓溜過小門。

examples.en: He looks slim in his new jacket.
examples.zh: 他穿著新外套看起來很苗條。

examples.en: She chose a slim book for the trip.
examples.zh: 她挑了一本薄薄的書帶去旅行。

explains.en: It means thin in a healthy or attractive way. A person may wear clothing that makes the body look narrow. The word can also describe a small chance.
A cat may have a narrow body. A person can become this after exercise and healthy food. It can also mean very slight.
This word describes a body with little extra fat. A line may be narrow and clean. It can also describe a small possibility.

examples.en: Turtles are famous for their slow pace.
examples.zh: 烏龜以緩慢的步伐聞名。

examples.en: Drivers must slow down when approaching a pedestrian crosswalk.
examples.zh: 駕駛人在接近行人穿越道時必須減速。

examples.en: The movie scene was captured in artistic slow motion.
examples.zh: 電影場景以極富藝術感的慢動作鏡頭呈現。

explains.en: It means moving without much speed. A turtle may cross a path this way. A person may take time to finish work.
A bus may travel at a low speed. A tired person may walk this way. It can also describe a clock that seems to move with difficulty.
This word means not fast. A person may speak with long pauses. A river may flow gently.

examples.en: Our apartment has a small but cozy balcony.
examples.zh: 我們的公寓有一個小巧但舒適的陽台。

examples.en: Making small improvements every day leads to massive long-term progress.
examples.zh: 每天做出微小的進步能帶來巨大的長期成果。

examples.en: They engaged in friendly small talk while waiting for the elevator.
examples.zh: 等電梯時他們進行了親切的閒聊寒暄。

explains.en: It means little in size. A mouse is much tinier than a horse. A child may live in a home with little space.
A tiny cup holds only a little water. A baby is shorter than an adult. This word can describe an amount too.
This describing word means not large. A pebble is less than a boulder. A tiny amount is not much.

examples.en: She is smart and always solves math riddles quickly.
examples.zh: 她很聰明，總是能迅速解開數學謎題。

examples.en: Modern smart homes can control lights and air conditioning automatically.
examples.zh: 現代智慧家庭可以自動調節燈光與空調。

examples.en: Wearing a smart blazer makes a positive impression at an interview.
examples.zh: 面試時穿著一套俐落帥氣的西裝外套能留下良好印象。

explains.en: It means clever and able to learn quickly. A child may solve a hard puzzle. A computer can also be called this.
A person who learns fast may have this quality. A neat idea can be clever. A phone that uses apps is sometimes described this way.
This word describes a person who understands things quickly. A dog may learn many tricks. It can also mean neat or stylish.

examples.en: Freshly baked bread smells absolutely wonderful.
examples.zh: 現烤出爐的麵包聞起來真是香極了。

examples.en: Dogs have an acute sense of smell and can detect faint odors.
examples.zh: 狗狗擁有敏銳的嗅覺，能夠察覺微弱的氣味。

examples.en: She stopped in the garden to smell the blooming fragrant jasmine.
examples.zh: 她在花園裡駐足，聞著盛開茉莉花的撲鼻芬芳。

examples.en: The night market stinky tofu smells strong but tastes amazing!
examples.zh: 夜市臭豆腐聞起來味道濃烈但吃起來極為美味！

examples.en: I love the relaxing smell of lavender essential oil before sleeping.
examples.zh: 我很喜歡睡前薰衣草精油散發的放鬆氣味。

examples.en: Dogs have a keen sense of smell that helps them track lost people.
examples.zh: 狗狗擁有敏銳的嗅覺，能幫助牠們搜救失蹤人員。

explains.en: This noun names something your nose can notice. Fresh bread may give off a pleasant one. The verb means using your nose to notice an odor.
A flower may have a sweet odor. A person can notice coffee in a room. This word can name the sense used by the nose.
A strong odor may be pleasant or unpleasant. A dog can use its nose to find food. The action can mean taking air in through the nose.

examples.en: A warm smile makes people feel welcome.
examples.zh: 溫暖的微笑能讓人感到賓至如歸。

examples.en: She smiled cheerfully upon seeing the unexpected birthday bouquet.
examples.zh: 看見意想不到的生日花束時，她開心地笑了。

examples.en: Keep smiling even when you encounter unexpected obstacles.
examples.zh: 即使遇到意想不到的挫折，也要保持微笑與樂觀。

explains.en: It is a happy look made by turning the lips upward. A kind person may give one to a friend. The word can also mean showing happiness this way.
A baby may make this face when seeing a parent. It can show joy or welcome. A person may do this in a photo.
This expression often makes a face look friendly. A person may use it to cheer up a friend. As an action, it means showing joy without words.

examples.en: Smoke rose from the campfire.
examples.zh: 煙從營火升起。

examples.en: The room was full of smoke after the toast burned.
examples.zh: 吐司烤焦後房間裡充滿了煙。

examples.en: Please do not smoke near the children.
examples.zh: 請不要在孩子附近抽菸。

explains.en: A cloud from a fire or cigarette can fill the air. A person may see it rise from a chimney. It can also mean using a cigarette.
A kitchen may fill with a gray cloud when food burns. A campfire sends it into the air. It can make breathing hard.
This gray stuff comes from something burning. It can rise above a candle. A person should avoid breathing it.

examples.en: Be cautious of poisonous snakes when walking in tall grass.
examples.zh: 走在高草叢中時要當心毒蛇。

examples.en: The winding mountain road snaked through the steep misty peaks.
examples.zh: 蜿蜒曲折的山路在陡峭雲霧繚繞的山峰間穿行。

examples.en: Snakes shed their skin several times a year as they grow larger.
examples.zh: 蛇在成長過程中每年都會蛻皮數次。

explains.en: This long animal has no legs. It moves along the ground. Some kinds are dangerous, while many are harmless.
A garden may have this animal near rocks. It uses its tongue to learn about the air. It can move by bending its body.
This creature has scales and a long body. It may live in grass or a tree. Many kinds eat mice.

examples.en: It rarely snows in low altitude areas of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台灣低海拔地區很少下雪。

examples.en: Mount Hehuan is covered in thick snow during cold winters.
examples.zh: 寒冷的冬日裡，合歡山覆蓋著厚厚的白雪。

examples.en: Children were delighted to build a snowman in the fresh snow.
examples.zh: 小朋友們在新下的白雪中開心地堆起雪人。

examples.en: Drifting flakes of organic marine snow provide the primary food source for bizarre creatures of the abyss.
examples.zh: 從海洋表層如雪花般飄落的海雪有機碎屑，是萬米深淵奇特生物賴以維生的主要糧食來源。

examples.en: Composed of dead plankton, fecal pellets, and dust, marine snow drifts perpetually into the abyss.
examples.zh: 由死去的浮游生物殘骸、排泄物顆粒與大氣微塵組成的海雪，永不停歇地向萬米深淵深處緩緩沉降。

examples.en: Deep-sea filter feeders extend feathery appendages to catch descending particles of marine snow.
examples.zh: 深海底棲濾食性生物伸展出羽毛般的觸手與過濾篩網，在水流中攔截沉降而下的點點海雪顆粒。

entries.definition: 雪；下雪；海雪 (表層有機碎屑如雪花般緩緩沉降)

explains.en: Soft white flakes fall from clouds in cold weather. Children may build a person-shaped figure outside. It can cover roads and trees.
This frozen water falls from the sky. It makes hills white in winter. People wear warm coats when it comes.
A mountain may have this white covering. Each flake has a special pattern. A warm hand can make it melt.

examples.en: It was raining heavily, so we stayed home.
examples.zh: 外面下著大雨，所以我們待在家裡。

examples.en: She practiced the violin diligently every day so that she could win the competition.
examples.zh: 她每天勤奮練習小提琴，以便能在比賽中獲勝。

examples.en: Thank you so much for your warm hospitality during my stay.
examples.zh: 非常感謝你在我借宿期間的熱情款待。

explains.en: It can mean very much or to that degree. A person may agree with a friend. It can also join a reason to a result.
Use this short word to show a result. A child was tired, and that is why the child went to bed. It can mean in this way.
This word can connect a cause with what happened after. It may mean to a great degree. A person can use it to agree.

examples.en: The grandfather took a nap on the soft sofa.
examples.zh: 爺爺在柔軟的沙發上小睡片刻。

examples.en: We all sat on the leather sofa to watch the basketball finals.
examples.zh: 我們全都坐在皮沙發上觀看籃球總決賽。

examples.en: The playful kitten curled up in the corner of the comfortable sofa.
examples.zh: 頑皮的小貓在舒適沙發的角落蜷縮著入睡。

explains.en: People sit on this soft piece of furniture. It often has room for two or three. Cushions make it comfortable.
A living room may have this long seat. Friends can sit together on it. It may be covered with cloth or leather.
This furniture can be placed near a table. A family may watch TV while seated there. It has a back and arms.

examples.en: The soldier helped carry food to the camp.
examples.zh: 士兵幫忙把食物搬到營區。

examples.en: A young soldier wrote home to his family.
examples.zh: 一名年輕士兵寫信回家給家人。

examples.en: The soldier stood guard by the gate.
examples.zh: 那名士兵在門邊站崗。

explains.en: This person serves in an army. They may wear a uniform and follow orders. They can help protect a country.
A person in the armed forces may train with a team. They may work far from home. The job can include guarding a place.
This worker may carry supplies or help during an emergency. A uniform may show the role. The person follows a leader in the army.

examples.en: Would you like some hot tea?
examples.zh: 你想要來點熱茶嗎？

examples.en: Some students prefer to study in the quiet library.
examples.zh: 有些學生偏好在安靜的圖書館唸書。

examples.en: Can you lend me some coins for the vending machine?
examples.zh: 你能借我一些零錢投販賣機嗎？

explains.en: It means an amount that is not all. A person may have a few apples. It can also mean a part of a group.
Use this word for an unknown or small amount. A child may have a little milk. It can refer to a number of people or things.
This word points to an amount without saying exactly how much. A few birds may sit in a tree. It can also mean a certain one.

examples.en: Someone left their umbrella at the classroom door.
examples.zh: 有人把雨傘遺忘在教室門口了。

examples.en: There is someone waiting for you at the front reception desk.
examples.zh: 在前台接待處有人正在等候你。

examples.en: It feels comforting when someone genuinely listens to your worries.
examples.zh: 當有人真誠傾聽你的煩惱時，感覺十分令人寬慰。

explains.en: This word means a person whose name is not known. A teacher may call for a volunteer. It can refer to an unknown human.
Use this word when the person is not named. A friend may have left a gift. The speaker does not know who did it.
This word points to one human, though the speaker does not say who. A voice may come from another room. The person is not known.

examples.en: There is something delicious cooking in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 廚房裡正在煮著某種很香的美味料理。

examples.en: I have something important to discuss with our project manager.
examples.zh: 我有一件重要的事情想與我們的專案經理討論。

examples.en: Try something new every day to keep your mind active and curious.
examples.zh: 每天嘗試一點新事物，讓心智保持活躍與充滿好奇。

explains.en: It means an item or idea without saying which one. A child may ask for a drink. The exact object is not named.
Use this word for an unknown thing. A box may hold a surprise. A person may want to say an idea.
This word can point to an unnamed object. A person may have an idea. The speaker does not give its exact name.

examples.en: Sometimes I ride a YouBike along the riverbank.
examples.zh: 有時候我會沿著河岸騎 YouBike。

examples.en: Even the most experienced experts sometimes make careless mistakes.
examples.zh: 就連最有經驗的專家有時也會犯粗心的錯誤。

examples.en: Sometimes taking a short walk helps clear your busy mind.
examples.zh: 有時候散個步有助於讓紛亂的思緒沉澱下來。

explains.en: It means on certain occasions, but not every time. A person may walk to work on a few days. It can describe a habit that happens now and then.
Use this word for an event that happens at times. A child may eat ice cream after dinner on a few nights. It is less often than always.
This word tells that something happens on some days. A friend may visit now and then. It does not happen each time.

examples.en: Let's find somewhere quiet to study English together.
examples.zh: 我們找個安靜的地方一起讀英文吧。

examples.en: I know I left my glasses somewhere on this messy desk.
examples.zh: 我知道我把眼鏡忘在這張凌亂書桌的某個地方了。

examples.en: Somewhere deep in the mountains, a pristine hot spring waterfall flows.
examples.zh: 在深山某處，流淌著一座純淨天然的溫泉瀑布。

explains.en: It means in a place that is not named. A child may leave a toy in an unknown spot. The location is not clear.
Use this word when a place is unknown. A person may look for keys in the house. The exact spot is not known.
This word points to an unnamed location. A traveler may want to go to a quiet place. The speaker has not said where.

examples.en: They are very proud of their son.
examples.zh: 他們為自己的兒子感到非常驕傲。

examples.en: Mr. Wu took his son to the zoo last Sunday.
examples.zh: 吳先生上週日帶兒子去動物園。

examples.en: Their eldest son has graduated from medical school.
examples.zh: 他們的大兒子已經從醫學院畢業了。

explains.en: A boy is a male child. He may be part of a family. A parent may call a boy this relation.
This word means a male child in relation to a parent. He may have brothers or sisters. A family can have more than one.
A mother or father may use this word for a male child. He can be young or grown. It describes a family relationship.

examples.en: What is your favorite Mandopop song?
examples.zh: 你最喜歡哪一首華語流行歌曲？

examples.en: The whole audience sang the cheerful theme song together.
examples.zh: 全場觀眾一起齊唱了歡快的活動主題曲。

examples.en: Birds greeted the rising sun with a melodic morning song.
examples.zh: 鳥兒用悅耳的晨鳴迎接冉冉升起的朝陽。

explains.en: People may sing words with music. A radio can play one. A child may learn the words by heart.
This is a piece of music with words. A band may perform it at a show. It can make people feel happy or sad.
A person can hum a tune from this. It may have verses and a chorus. People listen to it for fun.

examples.en: Get well soon! We all miss you.
examples.zh: 祝你早日康復！我們都很想你。

examples.en: The summer vacation will end soon, so let's make the most of it.
examples.zh: 暑假很快就要結束了，讓我們好好把握剩下的時光。

examples.en: As soon as the bell rang, the students rushed to the playground.
examples.zh: 鐘聲一響，學生們便立刻衝向操場。

explains.en: It means after a short time. A bus may come in a few minutes. The word can also mean early.
A person may arrive shortly. A baby may be born in the coming days. This word tells that the wait will not be long.
Use this word for something that will happen in a little while. A friend may call shortly. It can also mean early in life.

examples.en: My sore throat hurts when I swallow.
examples.zh: 我吞嚥時喉嚨會痛。

examples.en: His feet were sore after the long walk.
examples.zh: 長途步行後他的腳很痠痛。

examples.en: She had a sore knee after the game.
examples.zh: 比賽後她的膝蓋很痛。

entries.definition: （形）疼痛的；酸痛的；惱火的；（名）痛處；潰瘍

explains.en: It describes pain or tenderness in the body. A person may feel pain in a tooth. It can also mean angry or upset.
A muscle may hurt after exercise. A throat can feel painful during a cold. This word may describe a feeling of anger.
This word means painful or tender. A person may have a hurt foot. It can also describe hurt feelings.

examples.en: I am sorry for being late today.
examples.zh: 我為今天的遲到感到抱歉。

examples.en: I feel deeply sorry for the families affected by the earthquake.
examples.zh: 我對受到地震影響的家庭深表同情與難過。

examples.en: Say sorry immediately if you accidentally step on someone's foot.
examples.zh: 如果不小心踩到別人的腳，請立刻道歉。

explains.en: People say this after a mistake or when they feel sad for someone. A child may use it after breaking a toy. It can show regret.
This word can mean feeling bad about an event. A person may say it after bumping into a friend. It can also describe sadness for another person.
A speaker may use this word to ask for forgiveness. It can show care for someone in trouble. A person may say it after doing wrong.

examples.en: That idea sounds exciting and creative!
examples.zh: 那個點子聽起來刺激又有創意！

examples.en: The calming sound of ocean waves lapping against the shore helped me relax.
examples.zh: 海浪輕輕拍打海岸的舒緩聲音幫助我放鬆身心。

examples.en: Despite the storm, the sturdy wooden cabin remained structurally sound.
examples.zh: 儘管經歷了暴風雨，這座堅固的木屋結構依然完好無損。

explains.en: It is something heard by the ears. A bell makes one. The word can also mean a healthy condition.
A voice or music can be heard. A loud bang makes a strong one. This word may describe a body that is in good condition.
People hear this through their ears. A guitar can make a lovely one. The same word can mean sensible or healthy.

examples.en: A hot bowl of corn soup warms you up quickly.
examples.zh: 一碗熱騰騰的玉米濃湯能讓你迅速暖和。

examples.en: Taiwanese beef noodle soup has won international culinary awards.
examples.zh: 台灣牛肉麵在國際美食界屢獲殊榮。

examples.en: Grandmother simmered chicken soup with ginger for three hours.
examples.zh: 奶奶用老薑慢火燉煮了三小時的雞湯。

explains.en: This warm liquid food may have vegetables or meat. People eat it with a spoon. It can be served in a bowl.
A cook may boil water with vegetables to make this dish. A child can eat it when feeling unwell. Bread may be served beside it.
This food is often hot. It may be clear or thick. A spoon helps people eat it.

examples.en: Kenting is in the south, known for sunny beaches.
examples.zh: 墾丁在南部，以陽光明媚的海灘聞名。

examples.en: Many elderly people travel south during winter to escape frigid weather.
examples.zh: 許多長者在冬天前往南方避寒。

examples.en: Kaohsiung is Taiwan's largest port city located in the sunny south.
examples.zh: 高雄是位於陽光明媚南部的台灣第一大港口城市。

explains.en: This is one of the four main directions. It is opposite north. A compass often marks it with the letter S.
Face the direction where the sun rises. The direction to your right has this name. A compass can help you check which way you are facing.
On a map with north at the top, this direction is toward the bottom. A town can lie this way from another town. The weather there depends on where you are in the world.

examples.en: The astronaut traveled through space.
examples.zh: 太空人穿越太空。

examples.en: There is enough space for one more chair.
examples.zh: 還有足夠的空間可以再放一張椅子。

examples.en: The cat found a warm space by the window.
examples.zh: 貓在窗邊找到一個溫暖的位置。

explains.en: It means the area beyond Earth’s air. Stars and planets are found there. A rocket can carry a person through it.
A room has an amount of open area for people to move around. Stars are found in a huge region beyond Earth. A satellite may travel through it.
This word may mean a place with room to move. It can also name the dark region beyond our planet. A ship or satellite may travel through it.

examples.en: Can you speak English and Mandarin?
examples.zh: 你會說英文和國語嗎？

examples.en: Actions speak much louder than words.
examples.zh: 行動勝於空談。

examples.en: She was invited to speak at the international youth forum.
examples.zh: 她受邀在國際青年論壇上發表演說。

explains.en: It means using the voice to say words. A person may talk with a friend. The word can also mean giving a speech.
A child may use words in class. A teacher can talk to parents. This action uses the mouth and voice.
This word means talking aloud. A person may use it to share an idea. It can also mean knowing a language.

examples.en: Today is a very special day for our family.
examples.zh: 今天對我們全家來說是一個非常特別的日子。

examples.en: The restaurant offers a special discount price for birthday guests.
examples.zh: 該餐廳為壽星顧客提供專屬的特別優惠價格。

examples.en: She has a special talent for learning foreign languages effortlessly.
examples.zh: 她有一種能輕鬆迅速學會外國語言的獨特天賦。

explains.en: It means different from usual. A birthday may feel important to a child. A gift can be made for one person.
A certain day may be important to a family. A person may have a skill that few others share. This word describes something out of the ordinary.
This word tells that something is not common. A holiday can feel important. A person may have a particular reason for doing something.

examples.en: Can you spell your last name for me?
examples.zh: 你可以把你的姓拼給我聽嗎？

examples.en: The child learned to spell the word correctly.
examples.zh: 那個孩子學會了正確拼寫這個字。

examples.en: She can spell many long words.
examples.zh: 她會拼很多長單字。

entries.definition: （動）拼字；拼出；（名）一段時間；咒語

explains.en: It means saying or writing the letters in a word in the correct order. A child may learn this in class. A teacher may ask for each letter.
A person may write a word letter by letter. A contest can test this skill. The order of letters matters.
This action uses the names of letters. A student may practice with a list. It can help with writing words correctly.

examples.en: I spent two hours reviewing my English vocabulary.
examples.zh: 我花了兩個小時複習英文單字。

examples.en: How much time do you spend on homework each weekday evening?
examples.zh: 你每個平日晚上花多少時間在功課上？

examples.en: We spent our summer holidays exploring coral reefs and marine biology.
examples.zh: 我們整個暑假都在探索珊瑚礁與海洋生態。

explains.en: It means using time or money. A family may use a day at the beach. A person may pay for food.
A child may use an hour doing homework. A shopper can use money at a store. The word can mean passing time in a certain way.
This action uses up time, money, or energy. A worker may use a day on a task. It can also mean living time in a certain way.

examples.en: Beautiful flowers bloom in warm spring.
examples.zh: 美麗的花朵在溫暖的春天綻放。

examples.en: Natural hot springs in Beitou attract thousands of relaxed visitors.
examples.zh: 北投的天然溫泉吸引了成千上萬前來放鬆的遊客。

examples.en: The curious cat sprang quickly onto the high fence.
examples.zh: 好奇的貓咪敏捷地跳上了高高的圍牆。

examples.en: High baking temperatures trigger massive oven spring, creating a dramatic crust ear.
examples.zh: 烤箱下火高溫瞬間引爆強大的「烤箱膨脹爆發力」（Oven Spring），在割線上炸出立體高聳的麥穗兔耳。

examples.en: Trapped steam and active yeast work together to maximize dough spring during the first ten minutes.
examples.zh: 密封的烘烤水蒸氣與受熱劇烈活躍的酵母菌在進烤箱前十分鐘協同做功，將爆發力推向極致。

examples.en: Colorful cherry blossoms bloom across Taiwan's mountain trails every spring.
examples.zh: 每年初春時節，五彩繽紛的粉嫩櫻花便在全台灣各處風景秀麗的高山登山步道競相盛開。

examples.en: Individually wrapped pocket springs isolate motion transfer so your partner's tossing doesn't wake you.
examples.zh: 數百顆各自獨立運作的獨立袋裝彈簧能完美隔絕震動傳遞，就算枕邊人翻身也絲毫不受打擾。

examples.en: High-tensile steel springs offer responsive bounce while conforming to lumbar curvature.
examples.zh: 高錳碳鋼鍛造的獨立筒彈簧具備極佳的韌性回彈力，能完美貼合腰部曲線並提供飽滿支撐。

examples.en: Zoned pocket spring systems provide firmer coil resistance underneath the heavier hip region.
examples.zh: 分區獨立筒彈簧系統在承托身體重量最沉的臀部中段配置加粗強韌彈簧，防止腰椎過度塌陷。

examples.en: Trapping high-pressure steam inside the hot Dutch oven generates explosive oven spring during the first 20 minutes.
examples.zh: 在滾燙鑄鐵鍋內鎖住高壓水蒸氣，在入爐前二十分鐘激發出驚人的烤箱入爐膨脹力。

examples.en: A well-fermented sourdough exhibits remarkable vertical spring when baked on a preheated pizza stone.
examples.zh: 發酵成熟度絕佳的酸種麵團，在放上預熱充分的披薩石板烘烤時會展現驚人的向上拔高爆發力。

examples.en: Insufficient yeast vitality or overproofing results in a flat loaf that lacks proper oven spring.
examples.zh: 若酵母活力衰退或後發過度耗盡糖分，烤出的麵包將扁塌下陷，完全喪失入爐膨脹力。

examples.en: Winding the crown coils the resilient alloy mainspring tightly inside the toothed brass drum.
examples.zh: 手動旋轉錶冠，將高彈性合金「主發條」（Mainspring）緊密盤捲於發條盒內以儲存機械位能。

examples.en: Fragrant cherry blossoms bloom abundantly along riverbanks as early spring arrives across the country.
examples.zh: 隨著溫暖初春腳步輕盈降臨寶島，沿著清澈河岸盛開的嬌豔櫻花將整條水岸步道染成一片浪漫粉紅。

examples.en: Tired travelers soaked their sore feet in the bubbling waters of the mountain natural hot spring.
examples.zh: 舟車勞頓的疲憊旅人紛紛脫下鞋襪，將酸痛的雙腳浸泡在咕嚕冒泡的高山天然碳酸溫泉泉水裡。

examples.en: Large helical steel springs decouple the concert hall foundation from surrounding urban vibrations.
examples.zh: 巨型「螺旋鋼製減震彈簧」（Steel Springs），將音樂廳地基與周遭繁忙都市的劇烈震動完全彈性解耦。

examples.en: Fresh cherry blossoms blanketed the countryside in brilliant pink hues as warm spring arrived.
examples.zh: 隨著溫暖宜人的春天悄然降臨，漫山遍野盛開的嬌豔櫻花將整片鄉村原野妝點得粉嫩動人。

examples.en: The old coil mattress lost its resilience as rusted interior metal springs began poking through the padding.
examples.zh: 這張老舊的彈簧床墊逐漸失去了應有的回彈支撐力，內部生鏽的螺旋彈簧甚至開始頂穿表層墊料。

entries.definition: 春天；泉水；跳躍；烤箱爆發力 (Oven Spring)；彈簧；獨立袋裝彈簧 (Pocket Spring)；烤箱入爐高溫蒸氣膨脹爆發力；彈性合金主發條 (儲存純機械旋緊位能)；阻絕外部捷運震動之重型鋼製螺旋減震彈簧

explains.en: It is the season after winter and before summer. Flowers begin to grow. The weather often gets warmer.
A coiled metal part can jump back when pressed. A person may leap from the ground. The word also means a time of year with fresh flowers.
Trees may grow new leaves during this season. A small animal may jump forward. The same word can name a curled metal part.

examples.en: Draw a square around the answer.
examples.zh: 在答案周圍畫一個方框。

examples.en: The room has a large square window.
examples.zh: 房間有一扇大方形窗戶。

examples.en: We met in the town square.
examples.zh: 我們在城鎮廣場碰面。

explains.en: This flat shape has four sides of equal length. Each corner is a right angle, like the corner of a sheet of paper. All four sides join to make a closed shape.
A chessboard has many small spaces with this shape. They form rows across the board. Dark and light spaces take turns in each row.
This noun can also mean an open public area in a town. People may meet there or visit a market. Shops and other buildings often stand around its edges.

examples.en: Climb each stair slowly.
examples.zh: 慢慢爬每一階樓梯。

examples.en: The child sat on the top stair.
examples.zh: 孩子坐在最上面一階樓梯。

examples.en: One stair was broken near the door.
examples.zh: 門附近有一階樓梯壞了。

explains.en: This is one step in a set that leads between levels. You put a foot on it as you go up. A handrail can help you keep your balance.
A building may have many raised steps between floors. Each one gives you a place to put your foot. You can use them to go up or down.
You might sit on the lowest step by a door. The next step is a little higher. A row of these lets people reach the entrance.

examples.en: Please stand in line and wait for your turn.
examples.zh: 請排隊站好並等待輪到你。

examples.en: The brave old fortress has stood on the hill for over three centuries.
examples.zh: 這座堅固古老的要塞已在山丘上屹立了超過三個世紀。

examples.en: I cannot stand loud construction noise while trying to study.
examples.zh: 讀書時我實在無法忍受吵雜的施工噪音。

explains.en: It means being upright on your feet. A person may do this in a line. The word can also mean accepting or supporting an idea.
A child may get up from a chair. A person can remain upright while waiting. The word can also mean tolerating something.
This action uses the feet to hold the body upright. A worker may do it all day. It can also mean supporting a friend.

examples.en: We can see lots of bright stars in the country.
examples.zh: 我們在鄉下可以看到許多閃亮的星星。

examples.en: He dreams of becoming an international pop music star.
examples.zh: 他夢想成為一名國際流行音樂巨星。

examples.en: She wished upon a shooting star as it streaked across the dark sky.
examples.zh: 當一顆流星劃過夜空時，她對著流星許下了願望。

explains.en: A bright ball of light shines far away in space. The sun is one. A person may draw one with five points.
At night, small lights appear above the Earth. A telescope can make them easier to see. A famous person may also have this title.
This object shines in the night sky. It is very far away. A person may wish upon one in a story.

examples.en: The movie is about to start; take your seats.
examples.zh: 電影馬上就要開始了，請就座。

examples.en: Let's start the morning project meeting with a brief round of introductions.
examples.zh: 讓我們用簡短的一輪自我介紹來開啟今晨的專案會議。

examples.en: She plans to start her own online boutique clothing business next spring.
examples.zh: 她計劃在明年春天創立屬於自己的線上精品服飾事業。

explains.en: It means doing the first part of an activity. A race may begin when a signal sounds. A person can also open a machine.
A class may begin at nine. A runner moves when the event begins. The word can also mean beginning to do something.
This action happens at the beginning. A person may open a trip with a first step. A car engine can begin working.

examples.en: I will meet you at Main Station at noon.
examples.zh: 我中午在台北車站跟你碰面。

examples.en: The police station is right next to the post office.
examples.zh: 警察局就在郵局隔壁。

examples.en: We stopped at a gas station to refuel the vehicle.
examples.zh: 我們停在加油站給車子加油。

examples.en: The modern hydrogen refueling station fills heavy-duty freight trucks in five minutes, matching diesel convenience.
examples.zh: 現代「智慧加氫站」（Refueling Station），僅需五分鐘即可為重型貨卡加滿燃料，媲美傳統柴油車。

examples.en: Commuters waited patiently on the elevated subway station platform during the rainy morning rush hour.
examples.zh: 在陰雨濛濛的上班尖峰時刻，眾多通勤民眾井然有序地在高架捷運車站月台黃線後方排隊候車。

examples.en: Meteorologists maintain an automated high-altitude weather station atop the central mountain peak.
examples.zh: 中央氣象署在高山主峰頂端設立了一座全自動無人高山氣象觀測站，全天候記錄即時氣壓風向。

entries.definition: 車站；局；站；智慧型 700-bar 加氫站 (三分鐘快速安全加滿卡車)

explains.en: People wait for a train or bus here. A worker may sell tickets. The building can have a platform.
A train stops at this place to let riders get on or off. A schedule may hang on the wall. Travelers can wait inside.
A bus may pick up passengers at this place. A worker may answer questions. It can also be a place for police or radio work.

examples.en: Stay home if you catch a bad cold.
examples.zh: 如果你重感冒，請待在家裡。

examples.en: We stayed at a comfortable resort during our vacation in Hualien.
examples.zh: 在花蓮度假期間我們住在一家舒適的度假村。

examples.en: Don't stay up late cramming the night before an important exam.
examples.zh: 重要考試前一晚切莫熬夜死記硬背。

explains.en: It means remaining in one place. A guest may sleep at a hotel. The word can also mean a short visit.
A person may not leave a town. A family can live with friends for a few days. The word can also mean a period spent somewhere.
This action means continuing to be somewhere. A child may visit an aunt for a week. It can also mean waiting.

examples.en: Are you still working on your project?
examples.zh: 你還在忙你的專題計畫嗎？

examples.en: Please stand completely still while the doctor takes the X-ray.
examples.zh: 醫生照 X 光時，請完全保持靜止不動。

examples.en: Although it was raining, they still enjoyed their cycling trip.
examples.zh: 儘管下著雨，他們仍然十分享受單車之旅。

examples.en: It was late, but my brother was still studying.
examples.zh: 時間已經很晚了，但我哥哥依然在用功讀書。

examples.en: Stand still and smile while the photographer takes your portrait.
examples.zh: 當攝影師為你拍攝個人肖像時，請站好別動並露出微笑。

examples.en: The mystery surrounding the lost ancient kingdom still puzzles modern archaeologists.
examples.zh: 圍繞這座失落古王國的神秘謎團至今依然令現代考古學家百思不解。

explains.en: It can mean not moving. A pond may have no waves. It can also mean even now or yet.
A person may remain in one place. A room may be very quiet. This word can also mean despite what has happened.
It describes something calm and without movement. A person may continue to wait. It can also mean even at this time.

examples.en: The bus stops right in front of the school.
examples.zh: 公車剛好停在學校正前方。

examples.en: Please stop talking and open your textbooks to page ten.
examples.zh: 請停止講話，並翻開課本第十頁。

examples.en: There is a red stop sign at the street intersection.
examples.zh: 街角十字路口有一個紅色的停車標誌。

explains.en: It means making something no longer move. A bus may do this at a red light. The word can also name a place where vehicles wait.
A person can end an action. A sign may tell drivers what to do. It can also mean a small break on a trip.
This action means bringing movement to an end. A car may wait at a line. A worker can prevent a machine from working.

examples.en: Let's drop by the convenience store.
examples.zh: 我們順道去一趟便利商店吧。

examples.en: You should store fresh milk in the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 你應該把鮮奶存放在冰箱裡。

examples.en: The department store is holding an annual anniversary sale.
examples.zh: 這家百貨公司正在舉辦一年一度的週年慶。

explains.en: People buy things here. Food, clothes, and toys may be sold. A large business can have many locations.
A person may go to this place for milk. Shelves hold goods for buyers. The word can also mean keeping items for later.
This business sells items to people. A cashier takes payment. A warehouse may keep goods until they are needed.

examples.en: Grandma told us a fairy story before bed.
examples.zh: 奶奶在睡前給我們講了一個童話故事。

examples.en: The author based her inspiring novel on a true survival story.
examples.zh: 作者將她鼓舞人心的小說建立在真實的求生故事之上。

examples.en: The department store building rises twelve stories above the ground.
examples.zh: 這棟百貨公司大樓地上高達十二層樓。

explains.en: A book may tell about people and events. A parent may read one to a child. It can be true or made up.
A writer uses words to tell what happened. A movie may have one too. It often has a beginning, middle, and end.
People may tell this aloud to friends. A book can have many pages. It may be based on true events or imagination.

examples.en: Go straight for two blocks and you will see it.
examples.zh: 筆直走兩條街，你就會看到它了。

examples.en: Use a wooden ruler to draw a straight pencil line.
examples.zh: 用木尺畫一條筆直的鉛筆線。

examples.en: He looked me straight in the eye and spoke with complete honesty.
examples.zh: 他直視著我的眼睛，說得十分坦誠真摯。

explains.en: It means without a curve or bend. A ruler helps draw a line this way. A person can walk forward on a path.
A road may continue without turning. A person can stand tall. This word can also mean honest and direct.
A line from one point to another may have no bends. A tree trunk may grow upright. A person can give an honest answer.

examples.en: A strange light moved across the sky.
examples.zh: 一道奇怪的光劃過天空。

examples.en: The house made a strange sound at night.
examples.zh: 那棟房子晚上發出奇怪的聲音。

examples.en: It felt strange to walk alone in the dark.
examples.zh: 獨自在黑暗中行走感覺很奇怪。

entries.definition: 奇怪的；陌生的；不尋常的。
