explains.en: It describes something unusual. A sound may make a person feel unsure. Someone may act in a way people do not expect.
An unfamiliar object may look new. A story can include events that seem odd. The word can describe a person who acts differently.
This word means unusual. A noise at night may be hard to explain. A visitor may come from a faraway place.

examples.en: The children walked along the quiet street.
examples.zh: 孩子們沿著安靜的街道散步。

examples.en: Our school is across the street from the park.
examples.zh: 我們學校在公園的街道對面。

examples.en: A new store opened on this street.
examples.zh: 這條街上開了一家新店。

explains.en: Cars and people travel along this public path in a town. Stores may stand along it. A sidewalk is often beside it.
A city has many of these paths. Drivers use them to reach homes and shops. A person can cross at a marked place.
This paved way is found between buildings. A bus may travel along it. People walk along its edge.

examples.en: The kite string broke in the wind.
examples.zh: 風箏線被風吹斷了。

examples.en: She tied the package with a piece of string.
examples.zh: 她用一段細繩把包裹綁起來。

examples.en: The guitar has six strings.
examples.zh: 這把吉他有六條弦。

explains.en: A thin cord may hold a kite to a hand. It can also mean a line of words or letters. A guitar has several.
A toy may be tied with this narrow cord. A person can pull it to open curtains. It can also mean a small line used in a computer system.
Many fine strands can be twisted together. A bead may slide along one. The word can also mean a long set of characters.

examples.en: Regular exercise will help you stay strong and energetic.
examples.zh: 規律運動會幫助你保持強壯且充滿活力。

examples.en: The typhoon brought strong winds that knocked down trees.
examples.zh: 颱風帶來強風，吹倒了路邊的路樹。

examples.en: She ordered a cup of strong black coffee to stay awake.
examples.zh: 她點了一杯濃郁的黑咖啡來提神。

explains.en: It means having great force. A healthy person may lift a heavy box. A wall can withstand wind.
A large dog may pull hard on a lead. A person can feel well after rest. This word can describe a powerful taste.
This word describes something that does not break easily. A team can work well together. A wind may blow with great force.

examples.en: There are thirty students in our class.
examples.zh: 我們班上有三十位學生。

examples.en: Every student must hand in the homework before Friday.
examples.zh: 每位學生都必須在星期五前繳交功課。

examples.en: College students often join various clubs and activities.
examples.zh: 大學生通常會參加各式各樣的社團與活動。

explains.en: A child learns in a classroom with a teacher. The word can mean a person who studies. A school may have many in each class.
A person who attends a college may be called this. They learn facts and practice skills. A notebook may belong to one.
This word describes a learner. A teacher may help one with homework. A person may study a subject for many years.

examples.en: I usually study in the library after school.
examples.zh: 我放學後通常在圖書館讀書。

examples.en: Recent scientific studies show that sleep is vital for memory.
examples.zh: 近期科學研究顯示睡眠對記憶力至關重要。

examples.en: He decided to study abroad in Canada for high school.
examples.zh: 他決定高中前往加拿大留學深造。

explains.en: It means using books or lessons to learn. A child may do homework in the evening. A person can also examine a topic closely.
A student may spend time learning new facts. A family may read together before a test. The word can also mean looking carefully at a subject.
This action helps a person learn. A book can teach history or math. A researcher may examine how animals live.

examples.en: Don't do silly things that might hurt yourself.
examples.zh: 別做可能會傷害自己的傻事。

examples.en: It was a silly mistake that could have been easily avoided.
examples.zh: 那是一個本來可以輕易避免的糊塗小錯誤。

examples.en: I felt stupid after realizing I had put my shirt on backwards.
examples.zh: 在發現自己把衣服穿反之後，我感到自己好蠢。

explains.en: It is an unkind word for a person who does not think well. People should avoid calling others this. A mistake does not make someone bad.
This hurtful word can describe a very foolish action. It is better to speak kindly. A person can learn from an error.
People sometimes use this insult when angry. It can hurt someone’s feelings. A kinder choice is to explain what went wrong.

examples.en: Science is my favorite school subject.
examples.zh: 自然科學是我最喜歡的學科。

examples.en: The subject of today's morning assembly speech was digital safety.
examples.zh: 今天朝會演講的主題是數位網路安全。

examples.en: Every complete English sentence requires a subject and a predicate verb.
examples.zh: 每個完整的英文句子都需要主詞與謂語動詞。

explains.en: A school class may learn about animals, math, or art. A lesson area has this name. People can talk about one during a discussion.
A book may focus on one area of learning. A teacher gives work in it. A class can change to a different area.
This word means a field of study. English and science are examples. It may also mean what a conversation is about.

examples.en: The team was successful in the final game.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍在決賽中獲勝。

examples.en: She became a successful writer.
examples.zh: 她成為一位成功的作家。

examples.en: His plan was successful after much work.
examples.zh: 經過許多努力，他的計畫成功了。

explains.en: It means reaching a goal. A person may finish a hard task. The result may make a family proud.
A team that wins a game has done well. A worker may complete a project. This word describes a good result.
This word tells that an effort worked. A student may pass a test. People may feel happy after doing well.

examples.en: Would you like sugar with your black tea?
examples.zh: 你的紅茶要加糖嗎？

examples.en: Consuming too much added sugar is harmful to your overall health.
examples.zh: 攝取過多添加糖對你的整體健康有害。

examples.en: Sugar cane was historically an important cash crop in southern Taiwan.
examples.zh: 甘蔗在歷史上曾是台灣南部重要的經濟作物。

explains.en: This sweet white powder comes from a plant. People add it to tea or cakes. Too much can harm teeth.
A cook may use this to make a dessert taste sweet. It can come from cane or beets. Small grains dissolve in hot tea.
This food makes many treats taste sweet. It is often kept in a jar. A person should eat only a little.

examples.en: The sun rises in the east.
examples.zh: 太陽從東方升起。

examples.en: Wearing sunglasses protects your eyes from the bright sun.
examples.zh: 戴太陽眼鏡可以保護眼睛免受強烈陽光傷害。

examples.en: The flowers blossomed happily under the morning sun.
examples.zh: 花兒在晨光朝陽下燦爛綻放。

explains.en: A bright star gives light and warmth to Earth. It rises in the morning and sets at night. Plants need its light to grow.
People feel its warmth on a clear day. The moon reflects its light. It is the star closest to Earth.
This star lights the day. It helps plants make food. A person should not look at it directly.

examples.en: We had a picnic on a sunny Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們在一個陽光明媚的週日野餐。

examples.en: It was a bright and sunny morning without a cloud in sight.
examples.zh: 那是一個晴朗萬里的早晨，天空中萬里無雲。

examples.en: Sunny days always lift people's spirits and energy.
examples.zh: 陽光明媚的日子總能讓人精神煥發、充滿活力。

explains.en: It describes weather with lots of sunshine. People may wear light clothes outside. The sky may look bright and clear.
A clear day can feel warm. A person may use glasses to block the bright light. This word tells that the weather is bright.
This describing word means full of sunshine. A picnic may happen in such weather. Plants get light from above.

examples.en: Mom goes to the supermarket every weekend.
examples.zh: 媽媽每個週末都去超市。

examples.en: There is a large supermarket across from our apartment.
examples.zh: 我們公寓對面有一間大型超市。

examples.en: We bought fresh milk, bread, and fruits at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 我們在超市買了鮮奶、麵包和水果。

examples.en: PX Mart is a popular supermarket chain throughout Taiwan.
examples.zh: 全聯是全台灣廣受歡迎的連鎖超級市場。

examples.en: Supermarkets offer a wide variety of domestic and imported food products.
examples.zh: 超級市場提供品項繁多的國內與進口食品。

examples.en: I usually do my weekly grocery shopping at the nearby supermarket on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我通常在週日去附近的超級市場進行一週的採買。

explains.en: People buy food and home goods here. The building may have many aisles. A cart helps carry items.
A large food shop sells fruit, milk, and bread. A person may push a cart through it. Workers put goods on shelves.
This place has many kinds of food for sale. A cashier takes payment at the end. People often visit each week.

examples.en: Are you sure the door is locked?
examples.zh: 你確定門鎖好了嗎？

examples.en: I am sure she will arrive soon.
examples.zh: 我確信她很快就會到。

examples.en: He is sure about his answer.
examples.zh: 他對自己的答案很有把握。

entries.definition: （形）確定的；可靠的；（副）當然；確實。

explains.en: It means certain and without doubt. A person may feel this after checking a fact. It can also be used to agree.
A child may know the answer with confidence. A person can ask whether a friend is certain. The word may mean yes.
This word shows that someone has no doubt. A person may ask if a door is locked. It can also mean definitely.

examples.en: The birthday gift was a delightful surprise.
examples.zh: 這份生日禮物是一個令人愉悅的驚喜。

examples.en: Much to our pleasant surprise, the weather cleared up right before the picnic.
examples.zh: 讓我們非常驚喜的是，天氣在野餐開始前恰好放晴了。

examples.en: We organized a memorable surprise party to celebrate our teacher's retirement.
examples.zh: 我們精心籌辦了一場難忘的驚喜派對來慶祝老師光榮退休。

explains.en: It is something unexpected that makes a person feel amazed. A party may be planned in secret. A gift can cause this feeling.
A person may not know what will happen next. A sudden visit can make them feel amazed. The word can also mean causing that feeling.
This event is not expected. A box may hold a gift inside. It can make a person happy or shocked.

examples.en: I was surprised by the birthday cake.
examples.zh: 我看到生日蛋糕時很驚訝。

examples.en: They were surprised to see a deer in the yard.
examples.zh: 他們看到院子裡有一隻鹿，感到很驚訝。

examples.en: She looked surprised when the lights came on.
examples.zh: 燈亮起時她看起來很驚訝。

explains.en: A person may feel amazed by an unexpected gift. A sudden noise can cause this feeling. The person did not expect it.
A child may be amazed at a magic trick. A friend may visit without warning. This word describes the feeling afterward.
This word means feeling amazement. A strange event can cause it. A person may open wide eyes.

examples.en: Watermelons in Hualien are juicy and sweet.
examples.zh: 花蓮的西瓜多汁又香甜。

examples.en: It was very sweet of you to remember my grandmother's birthday.
examples.zh: 你能記得我奶奶的生日，真是太貼心了。

examples.en: He has a major sweet tooth and loves cakes, puddings, and chocolates.
examples.zh: 他是個不折不扣的甜食愛好者，超愛蛋糕、布丁和巧克力。

explains.en: It describes a taste like honey or fruit. A child may enjoy candy. The word can also mean kind and caring.
A ripe peach may have this pleasant taste. A person who speaks gently can have this quality. It can also describe a dessert.
This word can mean sugary or pleasant. A kind person may use gentle words. The opposite taste is bitter.

examples.en: Dinner is ready on the table.
examples.zh: 晚餐已經在餐桌上準備好了。

examples.en: We reserved a table for four at the Italian restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們在義大利餐廳預訂了一張四人桌。

examples.en: The report presents the experimental results in a clear table.
examples.zh: 報告在清楚的表格中呈現了實驗結果。

explains.en: People eat meals at this flat piece of furniture. It may have four legs. A family can sit around it.
A student may do homework here. A kitchen can have one for meals. It has a flat top and legs.
This furniture holds dishes and books. A person may place a cup on it. Several chairs can go around it.

examples.en: The dog wagged its tail when I came home.
examples.zh: 我回家時狗搖了搖尾巴。

examples.en: The bird spread its tail feathers.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥展開尾羽。

examples.en: A lizard can lose its tail and grow a new one.
examples.zh: 蜥蜴可能會失去尾巴並長出新的尾巴。

explains.en: An animal has a long part that grows from its back end. A dog may wag it when happy. A peacock has colorful feathers there.
This body part may help a fish move through water. A cat can curl it around its body. It can be short or long.
A horse swishes this part to keep flies away. A bird may spread its feathers. It grows at the back of an animal.

examples.en: It will take fifteen minutes to get there.
examples.zh: 到那裡需要花費十五分鐘。

examples.en: We took lots of wonderful photos during our hike in Taroko Gorge.
examples.zh: 我們在太魯閣峽谷健行時拍了許多精彩照片。

examples.en: Remember to take your prescribed medicine after each meal.
examples.zh: 記得三餐飯後服用醫師開立的處方藥。

examples.en: The perfectionist director shot twenty takes to get the ideal performance.
examples.zh: 追求極致完美的導演同一個鏡頭重拍了二十次才捕捉到最理想的演繹。

examples.en: After a flawless first take, the cast and crew cheered with relief.
examples.zh: 在全員超常發揮、一次拍攝就完美過關的第一鏡（Take 1）喊卡後，片場全體演職員如釋重負地熱烈鼓掌。

examples.en: Don't be discouraged by repeated takes; capturing cinematic magic requires dedication.
examples.zh: 千萬不要因為同一個鏡頭反覆重拍而感到沮喪氣餒；捕捉大銀幕上的動人魔法時刻本就需要毫無保留的執著。

entries.definition: 拿取；攜帶；搭乘；花費；拍攝次數；鏡頭畫面

explains.en: It means picking up or carrying something. A person may hold a bag in one hand. It can also mean accepting an offer.
A child may bring a book from a shelf. A bus can carry passengers. The word can mean choosing a certain amount.
This action moves an item from one place. A person may hold an umbrella in the rain. It can also mean needing a medicine.

examples.en: Let's talk about our weekend plans.
examples.zh: 我們來聊聊週末的計畫吧。

examples.en: We had a long heart-to-heart talk about our future dreams.
examples.zh: 我們針對未來的夢想進行了一次長談交心。

examples.en: Don't talk during the movie screening in the cinema.
examples.zh: 電影院放映期間請不要說話。

explains.en: People speak aloud when sharing ideas. Friends may do this over lunch. The word can also mean a speech or conversation.
A teacher may speak with a parent. Two people can share ideas. The action may be calm or serious.
This word means speaking with another person. A group may have a long conversation. It can also describe a long chat.

examples.en: Jeremy Lin is a very tall basketball player.
examples.zh: 林書豪是一位非常高大的籃球員。

examples.en: Tall coconut palm trees line the beautiful tropical beach.
examples.zh: 高聳的椰子樹排列在美麗的熱帶海灘旁。

examples.en: How tall have you grown since the beginning of this year?
examples.zh: 從今年初以來你長高了多少呢？

explains.en: This describes a great distance from bottom to top. A giraffe has this body shape compared with most other land animals. A building with many floors can also be described this way.
A tree may reach far above the ground. A person can be greater in height than a friend. The word can also describe a high amount.
This word describes someone with greater height. A lamp can stand above a table. A mountain may reach far into the clouds.

examples.en: Stick the poster on the wall with clear tape.
examples.zh: 用透明膠帶把海報貼在牆上。

examples.en: We sealed the cardboard moving boxes tightly with brown packing tape.
examples.zh: 我們用棕色封箱膠帶將紙箱嚴密貼牢。

examples.en: The old cassette tape holds precious recordings of my grandfather singing.
examples.zh: 這盒老舊錄音帶保存著我祖父唱歌的珍貴錄音。

explains.en: This is a narrow strip with a sticky side. It can hold two sheets of paper together. People also use it to close boxes.
This can be a long strip used for recording sound. Older music players used it inside small plastic cases. Music was stored along the strip.
This verb can mean recording sounds or moving pictures. A family might record a school show. They can watch the recording later.

examples.en: This mango shaved ice tastes heavenly!
examples.zh: 這碗芒果刨冰嚐起來真是人間美味！

examples.en: Taste the soup first before adding any extra salt or pepper.
examples.zh: 在加入額外的鹽或胡椒之前，先嚐一下湯的味道。

examples.en: Everyone has different tastes in music, movies, and fashion.
examples.zh: 每個人在音樂、電影與流行時尚方面的品味都各不相同。

explains.en: It is the flavor of food or drink. A lemon has a sour one. A person can try food with the tongue.
A cook may check soup before serving. Sweet, salty, and bitter are kinds. The word can also mean a small amount.
This sense helps people enjoy food. A person may like a certain flavor. As an action, it means trying a little food.

examples.en: Let's call a taxi because it's raining heavily.
examples.zh: 下大雨了，我們叫計程車吧。

examples.en: Yellow taxis can be flagged down easily on the street.
examples.zh: 黃色計程車在街上很容易隨招隨停。

examples.en: The taxi driver was very friendly and recommended great local restaurants.
examples.zh: 計程車司機非常友善，還推薦了很棒的在地美食。

examples.en: The driver sits inside the ergonomic cab, monitoring triple touchscreen telemetry flight-deck displays.
examples.zh: 司機員端坐在符合人體工學的「列車駕駛室」（Cab）內，全神貫注審視三重備援的數位行車儀表。

examples.en: We hailed a yellow taxi cab outside Taipei Main Station to take us to our hotel across town.
examples.zh: 我們在台北火車站前計程車招呼站搭上一輛小黃計程車，平穩前往位於市區另一端的飯店辦理入住。

examples.en: Truck drivers customize the interior of their long-haul sleeper cab with a compact bed and mini-refrigerator.
examples.zh: 長途貨卡聯結車駕駛將車頭後方的臥鋪駕駛座艙精心改裝，配備舒適單人床墊與節能小冰箱。

entries.definition: 計程車；視野寬廣雙人配置流線型高速列車駕駛室；駕駛室

explains.en: A car with a driver can carry people for money. A person may call one from a street. The ride can go to a home or airport.
This vehicle can be hired for a trip. A driver takes passengers where they ask. A sign on top may show it is available.
A passenger may pay a driver for a short ride. The vehicle may be yellow in some cities. A phone app can help call one.

examples.en: Would you like some hot green tea?
examples.zh: 你想來點熱綠茶嗎？

examples.en: Black tea with milk is a classic breakfast drink.
examples.zh: 奶茶是經典的早餐飲品。

examples.en: In Taiwan, tea culture has a very long history.
examples.zh: 在台灣，茶文化有著悠久的歷史。

explains.en: A warm drink is made by soaking leaves in hot water. People may drink it with milk or lemon. It can be served in a cup.
A person may have this drink with breakfast. Green and black kinds come from leaves. A pot can hold enough for a family.
This hot drink may help a person relax. A bag of dried leaves goes into a cup. Some people add honey.

examples.en: Mr. Wu teaches us mathematics and science.
examples.zh: 吳老師教我們數學和自然科學。

examples.en: Experience is the best teacher in life.
examples.zh: 經驗是人生最好的老師。

examples.en: My older brother taught me how to swim when I was eight.
examples.zh: 我哥哥在我八歲時教我學會了游泳。

explains.en: A person helps others learn. A parent may do this with a child at home. The action can mean giving a lesson.
A coach helps children learn a skill. A school worker may explain math. The word can also mean guiding a person.
This action means helping another person learn. A class leader may give directions. A parent can help with reading.

examples.en: Our English teacher is very patient.
examples.zh: 我們的英文老師非常有耐心。

examples.en: A great teacher can inspire students to learn with passion.
examples.zh: 一位優秀的老師能激發學生充滿熱情地學習。

examples.en: She wants to be a history teacher after graduation.
examples.zh: 她畢業後想成為一名歷史老師。

explains.en: A person who helps children learn works in a school. They may explain math or reading. Students ask this worker for help.
A class has an adult who leads lessons. The worker checks homework. A person may help students learn a skill.
This school worker teaches facts and skills. Children may ask questions in class. The job can take place in a room or online.

examples.en: Good teamwork is essential to win this match.
examples.zh: 良好的團隊合作是贏得這場比賽的關鍵。

examples.en: Our sales team achieved record revenue during the past quarter.
examples.zh: 我們的業務團隊在上一季度創下了歷史新高的營業額。

examples.en: Each team member brings distinct skills and creative perspectives.
examples.zh: 每位團隊成員都帶來了獨特的技能與創新的視角。

explains.en: A group of people can work or play together. A soccer side may have many members. The word can also mean people who share a job.
Friends may form a group for a game. Workers can join for a shared task. Each person has a role.
This word means a group with a shared goal. Players may practice together. A work group can solve a problem.

examples.en: Teenagers love sharing short videos on social media.
examples.zh: 青少年喜歡在社群媒體上分享短影音。

examples.en: Many teenagers balance academic schoolwork with sports club training.
examples.zh: 許多青少年在沉重學校課業與運動社團訓練之間努力尋求平衡。

examples.en: It is common for teenagers to seek independence from their parents.
examples.zh: 青少年渴望脫離父母追求獨立自主是很常見的現象。

explains.en: A person between thirteen and nineteen years of age has this label. They are no longer a small child. They are not yet an adult.
This young person is in the years between childhood and adulthood. They may attend high school. The age appears in the word’s ending.
A person in this age group may learn to drive. They may have more independence than a child. They still need help from adults.

examples.en: Please turn off your phone during the exam.
examples.zh: 考試期間請關閉手機。

examples.en: I will give you a phone call as soon as I arrive at the station.
examples.zh: 我一抵達車站就會立刻打電話給你。

examples.en: The receptionist answered the phone with a polite greeting.
examples.zh: 櫃檯接待員以禮貌的問候語接聽了電話。

explains.en: People use this device to talk with someone far away. It can be kept in a pocket. A call may use a number.
A person can call a friend using this device. Older kinds stay on a desk. A newer kind can travel in a pocket.
This tool sends voices between people. It can use wires or a wireless signal. A family may keep one at home.

examples.en: Turn down the television; it is too loud.
examples.zh: 把電視聲音關小一點，太吵了。

examples.en: Watching English television shows with subtitles improves listening skills.
examples.zh: 觀看附中文字幕的英語電視節目有助於提升聽力。

examples.en: They bought a large sixty-five-inch smart television for the living room.
examples.zh: 他們為客廳添購了一台六十五吋的大型智慧電視。

explains.en: A screen shows moving pictures and sound. Families may watch a news program at home. It can also mean the business of making shows.
People sit on a couch and watch this device. A remote can change its channel. It may show films, sports, or news.
This screen brings pictures into a home. A person can watch shows on it. The short form uses two letters.

examples.en: Can you tell me the way to the station?
examples.zh: 你能告訴我往車站怎麼走嗎？

examples.en: Grandfather loves to tell fascinating folk stories by the fireplace.
examples.zh: 爺爺喜歡在壁爐旁講述迷人的民間傳說。

examples.en: It is always best to tell the truth even when it is difficult.
examples.zh: 即使困難重重，說實話永遠是最好的選擇。

explains.en: It means giving information with words. A parent may share a fact with a child. It can also mean knowing a person or place.
A person may explain what happened. A friend can give a secret. The word may also mean recognizing someone.
This action uses speech to share facts. A teacher may explain a rule. A person can ask someone about an event.

examples.en: Longshan Temple in Taipei attracts millions of visitors.
examples.zh: 台北龍山寺每年吸引數百萬遊客造訪。

examples.en: Devotees light fragrant incense sticks to pray for health and peace at the temple.
examples.zh: 信眾們在寺廟裡點燃清香，祈求身體健康與萬事平安。

examples.en: The historic Buddhist temple features intricate dragon carvings on its curved roofs.
examples.zh: 這座歷史悠久的佛教寺廟飛簷屋頂上飾有精雕細琢的蟠龍雕刻。

examples.en: Longshan Temple in Wanhua is a renowned architectural landmark.
examples.zh: 萬華的龍山寺是一座聞名遐邇的宗教古蹟地標。

examples.en: Tourists marveled at the intricate stone dragon pillars carved inside the temple.
examples.zh: 觀光客對寺廟內部雕刻精細入微的石雕龍柱讚嘆不已。

examples.en: Early in the morning, neighborhood residents gather outside the temple courtyard to chat.
examples.zh: 一大清早，社區居民紛紛聚集在廟埕前廣場熱絡寒暄聊天。

explains.en: People may pray in this building. It can be found in a place of worship. A tall tower may rise above it.
A religious building may have an altar and special decorations. Visitors may be quiet inside. It can stand in a city or village.
This place is used for prayer. People may light candles there. Some have a tall roof or tower.

examples.en: We rented a tennis racket to play this weekend.
examples.zh: 我們租了一支網球拍準備這週末去打球。

examples.en: Professional tennis matches on grass courts require precise footwork.
examples.zh: 草地網球場上的職業網球賽需要精準的步法移動。

examples.en: She took private tennis lessons twice a week throughout the summer.
examples.zh: 整個夏天她每週上兩次私人網球課。

explains.en: Two or four people hit a small ball over a net with rackets. A player can serve first. It is a popular sport.
A court has lines and a net for this game. Players use rackets to hit a ball. A match may be singles or doubles.
People exercise by running around a court. The ball must go over a net. A racket helps strike it.

examples.en: We had a terrible storm last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我們遇到一場可怕的暴風雨。

examples.en: The soup tasted terrible without salt.
examples.zh: 沒有加鹽的湯味道很糟。

examples.en: He felt terrible after staying up all night.
examples.zh: 熬夜一整晚後他覺得很不舒服。

explains.en: It means very bad or unpleasant. A person may have a hard day. A storm can cause great harm.
A meal may taste very bad. A person can have a painful headache. The word describes something very unpleasant.
This word means awful. A loud crash may scare a child. A bad event can be hard to forget.

examples.en: We have an English vocabulary test every Friday.
examples.zh: 我們每週五都有英文單字測驗。

examples.en: Scientists conducted several laboratory tests to verify the vaccine's safety.
examples.zh: 科學家進行了多項實驗室檢驗以確認疫苗的安全性。

examples.en: He studied hard and passed his driver's license test on the first try.
examples.zh: 他努力準備，一次就考過了汽車駕照考試。

explains.en: A teacher may ask students to answer questions. A doctor can check a person for illness. A person may also try a tool before buying it.
A school may give one at the end of a unit. It checks what students know. A driver may take one before getting a license.
This process checks knowledge or health. A person may try a new product. It can be written, spoken, or done with a machine.

examples.en: My bag is lighter than yours.
examples.zh: 我的包包比你的輕。

examples.en: The cat is smaller than the dog.
examples.zh: 貓比狗小。

examples.en: Today is warmer than yesterday.
examples.zh: 今天比昨天暖和。

entries.definition: 比；用於比較兩個人、事物或情況。

explains.en: It compares two people or things. A dog can outrun a turtle in speed. It can follow a word ending with er.
A person may say one bag costs less. A small connector links two parts of a comparison. It often follows a describing word.
This word helps compare one thing with another. A child can be older while a friend is younger. It may follow a word such as better.

examples.en: Thank you very much for your kind help.
examples.zh: 非常感謝你的熱心幫忙。

examples.en: We wrote greeting cards to thank our teachers on Teachers' Day.
examples.zh: 我們在教師節寫了祝賀卡片感謝老師們。

examples.en: Thanks to regular exercise, his stamina has improved significantly.
examples.zh: 多虧了規律運動，他的體能耐力顯著提升。

explains.en: People use this word to show they feel grateful. A child may say it after receiving help. It can also mean expressing gratitude.
A person may use polite words after a gift. A friend can show care with a kind act. The action means telling someone you feel grateful.
This word is said after help or kindness. A person may write it in a note. It can also mean feeling grateful.

examples.en: That is my favorite book.
examples.zh: 那是我最喜歡的書。

examples.en: I know that she is at home.
examples.zh: 我知道她在家。

examples.en: The bag that you gave me is blue.
examples.zh: 你給我的包包是藍色的。

entries.definition: （代）那；（形）那個；（連）引導子句；（副）那麼

explains.en: It points to a person or thing already known. A speaker may use it before a short explanation. It can join two ideas.
A person can use this word while pointing at an object. It may introduce a reason. It also appears in sentences about a fact.
This small connector can refer to a known idea. A speaker may use it before giving details. It can link a cause and result.

examples.en: The sun is bright today.
examples.zh: 今天陽光很明亮。

examples.en: Please close the door.
examples.zh: 請把門關上。

examples.en: We saw the moon last night.
examples.zh: 我們昨晚看到了月亮。

entries.definition: （定冠詞）這個；那個；用於特定或已知的人事物前

explains.en: A short article comes before a noun when a speaker means a known person or object. It can appear before one noun or many nouns. English uses it very often.
Speakers use this article for a specific item. It can come before a name for something mentioned before. It is a short word placed before a noun.
This tiny article points to a particular person, place, or object. It may come before a describing word and a noun. Readers see it very often.

examples.en: We booked tickets at the IMAX movie theater.
examples.zh: 我們在 IMAX 電影院訂了票。

examples.en: The national theater hosted a world-class classical ballet performance.
examples.zh: 國家劇院舉辦了世界級的古典芭蕾舞盛大演出。

examples.en: Turn your phones to silent mode before entering the movie theater.
examples.zh: 進入電影院前請將手機調整為靜音模式。

examples.en: We bought front-row tickets to enjoy the Broadway musical at the National Theater.
examples.zh: 我們購買了前排門票前往國家戲劇院欣賞百老匯音樂劇。

examples.en: She majored in theater design and specializes in theatrical stage lighting.
examples.zh: 她在大學專攻劇場設計學系，特別專長於舞台專業燈光視覺氛圍營造。

examples.en: The Mediterranean was a major theater of military conflict during World War II.
examples.zh: 地中海海域在第二次世界大戰爆發期間曾是雙方軍事對峙交火的核心主要戰場戰區。

examples.en: Taipei's National Theater and Concert Hall (NTCH) is celebrated for its classical palace architecture.
examples.zh: 坐落於台北自由廣場的國家兩廳院（NTCH），以古典莊嚴的宮殿式宮廷建築風格享譽國際。

examples.en: We booked front-orchestra seats at the historic downtown theater to watch the touring production.
examples.zh: 我們早早預訂了這座歷史悠久的市中心劇院一樓正廳前排黃金席位，迫不及待欣賞巡演大作。

examples.en: The university drama club transformed an abandoned warehouse into an intimate experimental black-box theater.
examples.zh: 大學話劇社成員齊心協力將校園旁廢棄倉庫打造成一座充滿前衛氛圍的黑盒子實驗劇場。

entries.definition: 電影院；劇院；戲劇界；劇場；國家戲劇院

explains.en: People sit here to watch actors perform. A screen may show a film. Visitors buy tickets before entering.
A stage and seats are found in this building. A school may put on a play. People watch from rows of chairs.
This place shows live performances or movies. A curtain may open before a play. An audience sits and watches.

examples.en: We ate dinner, then watched a movie.
examples.zh: 我們吃完晚餐，接著看了一部電影。

examples.en: First wash your hands, then sit down.
examples.zh: 先洗手，然後坐下。

examples.en: She was a child then.
examples.zh: 她那時還是個孩子。

explains.en: It can mean at that time in the past. A person may finish one task and start another. The word can also show what happened next.
A speaker may use it for the next event. A child ate dinner and afterward went outside. It can also mean in that case.
This word points to a later moment. A bell rang, and a class began. It can also mean at that point.

examples.en: There is a new bakery over there.
examples.zh: 那裡開了一家新的麵包店。

examples.en: Are there any seats left on the evening bullet train?
examples.zh: 晚班高鐵還有剩餘座位嗎？

examples.en: Put your heavy backpack over there by the classroom door.
examples.zh: 把你的重背包放在教室門口那邊。

explains.en: It means in or at a place. A speaker may point toward a chair. It can also begin a sentence about existence.
A person may say a book is in a room. The word can describe a location. It is also used when introducing a new idea.
This word points to a place. A cat may be under a table. It can also mean that something exists.

examples.en: These apples are fresh.
examples.zh: 這些蘋果很新鮮。

examples.en: Please put these books on the desk.
examples.zh: 請把這些書放在桌上。

examples.en: These flowers smell lovely.
examples.zh: 這些花聞起來很香。

entries.definition: 這些；這些（人或物），指靠近說話者的複數對象。

explains.en: It points to more than one person or object nearby. A teacher may speak about books on a desk. The word is used before a noun.
A person may point at a group of flowers. The word means more than one nearby object. It can be used for things close by.
This word refers to a group near a speaker. A child may choose several toys. It comes before a plural noun.

examples.en: They are playing basketball in the park.
examples.zh: 他們正在公園打籃球。

examples.en: They arrived at the station on time.
examples.zh: 他們準時抵達車站。

examples.en: They are planning a surprise party for Amy.
examples.zh: 他們正在為艾咪籌辦一場驚喜派對。

entries.definition: 他們；她們；它們；他們自己；它們自己

explains.en: This pronoun means a group of people already known. It can be used as the subject of a sentence. Other forms show ownership or receive an action.
A teacher may talk about a class without naming each child. The word refers to that group. It can take the place of several names.
This word points to more than one person. It may come before an action. Related forms can show ownership or act as an object.

examples.en: The thick book has many pages.
examples.zh: 這本厚書有很多頁。

examples.en: A thick blanket kept us warm.
examples.zh: 一條厚毯子讓我們保持溫暖。

examples.en: She cut a thick slice of bread.
examples.zh: 她切了一片厚厚的麵包。

explains.en: It means having a large distance from one side to another. A winter coat may keep a person warm. A wall can be built with this material.
A blanket may have much material between its surfaces. A tree trunk can be wide. This word is the opposite of thin.
This describing word means wide or heavy from front to back. A book can have many pages. A coat may protect against cold weather.

examples.en: The paper is too thin to hold the paint.
examples.zh: 這張紙太薄，承受不住顏料。

examples.en: He wore a thin coat in the rain.
examples.zh: 他下雨時穿了一件薄外套。

examples.en: Cut the apple into thin slices.
examples.zh: 把蘋果切成薄片。

explains.en: It means having little distance from one side to another. Paper may be light and narrow. A person may wear a light coat in warm weather.
A board can have little depth. A hair may be narrow. This word is the opposite of thick.
This describing word can mean narrow or low in weight. A slice of bread may be very fine. A person may have a light body.

examples.en: That thing is very heavy.
examples.zh: 那個東西很重。

examples.en: I need one more thing from the shop.
examples.zh: 我還需要商店裡的一樣東西。

examples.en: The strange thing made us laugh.
examples.zh: 那件奇怪的事讓我們笑了。

explains.en: It means an object, idea, or item. A person may have one in a bag. The word can refer to almost anything.
A child may point at an object and ask what it is. This general word can name an item. It can also mean an event or matter.
Use this word when an exact name is not known. A bag may hold an unknown item. It can also mean an idea.

examples.en: I think English is interesting and useful.
examples.zh: 我認為英文很有趣也很實用。

examples.en: Take some time to think carefully before making a major decision.
examples.zh: 在做重大決定之前，花點時間深思熟慮。

examples.en: I think so too; that seems like the most practical solution.
examples.zh: 我也這麼認為，這似乎是最切實可行的方案。

explains.en: It means using the mind to form an idea. A person may consider a question. It can also mean having an opinion.
A student may use the mind to solve a puzzle. A person can also believe something is true. This verb describes what goes on in the mind.
This action happens in the mind. A person may form an idea about a friend. It can also mean planning.

examples.en: Our apartment is on the third floor.
examples.zh: 我們的公寓在三樓。

examples.en: Tuesday is the third day of the work week.
examples.zh: 星期二是工作週的第三天。

examples.en: One third of the students voted in favor of the new proposal.
examples.zh: 三分之一的學生投票贊成這項新提案。

explains.en: This position comes after second and before fourth. Two children stand ahead of a child in line. That child holds this position.
This can mean one of three equal parts. A cake can be cut into three matching pieces. Each piece is one such share.
This describes item number three in an ordered group. March holds this place among the months. A building may also have a floor with this position.

examples.en: This is my new book.
examples.zh: 這是我的新書。

examples.en: I like this blue shirt.
examples.zh: 我喜歡這件藍色襯衫。

examples.en: This apple is very sweet.
examples.zh: 這顆蘋果很甜。

entries.definition: 這；這個（人或物），指靠近說話者的對象；如此。

explains.en: It points to one person or object near a speaker. A child may hold a toy while talking. The word often comes before a noun.
A person can point to a nearby item. It may introduce an example. It is used for one thing close by.
A small word refers to an object close at hand. A speaker may use it before giving details. It can also introduce a person.

examples.en: Those birds are flying south.
examples.zh: 那些鳥正往南飛。

examples.en: I remember those happy days.
examples.zh: 我記得那些快樂的日子。

examples.en: Those shoes belong to my brother.
examples.zh: 那些鞋子是我哥哥的。

explains.en: It points to more than one person or object far away. A speaker may point at birds across a field. The word comes before a noun.
A person may talk about faraway objects on a shelf. It refers to things over there. It is used for a group.
This word refers to a group that is not nearby. A child may point at stars. It comes before a plural noun.

examples.en: The climb was exhausting; the mountain view was stunning, though.
examples.zh: 爬山過程很累人；不過山頂的風景真是絕美無比。

examples.en: Even though he had never visited Taipei before, he navigated the MRT with ease.
examples.zh: 即便他在此之前從未造訪過台北，他依然能毫不費力地輕鬆搭乘捷運趴趴走。

examples.en: I haven't heard from him in weeks; I am sure he is doing well, though.
examples.zh: 雖然我已經好幾個禮拜沒收到他的音訊了；不過我深信他一定過得很好。

explains.en: It means even if something is true. A person may go outside despite light rain. It can also mean however.
A speaker may use this word when adding a contrast. A child may keep trying despite a hard task. It often begins a sentence.
This word joins two ideas that do not fully agree. A person may smile despite feeling tired. It can mean even if.

examples.en: Over five thousand runners joined the marathon.
examples.zh: 超過五千名跑者參加了馬拉松。

examples.en: This historic temple has stood for more than a thousand years.
examples.zh: 這座歷史悠久的古廟已經屹立了一千多年。

examples.en: Thousands of migratory birds visit the wetlands every winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天都有數千隻候鳥造訪這片濕地。

explains.en: It means ten groups of one hundred. A town may have this many people. It can also mean a very large amount.
A number of this size is ten times one hundred. A book may have many pages, but far fewer. Its plural form can describe a huge amount.
This number comes after nine hundred ninety-nine. A person may count this many stars in a story. It is a large amount.

examples.en: My throat hurts when I swallow.
examples.zh: 我吞嚥時喉嚨會痛。

examples.en: The singer cleared her throat.
examples.zh: 歌手清了清喉嚨。

examples.en: He had a sore throat yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天喉嚨痛。

explains.en: Food and air pass through this body part. A person may feel pain there when sick. It is between the mouth and chest.
A doctor may look inside this part of the body. A singer uses it to make sounds. A scarf can keep it warm.
This passage carries food down toward the stomach. It can feel dry or painful. A person may clear it before speaking.

examples.en: The train speeds through the long Hsuehshan Tunnel.
examples.zh: 火車飛速穿過長長的雪山隧道。

examples.en: Sunshine filtered gently through the green leaves of the ancient banyan tree.
examples.zh: 陽光透過古老榕樹的翠綠樹葉柔和地灑落下來。

examples.en: We worked tirelessly through the night to prepare all the presentation slides.
examples.zh: 我們通宵達旦地工作，連夜準備所有的簡報投影片。

examples.en: The train sped through the long mountain tunnel into Yilan.
examples.zh: 火車飛速穿過長長的山脈隧道駛入宜蘭。

examples.en: Sunlight filtered softly through the bamboo leaves onto the stone trail.
examples.zh: 金黃色的晨曦陽光穿透層層竹葉縫隙，溫柔灑落在青石健行步道上。

examples.en: He achieved academic success through sheer perseverance and daily dedication.
examples.zh: 他完全是憑藉著堅定不移的過人毅力與日復一日的苦讀，取得了學業成就。

entries.definition: 穿過；透過；自始至終；通過；憑藉

explains.en: It means from one side to another. A person may walk inside a door and come out elsewhere. It can also mean during a whole period.
A tunnel carries cars beneath a hill. A needle can pass inside cloth. A person may learn by practice over time.
This word describes movement inside or across something. Light can pass across glass. A person may look across an opening.

examples.en: Throw the baseball straight into the catcher's glove.
examples.zh: 把棒球筆直投進捕手的手套中。

examples.en: Please don't throw litter on the street; place it in recycling bins.
examples.zh: 請不要在街上亂丟垃圾，請放入資源回收桶。

examples.en: The playful dog loves running to fetch balls when you throw them.
examples.zh: 當你把球丟出去時，愛玩的狗狗非常喜歡跑去把球撿回來。

explains.en: It means sending something through the air with the hand. A child may toss a ball. It can also mean removing something away.
A person can send a paper plane across a room. A player may toss a ball to a friend. The word may also mean having a party.
This action moves an object by using the arm. A baseball player does it toward a teammate. It can also mean confusing someone.

examples.en: Do you have your train ticket ready?
examples.zh: 你的火車票準備好了嗎？

examples.en: Concert tickets sold out within two minutes of going on sale.
examples.zh: 演唱會門票開賣兩分鐘之內便全數售罄。

examples.en: Scan the QR code on your mobile ticket at the automatic turnstile gate.
examples.zh: 在自動驗票閘門上感應掃描手機電子票券上的 QR 碼。

explains.en: People show this paper or card before entering a place. A bus rider may buy one. It may also let someone see a movie.
A small paper gives permission to travel. A person may keep it in a wallet. A gate worker checks it before entry.
This item may have a seat number. A passenger needs one for a trip. A theater may sell one at its door.

examples.en: Please tidy your room before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐前請整理你的房間。

examples.en: The desk looks tidy now.
examples.zh: 書桌現在看起來很整齊。

examples.en: She keeps her books in a tidy row.
examples.zh: 她把書整齊地排成一列。

entries.definition: （形）整潔的；有條理的；（動）整理；收拾

explains.en: It means neat and in order. A child may put toys away. A room can look clean after work.
A person may arrange books on a shelf. A bedroom can have no mess. This word describes things kept in order.
This word means clean and well arranged. A desk may have no clutter. A person can make a room neat.

examples.en: The exciting volleyball match ended in a 2-2 tie.
examples.zh: 這場精彩的排球賽最終以二比二打成平手。

examples.en: He wore a crisp white dress shirt with a handsome silk tie.
examples.zh: 他身穿筆挺白襯衫並繫著一條帥氣的真絲領帶。

examples.en: Remember to tie your shoelaces tightly before heading out for a run.
examples.zh: 出門跑步前記得把鞋帶繫緊。

explains.en: Two people may fasten cloth around a neck. A person can make a bow from a ribbon. The word can also mean a game with the same score.
A boy may wear one with a shirt. A person can connect shoelaces with a knot. A match can finish with equal scores.
This word can mean a strip of cloth worn at the neck. It can also describe joining two ends. A close result may have no winner.

examples.en: Tigers have orange fur with black stripes.
examples.zh: 老虎有著帶黑條紋的橘色毛皮。

examples.en: Bengal tigers are known for their strength and solitary lifestyle.
examples.zh: 孟加拉虎以其力量和獨居習性而聞名。

examples.en: That strict warning turned out to be nothing more than a paper tiger.
examples.zh: 那個嚴格的警告結果只不過是一隻紙老虎。

explains.en: This large wild cat has dark stripes on orange fur. It lives in parts of Asia. It hunts other animals for food.
A powerful cat may live in a forest. Each one has a different stripe pattern. It can swim well.
This animal is the largest kind of cat. It has sharp teeth and strong legs. A young one is called a cub.

examples.en: What time is it now?
examples.zh: 現在幾點了？

examples.en: We had a great time at the amusement park.
examples.zh: 我們在遊樂園玩得非常開心。

examples.en: Please make sure you arrive on time for the meeting.
examples.zh: 開會請務必準時抵達。

explains.en: It means minutes, hours, days, or years. A clock helps people know it. A person may wait for a bus.
A day has twenty-four hours. A person may use a calendar to count it. The word can also mean a good moment.
This measure tells how long something lasts. A watch tracks it. People may spend it with friends.

examples.en: In the US, it is customary to leave a 15% tip.
examples.zh: 在美國，留下 15% 的小費是當地的慣例。

examples.en: Here is a helpful tip to improve your daily English listening skills.
examples.zh: 這裡有一個改善你日常英語聽力技巧的實用秘訣。

examples.en: The waiter smiled gratefully when we gave him a generous tip.
examples.zh: 當我們給了豐厚的小費時，服務生感激地微笑致意。

examples.en: Viewers can tip their favorite indie musicians directly via the virtual tip jar.
examples.zh: 觀看線上演出的熱情粉絲可透過虛擬小費箱直接線上打賞抖內支持獨立創作歌手。

examples.en: In many countries, it is customary to tip restaurant waiters between 15% and 20%.
examples.zh: 在許多國家，用餐後給餐廳服務生 15% 至 20% 的小費是一項慣例。

examples.en: The experienced photographer gave us a helpful tip on shooting in low light.
examples.zh: 這位經驗豐富的攝影師給了我們一個在微光環境下拍攝的實用技巧秘訣。

entries.definition: 小費；秘訣；給小費；打賞贊助；抖內；實用秘訣

explains.en: The end of a tool may be called this. A person may give helpful advice. It can also mean leaving a small extra amount.
A pencil has a sharp end. A cook may add a little salt. A person can offer a clue to help someone.
This word can mean a small piece at an end. It can also mean advice or a small amount of money left for a waiter. A small clue may help someone solve a puzzle.

examples.en: I feel tired after a long day of classes.
examples.zh: 上了一整天的課我感到很疲累。

examples.en: After hours of continuous typing, my eyes felt dry and tired.
examples.zh: 連續打字數小時後，我的眼睛感到乾澀疲倦。

examples.en: She was tired of eating convenience store lunchboxes every single day.
examples.zh: 她厭倦了每天都吃便利商店的微波便當。

explains.en: It means needing sleep or rest. A person may yawn after a long day. A child may feel this before bed.
A worker may feel low in energy after many hours. A soft bed can help. This word describes someone who needs rest.
A person who did not sleep well may feel this. A long walk can make legs feel heavy. Rest can help.

examples.en: I want to go home now.
examples.zh: 我現在想回家。

examples.en: Give the letter to your teacher.
examples.zh: 把信交給你的老師。

examples.en: We walked to the park together.
examples.zh: 我們一起走到公園。

entries.definition: 到；向；給；用於表示方向、目的地、對象或不定詞。

explains.en: This particle comes before a verb and names an action or goal. A person may hope for food. It can point toward a place.
A short word can join a verb and an idea. A child may hope for a gift. It can also show direction.
A speaker may place it before an action word. A person can head toward a place. It can also show who receives something.

examples.en: What day is it today?
examples.zh: 今天是星期幾？

examples.en: Today is my classmate's fourteenth birthday.
examples.zh: 今天是我同班同學的十四歲生日。

examples.en: I have a lot of things to accomplish today.
examples.zh: 我今天有很多事情需要完成。

explains.en: It means the current day. A calendar shows its date. A person may do homework before bedtime.
People wake up and begin a new day. The word can mean at this time. A store may be open now.
This word names the day happening now. A person may ask what date it is. It can also mean in modern times.

examples.en: I stubbed my toe on the chair.
examples.zh: 我的腳趾撞到椅子。

examples.en: The baby curled her toes.
examples.zh: 嬰兒蜷起腳趾。

examples.en: He hurt his big toe while running.
examples.zh: 他跑步時大腳趾受傷了。

explains.en: A small part at the end of a foot helps with balance. A person has five on each foot. Shoes cover them.
A child may wiggle one after taking off a sock. This body part can help push a ball. It is smaller than a finger.
Each foot has several small digits. They help people stand and walk. A nail grows at the end.

examples.en: We worked together on the project.
examples.zh: 我們一起完成這個專案。

examples.en: The children sang together at school.
examples.zh: 孩子們在學校一起唱歌。

examples.en: Put the two books together on the shelf.
examples.zh: 把這兩本書一起放在架子上。

explains.en: It means with another person or group. Friends may eat a meal at one table. Families can travel in one car.
A team works toward one goal. People may walk beside each other. This word describes being in one place at the same time.
It means joined in one group. A child may play beside a friend. People can do an activity as a team.

examples.en: Press the dual-flush button to save water after using the toilet.
examples.zh: 使用完馬桶後按下兩段式節水沖水按鈕。

examples.en: Clean the ceramic toilet bowl with a disinfectant brush regularly.
examples.zh: 定期使用消毒清潔刷清洗陶瓷馬桶內壁。

examples.en: The restaurant restroom provides clean toilet seat sanitizing wipes.
examples.zh: 餐廳洗手間貼心備有乾淨的馬桶坐墊消毒擦拭巾。

explains.en: This is the bowl people use when passing waste from the body. It is usually in a bathroom. Most kinds use water to carry waste away.
This fixture often has a seat and a lid. People sit on the seat to use it. Afterward, they flush and wash their hands.
In some places this word can also mean the room containing the fixture. A traveler may ask where that room is. A sign helps them find it.

examples.en: Cherry tomatoes grown in Chiayi are very sweet.
examples.zh: 嘉義種植的玉女小番茄非常香甜。

examples.en: Slice fresh red tomatoes to add inside the turkey sandwich.
examples.zh: 切幾片新鮮紅番茄加入火雞三明治中。

examples.en: Tomato scrambled eggs is a beloved comfort dish in Taiwanese households.
examples.zh: 番茄炒蛋是深受台灣家庭喜愛的家常暖心料理。

explains.en: This red fruit is used in salads and sauces. It grows on a plant. A person can slice it for a sandwich.
A round food item may be red or yellow. It has seeds inside. People use it in soup or pasta sauce.
A cook may chop this fruit for a salad. It grows on a vine. Some people call it a vegetable in cooking.

examples.en: We will have an English quiz tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天有英文小考。

examples.en: Tomorrow will be sunny and warm according to the weather forecast.
examples.zh: 根據天氣預報，明天將是晴朗溫暖的好天氣。

examples.en: See you at the library tomorrow afternoon!
examples.zh: 明天下午圖書館見！

explains.en: It means the day after today. A person may make plans for the next day. The word can also mean in the future.
A child may ask what will happen the next day. A calendar can show it. It is one day after now.
This word points to the next day. A person may finish homework then. The future can begin very soon.

examples.en: We will have dinner together tonight.
examples.zh: 我們今晚要一起吃晚餐。

examples.en: Tonight is cool and clear.
examples.zh: 今晚天氣涼爽晴朗。

examples.en: I need to finish this book tonight.
examples.zh: 我今晚需要讀完這本書。

explains.en: It means during the evening of the current day. A person may eat dinner then. The sky is dark at that time.
People may watch a movie after sunset. A child may get ready for bed. This word names the evening happening now.
A family may meet for dinner this evening. The word can also be used as a friendly greeting after dark. It refers to the current date.

examples.en: This jacket is too small for me.
examples.zh: 這件夾克對我來說太小了。

examples.en: I am going to the night market tonight; do you want to come too?
examples.zh: 我今晚要去逛夜市，你也想一起來嗎？

examples.en: Don't worry too much about minor mistakes in your first draft.
examples.zh: 初稿中微小的錯誤不必太過擔憂。

explains.en: It means more than is needed. A person may drink an extra cup of milk. It can also show agreement.
A bag may be heavier than a child can carry. This word can mean also. A person may say yes using it.
It can mean an amount greater than needed. A child may have an extra cookie. It can also describe something done very much.

examples.en: A hammer is a useful tool.
examples.zh: 榔頭是很好用的工具。

examples.en: The cook chose a sharp tool to cut the fruit.
examples.zh: 廚師選了一把鋒利的工具來切水果。

examples.en: A garden tool can help remove weeds.
examples.zh: 園藝工具可以幫忙拔除雜草。

explains.en: It is an object that helps people do a task. A hammer can drive a nail. A spoon helps with food.
A worker may carry an item for fixing a car. A kitchen has items for cutting and stirring. The object makes work easier.
This word means a device used for a job. A rake helps clean leaves. A computer program can do a task as well.

examples.en: The dentist checked my tooth.
examples.zh: 牙醫檢查了我的牙齒。

examples.en: Brush each tooth before bed.
examples.zh: 睡前把每顆牙齒都刷乾淨。

examples.en: A loose tooth fell out while he ate.
examples.zh: 他吃東西時一顆鬆動的牙齒掉了。

explains.en: Hard white parts in a mouth help cut and chew food. A dentist checks them. A baby grows its first ones.
A person brushes these twice a day. They help break food into small bits. An adult may have thirty-two.
A smile can show these white parts. A dentist can fix one that hurts. They are held in the jaw.

examples.en: We reached the top of the mountain at noon.
examples.zh: 我們在中午抵達了山頂。

examples.en: She ranked at the very top of her graduating high school class.
examples.zh: 她在高中畢業班中名列前茅、榮登榜首。

examples.en: Put the heavy storage boxes at the bottom and lighter ones on top.
examples.zh: 把沉重的收納箱放在底部，較輕的放在頂層。

explains.en: It means the highest part of something. A hat may sit there. A mountain can reach high above the land.
A cup may be filled up to its edge. A person can stand at the highest point of a hill. The word can also mean a lid.
This word can name the upper part of a box. A cap may cover it. A person who is best may be at the highest level.

examples.en: Our topic today is ocean animals.
examples.zh: 我們今天的主題是海洋動物。

examples.en: The teacher chose a new topic for class.
examples.zh: 老師為課堂選了一個新主題。

examples.en: They talked about the topic after lunch.
examples.zh: 他們午餐後討論了這個主題。

explains.en: A person may talk about one area in a class. A book can cover animals or space. People may ask a question about it.
This word means a theme or area of discussion. A teacher may choose one for a lesson. Friends can change what they talk about.
A story may focus on one idea. A student may write about it. It can be something people discuss.

examples.en: The total cost is ten dollars.
examples.zh: 總費用是十美元。

examples.en: Add the scores to find the total.
examples.zh: 把分數加起來找出總和。

examples.en: The total number of guests was twenty.
examples.zh: 賓客總數是二十人。

entries.definition: （形）總計的；完全的；（名）總數；總額；（動）合計；總計達

explains.en: It means the full amount after adding parts. A bill may show a final cost. A person can add points from a game.
A score can be found by counting all points. A store receipt shows how much was paid. This word means the whole sum.
This amount includes every part. A teacher may count all student answers. It can also mean the number of people in a group.

examples.en: Please do not touch the art exhibits in the museum.
examples.zh: 在博物館內請勿觸摸藝術展品。

examples.en: Modern smartphones operate via smooth glass touch screens.
examples.zh: 現代智慧型手機透過滑順的玻璃觸控螢幕進行操作。

examples.en: Her sincere thank-you speech deeply touched everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她真摯誠懇的致謝感言深深打動了在場的每個人。

explains.en: It means placing a hand or finger on something. A person may feel a soft cloth. It can also mean having an effect on someone.
A child may reach for a warm cup. A doctor may check a patient. The word can also mean a small amount of feeling.
This action uses the hand to feel an object. A person may gently tap a shoulder. It can also mean affecting someone’s feelings.

examples.en: Dry your hands with a clean towel.
examples.zh: 用乾淨的毛巾把手擦乾。

examples.en: Hang the wet bath towel outside in the sun to dry.
examples.zh: 把濕浴巾掛在外面曬太陽晾乾。

examples.en: Bring an extra beach towel when you visit the swimming pool.
examples.zh: 去游泳池時多帶一條海灘毛巾。

explains.en: People dry their bodies with this soft cloth after bathing. It can soak up water. A beach bag may hold one.
A person may wrap one around wet hair. It is made from cloth. A kitchen may have a smaller one for dishes.
This fabric item helps dry hands and body. It may hang near a sink. A swimmer can carry one to the pool.

examples.en: My town has a new library.
examples.zh: 我的城鎮有一間新圖書館。

examples.en: The small town is near the river.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮在河流附近。

examples.en: We drove through the town on our way home.
examples.zh: 我們回家途中開車經過這個城鎮。

explains.en: A place with many homes and shops is smaller than a large city. People may know their neighbors. A main street can go through it.
This community may have a school and a library. People live there and go to work. It can be found near farms.
A small city-like place may have streets and houses. A bus can bring people there. A local government may serve its residents.

examples.en: The floor was covered with colorful toys.
examples.zh: 地板上擺滿了形形色色的玩具。

examples.en: Please tidy up your toys and put them into the storage box.
examples.zh: 請把你的玩具整理好並收進收納箱中。

examples.en: Wooden educational toys help foster young children's creativity.
examples.zh: 木製益智玩具能幫助培養幼童的創造力。

explains.en: A child may play with this object for fun. It can be a ball, doll, or small car. A store sells many kinds.
This plaything may be made from wood or plastic. A child may share it with a friend. It can help a child imagine stories.
A young child often enjoys this object. It can make sounds or move. A box can hold several playthings.

examples.en: Traffic was heavy near the school.
examples.zh: 學校附近車流很大。

examples.en: The traffic light turned green.
examples.zh: 交通號誌轉為綠燈。

examples.en: We waited in traffic for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 我們在車陣中等了十分鐘。

explains.en: Cars, buses, and bikes move along roads. Too many can make travel slow. A light can help control it.
Drivers must follow signs and lights. A busy road may have many vehicles. People should look both ways before crossing.
This word means movement of vehicles and people along streets. A police officer may guide cars. A jam can form at busy times.

examples.en: The train from Taipei to Kaohsiung is very fast.
examples.zh: 從台北到高雄的火車非常快。

examples.en: We need to train hard to win the championship.
examples.zh: 我們需要努力訓練才能贏得冠軍。

examples.en: Be sure to arrive at the train platform five minutes before departure.
examples.zh: 務必在發車前五分鐘抵達火車月台。

examples.en: The mechanical gear train multiplies rotation speed from the slow mainspring to the fast escape wheel.
examples.zh: 機械「走時齒輪輪系」（Gear Train），將緩慢旋轉的發條盒轉速逐級放大並傳送至高速跳動的擒縱輪。

examples.en: Commuters boarded the sleek electric high-speed train to travel between Taipei and Kaohsiung in ninety minutes.
examples.zh: 趕著上班洽公的商務通勤旅客陸續登上流線型的台灣高鐵列車，短短九十分鐘即可往返台北與高雄。

examples.en: The professional soccer team traveled to the sports academy to train for the continental cup.
examples.zh: 職業足球隊全員飛抵封閉式高原運動基地，展開為期一個月的魔鬼體能集訓以備戰即將開踢的亞洲盃。

entries.definition: 火車；列車；訓練；傳遞發條動力至擒縱結構之四輪機械走時輪系

explains.en: A long vehicle moves on tracks. People ride it between cities. It may carry goods too.
A station is where passengers get on. The vehicle has many cars joined together. It can travel quickly across land.
People may take this vehicle to work. It follows metal rails. A driver controls it from the front.

examples.en: The doctor began treatment right away.
examples.zh: 醫生立刻開始治療。

examples.en: Her treatment helped the sore knee.
examples.zh: 她的治療改善了膝蓋痠痛。

examples.en: The treatment lasted for two weeks.
examples.zh: 治療持續了兩週。

entries.definition: （動）對待；治療；款待；（名）樂事；特別享受

explains.en: It means caring for someone who is ill. A doctor may give medicine. It can also mean handling a subject in a certain way.
A nurse may help a sick person get better. A clinic offers care. The word can also mean how someone acts toward another person.
This word can mean medical care. A hospital gives help for injuries. It may also mean handling a topic in speech or writing.

examples.en: Banyan trees provide great shade on sunny days.
examples.zh: 榕樹在出太陽的日子提供良好的遮蔭。

examples.en: Planting green trees helps absorb carbon dioxide and cools our cities.
examples.zh: 種植綠樹有助於吸收二氧化碳並為我們的城市降溫。

examples.en: Birds build protective nests among the thick branches of the oak tree.
examples.zh: 鳥兒在橡樹茂密的枝枒間築起遮風避雨的巢穴。

explains.en: A tall living plant has a trunk, branches, and leaves. Birds may make a nest in it. It can give shade.
A forest has many of these plants. A person may climb one as a child. Its roots take in water from soil.
This plant can live for many years. Its branches grow above the ground. It may produce fruit or nuts.

examples.en: Have a safe trip back home!
examples.zh: 祝你返家旅途平安！

examples.en: We went on an unforgettable road trip along the scenic East Coast.
examples.zh: 我們沿著風景優美的東海岸展開了一趟難忘的公路旅行。

examples.en: Watch your step so you don't trip over the tree roots on the trail.
examples.zh: 腳步小心，別在步道上被樹根絆倒了。

explains.en: It means going away from home and coming back. A family may take one during school break. A person can travel by car or plane.
A person may go to a new place for fun. A bag holds clothes for the stay. The word can also mean a fall or stumble.
This journey may last one day or longer. People often plan it in advance. It can be for work or rest.

examples.en: Ask the teacher for help if you get into trouble.
examples.zh: 如果遇到麻煩，請向老師求助。

examples.en: She had trouble falling asleep because of the loud thunderstorm outside.
examples.zh: 因為外面的雷雨交加，她翻來覆去難以入睡。

examples.en: I am sorry to trouble you, but could you tell me the way to the subway?
examples.zh: 不好意思麻煩你，請問你可以告訴我前往捷運站的路嗎？

explains.en: It means a difficult situation. A broken bike can create one. A person may ask for help.
A math question may be hard to solve. A family can talk about a concern. The word can also mean difficulty.
This word names something that needs attention. A child may face a challenge at school. Friends can help find an answer.

examples.en: The truck carried wood to the store.
examples.zh: 卡車把木材運到商店。

examples.en: A large truck stopped beside the road.
examples.zh: 一輛大卡車停在路邊。

examples.en: My uncle drives a delivery truck.
examples.zh: 我叔叔開送貨卡車。

explains.en: A large vehicle carries heavy goods. It may deliver boxes to stores. Its back can be open or covered.
A driver uses this vehicle to move furniture. It has a strong engine and large wheels. A delivery company may own many.
This road vehicle is larger than a car. It can carry wood, food, or machines. A person may rent one for a move.

examples.en: I will try to solve the puzzle.
examples.zh: 我會試著解開這個謎題。

examples.en: Try the soup before adding salt.
examples.zh: 加鹽之前先嚐嚐湯。

examples.en: She tried her best in the race.
examples.zh: 她在比賽中盡了全力。

explains.en: It means making an effort. A child may make an effort to tie a shoe. The action can also mean tasting a small amount.
A person may work hard on a puzzle. A cook can taste soup before serving. This word means making an effort even if success is not certain.
This action means making an attempt. A child may make an effort to jump high. It can also mean testing a food or idea.

examples.en: I bought a cotton T-shirt at the night market.
examples.zh: 我在夜市買了一件純棉 T 恤。

examples.en: He likes wearing a plain graphic T-shirt with jeans.
examples.zh: 他喜歡穿素色圖案 T 恤搭配牛仔褲。

examples.en: Our class designed a custom T-shirt for sports day.
examples.zh: 我們班為運動會設計了專屬的班服 T 恤。

explains.en: This clothing covers the upper body and has short sleeves. It often has a picture or words on it. People wear it with pants.
A cotton shirt may have a round neck. A person can wear it for sports. It may have a team name printed on the front.
This casual garment has sleeves and a body. It is easy to wash. People may wear one on a warm day.

examples.en: It is your turn to speak now.
examples.zh: 現在輪到你發言了。

examples.en: Please turn right at the intersection after the bridge.
examples.zh: 過橋後請在十字路口右轉。

examples.en: Caterpillars turn into beautiful butterflies through metamorphosis.
examples.zh: 毛毛蟲透過完全變態轉變為美麗的蝴蝶。

explains.en: It means moving around a center point. A person may change direction at a corner. It can also mean an opportunity in a game.
A wheel moves in a circle. A driver may go left at an intersection. A player may wait for a chance to act.
This action changes direction. A key can move in a lock. A game may give each person a chance.

examples.en: I have been to Paris twice.
examples.zh: 我去過巴黎兩次。

examples.en: She called her friend twice yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天打了兩次電話給朋友。

examples.en: Twice a week, we visit Grandma.
examples.zh: 我們每週去看奶奶兩次。

explains.en: It means two times. A person may brush teeth in the morning and evening. The word can also mean once more.
A child may visit a place on two occasions. A cook can stir a pot again. It describes a count of two.
This word means on two occasions. A person may call a friend again. It can describe a doubled amount.

examples.en: She can type very fast without looking at the keyboard.
examples.zh: 她打字非常快，不用看鍵盤。

examples.en: What type of cuisine do you prefer for tonight's dinner?
examples.zh: 今晚的晚餐你偏好哪種類型的料理？

examples.en: Please type your full name and email address in the registration form.
examples.zh: 請在報名表中鍵入你的全名與電子信箱。

explains.en: It means one kind of something. A store may sell many kinds of fruit. A person can also write or press words on a keyboard.
An animal belongs to a group with shared features. A person may enter words using keys. This word can mean a category.
This word describes a group or category. A letter can be made with a keyboard. A person may choose a kind of food.

examples.en: Uncle David lives in Taichung and owns a bakery.
examples.zh: 大衛叔叔住在台中並經營一家麵包店。

examples.en: My uncle taught me how to fish by the scenic riverside when I was young.
examples.zh: 在我年幼時，我的舅舅教我如何在風景秀麗的河畔釣魚。

examples.en: Everyone in the family enjoys listening to Uncle John's humorous travel tales.
examples.zh: 家族裡的每個人都非常喜歡聽約翰叔叔講述他幽默風趣的旅行軼事。

explains.en: A parent’s brother is this family member. He may visit on holidays. A child may call him by a family title.
A boy has a mother’s or father’s brother in his family. This adult may help care for a child. He can be married or single.
This word names a male relative. A child may visit him at home. He is a brother of a parent.

examples.en: The cat is sleeping under the table.
examples.zh: 貓咪正在桌子底下睡覺。

examples.en: We stood under the big tree to avoid the sudden rain.
examples.zh: 我們站在大樹下躲避突如其來的陣雨。

examples.en: Keep everything under control during the experiment.
examples.zh: 實驗過程中要讓一切保持受控。

explains.en: It means below something. A cat may hide beneath a bed. A person can wear a shirt beneath a coat.
A book may be lower than a table. A child can crawl beneath a blanket. This word describes a lower position.
This word means in a lower place. A fish may swim below a boat. A person can put shoes beneath a bench.

examples.en: Do you understand what the teacher explained?
examples.zh: 你明白老師剛剛解釋的內容了嗎？

examples.en: Practice speaking English regularly so you can make yourself understood clearly.
examples.zh: 經常練習說英語，這樣你才能讓別人清楚理解你的意思。

examples.en: True empathy means striving to understand someone else's feelings.
examples.zh: 真正的同理心意味著努力設身處地去理解他人的感受。

explains.en: It means knowing what words or ideas mean. A child may learn a rule. A person can grasp a hard lesson.
A student may know why an answer is correct. A friend can follow what another person says. The word can mean realizing an idea.
This action means learning the meaning of something. A teacher may explain a new word. A person can grasp a problem.

examples.en: The students wore a blue uniform.
examples.zh: 學生們穿著藍色制服。

examples.en: His school uniform has a white shirt.
examples.zh: 他的校服有一件白襯衫。

examples.en: The nurse put on her uniform before work.
examples.zh: 護士上班前穿上制服。

explains.en: People who do the same job may wear matching clothes. A school may require one for each student. It can show membership in a group.
A team wears matching clothing. A nurse may have special work clothes. The word can mean making things alike.
This clothing shows a person’s group or job. Students may put it on each day. It often has the same color and design for all.

examples.en: We chatted happily at the cafe until midnight.
examples.zh: 我們在咖啡廳愉快地聊天直到午夜。

examples.en: You cannot open the sealed examination booklet until the bell rings.
examples.zh: 在鐘聲響起之前，嚴禁拆開密封的試卷題本。

examples.en: Until now, scientists continue discovering new underwater marine species.
examples.zh: 時至今日，科學家們依然在持續發現全新的海底生物物種。

examples.en: Study hard until you achieve complete mastery of the grammar rules.
examples.zh: 努力用功讀書，直到你完全掌握文法規則為止。

examples.en: We waited under the arcade awning until the heavy thunderstorm finally stopped.
examples.zh: 我們靜靜站在騎樓遮雨棚下耐心避雨，直到窗外滂沱的大雷雨終於漸漸止歇。

examples.en: The night market stalls stay bustling with cheerful customers until two in the morning.
examples.zh: 這處知名觀光夜市的熱門小吃攤位熱鬧滾滾，熱絡氣氛一直持續到凌晨兩點為止。

explains.en: This word marks the time when an action or state ends. A shop may stay open all evening and close at ten. Ten is the ending time.
You can use this word to show how long someone waits. A child may wait while a parent finishes work. The wait ends when the work is done.
With a negative statement, this word can show that something happens no earlier than a certain time. A bus may arrive at noon rather than in the morning. The passengers must wait that long.

examples.en: Look up at the bright twinkling stars in the night sky.
examples.zh: 抬頭仰望夜空中閃爍的明亮星星。

examples.en: The students stood up politely to greet the visiting guest professor.
examples.zh: 學生們彬彬有禮地起立向蒞臨參訪的客座教授問好。

examples.en: Wake up early to catch the crisp morning air and exercise in the park.
examples.zh: 早早起床呼吸清晨清新的空氣並在公園裡做運動。

explains.en: It means toward a higher place. A person may stand after sitting. A bird can fly into the air.
A child may climb a hill. A person can lift a hand above the head. It can also mean awake.
This word can show a move to a higher position. A flag may be raised. It can also mean finished or complete.

examples.en: We use a spoon to eat soup.
examples.zh: 我們用湯匙喝湯。

examples.en: She uses a map to find the park.
examples.zh: 她用地圖找公園。

examples.en: They used clean water for the plants.
examples.zh: 他們用乾淨的水澆植物。

entries.definition: （動）使用；運用；利用；（名）用途；使用

explains.en: It means doing something with an object or idea. A person may handle a hammer at work. The word can also mean consuming food or drink.
A cook may handle a spoon. A student can apply a new skill. It may also mean treating someone in a certain way.
This action means applying a tool or method. A person may handle a phone. It can also mean taking a medicine.

examples.en: A flashlight is useful at night.
examples.zh: 手電筒在晚上很有用。

examples.en: This guide is useful for new students.
examples.zh: 這本指南對新生很有幫助。

examples.en: A warm coat is useful in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天一件暖和的外套很好用。

entries.definition: 有用的；有幫助的；實用的。

explains.en: It means helpful for a task. A map can guide a traveler. A warm coat helps in winter.
A tool that works well can save time. A clear list may help a person remember. This word describes something that gives help.
This word means good for a purpose. A bag with pockets can help carry items. A friend may give helpful advice.

examples.en: I usually take the bus to school on weekdays.
examples.zh: 我平日通常搭公車上學。

examples.en: What do you usually eat for breakfast before going to work?
examples.zh: 上班前你早餐通常吃什麼？

examples.en: We usually spend Sunday afternoons reading books at home.
examples.zh: 我們週日下午通常待在家裡看書。

explains.en: It means in most cases. A child may eat breakfast each morning. The word can describe a habit.
A person may take the bus on many days. It happens often but not every time. This word shows what happens in a usual way.
This word describes what happens most of the time. A shop may open early each day. A person can describe a regular habit.

examples.en: We ate a green vegetable with dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐吃了一種綠色蔬菜。

examples.en: Carrot is my favorite vegetable.
examples.zh: 胡蘿蔔是我最喜歡的蔬菜。

examples.en: The farmer grows many kinds of vegetables.
examples.zh: 農夫種植許多種類的蔬菜。

explains.en: A plant grown for food may have leaves or roots. Carrots and peas are examples. People may cook them for dinner.
This food comes from a plant. A cook may chop it into soup. It can be fresh, frozen, or dried.
A farmer grows these plants in a field. People eat many kinds. Some are green, while others grow beneath soil.

examples.en: She is a very polite and hardworking student.
examples.zh: 她是一位非常禮貌且用功的學生。

examples.en: Thank you very much for your thoughtful birthday present.
examples.zh: 非常感謝你貼心準備的生日禮物。

examples.en: This is the very book that my teacher recommended last semester.
examples.zh: 這本正是我的老師上學期極力推薦的那本書。

explains.en: It means to a great degree. A person may feel happy about a gift. The word can make an idea stronger.
A cold day may make people wear coats. A person can feel tired after work. This word adds strength to a description.
This word means greatly or truly. A child may enjoy a fun game. It can come before a describing word.

examples.en: The children watched a short video.
examples.zh: 孩子們看了一段短片。

examples.en: She made a video of the school concert.
examples.zh: 她拍了一段學校音樂會的影片。

examples.en: This video shows how to bake bread.
examples.zh: 這段影片示範如何烤麵包。

entries.definition: （名）影片；錄影；（動）錄影；（形）影片的

explains.en: A recording shows moving pictures with sound. A person may watch one on a phone. It can teach or entertain.
A short clip can show an event. A teacher may play one in class. It is stored on a computer or camera.
People watch this kind of recording on a screen. It may have music or speech. A phone can make one.

examples.en: The violin soloist performed beautifully on stage.
examples.zh: 小提琴獨奏家在舞台上演奏得非常優美。

examples.en: A good violin produces a warm, rich, and expressive tone.
examples.zh: 一把優質的小提琴能發出溫暖、渾厚且富有表現力的音色。

examples.en: She tuned her violin carefully before the orchestral rehearsal began.
examples.zh: 在管弦樂團彩排開始前，她仔細地為小提琴調音。

examples.en: The violin soloist played with incredible passion and precision.
examples.zh: 小提琴獨奏家以無比的熱情與精準度進行演奏。

examples.en: An authentic Stradivarius violin can sell for millions of dollars at auction.
examples.zh: 真正的史特拉第瓦里古董名琴在拍賣會上能拍出數百萬美元天價。

examples.en: Rosin your violin bow thoroughly before practicing classical etudes.
examples.zh: 在練習古典練習曲前，請用松香仔細擦拭你的小提琴琴弓。

explains.en: A wooden instrument has four strings and is played with a bow. A musician holds it near the neck. It can make high sounds.
A player moves a bow across its strings. It is often used in an orchestra. The instrument is made from wood.
This instrument can play classical music. A person holds it under the chin. A bow helps make sound.

examples.en: Many foreign tourists visit the National Palace Museum.
examples.zh: 許多外國遊客參觀國立故宮博物院。

examples.en: We visit our grandparents in the countryside every Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 每年農曆新年我們都會去鄉下探望祖父母。

examples.en: Doctors visit hospitalized patients in the wards every morning.
examples.zh: 醫生每天早晨都會到病房巡視探視住院病患。

explains.en: It means going to see a person or place. A child may go to a friend’s home. The word can also mean spending time with a doctor.
A person may travel to a museum. A family can go see a grandparent. The action can be for work or fun.
This action means going somewhere for a short time. A student may go see a teacher. It can also mean asking a doctor for help.

examples.en: A visitor asked for directions.
examples.zh: 一位訪客問路。

examples.en: The museum welcomes every visitor.
examples.zh: 博物館歡迎每一位訪客。

examples.en: The visitor left a note for the family.
examples.zh: 訪客留了一張紙條給那個家庭。

explains.en: A person who comes to a place for a short time is a guest. A museum may welcome many each day. A host can help them.
A traveler may come into a town for a day. A family can welcome this person at home. The person does not live there.
This word means a guest in a place. A guide may help one learn about a city. A hotel worker can answer questions.

examples.en: The singer has a sweet and melodious voice.
examples.zh: 這位歌手擁有一副甜美悅耳的好歌喉。

examples.en: Please lower your voice because patients in the ward are resting.
examples.zh: 病房裡的病患正在休息，請壓低你的說話音量。

examples.en: Citizens have every right to raise their voice against unfair community policies.
examples.zh: 公民完全有權利發出聲音反對不合理的社區政策。

explains.en: It is the sound made when a person speaks or sings. A phone call carries it. It can be high or low.
A person uses this sound to talk. A singer may have a strong one. It comes from the throat.
This sound helps people share words. A child may recognize a parent by it. It can be loud, soft, high, or low.

examples.en: Please wait here until your number is called.
examples.zh: 請在這裡等候直到叫到你的號碼。

examples.en: I cannot wait to see my best friend after summer vacation.
examples.zh: 暑假結束後我迫不及待想見到最好的朋友。

examples.en: We waited patiently in line for the popular bakery to open.
examples.zh: 我們耐心地排隊等待這家人氣麵包店開門。

explains.en: It means staying in one place until something happens. A person may remain at a bus stop. The word can also mean a period of delay.
A child may remain near the door. A friend may arrive later. This word can mean expecting someone or something.
This action means not leaving yet. A person may remain in a line. It can also mean putting something off.

examples.en: I usually wake up at 6:30 in the morning.
examples.zh: 我通常早上六點半醒來。

examples.en: Please wake me up if my alarm doesn't ring.
examples.zh: 如果我的鬧鐘沒響，請叫醒我。

examples.en: The loud thunder woke the baby up in the middle of the night.
examples.zh: 巨大的雷聲在半夜驚醒了嬰兒。

explains.en: It means opening the eyes after sleep. A person may get out of bed in the morning. An alarm can help.
A child may become awake when the sun comes up. A sound may make a person stop sleeping. The action can happen naturally or with help.
This action ends a period of sleep. A parent may call a child in the morning. A loud clock can cause it.

examples.en: I like to walk my dog in the park.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在公園裡溜狗散步。

examples.en: It is healthy to take a twenty-minute walk after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐後散步二十分鐘對身體很有益處。

examples.en: We decided to walk to the museum instead of taking the bus.
examples.zh: 我們決定走路去博物館而不是搭公車。

explains.en: It means moving on foot at a regular pace. A person may go around a park. The word can also mean guiding a dog outside.
A child may go along a path with a friend. People use their legs for this action. It is slower than running.
This action moves a person from place to place using the feet. A family may do it after dinner. A dog needs it each day.

examples.en: There is a world map on the wall.
examples.zh: 牆上有一張世界地圖。

examples.en: Don't draw or write on the classroom wall.
examples.zh: 請勿在教室牆壁上塗鴉或寫字。

examples.en: They painted the bedroom wall light blue.
examples.zh: 他們把臥室的牆壁漆成了淺藍色。

explains.en: A building may have a flat side around a room. People hang pictures on it. A fence can mark a yard.
A brick structure can keep wind out. A person may lean against one. A room has several flat surfaces around it.
This part of a house stands upright. It may hold a window or door. A ball can bounce off it.

examples.en: I want to order a bowl of beef noodles.
examples.zh: 我想要點一碗牛肉麵。

examples.en: Do you want to join our study group this semester?
examples.zh: 這學期你想加入我們的讀書小組嗎？

examples.en: The charity provides warm coats to families in want during winter.
examples.zh: 該慈善機構在冬季為貧困家庭提供保暖大衣。

explains.en: It means wishing for something. A child may ask for a new bike. The word can also mean needing an item.
A person may hope for a day off. A shopper can ask for a bag. It describes a wish or desire.
This word tells that someone hopes to have something. A child may ask for a snack. It can also mean choosing a result.

examples.en: Spring brings warm sunshine and blooming flowers.
examples.zh: 春天帶來溫暖的陽光和綻放的花朵。

examples.en: She gave her guests a warm and enthusiastic welcome.
examples.zh: 她對客人給予了溫馨熱誠的歡迎。

examples.en: Remember to warm up your muscles before running the sprint.
examples.zh: 短跑衝刺前記得先把肌肉熱身開來。

explains.en: It means having a pleasant amount of heat. A blanket can keep a person comfortable. Soup may be served this way.
A sunny room may feel comfortable. A coat helps keep the body from getting cold. The word can also describe a kind welcome.
This word means not cold. A cup of tea may have gentle heat. A friendly smile can make a guest feel welcome.

examples.en: My dad bought me a digital watch.
examples.zh: 我爸爸買給我一隻數位手錶。

examples.en: Do you want to watch a movie with us tonight?
examples.zh: 你今晚想和我們一起看電影嗎？

examples.en: Watch out for cars when you cross the street!
examples.zh: 過馬路時要注意來車！

explains.en: A person looks at a clock to know the hour. They may also see a show on a screen. The word can mean keeping guard.
A child may look at birds in a tree. A person can see a movie at home. The word also names a small clock worn on a wrist.
