This action uses the eyes for a period. A person may keep guard at night. It can also mean following a game.

examples.en: Remember to drink plenty of water every day.
examples.zh: 記得每天多喝水。

examples.en: Don't forget to water the plants on the balcony.
examples.zh: 別忘了給陽台上的植物澆水。

examples.en: Can I have a glass of cold water, please?
examples.zh: 請問能給我一杯冰水嗎？

explains.en: It is a clear liquid people drink. Rivers and lakes hold it. Rain falls from clouds.
A person may drink this after running. A bath can be filled with it. Plants need it to grow.
This liquid has no color or smell. It comes from a tap. A person can freeze it into ice.

examples.en: Massive colliding black holes send catastrophic ripples of gravitational waves vibrating across the cosmos.
examples.zh: 雙黑洞劇烈碰撞合併，向浩瀚宇宙釋放出震撼時空結構的「重力波時空漣漪」（Gravitational Waves）。

examples.en: Surfers paddled furiously to catch the gigantic rolling wave crashing onto the sandy coastline.
examples.zh: 衝浪愛好者拼命划水追浪，試圖征服那道轟然拍擊在金色沙灘上的壯麗翻騰海浪。

examples.en: The government announced a supportive wave of renewable energy subsidies for rural solar cooperatives.
examples.zh: 政府農政部門宣布推出新一波針對農村太陽能發電合作社的專案綠能補貼支持措施。

entries.definition: 穿越時空傳播之引力波重力波；波浪

explains.en: A moving line of water travels across a lake or sea. It can rise and fall. A hand can also move from side to side to greet someone.
People may see this motion on the ocean. A flag can move in the wind. A person may lift a hand in greeting.
This word can mean a moving line of water. It can also mean moving a hand or arm. A radio can send signals through the air.

examples.en: This is a good way to learn new words.
examples.zh: 這是學習新單字的好方法。

examples.en: We found a quiet way through the forest.
examples.zh: 我們找到一條穿越森林的安靜小路。

examples.en: There is no easy way to solve this puzzle.
examples.zh: 沒有簡單的方法可以解開這個謎題。

explains.en: It means a path or route. A person may find one through a forest. It can also mean a method for doing something.
A road leads from one place to another. A person may choose a method for learning. The word can also mean how something happens.
This word can describe a direction or method. A traveler may look for a route. It can also mean a style or manner.

examples.en: We take the MRT to school every day.
examples.zh: 我們每天搭捷運上學。

examples.en: We are going to have a picnic this weekend.
examples.zh: 我們這個週末打算去野餐。

examples.en: We should protect the environment together.
examples.zh: 我們應該一起保護環境。

examples.en: We prepared all the party decorations ourselves.
examples.zh: 我們自己動手準備了所有派對布置。

examples.en: We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves at the beach music festival last Saturday.
examples.zh: 我們上週六在海灘音樂節上玩得非常盡興開心。

examples.en: We must rely on ourselves to solve complex mathematical challenges.
examples.zh: 我們必須依靠自己的力量來解開複雜的數學難題。

explains.en: This pronoun refers to the speaker and at least one other person. It can be the subject of a sentence. Related forms can show ownership or receive an action.
A group that includes the speaker can be named by this pronoun. It replaces several names. Other forms act as objects or show possession.
This word points to a group that includes the person speaking. It may come before an action. Different forms can mean belonging to that group.

examples.en: I felt weak after recovering from the flu.
examples.zh: 流行性感冒痊癒後我感到身體有些虛弱。

examples.en: The wooden bridge is too weak to support heavy vehicles.
examples.zh: 這座木橋結構太脆弱，無法承載重型車輛。

examples.en: Math has always been my weakest subject in school.
examples.zh: 數學一直是我在學校裡最薄弱的科目。

explains.en: It means having little strength. A sick person may feel this way. A thin rope may break easily.
A small light may be hard to see. A person may need rest after illness. The word can describe something not powerful.
This word means not strong. A gentle wind may barely move a leaf. A person may need help lifting a box.

examples.en: Students must wear uniforms to school.
examples.zh: 學生上學必須穿制服。

examples.en: She always wears glasses when working on the computer.
examples.zh: 她在用電腦時總是戴著眼鏡。

examples.en: What are you planning to wear to the birthday party?
examples.zh: 你打算穿什麼去參加生日派對？

explains.en: It means having clothes on the body. A person may put on a coat in winter. The word can also mean having a certain look.
A child puts on shoes before going outside. A ring can stay on a finger. Clothing may become old after much use.
This action covers the body in clothing. A person may put on a hat. The word can also describe carrying a smile.

examples.en: The weather is pleasant in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天的天氣很宜人。

examples.en: Check the weather forecast before going hiking in the mountains.
examples.zh: 去山區健行前請務必查看天氣預報。

examples.en: Hot and humid weather is typical during summer in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 炎熱潮濕的天氣是台灣夏天的典型特徵。

explains.en: It describes the air outside, including sun, rain, or wind. People may check a report before travel. A storm can change it quickly.
A cold day or a warm day is described by this word. Clouds and rain are part of it. A forecast tells what may happen outside.
People look outside to learn if it is sunny or rainy. This word describes those conditions. It can change from day to day.

examples.en: There are seven days in a week.
examples.zh: 一個星期有七天。

examples.en: We are taking final exams next week.
examples.zh: 我們下週要參加期末考。

examples.en: I go to swimming class twice a week.
examples.zh: 我每週上兩次游泳課。

explains.en: Seven days make one of these periods. A calendar shows its dates. A person may work for five days and rest after.
This period has seven days. Monday and Tuesday are two of them. A month contains several.
A school schedule may repeat after seven days. People count time by these periods. One has seven mornings.

examples.en: Have a great weekend with your friends!
examples.zh: 和朋友度過一個愉快的週末吧！

examples.en: What are your plans for the upcoming three-day weekend?
examples.zh: 你對即將到來的連續三天週末有什麼計畫？

examples.en: We spent the entire weekend hiking in Yangmingshan National Park.
examples.zh: 我們整個週末都在陽明山國家公園健行。

explains.en: Saturday and Sunday are often part of these days. Many people do not go to work then. Families may take a trip.
This time comes after Friday. It often gives people a break from school or work. Friends may meet for fun.
A person may sleep later during these two days. Shops may be busy. People often visit family during this time.

examples.en: You are always welcome to visit our school.
examples.zh: 隨時歡迎你來參觀我們的學校。

examples.en: The friendly host welcomed the foreign guests with fresh fruit juice.
examples.zh: 親切的主人用新鮮果汁熱情款待外國賓客。

examples.en: Warm spring sunshine was a welcome change after weeks of winter chills.
examples.zh: 經歷了數週的冬寒後，溫暖的春陽是令人欣喜的轉變。

explains.en: It means greeting a person kindly. A host may invite a guest inside. The word can also describe something accepted or allowed.
A friendly greeting can make a visitor feel at home. A new idea may be accepted by a group. This word can also mean gladly received.
A person may greet a guest at the door. An offer can be gladly accepted. The word can also mean allowed.

examples.en: She speaks English very well.
examples.zh: 她英文說得很好。

examples.en: I hope you are feeling well today.
examples.zh: 我希望你今天感覺很好。

examples.en: The farmer dug a well for fresh water.
examples.zh: 農夫挖了一口井來取乾淨的水。

entries.definition: （副）好地；充分地；（形）健康的；（名）井

explains.en: It can mean healthy. A person may feel good after resting. It can also mean in a good way.
A doctor may say a patient is healthy again. A student can do a task correctly. The word may also name a deep hole for water.
This word may describe a person who is not ill. It can also mean something was done in a good way. A farm may have a deep water hole.

examples.en: The sun sets in the west over the ocean.
examples.zh: 太陽在西方海面上緩緩落下。

examples.en: Taiwan's major high-speed rail line runs along the flat west coast plain.
examples.zh: 台灣的高鐵主幹線沿著平坦的西海岸平原運行。

examples.en: We drove west toward the coastal scenic highway to catch the twilight.
examples.zh: 我們開車一路向西前往濱海景觀公路追逐餘暉。

explains.en: It is a direction on a map. It is opposite east. The sun sets toward this side.
A compass can point to this direction. It is found on the left side of many maps. A person may travel toward it.
This word names one of four main directions. A country may lie in this part of a region. A sunset occurs in this direction.

examples.en: The grass was wet after the rain.
examples.zh: 下雨後草地是濕的。

examples.en: His wet shoes dried by the door.
examples.zh: 他的濕鞋子在門邊晾乾了。

examples.en: We got wet while swimming in the lake.
examples.zh: 我們在湖裡游泳時全身都濕了。

explains.en: It means covered in water or another liquid. Rain can make clothes this way. A sponge can become soaked.
A person may step in a puddle and get shoes soaked. A towel can dry a surface. The word can describe something not dry.
A dog may come inside after swimming with its fur soaked. Rain can leave a road shiny. This describing word means damp.

examples.en: What would you like to eat for dinner?
examples.zh: 你晚餐想吃什麼？

examples.en: What time does the next northbound high-speed train depart?
examples.zh: 下一班北上高鐵什麼時候發車？

examples.en: What a wonderful performance by the school orchestra!
examples.zh: 學校管弦樂團的演出真是太精彩了！

explains.en: It is used to ask about a thing or fact. A person may ask for a name. The word begins many questions.
A teacher may ask for information using this question word. It can refer to an object or an idea. A reply gives an answer.
This word helps ask for details. A child may use it when curious. It can ask about a thing, action, or fact.

examples.en: When does the English class start?
examples.zh: 英文課什麼時候開始？

examples.en: Call me immediately when you arrive safely at the station.
examples.zh: 當你平安抵達車站時，請立刻打電話給我。

examples.en: I remember the exact moment when we won our first trophy.
examples.zh: 我清楚記得我們贏得第一座獎盃的那一瞬間。

explains.en: It asks about a time. A person may ask for a birthday date. It can also connect two events.
This question word asks at what time an event happens. A clock can help find an answer. It may link a past event to another.
A person can use this word for a day or hour. It may begin a question. It also connects events happening at the same time.

examples.en: Where can I buy an EasyCard?
examples.zh: 我可以在哪裡買到悠遊卡？

examples.en: Where did you leave your bicycle after school yesterday?
examples.zh: 昨天放學後你把腳踏車停在哪裡了？

examples.en: Home is where the heart finds true peace and comfort.
examples.zh: 家是心靈尋得真正平靜與撫慰的所在。

explains.en: It asks about a place. A traveler may ask for a station. A map can help answer.
This question word asks in what place something is. A person may use it when looking for a home. It can also begin a sentence about a place.
A child may ask for a location using this word. A map can give an answer. It may refer to a town, room, or country.

examples.en: Let me know whether you can attend the farewell party tonight.
examples.zh: 請讓我知道你今晚是否能夠出席歡送派對。

examples.en: Whether it rains or shines, the annual marathon race will take place as scheduled.
examples.zh: 無論當天天候是艷陽高照還是刮風下雨，一年一度的馬拉松大賽都將如期舉行。

examples.en: He couldn't decide whether to study computer engineering or fine arts at university.
examples.zh: 他一時之間難以抉擇，上大學後究竟該專攻電腦資訊工程還是純藝術創作。

explains.en: It asks if one of two things is true. A person may ask if a friend can come. The answer may be yes or no.
This word introduces a choice or doubt. A teacher may ask if homework is finished. It can mean no matter which option is true.
A person can use this word before two possible outcomes. A question may ask if something happened. It can also mean regardless of the answer.

examples.en: Which dessert do you prefer, cake or ice cream?
examples.zh: 蛋糕和冰淇淋，你比較喜歡哪一個甜點？

examples.en: Which platform does our train to Hualien leave from?
examples.zh: 我們去花蓮的火車在第幾月台發車？

examples.en: Tell me which of these two books you enjoyed reading more.
examples.zh: 告訴我這兩本書中你比較喜歡閱讀哪一本。

explains.en: It asks a person to choose from a group. A child may point at one toy. The answer names one choice.
This word refers to a specific person or object in a group. A question may ask for one item. It can also join two ideas.
A speaker may use it when asking about a choice. A list can have many things. The reply identifies one of them.

examples.en: Listen to pleasant music while doing your homework.
examples.zh: 寫作業時可以聽些悅耳的音樂。

examples.en: Some people prefer waking up early, while others work best late at night.
examples.zh: 有些人偏好早起工作，然而其他人則在深夜時效率最高。

examples.en: Let's sit on the park bench and rest our legs for a little while.
examples.zh: 我們在公園長椅上坐一下，稍微讓雙腿休息一會兒吧。

examples.en: Listen to English audio while commuting on the MRT every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早上搭乘捷運通勤時聽英文廣播。

examples.en: While my sister loves spicy hot pot, I prefer mild herbal chicken soup.
examples.zh: 然而我姐姐極度嗜吃麻辣火鍋，我個人卻偏好清甜甘醇的溫和藥膳雞湯。

examples.en: Sit down and rest a while on the park bench after your long jog.
examples.zh: 跑完漫長的一大圈晨跑之後，不妨在公園的木質長凳上坐下來稍微歇息片刻。

entries.definition: 當…之時；一段時間；當…的時候；然而

explains.en: It means during a period of time. A child may read as a parent cooks. It can also show contrast.
A person may listen to music during homework. Two actions can happen at once. The word can also mean although.
This word can connect two events happening at the same time. It can also introduce an opposing idea. A person may wait for a short period.

examples.en: White snow covered the mountain top.
examples.zh: 白雪覆蓋了山頂。

examples.en: Please write your answers on a blank sheet of white paper.
examples.zh: 請將答案寫在一張空白的白紙上。

examples.en: The doctor wore a clean white lab coat.
examples.zh: 醫生穿著一件乾淨的白長袍。

explains.en: This color is like fresh snow or milk. A sheet of paper may have this shade. It is the opposite of black.
A cloud can look this color in sunlight. A rabbit may have fur of this shade. It can also describe a pale face.
This word names a light color. People may use it for walls or clothing. It is often linked with purity.

examples.en: Who is that smiling lady in the picture?
examples.zh: 照片中那位微笑的女士是誰？

examples.en: Who won first prize in the national English speech contest?
examples.zh: 誰在全國英語演講比賽中獲得了第一名？

examples.en: Do you know who invented the world wide web?
examples.zh: 你知道是誰發明了全球資訊網嗎？

explains.en: It asks about a person. A speaker may ask for a name. The answer can point to a man or woman.
This question word asks which person did something. A teacher may use it to ask for a helper. It can also connect parts of a sentence.
A child may use this word when looking for a friend. It asks about a person’s identity. It may begin a question.

examples.en: Whose bag is on the chair?
examples.zh: 椅子上的包包是誰的？

examples.en: I know whose coat this is.
examples.zh: 我知道這是誰的外套。

examples.en: Whose turn is next?
examples.zh: 下一個輪到誰？

entries.definition: 誰的；哪一個人的（所有格疑問詞或關係代名詞）

explains.en: It asks who owns something. A person may ask about a bag. The answer names its owner.
This question word asks about ownership. A child may ask which person has a toy. It can also connect ideas in a sentence.
A speaker may use this word before a noun to ask about its owner. It can point to a person. It appears in questions.

examples.en: Why are you late for school today?
examples.zh: 你今天為什麼上學遲到？

examples.en: The teacher patiently explained why regular review improves exam scores.
examples.zh: 老師耐心地解釋了為何定期複習能提升考試成績。

examples.en: Why not join our cycling club and make new friends?
examples.zh: 何不加入我們的單車社團結交新朋友呢？

explains.en: It asks for a reason. A person may ask for an explanation. The answer may begin with because.
This question word asks for a cause. A child may ask for an explanation about a rule. A reply can give a reason.
A person uses this word to ask what caused something. It can begin a question. The answer explains a reason.

examples.en: The river is wide near the bridge.
examples.zh: 河流在橋附近很寬。

examples.en: She opened the wide gate.
examples.zh: 她打開寬大的門。

examples.en: The table is too wide for this room.
examples.zh: 這張桌子對這個房間來說太寬了。

entries.definition: 寬的；廣闊的；充分睜大的。

explains.en: It means having a large distance from left to right. A river can be hard to cross. A road may have many lanes.
A door can have a large opening from side to side. A smile may stretch across a face. The word describes a great width.
This word means broad. A table may have a large surface. It can describe something that covers a lot from one side to another.

examples.en: His wife works at a hospital.
examples.zh: 他的妻子在醫院工作。

examples.en: The farmer and his wife live near the hill.
examples.zh: 農夫和他的妻子住在山坡附近。

examples.en: My uncle brought his wife to dinner.
examples.zh: 我叔叔帶他的妻子來吃晚餐。

explains.en: A married man may call this woman his partner. They can share a home. The word describes a family relationship.
A person may marry a woman and live as a family. She may be a mother. This word names her relation to her partner.
This word refers to a woman in a marriage. A family may have children. The couple can share a life together.

examples.en: The train will arrive in five minutes.
examples.zh: 火車將在五分鐘內抵達。

examples.en: She showed remarkable iron will in overcoming the sports injury.
examples.zh: 她展現了鋼鐵般的堅強意志戰勝了運動傷害。

examples.en: Technology will continue to reshape how people learn and collaborate globally.
examples.zh: 科技將繼續重塑全球人類學習與協同合作的方式。

explains.en: It can show that something happens in the future. A person may make a promise. It can also mean determination.
This helping verb can talk about a future action. It can also show a promise or a decision made at the moment of speaking. A person may use it when offering to carry a bag.
This word may mean shall or is going to. A person can make a firm choice. A legal paper can say who gets belongings after death.

examples.en: Our school baseball team won the championship game.
examples.zh: 我們學校的棒球隊贏得了冠軍賽。

examples.en: Hard work and consistent practice will help you win competitions.
examples.zh: 勤奮努力與持續不懈的練習將助你在比賽中獲勝。

examples.en: She felt overjoyed to win first prize in the national contest.
examples.zh: 在全國大賽中榮獲首獎讓她感到欣喜若狂。

explains.en: It means coming first in a contest. A team may get a medal. A person can receive a prize.
A runner may reach the end before others. A game has one side that does better. This word can also mean getting something by effort.
This action means being the best in a contest. A player may score more points. A person can gain a prize or honor.

examples.en: A strong wind blew my hat away.
examples.zh: 一陣強風吹走了我的帽子。

examples.en: A refreshing cool wind blew in from the sea.
examples.zh: 一陣清涼爽朗的微風從海面上吹拂而來。

examples.en: Wind turbines generate renewable energy along the western coast.
examples.zh: 風力發電機在西部海岸生產再生能源。

explains.en: Moving air can make leaves shake. A person may feel it outside. It can be soft or very strong.
A storm may bring fast-moving air. A flag can move because of it. The word also means twisting something around a center.
Air travels across the land. It may cool a warm day. A person can twist a clock key to make it work.

examples.en: Open the window to let fresh air in.
examples.zh: 打開窗戶讓新鮮空氣進來。

examples.en: The cat is sitting quietly by the living room window.
examples.zh: 貓咪安靜地坐在客廳窗戶旁。

examples.en: Raindrops are tapping gently against the bedroom window.
examples.zh: 雨滴輕輕敲打著臥室的窗戶。

examples.en: The planetary launch window opens every twenty-six months when Earth and Mars align favorably in orbit.
examples.zh: 當地球與火星在公轉軌道上運行至最佳相對位置時，每二十六個月才會開啟一次寶貴的發射窗口。

examples.en: Missing the tight launch window forces flight planners to postpone interplanetary missions by two full years.
examples.zh: 萬一因天氣或技術故障錯過這短短兩週的發射窗口，整個火星探測計畫將被迫整整延宕兩年之久。

examples.en: Propulsion engineers calculated an optimal departure window to take full advantage of orbital alignment.
examples.zh: 火箭軌道工程師精算出能量消耗最低的最佳出發窗口，以極致利用兩顆行星公轉軌道的幾何交會紅利。

entries.definition: 窗戶；每二十六個月開啟一次的地火發射窗口

explains.en: A clear opening in a wall lets light enter. People can look outside through it. Curtains may cover it.
A house has glass panels that can open. A bird may sit on its outer ledge. A person may close it during a storm.
This part of a room lets people see outdoors. It may have curtains or blinds. A frame holds its glass.

examples.en: It is wise to save money for later.
examples.zh: 先存錢以備將來是明智的。

examples.en: The wise old woman gave good advice.
examples.zh: 那位睿智的老太太給了很好的建議。

examples.en: He made a wise choice.
examples.zh: 他做了一個明智的選擇。

explains.en: It means having good judgment. An older person may give helpful advice. A careful choice can show this quality.
A person who learns from experience may have this quality. It can describe a thoughtful choice. The opposite is foolish.
This word describes someone who thinks carefully. A leader may make a good choice. A kind answer can show sound judgment.

examples.en: We wish you a Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!
examples.zh: 我們祝你聖誕快樂、新年如意！

examples.en: Close your eyes and make a special birthday wish.
examples.zh: 閉上眼睛，許下一個特別的生日願望。

examples.en: Send my warmest best wishes to your family members.
examples.zh: 代我向你的家人致上最誠摯溫馨的祝福。

examples.en: Make a wish before blowing out the birthday candles.
examples.zh: 吹熄生日蠟燭前許個願吧。

examples.en: I wish you the best of luck on your college entrance exam!
examples.zh: 祝你在大學聯考中一切好運順利！

examples.en: Send our warm wishes to your parents when you visit home.
examples.zh: 你回家探親時代我們向你的雙親致上溫馨的祝福。

explains.en: It means hoping for something good. A child may hope for a pet. It can also mean a kind greeting for a birthday.
A person may hope a friend feels better. A candle can be blown out after making one. The word can also be a desire.
This feeling is a hope for the future. People may express one on a holiday. A person can want something to happen.

examples.en: I like drinking hot pearl milk tea with less sugar.
examples.zh: 我喜歡喝微糖的熱珍珠奶茶。

examples.en: She loves spending her weekend afternoons cooking dinner with close friends.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在週末午後和親密摯友一起動手煮晚餐。

examples.en: Write your signature with a black ballpoint pen on the official form.
examples.zh: 請在正式表格上使用黑色原子筆簽上你的名字。

explains.en: It means together or alongside. A person may walk beside a friend. It can also mean using an object.
A meal may include rice and beans. A person can hold a cup in one hand. The word can mean having something at the same time.
This short preposition can show company. A child may go to school beside a parent. It can also describe a tool used for an action.

examples.en: Never go hiking in remote mountains without a guide.
examples.zh: 絕不要在沒有嚮導的情況下深入荒山健行。

examples.en: Without a doubt, hard work and dedication yield meaningful rewards.
examples.zh: 毫無疑問，辛勤耕耘與全心投入必能收穫豐碩回報。

examples.en: Plants cannot survive without sunlight, carbon dioxide, and adequate water.
examples.zh: 沒有陽光、二氧化碳與充足的水分，植物便無法生存。

examples.en: Never enter a construction zone without wearing a safety helmet.
examples.zh: 未佩戴安全帽切勿進入施工工地區域。

examples.en: We navigated the winding mountain backroads successfully without a GPS map.
examples.zh: 在沒有衛星定位導航的情況下，我們憑著路標成功穿過了蜿蜒的深山小徑。

examples.en: She completed the demanding half-marathon course without stopping to rest once.
examples.zh: 她跑完了極具挑戰性的半程馬拉松賽事，全程連一次停下來休息都沒有。

explains.en: It means lacking something. A person may go outside and have no coat. A meal may have no salt.
A room may have no windows. A person can do a task lacking help. The word shows that something is missing.
This word tells that an item is not present. A person may travel lacking a bag. It can also mean unless.

examples.en: That woman is wearing a beautiful dress.
examples.zh: 那位女士穿著一件漂亮的洋裝。

examples.en: A kind woman returned the lost wallet to the police station.
examples.zh: 一位好心的女士將遺失的皮夾送到警察局。

examples.en: She is a successful businesswoman in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她是台北一位成功的女性企業家。

explains.en: An adult female person has this meaning. She may be a mother or sister. The word can describe a grown person.
A girl becomes an adult. This word names an adult female. People may use it in forms or stories.
This person is no longer a child. She may have a job or family. The word refers to an adult female human.

examples.en: We had a wonderful family vacation in Taitung.
examples.zh: 我們在台東度過了一個精彩美好的家庭假期。

examples.en: The violinist played a truly wonderful musical piece that moved the audience.
examples.zh: 那位小提琴家演奏了一首極其美妙、深深打動聽眾的樂章。

examples.en: What a wonderful surprise to bump into an old classmate on the train!
examples.zh: 在火車上巧遇老同學真是個令人驚喜的美好緣分！

explains.en: It means very good and pleasing. A day with friends may feel this way. A gift can make a person happy.
A beautiful view may bring joy. A person may have a lovely time. This word describes something excellent.
This word means marvelous or very pleasing. A kind act may make someone feel happy. A song can sound lovely.

examples.en: Please write one word on each line.
examples.zh: 請在每一行寫一個單字。

examples.en: The word “apple” has five letters.
examples.zh: 「apple」這個單字有五個字母。

examples.en: She learned a new word today.
examples.zh: 她今天學了一個新單字。

explains.en: A group of letters with meaning is part of a sentence. A person may look one up in a book. Speech uses many of them.
A language has many units with meaning. A child can learn how to spell one. Several can form a sentence.
This small piece of language can name an object or action. A dictionary explains it. People use many while speaking.

examples.en: My father works at a tech company in Hsinchu.
examples.zh: 我父親在新竹的一家科技公司上班。

examples.en: Hard work and persistence will eventually pay off.
examples.zh: 辛勤工作與持之以恆終將換來回報。

examples.en: That medication worked wonders and cured my headache.
examples.zh: 那種藥效神奇，治好了我的頭痛。

explains.en: People do this to earn money. A person may do a task at an office. A machine can also function.
A job takes effort and time. A person may make art as a job. The word can mean a task or a place of employment.
This activity may help people earn a living. A machine can run properly. A person may make a painting or book as a result.

examples.en: The factory workers are taking a lunch break.
examples.zh: 工廠工人們正在吃午休便當。

examples.en: Construction workers wear yellow protective helmets on building sites.
examples.zh: 建築工人在工地現場佩戴黃色安全帽。

examples.en: Diligent office workers gathered to brainstorm new promotional campaigns.
examples.zh: 勤奮的上班族聚在一起集思廣益構思新的促銷方案。

explains.en: A person who has a job may build, clean, or teach. A factory can have many. The word describes someone who does labor.
This person earns money by doing a task. A cook may prepare food. A person can also volunteer.
A person in a job has this name. Some build houses, and others care for people. The word can describe many kinds of labor.

examples.en: People around the world enjoy music.
examples.zh: 世界各地的人都喜歡音樂。

examples.en: The world looks beautiful from space.
examples.zh: 從太空看地球很美。

examples.en: They traveled around the world by boat.
examples.zh: 他們搭船環遊世界。

explains.en: It means Earth and all people, places, and life. A map may show many countries. People live on this planet.
A large group of people across Earth can be described this way. It may also mean a setting or area of life. A person can travel around it.
This word names the planet where humans live. It can mean all countries together. A person may see its beauty in nature.

examples.en: Do not worry about the small mistake.
examples.zh: 不要為小錯誤擔心。

examples.en: She worries when her son is late.
examples.zh: 兒子遲到時她會擔心。

examples.en: His worry kept him awake at night.
examples.zh: 他的擔憂讓他夜裡睡不著。

explains.en: It means feeling uneasy about a problem. A person may be afraid of a test. Talking can help.
A parent may feel uneasy when a child is late. A difficult thought can cause stress. The word can also mean causing concern.
This feeling may happen before an important event. A friend may offer comfort. It can mean being troubled in mind.

examples.en: Please write down your email address.
examples.zh: 請寫下你的電子郵件地址。

examples.en: She writes in her personal diary every night before going to sleep.
examples.zh: 她每晚睡前都會在私人日記裡寫下記錄。

examples.en: He decided to write a thank-you letter to his former tutor.
examples.zh: 他決定寫一封感謝信給他以前的家教老師。

explains.en: It means making letters or words on paper. A child may do homework. A person can use a keyboard.
A person may put an idea in a letter. A student can make a story. The action uses a pen or computer.
This action records language. A child may put their name on a page. A person can send a message by email.

examples.en: She dreams of becoming a fiction writer.
examples.zh: 她夢想成為一名小說作家。

examples.en: The famous travel writer published a bestselling book about hiking trails.
examples.zh: 著名旅遊作家出版了一本關於健行步道的暢銷著作。

examples.en: A skilled writer uses clear, concise, and vivid language to connect with readers.
examples.zh: 熟練的寫作者運用清晰、簡練且生動的文字與讀者產生共鳴。

explains.en: A person who creates books, stories, or articles has this job. They may work at home. Their name appears on a book.
This person makes stories with language. A newspaper may have many. They can write facts or make up events.
A book may be made by this person. They choose ideas and put them on a page. Their work can entertain or teach.

examples.en: What is wrong with your bicycle tire?
examples.zh: 你的腳拔車輪胎怎麼了？

examples.en: It is wrong to blame innocent others for your own mistakes.
examples.zh: 將自己的過錯歸咎推卸給無辜的他人是不對的。

examples.en: If anything goes wrong during system testing, alert the technician immediately.
examples.zh: 如果在系統測試期間發生任何差錯，請立即通知技術人員。

explains.en: This describes something that is not correct. A student may write five when the answer is six. The answer needs to be changed.
This can describe a choice that does not fit your purpose. You may take a bus that goes away from your school. You need a different bus to get there.
This can describe an action that is unfair or harmful. Taking another person's belongings without asking is an example. People may use this word to say the action should not happen.

examples.en: The children are playing tag in the front yard.
examples.zh: 小朋友們正在前院玩捉迷藏。

examples.en: Grandpa enjoys planting fragrant flowering bushes in the spacious yard.
examples.zh: 爺爺喜歡在寬敞的院子裡種植散發清香的花木。

examples.en: The fabric merchant measured five yards of fine silk cloth.
examples.zh: 布料商量取了五碼的上等絲綢布料。

examples.en: Smart terminal operating software organizes the container yard to minimize unnecessary box reshuffling.
examples.zh: 智慧碼頭作業系統對貨櫃堆場進行動態空間最佳化，將不必要的翻櫃次數降至最低。

examples.en: Semi-trucks lined up outside the terminal gates waiting to drop off exports in the container yard.
examples.zh: 長途拖車在碼頭大門外排成一條長龍，依序等待進入管制堆場卸放即將報關出口的重櫃。

examples.en: Floodlights illuminate the sprawling container yard, enabling non-stop overnight cargo transfers.
examples.zh: 高空大功率投光燈將廣袤無邊的貨櫃堆場照耀得如白晝，保障通宵達旦的裝卸作業安全運作。

entries.definition: 庭院；院子；碼（長度）；貨櫃堆場智慧堆疊與翻櫃最小化；場地

explains.en: A grassy area beside a home may have flowers. Children can run there. The word can also mean three feet in length.
A fence may surround this outdoor area. A family may keep a garden there. One unit of this length equals thirty-six inches.
This open space may be behind a house. A dog can play there. The word also names a measure of length.

examples.en: Happy New Year to everyone!
examples.zh: 祝大家新年快樂！

examples.en: I will turn sixteen years old this year.
examples.zh: 我今年就要滿十六歲了。

examples.en: Our family travels abroad once a year.
examples.zh: 我們全家每年出國旅遊一次。

explains.en: Twelve months make this period. A birthday comes once during it. People use a calendar to count it.
This length of time begins in January. It has four seasons in many places. A person may say how old they are by counting them.
A calendar shows all days in this period. It lasts about three hundred sixty-five days. People celebrate its beginning.

examples.en: School buses in the US are bright yellow.
examples.zh: 美國的校車是亮黃色的。

examples.en: Sunflowers turned their yellow faces towards the warm sun.
examples.zh: 向日葵把黃色的花盤朝向溫暖的太陽。

examples.en: She highlighted the important keywords with a yellow marker.
examples.zh: 她用黃色螢光筆畫出重要關鍵字。

explains.en: This color is like a ripe lemon. A school bus may have this bright shade. It is made by mixing red and green light.
A banana can be this color before it turns brown. Sunflowers may have petals of this shade. It is a bright color.
This word names a warm color. It can be pale or bright. A warning sign may use it.

examples.en: She said yes to the invitation.
examples.zh: 她答應了邀請。

examples.en: The answer is yes.
examples.zh: 答案是肯定的。

examples.en: He nodded yes when I asked.
examples.zh: 我詢問時他點頭表示同意。

entries.definition: 是；是的；表示肯定的回答

explains.en: It is a word used to agree. A person may answer a question this way. It can also show permission.
A child may say it after a parent asks a question. It means the answer is positive. A person can use it to accept an offer.
This short reply means agreement. A person may use it when asked if they are ready. It can also mean correct.

examples.en: I visited my grandparents yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天去探望我的祖父母。

examples.en: Did you watch the baseball game on TV yesterday?
examples.zh: 你昨天有看電視上的棒球比賽嗎？

examples.en: Yesterday was the hottest day of this week.
examples.zh: 昨天是這星期最炎熱的一天。

explains.en: It means the day before today. A person may remember what happened then. A calendar shows it as a past date.
A child may talk about the previous day. It is one day before now. The word can refer to a recent past.
This word names the day that has ended before today. People may discuss a meeting from that day. It is a past time.

examples.en: Have you finished your English composition yet?
examples.zh: 你的英文作文已經寫完了嗎？

examples.en: We haven't decided our holiday travel destination yet.
examples.zh: 我們尚未決定假期的旅遊目的地。

examples.en: The young athlete was tired yet determined to cross the marathon finish line.
examples.zh: 這位年輕運動員身心疲憊，然而依然下定決心衝過馬拉松終點線。

explains.en: It means up to now, often in a negative sentence. A person may not finish a task. It can also mean even now.
A child may not have eaten lunch at this time. The word can mean until now. It can also show contrast.
This word may mean something has not happened so far. A person can ask if a bus has arrived. It can also mean nevertheless.

examples.en: Nice to meet you.
examples.zh: 很高興認識你。

examples.en: Where did you buy that beautiful notebook?
examples.zh: 你在哪裡買那本漂亮的筆記本的？

examples.en: You can join our study group anytime.
examples.zh: 你隨時都可以加入我們的讀書會。

examples.en: Did you hurt yourself when you fell off the skateboard?
examples.zh: 你從滑板上摔下來時有傷到自己嗎？

examples.en: Did you all enjoy yourselves at the amusement park today?
examples.zh: 你們大家今天在主題遊樂園玩得盡興開懷嗎？

entries.definition: 你；你們；你自己；你們自己

explains.en: This pronoun refers to the person being spoken to. It can be one person or a group. Related forms show ownership or receive an action.
A speaker may use this word while talking directly to a friend. It can replace a name. Other forms can point to something owned by that person.
This word points at a listener. It may be used as a subject or object. Different forms show belonging or refer back to the listener.

examples.en: Many young people enjoy playing online games.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人喜歡玩線上遊戲。

examples.en: When I was young, I spent summer holidays catching cicadas in the orchard.
examples.zh: 當我年幼時，整個暑假都在果園裡抓蟬玩耍。

examples.en: The young artist won an award for her creative landscape paintings.
examples.zh: 這位年輕藝術家以其富創意的風景畫作榮獲獎項。

explains.en: It means not old. A baby is at the beginning of life. A person may still be growing.
A child has not lived many years. A puppy is not fully grown. This word describes someone early in life.
This describing word means new in age. A person may have little experience. A tree can also be newly planted.

examples.en: The score was zero after the first half.
examples.zh: 上半場結束時比分是零比零。

examples.en: Zero is less than one.
examples.zh: 零比一小。

examples.en: The temperature fell to zero last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚氣溫降到零度。

explains.en: This number represents no amount. An empty basket has this many apples. It comes just before one when counting upward.
This digit is written as a closed oval. Its place can change the value of another digit. For example, 10 is larger than 1.
On the Celsius scale, this value is the usual freezing point of water. Colder readings have a minus sign. Warmer readings are above this point.

examples.en: Children love visiting the giant pandas at Taipei Zoo.
examples.zh: 小朋友們喜歡去台北市立動物園看大貓熊。

examples.en: Modern zoos prioritize animal welfare, habitat conservation, and public education.
examples.zh: 現代化動物園優先重視動物福祉、棲地保育與大眾教育。

examples.en: We spent an enjoyable Saturday afternoon exploring the open-air safari zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在戶外野生動物園度過了一個愉快的週六下午。

explains.en: People can see many animals here. Some live in water, and some live on land. Families may visit it on a day off.
This place has cages or open areas for animals. A keeper brings food. Children can learn about wildlife there.
A city may have this place for animal care. Visitors can watch lions, birds, and bears. It can help protect rare animals.

examples.en: His absence made the class feel quiet.
examples.zh: 他的缺席讓班上氣氛很安靜。

examples.en: The absence of rain hurt the crops.
examples.zh: 缺少雨水傷害了農作物。

examples.en: She noticed his absence from the meeting.
examples.zh: 她注意到他沒有出席會議。

explains.en: It means not being present. A teacher may mark a student who is away. The word can also mean a lack of something.
A missing item is not there. A person may notice a gap in a group. The word can describe a lack.
This word names a state of being away. A family may feel sad while a loved one is away. It can also mean something is missing.

examples.en: Why were you absent from English class yesterday morning?
examples.zh: 你昨天早上英文課為什麼缺席沒來？

examples.en: He had an absent look on his face while lost in deep thought.
examples.zh: 他陷入沉思時臉上帶著若有所思、心不在焉的神情。

examples.en: Students who are absent more than three times cannot take the final exam.
examples.zh: 曠課缺席超過三次以上的學生將不得參加期末考試。

explains.en: It means not at a place. A student may be away from class. A chair may be empty.
A worker may not come to the office. The person is away for a day. This word describes not being present.
This word tells that someone is missing from a place. A person may be away due to illness. A room can be empty.

examples.en: She gladly accepted the invitation to the birthday party.
examples.zh: 她欣然接受了參加生日派對的邀請。

examples.en: The university accepted his application for the master's degree program.
examples.zh: 這所大學錄取了他攻讀碩士學位學程的入學申請。

examples.en: Learning to accept constructive criticism helps you grow professionally.
examples.zh: 學會接納建設性的批評能幫助你在職場上不斷成長。

explains.en: It means saying yes to an offer or idea. A person may agree to a gift. The action can also mean taking something willingly.
A friend may agree with a plan. A person can take a job offer. The word may mean allowing something to happen.
This action means receiving or agreeing. A child may take an apology. A group can allow a new member to join.

examples.en: Drive defensively to prevent serious road accidents.
examples.zh: 採取防衛性駕駛以預防嚴重的交通事故。

examples.en: I spilled hot coffee over my keyboard completely by accident.
examples.zh: 我純屬意外不小心把熱咖啡潑灑在鍵盤上。

examples.en: Emergency medics responded swiftly to the factory accident.
examples.zh: 緊急救護人員對工廠發生的意外事件迅速做出了處置。

explains.en: It is an event that happens by chance and may cause harm. A car can hit another car. Someone may get hurt.
A fall on a wet floor can be this kind of event. It was not planned. A doctor may help a person afterward.
This word means a sudden event that was not meant to happen. It may break an object. A person may need help.

examples.en: Enter your username to log in to your student account.
examples.zh: 輸入你的使用者名稱以登入學生帳號。

examples.en: She opened a joint savings account with her husband.
examples.zh: 她和先生開立了一個聯名儲蓄帳戶。

examples.en: Eyewitness accounts helped the police solve the crime.
examples.zh: 目擊者的陳述說明幫助警方偵破了這起案件。

explains.en: It can mean a place where a person keeps money in a bank. It can also mean a username and password online. A story of events has the same name.
A person may open one at a bank. A website may ask someone to sign in. The word can also mean a report of what happened.
This word can mean a record kept by a bank. It may also mean a user profile on a site. A person can give an explanation of an event.

examples.en: Active aging encourages retirees to participate in community clubs, travel, and practice lifelong learning.
examples.zh: 活躍老化理念鼓勵銀髮退休族走出家門參與社團、結伴旅遊，活出精采豐富的第二人生。

examples.en: Regular swimming and cycling help middle-aged adults maintain an active and energetic lifestyle.
examples.zh: 養成規律游泳與騎單車的好習慣，有助於中年族群長期維持活力充沛的積極生活型態。

examples.en: She plays an active role in local neighborhood watch meetings to improve pedestrian sidewalk safety.
examples.zh: 她積極主動參與社區守望相助會報，建言改善社區周遭人行步道的各項通行安全。

entries.definition: 樂齡活躍老化的；積極活躍的

explains.en: It means moving and doing things. A child may run outside. A machine can also be working.
A person who joins many events is lively. A group may be busy. This word can describe something in use.
This word means lively or busy. A person may take part in sports. A machine that works is not idle.

examples.en: Astronauts rehearsed emergency drills for seven-hour extravehicular activity (EVA) spacewalks.
examples.zh: 太空人針對長達七個小時的艙外活動漫步，在水槽中進行了上百次模擬演練。

examples.en: Stepping out through the hatch during extravehicular activity requires double-checking every suit seal.
examples.zh: 跨出氣閘艙門執行艙外活動漫步前，兩位太空人必須相互進行上百道嚴格的防護衣氣密雙重覆核。

examples.en: Autonomous robotic assistants accompany explorers during surface planetary activity to carry heavy geology drills.
examples.zh: 自主型伴隨輪式機器人在探險隊員執行地表科考活動時如影隨形，主動扛起沉重的重型地質鑽探機具。

entries.definition: 太空人走出氣閘之艙外漫步活動 (EVA)；活動

explains.en: It is something people do for learning or fun. A class may make a paper craft. A game can be one.
A person may join a group walk. Students can do a science task. The word means an event or action.
This word names an event people take part in. A teacher may give one in class. It can be fun or work.

examples.en: The actual cost was higher than we thought.
examples.zh: 實際費用比我們想的高。

examples.en: Is that the actual story?
examples.zh: 那是真實的故事嗎？

examples.en: The actual time is written on the ticket.
examples.zh: 票上寫著正確的時間。

explains.en: It means true and not imagined. A real event actually happened. The word can also mean current.
A person may ask for the true fact. A story can be based on life. It can mean genuine.
This word describes something that exists. A fact is not made up. It can also mean exact or current.

examples.en: Two plus three is addition.
examples.zh: 二加三是加法。

examples.en: The addition of milk made the soup creamy.
examples.zh: 加入牛奶後湯變得滑順。

examples.en: They built an addition to the house.
examples.zh: 他們為房子增建了一個部分。

explains.en: It means putting numbers together to find a sum. Two and two make four. It can also mean something added.
A student may add two amounts. A new part may be joined to a house. This word can describe the act or result.
This word means adding one thing to another. A cook may put an extra item in a recipe. In math, the result is a sum.

examples.en: Write the recipient's shipping address clearly in English.
examples.zh: 用英文將收件人的收件地址書寫清楚。

examples.en: The mayor delivered a powerful keynote address at the opening ceremony.
examples.zh: 市長在開幕典禮上發表了震撼有力的專題致詞演說。

examples.en: We need to work together to address environmental pollution issues.
examples.zh: 我們需要齊心協力來應對並解決環境污染問題。

explains.en: A home has a place where mail is sent. A person may also speak to a group formally. The word can be used as an action when talking to someone.
A letter shows where a person lives. A speaker may give a speech to an audience. A person can also talk about a problem.
This can mean the location of a house. It can also mean a formal speech. As a verb, it means speaking directly to someone.

examples.en: The school admitted three new students.
examples.zh: 學校收了三名新生。

examples.en: He admitted that he broke the cup.
examples.zh: 他承認自己打破了杯子。

examples.en: The club will admit new members in May.
examples.zh: 俱樂部五月會接納新會員。

entries.definition: 承認；坦承；准許進入；接納

explains.en: It means saying that something is true. A person may say they made a mistake. A school may let a student join.
A person can say honestly that they made a mistake. A club may also allow someone to become a member. Both ideas can be expressed with this verb.
This action means allowing someone in. It can also mean telling the truth about something. A person may do it after being asked.

examples.en: In Taiwan, an eighteen-year-old is considered a legal adult.
examples.zh: 在台灣，年滿十八歲即被視為法定成年人。

examples.en: Adult admission tickets to the art museum cost three hundred dollars.
examples.zh: 參觀這座美術館的成人全票費用為三百元。

examples.en: With adulthood comes greater freedom as well as serious responsibilities.
examples.zh: 成年伴隨著更大的自由，同時也肩負著重大的責任。

explains.en: A person who is fully grown has this age status. They can vote in many places. The word can also describe something for grown people.
This person is no longer a child. They may live on their own. A movie can be made for this age group.
This word names a grown person. The person can make many choices legally. A child becomes one after many years.

examples.en: The team made great advances this year.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍今年有很大的進步。

examples.en: They paid an advance before the work began.
examples.zh: 工作開始前他們先付了一筆預付款。

examples.en: The army advanced toward the bridge.
examples.zh: 軍隊朝橋的方向前進。

explains.en: It means moving forward. A student may go ahead in a lesson. The word can also mean money paid before a sale.
A team may make progress. A person can move toward a goal. A buyer may pay some money early.
This word means progress or movement ahead. A company may pay money before work is done. As a verb, it means making progress.

examples.en: My teacher gave me good advice.
examples.zh: 老師給了我很好的建議。

examples.en: She asked her mother for advice.
examples.zh: 她向媽媽請教。

examples.en: His advice helped me choose a book.
examples.zh: 他的建議幫我選了一本書。

explains.en: It is a helpful idea about what someone should do. A friend may give guidance. A doctor may suggest rest.
A person may ask for help making a choice. A teacher can offer a useful idea. The word means guidance.
This word names a suggestion meant to help. A family member may offer one. It can help someone make a decision.

examples.en: The newspaper reported a public affair.
examples.zh: 報紙報導了一件公共事件。

examples.en: Their love affair became a movie.
examples.zh: 他們的戀情被拍成了一部電影。

examples.en: The family discussed a private affair.
examples.zh: 那家人討論了一件私事。

explains.en: It can mean a matter or event. A person may discuss family concerns. It can also mean a romantic relationship.
A news story may describe a public event. A person can have a private concern. The word may also name a love relationship.
This word means an event or subject people discuss. It may refer to a personal concern. It can also mean a secret romance.

examples.en: The cold weather affected the plants.
examples.zh: 寒冷的天氣影響了植物。

examples.en: Her kind words affected him deeply.
examples.zh: 她親切的話深深影響了他。

examples.en: The medicine may affect your sleep.
examples.zh: 這種藥可能會影響你的睡眠。

entries.definition: 影響；作用於；（較少用）假裝

explains.en: It means making a change in someone or something. A kind word can change a mood. Heat can change ice into water.
A person’s choice may have an effect. A story can change how someone feels. The word means having an effect.
This action causes a change. A loud sound may disturb a baby. The result can be good or bad.

examples.en: Lean your umbrella against the shoe cabinet near the door.
examples.zh: 把你的雨傘靠在門口的鞋櫃旁。

examples.en: Citizens voted overwhelmingly against the proposal to tear down the historic library.
examples.zh: 全體市民以壓倒性票數投票，強烈反對拆除這座具有百年歷史的古蹟圖書館。

examples.en: Wearing a sturdy waterproof jacket provides great protection against bitter winter winds.
examples.zh: 穿上一件厚實硬挺的防水防風機能外套，能為你提供抵禦冬日寒風的絕佳防護。

explains.en: It means in opposition to something. A player may lean on a wall. A person can protect a home from rain.
A team can play an opponent. A picture may rest on a surface. This word can show protection from harm.
This word can mean opposite or touching. A person may stand beside a wall for support. A shield protects someone from danger.

examples.en: The runner was ahead of the others.
examples.zh: 那位跑者領先其他人。

examples.en: We arrived ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 我們提早到了。

examples.en: Think ahead before you make a choice.
examples.zh: 做選擇前先想想未來。

explains.en: It means in front or at a later stage. A person may arrive before others. A child may look toward the future.
A runner can move in front of a group. A student may finish a task early. This word can mean a point in the future.
This word describes a position in front. It can also mean earlier than expected. A person may plan for what comes next.

examples.en: The nurse gave aid to the injured boy.
examples.zh: 護士幫助了受傷的男孩。

examples.en: This map is a great aid on trips.
examples.zh: 這張地圖在旅行時很有幫助。

examples.en: They sent food aid after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨後他們送來糧食援助。

explains.en: It means help. A rescue worker may give support. A tool can make a task easier.
A person may help a neighbor carry a box. Money can be given to a family in need. The word can mean support.
This word names help given to someone. A friend may offer it during a hard time. It can also mean a tool that helps.

examples.en: The archer aimed at the target.
examples.zh: 弓箭手瞄準了目標。

examples.en: Her aim is to become a doctor.
examples.zh: 她的目標是成為醫生。

examples.en: The camera aimed toward the stage.
examples.zh: 相機朝向舞台。

explains.en: It means pointing at a goal. A person may point a camera at a bird. The word can also mean a purpose.
A player may try to send a ball into a net. A person can set a goal for the year. This word means a purpose or direction.
This word describes a goal someone hopes to reach. An archer points an arrow at a mark. The action can mean pointing toward something.

examples.en: The aircraft landed safely at the airport.
examples.zh: 飛機安全降落在機場。

examples.en: A small aircraft flew over the island.
examples.zh: 一架小型飛機飛過島嶼。

examples.en: The aircraft can carry twenty people.
examples.zh: 這架飛機可以搭載二十人。

explains.en: A flying machine carries people or goods. It can travel high above land. A pilot controls it.
This vehicle flies through the sky. A cargo version carries boxes. Passengers may use one for a long trip.
A large machine can travel through air. It has wings and engines. A pilot guides it from a cockpit.

examples.en: The alarm rang at six in the morning.
examples.zh: 鬧鐘早上六點響起。

examples.en: Smoke set off the fire alarm.
examples.zh: 煙霧觸發了火災警報器。

examples.en: She set an alarm before bed.
examples.zh: 她睡前設定了鬧鐘。

entries.definition: （名）警報器；鬧鐘；（動）使警覺；使驚慌。

explains.en: A loud sound can warn people of danger. A clock may make one in the morning. A person may feel worried by a sudden sound.
A fire can trigger a warning signal. A phone may make a loud sound at a set time. The word can mean a warning.
This device tells people to wake up or pay attention. It may ring loudly. A person may set one before bed.

examples.en: The band released a new album.
examples.zh: 樂團發行了一張新專輯。

examples.en: She keeps family photos in an album.
examples.zh: 她把家庭照片放在相簿裡。

examples.en: I listened to the whole album.
examples.zh: 我聽完整張專輯。

explains.en: A book holds photos or music in one collection. A singer may release one. A person can keep family pictures inside it.
A photo book can show memories from a trip. A music collection may have many songs. The word can also mean a computer file for pictures.
This collection may hold photos or songs. A person may look at family memories. A music artist can make one for fans.

examples.en: The twins look alike.
examples.zh: 這對雙胞胎看起來很像。

examples.en: The two houses are alike in color.
examples.zh: 這兩棟房子的顏色相似。

examples.en: Their ideas are very much alike.
examples.zh: 他們的想法非常相似。

explains.en: It means similar to another person or thing. Two coats may look the same. The word can also mean having a shared view.
A pair of twins may look very much like each other. Two houses may have a similar design. This word describes a close match.
This word means nearly the same. A person may have ideas like a friend’s. Two objects can share a look.

examples.en: The fish is still alive.
examples.zh: 那條魚還活著。

examples.en: The plant stayed alive through winter.
examples.zh: 那株植物熬過冬天仍然活著。

examples.en: She felt alive after the long swim.
examples.zh: 長泳之後她感覺精神充沛。

entries.definition: 活著的；有活力的；繼續存在的

explains.en: It means not dead. A plant can grow and change. A person may feel full of energy.
An animal that breathes and moves is living. A person can feel excited. The word can describe a creature with life.
This word describes a person or animal that lives. A green plant may keep growing. Someone may feel energetic and happy.

examples.en: He lives alone in a small house.
examples.zh: 他獨自住在一間小房子裡。

examples.en: The child was alone in the room.
examples.zh: 那個孩子獨自在房間裡。

examples.en: She likes to walk alone in the morning.
examples.zh: 她喜歡早上獨自散步。

entries.definition: （形）獨自的；單獨的；（副）獨自地；單獨地。

explains.en: It means being by oneself. A person may live without roommates. A quiet walk can happen with no one else.
A child may sit apart from a group. The person has no company. This word can also mean only one.
This word describes a person who is not with others. A house may have one person in it. It can mean single.

examples.en: Please read the poem aloud.
examples.zh: 請把這首詩大聲念出來。

examples.en: The child laughed aloud at the joke.
examples.zh: 那個孩子聽了笑話大聲笑出來。

examples.en: She called aloud for help.
examples.zh: 她大聲呼救。

explains.en: It means speaking so others can hear. A child may read a story to a class. A person can call across a room.
This means using your voice so other people can hear the words. A student may read a poem to the class. The voice can be quiet or loud, as long as it can be heard.
This action uses the voice at a clear volume. A teacher may call names. A person can speak so a group hears.

examples.en: Altogether, we collected fifty books.
examples.zh: 我們總共收集了五十本書。

examples.en: The room was altogether too dark.
examples.zh: 這個房間實在太暗了。

examples.en: They worked altogether as one team.
examples.zh: 他們全體一起合作。

explains.en: It means all together or in total. A group may finish a task as one. It can also mean completely.
A person may add all parts. Friends can agree as a group. The word can mean wholly or entirely.
This word means the full amount. A team may act as one group. It can also mean completely.

examples.en: Bubble tea is hugely popular among international exchange students.
examples.zh: 珍珠奶茶在國際交換學生群體中極受歡迎。

examples.en: We strolled happily among ancient red cypress trees in the Alishan forest.
examples.zh: 我們漫步在阿里山神木林間，穿梭矗立在數千年紅檜巨木群之中。

examples.en: The generous lottery winner divided his fortune equally among five local charities.
examples.zh: 慷慨的大樂透得主將大部分中獎彩金平均分配捐贈給五家在地慈善機構。

explains.en: It means in the middle of a group. A child may stand near friends. The word can also mean surrounded by.
A flower may grow inside a field of grass. A person can live in a large group. This word describes being in a larger set.
This word means in the company of many. A bird may hide in trees. One item can be found inside a group.

examples.en: The total amount of water is two liters.
examples.zh: 水的總量是兩公升。

examples.en: We need a small amount of flour.
examples.zh: 我們需要少量麵粉。

examples.en: The amount on the bill is correct.
examples.zh: 帳單上的金額正確。

explains.en: It means how much there is. A cup can hold a certain number of liters. The word can also mean a sum of money.
A person may measure flour for a cake. A bill shows the money owed. This word names a quantity.
This word describes a quantity or total. A bottle may hold a certain volume. It can also mean a sum.

examples.en: The ancient temple is over two thousand years old.
examples.zh: 這座古老寺廟有兩千多年歷史。

examples.en: They found an ancient coin in the field.
examples.zh: 他們在田裡找到一枚古錢幣。

examples.en: Ancient stories are taught in class.
examples.zh: 課堂上會教古代故事。

entries.definition: 古代的；古老的；很久以前的。

explains.en: It means very old, from a long time ago. A stone building may have stood for hundreds of years. Historians study old objects.
A city may have a past from many centuries ago. A person can see old tools in a museum. This word means from early history.
This word describes something from a very long time ago. It may refer to old people or objects. An old temple can have this quality.

examples.en: His anger faded after he took a walk.
examples.zh: 散步後他的怒氣消退了。

examples.en: She spoke with anger in her voice.
examples.zh: 她說話時語氣帶著怒氣。

examples.en: He felt anger when the game was canceled.
examples.zh: 比賽取消時他感到生氣。

explains.en: It is a strong feeling of being upset. A person may feel it after unfair treatment. Calm breathing can help.
A child may feel mad after losing a game. A kind reply can reduce this feeling. The word means strong displeasure.
This emotion may happen during a fight. A person can feel hot and tense. It is better to speak calmly.

examples.en: The two roads meet at a sharp angle.
examples.zh: 兩條道路以一個尖角交會。

examples.en: Take a photo from a low angle.
examples.zh: 從低角度拍一張照片。

examples.en: The roof has a gentle angle.
examples.zh: 屋頂有一個平緩的斜角。

explains.en: Two straight arms meet at a shared point. The amount of turn from one arm to the other has this name. A wider opening gives a larger amount of turn.
The corner of a square measures ninety degrees. It makes a square corner. Four such turns bring you back to your starting direction.
The word can also describe the direction from which something is viewed. A photographer may move to one side before taking a picture. The new position shows the scene differently.

examples.en: She twisted her ankle while running.
examples.zh: 她跑步時扭傷腳踝。

examples.en: He wore a bracelet around his ankle.
examples.zh: 他在腳踝上戴了一條手鍊。

examples.en: The doctor checked my sore ankle.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查我痠痛的腳踝。

explains.en: It is the joint between the foot and leg. A person may twist it while running. Shoes cover it.
This body part moves as a person walks. A sock can cover it. A doctor may check it after a fall.
A foot joins the lower leg here. A person may wear a bracelet around it. It can hurt after a sprain.

examples.en: Call me anytime after school.
examples.zh: 放學後隨時打給我。

examples.en: You can visit anytime this week.
examples.zh: 你這週任何時候都可以來。

examples.en: Anytime is a good time for tea.
examples.zh: 任何時候都適合喝茶。

entries.definition: 任何時候；隨時；無論何時。

explains.en: It means at any time. A person may call for help day or night. The word can also mean whenever.
A child may visit a friend at any hour. It can describe a time without limits. A person can use it in a question.
This word means whenever a time comes. A shop may be open at any hour. It can also mean at all times.

examples.en: Anyway, we can try again tomorrow.
examples.zh: 無論如何，我們明天可以再試一次。

examples.en: I was tired, but I went anyway.
examples.zh: 我很累，但還是去了。

examples.en: Anyway, what happened next?
examples.zh: 無論如何，接下來發生了什麼？

entries.definition: 無論如何；不管怎樣；反正

explains.en: It means in any case. A person may finish a task despite a problem. The word can also mean regardless.
A child may go outside even if it rains. The result does not change. This word can show that a choice remains.
This word means regardless of what happened. A person may try again. It can also move a conversation forward.

examples.en: I cannot find my house keys anywhere.
examples.zh: 我在任何地方都找不到我的家門鑰匙。

examples.en: With reliable internet, digital nomads can work from anywhere in the world.
examples.zh: 有了穩定的網路，數位遊民可以在世界任何角落工作。

examples.en: You can park your shared bicycle anywhere inside the designated green zones.
examples.zh: 你可以將共享單車停放在指定綠色區域內的任何地點。

explains.en: It means at a place that is not named. A person may search for a quiet location. The exact spot is unknown.
A traveler may go to any place. A map can show many locations. This word does not say where exactly.
This word means in any location. A child may hide in one of many places. It can also describe movement to an unknown spot.

examples.en: The ape climbed high into the tree.
examples.zh: 猿爬到樹的高處。

examples.en: An ape used a stick to get food.
examples.zh: 一隻猿用棍子取得食物。

examples.en: The young ape stayed near its mother.
examples.zh: 那隻年幼的猿待在媽媽身邊。

explains.en: This animal belongs to the same group as gorillas and chimpanzees. It has no tail. Its hands can hold objects.
Many animals in this group can climb trees. Their arms help them move between branches. They can learn and solve simple problems.
The verb can mean copying another person’s actions. A child may copy a teacher’s walk. The copying may be done to make people laugh.

examples.en: Her appearance changed after the haircut.
examples.zh: 剪髮後她的外表改變了。

examples.en: The house has a modern appearance.
examples.zh: 這棟房子外觀很現代。

examples.en: His calm appearance hid his fear.
examples.zh: 他平靜的外表掩飾了恐懼。

explains.en: It means how someone or something looks. A person may change clothes before a photo. The word can also mean seeming to be.
A person’s face gives a first look. A building may have a neat outside. This word can describe what seems true.
This word names the way something looks. A person may make a good first impression. It can also mean seeming to happen.

examples.en: A long walk gave me an appetite.
examples.zh: 走了很久讓我有了食慾。

examples.en: The soup made her appetite better.
examples.zh: 這碗湯讓她胃口變好了。

examples.en: He has a healthy appetite.
examples.zh: 他的食慾很好。

explains.en: It is a desire to eat. A person may feel it before lunch. A tasty smell can make it stronger.
A hungry child may ask for food. A meal can satisfy this feeling. The word means wanting to eat.
This feeling makes a person look for food. A long walk may increase it. Soup or fruit can help.

examples.en: He decided to apply for the overseas software engineer position.
examples.zh: 他決定應徵這份海外軟體工程師的工作職缺。

examples.en: Apply theoretical classroom knowledge to practical everyday engineering problems.
examples.zh: 將課堂上學得的各項抽象理論知識，靈活應用於解決日常工程實務難題之中。

examples.en: Apply sunscreen lotion evenly across exposed skin thirty minutes before swimming.
examples.zh: 在下水游泳嬉戲的三十分鐘前，先將防曬乳均勻塗抹在曝露於陽光下的肌膚上。

explains.en: It means asking for a job or a place in a school. A person may send a form. It can also mean putting a cream on skin.
A student may ask to join a program. A worker may ask for a new job. The word can also mean using a rule.
This action means making a formal request. A person can also spread lotion on a hand. It may mean putting an idea into practice.

examples.en: I truly appreciate your patient help with my English essay.
examples.zh: 我由衷感激你對我英語作文所提供的耐心指導。

examples.en: Taking art history lessons taught me how to appreciate classical oil paintings.
examples.zh: 研修藝術史課程教會了我如何細細品味並欣賞古典西洋油畫之美。

examples.en: Real estate properties in convenient transit hubs appreciate steadily over time.
examples.zh: 坐落於交通便利樞紐核心地段的優質不動產，其市場價值隨時間穩步升值。

explains.en: It means feeling thankful. A person may value a kind gift. It can also mean enjoying art or music.
A friend may be grateful for help. A person can enjoy a beautiful song. The word means valuing something.
This word tells that someone feels thankful. A listener may enjoy a song. A person can value a kind act.

examples.en: The train approached the station slowly.
examples.zh: 火車慢慢接近車站。

examples.en: She approached the teacher after class.
examples.zh: 下課後她走近老師。

examples.en: We need a new approach to this problem.
examples.zh: 我們需要一種解決這個問題的新方法。

entries.definition: （名）方法；接近；（動）接近；著手處理

explains.en: It means coming closer to a place. A person may walk toward a door. It can also mean a way of handling a problem.
A bus may come nearer to a stop. A person can ask someone for help. The word can describe a method.
This action means moving nearer. A student may come closer to a teacher. It can also mean trying a new method.

examples.en: Don't argue over trivial matters with your siblings.
examples.zh: 不要為了微不足道的小事和兄弟姊妹起爭執。

examples.en: The defense attorney argued convincingly that the evidence had been contaminated.
examples.zh: 辯護律師在法庭上提出強而有力的論證，主張關鍵證物早已遭到不當汙染。

examples.en: Economists argue whether raising interest rates will cool inflation without hurting growth.
examples.zh: 經濟學家針對調高基準利率能否在不扼殺經濟動能的前提下抑制通膨爭論不休。

entries.definition: 爭吵；口角；爭辯；爭論；論點；辯論

explains.en: It means giving reasons for an idea. Two friends may disagree loudly. A person can explain a point.
A student may give reasons for an answer. People can have a disagreement. The word can also name a reason used to support an idea.
This action means speaking about different views. A person may try to prove a point. A loud disagreement can happen between friends.

examples.en: The army marched through the town.
examples.zh: 軍隊行經城鎮。

examples.en: He joined the army at eighteen.
examples.zh: 他十八歲時加入軍隊。

examples.en: The army helped after the flood.
examples.zh: 洪水後軍隊提供了協助。

explains.en: A country’s armed forces have people trained to protect it. They may wear uniforms. They can help during a war or disaster.
This group of soldiers protects a nation. Members may train together. They can also bring help after a storm.
A large group of trained fighters can defend a country. They follow orders from leaders. Some work with vehicles or aircraft.

examples.en: Please arrange the chairs in a circle.
examples.zh: 請把椅子排成一個圓圈。

examples.en: They arranged a meeting for Monday.
examples.zh: 他們安排星期一開會。

examples.en: She arranged the flowers in a vase.
examples.zh: 她把花插在花瓶裡。

explains.en: It means putting things in order. A person may prepare chairs for a meeting. The word can also mean a plan between people.
A worker may place items neatly. Friends can agree on a date to meet. This word can mean an organized plan.
This action means putting things in a chosen order. A person may sort books on a shelf. It can also mean making plans for a meeting or trip.

examples.en: We will meet our visiting foreign friends at the arrival hall.
examples.zh: 我們將在機場入境接機大廳迎接來訪的外國友人。

examples.en: The flight arrival was delayed by poor weather conditions.
examples.zh: 航班抵達時間因惡劣天候狀況而有所延誤。

examples.en: On arrival at the hotel, guest luggage was taken directly to their suites.
examples.zh: 抵達飯店時，客人的行李被直接送往了他們的套房。

explains.en: It means coming to a place. A train may reach a station. A traveler can come home after a trip.
A person may reach a town after a long drive. A guest can come to a party. The word names the act of getting there.
This word means reaching a destination. An airplane may land at an airport. A family may greet a guest at home.

examples.en: The arrow pointed toward the exit.
examples.zh: 箭頭指向出口。

examples.en: He shot an arrow at the target.
examples.zh: 他朝目標射了一支箭。

examples.en: Follow the arrow on the map.
examples.zh: 沿著地圖上的箭頭走。

explains.en: A small mark with a point shows a direction. A person may draw one on a map. It can also be shot from a bow.
A sign may have a mark that shows where to go. A hunter can send this pointed object through the air. It has a sharp head and a long shaft.
This pointed object can be made of wood or metal. A bow sends it toward a target. A road sign may use a symbol that points.

examples.en: I read an article about birds.
examples.zh: 我讀了一篇關於鳥類的文章。

examples.en: The article explains how rain forms.
examples.zh: 這篇文章說明雨是如何形成的。

examples.en: She wrote an article for the school paper.
examples.zh: 她為校刊寫了一篇文章。

explains.en: A group of words in a newspaper may give facts about an event. A book has chapters. The word can also mean one item in a group.
A newspaper may have a story about a game. A book has sections with names. This word can also mean one item in a list.
This word means one part of a newspaper or a legal paper. It may give information. A book can have many parts of this kind.

examples.en: The artist painted a picture of the sea.
examples.zh: 那位藝術家畫了一幅海景。

examples.en: A local artist played music in the park.
examples.zh: 一位當地藝術家在公園演奏音樂。

examples.en: The artist signed her work.
examples.zh: 那位藝術家在作品上簽名。

explains.en: A person who makes paintings, music, or other creative things has this role. A gallery may show their work. They may use many tools.
This person creates pictures or music. A concert may feature one. Their work can be sold or shared.
A person who makes art has this name. They may draw, paint, or perform music. A museum may show their work.

examples.en: The baby was asleep in the crib.
examples.zh: 嬰兒在嬰兒床裡睡著了。

examples.en: He fell asleep during the movie.
examples.zh: 他看電影時睡著了。

examples.en: The house was quiet while everyone was asleep.
examples.zh: 大家都睡著時房子很安靜。

explains.en: It means sleeping. A child may be quiet in bed. A person can close their eyes after a long day.
A baby may be in this state at night. A tired person may lie down. A loud sound can wake them.
This word describes a person who is not awake. They may be dreaming. Rest helps the body.

examples.en: She made an attempt to climb the hill.
examples.zh: 她試著爬上小山。

examples.en: His first attempt was not successful.
examples.zh: 他的第一次嘗試沒有成功。

examples.en: They attempted to fix the broken chair.
examples.zh: 他們試著修理壞掉的椅子。

explains.en: It means making an effort to do something. A student may try a hard puzzle. The result is not always good.
A person may make an effort at a new skill. A cook can test a recipe. This word can also mean a test or effort.
This action means trying to reach a goal. A player may make a shot. A person can try more than once.

examples.en: Many students attend the morning class.
examples.zh: 許多學生上早上的課。

examples.en: She attends church every Sunday.
examples.zh: 她每週日都去教堂。

examples.en: The doctor will attend to the patient soon.
examples.zh: 醫生很快會照料病人。

explains.en: It means going to a place or event. A child may go to class each day. A person can be at a meeting.
Students go to school to learn. A guest may go to a wedding. The word can also mean paying careful attention.
This action means being present at an event. A person may go to a class. It can also mean caring for a need.

examples.en: Training your attention span like a muscle builds resistance against impulsive social media scrolling.
examples.zh: 像鍛鍊肌肉般耐心鍛鍊自己的注意力，能築起強大防線，不再無意識滑動手機社群。

examples.en: The flight attendant politely asked passengers to give their undivided attention to the emergency safety briefing.
examples.zh: 空服員親切且禮貌地廣播提醒所有機上旅客，請全神貫注聆聽起飛前的客艙安全逃生示範與說明。

examples.en: She paid meticulous attention to every single detail when drafting the international joint venture contract.
examples.zh: 在親自起草這份跨國合資企業法律契約時，她對合約條文中的每一個文字細節都傾注了一絲不苟的專注。

entries.definition: 專注不移的選擇性注意力廣度

explains.en: It means looking or listening carefully. A teacher may ask for quiet. A child may watch a story.
A loud sound can make people look up. A student may listen to directions. The word can also mean care or notice.
This word means careful focus. A person may look at a sign. A teacher may ask a class to listen.

examples.en: The famous author signed copies of her new book at the Taipei Book Fair.
examples.zh: 知名作家在台北國際書展上親切為讀者簽署新書。

examples.en: Who is the author of this insightful editorial on semiconductor manufacturing?
examples.zh: 究竟是哪位專欄作家撰寫了這篇針對半導體晶片製造業極具見地的社論文章？

examples.en: Over her forty-year literary career, the author produced twenty acclaimed novels.
examples.zh: 在長達四十載的文學生涯中，該知名作家累計創作了二十餘部備受讚譽的長篇小說。

explains.en: A person who creates a book or story has this job. Their name may appear on its cover. They choose what to write.
This person makes stories, poems, or facts in books. A newspaper may have one. They may work alone.
A book has a creator with this title. The person puts ideas into writing. Their work can teach or entertain.

examples.en: The room is available after lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐後這個房間可以使用。

examples.en: Tickets are still available online.
examples.zh: 網路上還買得到票。

examples.en: Is the teacher available now?
examples.zh: 老師現在有空嗎？

entries.definition: 可取得的；有空的；可用的

explains.en: It means ready for use. A seat may be empty for a guest. A doctor may have an opening.
A room can be free for a new person. A shop may have an item to buy. The word means ready or free.
This word describes a thing that can be used now. A worker may have time. A seat may not be taken.

examples.en: The average score was eighty points.
examples.zh: 平均分數是八十分。

examples.en: On average, the bus comes every ten minutes.
examples.zh: 平均來說，公車每十分鐘來一班。

examples.en: Her height is close to the class average.
examples.zh: 她的身高接近班級平均值。

entries.definition: （名）平均數；一般水準；（形）平均的；普通的；（動）平均為

explains.en: One common meaning is a value found by adding numbers and dividing by how many there are. It gives a single summary of the group. Math classes often use this calculation.
Three children collect two, four, and six stones. Together they have twelve stones. Sharing them equally gives each child four.
The adjective can mean ordinary or typical. An ordinary-sized room is neither very big nor very small. The word often compares something with what is usual.

examples.en: Try to avoid the wet floor.
examples.zh: 盡量避開濕滑的地板。

examples.en: He avoids eating too much candy.
examples.zh: 他避免吃太多糖果。

examples.en: We left early to avoid traffic.
examples.zh: 我們提早離開以避開車潮。

explains.en: It means staying away from something. A person may not eat a food that causes illness. A driver can keep away from danger.
A child may stay clear of a hot stove. A person can choose not to talk about a hard topic. This action helps prevent trouble.
This word means keeping clear of a person or thing. A hiker may go around a deep hole. A person may not do something harmful.

examples.en: The ergonomic 50-liter backpack transfers heavy tent and food loads comfortably onto the hiker’s hip belt.
