explains.en: Hair grows on a man’s chin and cheeks. A person may shave it. It can be short or long.
A face may have this hair below the mouth. A razor can remove it. Some people let it grow thick.
This facial hair may cover a person’s jaw. A barber can trim it. It often grows after a boy becomes an adult.

examples.en: The drum beat loudly in the band.
examples.zh: 樂團裡的鼓聲大作。

examples.en: Our team beat the other school.
examples.zh: 我們隊打敗了另一所學校。

examples.en: I could hear my heart beat fast.
examples.zh: 我能聽見自己的心跳得很快。

entries.definition: （動）打；敲打；擊敗；勝過；（名）節拍；心跳

explains.en: It means hitting something again and again. A heart moves blood through the body. A person may win against another.
A drummer can keep a steady sound. The heart moves inside the chest. The word can also mean defeating an opponent.
This action may mean hitting. A person can play a drum. A team can do better than another in a game.

examples.en: The beauty of the lake amazed us.
examples.zh: 湖泊的美景讓我們驚艷。

examples.en: She saw beauty in the old garden.
examples.zh: 她在老花園裡看見了美。

examples.en: The beauty of the song made him smile.
examples.zh: 歌曲的優美讓他露出微笑。

explains.en: It means a pleasing look or quality. A flower may have it. A person can find it in nature.
A sunset can be lovely. Kindness can make a person pleasing to others. This word describes what is lovely.
This word names something that looks or feels pleasing. Art can have it. People may see it in nature.

examples.en: He ordered a glass of beer.
examples.zh: 他點了一杯啤酒。

examples.en: The beer was cold and fresh.
examples.zh: 啤酒冰涼又新鮮。

examples.en: Some adults drink beer with dinner.
examples.zh: 有些成年人晚餐時會喝啤酒。

explains.en: An adult drink is made from grain. People may serve it cold. It should not be given to children.
A bar may sell this drink in a glass. It can be made from barley or wheat. Some kinds have foam.
This drink is made by fermenting grain. Adults may have it with a meal. It can be light or dark.

examples.en: The hungry child begged for another cookie.
examples.zh: 那個餓了的孩子懇求再給一塊餅乾。

examples.en: He begged his friend to stay.
examples.zh: 他懇求朋友留下。

examples.en: The dog begged for food at the table.
examples.zh: 狗在桌邊討食物。

explains.en: It means asking for something in a very humble way. A person may ask for food. The word can also mean making a strong request.
A hungry dog may ask for food. A child can ask a parent again and again. This word means pleading.
This action means asking earnestly. A person may request help. The word can also mean asking someone to let them join.

examples.en: The beginner asked many questions.
examples.zh: 初學者問了很多問題。

examples.en: This book is good for a beginner.
examples.zh: 這本書很適合初學者。

examples.en: A beginner can learn to swim with help.
examples.zh: 初學者可以在協助下學游泳。

explains.en: A person who is just learning a skill has this label. A new swimmer may need lessons. Practice helps.
A player may be new to a game. The person has little experience. A teacher can help them learn the rules.
This word names someone at the first level. A new driver may be careful. The person needs time to improve.

examples.en: Children should behave kindly to each other.
examples.zh: 孩子們應該友善地對待彼此。

examples.en: The dog behaved well at the vet.
examples.zh: 這隻狗在獸醫那裡表現良好。

examples.en: He behaved like a good friend.
examples.zh: 他的行為像個好朋友。

explains.en: It means acting in a certain way. A child may follow rules at school. A dog can learn to sit calmly.
A person may act kindly toward others. A student can follow a classroom rule. This word means acting.
This verb describes how a person acts. Parents may teach children to speak politely and take turns. Someone can act well or badly toward others.

examples.en: Being honest is important.
examples.zh: 誠實很重要。

examples.en: A human being needs food and water.
examples.zh: 人類需要食物和水。

examples.en: Being a parent takes patience.
examples.zh: 為人父母需要耐心。

entries.definition: 存在；生物；人；（動名詞）成為；處於

explains.en: It means a life, person, or thing that exists. A living creature breathes. The word can also mean the state of existing.
A person is a living thing. A bug is a tiny creature. This word can name life itself.
This word means a living creature or existence. A human is one example. All living things need air.

examples.en: Her belief in herself grew stronger.
examples.zh: 她對自己的信心越來越強。

examples.en: Many people share a belief in kindness.
examples.zh: 許多人都相信善良。

examples.en: He has a strong belief that hard work helps.
examples.zh: 他堅信努力會有幫助。

explains.en: It means an idea a person thinks is true. People may have strong ideas about a god. A child may trust a parent.
A person may hold an idea about how the world works. A community can share such ideas. This word can also mean trust.
This word names an idea held to be true. A person may have faith in a friend. Groups can share common ideas.

examples.en: Bend your knees before you lift the box.
examples.zh: 抬箱子前先彎曲膝蓋。

examples.en: The road bends near the river.
examples.zh: 道路在河邊轉彎。

examples.en: He bent the wire into a circle.
examples.zh: 他把鐵絲彎成一個圓圈。

explains.en: It means moving a straight object or body part into a curved shape. A person may lower their body to pick something up. A tree branch can curve.
A person can move a knee or arm into a curved position. A road may curve around a hill. This action may help someone reach the floor.
This word means curving rather than staying straight. A person may lower the body. A branch can move under pressure.

examples.en: This book is better than the last one.
examples.zh: 這本書比上一本好。

examples.en: I feel better after some rest.
examples.zh: 休息一下後我感覺好多了。

examples.en: She is a better swimmer now.
examples.zh: 她現在游泳游得更好了。

entries.definition: （形）較好的；更好的；（副）較好地；（名）較好的狀況。

explains.en: It means higher in quality or more helpful. A person may improve a skill. A kind result can be preferable.
A newer phone may work faster. A student may get a higher mark. This word compares two things.
This word means more good or useful. A person can feel healthy again. It can also mean a little more.

examples.en: The beauty of Taroko Gorge is beyond words.
examples.zh: 太魯閣峽谷的壯麗美景令人難以言喻。

examples.en: The hiking trail extends far beyond that green ridge into the deep forest.
examples.zh: 登山健行步道一路延伸至那座翠綠山脊的更遠處，深入濃密黑森林。

examples.en: Fixing this complex database crash is frankly beyond my current technical ability.
examples.zh: 搶修這起錯綜複雜的資料庫崩潰事故，坦白講遠遠超出了我目前的能力。

explains.en: It means farther away than a place or limit. A hill may lie past a river. The word can also mean more than.
A person may travel past a town. A dream may be greater than a person’s current life. This word points outside a limit.
This word means on the far side. A mountain can rise above the clouds. It can also describe an idea outside common knowledge.

examples.en: Could we have the bill, please?
examples.zh: 請問可以買單結帳了嗎？

examples.en: Remember to pay your electricity bill before the due date.
examples.zh: 記得在截止日期前繳清你的電費帳單。

examples.en: He pulled a crisp one-hundred-dollar bill out of his leather wallet.
examples.zh: 他從皮夾裡掏出一張嶄新的一百元鈔票。

examples.en: Excuse me, may we have the bill now?
examples.zh: 不好意思，請問我們可以買單結帳了嗎？

examples.en: Shall we split the dinner bill equally among the four of us?
examples.zh: 我們四個人平分這筆晚餐帳單好嗎？

examples.en: The utility bill for electricity was unusually high this summer.
examples.zh: 今年夏天的電費水電帳單異常高昂。

explains.en: A paper from a store shows what a customer must pay. A person may send one for a service. It can also mean a paper money note.
A restaurant gives this paper after a meal. A phone company may send one each month. The word can also mean a note worth money.
This paper lists goods and costs. A person may pay it at a counter. A government can send one for taxes.

examples.en: The company earned a billion dollars.
examples.zh: 這家公司賺了十億美元。

examples.en: A billion stars filled the sky in the story.
examples.zh: 故事裡天空中有十億顆星星。

examples.en: The country has more than a billion people.
examples.zh: 這個國家有超過十億人口。

explains.en: This number is one thousand million. It is written as a one followed by nine zeros. People use it when talking about very large amounts.
Imagine one thousand boxes with one million beads in each box. The total would have this name. It would take a very long time to count every bead.
A very large company may talk about its money using this number. Scientists also use it to describe huge counts or long periods of time. It is much larger than one million.

examples.en: The baby’s birth was a happy event.
examples.zh: 嬰兒的出生是件快樂的事。

examples.en: Her birth date is in June.
examples.zh: 她的出生日期在六月。

examples.en: The birth of a new idea can change a life.
examples.zh: 新想法的誕生可以改變人生。

explains.en: It is the moment a baby comes into the world. A family may celebrate it each year. A record shows its date.
A baby begins life at this event. Parents may keep a paper record. The word can also mean the family someone comes from.
This event happens at the start of life. A person may celebrate its yearly date. A certificate may show where it happened.

examples.en: Would you like a biscuit with your tea?
examples.zh: 你想配茶吃一塊餅乾嗎？

examples.en: The child ate a sweet biscuit.
examples.zh: 孩子吃了一塊甜餅乾。

examples.en: She baked biscuits for the picnic.
examples.zh: 她為野餐烤了餅乾。

explains.en: A small baked food may be sweet or plain. People may eat it with tea. It can be crisp or soft.
A baker makes this snack from flour. It may have chocolate inside. People can dunk it in a warm drink.
This small treat can be round or square. It may be crunchy. A child can have one after lunch.

examples.en: Heavy-duty polycrystalline diamond compact (PDC) drill bits crush through quartz veins without wearing out.
examples.zh: 頂級「人造金剛石複合片鑽頭」（PDC Drill Bit），能輕易研磨粉碎極硬石英岩脈且具備超高耐磨壽命。

examples.en: The lively puppy chewed on a rubber toy and tore a small bit off the squeaker.
examples.zh: 活潑調皮的小幼犬在客廳興奮地啃咬橡膠玩具球，不小心把塑膠發聲哨的一小角咬破扯了下來。

examples.en: In digital computing, a single bit represents the most basic binary unit of information as zero or one.
examples.zh: 在電腦數位計算科學中，一個位元（bit）代表最微小、最基礎的二進位資訊單位，數值非零即一。

entries.definition: 聚晶人造金剛石複合片 (PDC) 耐磨鑽頭；一點

explains.en: It means a small piece or amount. A person may eat a little cake. The word can also mean a little while.
A little food may be enough. A person can wait for a short time. It can also mean a small computer unit.
This word describes a tiny amount. A person may need a little help. It can also mean a short period.

examples.en: The teacher wrote the vocabulary words on the blackboard.
examples.zh: 老師把單字寫在黑板上。

examples.en: Dust from old chalk on the blackboard can sometimes make students sneeze.
examples.zh: 黑板上的舊粉筆灰有時會讓學生打噴嚏。

examples.en: The class monitor washed the blackboard clean at the end of the day.
examples.zh: 班長在放學前把黑板擦得乾乾淨淨。

explains.en: A teacher writes on this dark board with chalk. Students look at it from their seats. A cloth can wipe it clean.
A classroom may have one at the front. Chalk leaves marks on its surface. A teacher can write math there.
This school item has a dark surface. A person can write lessons with chalk. It can be erased for a new lesson.

examples.en: Do not blame your brother for the spill.
examples.zh: 不要因為打翻東西而責怪你弟弟。

examples.en: She blamed the rain for the delay.
examples.zh: 她把延誤歸咎於下雨。

examples.en: He took the blame for the mistake.
examples.zh: 他為錯誤承擔責任。

explains.en: It means saying someone caused a problem. A person may say a friend broke a cup. The word can also mean feeling responsible.
A child may say a sibling made a mess. A person can feel responsible for a mistake. This word means accusing someone.
This action says someone did something wrong. A person may feel at fault. It can also mean responsibility for a bad event.

examples.en: Write your name on the blank line.
examples.zh: 在空白線上寫下你的名字。

examples.en: The answer box was left blank.
examples.zh: 答案欄留白了。

examples.en: She filled in the blank with a blue pen.
examples.zh: 她用藍筆填上空格。

entries.definition: （形）空白的；茫然的；（名）空格；空白處

explains.en: It means having no writing or marks. A sheet of paper may be ready for a note. A room can be empty.
A form may have no words filled in. A space can have no people. This word can also mean empty.
This word describes a page with no writing. A wall may have no pictures. A person can leave a line empty.

examples.en: Cover yourself with a warm blanket so you won't catch cold.
examples.zh: 蓋上一條保暖毛毯，這樣才不會著涼。

examples.en: In winter, a thick blanket of pristine white snow covered the mountain.
examples.zh: 冬天時，一層厚厚純白無瑕的積雪覆蓋了整座山嶺。

examples.en: Spread a waterproof picnic blanket across the green grass.
examples.zh: 在綠色草地上鋪開一張防水野餐墊。

explains.en: A soft cover keeps a bed warm. A person may wrap it around their body. It can be made from wool or cotton.
A bed may have this warm covering. A child can use one on a cold night. It may have a pattern or color.
This fabric item covers a person during rest. It can be thick and soft. A family may fold it at the end of the bed.

examples.en: The cut made a little blood appear.
examples.zh: 割傷讓少量血流了出來。

examples.en: Blood carries oxygen around the body.
examples.zh: 血液把氧氣輸送到全身。

examples.en: The doctor took a blood sample.
examples.zh: 醫生抽取了一份血液樣本。

explains.en: A red liquid moves through the body. It carries oxygen. A small cut may make it come out.
A person has this liquid inside their veins. Doctors may test it. It helps keep the body alive.
This fluid moves around the body. It can be donated to help a sick person. A heart pumps it.

examples.en: The teacher wrote on the board.
examples.zh: 老師在板子上寫字。

examples.en: She joined the school board last year.
examples.zh: 她去年加入了學校董事會。

examples.en: A wooden board covered the hole.
examples.zh: 一塊木板蓋住了洞。

entries.definition: （名）板子；董事會；膳食；（動）登上（交通工具）；寄宿

explains.en: Students write on a flat surface in a classroom. A person may also serve on a group that makes decisions. The word can mean a flat piece of wood.
A teacher may write with chalk on one. A group of leaders may meet as a committee. The word can also mean a piece of wood.
This flat item can cover a wall. A class may use it for lessons. People may sit on a group of directors.

examples.en: Boil the dumplings in water for six to eight minutes.
examples.zh: 將水餃放入水中滾煮六至八分鐘。

examples.en: The water in the pot began to boil vigorously.
examples.zh: 鍋裡的水開始劇烈滾騰。

examples.en: Hard-boiled eggs are a convenient source of healthy protein.
examples.zh: 水煮蛋是補充優質蛋白質的便利來源。

explains.en: Water begins to bubble when it gets very hot. A cook may heat soup in a pot. The liquid changes with heat.
A kettle may do this on a stove. Bubbles rise from hot water. A person can cook food in liquid.
This word means heating liquid until it bubbles. A person may do this for tea. It can also describe becoming very angry.

examples.en: The dog broke a bone in its leg.
examples.zh: 狗的腿骨斷了。

examples.en: A strong bone supports the body.
examples.zh: 堅硬的骨頭支撐著身體。

examples.en: The puppy buried a bone in the garden.
examples.zh: 小狗把骨頭埋在花園裡。

entries.definition: 骨頭；支撐身體的硬組織。

explains.en: The hard parts inside a body support it. A dog has many. A doctor may mend one after a break.
A person’s body has a frame made from these hard parts. They protect organs. Milk helps keep them strong.
A skeleton is made of many hard pieces. A person may break one in a fall. The body can heal it.

examples.en: Eslite Bookstore is popular among book lovers in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 誠品書店在台灣愛書人之間非常受歡迎。

examples.en: I spent a peaceful rainy afternoon browsing magazines in the bookstore.
examples.zh: 我在書店翻閱雜誌，度過了一個寧靜祥和的雨後下午。

examples.en: The cozy independent bookstore hosts weekend book readings and author talks.
examples.zh: 這家溫馨的獨立書店在週末舉辦讀書會與作家講座。

explains.en: People buy books here. A worker may help a customer find a story. Some also sell cards and pens.
A shop has shelves full of books. A student may visit after class. The worker can order a title.
This store sells books and magazines. A reader may look for a new story. A cashier takes payment.

examples.en: The river forms a border between the two towns.
examples.zh: 這條河形成兩個城鎮之間的邊界。

examples.en: A fence marks the border of the yard.
examples.zh: 柵欄標示出庭院的邊界。

examples.en: They crossed the border by train.
examples.zh: 他們搭火車越過邊界。

explains.en: A line can mark the edge between two countries. A fence may go along it. The word can also mean an outer edge.
A map shows where one country ends and another begins. A park may have a fence around it. This word names that dividing line.
A wall can mark an edge. Two lands may have a line between them. A person may set a limit.

examples.en: Sorry to bother you, but I need help.
examples.zh: 不好意思打擾你，但我需要幫忙。

examples.en: The loud music bothered our neighbors.
examples.zh: 吵鬧的音樂打擾了鄰居。

examples.en: Does the noise bother you?
examples.zh: 這個噪音會困擾你嗎？

explains.en: It means causing someone a small problem. A person may ask a friend for help. The word can also mean worrying.
A loud sound may upset a sleeping baby. Someone can ask if a task is too much trouble. This word can mean to disturb.
A person may not want to disturb another. The word can also mean taking time or effort. A small issue may be annoying.

examples.en: The brain helps us think and learn.
examples.zh: 大腦幫助我們思考和學習。

examples.en: She hit her head but did not hurt her brain.
examples.zh: 她撞到頭，但沒有傷到大腦。

examples.en: Sleep is good for the brain.
examples.zh: 睡眠對大腦有好處。

explains.en: This organ inside the head helps people think and remember. It sends messages through the body. Doctors study it.
A person uses this part to learn and solve problems. It is protected by the skull. It works while a person sleeps.
This body part helps control movement and feelings. A student uses it during class. It can remember names and facts.

examples.en: Which local branch did you open your bank account at?
examples.zh: 你是在哪一家分行開立銀行帳戶的？

examples.en: Colorful birds built their nest on a high tree branch.
examples.zh: 色彩鮮豔的小鳥在高高的樹枝上築巢。

examples.en: Physics is a major branch of natural science.
examples.zh: 物理學是自然科學的一個重要分支領域。

explains.en: A tree grows a limb from its trunk. A bank may have a smaller office in another town. The word can also mean a part of a larger group.
A tree has arms that hold leaves. A company may have offices in many places. A road may split into another path.
This word can mean a limb of a tree. It can also name a local office. A large organization may have parts in many places.

examples.en: Acer and Asus are globally recognized Taiwanese PC brands.
examples.zh: 宏碁（Acer）與華碩（Asus）是全球知名的台灣電腦品牌。

examples.en: Building a trustworthy brand reputation requires decades of consistent quality.
examples.zh: 建立值得信賴的卓越品牌商譽，往往需要數十年如一日的穩定品質。

examples.en: Many consumers remain deeply loyal to their favorite coffee brand.
examples.zh: 許多消費者對自己最鍾愛的咖啡品牌抱持著極高的忠誠度與黏著度。

explains.en: A company name or mark helps people know its goods. A shoe may have one on its side. The word can also mean making a mark on skin.
A store may sell a well-known kind of food. A logo can identify a business. In the past, a hot tool marked animals.
This word names a product maker or label. People may choose one kind of soap. It can also mean marking with a hot iron.

examples.en: Keep your answer brief.
examples.zh: 請讓你的回答簡短。

examples.en: He gave a brief talk about the trip.
examples.zh: 他簡短地談了這趟旅行。

examples.en: The meeting was brief and helpful.
examples.zh: 會議簡短又有幫助。

entries.definition: （形）簡短的；短暫的；（名）簡報；律師訴訟摘要。

explains.en: It means short and using few words. A person may give a quick answer. A note can be only a few lines.
A short message does not last long. A speaker may explain a point quickly. This word can also describe a short visit.
This word means lasting for a short time. A report may have only a few pages. A person may give a quick summary.

examples.en: She had a brilliant idea.
examples.zh: 她有一個絕妙的主意。

examples.en: The brilliant stars filled the sky.
examples.zh: 明亮的星星布滿天空。

examples.en: He is a brilliant young scientist.
examples.zh: 他是一位傑出的年輕科學家。

explains.en: It means very bright or clever. A light may shine strongly. A student can have a great idea.
A very smart person may solve a hard problem. A jewel can shine brightly. This word describes something excellent.
This word means outstanding or full of light. A child may show a clever answer. The night sky can look bright.

examples.en: The broad river was hard to cross.
examples.zh: 這條寬闊的河流很難渡過。

examples.en: She has a broad smile.
examples.zh: 她露出燦爛的笑容。

examples.en: The book gives a broad view of history.
examples.zh: 這本書概述了歷史。

explains.en: It means wide from one side to another. A road may have many lanes. A general idea covers many things.
A river can be wide. A person may have a large smile. The word can mean general rather than detailed.
This word describes something wide. A table may hold many plates. A topic may include several ideas.

examples.en: Remember to brush your teeth twice a day.
examples.zh: 記得每天刷牙兩次。

examples.en: She brushed her long hair before looking into the mirror.
examples.zh: 她在照鏡子前先梳理了長髮。

examples.en: Dip the paint brush into clean water before switching colors.
examples.zh: 更換顏色前先將水彩筆刷浸入清水中清洗。

explains.en: A person cleans teeth with a small tool. Hair can be smoothed with one. The word can also mean rubbing with a tool.
A painter uses a tool with hairs to add color. A person may clean shoes. The action can mean rubbing back and forth.
This item has bristles. It can clean hair or teeth. An artist uses one with paint.

examples.en: Taipei 101 is one of the tallest green buildings.
examples.zh: 台北 101 是最高的地標綠建築之一。

examples.en: The university constructed a modern science building on campus.
examples.zh: 這所大學在校園內興建了一棟現代化的理學大樓。

examples.en: Building strong relationships requires mutual trust and patience.
examples.zh: 建立深厚穩固的人際關係需要互相信任與耐心。

examples.en: Taipei 101 is an iconic skyscraper building in East Asia.
examples.zh: 台北 101 是東亞地區指標性的摩天大樓。

examples.en: The historic red-brick building was converted into an artistic community cafe.
examples.zh: 這棟歷史悠久的紅磚建築被改造成了一間充滿文藝氣息的社區咖啡館。

examples.zh: 辦公大樓每年進行兩次消防安全疏散演練。

explains.en: People live or work inside this structure. It has walls and a roof. A city may have many tall ones.
A school is one kind of this structure. Workers may enter through doors. A builder can make one from wood or stone.
This structure gives people a place to live or work. It may have many floors. Windows let in light.

examples.en: We ate a warm bun with soup.
examples.zh: 我們喝湯時吃了一個熱麵包。

examples.zh: 她在麵包店買了一個甜麵包。

examples.zh: 這個麵包裡有葡萄乾。

explains.en: A small round bread roll is often eaten for breakfast. It may have a sweet filling. A person can cut it in half.
A baker may make this soft bread. It can contain cinnamon or fruit. People may eat it with butter.
This little bread can be sweet. It is shaped like a small roll. A person may have it with tea.

examples.en: The heavy burden made his walk slow.
examples.zh: 沉重的負擔讓他走得很慢。

examples.en: She shared the burden with her family.
examples.zh: 她和家人分擔了重擔。

examples.zh: 照顧嬰兒是個甜蜜的負擔。

entries.definition: （名）負擔；重擔；（動）使負重；把責任加在……身上。

explains.en: It is a heavy duty or problem. A person may carry a large box. It can also mean a worry.
A heavy bag may feel hard to lift. A family can share a difficult task. This word can mean a responsibility.
This word means a heavy load. A problem may feel hard to handle. A friend can help carry it.

examples.en: The dry leaves burned quickly.
examples.zh: 乾葉子很快就燒起來了。

examples.en: The soup burned my tongue.
examples.zh: 湯燙傷了我的舌頭。

examples.en: He burned the old letters in the fire.
examples.zh: 他在火裡燒掉了舊信件。

explains.en: It means being hurt by heat or fire. A person may cook food over a flame. The word can also mean using fuel.
A candle may do this when its wick is lit. Hot soup can hurt skin. The word can describe a mark from heat.
This action uses fire or heat. Wood can turn to ash. A person may feel a painful mark on the skin.

examples.en: The balloon burst with a loud pop.
examples.zh: 氣球砰一聲爆開了。

examples.en: The children burst into laughter.
examples.zh: 孩子們突然大笑起來。

examples.en: A pipe burst during the cold night.
examples.zh: 寒冷的夜裡有一根管子爆裂了。

entries.definition: （動）爆裂；突然湧出；（名）爆發；一陣

explains.en: It means breaking open suddenly. A balloon may make a loud sound. A person can begin crying.
A bag can open after being too full. Bubbles may pop. The word can also mean a sudden start.
This action happens quickly and with force. A pipe may break open. A person may begin laughing all at once.

examples.en: The businessman met with his clients.
examples.zh: 那位商人和他的客戶會面。

examples.en: A businessman opened a new store.
examples.zh: 一位商人開了一間新店。

examples.en: The businessman worked late every night.
examples.zh: 那位商人每晚工作到很晚。

entries.definition: 商人；男企業家；男商務人士

explains.en: A man who owns or manages a company has this job. He may meet with customers. The word can describe a male person in business.
This person may sell goods or services. He can hire workers. A small shop may belong to him.
A man may run a store or company. He may make deals. The job involves earning money by selling things.

examples.en: Stir-fried cabbage with garlic is a classic home-cooked dish.
examples.zh: 蒜炒高麗菜是一道經典的家常菜。

examples.en: Mountain-grown cabbage from Lishan is famed for its crisp sweetness.
examples.zh: 梨山出產的高山高麗菜以其清脆鮮甜聞名。

examples.en: Shred fresh cabbage finely to make refreshing homemade coleslaw.
examples.zh: 將新鮮高麗菜切成細絲以製作爽口的自製涼拌捲心菜。

examples.en: Lishan high-mountain cabbage develops natural sugary crispness under wide day-night temperature swings.
examples.zh: 生長在海拔兩千公尺梨山的大日夜溫差環境下，高山高麗菜自然凝結出極致清甜、鮮脆爽口的頂級口感。

examples.en: Quickly stir-fry shredded cabbage with minced garlic and chili over blazing high wok heat.
examples.zh: 在燒得滾燙的鐵鍋中將手撕高麗菜搭配蒜末與辣椒大火快炒，十數秒即可炒出鍋氣撲鼻的鮮脆美味。

examples.en: Fermenting shredded cabbage with salt and spices produces traditional probiotic-rich sauerkraut.
examples.zh: 將細切甘藍高麗菜絲加入海鹽與天然香料封罐慢速自然乳酸發酵，能做出富含活性益生菌的德式酸菜。

entries.definition: 高麗菜；捲心菜；高山高麗菜；甘藍菜

explains.en: This leafy vegetable has thick green or purple leaves. A cook may cut it for soup. It can grow in a garden.
A farmer grows this round vegetable in a field. People may chop it into a salad. It can be cooked with meat.
This plant has many leaves packed together. A family may eat it in a stew. It is often green.

examples.en: We met at a cafe after work.
examples.zh: 下班後我們在咖啡館碰面。

examples.en: The cafe serves tea and cakes.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡館供應茶和蛋糕。

examples.en: She read a book at the cafe.
examples.zh: 她在咖啡館看書。

explains.en: People sit here to drink coffee or eat a snack. A worker may bring a cup to a table. It can have small tables.
This place sells hot drinks and light food. A person may meet a friend there. It can be found on a street.
A customer may order coffee in this small shop. A chair may sit beside a table. Some places also sell cakes.

examples.en: The bird stayed in a large cage.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥待在一個大籠子裡。

examples.en: The zoo built a new cage for the lion.
examples.zh: 動物園為獅子蓋了一個新籠子。

examples.en: Please open the cage door carefully.
examples.zh: 請小心打開籠子的門。

explains.en: An animal may stay inside a metal enclosure. A bird can live in one. The bars help keep it safe.
A zoo may have a space for a tiger. A door can open and close. A person should not put an animal in a small one for long.
This enclosure has bars or wire. It can protect an animal. A pet bird may have one in a home.

examples.en: Mark your birthday on the calendar.
examples.zh: 在日曆上標記你的生日。

examples.en: The calendar shows the month of May.
examples.zh: 日曆上顯示五月份。

examples.en: We checked the calendar for the holiday.
examples.zh: 我們查看日曆確認假期日期。

explains.en: It shows days, weeks, and months. A person may mark a birthday. It helps people plan events.
A family may hang one on the wall. It shows what day comes next. A school can use one for holidays.
This chart lists dates. A person may check it before a trip. It helps keep track of time.

examples.en: Stay calm and follow instructions during an earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震發生時請保持冷靜並遵循指示。

examples.en: The doctor's gentle voice helped calm down the crying child in the clinic.
examples.zh: 診所裡醫生溫柔的嗓音幫助撫慰並平息了哭泣的孩子。

examples.en: The calm blue waters of the harbor mirrored the morning clouds like glass.
examples.zh: 港灣平靜蔚藍的水面猶如玻璃般倒映著晨曦的雲彩。

explains.en: It means peaceful and not upset. A person may breathe slowly. A lake can have no waves.
A teacher may speak in a quiet voice. A person can become peaceful after resting. The word can also mean making someone less upset.
This word describes a quiet mood. A person may stay relaxed during a storm. Slow breathing can help.

examples.en: The camel walked across the hot desert.
examples.zh: 駱駝走過炎熱的沙漠。

examples.en: A camel can live with little water.
examples.zh: 駱駝可以在水很少的情況下生存。

examples.en: The children rode a camel at the fair.
examples.zh: 孩子們在市集騎駱駝。

explains.en: This desert animal has one or two humps. It can walk far without much water. Its feet are wide.
A person may ride this large animal across sand. It can store fat in its hump. It eats plants.
This animal can live in dry places with little plant food. Some kinds face very hot summers and cold winters. Its body helps it cope with these harsh conditions.

examples.en: The flight was canceled due to the typhoon.
examples.zh: 由於颱風來襲，該航班已被取消。

examples.en: You can cancel your subscription at any time without fees.
examples.zh: 您可以隨時取消訂閱且不收手續費。

examples.en: We had to cancel our weekend camping trip because of the storm.
examples.zh: 因為暴風雨的緣故，我們不得不取消週末露營行程。

explains.en: It means deciding that an event will not happen. A person may call off a meeting. A school can stop a class.
Rain may cause a game to be called off. A person can remove a plan. This word means ending or stopping something.
A flight can be ended before it begins. A party may not happen. The action means stopping a planned event.

examples.en: Her uncle is being treated for cancer.
examples.zh: 她叔叔正在接受癌症治療。

examples.en: Doctors found the cancer early.
examples.zh: 醫生及早發現了癌症。

examples.en: The hospital has a cancer research team.
examples.zh: 這家醫院有一個癌症研究團隊。

explains.en: It is a serious illness where body cells grow in a harmful way. Doctors may use medicine or other care. Finding it early can help.
A person may need special care for this illness. It can affect different body parts. Doctors study ways to treat it.
This disease can make a person very sick. A doctor may find it with tests. Treatment can help some patients.

examples.en: She lit a candle during the power cut.
examples.zh: 停電時她點了一支蠟燭。

examples.en: The candle burned for three hours.
examples.zh: 蠟燭燃燒了三個小時。

examples.en: Blow out the candle after your wish.
examples.zh: 許完願後把蠟燭吹熄。

explains.en: A wax stick has a string inside. A flame gives light when it is lit. People may use one on a birthday cake.
A person can light this item during a power cut. It slowly melts as it burns. It may have a scent.
This wax object has a wick. A small flame shines at its top. People may place it on a table.

examples.en: Taipei is the capital of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台北是台灣的首都。

examples.en: She used capital letters for names.
examples.zh: 她用大寫字母寫名字。

examples.zh: 這家公司需要更多資金才能成長。

examples.en: Paris is the capital of France.
examples.zh: 巴黎是法國的首都。

examples.zh: 每個句子的開頭都要使用大寫字母。

examples.en: The company needs capital to open a second store.
examples.zh: 這家公司需要資金來開設第二間店。

explains.en: It is a city where a government is based. A country may have one. The word can also mean money for starting a business.
A nation has a main city for its leaders. A person may save money to start a shop. The word can also mean a big letter.
This word can name a government city. It may mean money or property used for business. A tall letter begins a name.
The main city of a region or country is often where its government meets. It may also be a large center for work and travel. People can find important offices there.
The class marked the country's main city on a map. They found the government building and a busy train station nearby. Many visitors traveled there each day.

examples.en: The children watched a funny cartoon.
examples.zh: 孩子們看了一部有趣的卡通。

examples.en: He drew a cartoon of his teacher.
examples.zh: 他畫了一幅老師的漫畫。

examples.en: A cartoon mouse made us laugh.
examples.zh: 卡通老鼠逗笑了我們。

entries.definition: （名）卡通；漫畫；動畫片；（動）畫漫畫

This kind of art uses simple drawings. It may appear in a comic strip. A screen can show moving versions.

examples.zh: 你喜歡用現金支付還是刷信用卡？

examples.en: Small food stalls at night markets usually accept only cash.
examples.zh: 夜市裡的小吃攤通常只收取現金。

examples.en: I withdrew two thousand dollars in cash from the ATM.
examples.zh: 我從自動提款機領取了兩千元現金。

examples.zh: 許多傳統夜市攤位只接受現金付款。

examples.zh: 我需要找一台自動提款機領取一些現金。

examples.en: Can you cash this traveler's check at the bank counter?
examples.zh: 你可以在銀行櫃檯把這張旅行支票兌現嗎？

This money is made of notes and coins. A person can use it at a market. A cashier may give change.

examples.zh: 國王住在一座石造城堡裡。

examples.zh: 我們參觀了山丘上的古堡。

examples.en: The castle had a tall tower.
examples.zh: 城堡有一座高塔。

A ruler may live in this building. Soldiers guarded its gates. It often appears in fairy tales.

examples.en: Heavy rain caused the flood.
examples.zh: 大雨造成了洪水。

examples.zh: 天花板漆成淺藍色。

examples.zh: 一盞燈掛在天花板上。

examples.zh: 這個房間的天花板很高。

This upper surface covers a room. It may have lights. Paint can make it bright.

examples.en: A hydrogen fuel cell combines hydrogen and atmospheric oxygen electrochemically, producing electricity directly.
examples.zh: 「氫燃料電池」（Fuel Cell），透過電化學方式將氫氣與空氣中的氧氣結合，直接無燃燒發出強勁電能。

examples.en: Human blood contains red blood cells that transport oxygen and white blood cells that fight bacterial infection.
examples.zh: 人體血液中循環流動著負責將氧氣輸送至各器官的紅血球，以及擔任人體免疫衛士抵抗細菌感染的白血球。

explains.en: A tiny part of a body is called this. It can also hold power in a phone. The word may mean a small room in a jail.
A battery has a part that stores energy. A body is made of many tiny living parts. A prison may have a small room with this name.

examples.en: The pencil is twelve centimeters long.
examples.zh: 這枝鉛筆長十二公分。

examples.en: The child grew two centimeters this year.
examples.zh: 這個孩子今年長高了兩公分。

examples.en: Cut the ribbon into pieces that are five centimeters long.
examples.zh: 把緞帶剪成五公分長的小段。

explains.en: This metric unit measures a short distance. One hundred of these make a meter. A ruler shows the units with marks.
Ten millimeters make one of these units. They help measure a pencil or small toy. A school ruler often has thirty of them.
This unit is written as cm after a number. People use it to record height and width. It is smaller than an inch.

examples.en: The central library is near the park.
examples.zh: 中央圖書館在公園附近。

examples.en: A clock stood in the central hall.
examples.zh: 大廳中央放著一座時鐘。

examples.en: She lives in a central part of town.
examples.zh: 她住在鎮中心。

entries.definition: 中央的；中心的；最重要的。

explains.en: It means in the middle of an area. A library may stand in the middle of town. A body has a middle part.
A city may have a main place for shops. A person can focus on an important idea. This word means in the middle or main.
This word describes a location near the middle. A school may be in a main area. It can also mean very important.

examples.en: A century is one hundred years.
examples.zh: 一個世紀是一百年。

examples.en: The old bridge is over a century old.
examples.zh: 這座老橋有一百多年歷史。

examples.en: They studied events from the last century.
examples.zh: 他們研究上個世紀的事件。

explains.en: One hundred years make this period. A person may live for less than one. A museum may show objects from a past one.
This length of time has ten decades. History books may describe one. It is a very long period.
A hundred years is one of these. People use it to talk about history. A new one starts after each group of one hundred years.

examples.en: I ate cereal with milk for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐吃了加牛奶的穀片。

examples.en: The cereal box is on the shelf.
examples.zh: 穀片盒在架子上。

examples.en: She chose a bowl of hot cereal.
examples.zh: 她選了一碗熱穀粥。

explains.en: A breakfast food is made from grains. People may eat it with milk. A box can hold it.
A child may pour this food into a bowl. It can be hot or cold. Wheat or corn may be used.
This grain food is often eaten in the morning. Milk may be added. It can come in flakes or small shapes.

examples.en: The dog wore a chain around its neck.
examples.zh: 狗脖子上戴著一條鐵鍊。

examples.en: A bicycle chain needs oil.
examples.zh: 自行車鏈條需要上油。

examples.en: The store is part of a large chain.
examples.zh: 這家店是大型連鎖店的一部分。

entries.definition: （名）鏈條；一連串；連鎖店；（動）用鏈條拴住

explains.en: A group of metal links can hold things together. A necklace may have one. The word can also mean a series of shops.
A bicycle has a linked part that moves its wheels. A person may wear a gold one around the neck. Stores can form a large business group.
This item is made from connected links. It can secure a gate. The word can also mean connected events.

examples.en: The teacher wrote with white chalk.
examples.zh: 老師用白色粉筆寫字。

examples.en: The child drew a hopscotch game with chalk.
examples.zh: 孩子用粉筆畫了一個跳房子格子。

examples.en: She cleaned the chalk from the board.
examples.zh: 她把板子上的粉筆字擦掉。

entries.definition: 粉筆；用粉筆書寫或畫畫。

explains.en: A soft white stone leaves marks on a dark board. A teacher may write with it. It can be broken into small sticks.
Students may draw on a playground with this white material. It is used in classrooms. A cloth can wipe its marks away.
This writing material is soft and dusty. A person can use it on a black surface. It is made from a kind of stone.

examples.en: The puzzle was a fun challenge.
examples.zh: 這個謎題是個有趣的挑戰。

examples.en: She challenged her brother to a race.
examples.zh: 她向哥哥挑戰賽跑。

examples.en: The team faced a difficult challenge.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍面臨一項艱難挑戰。

explains.en: It is a hard task that tests someone. A puzzle may be difficult. A person can try to solve it.
A team may face a difficult game. The word can also mean asking someone to do something hard. A hard task takes effort.
This word names a task that needs effort. A person may accept it. It can help people learn.

examples.en: Switch the TV channel to watch the live baseball tournament.
examples.zh: 切換電視頻道以觀賞現場直播的棒球錦標賽。

examples.en: The Taiwan Strait is a busy international shipping and maritime channel.
examples.zh: 台灣海峽是國際上極為繁重繁忙的海運船舶航運海峽通道。

examples.en: Companies establish formal feedback channels to hear from valued customers.
examples.zh: 企業紛紛建立正式的溝通反饋管道，以傾聽重要顧客的心聲。

explains.en: A TV station sends programs on this. A narrow path of water between lands has the same name. The word can also mean a way to send something.
A person may change the number on a television. Boats pass through a narrow waterway. A company may use a path for messages.
This word can mean a TV station or a water passage. A narrow sea route may connect two larger bodies. It can also mean a way to reach people.

examples.en: We read one chapter before bed.
examples.zh: 睡前我們讀了一章。

examples.en: The book has twelve chapters.
examples.zh: 這本書有十二章。

examples.en: Chapter three tells about the journey.
examples.zh: 第三章講述了這趟旅程。

explains.en: A book may be divided into named parts. A person can read one each night. It may contain many pages.

This part of a book has a title or number. It covers one section of the story. A student may read it for homework.

examples.zh: 龍貓是宮崎駿所創造的深受喜愛的動畫角色。
