examples.zh: 克服逆境能鍛鍊人的心理韌性並磨礪品格。

examples.en: Learning to write traditional Chinese characters requires careful stroke order discipline.
examples.zh: 學習書寫繁體漢字需要嚴謹遵守筆畫順序的自律規範。

explains.en: A person in a story has this role. It can also mean someone’s nature. A written mark in Chinese writing has this name.
A book may have a kind person or a villain. A person can have a brave nature. A single written symbol may carry meaning.
This word can mean a story person. It may describe someone’s nature. It can also name a letter or symbol.

examples.en: It takes one hour to charge this phone fully.
examples.zh: 這支手機充滿電需要一個小時。

examples.en: The hotel does not charge any extra fees for wireless internet access.
examples.zh: 該飯店對無線網路使用不收取任何額外費用。

examples.en: The police officer charged the reckless driver with speeding through red lights.
examples.zh: 員警對這名闖紅燈超速的魯莽駕駛提出控告。

explains.en: It means putting power into a battery. A store may ask money for a service. A police officer can say someone broke a rule.
A phone needs this action when its battery is low. A shop can ask a fee. The word can also mean accusing someone of a crime.
This word has several meanings. It can mean adding power to a battery. It can also mean asking for money or making an accusation.

examples.en: The sales chart shows rapid revenue growth over the past six months.
examples.zh: 銷售圖表顯示過去六個月以來營業額呈現快速成長。

examples.en: Navigators charted a safe maritime route around dangerous rocky shoals.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的遠洋航海領航員在精密海圖上繪製出一條繞開暗礁淺灘的平安航線。

examples.en: The catchy Taiwanese pop song remained at the top of the music charts for eight weeks.
examples.zh: 這首旋律洗腦的台灣本土流行金曲連續八週蟬聯各大數位音樂排行榜冠軍寶座。

explains.en: A drawing or table can show facts. A ship worker may use a map of the sea. A person can make one with data.
A line graph is one kind of this. A sailor may follow one across the ocean. A teacher can draw one for a lesson.
This visual tool helps people understand facts. It may use lines or bars. A map can help guide a boat.

examples.en: The dog chased the ball across the yard.
examples.zh: 狗追著球跑過庭院。

examples.en: The police chased the thief through the street.
examples.zh: 警察在街上追捕小偷。

examples.en: She chased her dream of becoming a singer.
examples.zh: 她追尋成為歌手的夢想。

explains.en: It means running after someone or something. A dog may follow a ball. A person may try to catch a bus.
A child may follow a friend in a game. A police officer can look for a person. The action can also mean pursuing a goal.
This action means trying to catch up. A cat may follow a mouse. A person can pursue a dream.

examples.en: Cheating during examinations results in immediate zero marks and disciplinary action.
examples.zh: 考試作弊將導致該科零分並遭受校規懲處。

examples.en: Some athletes use banned substances to cheat in competitive tournaments.
examples.zh: 部分運動員使用違禁藥物在競爭賽事中弄虛作假不法作弊。

examples.en: He felt cheated after discovering the luxury handbag was a counterfeit replica.
examples.zh: 在發現那個名牌精品包只是仿冒贗品後，他深感遭到欺騙。

explains.en: It means using unfair methods to win. A student may look at another person’s answers. It can also mean tricking someone.
A player may break the rules in a game. A person can tell a lie for gain. The word can name someone who deceives others.
This action is unfair. A child may copy homework. A person may trick a friend.

examples.en: The audience cheered loudly for the winning team.
examples.zh: 觀眾為獲勝的隊伍大聲歡呼喝采。

examples.en: Her thoughtful words helped cheer me up after a hard day.
examples.zh: 在她貼心的安慰下，我度過辛勞一天後心情好轉了。

examples.en: Cheerleaders waved bright pom-poms to encourage the runners.
examples.zh: 啦啦隊員揮舞著鮮艷的彩球為跑者加油打氣。

explains.en: This action means shouting to show support or joy. A crowd may make a loud sound at a game. The verb can also mean making someone feel happier.
People may call out loudly for a team. A person can support a friend. This word can mean giving hope.
This action shows support. Fans may clap and call at a match. A friend can say something kind.

examples.en: The lab used a chemical to clean the glass.
examples.zh: 實驗室使用一種化學物質清潔玻璃。

examples.en: Some chemicals can be dangerous.
examples.zh: 有些化學物質可能很危險。

examples.en: The plant makes a natural chemical.
examples.zh: 這種植物會產生天然化學物質。

entries.definition: （名）化學物質；（形）化學的；化學品。

explains.en: A material used in a lab may change when mixed. Some cleaners have it. A scientist studies how materials react.
A substance can be found in soap or medicine. Some can be harmful. A person should read safety labels.
This word describes a substance used in science. It may be solid, liquid, or gas. Many products are made from such materials.

examples.en: The children played chess after school.
examples.zh: 孩子們放學後下西洋棋。

examples.en: She won the chess game in ten moves.
examples.zh: 她下了十步就贏了棋局。

examples.en: He studies chess with his grandfather.
examples.zh: 他和祖父一起學西洋棋。

explains.en: Two players move black and white pieces on a board. The goal is to trap the other king. A game can take a long time.
This board game uses a king, queen, and smaller pieces. Players think ahead. It is played around the world.
A person must plan each move in this game. The board has sixty-four squares. One player uses black pieces and one uses white.

examples.en: The chief spoke to the whole team.
examples.zh: 主管對整個團隊說話。

examples.en: She is the chief of the fire station.
examples.zh: 她是消防局主管。

examples.en: The chief reason was bad weather.
examples.zh: 主要原因是天氣不好。

entries.definition: （形）主要的；首要的；（名）首領；主管

explains.en: It means the main person in a group. A school may have one teacher in charge. The word can also mean first or most important.
A team may have a top leader. A city may have a main officer. This word describes someone at the top.
This word means the person with the highest role. A company may have one leader. It can also mean most important.

examples.en: My childhood was full of happy memories.
examples.zh: 我的童年充滿快樂回憶。

examples.en: He spent his childhood near the sea.
examples.zh: 他在海邊度過童年。

examples.en: The book tells about her childhood.
examples.zh: 這本書講述她的童年。

explains.en: It is the time when a person is a child. Games and school may fill those years. Memories can stay for a long time.
A person may remember family life from early years. Children learn many things during this period. It comes before adult life.
This word means the years before adulthood. A person may look back on them. It can include play, school, and growing.

examples.en: His childish joke made the class laugh.
examples.zh: 他幼稚的笑話讓全班大笑。

examples.en: Stop acting childish and share the toy.
examples.zh: 別再幼稚了，把玩具分享出來。

examples.en: She made a childish face at her brother.
examples.zh: 她對哥哥做了個孩子氣的表情。

entries.definition: 孩子氣的；幼稚的；不成熟的。

explains.en: It means acting like a young child in a bad way. A person may complain over a small issue. The word can sound unkind.
An adult may behave in a silly way. A person can refuse to share. This word describes behavior that seems too young.
This word can describe an immature action. A person may throw a fit. It is often used as a criticism.

examples.en: The bowl is made of china.
examples.zh: 這個碗是瓷器做的。

examples.en: She collects fine china cups.
examples.zh: 她收藏精美的瓷杯。

examples.en: The china plate broke on the floor.
examples.zh: 瓷盤掉在地上摔破了。

explains.en: It is a hard white dish material. People make cups and bowls from it. It can break if dropped.
A tea cup may be made from this smooth material. It is heated in a kiln. A person may collect fine dishes.
This material can be used for plates and vases. It often has a shiny finish. It may be painted with patterns.

examples.en: Taiwanese people use chopsticks to eat noodles.
examples.zh: 台灣人用筷子吃麵。

examples.en: Can you hold chopsticks properly when eating rice?
examples.zh: 你吃米飯時能拿好筷子嗎？

examples.en: Using reusable chopsticks helps protect the environment.
examples.zh: 使用環保筷有助於保護環境。

explains.en: These are two thin sticks used for eating. A person holds both in one hand. Moving their tips together helps lift food.
These eating tools are common in many Asian countries. They may be made from wood or metal. A pair can lift noodles from a bowl.
One stick usually stays fairly still in the hand. The other moves toward it. Food is held between the two tips.

examples.en: File a medical insurance claim along with doctor diagnosis receipts.
examples.zh: 檢附醫師診斷證明書與收據以向保險公司申請醫療險理賠。

examples.en: The passenger made a compensation claim after the airline misplaced her suitcase.
examples.zh: 航空公司不慎遺失旅客行李箱後，乘客正式提出了行李遺失損害賠償申訴。

examples.en: The politician claimed that his tax reform would stimulate domestic manufacturing.
examples.zh: 這位政治人物公開聲稱其減稅改革措施將能有效提振本土製造業景氣。

examples.en: Proceed directly to baggage claim after clearing immigration and passport checks.
examples.zh: 在順利通過移民署證照查驗證件後，請依照動線指標前往行李提領大廳提領行李。

examples.en: She filed an official insurance claim after her suitcase was accidentally misplaced.
examples.zh: 在發現自己的託運行李箱不幸遭到航空公司誤送遺失後，她立即向保險公司提出理賠申報。

examples.en: Passengers can claim reimbursement for travel meals if flight delays exceed six hours.
examples.zh: 若因航空公司調度因素導致班機延誤超過六小時以上，旅客有權要求餐飲住宿交通費用補償。

entries.definition: 保險理賠申請；主張；索賠；行李提領；申領；主張要求

explains.en: It means saying something is true. A person may ask for money after a loss. The word can also mean a request for property.
A worker may say they own an idea. A customer may ask for payment after damage. This word can mean stating or asking.
This word can mean a statement of fact. A person may ask for money from an insurer. It can also mean demanding something.

examples.en: The audience clapped after the show.
examples.zh: 表演結束後觀眾鼓掌。

examples.en: Clap your hands to the beat.
examples.zh: 跟著節拍拍手。

examples.en: The children clapped for the singer.
examples.zh: 孩子們為歌手鼓掌。

explains.en: People bring their hands together to make a sound. An audience may do this after a song. It can show approval.
A person can make a sharp sound with two hands. Fans may do this for a team. The word can mean a hand sound.
This action makes a sound by hitting palms together. It may show praise. A child can do it during a game.

examples.en: That classic movie is still popular.
examples.zh: 那部經典電影仍然很受歡迎。

examples.en: She wore a classic black dress.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件經典黑洋裝。

examples.en: The book became a modern classic.
examples.zh: 這本書成為現代經典。

entries.definition: （形）經典的；典型的；（名）經典作品；名著

explains.en: It means an admired example that lasts a long time. A book may become well known. The word can also mean a work that is excellent.
A famous film may stay popular for many years. A student may read an old book. This word describes something considered a model.
This word can describe a lasting work of art. A favorite film may have this status. It can also mean a traditional design.

examples.en: Unlike classical computers that process bits as zeros or ones, quantum systems explore both simultaneously.
examples.zh: 不同於傳統電腦只能將位元非 0 即 1 地循序處理，量子系統能同時探索兩者。

examples.en: Even the fastest classical supercomputer would require millennia to factor modern cryptographic keys.
examples.zh: 即便動用當前全球運算速度最快的傳統超級電腦，也需要耗費數萬年才能暴力破解現代密碼公鑰。

examples.en: Hybrid computing combines classical CPU pipelines with quantum acceleration chips.
examples.zh: 混合式運算架構巧妙將傳統 CPU 資料流水線與專用量子加速晶片深度整合，截長補短。

entries.definition: 傳統二進位 0 與 1 電晶體位元的；經典的

explains.en: It describes music from a long tradition. An orchestra may play it. A piano can be used.
A story from ancient Greece may have this style. A concert can feature an orchestra. The word can describe formal music.
This word may refer to serious music played by instruments. It can also describe something from old times. A violin may be heard.

examples.en: Amy is my favorite classmate.
examples.zh: 艾咪是我最喜歡的同班同學。

examples.en: I borrowed a math textbook from my classmate.
examples.zh: 我向我的同班同學借了一本數學課本。

examples.en: All of my classmates are friendly and helpful.
examples.zh: 我的同班同學都很友善且樂於助人。

explains.en: A student in the same class has this relation. They may study together. A person can share a desk.
A child may work with another learner in class. They have the same teacher. This person can become a friend.
This word names another student in one’s class. They may do group work. They learn the same lessons.

examples.en: The clever girl solved the puzzle quickly.
examples.zh: 那個聰明的女孩很快解開謎題。

examples.en: That was a clever way to save time.
examples.zh: 那是節省時間的巧妙方法。

examples.en: The clever fox escaped from the trap.
examples.zh: 那隻聰明的狐狸逃離了陷阱。

explains.en: It means quick to learn or understand. A child may solve a puzzle. A person can have a smart idea.
A person who learns fast has this quality. A fox in stories is often smart. A good plan may show skill.
This word describes a person with a sharp mind. A student may find an easy answer. It can also mean well designed.

examples.en: Click the link below to join the online meeting.
examples.zh: 點擊下方連結以加入線上會議。

examples.en: Double click the desktop folder icon to view stored photos.
examples.zh: 按兩下桌面資料夾圖示以檢視儲存的照片。

examples.en: With just a single click, your order will be placed successfully.
examples.zh: 只需輕輕一點，你的訂單就能成功送出。

examples.en: Click the blue button to confirm your airline seat selection.
examples.zh: 點擊藍色按鈕以確認您的飛機劃位選擇。

examples.en: The key turned in the lock with a satisfying click.
examples.zh: 鑰匙在鎖孔中轉動，發出了一聲令人安心的喀噠聲。

examples.en: As soon as they met, their personalities just clicked right away.
examples.zh: 他們倆一見面，彼此的個性立刻一拍即合、非常投緣。

explains.en: A mouse makes this sound when pressed. A person can choose a button on a screen. It may mean a short sharp noise.
A small sound may come from a door latch. A computer user may press a key. The word can mean selecting something on a screen.
This action picks an item on a computer. A switch may make a small sound. A link can be chosen by pressing a mouse button.

examples.en: Southern Taiwan enjoys a warm, sunny tropical climate year-round.
examples.zh: 南台灣全年享有溫暖晴朗的熱帶氣候。

examples.en: The Mediterranean climate is known for dry summers and mild winters.
examples.zh: 地中海型氣候以夏季乾燥與冬季溫和而著稱。

examples.en: Scientists are closely studying how global climate affects agriculture.
examples.zh: 科學家正密切研究全球氣候如何對農業產生影響。

explains.en: It describes the usual weather of a place over many years. A hot region has one kind. A cold area has another.
A country near the equator may be warm. A northern region may have long winters. This word names long-term weather patterns.
This word means the normal weather in an area. Scientists study temperature and rain. It can affect plants and animals.

examples.en: The table was covered with a blue cloth.
examples.zh: 桌上鋪著一塊藍布。

examples.en: She wiped the window with a soft cloth.
examples.zh: 她用軟布擦窗戶。

examples.en: This cloth is made of cotton.
examples.zh: 這塊布是棉製的。

explains.en: A piece of material can cover a table. It may be used for cleaning. A shirt can be made from it.
A towel is made from woven material. A person can cut a piece for sewing. It may be cotton or linen.
This material is used to make clothes or curtains. It can be soft or rough. A person may wipe a table using it.

examples.en: Warm clothing helps in winter.
examples.zh: 保暖衣物在冬天很有幫助。

examples.en: The store sells clothing for children.
examples.zh: 這家店販售兒童服裝。

examples.en: Pack enough clothing for the trip.
examples.zh: 帶足夠的衣物去旅行。

explains.en: People put these items on their bodies. Shirts, pants, and coats are examples. They can keep a person warm.
A person may choose a clean shirt each day. A closet holds many items. The word means garments.
This word means things worn on the body. A store may sell many styles. A coat is one example.

examples.en: It is cloudy today, but it won't rain.
examples.zh: 今天多雲，但不會下雨。

examples.en: The weather was cool and cloudy during our mountain hike.
examples.zh: 我們登山健行期間的天氣涼爽且多雲。

examples.en: Photography is often softer and more flattering on cloudy days.
examples.zh: 在陰天拍照時光線通常更加柔和、呈現效果更佳。

explains.en: It means the sky has many clouds. The sun may be hard to see. Rain may come later.
A gray sky can cover a town. A person may carry an umbrella. This word describes a day with clouds.
Clouds fill much of the sky. The day may look dark. The weather report can use this describing word.

examples.en: Coal was used to heat the old house.
examples.zh: 煤曾用來為這棟老房子供暖。

examples.en: The train burned coal for fuel.
examples.zh: 這列火車燒煤作為燃料。

examples.en: Miners found coal deep underground.
examples.zh: 礦工在地底深處找到煤。

explains.en: A black rock can burn and make heat. A train once used it as fuel. It comes from underground.
This dark material is dug from the earth. A fire can burn it. It helped power old factories.
A mine may produce this fuel. It is made from old plants. Burning it can make smoke.

examples.en: The small town sits on the coast.
examples.zh: 這座小鎮位於海岸邊。

examples.en: We walked along the coast at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落時我們沿著海岸散步。

examples.en: The coast was rocky and cold.
examples.zh: 海岸多岩石又寒冷。

entries.definition: 海岸；海岸地區；沿海地帶。

explains.en: Land beside the ocean is this area. Waves may hit the beach. A person can walk along it.
A road may follow the edge of the sea. Birds and crabs may live nearby. People visit for a view.
This word means the land next to a sea. A beach may be there. Ships can travel along it.

examples.en: A cockroach ran under the fridge.
examples.zh: 一隻蟑螂跑到冰箱底下。

examples.en: Store flour, cereal, and sugar in airtight containers to avoid attracting any unwanted cockroach.
examples.zh: 將麵粉、穀片與糖存放在密封容器中，以免引來令人不快的蟑螂。

examples.en: Biologists admire the astonishing evolutionary resilience of the common cockroach.
examples.zh: 生物學家十分驚嘆於一般常見蟑螂那令人難以置信的進化適應韌性。

explains.en: A small brown insect may live in a kitchen. It has long feelers and can move fast. People try to keep it away from food.
This insect hides in dark places. It has six legs and a hard back. It may come out at night.
A home may have this unwanted insect. It can fit into small cracks. Clean food areas help keep it away.

examples.en: Dust Dutch-processed unsweetened cocoa powder across the top of chilled tiramisu.
examples.zh: 在冰鎮冷藏定型好的經典提拉米蘇表面均勻篩上一層厚厚的頂級無糖純黑可可粉。

examples.en: A mug of steaming hot cocoa topped with fluffy marshmallows warms cold winter evenings.
examples.zh: 寒冬深夜裡，手捧一杯頂部漂浮著軟綿棉花糖的熱可可，能帶來無比療癒的溫暖暖意。

examples.en: High-quality cocoa butter gives luxury chocolate bars their smooth melting sensation on the tongue.
examples.zh: 頂級天然可可脂賦予了高端精品黑巧克力在舌尖接觸瞬間絲滑化口的極致奢華感官體驗。

examples.en: Sourcing single-origin Ecuadorian dark cocoa beans yields fruity, floral notes with earthy depth.
examples.zh: 嚴選厄瓜多單一產區莊園級純黑可可豆，在烘焙後散發出迷人的熱帶果酸與優雅花香。

examples.en: Dusting the chocolate truffles with unsweetened Dutch-process cocoa powder provides a pleasantly bitter finish.
examples.zh: 在手工黑松露巧克力球表面薄薄滾上一層天然無糖荷蘭式純可可粉，帶來微苦回甘的優雅餘韻。

examples.en: Farmers ferment and dry the raw cocoa beans carefully to develop chocolate precursors before roasting.
examples.zh: 可可莊園農民在日照下細心翻拌發酵曬乾生可可豆，在烘烤前完整孕育出濃郁豐富的巧克力前驅風味。

entries.definition: 可可粉；可可豆；70% 單一產區莊園級純黑可可膏

explains.en: A warm drink can be made from roasted beans. A person may add milk. The powder is also used in sweets.
This brown powder gives chocolate its taste. A farmer grows its beans in warm places. People mix it into a hot drink.
A cup of this drink may warm a person. The beans come from a tropical plant. It can be used in cake and candy.

examples.en: Insert a ten-dollar coin into the vending machine.
examples.zh: 投一枚十元硬幣進自動販賣機。

examples.en: He flips a coin whenever he has trouble making a tough choice.
examples.zh: 每當遇到難以抉擇的難題時，他總會丟硬幣決定。

examples.en: The cashier handed me two fifty-dollar coins as change.
examples.zh: 收銀員找了我兩枚五十元的硬幣作為零錢。

examples.en: Insert two fifty-dollar coins into the capsule toy machine.
examples.zh: 在扭蛋機投入兩枚五十元硬幣。

examples.en: Let's flip a coin to decide who washes the dishes tonight.
examples.zh: 我們擲硬幣來決定今晚誰負責洗碗吧。

examples.en: Shakespeare coined many English expressions that are still used today.
examples.zh: 莎士比亞創造了許多至今仍被廣泛使用的英語詞彙表現方式。

entries.definition: 硬幣；錢幣；創造（新詞）；創造（新字）

explains.en: A small round piece of metal is used as money. A person may toss one in the air. It can have a picture on each side.
A person can pay for a snack using this metal money. A collection may contain old ones. It is smaller than most paper money.
This money has a round shape. A child may put it in a piggy bank. It can be made from copper or other metals.

examples.en: He ordered a cola with his meal.
examples.zh: 他點餐時點了一杯可樂。

examples.en: The cola was cold and fizzy.
examples.zh: 可樂冰涼又有氣泡。

examples.en: Chilled sparkling cola served with crushed ice cubes is a perennial summer thirst quencher.
examples.zh: 搭配碎冰塊飲用的冰涼氣泡可樂是一道長盛不衰的盛夏消暑解渴良伴。

explains.en: A dark fizzy drink is sold in cans or bottles. It has a sweet taste. Ice can make it cold.
People may drink this soda with a meal. It has bubbles. A famous kind has a red label.
This sweet drink contains gas bubbles. A person may pour it into a glass. It can be caffeine-free or have caffeine.

examples.en: She will study science in college.
examples.zh: 她將在大學讀科學。

examples.en: The college has a large library.
examples.zh: 這所大學有一座大型圖書館。

examples.en: He moved away to attend college.
examples.zh: 他搬到外地上大學。

explains.en: A student may go here after high school. They can learn a job or subject. The place has teachers and classes.
This school offers higher learning. Students may earn a degree. A campus can have a library and dorms.
A young adult may study science or art here. Classes may be large. The school can have sports teams.

examples.en: She used a comb to fix her hair.
examples.zh: 她用梳子整理頭髮。

examples.en: The comb has wide teeth.
examples.zh: 這把梳子的齒很寬。

examples.en: He lost his comb at the gym.
examples.zh: 他在健身房弄丟了梳子。

explains.en: A person moves this tool through hair to make it neat. It has teeth along one side. It can be made from plastic.
This small tool helps smooth tangled hair. A person may keep one in a bag. It can also be used for wool.
A barber may use this tool while cutting hair. Its narrow teeth go through strands. A handle helps someone hold it.

examples.en: Combine the flour and water in a bowl.
examples.zh: 把麵粉和水混合在碗裡。

examples.en: The two roads combine near the bridge.
examples.zh: 兩條路在橋附近交會。

examples.en: They combined their money to buy a gift.
examples.zh: 他們把錢合在一起買禮物。

explains.en: It means putting two or more things together. A person may mix flour and water. Groups can join forces.
A cook can mix ingredients in a bowl. Two roads may join. The word means bringing things into one.
This action joins items or people. A worker may bring data from two lists into one. A person can mix flavors.

examples.en: The child read a comic about a hero.
examples.zh: 孩子讀了一本英雄漫畫。

examples.en: The comic book has bright pictures.
examples.zh: 這本漫畫書有鮮豔的圖畫。

examples.en: The whimsical Sunday newspaper comic strip brightened up an otherwise gloomy rainy morning.
examples.zh: 週日早報刊登的異想天開趣味漫畫專欄為原本陰鬱綿綿的雨天早晨帶來了一抹亮色。

entries.definition: （形）滑稽的；逗趣的；（名）連環漫畫；喜劇演員

explains.en: A funny story told with pictures may appear in a book. A child may read one. Characters often speak in bubbles.
A magazine can have a funny drawing. A set of pictures may tell a story. A person may collect these books.
This kind of story uses drawings. It may have speech bubbles. A superhero can be a character.

examples.en: The officer gave a command to stop.
examples.zh: 警官下達停下的命令。

examples.en: The computer follows each command.
examples.zh: 電腦會執行每一個指令。

examples.en: The captain commanded the ship.
examples.zh: 船長指揮這艘船。

entries.definition: （名）命令；指令；掌控；（動）命令；指揮；掌握

explains.en: A person in charge may tell a group what to do. A computer can receive an instruction. The word can mean control.
A teacher may give directions to a class. A computer user can type a request. The word also names an order from a leader.
This word means an instruction. A captain may tell a team to move. A computer may follow a typed request.

examples.en: The exciting movie was interrupted by three long commercial breaks.
examples.zh: 精彩的電影中途穿插了三段冗長的電視廣告。

examples.en: The bustling district is filled with vibrant commercial activity and restaurants.
examples.zh: 這處熱鬧的街區充滿了蓬勃繁榮的商業活動與各式美食餐廳。

examples.en: A humorous television commercial boosted the snack brand's sales overnight.
examples.zh: 一支幽默風趣的電視廣告讓該零食品牌的銷量一夜之間飆升。

explains.en: A short message tries to sell a product. It may appear on TV. A store may pay for it.
A company may show a short video between programs. It tells people about goods. The word can describe business activity.
This message asks people to buy something. It can be on radio or a screen. A business may pay for a spot.

examples.en: TSMC is Taiwan's world-leading semiconductor company.
examples.zh: 台積電是台灣引領全球的半導體公司。

examples.en: Thank you for keeping me company while I waited for the late train.
examples.zh: 謝謝你在我等候晚點列車時一路陪著我作伴。

examples.en: He founded a software startup company that grew into a multinational tech firm.
examples.zh: 他創立了一家軟體新創公司，如今已茁壯發展為跨國科技大企業。

explains.en: People work together in a business. A friend can stay so another person is not alone. The word can mean a group of performers.
A store may have many employees. A person may enjoy a friend’s presence. A group of actors can travel together.
This word can mean a business group. It can also mean being beside a friend. A group of soldiers may live and work together.

examples.en: Compare prices online before making big electronic purchases.
examples.zh: 購買高單價電子產品前先在線上比價。

examples.en: Don't compare your personal learning pace with classmates around you.
examples.zh: 切勿將自己個人的學習步調與身旁同儕盲目攀比，保持節奏即可。

examples.en: Poets frequently compare the fleeting beauty of youth to blossoming spring flowers.
examples.zh: 詩人經常將青春稍縱即逝的耀眼美好，比喻為春日裡絢爛盛開的花朵。

explains.en: It means looking at two things to find ways they are alike or different. A child may check two drawings. The word can also mean saying one is similar to another.
A teacher may ask students to look at two stories. A person can notice differences. This word means examining two items side by side.
This action finds likenesses and differences. A person may look at two prices. It can also mean describing one thing as like another.

examples.en: Please complete the form before Friday.
examples.zh: 請在星期五之前填完表格。

examples.en: The puzzle is complete now.
examples.zh: 這個拼圖現在完成了。

examples.en: She completed her homework early.
examples.zh: 她很早就完成了作業。

entries.definition: （形）完整的；完成的；（動）完成；結束。

explains.en: It means finished with nothing missing. A puzzle may have every piece. A person can finish a task.
A full set includes all parts. A student may finish homework. The word can also mean filling in a form.
This word means done or whole. A person may finish a meal. A book may have all its pages.

examples.en: The machine has a complex design.
examples.zh: 這台機器的設計很複雜。

examples.en: The problem was too complex for a quick answer.
examples.zh: 這個問題太複雜，無法快速回答。

examples.en: The story has a complex character.
examples.zh: 這個故事有一個複雜的人物。

entries.definition: （形）複雜的；難懂的；（名）建築群；情結

explains.en: It means having many parts that are hard to understand. A machine may have many small pieces. A math idea can be hard.
A story may have many people and events. A person may need time to understand it. This word means not simple.
A large system can have many connected parts. A puzzle may be difficult. A person may explain it in smaller steps.

examples.en: The nurse asked about my health concern.
examples.zh: 護士詢問了我對健康的擔憂。

examples.en: Her main concern was the children.
examples.zh: 她最關心的是孩子們。

examples.en: Please contact us if you have a concern.
examples.zh: 如有疑慮請與我們聯絡。

entries.definition: （名）擔心；關切；事情；（動）使擔心；涉及

explains.en: It means a worry or matter that needs care. A parent may think about a child’s health. A person can ask about a friend.
A worker may have a question about safety. A kind person may show care for others. The word can mean a problem.
This word names a worry or important matter. A person may care about the environment. It can also mean being worried.

examples.en: We concluded the team presentation with a lively Q&A session.
examples.zh: 我們以熱絡的問答環節為團隊簡報劃下句點。

examples.en: Scientists concluded that volcanic activity caused the ancient climate disruption.
examples.zh: 地質科學家經過縝密研究後得出結論，判定古代氣候巨變係由劇烈火山活動所致。

examples.en: The international trade agreement concluded after eighteen months of talks.
examples.zh: 經過長達整整十八個月的艱辛談判，雙方最終順利敲定締結了這項國際經貿協定。

explains.en: It means finishing a talk or piece of writing. A person may decide what is true after hearing facts. The word can also mean bringing an event to an end.
A report may end with a final idea. A person can decide an answer. The action means finishing or deciding.
This word names the end result of thought. A speaker may wrap up a talk. A person may decide something from facts.

examples.en: The car is in good condition.
examples.zh: 這輛車狀況良好。

examples.en: You can swim if the weather conditions are safe.
examples.zh: 如果天氣狀況安全，你可以游泳。

examples.en: She has a heart condition.
examples.zh: 她有心臟方面的疾病。

entries.definition: （名）狀況；條件；疾病；（動）訓練；使適應

explains.en: It means how something is or the state it is in. A doctor may ask about health. A road can be icy.
A person may live in a hard state of life. A contract can have rules. This word can also mean a requirement.
A room may be in good shape. A person’s health can be checked. The word can mean a state or rule.

examples.en: Practice speaking daily so you feel confident during the interview.
examples.zh: 每天多加練習口語，面試時就能充滿自信。

examples.en: The star basketball player felt confident stepping up to shoot the winning free throw.
examples.zh: 明星主力籃球員充滿信心地站上罰球線，準備投出絕殺致勝的關鍵關鍵罰球。

examples.en: She walked onto the performance stage with a calm, poised, and confident posture.
examples.zh: 她邁著優雅從容且充滿強大自信的堅定步伐，緩緩走上萬眾矚目的表演舞台。

examples.en: Wearing clothes that fit comfortably makes you radiate calm, confident energy.
examples.zh: 穿著剪裁合身舒服、真正契合個人身型的衣服，能讓您在任何場合皆散發出沉穩自信的光芒。

examples.en: She felt completely confident walking into the presentation in her sharp navy suit.
examples.zh: 身著一襲剪裁銳利的深藍色西裝套裝踏入演講簡報會場，讓她內心感到篤定且充滿自信。

examples.en: A genuine warm smile is the most powerful accessory for a truly confident appearance.
examples.zh: 一抹發自內心真誠溫暖的自信微笑，是任何華麗裝扮中最能展現從容大器氣場的無敵配件。

entries.definition: 有信心的；自信的；自信從容的

explains.en: It means believing in one’s ability. A student may speak clearly during a talk. A person can feel sure about a choice.
A runner may feel ready before a race. A person may trust their own skill. This word describes feeling certain.
This word means having trust in oneself. A person may try a new task. It can also mean feeling sure about a fact.

examples.en: Open communication helps resolve family conflicts peacefully.
examples.zh: 坦誠溝通有助於和平化解家庭內部的分歧衝突。

examples.en: Unresolved conflicts in the workplace can damage overall team productivity.
examples.zh: 職場內部懸而未決的人際摩擦與矛盾，將會重創整體團隊的產能效率。

examples.en: Her busy work schedule unfortunately conflicted with her son's championship game.
examples.zh: 她緊湊忙碌的加班出差日程，非常遺憾地與兒子棒球總決賽的登場時間相撞期。

explains.en: It means a serious disagreement. Two people may want different things. A story can have a fight.
A family may argue about a plan. Two rules can oppose each other. This word means a clash.
This word names a fight or disagreement. A team may have opposing goals. A story may have a problem between characters.

examples.en: Congratulations on your new job!
examples.zh: 恭喜你找到新工作！

examples.en: We sent congratulations to the winners.
examples.zh: 我們向得獎者致上祝賀。

examples.en: Congratulations! You passed the test.
examples.zh: 恭喜你通過考試。

explains.en: People say these kind words after someone succeeds. A friend may get a new job. A family may celebrate.
A person may say “well done” after a win. The words show happiness for someone. They are often said at a party.
This expression shares joy about another person’s success. A student may pass an exam. Friends may cheer.

examples.en: Walking barefoot through damp paddy mud restores a healing emotional connection with Mother Nature.
examples.zh: 脫掉鞋襪、赤腳踩入溫潤鬆軟的水田泥土中，在每個人心頭喚起一股與大地之母久違的深沉心靈連結。

examples.en: The newly opened high-speed rail branch provides a seamless direct transit connection to the international airport.
examples.zh: 新近通車啟用的高鐵聯外延伸支線，為旅客提供通往國際機場航廈無縫轉乘的便捷交通接駁連線。

examples.en: Scientists discovered a fascinating biochemical connection between gut microbiome balance and brain mood regulation.
examples.zh: 醫學科學家驚喜證實了腸道益生菌微生態菌相平衡與大腦情緒調控中樞之間，存在著不可思議的腦腸軸雙向連結。

examples.en: Beyond transporting passengers, high-speed rail weaves an enduring connection of hearts, memories, and shared futures.
examples.zh: 除了運送千萬旅客，高速鐵路更拉近了城鄉時空距離，編織出凝聚全島情感與繁榮的「永恆美好連結」（Connection）。

examples.en: The international flight landed on schedule, allowing travelers ample time to catch their connecting flight.
examples.zh: 跨洋國際長途班機準點降落國際機場，讓轉機旅客有充裕從容的時間搭上前往下一座城市的銜接班機。

examples.en: A strong emotional connection between parents and children builds resilience against adolescent peer pressure.
examples.zh: 父母與孩子之間建立起深厚穩固的親情信任連結，能賦予青少年強大的心靈韌性以抵禦同儕盲從壓力。

examples.en: Language creates lasting human connections that turn strangers across the globe into lifelong brothers and sisters.
examples.zh: 語言能締造出跨越國界的「真摯人際連結」（Connections），將千里之外的陌生人化為一生的摯友。

examples.en: Attending overseas academic conferences enabled her to build valuable professional connections.
examples.zh: 赴海外參與重量級國際學術研討會，讓她建立起了許多珍貴且深遠的專業學術人脈網絡。

examples.en: High-speed broadband connections allow remote professionals to collaborate seamlessly from any location.
examples.zh: 高速穩定的寬頻網路連線，使遠距工作者無論身處世界何地都能順暢無阻地展開跨國協作。

entries.definition: 赤腳踩在溫暖泥土上的深刻連結；縮短城鄉距離、凝聚人情與繁榮的永恆連結；連結；結交跨越國界、真摯溫暖之終身國際情誼

explains.en: It means a link between people or things. A road joins two towns. A phone call can help friends stay close.
A train may let passengers change to another line. Two ideas can be linked. The word can mean a relationship.
This word names a link or relationship. A computer can join to a network. People may form friendships.

examples.en: Please consider all options before making a final career choice.
examples.zh: 作出最終職業抉擇前請考慮所有可行選項。

examples.en: Have you ever considered studying abroad in an English-speaking country?
examples.zh: 你是否曾經認真考慮過前往英語系國家展開海外留學深造的計畫呢？

examples.en: Many colleagues consider him to be the most patient mentor in the company.
examples.zh: 公司許多同仁一致認為他是整家企業中最具耐心、提攜後進最用心的好前輩。

explains.en: It means thinking carefully before making a choice. A person may look at two options. The word can also mean believing something.
A family may think about where to travel. A student can look at the facts. This action takes time.
This word means thinking about an idea. A person may regard someone as a friend. It can help make a choice.

examples.en: Thank you for your kind consideration of my job application.
examples.zh: 感謝您撥冗考慮我的求職應徵申請。

examples.en: Commuter safety must be the foremost consideration in railway route engineering.
examples.zh: 通勤旅客的搭乘安全，必須是整條鐵路軌道路線工程規劃中最首要的考量因素。

examples.en: Showing thoughtful consideration for the elderly earns genuine societal respect.
examples.zh: 處處為年長者著想並展現細膩體貼的關懷之情，能贏得整個社會發自內心的敬意。

explains.en: It means careful thought before acting. A kind person thinks about others. A choice may take time.
A person may pause before deciding. A teacher can show care for a student. The word means thought or kindness.
This word describes thinking something through. A person may show care for a neighbor. A decision may need thought.

examples.en: Feel free to contact me if you have further questions.
examples.zh: 若有任何進一步問題，歡迎隨時與我聯繫。

examples.en: Keep this emergency contact number inside your wallet.
examples.zh: 請把這個緊急聯絡人電話放在皮夾裡面。

examples.en: Do you prefer contact lenses or glasses for reading?
examples.zh: 閱讀時你偏好戴隱形眼鏡還是普通眼鏡？

examples.en: Hardened copper-tin contact wires withstand friction and prevent arcing under extreme electrical currents.
examples.zh: 高強度耐磨銅錫合金「接觸導線」（Contact Wire），能耐受集電弓高速滑動摩擦並防止電弧灼傷。

examples.en: Please contact our local emergency hotline immediately if you observe water pipe leakage on your street.
examples.zh: 若您發現住家門前馬路有任何自來水暗管漏水冒水現象，請立刻撥打二十四小時通報專線聯絡公務單位。

examples.en: The diplomat maintained secret informal contact with foreign representatives during tense negotiations.
examples.zh: 在情勢高度緊繃的談判期間，這位資深外交特使始終與外國談判代表保持著秘密非正式接觸。

entries.definition: 聯繫；聯絡；聯絡人；承受集電弓碳刷高溫滑動摩擦之高導電合金接觸線；接觸

explains.en: It means speaking or writing to someone. A person may call a friend. The word can also mean a person’s details.
A worker may email a customer. A person can touch a hot surface. A name and phone number can be used to reach someone.
This word means getting in touch. It can also name a person who can be called. Two surfaces may meet.

examples.en: The box contains old photos.
examples.zh: 盒子裡裝著舊照片。

examples.en: This drink contains no sugar.
examples.zh: 這種飲料不含糖。

examples.en: The bag contained several books.
examples.zh: 包包裡有幾本書。

explains.en: It means having something inside. A box may hold toys. A drink can have sugar.
A bag may have books inside. A list can include many names. The word means to hold or include.
This action keeps something within. A bottle can hold water. A story may include a lesson.

examples.en: Please continue reading the next page.
examples.zh: 請繼續讀下一頁。

examples.en: The rain continued through the night.
examples.zh: 雨整晚都沒停。

examples.en: She continued her work after lunch.
examples.zh: 她午餐後繼續工作。

explains.en: It means going on after a pause. A person may keep working. A story can go on.
A game may go on after a break. A child can keep reading. This word means not stopping.
This action means carrying on. A person may keep learning. It can describe something lasting longer.

examples.en: Both parties carefully reviewed and signed the contract.
examples.zh: 雙方仔細審閱並共同簽署了合約。

examples.en: The employment contract outlines your working hours and salary.
examples.zh: 聘僱合約詳細列出了你的工時與薪資福利。

examples.en: Metals contract when they are cooled down.
examples.zh: 金屬在冷卻時會收縮。

examples.en: Beverage companies sign long-term contract farming agreements with organic tea plantations.
examples.zh: 知名連鎖精品茶飲集團與南投名間有機茶園簽署長期契作收購合約，保障茶農穩定收益。

examples.en: Review the legal terms of the lease contract carefully before signing and paying the deposit.
examples.zh: 在正式提筆簽名並轉帳支付昂貴押金之前，務必逐字逐條審閱房屋租賃契約合約的法律條款。

examples.en: Muscle fibers naturally contract and shorten to generate physical force during weight lifting.
examples.zh: 在重訓推舉槓鈴施力做功的過程中，人體骨骼肌纖維會自然而然地緊繃收縮以產生強大力量。

examples.en: Exploring companies hold official fifteen-year exploration contracts to study geology and biology.
examples.zh: 各國研究團隊持有正式的十五年「深海探勘合約」（Contract），全面調查海床地質結構與底棲生物。

examples.en: Legal advisors reviewed every clause of the commercial lease contract before signing the agreement.
examples.zh: 專業法務顧問在雙方正式落款簽署前，逐條審查了該商業店面租賃契約的每一個法條細節。

examples.en: Metals expand slightly when heated and contract when exposed to freezing cold temperatures.
examples.zh: 大多數金屬物質在受熱時會微幅膨脹，而一旦暴露於極度嚴寒的低溫中則會產生冷縮現象。

entries.definition: 合約；契約；收縮；契作合約；契約耕作；簽約；各國探勘團隊簽署之深海礦產十五年探勘合約

explains.en: A legal paper records an agreement. A worker may agree to build a house. It can also mean becoming smaller.
Two people may sign a paper about a job. A company can hire a person for a set time. A muscle may get shorter.
This written agreement explains duties. People may sign before work begins. As a verb, it can mean getting an illness.

examples.en: Automatic train control constantly monitors train separation to maintain safe braking distance buffers.
examples.zh: 「自動列車控制系統」（Automatic Train Control ATC），隨時計算前後列車間距以維繫絕對安全煞車防線。

examples.en: The experienced captain maintained calm command and full control of the ship during the typhoon storm.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的資深船長在遭遇強颱狂浪襲擊的危急關頭，沉著冷靜指揮並精準掌控全船各項航行操舵。

examples.en: Strict environmental regulations aim to control harmful carbon emission levels from heavy industrial plants.
examples.zh: 國家制定極嚴苛的空污環保法令法規，旨在鐵腕嚴密管控石化鋼鐵等重工業重污染排放源的碳排總量。

entries.definition: 數位自動列車控制系統 (防止超速與追撞事故)；控制

explains.en: It means having power over a machine or situation. A driver can use a wheel. A person may manage their feelings.
A teacher may guide a class. A remote can change a TV. This word can mean directing or managing.
This word means guiding an action. A driver may steer a car. A person may keep a situation in order.

examples.en: We had a long conversation about school.
examples.zh: 我們聊了很久學校的事。

examples.en: The conversation was friendly and fun.
examples.zh: 這段談話友善又有趣。

examples.en: He started a conversation with his neighbor.
examples.zh: 他和鄰居開始交談。

explains.en: Two people share ideas by speaking. Friends may do this at lunch. The word can mean a friendly talk.
A family may speak about a trip. A person can ask questions. This kind of talk can last a long time.
This word names an exchange of ideas. People may talk about work or fun. A phone call can include one.

examples.en: Sweet corn soup is popular with kids and adults alike.
examples.zh: 甜玉米濃湯深受大人小孩喜愛。

examples.en: Grilled corn brushed with savory barbecue sauce smells heavenly.
examples.zh: 塗上鹹香烤肉醬的烤玉米聞起來令人垂涎。

examples.en: Farmers cultivate fields of yellow corn throughout the fertile valley.
examples.zh: 農民在肥沃的山谷各處種植了大片黃金玉米田。

explains.en: This tall plant has yellow kernels. People cook and eat them. A farm may grow it in a field.
A person may eat this food on the cob. It can be ground into flour. Animals may eat its seeds.
This crop grows on long stalks. The seeds can be yellow or white. A cook may add them to soup.

examples.en: They drove through the countryside after lunch.
examples.zh: 他們午餐後開車穿過鄉間。

examples.en: The countryside is quiet at night.
examples.zh: 鄉間夜晚很安靜。

examples.en: She grew up in the countryside.
examples.zh: 她在鄉下長大。

explains.en: It means land outside cities and towns. Farms and fields are often found there. People may live in small villages.
A person may drive past fields and forests. The area is quiet and has fewer buildings. This word describes country land.
This place has farms, hills, and small homes. It is far from busy city streets. People may enjoy its quiet.

examples.en: The newly married couple traveled to Japan for honeymoon.
examples.zh: 這對新婚夫婦去日本度蜜月。

examples.en: We plan to stay in Taitung for a couple of days to relax by the ocean.
examples.zh: 我們打算在台東待上幾天，在海邊放鬆享受愜意時光。

examples.en: An elderly couple walked hand in hand along the peaceful park pathway.
examples.zh: 一對年邁的恩愛夫妻手牽著手漫步在幽靜的公園小徑上。

explains.en: Two people or things can form this number. A married pair may share a home. It can also mean a few.
A man and woman may be a pair. A person can join two objects together. The word can also mean a small number.
This word means two that belong together. It may describe a husband and wife. As an action, it means connecting two things.

examples.en: It takes courage to admit your mistakes and make things right.
examples.zh: 勇於承認自身錯誤並設法彌補需要莫大的勇氣。

examples.en: She found the courage to speak publicly in front of hundreds of international delegates.
examples.zh: 她鼓起非凡的勇氣，從容自若地站上數百位國際各國代表面前公開發表演講。

examples.en: True courage is not the total absence of fear, but taking action in spite of it.
examples.zh: 真正的勇氣絕非毫無恐懼害怕，而是在內心深感敬畏的情況下依然昂首前行。

examples.en: Standing up against injustice demands immense moral courage in the face of public disapproval.
examples.zh: 在眾人盲從退縮的艱難時刻挺身捍衛公平正義，需要內心具備無比強大的「道德勇氣」（Moral Courage）。

examples.en: Firefighters displayed breathtaking physical courage as they charged into the burning warehouse to rescue victims.
examples.zh: 消防隊員在面對滾滾濃煙與熊熊烈火的危急關頭，展現出令人肅然起敬的無畏肉體勇氣，毅然衝入火場搜救受困民眾。

examples.en: Admitting your own mistakes openly to your team takes emotional maturity and genuine personal courage.
examples.zh: 勇於在團隊同仁面前坦然承認自己的決策失誤與盲點，需要極高的心智成熟度與令人信服的個人真誠勇氣。

examples.en: Venturing into the deep celestial wilderness demands immense technical ingenuity and collective human courage.
examples.zh: 勇敢航向深邃無垠的星海荒野，需要全人類無窮的科學智慧與世代相傳的「探索勇氣」（Courage）。

examples.en: It takes moral courage to stand up against unfair workplace practices and advocate for vulnerable colleagues.
examples.zh: 在面對職場不合理的不公不義與權勢壓迫時，敢於挺身而出為弱勢同仁仗義執言，需要極大的道德勇氣。

examples.en: The injured firefighter showed tremendous courage by carrying the child through the smoke-filled stairwell.
examples.zh: 負傷的打火弟兄展現出令人動容的無畏勇氣，在濃煙瀰漫的炙熱樓梯間奮勇背負著幼童脫離火海。

entries.definition: 勇氣；膽量；勇於捍衛正義的道德勇氣；勇於航向深邃宇宙未知荒野之無畏勇氣與探索精神

explains.en: It means being brave when something feels scary. A person may speak up for a friend. A firefighter can enter a dangerous place.
A child may try a hard task despite fear. A hero may protect others. This word names bravery.
This feeling helps people face danger. A person may tell the truth even when afraid. It can help someone do what is right.

examples.en: We booked a wooden badminton court for two hours.
examples.zh: 我們預訂了兩個小時的木地板羽球場。

examples.en: The tennis players stepped onto the clay court under bright sunshine.
examples.zh: 網球選手們在燦爛陽光下步入了紅土球場。

examples.en: The suspect appeared before the district court judge this morning.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人今天上午在地區法院法官面前出庭應訊。

examples.en: The dispute was resolved peacefully inside the district court.
examples.zh: 這起糾紛在地方法院法庭內獲得了和平調解。

examples.en: Students booked an indoor basketball court for their weekend tournament.
examples.zh: 學生們預約了一處室內籃球場，作為舉辦週末班際盃球賽的場地。

examples.en: Witnesses must swear to speak the truth before giving testimony in court.
examples.zh: 證人在法庭上作證之前，必須莊嚴宣誓所言皆為毫無虛假的事實真相。

examples.en: The dispute was resolved through judicial settlement inside the Taipei District Court.
examples.zh: 該起民事爭議最終在台北地方法院法庭內透過司法和解圓滿落幕。

examples.en: The witness swore an oath on the Bible to tell nothing but the truth in open court.
examples.zh: 出庭證人在法官面前將手輕按於聖經上莊嚴宣誓，保證在公開法庭上所陳述之證言絕無虛言。

examples.en: After playing tennis on the clay court, the athletes rested at the clubhouse.
examples.zh: 在紅土球場上揮汗如雨打完一場激烈的網球單打比賽後，運動員們紛紛移步至俱樂部會館內放鬆休息。

entries.definition: 球場（網球、籃球）；法庭；法院；球場

explains.en: A judge works in this place. A lawyer may speak there. It can also mean an area for sports.
A tennis match happens on a marked area. A legal case may be heard in a building. People may watch a game or trial there.
This word can name a place where legal cases are heard. It can also be an outdoor area for basketball or tennis. A judge may sit in a room there.

examples.en: The cowboy rode his horse across the ranch.
examples.zh: 牛仔騎馬穿過牧場。

examples.en: A cowboy wore a wide hat.
examples.zh: 牛仔戴著一頂寬帽子。

examples.en: The cowboy helped move the cattle.
examples.zh: 牛仔幫忙趕牛群。

explains.en: A man who rides a horse on a ranch may have this job. He may care for cattle. A hat often appears in stories about him.
This person works with horses and cows. A ranch may hire him. He may ride across open land.
A western story may have this horse rider. He can move a herd of cattle. Boots and a hat are common clothes.

examples.en: She drew a flower with a red crayon.
examples.zh: 她用紅色蠟筆畫了一朵花。

examples.en: The child colored the picture with crayons.
examples.zh: 孩子用蠟筆替圖畫上色。

examples.en: My crayon broke in half.
examples.zh: 我的蠟筆斷成兩半。

explains.en: A child draws with this colored stick. It leaves wax on paper. Many colors can be kept in a box.
A teacher may give each student a box of these. They are used to color pictures. A paper wrapper covers each one.
This art item is made of wax and color. A child can use it to draw. It is softer than a pencil.

examples.en: Would you like cream in your coffee?
examples.zh: 你想在咖啡裡加奶油嗎？

examples.en: The cream cake was soft and sweet.
examples.zh: 奶油蛋糕柔軟又香甜。

examples.en: She put cream on the cut.
examples.zh: 她在傷口上塗了乳膏。

entries.definition: 奶油；鮮奶油；乳霜；乳脂色的

explains.en: This is the thick, fatty part of milk. It can rise to the top before milk is mixed. Cooks add it to sauces and soups.
This dairy food can be whipped until light and fluffy. People put it on cakes or fruit. It often tastes rich and smooth.
This can also mean a thick product spread on skin. It may keep skin soft. Some kinds contain medicine for a skin problem.

examples.en: The children created a new game.
examples.zh: 孩子們創造了一種新遊戲。

examples.en: She creates beautiful paintings.
examples.zh: 她創作美麗的畫作。

examples.en: We created a plan for the trip.
examples.zh: 我們為旅行制定了計畫。

explains.en: It means making something new. A person may make a story. An artist can make a picture.
A builder may make a house. A cook can make a new dish. This action brings an idea into life.
This word means bringing something into being. A team can make a new plan. A person may make a piece of art.

examples.en: Taiwan is globally recognized for its remarkably low crime rate.
examples.zh: 台灣以其極低的犯罪率在國際上享有極佳治安美譽。

examples.en: Installing security cameras along alleyways helps deter burglary and street crime.
examples.zh: 在巷弄周邊裝設監控攝影機有助於震懾竊盜與各類街頭犯罪行為。

examples.en: Financial cyber crime has become a serious threat requiring specialized digital forensics.
examples.zh: 金融網路犯罪日益猖獗，已成為亟需專業數位鑑識技術打擊的嚴重威脅。

explains.en: An action that breaks a law is this. A police officer may investigate it. A court can decide what happened.
Taking something that belongs to another person is against the law. A person may be punished. This word means an illegal act.
A law may say an action is illegal. The police may look for the person who did it. A judge may hear the case.

examples.en: The country faced a serious crisis.
examples.zh: 這個國家面臨嚴重危機。

examples.en: The crisis ended after the storm passed.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後危機解除了。

examples.en: They worked together during the crisis.
examples.zh: 危機期間他們一起合作。

explains.en: It is a time of great trouble or danger. A family may need help after a fire. Leaders may act quickly.
A country may face a serious problem. Hospitals can be busy during one. People work together to help.
This word describes a hard moment that needs quick action. A storm may cause one. A team can plan how to respond.

examples.en: A crow sat on the fence.
examples.zh: 一隻烏鴉停在柵欄上。

examples.en: The crow flew over the field.
examples.zh: 烏鴉飛過田野。

examples.en: We heard a crow calling in the tree.
examples.zh: 我們聽見樹上的烏鴉在叫。

explains.en: A large black bird makes a loud call. It is common on farms and in stories. It can have shiny feathers.
This bird may sit on a fence. It makes a sound in the morning. It can eat seeds and insects.
A black bird with a strong beak may live near fields. It can fly in a group. People may hear its loud call.

examples.en: A large crowd gathered to watch the live concert.
examples.zh: 一大群民眾聚集觀賞現場演唱會。

examples.en: Festive holiday crowds poured into the bustling department stores for sales.
examples.zh: 洋溢節慶歡樂的人潮湧入熱鬧的百貨公司搶購特賣商品。

examples.en: Avoid walking alone into chaotic and uncontrolled street crowds.
examples.zh: 避免隻身走入混亂且缺乏管制的街頭人群之中。

explains.en: Many people in one place form this group. It may gather to watch a game. A person can move into it.
A street may be full of people. A group may gather near a stage. This word can also mean moving close together.
This word means a large group of people. A person may move through it carefully. It can form at a busy event.

examples.en: Tainan has a rich historical and cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 台南擁有豐富深厚的歷史與文化底蘊。

examples.en: Studying overseas helps students bridge delicate cultural differences with ease.
examples.zh: 赴海外留學有助於學生輕鬆跨越細微微妙的文化差異。

examples.en: The cultural center holds monthly exhibitions featuring contemporary local artists.
examples.zh: 文化中心每月都會舉辦展覽，展示當代本土藝術家的精彩傑作。

explains.en: It relates to the arts, beliefs, and ways of life of a group. A festival may share music and food. People may learn about another nation.
A dance or meal can show a group’s traditions. Museums may teach about history. This word describes those human ways.
This word describes something linked to customs and art. A city may have many traditions. A book can explore how people live.

examples.en: Night markets are an essential part of Taiwanese culinary culture.
examples.zh: 夜市是台灣飲食文化中不可或缺的重要一環。

examples.en: Reading foreign literature introduces you to unique ways of life and culture.
examples.zh: 閱讀外國文學作品能引領你認識獨特的生活型態與多元文化。

examples.en: Corporate culture at this tech firm emphasizes teamwork and open communication.
examples.zh: 這家科技公司的企業文化十分強調團隊協作與開放暢通的溝通。

explains.en: It means the arts, customs, and beliefs of a group. People may share food and music. It can also mean good manners.
A society has stories, clothes, and celebrations. A person can learn about another group. This word describes shared ways of life.
People pass traditions from parents to children. A museum may show old art. This word can also describe a person’s learning and manners.

examples.en: The doctor found a cure for the infection.
examples.zh: 醫生找到了感染症的治療方法。

examples.en: Rest helped cure his cold.
examples.zh: 休息幫助他治好了感冒。

examples.en: There is no easy cure for this illness.
examples.zh: 這種疾病沒有簡單的治療方法。

entries.definition: （名）治療方法；療法；（動）治癒；治療；矯正

explains.en: It means making an illness go away. Medicine may help a person feel better. Rest can help too.
A doctor may give care for a sick person. Some treatments help a wound close. The word can also mean a solution.
This action makes a sickness or problem better. A medicine may help. A person may recover after rest.

examples.en: The curious child opened the box.
examples.zh: 好奇的孩子打開了盒子。

examples.en: I am curious about the old house.
examples.zh: 我很好奇那棟老房子。

examples.en: She asked a curious question.
examples.zh: 她問了一個令人好奇的問題。

entries.definition: 好奇的；想知道的；稀奇古怪的。

explains.en: It means wanting to learn more. A child may ask many questions. A cat may look at a new box.
A person may wonder about a sound. Someone who likes learning has this quality. It can describe a strong desire to know.
This word describes someone who wants to find out. A student may ask how a machine works. A new place may draw attention.

examples.en: Skilled scuba divers ride strong ocean currents during thrilling deep drift dives.
examples.zh: 經驗老道的高階水肺潛水員在澎湖七美海域順著強勁洋流前進，享受御風而行般的「放流潛水」。

examples.en: Always deploy an orange surface marker buoy before ascending in an unpredictable tidal current.
examples.zh: 在變幻莫測的潮汐強流中準備上升水面時，第一件事務必先打起顯眼亮橘色的水面浮標（SMB）。

examples.en: Rip currents can pull unwary swimmers away from the beach at speeds surpassing Olympic athletes.
examples.zh: 海邊無聲無息的離岸流（裂流）能在數秒內將戲水遊客迅速拖往外海，其流速甚至超越奧運游泳健將。

explains.en: It means happening now. A river may flow in one direction. Electricity can move through a wire.
A newspaper may report the latest facts. Water can flow in a stream. This word can mean the present or a flow.
This word describes something happening at this time. It can also name moving water or air. A river may have a strong flow.

examples.en: Open the curtains to let the warm sunlight in.
examples.zh: 拉開窗簾讓溫暖的陽光照進來。

examples.en: Heavy blackout curtains block out blinding morning glare effectively.
examples.zh: 厚實的遮光窗簾能有效阻擋早晨刺眼的陽光。

examples.en: The stage curtain rose slowly as the orchestra began the overture.
examples.zh: 隨著管弦樂團奏響序曲，舞台大幕緩緩升起。

examples.en: Deploying a dual-layer bubble curtain creates acoustic shielding that protects endangered dolphins from noise.
examples.zh: 在打樁點四周環繞佈設雙層氣泡幕，形成微氣泡隔音牆保護珍稀白海豚免受噪音干擾。

examples.en: High-output air compressors pump millions of tiny air bubbles through perforated hoses to form the curtain.
examples.zh: 甲板上的大功率空壓機透過海底穿孔微孔軟管，每分鐘泵入數百萬個細密微氣泡以築起降噪氣幕簾。

examples.en: Sonar measurements proved that the bubble curtain reduced underwater impact noise levels by over fifteen decibels.
examples.zh: 水下聲納監測數據鐵證，雙層氣泡幕技術成功將水下打樁的衝擊聲壓級大幅消減了超過十五分貝。

examples.en: Motorized acoustic wool curtains deploy from hidden ceiling pockets to adjust reverberation for amplified jazz concerts.
examples.zh: 隱藏式「電動羊毛吸音布幕」（Acoustic Curtains），在舉辦爵士與流行電聲音樂會時迅速展開以縮短殘響。

examples.en: She drew the thick velvet curtains shut to block out bright morning streetlights and sleep in late.
examples.zh: 她隨手拉緊厚實遮光的天鵝絨窗簾以完全隔絕清晨刺眼的街燈與晨曦，安心享受週末難得的補眠時光。

examples.en: The stage crew waited backstage for the heavy red velvet theater curtains to part before the play commenced.
examples.zh: 舞台後台全體工作人員屏息待命，靜候沉重華麗的大紅天鵝絨戲劇布幕徐徐拉開，宣告年度大戲正式開演。

entries.definition: 窗簾；幕簾；雙層氣泡幕阻隔打樁水下噪音 (護鯨)；隱藏於木格柵後方之電動可伸縮調音吸音布幕

explains.en: A piece of cloth can cover a window. A theater has one that opens before a show. It can give privacy.
A person may pull it across a window. Heavy fabric can block light. A stage has one that hides actors.
This cloth hangs in front of glass. It may be opened in the morning. A theater uses a large one.

examples.en: Eating round tangyuan during Dongzhi (Winter Solstice) is an ancient custom.
examples.zh: 冬至吃象徵圓滿的湯圓是一項古老的民俗。

examples.en: International travelers should respect local social customs when visiting temples.
examples.zh: 跨國旅行者在造訪寺廟宮觀時應當尊重當地的民俗習慣。

examples.en: Giving newlyweds pairs of chopsticks is an auspicious wedding custom.
examples.zh: 贈送成雙成對的筷子給新人是寓意早生貴子的吉祥婚俗。

explains.en: It is a usual way people do something. A family may have a special meal on holidays. Different places have different traditions.
A group may follow a long-held practice. A store may make clothes for one person. This word can mean a personal habit.
People may keep a tradition for many years. A person may have a regular habit. A business can make goods for one buyer.

examples.en: Convenience stores treat every customer with courtesy.
examples.zh: 便利商店對待每位顧客都彬彬有禮。

examples.en: Understanding customer feedback is crucial for improving product quality.
examples.zh: 深入理解顧客的反饋意見對於改善並提升產品質量至關重要。

examples.en: Loyal customers enjoy special VIP privileges and seasonal member discounts.
examples.zh: 忠實顧客享有專屬的貴賓尊榮禮遇與當季會員特惠折扣。

explains.en: A person who buys goods from a store has this role. A worker may help them. They may pay at a counter.
A shop welcomes people who buy things. A person may ask for help finding an item. The shop wants this person to return.
This person pays for goods or services. A restaurant may bring food to them. A business may try to help them.

examples.en: Streamlining manufacturing cycle times allows urgent wafer lots to ship to customers weeks ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 不斷優化縮短晶圓生產製造週期（Cycle Time），讓急件晶圓能比原定交期提前數週空運交付給客戶。

examples.en: The four seasons follow a predictable annual cycle governed by Earth's tilted axial rotation.
examples.zh: 春夏秋冬四季在地球傾斜地軸圍繞太陽公轉規律下周而復始運轉，構築出井然有序的大自然年度生命循環。

examples.en: Economists warn that the current macroeconomic business cycle is entering a prolonged cooling period.
examples.zh: 國際宏觀經濟學家提出前瞻預警，指出當前全球總體經濟商業週期正在跨入長達數季的通膨降溫與放緩階段。

examples.en: The Organic Rankine Cycle evaporates an organic liquid with a boiling point much lower than water.
examples.zh: 「有機朗肯循環」（Organic Rankine Cycle ORC），利用沸點遠低於水的環保有機工質在低溫下蒸發發電。

examples.en: The natural water cycle involves evaporation from oceans, cloud condensation, and rainfall return to rivers.
examples.zh: 大自然奧妙的水循環系統涵蓋了海水受熱蒸發上升、雲層凝結致雨以及雨水匯入河流奔流入海的永恆循環。

examples.en: Fitness enthusiasts cycle along dedicated riverside bike paths early every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 自行車運動愛好者每逢週六清晨便會整裝出發，沿著規劃完善的水岸專用自行車道迎風暢快騎乘腳踏車。

examples.en: The Design-Build-Test-Learn cycle integrates AI algorithms to optimize microbial pathways iteratively.
examples.zh: 「DBTL 迭代閉環」（DBTL Cycle），結合 AI 大數據模型，以極快速度持續最佳化微生物代謝途徑。

examples.en: Agricultural communities organize planting and harvesting around the predictable annual seasonal weather cycle.
examples.zh: 傳統農業聚落依循大自然周而復始、規律運行的年度節氣週期，安排播種與豐收各項農事。

examples.en: He decided to cycle to work along the riverside bike path every morning to stay healthy and active.
examples.zh: 為了維持強健體魄，他決定每個工作日早晨皆沿著風景優美的河濱自行車道騎單車通勤上班。

entries.definition: 晶圓製造三至四個月生產週期；循環；ORC 有機朗肯雙循環低沸點工質發電循環；設計-建造-測試-學習 (DBTL 合成生物學迭代閉環)；週期

explains.en: A bike has wheels that move around again and again. A year has seasons in a repeating pattern. The word can mean riding a bicycle.
A set of events may happen in the same order repeatedly. A person can ride a bike around town. A machine may repeat its steps.
This word can mean riding a bicycle. It can also name a repeating series. A life process may begin again after it ends.

examples.en: The shop publishes a daily list of prices.
examples.zh: 商店每天公布價格清單。

examples.en: He takes a daily walk after dinner.
examples.zh: 他每天晚餐後散步。

examples.en: This is my daily routine.
examples.zh: 這是我每天的例行活動。

entries.definition: （形）每日的；日常的；（副）每天；（名）日報

explains.en: It means happening each day. A person may read the news every morning. A paper may come out each day.
A routine can happen every day. A worker may record events in a journal. This word can mean something done each day.
This word describes a regular day-by-day event. A newspaper may have this schedule. A person can take medicine each day.

examples.en: The storm damaged the roof.
examples.zh: 暴風雨損壞了屋頂。

examples.en: The car had damage on its side.
examples.zh: 這輛車側面有損傷。

examples.en: Too much sun can damage your skin.
examples.zh: 太多陽光可能會傷害皮膚。

explains.en: It means harm to a person or object. A storm may break a roof. A car can hit a fence.
A broken toy has this. A person may ask for money after something is harmed. The word can mean harm or loss.
This word names harm caused by an event. Heavy rain may hurt crops. A worker can repair a broken item.

examples.en: The dancer moved gracefully across the stage.
examples.zh: 舞者優雅地在舞台上移動。

examples.en: A dancer needs to practice often.
examples.zh: 舞者需要經常練習。

examples.en: The young dancer wore a blue costume.
examples.zh: 年輕舞者穿著藍色服裝。

explains.en: A person who moves to music has this role. They may perform on a stage. A group can practice together.
This performer uses body movements with music. A show may have several people. The person may train for years.
A child may take lessons for this art. The person can perform ballet or hip hop. Music helps guide the movements.

examples.en: The warning sign showed danger ahead.
examples.zh: 警告標誌顯示前方有危險。

examples.en: Fire can be a danger to the forest.
examples.zh: 火災可能對森林造成危險。

examples.en: The dog was in danger near the road.
examples.zh: 那隻狗在路邊處於危險中。

entries.definition: 危險；危害；危險人物或事物。

explains.en: It means the chance of harm. A steep road may have this. A person should be careful near fire.
A storm can put people in harm’s way. A warning may tell people to leave. This word means possible harm.
This word describes something that may hurt people. A wet floor can cause a fall. A sign may warn about it.

examples.en: The data came from a school survey.
examples.zh: 這些資料來自一份學校調查。

examples.en: We entered the data into a computer.
examples.zh: 我們把資料輸入電腦。

examples.en: The data show that plants need sunlight.
examples.zh: 資料顯示植物需要陽光。

explains.en: Facts and numbers collected for study are called this. A computer can store them. A scientist may examine them.
A chart can show facts from a survey. A person may save information in a file. This word often means collected facts.
A report may include facts and numbers. A computer worker can sort them. Researchers use them to learn.

examples.en: The deaf child uses sign language.
examples.zh: 那位聽障孩子使用手語。

examples.en: My grandfather became deaf in one ear.
examples.zh: 我祖父有一邊耳朵失聰了。

examples.en: The deaf student sat near the front.
examples.zh: 那位聽障學生坐在前排。

explains.en: It means unable to hear well or at all. A person may use signs to talk. Hearing aids can help some people.
A person who cannot hear may read lips. Some people use sign language. This word describes a hearing condition.
A loud sound may not be heard by a person with this condition. They may communicate with hand signs. A doctor can check hearing.

examples.en: The two mayoral candidates engaged in a live televised policy debate.
examples.zh: 兩位市長候選人進行了電視現場直播的政見辯論。

examples.en: Our high school debate team won the regional championship trophy.
examples.zh: 我們學校的高中英語辯論校隊奪得了區域錦標賽冠軍金盃。

examples.en: Lawmakers debated the healthcare funding bill for three consecutive days.
examples.zh: 立法委員針對全民健保預算改革法案連續激辯討論了整整三天。

explains.en: Two people may share different views in a formal talk. Each person gives reasons. A class may hold one.
A group can discuss a question. Speakers take turns. The goal is to share ideas and reasons.
This kind of talk lets people explain opposing views. A school may hold one before a vote. It can be calm or heated.

examples.en: Try to pay off credit card debts as quickly as possible.
examples.zh: 盡可能快速清償信用卡卡債。

examples.en: The national debt of the country has risen steadily in recent decades.
examples.zh: 近幾十年來該國的國家債務持續攀升。

examples.en: He felt a deep debt of gratitude toward the doctor who saved his life.
examples.zh: 他對拯救他性命的醫生心懷無比深沉的感恩之情。

examples.en: Pay off high-interest credit card debt first to achieve financial freedom.
examples.zh: 先清償高利息的信用卡卡債，才能逐步邁向財務自由。

examples.en: The student worked part-time at a campus cafe to clear her college tuition debt.
examples.zh: 這名大學生利用課餘時間在校園咖啡館打工，以儘早還清大學就學貸款。

examples.en: Our country has an immense national debt that requires careful fiscal planning.
examples.zh: 國家背負著龐大的公共債務，需要政府當局審慎制定財政健全計畫。

explains.en: Money that a person owes is this. A bank may lend money for a home. The borrower must pay it back.
A person may owe money after using a credit card. A loan can become this. Paying on time helps reduce it.
This word means money owed. A bill may not be paid yet. A person can work to pay it back.

examples.en: Getting enough exercise is a healthy life decision.
examples.zh: 保持充足運動是一項有益健康的生活決定。

examples.en: Making a major career decision requires weighing pros and cons thoroughly.
examples.zh: 做出重大的職涯抉擇需要周詳權衡各項利弊得失。

examples.en: We respect your thoughtful decision to pursue further studies overseas.
examples.zh: 我們由衷尊重你前往海外深造進修的深思熟慮決定。

examples.en: Clinical Decision Support Systems (CDSS) cross-reference patient lab trends to suggest antibiotic adjustments.
examples.zh: 臨床決策輔助系統（CDSS）即時比對病患血液發炎指數趨勢，主動向主治醫師提出最適抗生素劑量調整建議。

examples.en: After months of soul-searching, she made the courageous decision to resign and pursue her startup dream.
examples.zh: 歷經數月的深思熟慮與內心掙扎，她終於鼓起莫大勇氣做出了人生重大決定：辭去高薪外商主管職位投入創業夢想。

examples.en: The referee's controversial penalty kick decision in the final minute sparked intense outrage in the stadium.
examples.zh: 主裁判在終場補時最後一分鐘所做出的極具爭議的十二碼十二碼罰球判決決定，引爆了全場球迷震耳欲聾的抗議怒吼。

entries.definition: 決定；決策；臨床決策輔助警示系統 (CDSS)

explains.en: This is a choice made after thinking about different options. A person may pick a meal from a menu. They have now chosen what to eat.
A group may need to agree on what to do next. Members can discuss several plans and vote. Their final choice guides their actions.
A judge can give a final answer about a case. People listen to what the judge has chosen. This result may affect what happens next.

examples.en: A deer ran across the road.
examples.zh: 一隻鹿跑過道路。

examples.en: The deer ate leaves near the tree.
examples.zh: 那隻鹿在樹旁吃葉子。

examples.en: We saw a deer in the forest.
examples.zh: 我們在森林裡看到一隻鹿。

explains.en: A large wild animal has long legs and spots or brown fur. It may live in a forest. A male may have antlers.
This animal can run quickly. It eats leaves and grass. People may see one near a road.
A female of this kind may care for a fawn. A male can grow antlers. It is often shy around people.

examples.en: The water is twenty degrees warm.
examples.zh: 水溫是二十度。

examples.en: She has a degree in biology.
examples.zh: 她有生物學學位。

examples.en: Turn the handle ninety degrees.
examples.zh: 把把手轉九十度。

explains.en: A unit shows how hot or cold something is. A student may earn one at college. A circle can be measured this way.
A thermometer shows the heat level. A person may earn a university qualification. The word can also mean an amount of a turn.
This word can mean a level of heat or cold. It can name a university award. A right angle has ninety of these units.

examples.en: The flight departure was delayed by two hours due to heavy fog.
examples.zh: 由於濃霧，該航班起飛時間延誤了兩小時。

examples.en: Don't delay in seeking medical advice if symptoms persist.
examples.zh: 若症狀持續未消，請勿拖延就醫諮詢。

examples.en: Technical difficulties caused an unexpected delay in the live broadcast.
examples.zh: 技術故障導致現場直播節目發生了意料之外的延遲。

examples.en: Typhoon winds caused a three-hour departure delay for all international evening flights.
examples.zh: 強烈颱風強陣風導致今晚所有從桃園機場起飛的國際航班全面面臨三小時以上的航班延誤。

examples.en: The unexpected technical delay meant we had to spend an extra night in Frankfurt.
examples.zh: 突如其來的機械故障延誤，意味著我們不得不由航空公司安排在法蘭克福過境旅館多待一宿。

examples.en: Heavy morning commuter traffic caused an unavoidable delay for our airport bus.
examples.zh: 早晨上班尖峰時段國道主線車流嚴重回堵壅塞，導致我們搭乘的機場接駁巴士遭遇不可避免的延遲。

examples.en: A rhythmic stereo ping-pong delay bounces shimmering echo repeats seamlessly between left and right ears.
examples.zh: 富節奏感的立體聲乒乓延遲效果，讓清亮空靈的迴音在聽者左右耳之間流暢交替彈跳穿梭。

examples.en: Torrential mudslides caused an unexpected four-hour train delay along the eastern railway corridor.
examples.zh: 豪雨引發的突發土石流落石意外，導致東部幹線鐵路各級列車發生了長達四小時的非預期誤點延誤。

examples.en: Do not delay seeing a qualified doctor if you notice persistent unexplained chest pain or dizziness.
examples.zh: 倘若你察覺自己出現持續不明原因的胸悶胸痛或陣發性眩暈，千萬切莫拖延拖拖拉拉，務必及早就醫。

examples.en: A forty-minute round-trip light communication delay makes real-time joysticking from Earth physically impossible.
examples.zh: 由於光速傳播需要整整四十分鐘的「來回通訊延遲」（Communication Delay），地球工程師完全無法即時搖桿操控。

examples.en: Severe runway thunderstorms caused a four-hour flight departure delay at the international airport.
examples.zh: 機場上空突如其來的雷雨胞冰雹強降雨，造成該國際樞紐機場所有國際線班機平均出現四小時的起飛延誤。

examples.en: Do not delay seeing a certified cardiologist if you experience sudden tightness or pain across your chest.
examples.zh: 假若您在日常活動中感到胸口有任何突發性的壓迫感或悶痛，請立刻就醫檢查心臟專科，切莫有絲毫延誤拖延。

entries.definition: 延誤；延期；耽擱；班機延誤；立體聲左右延遲迴音效果；延遲；光速來回傳播數十分鐘之深太空訊號傳輸延遲

explains.en: It means something happens later than planned. A train may come late. A person can ask someone to wait.
Bad weather may slow a flight. A meeting can begin late. This word means a wait or postponement.
This word names a time lost while waiting. A worker may push a task to a later day. It can also mean making someone wait.

examples.en: The soup dumplings here are truly delicious.
examples.zh: 這裡的小籠包真的很美味。

examples.en: Grandmother prepared a delicious feast for the family reunion.
examples.zh: 奶奶為家族團圓準備了一頓豐盛美味的饗宴。

examples.en: Everything on the buffet table looks and smells absolutely delicious.
examples.zh: 自助餐檯上的每樣佳餚看起來和聞起來都美味極了。

examples.en: The braised beef shank noodles are incredibly delicious.
examples.zh: 這裡的紅燒牛腱肉麵好吃得令人驚艷。

examples.en: Thank you for hosting us and preparing such a delicious home-cooked dinner.
examples.zh: 感謝您的熱情款待並準備了如此美味的家常豐盛晚餐。

examples.en: Fresh tropical mangoes taste extraordinarily sweet and delicious in summer.
examples.zh: 新鮮熱帶芒果在夏天吃起來格外香甜美味。

explains.en: It means tasting very good. A ripe peach may have a sweet flavor. A person may enjoy a meal.
A cake can have a pleasant flavor. A cook may use fresh food. This word describes food that tastes very good.
A meal may make a person smile. Soup can be rich and pleasant. The word means good to eat.

examples.en: Food delivery riders deliver hot meals directly to your doorstep.
examples.zh: 美食外送員將熱騰騰的餐點直接送到你家門口。

examples.en: The president delivered an inspiring speech to university graduates.
examples.zh: 校長對大學畢業生發表了一場鼓舞人心的動人演說。

examples.en: The company promised to deliver high-quality software on schedule.
examples.zh: 該公司承諾會如期交付高品質的軟體產品。

explains.en: It means bringing something to a person or place. A mail carrier takes letters to homes. A speaker may give a speech.
A driver may bring food to a house. A person can hand a package to a friend. The word also means giving a talk.
This action moves goods to a customer. A baby can come into the world through birth. A speaker can give a message.

examples.en: Foodpanda and Uber Eats offer speedy food delivery services.
examples.zh: Foodpanda 與 Uber Eats 提供迅速的美食外送服務。

examples.en: Expect free home delivery on all purchases over one thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 凡購物滿一千元即可享有免費宅配到府服務。

examples.en: The mother had a smooth and safe delivery at the regional hospital.
examples.zh: 這位母親在地區醫院順利平安分娩生下小寶寶。

explains.en: A store may bring food to a home. A package can arrive at a door. The word can also mean a baby being born.
A person may order a meal online. A driver brings it. A hospital worker helps during childbirth.
This word means bringing goods to a place. It can name a baby’s birth. A person may receive a package.

examples.en: Visit the dentist twice a year for regular teeth cleaning.
examples.zh: 每年看兩次牙醫進行定期洗牙檢查。

examples.en: Children are often terrified of visiting the dental clinic.
examples.zh: 小朋友通常很害怕去看牙醫門診。

examples.en: The dentist filled the tooth cavity gently without causing much pain.
examples.zh: 牙醫溫柔地幫蛀牙補牙，幾乎沒引起什麼痛楚。

explains.en: A person who cares for teeth has this job. They may clean them and fix cavities. A patient sits in a chair.
This health worker checks the mouth. A person may visit twice a year. A drill can help fix a tooth.
A child may visit one when a tooth hurts. The worker can teach brushing. They help keep teeth healthy.

examples.en: He denied taking the cookie.
examples.zh: 他否認拿了餅乾。

examples.en: The school denied her request.
examples.zh: 學校拒絕了她的請求。

examples.en: She denied that the story was true.
examples.zh: 她否認那個故事是真的。

explains.en: It means saying something is not true or refusing to allow it. A person may turn down an offer. A worker can refuse a request.
A child may say they did not take a cookie. A leader can refuse permission. This word means saying no.
This action means refusing or saying a fact is false. A person may reject an idea. A judge can refuse a claim.

examples.en: Which department does Mr. Chen work in?
examples.zh: 陳先生在哪個部門上班？

examples.en: She was promoted to head of the marketing department.
examples.zh: 她被晉升為行銷部門的主管。

examples.en: Let's browse the clothing section in that department store.
examples.zh: 我們去那家百貨公司的服飾區逛逛吧。

examples.en: The Department of Foreign Languages hosts an annual English drama festival.
examples.zh: 外國語文學系每年都會盛大舉辦英語戲劇公演活動。

examples.en: She transferred from the chemistry department to life sciences during her sophomore year.
examples.zh: 她在大二那年順利從化學系轉系至生命科學系就讀。

examples.en: The sales department achieved record-breaking revenue figures this quarter.
examples.zh: 業務部門在這一季度繳出了打破歷史紀錄的亮眼營收業績。

explains.en: A large organization may have parts for different jobs. A store may have one for clothes. A college has areas of study.
A hospital may have one for children. A company can divide workers by task. This word means a section of a large group.
This word names a part of a business or school. A government may have one for health. It can mean an area or field.

examples.en: Children depend on adults for care.
examples.zh: 孩子們依賴大人照顧。

examples.en: The picnic depends on the weather.
examples.zh: 野餐是否舉行取決於天氣。

examples.en: Plants depend on sunlight to grow.
examples.zh: 植物依靠陽光生長。

explains.en: It means needing something else. A plant needs water. A person may rely on a friend.
A child may need help with homework. A team may rely on each member. The result can change based on another thing.
This word means being affected by something else. A person may trust a helper. A plant needs light for growth.

examples.en: The depth of the pool is two meters.
examples.zh: 池塘深度是兩公尺。

examples.en: They measured the depth of the well.
examples.zh: 他們測量了井的深度。

examples.en: The story has great depth.
examples.zh: 這個故事很有深度。

entries.definition: 深度；深處；深厚；（聲音、顏色等）濃度

explains.en: It means how deep something goes. A pool can have a shallow end. A well may reach far underground.
A person may measure the bottom of a lake. A thought can have great meaning. This word describes distance from top to bottom.
This word means the amount from surface to bottom. A hole may be very deep. It can also mean a strong level of meaning.

examples.en: Can you describe your hometown's unique geographical features in English?
examples.zh: 你能用英文描述家鄉獨特的地理特徵嗎？

examples.en: The eyewitness described the fleeing suspect’s height and clothing accurately.
examples.zh: 目擊證人向執法員警極為準確地描述了逃逸嫌疑人的身高特徵與穿著衣物。

examples.en: Words fail to adequately describe the awe of standing atop the snow-covered peak.
examples.zh: 任何言語文字都難以貼切描繪親身矗立在白雪皚皚的山巔時內心的極致震撼。

explains.en: It means telling what something looks or feels like. A person may explain a room. A writer can use simple words.

This action gives information about an object or event. A person may explain what happened. It helps another person imagine it.

examples.en: The online hotel description matched our wonderful vacation experience.
examples.zh: 網路上對飯店的介紹說明與我們美好的度假體驗完全相符。

examples.en: Read the official job description carefully to understand required qualifications.
examples.zh: 投遞履歷前務必先詳讀官方職缺說明，充分了解該職位所需的各項專業資格。

examples.en: The sunset over Kenting beach was so breathtaking it was beyond all description.
examples.zh: 墾丁海灘上那場絕美無比的落日晚霞壯麗動人，簡直筆墨難以形容。

explains.en: It is a set of words that tells details about something. A shop may give details about a product. A person can explain a picture.
A guide may tell what a place looks like. A report can include many facts. This word means an explanation with details.
A book may give facts about a character. A person may explain an item’s color and shape. This text helps readers understand.

examples.en: The camel crossed the hot desert.
examples.zh: 駱駝穿越炎熱的沙漠。

examples.en: Few plants grow in the desert.
examples.zh: 沙漠裡很少有植物生長。

examples.en: They drove across the desert at night.
