examples.zh: 水瓶空了，請幫忙重新裝滿。

examples.en: The classroom was empty after the final school bell rang.
examples.zh: 最後一堂放學鐘聲響過後，教室裡空無一人。

examples.en: Don't take strong medication on an empty stomach without consulting a doctor.
examples.zh: 諮詢醫生前，請勿在空腹狀態下服用強效藥物。

explains.en: It means having nothing inside. A box may have no toys. A room can have no people.
A glass may have no water. A person can remove everything from a bag. The word can also be an action.
This word describes a container with nothing in it. A person may clear a table. A hall can have no furniture.

examples.en: The coach encouraged the team never to lose hope.
examples.zh: 教練激勵全體球員永遠不要失去希望。

examples.en: Parents should encourage their teenagers to pursue their unique creative passions.
examples.zh: 家長應當多加鼓勵正值青春期的孩子，勇敢追隨屬於自己獨特的創意熱情。

examples.en: The government offers subsidies to encourage households to install rooftop solar panels.
examples.zh: 政府推出安裝補助方案，大力鼓勵家家戶戶在住宅屋頂鋪設太陽能集熱板。

explains.en: It means helping someone feel brave. A teacher may praise a student. A friend can give hope.
A kind word can help a person try again. A parent may cheer a child. The word can mean giving support.
This action gives someone hope or confidence. A coach may help a team before a game. Praise can help a child learn.

examples.en: The ending of the story was happy.
examples.zh: 故事的結局很快樂。

examples.en: The movie has a surprising ending.
examples.zh: 這部電影有一個令人驚訝的結尾。

examples.en: We watched the ending together.
examples.zh: 我們一起看了結尾。

explains.en: It is the last part of a story or event. A book may have a happy one. A race has a finish.
A movie reaches this part after its middle. A person may finish a task. The word names the last point.
This word means the final part. A show may finish with music. A story may close after a problem is solved.

examples.en: The enemy army crossed the river.
examples.zh: 敵軍渡過了河流。

examples.en: He treated his old enemy with kindness.
examples.zh: 他善待以前的敵人。

examples.en: The hero faced his enemy bravely.
examples.zh: 英雄勇敢面對敵人。

explains.en: A person who wants to hurt or oppose another can be called this. A hero may fight one in a story. The word can also mean an opposing country.
Two people may have a serious dislike. A group can oppose another group. This word means an opponent.
This word names a person or group that is against someone. A story may have a hero and one. It can also mean someone disliked.

examples.en: Comprising seventy percent of the universe, dark energy acts as a repulsive force accelerating cosmic expansion.
examples.zh: 佔據全宇宙總能量七成的「暗能量」（Dark Energy），如同一種無所不在的反引力，推動宇宙加速膨脹。

examples.en: Transitioning to clean solar and offshore wind energy reduces national reliance on imported fossil fuels.
examples.zh: 全面轉型發展潔淨太陽能與離岸風力能源，能有效大幅降低國家對進口化石燃料的過度依賴。

examples.en: The lively toddlers ran around the playground with boundless energy that exhausted their parents.
examples.zh: 活潑好動的幼童在公園遊樂場精力充沛地到處奔跑嬉鬧，讓陪伴在側的父母疲憊不堪。

entries.definition: 推動宇宙加速膨脹之神祕暗能量；能量

explains.en: It is the power needed to move or work. Food gives the body strength. A battery stores it.
A person may feel full of life after a good night’s sleep. A lamp needs power. This word means strength or power.
The sun sends light and heat. A runner uses strength to move. Machines need power to work.

examples.en: The mechanic checked the car engine thoroughly.
examples.zh: 技師徹底檢查了汽車引擎。

examples.en: Strange rattling noises came from the old aircraft engine.
examples.zh: 老舊飛機引擎發出奇怪的喀喀聲響。

examples.en: Turn off the engine while waiting at the railway crossing.
examples.zh: 在平交道等候時請將發動機熄火。

examples.en: The blue-glowing xenon ion engine produces gentle, continuous thrust for years using solar electricity.
examples.zh: 散發幽藍光芒的氙氣離子引擎，利用太陽能電力提供持續數年不絕的微小穩定推力。

examples.en: Multiple Hall-effect thruster engines fired in sequence to steer the robotic asteroid redirect spacecraft.
examples.zh: 多具霍爾效應離子推進引擎依序輪流點火，穩健牽引著重達數十噸的無人小行星攔截探測飛船。

examples.en: Operating the high-efficiency ion engine requires only a few grams of inert noble gas per day.
examples.zh: 運轉這具效率驚人的超高比沖離子發動機，每天僅僅需要耗費幾公克惰性無毒的純氙氣氣體。

examples.en: The 300kW fuel cell engine powers forty-ton semi-trucks easily up steep mountain highways.
examples.zh: 搭載三百千瓦大功率「燃料電池動力引擎」（Engine），能輕鬆驅動四十公噸聯結車平穩攀爬陡峭山路。

examples.en: The certified mechanic repaired the automobile engine after diagnosing a cracked cylinder head gasket.
examples.zh: 領有甲級證照的汽車引擎維修技師在拆解檢測後，精準排除並更換了汽缸墊片燒穿導致漏氣的引擎故障。

examples.en: Technological innovation serves as the primary engine driving economic productivity and job growth nationwide.
examples.zh: 蓬勃不息的科學前沿技術創新，向來是驅動國家總體經濟生產力飛躍與促進優質就業人口成長的最核心引擎。

entries.definition: 引擎；發動機；氙氣離子霍爾推進超高比沖引擎；三百千瓦級重型商用卡車燃料電池引擎電堆

explains.en: A car has a machine that makes it move. It uses fuel or electricity. A mechanic may fix it.
A plane has a powerful part that moves it forward. A small machine can run a pump. The word means a machine that provides motion.
This machine turns fuel into movement. It can be found in a car or boat. A driver starts it with a key.

examples.en: The entire class went to the museum.
examples.zh: 全班都去了博物館。

examples.en: She read the entire book in one day.
examples.zh: 她一天就讀完整本書。

examples.en: The entire family came to dinner.
examples.zh: 全家人都來吃晚餐。

explains.en: It means all of something. A person may eat a full cake. A whole day can pass quickly.
A full group may travel together. Nothing is missing. This word means complete or whole.
This word describes all parts of a thing. A person can read a whole book. It may mean complete.

examples.en: The entrance to the museum is on the left.
examples.zh: 博物館入口在左邊。

examples.en: We waited near the entrance.
examples.zh: 我們在入口附近等候。

examples.en: The school has a large front entrance.
examples.zh: 學校有一個很大的正門入口。

explains.en: People enter a building through this place. A door may be near it. A sign can point the way.
A theater has a place where guests come in. A person may wait near the door. This word means a way inside.
This area lets people go into a building. A school may have a main one. It can be marked by a gate.

examples.en: We should protect the natural environment.
examples.zh: 我們應該保護自然環境。

examples.en: The environment is cleaner after the beach cleanup.
examples.zh: 海灘清理後環境變得更乾淨。

examples.en: Plants need a healthy environment to grow.
examples.zh: 植物需要健康的環境才能生長。

entries.definition: 環境；周遭的空氣、土地、水及生物；工作或生活條件。

explains.en: It means the air, land, water, and living things around us. People should keep it clean. Animals depend on it.
A forest, river, and city are part of it. People can change it. This word names everything around a living thing.
Plants need clean air and water. People share the same surroundings. Protecting them helps life.

examples.en: Environmental DNA (eDNA) sampling detects elusive freshwater species from a single liter of river water.
examples.zh: 「環境 DNA 採樣技術」（eDNA），僅需過濾一公升溪水即可精準偵測出極端隱密的珍稀水生動物。

examples.en: Strict environmental regulations prevent chemical factories from discharging wastewater into mountain streams.
examples.zh: 嚴格的環境保護法規嚴格杜絕化學工廠向清澈的高山溪流違規排放任何工業廢水。

examples.en: Educating hikers about environmental ethics helps preserve pristine alpine trails from trash accumulation.
examples.zh: 向登山愛好者推廣無痕山林環境倫理，有助於保護原始高山步道免於垃圾髒亂侵擾。

entries.definition: 環境 DNA (eDNA 溪水過濾微量基因採樣) 的

explains.en: It describes something related to nature and the world around us. A group may clean a beach. A rule can protect forests.
A person may care about clean air. A school can teach how to protect nature. This word means connected to surroundings.
This word describes actions that help keep air and water clean. A group may plant trees. People can reduce waste.

examples.en: The two boxes are equal in size.
examples.zh: 這兩個盒子大小相同。

examples.en: Each team scored an equal number of points.
examples.zh: 每隊得到相同數量的分數。

examples.en: All children should have equal chances.
examples.zh: 所有孩子都應該有平等的機會。

entries.definition: （形）相等的；平等的；（動）等於；比得上；（名）同等的人或物

explains.en: It means the same in amount or value. Two teams may have matching scores. A scale can show matching weight.
A person may share food in matching amounts. A square has sides of the same length. The word can describe fairness.
This word means alike in value or amount. Each child may get the same share. A rule can treat people fairly.

examples.en: The bird escaped from its cage.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥從籠子裡逃了出來。

examples.en: We escaped the rain by going inside.
examples.zh: 我們進到室內躲過了雨。

examples.en: The thief tried to escape through a window.
examples.zh: 小偷試圖從窗戶逃走。

entries.definition: （動）逃脫；避開；（名）逃脫；暫時解脫

explains.en: It means getting away from a place or danger. A bird may fly out of a cage. A person may leave a locked room.
A fish can get away from a net. Someone may run from danger. The word can mean breaking free.
This action means leaving a place safely. A prisoner may get out of a room. A person can avoid harm.

examples.en: Taiwan's fresh tropical fruits are delicious, especially the sweet mangoes.
examples.zh: 台灣的新鮮熱帶水果非常美味，尤其是香甜的芒果。

examples.en: This windproof jacket is especially useful when riding a scooter on chilly winter nights.
examples.zh: 寒風刺骨的冬日夜晚騎乘機車時，這件連帽防風外套顯得格外好用保暖。

examples.en: Children especially love splashing around in shallow water during hot summer afternoons.
examples.zh: 炎炎夏日的午後時分，小孩子們尤其喜歡在清涼的淺水池畔開心地打水仗嬉戲。

explains.en: This word gives extra attention to one person or thing in a group. You may enjoy many fruits but like mangoes most. It helps show that stronger liking.
This word can mean more than usual. A day may feel much hotter than other days. You use it to make that difference clear.
This word can show that something matters more in one situation. A warm coat is useful on many days. It matters even more when the weather is very cold.

examples.en: High school students wrote reflective personal essays on their goals.
examples.zh: 高中生們撰寫了關於個人未來志向的深思心得論述隨筆。

examples.en: The political essay generated heated discussions among academic scholars.
examples.zh: 這篇立論精闢的政治評論短文在國內外學術圈引起了熱烈激盪的思辨交鋒。

examples.en: The fledgling athlete made a brave essay to break the long-standing record.
examples.zh: 這位初生之犢不畏虎的年輕運動員做出了勇敢無畏的初次嘗試，全力衝擊歷史紀錄。

explains.en: A student writes this short piece about a subject. It may share an opinion. A teacher can ask for one.
A person may write a few pages about a book. The text has a main idea. It can be used for school work.
This writing explains an idea. A student may include facts and reasons. It is often shorter than a book.

examples.en: We decorated the house on Christmas Eve.
examples.zh: 我們在平安夜裝飾房子。

examples.en: The eve of the trip was exciting.
examples.zh: 旅行前夕令人興奮。

examples.en: They met on New Year’s Eve.
examples.zh: 他們在除夕夜見面。

explains.en: It means the evening before a special day. Families may prepare for a holiday. The word can also mean the time before an event.
People may stay up on the night before a celebration. A holiday begins after it. The word can refer to an earlier period.
This word names the evening before a major day. A family may have a meal then. It can also mean the day before something happens.

examples.en: The school event starts at noon.
examples.zh: 學校活動中午開始。

examples.en: The wedding was a joyful event.
examples.zh: 婚禮是個快樂的活動。

examples.en: A big event filled the town square.
examples.zh: 一場大型活動讓城鎮廣場熱鬧起來。

entries.definition: 事件；活動；大事；比賽項目。

explains.en: It is something that happens. A birthday party is one. A storm can be a big one.
People may gather for a game or show. A calendar can list a future happening. This word means an occasion.
This word names an activity or happening. A school may hold a concert. News can report an important occasion.

examples.en: The story tells of an evil king.
examples.zh: 故事講述一位邪惡的國王。

examples.en: The evil plan was stopped.
examples.zh: 邪惡計畫被阻止了。

examples.en: He fought against evil.
examples.zh: 他對抗邪惡。

explains.en: It means very bad or harmful. A story may have a cruel person. The word can also mean a bad force.
A person may do something cruel. A fairy tale may have a dark force. This word is the opposite of good.
This word describes something harmful or wicked. A story can have a bad character. It can also name a bad force.

examples.en: The exact time is written on the clock.
examples.zh: 時鐘上寫著準確時間。

examples.en: Please give me the exact number.
examples.zh: 請告訴我確切數字。

examples.en: Her answer was exact.
examples.zh: 她的答案很精確。

entries.definition: 確切的；精確的；完全相同的

explains.en: It means fully correct and not different. A clock may show the time. A person can measure carefully.
A number may be fully correct. A person can give the same answer again. This word means without error.
This word describes something correct in every detail. A scale can show a precise weight. A map can mark a location.

examples.en: The examination will be next week.
examples.zh: 考試將在下週舉行。

examples.en: The doctor gave him a full examination.
examples.zh: 醫生為他做了全面檢查。

examples.en: An exhaustive engineering examination confirmed that the suspension bridge met all earthquake safety codes.
examples.zh: 一次詳盡周密的工程體檢證實該吊橋完全符合所有的防震抗災安全規範。

explains.en: A school may give students questions to check what they know. A doctor can check a person’s health. The word can mean a test.
A student may take one before a class ends. A nurse may check blood. It measures knowledge or health.
This test can be written or done by a doctor. A person may study first. It helps check what someone knows.

examples.en: The doctor examined my throat with a tongue depressor.
examples.zh: 醫生用壓舌棒仔細檢查了我的喉嚨。

examples.en: Scientists examined the rock samples under powerful electron microscopes.
examples.zh: 科學家在強大的電子顯微鏡下檢視了岩石樣本。

examples.en: Customs officers thoroughly examined the cargo container for contraband.
examples.zh: 海關官員徹底檢查了貨櫃以查緝走私違禁品。

explains.en: A doctor looks closely at a patient. A teacher may give a test. A person can look at an object carefully.
A worker may check a machine for damage. A doctor can look in a person’s ear. This action means checking.
This word means looking carefully to learn facts. A teacher may check a student’s work. A doctor may look at a patient.

examples.en: The game excited the children.
examples.zh: 這場比賽讓孩子們興奮。

examples.en: She was excited about the trip.
examples.zh: 她對這趟旅行感到興奮。

examples.en: Interactive planetary exhibits at the science observatory never fail to excite young budding astronomers.
examples.zh: 天文科學館裡的互動式行星展覽總是能讓新露頭角的年輕小小天文學家興奮不已。

explains.en: It means making someone feel eager or happy. A new game may bring joy. A person may feel a strong emotion.
A surprise can make a child very happy. A good story may create strong interest. This word can mean stirring feelings.
This verb means to cause a strong happy feeling. A fun trip may make a child eager to leave home. News of a surprise can make people jump up with joy.

examples.en: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
examples.zh: 不好意思，請問這個位子有人坐嗎？

examples.en: There is no valid excuse for cheating on an examination.
examples.zh: 在考試中作弊沒有任何正當藉口。

examples.en: Please excuse my late reply to your email; I was out of town.
examples.zh: 抱歉這麼晚才回覆您的信件，我先前出差在外。

explains.en: People say this when asking forgiveness. A person may arrive late. It can also mean a reason for doing something.
A child may say it after bumping into someone. A person can give a reason for leaving early. The word can be polite.
This word may mean forgiving a mistake. It can also name a reason that is not very good. A speaker may ask permission.

examples.en: Many kinds of birds exist here.
examples.zh: 這裡有許多種鳥類。

examples.en: Does life exist on other planets?
examples.zh: 其他行星上存在生命嗎？

examples.en: The old rule still exists.
examples.zh: 這條舊規則仍然存在。

explains.en: It means being real or living. Plants and animals do this. A person can live in a place.
A thing may be present in the world. A rule can remain in use. This word means having life or being real.
This action means living or being present. Animals and plants do it. A problem may remain for years.

examples.en: The existence of life on Mars is unknown.
examples.zh: 火星上是否有生命仍未知。

examples.en: They questioned the existence of the old bridge.
examples.zh: 他們質疑那座老橋是否存在。

examples.en: The building has been in existence for years.
examples.zh: 這棟建築已存在多年。

explains.en: It means being alive or real. A person may ask if ghosts are real. The word can also mean life itself.
A person’s life has this name. Plants and animals are alive. A thing may be present in a place.
This word means life or being real. People have it from birth. A law can remain in effect.

examples.en: The exit is near the stairs.
examples.zh: 出口在樓梯附近。

examples.en: Please use the side exit.
examples.zh: 請使用側邊出口。

examples.en: We found the exit after the show.
examples.zh: 表演結束後我們找到了出口。

explains.en: People leave a room through this door. A sign may point toward it. It can mean leaving.
A theater has a way out. A person may leave after a show. This word names the door or action.
A building may have more than one way out. A worker can leave through one. A sign can show its location.

examples.en: Track your daily living expenses with a budgeting app.
examples.zh: 使用記帳 App 追蹤你的日常生活開銷。

examples.en: Travel and accommodation were the biggest expenses of our vacation.
examples.zh: 交通與住宿是我們這次假期中最主要的支出開銷。

examples.en: He spared no expense to provide the best medical care for his mother.
examples.zh: 他不惜一切代價為母親提供最好的醫療照護。

examples.en: Rent and food groceries make up our largest monthly household expenses.
examples.zh: 房屋租金與日常伙食採買構成了我們每月家庭開銷的最大宗。

examples.en: Employees must submit receipts to be reimbursed for travel business expenses.
examples.zh: 員工出差實報實銷時，必須檢附合規發票單據以向公司申請差旅費核銷。

examples.en: Cutting non-essential subscriptions is an easy way to trim monthly expenses.
examples.zh: 停掉非必要的串流會員訂閱是輕鬆削減每個月不必要開銷的好辦法。

explains.en: Money paid for goods or services is this. A family may track it each month. A trip can have a cost.
A person may spend money on food. A business records what it pays. The word means the cost of something.
A bill may include travel costs. A family can plan a budget. This word means money used or paid.

examples.en: The expert answered our questions.
examples.zh: 專家回答了我們的問題。

examples.en: She is an expert on birds.
examples.zh: 她是鳥類專家。

examples.en: Ask an expert before you repair the machine.
examples.zh: 修理機器前先詢問專家。

entries.definition: 專家；行家；（形）熟練的；專業的。

explains.en: A person who knows a lot about a subject can help others. They may answer hard questions. A skilled worker can have this role.
A doctor may know much about the body. A person can ask a skilled helper. This word describes someone with special knowledge.
This person has learned a subject very well. A team may ask for advice. The person can solve hard problems.

examples.en: Don't hesitate to express your personal thoughts during class.
examples.zh: 課堂上請勇於表達你個人的想法。

examples.en: We boarded the express train to Hualien, saving nearly two hours of travel.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘前往花蓮的自強號特快列車，節省了將近兩個小時的車程。

examples.en: Send this urgent legal document by express mail for same-day delivery.
examples.zh: 請用快捷快遞寄送這份緊急法律文件，以確保當日送達收件人手中。

explains.en: It means saying what you think or feel. A person may speak clearly. A fast train can also have this label.
A person can share an idea in speech or writing. A package may be sent quickly. This word can mean clear or fast.
This action tells a feeling or thought. A face can show emotion. A mail service may carry a package quickly.

examples.en: A cheerful smile is an international expression of friendliness.
examples.zh: 燦爛的微笑是跨越國界的友善表情。

examples.en: His facial expression instantly revealed his excitement when he heard the news.
examples.zh: 聽到那個好消息時，他臉上的喜悅表情立刻展露無遺。

examples.en: 'Piece of cake' is a common colloquial English expression meaning something easy.
examples.zh: 「Piece of cake」是一句常用的英語口語慣用語，意思是「小事一樁」。

examples.en: Getting dressed each morning is a wonderful form of creative self-expression.
examples.zh: 每天早晨站在鏡子前用心搭配衣服，是一種向世界無聲傳遞個人獨特美學的自我性格展現。

examples.en: Personal style is an authentic expression of one's unique identity, mood, and creativity.
examples.zh: 個人穿搭風格正是每個人內在獨特身份認同、當日心情以及無限創造力最真實的表達。

examples.en: Her relaxed facial expression reflected a deep sense of confidence in her chosen outfit.
examples.zh: 她臉龐上流露出的從容優雅表情，全然反映出對自己今日這身穿搭所散發的由衷自信。

examples.en: Rich vocabulary provides a treasure chest of colorful expressions to describe human emotions.
examples.zh: 豐富的詞彙量如同一座寶庫，為你提供無數「生動優雅的語言表達」（Expressions）來描摹人類細膩情感。

examples.en: She noted down several practical expressions from the podcast to use in her morning meetings.
examples.zh: 她從晨間播客中筆記下了數個實用表達語句，準備在早上的團隊工作會議中實際運用。

examples.en: Facial expressions and body posture convey as much meaning in communication as spoken words.
examples.zh: 面部神情與肢體儀態在人際互動中所傳達的信息量，絲毫不亞於口中所說出的語言。

entries.definition: 表情；表達；片語詞句；自我表達；表現；豐富生動、打動人心之真實生活語言表達

explains.en: A person’s face can show joy or anger. A group of words may have a special meaning. The word can also mean sharing an idea.
A smile is one kind of look on a face. A common phrase can have meaning. A person may show a thought through speech.
This word can mean a face look, a phrase, or sharing an idea. A person can show a feeling. A language has many phrases.

examples.en: University students worked as background extras during temple festival scenes.
examples.zh: 大學生們在傳統廟會熱鬧大場面的拍攝中擔任背景臨演賺取外快。

examples.en: Hundreds of extras dressed in medieval armor were needed for the massive battlefield sequence.
examples.zh: 為了完美呈現兩軍對壘的壯烈古代史詩古戰場大場面，劇組緊急召集了數百名身披全副盔甲的臨時演員。

examples.en: The airline charged an extra fee for passengers wishing to check overweight suitcases.
examples.zh: 航空公司針對攜帶超重行李託運的旅客，依國際航空運送規定加收了一筆額外的超重行李附加費。

explains.en: It means more than usual. A person may pay an added amount. A worker can stay after normal hours.
A bag may have an added pocket. A customer may ask for another item. This word means added or beyond what is needed.
This word can describe an added amount. A class may have more time. A movie may have a person in the background.

examples.en: She raised one eyebrow in surprise.
examples.zh: 她驚訝地挑起一邊眉毛。

examples.en: His eyebrows are dark and thick.
examples.zh: 他的眉毛又黑又濃。

examples.en: The inquisitive scientist arched a single skeptical eyebrow upon reviewing the anomalous laboratory data.
examples.zh: 這位好學深思的科學家在審視異常實驗數據時，帶著懷疑的神情挑起了一邊眉毛。

explains.en: Hair grows above each eye. A person may lift it to show surprise. It can be shaped with a brush.
This line of hair helps keep sweat from the eye. A person may color it. The smaller word can mean the same body part.

examples.en: Price is one factor in our choice.

examples.zh: 天氣是延誤的關鍵因素。

examples.en: Many factors affect plant growth.
examples.zh: 許多因素會影響植物生長。

examples.en: Training to complete muscular failure on the final set maximizes muscle stimulation.
examples.zh: 在最後一組動作中全力拚搏推進至肌肉全然力竭狀態，能帶給肌纖維最大化機械張力刺激。

examples.en: Going to failure on every single set can lead to overtraining and nervous system exhaustion.
examples.zh: 每組都做到徹底力竭可能會導致過度訓練與中樞神經系統衰竭。

examples.zh: 在達到動作變形的力竭前保留一到兩下反覆，能確保動作生物力學的標準完整。

examples.zh: 在測驗中將句子標註為正確或錯誤。

examples.zh: 火災警報器的聲響事後證實只是一場虛驚一場的誤報。

examples.zh: 在社群媒體上散布不實謠言會引發不必要的公眾恐慌。

This word means incorrect or not genuine. A lie is untrue. A person may find a made-up report.

examples.zh: 時尚每年都在改變。

examples.en: She works in the fashion industry.
examples.zh: 她在時尚產業工作。

examples.zh: 這件洋裝本季很流行。

examples.zh: 命運讓他們相遇。

examples.en: The power outage was not caused by a generator failure but by an electrical insulation fault in a transformer.
examples.zh: 這次區域大停電並非發電機組運轉故障所致，而是路邊高壓變壓器內部絕緣老化引發的電力接地故障。

examples.zh: 她展現出高度成熟的處事擔當，坦然承認這起擦撞車禍自己未提前打方向燈變換車道也有不可推卸的責任。

entries.definition: 車籠埔等活動斷層地表微小蠕滑長期即時監測；斷層

explains.en: It means a mistake or weak point. A person may admit an error. A machine may have a broken part.
A crack in a road can be a problem. A person can take responsibility for an error. The word can also mean a break in Earth’s rock.
This word can mean an error or problem. A person may accept responsibility. Earth scientists study breaks in the ground.

examples.en: May I ask you a favor?
examples.zh: 我可以請你幫個忙嗎？

examples.zh: 她昨天幫了我一個忙。

examples.zh: 如果你心直口快的直率言詞傷害了好友細膩的感受，請誠懇向對方道歉。

examples.zh: 在寒冷的高山健行結束後踏入溫暖的熱水淋浴間，感覺真是無比舒暢。

examples.zh: 一位同學幫我完成這個專案。

examples.zh: 台灣選出了歷史上第一位女性總統。

examples.en: Drink plenty of warm fluids if you have a mild fever.

examples.zh: 世界盃狂熱風潮席捲了整個熱愛足球的國度。

This word can mean level, not raised, or an apartment. A road may cross open land. A person may lie on a bed.

examples.en: Our flight to Tokyo will board in thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 我們飛往東京的班機將在三十分鐘後登機。

examples.en: The direct international flight takes about three hours and forty minutes.
examples.zh: 這趟直飛國際航班航程約需三小時四十分鐘。

examples.en: Bad typhoon weather caused several domestic flights to be canceled.
examples.zh: 惡劣的颱風天氣導致數班國內線航班被迫取消。

explains.en: People travel by air in a plane. A bird moves through the air. A group of stairs can have steps.
A plane trip takes a person from one place to another. The word can also mean flying. A building may have stairs between floors.
This word can mean a trip through the sky. A plane may be full of passengers. It can also describe birds moving above the ground.

examples.en: Being in a state of flow dissolves self-consciousness, allowing artists and programmers to produce brilliant work.
examples.zh: 沉浸在渾然忘我的心流狀態中，時間彷彿靜止，能讓創作者與工程師爆發出驚人創造力。

examples.en: A gentle, steady flow of fresh cool water trickled down the mossy mountain rocks into the brook.
examples.zh: 一股清涼甘洌的山泉水細流緩緩順著生滿翠綠青苔的岩壁滴落，匯入清澈見底的山澗溪流中。

examples.en: Improving the user interface simplified the checkout flow, significantly boosting mobile purchasing rates.
examples.zh: 全面優化使用者操作介面簡化了購物結帳流程，進而顯著提升了手機行動端的下單轉換率。

examples.en: Maintaining a gentle, vertical water flow rate prevents splashing and channels through the coffee bed.
examples.zh: 穩定維持每秒約三克垂直細緻注水水流，能溫柔濕潤粉層且完全不濺起水花。

examples.en: Controlling your flow rate allows you to extend contact time for denser, high-altitude beans.
examples.zh: 精準控制手腕的注水流速節奏，能有效延長熱水與高密度極硬高山豆的浸泡萃取接觸時間。

examples.en: A shaky pouring hand disrupts the laminar water flow, resulting in uneven saturation of the grinds.
examples.zh: 握持手壺懸空發抖會破壞平穩的層流水柱，進而造成濾杯內部咖啡粉層乾濕飽和不均的遺憾。

entries.definition: 渾然忘我的心流極致沉浸體驗；每秒三克穩定垂直細緻注水水流流速；流動

explains.en: A river moves along its path. Water may pass through a pipe. A person’s ideas can come easily.
This word means moving smoothly. A stream can move over rocks. A crowd may move into a room.
A liquid can move from one place to another. A person may feel focused and calm. The word can describe a steady movement.

examples.en: The flu kept him home from school.
examples.zh: 流感讓他待在家裡沒去上學。

examples.en: She got a flu shot in October.
examples.zh: 她十月接種了流感疫苗。

examples.en: Flu can spread quickly in winter.
examples.zh: 流感在冬天可能快速傳播。

explains.en: It is a common illness with fever and body pain. A person may cough or feel tired. Rest can help.
A virus can make a person feel sick. A doctor may suggest fluids. The illness often spreads in winter.
This sickness may cause a high temperature. A person may stay home from school. It can spread through coughs.

examples.en: Practicing single-tasking restores deep focus in a world overflowing with distracting digital notifications.
examples.zh: 練習一次只專心做好一件事，能在充斥各類手機推播干擾的現代世界中重拾珍貴的深度專注力。

examples.en: The photographer adjusted the manual camera lens ring until the dewdrop came into razor-sharp focus.
examples.zh: 專業攝影師細心旋轉手動相機鏡頭對焦環，直到葉片上的晶瑩晨露完美呈現於銳利清晰的焦點中。

examples.en: Our immediate corporate focus for the upcoming quarter is expanding customer retention and satisfaction.
examples.zh: 我們公司在即將到來的下一個季度中，最迫切且首要的工作焦點是全面深化顧客留存率與滿意度。

entries.definition: 深度不受干擾的極致專注力；聚焦

explains.en: It means looking at one thing carefully. A camera can make a clear picture. A person can pay close attention.
A student may look closely at a task. A lens can make an image clear. The word can mean a main point.
This word means giving full attention. A person may look at one place. A camera needs a clear image.

examples.en: A thick fog covered the road.
examples.zh: 濃霧籠罩了道路。

examples.en: The fog lifted after sunrise.
examples.zh: 日出後霧散了。

examples.en: We could not see the boat through the fog.
examples.zh: 我們看不見霧中的船。

explains.en: A low cloud near the ground makes it hard to see. Cars may slow down in it. It often forms in cool air.
A road can become hard to see across. Drivers may turn on lights. This word describes a gray cloud close to land.
Water in the air can make a soft gray cover. It may hide hills. A person should drive carefully.

examples.en: The folk music came from the mountains.
examples.zh: 民謠來自山區。

examples.en: The folk danced at the festival.
examples.zh: 民眾在節慶中跳舞。

examples.en: A folk tale tells an old story.
examples.zh: 民間故事講述古老的故事。

entries.definition: （名）人們；民眾；家人；（形）民間的；傳統的。

explains.en: This word can mean people in a casual way. A speaker may use it when talking to a group of neighbors. It can also refer to people in a certain area or community.
A family may be called this in an informal way. A person can ask how everyone is doing. It means a group of people.
This word refers to people or relatives. It sounds friendly and casual. A child may use it when talking about parents.

examples.en: The following day was sunny.
examples.zh: 隔天是晴天。

examples.en: Read the following pages for homework.
examples.zh: 閱讀接下來幾頁作為作業。

examples.en: The following students won prizes.
examples.zh: 以下學生獲得了獎品。

entries.definition: （形）接下來的；下列的；（介）在…之後；（名）追隨者

explains.en: It means coming next. A list may show what happens after a meeting. The word can also mean people who support someone.
A person may read the next pages. Fans who support a singer can have this name. It describes what comes after.
This word points to something coming later. A group may follow a leader. A set of instructions can come next.

examples.en: It was foolish to run across the road.
examples.zh: 跑過馬路是愚蠢的。

examples.en: He made a foolish mistake.
examples.zh: 他犯了一個愚蠢的錯誤。

examples.en: The foolish plan did not work.
examples.zh: 這個不明智的計畫行不通。

explains.en: It means not wise. A person may make a bad choice. The word can sound unkind.
A silly act may be called this. A person can learn after making a mistake. It means lacking good sense.
This word describes a poor choice. A person may act without thinking. It can hurt someone’s feelings when used as an insult.

examples.en: The children played football after school.
examples.zh: 孩子們放學後踢足球。

examples.en: He watched a football game on TV.
examples.zh: 他在電視上看足球比賽。

examples.en: The football rolled into the yard.
examples.zh: 足球滾進了院子。

explains.en: This sport is played by two teams with a ball. In many countries, players mostly kick a round ball. They try to send it into the other team’s net.
In the American version, players use an oval ball. They can carry it or pass it to teammates. Moving it into the other team’s end zone scores points.
This can also name the ball used in the sport. Its shape depends on the kind of game. Players practice with it before a match.

examples.en: The force of the wind broke a branch.
examples.zh: 風的力量折斷了一根樹枝。

examples.en: The police used force to open the door.
examples.zh: 警方用力打開了門。

examples.en: A magnet has a strong pulling force.
examples.zh: 磁鐵有很強的吸引力。

entries.definition: （名）力量；武力；勢力；（動）強迫；迫使。

explains.en: It means strength or control. A storm can push trees. A leader may have the ability to make choices.
A person may use strength to lift a box. A machine needs energy. The word can mean authority.
This word means strong influence or ability. A team may push a door open. A leader may have control over a group.

examples.en: Alishan is famous for its ancient cypress forest.
examples.zh: 阿里山以其古老的紅檜森林聞名。

examples.en: Walking through the quiet forest fills your lungs with fresh air.
examples.zh: 漫步在寧靜的森林裡讓你的肺部吸飽新鮮空氣。

examples.en: The Amazon rainforest is vital for global oxygen production.
examples.zh: 亞馬遜雨林對全球氧氣生成至關重要。

examples.en: Alishan is renowned for its ancient sacred cypress forest trees.
examples.zh: 阿里山以其古老壯麗的神木檜木巨木森林聞名天下。

examples.en: Taking deep breaths in a pine forest fills your lungs with restorative phytoncides.
examples.zh: 在松樹森林中深呼吸，能讓雙肺吸滿具有療癒身心功效的芬多精。

examples.en: Reforestation projects plant millions of saplings to revive degraded forest lands.
examples.zh: 造林計畫種下了數百萬株健壯幼苗，致力於讓退化貧瘠的林地重現生機。

explains.en: A large area has many trees. Animals may live there. People can walk on paths.
This land is covered by trees and plants. A hiker may follow a trail. Birds build nests there.
A group of trees grows in this place. It may be home to deer and foxes. People should protect it.

examples.en: To forgive others is to free yourself from bitterness.
examples.zh: 原諒他人就是將自己從怨恨中解脫出來。

examples.en: Can you ever forgive me for forgetting your birthday anniversary?
examples.zh: 我竟然粗心大意忘記了你的生日紀念日，你還能原諒寬恕我嗎？

examples.en: She chose to forgive her former rival and move forward with peace of mind.
examples.zh: 她選擇大度原諒過往的競爭對手，卸下心防並平靜坦然地迎向嶄新未來。

explains.en: It means no longer being angry about a mistake. A friend may say sorry. A person can accept an apology.
A parent may let go of a child’s mistake. The person stops feeling upset. This action can help repair a friendship.
This word means pardoning someone. A person may not hold anger. It can bring peace after a problem.

examples.en: Please fill out this form.
examples.zh: 請填寫這份表格。

examples.en: Water can form ice in cold weather.
examples.zh: 天冷時水會形成冰。

examples.en: The clouds formed a long line.
examples.zh: 雲形成了一條長線。

entries.definition: （名）表格；形狀；種類；（動）形成；組成

explains.en: This can mean the shape of something. Clay can become a bowl or a cup. Each finished object has a different outline.
This can be a paper with spaces for information. A person writes a name and an address in those spaces. A school may ask a parent to fill it in.
The verb means making or developing something. Children can make a circle by standing together. Clouds can also develop in the sky.

examples.en: He wore formal clothes to the wedding.
examples.zh: 他穿正式服裝參加婚禮。

examples.en: The school held a formal meeting.
examples.zh: 學校舉行了一場正式會議。

examples.en: She wrote a formal letter to the mayor.
examples.zh: 她寫了一封正式信給市長。

entries.definition: 正式的；拘謹的；合乎規範的

explains.en: It means suitable for an important event. A person may wear special clothes to a wedding. A letter can sound polite.
A meeting may have rules. A person can speak in a serious way. This word describes proper behavior or dress.
This word means proper and serious. A person may wear a suit. A school event can have a set style.

examples.en: The former teacher visited our class.
examples.zh: 以前的老師來拜訪我們班。

examples.en: This was the former home of the king.
examples.zh: 這裡曾是國王的住所。

examples.en: My former job was in a restaurant.
examples.zh: 我以前的工作是在餐廳。

entries.definition: 以前的；前任的；前者（兩者之中先提及者）

explains.en: It means earlier or previous. A person may have an old job. The word can also mean the first of two things just named.
A house may have had a different owner in past years. A person may talk about an earlier teacher. This word points to something before now.
This word describes an earlier time. A person may talk about a previous home. It can mean past or previous.

examples.en: The army moved forth at dawn.
examples.zh: 軍隊在黎明時向前進。

examples.en: She stepped forth to accept the award.
examples.zh: 她走上前領獎。

examples.en: The brave explorer went forth alone.
examples.zh: 勇敢的探險家獨自向前。

explains.en: It means forward or onward. A person may step out into a room. A speaker can bring an idea forward.
A soldier may move ahead. A person can put a hand out. This word can mean moving forward.
This word means onward or ahead. A person may step from a doorway. It can also mean publicly.

examples.en: Please forward this memo to all team members.
examples.zh: 請將這份備忘錄轉寄給全體團隊成員。

examples.en: Step forward when your name is called by the officer.
examples.zh: 當長官叫到你的名字時，請向前一步。

examples.en: We look forward to meeting your family this weekend.
examples.zh: 我們期待這週末與你的家人碰面。

explains.en: It means toward the front. A person may move ahead in a line. A letter can be sent to another person.
A runner may go ahead of others. A person can send an email onward. The word can describe future movement.
This word means moving ahead. A person may step in front. It can also mean sending a message onward.
It means toward the front or ahead. A person may take a step onward. A letter can be sent to a new address.
A runner may move ahead. A person can send a message onward. This word can describe a direction.
This word means onward. A person may move toward the front. It can also mean passing a message to someone else.

examples.en: They founded a new school in the town.
examples.zh: 他們在城鎮創辦了一所新學校。

examples.en: The lost hikers were found by a farmer.
examples.zh: 迷路的健行者被農夫找到。

examples.en: She founded a company with her friend.
examples.zh: 她和朋友創辦了一家公司。

entries.definition: （動）找到；發現（find 的過去式及過去分詞）；創立；建立

explains.en: It means starting a group or business. A person may build a school. It can also mean discovering something.
A team may create a new company. A person can establish a club. The word can also mean finding a thing that was lost.
This word can mean establishing a place or group. It may also mean discovering something by chance. A person can start a school.

examples.en: A fox ran across the snowy field.
examples.zh: 一隻狐狸跑過雪地。

examples.en: The fox has a thick red tail.
examples.zh: 狐狸有一條濃密的紅尾巴。

examples.en: We saw a fox near the forest.
examples.zh: 我們在森林附近看到一隻狐狸。

explains.en: A wild animal has a bushy tail and pointed ears. It may have orange fur. It hunts small animals.
This animal can live in woods or fields. It may be clever in stories. It has a long furry tail.
A small wild dog has a narrow face. It can run quickly. Its fur may be red or gray.

examples.en: Freedom of the press is vital for a transparent government.
examples.zh: 新聞媒體自由對於監督政府與透明施政至關重要。

examples.en: Freedom of speech allows diverse voices and perspectives to flourish safely.
examples.zh: 言論自由能保障社會上多元相異的聲音與觀點得以安全蓬勃發展。

examples.en: Many immigrants came to this new land in search of economic and religious freedom.
examples.zh: 許多移民不遠千里遷徙來到這片新土地，尋求經濟發展與宗教信仰的自由。

examples.en: Fluency gives you the intellectual freedom to explore any subject, travel anywhere, and connect with anyone.
examples.zh: 語言流利賦予你無拘無束的「智識與探索自由」（Freedom），讓你能自由涉獵任何學問、暢遊任何國度。

examples.en: Having financial and geographic freedom allows remote entrepreneurs to live and work worldwide.
examples.zh: 享有財務自主與地理空間的無拘自由，讓數位遊民創業家能夠在世界任何角落自在生活與辦公。

examples.en: Freedom of speech and creative expression are foundational pillars of a democratic and prosperous society.
examples.zh: 言論自由與多元蓬勃的文藝創作自由，是民主自由繁榮社會無可動搖的重要基石。

entries.definition: 自由；暢遊全球、自由探索無窮知識之語言自由

explains.en: It means being able to make one’s own choices. A person may speak freely. A bird can fly away from a cage.
People may have the ability to choose where they live. A country can be free from control. This word names the state of being free.
This word means the right to act or speak freely. A person may make choices. A nation may gain it.

examples.en: True friendship lasts through the years.
examples.zh: 真正的友誼歷久彌新。

examples.en: Distance and time cannot diminish the deep bond of genuine friendship.
examples.zh: 距離與歲月無法磨滅真正友誼之間深厚堅固的羈絆。

examples.en: We exchanged handwritten postcards to cultivate and cherish our international friendship.
examples.zh: 我們互相寄送手寫明信片，以維繫並珍惜這份跨越國界的深厚友誼。

explains.en: It means caring and trust between people. Two friends may help each other. It can last many years.
A close bond can grow through shared time. A friend may keep a secret. This word names that bond.
People may build trust and kindness. They can share happy times. This relationship may last a long time.

examples.en: We ordered fries with our burgers.
examples.zh: 我們點漢堡時配了薯條。

examples.en: The fries were hot and crispy.
examples.zh: 薯條又熱又脆。

examples.en: She shared her fries with her brother.
examples.zh: 她和弟弟分享薯條。

explains.en: Long pieces of potato are cooked in hot oil. People may eat them with a burger. They are often salty.
A restaurant may serve these with ketchup. They can be soft inside and crisp outside. A potato is cut into strips.
This food is made from potato sticks. They are cooked until golden. A paper bag may hold them.

examples.en: Fry the eggs sunny-side up for breakfast.
examples.zh: 早餐煎幾顆太陽蛋。

examples.en: Pan-fry the fish fillets over medium heat until golden.
examples.zh: 用中火將魚排煎至表面金黃。

examples.en: She fried diced potatoes with onions and black pepper.
examples.zh: 她將馬鈴薯丁與洋蔥和黑胡椒一同翻煎。

explains.en: This action cooks food in hot oil or fat. A cook heats a pan first. The food may become brown and crisp.
Potatoes can be cooked this way in a deep pot of oil. Small pieces cook quickly. The cook removes them when they are ready.
The noun can refer to very young fish. They have recently come out of eggs. Many are tiny and swim in groups.

examples.en: The heart has an important function.
examples.zh: 心臟有重要的功能。

examples.en: This button has two functions.
examples.zh: 這個按鈕有兩種功能。

examples.en: The function begins at seven o’clock.
examples.zh: 典禮七點開始。

entries.definition: （名）功能；用途；職責；（動）運作；發揮作用。

explains.en: It means what a tool or body part does. A heart moves blood. A phone has a useful purpose.
A machine may have one main job. A person can serve a role in a group. The word can mean a purpose or job.
This word names a purpose. A key can open a lock. A body part can do a special job.

examples.en: The room has new furniture.
examples.zh: 房間裡有新家具。

examples.en: We bought furniture for the living room.
examples.zh: 我們買了客廳家具。

examples.en: The furniture is made of wood.
examples.zh: 這些家具是木製的。

explains.en: Chairs, beds, and tables are items in a home. They help people sit or store things. A room may have many.
A family may buy a couch for a living room. A desk is used for work. These home items can be made of wood.
This word means large movable items in a room. A person may sit on a chair. A table is one example.

examples.en: We need to look further into the problem.
examples.zh: 我們需要更深入地研究這個問題。

examples.en: The village is further down the road.
examples.zh: 村莊再往前走一段路。

examples.en: She asked for further details.
examples.zh: 她要求更多細節。

entries.definition: （副）更遠地；進一步；（形）更多的；進一步的；（動）促進

explains.en: It means more or farther. A person may walk a longer distance. The word can also mean additional.
A student may learn more about a topic. A road may continue farther. This word means a greater amount or distance.
This word can mean extra. A person may ask for more time. It can also mean at a greater distance.

examples.en: Proper gain staging ensures the vocal track stays well above the noise floor without clipping into red distortion.
examples.zh: 嚴謹的增益調校確保人聲音軌維持在安全動態範圍內，既無底噪又絕不爆音過載。

examples.en: Regular resistance training helps elderly adults gain functional muscle mass and joint stability.
examples.zh: 養成規律的阻力重訓習慣，能協助高齡長輩實質增長具備機能性的骨骼肌肌肉量與關節穩定度。

examples.en: The international export market showed a noticeable gain in revenue over the previous financial year.
examples.zh: 該企業海外國際外銷市場在上一個財政年度中，展現出令人欣喜的營收實質增長。

entries.definition: 前級增益調校 (Gain Staging)；獲得

explains.en: It means getting or receiving something. A person may get a new skill. A business can make money.
A student may get knowledge from books. A team can make ground in a game. This word means an increase.
This action means receiving or improving. A person may earn respect. A company can get more customers.

examples.en: Carrying ziplock bags to pack out all garbage, orange peels, and used tissues preserves pristine mountain beauty.
examples.zh: 準備好雙層夾鏈密封袋將所有個人果皮垃圾與衛生紙百分之百背下山，共同守護純淨聖境。

examples.en: Food garbage left at backcountry camps attracts black bears and alters natural foraging behaviors.
examples.zh: 遺留在山區營地的廚餘果皮垃圾會引來台灣黑熊覓食，進而破壞野生動物天然覓食習性。

examples.en: Volunteers hauled twenty kilograms of historical trail garbage down from the high alpine ridge.
examples.zh: 淨山志工們合力從高海拔稜線上，將重達二十公斤的歷史人為垃圾全數背運下山清理。

entries.definition: 垃圾廚餘衛生紙百分之百全數背下山

explains.en: It means waste people throw away. A truck picks it up. A bin can hold it.
A person may put food scraps in a bag. A town collects waste. The word can mean things no longer wanted.
This waste may be left after a meal. Workers take it away. People should sort it for recycling.

examples.en: The gardener planted roses in the yard.
examples.zh: 園丁在庭院裡種了玫瑰。

examples.en: A gardener watered the flowers.
examples.zh: 園丁為花澆水。

examples.en: The gardener trimmed the bushes.
examples.zh: 園丁修剪了灌木。

explains.en: A person who grows flowers or food plants has this job. They may trim bushes. A yard can look neat.
This worker cares for plants. A person may hire them to cut grass. They can grow vegetables.
A person who tends a garden has this role. They may water flowers. The work happens outdoors.

examples.en: Minced garlic gives a rich flavor to stir-fries.
examples.zh: 蒜末能為熱炒增添濃郁風味。

examples.en: Garlic bread toasted golden brown is the perfect pasta companion.
examples.zh: 烤至金黃微焦的蒜香麵包是義大利麵的完美搭檔。

examples.en: Crush two cloves of garlic before adding them into the marinade.
examples.zh: 在將蒜頭加入醃料之前先將兩瓣大蒜壓碎。

explains.en: This strong-smelling plant is used in cooking. Its small sections can be peeled. It may help flavor soup.
A cook may crush this food and add it to sauce. It grows underground in a bulb. Many dishes use it.
This plant has white cloves. Its taste is strong. People may chop it for pasta or meat.

examples.en: People gathered around the table.
examples.zh: 人們聚集在桌子旁。

examples.en: She gathered flowers for her mother.
examples.zh: 她為媽媽採了一些花。

examples.en: The students gathered in the hall.
examples.zh: 學生們聚集在大廳。

explains.en: It means bringing people or things into one place. A family may meet for dinner. A person can collect leaves.
Students may meet in a room. A child can collect shells on a beach. The word means bringing together.
This action brings a group closer. A person may collect papers. Friends can meet for a meal.

examples.en: The general led the army across the bridge.
examples.zh: 將軍率領軍隊過橋。

examples.en: The general rule is easy to remember.
examples.zh: 一般規則很容易記住。

examples.en: He spoke in general terms.
examples.zh: 他大致地說明。

explains.en: It means common or applying to many things. A person may give a broad idea. An army can have a high-ranking officer.
A rule may apply to many people. A person may speak in a broad way. The word can also mean a high military officer.
This word describes what is usual or broad. A person may share a main point. An army leader can hold this title.

examples.en: The generous donor contributed funds to build rural school libraries.
examples.zh: 慷慨的善心人士捐款資助興建偏鄉學校圖書館。

examples.en: The small village restaurant served wonderfully generous portions of beef noodles.
examples.zh: 這家鄉間小館端出份量十足、大碗滿意且肉塊厚實的招牌牛肉麵。

examples.en: She was always generous with her praise whenever her students showed progress.
examples.zh: 每當班上學童有一丁點的微小進步，她從來都不吝於給予最熱情大方的讚美。

explains.en: It means willing to share. A person may give food to a friend. A host may offer extra help.
A person who gives a lot has this quality. A neighbor can share tools. It can also describe a large amount.
This word means kind and giving. A person may donate money. A meal can have plenty of food.

examples.en: Be gentle with the little kitten.
examples.zh: 對小貓要溫柔一點。

examples.en: She used a gentle voice.
examples.zh: 她用溫柔的聲音說話。

examples.en: A gentle breeze moved the leaves.
examples.zh: 微風搖動了樹葉。

explains.en: It means soft and kind. A person may speak in a quiet way. A breeze can be light.
A parent may handle a baby carefully. A person can use kind words. The word describes mild behavior.
This word means not rough or harsh. A small animal may be handled carefully. A person can have a mild voice.

examples.en: The gentleman held the door open.
examples.zh: 那位紳士把門扶開。

examples.en: A gentleman helped the old woman.
examples.zh: 一位紳士幫助了老太太。

examples.en: He acted like a true gentleman.
examples.zh: 他的舉止像個真正的紳士。

entries.definition: 紳士；有禮貌的男士；先生

explains.en: A polite title for a grown man is this. He may open a door for someone. The word can also mean a kind man.
A person may use this title when speaking respectfully. A man may act with good manners. The word can be formal.
This word describes a polite adult man. A person may greet him formally. He may wear a suit.

examples.en: The giraffe reached leaves high in the tree.
examples.zh: 長頸鹿吃到樹上高處的葉子。

examples.en: A giraffe has a very long neck.
examples.zh: 長頸鹿有非常長的脖子。

examples.en: We saw a giraffe at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在動物園看到一隻長頸鹿。

explains.en: A very tall animal has a long neck and spots. It eats leaves from high trees. It lives in Africa.
This animal has long legs. It can reach high branches. Its coat has brown patches.
A zoo may have this spotted animal. It walks with a slow step. Its neck is longer than a person’s.

examples.en: Glue the photo firmly onto the colored cardboard.
examples.zh: 把照片牢固地黏在彩色西卡紙上。

examples.en: A glue stick is much cleaner to use than messy liquid glue.
examples.zh: 固體口紅膠比黏膩的液態膠水用起來乾淨許多。

examples.en: Apply a small drop of super glue to fix the broken mug handle.
examples.zh: 滴一小滴快乾膠以修復破損的馬克杯把手。

examples.en: Reversible hot hide glue allows centuries-old violins to be opened for delicate interior restorations without wood damage.
examples.zh: 具備可逆性的古法「熱動物皮膠」（Hide Glue），讓數百年的古琴能無損開蓋進行精細的內部修復。

examples.en: Elementary school students used non-toxic glue sticks to assemble paper holiday greeting cards.
examples.zh: 國小美術課上的小朋友們開心地手拿無毒固體膠棒，剪剪貼貼親手製作溫馨的立體聖誕賀卡。

examples.en: Unlike modern epoxy, natural hide glue dries glass-hard and never dampens acoustic vibrations.
examples.zh: 與現代人工環氧樹脂膠不同，天然動物皮膠乾涸後質地堅硬如玻璃，絕不會吸收或衰減樂器聲波振動。

entries.definition: 膠水；黏貼；古法熱動物皮膠 (可無損拆卸修復之天然膠水)

explains.en: It is a sticky liquid used to join paper or wood. A person may use it for crafts. It becomes hard when dry.
A child may join two pieces of paper with this. A bottle can hold it. It can be clear or white.
This substance helps things stick together. A worker may use it on a broken chair. It can come in a tube.

examples.en: Set clear study goals at the beginning of each semester.
examples.zh: 每個學期初設定明確的讀書目標。

examples.en: The star soccer forward scored an astonishing goal in the final seconds.
examples.zh: 明星足球前鋒在最後幾秒攻進了一記驚艷全場的關鍵進球。

examples.en: Breaking down long-term dreams into smaller milestones makes goals achievable.
examples.zh: 將遠大夢想拆解為各個階段性小目標會使目標更容易達成。

explains.en: It means something a person hopes to do. A team may try to score one. A soccer net has this name.
A student may set one for the year. A player kicks a ball toward it. It can mean a purpose or result.
This word can mean a target. A person may work hard to reach one. In sports, a ball may go into a net.

examples.en: Mountain goats can climb extremely steep rocky cliffs.
examples.zh: 野山羊能夠攀爬非常陡峭的岩壁。

examples.en: Fresh goat milk and goat cheese are nutrient-rich dairy options.
examples.zh: 新鮮羊奶與羊乳酪是營養豐富的乳製品選擇。

examples.en: The lively baby goat leaped playfully around the farm enclosure.
examples.zh: 活潑的小山羊在農場圍欄周圍歡快地蹦蹦跳跳。

explains.en: A farm animal has horns and a beard. It eats grass and leaves. Its young is called a kid.
This animal can climb rocky hills. It may give milk. A person may keep one on a farm.
A male or female farm animal has a short tail. It eats plants. Some people make cheese from its milk.

examples.en: The ring is made of gold.
examples.zh: 這枚戒指是金製的。

examples.en: She found a gold coin in the garden.
examples.zh: 她在花園裡找到一枚金幣。

examples.en: The medal was bright gold.
examples.zh: 這面獎牌是亮金色的。

explains.en: A shiny yellow metal is used for jewelry. It does not rust easily. People may give rings made from it.
This metal is valuable. A person may wear it around a neck. Coins can be made from it.
A bright yellow color has this name. A medal may be made from this metal. People dig it from the ground.

examples.en: The golden leaves fell in autumn.
examples.zh: 金黃色的葉子在秋天落下。

examples.en: He won a golden medal.
examples.zh: 他贏得一面金牌。

examples.en: It was a golden chance to learn.
examples.zh: 這是學習的絕佳機會。

entries.definition: 金色的；金黃的；珍貴的；極佳的

explains.en: It describes a color like yellow metal. A ripe wheat field may look this way. It can also mean excellent.
A prize may have this bright color. A person may have a very good opportunity. The word can describe something special.
This word means yellow and shiny. A medal for first place may look this way. It can also mean very good.

examples.en: A goose swam across the pond.
examples.zh: 一隻鵝游過池塘。

examples.en: The goose laid an egg.
examples.zh: 那隻鵝下了一顆蛋。

examples.en: We saw a goose near the farm.
examples.zh: 我們在農場附近看到一隻鵝。

explains.en: This is a large water bird with a long neck. Its feathers may be white, gray, brown, or a mix of colors. Its young is called a gosling.
This water bird may live on a farm. It has webbed feet. A group can make a loud honking sound.
A person may roast this bird for a holiday meal. It has feathers and a broad bill. It can fly.

examples.en: The mayor governs the city.
examples.zh: 市長治理這座城市。

examples.en: A king governed the land long ago.
examples.zh: 很久以前一位國王統治這片土地。

examples.en: People choose leaders to govern them.
examples.zh: 人們選擇領導者來治理他們。

explains.en: It means leading a place or group. A leader may make laws. The word can also mean controlling behavior.
A country’s leaders may make decisions. A person may guide a team. This action means leading or directing.
This word means ruling or directing. A city can be led by a mayor. Rules can guide how people act.

examples.en: The government introduced subsidies to encourage electric scooter purchases.
examples.zh: 政府推出補助方案以鼓勵民眾換購電動機車。

examples.en: Citizens expect the government to maintain public safety and economic growth.
examples.zh: 國民殷切期盼政府能全力維護社會公共安全並促進經濟繁榮發展。

examples.en: Local government agencies work around the clock during severe typhoons.
examples.zh: 地方政府各防救災機關在強烈颱風侵襲期間日以繼夜全力值勤應變。

explains.en: The leaders of a country make laws and provide services. People may vote for them. They work in offices.
A country has leaders who make choices for many people. They may run schools and roads. Citizens pay taxes.
This group manages a nation or city. It can create rules. People may elect some of its leaders.

examples.en: The gradual change took several weeks.
examples.zh: 這項逐漸的改變花了好幾週。

examples.en: Her health showed gradual improvement.
examples.zh: 她的健康逐漸改善。

examples.en: The gradual slope was easy to climb.
examples.zh: 這段平緩的斜坡很容易爬。

explains.en: It means happening little by little. A child may learn a skill over time. A change can be slow.
A plant grows bit by bit. A person may feel better after rest. This word means taking place in steps.
This word describes a slow change. A person may get stronger over many weeks. It does not happen all at once.

examples.en: Ancient proverbs remind us to cherish every single precious grain of rice.
examples.zh: 「誰知盤中飧，粒粒皆辛苦」，古老農耕智慧時刻提醒著我們應當常懷感恩、珍惜每一粒珍貴米糧。

examples.en: Nutritionists advise incorporating whole grains like brown rice and rolled oats into your diet.
examples.zh: 權威營養學專家極力建議在日常三餐中多方攝取糙米、黑米與大燕麥等未精緻全穀雜糧穀物。

examples.en: Take his dramatic courtroom exaggerations with a grain of salt because he likes attention.
examples.zh: 對於他在法庭上過度戲劇化且誇大其詞的說法請抱持懷疑態度（半信半疑），因為他向來愛博眼球。

examples.en: Applying transparent oil brings out the swirling golden grain and natural character of solid walnut.
examples.zh: 塗刷上一層清澈護木油，能將胡桃木天然交織的如流水般優美年輪木紋完美顯透。

examples.en: Always sand parallel to the wood grain to avoid leaving visible cross-scratches on the surface.
examples.zh: 進行砂磨作業時務必順著木材紋理平行打磨，以避免在木頭表面留下難以消除的橫向刮痕。

examples.en: Whole wheat bread contains all parts of the natural grain, providing abundant dietary fiber and nutrients.
examples.zh: 全麥麵包保留了天然穀物顆粒的所有部分，能為人體提供豐富的膳食纖維與微量營養。

examples.en: Luthiers look for straight, evenly spaced annual grain lines with zero runout across the soundboard.
examples.zh: 製琴師精挑細選緊密筆直、間距均勻且完全無偏斜的天然「年輪木紋」（Grain）來打造面板。

examples.en: Golden fields of wheat grain swayed gently beneath summer sunshine across the rolling plains.
examples.zh: 盛夏燦爛金黃的陽光灑滿連綿起伏的平原，無邊無際的成熟小麥麥浪隨風泛起金色漣漪。

examples.en: Sanding along the natural wood grain prevents unsightly scratches from ruining the tabletop finish.
examples.zh: 順著木材天然生長的纖維木紋方向進行細緻砂磨，能徹底防止粗暴刮痕破壞桌面平整漆面。

entries.definition: 糧食穀物；一粒米；微量；原木天然年輪木紋；紋理；密集筆直對稱之面板年輪木紋；穀物

explains.en: A farmer grows this plant for food. It can be wheat, rice, or corn. Small pieces may be called kernels.
People grind it to make flour. A bowl of rice is one kind. A person can see a small speck on a table.
This word can mean a food plant. It can also be one tiny piece. Wood has lines that show its texture.

examples.en: The apple weighs about one hundred grams.
examples.zh: 這顆蘋果大約重一百公克。

examples.en: Add ten grams of sugar.
examples.zh: 加入十公克的糖。

examples.en: The letter weighed less than a gram.
examples.zh: 這封信不到一公克重。

explains.en: A small unit is used to measure weight. A paper clip may weigh one. A short form is written after a number.
A recipe may need a certain weight of flour. One is a very small amount. A scale can measure it.
This metric measure is one thousandth of a kilogram. A person may use it for food. A small candy may weigh several.

examples.en: They stayed in a grand hotel.
examples.zh: 他們住在一間豪華飯店。

examples.en: The parade was a grand event.
examples.zh: 遊行是一場盛大的活動。

examples.en: She has grand plans for the future.
examples.zh: 她對未來有宏大的計畫。

entries.definition: 宏偉的；壯麗的；盛大的；重大的；一千元（口語）

explains.en: It means large and impressive. A person may live in a large old home. The word can also mean very good.
A party may have a lot of food and guests. A person can feel joy about a success. This word describes something large or fine.
This word means large, impressive, or important. A hotel may have a large entrance. A person may feel proud of a great achievement.

examples.en: Kyoho grapes grown in Changhua are juicy and sweet.
examples.zh: 彰化種植的巨峰葡萄多汁又香甜。

examples.en: Wash the whole bunch of purple grapes thoroughly with clean water.
examples.zh: 用清水把整串紫葡萄徹底清洗乾淨。

examples.en: Dried grapes are known as raisins and make tasty snacks.
examples.zh: 曬乾的葡萄被稱為葡萄乾，是美味的零食小點心。

explains.en: A small round fruit grows in bunches on a vine. It may be green or purple. People can make juice from it.
A person may eat this sweet fruit fresh. Raisins are dried ones. A farm may grow it in rows.
This fruit has a thin skin and seeds. It can be used to make juice. A bunch may hang from a plant.

examples.en: The shop clerk greeted every customer with a smile.
examples.zh: 店員面帶微笑向每一位顧客打招呼。

examples.en: Dogs wag their tails excitedly to greet their owners coming home.
examples.zh: 狗狗興奮地搖尾巴迎接回家的主人。

examples.en: In many cultures, bowing is a traditional way to greet elders politely.
examples.zh: 在許多文化中，鞠躬是向長輩禮貌致意的傳統方式。

explains.en: It means saying hello to someone. A person may smile and wave. A host can meet a visitor at the door.
A teacher may say hello to a class. A person can meet a friend warmly. This action shows kindness.
This word means meeting someone in a friendly way. A person may wave. A shop worker can say hello to a buyer.

examples.en: Language learning sparks profound personal growth, expanding both your intellect and emotional maturity.
examples.zh: 語言學習能激發深刻的「個人內在成長」（Personal Growth），讓你的智識維度與情感成熟度全面昇華。

examples.en: Stepping outside your comfort zone is the single most reliable catalyst for career growth.
examples.zh: 勇敢踏出舒適圈去擁抱未知挑戰，是推動個人職涯實現飛躍式突破成長最可靠的催化劑。

examples.en: Economic analysts forecast steady long-term growth across renewable technology sectors.
examples.zh: 經濟分析專家預測，在各項綠能與再生科技領域中，將迎來持續而穩健的長期市場成長。

entries.definition: 不斷突破自我、實現心智蛻變之個人內在成長；成長

explains.en: It means getting bigger or better. A child grows taller each year. A plant makes new leaves.
A business may become larger. A person can learn new skills. This word means increase or progress.
This word describes change over time. A town may have more homes. A person may become stronger.

examples.en: The guard stood by the door.
examples.zh: 警衛站在門邊。

examples.en: A dog guards the house at night.
examples.zh: 狗晚上守著房子。

examples.en: The guard checked our tickets.
examples.zh: 警衛檢查了我們的票。

entries.definition: （名）守衛；警衛；防護；（動）守衛；看守；保護。

explains.en: A person who protects a place has this job. They may stand by a door. A dog can protect a home.
A worker may watch a building at night. The person helps keep others safe. This word can mean protection.
This person may protect a museum or bank. A parent can protect a child. The word also means watching carefully.

examples.en: Taiwanese guava sprinkled with plum powder is tasty.
examples.zh: 台灣芭樂灑上梅子粉非常美味。

examples.en: Crunchy guava is packed with more vitamin C than most citrus fruits.
examples.zh: 爽脆的芭樂富含比多數柑橘類水果更高的維生素 C。

examples.en: She sliced a fresh guava and packed it in her lunchbox.
examples.zh: 她切了一顆新鮮芭樂並裝進便當盒中。

examples.en: Crisp Yanchao Pearl guavas sprinkled with sweet plum powder make a refreshing snack.
examples.zh: 來自高雄燕巢泥火山沃土培育出的鮮脆珍珠芭樂切片後撒上一層酸甜梅子粉，滋味無比生津。

examples.en: Fresh guava boasts an exceptionally high concentration of vitamin C compared to citrus fruits.
examples.zh: 新鮮芭樂中所蘊含的天然維生素 C 含量冠絕群雄，其濃度遠遠超越了傳統的柑橘與檸檬。

examples.en: Night market vendors display pyramids of freshly sliced guava seasoned with licorice and salt.
examples.zh: 台灣各大夜市現切水果攤位前，總陳列著一座座撒上甘草鹽、水潤脆口的新鮮芭樂切片金字塔。

entries.definition: 芭樂；番石榴；珍珠芭樂；芭樂 (Guava)

explains.en: A tropical fruit has green or yellow skin. Its inside may be pink or white. It has many small seeds.
A person may eat this fruit with salt. It grows on a small tree. The juice can be sweet.
This fruit is often round. A cook may make juice or jam from it. Its smell is strong and sweet.

examples.en: We prepared a warm welcome for our dinner guests.
examples.zh: 我們為晚餐賓客準備了熱情的款待。

examples.en: The luxury resort offers complimentary breakfast and fruit bowls to hotel guests.
examples.zh: 這家豪華度假飯店為飯店住客提供免費精緻早餐與迎賓水果盤。

examples.en: A world-famous author appeared as the special guest speaker at the literary seminar.
examples.zh: 一位舉世聞名的作家作為特別受邀貴賓出席了這場文學研討會。

explains.en: A person invited to a home or event is this. The host may offer food. A hotel may have many.
A friend may come to stay for a night. The person is invited. A party can have many of them.
This word means a visitor who is invited. A host may greet the person. They may be given a seat and food.

examples.en: The friendly local guide showed us around Tainan.
examples.zh: 親切的在地導遊帶領我們遊覽台南。

examples.en: Follow this step-by-step user guide to install the software correctly.
examples.zh: 請依照這份逐步操作指南來正確安裝軟體。

examples.en: A mentor can guide young professionals toward achieving their career goals.
examples.zh: 一位良師能指引年輕職場新鮮人邁向實現職業目標。

examples.en: Automated guided vehicles (AGVs) transport heavy containers quietly between the quay and storage yards.
examples.zh: 全電動無人自動導引搬運車，安靜無聲穿梭於碼頭與堆場之間。

examples.en: Buried transponders and magnetic floor markers guide driverless transport vehicles along harbor tracks.
examples.zh: 預先埋設於地面下的射頻發報晶片與磁性感應標記，引導無人搬運車沿著專屬安全路線行駛。

examples.en: The port management software guides crane operators to pick the exact container scheduled for export.
examples.zh: 智慧碼頭作業軟體自動引導起重機吊具，分秒不差鎖定並吊取排定出口的目標貨櫃。

examples.en: Custom synthetic single guide RNA navigates the editing complex directly to the mutated disease gene.
examples.zh: 客製化人工「單一導航 RNA」（Guide RNA sgRNA），能精準引導剪刀複合體降落至突變致病基因位點。

examples.en: An experienced local mountain guide escorted the hiking group across the treacherous glacier pass.
examples.zh: 一位經驗豐富的在地高山嚮導，安全護送整支登山隊伍順利穿越險象環生的冰川隘口。

explains.en: It means how much something matters. A person may care about family. A small detail can matter a lot.
A teacher may explain why a rule matters. A kind act can have meaning. This word names value or meaning.
This word describes how much value something has. A person may give it care. A major fact can matter greatly.

examples.en: The view was impressive from the top.
examples.zh: 從頂端看到的景色令人印象深刻。

examples.en: She gave an impressive speech.
examples.zh: 她發表了一場精彩的演說。

examples.en: The building is tall and impressive.
examples.zh: 這棟建築高大又壯觀。

entries.definition: 令人印象深刻的；令人讚嘆的。

explains.en: It means causing people to admire. A singer may perform well. A tall building can look grand.
A person may do something that makes others feel amazed. A view can be beautiful. This word describes something notable.
This word means very good or amazing. A student may do excellent work. A large waterfall can leave people amazed.

examples.en: Practice can improve your writing.
examples.zh: 練習可以改善你的寫作。

examples.en: Her health improved after a rest.
examples.zh: 休息後她的健康狀況改善了。

examples.en: Adopting structured bedtime habits will significantly improve both sleep quality and daytime mental focus.
examples.zh: 養成規律的睡前習慣將大幅改善並提升睡眠品質與白天的專注力。

explains.en: It means making something better. A student can practice reading. A person may fix a weak skill.
A plan may get better after feedback. A person can work on health. This word means making progress.
This action means changing for the better. A worker may learn a new skill. A product can be made better.

examples.en: The price includes breakfast.
examples.zh: 價格包含早餐。

examples.en: The box includes three books.
examples.zh: 盒子裡包含三本書。

examples.en: Please include your name on the form.
examples.zh: 請在表格上填寫你的名字。

explains.en: It means having something as part of a group. A box may hold toys. A meal can have rice.
A book may have pictures. A bag can hold a lunch. This word means having something inside.
This word means to have or contain. A team may have five players. A list can name many items.

examples.en: Higher education often leads to higher average annual income.
examples.zh: 高等教育通常能帶來較高的年均所得。

examples.en: Freelancers must file taxes accurately on all freelance income.
examples.zh: 自由接案者必須就所有接案收入確實誠實申報稅額。

examples.en: Many retirees rely on pension income and investment dividends.
examples.zh: 許多退休人士仰賴退休金收入與投資股利維生。

examples.en: Freelancers often manage fluctuating monthly income through smart saving.
examples.zh: 自由接案工作者通常透過聰明的儲蓄策略來因應每月起伏的收入。

examples.en: Families below the national average income threshold qualify for childcare subsidies.
examples.zh: 所得低於全國家戶平均收入門檻的弱勢家庭，具備申請育兒育嬰津貼的資格。

examples.en: Real estate rent provides a steady source of passive income for retirees.
examples.zh: 不動產房產租金為廣大退休族群提供了穩健可靠的被動收入來源。

explains.en: It means money a person gets. A worker is paid for a job. A family can plan how to spend it.
A person may get money from work. A shop earns money by selling goods. This word means money received.
A worker may bring money home. A person can also get money from rent. It is used for bills and food.

examples.en: The number of students increased this year.
examples.zh: 今年學生人數增加了。

examples.en: Prices increased after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨後價格上漲了。

examples.en: We saw an increase in visitors.
examples.zh: 我們看到訪客增加了。

entries.definition: （動）增加；增長；提高；（名）增加；增幅

explains.en: It means becoming greater in number or amount. A plant may grow taller. The price of food can go up.
A person may add more to a group. A child’s height can change. This word means a rise.
This action makes a number larger. A town may have more homes. A person can get more pay.

examples.en: Indeed, the cake was delicious.
examples.zh: 確實，這個蛋糕很好吃。

examples.en: He is indeed a kind person.
examples.zh: 他確實是個善良的人。

examples.en: The job was harder than I thought, indeed.
examples.zh: 這份工作確實比我想的更難。

entries.definition: 的確；確實；真正地；（用於強調）甚至。

explains.en: It means truly or without doubt. A person may agree with a fact. The word can show surprise.
A speaker may say something is true. A friend may be surprised by good news. The word means really.
This word can mean in truth. It may add strong feeling. A person may use it to agree.

examples.en: Financial independence gives you the power to choose work based on joy, not survival.
examples.zh: 實現財務獨立（Financial Independence）賦予了您完全依循個人熱情而非為了餬口而工作的底氣。

examples.en: Citizens gathered across the capital city to celebrate the nation's 50th Independence Day.
examples.zh: 全國各地的廣大群眾紛紛走上首都廣場與林蔭大道，熱情歡慶國家獨立建國五十週年的光輝國慶。

examples.en: Encouraging children to tidy their toys promotes early independence and responsibility.
examples.zh: 從小耐心鼓勵幼兒在玩耍後自己收拾玩具歸位，能從小扎根培養孩子的自主獨立性與責任感。

examples.en: Harnessing domestic volcanic heat strengthens national energy independence and security.
examples.zh: 充分開發本土源源不絕的火山地熱資源，能顯著強化海島國家的戰略安全與「能源獨立自主」（Independence）。

examples.en: Learning basic budgeting and cooking helps college freshmen develop healthy personal independence.
examples.zh: 學會日常量入為出的財務記帳與親手烹煮三餐，有助於大一新鮮人培養健全自信的獨立生活能力。

examples.en: Citizens celebrated the historic anniversary of their nation's democratic independence with colorful parades.
examples.zh: 全國熱情民眾聚集在首都寬闊的林蔭大道兩旁，揮舞旗幟歡慶國家重獲自由民主獨立建國的歷史紀念日。

examples.en: Producing green fuel from domestic sunshine and sea wind bolsters our island nation’s energy independence.
examples.zh: 利用本土陽光與海風自產純淨綠氫，顯著增強了海島國家在面對地緣政治時的「能源獨立自主」（Independence）。

examples.en: Young teenagers naturally yearn for personal financial and emotional independence as they grow older.
examples.zh: 隨著身心逐步成長茁壯，處於青春期的少男少女心中自然而然會產生渴望經濟自主與生活獨立的強烈渴望。

examples.en: Citizens celebrated national independence day with colorful parades, marching bands, and dazzling night fireworks.
examples.zh: 全國各縣市男女老少攜手熱情歡慶國家獨立紀念日，街頭舉行盛大踩街嘉年華、儀隊行進表演與璀璨奪目的國慶焰火秀。

entries.definition: 財務獨立；自主獨立；提升海島國家自主自給自足綠色能源獨立自主；多元綠氫進口與在地自產結合強化國家能源獨立；獨立

explains.en: It means being free to make one’s own choices. A country may rule itself. A person can live alone.
A child may learn to do a task without help. A nation may be free from another. This word names freedom.
This word means not controlled by others. A person can make their own choices. A nation can govern itself.

examples.en: She became independent at eighteen.
examples.zh: 她十八歲時開始獨立。

examples.en: This is an independent shop, not part of a large chain.
examples.zh: 這是一家獨立商店，不屬於大型連鎖店。

examples.en: He wants to live an independent life.
examples.zh: 他想過獨立的生活。

entries.definition: 獨立的；自主的；獨立經營的

explains.en: It means not needing help or control. A person may live alone. A country can govern itself.
A child may do homework without help. A group may make its own choices. This word means free or separate.
This word describes a person who can act alone. A nation may make its own laws. It can mean not connected.

examples.en: The arrow indicates the exit.
examples.zh: 箭頭指示出口。

examples.en: Dark clouds indicate rain.
examples.zh: 烏雲預示著下雨。

examples.en: Please indicate your choice on the form.
examples.zh: 請在表格上標示你的選擇。

explains.en: It means showing something clearly. A sign may point toward a door. A face can show a feeling.
A number may tell the answer. A person can point at a place. This word means giving a sign or clue.
This action means pointing out or showing. A thermometer gives a temperature. A map can show a route.

examples.en: Each individual needs a ticket.
examples.zh: 每個人都需要一張票。

examples.en: The group supports individual choice.
examples.zh: 這個團體支持個人選擇。

examples.en: She spoke to each individual student.
examples.zh: 她和每一位學生交談。

entries.definition: （形）個別的；個人的；獨特的；（名）個人；個體

explains.en: It means one person, not a group. A person may choose a shirt. The word can also mean special.
A single member of a team has this role. A person may have their own needs. This word means one by one.
This word refers to one person or thing. A person can make a choice alone. It may describe a unique item.

examples.en: The technology industry is a core pillar of Taiwan's GDP.
examples.zh: 科技產業是台灣國內生產毛額（GDP）的核心支柱。

examples.en: Eco-tourism is an increasingly lucrative green industry for island nations.
examples.zh: 生態旅遊對海島國家而言是一項極具商機潛力的綠色朝陽產業。

examples.en: Government incentives encourage digital transformation across the service industry.
examples.zh: 政府各項獎勵措施積極輔導鼓勵服務業全面推動數位轉型升級。

explains.en: People make or sell goods in this kind of work. Farming is one example. A city may have many businesses.
A group of businesses makes similar products. People may work in travel or food. This word describes a kind of business.
This word names a type of work or business. Factories make goods. Many people have jobs in one area.

examples.en: Her words influenced his choice.
examples.zh: 她的話影響了他的選擇。

examples.en: The teacher had a strong influence on me.
examples.zh: 老師對我有很大的影響。

examples.en: Music can influence how we feel.
examples.zh: 音樂會影響我們的感受。

explains.en: It means the power to change what someone thinks or does. A friend can give advice. A leader may affect a group.
A person may change someone’s mind. A song can affect a mood. This word names an effect.
This power can shape choices. A parent may guide a child. A famous person may affect many fans.

examples.en: The pen ran out of ink.
examples.zh: 這支筆沒墨水了。

examples.en: She wrote her name in blue ink.
examples.zh: 她用藍墨水寫下自己的名字。

examples.en: The printer needs more ink.
examples.zh: 印表機需要更多墨水。

explains.en: A dark liquid is used for writing or printing. A pen holds it. A printer may use several colors.
A writer makes marks with a pen. A spilled bottle can leave a stain. The liquid may be blue or black.
This fluid gives color to letters. A printer sprays it onto paper. A person may refill a pen.

examples.en: He insisted on carrying the bag.
examples.zh: 他堅持要提那個包包。

examples.en: She insisted that the answer was correct.
examples.zh: 她堅持答案是正確的。

examples.en: They insisted on helping us.
examples.zh: 他們堅持要幫助我們。

explains.en: It means saying firmly that something must happen. A person may repeat a request. A child can keep asking.
A worker may say a rule is important. A person can strongly ask for help. This word means refusing to give up a view.
This action means holding firmly to an idea. A parent may ask a child to be careful. A person may keep asking for an answer.

examples.en: For instance, a dog can learn many tricks.
examples.zh: 例如，狗可以學會很多把戲。

examples.en: This instance shows why rules matter.
examples.zh: 這個例子說明規則為何重要。

examples.en: There was one instance of heavy rain.
examples.zh: 曾有一次下大雨。

explains.en: It means one example of something. A person may point to a dog as one. The word can also mean a particular time.
A teacher may give one example. A person may recall a moment. This word means a single case.
This word names one example or event. A story can describe one case. It can also mean a short time.

examples.en: The instant the bell rang, class began.
examples.zh: 鐘聲一響，課程就開始了。

examples.en: She sent an instant reply.
examples.zh: 她立刻回覆。

examples.en: The instant coffee was easy to make.
examples.zh: 即溶咖啡很容易沖泡。

entries.definition: （形）立即的；速溶的；（名）瞬間；片刻。

explains.en: It means happening right away. A person may get an answer at once. A photo can appear quickly.
A person may feel an immediate need. A small meal can be ready in a moment. This word means at once.
This word means very soon. A button may cause a quick change. A message can arrive right away.

examples.en: We didn't take a taxi; we walked to the museum instead.
examples.zh: 我們沒有搭計程車，而是選擇走路去美術館。

examples.en: Don't waste energy complaining about the rainy weather; read a captivating book instead.
examples.zh: 別再把寶貴的精神力氣耗費在抱怨陰雨連綿的天氣上；反之，不妨捧讀一本好書。

examples.en: He decided not to buy a new smartphone and invested the savings in index funds instead.
examples.zh: 他打消了換購全新旗艦手機的念頭，轉而將省下來的這筆錢全數投入指數基金。

explains.en: It means choosing another thing. A person may drink water rather than juice. A different path may be taken.
A child may read a book rather than watch TV. The word can mean as a replacement. It shows another choice.
This word means in place of something else. A person can walk rather than drive. It can introduce a new choice.

examples.en: Follow the instructions on the box.
examples.zh: 按照盒子上的說明操作。

examples.en: The teacher gave clear instructions.
examples.zh: 老師給了清楚的指示。

examples.en: Read each instruction before you begin.
examples.zh: 開始前先讀每一項說明。

explains.en: It means telling someone what to do. A teacher may give steps for homework. A sign can show how to exit.
A person may follow steps to build a toy. A doctor can say how to take medicine. This word can mean directions.
This word names a direction or order. A student may listen carefully. A manual can explain each step.

examples.en: The violin is a musical instrument.
examples.zh: 小提琴是一種樂器。

examples.en: The doctor used a small instrument.
examples.zh: 醫生使用了一個小器具。

examples.en: She plays several instruments.
examples.zh: 她會演奏好幾種樂器。

explains.en: A tool for making or playing music is this. A piano is one kind. A doctor may use a small tool.
A band plays music using many objects. A scientist may measure things with a tool. This word means a tool or device.
This word can mean a music tool. It can also mean a tool used for a task. A violin makes sound.

examples.en: The internal parts of the machine were broken.
examples.zh: 機器的內部零件壞了。

examples.en: She felt internal pain after the fall.
examples.zh: 跌倒後她感到內部疼痛。

examples.en: The company changed its internal rules.
examples.zh: 公司更改了內部規定。

explains.en: It means inside the body or organization. A person may feel pain inside. A company can have private rules.
The inner parts of a computer are not seen from outside. A family may have private matters. This word means within.
This word describes something inside. A body has inner organs. A group may have its own rules.

examples.en: They joined an international science project.
examples.zh: 他們參加了一項國際科學計畫。

examples.en: The international flight was delayed.
examples.zh: 國際航班延誤了。

examples.en: She enjoys international food.
examples.zh: 她喜歡各國料理。

entries.definition: 國際的；跨國的；世界各國之間的。

explains.en: It means between countries. A flight may travel from one nation to another. A group may have members from many places.
A sports game can have teams from different nations. A business may sell goods around the world. This word means involving many countries.
This word describes something shared by nations. A law may apply across borders. People from many countries can join.

examples.en: I use the internet to search for school information.
examples.zh: 我使用網際網路來搜尋學校資訊。

examples.en: Fast and reliable internet access is essential for remote work.
examples.zh: 高速穩定的網路連線對遠端工作至關重要。

examples.en: You can browse recipes and watch cooking videos on the internet.
examples.zh: 你可以在網路上瀏覽食譜並觀看烹飪影片。

examples.en: High-speed fiber-optic internet is widely accessible across Taiwan.
examples.zh: 光纖寬頻高速網路在全台灣各地都非常普及。

examples.en: The internet revolutionized how humanity communicates and accesses information.
examples.zh: 網際網路徹底革新了人類溝通與獲取資訊的方式。

examples.en: Make sure not to share personal financial secrets over unsecured public internet networks.
examples.zh: 請確保切勿在未加密的不安全公共網路上透露個人財務機密。

examples.en: The future quantum internet will interconnect distributed quantum computers into a unified planetary cloud.
examples.zh: 未來的全球量子互聯網，將把分散在世界各地的量子電腦無縫串聯成行星級雲端算力。

examples.en: Quantum internet architectures will enable distributed quantum sensing networks of unprecedented sensitivity.
examples.zh: 全球量子互聯網基礎設施，將催生出靈敏度前所未見的跨洲分散式量子大地與天文觀測感測網絡。

examples.en: Connecting quantum processors via an optical quantum internet unlocks collaborative multi-node computing.
examples.zh: 透過光纖量子互聯網將分散各地的量子晶片即時互聯，能解鎖跨節點分散式量子協同運算的無限潛力。

entries.definition: 網際網路；網路；全球超安全量子互聯網通訊網絡

explains.en: People use this global network to find information. A computer or phone can connect to it. Websites are part of it.
A person may send messages over a worldwide network. People can shop and learn there. A phone needs a signal.
This network connects computers around the world. A person can read news or watch videos. It helps people communicate.

examples.en: Let me introduce my new classmate, David.
examples.zh: 讓我來介紹我的新同班同學，大衛。
