examples.en: Please take two minutes to introduce yourself to the interview panel.
examples.zh: 請花兩分鐘時間向面試官小組做自我介紹。

examples.en: The tech company plans to introduce innovative eco-friendly products next quarter.
examples.zh: 這家科技公司計劃於下季度推出創新的環保產品。

explains.en: It means telling people who someone is. A person may bring a friend to meet a family. A school may bring a new idea.
A host may tell a guest a person’s name. A teacher can show a topic to a class. The word means making known.
This action makes two people meet. A person may tell a name. A company can bring a new product to buyers.

examples.en: The introduction explains the book’s main idea.
examples.zh: 導言說明這本書的主要想法。

examples.en: His introduction was short and friendly.
examples.zh: 他的介紹簡短又友善。

examples.en: Read the introduction before chapter one.
examples.zh: 先讀導言再讀第一章。

explains.en: It is the first part of a book or talk. A person may say hello before sharing facts. It can explain what comes next.
A teacher may begin a lesson with a short opening. A book can tell its subject at the start. This word means an opening.
This word names a beginning section. A person may introduce a speaker. It can give background information.

examples.en: The gate is made of iron.
examples.zh: 這個大門是鐵製的。

examples.en: She ironed her shirt before work.
examples.zh: 她上班前熨燙襯衫。

examples.en: Iron is used to build bridges.
examples.zh: 鐵常用來建造橋梁。

explains.en: This is a strong gray metal used to make tools and other objects. It can rust when exposed to air and water. People mix it with small amounts of other materials to make steel.
The same noun names a tool with a flat bottom that gets hot. People move it over clothes to make them smooth. It needs care because its hot surface can burn skin.
As a verb, this means to smooth clothes using a heated tool. A shirt is spread out on a board before the tool moves over it. The heat helps remove wrinkles from the cloth.

examples.en: Strawberry jam on toast is my favorite breakfast.
examples.zh: 吐司抹草莓果醬是我最愛的早餐。

examples.en: We were stuck in a heavy traffic jam on the highway for hours.
examples.zh: 我們在高速公路上的嚴重塞車中受困了好幾個小時。

examples.en: Grandma boiled sweet ripe blueberries to make homemade fruit jam.
examples.zh: 奶奶將香甜成熟的藍莓熬煮成果醬。

explains.en: Fruit can be cooked with sugar to make a spread. Heavy traffic means cars cannot move. A machine can also get stuck.
A sweet fruit spread goes on bread. A road may be full of cars. The word can mean a stuck place.
This word can mean a sweet spread or a road delay. People may put it on toast. Cars can become stuck.

examples.en: I jog around the park each morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上在公園慢跑。

examples.en: She went for a jog before breakfast.
examples.zh: 她早餐前去慢跑。

examples.en: He jogged slowly beside the river.
examples.zh: 他在河邊慢慢慢跑。

explains.en: It means running slowly for exercise. A person may do it around a park. It is slower than sprinting.
A runner can move at an easy pace. A person may do it each morning. Good shoes can help.
This exercise is a slow kind of running. It can help the heart. A person may do it alone or with a friend.

examples.en: The knee is a joint in the leg.
examples.zh: 膝蓋是腿部的一個關節。

examples.en: They formed a joint project.
examples.zh: 他們組成了一個共同計畫。

examples.en: The two boards meet at a joint.
examples.zh: 兩塊木板在接合處相連。

entries.definition: （名）關節；接合處；（形）共同的；聯合的。

explains.en: Two bones meet at this place. A person can bend an arm. The word can also mean a shared effort.
A knee is one example. A person may join a team with another. This word means a place where parts meet.
This word can mean a body connection point. It can also describe two groups working together. A door may have one part that bends.

examples.en: She writes in her journal every night.
examples.zh: 她每天晚上都在日記裡寫字。

examples.en: The journal reported the news.
examples.zh: 這份日報報導了這則新聞。

examples.en: He kept a journal during the trip.
examples.zh: 他旅行期間寫日記。

explains.en: This can be a book where someone writes about daily life. A person may record what happened at school. They can add their thoughts and feelings.
This can be a publication with articles about a particular subject. Scientists may publish their studies in it. Other people can read about the results.
A traveler may keep a written record of a trip. Each page can describe a different day. Looking back at the pages helps the traveler remember the journey.

examples.en: The impartial judge listened carefully to testimony from both parties.
examples.zh: 公正無私的法官仔細聆聽雙方當事人的證詞。

examples.en: A panel of experienced pastry chefs was invited to judge the baking contest.
examples.zh: 大會特別邀請了一組資深甜點烘焙名廚，擔任本次烘焙大賽的專業評審。

examples.en: Don't judge a person’s character merely by their exterior appearance.
examples.zh: 評斷一個人的品德與為人，切勿僅憑其表面外貌就輕易妄下論斷。

explains.en: A person who decides cases in a court has this job. A contest may have one who scores. The word can also mean making an opinion.
A court worker listens to facts. A sports event may have someone who checks rules. The person can decide what is fair.
This person makes a decision in court. They may also score a contest. As an action, it means deciding.

examples.en: The judge made a fair judgment.
examples.zh: 法官做出了公平的判斷。

examples.en: She used good judgment in the storm.
examples.zh: 她在暴風雨中做了明智的判斷。

examples.en: His judgment was based on the facts.
examples.zh: 他的判斷是根據事實做出的。

explains.en: It means an opinion made after thinking. A person can choose after looking at facts. A court may give one.
A person may make a choice about a plan. A teacher can check a student’s work. The word can also mean good sense.
This word names a choice or opinion. A judge may decide a case. A person can use good sense.

examples.en: The judicial court aims to uphold justice and fairness for all citizens.
examples.zh: 司法體系旨在為全體國民捍衛社會公平與正義。

examples.en: Victims of financial fraud demanded legal justice and proper restitution.
examples.zh: 金融詐騙案件的無辜受害者要求嚴懲罪犯，討回司法正義與合理賠償。

examples.en: Social justice advocates campaign to protect underprivileged groups from exploitation.
examples.zh: 致力於社會正義的倡議人士積極奔走，保護弱勢弱勢群體免遭不當剝削。

examples.en: John Rawls argued that true social justice protects the basic rights of the most disadvantaged citizens.
examples.zh: 政治哲學家羅爾斯在《正義論》中深刻闡述：真正的社會正義（Justice），必須優先捍衛最弱勢族群的基本人權。

examples.en: The dedicated detective spent a decade pursuing cold case clues to deliver justice for the murder victim.
examples.zh: 熱血刑警長達十年如一日鍥而不捨追查陳年冷案懸案線索，終為含冤九泉的受害者家屬伸張遲來的公道與正義。

examples.en: Lady Justice is traditionally portrayed blindfolded, holding a balanced scale and a double-edged sword.
examples.zh: 在西方雕塑傳統中，正義女神通常雙眼蒙布象徵不徇私情，左手平端天平衡量曲直，右手緊握正義雙刃利劍。

examples.en: Forensic science is a powerful shield in the tireless societal pursuit of truth, fairness, and justice.
examples.zh: 現代鑑識科學是人類社會在不懈追求真理、公平與公理正義道路上最強大的守護之盾。

examples.en: Society expects the judicial system to deliver swift and impartial justice to every citizen alike.
examples.zh: 民主法治社會殷切期盼司法審判體系能為每一位公民伸張迅速、不偏不倚的實質公理正義。

examples.en: Justice is not merely punishing wrongdoers, but ensuring the truly innocent are never wrongly convicted.
examples.zh: 司法正義絕非僅止於嚴懲作奸犯科之徒，更在於全力築起防線，確保真正無辜的人民絕不遭受絲毫冤屈。

entries.definition: 正義；司法；公正；羅爾斯正義論（公平即正義）；矢志捍衛真理追求公理正義與司法公正

explains.en: It means treating people fairly. A judge may protect people’s rights. A person can ask for fair treatment.
A court system applies rules. People may work for fairness. This word means what is fair and right.
This idea means fairness. A person may defend the rights of others. A court can make a fair decision.

examples.en: The zookeeper is the keeper of the lions.
examples.zh: 動物園管理員照料獅子。

examples.en: The keeper locked the gate at night.
examples.zh: 管理員晚上鎖上大門。

examples.en: She is the keeper of the family photos.
examples.zh: 她保管著家庭照片。

entries.definition: 看守人；管理員；飼養員；守門員

explains.en: A person who looks after animals or a place has this role. A zoo may have one. A key holder can watch a building.
A person may care for a garden or park. A zoo worker feeds animals. This word means someone who keeps or protects something.
This person takes care of a place or animal. They may watch a gate. A family can have a pet caretaker.

examples.en: Put some ketchup on the fries.
examples.zh: 在薯條上加一些番茄醬。

examples.en: The ketchup bottle is almost empty.
examples.zh: 番茄醬瓶快空了。

examples.en: He likes ketchup with his burger.
examples.zh: 他喜歡漢堡配番茄醬。

explains.en: A red sauce is made from tomatoes. People put it on fries. It may be sweet and sour.
A bottle of this sauce may sit on a table. A person can add it to a burger. It is made from tomatoes and spices.
This thick red sauce adds flavor to food. A child may dip fries in it. It often comes in a squeeze bottle.

examples.en: The bag weighs one kilogram.
examples.zh: 這個袋子重一公斤。

examples.en: She bought a kilogram of apples.
examples.zh: 她買了一公斤蘋果。

examples.en: The child gained one kilogram this month.
examples.zh: 這個孩子這個月增加了一公斤。

explains.en: A unit measures how heavy something is. One thousand grams make one. A scale can show it.
A bag of flour may weigh one of these units. It is a metric measure. A short form is kg.
This unit is used to measure weight. A person may weigh fruit at a store. It equals one thousand grams.

examples.en: There is a lack of clean water.
examples.zh: 乾淨的水不足。

examples.en: His lack of sleep made him tired.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足讓他很累。

examples.en: The team lacked enough players.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍缺少足夠的球員。

explains.en: It means not having enough of something. A person may run low on money. A room can have no chairs.
Too little sleep can make a person tired. A dry area may have little rain. The word means a shortage.
This word describes something missing. A person may need help. It can mean not enough.

examples.en: The lady smiled at the child.
examples.zh: 那位女士對孩子微笑。

examples.en: A kind lady helped us cross the road.
examples.zh: 一位好心女士幫我們過馬路。

examples.en: The young lady wore a red coat.
examples.zh: 那位年輕女士穿著紅色外套。

explains.en: A polite title for a woman is this. A person may use it when greeting someone. It can also mean a woman of good manners.
A young woman may be called this politely. A shop worker may greet her. The word can be formal.
This word names a woman or girl in a polite way. A person may use it in a letter. It can also mean a woman of high social position.

examples.en: A ladybug landed on the flower.
examples.zh: 一隻瓢蟲停在花上。

examples.en: The child found a ladybug in the garden.
examples.zh: 孩子在花園裡找到一隻瓢蟲。

examples.en: Ladybugs eat small plant pests.
examples.zh: 瓢蟲會吃小型植物害蟲。

explains.en: A small red insect has black spots. It can fly. Gardeners like it because it eats pests.
This tiny beetle may land on a leaf. Its wings are often red with black dots. Children may enjoy seeing one.
A farmer may welcome this helpful insect. It eats tiny plant pests. Its spotted wings are bright.

examples.en: The lamb stayed close to its mother.
examples.zh: 小羊待在媽媽身邊。

examples.en: A lamb has soft white wool.
examples.zh: 小羊有柔軟的白羊毛。

examples.en: The farmer fed the young lamb.
examples.zh: 農夫餵食那隻小羊。

explains.en: A young sheep is this animal. It may drink milk from its mother. A person can cook meat from it.
A baby sheep has soft wool. It can walk soon after birth. It may live on a farm.
This young farm animal has a short tail. It may stay near its mother. People may see it in spring.

examples.en: Motorcyclists should stay inside the dedicated scooter lane.
examples.zh: 機車騎士應行駛在機車專用道內。

examples.en: Vehicles must signal before changing into the passing lane.
examples.zh: 車輛在變換至超車道前必須打方向燈。

examples.en: A quaint stone lane wound through the historic mountain village.
examples.zh: 一條古雅的石板小巷蜿蜒穿過這座歷史悠久的山村。

examples.en: Dedicated barrier-separated bike lanes make daily bicycle commuting safe, breezy, and enjoyable.
examples.zh: 設置實體分隔島保護的 YouBike 專用自行車道（Bike Lane），讓市民每天單車綠色通勤更加安全愜意。

examples.en: The highway patrol pulled over a reckless driver weaving dangerously across the fast lane without signaling.
examples.zh: 國道公路警察巡邏車在高速公路上及時攔停了一輛在內側超車快車道上連續蛇行且未打方向燈的危險車輛。

examples.en: Strolling hand-in-hand down the quiet tree-lined cobblestone lane brought back sweet college memories.
examples.zh: 倆人手牽著手漫步在鋪滿鵝卵石、綠樹成蔭的靜謐社區小巷弄內，腦海中湧現出大學青蔥歲月的美好回憶。

entries.definition: 車道；小巷；航線；YouBike 專用自行車道

explains.en: A narrow road in a city is this. Cars may travel in one part of a road. A pool swimmer can stay in a marked path.
A small path goes between houses. Drivers follow marked paths. A bowling ball rolls along one.
This word can mean a narrow street. It can also mean a marked path for traffic or sports. A person may live beside one.

examples.en: Children carry glowing animal-shaped paper lanterns in the park.
examples.zh: 小朋友們在公園裡提著發光的可愛生肖紙燈籠。

examples.en: Red cloth lanterns hung outside traditional courtyard homes create a cozy ambiance.
examples.zh: 三合院老宅門外懸掛的大紅布燈籠營造出溫馨懷舊的氛圍。

examples.en: In the past, night watchmen carried oil-lit lanterns to guide their patrol steps.
examples.zh: 在過去年代，巡夜更夫總是提著點燃油燈的小燈籠照亮巡邏夜路。

examples.en: Thousands of illuminated sky lanterns rise into the night sky over Pingxi carrying heartfelt wishes.
examples.zh: 數以萬計寫滿祝福願望的溫暖火光平溪天燈在夜空中冉冉升起，照亮元宵夜空，場面壯麗如夢似幻。

examples.en: Traditional paper lanterns painted with auspicious calligraphy hang from the eaves of the ancient temple.
examples.zh: 題寫著吉祥祈福書法的古老手繪紅紙燈籠，整齊高掛在香火鼎盛的百年媽祖古廟屋簷飛簷之下。

examples.en: Children carry glowing animal-shaped LED lanterns through neighborhood streets during the Lantern Festival.
examples.zh: 每逢元宵節慶元宵夜，孩子們手提著造型逗趣可愛的發光生肖小提燈，在社區街頭巷尾歡樂踩街遊行。

explains.en: A paper or cloth cover holds a light inside. People hang one during a festival. It can have bright colors.
A small lamp may be carried by hand. A candle can shine through thin paper. People may hang them outside.
This light is often made for a celebration. A person can carry it at night. It may be made from paper and bamboo.

examples.en: The child sat on her mother’s lap.
examples.zh: 孩子坐在媽媽的大腿上。

examples.en: The runner completed one lap.
examples.zh: 跑者完成了一圈。

examples.en: The cat lapped water from the bowl.
examples.zh: 貓用舌頭舔碗裡的水喝。

explains.en: This is the area over the upper legs of a seated person. A child may sit there. It disappears as a resting place when the person stands.
This can mean one complete trip around a race track. A runner returns to the starting point. Longer races may require several trips.
The verb describes drinking with small movements of the tongue. A cat lowers its head to a bowl. Its tongue carries liquid into its mouth.

examples.en: What is the latest news?
examples.zh: 最新消息是什麼？

examples.en: She bought the latest phone.
examples.zh: 她買了最新款手機。

examples.en: Nine is the latest time we can leave.
examples.zh: 九點是我們最晚可以出發的時間。

explains.en: It means most recent. A news story may tell what just happened. A shop may sell the newest model.
A person may ask for the newest report. The word describes something that happened near now. It can mean up to date.
This word means the newest or most recent. A phone may have new features. A newspaper carries recent news.

examples.en: The latter choice was cheaper.
examples.zh: 後者比較便宜。

examples.en: Of the two sisters, the latter is taller.
examples.zh: 兩姊妹中後者比較高。

examples.en: He chose the latter option.
examples.zh: 他選了後面那個選項。

entries.definition: 後者；兩者中的後一個；較晚的。

explains.en: It means the second of two things just named. A person may choose the later option. It contrasts with former.
Two choices may be discussed. The one named second has this label. A person may select it.
This word refers to the second item in a pair. A speaker may compare two books. The second one is meant.

examples.en: Everyone must obey traffic safety laws.
examples.zh: 每個人都必須遵守交通安全法規。

examples.en: Isaac Newton formulated universal scientific laws explaining gravity and motion.
examples.zh: 艾薩克·牛頓創立了闡釋萬有引力與物體運動的普遍科學定律。

examples.en: She studied constitutional law at university to become a public interest attorney.
examples.zh: 她在大學研讀憲法，志在成為一名維護公眾利益的人權律師。

examples.en: Everyone is equal before the law in a constitutional democracy.
examples.zh: 在憲政民主體制下，法律之前人人平等。

examples.en: Drivers who violate traffic laws face heavy fines and point deductions.
examples.zh: 違反道路交通安全法規的駕駛人將面臨高額罰鍰與駕照違規記點。

examples.en: Sir Isaac Newton formulated the fundamental universal laws of motion.
examples.zh: 艾薩克·牛頓爵士確立了奠定現代物理學基礎的萬有運動定律。

explains.en: Rules made by a country or city guide behavior. A police officer may enforce them. A person can study them.
A country has rules people must follow. A court decides if they were broken. The word can also mean a rule in science.
This word means a rule made by government. A person may hire a lawyer. A scientist can describe a natural rule.

examples.en: Lay the baby gently in the crib.
examples.zh: 輕輕把嬰兒放進嬰兒床。

examples.en: Hens lay eggs every day.
examples.zh: 母雞每天都下蛋。

examples.en: She laid the book on the table.
examples.zh: 她把書放在桌上。

explains.en: It means placing something down gently. A person may put a baby in bed. Eggs come from a hen.
A worker can place a book on a table. A bird may make an egg. The word can also mean telling a plan.
This action means setting something down. A person may put out clothes for tomorrow. A hen produces an egg.

examples.en: Good leadership helped the team succeed.
examples.zh: 良好的領導力幫助團隊成功。

examples.en: She showed leadership during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間她展現了領導能力。

examples.en: The school teaches leadership skills.
examples.zh: 學校教授領導技巧。

explains.en: It means guiding a group. A person may help a team choose a goal. A leader can make decisions.
A good leader listens to others. A group may need a person to guide it. This word means the skill of leading.
This word names the ability to lead. A manager may guide workers. A coach can help a team.

examples.en: A green leaf fell from the tree.
examples.zh: 一片綠葉從樹上掉下來。

examples.en: The leaf changed color in autumn.
examples.zh: 那片葉子在秋天變色。

examples.en: She pressed a leaf inside the book.
examples.zh: 她把一片葉子夾在書裡。

entries.definition: 葉子；葉片；（書的）一頁；翻頁

explains.en: A flat green part grows from a plant. It uses sunlight to help the plant live. It may fall in autumn.
A tree has many of these parts. They can be green, yellow, or red. A person may press one in a book.
This plant part grows on a stem. It takes in light. It can change color in fall.

examples.en: The legal voting age was officially lowered to eighteen years old.
examples.zh: 法定投票年齡已正式依法調降至十八歲。

examples.en: The company consulted their legal advisor before signing the international partnership.
examples.zh: 該公司在簽署這份跨國戰略合作協議之前，先行徵詢了常年法律顧問。

examples.en: You have a legal obligation to declare all overseas income when filing taxes.
examples.zh: 依法納稅申報所得時，公民負有申報所有海外合法所得的法定責任。

explains.en: This describes something allowed by law. A driver needs the right license. Driving with that license and following the rules is permitted.
This can describe work connected with laws. A lawyer helps people understand rules. The advice concerns rights and duties.
This can describe documents used in matters of law. An agreement may set out duties for two people. Both people may sign it.

examples.en: Could you lend me fifty NT dollars for the bus?
examples.zh: 你能借我五十元新台幣搭公車嗎？

examples.en: Can you lend a helping hand to carry these heavy science equipment boxes?
examples.zh: 你能搭把手幫忙搬運這些沉重的實驗器材箱嗎？

examples.en: The municipal library lends audiobooks and digital tablets to registered members.
examples.zh: 市立圖書館向註冊會員借出有聲書與數位平板。

examples.en: My brother kindly lent me his laptop for my online class.
examples.zh: 我哥哥好心把他的筆電借給我上線上課程。

examples.en: Banks are often reluctant to lend money to unproven startups.
examples.zh: 銀行往往不願意借貸資金給未經證實的新創公司。

examples.en: Could you please lend a hand with moving this heavy sofa?
examples.zh: 你能幫忙伸手搬一下這張沉重的沙發嗎？

examples.en: Banks lend money to creditworthy entrepreneurs starting green businesses.
examples.zh: 銀行將資金借貸給具備良好信用且開創綠能事業的創業家。

examples.en: Could you please lend me your umbrella until the torrential rain stops?
examples.zh: 你能先把雨傘借我撐一下，直到這場傾盆大雨停歇嗎？

examples.en: Historical stone walls lend a uniquely charming character to the old city street.
examples.zh: 古樸滄桑的石頭城牆為這座老城街道增添了一股獨具魅力的歷史風情。

explains.en: It means giving something to someone for a short time. A person may share a book. The item should come back.
A friend may give a little money and ask for it later. A library can give books to readers. This action means letting someone use something.
This action gives an item for temporary use. A person may let a neighbor use a tool. The item is expected back.

examples.en: The length of the table is two meters.
examples.zh: 這張桌子的長度是兩公尺。

examples.en: Measure the length of the rope.
examples.zh: 量一下繩子的長度。

examples.en: The dress is the right length.
examples.zh: 這件洋裝長度剛好。

explains.en: This is the distance from one end to another. A ruler can measure a pencil. The result tells how long it is.
This can describe how long an event lasts. A short song takes a few minutes. A film usually lasts much longer.
This can refer to a piece cut from a longer item. A worker cuts some rope for a job. The piece must reach between two posts.

examples.en: Fast prime lenses with wide apertures create breathtaking portraits with creamy blur.
examples.zh: 配備超大光圈的頂級大光圈定焦鏡頭能拍出主體極其銳利、背景如奶油般化開的人像。

examples.en: Keep your camera lens clean using a microfiber cloth and specialized optical spray.
examples.zh: 平常請養成使用超細纖維拭鏡布與專用光學清潔液定期擦拭相機鏡頭的好習慣。

examples.en: A wide-angle lens allows you to capture sweeping mountain vistas and vast horizons.
examples.zh: 超廣角鏡頭能讓你在畫面中一次納入連綿起伏的壯麗高山全景與浩瀚開闊的地平線。

entries.definition: 相機鏡頭；鏡片；隱形眼鏡

explains.en: A camera has glass that helps make a clear picture. A person may wear one in glasses. It can focus light.
This clear piece may be part of a camera or glasses. It helps eyes see. A photographer can change it.
A camera may need a special glass part. A person can use one in an eye aid. It bends light.

examples.en: She has a liberal view of art.
examples.zh: 她對藝術有開放的看法。

examples.en: The school offers a liberal education.
examples.zh: 這所學校提供多元教育。

examples.en: He is liberal with his praise.
examples.zh: 他不吝於稱讚。

entries.definition: 開明的；自由派的；寬宏的；豐富的

explains.en: It means open to new ideas. A person may support change. The word can also mean generous.
A person may be willing to listen to many views. A school can offer many choices. This word may describe broad thinking.
This word describes someone who supports new ideas. A person may accept change. It can also mean not strict.

examples.en: Put the lid on the pot.
examples.zh: 把鍋蓋蓋上。

examples.en: The jar lid was hard to open.
examples.zh: 罐子的蓋子很難打開。

examples.en: She lifted the lid from the box.
examples.zh: 她掀開盒蓋。

explains.en: A cover goes on top of a jar or pot. It keeps food inside. A person can lift it off.
A cup may have a covering. A pan has one to keep heat inside. The word means a top cover.
This item closes a container. A bottle may have one. A person can remove it to get what is inside.

examples.en: The elevator can lift heavy boxes.
examples.zh: 電梯可以搬運重箱子。

examples.en: He gave me a lift to school.
examples.zh: 他開車載我去學校。

examples.en: Lift your hand if you know the answer.
examples.zh: 知道答案的話請舉手。

entries.definition: （動）舉起；抬起；提升；解除；（名）電梯；搭便車；舉起

explains.en: It means raising something up. A person may move a box off the floor. A building may have a device for moving people between levels.
A worker may raise a heavy bag. A chair can move a person up. The word can also mean a ride in someone’s car.
This action takes something higher. A crane can move a beam. A passenger may ride in a car with another person.

examples.en: Rain is likely this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午可能會下雨。

examples.en: She is likely to arrive soon.
examples.zh: 她可能很快就會到。

examples.en: It is likely that the game will end early.
examples.zh: 比賽可能會提早結束。

explains.en: It means something may happen. Dark clouds can mean rain. A person is not fully sure.
A team may have a good chance to win. The result is not certain. This word shows that an event may occur.
This word means expected or probable. A bus may arrive soon. A person can make a strong guess.

examples.en: There is a limit to how much we can carry.
examples.zh: 我們能搬運的東西有上限。

examples.en: The speed limit is fifty miles per hour.
examples.zh: 速限是每小時五十英里。

examples.en: The teacher set a time limit for the test.
examples.zh: 老師為考試設定了時間限制。

explains.en: This is the greatest amount allowed. A bag may be allowed to weigh only ten kilograms. Anything heavier goes beyond the rule.
This can mean a boundary. A fence may mark the end of a property. The land beyond it belongs to someone else.
The verb means keeping something within a certain amount. A parent may allow only a short time for games. The child stops when that time ends.

examples.en: Click the link to open the page.
examples.zh: 點擊連結開啟頁面。

examples.en: The bridge links the two towns.
examples.zh: 這座橋連接兩個城鎮。

examples.en: There is a link between sleep and health.
examples.zh: 睡眠和健康之間有關聯。

explains.en: It means a connection between places or ideas. A bridge joins two roads. A website may point to another page.
A chain joins pieces together. A person may connect to the internet. This word can mean a relationship.
This word can mean joining two things. A road may connect towns. A computer has a path between devices.

examples.en: Water is a clear liquid.
examples.zh: 水是一種透明液體。

examples.en: The liquid spilled from the bottle.
examples.zh: 液體從瓶子裡灑出來。

examples.en: Pour the liquid into a cup.
examples.zh: 把液體倒進杯子裡。

explains.en: It can flow and take the shape of a cup. Water is one kind. Milk is another.
A substance may pour from a bottle. It may be thick or thin. This word means not solid or gas.
Water and juice belong to this group of materials. You can pour them into a glass. They spread out to fill the bottom of the container.

examples.en: The listener enjoyed the radio show.
examples.zh: 聽眾很喜歡這個廣播節目。

examples.en: Each listener heard the same story.
examples.zh: 每位聽眾都聽到同一個故事。

examples.en: She is a careful listener.
examples.zh: 她是一位專心的聽眾。

explains.en: A person who listens to a program or speech has this role. A radio show may have many. They can learn new facts.
A person may pay attention to a speaker. Music can have fans who listen. This word names someone hearing a program.
This person hears a story or talk. A teacher may speak to a group. The word can describe people using a podcast.

examples.en: The liver helps clean the blood.
examples.zh: 肝臟有助於清潔血液。

examples.en: Too much alcohol can hurt the liver.
examples.zh: 過量酒精會傷害肝臟。

examples.en: The doctor checked his liver.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查了他的肝臟。

explains.en: A large organ in the body cleans the blood. It is on the right side under the ribs. A doctor may check it.
This body part helps digest food. Some animals eat it. It works inside the body.
A person has one of these organs. It helps remove harmful things from blood. Alcohol can hurt it.

examples.en: The truck carried a heavy load.
examples.zh: 卡車載著沉重的貨物。

examples.en: She put the load on the cart.
examples.zh: 她把貨物放到推車上。

examples.en: The washing machine can handle a large load.
examples.zh: 洗衣機可以洗大量衣物。

entries.definition: （名）負載；一批物品；（動）裝載；載入

explains.en: This is the amount carried by a person or vehicle. A truck may carry boxes. Their total weight affects how the truck moves.
This can mean a set of items handled at one time. Dirty clothes go into a washing machine together. The machine washes that group in one cycle.
The verb means putting things into a vehicle or container. Workers place bags inside a plane. The plane is then ready for the trip.

examples.en: The local school is near my house.
examples.zh: 當地學校在我家附近。

examples.en: We bought local fruit at the market.
examples.zh: 我們在市場買了當地水果。

examples.en: A local shop opened on the corner.
examples.zh: 轉角開了一家當地商店。

entries.definition: （形）當地的；本地的；局部的；（名）當地居民

explains.en: It means from or in the nearby area. A shop may sell food from nearby farms. People may know one another.
A person may live in a nearby town. A group can help people in its area. This word means not far away.
This word describes something in the area close by. A business may serve its town. People may use a nearby school.

examples.en: The lone tree stood on the hill.
examples.zh: 那棵孤單的樹立在山丘上。

examples.en: He was the lone person in the room.
examples.zh: 他是房間裡唯一的人。

examples.en: A lone bird flew across the lake.
examples.zh: 一隻孤鳥飛過湖面。

explains.en: It means alone. A person may walk with no one else. A tree can stand by itself.
A child may be the only person in a room. A single house may sit on a hill. The word means solitary.
This word describes one person or thing by itself. A person may sit apart. It can mean lonely.

examples.en: The airline suffered heavy financial losses during border closures.
examples.zh: 邊境封閉期間該航空公司遭受了沉重的財務虧損。

examples.en: Wearing earplugs at rock concerts prevents irreversible long-term hearing loss.
examples.zh: 參加搖滾演唱會時配戴專業防護耳塞，能防範不可逆的長期聽力受損。

examples.en: We expressed our heartfelt condolences for the sad loss of her beloved grandmother.
examples.zh: 我們對她痛失摯愛慈祥的祖母表達了最深切的由衷哀悼與不捨之意。

explains.en: It means losing something or having less. A team may not win a game. A family can feel sad after someone dies.
A store may lose money. A person may misplace a key. This word names the act of losing.
This word means something gone or lost. A team can suffer a defeat. A person may feel sadness.

examples.en: Please lower your voice in the library.
examples.zh: 請在圖書館放低音量。

examples.en: They lowered the flag at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落時他們降下旗子。

examples.en: The store lowered the price.
examples.zh: 商店降價了。

entries.definition: （動）降低；放下；（形）較低的；下方的

explains.en: This means closer to the ground than something else. A child can reach one shelf easily. Another shelf is much higher.
The verb means moving something down. A worker slowly brings a box toward the floor. The box ends below its starting place.
This action can also reduce an amount. A shop may change a price from ten dollars to eight. Customers then pay less.

examples.en: Good luck on your test.
examples.zh: 祝你考試好運。

examples.en: She had the luck to find a seat.
examples.zh: 她幸運地找到了一個座位。

examples.en: The lucky coin brought him luck.
examples.zh: 那枚幸運硬幣帶給他好運。

explains.en: Good or bad things can happen by chance. You may find money on the ground. You may also lose a game even after trying hard.
This means what happens when you cannot control the result. A person may win a prize in a draw. Someone else may not win anything.
People sometimes carry an object because they hope it will bring good things. A four-leaf clover is one example. Finding one does not promise a good result.

examples.en: English learning magazines are very helpful.
examples.zh: 英語學習雜誌非常有幫助。

examples.en: She subscribed to a monthly science magazine for young readers.
examples.zh: 她訂閱了一本適合青年讀者的科普月刊雜誌。

examples.en: You can flip through magazines while waiting in the dental clinic.
examples.zh: 在牙醫診所等候時你可以翻閱雜誌打發時間。

examples.en: This English learning magazine features interesting cultural stories.
examples.zh: 這本英語學習雜誌刊載了豐富有趣的文化故事。

examples.en: She subscribed to an interior design magazine to gather home decorating ideas.
examples.zh: 她訂閱了一本室內設計雜誌，為居家裝潢佈置汲取靈感創意。

examples.en: The doctor's clinic waiting room provides current news and science magazines.
examples.zh: 診所候診室為候診病患備妥了當期的新聞時事與科學雜誌。

explains.en: A book comes out regularly with stories and pictures. A person may read one at a doctor’s office. It can have many pages.
A monthly publication may share news or fashion. A shop sells it. A reader may collect old issues.
This printed book has articles and photos. It can be published each week or month. People may read it for fun.

examples.en: Exercise helps maintain good health.
examples.zh: 運動有助於維持健康。

examples.en: They maintain the park every week.
examples.zh: 他們每週維護公園。

examples.en: She maintains a close friendship with Anna.
examples.zh: 她和安娜維持親密的友誼。

explains.en: It means keeping something in good shape. A worker may fix a road. A person can keep a healthy habit.
A machine needs care. A person may keep a friendship strong. This word means continuing or preserving.
This action keeps something working or in good condition. A mechanic may check a car. A person can keep a promise.

examples.en: She decided to major in international business administration.
examples.zh: 她決定主修國際企業管理。

examples.en: Climate change is one of the major global challenges of our era.
examples.zh: 氣候變遷是我們這個時代所面臨的最主要全球挑戰之一。

examples.en: He decided to switch his college major from biology to software engineering.
examples.zh: 他決定將大學主修學系從生物學轉為主修軟體工程。

explains.en: It means important or large. A road can connect big cities. A student may study one main subject at college.
A person may be a main leader. A problem can need much attention. The word can mean very important.
This word describes something important. A student can focus on one subject. A road may be a main route.

examples.en: The male population in this district is slightly higher.
examples.zh: 該行政區的男性人口比例略高。

examples.en: The choir consists of thirty female and twenty-five male singers.
examples.zh: 這個合唱團由三十位女歌手與二十五位男歌手組成。

examples.en: In many bird species, the male boasts colorful plumage to attract mates.
examples.zh: 在許多鳥類物種中，雄鳥擁有鮮豔奪目的羽毛以吸引異性。

explains.en: This describes a man or boy. It can be used as a noun or a describing word. Its usual opposite is female.
This can describe an animal of the sex that can father young. A rooster belongs to this group. A hen belongs to the other group.
This label may appear on a form beside the label female. People use it to describe sex. It can apply to humans and other animals.

examples.en: She managed to finish all her homework before 9 PM.
examples.zh: 她設法在晚上九點前完成了所有功課。

examples.en: Who will manage the retail shop while the owner is away?
examples.zh: 店長不在時誰來管理這間零售店面？

examples.en: I can barely manage to wake up early on winter mornings.
examples.zh: 冬天早晨我幾乎沒辦法設法早起。

entries.definition: 管理；經營；設法做到；經營團隊

explains.en: It means guiding people or work. A person may lead a store. A team can plan how to use money.
A worker may keep a project on time. A person can find a way to finish a hard task. The word can mean leadership.
This action means leading or handling a task. A manager may guide a group. A person can find a way to succeed.

examples.en: Our project manager assigned tasks to everyone fairly.
examples.zh: 我們的專案經理公平地把任務分配給大家。

examples.en: The hotel general manager greeted guests warmly in the executive lounge.
examples.zh: 飯店總經理在行政貴賓廳親切熱情地迎接下榻貴賓。

examples.en: An effective office manager fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace culture.
examples.zh: 一位優秀得力的行政經理能營造充滿團隊協作與相互支持的工作氛圍。

explains.en: This person is in charge of work done by a team. They may plan a schedule. They also help solve problems.
A shop may have one person who guides the other workers. That person checks that customers receive help. The person may also order more goods.
A performer may hire someone to organize their career. That helper arranges jobs and meetings. The performer can spend more time practicing.

examples.en: Tainan is famous for its sweet Irwin mangoes.
examples.zh: 台南以香甜的愛文芒果聞名。

examples.en: Mango shaved ice is Taiwan's most iconic summer dessert.
examples.zh: 芒果雪花冰是台灣最具代表性的夏日甜品。

examples.en: Peel the ripe mango before cutting it into juicy cubes.
examples.zh: 將熟透的芒果削皮後再切成多汁的小丁塊。

examples.en: Tainan Yujing is world-renowned for luscious, ruby-red Aiwen Irwin mangoes.
examples.zh: 台南玉井以香氣馥郁濃烈、果肉細嫩金黃無絲、外皮艷紅如紅寶石般的頂級愛文芒果聞名遐邇。

examples.en: A towering bowl of shaved ice topped with sweet fresh mango chunks and condensed milk is iconic.
examples.zh: 一大碗堆成小山般、鋪滿香甜現切芒果丁並淋上濃郁煉乳的芒果雪花冰，是台灣夏日的招牌象徵。

examples.en: Taiwan's agricultural scientists bred distinct mango cultivars that offer unique aromas and silky flesh.
examples.zh: 台灣農業研發團隊培育出各具特色與迷人香氣的優良芒果新品種，果肉細膩如絲且甜度驚人。

entries.definition: 芒果；愛文芒果；芒果王國

explains.en: A sweet yellow fruit grows on a tree. It has a large flat pit. People may eat it fresh.
This tropical fruit has soft orange flesh. A person can make juice from it. It has green or yellow skin.
A summer fruit can be cut into slices. A smoothie may use it. It has a sweet taste.

examples.en: He spoke in a polite manner.
examples.zh: 他說話很有禮貌。

examples.en: The teacher explained the manner of doing the task.
examples.zh: 老師說明了完成任務的方式。

examples.en: Her calm manner helped the child.
examples.zh: 她冷靜的舉止幫助了那個孩子。

explains.en: It means how someone acts. A person may speak politely. The word can also mean a type of action.
A waiter may serve food in a kind way. A child may learn to say please and thank you. This word can describe a style or way of acting.
This word describes a way of doing something. A person can show respect. It can also mean a type or sort.

examples.en: Their marriage lasted for many years.
examples.zh: 他們的婚姻維持了很多年。

examples.en: The marriage ceremony was beautiful.
examples.zh: 婚禮儀式很美。

examples.en: They celebrated their tenth marriage anniversary.
examples.zh: 他們慶祝結婚十週年。

explains.en: It is a legal union between two people. A couple may celebrate each year. A wedding marks its start.
Two people may choose to live as partners. They may have a ceremony. This word names their union.
A couple may share a home and family. They can make promises at a wedding. The word means their joined life.

examples.en: They plan to marry in a garden ceremony next autumn.
examples.zh: 他們計畫明年秋天在花園婚禮中結為連理。

examples.en: He decided to marry his college sweetheart after eight years of dating.
examples.zh: 在交往八年之後，他毅然決定迎娶他的大學初戀女友。

examples.en: Traditional Taiwanese customs surround the ceremonies when two families marry.
examples.zh: 當兩家聯姻結為親家時，伴隨著許多深厚典雅的傳統禮俗。

explains.en: It means becoming a husband or wife. Two people may have a wedding. The word can be used for either person.
A couple may promise to stay together. They can make a family. This action begins a legal union.
This action joins two people as partners. A wedding may celebrate it. It can mean taking a husband or wife.

examples.en: Wearing a medical surgical mask on the MRT is a common habit.
examples.zh: 搭乘捷運時佩戴醫療外科口罩是常見的衛生習慣。

examples.en: Performers at the Venice carnival disguised their identities behind golden masks.
examples.zh: 威尼斯嘉年華會上的化裝表演者紛紛戴上華麗的金色面具隱藏真實身分。

examples.en: A fresh facial clay mask tightens pores and cleanses excess surface skin oil.
examples.zh: 敷上一層新鮮的深層淨膚泥膜能緊緻毛孔並深層清潔肌膚多餘油脂。

explains.en: A covering goes over the face. A person may wear one to protect against germs. It can also mean hiding feelings.
An actor may wear a face covering. A person can hide who they are. The word can also mean hiding a truth.
This item covers part of the face. It may help block dust. A person can use it to disguise themselves.

examples.en: The mass of the stone was two kilograms.
examples.zh: 這塊石頭的質量是兩公斤。

examples.en: A large mass of people filled the square.
examples.zh: 一大群人擠滿了廣場。

examples.en: The mass of the cake was too large.
examples.zh: 這個蛋糕的份量太大了。

explains.en: It means a large amount of matter. A stone has it. A large group of people can gather.
A crowd may fill a square. A scientist may measure matter in an object. This word can mean a group or amount.
This word can mean a body of material. A large gathering has many people. A star has a great amount of matter.

examples.en: She became a master of the piano.
examples.zh: 她成為鋼琴高手。

examples.en: The master taught the young students.
examples.zh: 那位老師教年輕學生。

examples.en: Save a master copy of the file.
examples.zh: 保留一份檔案的主副本。

entries.definition: （名）主人；大師；碩士；母帶；（動）精通；掌握；（形）主要的

explains.en: A person who has learned a skill very well has this title. A teacher may guide a group. The word can also mean a main copy.
A skilled cook may teach others. A person can have control of a subject. A copy may be used to make others.
This word can mean an expert or teacher. A person may become very skilled. It can also mean a main version of a document.

examples.en: Wipe your shoes on the mat.
examples.zh: 在墊子上擦擦鞋。

examples.en: The cat slept on a soft mat.
examples.zh: 貓睡在柔軟的墊子上。

examples.en: She put a mat under the plant pot.
examples.zh: 她在盆栽底下放了一個墊子。

explains.en: A soft piece is placed on the floor by a door. A person may wipe shoes on it. It can also mean a flat pad.
A bath room may have one to keep feet warm. A cat may sit on one. It can be made from cloth or rubber.
This item lies on a floor. It can help keep dirt outside. A person may stand on it.

examples.en: We watched an exciting soccer match on TV.
examples.zh: 我們在電視上看了一場刺激的足球比賽。

examples.en: Be cautious when striking a match near flammable objects.
examples.zh: 在易燃物附近劃火柴時一定要格外謹慎。

examples.en: Your navy blue tie matches your crisp white shirt perfectly.
examples.zh: 你的深藍色領帶與純白襯衫搭配得完美無暇。

explains.en: Two teams may play against each other. A small stick can make a fire. Clothes may have colors that look good together.
A game can have a winner. A person may strike a small wooden stick to make a flame. Two colors can go well together.
This word can mean a contest or a small fire stick. It can also mean two items that are alike. A person may play a tennis game.

examples.en: My mate came over to play tennis.
examples.zh: 我的朋友過來打網球。

examples.en: The bird found a mate in spring.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥在春天找到了伴侶。

examples.en: He shared his lunch with a mate from school.
examples.zh: 他和一位學校的朋友分享午餐。

explains.en: This can mean a friend or companion. Two people may work together. In some places it is a friendly way to address someone.
This can mean one member of a matching pair. A glove needs another glove for the other hand. The two belong together.
This can mean an animal’s breeding partner. Two birds may build a nest together. They may raise their young as a pair.

examples.en: The jacket is made of warm material.
examples.zh: 這件外套是用保暖材質製成的。

examples.en: The book contains useful material.
examples.zh: 這本書包含有用的資料。

examples.en: We bought building materials.
examples.zh: 我們買了建築材料。

explains.en: It is what something is made from. A shirt may be made of cotton. A book can give facts.
Wood is a building substance. A person may read facts about a topic. This word can mean cloth or information.
This word names a substance or information. A chair may be made from it. A report may include facts.

examples.en: The fruit is mature and ready to eat.
examples.zh: 水果成熟了，可以吃了。

examples.en: She made a mature choice.
examples.zh: 她做了一個成熟的選擇。

examples.en: The mature tree gives shade.
examples.zh: 這棵成熟的樹能提供遮蔭。

entries.definition: （形）成熟的；穩重的；（動）成熟；使成熟

explains.en: It means fully grown. A person may act with care. Fruit may be ready to eat.
A young person grows into an adult. A person can make thoughtful choices. This word can describe ripe food.
This word describes someone grown or ready. A banana may change color as it ripens. A person can behave with good judgment.

examples.en: Look up the meaning of the word in a dictionary.
examples.zh: 在字典裡查詢這個單字的意思。

examples.en: Serving underprivileged communities gave deep meaning and purpose to her life.
examples.zh: 為弱勢社區服務為她的生命賦予了深遠的意義與目標。

examples.en: The true meaning of friendship is being there through both happiness and hardships.
examples.zh: 友誼的真諦是在順境與逆境中都常伴左右。

explains.en: It is what a word or action says. A person may ask for an explanation. A sign can have a clear idea.
A sentence can share an idea. A person may find a new word in a book. This word names what something means.
This word describes an idea or purpose. A person may explain a story. A gesture can also have a message.

examples.en: What is the means of payment?
examples.zh: 付款方式是什麼？

examples.en: She has the means to travel.
examples.zh: 她有能力旅行。

examples.en: By all means, come in.
examples.zh: 當然，請進。

entries.definition: 方法；手段；財力；收入來源。

explains.en: This names a way of doing something. A bicycle is one way to travel. A bus is another.
This can refer to money or other resources a person has. A family may save enough for a holiday. Their savings make the trip possible.
This can name a tool or method used to reach a goal. A phone lets people talk across long distances. It is one way to communicate.

examples.en: Please measure the table before buying a new cloth.
examples.zh: 買新桌布前請先量一下桌子的尺寸。

examples.en: We measured two cups of flour for the recipe.
examples.zh: 我們為食譜量了兩杯麵粉。

examples.en: Prudent master carpenters always measure twice meticulously before executing any single saw cut.
examples.zh: 深思熟慮的資深木匠在進行任何單一鋸切動作前，總是會細心測量兩次。

explains.en: It means finding the size or amount of something. A person may use a ruler. The result can be written down.
A cook may check how much flour is needed. A tailor can find how long cloth is. This action means finding an amount.
This word can mean a size or amount. A ruler helps find length. A person may compare two things.
To find the size or amount of something, people compare it with units such as centimeters or liters. A ruler or cup can help. Careful reading gives accurate results.
Nico used a ruler to check how tall the plant had grown. He wrote the number in his notebook. Next week, he planned to check again.
Guessing gives an approximate idea. Using a tool gives a more exact amount. Different tools are made for different kinds of size.

examples.en: The medical team helped the child.
examples.zh: 醫療團隊幫助了那個孩子。

examples.en: She studies medical science.
examples.zh: 她研讀醫學。

examples.en: He needs medical care after the fall.
examples.zh: 跌倒後他需要醫療照護。

explains.en: It means related to health or doctors. A person may need a checkup. A clinic gives care.
A doctor may give help for an illness. A person can study health. This word describes treatment or care.
This word is connected to health. A school may have a nurse. A person may take medicine.

examples.en: The gentle piano melody helped the restless baby fall asleep.
examples.zh: 輕柔的鋼琴旋律幫助躁動的嬰兒安然入睡。

examples.en: That catchy television commercial melody has been stuck in my head all morning.
examples.zh: 那支電視廣告洗腦好記的旋律在我腦海中迴盪了一整個早晨。

examples.en: The flutist played an ancient folklore melody that sounded melancholic and pure.
examples.zh: 長笛演奏家吹奏了一首聽起來既憂傷又純淨的古老民謠旋律。

explains.en: A series of musical notes makes a pleasant tune. A child may hum one. It can be part of a song.
A flute may play a simple tune. A song has notes in a pattern. The word means a pleasing line of music.
This music has notes that sound good together. A person may remember a tune. It can repeat in a song.

examples.en: Channel memberships offer exclusive behind-the-scenes vlogs and custom emojis.
examples.zh: 加入頻道每月付費專屬會員即可享有搶先收看未公開幕後花絮與專屬徽章貼圖特權。

examples.en: She renewed her annual gym membership to stay committed to fitness goals.
examples.zh: 她續訂了一年的健身房會員會籍，以督促自己達成健康體態的目標。

examples.en: Library membership allows you to borrow up to ten books and audiobooks at a time.
examples.zh: 辦理圖書館借閱證會員資格後，你一次最多可借閱十本書籍或有聲書。

entries.definition: 頻道付費會員資格；會籍

explains.en: A person who pays to join a club has this status. They can use its services. A group may have many.
A library card may give access to a group. A person can join a gym. This word names being a member.
This status means belonging to a group. A person may pay a fee. They can enjoy benefits.

examples.en: I have fond memories of childhood camping trips in Kenting.
examples.zh: 我對童年時期在墾丁露營的時光有著美好的回憶。

examples.en: My grandfather possesses an astonishing memory and easily recites poems from memory.
examples.zh: 我祖父擁有驚人的超強記憶力，信手拈來便能不看稿熟練背誦古典詩詞。

examples.en: Upgrading your laptop's memory from 8GB to 16GB significantly speeds up multitasking.
examples.zh: 將筆記型電腦記憶體由 8GB 升級擴充至 16GB，能顯著提升多工作業運行速度。

examples.en: High Bandwidth Memory (HBM3e) stacks eight DRAM dies vertically to deliver terabytes of throughput.
examples.zh: 高頻寬記憶體（HBM）透過垂直堆疊八層高密度 DRAM 晶粒，創造出每秒數 TB 吞吐量的驚人傳輸速度。

examples.en: As grandmothers age, playing chess and engaging in storytelling helps preserve sharp episodic memory.
examples.zh: 隨著年歲漸長，鼓勵銀髮長輩規律下棋並參與社區長者說故事坊，有助於活化大腦神經並維持敏銳的記憶力。

examples.en: The team erected a granite memorial pillar in loving memory of firefighters who perished in the blaze.
examples.zh: 地方政府在綠地廣場旁莊嚴矗立起一座黑色花崗岩紀念碑，深情緬懷並致敬在那場暗夜惡火中因公殉職的英勇消防隊員。

entries.definition: 記憶；回憶；記憶體；HBM 高頻寬記憶體；記憶力

explains.en: It means what a person can remember. A smell may bring back an old day. A computer also stores information.
A person may keep facts in their mind. A photo can bring back an event. A phone has a place to store files.
This word names the mind’s ability to keep facts. It can also mean a past event someone recalls. A computer has digital storage.

examples.en: He mentioned the meeting in his email.
examples.zh: 他在電子郵件中提到了會議。

examples.en: She forgot to mention her new job.
examples.zh: 她忘了提到新工作。

examples.en: The report mentions three important facts.
examples.zh: 報告提到了三項重要事實。

entries.definition: （動）提及；說到；（名）提及；簡短的說明

explains.en: It means saying something briefly. A person may say a name during a talk. The word can also mean bringing up a subject.
A speaker may say a fact without giving many details. A person can talk about a book. This action means naming or speaking of.
This word means referring to an idea. A teacher may speak of a topic. A person can say a name.

examples.en: Send me a LINE message when you arrive.
examples.zh: 你到達時傳個 LINE 訊息給我。

examples.en: Did you receive the text message about the schedule change?
examples.zh: 你有收到關於課表異動的簡訊嗎？

examples.en: He left a thoughtful voice message wishing me good luck on the exam.
examples.zh: 他留了一則溫馨的語音留言，祝我考試順利。

explains.en: It is information sent to someone. A phone can receive one. A person may leave one after a call.
A note may tell a friend about plans. A computer can send it by email. This word can mean an idea sent between people.
This word names information sent by text or speech. A person may leave a note. A phone can show it.

examples.en: This reusable water bottle is made of food-grade metal.
examples.zh: 這款環保水壺是由食品級金屬製成。

examples.en: Magnets strongly attract objects made of iron and other metals.
examples.zh: 磁鐵會強烈吸引鐵與其他金屬製成的物體。

examples.en: The old door was reinforced with sturdy metal brackets.
examples.zh: 這扇老舊木門用堅固的金屬支架進行了加固。

explains.en: A hard substance can be used to make tools. Iron and gold are examples. It often shines.
A spoon may be made from this material. It can be shaped when hot. A person may recycle cans.
This substance is found in rocks. A factory can shape it into parts. It can be strong or soft.

examples.en: The parking meter takes coins.
examples.zh: 停車計時器接受硬幣。

examples.en: The meter showed a high temperature.
examples.zh: 儀表顯示高溫。

examples.en: A meter is a little longer than a yard.
examples.zh: 一公尺比一碼稍長。

entries.definition: 公尺；計量器；停車計時器；韻律。

explains.en: This metric unit measures distance. One hundred centimeters make one. A school desk may be about this long.
This can also be a device that measures something. A home may have one for electricity. Its reading shows how much power has been used.
A parking space may have this device nearby. A driver pays for a certain amount of time. The device shows when that time ends.

examples.en: This method is easy to learn.
examples.zh: 這個方法很容易學。

examples.en: The teacher showed us a new method.
examples.zh: 老師示範了一種新方法。

examples.en: They used a safe method to clean the glass.
examples.zh: 他們用安全的方法清潔玻璃。

explains.en: It means a way to do something. A teacher may show a better way to learn. A recipe has steps.
A worker may follow a process. A person can solve a problem in different ways. This word means a procedure.
This word names a process or way. A scientist may test an idea. A person can follow steps.

examples.en: The clock showed midnight.
examples.zh: 時鐘顯示午夜。

examples.en: We arrived home just before midnight.
examples.zh: 我們在午夜前剛好到家。

examples.en: The city was quiet at midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜時城市很安靜。

explains.en: It is twelve o’clock at night. A new day begins then. Most people are asleep.
A clock shows this time after eleven at night. A person may stay awake to see the new day begin. It is the middle of the night.
This time is halfway between evening and morning. A date changes at this point. A person may hear a clock strike twelve.

examples.en: The race was one mile long.
examples.zh: 這場賽跑長一英里。

examples.en: We walked a mile to the store.
examples.zh: 我們走了一英里到商店。

examples.en: The next town is five miles away.
examples.zh: 下一個城鎮在五英里外。

explains.en: It is a measure of distance. A road may be many of them long. A person can run one in a race.
A traveler may drive many of these. It is longer than a kilometer. A race can be about this far.
This unit measures how far places are apart. A person can walk one in a short time. It has five thousand two hundred eighty feet.

examples.en: The town museum has a room about military history.
examples.zh: 鎮上的博物館有一間介紹軍事歷史的展廳。

examples.en: Her uncle works as a military doctor.
examples.zh: 她的叔叔是一名軍醫。

examples.en: The country sent its military to help after the flood.
examples.zh: 洪水過後，該國派出軍方前往協助。

entries.definition: （名）軍隊；武裝部隊；（形）軍事的；軍用的。

explains.en: This adjective describes people, plans, or things connected with a country’s armed forces. It can also name the group of soldiers and other people who serve in those forces. The word often appears in news about training, equipment, or defense.
A family may visit a museum to learn how soldiers lived long ago. A town may hold a parade for people who served their country. These settings show how the word relates to organized forces.
This word is broader than “soldier,” which names one person in the forces. It may describe a uniform, a vehicle, or a place as well as people. It can also be a noun for the whole armed service.

examples.en: He chose Japanese as his academic minor subject.
examples.zh: 他選擇日語作為他的輔修學科。

examples.en: The car sustained only minor surface scratches in the parking lot mishap.
examples.zh: 這輛汽車在停車場小擦撞中僅受到表面輕微刮痕。

examples.en: In many countries, individuals under age eighteen are legally considered minors.
examples.zh: 在許多國家，未滿十八歲的個人在法律上均被視為未成年人。

explains.en: This adjective means small in amount, size, or importance. A small scratch on a table is not serious. The same word can name a subject studied less deeply than a main subject.
A university student may focus on science and study music as an extra subject. A small change to a plan may also be described this way. The exact meaning depends on the situation.
In law, this noun can mean a person who has not reached the age of adulthood. In other contexts, it means less important or smaller. “Major” is often the opposite when comparing subjects or issues.

examples.en: A minority of students chose the blue team.
examples.zh: 少數學生選了藍隊。

examples.en: The club welcomed members from every minority group.
examples.zh: 這個社團歡迎各個少數族群的成員。

examples.en: Only a small minority voted for the last option.
examples.zh: 只有很少一部分人投票支持最後一個選項。

explains.en: This word names a smaller part of a larger group. It is often used for people who make up less than half of a whole group. It can also describe the condition of being part of such a smaller group.
A class may have students who speak different languages at home. If only a few speak one language, they form a small part of the class. A report can compare that group with the whole class.
A smaller group may form less than half of a larger whole. The larger part is called the majority. Even a small group can have important ideas and rights.

examples.en: Look in the mirror to adjust your tie.
examples.zh: 照照鏡子調整一下領帶。

examples.en: The calm mountain lake reflected the peaks like a polished mirror.
examples.zh: 平靜的高山湖泊宛如一面打磨光滑的鏡子映照著山巒。

examples.en: She smiled at her reflection in the bathroom mirror.
examples.zh: 她對著浴室鏡子裡的自己展露微笑。

examples.en: The massive primary mirror collects faint infrared photons from the most distant corners of space.
examples.zh: 巨大的「主反射鏡」（Primary Mirror），在極低溫下匯聚來自宇宙最遙遠邊緣的微弱紅外線光子。

examples.en: Technicians polished the concave telescope mirror to nanometer precision over several months.
examples.zh: 專業光學技師耗費數月時間，將望遠鏡凹面主鏡打磨拋光至奈米級的極致精準度。

examples.en: Looking into the bathroom mirror, the tired astronomer splashed cold water on his face after an all-night session.
examples.zh: 在結束整夜通宵的觀測工作後，疲憊的天文學家看著浴室鏡子並用冷水洗了把臉。

entries.definition: 鏡子；6.5 公尺鍍金十八邊形主反射鏡

explains.en: This noun names a smooth surface that reflects an image. People use one to check how their hair or clothes look. Some machines also use curved reflective surfaces to direct light.
A bathroom may have one above the sink. A driver checks one to see traffic behind the car. The image appears because light bounces off the surface.

A window may show a faint reflection, but it is made to give a clearer image. A flat one keeps the image about the same size, while curved kinds can change it. The word can also be a verb meaning to show an image.

examples.en: Mix the flour, eggs, and milk thoroughly in a large bowl.
examples.zh: 在大碗中將麵粉、雞蛋和牛奶徹底混合均勻。

examples.en: Oil and water do not mix naturally without an emulsifier.
examples.zh: 沒有乳化劑的情況下油和水自然不會融合相溶。

examples.en: The playlist is a fun mix of pop hits and classic rock ballads.
examples.zh: 這份播放清單融合了流行金曲與經典搖滾抒情歌。

explains.en: This verb means to put things together so they become combined. It can describe stirring ingredients, blending colors, or joining sounds. As a noun, it can mean a group of things combined.
A cook may stir milk into flour to make batter. A painter can combine two colors to create a new shade. The parts come together through an action.

Some ingredients keep their shape after being combined, while others blend evenly. This word can also describe changing sound levels in a song. It often takes an object, such as “the colors” or “the batter.”

examples.en: We made a mixture of flour and water for the craft.
examples.zh: 我們把麵粉和水混合來做手工。

examples.en: The snack bag holds a mixture of nuts and raisins.
examples.zh: 點心袋裡裝著堅果和葡萄乾的混合物。

examples.en: She felt a mixture of joy and surprise.
examples.zh: 她心中又高興又驚訝。

explains.en: This noun means two or more things put together. The parts may keep their own form, like fruit in a bowl. They may also blend so that it is hard to see each part.
A cook can stir flour, eggs, and milk together before making pancakes. A child might combine red and yellow paint to make orange. Both results contain parts joined into one whole.

A blend is different from one pure substance because it has more than one part. Some blends can be separated by picking, filtering, or sorting. The word also describes a collection of different feelings or ideas.

examples.en: Mia built a model of the school from blocks.
examples.zh: 米雅用積木做了一個學校模型。

examples.en: The model walked across the stage in a bright coat.
examples.zh: 模特兒穿著鮮豔外套走過舞台。

examples.en: Our class chose him as a model student.
examples.zh: 我們班選他當模範學生。

entries.definition: （名）模型；模特兒；典範；型號；（動）示範；塑造；（形）模範的

explains.en: A small copy can represent a real object, such as a building or plane. The word can also name a person who shows clothes or products. As an adjective, it describes someone or something worthy of imitation.
A student may build a tiny house from cardboard before a real one is made. A toy car can show how a full-sized car looks. Designers use these copies to plan and explain ideas.

A small copy is usually made to represent something larger or to show how it works. A picture only shows appearance, while a working copy may move or have useful parts. Scientists also use simple versions to explain complex ideas.

examples.en: Lena was in a good mood after the game.
examples.zh: 比賽後，莉娜心情很好。

examples.en: Soft music gave the room a peaceful mood.
examples.zh: 柔和的音樂讓房間充滿平靜的氣氛。

examples.en: His mood changed when he heard the good news.
examples.zh: 聽到好消息後，他的心情改變了。

explains.en: This noun describes how someone feels at a certain time. A person may feel cheerful, quiet, or cross, and those feelings can change during the day. The word can also mean the feeling created by a song, room, or story.
A rainy afternoon may make someone feel calm and thoughtful. A funny game can help a group feel lively. People sometimes notice these feelings and choose an activity to match.

A passing feeling is different from personality, which describes qualities that tend to last. A person can have a bad day and still be kind. Music and colors can also create a certain feeling for listeners or visitors.

examples.en: Dad used a mop to clean the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 爸爸用拖把清理廚房地板。

examples.en: Please mop the small spill before someone slips.
examples.zh: 請把那灘小小的灑出物拖乾，免得有人滑倒。

examples.en: The cleaner rinsed the mop in a bucket.
examples.zh: 清潔人員在水桶裡沖洗拖把。

explains.en: This noun is a cleaning tool with a long handle and soft strands at one end. People push it across a wet floor to collect water or spread soapy water. The same word can be used as a verb for cleaning in this way.
After dinner, someone may spill juice on the kitchen floor. A worker can use this tool with a bucket to clean the wet area. It is useful on smooth floors.
A broom has stiff bristles and is mainly used on dry dirt. This tool has softer strands and is often used with water. The verb form describes the action of moving it across a floor.

examples.en: The motion of the boat made me feel sleepy.
examples.zh: 船的晃動讓我想睡覺。

examples.en: She made a motion for everyone to sit down.
examples.zh: 她做了個手勢，請大家坐下。

examples.en: The dancer’s slow motion matched the music.
examples.zh: 舞者緩慢的動作配合著音樂。

explains.en: This noun can mean a change in where something is or how it is placed. It can also name an action or gesture made by the body. In music or art, it may describe a part that seems to move.
A hand raised in class is a small action that sends a message. A dancer may turn and stretch to make graceful actions. A camera can record these changes.

This noun often refers to movement itself, while “move” can name one change from place to place. In a meeting, it can also mean a formal suggestion for a group to vote on. Meaning depends on the setting.

examples.en: Riding a heavy motorcycle requires a special license.
examples.zh: 騎乘大型重型機車需要考取專用駕照。

examples.en: He spent the entire afternoon polishing his classic motorcycle.
examples.zh: 他花了一整個下午擦拭保養他的經典重機。

examples.en: Motorcyclists should always stay vigilant at intersections.
examples.zh: 機車騎士在十字路口應隨時保持警覺。

explains.en: This noun names a two-wheeled motor vehicle that a person rides while sitting astride it. It is powered by an engine and steered with handlebars. A helmet and other protective gear help riders stay safer.
People may use this vehicle to travel through busy streets. It can carry one or two riders, depending on its design. Riders must follow traffic rules just like other road users.
A bicycle has pedals that provide its power, but this vehicle has an engine. A scooter is often smaller and may have a step-through frame. The word can cover many sizes of motor-powered two-wheelers.

examples.en: Grandpa drinks tea from his favorite mug.
examples.zh: 爺爺用他最喜歡的大杯子喝茶。

examples.en: The shop sells a mug with a picture of the moon.
examples.zh: 那家店賣印有月亮圖案的大杯子。

examples.en: She filled the mug with warm milk.
examples.zh: 她把大杯子裝滿溫牛奶。

entries.definition: 馬克杯；大杯子；（口語）臉；搶劫

explains.en: This word can name a large cup with a handle, often used for coffee or tea. It can also mean a person’s face in informal speech, though that use can sound rude. In another informal use, it names a kind of robbery.
A traveler may buy a cup decorated with a picture of a city. At breakfast, someone might pour hot cocoa into it. The handle makes it easy to hold.

A large handled cup is usually bigger and heavier than a small teacup. The face-related use is casual and should be avoided when speaking politely. The word has several meanings, so the sentence helps show which one is intended.

examples.en: The Phantom of the Opera is a legendary stage musical loved worldwide.
examples.zh: 《歌劇魅影》是一部風靡全球、傳唱不衰的傳奇經典舞台音樂劇。

examples.en: She was blessed with great musical talent and mastered the piano by age eight.
examples.zh: 她天賦異稟、具備過人的音樂才華，年僅八歲便能游刃有餘地精通鋼琴演奏。

examples.en: London's West End theaters stage internationally acclaimed musicals throughout the year.
examples.zh: 倫敦西區各大知名百年劇院常年輪番上演享譽國際的頂級原創舞台音樂劇。

examples.en: Broadway musicals combine catchy melodies, dynamic acting, and athletic dancing into thrilling spectacles.
examples.zh: 風靡全球的百老匯音樂劇（Musical）將洗腦動聽的旋律、精湛演技與高難度群舞完美融為一體。

examples.en: Tickets for the world-famous musical sold out within ten minutes of going live on the ticketing platform.
examples.zh: 這部名聞遐邇的世界巡演原版音樂劇在售票系統一開賣，短短十分鐘內全數場次票券被熱情戲迷搶購一空。

examples.en: Both siblings showed remarkable musical talent from early childhood, playing violin and piano with natural grace.
examples.zh: 這對兄妹自幼便展現出過人的音樂天賦，無論是演奏小提琴還是彈奏古典鋼琴皆流露出一派從容典雅。

entries.definition: 音樂劇；音樂的；悅耳的；百老匯音樂劇

explains.en: This adjective describes something related to songs or instruments. It can describe a person with skill or natural ability in music. As a noun, it means a show that tells a story through songs and acting.
A child might enjoy a show where actors tell a story through songs. A bird’s clear notes can sound sweet and tuneful. Both uses connect to music.

A stage show with songs is different from a play that uses only spoken lines. The adjective can describe a voice or sound, while the noun names a kind of performance. Context and grammar make the meaning clear.

examples.en: Jay Chou is one of Asia's most influential pop musicians.
examples.zh: 周杰倫是亞洲最具影響力的流行音樂家之一。

examples.en: Street musicians fill the pedestrian plazas with lively guitar music.
examples.zh: 街頭音樂家以熱情活潑的吉他音樂充滿了行人徒步廣場。

examples.en: Being a successful professional musician demands immense discipline and creative passion.
examples.zh: 成為一名成功的職業音樂家需要極大的自律與源源不絕的創作熱情。

explains.en: This noun names a person who writes, sings, or plays music. Some people perform alone, while others play in a group. They may practice for years to improve their skill.
A person who plays drums in a band has this role. Another may sing at a concert or write tunes at home. Each one works with music in a different way.
A singer uses the voice, while an instrumental performer plays an instrument. One person can do both. The word covers people who create or perform music.

examples.en: A tiny blue dot of paint landed on my nail.
examples.zh: 一小點藍色顏料沾到了我的指甲上。

examples.en: The carpenter used a nail to hang the sign.
examples.zh: 木匠用一根釘子掛起招牌。

examples.en: She had to nail the loose board back in place.
examples.zh: 她得把鬆脫的木板重新釘好。

entries.definition: （名）指甲；釘子；（動）用釘子固定；成功完成。

explains.en: This word names the hard covering at the end of a finger or toe. It can also name a thin metal point used to join pieces of wood. As a verb, it means to fasten something with such a small metal piece.
People trim the hard coverings on their fingers when they grow too long. A carpenter may tap a small metal point into a board with a hammer. The same spelling can describe both things.
The body part is made of a hard natural material and grows over time. The metal object is pointed and is used in building. Context tells readers which meaning is intended.

examples.en: The narrow bridge let only one person cross at a time.
examples.zh: 這座狹窄的橋一次只能讓一個人通過。

examples.en: We walked along a narrow path beside the garden.
examples.zh: 我們沿著花園旁的小徑走。

examples.en: Our team won by a narrow margin.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍以些微差距獲勝。

entries.definition: （形）狹窄的；勉強的；（動）使變窄；縮小

explains.en: This adjective describes something with little space from side to side. A road, hallway, or opening may be difficult to pass through when it has this shape. It can also describe a small difference or limited choice.
Two cars may need to slow down on a road between tall walls. A person carrying a wide box might have trouble getting through a small doorway. Careful steps help in a tight space.
A word meaning “wide” describes the opposite shape. A path can be long and still have little side-to-side space. It can also describe a close victory when the score difference is small.

examples.en: The nation celebrated its independence day.
examples.zh: 這個國家慶祝獨立日。

examples.en: People from every part of the nation watched the game.
examples.zh: 全國各地的人都收看了這場比賽。

examples.en: The two nations signed an agreement.
examples.zh: 兩個國家簽署了一項協議。

explains.en: This noun can mean a large group of people who share a country. The people may have a common government and live within shared borders. It can also mean a group with shared history or traditions.
Children learn about the places and people that make up their country. A flag may stand for the whole group. People can feel connected even when they live far apart.
A country may include many different communities. This term can stress the people as a whole rather than the land. Such groups can work together or disagree.

examples.en: Sun-dried natural coffees ferment slowly inside intact fruit skins, developing heavy blueberry and winey sweetness.
examples.zh: 日曬處理法讓咖啡豆在果皮內慢速日曬發酵，醞釀出濃郁的藍莓果醬與紅酒甜感。

examples.en: Workers turn the natural coffee cherries constantly on raised African beds to prevent over-fermentation.
examples.zh: 莊園工人在通風非洲高架棚架上每隔半小時翻動一次日曬鮮果，確保均勻乾燥並防止發酵過度走味。

examples.en: The thick sweetness and tropical punch of a natural processed bean makes it a favorite for espresso blends.
examples.zh: 日曬處理生豆濃厚的甜感與熱帶水果炸彈風味，使其成為頂級義式配方豆爭相採用的靈魂基底。

entries.definition: 經典非洲棚架日曬處理法 (濃郁熟果甜感) 的

explains.en: This adjective means belonging to nature or not made by people. It can describe something that happens without special effort or treatment. It may also mean normal for a person or animal.
A stream flowing down a hill is part of the world around us. A person may have an inborn ability to draw well. The word can describe the outdoors or a quality someone has from birth.

The opposite of “artificial” describes something made by people to copy or replace things from the world around us. This adjective can also describe a relaxed, unforced way of acting. Meaning changes with the noun it describes.

examples.en: The naughty puppy chewed one of Dad’s slippers.
examples.zh: 那隻調皮的小狗咬壞了爸爸的一隻拖鞋。

examples.en: He made a naughty face during the quiet lesson.
examples.zh: 安靜上課時，他做了個調皮的鬼臉。

examples.en: The teacher smiled but told the naughty boys to settle down.
examples.zh: 老師笑了笑，但叫那些調皮的男孩安靜下來。

entries.definition: 頑皮的；淘氣的；不聽話的

explains.en: This adjective describes a child who behaves badly in a playful or disobedient way. It can also describe an action that breaks a simple rule. The word is often used gently when the behavior is not serious.
A child might draw on a foggy window or hide a toy as a joke. A parent may call the action by this word while asking the child to stop. The tone can be teasing rather than angry.
This word is milder than “bad” in many family settings. It often points to small mischief instead of harm. Adults should still explain which behavior needs to change.

examples.en: Let's grab lunch at a nearby noodle shop.
examples.zh: 我們去附近的一家牛肉麵館吃午餐吧。

examples.en: Is there a public restroom or convenience store nearby where I can wash my hands?
examples.zh: 這附近是否有公共洗手間或便利商店，可以讓我稍微洗洗雙手嗎？

examples.en: Neighborhood children play soccer on the nearby elementary school sports field.
examples.zh: 住在附近的社區小朋友們，放學後常在旁邊的國小操場草地上踢足球。

explains.en: This adjective means not far away. As an adverb, it tells where something is located in relation to the speaker. It is often used to give directions or describe a place.
A store across the street may be close enough to walk to. A family can choose a table near the door. The word helps explain where one thing is.
“Next door” gives a more exact sense of closeness. This word can describe places, people, or objects. It does not tell the exact distance.

examples.en: We nearly missed the train because we walked slowly.
examples.zh: 我們走得很慢，差點錯過火車。

examples.en: The jar is nearly full of buttons.
examples.zh: 罐子裡幾乎裝滿了鈕扣。

examples.en: Her answer was nearly the same as mine.
examples.zh: 她的答案幾乎和我的一樣。

explains.en: This adverb means almost, but not completely. It tells us that something came close to happening or reaching a number. It can also show that two things are very similar.
A bus may arrive just before the rain starts. A glass may be almost full but still have room for a little more water. In each case, the result is close to the limit.
“Almost” has a similar meaning. It does not mean that an action or amount is fully complete. Speakers use it to show that a small gap remains.

examples.en: Warm clothes are necessary on a cold mountain trip.
examples.zh: 寒冷的登山旅程需要保暖衣物。

examples.en: It is necessary to wash your hands before cooking.
examples.zh: 做菜前洗手是必要的。

examples.en: A map is necessary when we visit the new park.
examples.zh: 我們去新公園時需要一張地圖。

explains.en: This adjective describes something that is needed or must be done. A rule, tool, or action may be required before another thing can happen. It can also describe something very useful in a situation.
A student needs a pencil to finish a written quiz. A ticket may be needed before someone can enter a show. These things are required for the next step.
Something needed for a purpose is more than merely nice to have. It is required for a purpose or result. The word “important” can mean valuable, but it does not always mean required.

examples.en: She wore a necklace made of wooden beads.
examples.zh: 她戴著一條木珠項鍊。

examples.en: The silver necklace was a birthday gift from her aunt.
examples.zh: 那條銀項鍊是阿姨送的生日禮物。

examples.en: He found a shell necklace at the seaside market.
examples.zh: 他在海邊市集找到一條貝殼項鍊。

explains.en: This noun names a piece of jewelry worn around the neck. It may be made from beads, metal, shells, or other small decorations. Some have a charm that hangs from a chain.
A child might make one from colored beads for a family member. Someone dressing for a party may choose a shiny chain. The decoration rests around the neck.
A chain worn at the neck is different from earrings, which are worn on the ears. It can be simple or fancy and may have personal meaning. People often give one as a gift.

examples.en: Stirring the ground coffee with a fine needle distribution tool breaks up clumps for a flat, even bed.
examples.zh: 用超細不銹鋼布粉針輕輕攪拌咖啡粉，能徹底掃除結塊並營造出平整均勻的粉床。

examples.en: The Weiss Distribution Technique (WDT) utilizes surgical needles to homogenize coffee grinds inside the basket.
examples.zh: 享譽全球的 WDT 布粉法，利用細如針灸針的極細不鏽鋼針，將粉碗內的咖啡粉徹底梳理均質化。

examples.en: Whisking with flexible needles eliminates air pockets that would otherwise turn into catastrophic channels.
examples.zh: 用彈性鋼針在粉碗中快速劃圈梳理，能掃除深藏於粉層內部的微小空隙，杜絕致命通道效應。

entries.definition: WDT 超細不銹鋼布粉針 (掃除結塊)；針

explains.en: This noun names a very thin, sharp tool used for sewing or giving medicine. One end has a point, and the other may have a tiny hole for thread. A small metal object used to knit can also have this name.
A person mending a shirt can pass thread through the small hole and stitch cloth. A nurse may use a special hollow tool to give a shot. These tools are thin and pointed.
A sewing kind has an eye for thread, while a medical kind may be hollow. Both are much thinner than a nail. The word can also describe something sharp and narrow, such as the point on a pine tree.

examples.en: The doctor said the test result was negative.
examples.zh: 醫生說檢查結果呈陰性。

examples.en: Her answer was negative, so we made another plan.
examples.zh: 她的回答是否定的，所以我們另做了計畫。

examples.en: He tried to find one positive idea in the negative review.
examples.zh: 他試著在負面的評論中找出一個正面想法。

entries.definition: （形）否定的；負面的；消極的；陰性的；（名）負數；底片

explains.en: This adjective describes an answer or sign that says no or shows that something is not present. It can also describe an attitude that focuses on problems. In photography, it names an image with reversed light and dark areas.
A test result may show that a certain thing was not found. A person may answer with a firm refusal. The meaning depends on what is being discussed.

This word can oppose “positive,” which may show yes or that something is present. In conversation, a comment of this kind may sound discouraging. A reversed-light image is a special kind of picture used to make a photograph.

examples.en: Our neighbors are very friendly and always helpful.
examples.zh: 我們的鄰居非常親切而且總是樂於助人。

examples.en: Our next-door neighbor baked homemade banana bread and shared it with us.
examples.zh: 我們的隔壁鄰居烤了手工香蕉蛋糕並熱情與我們分享。

examples.en: Good community neighbors watch out for each other's home safety during holidays.
examples.zh: 良好的社區鄰里會在假期外出時互相守望相助照顧門戶安全。

examples.en: Our next-door neighbor kindly helped water our plants.
examples.zh: 我們的隔壁鄰居好心幫忙我們澆花。

examples.en: We exchanged homemade festive cookies with our friendly neighborhood neighbors.
examples.zh: 我們與熱情親切的社區鄰居互相交換自製的節慶餅乾。

examples.en: It is wonderful having considerate neighbors who respect quiet evening hours.
examples.zh: 擁有在夜晚時分懂得輕聲細語、顧及他人的體貼鄰居真是太棒了。

explains.en: This noun means a person who lives near another person’s home. People may help one another or simply greet each other. The word can also describe nearby places or things.
A family may borrow a cup of sugar from the person next door. People on the same street may share news or help after a storm. Living close makes these everyday connections possible.
A friend is someone you know well, while a person living close by may be unfamiliar. People can become friends with those who live nearby. The word is often used in community life.

examples.en: Neither option is suitable for our travel budget.
examples.zh: 這兩個選項都不符合我們的旅遊預算。

examples.en: Neither my brother nor my sister enjoys spicy Sichuan hot pot.
examples.zh: 我哥哥和我姊姊都不喜歡吃辛辣的四川麻辣火鍋。

examples.en: He claims neither praise nor reward for his charitable deeds.
examples.zh: 他對自己所做的慈善善舉既不邀功也不索取回報。

explains.en: This word means not one and not the other when there are two choices. It is often used with “nor” to join two negative ideas. It can also answer a question about two options.

When someone is offered tea and juice but wants water, the two drinks are both unwanted. A sentence can say the person likes both choices no more than the other. The word helps express rejection of two options.
When a person rejects both choices, this word can describe the result. “None” can refer to a larger group. It is commonly paired with “nor,” though informal speech may use “or.”

examples.en: I bought a robot toy for my little nephew's birthday.
examples.zh: 我買了一台機器人玩具送給小姪子當生日禮物。

examples.en: My seven-year-old nephew loves building elaborate castles with plastic blocks.
examples.zh: 我那七歲的小外甥非常喜歡用塑膠積木搭建精緻壯麗的城堡。

examples.en: She felt immense pride watching her nephew perform in the school piano recital.
examples.zh: 看著姪子在學校鋼琴獨奏會上的優雅演出，她感到無比驕傲自豪。

explains.en: This noun names the son of someone’s brother or sister. It is also used for the son of a spouse’s brother or sister. The matching word for a girl is different.
A child may call his aunt’s son by this family name. Cousins often grow up playing together at family visits. The relationship is defined through a parent’s sibling.
This word applies to a boy or man in the family relationship. A niece is the female equivalent. The same person may be related through either side of a family.

examples.en: The dentist touched the nerve in his tooth.
examples.zh: 牙醫碰到了他牙齒裡的神經。

examples.en: It took nerve to sing alone on stage.
examples.zh: 獨自在舞台上唱歌需要勇氣。

examples.en: She had the nerve to ask the famous player for a photo.
examples.zh: 她竟有膽量向那位知名球員要求合照。

explains.en: This noun names a part of the body that carries messages between the brain and other body parts. It can also mean courage to do something difficult. In casual speech, it may describe boldness that seems rude.
A doctor checks how well messages travel through the body. A child may need courage to speak in front of the class. In both cases, people use the same short word.
