explains.en: A person you have never met is unknown to you. Children should stay near trusted adults. They should not go away with unknown people.
A visitor may be new to a neighborhood. Someone can greet them politely. It is fine to keep personal details private.
The word can also describe someone who does not know a subject well. A beginner may need help. Practice makes the activity feel familiar.

examples.en: Many families go picking strawberries in Dahu every winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天許多家庭都會去大湖採草莓。

examples.en: Fresh strawberry shortcake is a holiday favorite at the bakery.
examples.zh: 新鮮草莓蛋糕是烘焙坊在節慶期間的熱銷商品。

examples.en: She spread sweet strawberry jam generously on her morning toast.
examples.zh: 她在早晨的吐司上大方抹上香甜的草莓果醬。

explains.en: This small red fruit has tiny seeds on its outside. It grows on a low plant. Many people enjoy its sweet taste.
The fruit can be eaten fresh or added to cereal. A cook may slice it. Yogurt and berries make a quick snack.
Some kinds grow in gardens during warm weather. The leaves have three parts. Bees help the flowers make fruit.

examples.en: Cool freshwater streams in the mountains are home to river trout.
examples.zh: 山間清涼澄澈的淡水溪流是溪哥苦花魚的家園。

examples.en: We sat beside a babbling clear stream to dip our tired feet after a long trek.
examples.zh: 漫長健行跋涉後，我們坐在潺潺清溪旁將疲憊的雙腳浸泡在溪水中消暑。

examples.en: Millions of gamers stream live tournament matches simultaneously every weekend.
examples.zh: 每個週末都有數百萬名電競玩家在網路上同時串流直播錦標賽激戰。

explains.en: A small narrow river flows over land. Water moves around stones. Fish and insects may live nearby.
A steady flow of music or video can arrive through the internet. A phone or computer plays it. A strong connection helps it continue.
The word can describe a line of people or things moving along. Visitors entered in a steady flow. Each person waited their turn.

examples.en: The loud noise caused stress for the baby, so we left the room.
examples.zh: 吵鬧的聲音讓寶寶感到緊張，所以我們離開了房間。

examples.en: Put the stress on the first part when you say this word.
examples.zh: 說這個字時，重音要放在第一部分。

examples.en: Our teacher stressed the need to wash our hands.
examples.zh: 老師強調了洗手的必要性。

explains.en: Worry or pressure can make a person feel tense. A test or big change may cause this feeling. Talking to someone kind can help.
A speaker may give one part of a word extra force. Careful listening helps students hear the strong sound. Practice can improve pronunciation.
The word can also mean placing special importance on an idea. A coach may highlight teamwork. Clear examples help everyone understand.

examples.en: Stretch your leg muscles to prevent painful cramps.
examples.zh: 伸展腿部肌肉以預防痛苦的抽筋。

examples.en: A long highway stretch of road connects the two northern coastal towns.
examples.zh: 一條綿延漫長的公路路段連接了這兩座北部沿海城鎮。

examples.en: Elastic workout fabrics easily stretch to fit all body shapes comfortably.
examples.zh: 高彈力運動布料能輕鬆延展以舒適貼合各種身形。

explains.en: A person can make a muscle longer by reaching or bending gently. Athletes do this before running. Slow movement helps prevent a sudden pull.
A piece of elastic cloth can become longer when pulled. It returns to its shape afterward. Do not pull too hard.
A long area of land may extend beside a road or river. Trees line the grassy area. Families walk there on weekends.

examples.en: Our strict coach asked everyone to arrive before seven.
examples.zh: 我們嚴格的教練要求每個人七點前到。

examples.en: The library has strict rules about food near the computers.
examples.zh: 圖書館嚴格禁止在電腦附近飲食。

examples.en: A strict bedtime helps Leo wake up rested.
examples.zh: 嚴格遵守就寢時間能讓里奧醒來時精神飽滿。

explains.en: A person follows rules closely and expects others to do the same. A teacher may require quiet during a test. Clear rules can feel fair.
A schedule may allow very little extra time. Students need to arrive promptly. Planning ahead helps them be ready.
Careful limits can protect people or property. A museum asks visitors not to touch old paintings. Signs explain what is allowed.

examples.en: The clock will strike twelve at lunchtime.
examples.zh: 時鐘會在午餐時間敲響十二下。

examples.en: A bright idea struck Nina while she rode the bus.
examples.zh: 妮娜搭公車時突然想到一個好主意。

examples.en: The workers went on strike for safer working hours.
examples.zh: 工人為了更安全的工時而罷工。

entries.definition: （動）打；擊中；敲響；突然想到；（名）罷工；打擊；好球。

explains.en: A hand or tool can hit something with force. A hammer hits a nail. Careful aim keeps fingers safe.
A thought may suddenly come to someone's mind. An idea for a story can appear during a walk. Writing it down helps remember it.
Workers may stop working together to ask for better conditions. They choose a clear request. Leaders then discuss what can change.

examples.en: I struggle to reach the top shelf without a chair.
examples.zh: 我不用椅子就很難拿到最上層的架子。

examples.en: The puppy struggled to carry the large ball.
examples.zh: 小狗費力地想把大球叼起來。

examples.en: She struggled with the math problem until her brother helped.
examples.zh: 她解數學題時遇到困難，直到哥哥來幫忙。

entries.definition: （動）努力；掙扎；費力；（名）奮鬥；難事

explains.en: A person may have trouble doing something difficult. Learning a new dance takes effort. Asking for help can make practice easier.
Two people or animals may push against each other. They should stop if someone could get hurt. A grown-up can help.
A hard time may continue before things improve. Families sometimes face money problems. Friends can support one another through them.

examples.en: Maya likes to draw houses in her own style.
examples.zh: 瑪雅喜歡用自己的風格畫房子。

examples.en: This shop sells clothes in a simple style.
examples.zh: 這家店販售簡約風格的衣服。

examples.en: He styled his hair before the school photo.
examples.zh: 他在拍學校照片前整理了頭髮。

explains.en: A person's way of dressing or creating something can have its own look. Bright colors make the artist's work easy to recognize. That personal look can change over time.
A type of clothing may fit a certain event. People choose neat outfits for a wedding. Comfort matters too.
The word can describe how someone does an activity. A player may move in a graceful way. Different people have different strengths.

examples.en: We took the subway to the museum downtown.
examples.zh: 我們搭地鐵到市中心的博物館。

examples.en: Taking the subway is often significantly faster than sitting in heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 搭乘地下鐵通常比塞在壅塞的車陣中快得多。

examples.en: She grabbed an overhead handrail as the subway train sped through the tunnel.
examples.zh: 當地下鐵列車高速穿過隧道時，她抓住了頭頂上方的扶手。

entries.definition: 地鐵；地下鐵；潛水艇（較少用）

explains.en: An electric train carries people beneath busy city streets. Riders enter at stations. It can help them avoid traffic above ground.
The train follows rails through tunnels. Maps show the stops. Passengers should stand behind the safety line.
Different cities use different names for this transport system. Tickets may work for several routes. Signs help visitors find the right platform.

examples.en: You can succeed if you keep practicing your piano piece.
examples.zh: 只要持續練習鋼琴曲，你就能成功。

examples.en: The garden will succeed with enough light and water.
examples.zh: 只要有足夠的陽光和水，花園就會長得很好。

examples.en: Our class succeeded in collecting books for the shelter.
examples.zh: 我們班成功為收容所募集了書籍。

entries.definition: 成功；達成目標；接替；繼任。

explains.en: A person reaches a goal after trying and learning. Practice helps a child read a hard book. Small steps can build confidence.
A plan works when it brings the wanted result. Seeds need water and sunlight. Good care helps them grow.
Doing well does not always mean winning a prize. Helping a teammate can be an important achievement. Effort matters too.

examples.en: We wished our school team great success.
examples.zh: 我們祝福校隊獲得巨大的成功。

examples.en: Persistence, discipline, and passion are crucial keys to lasting success.
examples.zh: 堅持、自律與熱忱是通往持久成功的關鍵要素。

examples.en: The charity fundraising gala was an overwhelming commercial and social success.
examples.zh: 這場慈善募款晚會在商業與社會層面上皆獲得了空前的巨大成功。

explains.en: A goal is reached after effort and planning. A child learns to ride a bike. Each practice day brings progress.
Something that works well can be called a good result. A school play may delight the audience. The actors feel proud afterward.
People can measure achievement in many ways. Helping a friend can matter. Winning is only one possible result.

examples.en: I have never seen such a tall tree in our town.
examples.zh: 我從未在我們鎮上看過這麼高的樹。

examples.en: She enjoys such stories about brave animals.
examples.zh: 她喜歡這類描寫勇敢動物的故事。

examples.en: It was such a windy day that our hats blew away.
examples.zh: 那天風非常大，我們的帽子都被吹走了。

entries.definition: （形）這樣的；如此的；（代）這種人或事

explains.en: This word points to a kind or type already being discussed. A child may say they want that kind of toy. The listener knows which one.
It can introduce an example of a quality. A very loud sound may surprise everyone. The word helps show how strong it was.
It can refer to people or things of the same sort. These instructions help new cooks. They make each step clear.

examples.en: A sudden clap of thunder made the dog hide.
examples.zh: 突然一聲雷響，讓狗躲了起來。

examples.en: The sudden rain sent us running into the shop.
examples.zh: 突然下起雨來，我們趕緊跑進商店。

examples.en: We heard a sudden noise behind the garden wall.
examples.zh: 我們聽見花園圍牆後方突然傳來聲響。

explains.en: Something happens quickly and without warning. A loud bang may startle everyone. People look around to learn what happened.
A fast change can surprise a person. The weather may turn cold in the afternoon. Keeping a jacket nearby can help.
The word describes an event that was not expected. A guest may arrive early. The family quickly sets another place at the table.

examples.en: I suggest taking the earlier bus to avoid the crowd.
examples.zh: 我建議搭早一班公車，避開人潮。

examples.en: The teacher suggested a book about ocean animals.
examples.zh: 老師推薦了一本關於海洋動物的書。

examples.en: Dark clouds suggest that we should carry umbrellas.
examples.zh: 烏雲表示我們應該帶傘。

entries.definition: 建議；提議；暗示；使人想到

explains.en: A person offers an idea for others to consider. A friend may recommend a game for recess. The group can decide together.
A clue may point toward an answer without proving it. Dark clouds can indicate rain. People can bring an umbrella just in case.
Kind advice can help someone choose what to do. A parent may recommend taking a short break. The child still makes the choice.

examples.en: Dad wore a dark suit to the wedding.
examples.zh: 爸爸穿著深色西裝參加婚禮。

examples.en: These light shoes suit our long walk in the park.
examples.zh: 這雙輕便的鞋很適合我們在公園長時間散步。

examples.en: A heart is one suit in a deck of playing cards.
examples.zh: 紅心是撲克牌中的一種花色。

entries.definition: （名）套裝；西裝；一副牌；（動）適合；相配。

explains.en: A matching jacket and trousers are worn for work or a special event. The clothes may be made from the same fabric. People often wear one with a shirt and tie.
Something is right for a person or purpose. Comfortable shoes work well for a long walk. A choice depends on what is needed.
In card games, hearts, clubs, diamonds, and spades are groups of cards. Each group has its own small picture. Players can sort cards by these groups.

examples.en: This quiet corner is suitable for reading after lunch.
examples.zh: 這個安靜的角落適合午餐後閱讀。

examples.en: Wear suitable shoes before climbing the rocky trail.
examples.zh: 攀登多石的小徑前，請穿合適的鞋子。

examples.en: The bright room is suitable for growing small plants.
examples.zh: 這間明亮的房間適合種植小植物。

explains.en: Something fits a purpose or situation well. Warm boots are a good choice for snowy weather. Sandals may not keep feet dry.
A place can be right for an activity. A quiet room works well for reading. A playground is better for running.
People should choose objects that match their needs. A small cup fits a young child. A tall bottle holds more water.

examples.en: We had a super time building sandcastles at the beach.
examples.zh: 我們在海邊堆沙堡，玩得非常開心。

examples.en: My aunt gave me a super warm scarf for winter.
examples.zh: 阿姨送我一條非常保暖的冬季圍巾。

examples.en: This cake is super sweet and very soft.
examples.zh: 這個蛋糕非常甜，而且口感很柔軟。

entries.definition: （形）極好的；超級的；（副）非常；超級

explains.en: Something is very good or enjoyable. A child may feel excited after a fun day. Friends can share the happy news.
A prefix can show that something is above or beyond another thing. A superhero has special powers in a story. The prefix changes a word's meaning.
In casual speech, people use this word to show strong approval. A tasty meal can earn praise. A kind action deserves thanks.

examples.en: We ate vegetable soup for supper after soccer practice.
examples.zh: 足球練習後，我們晚餐吃了蔬菜湯。

examples.en: Grandma invited us to supper on Sunday evening.
examples.zh: 奶奶邀請我們星期日晚上去吃晚餐。

examples.en: I helped set the table before supper.
examples.zh: 晚餐前我幫忙擺好了餐桌。

explains.en: An evening meal is eaten near the end of the day. Families may sit together after work or school. They talk about what happened.
The meal can be simple or special. Soup and bread may be enough. A holiday meal might include several dishes.
Some families use a different word for the evening meal. Their usual time depends on work, school, and local customs. Families may eat at different times.

examples.en: Disrupted supply chains can lead to temporary product shortages.
examples.zh: 供應鏈中斷可能會導致商品暫時性缺貨。

examples.en: The city reservoir provides a reliable freshwater supply to urban households.
examples.zh: 市區水庫為整座都會區家庭提供了穩定乾淨且源源不絕的自來水供應。

examples.en: Relief teams rushed to supply clean drinking water and blankets to flood victims.
examples.zh: 救災隊伍十萬火急馳援災區，為水災災民緊急供應純淨飲用水與保暖毛毯。

explains.en: A needed amount of something is kept ready for use. A backpack may hold pencils and paper. Students can get them when class begins.
A store provides goods to people who need them. Farmers bring fresh vegetables to nearby shops. The shop then sells them to families.
The word can describe giving what is needed. Rain gives water to plants. Regular sunlight helps them grow.

examples.en: Community Supported Agriculture connects urban families directly with local organic vegetable growers.
examples.zh: 社區支持型農業模式讓都會家庭與產地小農建立信任連結，每週定期配送新鮮現採無毒蔬菜箱。

examples.en: Steel foundation pillars were driven into bedrock to support the weight of the elevated highway bridge.
examples.zh: 巨大的鋼筋混凝土橋墩深深打入堅硬的岩盤中，穩穩支撐起整座高架快速公路橋樑的驚人重量。

examples.en: Having the loving emotional support of family members gave him the strength to overcome his cancer treatments.
examples.zh: 擁有家人毫無保留且無微不至的真情陪伴與情感支持，賜予了他咬牙戰勝漫長癌症化療的勇氣與力量。

examples.en: Using hot water softens resin contact tips, allowing micro supports to snap off cleanly without gouges.
examples.zh: 將列印件浸泡在熱水中軟化接觸點，能讓微型列印支撐結構一撥即落且不留深坑凹洞。

examples.en: Strong concrete support pillars were placed strategically beneath the ceiling of the underground parking garage.
examples.zh: 在地下多功能立體停車場的天花板下方，科學佈設了數根堅固粗壯的鋼筋混凝土支撐柱作為垂直承重支柱。

examples.en: Family members offered unwavering moral and financial support while she pursued her second medical degree.
examples.zh: 在她毅然辭職重返校園攻讀第二個醫學博士學位期間，全體家庭成員給予了她毫無保留的精神鼓勵與經濟資助。

examples.en: The space station’s environmental control and life support system recycles 98% of all astronaut wastewater.
examples.zh: 太空站搭載的環境控制與生命維持系統，能將 98% 廢水循環再生。

examples.en: Modern life support infrastructure maintains cabin atmospheric pressure, oxygen levels, and humidity balance continuously.
examples.zh: 現代生命維持系統全天候維持太空艙內部大氣壓力穩定、精確配比氧氣濃度並嚴密調節濕度平衡。

examples.en: Redundant backup scrubbing canisters ensure life support never halts even during electrical bus overhauls.
examples.zh: 雙軌並行的備用二氧化碳吸收濾罐，確保即便在主供電匯流排檢修期間，生命維持循環也絕不停擺。

examples.en: Behind the exhibit walls, a sophisticated life support system operates twenty-four hours a day without pause.
examples.zh: 在展示牆背後，龐大複雜的「水族生命維持系統」（Life Support System LSS），二十四小時不間斷運轉淨化。

examples.en: Titanium rods and screws provide structural support to help the fractured bone heal correctly.
examples.zh: 外科醫師植入鈦合金骨板與骨釘提供堅固的結構支撐，協助粉碎性骨折骨骼精準對位癒合。

examples.en: Generous philanthropic donations provide vital financial support to local wildlife rescue shelters.
examples.zh: 社會各界善心人士的慷慨解囊捐款，為在地民間野生動物急難救傷庇護所提供了關鍵資金支援。

entries.definition: 社區支持型農業 (CSA 產地直送)；細心剪除列印支撐結構；支撐；環控與生命維持系統 (ECLSS 98% 水循環)；支援；水族館生命維持系統 (LSS 水質循環淨化)

explains.en: A person can help someone by listening or offering kind words. A friend may stay nearby. The person feels less alone.
A strong object holds up another thing. A table leg keeps the top steady. Braces can keep a shelf from falling.
People may agree with an idea or team and show it. Fans cheer at a game. Family members encourage a child to keep practicing.

examples.en: I suppose it is going to rain soon; look at the dark clouds.
examples.zh: 我猜快要下雨了，看看那些烏雲。

examples.en: We are supposed to submit our project assignments before Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們理應在週五下午前繳交專案作業。

examples.en: What do you suppose is the most effective method for memorizing new words?
examples.zh: 你認為記憶新單字最有效的方法是什麼？

explains.en: A person may think something is likely, but they are not fully sure. Gray clouds make them expect rain. They bring a light coat.
It can introduce an imagined situation. A teacher may ask what would happen if the lights went out. Students share possible answers.
People sometimes use it to check whether others agree. One child may ask if they should begin now. The group can answer.

examples.en: We watched people surf the waves from the sandy beach.
examples.zh: 我們在沙灘上看著人們衝浪。

examples.en: I surf the school website to find homework updates.
examples.zh: 我瀏覽學校網站查看作業更新。

examples.en: She learned to surf with an instructor in calm water.
examples.zh: 她在平靜的水域跟著教練學衝浪。

explains.en: A person rides across ocean waves while standing on a board. They wait for a suitable wave. Balance helps them stay upright.
People can also move through pages on a website. They click links and look for information. A clear goal helps save time.
The ocean activity needs practice and safety knowledge. Beginners should learn from a trained adult. They should use places suited to their ability.

examples.en: The two-dimensional surface code lattice detects data errors continuously using syndrome measurement qubits.
examples.zh: 二維表面碼晶格，利用輔助校驗位元二十四小時持續偵測並修正資料位元的微小漂移。

examples.en: Theoretical physicists favor the surface code because of its remarkably high fault-tolerance threshold.
examples.zh: 理論物理學界普遍推崇二維拓撲表面碼架構，因其具備當前所有糾錯碼中容許度最高的容錯門檻。

examples.en: Implementing the planar surface code requires a square grid of alternating data and measurement qubits.
examples.zh: 在晶片上落實平面表面碼糾錯，需要將資料量子位元與測量校驗位元以黑白棋盤般交錯緊密排列。

entries.definition: 表面碼拓撲量子糾錯晶格；表面

explains.en: The outside or top layer of something can be touched or seen. A table has a flat top. A pond has water across its top.
A hidden thing may become visible after being covered. A leaf rises in a puddle. People can notice it once it appears.
Different materials have different outer textures. Glass feels smooth. Tree bark feels rough under a careful hand.

examples.en: Carrying a basic wilderness survival kit provides reassurance in emergencies.
examples.zh: 登山大背包內始終常備一套包含求生毯、打火石與急救包的野外求生組，在關鍵時刻能拯救生命。

examples.en: Learning how to build an emergency shelter and start fire is vital for mountain survival.
examples.zh: 熟練掌握如何就地取材搭建緊急避難所與鑽木生火，是身陷荒野時保命求生的必備核心技能。

examples.en: The lone castaway's incredible story of oceanic survival captivated readers across the globe.
examples.zh: 這位海上遇難船員在浩瀚大洋上孤身漂流生還的奇蹟求生歷程，深深震撼了全球無數讀者。

examples.en: The innovative pill extended progression-free survival by an unprecedented fourteen months.
examples.zh: 這款創新口服標靶藥物將病患的「無惡化存活期」（Progression-Free Survival PFS）大幅延長了十四個月。

examples.en: Wilderness survival skills such as building a fire and purifying water save lives during mountain emergencies.
examples.zh: 鑽木取火與生水過濾消毒等野外求生技能，在高山遇險受困的關鍵時刻能夠拯救寶貴性命。

examples.en: Early mammogram screening dramatically improves breast cancer five-year survival rates across demographics.
examples.zh: 定期推動乳房攝影篩檢巡迴車服務，大幅提升了各年齡層女性乳癌患者的五年存活率。

entries.definition: 野外求生；生存生還；無惡化存活期 (PFS) 與總生存期指標；存活

explains.en: Staying alive through danger or hardship is necessary when conditions are difficult. A person may need clean water, shelter, and help from others. People prepare supplies before a difficult trip. People also help one another.
Animals have ways to find food and protect themselves. A turtle can hide in its shell. Birds may fly away from danger.
A difficult test can also be described as a matter of continuing. A team needs food and rest during a long hike. A map and warm clothing can help hikers. Planning ahead makes the trip safer.

examples.en: Some desert plants survive with very little rain.
examples.zh: 有些沙漠植物只靠很少的雨水就能存活。

examples.en: The small fish survived the trip in a cool tank.
examples.zh: 這條小魚在涼爽的水箱中撐過了旅程。

examples.en: Their old tent survived the windy night.
examples.zh: 他們的舊帳篷經受住了那個多風的夜晚。

explains.en: A person or animal stays alive after danger or illness. Finding safe shelter can help. Caring people may offer food and comfort.
Plants can keep growing through dry weather. Deep roots help them reach water. Gardeners can cover the soil to hold moisture.
A family may keep going through a hard time by helping one another. Sharing jobs makes daily life easier. They can share food and take turns resting. Working together helps everyone.

examples.en: Please chew the apple well before you swallow it.
examples.zh: 請把蘋果充分咀嚼後再吞下去。

examples.en: A swallow flew low over the quiet pond.
examples.zh: 一隻燕子低低地飛過安靜的池塘。

examples.en: He swallowed hard before speaking to the whole class.
examples.zh: 他在對全班說話前緊張地吞了吞口水。

explains.en: Food moves from the mouth down into the body after chewing. Taking small bites makes eating safer. Drinking water can help with dry food.
A small bird with pointed wings may fly quickly through the air. It catches insects while moving. Some kinds travel to warmer places in winter.
A person may hold back tears or a strong feeling. Taking a deep breath can help. Talking to someone trusted is also useful.

examples.en: My grandmother knitted a warm sweater for me.
examples.zh: 我奶奶為我織了一件溫暖的毛衣。

examples.en: This woolen sweater feels soft and keeps me warm in winter.
examples.zh: 這件羊毛毛衣觸感柔軟，讓我在冬天保持溫暖。

examples.en: Pull on a cozy sweater when sitting by the campfire.
examples.zh: 坐在營火旁時套上一件舒適的毛衣。

explains.en: A warm knitted piece of clothing covers the upper body and arms. People wear it over a shirt on cool days. It may have buttons or a zipper.
Wool, cotton, or other yarn can be used to make it. Some are light for spring. Thick ones help keep a person warm in winter.
A neck opening may be round or shaped like a V. Sleeves can be long or short. Washing instructions help keep the fabric in good shape.

examples.en: Please sweep the crumbs into a small pile after lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐後請把碎屑掃成一小堆。

examples.en: The wind swept dry leaves across the garden path.
examples.zh: 風吹著乾葉掃過花園小徑。

examples.en: Our team swept the final round by winning all three games.
examples.zh: 我們隊在最後一輪贏下全部三場比賽，橫掃對手。

explains.en: A broom moves dust and small pieces toward one place. People can then pick up the pile. This work keeps floors tidy.
A strong motion can move across an area. Wind may push leaves along a street. A brush can clear snow from a step.
A person may win every game in a series. The team must play well each time. Practice and teamwork improve its chances.

examples.en: Going for a swim in the ocean is refreshing in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天去海裡游泳令人神清氣爽。

examples.en: She learned how to swim freestyle and breaststroke during summer camp.
examples.zh: 她在夏令營期間學會了自由式與蛙式的游泳技巧。

examples.en: Dolphins can swim effortlessly at high speeds through ocean currents.
examples.zh: 海豚能毫不費力地在洋流中高速游動。

explains.en: A person moves through water by using arms and legs. A lifeguard watches swimmers at a public pool. Beginners should stay where they can stand.
The activity can exercise many muscles. People may practice in a pool, lake, or ocean. Safe places and adult supervision are important.
Some animals move through water too. Ducks paddle with their feet. Fish use fins and tails to travel.

examples.en: Put on your swimsuit and shower before entering the public pool.
examples.zh: 進入公共泳池前請換上泳衣並先淋浴沖洗。

examples.en: She packed two colorful swimsuits for her beach holiday in Kenting.
examples.zh: 她為墾丁的海灘假期打包了兩套色彩鮮豔的泳裝。

examples.en: Rinse your chlorine-soaked swimsuit with cold tap water after swimming.
examples.zh: 游泳完畢後請用冷自來水沖洗浸滿氯水的泳衣。

explains.en: This special piece of clothing is worn in a pool or at the beach. It is made from fabric that dries quickly. It should fit comfortably.
Different styles cover different parts of the body. People choose one that feels secure for swimming. A towel can help keep them warm afterward.
A clean, dry set of clothes is useful after time in water. Wearing sunscreen and following pool rules also help protect the body. Dry clothes feel better after a swim. A safe pool has clear rules.

examples.en: The children took turns on the red swing in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子們輪流坐公園裡的紅色鞦韆。

examples.en: I swing the racket to hit the ball over the net.
examples.zh: 我揮動球拍，把球打過球網。

examples.en: His mood can swing from joy to worry very quickly.
examples.zh: 他的心情可能很快從喜悅轉為擔憂。

entries.definition: （名）鞦韆；揮動；變化；（動）搖擺；揮動；盪。

explains.en: A seat hanging from ropes or chains moves back and forth. A child pumps their legs to go higher. An adult should check that it is safe.
A bat or racket moves through the air to hit a ball. Players practice their motion carefully. Good timing helps make a strong hit.
Mood or opinion can change from one side to another. Someone may feel excited, then become worried. Talking can help them understand the change.

examples.en: An engineered molecular kill switch self-destructs the bacteria if synthetic amino acids are absent.
examples.zh: 設計在菌株內部的「分子自毀安全開關」（Kill Switch），在環境缺乏特定人造氨基酸時會自動啟動毒素消滅自身。

examples.en: Please remember to flick the light switch off when you leave the conference room to conserve electricity.
examples.zh: 離開研討會議室時請隨手將室內電燈開關關閉，養成隨手節約用電與節能減碳的好習慣。

examples.en: Many consumers decided to switch from conventional gas vehicles to electric cars to save on fuel costs.
examples.zh: 為了節省長期居高不下的燃油油資開銷，許多開車通勤族紛紛決定將傳統汽油車汰換改開純電車。

entries.definition: 人工合成毒素-抗毒素自毀防逃逸安全開關；開關

explains.en: A small control can turn a light or machine on and off. A finger moves it up or down. It should be used with dry hands.
People can change from one choice to another. A rider may take a different train. Signs show where each route goes.
Two people may trade places or things. They agree on what each will receive. A fair exchange keeps both people comfortable.

examples.en: A red heart is a symbol of love on the card.
examples.zh: 卡片上的紅色愛心是愛的象徵。

examples.en: The arrow symbol points toward the nearest exit.
examples.zh: 箭頭符號指向最近的出口。

examples.en: A small star symbol marks our favorite page in the book.
examples.zh: 我們用小星號標記書中最喜歡的一頁。

explains.en: A picture or mark can stand for an idea, place, or group. A heart shape often represents love. Road signs use clear pictures to give directions.
Letters and numbers can represent sounds or amounts. A plus sign tells people to add. Children learn what each mark means at school.
A flag is a sign connected with a country or community. It helps people recognize a group during a parade or game. Its colors help fans find their team. A sign can guide visitors quickly.

examples.en: The bus system connects our town with nearby villages.
examples.zh: 公車系統連結了我們的城鎮和附近村莊。

examples.en: Our school system has a library in every building.
examples.zh: 我們的學校體系每棟大樓都有一間圖書館。

examples.en: A simple system helps me keep my desk tidy.
examples.zh: 一套簡單的方法能幫我保持書桌整潔。

entries.definition: 系統；制度；方法；身體系統

explains.en: Several parts work together in an organized way. A school schedule helps students know where to go. Each class has a time and place.
The human body has parts that do different jobs. The heart moves blood. Lungs help a person breathe.
A set of rules can guide how people do a task. A library uses a method for borrowing books. Clear steps prevent confusion.

examples.en: Grandma told us a tale about a fox and a moonlit forest.
examples.zh: 奶奶講了一個關於狐狸和月光森林的故事。

examples.en: The old tale teaches children to keep their promises.
examples.zh: 這則古老故事教孩子們要信守承諾。

examples.en: We read a funny tale before going to bed.
examples.zh: 我們睡前讀了一則有趣的故事。

explains.en: A story may describe real or made-up events. A grandparent can tell one at bedtime. It may have a lesson or surprise ending.
Old stories often pass from one generation to another. People remember the characters and places. Each family may tell the details differently.
A long, exciting story can be shared over several evenings. Listeners may wonder what will happen next. Pictures can make it easier to imagine.

examples.en: When presented with a yellow plastic target board, the trained stingray swims up calmly to receive its treat.
examples.zh: 當潛水員出示專屬的黃色圓形「塑膠標靶」（Target），受過訓練的魟魚會溫馴靠攏等待獎勵美食。

examples.en: The retail company achieved its quarterly sales target two weeks ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 該大型跨國零售企業憑藉靈活的行銷策略，提早整整兩週順利達成了本季度的業績營收目標。

examples.en: Precision medicine aims to target cancer cells selectively without damaging normal healthy tissues.
examples.zh: 當代精準標靶醫療的核心目標，在於具備選擇性鎖定消滅癌細胞的同時，完全不傷及健康人體組織。

entries.definition: 幾何圖形標靶水下動物制約行為訓練；目標

explains.en: A mark shows where a person should aim in a game. Players throw a ball toward the center. Each turn gives them another try.
A goal gives people something to work toward. A student may plan to finish a book. Small daily efforts help reach it.
Businesses may try to reach a certain group of people. They learn what that group needs. Clear messages help people understand an offer.

examples.en: Break large tasks into smaller manageable steps.
examples.zh: 將大任務拆解為較容易處理的小步驟。

examples.en: Cleaning the entire warehouse was an exhausting task.
examples.zh: 清理整個倉庫是一項令人筋疲力盡的任務。

examples.en: Each student was assigned a specific task for the event.
examples.zh: 每個學生都被分配了該活動的一項具體任務。

explains.en: A piece of work needs to be completed. A child may put toys away before dinner. Finishing one part at a time can help.
A teacher can give students a job to do. They may read a page or draw a map. Clear directions show what is expected.
People can assign work to different helpers. Each person knows their part. Sharing the load can make a big project easier.

examples.en: Carbon tax revenues are reinvested into subsidizing community solar installations and electric buses.
examples.zh: 政府將課徵碳稅（Carbon Tax）所得的公帑專款專用，全力用於補貼偏鄉社區太陽能與電動公車普及。

examples.en: Working citizens file their annual personal income tax returns online before the end of May.
examples.zh: 辛苦打拼的全體納稅義務人，依法於每年五月三十一日截止日前透過網路報稅系統申報綜合所得稅。

examples.en: Preparing for three challenging final exams in a single week heavily taxed the tired student's stamina.
examples.zh: 在短短一週內連續應付三場長達三小時的硬核期末考，極大考驗並消耗了這位疲憊學子最後的體能與意志極限。

entries.definition: 國家總量管制碳稅；徵稅

explains.en: Money that people or businesses pay to a government helps fund public services. Roads, schools, and parks may receive support from it. Public services can benefit every neighborhood. People can learn how funds are used.
A government may charge extra money for certain goods or activities. Stores show the final amount on a bill. Rules vary by place.
People can learn about payments by reading a clear form. Asking a trusted adult may help explain confusing details. Read forms with care before signing. A trusted adult can explain unfamiliar words.

examples.en: The tea master brewed fragrant Oolong tea in a clay teapot.
examples.zh: 茶藝師在紫砂茶壺中沖泡香醇烏龍茶。

examples.en: Be careful when holding the handle because the metal teapot is scorching hot.
examples.zh: 拿握把手時要小心，因為金屬茶壺非常滾燙。

examples.en: She poured boiling hot water from the kettle into the porcelain teapot.
examples.zh: 她將熱水壺裡的沸水注入瓷茶壺中。

examples.en: Yixing clay teapots enhance tea flavor by absorbing essential oils over time.
examples.zh: 宜興紫砂茶壺長年經茶水滋養，能讓沖泡出的茶湯越發香醇。

examples.en: Pour boiling water into the porcelain teapot to warm it before adding tea leaves.
examples.zh: 在投入茶葉前，先將滾燙熱水注入白瓷茶壺中進行溫壺。

examples.en: Antique glass teapots allow drinkers to admire the blossoming jasmine flowers inside.
examples.zh: 古董透明耐熱玻璃茶壺能讓茶客在品茗時靜心欣賞茉莉花球在壺中優雅舒展綻放。

examples.en: Porous purple clay Yixing teapots absorb tea oils and enhance flavor over decades.
examples.zh: 透氣性極佳的宜興紫砂茶壺能吸收茶湯精華油脂，長年泡養更能讓茶湯越發香醇。

examples.en: She poured hot water into the ceramic teapot to warm it before adding loose leaves.
examples.zh: 她在放入茶葉前先將滾燙熱水注入陶瓷小茶壺中進行溫壺，以確保泡茶溫度充沛。

examples.en: An antique cast-iron teapot sat quietly on the stove, warming the cozy dining room.
examples.zh: 一只古色古香的日本手工鑄鐵壺靜靜坐在火爐上煨著熱水，為溫馨的飯廳帶來融融暖意。

examples.en: Unglazed purple clay teapots absorb tea oils, seasoning the interior to enhance future brews.
examples.zh: 無施釉的宜興紫砂壺能吸收茶葉精華天然茶油，長年養壺後即使用熱水沖泡亦能暗香盈室。

examples.en: She rinsed the vintage clay teapot with boiling water to warm the vessel before adding dry leaves.
examples.zh: 在投入茶乾前，她先用滾燙熱水細心溫壺淋洗這把老紫砂壺，讓陶土毛細孔充分受熱甦醒。

examples.en: The English afternoon tea set arrived on a silver tray with a floral bone china teapot and scones.
examples.zh: 英式下午茶套餐端上銀製托盤，陳列著精緻的花卉骨瓷茶壺、剛出爐的司康與濃郁凝脂奶油。

entries.definition: 茶壺；紫砂壺；泡茶壺；宜興紫砂壺；手拉坏茶壺

explains.en: A handled container with a lid holds hot water and tea leaves while they steep. A small opening lets the drink pour into cups. A spout guides the drink into cups. The lid keeps leaves inside.
It can be made from ceramic, glass, or metal. A lid helps keep the heat inside. The handle stays cooler than the body.
People may serve tea to guests from this kitchen item. A strainer can catch leaves. Pour slowly to avoid spills.

examples.en: A tear rolled down Sam's cheek during the sad movie.
examples.zh: 看悲傷的電影時，一滴眼淚滑過山姆的臉頰。

examples.en: Please do not tear the picture while cutting it out.
examples.zh: 剪下圖片時請不要把它撕破。

examples.en: One tear fell from the page when I pulled too hard.
examples.zh: 我太用力拉時，紙張裂開了一道口子。

entries.definition: （名）眼淚；裂口；（動）撕裂；流淚；急奔。

explains.en: A drop of water from the eye can appear when someone cries. Strong feelings or dust may cause it. A tissue can gently wipe the cheek.
Paper can rip into pieces when pulled apart. Thin paper can rip easily. Children should use scissors safely for crafts.
The word sounds different depending on its meaning. A teacher can say each form aloud. Context helps listeners know which one is meant.

examples.en: Cutting-edge green technology reduces industrial carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 前瞻尖端的綠色科技有效降低了工業碳排放。

examples.en: Advancements in medical technology have extended average human life expectancy.
examples.zh: 醫療技術的進步延長了人類的平均預期壽命。

examples.en: Many schools incorporate educational technology into their daily curricula.
examples.zh: 許多學校已將教育科技融入日常課程教學中。

explains.en: Tools and methods people create to solve problems are part of this field. A phone helps families talk across long distances. People should protect private information online. Careful use keeps devices helpful.
New machines can change how people learn or work. Computers store information. People still need to use them carefully.
Simple inventions also belong here. A wheel makes it easier to move heavy things. Good design can save time and effort.

examples.en: The teens in our club planned a beach cleanup.
examples.zh: 我們社團的青少年規劃了一場海灘清潔活動。

examples.en: Many teens enjoy learning new songs with their friends.
examples.zh: 許多青少年喜歡和朋友一起學新歌。

examples.en: The camp welcomes children and teens during summer.
examples.zh: 這個營隊暑假期間歡迎兒童和青少年參加。

explains.en: People from thirteen through nineteen years old belong to this age group. They may attend high school. They are growing toward adulthood.
Many young people at this age learn more independence. They may take on chores or plan their schedules. Adults can still offer guidance.

The word is also used for numbers ending in teen, from thirteen to nineteen. Students practice these numbers when learning to count. The count starts at thirteen and ends at nineteen. Each number has its own spelling.

examples.en: The forehead scanner measured my body temperature as 36.8°C.
examples.zh: 額溫槍測量出我的體溫為攝氏 36.8 度。

examples.en: The ambient room temperature dropped sharply overnight.
examples.zh: 室內環境氣溫在一夜之間急劇下降。

examples.en: Bake the sourdough loaf at a constant temperature of 220 degrees.
examples.zh: 將酸種麵包在攝氏兩百二十度的恆溫下烘烤。

examples.en: Precision temperature dataloggers monitor thermal stability inside pharmaceutical containers continuously.
examples.zh: 高精密溫度記錄儀，全程二十四小時持續監控藥品冷藏箱內的恆溫狀態。

examples.en: The dairy shipment must be maintained at a stable temperature between two and four degrees Celsius.
examples.zh: 這批高優質鮮乳在跨國配送途中，全程環境溫度必須嚴格維持在攝氏兩度至四度的黃金溫層。

examples.en: Digital sensors trigger automatic alerts if the container’s internal temperature rises by even one degree.
examples.zh: 數位感測系統在貨櫃內部溫度哪怕僅微幅攀升攝氏一度時，也會立即向後台調度中心發出自動警報。

entries.definition: 體溫；溫度；恆溫正負 0.5 度精密溫控與即時記錄

explains.en: A number tells how hot or cold something is. A thermometer can check the air. People may wear a coat when the reading is low.
A person's body heat can be measured when they feel unwell. A caregiver can help read the result. Rest and water are often useful.
Food also has a heat level. Soup may be warm, while ice cream is cold. Let hot dishes cool before tasting.

examples.en: Our teacher explained the science term with a clear drawing.
examples.zh: 老師用一張清楚的圖解釋了這個科學術語。

examples.en: The spring term ends before the summer holiday.
examples.zh: 春季學期在暑假前結束。

examples.en: We agreed to the terms before borrowing the camping gear.
examples.zh: 借用露營裝備前，我們同意了各項條件。

entries.definition: （名）詞語；學期；期間；條件；（動）稱為

explains.en: A word or phrase can name an idea in a subject. A science class may teach new names for parts of a plant. A glossary lists important vocabulary. Examples help students understand each idea.
A school year may be divided into periods of study. Students learn different lessons in each period. They may receive progress reports.
People can set a condition in an agreement. Everyone should understand the rules before saying yes. Asking questions can prevent confusion.

examples.en: The history class discussed how terrorism harms peaceful communities.
examples.zh: 歷史課討論了恐怖主義如何傷害和平的社區。

examples.en: Leaders work together to prevent terrorism and protect the public.
examples.zh: 各地領袖合作防止恐怖主義並保護民眾。

examples.en: The book explains the effects of terrorism on families.
examples.zh: 這本書說明恐怖主義對家庭造成的影響。

explains.en: This means using violence or threats to spread fear and reach a political goal. An attack may try to make a government change its actions. The fear can affect people far beyond the place of the attack.
A group may threaten to harm people unless its demands are met. The aim is to frighten others into doing what the group wants. This use of fear and violence is central to the meaning.

News reports may use this word when discussing attacks meant to pressure a country or community. The people hurt may have no part in the disagreement. The purpose of the attack helps explain why this word is used.

examples.en: The report described a terrorist plot that police stopped safely.
examples.zh: 報導描述警方安全阻止了一起恐怖分子陰謀。

examples.en: The judge sentenced the terrorist after a fair trial.
examples.zh: 法官在公平審判後判處那名恐怖分子。

examples.en: A terrorist attack can frighten an entire community.
examples.zh: 恐怖分子攻擊可能讓整個社區陷入恐懼。

explains.en: A person who plans or carries out violence to frighten the public may be described this way. Such acts put innocent people in danger. Authorities investigate threats carefully. Protecting the public is a shared concern.
The word can describe actions connected with that kind of violence. News reports should use careful facts. Fear should not be spread without reason.
People can learn about safety and peaceful problem solving. Communities help one another during frightening events. Violence never solves disagreements fairly.

examples.en: I sent a text to Dad when the bus arrived.
examples.zh: 公車抵達時，我傳了一則簡訊給爸爸。

examples.en: The text on the sign was too small to read.
examples.zh: 告示牌上的文字太小，看不清楚。

examples.en: Please text me when you finish your music lesson.
examples.zh: 音樂課結束後請傳簡訊給我。

explains.en: Written words sent by phone can reach a friend quickly. A short greeting may brighten someone's day. Check the name before sending.
A book, sign, or letter contains written language. Readers look at the words to understand the message. Pictures can add helpful clues.
A phone message is often brief. People may use it to share a time or place. Important details should be clear.

examples.en: Open your English textbook to page twenty.
examples.zh: 把你的英文課本翻到第二十頁。

examples.en: High school students carry heavy textbooks in their backpacks.
examples.zh: 高中生在書包裡背著沉重的教科書。

examples.en: The science textbook explains photosynthesis with clear colorful diagrams.
examples.zh: 這本自然科學教科書用清晰的彩色圖表解釋光合作用。

explains.en: A school book gives lessons and information about one subject. Students read its pages during class. Pictures and charts can help explain ideas.
Teachers may ask a class to open a certain page. Notes in the margins can remind learners of key facts. Keep it clean and dry.
Some books include questions and practice activities. Working through them helps students check what they understand. A class can discuss difficult parts together.

examples.en: He practiced every day; therefore, he passed the English speaking test easily.
examples.zh: 他每天勤奮練習；因此，他輕鬆通過了英語口說測驗。

examples.en: The flight was overbooked; therefore, the airline offered travel vouchers to volunteers.
examples.zh: 該航班機位出現超賣；因此，航空公司主動向自願改搭旅客提供機票抵用券。

examples.en: Regular exercise strengthens cardiovascular health; therefore, doctors advise walking daily.
examples.zh: 規律運動能增強心肺與心血管功能；因此，專業心臟科醫師極力建議每日健走。

explains.en: This word links a reason to what happens next. The floor was wet, so the game stopped. The players waited until it was safe.
A writer uses it to make a conclusion clear. The bus did not come. The family chose to walk home.
It can begin a result that follows from facts. The plant got no water. Its leaves became dry.

examples.en: The thief took a bicycle from the shop after closing time.
examples.zh: 小偷在商店打烊後偷走了一輛腳踏車。

examples.en: A clever thief in the story left muddy footprints behind.
examples.zh: 故事裡的聰明小偷留下了沾滿泥巴的腳印。

examples.en: The police caught the thief near the old bridge.
examples.zh: 警方在舊橋附近抓到了小偷。

explains.en: A person takes something without the owner’s permission. The act is against the law. The owner can ask the police for help.
In stories, a sneaky character may steal treasure. Detectives look for clues. Honest people return things that do not belong to them.
A child should tell a trusted adult if an item disappears. Grown-ups can look for clues. They can help return what belongs to someone.

examples.en: After running in the sun, I was very thirsty.
examples.zh: 在太陽底下跑步後，我感到非常口渴。

examples.en: The potted flowers look thirsty and need watering immediately.
examples.zh: 這盆花看起來缺水，需要立刻澆水。

examples.en: Curious students are thirsty for new scientific discoveries.
examples.zh: 好奇心旺盛的學生對嶄新的科學發現求知若渴。

explains.en: A person needs a drink when their mouth feels dry. After running outside, a child may ask for water. Drinking helps the body feel better.
Warm weather can make people want more fluids. A reusable bottle is handy at the park. Remember to take regular sips.
A wilted flower may need a drink. Water the roots gently. It may stand up again later.

examples.en: I had a thought about how to fix the broken toy.
examples.zh: 我想到一個修理壞玩具的方法。

examples.en: Her thought was to share the last cookie with her brother.
examples.zh: 她想到把最後一塊餅乾和弟弟分享。

examples.en: He gave the question careful thought before answering.
examples.zh: 他仔細思考了這個問題才回答。

entries.definition: 想法；思想；思考；關心；念頭

explains.en: An idea or opinion forms in someone's mind. A child may wonder why the moon follows the car. They can ask a question.
A person can think carefully before making a choice. They may consider how an action affects a friend. Pausing can prevent mistakes.
A kind idea can become an action. Someone may invite a new classmate to join a game. A small gesture can help.

examples.en: Convenience stores operate twenty-four hours throughout Taiwan.
examples.zh: 便利商店在全台灣各地全天候二十四小時營運。

examples.en: The audience maintained complete and respectful silence throughout the piano recital.
examples.zh: 在整場鋼琴獨奏會演奏進行的自始至終，全體聽眾保持著肅穆與專注。

examples.en: Famous night market food stalls attracted cheerful crowds throughout the entire year.
examples.zh: 這家知名夜市排隊名攤在整整一整年當中，始終吸引著絡繹不絕的熱絡人潮。

explains.en: This preposition shows that something continues across an entire place or period. Rain fell across the whole town. Every street became wet.
A rule may apply from beginning to end. Students stayed quiet during the complete lesson. Everyone followed the same direction.
The word can also mean in many parts of an area. Trees grow all over the island. Birds live in many different places.

examples.en: The loud clap of thunder startled the resting puppy.
examples.zh: 巨大的雷聲把正在休息的小狗嚇了一跳。

examples.en: Distant thunder warned hikers that a summer storm was approaching fast.
examples.zh: 遠處隆隆的雷聲警示著登山者一場夏季暴風雨正迅速逼近。

examples.en: The heavy machinery produced a roar like continuous rolling thunder.
examples.zh: 重型機械設備發出如連綿滾滾雷鳴般的轟隆巨響。

explains.en: A loud rumbling sound follows lightning during a storm. People may hear it after seeing a flash. They should go indoors for safety.
The sound can echo across hills or buildings. A dog may hide under a table. A calm adult can help the animal feel safe.
A person can speak in a very loud voice. Their words may boom through a room. Quiet voices help others listen.

examples.en: The path was blocked; thus, we took the road beside the river.
examples.zh: 小徑被擋住了，因此我們改走河邊的道路。

examples.en: Plants need sunlight and water, and thus they grow toward the window.
examples.zh: 植物需要陽光和水，因此會朝窗邊生長。

examples.en: The team arrived early and thus had time to warm up.
examples.zh: 球隊提早抵達，所以有時間暖身。

entries.definition: 因此；於是；如此；到這種程度。

explains.en: This formal word means in this way or as a result. The team practiced every day. They became better at passing the ball.
A writer can use it to show what follows from an earlier fact. The store was closed. The family went somewhere else.
It appears more often in books and careful writing. Speakers often choose an easier linking word. Readers can still understand the result.

examples.en: We waited till the rain stopped before leaving the tent.
examples.zh: 我們等到雨停才離開帳篷。

examples.en: The bakery is open till noon on Sunday.
examples.zh: 這家麵包店星期日營業到中午。

examples.en: Please read quietly till everyone arrives.
examples.zh: 請安靜閱讀，直到大家都到齊。

explains.en: This word can mean up to a certain time. The shop stays open until six. A customer can come before it closes.
It can also connect an action with the moment another begins. The child waited until the light turned green. Then the group crossed.
People often use the short form in casual speech. Clear timing helps friends know when to meet. The speaker can name a clock time.

examples.en: A tiny ladybug crawled across the green leaf.
examples.zh: 一隻小瓢蟲爬過綠葉。

examples.en: We found a tiny shell beside the big rock.
examples.zh: 我們在大石頭旁找到一個小貝殼。

examples.en: The puppy wore a tiny blue sweater.
examples.zh: 小狗穿著一件小小的藍色毛衣。

explains.en: Something is very small in size. A little ant can walk along a pencil. It may be hard to see from far away.
A small amount can also be described this way. One drop fell into the cup. The drink barely changed.
Small creatures need care too. A young seedling can be delicate. Gentle hands keep its thin stem from bending.

examples.en: Check the tire pressure before setting off on a road trip.
examples.zh: 開車出遊前請先檢查輪胎胎壓。

examples.en: He learned how to replace a flat tire on the side of the highway.
examples.zh: 他學會了如何在公路旁更換洩氣的扁胎。

examples.en: Working twelve hours without a break will tire anyone out.
examples.zh: 連續工作十二小時不休息會讓任何人都感到疲累。

explains.en: A rubber ring around a wheel touches the road. It helps a bicycle or car move safely. The pattern on it grips the ground.
Long work or play can leave a person low on energy. They may slow down. A short rest can help them feel ready again.
Worn rubber around a wheel needs checking. Proper air pressure helps it work well. Careful maintenance makes travel safer.

examples.en: Could you pass me a box of facial tissue?
examples.zh: 可以遞給我一盒面紙嗎？

examples.en: He wiped his hands with a soft tissue after eating.
examples.zh: 吃完東西後他用柔軟的面紙擦了擦手。

examples.en: Always carry a pack of pocket tissues when going out.
examples.zh: 出門時隨身攜帶一包袖珍面紙。

explains.en: A thin paper sheet can wipe a nose or spill. It is usually thrown away after use. Keep a box nearby during a cold.
Cells of one kind work together inside the body. Each group has a special job. Some protect skin or help muscles move.
A box is useful at home or school. Keep the paper clean and dry. It can help during art time.

examples.en: The title of my favorite book is printed in gold letters.
examples.zh: 我最喜歡的書名是用金色字母印上去的。

examples.en: Dr. Chen has the title of head teacher at our school.
examples.zh: 陳博士在我們學校擔任主任教師的職稱。

examples.en: She titled her painting 'Rainy Garden.'
examples.zh: 她把畫作命名為「雨中的花園」。

entries.definition: （名）標題；頭銜；稱號；冠軍；（動）加標題

explains.en: A book, film, or song has a name printed near the top. It helps people recognize the work. A short name is easy to remember.
A formal role can show what work someone does. A school leader may have an official position. The role carries certain duties.
Writers choose a name that hints at the subject. A clear one helps readers find the work. Words at the top can attract interest.

examples.en: I ate toast with honey before school.
examples.zh: 我上學前吃了抹蜂蜜的吐司。

examples.en: Everyone raised a glass to toast the new teacher.
examples.zh: 大家舉杯向新老師致意。

examples.en: Dad toasted the bread until the edges turned golden.
examples.zh: 爸爸把麵包烤到邊緣變成金黃色。

entries.definition: （名）烤吐司；祝酒；（動）烘烤；舉杯祝賀。

explains.en: A slice of bread becomes crisp in a toaster. People may add butter or jam. It makes a quick breakfast.
Guests lift their glasses to celebrate a person or event. Someone may say a few kind words. Everyone takes a sip afterward.
Watch the bread as it heats. Leaving it too long can make it burn. Smoke may set off an alarm.

examples.en: Stinky tofu is a famous Taiwanese night market specialty.
examples.zh: 臭豆腐是著名的台灣夜市特色小吃。

examples.en: Silken tofu drizzled with soy sauce and bonito flakes is refreshing.
examples.zh: 嫩豆腐淋上醬油膏並撒上柴魚片非常爽口開胃。

examples.en: Tofu is an outstanding plant-based protein source for vegetarians.
examples.zh: 豆腐對素食者而言是絕佳的植物性蛋白質來源。

examples.en: Fermented stinky tofu may smell pungent, but it tastes wonderfully savory.
examples.zh: 傳統發酵臭豆腐聞起來雖然氣味強烈撲鼻，但入口咀嚼卻是無比甘甜香醇。

examples.en: Silken tofu drizzled with soy sauce and spring onions makes a refreshing summer appetizer.
examples.zh: 淋上淡口醬油與青蔥碎的涼拌嫩豆腐是一道開胃又清爽的夏日小菜。

examples.en: Vegetarians frequently rely on firm tofu as an outstanding plant-based protein substitute.
examples.zh: 素食主義者通常依靠口感扎實的板豆腐作為極佳的植物性優質蛋白質來源。

explains.en: This food is made from soybeans and water. It can go into soup or noodles. Cooks may fry it until golden.
Its mild flavor takes on the taste of sauces. People cut it into cubes or slices. It can be served hot or cold.
This food can be pressed to remove some of its water. Firm pieces hold their shape in a hot pan. Softer kinds work well in soups or sweet dishes.

examples.en: The piano tone sounded soft in the quiet room.
examples.zh: 安靜的房間裡，鋼琴的音色聽起來很柔和。

examples.en: Please use a friendly tone when you ask for help.
examples.zh: 請用友善的語氣尋求協助。

examples.en: The blue paint has a cool tone in the morning light.
examples.zh: 晨光下，藍色顏料帶有冷色調。

explains.en: A sound may feel high, low, gentle, or loud. A bell rings with a clear sound. A drum makes a deeper one.
The way someone speaks can show how they feel. A gentle voice sounds kind. A sharp voice may show anger.
Painters mix shades to create different looks. A warm shade can make a room feel cozy. A cool one may feel calm.

examples.en: The cat licked milk from the bowl with its tongue.
examples.zh: 貓用舌頭舔碗裡的牛奶。

examples.en: I burned my tongue on the hot soup.
examples.zh: 我被熱湯燙到了舌頭。

examples.en: She stuck out her tongue to make her brother laugh.
examples.zh: 她吐舌頭逗弟弟笑。

explains.en: A muscle inside the mouth helps people taste food. It moves food while chewing. It also helps form speech sounds.
Animals use this part to taste or drink. A dog may lick water from a bowl. Some creatures use it to catch food.
The top can feel rough. A dentist may ask a patient to move it. This helps during an examination.

examples.en: You should visit a dentist if you have a toothache.
examples.zh: 如果你牙痛，應該去看牙醫。

examples.en: A throbbing toothache kept him awake the entire night.
examples.zh: 陣陣抽痛的牙痛讓他整夜無法入眠。

examples.en: Neglecting dental cavities will eventually lead to a severe toothache.
examples.zh: 忽視蛀牙最終會導致劇烈的牙痛。

examples.en: A cavity in the molar caused a throbbing toothache.
examples.zh: 臼齒上的蛀牙導致了一陣陣劇烈的牙痛。

examples.en: I couldn't sleep all night because of an agonizing toothache.
examples.zh: 因為痛苦難耐的牙痛，我整夜都無法入睡。

examples.en: Avoid drinking ice water when you are suffering from a toothache.
examples.zh: 牙痛發作時應避免飲用冰水。

explains.en: Pain in one or more teeth can make chewing uncomfortable. A person should tell a trusted adult. A dentist can check the cause.
Sugary foods can contribute to tooth problems. Brushing and flossing help protect teeth. Regular checkups are useful too.
The pain can make someone lose sleep. A caregiver can arrange dental care. Avoid guessing about the cause.

examples.en: Dentists recommend changing your toothbrush every three months.
examples.zh: 牙醫建議每三個月更換一次牙刷。

examples.en: An electric toothbrush removes dental plaque more effectively.
examples.zh: 電動牙刷能更有效地清除牙菌斑。

examples.en: Don't forget to pack your toothbrush before going on vacation.
examples.zh: 去度假前別忘了把牙刷打包進去。

explains.en: A small brush with a handle helps clean teeth. People move it gently over each tooth. They use it with toothpaste and water.
Brushes have soft or firm bristles. A clean one should be stored where it can dry. Each person should have their own.
Cleaning teeth every day is part of good care. Replace worn bristles when needed. A clean brush works better.

examples.en: We took a tour of the history museum with our class.
examples.zh: 我們和全班一起參觀了歷史博物館。

examples.en: The singer's tour will visit three cities this summer.
examples.zh: 這位歌手今年夏天的巡演將前往三座城市。

examples.en: Maya toured her cousins around the new school.
examples.zh: 瑪雅帶表親們參觀了新學校。

entries.definition: （名）旅遊；參觀；巡迴演出；（動）旅行；導覽

explains.en: A planned visit takes people around interesting places. A guide may show visitors old buildings. The group learns facts along the way.
Musicians can travel to many cities to perform. Fans buy tickets to hear the songs. Each stop is part of the trip.
A person can show guests around a school or factory. They point out important rooms. Questions help visitors learn more.

examples.en: The children ran excitedly toward the playground swing.
examples.zh: 小朋友們興奮地朝著遊樂場鞦韆跑去。

examples.en: He has always maintained a positive, open-minded attitude toward learning new skills.
examples.zh: 他對於學習新技能始終抱持著積極開放的心態。

examples.en: Donations from the charity concert will go toward funding local children's healthcare.
examples.zh: 這場慈善音樂會的所有捐款將全數用於資助當地兒童的醫療照護。

examples.en: The tourists walked toward the Taipei 101 observatory entrance.
examples.zh: 遊客們朝著台北 101 觀景台入口走去。

examples.en: Taking twenty daily vocabulary quizzes is an encouraging step toward English mastery.
examples.zh: 每天堅持完成二十題單字測驗，是朝向精通英語目標邁出的踏實一步。

examples.en: She always maintains a gentle and compassionate attitude toward stray animals.
examples.zh: 對待街頭流浪受苦的弱小動物，她始終抱持著溫柔體貼與憐憫的關懷態度。

explains.en: Movement in the direction of a place can be shown with this preposition. The dog ran in its owner’s direction. The owner held out a hand.
It can show a route without saying someone arrived. A child walked closer to the gate. Then the bell rang.
The word can also describe a feeling or attitude. Kind actions for others help a classroom feel welcoming. A thoughtful gesture can build trust.

examples.en: You can track your package's real-time shipment progress online.
examples.zh: 您可以在線上追蹤包裹的即時運送進度。

examples.en: Athletes trained hard on the running track before the championship.
examples.zh: 運動員在冠軍錦標賽前在田徑跑道上刻苦訓練。

examples.en: The hunter followed the deer's fresh tracks in the soft mud.
examples.zh: 獵人跟隨軟泥中鹿群留下的新鮮足跡前進。

explains.en: A marked path lets runners practice and race. It may go around a field. Lines show where each person should run.
A mark or trail can show where someone or something has gone. Muddy footprints cross the floor. They lead to the back door.
People can follow progress over time by keeping notes. A chart shows daily reading. Small changes become easier to notice.

examples.en: International trade drives economic prosperity across the island.
examples.zh: 國際貿易推動了全島的經濟繁榮。

examples.en: Taiwan maintains strong bilateral trade partnerships with countries worldwide.
examples.zh: 台灣與世界各國維持著緊密繁榮的雙邊經貿夥伴關係。

examples.en: The two schoolboys agreed to trade their rare baseball collector cards.
examples.zh: 兩位男同學達成共識，開心地交換了彼此手上的珍稀棒球收藏卡。

explains.en: People exchange goods or services with one another. A child may swap stickers with a friend. Both people agree before changing items.
Countries buy and sell products across borders. Ships carry food, clothes, and tools. Rules guide these exchanges.
Workers may exchange duties for a short time. They discuss the plan first. Clear agreement prevents confusion.

examples.en: Giving red envelopes is a cherished Lunar New Year tradition.
examples.zh: 發紅包是農曆新年一項深具意義的珍貴傳統。

examples.en: It has long been a family tradition to eat breakfast together on Sundays.
examples.zh: 週日全家一起吃早餐長久以來都是我們家的家庭傳統慣例。

examples.en: Respecting teachers and masters is an essential cultural tradition in Asia.
examples.zh: 尊師重道是亞洲文化中不可或缺的優良文化傳統。

explains.en: A custom is passed from older family members to younger ones. A family may cook a special meal each New Year. Everyone joins in.
Schools or communities can keep customs too. Students may sing a song at graduation. The activity connects people across years.
People may change old customs while keeping what matters. Families talk and choose new ways together. Respect helps everyone feel included.

examples.en: Handcrafted Taiwanese tea sets showcase fine traditional art.
examples.zh: 純手工製作的台灣茶具展現了精緻的傳統工藝。

examples.en: Grandmother still cooks sticky rice following her traditional family recipe.
examples.zh: 外婆依然遵循她世代相傳的傳統家族食譜烹調香噴噴的油飯。

examples.en: You can see performers wearing colorful traditional costumes at the village parade.
examples.zh: 你可以在鄉村遊行隊伍中看見表演者身著色彩繽紛的傳統服飾。

explains.en: An old custom or way of doing something has continued for many years. Families may gather for a shared holiday meal. Children learn why it matters.
Clothing, music, and art can show the history of a community. Patterns and colors may have special meanings. People share them proudly.
A familiar method can be passed down over time. Cooks follow recipes from grandparents. Each family may add a small change.

examples.en: Placing dense mineral wool bass traps in corners eliminates boomy low-end standing waves.
examples.zh: 在錄音室四個牆角堆疊高密度岩棉低頻陷阱，能徹底消除低音駐波所引發的轟鳴共振。

examples.en: Wildlife rangers set humane cage traps to safely rescue and relocate injured mountain animals.
examples.zh: 國家公園巡山員設置了不傷動物的人道誘捕籠陷阱，以安全救援並異地野放受傷受困的山林野生動物。

examples.en: Consumers should budget carefully to avoid falling into the dangerous cycle of high-interest credit card debt traps.
examples.zh: 消費者在日常生活中應當精打細算編列各項開銷預算，以防陷入惡性循環的高利息卡債陷阱之中。

entries.definition: 錄音室角落低頻吸音陷阱；陷阱

explains.en: A device can catch an animal or object and keep it from leaving. People should follow local rules. Animals need kind treatment.
A difficult situation may leave someone with few choices. A friend can listen. Together they can plan a safe way out.
A magic show may surprise people with a clever trick. The performer practices each move. Props help create the effect.

examples.en: Please do not throw trash on the ground.
examples.zh: 請不要把垃圾丟在地上。

examples.en: Taiwan has an effective community recycling and trash collection system.
examples.zh: 台灣擁有高效的社區資源回收與垃圾清運系統。

examples.en: Separate food waste from regular household trash carefully.
examples.zh: 請將廚餘與一般家戶垃圾仔細分類。

explains.en: Things people no longer want can be thrown away or recycled. Empty boxes and food wrappers often go into a bin. Sorting helps reduce waste.
A place can look messy when unwanted items lie around. Cleaning up makes it safer. People can keep useful objects for another day.
The word can be a verb for treating something carelessly or insulting it. A person should speak kindly. Respectful words make conversations better.

examples.en: I love to travel to Japan during winter vacation.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在寒假去日本旅行。

examples.en: Light travels much faster than sound through the atmosphere.
examples.zh: 在大氣中，光傳播的速度遠遠快於聲音。

examples.en: Traveling opens our minds and exposes us to diverse cultures.
examples.zh: 旅行開拓我們的心胸，讓我們接觸豐富多元的文化。

explains.en: People go from one place to another for work, family, or fun. A bus or train can carry them. Planning helps the trip go smoothly.
Moving across a large distance can take many hours. A map helps people choose a route. Rest stops make long rides more comfortable.
Stories and pictures can let readers visit faraway places in their minds. They learn about new food and customs. Curiosity can lead to more learning.

examples.en: Every flying bird and swimming fish is an irreplaceable biological treasure of our home island.
examples.zh: 每一隻在山林飛翔的珍禽、在溪流悠游的魚兒與在月光下穿梭的石虎，都是這座寶島最無價的「生命瑰寶」（Treasure）。

examples.en: The pristine high-mountain cedar forests are recognized as a world-class natural treasure.
examples.zh: 這座島嶼高聳入雲的原生台灣扁柏與紅檜神木巨木群，是舉世稱奇的世界級大自然瑰寶。

examples.en: Future generations deserve to inherit this island's magnificent treasure of endemic biodiversity.
examples.zh: 我們的後代子孫理應完整繼承這座美麗海島所孕育的壯麗特有種生物多樣性瑰寶。

examples.en: Boiling water beneath our volcanic slopes is a clean, eternal underground treasure waiting to power the future.
examples.zh: 翻湧在台灣火山斜坡地底深處的滾燙熱泉，是一座等待我們智慧開發、點亮未來的無價「綠能寶藏」（Treasure）。

examples.en: Pirates in legend sailed across uncharted southern oceans searching for buried gold treasure chests.
examples.zh: 古老航海傳奇中的海盜揚帆航向未知的神秘南方大洋，歷經千難萬險搜尋傳說中埋藏在荒島深處的黃金寶藏。

examples.en: The university library preserves an irreplaceable cultural treasure of hand-copied medieval manuscripts.
examples.zh: 國立大學總圖書館古籍珍本善本書庫中，完整珍藏著數批無可取代、由中世紀修道院修士親手謄寫的手抄本文化寶藏。

entries.definition: 繁衍生息於這座美麗寶島之無價生命瑰寶；埋藏在寶島地底深處取之不盡之綠色能源寶藏

explains.en: Something very valuable may be kept safe and hidden. A pirate story might describe a chest full of gold. The owner protects it carefully.
People can care deeply about a memory or object. A child's drawing from a grandparent may be precious. It brings back happy moments.
A person may search for something special. A map can give clues. Friends work together to find the hidden prize.

examples.en: Every accused citizen is entitled to a speedy, public, and fair trial.
examples.zh: 每一位遭受起訴的國民皆享有獲得迅速、公開且公正審判的憲法權利。

examples.en: The high-profile murder trial lasted for three grueling months before reaching a final verdict.
examples.zh: 這場引發全社會高度關注的重大殺人案法庭審判，在歷經整整三個月緊繃審理後方才迎來最終判決。

examples.en: The biopharmaceutical company launched Phase 3 clinical trials to test the efficacy of the new cancer vaccine.
examples.zh: 該生技製藥巨擘正式展開第三期大規模人體臨床試驗，以驗證這款革命性新型抗癌疫苗的真實療效。

examples.en: Enrolling in a global randomized clinical trial granted the patient early access to cutting-edge therapy.
examples.zh: 簽署加入全球多中心「隨機對照臨床試驗」（Clinical Trial），讓患者有機會提早接受劃時代新藥治療。

examples.en: The high-profile financial fraud trial drew hundreds of curious spectators and journalists to court.
examples.zh: 這樁引發全台轟動的重大金融詐欺案公開庭審，吸引了數以百計的旁聽民眾與新聞記者擠滿法庭。

examples.en: Through rigorous trial and error, the baker perfected her sourdough bread fermentation recipe.
examples.zh: 歷經無數次堅持不懈的嘗試與摸索修正，烘焙師傅終於調配出頂級天然酵母酸種麵包的黃金配方。

entries.definition: 審判；訴訟審理；試驗；嚴格隨機雙盲對照臨床試驗 (Phase I-III)

explains.en: A court examines facts before deciding whether a law was broken. A judge listens to both sides. Rules help keep the process fair.
A test can show whether a new idea works. Scientists compare results. They write down what happens each time.
A difficult experience can challenge a person's patience. Family and friends may offer help. People can learn as they work through it.

examples.en: I drew a red triangle beside the square on my paper.
examples.zh: 我在紙上的正方形旁畫了一個紅色三角形。

examples.en: The warning sign has a large triangle around the picture.
examples.zh: 警告標誌上的圖案外圍有一個大三角形。

examples.en: The musician tapped the triangle with a small metal stick.
examples.zh: 音樂家用一根小金屬棒敲擊三角鐵。

entries.definition: 三角形；三角形物體；三角鐵。

explains.en: This flat shape has three straight sides and three corners. A ruler can help draw it. The sides may be equal or different lengths.
A road sign may use this shape to warn drivers. Bright colors make it easy to notice. People should look carefully and follow the sign.
A musical instrument made of metal has three sides. A small beater makes a clear ringing sound. Musicians use it in some songs.

examples.en: The magician showed us a card trick at the party.
examples.zh: 魔術師在派對上為我們表演了紙牌戲法。

examples.en: Mia played a harmless trick by hiding Dad's hat in the closet.
examples.zh: 米亞把爸爸的帽子藏進衣櫃，開了一個無傷大雅的玩笑。

examples.en: Here is a trick for keeping your shoelaces tied.
examples.zh: 這裡有個讓鞋帶保持繫緊的小妙招。

explains.en: A clever action can surprise someone or help solve a small problem. A magician practices carefully. The audience enjoys guessing how it works.
A playful joke may fool a friend for a moment. It should not hurt anyone. A kind laugh brings people together.
A useful method can make a hard task easier. Turning a jar lid under warm water may help open it. Small ideas can save time.

examples.en: Dreams can come true if you pursue them.
examples.zh: 只要勇於追求，夢想就能成真。

examples.en: This inspiring film is based on a true historical rescue story.
examples.zh: 這部振奮人心的電影改編自真實的歷史搜救故事。

examples.en: Loyal friends remain true and steadfast when hardships arise.
examples.zh: 患難時刻，忠誠的朋友始終真誠堅定、不離不棄。

explains.en: Something matches what really happened or what can be checked. A witness tells what they saw. Careful facts help people understand.
A statement can be correct rather than mistaken. The answer to a math problem should match the work. Checking helps find errors.
A loyal friend stays kind and keeps promises. Their actions show that they care. Trust grows when people are dependable.

examples.en: Good friends trust each other completely.
examples.zh: 好朋友之間會彼此完全信任。

examples.en: Mutual trust is the solid foundation of any strong relationship.
examples.zh: 相互信任是任何穩固人際關係的堅實基石。

examples.en: Can I trust you to keep this secret safe between us?
examples.zh: 我能信任你替我們兩人保守這個秘密嗎？

examples.en: Mutual trust is the foundation of any lasting friendship.
examples.zh: 相互信任是任何長久友誼的堅固基石。

examples.en: You can trust him completely with confidential company data.
examples.zh: 你完全可以信賴他，將公司最重要的核心機密檔案安心交付給他保管。

examples.en: It takes years to build customer trust, but only seconds of carelessness to lose it.
examples.zh: 贏得消費者的信任需要耗費數年心血，但只要一瞬間的疏忽便會蕩然無存。

explains.en: People feel safe relying on someone who keeps promises. Friends show they care by being honest. Good relationships grow over time.
A person may believe that a fact is correct. They can still check reliable information. Asking questions helps them understand.
Money or property can be managed for someone under agreed rules. Adults may arrange this carefully. Clear records help protect what belongs to another person.

examples.en: No matter how cleverly a crime is concealed, objective physical evidence always whispers the undeniable truth.
examples.zh: 無論罪行被掩蓋得如何天衣無縫，冰冷客觀的物理物證終將無聲訴說著無可辯駁的客觀真相。

examples.en: Seeking the forensic truth requires setting aside all preconceived theories and letting facts speak.
examples.zh: 追尋鑑識科學的客觀真相，要求辦案人員徹底拋棄一切先入為主的主觀偏見，唯讓冰冷事實說話。

examples.en: Unearthing the unvarnished scientific truth restores public confidence in the judicial integrity of trials.
examples.zh: 抽絲剝繭還原未經修飾的科學真理真相，是重建社會大眾對國家司法審判公平信賴的唯一基石。

entries.definition: 抽絲剝繭還原犯罪現場客觀真相

explains.en: What really happened can be learned by checking facts. People may ask questions and look at evidence. Honest answers help everyone understand.
A person can share what they know without making things up. Owning a mistake can be difficult. It helps others believe future words.
Finding facts may take time. Different people can remember an event differently. Careful listening and clear records can help.

examples.en: Underground lava tubes span fifty meters wide, providing ready-made caverns shielded from surface micrometeorites.
examples.zh: 火星地下寬達五十公尺的火山熔岩洞穴通道，是隔絕地表微隕石撞擊的現成地下基地。

examples.en: Thermal imaging cameras discovered openings leading into massive subsurface lava tube networks.
examples.zh: 軌道探測器的紅外線熱顯像儀，在火山斜坡邊緣發現了數個直通地下龐大熔岩管網系統的天窗開口。

examples.en: Inflatable habitat modules can be expanded inside a deep lava tube to create a permanent underground settlement.
examples.zh: 將充氣式模組化居住艙運送進深層熔岩洞穴中展開組裝，能建構出不受沙塵暴侵擾的永久性地下城。

entries.definition: 火星地下龐大天然火山熔岩洞穴通道；管子

explains.en: A long hollow object carries water, air, or another material from one place to another. A straw is a small example. Pipes can be much larger.
A soft cylinder can hold paint, toothpaste, or cream. People squeeze out a small amount. Closing the cap keeps it clean.
A hollow part can fit inside a machine. Its opening lets something pass through. The size depends on the job it must do.

examples.en: You can see green sea turtles snorkeling in Xiaoliuqiu.
examples.zh: 在小琉球浮潛可以看到綠蠵龜。

examples.en: The pet turtle crawled slowly across the sunny living room rug.
examples.zh: 寵物小烏龜在陽光明媚的客廳地毯上緩緩爬行。

examples.en: Marine conservation groups work tirelessly to protect endangered sea turtles.
examples.zh: 海洋保育團體不遺餘力地保護瀕臨滅絕的海龜。

examples.en: Xiao Liuqiu is world-famous as a haven where hundreds of wild green sea turtles forage peacefully.
examples.zh: 屏東小琉球以清澈水質聞名全球，是數百隻野生保育類綠蠵龜在此悠閒覓食、棲息繁衍的海龜樂園。

examples.en: Volunteers patrol nesting beaches late at night to protect vulnerable baby turtles heading out to sea.
examples.zh: 海龜巡守志工每逢盛夏深夜在沙灘上耐心巡守，守護剛破殼而出的脆弱小海龜平安爬向大海。

examples.en: Regulations strictly prohibit divers from touching or chasing an endangered green sea turtle.
examples.zh: 國家野生動物保育法明文嚴禁任何潛水客追逐、觸摸或騷擾瀕危野生海龜，違者將面臨重罰。

explains.en: This animal has a hard shell that protects its body. Some kinds live on land, while others spend much time in water. Its shell has a firm surface.
It moves slowly on land and can hide inside its shell. People should never take a wild one from its home. It can pull its head and legs inside.
Some kinds have flippers for swimming. They come up to breathe air. Many lay eggs on sandy ground.

examples.en: The typhoon brought strong gusts and heavy downpours.
examples.zh: 颱風帶來了強勁陣風與豪雨。

examples.en: Local governments announce school closures on official typhoon days.
examples.zh: 地方政府會在正式宣布放颱風假時公布停班停課資訊。

examples.en: Residents boarded up windows to prevent damage during the fierce typhoon season.
examples.zh: 在強烈颱風盛行季節，居民們封好窗戶以防遭受損壞。

explains.en: A very powerful tropical storm can bring strong winds and heavy rain. People may hear warnings before it arrives. They should follow local safety advice.
The storm can damage roofs, trees, and power lines. Families prepare water and food. They stay away from flooded roads.
Weather workers watch the storm and share updates. Knowing its path helps communities get ready. Neighbors can check on one another safely.

examples.en: A typical school day begins with morning reading in our class.
examples.zh: 我們班一般的上課日會從早晨閱讀開始。

examples.en: It is typical for our family to eat noodles on Friday.
examples.zh: 我們家通常星期五會吃麵。

examples.en: The typical garden here has flowers and a small bench.
examples.zh: 這裡常見的花園有花朵和一張小長椅。

entries.definition: 典型的；通常的；有代表性的

explains.en: Something is common for a person or place and is not surprising. A rainy winter may be normal for a coastal town. Many families follow a similar pattern.
A usual example can help explain a group. A sparrow is one common small bird. Other birds may look quite different.
The word can describe what generally happens, though not every time. Plans may change with weather or special events. The weather may still change the plan.

examples.en: The old wall looked ugly before the children painted flowers on it.
examples.zh: 孩子們在舊牆上畫花之前，它看起來很難看。

examples.en: It was ugly to laugh at someone who had fallen.
examples.zh: 嘲笑跌倒的人是不友善的行為。

examples.en: That ugly stain came out after Mom washed the shirt.
examples.zh: 媽媽洗過襯衫後，那塊難看的污漬就消失了。

entries.definition: 醜陋的；難看的；令人不快的

explains.en: Something may look unpleasant to a person. A broken old sign can seem unattractive. Painting it may make it nicer.
An unkind action can be described this way too. Shouting at a friend may hurt their feelings. Apologizing can help repair the friendship.
People do not always agree about appearance. One person may dislike a pattern. Another person may think it is interesting.

examples.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
examples.zh: 帶把雨傘以防下雨。

examples.en: She opened her colorful umbrella when raindrops began to fall.
examples.zh: 雨滴開始落下時，她撐開了色彩繽紛的雨傘。

examples.en: I accidentally left my folding umbrella on the MRT train.
examples.zh: 我不小心把折疊傘遺留在捷運列車上了。

examples.en: Hand-painted Meinong oil-paper umbrellas symbolize round perfection, prosperity, and blessings.
examples.zh: 彩繪梅蘭竹菊的美濃客家手工油紙傘圓潤雅緻，在客家文化中寓意圓滿吉祥、多子多孫與平安賜福。

examples.en: The artisan coats tough persimmon glue over the umbrella frame before applying waterproof tung tree oil.
examples.zh: 師傅將堅韌的柿子汁膠均勻塗刷在天然竹製傘骨上，最後再反覆塗上多道具備防水功效的天然桐油。

examples.en: Beyond rain shelter, the oil-paper umbrella is a classic prop in traditional Taiwanese glove puppetry.
examples.zh: 除了作為雨天遮陽避雨的日用品，美濃手工油紙傘更是台灣傳統掌中戲與客家歌舞劇中的經典道具。

examples.en: Protecting the leopard cat’s extensive territory casts an ecological umbrella over hundreds of smaller animals.
examples.zh: 保護需要廣大活動領域的石虎，宛如撐起了一把強大的「生態保護傘」（Umbrella），庇護了成百上千種伴生物種。

examples.en: As an umbrella species, the forest raptor requires broad tracts of unfragmented woods to thrive.
examples.zh: 作為庇護傘物種，大型森林猛禽需要廣大且未被切割的大片林地才能健全繁衍。

examples.en: Safeguarding large river catchments under an umbrella conservation policy preserves minor freshwater crustaceans.
examples.zh: 在保護傘保育政策下整體維護大型河流集水區，能同時全面庇護無數隱密的淡水甲殼類與魚類。

entries.definition: 雨傘；美濃客家油紙傘；庇護物種 (Umbrella Species 保護傘效益)

explains.en: A folding cover held above the head can keep rain off a person. It has a handle and a frame. Closing it makes it easy to carry.
A wide cover can also block bright sunshine. People may use one at the beach. It should be secured when the wind is strong.
A company or group may provide shelter or protection. The word can describe a larger organization that includes smaller groups. Several smaller groups can work together.

examples.en: Megaships carry over twenty-four thousand twenty-foot equivalent units (TEU) in a single ocean voyage.
examples.zh: 全球最新超大型巨輪單趟遠洋航程，即可裝載超過兩萬四千個二十呎標準貨櫃單位。

examples.en: Port statistics count annual capacity in TEU units to benchmark international shipping efficiency.
examples.zh: 國際各大港口皆以標準 TEU 貨櫃計量單位統計全年吞吐量，以客觀評定全球港務營運效率。

examples.en: A standard forty-foot container represents two equivalent TEU units in commercial maritime accounting.
examples.zh: 在國際海運商業核算標準中，一只四十呎大櫃在計量上等同於兩個標準二十呎 TEU 單位。

examples.en: The MEMS inertial measurement unit tracks angular velocity and linear acceleration thousands of times per second.
examples.zh: 微機電「慣性測量單元」（Measurement Unit IMU），每秒數千次偵測車體的三軸角速度與線性加速度。

examples.en: The intensive care unit is staffed around the clock with specialized critical care physicians and registered nurses.
examples.zh: 綜合醫學中心加護病房由全天候輪值的高階重症專科醫師與專業加護護理師團隊守護危急病患生機。

examples.en: The fundamental currency unit in Taiwan is the New Taiwan Dollar, accepted across all domestic transactions.
examples.zh: 台灣地區流通的法定基本貨幣計價單元為新台幣（NTD），通用於國內各類金融交易與日常民生消費。

entries.definition: 二十呎標準貨櫃計算單位 (TEU)；單位；六軸微機電慣性測量單元 (IMU 隧道內無死角導航)；單元

explains.en: A single part can belong to a larger whole. A classroom may study one chapter at a time. Each part has related lessons.
A standard amount helps people measure or count something. A meter measures length. A liter measures liquid.
A small group of people or homes can form a section. Families may live in separate homes in one building. Each home has its own entrance.

examples.en: The observable universe contains billions of evolving galaxy clusters.
examples.zh: 人類目前可觀測的宇宙範圍內蘊藏著數百億個正在演化繁衍的星系團。

examples.en: Contemplating the sheer scale of the universe makes human earthly troubles feel insignificantly small.
examples.zh: 當個人靜心沉思並仰望浩瀚宇宙的無垠尺度時，日常生活中微不足道的世俗煩惱頓時顯得無比渺小。

examples.en: Cosmologists theorize that the physical universe began with a rapid inflationary expansion called the Big Bang.
examples.zh: 宇宙學家提出扎實的物理理論，認為我們所處的物質宇宙起源於一場名為大爆炸的急劇暴脹膨脹起點。

examples.en: The universe is not only stranger than we imagine, it is more wonderfully interconnected than we can dream.
examples.zh: 這個浩瀚壯麗的「宏偉宇宙」（Universe），不僅比我們想像的更奇妙，更以超越夢想的方式緊密相連。

examples.en: Cosmologists estimate that the observable universe spans approximately ninety-three billion light-years in diameter.
examples.zh: 當代宇宙學家估算，人類目前所能觀測到的可觀測宇宙空間直徑大約跨越了九百三十億光年之巨。

examples.en: Cultivating gratitude helps us realize that each conscious person is a way for the universe to know itself.
examples.zh: 心懷感恩與敬畏的生活，能讓我們體認到每一位具備感知意識的生命，都是宇宙認識自身的奇蹟方式。

entries.definition: 宇宙；全宇宙；世界；浩瀚壯麗、孕育萬物生命之神秘宏偉宇宙

explains.en: All space, stars, planets, and matter together form everything beyond Earth. Scientists study what they can observe. Some questions remain unanswered.
Night skies show only a small part of the vast space around us. A telescope helps people see distant objects. The moon is much closer than faraway stars.
Stories imagine people traveling among planets. Real space travel takes special training and equipment. Researchers learn more through careful study.

examples.en: National Taiwan University is located in the Daan District of Taipei.
examples.zh: 台灣大學位於台北市大安區。

examples.en: Going to university offers students opportunities to explore diverse career pathways.
examples.zh: 進入大學就讀為學生提供了探索多元職業發展路徑的機會。

examples.en: The university library stays open twenty-four hours during final exam week.
examples.zh: 大學圖書館在期末考週期間全天二十四小時對外開放。

explains.en: A school for adults offers advanced courses in many subjects. Students may study science, language, or art. They choose a program that fits their goals.
Learners often attend after finishing high school. They may live on campus or commute from home. Teachers guide them through challenging work.
Research and teaching happen there. People share ideas and make discoveries. Graduates can use what they learn in many careers.

examples.en: We won't go on a picnic unless the weather clears up.
examples.zh: 除非天氣放晴，否則我們不會去戶外野餐。

examples.en: You cannot enter the airport boarding gate unless you show a valid passport and ticket.
examples.zh: 除非您主動出示本人的有效護照與實體或電子登機證，否則將無法進入登機門。

examples.en: Unless we take urgent action on climate change, extreme storms will become even more severe.
examples.zh: 除非我們各國當前針對氣候變遷採取果斷緊急行動，否則極端暴風災情將愈發嚴峻。

explains.en: This connecting word sets a condition for what may happen. We will play outdoors if it does not rain. The weather decides the plan.
A rule can depend on something being true. Children may enter the pool only with an adult. Safety comes first.
