explains.en: A person is not sure whether something is true or will happen. Dark clouds make the picnic plan uncertain. The family checks the forecast.
A result may seem unlikely. A team has little time left to score. Players continue trying.
Asking questions can clear up uncertainty. Look for reliable facts. A trusted adult can help explain.

examples.en: The bakery made a doughnut with pink icing and sprinkles.
examples.zh: 麵包店做了一個撒滿彩色糖粒的粉紅糖霜甜甜圈。

examples.en: He chose a chocolate doughnut for his birthday treat.
examples.zh: 他選了一個巧克力甜甜圈當生日點心。

examples.en: The warm doughnut smelled sweet as it came out of the oven.
examples.zh: 熱騰騰的甜甜圈出爐時聞起來香甜。

explains.en: A sweet fried cake often has a hole in the center. It may have sugar or icing on top. Eat it as a treat.
Bakers mix dough and cook it in hot oil. An adult handles the equipment. Different fillings add flavor.
Some are round without a hole. A shop may sell them with fruit or cream inside. Keep pastries covered.

examples.en: We took the train downtown to visit the art museum.
examples.zh: 我們搭火車到市中心參觀美術館。

examples.en: A downtown hotel stood across from the old theater.
examples.zh: 市中心的一家旅館位於老劇院對面。

examples.en: The downtown streets were busy during the holiday parade.
examples.zh: 假日遊行期間，市中心街道很熱鬧。

entries.definition: （名）市中心；（副）到市中心；（形）市中心的。

explains.en: The central business area of a town or city has many shops and offices. People may ride a bus to get there. Many workers go there each morning.
The adjective describes a place in this busy center. A hotel may stand near a theater. Streets can have heavy traffic.
Visitors can find restaurants and museums there. A map helps them choose a route. Walking is easier on marked sidewalks.

examples.en: A sleek streamlined silhouette achieves a record-breaking 0.21 aerodynamic drag coefficient (Cd).
examples.zh: 流線型水滴美學車身輪廓創造出打破同級紀錄的 0.21 超低風阻係數（Cd），顯著降低高速電耗。

examples.en: Flush door handles retract automatically into the bodywork to eliminate parasitic aerodynamic drag.
examples.zh: 平整化隱藏式車門把手在車輛行駛起步時會自動縮回車體內，徹底消除多餘的迎風空氣阻力擾流。

examples.en: You can click and drag files across the desktop screen into the cloud storage folder.
examples.zh: 你只需輕按滑鼠左鍵點選檔案並直接拖曳過桌面，即可將所有重要文件快速歸檔至雲端硬碟資料夾。

explains.en: To pull something along a surface takes effort. A child moves a heavy box across the floor. Asking for help is safer.
A computer action can move an icon across the screen. Hold the button and shift it. Release at the right place.
A long, slow event may feel tiring. A meeting goes on for hours. Short breaks help people pay attention.

examples.en: A blue dragonfly hovered above the pond.
examples.zh: 一隻藍色蜻蜓在池塘上方盤旋。

examples.en: The dragonfly landed on a reed beside the water.
examples.zh: 蜻蜓停在水邊的一根蘆葦上。

examples.en: We watched a dragonfly dart across the sunny garden.
examples.zh: 我們看著一隻蜻蜓飛快地掠過陽光明媚的花園。

explains.en: A flying insect has a long body and four clear wings. It often stays near ponds. It eats smaller insects.
Its large eyes help it see around itself. It can fly quickly and change direction. Watch it without catching it.
The wings may shine in sunlight. A garden pond can attract these insects. Keep water areas clean.

examples.en: Clean fallen hair from the shower floor drain regularly.
examples.zh: 定期清理淋浴間地板排水孔上的掉落毛髮。

examples.en: Heavy rainfall overwhelmed the municipal street storm drains.
examples.zh: 傾盆暴雨讓市區街道的雨水下水道排水系統不堪重負。

examples.en: Continuous stress and overwork will completely drain your physical energy.
examples.zh: 長期持續的壓力與超時過勞會徹底耗盡你的體力與精力。

explains.en: A pipe or hole carries extra water away from a sink or street. Keep it clear of leaves. Water can flow properly.
The verb means removing liquid from a container. Pour it slowly. Use a strainer to keep food from falling out.
A person may use up energy after a busy day. Rest and food help the body recover. Take breaks when needed.

examples.en: The dramatic sunset filled the sky with red and purple clouds.
examples.zh: 壯觀的日落讓天空布滿紅色和紫色的雲。

examples.en: Her dramatic reading made the story exciting for the class.
examples.zh: 她生動的朗讀讓全班覺得故事很精彩。

examples.en: The team made a dramatic comeback in the final minutes.
examples.zh: 球隊在最後幾分鐘上演了戲劇性的逆轉。

entries.definition: 戲劇性的；突然的；引人注目的；誇張的

explains.en: Something is exciting or full of strong feeling. A sudden storm changes the sky quickly. People watch from indoors.
An actor makes a scene lively with voice and movement. The audience follows the story. Practice helps the performance feel real.
A big change can be noticeable. A plant grows much taller in a week. Keep a picture to see the difference.

examples.en: Solar-powered precision drip irrigation delivers water drop by drop directly to thirsty plant roots.
examples.zh: 結合太陽能的智慧微滴灌系統，將珍貴水資源一滴滴精準送達作物根系，節水七成。

examples.en: The plumber tightened the compression fitting beneath the kitchen sink to stop the annoying faucet drip.
examples.zh: 水電師傅拿起扳手迅速鎖緊了廚房流理台下方的防漏接頭，徹底解決了困擾已久的水龍頭滴水問題。

examples.en: Intravenous medication was administered to the hospital patient via a steady bedside medical drip.
examples.zh: 護理師透過床邊懸掛的醫療級靜脈輸液點滴，將抗生素藥劑以穩定規律的速度滴注輸入病患體內。

entries.definition: 太陽能智慧微滴灌省水灌溉；滴下

explains.en: A small drop of liquid falls slowly from a surface. A leaky faucet can make this sound. Tell an adult so it can be fixed.
The verb means letting drops fall one by one. Wet clothes hang over a sink. A towel catches the water.
Water may run down after rain. Roof edges release drops. A bucket can protect the floor.

examples.en: A life jacket can help prevent drowning during boat trips.
examples.zh: 搭船時穿救生衣有助於預防溺水。

examples.en: The rescue team saved the swimmer from drowning.
examples.zh: 救援隊救起了那名溺水的游泳者。

examples.en: The loud music drowned out our quiet conversation.
examples.zh: 吵鬧的音樂蓋過了我們輕聲的談話。

entries.definition: 溺水；淹死；淹沒；蓋過（聲音）

explains.en: A person or animal can die after being unable to breathe underwater. Stay with an adult near pools or rivers. Follow water safety rules.
Strong water currents can be dangerous. Never enter floodwater. Call trained rescuers if someone is in trouble.
A person may be overwhelmed by too much work or noise in a figurative sense. Take a break. Ask for help.

examples.en: We bought bandages and soap at the drugstore.
examples.zh: 我們在藥妝店買了繃帶和肥皂。

examples.en: The drugstore pharmacist explained how to use the thermometer.
examples.zh: 藥局藥師說明了溫度計的使用方法。

examples.en: A small drugstore opened near the bus station.
examples.zh: 公車站附近開了一家小藥局。

entries.definition: 藥局；藥妝店；販售藥品與日用品的商店。

explains.en: A shop sells medicine and health supplies. A pharmacist can answer questions. Follow labels and ask an adult before taking anything.
The store may also have snacks, shampoo, and greeting cards. People can buy daily needs. Keep medicine away from children.
Some places use a different name for this kind of shop. Signs show where it is. Check opening hours before going.

examples.en: The drunk driver was stopped before anyone got hurt.
examples.zh: 那名酒醉駕駛在有人受傷前就被攔下了。

examples.en: The story showed a drunk sailor who could not walk straight.
examples.zh: 故事描寫一名喝醉的水手走路不穩。

examples.en: A drunk passenger rested while a friend called for a ride.
examples.zh: 一名喝醉的乘客休息時，朋友幫忙叫了車。

explains.en: A person who has consumed too much alcohol may lose balance or judgment. Adults should not drive. Children should get help from a trusted adult.
The word can describe an animal that has taken too much fermented fruit in a story. Such scenes are unusual. Animals need protection.
A person who drinks alcohol should stay with safe companions. They should not operate vehicles. Call emergency services if someone is in danger.

examples.en: The cartoon mouse gave a dumb look when the cheese disappeared.
examples.zh: 起司消失時，卡通老鼠露出一臉茫然。

examples.en: It was a dumb mistake to leave the lunch outside in the rain.
examples.zh: 把午餐忘在雨裡是個愚蠢的錯誤。

examples.en: Some people once used dumb to mean unable to speak, but that use can offend.
examples.zh: 過去有人用 dumb 表示無法說話，但這種用法可能冒犯他人。

entries.definition: 愚蠢的；笨的；（舊義，可能冒犯）不會說話的

explains.en: A person may be unable to speak or choose not to speak. Some people communicate with signs or devices. Treat everyone with respect.
This word can be rude when used to call someone unintelligent. Choose kinder language. People learn in different ways.
A quiet animal may make no sound. A toy may also have no voice. Context tells which meaning is meant.

examples.en: The town closed the old dump and opened a recycling center.
examples.zh: 鎮上關閉了舊垃圾場，並開設回收中心。

examples.en: Please do not dump your toys on the stairs.
examples.zh: 請不要把玩具亂丟在樓梯上。

examples.en: He dumped the sand from the pail into the sandbox.
examples.zh: 他把桶裡的沙倒進沙坑。

entries.definition: （動）傾倒；丟棄；拋下；分手；（名）垃圾場；廢物堆

explains.en: A place where unwanted waste is left may be called this. People should use proper bins. Litter harms animals and nature.
The verb can mean dropping or putting something down carelessly. A person may empty a bag on the floor. They should clean up.
A computer user can remove files from a device. Check before deleting. Important work should be saved first.

examples.en: Steamed pork soup dumplings (Xiao Long Bao) burst with steaming hot juice.
examples.zh: 剛出爐的鼎泰豐經典小籠湯包皮薄餡多，輕輕咬破便流出滾燙濃郁的鮮美湯汁。

examples.en: The entire family gathers around the table on Lunar New Year's Eve to wrap festive dumplings.
examples.zh: 除夕夜全家老小圍坐在餐桌旁齊心包水餃，象徵招財進寶、迎春納福。

examples.en: Dip the boiled cabbage pork dumplings into black vinegar mixed with finely sliced ginger.
examples.zh: 將剛煮熟的高麗菜鮮肉水餃沾著調和薑絲的烏醋醬汁一同食用，滋味絕妙。

explains.en: A small ball or pocket of dough is filled with meat or vegetables. It can be boiled or steamed. People eat it with sauce.
Families may make these together for a holiday. Each person folds the edges. The shapes can vary.
A sweet version may contain fruit. Let hot filling cool before taking a bite. Share a plate with friends.

examples.en: A layer of dust covered the books on the top shelf.
examples.zh: 一層灰塵覆蓋了最上層架子上的書。

examples.en: She dusted the cake with powdered sugar.
examples.zh: 她在蛋糕上撒了糖粉。

examples.en: Dust from the dry field blew across the road.
examples.zh: 乾燥田地的塵土吹過道路。

explains.en: Tiny dry bits settle on shelves and floors. A cloth can wipe them away. Open windows carefully to air out a room.
The verb means covering something with fine powder. A baker adds sugar to a cake. Use only a little.
Wind can carry dry earth through the air. People may wear a mask in a dusty place. Keep eyes protected.

examples.en: The eager puppy waited by the door for its walk.
examples.zh: 熱切期待的小狗在門邊等著散步。

examples.en: Mia was eager to show her painting to the class.
examples.zh: 米亞迫不及待想把畫作展示給全班看。

examples.en: The eager volunteers arrived early to plant trees.
examples.zh: 熱心的志工提早到場種樹。

explains.en: A person is excited and ready for something to happen. A child waits for a birthday party. They ask when guests will arrive.
Someone may be very willing to learn. A student raises a hand to answer. Curiosity helps them grow.
People can feel keen to join an activity. Friends prepare for a hike. They pack water and snacks.

examples.en: Angled geometry and textured surfaces eliminate flutter echo between opposing parallel side walls.
examples.zh: 傾斜的非平行牆面設計搭配立體幾何紋理，徹底消除了平行側牆之間發生的「顫動回音」（Flutter Echo）。

examples.en: The lost mountaineer shouted loudly into the vast canyon, listening for the faint returning echo of his voice.
examples.zh: 迷路的登山客朝著空曠深邃的大峽谷大聲呼喊求救，屏息傾聽自己悠遠聲音在岩壁間傳回的微弱回聲。

examples.en: The prime minister’s impassioned speech seemed to echo the deep frustrations felt by working-class families.
examples.zh: 內閣總理發表的這場慷慨激昂施政演說，深刻呼應並共鳴了廣大基層勞工家庭長久以來的生計無奈。

entries.definition: 徹底消除平行牆面之顫動回音與空間駐波；回音

explains.en: A sound reflects off a wall or mountain and is heard again. People may call out in a cave. Their voices return to them.
The verb means repeating a sound in this way. A clap bounces around a hall. It fades slowly.
A person's words can be repeated by another speaker. This may show agreement. Listening carefully helps people understand.

examples.en: Please edit your story before you hand it in.
examples.zh: 請在交出故事前先修改。

examples.en: He edited the video to make the ending shorter.
examples.zh: 他剪輯影片，讓結尾更短。

examples.en: I edited my email to fix a spelling mistake.
examples.zh: 我修改電子郵件，修正了一個拼字錯誤。

explains.en: A person changes a piece of writing to make it clearer or correct mistakes. They check spelling and punctuation. A clean copy is easier to read.
A video maker can cut or arrange clips. They choose which scenes to keep. The final version tells a clear story.
A computer user may change a saved file. Save the new work. Keep a copy in case something goes wrong.

examples.en: The editor corrected a few spelling errors in my article.
examples.zh: 編輯修正了我文章中的幾個拼字錯誤。

examples.en: A newspaper editor chose the front-page story.
examples.zh: 報紙編輯選出了頭版故事。

examples.en: The editor added captions to the short film.
examples.zh: 剪輯師為短片加上字幕。

explains.en: A person checks writing and helps prepare it for readers. They correct mistakes. They may suggest clearer words.
A newspaper worker chooses which stories to print. They plan the pages. Deadlines help everyone finish on time.
A video worker may select scenes and put them in order. The story becomes easier to follow. Good sound is important too.

examples.en: The museum's programs educate children about local history.
examples.zh: 博物館的活動教導孩子認識地方歷史。

examples.en: Books educate us about animals from faraway places.
examples.zh: 書籍讓我們認識遠方的動物。

examples.en: The guide educated our group about the old bridge.
examples.zh: 導覽員讓我們了解這座舊橋的歷史。

explains.en: To teach someone facts or skills is to help them learn. A parent shows a child how to read a map. Practice helps.
Schools give lessons in many subjects. Teachers answer questions. Students learn from books and activities.
People can continue learning as adults. A class may teach cooking or computer skills. New knowledge can be useful.

examples.en: The educational game helped us practice spelling.
examples.zh: 這個教育遊戲幫助我們練習拼字。

examples.en: The zoo offers educational tours for school groups.
examples.zh: 動物園為學校團體提供教育導覽。

examples.en: We watched an educational video about ocean life.
examples.zh: 我們看了一部關於海洋生物的教育影片。

explains.en: Something helps people learn facts or skills. A museum trip can teach children about science. Hands-on activities make ideas clear.
A book may explain a subject with pictures and examples. Readers ask questions. Practice helps them remember.
Games can teach counting or teamwork. People have fun while learning. Choose activities that fit the learner's age.

examples.en: The efficient fan cools the room while using less electricity.
examples.zh: 這台省電的風扇能在耗電較少的情況下讓房間降溫。

examples.en: Our efficient plan helped us pack before the rain began.
examples.zh: 我們有效率的計畫幫助大家在下雨前收拾好。

examples.en: An efficient worker finished the careful task without wasting supplies.
examples.zh: 一位做事俐落的工作者沒有浪費材料就完成了細心的工作。

entries.definition: 有效率的；能節省時間或資源的

explains.en: A person or tool does a job well without wasting much time or effort. A sharp pencil makes drawing easier. Good planning helps too.
A machine may use less energy to finish a task. This can save money. Follow directions for best results.
A clear routine helps a group complete work smoothly. Everyone knows their part. Fewer steps can prevent mistakes.

examples.en: She bumped her elbow on the desk while reaching for a book.
examples.zh: 她伸手拿書時，手肘撞到了桌子。

examples.en: The pipe has an elbow beneath the kitchen sink.
examples.zh: 廚房水槽下方的管子有一個彎頭。

examples.en: He gently elbowed the door open because his hands were full.
examples.zh: 他雙手拿滿東西，便輕輕用手肘把門推開。

entries.definition: 手肘；肘部；彎管；（動）用手肘推

explains.en: This joint connects the upper and lower parts of an arm. It bends when someone reaches. A sleeve covers it.
People may lean an arm on a table during a meal. Keep space for others. Good manners help everyone feel comfortable.
A pipe may have a curved piece that changes its direction. Plumbers fit the part carefully. It helps water flow around a corner.

examples.en: The elderly neighbor waved to us from her garden.
examples.zh: 年長的鄰居在花園裡向我們揮手。

examples.en: A bus seat was saved for the elderly passenger.
examples.zh: 公車上為年長乘客保留了一個座位。

examples.en: The center offers free classes for elderly residents.
examples.zh: 活動中心為年長居民提供免費課程。

entries.definition: 年長的；年邁的；老年人的。

explains.en: Older people may need more time or help with some daily tasks. They have many life experiences. Treat them with patience and respect.
A person in this age group may enjoy walking or meeting friends. Activities should suit their health. Family members can offer support.
Different people age in different ways. Some stay active for many years. Kind communities make places easier for everyone to use.

examples.en: Students will elect a class leader on Monday.
examples.zh: 學生們將在星期一選出班級幹部。

examples.en: The club members elected Maya as their new president.
examples.zh: 社團成員選出瑪雅擔任新會長。

examples.en: Voters elect local leaders to represent their community.
examples.zh: 選民選出地方領袖來代表社區。

explains.en: People choose someone for a position by voting. Members mark a paper or use a machine. The person with enough votes wins.
A group may choose a leader for a club. Everyone listens to ideas. A fair process gives members a voice.
In older writing, the word can mean choosing or deciding. Context explains which meaning fits. Read the whole sentence.

examples.en: The presidential election took place smoothly on Saturday.
examples.zh: 總統大選在週六平穩順利地完成舉行。

examples.en: Election campaigns filled city streets with colorful banners and broadcast trucks.
examples.zh: 選舉宣傳活動讓市區大街小巷掛滿了繽紛旗幟並穿梭著宣傳車。

examples.en: She volunteered as an election observer to ensure fair ballot counting.
examples.zh: 她自願擔任投開票所監票志工，以確保計票過程公正公開。

explains.en: People vote to choose leaders or decide an issue. They learn about the choices first. Rules make the process fair.
A school club may choose a president this way. Each member marks a vote. The group counts them carefully.
Taking part lets people help shape decisions. Citizens follow local rules. Results are shared with the public.

examples.en: The storm knocked out electricity across our street.
examples.zh: 暴風雨讓我們整條街都停電了。

examples.en: Electricity powers the lights in the school gym.
examples.zh: 電力為學校體育館的燈供電。

examples.en: We saved electricity by turning off the lamps after class.
examples.zh: 下課後我們關掉燈，節省了電力。

explains.en: Energy flows through wires and powers lights, machines, and computers. People should never touch loose wires. Ask an adult for help.
A power station sends energy to homes. Switches control lamps. Turn them off when leaving a room.
Lightning is a natural form of this energy. Stay indoors during storms. Avoid tall trees and open fields.

examples.en: The electronic clock shows the time in large green numbers.
examples.zh: 電子時鐘用綠色大字顯示時間。

examples.en: Our class used an electronic map to find the museum.
examples.zh: 我們班用電子地圖尋找博物館。

examples.en: Please recycle old electronic devices at the collection center.
examples.zh: 請把舊電子設備送到回收中心。

entries.definition: 電子的；電子設備的；電子學的

explains.en: A device uses electricity and small parts to process information. Phones and tablets are examples. Use screen time wisely.
Music or messages can be stored and played by a computer. Files need space. Back them up to avoid losing them.
A card reader can send information to a cash register. Businesses use these tools. Protect private numbers and passwords.

examples.en: Unlocking the chemical power of the periodic table's first element empowers humanity to live in harmony with nature.
examples.zh: 解鎖週期表「第一號宇宙元素氫」（Element）的神奇能量，賦予人類與大自然生生不息、和諧共生的智慧。

examples.en: Water, carbon, and nitrogen are vital chemical elements necessary for sustaining biological organic life.
examples.zh: 氫、氧、碳與氮等天然化學元素，是構建並滋養地球上萬千碳基生物有機生命所絕對必需的根本物質基石。

examples.en: Trust, mutual respect, and clear communication are essential elements of any enduring partnership.
examples.zh: 彼此深厚堅定的信任、發自內心的相互尊重與坦率無礙的真誠溝通，是維繫任何長遠穩固夥伴合作關係不可或缺的核心要素。

entries.definition: 善用宇宙中最古老且豐沛之第一號元素氫；元素

explains.en: A basic part of something can help form a larger whole. Water has two kinds of atoms. Scientists study how parts combine.
A story has important parts such as characters and setting. These help readers follow what happens. Each one adds meaning.
A school subject may have a special symbol for a chemical substance. Students learn what it is. Lab rules keep them safe.

examples.en: Press the button to call the elevator to the 10th floor.
examples.zh: 按下按鈕叫電梯到十樓。

examples.en: The modern high-speed elevator whisks passengers to the observation deck.
examples.zh: 現代化的高速電梯迅速將遊客送達高空景觀觀景台。

examples.en: In case of fire or earthquake, never take the building elevator.
examples.zh: 遇到火災或地震時，絕對不可搭乘建築物內的電梯。

examples.en: Take the high-speed express elevator to reach the 89th floor observatory.
examples.zh: 搭乘高速景觀電梯即可在數十秒內直達八十九樓觀景台。

examples.en: A backup power system ensures that hospital elevators operate safely during blackouts.
examples.zh: 雙迴路緊急備用電源系統確保醫院電梯在遭遇突發大停電時依舊能平穩安全運轉。

examples.en: Step aside and let exiting passengers disembark before stepping into the elevator.
examples.zh: 進入升降電梯前請自覺側身讓開，禮讓車廂內欲離開的乘客先行步出電梯。

explains.en: A machine carries people between floors in a building. They press a button for the level they need. Wait behind the doors.
People with heavy bags or limited mobility can use it. Stand still while it moves. Let passengers leave before entering.
A small platform may lift goods in a shop or home. Do not overload it. Follow posted instructions.

examples.en: Detecting initial seismic P-waves triggers automatic emergency braking before the violent shaking arrives.
examples.zh: 捕捉到地震初波 P 波的瞬間，系統在劇烈搖晃到達前數秒自主啟動「強力緊急煞車」（Emergency Braking）。

examples.en: Hospital emergency rooms operate around the clock with trauma surgeons ready for urgent procedures.
examples.zh: 醫學中心急診重症室全天候燈火通明高效運作，創傷外科專科醫師隨時待命執行重大緊急手術。

examples.en: Keep a well-stocked emergency backpack containing bottled water, flashlight batteries, and canned food.
examples.zh: 家中應常備妥善收納的防震避難救急背包，備妥充足包裝飲用水、手電筒乾電池與開罐即食乾糧。

entries.definition: 地震偵測瞬間啟動之全車強力緊急煞車；緊急

explains.en: A sudden serious problem needs quick help. A fire or severe injury may require a call to local services. Stay calm and follow directions.
A school practices what to do during danger. Students learn where to go. Prepared plans can protect everyone.
Keep important phone numbers easy to find. Ask a trusted adult for help. Never play with alarm systems.

examples.en: The movie's ending was so emotional that many viewers cried.
examples.zh: 這部電影的結尾如此感人，令許多觀眾熱淚盈眶。

examples.en: Pets provide comforting emotional support to owners during difficult times.
examples.zh: 在主人身處人生低谷時，忠誠的毛小孩能提供溫暖慰藉的情感支持。

examples.en: Avoid making hasty life decisions when feeling exhausted and emotional.
examples.zh: 當身心感到精疲力竭且情緒波動較大時，切忌草率做出重大人生決策。

examples.en: High emotional intelligence (EQ) helps team leaders resolve workplace conflicts with empathy.
examples.zh: 具備高度的情緒智商（情商 EQ）能幫助團隊主管以同理心圓融化解同仁間的職場摩擦與歧見。

examples.en: Burnout often manifests as emotional exhaustion followed by detachment from everyday duties.
examples.zh: 嚴重的職場倦怠往往先從情緒能量枯竭開始，隨之而來的是對日常例行公事產生強烈疏離感。

examples.en: Providing compassionate emotional support to grieving colleagues strengthens organizational culture.
examples.zh: 在團隊成員面臨家庭變故時及時給予溫暖體貼的情感支持，能深層凝聚企業內部的人性關懷文化。

entries.definition: 情感上的；情緒化的；情緒的情商的；感性的

explains.en: A person feels strong feelings such as joy, sadness, or anger. Talking can help them understand what is happening. Others can listen kindly.
A story may make readers feel deeply. Music can also bring back memories. People react in different ways.
It is healthy to name a feeling. Take time to calm down. Ask someone trusted for support when needed.

examples.en: The emperor greeted guests from the balcony of his palace.
examples.zh: 皇帝在宮殿陽台上向賓客致意。

examples.en: An emperor ruled the ancient land in the story.
examples.zh: 故事中的皇帝統治著那片古老的土地。

examples.en: The museum displayed a robe once worn by an emperor.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了一件皇帝曾穿過的長袍。

explains.en: A male ruler once governed a large empire. He made important decisions. Many people lived under his rule.
History books tell about rulers in different countries. Their customs and power varied. Some built large palaces.
A person can learn about the past through records and objects. Museums preserve these items. Respectful study helps us understand history.

examples.en: The new path enables visitors to reach the lake safely.
examples.zh: 新的步道讓訪客能安全地抵達湖邊。

examples.en: This setting enables captions on the video.
examples.zh: 這項設定可以開啟影片字幕。

examples.en: A ramp enabled the child to enter the library in her wheelchair.
examples.zh: 斜坡讓坐輪椅的孩子能進入圖書館。

explains.en: To make something possible is to give it the means or permission to happen. A ramp lets a wheelchair enter a building. Access matters.
A button may turn on a feature in a program. Read instructions before changing settings. Ask for help if unsure.
Good tools let people complete jobs they could not do alone. A handle helps open a jar. Simple designs can be useful.

examples.en: The energetic puppy ran around the yard all morning.
examples.zh: 精力充沛的小狗整個早上都在院子裡跑來跑去。

examples.en: Our energetic guide led the hike up the hill.
examples.zh: 我們精力充沛的導遊帶領大家爬上山丘。

examples.en: The energetic music made everyone want to dance.
examples.zh: 充滿活力的音樂讓每個人都想跳舞。

entries.definition: 精力充沛的；充滿活力的

explains.en: A person has lots of strength and enthusiasm. A child may run and play for hours. Rest and food help them recover.
A lively performance can feel full of movement. Musicians play with excitement. The crowd responds with clapping.
A person can bring positive activity to a group. They share ideas. Others may feel encouraged to join.

examples.en: High audience engagement proves that the video resonated with viewers.
examples.zh: 高觀眾互動率證明了該影片引起了閱聽大眾的深刻共鳴。

examples.en: Replying to comments under your posts significantly boosts user engagement.
examples.zh: 在貼文底下回覆留言能顯著提升使用者的互動參與度。

examples.en: They happily announced their wedding engagement to close family members.
examples.zh: 他們滿心歡喜地向至親家人宣布了兩人訂婚的喜訊。

examples.en: Replying to community comments boosts social media algorithmic engagement scores.
examples.zh: 創作者親自逐一回覆粉絲留言互動能顯著拉升演算法對該篇貼文的社群互動率評分。

examples.en: The young couple happily celebrated their romantic engagement with close family and friends.
examples.zh: 這對年輕新人與摯愛親友聚在一塊，溫馨熱鬧地慶祝他們浪漫的訂婚喜訊。

examples.en: Teachers look for interactive lesson plans that stimulate active student engagement in class.
examples.zh: 教師們積極尋求具互動性的教學教案，以激發學生在課堂上的主動參與度與學習興致。

examples.en: Institutional investors use active shareholder engagement to urge boards to set science-based net-zero goals.
examples.zh: 大型退休基金等責任機構投資人透過「股東積極議合」（Engagement），敦促企業董事會訂定具約束力的淨零時程。

examples.en: The cheerful couple celebrated their romantic marriage engagement with family at an oceanfront restaurant.
examples.zh: 這對沉浸在幸福喜悅中的準新人與雙方親友齊聚在海景景觀餐廳，溫馨舉辦了甜蜜浪漫的訂婚慶祝家宴。

examples.en: Interactive classroom polling apps significantly increased student attention and active classroom engagement.
examples.zh: 在大學講堂中導入互動式即時手機投票問答軟體，極為顯著地提升了全場學生的專注力與課堂主動參與互動度。

entries.definition: 互動率；參與度；訂婚；社群互動率；約定；責任機構投資人股東氣候議合

explains.en: A person can take part in an activity or conversation. Students join a class discussion. Sharing ideas helps everyone learn.
A machine part can fit with another and work together. The pieces move as a pair. Proper fitting keeps the device running.
Two people may promise to marry in the future. They share the news with family. The ceremony can happen later.

examples.en: We had an enjoyable afternoon making paper boats by the river.
examples.zh: 我們在河邊摺紙船，度過愉快的午後。

examples.en: Mia found the puzzle enjoyable because each clue led to a surprise.
examples.zh: 米亞覺得這個謎題很有趣，因為每個線索都帶來驚喜。

examples.en: The children said the picnic was enjoyable, even though it rained.
examples.zh: 孩子們說這次野餐很愉快，儘管途中下了雨。

explains.en: A pleasant activity makes people feel happy while they do it. It can be fun without being exciting. A picnic with friends may feel this way.
People often use this description for a book, game, or meal that brings them pleasure. Different people may like different things. Sharing a favorite story can make reading more fun.
A good time can come from simple things, such as drawing or walking outside. The activity does not need to cost much. Feeling relaxed afterward is one sign that it went well.

examples.en: The side entry to the library is open after school.
examples.zh: 放學後，圖書館的側門入口會開放。

examples.en: Please add your name as the final entry on the class list.
examples.zh: 請把你的名字加在班級名單最後一項。

examples.en: Lena sent a poem as her entry in the writing contest.
examples.zh: 莉娜投稿一首詩，參加寫作比賽。

entries.definition: 入口；進入；條目；參賽作品；報名。

explains.en: This word can name a way into a room or building. It can also mean one item written on a list. A door is an entrance, and each name may be one listed item.
At a contest, a person may send in a piece of work to be judged. That work is one submission. A student might send a drawing to an art show.
A record book can hold many short pieces of information. Each one has its own place on a page. A line with a date and name is one example.

examples.en: I felt envy when my brother got a bigger slice of cake.
examples.zh: 弟弟拿到比較大塊的蛋糕時，我心生羨慕。

examples.en: Some students envy Ella because she can draw horses so well.
examples.zh: 有些同學羨慕艾拉，因為她很會畫馬。

examples.en: He tried not to envy his friend and practiced the guitar instead.
examples.zh: 他努力不去嫉妒朋友，轉而練習吉他。

explains.en: This feeling happens when someone wishes they had what another person has. It may involve a toy, skill, or good opportunity. Talking honestly can help a person handle the feeling kindly.
As a verb, it describes wanting another person’s good fortune for yourself. It does not mean you want to hurt that person. A child may wish for a friend’s bright new bicycle.

Admiration can feel warm and encouraging, while this feeling may include sadness about your own situation. You can notice the feeling and still be happy for a friend. Working toward your own goal can help.

examples.en: Please erase the extra line from your drawing.
examples.zh: 請把你畫多的那條線擦掉。

examples.en: Dad used a cloth to erase the chalk marks from the board.
examples.zh: 爸爸用布擦掉黑板上的粉筆痕跡。

examples.en: I erased the old phone number before writing the new one.
examples.zh: 我先刪掉舊電話號碼，再寫上新的。

explains.en: To remove marks from a surface is to make them disappear. A rubber tool can take pencil lines off paper. Some marks need careful rubbing.
A computer user can remove words from a screen with a key or command. The text disappears from the page. Saving a copy first can protect important work.
Cleaning and removing are related, but this action focuses on making a mark or recorded information go away. Chalk can be wiped from a board. A mistake in pencil is easy to correct.

examples.en: The pursuit of personal excellence is a continuous journey of self-discovery and refinement.
examples.zh: 對於「個人卓越境界的追尋」（Pursuit of Excellence），是一段永不停歇、不斷雕琢自我的崇高修行。

examples.en: Taiwan’s semiconductor manufacturing has achieved world-class excellence through uncompromising engineering standards.
examples.zh: 台灣半導體晶圓代工製造業憑藉著毫不妥協的嚴謹製程工藝，在全世界樹立了世界級卓越典範。

examples.en: She was awarded a scholarship recognizing her academic excellence and sustained community service.
examples.zh: 她因出類拔萃的優異學術研究表現與持之以恆的社區志工付出，榮獲全額獎學金表揚。

entries.definition: 永不停止追求卓越、精益求精之大師心境；卓越

explains.en: This noun describes a very high level of quality. Care, practice, and good choices can help someone reach it. A carefully built bridge may show excellent work.
In school, strong work over time can earn praise for its quality. It takes effort to learn and improve. Asking for feedback can help a student do better.
Being good is not always the same as being outstanding. The highest standard often comes from patience and attention to small details. A team can aim for this in every project.

examples.en: You can exchange US dollars for NT dollars at bank counters.
examples.zh: 您可以在銀行櫃檯將美金兌換為新台幣。

examples.en: Students from both universities participated in an academic exchange program.
examples.zh: 兩所大學的學生參加了學術文化交流計畫。

examples.en: Customers can exchange unused merchandise within seven days of purchase.
examples.zh: 顧客可在購買後七日內更換未拆封使用的商品。

examples.en: I would like to exchange this medium shirt for a large one.
examples.zh: 我想把這件 M 號襯衫換成 L 號的。

examples.en: Cultural and student exchange programs broaden young people's global horizons.
examples.zh: 文化與學生交流計畫能開拓年輕人的全球視野。

examples.en: Can I exchange foreign currency notes at this international airport bank?
examples.zh: 我能在這間國際機場銀行兌換外幣紙鈔嗎？

examples.en: Energy recovery ventilators exchange stale indoor air for filtered fresh air without losing room temperature.
examples.zh: 裝設全熱交換新風換氣機（Heat Recovery Ventilator），在引進戶外過濾活氧新風時完全不流失室內冷房溫度。

examples.en: Foreign tourists visited the bank to exchange US dollars and Euros into New Taiwan Dollars.
examples.zh: 剛抵達桃園國際機場的各國外籍旅客，紛紛前往出境大廳外幣兌換銀行櫃檯，將美元與歐元換成新台幣現鈔。

examples.en: The two opposing generals met briefly in no man's land to negotiate a formal exchange of captured prisoners.
examples.zh: 兩軍交戰的前線指揮官在非軍事中立緩衝區短暫會晤，就人道互換雙方戰俘的名單與地點展開正式停火交涉。

examples.en: The Taiwan Carbon Solution Exchange (TCX) allows certified corporations to trade verified carbon credits.
examples.zh: 臺灣碳權交易所（TCX）正式開市營運，提供經國際認證的高品質碳權在透明平台上公開合法交易。

examples.en: She visited the local currency exchange desk at the airport to convert leftover yen back into dollars.
examples.zh: 她在抵達機場出境大廳後前往外幣兌換水單櫃檯，將出國旅遊花剩的多餘日圓現鈔換回新台幣。

examples.en: High school students joined an international cultural exchange program to practice German in Berlin.
examples.zh: 幾位熱愛異國文化的高中學子主動報名參加國際青年文化交流計畫，遠赴德國柏林寄宿家庭精進德語會話。

entries.definition: 兌換；交換；交流；退換（商品）；全熱交換新風換氣機；臺灣碳權交易所 (TCX)

explains.en: Two people may give things to each other and receive something back. This can happen with gifts, cards, or useful information. Both sides take part.
A shop may let a customer return one size and take another. Banks also change one kind of money into another. The exact meaning depends on what is being traded.
People can share ideas by speaking or writing to one another. A friendly talk is one kind of sharing. Each person listens and then responds.

examples.en: We visited a contemporary art exhibition at Songshan Cultural Park.
examples.zh: 我們參觀了松山文創園區的當代藝術特展。

examples.en: The museum's dinosaur fossil exhibition attracted thousands of children.
examples.zh: 該博物館的恐龍化石展覽吸引了成千上萬的孩童。

examples.en: Several international technology brands displayed their innovations at the trade exhibition.
examples.zh: 數家國際科技品牌在貿易展覽會上展示了他們的創新成果。

examples.en: The special Impressionist art exhibition attracted thousands of visitors daily.
examples.zh: 這場印象派特展每天吸引了數千名藝文愛好者前來觀展。

examples.en: A prestigious pottery exhibition will be held in Yingge next month.
examples.zh: 下個月將在鶯歌盛大舉辦一場高規格的國際陶瓷陶藝特展。

examples.en: The natural history museum opened a temporary dinosaur fossil exhibition for children.
examples.zh: 自然史博物館特地為廣大學童開闢了一處為期三個月的恐龍化石常規特展。

examples.en: The veteran photographer hosted a solo black-and-white photography exhibition.
examples.zh: 這位資深紀實攝影大師在當代藝術館舉辦了個人大型經典黑白人文攝影回顧特展。

examples.en: The museum's contemporary art exhibition drew record crowds over the long holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 該美術館精心策劃的當代新銳藝術大展在連續長假期間吸引了創紀錄的爆滿觀展人潮。

examples.en: Framing and lighting are just as important as the prints themselves when curating an exhibition.
examples.zh: 在籌辦一場高水準的攝影作品展覽時，畫框裝裱的做工與展廳光影投射氛圍與作品本身同等重要。

examples.en: Over a million visitors attended the world-touring French Impressionist master exhibition.
examples.zh: 超過百萬名熱愛藝術的民眾爭相購票參觀這場跨國巡迴展出的法國印象派名畫大師特展。

examples.en: Photography is strictly prohibited inside the temporary gold artifact exhibition.
examples.zh: 該黃金古物專題特展展廳內全面嚴格禁止使用閃光燈與任何形式的拍照攝影。

examples.en: The local pottery exhibition at Yingge showcases both centuries of tradition and modern ceramics.
examples.zh: 於鶯歌陶瓷博物館舉辦的在地陶藝展，完美薈萃了數百年的製陶工藝底蘊與當代創新瓷作。

examples.en: The world-class deep-sea exhibition combines tactile models with interactive touchscreen learning kiosks.
examples.zh: 這場世界級的深海「科普常設展覽」（Exhibition），將實體觸摸模型與互動觸控多媒體完美結合。

examples.en: Thousands of visitors queued outside the fine arts museum to tour the visiting impressionist exhibition.
examples.zh: 數以萬計熱愛藝術的參觀民眾在國立美術館門外大排長龍，爭睹難得一見的法國印象派大師巡迴真跡特展。

examples.en: The industrial trade exhibition showcased cutting-edge automation robots and smart warehouse logistics.
examples.zh: 台北國際自動化工業大展在南港展覽館隆重揭幕，匯聚展示了當代最頂尖的機器人手臂與智慧倉儲物流。

entries.definition: 展覽；展出；博覽會；美展；攝影特展；藝術展覽會；專題特展；世界級寓教於樂沉浸式海洋科普常設展覽

explains.en: A public display lets visitors look at objects or works of art. A museum may show old tools, paintings, or animal models. Labels help explain what people see.
Schools sometimes arrange a display of student projects. Families can walk around and learn about each project. The work stays on view for a set time.
A performance happens on a stage, while this event usually presents things for people to view. A gallery may show photographs along its walls. Visitors can move from one piece to the next.

examples.en: My expectation was that the bus would arrive before noon.
examples.zh: 我原本預期公車會在中午前抵達。

examples.en: The coach explained her expectations before the first practice.
examples.zh: 教練在第一次練習前說明了她的要求。

examples.en: Our expectations changed when the storm delayed the ferry.
examples.zh: 暴風雨讓渡輪延誤後，我們的預期也改變了。

explains.en: A belief about what may happen in the future is called this. A child may think a package will arrive today. The real event can match that belief or differ from it.
People also have ideas about how someone should behave. Clear and fair rules can help everyone understand what is wanted. Talking about them avoids confusion.
A hope is a wish for something good, while this can be a belief about what is likely. A weather forecast may shape what families plan. Plans sometimes change when new facts appear.

examples.en: Chemistry students conducted a colorful titration laboratory experiment.
examples.zh: 化學系學生在實驗室進行了一場色彩斑斕的酸鹼滴定實驗。

examples.en: The startup decided to experiment with a four-day workweek model.
examples.zh: 這家創新新創團隊決定大膽試驗推行每週四天工作制的新營運模式。

examples.en: Careful control variables are crucial for obtaining reproducible results in any experiment.
examples.zh: 嚴格控制各項控制變數是確保任何科學實驗皆能產出可重複驗證成果的關鍵。

explains.en: A careful test can help answer a question. A person changes one thing and watches what happens. Keeping other conditions alike makes the result easier to understand.
In science class, children may test which paper towel absorbs the most water. They write down what they observe. Repeating the test can make the finding more dependable.
Trying a new idea is also a small test in everyday life. A cook may change one ingredient in a recipe. The result shows whether the change worked.

examples.en: The science teacher warned us never to heat a sealed can because it could explode.
examples.zh: 自然老師提醒我們，密封的罐子不能加熱，否則可能會爆開。

examples.en: A small firework seemed to explode above the lake.
examples.zh: 一枚小煙火似乎在湖面上空炸開了。

examples.en: The old balloon may explode if you keep blowing air into it.
examples.zh: 如果你一直往舊氣球裡吹氣，它可能會爆開。

entries.definition: 爆炸；爆裂；勃然大怒；突然增加。

explains.en: To burst apart suddenly with force is to do this. Some fireworks make a loud burst in the sky. People should watch them from a safe distance.
A balloon can burst when too much air fills it. The pieces move apart quickly and the sound may startle someone. A small pop is not the same as a dangerous blast.
In stories, this verb may describe a sudden strong reaction, such as anger. The person did not literally break into pieces. Context tells readers whether the meaning is physical or figurative.

examples.en: We explored the tide pools and found tiny crabs.
examples.zh: 我們探索潮池，發現了小螃蟹。

examples.en: The class explored how seeds grow in different soils.
examples.zh: 全班探究種子在不同土壤中的生長情形。

examples.en: Nora likes to explore new streets with her family.
examples.zh: 諾拉喜歡和家人一起探訪新街道。

explains.en: To travel around a place and learn what is there is to do this. A family may walk through a forest and notice birds. They can discover a quiet stream along the way.
People can examine an idea by asking questions and looking for facts. A student may read several books about space. This careful search helps the student understand more.
A trip with no known route can bring new sights and surprises. A map may help, but curiosity guides the visitors too. They should respect nature and local rules.

examples.en: Taiwan exports high-precision electronic components worldwide.
examples.zh: 台灣向全球出口高精密電子零組件。

examples.en: Tropical sweet mangoes and orchids are key agricultural exports.
examples.zh: 香甜多汁的熱帶芒果與嬌豔的蝴蝶蘭是重要的大宗外銷農產品。

examples.en: Strong global tech demand significantly boosted monthly export volume.
examples.zh: 全球強勁的科技硬體需求大幅推升了本月份的外銷出口總額。

examples.en: Heavy armored export cables buried beneath coastal beaches transmit green power directly to the inland grid.
examples.zh: 深埋在海床與海岸沙灘下方的 220kV 雙層鋼甲高壓輸出海纜，將綠電直送陸上電網。

examples.en: The export cable route traverses shallow fishing grounds and connects to a landing station ashore.
examples.zh: 輸出海纜路徑穿過沿岸近海淺水養殖作業區，最終登陸串接上岸邊的專用海纜陸上變電站接線所。

examples.en: Extra protective concrete mattresses shield the export cable where it crosses shipping fairways.
examples.zh: 在輸出海纜橫越繁忙商船航道交叉點的路段，施工團隊加鋪了重型混凝土連鎖防護塊毯予以強化保護。

entries.definition: 出口；輸出；外銷；220kV 高壓交流送電海纜 (輸電回陸地)

explains.en: A country sends goods to another country for people there to buy. Fruit, clothes, and machines can all be shipped this way. This trade connects businesses across borders.
A computer program can save a file in a form another program understands. The user chooses a format and creates a copy. Pictures and lists can be handled this way.
Sending goods out and bringing goods in describe opposite directions in trade. A farmer may sell tea leaves abroad. The leaves then travel to buyers in another land.

examples.en: Her expressive face showed how surprised she was.
examples.zh: 她生動的表情顯示她有多驚訝。

examples.en: The expressive singer made the sad song feel real.
examples.zh: 那位富有感染力的歌手讓悲傷的歌曲聽起來很真切。

examples.en: His hands were expressive as he told the story.
examples.zh: 他說故事時手勢豐富。

entries.definition: 富有表現力的；能表達情感的

explains.en: A face, voice, or movement can show feelings clearly. A child with a lively smile may reveal great excitement. Other people can understand the feeling without many words.
An actor uses changes in tone and gesture to make a character feel real. The audience can notice anger, joy, or worry. Small movements can carry a strong message.
A plain voice gives little clue about feelings, while a lively one shares more. Music can also sound full of emotion. Listeners may picture a scene as they hear it.

examples.en: The hikers turned back because of the extreme cold.
examples.zh: 登山客因為酷寒而折返。

examples.en: That was an extreme reaction to a tiny mistake.
examples.zh: 對一個小錯誤有那樣的反應實在太過激烈。

examples.en: The desert can have extreme heat during the day.
examples.zh: 沙漠白天可能會非常炎熱。

entries.definition: （形）極端的；極度的；盡頭的；（名）極端；極限

explains.en: Something at the far end of a range is described this way. Very hot weather can feel uncomfortable. Very cold weather is another example.
A person can have a very strong opinion or reaction. It may be much stronger than most people expect. Listening calmly can help everyone understand one another.
Mild means gentle or moderate, while this word points to an unusually high or low degree. A steep hill may be difficult to climb. Safety matters when conditions become severe.

examples.en: The red paint began to fade in the strong sun.
examples.zh: 紅色油漆在強烈陽光下開始褪色。

examples.en: The music faded as the train moved away.
examples.zh: 火車駛遠後，音樂聲逐漸消失。

examples.en: My worry started to fade after I spoke with my teacher.
examples.zh: 和老師談過之後，我的擔心開始減輕。

entries.definition: 褪色；逐漸消失；淡出；減弱。

explains.en: Colors may slowly become less bright over time. Sunlight can lighten a picture left by a window. Keeping it in a book may protect it.
A sound can grow quieter until people can no longer hear it. Music on a radio may become distant as a car drives away. The change happens gradually.
This verb describes a slow loss of strength or visibility. It differs from disappearing all at once. A memory may become less clear as years pass.

examples.en: She felt faint after standing in the hot sun.
examples.zh: 她在烈日下站了一會兒後感到頭暈虛弱。

examples.en: We saw a faint line drawn in blue pencil.
examples.zh: 我們看見一條用藍色鉛筆畫的淡淡線條。

examples.en: A faint sound came from the room upstairs.
examples.zh: 樓上房間傳來微弱的聲音。

entries.definition: （形）微弱的；模糊的；虛弱的；（動）昏倒；（名）昏厥

explains.en: A person who feels weak or dizzy may lose awareness briefly. Sitting down and telling a trusted adult can help keep that person safe. This can happen after standing too long or feeling unwell.
A mark or sound that is hard to notice can also be described this way. A pale line may barely show on paper. A distant bell may be difficult to hear.
Strong is the opposite of weak in many situations. A slight smell or dim light is present but not powerful. People may need to look or listen closely to notice it.

examples.en: The walk to the lake is fairly easy for young children.
examples.zh: 對年幼的孩子來說，走到湖邊算是相當輕鬆。

examples.en: Our teacher tried to treat every student fairly.
examples.zh: 我們的老師努力公平對待每位學生。

examples.en: The soup is fairly warm, so let it cool a little.
examples.zh: 湯還滿燙的，先讓它稍微涼一點。

explains.en: This adverb can mean to a moderate degree. If a path is moderately short, most walkers can finish it without much trouble. It is longer than tiny but not very long.
It can also describe treating people in an even and honest way. A referee should listen to both teams. Rules should apply equally to everyone.
The meaning depends on the sentence. It may describe how much something is true or how someone behaves. Context helps the reader choose the right sense.

examples.en: The little girl dressed as a fairy for the school play.
examples.zh: 小女孩在學校戲劇中扮成仙女。

examples.en: A fairy in the story left a silver key by the door.
examples.zh: 故事中的仙女在門邊留下一把銀色鑰匙。

examples.en: We drew a tiny fairy sitting on a flower.
examples.zh: 我們畫了一個坐在花朵上的小仙子。

explains.en: A tiny magical person in many old stories is called this. Such a character may have wings and use magic. The details change from tale to tale.
Children may read about these beings in picture books. They often live in forests or hidden gardens. A story may show them helping someone in trouble.
Such a being is an imaginary story figure, unlike a real insect or bird. Artists draw these characters in many ways. Their bright clothes and small wings are common story details.

examples.en: Her faith in her team helped everyone keep trying.
examples.zh: 她對團隊的信任讓大家繼續努力。

examples.en: The museum showed how people of different faiths celebrate.
examples.zh: 博物館展示不同信仰的人們如何慶祝。

examples.en: He had faith that his friend would return the book.
examples.zh: 他相信朋友會把書還回來。

explains.en: Trust in a person or idea can be described by this noun. A child may believe a friend will keep a promise. That trust grows when people act honestly.
For many people, it also means a set of religious beliefs. Families may celebrate special days connected with those beliefs. Different communities have different traditions.

Confidence can come from evidence, while trust sometimes continues even when the outcome is uncertain. A team may believe it can finish a hard task. Supporting one another can strengthen that feeling.

examples.en: The toy shop sold a fake crown made of gold-colored plastic.
examples.zh: 玩具店販售一頂金色塑膠製的假皇冠。

examples.en: He wore a fake smile when he did not enjoy the joke.
examples.zh: 他不喜歡那個笑話，卻露出不真誠的笑容。

examples.en: The museum warned visitors not to buy fake tickets online.
examples.zh: 博物館提醒遊客不要在線上購買假票。

entries.definition: （形）假的；仿造的；（動）偽造；假裝；（名）仿冒品

explains.en: Something made to look real but not genuine has this quality. A pretend coin may look shiny but be made of plastic. Looking closely can reveal the difference.
People sometimes use this adjective for behavior that is not sincere. A forced smile may not show what someone truly feels. Honest words are kinder in the long run.
A copy can be useful when it is clearly labeled, such as a toy phone. Trouble begins when someone tries to deceive others. Checking where an item came from can help.

examples.en: That face looks familiar, but I cannot remember his name.
examples.zh: 那張臉看起來很眼熟，但我想不起他的名字。

examples.en: The dog was familiar with the path through the park.
examples.zh: 那隻狗熟悉穿過公園的小徑。

examples.en: This tune is familiar because Grandma sings it often.
examples.zh: 這段旋律很熟悉，因為奶奶常常唱。

explains.en: A person or place may seem known because you have seen it before. The school gate feels known to a student who passes it every day. Repeated visits make it easier to recognize.
You can know a song well enough to sing along. Its tune and words are no longer new to you. Hearing it again may bring back memories.
Unfamiliar describes something new or unknown. When a place feels known, you may move around with more confidence. Still, it is wise to pay attention to changes.

examples.en: She wore a fancy hat to the costume party.
examples.zh: 她戴著華麗的帽子參加化裝派對。

examples.en: Do you fancy a bowl of warm soup?
examples.zh: 你想喝一碗熱湯嗎？

examples.en: The baker made a fancy cake with tiny sugar flowers.
examples.zh: 麵包師傅做了一個有小糖花裝飾的精緻蛋糕。

entries.definition: （形）華麗的；精緻的；昂貴的；想要的；（動）喜歡；想要；（名）想像

explains.en: As an adjective, this word can describe something decorated or stylish. A hat with ribbons and bright feathers may look elaborate. It may be worn for a special event.
As a verb, it can mean to want or like something. A child might want a cold drink after running. The sentence shows which meaning is intended.
Plain clothing has few decorations, while elaborate clothing may have many details. A person can also imagine liking a certain choice. Reading the surrounding words helps.

examples.en: You can tap your EasyCard to pay the bus fare.
examples.zh: 你可以感應悠遊卡來支付公車車資。

examples.en: Airline fares tend to surge during the summer vacation season.
examples.zh: 機票票價往往會在暑假旅遊旺季期間飆漲。

examples.en: Senior citizens enjoy discounted public transport fares nationwide.
examples.zh: 全國年長者搭乘大眾運輸工具享有優惠折扣票價。

explains.en: The money paid for a trip on a bus, train, or plane is called this. A passenger buys a ticket before traveling. The price can depend on distance.
In a restaurant, this noun can mean food offered to customers. A simple meal may include soup and bread. The menu shows what is available.
The cost of travel and the food served at a meal are different meanings. A sentence about a ticket points to the first sense. A sentence about lunch points to the second.

examples.en: The lake is farther from our house than the playground.
examples.zh: 湖比遊樂場離我們家更遠。

examples.en: We walked farther along the trail to reach the waterfall.
examples.zh: 我們沿著步道走得更遠，終於到達瀑布。

examples.en: The farther cabin had a clear view of the valley.
examples.zh: 較遠的那間小屋可以清楚看見山谷。

explains.en: This form compares physical distance between places. If one house is more distant from school, the trip there takes more walking. A map can help compare the routes.
It can describe moving beyond a point. Walk a little more along the path and you will reach the bridge. The word tells us the extra distance.
For distance, this form often compares how remote two places are. Further can also mean additional, as in more discussion. Careful writers choose the form that fits their meaning.

examples.en: Bright green shoes are fashionable at the school this year.
examples.zh: 今年學校裡流行亮綠色的鞋子。

examples.en: That small cafe has fashionable chairs and colorful lights.
examples.zh: 那間小咖啡館有時髦的椅子和彩色燈飾。

examples.en: Mina likes fashionable clothes but chooses comfortable ones.
examples.zh: 米娜喜歡流行服飾，但會選擇穿起來舒服的款式。

explains.en: Clothes or styles that many people currently admire can be described this way. The popular look may change from year to year. Comfort and personal taste still matter.
A design can be popular in furniture, music, or decoration too. Shops often show the styles customers are asking for. A trend does not have to suit everyone.
Classic styles stay popular for a long time, while a passing trend may soon change. People can enjoy a current look without buying everything new. Choosing what feels right is sensible.

examples.en: Turn off the bathroom sink faucet tightly after washing your hands.
examples.zh: 洗完手後請務必將洗手台水龍頭緊緊關閉。

examples.en: The plumber replaced the old corroded brass faucet with a modern stainless steel model.
examples.zh: 水電工將生鏽腐蝕的舊銅水龍頭更換為現代不鏽鋼款式。

examples.en: Water dripped slowly from the leaky faucet all night long.
examples.zh: 整個晚上水滴不停地從漏水的水龍頭中滴滴答答漏出。

examples.en: Aerated low-flow sensor faucets mix air bubbles with water, saving half of standard hand-washing volume.
examples.zh: 裝設充氣型微氣泡省水感應水龍頭（Faucet），在洗手時混合細緻氣泡，省水高達百分之五十且出水柔和。

examples.en: The constant drip from the bathroom sink faucet kept him awake until he shut off the supply valve.
examples.zh: 浴室洗臉盆水龍頭整夜滴滴答答漏水不停的清脆滴水聲吵得他無法入睡，直到他起身關緊牆角進水角閥。

examples.en: Public restrooms in the MRT stations are equipped with touchless sensor faucets to promote hygiene and save water.
examples.zh: 全台各大捷運站內的公共化妝室全面升級為全自動紅外線感應水龍頭，兼顧免接觸衛生防護與智慧節水效能。

entries.definition: 水龍頭；省水標章感應式水龍頭

explains.en: This fitting controls water flowing from a pipe. Turning its handle lets water run into a sink. Closing it stops the flow.
A kitchen and a bathroom often have one. Some designs have separate handles for hot and cold water. A dripping one can waste water.
A shower sprays water from many holes, while this fixture sends it from a spout. People use it to wash hands or fill a glass. Keep the surrounding area dry.

examples.en: The fearful puppy hid behind its owner during the storm.
examples.zh: 小狗在暴風雨中害怕地躲到主人身後。

examples.en: A fearful look crossed Ben’s face when the lights went out.
examples.zh: 燈熄滅時，本的臉上掠過害怕的神情。

examples.en: She felt fearful before her first swimming lesson.
examples.zh: 第一次上游泳課前，她感到害怕。

explains.en: A person who expects danger or feels afraid can be described this way. A loud bang in the night might frighten a child. A calm adult can help the child feel safe.
This adjective can describe a look or voice that shows worry. Wide eyes and a shaky voice may reveal fear. Kind words can comfort someone.
Brave does not mean a person never feels fear. It means the person tries to do what is right despite feeling afraid. Taking a trusted person along may help.

examples.en: A blue feather lay beside the birdbath.
examples.zh: 鳥浴盆旁邊有一根藍色羽毛。

examples.en: The duck shook a feather after swimming.
examples.zh: 鴨子游完泳後抖了抖羽毛。

examples.en: We found a soft feather on the path.
examples.zh: 我們在小路上找到一根柔軟的羽毛。

explains.en: A bird's body is covered with these light parts. They help keep the bird warm and help many birds fly. Different kinds of birds have different shapes and colors.
A small one can drift slowly through the air. People sometimes use soft ones to fill pillows. They should come from safe, responsible sources.
Fur grows on many mammals, while these coverings belong to birds. A peacock has bright, eye-shaped ones in its tail. A duck's covering helps keep water away from its skin.

examples.en: A white wooden fence surrounds the cozy garden.
examples.zh: 一道白色木柵欄圍繞著溫馨的花園。

examples.en: The farmer repaired the broken wire fence to keep sheep inside.
examples.zh: 農夫修補了損壞的鐵絲網柵欄，以防羊群跑出。

examples.en: Blooming yellow climbing roses grew gracefully along the backyard fence.
examples.zh: 盛開的黃色攀緣玫瑰優雅地沿著後院籬笆生長蔓延。

explains.en: A barrier made of posts or panels can mark the edge of a yard. It may also keep animals inside or out. Gates allow people to pass through.
A school garden may use one to protect young plants. Wooden boards, wire, or metal can form the barrier. Its height depends on what it needs to do.
A wall is usually solid, while this boundary may have spaces between its parts. Neighbors can still see through some designs. Check for loose boards to keep it safe.

examples.en: The young fighter trained carefully with her coach.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的格鬥選手在教練指導下認真訓練。

examples.en: Everyone called Grandpa a fighter because he never gave up.
examples.zh: 大家都說爺爺很堅強，因為他從不放棄。

examples.en: The fighter thanked her opponent after the match.
examples.zh: 比賽結束後，這位選手向對手道謝。

entries.definition: 戰士；格鬥選手；戰鬥機；奮鬥者。

explains.en: A person who takes part in a contest using punches or kicks may be called this. Such sports need training and protective rules. Coaches teach athletes to act safely.
The word can also describe someone who keeps trying during a hard time. A person may work through a difficult challenge with courage. Friends can support that effort.
In a story, a person defending others may be described this way. In sports, it can name an athlete in a match. The sentence helps show which sense is meant.

examples.en: The dazzling Taipei 101 fireworks display lit up the midnight sky.
examples.zh: 耀眼奪目的台北 101 跨年煙火秀點亮了午夜夜空。

examples.en: Crowds gathered along Tamsui River bank to watch the romantic summer fireworks.
examples.zh: 大批群眾聚集在淡水河岸邊，欣賞浪漫唯美的夏日大稻埕煙火秀。

examples.en: Brilliant colorful fireworks reflected across the calm water during National Day.
examples.zh: 國慶日璀璨絢爛的五彩煙火倒映在平靜澄澈的波光水面上。

explains.en: A small device can burst into bright colors in the sky during a celebration. Adults should light it only where the law allows. Everyone must stand far away.
Some create a loud bang, while others make sparkling shapes. Communities often watch a show together on holidays. Ear protection can help sensitive listeners.
A toy sparkler may seem harmless, but hot sparks can burn skin or start a fire. Follow local safety rules and adult directions. Never pick up a device that did not go off.

examples.en: He held the tiny stone in his fist.
examples.zh: 他把小石頭握在拳頭裡。

examples.en: She raised a fist to cheer for her team.
examples.zh: 她握拳替隊伍加油。

examples.en: The boy opened his fist and showed us a marble.
examples.zh: 男孩張開拳頭，給我們看一顆彈珠。

explains.en: When a hand is closed tightly, it forms this shape. A person may make one while holding a small object. Relaxing the fingers opens the hand again.
People sometimes raise a closed hand to show strength or determination. In a fight, it can hurt someone, so using words is safer. Sports have rules about physical contact.
An open palm is different because the fingers are spread or relaxed. A closed hand can hold a ball more firmly. Artists often draw this shape to show anger.

examples.en: A blue flame burned steadily beneath the pot.
examples.zh: 鍋子下方有一簇藍色火焰穩定地燃燒。

examples.en: The candle flame danced when a breeze crossed the room.
examples.zh: 微風吹過房間時，燭焰搖曳起來。

examples.en: The camper kept water near the small flame.
examples.zh: 露營者在小火堆旁放了水。

explains.en: The bright, hot part of a fire that you can see is called this. A candle has a small one above its wick. Never touch it because it can burn skin.
A campfire may have many moving shapes of light. Wind can make them flicker and change direction. Adults should keep water nearby when tending a fire.
Smoke may appear above it, but the two are different things. Smoke is made of tiny particles in the air. The visible hot light comes from burning material.

examples.en: An invisible black infrared flash captures crisp nighttime photographs without startling timid wildlife.
examples.zh: 採用 940 奈米完全不發紅光的「無光紅外線補光」（Flash），能在完全不驚擾膽小野生動物下清晰拍照。

examples.en: Traditional white camera flashes often scare skittish mammals away from monitored watering holes.
examples.zh: 傳統相機的刺眼白光閃光燈往往會嚇跑警覺性高的哺乳動物，使其不敢靠近水源。

examples.en: The sensor triggered a quick infrared flash that illuminated the flying squirrel gliding through the mist.
examples.zh: 感應器瞬間觸發一道隱形紅外閃光，清晰定格了在濃霧中滑翔的白面鼯鼠身影。

examples.en: Single-flash plants drop fluid pressure rapidly inside separators to flash hot brine into pressurized steam.
examples.zh: 閃蒸發電廠在分離槽內讓熱水迅速降壓，「瞬間閃蒸」（Flash）產生強大純淨蒸汽推動發電機發電。

examples.en: A sudden flash of lightning illuminated the dark thunderstorm clouds hovering above the harbor.
examples.zh: 夜空中一道刺目的雪白雷電閃光劃破天際，瞬間照亮了籠罩在港灣上空黑雲壓頂的狂暴雷雨雲團。

examples.en: The news station interrupted regular programming with a breaking flash update regarding the election results.
examples.zh: 電視台新聞部在黃金時段突然插播突發快訊閃電快訊，搶先報導剛剛出爐的直轄市長選舉開票結果。

entries.definition: 940nm 不發紅光全隱形紅外線夜視補光；閃光；降壓瞬間閃蒸產生純乾蒸汽推動渦輪機

explains.en: A sudden bright light that lasts only a moment is called this. A camera may make one when taking a picture. The light helps brighten a dark room.
A quick look can also be described with this word as a verb. Someone may glance at a clock and look away. The action takes very little time.
A sudden burst of lightning can light up the sky before thunder is heard. It appears suddenly and then is gone. People should stay indoors during a storm.

examples.en: We used a flashlight to find the cat under the porch.
examples.zh: 我們用手電筒找到躲在門廊下的貓。

examples.en: Keep a flashlight near your bed in case the power goes out.
examples.zh: 在床邊放一支手電筒，以備停電時使用。

examples.en: His flashlight needed fresh batteries.
examples.zh: 他的手電筒需要換新電池。

explains.en: This portable tool makes a beam of light when switched on. It usually runs on batteries. People carry one during a power outage or a night walk.
The narrow beam helps someone see in a dark place. Point it toward the floor so it does not shine in another person's eyes. Keep spare batteries ready.
A lamp stays in one place, while this tool can travel with its user. Some models can be recharged by plugging them in. It is helpful to know where one is stored.

examples.en: What ice cream flavor would you like to try?
examples.zh: 你想嘗試哪一種冰淇淋口味？

examples.en: Adding fresh basil gives the pasta sauce a rich herbal flavor.
examples.zh: 加入新鮮羅勒能賦予義大利麵醬濃郁的草本風味。

examples.en: The chef experimented with different spice blends to enhance flavor profiles.
examples.zh: 主廚嘗試了不同的香料組合以提升整體的風味層次。

explains.en: The taste that food or drink has is called this. Sweet, sour, salty, bitter, and savory are common kinds. Herbs and spices can change it.
A person can say that a story has a certain character or feeling. A funny tale may have a playful quality. This use is more figurative than talking about food.
Smell helps people notice taste. Two dishes with the same ingredients may still seem different when cooked another way. Trying a small bite can reveal what you like.

examples.en: The peach had sweet flesh beneath its fuzzy skin.
examples.zh: 桃子毛茸茸的表皮下有香甜的果肉。

examples.en: A small cut on his flesh needed cleaning.
examples.zh: 他身上的小傷口需要清潔。

examples.en: We scooped the orange flesh from the melon.
examples.zh: 我們把橘色的瓜肉挖出來。

entries.definition: （名）果肉；肉體；肌膚；（動）使充實；詳述。

explains.en: The soft parts of a person's or animal's body under the skin are known by this noun. A cut apple also has an inner part that people can eat. The exact sense depends on what is being discussed.
Butchers and cooks use the word for the edible part of some fruits or fish. It is softer than the hard peel or shell around it. A melon has juicy pink material inside.
Skin covers the outside, while the softer tissue lies beneath it. Doctors may use the word when discussing a wound. Children should tell an adult if they are hurt.

examples.en: The toy boat floated across the pond.
examples.zh: 玩具船漂過池塘。

examples.en: A leaf can float on the water after it falls from a tree.
examples.zh: 樹葉落下後可以浮在水面上。

examples.en: The balloon floated toward the ceiling.
examples.zh: 氣球飄向天花板。

entries.definition: （動）漂浮；浮動；飄動；（名）花車；漂浮物

explains.en: To stay on top of water without sinking is to do this. A cork can remain at the surface because it is light. A heavy stone usually drops to the bottom.
A balloon filled with a light gas can rise and remain in the air. A small boat can also stay on water. The materials and the surrounding liquid or air matter.
Swimming means moving through water, but a person can stay still and rest at the surface. Learning with an adult is safest. A life jacket helps keep a person above water.

examples.en: A flock of white birds crossed the evening sky.
examples.zh: 一群白鳥飛過傍晚的天空。

examples.en: Tourists flocked to the beach on the sunny day.
examples.zh: 晴朗的日子裡，遊客紛紛湧向海灘。

examples.en: A flock of sheep rested beside the road.
examples.zh: 一群羊在路旁休息。

entries.definition: （名）一群鳥／羊；（動）群集；蜂擁而至

explains.en: A group of birds moving or feeding together can be called this. Geese may travel in a large group across a field. They often stay near one another.
People may gather in a group too, especially when they move to the same place. Visitors might crowd toward a stage at a festival. The word can suggest many people arriving together.
A single bird is alone, while many gathered birds make a group. Sheep are more often called a herd. The best group word depends on the animals.

examples.en: The heavy rain caused a flood in the low fields.
examples.zh: 豪雨造成低窪田地淹水。

examples.en: Water began to flood the basement after the pipe broke.
examples.zh: 水管破裂後，地下室開始進水。

examples.en: The town closed the bridge during the flood.
examples.zh: 洪水期間，鎮上封閉了橋梁。

entries.definition: （名）洪水；水災；大量；（動）淹沒；蜂擁而至

explains.en: When too much water covers land that is usually dry, this event happens. Heavy rain or a river rising can cause it. People should move to a safe place when officials tell them to leave.
As a verb, it can mean that water spreads into a room or field. A broken pipe may fill a basement. Turning off the water and calling an adult can limit damage.
A puddle is small and shallow, while this event can cover streets and homes. Never walk or drive through moving water. It may be much deeper or stronger than it looks.

examples.en: High-protein bread flour gives sourdough loaves great elasticity and structure.
examples.zh: 蛋白質含量豐富的高筋麵粉能賦予手作歐式麵包極佳的麵筋彈性與立體膨脹支撐結構。

examples.en: Sift the cake flour twice through a fine mesh strainer to ensure a tender, lump-free batter.
examples.zh: 將低筋麵粉用細濾網過篩兩次，能確保蛋糕麵糊質地細緻綿密且絕無乾粉顆粒結塊。

examples.en: Store unbleached whole wheat flour in an airtight container placed in a cool, dark pantry.
examples.zh: 將未經漂白的天然全麥麵粉密封在保鮮罐中，並收納於陰涼避光的乾燥儲藏室內。

examples.en: Stone-ground French T65 wheat flour preserves the nutrient-rich wheat germ, producing traditional chewy bread.
examples.zh: 採用法國傳統石磨研磨的 T65 小麥麵粉，完整保留小麥胚芽營養，烘烤出道地麥香四溢的歐包。

examples.en: The miller sifts the flour through silk screens to achieve exact mineral ash levels required by French standards.
examples.zh: 麵粉製粉師透過精密絲網篩選麥粉，精確控制法國法規所嚴格規範的小麥灰分礦物質含量標準。

examples.en: Protein quality in unbleached organic flour dictates how well your dough rises during baking.
examples.zh: 無漂白有機麵粉中優質蛋白質的品質與活性，直接決定了麵團在入爐高溫烘烤時的膨脹與支撐高度。

entries.definition: 麵粉；小麥粉；法國原裝進口 T65 傳統石磨小麥麵粉

explains.en: A fine powder made by grinding grains is used in many baked foods. Wheat is a common source. Bread, noodles, and cakes may contain it.
Bakers measure this ingredient before mixing it with water and other items. It should be kept dry in a closed container. Wet powder can become lumpy.
Corn and rice can also be ground into cooking powder. Different kinds behave differently in recipes. Reading the directions helps a cook choose the right one.

examples.en: She plays the flute in the school concert band.
examples.zh: 她在學校管樂團裡吹長笛。

examples.en: The clear, sweet notes of the silver flute charmed the audience.
examples.zh: 銀製長笛清脆甜美的音符吸引了在場的觀眾。

examples.en: Learn how to breathe steadily when practicing the flute.
examples.zh: 練習長笛時要學會如何穩定地調節呼吸。

explains.en: This musical instrument is held sideways and played by blowing across an opening. The player presses keys to change the notes. It often makes a clear, high sound.
A student can learn simple songs on this instrument with regular practice. Breath control is important. Cleaning it after playing helps keep it in good condition.
A recorder is held more upright and has a different mouthpiece. Both are wind instruments because the player uses air to make sound. Their tones are not exactly alike.

examples.en: The mountain road was foggy, so Dad drove slowly.
examples.zh: 山路起霧了，所以爸爸開得很慢。

examples.en: A foggy morning hid the boats in the harbor.
examples.zh: 起霧的早晨讓港口裡的船隻變得模糊不清。

examples.en: My glasses became foggy when I entered the warm room.
examples.zh: 我走進溫暖的房間時，眼鏡起霧了。

entries.definition: 有霧的；霧茫茫的；模糊不清的。

explains.en: Tiny drops of water in the air make it hard to see far away. A road may look unclear early in the morning. Drivers should slow down and use care.
A person's memory or thinking can feel unclear too. Someone may be unsure about the details of an old event. Looking at notes may help bring them back.
Clear air lets people see distant hills, while misty air blocks the view. Fog often forms when air cools near the ground. Weather can change as the sun warms the air.

examples.en: Fold the paper in half to make a card.
examples.zh: 把紙對摺，做成一張卡片。

examples.en: She folded the clean towels and put them away.
examples.zh: 她把乾淨的毛巾摺好收起來。

examples.en: A deep fold ran down the middle of the map.
examples.zh: 地圖中央有一道深深的摺痕。

explains.en: To bend paper or cloth over itself is to do this. A sharp crease stays where the material was bent. A neatly bent map is easier to carry.
As a noun, it can name the line made by bending something. A shirt may have a crease after being put away. Ironing can smooth it out.
Rolling turns a flat item into a tube, while bending it back on itself makes a layered shape. People arrange napkins for meals. Careful corners make neat shapes.

examples.en: The fashion creator gained 50,000 new followers this month.
examples.zh: 這位時尚創作者本月增加了五萬名新追蹤者。

examples.en: Confucius had thousands of devoted followers who recorded his philosophical teachings.
examples.zh: 孔子擁有數千名忠誠門生追隨者，記錄下了他的哲學思想。

examples.en: She is a loyal follower of indie rock music and attends every live gig.
examples.zh: 她是獨立搖滾音樂的忠實追隨支持者，場場現場演出都不缺席。

examples.en: She gained thousands of new Instagram followers after the viral reel.
examples.zh: 在那支短影音爆紅後，她的 IG 暴增了數千名新粉絲。

examples.en: The chef shares quick weekly dinner recipes with his loyal followers.
examples.zh: 這位大廚每週與他忠實的粉絲追隨者分享快手晚餐食譜。

examples.en: Having millions of followers does not always translate into high sales.
examples.zh: 擁有數百萬名追隨者並不總是能直接轉化為高額銷售額。

examples.en: The food vlogger gained over one hundred thousand followers within a single year.
examples.zh: 這位專門挖掘隱藏版夜市小吃的美食創作者在短短一年內便斬獲逾十萬名死忠追隨者。

examples.en: Celebrities often communicate with their followers through casual social media stories.
examples.zh: 知名名人經常透過隨性的社群限時動態直接與廣大粉絲互動交流。

examples.en: He is a loyal follower of modern minimalist design and eco-friendly lifestyles.
examples.zh: 他是現代極簡主義設計與綠色環保生活方式的堅定追隨者。

entries.definition: 追蹤者；粉絲；信徒；追隨者；粉絲追蹤者

explains.en: A person who chooses to support a leader or idea can be described by this noun. People may share the same beliefs. They can still ask questions and think for themselves.
On a social website, this person chooses to receive updates from another account. The account's new posts may then appear on a screen. Someone can stop receiving them at any time.
A leader guides a group, while the people who support that leader form the group around them. In a parade, people may walk behind a band. The word can describe that position too.

examples.en: I am fond of the old tree in our schoolyard.
examples.zh: 我很喜歡校園裡那棵老樹。

examples.en: She is fond of her little cousin and reads to him each night.
examples.zh: 她疼愛年幼的表弟，每晚都唸書給他聽。

examples.en: Grandpa spoke with fond memories about his first bicycle.
examples.zh: 爺爺懷著愉快的回憶談起他的第一輛腳踏車。

explains.en: This adjective describes warm liking or affection. A child may feel this way about a kind neighbor. The feeling grows through caring moments.
People can remember a time with pleasure. They may speak warmly about a favorite trip or story. Such memories can make them smile.
Liking something means enjoying it, while affection often adds closeness and care. A person may feel this way toward a pet. Showing kindness helps that bond grow.

examples.en: The children wished summer vacation could last forever.
examples.zh: 孩子們希望暑假可以永遠持續下去。

examples.en: It felt like forever before the cookies were ready.
examples.zh: 餅乾烤好的等待時間感覺好漫長。

examples.en: Their friendship lasted forever in the story.
examples.zh: 故事中，他們的友誼天長地久。

explains.en: Something that lasts without an end can be described this way. People often use the word in poems or promises. In everyday speech, it can also mean a very long time.
Waiting may feel endless when someone is excited or bored. A few minutes can seem to last much longer. Checking a clock shows the actual time.
A short time has a clear ending soon, while this word suggests no ending. Some things, like a rainbow, last only briefly. Their beauty can still stay in a memory.

examples.en: Red symbolizes good fortune and prosperity in Chinese culture.
examples.zh: 在中華文化中，紅色象徵著吉祥好運與繁榮富貴。

examples.en: He amassed an enormous fortune through decades of prudent tech investing.
examples.zh: 憑藉數十年審慎精準的高科技投資，他積累了可觀龐大的財富。

examples.en: It was sheer good fortune that no one was injured during the unexpected road landslide.
examples.zh: 在那場突如其來的山區道路落石坍方中無人受傷，純粹是萬幸的好運氣。

explains.en: Good luck or success can be described with this noun. Finding a lost toy just before bedtime may feel like a lucky event. People sometimes say good luck came their way.
It can also mean a large amount of money or valuable things. A family may inherit wealth. The meaning becomes clear from the sentence.
Luck is an unexpected good or bad event, while wealth refers to money and possessions. This word can refer to either idea. Context tells readers which one fits.

examples.en: We ate lunch beside the fountain in the town square.
examples.zh: 我們在鎮上廣場的噴水池旁吃午餐。

examples.en: The drinking fountain was beside the school gym.
examples.zh: 飲水台就在學校體育館旁邊。

examples.en: Lights made the fountain glow after sunset.
examples.zh: 日落後，燈光讓噴泉發亮。

explains.en: Water can shoot upward from a decorated pool or nozzle in a public place. Parks often have one where people sit nearby. Some are lit at night.
A drinking version provides water for people to sip. It is often found in schools or parks. Use a clean cup or follow the posted directions.
A natural spring sends water from the ground, while a public structure may pump water in a repeating pattern. Birds may bathe in the shallow pool. Keep litter away from the water.

examples.en: Maya gave a frank answer about why she missed practice.
examples.zh: 瑪雅坦率地說明她缺席練習的原因。

examples.en: Please be frank if you do not understand the directions.
examples.zh: 如果你不明白指示，請坦白告訴我。

examples.en: Frank thanked his friend for the honest advice.
examples.zh: 法蘭克感謝朋友給他坦誠的建議。

explains.en: A person who speaks in an honest and direct way can be described this way. They say what they think without hiding the truth. Kindness still matters when speaking plainly.
This word can also be a person's name. Names do not always describe someone's behavior. The sentence helps readers understand how it is being used.
A polite answer can still be truthful. Speaking honestly does not mean being rude. Choosing gentle words helps others listen.

examples.en: The computer screen froze while playing the high-definition 3D game.
examples.zh: 在遊玩高畫質 3D 遊戲時，電腦螢幕畫面突然卡住不動。

examples.en: Water pipes can freeze and burst when winter temperatures drop below zero.
examples.zh: 冬季氣溫驟降至零度以下時，水管可能會結冰破裂。

examples.en: The government announced plans to freeze public transport fares this year.
examples.zh: 政府宣布了今年凍結大眾運輸票價的計劃。

examples.en: Banks freeze suspicious scam accounts within minutes of receiving emergency 165 anti-fraud police alerts.
examples.zh: 銀行防詐中心在接獲內政部 165 反詐騙專線通報後的黃金數分鐘內，火速圈存並凍結詐騙人頭帳戶款項。

examples.en: Sub-zero temperatures caused outdoor water pipes to freeze and burst across the mountain village.
examples.zh: 寒流來襲導致高山偏遠聚落室外裸露的水管全面結冰凍裂，造成全村居民在清晨一度面臨無水可用的窘境。

examples.en: Cardholders can temporarily freeze their lost credit cards via the smartphone app to prevent unauthorized swipes.
examples.zh: 遺失皮夾的持卡人可第一時間在手機銀行 App 內開啟「一鍵暫時鎖卡凍結」功能，徹底防堵任何盜刷可能。

entries.definition: 畫面凍結；卡住；結冰；圈存凍結受害款項

explains.en: Water turns into solid ice when it becomes cold enough. This change can make roads slippery in winter. People should walk carefully in icy weather.
Food can be kept very cold so it stays usable longer. Placing berries in a freezer helps preserve them. They can be thawed before eating.
As a verb, it can also mean to stop moving suddenly. Someone may stand still when surprised. The surrounding words show which meaning is intended.

examples.en: We put the extra soup in the freezer for next week.
examples.zh: 我們把多出來的湯放進冷凍庫，留到下週喝。

examples.en: The freezer door was not shut all the way.
examples.zh: 冷凍庫的門沒有完全關好。

examples.en: Dad keeps ice packs in the freezer.
examples.zh: 爸爸把保冷劑放在冷凍庫裡。

explains.en: This appliance keeps food at a temperature cold enough to freeze it. It may be part of a refrigerator or a separate box. Ice cream is commonly stored inside.
A home can use one to keep food for later meals. Labeling containers helps people know what is inside. Do not leave its door open for long.
A refrigerator keeps food cool, but this compartment makes it much colder. Frozen vegetables can stay good for a long time. Follow the package directions when cooking them.

examples.en: Frequent practice helped Leo learn the piano song.
examples.zh: 經常練習幫助里歐學會了那首鋼琴曲。

examples.en: The frequent bus service made the trip easy.
examples.zh: 班次頻繁的公車服務讓旅程很方便。

examples.en: We get frequent snow in the mountains during winter.
examples.zh: 冬天山區常常下雪。

entries.definition: （形）頻繁的；常見的；（動）常去；常做

explains.en: An event that happens often is described this way. A regular visitor comes to the library many times. The opposite is rare.
People may describe repeated actions with this adjective. If it rains often in spring, rainy days are common then. Keeping a record can show the pattern.
Regular means happening on a steady schedule, while this word only tells us that something happens many times. A friend may call often without coming on fixed days. The exact idea depends on context.

examples.en: The sudden shout gave me a fright.
examples.zh: 突然的喊叫嚇了我一跳。

examples.en: She got a fright when the cat jumped onto her desk.
examples.zh: 貓跳上她的書桌時，她嚇了一跳。

examples.en: After the fright, he checked that the kitten was safe.
examples.zh: 受到驚嚇後，他確認小貓平安無事。

explains.en: A sudden strong feeling of fear can be called this. A loud crash in a dark room may cause it. Turning on a light can help someone feel calm again.
A person may feel alarm when they think something dangerous is near. Taking a slow breath and asking for help can be useful. The feeling often passes when the person is safe.
Worry may build slowly, while this feeling can come all at once. A surprising noise can make someone jump. Knowing what made the sound may ease the concern.

examples.en: The thunder did not frighten the brave dog.
examples.zh: 雷聲沒有嚇到那隻勇敢的狗。

examples.en: Please do not frighten the birds by shouting.
examples.zh: 請不要大聲叫喊，以免嚇到鳥兒。

examples.en: The mask frightened my little brother at first.
examples.zh: 那個面具一開始嚇到了我弟弟。

explains.en: To make someone feel afraid is to do this. A sudden loud noise may upset a small child. Speaking gently can comfort the child.
A person can also scare an animal by moving too quickly. Approaching slowly helps the animal feel safe. Give wild animals plenty of space.
Surprise can be pleasant or unpleasant, but this verb usually describes causing fear. A dark costume may scare someone at a party. Asking first can prevent a mean joke.

examples.en: Hybrid cars consume significantly less fuel in city traffic.
examples.zh: 油電車在市區行駛時消耗顯著較少的燃料。

examples.en: Rising fuel prices have increased international shipping costs.
examples.zh: 燃油價格上漲增加了國際航運成本。

examples.en: His harsh criticism only fueled their determination to win.
