examples.en: She wore a warm robe after her bath.
examples.zh: 她洗完澡後穿上了一件暖和的浴袍。

examples.en: The judge put on a black robe before entering the courtroom.
examples.zh: 法官進入法庭前穿上黑袍。

examples.en: His robe had a soft hood.
examples.zh: 他的長袍有一頂柔軟的兜帽。

explains.en: A long, loose piece of clothing worn at home or for a ceremony is called this. A person may put one on after a bath. It can be soft and warm.
Some judges or religious leaders wear a special version for their work. The color and style may show a role. Customs differ.
A coat usually closes in front and is worn outside, while this garment may be tied with a belt. It can be casual or formal. The setting gives a clue.

examples.en: The heavy-lift rocket blasted off from the coastal launchpad gracefully.
examples.zh: 重型運載火箭在雷鳴般的轟鳴聲中優雅自沿海發射台騰空升空。

examples.en: Engineers engineered reusable rocket boosters that return and land vertically on ocean barges.
examples.zh: 頂尖航太工程師成功研發出可重複使用的火箭推進器，能在發射後垂直降落返回海上無人駁船平台。

examples.en: The promising young tech company's stock price began to rocket following the product announcement.
examples.zh: 這家極富市場潛力的新銳高科技公司，在其震撼新品正式亮相發布後，公司股價隨即如火箭般直線飆升。

explains.en: A vehicle that burns fuel to fly into space is called this. It carries astronauts or equipment. The launch creates a bright flame.
A small firework with the same name shoots into the sky. Adults should handle fireworks and follow local rules. Watch from far away.
An airplane uses wings to stay in the air, while this vehicle pushes itself upward with powerful engines. It can leave Earth's atmosphere. Scientists use it to explore space.

examples.en: They planned a romantic dinner by the sea.
examples.zh: 他們計畫在海邊享用浪漫晚餐。

examples.en: The novel tells a romantic story about two musicians.
examples.zh: 這本小說講述兩位音樂家的愛情故事。

examples.en: He gave her a romantic card for their anniversary.
examples.zh: 他在紀念日送她一張浪漫的卡片。

entries.definition: 浪漫的；愛情的；富有情調的；不切實際的

explains.en: Love and affection between people are related to this adjective. A story may describe two people who care deeply for each other. It can have a happy ending.
The word can describe a special evening with candles and music. People may celebrate an anniversary. Different people enjoy different gestures.
Friendship is caring without romance, while this word can describe love between partners. The meaning may also relate to artistic ideas. Context is important.

examples.en: Lethal root rot is almost always caused by poor soil drainage and chronic overwatering.
examples.zh: 奪走無數盆栽生命的致命爛根病，絕大多數皆是因為土壤排水不良與過度頻繁澆水積水所致。

examples.en: If you notice squishy black roots smelling foul, cut them away immediately to halt rot.
examples.zh: 若在檢查根系時發現變黑軟爛且散發難聞異味的水爛根，應立即果斷剪除以遏止腐爛擴散。

examples.en: Untreated fungal rot will quickly travel upward through the main stem and kill the entire plant.
examples.zh: 倘若未及時處理真菌性根腐病，病菌會迅速順著維管束向上蔓延至主幹，導致全株枯死。

explains.en: To decay or spoil over time is to do this. Fruit left in a warm place may become soft and bad. Keeping it cool can slow the change.
Wood can decay when it stays wet for too long. Paint may protect some surfaces. Check items regularly for damage.
Fresh food is safe to eat, while spoiled food should be thrown away. This verb describes the change that makes it go bad. Do not taste food that seems spoiled.

examples.en: The rotten apple had a brown spot inside.
examples.zh: 腐爛的蘋果內部有一塊褐色斑點。

examples.en: A rotten board broke under the old fence.
examples.zh: 腐朽的木板在舊圍欄下斷裂。

examples.en: It was rotten of him to hide her backpack.
examples.zh: 他把她的背包藏起來，這樣做很惡劣。

entries.definition: 腐爛的；腐敗的；惡劣的；糟糕的。

explains.en: Food that has decayed and is no longer safe to eat can be described this way. It may smell bad or look moldy. Throw it away safely.
The adjective can also describe behavior that is very mean or unfair. A mean trick may upset someone. People should treat one another kindly.
Fresh food is in good condition, while this word describes food that has gone bad. Check dates and appearance. Ask an adult if unsure.

examples.en: The rough rock scratched the table.
examples.zh: 粗糙的石頭刮傷了桌子。

examples.en: We had a rough ride over the bumpy road.
examples.zh: 我們在顛簸的道路上經歷了一段難受的車程。

examples.en: The cat has a rough tongue.
examples.zh: 貓的舌頭摸起來很粗糙。

entries.definition: 粗糙的；顛簸的；艱難的；大約的；不平順的

explains.en: A surface that is not smooth can be described this way. A stone may feel bumpy under the hand. Sandpaper can make wood smoother.
The word can also describe a difficult time. A family may have a difficult week when many things go wrong. Talking together can help.
Smooth surfaces have few bumps, while this adjective describes uneven ones. A road may feel bumpy. The word can also mean not gentle.

examples.en: There were roughly thirty people at the picnic.
examples.zh: 野餐大約有三十個人。

examples.en: The bus arrives roughly every half hour.
examples.zh: 公車大約每半小時一班。

examples.en: He handled the old book roughly and damaged its cover.
examples.zh: 他粗魯地翻動舊書，弄壞了封面。

explains.en: About or approximately is one meaning of this adverb. A walk may take about twenty minutes. The exact time can change.
It can also describe doing something in a not gentle way. A person should not handle a small animal carelessly. Kind care is safer.
Exactly gives a precise amount, while this word allows for a small difference. The context may describe an estimate or an action. Look at the verb nearby.

examples.en: Consistency is key; stick strictly to your 4-day weekly workout routine.
examples.zh: 成功貴在堅持；請嚴格落實您每週安排的四天規律分部位重量健身課表。

examples.en: Establishing a soothing bedtime routine improves sleep quality and morning alertness.
examples.zh: 建立舒緩固定的睡前放鬆儀式能顯著提升睡眠品質，並讓隔日清晨神清氣爽。

examples.en: The figure skater practiced her choreographed technical jump routine dozens of times.
examples.zh: 花式滑冰選手在冰面上反覆苦練她那套融合高難度旋轉與編舞的競技比賽套路。

entries.definition: 規律課表；例行公事；套路

explains.en: A regular way of doing things each day is called this. Regular morning habits may include washing and eating breakfast. It helps people get ready.
A familiar set of movements can also be part of a performance. A dancer practices the same steps. Repeating them builds skill.
A schedule lists times, while this noun can describe repeated actions. This pattern may be changed when needed. People often feel comfortable with familiar habits.

examples.en: The small rug beside the bed felt warm.
examples.zh: 床邊的小地毯摸起來很暖。

examples.en: She rolled up the rug before painting the floor.
examples.zh: 粉刷地板前，她把地毯捲了起來。

examples.en: A colorful rug covered the center of the room.
examples.zh: 一張色彩繽紛的地毯鋪在房間中央。

explains.en: A thick piece of material placed on the floor is called this. It can make a room warmer and softer. Use a non-slip pad to keep it from moving.
It may cover part of the floor rather than the whole room. Patterns and colors can decorate a space. Clean it regularly.
A carpet often covers most of a room, while this item may be smaller and movable. Both can feel soft underfoot. Keep edges flat to avoid trips.

examples.en: The rumor about a snow day turned out to be false.
examples.zh: 停課下雪的傳聞後來證明是假的。

examples.en: Please do not spread a rumor about your classmate.
examples.zh: 請不要散播關於同學的謠言。

examples.en: A rumor said the library would close early.
examples.zh: 有傳聞說圖書館會提早關門。

explains.en: A story or piece of news that people pass around without checking is called this. It may be untrue. Verify facts before sharing it.
The word can also mean talk about something that may happen. A school might be getting a new playground. Waiting for official news is wise.
A confirmed report has been checked, while this may be only a guess. Sharing it can hurt someone. Be careful with other people's private lives.

examples.en: Do not rush across the street without looking.
examples.zh: 不要沒看路就匆忙穿越街道。

examples.en: She rushed to finish her homework before dinner.
examples.zh: 她趕在晚餐前匆忙完成作業。

examples.en: A rush of water filled the empty channel.
examples.zh: 一股水流湧進空水道。

entries.definition: （動）趕忙；衝；蜂擁；（名）匆忙；一陣；熱潮

explains.en: To move or act very quickly is to do this. A person may hurry to catch a bus. Watch where you are going.
A sudden strong flow of water or people can be called this. A crowd may move toward a stage. Stay calm and give others space.
Walking slowly is the opposite of moving quickly. People sometimes hurry because they are late. Planning ahead can reduce the need.

examples.en: Streaking orange oil pigments downwards simulates realistic rain-washed rust running down steel armor.
examples.zh: 將橙褐色油畫顏料垂直向下輕輕暈染，能生動呈現鋼鐵裝甲遭雨水沖刷流淌而下的流鏽效果。

examples.en: Leaving garden tools outdoors in the rain causes exposed iron blades to develop orange coat of rust.
examples.zh: 將五金園藝修枝剪隨意遺落在戶外淋雨，會使外露的金屬鐵刃迅速生成一層毛茸茸的橙紅色鐵鏽鏽斑。

examples.en: After years of retirement, his conversational English had gathered a bit of rust from lack of daily practice.
examples.zh: 光榮退休定居鄉間多年之後，由於平時缺乏日常開口對話機會，他原本流暢的外語口條難免顯得有些生疏生鏽。

entries.definition: 斑駁鐵鏽流鏽效果；生鏽

explains.en: A reddish-brown coating forms on iron or steel when water and air affect it. It can weaken metal. Keeping tools dry helps prevent it.
The word can also mean to become less skilled after not practicing. A musician may need time to get comfortable again. Practice rebuilds ability.
Shiny clean metal has no such coating, while old wet metal may develop it. The verb describes the change. Oil can protect some tools.

examples.en: The farmer filled a sack with potatoes.
examples.zh: 農夫把一袋馬鈴薯裝滿。

examples.en: He carried a sack of rice to the kitchen.
examples.zh: 他把一袋米扛到廚房。

examples.en: The workers sacked the grain for storage.
examples.zh: 工人把穀物裝袋保存。

explains.en: A large bag made of cloth or thick material is called this. Farmers may fill one with grain. It can be carried over the shoulder.
The word can also mean putting something into a bag. A worker may place groceries in a paper bag. This use is informal.
A small purse holds a few personal items, while this container can carry a lot. It may be made from burlap or plastic. Check that it is strong before lifting.

examples.en: She saved the drawing for the sake of her little brother.
examples.zh: 她為了弟弟保留了那張畫。

examples.en: The restaurant served sake to the adult guests.
examples.zh: 餐廳為成年客人供應清酒。

examples.en: For the sake of safety, everyone wore a helmet.
examples.zh: 為了安全起見，每個人都戴上了安全帽。

entries.definition: 目的；緣故；為了……；日本米酒

explains.en: A phrase meaning for another person's benefit expresses this idea. Someone may stay quiet to avoid waking a baby. The words explain the reason.
The word also names a Japanese alcoholic drink made from rice. Adults may drink it with meals. Children should not drink alcohol.
A reason tells why someone acts, while this phrase names who or what benefits. The drink is a separate meaning. Context makes it clear.

examples.en: Employees receive their monthly salary on the fifth.
examples.zh: 員工在每月五號領取月薪。

examples.en: Negotiations for a starting salary should reflect your market skills and experience.
examples.zh: 起薪待遇的協商洽談應客觀反映出你在市場上的專業技能與經驗價值。

examples.en: Many companies award annual bonuses in addition to employees' standard base salary.
examples.zh: 除了標準基本月薪之外，許多企業還會發放豐厚的年終獎金。

examples.en: The company offers a competitive starting salary and annual bonuses.
examples.zh: 該公司提供具競爭力的起薪與優渥的年終獎金。

examples.en: Salaries are transferred directly into employee bank accounts on the fifth of every month.
examples.zh: 員工每月固定月薪均於每個月五號準時電匯入帳至個人薪轉銀行帳戶之中。

examples.en: She negotiated a higher monthly salary based on her seven years of specialized experience.
examples.zh: 憑藉個人長達七年的頂尖專業實務歷練，她在二面時成功爭取到了更高的核敘月薪。

entries.definition: 月薪；薪水；月薪（固定薪資）

explains.en: A fixed amount of money paid to a worker, often each month, is called this. It is agreed upon before someone starts a job. The amount may depend on the work.
Some workers are paid by the hour instead. Others receive a set payment over a longer period. The agreement explains when money arrives.
Wages can be paid for each hour or week, while this term often means a regular amount for a longer period. People earn money for their work. A budget helps plan spending.

examples.en: The repair was satisfactory, though the paint did not match.
examples.zh: 修理結果令人滿意，雖然油漆顏色不相配。

examples.en: Her test result was satisfactory for the class.
examples.zh: 她的考試成績符合課程要求。

examples.en: The simple meal was satisfactory after a long hike.
examples.zh: 長途健行後，這頓簡單的餐點很合適。

entries.definition: 令人滿意的；足夠好的；尚可的。

explains.en: Something that is good enough for a need or requirement can be described this way. A simple answer may meet the assignment rules. It does not have to be perfect.
A result can meet expectations without being excellent. The teacher may accept the work as complete. There can still be room to improve.
Excellent means especially good, while this word means acceptable or adequate. The level depends on the standard. Clear instructions help people know what is enough.

examples.en: She poured tomato sauce over the pasta.
examples.zh: 她把番茄醬汁淋在義大利麵上。

examples.en: The cook made a spicy sauce for the dumplings.
examples.zh: 廚師為水餃做了一種辣醬。

examples.en: We dipped the vegetables in a yogurt sauce.
examples.zh: 我們把蔬菜沾優格醬吃。

explains.en: A thick or thin liquid added to food for flavor is called this. Tomato versions go well with pasta. Some are sweet, and others are savory.
People may pour or spoon it over meat, vegetables, or noodles. A small amount can change a dish's taste. Keep it covered in the refrigerator.
A soup is usually eaten by itself, while this condiment is often added to another food. Recipes use many kinds. Check ingredients for allergies.

examples.en: Place the delicate coffee cup on the ceramic saucer.
examples.zh: 將精緻的咖啡杯放在陶瓷茶碟上。

examples.en: The antique porcelain cup and saucer set was passed down from grandmother.
examples.zh: 這套骨董瓷杯茶碟組是外婆傳承下來的。

examples.en: A little kitten lapped fresh milk greedily from a white saucer.
examples.zh: 小貓咪貪婪地舔食著白色小碟子裡的鮮奶。

explains.en: A small, shallow dish sits under a cup to catch drips. It may be made of ceramic or glass. A matching cup often comes with it.
People can place a tea bag or spoon on it. It helps keep a table clean. Carry it carefully so the cup does not slide.
A plate is usually larger and holds food, while this little dish supports a cup. Some sets have matching designs. It can also be used for small snacks.

examples.en: He grilled a sausage for lunch.
examples.zh: 他午餐烤了一根香腸。

examples.en: The recipe adds sliced sausage to the soup.
examples.zh: 食譜把切片香腸加入湯裡。

examples.en: She chose a plant-based sausage at the market.
examples.zh: 她在市場選了一根植物肉香腸。

explains.en: A seasoned mixture of meat or other ingredients is shaped into a long tube. It may be cooked in a pan or on a grill. Read the label for ingredients.
Some versions are made from plants instead of meat. They can be served in a bun or with vegetables. Cook them as directed.
A meatball is round, while this food is usually long and covered by a casing. Different regions have their own kinds. It can be eaten at breakfast or dinner.

examples.en: Saving water is important during a dry summer.
examples.zh: 乾燥的夏天節約用水很重要。

examples.en: Switching off unnecessary appliances yields noticeable electricity saving over time.
examples.zh: 關閉不必要的電器長期下來能帶來顯著的節電效果。

examples.en: Booking your train tickets several weeks early offers a substantial fare saving.
examples.zh: 提前數週預訂火車票可享有相當可觀的票價折扣節省。

entries.definition: （名）節省；儲蓄；節約下來的錢；（形）節省的

explains.en: Money kept for future use is called this. A person may put a little aside each week. It can help pay for a larger goal.
The act of preventing waste is another meaning. Turning off lights is one way to use less electricity. Small actions can add up.
Spending uses money now, while keeping some for later can help with future needs. People may save for a toy or trip. A plan can make the goal easier.

examples.en: Baking is exact chemistry where relying on volumetric cups instead of a scale causes unpredictable failures.
examples.zh: 烘焙本質上是一門精準的化學工藝，單純依賴量杯容積測量而非電子磅秤秤重極易導致翻車失敗。

examples.en: Press the tare button on the scale to zero out the bowl weight before adding your next baking ingredient.
examples.zh: 在倒入下一項烘焙食材之前，先輕按電子秤上的歸零去皮按鈕（Tare），扣除攪拌盆自身重量。

examples.en: The museum features a 1:35 scale historical diorama depicting a famous desert tank battle.
examples.zh: 歷史博物館展出了一座 1:35 精密比例立體情境模型，逼真重現著名的沙漠坦克戰役。

examples.en: The architects built a large physical scale model of the proposed city sports center.
examples.zh: 建築師團隊親手搭建了一座大型實體比例模型，向市府委員具體展示規劃中的市立體育中心。

examples.en: Stepping on the bathroom scale each morning helps him track his personal fitness progress.
examples.zh: 每天清晨起床後站上浴室體重計磅秤量體重，有助於他持續追蹤個人減重健身的成效。

examples.en: Engineers built a 1:10 physical scale model filled with dry nitrogen to test ultrasonic sound reflections.
examples.zh: 工程團隊耗資打造「一比十精密實體縮尺模型」（Scale Model），充入乾燥氮氣以超音波驗證聲學設計。

examples.en: Step onto the digital bathroom scale every morning to track your body weight progress consistently.
examples.zh: 每天清晨起床後踏上浴室數位體重秤，能持之以恆、客觀精準地掌握自身的體重管理進度。

examples.en: The seismologist categorized the major earthquake as a magnitude seven point two on the Richter scale.
examples.zh: 地震測報中心專業地震學家，將這起外海強震正式判定為芮氏規模七點二的強烈地震。

entries.definition: 電子料理秤；刻度；磅秤；模型比例尺 (如 1/35 軍事坦克)；十分之一精準實體縮尺模型超音波充氮聲學測試；比例

explains.en: A set of marks or numbers used for measuring is called this. A map uses one to show how distances compare. It helps people understand size.
The word can also refer to a device that measures weight. A person may stand on it at a clinic. It shows a number.
A ruler measures length, while this tool may measure weight or compare distances on a map. The subject tells which kind is meant. Follow directions to read it correctly.

examples.en: Fresh water became scarce during the long drought.
examples.zh: 長期乾旱期間，淡水變得稀少。

examples.en: Parking spaces are scarce near the busy market.
examples.zh: 熱鬧市場附近的停車位很少。

examples.en: The scarce bird was protected by local rules.
examples.zh: 當地規定保護這種稀有鳥類。

explains.en: Something that is not available in large amounts can be described this way. Water may be limited during a drought. People should use it carefully.
A rare bird is hard to find in a particular area. Protecting its home can help it survive. Researchers count how many remain.
Plentiful means there is a lot, while this adjective means there is little. A shortage can affect prices. Communities can plan for limited supplies.

examples.en: Wrap a soft tartan wool scarf snugly around your neck on chilly mornings.
examples.zh: 在寒流來襲的微冷清晨，將一條柔軟溫暖的經典英倫蘇格蘭格紋羊毛圍巾輕柔環繞於頸間。

examples.en: Tying a vibrant silk scarf onto the handle of a tote bag adds a pop of personality.
examples.zh: 將一條色彩明艷的印花真絲絲巾隨意繫在托特包提把上，能立即為包款增添獨特個人品味。

examples.en: An oversized blanket scarf can double as a warm wrap during long flights in chilly cabins.
examples.zh: 寬大厚實的披肩式毛毯圍巾，在搭乘長途客機寒冷的機艙內能隨時化身為保暖小蓋毯。

explains.en: A long piece of cloth worn around the neck is called this. It helps keep someone warm in cold weather. Some are light and decorative.
People may wrap one over their hair or shoulders. It can be knitted or woven. Fold it neatly when not in use.
A hat covers the head, while this garment goes around the neck or shoulders. Different cultures wear it in different ways. Choose fabric for the weather.

examples.en: The scary mask made the toddler hide.
examples.zh: 那個嚇人的面具讓幼兒躲了起來。

examples.en: A scary sound came from the empty hallway.
examples.zh: 空蕩蕩的走廊傳來可怕的聲音。

examples.en: The children told a scary story around the campfire.
examples.zh: 孩子們在營火旁講了一個恐怖故事。

explains.en: Something that causes fear can be described this way. A loud noise in the dark may startle a child. A calm adult can offer comfort.
A movie may have frightening scenes. People can choose a gentler story if they feel uncomfortable. It is okay to stop watching.
Funny things make people laugh, while this adjective describes things that frighten them. Different people have different fears. Be kind and do not tease someone.

examples.en: The wind scattered leaves across the path.
examples.zh: 風吹得落葉散落在小路上。

examples.en: She scattered seeds in the garden bed.
examples.zh: 她把種子撒在花圃裡。

examples.en: The children scattered toys across the room.
examples.zh: 孩子們把玩具散落在房間各處。

entries.definition: （動）散落；撒播；驅散；（名）少量分散物

explains.en: To spread things over an area in an untidy way is to do this. Wind may spread leaves across a yard. Raking gathers them again.
A person can place seeds over a garden bed. They should spread them evenly so plants have room to grow. Follow planting directions.
Collect means bring things together, while this verb means sending or placing them in different spots. Confetti is tossed at celebrations. Clean up afterward.

examples.en: The scholar studied ancient maps at the university.
examples.zh: 這位學者在大學研究古地圖。

examples.en: A young scholar won a prize for her history essay.
examples.zh: 一位年輕學者因歷史論文獲獎。

examples.en: The scholar shared his research with the class.
examples.zh: 這位學者和全班分享了他的研究。

entries.definition: 學者；獎學金得主；博學之士

explains.en: A person who studies a subject deeply is called this. They may read many books and write about what they learn. Careful research takes time.
A student who receives money to help pay for school may also be called this. The award often recognizes strong work. Requirements vary.
A beginner is just starting to learn, while this person has studied for a long time. The word can also refer to a student with an award. Context gives the meaning.

examples.en: Outstanding students are awarded academic merit scholarships.
examples.zh: 品學兼優的傑出學生獲頒優秀學業獎學金。

examples.en: Winning a full scholarship enabled her to study abroad without financial burdens.
examples.zh: 榮獲全額獎學金使她得以毫無財務負擔地赴海外深造留學。

examples.en: The corporate foundation funds dozens of university research scholarships annually.
examples.zh: 該企業基金會每年資助數十項大學學術研究獎學金。

examples.en: She was awarded a prestigious full government scholarship to study abroad.
examples.zh: 她榮獲了公費留學全額獎學金前往海外深造。

examples.en: Applicants must maintain top academic grades to retain their merit scholarship.
examples.zh: 申請人必須持續保持頂尖的學業成績以維持其優秀學生獎學金資格。

examples.en: The foundation established a memorial scholarship to honor the pioneering scientist.
examples.zh: 該基金會設立了一項紀念獎學金，以表彰這位先驅科學家的卓越貢獻。

explains.en: Money given to help a student pay for school is called this. A student may earn it for good grades or special skills. The rules explain how to apply.
The word can also mean serious study of a subject. A person's work on history may add to knowledge. This meaning is less common in everyday speech.
A loan must be paid back, while this kind of school support usually does not. Students can ask a counselor about applications. Different awards have different requirements.

examples.en: The students used a scientific method to test the soil.
examples.zh: 學生們用科學方法測試土壤。

examples.en: The museum displayed scientific tools from the past.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了昔日的科學工具。

examples.en: Her scientific report included careful observations.
examples.zh: 她的科學報告包含仔細的觀察紀錄。

entries.definition: 科學的；依據科學方法的；嚴謹的。

explains.en: Knowledge and methods used to study the natural world are related to this adjective. A careful test may compare two kinds of soil. Careful notes help explain the result.
A claim should be supported by evidence to be described this way. Researchers repeat tests to check results. Good methods reduce mistakes.
A guess is not tested, while this kind of work uses observations and evidence. Questions lead to experiments. Results may change when new facts are found.

examples.en: The scientist looked at the leaves through a microscope.
examples.zh: 科學家透過顯微鏡觀察葉子。

examples.en: A scientist measured the temperature of the lake.
examples.zh: 一位科學家測量了湖水的溫度。

examples.en: The young scientist asked how the stars form.
examples.zh: 這位年輕科學家詢問星星如何形成。

explains.en: A person who studies nature or how things work is called this. They ask questions and test ideas. Their work can help solve problems.
Some study animals, while others study space or tiny cells. They use tools and record what they observe. Teamwork can be important.
An engineer designs machines, while this researcher studies facts about the world. Their jobs can overlap. Both use careful thinking.

examples.en: Use a pair of scissors to cut out the picture.
examples.zh: 用剪刀把這張圖片剪下來。

examples.en: Children should use safety scissors with rounded tips for craft class.
examples.zh: 兒童在美勞課上應該使用圓頭安全剪刀。

examples.en: Be careful when passing scissors; hand them handle-first.
examples.zh: 遞剪刀時要當心，握住刀刃把刀柄朝向對方遞出。

explains.en: A hand tool with two sharp blades is used to cut paper, fabric, or other things. Hold it by the handles. Carry it with the points down.
The blades cross when the handles are squeezed. Children should use a safe pair and follow an adult's directions. Store it closed.
A knife has one blade, while this tool has two that move past each other. Choose the right kind for the material. Keep fingers away from the blades.

examples.en: The scout reported a clear path through the woods.
examples.zh: 偵察員回報森林裡有一條暢通的小路。

examples.en: A scout helped clean the neighborhood park.
examples.zh: 一位童軍協助清理社區公園。

examples.en: The baseball scout watched the new player practice.
examples.zh: 棒球球探觀察新球員練習。

entries.definition: （名）偵察員；童軍；球探；（動）勘查；物色

explains.en: A person sent ahead to find information about a place or group is called this. The person may look for a safe route. Their report helps others plan.
A member of a youth organization may also have this name. They learn outdoor skills and help their community. Activities vary by group.
A tourist visits for pleasure, while this person may search for useful details. Sports teams also send someone to look for talented players. The context shows the role.

examples.en: The fans screamed when the singer came on stage.
examples.zh: 歌手上台時，粉絲們尖叫起來。

examples.en: She screamed for help when she saw smoke.
examples.zh: 看到煙時，她大聲呼救。

examples.en: The children screamed with excitement on the ride.
examples.zh: 孩子們在遊樂設施上興奮地尖叫。

explains.en: To make a very loud, high sound because of fear, pain, or excitement is to do this. A child may shout on a roller coaster. The sound can surprise others.
A person can also call loudly to be heard across a field. A clear voice may carry farther. Do not frighten people for fun.
Whisper is very quiet, while this action is loud. People may do it when startled. Context explains whether the feeling is fear or joy.

examples.en: The screw held the chair leg in place.
examples.zh: 螺絲把椅腳固定住。

examples.en: Use a screwdriver to tighten the loose screw.
examples.zh: 用螺絲起子把鬆動的螺絲鎖緊。

examples.en: He screwed the shelf bracket to the wall.
examples.zh: 他把層架托架鎖在牆上。

entries.definition: （名）螺絲；螺旋槳；（動）用螺絲固定；擰緊。

explains.en: A metal fastener with a spiral ridge is turned to hold pieces together. A screwdriver fits into its head. Choose the right size for the job.
As a verb, it means to fasten something with such a device. A worker may join boards to make a shelf. Keep fingers clear of the tool.
A nail is hammered straight into wood, while this fastener is twisted into place. It can be removed and used again. Use proper tools.

examples.en: She scrubbed the muddy boots with a brush.
examples.zh: 她用刷子刷洗沾滿泥巴的靴子。

examples.en: We scrubbed the kitchen floor after the spill.
examples.zh: 飲料灑出來後，我們刷洗了廚房地板。

examples.en: The scrub along the trail was full of tiny flowers.
examples.zh: 步道旁的灌木叢裡開滿了小花。

entries.definition: （動）用力刷洗；擦洗；（名）矮樹叢；灌木地

explains.en: To clean something by rubbing it hard is to do this. A brush can remove mud from shoes. Use soap and water when needed.
The noun can mean a low bush or small area of rough plants. Rabbits may hide among them. The meaning depends on the sentence.
Wipe may mean a gentle pass, while this action uses more effort to remove dirt. Do not damage a surface. Follow cleaning directions.

examples.en: The prestigious Geneva Seal stamped onto the bridge guarantees origin, reliability, and supreme decoration.
examples.zh: 鐫刻在夾板上的尊貴「日內瓦印記」（Geneva Seal），是瑞士頂級產地、極致打磨與精準壽命的最高保證。

examples.en: The court clerk pressed the official municipal notary seal onto the legal real estate title document.
examples.zh: 地政事務所公證專員在產權過戶契約正本上，莊嚴加蓋了鋼印與具備法定公信力的官方證明關防印鑑。

examples.en: Playful sea lions and northern fur seals basked lazily on warm offshore rocky outcrops.
examples.zh: 一群慵懶的海獅與北方海豹舒服地躺在被陽光曬得暖洋洋的沿岸礁石上曬太陽，模樣滑稽討喜。

entries.definition: 象徵最高工藝標準之日內瓦印記與百達翡麗印記；印章

explains.en: A thick coating can close an opening and keep air or water from getting through. A jar's lid may have one. It helps keep food fresh.
The word also names a sea animal with smooth skin and flippers. It rests on rocks near the shore. Watch it from a distance.
As a verb, it can mean closing something tightly. An envelope is closed before mailing. The noun can refer to a closure or an animal.

examples.en: Diversified renewable power generation forms the bedrock of modern national energy security.
examples.zh: 多元化、在地化與分散式的綠色再生能源發電體系，是守護這座海島國家能源安全的最堅固基石。

examples.en: Strategic fuel stockpiles and dispersed wind farms insulate island economies against shipping embargoes.
examples.zh: 提高國家戰略能源儲備天數並廣泛佈建海上分散式風場，能保護海島經濟抵禦任何形式的禁運封鎖。

examples.en: Protecting power substations against cyber espionage has become a top priority for homeland security.
examples.zh: 保衛全國各關鍵輸電變電所免受跨國黑客組織的惡意網路間諜滲透，已成國家安全戰略的最高防線。

entries.definition: 確保島嶼關鍵基礎設施能源供應安全

explains.en: Steps taken to keep people or belongings safe are called this. A lock on a door is one example. Guards may also help.
A computer system uses passwords to keep private information safe. Choose a strong one and do not share it. Adults can help protect accounts.
Danger means a chance of harm, while this noun relates to safety. A school may have rules for visitors. These steps help protect everyone.

examples.en: The fall semester in Taiwan usually begins in early September.
examples.zh: 台灣的大學秋季學期通常在九月初開學。

examples.en: She decided to study abroad in Germany for one exchange semester.
examples.zh: 她決定前往德國進行為期一個學期的海外交換研習。

examples.en: Students often feel intense stress during the final weeks of the semester.
examples.zh: 學生在學期最後幾週通常會感受到沉重巨大的學業壓力。

examples.en: The fall academic semester runs from mid-September through mid-January.
examples.zh: 大學秋季學期從九月中旬一路進行至隔年一月中旬。

examples.en: Students cram for exams during the stressful final week of each semester.
examples.zh: 學生們在每學期壓力最沉重的期末週期間熬夜臨時抱佛腳苦讀迎考。

examples.en: She plans to take eighteen credits next semester to graduate one term early.
examples.zh: 她打算下學期多修十八個學分，爭取提早一個學期順利自大學畢業。

entries.definition: 學期（通常半年）；大學學期（秋季／春季）

explains.en: One of two main parts of a school year at some colleges is called this. Each has its own classes and exams. The length varies by school.
Students may choose new subjects at the start of each part. A calendar lists the dates. Holidays may fall between them.
A quarter is one of four parts, while this term usually describes one of two parts of a school year. Schools set their own schedules. Ask the office for dates.

examples.en: The Senior Citizens Learning Center offers free workshops on digital photography and ukulele playing.
examples.zh: 全台各區樂齡學習中心開辦豐富課程，免費教授長輩智慧型手機攝影與烏克麗麗彈唱。

examples.en: As the senior engineer on the team, he mentors younger coders and leads system architecture reviews.
examples.zh: 身為團隊中的資深主任工程師，他耐心地指導年輕後輩並主持核心系統架構審查。

examples.en: High school seniors often feel anxious while waiting for university entrance exam admission results.
examples.zh: 高中三年級的高三畢業生在焦急等待大學多元入學放榜榜單時，往往難免感到忐忑不安。

entries.definition: 樂齡長輩；銀髮族的；資深的

explains.en: An older or more experienced person may be described this way. A more experienced worker can help a new teammate. Experience brings useful knowledge.
In some schools, it names a student in the final year. The exact grade differs by country. A ceremony may celebrate graduation.
Junior often refers to someone younger or less experienced, while this word can signal the opposite. A center for older adults serves older adults. Context tells which use applies.

examples.en: Saving a portion of your monthly income is very sensible.
examples.zh: 將每月收入的一部分存起來是非常明智的做法。

examples.en: Wearing comfortable walking sneakers is a sensible choice for an all-day city tour.
examples.zh: 參加全天候的城市徒步深度探索行程，換上一雙舒適好走的運動鞋是明智的選擇。

examples.en: Let's make a sensible backup plan in case the afternoon mountain weather turns stormy.
examples.zh: 咱們應當事先規劃一套切實可行的雨天備案，以防午後山區天候驟變狂風暴雨。

explains.en: A choice that shows good judgment can be described this way. Wearing a coat on a cold day is a wise idea. It helps someone stay warm.
A person who thinks carefully before acting may be called this. They consider what could happen. Advice from trusted adults can help.
Careless choices ignore possible results, while this adjective suggests thoughtful action. A thoughtful plan includes enough time. It can change when new facts appear.

examples.en: Stage separation occurred smoothly at an altitude of eighty kilometers above the Earth.
examples.zh: 在海拔八十公里的近太空高空，火箭第一節推進器與第二節太空艙完成教科書般的完美分級分離。

examples.en: Engineers held their breath until telemetry confirmed clean mechanical separation of the space capsule.
examples.zh: 工程團隊屏息以待，直到遠端數據確認太空返回艙順利完成機械分離。

examples.en: Thorough waste separation and recycling have become daily civic habits across Taiwan communities.
examples.zh: 徹底的垃圾分類（Separation）與資源回收已成為全台灣社區鄰里深植人心的日常習慣。

entries.definition: 火箭一二節分級分離；分開

explains.en: The act of moving people or things apart is called this. A fence creates a space between two yards. A line may show where one area ends.
The word can also describe people living apart from each other. Families may change where they live. Kind support can help during change.
Together means being in the same place, while this noun refers to being apart. The context might be physical or personal. It can describe a temporary or lasting change.

examples.en: The biology book explained sexual reproduction in plants.
examples.zh: 生物課本解釋了植物的有性生殖。

examples.en: The lesson discussed sexual health in an age-appropriate way.
examples.zh: 課程以符合年齡的方式討論性健康。

examples.en: Some birds show sexual differences in their colors.
examples.zh: 有些鳥類在羽色上有性別差異。

entries.definition: 性的；與性或生殖有關的

explains.en: This adjective relates to sex, reproduction, or the body systems involved in having children. It appears in health and biology lessons. The topic should be discussed respectfully.
Some behavior or images are described this way when they involve adult intimacy. Children can ask a trusted adult about unfamiliar terms. Age-appropriate information is helpful.
Reproduction concerns how living things have young, while this word is also used for adult relationships. Its meaning depends on the subject. Use respectful language.

examples.en: The magazine described the actor as sexy.
examples.zh: 雜誌形容那位演員很性感。

examples.en: The singer wore a sexy costume for the adult concert.
examples.zh: 那位歌手在成人演唱會上穿著性感服裝。

examples.en: He called the advertisement sexy, but his teacher preferred a different word.
examples.zh: 他說那則廣告很性感，但老師比較喜歡用別的詞。

entries.definition: 性感的；富有性吸引力的（用於成年人，需留意語境）

explains.en: This informal adjective describes someone or something that people find sexually attractive. It is usually used about adults. Choose respectful words when talking about others.
People may use it to describe a style or appearance in music and fashion. The word can sound too personal or inappropriate in some settings. Think about the audience.
Beautiful can describe many kinds of appearance, while this term has a specifically adult meaning. It may make someone uncomfortable. Respect people's boundaries.

examples.en: The banyan tree casts a wide, cool shadow on the lawn.
examples.zh: 榕樹在草坪上投下了大片涼爽的樹蔭。

examples.en: Shadows grow longer as the afternoon sun begins to descend.
examples.zh: 隨著午後夕陽開始西沉，地上的影子逐漸拉得越來越長。

examples.en: The clever detective followed the suspicious suspect like a silent shadow.
examples.zh: 那名機敏的警探猶如無聲的影子般悄悄尾隨可疑嫌犯。

examples.en: Lifting dark shadows reveals intricate architectural carvings in historic temples.
examples.zh: 適度拉升照片陰影暗部細節，能清晰展現古老廟宇屋簷下巧奪天工的精細木雕藻井。

examples.en: The oak tree cast a broad, cool shadow over the lawn where children were playing.
examples.zh: 枝繁葉茂的百年老橡樹在草坪上投下了一大片清涼愜意的綠蔭樹影，孩童們在樹下嬉戲。

examples.en: Deep, dramatic shadows in black-and-white portraits create a sense of mystery.
examples.zh: 在黑白人像攝影中大膽運用深沉生動的濃重陰影對比，能營造出充滿懸念深邃的神秘氛圍。

examples.en: The historic image showed a glowing orange photon ring surrounding the dark silhouette of the black hole shadow.
examples.zh: 這張歷史性世紀影像展現出一個金黃色的光子光環，圍繞著中心漆黑深邃的「黑洞陰影」（Black Hole Shadow）。

examples.en: Tall palm trees cast long cool shadows across the sun-drenched coastal boardwalk at midday.
examples.zh: 高聳翠綠的椰子樹在正午烈日下，於陽光燦爛的海濱木棧道上投下漫長而清涼的陰影。

examples.en: The mysterious astronomical discovery stepped out from the shadow of long-standing theoretical doubt.
examples.zh: 這項劃時代的神秘天文發現，終於擺脫長達數十年的理論質疑陰影，贏得科學界一致讚譽。

entries.definition: 影子；陰影；遮蔽；陰影暗部；M87 與銀河系人馬座 A* 黑洞陰影世紀影像

explains.en: A dark shape made when something blocks light is called this. A tree may make one on the ground. It changes as the sun moves.
The word can also mean a small trace of something. A person may show a slight trace of a smile. This use is figurative.
A reflection appears in a mirror, while this dark shape forms when light is blocked. It needs a light source and an object. Move the object and it changes.

examples.en: The stream was shallow enough to see the stones.
examples.zh: 溪水很淺，可以看見石頭。

examples.en: She put the shells in a shallow dish.
examples.zh: 她把貝殼放進淺盤裡。

examples.en: The children waded in the shallow end of the pool.
examples.zh: 孩子們在游泳池的淺水區涉水玩耍。

explains.en: Water that is not deep can be described this way. A child may play near the shore where the bottom is close. An adult should watch carefully.
A dish with a low rim may also be described this way. It holds only a small amount. A deeper bowl can hold more soup.
Deep means reaching far down, while this adjective means not far below the surface. A puddle is usually not deep. Check water before stepping in.

examples.en: This botanical shampoo smells like mint.
examples.zh: 這款草本洗髮精聞起來有薄荷香氣。

examples.en: Wash your hair with anti-dandruff shampoo twice a week.
examples.zh: 每週用去屑洗髮精洗頭兩次。

examples.en: She prefers using silicone-free shampoo for healthier hair.
examples.zh: 她偏好使用無矽靈洗髮精以保持頭髮健康。

explains.en: A liquid or cream used to wash hair is called this. People massage it into wet hair and rinse it out. Keep it away from the eyes.
The verb means to wash hair with the product. Some kinds are made for dry or curly hair. Read the label before use.
Soap can clean hands and body, while this product is made especially for hair. Conditioner is used afterward by some people. Rinse well.

examples.en: The shepherd led the sheep to a green field.
examples.zh: 牧羊人帶著羊群前往一片綠草地。

examples.en: A shepherd watched the flock from the hillside.
examples.zh: 牧羊人從山坡上看顧羊群。

examples.en: The shepherd dog stayed near the animals.
examples.zh: 牧羊犬待在動物們身邊。

explains.en: A person who cares for sheep and leads them to food is called this. A dog may help guide the flock. The work can happen outdoors.
The word can also describe a person who guides or protects a group. A community leader may help people find support. This use is figurative.
A farmer grows crops or raises animals, while this worker focuses on sheep. A flock needs water and safe grazing land. Caring for animals takes attention.

examples.en: The shiny marble rolled across the floor.
examples.zh: 亮晶晶的彈珠滾過地板。

examples.en: He polished his shoes until they were shiny.
examples.zh: 他把鞋子擦得閃閃發亮。

examples.en: A shiny beetle crawled over the leaf.
examples.zh: 一隻閃亮的甲蟲爬過葉子。

explains.en: Something that reflects light and looks bright can be described this way. A polished spoon may sparkle. Wiping it clean can make it shine.
A person's hair or shoes may look bright and smooth. The adjective often describes a clean surface. Dust can make it look dull.
Dull surfaces reflect little light, while this word describes a bright appearance. Metal can be polished to look this way. Some stones naturally sparkle.

examples.en: We shortened the walk by taking the path through the park.
examples.zh: 我們走公園裡的小路，縮短了路程。

examples.en: The tailor shortened the sleeves of my coat.
examples.zh: 裁縫縮短了我外套的袖子。

examples.en: She shortened her story to fit the time limit.
examples.zh: 她縮短了故事，以符合時間限制。

explains.en: To make something shorter in length or time is to do this. A tailor may cut extra fabric from a dress. The clothing can fit better.
A person can reduce a long story to fewer words. Keeping only the main ideas helps. The listener can understand more quickly.
Lengthen means make longer, while this verb means make shorter. A meeting may end early. The adjective form describes a smaller length.

examples.en: The movie will begin shortly.
examples.zh: 電影很快就要開始了。

examples.en: She replied shortly because she was busy.
examples.zh: 她因為很忙而簡短地回覆。

examples.en: We will speak with the guide shortly.
examples.zh: 我們很快就會和導覽員談話。

entries.definition: 不久；很快；簡短地；唐突地。

explains.en: In a short time from now is one meaning of this adverb. The bus will arrive soon. Passengers should wait behind the line.
The word can also describe speaking in a brief, sometimes unfriendly way. A person may answer with just a few words. Tone helps show the feeling.
Later means after some time, while this adverb often means soon. It can also describe a brief response. Read the whole sentence to know which meaning fits.

examples.en: Dad used a shovel to clear the snowy steps.
examples.zh: 爸爸用鏟子清除階梯上的積雪。

examples.en: She shoveled soil into the flower bed.
examples.zh: 她把土鏟進花圃裡。

examples.en: The worker left the shovel beside the pile of sand.
examples.zh: 工人把鏟子放在沙堆旁。

explains.en: A tool with a broad blade is used for digging or moving loose material. A person may clear snow from a path with one. Hold it carefully.
The verb means to move soil, snow, or another loose substance with this tool. Gardeners may dig a hole for a plant. Use safe lifting techniques.
A rake gathers leaves, while this tool moves heavier material. There are different shapes for digging and scooping. Put it away after use.

examples.en: The shrimp swam backward through the water.
examples.zh: 蝦在水中向後游。

examples.en: She added shrimp to the vegetable noodles.
examples.zh: 她在蔬菜麵裡加了蝦。

examples.en: The small shrimp hid beneath a rock.
examples.zh: 小蝦躲在岩石下方。

explains.en: A small sea animal has a curved body, many legs, and a hard outer shell. People eat it cooked in many dishes. Some kinds live in fresh water.
This word can describe a small person or thing informally, but it may sound rude. Choose kinder words when talking about people. The comment can hurt feelings.
A crab has a broad shell and claws, while this animal has a long narrow body. Both live in water. Remove the shell before eating.

examples.en: The sweater may shrink if you wash it in hot water.
examples.zh: 這件毛衣如果用熱水洗，可能會縮水。

examples.en: The puddle may shrink under the warm sun.
examples.zh: 水坑在暖陽下可能會縮小。

examples.en: The plant began to shrink without enough water.
examples.zh: 沒有足夠的水，植物開始枯縮。

explains.en: To become smaller in size is to do this. Some clothes change after being washed in hot water. Follow the care label.
A material may get smaller when it dries or cools. Wood can change with heat and moisture. Builders allow for these changes.
Grow means become larger, while this verb means become smaller. A balloon gets smaller as air escapes. The cause may be different in each case.

examples.en: She sighed with relief when the test was over.
examples.zh: 考試結束時，她鬆了一口氣。

examples.en: He sighed after carrying the heavy box upstairs.
examples.zh: 他把沉重的箱子搬上樓後嘆了口氣。

examples.en: A deep sigh came from the tired traveler.
examples.zh: 疲憊的旅人深深嘆了一口氣。

explains.en: To breathe out slowly and audibly is to do this. Someone may do it after finishing a hard task. It can show relief or sadness.
The noun can mean the breath itself. A tired person may let out one after a long walk. The sound is soft.
A gasp is a sudden sharp breath, while this action is slower and longer. People may do it when disappointed. The face and voice give clues.

examples.en: The green signal told the cars to move.
examples.zh: 綠燈訊號告訴車輛可以通行。

examples.en: She gave a signal for the band to begin.
examples.zh: 她發出訊號，讓樂團開始演奏。

examples.en: A weak phone signal made the call hard to hear.
examples.zh: 手機訊號微弱，通話很難聽清楚。

entries.definition: （名）訊號；信號；暗號；（動）發信號；示意

explains.en: A sign, sound, or action that sends a message is called this. A traffic light tells drivers when to stop. People follow it to stay safe.
A hand movement can tell someone to begin or come closer. A coach may wave to a player. The group agrees on what it means.
A message may use words, while this can be a simple sound or sign. A bell can announce the end of class. The meaning depends on a shared rule.

examples.en: The discovery was significant for the whole research team.
examples.zh: 這項發現對整個研究團隊都很重要。

examples.en: There was a significant change in the river level.
examples.zh: 河流水位出現了明顯變化。

examples.en: Her help made a significant difference to the project.
examples.zh: 她的協助為專題帶來了重大的改變。

entries.definition: 重要的；顯著的；相當大的

explains.en: Something important or large enough to matter can be described this way. An important change in weather may affect a trip. People should prepare.
A small detail can have great meaning in a story. The reader may notice why it matters. Context helps explain its role.
Minor means not very important, while this adjective points to something that matters. A big difference in test results may matter. The subject tells what kind of importance is meant.

examples.en: The traditional scarf is woven from smooth Taiwanese silk.
examples.zh: 這條傳統圍巾是由光滑的台灣真絲編織而成。

examples.en: The queen wore an exquisite evening gown of pure royal blue silk.
examples.zh: 女王身穿一襲以純寶藍色真絲縫製的精緻晚禮服。

examples.en: The ancient Silk Road connected East Asia with the Mediterranean trade.
examples.zh: 古代的絲綢之路連繫了東亞與地中海的商業貿易。

examples.en: A Mulberry silk pillowcase reduces hair friction and prevents morning frizz.
examples.zh: 睡在頂級百分之百純桑蠶絲真絲枕套上能大幅減少頭髮摩擦，避免晨起秀髮毛躁打結。

examples.en: The bride walked down the aisle in a flowing dress woven from pure ivory silk.
examples.zh: 新娘身著一襲由純象牙白真絲織成的飄逸婚紗緩步走過紅毯通道。

examples.en: Gently hand-wash delicate silk scarves in cold water with mild shampoo.
examples.zh: 清洗細緻昂貴的真絲絲巾時，請務必使用溫和洗髮精或中性冷水輕柔手洗。

entries.definition: 絲綢；蠶絲的；蠶絲；絲綢真絲

explains.en: A smooth, soft thread is made by silkworms. Cloth woven from it can feel light and shiny. It is used for scarves and clothing.
The material may come in bright colors. It can be delicate and needs gentle washing. Read the care label before cleaning it.
Cotton is made from plant fibers, while this fabric comes from animal-made threads. Both are used for clothes. Their textures feel different.

examples.en: The similarity between the twins surprised their teacher.
examples.zh: 雙胞胎之間的相似之處讓老師很驚訝。

examples.en: We noticed a similarity in the two paintings.
examples.zh: 我們注意到兩幅畫有相似之處。

examples.en: Their ideas had one important similarity.
examples.zh: 他們的想法有一個重要的相似點。

explains.en: A way in which two things are alike is called this. Two birds may have the same color of feathers. They can still be different kinds.
A student may compare two stories and notice shared ideas. Listing those points helps explain the connection. The stories may also differ.
Difference shows how things are unlike, while this noun points to what they share. A chart can help compare objects. Look carefully at details.

examples.en: The lesson discussed the idea of sin in different religions.
examples.zh: 這堂課討論不同宗教中的罪。

examples.en: In math class, we used sin to solve the triangle problem.
examples.zh: 數學課上，我們用正弦函數解三角形問題。

examples.en: The story showed a character asking forgiveness for a sin.
examples.zh: 故事描寫一個角色為自己的罪請求寬恕。

entries.definition: （名）罪；罪行；（宗教）罪孽；（動）犯錯；（數學）正弦。

explains.en: In some religions, an action thought to be morally wrong is called this. Beliefs about right and wrong differ among faiths. People may discuss forgiveness.
The word can also mean the side opposite a right angle in a math problem. It is part of trigonometry. A calculator can help find its value.
A mistake in school is not automatically a religious offense. In math, the same spelling names a function used with angles. Context is essential.

examples.en: Wishing you a happy birthday with sincere heartfelt blessings!
examples.zh: 獻上最真誠由衷的祝福，祝你生日快樂！

examples.en: Please accept our most sincere congratulations on your well-deserved promotion.
examples.zh: 對於你實至名歸的榮譽升遷，請接受我們所有人最由衷真切的熱烈祝賀。

examples.en: A sincere smile instantly breaks the ice between strangers from different cultures.
examples.zh: 一個出自內心的真誠微笑，能瞬間打破不同文化背景陌生人之間的隔閡藩籬。

explains.en: A person who truly means what they say can be described this way. An honest apology accepts responsibility. Honest words help rebuild trust.
A greeting can show real kindness rather than being said only from habit. People notice when someone listens carefully. Small actions support kind words.
Pretending to care is different from speaking with real feeling. Honest thanks can make someone feel valued. Be truthful and respectful.

examples.en: Rinse the dishes thoroughly in the stainless steel kitchen sink.
examples.zh: 在不鏽鋼廚房水槽中將碗盤徹底沖洗乾淨。

examples.en: Heavy ships will sink beneath the waves if hull integrity is compromised.
examples.zh: 若船體結構完整性受損，沉重的船隻將沉入波濤之中。

examples.en: He washed his tired face with cool water over the porcelain bathroom sink.
examples.zh: 他在瓷製浴室洗手台前用清涼的冷水洗了洗疲憊的臉龐。

examples.en: Preserving ancient mangrove wetlands maintains a potent blue carbon sink that absorbs carbon forty times faster than forests.
examples.zh: 悉心保護紅樹林濱海濕地能維持強大的「藍碳碳匯」（Carbon Sink），其固碳速度高達陸地熱帶雨林的四十倍。

examples.en: Plumbers unclogged the blocked kitchen sink pipe by clearing accumulated food grease deposits.
examples.zh: 水電師傅利用通管專用鋼絞線工具，迅速清除了廚房不鏽鋼流理台洗碗水槽下方沉積多年的頑固油脂阻塞。

examples.en: Peatlands and undisturbed oceans function as the planet’s largest long-term planetary carbon sinks.
examples.zh: 廣大泥炭地濕地與未受污染的深海大洋，是大自然母親調節全球氣候最龐大、最長效的天然地球碳匯。

entries.definition: 水槽；流理台；洗手盆；下沉；大自然森林土壤天然碳匯

explains.en: A basin with a tap is used for washing hands or dishes. It is usually found in a kitchen or bathroom. Water drains away through a pipe.
As a verb, it means to go down below the surface of water or another substance. A stone may do this in a pond. A cork usually stays up.
A tub holds water for bathing, while this fixture is smaller and used for washing. The word also has a movement meaning. Context shows which one is intended.

examples.en: She sipped the warm tea slowly.
examples.zh: 她慢慢啜飲溫熱的茶。

examples.en: He took a sip of water after the race.
examples.zh: 賽跑後，他喝了一小口水。

examples.en: The baby sipped milk from the cup.
examples.zh: 寶寶從杯子裡小口喝牛奶。

explains.en: To drink a small amount slowly is to do this. Someone may taste hot tea carefully. It prevents burning the mouth.
The noun can mean one small drink. A person may take a small drink of water during a walk. The amount is little.
Gulp means swallow a lot quickly, while this action is gentle and slow. It helps someone enjoy a flavor. Take care with very hot drinks.

examples.en: The situation changed when the rain stopped.
examples.zh: 雨停後，情況改變了。

examples.en: She explained the situation to her teacher.
examples.zh: 她向老師說明了情況。

examples.en: We found ourselves in a difficult situation.
examples.zh: 我們發現自己處於困難的處境。

explains.en: The set of facts and conditions at a particular time is called this. A person may need to decide what to do next. Understanding the details helps.
A problem can create a difficult state of affairs. Friends may talk through possible solutions. Staying calm can help.
A single fact is only one detail, while this noun describes the whole set of circumstances. Different choices may improve it. The surrounding story explains what is happening.

examples.en: The children learned to skate at the ice rink.
examples.zh: 孩子們在溜冰場學習滑冰。

examples.en: He skated around the park on his new board.
examples.zh: 他踩著新滑板在公園裡滑行。

examples.en: She likes to skate with her brother on weekends.
examples.zh: 她喜歡週末和哥哥一起溜冰。

entries.definition: （動）滑冰；溜冰；滑滑板；（名）冰鞋；滑板

explains.en: To glide over ice or a smooth surface using special footwear is to do this. A person may glide across a rink. Wearing a helmet and pads can help keep them safe.
A skateboarder uses a board with wheels to ride along a path. The same verb can describe using that board. Practice in a safe area.
Walkers lift their feet, while skaters glide. Ice footwear has blades and roller footwear has wheels. Follow the rules of the rink or park.

examples.en: We skied down the gentle hill together.
examples.zh: 我們一起滑下平緩的山坡。

examples.en: She learned to ski during the winter vacation.
examples.zh: 她在寒假期間學會了滑雪。

examples.en: The family will ski in the mountains next week.
examples.zh: 這家人下週要到山裡滑雪。

explains.en: To glide over snow using long narrow boards on the feet is to do this. People need lessons to learn safely. Wear warm clothing.
A person may use poles to help balance on a slope. Some trails are for beginners and others are more difficult. Follow posted signs.
Snowboarding uses one board on both feet, while this sport uses one board for each foot. Both require practice. Stay within marked areas.

examples.en: The skillful player passed the ball to her teammate.
examples.zh: 技術熟練的球員把球傳給了隊友。

examples.en: He made a skillful repair to the broken chair.
examples.zh: 他巧妙地修好了壞椅子。

examples.en: The skillful artist painted tiny details.
examples.zh: 技藝高超的畫家畫出了細小的細節。

explains.en: A person who can do something well through practice can be described this way. An experienced cook prepares tasty meals. Experience improves ability.
An action may be done with care and control. A craft worker can shape wood without making mistakes. Training helps.
Clumsy means moving awkwardly, while this adjective praises ability. Someone can become better with effort. Different people are good at different skills.

examples.en: The skinny puppy needed a visit to the vet.
examples.zh: 這隻瘦小的小狗需要看獸醫。

examples.en: We walked along a skinny path between the trees.
examples.zh: 我們沿著樹木之間狹窄的小路行走。

examples.en: He wore a skinny tie to the dance.
examples.zh: 他在舞會上打了一條窄領帶。

explains.en: A person or animal with very little body fat may be described this way. The word can sound unkind when used about people. Choose respectful words.
A narrow object can also be described this way. A narrow path may be hard for two people to walk side by side. The meaning depends on the noun.
Slim can be a more polite word for a narrow body shape. People come in many healthy sizes. Avoid teasing others about their appearance.

examples.en: The child skipped across the playground.
examples.zh: 孩子蹦蹦跳跳地穿過遊樂場。

examples.en: Do not skip the last step in the directions.
examples.zh: 不要漏掉說明中的最後一步。

examples.en: She skipped rope with her friends.
examples.zh: 她和朋友們一起跳繩。

entries.definition: （動）跳過；略過；蹦跳；缺席；（名）跳躍

explains.en: To hop lightly or move with a bouncing step is to do this. Children may move with a bouncing step along a path. Watch for rocks and holes.
It can also mean leaving something out or not doing it. A person should not miss breakfast if they are hungry. The meaning depends on context.
Walk means moving at a steady pace, while this action may include hops. In a list, an omitted item has been passed over. Sentence clues help.

examples.en: The history book described how a slave fought for freedom.
examples.zh: 歷史書描述了一名奴隸如何爭取自由。

examples.en: The museum explained the history of a slave ship.
examples.zh: 博物館介紹了一艘奴隸船的歷史。

examples.en: The law ended the practice of keeping people as slaves.
examples.zh: 法律終止了把人當作奴隸的做法。

entries.definition: 奴隸；受奴役的人；（動）使受奴役；完全受制於。

explains.en: A person forced to work for another and not free to leave is called this. Slavery has harmed people throughout history. It is wrong to treat people as property.
In the past, some societies allowed people to be bought and sold. Many people fought to end this injustice. Learning history helps us understand its effects.
A paid worker can choose where to work, while an enslaved person is denied freedom and rights. The history is painful. People deserve respect and freedom.

examples.en: She rolled up her sleeve before washing the dishes.
examples.zh: 她洗碗前捲起了袖子。

examples.en: The jacket had a torn sleeve.
examples.zh: 外套有一隻袖子破了。

examples.en: He kept the record in a paper sleeve.
examples.zh: 他把唱片放在紙套裡。

explains.en: The part of a shirt or jacket that covers an arm is called this. It may be short or long. A cuff is at its end.
This word can also name a cover for a record or document. It helps keep the item clean. Some are made of paper or plastic.
A collar goes around the neck, while this clothing part covers an arm. Some garments have no arm coverings. The item being described clarifies the meaning.

examples.en: A slender tree grew beside the fence.
examples.zh: 一棵纖細的樹長在圍欄旁。

examples.en: The slender vase held one yellow flower.
examples.zh: 細長的花瓶裡插著一朵黃花。

examples.en: A slender path wound through the garden.
examples.zh: 一條狹窄的小徑蜿蜒穿過花園。

explains.en: Something long and thin can be described this way. A thin branch moved in the breeze. It bent without breaking.
The adjective can describe a person with a slim body shape. Use it kindly and do not judge people by their appearance. Everyone is different.
Thick is the opposite of thin, while this word suggests a graceful narrow shape. A narrow candle may fit in a small holder. The context tells what is being described.

examples.en: Slice the ripe watermelon into thick juicy wedges.
examples.zh: 將熟透的西瓜切成厚實多汁的切片。

examples.en: Would you like another slice of homemade strawberry cheesecake?
examples.zh: 你想再來一片自製的草莓起司蛋糕嗎？

examples.en: He sliced through the packaging tape with a sharp utility knife.
examples.zh: 他用鋒利的美工刀劃開了包裝膠帶。

explains.en: A thin, flat piece cut from a larger item is called this. A person may have one of bread or fruit. A knife makes the cut.
As a verb, it means to cut food into thin pieces. Use a sharp knife only with adult supervision. Keep fingers away from the blade.
A chunk is thicker, while this piece is thin and flat. Pizza is often cut into pieces of this shape. The word can also describe a cut.

examples.en: The slippery floor made the child walk slowly.
examples.zh: 地板很滑，孩子走得很慢。

examples.en: Wet leaves made the path slippery.
examples.zh: 濕葉子讓小路變得很滑。

examples.en: The fish felt slippery in his hands.
examples.zh: 魚在他手中摸起來滑溜溜的。

entries.definition: 滑的；容易滑倒的；狡猾的；不穩定的

explains.en: A surface that is hard to stand or walk on because it is smooth or wet can be described this way. Ice is a common example. Take small steps.
Soap can make a tub floor dangerous. Hold a handrail and ask for help if needed. Dry the floor after bathing.
Rough surfaces give shoes more grip, while this kind makes them slide. Rain can make roads dangerous. Move carefully.

examples.en: The trail climbed a gentle slope.
examples.zh: 步道沿著平緩的斜坡往上延伸。

examples.en: The children rolled balls down the grassy slope.
examples.zh: 孩子們把球從長滿草的斜坡上滾下去。

examples.en: A steep slope led to the top of the hill.
examples.zh: 一段陡坡通往山頂。

explains.en: A piece of land that rises or falls at an angle is called this. A hill has one side that people can climb. Steeper ground is harder to walk on.
A road can also have a gradual rise or drop. Drivers slow down on steep roads. Signs may warn them.
Flat land has no rise, while this ground changes height. Skiers travel down a snowy hillside. The angle can be gentle or steep.

examples.en: The dry stick snapped under his shoe.
examples.zh: 乾樹枝在他的鞋底下啪地折斷了。

examples.en: She snapped her fingers to keep the beat.
examples.zh: 她打響指來跟上節拍。

examples.en: He snapped a photo of the sunset.
examples.zh: 他拍了一張日落的照片。

entries.definition: （動）啪地折斷；打響指；拍照；（名）啪聲；快照

explains.en: To break something with a quick sharp sound is to do this. A dry twig may break in a person's hand. Do not throw pieces around.
A person can also make a sharp sound with their fingers. A camera takes a quick picture too. Context shows which action is meant.
Bend slowly means move something carefully, while this verb may describe a sudden break or sound. A dog may bite quickly. Use the sentence to identify the sense.

examples.en: The block of ice was solid and cold.
examples.zh: 那塊冰又硬又冷。

examples.en: They built a solid bridge from sturdy wood.
examples.zh: 他們用堅固的木材搭了一座牢固的橋。

examples.en: A solid wall separated the two rooms.
examples.zh: 一道實心牆隔開了兩個房間。

entries.definition: 堅固的；固體的；連續的；可靠的

explains.en: An object that keeps its shape and is not a liquid or gas is called this state of matter. Ice is one example. Heat can turn it into water.
The adjective can also mean strong and dependable. A sturdy chair does not wobble. It can support a person safely.
Liquid flows and gas spreads through a space, while this state keeps a fixed shape. A stone is an example. The context may refer to strength instead.

examples.en: Someday I hope to see the northern lights.
examples.zh: 我希望有一天能看到極光。

examples.en: She wants to learn to sail someday.
examples.zh: 她想在未來某天學會航海。

examples.en: Someday, the garden will be full of flowers.
examples.zh: 總有一天，花園會開滿花朵。

explains.en: At some time in the future is described by this adverb. A child may hope to visit another country. The exact date is not known.
People use it when talking about a wish or plan that may happen later. Practice can help someone reach a goal. It takes time.
Today means this day, while this word points to an unknown future day. A dream may come true after many years. The timing is uncertain.

examples.en: Somehow, the cat opened the closed cupboard.
examples.zh: 不知怎麼地，貓打開了關著的櫥櫃。

examples.en: We will somehow find a way to fix the kite.
examples.zh: 我們總會想辦法修好風箏。

examples.en: The ball somehow rolled back to the start.
examples.zh: 球不知怎麼又滾回了起點。

entries.definition: 不知怎麼地；以某種方式；不知何故。

explains.en: In a way that is not known or easy to explain is described by this adverb. A lost key may unexpectedly turn up. The person does not know how it happened.
It can also mean by some method or with effort. A team may find a way to finish before the deadline, even if the method is unclear. They keep working toward the goal.
Clearly tells exactly how something happened, while the adverb leaves the method unknown. A story may keep the details secret. Context gives the feeling.

examples.en: Let us visit the museum sometime next month.
examples.zh: 我們下個月找一天去參觀博物館吧。

examples.en: She lived in that town sometime during the 1990s.
examples.zh: 她在 1990 年代某個時候住在那座鎮上。

examples.en: I will call you sometime after lunch.
examples.zh: 我會在午餐後某個時候打給你。

explains.en: At an unknown time in the future or past is described by this adverb. A person may call a friend one day next week. The exact day is not chosen.
It can also mean at one point in a period. A bird may visit the garden at some point during the morning. The visit may be brief.
On some occasions means more than once, while this word means at one particular but uncertain time. Check the spelling. The sentence tells the time period.

examples.en: Her sorrow eased when friends came to visit.
examples.zh: 朋友來探望後，她的悲傷減輕了一些。

examples.en: The song was filled with sorrow.
examples.zh: 這首歌充滿悲傷。

examples.en: He felt sorrow when the old tree was cut down.
examples.zh: 老樹被砍倒時，他感到悲傷。

explains.en: A deep feeling of sadness is called this. Someone may feel it after losing a loved one. Friends can offer comfort.
A story may describe this emotion after a difficult event. The character may cry or sit quietly. People express feelings in different ways.
Joy is a happy feeling, while this noun describes deep sadness. Talking to someone trusted may help. Give people time to grieve.

examples.en: We ate spaghetti with tomato sauce for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐吃了番茄醬義大利麵。

examples.en: She twirled the spaghetti around her fork.
examples.zh: 她把義大利麵捲在叉子上。

examples.en: The pot was large enough to cook spaghetti.
examples.zh: 這個鍋子夠大，可以煮義大利麵。

entries.definition: 義大利麵；細長義大利麵條

explains.en: A long, thin pasta is called this. It is usually boiled and served with a sauce. Children may twirl it around a fork.
The word can also refer to a meal made with this pasta. Tomato or cheese sauce may be added. Cook it until tender.
Noodles can have many shapes, while this pasta is long and round. It is popular in many countries. Follow the package directions when cooking.

examples.en: Please give a specific example from the story.
examples.zh: 請提供故事中的一個具體例子。

examples.en: We need a specific time for the meeting.
examples.zh: 我們需要確定會議的時間。

examples.en: The doctor asked about a specific symptom.
examples.zh: 醫生詢問了一個特定的症狀。

entries.definition: 特定的；明確的；具體的；特殊的。

explains.en: A particular detail or item rather than something general can be described this way. A student may need one particular book for class. The title tells which one.
Clear directions give exact details. A map may show the exact road to take. Details reduce confusion.
General describes a wide group, while this adjective points to one particular thing. A question may ask for one example. Give the exact answer requested.

examples.en: The cook added a spice to the soup.
examples.zh: 廚師在湯裡加了一種香料。

examples.en: Cinnamon is a warm spice used in baking.
examples.zh: 肉桂是一種烘焙常用的香料。

examples.en: This spice made the curry taste hotter.
examples.zh: 這種香料讓咖哩吃起來更辣。

explains.en: A dried plant part added to food for flavor is called this. Cinnamon comes from tree bark. A little can change a dish's taste.
Some kinds add heat, while others give a sweet smell. Store them in closed containers. Use a small amount first.
Salt is a mineral seasoning, while this ingredient often comes from seeds, roots, or bark. Herbs come from leafy parts. Cooking uses both.

examples.en: She spilled juice on the tablecloth.
examples.zh: 她把果汁灑在桌布上。

examples.en: The bag spilled its toys across the floor.
examples.zh: 袋子裡的玩具散落一地。

examples.en: He spilled the surprise before the party.
examples.zh: 派對前他不小心說漏了驚喜。

entries.definition: （動）灑出；溢出；洩漏；（名）灑出物；溢出

explains.en: To let liquid or small objects fall out by accident is to do this. A cup may tip over and spread water. Wipe the floor to keep it safe.
The word can also mean revealing information that was meant to stay private. Someone may tell a secret. Think before sharing personal details.
Pour carefully to keep liquid inside a container. An accident may still happen. Clean it up promptly.

examples.en: The toy began to spin on the floor.
examples.zh: 玩具開始在地板上旋轉。

examples.en: She spun around when she heard her name.
examples.zh: 聽見自己的名字時，她轉過身來。

examples.en: The dancer spun gracefully across the stage.
examples.zh: 舞者優雅地在舞台上旋轉。

entries.definition: （動）旋轉；紡紗；眩暈；（名）旋轉；自轉；觀點說法

explains.en: To turn around a central point is to do this. A top can turn quickly on a table. It may slow down and stop.
A person can also turn around while dancing. A figure skater may do this on the ice. Practice helps with balance.
Slide means move across a surface, while this verb describes turning. A wheel turns around its center. The word can have other meanings in a sentence.

examples.en: The cook added spinach to the pasta sauce.
examples.zh: 廚師把菠菜加進義大利麵醬裡。

examples.en: We washed fresh spinach for the salad.
examples.zh: 我們把新鮮菠菜洗好做沙拉。

examples.en: She put spinach and cheese in the omelet.
examples.zh: 她在蛋捲裡放了菠菜和起司。

explains.en: A leafy green vegetable is used in salads, soups, and other foods. It has soft leaves and a mild taste. Wash it before eating.
It can be eaten raw or cooked. Some people add it to eggs or pasta. Cooking makes the leaves shrink in size.
Lettuce is often crisp and used in salads, while this vegetable can be cooked in many ways. Both are green leafy plants. They add nutrients to meals.

examples.en: Do not spit on the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 不要在人行道上吐口水。

examples.en: The horse spit out the bitter medicine.
examples.zh: 馬把苦藥吐了出來。

examples.en: She spit out the watermelon seeds.
examples.zh: 她把西瓜籽吐了出來。

explains.en: To force saliva or another liquid out of the mouth is to do this. It is rude in public and can spread germs. Use a tissue instead.
A small seed or pit can be pushed out of the mouth too. Some people do this after eating fruit. Dispose of it properly.
Swallow means move food down the throat, while this verb describes sending it out. It can also be used for a sharp metal point. Context matters.

examples.en: He broke the toy out of spite.
examples.zh: 他出於惡意把玩具弄壞了。

examples.en: In spite of the rain, the game continued.
examples.zh: 儘管下雨，比賽仍繼續進行。

examples.en: She helped her friend despite the argument, not out of spite.
examples.zh: 即使吵過架，她仍幫助朋友，而不是出於惡意。

entries.definition: 惡意；怨恨；（in spite of）儘管

explains.en: A wish to upset or hurt someone is called this feeling. Acting from it can damage friendships. Kind words are a better choice.
The phrase 'even though' means that an action happened despite a difficulty. A person may go for a walk during light rain. This use is different from the feeling of wanting to hurt someone.
Kindness tries to help, while this feeling aims to cause hurt. People can choose to solve problems peacefully. The phrase may also show contrast.

examples.en: A splash of paint landed on the paper.
examples.zh: 一點顏料濺到了紙上。

examples.en: The children splashed in the shallow pool.
examples.zh: 孩子們在淺水池裡潑水玩。

examples.en: The fish made a splash near the lily pads.
examples.zh: 魚在睡蓮葉附近濺起水花。

entries.definition: （名）潑濺聲；濺起的水花；醒目效果；（動）濺；潑；引起轟動

explains.en: A small amount of liquid that lands on a surface is called this. A child may make one by kicking water. It can wet nearby clothes.
As a verb, it means to make liquid scatter with a quick movement. A fish may do this in a pond. The water makes a sound.
A drip is one small drop, while this may send several drops outward. Step carefully near puddles. The word can also describe a bold design.

examples.en: The hot car could spoil the chocolate.
examples.zh: 炎熱的車內環境可能會讓巧克力變質。

examples.en: Do not spoil the surprise by telling everyone.
examples.zh: 不要把驚喜告訴所有人，破壞它的效果。

examples.en: The milk spoiled after it was left outside.
examples.zh: 牛奶放在外面後變質了。

entries.definition: 使變質；寵壞；破壞驚喜；掠奪。

explains.en: To make food no longer good to eat is to do this. Warm weather can cause milk to go bad. Keep food cold when needed.
A person can also ruin a plan or surprise. Telling the ending of a movie may upset someone. Ask before sharing details.
Preserve means keep something good, while this verb can mean making it bad. Check how food smells and looks. Ask an adult if unsure.

examples.en: She used a spray bottle to water the seedlings.
examples.zh: 她用噴霧瓶替幼苗澆水。

examples.en: The gardener sprayed the leaves with water.
examples.zh: 園丁把水噴在葉子上。

examples.en: A fine spray covered the windshield.
examples.zh: 細小的水霧覆蓋了擋風玻璃。

explains.en: A liquid sent out in tiny drops is called this. A bottle can spread water over plants. The drops cover a wide area.
As a verb, it means to send out a stream of small drops. A skunk may release a strong-smelling liquid for defense. Stay far away.
A stream pours in one line, while this comes out as many tiny droplets. Use cleaning products as directed. Avoid breathing mist.

examples.en: The spy sent a coded message from the city.
examples.zh: 間諜從城市裡送出一封密碼訊息。

examples.en: In the game, we pretended to spy on the pirates.
examples.zh: 遊戲中，我們假裝暗中監視海盜。

examples.en: A spy watched the meeting from a hidden room.
examples.zh: 間諜在一間隱蔽的房間裡監視會議。

entries.definition: （名）間諜；偵察者；（動）暗中監視；發現

explains.en: A person who secretly gathers information about another group is called this. The job can be dangerous. Stories often include secret codes.
As a verb, it means to watch someone secretly. This can invade privacy in real life. In a game, people may pretend to do it.
A detective may solve a public crime, while this person hides their identity to learn secrets. Fiction often makes it exciting. Respect people's privacy.

examples.en: Squeeze the orange to get its juice.
examples.zh: 把柳橙擠一擠，取出果汁。

examples.en: He squeezed through the narrow opening.
examples.zh: 他擠過狹窄的開口。

examples.en: The child squeezed the soft ball in both hands.
examples.zh: 孩子用雙手擠壓柔軟的球。

entries.definition: 擠壓；捏；榨汁；塞進；（名）擠壓；緊急困境

explains.en: To press something firmly between the hands or against another surface is to do this. A person may press a sponge to remove water. It becomes smaller.
People can also get through a tight space with care. A cat may fit between two chairs. Move slowly to avoid getting stuck.
Release means let go, while this verb means press tightly. Pressing fruit can get its juice out. Do not press fragile objects too hard.

examples.en: A squirrel buried an acorn under the tree.
examples.zh: 一隻松鼠把橡實埋在樹下。

examples.en: The squirrel leaped from one branch to another.
examples.zh: 松鼠從一根樹枝跳到另一根。

examples.en: A gray squirrel sat on the fence.
examples.zh: 一隻灰松鼠坐在圍欄上。

entries.definition: 松鼠；松鼠科動物；（動）儲藏、囤積。

explains.en: A small animal with a bushy tail climbs trees and gathers nuts. It can leap from branch to branch. Some live in parks.
It may hide food in the ground for later. A good sense of smell helps find the buried nuts. Birds and other animals may share its habitat.
A chipmunk has stripes on its back, while this animal often has a larger bushy tail. Both can gather seeds. Watch wildlife quietly.

examples.en: The bridge remained stable during the strong wind.
examples.zh: 這座橋在強風中仍然穩固。

examples.en: A stable routine helped the puppy feel safe.
examples.zh: 穩定的生活作息讓小狗感到安心。

examples.en: The table is stable on the level floor.
examples.zh: 桌子在平坦的地板上很穩。

entries.definition: 穩定的；牢固的；安定的；（名）馬廄

explains.en: Something that stays firm and does not change suddenly can be described this way. A steady table does not wobble. Its legs are strong.
A person may feel calm and balanced even during a busy day. Friends can offer support. Taking breaks may help.
Unstable means likely to move or change, while this adjective suggests steadiness. A ladder should be secure before someone climbs. Check it first.

examples.en: Taipei Dome is a modern indoor stadium for baseball and concerts.
examples.zh: 台北大巨蛋是用於棒球賽與演唱會的現代室內體育館。

examples.en: Over fifty thousand passionate fans packed into the Olympic stadium.
examples.zh: 超過五萬名熱血球迷湧入並坐滿了奧運體育場。

examples.en: Security guards checked bags at every gate entrance of the football stadium.
examples.zh: 保全人員在足球體育場的各個大門出入口仔細查驗隨身包包。

examples.en: Thousands of fans filled the Taipei Dome stadium for the international friendly.
examples.zh: 數萬名熱血球迷湧入台北大巨蛋觀看精彩的國際棒球邀請賽。

examples.en: The newly renovated baseball stadium features upgraded seating, lighting, and locker rooms.
examples.zh: 全新翻修竣工的棒球場全面升級了觀眾看台座椅、球場夜間照明以及球員專屬休息室。

examples.en: The pop singer announced two sold-out concerts at the national sports stadium.
examples.zh: 流行樂壇天后正式對外公布，將在國家體育場連開兩場門票秒殺一空的萬人大型巡迴演唱會。

entries.definition: 體育場；巨蛋體育館；巨蛋體育場；大型體育館

explains.en: A large sports building with seats around a field is called this. Crowds watch games there. Players may use the central field.
Some have roofs, while others are open to the sky. They can host concerts and ceremonies too. Follow signs to find your seat.
A gym is usually smaller and indoors, while this venue can hold many people. Parking and entrances may be busy during events. Arrive early.

examples.en: The hospital staff welcomed the new doctor.
examples.zh: 醫院員工歡迎新醫生。

examples.en: The hotel staff helped us find our room.
examples.zh: 飯店員工幫我們找到房間。

examples.en: A staff member answered the phone.
examples.zh: 一位工作人員接了電話。

entries.definition: （名）全體員工；手杖；五線譜；（動）配置人員

explains.en: The people who work for a business or organization are called this group. A school has teachers and office workers. They help it run each day.
The word can also mean a long stick carried by a person. A walking stick may support someone on a trail. The plural and context show the meaning.
A customer visits a business, while this group works there. Each member may have a different task. Respectful communication helps everyone.

examples.en: The crackers tasted stale after sitting open all night.
examples.zh: 餅乾打開放了一整晚後，吃起來不新鮮了。

examples.en: We opened a window to let out the stale air.
examples.zh: 我們打開窗戶讓悶舊的空氣散出去。

examples.en: The stale bread was too hard for the sandwich.
examples.zh: 不新鮮的麵包太硬了，不適合做三明治。

entries.definition: 不新鮮的；走味的；陳腐的；沉悶的

explains.en: Food that is no longer fresh and has become dry or less tasty can be described this way. Bread may feel hard after a few days. Store it well.
Air in a closed room can feel old and unpleasant. Opening a window may bring fresh air inside. Check with an adult first.
Fresh bread is soft, while this adjective describes bread that has lost its freshness. The word can also describe an old smell. Context matters.

examples.en: The child stared at the aquarium full of fish.
examples.zh: 孩子凝視著魚群滿滿的水族箱。

examples.en: Do not stare at people on the bus.
examples.zh: 不要在公車上盯著別人看。

examples.en: He stared at the map while planning the route.
examples.zh: 規劃路線時，他盯著地圖看。

explains.en: To look at something for a long time without looking away is to do this. People may watch a bright display. Remember to blink.
Looking at someone for a long time can make them uncomfortable. It is polite to look away sometimes. Ask before taking a photo.
Glance means look quickly, while this verb describes a long look. A person may be surprised by something unusual. Context explains why they keep looking.

examples.en: The rescued dog was weak because it had begun to starve.
examples.zh: 獲救的狗因為開始挨餓而很虛弱。

examples.en: Without enough food, some families began to starve.
examples.zh: 缺乏足夠食物時，有些家庭開始挨餓。

examples.en: I feel like I could starve after soccer practice.
examples.zh: 足球練習後，我覺得自己快餓扁了。

explains.en: To suffer because there is not enough food is to do this. It is a serious condition. People and animals need regular meals.
A person may exaggerate by saying they have no food when they are very hungry. This is informal speech. The literal meaning is more severe.
Hunger is a normal feeling before eating, while this verb can describe going without enough food for a long time. Communities help provide meals. Tell an adult if someone needs food.

examples.en: Holding the heavy bronze Golden Horse statue, the director delivered a tearful speech.
examples.zh: 雙手緊握沉甸甸的青銅金馬獎座，新銳導演在領獎台上發表了真情流露、感人肺腑的得獎感言。

examples.en: Tourists gathered to take commemorative photographs in front of the historic bronze statue downtown.
examples.zh: 來自世界各地的觀光客紛紛駐足於市中心歷史悠久的青銅偉人雕像前合影留念。

examples.en: Winning the iconic golden statue represents the pinnacle of recognition in the cinematic world.
examples.zh: 能夠在國際影壇殿堂捧起這尊標誌性的鍍金榮耀小金人獎座，象徵著電影人終其一生的最高肯定。

explains.en: A figure of a person or animal made from stone, metal, or another material is called this. It may stand in a park. People can admire the artwork.
Some are built to remember an important person or event. Plaques may explain their history. Visitors should not climb on them.
A painting is flat, while this artwork has shape on all sides. It may be small or very large. Sculptors create it by shaping material.

examples.en: Keep a steady pace during the long walk.
examples.zh: 長途步行時保持穩定的步伐。

examples.en: The boat moved at a steady speed.
examples.zh: 船以穩定的速度前進。

examples.en: She held the cup with a steady hand.
examples.zh: 她用穩定的手拿著杯子。

entries.definition: （形）穩定的；平穩的；堅定的；（動）使穩定；（副）穩穩地

explains.en: A speed or level that does not change much can be described this way. A smooth pace helps a runner continue. They do not start too fast.
A person may keep their hands firm while drawing a straight line. A controlled hand helps with careful work. Practice improves control.
