Sudden changes make a movement uneven, while this adjective suggests smooth and even motion. Rain can fall at an even rate. The context can describe behavior too.

examples.en: Someone tried to steal the bicycle from the yard.
examples.zh: 有人試圖從院子裡偷走腳踏車。

examples.en: The mouse stole a crumb from the table.
examples.zh: 老鼠從桌上偷走了一小塊麵包屑。

examples.en: She stole quietly into the room to surprise her brother.
examples.zh: 她悄悄溜進房間，想給弟弟驚喜。

entries.definition: 偷；竊取；剽竊；（口語）便宜貨

explains.en: To take something that belongs to someone else without permission is to do this. It is wrong and can hurt others. Return what was taken and tell an adult.
The word can also mean moving quietly so others do not notice. A cat may move silently toward a toy. The meaning depends on the situation.
Borrowing means getting permission and returning an item, while this verb means taking it without asking. Respect people's belongings. If you find something, turn it in.

examples.en: Steam the pork buns for ten minutes before serving.
examples.zh: 上桌前將肉包放進蒸籠蒸十分鐘。

examples.en: Clouds of hot steam rose from the bamboo dumpling baskets.
examples.zh: 陣陣滾燙的蒸氣從竹製蒸籠中裊裊升起。

examples.en: Steamed vegetables retain more natural vitamins and nutrients than boiled ones.
examples.zh: 清蒸蔬菜比水煮蔬菜保留了更多天然維生素與營養。

examples.en: Master chefs steam freshly caught sea bass with ginger slices and scallions.
examples.zh: 總鋪師將當天海港直送的現撈現流七星鱸魚搭配薑絲與蔥段以大火清蒸提鮮。

examples.en: Steam rising from the bamboo baskets signaled that the morning buns were ready.
examples.zh: 竹編蒸籠上方升騰而起的裊裊白霧蒸氣，意味著熱騰騰的現蒸手工包子已熟透出爐。

examples.en: Health-conscious diners prefer to steam fresh seasonal vegetables to retain nutrients.
examples.zh: 注重健康養生的饕客更偏好以清蒸手法烹調當季時蔬，以完整保留天然維生素營養。

entries.definition: 蒸；水蒸氣；熱氣；清蒸；蒸熟；蒸氣

explains.en: The hot vapor that rises from boiling water is called this. It can be seen above a kettle. Keep your face away because it can burn.
A train may use pressure from heated water to move. The vapor pushes parts of the engine. Modern trains use other power too.
Smoke comes from burning material, while this vapor comes from heated water. It often disappears into the air. Hot surfaces can be dangerous.

examples.en: Let the herbal tea steep for five minutes before removing the bag.
examples.zh: 讓草本花草茶包浸泡五分鐘後再取出茶包享用。

examples.en: The hiking group faced a steep rocky incline near the mountain summit.
examples.zh: 登山健行隊伍在接近百岳主峰峰頂處面臨了一段陡峭險峻的碎石攀登路段。

examples.en: First-time buyers struggled with a steep increase in downtown property prices.
examples.zh: 首購青年家庭在面對市中心蛋黃區房價急遽攀升的大漲趨勢時倍感吃力。

examples.en: Steep the high-mountain oolong leaves for 45 seconds during the first infusion.
examples.zh: 第一泡高山烏龍茶原葉建議浸泡萃取約四十五秒鐘即可迅速出湯出水。

examples.en: Don't steep the green tea leaves for too long, or the brew will turn unpleasantly bitter.
examples.zh: 沖泡鮮嫩綠茶時切忌浸泡時間過久，否則茶湯容易析出過多單寧而變得苦澀難嚥。

examples.en: We had to climb a steep, rocky mountain trail to reach the historic hilltop temple.
examples.zh: 我們必須沿著一條陡峭崎嶇的岩石山間小徑手腳並用攀爬，才能抵達山頂的古老寺廟。

entries.definition: 浸泡（茶包）；陡峭的；急遽的；浸泡萃取茶湯

explains.en: A hill or slope that rises sharply can be described this way. It may be hard to climb. Walk carefully on a sharply rising path.
A cup of tea can sit in hot water so its flavor comes out. This action is also described by the same adjective as a verb. The context shows the meaning.
A gentle hill is easy to walk up, while this one rises quickly over a short distance. Roads may have warning signs. Use care going down too.

examples.en: The sticky candy stuck to my fingers.
examples.zh: 黏黏的糖果黏在我的手指上。

examples.en: We used a sticky note to mark the page.
examples.zh: 我們用便利貼標記頁面。

examples.en: The table felt sticky after the juice spilled.
examples.zh: 果汁灑出來後，桌子摸起來黏黏的。

entries.definition: 黏的；黏稠的；悶熱潮濕的；難處理的。

explains.en: Something that feels like it may cling to other things can be described this way. Honey on a spoon feels this way. Wash your hands afterward.
A label or note can stay in place because it has a surface that clings. Children use them for crafts. Keep them off painted walls.
Dry surfaces do not cling to fingers, while this texture may. A spill of syrup can make a table this way. Clean it promptly.

examples.en: The stiff cardboard kept the picture flat.
examples.zh: 硬挺的紙板讓圖片保持平整。

examples.en: My legs felt stiff after the long walk.
examples.zh: 長途步行後，我的腿感到僵硬。

examples.en: He wore a stiff collar with his formal shirt.
examples.zh: 他穿正式襯衫時戴著硬挺的衣領。

entries.definition: 僵硬的；堅硬的；拘謹的；（副）極其

explains.en: Something that is hard to bend or move can be described this way. A new cardboard box may resist bending. A flexible one folds more easily.
A person's muscles may feel tight after exercise. Gentle stretching can help. Stop if it hurts.
Flexible things bend easily, while this adjective suggests limited movement. A board can be firm. The word can also describe formal behavior.

examples.en: A bee can sting someone who gets too close.
examples.zh: 有人靠得太近時，蜜蜂可能會螫人。

examples.en: The sting from the nettle made her skin itch.
examples.zh: 蕁麻的刺痛讓她的皮膚發癢。

examples.en: Cold wind can sting our cheeks.
examples.zh: 冷風吹在臉頰上會讓人感到刺痛。

explains.en: To cause a sharp, burning pain with a bite or a sharp object is to do this. A bee may hurt someone this way. Tell an adult if it happens.
The noun can mean the sudden pain itself. A small cut may cause it. Clean the area and seek help if needed.
A dull ache lasts longer, while this sensation can be sharp and brief. Insects such as bees can cause it. Some plants may also irritate skin.

examples.en: Stir the hot soup gently with a wooden spoon.
examples.zh: 用木匙輕輕攪拌熱湯。

examples.en: Stir two spoonfuls of sugar into your black coffee.
examples.zh: 在黑咖啡中拌入兩匙砂糖。

examples.en: The exciting news stirred great excitement among the young students.
examples.zh: 這個令人振奮的消息在年輕學生之間激起了熱烈迴響。

explains.en: To move a liquid or mixture around with a spoon is to do this. A cook may mix soup in a pot. Move the spoon slowly to avoid splashing.
The verb can also mean to make someone feel an emotion. A kind story may move people deeply. This use is figurative.
Pouring adds liquid, while this action mixes what is already in a bowl or pot. A spoon is a common tool. The sentence may show another meaning.

examples.en: She added one stitch to close the tear.
examples.zh: 她縫了一針，把裂口補起來。

examples.en: Grandpa stitched the patch onto his jacket.
examples.zh: 爺爺把補丁縫在外套上。

examples.en: The seam needed another stitch.
examples.zh: 這道縫線還需要再縫一針。

entries.definition: （名）一針；縫線；縫合處；（動）縫；縫合

explains.en: A single loop of thread made with a needle is called this. Many together can join pieces of cloth. Sewing takes practice.
The verb means to sew fabric with a needle and thread. A person can fix a small tear. Keep sharp tools away from young children.
Glue sticks surfaces together without thread, while this method uses small loops through fabric. A line of them can make a seam. Careful work lasts longer.

examples.en: My stomach growled before lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐前，我的肚子咕嚕叫。

examples.en: The doctor listened to her stomach.
examples.zh: 醫生聽了她的腹部。

examples.en: A big meal made his stomach feel full.
examples.zh: 一頓大餐讓他覺得肚子很飽。

explains.en: A body part that receives food and helps break it down is called this. It is below the chest. It can feel full after a meal.
People may say their belly hurts when they have a tummy ache. Eating too quickly can sometimes cause discomfort. Tell an adult if pain continues.
The lungs help with breathing, while this organ helps digest food. It works with other body parts. A balanced meal supports good health.

examples.en: She sat on a wooden stool to reach the counter.
examples.zh: 她坐在木凳上，好拿到櫃檯上的東西。

examples.en: The doctor asked about the child’s stool.
examples.zh: 醫生詢問孩子的排便情況。

examples.en: He carried the stool into the kitchen.
examples.zh: 他把凳子搬進廚房。

explains.en: A simple seat without a back or arms is called this. It may be made of wood or metal. Some are used at a counter.
The word can also mean solid waste passed from the body. A doctor may ask about it when checking someone's health. This use is more formal.
A chair usually has a back, while this seat may not. The same spelling has a body-related meaning. The sentence makes the difference clear.

examples.en: The stormy sea made the boat rock.
examples.zh: 暴風雨中的海面讓船搖晃。

examples.en: We stayed home on the stormy night.
examples.zh: 暴風雨的夜晚，我們待在家裡。

examples.en: They had a stormy argument but later made peace.
examples.zh: 他們激烈地爭吵，但後來和好了。

entries.definition: 暴風雨的；風雨交加的；激烈的

explains.en: Weather with strong wind, rain, thunder, or snow can be described this way. People may stay indoors during a storm. Watch weather warnings.
A person's mood or a discussion can also be described this way when there is anger or disagreement. Talking calmly may help. The meaning is figurative.
Calm weather has little wind, while this adjective points to rough conditions. A storm can make travel unsafe. Prepare before going out.

examples.en: The integrated canister stove boils half a liter of glacial stream water in ninety seconds in howling winds.
examples.zh: 搭載熱交換聚能環的一體式防風攻頂爐，在狂風中僅需九十秒即可將冰涼溪水煮至沸騰。

examples.en: Always check the rubber O-ring seal on your backpacking stove before screwing in the gas canister.
examples.zh: 在將高山瓦斯罐旋入登山爐頭前，請務必先確認爐具底部的橡膠防漏迫緊環完整無缺。

examples.en: Micro-regulator stoves maintain a steady flame output even when temperatures dip near freezing.
examples.zh: 搭載微調穩壓結構的高山瓦斯爐，即便在氣溫逼近冰點的低溫環境下依然能維持穩定火力。

entries.definition: 快速防風一體式高山攻頂爐具；爐子

explains.en: A kitchen appliance with burners used for cooking is called this. A pot sits on top of a burner. Adults should supervise children near it.
Some versions also include an enclosed space for baking. The heat can come from gas or electricity. Turn it off after cooking.
A microwave heats food in a different way, while this appliance often uses direct heat from burners. Both are useful in kitchens. Follow safety directions.

examples.en: A good marketing strategy attracts more customers.
examples.zh: 良好的行銷策略能吸引更多顧客。

examples.en: We need a clear strategy to win the championship match.
examples.zh: 我們需要明確的策略才能贏得冠軍賽。

examples.en: The company changed its pricing strategy to compete better.
examples.zh: 該公司改變了定價策略以提升競爭力。

explains.en: A plan for reaching a goal or solving a problem is called this. A team may decide how to share the ball. Each player has a role.
A student can choose steps for studying a difficult subject. Making a schedule may help. Trying a different approach is okay if the first one fails.
A random action has no plan, while this noun describes deliberate steps. Games often require one. Planning ahead can improve results.

examples.en: Drink your iced boba tea with a reusable stainless steel straw.
examples.zh: 用環保不鏽鋼吸管享用你的冰珍珠奶茶。

examples.en: The scarecrow standing in the paddy field was stuffed with dry straw.
examples.zh: 稻田裡站立的稻草人內部塞滿了乾燥的稻草。

examples.en: Sea turtle conservation campaigns urged a worldwide ban on single-use plastic straws.
examples.zh: 海龜保育倡議促使全球各國紛紛禁用一次性塑膠吸管。

explains.en: A thin tube used for drinking is called this. It can be made of paper, metal, or plastic. Some are reusable.
The dry stalks left after grain is collected are also called this. Farmers use them for animal bedding. The context shows which meaning is meant.
A cup lets someone drink directly, while this tube helps guide liquid to the mouth. The same word names a plant material. Look at the sentence.

examples.en: The strength of the bridge was tested by engineers.
examples.zh: 工程師測試了橋梁的強度。

examples.en: She showed strength by asking for help.
examples.zh: 她勇於求助，展現了堅強。

examples.en: Training increased his leg strength.
examples.zh: 訓練增強了他的腿部力量。

entries.definition: 力量；力氣；優勢；強度；長處

explains.en: The ability to lift, move, or resist force is called this. Muscles can build it through exercise. Rest is important too.
A person may stay emotionally strong when facing a difficult time. Friends and family can help. Asking for support is a sign of courage.
Weakness is the lack of power, while this noun describes physical or personal ability. A bridge needs enough of it to hold weight. The context may be physical or emotional.

examples.en: She cut a strip of blue paper for the craft.
examples.zh: 她剪下一條藍色紙帶做手工。

examples.en: They stripped the old paint from the door.
examples.zh: 他們刮掉了門上的舊漆。

examples.en: A strip of cloth was tied around the gift.
examples.zh: 一條布帶綁在禮物上。

entries.definition: （名）長條；狹長地帶；漫畫；（動）剝去；拆除；脫衣。

explains.en: A long, narrow piece cut or torn from something is called this. A long, narrow piece of paper can be used as a bookmark. It is thin and flat.
As a verb, it can mean to remove a covering. A person may take paint off an old chair. Use safe products with adult help.
A wide sheet covers more space than this narrow piece. The word can also mean removing clothes or layers. Context tells the use.

examples.en: The steel frame gives the skyscraper incredible strength and flexibility.
examples.zh: 鋼骨骨架賦予了這棟超高層摩天大樓卓越的強度與抗震韌性。

examples.en: The ancient wooden structure survived numerous major earthquakes over five centuries.
examples.zh: 這座歷經五個世紀風雨的古老木造建築結構，奇蹟般挺過了無數次大地震的考驗。

examples.en: An essay needs a logical grammatical structure with introduction, body, and conclusion.
examples.zh: 一篇嚴謹的論說文需要具備合乎邏輯的段落組織結構，包含引言、正文與結論。

entries.definition: 建築結構；建築物；構造；組織

explains.en: The way parts of something are arranged to make a whole is called this. A building has walls, floors, and a roof. Each part supports the others.
An organized piece of writing has sections in a clear order. An introduction comes before the main points. Planning helps readers follow it.
A loose pile has no clear arrangement, while this noun describes an organized form. Bridges and stories both have one. The parts work together.

examples.en: Don't be stubborn; listen to helpful advice from experienced elders.
examples.zh: 別那麼固執倔強，多聽聽經驗豐富長輩的有益忠告吧。

examples.en: He was too stubborn to ask for directions even after wandering lost for an hour.
examples.zh: 儘管已經迷路徘徊晃盪了一整個小時，他依然死要面子硬是不肯開口問路。

examples.en: The mechanic used penetrating oil to loosen the stubborn, rusted wheel bolt.
examples.zh: 汽車維修技師噴灑了強力除鏽潤滑劑，才終於將頑固卡死生鏽的輪胎螺栓轉鬆。

entries.definition: 固執的；倔強的；難以對付的

explains.en: A person who refuses to change their mind or do what others ask can be described this way. They may keep insisting on one choice. Listening can help.
An animal may resist being led. Gentle patience often works better than force. Treat animals kindly.
Flexible people can change their plans, while this adjective suggests someone is unwilling to change. Staying firm can sometimes be helpful. It depends on the situation.

examples.en: Renting a cozy studio apartment suits single young professionals.
examples.zh: 租一間溫馨的獨立套房非常適合單身青年上班族。

examples.en: The painter set up her art easel inside a naturally lit rooftop studio.
examples.zh: 畫家在採光自然充沛的頂樓工作室架起了繪畫畫架。

examples.en: The band spent three days in the sound recording studio laying down vocals.
examples.zh: 樂團在專業錄音室待了三天專心錄製主唱人聲。

examples.en: The creator converted an extra bedroom into a fully soundproof recording studio.
examples.zh: 該創作者將家中多餘的客房改建為鋪滿專業吸音棉的專業隔音錄音室工作室。

examples.en: The film studio announced that production on the superhero sequel will begin next month.
examples.zh: 該大型電影製片廠宣布，這部超級英雄系列續集的實地拍攝作業將於下個月正式啟動。

examples.en: He rents a compact sunny studio apartment located near the central subway station.
examples.zh: 他在市中心捷運站旁租了一間小巧精緻、採光極佳的單間獨立套房。

entries.definition: 獨立套房；攝影棚；工作室；錄音室

explains.en: A room or building where artists make work is called this. A painter may keep brushes and canvases there. Good light is useful.
A place for recording music or making television programs can also have this name. It contains special equipment. The meaning depends on the work.
An office is used for many tasks, while this space is designed for art, recording, or broadcast work. Different fields have different setups. Tools are chosen for the activity.

examples.en: Please put your stuff away before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐前請把你的東西收好。

examples.en: He stuffed the pillow with soft cotton.
examples.zh: 他把柔軟的棉花塞進枕頭裡。

examples.en: We packed our stuff into two bags.
examples.zh: 我們把行李裝進兩個袋子裡。

entries.definition: （名）東西；物品；事情；（動）塞滿；填塞

explains.en: A general informal word for things or belongings is this. A backpack can hold school supplies and other items. The word does not name them exactly.
As a verb, it means to fill something tightly. A person may put clothes into a suitcase. Pack carefully so it will close.
A specific noun names an exact item, while this word is casual and broad. People use it in conversation. Formal writing should be more precise.

examples.en: The lab tested the unknown substance.
examples.zh: 實驗室測試了那種未知物質。

examples.en: The speech had substance and clear examples.
examples.zh: 這場演講內容充實，也有清楚的例子。

examples.en: Water is a common substance found in nature.
examples.zh: 水是自然界中常見的物質。

entries.definition: 物質；材料；實質；重要內容

explains.en: A kind of material with its own properties is called this. Water is one example. Scientists study how different materials behave.
The word can also mean an important idea or quality. A speech containing useful ideas has helpful information. It is not just empty words.
A mixture contains several materials together, while this noun may name one material. It also has a figurative meaning. Context makes the sense clear.

examples.en: Subtract four from ten to find the answer.
examples.zh: 十減四，算出答案。

examples.en: We subtracted the cost of the coupon from the total.
examples.zh: 我們從總額中扣除了折價券的金額。

examples.en: The student learned to subtract using counters.
examples.zh: 學生學會用計數物做減法。

explains.en: To take one number away from another is to do this. If you start with eight apples and give away three, five remain. A minus sign shows the operation.
The verb can also mean remove an amount from a total. A discount lowers the price. Careful arithmetic helps find the result.
Add means combine amounts, while this operation reduces one amount by another. The answer is called the difference. Check the numbers carefully.

examples.en: Many families move to the quiet suburbs for larger living spaces.
examples.zh: 許多家庭為了更寬敞的居住空間而搬至寧靜的郊區。

examples.en: Commuting from the northern suburbs to downtown takes about forty minutes.
examples.zh: 從北部郊區通勤至市中心大約需要四十分鐘。

examples.en: Suburban neighborhoods often feature spacious private yards and quiet parks.
examples.zh: 郊區社區通常擁有寬敞的私人庭院與安靜的公園。

explains.en: A residential area outside or near a city is called this. Many people live there and travel into the city for work. Homes may have yards.
It can have schools, shops, and parks of its own. People may use buses or cars to get around. Each area has its own feel.
A downtown district is busy with offices and stores, while this area is often farther from the center. Some are quiet and some are crowded. The city map shows where they are.

examples.en: The baby sucked milk from the bottle.
examples.zh: 嬰兒從奶瓶裡吸奶。

examples.en: The vacuum sucked up the crumbs.
examples.zh: 吸塵器把碎屑吸了起來。

examples.en: The straw lets you suck up a drink.
examples.zh: 吸管讓你能吸飲料。

explains.en: To pull liquid or air into the mouth is to do this. A baby may drink milk from a bottle. A straw helps with a drink.
A machine can pull dust or water into itself. A vacuum cleaner does this. Empty it when it is full.
Blow sends air outward, while this verb describes drawing it inward. Some insects take nectar from flowers. The sentence gives the meaning.

examples.en: The plant suffered during the long dry spell.
examples.zh: 長時間乾旱期間，植物受到了影響。

examples.en: He suffered a small injury during the game.
examples.zh: 他在比賽中受了點小傷。

examples.en: Many people suffered when the storm damaged their homes.
examples.zh: 暴風雨破壞房屋時，許多人受了苦。

explains.en: To experience pain, sadness, or another difficulty is to do this. A person with a toothache may feel uncomfortable. They can tell an adult.
An animal may be affected by cold or lack of food. People should care for pets and wildlife. Help can make a difference.
Enjoy means feel pleasure, while this verb describes having a hard experience. Difficulties can be physical or emotional. Support from others may help.

examples.en: We had sufficient food for the whole picnic.
examples.zh: 我們準備了足夠的食物供整場野餐享用。

examples.en: A short break was sufficient to help her rest.
examples.zh: 短暫休息足以讓她恢復精神。

examples.en: The instructions provided sufficient detail.
examples.zh: 說明提供了足夠的細節。

explains.en: Enough for a particular need is described this way. A small amount of paint may cover one wall. More is needed for a whole room.
A person may need enough time to finish a project. Planning helps them avoid rushing. The amount depends on the task.
Too little is not enough, while this adjective means there is as much as needed. It does not always mean extra. Check what the task requires.

examples.en: The book discussed suicide in a careful and respectful way.
examples.zh: 這本書以謹慎且尊重的方式討論自殺。

examples.en: The counselor explained how the word suicide is used in the news.
examples.zh: 輔導老師解釋新聞中如何使用 suicide 這個詞。

examples.en: The family spoke gently about a relative’s suicide.
examples.zh: 家人以溫和的方式談起親人的自殺。

entries.definition: 自殺；自盡；自我毀滅（指蓄意結束自己的生命）

explains.en: This means a person deliberately causes their own death. The intention to end their life is part of the meaning. It does not describe a death caused by an accident.
Someone experiencing deep sadness or hopelessness may need support from trusted people. Friends and family can listen and help them find care. Everyone deserves compassion.

The word can also be used figuratively for an action that ruins someone’s chances or career. A character may make a choice that ends public support for them. In that use, it does not describe an actual death.

examples.en: The sum of six and nine is fifteen.
examples.zh: 六加九的總和是十五。

examples.en: She wrote a short sum of the book for class.
examples.zh: 她為課堂寫了一段書籍摘要。

examples.en: Add the numbers to find their sum.
examples.zh: 把數字相加以求出它們的總和。

entries.definition: （名）總和；總數；概要；（動）計算總和；概括。

explains.en: The result of adding numbers together is called this. Adding two and five gives seven. A plus sign shows the operation.
The word can also mean the main ideas of something. A brief account of a story tells what happened. The sentence shows the meaning.
A total can include several amounts, while this word may refer to an addition result or a brief account. The context makes it clear. Math and reading use it differently.

examples.en: Write a brief one-page summary of today's meeting decisions.
examples.zh: 撰寫一份一頁長度的今日會議決議摘要。

examples.en: In summary, regular aerobic exercise combined with sleep significantly boosts vitality.
examples.zh: 總結而言，維持規律有氧運動搭配充足優質睡眠，能大幅提升個人的身心活力。

examples.en: An executive summary gives busy company executives a rapid overview of the proposal.
examples.zh: 執行摘要能讓日程滿檔的企業高層決策者迅速掌握整份商業企劃書的精髓。

explains.en: A short account of the main points in a longer text is called this. It leaves out small details. Readers can understand the basic idea quickly.
A person may give one after a meeting. It helps everyone remember what was decided. Clear notes are useful.
A full story contains many details, while this brief version gives only the main ideas. It should be accurate. Use your own words.

examples.en: Hikers celebrated reaching the summit of Main Peak at sunrise.
examples.zh: 登山客在破曉日出時分慶祝成功登頂玉山主峰。

examples.en: World leaders met at the global economic summit to negotiate clean energy tariffs.
examples.zh: 各國領袖在世界經濟高峰會上會晤，商討綠能關稅協定。

examples.en: From the icy summit of Yushan, you can look down across breathtaking clouds.
examples.zh: 從寒風凜冽的玉山山頂俯瞰，映入眼簾的是壯麗震撼的翻騰雲海。

examples.en: Climbers reached the summit of Yushan (Jade Mountain) just before sunrise.
examples.zh: 登山隊員趕在破曉前夕順利登頂全台最高峰玉山主峰山頂。

examples.en: Standing at the windy mountain summit, hikers cheered as the sea of clouds glowed orange.
examples.zh: 佇立在強風呼嘯的高山峰頂，眼見腳下浩瀚翻滾的雲海在晨曦中鍍上一層金黃，登山客情不自禁熱血歡呼。

examples.en: World leaders assembled in Geneva for a high-stakes bilateral economic summit.
examples.zh: 各國領導人與代表團雲集日內瓦聯合國總部，共同出席一場關乎全球經濟未來走向的雙邊最高層級高峰會。

examples.en: After six grueling hours of uphill climbing, the mountaineering team summited Mt. Snow.
examples.zh: 歷經連續六個小時咬牙苦撐的高強度陡坡跋涉，登山隊全體隊員終於成功登頂雪山主峰。

examples.en: Frost coated the summit marker as the morning sun warmed the exhausted climbing expedition.
examples.zh: 當破曉晨曦漸漸溫暖疲憊不堪的登山隊伍時，高山三角點頂峰石碑上覆蓋著一層晶瑩剔透的白霜。

examples.en: World leaders gathered in Geneva for an emergency economic summit regarding global inflation.
examples.zh: 全球主要大國領袖齊聚瑞士日內瓦召開緊急經濟高峰會議，就抑制全球通膨危機展開磋商。

examples.en: Hikers celebrated under clear blue skies upon reaching the summit of Yushan Main Peak at 3,952 meters.
examples.zh: 歷經數小時長途跋涉，山友們在海拔 3,952 公尺的玉山主峰山頂峰頂迎著藍天歡呼登頂。

examples.en: The expedition team plans to summit Mount Nanhu at dawn before strong afternoon winds pick up.
examples.zh: 遠征隊計劃於黎明時分登頂南湖大山，搶在午後強陣風增強前完成攻頂。

examples.en: Heavy snowfall forced the climbing party to turn around just two hundred meters below the summit.
examples.zh: 猛烈的大雪迫使攀登隊伍在距離山頂僅剩兩百公尺處被迫下撤。

entries.definition: 山頂；最高峰；高峰會；登頂；百岳最高頂峰；高峰會議；百岳山巔峰頂；成功登頂

explains.en: The highest point of a mountain is called this. Climbers may reach it after a long hike. Weather can change quickly there.
A meeting between leaders of countries or organizations can also have this name. They discuss important issues. The meeting may last several days.
A hill's peak is its top, while this word can refer to a mountain top or a high-level meeting. Context reveals the meaning. Preparation is important for both.

examples.en: This fabric is superior to the thin one for winter coats.
examples.zh: 這種布料比薄布更適合做冬季外套。

examples.en: A superior officer checked the safety plan.
examples.zh: 一位上級主管檢查了安全計畫。

examples.en: The newer model proved superior in the test.
examples.zh: 較新的型號在測試中表現較佳。

entries.definition: 較好的；優越的；上級的；（名）上級

explains.en: Something better in quality or higher in rank than another can be described this way. A stronger rope may be safer for climbing. Compare items fairly.
The word can describe someone with a higher position at work. They may guide other workers. Treat people with respect regardless of rank.
Inferior means lower in quality or rank, while this adjective indicates a higher level. It is a comparison between things or positions. It does not mean someone is worth more as a person.

examples.en: Tall trees surround the quiet cabin.
examples.zh: 高大的樹木環繞著寧靜的小屋。

examples.en: The children surrounded the magician after the show.
examples.zh: 表演結束後，孩子們圍在魔術師身邊。

examples.en: A wall surrounds the old garden.
examples.zh: 一道牆圍住了老花園。

explains.en: To be on all sides of something is to do this. Trees may stand around a clearing. They make a ring of shade.
People can gather around a person or object. The audience may do this around a street performer. Leave room for others.
One object may be inside another, while this verb describes things all around it. A fence may go around a garden. The sentence shows the arrangement.

examples.en: Nighttime aerial thermal surveys census wild mammal herds without cutting footpaths through delicate habitats.
examples.zh: 夜間空中「熱成像生態普查」（Thermal Survey），無需砍伐開闢山路即可精確清點野生動物族群數量。

examples.en: Ecologists conducted an exhaustive vegetation survey across the high-altitude wetland plateau.
examples.zh: 生態學家針對高山濕地高原展開了地毯式植被調查，詳細記錄原生植物分佈。

examples.en: Annual bird surveys provide crucial statistical data on the wintering population of black-faced spoonbills.
examples.zh: 每年的跨國水鳥度冬普查，為全球黑面琵鷺族群數量評估提供了最關鍵的統計數據。

examples.en: Magnetotelluric resistivity surveys detect clay cap layers that seal boiling hydrothermal fluid below.
examples.zh: 進行 3D 大地電磁「電阻率普查測量」（Resistivity Survey），能精準找出封閉深層高溫熱水的緻密黏土帽層。

examples.en: A nationwide public opinion survey revealed overwhelming consumer support for renewable solar incentives.
examples.zh: 一項最新公佈的全國性民意調查報告顯示，超過八成民眾高度支持政府擴大綠色太陽能補助誘因政策。

examples.en: Land surveyors planted concrete boundary markers along the perimeter of the rural construction parcel.
examples.zh: 土地測量技師在鄉間建築用地的邊界轉折點上，牢牢釘入水泥測量界標與定位基樁。

examples.en: Cadastral land surveys require certified sub-centimeter GNSS measurements to update official property deeds.
examples.zh: 國家地籍「國土精確測繪」（Land Survey），需要經認證的亞公分級衛星數據以更新法定地籍圖資。

examples.en: The marketing department conducted an extensive customer satisfaction survey to identify service shortcomings.
examples.zh: 行銷企劃部針對全體會員展開大規模顧客滿意度問卷調查，全面檢視售後服務流程中的各項潛在盲點。

examples.en: Structural engineers surveyed the earthquake-damaged hillside highway to assess landslide structural risks.
examples.zh: 結構技師親赴遭遇強震侵襲的山區邊坡公路現場進行細部工程現勘測繪，詳盡評估土石邊坡坍方風險。

entries.definition: 空中無人機夜間野生動物族群熱像普查；調查；3D 大地電磁深層地底電阻率量測調查；地理資訊系統 (GIS 國土高精度測繪建檔)；測量

explains.en: A set of questions used to learn what people think is called this. A school may ask students which club they prefer. Their answers are counted.
The word can also mean looking carefully over an area. A farmer may inspect a field before planting. The meaning depends on the sentence.
An interview asks questions directly, while this may collect answers from many people at once. Maps can help examine land too. Context shows which use is intended.

examples.en: The survivor thanked the rescue team.
examples.zh: 倖存者感謝救援隊。

examples.en: A survivor of the storm shared her story.
examples.zh: 一位風暴倖存者分享了她的故事。

examples.en: The animal survivor was cared for at the wildlife center.
examples.zh: 這隻倖存的動物在野生動物中心受到照料。

explains.en: A person or animal that stays alive after danger or a difficult event is called this. A rescued hiker may recover at home. Others can help them.
The word can also describe someone who lives through a serious illness or accident. People may need time to heal. Their experiences differ.
A victim may be harmed by an event, while this person lives through it. Many people show courage afterward. Listen respectfully to their stories.

examples.en: The detective questioned the suspect about the missing bag.
examples.zh: 偵探詢問嫌疑人有關失蹤包包的事。

examples.en: I suspect the puppy hid my shoe.
examples.zh: 我猜是小狗把我的鞋藏起來了。

examples.en: The suspect spoke with a lawyer.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人和律師談了話。

entries.definition: （動）懷疑；猜想；（名）嫌疑人；（形）可疑的。

explains.en: A person thought to have possibly done something wrong is called this. Police may ask questions while they investigate. A suspicion is not proof.
As a verb, it means to think something may be true. A person may think the cat knocked over a cup. More facts can confirm it.
A witness saw what happened, while this person may only be thought to be involved. Everyone deserves fair treatment. The verb can also mean having a guess.

examples.en: Her suspicion grew when the door was open.
examples.zh: 門開著時，她的懷疑加深了。

examples.en: The detective had a suspicion about the broken window.
examples.zh: 偵探對破掉的窗戶起了疑心。

examples.en: A strange smell raised his suspicion.
examples.zh: 奇怪的氣味引起了他的懷疑。

explains.en: A feeling that something may be wrong or untrue is called this. A person may notice a strange noise and become worried. They can check safely.
In a mystery story, clues may create a belief about who caused a problem. More facts may change the idea. Do not accuse someone without evidence.
Certainty means knowing something is true, while this feeling involves doubt. It can encourage someone to investigate. Evidence helps settle questions.

examples.en: A swan drifted across the lake.
examples.zh: 一隻天鵝在湖面上漂游。

examples.en: The white swan spread its wings.
examples.zh: 白天鵝展開翅膀。

examples.en: We watched a swan lead its young through the reeds.
examples.zh: 我們看著天鵝帶著幼鳥穿過蘆葦。

explains.en: A large water bird has a long curved neck and broad wings. Many have white feathers. It glides smoothly across a pond.
These birds may live in pairs and care for their young. They eat plants and small animals. Give them space near water.
A duck is smaller and has a shorter neck, while this bird is usually larger. Both are waterfowl. Their shapes are easy to recognize.

examples.en: I swear I put the keys on the table.
examples.zh: 我發誓把鑰匙放在桌上了。

examples.en: He swore to tell the truth in court.
examples.zh: 他宣誓在法庭上說實話。

examples.en: Please do not swear around young children.
examples.zh: 請不要在年幼孩子面前說髒話。

explains.en: To make a serious promise is to do this. A person may promise to tell the truth. They should keep their word.
The verb can also mean using rude words. People can choose polite language instead. The sentence shows which meaning is intended.
A casual promise may be simple, while this verb suggests a strong pledge. The other meaning involves offensive language. Context and tone matter.

examples.en: The runner wiped sweat from his forehead.
examples.zh: 跑者擦掉額頭上的汗水。

examples.en: She began to sweat during the dance class.
examples.zh: 她上舞蹈課時開始流汗。

examples.en: A drop of sweat rolled down his cheek.
examples.zh: 一滴汗水沿著他的臉頰滑下。

explains.en: Drops of salty water come through the skin when a person is hot or exercising. The liquid helps cool the body. Drink water after activity.
As a verb, it means to produce these drops. A runner may do this on a warm day. Wear clean clothes afterward.
Tears come from the eyes, while this liquid comes from the skin. The body uses it to control temperature. Wipe it away with a towel.

examples.en: Experienced traditional sailors detect hidden islands over the horizon by feeling changes in ocean swell patterns.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的航海大師閉上雙眼、赤腳踩在船底甲板上，僅憑海浪長波湧浪的微小拍打折射即可感應遠方島嶼。

examples.en: The heavy ocean swell caused by an approaching typhoon generated towering waves crashing against coastal sea walls.
examples.zh: 遠方接近的強烈颱風所掀起的巨大長浪湧浪，在沿海防波堤上拍擊出滔天的驚人巨浪。

examples.en: An ankle sprain can cause painful swelling if you do not apply ice promptly after the injury.
examples.zh: 扭傷腳踝如果在受傷後沒有及時冰敷，很容易造成局部劇烈疼痛與紅腫。

entries.definition: 太平洋遠洋長波湧浪；膨脹

explains.en: To grow larger or become fuller is to do this. A balloon expands as air fills it. A small cut may also puff up.
A river may rise after heavy rain. Keep away from floodwater. The water can move with great force.
Shrink means become smaller, while this verb means increase in size. A crowd may grow as people arrive. Context shows what is expanding.

examples.en: The swift fox ran across the open field.
examples.zh: 敏捷的狐狸跑過空曠的田野。

examples.en: They made a swift choice before the doors closed.
examples.zh: 門關上前，他們迅速做了選擇。

examples.en: A swift current carried the leaf downstream.
examples.zh: 湍急的水流把葉子帶往下游。

explains.en: Something that moves very quickly can be described this way. A speedy bird darts through the air. It changes direction fast.
A person may make a quick decision when time is short. Thinking carefully is still important. Speed should not cause mistakes.
Slow is the opposite of this adjective. A fast-flowing stream flows quickly. The word can describe action, movement, or change.

examples.en: The museum displayed a sword from the Middle Ages.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了一把中世紀的劍。

examples.en: The knight carried a sword in the story.
examples.zh: 故事中的騎士帶著一把劍。

examples.en: A wooden sword was used in the school play.
examples.zh: 學校戲劇中使用了一把木劍。

explains.en: A long metal weapon with a handle and a sharp edge is called this. In old stories, knights carried one. It can be dangerous.
The tool may be used in historical reenactments or fencing with protective gear. Never play with a real one. Store it safely.
A knife is smaller and used for cutting food, while this weapon was made for fighting. It appears in many tales. Modern sports use safe practice versions.

examples.en: Take one painkiller tablet every eight hours with water.
examples.zh: 每八小時配水服用一顆止痛藥錠。

examples.en: Dissolve the effervescent vitamin C tablet in a glass of water.
examples.zh: 將發泡維生素 C 藥錠溶解在一杯溫水中。

examples.en: Students can take lecture notes and read digital textbooks on their tablets.
examples.zh: 學生可以在平板電腦上記錄課堂筆記並閱讀數位教科書。

examples.en: She uses a digital tablet and stylus pen to draw illustrations.
examples.zh: 她使用數位平板電腦和觸控筆繪製插畫。

examples.en: The flight attendants handed out entertainment tablets to first-class passengers.
examples.zh: 空服員向頭等艙旅客發放機上娛樂平板電腦。

examples.en: Swallow one calcium tablet each morning with fresh orange juice.
examples.zh: 每天早晨配新鮮柳橙汁吞服一顆鈣片藥錠。

examples.en: Dropping a chemical purification tablet into your water bottle neutralizes waterborne viruses within thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 在水壺中投入一顆二氧化氯淨水錠，靜置半小時即可徹底殺滅各種水生病毒。

examples.en: Chlorine dioxide tablets leave minimal aftertaste while killing stubborn aquatic pathogens.
examples.zh: 二氧化氯化學淨水發泡錠在殺滅頑強水生病原體的同時，幾乎不會殘留令人不適的藥水味。

examples.en: Keep emergency purification tablets in your first-aid kit as a backup to mechanical filters.
examples.zh: 在個人急救包中常備幾顆緊急淨水藥片，可作為濾水器結冰損壞時的可靠備援。

entries.definition: 藥錠；藥丸；平板電腦；二氧化氯高山水源淨水發泡錠；藥片

explains.en: A flat portable computer with a touch screen is called this. People can read books or draw on it. It is smaller than many laptops.
A small solid piece of medicine can also have this name. Follow a doctor's directions when taking it. Keep medicine away from children.
A laptop has a keyboard attached, while this device often uses an on-screen keyboard. The same word has a medical meaning. Context helps identify it.

examples.en: The price tag was still attached to the shirt.
examples.zh: 衣服上還掛著價格標籤。

examples.en: The children played tag in the yard.
examples.zh: 孩子們在院子裡玩鬼抓人。

examples.en: She tagged the photo with the place name.
examples.zh: 她在照片上加上了地點標籤。

entries.definition: （名）標籤；吊牌；標記；追逐遊戲；（動）貼標籤；標記；追上

explains.en: A small label attached to an item gives its name, price, or details. Clothes often have one inside. Read it before washing the garment.
As a verb, it can mean touching another player in a game. A child may touch another player during the chasing game. Agree on safe rules first.
A sign may show information for a whole place, while this is often attached to one object. It can also refer to a chasing game. The sentence shows the use.

examples.en: The tailor shortened the trousers for the wedding.
examples.zh: 裁縫為婚禮修改了褲子的長度。

examples.en: She took the jacket to a tailor for repair.
examples.zh: 她把外套拿去給裁縫修補。

examples.en: The teacher tailored the lesson to the students’ needs.
examples.zh: 老師依照學生的需求調整課程。

entries.definition: （名）裁縫師；（動）量身修改；量身訂做；調整以符合需求。

explains.en: A person who makes or repairs clothes is called this. They may adjust a jacket to fit better. Measuring carefully is important.
The verb can mean changing something to suit a particular person. A teacher may adapt a lesson to the class. The sentence shows which use is meant.
A designer creates the style, while this worker may sew and fit the garment. The roles can overlap. Good tools help make accurate changes.

examples.en: Top engineering universities cultivate elite graduate talent specializing in advanced materials and quantum physics.
examples.zh: 台灣頂尖大學半導體學院每年培育數千名主修材料科學、量子物理與電機工程的頂尖研發工程人才。

examples.en: The tech giant launched an international recruitment drive to attract top artificial intelligence talent.
examples.zh: 這家跨國軟體巨擘在全球啟動了極具吸引力的高薪徵才專案，全力延攬世界頂尖的人工智慧演算法菁英人才。

examples.en: The young cellist displayed astonishing natural musical talent from her very first lesson.
examples.zh: 這位年僅八歲的大提琴神童，從她人生第一堂音樂啟蒙課開始便展現出令指導教授震撼的天然音樂天賦。

entries.definition: 台灣頂尖半導體研發工程人才；才能

explains.en: A natural ability to do something well is called this. A child may be able to draw well without much training. Practice can make the skill stronger.
A person may also have a special ability learned over time. Musicians develop their skills by playing often. Encouragement helps them grow.
Practice builds ability, while this noun can describe a special gift or skill. People may be good at different things. Everyone can learn something new.

examples.en: The talkative parrot copied every sound in the room.
examples.zh: 健談的鸚鵡模仿房間裡的每種聲音。

examples.en: My talkative cousin told us stories all evening.
examples.zh: 我健談的表親整晚都在講故事。

examples.en: The talkative student asked many questions.
examples.zh: 那位愛說話的學生問了很多問題。

explains.en: A person who enjoys speaking a lot can be described this way. They may tell many stories at lunch. Listening to others matters too.
A lively conversation can include someone who shares many ideas. They should notice whether others want a turn. Good conversations go both ways.
Quiet people speak less, while this adjective describes someone who often talks. It does not mean they are rude. Situation and manners matter.

examples.en: The tame pony let the children brush its mane.
examples.zh: 這匹溫馴的小馬讓孩子們梳理牠的鬃毛。

examples.en: The trainer tamed the young horse with patience.
examples.zh: 訓練師耐心地馴服了這匹小馬。

examples.en: A tame bird perched on the keeper’s hand.
examples.zh: 一隻溫馴的鳥停在飼養員的手上。

entries.definition: （形）馴服的；不刺激的；（動）馴服；制服

explains.en: An animal that is used to people and not wild can be described this way. A pet rabbit may accept gentle handling. Treat it kindly.
As a verb, it means to train a wild animal to accept human care. This takes time and skill. Some animals should remain in the wild.
Wild animals usually avoid people, while this adjective suggests an animal is accustomed to them. Do not approach wildlife. Ask an adult before petting an animal.

examples.en: She packed a tangerine in her lunch bag.
examples.zh: 她在午餐袋裡放了一顆橘子。

examples.en: The tangerine peeled easily.
examples.zh: 這顆橘子很容易剝皮。

examples.en: He shared a tangerine with his friend.
examples.zh: 他和朋友分享了一顆橘子。

explains.en: A small citrus fruit has a loose orange skin and sweet sections inside. It is easy to peel by hand. People often eat it as a snack.
It is related to oranges and mandarins. Some kinds have seeds and others do not. Keep the fruit cool after peeling.
A lemon is sour and yellow, while this fruit is usually sweet and orange. Both contain juice. The skin gives off a fresh smell.

examples.en: The fish tank needs clean water.
examples.zh: 魚缸需要乾淨的水。

examples.en: The old tank stood outside the military museum.
examples.zh: 舊坦克停在軍事博物館外。

examples.en: Dad filled the car’s gas tank before our trip.
examples.zh: 出發前，爸爸把汽車油箱加滿。

entries.definition: 水槽；坦克；油箱；儲存槽；（動）暴跌。

explains.en: A large container for holding liquid or gas is called this. An aquarium holds water and fish. It needs regular cleaning.
A military vehicle with thick armor and tracks also has this name. It can travel over rough ground. People may see models in museums.
A bottle holds a small amount, while this container can store much more. The word also names a vehicle. Context explains which meaning applies.

examples.en: Tap the red icon on the screen to record a video.
examples.zh: 輕觸螢幕上的紅色圖示以錄製影片。

examples.en: Don't forget to turn off the bathroom water tap tightly.
examples.zh: 別忘了將浴室的水龍頭確實關緊。

examples.en: He tapped gently on the wooden office door before entering.
examples.zh: 他在進入辦公室前在木門上輕輕敲了幾下。

explains.en: To touch something lightly with a finger or tool is to do this. A person may knock gently on a window. The sound can get someone's attention.
The word can also name a faucet that controls water. Turn it to fill a cup. Close it after use to save water.
A hard hit is stronger, while this action is usually light. The same word names a water control. Context gives the meaning.

examples.en: The soup was tasty with fresh carrots and herbs.
examples.zh: 新鮮的胡蘿蔔和香草讓湯很好喝。

examples.en: We ate a tasty sandwich after the game.
examples.zh: 比賽後我們吃了一份美味的三明治。

examples.en: The ripe strawberries were sweet and tasty.
examples.zh: 熟透的草莓又甜又好吃。

explains.en: Food with a pleasant flavor can be described this way. A ripe peach may taste sweet and fresh. Different people like different flavors.
A cook can add herbs or spices to make a meal more enjoyable. Fresh ingredients often taste good. Try a small amount first.
Bland food has little flavor, while this adjective means it tastes good. It does not always mean spicy. Taste depends on personal preference.

examples.en: Do not tease your friend about her new glasses.
examples.zh: 不要取笑朋友的新眼鏡。

examples.en: The puppy teased the cat by waving a toy.
examples.zh: 小狗揮著玩具逗貓玩。

examples.en: He teased his brother gently about the silly hat.
examples.zh: 他善意地取笑弟弟戴著滑稽的帽子。

explains.en: To make fun of someone in a way that may hurt their feelings is to do this. It is kinder to use friendly words. Stop if someone feels upset.
People may also joke playfully with a close friend. Both people should enjoy the joke. A kind tone helps show it is friendly.
A joke makes people laugh together, while this action can sometimes be unkind. Notice how others feel. Apologize if a joke hurts someone.

examples.en: The technical guide explained how to connect the printer.
examples.zh: 技術指南說明了如何連接印表機。

examples.en: She solved a technical problem with the camera.
examples.zh: 她解決了相機的技術問題。

examples.en: The lesson included a technical drawing of the engine.
examples.zh: 課程包含引擎的技術圖。

entries.definition: 技術的；專業的；工藝的；技術性的

explains.en: A subject that requires special knowledge or tools can be described this way. A computer issue may need an expert. Instructions can help.
The adjective can also relate to machines, science, or a specific skill. An engineering drawing shows exact measurements. The details may be hard for beginners.
A simple explanation uses everyday words, while this kind may include specialized terms. Ask questions when something is unclear. Experts can explain it.

examples.en: The dancer practiced a new technique for turning.
examples.zh: 舞者練習了一種新的轉身技巧。

examples.en: A good breathing technique helped her sing longer.
examples.zh: 良好的呼吸技巧幫助她唱得更久。

examples.en: The chef showed us a technique for cutting onions.
examples.zh: 廚師示範了切洋蔥的技巧。

explains.en: A particular way of doing an activity is called this. A painter may use short brush strokes. Practice helps make them smooth.
An athlete can learn special movements to improve a skill. A coach shows how to do them safely. Repeating the steps builds control.
A goal is what someone wants to achieve, while this noun describes how they do it. Different people may use different methods. Training can improve the result.

examples.en: My teenage sister likes to play volleyball.
examples.zh: 我十幾歲的姊姊喜歡打排球。

examples.en: The teenage actor starred in the school play.
examples.zh: 那位青少年演員在學校戲劇中擔任主角。

examples.en: Teenage years can bring many new experiences.
examples.zh: 青少年時期會帶來許多新經歷。

explains.en: The ages from thirteen through nineteen are described by this adjective. A person in that age group may start high school. Their interests can change.
A person in this age group is no longer a small child but is not yet an adult. Different countries have different rules. Support from family is helpful.
Childhood comes before these years, and adulthood follows them. People grow at different rates. Respect their privacy and feelings.

examples.en: He lost his temper when the game ended early.
examples.zh: 比賽提早結束時，他發了脾氣。

examples.en: Her gentle temper made the new student feel safe.
examples.zh: 她溫和的脾氣讓新同學感到安心。

examples.en: The child learned to control his temper.
examples.zh: 孩子學會控制自己的脾氣。

explains.en: A person's usual way of reacting when upset is called this. A calm person does not get angry easily. Taking a breath can help.
The word can also mean the strength of a feeling. A person may lose control of their anger when frustrated. Talking kindly can settle things.
Mood can change during a day, while this noun often describes a person's way of handling anger. Everyone can learn self-control. Ask for help when emotions feel too strong.

examples.en: The library has a temporary entrance during repairs.
examples.zh: 圖書館在整修期間設有臨時入口。

examples.en: She took a temporary job for the summer.
examples.zh: 她暑假期間做了一份臨時工作。

examples.en: This is a temporary fix until the new part arrives.
examples.zh: 這是暫時的修補方式，等新零件送到即可更換。

explains.en: Something that lasts only for a limited time can be described this way. A short-term sign may guide people during road work. It will be removed later.
A worker may take a job for a short period. They know it will end at a set time. The arrangement may change.
Permanent means lasting a long time, while this adjective suggests it will not last. A short-lived solution can help until a better one is ready. Context tells the time limit.

examples.en: I tend to read before bed.
examples.zh: 我通常會在睡前閱讀。

examples.en: They tend the garden together each weekend.
examples.zh: 他們每個週末一起照料花園。

examples.en: She tends to be quiet in a new group.
examples.zh: 她在新的團體裡通常比較安靜。

explains.en: To often behave in a certain way is to do this. A person may usually wake up early. Habits can change over time.
The verb can also mean caring for something. A gardener may water young plants. Regular attention helps them grow.
Always means every time, while this verb suggests something happens often but not always. It can also mean look after. The sentence gives the sense.

examples.en: The chicken was tender after cooking slowly.
examples.zh: 雞肉慢慢煮熟後變得很嫩。

examples.en: She gave her little brother a tender hug.
examples.zh: 她溫柔地抱了抱弟弟。

examples.en: The tender leaves broke in the wind.
examples.zh: 柔嫩的葉子在風中折斷了。

entries.definition: 柔軟的；溫柔的；疼痛的；嫩的

explains.en: Something soft and easy to cut or bite can be described this way. Cooked vegetables may feel this way. Do not overcook them.
A person can show gentle care or kindness. A gentle moment between friends can feel warm. People may speak softly.
Tough food is hard to chew, while this adjective describes soft food. It can also mean kind and gentle. Context shows which meaning is intended.

examples.en: We pitched a tent beside the lake.
examples.zh: 我們在湖邊搭起帳篷。

examples.en: The tent kept us dry during the rain.
examples.zh: 帳篷讓我們在下雨時保持乾爽。

examples.en: She packed the tent into a small bag.
examples.zh: 她把帳篷收進一個小袋子裡。

explains.en: A portable shelter made from fabric stretched over poles is called this. People use it while camping. Pegs hold it to the ground.
Some versions are small for one person, while others can fit a family. Keep it dry before packing it away. Wet fabric can grow mold.
A cabin is a fixed building, while this shelter can be packed and carried. It protects campers from rain and wind. Choose a safe place to set it up.

examples.en: We had a terrific time at the science fair.
examples.zh: 我們在科學園遊會玩得非常開心。

examples.en: The team gave a terrific performance.
examples.zh: 隊伍表現得非常出色。

examples.en: That was a terrific idea for the class project.
examples.zh: 那是班級專題的一個好主意。

entries.definition: 極好的；非常棒的；令人愉快的

explains.en: Something extremely good or enjoyable can be described this way. A very enjoyable book may keep someone reading late. They want to know what happens.
The word can also mean very large or strong. A powerful storm may bring heavy rain. People should stay safe.
Good is a simple compliment, while this adjective adds extra excitement. It can describe an event or quality. Context shows whether it is praise or size.

examples.en: The explorers crossed the territory by river.
examples.zh: 探險者沿河穿越了這片領地。

examples.en: The two countries agreed on a new border for the territory.
examples.zh: 兩國為這片領土的新邊界達成協議。

examples.en: The fox marked its territory near the den.
examples.zh: 狐狸在巢穴附近標記了自己的地盤。

explains.en: An area of land controlled or claimed by a group or country is called this. A map may show its borders. The area can be large or small.
An animal may defend the area where it lives. A bird can sing to warn others to stay away. Different species behave differently.
A border marks where one area ends and another begins. This noun refers to the area itself. Context tells whether it is political or about animals.

examples.en: I am thankful for my family’s help.
examples.zh: 我很感謝家人的幫忙。

examples.en: She felt thankful when the neighbors brought soup.
examples.zh: 鄰居送來湯時，她感到很感激。

examples.en: The thankful team wrote a note to their coach.
examples.zh: 心懷感謝的隊伍寫了一張卡片給教練。

explains.en: A person who feels grateful for help or kindness can be described this way. A friend may lend a book. Saying thanks shows appreciation.
People may feel this after something good happens. A family can be glad that everyone arrived safely. They may share the feeling.
Ungrateful describes not showing appreciation, while this adjective means feeling it. People can thank others with words or actions. Small kindnesses matter.

examples.en: The class discussed a theory about how birds navigate.
examples.zh: 全班討論了鳥類如何導航的一種理論。

examples.en: Her theory explained why the ice melted faster in the sun.
examples.zh: 她的理論解釋了冰為何在陽光下融得更快。

examples.en: The scientist tested the theory with a simple experiment.
examples.zh: 科學家用簡單實驗測試了這個理論。

explains.en: An idea that explains how something may work is called this. Scientists may test it with evidence. New facts can change the idea.
A person may have an idea about who left footprints in the snow. Clues can support or challenge the guess. More checking is needed.
A fact is something shown to be true, while this noun may be an explanation that still needs testing. Different ideas can compete. Evidence helps.

examples.en: The long walk gave us thirst, so we drank water.
examples.zh: 長途步行讓我們口渴，因此我們喝了水。

examples.en: She felt a thirst for knowledge about space.
examples.zh: 她對太空知識充滿渴求。

examples.en: Cold water eased his thirst after the game.
examples.zh: 比賽後，冰水解了他的渴。

explains.en: The body's need for water is called this feeling. It often happens after exercise. Drinking clean water helps.
A strong desire for something can also be described this way. Someone may have a strong desire for adventure. This use is figurative.
Hunger is a need for food, while this noun refers to wanting a drink. Hot weather can increase it. Remember to stay hydrated.

examples.en: She used blue thread to mend the button.
examples.zh: 她用藍線縫補鈕扣。

examples.en: The online thread had many replies about gardening.
examples.zh: 那串線上討論有許多關於園藝的回覆。

examples.en: A loose thread hung from the sleeve.
examples.zh: 袖子上垂著一根鬆脫的線。

entries.definition: 線；棉線；討論串；主線；（動）穿線；串起。

explains.en: A thin strand of cotton or another material is used for sewing. It passes through the eye of a needle. Choose a color that matches the cloth.
The word can also mean a line of messages in an online conversation. People reply to the same topic. The meaning depends on context.
A rope is thick and strong, while this strand is fine and thin. Several strands can be twisted together. A needle helps guide it through fabric.

examples.en: The note contained a threat to damage the store.
examples.zh: 那張紙條威脅要破壞商店。

examples.en: The storm was a threat to the small boats.
examples.zh: 暴風雨對小船構成威脅。

examples.en: The school took the threat seriously.
examples.zh: 學校嚴肅看待這項威脅。

explains.en: A statement that someone may cause harm is called this. It can make people feel afraid. Tell a trusted adult or official if you hear one.
The word can also mean something that may cause danger. A storm can endanger boats at sea. Warnings help people prepare.
A promise to help is different from this frightening message. Some problems create danger without anyone speaking. The context makes the meaning clear.

examples.en: The bully threatened to break the model.
examples.zh: 霸凌者威脅要弄壞模型。

examples.en: Dark clouds threatened to bring more rain.
examples.zh: 烏雲預示著可能會再下雨。

examples.en: He threatened his friend during the argument.
examples.zh: 爭吵時，他威脅了朋友。

explains.en: To say that someone may cause harm is to do this. Such words can frighten people. Tell a trusted adult if someone says them.
A natural event can also put something in danger. Rising water may endanger homes near a river. People should follow warnings.
Promise means say you will do something, while this verb often suggests harm or danger. A threat may not happen, but it should be taken seriously. Get help.

examples.en: He hurt his thumb while closing the drawer.
examples.zh: 他關抽屜時弄傷了拇指。

examples.en: She gave a thumbs-up after tasting the soup.
examples.zh: 嚐過湯之後，她豎起拇指表示讚許。

examples.en: The baby held the toy with one hand and thumb.
examples.zh: 嬰兒用一隻手和拇指握住玩具。

explains.en: The short, thick digit on the side of the hand is called this. It helps people grip things. Each hand has one.
People may show this digit up to signal approval. A raised one can mean things are going well. Some signs differ by culture.
Fingers are longer and have several joints, while this digit sits apart from them. It moves in a special way. It helps a hand hold objects.

examples.en: The gravitational pull of the moon creates predictable rhythmic high and low ocean tides.
examples.zh: 月球與太陽對地球的萬有引力在浩瀚大洋中引發了每日規律起伏、漲退有序的潮汐更替現象。

examples.en: Fishermen consult local tide tables before venturing onto dangerous intertidal rock platforms.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的近海漁民與採蚵人家，在出發前往危險的礁岩海蝕平台前，必定會仔細核對當日潮汐時刻表。

examples.en: The receding evening tide exposed hundreds of hidden tide pools brimming with colorful marine critters.
examples.zh: 傍晚緩緩退去的海潮，在廣闊平坦的礁石間裸露出數百個生機盎然、藏著各色微小海洋生物的天然潮池。

entries.definition: 海洋潮汐漲落；潮水；趨勢

explains.en: The regular rise and fall of the sea is caused mainly by the moon's pull. It changes the level of the water near a shore. Check local times before walking on a beach.
Some coasts have high water and low water at different times each day. Sea life may be uncovered when the water goes out. Be careful near rocks.
Waves move across the surface, while this change raises or lowers the sea level over hours. A chart can show when it happens. The timing varies by place.

examples.en: These new leather shoes feel a bit too tight on my feet.
examples.zh: 這雙新皮鞋穿在我腳上感覺有點太緊。

examples.en: Hold tight to the safety handrail while riding the steep escalator.
examples.zh: 搭乘陡峭的手扶梯時請緊握安全扶手。

examples.en: We had to work late because of the tight project schedule.
examples.zh: 由於專案時程緊湊，我們不得不加班工作。

explains.en: Something fastened firmly or fitting closely can be described this way. A lid may be hard to open. Turn it carefully.
A schedule with little free time can also be called this. Someone may be busy all day. Making time to rest is helpful.
Loose means not firmly fastened, while this adjective suggests a firm fit. A shoe that fits too closely may hurt the foot. Choose comfortable clothing.

examples.en: Please tighten the loose handle on the drawer.
examples.zh: 請把抽屜上鬆動的把手鎖緊。

examples.en: He tightened the knot on the tent rope.
examples.zh: 他把帳篷繩上的結拉緊。

examples.en: She tightened the lid so the juice would not spill.
examples.zh: 她把蓋子轉緊，避免果汁灑出來。

entries.definition: 拉緊；擰緊；使更牢固；加強。

explains.en: To make something more firmly fastened is to do this. A person may turn a screw. Use the correct tool.
A rope can be pulled until it is less slack. Check that it is secure but not too tight. Safety matters when climbing.
Loosen means make less firm, while this verb means make more secure. A belt can be adjusted. Do not overtighten parts that may break.

examples.en: Cross-laminated timber (CLT) stores tons of atmospheric carbon inside modern multi-story wooden towers.
examples.zh: 採用高強度固碳交叉層積木材（CLT）興建的多層木構綠建築，能將大量大氣二氧化碳牢牢封存於結構中。

examples.en: Sustainable forestry practices ensure that newly planted pine saplings outnumber harvested timber trees.
examples.zh: 實踐永續撫育的林相管理工法，嚴格確保每年新植的人工林苗木數量遠遠超過計畫疏伐收穫的木材總量。

examples.en: Historic Shinto shrines and Taiwanese mountain temples were constructed from durable, aromatic red cypress timber.
examples.zh: 歷史悠久的百年古蹟與台灣高山木構寺廟，全數採用質地緊密防蟲蛀且香氣濃郁的珍貴台灣紅檜原木打造。

examples.en: Furniture designers select certified sustainable timber harvested from responsibly managed plantations.
examples.zh: 高級原木家具設計師嚴選獲得國際 FSC 永續認證、來自合法經營造林農場的優質原木木料。

examples.en: High winds during the mountain storm caused several towering timber trees to snap and fall across trails.
examples.zh: 高山暴風雨中的強陣風導致數棵高聳的大型木材林木折斷，橫倒在登山步道上。

examples.en: Canada and Sweden are major global exporters of structural softwoods and construction timber.
examples.zh: 加拿大與瑞典是全球重要的建築用軟木結構材與高品質工程原木出口大國。

examples.en: Constructing skyscrapers with engineered mass timber drastically lowers carbon emissions compared to concrete.
examples.zh: 採用重型工程結構大木興建高樓，相較於傳統鋼筋混凝土能大幅減少碳排。

examples.en: Sourcing certified timber from responsibly managed plantation forests prevents illegal deforestation.
examples.zh: 嚴格從通過永續驗證的人工造林林場採購原木，能從根本阻絕破壞熱帶原始雨林的非法盜伐。

examples.en: Heavy timber structures perform surprisingly well in fires because the outer charred layer insulates the core.
examples.zh: 重型木構建築在真實火場中耐火表現極佳，因為木材表面形成的碳化層能有效阻隔熱量保護木芯。

examples.en: Walls are clad in seasoned resonant oak timber, chosen for its balanced tonal response across registers.
examples.zh: 牆面全面鋪設經數十年風乾熟成的「頂級共鳴橡木」（Oak Timber），具備全頻段極度平衡的溫潤聲學響應。

examples.en: Loggers transported sustainably harvested pine timber down the river to the regional sawmills.
examples.zh: 伐木林班工人將兼顧永續林業伐採的高山紅松原木木材，順著溪流放流運往山腳下的地方木材加工廠。

examples.en: The traditional Taiwanese historical courtyard residence was constructed using aromatic cypress timber.
examples.zh: 這棟保存完好的台灣傳統閩南式歷史三合院古厝，全棟主要樑柱皆採用散發天然香氣的珍貴台灣檜木木料建造。

entries.definition: CLT 固碳交叉層積木構建材；木材；FSC 認證永續林業優質原木木材；大跨距重型工程木構結構；歷經數十年天然風乾熟成之頂級共鳴實木板材

explains.en: Wood prepared for building houses or making furniture is called this. It may come from trees grown for that purpose. Builders measure it carefully.
The word can also refer to trees that will be cut for use. Forests should be managed responsibly. Planting new trees helps.
A living tree grows in a forest, while this material has been cut and prepared. It is strong and useful. Different kinds have different properties.

examples.en: The museum exhibit explained the history of tobacco farming.
examples.zh: 博物館展覽介紹了菸草種植的歷史。

examples.en: Tobacco smoke can harm the lungs.
examples.zh: 菸草煙霧可能傷害肺部。

examples.en: The field once grew tobacco plants.
examples.zh: 這塊田以前種植菸草。

explains.en: A plant's dried leaves are used to make cigarettes and some other products. Smoking can harm health. Children should avoid these products.
The plant is grown on farms in some regions. Its leaves are dried and processed. Laws may limit who can buy products made from it.
Tea leaves are dried to make a drink, while these leaves are used in products that can be harmful. Avoid breathing smoke. Ask a trusted adult about health questions.

examples.en: The truck carried a ton of gravel.
examples.zh: 卡車載了一噸碎石。

examples.en: A blue whale can weigh many tons.
examples.zh: 藍鯨的體重可達好幾噸。

examples.en: The bridge limit is five tons per vehicle.
examples.zh: 這座橋的車輛載重限制是五噸。

explains.en: A unit of weight equal to 2,000 pounds in the United States is called this. Other countries use a different amount. Check which system is being used.
A large truck may carry several of these units. The load must stay within the safe limit. Signs show weight restrictions.
A kilogram is much smaller, while this unit measures very heavy loads. The exact value depends on the country. Labels should state the unit.

examples.en: She tossed the ball to her brother.
examples.zh: 她把球輕輕拋給弟弟。

examples.en: Toss the salad gently before serving it.
examples.zh: 上菜前輕輕拌一拌沙拉。

examples.en: He tossed the blanket over the chair.
examples.zh: 他把毯子隨手丟到椅子上。

entries.definition: （動）輕拋；投擲；翻動；（名）投擲；拋硬幣

explains.en: To throw something lightly or casually is to do this. A person may throw a ball to a friend. Make sure the area is clear.
A salad can be mixed by lifting and turning its pieces. The verb describes that action too. Use a large bowl.
Throw can mean sending something through the air, while this verb may suggest a light or quick motion. People may flip a coin to choose. The situation shows the sense.

examples.en: The hike was tough, but the view was beautiful.
examples.zh: 健行很辛苦，但景色很美。

examples.en: This tough leather bag lasted for years.
examples.zh: 這個耐用的皮包用好多年了。

examples.en: It was tough to say goodbye to our friends.
examples.zh: 和朋友道別很難受。

entries.definition: 堅韌的；堅強的；艱難的；嚼不爛的；嚴厲的。

explains.en: Something difficult to do or deal with can be described this way. A hard puzzle may take a long time. Asking for help is okay.
Food that is hard to chew can also have this quality. Cooking it longer may make it softer. Use safe cooking directions.
Easy means requiring little effort, while this adjective suggests a challenge. A durable material is also hard to break. Context tells the meaning.

examples.en: Tourism brings visitors to the island each summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，觀光業都會為這座島帶來遊客。

examples.en: The town depends on tourism during the festival season.
examples.zh: 節慶期間，這座城鎮仰賴觀光業。

examples.en: Tourism can help local shops and restaurants.
examples.zh: 觀光業能幫助當地商店和餐廳。

explains.en: Traveling to visit places for pleasure is called this activity. Visitors may stay in hotels and see local sights. It can support businesses.
A town may welcome people who come to enjoy beaches or museums. Good planning helps protect nature and local culture. Visitors should be respectful.
A work trip has a different purpose from a holiday visit. This field includes services for travelers. Communities can benefit when it is managed well.

examples.en: Jiufen Old Street is packed with international tourists.
examples.zh: 九份老街擠滿了來自世界各國的觀光客。

examples.en: The tourist information center provides complimentary maps and local brochures.
examples.zh: 觀光旅遊資訊中心提供免費地圖與在地導覽手冊。

examples.en: Eco-conscious tourists respect local natural wildlife and cultural customs.
examples.zh: 具備環保意識的遊客會尊重當地的自然野生生態與文化習俗。

explains.en: A person who visits a place for pleasure or interest is called this. They may look at landmarks and take pictures. Local maps can help.
Visitors may come from another town or country. They should learn local customs. Respectful behavior makes travel pleasant.
A resident lives in an area, while this person is visiting it. Some travelers stay for a few days. They can ask guides for help.

examples.en: A truck had to tow the broken car to a repair shop.
examples.zh: 卡車必須把故障車拖到修理廠。

examples.en: The small boat towed a raft across the lake.
examples.zh: 小船把木筏拖過湖面。

examples.en: They called for help to tow their van.
examples.zh: 他們打電話求助，請人拖吊廂型車。

explains.en: To pull a vehicle or boat behind another vehicle is to do this. A truck may move a broken car. Proper equipment is needed.
A strong rope or chain can connect the two vehicles. Drivers must follow safety rules. The load should not be too heavy.
Carry means hold or transport something, while this verb means pull it along. A boat can pull another boat. The road or water route matters.

examples.en: The old tower stood above the town square.
examples.zh: 舊塔矗立在鎮上的廣場旁。

examples.en: We climbed the tower to see the coastline.
examples.zh: 我們爬上塔樓眺望海岸線。

examples.en: The clock tower rang at noon.
examples.zh: 鐘樓在中午響起。

explains.en: A tall, narrow building or structure is called this. It may help people see far away. A lighthouse is one example.
A structure can rise above other buildings in a city. It may hold offices or homes. Elevators carry people between floors.
A short building has fewer levels, while this structure is very tall and narrow. Some are built for defense. Its purpose depends on its design.

examples.en: Embracing the Leave No Trace ethos means leaving nothing behind on the trail except footprints.
examples.zh: 堅定落實無痕山林原則，意味著除了足跡什麼都不留，除了回憶什麼都不帶走。

examples.en: The seven Leave No Trace principles educate hikers on respecting wildlife and minimizing campfire scars.
examples.zh: 無痕山林七大原則教育所有山友尊重高山野生動物，並竭力消除任何營火遺留的傷疤痕跡。

examples.en: True mountaineers strive to leave no trace of human presence in sensitive alpine ecological habitats.
examples.zh: 真正的山行者竭力在脆弱的高山生態棲地中隱去一切足跡，不留下一絲人為破壞痕跡。

entries.definition: 全民落實 LNT 無痕山林崇高精神；痕跡

explains.en: A small amount or sign of something left behind is called this. A footprint can be a sign that someone passed by. A detective may look for it.
As a verb, it means to copy a shape by following its lines. A child can place thin paper over a picture. Hold the paper steady.
A large amount is easy to see, while this noun refers to a tiny remainder or clue. The verb has a different use. Context helps distinguish them.

examples.en: The trader sold fresh oranges at the market.
examples.zh: 商人在市場販售新鮮柳橙。

examples.en: A cloth trader traveled between the villages.
examples.zh: 布商在村莊之間往來。

examples.en: The trader compared prices before buying grain.
examples.zh: 商人在購買穀物前比較了價格。

entries.definition: 商人；交易者；買賣商品的人。

explains.en: A person who buys and sells goods is called this. They may sell food at a market. The price depends on the product and location.
Some people trade stocks or other items as a job. They study information before making choices. Risks can be involved.
A customer buys something for personal use, while this worker buys and sells as a business. Different fields have different rules. The context tells what kind of goods are involved.

examples.en: The rugged historical alpine trail winds through pristine hemlock forests and alpine bamboo meadows.
examples.zh: 蜿蜒起伏的高山歷史登山古道步道，穿梭在參天鐵杉原始林與翠綠高山箭竹草原之間。

examples.en: Heavy monsoon rains washed away several sections of the remote mountain trail.
examples.zh: 連日強烈西南氣流暴雨沖毀了這條偏遠山區步道的數個路段。

examples.en: National park rangers maintain trail markers to ensure solitary backpackers stay on course.
examples.zh: 國家公園巡山員定期維護步道路標與反光標誌，確保獨攀山友不致偏離路徑。

entries.definition: 高山野外古道登山步道；小徑

explains.en: A narrow path through a natural area is called this. Hikers follow it through woods or hills. Signs can point the way.
The word can also mean to move behind someone or something. A puppy may follow its owner closely. It should stay safe near roads.
A road is often wide enough for cars, while this path may be for walking. It can also mean following behind. Context gives the sense.

examples.en: The ferry transports people between the islands.
examples.zh: 渡輪載送人們往返各島。

examples.en: Trucks transport food to the stores.
examples.zh: 卡車把食物運送到商店。

examples.en: The book transported her to an imaginary world.
examples.zh: 這本書把她帶進一個想像中的世界。

entries.definition: （名）交通運輸；交通工具；（動）運送；使身歷其境

explains.en: To move people or goods from one place to another is to do this. A bus carries passengers across a city. Trains can carry many people.
The noun can mean the system of vehicles and routes people use. Roads, buses, and ferries are part of it. Cities plan these systems carefully.
Carry something by hand is one way to move it, while this verb often uses a vehicle. Goods can travel far. The word can also mean a strong feeling in a story.

examples.en: The traveler asked for directions to the museum.
examples.zh: 旅客詢問前往博物館的路。

examples.en: A tired traveler rested at the station.
examples.zh: 疲憊的旅客在車站休息。

examples.en: The traveler packed a light bag for the trip.
examples.zh: 旅客為旅程準備了一個輕便的包包。

explains.en: A person who goes from one place to another is called this. They may visit family or explore new sights. A map can help them plan.
Some people travel for work, while others go for fun. Packing only what is needed makes the trip easier. Check the weather first.
A commuter travels regularly to work or school, while this word can describe anyone on a trip. People use many ways to travel. The context may give more detail.

examples.en: A carved solid bamboo tea tray drains excess rinse water neatly away beneath its slotted surface.
examples.zh: 雕工精細的原木竹製排水茶盤，能將溫壺洗杯的熱水順暢排入下方夾層，保持茶席乾爽整潔。

examples.en: The flight attendant walked down the airplane aisle balancing a beverage service tray with coffee and juice.
examples.zh: 空服人員踩著優雅步伐穿梭於機艙走道間，單手平穩托著放滿熱咖啡與柳橙汁的飲品服務托盤。

examples.en: Heavy wooden cafeteria trays were replaced with lightweight, recycled plastic versions.
examples.zh: 學校學生餐廳全面將原本笨重的老舊木質餐盤，汰換為輕巧耐用且符合環保標章的食品級托盤。

entries.definition: 實木排水茶盤；茶席托盤

explains.en: A flat object with raised edges is used to carry cups or food. A waiter may bring several drinks on it. The edges help stop items from sliding off.
People can also use one to keep small objects together on a desk. It can be made of wood or plastic. Clean it after use.
A plate holds one serving of food, while this flat carrier can hold several items. It is easy to lift with both hands. Keep it level.

examples.en: Video shorts are a booming social media trend among teenagers.
examples.zh: 短影音是當前在青少年群體中迅速爆紅的社群媒體潮流趨勢。

examples.en: Remote working arrangements are becoming a long-term trend in global enterprise.
examples.zh: 居家遠端或混合辦公模式正逐漸成為全球跨國企業不可逆轉的長期人力資源趨勢。

examples.en: News about the solar eclipse began to trend rapidly on social media across Asia.
examples.zh: 關於百年一遇罕見日全食的天文奇景快訊，迅速在亞洲各大社群平台上掀起洗版熱搜潮流。

explains.en: A general direction in which something is changing is called this. More people may choose bicycles for travel. The change can continue for a while.
Fashion or popular music can change in this way. Shops notice which styles people like. Popular styles may come and go.
A single event is only one moment, while this noun describes a pattern over time. Charts can show it. It may go upward or downward.

examples.en: The book described a tribe that lived near the river.
examples.zh: 這本書描寫一個住在河邊的部族。

examples.en: The tribe shared stories with the visitors.
examples.zh: 這個部族和訪客分享了故事。

examples.en: Each tribe has its own history and traditions.
examples.zh: 每個部族都有自己的歷史和傳統。

explains.en: A social group with shared culture, history, or family connections is called this. Some Indigenous communities use the word for themselves. Names and traditions should be respected.
A group may live in a particular region and share customs. Each community has its own ways of life. Learn from reliable sources.
A club is usually formed around a shared activity, while this group may be connected through ancestry and culture. Different people prefer different names. Use the community's own terms.

examples.en: The tricky riddle took us an hour to solve.
examples.zh: 這個棘手的謎語花了我們一小時才解開。

examples.en: It was tricky to carry the boxes up the stairs.
examples.zh: 把箱子搬上樓梯很不容易。

examples.en: She found a tricky way to open the stuck jar.
examples.zh: 她想出一個巧妙的方法打開卡住的罐子。

entries.definition: 棘手的；難處理的；狡猾的；機敏的。

explains.en: Something difficult to understand or do can be described this way. A puzzle may have a hidden clue. Taking time can help solve it.
A situation may be hard because it has many parts. Asking questions can make it clearer. A friend may help.
Easy describes something simple, while this adjective suggests a challenge. A problem may have a surprising answer. Keep trying.

examples.en: A troop of scouts camped in the forest.
examples.zh: 一隊童軍在森林裡露營。

examples.en: The troop marched across the field.
examples.zh: 軍隊行進穿越田野。

examples.en: A troop of monkeys crossed the road.
examples.zh: 一群猴子穿過道路。

explains.en: A group of soldiers is called this. The soldiers train and work together. They may be sent to help in an emergency.
The word can also mean a group of people or animals moving together. A group of scouts went camping. Context shows the group.
A single soldier is one person, while this noun describes many people together. A patrol may be smaller. The purpose of the group matters.

examples.en: The island has a tropical climate with warm rain.
examples.zh: 這座島氣候熱帶，溫暖多雨。

examples.en: We ate tropical fruit after lunch.
examples.zh: 我們午餐後吃了熱帶水果。

examples.en: Many tropical birds live in the rainforest.
examples.zh: 許多熱帶鳥類住在雨林裡。

entries.definition: 熱帶的；炎熱潮濕地區的

explains.en: A warm region near the equator is described this way. It may have rainforests and many kinds of plants. The weather is often hot.
Some fruits grow well in this climate. People may grow bananas or pineapples. Seasons can be different from colder places.
Polar regions are very cold, while this adjective describes warm areas near the equator. Rainfall can be heavy. Plants and animals adapt to the climate.

examples.en: The trumpet player practiced a new song.
examples.zh: 小號手練習了一首新歌。

examples.en: A trumpet sounded at the start of the parade.
examples.zh: 遊行開始時，小號響起。

examples.en: She learned to play the trumpet in band class.
examples.zh: 她在管樂課學會吹小號。

entries.definition: 小號；喇叭；（動）大聲宣揚；吹喇叭

explains.en: A brass instrument with a flared end is played by blowing into it. It makes bright, loud notes. Buttons change the pitch.
A musician may play it in a band or orchestra. Practice helps control the breath and sound. It can be heard from far away.
A flute makes sound through a small opening, while this instrument uses lips pressed to a mouthpiece. Both are wind instruments. They have different tones.

examples.en: The squirrel climbed the tree trunk.
examples.zh: 松鼠爬上了樹幹。

examples.en: We packed the suitcases into the car trunk.
examples.zh: 我們把行李箱放進汽車後車廂。

examples.en: The elephant lifted its trunk to spray water.
examples.zh: 大象抬起長鼻噴水。

entries.definition: 樹幹；汽車後車廂；象鼻；大箱子。

explains.en: The main thick stem of a tree is called this. It holds branches and leaves. Bark covers its outside.
The word can also mean a large storage area at the back of a car. People put luggage there. Keep heavy items secure.
A branch grows out from this central part, while the car's storage space has the same name. Elephants also have a long nose called one. Context shows the meaning.

examples.en: The truthful child admitted spilling the juice.
examples.zh: 誠實的孩子承認自己打翻了果汁。

examples.en: Her truthful account helped solve the problem.
examples.zh: 她如實的描述有助於解決問題。

examples.en: Please be truthful about what you saw.
examples.zh: 請如實說出你看到的事。

explains.en: A person who tells the truth and does not lie can be described this way. They admit what happened. Others can trust them.
A story based on real events may be described this way. The details match what actually happened. The writer can check facts.
Dishonest means not telling the truth, while this adjective means being honest. People can make mistakes and still speak truthfully. The facts matter.

examples.en: The child splashed water in the tub.
examples.zh: 孩子在浴缸裡潑水玩。

examples.en: A tub of popcorn sat on the table.
examples.zh: 桌上放著一桶爆米花。

examples.en: She filled the tub with warm water.
examples.zh: 她在浴缸裡裝滿溫水。

explains.en: A large container used to hold water or other things is called this. People may bathe in one. It is usually found in a bathroom.
A smaller version can hold ice cream or paint. The material may be plastic or metal. Close the lid when finished.
A bucket has a handle and is often carried, while this container may stay in one place. Some are used for washing. The item inside helps identify it.

examples.en: The dog tugged at the leash.
examples.zh: 狗拉扯著牽繩。

examples.en: A harbor tug guided the ship to the dock.
examples.zh: 港口拖船引導船隻靠上碼頭。

examples.en: He tugged the drawer until it opened.
examples.zh: 他拉了幾下抽屜，直到它打開。

explains.en: To pull something hard and briefly is to do this. A child may pull on a stuck drawer. Ask for help if it will not move.
A small boat can pull a larger one with a rope. The verb also names a kind of work boat. It helps move ships in a harbor.
Push sends something away, while this action pulls it toward you. The noun can name a boat that helps other vessels. The context shows the use.

examples.en: I recognized the tune from the movie.
examples.zh: 我認出了這段電影配樂。

examples.en: She tuned her guitar before practice.
examples.zh: 練習前，她調好了吉他的音準。

examples.en: The children sang a familiar tune together.
examples.zh: 孩子們一起唱了一首熟悉的曲子。

entries.definition: （名）曲調；旋律；（動）調音；調整；收聽。

explains.en: A series of musical notes that form a song is called this. A person may recognize it after hearing just a few notes. It can be hummed.
To adjust a musical instrument or engine so it works well is also described by this verb. A guitar needs its strings adjusted. A mechanic may adjust a car engine.
Lyrics are the words in a song, while this noun refers to the melody. The verb has a different use. Context tells which meaning is intended.

examples.en: The Hsuehshan Tunnel connects New Taipei and Yilan.
examples.zh: 雪山隧道連接了新北市與宜蘭縣。

examples.en: Turn on your car headlights whenever driving through a long tunnel.
examples.zh: 開車穿過長隧道時務必開啟汽車大燈。

examples.en: Workers dug an underground tunnel to expand the subway system.
examples.zh: 工人們挖掘了一條地下隧道以擴建地鐵系統。
