examples.en: Visitors strolling through the underwater walkthrough tunnel watch gigantic manta rays glide directly overhead.
examples.zh: 遊客漫步於三百六十度「海底玻璃隧道」（Tunnel），抬頭即可看見巨大的鬼蝠魟從頭頂優雅滑過。

examples.en: The engineering crew dug a five-kilometer railway tunnel straight through the granite mountain ridge.
examples.zh: 鐵路工程團隊歷經數年艱苦鑽探，成功貫通了一條穿透堅硬花崗岩山脈的五公里長鐵路隧道。

examples.en: Car headlights illuminated the curved concrete walls as the vehicle zipped through the expressway tunnel.
examples.zh: 車輛疾駛穿越快速道路隧道時，明亮的車頭大燈照亮了隧道內壁弧形的水泥反光牆面。

examples.en: Boring large-diameter tunnels reduces internal aerodynamic drag when bullet trains pass at full throttle.
examples.zh: 鑽掘大斷面「雙軌鐵路隧道」（Tunnel），能大幅減輕子彈列車全速會車時產生的強烈氣流阻力。

examples.en: Commuters drove through the undersea traffic tunnel linking the harbor island to the city mainland.
examples.zh: 每日早晚繁忙的通勤族駕車穿越這座海底過港隧道，往返於外島港區與都會本土核心地帶。

examples.en: Groundhogs tunnel extensively beneath garden lawns, digging complex underground burrow networks.
examples.zh: 土撥鼠在花園草坪下方四處挖掘隧道，日積月累構築出一套錯綜複雜的地下巢穴地道網絡。

entries.definition: 隧道；開鑿隧道；三百六十度全景沉浸式海底步道玻璃隧道；雙向雙軌寬斷面緩解活塞效應之長大隧道

explains.en: A passage built underground or through a mountain lets people, trains, or water pass through. Lights help drivers see. Ventilation brings in fresh air.
Some animals dig underground paths. Rabbits may hide in them. The underground paths can have several openings.
A bridge goes over an obstacle, while this structure goes under or through it. Both help people travel. Engineers plan carefully for safety.

examples.en: The tutor helped Leo understand fractions.
examples.zh: 家教老師幫助里歐理解分數。

examples.en: She tutors younger students in reading.
examples.zh: 她指導年紀較小的學生閱讀。

examples.en: Our tutor meets with us every Wednesday.
examples.zh: 我們的家教老師每週三和我們見面。

explains.en: A person who gives extra lessons to one student or a small group is called this. They help explain difficult subjects. Practice can build confidence.
As a verb, it means teaching someone outside a regular class. A student may get help with math. The lessons can be in person or online.
A classroom teacher works with a full class, while this educator may give more personal attention. The student can ask questions. Different subjects need different approaches.

examples.en: Engineers monitor automated fab operations in real time using an exact digital twin of the assembly line.
examples.zh: 工程師透過與實體產線同步連動的「數位孿生模型」（Digital Twin），隨時監控晶圓廠機台運作狀態。

examples.en: The city government created a digital twin of downtown traffic grids to test flood drainage scenarios.
examples.zh: 市政府建立了市中心交通路網的數位孿生體，用以模擬測試暴雨淹水時的排洪疏導方案。

examples.en: She gave birth to healthy twin girls at the regional medical center last Tuesday morning.
examples.zh: 她上週二上午在區域醫療中心順利平安誕下了一對健康的雙胞胎女嬰。

entries.definition: 晶圓廠與智慧工廠即時連動之數位孿生；孿生

explains.en: One of two children born to the same mother at the same time is called this. They may look alike or different. Some share the same birthday.
This term can also describe one of a pair of matching objects. A bed may have a size for one person. The context shows whether it refers to a person or an item.
A sibling is a brother or sister, while this word refers to one of a pair born together or a matching thing. The two may be very similar. Families differ.

examples.en: She twisted the cap off the bottle.
examples.zh: 她轉開了瓶蓋。

examples.en: The path twisted through the forest.
examples.zh: 小路蜿蜒穿過森林。

examples.en: The story took a surprising twist at the end.
examples.zh: 故事結尾出現了令人驚訝的轉折。

entries.definition: （動）扭轉；纏繞；使彎曲；（名）轉折；扭動

explains.en: To turn something around itself or bend it into a different shape is to do this. A person may turn a rope. It can become tighter.
A story can have an unexpected change in what happens. The ending may surprise the reader. This is a figurative use.
Straight means not bent, while this verb describes turning or bending. A dancer may turn their body. The sentence shows the meaning.

examples.en: The underlying rock made digging difficult.
examples.zh: 底層岩石讓挖掘變得困難。

examples.en: The teacher helped us find the underlying cause of the error.
examples.zh: 老師幫我們找出錯誤的根本原因。

examples.en: An underlying theme connects the chapters.
examples.zh: 一個潛在的主題串連了這些章節。

entries.definition: 在下面的；根本的；潛在的；基礎的

explains.en: Something that exists beneath the surface or forms the basic cause of a situation can be described this way. A hidden pipe may run below a garden. The topsoil covers it.
A person's basic reason for an action may not be obvious at first. Asking questions can help explain it. More information may be needed.
Visible things can be seen directly, while this adjective points to something less obvious or underneath. A problem may have a deeper cause. Context helps reveal it.

examples.en: She packed clean underwear for the trip.
examples.zh: 她為旅程準備了乾淨的內衣褲。

examples.en: The store sells cotton underwear in many sizes.
examples.zh: 這家店販售多種尺寸的棉質內衣褲。

examples.en: He folded his underwear and put it in the drawer.
examples.zh: 他把內衣褲摺好放進抽屜。

explains.en: Clothing worn beneath outer clothes is called this. It is usually soft and comfortable. Change it every day.
Different kinds cover different parts of the body. Choose the right size and wash it regularly. It is private clothing.
A coat is worn on the outside, while this clothing is worn next to the skin. People should respect privacy. Keep clean items separate from dirty ones.

examples.en: The workers formed a union to discuss safer conditions.
examples.zh: 工人組成工會討論更安全的工作條件。

examples.en: The two clubs announced a union for the charity event.
examples.zh: 兩個社團宣布合辦慈善活動。

examples.en: Their union brought the families together.
examples.zh: 他們的結合讓兩個家庭聚在一起。

explains.en: A group formed to bring people together for a shared purpose is called this. Workers may join to speak together about fair conditions. Members decide how it works.
The word can also mean the act of joining things or people. Two clubs may combine their activities. Together they can share resources.
Separate means apart, while this noun suggests joining. A country may be made from several regions joined together. The context gives the meaning.

examples.en: Each snowflake has a unique pattern.
examples.zh: 每片雪花都有獨特的圖案。

examples.en: The artist made a unique chair from driftwood.
examples.zh: 藝術家用漂流木製作了一把獨一無二的椅子。

examples.en: Her unique voice was easy to recognize.
examples.zh: 她獨特的嗓音很容易辨認。

explains.en: Something that is the only one of its kind can be described this way. A handmade cup may have a pattern unlike any other. It is special.
A person's skills and experiences are unlike anyone else's. People can appreciate those differences. Everyone has their own strengths.
Common things are found everywhere, while this adjective suggests something rare or one of a kind. A fingerprint is different for each person. The word can also mean unusual.

examples.en: The class united to raise money for the shelter.
examples.zh: 全班團結起來為收容所募款。

examples.en: The two teams united for a charity game.
examples.zh: 兩支隊伍為慈善賽而合作。

examples.en: Music united the audience in song.
examples.zh: 音樂讓觀眾一起唱了起來。

explains.en: To bring people or things together is to do this. A team may join its efforts to solve a problem. Working together can help.
People can become one group for a shared goal. A community may join to clean a park. Each person can contribute.
Separate means keep apart, while this verb means join together. A bridge can connect two sides. A common purpose may bring people together.

examples.en: The team showed unity by helping every player.
examples.zh: 隊伍互相幫助每位球員，展現了團結。

examples.en: The mural’s colors created a sense of unity.
examples.zh: 壁畫的色彩營造出整體一致的感覺。

examples.en: Unity helped the neighbors rebuild the playground.
examples.zh: 團結讓鄰居們一起重建遊樂場。

explains.en: A state of being joined together as one group is called this. A team works toward the same goal. Members support each other.
A design may look balanced because all its parts fit together. Artists think about colors and shapes. Their choices can create a whole.
Division separates people, while this noun describes connection and agreement. Groups can have different ideas and still work together. Respect helps build it.

examples.en: Urban gardens grow vegetables on city rooftops.
examples.zh: 城市花園在屋頂上種植蔬菜。

examples.en: The urban bus system serves many neighborhoods.
examples.zh: 城市公車系統服務許多社區。

examples.en: An urban park gives residents a place to relax.
examples.zh: 都市公園提供居民休息的地方。

explains.en: A place related to a city or town can be described this way. It may have many buildings and roads. People often use public transit.
The word can describe planning for homes, parks, and businesses in cities. Good design makes places easier to live in. Green spaces are helpful.
Rural refers to the countryside, while this adjective relates to towns and cities. The two areas have different needs. Maps show where they are.

examples.en: The vacant room was ready for new guests.
examples.zh: 空房間已準備好迎接新房客。

examples.en: A vacant seat beside the window was available.
examples.zh: 窗邊有一個空位。

examples.en: The company advertised a vacant position for a designer.
examples.zh: 公司刊登了一個設計師職缺。

entries.definition: 空著的；未被佔用的；空缺的

explains.en: An empty space or building that is not being used fits this meaning. An empty seat is ready for someone to sit. Look for a sign.
A job position with no worker may also be described this way. A company may be looking for someone to fill it. Check the listing for details.
Occupied means someone is using a space, while this adjective means it is empty. An empty lot has no building on it. Context shows what is unoccupied.

examples.en: The white van stopped outside the school.
examples.zh: 廂型車把隊伍的行李載到飯店。

examples.en: A van brought fresh bread to the shop.
examples.zh: 一共有三個孩子坐在後座。

examples.en: We loaded our camping gear into the van.
examples.zh: 司機把車停在大門旁。

entries.definition: 廂型車；小型貨車；客貨車

explains.en: This kind of small bus or truck carries people or goods. It often has a wide side door. Families and workers use it for short trips.
This vehicle is larger than many cars. It often has a wide door on its side. Families and workers use it to carry people or things.
A delivery company may use this kind of vehicle. Its open space can hold many boxes. Some models have windows all around.

examples.en: The rabbit seemed to vanish behind the tall grass.
examples.zh: 兔子似乎在高草後消失了。

examples.en: The footprints began to vanish in the falling snow.
examples.zh: 腳印開始在飄落的雪中消失。

examples.en: Her smile did not vanish when the rain started.
examples.zh: 下雨時，她的笑容沒有消失。

entries.definition: 消失；突然不見；逐漸消散。

explains.en: To disappear is to become impossible to see. A coin may seem to do this under a cloth. It is still there even when eyes cannot find it.
A puddle can become smaller on a sunny day. The water slowly dries into the air. After a while, the puddle may be gone.
A person in a story might suddenly be gone from a room. The people nearby may be surprised. They look around to find out where that person went.

examples.en: The market sells a wide variety of fresh fruit.
examples.zh: 市場販售種類繁多的新鮮水果。

examples.en: Our class tried a variety of science games.
examples.zh: 我們班試玩了各種科學遊戲。

examples.en: This variety of rose has bright yellow petals.
examples.zh: 這種玫瑰開著鮮黃色的花。

explains.en: A large selection means many different kinds of something. A fruit shop may sell apples with different colors or tastes. Shoppers can choose what they like.
A garden with many flowers has more choice than one with a single kind. Different shapes make it interesting to look at. People can choose the flowers they like best.
The word can describe a type of something too. A certain kind of tomato may grow well in warm weather. Gardeners pick a type that suits their space.

examples.en: Various birds gathered around the pond.
examples.zh: 各種鳥兒聚集在池塘周圍。

examples.en: She packed various snacks for the long trip.
examples.zh: 她為長途旅行帶了各種點心。

examples.en: The store sells various sizes of notebooks.
examples.zh: 這家店販售各種尺寸的筆記本。

explains.en: Several different items can be described together this way. A box may hold pencils, crayons, and markers. The items do not all have to be alike.
A person can do different activities during a free day. They might read, walk, or visit a friend. The word points to more than one kind.
A museum can show objects from many times and places. Each object tells a different story. Visitors see many kinds of things there.

examples.en: The trail can vary in length from one park to another.
examples.zh: 這條步道的長度會因公園而異。

examples.en: Please vary your voice when you read the story.
examples.zh: 讀故事時請改變你的語調。

examples.en: The color of the leaves may vary in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天的葉子顏色可能會有所不同。

explains.en: To change is to become different instead of staying the same. A cook may use a little more spice in one dish. The next dish can taste different.
The weather can change from one day to another. Some mornings are cool, and others are warm. The amount is not always the same.
A teacher may change an activity to keep a lesson interesting. Children can draw, read, and talk. Each part gives them a different way to learn.

examples.en: Dad put the roses in a blue vase.
examples.zh: 爸爸把玫瑰放進藍色花瓶裡。

examples.en: The tall vase stood beside the window.
examples.zh: 高高的花瓶立在窗邊。

examples.en: Please fill the vase with clean water.
examples.zh: 請在花瓶裡裝乾淨的水。

explains.en: This container is made to hold flowers. It may be made of glass, clay, or metal. Its opening is usually wide enough for stems.
People often place this container on a table or shelf. Water inside helps cut flowers stay fresh. Some designs are plain, while others have patterns.
This object can also be a decoration by itself. It may have a bright color or a special shape. Handle a glass one carefully because it can break.

examples.en: Electric vehicles are becoming increasingly popular in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 電動車在台灣越來越受到歡迎。

examples.en: Heavy goods vehicles are not permitted on this residential road.
examples.zh: 大型貨運車輛不得行駛於這條住宅區道路。

examples.en: Make sure all passengers exit the vehicle safely.
examples.zh: 確保所有乘客都已安全下車。

examples.en: The tethered robotic vehicle transmits 4K live video from six thousand meters below the research ship.
examples.zh: 搭載光纖臍帶纜的「深海無人遙控載具」（Remotely Operated Vehicle ROV），從六千公尺深海回傳 4K 實況。

examples.en: Electric vehicle adoption has accelerated rapidly as public charging station networks expand nationwide.
examples.zh: 隨著全國公有充電樁網路快速鋪設，國人換購電動車輛的普及速度展現出爆發性成長。

examples.en: Art and music serve as a wonderful creative vehicle for expressing complex human emotions.
examples.zh: 藝術與音樂向來是人類抒發深邃複雜情感、連結不同心靈最美妙動人的創造性媒介載體。

entries.definition: 車輛；交通工具；載具；六千公尺級深海無人遙控潛水器 (ROV 探測器)

explains.en: A machine for carrying people or goods from place to place has this name. A bus carries many passengers. A bicycle carries one rider at a time.
Cars, trucks, and trains are different kinds of transport. They move on roads or tracks. Some use fuel, while others use electricity.
The word can also name a small machine guided underwater. Scientists use it to look at the deep ocean. It can send pictures back to a boat.

examples.en: Our class learned a verse from the song.
examples.zh: 我們班學了這首歌的一段歌詞。

examples.en: The final verse tells how the journey ends.
examples.zh: 最後一段詩句說明旅程如何結束。

examples.en: She wrote a short verse about her cat.
examples.zh: 她寫了一小段關於貓的詩。

explains.en: A group of lines in a poem or song has this name. The lines often belong together in meaning. Some songs have several such parts.
Poems may be divided into small groups of lines. Each group can share a rhythm or rhyme. Readers pause briefly between groups.
In a songbook, one part may come before the repeating chorus. Singers learn each part in order. The words tell a story or share a feeling.

examples.en: He wore a red vest over his white shirt.
examples.zh: 他在白襯衫外穿了一件紅色背心。

examples.en: The worker put on a bright vest before crossing the road.
examples.zh: 工人過馬路前穿上了醒目的背心。

examples.en: Grandma knitted a warm vest for the baby.
examples.zh: 奶奶為寶寶織了一件暖和的背心。

explains.en: This piece of clothing is worn over a shirt. It covers the chest but usually has no sleeves. Some people wear it as part of a suit.
A warm padded layer can help keep a person cozy outside. A bright safety style helps workers be seen. Different kinds serve different purposes.
This garment may close with buttons or a zipper. It can have pockets in front. People choose a style to fit the weather or occasion.

examples.en: The storm victim received a dry blanket.
examples.zh: 風暴受災者收到一條乾燥的毯子。

examples.en: A kind neighbor helped the victim of the accident.
examples.zh: 好心的鄰居幫助了事故中的受害者。

examples.en: The book tells how the victim escaped safely.
examples.zh: 書中描述受害者如何安全逃脫。

explains.en: A person harmed by an event or action has this name. Someone whose bike was stolen may need help. The word describes what happened to that person.
A storm can damage houses and trees. People affected by the damage may need food or shelter. Neighbors can offer kind support.
The word can also describe an animal harmed by another animal. A nature book may explain what happened. It helps readers understand the event.

examples.en: The school teaches children to solve problems without violence.
examples.zh: 學校教孩子不用暴力解決問題。

examples.en: The film showed violence, so Mia chose another movie.
examples.zh: 電影有暴力場面，所以米亞選了另一部片。

examples.en: The community spoke out against violence in the park.
examples.zh: 社區居民公開反對公園裡的暴力行為。

entries.definition: 暴力；暴行；激烈或強烈的力量。

explains.en: This means actions that physically hurt people or damage things. Such actions can make others feel unsafe. Peaceful choices avoid this kind of harm.
A story may include fighting or other harmful actions. Parents and teachers may discuss why those actions cause pain. Characters can choose a kinder way.
People can solve many disagreements by talking calmly. Listening helps each side explain its feelings. No one needs to hurt another person.

examples.en: The violent storm knocked down several trees.
examples.zh: 猛烈的暴風雨吹倒了好幾棵樹。

examples.en: The teacher stopped the violent fight at once.
examples.zh: 老師立刻制止了激烈的打鬥。

examples.en: Waves became violent during the strong storm.
examples.zh: 強風暴期間，海浪變得很猛烈。

explains.en: This describes an action that uses force and may hurt someone. A strong fight can fit this meaning. The word can also describe damage caused by a storm.
A storm with powerful winds may break branches and windows. It can be dangerous to stand outside. People stay in a safe place until it passes.
A loud, forceful action can frighten others. Gentle behavior makes people feel safer. The word warns that something is rough or harmful.

examples.en: She painted a violet star on the card.
examples.zh: 她在卡片上畫了一顆紫羅蘭色的星星。

examples.en: A violet grew beside the garden path.
examples.zh: 一朵紫羅蘭長在花園小徑旁。

examples.en: The sky turned violet as the sun went down.
examples.zh: 太陽下山時，天空轉為紫羅蘭色。

entries.definition: （形）紫羅蘭色的；（名）紫羅蘭；紫色

explains.en: This is a color between blue and purple. Some flowers have petals in this shade. It can look soft or bright depending on the light.
A rainbow includes this color near its blue edge. It is often shown at the end of the color order. Paint can be mixed to make a similar shade.
The word also names a small flower. Its petals may be purple or blue. These flowers often grow close to the ground.

examples.en: The mountain was visible from our classroom.
examples.zh: 從我們的教室可以看見那座山。

examples.en: Make sure your name is visible on the bag.
examples.zh: 請確保你的名字在袋子上清晰可見。

examples.en: The stars were visible after the clouds moved away.
examples.zh: 雲散去後，星星清晰可見。

entries.definition: 看得見的；明顯的；可辨認的

explains.en: Able to be seen means easy to notice. A bright moon stands out in a clear sky. Thick clouds can hide it from view.
A sign should be easy for people to see. Bright letters help it stand out from far away. A hidden sign is hard to notice.
Some things can be seen, while others are too tiny or far away. A telescope helps people look at distant objects. Light also helps eyes see.

examples.en: Her vision was blurry until she put on her glasses.
examples.zh: 她戴上眼鏡後，視力變清楚了。

examples.en: The young architect had a vision for a greener town.
examples.zh: 這位年輕建築師對更綠意的城鎮有一番構想。

examples.en: A bright lamp improved my vision while reading.
examples.zh: 明亮的燈改善了我閱讀時的視力。

entries.definition: 視力；視覺；遠見；想像；景象。

explains.en: The ability to see with the eyes has this name. Glasses can help some people see more clearly. An eye doctor can check how well someone sees.
The word can also mean an idea of what someone hopes to make or do. An artist may imagine a picture before painting it. Planning can help turn an idea into a real project.
People use their eyes to notice shapes and colors. Good light makes reading easier. Some people use special tools to help them see.

examples.en: Oranges contain a vitamin that helps the body stay healthy.
examples.zh: 橘子含有一種有助身體保持健康的維生素。

examples.en: The doctor explained why each vitamin matters.
examples.zh: 醫生解釋了每種維生素為何重要。

examples.en: Carrots provide a vitamin that supports healthy eyes.
examples.zh: 胡蘿蔔提供一種有益眼睛健康的維生素。

explains.en: A helpful substance in food supports the body’s work. Fruits and vegetables contain different kinds. Eating varied foods can provide many useful nutrients.
People need only small amounts of these nutrients. Milk, eggs, and beans can be sources. A balanced meal includes different foods.
A bottle may contain these nutrients as tablets. Children should take them only with an adult’s guidance. Food is an important part of staying healthy.

examples.en: The artist used vivid colors in her painting.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家在畫作中使用鮮明的色彩。

examples.en: He gave a vivid account of the mountain hike.
examples.zh: 他生動地描述了登山之旅。

examples.en: A vivid orange scarf brightened her coat.
examples.zh: 一條鮮橙色圍巾讓她的外套亮了起來。

explains.en: Bright colors that are easy to notice can be described this way. A strong red kite stands out against a pale sky. Such colors catch the eye.
A person may remember a dream very clearly. The pictures and events seem sharp in the mind. It can feel almost like being there.
Writers use clear details to help readers imagine a scene. They may describe sounds, colors, and smells. Such details make a story feel lively.

examples.en: A broad vocabulary gives you the wings to fly across international borders and explore the universe.
examples.zh: 掌握堅實豐富的「核心實用詞彙庫」（Vocabulary），如同為你的心靈插上飛向全世界的金色翅膀。

examples.en: Expanding your active vocabulary enables you to choose words that express your exact thoughts.
examples.zh: 不斷擴充你的主動應用詞彙量，能讓你在表達思想時精準挑選出最貼切傳神的字眼。

examples.en: Learning specialized medical vocabulary prepares healthcare professionals to collaborate globally.
examples.zh: 學習專業的醫療核心詞彙，能為醫護從業人員參與國際合作與學術交流奠定厚實基礎。

entries.definition: 融會貫通七千實用單字之豐富強大詞彙庫；詞彙

explains.en: The words a person knows and uses form a personal store of language. Reading can help children learn more words. New words make it easier to share ideas.
A dictionary explains what words mean and how to spell them. Students can use it while reading. Practicing unfamiliar words helps them remember.
A word list in a book can help learners study. It may group terms by topic or letter. Reviewing the list builds skill in reading and speaking.

examples.en: We played beach volleyball during our seaside holiday in Kenting.
examples.zh: 我們在墾丁海邊度假時打了沙灘排球。

examples.en: The setter delivered a perfect pass for the middle blocker to spike the volleyball.
examples.zh: 舉球員送出了一記完美傳球，讓快攻手強勢扣殺排球。

examples.en: Team communication is essential on the volleyball court.
examples.zh: 排球場上的團隊溝通呼應至關重要。

explains.en: Two teams play this sport on opposite sides of a high net. They hit a ball back and forth using their hands or arms. A team scores when the ball lands on the other side.
Players take turns serving the ball to begin a play. Teammates call out so they do not bump into one another. The game can be played indoors or on a beach.
A match begins with a serve from behind the end line. Players move into position to return each hit. Quick teamwork can keep the ball in play.

examples.en: Turn down the TV volume; baby is taking a nap.
examples.zh: 把電視音量調小一點，小寶寶正在睡午覺。

examples.en: The sales volume of electric scooters hit an all-time high last quarter.
examples.zh: 電動機車的銷售量在上一季創下了歷史新高。

examples.en: This comprehensive encyclopedia consists of twelve thick leather volumes.
examples.zh: 這套完備的百科全書一共由十二本厚實的精裝卷冊組成。

examples.en: The physical volume per seat ratio determines the maximum natural reverberation time attainable in the space.
examples.zh: 每個座位的平均「空間聲學體積」（Acoustic Volume），決定了該音樂廳所能達到的天然最長殘響極限。

examples.en: Please turn down the television speaker volume so your sleeping baby sister is not woken up.
examples.zh: 請隨手調低客廳電視機的喇叭播放音量，以免驚醒正在臥室嬰兒床上甜甜熟睡的小妹妹。

examples.en: The university library preserves an irreplaceable rare book volume bound in hand-stitched pigskin vellum.
examples.zh: 大學總圖書館特藏室悉心珍藏著一卷舉世無雙的珍罕中世紀羊皮手抄典籍善本。

entries.definition: 音量；容量；卷冊；透過殘響室連通調節音樂廳整體有效立方體積；體積

explains.en: A control on a radio changes how loud the sound is. Turning it up makes music louder. Turning it down makes the sound softer.
One book in a set can be called a single book in the series. The books may tell different parts of a long story. A number on the cover shows its place.
In science, this word can mean how much space something takes up. A cup holds a certain amount of water. Large objects usually take up more space than small ones.

examples.en: Eligible voters lined up patiently at polling stations to cast ballots.
examples.zh: 合格選民在投開票所前耐心排隊領票並投票。

examples.en: Young voters are increasingly concerned about environmental and housing policies.
examples.zh: 青年選民群體越來越深刻關注環境永續與居住正義相關政策。

examples.en: The televised debate helped undecided voters make their final choices.
examples.zh: 電視辯論會有效幫助尚未做出決定的中間選民做出最終抉擇。

explains.en: A person who chooses among candidates or ideas in an election has this role. Adults may mark a paper or use a machine. Each choice helps decide the result.
Before choosing, people may learn about the candidates. An election gives them a chance to express a preference. Rules explain who may take part.
Some elections let people choose a local leader, while others decide a public question. The choices are counted after the voting ends. The result reflects the community’s selections.

examples.en: The statutory minimum hourly wage was adjusted upwards this January.
examples.zh: 法定最低基本時薪於今年一月起正式調漲。

examples.en: Hospital staff campaigned for a fair living wage reflecting their tireless dedication.
examples.zh: 醫院工作人員爭取能反映其不知疲倦付出的合理基本生活工資。

examples.en: He earned a reliable weekly wage while working as an apprentice carpenter.
examples.zh: 他擔任學徒木匠期間每週賺取一份穩定的工資。

explains.en: Money paid to workers for doing a job is called pay. A worker may receive it each week. The amount can depend on the work and time spent.
A person may earn money by working a set number of hours. A written agreement can state the rate. Keeping a record helps track each payment.
A person may earn money by working a set number of hours. A written agreement can state the rate. Keeping a record helps track payments.

examples.en: The farmer loaded pumpkins onto the wagon.
examples.zh: 農夫把南瓜裝上馬車。

examples.en: A child pulled her wagon along the path.
examples.zh: 孩子沿著小路拉著她的手拉車。

examples.en: The old wagon carried sacks of grain.
examples.zh: 那輛舊貨車載著幾袋穀物。

entries.definition: 四輪馬車；手拉車；運貨車

explains.en: This small wheeled cart carries things. A child may pull one with toys inside. Farms may use larger carts for tools or crops.
Some carts are pulled by a person or an animal. Others attach to a car or tractor. Their open space makes loading easier.
A covered cart has a roof made from cloth or another material. Long ago, families used such carts on journeys. The cover helped protect them from sun and rain.

examples.en: We like to wander through the market on Saturdays.
examples.zh: 我們喜歡在星期六漫步逛市場。

examples.en: The puppy began to wander away from its owner.
examples.zh: 小狗開始漫無目的地走離主人身邊。

examples.en: They wandered along the beach after lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐後，他們沿著海灘漫步。

entries.definition: 漫步；閒逛；徘徊；走失；離題。

explains.en: To walk around without a fixed route or destination is to explore freely. A visitor may look around the streets of a new town. They can stop wherever something interests them.
A person may move slowly from place to place in a garden. They might look at flowers and listen to birds. There is no hurry to reach a certain spot.
Ideas can also move from one subject to another. A speaker may lose track of the main point. A clear plan can help keep the talk focused.

examples.en: Adding natural wood elements infuses minimalist concrete living rooms with cozy organic warmth.
examples.zh: 在現代簡約冷冽的清水模客廳中添置幾件原木家具，瞬間為居家空間注入一股來自大地的溫潤暖意。

examples.en: The heartfelt smile and friendly greetings of the B&B owner brought genuine warmth to the tired hikers.
examples.zh: 民宿老闆娘真誠燦爛的笑容與貼心的問候關懷，為疲憊不堪的登山客心中帶來了無比的溫暖。

examples.en: We gathered around the stone fireplace to enjoy the comforting thermal warmth on a freezing winter night.
examples.zh: 在寒流來襲氣溫驟降的冬夜裡，大家圍坐在石造壁爐旁取暖，享受著柴火散發出舒心愜意的融融暖意。

examples.en: Golden glow vacuum tubes infuse cold synthesizer sounds with intoxicating vintage warmth and richness.
examples.zh: 散發溫暖金黃微光的真空管，為冰冷的合成器音符注入令人陶醉的復古溫潤暖意。

examples.en: The comforting physical warmth of a wool blanket on a chilly winter evening helps you relax completely.
examples.zh: 在寒意逼人的冬日夜晚裡，裹上一條溫暖舒適的羊毛毯，能讓身心瞬間得到徹底的放鬆釋放。

examples.en: Her open smile and kind, welcoming demeanor brought genuine hospitality and warmth to the exhausted travelers.
examples.zh: 她親切真誠的燦爛笑容與熱情溫暖的待客之道，為舟車勞頓、疲憊不堪的旅人心中帶來了如沐春風的暖意。

examples.en: Generous timber paneling enhances acoustic warmth, giving double basses a deep, resonant bloom.
examples.zh: 大面積實木護牆板大幅增強了「聲音溫暖度」（Warmth），讓低音大提琴呈現深沉渾厚的共鳴。

examples.en: Sitting beside the crackling brick hearth fire, she savored the comforting warmth of hot ginger tea.
examples.zh: 坐在劈啪作響的磚造壁爐火旁，她細細品啜著熱薑茶帶來的驅寒舒暢與溫暖暖意。

examples.en: The host welcomed international exchange students with genuine personal warmth and generous hospitality.
examples.zh: 主辦家庭以無比真摯由衷的個人親和溫暖與慷慨好客，熱情迎接遠道而來的各國國際交換學生。

entries.definition: 為現代水泥家居注入大地溫潤暖意；真空管擴大機復古溫潤管味暖意；低音大提琴與法國號深沉溫暖之低頻音色豐潤度；溫暖

explains.en: A comfortable feeling of heat can make a room pleasant. A coat gives this feeling on a cold day. A sunny room can feel cozy in winter.
A kind smile can make a person feel cared for. This emotional feeling differs from heat from a fire. Both uses describe comfort.
A warm blanket holds heat around the body. People may wrap one around themselves on a cool evening. It can make resting more comfortable.

examples.en: The sign will warn hikers about loose rocks.
examples.zh: 這個標誌會提醒登山客注意鬆動的岩石。

examples.en: I called to warn Sam that the gate was open.
examples.zh: 我打電話提醒山姆大門開著。

examples.en: Dark clouds warn us that rain may be near.
examples.zh: 烏雲警告我們雨可能快來了。

explains.en: To tell someone about possible danger or trouble is to alert them. A sign may tell drivers about a sharp turn. The message gives people time to be careful.
A friend may remind another person about a coming storm. They can bring an umbrella or stay indoors. Helpful messages let people prepare.
Parents may tell children not to touch a hot pan. The message explains a risk before anyone gets hurt. Listening can keep people safe.

examples.en: Shifen Waterfall in Pingxi is often nicknamed the Little Niagara of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 平溪的十分瀑布常被暱稱為「台灣的小尼加拉瀑布」。

examples.en: Sunlight passing through mist around the waterfall forms a vibrant double rainbow.
examples.zh: 陽光穿透瀑布周圍瀰漫的水氣薄霧，在潭面映照出繽紛奪目的雙彩虹。

examples.en: The roaring sound of the cascading waterfall echoed through the mountain valley.
examples.zh: 層疊奔騰的瀑布發出震耳欲聾的轟鳴水聲，在深山峽谷間久久迴盪。

explains.en: A river or stream may flow over a steep edge and drop to a lower place. The falling water can make a loud sound. This natural feature often attracts visitors.
Some are small enough to step across, while others are very tall. Rocks and plants often grow nearby. Visitors stay behind safe barriers.
A river may travel over rocks and then fall into a pool. The moving water carries air and makes a mist. Many people enjoy the sound of it.

examples.en: The candle was made of yellow wax.
examples.zh: 這根蠟燭是用黃色蠟製成的。

examples.en: Warm wax dripped onto the old table.
examples.zh: 溫熱的蠟滴在舊桌子上。

examples.en: We used wax to polish the wooden floor.
examples.zh: 我們用蠟擦亮木地板。

entries.definition: （名）蠟；耳垢；（動）上蠟；逐漸變大／增強

explains.en: This soft material can melt when heated. Candles are often made from it. When it cools, it becomes firm again.
Some people use this material to cover a surface. It can make wood or shoes look smooth. A thin layer can also help protect them.
Bees make a natural kind of this material. People use it for candles and other items. Heat changes its shape, so it is easy to form.

examples.en: The heavy rain may weaken the old wall.
examples.zh: 大雨可能會削弱老牆的結構。

examples.en: Lack of water can weaken a young tree.
examples.zh: 缺水會使幼樹變得脆弱。

examples.en: The wind weakened before evening.
examples.zh: 傍晚前，風勢減弱了。

explains.en: To make something less strong is to reduce its strength. A long dry spell can harm a plant. Water may help it grow again.
A rope can lose strength after years in the sun. It may break more easily than a new rope. Checking old equipment can prevent accidents.
A person can feel less strong when tired or ill. Rest and care may help them recover. The word describes a loss of strength.

examples.en: Generous wealthy philanthropists donate substantial funds to medical research.
examples.zh: 慷慨大度且富有的慈善家捐贈了巨額資金支持前瞻醫學研究。

examples.en: The tech mogul grew up in modest circumstances before founding a wealthy enterprise.
examples.zh: 這位科技巨擘出身清寒寒微，白手起家創立了實力雄厚富有的跨國企業。

examples.en: The countryside estate was situated in one of the most wealthy neighborhoods in the region.
examples.zh: 這處典雅悠閒的鄉間莊園座落於該地區環境最為幽靜富裕的頂級別墅豪宅區。

explains.en: Having a great deal of money or valuable things describes a person with much more than basic needs. Such a person may own several homes. This describes financial comfort.
Some communities have people with very different amounts of money. A person with wealth may choose to share with others. Kindness is not measured by money.
Valuable land, savings, or businesses can make a family financially comfortable. Money can pay for homes and services. People still need to make thoughtful choices.

examples.en: The guard kept the weapon locked away.
examples.zh: 警衛把武器鎖好收起來。

examples.en: The museum displayed an ancient weapon behind glass.
examples.zh: 博物館把一件古代武器陳列在玻璃櫃後。

examples.en: The story’s hero chose to put down his weapon.
examples.zh: 故事中的英雄選擇放下武器。

entries.definition: 武器；兵器；用來造成傷害的工具。

explains.en: An object used to hurt someone or to defend against attack has this name. It can be dangerous. Stories may show people putting such objects away to keep others safe.
Some animals have body parts used for defense, such as sharp horns. These can injure another creature. People should keep a safe distance from wild animals.
The word appears in history books about battles. Museums may display old objects behind glass. Adults explain how they were used long ago.

examples.en: Grandma can weave a basket from reeds.
examples.zh: 奶奶會用蘆葦編籃子。

examples.en: The artist wove blue thread into the cloth.
examples.zh: 藝術家把藍色線織進布料裡。

examples.en: We watched the craft worker weave a small rug.
examples.zh: 我們看著工藝師編織一張小地毯。

explains.en: To cross strips or threads over and under one another is to make cloth or a basket. The repeated pattern holds the pieces together. Different colors can create designs.
A person can use yarn on a loom to make fabric. One thread passes across many others. Different colors create patterns.
People may braid strips of grass into a mat. Each strip goes above and below the next. Careful hands keep the shape neat.

examples.en: A spider built a web between two leaves.
examples.zh: 蜘蛛在兩片葉子之間結了一張網。

examples.en: I found the recipe on a cooking web page.
examples.zh: 我在烹飪網頁上找到食譜。

examples.en: Morning dew shone on the web.
examples.zh: 晨露在蜘蛛網上閃閃發亮。

explains.en: A fine net made by a spider has this name. The spider uses silk threads to make it. Small insects may get caught in the sticky strands.
The word can also mean pages and information connected on the internet. People open these pages with a browser. They can read, watch, or learn online.
Spider threads often stretch between branches or corners. Dew drops make them easier to see in the morning. The pattern can look delicate and neat.

examples.en: The prince will wed the princess in spring.
examples.zh: 王子將在春天迎娶公主。

examples.en: They plan to wed beside the lake.
examples.zh: 他們打算在湖邊結婚。

examples.en: The couple wed in a small garden ceremony.
examples.zh: 這對伴侶在小花園裡結了婚。

explains.en: To marry someone is to make a promise to share a life together. The couple may invite friends and family to a ceremony. Different families have different customs.
Two people may make a promise to share their lives. They can celebrate with a ceremony. Different families have different customs.
This is a formal word often found in stories or news. Everyday speakers usually say “get married.” Both expressions refer to the same event.

examples.en: A weed grew between the paving stones.
examples.zh: 一株雜草從石板縫裡長出來。

examples.en: Dad pulled each weed from the vegetable bed.
examples.zh: 爸爸把菜圃裡的每株雜草都拔掉。

examples.en: The garden was free of weeds after their work.
examples.zh: 他們整理後，花園裡沒有雜草了。

explains.en: An unwanted plant in a garden has this name. It may take water and space from flowers. Gardeners sometimes pull it out by its roots.
Not every wild plant is harmful. A plant becomes a nuisance when it grows in the wrong place. Some are useful to insects or birds.
A lawn may have unwanted plants among the grass. A gardener can remove them carefully. Leaving the soil covered helps other plants grow.

examples.en: Our class has a weekly spelling quiz.
examples.zh: 我們班每週都有一次拼字小考。

examples.en: She writes a weekly note to her grandparents.
examples.zh: 她每週寫一張便條給祖父母。

examples.en: The weekly market opens every Saturday.
examples.zh: 每週市集在星期六開市。

explains.en: Happening once each week or relating to a week has this meaning. A lesson on this schedule takes place every seven days. A calendar helps people remember it.
A magazine that comes out every seven days brings new stories regularly. Readers can expect another issue soon. A date on its cover shows when it arrived.
People may plan meals or chores for the whole week. A plan for those seven days shows what happens each day. It helps keep busy tasks organized.

examples.en: The child began to weep when he lost his toy.
examples.zh: 孩子弄丟玩具後開始哭泣。

examples.en: She did not weep when the sad movie ended.
examples.zh: 悲傷電影結束時，她沒有哭。

examples.en: He wept with relief after finding his dog.
examples.zh: 找到狗之後，他如釋重負地哭了。

explains.en: To cry, often because of sadness or strong feelings, is to let tears come. A caring friend can offer comfort. Talking may help someone feel better.
People can cry when they are hurt or very happy. Feelings sometimes bring tears without warning. Talking may help someone feel better.
This word is more common in stories than in casual talk. It can make a scene sound serious or gentle. The meaning is close to crying.

examples.en: The farmer planted wheat in the large field.
examples.zh: 農夫在大田裡種了小麥。

examples.en: This bread is made with whole wheat flour.
examples.zh: 這種麵包是用全麥麵粉製成的。

examples.en: Golden wheat moved in the summer breeze.
examples.zh: 金黃色的小麥在夏日微風中搖曳。

explains.en: This grain grows in fields, and people grind its seeds into flour. Flour can be used to make bread, noodles, and cakes. It is an important food crop.
The plant has long green leaves and a head of seeds. Farmers harvest it when the seeds are dry. The grain can be stored for food.
Some people cannot eat foods made from this grain. Other grains, such as rice or corn, can be used instead. Each grain has its own taste and uses.

examples.en: The rider hung the whip beside the saddle.
examples.zh: 騎士把鞭子掛在馬鞍旁。

examples.en: A sharp crack came from the whip.
examples.zh: 鞭子傳來清脆的啪聲。

examples.en: The museum showed a whip from the old farm.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了一條舊農場用的鞭子。

entries.definition: （名）鞭子；攪打器；（動）鞭打；快速攪拌；迅速移動。

explains.en: A long, flexible tool can snap through the air. Riders have used it to guide animals. It can hurt, so it must be handled with care.
In stories, this object may belong to a rider or an explorer. It often has a handle and a long thin end. People should never use it to hurt others.
The word can also name a quick movement through the air. A strong wind may make a rope snap sharply. That sound can surprise people.

examples.en: The coach blew a whistle to start the race.
examples.zh: 教練吹哨開始比賽。

examples.en: I heard a whistle from the train station.
examples.zh: 我聽到火車站傳來哨聲。

examples.en: Dad can whistle the tune from the cartoon.
examples.zh: 爸爸會吹卡通裡的那段曲調。

entries.definition: （名）哨子；口哨聲；（動）吹口哨；呼嘯

explains.en: A small object that makes a clear, high sound when air passes through it has this name. A referee may use one during a game. The sound gets players’ attention.
People can also make this sound by blowing through their lips. A tune may be carried by the notes. The sound can be heard from far away.
Some trains once used a loud signal to announce their arrival. A kettle may also make a high sound as water heats. Such sounds warn or call people.

examples.en: The wicked witch tried to trap the children.
examples.zh: 邪惡的女巫試圖困住孩子們。

examples.en: It was wicked to break the neighbor’s window on purpose.
examples.zh: 故意打破鄰居的窗戶是很壞的行為。

examples.en: The hero stopped the wicked plan.
examples.zh: 英雄阻止了邪惡的計畫。

entries.definition: 邪惡的；缺德的；（口語）極好的／非常的

explains.en: Cruel or harmful behavior can be described this way. A person who enjoys hurting others may act in this manner. Stories often show such a character as an enemy.
In old stories, a powerful ruler may treat people unfairly. The people may hope for a kinder leader. This word can describe a bad or evil person.
A child may call a trick unfair when it hurts someone. It is better to play kindly and follow the rules. Actions matter more than angry names.

examples.en: They plan to widen the narrow path.
examples.zh: 他們計畫拓寬這條狹窄的小路。

examples.en: The river widened after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，河道變寬了。

examples.en: She widened the opening so the box would fit.
examples.zh: 她把開口加寬，好讓盒子放得進去。

explains.en: To make something wider is to give it more space from side to side. Workers may move a fence to make a path broader. Then more people can walk there.
A smile can grow larger across someone’s face. Their happy expression becomes easier to see. The change happens little by little.
A road project may add another lane. Cars then have more room to pass. Signs warn drivers while the work is happening.

examples.en: Please wipe the table after lunch.
examples.zh: 請在午餐後擦乾淨桌子。

examples.en: He wiped the rain from his glasses.
examples.zh: 他擦掉眼鏡上的雨水。

examples.en: Mia wiped the muddy marks off her shoes.
examples.zh: 米亞擦掉鞋子上的泥痕。

entries.definition: （動）擦拭；抹去；清除；（名）擦拭；濕紙巾。

explains.en: A cloth or paper can move across a surface to clean or dry it. A child may clear a spill from a table. The rubbing removes liquid or dirt.
A hand can move across a window to clear away dust. A soft cloth helps avoid scratches. Cleaning in small circles can work well.
People may move a wet cloth across their hands after eating. This action takes away crumbs or sauce. A clean towel can dry them afterward.

examples.en: Developing powerful technologies requires equal measures of human empathy, restraint, and collective wisdom.
examples.zh: 掌控越發強大的尖端科技，越需要人類內心深沉的同理心、自律道德感與跨世代的集體智慧（Wisdom）。

examples.en: Tribal elders gathered around the sacred campfire to share ancestral oral histories and folk ecological wisdom.
examples.zh: 原住民族部落耆老夜間圍坐在神聖的營火旁，向青年一代傳授祖靈口述歷史與世代守護山林的敬虔生態智慧。

examples.en: Experience brings the quiet wisdom to recognize which daily battles are worth fighting and which to let go.
examples.zh: 歲月與風霜帶給人一份洞明世事的沉著智慧，讓人學會看透生活中哪些爭執值得全力以赴，哪些紛擾該淡然放下。

examples.en: Philosophy is the eternal love of wisdom—a lifelong journey guiding us toward truth, beauty, and goodness.
examples.zh: 哲學乃是「對智慧（Wisdom）的永恆熱愛」——這是一場引領我們一生不斷追求真、善、美的光輝心靈旅程。

examples.en: Life experience teaches the quiet wisdom of choosing peace over the futile need to win petty arguments.
examples.zh: 豐富的生命閱歷賦予人一份沉著洞達的深邃智慧：學會在紛擾世事中選擇內心安詳，放下無謂爭辯對錯的執念。

examples.en: Ancient proverbs distill centuries of accumulated human observation into timeless, practical wisdom for daily living.
examples.zh: 流傳千百年的民間古老諺語，將歷代祖先觀察天地運行的智慧結晶，濃縮提煉為指引我們日常處世立身的永恆人生智慧。

examples.en: The highest fruit of neuroscience and self-reflection is the gradual blossoming of deep, compassionate wisdom.
examples.zh: 神經科學與內省修為結出的最甜美果實，莫過於在歲月中緩緩綻放、照亮自他生命的深刻慈悲智慧。

examples.en: Grandmothers often share timeless folk wisdom about using natural herbs to soothe common colds.
examples.zh: 外婆經常與晚輩們分享傳承百年的民間生活智慧，傳授如何運用天然生薑與草藥舒緩感冒不適。

examples.en: True intellectual wisdom lies in acknowledging the limits of our knowledge and remaining humble learners.
examples.zh: 真正高尚深遠的智慧，在於能夠坦然承認個人認知的有限邊界，並一生永遠保持謙遜好學的求知熱忱。

examples.en: Traditional builders possessed ingenious wisdom, designing courtyard houses that stay cool without air conditioning.
examples.zh: 古代匠師擁有令人讚嘆的營造智慧，巧妙利用四合院天井導風納涼，無需冷氣即可自然通風降溫。

examples.en: Passing down ecological wisdom embedded in native folklore ensures sustainable living.
examples.zh: 傳承深植於在地民俗與農事曆法中的生態智慧，為當代永續綠色生活提供了寶貴養分。

examples.en: Architects today study the architectural wisdom of vernacular residences to design passive cooling systems.
examples.zh: 當代建築大師紛紛回過頭向台灣傳統民居智慧取經，研發出不耗電的建築自然對流排熱系統。

examples.en: True wisdom lies in using language to heal divides, foster kindness, and enlighten human lives.
examples.zh: 真正的「人生智慧」（Wisdom），在於善用語言化解分歧、傳遞善意，並點亮更多身邊之人的心靈。

examples.en: Elders in the village generously passed down ancient ecological wisdom to younger generations.
examples.zh: 村莊裡的長輩們毫無保留地將代代相傳的古老生態智慧，傳承啟發給在地的年輕一代。

examples.en: Experience brings the wisdom to distinguish between urgent distractions and truly essential priorities.
examples.zh: 人生閱歷帶來洞悉世事的成熟智慧，讓人能清楚分辨眼前的瑣碎干擾與生命中至關重要的優先要務。

entries.definition: 駕馭強大科技的人類智慧；智慧；洞悉世事之崇高生命智慧；洞悉自我與宇宙運行的終極智慧；先人順應自然氣候之傳統營造智慧；透過英語汲取全人類文明精華之跨文化智慧

explains.en: Good judgment gained through learning and experience can guide a thoughtful choice. Older people may share lessons they have learned. Listening helps others learn from them.
Someone may use careful thinking to solve a problem. They consider what could happen next. Experience can help them choose wisely.
A person facing a difficult choice may think about likely results. Past experience can help guide the decision. Listening to trusted advice may help too.

examples.en: The director yelled 'That’s a wrap!' and the exhausted crew cheered in celebration.
examples.zh: 當導演在片場手持擴音器高喊「全劇殺青！」時，全體辛勞付出的劇組人員瞬間爆出歡呼。

examples.en: We hope to wrap today's intense filming schedule before sunset to avoid overtime penalties.
examples.zh: 我們希望能在夕陽西下天黑之前順利拍完今日密集的通告表，避免產生昂貴的超班加班費。

examples.en: She picked up a fresh chicken salad wrap from the convenience store for a quick lunch.
examples.zh: 她在超商隨手買了一份清爽低卡的現做雞肉沙拉捲餅，迅速解決忙碌工作間隙的午餐。

explains.en: To cover something, fold paper or cloth around it. People may use colorful paper for a present. Tape can hold the covering in place.
A scarf can go around a neck to keep it warm. The ends may cross over each other. A loose knot keeps it from falling.
People can place food inside a flatbread and fold it closed. The folded meal is easy to hold. Many fillings can be used.

examples.en: She wore a silver watch on her wrist.
examples.zh: 她在手腕上戴了一只銀色手錶。

examples.en: He hurt his wrist while playing tennis.
examples.zh: 他打網球時弄傷了手腕。

examples.en: A bracelet slid down her wrist.
examples.zh: 手環滑到了她的手腕上。

explains.en: The joint between the hand and the arm lets the hand bend and turn. A watch is often worn in that area. It helps connect the two parts.
This part has small bones and can move in several directions. It helps people hold a cup or write with a pencil. Gentle movement makes many tasks possible.
A bracelet can fit around this narrow area. Sleeves often end just above it. A doctor may check it after a fall.

examples.en: Our school has a yearly sports day.
examples.zh: 我們學校每年舉辦一次運動會。

examples.en: The family takes a yearly trip to the mountains.
examples.zh: 這家人每年都會去山上旅行。

examples.en: She gets a yearly library card renewal notice.
examples.zh: 她每年都會收到圖書館卡續期通知。

explains.en: Happening once in each twelve-month period describes this schedule. A checkup on this schedule takes place each year. A calendar can remind people when it is due.
Some events happen in the same season every twelve months. Families may celebrate a birthday on that schedule. They can mark the date on a calendar.
A report may describe what happened during twelve months. Readers can compare it with the report from the year before. This helps them notice changes.

examples.en: The coach had to yell over the crowd.
examples.zh: 教練必須大聲喊，才能蓋過人群的聲音。

examples.en: Please do not yell inside the library.
examples.zh: 請不要在圖書館裡大喊。

examples.en: She yelled for help when she saw smoke.
examples.zh: 她看到煙時大聲呼救。

explains.en: To speak or call very loudly is to raise your voice. Someone may do this to be heard across a noisy playground. A quiet voice is better when people are close.
A person may call out in excitement at a game. The loud sound can show strong feelings. People should avoid shouting near someone’s ears.
A lifeguard may call loudly when swimmers need to pay attention. The sound carries over water. Clear instructions help everyone stay safe.

examples.en: The egg yolk broke into the pan.
examples.zh: 蛋黃掉進鍋裡時破掉了。

examples.en: Grandpa mixed the yolk with flour for the cake.
examples.zh: 爺爺把蛋黃和麵粉混合做蛋糕。

examples.en: A bright yellow yolk sat in the middle of the egg.
examples.zh: 亮黃色的蛋黃位於蛋的中央。

explains.en: The yellow center inside an egg is surrounded by the clear part called the white. Both parts can be cooked and eaten. Cooks may mix the center into batter or sauces.
When an egg is opened, the round yellow part may stay whole. Cooks can mix it into batter or sauces. It gives food color and richness.
Bird eggs contain food that helps a baby bird grow. In a chicken egg, the yellow center is easy to see. A shell protects everything inside.

examples.en: The youngsters played tag in the yard.
examples.zh: 孩子們在院子裡玩鬼抓人。

examples.en: A local club offers art lessons for youngsters.
examples.zh: 當地社團為青少年開設美術課。

examples.en: The youngster asked many questions at the museum.
examples.zh: 那位年輕人參觀博物館時問了許多問題。

explains.en: A young person, often a child or teenager, can be described by this informal noun. A group may visit a museum with an adult leader. The word sounds friendly.
A sports team for children may give each young player a chance to practice. Coaches teach skills step by step. Everyone can learn at a different pace.
In a story, a young person may be called this instead of a child. The word can refer to one person or a group. It often sounds warm and familiar.

examples.en: His jacket zipper was stuck.
examples.zh: 他的外套拉鍊卡住了。

examples.en: She closed the zipper on her backpack.
examples.zh: 她拉上背包的拉鍊。

examples.en: The zipper kept the coins inside the pocket.
examples.zh: 拉鍊讓硬幣留在口袋裡。

explains.en: A fastener with two rows of small teeth joins parts of clothing or a bag. A small slider opens or closes it. Jackets and backpacks often use one.
Pulling the slider up joins the two sides of clothing. Pulling it down separates them. A tiny handle makes it easier to move.
Some bags use this fastener to keep things from falling out. The teeth must line up for it to close smoothly. A stuck one may need gentle care.

examples.en: The Clarion-Clipperton Zone in the central Pacific holds trillions of dollars worth of critical energy metals.
examples.zh: 位於太平洋中部的「克拉利昂-克利珀頓海域特區」（Zone CCZ），蘊藏著價值數兆美元的關鍵金屬。

examples.en: City hall designated the historical warehouse district as a pedestrian-only commercial shopping zone.
examples.zh: 市政府將老舊歷史倉庫群正式公告規劃為禁止車輛通行的步行商業文創街區。

examples.en: Drivers must observe the strict thirty-kilometer speed limit when passing through an elementary school zone.
examples.zh: 駕駛人駕車行經國小校園周邊減速學區時，必須嚴格遵守時速三十公里的限速規定。

entries.definition: 克拉利昂-克利珀頓斷裂帶 (CCZ 國際深海特區)；區域

explains.en: An area with a particular purpose or feature can have this name. A school may set aside a quiet place for reading. Signs show where it begins.
Different parts of a town may have different rules. One place may be for homes, while another is for shops. Maps can mark each area.
A protected part of a nature reserve may have limits on building or driving. These rules protect plants and animals. A map can show its boundaries.

examples.en: They had to abandon the picnic when rain began.
examples.zh: 下雨開始後，他們只好取消野餐。

examples.en: The hikers did not abandon their supplies.
examples.zh: 登山客沒有丟下補給品。

examples.en: The family adopted a dog abandoned near the road.
examples.zh: 這家人收養了一隻被遺棄在路邊的狗。

explains.en: To leave something behind and stop caring for it is to give it up. A person may leave an old toy in a box. Someone else might later find it.
A team may stop working on a plan that cannot succeed. They can choose a better idea instead. This decision can be difficult.
An animal left without care may need help. People at a shelter can provide food and a safe place. Pets need a responsible home.

examples.en: The team had absolute confidence in their plan.
examples.zh: 團隊對計畫有十足信心。

examples.en: The king once held absolute power over the land.
examples.zh: 國王曾對那片土地握有絕對權力。

examples.en: The absolute value of negative four is four.
examples.zh: 負四的絕對值是四。

entries.definition: 絕對的；完全的；無條件的；（數學）絕對值的。

explains.en: Complete or total, with no limits or exceptions, describes this adjective. A promise with no room for doubt is very firm. The word can make an idea sound strong.
A ruler may have power that nobody can limit. This can be unfair to other people. Shared rules can protect everyone.
In mathematics, a number’s distance from zero has a special name. That distance is never negative. Both three and minus three are three steps from zero.

examples.en: Dry sand can absorb water quickly.
examples.zh: 乾燥的沙子能快速吸收水分。

examples.en: The dark curtains absorb some street noise.
examples.zh: 厚窗簾吸收了一些街道噪音。

examples.en: She read slowly to absorb the new information.
examples.zh: 她慢慢閱讀，好吸收新資訊。

explains.en: To take in a liquid, sound, or information is to draw it inside. A sponge takes in water when pressed into a puddle. Its material holds the water.
Thick curtains can take in some sound from outside. This can make a room quieter. Soft materials often reduce echoes.
A student may take in new facts while reading. Pausing to think can help the ideas stay in memory. Practice helps learning last.

examples.en: Abstract expressionism conveys raw human emotion through spontaneous splatter and energetic sweeps.
examples.zh: 抽象表現主義（Abstract Expressionism）捨棄具象外形，透過畫布上奔放潑灑的色彩直抒最原始澎湃的情感。

examples.en: The researcher submitted a concise 300-word abstract outlining the key findings of her clinical trial.
examples.zh: 臨床醫學研究生提交了一份三百字的簡明論文摘要，言簡意賅概述了抗癌新藥臨床試驗的核心數據成果。

examples.en: Mathematics often involves manipulating abstract concepts that lack tangible physical representations.
examples.zh: 理論高等數學領域時常涉及大量純邏輯符號運算與高度抽象概念，現實世界中往往缺乏具象的實體對應。

entries.definition: 抽象派現代藝術的；摘要

explains.en: Some ideas cannot be touched, such as love or fairness. Art can show them through shapes or colors. People may understand them in different ways.
An idea that cannot be touched, such as love or fairness, is not a physical object. Art can show such ideas through shapes or colors. People may understand them in different ways.
A painting of a feeling may use lines and color instead of realistic objects. Viewers think about what those marks suggest. Artists can express thoughts without drawing real things.

examples.en: She won an award for academic work.
examples.zh: 她因學業表現獲得獎項。

examples.en: The library has many academic books about history.
examples.zh: 圖書館有許多歷史學術書籍。

examples.en: His academic goals include learning another language.
examples.zh: 他的學習目標包括再學一種語言。

explains.en: Relating to school learning or study describes books, work, or goals. A textbook may explain a subject in detail. Students use it to understand ideas.
A person may work in a college and teach or study. This kind of work is connected with education. Research can be part of it.
A school report may show how a student is doing in lessons. Reading and math are examples of subjects. Good study habits can help.

examples.en: Her accent showed that she grew up in Scotland.
examples.zh: 她的口音顯示她在蘇格蘭長大。

examples.en: The actor practiced a French accent for the play.
examples.zh: 這位演員為戲劇練習法語口音。

examples.en: A small accent mark appears above the letter.
examples.zh: 字母上方有一個小小的重音符號。

explains.en: A way of pronouncing words may show where someone learned to speak. People in different places can say the same word differently. Every way of speaking deserves respect.
Some people speak with a strong sound from their home region. Listeners can still understand them by paying attention. Practice helps with unfamiliar sounds.
A small mark above a letter can show how to pronounce it or distinguish one word from another. Different languages use different marks. Writers learn where each one belongs.

examples.en: Her acceptance into the music club made her smile.
examples.zh: 她獲准加入音樂社，開心地笑了。

examples.en: The school sent an acceptance letter to the student.
examples.zh: 學校寄了一封錄取信給學生。

examples.en: Acceptance of the invitation was confirmed by email.
examples.zh: 對邀請的接受已透過電子郵件確認。

explains.en: Agreeing to take or allow something is one meaning. A student may feel happy after receiving an offer to join a club. The group has welcomed that person.
People sometimes need to accept that plans have changed. They can then decide what to do next. Talking with a friend may help.
A package delivery may require a signature to show it was received. The person gives permission by signing. This records that the item arrived.

examples.en: Visitors have access to the garden from nine to five.
examples.zh: 訪客可以在九點到五點進入花園。

examples.en: Use your password to access the school website.
examples.zh: 使用密碼登入學校網站。

examples.en: The ramp gives everyone access to the hall.
examples.zh: 坡道讓每個人都能進入大廳。

explains.en: Permission to enter or use something may come from a key or password. A key opens a locked room. A password can let a person use an account.
A ramp gives wheelchair users a way to enter a building. Clear paths make places easier for everyone to use. Good design removes barriers.
In computing, permission may let someone see or change information. A teacher may let students use a class page. Rules help keep private things safe.

examples.en: An accidental spill left a blue spot on the rug.
examples.zh: 不小心灑出的顏料在地毯上留下藍點。

examples.en: The accidental meeting surprised us at the bus stop.
examples.zh: 這場偶然的相遇讓我們在公車站感到驚喜。

examples.en: An accidental tap closed the computer window.
examples.zh: 無意間的點擊關掉了電腦視窗。

explains.en: Happening by chance, without being planned, describes an event. A dropped cup may break by mistake. The person did not mean for it to happen.
A person can spill paint while carrying a tray. Cleaning it quickly may prevent a stain. Careful hands can still make mistakes.
An unexpected meeting may happen when two friends visit the same shop. Neither planned to see the other. They may be glad about the surprise.

examples.en: I will accompany my sister to the concert.
examples.zh: 我會陪妹妹去聽音樂會。

examples.en: A piano will accompany the singer.
examples.zh: 鋼琴將為歌手伴奏。

examples.en: Salad can accompany the warm soup.
examples.zh: 沙拉可以搭配熱湯一起享用。

explains.en: To go somewhere with another person is to give them company. A parent may walk with a child to school. Having company can make the trip pleasant.
Music can go along with a dance or a film. The sounds help set the mood. Quiet music may suit a gentle scene.
A dish may be served together with another food. Rice often goes with vegetables. The foods can taste good side by side.

examples.en: She worked hard to accomplish her reading goal.
examples.zh: 她努力達成閱讀目標。

examples.en: The team accomplished the task before lunch.
examples.zh: 團隊在午餐前完成了任務。

examples.en: He accomplished more by making a simple plan.
examples.zh: 他透過簡單的計畫完成了更多事情。

explains.en: To finish something successfully is to reach its goal. A class may complete a project after several weeks. Everyone can feel proud of the result.
A small goal can be reached by doing one step at a time. Practice helps people improve. Keeping a list shows what is finished.
A team may work together to solve a hard puzzle. Each person can share an idea. Their combined effort brings success.

examples.en: The accountant checked the company's financial balance.
examples.zh: 會計師審核了公司的財務收支平衡表。

examples.en: Companies hire certified public accountants to manage taxes and audits.
examples.zh: 企業聘請執業會計師來統籌管理稅務申報與財務稽核業務。

examples.en: A detail-oriented accountant caught the clerical discrepancy in the quarterly ledger.
examples.zh: 一位細心嚴謹的會計師及時查出了季度總帳中的登載出入。

explains.en: A professional who keeps records of money for a person or business adds up payments and costs. Careful numbers help show where money went. This work may include preparing reports.
A worker who keeps records of money for a person or business adds up payments and costs. Careful numbers help show where money went. This work may include preparing reports.
A shop owner may ask this professional to organize bills and income. Clear records help with planning. The worker checks calculations closely.

examples.en: Differential corrections elevate standard meter-level civilian GPS up to millimeter-level accuracy.
examples.zh: 透過先進差分校正技術，將普通民用公尺級衛星定位大幅昇華至驚人的「毫米級絕對精度」（Accuracy）。

examples.en: The accountant double-checked every balance sheet entry to guarantee hundred-percent financial accuracy.
examples.zh: 專業會計師在年度審計時逐筆反覆核對資產負債表上的每一筆進出明細，確保財務帳目百分之百精確無誤。

examples.en: Modern ballistic computer systems significantly improve the targeting accuracy of artillery defense units.
examples.zh: 現代化車載射控彈道計算電腦系統，能顯著提升國軍砲兵防空部隊在惡劣天候下的射擊首發命中精準度。

entries.definition: 舉世驚嘆之毫米至亞公分級空間絕對定位精度；精準度

explains.en: Being correct and free from mistakes matters when measuring. A ruler helps a student draw a line carefully. Checking the result can make it more reliable.
A map should place roads in the right locations. Careful measurements help it match the real world. Small errors can cause confusion.
A calculator can help check a sum. Reading the numbers carefully also matters. Both steps support a correct answer.

examples.en: He did not accuse his friend without proof.
examples.zh: 沒有證據，他不會指責朋友。

examples.en: The teacher asked questions before accusing anyone.
examples.zh: 老師沒有急著怪罪任何人，而是先提問。

examples.en: She accused the cat of knocking over the cup.
examples.zh: 她怪貓打翻了杯子。

explains.en: To say that someone did something wrong is a serious claim. It is important to know the facts first. A fair conversation lets everyone explain.
A missing cookie may lead one child to blame a sibling. They may discover a pet took it instead. Guessing too quickly can hurt feelings.
In a story, a detective may say someone caused a problem. More clues are needed before the truth is clear. Careful questions help reveal what happened.

examples.en: Lemon juice contains a mild acid.
examples.zh: 檸檬汁含有一種溫和的酸。

examples.en: The student wore goggles while testing the acid.
examples.zh: 學生測試酸液時戴著護目鏡。

examples.en: Vinegar has a weak acid that gives it a sharp taste.
examples.zh: 醋含有弱酸，所以味道較刺激。

entries.definition: （名）酸；酸性物質；（形）酸的；尖刻的

explains.en: A sour liquid such as lemon juice contains a substance that reacts with other materials. Some kinds are weak, while others are strong. Strong forms can be dangerous to touch.
The body uses a special liquid to help break down food. It is part of digestion. The body protects itself with special tissues.
Scientists use special tools to test how strong a liquid is. They wear safety equipment in a lab. Never taste an unknown liquid.

examples.en: I met an old acquaintance at the market.
examples.zh: 我在市場遇見一位舊識。

examples.en: She is an acquaintance from my art class.
examples.zh: 她是我美術課認識的人。

examples.en: His acquaintance with local history grew over time.
examples.zh: 他對地方歷史的了解逐漸加深。

entries.definition: 熟人；相識的人；認識；了解

explains.en: A person you know a little but are not close friends with has this name. You may greet someone you see sometimes. You might not know much about their life.
A person met at a class or event can be known this way. You may remember their name and a few details. More time together can build friendship.
This word can also mean knowledge of a subject. Reading gives a learner some understanding of history. Lessons can deepen that knowledge.

examples.en: She hopes to acquire a better understanding of birds.
examples.zh: 她希望增進對鳥類的了解。

examples.en: The museum acquired an old map for its collection.
examples.zh: 博物館為收藏添購了一張古地圖。

examples.en: He acquired a bicycle with money from his summer job.
examples.zh: 他用暑期打工賺的錢買了一輛腳踏車。

explains.en: To get or gain something is to make it yours. A child may save coins for a new book. The item belongs to them after they buy it.
A person can learn a skill through practice. They may slowly gain the ability to play an instrument. Patience helps learning.
A library may get new books for its shelves. Staff choose useful titles for readers. People can borrow them later.

examples.en: Animals adapt to changes in their environment.
examples.zh: 動物會適應環境的變化。

examples.en: We adapted the game for younger children.
examples.zh: 我們調整了遊戲，讓年紀較小的孩子也能玩。

examples.en: She adapted quickly to her new classroom.
examples.zh: 她很快適應了新教室。

explains.en: To change so something fits a new situation is to adjust. A plant may grow toward the sunlight. The change helps it live in its place.
A family moving to a new town may learn different routes. It takes time to feel at home. Asking questions can help them settle in.
A book may be changed into a movie. The story is adjusted for the screen. Some details may be different.

examples.en: The story follows an addict who seeks help from friends.
examples.zh: 故事描寫一位尋求朋友幫助的成癮者。

examples.en: A doctor helped the addict find support.
examples.zh: 醫生幫助這位成癮者找到支援。

examples.en: The addict asked a counselor for help.
examples.zh: 這位成癮者向諮商師求助。

explains.en: A person unable to easily stop using a harmful substance or doing a harmful activity may need help. This problem can affect health and daily life. Caring adults and trained helpers can offer support.
Some people feel unable to stop a behavior even when it causes trouble. They may need help from family and professionals. Support can make change possible.
The word is serious and should not be used as a casual insult. Kind language helps people ask for help. Everyone deserves care and respect.

examples.en: We had adequate food for the picnic.
examples.zh: 野餐的食物份量足夠。

examples.en: The tent gave adequate shelter from the rain.
examples.zh: 帳篷提供了足夠的避雨處。

examples.en: Please allow adequate time to finish the puzzle.
examples.zh: 請留出充足時間完成拼圖。

explains.en: Enough for a need or purpose is the meaning of this adjective. A small amount of water may be enough for one plant. More may be needed on a hot day.
A room with enough chairs can seat all the visitors. If there are too few, someone may stand. Planning helps provide what is needed.
A student may have enough time to finish a short task. A longer assignment needs more time. The amount should fit the job.

examples.en: Please adjust the mirror before we drive.
examples.zh: 開車前請調整後照鏡。

examples.en: He adjusted the straps on his backpack.
examples.zh: 他調整了背包上的背帶。

examples.en: We adjusted our plans because the train was late.
examples.zh: 火車誤點，所以我們調整了計畫。

entries.definition: 調整；校準；適應；改變以符合需要。

explains.en: To change something a little so it works or fits better is to fine-tune it. A chair can be moved higher for a tall person. Small changes can make it more comfortable.
A person may change a clock when traveling to another time zone. The new setting helps show local time. Instructions can explain how.
A mechanic may make a small change to a bicycle brake. Then it can stop more smoothly. Careful checks keep the bike safe.

examples.en: Her patience with the young students was admirable.
examples.zh: 她對年幼學生很有耐心，令人敬佩。

examples.en: The firefighters showed admirable courage.
examples.zh: 消防員展現了令人欽佩的勇氣。

examples.en: It was admirable of him to share his lunch.
examples.zh: 他願意分享午餐，值得讚賞。

entries.definition: 令人欽佩的；值得讚賞的

explains.en: Worthy of respect describes someone or something. A child who shares fairly may show a good quality. Others can learn from that example.
A team that keeps trying after a setback shows effort. People may respect their patience. Success is not the only thing that matters.
A kind action can make someone feel grateful. Holding a door for a person carrying boxes is thoughtful. Small helpful acts count.

examples.en: She felt admiration for her grandmother’s kindness.
examples.zh: 她敬佩祖母的善良。

examples.en: The crowd showed admiration for the dancers.
examples.zh: 觀眾向舞者表達敬意。

examples.en: He looked at the tall ship with admiration.
examples.zh: 他敬佩地望著那艘高大的船。

explains.en: A feeling of respect for someone or something can grow over time. A fan may respect an athlete’s hard work. Watching practice shows how much effort it takes.
People can appreciate a beautiful painting or a tall mountain. They may stop to look closely. The feeling can make them want to learn more.
A child may respect a teacher who explains things kindly. Good examples can inspire others. Respect grows through actions.

examples.en: General admission to the museum is free on national holidays.
examples.zh: 國定假日期間進入該博物館一律免費入場。

examples.en: High school graduates celebrate when receiving university admission letters.
examples.zh: 高中畢業生在收到大學錄取入學通知書時歡呼慶祝。

examples.en: His prompt admission of the mistake earned the respect of his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他迅速坦承錯誤的誠懇態度贏得了同事們的敬重。

examples.en: He received an official admission letter from his dream university.
examples.zh: 他收到了來自他心目中第一志願大學的正式入學錄取通知書。

examples.en: University admission requirements include language proficiency test scores and essays.
examples.zh: 大學入學申請資格條件涵蓋外語能力檢定成績與個人陳述自傳。

examples.en: Museum admission is free for children under the age of six.
examples.zh: 六歲以下幼童可享免費入館參觀的免門票入場優惠。

entries.definition: 入場費；門票；准許進入；入學許可；錄取資格

explains.en: Permission to enter a place or event may come with a ticket. The ticket lets someone into a museum. Some places are free to visit.
A school may accept a student into a program. The family receives a letter with details. The student can then prepare to join.
A person may admit that they made a mistake. This means they say honestly what happened. Telling the truth can help solve a problem.

examples.en: They decided to adopt a kitten from the shelter.
examples.zh: 他們決定從收容所領養一隻小貓。

examples.en: The school adopted a new rule for the playground.
examples.zh: 學校採用了操場的新規則。

examples.en: We adopted the habit of reading before bed.
examples.zh: 我們養成了睡前閱讀的習慣。

explains.en: To take a child or animal into a family and care for them is to give them a home. The new family gives love and care. The process follows important rules.
A group can choose a new plan or idea and begin using it. For example, a class may choose a quieter way to line up. Everyone learns the new steps.
A person may choose a special habit or way of doing things. A family might start a tradition of reading together. Repeating it can make it meaningful.

examples.en: The travel agency booked our train tickets.
examples.zh: 旅行社幫我們訂了火車票。

examples.en: A local agency helps families find housing.
examples.zh: 當地機構協助家庭尋找住處。

examples.en: The news agency sent a reporter to the game.
examples.zh: 新聞機構派記者前往比賽現場。

entries.definition: 機構；代理處；仲介公司；自主能力。

explains.en: An organization may provide a service or help people. A travel office can arrange trips. A news group gathers and shares information.
Some public offices help protect parks or support families. Workers follow rules while serving the community. People can ask them for information.
A company may represent artists or actors. It can help them find work and make plans. Each organization has its own purpose.

examples.en: Autonomous AI agents independently browse the web, execute terminal commands, and write unit tests to finish goals.
examples.zh: 自主 AI 智慧代理人（AI Agent）能自行上網搜尋、呼叫終端機指令並編寫單元測試，全自動達成複雜專案目標。

examples.en: We contacted a licensed real estate agent to help us negotiate the purchase of our first apartment in Banqiao.
examples.zh: 我們主動委託了一位信譽良好的資深持照不動產經紀人仲介，協助我們在板橋斡旋洽談人生第一間起家厝。

examples.en: The FBI undercover agent gathered critical evidence to expose the international money laundering syndicate.
examples.zh: 這位聯邦調查局臥底特工（Agent）冒著生命危險蒐集到了關鍵鐵證，一舉瓦解了龐大的跨國洗錢犯罪集團。

entries.definition: 自主執行任務之 AI 智慧代理人；代理

explains.en: A person who acts for another person or group may speak on their behalf. A sports professional can help a player make plans. The representative shares messages between them.
An actor may ask a representative to discuss a job offer. The representative checks details and passes along the actor’s wishes. This can save time.
A real estate representative may help someone buy or sell a home. This person arranges visits and shares information. The owner makes the final decision.

examples.en: The aggressive dog stayed behind a strong fence.
examples.zh: 那隻具攻擊性的狗待在堅固的圍欄後。

examples.en: The aggressive player followed the rules.
examples.zh: 那位積極進攻的球員遵守了規則。

examples.en: That aggressive vine spread across the garden.
examples.zh: 那種生長旺盛的藤蔓蔓延整座花園。

entries.definition: 有攻擊性的；積極進取的；強烈的

explains.en: Forceful behavior or a readiness to fight can be described this way. A dog that growls and rushes forward may seem threatening. Calm distance can keep people safe.
A team may play with strong energy and try hard to win. This can be positive when players follow the rules. Respect matters during competition.
A plant that grows quickly and takes space from others can be called this. Gardeners may give it room to grow. The word has more than one use.

examples.en: The neighbors were agreeable and welcomed us.
examples.zh: 鄰居們很親切，歡迎我們。

examples.en: That is an agreeable plan for our class.
examples.zh: 那是適合我們班的計畫。

examples.en: The mild weather made for an agreeable walk.
examples.zh: 溫和的天氣讓散步很愉快。

entries.definition: 令人愉快的；宜人的；欣然同意的

explains.en: Pleasant or easy to like describes a person, plan, or experience. A friendly person may be enjoyable to talk with. Kind manners can help people get along.
An idea can be acceptable to everyone in a group. They may agree to meet after school. Listening helps them choose a time.
The weather may feel comfortable for a walk. The sky is clear and the air is mild. People enjoy spending time outside.

examples.en: The bottle label said the liquid contained alcohol.
examples.zh: 瓶身標籤寫著液體含有酒精。

examples.en: Adults kept alcohol away from the children.
examples.zh: 大人把酒精放在孩子拿不到的地方。

examples.en: The nurse used alcohol to clean the small cut.
examples.zh: 護理師用酒精清潔小傷口。

explains.en: A substance found in some drinks is also used in cleaning liquids. Drinks with it are only for adults. Some kinds can be poisonous if swallowed.
This substance can also be used to clean surfaces or help make medicines. Labels give instructions for safe use. Children should ask an adult before touching it.
Different forms have different uses and strengths. A lab may use a small amount during an experiment. Careful handling is important.

examples.en: Real-time SMS and push alerts notify cardholders immediately after any overseas credit card charge.
examples.zh: 只要海外信用卡出現任何一筆外幣刷卡消費，系統第一時間立即透過簡訊與 App 發送即時推播警示。

examples.en: The weather bureau issued an urgent maritime gale alert advising small fishing vessels to return to harbor.
examples.zh: 氣象主管機關緊急發布海上強風特報警報，呼籲在台灣周邊海域作業的近海小型漁船立即返港避風。

examples.en: Setting an account balance alert prevents checking overdraft fees when automatic rent debits clear.
examples.zh: 在手機銀行內預先設定活期存款低餘額警示通知，能有效防止每逢月底房租自動扣款時因餘額不足產生違約金。

entries.definition: 即時交易推播警示通知；警覺的

explains.en: Paying close attention and ready to notice what happens describes a person. A crossing guard watches the road carefully. Being ready helps them respond quickly.
The same word can name a warning message. A phone may show a notice about bad weather. It tells people to pay attention.
A person who has slept well may feel awake and focused. Rest helps the mind notice sounds and sights. Breaks can help during long tasks.

examples.en: The economy ticket includes a standard checked baggage allowance of 23 kilograms.
examples.zh: 該經濟艙機票內含一件重量上限為二十三公斤的標準免費託運行李額度。

examples.en: Parents gave their teenage daughter a modest weekly allowance to teach financial discipline.
examples.zh: 父母每週給予青春期女兒一筆適度的每週零用錢，藉此從小培養她自主記帳與理性理財觀念。

examples.en: Premium passengers enjoy a generous baggage allowance of two 32-kilogram bags.
examples.zh: 搭乘商務艙的尊榮旅客享有極為寬裕的免費行李額度，可免費託運兩件各三十二公斤的行李。

examples.en: Under cap-and-trade rules, factories that exceed their carbon allowance must buy extra permits from cleaner peers.
examples.zh: 在總量管制交易體系下，排碳超標的工廠必須出資向減碳優良的低碳同業購買額外的排放配額。

examples.en: Parents gave their twelve-year-old child a modest weekly allowance to encourage money-saving habits.
examples.zh: 父母每週定期發放少許零用錢（Allowance）給剛上國中的孩子，引導他從小養成理性記帳與儲蓄儲蓄習慣。

examples.en: Airlines allow a standard checked baggage allowance of twenty-three kilograms per international passenger.
examples.zh: 國際線客運航空公司明文規範，經濟艙旅客享有每人單件行李限重二十三公斤的免費託運隨身行李額度。

entries.definition: 免費行李額度；零用錢；津貼；總量管制之碳排放配額

explains.en: A small amount of money given regularly, often to a child, has this name. A child may save it for a toy. Planning helps make the money last.
A person may receive permission to do something. A parent might allow extra time for a special event. The permission has clear limits.
In some places, the word refers to an amount set aside for a task or need. A budget may include money for food. Keeping track helps avoid waste.

examples.en: Fintech lenders evaluate alternative mobile bill payment data to grant microloans to young freelancers.
examples.zh: 金融科技借貸平台藉由分析手機電信費繳費紀錄等替代大數據，為缺乏傳統薪轉證明的自由工作者核貸。

examples.en: Many patients seek alternative therapies such as acupuncture to manage chronic neck pain.
examples.zh: 許多飽受頑固肩頸痠痛之苦的現代人，紛紛尋求中醫針灸拔罐等非侵入性的輔助替代療法以舒緩疼痛。

examples.en: Wind and solar installations provide sustainable alternative energy sources to reduce coal dependence.
examples.zh: 大規模興建離岸風電與太陽能光電設備，提供了充足永續的潔淨替代能源，大幅降低對燃煤發電的依賴。

entries.definition: 非傳統替代信用大數據的；替代方案

explains.en: Another choice can take the place of the first one. It gives people more than one way to solve a problem. A different route to school can be useful when the main road is closed.
At lunch, Mia could choose rice or noodles. She chose noodles instead of rice. Having another choice helped her enjoy the meal.
Another choice may work well for one person and poorly for another. People compare cost, time, and comfort before choosing. The best option depends on what they need.

examples.en: My amateur team practices soccer in the park every Saturday.
examples.zh: 我的業餘球隊每週六都在公園練習足球。

examples.en: An amateur photographer took pictures of the sunset.
examples.zh: 一位業餘攝影愛好者拍下了夕陽的照片。

examples.en: She is an amateur baker who makes bread for her family.
examples.zh: 她是個業餘烘焙愛好者，會做麵包給家人吃。

entries.definition: （名）業餘愛好者；（形）業餘的；非專業的。
