The verb can also describe making a promise or agreement again. Two groups may decide to continue working together. They confirm that they want the arrangement to go on.

examples.en: Spaced repetition scientifically schedules reviews right before the brain forgets new vocabulary.
examples.zh: 遵循大腦遺忘曲線設計的「間隔重複記憶法」（Spaced Repetition），在即將遺忘的黃金節點精準安排複習。

examples.en: Musical instrument mastery relies on deliberate physical repetition to build effortless muscle memory.
examples.zh: 任何古典樂器的登峰造極，皆高度仰賴數萬次帶有覺知的刻意練習重複，以化為行雲流水的肌肉記憶。

examples.en: Without active variation, mindless mechanical repetition leads to diminishing returns and boredom.
examples.zh: 若缺乏主動思考與情境變化，單純枯燥機械式的死記硬背只會讓大腦感到麻木，學習效益大幅遞減。

entries.definition: 間隔重複記憶法；重複練習

explains.en: This means doing or saying the same thing again. The action may happen once more or many times. Practice often includes this process.
A child says a new word several times while learning it. Each attempt gives another chance to remember the sounds. Hearing it again can also help.
A song may use the same line more than once. That repeated pattern makes the tune familiar. Too much of the same material, however, can make a long talk dull.

examples.en: The model is a small representation of the town.
examples.zh: 這個模型是城鎮的縮小呈現。

examples.en: The painting offers a bright representation of village life.
examples.zh: 這幅畫生動地呈現了鄉村生活。

examples.en: Students asked for representation on the school committee.
examples.zh: 學生要求在學校委員會中有代表參與。

explains.en: This can mean a picture, model, or description that stands for something else. A small model of a house is one example. It shows the shape of a real building.
A drawing of the sun may be a yellow circle with lines around it. The drawing is not the real star. It gives people a simple way to picture the idea.
The noun can also mean speaking or acting for other people. A student may attend a meeting for the whole class. The student shares the class’s views with the group.

examples.en: Delivering flawless project code on time builds a solid professional reputation.
examples.zh: 每次皆能準時交付高品質零瑕疵的專案程式碼能為您奠定扎實的業界好口碑。

examples.en: The restaurant suffered damage to its reputation after negative hygiene reviews.
examples.zh: 該餐廳在遭遇衛生負評後，其建立多年的品牌聲譽蒙受了打擊。

examples.en: A good reputation takes years to build but can be ruined in a single mistake.
examples.zh: 良好的聲譽需要多年積累才能建立，但一個嚴重的過失就可能毀於一旦。

explains.en: This is what people generally think about a person, place, or business. It comes from what they have seen or heard. It may be good or bad.
A baker always sells fresh bread and treats customers kindly. People tell their friends that the shop is reliable. The shop becomes known for its good work.
An opinion shared by many people can change over time. Repeated mistakes may damage trust. Honest and helpful actions can help rebuild it.

examples.en: The firefighters rescued the family from the burning house.
examples.zh: 消防員從失火的房屋中救出了那家人。

examples.en: The rescue took several hours.
examples.zh: 這場救援花了好幾個小時。

examples.en: Volunteers helped rescue animals after the flood.
examples.zh: 洪水過後，志工幫忙救援動物。

entries.definition: （名）救援；（動）救出、營救；使人或動物脫離危險。

explains.en: This means to save someone from danger or a difficult situation. A person may be trapped and need help getting out. Helpers bring the person to safety.
A kitten is stuck in a deep drain. Trained helpers lift it out and return it to its owner. The animal is safe again.
The noun can name the act of saving someone. A team may work together during a flood. Boats and other equipment can help them reach people who need assistance.

examples.en: Scientists are conducting groundbreaking research on clean green energy.
examples.zh: 科學家們正在對乾淨綠色能源進行開創性研究。

examples.en: Carry out extensive market research before launching a new product line.
examples.zh: 在推出全新產品線之前，務必先進行廣泛深入的市場研究調查。

examples.en: The university library provides access to thousands of peer-reviewed research databases.
examples.zh: 大學圖書館提供了檢索數千個同儕審查學術研究資料庫的權限。

explains.en: This means careful study to learn more about a subject. A person asks questions and looks for evidence. The aim is to find reliable information.
A class wants to know which soil helps seeds grow best. The students plant seeds in different soils and record the results. Their observations help answer the question.
This work can also involve books, records, or interviews. A writer may study old letters to learn about a town. Checking several sources can help make the account accurate.

examples.en: The researcher recorded how quickly each plant grew.
examples.zh: 研究人員記錄了每株植物生長的速度。

examples.en: A researcher visited the village to study its history.
examples.zh: 一位研究人員到村莊研究當地歷史。

examples.en: The researchers compared their results.
examples.zh: 研究人員比較了各自的結果。

entries.definition: 研究人員；研究者；調查者。

explains.en: This is someone who carefully studies a subject to learn more about it. The person asks questions and gathers information. Evidence helps them reach an answer.
A scientist watches birds to learn where they build nests. Notes are kept about each location. This kind of careful study is part of the person’s work.
Some people in this role work with old documents instead of living things. They might compare letters from the past. Their findings can help explain what happened long ago.

examples.en: The cloud resembled a sleeping cat.
examples.zh: 那朵雲看起來像一隻睡著的貓。

examples.en: She closely resembles her older sister.
examples.zh: 她長得很像姊姊。

examples.en: The leaves resemble tiny stars.
examples.zh: 這些葉子看起來像小星星。

explains.en: This means to look or seem like someone or something else. Two things may share a shape, color, or other feature. They do not have to be exactly the same.
A cloud has a long shape with two parts that look like ears. A child says it looks like a rabbit. The cloud reminds the child of that animal.
People in the same family may have similar eyes or smiles. A child can look a lot like a parent. This verb describes that similarity.

examples.en: I made a dinner reservation for four at the hot pot restaurant.
examples.zh: 我在火鍋店預約了四個人的晚餐訂位。

examples.en: You must confirm your table reservation at least one day before dining.
examples.zh: 您必須在用餐前至少一天確認您的訂位。

examples.en: The committee expressed strong reservations about the proposed budget cut.
examples.zh: 委員會對擬議中的預算削減表達了強烈保留態度。

examples.en: I made an online hotel reservation for two nights in Kenting.
examples.zh: 我在網路上預訂了墾丁兩晚的飯店住宿。

examples.en: Because the seafood restaurant is very popular, making a table reservation is mandatory.
examples.zh: 由於這家人氣海鮮餐廳極受歡迎，前來用餐必須提前事先訂位。

examples.en: You can modify or cancel your booking reservation without penalty up to forty-eight hours in advance.
examples.zh: 您在入住前四十八小時均可免費修改或取消飯店預約訂單。

entries.definition: 預約；訂位；訂房；預訂（房間、席位）

explains.en: This can mean an arrangement to keep a place or service ready for someone. A family may book a hotel room before a trip. The hotel holds the room for their arrival.
A restaurant may save a table for guests at a chosen time. The guests give their name when they arrive. The arrangement helps them plan their evening.
The noun can also mean a doubt or concern about a plan. Someone may like most of an idea but worry about its cost. That concern can make them hesitate.

examples.en: She decided to resign to pursue a master's degree in the UK.
examples.zh: 她決定辭職前往英國攻讀碩士學位。

examples.en: The government minister chose to resign to take full political responsibility.
examples.zh: 該名內閣部會首長為表示承擔全部政治責任，毅然決然主動請辭下台。

examples.en: After months of unresolved workplace disagreements, he chose to resign gracefully.
examples.zh: 經歷了數個月始終無法化解的職場理念歧異之後，他選擇體面優雅地遞出辭呈離職。

explains.en: This means to choose to leave a job or an official position. The person tells others they will no longer do that work. A letter may explain the decision.
A club leader has too little time for the role. The leader tells the members that someone else should take over. Leaving the role by choice is the action described.
In a board game such as chess, this can mean accepting that you have lost before the game ends. A player stops rather than making another move. The other player wins.

examples.en: He handed in his formal letter of resignation two weeks in advance.
examples.zh: 他提前兩週向上級遞交了正式的離職辭呈。

examples.en: The board of directors reluctantly accepted the founding CEO's resignation.
examples.zh: 公司董事會深思熟慮後，萬分不捨地依依接受了創始執行長提出的離職辭呈。

examples.en: News of the star director's sudden resignation surprised everyone in the tech community.
examples.zh: 這位明星技術長突然拋出震撼請辭辭職的消息，令整個科技創投圈深感錯愕震驚。

explains.en: This can mean the act of choosing to leave a job or position. A written notice may tell an employer about the decision. The person may name the day they plan to finish.
A team captain decides to step down because of other duties. The team receives a letter explaining the choice. They must choose someone new for the role.
The noun can also mean calmly accepting something unpleasant that seems impossible to change. A traveler learns that the last bus has left. With a sigh, the traveler accepts the long wait.

examples.en: Progressive resistance training strengthens skeletal bones and builds lean muscle.
examples.zh: 循序漸進的漸進式阻力訓練能有效強化骨質密度並刺激骨骼肌肌肉合成生長。

examples.en: Elastic bands create variable resistance that peaks at the top of each movement.
examples.zh: 彈力帶能產生變動阻力，在動作頂峰收縮時提供最大的阻抗力。

examples.en: Regular resistance exercise helps older adults preserve mobility and prevent muscle loss.
examples.zh: 規律進行阻力運動有助於年長者維持行動力並預防肌肉流失。

examples.en: Seated elastic band resistance exercises build thigh quadriceps without stressing aged knee joints.
examples.zh: 坐在椅子上進行的彈力帶阻力訓練，能在不磨損膝關節的前提下鍛鍊大腿股四頭肌。

examples.en: The union mounted strong political resistance against the proposed corporate pension cuts.
examples.zh: 工會發起了強烈且堅定的抗爭抵制，全力反對資方所提出的刪減員工退休金方案。

examples.en: High thermal resistance materials are installed inside walls to minimize summer air conditioning energy losses.
examples.zh: 建築牆體內部安裝了高熱阻隔熱材料，以最大限度減少夏季室內冷氣空調的能源損耗。

entries.definition: 阻力訓練；抵抗阻力；坐姿漸進式彈力帶阻力訓練；抵抗

explains.en: This means acting against something or refusing to accept it. People may oppose a plan they believe is unfair. Their objections make it harder for the plan to go ahead.
A heavy box is difficult to push across a rough floor. The surfaces press and rub against each other. That force opposes the movement.
The noun can also describe how much a material makes it difficult for electric current to pass. Some materials allow current through easily. Others greatly limit its flow.

examples.en: Export the master file in 4K resolution at sixty frames per second.
examples.zh: 請以 4K 超高解析度並搭配每秒六十幀（60 FPS）的極致流暢規格匯出母帶檔案。

examples.en: Making a New Year's resolution to exercise three times a week is a common goal.
examples.zh: 下定新年新希望並立志每週至少規律運動三次，是許多人最常見的新年決心。

examples.en: The United Nations General Assembly passed a historic resolution calling for peace.
examples.zh: 聯合國大會以壓倒性多數正式通過了一項呼籲和平與停止衝突的歷史性決議案。

examples.en: High 8K resolution eliminates visible print layer lines, producing flawless miniature facial expressions.
examples.zh: 高達 8K 的極致列印解析度，能徹底消除肉眼可見的層紋階梯，印出栩栩如生的精緻微表情。

examples.en: Making a New Year's resolution to exercise three times each week is a wonderful habit for personal health.
examples.zh: 在元旦清晨許下每週至少規律運動三次的新年新希望決心，是維持個人長久身心健康的絕佳好習慣。

examples.en: Peaceful diplomatic negotiations led to a prompt and amicable resolution of the cross-border trade dispute.
examples.zh: 經過多輪冷靜克制的外交斡旋協商，終於促成了這起跨國雙邊貿易摩擦爭端的迅速圓滿解決化解。

examples.en: High spatial resolution resolves individual star clusters inside merging colliding galaxies billions of light-years away.
examples.zh: 極致的「空間角解析度」（Resolution），能清晰分辨百億光年外相互碰撞星系內部的單獨星團結構。

examples.en: Modern 8K television screens offer breathtaking visual resolution that shows every grain of sand in landscapes.
examples.zh: 最新款 8K 超高畫質電視螢幕呈現令人屏息的細緻影像解析度，連風景畫面中的微小沙礫都歷歷在目。

examples.en: The United Nations General Assembly passed a unanimous resolution condemning maritime pollution.
examples.zh: 聯合國大會經過全體代表深入研商後，以壓倒性多數一致通過了譴責向公海傾倒污染物的正式決議。

entries.definition: 影片解析度；決心；解決；八微米超高列印解析度；解析度；毫角秒級極致超高空間角解析度

explains.en: This can mean a firm decision to do something. A person chooses a goal and intends to follow it. A new year is a common time for such promises.
The noun can also mean the settling of a problem or disagreement. Two friends may talk until they find an answer both accept. The conflict then comes to an end.
For pictures and screens, this word concerns how much detail an image can show. More tiny picture points can make small features clearer. This matters when viewing or printing an image.

examples.en: Both sides sat down calmly to resolve their differences.
examples.zh: 雙方心平氣和坐下來解決彼此的分歧。

examples.en: Customer service representatives worked patiently to resolve the complicated software issue.
examples.zh: 客服人員極具耐心地反覆排查測試，成功為使用者解決了複雜的軟體程式問題。

examples.en: She resolved to study English vocabulary for thirty minutes every single day this year.
examples.zh: 她下定堅定決心，今年無論如何每天一定要抽出整整三十分鐘專心背英語單字。

entries.definition: 解決（紛爭、難題）；下定決心

explains.en: This means to settle a problem or find an answer to it. People may discuss several ideas before agreeing. The difficulty is then dealt with.
Two classmates want to use the same computer. They agree to take turns for equal amounts of time. Their agreement settles the dispute.
The verb can also mean deciding firmly to do something. The noun names strong determination. A person may continue toward a goal even when progress is slow.

examples.en: She runs a respectable family business.
examples.zh: 她經營一家信譽良好的家族企業。

examples.en: The young runner finished with a respectable time.
examples.zh: 這位年輕跑者以相當不錯的成績完賽。

examples.en: They wanted to earn a respectable living through honest work.
examples.zh: 他們想靠誠實工作過上體面的生活。

entries.definition: （形）值得尊敬的；體面的；相當不錯的

explains.en: This describes someone or something generally considered decent and worthy of respect. Honest actions and good behavior can build that view. People may trust a person with this quality.
A family runs a shop fairly and treats customers well. Neighbors know that promises will be kept. The business earns a good standing in the community.
This word can also mean fairly good or large enough to be acceptable. A team may earn a solid score without winning first place. The result is still something to be pleased with.

examples.en: Students maintained a quiet and respectful silence during the lecture.
examples.zh: 學生在演講進行期間保持安靜且充滿敬意。

examples.en: Always use polite and respectful language when writing formal business emails.
examples.zh: 撰寫正式的商務商業往來電子郵件時，務必隨時使用客氣端莊的敬語措辭。

examples.en: Visitors bowed in a respectful manner when entering the historical ancestral shrine.
examples.zh: 參訪者在邁入歷史悠久的宗族祖祠時，皆莊重地微微躬身表達崇敬之禮。

explains.en: This describes behavior that shows care for someone’s feelings or position. A person listens politely and speaks thoughtfully. The person treats others as important.
A visitor waits while another person finishes speaking. Then the visitor asks a question in a calm voice. These actions show good manners and consideration.
People can disagree and still behave this way. They can explain their views without insults. Listening carefully shows that the other person deserves to be heard.

examples.en: You can restore all photos from your cloud account to the new phone.
examples.zh: 你可以將雲端帳戶中的所有照片完整還原至新手機上。

examples.en: The IT specialist managed to restore corrupted database files after the crash.
examples.zh: 資訊專員在當機事故後成功修復並還原了損毀的資料庫檔案。

examples.en: The community raised funds to restore the historic town hall.
examples.zh: 社區募集資金以修復重建這座歷史悠久的市政廳建築。

explains.en: This means to bring something back to an earlier or better condition. An old building may need careful repairs. The work can make it look much as it once did.
A storm cuts off power to a neighborhood. Workers fix the damaged lines. Electricity becomes available again.
The verb can also mean returning something that was lost or taken away. A museum may receive an object that had been missing. The item is put back in its proper place.

examples.en: Aviation liquid restrictions mandate all gels be packed in 100ml transparent bottles.
examples.zh: 民航安全法規嚴格規定，隨身攜帶之液體與凝膠乳液每瓶容量不得超過一百毫升。

examples.en: The city imposed traffic speed restrictions in school zones to protect crossing children.
examples.zh: 市政府在各國民小學校園周邊限速學區劃設嚴格的速限交通管制規定，以保護學童過馬路安全。

examples.en: Be aware of import restrictions regarding dried meats, fresh fruits, and dairy products.
examples.zh: 旅客入境前請務必熟記海關對肉乾零食、新鮮生果與乳製品等動植物產品的嚴格輸入限制。

entries.definition: 攜帶限制；管制規定；限制

explains.en: This is a rule or limit on what people can do. It may control an amount, a time, or an activity. People have less freedom within that limit.
A library allows each reader to borrow only five books at once. This limit helps keep books available for others. Readers must return some before taking more.
A limit may apply only in certain places or at certain times. A path may be closed while workers repair a bridge. The rule can be removed when the work is finished.

examples.en: The thick walls retain heat well.
examples.zh: 厚實的牆壁能很好地保留熱度。

examples.en: She retained a clear memory of the trip.
examples.zh: 她仍清楚記得那次旅行。

examples.en: Please retain your ticket until the journey ends.
examples.zh: 請保留車票直到旅程結束。

entries.definition: （動）保留、維持；繼續擁有或保存某物，不讓它消失或流失。

explains.en: This means to keep something instead of losing or giving it up. A person may hold on to an object or a right. The thing remains with them.
A student learns a new fact and remembers it weeks later. The information has stayed in the student’s memory. Regular practice can help it remain there.
A material can hold heat or water for a period of time. Thick cloth may help keep warmth close to the body. The verb can describe keeping that warmth in.

examples.en: My father plans to retire at sixty-five and take up gardening.
examples.zh: 我父親計畫在六十五歲退休並開始投入園藝愛好。

examples.en: The veteran baseball pitcher decided to retire after eighteen stellar seasons.
examples.zh: 在征戰賽場整整十八個戰功彪炳的輝煌賽季後，這位傳奇老將投手正式決定引退。

examples.en: Building an emergency nest egg enables individuals to retire comfortably with peace of mind.
examples.zh: 及早規劃存妥一筆充足的應急養老金，能讓每個人在晚年無憂無慮、體面舒適地退休。

explains.en: The verb often means to stop working at a job after many years. A person may do this later in life. More time can then be spent on family or other interests.
The noun names the time of life after leaving regular work. Someone may travel, garden, or help in the community. People choose different ways to spend this period.
The verb can also mean to stop taking part in an activity. An injured player may leave a match before it ends. An old machine can also be taken out of service.

examples.en: The hikers retreated when the path became unsafe.
examples.zh: 步道變得不安全時，登山客退了回去。

examples.en: The little cabin was a quiet retreat from city life.
examples.zh: 那間小木屋是遠離城市生活的寧靜休憩處。

examples.en: The army began its retreat before dawn.
examples.zh: 軍隊在黎明前開始撤退。

entries.definition: （名）撤退；休養處；靜修；（動）撤退；退避。

explains.en: This means to move back or away from danger or difficulty. A group may pull back when it cannot safely continue. Moving away creates more distance from the threat.
A cat approaches a barking dog and then steps backward. It moves behind a gate to feel safer. The action can be described with this verb.
The noun can also name a quiet place or a short stay away from daily pressures. People may go somewhere peaceful to rest and think. A small cabin can serve this purpose.

examples.en: Our family held a reunion at the old farmhouse.
examples.zh: 我們家在老農舍舉行了團聚活動。

examples.en: She met her former classmates at a school reunion.
examples.zh: 她在同學會上見到了以前的同學。

examples.en: The reunion of the lost dog and its owner made everyone smile.
examples.zh: 走失的狗與主人重逢，讓大家都笑了。

explains.en: This is a meeting of people who have been apart for some time. They come together again to share news and memories. The occasion may feel joyful or emotional.
Former classmates meet many years after leaving school. They talk about old lessons and teachers. They also learn what their friends are doing now.
A family may gather relatives who live in different towns. People travel to one place for a shared meal. Children may meet cousins they have not seen for years.

examples.en: The character wanted revenge after his friend betrayed him.
examples.zh: 那個角色被朋友背叛後想要報復。

examples.en: She decided to forgive him instead of seeking revenge.
examples.zh: 她決定原諒他，而不是尋求報復。

examples.en: The story shows how revenge can hurt both sides.
examples.zh: 這個故事展現了報復如何傷害雙方。

explains.en: This means hurting or upsetting someone because they hurt or upset you first. The aim is to make the other person suffer in return. It often grows from anger.
In a story, someone breaks a character’s favorite toy. The character wants to break something belonging to that person. That desire is an example of this feeling.
Trying to get even can keep a conflict going. One angry act may lead to another. A story may show a character deciding to end the cycle instead.

examples.en: Revise your vocabulary notes every evening before going to bed.
examples.zh: 每天晚上睡前把單字筆記重新溫習一遍。

examples.en: The editor asked the author to revise the final three chapters of the novel.
examples.zh: 責任編輯要求作者修改小說的最後三個章節。

examples.en: The economic agency revised its gross domestic product forecast upward.
examples.zh: 經濟評估主管機關將年度國內生產毛額預估值向上進行修正。

explains.en: This means to look over something and make changes to improve it. A writer may correct mistakes or make ideas clearer. The new version should work better.
A student reads a story draft and notices that the ending is confusing. The student changes a few sentences and adds a missing detail. The story becomes easier to follow.
In British English, this verb can mean studying material again before a test. A learner looks back at notes and practices questions. The aim is to remember and understand the subject.

examples.en: The teacher suggested a revision to my final paragraph.
examples.zh: 老師建議修改我的最後一段。

examples.en: This revision of the plan includes a larger playground.
examples.zh: 這份修訂後的計畫包含更大的遊樂場。

examples.en: He spent the evening doing revision for his exam.
examples.zh: 他晚上花時間複習，準備考試。

entries.definition: （名）修訂、修改；為改善內容而重新檢查並改動，也可指複習。

explains.en: This can mean a change made to improve or correct something. A report may need a clearer ending. An added sentence can be one such change.
The noun can also name a new version after changes have been made. A writer may send the updated text to an editor. The editor compares it with the earlier draft.
In British English, this can mean studying material again before an exam. Students may review notes and practice questions. This helps them prepare to use what they have learned.

examples.en: Spatial computing represents the next profound revolution in how humans create, communicate, and live.
examples.zh: 空間運算標誌著繼滑鼠與觸控螢幕之後，人類溝通、創造與生活的下一場「人機互動偉大革命」（Revolution）。

examples.en: The widespread adoption of smartphones triggered a digital communication revolution across every continent.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機的普及在全球各大洲引發了一場翻天覆地的數位通訊與生活型態革命。

examples.en: Planetary astronomers calculate the exact period of the satellite's revolution around Jupiter.
examples.zh: 行星天文學家精密計算出這顆天然衛星繞行木星運轉的完整公轉週期。

examples.en: The bio-manufacturing revolution is transforming factories from chemical smokestacks into clean fermentation tanks.
examples.zh: 這場席捲全球的「生物製造偉大革命」（Revolution），正將傳統排煙化工廠轉型為純淨清新的生物發酵槽。

examples.en: The invention of the movable type printing press catalyzed an unprecedented intellectual and literacy revolution.
examples.zh: 活字印刷術的偉大發明，在歐洲歷史上催化了一場前所未有的知識普及傳播與全民識字率巨幅躍升革命。

examples.en: Astronomical calculations accurately predict the celestial moon’s orbital revolution around planet Earth.
examples.zh: 天文軌道物理數學計算，能極其精確地預測月球圍繞地球公轉軌道運行的完整天體運行週期。

entries.definition: 繼滑鼠與多點觸控後之第三次人機互動革命；第四次工業革命之綠色生物製造偉大浪潮；革命

explains.en: This can mean a major change in who holds political power. People may remove an old system of rule. A different system takes its place.
The noun can also describe a very large change in how people live or work. New inventions may transform whole industries. Daily life can become very different afterward.
It can also mean one complete turn around a point or path. A wheel can make a full turn. A moving object may then reach the position where that turn began.

examples.en: The new printing method was a revolutionary invention.
examples.zh: 這種新的印刷方法是一項革命性的發明。

examples.en: The book describes revolutionary ideas that changed the country.
examples.zh: 這本書描述了改變國家的革命思想。

examples.en: The museum displayed a letter written by a famous revolutionary.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了一位著名革命者寫的信。

entries.definition: 革命的；重大創新的；革命者。

explains.en: This describes a change so large that it creates a very different way of doing things. An invention may transform work across the world. People no longer follow the old method.
The word can also describe actions or ideas connected with changing a system of government. A group may want to replace the old rulers. It seeks a major shift in power.
As a noun, this names someone working for that kind of political change. The person may organize others or spread new ideas. The goal is to replace an existing system.

examples.en: The owner offered a reward for the missing dog.
examples.zh: 主人懸賞尋找走失的狗。

examples.en: She rewarded the children with a picnic after their hard work.
examples.zh: 孩子們努力工作後，她以野餐作為獎勵。

examples.en: Seeing the finished garden was a reward for our effort.
examples.zh: 看見完工的花園，就是我們付出努力的回報。

explains.en: This is something good given in return for an action or effort. It may be money, a prize, or special time to enjoy an activity. It shows that the action was valued.
A person returns a lost bag to its owner. The owner offers a small gift as thanks. That gift is something the person receives for helping.
The good result can also be a feeling. A gardener may feel happy after seeing flowers grow. Enjoying that result can make the effort feel worthwhile.

examples.en: The words light and night rhyme.
examples.zh: light 和 night 這兩個字押韻。

examples.en: She wrote a short rhyme about her cat.
examples.zh: 她寫了一首關於自家貓咪的短押韻詩。

examples.en: Can you find a word that rhymes with tree?
examples.zh: 你能找一個和 tree 押韻的字嗎？

explains.en: This happens when words have matching ending sounds. Cat and hat are one pair. Writers often use such pairs in songs and poems.
A short verse may end its lines with similar sounds. Listeners can hear a pattern as the lines are read aloud. The pattern may make the verse easier to remember.
Matching sounds matter more than matching letters. Blue and shoe end alike when spoken. Love and move look similar but have different ending sounds.

examples.en: Clap your hands along with the lively rhythm of the music.
examples.zh: 跟隨音樂歡快的節奏一起拍拍手。

examples.en: Maintaining a steady daily sleep rhythm improves your mental focus.
examples.zh: 維持規律穩定的每日作息生理節奏有助於提升專注力。

examples.en: Latin dances are characterized by fast, energetic hip rhythms.
examples.zh: 拉丁舞的特色在於快速且充滿活力的臀部節奏律動。

explains.en: This is a pattern of sounds or movements over time. Some beats may be strong and others soft. The pattern helps music feel organized.
A child claps twice, pauses, and then claps twice again. The same timing continues for several rounds. Other children can copy the pattern.
Speech and poetry can have patterns of stressed and unstressed sounds. Dancers can also move in time with repeated beats. Listening to the timing helps them stay together.

examples.en: Solving clever riddles on Lantern Festival night is entertaining.
examples.zh: 在元宵節夜晚猜有趣的燈謎既益智又娛樂。

examples.en: The puzzle host gave contestants three subtle clues to solve the tricky riddle.
examples.zh: 猜謎活動主持人給了參賽選手三個巧妙提示來解開這道棘手的謎語。

examples.en: How the ancient builders moved those massive stone slabs remains an unsolved riddle.
examples.zh: 古代工匠究竟是如何搬運那些巨大石板的，至今仍是一個未解之謎。

explains.en: This is a puzzling question or description with a hidden answer. The clues may have more than one meaning. You have to think carefully to solve it.
A child asks what has hands but cannot clap. The answer is a clock. The trick comes from using a familiar word in a different way.
The noun can also mean something mysterious that is hard to explain. People may search for clues over time. Finding the answer removes the mystery.

examples.en: The robber demanded the traveler’s bag.
examples.zh: 搶匪要求旅人交出袋子。

examples.en: The police caught the robber near the station.
examples.zh: 警方在車站附近抓到了搶匪。

examples.en: The witness described the robber’s red jacket.
examples.zh: 目擊者描述了搶匪身上的紅色外套。

entries.definition: （名）強盜；以暴力或威脅從他人手中搶取財物的人。

explains.en: This is someone who takes another person’s property by using force or threats. The person frightens or hurts someone to get what they want. It is a kind of stealing.
In a story, someone demands a traveler’s bag and threatens to hurt the traveler. The bag is taken against the owner’s wishes. The noun names the person taking it.
A thief may secretly take something without confronting anyone. This word usually suggests that force or a threat is involved. The surrounding story helps show what happened.

examples.en: The movie tells a touching romance set in 1980s Taipei.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述了發生在 1980 年代台北的感人愛情故事。

examples.en: He still believes in the timeless romance of writing handwritten love letters.
examples.zh: 他依舊堅信親筆書寫紙本情書那份歷久彌新的浪漫情調。

examples.en: Backpacking through the Swiss Alps rekindled their romance and love for adventure.
examples.zh: 背包徒步穿越瑞士阿爾卑斯山重新點燃了他們的浪漫愛火與冒險熱情。

explains.en: This can mean a loving relationship between two people. They may enjoy being together and caring for one another. The feeling often involves attraction and affection.
A story about people falling in love can have this name. The characters may face problems before finding happiness together. Books and films often use this kind of plot.
The noun can also describe a sense of wonder or exciting beauty. Someone may feel this about distant travel or old sailing ships. The idea feels more magical than ordinary daily life.

examples.en: Check the GPS navigation for the fastest driving route.
examples.zh: 查閱 GPS 導航以獲取最快速的行車路線。

examples.en: The city added a new bus route serving remote suburban communities.
examples.zh: 市政府新增了一條服務偏遠郊區社區的公車路線。

examples.en: Hikers followed a well-marked mountain route up to the summit.
examples.zh: 登山客沿著標示清晰的登山路徑一路登上山頂。

explains.en: This is the way taken to get from one place to another. It can include roads, paths, or other sections of a journey. A map can show the whole course.
Two paths may lead to the same park. One goes past the school while the other follows a river. A traveler chooses which way to take.
The verb means to direct something along a chosen path. A delivery company sends packages through certain towns. The selected path helps them reach the correct address.

examples.en: The spilled juice ruined my drawing.
examples.zh: 打翻的果汁毀了我的畫。

examples.en: Heavy rain threatened to ruin the picnic.
examples.zh: 大雨眼看就要破壞這場野餐。

examples.en: We explored the ruins of an old castle.
examples.zh: 我們探索了一座古堡的遺跡。

entries.definition: （動）毀壞；使破產；破壞；（名）廢墟；毀滅。

explains.en: This means to damage something so badly that it cannot be used or enjoyed as before. Water may spoil a paper drawing. The picture loses the details the artist wanted.
A sudden storm can spoil plans for an outdoor picnic. The food may get wet and everyone has to leave. The enjoyable event no longer works as planned.
The noun can describe severe damage or the broken remains of an old building. Stone walls may stand where a castle once stood. These remains show what was there long ago.

examples.en: The school serves children in a rural area.
examples.zh: 這所學校為鄉村地區的孩子提供教育。

examples.en: We spent the weekend in a quiet rural village.
examples.zh: 我們在一座寧靜的鄉村度過週末。

examples.en: The bus connects several rural communities.
examples.zh: 這班公車連接幾個鄉村社區。

explains.en: This describes things connected with the countryside. Farms, fields, and small villages are common features. The setting is outside a large town or city.
A school stands beside fields and a narrow road. Some children travel from nearby farms. The school serves a country community.
Life in this setting may involve more open land and fewer nearby buildings. People may travel farther for some services. Different country areas still have different ways of life.

examples.en: The rusty gate made a loud noise when it opened.
examples.zh: 生鏽的門打開時發出很大的聲音。

examples.en: We found a rusty nail beside the shed.
examples.zh: 我們在小屋旁找到一根生鏽的釘子。

examples.en: My French is rusty because I have not used it for years.
examples.zh: 我多年沒用法文，已經生疏了。

explains.en: This describes iron or steel covered with a reddish-brown layer caused by air and water. The surface may look rough or flaky. The metal can become weaker over time.
An old bicycle is left outside in the rain for months. Brown patches form on some metal parts. Those parts no longer look smooth and shiny.
The word can also describe a skill that has become weaker through lack of practice. Someone may struggle to play a song they once knew well. Practice can help the skill return.

examples.en: She sacrificed her free afternoon to help her friend.
examples.zh: 她犧牲了下午的休閒時間來幫助朋友。

examples.en: His parents made many sacrifices so he could study.
examples.zh: 他的父母為了讓他讀書，付出了許多犧牲。

examples.en: The team’s success required time and sacrifice.
examples.zh: 團隊的成功需要時間與付出。

entries.definition: （名）犧牲、奉獻；（動）犧牲、捨棄；為重要目標放棄某物。

explains.en: This means giving up something valuable for a person, cause, or goal. The thing given up may be time, money, or comfort. Another need is treated as more important.
A student skips a favorite game to help a sick friend with missed lessons. The lost playtime matters to the student. Helping the friend is chosen instead.
The noun can name the thing given up or the act of giving it up. Parents may spend their free time caring for a child. The choice can involve effort or loss for someone else’s benefit.

examples.en: Formosat-5 is Taiwan's first domestically developed remote sensing satellite.
examples.zh: 福衛五號是全台灣第一顆由本土自主研發成功發射的遙測人造衛星。

examples.en: GPS receivers determine your exact geographic position by triangulating signals from four satellites.
examples.zh: 智慧手機的 GPS 定位晶片透過同時交叉比對接收四顆以上導航衛星訊號，精準鎖定您的地理位置。

examples.en: Natural satellites like the Moon orbit terrestrial planets due to gravitational attraction.
examples.zh: 如月球這般的天然衛星，在萬有引力牽引下億萬年如一日忠實繞行著各自行星母體運轉。

examples.en: Formosat-7 atmospheric satellites collect precise weather radar data to track severe typhoons.
examples.zh: 台灣自主研製的「福爾摩沙衛星七號」氣象衛星群，每日精準收集海量大氣資料以預測強颱動向。

examples.en: Emergency workers relied on satellite phones when mountain roads and cell towers were destroyed.
examples.zh: 當山區道路與行動基地台遭破壞時，緊急救難人員全仰賴衛星電話維持通訊。

examples.en: Modern farmers utilize satellite imagery to monitor soil moisture and crop health across vast fields.
examples.zh: 現代農民利用高解析度衛星空拍影像，監控廣大農田的土壤濕度與作物健康狀態。

entries.definition: 人造衛星；月球衛星；衛星城市；衛星通訊

explains.en: This is an object that travels around a larger body in space. It can be natural or made by people. Earth’s moon is a natural example.
People send machines into space to move around Earth. Some take pictures of clouds and storms. Others help carry messages or show locations.
The path around the larger body is called an orbit. Gravity helps keep the moving object on that path. It can go around many times without landing.

examples.en: She felt satisfaction after finishing the difficult puzzle.
examples.zh: 完成困難的拼圖後，她感到滿足。

examples.en: The gardener looked at the flowers with satisfaction.
examples.zh: 園丁滿足地看著那些花。

examples.en: The shop asked customers about their satisfaction with the service.
examples.zh: 商店詢問顧客對服務的滿意程度。

explains.en: This is a pleased feeling when something meets your needs or hopes. A job done well can bring it. You feel that the result is good.
A child finishes a difficult puzzle after many attempts. Looking at the complete picture brings a warm sense of success. The effort feels worthwhile.
A customer may be happy because a product works as promised. The service may also be friendly and helpful. Shops sometimes ask about this feeling to learn how well they are doing.

examples.en: There was scarcely enough room for one more chair.
examples.zh: 幾乎沒有足夠空間再放一張椅子。

examples.en: I could scarcely hear her quiet voice.
examples.zh: 她的聲音很輕，我幾乎聽不見。

examples.en: We had scarcely arrived when it began to rain.
examples.zh: 我們剛到，天就開始下雨了。

explains.en: This means hardly or almost not. It shows that there is very little of something. A person may have almost no time left.
A room is so dark that you can only just see the door. The shape is barely visible. This word can describe how difficult it is to see.
The word can also show that one event happened just before another. Someone arrives home and the phone immediately rings. There was almost no gap between the two events.

examples.en: We stopped to admire the mountain scenery.
examples.zh: 我們停下來欣賞山景。

examples.en: The train journey offered beautiful scenery.
examples.zh: 這趟火車旅程沿途風景優美。

examples.en: The students painted the scenery for the school play.
examples.zh: 學生們為學校戲劇繪製舞台布景。

explains.en: This means the natural features you can see in a place. Mountains, rivers, forests, and fields can all be part of it. People may enjoy looking at the whole view.
A train passes beside a lake and green hills. Travelers look out of the windows and take pictures. They admire the landscape along the journey.
The noun can also mean painted backgrounds and other large pieces used on a stage. These help show where a play takes place. A painted forest may make the stage look like woodland.

examples.en: The teacher scolded the students for shouting in the hall.
examples.zh: 老師責備學生在走廊大聲喊叫。

examples.en: She scolded her brother for taking her notebook without asking.
examples.zh: 她責備弟弟沒先問就拿走她的筆記本。

examples.en: He looked down after being scolded for the broken window.
examples.zh: 他因打破窗戶被責備後，低下了頭。

entries.definition: （動）責罵、斥責；（名）責罵；因某人做錯事而嚴厲批評。

explains.en: This means to speak angrily to someone about something they did wrong. The speaker shows clear disapproval. The words may sound sharp or severe.
A child breaks a rule after being reminded several times. An adult gives the child a stern talk. The adult is expressing anger about the behavior.
As a noun, this can mean someone who often speaks angrily about what other people do. The person may complain about small mistakes. This use is less common than the action word.

examples.en: Responsible dog owners carry biodegradable bags to scoop poop during walks.
examples.zh: 具備高度公德心的文明好飼主出門散步時皆會隨身攜帶環保分解拾便袋隨手撿便。

examples.en: Use a perforated plastic scoop to clean clumps easily from the litter box.
examples.zh: 使用帶有瀝砂孔洞的塑膠貓砂鏟，能輕鬆過濾並鏟除貓砂盆裡的凝結尿塊與便便。

examples.en: Remember to scoop the waste immediately to maintain clean and hygienic public parks.
examples.zh: 請記得在愛犬排泄後立刻隨手撿拾清理排泄物，共同維持公共綠地公園的整潔與衛生。

explains.en: This can mean a tool with a deep rounded part for lifting loose material. It may hold flour, grain, or ice cream. The shape helps gather a portion.
The verb means to lift or gather something with a curved tool or hand. Someone may cup both hands to pick up water. The material is carried in the hollow space.

In news writing, the noun can mean an important story reported before other news organizations have it. A reporter may discover new information first. Being first to share it makes the story stand out.

examples.en: The branch scratched the side of the car.
examples.zh: 樹枝刮傷了車子的側面。

examples.en: There was a small scratch on the table.
examples.zh: 桌上有一道小刮痕。

examples.en: The cat scratched its ear with a back paw.
examples.zh: 貓用後腳抓了抓耳朵。

explains.en: This means to rub a surface with something sharp or rough. A fingernail can leave a small mark on soft material. A key can also make a thin line on a painted surface.
An itchy arm may make someone rub the spot with their nails. That action has this name. An animal may do a similar action with a claw.
The noun can mean a small cut or thin mark left by a sharp object. A branch may leave one on a car door. The mark can be shallow even when it is easy to see.

examples.en: The stone sculpture in front of the plaza represents peace.
examples.zh: 廣場前方的石雕作品象徵著和平。

examples.en: Michelangelo carved majestic sculptures out of massive blocks of Italian marble.
examples.zh: 米開朗基羅將大塊義大利大理石雕刻成一座座雄偉的雕塑。

examples.en: An abstract bronze sculpture was unveiled in the botanical garden.
examples.zh: 一座抽象青銅雕塑在植物園中正式揭幕亮相。

examples.en: Ju Ming's Taichi sculpture series represents the harmony of human movement.
examples.zh: 朱銘大師的《太極》系列雕塑作品展現了人體律動的和諧之美。

examples.en: An impressive marble sculpture stood in the center of the fountain courtyard.
examples.zh: 一尊令人嘆為觀止的巨大大理石雕塑巍然矗立在噴水池庭院中央。

examples.en: The art academy trains students in traditional clay modeling and bronze sculpture.
examples.zh: 這所藝術學院悉心培訓學生掌握傳統泥塑成型與青銅雕塑工藝。

examples.en: Sanyi wood sculpture masters carve fragrant camphor tree roots into lifelike Buddhist statues.
examples.zh: 苗栗三義木雕名匠巧妙順應天然芳香樟木樹根的奇異紋理，以高超刀法雕琢出栩栩如生的莊嚴佛像。

examples.en: The outdoor sculpture park displays monumental bronze installations seamlessly integrated into the landscape.
examples.zh: 戶外雕塑藝術園區展出多件大型現代青銅裝置，與起伏翠綠的自然山丘地景融為一體。

examples.en: She studied classical stone sculpture in Italy before opening her creative studio in rural Miaoli.
examples.zh: 她遠赴義大利佛羅倫斯研習古典大理石雕刻技藝，返台後選擇在純樸的苗栗鄉間設立個人創作工坊。

entries.definition: 雕塑；雕像；雕刻；雕塑品；木雕雕刻藝術

explains.en: A carved figure or shaped object can be made from stone, wood, or clay. People may place it in a park or museum. Some works show people, animals, or abstract shapes.
An artist can shape soft clay with hands and simple tools. The form becomes firm after drying or heating. Visitors can walk around it and view it from many sides.
A large public artwork may stand beside a road or in a garden. Its size and material affect how it looks. Small pieces can also decorate a home.

examples.en: Please secure the gate before you leave.
examples.zh: 離開前請把大門鎖好。

examples.en: The hikers felt secure inside the warm cabin.
examples.zh: 孩子在溫暖的小屋裡感到安心。

examples.en: Use a strong password to secure your account.
examples.zh: 請使用強密碼保護你的帳戶。

entries.definition: （動）取得；確保；（形）安全的；穩固的

explains.en: This describes a place or object that is protected from danger. A strong lock can keep a bicycle from being stolen. A password can protect private information.
A person may feel sure and free from worry. A child who knows the swimming pool rules may feel calm there. Careful planning can help people feel safe.
As a verb, it can mean to fasten something firmly. A worker checks each strap before lifting a box. Tight knots help keep the load in place.

examples.en: The goalkeeper seized the ball with both hands.
examples.zh: 守門員雙手緊緊抓住球。

examples.en: A sudden fear seized him when the lights went out.
examples.zh: 燈熄滅時，他突然感到害怕。

examples.en: The police seized the stolen bicycles.
examples.zh: 警方查扣了那些失竊的腳踏車。

explains.en: To take hold of something suddenly and firmly is to grab it. A child may grab a falling cup before it hits the floor. Quick action can stop it from breaking.
A leader may take control of a place or object by force. Soldiers might take a bridge during a battle. The action can happen very quickly.
A strong feeling can suddenly fill someone. Fear may make a child freeze during a loud storm. Excitement can also take hold before a big game.

examples.en: The settlers built a small town near the river.
examples.zh: 移民在河邊建起一座小鎮。

examples.en: A settler planted corn beside her cabin.
examples.zh: 一位拓荒者在小木屋旁種了玉米。

examples.en: The museum showed how early settlers traveled west.
examples.zh: 博物館展示早期移民如何向西旅行。

entries.definition: （名）移居者、殖民者；搬到新地區定居的人。

explains.en: This is a person who moves to a new place to live there. Long ago, families traveled across land to build homes. They often had to grow food and make supplies themselves.
A new community may begin when many families arrive. People clear fields, build houses, and make roads. Their work changes the area over time.
The word often appears in stories about earlier times. A family may travel by wagon or on foot. Life can be difficult when few neighbors live nearby.

examples.en: The town prepared for a severe storm.
examples.zh: 鎮上為猛烈的暴風雨做好準備。

examples.en: The teacher gave a severe warning about running in the hall.
examples.zh: 老師嚴厲警告大家不要在走廊奔跑。

examples.en: He had a severe pain in his ankle after the fall.
examples.zh: 他跌倒後腳踝劇烈疼痛。

entries.definition: 嚴重的；嚴厲的；劇烈的；艱難的。

explains.en: This describes something very serious or strong. A heavy storm can damage roofs and knock down trees. People may need to stay indoors until it passes.
A strict rule may allow little freedom. A school may set firm limits on dangerous behavior. Everyone must follow them.
A serious illness or problem can need quick attention. A doctor may watch a very sick patient closely. The family may need clear information and support.

examples.en: My aunt will sew a patch onto my jacket.
examples.zh: 阿姨要在我的外套上縫一塊補丁。

examples.en: He sewed two pieces of blue cloth together.
examples.zh: 他把兩塊藍布縫在一起。

examples.en: We learned to sew a button in class.
examples.zh: 我們在課堂上學習縫鈕扣。

explains.en: This is the work of joining cloth with a needle and thread. A person pushes the needle through the fabric and pulls the thread after it. Small stitches can hold two pieces together.
A loose button can be attached to a shirt with thread. The needle goes through the button holes and cloth. A few careful stitches can make it stay.
People can make clothes, bags, or toys from fabric. They choose colors and patterns before joining the pieces. Patience helps keep the lines neat.

examples.en: We rested in the shade of a tall tree.
examples.zh: 我們在一棵大樹的樹蔭下休息。

examples.en: The umbrella gave the baby shade at the beach.
examples.zh: 海灘上的陽傘替寶寶遮陽。

examples.en: A cloud cast a shade over the garden.
examples.zh: 一片雲在花園投下陰影。

explains.en: This is a cooler place away from direct sunlight. A tree can block the sun on a hot afternoon. People may sit beneath its branches to rest.
The word can name a darker area made when something blocks light. A building casts a long shape across the ground. The shape moves as the sun changes position.
A cover can be pulled over a lamp to soften its light. The room then feels less bright. Artists also use darker areas to show form in a picture.

examples.en: The children sat in a shady spot beneath the trees.
examples.zh: 孩子們坐在樹下陰涼的地方。

examples.en: That shady deal made the shop owner uneasy.
examples.zh: 那筆可疑的交易讓店主感到不安。

examples.en: We walked along a shady lane on the warm day.
examples.zh: 天氣暖和時，我們沿著一條林蔭小路散步。

entries.definition: （形）有陰影的；可疑的、不光明正大的；也可形容不可靠的人事物。

explains.en: This describes a place that has plenty of shade. A leafy path may feel cool even in summer. Tall trees block much of the sunshine.
It can describe behavior that seems dishonest or unfair. A friend may give a doubtful excuse and avoid answering questions. That behavior can make others suspicious.
The word can also describe a person who is sly or untrustworthy. Others may wonder whether the person is hiding something. Clear actions help build trust.

examples.en: It was shameful to laugh at the new student.
examples.zh: 嘲笑新同學是可恥的行為。

examples.en: The team called the unfair trick shameful.
examples.zh: 隊員們稱那種不公平的把戲很丟臉。

examples.en: He felt shameful about taking his sister’s toy without asking.
examples.zh: 他因為沒問過就拿走妹妹的玩具而感到羞愧。

entries.definition: 可恥的；丟臉的；不光彩的。

explains.en: This describes an action that should make someone feel embarrassed. Cheating in a game is unfair to the other players. It can hurt trust between friends.
A public choice can bring dishonor to a group. People may feel upset when a leader lies. Honest behavior helps repair damaged trust.
A person may feel deep embarrassment after doing something cruel. Saying sorry and making things right can help. A sincere apology shows regret.

examples.en: Dad will shave before the family photo.
examples.zh: 爸爸會在拍全家福前刮鬍子。

examples.en: She shaved the side of the wood with a sharp tool.
examples.zh: 她用鋒利的工具削平木頭的一側。

examples.en: He uses warm water when he shaves his face.
examples.zh: 他用溫水刮臉。

entries.definition: （動）刮鬍子；剃除；削去薄層；（名）刮鬍

explains.en: This means to cut hair very close to the skin. A person may use a small blade on the face. Some people do this each morning.
A tool with a sharp edge removes short hairs. Water or cream can help it move smoothly. Careful movements reduce the chance of a small cut.
The word can also describe cutting hair from another part of the body. Some athletes remove hair before a race. People choose what feels comfortable for them.

examples.en: Designated underground metro stations serve as safe air-raid shelters.
examples.zh: 市區各大指定地下捷運站體皆具備堅固完善的防空避難處所掩體功能。

examples.en: The kindhearted couple adopted a stray golden retriever puppy from the municipal animal shelter.
examples.zh: 這對心地善良的年輕夫婦專程造訪公立公有動物收容所，收養了一隻無家可歸的流浪黃金獵犬幼犬。

examples.en: Hikers trapped on the ridge by the sudden blizzard were lucky to find a rustic stone mountain shelter.
examples.zh: 在高山稜線上被突如其來的狂暴暴風雪死死困住的登山小隊，萬分慶幸在山凹處尋獲了一處古樸堅固的避難砌石山屋。

examples.en: Dedicated animal shelter volunteers walk, bathe, and socialize rescued stray dogs every weekend.
examples.zh: 熱血無私的公立動物收容所志工每逢週末假日定期幫獲救流浪狗洗澡、梳毛、放風並進行親人訓練。

examples.en: The overcrowded public shelter organized an adoption day to find loving families for senior dogs.
examples.zh: 面臨空間超載的市立公立收容所舉辦週末認養會，全力替性情溫和的老狗尋找收養家庭。

examples.en: Generous donations of canned food and fleece blankets keep the animal shelter well-supplied during cold spells.
examples.zh: 社會各界慷慨捐贈的各類主食肉罐與保暖刷毛毛毯，讓動物收容所在寒流來襲時備感溫暖。

entries.definition: 避難所；遮蔽處；庇護；動物公立收容所；庇護所

explains.en: This is a place that protects people from weather or danger. A bus stop roof gives passengers cover from rain. A cave can protect animals from wind.
A building may provide a safe place for people who need help. Workers can offer food, a bed, and useful information. Visitors may stay there until they find a home.
As a verb, it can mean to protect someone or something. A thick roof keeps rain off the porch. Trees can also cover small animals.

examples.en: Dedicated process engineers work rotating shifts to maintain non-stop 24/7 manufacturing operations.
examples.zh: 專業製程工程師與設備工程師採四班二輪嚴謹輪班（Shift），確保晶圓產線三百六十五天全天候運作。

examples.en: A fundamental shift in consumer preferences toward electric mobility forced automakers to revamp strategy.
examples.zh: 全球消費者購車偏好向智慧純電車的根本性轉變轉向，迫使歐美傳統車廠火速全面重整旗下產品開發戰略。

examples.en: Hospital nurses handed over patient medical charts at the end of their twelve-hour night shift.
examples.zh: 醫院加護病房前線護理同仁在結束整整十二個小時的高強度大夜班輪班之際，嚴謹與白班同仁逐床交接病歷。

entries.definition: 二十四小時四班二輪產線輪班；轉換

explains.en: This means a change from one thing, place, or way to another. A driver may move the car into a different lane. A new direction can help avoid road work.
At work, a set period of hours can be called a work period. One group may begin in the morning and another at night. The groups take turns doing the same job.
The verb can describe moving your weight or attention. A child may move from one foot to the other while waiting. Looking at a new task can help someone focus.

examples.en: We spent the entire sunny morning sightseeing around historic Lukang town.
examples.zh: 我們整個晴朗的上午都在歷史悠久的鹿港小鎮觀光遊覽。

examples.en: An open-top double-decker bus offers an enjoyable sightseeing tour of downtown Taipei.
examples.zh: 敞篷雙層觀光巴士為遊客提供了暢遊台北市中心的愜意遊覽體驗。

examples.en: Pack comfortable walking shoes if you plan to do heavy city sightseeing.
examples.zh: 若你打算在市區進行長時間步行觀光，務必準備一雙好走的健走鞋。

explains.en: This is visiting interesting places, often while traveling. A family may see famous buildings in a city. They can take pictures and learn local history.
Travelers may ride a bus or walk with a guide. The guide points out important places along the way. A map helps visitors choose where to go.
A trip can include parks, museums, and old streets. Visitors should respect local rules and keep places clean. Planning ahead can make the day easier.

examples.en: Your legal signature is required on the passport form.
examples.zh: 護照申請表上需要您的親筆簽名。

examples.en: Beef noodle soup is the signature dish of this restaurant.
examples.zh: 牛肉麵是這家餐廳的招牌特色料理。

examples.en: He collected hundreds of signatures for the local park petition.
examples.zh: 他為當地公園請願書蒐集了數百份連署簽名。

examples.en: Digital signature algorithms like Dilithium authenticate official government identity passports against forgery.
examples.zh: 採用 Dilithium 抗量子數位簽章標準，能百分之百防範各國數位護照與官方公文遭受偽造。

examples.en: Transitioning digital signature standards prevents quantum adversaries from forging legal corporate contracts.
examples.zh: 全面平穩過渡至抗量子數位簽章標準，能有效防止未來惡意黑客偽造企業法律合約與跨國電匯指令。

examples.en: Cryptographic hardware security modules (HSMs) are being upgraded to sign transactions with quantum-safe signatures.
examples.zh: 金融業硬體安全模組（HSM）全面進行韌體升級，以支援產出符合後量子安全規格的抗量子數位簽章。

entries.definition: 簽名；署名；招牌特徵；數位簽章抗量子身分認證標準 (ML-DSA)

explains.en: This is a person’s written name, often placed at the end of a letter. It can show who wrote or approved the paper. Each person may write it in a special way.
A famous creator may have a product associated with a particular style or feature. Fans may recognize that detail right away. It can appear on several items.
A handwritten name can confirm that someone agreed to a paper. Adults may sign a permission note for a school trip. The writing helps identify the person who approved it.

examples.en: The teacher explained the significance of the old photograph.
examples.zh: 老師解釋了那張老照片的重要意義。

examples.en: Her small gift had great significance to her friend.
examples.zh: 她的小禮物對朋友有很大的意義。

examples.en: The shape has special significance in the local story.
examples.zh: 這個形狀在當地故事中有特殊意義。

explains.en: This is the importance or meaning of something. A small choice may matter a lot to a friend. Its importance depends on what happens next.
A symbol can carry a special message for a group. A flag may remind people of their home and history. The message gives the symbol value.
Researchers may ask why an event matters. They look at what changed and who was affected. Careful study can reveal its larger meaning.

examples.en: His warm words were spoken with deep sincerity.
examples.zh: 他的溫暖話語出自於深切的真誠。

examples.en: The committee welcomed the foreign delegation's sincere offer and evident sincerity.
examples.zh: 委員會十分歡迎外國代表團提出的友善提議以及展現出的顯著誠意。

examples.en: There was no questioning the absolute sincerity behind her generous charity pledge.
examples.zh: 她慷慨解囊捐出鉅額慈善款項的背後初衷，其百分之百的真誠母庸置疑。

explains.en: This means being honest and sincere in what someone says or does. A child who admits a mistake is showing honesty. Telling the truth can help friends trust each other.
A kind apology can feel real when the speaker truly regrets the action. The words match the person’s feelings. The listener may feel respected.
People can speak with honest care during a difficult conversation. They listen and answer openly. This behavior can strengthen a friendship.

examples.en: This noun has a singular form and a plural form.
examples.zh: 這個名詞有單數形式和複數形式。

examples.en: A singular bird sat alone on the branch.
examples.zh: 一隻鳥獨自停在樹枝上。

examples.en: The story had a singular ending that surprised us.
examples.zh: 這個故事有個令人驚訝的特別結局。

entries.definition: （形）單數的、獨特的；（名）單數形式；表示一個而非多個，也可指非凡。

explains.en: This describes one person, thing, or form. A single apple is only one piece of fruit. The word can also describe a noun that points to just one.
In grammar, some forms refer to one person or object. A speaker may say “this book” while holding one book. The listener knows there is only one.
It can describe something unusual or remarkable. A strange event may happen only once. People may remember it because it is unlike the usual pattern.

examples.en: The builders visited the site before work began.
examples.zh: 施工人員在開工前查看了那個地點。

examples.en: Our school has a site with class photos and news.
examples.zh: 我們學校有個網站，放著班級照片和消息。

examples.en: Please keep the work site clear of toys.
examples.zh: 請讓施工現場保持暢通，不要放玩具。

entries.definition: 地點；場所；工地；網站；（動）選址。

explains.en: This is a particular place where something happens or is built. A team may choose a flat field for a new playground. Workers check the ground before building.
A page on the internet can show information about a group or project. Visitors may read news, pictures, and contact details there. They can open it on a phone or computer.
A work area can be busy with tools and workers. Everyone should follow safety signs there. Keeping the area tidy helps people move around.

examples.en: She made a sketch of the new playground.
examples.zh: 她畫了一張新遊樂場的草圖。

examples.en: The artist sketched a bird on the page.
examples.zh: 那位藝術家在紙上快速畫了一隻鳥。

examples.en: I drew a quick sketch before painting the sign.
examples.zh: 我先畫了一張簡單草圖，再去畫招牌。

explains.en: This is a quick, simple drawing of an idea. An artist may use a pencil to mark the main shapes. Small details can be added later.
A student can draw a rough plan before making a model. The picture helps show where each part should go. It does not need to look perfect.
As a verb, it can mean to draw something quickly. A child may draw a house with a few lines. The picture gives others an idea of the design.

examples.en: Taipei 101 was once the tallest skyscraper in the entire world.
examples.zh: 台北 101 曾榮登為全世界第一高樓的超高層摩天大樓。

examples.en: Window washers on suspended platforms clean glass panels on the hundred-story skyscraper.
examples.zh: 洗窗洗玻璃外牆工人在高空吊船洗窗機上，悉心清洗百層摩天大樓的大片玻璃帷幕。

examples.en: The city skyline is dominated by glittering glass skyscrapers reflected in the harbor.
examples.zh: 城市天際線由一棟棟拔地而起、倒映在海港波光粼粼中的玻璃摩天大樓所勾勒。

examples.en: The world’s tallest wooden skyscraper stands eighty meters high, proving the viability of plyscrapers.
examples.zh: 這棟高達八十公尺的全球最高木構摩天大樓，成功向世人驗證木造高樓的成熟可行性。

examples.en: Elevators whisk tenants up to the observation deck of the city’s landmark timber skyscraper.
examples.zh: 高速電梯迅速將訪客送至這座城市指標性全木摩天大樓頂端的景觀露台。

examples.en: Building a skyscraper out of sustainable wood reduces the building's overall structural weight significantly.
examples.zh: 採用永續工程木材興建超高層摩天大樓，能顯著減輕整體建築的自重與地基載重負擔。

entries.definition: 摩天大樓；超高層建築；二十層全木構綠能摩天大樓；摩天樓

explains.en: This is a very tall building in a city. Many floors rise high above the street. People may live or work inside it.
Tall buildings often have elevators to carry people between floors. Strong frames help support the weight. Windows can give people a view over the city.
A group of such buildings can form a city center. Shops may fill the lower floors while offices sit above. At night, many windows shine like small squares of light.

examples.en: There was a slight change in the weather.
examples.zh: 天氣有了一點變化。

examples.en: She felt a slight pain in her knee.
examples.zh: 她膝蓋有些微疼痛。

examples.en: He gave a slight nod to show he understood.
examples.zh: 他微微點頭表示自己聽懂了。

entries.definition: （形）輕微的；瘦小的；（名）怠慢；（動）冷落

explains.en: This describes something small or not very important. A small change in color may be hard to notice. It is much less than a large change.
A light touch can be gentle and soft. Someone may press a feather against a hand. The touch is easy to feel but not strong.
A person can feel a little ill or dizzy. They may sit down and rest for a while. The feeling is mild rather than severe.

examples.en: The class made a slogan about keeping the beach clean.
examples.zh: 全班想出一句保持海灘乾淨的標語。

examples.en: Our team chose a short slogan for the poster.
examples.zh: 我們隊伍為海報選了一句簡短口號。

examples.en: The company printed its slogan on every bag.
examples.zh: 公司把它的標語印在每個袋子上。

entries.definition: （名）標語、口號；容易記住、用來傳達理念或促銷的短句。

explains.en: This is a short phrase used to share an idea. A team may print it on a poster. People can remember it easily.
A business may use a brief line to tell customers what it offers. The words can appear in ads or on a sign. Clear words help people understand the message.
A group may choose a phrase that encourages people to act. It can ask neighbors to save water or keep a park clean. The message should be easy to repeat.

examples.en: Put the charger into the socket beside the desk.
examples.zh: 請把充電器插進書桌旁的插座。

examples.en: The lamp plug did not fit the wall socket.
examples.zh: 燈的插頭不適合這個牆上插座。

examples.en: The bulb fits into a small socket in the device.
examples.zh: 燈泡可以裝進裝置裡的小插孔。

entries.definition: 插座；插孔；插槽；眼窩；關節窩。

explains.en: This is a hole or part that another piece fits into. A plug goes into one in a wall. The connection can carry electricity to a lamp.
A round opening in a machine can hold a bulb or another part. The piece must fit the opening. A loose fit may not work well.
The word can also name a small hollow in the body where a bone rests. The parts fit together to help a joint move. The shape gives the bone support.

examples.en: Keep your antivirus software updated to defend against malicious attacks.
examples.zh: 保持防毒軟體即時更新以抵禦惡意網路攻擊。

examples.en: Our company decided to switch to open-source software to save licensing costs.
examples.zh: 我們公司決定轉換至開源軟體以節省授權費用。

examples.en: The new graphic editing software offers dozens of intuitive drawing tools.
examples.zh: 這款全新的影像編輯軟體提供了數十種直覺好用的繪圖工具。

explains.en: This is a set of computer instructions and programs. A phone uses programs to show maps and play music. People can tap buttons to give commands.
A computer needs instructions to perform tasks. A program can help write a letter or draw a picture. Different programs do different jobs.
People often update programs to fix problems or add tools. A safe update can make a device work better. Users should follow clear instructions when installing it.

examples.en: Rooftop solar panels generate clean renewable electricity, feeding excess green power back into the grid.
examples.zh: 裝設於屋頂的太陽能光電板源源不絕產出潔淨綠電，並能將多餘電力躉售併入國家電網。

examples.en: Total solar eclipses offer rare opportunities to observe delicate streamers in the sun’s corona.
examples.zh: 壯麗罕見的日全食天文奇觀，為世界各地太陽物理學家提供了近距離觀測太陽日冕噴流的絕佳契機。

examples.en: Rural off-grid homestays use solar thermal heaters to provide hot showers for guests throughout the year.
examples.zh: 位於偏鄉無台電供電的深山生態民宿，全面採用屋頂真空管太陽能熱水系統，全年無休供應住客洗熱水澡。

entries.definition: 太陽能光電板的；太陽的

explains.en: This describes something related to the sun, our star. Sunlight gives Earth warmth and light. Plants use light from it to grow.
Energy collected from sunlight can be used in homes. Panels on a roof can change light into electricity. Bright days may provide more power.
Earth and the other planets travel around our star. Together with moons and smaller objects, they form a large system in space. The sun is at the center of that system.

examples.en: Dad used a spade to dig a hole for the tree.
examples.zh: 爸爸用鏟子替樹挖了一個洞。

examples.en: She lifted the soil with the garden spade.
examples.zh: 她用園藝鏟翻起土壤。

examples.en: The ace of spades lay on the table.
examples.zh: 黑桃 A 放在桌上。

explains.en: This is a tool with a broad flat blade and a handle. Gardeners push it into soil to dig. The blade can help move dirt from one place to another.
Some tools have a long handle so a person can work while standing. The flat end cuts into soft ground. A firm step can push it down.
A card game uses this word for one of its four suits. The suit is often shown as a dark leaf shape. Players sort cards by their suit.

examples.en: We keep a spare key in a safe place.
examples.zh: 我們把一把備用鑰匙放在安全的地方。

examples.en: Can you spare a minute to help me?
examples.zh: 你能抽出一分鐘幫我嗎？

examples.en: The driver changed the flat tire with the spare.
examples.zh: 駕駛用備胎換掉爆胎。

entries.definition: （形）多餘的；備用的；（動）抽出；饒恕；（名）備用品

explains.en: This describes something kept for later use. A family may keep an extra blanket in a closet. It is ready if someone needs it.
The verb can mean to give something that is not needed right now. A person may share an extra seat with a friend. The friend can use it during the ride.
It can describe an extra part kept as a replacement. A car may carry an extra tire in case one goes flat. Drivers can use it during a repair.

examples.en: A spark jumped from the campfire.
examples.zh: 一點火花從營火中跳出。

examples.en: Her question sparked an idea for the science project.
examples.zh: 她的問題激發了科展的點子。

examples.en: The wire gave off a bright spark.
examples.zh: 電線發出明亮的火花。

entries.definition: （名）火花；（動）引發、激起；也指促使某事開始的小小起因。

explains.en: This is a tiny flash of light or a small piece of burning material. Two hard stones may make one when struck together. Dry grass can catch fire from it.
A small event can start a new idea or feeling. A question in class may give a student an idea for a story. One thought can lead to many more.
A small flash of electricity can jump across a tiny gap. You may notice one when you touch a metal handle after walking on a carpet. The light lasts only a moment.

examples.en: The hunter carried a spear across the field.
examples.zh: 獵人拿著一支長矛穿過田野。

examples.en: The spear fisherman watched fish move through the water.
examples.zh: 使用魚叉的漁夫看著魚在水中游動。

examples.en: The guard held a spear beside the gate.
examples.zh: 守衛拿著長矛站在門旁。

entries.definition: （名）矛；長槍；魚叉；（動）用矛刺；攫取。

explains.en: This is a long, pointed weapon once used for hunting or fighting. A sharp tip is fixed to a long handle. People threw or carried it.
A fish with a long pointed bill has a similar name. It swims quickly through the sea. Its pointed bill helps it catch prey.
The verb can mean to throw or poke with a pointed object. In a story, a hunter may use a long weapon to catch food. The action requires care.

examples.en: Over six hundred distinct bird species have been recorded in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣全島已被正式記錄觀察到的野生鳥類物種超過六百種之多。

examples.en: Genetic scientists mapped the complete genome of this rare aquatic species.
examples.zh: 遺傳學家歷經多年努力，終於成功完整繪製出這種稀有水生物種的全基因組圖譜。

examples.en: Several unique insect species exist exclusively in the high-altitude cloud forests of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 有數種極具演化代表性的特有昆蟲物種，僅唯一生活在台灣中高海拔雲霧繚繞的山林之中。

entries.definition: 物種；生物種類（單複同形）

explains.en: A group of living things that share important features can belong to one kind. Cats and dogs are different kinds of animals. Each kind has its own traits.
Scientists name kinds of plants and animals so they can study them. Members of one kind can often have young together. A name helps researchers share information.
A forest may contain many kinds of birds, insects, and trees. Some live only in one area. Protecting their homes helps keep nature varied.

examples.en: The family shared a spiritual song at the gathering.
examples.zh: 家人在聚會中分享一首充滿靈性的歌曲。

examples.en: She enjoys reading spiritual stories before bed.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在睡前閱讀靈性故事。

examples.en: The quiet garden gave him a spiritual feeling of peace.
examples.zh: 安靜的花園讓他感受到心靈平靜。

explains.en: This describes things connected with the spirit, beliefs, or a person’s inner life. People may pray, meditate, or think about what matters to them. These activities can bring calm.
A person may look for meaning beyond daily chores and schoolwork. Quiet time can help them consider their values. Families and communities may have different beliefs.
Some music or art can feel peaceful and moving. It may help people reflect on hope or kindness. The effect can be personal.

examples.en: The choir gave a splendid performance.
examples.zh: 合唱團的演出十分精彩。

examples.en: We saw a splendid view from the hill.
examples.zh: 我們在山丘上看見絕美景色。

examples.en: She wore a splendid red dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她在派對上穿了一件華麗的紅裙。

explains.en: This describes something very impressive or beautiful. A bright rainbow across the sky can make people stop and look. Its colors may seem wonderful.
A person may do an excellent job on a difficult task. Careful practice can lead to a strong result. Friends may praise the work.
A special event can be grand and joyful. Music, lights, and friendly guests can make the day memorable. Everyone may enjoy the celebration.

examples.en: Co-workers used the mobile app to split the dinner bill evenly without counting physical change.
examples.zh: 同事聚餐結帳時使用手機電子錢包進行群組一秒精準拆帳，完全省去找零錢與代墊現金的麻煩。

examples.en: The apartment roommates decided to split the monthly high-speed internet and electricity costs right down the middle.
examples.zh: 合租公寓的室友們約定好在每個月底將高速寬頻光纖上網費與夏季電費單嚴格均攤、精準平分帳單。

examples.en: Modern bill-splitting features let party attendees calculate exact individual amounts based on what each person ordered.
examples.zh: 當代行動支付內建的智慧拆帳功能，能讓聚會好友依據各自單點的餐點品項，分毫不差精準算出各自應付金額。

entries.definition: 聚餐平分帳單 (拆帳)；分開；裂痕

explains.en: The verb can mean to break or separate into parts. A baker cuts a cake into equal pieces. Each person gets a piece to eat.
A group may divide into smaller groups to finish a task. Each team can work on one part. They meet later to share their results.
A crack can appear when something is pulled or bent too hard. The opening may grow if the object is used again. A repair can keep it from getting worse.

examples.en: Sprinkle a little cheese over the warm pasta.
examples.zh: 在熱騰騰的義大利麵上撒一點起司。

examples.en: She sprinkled water on the flowers.
examples.zh: 她把水灑在花朵上。

examples.en: The baker sprinkled sugar on the cookies.
examples.zh: 烘焙師在餅乾上撒了糖。

entries.definition: （動）灑、撒；（名）少量散落的小點；把少量東西分散放上去。

explains.en: This means to scatter small drops or pieces over something. A cook may add a little salt to soup. The tiny grains spread across the top.
A gardener can spread water gently over young plants. A light spray reaches the leaves and soil. Too much water may wash the seeds away.
Small bits of cheese or sugar can be scattered over food. They add flavor or decoration. The cook uses only a little.

examples.en: The thorn stabbed through the thin glove.
examples.zh: 荊棘刺穿了薄手套。

examples.en: He felt a sharp stabbing pain in his side.
examples.zh: 他感到側邊一陣刺痛。

examples.en: The detective found where the knife had stabbed the box.
examples.zh: 偵探發現刀子刺穿箱子的地方。

explains.en: This means to push a sharp object into something or someone. Such an action can cause a serious injury. Sharp tools should be handled carefully.
A sudden sharp pain can feel as if something has pierced the skin. A person should tell an adult if an injury is serious. Getting help quickly is important.
In a mystery story, a detective may learn that a sharp object caused a wound. The clue can help solve the case. Real injuries need proper care.

examples.en: One statistic showed that most students liked the new library.
examples.zh: 一項數據顯示，多數學生喜歡新的圖書館。

examples.en: The coach shared a statistic about the team’s wins.
examples.zh: 教練分享了球隊勝場的一項統計數據。

examples.en: This statistic compares rainfall in two towns.
examples.zh: 這項統計數字比較了兩個城鎮的降雨量。

entries.definition: （名）統計數字；統計資料中的一項

explains.en: A number that describes facts about a group is used to study patterns. A class may count how many students ride the bus. The total helps explain the group.
People collect numbers from surveys or records. They may compare results from different years. Good records make the comparison clearer.
A number can tell only part of a story. Researchers should also ask how the information was collected. Careful checking helps avoid mistakes.

examples.en: The website showed the status of my order.
examples.zh: 網站顯示了訂單的狀態。

examples.en: Her status as team captain came with extra duties.
examples.zh: 她擔任隊長的身分也帶來額外責任。

examples.en: The library changed the book status to returned.
examples.zh: 圖書館把書籍狀態改為已歸還。

explains.en: This is the condition or position of a person or thing. A library book can be marked as returned or overdue. That information tells its current condition.
A person may have a role or rank in a group. A team captain has a special position. The role can come with responsibilities.
A computer profile may show whether an account is active. The label helps people know if they can use it. It can change when something happens.

examples.en: The flower stem bent in the strong wind.
examples.zh: 花莖在強風吹拂下彎曲。

examples.en: She cut the stem below the rose.
examples.zh: 她在玫瑰下方剪斷花莖。

examples.en: The story stems from an old family tale.
examples.zh: 這個故事源自一則古老的家族傳說。

entries.definition: （名）莖、幹；詞幹；（動）起源於、阻止；須依語境判讀。

explains.en: This is the main part of a plant that holds up its leaves and flowers. Water travels through it from the roots. It helps the plant stay upright.
A small curved part of a letter or number may have this name. It connects the top with the lower part. A pen can draw it carefully.
The verb can mean to begin or come from something. A new idea may start with a question. That question can lead to a longer discussion.

examples.en: We listened to the song on the stereo.
examples.zh: 我們用音響聽這首歌。

examples.en: Dad turned down the stereo during the call.
examples.zh: 爸爸在通話時把音響音量調低。

examples.en: The stereo has two small speakers.
examples.zh: 這套音響有兩個小喇叭。

entries.definition: 立體聲設備；立體聲的；音響。

explains.en: This is an electronic system that plays sound through two or more speakers. Music can seem to come from different places around a room. Listeners hear a fuller sound.
A person may connect a music player to speakers. The controls can change the volume or choose a song. Careful listening keeps the sound pleasant.
The word can also describe a pair of speakers used to play recorded music. Some systems are small enough for a desk. Others are made for a living room.

examples.en: The stingy shopkeeper would not give the workers enough paper.
examples.zh: 那位吝嗇的店主不肯給員工足夠的紙。

examples.en: My stingy cousin never shares his snacks.
examples.zh: 我那小氣的表弟從不分享零食。

examples.en: The stingy host served only one small slice of cake.
examples.zh: 那位吝嗇的主人只端出一小片蛋糕。

entries.definition: （形）吝嗇的；小氣的；給得很少的

explains.en: This describes someone who does not like to spend or share money. A person may refuse to buy a needed school supply. Friends might think the choice is unfair.
A person may give too little of something that others need. A cook might use only a tiny amount of sauce for a large meal. Guests may still feel hungry.
Sharing fairly can show kindness. Someone who keeps everything may lose friends over time. It is thoughtful to consider what others need.

examples.en: She wore black stockings with her school uniform.
examples.zh: 她穿黑色長襪搭配校服。

examples.en: Warm wool stockings kept his legs cozy.
examples.zh: 保暖的羊毛襪讓他的雙腿很暖和。

examples.en: The dancer packed two pairs of stockings.
examples.zh: 舞者帶了兩雙長襪。

explains.en: These are long coverings for the legs and feet. They may be made from thin cloth or warm wool. People often wear them under a skirt or with a uniform.
A pair usually covers both legs up to the knees or higher. Elastic material helps each one stay in place. Different colors can match different clothes.
In cold weather, thick pairs help keep legs warm. Thin pairs may be worn for formal events. They should be washed after use.

examples.en: Daily practice will strengthen your reading skills.
examples.zh: 每天練習會增進你的閱讀能力。

examples.en: The builder added a post to strengthen the porch.
examples.zh: 建築工人加了一根柱子來加固門廊。

examples.en: A healthy meal can strengthen the body.
examples.zh: 健康的一餐能使身體更強健。

entries.definition: （動）加強、鞏固；使身體、能力、關係或事物變得更強。

explains.en: This means to make something stronger. Exercise can help muscles become strong over time. Rest and healthy food also support the body.
A team may improve its skills by practicing together. Each player learns to work with others. Practice can make the whole group more capable.
A wall can be made firmer with extra support. Workers check the structure and add strong materials. This helps it stand safely.

examples.en: The cat had a white stripe down its back.
examples.zh: 那隻貓的背上有一道白色條紋。

examples.en: A yellow stripe marked the edge of the road.
examples.zh: 一條黃色線標示出道路邊緣。

examples.en: She painted a blue stripe on the toy boat.
examples.zh: 她在玩具船上畫了一道藍色條紋。

entries.definition: 條紋；長條；線條；（動）使成條紋。

explains.en: This is a long, narrow line of a different color. A shirt may have several lines across it. The lines can form a simple pattern.
A road may have a painted line along its edge. The mark helps drivers see where to stay. Bright paint can be easier to notice.
The word can also name a band of a different material on an object. A ribbon may decorate a gift box. Its color can make the box look special.

examples.en: The runners strive to do their best.
examples.zh: 跑者努力做到最好。

examples.en: She strives to read one new book each week.
examples.zh: 她努力每週讀一本新書。

examples.en: We strive for a cleaner park by picking up litter.
examples.zh: 我們撿拾垃圾，努力讓公園更乾淨。

explains.en: This means to try very hard to reach a goal. A student may practice each day to learn a song. Steady effort can lead to progress.
People may keep working even when a task is difficult. They can ask for help and try a new way. Patience helps them continue.
A team can aim for a shared goal. Each member does a part of the work. Their combined effort can bring success.

examples.en: Rapid AI brain CT scans identify candidates for clot-busting stroke therapy within the golden 3-hour window.
examples.zh: AI 腦部電腦斷層能在黃金三小時關鍵窗口內，迅速篩選出適合施打血栓溶解劑的急性缺血性腦中風病患。

examples.en: Remembering the FAST acronym—Face, Arm, Speech, Time—saves lives when recognizing stroke symptoms.
examples.zh: 牢記辛辛那提腦中風評估口訣「微笑、舉手、說你好、快打119」，能在身旁親友中風發作時搶下救命先機。

examples.en: With a single masterful stroke of his calligraphy brush, the grandmaster finished the poetic couplet.
examples.zh: 書法國寶大師手握狼毫巨筆，氣定神閒運筆一揮，以一記遒勁有力的一筆一劃完成了氣勢磅礡的傳世對聯。

entries.definition: 急性缺血性腦中風 (黃金搶救期)

explains.en: This is a gentle movement of a hand over a pet’s fur. Many cats enjoy a soft touch along the back. A kind touch can help an animal relax.
It can mean a single movement of a tool or object. A swimmer uses an arm movement to push through water. Repeating the movement helps the swimmer travel.
A sudden medical emergency can happen when blood flow to part of the brain is blocked or a vessel breaks. It needs urgent medical care. Adults should call emergency services.

examples.en: The submarine sailed beneath the waves.
examples.zh: 潛水艇在海浪下航行。

examples.en: Scientists used a submarine to study deep-sea animals.
examples.zh: 科學家搭乘潛水艇研究深海動物。

examples.en: The crew climbed aboard the submarine before it left the harbor.
examples.zh: 船員在潛水艇離開港口前登艇。

explains.en: This is a vessel that can travel under the surface of the sea. Its crew stays inside a strong sealed hull. Special tanks help it move up and down.
Some of these vessels carry people for research. Scientists can observe deep water and sea life. Lights and cameras help them see in the dark.
A military vessel beneath the water can travel without being easily seen. It uses instruments to find its way. Trained crews operate it.

examples.en: The author threatened to sue the publisher over unpaid royalties.
examples.zh: 該名作家因出版社長期積欠版稅而揚言將正式委任律師依法提告。

examples.en: If you slip and fall on an icy sidewalk due to commercial negligence, you can sue for medical damages.
examples.zh: 若您因商家的嚴重疏失在結冰未清理的人行道上滑倒受傷，依法完全可以向店家提告求償醫療費用。

examples.en: The investor hired a law firm to sue the dishonest founders for securities fraud.
examples.zh: 這名受害投資人專門委任知名律師事務所，依法向涉嫌發布假財報惡意吸金的創辦團隊提告證券詐欺。

explains.en: This means to bring a legal case against someone in court. A person may ask a judge to decide a disagreement. The process follows rules.
People may seek money for harm through a court case. They need to present facts and evidence. A judge or jury considers the information.
The word is also used when a company or person starts a lawsuit. The other side can answer the claim. The court decides what happens next.

examples.en: Her suggestion made the science project easier.
examples.zh: 她的建議讓科學專題變得更容易。
