examples.en: The teacher gave a suggestion for improving the story.
examples.zh: 老師提出改善故事的建議。

examples.en: We followed his suggestion and took the earlier bus.
examples.zh: 我們採納他的建議，搭乘較早的公車。

entries.definition: （名）建議、提議；供人考慮或採納的想法。

explains.en: This is an idea or plan offered for someone to consider. A classmate may share a new game idea. The group can decide whether it sounds fun.
A helpful piece of advice can guide a person. A teacher may tell a student to read slowly and carefully. The advice gives a possible next step.
People can offer plans during a meeting. Everyone listens before choosing one. Good ideas can help solve a problem.

examples.en: Summarize the main idea of the reading paragraph in two sentences.
examples.zh: 用兩句話總結閱讀段落的核心大意。

examples.en: At the end of the meeting, the project manager summarized upcoming milestones.
examples.zh: 在會議即將散會之際，專案經理精準扼要地總結了下一階段的重要里程碑。

examples.en: The news anchor took thirty seconds to summarize the primary findings of the report.
examples.zh: 新聞主播花了短短三十秒鐘時間，概括總結了這份國際調查報告的核心結論。

explains.en: This means to tell the main points in a shorter form. A reader can name the most important events in a story. Small details may be left out.
A student may explain a long lesson in a few clear sentences. The short account helps classmates review. It should keep the key ideas.
At the end of a talk, a speaker may briefly repeat the central points. Listeners can remember what mattered most. Clear order makes the short version useful.

examples.en: The skilled surgeon performed the heart surgery successfully.
examples.zh: 技術精湛的外科醫師成功完成了心臟手術。

examples.en: It takes years of rigorous training to qualify as an orthopedic surgeon.
examples.zh: 經過多年嚴格培訓才能取得骨科外科醫師資格。

examples.en: The chief surgeon explained the surgical risks clearly before the operation.
examples.zh: 外科主任在動刀前清楚說明了手術風險。

examples.en: Skilled cardiac surgeons performed a successful heart bypass operation.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的心臟外科執刀醫師成功完成了心臟血管繞道手術。

examples.en: The orthopedic surgeon reattached the severed tendon with great precision.
examples.zh: 骨科執刀醫師以極為精準的手術技術將斷裂的肌腱重新吻合接合。

examples.en: Becoming a certified neurosurgeon requires over a decade of rigorous training.
examples.zh: 要想成為一名合格的神經外科主任醫師，需要歷經十餘年極其嚴苛的專業訓練。

entries.definition: 外科醫生；外科醫師；執刀醫師

explains.en: This is a doctor who is trained to operate on the body. The doctor may work with a team in a hospital. Careful planning takes place before an operation.
Some doctors use tools to repair an injury during an operation. They check the patient and explain the plan. Other health workers help during the procedure.
A doctor with this training studies for many years. The work requires steady hands and careful decisions. Patients receive care before and after an operation.

examples.en: Minimally invasive surgery results in smaller wounds and faster healing.
examples.zh: 微創外科手術傷口極小且能讓術後復原時間大幅縮短。

examples.en: The athlete underwent knee ligament surgery and will miss the remainder of the season.
examples.zh: 這位體育選手接受了膝蓋韌帶重建手術，確定將缺席本賽季後續所有賽事。

examples.en: Advances in robotic surgery allow operations to be completed with millimeter precision.
examples.zh: 達文西機器人手臂手術的突破進步使手術操作精度能達到毫米級的細膩水準。

examples.en: Surgeons perform complex robotic-assisted surgery with millimeter-level precision using the da Vinci Xi system.
examples.zh: 外科主治醫師操作第四代達文西手術機器人，以毫米級的極致精準度執行高難度微創腫瘤切除手術。

examples.en: After three hours in exploratory surgery, the team successfully removed the patient's inflamed appendix.
examples.zh: 歷經整整三個小時的腹腔鏡探查外科手術，外科醫療團隊順利為急性闌尾炎患者切除發炎腫脹的闌尾。

examples.en: Plastic surgery reconstructs facial bones following severe automobile collisions, restoring function and appearance.
examples.zh: 重建整型外科權威大師針對嚴重重大車禍傷患執行顱顏骨折重建手術，悉心重建患者咀嚼機能與容貌尊嚴。

entries.definition: 外科手術；開刀；達文西微創手術 (da Vinci)

explains.en: This is an operation in which doctors work on the body to treat a problem. The patient receives care in a hospital or clinic. Medical staff watch the patient closely.
An operation may repair an injury or remove something harmful. Doctors explain the reasons and possible risks to the patient. Recovery may take time.
Some procedures use small tools and tiny openings. Others need a larger cut. The medical team chooses an approach for the patient’s needs.

examples.en: The team surrendered after the final goal.
examples.zh: 最後一球進門後，球隊認輸了。

examples.en: The captain surrendered the fort to the opposing army.
examples.zh: 隊長把堡壘交給了敵軍。

examples.en: I surrendered to temptation and ate one cookie.
examples.zh: 我抵不住誘惑，吃了一塊餅乾。

entries.definition: （動）投降；交出；放棄；（名）投降；交出。

explains.en: This means to stop resisting and give something up. A player may admit that the other team has won. The contest then ends.
A person may hand over control of a place or object. In a story about a battle, one side may lay down its weapons. The fighting stops.
It can also mean to give in to a strong feeling or wish. A child may finally eat a cookie after smelling it. The child stops trying to resist.

examples.en: The bird blended into its green surroundings.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥融入綠意盎然的周遭景物中。

examples.en: We admired the peaceful surroundings of the lake.
examples.zh: 我們欣賞湖邊寧靜的環境。

examples.en: Please keep your surroundings clean at the picnic area.
examples.zh: 野餐時請保持周遭環境整潔。

explains.en: These are the places and things around a person or object. A quiet room may have books, chairs, and soft light. Each part helps make the setting.
A hiker should look at the land around the trail. Rocks, trees, and weather can affect the walk. Careful attention helps people stay safe.
A child in a new classroom may notice who is nearby and where supplies are kept. These details help the child understand the environment. Looking around can help the child feel more comfortable.

examples.en: Banks are legally required to file suspicious transaction reports (STR) for sudden massive cash deposits.
examples.zh: 當靜止帳戶突然湧入數百萬元不明大額現金頻繁存提時，銀行行員依法必須即刻向上申報可疑交易報告（STR）。

examples.en: The fraud monitoring system flagged a series of suspicious card authorizations attempted at 3 AM.
examples.zh: 銀行 AI 智慧風控引擎在凌晨三點鐘，連續攔截並標註了多筆來自海外未知 IP 的可疑高額刷卡授權。

examples.en: If an email asking for banking passwords looks suspicious, report it immediately to the cybersecurity team.
examples.zh: 一旦收到任何索取網銀登入帳密、語氣可疑怪異的電子郵件，請立即向公司資安主管回報以防釣魚詐騙。

entries.definition: 可疑異常交易申報的；懷疑的

explains.en: This describes something that seems unusual or not quite right. An unknown noise outside at night may make someone wonder what caused it. The person may check carefully.
A person may doubt that someone is being honest. They can ask calm questions and look for facts. It is wise not to accuse without evidence.
An object left in a strange place may raise questions. A teacher might ask who brought it. Finding the owner can clear up the concern.

examples.en: The branches swayed in the wind.
examples.zh: 樹枝在風中搖曳。

examples.en: The boat began to sway on the waves.
examples.zh: 小船開始隨著海浪搖晃。

examples.en: Her calm words swayed his decision.
examples.zh: 她平靜的話語影響了他的決定。

explains.en: This means to move gently from side to side. A tree top may move when a breeze blows. Its branches bend and return.
A hanging rope can move back and forth. A small push starts the motion. The movement slowly becomes smaller.
A person may influence another person’s choice. A kind argument could help a friend choose a safer plan. Listening carefully can change someone’s mind.

examples.en: Clap once for each syllable in your name.
examples.zh: 你的名字每個音節拍一下手。

examples.en: The word “sunshine” has two syllables.
examples.zh: 「sunshine」這個字有兩個音節。

examples.en: She slowly sounded out each syllable.
examples.zh: 她慢慢地把每個音節唸出來。

entries.definition: （名）音節；單字中一次發出的語音單位，通常含一個母音音素。

explains.en: A spoken part of a word is made with one beat of the voice. A short word may have one beat, while a longer word may have several. Clapping can help count them.
Vowels help form these sound parts. A teacher may say a word slowly and ask pupils to listen. Each beat can be marked with a clap.
Breaking a long word into sound beats can help with reading. A student says each part and then joins them. This practice can make spelling easier.

examples.en: Our teacher was sympathetic when I lost my notebook.
examples.zh: 我弄丟筆記本時，老師體諒我的心情。

examples.en: She gave a sympathetic smile to her upset friend.
examples.zh: 她向難過的朋友投以同情的微笑。

examples.en: The coach was sympathetic after the team lost.
examples.zh: 球隊輸球後，教練體諒隊員的心情。

entries.definition: 有同情心的；表示理解的；支持的；交感神經的。

explains.en: This describes someone who understands and cares about another person’s trouble. A friend may listen when someone feels sad. Kind words can help.
A person can show care without having the same experience. They can ask what support is needed. Listening patiently is often helpful.
It may also describe a kind response to a difficult situation. A teacher gives a worried student extra time to explain. The response shows understanding.

examples.en: We sent flowers and a sympathy card to the bereaved family.
examples.zh: 我們向喪家寄送了鮮花與慰問卡片以表哀思。

examples.en: She felt tremendous sympathy for the stray kittens shivering in the rain.
examples.zh: 看到在冰冷滂沱大雨中瑟瑟發抖的流浪幼貓，她心中充滿了無限憐惜。

examples.en: The mayor expressed his deepest sympathy to residents affected by the earthquake.
examples.zh: 市長向所有在本次強震中遭受財產損失的受災市民表達了最深切的慰問。

examples.en: We expressed our deepest sympathy to the family during their bereavement.
examples.zh: 我們在喪家痛失摯愛之際，向家屬致上了最深切誠摯的哀悼與慰問。

examples.en: I have a lot of sympathy for parents trying to work from home with young kids.
examples.zh: 我非常同情那些必須一邊居家工作一邊照顧年幼小孩的父母們。

examples.en: His radical proposal received very little sympathy from the conservative committee.
examples.zh: 他那激進的提案幾乎沒有獲得保守委員會的任何贊同或支持。

explains.en: This is a feeling of care for someone who is hurt or sad. A friend may sit beside a classmate who feels lonely. Listening can show kindness.
People may send kind words after a family has a loss. A card can let them know others care. Gentle support may comfort them.
Someone can feel this for people facing a hard problem. They may offer help or simply listen. Respectful care can make a difference.

examples.en: The team used a systematic plan to clean the beach.
examples.zh: 團隊用有系統的計畫清理海灘。

examples.en: She studied the map in a systematic way.
examples.zh: 她有系統地研讀地圖。

examples.en: A systematic check helped us find every missing book.
examples.zh: 有系統的檢查幫我們找到每一本不見的書。

entries.definition: （形）有系統的；有計畫有步驟的

explains.en: This describes doing things in a careful, organized order. A person may make a list before cleaning a room. Following the list helps finish each task.
A scientist may repeat the same steps in an experiment. This makes it easier to compare results. Keeping clear notes supports careful work.
A plan can arrange many small actions toward a goal. Each step follows the one before it. The order can prevent missed details.

examples.en: An authorized technician came to service our gas water heater.
examples.zh: 原廠維修技師前來檢修保養我們的瓦斯熱水器。

examples.en: The laboratory technician carefully analyzed the blood serum samples.
examples.zh: 醫檢實驗室技術人員仔細分析了血液血清樣本。

examples.en: Contact an IT support technician if you encounter computer network errors.
examples.zh: 若遇到電腦網路設定錯誤，請聯繫 IT 技術支援人員。

examples.en: Certified rope-access blade technicians rappel down hundred-meter blades to repair composite lightning damage.
examples.zh: 通過國際 IRATA 繩索證照的葉片檢修技師，懸掛在百米高空細心修補遭受雷擊的葉片表面。

examples.en: Wind technicians complete rigorous offshore survival and helicopter escape training before going out to sea.
examples.zh: 每位合格的離岸風電技術工程師，出海前皆必須通過嚴格的 GWO 高階海上求生與直升機水下逃生受訓。

examples.en: Every wind turbine technician carries specialized torque wrenches to verify thousands of structural bolts.
examples.zh: 每一位登上風機作業的專業技師都配備了經過校準的定扭力板手，逐一檢驗確認數千顆關鍵螺栓緊固度。

entries.definition: 維修技師；水電技工；風機葉片高空繩索懸吊檢修技師；技術員

explains.en: This is a worker with special skills for operating or fixing equipment. A computer worker may help repair a printer. Training teaches the person how machines work.
A worker in a hospital may check medical machines. The worker makes sure they are clean and ready. Doctors and nurses depend on the equipment.
Some workers test products in a lab or factory. They follow instructions and record results. Careful work can help prevent problems.

examples.en: The class used technological tools to make a short film.
examples.zh: 班上使用科技工具拍了一部短片。

examples.en: Technological changes have made maps easier to use.
examples.zh: 科技上的變化讓地圖更容易使用。

examples.en: She enjoys learning about technological inventions.
examples.zh: 她喜歡了解科技發明。

explains.en: This describes tools, machines, or methods based on new knowledge. Phones and computers are examples of modern devices. They can help people communicate and work.
A change in science can create new ways to solve problems. Engineers may design a faster machine. People then learn how to use it safely.
Schools and businesses may use digital tools to share information. These tools can make some tasks quicker. People still need to check that the information is correct.

examples.en: The museum displayed an old telegraph machine.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了一台古老的電報機。

examples.en: The station used a telegraph to send the news.
examples.zh: 車站用電報傳送消息。

examples.en: They telegraphed the message across the country.
examples.zh: 他們用電報把消息傳到全國各地。

entries.definition: （名）電報機；（動）以電報傳送；也可指明顯透露某個意圖。

explains.en: This was a device for sending messages over long distances using electrical signals. Operators tapped a key to send patterns. Another operator read the signals at the other end.
Before phones became common, people used this system to send news quickly. It carried messages much faster than a letter. The signals traveled along wires.
The name can also be a verb meaning to send a message by that system. A worker might tap a short urgent note. The receiver then wrote down its meaning.

examples.en: Stargazers pointed their high-powered telescope toward Jupiter and Saturn.
examples.zh: 熱血觀星族將高倍率天文望遠鏡對準了木星大紅斑與土星美麗光環。

examples.en: Galileo revolutionized human thought by turning his homemade telescope toward the moon's craters.
examples.zh: 伽利略毅然將自製的天文望遠鏡對準月球坑洞表面，徹底革新並顛覆了人類對整個宇宙運行的認知。

examples.en: The James Webb Space Telescope sends breathtaking infrared images from deep space back to Earth.
examples.zh: 翱翔於深空第二拉格朗日點的韋伯太空望遠鏡，持續不斷向地球傳回令人屏息震撼的深空紅外線影像。

examples.en: The James Webb Space Telescope peers back 13.5 billion years to photograph the universe's earliest infant stars.
examples.zh: 韋伯太空望遠鏡（JWST）以金色巨大反射鏡面穿透宇宙塵埃，回溯拍攝百億年前宇宙誕生初期的第一代恆星。

examples.en: The amateur astronomer carried his portable refractor telescope to Yangmingshan for a weekend star party.
examples.zh: 這位業餘天文同好週末扛著可攜式折射天文望遠鏡登上陽明山擎天崗，參加星空觀測聚會。

examples.en: High-resolution optical telescopes require pristine mirrors polished down to nanometer accuracy.
examples.zh: 高解析度光學望遠鏡需要經過奈米級精度極限研磨拋光的頂級反射鏡片，才能呈現銳利無瑕的天象。

examples.en: The James Webb Space Telescope peers back over 13.5 billion years to capture first-generation light.
examples.zh: 「詹姆斯·韋伯太空望遠鏡」（Telescope），回溯觀測超過一百三十五億年前宇宙初啼的第一道星光。

examples.en: Backyard stargazers use amateur optical telescopes to observe the craters and valleys of the Moon.
examples.zh: 業餘觀星愛好者使用光學望遠鏡，清晰觀察月球表面凹凸不平的隕石坑與峽谷。

examples.en: Radio telescopes stationed in remote deserts map celestial signals emitted by distant spinning pulsars.
examples.zh: 架設在偏遠荒漠中的巨型電波望遠鏡，能精確繪製遙遠自轉脈衝星釋放的天體訊號。

entries.definition: 天文望遠鏡；單筒望遠鏡；太空望遠鏡；詹姆斯·韋伯深空紅外線太空望遠鏡；望遠鏡

explains.en: This is an instrument that makes faraway objects look closer. A person can point it at the moon to see its surface. It collects light to form an image.
People use this instrument to study planets and stars. A steady stand helps keep it pointed in one direction. A dark sky makes faint objects easier to see.
Small handheld versions help people look at distant ships or birds. They are useful when the viewer is outdoors. Both lenses must be clean for a clear view.

examples.en: He has a tendency to lose his pencils.
examples.zh: 他常常弄丟鉛筆。

examples.en: The puppy has a tendency to bark at the mail truck.
examples.zh: 小狗常常對著郵車吠叫。

examples.en: Her tendency to arrive early helps the group start on time.
examples.zh: 她總是提早到，這讓團體能準時開始。

explains.en: This is a way something often happens or a direction it usually takes. A child may reach for a sweet snack after school each day. The repeated choice forms a pattern.
People can have common habits in how they act. One student may always check a backpack before leaving. Such repeated actions can be noticed over time.
A change in weather can follow a regular pattern. Rain may often come during one season. Looking at past records helps people notice the pattern.

examples.en: My shoulders felt tense before the race.
examples.zh: 比賽前我的肩膀很緊繃。

examples.en: The room grew tense as everyone waited for the result.
examples.zh: 大家等待結果時，房間裡的氣氛變得緊張。

examples.en: The verb changes tense to show when the action happens.
examples.zh: 動詞會改變時態來顯示動作發生的時間。

entries.definition: （形）緊張的；繃緊的；拉緊的；（動）使緊張；繃緊

explains.en: This describes a muscle that is tight and hard to move. Stretching gently can help it relax. A person should stop if movement hurts.
A conversation can feel uncomfortable when people are worried. They may speak quietly and choose words carefully. A kind question can ease the moment.
In grammar, this shows when an action happens. English verbs can talk about the past, present, or future. The form helps a reader understand the time.

examples.en: The Hubble tension between local star measurements and CMB data points toward new, undiscovered physics.
examples.zh: 測量宇宙膨脹速率產生的「哈伯常數衝突」（Hubble Tension），強烈暗示現有物理標準模型存在未知漏洞。

examples.en: Geopolitical tension along disputed maritime borders prompted naval patrols to raise alert levels.
examples.zh: 爭議海域邊界緊繃的地緣政治緊張局勢，促使周邊各國海軍巡邏艦艇全面提升警戒戰備等級。

examples.en: The violinist adjusted the peg carefully to tighten the string tension to the perfect concert pitch.
examples.zh: 小提琴家小心翼翼地微調琴頭弦軸，將琴弦張力精準調校至完美悅耳的標準演奏音高。

examples.en: Pulley-based tensioning systems adjust catenary tension automatically as temperatures fluctuate between seasons.
examples.zh: 滑輪「自動配重張力補償裝置」（Tensioning System），能隨四季氣溫熱脹冷縮自動微調電車線緊繃度。

examples.en: Regular neck stretches and deep breathing exercises help relieve muscular tension after computer desk work.
examples.zh: 規律進行頸部伸展與深呼吸放鬆操，能有效舒緩長時間坐在電腦桌前辦公引起的肩頸肌肉緊繃。

examples.en: Lingering political tension between neighboring states hampered cross-border economic trade development.
examples.zh: 鄰國之間長年揮之不去的政治緊張對峙僵局，嚴重阻礙了邊境跨國經貿物流的正常健康發展。

entries.definition: 哈伯常數衝突 (宇宙膨脹速率之世紀難題)；張力；自動滑輪配重恆張力補償裝置 (防止下垂)

explains.en: This is a stretched force inside a rope or string. Pulling both ends makes it tight. A hanging object can stay in place when the rope is firm.
People may feel worry when they face a hard situation. Taking a slow breath can help them calm down. Talking with a trusted person may also help.
A story can build suspense when a character faces danger. Readers wonder what will happen next. This feeling can make the story exciting.

examples.en: The loud crash filled the puppy with terror.
examples.zh: 巨響讓小狗非常害怕。

examples.en: She felt terror when she became lost in the cave.
examples.zh: 她在洞穴裡迷路時感到恐懼。

examples.en: The movie showed a town facing terror during the storm.
examples.zh: 電影呈現一座城鎮在暴風雨中面對恐懼。

explains.en: This is a strong feeling of fear. A frightening sound in the dark may make a child run to a parent. The child wants to feel safe.
A terrible event can fill people with fear. Families may need help after a dangerous storm. Neighbors can support one another.
A scary story may describe frightening creatures or places. The reader knows it is make-believe. A happy ending can help the fear fade.

examples.en: The theme of the book is friendship.
examples.zh: 這本書的主題是友誼。

examples.en: Our class chose an ocean theme for the party.
examples.zh: 我們班為派對選了海洋主題。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to write about the theme of courage.
examples.zh: 老師要我們寫一篇關於勇氣主題的文章。

entries.definition: （名）主題、題旨；作品、活動或討論中反覆呈現的核心內容。

explains.en: This is the main subject or idea of a story, lesson, or event. A book may focus on friendship or courage. Details in the story support the main idea.
A party can use one central idea for its decorations. A space party may have stars and planets around the room. Guests can dress to match.
Music may be chosen to fit a special subject. The instruments and pictures can help create a mood. People notice how each part connects.

examples.en: She made a thorough search of the classroom.
examples.zh: 她仔細搜尋了整間教室。

examples.en: The doctor asked thorough questions about the patient’s cough.
examples.zh: 醫生仔細詢問病人咳嗽的情況。

examples.en: We gave the room a thorough cleaning before guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人抵達前，我們徹底打掃了房間。

entries.definition: 徹底的；詳盡的；仔細周全的。

explains.en: This describes work done with great care and attention. A careful reader checks each line for mistakes. This can take extra time.
A close examination looks at every important part. A mechanic may inspect a bicycle before a long trip. Checking the brakes can help keep the rider safe.
A person can search an area completely instead of glancing quickly. Looking under tables may help find a lost toy. A careful search checks likely places.

examples.en: It was thoughtful of Maya to save me a seat.
examples.zh: 瑪雅替我留了位子，真是貼心。

examples.en: He wrote a thoughtful note for his teacher.
examples.zh: 他寫了一張充滿關懷的便條給老師。

examples.en: Bringing snacks for everyone was a thoughtful idea.
examples.zh: 替每個人準備點心是個貼心的主意。

entries.definition: （形）體貼的；深思的；仔細考慮過的

explains.en: This describes someone who thinks about what other people may need. A friend can offer a coat when another person feels cold. That small action shows care.
A carefully chosen gift can show that someone remembers your interests. The giver may pick a book about your favorite animal. The thought behind it matters.
A person may pause before speaking and consider others’ feelings. Kind words can prevent hurt. Listening is another way to show care.

examples.en: The feather tickled her nose.
examples.zh: 羽毛搔得她鼻子癢癢的。

examples.en: His funny story tickled the children.
examples.zh: 他的有趣故事逗得孩子們發笑。

examples.en: I tickled my brother’s feet, and he laughed.
examples.zh: 我搔弟弟的腳，他便笑了起來。

entries.definition: （動）搔癢；逗笑；使感到輕微刺激；（名）癢感

explains.en: This means to touch someone lightly in a way that makes them laugh. A soft feather can make an arm feel funny. The person may giggle and move away.
A funny story can make someone laugh and feel amused. Friends may share jokes during a break. A playful mood can spread through a group.
The verb can also mean to amuse someone’s sense of humor. A silly picture may make a child smile. Gentle fun can brighten a day.

examples.en: The new timetable lists every class period.
examples.zh: 新的課表列出每一堂課的時間。

examples.en: We checked the train timetable before leaving home.
examples.zh: 離家前我們查看了火車時刻表。

examples.en: The teacher changed the timetable for sports day.
examples.zh: 老師為運動日更改了時間表。

entries.definition: （名）時間表、課表；列出活動或交通工具預定時間的表格。

explains.en: This is a plan showing when events or activities will happen. A school plan lists lesson times and breaks. Students can use it to know where to go.
A bus plan shows when buses leave each stop. Travelers check the times before a journey. The list helps them arrive on time.
A worker may follow a plan for each day or week. It shows which tasks come first. Plans can change when something unexpected happens.

examples.en: The timid kitten hid beneath the chair.
examples.zh: 膽小的小貓躲在椅子下面。

examples.en: He felt timid when he spoke to the new class.
examples.zh: 他在新班級發言時感到害羞。

examples.en: A timid deer stepped carefully out of the woods.
examples.zh: 一隻膽怯的小鹿小心地走出樹林。

entries.definition: 膽怯的；羞怯的；缺乏勇氣的。

explains.en: This describes someone who feels shy or easily frightened. A child may hide behind a parent when meeting new people. A friendly greeting can help.
A person may avoid speaking in a large group. They can feel more comfortable with one close friend. Practice can make sharing ideas easier.
A small animal may stay quiet when it hears a loud noise. It waits until the place seems safe. Moving slowly can help it feel calm.

examples.en: The soup was hot but still tolerable.
examples.zh: 湯很燙，但還可以忍受。

examples.en: A short delay is tolerable when we have a book to read.
examples.zh: 如果有書可讀，短暫延誤還能接受。

examples.en: The old chair is tolerable for now, though a new one would be better.
examples.zh: 舊椅子暫時還能用，雖然換張新的會更好。

explains.en: This describes something that can be accepted or endured. A little noise may be bearable for a short time. Too much noise can make it hard to think.
A small mistake in a drawing may not spoil the whole picture. The result can still be good enough. The artist can improve it later.
A wait may be manageable when people have books or games. They can stay patient while time passes. Being prepared makes waiting easier.

examples.en: Assess your psychological risk tolerance before investing heavily in volatile growth stocks.
examples.zh: 在大筆重壓高波動的科技成長股之前，請務必先客觀評估個人能承受本金回撤的風險承受度。

examples.en: Investors with low risk tolerance should prioritize government bonds and high-yield savings.
examples.zh: 風險屬性偏向保守、心理承受度較低的投資人，應優先配置長天期公債與高利數位活存。

examples.en: Market downturns test whether an investor's actual risk tolerance matches their expectations.
examples.zh: 唯有在歷經真正的股市崩跌空頭考驗時，才能精準驗證投資人內心深處真實的風險承受底線。

examples.en: Mutual tolerance and respect are the foundational bedrock of any thriving pluralistic democracy.
examples.zh: 相互包容寬容（Tolerance）與由衷尊重彼此差異，是支撐多元開放民主社會繁榮穩定的最堅實基石。

examples.en: Patients with chronic pain often build up a bodily drug tolerance to pain medications over time.
examples.zh: 長期受慢性神經痛折磨的病患，隨著用藥時間拉長，體內對特定鎮痛止痛藥物往往會逐漸產生生理耐受性耐藥性。

examples.en: Precision aerospace manufacturing machines operate with microscopic dimensional tolerances under five microns.
examples.zh: 航太精密機械零組件車削加工機床，其工件加工尺寸公差容許值（Tolerance）嚴格控制在小於五微米以內。

examples.en: Modern CNC machines mill steel components within a microscopic tolerance of one thousandth of a millimeter.
examples.zh: 頂尖數控機床將精鋼零件的「加工公差」（Tolerance），嚴格控制在千分之一毫米（一微米）的極限之內。

examples.en: Fostering mutual tolerance and open dialogue among diverse religious communities promotes peaceful social cohesion.
examples.zh: 在多元信仰與文化的現代社會中倡導包容精神與理性對話，是促進社會族群和睦共融的基石。

examples.en: The patient exhibited high physiological tolerance to the antibiotic, experiencing zero adverse allergic symptoms.
examples.zh: 該名病患對這款新型抗生素展現出極佳的生理耐受性，在整個治療療程中完全沒有出現任何過敏不適。

entries.definition: 風險承受度；包容忍耐力；多元開放社會包容寬容度；正負一微米 (0.001mm) 之極限機械加工公差；寬容

explains.en: This is the ability to accept delay, difference, or discomfort without becoming angry. Waiting quietly in line shows patience. It helps everyone take a fair turn.
People may respect customs or opinions that differ from their own. Listening without laughing can show respect. Families may celebrate in different ways.
A machine part may allow a small amount of size difference and still work. Makers check its measurements carefully. The acceptable range must fit the design.

examples.en: Our tolerant coach welcomed players with different skills.
examples.zh: 我們那位包容的教練歡迎不同技能的球員。

examples.en: She was tolerant of her brother’s different opinion.
examples.zh: 她能包容弟弟不同的意見。

examples.en: The tolerant group listened carefully to each speaker.
examples.zh: 這個寬容的團體仔細聆聽每位發言者。

entries.definition: （形）寬容的；容忍不同意見或行為的

explains.en: This describes someone who accepts people or ideas that are different. A classmate may welcome a new student with unfamiliar customs. Respect helps the student feel included.
Someone with patience can listen calmly to another opinion. People may disagree and still speak kindly. This can lead to better understanding.
Someone may accept a small delay without getting upset. Plans do not always work perfectly. Patience helps people respond calmly.

examples.en: I can tolerate a little noise while I read.
examples.zh: 我讀書時可以忍受一點噪音。

examples.en: The garden plant can tolerate dry weather.
examples.zh: 這種花園植物能耐受乾燥天氣。

examples.en: The teacher will not tolerate bullying in class.
examples.zh: 老師不會容忍班上的霸凌行為。

entries.definition: （動）容忍、忍受；允許不喜歡或不舒服的事物持續存在。

explains.en: This means to allow something difficult or unpleasant to continue. A person may wait quietly through a short delay. They know the wait will end.
People should not accept unsafe behavior. They can tell a trusted adult when someone is being hurt. Asking for help is important.
A plant may survive a range of weather conditions. Some plants can handle dry soil better than others. Gardeners choose plants for the local climate.

examples.en: The family placed flowers beside the old tomb.
examples.zh: 家人在古墓旁放了鮮花。

examples.en: The guide told us about a ruler buried in the tomb.
examples.zh: 導覽員告訴我們一位埋葬在古墓中的統治者。

examples.en: Archaeologists carefully studied the stone tomb.
examples.zh: 考古學家仔細研究了那座石墓。

explains.en: This is a place where a dead person is buried. A stone marker may show the person’s name and dates. Families may visit to remember them.
A large underground room may hold the body of a ruler or important person. Historians study old burial places. They learn about past customs.
A burial place should be treated with respect. People may leave flowers or stand quietly. The site can be important to a family.

examples.en: The tortoise crossed the path very slowly.
examples.zh: 陸龜非常緩慢地穿過小路。

examples.en: A small tortoise rested beneath a warm lamp.
examples.zh: 一隻小陸龜在溫暖的燈下休息。

examples.en: We watched the tortoise eat a leaf.
examples.zh: 我們看著陸龜吃下一片葉子。

entries.definition: （名）陸龜；行動緩慢的人（非正式）

explains.en: This is a slow-moving reptile with a hard shell. It lives on land and has short legs. It can pull its head inside for protection.
A hard shell covers its back and belly. The animal eats plants, fruit, or other foods depending on its kind. It needs a safe place to live.
Unlike a sea turtle, this animal usually walks on dry ground. It may live for many years. People should never take a wild one from its home.

examples.en: The cruel captors tortured the prisoners in the story.
examples.zh: 故事中殘忍的綁匪折磨了囚犯。

examples.en: The old injury continued to torture his knee.
examples.zh: 舊傷持續讓他的膝蓋疼痛難受。

examples.en: It was wrong to torture animals for fun.
examples.zh: 為了好玩而虐待動物是不對的。

entries.definition: （名）酷刑；折磨；（動）施以酷刑；使痛苦

explains.en: This means to cause someone great pain or distress. A person may suffer when trapped in a frightening situation. Helping them get to safety matters.
Someone may feel strong pain from an injury or illness. They should tell a trusted adult and get proper care. Pain should not be used as a game.
An unkind person may deliberately hurt another person. Such behavior is wrong and should be reported. Adults can help protect the victim.

examples.en: Shakespeare's Romeo and Juliet is a world-famous romantic tragedy.
examples.zh: 莎士比亞的《羅密歐與茱麗葉》是舉世聞名的浪漫愛情悲劇。

examples.en: The sudden train collision was an unbearable national tragedy.
examples.zh: 這起突發的列車相撞意外是一場令人痛心難以承受的國家級慘事悲劇。

examples.en: It would be a tragedy if historic architectural landmarks were demolished.
examples.zh: 若這些歷史建築地標慘遭拆除，那將會是一場莫大的悲劇與憾事。

explains.en: This is a very sad event that brings great loss or suffering. A fire may destroy homes and hurt many families. Neighbors can help those affected.
A story with a painful ending can also be called this. The characters may face a serious loss. Readers can feel sad for them.
When a terrible event happens, people may remember it for years. They can learn how to help prevent similar harm. Support from others can bring comfort.

examples.en: The tragic fire left many families without homes.
examples.zh: 那場悲慘的火災讓許多家庭無家可歸。

examples.en: It was a tragic loss for the whole town.
examples.zh: 這是整個城鎮的一大悲痛損失。

examples.en: The play tells a tragic story about two friends.
examples.zh: 這齣戲講述兩位朋友的悲劇故事。

entries.definition: （形）悲慘的、令人悲痛的；造成巨大痛苦或失落的。

explains.en: This describes something very sad or harmful. A serious accident may change a family’s life. Friends can offer help during recovery.
A story can have a painful ending. The characters may lose something important. The reader understands why they feel sad.
A bad mistake can lead to serious results. People can talk about what happened and try to fix the problem. Learning may prevent another mistake.

examples.en: Transfer to the Red Line at Taipei Main Station.
examples.zh: 請在台北車站轉乘紅線捷運。

examples.en: He transferred money from his checking account to pay the rent.
examples.zh: 他從支票帳戶轉帳以支付房租。

examples.en: The university allows students to transfer course credits between departments.
examples.zh: 該大學允許學生在各系所之間辦理學分抵免轉移。

examples.en: You can easily transfer money using mobile phone numbers.
examples.zh: 你可以用手機號碼輕鬆進行跨行轉帳。

examples.en: Passengers can transfer to the airport express train at the central terminal.
examples.zh: 旅客可在中央轉運站轉乘機場快捷列車。

examples.en: The football star was transferred to a Spanish club for a record fee.
examples.zh: 這位足球巨星以創紀錄的轉會費轉隊到了西班牙俱樂部。

examples.en: Transfer funds instantly to your friend's account via mobile banking app.
examples.zh: 透過手機行動網銀 App 可以秒速轉帳給朋友。

examples.en: The branch manager was offered a promotion and transfer to the Tokyo regional office.
examples.zh: 這位分行經理獲得了晉升機會，並獲准調任至東京區域營運總部。

examples.en: Passengers need to transfer to the Green Line at Zhongshan MRT Station.
examples.zh: 乘客必須在捷運中山站轉乘松山新店綠線列車。

examples.en: Mobile banking apps allow instant interbank transfers with zero transaction fees.
examples.zh: 透過手機行動網銀 App 進行跨行即時轉帳快速又便利，且每月享有數十次免手續費優惠。

examples.en: He used the banking app to transfer his share of dinner expenses to his colleague.
examples.zh: 他在聚餐結束後隨即打開手機銀行應用程式，將自己分攤的晚餐餐費即時轉帳給同事。

examples.en: International wire transfers require the recipient bank's unique SWIFT code.
examples.zh: 辦理跨國大額外幣電匯匯款時，請務必再三核對受款人往來銀行的專屬國際 SWIFT 代碼。

examples.en: University technology transfer offices commercialize breakthrough laboratory discoveries into life-saving drugs.
examples.zh: 大學與學研機構的技術移轉中心（Tech Transfer），全力將象牙塔頂尖實驗室成果轉化為造福人類的救命新藥。

examples.en: Licensing revenue from successful technology transfer provides ongoing funding for basic academic research.
examples.zh: 成功技轉衍生新創公司所挹注的豐沛技術移轉授權金回饋，能為大學基礎科學研究提供綿綿不絕的充沛金援。

examples.en: The engineer oversaw the technical transfer of monoclonal antibody fermentation processes to the production plant.
examples.zh: 製程工程師親自進駐代工廠，全程督導單株抗體高密度發酵槽製程由實驗室規模放大至萬公噸量產的技術轉移。

entries.definition: 轉乘；轉移；轉帳；匯款；調職；跨行轉帳；電匯；學研成果技術移轉 (Tech Transfer)

explains.en: This means to move someone or something from one place to another. A student can move schools when the family changes towns. The new school receives the student’s records.
Money can be sent from one bank account to another. The sender checks the details before completing the action. A receipt can confirm it.
A passenger may change from one bus or train to another. Clear signs help travelers find the next ride. They should allow enough time.

examples.en: Sustainable policies transform congested concrete jungles into vibrant, breathable garden metropolises.
examples.zh: 前瞻的永續低碳政策，正將過去擁擠悶熱的灰色水泥叢林華麗轉型為充滿活力、能自由深呼吸的花園城市。

examples.en: Innovative generative AI tools promise to transform traditional customer support workflows completely.
examples.zh: 顛覆性生成式 AI 工具的導入，將徹底改變並自動化重構跨國企業傳統繁瑣的人工客服與工單處理解決流程。

examples.en: Dedicated coaching and rigorous practice helped transform the shy novice into a confident debate champion.
examples.zh: 專業教練手把手的耐心指導與數百場高強度實戰模擬辯論，讓昔日生性害羞的新手學妹蛻變為自信沉穩的全國辯論冠軍。

entries.definition: 城市綠色低碳華麗轉型；轉變

explains.en: This means to change something into a different form or condition. A caterpillar becomes a butterfly as it grows. Its body changes in stages.
A new coat of paint can make an old room look fresh. Adding light colors may change the feeling of the space. Careful work gives a neat result.
A person may change a rough idea into a finished project. Planning and practice help each step. The final result can look very different.

examples.en: Please translate this sign into Chinese for our visitors.
examples.zh: 請把這個標誌翻譯成中文，給訪客看。

examples.en: She can translate the story from English into French.
examples.zh: 她能把故事從英文翻譯成法文。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to translate three short sentences.
examples.zh: 老師要我們翻譯三個短句。

explains.en: This means to change words from one language into another. A helper may tell a visitor what a sign says. The message should keep the same meaning.
A person can change a short note into words another reader understands. Names and facts must be handled carefully. Checking the result helps avoid errors.
Pictures or symbols can also be changed into written instructions. A clear message helps people follow steps. The new version should be easy to understand.

examples.en: Cell-free in-vitro translation produces customized vaccines within hours, bypassing slow cell cultures.
examples.zh: 「體外無細胞轉譯技術」（In-Vitro Translation），在數小時內快速合成客製化疫苗，完全跳過耗時的細胞培養。

examples.en: The literary translation captured the whimsical humor and subtle wordplay of the original French novel.
examples.zh: 這部優秀的文學中譯本，傳神捕捉到了法文原著小說中詼諧靈動的幽默感與微妙文字雙關。

examples.en: Ribosomes read messenger RNA triplets to guide the accurate translation of polypeptide chains.
examples.zh: 細胞核糖體沿著信使 RNA 的三聯體密碼逐一解讀，精準指引多胜肽鏈氨基酸序列的轉譯合成。

entries.definition: 體外無細胞高通量核糖體蛋白質轉譯製造；翻譯

explains.en: This is the written or spoken result of changing a message into another language. It lets a new group of people understand the original. A careful reader checks the meaning.
A book may have versions in several languages. Each version should keep the story and ideas. Some phrases may need different wording.
The same sentence can be expressed in another language in more than one way. A good version sounds natural to its readers. Context helps the writer choose.

examples.en: The translator helped the visitors understand the guide.
examples.zh: 翻譯員協助訪客理解導覽內容。

examples.en: A translator checked the letter before it was sent.
examples.zh: 翻譯員在信件寄出前仔細檢查。

examples.en: The translator changed the children’s story into English.
examples.zh: 翻譯員把兒童故事譯成英文。

explains.en: This is a person who changes spoken or written words into another language. The person must understand both languages well. Careful listening and reading are important.
At a meeting, this worker may help people who speak different languages communicate. The worker waits for each speaker to finish. Clear wording helps everyone follow.
A written story may be prepared for readers in another country. The worker checks meaning, names, and tone. A careful result respects the original ideas.

examples.en: Intelligent transportation systems (ITS) utilize IoT sensors to improve safety.
examples.zh: 智慧交通運輸系統（ITS）全面串聯物聯網感測器以守護行人與車輛用路安全。

examples.en: High-speed rail revolutionized island-wide intercity transportation in Western Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台灣高速鐵路的通車營運徹底顛覆並縮短了台灣西部走廊各大都會間的城際交通運輸時間。

examples.en: Reliable public transportation is a vital lifeline connecting suburban communities to downtown.
examples.zh: 準點可靠的大眾交通運輸網絡是緊密連結遠郊社區與市中心各項機能的重要動脈生命線。

explains.en: This is the way people or goods move from place to place. Buses, trains, and bicycles can all carry travelers. Roads and stations support these trips.
A town may provide buses for people going to school or work. Regular service helps passengers plan. Safe stops make it easier to get on and off.
Ships and trucks carry food or supplies over long distances. Workers plan routes and schedules. Good planning helps goods arrive on time.

examples.en: The puppy trembled during the thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，小狗一直發抖。

examples.en: Her hands trembled as she held the cold cup.
examples.zh: 她拿著冰冷的杯子時，雙手顫抖。

examples.en: The tiny bird trembled in the chilly wind.
examples.zh: 小鳥在寒風中發抖。

explains.en: This means to shake slightly, often because of cold or fear. A person may shiver outside on a windy winter day. A warm coat can help.
A small animal may shake when it feels frightened. A quiet voice and safe place may help it calm down. Give it space to rest.
Leaves can shake when a strong breeze blows. The movement passes from one branch to another. It stops when the air becomes still.

examples.en: They made tremendous progress in reading this year.
examples.zh: 他們今年在閱讀方面進步非常多。

examples.en: A tremendous wave splashed over the rocks.
examples.zh: 巨浪拍打岩石。

examples.en: The team showed tremendous courage during the game.
examples.zh: 比賽期間，隊伍展現了極大的勇氣。

entries.definition: （形）巨大的、驚人的；程度或數量非常大，也可表示極好。

explains.en: This describes something very great in size, amount, or degree. A huge wave may rise above a boat. Sailors watch it carefully.
A person can feel very happy after reaching a hard goal. Their success may surprise their friends. Practice and patience helped them.
A very strong sound can fill a large room. People may cover their ears if it is too loud. Lowering the volume protects hearing.

examples.en: The museum displayed tribal art from the region.
examples.zh: 博物館展出該地區的部落藝術。

examples.en: She studied tribal stories with care and respect.
examples.zh: 她懷著敬意研究部落故事。

examples.en: The festival included tribal music and dancing.
examples.zh: 節慶包含部落音樂與舞蹈。

entries.definition: 部落的；部族的；部落文化相關的。

explains.en: This describes something connected with a tribe or its shared customs. Families may pass stories, songs, and skills from one generation to another. Traditions can be important.
A group may have its own language and ways of living. Members share a sense of community. Outsiders should learn about them respectfully.
Art and clothing can show a group’s history. Patterns may carry special meaning. People should ask before using a sacred design.

examples.en: Standing at the summit is not conquering the mountain, but a triumph over oneself.
examples.zh: 站在百岳頂峰的真正意義並非征服高山，而是戰勝內心恐懼、實現自我蛻變的極致精神勝利。

examples.en: The courageous mountaineering expedition was celebrated nationwide as a magnificent athletic triumph.
examples.zh: 這支英勇無畏的極地攀登遠征隊凱旋歸國時，受到了舉國上下如雷鳴般的熱烈歡呼與體育凱旋禮遇。

examples.en: Overcoming physical exhaustion to complete the rigorous Central Mountain Range traverse was a personal triumph.
examples.zh: 戰勝全身上下的極致體能透支力竭、圓滿完成嚴苛艱險的中央山脈大縱走，是一場刻骨銘心的個人勝利。

examples.en: Eradicating leukemia in thousands of children stands as a monumental triumph of modern medicine.
examples.zh: 在全球成功治癒數以萬計的白血病重症兒童，是當代精準生物醫學史上最震撼人心的「偉大勝利」（Triumph）。

examples.en: The underdog soccer team celebrated their hard-fought championship triumph under pouring rain.
examples.zh: 一路不被外界看好的黑馬足球隊在大雨磅礡中奮戰到最後一秒，在哨音響起時瘋狂慶祝奪冠的輝煌勝利。

examples.en: Overcoming speech anxiety to deliver an inspiring keynote address was a major personal triumph for him.
examples.zh: 徹底克服內心深層的公眾演說焦慮並在國際年會上發表振奮人心的專題演講，是他個人成長的重大勝利。

examples.en: Crossing the 7,000-word finish line is a hard-earned, triumphant victory of mind, will, and spirit.
examples.zh: 昂首跨過第七千個單字的終點線，是一場心智、意志力與堅定靈魂的「偉大甜美智識勝利」（Triumph）。

examples.en: The underdog soccer team celebrated an improbable triumph in the championship tournament.
examples.zh: 這支原本不被看好的黑馬足球隊，在錦標賽決賽中以驚人的團隊韌性迎來了奇蹟般的勝利。

examples.en: Scientific reason and human compassion will always triumph over ignorance and prejudice.
examples.zh: 追求真理的科學理性與博愛包容的人道關懷，終將戰勝暫時的蒙昧無知與狹隘偏見。

entries.definition: 凱旋登頂；勝利克服；大獲全勝；人類精準醫療對抗惡疾歷史上的偉大勝利；歷經堅持終抵頂峰之硬朗甜美智識勝利；勝利

explains.en: This is a great success after effort or difficulty. A team may win an important final game. Players celebrate their hard work.
A person can overcome a challenge by practicing and asking for help. Reaching the goal brings a feeling of success. Friends may cheer.
A story may describe people winning freedom or reaching safety. Their success follows a difficult struggle. The ending can make readers hopeful.

examples.en: The troublesome puppy chewed my slippers.
examples.zh: 那隻麻煩的小狗咬壞了我的拖鞋。

examples.en: A troublesome leak kept dripping into the bucket.
examples.zh: 漏水問題一直滴水到水桶裡，十分惱人。

examples.en: The broken zipper was troublesome during the trip.
examples.zh: 壞掉的拉鍊在旅途中很不方便。

entries.definition: （形）麻煩的；令人困擾的；難處理的

explains.en: This describes something that causes trouble or is hard to manage. A toy with many tiny pieces may be difficult to clean up. A box can keep them together.
A repeated problem can interrupt a person’s work. A loose door handle may keep falling off. Fixing it can save time.
A difficult task may need patience and a clear plan. Asking someone for help can make it easier. Small steps can solve the problem.

examples.en: The ball tumbled down the steps.
examples.zh: 球滾下了台階。

examples.en: He tumbled onto the soft grass while playing.
examples.zh: 他玩耍時跌到柔軟的草地上。

examples.en: The puppy tumbled over its toy and stood up again.
examples.zh: 小狗被玩具絆倒，又站了起來。

explains.en: This means to roll or fall over, often by accident. A child may lose balance on a soft mat. Getting up slowly can prevent another fall.
A ball can roll down a hill when someone lets it go. It keeps moving until something stops it. A fence can catch it.
A person may turn over in bed while trying to get comfortable. Changing position can help them rest. The sheets may become messy.

examples.en: A twig fell onto the garden path.
examples.zh: 一根小樹枝掉在人行小徑上。

examples.en: The bird carried a twig to its nest.
examples.zh: 鳥兒叼了一根小枝條回巢。

examples.en: He drew a circle in the dirt with a twig.
examples.zh: 他用小樹枝在泥土上畫圓圈。

entries.definition: （名）細枝；從樹枝長出的小而細的枝條。

explains.en: This is a small, thin branch from a tree or bush. It may fall when the wind blows. Birds sometimes use it to build nests.
A dry piece can snap easily between two fingers. It can be used to draw lines in sand. Children should not poke others with it.
A tiny branch has buds or leaves along it. It grows from a larger limb. New growth can appear in spring.

examples.en: The club chose a universal symbol that everyone could recognize.
examples.zh: 社團選了一個人人都認得的通用標誌。

examples.en: The story has a universal message about kindness.
examples.zh: 這個故事傳達了關於善良的普遍訊息。

examples.en: This charger works with a universal plug adapter.
examples.zh: 這個充電器可搭配通用插頭轉接器使用。

entries.definition: 普遍的；全體的；通用的；宇宙的。

explains.en: This describes something that includes everyone or applies everywhere. A rule for the whole school can affect every classroom. All students follow it.
A device may work with many kinds of equipment. It can fit different models. Clear instructions explain how to connect it.
Some ideas are shared by people around the world. Families may express them in different ways. Learning about those differences builds understanding.

examples.en: I urge you to wear a helmet while riding.
examples.zh: 我懇請你騎車時戴上安全帽。

examples.en: The coach urged the team to keep practicing.
examples.zh: 教練敦促隊員繼續練習。

examples.en: Her parents urged her to ask the teacher for help.
examples.zh: 她的父母鼓勵她向老師求助。

entries.definition: （動）力勸；催促；（名）強烈欲望；衝動

explains.en: This means to strongly encourage someone to do something. A coach may tell players to keep trying. Practice can help them improve.
A person may feel a strong need to act quickly. They can pause and think before deciding. Asking for advice may help.
Friends can encourage one another to make a good choice. Kind words can give someone courage. Support should not become pressure.

examples.en: The doctor said the patient needed urgent care.
examples.zh: 醫生說病人需要緊急照護。

examples.en: We received an urgent message about the school bus.
examples.zh: 我們收到一則有關校車的緊急消息。

examples.en: There was an urgent need to stop the water leak.
examples.zh: 當務之急是立刻阻止漏水。

explains.en: This describes something that needs attention very soon. A broken water pipe can flood a room. An adult should repair it quickly.
A message may need a fast answer because time is short. The sender can explain why it matters now. Clear details help others respond.
Someone who is hurt may need prompt help. A nearby adult can call emergency services. Quick action can be important.

examples.en: The guide explains the usage of each button.
examples.zh: 指南說明每個按鈕的用法。

examples.en: This word has a different usage in everyday speech.
examples.zh: 這個字在日常口語中有不同用法。

examples.en: The teacher showed us the correct usage with an example.
examples.zh: 老師用例句教我們正確用法。

entries.definition: （名）用法、使用；某字詞或物品實際使用的方式與情況。

explains.en: This is the way a word or tool is commonly used. A dictionary may show a sample sentence. The example helps readers understand its use.
A computer program can have a certain pattern of use. The maker may study which features people choose. That information can guide improvements.
People can choose polite or informal words for different situations. A greeting to a teacher may sound different from one to a friend. Context matters.

examples.en: The semiconductor company posted several engineering job vacancies online.
examples.zh: 半導體大廠在網路上公布了數個工程師職缺。

examples.en: The flashing neon sign outside the motel indicated 'No Vacancy' during the festival.
examples.zh: 連假旅遊旺季期間，汽車旅館外牆閃爍的霓虹燈牌無奈亮起了「客滿無空房」字樣。

examples.en: When the senior editor retired, a coveted promotional vacancy opened up in the department.
examples.zh: 當資深責任編輯屆齡榮退後，該編輯部內部立刻釋出了一個令人稱羨的晉升空缺。

explains.en: This is an empty place or position that is ready to be filled. A school may need a new helper after someone leaves. Applicants can ask about the job.
A hotel room that is not occupied can be available to guests. Travelers may call to check before arriving. The staff can say whether a room is open.
A seat or job can become empty when someone moves away. The group may choose another person to take the place. Planning helps the work continue.

examples.en: He tried in vain to open the stuck window.
examples.zh: 他徒勞地試著打開卡住的窗戶。

examples.en: She was vain about her shiny new shoes.
examples.zh: 她很愛炫耀自己閃亮的新鞋。

examples.en: All our efforts to find the lost key were in vain.
examples.zh: 我們找遍各處，仍然徒勞無功地找不到遺失的鑰匙。

entries.definition: 自負的；徒勞的；無結果的。

explains.en: This describes someone who has too much pride in an ability or appearance. A person may boast about every small success. Others may stop enjoying the conversation.
A plan may fail if someone expects success without preparing. Practice and careful work are more useful than empty hopes. People should check what is realistic.
The phrase A person who makes an effort without getting the hoped-for result has not succeeded. A child may search everywhere for a lost toy but not find it. The effort did not succeed.

examples.en: A vast field stretched beyond the village.
examples.zh: 一片廣闊的田野延伸到村莊以外。

examples.en: The library has a vast collection of picture books.
examples.zh: 圖書館收藏了大量繪本。

examples.en: The ocean looked vast from the shore.
examples.zh: 從岸邊看去，海洋顯得遼闊無邊。

explains.en: This describes something very large in size or amount. A wide plain can stretch farther than someone can see. Many animals may live there.
A very large number can be difficult to count. A beach may have countless grains of sand. Each grain is tiny, but together they cover a large area.
A person may face a wide range of choices. A store may offer many colors and shapes. Taking time helps someone choose.

examples.en: My vegetarian aunt made a bean soup for lunch.
examples.zh: 我吃素的阿姨午餐做了豆子湯。

examples.en: The restaurant has a vegetarian menu.
examples.zh: 這間餐廳有素食菜單。

examples.en: He became a vegetarian and learned to cook more vegetables.
examples.zh: 他開始吃素，並學會烹煮更多蔬菜。

explains.en: This describes a person who does not eat meat. The person may choose beans, eggs, or vegetables for meals. Restaurants often offer several such dishes.
A meal without meat can still provide energy and taste good. Grains, beans, and vegetables can be combined in many ways. People choose food for different reasons.
A person may read a menu carefully before ordering. Asking about ingredients can help them choose a suitable meal. Friends can respect each other’s food choices.

examples.en: The giant container vessel docked smoothly at Keelung Port this morning.
examples.zh: 巨型貨櫃船今晨平穩順利停靠於基隆港碼頭。

examples.en: High blood pressure can cause microscopic damage to delicate blood vessels over time.
examples.zh: 長期罹患高血壓可能會對人體微細脆弱的血管造成難以察覺的慢性損害。

examples.en: The Coast Guard dispatched a rescue patrol vessel to assist the stranded fishing boat.
examples.zh: 海巡署緊急派出巡邏搜救船艦前往外海馳援失去動力的受困漁船。

examples.en: Heavy-lift installation vessels equipped with 4,000-tonne cranes position wind turbines offshore.
examples.zh: 搭載四千噸級巨型旋轉吊車的離岸海事重吊安裝船，頂著海浪在台灣海峽精準完成風力發電機組裝。

examples.en: The coast guard dispatched a cutter vessel to rescue stranded fishermen during the tropical gale.
examples.zh: 海巡署在強烈熱帶低壓狂風暴雨中火速派遣千噸級巡防艦艇馳援，成功救出在礁岩擱淺待援的落海釣客。

examples.en: Modern oceanographic research vessels feature dynamic positioning thrusters to hold coordinates in swells.
examples.zh: 現代化頂級綜合海洋研究船配備全方位動態定位推進器，即便在洶湧湧浪中亦能穩如泰山定位在定點。

examples.en: Ultra-large container vessels reduce fuel consumption per cargo unit through optimized hydrodynamic hulls.
examples.zh: 超大型貨櫃船透過流體力學最佳化船體設計，大幅降低單一貨櫃在遠洋航行中的平均燃油電耗。

examples.en: Naval patrol vessels escorted fishing boats through contentious waters to ensure maritime security.
examples.zh: 海軍巡邏艦艇護送漁船通過爭議水域，以維護海上作業安全。

examples.en: The research vessel returned to Kaohsiung harbor after collecting seabed sediment samples for two weeks.
examples.zh: 海洋研究船在採集了兩星期的海底沉積物樣本後，順利返抵高雄港。

examples.en: The colossal container vessel navigated through the narrow harbor entrance guided by four tugboats.
examples.zh: 在四艘大馬力拖船引領下，這艘載滿貨櫃的巨型貨櫃輪緩緩駛入狹窄的港灣航道。

examples.en: Specialized deepwater dredgers cleared mud channels so the fully loaded vessel could dock safely.
examples.zh: 港務專用深水挖泥船疏浚清除了主航道沉積淤泥，確保滿載貨物的巨輪能夠安全靠泊深水碼頭。

examples.en: The maritime company commissioned three new green-methanol container vessels from local shipyards.
examples.zh: 該國際航運巨頭向本土造船廠正式下單訂造三艘採用綠色甲醇動力的次世代環保貨櫃輪。

examples.en: Taiwan's first hydrogen-powered passenger vessel glides silently across the harbor without exhaust smoke.
examples.zh: 台灣首艘「氫能雙體客輪」（Passenger Vessel），在港灣中完全靜音滑行，不排放任何黑煙廢氣。

examples.en: The potter shaped an exquisite ceramic vessel on the spinning wheel, glazing it in celadon green.
examples.zh: 陶藝大師在飛旋的手拉坯機前全神貫注將陶土塑形為造型典雅的陶瓷花器器皿，並施以溫潤通透的青瓷釉色。

examples.en: Arteries and capillaries form a complex network of blood vessels delivering oxygen to every human organ.
examples.zh: 動脈、靜脈與微細血管在人體內部交織成一張精密複雜的血管網絡，源源不絕向五臟六腑輸送生命氧氣與養分。

entries.definition: 大型貨船；船艦；血管；容器；大型重吊海事施工船；船隻；遠洋貨櫃商船；兩萬四千 TEU 超大型巨型貨櫃輪；行駛於高雄港之零廢氣排放氫能雙體客輪；船舶

explains.en: This is a container that can hold liquid. A glass cup is a small one used for drinking. Pots and bottles are other examples.
A person or animal has tubes that carry blood through the body. These tubes move blood to different places. Doctors can study how blood flows.
A large ship that carries goods or people can have this name. It travels across water. A crew guides it between ports.

examples.en: The player violated the rules by touching the ball with a hand.
examples.zh: 那名球員用手碰球，違反了規則。

examples.en: Do not violate your friend’s privacy by reading the diary.
examples.zh: 不要因為偷看日記而侵犯朋友的隱私。

examples.en: The company violated the safety agreement.
examples.zh: 那家公司違反了安全協議。

entries.definition: （動）違反、侵犯；不遵守法律、規則或他人的權利。

explains.en: This means to break a rule or fail to respect a right. A player who steps outside the marked area breaks the game rule. The referee may stop play.
People should respect another person’s privacy. Reading a private note without permission crosses a boundary. Asking first shows respect.
A company may fail to follow an agreed rule. Someone can report the problem to the proper office. Clear records can help explain what happened.

examples.en: The referee stopped the game after a rule violation.
examples.zh: 裁判在規則遭違反後暫停了比賽。

examples.en: The report described a violation of the safety rules.
examples.zh: 報告描述了一起違反安全規則的事件。

examples.en: The school investigated the uniform violation.
examples.zh: 學校調查了違反制服規定的情況。

explains.en: This is an act of breaking a rule or law. A referee may call one during a game. The player may receive a warning or penalty.
A person’s rights can be harmed when rules are ignored. The person may ask a trusted adult or official for help. Records can show what happened.
A building rule may protect people from danger. Ignoring it can put others at risk. Following the rule keeps the place safer.

examples.en: Aristotle taught that cultivating virtue requires daily practice of courage, justice, and temperance.
examples.zh: 亞里斯多德倡導「德性倫理學」，強調高尚的美德（Virtue）必須透過每日在勇氣、正義與節制中身體力行。

examples.en: Patience is universally hailed as an invaluable virtue in times of trial and personal hardship.
examples.zh: 在面對突如其來的艱難考驗與人生命運挫折時，耐心與沉著始終被普世公認為最難能可貴的高尚美德。

examples.en: By virtue of her outstanding research achievements, the young scientist won early tenure at the university.
examples.zh: 憑藉著（By virtue of）在半導體材料領域極為突出的世界級頂尖研發成就，這位年輕女科學家破格提早獲得終身教職。

entries.definition: 德性倫理學之崇高品格；美德

explains.en: This is a good quality in a person’s character. Honesty helps friends trust one another. Kindness can make a classroom welcoming.
A person may show courage by telling the truth after making a mistake. Admitting it can be difficult. Taking responsibility is a sign of good character.
A helpful quality can make someone a good teammate. Sharing supplies and taking turns show fairness. Small actions can reveal character.

examples.en: Never download suspicious email attachments that could contain a computer virus.
examples.zh: 切勿下載可能夾帶電腦病毒的可疑電子郵件附件。

examples.en: The seasonal flu virus spreads rapidly in crowded indoor environments.
examples.zh: 季節性流感病毒在擁擠的室內環境中傳播迅速。

examples.en: Running a complete system scan discovered a dormant Trojan virus.
examples.zh: 執行全系統掃描發現了一隻潛伏的木馬病毒。

explains.en: This is a tiny germ that can enter living cells and make copies of itself. Some kinds cause people to feel sick. Handwashing can help stop germs from spreading.
A computer program with this name can copy itself and cause problems. It may damage files or slow a device. Safe updates and careful downloads help protect computers.
Different kinds affect different living things or devices. A health worker can explain how people prevent certain infections. A computer helper can remove harmful code.

examples.en: Engaging with diverse visual arts cultivates open-minded perspectives and refined cultural literacy.
examples.zh: 多元接觸繪畫、雕塑與新媒體等各類視覺藝術（Visual Arts），能涵養包容的寬闊視野與細膩文化素養。

examples.en: Film directors use dynamic camera motion and striking lighting to create unforgettable visual impact.
examples.zh: 優秀電影導演善於調度流暢鏡頭運動與強烈光影明暗，在銀幕上營造出令人久久難以忘懷的強大視覺震撼。

examples.en: Visual learners grasp abstract scientific concepts much faster when supported by intuitive diagrams.
examples.zh: 傾向視覺型學習特質的學生，在配合生動直觀的彩色圖表與資訊圖輔助下，能極為迅速理解抽象科學原理。

entries.definition: 視覺藝術美感的；視覺畫面

explains.en: This describes something that can be seen. A picture can share an idea through what people see. Colors and shapes help people understand it.
A chart can show information using bars or lines. Readers can compare sizes without reading a long list. Labels make the picture clear.
People may remember a lesson better when they see a drawing or diagram. A teacher can add labels and simple examples. Clear images support learning.

examples.en: Water is vital for plants to grow.
examples.zh: 水對植物生長極為重要。

examples.en: It is vital to wear a seat belt in a car.
examples.zh: 在車上繫安全帶是很重要的。

examples.en: Sleep is vital for a growing child.
examples.zh: 睡眠對成長中的孩子十分重要。

entries.definition: （形）極重要的；維持生命所必需的；充滿活力的

explains.en: This describes something necessary or extremely important. Water is needed by people, plants, and animals. Without it, living things cannot survive.
A small detail may matter greatly to finishing a task. Checking the last step can prevent a mistake. Careful attention can make a big difference.
A person may need quick help after getting hurt. Finding a safe adult is important. Fast support can protect the person.

examples.en: She joined the voluntary cleanup at the beach.
examples.zh: 她參加了海灘的自願清掃活動。

examples.en: The school offered a voluntary art class after lessons.
examples.zh: 學校課後提供一堂自願參加的美術課。

examples.en: Their help was voluntary, and no one asked them to do it.
examples.zh: 沒有人要求他們幫忙，他們是自願的。

explains.en: This describes something done by choice instead of being required. A helper may give time to clean a park. The person receives no pay for that work.
People can offer help because they care about a cause. They may collect food for neighbors. Their effort is freely given.
A group may invite people to join an activity. Nobody has to take part. Participants decide whether they have time to help.

examples.en: Energetic silver volunteers serve as storytellers in local libraries, transmitting wisdom to children.
examples.zh: 活力充沛的銀髮志工在各市立圖書館擔任故事爺爺故事奶奶，將人生智慧說給孩子聽。

examples.en: Hundreds of compassionate volunteers helped clean debris from flooded streets after the ferocious typhoon.
examples.zh: 強烈颱風肆虐過後，數百名熱心慈悲的志工主動前往淹水街道協助清理傾倒路樹與污泥。

examples.en: She decided to volunteer at the animal shelter every Saturday morning to walk rescued shelter dogs.
examples.zh: 她毅然決定每週六上午前往流浪動物之家擔任志工，陪伴並牽遛收容所裡的毛小孩。

entries.definition: 退而不休社區銀髮志工；志工

explains.en: This is a person who freely gives time or help. A neighbor may read stories to children at a library. The helper does not do it for pay.
People can help at events, shelters, or community gardens. They share useful skills and time. Their work can make life better for others.
A person may choose to help a cause they care about. They can join a group or work alone. Even a small amount of help matters.

examples.en: Every container ship embarking on a transpacific voyage carries the dreams of global trade.
examples.zh: 每一艘啟航展開橫跨太平洋萬里壯闊遠洋航程的萬噸貨輪，都承載著全球貿易互通的繁榮夢想。

examples.en: The early Portuguese sailors described Taiwan as Formosa during an epic sixteenth-century maritime voyage.
examples.zh: 早期葡萄牙航海家在十六世紀航經台灣海域的壯闊航程中，情不自禁讚嘆這座島嶼為福爾摩沙。

examples.en: Retirement marked the exciting beginning of a lifelong voyage filled with volunteer work and worldwide travels.
examples.zh: 光榮退休象徵著人生嶄新航程的精彩啟航，充滿了公益志工服務與環遊世界的無盡探索。

examples.en: The research vessel departed on an epic two-month oceanographic voyage across the stormy western Pacific.
examples.zh: 頂級海洋科研船啟程展開為期兩個月、橫跨西太平洋狂風巨浪的壯麗深海科考遠航。

examples.en: Chronicling their scientific voyage across remote seas yielded remarkable documentary footage.
examples.zh: 詳實記錄他們穿越偏遠大洋風暴的這趟科學遠征航程，催生出震撼人心的海洋深海紀錄片巨作。

examples.en: Every crew member on this daring voyage into the abyss understood the dangerous risks involved.
examples.zh: 參與這趟勇闖萬米深海危險航程的每位船員與科學家，內心深處皆深知此行所伴隨的巨大技術風險。

examples.en: Our journey to the asteroids is just the opening chapter of a timeless voyage to the outer stars.
examples.zh: 小行星探測任務只是序曲，人類正開啟一場跨越世代、探尋生命真理的「偉大星際航程」（Voyage）。

examples.en: Ferdinand Magellan embarked on a historic maritime voyage that accomplished the first circumnavigation of the Earth.
examples.zh: 探險家麥哲倫率領帆船隊伍揚帆啟航展開這場名垂青史的波瀾壯闊遠航，成功實現了人類歷史上首次橫跨三大洋的環球航行。

examples.en: University graduation marks the successful conclusion of one chapter and the exciting start of a lifelong personal voyage.
examples.zh: 戴上大學方帽完成學業撥穗，標誌著求學黃金歲月的圓滿落幕，同時也是昂首邁向嶄新人生探險壯遊航程的精彩開端。

entries.definition: 航向未知世界的跨洋偉大航程；航向深海深淵的跨國深海科學遠航；世代接力、永不停歇探尋真理之偉大星際航程；航程

explains.en: This is a long trip by sea or through space. Travelers cross a great distance before they arrive. They may prepare food and supplies for the way.
A ship can travel from one port to another over many days. Sailors watch the weather and guide it across the water. The trip can bring new discoveries.
A long trip can also describe a person’s difficult path toward a goal. There may be setbacks along the way. Patience helps the traveler continue.

examples.en: The birdsong wakened me before sunrise.
examples.zh: 鳥鳴聲在日出前把我喚醒。

examples.en: Please waken your brother when breakfast is ready.
examples.zh: 早餐準備好時，請叫醒弟弟。

examples.en: The loud alarm wakened everyone in the house.
examples.zh: 大聲的鬧鐘喚醒了屋子裡的每個人。

entries.definition: （動）醒來、喚醒；從睡眠中醒來，或使某人醒來。

explains.en: This means to stop sleeping and become awake. A noise in the morning may make a child open their eyes. They may get out of bed.
A parent can gently cause a child to become awake for school. Opening the curtains lets daylight enter the room. A quiet greeting can help.
A sound may cause someone to become aware of danger. People can then move to a safe place. Paying attention helps them respond.

examples.en: Visit our official website for the latest updates.
examples.zh: 歡迎造訪我們的官方網站以獲取最新消息。

examples.en: The government website offers convenient online tax filing services.
examples.zh: 政府網站提供了便捷的線上報稅服務。

examples.en: Bookmark this educational website so you can practice English anytime.
examples.zh: 把這個教學網站加入書籤，這樣你隨時都能練習英文。

examples.en: Book your train tickets on the official Taiwan Railways website.
examples.zh: 在台鐵官方網站上預訂您的火車票。

examples.en: The company redesigned its corporate website to be mobile-friendly.
examples.zh: 該公司重新設計了企業官網，使其更適合手機行動裝置瀏覽。

examples.en: You can find comprehensive course syllabi posted on the university website.
examples.zh: 您可以在大學官方網站上找到公告的完整課程大綱。

explains.en: This is a group of pages that people can open on the internet. A school page may show dates, news, and photos. Visitors can read it on a phone or computer.
A person can use a browser to find information online. Links connect one page to another. A clear page is easier to use.
A shop may show its products and opening times online. Customers can look before visiting. The page may also explain how to contact the shop.

examples.en: Animal welfare laws strictly prohibit neglect, abuse, and abandonment of pets.
examples.zh: 現代動物保護法規明令嚴懲任何疏於照護、蓄意虐待或惡意棄養伴侶動物的不法行為。

examples.en: The government increased public spending to improve child healthcare and social welfare.
examples.zh: 政府大幅擴大公共財政支出規模，以完善基層兒童醫療保健與整體社會福祉體系。

examples.en: Animal welfare volunteers work tirelessly to rescue, rehabilitate, and rehome strays.
examples.zh: 動物保護志工團隊不分晝夜辛勤奔走，全力投入傷病流浪毛孩的救援、醫療與送養工作。

explains.en: This is health, happiness, and a good life for people or animals. Clean water and safe homes support people’s lives. Care can help animals stay healthy.
A government may offer support to people who need help. The support can include food, housing, or services. It aims to help people live more safely.
Animal care includes food, shelter, and kind treatment. Pet owners should make sure an animal has what it needs. Regular care supports its health.

examples.en: She gave her brother a wink across the room.
examples.zh: 她在房間另一端向弟弟眨了眨眼。

examples.en: The light began to wink during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，燈光開始忽明忽滅。

examples.en: He winked to show that it was only a joke.
examples.zh: 他眨眼表示那只是一個玩笑。

explains.en: This means to close one eye briefly while keeping the other open. A person may do this to send a playful signal. Friends may understand the joke.
A quick eye movement can show that someone is sharing a secret. It can be friendly when both people understand. The signal should not confuse anyone.
The verb can also describe a light turning off and on very quickly. A lamp may do this when its wire is loose. An adult should check it.

examples.en: Her wit made the whole class laugh.
examples.zh: 她的機智讓全班都笑了。

examples.en: The writer is known for his quick wit.
examples.zh: 這位作家以反應機敏著稱。

examples.en: He answered with wit but did not insult anyone.
examples.zh: 他機智地回答，卻沒有羞辱任何人。

explains.en: This is the ability to use clever words or ideas to make people laugh. A person may tell a quick, funny reply. Others enjoy the surprise.
A clever story can be amusing without being unkind. The speaker notices a funny detail. Good jokes do not hurt someone’s feelings.
The word can also mean a person’s intelligence and cleverness. Someone may solve a puzzle in an unexpected way. Practice can help people think carefully.

examples.en: The witch brewed a bright purple potion in the story.
examples.zh: 故事裡的女巫在鍋裡熬煮亮紫色藥水。

examples.en: The children dressed as a witch and a wizard for the play.
examples.zh: 孩子們在戲劇中打扮成女巫和男巫。

examples.en: In Celtic legends, the wise forest witch cultivated medicinal herbs deep within the enchanted glade.
examples.zh: 在塞爾特傳奇中，聰慧的森林女巫在受魔法庇護的林間深處栽種草藥。

explains.en: This is a magical person in a story who may cast spells. The character can use a wand or a special book. Some stories show the character helping others.
A spell may change an object or create a surprising effect. The character learns special words or actions. Magic is make-believe in these tales.
Stories may include a good magic user or a frightening one. The character might live in a forest or a tall tower. Readers enjoy imagining a world with magic.

examples.en: I need to withdraw some cash from the nearby ATM.
examples.zh: 我需要從附近的提款機領一些現金。

examples.en: The army decided to withdraw troops from the conflict zone.
examples.zh: 軍隊決定從衝突區域撤出部隊兵力。

examples.en: She withdrew her application because of unexpected family matters.
examples.zh: 因為突發的家庭事故，她撤回了求職申請。

examples.en: I withdrew ten thousand dollars from the ATM for weekend expenses.
examples.zh: 我從 ATM 提領了一萬元現金作為週末開銷。

examples.en: The exhausted athlete decided to withdraw from the marathon due to ankle pain.
examples.zh: 筋疲力竭的選手因腳踝劇烈疼痛，決定遺憾退出這場馬拉松比賽。

examples.en: Troop commanders were ordered to withdraw their forces from the contested border.
examples.zh: 部隊指揮官接獲上級命令，自局勢緊張的邊界前線撤回軍事防禦部隊。

entries.definition: 提款；領錢；撤回；提取；退出

explains.en: This means to take money out of a bank account. A person may use a machine to get cash. The account balance becomes smaller.
A person can remove something from a place or group. A runner may leave a race because of an injury. Rest can help the runner recover.
Someone may take back a statement or offer. They can tell others that it is no longer being made. Clear words help prevent confusion.

examples.en: The eye-witness gave a detailed testimony regarding the traffic collision.
examples.zh: 現場目擊證人就這起車禍擦撞經過向承辦員警提供了詳盡的目擊證詞。

examples.en: She signed as an official legal witness on the couple's marriage certificate.
examples.zh: 她作為法定具名證人，鄭重在這對新婚佳偶的官方結婚登記證書上親筆簽名見證。

examples.en: Travelers who hike to the summit at dawn can witness the spectacular sunrise over the Sea of Clouds.
examples.zh: 凡是在破曉清晨克服嚴寒徒步登頂的高山旅人，皆能親眼目睹阿里山壯麗雲海日出翻湧的震撼奇景。

explains.en: This is a person who sees an event happen or hears important information. The person may tell others what they noticed. Clear details can help explain the event.
The verb can mean to see something happen. A family may watch a new bridge open. They can remember the moment.
A person may state that something is true. A child can say that a friend returned a borrowed book. The statement helps confirm what happened.

examples.en: I did a short workout before breakfast.
examples.zh: 早餐前我做了一組短暫的健身運動。

examples.en: Her workout included running and stretching.
examples.zh: 她的鍛鍊包含跑步和伸展。

examples.en: The team planned a workout in the school gym.
examples.zh: 隊伍在學校體育館安排了一次訓練。

entries.definition: （名）健身、運動；為增進體能而進行的一段鍛鍊活動。

explains.en: This is a set of activities that people do to improve fitness. A person may walk, stretch, or lift light weights. Regular movement can keep the body active.
A worker may solve a problem by checking how several parts work together. The person tests possible steps. A clear result shows whether the plan works.
A practice session can include several movements done in order. People should choose activities that fit their ability. Rest is also important.

examples.en: The workplace has a quiet room for reading.
examples.zh: 工作場所設有一間安靜的閱讀室。

examples.en: He keeps his tools tidy at the workplace.
examples.zh: 他把工具整齊地收在工作場所。

examples.en: Everyone should follow safety rules in the workplace.
examples.zh: 每個人都應遵守工作場所的安全規則。

explains.en: This is the place where a person does a job. It may be a shop, office, school, or home desk. People use tools there to finish tasks.
Rules can help keep a job setting safe and respectful. Workers should know where to find help. Everyone can do their part.
People may meet coworkers in a shared area. They can plan tasks and solve problems together. Clear communication helps a group work well.

examples.en: The storm wrecked the old fence.
examples.zh: 暴風雨摧毀了舊圍籬。

examples.en: A wrecked truck was left near the road.
examples.zh: 一輛嚴重損壞的卡車被留在路邊。

examples.en: The crash wrecked the front of the car.
examples.zh: 撞擊毀壞了汽車前方。

entries.definition: （名）失事船隻；嚴重損壞的東西；（動）毀壞；使失事

explains.en: This means to damage something badly. A strong storm may break a small boat against rocks. The pieces may no longer work.
A vehicle that has been badly damaged may be called this. It might need many repairs. People should stay away from dangerous debris.
The verb can also mean to ruin or spoil something. A careless spill may damage a drawing. Cleaning it quickly can sometimes help.

examples.en: The baby began to yawn during the long ride.
examples.zh: 長途車程中，寶寶開始打哈欠。

examples.en: I yawn when I feel sleepy.
examples.zh: 我睏的時候會打哈欠。

examples.en: He covered his mouth when he yawned.
examples.zh: 他打哈欠時用手遮住嘴巴。

explains.en: This is the wide opening of the mouth that often happens when someone is tired or bored. It may happen before bedtime. The action can be hard to stop.
People sometimes copy this action after seeing someone else do it. One person opens their mouth, and another may do the same. It is a common response.
The verb means to open the mouth in this way. A person may cover the mouth politely. Getting enough rest can reduce tiredness.

examples.en: Her youthful smile brightened the room.
examples.zh: 她年輕有活力的笑容讓房間明亮起來。

examples.en: He kept a youthful interest in music and games.
examples.zh: 他一直保有年輕人對音樂與遊戲的興趣。

examples.en: The actor played a youthful character in the film.
examples.zh: 那位演員在電影裡扮演一名年輕角色。

entries.definition: （形）年輕的；有年輕人的活力、外貌或特質的。

explains.en: This describes someone who looks or acts young. A person may enjoy playful games and learning new things. Age alone does not decide someone’s spirit.
A fresh style or energy can make an adult seem young. People may stay active and curious as they grow older. Healthy habits can support well-being.
A story may show a young person full of hope. Their ideas and actions can bring new energy to a group. Others may enjoy that enthusiasm.

examples.en: The test showed an abnormal result, so the teacher checked the numbers again.
examples.zh: 測驗結果不尋常，因此老師再次檢查數字。

examples.en: The bird made an abnormal sound that we had never heard before.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥發出我們從未聽過的異常叫聲。

examples.en: An abnormal shape on the drawing made the student ask a question.
examples.zh: 圖畫上的異常形狀讓學生提出疑問。

explains.en: This describes something that is not usual or expected. A plant with a blue flower may surprise someone if its kind usually has red ones. It is different from the norm.
A reading that is far outside the usual range may need checking. A person should look for a mistake before deciding what it means. Comparison can be helpful.
A behavior can seem unusual in one place but ordinary in another. Customs differ between communities. Learning about them helps people understand each other.

examples.en: The council voted to abolish the old parking rule.
examples.zh: 議會投票決定廢除舊的停車規定。

examples.en: The school will abolish the fee next year.
examples.zh: 學校明年將取消這項費用。

examples.en: The leaders agreed to abolish the unfair practice.
examples.zh: 領導人同意廢除不公平的做法。

entries.definition: （動）廢除；取消（制度、法律或習俗）

explains.en: This means to officially end a rule or system. A town may remove an old rule that no longer helps people. The change must be announced clearly.
A group may decide that a practice should stop. Members discuss the effects before making a choice. They can explain the reason to everyone.
Ending a rule can change how people act. A new plan may replace the old one. Clear instructions help people adjust.

examples.en: The health class discussed abortion using clear, respectful facts.
examples.zh: 健康課以清楚且尊重的事實討論了人工流產。

examples.en: The article explained how abortion is described in medical language.
examples.zh: 文章說明醫學用語如何描述人工流產。

examples.en: The clinic provided information about abortion services.
examples.zh: 診所提供了人工流產服務的相關資訊。

explains.en: This is a medical procedure that ends a pregnancy. It can happen through medicine or an operation, depending on the care provided. The term is used in health information.
People may discuss this topic in health classes or news reports. Different laws and personal beliefs can affect how it is discussed. Facts should be shared respectfully.

A person facing a pregnancy decision may speak with a qualified health professional. Medical information should come from reliable care providers. Supportive adults can help someone find appropriate care.

examples.en: The abrupt stop made the passengers lean forward.
examples.zh: 突然停車讓乘客向前傾。

examples.en: An abrupt change in weather brought heavy rain.
examples.zh: 天氣突然轉變，帶來了大雨。

examples.en: Her abrupt reply surprised the class.
examples.zh: 她唐突的回答讓全班感到驚訝。

entries.definition: （形）突然的、唐突的；發生得很快或表現得不客氣。

explains.en: This describes a change that happens suddenly and quickly. A loud crash can startle people without warning. They may look around to find the cause.
A steep path may end with a sharp drop. Walkers should slow down and watch their steps. The sudden change can be dangerous.
A person may stop speaking in the middle of a sentence. The quick ending can surprise listeners. They may ask what happened.

examples.en: It is absurd to wear a winter coat on a hot summer day.
examples.zh: 大熱天穿冬衣實在荒謬。

examples.en: The movie showed an absurd race between a turtle and a bus.
examples.zh: 電影呈現烏龜和公車之間荒唐的比賽。

examples.en: That absurd excuse made everyone laugh.
examples.zh: 那個荒唐的藉口讓大家都笑了。

entries.definition: 荒謬的；不合理的；可笑的。

explains.en: This describes something so unreasonable that it seems silly. A plan to carry water in a paper bag would not work. The idea does not make sense.
A person may laugh at a claim because it seems impossible. They should still ask for evidence before deciding. Careful thinking is helpful.
A funny story may include a wildly strange event. Readers know it is made up. The surprising idea can make them laugh.

examples.en: The island has abundant sunshine in summer.
examples.zh: 這座島夏季陽光充足。

examples.en: We had abundant food for the picnic.
examples.zh: 我們為野餐準備了豐盛的食物。

examples.en: Abundant rain helped the plants grow.
examples.zh: 充足的雨水幫助植物生長。

explains.en: This describes having a lot of something. A garden with many flowers has plenty of color. Bees may find much nectar there.
A place can have many useful resources. A farm may grow lots of fruit in a good season. Farmers can share or sell the extra food.
A person may receive many chances to learn. A library offers books on many subjects. Choosing one book at a time can help.

examples.en: The shelter protects animals from abuse.
examples.zh: 收容所保護動物免受虐待。

examples.en: The coach told the players not to abuse the equipment.
examples.zh: 教練告訴球員不要糟蹋器材。

examples.en: The story showed how abuse can hurt a family.
examples.zh: 故事呈現虐待如何傷害一個家庭。

entries.definition: （名）虐待；辱罵；濫用；（動）虐待；辱罵；濫用

explains.en: This means to treat a person or animal in a harmful or cruel way. Hitting, frightening, or neglecting someone can cause serious harm. They need protection and help.
The word can also mean using something in the wrong or harmful way. Taking medicine in a way that was not prescribed can be dangerous. A trusted adult should help.
People should ask for help if someone is being hurt. A safe adult or local service can support them. Kind treatment is important for everyone.

examples.en: The driver accelerated after the light turned green.
examples.zh: 綠燈亮起後，駕駛加速前進。

examples.en: The car can accelerate quickly on the open road.
examples.zh: 這輛車能在空曠道路上快速加速。

examples.en: Good practice helped accelerate the team’s progress.
examples.zh: 良好的練習加快了隊伍的進展。

entries.definition: （動）加速；使速度變快，或讓某事更快發生。

explains.en: This means to make something move faster. A cyclist may pedal harder to go up a hill. The bicycle gains speed.
