A machine can increase how quickly it works. Careful adjustments help it operate properly. Workers should follow safety instructions.
A person may work faster after understanding the task. A clear plan can save time. Rushing without care can cause mistakes.

examples.en: Modern metro stations are completely wheelchair accessible with tactile floor paving.
examples.zh: 現代捷運站體全面規劃完善的輪椅無障礙動線、導盲磚與大容量博愛無障礙電梯。

examples.en: Web developers must design sites that are accessible to users with vision impairments.
examples.zh: 網頁前端工程師必須打造具備高對比與無障礙網頁規格的網站供視障者使用。

examples.en: The newly renovated museum features wide, accessible ramps and braille descriptions.
examples.zh: 重新整建完工的博物館增設了寬敞好走的無障礙斜坡道與點字導覽說明牌。

examples.en: Low-floor accessible public buses feature kneeling air suspensions and flip-out ramps for wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 低地板無障礙公車具備車身傾斜跪傾功能與延伸斜坡板，方便輪椅族平穩上下車。

examples.en: The new public transit station was praised for being fully accessible to visually impaired commuters.
examples.zh: 新落成的捷運大眾運輸樞紐獲得各界一致讚揚，因為它對視障通勤族提供了全方位的無障礙通行環境。

examples.en: Quality healthcare services should be affordable, dependable, and easily accessible to all rural residents.
examples.zh: 優質的公立醫療資源應當具備收費合理平價、可靠且便於偏鄉長輩隨時就醫通達的便利性。

entries.definition: 無障礙的；易於使用的；可到達的；低地板無障礙公車易通達的

explains.en: This describes a place or service that people can reach or use. A ramp can help someone using a wheelchair enter a building. Wide doors make movement easier.
A book with clear words and large print can be easier for many readers. Different tools help different people. Good design welcomes more users.
A file online can be opened by people with permission. Clear buttons help visitors find it. The owner should keep private information safe.

examples.en: The hotel can accommodate four guests in one room.
examples.zh: 這間旅館一個房間可容納四位旅客。

examples.en: Our schedule can accommodate an extra art lesson.
examples.zh: 我們的時間表可以加入一堂額外美術課。

examples.en: The bus was large enough to accommodate the whole class.
examples.zh: 這輛公車夠大，能載下全班。

entries.definition: 容納；提供住宿；配合；適應。

explains.en: This means to provide enough room for someone or something. A bus may hold a group of students for a short trip. The driver checks that everyone has a seat.
A plan can be changed to meet someone’s needs. A teacher may give a student extra time to finish. The adjustment helps the student take part.
A small room may need to fit several tables. Moving furniture can create more space. Careful arrangement makes the room easier to use.

examples.en: Book your hotel accommodation well in advance during holidays.
examples.zh: 連假期間請務必提前預訂飯店住宿。

examples.en: University dormitory accommodation is provided for all freshmen students.
examples.zh: 全體大學一年級新生均享有學校宿舍住宿安排。

examples.en: The travel agency arranged comfortable resort accommodation near the beach.
examples.zh: 旅行社在海灘附近安排了舒適的度假村住宿。

examples.en: Book your holiday accommodation well in advance during cherry blossom season.
examples.zh: 櫻花花季期間請務必提前預訂飯店住宿。

examples.en: The university guarantees dorm accommodation for all first-year foreign students.
examples.zh: 該大學保證為所有大一外籍新生提供全額住宿床位分配。

examples.en: Finding budget accommodation in central Tokyo can be challenging during holidays.
examples.zh: 在連假假期要在東京市中心找到平價合適的住宿往往頗具挑戰。

entries.definition: 住宿；膳宿（不可數）；膳宿設施

explains.en: This means a place to stay, often while traveling. A family may sleep in a hotel or rented room during a trip. They can book before they arrive.
The word can also describe what a person needs to feel comfortable. A school might provide a quiet space for a student. Helpful changes can support learning.
Some places provide a room and meals together. Guests learn what is included before booking. Asking questions can prevent confusion.

examples.en: The two clubs reached an accord about sharing the field.
examples.zh: 兩個社團達成共用球場的協議。

examples.en: The leaders signed an accord to protect the river.
examples.zh: 領導人簽署了一項保護河流的協定。

examples.en: Their plan was in accord with the school rules.
examples.zh: 他們的計畫符合學校規定。

explains.en: This is a formal agreement or understanding between people or groups. They may decide to work together on a project. Each side agrees to certain terms.
As a verb, this can mean to agree with or match something. A story about an event may match what a video shows. In formal writing, it can also mean to give someone a right or an honor.
The word can also mean harmony or agreement. Friends may settle a disagreement and decide to play together. Listening can help them find common ground.

examples.en: She studies accounting at college.
examples.zh: 她在大學研讀會計。

examples.en: The shop uses accounting records to track its costs.
examples.zh: 商店用會計紀錄追蹤成本。

examples.en: He works in accounting for a small company.
examples.zh: 他在一家小公司從事會計工作。

explains.en: This is the work of keeping track of money that comes in and goes out. A shop records each sale and expense. The records help show whether it earned money.
A person in this field checks bills, receipts, and reports. Careful numbers help a business plan. Mistakes can cause confusion.
Families can use simple records to plan spending. They compare what they earn with what they pay. Saving a little can help with future needs.

examples.en: The teacher acknowledged my answer with a smile.
examples.zh: 老師微笑著表示認可我的回答。

examples.en: She acknowledged receipt of the letter.
examples.zh: 她確認已收到那封信。

examples.en: He acknowledged that he had forgotten the book.
examples.zh: 他承認自己忘了帶書。

entries.definition: （動）承認、確認；表示知道某事存在或接受其為真，也可表示致意。

explains.en: This means to say that something is true or to show that you noticed it. A child may agree that a mistake happened. Honest words help solve the problem.
A person can show thanks for someone’s help. A kind note lets the helper know their work mattered. Small gestures can mean a lot.
A company may officially accept a report or request. The workers check it and respond. A clear reply lets the sender know it arrived.

examples.en: The guide acquainted us with the town’s history.
examples.zh: 導覽員讓我們認識這座城鎮的歷史。

examples.en: I want to acquaint my cousin with our neighbors.
examples.zh: 我想讓表弟認識我們的鄰居。

examples.en: The first lesson acquainted the class with the new rules.
examples.zh: 第一堂課讓全班熟悉了新規定。

explains.en: This means to help someone become familiar with a person, place, or subject. A teacher may show a new student around the school. The student learns where things are.
A host can introduce two guests who have not met. They may share their names and interests. The introduction can begin a friendly conversation.
A person can learn about a new idea by reading or asking questions. Simple examples make it easier to understand. Learning takes time.

examples.en: Keeping customer acquisition costs (CAC) low is vital for profitability.
examples.zh: 將新客戶獲取成本（CAC）維持在合理低檔是企業實現盈利的關鍵。

examples.en: The conglomerate announced the multibillion-dollar acquisition of an overseas AI startup.
examples.zh: 該大型跨國企業集團正式公開宣布，斥資數十億美元全資收購了一家海外知名 AI 晶片新創公司。

examples.en: Referral programs leverage word-of-mouth recommendations to accelerate new user acquisition.
examples.zh: 會員好友推薦獎勵方案善用真實口碑傳播的力量，能極大化加速新用戶的獲客成長裂變。

examples.en: Robotic sample acquisition mechanisms touched the porous surface for only five seconds before backing away.
examples.zh: 機械臂「樣本採集裝置」（Sample Acquisition），在接觸小行星表面短短五秒後迅速點火後退。

examples.en: Language acquisition in early childhood occurs naturally through social imitation and everyday conversational immersion.
examples.zh: 幼童時期的語言習得過程，完全建立在日常生活的模仿互動與沉浸式家庭對話環境中自然生根發芽。

examples.en: The tech conglomerate announced the multi-billion-dollar acquisition of an innovative cloud computing startup.
examples.zh: 跨國科技巨擘正式對外宣布，斥資數十億美元全資併購收購了一家擁有獨門專利的雲端運算新創企業。

entries.definition: 客戶獲取；收購；獲得；觸碰即離 (Touch-and-Go) 採樣機構樣本採集；獲取

explains.en: This is the act of getting or gaining something. A student may learn a new skill through practice. Each lesson adds to what the student can do.
A company may buy another company or a piece of property. The purchase can help it grow. Workers plan how the groups will join.
A museum may add an old object to its collection. Experts check where it came from. Careful records explain how it was obtained.

examples.en: The activist spoke at the town meeting about clean water.
examples.zh: 這名倡議者在鎮民大會上談論乾淨的飲用水。

examples.en: A young activist organized a campaign to plant trees.
examples.zh: 一位年輕倡議者發起植樹活動。

examples.en: The activist asked the council to add a safe crosswalk.
examples.zh: 倡議者請議會增設一處安全的行人穿越道。

entries.definition: （名）社會或政治活動人士；倡議者

explains.en: This is a person who works to bring about social or political change. The person may ask leaders to improve a rule. They share reasons and facts.
A group member may organize meetings or share information. Others can join the effort if they agree. Peaceful action can help people be heard.
People can support a cause in different ways. They may write letters, volunteer, or teach others. Respectful discussion helps explain the goal.

examples.en: The patient was rushed to the ER suffering from acute appendicitis.
examples.zh: 該名病患因急性闌尾盲腸炎發作被火速送往急診室救治。

examples.en: Dogs possess an exceptionally acute sense of smell and hearing.
examples.zh: 狗狗擁有極其敏銳發達的嗅覺靈敏度與聽覺感知能力。

examples.en: The city faced an acute shortage of potable drinking water during the summer drought.
examples.zh: 在那場罕見的盛夏乾旱期間，這座城市面臨了極度嚴峻的飲用水短缺危機。

explains.en: This describes a problem or feeling that is very strong or happens quickly. A sharp pain may begin suddenly. A person should tell a trusted adult if they feel unwell.
A person can have a very keen sense of noticing details. They may hear a quiet sound from far away. Careful attention helps them respond.
An angle smaller than a right angle is called this in geometry. A student can measure it with a protractor. It looks narrow and pointed.

examples.en: The Central Weather Administration (CWA) issues immediate severe rain advisories.
examples.zh: 交通部中央氣象署（CWA）即時針對各縣市發布豪大雨特報。

examples.en: Efficient hospital administration ensures that incoming emergency patients receive prompt treatment.
examples.zh: 高度現代化且高效的醫院行政管理體系，確保了每一位被救護車送達的急重症病患皆能獲得即時救治。

examples.en: The new presidential administration implemented major reforms in public transportation and clean energy.
examples.zh: 剛上任的新一屆政府行政當局，在綠色大眾運輸網絡與潔淨再生能源領域大刀闊斧推動了多項深遠改革。

explains.en: This is the work of organizing and managing a group or service. A school office keeps records and shares notices. Staff help daily tasks run smoothly.
A group of people may lead a public agency or organization. They make plans and carry out rules. Their work affects how the group operates.
A person in charge may arrange schedules and resources. Clear records help the team know what needs to be done. Good planning supports the whole group.

examples.en: The administrative office sent a notice about the new schedule.
examples.zh: 行政辦公室寄出新時間表的通知。

examples.en: She completed the administrative tasks before lunch.
examples.zh: 她午餐前完成了行政事務。

examples.en: Administrative staff helped visitors find the right room.
examples.zh: 行政人員協助訪客找到正確的房間。

explains.en: This describes work related to organizing an office or public service. Staff may keep files, plan meetings, and answer questions. These tasks help a group run.
A form used for official records may require a person’s name and date. Filling it out clearly helps others understand it. Offices use forms for many tasks.
A worker may arrange schedules and share information with coworkers. Clear messages help prevent confusion. Careful record keeping is useful.

examples.en: Contact the IT systems administrator if your enterprise account gets locked.
examples.zh: 若您的公司企業公務信箱帳號遭到鎖定，請立即聯繫資訊系統管理員。

examples.en: The database administrator optimized database indexing to speed up search queries.
examples.zh: 資料庫管理員優化了索引結構以加速搜尋查詢速度。

examples.en: School administrators held a meeting with parents to discuss campus safety.
examples.zh: 學校行政主管與家長們召開會議以討論校園安全事宜。

entries.definition: 系統管理員；網管；行政官員 (Admin)

explains.en: This is a person who organizes or manages a service or group. A school may have someone who plans records and schedules. Teachers can ask this person for help.
A computer worker may control user accounts and keep a system running. The worker checks settings and solves problems. Careful attention protects information.
The person in charge may make sure people follow procedures. Clear instructions help everyone do their part. Good organization saves time.

examples.en: The adolescent joined the school debate team.
examples.zh: 這名青少年加入了校內辯論隊。

examples.en: An adolescent may be learning to take more responsibility.
examples.zh: 青少年可能正在學習承擔更多責任。

examples.en: The program offers art classes for adolescents.
examples.zh: 這項計畫為青少年開設美術課。

entries.definition: （名）青少年；（形）青春期的；指成長為成年人的人或階段。

explains.en: This is a young person who is growing from childhood toward adulthood. The body and feelings may change during these years. Supportive adults can help.
People at this age may learn to make more choices for themselves. They still need guidance and care. Listening can help families understand one another.
School, friends, and family can all shape a young person’s experience. Each person grows at a different pace. Respect and patience matter.

examples.en: Children adore the friendly librarian.
examples.zh: 孩子們很喜愛那位親切的圖書館員。

examples.en: I adore this song because it reminds me of home.
examples.zh: 我很喜愛這首讓我想起家的歌。

examples.en: The puppy adores its new family.
examples.zh: 小狗非常喜愛牠的新家人。

explains.en: This means to love or like someone or something very much. A child may feel this way about a favorite grandparent. They enjoy spending time together.
A person may have a strong fondness for music or books. They may choose them often during free time. Sharing an interest can be fun.
People can show deep love through kind actions. Helping with a task or listening closely can make someone feel valued. Care matters more than gifts.

examples.en: The hikers faced adverse weather on the mountain.
examples.zh: 登山客在山上遭遇惡劣天氣。

examples.en: The medicine caused an adverse reaction, so the nurse was told.
examples.zh: 藥物引起不良反應，因此有人通知了護理師。

examples.en: Heavy rain had an adverse effect on the outdoor concert.
examples.zh: 大雨對戶外音樂會造成了不利影響。

explains.en: This describes something harmful or unfavorable. Very cold weather can make a walk unpleasant. Warm clothes may help people stay comfortable.
A situation can bring bad results instead of good ones. A sudden delay may cause someone to miss a bus. Planning extra time can help.
A person may face a response that makes a task harder. They can ask for advice and consider other choices. Calm planning is useful.

examples.en: Civil groups advocate for stronger pedestrian safety legislation and road redesigns.
examples.zh: 民間公民團體大力倡導並推動改善行人地獄現狀、促成更嚴謹的交通安全立法。

examples.en: She has been a fierce advocate for children's mental healthcare resources for decades.
examples.zh: 數十年來，她始終是為兒童心理醫療資源大聲疾呼並積極爭取權益的堅定倡議者。

examples.en: Nutritionists advocate eating balanced whole foods rather than relying entirely on supplements.
examples.zh: 營養專家大力倡導日常應當攝取均衡天然原型食物，而非盲目依賴人工營養補充品。

explains.en: This means to support an idea or speak in favor of a person or cause. A student may ask the school to add more books. Clear reasons help explain the request.
A person who supports a cause can encourage others to help. They may share facts and listen to questions. Respectful discussion can persuade people.
The word can also name someone who speaks for another person. A helper may explain what a child needs. The speaker should listen carefully first.

examples.en: The child showed affection by hugging her grandmother.
examples.zh: 孩子擁抱奶奶來表達愛意。

examples.en: The dog has great affection for its family.
examples.zh: 這隻狗非常愛牠的家人。

examples.en: His note expressed affection for his old friend.
examples.zh: 他的便條表達了對老朋友的關懷。

explains.en: This is a warm feeling of love and care for someone. A parent may hug a child after a hard day. The hug can bring comfort.
People can show care by helping, listening, or spending time together. Small acts can make someone feel important. Kind actions strengthen relationships.
A pet may show closeness by sitting beside its owner. The owner can respond gently. Trust grows through patient care.

examples.en: The team lead sent out the meeting agenda one day in advance.
examples.zh: 團隊主管提前一天發送了會議議程給所有與會者。

examples.en: The first item on today's agenda is the annual marketing budget review.
examples.zh: 今天會議議程上排定討論的第一項核心議題，是全公司年度市場行銷預算審查案。

examples.en: Setting a focused agenda keeps executive boardroom meetings efficient and concise.
examples.zh: 事先擬定綱舉目張的精準會議議程，能確保高層董事會會議始終保持高效且言之有物。

explains.en: This is a list of matters to discuss at a meeting. The leader may write each topic in order. Members know what they will talk about.
A group can add questions to a plan for a meeting. They may decide how much time to give each subject. A clear list keeps the meeting focused.
A person can plan tasks for the day. Writing them down helps remember what needs attention. The list can be changed when plans change.

examples.en: The coach stopped the aggression between the players.
examples.zh: 教練制止了球員間的攻擊行為。

examples.en: The dog showed aggression when a stranger came near its food.
examples.zh: 陌生人靠近狗的食物時，牠表現出攻擊性。

examples.en: The report described aggression during the argument.
examples.zh: 報告描述了爭吵期間的攻擊行為。

entries.definition: （名）攻擊性、侵略行為；以敵意或暴力傷害、威脅他人的行為。

explains.en: This is angry or harmful behavior toward another person or group. Shouting threats can make people feel unsafe. Calm discussion is a better way to solve problems.
An animal may act fiercely to protect itself or its young. People should give it space. Trained helpers know how to respond safely.
People can feel angry without hurting anyone. Taking a break and asking for help can prevent harm. Everyone deserves to feel safe.

examples.en: She cried out in agony after hurting her ankle.
examples.zh: 腳踝受傷後，她痛苦地叫了出來。

examples.en: The character suffered agony when he lost his friend.
examples.zh: 故事中的角色在失去朋友時深感痛苦。

examples.en: Waiting for the lost dog’s return was agony for the family.
examples.zh: 家人苦等走失的狗回家，十分煎熬。

explains.en: This is extreme physical or emotional pain. A person may feel it after a serious loss. Caring support can help them cope.
A character in a story may face great suffering. The writer shows how hard the situation is. Readers may hope the character finds help.
A person can use strong language to describe waiting or frustration. They may say the delay feels unbearable. Talking calmly can make it easier.

examples.en: The Chianan Plain is Taiwan's most fertile agricultural region.
examples.zh: 嘉南平原是全台灣最肥沃富饒的農業生產重鎮。

examples.en: International trade agreements open new export markets for local agricultural products.
examples.zh: 跨國自由貿易協定的簽署為在地各類農產品開闢了全新的海外外銷市場。

examples.en: The government established an agricultural bank to support rural farmers with low-interest loans.
examples.zh: 政府輔導設立農業金融金庫，向廣大農村農民提供低利農貸與資金支援。

explains.en: This describes work, tools, or products connected with farming. Farmers grow crops and raise animals for food. Their work depends on land and weather.
A machine can help prepare soil or harvest crops. Workers learn to use it safely. Good tools can save effort.
A food product may come from a farm. It can be grown, gathered, and sent to a store. Careful handling keeps it fresh.

examples.en: Instant noodles are located on aisle four, next to snacks.
examples.zh: 泡麵區位於第四走道，就在零食區旁邊。

examples.en: Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat on the airplane?
examples.zh: 搭飛機時你偏好靠窗座位還是走道座位？

examples.en: The bride walked gracefully down the church aisle with her father.
examples.zh: 新娘挽著父親的手優雅地走在教堂的走道上。

examples.en: The passenger preferred an aisle seat for easy access to stretch during long flights.
examples.zh: 在長途跨洋飛行中，這位旅客特別偏好挑選走道座位以便隨時起身活動筋骨去洗手間。

examples.en: The supermarket aisle was stocked with a rich variety of international specialty snacks.
examples.zh: 大型生鮮超市的乾糧零食走道陳列貨架上，琳瑯滿目擺滿了來自各國的特色進口休閒點心。

examples.en: She walked gracefully down the church aisle as the wedding march played softly.
examples.zh: 伴隨著管風琴悠揚浪漫的結婚進行曲樂聲，新娘挽著父親的手臂優雅緩緩走過教堂紅毯中央走道。

entries.definition: 走道；通道；走廊（飛機／火車／超市）

explains.en: This is the passage between rows of seats or shelves. People walk through it to reach a seat or item. Keeping it clear makes movement easier.
A passenger can use the narrow path between seats on a plane or train. Bags should not block the way. Other travelers need room to pass.
A grocery store has paths between shelves of food. Signs help shoppers find what they need. Carts should leave room for others.

examples.en: The book described the struggles of an alcoholic man.
examples.zh: 這本書描寫一位酗酒男子所經歷的掙扎。

examples.en: The restaurant serves alcoholic drinks to adults.
examples.zh: 餐廳為成年人供應含酒精的飲料。

examples.en: An alcoholic may need support from health professionals.
examples.zh: 有酒精成癮問題的人可能需要健康專業人員的支持。

entries.definition: （形）含酒精的；酒精造成的；（名）酒精依賴者

explains.en: This describes a person who drinks too much alcohol and may have a serious health problem. Such a person may need care and support from trained professionals. Loved ones can offer support without blame.
The word can also describe a drink that contains alcohol. Adults may choose whether to drink, while children should not. People should follow local rules.
A person’s health and safety matter. If drinking causes problems, they can speak with a qualified health worker or trusted support service. Help is available.

examples.en: The alien waved from its silver spaceship.
examples.zh: 那個外星人從銀色太空船中揮手。

examples.en: The strange custom felt alien to the new visitor.
examples.zh: 對新來的訪客而言，這種陌生習俗感覺很不熟悉。

examples.en: The story followed an alien who wanted to make friends.
examples.zh: 故事描述一名想交朋友的外星人。

entries.definition: （名）外星人；外國人；（形）陌生的；外來的

explains.en: This can mean a being from another planet in a story. Writers imagine what such a visitor might look like. The character may travel in a spaceship.
It can describe someone or something that seems strange or unfamiliar. A new custom may feel unusual to a visitor. Learning about it can help.
The word can name a person who comes from another country in legal writing. Laws use specific terms for people who are not citizens. The context matters.

examples.en: Are you allergic to any specific antibiotic medications?
examples.zh: 請問您對任何特定的抗生素藥物過敏嗎？

examples.en: She is severely allergic to bee stings and pet fur.
examples.zh: 她對蜜蜂叮咬和寵物毛髮具有嚴重的過敏反應。

examples.en: Always inform restaurant staff if you are allergic to dairy products.
examples.zh: 若您對乳製品過敏，請務必隨時告知餐廳服務人員。

examples.en: Inform the restaurant waiter immediately if you are allergic to peanuts.
examples.zh: 若您對花生等堅果過敏，請務必在點餐時第一時間告知服務生。

examples.en: My younger brother is severely allergic to cat dander and bee stings.
examples.zh: 我弟弟對貓咪皮屑毛髮與蜜蜂叮咬有著極度劇烈的嚴重過敏體質。

examples.en: Many people develop allergic skin rashes after touching poison ivy.
examples.zh: 許多人在皮膚不慎接觸到毒藤蔓後，會長出奇癢難耐的過敏性紅疹。

examples.en: Inform the triage nurse immediately if you are allergic to penicillin antibiotics.
examples.zh: 若您個人體質對盤尼西林抗生素有過敏病史，請在就醫時第一時間主動告知醫護人員。

examples.en: She discovered she was severely allergic to shellfish after breaking out in hives.
examples.zh: 在一次海鮮大餐後全身突然起大片蕁麻疹紅疹，她這才發現自己對甲殼類海鮮嚴重過敏。

examples.en: Many children are allergic to peanuts and must carry emergency epinephrine injectors.
examples.zh: 許多歐美學童對花生堅果具有致命性的嚴重過敏反應，上學時背包必須隨身攜帶腎上腺素筆。

explains.en: This describes a body that reacts badly to a certain substance. A person may sneeze around dust or get a rash from a plant. Avoiding the trigger may help.
Some people react to particular foods, medicines, or animal fur. A health professional can help identify the cause. Families should read labels carefully.
A person can tell a trusted adult if they feel sick after contact with something. Severe reactions need prompt help from medical professionals. Safety plans can guide adults.

examples.en: He developed an allergy to seafood such as shrimp and crabs.
examples.zh: 他對蝦蟹等海鮮類食物產生了過敏反應。

examples.en: People with peanut allergies must carry epinephrine auto-injectors.
examples.zh: 對花生過敏的人必須隨身攜帶腎上腺素自動注射器。

examples.en: Seasonal pollen allergies affect millions of individuals every spring.
examples.zh: 季節性花粉過敏每逢春季都會影響數百萬人。

examples.en: Dust mites and animal fur can trigger seasonal nasal allergies.
examples.zh: 塵蟎與動物毛屑容易誘發季節性過敏性鼻炎。

examples.en: She underwent skin prick testing to pinpoint the exact source of her food allergy.
examples.zh: 她接受了皮膚針刺過敏原測試，以精準找出誘發食物過敏的真正源頭。

examples.en: Severe peanut allergies can lead to life-threatening anaphylactic reactions.
examples.zh: 嚴重的花生堅果過敏症狀可能會迅速惡化為危及生命的過敏性休克。

examples.en: Severe penicillin drug allergies are permanently highlighted on the electronic health record banner.
examples.zh: 對特定抗生素盤尼西林過敏的嚴重藥物過敏史（Allergy），會在跨院電子病歷系統首頁亮起醒目的紅色警示。

examples.en: Millions of people suffer from seasonal pollen allergies, experiencing runny noses and itchy eyes every spring.
examples.zh: 每逢春暖花開時節，數以百萬計的民眾飽受花粉過敏症所苦，面臨噴嚏連連、流鼻水與眼睛奇癢難耐的困擾。

examples.en: The restaurant kitchen takes peanut allergies seriously, preparing anaphylaxis-safe meals in dedicated sanitized areas.
examples.zh: 飯店主廚嚴格正視花生引發的急性過敏性休克風險，在獨立專屬料理工作台上為過敏體質貴賓精心烹調無過敏原餐點。

entries.definition: 過敏；過敏反應；過敏症；藥物過敏史雲端警示

explains.en: This is a harmful reaction that the body has to a certain substance. A person may sneeze near dust or develop a rash after touching a plant. The reaction can range from mild to serious.
Some people react to foods, medicine, or animal fur. A health professional can help find what caused the problem. Clear records can help.
A person should tell an adult if they feel unwell after eating or touching something. Adults can follow a care plan from a health professional. They can name what they touched or ate.

examples.en: The two teams formed an alliance for the science fair.
examples.zh: 兩個隊伍結盟參加科展。

examples.en: The alliance helped the villages share clean water.
examples.zh: 這個聯盟幫助村莊共享乾淨的水。

examples.en: They built an alliance to protect the forest.
examples.zh: 他們組成聯盟來保護森林。

entries.definition: （名）聯盟、同盟；為共同目標而合作的團體或國家關係。

explains.en: This is a partnership between people or groups who agree to work together. Two schools may share books for a project. They can reach a goal by helping each other.
Groups can join to solve a shared problem. Each brings different skills or supplies. Clear promises help everyone know their part.
Countries may cooperate for trade or safety. Leaders discuss goals and rules. Working together can help both sides.

examples.en: The teacher allocated ten minutes for each team.
examples.zh: 老師分配給每組十分鐘。

examples.en: We allocated a small part of the budget for new books.
examples.zh: 我們撥出一小部分預算購買新書。

examples.en: The coach allocated one ball to each group.
examples.zh: 教練分給每組一顆球。

explains.en: This means to set aside something for a particular person or purpose. A teacher may give each group time with a computer. Everyone gets a fair turn.
A family can decide how to use its money. They may save some for food and some for a trip. Planning helps avoid spending too much.
A leader may assign jobs to different workers. Each person knows what to do. Sharing tasks can help a project finish on time.

examples.en: My ally helped me finish the group project.
examples.zh: 我的盟友幫我完成了小組專題。

examples.en: The two villages became allies after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後，兩個村莊成為盟友。

examples.en: She will ally herself with the team that protects the river.
examples.zh: 她會與保護河流的隊伍結盟。

explains.en: This is a person or group that supports another person or cause. A friend may stand beside someone during a difficult time. Support can make them feel less alone.
A country that cooperates with another can provide help. They may share supplies or work toward the same goal. Trust is important.
As a verb, it means to support or join with someone. A student may work with a classmate on a project. Sharing ideas can improve the result.

examples.en: A small garden sits alongside the school library.
examples.zh: 學校圖書館旁有一座小花園。

examples.en: She walked alongside her grandmother on the path.
examples.zh: 她沿著小路陪奶奶一起走。

examples.en: The bus stopped alongside the curb.
examples.zh: 公車停在路邊。

explains.en: This means beside or next to something. A path may run next to a quiet stream. Walkers can hear the water as they go.
A person may work at the same time as another. Two friends can cook beside each other in the kitchen. Sharing space can make the task fun.
A vehicle may travel near another one. Drivers should leave enough room for safety. Keeping distance helps prevent a crash.

examples.en: We altered the plan because it began to rain.
examples.zh: 因為開始下雨，我們改變了計畫。

examples.en: The tailor altered the dress to fit her better.
examples.zh: 裁縫修改了洋裝，讓它更合身。

examples.en: The students altered the poster by adding larger letters.
examples.zh: 學生修改海報，加入更大的字。

entries.definition: （動）改變、修改；使某物在外觀、狀態或內容上有所不同。

explains.en: This means to change something, often a small part. A tailor may shorten a sleeve so it fits better. The rest of the shirt stays the same.
A plan may need a change when the weather turns rainy. The group can move its picnic indoors. A new choice keeps the event going.
A person can change their opinion after learning new facts. Listening carefully can help someone decide. Good reasons can guide a new view.

examples.en: The class meets on alternate Fridays.
examples.zh: 班級每隔一個星期五聚會一次。

examples.en: We take alternate turns choosing the game.
examples.zh: 我們輪流選擇遊戲。

examples.en: The lights flashed in alternate colors.
examples.zh: 燈光以不同顏色交替閃爍。

entries.definition: （形）交替的；（動）交替；輪流；（名）替代者。

explains.en: This means happening one after another by turns. Two students may take turns reading each page. Both get a chance to join.
A route can go in two different directions on different trips. One day it travels north and the next day south. The pattern repeats.
A person may choose between two options in a regular order. Taking turns can be fair. A clear plan helps people know what comes next.

examples.en: The council voted to amend the rule.
examples.zh: 議會投票修訂這條規定。

examples.en: She amended the letter to correct the date.
examples.zh: 她修改信件來更正日期。

examples.en: The group will amend its plan after the meeting.
examples.zh: 小組會在會議後修訂計畫。

explains.en: This means to change a written rule or document to make it better or clearer. A group may fix a confusing sentence. The new words explain the idea more clearly.
A plan can be updated when new information appears. The group checks what needs changing. Everyone should know about the change.
A person can correct a mistake in a letter before sending it. Reading it again may reveal a wrong date. Careful checking helps.

examples.en: There is ample room for everyone at the table.
examples.zh: 桌邊有足夠的空間讓每個人入座。

examples.en: We had ample time to pack before the trip.
examples.zh: 出發旅行前，我們有充裕的時間打包。

examples.en: The garden has ample sunlight for the flowers.
examples.zh: 花園裡有充足的陽光照耀花朵。

explains.en: This describes having enough or more than enough of something. A picnic basket with plenty of fruit can feed everyone. No one needs to go hungry.
A room may have enough space for a group to sit comfortably. People can move without bumping into chairs. Careful planning helps.
A person may have enough time to finish a task. Starting early can leave room for checking. A calm pace can improve the work.

examples.en: The analyst studied the chart before the meeting.
examples.zh: 分析師在會議前研究了圖表。

examples.en: A weather analyst explained the storm data.
examples.zh: 氣象分析師解釋了暴風雨資料。

examples.en: The analyst found a pattern in the survey answers.
examples.zh: 分析師在問卷答案中找出一種模式。

entries.definition: （名）分析師；研究資料與情況，並提出判斷或建議的人。

explains.en: This is a person who studies information to understand what it shows. A worker may compare numbers from several months. The pattern can help a group plan.
A science worker may examine results from an experiment. Checking the facts helps avoid mistakes. Clear notes make the work easier to review.
People in this job can explain a problem using evidence. They may prepare a report with charts. Others can use the findings to decide what to do.

examples.en: The reporter protected the identity of the anonymous inside whistleblower source.
examples.zh: 這位正直的記者全力保護提供貪腐內幕的匿名內部吹哨者之真實身分。

examples.en: Police solved the burglary case thanks to an anonymous tip from a neighbor.
examples.zh: 多虧鄰居提供的一則匿名線報，警方順利偵破了這起入室竊盜案。

examples.en: Online surveys often collect anonymous feedback to encourage honest responses.
examples.zh: 線上問卷調查通常採匿名填寫方式，以鼓勵受訪者提供最真實的回饋。

explains.en: This describes a person whose name is not shared. A writer may use a different name when sending a comment. Readers do not know who wrote it.
A note can leave out the sender’s name to protect privacy. The message should still be respectful. People may want to share ideas without being recognized.
A gift may arrive without showing who sent it. The receiver may wonder about the kind person. A small note can include a clue.

examples.en: We anticipate a large crowd at the school fair.
examples.zh: 我們預期學校園遊會會有很多人。

examples.en: She anticipated that the road would be busy.
examples.zh: 她預料道路會很繁忙。

examples.en: The team anticipates finishing the project on Friday.
examples.zh: 隊伍預計星期五完成專案。

entries.definition: 預期；預料；期待；先行準備。

explains.en: This means to expect something may happen. A family may bring umbrellas because rain is likely. Preparing ahead can keep them dry.
A person can guess what another person might need. A host may set out extra chairs for visitors. Thinking ahead is helpful.
Students may look forward to an event. They can make plans before it begins. Knowing what to expect can help them feel ready.

examples.en: They found an antique clock in the attic.
examples.zh: 他們在閣樓裡發現一座古董時鐘。

examples.en: My aunt collects antique teacups.
examples.zh: 我阿姨收藏古董茶杯。

examples.en: The shop displayed an antique wooden chair.
examples.zh: 商店展示一張古董木椅。

explains.en: This describes something made long ago and often valued for its age or style. A shop may sell an old clock with carved wooden sides. Someone may collect such objects.
An old object can show how people lived in the past. Museums care for these items. Visitors can learn from them.
A person may buy an old chair and fix it carefully. The chair can still be useful. Its design may look different from new furniture.

examples.en: The violin solo ended with thunderous applause from the crowd.
examples.zh: 小提琴獨奏在全場如雷的掌聲中圓滿落幕。

examples.en: A warm round of applause greeted the guest speaker as she approached the podium.
examples.zh: 當客座主講人走向講台時，台下響起了熱烈的歡迎掌聲。

examples.en: The young pianist bowed gracefully in response to the audience's enthusiastic applause.
examples.zh: 年輕的鋼琴家優雅地鞠躬致意，回應觀眾們熱情的熱烈鼓掌。

examples.en: The virtuoso pianist received thunderous applause after completing the concerto.
examples.zh: 鋼琴名家在演奏完協奏曲後，全場爆發出如雷貫耳的熱烈掌聲。

examples.en: The audience broke into spontaneous applause as the curtain descended.
examples.zh: 當大紅舞台布幕緩緩降下時，全場熱情觀眾不由自主地爆發出熱烈歡呼與掌聲。

examples.en: Her passionate speech on environmental conservation drew warm applause from delegates.
examples.zh: 她針對生態環境保護所發表的慷慨激昂演說，博得了各國參會代表的熱烈讚賞掌聲。

examples.en: Waves of roaring applause echoed through the concert hall after the pianist’s flawless solo.
examples.zh: 當鋼琴名家行雲流水彈完高難度獨奏樂章，如雷貫耳的熱烈掌聲在大廳各個角落久久不絕於耳。

examples.en: Please hold your applause until all four movements of the Beethoven symphony have concluded.
examples.zh: 為了尊重古典音樂演奏禮儀與曲目完整性，請各位愛樂朋友在貝多芬交響曲全四個樂章全部演奏完畢後再行鼓掌。

examples.en: The young acrobat took a modest bow as spontaneous bursts of applause swept through the tent.
examples.zh: 當自發性的如雷掌聲如潮水般席捲整個馬戲大帳篷時，年僅十歲的雜技神童謙遜地向台下四面觀眾鞠躬致意。

entries.definition: 掌聲；喝采；讚賞；如雷貫耳的掌聲

explains.en: This is the sound people make by clapping their hands to show approval. An audience may do this after a play. The performers hear that people enjoyed it.
A crowd may clap when someone wins a prize or gives a good speech. Their hands make a loud sound together. It can show praise.
People can also show approval with words or smiles. Kind responses encourage someone who has worked hard. Everyone can join in a respectful way.

examples.en: The new appliance keeps food cold.
examples.zh: 這台新家電能讓食物保持冰涼。

examples.en: Dad unplugged the appliance before cleaning it.
examples.zh: 爸爸清潔家電前先拔掉插頭。

examples.en: This appliance can wash and dry clothes.
examples.zh: 這台家電可以洗衣服和烘衣服。

explains.en: This is a machine or tool used in a home. A toaster warms slices of bread. A washing machine cleans clothes.
People plug some home machines into an outlet. They should follow safety instructions. An adult can help when a device needs repair.
Different machines make household tasks easier. A refrigerator keeps food cool, while a vacuum cleans floors. Each one has a special job.

examples.en: This is an apt name for a very fast rabbit.
examples.zh: 這是替一隻跑很快的兔子取的貼切名字。

examples.en: She made an apt comment about the story.
examples.zh: 她對故事做了貼切的評論。

examples.en: He is apt to forget his lunch when he is in a hurry.
examples.zh: 他趕時間時很容易忘記帶午餐。

entries.definition: （形）恰當的、適合的；有傾向或天分的，依上下文判斷。

explains.en: This describes something suitable or likely to happen. A quick walk is a good choice before dinner. It fits the time available.
A person may be likely to make a certain mistake if they rush. Slowing down can help them check their work. Careful habits make a difference.
The word can also mean clever or quick to learn. A student may understand a puzzle after one hint. Practice helps build skill.

examples.en: The renowned architect designed the eco-friendly Beitou Public Library.
examples.zh: 這位知名建築師親手設計了環保綠建築北投公共圖書館。

examples.en: An experienced landscape architect transformed the abandoned railway into a linear park.
examples.zh: 一位經驗豐富的景觀建築師將廢棄鐵道改造成綠意盎然的帶狀公園。

examples.en: He is considered the chief architect behind the nation's economic miracle.
examples.zh: 他被各界公認為造就該國經濟奇蹟背後的總策劃締造者。

explains.en: This is a person trained to design buildings. The person draws plans for rooms, doors, and windows. Workers use the plans to build safely.
A building designer thinks about how people will use each space. A library needs quiet areas and places to read. Good planning helps visitors.
This person may choose shapes and materials for a structure. Safety and comfort matter. The final building can be useful and attractive.

examples.en: Modern Taiwanese architecture harmoniously blends glass facades with greenery.
examples.zh: 現代台灣建築風格巧妙將玻璃帷幕外牆與綠意植栽融為一體。

examples.en: Roman architecture is famous for monumental arches, domes, and durable aqueducts.
examples.zh: 古羅馬建築風格以其宏偉的拱門、穹頂與堅固耐用的水道橋名揚天下。

examples.en: Software engineers must understand microservice architecture before designing systems.
examples.zh: 軟體架構工程師在著手設計大型系統前，必須深入理解微服務架構。

examples.en: Contemporary Taiwanese architecture harmoniously blends raw concrete with traditional red brick.
examples.zh: 當代台灣建築美學巧妙且和諧地將質樸清水模與百年傳統紅磚瓦元素完美交融。

examples.en: She studied classical Gothic architecture during her study abroad program in Europe.
examples.zh: 她在歐洲留學研修期間，專題深入研讀了中世紀經典哥德式建築美學風格。

examples.en: Software architecture defines the high-level structural framework of complex software systems.
examples.zh: 軟體系統架構（Architecture）定義了高度複雜大型軟體系統的高層次底層骨幹框架。

examples.en: Sustainable architecture maximizes natural daylight, cross-ventilation, and recycled materials to reduce carbon footprints.
examples.zh: 永續綠建築設計巧妙結合自然採光、對流通風與循環建材，大幅降低建築全生命週期碳足跡。

examples.en: She studied classical European architecture before returning to design innovative bamboo public spaces.
examples.zh: 在返鄉投入本土創新竹構公共空間設計前，她曾遠赴歐洲深入鑽研古典與當代西方建築學。

examples.en: Cloud software engineers redesigned the system's microservice architecture to handle sudden traffic spikes.
examples.zh: 雲端軟體架構師全面重構了後台微服務系統架構，以確保在遭遇瞬間湧入的百萬級流量時依然穩健運作。

examples.en: Healthy sleep architecture consists of repeating ninety-minute cycles alternating between light, deep, and dream sleep.
examples.zh: 健康的睡眠結構由數個九十分鐘週期組成，在淺眠、慢波深睡與夢境間規律循環。

examples.en: Traditional Minnan architecture features sweeping swallowtail roofs and red brick courtyards across Lukang.
examples.zh: 鹿港古鎮處處可見傳統閩南式歷史建築結構，以飛揚優美的燕尾屋脊與紅磚合院著稱。

examples.en: The software architecture of the platform was designed with high modularity to support millions of concurrent users.
examples.zh: 該雲端平台的軟體系統架構採用高度模組化設計，能從容支撐數百萬名使用者同時在線操作。

examples.en: Sustainable green architecture harnesses solar energy, cross-ventilation, and recycled building materials.
examples.zh: 現代永續綠建築，善用太陽能發電、自然對流通風與循環再生建材。

examples.en: She studied bioclimatic architecture to design energy-efficient residential communities in subtropical climates.
examples.zh: 她專攻生物氣候建築學，致力於為亞熱帶海島型氣候設計高能效的綠能宜居住宅社區。

examples.en: Traditional vernacular architecture often holds the best passive cooling lessons for modern designers.
examples.zh: 傳統風土聚落建築的匠人營造智慧，往往為當代設計師提供了最卓越的被動式節能降溫範本。

entries.definition: 建築學；建築風格；系統架構；架構；永續綠建築設計；完整九十分鐘睡眠階段結構；現代永續綠建築設計

explains.en: This is the study and design of buildings. It looks at how spaces are shaped and used. People may compare homes from different times.
A building’s design includes its rooms, walls, doors, and roof. The layout affects how people move inside. Light and materials also matter.
Computer systems can also have a basic design made of connected parts. Each part has a job. A clear plan helps the system work.

examples.en: The basketball game filled the arena with cheering fans.
examples.zh: 籃球比賽讓體育館裡的球迷歡呼不已。

examples.en: The singer performed in a large arena.
examples.zh: 歌手在大型體育館演出。

examples.en: The arena was quiet before the show began.
examples.zh: 表演開始前，體育館裡很安靜。

entries.definition: 競技場；活動場所；競爭領域。

explains.en: This is a large place for sports, shows, or other public events. Many people can sit and watch what happens. Workers help keep the area safe.
A contest may take place on a special floor or field. Players follow rules while fans cheer. The event brings people together.
The word can describe a place where people compete or show their skills. It may be indoors or outside. Signs guide visitors to seats.

examples.en: The music aroused strong feelings in the audience.
examples.zh: 音樂引起觀眾強烈的感受。

examples.en: Her question aroused the class’s curiosity.
examples.zh: 她的問題激發了全班的好奇心。

examples.en: The smell of cookies aroused happy memories.
examples.zh: 餅乾的香氣喚起了快樂的回憶。

explains.en: This means to cause a feeling or reaction to begin. A funny story can make people laugh. A loud bang may make them jump.
A question can make someone curious about a subject. Looking for an answer may lead to new learning. Good questions can start discussion.
A smell can bring back a memory. The scent of bread may remind someone of a family kitchen. Feelings can arise without warning.

examples.en: Advanced phased array antennas steer radio beams electronically without moving physical mechanical parts.
examples.zh: 先進的電子相位陣列天線，無需任何機械齒輪轉動即可利用電磁波束毫秒級精準追蹤衛星。

examples.en: The modern solar farm features a sprawling array of photovoltaic panels tilted toward the southern sky.
examples.zh: 這座現代化太陽能電廠設有一望無際整齊排列的太陽能光電陣列板，朝向南方天空傾斜蓄能。

examples.en: The computer programmer declared a multi-dimensional array to store weekly temperature logs efficiently.
examples.zh: 電腦軟體工程師宣告了一個多維陣列資料結構，以高效儲存與處理每週的氣溫變化記錄。

examples.en: Flexible 66kV inter-array cables link dozens of individual turbines to gather electricity across the wind farm.
examples.zh: 鋪設於海床底部的 66kV 風場內部陣列海纜，串聯各座風機匯集所發出的潔淨電力。

examples.en: The layout of the subsea cable array was optimized to minimize electrical impedance and trench length.
examples.zh: 整個水下陣列海纜走向經過電氣模擬拓撲最佳化，以大幅降低線路阻抗損耗並縮短開溝挖埋長度。

examples.en: Diverless underwater vehicles inspect the cable array to ensure no sections have been uncovered by currents.
examples.zh: 水下無人遙控潛水器（ROV）定期沿著海纜陣列巡檢，確保沒有任何電纜段落因強勁洋流沖刷而裸露。

entries.definition: 電子相位陣列波束成形天線；陣列；66kV 風場陣列內部海底電纜網；排列

explains.en: This is a group of items or people arranged in rows or patterns. A tray may hold a neat group of colored buttons. Each item has a place.
A list can show things in order. A shop may arrange its products by size or price. The clear layout helps customers compare them.
In electronics, a flat set of small parts can work together to send or receive signals. Engineers place the parts in a planned pattern. This design can guide a signal.

examples.en: The arrogant player refused to pass the ball.
examples.zh: 那位傲慢的球員拒絕傳球。

examples.en: His arrogant reply made his classmates feel small.
examples.zh: 他傲慢的回答讓同學感到自卑。

examples.en: She sounded arrogant when she bragged about every prize.
examples.zh: 她吹噓每一個獎項時，聽起來很自大。

explains.en: This describes someone who thinks they are better or more important than other people. They may brag and refuse to listen. Such behavior can hurt friendships.
A person may ignore other people’s ideas because they feel too proud. Teamwork requires everyone to share and listen. Respect helps a group succeed.
Confidence is helpful, but looking down on others is unkind. A person can be proud of hard work while still treating people fairly. Humility helps.

examples.en: She articulated her plan clearly to the group.
examples.zh: 她向小組清楚表達了自己的計畫。

examples.en: The speaker articulated each word slowly.
examples.zh: 演講者慢慢地把每個字說清楚。

examples.en: He tried to articulate why the game felt unfair.
examples.zh: 他試著清楚說明為什麼覺得遊戲不公平。

entries.definition: （動）清楚表達；（形）表達清晰的，也指說話有條理。

explains.en: This means to express thoughts clearly in speaking or writing. A student can explain an idea in an organized way. Listeners can follow the message.
A person may speak with clear words and careful pronunciation. Practicing aloud can make the message easier to understand. Pauses help too.
The word can describe joints that move freely. Some birds have body parts that bend in several places. This helps them move.

examples.en: The ass carried baskets along the mountain path.
examples.zh: 那頭驢沿著山路馱著籃子。

examples.en: An ass brayed beside the fence.
examples.zh: 一頭驢在圍籬旁嘶叫。

examples.en: The farmer gave the ass fresh hay.
examples.zh: 農夫給那頭驢新鮮乾草。

explains.en: This is a farm animal related to a horse. It has long ears and can carry loads. It often makes a loud braying sound.
The animal may walk along rocky paths and carry supplies. Its strong legs help it travel over rough ground. It eats plants and grass.
A young one may stay near its mother in a field. Farmers care for it with food and shelter. Gentle handling helps it feel safe.

examples.en: The report described an assault near the station.
examples.zh: 報告描述了車站附近的一起攻擊事件。

examples.en: The player received a penalty for assault during the match.
examples.zh: 那名球員在比賽中因攻擊行為受到處罰。

examples.en: The guards prevented an assault on the traveler.
examples.zh: 守衛阻止了對旅客的襲擊。

entries.definition: （名）攻擊；襲擊；（動）攻擊；猛烈抨擊

explains.en: This is a violent attack on a person. It is a serious crime and can cause harm. People should seek help from trusted authorities if someone is in danger.
In sports, the word can refer to a forceful attempt to reach an opponent. Rules help keep players safe. Officials stop unsafe play.
The verb can mean to attack someone or something. In a story, a character may be attacked by a group. The event can frighten them.

examples.en: She asserted that the team had followed the rules.
examples.zh: 她堅稱隊伍遵守了規則。

examples.en: He asserted his right to ask a question.
examples.zh: 他堅定地表明自己提問的權利。

examples.en: The report asserts that the bridge is safe.
examples.zh: 報告主張這座橋很安全。

explains.en: This means to state something firmly and clearly. A student may say that everyone deserves a fair turn. Calm words can make the point clear.
A person can stand up for their rights or beliefs. They should explain their reasons and listen to others. Respectful speech helps.
A speaker may claim that something is true. Evidence can support the claim. Checking facts helps people make good decisions.

examples.en: The engineering panel assessed technical feasibility before starting construction.
examples.zh: 工程專家小組在動工興建前全面評估了技術可行性。

examples.en: Insurance adjusters arrived promptly to assess vehicle damage following the highway collision.
examples.zh: 車禍理賠勘查專員第一時間趕赴車禍現場，嚴格評估國道追撞事故對車體造成的損壞。

examples.en: The university uses blind grading protocols to assess final research papers impartially.
examples.zh: 國立大學全面採行雙向匿名盲審評分規範，以求徹頭徹尾客觀公正地評定學期專題論文。

entries.definition: 評估；核定；評定；評量；鑑定；全建築生命週期碳足跡評估 (LCA)

explains.en: This means to examine something and judge its quality, amount, or value. A teacher may look at a student’s work and offer feedback. Clear standards help make the judgment fair.
A worker may check how much a project costs. The numbers help a group plan its budget. Careful records prevent errors.
A person may look at a situation and decide what should happen next. They gather facts before making a choice. Asking questions can help.

examples.en: The library is a valuable asset to the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 圖書館是社區很有價值的資產。

examples.en: Her patience is an asset when she teaches young children.
examples.zh: 她的耐心是教導幼童時的一大優點。

examples.en: The company listed its computers as assets.
examples.zh: 公司把電腦列為資產。

entries.definition: （名）資產、優勢；有價值或有用的人事物，也可指擁有的財產。

explains.en: This is something valuable or useful that a person or group owns. A bicycle can help someone get to school. A skill can also be useful.
A business may own tools, buildings, or money. These things help it do its work. Careful records show what it has.
A person’s kindness can be a valuable quality. Friends may depend on someone who listens and helps. Good qualities support a group.

examples.en: Check your facts to ensure your reasoning isn't based on false assumptions.
examples.zh: 核實事實以確保你的推論並非建立在錯誤的假設上。

examples.en: The economic forecast relied on the optimistic assumption that fuel prices would stabilize.
examples.zh: 這份經濟成長預測完全建立在一個樂觀的假設前提上，即國際油價將會回穩。

examples.en: It is a dangerous assumption to believe that walking alone in unlit alleys is always safe.
examples.zh: 盲目認為深夜獨自漫步在沒有路燈照明的昏暗僻靜小巷絕對安全，是危險的臆斷。

explains.en: This is an idea accepted as true without proof. A person may guess that a friend is busy because they have not replied. The guess may be wrong.
People sometimes make a guess before checking facts. Asking questions can help them learn what is really happening. It is good to stay open to new information.
A plan can rely on a certain belief about what will happen. If the belief changes, the plan may need to change too. Careful thinking helps.

examples.en: The magic trick astonished the children.
examples.zh: 魔術戲法讓孩子們驚訝不已。

examples.en: Her high score astonished her whole family.
examples.zh: 她的高分讓全家人都很驚訝。

examples.en: We were astonished to see snow in April.
examples.zh: 我們驚訝地看到四月下雪。

explains.en: This means to surprise someone greatly. A sudden visit from a dear friend may make a person smile. They did not expect it.
A surprising result can make people stare or ask questions. They may need time to understand what happened. New facts can change their view.
A person may react with wonder after seeing something unusual. A bright comet in the night sky can amaze a family. They may remember it for years.

examples.en: High schools invest in quality rubber running tracks to promote track athletics.
examples.zh: 高中校園積極鋪設優質國際標準 PU 田徑跑道，全力推廣青少年田徑體育運動。

examples.en: She showed a natural talent for athletics from a very young age.
examples.zh: 她從很小的時候就展現出了在田徑與體育運動方面的過人天賦。

examples.en: The university athletic department allocates scholarships to support collegiate athletics.
examples.zh: 該大學體育室特別提撥專款獎學金，大力支持大專校院各項體育競賽。

explains.en: This is a group of sports that includes running, jumping, and throwing. People train their bodies to do these events. Competitions may take place on a track.
A school may offer these sports as an activity. Students practice skills such as long jumps and races. They learn to follow rules and encourage teammates.
Some events test how fast or far a person can move. Athletes prepare with practice and rest. Coaches help them train safely.

examples.en: Regular class attendance is factored into your final semester grade.
examples.zh: 平常課堂出席率會計入您的學期總成績。

examples.en: Overall attendance at the annual technology exhibition set a new record.
examples.zh: 年度科技博覽會的整體參觀出席人數創下了嶄新歷史紀錄。

examples.en: The teacher calls roll every morning to take daily student attendance.
examples.zh: 老師每天早晨點名以確實記錄學生的每日出勤狀況。

explains.en: This is the act or number of people who are present at a place or event. A teacher may mark who came to class. The record helps track participation.
A concert may have many people in the audience. Workers count visitors to learn how popular the event was. The number can help with planning.
A student who comes to school regularly has good participation. Families can tell the school when a student must stay home. Clear records help.

examples.en: We found an old toy in the attic.
examples.zh: 我們在閣樓裡找到一個舊玩具。

examples.en: The attic has a small window above the stairs.
examples.zh: 樓梯上方的閣樓有一扇小窗。

examples.en: Dad stores holiday decorations in the attic.
examples.zh: 爸爸把節慶裝飾品收在閣樓裡。

explains.en: This is the space just under the roof of a house. Families may store boxes there. A small window can let in light.
The room may have sloped ceilings because it is beneath the roof. People sometimes turn it into a bedroom or play area. Good stairs make it easier to reach.
Old decorations and family objects may be kept in this space. It can get dusty, so people clean it carefully. A sturdy floor is important.

examples.en: Consult with a qualified corporate attorney before signing international joint ventures.
examples.zh: 在簽署跨國合資企業合約前，請先諮詢合格專業的企業商務律師。

examples.en: The defense attorney delivered a passionate closing argument to convince the jurors.
examples.zh: 刑事辯護律師在法庭上發表了一段慷慨激昂、邏輯縝密的結案陳詞，極力說服全體陪審員相信被告。

examples.en: She granted her trusted elder brother full power of attorney to manage her financial assets.
examples.zh: 她在出國定居前正式簽署了法律授權書，全權委託深得她信賴的兄長作為法定代理人代為處分資產。

explains.en: This is a lawyer who can give legal help or represent someone. The person studies laws and court procedures. Clients can ask questions about their case.
A person may hire this professional to prepare papers or speak in court. The professional must follow legal rules. Clear facts help explain a case.
Some people have a legal representative who can make certain decisions for them. The role depends on the law and the person’s needs. The person must act in the client’s interest.

examples.en: The coach attributed the win to the team’s hard work.
examples.zh: 教練把勝利歸功於全隊的努力。

examples.en: The tag attributes the painting to a local artist.
examples.zh: 標籤把這幅畫的作者標示為一位當地藝術家。

examples.en: She attributes her good grades to regular study.
examples.zh: 她把好成績歸功於定期讀書。

entries.definition: （動）把……歸因於；認為……是某人所作

explains.en: This means to say that a feature or quality belongs to a person or thing. A story may give a character great courage. The quality shapes how the character acts.
A person can say that a success happened because of practice. They give credit to the effort that helped. Others may have helped too.
A label can name the features of an object. A museum card may list its age and material. The details help visitors understand it.

examples.en: The old vase sold at an auction.
examples.zh: 那只舊花瓶在拍賣會上售出。

examples.en: They auctioned the bicycle to raise money for the club.
examples.zh: 他們拍賣腳踏車，為社團募款。

examples.en: Many people placed bids at the charity auction.
examples.zh: 許多人在慈善拍賣會上出價。

entries.definition: （名）拍賣；（動）拍賣；讓買家出價競爭，通常由最高出價者得標。

explains.en: This is a public sale where people offer different prices for an item. The person who offers the highest price may buy it. The sale has clear rules.
A rare painting or old object may be sold this way. Interested buyers can raise their offers. The seller chooses when to end the sale.
The word can also be a verb meaning to sell through this kind of event. An auctioneer calls out the prices. Buyers decide how much they will pay.

examples.en: The principal authorized the class to visit the museum.
examples.zh: 校長批准全班參觀博物館。

examples.en: Only a manager can authorize a refund.
examples.zh: 只有經理可以核准退款。

examples.en: Her parents authorized the school trip.
examples.zh: 她的父母同意了校外教學。

explains.en: This means to give official permission for an action. A parent may let a child join a school trip. The teacher checks the form.
A manager can allow a worker to use a room or tool. Clear rules explain what is permitted. Asking first shows respect.
A group may formally approve a plan. Members review it before agreeing. A written record can show the decision.

examples.en: Achieving financial autonomy frees individuals to pursue creative passions without monetary anxiety.
examples.zh: 達成財務自主與被動收入獨立（Financial Autonomy），能讓每個人無後顧之憂地全心追尋內心真正熱愛的夢想。

examples.en: Decentralized software teams enjoy high levels of project autonomy, allowing members to innovate freely.
examples.zh: 跨國遠距軟體開發小組享有極高度的專案執行自主權，讓每位工程師皆能在不受過度干預下自由揮灑創新創意。

examples.en: The remote territory fought for decades to achieve political autonomy and self-governance.
examples.zh: 這處偏遠島嶼地區的自治代表經過數十年和平抗爭與公民投票，終於爭取到了合憲的地方自治與決策權。

examples.en: Respecting seniors' autonomy means letting them choose their daily menus, clothing, and activity schedules.
examples.zh: 由衷尊重長輩的個人自主權，意味著鼓勵他們自行決定每日穿搭、餐點菜色與休閒活動。

examples.en: Students at progressive universities enjoy substantial academic autonomy to customize their course curricula.
examples.zh: 開明多元的大學學生享有高度的學術選課自主權，能自由規劃並客製化跨領域專題課程。

examples.en: Preserving personal autonomy in old age strengthens one's sense of self-worth and emotional well-being.
examples.zh: 在高齡歲月裡保有生活自主與掌控權，能極大地強化個人的自我價值認同與心理幸福感。

examples.en: Onboard edge AI autonomy enabled the spacecraft to identify safe hazard-free landing spots in real time.
examples.zh: 強大的機載「邊緣 AI 自主決策系統」（Autonomy），讓太空船能在數秒內自主辨識並降落在毫無障礙的安全平原。

examples.en: University students learn to manage their study schedules and finances with maturity, embracing personal autonomy.
examples.zh: 大學新鮮人學會成熟獨立自主地安排個人作息、讀書進度與生活開銷預算，欣然擁抱完全屬於自己的獨立自主性。

examples.en: Regional tribal councils preserve cultural autonomy to govern local community ancestral territories.
examples.zh: 原住民族部落議會依法享有管理部落傳統領域與自治事務的高度自治權，代代傳承尊嚴與文化命脈。

entries.definition: 財務掌控自主獨立權；自治權；保有自主選擇決定權；自立；擺脫地面控制延遲之探測器機載 AI 自主決策導航能力

explains.en: This is the freedom to make choices and manage one’s own actions. A student may choose which book to read for a project. Guidance can still be helpful.
A community may govern itself and make local decisions. Members discuss rules that affect everyone. Fair participation matters.
A machine that can make choices on its own may use sensors and computer instructions. People still design and check its behavior. Safety is important.

examples.en: Staring out of the submarine viewport into the pitch-black abyss fills human hearts with quiet awe.
examples.zh: 當透過潛水艇觀察窗凝視著窗外無邊無際的漆黑深淵時，每個人的心靈深處都被巨大的震撼與敬畏所填滿。

examples.en: The sheer scale and ancient stillness of the deep sea command respect and profound scientific awe.
examples.zh: 萬米深海那令人屏息的壯闊浩瀚與億萬年不變的永恆沉寂，喚起人類由衷的敬意與深刻的科學敬畏。

examples.en: Divers who witnessed giant bioluminescent siphonophores floated motionless in stunned awe.
examples.zh: 親眼目睹長達數十公尺、全身閃耀冷光的巨型管水母的潛水員們，無不在強烈震撼與由衷敬畏中屏息凝神。

examples.en: Floating quietly beside glowing hydrothermal chimneys fills scientists with profound, humbling awe.
examples.zh: 靜靜懸浮在散發微光的深海熱泉黑煙囪旁，科學家的心靈被大自然的浩瀚與神聖注入了深沉的「敬畏」（Awe）。

examples.en: Gazing at the Milky Way stretching across the pitch-black desert night sky filled the stargazers with awe.
examples.zh: 在伸手不見五指的沙漠暗夜中仰望橫跨天際的浩瀚銀河，觀星愛好者的內心油然而生純粹的震撼敬畏。

examples.en: The Olympic gymnast's flawless balance beam performance awed spectators and international judges alike.
examples.zh: 這位奧運女子體操選手在平衡木上無懈可擊的高難度完美落地，深深震撼了全場觀眾與國際裁判。

entries.definition: 凝望漆黑無垠深淵之極致震撼與敬畏；潛入深淵深處對大自然由衷生起之崇高敬畏；敬畏

explains.en: This is a feeling of wonder mixed with deep respect. A huge waterfall may make visitors stop and stare. They can feel small beside its power.
People may feel this when they see a starry sky or a tall mountain. The scene can seem grand and beautiful. Quiet observation can deepen the feeling.
A person may admire someone’s brave or kind action. Respect grows when people see something remarkable. They may talk about it afterward.

examples.en: The children played tag in the backyard.
examples.zh: 孩子們在後院玩捉迷藏。

examples.en: Mom planted tomatoes in the backyard.
examples.zh: 媽媽在後院種了番茄。

examples.en: Our dog likes to nap in the backyard.
examples.zh: 我們的狗喜歡在後院打盹。

explains.en: This is the open space behind a house. Families may grow flowers or play games there. A fence can mark its edge.
A small garden can have vegetables and fruit trees. People water the plants and pull weeds. Fresh food may come from the garden.
Children may play outside in this space. Adults can set rules to keep them safe. A ball and a patch of grass can provide hours of fun.

examples.en: Stamp your chosen candidate stamp clearly on the paper ballot.
examples.zh: 在紙本選票上清楚蓋上您所選候選人的圈選印章。

examples.en: The secret ballot ensures that no one can pressure how citizens vote.
examples.zh: 無記名秘密投票機制確保沒有任何人能脅迫影響公民的投票意向。

examples.en: Election workers carefully removed ballots from the sealed wooden ballot box.
examples.zh: 選務工作人員小心翼翼地將選票自封緘完整的票箱中逐張取出。

explains.en: This is a piece of paper or a choice used in an election. A voter marks one option in private. The collected papers help show what people chose.
People may use a secret process to choose a leader or decide an issue. Each person gets one chance to choose. Fair rules protect the process.
A group can count the choices after everyone has finished. The result tells which option received the most support. Observers can help make the count fair.

examples.en: The channel automated bot banned toxic users who violated community rules.
examples.zh: 頻道智慧管理機器人會自動對惡意違規侮辱他人的酸民帳號祭出永久封鎖禁言。

examples.en: The government placed a total ban on the sale of single-use plastic bags.
examples.zh: 政府全面實施了禁止販售一次性塑膠提袋的法令禁令。

examples.en: He received a temporary chat ban for posting repetitive advertisements.
examples.zh: 他因為在聊天室中重複張貼廣告連結，而遭到了暫時禁言的懲罰。

explains.en: This is an official rule that does not allow something. A school may forbid running near the swimming pool. The rule helps prevent accidents.
A group may decide that an item cannot be brought into a place. Signs can explain what is not allowed. Visitors should follow the rule.
As a verb, it means to officially stop an action. A town may stop cars from using a damaged road. Clear notices help people choose another way.

examples.en: A red banner hung above the school entrance.
examples.zh: 學校入口上方掛著一面紅色橫幅。

examples.en: The website displayed a colorful banner for the festival.
examples.zh: 網站展示了色彩繽紛的節慶橫幅。

examples.en: The team carried a banner through the parade.
examples.zh: 隊伍帶著一面橫幅穿過遊行隊伍。

explains.en: This is a long piece of cloth with a picture or words on it. It may hang outside a building. People can see it from far away.
A website may show a wide picture at the top of a page. It can include the name of a group or event. The image catches a visitor’s attention.
A large sign may carry a message during a parade. Bright colors make the words easy to read. People can carry it above the crowd.

examples.en: The barren field had almost no green plants.
examples.zh: 貧瘠的田地幾乎沒有綠色植物。

examples.en: After the fire, the hillside looked barren.
examples.zh: 火災過後，山坡看起來一片荒蕪。

examples.en: The barren ground could not support many crops.
examples.zh: 那片貧瘠的土地無法養活許多作物。

entries.definition: （形）貧瘠的、荒蕪的；缺少植物、資源或生產能力的。

explains.en: This describes land that is dry and has little plant life. Few trees may grow there. The soil may be too poor for crops.
A place without water or useful resources can be difficult to live in. Plants and animals may struggle. People need to find safe supplies.
The word can describe a person who cannot have children. This is a medical condition. A health professional can explain it with care and respect.

examples.en: The bakery made a batch of fresh rolls this morning.
examples.zh: 麵包店今天早上烤了一批新鮮餐包。

examples.en: We checked the first batch of forms for mistakes.
examples.zh: 我們檢查第一批表格有沒有錯誤。

examples.en: She baked one batch of cookies for the class.
examples.zh: 她烤了一批餅乾給全班吃。

explains.en: This is a group of items made or handled at one time. A baker may prepare many cookies together. They are cooked in the same round of work.
A set of letters or numbers can be processed together by a computer. The machine follows the same steps for each item. Grouping work can save time.
A short period of work may be followed by a rest. Workers complete one group of tasks before starting another. Planning helps keep the work organized.

examples.en: She accepted the award on behalf of her team.
examples.zh: 她代表隊伍接受了獎項。

examples.en: I am calling on behalf of my mother.
examples.zh: 我代表媽媽打電話。

examples.en: He collected the package on behalf of his neighbor.
examples.zh: 他代表鄰居領取包裹。

entries.definition: （名）代表；為了某人；為某團體利益

explains.en: This phrase means acting for another person or group. A student may speak for a team at a meeting. The team’s ideas are shared through that person.
A helper may pick up medicine for a family member. They carry out the task with permission. Clear instructions help them do it correctly.
A person can write a thank-you note for someone else. The note explains who asked for it. The writer should share the message honestly.

examples.en: The guests left their belongings in the coatroom.
examples.zh: 客人把個人物品留在衣帽間。

examples.en: Please keep your belongings close while traveling.
examples.zh: 旅行時請把個人物品放在身邊。

examples.en: She packed her belongings before moving to a new home.
examples.zh: 搬到新家前，她打包了個人物品。

explains.en: These are the personal things that someone owns. A traveler may pack clothes, books, and a toothbrush. Keeping them together helps prevent loss.
A person may carry small items in a bag. Labels can help identify who they belong to. It is polite to ask before touching them.
When someone moves, they sort their things into boxes. Some items can be donated or kept. A list helps track what is packed.

examples.en: The beloved teacher was remembered by many students.
examples.zh: 許多學生都記得那位深受喜愛的老師。

examples.en: Her beloved dog followed her everywhere.
examples.zh: 她心愛的狗總是跟在她身邊。

examples.en: The town held a party for its beloved coach.
examples.zh: 鎮上為深受喜愛的教練舉辦派對。

entries.definition: （形）深愛的、深受喜愛的；（名）摯愛的人，受到珍惜。

explains.en: This describes someone who is deeply loved. A grandparent may be very dear to a child. The child enjoys hearing family stories.
A person may have a special place in many people’s hearts. Friends remember their kindness. They can celebrate that person’s life.
A favorite object or place can be cherished for a long time. It may remind someone of happy moments. Careful keeping shows its value.

examples.en: Organic farmers release beneficial insects like ladybugs to consume harmful aphid colonies.
examples.zh: 有機果農在園區野放瓢蟲與草蛉等天敵益蟲，利用大自然食物鏈天然剋制惱人的蚜蟲害。

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise delivers beneficial effects for cardiovascular health and longevity.
examples.zh: 每週規律進行有氧耐力運動，對促進心血管健康循環與延年益壽有著不可估量的有益助益。

examples.en: Gentle summer showers proved highly beneficial to newly sprouted corn seedlings.
examples.zh: 仲夏午後降下的一場及時甘霖微雨，對剛剛破土萌芽的鮮綠玉米幼苗帶來了極大的滋養。

explains.en: This describes something that helps or improves a situation. Eating fruit can be good for the body. A balanced diet supports health.
A change may help a community. Planting trees gives shade and homes to birds. People can enjoy the greener streets.
A habit can make learning easier. Reading every day helps a student meet new words. Small practice adds up over time.

examples.en: He betrayed his friend by revealing the secret.
examples.zh: 他洩露秘密，背叛了朋友。

examples.en: The soldier refused to betray the people he protected.
examples.zh: 那名士兵不肯背叛自己保護的人。

examples.en: She felt hurt when her teammate betrayed her trust.
examples.zh: 隊友辜負了她的信任，讓她很受傷。

entries.definition: 背叛；出賣；辜負；無意中顯露。

explains.en: This means to be disloyal or to break someone’s trust. A friend may share a secret after promising not to. The other person can feel hurt.
A character in a story may turn against a trusted group. Their choice can surprise everyone. The story may show why they did it.
A person can break trust by lying or hiding important facts. Honest words can help repair a friendship. Making amends may take time.

examples.en: Beware of the wet floor near the door.
examples.zh: 小心門邊的濕滑地板。

examples.en: The guide told us to beware of loose stones.
examples.zh: 導遊提醒我們小心鬆動的石頭。

examples.en: Beware: the dog needs space while it eats.
examples.zh: 小心：狗吃東西時需要空間。

explains.en: This is a warning to stay careful around something risky. A sign may tell hikers to watch out for loose rocks. They should walk slowly.
People should pay attention when a situation seems unsafe. Asking an adult can help them decide what to do. Caution can prevent harm.
A wild animal may need space. Visitors should not feed or touch it. Signs can explain how to stay safe nearby.

examples.en: Readers should recognize political bias when consuming partisan news commentary.
examples.zh: 閱聽大眾在收看立場鮮明的政論節目時，應具備辨識黨派政治偏頗立場的能力。

examples.en: Confirmation bias leads individuals to only accept information that supports their views.
examples.zh: 確認偏誤會讓人們只願意接受那些印證自身既有觀點的資訊。

examples.en: The judge stepped down to avoid any perception of racial or personal bias.
examples.zh: 該法官主動迴避審判，以避免引發任何種族或個人偏見的質疑。

examples.en: Confirmation bias leads internet users to only read news articles matching their pre-existing beliefs.
examples.zh: 「確認偏誤」（Confirmation Bias）促使網友往往只熱衷點閱符合自身既定政治立場的文章，強化盲點。

examples.en: Judges take a solemn oath to preside over courtroom proceedings fairly without personal bias or prejudice.
examples.zh: 法官在就職時莊嚴宣誓，誓言在法庭審理案件過程中秉持客觀超然，絕不受個人任何主觀偏見左右。

examples.en: Artificial intelligence training datasets must be carefully audited to prevent algorithmic gender and racial bias.
examples.zh: 人工智慧訓練資料庫必須經過嚴密的獨立資安與倫理審查，以徹底消除演算法潛藏的性別與種族偏誤。

entries.definition: 偏見；偏頗立場；成見；認知偏誤；確認偏誤

explains.en: This is an unfair preference for one side or person. A judge should treat each team by the same rules. Fair choices help people trust the result.
A person may judge someone before learning the facts. Meeting and listening can correct a mistaken idea. Everyone deserves a fair chance.
A survey question can push people toward one answer. Neutral wording helps gather more honest opinions. Careful design makes results more useful.

examples.en: She made a bid for the last seat at the table.
examples.zh: 她為了餐桌旁最後一個座位出價。

examples.en: The company bid to build the new bridge.
examples.zh: 那家公司投標興建新橋。

examples.en: He bid ten dollars for the old book.
examples.zh: 他為那本舊書出價十美元。

entries.definition: （名）出價；努力爭取；（動）投標；出價

explains.en: This is an offer of money for something that will be sold. A person may offer more than others for a painting. The seller can choose the highest offer.
A person may try to get a job or contract by promising to do the work for a price. The buyer compares offers. Clear terms help both sides.
The verb can mean to try to do something or make an offer. A child may try to help carry a box. The effort shows willingness.

examples.en: Biological pest control replaces chemical pesticides, preserving beneficial honeybee populations.
examples.zh: 採用天敵與性費洛蒙誘捕等生物防治法取代劇毒農藥，能保護辛勤授粉的野生蜜蜂族群。

examples.en: Students observed the intricate biological life cycle of silkworms in science class.
examples.zh: 國小自然科學課堂上，學童們透過放大鏡聚精會神觀察蠶寶寶神奇完整的生物生命週期變態。

examples.en: Biological washing powders contain active natural enzymes that break down stubborn protein stains.
examples.zh: 生物酵素洗衣精蘊含高活性天然蛋白酵素，能以溫和方式徹底分解衣物上的頑固血漬汗斑。

explains.en: This describes something connected with living things and how they grow. Plants, animals, and tiny germs are all alive. Scientists study their parts and actions.
Some small insects eat other insects that damage garden plants. This method uses one living thing to control another. Farmers may use it to protect their crops.
A person may learn about how living things are related. They can study cells, habitats, and inherited traits. Careful observation is useful.

examples.en: The bizarre hat made everyone smile.
examples.zh: 那頂奇怪的帽子讓大家笑了。

examples.en: We heard a bizarre noise from the old machine.
examples.zh: 我們聽到老機器發出奇怪的聲音。

examples.en: The story had a bizarre ending that surprised me.
examples.zh: 故事有個古怪的結局，讓我很驚訝。

entries.definition: （形）奇異的、古怪的；非常不尋常，令人感到驚訝或難以理解。

explains.en: This describes something very strange or unusual. A fish with glowing spots may seem surprising. People may want to learn why it looks that way.
A story can include an event that is hard to explain. Readers may wonder whether it is real or make-believe. A surprising detail can make a tale exciting.
An unusual outfit may attract attention. People have different tastes in clothing. Kind comments are better than teasing.

examples.en: Blow three loud blasts on your emergency whistle to signal international distress.
examples.zh: 用力吹響隨身攜帶的高音救生哨發出「短吹三聲」長鳴，是全體搜救人員皆懂的國際求救信號。

examples.en: A sudden freezing blast of Arctic wind shook the alpine tents violently throughout the night.
examples.zh: 一陣突如其來的極地刺骨狂風呼嘯而過，整夜劇烈搖撼著高山露營營地上搭設的帳篷。

examples.en: Controlled dynamite blasts helped engineers carve the highway tunnel through solid granite mountains.
examples.zh: 精準定向的炸藥控制爆破工程，協助工程團隊在堅不可摧的堅硬花崗岩山體深處開鑿出公路隧道。

entries.definition: 哨子短促響亮的長鳴吹奏；爆炸

explains.en: This can mean a sudden loud explosion. A firework makes a bright flash and a loud sound in the sky. People should watch from a safe place.
A strong gust of air can make a loud noise as it passes. A door may shake when the wind hits it. The sound can startle people.
The verb can mean to make something explode or strike with great force. Stories may describe a sudden burst of light. Real explosives are dangerous.

examples.en: Rain blurred the writing on the paper.
examples.zh: 雨水模糊了紙上的字跡。

examples.en: The photo was a blur because the camera moved.
examples.zh: 相機移動，讓照片變得模糊。

examples.en: Tears blurred her view of the page.
examples.zh: 淚水模糊了她看書頁的視線。

entries.definition: （動）使模糊；變模糊；（名）模糊不清。

explains.en: This means to make an image unclear or out of focus. Moving a camera too quickly can hide small details. Holding it still may help.
A person may find it hard to see clearly after rubbing their eyes. Resting can help their eyes feel better. They should tell an adult if it continues.
A line of ink can run when paper gets wet. The letters then become hard to read. Keeping the page dry protects the writing.

examples.en: She blushed when the class sang happy birthday to her.
examples.zh: 全班為她唱生日快樂歌時，她害羞得臉紅了。

examples.en: He blushed after making a small mistake.
examples.zh: 他犯了一個小錯後臉紅了。

examples.en: My cheeks blush in the cold wind.
examples.zh: 冷風吹來時，我的臉頰會泛紅。

explains.en: This means to turn red in the face, often because someone feels shy or embarrassed. A compliment may make a person feel warm. They might look down.
Strong heat or exercise can make cheeks turn red. A person should rest if they feel unwell. Drinking water can help after activity.
A ripe fruit may have a red outer skin. Color can show that it is ready to eat. People check fruit before choosing it.

examples.en: The bodyguard walked beside the singer.
examples.zh: 那名保鑣走在歌手身旁。

examples.en: A bodyguard checked the entrance before the event.
examples.zh: 活動開始前，保鑣檢查了入口。

examples.en: The actor thanked his bodyguard for staying nearby.
examples.zh: 演員感謝保鑣一直在附近保護他。

explains.en: This is a person whose job is to protect someone. A guard may walk beside a public figure in a crowd. The guard watches for danger.
A person with this job may check a doorway or travel route. Careful planning helps keep people safe. The worker follows clear rules.
Some stories include a protector who stays close to a king or hero. The character may be brave and alert. The role is to help prevent harm.

examples.en: Please tighten the bolt on the chair.
examples.zh: 請把椅子上的螺栓鎖緊。

examples.en: The gate has a bolt that slides into place.
examples.zh: 門閂可以滑進定位，固定大門。

examples.en: The rabbit bolted into its burrow when it heard a sound.
examples.zh: 兔子聽到聲音後，立刻衝進洞穴。

entries.definition: （名）螺栓、門閂；（動）用螺栓固定；也可指突然奔跑。

explains.en: This is a metal fastener with a rounded head and a threaded end. It can join pieces of wood or metal. A tool helps turn it tightly.
A small sliding bar can keep a door closed. Moving it across the frame secures the door. A person can pull it back to open the door.
The verb can mean to move away suddenly. A frightened horse may run from a loud noise. People should stay clear and calm.

examples.en: Tech employees rejoiced over generous year-end performance bonuses.
examples.zh: 科技業員工為領到豐厚的年終績效獎金而雀躍不已。

examples.en: The sales executive earned a lucrative quarterly commission bonus for breaking targets.
examples.zh: 業務經理因超額達成季度業績指標，領取了一筆極為豐厚可觀的季度分紅抽成獎金。

examples.en: As an added bonus, the boutique hotel offers all guests complimentary afternoon tea.
examples.zh: 作為一項令人驚喜的額外貼心款待，這家精品設計酒店為所有房客提供免費精緻下午茶。

explains.en: This is an extra reward added to what someone already receives. A worker may get extra pay for doing a good job. A game may give players an extra point.
A shop may include an additional item with a purchase. The gift can make the customer happy. It is separate from the main product.
A person can receive something extra for a special reason. A school may give a prize for excellent work. The reward encourages effort.

examples.en: The sound engineer operated a carbon-fiber boom mic just outside the camera frame.
examples.zh: 現場收音師熟練高舉超長碳纖維錄音吊桿麥克風，精準懸停於攝影機畫面邊緣上方收音。

examples.en: The boom operator must have exceptional shoulder strength to hold the microphone steady for long takes.
examples.zh: 吊桿麥克風操作員必須具備驚人的肩臂肌耐力，才能在長鏡頭一鏡到底時全程穩如泰山。

examples.en: Taiwan's semiconductor industry experienced an unprecedented global export boom in recent years.
examples.zh: 台灣高階半導體晶圓代工與先進封裝產業在近年迎來了前所未有的全球外銷出口繁榮大爆發。

examples.en: Streamlined train noses combined with entrance hoods completely eliminate loud tunnel sonic boom noise.
examples.zh: 流線型車頭設計搭配減壓洞門，徹底消除了列車高速穿出隧道時引發的「微氣壓波音爆」（Sonic Boom）。

examples.en: The seaside resort town experienced an unprecedented tourism boom after hosting the international surf festival.
examples.zh: 這座美麗的濱海度假小鎮在主辦國際衝浪節後，迎來了一場前所未有的觀光旅遊大繁榮。

examples.en: Fighter jets exceeding supersonic speed generate a thunderous sonic boom heard for miles around.
examples.zh: 超音速噴射戰鬥機在低空突破音障瞬間，會產生震耳欲聾的巨大音爆巨響，數英里外清晰可聞。

entries.definition: 錄音吊桿 (Boom Mic)；繁榮激增；列車高速衝入洞口產生之微氣壓波音爆消除；隆隆聲

explains.en: This can be a deep, loud sound. Thunder may make a low rumble during a storm. The sound can seem to shake windows.
It can describe a time when business or activity grows quickly. A town may get many new jobs. More people come to live and work there.
A long pole can hold a microphone above actors or speakers. A helper moves it quietly to capture sound. The pole stays outside the camera view.

examples.en: The kind note boosted her confidence.
examples.zh: 那張親切的便條增強了她的信心。

examples.en: The new road boosted business in the town.
examples.zh: 新道路促進了鎮上的商業活動。

examples.en: A short walk can boost your energy.
examples.zh: 散步一小段可以讓你恢復活力。

entries.definition: （動）提升；促進；增加；（名）推動；增加。

explains.en: This means to help something grow, rise, or become stronger. A good night’s sleep can help a tired person feel more energetic. Rest supports the body.
A coach may encourage a player after a mistake. Kind words can help the player try again. Practice can improve confidence.
A machine can push air or water with greater force. A fan moves air through a room. Adjusting its speed changes the amount.

examples.en: A lighted desktop spray booth with high-velocity exhaust fans evacuates toxic paint fumes safely outdoors.
examples.zh: 配備高風速排氣風扇與 LED 照明的桌上型噴漆箱，將有害漆霧安全抽出窗外。
