examples.en: Visitors queued up outside the exhibition booth to try the new virtual reality gaming demo.
examples.zh: 參觀展覽的熱情民眾在科技大廠的展覽攤位前大排長龍，爭相搶先體驗最新發表的虛擬實境遊戲。

examples.en: She stepped into the soundproof recording booth to lay down voiceover tracks for the commercial.
examples.zh: 她緩步走進專業隔音錄音間配音室，在安靜無噪的環境中為即將上映的電視商業廣告錄製旁白。

entries.definition: 水簾抽風排氣模型噴漆箱

explains.en: This is a small enclosed space for one person or a few people. A worker may sit inside to sell tickets. A curtain or door gives privacy.
A fair may have a little stand where people play a game or buy snacks. Bright signs help visitors find it. Workers keep the area tidy. Workers keep the area tidy.
A phone call can take place in a soundproof space at a station. The closed walls make it easier to hear. People can talk privately.

examples.en: The long wait caused boredom for the children.
examples.zh: 漫長的等待讓孩子們感到無聊。

examples.en: She read a book to fight boredom on the bus.
examples.zh: 她在公車上看書來打發無聊時間。

examples.en: Boredom made him start drawing pictures.
examples.zh: 無聊時，他開始畫圖。

explains.en: This is the feeling of having nothing interesting to do. Waiting a long time without a game can feel dull. Finding a safe activity can help.
A person may feel restless during a repeated task. Taking a short break can refresh them. Changing the activity may make it more fun.
People can prevent this feeling by choosing a book, puzzle, or outdoor game. Sharing an activity with a friend can make time pass. They may enjoy it more together.

examples.en: The dog was bound to the tree with a soft lead.
examples.zh: 狗用柔軟的牽繩繫在樹旁。

examples.en: We are bound to see our cousins during the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期期間，我們一定會見到表親。

examples.en: She felt bound by her promise to help.
examples.zh: 她覺得自己有義務履行幫忙的承諾。

entries.definition: （動）綁住；跳躍；很可能；（名）跳躍；界限

explains.en: This describes something attached with a knot or fastener. A package can be tied with string. The knot keeps it closed.
It can describe a person who is sure to do something. Dark clouds may mean rain is likely to come. People can bring an umbrella.
A person may have a duty to do a task. A promise can make someone responsible for finishing it. Clear plans help.

examples.en: Setting clear personal boundaries prevents burnout from excessive commitments.
examples.zh: 學會劃定清晰堅定的人際心理界線，能防止因過度承攬過多請求而心力交瘁。

examples.en: Rivers often serve as the natural geographic boundary between neighboring countries.
examples.zh: 奔流的江河常常成為相鄰國境之間天然的地理界線。

examples.en: Healthy professional boundaries mean not answering non-urgent work emails past midnight.
examples.zh: 健全的職場邊界感意味著在午夜過後不再回覆非緊急的工作電子郵件。

examples.en: Spatial headsets dissolve the boundary between physical atoms and digital bits forever.
examples.zh: 空間運算頭戴設備，永遠消弭了「實體原子物理世界與數位位元世界之間的邊界」（Boundary）。

examples.en: Surveyors erected concrete boundary markers to clearly delineate the edge of the national park reserve.
examples.zh: 土地測量員設立混凝土界樁，以明確劃定國家自然公園保護區的外圍邊界線。

examples.en: Maintaining a healthy boundary between professional duty and family life is crucial for mental well-being.
examples.zh: 在職場工作職責與家庭私人生活之間維持健康的界線，對於心理健康至關重要。

entries.definition: 人際心理界線；邊界；徹底打破物理空間與數位資訊的隔閡邊界

explains.en: This is a line that marks where one area ends and another begins. A fence may show the edge of a garden. It helps people know where not to walk.
A map may draw a line between two towns or countries. The line helps travelers see which area they are in. It can also show where someone must follow different rules.
People may set personal limits about privacy or time. Others should respect those limits. Clear words can help explain them.

examples.en: The boxer trained carefully before the match.
examples.zh: 那位拳擊手在比賽前仔細訓練。

examples.en: A boxer dog wagged its tail at the park.
examples.zh: 一隻拳師犬在公園搖著尾巴。

examples.en: The young boxer practiced footwork with a coach.
examples.zh: 年輕拳擊手跟教練練習步法。

entries.definition: （名）拳擊手；參加拳擊運動的人。

explains.en: This is an athlete who takes part in a sport where opponents punch with padded gloves. The athletes follow rules and wear protective gear. A referee watches closely.
Some dogs belong to a breed with a short muzzle and strong body. People care for them with exercise and attention. Each dog has its own personality.
The athlete practices footwork and defense. Training helps improve skill and fitness. Safety rules are important during a match.

examples.en: Constructive late-night talks achieved a historic diplomatic breakthrough.
examples.zh: 建設性的深夜閉門會談最終促成了一項極具里程碑意義的重大外交突破。

examples.en: Scientists announced a breakthrough in solar cell efficiency that lowers costs.
examples.zh: 科學家宣布了太陽能電池發電效率上的重大突破，大幅降低了成本。

examples.en: Perseverance is often required right before an engineer reaches an inventive breakthrough.
examples.zh: 在工程師達成發明上的關鍵重大突破之前，往往需要堅持不懈的毅力。

examples.en: The novel cancer drug was granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation by international drug regulators.
examples.zh: 該款針對罕見實體腫瘤的原創新藥，憑藉前所未見的顯著療效榮獲美國 FDA 頒發「突破性治療資格認定」。

examples.en: Scientists celebrated a major scientific breakthrough after synthesizing functional artificial chloroplasts.
examples.zh: 當科學家在實驗室中成功人工合成出具備完整光合作用機能的人工葉綠體時，全體研發同仁歡欣鼓舞熱烈慶祝。

examples.en: Continuous trial and error in the laboratory paved the way for this historic clinical breakthrough.
examples.zh: 在陰暗實驗室中經歷數千次失敗挫折與無悔嘗試，終於為這項改寫癌症治療史的歷史性臨床突破鋪平了道路。

examples.en: Achieving room-temperature quantum coherence would represent a Nobel Prize-worthy scientific breakthrough.
examples.zh: 一旦成功在常溫下實現長時間量子相干，將是足以斬獲諾貝爾獎、改寫人類文明的歷史性重大突破。

examples.en: The research consortium announced a technological breakthrough in suppressing phase noise inside silicon qubits.
examples.zh: 跨國前沿聯合研究團隊正式對外宣布，在抑制矽自旋量子位元相位雜訊上取得了突破性科技進展。

examples.en: Every engineering breakthrough in cryogenic microelectronics brings commercial quantum computing a step closer.
examples.zh: 極低溫微電子控制晶片的每一次工程重大突破，都讓通用型商業量子電腦的到來更向前邁進一大步。

examples.en: Granting breakthrough therapy designation expedited international regulatory review timelines.
examples.zh: 獲得官方授予「突破性療法資格認證」（Breakthrough Designation），大幅縮短了跨國新藥審查上市的漫長時程。

examples.en: Developing solid-state battery cells represents a monumental technological breakthrough for electric mobility.
examples.zh: 成功研發出全固態鋰電池技術，代表了全球電動車產業與綠色交通領域一場劃時代的重大技術突破。

examples.en: Archaeologists made a stunning breakthrough when they uncovered an undisturbed subterranean tomb chamber.
examples.zh: 考古學考察隊在古城遺址挖掘出一座未遭任何盜掘破壞的宏偉地下墓室，迎來了震驚考古界的重大突破。

examples.en: Nanometer optical manufacturing represents a pivotal breakthrough enabling lightweight smart glasses.
examples.zh: 奈米級光學微影技術的「歷史性重大突破」（Breakthrough），讓輕巧時尚的日常智慧眼鏡即將成為現實。

examples.en: Medical researchers hailed the discovery of this novel targeted antibody as a monumental cancer breakthrough.
examples.zh: 醫學研究人員讚譽這款新型標靶抗體的發現，是現代癌症治療史上的劃時代突破。

examples.en: After weeks of stalled bargaining, negotiators achieved a breakthrough in cross-strait trade talks.
examples.zh: 經過數週停滯不前的艱辛談判，雙方談判代表終於在跨國貿易協商中取得了關鍵突破。

examples.en: Developing climate-resilient synthetic crops marks a historic agricultural breakthrough for global food security.
examples.zh: 培育出抗極端氣候的合成生物農作物，標誌著捍衛全球糧食安全的一項「歷史性重大突破」（Breakthrough）。

examples.en: Medical oncologists cheered the landmark drug discovery as a revolutionary clinical cancer breakthrough.
examples.zh: 腫瘤臨床專科醫師齊聲熱烈讚譽這項劃時代的新藥研發成果，視其為人類對抗癌症史上的革命性突破。

examples.en: Diplomatic envoys achieved a long-awaited breakthrough during peace talks, signing a border disarmament pact.
examples.zh: 各國外交特使在和平談判桌上取得了眾所期盼的關鍵性外交突破，正式簽署了邊境非軍事化裁軍條約。

examples.en: Chip-scale atomic clocks represent a massive hardware breakthrough, fitting ultra-stable timekeeping onto a silicon die.
examples.zh: 「晶片級微型原子鐘」（Chip-Scale Atomic Clock）的重大突破，將原本大型儀器縮小至單一矽晶片上。

examples.en: The biomedical startup announced a major clinical breakthrough in non-invasive early Alzheimer's screening.
examples.zh: 這家生醫新創團隊正式對外宣布，在非侵入性早期阿茲海默症血液檢測領域取得了劃時代的臨床科研突破。

examples.en: After years of diplomatic deadlock, negotiators achieved a decisive breakthrough on carbon tariff standards.
examples.zh: 歷經多年的國際外交對峙與多輪艱難折衝，各國談判代表終於在跨國碳關稅認定標準上達成了決定性重大突破。

examples.en: Overcoming your fear of speaking represents a monumental cognitive breakthrough in your journey.
examples.zh: 克服開口恐懼並享受對話，是你在這趟英語旅程中迎來的「重大心智突破」（Breakthrough）。

examples.en: Scientists announced an unprecedented medical breakthrough that could cure several rare genetic disorders.
examples.zh: 科學家宣布了一項前所未有的醫學突破，有望治癒數種罕見的遺傳性疾病。

examples.en: Watching foreign movies without subtitles was an exhilarating linguistic breakthrough for her.
examples.zh: 能在不依賴字幕的情況下看懂外語原聲電影，對她而言是一次令人興奮的語言大突破。

entries.definition: 重大突破；轉機；重大進展；突破性治療資格認定；顛覆人類文明之物理科學重大突破；獲官方認可之癌症突破性療法資格；微型顯示器與全像光學波導歷史性重大突破；解決全球糧食與抗癌難題之生物學歷史性重大突破；晶片級微型銫原子鐘歷史性重大科技突破；突破；突破自我語言天花板之重大認知躍進

explains.en: This is an important new discovery or advance that solves a difficult problem. Scientists may find a better way to clean dirty water. The improvement can help many people.
A person may suddenly find a way to move past a hard obstacle. The new idea changes what they can do. Practice and teamwork can help.
In a story, a team may uncover a clue that changes the whole case. Their discovery points to a solution. The characters can make progress.

examples.en: Dad packed his papers in a briefcase.
examples.zh: 爸爸把文件裝進公事包。

examples.en: The lawyer carried a briefcase into the office.
examples.zh: 律師提著公事包走進辦公室。

examples.en: She set her briefcase beside the desk.
examples.zh: 她把公事包放在桌旁。

explains.en: This is a flat case with a handle used to carry papers or a computer. A worker may bring it to a meeting. It helps keep important items together.
A student can use this case to carry notebooks and pencils. Pockets help sort supplies. The handle makes it easy to hold.
The case may close with a clasp or zipper. Keeping it shut protects the contents. A label can help identify its owner.

examples.en: The Mao Gong Ding features a 500-character ritual inscription cast inside its ancient bronze bowl.
examples.zh: 西周晚期重器「毛公鼎」在青銅鼎腹內壁鑄刻了長達五百字的珍貴銘文，堪稱青銅器銘文之冠。

examples.en: Ritual bronze vessels were symbols of royal authority, sacrifice, and cosmic harmony in early dynasties.
examples.zh: 在商周早期王朝，祭祀青銅禮器代表著至高無上的王權象徵、祭天敬祖與天地宇宙的和諧秩序。

examples.en: Conservators removed thick green patina from the ritual bronze bell using delicate ultrasound tools.
examples.zh: 文物修復團隊運用高精密度超音波精密儀器，極其審慎地清除青銅編鐘表面有害的粉狀銅綠銹蝕。

entries.definition: 青銅禮器；青銅鼎；青銅製的

explains.en: This is a brown metal made by mixing copper with another metal, often tin. People used it long ago to make tools and statues. It is strong and durable.
A medal may have a brownish color like this metal. Athletes can win one for placing third. The award celebrates their effort.
Artists can use this metal to make a bell or sculpture. The object can last a long time. Its color may darken as it ages.

examples.en: I browsed the shelves for a book about space.
examples.zh: 我在書架間瀏覽太空主題的書。

examples.en: She browsed the website before ordering a gift.
examples.zh: 她在下單買禮物前瀏覽了網站。

examples.en: We browsed the market and found fresh peaches.
examples.zh: 我們逛遍市場，找到新鮮桃子。

entries.definition: （動）瀏覽；隨意查看；（名）嫩葉；吃嫩葉

explains.en: This means to look through items or pages without a fixed plan. A person may look at books in a shop until one catches their eye. They can take their time.
A person can visit pages on the internet to find information. Links lead to other places. They should check that sources are trustworthy.
A shopper may look over different products before deciding. Comparing prices and features can help. There is no need to hurry.

examples.en: He had a purple bruise on his arm after soccer.
examples.zh: 踢足球後，他手臂上有一塊紫色瘀青。

examples.en: The bruise faded after several days.
examples.zh: 幾天後，瘀青逐漸消退。

examples.en: She bruised her knee when she fell on the grass.
examples.zh: 她跌在草地上時撞傷了膝蓋。

explains.en: This is a dark mark under the skin after a bump. Small blood vessels may break, making the area change color. It usually fades over time.
A person may get a sore mark after falling or hitting a hard object. Resting the area may help. A trusted adult can check a serious injury.
The verb can mean to cause such a mark. A gentle bump may leave a colored spot. People should be careful during play.

examples.en: Cold bulk fermentation inside a 4°C refrigerator allows lactic acid bacteria to develop deep sourdough complexity.
examples.zh: 在四度低溫冰箱中進行長達二十四小時的冷藏主發酵，讓乳酸菌充分發酵出迷人風味。

examples.en: The baker watches for a fifty percent volume increase to judge when bulk fermentation is finished.
examples.zh: 烘焙師密切觀察麵團膨脹約五成體積的關鍵指標，以精準判斷初次主發酵是否圓滿成熟。

examples.en: Bubbles visible through clear plastic tubs indicate healthy gas production during bulk rise.
examples.zh: 從透明發酵保鮮盒側面觀察到密集的微小氣泡，代表麵團在初發階段產氣旺盛健康。

entries.definition: 24 小時低溫冷藏初次主發酵；體積

explains.en: This means a large amount or size. A large package may be difficult for one person to lift. Two people can carry it safely.
The main part of a crowd can move slowly through a doorway. People should avoid pushing. Wide exits make movement easier.
A shop may sell goods in large quantities rather than small packages. Buyers can share or store the extra items. Planning helps prevent waste.

examples.en: The bully apologized after the teacher spoke with him.
examples.zh: 老師和那名霸凌者談過後，他道了歉。

examples.en: Do not bully a younger student.
examples.zh: 不要欺負年紀較小的學生。

examples.en: A bully tried to scare the new child, but classmates helped.
examples.zh: 一名霸凌者試圖嚇唬新同學，但其他同學出面幫忙。

entries.definition: （名）霸凌者；（動）霸凌；以力量或威脅反覆欺負他人。

explains.en: This is a person who repeatedly frightens or hurts someone weaker. A student may tease or threaten a classmate again and again. The person being hurt should tell a trusted adult.
The verb means to frighten someone into doing something. Threats are not a kind way to solve a problem. Adults can help stop them.
Some dogs of a certain breed are called by this name. Each animal is different, so people should learn safe ways to approach dogs. Owners must act responsibly.

examples.en: She visited the travel bureau to ask about train tickets.
examples.zh: 她到旅行社詢問火車票的資訊。

examples.en: The writing bureau has several small drawers.
examples.zh: 那張有小抽屜的寫字桌可以收納文具。

examples.en: The bureau sent a notice about the new service.
examples.zh: 辦公機構寄出有關新服務的通知。

explains.en: This is an office or agency that provides a service. A travel office may help people plan a trip. Workers answer questions and keep records.
A desk with drawers for papers can have this name. Someone may use it to organize documents. Labels help keep each paper in the right place.
A government office may handle a certain kind of work. People visit it to get information or complete forms. Clear signs help visitors.

examples.en: The new form reduced bureaucracy at the school office.
examples.zh: 新表格減少了學校辦公室的繁瑣行政程序。

examples.en: They waited while the bureaucracy checked the request.
examples.zh: 他們等候行政機關審查這項申請。

examples.en: The club simplified its rules to avoid too much bureaucracy.
examples.zh: 社團簡化規則，避免過多行政程序。

entries.definition: （名）官僚體制；繁瑣行政程序；官僚機構

explains.en: This is a system with many offices and rules for managing a large organization. People may need to fill in forms before a request is approved. Clear steps can help.
A large public service may have many workers with different jobs. Each office handles one part. The system can be slow if steps are unclear.
Rules and records can help an organization treat people fairly. Too many steps may make simple tasks take longer. Good design keeps the process understandable.

examples.en: The family held a burial beside the old church.
examples.zh: 家人在古老教堂旁舉行安葬儀式。

examples.en: Friends brought flowers to the burial.
examples.zh: 朋友們帶花參加安葬儀式。

examples.en: The burial ceremony gave the family time to remember him.
examples.zh: 安葬儀式讓家人有時間緬懷他。

explains.en: This is the act of placing a dead person in the ground or another resting place. Family and friends may gather to remember them. They can share kind stories.
A ceremony may follow the loss of a person. People can offer comfort to the family. Quiet respect is important.
Some communities have special customs for saying goodbye. Families may choose flowers, prayers, or music. Traditions can honor the person’s life.

examples.en: The butcher wrapped the meat in paper.
examples.zh: 肉販用紙包好肉品。

examples.en: The butcher prepared fresh cuts for the shop.
examples.zh: 肉販為商店準備新鮮肉塊。

examples.en: The butcher shop opened early on Saturday.
examples.zh: 肉舖星期六一大早就開門。

entries.definition: （名）肉販、屠夫；（動）屠宰；也可指把事情做得很糟。

explains.en: This is a person who cuts and sells meat. They may prepare different pieces for customers. Clean tools and careful handling are important.
The verb can mean to cut up an animal for meat. This work requires special training and equipment. Food safety rules must be followed.
The word can also describe someone who buys and sells goods. A person may trade old tools at a market. The meaning depends on the situation.

examples.en: Submerging alginate droplets into a calcium bath triggers instant surface polymerization into a flexible skin.
examples.zh: 將海藻酸鈉滴液沉入「鈣離子水浴」（Calcium Bath），瞬間觸發表面交聯反應形成一層彈性薄膜。

examples.en: Nutritionists recommend fortified soy milk and dark leafy vegetables to maintain daily dietary calcium.
examples.zh: 營養學專家建議攝取高鈣強化豆漿與深綠色蔬菜，以補足每日所需飲食鈣質。

examples.en: Adequate calcium intake during teenage years helps build peak bone mineral density for adulthood.
examples.zh: 青少年時期維持充足的鈣質攝取，有助於成年後累積豐厚強健的骨質密度基石。

entries.definition: 氯化鈣水浴 (引發聚合物交聯凝膠化反應)；鈣

explains.en: This is a mineral element found in bones, teeth, and many foods. Milk and some vegetables contain it. People need it as part of a varied diet.
Doctors may measure this element in blood during a test. A health professional explains what the result means. One number alone does not tell the whole story.
The element is also used in some building materials. Chalk and limestone contain it. Rocks can hold many different minerals.

examples.en: Transiting the Panama Canal saves container freighters thousands of nautical miles around South America.
examples.zh: 穿越百年巴拿馬運河，為跨洋貨輪節省了繞道南美洲合恩角數千海里的航程與油耗。

examples.en: Grounding a giant megaship in the Suez Canal halted ten billion dollars in global trade every single day.
examples.zh: 超級巨輪長賜輪在蘇伊士運河意外擱淺卡死，曾造成全球每天高達上百億美元國際貿易瞬間停擺癱瘓。

examples.en: Expansion of the canal locks allows larger Neo-Panamax vessels to pass with heavier cargo loads.
examples.zh: 運河全新拓寬擴建水閘工程竣工後，允許吃水更深、載貨量更龐大的新巴拿馬型巨輪安全快速通航。

entries.definition: 蘇伊士運河與巴拿馬運河關鍵海運要衝

explains.en: This is a human-made waterway that boats can travel through. It may connect two rivers or seas. Locks can raise or lower a boat.
Some channels are built to carry water to farms. Gates control how much water flows. Farmers can use it for crops.
People can walk along the side and watch boats pass. Bridges cross over it at roads. It may be part of a city.

examples.en: Stretched linen canvas provides an archival, resilient surface for heavy oil paint layers.
examples.zh: 繃緊在實木內框上的頂級比利時亞麻油畫布，為多層厚塗油彩提供了抗氧化、不易脆化的專業載體。

examples.en: She packed her daily essentials inside a durable canvas backpack before catching the morning train.
examples.zh: 在搭乘清晨第一班區間車出發踏青前，她將雨傘、水壺等隨身必備物品妥善裝入厚實耐磨的帆布後背包。

examples.en: Campaign volunteers will canvas the local neighborhood this weekend to listen to community residents.
examples.zh: 青年志工團隊預計在本週末逐戶走訪基層社區鄰里，傾聽在地鄉親長輩對於老舊公寓都更工程的心聲。

examples.en: Spatial computing turns your entire physical room into an infinite, borderless productive canvas.
examples.zh: 空間運算將你的整個房間轉化為一塊無限延伸、毫無邊界的「三維工作畫布」（Canvas）。

examples.en: The oil painter primed a large stretched canvas with white gesso before beginning the landscape portrait.
examples.zh: 油畫家在開始繪製風景肖像畫前，先在大型繃布畫布上均勻塗抹白色底劑打底。

examples.en: Heavy water-resistant canvas tents shielded campers from fierce wind and pouring rain on the ridge.
examples.zh: 厚實防潑水的帆布帳篷在稜線上替露營登山客抵擋住了強勁的狂風與傾盆大雨。

entries.definition: 油畫布；帆布；擺脫實體螢幕限制之無限三維空間工作畫布；畫布

explains.en: This is a strong cloth used for painting or making bags. An artist stretches it over a frame before adding paint. Its rough surface holds the colors.
A heavy cloth can cover equipment or protect goods outdoors. It is made to last through regular use. Strong threads help it resist wear.
Artists can use this material to create a picture. They add colors and shapes with brushes. The finished work can hang on a wall.

examples.en: The robot has the capability to sort small blocks by color.
examples.zh: 機器人有能力依顏色分類小積木。

examples.en: Her capability to explain math helped the class.
examples.zh: 她解釋數學的能力幫助了全班。

examples.en: This camera has the capability to take clear pictures at night.
examples.zh: 這台相機能在夜間拍出清晰照片。

explains.en: This is the power or skill to do something. A student may learn to solve new kinds of puzzles. Practice builds skill over time.
A machine may be able to lift a certain weight. Its size and design set the limit. Workers read instructions before using it.
A person can do a task better after training. Asking questions and practicing can help. Different people have different strengths.

examples.en: Solid wood furniture acts as a permanent carbon vault, locking away atmospheric carbon for generations.
examples.zh: 原木實木家具宛如一座座堅固的固碳保險庫，將空氣中的碳元素永久鎖定在木質纖維中。

examples.en: Carbon fiber reinforced polymer delivers exceptional strength while drastically reducing bicycle frame weight.
examples.zh: 碳纖維複合增強材料在大幅減輕公路競速自行車車架重量的同時，提供了無與倫比的高剛性。

examples.en: Major corporations are investing in direct air capture facilities to remove industrial carbon from the atmosphere.
examples.zh: 國際跨國巨頭正大舉投資直接空氣捕捉新創設施，以期從大氣層中直接抽離工業二氧化碳。

explains.en: This is a chemical element found in living things and many materials. Plants take it from the air as they grow. It is part of many natural substances.
A pencil’s dark writing material contains this element. It leaves a mark on paper. Artists use it to draw lines and shade pictures.
Fuel made from ancient plants and animals contains this element. Burning such fuel releases gases into the air. Saving energy can reduce how much fuel people use.

examples.en: The carnival had colorful rides and games.
examples.zh: 園遊會有色彩繽紛的遊樂設施和遊戲。

examples.en: We watched a parade during the summer carnival.
examples.zh: 我們在夏季嘉年華會上觀看遊行。

examples.en: The school carnival raised money for new books.
examples.zh: 學校園遊會為新書募款。

entries.definition: （名）嘉年華；狂歡節；有遊樂設施的節慶活動

explains.en: This is a lively public event with rides, games, music, or performances. Families may visit booths and try activities. Bright lights make it festive.
A town may hold this event each year to celebrate a season or tradition. Visitors can enjoy food and shows. Workers help keep the area safe.
People may dress in costumes and join a parade. Musicians and dancers move through the streets. The celebration can bring a community together.

examples.en: The adults visited a casino during their trip.
examples.zh: 大人們在旅行時去了賭場。

examples.en: The casino had card tables and bright lights.
examples.zh: 賭場裡有牌桌和明亮燈光。

examples.en: A casino worker explained the rules to the guests.
examples.zh: 賭場工作人員向客人解釋遊戲規則。

explains.en: This is a place where adults can play games for money. People may use cards, dice, or a wheel. The games have rules and prizes.
Visitors may find bright lights and many tables inside. Workers explain how games are played. Adults should follow the rules of the place.
Some people visit for entertainment while traveling. Games can also involve losing money. It is important to make careful choices.

examples.en: The cathedral bells rang across the town.
examples.zh: 大教堂的鐘聲響徹整座城鎮。

examples.en: We admired the tall windows inside the cathedral.
examples.zh: 我們欣賞大教堂裡高聳的窗戶。

examples.en: The old cathedral took many years to build.
examples.zh: 這座古老大教堂花了許多年才建成。

entries.definition: （名）大教堂；主教座堂，通常是重要且宏偉的基督教教堂。

explains.en: This is a very large and important Christian church. It may have tall towers, stained-glass windows, and many seats. People may visit to pray or admire the design.
Builders may work for many years to complete a grand church. Stone arches and high ceilings can make the inside feel spacious. The building can be old.
A central church may serve a large area and hold special services. Visitors should speak quietly inside. Its art and history can attract people.

examples.en: Use caution when crossing the busy street.
examples.zh: 穿越繁忙街道時請小心。

examples.en: The sign urged caution near the deep water.
examples.zh: 告示牌提醒大家在深水區附近要小心。

examples.en: She handled the glass bowl with caution.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地拿著玻璃碗。

entries.definition: （名）小心；謹慎；警告；（動）提醒小心。

explains.en: This means care taken to avoid danger or mistakes. A driver should slow down on a wet road. Careful actions help keep people safe.
A warning can tell people about a possible problem. A sign may ask visitors to watch their step near stairs. Reading signs matters.
People can act carefully around hot objects or sharp tools. An adult can show children how to use them safely. Good habits prevent injuries.

examples.en: The cautious hiker checked the path before stepping forward.
examples.zh: 謹慎的登山客先檢查小徑才往前走。

examples.en: Be cautious around a dog you do not know.
examples.zh: 接近不熟悉的狗時要小心。

examples.en: She was cautious when carrying the full cup.
examples.zh: 她小心地拿著裝滿水的杯子。

entries.definition: （形）小心的；謹慎的；避免冒險的

explains.en: This describes someone who thinks carefully before acting. A child may look both ways before crossing a street. Checking first can prevent harm.
A person may move slowly around a frightened animal. Giving it space helps everyone stay safe. Calm actions are important.
Someone can check a plan for mistakes before beginning. Reading the instructions twice may help. Careful preparation saves time.

examples.en: The celebrity waved to fans outside the theater.
examples.zh: 那位名人向劇院外的粉絲揮手。

examples.en: A famous celebrity visited our school.
examples.zh: 一位名人到我們學校參觀。

examples.en: The young celebrity signed books for her readers.
examples.zh: 那位年輕名人替讀者簽書。

explains.en: This is a person who is known by many people, often from acting, sports, or music. Fans may recognize the person from television or news. Many people follow their work.
A well-known person may attend a public event. People sometimes ask for a photo or signature. The person may need privacy too.
Someone can become known for helping a community or making an important discovery. News stories may share their work. Being well known does not mean everyone knows them personally.

examples.en: The family visited the cemetery on Sunday.
examples.zh: 家人星期天到墓園探望。

examples.en: A stone marker stood in the old cemetery.
examples.zh: 古老的墓園裡有一座石碑。

examples.en: They planted flowers near their grandparents’ graves in the cemetery.
examples.zh: 他們在墓園裡祖父母的墓旁種花。

entries.definition: （名）墓園、墓地；安葬死者的地方。

explains.en: This is a place where people who have died are buried. Rows of markers may show their names and dates. Families sometimes visit to remember them.
The grounds may have trees, paths, and quiet spaces. Visitors should act respectfully. Workers care for the area.
A person can leave flowers or stand quietly near a loved one’s resting place. People may follow different customs. Kind support matters to grieving families.

examples.en: The opening ceremony of the sports games was spectacular.
examples.zh: 運動會的開幕典禮場面十分壯觀隆重。

examples.en: Our high school graduation ceremony will be held in the main gymnasium tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們的高中畢業典禮將於明天在學校體育館主館隆重舉行。

examples.en: The traditional tea ceremony requires patience, calm posture, and precise focus.
examples.zh: 傳統茶道儀式講求沉著耐心、端正儀態以及高度專注的心境。

examples.en: The traditional Taiwanese tea ceremony emphasizes mindfulness, hospitality, and seasonal flower arrangements.
examples.zh: 台灣當代茶道茶藝注重靜心泡茶、以茶待客之道，並融合典雅的四季插花茶席美學。

examples.en: Graduating medical students took the Hippocratic Oath during a solemn commencement ceremony.
examples.zh: 醫學院畢業生在莊嚴隆重的畢業典禮上，齊聲莊嚴宣讀希波克拉底誓詞。

examples.en: An elaborate ribbon-cutting ceremony marked the official opening of the new light rail transit line.
examples.zh: 地方首長與貴賓出席了隆重的剪綵典禮，正式宣告全新輕軌捷運路線通車營運。

entries.definition: 儀式；典禮；禮節；台灣茶藝茶道；典禮儀式

explains.en: This is a formal event held for a special reason. People may gather to celebrate, remember, or welcome someone. There may be music and speeches.
A school may hold a special event to honor students. Families watch as names are called. The event can mark an important achievement.
Some events follow traditions passed down over time. People may wear special clothes or say certain words. Customs can differ between communities.

examples.en: She spoke with certainty about the meeting time.
examples.zh: 她很確定地說出會議時間。

examples.en: There is no certainty that it will rain tomorrow.
examples.zh: 不確定明天會不會下雨。

examples.en: He checked the label to know with certainty which box was his.
examples.zh: 他查看標籤，確定哪個箱子是他的。

entries.definition: 確定；肯定；必然性；確實的事。

explains.en: This is a strong feeling that something is true or will happen. A student may feel sure after checking the answer twice. Careful work can build confidence.
A fact can be known clearly when there is good evidence. A scientist records observations and checks results. More information can remove doubt.
People may not always know exactly what will happen next. They can make a plan while staying ready for changes. Asking questions can help.

examples.en: A valid SSL certificate ensures the website connection is encrypted and authentic.
examples.zh: 有效的 SSL 數位安全憑證能保證瀏覽器與網站之間的連線安全加密無虞。

examples.en: Browsers display a warning warning users if a website's security certificate is expired.
examples.zh: 如果網站的安全憑證過期，瀏覽器會向使用者顯示安全警告。

examples.en: She received a professional certificate after completing the data science course.
examples.zh: 她在完成資料科學課程後獲得了一張專業結業證書。

examples.en: Purchasing verified Taiwan Renewable Energy Certificates (T-RECs) documents compliance with ESG export rules.
examples.zh: 購買通過官方嚴格核發的台灣再生能源憑證，是跨國企業符合歐盟與國際 ESG 規範的有力鐵證。

examples.en: Each electronic REC certificate represents one thousand kilowatt-hours of clean green power generated.
examples.zh: 每一張電子綠電憑證（T-REC）皆代表一千度（1,000 kWh）真實發出並注入電網的綠色潔淨電力。

examples.en: Regulators audit green certificate registers to prevent fraudulent double-counting of renewable credits.
examples.zh: 國家能源主管機關嚴密稽核官方綠電憑證媒合平台資料庫，徹底杜絕任何重複申報與雙重計算弊端。

entries.definition: 數位安全憑證；證書；執照；台灣再生能源綠電憑證 (T-REC)

explains.en: This is an official paper or digital record that proves something. A school may give one after a student finishes a course. It carries important details.
A person may need a record to show that they passed a test or have permission. The document may include a name and date. Keep it safe.
A computer system may use a digital record to prove who sent a message. It helps users check identity. Security tools protect the information.

examples.en: The wind and rain created chaos in the garden.
examples.zh: 風雨讓花園一片混亂。

examples.en: There was chaos in the kitchen when the cake fell.
examples.zh: 蛋糕掉下來時，廚房裡亂成一團。

examples.en: There was chaos after the classroom door slammed shut.
examples.zh: 教室門砰然關上後，大家一陣混亂。

explains.en: This is a state of great confusion or disorder. Toys scattered across every room can make a house look this way. Sorting them can help.
A sudden emergency may make people unsure what to do. Clear directions can help everyone stay calm. Helpers can guide the group.
A busy room with many people talking at once may feel hard to manage. Taking turns speaking can improve order. Simple rules help.

examples.en: The travelers stopped at a chapel beside the road.
examples.zh: 旅客在路旁的小教堂停留。

examples.en: The hospital chapel was quiet in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 醫院的小禮拜堂下午很安靜。

examples.en: A small chapel stood near the village school.
examples.zh: 村莊學校附近有一座小教堂。

explains.en: This is a small building or room used for Christian worship. It may stand beside a hospital, school, or larger church. People can pray there quietly.
The room may have benches, a simple altar, and windows. Visitors should speak softly. Some places hold short services there.
A family may gather in a small worship space for a special service. The setting can feel calm. People follow the customs of their faith.

examples.en: The story characterizes the king as fair and kind.
examples.zh: 故事把國王描寫成公平又善良的人。

examples.en: Bright colors characterize the artist’s early paintings.
examples.zh: 鮮豔的色彩是這位藝術家早期畫作的特色。

examples.en: The report characterizes the bird by its long tail and curved beak.
examples.zh: 報告以長尾巴和彎曲鳥喙描述這種鳥。

entries.definition: （動）描述特徵、刻畫；指出人事物的重要特性。

explains.en: This means to describe the main qualities of a person or thing. A writer may show that a character is brave through actions. Readers learn what the person is like.
A person can describe a place by naming its colors, sounds, and shapes. Details help someone imagine it. Clear examples make the picture stronger.
A scientist may explain features shared by a group of animals. Careful observations support the description. The details help people compare them.

examples.en: The executive chef prepared a gourmet five-course meal.
examples.zh: 行政主廚精心準備了精緻的五道菜套餐。

examples.en: Master chefs blend traditional ingredients with innovative modern cooking techniques.
examples.zh: 頂級名廚將傳統在地食材與創新的現代料理廚藝手法融會貫通。

examples.en: The pastry chef crafted an exquisite multi-tiered wedding cake adorned with sugar flowers.
examples.zh: 西點主廚精心烘培了一座點綴著精緻糖花的多層奢華婚禮蛋糕。

explains.en: This is a person whose job is to prepare food in a kitchen. The person follows recipes and keeps the work area clean. Good timing helps meals come together.
A skilled kitchen worker may plan meals and choose fresh ingredients. The person tastes dishes as they cook. Careful work helps food taste good.
Some kitchen workers lead a team and organize its tasks. They make sure food is ready at the right time. Clean tools help keep meals safe.

examples.en: The indigenous children's choir sang heavenly tribal harmony melodies.
examples.zh: 原住民兒童合唱團演唱了如天籟般純淨動人的部落天籟和聲。

examples.en: Joining the church choir on Sundays brought joy and solace to her retirement years.
examples.zh: 週日主日加入教會詩班合唱團獻唱，為她的退休銀髮生活注入了無比喜樂與慰藉。

examples.en: The choir received a thunderous standing ovation at the international choral competition.
examples.zh: 該合唱團在世界合唱奧林匹克大賽中贏得了全場如雷貫耳的起立鼓掌致敬。

explains.en: This is a group of people who sing together. They may perform at a school, church, or concert hall. A leader helps them stay in time.
Members practice the same song so their voices blend. They may sing high or low notes. Listening to one another helps the group sound balanced.
A music teacher may direct the singers during a performance. The group follows the beat and watches for cues. Practice helps them begin and stop together.

examples.en: She played a bright chord on the piano.
examples.zh: 她在鋼琴上彈出明亮和弦。

examples.en: The guitarist changed to a different chord.
examples.zh: 吉他手換彈另一個和弦。

examples.en: A warm chord ended the song.
examples.zh: 溫暖的和弦為歌曲畫下句點。

explains.en: This is a group of musical notes played together. A guitar player can press several strings at once. The sound can support a song.
In music, notes can be arranged to sound pleasant or tense. Musicians practice changing from one group of notes to another. Their hands must move carefully.
A musical group of notes can help create a feeling in a song. It may sound joyful, calm, or sad. Listening closely helps people notice the effect.

examples.en: Taking out the trash is my weekly chore.
examples.zh: 倒垃圾是我每週的家務之一。

examples.en: He finished his chores before playing outside.
examples.zh: 他做完家事才到外面玩。

examples.en: Her chore was to feed the family’s cat.
examples.zh: 她的家務是餵家裡的貓。

entries.definition: （名）日常雜務；例行工作；令人厭煩的工作

explains.en: This is a small job that needs to be done regularly. A child may put toys away after playing. Finishing it helps keep the home tidy.
People may share simple jobs at home. One person sets the table while another washes vegetables. Working together saves time.
A list can remind someone what needs doing. Crossing off finished jobs feels good. A routine helps people remember.

examples.en: Regular health checkups help detect chronic conditions like high cholesterol early.
examples.zh: 定期健康檢查有助於及早發現高膽固醇等慢性健康問題。

examples.en: He struggled with chronic insomnia caused by prolonged career stress.
examples.zh: 長期沈重的工作職業壓力讓他常年深受慢性失眠之苦。

examples.en: Managing chronic back pain often requires a combination of therapy and exercise.
examples.zh: 妥善控制慢性的下背痛問題通常需要搭配物理治療與核心肌力鍛鍊。

entries.definition: 慢性的；長期的；積習難改的

explains.en: This describes a problem that lasts for a long time. A long-lasting cough may continue for weeks. A health professional can explain what to do.
A repeated habit can be hard to change. Practicing a new routine may help someone improve it. Support from others can be useful.
A condition that continues over time may need ongoing attention. People can keep notes about what they notice. A qualified professional can offer guidance.

examples.en: The chubby puppy rolled onto its back.
examples.zh: 那隻胖嘟嘟的小狗翻身躺下。

examples.en: A chubby squirrel carried an acorn up the tree.
examples.zh: 一隻圓滾滾的松鼠把橡實帶上樹。

examples.en: The baby had chubby cheeks and a bright smile.
examples.zh: 寶寶有著胖胖的臉頰和燦爛笑容。

explains.en: This describes someone or an animal with a round, soft body. A small puppy may look this way after a good meal. Its shape can seem cuddly.
A baby’s cheeks may be round and full. Families often find this look sweet. Every healthy body has a different shape.
A soft object can also be round and thick. A cushion may feel comfortable to hug. Shape and size can vary.

examples.en: Add a chunk of cheese to the soup.
examples.zh: 在湯裡加一大塊起司。

examples.en: He cut the wood into a small chunk.
examples.zh: 他把木頭切成一小塊。

examples.en: A large chunk of ice floated past the boat.
examples.zh: 一大塊冰從船旁漂過。

entries.definition: （名）厚塊、大塊；（動）把某物分成較大的塊。

explains.en: This is a thick piece or portion cut from a larger whole. A cook may add a piece of cheese to a dish. It gives a rich taste.
A broken rock may fall into several large pieces. Workers can move them one at a time. Smaller pieces are easier to carry.
A story may be divided into parts for reading. Each part can cover one event. A short part is easier to finish at once.

examples.en: Designing shallow quantum circuits minimizes runtime before thermal noise degrades the calculation.
examples.zh: 設計淺層量子邏輯電路，能在熱雜訊破壞運算前以最高速度完成演算法。

examples.en: Compiling the quantum circuit reorders operations to respect the physical topology of the chip.
examples.zh: 將高階量子電路編譯轉譯時，軟體會智慧重新排列閘順序以嚴格契合實體晶片的底層物理拓撲。

examples.en: The circuit depth measures how many sequential gate steps must be performed from start to finish.
examples.zh: 量子電路深度（Circuit Depth）是衡量演算法從頭到尾必須循序執行多少道邏輯閘步驟的核心指標。

examples.en: Synthetic gene regulatory circuits program cells to glow green only when they detect toxic heavy metals.
examples.zh: 「人工合成基因邏輯電路」（Gene Circuit），能編程細胞唯有在偵測到有毒重金屬時才發出綠色螢光。

examples.en: The electrician traced the short circuit back to a loose connection inside the junction box.
examples.zh: 水電技師循線追查短路故障源頭，最終定位在電線接線盒內部一處鬆脫的端子接頭。

examples.en: Formula One racers sped around the challenging coastal street circuit in Monaco under clear skies.
examples.zh: 一級方程式賽車好手在晴朗天候下，全速馳騁於摩納哥極具挑戰性的濱海街道賽道中。

entries.definition: 深度量子演算法執行邏輯電路；電路；人工合成基因調控邏輯電路 (邏輯閘開關)

explains.en: This is a path that electric current follows through connected parts. A battery can send power along wires to a small light. A closed path lets the light turn on.
A road or train route may form a loop that returns to its starting place. Travelers can follow signs around it. The route connects several stops.
The word can name a series of sports or racing events held in different places. Players travel from one event to the next. Scores may be compared.

examples.en: Please cite the book you used in your report.
examples.zh: 請在報告中引用你使用的書籍。

examples.en: The teacher cited a poem during the lesson.
examples.zh: 老師在課堂上引用了一首詩。

examples.en: She cited two sources to support her idea.
examples.zh: 她引用兩個來源來支持自己的想法。

entries.definition: 引用；引述；舉例說明；傳喚。

explains.en: This means to name a source or example as support for an idea. A student may mention a book when writing a report. The reader can find the information there.
A speaker can point to a fact that supports an answer. Giving the source helps others check it. Honest work credits where ideas came from.
Writers may name a person’s words or work. They should show who created it. This respects the original author.

examples.en: Active global citizenship requires understanding international issues and contributing to humanity's progress.
examples.zh: 踐行「世界公民素養」（Global Citizenship），要求我們關心氣候、和平與科技發展，為人類進步貢獻心力。

examples.en: Schools teach digital citizenship so students can evaluate online content with critical insight.
examples.zh: 現代學校積極傳授數位公民素養，讓學生在面對網路龐雜資訊時具備批判思考與辨別能力。

examples.en: After living abroad as a permanent resident for five years, she officially applied for citizenship.
examples.zh: 在海外以永久居民身分生活五年後，她正式向移民主管機關遞交了公民身份歸化申請。

entries.definition: 具備全球關懷與永續視野之世界公民素養；公民身份

explains.en: This is the legal membership and relationship a person has with a country. It can come with rights and duties. Laws explain how people gain it.
People may take part in their community by voting, helping neighbors, or learning local rules. These actions show care for the place where they live. They can also listen to others.
A person may belong to more than one culture or community. They can respect different traditions. Taking part helps people feel connected.

examples.en: The students joined a civic project to clean the park.
examples.zh: 學生參加了清理公園的社區活動。

examples.en: Voting is one way to take part in civic life.
examples.zh: 投票是參與公共生活的一種方式。

examples.en: The town held a civic celebration in the main square.
examples.zh: 鎮上在主要廣場舉辦社區慶典。

entries.definition: （形）公民的；城市的；與社區公共生活有關的

explains.en: This describes things related to a town, city, or its people. A local park is a shared place for neighbors. Residents can help care for it.
People may join projects that improve their community. They can clean a street or plant trees. Small efforts make public places nicer.
Rules and services can help a city work well. People can attend meetings and share ideas. Listening helps leaders understand what residents need.

examples.en: Savoring fine tea clears the restless mind, bringing serene emotional clarity and insight.
examples.zh: 靜下心來細品一杯好茶，能洗滌平日紛擾雜亂的思緒，為內心帶來無比平靜澄澈的定力與智慧。

examples.en: The executive drafted the memo with admirable clarity, leaving no ambiguity regarding project milestones.
examples.zh: 這位營運長撰寫的專案備忘錄條理極為分明清晰，針對各階段關鍵里程碑與權責分工毫無模糊空間。

examples.en: The jeweler inspected the diamond's internal purity and optical clarity under a tenfold magnification loupe.
examples.zh: 珠寶鑑定大師手持十倍放大鏡，在專業光源下細細檢視這顆克拉鑽石內部的純淨度與透亮光學淨度。

examples.en: Rigorous philosophical inquiry cuts through emotional fog, bringing diamond-sharp clarity to difficult decisions.
examples.zh: 嚴密的哲學思辨能如利刃般切開迷惘的情緒迷霧，為人生的重大關鍵抉擇帶來如鑽石般澄澈明亮的定見（Clarity）。

examples.en: The CEO articulated the company’s five-year expansion roadmap with impressive strategic clarity.
examples.zh: 執行長在全體員工大會上條理分明、言簡意賅地闡述了企業未來五年的全球擴張戰略藍圖，思路極其清晰明確。

examples.en: A gemologist grades precious emeralds based on their vivid green saturation, cut symmetry, and internal clarity.
examples.zh: 國際珠寶鑑定大師依據濃郁正綠色飽和度、精準切割對稱比例以及寶石內部純淨無瑕的透亮淨度（Clarity）為頂級祖母綠評級。

examples.en: Exceptional acoustic clarity allows listeners to distinguish individual flute trills within a full orchestral fortissimo.
examples.zh: 極致的「聲學清晰度」（Clarity），讓聽眾即使在全樂團最強奏中，依然能清晰分辨長笛細膩的顫音。

examples.en: The crystal-clear mountain stream flowed with such clarity that swimming trout were easily visible.
examples.zh: 高山溪澗清洌甘甜，水質澄澈純淨到連在卵石間悠游穿梭的野生鱒魚都清晰可見。

examples.en: The economics professor explained complex monetary inflation theories with admirable simplicity and clarity.
examples.zh: 這位經濟學名教授以令人讚嘆的深入淺出與條理分明，清晰透徹地剖析了繁複的貨幣通膨理論。

entries.definition: 思緒清明澄澈；清晰度；思緒清明透徹；獨奏鋼琴微弱觸鍵之清脆晶瑩聲音清晰度；清晰

explains.en: This is the quality of being easy to see, hear, or understand. Large letters make a sign easier to read. Good lighting can help too.
A clear speaker uses simple words and an organized order. Listeners can follow the main idea. Examples make a message easier to grasp.
A picture may have sharp lines and distinct shapes. Viewers can notice small details. Careful focus improves the image.

examples.en: Review the liability limitation clause in the service agreement carefully.
examples.zh: 仔細審閱該服務提供協議書中關於損害賠償責任限制的合約條款。

examples.en: The contract includes an arbitration clause specifying that all disputes must be resolved in Taipei.
examples.zh: 該商業合約中特別增設了一道強制仲裁條款，載明雙方未來一切履約紛爭均須提交台北仲裁機構裁決。

examples.en: The employer inserted a non-compete clause that restricts departing staff from joining competitors for one year.
examples.zh: 資方在勞動合約中特別載入競業禁止條款，嚴格限制離職員工在離職後一年內不得投奔同業競品公司。

entries.definition: 合約條款；款項；文法子句

explains.en: This is a part of a sentence that contains a subject and a verb. It can be complete or depend on another part. Punctuation helps show how ideas connect.
A written agreement may have a section that states one rule. Each section helps explain what people have agreed to do. Reading carefully is important.
A sentence can contain several parts joined by words such as “because” or “when.” These parts add details. Good punctuation helps readers follow them.

examples.en: The toddler clung to her father’s hand.
examples.zh: 幼兒緊緊握住爸爸的手。

examples.en: Wet leaves clung to the window.
examples.zh: 濕葉子黏在窗戶上。

examples.en: The kitten clung to the blanket during the car ride.
examples.zh: 車程中，小貓緊緊抓著毛毯。

explains.en: This means to hold tightly to something. A child may hold a parent’s hand while crossing a busy street. The grip can help the child feel safe.
A wet shirt can stick to skin on a hot day. The fabric stays close until it dries. Loose clothing may feel cooler.
A person can stay close to a group or idea. Friends may remain together during a difficult time. Supporting one another can help.

examples.en: The clinical team checked the patient’s chart.
examples.zh: 臨床團隊檢查了病人的病歷。

examples.en: Students learned about clinical tests in health class.
examples.zh: 學生在健康課學習臨床檢查。

examples.en: The report described a clinical study with adult volunteers.
examples.zh: 報告描述一項由成年志願者參加的臨床研究。

entries.definition: （形）臨床的；與病人診療有關；也可指冷靜、缺乏情感。

explains.en: This describes something related to doctors, patients, or medical treatment. A nurse may use a careful method to check a person’s health. Clear records help the care team.
A medical study may test an idea with patients under close supervision. Researchers follow a plan and record results. Safety rules are important.
A clean, plain style can also be called this. A room with white walls and simple furniture may have that look. The design keeps attention on the work.

examples.en: The customizable 12-inch instrument cluster displays live 3D navigation maps between gauges.
examples.zh: 十二吋全數位虛擬液晶儀表板支援客製化切換模式，能在時速表之間直接全螢幕顯示立體導航地圖。

examples.en: Astronomers aimed the observatory telescope at the Pleiades star cluster glittering in the Taurus constellation.
examples.zh: 高山天文學家將大型望遠鏡精準對準在金牛座中閃耀如璀璨鑽石的七姊妹昴宿星團。

examples.en: High-tech hardware companies formed a collaborative industrial cluster around the Hsinchu Science Park.
examples.zh: 頂尖半導體與高科技零組件企業，在新竹科學園區周圍形成了舉世聞名且高度垂直整合的產業聚落。

examples.en: Hsinchu Science Park forms a tightly knit industrial cluster where suppliers, fabs, and designers collaborate.
examples.zh: 新竹科學園區（竹科）形成了全球最緊密高效的半導體產業聚落（Cluster），上下游協同合作極具效率。

examples.en: A dense cluster of ripe purple grapes hung gracefully from the wooden trellis in the vineyard.
examples.zh: 一串串熟透飽滿的紫黑甜美葡萄沉甸甸地懸掛在觀光果園的原木棚架下，在微風中散發著誘人果香。

examples.en: Epidemiologists worked urgently to trace the source of a sudden cluster of viral influenza cases at the boarding school.
examples.zh: 疾管署流行病學防疫專家火速進駐該私立寄宿中學，全力疫調追查這起突如其來的群聚性流感感染源頭。

entries.definition: 全數位液晶儀表板；星團；群；新竹科學園區半導體產業聚落

explains.en: This is a group of similar things close together. A group of stars may look like a bright patch in the night sky. A telescope helps people see it.
A group of buildings can form one area for a certain kind of work. The buildings may share roads and services. Workers travel between them.
Small fruits may grow close together on a stem. A gardener can pick them carefully. The grouped shape makes them easy to notice.

examples.en: The health lesson explained why cocaine is dangerous.
examples.zh: 健康課說明了古柯鹼為什麼危險。

examples.en: The police found cocaine hidden in the bag.
examples.zh: 警方在袋子裡發現藏匿的古柯鹼。

examples.en: The story described how cocaine harmed the character’s life.
examples.zh: 故事描述古柯鹼如何傷害角色的生活。

entries.definition: 古柯鹼；一種會使人上癮的非法毒品。

explains.en: This is a powerful illegal drug made from a plant. It can harm a person’s health and lead to serious problems. People should stay away from it.
The substance can change how the brain and body work. It is dangerous and against the law in many places. A person who needs help should speak to a trusted adult or health professional.
News stories may discuss this drug when explaining crime or health risks. Facts should be shared carefully. No one should try unknown substances.

examples.en: The family placed flowers on the coffin.
examples.zh: 家人在棺木上放了鮮花。

examples.en: The wooden coffin was carried to the cemetery.
examples.zh: 木製棺木被抬往墓園。

examples.en: The story described a coffin inside an ancient tomb.
examples.zh: 故事描述古墓中的一具棺木。

explains.en: This is a box used to hold a dead person’s body before burial. Families may choose one for a funeral. People treat it with respect.
The box may be made from wood or another material. It is placed in a grave or resting place. Customs differ among families.
A story about an old burial may mention this container. The scene can feel sad. Kind support matters when people grieve.

examples.en: Quality sleep enhances daytime cognitive speed, memory consolidation, and creative inspiration.
examples.zh: 優質充沛的睡眠能全方位提升白天的思維敏捷度、邏輯決策力、記憶力固化與創意靈感迸發。

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise supports neuroplasticity, protecting against age-related cognitive decline.
examples.zh: 規律進行慢跑等有氧耐力運動能促進大腦神經可塑性，有效防範年長者出現不可逆的認知功能退化。

examples.en: The neuroscientist measured cognitive load during complex multi-tasking problem-solving sessions.
examples.zh: 腦神經科學家透過精密儀器即時監測受試者在執行繁複多工運算任務時，前額葉大腦皮層的認知負荷。

examples.en: Seniors solve math puzzles and play mahjong as fun cognitive exercises to keep their brains sharp.
examples.zh: 社區關懷據點長輩們一起打麻將與玩數獨，透過生動有趣的大腦認知訓練活化思緒。

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise has been shown to slow down age-related cognitive decline significantly.
examples.zh: 研究顯示規律的有氧運動能顯著延緩隨年齡增長而出現的認知功能退化。

examples.en: The psychologist conducted standard tests to evaluate the patient's cognitive perception and memory recall.
examples.zh: 心理學家進行了標準化測驗，以評估病患的認知感知與記憶提取能力。

entries.definition: 大腦認知思維專注的；大腦認知功能刺激訓練的

explains.en: This describes thinking, learning, remembering, and understanding. A puzzle can help a child practice memory and problem-solving. Different tasks use different skills.
A person may use their mind to compare choices. Writing a list of good and bad points can help. Taking time can improve decisions.
Some activities use attention and memory. Reading, counting, and following steps all require thinking. Rest helps people focus.

examples.en: Her explanation was coherent and easy to follow.
examples.zh: 她的解釋清楚連貫，容易理解。

examples.en: The report gave a coherent account of the event.
examples.zh: 報告連貫地敘述了這件事。

examples.en: He organized his notes into a coherent story.
examples.zh: 他把筆記整理成一個連貫的故事。

entries.definition: （形）連貫的；有條理的；清楚易懂的

explains.en: This describes ideas that are clear and fit together logically. A story is easier to follow when events come in order. Clear links help the reader understand.
A speaker can share ideas in a way that makes sense. They explain one point before moving to the next. Examples can make the message clearer.
A group can create a plan that everyone understands. Members agree on the steps and their order. Clear planning prevents confusion.

examples.en: It was a coincidence that we wore the same color.
examples.zh: 我們剛好穿了同一種顏色，真巧。

examples.en: By coincidence, the twins chose the same book.
examples.zh: 碰巧，雙胞胎選了同一本書。

examples.en: What a coincidence! We both live on the same street.
examples.zh: 真巧！我們住在同一條街上。

entries.definition: （名）巧合；兩件事同時發生或相似，卻沒有明顯因果關係。

explains.en: This is an event that happens by chance when two things occur at the same time. Two friends may meet unexpectedly at a store. Neither planned to be there.
People may notice that they have the same birthday as a new classmate. The match can feel surprising. It happened without planning.
A surprising match can make people smile. They may share the story with others. Not every unusual event has a special cause.

examples.en: Effective cross-cultural collaboration boosts creative innovation.
examples.zh: 高效的跨文化合作能激發出豐沛的創意思維與創新。

examples.en: The new electric scooter is the fruit of close collaboration between two tech firms.
examples.zh: 這款嶄新的智慧聯網電動機車，是兩大科技巨擘歷時兩年密切通力協作的璀璨結晶。

examples.en: Online document editing tools facilitate real-time collaboration among remote teams.
examples.zh: 線上即時共同編輯工具，為分散全球各地的跨國遠端團隊提供了無縫即時協作體驗。

examples.en: The sneaker brand launched a limited crossover collaboration with a famous anime.
examples.zh: 該人氣運動潮鞋品牌推出了與知名動漫超人氣 IP 的限量跨界聯名合作款。

examples.en: Effective team collaboration relies heavily on modern cloud communication tools.
examples.zh: 高效的團隊協同作業高度仰賴現代化的雲端協作溝通工具。

examples.en: The scientific breakthrough was the fruit of international collaboration across three continents.
examples.zh: 這項重大科學突破是橫跨三大洲的跨國合作所結出的豐碩果實。

examples.en: Cross-border holographic collaboration accelerates automotive design cycles by months.
examples.zh: 跨國團隊進行「全像遠距協同設計」（Collaboration），能將全新電動汽車的研發週期大幅縮短數個月。

examples.en: Effective inter-departmental collaboration between sales and engineering ensured on-time software delivery.
examples.zh: 業務部與研發部之間緊密有效的跨部門協作，確保了旗艦軟體產品如期上線交件。

examples.en: The famous university announced a research collaboration with local hospitals to fight rare diseases.
examples.zh: 這所頂尖名校宣布與在地多家醫院展開臨床研究合作，攜手對抗罕見疾病。

entries.definition: 合作；通力協作；跨界合作；協同作業；聯名；跨國工程師在同一虛擬晶片模型前協同設計

explains.en: This is the act of working together on a task. Two students may share ideas to make a poster. Each person can contribute a different skill.
People can join their efforts to solve a problem. One person may plan while another builds. Sharing ideas can improve the result.
A company may work with another group to create a product. Each side brings its own knowledge. Clear communication helps the partners succeed.

examples.en: The collective effort helped clean the entire beach.
examples.zh: 大家共同努力，清理了整片海灘。

examples.en: The club made a collective decision to plant trees.
examples.zh: 社團共同決定要種樹。

examples.en: The team’s collective strength helped them finish the race.
examples.zh: 全隊的力量幫助他們完成了比賽。

entries.definition: （形）集體的；共同的；（名）集體；團體。

explains.en: This describes something shared by a whole group. A class may make one large drawing together. Each student adds a small part.
People can make a decision as a group. They listen to one another and choose a plan. Everyone shares the result.
A community may share a goal or responsibility. Members help in different ways. Working together can make the goal easier to reach.

examples.en: The collector showed us a book of rare stamps.
examples.zh: 收藏家給我們看一本珍稀郵票集。

examples.en: A coin collector found an old silver piece.
examples.zh: 一位錢幣收藏者找到一枚古老的銀幣。

examples.en: The art collector donated a painting to the museum.
examples.zh: 藝術收藏家把一幅畫捐給博物館。

explains.en: This is someone who gathers or saves a certain kind of object. A person may keep stamps from many countries. Each item can have a story.
A museum worker may gather old tools for an exhibit. The worker records where each one came from. Careful storage protects them.
A person who asks people to pay money they owe may also have this job title. The work should follow fair rules. Clear records matter.

examples.en: The museum displayed colonial maps from the past.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了過去的殖民地地圖。

examples.en: The book discussed colonial rule and its effects.
examples.zh: 這本書討論殖民統治及其影響。

examples.en: They studied a colonial building during the history trip.
examples.zh: 他們在歷史之旅中研究一棟殖民時期建築。

entries.definition: （形）殖民地的；殖民時期的；（名）殖民地居民

explains.en: This describes a time when one country controlled another land and its people. History books explain how this affected communities. People may study both sides of the past.
Buildings and language can show traces of an earlier ruling power. Historians look at records and objects. Careful study helps explain change.
People living under outside rule may have had fewer choices. Their stories are important to learn. Respectful discussion can help understand history.

examples.en: The renowned columnist writes weekly analyses on macroeconomic market trends.
examples.zh: 這位享譽盛名的財經專欄作家每週撰寫專欄深入剖析全球總體經濟脈動。

examples.en: Readers eagerly await the humorous life stories penned by the lifestyle columnist.
examples.zh: 廣大讀者每週都熱切期盼著那位生活專欄作家筆下風趣幽默的生活雜感。

examples.en: A syndicated columnist has their articles distributed to hundreds of newspapers.
examples.zh: 聯合報業專欄作家的文章會被分發授權給全美數百家報紙刊登。

explains.en: This is a writer who regularly shares opinions or ideas in a newspaper or magazine. The pieces may appear in a special section. Readers can follow the writer’s views.
A newspaper may ask this writer to explain a subject for its readers. The writer researches facts and gives a point of view. Clear examples help.
Readers may agree or disagree with the writer’s opinions. They can compare the arguments with other information. Thoughtful reading helps people decide.

examples.en: The soldiers trained for combat.
examples.zh: 士兵接受了戰鬥訓練。

examples.en: The town began a campaign to combat litter.
examples.zh: 鎮上開始推廣對抗垃圾的活動。

examples.en: The report described combat during the war.
examples.zh: 報告描述戰爭期間的戰鬥。

entries.definition: （名）戰鬥、搏鬥；（動）與問題或敵人對抗。

explains.en: This means a fight between armed groups or a strong effort against a problem. Soldiers may take part in a battle. People hope for peace.
A team can work hard to stop a disease or protect a forest. The effort may take many steps. Helpers share ideas and supplies.
As a verb, it can mean to fight or struggle against something. A group may oppose unfair treatment. Peaceful action can make a difference.

examples.en: The comedian made the audience laugh with a silly story.
examples.zh: 那位喜劇演員說了一個有趣的故事，逗得觀眾發笑。

examples.en: A famous comedian visited our school.
examples.zh: 一位知名喜劇演員造訪了我們學校。

examples.en: The comedian practiced her jokes before the show.
examples.zh: 那位喜劇演員在演出前練習笑話。

entries.definition: 喜劇演員；說笑逗樂的人。

explains.en: This is a person who makes people laugh, often on stage or television. They may tell jokes or act out funny scenes. Audiences enjoy the performance.
A person in this job may use funny voices or costumes. Good timing helps the joke work. The performer should avoid hurting others.
Some performers use comedy to talk about everyday life. They notice surprising or silly details. People may laugh and think at the same time.

examples.en: The radio commentary described the final minutes of the game.
examples.zh: 電台的賽事解說描述了比賽最後幾分鐘的情況。

examples.en: Her commentary helped us understand the painting.
examples.zh: 她的評論幫助我們理解這幅畫。

examples.en: The teacher gave commentary on each group’s project.
examples.zh: 老師對每組的專題都給了講評。

explains.en: This is spoken or written explanation about an event. A sports announcer may describe each play as it happens. Listeners can follow the action.
A book may include notes that explain a writer’s ideas. The notes can help readers understand the subject. Clear examples are useful.
A news program may explain what happened during the day. The speaker can add facts and background. Viewers learn more about the event.

examples.en: The commentator described the race as the runners crossed the finish line.
examples.zh: 賽事評論員描述選手衝過終點線的情況。

examples.en: A commentator explained the election results on television.
examples.zh: 評論員在電視上說明選舉結果。

examples.en: The sports commentator praised both teams.
examples.zh: 體育評論員讚揚了兩支隊伍。

explains.en: This is a person who describes events as they happen. A sports worker may tell listeners what players are doing. The audience can imagine the game.
A person on television may explain a news event. They share details and background for viewers. Clear speech helps everyone follow.
A worker may talk about a parade or race over a loudspeaker. The listeners hear updates. The speaker should give accurate information.

examples.en: The real estate agency charged a standard legal buyer commission fee.
examples.zh: 房屋仲介公司依照主管機關法定規範向買賣雙方合理收取標準仲介服務費佣金。

examples.en: Sales representatives earn a base monthly salary plus a ten percent sales commission.
examples.zh: 業務代表每個月除了享有保障底薪外，還能領取按成交業績抽成一成的業務佣金。

examples.en: Be sure to clarify the exact broker commission rate before signing the exclusive agency agreement.
examples.zh: 在簽署專任委託買賣契約書之前，務必事先確認清楚買賣雙方實際應負擔的佣金趴數。

explains.en: This can be a group chosen to study a question or make a decision. Members meet and share ideas. They may report their findings.
It can also be money paid to someone who helps sell a product or arrange a deal. The amount may depend on the sale. Clear terms explain the payment.
A person may receive this payment for making a sale. The seller records the amount. Honest records help avoid confusion.

examples.en: Adopting a pet is a lifelong 15-year commitment of patient care, love, and unwavering responsibility.
examples.zh: 帶一隻毛小孩回家是一份長達十五年終生不離不棄的莊嚴承諾，需要全心全意的包容、愛與責任感。

examples.en: Before bringing a puppy home, consider whether your financial budget and daily schedule can sustain that commitment.
examples.zh: 在將幼犬迎進家門前，請務必再三深思自身的經濟預算與生活作息能否長期支撐這份沉甸甸的承諾。

examples.en: True pet guardianship means honoring your lifetime commitment even when animals grow old or require nursing care.
examples.zh: 真正的負責任飼主，意味著即便毛孩步入衰老殘疾或長期臥病需要照護，也絕不背棄當初相守一生的承諾。

examples.en: Transitioning away from fossil fuels is a solemn intergenerational commitment to our children's future.
examples.zh: 堅定告別高污染化石燃料，是當代人對後代子孫生存環境許下的最莊嚴世代承諾。

examples.en: Corporate leaders signed an ironclad sustainability commitment to power all factories with renewable energy.
examples.zh: 產業領袖簽署了堅定不移的永續行動承諾書，承諾在指定年限前將旗下所有生產基地改採百分之百綠能運作。

examples.en: Delivering on our net-zero commitment requires unyielding political determination and community collaboration.
examples.zh: 全面踐行二零五零淨零承諾，需要執政當局堅定不移的政治魄力以及全民社會上下一心的團結攜手。

entries.definition: 終生不離不棄的責任承諾；奉獻；守護後代子孫之堅定不移淨零承諾

explains.en: This is a promise to give time or effort to something. A student may practice an instrument every day. Regular work helps reach a goal.
A friend may promise to help someone move. Keeping the promise shows care. People can trust someone who follows through.
A person can choose to support a team or cause for a long time. The choice involves responsibility. Steady action shows dedication.

examples.en: Coffee is an important commodity in many countries.
examples.zh: 咖啡是許多國家的重要商品。

examples.en: The market price of this commodity changed this year.
examples.zh: 今年這項商品的市場價格有所變動。

examples.en: Farmers shipped the commodity to buyers overseas.
examples.zh: 農民把這種商品運送給海外買家。

entries.definition: （名）商品、貨物；可買賣的物品或原物料。

explains.en: This is a product that people buy or sell, often in large amounts. Grain, oil, and metals are examples. Prices can change over time.
A farmer may grow a crop that is sold to many buyers. The crop travels from farms to markets. Quality can affect its price.
People may trade basic goods between places. Supply and demand can change what buyers pay. Fair rules help markets work.

examples.en: The class studied communism in a history lesson.
examples.zh: 這堂歷史課研讀了共產主義。

examples.en: The book compared communism with other economic systems.
examples.zh: 這本書比較了共產主義與其他經濟制度。

examples.en: They discussed communism and its effects on society.
examples.zh: 他們討論了共產主義及其對社會的影響。

entries.definition: 共產主義；主張共同擁有生產資源的政治經濟思想。

explains.en: This is a political and economic idea about sharing property and wealth across a society. Different countries have used different forms of it. Its history is complex.
People who study this idea examine how governments organize work and resources. They compare plans and outcomes. Careful reading helps explain the topic.
The word is often discussed in history or politics. People may have different opinions about it. A respectful discussion uses clear facts.

examples.en: The communist party held a public meeting in the story.
examples.zh: 故事中的共產黨舉行了一場公開會議。

examples.en: The book described a communist leader from the past.
examples.zh: 這本書描述了一位過去的共產主義領導人。

examples.en: He read about communist ideas in his history class.
examples.zh: 他在歷史課閱讀共產主義思想。

entries.definition: （名）共產主義者；（形）共產主義的

explains.en: This describes a person who supports a political and economic system based on shared ownership. People may have different reasons for supporting it. The word can also describe ideas linked to that system.
A history book may describe a leader or party with this belief. Readers can learn about the time and place. Reliable sources help explain events.
Political beliefs can shape how people think about work and resources. People should discuss them respectfully. Listening helps explain different views.

examples.en: I commute thirty minutes by MRT from New Taipei City to Taipei downtown.
examples.zh: 我每天搭乘捷運從新北市通勤三十分鐘至台北市中心。

examples.en: Listening to English podcasts turns an otherwise boring daily commute into study time.
examples.zh: 每天戴上耳機收聽英文播客節目，能將原本枯燥乏味的通勤路程轉化為充實學習時光。

examples.en: Traffic jams during the morning rush hour extended his car commute to over an hour.
examples.zh: 早晨上班尖峰時段慘烈的大塞車，讓他開車通勤的單程耗時一口氣拉長到一個多小時。

explains.en: This means to travel regularly between home and work or school. A person may ride a bus each morning. The trip can take a short or long time.
A traveler may use a train, bicycle, or car for the repeated journey. Planning the route can save time. Traffic can change how long it takes.
Some people travel between two places on a set schedule. They may leave early to arrive on time. A familiar route can become part of daily life.

examples.en: Thousands of busy commuters pass through Taipei Main Station every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早晨數以萬計忙碌的通勤族穿梭於台北車站大廳。

examples.en: Commuters tapped their EasyCards swiftly at the subway turnstile gates.
examples.zh: 步履匆匆的通勤族在捷運驗票閘門前俐落地輕觸感應悠遊卡，依序迅速進站。

examples.en: Rainy morning weather caused long lines of wet commuters waiting at city bus stops.
examples.zh: 陰雨綿綿的濕冷早晨，市區各主要公車站牌前排滿了撐著雨傘耐心候車的通勤人群。

explains.en: This is a person who travels regularly between home and work or school. The person may use a bus or train. The trip happens often.
A person may spend time traveling to a job each day. They can read or listen to music during the ride. Traffic may affect arrival time.
People on the same route may recognize one another. They often travel at similar times. Planning ahead can make the trip easier.

examples.en: Foldable multi-functional furniture is perfect for compact studio apartments.
examples.zh: 可摺疊多功能家具是空間緊湊小巧的獨立套房的最佳首選。

examples.en: The engineer designed a compact, lightweight lithium battery pack for drones.
examples.zh: 工程師為無人機研發出了一套體積緊湊小巧且重量極其輕盈的高效能鋰電池模組。

examples.en: She pulled a stylish mirrored makeup compact from her handbag to touch up her powder.
examples.zh: 她從隨身手提包中優雅拿出一只附帶精緻化妝鏡的隨身粉餅盒補妝撲粉。

entries.definition: 緊湊小巧的；小型的；粉餅

explains.en: This describes something small and arranged to use little space. A tiny camera can fit in a pocket. It is easy to carry.
A design can place many parts close together. The items still need to be easy to use. Careful planning helps.
The word can also name a small case of face powder. It may include a mirror and a soft applicator. Someone can carry it in a bag.

examples.en: The two paintings are comparable in size.
examples.zh: 這兩幅畫的大小相近，可以互相比較。

examples.en: Her score was comparable to the class average.
examples.zh: 她的分數和班級平均分相當。

examples.en: The new phone has features comparable to the older model.
examples.zh: 這支新手機有可媲美舊款的功能。

explains.en: This describes two things that can be compared because they share important features. Two books may tell similar kinds of stories. Readers can notice their differences too.
A person can compare the price and size of two bicycles. The information helps them choose. Clear facts make the choice easier.
Two tasks may require a similar amount of effort. People can compare them before making a plan. The details may not be exactly the same.

examples.en: Volunteers treat shelter animals with boundless warmth and tender compassion.
examples.zh: 志工們以無比溫暖的愛心與溫柔的慈悲心細心照護動物收容所裡的毛孩。

examples.en: Mother Teresa was globally renowned for her selfless compassion toward the destitute.
examples.zh: 德蕾莎修女以其對赤貧貧民無私奉獻的慈悲關懷而享譽全球。

examples.en: A truly humane society treats its most vulnerable members with dignity and compassion.
examples.zh: 一個真正仁慈的社會會以尊嚴與關懷來對待其最弱勢的成員。

examples.en: Boundless compassion prompts us to alleviate the suffering of all sentient living beings on Earth.
examples.zh: 廣大無私的慈悲心（Compassion），驅使著我們以溫柔的雙手撫慰世間所有生命承受的苦難與創痛。

examples.en: The dedicated social worker listened to the homeless veteran’s story with genuine warmth, dignity, and compassion.
examples.zh: 這位資深社工師以真誠溫暖、平等待人與深沉的慈悲同理心，耐心傾聽流浪街頭的榮民老伯伯訴說滄桑過往。

examples.en: Buddhist and Christian spiritual traditions share a foundational commitment to unconditional compassion and mercy.
examples.zh: 無論是東方佛家的普度眾生大悲願力，還是基督信仰中的神愛世人，皆在精神核心上崇尚無條件的慈悲、博愛與憐憫。

examples.en: True medical greatness blends cutting-edge scientific innovation with deep, heartfelt patient compassion.
examples.zh: 真正偉大的現代醫學，將頂尖尖端科學創新與床邊對病患無微不至的「同理與慈悲仁心」（Compassion）融為一體。

examples.en: The volunteer hospice worker sat beside the bed, holding the lonely patient’s hand with gentle compassion.
examples.zh: 安寧病房的愛心志工溫柔坐在病床旁，以滿懷慈悲同理的雙手緊緊握住孤單病患微顫的手心。

examples.en: Practicing empathy and compassion toward marginalized communities creates a kinder, more inclusive society.
examples.zh: 在日常生活中對弱勢族群抱持深切同理與慈悲關懷，方能攜手打造一個更加溫暖、包容而美好的文明社會。

entries.definition: 慈悲心；憐憫關懷；慈悲為懷廣大同情心；憐憫；臨床腫瘤醫師守護病患之無私同理慈悲心

explains.en: This is care for someone who is suffering or having a hard time. A friend may listen when another person feels upset. Kind support can help.
A person can notice another’s needs and offer help. They may bring food to a neighbor who is sick. Small actions matter.
People can show concern while respecting someone’s choices. Asking what help is wanted can be thoughtful. Listening is part of caring.

examples.en: Doctors applied for compassionate use approval to administer experimental medicine to critically ill patients.
examples.zh: 主治醫師緊急向衛福部專案申請「恩慈療法」（Compassionate Use），讓命在旦夕的重症病患使用試驗中新藥。

examples.en: The hospital's compassionate palliative care team ensures dying patients experience peace and dignity.
examples.zh: 該大型醫學中心的安寧緩和醫療團隊以無比溫柔的恩慈陪伴，確保末期病患在人生的最後一哩路享有尊嚴與安詳。

examples.en: The biotechnology firm granted compassionate access to their unapproved oncology drug free of charge.
examples.zh: 該生技新藥公司本著人道救死扶傷之崇高精神，無償免費提供處於臨床階段的未上市抗癌新藥供恩慈特案救治。

examples.en: True medical excellence combines cutting-edge AI technology with warm, compassionate bedside care.
examples.zh: 醫學殿堂的最高境界，在於將最頂尖的 AI 科技與視病猶親、充滿溫暖同理心（Compassionate）的床邊關懷完美結合。

examples.en: The compassionate hospice nurse held the dying patient's hand gently, offering quiet comfort during his final hours.
examples.zh: 充滿慈悲大愛的安寧病房護理師，溫柔握著走到生命終點臨終長輩乾枯的雙手，在最後時刻給予最平靜安詳的撫慰。

examples.en: Compassionate leaders listen actively to employee struggles and support their mental health during crises.
examples.zh: 具備仁愛同理心的卓越企業領袖，始終耐心傾聽同仁在工作與生活中的真實困境，並在家庭重大變故時給予最堅定的支持。

entries.definition: 恩慈療法特案核准的；富同情心的；仁心仁術視病猶親的

explains.en: This describes someone who cares about people in trouble. A teacher may listen patiently to a student who is worried. Support can help the student feel understood.
A person may show kindness by helping a neighbor carry groceries. They notice a need and offer assistance. A small favor can matter.
A caring response does not make fun of someone’s feelings. It gives them time to speak. Gentle words can comfort them.

examples.en: This USB-C charging cable is compatible with all modern smartphones.
examples.zh: 這條 Type-C 充電線與所有現代智慧型手機皆完全相容。

examples.en: The new software suite is fully compatible with older operating systems.
examples.zh: 這套新軟體套件與舊版作業系統完全相容。

examples.en: They make a great couple because their personalities and goals are highly compatible.
examples.zh: 他們是非常般配的情侶，因為性格與人生目標非常契合。

explains.en: This describes two things that can work or exist together. A plug must fit the outlet to work safely. Matching parts connect properly.
A program may run on a certain computer system. The maker lists which devices it supports. Checking the details helps users.
People can also be suited to work or live together. They share enough habits or interests to cooperate. Respect helps them get along.

examples.en: The rules compel everyone to wear a helmet.
examples.zh: 規定要求每個人都戴安全帽。

examples.en: Her kind words compelled him to say thank you.
examples.zh: 她善意的話讓他忍不住道謝。

examples.en: The deadline compelled the team to finish the poster today.
examples.zh: 截止期限迫使團隊今天完成海報。

entries.definition: （動）迫使、強迫；使某人因壓力或情況而不得不做某事。

explains.en: This means to force someone to do something or make it necessary. A rule may require students to wear safety goggles in a lab. The rule protects their eyes.
A strong feeling can make someone act quickly. A person may feel pushed to answer a question. They can pause and think first.
A deadline may make a team finish a task sooner. The group can divide the work and ask for help. Good planning reduces stress.

examples.en: The company compensated the worker for extra hours.
examples.zh: 公司補償了工人的加班費。

examples.en: The shop compensated us when the package arrived broken.
examples.zh: 包裹送達時已損壞，商店因此賠償我們。

examples.en: She tried to compensate for the mistake by correcting the report.
examples.zh: 她試著透過更正報告來彌補錯誤。

explains.en: This means to give someone money or another benefit for work or loss. A company may pay a worker for a job. The payment should match the agreement.
A person may receive money after an item is damaged. The amount can depend on the facts and rules. Keeping records can help explain what happened.
A person can make up for a mistake by fixing the problem. A sincere apology and helpful action may repair trust. People can discuss a fair solution.

examples.en: Travel insurance policies provide financial compensation for extended flight delays.
examples.zh: 出國前投保完整的海外旅遊不便險能針對因故延誤四小時以上的航班提供實質定額理賠。

examples.en: Passengers who were bumped from the overbooked flight received generous flight voucher compensation.
examples.zh: 因超賣機位而自願放棄當班座位的旅客，獲得了航空公司現場核發的優厚免費機票兌換券補償。

examples.en: Workers injured on the job are legally entitled to receive workers' disability compensation.
examples.zh: 依據勞工職業災害保險保障法，因公在工作場所受傷的勞工依法享有完整的工傷醫療與殘廢補償。

examples.en: The competitive total compensation package includes stock options, annual bonuses, and hybrid flexibility.
examples.zh: 這份極具市場競爭力的整體薪酬福利方案包含了公司股票選擇權、豐厚年終獎金與遠距彈性辦公。

examples.en: Workers injured on the job received financial compensation to cover medical bills and lost earnings.
examples.zh: 在工廠值勤時不幸遭受職業災害受傷的勞工，依法獲領全額醫療給付補助與原領薪資工傷補償金。

examples.en: Senior leadership reviewed regional compensation data to ensure employee wages keep pace with inflation.
examples.zh: 企業最高決策層定期調研同業市場薪酬報告，確保全體同仁的調薪幅度能實質跑贏通貨膨脹。

entries.definition: 班機延誤理賠補償金；報酬；整體薪酬福利套裝；補償金

explains.en: This is money or another benefit given for work or a loss. A worker may receive pay for completing a task. The amount depends on an agreement.
A person may be given money after something valuable is damaged. Rules explain how the amount is decided. Clear records can help.
The word can also mean something that makes up for a disadvantage. Extra time may help a student finish an assignment. A fair adjustment supports learning.

examples.en: The coach praised her competence on the field.
examples.zh: 教練稱讚她在球場上的能力。

examples.en: His competence with computers made him a good helper.
examples.zh: 他具備電腦專長，因此成為得力助手。

examples.en: The job requires competence in reading maps.
examples.zh: 這份工作需要具備閱讀地圖的能力。

explains.en: This is the ability to do a task well. A student can learn to solve math problems through practice. Each success builds skill.
A worker may show this ability by using tools safely. Training and experience help. Asking questions can improve performance.
A person can gain skill in speaking, drawing, or cooking. Feedback helps them learn. Regular practice can make a task easier.

examples.en: She is competent at fixing simple computer problems.
examples.zh: 她有能力修理簡單的電腦問題。

examples.en: The competent guide led us safely through the cave.
examples.zh: 稱職的導遊安全地帶我們穿過洞穴。

examples.en: He became competent in cooking after many lessons.
examples.zh: 上了許多課後，他熟練地學會烹飪。

explains.en: This describes someone who has enough skill to do a job well. A careful worker can follow directions and finish tasks. Practice builds ability.
A person may know how to use a tool safely. They can ask for training before starting. Knowing the steps helps avoid mistakes.
Someone with enough experience can help others learn. They explain each step clearly. Patience makes teaching easier.

examples.en: The complexity of the game made it fun to learn.
examples.zh: 遊戲的複雜性讓學習過程更有趣。

examples.en: We studied the complexity of the water system.
examples.zh: 我們研究了供水系統的複雜程度。

examples.en: The puzzle’s complexity surprised the students.
examples.zh: 謎題的複雜性令學生們驚訝。

entries.definition: （名）複雜性；由許多互相關聯的部分所形成的難度。

explains.en: This is the state of having many parts or details. A puzzle with many pieces may take time to finish. Sorting by color can help.
A machine may have many connected parts that work together. Learning each part’s job can make it easier to understand. Diagrams help.
A difficult story may have several characters and events. Readers can take notes to follow what happens. Breaking it into sections can help.

examples.en: Every licensed fintech startup hires certified compliance officers to adhere to national banking laws.
examples.zh: 每一家獲准營運的金融科技新創皆聘請專業法遵專員，以嚴格確保各項創新商業模式全然合法合規。

examples.en: The auditor reviewed internal software logs to verify full compliance with European GDPR privacy rules.
examples.zh: 外部資安稽核專家逐一調閱內部系統連線日誌，嚴格審查公司是否全然符合歐盟 GDPR 嚴格的個資隱私規範。

examples.en: Failure to demonstrate environmental regulatory compliance can lead to hefty corporate environmental fines.
examples.zh: 若企業在生產製造過程中無法出具符合國家環保法規的合規排放證明，將面臨勒令停工與巨額環保裁罰。

examples.en: Smart pillboxes with flashing alarms improve patient medication compliance, preventing blood pressure spikes.
examples.zh: 具備定時聲光提醒的智慧藥盒大幅提升了慢性病患的「服藥遵從性」（Compliance），防止血壓忽高忽低。

examples.en: The semiconductor corporation underwent an exhaustive audit to ensure full regulatory environmental compliance.
examples.zh: 該大型半導體晶圓廠主動接受各項嚴苛的環評查核，確保全廠廢水排放與廢氣處理百分之百符合法規遵循標準。

examples.en: Patient compliance with daily physical therapy exercises directly determines the success of knee replacement surgery.
examples.zh: 病患在人工全膝關節置換術後能否持之以恆嚴格配合每日下肢肌力復健操，直接決定了術後行走功能的恢復成效。

examples.en: Audits verified full regulatory compliance with international clinical good practice standards.
examples.zh: 衛福部外部稽核員進行全面查核，確認臨床試驗百分之百符合國際法規「合規標準」（Compliance）。

examples.en: Ensuring strict environmental compliance saved the manufacturing plant from crippling regulatory fines.
examples.zh: 嚴格遵守各項環保排污合規標準，讓這座現代化工廠免於遭受環保稽查局巨額停工罰款的處分。

examples.en: The bank established an internal compliance department to guard against money laundering and fraud.
examples.zh: 該跨國商業銀行設立了專業獨立的法規遵循合規部門，日夜嚴密防範洗錢防制與金融舞弊交易。
