entries.definition: 法令遵循審查 (法遵)；順從；慢病病患定時按時服藥遵從性；嚴格遵循國際藥品優良臨床試驗規範

explains.en: This is the act of following a rule, request, or instruction. A student may follow the teacher’s directions during a science activity. Careful steps help everyone.
A company may check that its work follows laws and safety rules. Clear records show what was done. Regular checks can find problems.
People may follow an agreement because they understand its purpose. Asking questions can clear up confusion. Shared understanding makes cooperation easier.

examples.en: Grand complication timepieces incorporate minute repeaters, perpetual calendars, and split-second chronographs.
examples.zh: 「大複雜功能腕錶」（Complication），在一枚小巧機芯中集結了三問報時、萬年曆與雙追針計時。

examples.en: Adding a dual-timezone GMT complication makes the sports watch an ideal companion for frequent business flyers.
examples.zh: 融入實用的雙時區 GMT 複雜功能，使這款奢華運動腕錶成為經常跨國出差商務人士的完美夥伴。

examples.en: The sudden medical complication prompted surgeons to modify their operative strategy immediately.
examples.zh: 手術過程中突發的急性醫療併發症，促使外科主治醫師立即果斷調整原有手術處置策略。

entries.definition: 大複雜功能機械腕錶 (三問、萬年曆、陀飛輪)

explains.en: This is an extra problem that happens along with a main problem. A cold may lead to a cough that makes someone feel worse. Rest and care may help.
A project can face an unexpected difficulty. A missing tool may delay the work. The team can make a new plan.
A machine may have an added feature that makes it more complicated. The user can read the guide to learn how it works. Clear instructions help.

examples.en: She gave her friend a compliment on the bright scarf.
examples.zh: 她稱讚朋友那條色彩鮮豔的圍巾。

examples.en: The coach complimented the team’s effort.
examples.zh: 教練稱讚了全隊的努力。

examples.en: I received a compliment about my drawing.
examples.zh: 我收到別人對我畫作的稱讚。

explains.en: This is a kind remark about someone or something. A friend may say that your drawing has lovely colors. The praise can make you smile.
A person can say something nice about another’s effort. Honest praise feels meaningful. It can encourage someone to keep practicing.
People may praise a helpful action. Saying thank you shows that they noticed. Kind words can brighten a day.

examples.en: Please comply with the library’s quiet rules.
examples.zh: 請遵守圖書館的安靜規定。

examples.en: The company complied with the safety requirements.
examples.zh: 公司遵守了安全要求。

examples.en: Drivers must comply with the posted speed limit.
examples.zh: 駕駛人必須遵守張貼的速限。

explains.en: This means to do what a rule or request says. People may follow a sign that asks them to walk slowly. The rule helps protect everyone.
A worker may follow steps for using a machine. Reading directions first can prevent mistakes. Safety is important.
A person may agree to meet a promise or requirement. Keeping the agreement helps others trust them. Clear reminders can help.

examples.en: High-precision electronic components are assembled inside clean rooms.
examples.zh: 高精密電子零組件均在無塵室環境內進行組裝與封測。

examples.en: Trust and honest communication are vital components of any healthy working relationship.
examples.zh: 互相信任與誠懇透明的溝通，是維繫任何健康良好工作合作關係最不可或缺的基石。

examples.en: The automobile repair technician replaced a faulty mechanical component in the braking system.
examples.zh: 汽車維修技師迅速拆卸並更換了煞車制動系統中出現疲勞受損的故障機械零組件。

explains.en: This is one part of a larger thing or system. A bicycle has wheels, pedals, and a frame. Each part helps it move.
A computer has parts that work together to process information. Each one has a different job. A broken part can affect the whole machine.
A recipe has several parts, such as flour, eggs, and water. Each ingredient helps make the finished food. Following the steps matters.

examples.en: Albert Einstein famously called compound interest the eighth wonder of the world.
examples.zh: 愛因斯坦曾讚譽「複利效應」（Compound Interest）是人類世界中的第八大奇蹟。

examples.en: Reinvesting your stock dividends harnesses the incredible long-term power of compound growth.
examples.zh: 長期將每期領到的股票現金股利全數滾入再投資，能徹底釋放指數投資驚人的時間複利威力。

examples.en: Compound annual growth rates measure an investment's smoothed return over multiple years.
examples.zh: 年化複合成長率（CAGR）能客觀平滑評估一項投資資產在歷經數年牛熊考驗後的真實實質回報。

examples.en: Compound movements recruit multiple muscle groups simultaneously for maximum efficiency.
examples.zh: 包含深蹲、硬舉與臥推在內的多關節複合動作能同時動員全身多組大肌群，燃脂效率極高。

examples.en: Prioritize heavy compound exercises at the beginning of your training session.
examples.zh: 建議在重訓一開始體力最充沛時，優先進行大重量的多關節複合動作。

examples.en: Exercises like pull-ups and squats are compound movements that burn more calories per set.
examples.zh: 像是引體向上與深蹲等複合動作，每組能燃燒消耗的熱量遠高於單關節孤立動作。

examples.en: Medicinal chemists synthesized a potent lead compound showing remarkable tumor-shrinking capabilities.
examples.zh: 藥物化學家成功人工合成出一種活性極強的先導化合物（Lead Compound），在試驗中展現驚人縮小腫瘤效果。

examples.en: Water is a chemical compound consisting of two hydrogen atoms bonded to one oxygen atom.
examples.zh: 純淨的水是一種由兩個氫原子與一個氧原子透過化學鍵緊密鍵結而成的無機化合物。

examples.en: The novel antibacterial compound demonstrated strong bactericidal activity against drug-resistant superbugs.
examples.zh: 這種全新開發的人工合成抗菌先導化合物，在實驗中展現出強力撲殺多重抗藥性超級細菌的卓越活性。

examples.en: Strawberries and basil share common aromatic compounds, creating a natural harmony on the dessert plate.
examples.zh: 草莓與羅勒在化學分析上共享了關鍵的「揮發性芳香化合物」（Compounds），在甜點盤中譜出天作之合。

examples.en: Water is a simple chemical compound formed by two hydrogen atoms covalently bonded to one oxygen atom.
examples.zh: 水是由兩個氫原子與一個氧原子以共價鍵緊密鍵合而成的一種最常見化學化合物。

examples.en: The foreign diplomatic staff resided inside a heavily guarded embassy compound downtown.
examples.zh: 外國使館全體外交工作人員，集中居住在市中心戒備森嚴的駐外使領館住宅園區內。

entries.definition: 複利的；複合的；複合物；多關節複合的；複合式的；候選先導化合物；食材內部共享之相同揮發性芳香化合物；化合物

explains.en: This describes something made of two or more different parts or substances. A cake may combine flour, eggs, and fruit. Each part adds something.
The word can name a substance made by joining elements. A science class may study how its parts behave. Safe lab rules are important.
A fenced area with buildings inside can also have this name. A gate controls who enters. The residents may share the space.

examples.en: I could not comprehend the long directions until the teacher explained them.
examples.zh: 老師解釋長篇指示後，我才理解內容。

examples.en: She comprehended the story after reading it twice.
examples.zh: 她讀了兩次才理解這個故事。

examples.en: The diagram helped us comprehend how the water system works.
examples.zh: 圖解幫我們理解供水系統如何運作。

explains.en: This means to understand an idea or message. A reader may study a sentence twice to grasp its meaning. Examples can make it clearer.
A person can learn how a machine works by watching each part. They ask questions and connect the steps. Patience helps build understanding.
A child may listen to directions and then repeat them in their own words. This shows they followed the message. Asking for help is okay.

examples.en: Deep listening comprehension allows you to appreciate subtle jokes and cultural nuances in movies.
examples.zh: 卓越的「聽力與閱讀理解力」（Comprehension），讓你能心領神會英美電影中的幽默笑點與文化隱喻。

examples.en: The standardized examination tests both rapid reading speed and nuanced reading comprehension.
examples.zh: 這項標準化測驗同時評量考生迅速掃描文章的速度，以及對深層語意的精確理解力。

examples.en: Practicing with authentic audio podcasts helps elevate your everyday speech comprehension.
examples.zh: 經常收聽道地的英文播客節目，能顯著提升你對日常生活快速談話的聽力理解度。

entries.definition: 深刻理解幽默、隱喻與弦外之音之聽讀理解力；理解

explains.en: This is the ability to understand what someone reads or hears. A student can answer questions about a story. The answers show what the student understood.
A person may understand words but miss the main idea. Taking notes can help connect details. Practice improves this skill.
Listening carefully can help someone follow spoken directions. Repeating the steps can check understanding. Clear speech helps listeners.

examples.en: The meal comprises rice, vegetables, and soup.
examples.zh: 這餐包含米飯、蔬菜和湯。

examples.en: The team comprises students from three classes.
examples.zh: 隊伍由三個班級的學生組成。

examples.en: The book comprises ten short chapters.
examples.zh: 這本書包含十個短篇章。

entries.definition: （動）包含、由……組成；構成整體的部分包括某些成分。

explains.en: This means to include several parts as members of a whole. A fruit salad may have apples, grapes, and bananas. Each fruit is part of the dish.
A team can have people with different skills. Together they make the whole group. Each person has a role.
A plan may list several tasks that make up a project. Checking each task helps the group know what remains. A clear list is useful.

examples.en: In team projects, finding a fair compromise is often necessary.
examples.zh: 在團隊合作中，尋求公平合理的折衷妥協往往是必要的。

examples.en: After hours of negotiations, management and labor finally agreed on a compromise.
examples.zh: 歷經數小時的艱辛協商談判，勞資雙方終於在各退一步的前提下達成了妥協。

examples.en: Never compromise on construction safety standards merely to speed up delivery deadlines.
examples.zh: 絕不能僅僅為了趕在交期日前搶工完工，就在建築施工安全標準上妥協退讓。

examples.en: Both sides compromised on payment timelines to finalize the partnership.
examples.zh: 雙方在付款分期時程上各自作出了合理折衷妥協，最終促成了策略結盟。

examples.en: Finding a fair compromise is often necessary when balancing budget and features.
examples.zh: 在平衡預算與功能需求時，尋求合理的折衷妥協通常是不可避免的。

examples.en: Never compromise user data security to rush a software release date.
examples.zh: 絕不能為了趕著軟體上線日期而犧牲或危及使用者的資料安全。

entries.definition: 妥協；折衷；讓步；折衷方案；危及

explains.en: This means to settle a disagreement by having each side give up part of what it wants. Friends may choose a game both enjoy. Sharing can solve the problem.
A middle choice can help people agree. Each person listens and suggests a fair change. The final plan may satisfy everyone somewhat.
The word can also mean to put something at risk. Sharing a password may threaten the safety of an account. Private information should be protected.

examples.en: Freshman English is a compulsory course for all university freshmen.
examples.zh: 大一英文是所有大學新鮮人的必修課程。

examples.en: Nine years of compulsory education is guaranteed by national law.
examples.zh: 國家法律保障國民享有九年義務強制的基礎教育。

examples.en: Wearing safety helmets on motorcycles is compulsory in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣騎乘機車強制規定必須佩戴安全帽。

examples.en: Freshman English is a compulsory required subject for all incoming students.
examples.zh: 大一英文是全體大一新生必須共同修習的必修科目。

examples.en: Basic military training is compulsory for eligible male citizens in many countries.
examples.zh: 在許多國家，役男公民依法接受基礎軍事常規訓練是法定的義務義務。

examples.en: Wearing safety hard hats is compulsory at all construction worksites.
examples.zh: 在所有建築工地施工現場，所有人皆一律強制佩戴安全帽。

explains.en: This describes something that must be done because of a rule. Students may have to wear a safety helmet on a bike trip. The rule protects them.
A class can be required for every student in a program. Everyone takes it before choosing other lessons. The school sets the plan.
An official form may need to be completed. A person must provide the requested details. Reading instructions helps avoid mistakes.

examples.en: She concealed the present under her bed.
examples.zh: 她把禮物藏在床底下。

examples.en: The bushes concealed the small bird from view.
examples.zh: 灌木叢遮住了那隻小鳥，讓人看不見。

examples.en: He tried to conceal his surprise at the news.
examples.zh: 他試圖掩飾自己聽到消息後的驚訝。

explains.en: This means to keep something out of sight. A child may put a birthday gift inside a closet. The surprise stays secret until the party.
A person may cover an object with a cloth. The object is not easy to see. The covering can protect it from dust.
A character in a story may keep a secret from friends. Later, the truth may come out. Honest conversation can solve problems.

examples.en: The team conceded that their opponents had played better.
examples.zh: 隊伍承認對手表現得更好。

examples.en: She conceded that she had made a mistake.
examples.zh: 她承認自己犯了錯。

examples.en: He finally conceded the point after hearing the evidence.
examples.zh: 聽到證據後，他終於承認這個論點。

explains.en: This means to admit that something is true, especially after first disagreeing. A player may accept that the other team scored fairly. Honesty matters.
A person can agree that an idea is good after hearing reasons. Listening can change someone’s mind. Respectful discussion helps.
A person may admit that they made a mistake. Saying so can help fix the problem. Taking responsibility builds trust.

examples.en: The designer conceived a clever plan for the playground.
examples.zh: 設計師構思出遊樂場的巧妙計畫。

examples.en: She conceived the idea while walking home.
examples.zh: 她在回家路上想到這個點子。

examples.en: They conceived a new game for rainy days.
examples.zh: 他們想出一款雨天可玩的新遊戲。

explains.en: This means to form an idea in the mind. An artist may picture a new design before drawing it. Sketches can help develop the idea.
A person can imagine how a plan might work. They think through the steps and possible problems. Planning helps turn ideas into action.
Someone may create an idea for a story or invention. They can write it down before they forget. Sharing it may bring helpful feedback.

examples.en: Her conception of the story changed after the first draft.
examples.zh: 初稿完成後，她對故事的構想改變了。

examples.en: The project began with a simple conception of a garden classroom.
examples.zh: 這個計畫起初只是想打造一間簡單的花園教室。

examples.en: The book explains the artist’s conception of the city.
examples.zh: 這本書說明了藝術家對城市的構想。

entries.definition: （名）構想、概念；形成想法的過程；也可指受孕。

explains.en: This is an idea or plan formed in someone’s mind. A child may imagine a new kind of treehouse. Drawing it can help explain the plan.
The beginning of a project may involve deciding what it should do. People share thoughts and choose a direction. Careful planning is useful.
People can have different ideas about how something works. They compare facts and examples. Discussion can improve understanding.

examples.en: The teacher condemned the cruel prank.
examples.zh: 老師譴責了那個殘酷的惡作劇。

examples.en: The group condemned the plan to damage the playground.
examples.zh: 這個團體譴責破壞遊樂場的計畫。

examples.en: The judge condemned the unsafe building practices.
examples.zh: 法官譴責了不安全的建築做法。

entries.definition: 譴責；判定有罪；宣告不適用；迫使陷入。

explains.en: This means to say that someone or something is very wrong. A class may speak against unfair treatment. They explain why it should stop.
A judge may officially state that a person’s action broke a rule. The decision follows careful review. Facts are important.
People can strongly criticize harmful behavior. They should focus on the action and use respectful words. Clear reasons help others understand.

examples.en: The school expects good conduct from every student.
examples.zh: 學校要求每位學生都有良好行為。

examples.en: She conducted the orchestra during the concert.
examples.zh: 她在音樂會上指揮管弦樂團。

examples.en: The researchers conducted a survey about reading habits.
examples.zh: 研究人員進行了一項閱讀習慣調查。

entries.definition: （動）進行；指揮；引導；（名）行為；舉止

explains.en: This can mean the way a person behaves. A student who listens and shares shows good behavior. Families teach children how to act kindly.
The verb can mean to lead or manage an event. A teacher may guide a science experiment. Clear instructions help students.
A person can carry out a survey by asking the same questions. Careful records make the results more useful. The method should be fair.

examples.en: His confession surprised the whole family.
examples.zh: 他的坦白讓全家人都很驚訝。

examples.en: She made a confession about breaking the vase.
examples.zh: 她坦承自己打破了花瓶。

examples.en: The letter contained a confession to the mistake.
examples.zh: 信中有一段對錯誤的坦白。

explains.en: This is a statement in which someone admits they did something wrong or tells a hidden truth. A person may admit taking a cookie without asking. Honesty can help repair trust.
In a story, a character may reveal a secret to a friend. The friend listens and asks questions. The truth can change their relationship.
People may share an honest admission with someone they trust. The listener should respond calmly. Taking responsibility is a useful first step.

examples.en: The confidential letter was kept in a locked drawer.
examples.zh: 這封機密信件被鎖在抽屜裡。

examples.en: Please keep this information confidential.
examples.zh: 請對這項資訊保密。

examples.en: They held a confidential meeting about the new plan.
examples.zh: 他們舉行了一場討論新計畫的保密會議。

entries.definition: （形）機密的、保密的；只供特定人士知道或使用。

explains.en: This describes information meant to be kept private. A doctor’s notes about a patient should not be shared with strangers. Privacy matters.
A person may share a secret with someone they trust. The listener should not repeat it without permission. Trust can be broken.
A private meeting may include personal details. Attendees should follow the rules for sharing information. Careful handling protects people.

examples.en: The fence confined the goats to one field.
examples.zh: 圍欄把山羊限制在一塊田地裡。

examples.en: The nurse confined the patient to bed for a short rest.
examples.zh: 護士讓病人短時間臥床休息。

examples.en: They confined the noisy work to daytime hours.
examples.zh: 他們把吵雜的工程限制在白天進行。

entries.definition: 限制；使局限；禁閉；集中於。

explains.en: This means to keep someone or something within a limited place or area. A fence can keep a pet inside a yard. A gate lets it enter or leave.
A rule may limit when or how something can happen. The limits can make an activity safer. People should understand the rules.
A person may stay indoors while resting from an illness. Family members can bring food and help. A health professional can advise them.

examples.en: The building conforms to the town’s safety rules.
examples.zh: 這棟建築符合鎮上的安全規定。

examples.en: The colors conform to the artist’s original design.
examples.zh: 顏色符合藝術家的原始設計。

examples.en: Each label must conform to the same format.
examples.zh: 每個標籤都必須符合相同格式。

explains.en: This means to follow a rule or match a pattern. Students may wear a uniform at school. Everyone follows the same clothing rule.
A shape can match another shape in size or form. A puzzle piece fits when its edges line up. Careful matching is needed.
A person may act like a group to fit in. It is also okay to be different while treating others kindly. Respect matters.

examples.en: She confronted her friend about the broken promise.
examples.zh: 她就朋友失信一事直接找他談。

examples.en: The team confronted a difficult challenge together.
examples.zh: 團隊一起面對一項艱難挑戰。

examples.en: He confronted the problem instead of ignoring it.
examples.zh: 他沒有忽視問題，而是正面處理。

explains.en: This means to face a difficult problem or speak directly to someone about it. A student may tell a classmate that a hurtful joke was unkind. Calm words can help.
A team can face a challenge by making a plan. Members share the work and ask for support. Small steps make it manageable.
A person may meet an unexpected situation bravely. They can gather facts before deciding what to do. Help is available.

examples.en: The confrontation ended after the coach spoke to both players.
examples.zh: 教練和兩名球員談過後，衝突便結束了。

examples.en: They avoided a confrontation by discussing the issue calmly.
examples.zh: 他們冷靜討論問題，避免了正面衝突。

examples.en: A confrontation between the neighbors began over a loud noise.
examples.zh: 鄰居間因噪音開始發生衝突。

entries.definition: （名）對峙、衝突；雙方直接面對並爭論或對抗。

explains.en: This is a direct meeting or argument between people who disagree. Voices may become upset. Calm discussion can prevent things from getting worse.
Two groups may meet to discuss a serious problem. A helper can make sure each side is heard. Clear rules support fairness.
A story may include a tense encounter between two characters. Their words show the conflict. They may later find a solution.

examples.en: She attended class for five consecutive days.
examples.zh: 她連續五天都有上課。

examples.en: The team won three consecutive games.
examples.zh: 隊伍連續贏了三場比賽。

examples.en: It rained on four consecutive mornings.
examples.zh: 連續四個早晨都下雨。

explains.en: This describes things that happen one after another without a break. A student may read for five days in a row. A calendar can show each day.
A team may win several games in a row. Fans celebrate the pattern. One later loss does not erase the effort.
A person may work several hours without stopping. Taking breaks can help them stay healthy. It is good to rest when needed.

examples.en: After extensive discussions, the board reached unanimous consensus on expansion.
examples.zh: 歷經深入詳實的評估討論，董事會就海外擴張計畫達成了全票通過的一致共識。

examples.en: Building consensus takes time, but it guarantees stronger commitment from everyone.
examples.zh: 凝聚團隊共識需要花費時間，但它能確保每個人都抱持更堅定的投入度。

examples.en: The scientific consensus is that greenhouse gas emissions contribute to global warming.
examples.zh: 科學界的普遍共識是溫室氣體排放造成了全球暖化。

examples.en: Building broad societal consensus on renewable energy requires patient dialogue across all sectors.
examples.zh: 在推動能源轉型等重大國家政策上凝聚廣泛的「社會共識」（Consensus），需要政府與民間展開耐心的長期對話。

examples.en: The scientific consensus is overwhelming: human activities are driving accelerated changes in the global climate.
examples.zh: 全球頂尖科學界已達成壓倒性的壓倒性科學共識：人類頻繁的化石燃料活動正是驅動全球氣候急遽變遷的罪魁禍首。

examples.en: Reaching an amicable family consensus regarding holiday travel plans took several lively dinner discussions.
examples.zh: 全家人在餐桌上經過幾番熱烈愉快的討論後，終於就今年過年全家出遊行程達成了其樂融融的家庭共識。

entries.definition: 團隊共識；意見一致；跨黨派凝聚社會廣泛共識

explains.en: This is a shared decision or opinion reached by a group. Members discuss choices and try to find a plan most can accept. Listening helps.
A team may agree on which project to do after considering ideas. Everyone can support the chosen plan. The group moves forward together.
People may not share every detail of an idea but still agree on the main point. They can note remaining differences. Clear discussion is useful.

examples.en: Trial participants must sign informed consent forms after fully understanding all potential experimental risks.
examples.zh: 所有參與臨床試驗的受試者在充分了解各項試驗流程與潛在副作用風險後，必須親筆簽署知情同意書。

examples.en: Parents must provide written consent before minors can participate in pediatric clinical studies.
examples.zh: 在未成年兒童正式參與小兒科臨床試驗研究之前，其法定代理人父母親必須出具完整的書面知情同意書。

examples.en: The ethics committee verified that patients gave their consent freely without any financial coercion.
examples.zh: 醫學倫理審查委員會再三嚴格稽核，確認所有受試病患皆是在完全知情、毫無任何金錢脅迫下自主簽署同意。

examples.en: Doctors explained all potential risks before the volunteer signed the informed consent document.
examples.zh: 在受試者正式簽署「知情同意書」（Informed Consent）前，主治醫師巨細靡遺解釋所有潛在風險與替代療法。

examples.en: Parents must provide written parental consent before minor children can participate in overnight school camps.
examples.zh: 未成年學童在報名參加學校舉辦的隔宿露營活動前，必須取得法定代理人簽署的家長同意書。

examples.en: By mutual consent, both companies agreed to terminate the joint venture without seeking legal damages.
examples.zh: 經過雙方友好充分協商，兩家企業達成一致共識，同意平和終止合資合作協議且互不索賠賠償。

entries.definition: 受試者知情同意書；同意；病患受試者簽署完全知情同意書

explains.en: This means to agree to something after understanding what it involves. A student may say yes to joining a school activity. They can ask questions first.
A person should be free to say yes or no to a request. Clear information helps them decide. Their choice should be respected.
A group may need permission from members before taking an action. Everyone should understand the plan. People can change their minds when appropriate.

examples.en: Energy conservation in homes helps lower carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 居家節約能源有助於降低碳排放量。

examples.en: Wildlife conservation programs have revived the local Formosan sika deer population.
examples.zh: 野生動物保育計畫成功讓本土台灣梅花鹿族群得以復育繁衍。

examples.en: Turning off faucets while brushing teeth is an effortless daily water conservation habit.
examples.zh: 刷牙時隨手關緊水龍頭是毫不費力的日常節約用水好習慣。

examples.en: Water conservation habits like short showers help during dry spring seasons.
examples.zh: 養成縮減淋浴時間等節約用水好習慣能安度春季乾旱枯水期。

examples.en: Wildlife conservation groups work around the clock to protect green sea turtle nesting grounds.
examples.zh: 野生動植物保育民間團體日以繼夜全力奔走，悉心守護綠蠵龜在離島沙灘上的產卵棲地。

examples.en: The national park enforces strict environmental conservation regulations to keep the alpine forest pristine.
examples.zh: 國家公園依法嚴格執行各項自然環境資源保育法令規章，竭力維護這片高山冷溫帶原始林的純淨。

examples.en: Modern architectural conservation relies on non-destructive sonic testing to assess internal timber decay.
examples.zh: 現代建築文化資產科學保存，仰賴非破壞性超音波檢測評估古木柱內部的腐朽程度。

examples.en: International charters emphasize minimal intervention as a golden rule in architectural conservation.
examples.zh: 國際保存憲章一再強調最低限度干預，作為建築文化資產保存修復的黃金法則。

examples.en: The university established a graduate institute specializing in paper and mural painting conservation.
examples.zh: 這所大學創立了專門針對紙質古籍與壁畫修護的文化資產科學保存研究所。

entries.definition: 保育；節約；保存；環境保護；有形文化資產科學保存與修復

explains.en: This is the care and protection of nature, historic objects, or useful resources. A park worker may protect a forest and its animals. Visitors can help by following rules.
People can save water by turning off a tap while brushing their teeth. Small actions can add up. Careful use protects supplies.
A museum may carefully protect an old painting from light and dust. Experts use safe methods to keep it in good shape. Future visitors can see it.

examples.en: It was considerate of him to save me a seat.
examples.zh: 他替我留個位子，真是體貼。

examples.en: She left a note so her roommate would not worry, which was considerate.
examples.zh: 她留了張字條，讓室友不必擔心，真周到。

examples.en: The considerate driver stopped to let the family cross.
examples.zh: 體貼的駕駛停下來讓一家人先過馬路。

explains.en: This describes someone who thinks about other people’s comfort. A person may hold a door open for someone carrying bags. Small acts show care.
A thoughtful classmate may speak quietly while a friend is reading. Respecting others can make a shared place pleasant. People notice kindness.
Someone may offer a seat to a tired passenger. Looking around helps a person notice what others need. Helpful actions can make a difference.

examples.en: The court reviewed the constitutional question.
examples.zh: 法院審理了這項憲法問題。

examples.en: The class learned about constitutional rights.
examples.zh: 全班學習了憲法所保障的權利。

examples.en: The constitutional rules explain how the government works.
examples.zh: 憲法規則說明政府如何運作。

entries.definition: （形）憲法的；合乎憲法的；體質的

explains.en: This describes something related to the basic laws and structure of a country. A written set of rules may explain how leaders are chosen. People can study those rules.
A country’s main legal document may describe people’s rights. Courts and leaders must follow its rules. The document guides public life.
A change to the basic structure of government can affect many people. Careful discussion is important. Citizens may learn how decisions are made.

examples.en: The budget constraint limited our choices.
examples.zh: 預算限制了我們的選擇。

examples.en: Time was the main constraint during the project.
examples.zh: 時間是這項專題的主要限制。

examples.en: A low ceiling was a constraint for the tall bookshelf.
examples.zh: 低矮的天花板限制了書架的高度。

entries.definition: （名）限制、約束；妨礙行動或選擇的條件。

explains.en: This is a limit or difficulty that makes an action harder. A small budget may prevent a team from buying every supply. They can choose carefully.
A rule may restrict where a person can go. Signs explain what areas are safe. Following instructions can prevent trouble.
A lack of time can limit how much work gets done. Making a list helps people focus. They may ask for more time if needed.

examples.en: The doctor scheduled a consultation with the family.
examples.zh: 醫生安排了一次與家人的諮詢。

examples.en: We had a consultation about the garden design.
examples.zh: 我們討論了花園設計。

examples.en: She booked a short consultation with the school counselor.
examples.zh: 她和學校輔導員約了一次簡短諮詢。

entries.definition: 諮詢；商議；會診；諮詢會議。

explains.en: This is a meeting where someone asks for advice or information. A family may talk with a travel worker before a trip. They can ask about routes.
A person may meet a professional to discuss a question. The professional listens and explains possible next steps. Clear details help.
A group may talk together before choosing a plan. Everyone shares concerns and ideas. Listening can lead to a better decision.

examples.en: The report measured energy consumption in the school.
examples.zh: 報告測量了學校的能源消耗。

examples.en: Our household reduced water consumption this summer.
examples.zh: 我們家今年夏天減少了用水量。

examples.en: Food consumption increased during the festival.
examples.zh: 節慶期間食品消耗量增加。

entries.definition: （名）消耗；消費；食用量；（舊）肺結核

explains.en: This is the act of using food, fuel, or other goods. A family may use electricity to light its home. Turning off unused lights can save it.
People eat food to get energy. Different meals provide different nutrients. Drinking water is also important.
A factory uses materials to make products. Careful use can reduce waste. Recycling can help save resources.

examples.en: The nurse explained that the illness was contagious.
examples.zh: 護理師解釋這種疾病具有傳染性。

examples.en: Some contagious diseases spread through close contact.
examples.zh: 有些傳染病會透過密切接觸傳播。

examples.en: Her laughter was contagious, and soon everyone smiled.
examples.zh: 她的笑聲很有感染力，很快大家都笑了。

explains.en: This describes an illness or germ that can pass from one person to another. Some germs spread when people are close together. Clean habits can lower the chance of passing them on.
A person who feels sick can rest and tell a trusted adult. Health workers explain what steps are helpful. People should be kind and avoid teasing.
The word can also describe a feeling or idea that spreads among a group. One person’s laughter may make others laugh too. The mood can pass quickly.

examples.en: The spill contaminated the pond.
examples.zh: 液體外洩污染了池塘。

examples.en: Dirty hands can contaminate food.
examples.zh: 手不乾淨可能會污染食物。

examples.en: The factory worked to prevent chemicals from contaminating the soil.
examples.zh: 工廠設法防止化學物質污染土壤。

entries.definition: （動）污染；使水、食物或環境混入有害或不潔物質。

explains.en: This means to make something dirty or unsafe by adding harmful material. Oil spilled into a stream can hurt animals and plants. People should report pollution.
Food can become unsafe if raw meat touches ready-to-eat food. Keeping items separate helps protect meals. Clean hands matter.
A chemical leak may damage soil or water. Trained workers can clean it safely. People should stay away from the area.

examples.en: She contemplated the answer before raising her hand.
examples.zh: 她舉手前仔細思考了答案。

examples.en: We contemplated taking the train instead of driving.
examples.zh: 我們考慮搭火車，不開車。

examples.en: He sat by the window and contemplated the drawing.
examples.zh: 他坐在窗邊思索那幅畫。

explains.en: This means to think carefully about a choice or question. A student may sit quietly and consider which book to read. Taking time can help.
A person may imagine what could happen if they choose a certain plan. They think about benefits and problems. Advice can be useful.
Someone can think about a place they hope to visit. They may look at pictures and make a list. Planning turns an idea into a real trip.

examples.en: The museum shows contemporary art.
examples.zh: 博物館展示當代藝術。

examples.en: The two contemporary writers exchanged letters.
examples.zh: 那兩位同時代的作家交換過書信。

examples.en: She enjoys contemporary music from many countries.
examples.zh: 她喜歡來自許多國家的當代音樂。

entries.definition: （形）當代的；同時期的；（名）同時代的人

explains.en: This describes something from the present time or the same period. A new song may use sounds popular today. Listeners can hear current styles.
Two writers who lived during the same years may have shared ideas. Their work can be compared. History gives context.
A person may wear clothes with a style that is popular now. Fashion can change over time. People can choose what feels comfortable.

examples.en: He spoke with contempt about the unfair rule.
examples.zh: 他用輕蔑的口吻談論那項不公平規則。

examples.en: The character treated the poor villagers with contempt.
examples.zh: 故事中的角色輕蔑地對待貧困村民。

examples.en: She showed contempt for bullying by standing up for the student.
examples.zh: 她挺身幫助那位學生，表達對霸凌行為的不屑。

explains.en: This is a strong feeling of disrespect or dislike for someone or something. A person may feel this after seeing unfair behavior. Calm discussion can help.
A character may look down on another person in a story. Their words show disrespect. The other character may feel hurt.
People can disagree without showing disrespect. Listening and using kind words helps keep a discussion fair. Everyone deserves dignity.

examples.en: The two runners contended for first place.
examples.zh: 兩位跑者爭奪第一名。

examples.en: She contends that the rule is unfair.
examples.zh: 她主張這條規則不公平。

examples.en: The teams will contend for the championship.
examples.zh: 兩支隊伍將競逐冠軍。

entries.definition: （動）競爭、奮鬥；主張、堅稱；依語境判斷。

explains.en: This means to compete or struggle for something. Two teams may try to win the same prize. Practice helps them do their best.
A person may state that something is true. They should give facts to support the claim. Others can check the evidence.
People can disagree about how to solve a problem. They may each argue for a different plan. Listening helps them understand each side.

examples.en: The continental climate brings cold winters to the inland town.
examples.zh: 內陸城鎮的冬天寒冷，呈現大陸型氣候。

examples.en: They crossed the continental landmass by train.
examples.zh: 他們搭火車橫越整個大陸。

examples.en: The hotel served a continental breakfast with fruit and bread.
examples.zh: 飯店提供包含水果與麵包的大陸式早餐。

entries.definition: 大陸的；洲際的；歐洲大陸的。

explains.en: This describes something related to a large continuous area of land. A map may show a wide landmass with many countries. Oceans can separate it from others.
The climate of a large land area may differ from island weather. Inland places can have hotter summers and colder winters. This land can stretch across several countries.
A breakfast served in a style associated with Europe may include bread, cheese, and fruit. Hotels sometimes use this name for a light meal. It is usually a light meal.

examples.en: The general contractor finished the residential tower ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 總營造承包商提前於預定工期順利完成了住宅大樓的興建。

examples.en: The school board hired an electrical contractor to upgrade campus wiring.
examples.zh: 校務委員會聘請了一家合格的機電工程承包商，全面升級全校老舊管線設備。

examples.en: Independent contractors must manage their own tax filings and health insurance.
examples.zh: 獨立簽約外包承包商必須自主申報個人年度綜合所得稅與繳納全民健保保費。

examples.en: Hire an experienced licensed contractor to manage demolition and carpentry teams.
examples.zh: 聘請口碑良好、信譽可靠的專業裝潢統包工程工頭來統籌調度泥作與木工師傅班底。

examples.en: The independent contractor submitted a detailed itemized quote before breaking ground.
examples.zh: 統包工程承包商在正式動工開拆前，先提交了一份詳盡列出各工種單價的估價單。

examples.en: Regular on-site communication with your general contractor ensures construction stays on schedule.
examples.zh: 定期與統包工地主任進行面對面現場溝通核對，能確保各施工工期按照既定進度推進。

entries.definition: 承包商；營造廠商；裝潢統包工頭；工程承包商

explains.en: This is a person or company hired to complete a particular job. A builder may repair a roof for a family. The client agrees to the work and price.
A project manager may hire this worker to build a road or install new windows. The job has a clear plan. Workers follow safety rules.
This worker may bring special tools and skills to a project. The client checks the finished work. Clear communication helps prevent mistakes.

examples.en: There was a contradiction between his words and actions.
examples.zh: 他的言行互相矛盾。

examples.en: The report contained a contradiction about the meeting time.
examples.zh: 報告中對會議時間的描述前後矛盾。

examples.en: She noticed a contradiction in the two answers.
examples.zh: 她在兩個答案中發現了矛盾。

entries.definition: （名）矛盾；反駁；互相衝突的說法

explains.en: This is a statement that conflicts with another statement. One person may say the door is open while another says it is shut. Both cannot be true at once.
A story may include details that do not fit together. Readers notice the mismatch. The writer can correct it.
A person’s actions may go against their words. Others may question which message is true. Consistency helps build trust.

examples.en: The controversial rule started a long discussion.
examples.zh: 這項引發爭議的規定開始了一場長時間討論。

examples.en: The film addressed a controversial subject.
examples.zh: 這部電影探討了一個具爭議性的主題。

examples.en: Her controversial idea received both support and criticism.
examples.zh: 她那個備受爭議的想法同時得到支持與批評。

explains.en: This describes a subject that causes people to disagree strongly. A new school rule may upset some families while others support it. People share different reasons.
A difficult topic can lead to public discussion. Speakers should use facts and listen to one another. Respectful debate is helpful.
A decision may receive both praise and criticism. Leaders can explain how they made it. Clear information helps people understand.

examples.en: The controversy about the new road continued for months.
examples.zh: 關於新道路的爭議持續了好幾個月。

examples.en: The book caused controversy in the town.
examples.zh: 這本書在鎮上引起了爭論。

examples.en: They discussed the controversy during the meeting.
examples.zh: 他們在會議中討論了這場爭議。

entries.definition: （名）爭議；人們對某事有強烈且相反意見的公開討論。

explains.en: This is a public disagreement about an issue. People may share different opinions in news reports or meetings. Facts can help clarify the matter.
A topic can cause strong debate among a community. Each side may explain its reasons. Listening helps people understand the disagreement.
A disagreement may continue for a long time. A fair discussion can help find common ground. Some differences may remain.

examples.en: The conversion of the garage into a studio took two weeks.
examples.zh: 把車庫改建成工作室花了兩週。

examples.en: We checked the conversion from miles to kilometers.
examples.zh: 我們檢查了英里轉換成公里的換算。

examples.en: The town planned a conversion of the old library into a museum.
examples.zh: 鎮上計畫把舊圖書館改建成博物館。

explains.en: This is a change from one form, use, or system to another. A room can be changed into a study area. Furniture and lights may be moved.
A measurement can be changed into a different unit. A chart can help show how the amounts match. Checking the math is useful.
A person may change their beliefs after learning new information. They can reflect and ask questions. People may change in different ways.

examples.en: The workers converted the old barn into a classroom.
examples.zh: 工人把舊穀倉改建成教室。

examples.en: She converted the recipe from cups to grams.
examples.zh: 她把食譜的杯數換算成公克。

examples.en: The program converts photos into smaller files.
examples.zh: 這個程式會把照片轉成較小的檔案。

explains.en: This means to change something into a different form or use. A caterpillar changes into a butterfly. The stages happen over time.
A person can change a recipe to make it fit a different meal. They may replace an ingredient. Careful amounts help the food turn out well.
A file can be changed into another digital type so a device can open it. The user chooses the right format. Saving a copy is helpful.

examples.en: The jury convicted the driver after hearing the evidence.
examples.zh: 陪審團聽取證據後，判定駕駛有罪。

examples.en: The court convicted him of stealing the bicycle.
examples.zh: 法院判定他偷竊腳踏車。

examples.en: She was convicted after the trial.
examples.zh: 審判後，她被判有罪。

explains.en: This means that a court officially decides a person committed a crime. The judge or jury listens to the evidence. Legal rules guide the decision.
A person may be found guilty after a fair trial. The result can lead to a penalty. The court explains its decision.
The verb can also mean to prove someone responsible for a wrongdoing. Facts and careful review are important. Everyone deserves a fair process.

examples.en: She has a strong conviction that everyone deserves a fair chance.
examples.zh: 她堅信每個人都應有公平的機會。

examples.en: The court recorded a conviction after the trial.
examples.zh: 法院在審判後記錄了定罪判決。

examples.en: His conviction about the team’s success never changed.
examples.zh: 他對球隊會成功的信念從未改變。

entries.definition: （名）堅定信念；定罪；依上下文指確信或法律判決。

explains.en: This is a strong belief that someone holds. A person may believe that honesty is important. Their actions can show this belief.
A court’s decision that someone is guilty may also have this name. The decision follows a legal process. Evidence is considered.
A person may feel sure about what they believe. They can explain their reasons respectfully. Listening to others can also be useful.

examples.en: The event director coordinated with caterers, sound crews, and hosts.
examples.zh: 活動總監與外燴廠商、音響團隊及主持人密切協調。

examples.en: Rescue helicopters coordinated closely with ground troops during the search operation.
examples.zh: 搜救直升機在深山搜救行動中，與地面挺進的特搜部隊保持著極為緊密的空地協同。

examples.en: A color consultant helped coordinate the furniture colors with the living room walls.
examples.zh: 色彩搭配顧問專業指導，協助將家具軟件色調與客廳主牆壁紙完美整合搭配。

explains.en: This means to organize people or actions so they work well together. A teacher may plan times for different groups to use a room. Clear schedules help.
A person may move their hands and feet together smoothly. Dancing requires practice and timing. Music can guide the movement.
Groups can share information and plan who will do each task. Everyone knows their part. Good communication prevents missed steps.

examples.en: Always use royalty-free background music to avoid copyright strikes.
examples.zh: 務必使用免版稅背景音樂以避免觸犯版權警告。

examples.en: The author holds the international copyright to all her published novels.
examples.zh: 該作家對其名下出版的所有長篇小說享有國際著作權。

examples.en: Unauthorized distribution of movie torrents is a clear violation of copyright law.
examples.zh: 未經授權散布電影種子檔案是公然違反著作權法的侵權行為。

examples.en: All photos and articles on this blog are protected under copyright law.
examples.zh: 本部落格上刊載之所有攝影照片與專題文章皆受著作權法保護。

examples.en: The photographer registered copyright for her landscape photos to prevent unauthorized commercial usage.
examples.zh: 該攝影師為其拍攝的高山風景攝影作品登記註冊版權，以嚴防遭他人未經授權擅自商業盜用。

examples.en: Downloading movies from illegal streaming sites directly violates international copyright treaties.
examples.zh: 從非法盜版影音網站任意下載電影觀看，直接違反了國際著作權公約的嚴格規定。

examples.en: Receiving three copyright strikes will result in permanent channel termination.
examples.zh: 若頻道累計遭到權利人提出三次版權警告（Strike），將會面臨被官方永久停權封號。

examples.en: The author holds exclusive copyright over all text and illustrations in the novel.
examples.zh: 作者擁有該部小說中所有文字篇章與精美手繪插畫的獨家著作權保護。

examples.en: Never use background tracks without permission, or your video may face copyright claims.
examples.zh: 未經授權切勿擅自使用受版權保護的背景配樂，否則影片可能會面臨版權索賠。

examples.en: Legal scholars debate whether training large models on public websites constitutes copyright fair use.
examples.zh: 法律學者與法官深入辯論在大規模抓取公開網路文章與插畫訓練大模型時，是否構成著作權法上的「合理使用」。

examples.en: The novelist registered her best-selling fantasy manuscript with the federal copyright office.
examples.zh: 這位當紅奇幻小說作家在長篇手稿出版前夕，依法前往智慧財產局辦理了完整的著作權版權註冊登記。

examples.en: Unauthorized downloading or public broadcasting of commercial movies constitutes severe copyright infringement.
examples.zh: 任何未經授權在公開場所播映未授權商業院線電影或非法重製販售之行為，皆構成嚴重的著作權侵害刑事罪責。

entries.definition: 版權；著作權；取得版權；AI 訓練著作權保護；智慧財產權

explains.en: This is the legal right that protects a person’s original writing, music, art, or other creative work. It helps control how others copy or share it. Creators can use rules to protect their work.
A book, song, or picture may belong to its creator. People should ask permission before copying it. Giving credit is respectful.
Rules can allow limited use in certain situations. A teacher may explain how to use material fairly. Checking the rules helps avoid problems.

examples.en: Scientists extracted a fifty-foot sediment core to reconstruct prehistoric climate swings and ice age cycles.
examples.zh: 地質學家從海床鑽取了一根長達五十英尺的沉積物岩芯，藉此重構史前冰河時期的氣候變遷。

examples.en: Slicing the sediment core open revealed ash layers from volcanic super-eruptions millions of years ago.
examples.zh: 剖開深海沉積物岩芯，橫斷面清晰浮現出數百萬年前超級海底火山爆發遺留下來的灰白火山灰層。

examples.en: Technicians carefully freeze and catalog each sediment core inside chilled research ship lockers.
examples.zh: 實驗室技術員細心將採集到的每節沉積物岩芯低溫冷凍並編號建檔，保存於研究船專用冰庫中。

examples.en: Push-core tubes plunged into the seabed extract stratified mud cores containing thousands of micro-fossils.
examples.zh: 垂直插入海床的「柱狀採樣管」（Core Tube），採集出完整分層的深海沉積泥芯，封存著萬年微化石。

examples.en: Honesty and transparency form the absolute core values of our corporate business ethics.
examples.zh: 誠信正直與公開透明，構成了我們整家企業商業道德準則中最不可妥協的核心價值觀。

examples.en: The pastry chef carefully scooped out the center core of the crisp apple before baking the tart.
examples.zh: 甜點名廚在烘烤經典法式蘋果派之前，手持專用去核器細心地將整顆脆甜蘋果的核心果核挖除。

entries.definition: 海底沉積物重力柱狀岩芯採樣管；核心；沉積物柱狀採樣管 (無擾動採集深海泥芯)

explains.en: This is the central or most important part of something. An apple has a firm middle that holds its seeds. A person can cut around it.
A group may focus on its main idea or purpose. Other details support that central point. Staying focused can help finish a task.
A long cylinder of earth or rock taken from the ground can be studied to learn about the past. Scientists examine its layers. Each layer gives clues.

examples.en: She attended a corporate meeting in the city.
examples.zh: 她在市區參加公司會議。

examples.en: The company announced a corporate policy for its workers.
examples.zh: 公司宣布了一項員工政策。

examples.en: He works in the corporate office downtown.
examples.zh: 他在市中心的公司辦公室工作。

entries.definition: 公司的；企業的；法人的；共同的。

explains.en: This describes something related to a business company. A company office may have meeting rooms and desks. Workers share information there.
A large business may set rules for its workers. The rules explain how people should act and do their jobs. Clear guidance helps.
A company may sell products or services to customers. Teams plan how to make and deliver them. Good service builds trust.

examples.en: The corporation opened a new office downtown.
examples.zh: 這家公司在市中心開設了新辦公室。

examples.en: A large corporation hired more workers this year.
examples.zh: 一家大型公司今年聘用了更多員工。

examples.en: The corporation makes toys for children.
examples.zh: 這家公司製造兒童玩具。

explains.en: This is a large business organization that may have many workers. It can sell goods or provide services. People may own shares in it.
A group of people can form this kind of organization to run a business. It follows laws and keeps official records. Leaders guide its work.
The organization may have offices in several places. Different teams handle money, products, and customer help. Good planning connects their work.

examples.en: Studies show a positive correlation between aerobic exercise and memory retention.
examples.zh: 多項研究顯示有氧運動與記憶力保持之間存在著正向相關性。

examples.en: Scientists emphasize that statistical correlation does not necessarily imply direct causation.
examples.zh: 科學界再三強調，統計學上的數據相關性並不必然等同於直接因果關係。

examples.en: Researchers discovered an inverse correlation between sleep deprivation and work productivity.
examples.zh: 研究人員敏銳地發現，睡眠剝奪程度與白天工作生產力之間存在著顯著負相關。

explains.en: This is a connection between two things that change together. When one number goes up, another may also rise. A chart can show the pattern.
A relationship does not always prove that one thing caused the other. People should check other facts. Careful study avoids wrong conclusions.
Researchers may compare weather and plant growth over time. They look for patterns in the records. More data can help.

examples.en: The foreign correspondent reported live from the international summit in Geneva.
examples.zh: 駐外特派記者自日內瓦舉行的全球領袖高峰會現場發回即時連線報導。

examples.en: He worked as a seasoned war correspondent documenting humanitarian crises across the Middle East.
examples.zh: 他曾擔任資深戰地特派記者，記錄中東地區的人道主義危機。

examples.en: The network's financial correspondent analyzed the central bank's unexpected interest rate decision.
examples.zh: 該電視台的財經特派員深入分析了中央銀行出人意料的利率決策。

entries.definition: 特派記者；特派通訊員；駐外記者

explains.en: This is a reporter who sends news from a particular place. The person may work in another city or country. They share what is happening there.
A newspaper or radio station may send this reporter to cover a local event. The reporter talks with people and checks facts. Clear details help the audience.
The worker sends stories back to an editor. Photos and notes can support the report. Careful checking helps avoid mistakes.

examples.en: Riverbank green corridors connect mountain forests to coastlines, allowing birds and butterflies to migrate safely.
examples.zh: 沿著大漢溪與淡水河畔整建的帶狀都市生態綠廊（Green Corridor），讓鳥類與蝴蝶能安全穿梭棲息。

examples.en: Hospital nurses rushed the emergency gurney quickly down the sterile hallway corridor toward surgery.
examples.zh: 急診醫護人員推著載有重傷病患的緊急急救推床，在寂靜潔淨的無菌醫院長廊走道上分秒必爭狂奔向手術室。

examples.en: The Taiwan High-Speed Rail forms an indispensable Western Taiwan economic and transportation corridor.
examples.zh: 縱貫南北的台灣高速鐵路路網，已構築起連結西半部各大都會區與科學園區不可或缺的黃金經濟運輸走廊。

examples.en: Constructing forested wildlife corridors connects isolated populations, enabling genetic exchange.
examples.zh: 興建綠化「野生動物生態廊道」（Corridor），能串聯被道路隔絕的孤立族群並促進基因健康交流。

examples.en: Aerial rope bridges serve as canopy corridors for arboreal monkeys crossing newly paved mountain highways.
examples.zh: 架設在高空的繩梯天橋為樹棲猴群提供了穿越新闢高山公路的樹冠層生態通道。

examples.en: Riverbank greenways act as essential ecological corridors linking fragmented urban parks together.
examples.zh: 河岸水岸綠帶是串聯破碎都市公園與郊野山林的重要生態廊道。

examples.en: The high-speed corridor acts as the economic spine of the country, linking science parks and tech hubs.
examples.zh: 高鐵「西部經濟走廊動脈」（Corridor），將各大科學園區與竹科、南科緊密串聯為繁榮的一體化經濟動脈。

examples.en: Hospital nurses walked quickly down the brightly lit corridor to attend to a ringing patient buzzer.
examples.zh: 綜合醫院值班護理師快步走過燈火通明的走廊通道，第一時間趕往病房處理病患呼叫鈴。

examples.en: Urban planners established a lush green ecological corridor allowing native deer to roam between forests.
examples.zh: 都會生態規劃師在城市外圍保留了一整條林木繁茂的綠色生態廊道，讓原生水鹿得以安全穿梭於兩片森林。

entries.definition: 都市生態綠廊；走廊；跨越國道之野生動物專用生態廊道；串聯一日生活圈之台灣西部經濟走廊大動脈

explains.en: This is a long passage connecting rooms or parts of a building. Students walk along it to reach classrooms. Doors open from the sides.
A long, open path may connect one outdoor area with another. Animals can travel along it. Plants and trees offer shelter.
A narrow route through a busy area can help people move between places. Signs can guide them. Keeping the route clear is helpful.

examples.en: The corrupt official took money from the town.
examples.zh: 貪污官員拿走了鎮上的錢。

examples.en: The food was corrupted by unsafe storage.
examples.zh: 食物因保存不當而腐敗了。

examples.en: The judge refused to support a corrupt deal.
examples.zh: 法官拒絕支持不正當的交易。

entries.definition: （形）貪污的；腐敗的；（動）使腐化；損壞

explains.en: This describes someone who uses power dishonestly for personal gain. A worker may take money that belongs to the group. Such behavior is wrong.
Food can become spoiled or unsafe when harmful material gets into it. Clean storage helps protect food. People should follow safety rules.
A computer file may be changed to hide the truth or cause problems. Strong safeguards can protect important information. Honest actions matter.

examples.en: The newspaper reported corruption in the city office.
examples.zh: 報紙報導了市府的貪污事件。

examples.en: The investigation uncovered corruption in the company.
examples.zh: 調查揭發了公司的貪腐。

examples.en: Citizens spoke out against corruption in government.
examples.zh: 市民公開反對政府貪污。

entries.definition: （名）貪污、腐敗；不誠實地利用權力，也可指逐漸敗壞。

explains.en: This is dishonest behavior by someone who has power or responsibility. A leader may take money meant for a public project. People can report wrongdoing.
Rules and careful records can make it harder for people to cheat. A group can check how money is used. Fair systems matter.
A person may lose trust in a group after dishonest acts are revealed. Leaders can explain what happened and fix problems. Honesty helps rebuild trust.

examples.en: The school offered counsel to students who felt worried.
examples.zh: 學校為感到擔憂的學生提供諮詢。

examples.en: She sought legal counsel before signing the paper.
examples.zh: 簽署文件前，她先尋求法律諮詢。

examples.en: His counsel helped us choose a safe route.
examples.zh: 他的建議幫助我們選擇安全的路線。

entries.definition: （名）建議；忠告；法律顧問；（動）提供建議。

explains.en: This can mean advice or guidance about a problem. A student may ask a teacher what to do about a hard assignment. Careful listening helps.
The word can also name a lawyer who gives legal advice. The person explains rules and represents a client. The work follows laws.
A trusted adult may guide a young person through a difficult choice. They can talk about possible results. The decision belongs to the person.

examples.en: The counselor helped me choose my next classes.
examples.zh: 輔導員幫我選擇下一學期的課程。

examples.en: A counselor listened to the child’s concerns.
examples.zh: 輔導員聆聽了孩子的煩惱。

examples.en: She made an appointment with a school counselor.
examples.zh: 她預約了學校輔導員。

entries.definition: （名）輔導員；顧問；提供建議與支持的人

explains.en: This is a person who helps others with personal, school, or work problems. A student may talk with one about choosing classes. The conversation can help.
The person listens and may suggest steps to try. They keep private details safe. Building trust takes time.
Some work in schools while others help families or groups. Their training helps them guide people. Asking for support is okay.

examples.en: The courteous visitor thanked the host for dinner.
examples.zh: 有禮的訪客感謝主人準備晚餐。

examples.en: He was courteous to the bus driver.
examples.zh: 他對公車司機很有禮貌。

examples.en: Please be courteous when asking a question.
examples.zh: 提問時請保持禮貌。

explains.en: This describes someone who is polite and shows respect. A person may say please and thank you when asking for help. Kind words matter.
Someone can behave well when visiting another person’s home. They listen, take turns, and follow the host’s rules. Respect makes guests welcome.
A polite person may speak calmly even when they disagree. They let others finish before replying. Good manners help conversations go smoothly.

examples.en: The presidential election received comprehensive 24/7 media coverage nationwide.
examples.zh: 總統大選在全台各大電視新聞台與網路媒體獲得了二十四小時全方位即時報導。

examples.en: Ensure your travel insurance policy provides adequate medical coverage abroad.
examples.zh: 出國前請確保你的旅遊平安險保單包含足夠的海外醫療理賠保障。

examples.en: Live television coverage brought the historic space mission directly into living rooms.
examples.zh: 電視現場直播報導將這項具歷史意義的太空探測任務直接呈現在大眾客廳中。

examples.en: Satellite broadband ensures 100% broadband coverage for remote Pacific fishing boats and mountain villages.
examples.zh: 低軌衛星寬頻為偏遠南太平洋遠洋漁船與崇山峻嶺間的原鄉部落，帶來百分之百無死角的通訊覆蓋。

examples.en: The mobile telecom operator expanded its 5G network coverage to include underground subway tunnels.
examples.zh: 行動電信業者大幅擴建 5G 基地台訊號涵蓋範圍，甚至延伸至地底捷運隧道各線路。

examples.en: Before traveling abroad, purchase travel insurance that provides comprehensive medical emergency coverage.
examples.zh: 在出國自助旅行前，務必購買提供完善海外突發疾病與緊急醫療全方位涵蓋的旅遊保險。

entries.definition: 新聞報導；媒體曝光；保險理賠範圍；全球極地偏鄉無死角通訊覆蓋

explains.en: This can mean the amount of news or attention given to an event. A newspaper may tell readers about a school concert. Photos can show what happened.
An insurance plan may explain which costs it will pay for. People read the details before choosing a plan. Clear terms matter.
A phone network may reach many places. A map can show where a signal is available. People check it before traveling.

examples.en: Spreading unverified rumors destroys an investigative journalist's professional credibility.
examples.zh: 隨意散布未經求證的傳聞將會徹底摧毀一位深度調查記者長年累積的專業公信力。

examples.en: Citing peer-reviewed studies significantly enhances the credibility of your research paper.
examples.zh: 引用經同儕審查的學術研究能大幅提升你的學術論文可信度。

examples.en: Once lost, an institution's credibility with the public is extremely hard to rebuild.
examples.zh: 一個機構在大眾心中的公信力一旦喪失，便極難再次重建。

explains.en: This is how much people believe someone or something can be trusted. A news source gains trust by checking facts. Readers look for reliable information.
A person’s honest actions can build trust over time. Keeping promises helps. One lie may damage it.
A report seems believable when it gives clear sources and evidence. Readers can check the details themselves. Careful research matters.

examples.en: We followed the creek through the woods.
examples.zh: 我們沿著溪流穿過樹林。

examples.en: A small bridge crossed the creek.
examples.zh: 一座小橋橫跨溪流。

examples.en: The children watched fish swim in the creek.
examples.zh: 孩子們看著魚在溪裡游泳。

entries.definition: （名）溪流、小河；比河流小的自然水道。

explains.en: This is a small stream of water that flows through land. It may run beside trees or fields. People can hear the water move.
Rain and melting snow may feed the stream. It can become deeper after a storm. Visitors should be careful near fast water.
Fish and insects may live in this waterway. Plants along its banks give them shelter. Keeping litter away helps protect them.

examples.en: The flood crippled traffic across the town.
examples.zh: 洪水癱瘓了全鎮的交通。

examples.en: A broken wheel crippled the cart until it was repaired.
examples.zh: 車輪壞了，讓手推車無法使用，直到修好為止。

examples.en: The long delay crippled the team’s plan for the day.
examples.zh: 漫長的延誤嚴重打亂了隊伍當天的計畫。

entries.definition: 使嚴重受損；使癱瘓；跛子（冒犯用語）。

explains.en: This means to badly damage something or make it difficult to use. A storm may damage roads and stop buses from running. Repair workers can help.
An injury can limit how well a body part works. A person may need support while healing. A health professional can explain care.
A lack of tools may seriously slow a project. The team can find another way to finish. Asking for help may solve the problem.

examples.en: Achieving a Noise Criterion (NC) rating below 15 requires extensive silencing across all mechanical systems.
examples.zh: 想要達到「噪音評定準則」（Noise Criterion NC）15 級以下的極限標準，必須對全館所有機電進行深度消音。

examples.en: Academic integrity and genuine research passion served as the primary criterion for selecting scholarship winners.
examples.zh: 學術誠信與對學術探究的真實熱忱，是評審委員會遴選今年度頂尖出國獎學金得主的最高核心準則。

examples.en: Financial institutions evaluate credit score history as a crucial criterion when reviewing mortgage applications.
examples.zh: 各家金融行庫在嚴格審核購屋房貸申請時，將申請人過往的聯徵個人信用評分紀錄列為關鍵核貸準則。

entries.definition: 國際音樂廳噪音評定準則 (NC 噪音曲線等級)；準則；台灣 EEWH 綠建築九大指標評估基準

explains.en: This is a rule or measure used to judge whether something meets a need. A teacher may use clear rules to grade a project. Students know what to aim for.
A group may compare options using several important measures. One choice may be safer or cheaper. Writing them down helps.
A person can decide whether a tool is right for a job. They check its size, strength, and cost. The best choice fits the task.

examples.en: It is crucial to wear a helmet when riding a bike.
examples.zh: 騎腳踏車時戴安全帽非常重要。

examples.en: Water is crucial for plants and animals.
examples.zh: 水對動植物至關重要。

examples.en: The final clue was crucial to solving the puzzle.
examples.zh: 最後一條線索對解開謎題極為關鍵。

entries.definition: （形）至關重要的；決定性的；不可或缺的

explains.en: This describes something extremely important to a result. A key may help someone open a locked door. Without it, the person cannot get inside.
A decision may affect many people. They should learn the facts before choosing. Careful discussion can help.
One small step can be necessary to finish a larger task. A team checks each step on its list. Missing one can cause a delay.

examples.en: The carpenter used crude tools to shape the wood.
examples.zh: 木匠用粗糙的工具修整木頭。

examples.en: The oil was still crude before it was refined.
examples.zh: 石油尚未精煉前稱為原油。

examples.en: His crude joke upset the group.
examples.zh: 他粗俗的笑話讓大家不舒服。

explains.en: This describes something in a natural or unfinished state. A rough wooden board may need sanding before painting. It has not been smoothed.
A material that has not been cleaned or refined may be called this. Workers process it before using it. Careful handling is important.
A comment can be blunt or unpolished. The speaker may need to choose kinder words. Respectful speech helps.

examples.en: We booked a cruise around the islands.
examples.zh: 我們預訂了環島郵輪之旅。

examples.en: The ship will cruise along the coast.
examples.zh: 船將沿著海岸航行。

examples.en: They enjoyed a week-long cruise with their family.
examples.zh: 他們和家人享受了一週的郵輪假期。

entries.definition: （名）乘船旅行、巡航；（動）以平穩速度行駛或航行。

explains.en: This is a trip taken for pleasure on a large ship. Passengers visit different ports during the journey. The ship may have rooms and places to eat.
A vehicle can move smoothly at a steady speed. A driver may travel along a road without rushing. Safe attention is needed.
The verb can mean to travel by boat or plane at a steady pace. People watch the route and weather. The journey can last many days.

examples.en: Instant freezing creates microscopic ice crystals, yielding an incomparably silky, velvety gelato.
examples.zh: 瞬間極速冷凍徹底消除了粗糙大冰晶，創造出細膩到「微米級冰晶結構」（Microscopic Ice Crystals）的絲滑冰淇淋。

examples.en: The chandelier in the historic ballroom was crafted from hundreds of hand-cut sparkling crystal prisms.
examples.zh: 歷史悠久的國宴宴會廳水晶吊燈，由數百枚手工精密切割的水晶三稜鏡折射出璀璨光芒。

examples.en: Snowflakes form distinct hexagonal ice crystal patterns as moisture freezes high in winter clouds.
examples.zh: 當水氣在冬日高空凍結時，每一片飄落的雪花都會凝結成獨一無二的六角形冰晶圖案。

entries.definition: 極速冷凍消除大冰晶之極致絲滑頂級冰淇淋；水晶

explains.en: This is a clear solid that forms in a regular shape. Some kinds are found in rocks. Light can shine through them.
The word can describe clear glass or plastic shaped like a natural solid. It may be used in decorations. Its surfaces catch light.
Snowflakes form in tiny solid patterns in cold clouds. Each one has a delicate shape. People can see them under a magnifying glass.

examples.en: Taiwanese cuisine is celebrated globally for diverse night market snacks.
examples.zh: 台灣在地特色料理因豐富多元的夜市小吃而揚名國際。

examples.en: Cantonese cuisine emphasizes fresh seafood and gentle steaming techniques.
examples.zh: 經典粵菜菜系極為講究生猛鮮活的海鮮食材與原汁原味的清蒸火候技藝。

examples.en: The cosmopolitan city offers a vibrant variety of international cuisines.
examples.zh: 這座多元文化的國際大都會匯聚了令人目不暇給的各國道地風味料理。

entries.definition: 菜系；特色料理；烹飪藝術

explains.en: This is a style of cooking linked to a place or culture. A region may be known for noodles, herbs, or special sauces. Recipes pass between generations.
A meal can show the flavors people enjoy in an area. Visitors may try local dishes when traveling. Food can tell a story.
Different styles use different ingredients and methods. Cooks may roast, steam, or fry food. Each method creates a different taste.

examples.en: The local currency used in Taiwan is the New Taiwan Dollar (NTD).
examples.zh: 台灣使用的本地貨幣為新台幣（NTD）。

examples.en: Most European Union nations adopted the Euro as their common currency.
examples.zh: 多數歐盟國家採用歐元作為其通用流通貨幣。

examples.en: Exchange rates between foreign currencies fluctuate on financial markets daily.
examples.zh: 各國外幣之間的匯率每天在金融市場上持續浮動。

examples.en: The New Taiwan Dollar (NTD) is the official domestic currency.
examples.zh: 新台幣（NTD）是台灣法定的官方流通貨幣。

examples.en: Digital cryptocurrencies operate without central bank supervision.
examples.zh: 數位加密虛擬貨幣在沒有各國央行監管與背書的去中心化模式下運作。

examples.en: His unconventional philosophical arguments gained broad currency among students.
examples.zh: 他標新立異的哲學論述在大學校園學生群體中獲得了廣泛的認同與流傳。

entries.definition: 貨幣；通貨；流通貨幣；流通

explains.en: This is the kind of money used in a country or region. People use it to buy goods and pay for services. Coins and notes may look different.
Travelers may exchange one kind of money for another before a trip. The amount they receive can change. Checking the rate is helpful.
Some money exists as coins, paper notes, or digital amounts. Stores show prices using the money people use locally. Clear labels prevent confusion.

examples.en: The school curriculum includes art and science.
examples.zh: 學校課程包含美術和科學。

examples.en: The teacher changed the curriculum to add more reading time.
examples.zh: 老師修改了課程，增加閱讀時間。

examples.en: Our curriculum has lessons about plants and animals.
examples.zh: 我們的課程安排了關於動植物的課程。

entries.definition: 課程；課程綱要；學校的教學內容。

explains.en: This is the set of subjects and lessons taught in a school or course. A class plan may include reading, math, and science. Students learn different skills.
Teachers use learning goals to decide what to teach. Lessons can build from simple ideas to harder ones. Planning helps students progress.
A course may include books, activities, and tests. Students can ask questions when they need help. A clear plan shows what to study.

examples.en: A rigorous chain of custody log proves that the blood sample was never altered or contaminated.
examples.zh: 嚴謹記載每位經手人的證物保管鏈，證明血液樣本從未遭受竄改或污染。

examples.en: Any break in the chain of custody can render crucial evidence completely inadmissible in court.
examples.zh: 證物保管鏈在傳遞過程中只要出現任何時間斷點或紀錄漏洞，都會導致關鍵證物在法庭上被全盤推翻。

examples.en: The forensic officer signed the custody transfer sheet before delivering the weapon to the ballistics lab.
examples.zh: 鑑識警官在將作案槍枝親自押送至彈道實驗室前，在證物保管移交清冊上鄭重簽字確認。

entries.definition: 證物保管鏈紀錄 (防竄改防調包)；監管

explains.en: This means the care and control of a person or object. A parent may look after a young child after school. The child stays safe.
A court may decide which adult a child lives with. The decision follows laws and the child’s needs. Families may need support.
A museum keeps valuable objects in a safe place. Workers record who handles each item. Careful records prevent loss.

examples.en: Declare any fresh agricultural products when passing customs.
examples.zh: 通過海關時，若攜帶任何新鮮農產品必須申報。

examples.en: The border customs officer inspected our declaration forms carefully.
examples.zh: 邊境海關官員仔細檢查了我們的申報單。

examples.en: It took almost an hour to pass through airport customs and immigration.
examples.zh: 通過機場海關與移民審查關卡花了將近一個小時。

examples.en: Passengers must pass through airport customs and declare fresh meat items.
examples.zh: 旅客入境時必須通過機場海關並主動申報生鮮肉類製品。

examples.en: The customs officer asked us to open our luggage for a routine random check.
examples.zh: 海關官員要求我們打開隨身行李接受例行隨機抽查。

examples.en: Different ethnic groups observe unique cultural customs during lunar new year festivities.
examples.zh: 不同族群在農曆春節節慶期間恪守著各自獨特的文化習俗。

examples.en: Go through the Red Channel at customs if you have goods exceeding duty allowances.
examples.zh: 若您隨身攜帶超過免稅限額之高價名品或外幣現鈔，通關時請主動走紅線應申報海關櫃檯。

examples.en: Customs agents randomly scan baggage to detect undeclared foreign currencies or plants.
examples.zh: 海關緝私關員在出關通道前隨機抽驗旅客隨身行李，以查緝未申報之高額外幣或管制生鮮植物。

examples.en: Walk through the Green Channel at customs if you have nothing to declare.
examples.zh: 若您本次入境所攜帶的行李物品皆完全符合免稅規範且無受管制品，可直接步入綠線免申報通道。

examples.en: Cross-border parcels undergo automated X-ray security scanning and customs clearance checks.
examples.zh: 每一件搭機抵達國門的跨境網購包裹皆必須通過高速 X 光安檢機掃描與海關嚴格報關審驗。

examples.en: All passengers carrying undeclared foreign currency exceeding regulatory limits will be detained by customs.
examples.zh: 旅客攜帶超出法定限額且未誠實申報的外幣現鈔通關入境時，一律將依法遭海關攔截沒入裁罰。

examples.en: Experienced brokers guide importers through complex customs classification codes and documentation.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的專業報關行人員協助進口商精確申報繁瑣的各類海關商品稅則號列與產地證明文件。

examples.en: Paperless electronic customs declarations clear compliant import cargo within minutes of ship arrival.
examples.zh: 採用無紙化智慧海關申報，在貨輪靠泊後數分鐘內即可完成合規貨物線上放行。

examples.en: High-risk shipments flagged by automated risk algorithms are diverted to customs inspection bays.
examples.zh: 被智慧風險評估演算法列為高風險的貨櫃，會被自動導引至海關專用人工開箱查驗區。

examples.en: Customs brokers assist importers by classifying tariff codes and ensuring trade compliance.
examples.zh: 專業報關行全力協助進口廠商精確申報貨品稅則號列，並確保百分之百符合各項貿易法規。

entries.definition: 海關；關稅；出入境檢查處；海關（貨物與行李申報稽查）；海關報關查驗；智慧無紙化二十四小時快速海關通關

explains.en: This is the government service that checks goods and luggage entering or leaving a country. Travelers may need to answer questions. Workers look for restricted items.
A border officer may ask what a person is carrying. Travelers should follow the rules and tell the truth. Clear forms help.
A country may charge money on certain goods brought from elsewhere. The amount depends on the rules. People can check requirements before a trip.

examples.en: The snake has a deadly bite.
examples.zh: 那條蛇的咬傷可能致命。

examples.en: A deadly storm moved toward the coast.
examples.zh: 致命的暴風雨朝海岸移動。

examples.en: The poison was deadly to small animals.
examples.zh: 這種毒藥對小動物有致命危險。

entries.definition: （形）致命的；極有害的；（副）極其；非常

explains.en: This describes something that can cause death. A dangerous poison can harm a person if swallowed. People should never taste unknown substances.
A very serious storm may threaten lives. Families can follow safety instructions and move to shelter. Emergency workers help.
The word can describe an animal’s venom or a harmful disease. Experts explain the risks. People should take warnings seriously.

examples.en: Volunteer divers haul tons of discarded fishing nets and plastic marine debris from the seafloor.
examples.zh: 熱血潛水志工每週背著氣瓶潛入海底，合力割除並打撈重達數噸的沉底廢棄刺網與海洋塑膠垃圾。

examples.en: Ingested microplastic debris accumulates inside the digestive systems of seabirds and marine mammals.
examples.zh: 漂浮在海中的微塑膠碎片被誤食後，會長期沉積累積在海鳥與海洋哺乳動物的腸胃消化系統中。

examples.en: Giant ocean gyres trap floating plastic debris, forming massive offshore garbage patches across the Pacific.
examples.zh: 浩瀚的太平洋環流系統將數以億計的漂流塑膠廢棄物聚攏在一起，形成了震驚全球的「太平洋垃圾帶」。

examples.en: Thousands of defunct satellites and rocket fragments form dangerous orbiting space debris.
examples.zh: 數以萬計退役報廢的衛星與火箭殘骸在地球軌道以超音速狂飆，形成威脅太空站安全的太空垃圾。

examples.en: International space agencies collaborate to track microscopic space debris moving at bullet speeds.
examples.zh: 各國太空機構通力合作，嚴密監控那些以子彈般超高時速呼嘯飛馳的微型太空碎屑殘骸。

examples.en: Rescue workers cleared fallen concrete debris from the collapsed highway after the magnitude 7 tremor.
examples.zh: 在芮氏規模七的強震過後，救難人員全力清除從崩塌高架道路上掉落的混凝土瓦礫殘骸。

examples.en: International radar networks track over thirty thousand pieces of tracked space debris larger than a softball.
examples.zh: 國際太空雷達監測網絡日夜追蹤超過三萬件大於壘球、在軌道上以數十倍音速狂飆的太空垃圾殘骸。

examples.en: City sanitation workers cleared broken glass and tree debris from roads following the fierce typhoon.
examples.zh: 清潔隊環保人員在強颱過境後，迅速清除倒塌在市區幹道上的殘破碎玻璃與斷裂樹枝殘骸。

examples.en: Forensic investigators sifted through the burnt debris of the warehouse to pinpoint the origin of the fire.
examples.zh: 鑑識火調專家細心篩檢燒毀倉庫現場焦黑的火災殘骸碎片，以精確鎖定最初的起火點。

entries.definition: 海洋廢棄物；殘骸垃圾 (Marine Debris)；太空垃圾碎片 (Space Debris)；殘骸；太空垃圾高速廢棄物殘骸

explains.en: This is broken pieces left after something is damaged or destroyed. A storm may leave pieces of branches on the ground. Workers can clear them safely.
A crash can scatter bits of glass or metal. People should stay away from sharp pieces. Cleanup crews wear protective gear.
Space missions leave small human-made objects moving around Earth. Scientists track them carefully. These pieces can be dangerous to spacecraft.

examples.en: The actor made her debut in a school play.
examples.zh: 那位演員第一次在校園戲劇中登台演出。

examples.en: The phone made its debut at the technology show.
examples.zh: 這支手機在科技展上首次亮相。

examples.en: He scored a goal during his professional debut.
examples.zh: 他在職業生涯首場比賽中進了一球。

explains.en: This is a person’s first public appearance or performance. A young singer may perform on stage for the first time. The audience welcomes the new artist.
A new product can be shown to the public for the first time. People may read about it online. The event creates interest.
The first game of a sports player’s career can be a special moment. Fans may cheer. Practice prepares the player for the occasion.

examples.en: Improving roof ventilation arrests fungal wood decay, extending the lifespan of ancient rafters.
examples.zh: 改善屋架頂部的通風對流，能從根本阻絕真菌滋生引發的木材腐朽，大幅延長古木樑壽命。

examples.en: Entomologists discovered moisture trapped behind false ceilings was fueling internal timber decay.
examples.zh: 昆蟲與病理專家發現藏在木作夾層暗處的濕氣滯留，是導致內部古樑菌絲腐朽的罪魁禍首。

examples.en: Left unchecked, wood decay fungi can hollow out load-bearing columns within a single decade.
examples.zh: 若不及時處置，木材腐朽菌會在短短十年間將整根主要承重木柱的核心徹底蛀空。

entries.definition: 濕氣引發之木結構真菌腐朽；腐爛

explains.en: This means to rot or break down over time. Fruit left in a warm place may soften and spoil. It should be thrown away.
A tooth can break down when germs damage its hard surface. Brushing and dental care help keep it clean. A dentist can examine it.
A building may weaken when water and weather damage its materials. Regular repairs can help protect it. People should stay away from unsafe structures.

examples.en: He deceived his friend by hiding the broken toy.
examples.zh: 他藏起壞掉的玩具來欺騙朋友。

examples.en: The fake message deceived many readers.
examples.zh: 這則假消息騙了許多讀者。

examples.en: She felt sad when the salesman deceived her family.
examples.zh: 銷售員欺騙她的家人時，她感到難過。

entries.definition: （動）欺騙、蒙騙；使人相信不真實的事。

explains.en: This means to make someone believe something that is not true. A person may tell a lie to hide a mistake. The lie can hurt trust.
A trick can fool someone into giving away private information. People should check who is asking before sharing details. Careful questions help.
A story may include a character who hides the truth. Later, others discover what really happened. Honest words can repair trust.

examples.en: The hotel room was decent and clean.
examples.zh: 旅館房間整潔，住起來還不錯。

examples.en: He earned a decent score on the spelling test.
examples.zh: 他的拼字測驗成績還算不錯。

examples.en: She is a decent person who always helps her neighbors.
examples.zh: 她是個善良正派的人，總是幫助鄰居。

entries.definition: 像樣的；得體的；正派的；相當不錯的。

explains.en: This describes something acceptable or good enough. A clean room with a comfortable bed can be a suitable place to sleep. It does not need to be fancy.
A person may behave fairly and kindly. They listen and keep their promises. Good actions earn respect.
The word can also mean proper or appropriate for a situation. A quiet voice is right for a library. People follow shared rules.

examples.en: Travelers submit customs declaration forms declaring regulated foreign currencies or tobacco.
examples.zh: 入境旅客依法誠實填寫並繳交海關申報單，主動列明攜帶之受管制外幣現鈔與菸酒數量。

examples.en: Sign the legal declaration at the bottom confirming all entered details are accurate.
examples.zh: 在紙本或電子海關申報單最下方親筆簽名，鄭重確認所有填報的行李物品內容均完全屬實。

examples.en: Failure to make an honest declaration of agricultural products carries heavy monetary fines.
examples.zh: 入境時若未如實申報隨身攜帶的違禁動植物產品，一經查獲將面臨高達數十萬元的巨額罰鍰。

examples.en: Falsifying invoice values on import customs declarations violates national trade regulations.
examples.zh: 在進口海關報關申報單上低報商品發票價值以圖逃漏稅，屬於違法行為將面臨高額罰鍰。

examples.en: Travelers must submit an accurate currency declaration before walking through the red inspection channel.
examples.zh: 攜帶超額現鈔或高價應稅管制品之旅客，在走入海關紅線查驗櫃檯前必須填寫正確申報單。

examples.en: The electronic declaration system automatically cross-references submitted cargo lists against shipping manifests.
examples.zh: 海關電子申報審核系統會自動將報關行上傳的貨物清單，與航商申報的艙單提單進行大數據勾稽。

entries.definition: 海關申報單；鄭重聲明；進口報關申報單；宣告

explains.en: This is a clear statement made in public or on paper. A town may announce a new rule. Residents can read what it says.
A traveler may fill out a form about items being carried across a border. The form gives important facts. Honest answers are needed.
A group can officially say that something is true. Members may sign a paper to show agreement. The words should be clear.

examples.en: The temperature declined after sunset.
examples.zh: 日落後氣溫下降了。

examples.en: She declined the invitation because she was busy.
examples.zh: 她因為很忙而婉拒了邀請。

examples.en: The number of errors declined after the lesson.
examples.zh: 上完課後，錯誤數量減少了。

entries.definition: （名）下降；衰退；婉拒；（動）下降；拒絕

explains.en: This means to become smaller, weaker, or less. A puddle may get smaller under the sun. The water slowly disappears.
A person may politely refuse an offer. They can say no with kind words. The other person may ask someone else.
A number may go down over time. A chart can show the change. Checking the dates helps explain the pattern.

examples.en: She dedicated the song to her grandmother.
examples.zh: 她把這首歌獻給奶奶。

examples.en: He dedicated an hour each day to reading.
examples.zh: 他每天花一小時專心閱讀。

examples.en: They dedicated the new garden to the school community.
examples.zh: 他們把新花園獻給學校社區。

explains.en: This means to give time or effort to a person, task, or cause. A student may spend each afternoon practicing music. Regular effort can lead to progress.
A person may set aside a book for someone they love. The book can show care and thought. Small actions are meaningful.
A worker may use time to help a community project. The effort supports a shared goal. Teamwork can make a difference.

examples.en: The defendant pleaded not guilty to all charges during the initial hearing.
examples.zh: 被告在初次開庭審訊程序中針對檢方所起訴之罪名全數抗辯無罪。

examples.en: The public defender worked tirelessly to prepare an alibi defense for the indigent defendant.
examples.zh: 公設辯護人日以繼夜全力奔走，悉心為這名無力聘請大律師的貧困刑事被告搜集完整的不在場證明。

examples.en: Throughout the televised courtroom trial, the defendant remained completely silent and expressionless.
examples.zh: 在整場電視新聞全程轉播的法庭公開審理過程中，端坐在被告席上的被告始終緊抿雙唇且面無表情。

explains.en: This is a person accused of breaking a law in court. The court listens to evidence before deciding what happened. The person has legal rights.
A lawyer may speak for this person during a trial. The lawyer asks questions and explains the person’s side. The judge follows the law.
A person may be found guilty or not guilty after the case is heard. The decision depends on the evidence. A fair process matters.

examples.en: Maintaining a modest 300-calorie daily deficit results in sustainable fat loss.
examples.zh: 每天維持約三百大卡的溫和熱量赤字（Calorie Deficit），能達成健康不掉肌肉的減脂目標。

examples.en: Creating too severe a caloric deficit will slow your metabolism and lead to muscle atrophy.
examples.zh: 製造過度極端的熱量赤字會導致基礎代謝率驟降，並引發不必要的肌肉流失。

examples.en: Tracking food intake diligently makes it much easier to sustain a consistent calorie deficit.
examples.zh: 認真記錄每日飲食熱量攝取，能讓你更輕鬆且精準地維持穩定的熱量赤字。

entries.definition: 熱量赤字；赤字缺口；虧損

explains.en: This is an amount by which spending is greater than available money or income. A school may need to plan carefully if costs exceed its budget. Saving can help.
A shortage happens when there is not enough of something needed. A store may run low on bread before a holiday. Workers can bring more.
A game may have fewer points than the other team. Players can keep trying. Practice may improve the next result.

examples.en: The team defied the odds and won the game.
examples.zh: 隊伍克服重重困難，贏得比賽。

examples.en: She defied the rule and entered the closed room.
examples.zh: 她違反規定，走進了封閉的房間。

examples.en: The small boat defied the waves during the storm.
examples.zh: 小船在暴風雨中頂著浪前進。

entries.definition: （動）公然反抗、違抗；也可指某事難以解釋或做到。

explains.en: This means to resist a rule, command, or strong force. A child may refuse to follow an unfair order. They can explain why they disagree.
A person may face a difficult challenge bravely. They keep trying even when the task is hard. Support can help them continue.
Someone can openly refuse to accept an idea. They give reasons for their choice. Respectful disagreement is possible.

examples.en: Good managers delegate daily tasks so they can focus on strategy.
examples.zh: 優秀的管理者懂得授權分派日常瑣事，以便全神貫注於策略佈局。

examples.en: Hundreds of international delegates attended the United Nations climate conference.
examples.zh: 來自世界各國的數百位官方代表團代表，齊聚一堂出席了聯合國氣候變遷大會。

examples.en: You cannot do everything alone; learn to delegate responsibilities to your capable deputies.
examples.zh: 你不可能事必躬親凡事一人扛；學會將具體職責適度授權分派給得力副手是關鍵修煉。

explains.en: This means to give a task or responsibility to another person. A teacher may ask a student to hand out papers. Sharing jobs saves time.
A leader can choose someone to speak for a group. The person shares the group’s ideas at a meeting. Clear instructions help.
