examples.en: An alternating pressure air mattress shifts contact points continuously to prevent painful skin bedsores.
examples.zh: 醫療級交替式充氣防褥瘡減壓氣墊床墊，透過微電腦定時交替充氣，有效預防壓瘡形成。

examples.en: Testing the mattress in the showroom helps buyers find the ideal balance between softness and lumbar support.
examples.zh: 親自在實體展示門市試躺床墊，有助於消費者找到軟硬適中且腰部支撐良好的最佳款式。

examples.en: Natural latex mattresses offer hypoallergenic comfort and superior thermal regulation in humid climates.
examples.zh: 天然乳膠床墊具備防蟎抗菌的舒適特性，非常適合在潮濕炎熱的氣候環境中調節體溫。

entries.definition: 人體工學獨立筒床墊；床墊；居家減壓交替式防褥瘡氣墊床墊

explains.en: This is the thick soft part of a bed that a person lies on. A sheet usually covers it. It rests on a frame or another supporting base.
The inside may contain springs, foam, or other soft materials. These parts support the body while someone sleeps. Different kinds can feel firm or soft.
A bed cover keeps a person warm from above. This part supports the person from below. Its size needs to fit the bed frame.

examples.en: The soup is cooking; in the meantime, we can set the table.
examples.zh: 湯正在煮；這段時間我們可以擺好餐具。

examples.en: The bus will arrive soon, so wait here in the meantime.
examples.zh: 公車很快就會到，這段時間先在這裡等。

examples.en: A new library is being built; in the meantime, readers use a small room nearby.
examples.zh: 新圖書館正在興建，這段期間讀者先使用附近的一間小閱覽室。

explains.en: This word points to the time between one event and another. Something else happens during that gap. People often use it while waiting for the next step.
Dinner is cooking and will be ready in twenty minutes. During the wait, a child sets the table. The word can link that activity to the waiting period.
A worker has ordered a new tool, but it has not arrived. For now, the worker uses an older one. This expression describes what happens until the new tool comes.

examples.en: The clock’s mechanism was hidden behind its face.
examples.zh: 時鐘的機械裝置藏在鐘面後方。

examples.en: The door has a mechanism that makes it close slowly.
examples.zh: 這扇門有一個讓它緩慢關閉的裝置。

examples.en: The school created a mechanism for collecting student suggestions.
examples.zh: 學校建立了收集學生建議的機制。

explains.en: This can mean a set of parts that work together in a machine. Each part helps produce an action. A clock uses moving parts to keep track of time.
A door closer contains parts that control how the door moves. A spring and other pieces help it return slowly. Together they make the action work.
The noun can also mean a process that makes something happen. An organization may have a way to collect and answer complaints. The linked steps provide a system for handling them.

examples.en: Take your daily prescribed medication after breakfast.
examples.zh: 早餐後請記得按時服用每日處方藥物。

examples.en: Are you taking any other prescription medication or dietary supplements?
examples.zh: 您目前有在服用任何其他處方藥物或膳食營養品嗎？

examples.en: Never stop taking your blood pressure medication without consulting your doctor.
examples.zh: 未經醫師諮詢，切勿擅自停用降血壓藥物。

explains.en: This is medicine used to treat an illness or a health problem. It may help control a symptom or affect a cause. Different kinds are made for different purposes.
The substance can come in several forms. It may be a tablet, liquid, cream, or another preparation. The form affects how it is used.
A pharmacy may provide a labeled package containing this kind of treatment. The label identifies what is inside. It also gives instructions for its use.

examples.en: Her mentor helped her plan her first science project.
examples.zh: 她的指導者幫助她規劃第一個科學專題。

examples.en: An experienced teacher mentored the new staff member.
examples.zh: 一位資深教師指導那名新進同事。

examples.en: He became a mentor to younger artists.
examples.zh: 他成為年輕藝術家的良師。

entries.definition: （名）導師、指導者；有經驗並提供建議與支持的人。

explains.en: This is an experienced person who guides someone with less experience. The guide shares advice and helps the learner grow. The relationship often lasts over time.
A new teacher meets regularly with a teacher who has worked for many years. They talk about lessons and classroom problems. The experienced teacher helps the newcomer learn.
The word can also be a verb meaning to give this kind of guidance. A person may share skills, answer questions, and offer encouragement. The aim is to help someone develop.

examples.en: The two streams merge near the bridge.
examples.zh: 兩條溪流在橋附近匯合。

examples.en: Traffic merges into one lane ahead.
examples.zh: 前方車流匯入同一條車道。

examples.en: We merged the two lists into a single file.
examples.zh: 我們把兩份清單合併成一個檔案。

explains.en: This means to join separate things so they become one. Two streams may flow together into a single river. Their waters are no longer in separate channels.
Two lanes of traffic may become one lane ahead. Vehicles from both sides join the same line. The road brings the two flows together.
The verb can also describe combining groups or information. Two clubs may join to form a larger club. Two lists can be brought together into one list.

examples.en: The recurring birdcage served as a poignant visual metaphor for emotional entrapment.
examples.zh: 影片中反覆出現的精緻金屬鳥籠，被導演巧妙運用為女主角內心渴望自由的深刻視覺隱喻。

examples.en: Poets frequently utilize the changing seasons as a metaphor for the human cycle of life and aging.
examples.zh: 詩人往往習慣將春夏秋冬的四季遞嬗，借代作為人生生老病死與歲月興衰的深刻隱喻。

examples.en: The filmmaker explained that the flooded city streets were an intentional metaphor for societal breakdown.
examples.zh: 導演在訪談中深入剖析，片中被滾滾洪流淹沒的末日都市街景，實則是整個文明體系崩解的鮮活隱喻。

explains.en: This is a way of describing something by saying it is another thing. The comparison is not meant literally. It helps readers imagine a quality or feeling.
A writer may call a classroom a zoo. The room does not actually contain wild animals. The comparison suggests that it is noisy or difficult to control.
A comparison using like or as is called a simile. This other form states the comparison more directly. Both can help make writing vivid.

examples.en: The train serves the whole metropolitan area.
examples.zh: 這班列車服務整個都會區。

examples.en: Many people work in the metropolitan center.
examples.zh: 許多人在都會中心工作。

examples.en: The metropolitan transport system connects the city and nearby towns.
examples.zh: 都會交通系統連接城市與附近的城鎮。

entries.definition: （形）大都市的；都會區的；（名）大主教

explains.en: This describes a large city and the nearby areas closely linked to it. People may live outside the city center but travel into it for work. The whole connected area is included.
A train network may link a city with surrounding towns. Travelers use the network every day. This word can describe the area that the service covers.
Services for a large urban region may cross the borders of several local districts. A transport plan can consider the whole region. The word focuses on that wider city area.

examples.en: A small cottage stood in the midst of the forest.
examples.zh: 一間小屋坐落在森林之中。

examples.en: The phone rang in the midst of our discussion.
examples.zh: 我們討論到一半時，電話響了。

examples.en: She stayed calm in the midst of the noisy crowd.
examples.zh: 她身處吵雜的人群之中，仍保持冷靜。

explains.en: This means the middle of a group, place, or event. Someone may be surrounded by many people. The word places them among those around them.
A small house stands between tall trees on every side. It lies within the surrounding forest. This noun can describe that central position.
The word can also refer to a time while something is happening. A phone may ring during a busy discussion. The interruption comes before the activity has ended.

examples.en: We watched the spring migration of the birds.
examples.zh: 我們觀察了鳥類春季的遷徙。

examples.en: The book describes migration from villages to cities.
examples.zh: 這本書描述了人口從鄉村移居城市的現象。

examples.en: The team planned the migration of files to the new system.
examples.zh: 團隊規劃將檔案移轉到新系統。

entries.definition: （名）遷移、移居；人或動物從一地移往另一地。

explains.en: This means movement from one place or region to another. Animals may do it at certain times of year. They often travel to find food or suitable places to breed.
People may also move from one region or country to another to live. Work, family, and safety can all affect the decision. The movement can involve many people over time.
The noun can also describe moving information between computer systems. Files may be transferred to a new system. Care is needed to keep the information complete.

examples.en: Completing the app user testing is a critical project milestone.
examples.zh: 完成應用程式的使用者測試是一項關鍵的專案里程碑。

examples.en: Reaching their tenth wedding anniversary was an emotional milestone for the couple.
examples.zh: 攜手迎來結婚十週年紀念日，對這對恩愛夫妻而言是一個充滿感觸的重大人生里程碑。

examples.en: The construction team celebrated reaching the tunneling breakthrough milestone.
examples.zh: 工程營造團隊在隧道全線順利貫通的關鍵里程碑時刻，現場開香檳歡慶重大勝利。

examples.en: Reaching 3,000 English vocabulary words is a tremendous learning milestone!
examples.zh: 成功累積掌握三千個實用英語單字是一項無比值得自豪的重大學習里程碑！

examples.en: Successfully launching our first commercial orbital rocket was a historic engineering milestone for the team.
examples.zh: 成功將我們團隊自主研發的第一枚商業入軌運載火箭送入浩瀚太空軌道，是全體工程研發團隊載入史冊的輝煌工程里程碑。

examples.en: Graduating from university marked an unforgettable milestone in his journey toward adulthood and independence.
examples.zh: 身著學士袍昂首從大學畢業，標誌著他邁向成熟獨立成人世界的征途中一個令人終生難忘的嶄新里程碑。

examples.en: Congratulations on mastering 5,000 core English words—an extraordinary learning milestone achieved!
examples.zh: 熱烈恭喜您紮實掌握了 5,000 個核心實用英語單字——這是一項令人無比驕傲與振奮的卓越學習重大里程碑！

examples.en: Reaching one million active daily subscribers marked a historic commercial milestone for the streaming platform.
examples.zh: 突破全球每日活躍訂閱付費用戶達一百萬大關，標誌著該影音串流平台在商業競爭上迎來了劃時代的歷史里程碑。

examples.en: Completing your first full 42-kilometer marathon is a thrilling milestone that changes how you view yourself.
examples.zh: 憑藉無比毅力咬牙完成人生第一場四十二公里全程馬拉松並衝過終點線，是一場徹底改寫自我極限認知的振奮人生里程碑。

examples.en: Reaching this Phase III milestone marks a transformative leap forward in combating metastatic disease.
examples.zh: 順利跨過這座第三期臨床試驗「歷史里程碑」（Milestone），標誌著人類對抗轉移性癌症邁出關鍵躍進。

examples.en: Celebrating our company's tenth anniversary is a proud milestone reflecting a decade of dedication.
examples.zh: 熱烈歡慶公司成立十週年是一座令人自豪的輝煌里程碑，凝聚了全體員工整整十載的戮力同心與奉獻。

examples.en: Completing her first marathon was a personal milestone that proved her physical endurance and grit.
examples.zh: 咬緊牙關跑完人生第一場四十二公里全程馬拉松，是一座完美證明自身體能耐力與堅毅意志的個人里程碑。

examples.en: Returning pristine asteroid samples marks a magnificent milestone in the grand history of human spaceflight.
examples.zh: 成功從小行星帶回未受污染的宇宙原始物質，是人類太空航行史上的一座「輝煌歷史里程碑」（Milestone）。

examples.en: Graduating from medical school was a hard-earned personal milestone achieved after seven grueling years.
examples.zh: 歷經長達七年日夜不休的嚴苛醫學專業修習與醫院實習，順利自醫學院畢業是他人生中最引以為傲的一座重要里程碑。

examples.en: Ancient Roman roads featured stone markers carved every thousand paces to indicate official route milestones.
examples.zh: 古羅馬在帝國全境鋪設的石板大道上，每隔一千個雙步便會豎立一尊雕刻精緻的石刻里程碑，標示行車里程距離。

examples.en: Completing all 7,000 English vocabulary words marks a historic personal learning milestone.
examples.zh: 完成全套 7,000 個實用英語單字，標誌著個人語言學習生涯中一座「歷史性輝煌里程碑」（Milestone）。

examples.en: Reaching this milestone gives you the confidence to communicate with native speakers anywhere.
examples.zh: 跨越這座重要里程碑，讓你有充足的自信在世界任何角落與母語人士自如交流。

examples.en: We celebrated this significant academic milestone with our study partners and mentors.
examples.zh: 我們與讀書會夥伴及指導老師共同慶祝這項深具意義的學術成就里程碑。

entries.definition: 里程碑；重大轉折點；累計完成五千字重大里程碑！；達成臨床試驗成功救人無數之歷史里程碑；人類從小行星採集純淨原始物質返回地球之歷史里程碑；跨越 7,000 實用單字之歷史性學習里程碑

explains.en: This can mean an important point in a person’s life or the progress of a project. It marks a meaningful achievement or change. People often pause to celebrate it.
A child reads a whole book alone for the first time. The family sees it as an important step in learning. The event shows how much the child has grown.
The original meaning is a marker beside a road showing distance in miles. Travelers could use these markers to judge their progress. That idea of marking progress also explains the figurative use.

examples.en: Painting tiny fantasy miniatures with intricate armor details requires steady hands and fine brushes.
examples.zh: 為精細的奇幻微縮模型盔甲塗裝上細膩紋路，需要極度平穩的雙手與超細面相筆。

examples.en: The dollhouse was filled with charming miniature furniture, including a tiny wooden dining set.
examples.zh: 這棟玩具娃娃屋裡擺滿了精巧迷人的袖珍微縮家具，甚至包括一套小巧玲瓏的原木餐桌椅。

examples.en: Growing up, he built miniature airplane models and hung them from his bedroom ceiling.
examples.zh: 在成長過程中，他熱衷於親手組裝各種微型飛機模型，並把它們一一懸吊在臥室的天花板下。

entries.definition: 微縮模型；微型的；袖珍的

explains.en: This describes something made on a very small scale. It may look like a larger real object. Details are reduced to fit the smaller size.
A model house may have tiny windows, doors, and chairs. The parts are much smaller than those in a real home. People enjoy seeing how carefully the small details are made.
The noun can name a small copy or a very small painting. Someone may hold the object in one hand. Its small size is a key feature.

examples.en: Synthetic minimal cells serve as clean-slate biological factories without wasteful evolutionary baggage.
examples.zh: 人工打造的「極簡人造細胞」（Minimal Cells），如同一張純淨的白紙生物工廠，完全拋棄了演化遺留的冗餘包袱。

examples.en: The storm caused only minimal cosmetic damage to the historic brick lighthouse on the rocky promontory.
examples.zh: 這場強烈風暴僅對海岬懸崖上的百年歷史磚造燈塔造成了極微小的表皮外觀輕傷，主結構安然無恙。

examples.en: His minimalist studio apartment featured clean lines, neutral colors, and minimal ornamental furniture.
examples.zh: 他的極簡風單身小公寓採用俐落清爽的幾何線條、中性大地色調，並刻意擺設最精簡低調的實用家具。

entries.definition: 剔除所有冗餘序列之人工合成極簡人造細胞的；極小的

explains.en: This means very small in amount or degree. There may be hardly any change. The amount is close to the lowest level needed or possible.
A wall needs only a small touch of paint after a light mark is removed. Very little work is required. This word can describe the effort involved.
A design with very few parts can also have this quality. It leaves out extra decoration and keeps only basic features. The result is simple and spare.

examples.en: We planned the work carefully to minimize waste.
examples.zh: 我們仔細規劃工作，以盡量減少浪費。

examples.en: Sharing a ride can help minimize travel costs.
examples.zh: 共乘有助於盡量降低交通費用。

examples.en: He tried to minimize the seriousness of the mistake.
examples.zh: 他試圖淡化這個錯誤的嚴重性。

explains.en: This means to make something as small or limited as possible. A person may try to reduce waste during a project. The aim is to avoid unnecessary amounts.
A club plans a trip and looks for ways to keep costs low. Members share supplies and compare prices. Their choices reduce the money needed.
The verb can also mean making a problem seem less important than it is. Someone may brush aside a serious mistake. That description can hide how much the problem matters.

examples.en: She added fresh mint to the cold drink.
examples.zh: 她在冷飲裡加入新鮮薄荷。

examples.en: The new coins were minted last year.
examples.zh: 這些新硬幣是去年鑄造的。

examples.en: The old toy was still in mint condition.
examples.zh: 這個老玩具仍保存得完好如新。

explains.en: This is a plant whose leaves have a fresh, strong smell and taste. People use the leaves in food and drinks. The flavor is also common in sweets and toothpaste.
The same noun can name a place where coins are made. Metal is shaped and stamped with a design. Finished coins can then be put into use.
As a verb, it means to make coins. The word also appears in a phrase meaning perfect condition. An old object kept without damage may be described that way.

examples.en: The missionary learned the local language before teaching.
examples.zh: 那位傳教士在教學前先學習了當地語言。

examples.en: She read a book about a missionary who lived overseas.
examples.zh: 她讀了一本關於旅居海外傳教士的書。

examples.en: The missionaries helped establish a village school.
examples.zh: 傳教士們協助成立了一所鄉村學校。

explains.en: This is a person sent to share religious beliefs with other people. The person may teach or explain their faith. Some travel to another community or country.
A person in this role may learn a new language before beginning the work. Clear speech helps them talk with local people. Understanding local customs can also matter.
Some people in this role also help with schools or community services. Their activities vary from place to place. Sharing religious belief remains an important part of the role.

examples.en: He gave a quiet moan when he tried to move his sore foot.
examples.zh: 他試著移動痠痛的腳時，輕輕呻吟了一聲。

examples.en: The tired dog moaned in its sleep.
examples.zh: 疲倦的狗在睡夢中低聲嗚咽。

examples.en: Please stop moaning about the weather.
examples.zh: 請別再抱怨天氣了。

entries.definition: （名）呻吟、抱怨聲；（動）呻吟、哀嘆或不斷抱怨。

explains.en: This is a long, low sound made when someone feels pain, sadness, or discomfort. The voice may sound weak or unhappy. It often expresses a feeling without clear words.
A person with a painful ankle may let out a low cry. The sound shows that something hurts. The noun can name that sound.
The verb can also mean complaining in an unhappy way. Someone may keep saying that a task is too hard. The repeated complaints show dissatisfaction.

examples.en: Practicing mock interviews with career coaches eliminates nervous fidgeting and rambling answers.
examples.zh: 與資深職涯教練進行高強度模擬面試演練，能有效克服上場緊張結巴並戒除冗長無重點的回答。

examples.en: Law students participated in an intense mock trial competition judged by practicing appellate magistrates.
examples.zh: 法律系高材生組隊參加激烈的全英語模擬法庭大賽，由現役資深高等法院法官親自坐鎮評判詰問。

examples.en: Running a realistic mock presentation in front of friends boosts confidence ahead of the real investor pitch.
examples.zh: 正式向創投評審提案前先在好友面前進行逼真的模擬簡報演練，能大幅增強上台的自信與台風。

explains.en: This means to make fun of someone in an unkind way. A person may copy another person’s voice to make others laugh. The action can hurt the person being copied.
As an adjective, it can describe a practice version of a real event. Students may take a trial exam before the final one. The practice helps them learn what to expect.
The adjective can also describe something pretend or not genuine. An actor may show false surprise during a funny scene. The feeling is performed rather than truly felt.

examples.en: The camera is in video mode.
examples.zh: 相機目前處於錄影模式。

examples.en: The device has a quiet mode for use at night.
examples.zh: 這個裝置有供夜間使用的安靜模式。

examples.en: The mode of the numbers two, three, three, and five is three.
examples.zh: 二、三、三、五這組數字的眾數是三。

entries.definition: 方式；模式；狀態；模式選項。

explains.en: This means a particular way in which something works or is done. A machine may have several settings. Each setting changes its behavior.
A camera may have one setting for still pictures and another for video. The user chooses which kind of work it will do. The noun can name the chosen setting.
In mathematics, this names the value that appears most often in a set of data. In the list one, two, two, and three, the repeated value is two. It occurs more often than the others.

examples.en: We modified the plan when the weather changed.
examples.zh: 天氣改變時，我們調整了計畫。

examples.en: She modified the model by adding a wider base.
examples.zh: 她為模型加上更寬的底座，做了修改。

examples.en: The teacher modified the game for younger children.
examples.zh: 老師調整了遊戲，讓年紀較小的孩子也適合玩。

explains.en: This means to change something without replacing it completely. The change may make it more useful or suitable. Most of the original thing remains.
A student builds a paper airplane that falls quickly. The student bends the wings a little and tries again. The small change may improve the flight.
A plan can also be adjusted to suit new conditions. Rain may lead a class to move a game indoors. The activity continues with a few changes.

examples.en: A water molecule contains three atoms.
examples.zh: 一個水分子含有三個原子。

examples.en: The model shows the shape of a molecule.
examples.zh: 這個模型顯示了一個分子的形狀。

examples.en: Scientists study how molecules move and interact.
examples.zh: 科學家研究分子如何移動與互相作用。

explains.en: This is a tiny group of atoms joined together. It is far too small to see with your eyes alone. Many substances are made of these groups.
A unit of water contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom. The three atoms are joined together. This tiny group has the chemical identity of water.
Different arrangements of atoms make different substances. Oxygen in the air commonly has two atoms joined together. Carbon dioxide has one carbon atom joined with two oxygen atoms.

examples.en: The company had a monopoly on the local supply of salt.
examples.zh: 這家公司壟斷了當地的鹽供應。

examples.en: The new shop ended the old store’s monopoly.
examples.zh: 新商店打破了老店的壟斷地位。

examples.en: No one person should have a monopoly on the group’s decisions.
examples.zh: 不應由一個人獨攬團體的所有決定。

entries.definition: （名）壟斷、專賣；由單一企業或團體控制某市場或資源。

explains.en: This means control of a market or activity by one company or person. A single business may be the only seller of a product. Customers then have little or no choice of another supplier.
Imagine that only one shop in a region is allowed to sell a certain item. Other shops cannot offer it. That shop has exclusive control of those sales.
The noun can also be used more loosely for having all of something that others want to share. One person may try to control every decision. Others may object to having no chance to take part.

examples.en: The story raises questions about morality and fairness.
examples.zh: 這個故事提出了道德與公平的問題。

examples.en: They discussed the morality of keeping money they had found.
examples.zh: 他們討論了將撿到的錢據為己有是否合乎道德。

examples.en: Honesty is an important part of her sense of morality.
examples.zh: 誠實是她道德觀中很重要的一部分。

explains.en: This concerns ideas about right and wrong behavior. It asks how people ought to treat one another. Honesty, fairness, and kindness are common topics.
A child finds money that belongs to a classmate. Deciding whether to return it involves a question of right and wrong. The choice shows values in action.
People and societies can hold different views about proper behavior. They may discuss why an action is good or harmful. The noun names this area of values and judgment.

examples.en: The poem reflects on human mortality.
examples.zh: 這首詩思考人終有一死的事實。

examples.en: The study compared mortality rates in two regions.
examples.zh: 這項研究比較了兩個地區的死亡率。

examples.en: The report recorded changes in infant mortality.
examples.zh: 這份報告記錄了嬰兒死亡率的變化。

entries.definition: （名）死亡率；死亡現象；必有一死的事實

explains.en: This can mean the fact that living things eventually die. Human beings do not live forever. The noun names that condition of being able to die.
The word can also concern the number or rate of deaths in a group. A study may count deaths over a certain period. The figures help describe what happened to the group.
A writer may use this noun while thinking about how limited a human lifetime is. A character may consider what matters most in the time available. The topic connects life with its eventual end.

examples.en: The young couple took out a thirty-year bank home mortgage.
examples.zh: 這對年輕夫妻向銀行申辦了三十年期的青年安心成家房貸。

examples.en: Refinancing your home mortgage at a lower rate can save thousands each year.
examples.zh: 以更低廉的利率辦理房屋貸款轉貸轉貸，每年能省下數以萬計的利息。

examples.en: They finally made their last mortgage payment and owned their house outright.
examples.zh: 他們終於全額還清了最後一筆房貸本息，徹徹底底擁有了屬於自己的房子。

examples.en: First-time buyers applied for a 30-year preferential home mortgage loan.
examples.zh: 年輕首購族夫妻向公股銀行正式申辦了為期三十年期的青年安心成家優惠首購房貸。

examples.en: The young couple calculated their monthly income to ensure they could comfortably service the mortgage.
examples.zh: 這對年輕新婚夫妻精準盤點每月家庭總收入，以確保薪資足以輕鬆負擔每月房貸還款。

examples.en: Paying off the 20-year mortgage early freed up substantial cash for retirement investments.
examples.zh: 提前五年提早清償長達二十年的房屋抵押貸款，讓夫妻倆騰出了豐沛的現金投入退休儲蓄。

examples.en: First-time buyers applied for Taiwan's preferential Youth Housing Mortgage scheme.
examples.zh: 許多年輕首購族積極申辦政府推出的新青安優惠房屋貸款專案以圓成家購屋之夢。

examples.en: Making biweekly payments can shorten the total lifespan of your home mortgage.
examples.zh: 改採雙週彈性還款機制，能有效加速本金償還進度並顯著縮短長期房貸的總還款年限。

examples.en: Defaulting on your mortgage can result in the bank seizing and auctioning the property.
examples.zh: 若長期無故違約拒繳房屋貸款，銀行依法有權向法院聲請拍賣抵押房產以強制清償債權。

entries.definition: 房屋貸款；房貸；抵押；房屋抵押貸款

explains.en: This is a loan secured by a home or other property. People often use it to help buy a house. The borrower makes payments over time.
The property serves as security for the money borrowed. If the debt is not repaid, the lender may be able to have the property sold. The arrangement links the loan to that property.
A home buyer may pay part of the price with savings and borrow the rest. Regular payments usually cover interest and part of the debt. The noun can name the loan or the related agreement.

examples.en: Her motive for joining the club was to make new friends.
examples.zh: 她加入社團的動機是結交新朋友。

examples.en: The detective tried to understand the thief’s motive.
examples.zh: 偵探試圖了解竊賊的動機。

examples.en: He had a kind motive for offering help.
examples.zh: 他提供協助的動機是出於善意。

explains.en: This is a reason for doing something. It explains what makes a person choose an action. The reason may be clear or hidden.
A child helps a classmate carry books because the classmate has a sore arm. The wish to help is the reason behind the action. That reason has this name.
The same action can have different reasons behind it. One person may give a gift out of kindness. Another may hope to receive a favor in return.

examples.en: She mounted her bicycle and rode toward the park.
examples.zh: 她騎上腳踏車，朝公園出發。

examples.en: We mounted the photograph on a piece of card.
examples.zh: 我們把照片裱貼在一張卡紙上。

examples.en: Excitement mounted as the show was about to begin.
examples.zh: 表演即將開始，大家越來越興奮。

entries.definition: （名）山、支架、底座；（動）安裝、登上；依語境判斷。

explains.en: This means to climb onto something, such as a horse or bicycle. A person moves into position to ride. The action comes before setting off.
The verb can also mean fixing something firmly in place. A picture may be attached to a board or wall. The support holds it where people can see it.
The word can also mean to increase in amount or intensity. Worry may grow as a deadline comes closer. The feeling becomes stronger over time.

examples.en: He mumbled a greeting as he woke up.
examples.zh: 他醒來時，含糊地打了聲招呼。

examples.en: Please do not mumble; I cannot hear the words clearly.
examples.zh: 請不要含糊地說話，我聽不清楚。

examples.en: Her answer came out as a quiet mumble.
examples.zh: 她的回答低聲含糊不清。

entries.definition: 含糊地說；咕噥；小聲嘟噥。

explains.en: This means to speak quietly and unclearly. The words may run together or be hard to hear. Other people may need to ask the speaker to repeat them.
A sleepy child answers without opening the mouth much. The voice is low and the words are not clear. A parent leans closer to understand.
The noun can name an unclear, low bit of speech. A listener may hear sound without knowing exactly what was said. It differs from a clear whisper whose words are easy to follow.

examples.en: The town opened a new municipal swimming pool.
examples.zh: 鎮上開放了一座新的公立游泳池。

examples.en: The meeting was held in the municipal building.
examples.zh: 會議在市政大樓裡舉行。

examples.en: Municipal workers repaired the path in the park.
examples.zh: 市政工作人員修好了公園裡的步道。

entries.definition: （形）市政的；地方政府的；城市公共服務的

explains.en: This describes things connected with the government of a town or city. It may concern services or buildings run for local residents. A town hall is one example.
A city may operate a public swimming pool. Local workers maintain it and manage its opening hours. This word can describe the pool and its service.
Local authorities make decisions about matters such as roads and public spaces. Their work concerns the city or town they serve. The word points to that level of government.

examples.en: The horse had powerful, muscular legs.
examples.zh: 這匹馬有強壯、肌肉發達的腿。

examples.en: The athlete had a muscular build.
examples.zh: 這名運動員體格強壯，肌肉發達。

examples.en: The lesson explained how muscular movement helps us walk.
examples.zh: 這堂課解釋了肌肉運動如何幫助我們行走。

explains.en: This can describe a body with strong, well-developed muscles. A person may have thick, firm arms or legs. The muscles are an obvious feature of the body.
The word can also mean related to muscles in general. A movement depends on parts of the body tightening and relaxing. These actions help move bones and other body parts.
An animal can have a strong build suited to powerful movement. A horse may use its strong legs to pull a heavy load. The word can describe that visible strength.

examples.en: He spread mustard on his sandwich.
examples.zh: 他在三明治上塗了芥末醬。

examples.en: The sauce contained ground mustard seeds.
examples.zh: 這種醬汁含有磨碎的芥末籽。

examples.en: The field was bright with yellow mustard flowers.
examples.zh: 田裡開滿了鮮黃色的芥菜花。

entries.definition: （名）芥末；芥菜籽製成的辛香調味醬，也指芥菜植物。

explains.en: This is a plant with seeds that can be ground into a sharp-tasting sauce. The sauce is often yellow or brown. People may spread it on sandwiches.
A cook can mix the ground seeds with liquid and other ingredients. Different mixtures produce different flavors. Some taste mild while others are very strong.
The plant can also have leaves used as food. Those leaves may be cooked like other greens. Both the seeds and leaves can be useful in the kitchen.

examples.en: The children read a Greek myth about a brave hero.
examples.zh: 孩子們讀了一則關於勇敢英雄的希臘神話。

examples.en: The myth explains how the island was formed.
examples.zh: 這則神話解釋了島嶼是如何形成的。

examples.en: The article challenged a common myth about learning.
examples.zh: 這篇文章質疑了一種關於學習的常見迷思。

entries.definition: 神話；迷思；廣為流傳但不正確的說法。

explains.en: This can mean a traditional story that explains something about the world. It may include gods, heroes, or unusual events. Such stories are part of a culture’s shared past.
An old tale may tell how the sun or mountains came to exist. People pass the tale from one generation to another. It can express important beliefs and values.
The noun can also mean a widely repeated belief that is not true. People may accept a claim without checking it. Evidence can show that the claim is mistaken.

examples.en: It was naive to believe every promise in the advertisement.
examples.zh: 相信廣告裡的每個承諾，未免太天真。

examples.en: His naive plan did not consider how much the trip would cost.
examples.zh: 他天真的計畫沒有考慮旅行要花多少錢。

examples.en: She was young and naive when she first moved away from home.
examples.zh: 她第一次離家生活時，年輕又天真。

entries.definition: （形）天真的；缺乏經驗的；輕信的

explains.en: This describes someone who lacks experience and trusts things too easily. The person may not notice a hidden risk or dishonest plan. Their view of the situation can be too simple.
A child believes that every promise in an advertisement must be true. The child has not yet learned to question the claim. More experience may change that belief.
The word can describe an idea as well as a person. A plan may ignore difficulties that are likely to arise. It assumes that everything will work out easily.

examples.en: The diorama's emotional narrative captures tired soldiers sharing a quiet laugh beside a campfire.
examples.zh: 這座微縮場景蘊含著深沉動人的敘事張力，定格了疲憊戰士在營火旁相視一笑的溫暖瞬間。

examples.en: The best-selling novel weaves a complex, multi-perspective narrative spanning three generations of an immigrant family.
examples.zh: 這本轟動文壇的暢銷經典小說，巧妙編織出一套跨越三代移民家族愛恨糾葛、視角宏大多元的精彩歷史敘事史詩。

examples.en: Marketing directors understand that an authentic brand narrative builds lasting emotional loyalty with consumers.
examples.zh: 卓越的品牌行銷總監深知：唯有一套真誠不造作、打動人心的品牌故事敘事核心，才能與廣大消費者建立長遠深厚的情感共鳴。

entries.definition: 凝結歷史瞬間的微縮敘事張力

explains.en: This is an account of events told as a connected story. It can be spoken or written. The events may be real or imagined.
A traveler tells what happened from the start of a journey to its end. The account links people, places, and actions. Listeners follow how one event leads to another.
As an adjective, it describes writing or art that tells a story. A poem may follow a character through several events. The focus is on what happens and how it is told.

examples.en: A nasty smell came from the old bin.
examples.zh: 舊垃圾桶傳出一股難聞的氣味。

examples.en: That was a nasty thing to say to your friend.
examples.zh: 對朋友說那種話很刻薄。

examples.en: He had a nasty fall on the wet path.
examples.zh: 他在濕滑的小路上重重摔了一跤。

entries.definition: （形）令人不快的；惡意的；嚴重的

explains.en: This describes something very unpleasant or disagreeable. A bad smell or taste can have this quality. People usually want to avoid it.
The word can also describe unkind behavior. A person may make a hurtful comment to upset someone. The action feels mean rather than friendly.
It can also describe something serious or difficult to deal with. A fall may leave a painful cut. A storm may create especially unpleasant conditions.

examples.en: After peaceful negotiations, both parties finalized the agreement.
examples.zh: 經過和平協商後，雙方最終敲定了合作協議。

examples.en: Complex salary negotiations between players and management took nearly three weeks.
examples.zh: 球員與球團管理階層之間錯綜複雜的薪資待遇談判協商耗時將近三個星期。

examples.en: Good listening skills are an invaluable asset during any high-stakes business negotiation.
examples.zh: 在任何攸關重大商業利益的高層談判桌上，善於傾聽是一項無比珍貴的資產。

examples.en: Contract price negotiations concluded after three rounds of discussions.
examples.zh: 這場攸關重大的合約價格商業談判在歷經三輪深度協商後圓滿拍板定案。

examples.en: Skillful negotiation can turn a tense dispute into a mutually profitable venture.
examples.zh: 熟練的談判技巧能將緊張的爭端轉化為互利互惠的商業合作。

examples.en: Both labor and management entered collective bargaining negotiations yesterday.
examples.zh: 勞資雙方昨天正式展開了勞資集體協商談判。

examples.en: Principled win-win negotiation secures profitable contracts while forging enduring vendor partnerships.
examples.zh: 秉持原則的雙贏談判技巧能在為公司爭取最優合約利潤的同時，與供應商建立長久信任的夥伴關係。

examples.en: After two weeks of intense negotiation, both labor unions and management ratified the collective agreement.
examples.zh: 經過長達兩週緊鑼密鼓的勞資協商談判，工會代表與資方高層終於共同正式簽署了團體協約。

examples.en: Mastering the art of salary negotiation starts with thorough research into regional compensation benchmarks.
examples.zh: 精通求職薪資談判藝術的第一步，在於事前全面詳實調研該職位在當前就業市場的行情薪酬水準。

entries.definition: 談判；協商會議；商務談判；商業雙贏談判技巧；協商

explains.en: This is a discussion aimed at reaching an agreement. People may begin with different wishes. They talk about changes each side could accept.
A buyer and seller discuss the price of a bicycle. The buyer offers less and the seller suggests another amount. They keep talking to find a price that works for both.
The process can involve more than money. Two groups may discuss how to share a space or divide work. Listening and making clear offers can help them reach common terms.

examples.en: Optical tweezers use focused lasers to arrange hundreds of individual neutral atoms into 3D lattices.
examples.zh: 聚焦雷射光鑷將數百顆中性原子精確排列成立體陣列，展現極高擴展潛力。

examples.en: Pumping neutral rubidium atoms into Rydberg states triggers strong dipole interactions for gate logic.
examples.zh: 將中性銣原子激發至高能量的里德伯態，能激發出強烈的偶極相互作用以執行雙位元邏輯運算。

examples.en: Neutral atom architectures scale rapidly because thousands of identical atoms can be held simultaneously.
examples.zh: 中性原子運算架構具備極為驚人的擴展潛力，因為同一光場中能同時穩定懸浮操控數千顆完全相同的原子。

entries.definition: 中性原子光鑷雷射陣列量子運算的；中性的

explains.en: This can mean not supporting either side in a disagreement. A person listens without choosing a team to defend. The position avoids taking sides.
The adjective can also describe a color that is quiet and easy to combine with others. Gray and beige are common examples. These colors often form a simple background.

In chemistry, this can describe a solution that is neither acidic nor alkaline. The balance differs from that in vinegar or a strong soap solution. Pure water is a familiar example under ordinary conditions.

examples.en: I nominate Maya to lead our project team.
examples.zh: 我提名瑪雅擔任專題小組的組長。

examples.en: The teacher nominated him for a writing award.
examples.zh: 老師提名他角逐一個寫作獎項。

examples.en: Each club can nominate one member for the role.
examples.zh: 每個社團都可以提名一位成員擔任這個職務。

entries.definition: （動）提名、推薦；正式提出某人作為候選者或負責人。

explains.en: This means to formally suggest someone for a job, role, or honor. Other people may consider that person before making a choice. The suggestion begins the process.
A class is choosing a leader for a project. One student puts forward a classmate’s name. The class can then discuss or vote on the choice.
A group can also put someone forward for a prize. The person has not necessarily won yet. The action places them among those being considered.

examples.en: Her nomination for the award surprised her family.
examples.zh: 她獲得該獎項提名，讓家人很驚喜。

examples.en: The club accepted nominations for a new leader.
examples.zh: 社團接受新任領導人的提名。

examples.en: He received two nominations at the film festival.
examples.zh: 他在影展中獲得兩項提名。

entries.definition: 提名；任命；被提名的資格或身分。

explains.en: This is the act of formally suggesting someone for a role or award. A name is put forward for consideration. The final choice may come later.
A classmate suggests a student as a possible team captain. That official suggestion has this name. Other students may suggest different people.
The noun can also refer to being placed among possible winners of an award. It recognizes someone for consideration. Receiving it does not necessarily mean winning the prize.

examples.en: All five Best Director nominees gathered onstage to celebrate creative artistic courage.
examples.zh: 入圍金馬獎最佳導演獎的五位優秀電影導演齊聚榮耀舞台，共同舉杯慶祝無畏的創作勇氣。

examples.en: Being named an Oscar nominee instantly boosts an actor's international profile and career prospects.
examples.zh: 榮獲奧斯卡金像獎提名入圍者殊榮，能瞬間讓演員的國際知名度與未來的片約片酬身價水漲船高。

examples.en: The award ceremony cameras captured the anxious expressions of every Best Actor nominee.
examples.zh: 頒獎典禮現場導播鏡頭在揭曉得主瞬間，即時捕捉每位最佳男主角入圍者屏氣凝神的緊張神情。

explains.en: This is a person who has been formally suggested for a role or award. The person is being considered. Someone else may still receive the final position or prize.
A student is put forward as a possible class leader. The class has not voted yet. The noun can name that student at this stage.
An award ceremony may announce several people for one prize. Each has been selected for consideration. Only some of them will become winners.

examples.en: She volunteers for a nonprofit that helps local families.
examples.zh: 她在一個協助當地家庭的非營利組織擔任志工。

examples.en: The nonprofit group runs an after-school reading program.
examples.zh: 這個非營利團體經營課後閱讀計畫。

examples.en: The museum is operated by a nonprofit organization.
examples.zh: 這間博物館由非營利組織營運。

entries.definition: （形）非營利的；不以賺取利潤為目的的

explains.en: This describes an organization whose purpose is not to distribute profits to owners. Money left after costs is used to support its work. The work may serve a community or another cause.
A group may run a food bank and use donations to buy supplies. It can pay workers and other necessary costs. Extra income supports the group’s purpose.
The noun can name an organization of this kind. It may raise funds, provide services, or support the arts. Its purpose guides how its money is used.

examples.en: At our school, lining up before lunch is the norm.
examples.zh: 在我們學校，午餐前排隊是常見規矩。

examples.en: The norm at the beach is to wear sandals.
examples.zh: 在海邊穿涼鞋是常見習慣。

examples.en: Their family norm is to eat dinner together.
examples.zh: 他們家的習慣是一起吃晚餐。

explains.en: A shared standard guides behavior in a group, even when nobody has written a rule. People may recognize it by seeing what others commonly do. This expectation shapes everyday conduct.
At a library, visitors speak quietly because that is the expected behavior. A child who shouts may surprise people nearby. The shared expectation is a social standard.
Groups can have different standards for clothing, greetings, or taking turns. These expectations may change over time. A new member often learns them by watching others.

examples.en: There was a noticeable change in the weather.
examples.zh: 天氣有了明顯的變化。

examples.en: Her red hat made her easy to spot because it was noticeable.
examples.zh: 她的紅帽子很顯眼，所以大家很容易看到她。

examples.en: The crack became noticeable after we painted the wall.
examples.zh: 我們粉刷牆壁後，那道裂縫變得很明顯。

entries.definition: （形）明顯的、容易察覺的；足以引起注意的。

explains.en: This describes something easy to see, hear, or recognize. A small change can become clear when it stands out from what came before. People do not need to search carefully to find it.
After a haircut, a person may look quite different to friends. The change catches their attention right away. It can be described as easy to observe.
A bright red sign is easier to spot than a gray sign on a gray wall. Strong color makes it stand out. The quality concerns how readily something attracts attention.

examples.en: Please notify me if the meeting time changes.
examples.zh: 如果會議時間改變，請通知我。

examples.en: The school will notify parents about the field trip.
examples.zh: 學校會通知家長校外教學的事。

examples.en: We must notify the coach before we miss practice.
examples.zh: 如果我們不能參加練習，必須先通知教練。

explains.en: This means to tell someone important information, often in a formal way. A message may arrive by letter, phone, or computer. The receiver learns that something has happened or will happen.
A school office sends a note to families about a changed schedule. The message gives them time to prepare. The verb describes sending that kind of information.
A company may contact a customer when a package is ready. The notice can include a date or instructions. The action makes sure the other person is informed.

examples.en: She had a notion that the keys were in the car.
examples.zh: 她猜想鑰匙可能在車裡。

examples.en: The notion of sharing toys was new to the puppy.
examples.zh: 分享玩具這個想法對那隻小狗來說很新鮮。

examples.en: I like the notion of walking to school together.
examples.zh: 我喜歡一起走路上學這個點子。

explains.en: This is an idea or belief about something. It may be a general understanding rather than a carefully proven fact. Different people can hold different ideas.
A child might believe that every bird can fly. New information about penguins can change that belief. The noun can name a thought someone has about the world.
The word can also refer to a small or vague idea. A person may have only a rough plan for a weekend project. The thought exists, but its details are not yet settled.

examples.en: There was nowhere to park near the bustling night market.
examples.zh: 在熱鬧的夜市附近根本無處可以停車。

examples.en: During the fierce typhoon, there was nowhere safe outdoors.
examples.zh: 在強烈颱風肆虐期間，戶外根本沒有任何一處是安全的。

examples.en: The mysterious stray cat seemed to vanish into nowhere within seconds.
examples.zh: 那隻神秘的流浪貓彷彿在幾秒鐘內憑空消失得無影無蹤。

explains.en: This adverb points to no place at all. It can describe a search that finds no location or a person who has no destination. The meaning depends on the surrounding sentence.
A family looks in every room for a missing shoe but cannot find it. They may say the shoe is in no place they can discover. The word can express that result.

In a sentence such as “We have no place to sit,” the speaker means there is no available seat. It can also describe traveling without a clear destination. The adverb often appears with a negative idea.

examples.en: Dark green leafy vegetables are packed with essential vitamins and nutrients.
examples.zh: 深綠色葉菜類蔬菜富含人體不可或缺的多種維生素與必需營養素。

examples.en: Fertile soil delivers vital nutrients to crops through organic composting.
examples.zh: 肥沃的土壤透過有機堆肥為農作物輸送源源不絕的關鍵營養成分。

examples.en: Overcooking vegetables can destroy delicate heat-sensitive nutrients like vitamin C.
examples.zh: 過度高溫久煮蔬菜容易破壞維生素 C 等不耐熱的嬌貴營養素。

examples.en: Organic dark leafy vegetables are packed with essential vitamins, minerals, and disease-fighting phytonutrients.
examples.zh: 在肥沃健康土壤中生長的有機深綠色蔬菜，富含人體必需的礦物質與多酚類植化素營養成分。

examples.en: Healthy agricultural soil contains balanced levels of nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium as primary plant nutrients.
examples.zh: 充滿生機的健康農田泥土，蘊含著黃金比例調和的氮、磷、鉀三大核心植物所需巨量營養元素。

examples.en: Breast milk provides an ideal balance of fats, carbohydrates, and protective antibodies as complete infant nutrient food.
examples.zh: 純天然母乳提供了比例完美的優質脂質、乳糖碳水化合物與免疫抗體，是新生兒最天然完整的營養盛宴。

entries.definition: 營養素；養分；富含有機微量元素之飽滿營養成分

explains.en: This is a substance in food that living things need to grow and stay healthy. Protein, vitamins, and minerals are examples. Different substances perform different jobs in the body.
Plants take in water and minerals through their roots. These materials help the plant grow leaves and make seeds. Each needed substance has a role in supporting life.
Food labels may list the amounts of several useful substances. A balanced meal can provide a range of them. The noun names one needed part of food or soil.

examples.en: Proper nutrition during childhood fuels healthy bone and brain development.
examples.zh: 童年時期均衡充足的營養攝取是骨骼與大腦健全發育的基石。

examples.en: The certified dietitian gave an informative lecture on sports nutrition.
examples.zh: 具備國家執照的營養師就運動營養學進行了內容豐富精闢的專題演講。

examples.en: Malnutrition remains a serious challenge in impoverished rural regions.
examples.zh: 營養不良在貧困落後的偏遠鄉村地區依舊是一項嚴峻的民生挑戰。

examples.en: Premium pet foods meet balanced AAFCO nutrition standards across all life stages.
examples.zh: 頂級優質天然寵物糧食嚴格符合美國 AAFCO 全齡犬貓均衡營養標準，提供充足優質蛋白。

examples.en: Proper nutrition directly influences the immune strength and coat quality of developing puppies.
examples.zh: 均衡完善的營養配方直接決定了成長中幼犬的免疫抵抗力與被毛光澤。

examples.en: A veterinary nutritionist tailored a low-protein diet to support the cat's failing renal function.
examples.zh: 寵物營養學專家特別調配低蛋白處方膳食，以減輕腎功能衰退老貓的代謝負擔。

entries.definition: 營養；營養學；營養攝取；寵物均衡營養

explains.en: This is the process of getting and using substances from food. It concerns how eating supports growth and the body’s daily work. The word can also name the field that studies food and health.
A meal with grains, vegetables, and beans supplies the body with different materials. The body uses them for energy and growth. This describes the way food supports living things.
A class may study how meals affect the body over time. Students compare foods and learn what they contain. The subject is a branch of health science.

examples.en: Paying the rent on time is his obligation.
examples.zh: 準時付房租是他的責任。

examples.en: I have an obligation to return the library book.
examples.zh: 我有責任歸還圖書館的書。

examples.en: She felt an obligation to help her younger brother.
examples.zh: 她覺得自己有責任幫助弟弟。

explains.en: This is something a person is required or expected to do. The duty may come from a rule, promise, or relationship. It is stronger than a casual wish.
A student promises to return a borrowed book by Friday. Keeping that promise becomes a responsibility. The person is expected to complete it.
People may have duties at home, work, or in a community. Some are written into rules, while others come from trust. The noun can describe either kind of responsibility.

examples.en: The old map shows an obscure path through the hills.
examples.zh: 這張舊地圖標出一條鮮為人知的山間小徑。

examples.en: Clouds obscure the moon tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚雲層遮住了月亮。

examples.en: A stain made the tiny label obscure.
examples.zh: 污漬讓那張小標籤變得難以辨認。

entries.definition: （形）不出名的、難懂的；（動）使模糊、遮蔽。

explains.en: As an adjective, this describes something hard to see, understand, or know about. Poor light can hide details, and unfamiliar information can be difficult to follow. The exact sense depends on what is being described.
A faded sign hangs behind thick branches. Drivers may have trouble reading its words. Its position makes the message difficult to see.
As a verb, this means to hide or make something less clear. Smoke can cover a view, while confusing wording can hide a simple point. In both cases, something becomes harder to notice or understand.

examples.en: An observer wrote down every bird seen in the garden.
examples.zh: 一位觀察者記下在花園裡看到的每一種鳥。

examples.en: The observer watched the game from the side.
examples.zh: 觀察員在場邊觀看比賽。

examples.en: Each observer described what happened in the room.
examples.zh: 每位觀察者都描述了房間裡發生的事。

explains.en: This is a person who watches an event or situation carefully. The person may be present without taking part. Watching can help someone describe what happened.
A child stands beside a soccer field and follows each play. The child does not join either team. That watching role makes the child a viewer of the event.
Someone in this role may record details during a science activity or public meeting. Written notes can help others understand what occurred. The person mainly watches and reports.

examples.en: The odds of rain are high, so bring an umbrella.
examples.zh: 下雨的機率很高，所以帶把雨傘吧。

examples.en: Against the odds, our small team won the final.
examples.zh: 儘管勝算不高，我們的小隊還是贏了決賽。

examples.en: The two neighbors were at odds about the fence.
examples.zh: 兩位鄰居對圍籬的事有不同意見。

entries.definition: （名）勝算；可能性；賠率；困難處境

explains.en: This plural noun can describe how likely an event is to happen. A strong chance means success is more probable, while a small chance means it is less probable. It also appears in phrases about chances.
A team that has won many games may be expected to win again. Fans may say the chances favor that team. The word expresses likelihood rather than certainty.
The plural noun can also mean a difference or disagreement between people. If two friends are in conflict, they may be in disagreement. This use describes a lack of agreement.

examples.en: The bakery’s new offering is a lemon cake.
examples.zh: 這家麵包店新推出的品項是檸檬蛋糕。

examples.en: The museum is offering free tours this Sunday.
examples.zh: 博物館本週日提供免費導覽。

examples.en: Their handmade cards were a popular offering at the fair.
examples.zh: 他們的手工卡片是市集上很受歡迎的商品。

entries.definition: （名）提供的事物；供品；（動）提供（進行式）

explains.en: This noun can mean something presented for people to accept, buy, or use. A shop may provide a new service, while a person may give a gift. The item or service is being made available.
A museum opens a weekend class for families. Visitors can choose to join it. The class is one of the activities the museum provides.
In a religious setting, the word may mean a gift brought to a place of worship. In business, it can name a product or service for sale. The context shows which kind is meant.

examples.en: He added an olive to the top of each sandwich.
examples.zh: 他在每份三明治上放了一顆橄欖。

examples.en: The olive tree grew beside the stone wall.
examples.zh: 橄欖樹長在石牆旁。

examples.en: She wore an olive jacket on the hike.
examples.zh: 她健行時穿了一件橄欖綠外套。

explains.en: This word names a small oval fruit that grows on a tree. It is often green or dark purple when ripe. People eat it whole or press it to make cooking oil.
The fruit has a firm texture and a salty taste when prepared for eating. It may appear in salads, sandwiches, or pasta. The tree grows well in warm regions.
As an adjective, the word describes a yellowish-green or brownish-green color. A jacket in that shade can look earthy. The color takes its name from the fruit.

examples.en: Investing in triple-pane Low-E windows slashes operational carbon emissions from continuous air conditioning.
examples.zh: 投資安裝頂級三層 Low-E 節能低輻射玻璃窗，能顯著腰斬大樓三十年營運期間來自空調的營運碳排放。

examples.en: The automated underground MRT line became fully operational ahead of the upcoming national holiday.
examples.zh: 這條全自動駕駛高運量地下捷運新路網在國慶連假來臨前正式如期全線通車，投入日常商業營運運轉。

examples.en: The logistics company streamlined operational workflows to shorten package warehouse turnover time.
examples.zh: 這家大型智慧物流快遞企業全面梳理並簡化了各轉運站的作業工作流程，大幅縮短了包裹倉儲週轉時效。

entries.definition: 建築營運期用電碳排的；操作的

explains.en: This describes a machine, service, or system that is working and ready to be used. A closed or broken system is not in this state. The word can also relate to the way a task is carried out.
After repairs, the school elevator begins moving between floors again. Students can use it safely as part of the building. The adjective describes its working condition.
In business, the adjective may describe the practical work needed to run an organization. Staff schedules and daily procedures are part of that work. The surrounding topic clarifies the sense.

examples.en: Always show respect to your opponent after the match.
examples.zh: 比賽結束後務必展現對對手的尊重。

examples.en: His political opponent criticized the newly announced tax policy.
examples.zh: 他的政治對手批評了新公布的稅收政策。

examples.en: She studied her opponent's game footage carefully to identify weak spots.
examples.zh: 她仔細研究對手的比賽錄影以找出弱點破綻。

explains.en: This is someone who competes against another person or team. The people may face each other in a sport, game, or debate. Each side tries to reach a different result.
A chess player studies the person sitting across the board. Both players take turns and try to win. Each is the other player’s rival in the match.
The noun can also describe someone with a different position in an argument. Two speakers may disagree about a plan. One speaker is the other’s challenger in the discussion.

examples.en: The plan faced opposition from nearby residents.
examples.zh: 這項計畫遭到附近居民反對。

examples.en: Our team studied the opposition before the match.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍在比賽前研究了對手。

examples.en: She spoke in opposition to the new rule.
examples.zh: 她發言反對這項新規定。

entries.definition: 反對；反對派；對手；相對位置。

explains.en: This noun means resistance or disagreement toward a plan, idea, or action. People may speak against a proposal or try to stop it. The word can describe the resistance itself or the people who show it.
A town council suggests closing a playground. Families who want it to stay open speak against the plan. Their disagreement is resistance to the proposal.
In sports, the word can refer to the other side in a contest. In politics, it can name a group that challenges those in power. Context tells which sense is intended.

examples.en: We opted for the blue tent because it was lighter.
examples.zh: 我們選了藍色帳篷，因為它比較輕。

examples.en: Mina opted to stay home and finish her book.
examples.zh: Mina 選擇待在家裡看完她的書。

examples.en: You can opt for soup instead of salad.
examples.zh: 你可以選湯而不是沙拉。

explains.en: This verb means to choose one thing from several possibilities. A person usually makes the choice deliberately. The selected path may differ from what others choose.
A family can travel by train or by bus. They choose the train because the station is nearby. The verb describes making that selection.
The word often appears with “for” or “to.” A student may select a science club, or decide to walk home. The choice can involve an activity or an available option.

examples.en: Unwavering optimism enabled the founder to overcome early startup hurdles.
examples.zh: 堅定不移的樂觀信念支撐著創辦人成功克服創業初期的重重艱難險阻。

examples.en: Despite economic downturns, she approached new ventures with cautious optimism.
examples.zh: 儘管經濟面臨景氣衰退，她仍以審慎樂觀的態度開展新的商業投資。

examples.en: A healthy dose of optimism encourages people to pursue ambitious dreams.
examples.zh: 適度的樂觀心態能激勵人們勇敢追求遠大的夢想。

examples.en: Cultivating learned optimism reframes temporary challenges as valuable stepping stones toward mastery.
examples.zh: 在心底深植積極樂觀的心態，能將暫時的挑戰與困難視為通往卓越成長的珍貴墊腳石。

examples.en: Despite facing severe supply chain delays, the project manager maintained contagious optimism and high morale.
examples.zh: 儘管面臨關鍵零件供應鏈嚴重延遲的重重考驗，專案負責人始終保持著極具感染力的樂觀態度與高昂士氣。

examples.en: Economists expressed cautious optimism regarding next year’s job market recovery and export growth.
examples.zh: 總體經濟學者對明年度國內就業市場景氣回溫與出口外銷成長動能，普遍表達出審慎樂觀的看法。

entries.definition: 樂觀主義；正面心態；相信問題終能解決的習得性樂觀

explains.en: This is a hopeful way of thinking about what may happen. A person with this outlook expects that good results are possible. It does not mean that every problem will disappear.
A runner feels tired before a race but believes practice can help. That hopeful attitude gives the runner a reason to keep trying. It focuses on possible improvement.
The noun can describe hope shared by a group. After a difficult week, neighbors may expect their plans to succeed. Their positive expectation can influence how they act.

examples.en: The final question on the form is optional.
examples.zh: 表格上的最後一題可以選擇不回答。

examples.en: We added an optional stop at the lake.
examples.zh: 我們另外安排了可自行選擇的湖邊停留點。

examples.en: An optional art class begins after lunch.
examples.zh: 一堂選修美術課在午餐後開始。

explains.en: This describes something that a person may choose to do or use. It is available but not required. Someone can leave it out without breaking a rule.
A school offers an extra art club after regular classes. Students who want more drawing time can join. Attendance is a choice rather than a requirement.
A form may include an extra question that people can skip. The answer is not necessary for the main request. The adjective marks something as a personal choice.

examples.en: Lush hillside citrus orchards in Hsinchu produce famously sweet ponkan mandarins.
examples.zh: 新埔與峨眉山坡地上結實纍纍的柑橘觀光果園盛產果汁飽滿、甜美多汁的極品桶柑與椪柑。

examples.en: Tourists flocked to the hillside cherry orchard to pick sweet fruit under sunny blue skies.
examples.zh: 大批觀光客趁著晴空萬里的晴朗藍天，爭相造訪向陽山坡上的櫻桃園親手採摘甜美櫻桃。

examples.en: Pruning overgrown fruit trees each winter keeps the commercial apple orchard healthy and highly productive.
examples.zh: 每年嚴冬農閒期為過度徒長的果樹進行細緻修剪疏枝，能確保商業蘋果果園常保生機並維持高產。

explains.en: This is a piece of land where fruit trees are grown. Rows of trees may produce apples, pears, or other fruit. Workers care for the trees and gather the crop.
A family visits a farm in autumn and picks ripe apples from low branches. The trees stand in organized rows across the field. The place is used to grow fruit.
This kind of farm may change with the seasons. Blossoms appear in spring, fruit grows during warm months, and picking happens later. The trees are the central part of the land.

examples.en: Giant single-celled xenophyophores are fragile, centimeter-sized organisms thriving only on abyssal nodules.
examples.zh: 體型達數公分的「深海巨型單細胞生物」（Organisms），極度脆弱且專一性依附在錳結核硬表面生存。

examples.en: Soil microbiologists study microscopic soil organisms that convert decaying matter into plant nutrients.
examples.zh: 土壤微生物學家深入研究能將腐敗有機質轉化為作物易吸收養分的微觀土壤微生物。

examples.en: Any living organism requires water, energy sources, and suitable environmental conditions to reproduce.
examples.zh: 任何有生命的生物有機體，皆需要充足的水分、能量來源與合適的生態棲地環境才能繁衍後代。

entries.definition: 巨大單細胞原生生物異壁變蟲；生物有機體

explains.en: This is any living thing, from a tiny cell to a large animal. Living things take in materials, grow, and respond to their surroundings. The noun is used in biology for a living body.
A pond contains plants, insects, and fish. Each living body depends on its environment in a different way. Scientists may study one of these life forms closely.
The word can describe a whole living body with many working parts. It can also refer to a single microscopic life form. Its size does not change the basic meaning.

examples.en: The judges praised the originality of her story.
examples.zh: 評審稱讚她故事中的創意。

examples.en: His originality showed in the unusual garden design.
examples.zh: 他別出心裁的花園設計展現了他的創意。

examples.en: The project needs originality, not another copy.
examples.zh: 這項計畫需要創新點子，而不是再做一份複製品。

entries.definition: （名）獨創性、創意；新穎且具有個人特色的品質。

explains.en: This is the quality of having fresh or unusual ideas. A person may create something that does not simply copy earlier work. The result can feel new and personal.
A student builds a birdhouse shaped like a small castle. Its design is different from the usual box shape. The creative choice shows an individual style.
The quality may appear in art, writing, or problem solving. New ideas can still use familiar materials. What matters is the distinctive way they are combined.

examples.en: Influencers post stylish daily #OOTD (outfit of the day) photos on Instagram.
examples.zh: 潮流穿搭網紅每日在 Instagram 上打卡分享充滿巧思與層次感的精緻 #OOTD 今日穿搭照片。

examples.en: She completed her chic outfit with a pair of leather ankle boots and gold hoop earrings.
examples.zh: 她穿上一雙俐落真皮短踝靴並戴上金屬圈型耳環，讓整套時髦穿搭更加畫龍點睛。

examples.en: Selecting an appropriate outfit for a job interview creates an outstanding first impression.
examples.zh: 為求職面試挑選得體合宜的正式套裝穿搭，能為考官留下極佳的第一印象。

explains.en: This noun means a set of clothes worn together. The pieces may be chosen for a certain activity, weather, or appearance. As a verb, it can mean to provide someone with needed clothing or equipment.
A child wears a warm coat, boots, and a scarf for a snowy walk. The pieces work together for one occasion. They make up a coordinated set of clothing.
A group preparing for a camping trip may receive tents and cooking tools. The verb describes supplying the group with what it needs. The context shows whether clothing or equipment is meant.

examples.en: You can buy branded clothing at discount prices in the outlet.
examples.zh: 你可以在暢貨中心以折扣價買到名牌服飾。

examples.en: Don't overload the electrical outlet with too many high-power appliances.
examples.zh: 切勿在電源插座上插上過多高功率家電以免負載過重。

examples.en: The sports outlet mall is located just twenty minutes from the airport.
examples.zh: 這座運動品牌暢貨中心距離機場僅二十分鐘車程。

entries.definition: 暢貨中心；暢貨門市；插座

explains.en: This noun can mean a place where goods are sold, often directly by a maker or at reduced prices. It can also name a wall fitting that supplies electricity to a plug. The surrounding sentence makes the sense clear.
A family visits a shop outside the city to buy factory goods at lower prices. The store is a retail location. At home, a person may connect a lamp to a wall socket instead.
The word can also mean a way to express feelings or use energy. Painting may give someone a healthy way to share emotions. In other situations, it refers to a business that sells goods.

examples.en: The farm increased its output of apples this year.
examples.zh: 這座農場今年增加了蘋果產量。

examples.en: The computer outputs a short report after each test.
examples.zh: 電腦在每次測試後輸出一份簡短報告。

examples.en: Our team checked the output from the new printer.
examples.zh: 我們的小組檢查了新印表機列印的結果。

explains.en: This noun can mean the amount of work, goods, or information produced. A factory measures how many items it makes each day. Computers also send results after processing information.
A printer receives a document and produces pages on paper. Those pages are the result of its work. The noun can name the produced material.
As a verb, it means to produce or send something out. A machine may provide a printed label, while a program sends numbers to a screen. The word connects a process with what comes from it.

examples.en: As an outsider, I needed help finding the meeting room.
examples.zh: 身為外來者，我需要有人幫忙找會議室。

examples.en: The team welcomed the outsider into their game.
examples.zh: 隊員們歡迎新來的人加入遊戲。

examples.en: An outsider may see the problem in a new way.
examples.zh: 圈外人或許能以新的角度看待這個問題。

explains.en: This is someone who does not belong to a particular group or community. The person may be new, unfamiliar, or simply not included. The word describes their position in relation to the group.
A new student arrives after the school year has begun. The class already knows its routines and friends. The newcomer may feel like someone from beyond the group.
The noun can also mean a person without special knowledge of a field. An unfamiliar reader may need extra explanation. The meaning depends on whether the group or subject is being discussed.

examples.en: The overall design of the playground is easy to understand.
examples.zh: 遊樂場的整體設計簡單明瞭。

examples.en: Overall, the trip went better than we expected.
examples.zh: 整體而言，這趟旅行比我們預期的順利。

examples.en: Dad wore an overall to keep paint off his clothes.
examples.zh: 爸爸穿了一件工作服，避免油漆沾到衣服上。

entries.definition: （形）整體的；全面的；（副）總的來說；（名）工作服

explains.en: This adjective describes the whole of something rather than one small part. It can summarize a general result or impression. As an adverb, it can mean when all parts are considered together.
A teacher looks at a student’s work across several subjects. One difficult quiz does not decide the full judgment. The complete picture matters more than one detail.
The word can also name a loose garment worn over regular clothes for protection. A painter wears one while working. In that use, it is a noun and refers to clothing.

examples.en: Automated Overhead Hoist Transport (OHT) vehicles glide silently along ceiling tracks delivering wafer pods.
examples.zh: 懸掛於天花板軌道上的 OHT 無人自動化搬運天車（Overhead Transport），安靜穿梭廠區運送晶圓傳送盒。

examples.en: Flight attendants assisted passengers with stowing heavy carry-on luggage inside the aircraft overhead bins.
examples.zh: 親切的客艙空服員主動上前協助年長旅客，將沉重隨身登機手提行李穩妥安放於客艙座椅上方行李櫃內。

examples.en: Cutting corporate overhead expenses by subleasing unused office space helped the agency stay solvent.
examples.zh: 透過將閒置未用的辦公樓層轉租分租以大幅削減企業固定營運管理間接成本（Overhead），幫助公司平穩度過難關。

entries.definition: 天軌天車全自動傳送系統 (OHT) 的

explains.en: This word describes something located above a person or place. It can also refer to costs needed to keep a business running, such as rent and electricity. As a noun, it can name those ongoing costs.
A plane passes high above a beach. People look up as its shadow moves across the sand. Its position is above them.
A small shop pays for lights, rent, and other regular expenses. These costs do not belong to one particular product. The noun can refer to the general expense of keeping the shop open.

examples.en: Mia will oversee the class garden this summer.
examples.zh: Mia 今年夏天會負責管理班級花園。

examples.en: A nurse oversees the daily schedule at the clinic.
examples.zh: 一位護理師負責監督診所的每日行程。

examples.en: We asked the coach to oversee the practice.
examples.zh: 我們請教練來指導這次練習。

entries.definition: （動）監督、管理；查看工作進行並確保妥善完成。

explains.en: This verb means to watch work and make sure it is done properly. The person in charge may guide others and check progress. It does not necessarily mean doing every task personally.
A teacher helps students during a science activity. The teacher checks that each group follows the steps and handles materials carefully. That role involves supervising the work.
A manager may coordinate several workers on a building project. Regular checks help the project stay organized. The verb describes directing and monitoring the activity.

examples.en: The blue car overtook the truck on the highway.
examples.zh: 藍色轎車在公路上超越了卡車。

examples.en: A runner overtook me near the finish line.
examples.zh: 一位跑者在接近終點線時超過了我。

examples.en: Doubt overtook him before the speech.
examples.zh: 演講前，疑慮突然湧上他的心頭。

entries.definition: 超車；趕上並超過；突然影響。

explains.en: This verb means to catch up with and pass someone or something moving ahead. It is often used for vehicles on a road. The action changes who is in front.
A cyclist pedals faster and moves past another rider on a wide path. The rider who was behind becomes the one ahead. The verb describes passing during movement.
The word can also mean that an event or feeling suddenly affects someone. Sleepiness may become stronger during a long trip. In that use, something takes control or comes upon a person.

examples.en: The strong wind overturned the empty cart.
examples.zh: 強風吹翻了空推車。

examples.en: A large wave overturned the small boat.
examples.zh: 一個大浪把小船掀翻了。

examples.en: The appeal court overturned the earlier decision.
examples.zh: 上訴法院推翻了先前的裁決。

entries.definition: （動）推翻決定；打翻；翻覆；（名）顛覆

explains.en: This verb means to turn something upside down or onto its side. A strong wind may tip over a light chair. The word can also describe a court or authority canceling an earlier decision.
A toy boat flips in a rough wave and ends up bottom-side up. Water has turned it from its usual position. The physical sense involves a complete change of orientation.
A judge reviews an earlier ruling and decides it should no longer stand. The previous decision is formally reversed. This figurative use changes an established result.

examples.en: The loud crowd overwhelmed the young singer.
examples.zh: 喧鬧的人群讓年輕歌手不知所措。

examples.en: A pile of homework can overwhelm a student.
examples.zh: 一大堆作業可能讓學生應付不來。

examples.en: The sudden kindness overwhelmed her with joy.
examples.zh: 突如其來的善意讓她感動不已。

explains.en: This verb means to affect someone so strongly that handling the situation becomes difficult. A person may face too many tasks, feelings, or sights at once. The experience can seem greater than their ability to manage it.
A child enters a noisy room full of strangers and bright lights. The sounds and activity feel like too much. The child may need a quiet break.
The verb can also mean defeating or covering something with a much greater force or amount. Heavy rain may flood a small stream. In each use, one thing is far stronger than another.

examples.en: The two streets run parallel to the river.
examples.zh: 這兩條街道與河流平行。

examples.en: Her story has a parallel in an old folk tale.
examples.zh: 她的故事與一則古老民間故事有相似之處。

examples.en: The class drew parallel lines with a ruler.
examples.zh: 全班用尺畫出平行線。

entries.definition: （形）平行的、類似的；（名）相似之處；（動）與……相似。

explains.en: As an adjective, this describes lines or paths that stay the same distance apart and do not meet. The word can also describe things that are similar or happen in a matching way. As a noun, it may name a close comparison.
Two railway tracks run beside each other across a flat field. They keep apart as they continue forward. Their paths have this geometric relationship.
A school and a library may run similar reading programs at the same time. Their activities are alike in structure. The word can describe that close correspondence.

examples.en: Every participant received a number before the race.
examples.zh: 每位參賽者在比賽前都拿到一個號碼。

examples.en: She was an active participant in the class discussion.
examples.zh: 她積極參與了班級討論。

examples.en: Each participant planted a tree near the school.
examples.zh: 每位參與者都在學校附近種了一棵樹。

explains.en: This is a person who takes part in an activity or event. The person is involved rather than only watching. A group activity can have many people in this role.
Children join a neighborhood race and run along the marked course. Each child is actively involved in the event. The noun names one of those people.
A research study may invite volunteers to answer questions or complete tasks. They help the study take place by being involved. The word can be used in sports, learning, or research.

examples.en: A tiny particle of dust floated through the sunlight.
examples.zh: 一小粒灰塵在陽光中飄浮。

examples.en: The filter caught each particle from the water.
examples.zh: 濾網攔下了水中的每個微粒。

examples.en: Scientists studied a particle smaller than a grain of sand.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了一個比沙粒還小的微粒。

explains.en: This is a very small piece of matter. Dust in a sunbeam contains tiny pieces that float through the air. Scientists use the noun when talking about matter at very small scales.
A grain of sand is made of much smaller pieces. Some are too tiny to see without special tools. The word can name one such bit.
In grammar, this noun can describe a short word used with a verb or another expression. In science, it concerns matter. Context shows which field is being discussed.

examples.en: The path was partly covered with fallen leaves.
examples.zh: 小徑有一部分被落葉覆蓋。

examples.en: Our delay was partly caused by the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 我們的延誤部分是大雨造成的。

examples.en: The jar was only partly full.
examples.zh: 罐子只裝了部分內容。

explains.en: This adverb means to some degree or in part, but not completely. A cause may explain only one portion of a result. The word often helps describe a limited amount.
A sky has clouds over one side and blue patches over the other. It is not completely cloudy or clear. This adverb can describe that mixed condition.
A person may finish a task but still need help with the rest. The work is done to a certain extent. The word signals that something is incomplete or has more than one cause.

examples.en: He is passionate about protecting wild birds.
examples.zh: 他熱衷於保護野生鳥類。

examples.en: The passionate fans cheered for their team.
examples.zh: 熱情的球迷為自己的隊伍加油。

examples.en: She gave a passionate speech about clean rivers.
examples.zh: 她發表了一場熱情洋溢的演說，談論河川清潔。

entries.definition: （形）熱情的、熱愛的；對某事投入強烈感情的。

explains.en: This describes someone who feels very strong interest or emotion about something. The feeling can lead the person to spend time and energy on it. The adjective may also describe an intense expression of feeling.
A young musician practices every day because music matters deeply to her. She talks about songs with excitement. Her strong interest shapes what she chooses to do.
A speaker may give an intense argument in support of a cause. Their voice and words show powerful feeling. The adjective describes the force of that emotion.

examples.en: Tourists buy boxes of sweet and tangy pineapple pastries as holiday souvenirs.
examples.zh: 各國觀光客紛紛在台北名店大排長龍採購微酸甜的土鳳梨酥作為回國伴手禮。

examples.en: French bakeries are famous for crafting delicate, flaky pastries like croissants.
examples.zh: 法式烘焙坊以製作精緻細膩、層次分明且鬆酥的可頌等法式酥皮糕點聞名。

examples.en: Grandmother baked savory moon pastries filled with salted egg yolk and lotus seed paste.
examples.zh: 祖母親手烘烤了包覆金黃鹹蛋黃與綿密蓮蓉餡料的傳統鹹甜中秋月餅。

entries.definition: 糕餅點心；酥皮油酥糕點

explains.en: This noun names baked food made with dough that may be light, crisp, or flaky. It can refer to the dough itself or a sweet item made from it. Pies, tarts, and filled rolls are examples.
A baker folds thin layers of dough with butter before putting them in an oven. The layers become crisp and delicate. The prepared food belongs to this broad group.
Some kinds contain fruit, cream, or savory fillings. Others are plain and used as a base for another dish. The exact shape and taste depend on the recipe.

examples.en: Always install official system security patches promptly on your phone.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機接收到官方系統安全補丁更新通知時，請務必即刻安裝。

examples.en: The development team released an emergency patch to fix the memory leak.
examples.zh: 開發團隊發布了緊急修補程式以修復記憶體洩漏問題。

examples.en: Network engineers patched all company servers over the weekend.
examples.zh: 網路工程師利用週末期間修補了公司所有的伺服器。

entries.definition: 安全補丁；更新修補程式；修補

explains.en: This noun can mean a small piece of material used to cover a hole or damaged area. It can also name a small area of ground with one kind of plant. As a verb, it means to repair or cover.
A gardener grows herbs in a small section of soil beside the house. The area is easy to distinguish from the lawn. The noun can describe that planted section.
Software makers use this verb for a small repair to a program. The noun can describe that added fix. In each use, a damaged or faulty part is covered or corrected.

examples.en: The semiconductor engineer filed a patent application for microchip packaging.
examples.zh: 半導體工程師針對創新的晶片封裝製程技術提出了專利申請。

examples.en: Holding key patents on lithium battery chemistry gives the startup a massive competitive edge.
examples.zh: 握有鋰電池化學配方的關鍵專利技術，使這家新創團隊在市場上擁有龐大且難以撼動的競爭優勢。

examples.en: The invention must be novel, useful, and non-obvious to be granted an official patent.
examples.zh: 一項發明必須具備新穎性、產業利用性以及進步性（非顯而易見性），方能順利獲頒正式發明專利。

examples.en: Securing global patent protection protects billions of dollars invested in revolutionary cancer research.
examples.zh: 取得關鍵化合物全球「智慧財產權專利」（Patent），保護了投入在革命性抗癌研發上的數十億美元心血。

examples.en: The inventor applied for a utility patent to prevent rival manufacturers from copying her folding scooter design.
examples.zh: 該發明家為其新型折疊滑板車機構設計申請了新型實用發明專利，全面防止同業競爭對手惡意仿冒抄襲。

examples.en: When the drug’s primary patent expired, cheaper generic versions flooded the national pharmaceutical market.
examples.zh: 當該款專利藥的原廠核心專利期滿失效後，價格實惠親民的學名藥迅速進入各大醫療院所與健保體系。

entries.definition: 專利；取得專利；專利的；創新藥物分子結構二十年智慧財產權專利

explains.en: This noun is an official right that lets an inventor control the use or sale of a new invention for a limited time. It is granted through a legal process. The same adjective can describe something obvious, as in “a clear mistake.”
An inventor creates a new kind of folding tool and applies for legal protection. If granted, the protection limits how others may use the invention. The right is tied to the specific creation.
As an adjective, the word may mean plainly clear or easy to recognize. A very obvious error does not require much explanation. Context separates this everyday sense from the legal noun.

examples.en: The lost kitten looked pathetic in the cold rain.
examples.zh: 迷路的小貓在冷雨中看起來十分可憐。

examples.en: They made a pathetic attempt to hide the broken vase.
examples.zh: 他們試圖藏起破花瓶的樣子實在很拙劣。

examples.en: The team felt embarrassed by its pathetic score.
examples.zh: 隊伍對自己糟糕的得分感到難為情。

entries.definition: 可憐的；令人同情的；差勁的。

explains.en: This adjective can describe something that causes pity or sadness because it is very weak or unsuccessful. It can also be used to criticize something as very poor. The tone may sound unkind, so context matters.
A tiny abandoned puppy waits outside in the cold rain. Its situation makes people feel sorry for it. The adjective describes the pitiful scene.
A reviewer may call a team’s effort extremely poor after careless mistakes. That use expresses strong criticism. The word is less gentle in this sense.

examples.en: Coast Guard cutters patrol national maritime borders 24/7 to deter illegal poaching and smuggling.
examples.zh: 海洋委員會海巡署千噸級巡防艦全天候巡弋守護國家領海經濟海域，嚴格取締越界捕魚與海上走私。

examples.en: Marine wildlife protection units patrol fragile turtle nesting beaches every single night during summer.
examples.zh: 海洋野生動物保護保育巡守員每逢盛夏產卵季，整夜寸步不離守護著小海龜孵化的脆弱沙灘。

examples.en: Aerial drones assist the maritime police patrol in tracking suspicious vessels maneuvering without identification flags.
examples.zh: 遠程空中監控無人機高空巡弋，強大協同海巡巡防艇精準追緝在海面關閉船舶自動辨識系統的幽靈可疑私梟。

examples.en: Coast Guard cutters patrol Taiwan's Exclusive Economic Zone 24/7 to safeguard local fishing rights.
examples.zh: 海洋委員會海巡署巡防艦全天候三班巡弋專屬經濟海域，堅定捍衛台灣漁民海上作業權益。

examples.en: Police patrol cars cruised through the residential neighborhood to deter late-night burglaries.
examples.zh: 警用巡邏車在住宅社區周邊穿梭巡視，以嚇阻深夜可能發生的竊盜犯罪。

examples.en: Park rangers conduct regular walking patrols along slippery hiking trails after torrential afternoon downpours.
examples.zh: 午後暴雨過後，國家公園巡山員沿著濕滑的登山步道展開例行徒步巡邏。

entries.definition: 海巡署海事巡邏巡弋；巡邏；海巡署千噸級巡防艦巡弋執法

explains.en: This can be a verb meaning to move through an area and watch for danger or trouble. It can also name the people or group who do this work. A regular route helps them check that place.
A park worker walks along paths after sunset and looks for problems. The worker checks gates and notices anything unusual. The activity helps keep the area watched.
A group of volunteers may take turns watching a neighborhood. As a noun, the word can name that group or its round. It is used for organized watching in many settings.

examples.en: Generous arts patrons donated millions of dollars to fund new wings and educational youth programs.
examples.zh: 熱心推廣美育的藝術贊助人慷慨解囊捐贈數千萬元，全力支持美術館興建全新典藏庫房與青年工作坊。

examples.en: The Renaissance flourished because wealthy merchant patrons like the Medici financed brilliant sculptors and painters.
examples.zh: 歐洲文藝復興之所以迎來空前燦爛，關鍵在於梅第奇等富可敵國的商人家族長年巨資贊助頂尖雕塑家與畫家。

examples.en: As a lifelong patron of the city orchestra, she purchased front-row season subscriptions every single year.
examples.zh: 作為市立交響樂團三十年來最忠實的藝文贊助人，她每年初必定雷打不動預訂全季最前排尊爵套票。

entries.definition: 藝術贊助人；美術館常客主顧

explains.en: This is a person who supports or regularly uses a business or organization. A café customer can be called this, and an arts supporter may also fit the word. The person gives help through visits or support.
A family visits the same small bookstore each month. They buy books and attend readings there. Their regular support makes them valued customers.
The noun can also mean a person who gives money or protection to artists or a cause. This older sense appears in history and the arts. The context shows the kind of support involved.

examples.en: The story follows a peasant who works in the fields.
