explains.en: This adjective relates to an operation performed by a doctor. A hospital may have a special room for such work. The term describes medical treatment.
The word can describe tools or clothing used in an operating room. A mask and gloves help protect the patient. The adjective concerns operations.
A doctor may recommend a procedure that uses instruments to treat a body part. The term relates to that type of care. It is commonly used in medicine.

examples.en: Please write your surname on the form.
examples.zh: 請在表格上寫下你的姓氏。

examples.en: Her surname is the same as her brother's.
examples.zh: 她的姓氏和哥哥相同。

examples.en: The teacher called him by his surname.
examples.zh: 老師用他的姓氏稱呼他。

explains.en: This noun means a family name passed from parents to children. It usually comes after a person's given name. Forms of address may use it.
A school list may arrange students by this name. People in one family often share it. The word helps identify family connections.
A person may change this name after marriage or for other reasons. The word refers to the inherited family name, not the first name. It is usually shared by close relatives.

examples.en: The young runner surpassed the school record.
examples.zh: 這位年輕跑者超越了校紀錄。

examples.en: Her latest score surpassed her earlier one.
examples.zh: 她最近的分數超過了之前的成績。

examples.en: The team surpassed everyone's expectations.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍超越了所有人的期待。

entries.definition: （動）超越、勝過；在程度或表現上超過。

explains.en: This verb means to do better than someone or something else. A runner may finish faster than a rival. The result is stronger.
A student can achieve a higher score than before. The new result is better. The verb describes going beyond a former level.
A person may do more than others expected. The action goes beyond a limit or standard. Context shows a comparison or achievement.

examples.en: Alfred Hitchcock is universally revered as the master of building spine-chilling suspense.
examples.zh: 驚悚大師希區考克被全球影壇公認為掌控心理節奏、營造令人屏息窒息懸疑張力的至高大師。

examples.en: The ticking clock in the soundtrack raised the suspense until the detective solved the bomb puzzle.
examples.zh: 背景配樂中不斷倒數計時的滴答聲將全場懸疑張力拉升到最高點，直到警探在最後一秒拆除炸彈。

examples.en: Don't keep us in suspense—tell us right now who won the election!
examples.zh: 別再吊我們的胃口賣關子了——趕快直接告訴我們究竟是誰贏得了這場激烈的選舉！

explains.en: This noun means a feeling of excitement or worry about what may happen next. A mystery story can keep readers guessing. They want to know the ending.
A game may become tense when the score is close. The audience waits to see who will win. The word describes this uncertain feeling.
A writer can build this feeling by hiding information. Readers form questions and look for clues. It often appears in stories and films.

examples.en: Adaptive air suspension automatically absorbs road bumps on uneven mountain passes.
examples.zh: 主動式主動氣壓懸吊系統能在崎嶇不平的山道上自動撫平顛簸、提供極致舒適。

examples.en: A stiff sport suspension keeps the vehicle body completely flat during aggressive turns.
examples.zh: 阻尼偏硬的運動化懸吊調校能讓車身在激烈急轉彎時保持極佳的抗側傾支撐性。

examples.en: The athlete received a two-game disciplinary suspension after arguing with the umpire.
examples.zh: 該名運動員在比賽中與主審裁判發生激烈口角衝突後，遭到了禁賽兩場的紀律處分。

examples.en: Smart adaptive air suspension automatically lowers highway ride height to reduce aerodynamic drag.
examples.zh: 智慧主動式氣壓懸吊系統在高速行駛時會自動降低車身高度，以大幅降低風阻並提升貼地穩定性。

examples.en: The double-wishbone front suspension irons out potholes and speed bumps on rough city streets.
examples.zh: 前懸吊採用的前雙 A 臂獨立避震結構，能完美熨平市區坑窪不平的路面碎震與減速墊起伏衝擊。

examples.en: The professional baseball player received a ten-game suspension for violating league rules.
examples.zh: 這位職棒明星球員因嚴重違反聯盟紀律防賭規章，遭到職棒聯盟官方處以十場例行賽禁賽停權處分。

examples.en: Active secondary air suspension adjusts car body tilt electronically during high-speed curve transitions.
examples.zh: 主動式「電子氣壓懸吊系統」（Air Suspension），在高速過彎時自動微調車廂傾角以維持乘坐穩定度。

examples.en: The luxury sports sedan boasts an adaptive magnetic suspension system that smooths out rough potholes.
examples.zh: 這款豪華旗艦運動轎跑配備主動式電磁避震懸吊系統，能行雲流水般撫平路面坑洞的不適震動。

examples.en: The university disciplinary committee announced the temporary academic suspension of the cheating student.
examples.zh: 大學校園學生獎懲審議委員會正式公告，對涉及重大考試舞弊情事的該名學生處以停學處分。

entries.definition: 懸吊系統；中止停職；主動式氣壓懸吊避震系統；暫停；主動式電子氣壓彈簧次懸吊智慧避震系統；懸吊

explains.en: This noun can mean temporarily stopping an activity. A school may pause classes because of snow. The pause may end later.
It can also mean the act of hanging something from above. A bridge may be supported by cables. The word has different meanings by context.
In law, it may mean that a license or right is temporarily stopped. A person may not use it for a set time. The noun names a pause or hanging support.

examples.en: The trail crossed a swamp filled with tall reeds.
examples.zh: 小徑穿過一片長滿高蘆葦的沼澤。

examples.en: Their boots sank into the swamp.
examples.zh: 他們的靴子陷進了沼澤。

examples.en: The paperwork swamped the small office.
examples.zh: 文書工作淹沒了小辦公室。

entries.definition: 沼澤；濕地；使忙不過來；淹沒。

explains.en: As a noun, this is wet land with soft ground and many plants. Frogs and birds may live there. The water may be shallow.
As a verb, it means to cover or trap something in wet ground. A car may get stuck in deep mud. The word can also mean to make progress slow.
A figurative problem can trap a person in difficulty. Too many forms may slow a project. Context indicates wet land or a difficult situation.

examples.en: A swarm of bees gathered near the hive.
examples.zh: 一大群蜜蜂聚集在蜂巢附近。

examples.en: Fans swarmed into the stadium.
examples.zh: 粉絲們蜂擁進入體育場。

examples.en: A swarm of tiny fish moved through the water.
examples.zh: 一大群小魚在水中游動。

entries.definition: （名）一大群；蜂群；（動）蜂擁而至；成群移動

explains.en: As a noun, this is a large group of insects moving together. Bees may travel as a group to find a new home. The movement can be dense.
As a verb, it means to gather or move in a large group. People may gather around a performer. The word describes many moving together.
The word can also describe a large number of people or things. A crowd may enter a stadium at once. Context shows insects or a large group.

examples.en: The dove symbolizes peace in the painting.
examples.zh: 這幅畫中的鴿子象徵和平。

examples.en: A red rose can symbolize love.
examples.zh: 紅玫瑰可以象徵愛情。

examples.en: The empty chair symbolizes a missing friend.
examples.zh: 空椅子象徵著一位缺席的朋友。

explains.en: This verb means to use something as a sign or picture for an idea. A dove may stand for peace. The symbol has a meaning beyond itself.
An author may use a storm to show anger or trouble. The image suggests an idea. The verb describes this symbolic connection.
A color may stand for a holiday or group. People learn the meaning from culture. The word means to represent something.

examples.en: Architectural photographers seek perfect geometric symmetry inside historical stations.
examples.zh: 建築攝影師在百年歷史古蹟車站與現代美術館內部尋求極致完美的幾何對稱美感。

examples.en: Reflections in still alpine lakes create breathtaking horizontal symmetry.
examples.zh: 平靜無波的高山湖面倒映著巍峨雪山，營造出令人屏息讚嘆的水準鏡像對稱之美。

examples.en: The grand palace hallway was designed with immaculate, majestic architectural symmetry.
examples.zh: 這座宏偉皇宮的中央長廊在設計上展現出嚴謹無瑕的軸線對稱美學，莊嚴而大器。

explains.en: This noun means a balanced arrangement of parts around a center or line. A butterfly's wings look alike on both sides. The pattern seems even.
A building may have matching windows on either side of a door. The arrangement is pleasing and balanced. The word describes this order.
The term can also refer to balance in shape or size. A design may have equal parts. It is common in art, math, and nature.

examples.en: I deeply sympathize with your difficult situation.
examples.zh: 我對你當前所面臨的困境深表同情與體諒。

examples.en: Classmates sympathized with him when he fractured his wrist before the playoffs.
examples.zh: 當他在季後賽前夕不幸骨折手腕時，全班同學都對他深表惋惜與同情。

examples.en: We can easily sympathize with working parents juggling demanding jobs and childcare.
examples.zh: 我們完全能夠理解並體諒在職父母同時兼顧高壓工作與育兒的辛勞。

explains.en: This verb means to understand and share another person's feelings, especially sadness or trouble. A friend may listen when someone is upset. The response shows care.
A person may express kindness after hearing bad news. They may say they are sorry. The word describes feeling concern for someone.
It can also mean agreeing with a person's view or situation. Context shows emotional understanding or support. A thoughtful response can comfort someone.

examples.en: Life is a grand acoustic symphony where every unique voice contributes to the rich harmony of human experience.
examples.zh: 人生宛如一部波瀾壯闊的聲學交響樂章，每一道獨特而真誠的聲音都在為人類經驗增添和諧樂章。

examples.en: The national symphony orchestra received a standing ovation for their passionate performance of Tchaikovsky.
examples.zh: 國家交響樂團對柴可夫斯基經典巨作淋漓盡致的深情詮釋，贏得了全場觀眾起立致敬與久久不歇的如雷掌聲。

examples.en: In spring, the chirping crickets, croaking tree frogs, and murmuring stream perform a delightful nature symphony.
examples.zh: 漫步在春夜山林裡，草叢中呢喃的鳴蟲、清脆樹蛙與潺潺流水聲，宛如大自然即興合奏的一曲天籟交響樂。

examples.en: When the brass section thundered in the climax of the symphony, the entire wooden hall resonated like a cello.
examples.zh: 當銅管樂部在「交響曲高潮」（Symphony）中齊聲咆哮時，整座木質音樂廳如同一把巨大的大提琴般共鳴震撼。

examples.en: Beethoven composed his triumphant Ninth Symphony despite suffering from severe hearing impairment.
examples.zh: 偉大音樂家貝多芬在飽受全聾聽力障礙折磨的晚年，依然創作出震撼萬古、歌頌歡樂與大愛的第九號交響曲。

examples.en: The sunrise over the misty tea plantation felt like a harmonious visual symphony of light and shadow.
examples.zh: 晨曦朝陽從雲霧繚繞的高山茶園稜線上緩緩升起，宛如一場光影與色彩在大地上交織譜寫出的視覺交響詩。

entries.definition: 聲學與靈魂交織之和諧交響樂章；百人大型管弦樂團馬勒交響曲之震撼磅礡演奏；交響樂

explains.en: This noun names a long musical work for a large group of instruments. An orchestra may perform it in several sections. Each instrument has a part.
A concert program may list a work with several movements. The music can be dramatic or quiet. The word refers to the composition.
The piece is often played by strings, woodwinds, brass, and percussion. A conductor leads the musicians. The noun names the full work.

examples.en: “Quick” is a synonym for “fast.”
examples.zh: 「quick」是「fast」的同義詞。

examples.en: The thesaurus suggested a synonym for “happy.”
examples.zh: 同義詞詞典為「happy」提供了一個近義詞。

examples.en: She used a synonym to avoid repeating the word.
examples.zh: 她用一個同義詞避免重複那個詞。

entries.definition: （名）同義詞；意思相同或相近的字詞。

explains.en: This noun means a word that has the same or nearly the same meaning as another word. “Big” and “large” are examples. Writers can choose between them.
A dictionary may list similar words under an entry. Their meanings may not match perfectly in every sentence. The term describes a close match in meaning.
A student can use one of these words to avoid repeating the same term. The best choice depends on context. The noun names a word with a similar meaning.

examples.en: Modern athletic wear blends elastic spandex with lightweight synthetic polyester.
examples.zh: 現代高機能運動服飾巧妙將高彈力彈性纖維與輕量快乾人造合成聚酯纖維黃金混紡。

examples.en: Some synthetic fabrics can trap body heat and perspiration during humid weather.
examples.zh: 某些人造合成面料在悶熱潮濕的天氣下容易悶住身體熱氣與汗水。

examples.en: Technological breakthroughs in synthetic textiles have created remarkable water-repellent shells.
examples.zh: 合成纖維紡織技術的重大突破，研發出了防風防潑水性能卓越的戶外硬殼機能面料。

examples.en: Synthetic biology engineers engineered yeast strains to manufacture vanilla flavoring sustainably without crops.
examples.zh: 合成生物學（Synthetic Biology）透過基因重組酵母菌株，能在發酵槽中環保合成純天然香草精香氣。

examples.en: The bio-foundry utilizes synthetic DNA fragments to construct entirely novel metabolic pathways inside bacteria.
examples.zh: 全自動化生物晶圓廠運用人工化學合成的 DNA 基因片段，在益生菌體內無中生有搭建出嶄新的代謝合成途徑。

examples.en: Synthetic textiles often shed microplastic fibers when laundered in domestic washing machines.
examples.zh: 人造合成化學纖維衣物在一般家用洗衣機洗滌時，極易脫落大量微細塑料纖維進入下水道並污染水體。

examples.en: Synthetic biology applies engineering logic to design new biological pathways and living circuits.
examples.zh: 「合成生物學」（Synthetic Biology），將工程思維導入生命科學，設計出自然界前所未有的人造生物路徑。

examples.en: Outdoor sports jackets often feature synthetic insulation that retains warmth even when damp.
examples.zh: 戶外運動風衣外套多採用人造合成保暖纖維，即便受潮潮濕依然能維持優異的蓄熱保暖性。

examples.en: Pharmaceutical chemists synthesized a powerful synthetic analog of natural taxol to fight tumors.
examples.zh: 藥物化學家人工合成了天然紫杉醇的高效合成類似物，用以對抗頑固惡性腫瘤。

entries.definition: 合成的人造纖維；綜合的；合成生物學的；人工合成的；設計與編程人工生命程式碼之合成生物學的；合成的

explains.en: This adjective describes something made by people rather than formed naturally. A plastic cup is made in a factory. The material is not grown from a plant.
A fabric may be made from chemical fibers. It can feel like cotton or silk. The word describes human-made materials.
The term can also describe an artificial voice or sound. A computer may create it. Context shows a material or something not natural.

examples.en: The sweet cough syrup helped soothe my persistent night coughing.
examples.zh: 甜甜的止咳糖漿有助於舒緩我夜間持續的咳嗽。

examples.en: Pour warm maple syrup generously over your fluffy morning pancakes.
examples.zh: 在早晨蓬鬆的煎餅上淋上濃郁的熱楓糖漿。

examples.en: Fruit-flavored shaved ice is drizzled with sweet condensed milk and sugar syrup.
examples.zh: 水果雪花冰上淋滿了香甜煉乳與糖水糖漿。

explains.en: This noun means a thick, sweet liquid used to flavor food or drinks. A thick, sweet liquid from maple trees is poured over pancakes. It can come from plants.
A cook may stir it into tea or use it in a dessert. The liquid is sweeter and thicker than water. The word names the ingredient.
Some medicine has a sweet liquid form. The word can describe this type of mixture too. Context shows a food ingredient or medicine.

examples.en: He wore a tan jacket to the game.
examples.zh: 他穿著一件棕褐色外套去看比賽。

examples.en: Her skin tanned after the summer trip.
examples.zh: 夏日旅行後，她的皮膚曬成了棕褐色。

examples.en: The wall was painted a warm tan.
examples.zh: 牆壁漆成溫暖的淺棕色。

entries.definition: 曬黑；鞣製；棕褐色；日曬後的膚色。

explains.en: As an adjective, this describes a light brown color of skin or a surface. A person may get this color after spending time in the sun. The shade varies.
As a verb, it means to turn brown in the sun or color something brown. A baker may toast bread until it changes color. The word has several parts of speech.
As a noun, it can name a yellowish-brown color. A coat may be this shade. Context shows color, change, or the color itself.

examples.en: The tedious wait felt longer than an hour.
examples.zh: 令人厭煩的等待感覺比一小時還久。

examples.en: Filling out the forms was tedious.
examples.zh: 填寫這些表格很繁瑣。

examples.en: He found the long lecture tedious.
examples.zh: 他覺得那場長時間的講座很乏味。

entries.definition: （形）冗長乏味的；令人厭煩的；單調的

explains.en: This adjective describes something that feels too long and boring. A meeting may repeat the same points. People may lose interest.
A task with many slow steps can seem tiring. The work may take longer than expected. The word describes a lack of interest due to length.
A book or lecture may be hard to finish because it seems dull. The adjective means boring and drawn out. The activity seems to take too long.

examples.en: Telecommunications connect people across long distances.
examples.zh: 電信通訊讓遠距離的人們得以聯繫。

examples.en: She works in telecommunications.
examples.zh: 她在電信業工作。

examples.en: The storm damaged local telecommunications equipment.
examples.zh: 暴風雨損壞了當地的電信設備。

explains.en: This noun means communication over long distances using phones, radio, or computer networks. People can talk without being in the same place. The field uses many technologies.
A company may send voice, text, or video messages through a network. The systems connect people far apart. The word describes this kind of communication.
The field includes devices and services that carry messages. A phone call is one example. The noun often refers to an industry or technology area.

examples.en: The teller counted the cash carefully.
examples.zh: 出納員仔細清點現金。

examples.en: A bank teller helped her deposit the check.
examples.zh: 銀行櫃員協助她存入支票。

examples.en: The tale's narrator was an unreliable teller.
examples.zh: 這個故事的敘述者並不可靠。

entries.definition: （名）銀行櫃員；講述者；依語境指處理現金或說故事的人。

explains.en: This noun names a person who receives money and gives it to someone else, often at a bank or store. A customer may cash a check. The worker handles the payment.
It can also mean someone who tells a story. A novel may have a storyteller who speaks directly to readers. This meaning is less common in everyday English.
A machine may be used at a bank to count bills, but a person in this job serves customers. Context indicates a cashier or storyteller. The role depends on the setting.

examples.en: The song's tempo increased near the end.
examples.zh: 歌曲接近尾聲時速度加快。

examples.en: The drummer kept a steady tempo.
examples.zh: 鼓手保持穩定的節奏。

examples.en: The dancers moved to the lively tempo.
examples.zh: 舞者隨著活潑的節奏移動。

explains.en: This noun means the speed or pace of music. A fast song has a quick beat. A slow song has a relaxed pace.
A band may change speed during a piece. The movement can make music feel calm or exciting. The word describes how quickly notes are played.
The term can also mean the speed of an activity. A runner may keep an even pace. Context shows music or general speed.

examples.en: Tenants are required to pay rent by the fifth of every month.
examples.zh: 房客必須在每月五號前繳納房租。

examples.en: Prospective tenants toured the newly renovated loft apartment on Saturday.
examples.zh: 準房客們在週六參觀了這間剛翻修完畢的挑高閣樓公寓。

examples.en: Landlords must give tenants sufficient advance notice before inspecting the property.
examples.zh: 房東在前往視察房屋前必須給予房客充分的提前通知。

examples.en: Reliable tenants pay monthly rent punctually and maintain clean living spaces.
examples.zh: 優質守信的愛乾淨好房客每個月皆會準時匯交租金，並悉心維護屋況整潔。

examples.en: The property manager screened prospective tenants thoroughly before offering a lease.
examples.zh: 物業管理專員在正式簽訂租約前，會嚴謹審核每位潛在租客的信用背景與在職證明。

examples.en: Both landlords and tenants have legal rights clearly protected under housing tenancy laws.
examples.zh: 房東與房客雙方合法的租賃權益，在租賃專法中皆享有明確周全的法律保障。

explains.en: This noun means a person who pays to live in a house, apartment, or room owned by someone else. The person agrees to follow the rental terms. The owner may be called a landlord.
A family may rent an apartment for a year. The people living there are renters. The word describes their relationship to the owner.
A business can also rent a store or office. The company pays to use the space. The term may refer to one person or a business.

examples.en: They made a tentative plan for Saturday.
examples.zh: 他們初步安排了星期六的計畫。

examples.en: She gave a tentative answer to the question.
examples.zh: 她對這個問題給出不確定的回答。

examples.en: The agreement remained tentative until both sides signed.
examples.zh: 雙方簽字前，協議仍屬暫定。

entries.definition: （形）暫定的；試探性的；尚未確定的

explains.en: This adjective describes something that is not certain or final. A plan may change after people talk. The details remain open.
A person may make a careful guess without full confidence. They do not claim to know for sure. The word shows doubt.
A temporary offer may be made until more information is available. The decision can be changed. Context shows an uncertain idea or an early plan.

examples.en: We ate dinner on the terrace.
examples.zh: 我們在露台上吃晚餐。

examples.en: The hotel terrace overlooks the harbor.
examples.zh: 飯店露台可以俯瞰港口。

examples.en: A sunny terrace stood behind the house.
examples.zh: 房子後方有一處陽光充足的露台。

entries.definition: （名）露臺；梯田；排屋；（動）使成梯田狀

explains.en: This noun can mean a flat outdoor area beside a house or above a building. People may sit there in warm weather. It is often paved.
A restaurant may place tables on a raised platform. Guests can eat outside. The word names that open area.
It can also mean a row of houses built along a slope or level surface. The homes share a similar design. Context shows an outdoor area or a building style.

examples.en: Taiwan is a global innovation leader in producing high-tech eco textiles.
examples.zh: 台灣在研發製造高端機能性環保紡織面料與涼感吸濕排汗布料領域居全球領導地位。

examples.en: The museum displayed exquisite antique textiles from the eighteenth century.
examples.zh: 該博物館展出了來自十八世紀的精緻古董紡織品面料。

examples.en: Advancements in textile engineering have created fabrics that actively repel stains.
examples.zh: 紡織工程技術的進步研發出了能夠主動防潑水且抗污漬的新型布料。

explains.en: This noun means cloth or material made by weaving or knitting fibers. Cotton and wool are common kinds. The material can be made into clothes.
A factory may produce material for curtains, shirts, or bags. Different fibers create different textures. The word refers to the material itself.
The term can also describe the industry that makes cloth. Workers turn yarn into usable material. Context shows the fabric or business.

examples.en: She moved to Taipei and thereafter worked at a school.
examples.zh: 她搬到台北，之後在一所學校工作。

examples.en: Thereafter, the group met every Friday.
examples.zh: 此後，這個團體每週五聚會。

examples.en: He completed the course and thereafter began a new job.
examples.zh: 他完成課程後，接著開始新工作。

entries.definition: （副）此後、從那時起；某件事發生之後的時間。

explains.en: This adverb means after that time or event. A story may describe a meeting and what happened later. The word links events in order.
A person may finish a meal and then go home. The next event happens afterward. The word is often used in formal writing.
The term points to a time following a stated moment. It helps readers understand sequence. It is similar to later or after that.

examples.en: Use a digital ear thermometer to check the baby's fever.
examples.zh: 使用電子耳溫槍來測量小寶寶是否發燒。

examples.en: The wall thermometer indicated that the outdoor temperature was thirty degrees.
examples.zh: 壁掛式溫度計顯示室外溫度為攝氏三十度。

examples.en: Clean the thermometer probe with alcohol before and after each use.
examples.zh: 每次使用前後請用酒精棉片擦拭消毒溫度計探頭。

explains.en: This noun names a tool that measures how hot or cold something is. A doctor may use one to check body temperature. A weather station has another kind.
The device may contain a scale or a digital screen. A person reads the number to learn the temperature. The word names the measuring instrument.
A cook can use a kitchen device to check whether food is hot enough. The term applies to several kinds of temperature tools. Different designs can be digital or glass.

examples.en: The picture tilted to the left.
examples.zh: 照片向左傾斜。

examples.en: She tilted the glass to pour the water.
examples.zh: 她傾斜玻璃杯倒水。

examples.en: His answer showed a slight tilt toward caution.
examples.zh: 他的回答顯示他稍微傾向謹慎。

explains.en: As a verb, this means to lean or turn to one side. A picture may hang at an angle. The movement is not level.
As a noun, it can mean a sloping position or a preference. A person may have a slight preference for one option. Context shows angle or tendency.
A person can move a container so liquid pours out. The action changes its position. The word describes the movement or the angled state.

examples.en: She tiptoed past the sleeping dog.
examples.zh: 她躡手躡腳地走過熟睡的狗。

examples.en: The child walked on tiptoe to reach the shelf.
examples.zh: 孩子踮著腳尖走到架子旁。

examples.en: He tiptoed into the room after midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜過後，他躡手躡腳地走進房間。

entries.definition: （名）腳尖；踮腳；（動）踮著腳走；（形）踮腳的

explains.en: As a verb, this means to walk very quietly on the front parts of the feet. A child may move softly to avoid waking someone. The steps make little noise.
As a noun, it can mean a careful, quiet walk. A person may use it near a sleeping baby. The movement is light and slow.
The word can also be an adverb describing how someone walks. The person tries not to be heard. It refers to a quiet way of moving.

examples.en: The tiresome lecture lasted for two hours.
examples.zh: 令人厭煩的演講持續了兩小時。

examples.en: We had a tiresome wait at the station.
examples.zh: 我們在車站等得很煩。

examples.en: He found the repeated exercise tiresome.
examples.zh: 他覺得一再重複的練習很乏味。

explains.en: This adjective describes something that feels boring or annoying because it lasts too long or repeats. A long wait may feel unpleasant. People may lose interest.
A task with many repeated steps can seem dull. The work may take more time than expected. The word describes a tiring experience.
A person who talks for a long time about an uninteresting subject can seem this way. The adjective describes the effect on listeners. The experience may make people tired.

examples.en: The advanced language model boasts a 2-million token context window, analyzing entire books in seconds.
examples.zh: 先進大語言模型支援高達兩百萬 Token 的超長上下文視窗，能在數秒內完整精讀並總結整座圖書館的書籍。

examples.en: Riders dropped a blue plastic token into the subway turnstile gate before boarding the train.
examples.zh: 購買單程票的乘客在走進捷運閘門時，依序將藍色感應式塑膠圓形代幣（Token）投入驗票機投幣口。

examples.en: He gave her a silver charm bracelet as a humble token of appreciation for her unwavering friendship.
examples.zh: 他親手贈送了一條純銀幸運手鍊給她，作為由衷感謝她多年來始終如一、風雨同舟真摯友誼的微薄心意信物。

entries.definition: 算力計費與文本分割符元 (Token)；代幣

explains.en: This noun can mean a small object used as a sign or symbol of something. A flower may be a gift of thanks. It represents a feeling.
It can also mean a small coin or disk used in a machine. A person may put one into a game. The object gives access or permission.
The word can describe a small sign of appreciation. A card or gift can show that someone cares. Context shows a symbol, coin, or gesture.

examples.en: A tornado damaged several barns.
examples.zh: 龍捲風損壞了幾座穀倉。

examples.en: The family took shelter during the tornado.
examples.zh: 龍捲風來襲時，這家人躲進避難處。

examples.en: A tornado crossed the open field.
examples.zh: 一場龍捲風越過了空曠田野。

entries.definition: （名）龍捲風；猛烈旋轉並從雲層延伸到地面的風暴。

explains.en: This noun means a very strong, spinning storm that forms over land. It can damage buildings and trees. The storm may move quickly.
Weather scientists watch clouds and winds to identify one. People may take shelter when warnings are issued. The word names a type of storm.
A funnel-shaped cloud can reach the ground. The air spins around its center. The storm may last only a short time.

examples.en: A torrent of rain poured down the street.
examples.zh: 暴雨如洪流般傾瀉在街道上。

examples.en: She faced a torrent of questions after the talk.
examples.zh: 演講後，她面對一連串問題。

examples.en: The hikers crossed a torrent after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨後，登山客涉過急流。

entries.definition: 急流；洪流；連珠炮似的一連串。

explains.en: This noun means a large, fast flow of water. Heavy rain may create one on a hillside. The current can carry branches and dirt.
It can also mean a large amount of words or events arriving quickly. A person may receive many messages. The word suggests a powerful flow.
A river may rise and rush after a storm. The water moves with force. Context shows a real flow or a large amount.

examples.en: Registering your brand name as a trademark prevents unfair imitation.
examples.zh: 將自有品牌名稱正式登記註冊為商標能有效防範不肖同業抄襲模仿。

examples.en: The golden arches are an internationally recognized registered trademark of McDonald's.
examples.zh: 金黃色雙拱門標誌是麥當勞在全球各地廣為人知、享有高度辨識度的知名註冊商標。

examples.en: The beverage company sued a competitor for using a confusingly similar logo trademark.
examples.zh: 這家飲料大廠正式向法院控告同業競爭對手，指控其採用了極易引發消費者混淆的近似商標。

explains.en: This noun means a name, word, or symbol that identifies a product or business. A shoe company may print one on each box. The mark helps buyers recognize the maker.
A business can protect its special name from being copied. The legal mark shows that a product comes from a particular source. The word has a legal use.
The term can also mean a lasting sign of a person's style. A writer may use the same phrase in many books. Context shows legal protection or a recognizable sign.

examples.en: You must submit your official academic transcript when applying for colleges.
examples.zh: 申請大學時必須檢附官方正式成績單。

examples.en: Request a sealed copy of your university transcript from the registrar.
examples.zh: 向教務處註冊組申請一份加蓋密封章的大學成績單正本。

examples.en: The court reporter provided an accurate transcript of the legal trial proceedings.
examples.zh: 法庭書記官提供了法庭訴訟審訊過程的精準速記謄本記錄。

examples.en: Submit your official certified high school transcript along with the application.
examples.zh: 提出申請時，請檢附由學校官方認證蓋章的歷年成績單。

examples.en: The court reporter prepared a verbatim transcript of the trial proceedings.
examples.zh: 法庭書記官迅速整理出了該次庭審訴訟過程的一字不差完整逐字稿。

examples.en: Graduate schools request sealed academic transcripts sent directly from registrars.
examples.zh: 研究所申請通常要求由畢業學校註冊組直接寄出密封認證的歷年成績單。

entries.definition: 成績單；成績證明書；歷年成績單；文字逐字稿

explains.en: This noun means a written or printed copy of spoken words. A court may keep a record of what people said. The document follows their speech.
A school may give a student a list of courses and grades. The paper shows the student's academic history. The term can refer to an official record.
A video may include a written record of dialogue. People can read what was said. Context shows spoken words or school records.

examples.en: The station transmits weather reports every hour.
examples.zh: 電台每小時播送天氣報告。

examples.en: She transmitted the file to her colleague.
examples.zh: 她把檔案傳給同事。

examples.en: Some insects transmit plant diseases.
examples.zh: 有些昆蟲會傳播植物疾病。

explains.en: This verb means to send a signal, message, or program from one place to another. A radio tower sends sound through the air. The receiver gets it.
A person may send a picture from a phone to another device. The information travels through a network. The word describes sending electronically.
The term can also mean passing an illness or quality from one person to another. Context may be technical or biological. The source and receiver may be far apart.

examples.en: The doctor performed a kidney transplant.
examples.zh: 醫師進行了腎臟移植手術。

examples.en: They transplanted the young tree into the yard.
examples.zh: 他們把小樹移植到院子裡。

examples.en: The patient received a heart transplant.
examples.zh: 病人接受了心臟移植。

explains.en: As a verb, this means to move a living organ or plant from one place to another. A doctor may move an organ into a patient. A gardener may move a small tree.
As a noun, it can mean the organ or plant that has been moved. The new location helps it grow or function. The context may be medical or gardening.
A plant may be moved from a pot to a garden bed. The word describes the move or the living thing moved. The new place must suit its needs.

examples.en: US Treasury bonds are globally recognized as the ultimate risk-free benchmark asset.
examples.zh: 美國財政部發行的長天期美國國債被全球金融機構公認為最安全的零風險基準無風險資產。

examples.en: When global stock markets tumble, investors flock to safe-haven US Treasuries.
examples.zh: 每當全球國際金融市場面臨突發動盪黑天鵝事件時，大量避險資金便會迅速湧向美國公債。

examples.en: The government issues short-term Treasury bills to finance routine federal expenditures.
examples.zh: 國家財政部每季定期標售發行短天期國庫券，以充實國庫資金並融通各項經常性公共財政支出。

entries.definition: （名）國庫、財政部；也指金銀財寶的收藏處。

explains.en: This noun can mean a place where government money is kept and managed. A country may store gold there. The building protects valuable funds.
It can also refer to a government department that manages money. Workers plan budgets and payments. The word describes the financial office or its funds.
A school may keep a small fund for activities. The person who manages it may be called a treasurer. Context shows a building, department, or money supply.

examples.en: The trek across the desert took five days.
examples.zh: 穿越沙漠的長途跋涉花了五天。

examples.en: They trekked through the forest to the lake.
examples.zh: 他們穿越森林跋涉到湖邊。

examples.en: The mountain trek challenged every hiker.
examples.zh: 這趟山區長途跋涉考驗了每位登山客。

entries.definition: 長途跋涉；艱苦旅行；（名）長途旅程。

explains.en: This noun means a long, difficult journey, often on foot. A group may cross mountains for several days. The route can be challenging.
The verb means to travel a long distance over rough land. Hikers may carry supplies. The word suggests effort and distance.
A person may take a long trip through a wilderness area. The journey may be adventurous. Context shows the trip or the act of traveling.

examples.en: The fee was a mere trifle to the company.
examples.zh: 這筆費用對公司來說微不足道。

examples.en: She worried about a trifle before the party.
examples.zh: 派對前，她為一件小事煩惱。

examples.en: He trifled with the old watch and broke it.
examples.zh: 他隨意把玩那支老手錶，結果把它弄壞了。

entries.definition: （名）小事；少量；（動）輕視；浪費時間

explains.en: As a noun, this means a small amount or thing that is not important. A person may worry over a tiny stain. The concern is greater than the problem.
It can also mean a matter of little value or importance. A small error in a draft may be easy to fix. The word can sound dismissive.
As a verb, it means to treat something as unimportant. A person may ignore a small detail. Context shows a tiny amount or a minor matter.

examples.en: The company sold a trillion tiny particles in its simulation.
examples.zh: 公司在模擬中賣出了一兆個微小粒子。

examples.en: A trillion has twelve zeros in the short scale.
examples.zh: 在短制計數法中，一兆有十二個零。

examples.en: The report estimated a trillion grains of sand.
examples.zh: 報告估計有一兆粒沙子。

explains.en: This number means one thousand billion in the short scale used in the United States and many other places. It has twelve zeros. The exact scale can vary by country.
Scientists may use this number when counting tiny cells or stars. It represents an extremely large amount. The word can describe a quantity.
A government budget may include a large sum measured in this unit. The number is far beyond one million. Context shows a count or amount.

examples.en: The island lies near the tropic.
examples.zh: 這座島位於熱帶線附近。

examples.en: Many warm forests grow near the tropics.
examples.zh: 許多溫暖的森林生長在熱帶地區附近。

examples.en: The tropic marks a boundary of the tropical zone.
examples.zh: 回歸線標示出熱帶地區的邊界。

entries.definition: （名）回歸線；（形）熱帶的；與地球熱帶地區有關。

explains.en: This noun names either of two lines of latitude north and south of the equator. They mark the edges of the warm tropical zone. The Sun can be nearly overhead there.
The region between the two lines has warm weather for much of the year. Many kinds of plants grow there. The word can name the line or zone.
Two named latitude lines mark the north and south edges of this region. Maps show their locations. They help describe Earth’s climate zones.

examples.en: A trout jumped from the clear stream.
examples.zh: 一條鱒魚從清澈溪流中躍起。

examples.en: They caught a trout in the mountain lake.
examples.zh: 他們在高山湖泊裡捕到一條鱒魚。

examples.en: The restaurant served baked trout with herbs.
examples.zh: 餐廳供應香草烤鱒魚。

explains.en: This noun names a freshwater fish with dark spots. It often lives in clear rivers and streams. People may catch it for food.
The fish swims against the current in some seasons. Different kinds live in lakes or rivers. The word names a familiar fish.
A restaurant may serve this fish grilled or baked. Its meat is usually mild. The term refers to the animal and its food.

examples.en: The trustee managed the funds for the family.
examples.zh: 受託人替這個家庭管理基金。

examples.en: A trustee joined the school board meeting.
examples.zh: 一位受託人出席了校董會議。

examples.en: The charity appointed a trustee to review its accounts.
examples.zh: 慈善機構任命一位受託人審查帳目。

entries.definition: （名）受託人；信託管理人；代表他人管理資產的人

explains.en: This noun names a person who is trusted to manage money or property for someone else. A family may choose one to oversee an inheritance. The person must act responsibly.
A charity may have a group of people who manage its funds and make decisions. Each member has a duty to the organization. The word describes such a person.
The term can also mean someone who has been given responsibility to care for something. They may protect a trust or fund. Context shows the person's role.

examples.en: She tucked the note into her pocket.
examples.zh: 她把紙條塞進口袋裡。

examples.en: Dad tucked the blanket around the child.
examples.zh: 爸爸把毯子替孩子掖好。

examples.en: The bird tucked its head beneath a wing.
examples.zh: 鳥把頭縮到翅膀下。

entries.definition: （動）塞進；摺起；把被子掖好；（名）摺疊處

explains.en: This verb means to put something into a small or narrow space. A person may place a shirt into a waistband. The fabric stays in place.
It can also mean to pull blankets closely around someone in bed. A parent may cover a child warmly. The action creates a snug fit.
A person may put a small object into a pocket or corner. The word can describe fitting something tightly into a space. The space may be a pocket, box, or small gap.

examples.en: The town was in turmoil after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後，鎮上陷入混亂。

examples.en: The news caused turmoil in the family.
examples.zh: 這個消息讓家裡一陣混亂。

examples.en: Political turmoil delayed the election.
examples.zh: 政治動盪延誤了選舉。

entries.definition: （名）混亂、動盪；局勢或情緒極不平靜的狀態。

explains.en: This noun means a state of confusion, disorder, or great worry. A town may feel unsettled after a storm. People may not know what to do first.
A family may face many problems at once. Their routines become confused. The word describes a troubled situation.
A crowd may become noisy and hard to control. The situation feels unsettled. The noun often describes social or emotional disorder.

examples.en: We reached the lake at twilight.
examples.zh: 我們在黃昏時抵達湖邊。

examples.en: The garden looked blue in the twilight.
examples.zh: 花園在暮色中看起來泛著藍光。

examples.en: The birds grew quiet as twilight fell.
examples.zh: 暮色降臨時，鳥兒安靜下來。

entries.definition: 黃昏；黎明前；朦朧昏暗的光線；衰退期。

explains.en: This noun means the soft light and time just after sunset or just before sunrise. The sky is not fully dark. Colors can look gentle.
People may walk home while the last light fades. Streetlights begin to shine. The word names this short part of the day.
The term can also describe an early or ending stage of something. A town may be changing from one period to another. The use is figurative.

examples.en: The stars twinkled above the quiet field.
examples.zh: 星星在寧靜的田野上方閃爍。

examples.en: Her eyes twinkled when she told the joke.
examples.zh: 她講笑話時眼中閃著光。

examples.en: The small lights twinkled along the path.
examples.zh: 小燈沿著小徑閃爍。

entries.definition: （動）閃爍；發亮；（名）閃爍的光點；眼中閃現的神情

explains.en: As a verb, this means to shine with quick, small flashes of light. Stars may do this in the night sky. The light seems to blink.
A child's eyes may shine with excitement. The word can describe a bright look. It also names a small flash.
A polished object may reflect light in brief flashes. The effect is not a steady glow. Context shows a light or a person's expression.

examples.en: The committee was unanimous in its decision.
examples.zh: 委員會全體一致做出了決定。

examples.en: They reached a unanimous agreement.
examples.zh: 他們達成了全體一致的協議。

examples.en: The class gave a unanimous vote for the new mascot.
examples.zh: 全班一致投票選出新的吉祥物。

explains.en: This adjective means everyone in a group agrees. A team may choose the same plan. No one votes against it.
A jury may make one shared decision after talking. Each member accepts the result. The word describes complete agreement.
A group can reach this kind of decision on a name or date. All members support the choice. The adjective means without disagreement.

examples.en: Pets offer pure, unconditional love that provides deep therapeutic solace.
examples.zh: 寵物給予主人最純粹、毫無保留的無條件的愛，能為疲憊的心靈帶來無可比擬的深層撫慰。

examples.en: A mother's unconditional support helped him overcome the toughest challenges in life.
examples.zh: 母親毫無保留且無條件的支持與鼓勵，陪伴著他度過了人生中最艱難的低谷挑戰。

examples.en: Dogs accept you for who you are, showing unconditional loyalty regardless of circumstances.
examples.zh: 狗狗從不論貧富貴賤全心接納主人，無論環境如何變遷始終展現無條件的忠誠與陪伴。

examples.en: Coming home to a pet's unconditional love dissolves the heaviest workplace exhaustion instantly.
examples.zh: 下班踏進家門迎接毛孩飛撲過來那份毫無保留的無條件的愛，瞬間融化了一整天所有的職場疲憊。

examples.en: A dog offers unconditional acceptance, loving you unconditionally regardless of worldly wealth or status.
examples.zh: 狗狗給予人類的是最純粹毫無條件的包容與接納，不論主人貧富貴賤，始終視你為牠唯一的全世界。

examples.en: Through sickness and health, the unconditional bond between humans and pets remains deeply pure.
examples.zh: 無論生老病死，人與動物之間那份純粹真摯、無條件互許的情感連結，永遠是最深刻動人的牽絆。

entries.definition: 無條件的；全心全意的；無條件全然的；無保留的

explains.en: This adjective describes support or love that has no special conditions. A parent may care for a child even after a mistake. The feeling does not depend on success.
A friend may help someone without asking for anything in return. The support is freely given. The word describes care without limits.
A rule or promise can apply in every situation. No exception is named. The adjective means not limited by conditions.

examples.en: I underestimated how long the walk would take.
examples.zh: 我低估了這段路要走的時間。

examples.en: They underestimated the cost of the repair.
examples.zh: 他們低估了修理費用。

examples.en: She had underestimated her opponent's strength.
examples.zh: 她低估了對手的實力。

entries.definition: （動）低估、估計不足；（名）低估的判斷。

explains.en: This verb means to think that something is smaller or less important than it really is. A hiker may guess a trail is short. The journey takes much longer.
A person may not expect a task to be difficult. They learn that it needs more time or skill. The word describes judging too low.
People can misjudge the size, cost, or strength of something. The result is often surprise. The verb means to make a low estimate.

examples.en: The shoes were underneath the bed.
examples.zh: 鞋子在床底下。

examples.en: The area underneath the bridge stayed cool.
examples.zh: 橋下的區域保持涼爽。

examples.en: She found a note underneath the book.
examples.zh: 她在書本底下找到一張紙條。

entries.definition: 在……下面；在底下；表面之下。

explains.en: This word means below or beneath something. A cat may hide below a table. The object is higher than the cat.
Something may be hidden by an object placed over it. A key can lie below a large stone. You lift the stone to find the key.
The word can describe what lies below a surface. Soft cloth may cover a hard wooden seat. The wood is below the cloth even though you cannot see it.

examples.en: Installing dry ledges inside concrete drainage underpasses encourages nocturnal mammals to pass safely.
examples.zh: 在水泥排水箱涵側邊加裝乾燥踏板「動物地下通道」（Underpass），引導夜行性哺乳類安全通過。

examples.en: Low-clearance culvert underpasses provide small reptiles with sheltered routes beneath expressways.
examples.zh: 低矮涵洞形式的地下通道為小型爬蟲類在快速道路下方提供了安全的庇護通道。

examples.en: Maintenance crews clear accumulated mud from wildlife underpasses after heavy seasonal rains.
examples.zh: 工務維修團隊在大雨過後會定期清除野生動物地下通道內淤積的泥沙與雜物。

entries.definition: 箱涵排水側邊乾燥動物地下通道；地下道

explains.en: This noun means a passage that goes below a road or railway. People can walk through it without crossing traffic. It may be a tunnel.
A subway entrance may pass under a busy street. The passage helps pedestrians move safely. The word names the route below the road.
The passage can be for cars or people. Its roof supports the road above. Context shows which kind of traffic uses it.

examples.en: The repairs are underway at the library.
examples.zh: 圖書館正在進行修繕工程。

examples.en: The train was underway before sunrise.
examples.zh: 火車在日出前已經開動。

examples.en: The project is underway and should finish soon.
examples.zh: 專案已經開始，應該很快會完成。

entries.definition: （副）正在進行中；已經開始；航行中

explains.en: This adjective means that something has started and is continuing. A trip may begin after the bus leaves. The journey is happening now.
A project may be in progress after workers have begun. The work is not finished. This phrase describes an activity that continues now.
The term can also mean moving toward a place. A ship may be on its way to a harbor. Context shows an activity or journey that has begun.

examples.en: The unification of the two clubs created a larger team.
examples.zh: 兩個俱樂部合併後組成了一支更大的隊伍。

examples.en: The book describes the unification of the country.
examples.zh: 這本書描述了國家的統一。

examples.en: Unification brought the scattered groups together.
examples.zh: 統一讓分散的群體團結起來。

explains.en: This noun means the act or result of joining separate parts into one. Two clubs may combine into a single group. Members share their plans.
Countries may join under one government. The process can create a single nation. The word describes coming together.
A team can bring people from different places into one unit. They cooperate toward a shared goal. The noun names this joining process.

examples.en: The leaders unified the separate teams.
examples.zh: 領導者整合了各個隊伍。

examples.en: The shared goal unified the neighbors.
examples.zh: 共同目標讓鄰居們團結起來。

examples.en: They unified the two lists into one.
examples.zh: 他們把兩份清單合併成一份。

entries.definition: （動）統一、合一；使分散的部分成為一個整體。

explains.en: This verb means to bring separate people or things together as one group. A teacher may combine two small classes. They share one lesson.
Countries or organizations may join under one system. They work together rather than separately. The verb describes forming unity.
A person may unite several ideas into a single plan. The parts become connected. The word means to make one whole.

examples.en: The artist unveiled a new painting.
examples.zh: 藝術家公開展示了一幅新畫作。

examples.en: They unveiled the statue in the town square.
examples.zh: 他們在鎮上廣場揭幕了那座雕像。

examples.en: The company will unveil its new logo tomorrow.
examples.zh: 公司明天將公開新標誌。

explains.en: This verb means to show something that was covered or hidden. A theater may open its curtain to show a new set. The audience sees it for the first time.
A company may announce a new product. People learn what it looks like. The word describes making something known.
The verb can also mean to remove a covering. A person may pull cloth away from a painting. Context shows revealing information or an object.

examples.en: Flight attendants instructed all passengers to return their seatbacks to the full upright position.
examples.zh: 空服員在飛機進場降落前逐一溫柔提醒全體旅客將座椅椅背調整豎直並收起前方腳踏板。

examples.en: Sit upright in your ergonomic office chair to prevent chronic lower back strain.
examples.zh: 在辦公室打電腦伏案辦公時請端正坐姿、保持背部挺直，避免長期彎腰駝背造成腰椎疲勞酸痛。

examples.en: The grandfather clock stood upright against the wall, ticking with antique dignity.
examples.zh: 那座古董落地大座鐘端正筆直地立於客廳轉角牆邊，以沉穩莊重的鐘擺聲記錄著歲月流轉。

entries.definition: 垂直豎直的；正直誠實的

explains.en: This adjective means standing or pointing straight up. A person may sit with a straight back. The body is not leaning.
It can describe someone who is honest and follows moral rules. The person behaves fairly. Such character earns trust.
As a noun, it can name a piano with strings that stand vertically. The instrument takes less floor space than a large concert piano. This kind of piano is common in homes and schools.

examples.en: The uprising began in the northern town.
examples.zh: 起義在北方城鎮爆發。

examples.en: The story tells of an uprising against the king.
examples.zh: 故事講述了一場反抗國王的起義。

examples.en: The government faced an uprising after the tax increase.
examples.zh: 稅額提高後，政府面臨一場起義。

entries.definition: （名）起義；暴動；反抗統治的行動

explains.en: This noun means a sudden act of rising against a ruler or government. A group may protest unfair control. The action can grow into conflict.
People may join together to demand change. They are unhappy with those in power. The word describes a public rebellion.
A story may describe villagers rising against a cruel king. The movement is organized and forceful. The noun names the event.

examples.en: Electric vehicle sales have shown a steady upward trend this decade.
examples.zh: 近十年來電動車的銷售量呈現穩步上升的增長趨勢。

examples.en: The helicopter climbed upward through the dense alpine fog toward safety.
examples.zh: 搜救直升機穿透層層高山濃霧筆直向上爬升，朝向空曠安全的高空空域飛去。

examples.en: Expanding your vocational skills creates strong upward career mobility over time.
examples.zh: 持續不斷地自我進修精進職業專業技能，長遠來看能為你帶來強大的向上流動升遷契機。

explains.en: This adverb describes movement toward a higher place or point. A bird may fly from a branch toward the sky. Its position becomes higher.
An amount can also move in this direction. A line on a chart may show rising numbers. The word describes an increase.
A person may look toward a higher floor. The direction is away from the ground. The term can describe place or amount.
This adverb describes movement from a lower place toward a higher one. A kite rises from the ground into the sky. The direction is clear.
A line on a chart may show growing numbers. The amount increases over time. The word can describe direction or growth.
A person may climb from the bottom of a hill toward its top. They move to a higher point. Context shows physical direction or an increase.

examples.en: The urgency of the call brought help quickly.
examples.zh: 這通電話的急迫性讓援助迅速趕到。

examples.en: She spoke with urgency about the missing child.
examples.zh: 她急切地談到失蹤的孩子。

examples.en: The repair had a sense of urgency.
examples.zh: 這項修理工作有急迫性。

explains.en: This noun means the need to act quickly. A person may need help at once. The situation cannot wait.
A message may call for quick attention because a deadline is near. The sender wants action soon. The word describes importance and time pressure.
A fire alarm creates a need for people to respond immediately. The situation allows little time for delay. This feeling can make a person speak or move quickly.

examples.en: The usher led us to our seats.
examples.zh: 引座員帶我們到座位。

examples.en: She ushered the guests into the hall.
examples.zh: 她引導賓客進入大廳。

examples.en: The invention ushered in a new age of travel.
examples.zh: 這項發明開啟了旅行的新時代。

entries.definition: （動）引導、帶領；（名）引座員；帶人到座位或迎接某事發生。

explains.en: As a noun, this means a person who shows guests to their seats or guides them into a place. A theater may have workers at the entrance. They help visitors.
As a verb, it means to guide someone to a seat or place. A host may show guests where to sit. The person follows the guide.
The word can also mean to introduce or bring in a new period. A new mayor may start a different era. Context shows a guide or a beginning.

examples.en: The drawer held every utensil we needed.
examples.zh: 抽屜裡有我們需要的各種餐具。

examples.en: She used a wooden utensil to stir the soup.
examples.zh: 她用木製廚具攪拌湯。

examples.en: Please place each utensil beside the plate.
examples.zh: 請把每件餐具放在盤子旁。

explains.en: This noun means a tool used for eating, cooking, or serving food. A fork is one example. People keep these tools in a kitchen drawer.
A spoon can stir soup, and a knife can cut fruit. Different tools have different shapes and uses. The word describes kitchen items.
A family may set several tools beside each plate. They help people eat a meal. Context can include cooking tools as well.

examples.en: The room fell into utter silence.
examples.zh: 房間裡完全安靜了下來。

examples.en: She uttered a quiet greeting.
examples.zh: 她輕聲說了句問候。

examples.en: His utter surprise made him stop speaking.
examples.zh: 他極度驚訝，一時說不出話來。

entries.definition: （形）完全的；十足的；（動）說出；發出聲音

explains.en: This adjective means complete or total. It adds strength to a description. A plan that goes completely wrong may be described this way.
As a verb, it means to say something aloud. A witness may speak a short sentence. The word often appears in formal writing.
A room may become completely quiet. No one speaks and no sound can be heard. This adjective can emphasize how complete the silence is.

examples.en: Annual influenza vaccines protect vulnerable groups from serious illness.
examples.zh: 每年施打流感疫苗能保護體弱族群免於重症。

examples.en: Scientists worked around the clock to develop a reliable viral vaccine.
examples.zh: 科學家日以繼夜地研發可靠的抗病毒疫苗。

examples.en: Childhood vaccines have eradicated several dangerous infectious diseases.
examples.zh: 兒童疫苗接種已經根除了數種危險的傳染性疾病。

examples.en: Flu vaccines are offered free of charge to elderly citizens every autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋季政府都會為年長長者提供免費的流感疫苗接種服務。

examples.en: Medical researchers worked around the clock to develop a safe mRNA vaccine.
examples.zh: 醫學科研人員日以繼夜全力研發安全有效的新型 mRNA 疫苗。

examples.en: Store temperature-sensitive vaccines inside specialized ultra-cold medical freezers.
examples.zh: 請將溫控敏感的特定疫苗存放在專業的醫用超低溫冷凍冷藏箱中。

explains.en: This noun names a substance given to help the body learn to defend against a disease. It may be given as a shot or drops. The body builds protection.
A health worker may give one before a person travels. It helps lower the chance of illness. The word names the preventive substance.
Scientists create different kinds for different diseases. A person may receive it at a clinic. The noun describes a medical product.

examples.en: Scrape fragrant tiny black seeds from a plump Bourbon vanilla bean pod.
examples.zh: 拿小刀輕輕剖開並刮出肥美飽滿的波旁天然香草豆莢中數以萬計的芬芳黑色小香草籽。

examples.en: High-grade natural vanilla extract adds warmth and depth to homemade chocolate chip cookies.
examples.zh: 滴入幾滴高品質的天然純香草精，能為剛出爐的手工美式巧克力軟餅乾注入溫潤深沉的香氣。

examples.en: The software includes a straightforward vanilla version without any customized third-party extensions.
examples.zh: 該軟體套件提供了一個乾淨純粹的標準原裝版本（Vanilla Version），未包含任何第三方客製擴充套件。

examples.en: Splitting a plump Madagascar bourbon vanilla bean releases thousands of fragrant black caviar-like seeds.
examples.zh: 剖開一根飽滿油亮的馬達加斯加天然香草莢，刮出數以萬計如黑魚子醬般香甜芬芳的香草籽。

examples.en: Real natural vanilla imparts warm, woody notes that synthetic vanillin can never authentically duplicate.
examples.zh: 純天然頂級香草莢散發出溫潤溫暖的木質乳香，是人工合成香精香草粉永遠無法比擬的尊榮風味。

examples.en: After scraping out the tiny seeds, the spent vanilla pod was placed in a jar of raw sugar to create fragrant vanilla sugar.
examples.zh: 刮出細密香草籽後，將香草莢外皮埋入未精製細砂糖罐中封存，即可製成香氣逼人的天然香草糖。

entries.definition: 天然香草豆莢；香草味的；馬達加斯加波旁天然頂級香草莢

explains.en: This noun names a flavor from a dark orchid seed. It is often used in ice cream and cakes. The taste is sweet and gentle.
The word can also describe a plain or standard choice. A person may choose the basic flavor instead of something unusual. This figurative use is common.
The seed pods are dried and used in cooking. The flavor can be added to milk, cookies, or drinks. The noun names the ingredient or flavor.

examples.en: The wall-hung bathroom vanity incorporates generous storage for toiletries.
examples.zh: 懸空壁掛式的現代衛浴下嵌式面盆浴櫃提供了充裕的收納空間以妥善擺放洗沐備品。

examples.en: An illuminated LED mirror was mounted above the double-sink bathroom vanity.
examples.zh: 雙面盆寬敞衛浴浴櫃正上方，客製安裝了一面具備觸控除霧功能的環形 LED 美妝化妝鏡。

examples.en: She sat down at her bedroom vanity table to apply skincare creams and moisturizer.
examples.zh: 她安適地坐在臥室典雅的梳妝台前，細心塗抹夜間保濕乳霜與精華液滋潤肌膚。

examples.en: A floating double vanity allows morning grooming without competing for mirror space.
examples.zh: 壁掛懸空式雙人洗手台面盆浴櫃能讓夫妻在忙碌早晨從容梳洗刷牙，無需爭搶鏡面空間。

examples.en: The vanity drawers feature customized wooden compartments for organizing cosmetics and skincare bottles.
examples.zh: 洗手台浴櫃抽屜內部配備了客製化實木分隔格層，讓各類彩妝化妝品與保養精華液井然有序收納。

examples.en: Chasing empty vanity on social media often detracts from building genuine, meaningful relationships.
examples.zh: 盲目追逐社群網路上虛無縹緲的按讚虛榮感，往往只會讓人忽略了在現實生活中建立真誠深厚的連結。

entries.definition: 衛浴面盆浴櫃；梳妝台；虛榮；衛浴洗手面盆櫃

explains.en: This noun means too much pride in one's appearance or importance. A person may spend a long time admiring their reflection. The attitude can seem self-centered.
It can also mean a bathroom cabinet with a sink and mirror. A home may have one in the bathroom. The word has a furniture meaning.
The term may describe concern about looks or personal success. A person may focus too much on being admired. Context shows pride or furniture.

examples.en: Vapor rose from the hot soup.
examples.zh: 熱湯上方升起水蒸氣。

examples.en: The cold window was covered with water vapor.
examples.zh: 冰冷的窗戶上佈滿了水蒸氣。

examples.en: A cloud of vapor drifted above the lake.
examples.zh: 一團水氣飄浮在湖面上方。

explains.en: This noun means a cloud of tiny drops or gas floating in the air. A kettle sends it upward when water gets hot. It can be hard to see.
The word can also mean the gas form of a liquid. Water becomes this form when heated. It spreads through the air.
A foggy window may show tiny drops in the air. The noun describes a gas or fine cloud. It is often used in science.

examples.en: She wore a white veil at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 她在典禮上戴著白色面紗。

examples.en: A veil covered the statue's face.
examples.zh: 面紗遮住了雕像的臉。

examples.en: The story used mystery to veil the truth.
examples.zh: 故事用謎團掩蓋真相。

explains.en: This noun names a piece of cloth worn over the face or head. A bride may cover her hair during a ceremony. The fabric is often light.
It can also mean something that hides or covers the truth. A smile may hide sadness. The word can be used in a figurative way.
As a verb, it means to cover or hide something. Clouds may cover the moon. Context shows a cloth or concealment.

examples.en: The blue velvet curtain covered the stage.
examples.zh: 藍色天鵝絨布幕遮住了舞台。

examples.en: Her velvet jacket felt soft.
examples.zh: 她的天鵝絨外套摸起來很柔軟。

examples.en: The box had a velvet lining.
examples.zh: 盒子裡襯著天鵝絨。

explains.en: This is a soft cloth with a smooth, thick surface. Light makes its short fibers look rich and deep. People use it for jackets, curtains, and cushions.
The cloth feels soft when a hand moves across it. Its surface can look darker when brushed one way. A theater curtain may use it to block light.
The name can describe a rich, smooth feel or appearance. A singer may have a soft, warm voice. The comparison suggests a gentle texture.

examples.en: A crisp white button-down shirt is the most versatile staple in any closet.
examples.zh: 一件挺拔合身的經典白襯衫是任何男女衣櫥中進可攻、退可守最不可或缺的百搭神級單品。

examples.en: This versatile trench coat can be styled with formal workwear or casual weekend jeans.
examples.zh: 這款百搭的英倫長版風衣既能搭配正式上班西裝，也能隨性混搭週末牛仔休閒褲。

examples.en: Choosing versatile pieces maximizes the number of outfits you can assemble with fewer garments.
examples.zh: 挑選多功能的百搭單品能用最少數量的衣服，組合搭配出最多變豐富的穿搭風格。

explains.en: This describes someone or something useful in many different ways. A small room can serve as a study and guest room. The item or person can handle several tasks.
A kitchen tool that serves several purposes may open cans, cut string, and turn screws. It replaces separate items. Its wide range of uses saves space.
A tool with many uses may open cans, cut string, and turn screws. It replaces several separate tools. An actor may also play funny and serious roles.

examples.en: The licensed veterinarian performed a gentle physical checkup on the kitten.
examples.zh: 溫柔細心的執業獸醫師為初次來到診所的小奶貓進行了全面的健康檢查。

examples.en: You should consult a licensed veterinarian immediately if your pet refuses to eat.
examples.zh: 若你的毛孩連續多餐拒絕進食，應立即尋求合格獸醫師的專業診斷。

examples.en: She has dreamed of becoming a wildlife veterinarian since she was a little girl.
examples.zh: 她從小女孩時期起，就立志長大後要成為一名救治野生動物的獸醫。

examples.en: Licensed veterinarians perform complex orthopedic surgeries and preventive healthcare exams.
examples.zh: 領有國家專業執照的動物醫院獸醫師，專門執行複雜的骨科手術與日常預防醫學健檢。

examples.en: If your cat stops eating for more than twenty-four hours, consult a veterinarian immediately.
examples.zh: 如果您的貓咪超過二十四小時未進食，請立即諮詢獸醫師。

examples.en: The clinic employs three experienced veterinarians specializing in exotic animals and avian medicine.
examples.zh: 該診所聘請了三位經驗豐富的獸醫師，專精於特殊寵物與鳥類醫學。

explains.en: This is a doctor who cares for animals. The doctor checks pets when they are sick or hurt. The shorter form is common in everyday speech.
The doctor may examine a dog, treat a bird, or help a cat recover. Clinics often keep medicine and tools for animal care. This job focuses on health beyond human patients.
People bring pets for checkups and care when an animal feels ill. The professional may explain an animal’s condition to its owner. The title names this kind of doctor.

examples.en: The president used a veto to stop the bill.
examples.zh: 總統行使否決權阻止了這項法案。

examples.en: The council may veto the building plan.
examples.zh: 議會可能會否決這項建築計畫。

examples.en: Her veto ended the proposal.
examples.zh: 她的否決讓這項提案告終。

entries.definition: （名）否決權；否決；（動）否決；拒絕批准

explains.en: This noun is an official power to reject a plan or law. A leader may stop a bill from taking effect. The rejection blocks the decision.
As a verb, it means to use that power and reject a proposal. A committee may vote for a plan, but one official can stop it. The decision then cannot proceed in that form.
The power can also stop a group decision. A board member may reject a motion under the group’s rules. The word describes a firm refusal with authority.

examples.en: The phone began to vibrate in my pocket.
examples.zh: 手機開始在我口袋裡震動。

examples.en: The drum skin vibrates when struck.
examples.zh: 鼓面受到敲擊時會振動。

examples.en: The old window vibrated in the wind.
examples.zh: 老窗戶在風中震動。

explains.en: This verb means to move back and forth very quickly. A phone may shake when it receives a call. The movement can be felt or heard.
A guitar string moves rapidly after someone plucks it. That motion makes the air carry a musical note. The string does not travel far from its place.
A machine can shake because a part is moving unevenly. A window may also tremble when a large truck passes. The verb describes this quick repeated motion.

examples.en: I felt a vibration in the floor.
examples.zh: 我感覺到地板在震動。

examples.en: The phone uses vibration instead of a ring.
examples.zh: 這支手機用震動代替鈴聲。

examples.en: The motor makes a strong vibration.
examples.zh: 馬達產生強烈的震動。

entries.definition: （名）震動、振動；物體快速往返移動所產生的動作。

explains.en: This noun is a quick repeated movement around a position. A phone makes a small shaking motion to alert its owner. The movement may be felt through a table.
A speaker cone moves rapidly and pushes air. Those movements help create sound. The repeated motion is a physical event.
A machine may produce shaking when its parts move. A loose panel can rattle along with it. The noun names that kind of motion.

examples.en: He called greed a dangerous vice.
examples.zh: 他稱貪婪是一種危險的惡習。

examples.en: The carpenter held the board in a vice.
examples.zh: 木工用虎鉗固定木板。

examples.en: The vice president welcomed the guests.
examples.zh: 副總統歡迎了來賓。

entries.definition: 惡習；缺點；副職；副手；虎鉗。

explains.en: This noun can mean a bad habit or action. Lying for personal gain is one example. The behavior can harm the person or others.
In a machine shop, a clamp holds an object firmly. Its jaws close around wood or metal. A worker can then cut or shape the held piece.
The word also appears in a formal title for a person next in rank. A deputy president may lead when the president is away. Here it signals a second-in-command role.

examples.en: The victor lifted the trophy above his head.
examples.zh: 勝利者把獎盃高高舉起。

examples.en: She was the victor in the chess match.
examples.zh: 她是這場棋賽的勝者。

examples.en: The victors returned to the city.
examples.zh: 勝利的一方回到了城市。

explains.en: This noun means a person or group that wins a contest or conflict. The winner receives a prize after the final round. The other side does not win.
In a race, the person who crosses the finish line first takes the title. The result is clear when judges confirm it. The word focuses on the winner.
A story may call the side that wins a battle the winning side. A flag may mark its success. The term can refer to one person or a whole group.

examples.en: The team played with vigor until the final whistle.
examples.zh: 球隊充滿活力地比賽到最後一聲哨響。

examples.en: She defended her idea with vigor.
examples.zh: 她有力地捍衛自己的想法。

examples.en: The young tree grew with vigor.
examples.zh: 這棵小樹生長得很茂盛。

explains.en: This noun means strong energy and effort. A child may run around energetically all afternoon. The person seems lively and active.
A worker may speak with energy while defending an idea. The voice sounds strong and full of life. The word can describe physical or mental force.
Plants growing strongly in good soil look healthy and make new leaves quickly. Their growth is full of strength. The noun describes lively energy.

examples.en: They took a vigorous walk along the river.
examples.zh: 他們沿著河邊快步健行。

examples.en: The class had a vigorous discussion.
examples.zh: 全班進行了熱烈的討論。

examples.en: Vigorous plants filled the garden.
examples.zh: 茂盛的植物長滿了花園。

entries.definition: （形）精力充沛的、有力的；進行得活躍而充滿力量。

explains.en: This adjective describes strong and energetic action. A fast walk may make a person breathe harder. The movement uses plenty of effort.
A lively debate includes clear, forceful arguments. Speakers take the issue seriously. Their words show energy and attention.
A plant may grow strongly in good soil. It quickly sends out new leaves and stems. The adjective points to healthy strength.

examples.en: They rented a villa near the beach.
examples.zh: 他們在海邊租了一棟別墅。

examples.en: The old villa stood among olive trees.
examples.zh: 那棟古老別墅矗立在橄欖樹間。

examples.en: Our villa had a small garden.
examples.zh: 我們的別墅有一座小花園。

explains.en: This noun often means a large, comfortable house, sometimes in the country. A family may spend summer there. The building may have a garden around it.
In ancient Rome, a country home could belong to a wealthy person. It might include land and work buildings. This old use appears in history books.
Today, a holiday house may stand by the sea or in the hills. Guests may rent it for a short stay. The word often suggests a private home.

examples.en: The villain hid the map from the explorers.
examples.zh: 反派把地圖藏了起來，不讓探險家找到。

examples.en: The hero finally caught the villain.
examples.zh: 主角終於抓到了壞人。

examples.en: In this story, the villain becomes a friend.
examples.zh: 在這個故事裡，反派最後成了朋友。

entries.definition: （名）壞人；反派角色；造成問題的人

explains.en: In a story, this is a person who causes harm or fights the hero. The character may trick others or break rules. The plot often follows the struggle against this person.
The word can describe a person who commits a cruel or wicked act. A newspaper may use it about a story’s criminal. It expresses strong disapproval.
Some tales show the bad character changing and becoming kind. Other stories give that person a reason for acting badly. The noun names an enemy in a story or a wicked person.

examples.en: A grape vine covered the wooden fence.
examples.zh: 葡萄藤爬滿了木製圍籬。

examples.en: The vine climbed up the garden wall.
examples.zh: 藤蔓爬上了花園牆面。

examples.en: She cut a dry vine from the tree.
examples.zh: 她從樹上剪下一條乾枯的藤蔓。

explains.en: This noun names a plant with a long, thin stem. It may climb a wall or wrap around a support. Grapes grow on one well-known kind.
The plant can spread across the ground or climb toward sunlight. Gardeners often give it a frame to hold onto. Its flexible stem can grow a long way.
Some climbing plants have flowers, while others produce fruit. Ivy can cover a building. The word describes this kind of plant itself.

examples.en: The contemporary vineyard layout arranges terraced seating blocks around a centrally positioned stage.
examples.zh: 衛武營採用的現代「葡萄園梯田式格局」（Vineyard Layout），將觀眾席如梯田般環繞中央舞台佈置。

examples.en: Rolling green hills in central Taiwan host a boutique vineyard producing award-winning domestic wines.
examples.zh: 台灣中部起伏翠綠的丘陵上坐落著一處精品葡萄園酒莊，精釀出屢獲國際大獎肯定的在地名酒。

examples.en: Touring the family-owned French vineyard allowed visitors to sample crisp white wine straight from oak barrels.
examples.zh: 參觀這座歷史悠久的家族葡萄酒莊園，遊客得以直接從橡木桶中品嚐剛熟成出桶的清洌白葡萄酒。

entries.definition: 葡萄園梯田式環繞型現代音樂廳格局 (衛武營)；葡萄園

explains.en: This is a piece of land where grape plants are grown. Rows of plants often cover a sunny hillside. Workers care for the grapes through the seasons.
The grapes from this land may be used to make wine or juice. A visitor can walk between the rows. The place may also have a cellar or tasting room.
A family or company may own this farm. The plants need suitable weather and careful work. The noun names the growing grounds, not just the drink.

examples.en: The violinist tuned her instrument before the concert.
examples.zh: 小提琴家在音樂會前調整了樂器。

examples.en: A young violinist played a folk song.
examples.zh: 一位年輕的小提琴手演奏了一首民謠。

examples.en: The violinist stood beside the orchestra.
examples.zh: 小提琴家站在管弦樂團旁邊。

explains.en: This is a musician who plays the violin. The instrument rests near the shoulder while the player draws a bow across its strings. The music may be soft or lively.
A musician may perform alone or with an orchestra. The player reads notes and listens to the other musicians. Practice helps build skill.
A street musician may play for passersby in a square. A concert performer may play in a hall. The word identifies the person by the instrument played.

examples.en: The factory uses virgin plastic for these parts.
examples.zh: 這家工廠用全新的塑膠原料製造這些零件。

examples.en: They crossed a virgin forest.
examples.zh: 他們穿越了一片原始森林。

examples.en: This blanket is made from virgin wool.
examples.zh: 這條毯子用未經回收的原生羊毛製成。

entries.definition: 處女；處男；未開發的；原始未受破壞的。

explains.en: As a noun, this means a person who has never had sex. An adult can have this description. The word refers to a person’s sexual experience.
As an adjective, this can describe land that people have not changed or developed. A forest may still grow without roads or buildings. Its natural state remains largely untouched.
Materials described this way have not been used to make something before. They do not come from old products collected for reuse. A factory may use them to make a new item.

examples.en: Consistent eight-hour sleep habits fuel daytime vigor, mental resilience, and vibrant physical vitality.
examples.zh: 養成規律作息並每晚睡足八小時，能為白天的繁重工作注入源源不絕的專注韌性與蓬勃生命活力。

examples.en: Wholesome organic nutrition and daily outdoor sunshine restore youthful energy and biological vitality.
examples.zh: 堅持純淨無添加的原型有機飲食並天天擁抱大自然陽光，能重新喚醒細胞的青春能量與生理生機。

examples.en: Her contagious laughter and bounding vitality brought infectious warmth into every community meeting.
examples.zh: 她那如銀鈴般爽朗的開懷笑聲與永遠用不完的朝氣活力，為每一次的社區鄰里會議注入了無限溫暖。

examples.en: Regular morning Tai Chi practice in the park radiates healthy physical vitality and youthful spirit.
examples.zh: 每天清晨在綠意盎然的公園中練習太極拳，讓長輩步履輕盈、臉色紅潤，煥發出神采奕奕的銀髮活力。

examples.en: The injection of government venture subsidies brought renewed economic vitality to old industrial districts.
examples.zh: 政府挹注青年創業輔導基金，為昔日沒落蕭條的傳統老舊工業區注入了嶄新的經濟活力。

examples.en: Fresh seasonal fruits and crisp green leafy vegetables are packed with natural enzymes and vitality.
examples.zh: 當季現摘的生鮮水果與翠綠時蔬富含天然酵素與微量營養素，洋溢著大自然的生機活力。

examples.en: Combining nutritious whole foods with restorative sleep fills your mornings with boundless mental vitality.
examples.zh: 將營養豐富的原型食物與深度修復睡眠完美結合，能讓你的每個清晨都充滿源源不絕的心智活力。

examples.en: The mayor's revitalized waterfront promenade project restored vibrant cultural vitality to the old historic harbor.
examples.zh: 市長推動的親水河畔景觀步道活化計畫，為這座昔日繁華的老歷史港區重新找回了蓬勃的文化活力。

examples.en: Regular cardiovascular exercise keeps the heart muscle strong and preserves youthful physical vitality into old age.
examples.zh: 養成規律的心肺有氧運動習慣，能保持心肌收縮強健有力，並讓人在高齡歲月依然享有年輕飽滿的身心活力。

entries.definition: 蓬勃充沛的生命活力；生機；煥發神采奕奕的銀髮朝氣活力；充沛飽滿的身心活力朝氣

explains.en: This noun means energy and a strong feeling of being alive. Children may show energy while playing outdoors. They seem active and lively.
A healthy plant has strong life when its leaves are green and its stems are firm. It continues to grow. The word can describe living things and people.
A town may feel lively when its streets are busy and its arts are active. People meet and take part in events. Here the noun means energy in a place.

examples.en: Teaching became her vocation.
examples.zh: 教學成了她的志業。

examples.en: His vocation is repairing musical instruments.
examples.zh: 他的職業是修理樂器。

examples.en: The school offers training for a vocation in cooking.
examples.zh: 這所學校提供餐飲職業訓練。

entries.definition: （名）職業；志業；使命感強的工作

explains.en: This noun can mean a job that feels especially meaningful to a person. A nurse may feel called to care for others. The work can seem like a personal purpose.
It can also mean a person’s usual occupation. A carpenter’s work is building and repairing things. The word often suggests more than a temporary task.
A school may offer lessons that prepare students for a career. They learn skills for a certain kind of work. The noun can refer to both a calling and a job.

examples.en: She entered a vocational program for electricians.
examples.zh: 她進入電工職業訓練課程。

examples.en: The school offers vocational classes in cooking.
examples.zh: 這所學校開設烹飪職業課程。

examples.en: He chose vocational training after high school.
examples.zh: 高中畢業後，他選擇接受職業訓練。

explains.en: This adjective relates to learning skills for a particular job. A work course may teach cooking or carpentry. Students practice useful tasks.
A trade school prepares learners for specific careers. It may have workshops and equipment. The training focuses on skills used at work.
Job training can include classroom lessons and hands-on practice. Learners may prepare for a trade or service job. The adjective connects education with work.

examples.en: The word “apple” begins with a vowel.
examples.zh: 「apple」這個字以母音開頭。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to circle every vowel.
examples.zh: 老師要我們圈出每個母音。

examples.en: A vowel sound follows the first letter.
examples.zh: 第一個字母後面接著一個母音。

entries.definition: （名）母音、元音；發音時氣流不受明顯阻礙的語音。

explains.en: This is a speech sound made with an open passage of air in the mouth. English letters a, e, i, o, and u usually represent these sounds. Words often need one.
The sound can change the meaning of a word. A small change in mouth shape makes a different sound. Letters and sounds do not always match exactly.
Some writing systems use marks to show these sounds. A learner can listen for them when reading aloud. The term names a basic kind of speech sound and its letters.

examples.en: The golden retriever wagged its bushy tail enthusiastically to welcome home its family.
examples.zh: 大黃金獵犬在玄關興奮地狂搖毛茸茸的尾巴，熱情飛撲迎接下班回家的家人。

examples.en: A friendly puppy will often wag its tail with full-body wiggles when meeting new friends.
examples.zh: 親人的小狗在公園遇到新同伴時，常常會連同整副身軀扭動並興奮地使勁搖尾巴。

examples.en: Dogs wag their tails in various patterns to communicate different emotions and energy levels.
examples.zh: 狗狗搖尾巴的擺動幅度與高度代表著不同情緒密碼，傳達牠們當下的心情與興奮程度。

explains.en: This verb means to move something from side to side repeatedly. A happy dog may move its tail when its owner arrives. The motion can show excitement.
A person may move a finger from side to side to warn someone. The motion is small but clear. It can show disapproval or caution.
As a noun, it can mean a side-to-side movement, often made by a tail. The puppy’s tail made a quick motion. The word can name either the action or its movement.

examples.en: She added chopped walnut to the salad.
examples.zh: 她在沙拉裡加了切碎的核桃。

examples.en: A walnut tree grew beside the house.
examples.zh: 房子旁邊長著一棵核桃樹。

examples.en: The cabinet was made of walnut.
examples.zh: 這個櫥櫃是用胡桃木製成的。

explains.en: This is a nut with a hard shell and a wrinkled edible center. It grows on a tree. People eat it plain or add it to food.
The nut has a rich taste and a firm texture. Bakers may put pieces into bread or cake. The shell must be cracked before eating.
The tree’s dark wood is also valued for furniture. A table made from this wood can have a warm brown color. The word can name the nut or the wood.

examples.en: The nurse walked through the hospital ward.
examples.zh: 護理師走過醫院病房。

examples.en: The court appointed an adult to care for the ward.
examples.zh: 法院指定一位成年人照顧這名受監護人。

examples.en: She represents the northern ward on the city council.
examples.zh: 她在市議會代表北區。

entries.definition: （名）病房；行政區；受監護者；（動）守護；防範（較少見）

explains.en: This noun can mean a room or area in a hospital for patients. Nurses care for people there. A hospital may have separate areas for children or surgery.
It can also mean a person placed under another person’s legal care. A court may appoint an adult to look after a child. The child receives support and protection.
The word appears in names for city districts. Local residents may vote for a representative from their area. In this use, it means a defined part of a city.

examples.en: Building a minimalist capsule wardrobe eliminates morning outfit decision fatigue.
examples.zh: 打造實穿百搭的極簡「膠囊衣櫥」（Capsule Wardrobe），能徹底告別清晨出門前的選衣焦慮。

examples.en: Clean out your wardrobe each spring to donate garments you have not worn in the past year.
examples.zh: 每年春季趁機整頓斷捨離衣櫥，將過去一年從未穿出門的閒置衣物捐贈給慈善機構。

examples.en: A well-curated wardrobe contains versatile essentials that can be mixed and matched endlessly.
examples.zh: 一個精心規劃的實用衣櫥應包含多種百搭核心基本款，能輕鬆交替混搭出無數造型。

examples.en: The wardrobe department meticulously steams and sews hundreds of Victorian corsets and cloaks.
examples.zh: 劇團龐大的服裝造型部門（Wardrobe），細心熨燙並手工縫紉數百套華麗繁複的十九世紀維多利亞宮廷禮服。

examples.en: She invested in versatile, high-quality staples to build a timeless capsule wardrobe for work.
examples.zh: 她投資添購了幾款剪裁俐落的高質感百搭單品，為自己打造出一套適合都會通勤的永恆膠囊衣櫥。

examples.en: During the rapid 45-second wardrobe change, dressers secured zipper hooks with practiced ease.
examples.zh: 在側台短短四十五秒極限換裝時間內，服裝助理以千錘百鍊的俐落手法迅速扣妥緊身胸衣暗扣。

entries.definition: 衣櫥；全套服裝組合；劇團戲服管理部；衣櫃

explains.en: This noun can mean a tall cabinet used to store clothes. It may have doors, shelves, and a rail for hangers. People keep clothing inside it.
The word also means all the clothes a person owns. A small collection may include a few work outfits and casual clothes. It can describe clothing rather than furniture.
In theater or film, a costume department handles clothes worn by performers. Workers choose and care for each outfit. The noun can name clothes or a cabinet for storing them.

examples.en: The judge signed a lawful wiretap warrant after investigators presented probable cause of drug trafficking.
examples.zh: 在辦案人員出示跨國販毒充足事證後，法官正式簽發合法的通訊監察監聽令狀。

examples.en: Officers must present a signed search warrant to the homeowner before entering the private residence.
examples.zh: 執法人員在強制破門跨入私人住宅執行搜查前，必須當場依法出示法官簽名的正式搜索扣押令狀。

examples.en: An emergency arrest warrant was issued immediately after ballistics confirmed the weapon match.
examples.zh: 在彈道比對鑑定確定扣案槍枝與命案彈頭吻合後，檢察官立即向法院聲請並核發了緊急拘票。

entries.definition: 法院核發合法通訊監察監聽令狀；搜查令

explains.en: This noun can be an official document giving permission or authority. A judge may sign an order for police to search a place. The paper sets out legal approval.
It can also mean a reason that makes an action seem justified. Clear evidence may give reason to investigate further. The word can appear in formal speech.
In law, the document may authorize an arrest or search. Officials must follow the limits written in it. It gives specific legal power.

examples.en: This laptop comes with a two-year international manufacturer warranty.
examples.zh: 這台筆電附有原廠提供的兩年全球國際保固。

examples.en: Dropping your waterproof phone into saltwater voids the official repair warranty.
examples.zh: 將防水手機意外掉落進高鹽分海水中將導致官方免費維修保固失效。

examples.en: Keep your stamped purchase receipt safe inside the product warranty booklet.
examples.zh: 請妥善將蓋有店章的統一發票與購買證明隨手保存在產品保固說明書中。

explains.en: This is a promise that a seller or maker will repair or replace a product under stated conditions. A new appliance may include one. The document explains the length and limits of the promise.
A product promise may cover a broken part for a set time. The owner may need proof of purchase. This assurance can make a buyer feel more secure.
Some promises cover only certain problems or parts. A buyer can read the terms before relying on them. The noun names this kind of product guarantee.

examples.en: The waterproof jacket kept me dry in the rain.
examples.zh: 這件防水外套讓我在雨中保持乾爽。

examples.en: They bought a waterproof cover for the camera.
examples.zh: 他們買了防水相機罩。

examples.en: The workers waterproofed the basement wall.
examples.zh: 工人替地下室牆面做了防水處理。

explains.en: This adjective describes something that water cannot pass through easily. A raincoat keeps rain off the clothes beneath it. The material blocks water.
A sealed case helps protect a phone near water. A closed bag may keep papers dry. The item is made to resist getting wet.
As a verb, it means to treat something so water cannot enter. A worker may seal a wooden deck. This treatment helps keep it dry.
