examples.en: The weary hikers rested beside the trail.
examples.zh: 疲憊的健行者在步道旁休息。

examples.en: She grew weary of waiting for the bus.
examples.zh: 她等公車等得不耐煩了。

examples.en: The long speech wearied the audience.
examples.zh: 冗長的演講讓聽眾感到疲倦。

entries.definition: （形）疲倦的、厭倦的；（動）使疲累、使厭煩。

explains.en: This adjective means very tired after effort or worry. A long trip may leave a person exhausted. The person needs rest.
It can describe someone who has lost patience with something repeated. A teacher may hear the same excuse again and again. The feeling comes from being tired of it.
As a verb, it means to make someone tired or bored. Repeated delays can drain a traveler. The person may lose energy or interest.

examples.en: The fishing boat returned to the wharf at dawn.
examples.zh: 漁船在黎明時回到碼頭。

examples.en: Crates of fruit waited on the wharf.
examples.zh: 一箱箱水果在碼頭上等候搬運。

examples.en: They tied the small boat beside the wharf.
examples.zh: 他們把小船繫在碼頭旁。

entries.definition: 碼頭；裝卸船貨的岸邊平台。

explains.en: This noun is a platform beside water where ships load and unload goods or people. Boats can tie up along its edge. Workers move cargo between land and ship.
A town may build this landing near its harbor. Fishing boats return there with their catch. The structure helps connect boats with the shore.
As a verb, it can mean to place or secure a boat at such a landing. A crew brings the vessel alongside. This use is less common than the noun.

examples.en: He ordered a glass of whiskey with ice.
examples.zh: 他點了一杯加冰的威士忌。

examples.en: The bottle of whiskey was kept in a cabinet.
examples.zh: 那瓶威士忌被收在櫥櫃裡。

examples.en: Aged barrels of oak infuse traditional whiskey with rich caramel and smoky flavors.
examples.zh: 陳年橡木桶為傳統威士忌注入了濃郁的焦糖與煙燻風味。

entries.definition: （名）威士忌；以穀物釀製的烈酒

explains.en: This is a strong alcoholic drink made from grain. It is aged in wooden barrels. Different places make it in different styles.
The spelling varies by country and maker. Some labels use an extra letter, while others leave it out. Both forms name a similar kind of drink.
People may serve it in a small glass or use it in cooking. It has a strong smell and taste. The drink is intended for adults.

examples.en: Buying snacks at wholesale stores like Costco saves family budgets.
examples.zh: 在好市多等批發賣場大量採買零食能節省家庭開銷。

examples.en: The boutique owner buys jewelry at wholesale prices directly from artisans.
examples.zh: 精品店老闆直接向工藝手作匠人以批發價大宗採購純手工精美飾品。

examples.en: Selling merchandise wholesale yields lower unit profit but generates immense total volume.
examples.zh: 採取整批大宗批發銷售模式單件毛利雖低，但能帶來龐大可觀的總出貨量。

explains.en: This word describes buying or selling goods in large quantities, often to shops. A shop owner may buy many boxes at once. The price per item is often lower.
As an adjective or adverb, it relates to sales in bulk. A bakery may buy flour at a low price for large orders. The deal serves businesses that resell goods.
As a noun, it refers to the business of selling goods in bulk. As a verb, it means to sell that way. A maker may sell toys by the case to stores.

examples.en: Board game nights with good friends offer clean, wholesome entertainment.
examples.zh: 與三五好友相約在週末暢玩桌遊，是一種既溫馨健康又增進感情的正派娛樂。

examples.en: Eating wholesome home-cooked meals made with organic greens boosts overall immunity.
examples.zh: 經常品嚐使用有機時令蔬菜用心烹調的健康家常飯菜，能大幅提振整體免疫力。

examples.en: Animated family movies with positive uplifting values provide wholesome fun for all ages.
examples.zh: 傳遞正向積極溫暖價值觀的閤家歡動畫長片，能為男女老幼帶來老少咸宜的正派歡樂。

entries.definition: 健康有益的；正派健全的

explains.en: This adjective describes something good for health or well-being. A meal with vegetables and grains can be nourishing. It helps the body.
It can also describe entertainment or behavior that is kind and suitable for families. A gentle comedy may be enjoyable for all ages. The content avoids harmful or crude parts.
A positive atmosphere feels safe and kind. People treat one another with care. The word can describe food, entertainment, or behavior.

examples.en: The widow kept her husband’s letters in a box.
examples.zh: 這位寡婦把丈夫的信件收在盒子裡。

examples.en: The widows met for tea each month.
examples.zh: 幾位寡婦每個月相約喝茶。

examples.en: The kindhearted widow dedicated her retirement years to tending the neighborhood community garden.
examples.zh: 那位心地善良的寡婦將退休歲月全心投入在照料社區花園上。

explains.en: This noun names a person whose spouse has died. The feminine form is used for a woman and the masculine form for a man. The term describes a change in family status.
A person may continue to use the term years after the loss. Friends and family may offer support. The word does not tell how long ago the spouse died.
The plural form can refer to several people who lost spouses. A community group may bring them together. The paired forms cover women and men.

examples.en: The office will withhold payment until the form is signed.
examples.zh: 辦公室會等表格簽署後才扣住款項。

examples.en: He may withhold the news until the family arrives.
examples.zh: 他可能會等家人到齊後才公布消息。

examples.en: The employer withholds tax from each paycheck.
examples.zh: 雇主會從每份薪水中預扣稅款。

entries.definition: （動）扣留、保留；不提供或不交出本可給予的東西。

explains.en: This verb means to keep something back instead of giving or sharing it. A person may hold back a payment until a bill is checked. The item is not handed over yet.
A person can keep information from a group. The details may remain private. The verb describes choosing not to reveal or provide something.
A company may keep part of a worker’s pay for taxes. The money is set aside for a required purpose. The word often appears in formal situations.

examples.en: The family shared their woe after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後，一家人共同承受悲傷。

examples.en: The hero faced many woes on the journey.
examples.zh: 主角在旅途中遭遇許多苦難。

examples.en: He joked about the woe of a broken umbrella.
examples.zh: 他開玩笑地抱怨雨傘壞掉的倒楣事。

explains.en: This noun means great sadness or trouble. A person may feel deep sorrow after losing a home. The feeling is serious and painful.
The word often appears in stories or formal writing. A character may face many problems during a difficult journey. It can refer to one sorrow or several troubles.
People sometimes use it in a light way about small troubles. A student may complain about a rainy day. The usual meaning is a serious sorrow.

examples.en: A woodpecker tapped on the oak tree.
examples.zh: 一隻啄木鳥在橡樹上啄擊。

examples.en: We heard a woodpecker in the forest.
examples.zh: 我們在森林裡聽見啄木鳥的聲音。

examples.en: The woodpecker searched the trunk for insects.
examples.zh: 啄木鳥在樹幹上尋找昆蟲。

entries.definition: （名）啄木鳥；用尖喙敲擊樹木的鳥

explains.en: This is a bird that taps or drills tree trunks with its strong bill. It searches for insects beneath the bark. Its feet help it cling to the trunk.
Many kinds have sharp calls and patterned feathers. A bird may drum on wood to find food or signal another bird. The tapping can be heard across a quiet forest.
A bird of this kind has a long tongue that can reach into small holes. It pulls insects from the tree. Its body is suited to climbing and pecking.

examples.en: The company expanded its workforce last year.
examples.zh: 公司去年擴大了員工人數。

examples.en: A skilled workforce helps the factory meet orders.
examples.zh: 熟練的勞動力有助於工廠完成訂單。

examples.en: The report describes changes in the national workforce.
examples.zh: 這份報告說明全國勞動人口的變化。

explains.en: This noun means all the people who work for a company or in a country. A factory may have hundreds of workers. The group carries out the work.
A company’s employees may have different skills and ages. Managers plan jobs around those abilities. The term names the working people as a group.
A country’s working population includes people who are employed or seeking jobs. Reports may compare its size over time. The term can describe a company or a larger economy.

examples.en: The two athletes wrestled for the title.
examples.zh: 兩位運動員為了冠軍頭銜摔角競賽。

examples.en: She wrestled with a hard math problem.
examples.zh: 她努力思考一道困難的數學題。

examples.en: The puppies wrestled on the rug.
examples.zh: 小狗們在地毯上玩鬧扭打。

entries.definition: （動）摔角、搏鬥；努力處理困難問題；（名）摔角比賽。

explains.en: This verb can mean to fight by holding and pushing an opponent, often in a sport. Two athletes try to pin each other. Strength and skill both matter.
People may struggle with a difficult problem. They think hard and try different answers. The phrase describes an effort to understand or solve it.
Two friends may playfully grapple on the grass. The movement can be rough but friendly. Context shows a sport, a problem, or playful action.

examples.en: There was a wrinkle in the sleeve of his shirt.
examples.zh: 他的襯衫袖子上有一道皺褶。

examples.en: Her nose wrinkled at the sour smell.
examples.zh: 她聞到酸味時皺起了鼻子。

examples.en: A late delivery added a wrinkle to the plan.
examples.zh: 延遲送貨為計畫增添了一個小麻煩。

entries.definition: 皺紋；皺褶；使起皺；想出妙計。

explains.en: This noun is a small line or fold in skin or cloth. A shirt may have one after being packed. The line can often be smoothed out.
As a verb, it means to form small folds. A person may crease a sheet by sitting on it. Skin may also form lines with age.
A small complication in a plan is an unexpected difficulty. A delay may create a problem for the schedule. This figurative use describes a complication.

examples.en: She yearned to see her family again.
examples.zh: 她渴望再次見到家人。

examples.en: He yearned for a quiet home by the sea.
examples.zh: 他渴望在海邊擁有一個安靜的家。

examples.en: They yearned to return to their hometown.
examples.zh: 他們渴望回到家鄉。

explains.en: This verb means to want something very much, often over a long time. A child may long to see a faraway friend. The feeling can be strong and emotional.
Someone may long for a quieter life after years in a busy city. The person imagines a different way to live. The desire is deeper than a passing wish.
People may long to return to a place they remember fondly. They miss its people or familiar sights. The verb often expresses longing.

examples.en: Practicing morning yoga improves flexibility and reduces mental stress.
examples.zh: 練習晨間瑜伽能提升身體柔軟度並減輕心理壓力。

examples.en: Unroll your non-slip rubber yoga mat in a quiet, well-ventilated room.
examples.zh: 在安靜且通風良好的房間內攤開你的防滑橡膠瑜伽墊。

examples.en: Yoga breathing techniques help promote mindfulness and mental calm.
examples.zh: 瑜伽呼吸技巧有助於促進正念冥想與內心平靜。

explains.en: This is a practice that combines body positions, breathing, and attention. People may do it on a mat. Some use it to stretch and relax.
A class may guide people through slow poses and steady breaths. Some movements build balance and strength. Quiet attention is part of the practice.
People can follow a teacher or use a recorded lesson at home. They choose movements suited to their ability. The activity can support calm and flexibility.

examples.en: She added berries to her yogurt.
examples.zh: 她在優格裡加入莓果。

examples.en: The yogurt was creamy and slightly sour.
examples.zh: 這份優格口感滑順，帶點酸味。

examples.en: We used plain yogurt to make the dip.
examples.zh: 我們用原味優格製作沾醬。

explains.en: This is a soft food made when helpful bacteria change milk. It can taste plain or sweet. People often eat it for breakfast or a snack.
The food may be thick or thin, depending on how it is made. Fruit or honey can be mixed in. It can also be used in sauces and baking.
Some kinds contain live cultures. Cups are kept cold before serving. The food is made from milk, though plant-based versions also exist.

examples.en: The cyclist zoomed down the hill.
examples.zh: 騎自行車的人飛快地衝下山坡。

examples.en: Please zoom in on the map.
examples.zh: 請把地圖放大。

examples.en: The camera has a powerful zoom lens.
examples.zh: 這台相機配有強大的變焦鏡頭。

entries.definition: （動）快速移動、放大畫面；（名）鏡頭變焦或快速移動。

explains.en: As a verb, this means to move very quickly. A race car may rush past the stands. The motion is fast and sudden.
A camera can enlarge a distant object so it looks closer. The view becomes larger without the photographer walking nearer. The verb describes changing the view.
A camera lens may change its view from wide to close. The noun can name this change or a lens that makes it possible. You can show a small detail without moving the camera.

examples.en: She ate an orange after lunch.
examples.zh: 她午餐後吃了一顆橘子。

examples.en: We need an umbrella because it is raining.
examples.zh: 因為正在下雨，我們需要一把雨傘。

examples.en: Carrying an umbrella is wise whenever overcast skies suggest an impending afternoon shower.
examples.zh: 每當密布的陰雲暗示即將落下午後雷陣雨時，隨身攜帶一把雨傘總是明智的。

entries.definition: 一個；一名；用於母音音素開頭單字前的不定冠詞。

explains.en: This short grammar word comes before one countable thing. It is useful when the listener does not know which thing you mean. Its form can change to match the first sound of the next word.
Use this word when you mean one item in general. One form comes before consonant sounds. Another form comes before vowel sounds.
This word can come before the name of one person, place, or object. It helps show that you mean one, but not one special thing. It is often used before jobs and things people can count.

examples.en: The lead actor gave an emotional and convincing performance.
examples.zh: 男主角帶來了極富感染力且令人信服的精湛演出。

examples.en: He auditioned for several roles before landing his breakthrough part as a dramatic actor.
examples.zh: 在獲得突破性的戲劇要角之前，他參加過許多角色的試鏡。

examples.en: Many renowned theater actors also teach masterclasses at acting academies.
examples.zh: 許多著名的劇場演員也在戲劇學院講授大師班課程。

explains.en: This is a person who plays a part in a movie or show. The person speaks or moves to help tell a story. The role can be funny, serious, or exciting.
A person with this job pretends to be someone in a story. The work may happen on a stage or in a film. The performer learns lines and actions.
This person helps bring a story to life for an audience. The work can be done for a play, movie, or television show. People watch the performer speak and move.

examples.en: After a fruitful discussion, both sides agreed to sign the cooperation agreement.
examples.zh: 經過卓有成效的討論後，雙方同意簽署合作協議。

examples.en: They reached a trade agreement after weeks of negotiation.
examples.zh: 經過數週談判後，他們達成了貿易協定。

examples.en: Everyone in the meeting was in agreement with the new proposal.
examples.zh: 會議上的每個人都一致贊同這項新提案。

examples.en: Sign the user agreement before creating a new software account.
examples.zh: 在建立新的軟體帳號前請先簽署使用者條款協議。

examples.en: Leading semiconductor fabs signed a twenty-year corporate power purchase agreement for offshore wind output.
examples.zh: 晶圓製造大廠與離岸風電開發商簽署了為期二十年的長約企業購售電合約。

examples.en: Negotiating a long-term power purchase agreement guarantees fixed electricity prices for the data center.
examples.zh: 透過談判簽署二十年期長期企業購售電合約（CPPA），能為跨國資料中心鎖定長期可預期的電力成本。

examples.en: Institutional banks approve billion-dollar wind loans only after seeing a signed corporate purchase agreement.
examples.zh: 國際聯貸銀行團唯有在查驗審核具有高信評企業簽署的長期購電合約後，方始核准數百億元的專案融資。

entries.definition: 同意；贊同；協定；協議；一致；企業綠電採購長期購售電合約 (CPPA)

explains.en: It means sharing the same idea or saying yes to a plan. People may choose one plan together. It can also name a promise or plan they accept.
This word can show that people have the same view. It can also name a deal made between people. They may write down the details.
Use it when someone accepts an idea or choice. A written plan can set out what people have accepted. People may talk until they share one view.

examples.en: It takes about three hours by plane from Taipei to Tokyo.
examples.zh: 從台北搭飛機到東京大約需要三個小時。

examples.en: The craftsman adjusts his wooden hand plane to shave paper-thin translucent ribbons of cedar.
examples.zh: 木匠屏氣凝神細心微調手作木工刨刀，輕輕一推便刨出薄如蟬翼、半透明的優美木花。

examples.en: We booked our flight on an eco-friendly modern passenger plane powered by efficient turbofan engines.
examples.zh: 我們預訂了一架由高效渦輪風扇發動機驅動的現代環保型噴射客機機票飛往海外。

examples.en: The mathematician drew two intersecting geometric lines across an infinite two-dimensional plane.
examples.zh: 數學家在黑板上的二維無垠平面上，用粉筆畫出了兩條相互垂直相交的幾何直線。

entries.definition: 飛機；手工木工推刨刨刀；刨平

explains.en: This is a large machine that carries people through the sky. It has wings and an engine. It can take travelers to far places.
People ride inside this flying machine to reach another city or country. Its wings help it stay in the air. A pilot guides it.
This kind of transport travels above the ground. It can carry many passengers across long distances. The crew helps guide the trip.

examples.en: The train leaves at 7:30 a.m.
examples.zh: 火車在上午七點半出發。

examples.en: We have music class at 10 a.m. on Monday.
examples.zh: 我們星期一上午十點有音樂課。

examples.en: The shop opens at 8:00 a.m.
examples.zh: 商店上午八點開始營業。

explains.en: This short time label shows that the clock time is after midnight and before noon. It is used with numbers on a clock. It helps tell morning hours apart from later hours.
It marks an hour during the first part of the day. A clock number can come before it. People use it when writing down an early meeting or trip.
This label tells the reader that a time comes before midday. It may appear in a schedule or on a clock. It makes the time of day clear.

examples.en: Does anyone know the opening hours of the museum?
examples.zh: 有人知道這家博物館的開放時間嗎？

examples.en: Is anyone interested in joining the weekend hiking trip to Yangmingshan?
examples.zh: 有人有興趣參加週末去陽明山的健行活動嗎？

examples.en: If anyone calls for me, please tell them I will return after three.
examples.zh: 如果有人打電話找我，請轉告他們我三點後會回來。

explains.en: It means one person, but the person is not named. A visitor may leave a note without giving a name. The listener knows that a person is involved.
Use this word when talking about an unknown person. It can point to one person in a question or statement. It does not tell who the person is.
This word refers to a person whose name is not known. It may describe someone in a group. It can also be used when asking whether a person is there.

examples.en: Remember to lock your bike when you park it outside.
examples.zh: 將腳踏車停在室外時記得上鎖。

examples.en: Always remember to strap your safety helmet securely before riding your mountain bike.
examples.zh: 在騎乘你的登山腳踏車之前，務必記得將安全帽繫緊扣好。

examples.en: She pedaled her vintage city bike along the tree-lined avenue toward the central market.
examples.zh: 她沿著綠樹成蔭的大道踩著她的復古城市腳踏車前往中央市集。

explains.en: This is a vehicle with two wheels and pedals. A rider pushes the pedals to move it. It can be used for travel or exercise.
People sit on this two-wheeled machine and move the pedals with their feet. It has a handlebar for steering. Many children learn to ride one.
This word names a light vehicle powered by a rider’s legs. It has two wheels and a seat. People use it on roads and paths.

examples.en: You should see a doctor if your fever continues.
examples.zh: 如果你發燒持續，應該去看醫生。

examples.en: The doctor examined the patient's throat and prescribed medicine.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查了病人的喉嚨並開立處方藥。

examples.en: My elder sister wants to become an eye doctor.
examples.zh: 我的姊姊想成為一名眼科醫生。

explains.en: This is a person trained to help sick or injured people. The person may work in a hospital or clinic. The title can also mean someone with a high degree.
People visit this health worker when they are ill. The worker can examine them and suggest care. At a university, the same title may follow someone’s name.
This word names a trained health professional. The person helps find and treat illness. It can also be a title for someone who has earned an advanced degree.

examples.en: We really enjoyed our trip to Kenting.
examples.zh: 我們非常享受去墾丁的旅行。

examples.en: Did you enjoy reading that fantasy mystery book?
examples.zh: 你喜歡閱讀那本奇幻懸疑小說嗎？

examples.en: Please enjoy yourselves at the evening welcome party!
examples.zh: 今晚的迎新派對請大家盡情玩得開心！

explains.en: It means feeling happy while doing something. People may like music, food, or a game. The noun form names that good feeling.
Use this word when someone likes an activity or thing. A person may feel glad during a visit. The related noun means pleasure.
This verb means taking pleasure in an activity. It can describe a good meal or a fun day. The noun names the feeling of pleasure.

examples.en: Good morning, everyone! Let's begin our English lesson.
examples.zh: 大家早安！我們開始上英文課吧。

examples.en: Everyone deserves equal opportunities to learn and achieve their goals.
examples.zh: 每個人都應享有平等學習與實現目標的機會。

examples.en: In Taiwan, almost everyone is familiar with the taste of bubble tea.
examples.zh: 在台灣，幾乎每個人都熟悉珍珠奶茶的滋味。

explains.en: It means all the people in a group. No person is left out. It can describe a crowd or a whole family.
Use this word when talking about all people together. A teacher may ask the full group to listen. It does not name one person in particular.
This word refers to all people in a place or group. It can stand alone as the subject of a sentence. It means no person is left out.

examples.en: The gardener wore gloves to protect her hands.
examples.zh: 園丁戴著手套保護雙手。

examples.en: Please put on your gloves before going outside.
examples.zh: 出門前請戴上手套。

examples.en: These gloves are warm and soft.
examples.zh: 這副手套溫暖又柔軟。

explains.en: These are coverings worn on the hands. They keep the hands warm or safe. Some kinds are used for sports or cleaning.
A pair of these covers protects fingers and palms. They may be made of wool, leather, or rubber. Workers wear them to keep their hands safe.
This word names hand coverings. They may keep fingers warm in winter. A builder may wear them to avoid scratches.

examples.en: Mazu is revered as the compassionate goddess of the sea.
examples.zh: 媽祖被尊崇為慈悲護佑眾生的海上女神。

examples.en: In Greek mythology, Athena was venerated as the goddess of wisdom and strategic war.
examples.zh: 在希臘神話中，雅典娜被尊奉為掌管智慧與軍事策略的女神。

examples.en: Fisherman offer prayers and thanksgiving whenever they return safely to the goddess's shrine.
examples.zh: 漁民每次平安返港靠岸，總會向女神的神龕敬獻虔誠的祈禱與感恩。

explains.en: This is a powerful being worshipped in some religions. Stories may describe such a being with special powers. A female one may have a different name.
People may pray to this being. Many stories tell of a male or female one. Beliefs differ across cultures.
This word names a being that some people believe made or rules the world. Myths may tell stories about such beings. Different faiths describe them in different ways.

examples.en: He is my English teacher.
examples.zh: 他是我的英文老師。

examples.en: He plays soccer every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 他每個星期六早上都踢足球。

examples.en: He always helps his mother with the housework.
examples.zh: 他總是幫媽媽做家事。

examples.en: He learned computer programming all by himself.
examples.zh: 他完全靠自學學會了電腦程式設計。

examples.en: He looked at himself in the mirror and adjusted his necktie.
examples.zh: 他看著鏡子裡的自己並整理好領帶。

examples.en: The grandfather built a charming wooden birdhouse for his garden himself.
examples.zh: 爺爺親手為他的花園建造了一座精巧迷人的木製鳥屋。

explains.en: This pronoun points to a boy or man already named. Other forms show that the person receives an action or owns something. One form can also point back to that person.
Use this pronoun when speaking about a male person. Its forms may act as a subject, object, or possessive word. A reflexive form points back to the same person.
This word group refers to a male person. One form can take the place of a name in a sentence. Other forms show ownership or receive an action.

examples.en: I am a high school student in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 我是台灣的高中生。

examples.en: I enjoy reading books on rainy days.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在下雨天看書。

examples.en: Can I ask you a quick question?
examples.zh: 我可以問你一個簡短的問題嗎？

examples.en: I cooked a bowl of beef noodle soup for myself.
examples.zh: 我為自己煮了一碗牛肉麵。

examples.en: I promised myself to read at least one chapter every evening.
examples.zh: 我向自己保證每晚至少要讀完一個章節。

examples.en: I built this wooden bookshelf all by myself over the weekend.
examples.zh: 我利用週末完全靠自己親手打造了這個木製書架。

explains.en: This pronoun points to the person speaking. It often begins a sentence about that speaker. Other forms show ownership or receive an action.
Use this pronoun when the speaker talks about themselves. Its forms change when the person owns something or is the object. It is written with a capital letter.
This word group refers to the speaker. One form acts as the subject of a sentence. Other forms show possession or point back to the same person.

examples.en: It is a sunny day today.
examples.zh: 今天是個大晴天。

examples.en: I found my lost key; it was under the sofa.
examples.zh: 我找到遺失的鑰匙了，它在沙發下面。

examples.en: It takes only ten minutes to walk there.
examples.zh: 走路到那裡只要十分鐘。

examples.en: The smart robot vacuum cleaner charges itself automatically.
examples.zh: 這台智慧掃地機器人會自動幫自己充電。

examples.en: History often repeats itself if societies fail to learn from past errors.
examples.zh: 如果社會未能從昔日錯誤中吸取教訓，歷史往往會重蹈覆轍。

examples.en: The majestic antique mansion is an architectural masterpiece in itself.
examples.zh: 這座宏偉的古典宅邸本身就是一座令人讚嘆的建築傑作。

explains.en: This pronoun refers to a thing, animal, or idea already named. Another form shows ownership. A reflexive form points back to the same noun.
Use this pronoun when talking about a non-human subject. Other forms change when showing ownership. One form can point back to that subject.
This word group may refer to an object or animal. One form acts as a subject or object. Other forms show possession or self-reference.

examples.zh: 這台智慧掃地機器人會自動幫自己充電。

examples.zh: 如果社會未能從昔日錯誤中吸取教訓，歷史往往會重蹈覆轍。

examples.zh: 這座宏偉的古典宅邸本身就是一座令人讚嘆的建築傑作。

examples.en: Practice makes math problems much easier.
examples.zh: 多加練習會讓數學題目容易得多。

examples.en: We will have a comprehensive math quiz covering fractions next Monday.
examples.zh: 我們下週一將舉行涵蓋分數單元的數學綜合測驗。

examples.en: Learning math strengthens your problem-solving and critical thinking abilities.
examples.zh: 學習數學能強化你解決問題與批判性思維的能力。

explains.en: This is the study of numbers, shapes, and patterns. Students may add, subtract, or solve problems. It helps people measure and plan.
People use this school subject to work with amounts. It includes shapes and equations. Builders use it to measure materials.
This word names the study of numbers and space. It can help answer practical questions. Students may use it to solve puzzles.

examples.en: The movement of the dancers was smooth.
examples.zh: 舞者們的動作很流暢。

examples.en: The story has a movement from sadness to hope.
examples.zh: 故事從悲傷轉向希望。

examples.en: The synchronized movement of the rowing crew propelled the slender racing boat swiftly across the water.
examples.zh: 划船隊員整齊劃一的動作驅使纖細的賽艇在水面上風馳電掣般前進。

entries.definition: （名）動作；移動；社會或政治運動。

explains.en: It means changing place or position. It can also name a change in a story or dance. A person may shift a chair across a room.
Use this word when someone changes where they are. A dancer may make one step or turn. The noun can mean a change in position.
This verb means going from one place to another. The noun may name one action in a game or story. A person can shift an object too.

examples.en: The Golden Horse Film Festival celebrates exceptional Mandarin cinema.
examples.zh: 金馬影展表揚傑出的華語電影作品。

examples.en: Vintage photography enthusiasts love shooting street scenes on 35mm film.
examples.zh: 復古底片攝影愛好者熱愛用 35mm 膠卷拍攝街頭風光。

examples.en: A thin oily film floated on the surface of the harbor water.
examples.zh: 一層薄薄的油漬薄膜漂浮在港灣水面上。

explains.en: This is a story shown on a screen. People watch moving pictures and hear sound. It may make them laugh or feel sad.
A theater shows this kind of entertainment. It often has actors and a story. People may watch one at home.
This word names a moving-picture story. It can be shown on television or a large screen. People may call it a picture show.

examples.en: Mr. Lin is our new math teacher.
examples.zh: 林先生是我們的新數學老師。

examples.en: Mr. Brown will give a speech in the auditorium tomorrow.
examples.zh: 布朗先生明天將在禮堂發表演講。

examples.en: Excuse me, is Mr. Wang in his office right now?
examples.zh: 請問王先生現在在辦公室嗎？

explains.en: This title is placed before a man’s name. People use it to speak politely. It does not tell whether he is married.
Use this respectful title before a male person’s family name. It may be written with a dot. A teacher or customer may be addressed this way.
This word is a polite title for a man. It comes before his name in writing. The title can be used for married or unmarried men.

examples.en: She said nope and smiled.
examples.zh: 她說不，然後笑了。

examples.en: Did anyone forget their umbrella in the hallway? Nope, everybody packed theirs.
examples.zh: 有人把雨傘忘在走廊上嗎？沒有喔，大家都收好自己的了。

examples.en: When asked if he wanted broccoli on his pizza, the toddler laughed and answered, Nope!
examples.zh: 當被問到披薩上要不要加青花菜時，小幼童笑著回答：才不要！

entries.definition: 不；沒有；口語的否定回答。

explains.en: This is a short reply that refuses or disagrees. It can answer a question about permission. The tone may sound firm or gentle.
Use this response when someone does not agree. It may also say that something is absent. A person can say it politely.
This word is a negative answer. It can refuse an offer or deny a fact. A head shake may go with it.

examples.en: Everything will be okay; just relax.
examples.zh: 一切都會沒事的，放輕鬆就好。

examples.en: Is it okay if I borrow your English dictionary for a few minutes?
examples.zh: 我可以借用你的英語字典幾分鐘嗎？

examples.en: The doctor confirmed that the patient is doing okay after surgery.
examples.zh: 醫生確認病人在手術後狀況良好穩定。

explains.en: This short reply shows agreement or approval. It can mean that something is acceptable. People may use it in casual speech.
Use this expression to say that a plan is acceptable. It may answer a question about permission. It can also describe something in good condition.
This word group means all is well. It can agree with a suggestion. It may be used as an adjective or a reply.

examples.en: My parents support my dream.
examples.zh: 我的父母支持我的夢想。

examples.en: Both of her parents are high school teachers.
examples.zh: 她的雙親都是高中老師。

examples.en: Supportive parents play an indispensable role in shaping their children's emotional resilience.
examples.zh: 給予支持與陪伴的父母在塑造孩子的情感心理韌性方面扮演不可或缺的角色。

entries.definition: 雙親之一；父母親（常用複數）

explains.en: A mother or father has this role in a family. This person cares for a child. Two people with this role are a child’s mother and father.
This word describes an adult who raises a child. The person may teach, feed, and protect the young one. A child can have one or two people in this role.
A child depends on this grown person for care. The person may help with school work. The word often refers to both the mother and father together.

examples.en: You can pay with mobile payment apps here.
examples.zh: 你可以在這裡使用行動支付應用程式付款。

examples.en: You will receive an electronic confirmation receipt right after completing your payment.
examples.zh: 完成付款後，您將立即收到一份電子確認收據。

examples.en: Many modern convenience stores in Taiwan support convenient mobile contactless payment.
examples.zh: 台灣許多現代便利商店都支援便捷的行動感應式支付。

explains.en: It means giving money for something. A worker gets money for doing a job. The money itself can also be called this.
Use this word when buying food at a shop. A company may send money to a worker each month. It can also mean the amount a worker receives.
A person may give coins or a card to a seller. A worker receives money for a job. The word can name that action or the money received.

examples.en: Let's take a group photo together!
examples.zh: 我們大家一起拍張大合照吧！

examples.en: She framed the vacation photo and hung it on her bedroom wall.
examples.zh: 她把度假照片裝裱起來掛在臥室牆上。

examples.en: Modern smartphones can take stunning high-resolution photos in low light.
examples.zh: 現代智慧型手機在微光環境下也能拍出令人驚豔的高畫質照片。

explains.en: This is an image made with a camera. People may keep one to remember a trip. The short form is often used in casual speech.
A camera can make a picture of a person or place. A family may put one in a frame. The shorter word is common in daily talk.
This word means a picture made by taking a camera shot. It can show a face or scene. People often share one with friends.

examples.en: The train leaves at 7 p.m.
examples.zh: 火車在晚上七點離開。

examples.en: The store closes at 9 p.m.
examples.zh: 商店晚上九點打烊。

examples.en: Our movie starts at 8:30 p.m.
examples.zh: 我們的電影在晚上八點半開始。

entries.definition: （副）下午或晚上；中午至午夜之間

explains.en: This short form tells the time from noon until midnight. It is often written after a clock time. It helps show which half of the day is meant.
A clock may show a time in the evening. This mark after the digits tells that it is after noon. It is often used in schedules.
A person can use these letters to show an evening time. They follow the hour and minute digits. The mark helps separate day from night.

examples.en: She lives in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她住在台北。

examples.en: She wants to be a doctor in the future.
examples.zh: 她未來想成為一名醫生。

examples.en: She speaks English very fluently.
examples.zh: 她的英語說得非常流利。

examples.en: She made a beautiful beaded bracelet for herself.
examples.zh: 她為自己做了一條漂亮的串珠手鍊。

examples.en: She taught herself how to play acoustic guitar through online video tutorials.
examples.zh: 她透過線上影片教學自學學會了彈奏木吉他。

examples.en: She took great pride in herself after passing the advanced certification exam.
examples.zh: 在通過高階檢定考試後，她為自己感到無比驕傲與自豪。

A girl may be spoken about with this pronoun. It takes the place of a female name in a sentence. The form for something owned by that person is different.
This pronoun points to a female person. It may be used after a verb or before something owned. A speaker uses it to avoid saying a name again.

examples.en: Please take off your shoes before entering the house.
examples.zh: 進屋前請脫鞋。

examples.en: I need a pair of supportive running shoes for track practice.
examples.zh: 田徑練習時我需要一雙支撐良好的跑步鞋。

examples.en: Make sure your shoes are tied tightly before the race.
examples.zh: 比賽前請確保你的鞋帶已繫緊。

explains.en: People wear these over their feet outside. A pair often has a sole and laces. They help keep feet clean and safe.
A runner ties these before a race. They can be made from leather or cloth. A person usually wears one on each foot.
This footwear protects the feet. Some pairs are made for sports. A store may sell many colors and styles.

examples.en: Someone left their umbrella at the classroom door.
examples.zh: 有人把雨傘遺忘在教室門口了。

examples.en: There is someone waiting for you at the front reception desk.
examples.zh: 在前台接待處有人正在等候你。

examples.en: It feels comforting when someone genuinely listens to your worries.
examples.zh: 當有人真誠傾聽你的煩惱時，感覺十分令人寬慰。

explains.en: This word means a person whose name is not known. A teacher may call for a volunteer. It can refer to an unknown human.
Use this word when the person is not named. A friend may have left a gift. The speaker does not know who did it.
This word points to one human, though the speaker does not say who. A voice may come from another room. The person is not known.

examples.en: Let's call a taxi because it's raining heavily.
examples.zh: 下大雨了，我們叫計程車吧。

examples.en: Yellow taxis can be flagged down easily on the street.
examples.zh: 黃色計程車在街上很容易隨招隨停。

examples.en: The taxi driver was very friendly and recommended great local restaurants.
examples.zh: 計程車司機非常友善，還推薦了很棒的在地美食。

examples.en: We hailed a yellow taxi cab outside Taipei Main Station to take us to our hotel across town.
examples.zh: 我們在台北火車站前計程車招呼站搭上一輛小黃計程車，平穩前往位於市區另一端的飯店辦理入住。

examples.zh: 司機員端坐在符合人體工學的「列車駕駛室」（Cab）內，全神貫注審視三重備援的數位行車儀表。

examples.zh: 考試期間請關閉手機。

examples.en: I will give you a phone call as soon as I arrive at the station.
examples.zh: 我一抵達車站就會立刻打電話給你。

examples.en: The receptionist answered the phone with a polite greeting.
examples.zh: 櫃檯接待員以禮貌的問候語接聽了電話。

explains.en: People use this device to talk with someone far away. It can be kept in a pocket. A call may use a number.
A person can call a friend using this device. Older kinds stay on a desk. A newer kind can travel in a pocket.
This tool sends voices between people. It can use wires or a wireless signal. A family may keep one at home.

examples.en: Turn down the television; it is too loud.
examples.zh: 把電視聲音關小一點，太吵了。

examples.en: Watching English television shows with subtitles improves listening skills.
examples.zh: 觀看附中文字幕的英語電視節目有助於提升聽力。

examples.en: They bought a large sixty-five-inch smart television for the living room.
examples.zh: 他們為客廳添購了一台六十五吋的大型智慧電視。

explains.en: A screen shows moving pictures and sound. Families may watch a news program at home. It can also mean the business of making shows.
People sit on a couch and watch this device. A remote can change its channel. It may show films, sports, or news.
This screen brings pictures into a home. A person can watch shows on it. The short form uses two letters.

examples.en: They are playing basketball in the park.
examples.zh: 他們正在公園打籃球。

examples.en: They arrived at the station on time.
examples.zh: 他們準時抵達車站。

examples.en: They are planning a surprise party for Amy.
examples.zh: 他們正在為艾咪籌辦一場驚喜派對。

examples.en: The students cleaned the classroom by themselves.
examples.zh: 學生們自己把教室打掃乾淨了。

examples.en: Wild animals in national parks find food and shelter for themselves.
examples.zh: 國家公園裡的野生動物自行覓食並尋找棲息遮蔽之處。

examples.en: The runners pushed themselves to their physical limits during the final sprint.
examples.zh: 跑者們在最後衝刺階段竭盡全力挑戰自己的體能極限。

examples.zh: 孩子們整齊地將他們的書包與外套放進教室置物櫃裡。

examples.en: The swallows returned in spring to rebuild their cozy mud nest.
examples.zh: 燕子在春天歸來，重新築起牠們溫馨的泥巢。

examples.en: The doctor began treatment right away.
examples.zh: 醫生立刻開始治療。

examples.en: Her treatment helped the sore knee.
examples.zh: 她的治療改善了膝蓋痠痛。

examples.en: The treatment lasted for two weeks.
examples.zh: 治療持續了兩週。

entries.definition: （名）治療；待遇；處理方式；論述方式。

explains.en: It means caring for someone who is ill. A doctor may give medicine. It can also mean handling a subject in a certain way.
A nurse may help a sick person get better. A clinic offers care. The word can also mean how someone acts toward another person.
This word can mean medical care. A hospital gives help for injuries. It may also mean handling a topic in speech or writing.

examples.en: We take the MRT to school every day.
examples.zh: 我們每天搭捷運上學。

examples.en: We are going to have a picnic this weekend.
examples.zh: 我們這個週末打算去野餐。

examples.en: We should protect the environment together.
examples.zh: 我們應該一起保護環境。

examples.en: We prepared all the party decorations ourselves.
examples.zh: 我們自己動手準備了所有派對布置。

examples.en: We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves at the beach music festival last Saturday.
examples.zh: 我們上週六在海灘音樂節上玩得非常盡興開心。

examples.en: We must rely on ourselves to solve complex mathematical challenges.
examples.zh: 我們必須依靠自己的力量來解開複雜的數學難題。

examples.zh: 她答應了邀請。

examples.en: The answer is yes.
examples.zh: 答案是肯定的。

examples.en: He nodded yes when I asked.
examples.zh: 我詢問時他點頭表示同意。

entries.definition: （副）是、對；口語中表示肯定；（名）肯定的回答。

explains.en: It is a word used to agree. A person may answer a question this way. It can also show permission.
A child may say it after a parent asks a question. It means the answer is positive. A person can use it to accept an offer.
This short reply means agreement. A person may use it when asked if they are ready. It can also mean correct.

examples.en: Always believe in yourself and your unique capabilities.
examples.zh: 請始終相信你自己以及你獨一無二的才能。

examples.en: Don't forget to pack your English textbook before going to sleep.
examples.zh: 睡覺前別忘了把你的英文課本放進書包。

examples.en: Is this red water bottle on the dining table your sister's or yours?
examples.zh: 餐桌上這個紅色水壺是你妹妹的還是你的？

explains.en: This pronoun refers to the person being spoken to. It can be one person or a group. Related forms show ownership or receive an action.
A speaker may use this word while talking directly to a friend. It can replace a name. Other forms can point to something owned by that person.
This word points at a listener. It may be used as a subject or object. Different forms show belonging or refer back to the listener.

examples.en: Nice to meet you.
examples.zh: 很高興認識你。

examples.en: Where did you buy that beautiful notebook?
examples.zh: 你在哪裡買那本漂亮的筆記本的？

examples.en: You can join our study group anytime.
examples.zh: 你隨時都可以加入我們的讀書會。

examples.en: Help yourself to some fresh fruits and hot tea.
examples.zh: 請自便享用一些新鮮水果和熱茶。

examples.en: Always believe in yourself and your unique capabilities.
examples.zh: 請始終相信你自己以及你獨一無二的才能。

examples.en: Did you hurt yourself when you fell off the skateboard?
examples.zh: 你從滑板上摔下來時有傷到自己嗎？

examples.en: Make yourselves comfortable, dear guests.
examples.zh: 親愛的客人們，請各位隨意放輕鬆。

examples.en: Did you all enjoy yourselves at the amusement park today?
examples.zh: 你們大家今天在主題遊樂園玩得盡興開懷嗎？

examples.en: Please introduce yourselves briefly before we start the collaborative workshop.
examples.zh: 在我們展開合作工作坊之前，請大家簡短自我介紹。

examples.en: I cannot find my house keys anywhere.
examples.zh: 我在任何地方都找不到我的家門鑰匙。

examples.en: With reliable internet, digital nomads can work from anywhere in the world.
examples.zh: 有了穩定的網路，數位遊民可以在世界任何角落工作。

examples.en: You can park your shared bicycle anywhere inside the designated green zones.
examples.zh: 你可以將共享單車停放在指定綠色區域內的任何地點。

explains.en: It means at a place that is not named. A person may search for a quiet location. The exact spot is unknown.
A traveler may go to any place. A map can show many locations. This word does not say where exactly.
This word means in any location. A child may hide in one of many places. It can also describe movement to an unknown spot.

examples.en: The two friends quickly made up after a brief argument.
examples.zh: 兩位好友在短暫的爭執後很快就和好如初了。

examples.en: She constructed a compelling logical argument supporting green infrastructure investment.
examples.zh: 她建構出條理分明、極具說服力的邏輯論據，強力支持擴大投資綠色基礎建設。

examples.en: Engaging in angry personal arguments on social media forums wastes valuable mental energy.
examples.zh: 在社群媒體論壇上與陌生網友捲入情緒化的人身攻擊爭論，純屬浪費精神心力。

entries.definition: 爭吵；口角；爭辯；爭論；論點；辯論

explains.en: It means giving reasons for an idea. Two friends may disagree loudly. A person can explain a point.
A student may give reasons for an answer. People can have a disagreement. The word can also name a reason used to support an idea.
This action means speaking about different views. A person may try to prove a point. A loud disagreement can happen between friends.

examples.en: Please arrange the chairs in a circle.
examples.zh: 請把椅子排成一個圓圈。

examples.en: They arranged a meeting for Monday.
examples.zh: 他們安排星期一開會。

examples.en: She arranged the flowers in a vase.
examples.zh: 她把花插在花瓶裡。

entries.definition: 安排；布置；排列；協議；改編曲。

explains.en: It means putting things in order. A person may prepare chairs for a meeting. The word can also mean a plan between people.
A worker may place items neatly. Friends can agree on a date to meet. This word can mean an organized plan.
This action means putting things in a chosen order. A person may sort books on a shelf. It can also mean making plans for a meeting or trip.

examples.en: The child walked backwards toward the door.
examples.zh: 孩子倒退著走向門口。

examples.en: The coach demonstrated how to skate smoothly backwards across the ice rink without stumbling.
examples.zh: 教練示範了如何在滑冰場上流暢倒滑而不致踉蹌失足。

examples.en: Can you count backwards from twenty down to zero without hesitation?
examples.zh: 你能毫不猶豫地從二十倒數回零嗎？

explains.en: It means toward the back or in reverse. A person may take a step away. A car may move in this direction.
A child can lean toward the rear. A vehicle may go in reverse. This word can describe looking to the past.
This word means moving toward the back. A person may walk in reverse. It can also describe something done earlier.

examples.en: We met at a cafe after work.
examples.zh: 下班後我們在咖啡館碰面。

examples.en: The cafe serves tea and cakes.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡館供應茶和蛋糕。

examples.en: She read a book at the cafe.
examples.zh: 她在咖啡館看書。

explains.en: People sit here to drink coffee or eat a snack. A worker may bring a cup to a table. It can have small tables.
This place sells hot drinks and light food. A person may meet a friend there. It can be found on a street.
A customer may order coffee in this small shop. A chair may sit beside a table. Some places also sell cakes.

examples.en: Taiwanese people use chopsticks to eat noodles.
examples.zh: 台灣人用筷子吃麵。

examples.en: Can you hold chopsticks properly when eating rice?
examples.zh: 你吃米飯時能拿好筷子嗎？

examples.en: Using reusable chopsticks helps protect the environment.
examples.zh: 使用環保筷有助於保護環境。

explains.en: These are two thin sticks used for eating. A person holds both in one hand. Moving their tips together helps lift food.
These eating tools are common in many Asian countries. They may be made from wood or metal. A pair can lift noodles from a bowl.
One stick usually stays fairly still in the hand. The other moves toward it. Food is held between the two tips.

examples.en: She saw a roach in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 她在廚房看到一隻蟑螂。

examples.en: The roach hid behind the cabinet.
examples.zh: 那隻蟑螂躲在櫥櫃後面。

examples.en: Thorough sanitation in restaurant kitchens ensures no invasive roach can ever find nourishment.
examples.zh: 餐廳廚房徹底的環境衛生清潔能確保侵入性蟑螂無處覓食。

entries.definition: （名）蟑螂；也可指魚類或香菸末端，依語境判斷。

explains.en: A small brown insect may live in a kitchen. It has long feelers and can move fast. People try to keep it away from food.
This insect hides in dark places. It has six legs and a hard back. It may come out at night.
A home may have this unwanted insect. It can fit into small cracks. Clean food areas help keep it away.

examples.en: Would you like a Coke?
examples.zh: 你想喝可樂嗎？

examples.en: A chilled bottle of classic Coke paired delightfully with our barbecue lunch.
examples.zh: 一瓶冰透的經典可口可樂與我們的戶外烤肉午餐搭配得相得益彰。

examples.en: Would you prefer a regular Coke or a refreshing lemon iced tea with your meal?
examples.zh: 用餐時你想要來杯原味可口可樂，還是清爽解膩的檸檬冰紅茶？

explains.en: A dark fizzy drink is sold in cans or bottles. It has a sweet taste. Ice can make it cold.
People may drink this soda with a meal. It has bubbles. A famous kind has a red label.
This sweet drink contains gas bubbles. A person may pour it into a glass. It can be caffeine-free or have caffeine.

examples.en: She likes funny comics in the paper.
examples.zh: 她喜歡報紙上的有趣漫畫。

examples.en: Every Sunday after breakfast, Ben immerses himself in funny Sunday newspaper comics.
examples.zh: 每週日早餐過後，Ben 都沉浸在週日報紙刊載的逗趣連環漫畫中。

examples.en: Illustrated comics can spark a lifelong passion for reading among elementary students.
examples.zh: 生動精彩的插圖漫畫能激發國小學童對於閱讀維持一生的濃厚熱情。

entries.definition: （名）漫畫；連環圖畫；（形）喜劇的；滑稽的

explains.en: A funny story told with pictures may appear in a book. A child may read one. Characters often speak in bubbles.
A magazine can have a funny drawing. A set of pictures may tell a story. A person may collect these books.
This kind of story uses drawings. It may have speech bubbles. A superhero can be a character.

examples.en: Congratulations on your new job!
examples.zh: 恭喜你找到新工作！

examples.en: We sent congratulations to the winners.
examples.zh: 我們向得獎者致上祝賀。

examples.en: Congratulations! You passed the test.
examples.zh: 恭喜你通過考試。

explains.en: People say these kind words after someone succeeds. A friend may get a new job. A family may celebrate.
A person may say “well done” after a win. The words show happiness for someone. They are often said at a party.
This expression shares joy about another person’s success. A student may pass an exam. Friends may cheer.

examples.en: Continuous professional development keeps workers competitive in the fast-evolving AI era.
examples.zh: 持續不斷的職場專業進修能確保職場工作者在日新月異的 AI 人工智慧時代長保競爭力。

examples.en: The HR department allocated a budget for staff leadership development retreats this fall.
examples.zh: 人資部門今年秋季編列了專門預算，籌辦主管群的領導力精進培訓營。

examples.en: Early childhood language development lays the groundwork for critical thinking later in life.
examples.zh: 幼兒時期的語言能力發展，為日後成年階段的批判性思考與邏輯表達奠定了堅實基礎。

entries.definition: 職場專業發展進修；發展

explains.en: It means growing or changing over time. A child may learn new skills. A town can become larger.
A person may improve through practice. A plant grows from a seed. This word can mean progress.
This action means becoming more advanced. A student may gain knowledge. A plan can grow over time.

examples.en: It is okay to disagree politely during discussions.
examples.zh: 討論時抱持不同意見並禮貌表達是沒關係的。

examples.en: They often disagree on politics but remain very close friends.
examples.zh: 他們在政治立場上經常意見相左，但依然是親密的好朋友。

examples.en: I respectfully disagree with the claim that technology replaces human empathy.
examples.zh: 對於科技會取代人類同理心的說法，我抱持不同的見解。

explains.en: This means having a different opinion. One child likes a plan. Another thinks a different plan would be better.
This can happen when two answers do not match. One report gives one result. A second report gives a different result.
The noun names a difference of opinion. People may discuss their views calmly. They do not have to become angry.

examples.en: She wore silver earrings to the party.
examples.zh: 她戴著銀耳環參加派對。

examples.en: The earrings were a gift from her mother.
examples.zh: 這對耳環是媽媽送的禮物。

examples.en: He bought a pair of gold earrings.
examples.zh: 他買了一對金耳環。

entries.definition: （名）耳環；戴在耳朵上作為裝飾的飾品。

explains.en: Small pieces of jewelry hang from the ear. A person may wear one on each side. They can be gold or silver.
A child may receive these as a gift. They can have stones or beads. A tiny hole in the ear may hold one.
These decorations are worn on ears. A pair often matches. They may swing when a person moves.

examples.en: She found employment at a local shop.
examples.zh: 她在當地商店找到工作。

examples.en: The newly established industrial park generated thousands of local employment opportunities.
examples.zh: 新設立的科學工業園區為當地創造了數千個就業工作機會。

examples.en: Career counselors assist graduates in finding fulfilling full-time employment matched to their talents.
examples.zh: 就業輔導顧問協助畢業生找到能發揮其天賦的充實正職工作。

explains.en: A business may give a person a job. The person works for money. The word can also mean using someone’s help.
A worker may get a job at a store. A company can hire new people. The word can mean work or a job.
This action gives someone paid work. A person may hire a cook. A worker can have steady work.

examples.en: A few words of encouragement can brighten someone's dark day.
examples.zh: 幾句鼓勵的話語就能點亮他人灰暗的一天。

examples.en: She drew great encouragement from her grandmother's inspiring life stories.
examples.zh: 她從外婆一生跌宕起伏但無比精彩的生命故事中汲取了莫大的勇氣與鼓舞。

examples.en: Applause and cheerful encouragement from the stadium fans propelled the runners forward.
examples.zh: 來自體育場看台上觀眾熱烈沸騰的掌聲與加油鼓勵，推動著跑者奮勇向前。

explains.en: It means helping someone feel brave. A teacher may praise a student. A friend can give hope.
A kind word can help a person try again. A parent may cheer a child. The word can mean giving support.
This action gives someone hope or confidence. A coach may help a team before a game. Praise can help a child learn.

examples.en: I studied hard for the exam.
examples.zh: 我為考試努力讀書。

examples.en: Preparing thorough study summaries helped Emily feel calm and confident before her biology exam.
examples.zh: 準備詳盡的複習摘要幫助 Emily 在生物考試前感到平靜且充滿自信。

examples.en: The teacher announced that our midterm math exam will cover fractions and decimals.
examples.zh: 老師宣布我們的期中數學考試範圍將涵蓋分數與小數。

explains.en: A school may give students questions to check what they know. A doctor can check a person’s health. The word can mean a test.
A student may take one before a class ends. A nurse may check blood. It measures knowledge or health.
This test can be written or done by a doctor. A person may study first. It helps check what someone knows.

examples.en: The excitement grew before the concert.
examples.zh: 演唱會前的興奮感越來越高。

examples.en: The festive music in the town square stirred immense excitement among the gathered crowds.
examples.zh: 城鎮廣場上的節慶樂聲在聚集的人群中激起無比熱烈的興奮情緒。

examples.en: Eyes sparkling with excitement, the twins unwrapped their birthday mystery boxes.
examples.zh: 雙胞胎雙眼閃爍著興奮的光芒，迫不及待地拆開他們的生日驚喜禮物盒。

explains.en: It means making someone feel eager or happy. A new game may bring joy. A person may feel a strong emotion.
A surprise can make a child very happy. A good story may create strong interest. This word can mean stirring feelings.
This verb means to cause a strong happy feeling. A fun trip may make a child eager to leave home. News of a surprise can make people jump up with joy.

examples.en: She brushed her brow with her hand.
examples.zh: 她用手輕撫眉毛。

examples.en: The marathon runner paused briefly at the hydration station to wipe sweat from his brow.
examples.zh: 馬拉松跑者在補水站稍作停留，擦去額頭上不斷滑落的汗珠。

examples.en: The artisan furrowed his brow in deep concentration while carving intricate wooden ornaments.
examples.zh: 工匠在雕刻繁複精巧的木質飾品時，專注深思地微微皺起了眉頭。

explains.en: Hair grows above each eye. A person may lift it to show surprise. It can be shaped with a brush.
This line of hair helps keep sweat from the eye. A person may color it. The smaller word can mean the same body part.
A face has one above each eye. It can move upward when someone is surprised. A person may trim it.

examples.en: A firewoman drove the truck.
examples.zh: 一位女消防員開著消防車。

examples.en: The courageous firewoman operated the high-pressure water hose during the emergency drill.
examples.zh: 英勇的女消防員在緊急防災演習中操作高壓消防水帶。

examples.en: Inspired by her mother, Lily dreams of becoming a certified firewoman in the future.
examples.zh: 受到母親的啟發，Lily 夢想將來也能成為一名合格的女消防員。

entries.definition: 女消防員；女性消防隊員。

explains.en: A person who puts out fires has this job. They wear special clothes and use a hose. They may rescue people.
This worker drives a large red vehicle. The job can include helping during a crash. Women and men can do it.
A fire station has people trained to stop flames. They may climb ladders. They help keep a town safe.

examples.en: Please forward this memo to all team members.
examples.zh: 請將這份備忘錄轉寄給全體團隊成員。

examples.en: Step forward when your name is called by the officer.
examples.zh: 當長官叫到你的名字時，請向前一步。

examples.en: We look forward to meeting your family this weekend.
examples.zh: 我們期待這週末與你的家人碰面。

explains.en: It means toward the front or ahead. A person may take a step onward. A letter can be sent to a new address.
A runner may move ahead. A person can send a message onward. This word can describe a direction.
This word means onward. A person may move toward the front. It can also mean passing a message to someone else.

examples.en: The school gym is open for basketball practice.
examples.zh: 學校體育館開放進行籃球練習。

examples.en: Many working professionals go to the gym to work out after office hours.
examples.zh: 許多上班族下班後會到健身房健身鍛鍊。

examples.en: The school graduation ceremony took place in the air-conditioned indoor gym.
examples.zh: 學校畢業典禮在附設空調的室內體育館舉行。

examples.en: Students play dodgeball inside the school gym on rainy days.
examples.zh: 雨天時學生在學校體育館內玩躲避球。

examples.en: He hits the fitness gym three times a week to lift weights and stay healthy.
examples.zh: 他每週去三次健身房重訓以保持身體健康。

examples.en: The membership fee for this 24-hour gym includes access to the sauna.
examples.zh: 這間二十四小時健身房的會費包含了三溫暖設施的使用權。

examples.en: Many office workers hit the local gym after work to lift weights and destress.
examples.zh: 許多上班族下班後習慣前往社區連鎖健身房重訓流汗、釋放整天的工作壓力。

examples.en: She signed up for an annual gym membership to access the swimming pool and sauna.
examples.zh: 她報名了一年的健身房會員，以便隨時使用游泳池和桑拿設施。

examples.en: The new gym downtown is equipped with top-of-the-line strength machines and free weights.
examples.zh: 市中心新開的健身房配備了最頂級的重量訓練器材和自由重量區。

entries.definition: 體育館；健身房；健身俱樂部

explains.en: Students play sports in a large indoor room. People lift weights at a health club. The short form is common.
A school may have a room with courts and exercise gear. A person can train there. The short name has one syllable.
This place is used for exercise or sports. It may have basketball hoops. People may go there to get fit.

examples.en: He ordered a beef burger and french fries.
examples.zh: 他點了一份牛肉漢堡和薯條。

examples.en: Dad prepared a succulent handmade beef burger sizzling over hot charcoal on the patio.
examples.zh: 爸爸在戶外庭院熱騰騰的炭火上準備了一個滋滋作響的多汁手工牛肉漢堡。

examples.en: Would you care for a grilled mushroom burger accompanied by seasoned baked potato wedges?
examples.zh: 你要不要試試烤蘑菇漢堡搭配特調香料烘烤薯瓣？

explains.en: A round bun holds meat, lettuce, and sauce. People often eat one with fries. A restaurant may sell it.
A cook may grill a meat patty. The food is placed inside bread. It can have cheese and tomato.
This sandwich has a cooked patty. It is often eaten with a bun. The short name is common.

examples.en: She played the heroine in the movie.
examples.zh: 她在電影中飾演女主角。

examples.en: Marie Curie remains an iconic scientific heroine whose pioneering discoveries changed medicine.
examples.zh: 居禮夫人始終是一位標誌性的科學女英雄，她的開創性發現改變了醫學。

examples.en: The intrepid heroine of the fantasy epic rallied the villagers to defend their ancestral valley.
examples.zh: 這部奇幻史詩中勇猛的女主角號召村民們共同保衛祖傳山谷。

entries.definition: （名）女英雄；故事中的女性主角

explains.en: A brave man or woman saves others. A story may have one who fights danger. A person can admire this character.
This person may protect a town. A woman with brave actions can have the female form of this word. Stories often have such people.
A person who does brave things can be called this. They may help others. The feminine form has a different ending.

examples.en: A hippo opened its huge mouth.
examples.zh: 一隻河馬張開大嘴。

examples.en: We watched the hippos at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在動物園看河馬。

examples.en: The playful young hippo splashed cooling river water over its back using its small flat ears.
examples.zh: 頑皮的小河馬用牠扁平的小耳朵將清涼的河水潑灑在自己的背上嬉戲。

explains.en: A very large animal has a wide mouth and short legs. It lives near rivers in Africa. It spends time in water.
This heavy animal may be found in a river. It has a large head and thick skin. It can run quickly on land.
A zoo may have this giant water animal. It eats grass. Its name has a shorter form.

examples.en: The charismatic podcast host interviewed a renowned movie director.
examples.zh: 魅力十足的播客主持人專訪了一位知名電影導演。

examples.en: Taipei was chosen to host the international technology convention next year.
examples.zh: 台北獲選為主辦明年國際科技盛會的東道主城市。

examples.en: The gracious party host ensured every guest had drinks and appetizers.
examples.zh: 熱情好客的派對主人確保每位賓客都有充足的飲品與開胃小點。

explains.en: A person who invites guests has this role. They may lead a TV program. A woman can use a different form.
A person may welcome people at a party. Someone can lead a radio show. The word can also mean a computer that serves a site.
This person greets guests and helps them. A TV show may have one presenter. A female form adds another ending.

examples.en: The new road is an improvement.
examples.zh: 這條新道路是一項改善。

examples.en: The teacher commended David on his remarkable improvement in English speaking fluency.
examples.zh: 老師讚許 David 在英語口說流暢度上的顯著進步。

examples.en: Installing solar panels on the community center roof marked a major energy improvement.
examples.zh: 在社區中心屋頂安裝太陽能板標誌著一項重大的能源改善成就。

explains.en: It means making something better. A student can practice reading. A person may fix a weak skill.
A plan may get better after feedback. A person can work on health. This word means making progress.
This action means changing for the better. A worker may learn a new skill. A product can be made better.

examples.en: I use the internet to search for school information.
examples.zh: 我使用網際網路來搜尋學校資訊。

examples.en: Fast and reliable internet access is essential for remote work.
examples.zh: 高速穩定的網路連線對遠端工作至關重要。

examples.en: You can browse recipes and watch cooking videos on the internet.
examples.zh: 你可以在網路上瀏覽食譜並觀看烹飪影片。

examples.en: High-speed fiber-optic internet is widely accessible across Taiwan.
examples.zh: 光纖寬頻高速網路在全台灣各地都非常普及。

examples.en: The internet revolutionized how humanity communicates and accesses information.
examples.zh: 網際網路徹底革新了人類溝通與獲取資訊的方式。

examples.en: Make sure not to share personal financial secrets over unsecured public internet networks.
examples.zh: 請確保切勿在未加密的不安全公共網路上透露個人財務機密。

examples.en: The future quantum internet will interconnect distributed quantum computers into a unified planetary cloud.
examples.zh: 未來的全球量子互聯網，將把分散在世界各地的量子電腦無縫串聯成行星級雲端算力。

examples.en: Quantum internet architectures will enable distributed quantum sensing networks of unprecedented sensitivity.
examples.zh: 全球量子互聯網基礎設施，將催生出靈敏度前所未見的跨洲分散式量子大地與天文觀測感測網絡。

examples.en: Connecting quantum processors via an optical quantum internet unlocks collaborative multi-node computing.
examples.zh: 透過光纖量子互聯網將分散各地的量子晶片即時互聯，能解鎖跨節點分散式量子協同運算的無限潛力。

entries.definition: 網際網路；網路；全球超安全量子互聯網通訊網絡

explains.en: People use this global network to find information. A computer or phone can connect to it. Websites are part of it.
A person may send messages over a worldwide network. People can shop and learn there. A phone needs a signal.
This network connects computers around the world. A person can read news or watch videos. It helps people communicate.

examples.en: The judge made a fair judgment.
examples.zh: 法官做出了公平的判斷。

examples.en: She used good judgment in the storm.
examples.zh: 她在暴風雨中做了明智的判斷。

examples.en: His judgment was based on the facts.
examples.zh: 他的判斷是根據事實做出的。

explains.en: It means an opinion made after thinking. A person can choose after looking at facts. A court may give one.
A person may make a choice about a plan. A teacher can check a student’s work. The word can also mean good sense.
This word names a choice or opinion. A judge may decide a case. A person can use good sense.

examples.en: Time management is crucial for exam preparation.
examples.zh: 時間管理對考試準備至關重要。

examples.en: The new hotel management improved customer service greatly.
examples.zh: 飯店的新管理團隊大幅提升了顧客服務。

examples.en: Stress management workshops are held every semester.
examples.zh: 每個學期都會舉辦壓力管理工作坊。

entries.definition: 管理；經營；設法做到；經營團隊

explains.en: It means guiding people or work. A person may lead a store. A team can plan how to use money.
A worker may keep a project on time. A person can find a way to finish a hard task. The word can mean leadership.
This action means leading or handling a task. A manager may guide a group. A person can find a way to succeed.

examples.en: The measurement showed the table was too short.
examples.zh: 測量結果顯示桌子太短。

examples.en: Take a measurement of the window.
examples.zh: 量一下窗戶的尺寸。

examples.en: The doctor checked his blood pressure measurement.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查他的血壓測量值。

explains.en: It means finding the size or amount of something. A person may use a ruler. The result can be written down.
A cook may check how much flour is needed. A tailor can find how long cloth is. This action means finding an amount.
This word can mean a size or amount. A ruler helps find length. A person may compare two things.

examples.en: We thanked the cop for keeping the park safe.
examples.zh: 我們感謝那名警察維護公園安全。

examples.en: A vigilant neighborhood cop helped pedestrians safely cross the busy four-way intersection.
examples.zh: 一位警覺性高的社區警察協助行人們安全通過繁忙的十字路口。

examples.en: The school invited a friendly local cop to present an informative lecture on bicycle road safety.
examples.zh: 學校邀請了一位友善的在地警官發表一場生動實用的腳踏車道路安全演講。

explains.en: This noun names a person whose job is to help enforce laws and protect people. Officers may patrol streets, respond to emergencies, and investigate crimes. The word has a male form in some older usage and a gender-neutral form in modern usage.
A person can ask an officer for help when lost in a busy place. Officers may direct traffic or help during a community event. Their work is connected with public safety.

“Police officer” is the common neutral term. A detective has a more specialized role in solving cases. The word may be shortened in casual conversation, but formal writing usually uses the full title.

examples.en: The princess wore a blue dress to the ceremony.
examples.zh: 公主在典禮上穿著藍色洋裝。

examples.en: The princess waved to the children from the balcony.
examples.zh: 公主在陽台上向孩子們揮手。

examples.en: The benevolent princess funded new academies so children across the realm could learn science.
examples.zh: 仁慈的公主資助興建了新學院，讓王國各地的孩童都能學習科學知識。

entries.definition: （名）公主；國王或女王的女兒，或王室女性成員。

explains.en: These family titles name the son or daughter of a king or queen. They may inherit a special role in a royal family. Stories often show them living in a palace.
A tale may tell how a young royal person helps a village. A real royal family may attend public events. The title can be used before a person’s name.
A royal family may include a young son or daughter who could later take a special role. Stories often show these children living in a palace. They may attend public events with their parents.

examples.en: The punishment was to clean the art tables.
examples.zh: 處罰是清理美術桌。

examples.en: Parents should choose a fair punishment for breaking the rule.
examples.zh: 父母應為違規行為選擇公平的處罰。

examples.en: Modern educational philosophy views restorative dialogue as far superior to retributive punishment.
examples.zh: 現代教育哲學認為修復式對話遠勝於單純報復性的處罰懲戒。

explains.en: This word means to make someone face a consequence for breaking a rule. It can also name the consequence itself. Adults may use fair consequences to teach children about choices.
A student who runs in the hall may lose a few minutes of playtime. A referee may send a player off after a serious rule break. The consequence should match the action.
The verb describes giving a consequence, while the noun names it. This consequence can sound severe, so people often talk about fair rules and results. The goal should be safety and learning.

examples.en: We traveled by railway to the coast.
examples.zh: 我們搭火車前往海岸。

examples.en: The scenic mountain railway carries travelers past towering cliffs and cascading waterfalls.
examples.zh: 風景優美的高山鐵路載著旅客穿過高聳峭壁與飛瀑流泉。

examples.en: Workers inspected the railway tracks thoroughly before authorizing morning trains to run.
examples.zh: 工人們在核准晨間列車行駛前，徹底檢查了鐵軌狀態。

entries.definition: （名）鐵路；鐵道系統；鐵路公司或路線

explains.en: These words name a track system used by trains and the companies or routes connected with it. One spelling is more common in American English, and the other is more common in British English. Trains carry people and goods along the tracks.
A passenger may ride between two cities on a train. Freight trains move supplies from factories to stores. Both use long tracks that connect places.
The spellings differ by region but refer to the same general system. A subway is an urban train network, often underground. The words can also refer to the track itself.

examples.en: Keep the milk in the refrigerator so it stays fresh.
examples.zh: 把牛奶放進冰箱以保持新鮮。

examples.en: She posted our weekly class timetable on the door of the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 她把我們每週的課表貼在冰箱門上。

examples.en: Put leftover soup into a sealed container before placing it in the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 將吃剩的湯放入密封保鮮盒後再放進冰箱保存。

explains.en: This large kitchen appliance keeps food cold. It usually has shelves and a door that opens and closes. Cold storage helps food stay fresh longer.
A family puts milk and fruit inside after shopping. Ice trays can freeze water in a small compartment. The appliance uses electricity to stay cool.
A freezer makes food much colder and keeps it frozen. This machine keeps most food cold but not solid. People often use a shorter name in casual speech.

examples.en: Fluent English communication is an essential job requirement.
examples.zh: 流利的英語溝通能力是一項必要的基本職務要求。

examples.en: Fulfilling ninety credit hours is a mandatory academic requirement for graduation.
examples.zh: 修畢取得九十個學分，是這所大學取得學士學位必備的核心修業規章要求。

examples.en: Wearing non-slip shoes and ear protection is a strict factory safety requirement.
examples.zh: 進入廠區工作時穿戴防滑安全鞋與抗噪防護耳罩，是一項不可妥協的工安強制規定。

explains.en: This verb means to need something or make it necessary. A rule may say what people must do. The noun names something that is needed.
A school trip may need a signed form. A game may need two teams before it can begin. These things must be ready first.
Something needed can be a rule, condition, or item. People should check instructions carefully. It is stronger than a wish because it must be done.

examples.en: A salesman helped Dad choose a new lamp.
examples.zh: 一名男銷售員幫爸爸挑了一盞新燈。

examples.en: The traveling salesman drove across three counties each week to supply local pharmacies.
examples.zh: 這位外勤業務員每週驅車穿梭三個郡縣，為各地藥局補貨。

examples.en: An honest car salesman clearly explained the maintenance history of the used vehicle.
examples.zh: 那位誠實的汽車業務員清楚說明了該輛二手車的保養歷史。

explains.en: This noun names someone whose job is helping customers choose and buy things. They may work in a store or contact people about a service. The word has several gender forms.
A man may help a customer choose a coat. A customer can ask about sizes, colors, or prices. Helpful workers answer questions before a purchase.
A cashier takes payment, while this worker may help people choose an item. The gender-neutral form is common. The role may involve products or services.

examples.en: The saleswoman answered my question about the shoes.
examples.zh: 那位女銷售員回答了我關於鞋子的問題。

examples.en: The boutique saleswoman helped my mother pick out a flattering evening dress.
examples.zh: 精品店的女店員熱心協助我母親挑選了一件得體的晚禮服。

examples.en: As a top-tier saleswoman, she met all of her annual revenue goals ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 作為一名頂尖的女性業務員，她提前達成了所有的年度業績目標。

entries.definition: （名）女銷售員、女店員；負責銷售商品或服務的女性。

explains.en: This noun names someone whose job is helping customers choose and buy things. They may work in a store or contact people about a service. The word has several gender forms.
A man may help a customer choose a coat. A customer can ask about sizes, colors, or prices. Helpful workers answer questions before a purchase.
A cashier takes payment, while this worker may help people choose an item. The gender-neutral form is common. The role may involve products or services.

examples.en: They settled the argument by taking turns.
examples.zh: 他們輪流使用，平息了爭吵。

examples.en: The family settled in a small town.
examples.zh: 這家人在一個小鎮定居下來。

examples.en: We paid the bill to settle the account.
examples.zh: 我們付清帳單以結清帳款。

entries.definition: 定居點；和解；結算；殖民地。

explains.en: This verb can mean to calm a disagreement or decide where to live. It can also mean paying money that is owed. The noun names an agreement or a place where people live.
Two friends may talk and agree after an argument. A family may move to a new town and build a home. Both make a situation stable.
People can pay a bill to close an account. A small community can also have this name. Nearby details explain the meaning.

examples.en: Grandpa put on his slippers before walking to the kitchen.
examples.zh: 爺爺穿上室內拖鞋後才走去廚房。

examples.en: Her warm slippers have little yellow stars on them.
examples.zh: 她那雙溫暖的室內拖鞋上有小黃星星。

examples.en: Please leave your slippers beside the front door.
examples.zh: 請把室內拖鞋放在前門旁邊。

entries.definition: （名）室內拖鞋；柔軟方便穿脫的鞋

explains.en: These soft indoor shoes cover the feet and are easy to put on. People often wear them at home instead of outdoor shoes. They keep feet cozy.
A pair may have cloth, felt, or a soft sole underneath. Some have an open back, while others cover the heel completely. They are handy after a bath or shower.
They are useful on a cool floor, but they are not made for running outside. Their soles may not grip rough streets well. A thick sole can protect feet from cold floors.

examples.en: Wear thick socks to keep your feet warm.
examples.zh: 穿厚襪子能讓雙腳保持保暖。

examples.en: I bought three pairs of white cotton socks at the department store.
examples.zh: 我在百貨公司買了三雙白色純棉襪。

examples.en: He couldn't find a matching pair of clean socks this morning.
examples.zh: 他今天早上找不到一雙配對整齊的乾淨襪子。

explains.en: This soft piece of clothing covers a foot inside a shoe. It helps keep the foot warm and can soak up sweat during a busy day. It can also protect the foot from rubbing inside a shoe.
People usually wear one on each foot. A pair may match in color, or each piece may have a fun picture or stripe. Washing them after use keeps them fresh.
Different lengths cover different parts of the leg. A thick pair may suit cold weather, while a thin pair fits inside dress shoes. Bright colors make it easy to tell pairs apart.

examples.en: Review your monthly bank statement carefully to detect any unfamiliar charges.
examples.zh: 仔細核對每月的銀行對帳單，以即時發現任何不明扣款。

examples.en: The Prime Minister issued an official public statement regarding the summit.
examples.zh: 首相針對雙邊高峰會談的圓滿共識發表了正式的公開官方聲明。

examples.en: Her bold, colorful artwork makes a dramatic aesthetic statement in the modern gallery.
examples.zh: 她色彩大膽濃烈的原創畫作在現代畫廊中散發出極具震撼力的美學主張。

examples.en: A bold turquoise necklace served as the vibrant statement piece of her outfit.
examples.zh: 一條造型誇張大膽的綠松石復古鎖骨鏈成為她整套素雅黑色洋裝中最奪目吸睛的視覺焦點。

examples.en: Wearing statement earrings instantly draws attention to your face and brightens simple tops.
examples.zh: 戴上一副造型搶眼的焦點大耳環能瞬間將視覺重心引向臉龐，點亮素色上衣。

examples.en: The fashion house issued a public statement clarifying its new cruelty-free material standards.
examples.zh: 這家知名時尚奢侈品牌發表了一份公開聲明，闡明其全面採用零殘忍環保面料的新規範。

entries.definition: 銀行對帳單；結算單；聲明；吸睛焦點的；聲明陳述

explains.en: To say something clearly, a person gives information in direct words. A witness may tell what they saw without adding guesses. The listener can ask follow-up questions afterward.
A written record can list money that came into an account and money that went out. A bank sends one to help customers review their spending. Customers can spot fees by reading each line.
A person can make a firm public announcement about an idea or plan. The words should be easy for others to understand. A clear announcement helps a group prepare.

examples.en: The underground train was busy during the morning rush.
examples.zh: 早晨尖峰時段，地鐵裡很擁擠。

examples.en: Commuters in London rely on the underground transit network during rush hour.
examples.zh: 倫敦的通勤族在尖峰時段仰賴地下鐵交通網路。

examples.en: Rabbits dig complex underground burrows to shelter their young from natural predators.
examples.zh: 兔子挖掘複雜的地下洞穴，以保護幼兔免受天敵侵害。

entries.definition: （名）地下鐵；地下組織；地下場所

explains.en: An electric train carries people beneath busy city streets. Riders enter at stations. It can help them avoid traffic above ground.
The train follows rails through tunnels. Maps show the stops. Passengers should stand behind the safety line.
Different cities use different names for this transport system. Tickets may work for several routes. Signs help visitors find the right platform.

examples.en: A metro map helped us find the art gallery.
examples.zh: 地鐵路線圖幫我們找到了美術館。

examples.en: The Kaohsiung Metro makes visiting the harbor pier both fast and comfortable.
examples.zh: 高雄捷運讓前往港灣碼頭的行程既迅速又舒適。

examples.en: Passengers waited patiently on the metro platform behind the designated safety line.
examples.zh: 乘客們在捷運月台黃色安全線後方耐心等候列車進站。

entries.definition: （名）地鐵；城市地下或專用軌道的快速大眾運輸系統。

explains.en: An electric train carries people beneath busy city streets. Riders enter at stations. It can help them avoid traffic above ground.
The train follows rails through tunnels. Maps show the stops. Passengers should stand behind the safety line.
Different cities use different names for this transport system. Tickets may work for several routes. Signs help visitors find the right platform.

examples.en: The children ran excitedly toward the playground swing.
examples.zh: 小朋友們興奮地朝著遊樂場鞦韆跑去。

examples.en: He has always maintained a positive, open-minded attitude toward learning new skills.
examples.zh: 他對於學習新技能始終抱持著積極開放的心態。

examples.en: Donations from the charity concert will go toward funding local children's healthcare.
examples.zh: 這場慈善音樂會的所有捐款將全數用於資助當地兒童的醫療照護。

examples.en: The tourists walked toward the Taipei 101 observatory entrance.
examples.zh: 遊客們朝著台北 101 觀景台入口走去。

examples.en: Taking twenty daily vocabulary quizzes is an encouraging step toward English mastery.
examples.zh: 每天堅持完成二十題單字測驗，是朝向精通英語目標邁出的踏實一步。

examples.en: She always maintains a gentle and compassionate attitude toward stray animals.
examples.zh: 對待街頭流浪受苦的弱小動物，她始終抱持著溫柔體貼與憐憫的關懷態度。

explains.en: Movement in the direction of a place can be shown with this preposition. The dog ran in its owner’s direction. The owner held out a hand.
It can show a route without saying someone arrived. A child walked closer to the gate. Then the bell rang.
The word can also describe a feeling or attitude. Kind actions for others help a classroom feel welcoming. A thoughtful gesture can build trust.

examples.en: The waiter brought a glass of lemon water to our table.
examples.zh: 男服務生為我們桌端上了一杯檸檬水。

examples.en: We gave the attentive waiter a generous tip for outstanding dining service.
examples.zh: 我們給了這位體貼周到的服務生一筆豐厚的小費，以酬謝他卓越的用餐服務。

examples.en: The waiter recited tonight's chef's special recommendations with enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 服務生熱情洋溢地向大家娓娓道來今晚主廚精心特製的招牌私房菜。

explains.en: A person who serves meals at a restaurant takes orders and brings food to tables. They may answer questions about dishes. Good service is polite.
The worker checks that guests have what they need. A family may ask for extra napkins. They can call the server with a friendly wave.
Restaurants have many jobs behind the scenes too. Cooks prepare meals. The dining room worker carries them safely to guests.

examples.en: We walked through the woods and listened to birds.
examples.zh: 我們穿過樹林，聆聽鳥鳴。

examples.en: Autumn painted the quiet woods in vibrant shades of gold and amber.
examples.zh: 秋天將寧靜的樹林染上了充滿生機的金黃與琥珀色彩。

examples.en: The scouts pitched their tents at a clearing deep inside the woods.
examples.zh: 童軍們將帳篷搭建在樹林深處的一處林間空地。

explains.en: Hard material from a tree trunk is used to make furniture or paper. A carpenter can cut it into boards. Different kinds have different colors.
A group of trees growing close together can form a small forest. Birds build nests there. People walk along marked paths.
The material needs protection from rain and insects. Paint or varnish can help. Builders choose the right kind for each job.

examples.en: Mastering seven thousand carefully curated words is an extraordinary academic and personal achievement.
examples.zh: 完整精熟這七千個精心挑選的實用單字，是一項無比非凡、值得銘記一生的「卓越個人成就」（Achievement）。

examples.en: Winning the prestigious international design award was the crowning achievement of her creative career.
examples.zh: 斬獲享有盛譽的國際頂尖設計大獎，成為她長年創意設計生涯中最璀璨奪目的巔峰榮耀成就。

examples.en: Setting incremental micro-goals creates a continuous sense of accomplishment and genuine achievement.
examples.zh: 為自己設定按部就班的微型階段目標，能在前行路上持續收穫踏實的成就感與由衷的自信。

entries.definition: 完成 7,000 字全套挑戰之耀眼卓越學習成就；成就

explains.en: A person reaches a goal after effort and practice. Learning to play a song takes time. Each try helps build ability.
Completing a difficult task can make someone proud. A student may finish a science project. Family members can celebrate together.
Goals can be small or large. Reading every day is one helpful aim. Steady work brings progress.

examples.en: An eye-catching digital advertisement displayed on the building screen.
examples.zh: 大樓外牆巨型螢幕上播放著引人注目的數位廣告。

examples.en: Skipping YouTube video advertisements is a premium membership feature.
examples.zh: 免等待直接略過 YouTube 影片片頭插入廣告是付費會員的專屬功能。

examples.en: Classified advertisements in the back of the newspaper list apartments for rent.
examples.zh: 報紙後頁刊登的分類小廣告羅列了各區套房與公寓出租的最新資訊。

entries.definition: 刊登廣告；宣傳；打廣告；廣告（簡稱 ad）

explains.en: A message tells people about a product, service, or event. A poster may show a new book. It gives details about where to find it.
Companies share these messages on signs, websites, or television. Clear facts help customers make choices. People should think carefully before buying.
The short noun can also mean a brief promotional message. It may appear between programs. Some messages try to persuade viewers.
