examples.en: Companies advertise their newest gadgets on YouTube and Instagram.
examples.zh: 各家公司在 YouTube 與 Instagram 上為最新科技新品打廣告。

examples.en: The bakery will advertise its grand opening discount in the local paper.
examples.zh: 這家烘焙坊將在地方報刊與社群上限時刊登盛大開幕特惠折扣廣告。

examples.en: Organic food brands frequently advertise their farm-to-table natural ingredients.
examples.zh: 有機天然食品品牌經常大力宣傳其產地直送、無添加的新鮮食材特色。

examples.en: An eye-catching digital advertisement displayed on the building screen.
examples.zh: 大樓外牆巨型螢幕上播放著引人注目的數位廣告。

examples.en: Skipping YouTube video advertisements is a premium membership feature.
examples.zh: 免等待直接略過 YouTube 影片片頭插入廣告是付費會員的專屬功能。

examples.en: Classified advertisements in the back of the newspaper list apartments for rent.
examples.zh: 報紙後頁刊登的分類小廣告羅列了各區套房與公寓出租的最新資訊。

entries.definition: 刊登廣告；宣傳；打廣告；廣告（簡稱 ad）

explains.en: A message tells people about a product, service, or event. A poster may show a new book. It gives details about where to find it.
Companies share these messages on signs, websites, or television. Clear facts help customers make choices. People should think carefully before buying.
The short noun can also mean a brief promotional message. It may appear between programs. Some messages try to persuade viewers.

examples.en: Meet with your thesis advisor regularly to discuss experimental methodologies.
examples.zh: 定期與您的論文指導教授會面以討論實驗研究方法論。

examples.en: The foreign policy advisor briefed the president prior to the international summit.
examples.zh: 在跨國高峰會召開之前，外交政策資深顧問向總統進行了全面的機密簡報。

examples.en: A trusted financial advisor helps families plan retirement and minimize tax liabilities.
examples.zh: 值得信賴的專業理財顧問協助廣大家庭規劃退休金並合法達到節稅效益。

entries.definition: 指導教授；學術導師；顧問

explains.en: A person gives information to help someone make a choice. A school worker may explain which classes to take. Students can ask questions.
An expert can guide people through a difficult plan. They listen first. Then they share useful options.
The helper does not choose for someone else. They explain facts and possible results. The final decision belongs to the person asking.

examples.en: The children washed their hands after the game and ate lunch afterwards.
examples.zh: 孩子們比賽後洗手，接著吃午餐。

examples.en: Let us finish tidying our study desks now so we may play soccer outdoors afterwards.
examples.zh: 讓我們現在先把書桌收拾整齊，這樣待會兒就能到戶外盡情踢足球了。

examples.en: The guest lecturer cordially answered student inquiries during a tea reception held afterwards.
examples.zh: 客座講師在隨後舉行的茶會交流時段親切地回答了學生們提出的問題。

explains.en: This adverb means at a later time, following an event. The class finished a game. Then students put away the equipment.
A person may rest following a long walk. They drink water first. Their body can recover gradually.
It helps show the order of events. People eat dinner and clean the table later. Clear timing makes a story easier to follow.

examples.en: To my amazement, the tiny seed grew into a tall sunflower.
examples.zh: 令我驚訝的是，那顆小種子長成了高大的向日葵。

examples.en: The audience watched in utter amazement as the illusionist vanished into thin air on stage.
examples.zh: 全場觀眾無比驚奇地看著魔術師在舞台上憑空消失無蹤。

examples.en: To the young botanist's amazement, the rare night-blooming orchid opened its pristine petals.
examples.zh: 令年輕植物學家驚喜萬分的是，那株罕見的夜開蘭花緩緩展開了它潔白純淨的花瓣。

explains.en: Something can surprise people greatly and make them feel wonder. A tiny seed grows into a tall tree. Children watch it change.
A person may feel impressed by an unusual skill. A musician plays a fast tune. The audience listens closely.
An unexpected sight can make someone pause. A rainbow appears across the sky. Friends point and smile.

examples.en: The announcement about the new library made the students cheer.
examples.zh: 新圖書館的消息讓學生們歡呼起來。

examples.en: The railway conductor made an urgent announcement informing commuters of track signal repairs.
examples.zh: 鐵路列車長廣播發布緊急通告，告知通勤族鐵路號誌正在進行搶修。

examples.en: Students listened with rapt attention to the exciting announcement regarding the upcoming science fair.
examples.zh: 學生們全神貫注地聆聽著有關即將舉行的科學展覽競賽的振奮人心的公告。

explains.en: A person tells people important news in a clear way. A teacher shares the date of a school trip. Everyone can write it down.
A public message may come over a speaker or appear on a sign. Travelers hear when a train will arrive. Clear words prevent confusion.
The noun can mean the news that has been shared. A family may tell friends about a new baby. People send good wishes.

examples.en: Dad's auto needs new tires before the long trip.
examples.zh: 爸爸的車在長途旅行前需要換新輪胎。

examples.en: The national auto racing championship attracted thousands of enthusiastic motorsport fans.
examples.zh: 全國汽車拉力賽錦標賽吸引了成千上萬熱情澎湃的賽車運動迷。

examples.en: A hybrid auto seamlessly switches between gasoline and electric battery power to conserve energy.
examples.zh: 油電混合汽車能在汽油與電池電力間流暢切換以節省能源。

explains.en: A road vehicle with four wheels carries people from place to place. A driver steers it. Passengers wear seat belts for safety.
Families may use this vehicle for a long trip. They check the fuel and tires first. A map helps them choose a route.
Some models use electricity instead of gasoline. Others use a motor that burns fuel. All drivers must follow road rules.

examples.en: She placed the music disc in the player.
examples.zh: 她把音樂光碟放進播放機。

examples.en: My uncle owns an impressive archive of classic jazz vinyl disc albums.
examples.zh: 我叔叔收藏了令人印象深刻的經典爵士黑膠唱片黑膠盤專輯。

examples.en: The physical therapist explained that proper posture relieves excessive pressure on each spinal disc.
examples.zh: 物理治療師解釋維持正確體態能減輕施加在每一節脊椎椎間盤上的過度壓力。

explains.en: A flat round object can store computer files or music. It spins inside a device. Keep its surface free of scratches.
A wheel-shaped part in the body helps movement. It sits between bones in the back. Doctors can explain health concerns.
The two spellings are used for different objects and in different regions. Read the label. It shows what kind is meant.

examples.en: High audience engagement proves that the video resonated with viewers.
examples.zh: 高觀眾互動率證明了該影片引起了閱聽大眾的深刻共鳴。

examples.en: Replying to comments under your posts significantly boosts user engagement.
examples.zh: 在貼文底下回覆留言能顯著提升使用者的互動參與度。

examples.en: They happily announced their wedding engagement to close family members.
examples.zh: 他們滿心歡喜地向至親家人宣布了兩人訂婚的喜訊。

examples.en: Replying to community comments boosts social media algorithmic engagement scores.
examples.zh: 創作者親自逐一回覆粉絲留言互動能顯著拉升演算法對該篇貼文的社群互動率評分。

examples.en: The young couple happily celebrated their romantic engagement with close family and friends.
examples.zh: 這對年輕新人與摯愛親友聚在一塊，溫馨熱鬧地慶祝他們浪漫的訂婚喜訊。

examples.en: Teachers look for interactive lesson plans that stimulate active student engagement in class.
examples.zh: 教師們積極尋求具互動性的教學教案，以激發學生在課堂上的主動參與度與學習興致。

examples.en: Institutional investors use active shareholder engagement to urge boards to set science-based net-zero goals.
examples.zh: 大型退休基金等責任機構投資人透過「股東積極議合」（Engagement），敦促企業董事會訂定具約束力的淨零時程。

examples.en: The cheerful couple celebrated their romantic marriage engagement with family at an oceanfront restaurant.
examples.zh: 這對沉浸在幸福喜悅中的準新人與雙方親友齊聚在海景景觀餐廳，溫馨舉辦了甜蜜浪漫的訂婚慶祝家宴。

examples.en: Interactive classroom polling apps significantly increased student attention and active classroom engagement.
examples.zh: 在大學講堂中導入互動式即時手機投票問答軟體，極為顯著地提升了全場學生的專注力與課堂主動參與互動度。

entries.definition: 互動率；參與度；訂婚；社群互動率；約定；責任機構投資人股東氣候議合

explains.en: A person can take part in an activity or conversation. Students join a class discussion. Sharing ideas helps everyone learn.
A machine part can fit with another and work together. The pieces move as a pair. Proper fitting keeps the device running.
Two people may promise to marry in the future. They share the news with family. The ceremony can happen later.

examples.en: We need to stop at the service station to fill up on gas.
examples.zh: 我們需要停在休息站加油。

examples.en: Turn off the gas valve properly after cooking dinner.
examples.zh: 煮完晚餐後請務必將瓦斯閥門確實關緊。

examples.en: Natural gas is widely used for residential home heating.
examples.zh: 天然氣被廣泛應用於一般住宅供暖。

explains.en: A liquid fuel powers many cars and small engines. It is stored in a tank and must be handled carefully. Keep it away from flames.
In some places, people shorten the name of this fuel to a word that can also mean a substance in the air. Context helps readers tell the senses apart. The liquid belongs in a vehicle tank.
Electric cars use stored electrical power instead of this liquid. Small lawn machines may use it too. Adults should handle filling containers and follow safety rules.

examples.en: Humankind has explored many parts of the Earth.
examples.zh: 人類已探索地球上許多地方。

examples.en: Humankind depends on healthy forests and oceans.
examples.zh: 人類仰賴健康的森林與海洋。

examples.en: Safeguarding planetary biodiversity and pristine oceans remains the shared moral duty of all humankind.
examples.zh: 維護地球生物多樣性與原始蔚藍海洋是全人類共同肩負的崇高道德責任。

explains.en: All people considered together are described by this noun. It refers to humans across the world. Every person deserves respect.
The term can appear in stories about the future or the history of human beings. People build communities and share ideas. The exact wording may vary.
Animals are living beings too, but this word refers specifically to people. Humans live in many cultures and places. We have responsibilities toward one another and the planet.

examples.en: Please speak directly into the microphone so everyone can hear.
examples.zh: 請對著麥克風說話，以便大家都聽得清楚。

examples.en: The host adjusted the height of the podium microphone before speaking.
examples.zh: 主持人在發言前微調了講台麥克風的高度。

examples.en: Studio condenser microphones capture crystal-clear vocal recordings.
examples.zh: 錄音室等級的電容式麥克風能捕捉清澈透亮的純淨人聲。

examples.en: Miniature measurement microphones placed on toy-sized seats recorded sound pressure levels accurately.
examples.zh: 安裝在模型微型座椅上的「高靈敏度測量麥克風」（Microphones），精確記錄全場各頻段的聲壓分佈。

examples.en: The keynote speaker stepped up to the podium and adjusted the wireless microphone before beginning his speech.
examples.zh: 開場專題主講人穩健步上講台，在正式開講前將講台上的鵝頸式無線麥克風調整至最適合的高度。

examples.en: Professional podcast creators invest in dynamic studio microphones to ensure crisp and warm vocal broadcasts.
examples.zh: 專業優質播客創作者不惜重金添購錄音室等級動圈麥克風，確保播客音質清晰飽滿、溫潤純淨。

entries.definition: 麥克風；話筒；散佈於模型各座位之高靈敏度微型全向測量麥克風

explains.en: A device that picks up a person's voice and sends it to speakers or a recording system is called this. Singers use one on stage. It makes quiet sounds louder.
A reporter may hold one while asking questions. Some are small and clip to clothing. They help record clear speech.
A loudspeaker plays sound for listeners, while this device captures a voice. Both can be used at a concert. The two tools work in opposite directions.

examples.en: The new pavement made cycling easier.
examples.zh: 新鋪的路面讓騎腳踏車更輕鬆。

examples.en: Pigeons pecked at breadcrumbs scattered along the smooth stone pavement.
examples.zh: 鴿子啄食著散落在平整石板人行道上的麵包屑。

examples.en: City maintenance crews repaired deep cracks on the brick pavement after winter frosts.
examples.zh: 市府養護人員在冬霜過後修補了紅磚人行道上的深長裂縫。

entries.definition: （名）人行道；鋪設的路面；依英美用法而有不同。

explains.en: To cover a road or path with a hard surface is to do this. Workers may use stones or asphalt. A smooth road is easier to travel on.
It can also mean to prepare the way for something to happen. Careful planning can make success more likely. The use is figurative.
A dirt track is soft and uneven, while this verb describes making a firm path. The noun form names the surface. Context shows which form is needed.

examples.en: The postponement gave the team more time to practice.
examples.zh: 延期讓隊伍有更多時間練習。

examples.en: The unexpected postponement of the championship tournament gave the injured star time to heal.
examples.zh: 錦標賽的意外延期讓受傷的明星選手獲得了寶貴的康復時間。

examples.en: Torrential rain forced the postponement of the outdoor graduation ceremony until Saturday.
examples.zh: 暴雨迫使戶外畢業典禮延期至週六舉行。

explains.en: To move a planned event to a later time is to do this. Rain may cause a school trip to change dates. Organizers tell everyone the new plan.
Sometimes a person delays a task until later. Writing it on a calendar can help them remember. Waiting too long may cause trouble.
Cancel means the event will not happen, while this action means it will happen later. A new date should be shared. Reasons can include weather or illness.

examples.en: The landlord agreed to replace the worn-out living room sofa.
examples.zh: 房東同意更換客廳那張磨損老舊的沙發。

examples.en: Artificial intelligence will assist professionals rather than completely replace human empathy.
examples.zh: 人工智慧將扮演輔助專業人士的角色，而非完全取代人類的同理心。

examples.en: Remember to replace the smoke detector battery once every year.
examples.zh: 請記得每年定期更換一次火災煙霧偵測器的電池。

explains.en: To put something new where an old thing was is to do this. A person may put a fresh battery in a toy. The toy can work again.
A substitute can take the place of something else. If a player is tired, another may join the game. The group continues.
Repairing fixes the same item, while this action uses another one instead. A broken part may need changing. The noun form names the new item or act.

examples.en: Her savings helped pay for a new bicycle.
examples.zh: 她的存款幫助她買了一輛新腳踏車。

examples.en: He added ten dollars to his savings each month.
examples.zh: 他每個月存十美元。

examples.en: Prudent students deposit a fraction of their part-time earnings into high-yield savings accounts.
examples.zh: 精打細算的學生會將打工所得的一部分存入高收益儲蓄帳戶中。

explains.en: Money kept for future use is called this. A person may put a little aside each week. It can help pay for a larger goal.
The act of preventing waste is another meaning. Turning off lights is one way to use less electricity. Small actions can add up.
Spending uses money now, while keeping some for later can help with future needs. People may save for a toy or trip. A plan can make the goal easier.

examples.en: Precision digital kitchen scales ensure every gram of salt and yeast is measured accurately.
examples.zh: 一台精準至零點一公克的數位電子料理秤能確保每一克酵母與微量海鹽皆被精準無誤量取。

examples.en: The fish vendor placed the fresh salmon onto the hanging scales to determine its weight.
examples.zh: 魚販將新鮮鮭魚放在吊秤上以確定其重量。

examples.en: Iridescent emerald scales covered the serpent, glistening brightly under the morning sun.
examples.zh: 彩虹般光澤的翠綠鱗片覆蓋著這條蛇，在晨光下閃閃發亮。

entries.definition: 電子料理秤；刻度；磅秤；模型比例尺 (如 1/35 軍事坦克)；十分之一精準實體縮尺模型超音波充氮聲學測試；比例

explains.en: A set of marks or numbers used for measuring is called this. A map uses one to show how distances compare. It helps people understand size.
The word can also refer to a device that measures weight. A person may stand on it at a clinic. It shows a number.
A ruler measures length, while this tool may measure weight or compare distances on a map. The subject tells which kind is meant. Follow directions to read it correctly.

examples.en: Construction day laborers receive their wages at the end of each physical workday.
examples.zh: 營建工地的日薪作業勞工，通常在每日揮汗辛勤工作結束收工時現場領取工資。

examples.en: Fair living wages empower workers to support their households with dignity and security.
examples.zh: 具備尊嚴的合理維生工資，能賦予基層勞動者充足底氣，體面且安定地撫育整個家庭。

examples.en: Labour regulations guarantee that overtime wages must be paid promptly and accurately.
examples.zh: 勞動法規保障加班工資必須準時且正確無誤地發放給勞工。

explains.en: Money paid to workers for doing a job is called pay. A worker may receive it each week. The amount can depend on the work and time spent.
A person may earn money by working a set number of hours. A written agreement can state the rate. Keeping a record helps track each payment.
A person may earn money by working a set number of hours. A written agreement can state the rate. Keeping a record helps track payments.

examples.en: She worked hard to accomplish her reading goal.
examples.zh: 她努力達成閱讀目標。

examples.en: The team accomplished the task before lunch.
examples.zh: 團隊在午餐前完成了任務。

examples.en: He accomplished more by making a simple plan.
examples.zh: 他透過簡單的計畫完成了更多事情。

explains.en: To finish something successfully is to reach its goal. A class may complete a project after several weeks. Everyone can feel proud of the result.
A small goal can be reached by doing one step at a time. Practice helps people improve. Keeping a list shows what is finished.
A team may work together to solve a hard puzzle. Each person can share an idea. Their combined effort brings success.

examples.en: Please adjust the mirror before we drive.
examples.zh: 開車前請調整後照鏡。

examples.en: He adjusted the straps on his backpack.
examples.zh: 他調整了背包上的背帶。

examples.en: We adjusted our plans because the train was late.
examples.zh: 火車誤點，所以我們調整了計畫。

explains.en: To change something a little so it works or fits better is to fine-tune it. A chair can be moved higher for a tall person. Small changes can make it more comfortable.
A person may change a clock when traveling to another time zone. The new setting helps show local time. Instructions can explain how.
A mechanic may make a small change to a bicycle brake. Then it can stop more smoothly. Careful checks keep the bike safe.

examples.en: We found amusement in the board game on a rainy day.
examples.zh: 下雨天時，我們從桌上遊戲中找到了樂趣。

examples.en: Our weekend visit to the seaside amusement park was brimming with roller coaster thrills and laughter.
examples.zh: 我們週末參訪海濱遊樂園的行程充滿了雲霄飛車的驚險刺激與歡聲笑語。

examples.en: A twinkle of lighthearted amusement sparkled in grandfather's eyes as he shared childhood tales.
examples.zh: 祖父分享童年趣事時，雙眼閃爍著風趣幽默的愉快笑意。

explains.en: To make someone laugh or feel happy is to entertain that person. A funny story can bring a smile to a listener. A game can also give people a pleasant time.
The children watched a puppet show after lunch. The silly voices made them giggle. They talked about their favorite part on the way home.
A joke may make someone laugh for a moment. A hobby can keep a person happily busy for longer. People enjoy different things, such as music, puzzles, or sports.

examples.en: I made a dental appointment for Thursday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我預約了週四下午看牙醫。

examples.en: Please arrive ten minutes before your doctor's appointment.
examples.zh: 請在門診預約時間前十分鐘抵達。

examples.en: He had to cancel his morning appointment because of an urgent business flight.
examples.zh: 因為緊急的商務出差航班，他不得不取消了早上的預約。

explains.en: To choose someone for a job or duty is to give that person a role. A person can also arrange a time to meet someone. The surrounding sentence shows which meaning is intended.
The coach chose Sam to lead the warm-up. Sam accepted the duty and told the team what to do. Everyone knew who was in charge.
A scheduled visit has a set time and place. People write it on a calendar so they will remember. Calling ahead can help when a plan needs to change.

examples.en: Hand in your written research assignment by 5 PM this Friday.
examples.zh: 請在本週五下午五點前繳交書面研究作業。

examples.en: Taking an overseas work assignment in Tokyo broadened his global professional perspective.
examples.zh: 勇敢接受調派赴日本東京擔任外派主管的海外派任任務，大幅拓寬了他的國際職場格局。

examples.en: The math teacher gave students a challenging problem-solving assignment over the weekend.
examples.zh: 數學老師在週末放假前給全班同學出了一份極富挑戰性、需深度動腦思辨的專題作業。

entries.definition: 指派；分派（任務、職位）；指派作業；任務；分配

explains.en: A person in charge can give someone a duty or piece of work to do. The task may have a deadline and clear steps. Sharing duties helps a group work together.
The teacher gave each student one page to read. Ana wrote notes about her page and prepared to share them. The class put all the pages together for a report.
A duty is work someone is expected to complete. A school task can help students practice what they have learned. Asking questions is useful when directions are unclear.

examples.en: Please see the email attachment for the full conference schedule.
examples.zh: 完整會議議程請參閱電子郵件附件。

examples.en: Do not open email attachments from unknown senders.
examples.zh: 切勿開啟來自陌生寄件者的電子郵件附件。

examples.en: The baby developed a deep emotional attachment to her blanket.
examples.zh: 小嬰兒對她的小毛毯產生了深厚的情感依附。

entries.definition: 附加；貼上；繫上；電子郵件附件；依附

explains.en: To fasten one thing to another is to join them so they stay together. Tape, glue, or a clip can do the job. The right method depends on the materials.
Ella used a paper clip to keep two worksheets together. She placed them in her folder so they would not get lost. Later, she removed the clip easily.
A file sent with an email is an extra item that travels with the message. It may be a photo or a document. The receiver can open it if their device supports it.

examples.en: The groom wore a dark suit for the ceremony.
examples.zh: 新郎在儀式上穿著深色西裝。

examples.en: The handsome groom waited patiently at the altar, beaming with happiness as music played.
examples.zh: 英俊的新郎在聖壇前耐心等候，伴隨著樂聲洋溢著幸福的笑容。

examples.en: Volunteers at the rescue shelter regularly groom and brush rescued golden retrievers.
examples.zh: 救援收容所的志工定期為獲救的黃金獵犬進行梳洗與刷毛。

entries.definition: （名）新郎；馬伕；（動）梳理毛髮；打理；培養人才

explains.en: At a wedding, the man who is getting married is one of the two people being celebrated. He may stand beside his partner during the ceremony. Family and friends often join the celebration.
At the garden wedding, Daniel waited near the flowers while guests found their seats. He smiled when his partner walked down the path. They exchanged promises in front of their families.
A wedding celebrates two people joining their lives. Each partner may wear special clothes for the day. Traditions differ among families and cultures.

examples.en: Paris is the capital of France.
examples.zh: 巴黎是法國的首都。

examples.en: Begin each sentence with a capital letter.
examples.zh: 每個句子的開頭都要使用大寫字母。

examples.en: The company needs capital to open a second store.
examples.zh: 這家公司需要資金來開設第二間店。

explains.en: The main city of a region or country is often where its government meets. It may also be a large center for work and travel. People can find important offices there.
The class marked the country's main city on a map. They found the government building and a busy train station nearby. Many visitors traveled there each day.
A large letter is a large form used at the start of a sentence or for names. The word can also describe money or an economic system. Nearby words show the meaning.

examples.en: Finding contentment in simple pleasures brings enduring inner tranquility.
examples.zh: 在生活微小的單純美好中尋得由衷的知足，能帶來恆久安詳的內心寧靜。

examples.en: A life of genuine contentment is rarely achieved through material wealth alone.
examples.zh: 真正知足常樂的人生心境，絕非單純依靠累積物質財富便能輕易獲得。

examples.en: The retired artisan sat in his garden, a look of profound contentment on his face.
examples.zh: 退休的老工匠悠然坐在花園裡，臉上洋溢著無比知足平靜的神采。

explains.en: A calm feeling comes when someone is pleased with what they have. It does not require having everything they want. Enjoying a simple moment can bring peace.
After finishing her drawing, Mira sat by the window and watched the rain. She felt happy with her quiet afternoon. She did not need a new toy to enjoy herself.
Excitement can be loud and brief, while calm satisfaction may last quietly. People find happiness in different ways. Gratitude can help them notice what is good.

examples.en: The canceled picnic was a disappointment to the children.
examples.zh: 野餐取消讓孩子們很失望。

examples.en: Although missing first place brought initial disappointment, the runner was proud of his personal best.
examples.zh: 儘管錯失第一名帶來了最初的失落，這位跑者仍為刷新個人最佳成績感到驕傲。

examples.en: Missing the final train home was a bitter disappointment on an otherwise wonderful evening.
examples.zh: 錯過末班回家的火車為原本美好的夜晚帶來了一絲遺憾與失望。

explains.en: When something does not happen as hoped, a person may feel sad or let down. Plans can change for many reasons. Talking about the feeling can help.
Rae hoped to visit the zoo, but heavy rain closed it for the day. Her dad suggested looking at animal books at home. They planned another visit.
A happy surprise meets a hope, while an unwanted change can make someone sad. Feelings may pass with time. Making a new plan can help.

examples.en: Don't be discouraged by a single failed quiz; keep trying!
examples.zh: 不要因為一次隨堂測驗失利就感到沮喪，繼續努力！

examples.en: Steep import tariffs are designed to discourage the consumption of foreign luxury goods.
examples.zh: 高額的關稅壁壘旨在適度遏抑並打消國內消費者過度採購外國奢侈品的念頭。

examples.en: Rainy weekend forecasts did not discourage enthusiastic campers from pitching their tents.
examples.zh: 氣象預報顯示週末連綿陰雨，但絲毫未能打退熱情露營愛好者扎營的興致。

explains.en: Harsh words or a hard setback can make someone feel less hopeful about trying. Supportive words can help them continue. A person may need time to feel ready again.
After missing the goal, Ben wanted to stop playing soccer. His coach reminded him how much he had improved. Ben decided to practice one more week.
Encouragement helps someone believe they can try. A setback may weaken that belief for a while. Friends can offer help and patience.

examples.en: The spill caused embarrassment, but her friends helped clean it up.
examples.zh: 打翻飲料讓她很難為情，但朋友們幫忙清理。

examples.en: To spare his little brother any embarrassment, Kevin pretended not to notice the minor spelling error.
examples.zh: 為了避免讓小老弟感到尷尬，Kevin 假裝沒注意到那個微小的拼字錯誤。

examples.en: She felt a wave of fleeting embarrassment when her mobile phone rang during the concert prelude.
examples.zh: 當她的手機在音樂會序曲中響起時，她感到一陣短暫難耐的尷尬與難堪。

entries.definition: 尷尬；難堪；使人困窘的事。

explains.en: A person may feel uncomfortable when attention turns to a mistake or awkward moment. A kind response can help them feel better. Everyone has such moments sometimes.
Ava tripped on the way to the stage and dropped her notes. Her classmates helped pick them up without laughing. She took a breath and began her speech.
Feeling proud is pleasant, while feeling awkward can make someone blush. Being kind to others helps. A small mistake does not define a person.

examples.en: Enforcement of the park rules keeps visitors safe.
examples.zh: 執行公園規則能保障訪客安全。

examples.en: Rigorous enforcement of environmental protection statutes prevents industrial pollution in lakes.
examples.zh: 嚴格執行環境保護法規能有效防範工業廢水對湖泊造成污染。

examples.en: Community leaders commended the police department for fair and consistent traffic enforcement.
examples.zh: 社區領袖稱讚警察局在交通執法上維持公正與始終如一的原則。

entries.definition: （名）執行；實施；確保法律或規則被遵守

explains.en: To make sure people follow a rule is to require that it be obeyed. Fair reminders and clear consequences can help. Rules should be applied consistently.
The lifeguard asked swimmers to stay behind the rope near the deep water. She explained the safety reason and watched the area. Everyone followed the rule.
A suggestion is optional, while a rule must be followed. A fair system applies it to everyone. Clear reasons help people understand.

examples.en: The family planned an enlargement of the kitchen.
examples.zh: 這家人計畫擴建廚房。

examples.en: The museum commissioned an architectural enlargement to house its expanding sculpture collection.
examples.zh: 博物館委託進行建築擴建工程，以容納其日益增長的雕塑典藏品。

examples.en: A framed photographic enlargement of our mountain summit trek hangs in the living room.
examples.zh: 一張我們登山攻頂健行的高畫質放大裝框照片掛在客廳牆上。

explains.en: To make something bigger in size is to increase its dimensions. A picture can be printed larger, or a room can be expanded. The original shape may stay the same.
The class needed a larger map to see the small roads. The teacher copied it at a bigger size. The labels were easier to read.
A smaller copy takes up less space. A bigger version can show details more clearly. The purpose guides the choice.

examples.en: Browse hundreds of Hollywood blockbusters on the seatback in-flight entertainment screen.
examples.zh: 透過座椅後方的個人高畫質觸控機上娛樂系統，旅客可隨心點播數百部最新院線強片。

examples.en: The cruise ship offers live Broadway musicals, magic shows, and family entertainment.
examples.zh: 這艘豪華頂級國際郵輪每天在海上劇院上演精彩的百老匯歌舞劇、奇幻魔術秀等豐富娛樂節目。

examples.en: Children stayed cheerful throughout the ten-hour flight thanks to interactive game entertainment.
examples.zh: 多虧了機上娛樂系統內建的益智互動小遊戲，小朋友在長達十小時的飛行旅程中全程專注乖巧。

entries.definition: 機上個人娛樂系統 (IFE)；娛樂

explains.en: A show, game, or story can hold people's attention and help them enjoy their time. People may laugh, listen, or take part. Different audiences like different activities.
The magician performed simple tricks at the birthday party. The children watched closely and clapped after each one. They stayed cheerful all afternoon.
A lesson teaches facts, while a fun activity may help people relax. Some activities can do both. The purpose depends on the event.

examples.en: The team packed its equipment before leaving for the match.
examples.zh: 隊伍在出發去比賽前整理好裝備。

examples.en: The camping equipment was ready by the door.
examples.zh: 露營裝備已經準備好，放在門邊。

examples.en: Before embarking on the alpine glacier hike, double-check all specialized climbing equipment.
examples.zh: 在啟程踏上高山冰河健行之前，請務必再三複查所有專業登山裝備。

entries.definition: （名）設備、器材；為特定用途準備的一組工具或用品。

explains.en: Tools and supplies help someone do a particular job or activity. They may be simple, like a pencil, or larger, like a machine. Keeping them ready is useful.
Before the game, the players checked their balls, shoes, and water bottles. Each person brought what they needed. The coach inspected the field.
A plan tells what to do, while useful tools help carry it out. Different activities need different supplies. Careful storage keeps them in good shape.

examples.en: The establishment of the new club brought students together.
examples.zh: 新社團的成立讓學生們聚在一起。

examples.en: The historical plaque marks the official establishment of the elementary school in 1895.
examples.zh: 這座歷史紀念牌匾標註著該小學於1895年正式創立建校的里程碑。

examples.en: This neighborhood dining establishment has been serving hearty home-style soups for decades.
examples.zh: 這家社區餐飲店家數十年來一直供應著豐盛道地的家常熱湯。

entries.definition: 機構；企業；建立；既有體制。

explains.en: To start a group, business, or rule that will continue is to create it in an organized way. People may plan carefully before beginning. The work can take time.
Neighbors wanted a place to share books, so they gathered shelves and asked the town for a room. They opened a small reading center. More families began visiting.
An idea exists in someone's mind before it begins. Setting up a lasting group takes planning and helpers. Clear goals guide the start.

examples.en: Mentoring underprivileged students gives retired educators deep personal fulfillment.
examples.zh: 悉心指導偏鄉弱勢學童課業讓退休教師收穫了難以言喻的深層自我實現感。

examples.en: True happiness comes from pursuing meaningful goals that offer lasting fulfillment.
examples.zh: 真正的幸福源自於追尋能為人生帶來深邃持久滿足感與成就感的崇高目標。

examples.en: The prompt fulfillment of overseas customer orders is the logistics center's top priority.
examples.zh: 迅速且準確地履行交付海外客戶訂單，是該物流配送中心運作的首要任務。

examples.en: Robotic fulfillment centers process tens of thousands of online shopping parcels every hour.
examples.zh: 配備高度自動化機器人的大型電商物流履行中心（Fulfillment Center）每小時高效處理數萬件網購包裹。

examples.en: Fast order fulfillment has become a primary competitive battleground for modern e-commerce platforms.
examples.zh: 極速精準的訂單履行能力，已成為現代各大電商平台兵家必爭的核心競爭焦點。

examples.en: Outscoring warehouse fulfillment to a third-party partner allows boutique brands to focus on marketing.
examples.zh: 將倉儲理貨與包裝出貨外包給專業第三方物流履行業者，能讓新創設計品牌全力專注於產品行銷。

examples.en: Engaging in creative hobbies brings profound emotional fulfillment throughout one's golden retirement years.
examples.zh: 在悠閒的退休晚年歲月中投身繪畫與園藝等興趣愛好，能為心靈帶來深沉的圓滿與充實感。

examples.en: Dedicating personal time to mentoring underprivileged youth provided him with deep spiritual fulfillment.
examples.zh: 撥出寶貴的私人時間用心輔導弱勢偏鄉學童，為他的人生帶來了無比深刻的精神自我實現。

examples.en: Automated logistics centers ensure speedy order fulfillment within twelve hours of online checkout.
examples.zh: 智慧自動化物流調度中心確保所有線上電商訂單在顧客結帳後十二小時內迅速完成出貨配送。

entries.definition: 成就感；自我實現感；履行；電商倉儲物流履行；履行實現；圓滿無憾的金色黃金晚年；實現

explains.en: To do what was promised or needed is to complete a duty. A person can also reach a hope or goal. Careful steps help finish the task.
The class promised to collect books for the shelter. They gathered boxes from home and delivered them together. They were glad to keep their promise.
Starting a plan is only the first step. Finishing it means the duty has been completed. Reaching a personal hope may take time.

examples.en: He sent greetings to his cousins in another country.
examples.zh: 他向另一個國家的表親們問候。

examples.en: Students exchanged warm holiday greetings before departing for the winter break.
examples.zh: 學生們在出發放寒假前彼此互道溫馨的節日問候。

examples.en: The mayor extended formal greetings to visiting cultural ambassadors from abroad.
examples.zh: 市長向來自海外參訪的文化親善大使致上正式的熱烈問候。

explains.en: Friendly words or actions used when people meet show that someone notices them. A wave, smile, or hello can be used. Customs differ around the world.
When her aunt arrived, June waved and said hello at the door. Her aunt smiled and hugged her. They went inside together.
A goodbye is used when people leave. A welcome is used when they meet. Both can show care and politeness.

examples.en: Education is the best long-term investment in your future.
examples.zh: 教育是對自己未來最棒的長期投資。

examples.en: Buying real estate in prime city locations has historically been a safe investment.
examples.zh: 從歷史經驗來看，在市中心精華黃金地段置產向來是相當穩健的保值投資。

examples.en: Venture capital funds made substantial early investments in clean biotech ventures.
examples.zh: 創業投資基金在早期階段對數家潛力綠色生技新創企業進行了關鍵大額投資。

examples.en: Offshore wind projects attracted over one trillion NT dollars in foreign direct green infrastructure investment.
examples.zh: 離岸風電國家重大建設吸引了超過新台幣一兆元的龐大外國綠色基礎建設投資湧入台灣。

examples.en: Green bond issuances enable pension funds to direct long-term capital investment toward solar parks.
examples.zh: 官方與金融機構發行綠色永續債券，引導國家退休基金與長期民間壽險資本直接挹注重大光電風電建設計畫。

examples.en: Sustainable infrastructure investment creates high-quality engineering apprenticeships for young graduates.
examples.zh: 蓬勃發展的永續綠能基建投資，為在地大專理工科畢業生創造了數以萬計的高薪海事工程技師就業機會。

entries.definition: 投資；投入（時間、金錢）；投資項目；吸引數千億國際綠色基礎建設投資

explains.en: To put money, time, or effort into something for a future benefit is to make a careful choice. The result may take time. People should consider possible risks.
The family spent an afternoon planting fruit trees in their yard. They knew the trees would need care before producing fruit. They looked forward to future harvests.
Spending money now may bring value later, but success is not certain. People can also give time to learning a skill. Planning helps them decide.

examples.en: Her involvement in the garden club grew over time.
examples.zh: 她參與園藝社的程度隨時間增加。

examples.en: Active parental involvement in reading programs significantly boosts early childhood literacy.
examples.zh: 家長積極參與閱讀計畫能顯著提升幼兒的讀寫能力。

examples.en: Her long-standing involvement with the wildlife sanctuary helped protect numerous bird species.
examples.zh: 她長年對野生動物庇護所的投入參與，協助保護了無數鳥類物種。

explains.en: To include someone or something as part of an activity is to make it a participant. A task may also require several steps. The context shows which use fits.
The class play included every student, with some acting and others painting scenery. Each child had a role. The show felt like a group effort.
Watching from the seats is different from taking part on stage. A job may need tools or time as well. The sentence explains what is included.

examples.en: Put on safety goggles before conducting chemistry experiments in the lab.
examples.zh: 在實驗室進行化學實驗前請戴上護目鏡。

examples.en: Students must wear protective goggles whenever they enter the chemistry lab.
examples.zh: 學生進入化學實驗室時必須隨時配戴防護護目鏡。

examples.en: Technicians analyzed soil and water samples under high-power microscopes in the testing lab.
examples.zh: 技術員在檢驗實驗室的高倍顯微鏡下分析土壤與水質樣本。

explains.en: A room with tools and equipment is used for experiments or scientific study. People measure, observe, and record what happens. Safety rules are important there.
The students wore glasses while mixing safe liquids in the school science room. They wrote down the colors they saw. Their teacher watched closely.
A classroom may be used for many lessons. A special science room has tools for testing ideas. Careful notes help others repeat the work.

examples.en: The nurse measures the child's height each year.
examples.zh: 護士每年都會測量孩子的身高。

examples.en: The municipal government took swift measures to clear fallen branches after the storm.
examples.zh: 風災過後，市政府迅速採取各項應變措施以清除倒塌的樹枝。

examples.en: A tailor measures client shoulders carefully to ensure a perfectly fitted bespoke suit.
examples.zh: 裁縫師仔細量測顧客的肩寬，以確保量身定制的西裝完美合身。

entries.definition: （名）措施、方法；測量結果；也可指音樂小節。

explains.en: To find the size or amount of something, people compare it with units such as centimeters or liters. A ruler or cup can help. Careful reading gives accurate results.
Nico used a ruler to check how tall the plant had grown. He wrote the number in his notebook. Next week, he planned to check again.
Guessing gives an approximate idea. Using a tool gives a more exact amount. Different tools are made for different kinds of size.

examples.en: My father plans to retire at sixty-five and take up gardening.
examples.zh: 我父親計畫在六十五歲退休並開始投入園藝愛好。

examples.en: The veteran baseball pitcher decided to retire after eighteen stellar seasons.
examples.zh: 在征戰賽場整整十八個戰功彪炳的輝煌賽季後，這位傳奇老將投手正式決定引退。

examples.en: Building an emergency nest egg enables individuals to retire comfortably with peace of mind.
examples.zh: 及早規劃存妥一筆充足的應急養老金，能讓每個人在晚年無憂無慮、體面舒適地退休。

explains.en: The verb often means to stop working at a job after many years. A person may do this later in life. More time can then be spent on family or other interests.
The noun names the time of life after leaving regular work. Someone may travel, garden, or help in the community. People choose different ways to spend this period.
The verb can also mean to stop taking part in an activity. An injured player may leave a match before it ends. An old machine can also be taken out of service.

examples.en: One statistic showed that most students liked the new library.
examples.zh: 一項數據顯示，多數學生喜歡新的圖書館。

examples.en: The coach shared a statistic about the team’s wins.
examples.zh: 教練分享了球隊勝場的一項統計數據。

examples.en: This statistic compares rainfall in two towns.
examples.zh: 這項統計數字比較了兩個城鎮的降雨量。

explains.en: A number that describes facts about a group is used to study patterns. A class may count how many students ride the bus. The total helps explain the group.
People collect numbers from surveys or records. They may compare results from different years. Good records make the comparison clearer.
A number can tell only part of a story. Researchers should also ask how the information was collected. Careful checking helps avoid mistakes.

examples.en: She wore black stockings with her school uniform.
examples.zh: 她穿黑色長襪搭配校服。

examples.en: Warm wool stockings kept his legs cozy.
examples.zh: 保暖的羊毛襪讓他的雙腿很暖和。

examples.en: The dancer packed two pairs of stockings.
examples.zh: 舞者帶了兩雙長襪。

entries.definition: （名）長襪；通常覆蓋腿部的貼身襪

explains.en: These are long coverings for the legs and feet. They may be made from thin cloth or warm wool. People often wear them under a skirt or with a uniform.
A pair usually covers both legs up to the knees or higher. Elastic material helps each one stay in place. Different colors can match different clothes.
In cold weather, thick pairs help keep legs warm. Thin pairs may be worn for formal events. They should be washed after use.

examples.en: A wizard helped the young hero find the hidden path.
examples.zh: 一位男巫幫助年輕英雄找到隱藏的小徑。

examples.en: The children dressed as a witch and a wizard for the play.
examples.zh: 孩子們在戲劇中打扮成女巫和男巫。

examples.en: The mystical wizard carried an ancient wooden staff adorned with glowing runic crystals.
examples.zh: 神秘的巫師手持一根飾有發光盧恩符文水晶的古老木杖。

explains.en: This is a magical person in a story who may cast spells. The character can use a wand or a special book. Some stories show the character helping others.
A spell may change an object or create a surprising effect. The character learns special words or actions. Magic is make-believe in these tales.
Stories may include a good magic user or a frightening one. The character might live in a forest or a tall tower. Readers enjoy imagining a world with magic.

examples.en: The teacher acknowledged my answer with a smile.
examples.zh: 老師微笑著表示認可我的回答。

examples.en: She acknowledged receipt of the letter.
examples.zh: 她確認已收到那封信。

examples.en: He acknowledged that he had forgotten the book.
examples.zh: 他承認自己忘了帶書。

explains.en: This means to say that something is true or to show that you noticed it. A child may agree that a mistake happened. Honest words help solve the problem.
A person can show thanks for someone’s help. A kind note lets the helper know their work mattered. Small gestures can mean a lot.
A company may officially accept a report or request. The workers check it and respond. A clear reply lets the sender know it arrived.

examples.en: Conduct a thorough risk assessment before entering emerging markets.
examples.zh: 在進軍新興市場前，請務必進行全方位的風險評估。

examples.en: Formative classroom assessments help teachers identify which grammar topics require review.
examples.zh: 課堂形成性隨堂評量能有效協助授課教師精準診斷，究竟哪些核心文法章節亟待補強複習。

examples.en: The environmental impact assessment concluded that the solar farm posed minimal eco-threats.
examples.zh: 該項環境影響評估審查報告最終裁定，這座大型太陽能發電廠對周邊生態衝擊極其微小。

examples.en: Conducting a whole-building life cycle assessment (LCA) quantifies carbon impacts from raw extraction to demolition.
examples.zh: 進行嚴謹的全生命週期碳評估，精準計算建材從開採、建造到拆除的總碳排。

examples.en: Environmental engineers run detailed software assessments to choose materials with lower global warming potential.
examples.zh: 環境工程師藉由精密評估模擬軟體反覆試算，挑選出全球暖化潛勢最低的優質環保節能建材。

examples.en: The municipal carbon assessment determined that mass timber reduced the stadium's total emissions by 35%.
examples.zh: 市政專案全生命週期碳評估報告證實，改用工程木構讓這座大型體育館的全生命週期總碳排大減三成五。

entries.definition: 評估；核定；評定；評量；鑑定；全建築生命週期碳足跡評估 (LCA)

explains.en: This means to examine something and judge its quality, amount, or value. A teacher may look at a student’s work and offer feedback. Clear standards help make the judgment fair.
A worker may check how much a project costs. The numbers help a group plan its budget. Careful records prevent errors.
A person may look at a situation and decide what should happen next. They gather facts before making a choice. Asking questions can help.

examples.en: The magic trick astonished the children.
examples.zh: 魔術戲法讓孩子們驚訝不已。

examples.en: Her high score astonished her whole family.
examples.zh: 她的高分讓全家人都很驚訝。

examples.en: We were astonished to see snow in April.
examples.zh: 我們驚訝地看到四月下雪。

explains.en: This means to surprise someone greatly. A sudden visit from a dear friend may make a person smile. They did not expect it.
A surprising result can make people stare or ask questions. They may need time to understand what happened. New facts can change their view.
A person may react with wonder after seeing something unusual. A bright comet in the night sky can amaze a family. They may remember it for years.

examples.en: Taiwan's green building evaluation system assesses projects across nine strict ecological criteria.
examples.zh: 台灣 EEWH 綠建築評估制度依據生態、節能、減廢與健康等九大嚴格評估指標進行分級。

examples.en: Projects must fulfill mandatory criteria regarding greenery coverage and soil water retention before receiving permits.
examples.zh: 新建建案在取得建照前，必須在綠化量指標與基地保水指標等強制性評鑑基準上全數達標。

examples.en: The review committee evaluated the architectural blueprint against established low-carbon criteria.
examples.zh: 審查委員會依照政府最新公告的低碳永續建築指標，對投標建築規劃藍圖進行逐項嚴格審核。

entries.definition: 國際音樂廳噪音評定準則 (NC 噪音曲線等級)；準則；台灣 EEWH 綠建築九大指標評估基準

explains.en: This is a rule or measure used to judge whether something meets a need. A teacher may use clear rules to grade a project. Students know what to aim for.
A group may compare options using several important measures. One choice may be safer or cheaper. Writing them down helps.
A person can decide whether a tool is right for a job. They check its size, strength, and cost. The best choice fits the task.

examples.en: Celebrity endorsements instantly boost consumer trust in new sportswear.
examples.zh: 頂級運動明星的親身代言背機能瞬間引爆消費者對新機能運動服的信賴。

examples.en: The presidential candidate received a passionate public endorsement from former cabinet officials.
examples.zh: 這位總統候選人在造勢大會上，獲得了多位重量級前內閣政務官員的聯名公開力挺與背書支持。

examples.en: Misleading celebrity endorsements of fraudulent financial apps have led to stricter government penalties.
examples.zh: 明星網紅若為詐騙吸金金融 App 進行誤導性不實代言，將面臨主管機關前所未有的嚴格法律重罰。

entries.definition: 代言；公開支持；背書；推薦認同

explains.en: This means to publicly support or recommend a person, product, or idea. A teacher may say that a book is useful for learning. Readers can consider the recommendation.
A famous person may agree to appear in an advertisement. The audience recognizes them. Honest statements help people make choices.
A group may officially support a plan. Members explain why they think it will help. The public can learn their reasons.

examples.en: Journalists must uphold high professional ethics by refusing bribery and bribes.
examples.zh: 新聞從業人員必須恪守崇高的專業新聞倫理道德，嚴正拒絕任何形式的紅包賄賂。

examples.en: Business leaders who ignore business ethics risk destroying consumer confidence overnight.
examples.zh: 漠視商業道德的企業領袖可能會在一夜之間徹底摧毀消費者的信任。

examples.en: The Institutional Review Board (IRB) enforces strict human research ethics and patient safety protocols.
examples.zh: 醫院人體試驗倫理委員會（IRB）以極為嚴格的醫學倫理標準，全程監督臨床試驗並捍衛病患權益。

examples.en: Every clinical investigator must complete certified training in biomedical research ethics before recruiting subjects.
examples.zh: 每一位主持人體試驗的臨床醫師在正式招募第一位受試者前，均必須取得生物醫學研究倫理研習合格證書。

examples.en: Professional journalism ethics mandate verifying sources with three independent witnesses before publishing.
examples.zh: 專業新聞從業人員的崇高新聞倫理（Ethics），嚴格要求在頭條報導刊出前必須向三位獨立消息來源查證。

examples.en: The engineering curriculum requires all undergraduates to pass a course in professional engineering ethics.
examples.zh: 國立大學工學院明文規定，所有工程系學生在畢業前皆必須修習並通過專業工程師職業倫理必修學分。

entries.definition: 倫理道德；專業職業道德；臨床試驗倫理委員會 (IRB)；道德倫理；道德倫理學；職業道德準則

explains.en: These are beliefs about right and wrong behavior. A class may discuss why honesty matters. People can explain their reasons.
A job may have rules that guide fair and safe work. Workers follow them to protect others. Clear standards help.
People may face a hard choice about what is fair. They can consider who may be affected. Careful thought helps them decide.

examples.en: The coach changed tactics during the second half.
examples.zh: 教練在下半場改變了戰術。

examples.en: They used different tactics to solve the puzzle.
examples.zh: 他們用不同的方法解謎。

examples.en: The basketball coach devised innovative offensive tactics to outmaneuver the taller defending team.
examples.zh: 籃球教練設計了創新的進攻戰術，以克敵制勝身材更為高大的防守隊伍。

entries.definition: （名）策略；戰術；達成短期目標的方法

explains.en: This noun means a planned action used to reach a goal or gain an advantage. It may be used in a game, discussion, or business. A larger strategy can include several such actions.
A chess player moves a piece to draw an opponent away from a key square. The move has a clear purpose. It is one planned action in the game.
A salesperson may ask a customer questions to learn what they need. The method can help move a conversation forward. The noun describes a chosen way to act.

examples.en: The school will administer the reading test next week.
examples.zh: 學校下週將實施閱讀測驗。

examples.en: A nurse administered the medicine at noon.
examples.zh: 護理師在中午給予藥物。

examples.en: The office administers several community programs.
examples.zh: 辦公室負責管理幾項社區計畫。

explains.en: These verbs mean to manage or organize a system, activity, or office. One can also mean to give medicine or a test. One form is less common in everyday English.
A school office manages a new program and keeps its records. Staff plan the steps and check that it runs well. They run the program.
A nurse gives a dose of medicine according to instructions. In that use, the verb means to give a treatment. The words can also refer to managing a government or organization.

examples.en: She stayed calm amidst the noise.
examples.zh: 她在喧鬧中保持冷靜。

examples.en: A lone snowdrop flower bloomed bravely amidst the lingering patches of late winter frost.
examples.zh: 一朵孤單的雪花蓮在殘存的晚冬積霜寒氣中傲然綻放。

examples.en: The seasoned diplomat kept her calm composure amidst heated political negotiations.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的外交官在氣氛劍拔弩張的政治交涉談判中始終保持從容沉著。

entries.definition: （介系詞）在……之中、被……包圍；常用於較正式語境。

explains.en: These prepositions mean surrounded by or during something. One is a longer form with the same basic meaning. They are often followed by a noun phrase.
A small house stands among tall trees. The trees surround the house. It is in the middle of the forest.
A bell rings during a busy meeting. The sound happens while the activity is going on. The word can describe either place or time.

examples.en: The award recognized his academic attainment.
examples.zh: 這個獎項肯定了他的學業成就。

examples.en: Fluency in multiple languages is an admirable cultural attainment earned through persistence.
examples.zh: 流利掌握多種語言是透過持之以恆的努力所獲得令人欽佩的文化修養成就。

examples.en: The diploma ceremony honored high levels of academic attainment and leadership across all faculties.
examples.zh: 畢業典禮表揚了各院系學生卓越的學術成就與傑出的領導能力。

entries.definition: 達成；成就；取得；學歷程度。

explains.en: These related forms concern reaching a goal or level. The verb means to achieve something, while the noun means the act or result of achieving it. The goal may involve skill, knowledge, or success.
A student practices for months and finally reaches the needed score. The student achieves the goal. The verb describes this success.
A school records how much knowledge students gain during a course. The result shows what they have achieved. The noun names the act or result of reaching a goal.

examples.en: She has blonde hair and brown eyes.
examples.zh: 她有一頭金髮和一雙棕色眼睛。

examples.en: A cheerful blonde girl with bright hazel eyes waved enthusiastically across the school playground.
examples.zh: 一位有著明亮淡褐色眼眸的開朗金髮女孩在學校操場對面熱情地揮手。

examples.en: The portrait depicts a noble European lady with braided blonde locks crowned by wildflowers.
examples.zh: 這幅肖像畫描繪了一位編著金色髮辮、頭戴野花花冠的高貴歐洲貴婦。

entries.definition: （名）金髮的人；（形）金黃色頭髮的

explains.en: These forms describe hair that is pale yellow or gold in color. One spelling is often used for men and the other for women, though usage varies. The words can also be nouns for people with this hair color.
A child has light golden hair that looks pale in the sun. The adjective describes the hair color. The spelling may vary by person or style guide.
As a noun, this word can name a person with pale yellow or golden hair. A writer may use it to describe a character in a story. In that use, the word refers to the person rather than just the color.

examples.en: She bought a comfortable bra for the trip.
examples.zh: 她為旅程買了一件舒適的胸罩。

examples.en: The shop carries bras in many sizes.
examples.zh: 這家商店販售多種尺寸的胸罩。

examples.en: A properly fitted sports bra minimizes strain and maximizes athletic mobility during vigorous workouts.
examples.zh: 尺寸合身剪裁的運動內衣能最大程度減少運動拉傷，並在劇烈鍛鍊中提供最佳活動度。

explains.en: These nouns name a close-fitting undergarment that supports the breasts. One form is shorter and more common in daily speech. Sizes and designs vary for comfort and clothing needs.
A person chooses a soft garment to wear beneath a shirt. It has straps and cups that provide support. The item is worn under clothing.
Stores sell many styles, from sports designs to everyday ones. One name is more formal, while the short form is common in speech. Both names refer to the same kind of clothing.

examples.en: Please sit down on that wooden chair.
examples.zh: 請在那張木椅上坐下。

examples.en: There are not enough chairs for all the guests.
examples.zh: 沒有足夠的椅子給所有客人坐。

examples.en: He pulled out a chair and sat down next to me.
examples.zh: 他拉開一張椅子並坐在我身旁。

explains.en: These nouns can name a person who leads a meeting or group. The shorter form is often used for the role. A leader guides discussion and helps the group make decisions.
A committee meets to discuss a new plan. One person keeps the talk in order and invites each member to speak. That person leads the meeting.
A group may choose someone to guide its work for a year. The person may set meeting topics and speak for the group. The role can be held by anyone.

examples.en: Please sit down on that wooden chair.
examples.zh: 請在那張木椅上坐下。

examples.en: There are not enough chairs for all the guests.
examples.zh: 沒有足夠的椅子給所有客人坐。

examples.en: He pulled out a chair and sat down next to me.
examples.zh: 他拉開一張椅子並坐在我身旁。

explains.en: These nouns can name a person who leads a meeting or group. The shorter form is often used for the role. A leader guides discussion and helps the group make decisions.
A committee meets to discuss a new plan. One person keeps the talk in order and invites each member to speak. That person leads the meeting.
A group may choose someone to guide its work for a year. The person may set meeting topics and speak for the group. The role can be held by anyone.

examples.en: A congresswoman met with voters in her district.
examples.zh: 一位女性國會議員在選區與選民會面。

examples.en: The congresswoman introduced legislation to expand green energy subsidies for public schools.
examples.zh: 這位女性國會議員提出了擴大公立學校綠色能源補助的立法法案。

examples.en: Constituents gathered at the auditorium to discuss municipal healthcare issues with their congresswoman.
examples.zh: 選區選民齊聚在大禮堂，與他們的女國會議員研商地方基層醫療保健議題。

entries.definition: （名）女國會議員；在美國國會任職的女性代表。

explains.en: These nouns name a person elected to serve in a national lawmaking body. One form refers to a man and another to a woman. The shorter gender-neutral title is often used today.
Voters choose a local representative to speak for them in the capital. The person helps discuss and pass laws. The role is filled through an election.
A person writes to an elected lawmaker about a new bill. The official reads concerns from people in the district. The title names this kind of representative.

examples.en: Living in the university dormitory is a great way to make lifelong friends.
examples.zh: 住在大學宿舍是結交終生好友的極佳途徑。

examples.en: Each dormitory room accommodates four students with study desks and bunk beds.
examples.zh: 每一間學生宿舍寢室配有書桌與上下鋪，供四位學生同住。

examples.en: The resident advisor oversees building safety rules within the dormitory.
examples.zh: 舍監督導負責維護宿舍大樓內部的各項安全公約守則。

explains.en: This is a building where many students live during their studies. Bedrooms may be shared or private. Residents often share bathrooms or common spaces.
A student moves away from home to attend a distant school. The school provides a room near classrooms and the library. Other students live in the same building.
The noun can also mean a large room with beds for several people. People sleep in the same space instead of separate bedrooms. A camp or hostel may have such a room.

examples.en: Raw material prices experienced a sharp downward trend this quarter.
examples.zh: 原物料價格在該季度經歷了急遽的下滑走勢。

examples.en: The roller coaster plunged downward at dizzying speed, making riders scream.
examples.zh: 雲霄飛車以令人目眩神迷的驚人高速由最高點向下垂直俯衝，令所有遊客放聲尖叫。

examples.en: Poor cash flow can push a struggling business into a dangerous downward spiral.
examples.zh: 長期現金流枯竭且債台高築，極易將一家營運困難的中小企業拖入危險的惡性下滑螺旋。

explains.en: This means toward a lower level or place. Rain falls from clouds toward the ground. The movement goes from higher to lower.
A climber looks from a high rock toward the valley below. The eyes turn away from the top of the mountain. The word can describe that direction of looking.
It can also describe change toward a smaller amount. A price may fall over several weeks. A graph can show the movement toward lower values.

examples.en: Soft music can enhance the mood of the dinner.
examples.zh: 柔和的音樂能提升晚餐的氣氛。

examples.en: The new windows enhanced the view of the garden.
examples.zh: 新窗戶讓花園景色更加出色。

examples.en: A short caption enhances the meaning of the photograph.
examples.zh: 簡短的說明文字能增進照片所傳達的意義。

entries.definition: 提升；增強；改善；增加價值。

explains.en: This verb means to improve the quality, value, or appearance of something. Better lighting can make a room look warmer. The change adds to what is already there.
A clear title can make a school project easier to understand. Small improvements help the whole piece work better. The original project remains recognizable.
This idea is about making a good feature stronger. Color can bring out details in a picture. The added effect helps viewers notice them.

examples.en: The historical Enlightenment era championed scientific reason, individual freedom, and democratic equality.
examples.zh: 橫掃歐洲的十八世紀「啟蒙運動」（Enlightenment），大舉確立了科學理性、個人自由與民主平等的思想燈塔。

examples.en: Decades of disciplined meditation under ancient bodhi trees brought the sage to a state of spiritual enlightenment.
examples.zh: 在古老菩提樹下歷經數十年如一日的嚴格打坐參禪與內觀，引導這位高僧最終證悟抵達精神心靈大徹大悟的超脫境界。

examples.en: Reading global history from non-Western viewpoints provided university students with immense intellectual enlightenment.
examples.zh: 跳脫西方中心主義、從多元南方視角研讀全球通史，為這群大學歷史系學子帶來了豁然開朗的知識啟蒙心智覺醒。

entries.definition: 十八世紀啟蒙思潮心智覺醒；啟蒙

explains.en: This verb means to give someone useful knowledge or a clearer understanding. A teacher can explain a difficult idea. The learner sees the subject in a new way.
It can also describe a sudden improvement in understanding. Reading about another culture may help a person see beyond old assumptions. New facts can change a viewpoint.
As a noun, it names the state of gaining deeper understanding. A class discussion can open students' minds. The result is greater awareness.

examples.en: Immersing oneself in great art offers deep emotional resonance and lifelong spiritual enrichment.
examples.zh: 讓自己沉浸於偉大藝術名作的浩瀚海洋中，能獲得深沉的情感共鳴與終身豐盈的心靈精神富足。

examples.en: The community college offers weekend foreign language and cooking classes for personal enrichment.
examples.zh: 社區大學每逢週末開設多元的外語會話、陶藝及烘焙料理手作課程，提供廣大市民豐富多元的終身學習自我充實。

examples.en: Zoo caretakers introduce puzzle toys and foraging mazes as daily mental enrichment for rescued primates.
examples.zh: 台北市立動物園保育員每天定期在展場投放益智藏食玩具與攀爬繩梯，為靈長類動物提供豐富化行為刺激。

entries.definition: 豐盈充實心靈世界；豐富

explains.en: This verb means to improve something by adding valuable qualities. A story gains depth when it includes vivid details. Those additions make the experience fuller.
Food may become more nutritious by adding helpful ingredients. The added parts increase its value. The word can describe this kind of improvement.
Experiences can also make a person's life more interesting or meaningful. Meeting new people can broaden someone's view. New knowledge adds depth to daily life.

examples.en: The school opened enrollment for its summer program.
examples.zh: 學校開放暑期課程報名了。

examples.en: Record student enrollment prompted the university to construct a brand new dormitory complex.
examples.zh: 創紀錄的學生註冊入學人數促使大學興建了一座全新的學生宿舍園區。

examples.en: Fall enrollment for after-school music and pottery classes begins next Monday morning.
examples.zh: 秋季課後音樂與陶藝課程的報名註冊作業將於下週一早晨開始受理。

explains.en: This verb means to officially join a class, school, or program. A student fills out forms and becomes a member. The school records the new name.
A parent may sign a child up for swimming lessons. Once accepted, the child is part of the course. The noun form can describe the act or number of students.
A person can join a club by completing its registration. The process makes the membership official. It often happens before classes or activities begin.

examples.en: A tiny raindrop rested on her eyelash.
examples.zh: 一小滴雨水停在她的睫毛上。

examples.en: He brushed an eyelash off his cheek.
examples.zh: 他把一根睫毛從臉頰上拂掉。

examples.en: The doll has long painted eyelashes.
examples.zh: 這個娃娃有長長的彩繪睫毛。

entries.definition: （名）睫毛；鞭子；猛烈抽打；（動）鞭打；猛烈抨擊

explains.en: This noun names one of the short hairs along the edge of an eye. These hairs help keep dust away. They also make the eyes look distinct.
Makeup products may be applied to these hairs to make them more visible. A small brush can separate them. The noun refers to the hairs themselves.
Each eye has a row of these protective hairs. They can catch tiny particles before they reach the eye. Their position is right along the eyelid.

examples.en: Her fiancé brought flowers to the family dinner.
examples.zh: 她的未婚夫帶了花來參加家庭晚餐。

examples.en: They introduced her fiancé to their friends.
examples.zh: 他們把她的未婚夫介紹給朋友。

examples.en: My sister and her fiancé chose a wedding date.
examples.zh: 我姊姊和她的未婚夫選定了婚期。

entries.definition: （名）未婚夫；已訂婚、準備結婚的男性伴侶。

explains.en: This noun means a man who is engaged to be married. He has agreed to marry his partner. The wedding has not happened yet.
People often introduce this person as their future husband. The feminine counterpart names a woman engaged to marry. Both terms describe a relationship before marriage.
The borrowed French spelling may include an accent mark, but English writing often leaves it out. Pronunciation remains similar. The meaning depends on the engagement.

examples.en: She reported the harassment to the school.
examples.zh: 她向學校通報了這種騷擾行為。

examples.en: Online harassment can make a person feel unsafe.
examples.zh: 網路騷擾可能讓人感到不安全。

examples.en: Educational institutions enforce strict anti-bullying policies to shield every learner from digital harassment.
examples.zh: 各級教育機構嚴格執行防霸凌規範，以保護每位學習者免受網路霸凌騷擾。

explains.en: This verb means to repeatedly bother or trouble someone in an unwelcome way. Mean messages can upset a student. The action is ongoing rather than a single disagreement.
A person may face unwanted comments or pressure at work. The behavior makes it difficult to feel safe or comfortable. It is more serious than ordinary teasing.
The noun names this repeated troubling behavior. It can occur in person or through messages. The term describes a harmful pattern that affects another person.

examples.en: Sound designers use open-back reference headphones to evaluate subtle stereo panning and spatial reverb tails.
examples.zh: 聲音設計師配戴開放式監聽耳機，細細審聽立體聲左右聲道平移定位與微細空間殘響尾音。

examples.en: Commuters put on noise-canceling headphones to enjoy podcasts in quiet serenity on the crowded metro.
examples.zh: 通勤上班族在擁擠吵雜的捷運車廂中戴上主動降噪耳機，在安詳寧靜中愜意收聽喜愛的播客節。目

examples.en: Studio tracking sessions require closed-back headphones to prevent headphone audio bleed into the open vocal mic.
examples.zh: 歌手進錄音室錄唱時必須配戴密閉式監聽耳機，以防耳機裡的伴奏音樂漏音滲入敏感的人聲話筒中。

examples.en: Noise-canceling headphones help you concentrate in noisy cafes.
examples.zh: 抗噪耳罩式耳機有助於在吵雜的咖啡廳中集中注意力。

examples.en: He placed his over-ear headphones on the desk after the podcast recording.
examples.zh: 播客錄音結束後，他將耳罩式耳機平放在辦公桌上。

examples.en: Wear stereo headphones to appreciate the subtle details of classical music.
examples.zh: 戴上立體聲耳機以細細品味古典樂細緻精妙的音質層次。

entries.definition: 開放式錄音室監聽耳機；耳機；耳罩式耳機；頭戴耳機

explains.en: This noun names a pair of small speakers worn over or in the ears. They let one person listen without playing sound aloud. They connect to a phone or computer.
A student may use them to hear a language lesson on a bus. Other passengers hear less noise. The device can be wired or wireless.
Different models cover the ears or fit inside them. They help people listen privately. The plural spelling is most common because the pair has two sides.

examples.en: His imprisonment lasted several months.
examples.zh: 他的監禁持續了好幾個月。

examples.en: The convicted embezzler was sentenced to seven years of strict imprisonment.
examples.zh: 被定罪的公款侵占犯被判處七年嚴格監禁刑期。

examples.en: The historical novel depicts the brave dissident's prolonged political imprisonment.
examples.zh: 這部歷史小說描繪了那位勇敢異議人士漫長的政治監禁歲月。

explains.en: This verb means to put someone in a prison or another place where they cannot leave. A court may order a person to remain there. Freedom is taken away.
The noun names the act or period of keeping someone confined. A story may describe a long time behind locked doors. The word has a serious legal sense.
A person can also be held in a small space, such as a cell. The term describes confinement and loss of freedom. Context may refer to the act or state.

examples.en: Madam, your table is ready.
examples.zh: 女士，您的桌位已經準備好了。

examples.en: The letter began, “Dear Madam.”
examples.zh: 這封信以「親愛的女士」作為開頭。

examples.en: Madam, may I help you with your coat?
examples.zh: 女士，我可以幫您拿外套嗎？

explains.en: This noun is a polite way to address a woman, especially in a formal setting. A speaker may use it before asking a question. It shows respect.
A letter may begin with this title when the writer does not know the woman's name. It is placed before a surname or used alone. The style can sound old-fashioned.
The longer form is sometimes used before a woman’s official role. A speaker might address a meeting leader with it. This title shows respect for her position.

examples.en: Wholesome, organically grown produce provides pure vital nourishment that energizes body and soul.
examples.zh: 來自純淨山林無毒耕作的原型蔬果，為我們的身體與心靈提供最純粹、最充滿生命力的大地天然滋養。

examples.en: Gentle rain showers provided desperate nourishment to parched crops during the prolonged spring drought.
examples.zh: 連綿數日的溫柔及時春雨，為長達數月乾旱後乾裂焦渴的農田莊稼帶來了起死回生的甘霖滋養。

examples.en: Classic literature and uplifting chamber music offer deep, enduring intellectual nourishment for curious minds.
examples.zh: 經得起時間淘洗的傳世文學經典名著與悠揚室內樂天籟，為渴求新知的心智提供了源遠流長的精神智慧滋養。

entries.definition: 大地之母純淨無毒之天然滋養

explains.en: This verb means to provide food or care that helps something grow and stay strong. Parents give children meals and support. The body gains what it needs.
A gardener adds compost to help plants grow. The soil receives useful material. The word describes giving what supports healthy development.
It can also mean to encourage an idea or feeling. A kind teacher may help a student's confidence grow. The noun form names this care or support.

examples.en: The branches spread outwards over the path.
examples.zh: 樹枝向外伸展，覆蓋了小徑。

examples.en: The cat stepped outwards from the doorway.
examples.zh: 貓從門口向外踏出。

examples.en: Ripples on the tranquil mountain lake expanded steadily outwards after a pebble broke the calm surface.
examples.zh: 一顆鵝卵石打破平靜水面後，寧靜高山湖泊上的漣漪穩步向外擴散開來。

entries.definition: （副）向外、朝外；從中心移向外側。

explains.en: This adverb describes movement or direction from the inside toward the outside. A door opens in this direction. The movement leaves a room or center.
A person may move away from a central place. A crowd spreads toward the edges of a square. The word tells which way people are going.
It can also describe something that appears on the outside. A person may look calm on the surface. The term concerns visible direction or appearance.

examples.en: A final refinement made the design clearer.
examples.zh: 最後的小幅修改讓設計更清楚。

examples.en: Continuous design refinement transformed the bulky prototype into a sleek handheld device.
examples.zh: 持續的設計精進將原本笨重的原型機轉化為輕巧優雅的手持裝置。

examples.en: Years of deliberate practice brought the violinist's phrasing to exceptional refinement.
examples.zh: 多年的刻意練習使這位小提琴家的樂句詮釋達到了無與倫比的細膩境界。

explains.en: This verb means to make something purer or better by removing unwanted parts. A company may clean a metal material. The finished substance is of higher quality.
An author may improve a draft by making small changes. Unclear parts are removed. The work becomes clearer and more polished.
The noun form can name a small improvement or a pure substance. Context shows whether it concerns cleaning material or making a work better. Both uses involve change or improvement.

examples.en: The hotel provided refreshments after the tour.
examples.zh: 導覽結束後，飯店提供了茶點。

examples.en: We enjoyed light refreshments in the garden.
examples.zh: 我們在花園裡享用了簡單茶點。

examples.en: The club served refreshments during the break.
examples.zh: 俱樂部在休息時間供應茶點。

entries.definition: （名）茶點；飲料與小吃；簡單餐飲

explains.en: This plural noun means small amounts of food or drink served to guests. A meeting may offer juice and crackers. The items are usually light.
It can also mean a short break during a meeting or event. People may stretch and talk before returning. The pause gives everyone time to rest.
A school may sell drinks and snacks after a concert. The word can refer to the food and the pause when it is served. The event may offer a chance to rest.

examples.en: He felt resentment after the unfair decision.
examples.zh: 不公平的決定讓他心生怨恨。

examples.en: Holding on to old resentment only burdens your mind and prevents genuine happiness.
examples.zh: 緊抓著陳年怨懟不放只會加重心靈負擔，並阻礙真正的快樂。

examples.en: Transparent dialogue between coworkers prevents toxic resentment from forming.
examples.zh: 同事之間透明公開的對話能防止不良芥蒂與不滿的滋生。

explains.en: This verb means to feel anger or bitterness about something unfair or hurtful. A person may remember being left out. The feeling can last.
The noun form names this unhappy feeling. A worker may feel upset about unequal treatment. The emotion is often quiet but strong.
The term can describe a reaction to a real or imagined wrong. People may talk about what hurt them. Context shows the feeling or its cause.

examples.en: The gull landed on the sandy shore.
examples.zh: 那隻海鷗降落在沙灘上。

examples.en: A solitary sea gull glided effortlessly across the windy harbor entrance.
examples.zh: 一隻孤單的海鷗在海風徐徐的港口入口處輕鬆滑翔。

examples.en: We watched a curious gull swoop down to scoop up a floating piece of biscuit.
examples.zh: 我們看著一隻好奇的海鷗俯衝而下，叼起漂浮在水面的餅乾碎屑。

entries.definition: （名）鷗、海鷗；海邊常見的中大型鳥類。

explains.en: This noun names a large bird that often lives near the sea. It has long wings and a strong beak. It may search beaches for food.
The bird can glide above waves for a long time. It may gather near fishing boats or harbors. People often see it along a coast.
Some people call this bird by a shorter name. It eats fish and other small food. The noun refers to a common coastal bird.

examples.en: Minimalist white leather sneakers match effortlessly with both suits and floral dresses.
examples.zh: 極簡全白真皮休閒小白鞋是無敵百搭鞋款，無論搭配俐落西裝抑或碎花洋裝皆毫無違和。

examples.en: Cushioning insoles in modern sneakers protect your knees and feet during long journeys.
examples.zh: 現代休閒球鞋內置的緩震氣墊鞋墊，能為長途跋涉旅遊提供極佳的足弓支撐與膝蓋減震保護。

examples.en: Clean your favorite canvas sneakers with a soft toothbrush and baking soda paste.
examples.zh: 使用軟毛舊牙刷沾取小蘇打糊，能溫和且高效刷洗掉心愛帆布球鞋上的頑固污垢。

explains.en: This noun means a light shoe made for walking or sports. It often has a rubber sole. People may wear a pair for running or everyday use.
The shoe is designed to feel comfortable during movement. It can be made of cloth, leather, or synthetic material. The term is common in American English.
A store may sell many styles of these shoes. They can be used for exercise or casual clothing. The word usually appears in plural form.

examples.en: Unmanned robotic spacecraft beamed high-definition photos of Martian craters.
examples.zh: 無人智慧太空探測船傳回了火星地表隕石坑的高畫質精細全彩影像。

examples.en: The manned spacecraft completed a flawless automated docking maneuver with the orbital habitat.
examples.zh: 載人太空飛船精準執行了毫釐不差的全自動太空姿態微調，與軌道太空艙順利實現精準對接。

examples.en: Thermal heat shields protect the descending spacecraft from incinerating upon atmospheric re-entry.
examples.zh: 飛船底部加裝的高科技陶瓷防熱隔熱盾，能嚴密防止太空探測船在再入大氣層摩擦時被高溫焚毀。

entries.definition: 太空船；太空探測器（單複同形）

explains.en: This noun names a vehicle designed to travel beyond Earth's atmosphere. It may carry astronauts or equipment. Rockets can launch it into space.
A space agency may send one to orbit another planet. The vehicle can contain instruments and living quarters. The term includes many designs.
The object may be crewed or unmanned. Some travel between planets, while others orbit Earth. The word means a vehicle for space travel.

examples.en: The government spokesperson answered media questions regarding the new subsidy policy.
examples.zh: 行政院政府發言人親切詳盡回答媒體記者有關各項民生最新補貼政策提問。

examples.en: A company spokesperson clarified that no customer credit card data was compromised.
examples.zh: 公司發言人主動出面澄清，客戶的信用卡資料並未遭到任何洩漏。

examples.en: Being an effective spokesperson requires poise under pressure and clear articulation.
examples.zh: 成為一名優秀的發言人需要在高壓環境下保持沉著鎮定並具備清晰的表達能力。

explains.en: This noun names a person chosen to speak for a group or organization. A reporter may ask that person questions. They share the group's official message.
A school may choose someone to explain a new rule to parents. The person communicates on behalf of others. The title can refer to any gender.
A company may have one worker who answers public questions. The person represents the organization. The word refers to that speaking role.

examples.en: The government spokesperson answered media questions regarding the new subsidy policy.
examples.zh: 行政院政府發言人親切詳盡回答媒體記者有關各項民生最新補貼政策提問。

examples.en: A company spokesperson clarified that no customer credit card data was compromised.
examples.zh: 公司發言人主動出面澄清，客戶的信用卡資料並未遭到任何洩漏。

examples.en: Being an effective spokesperson requires poise under pressure and clear articulation.
examples.zh: 成為一名優秀的發言人需要在高壓環境下保持沉著鎮定並具備清晰的表達能力。

explains.en: This noun names a person chosen to speak for a group or organization. A reporter may ask that person questions. They share the group's official message.
A school may choose someone to explain a new rule to parents. The person communicates on behalf of others. The title can refer to any gender.
A company may have one worker who answers public questions. The person represents the organization. The word refers to that speaking role.

examples.en: The sportswoman won a medal in swimming.
examples.zh: 這位女運動員贏得游泳獎牌。

examples.en: The teenage sportswoman broke the national record in the high jump competition.
examples.zh: 這位青少年女運動員在跳高比賽中打破了全國紀錄。

examples.en: She was honored as the premier sportswoman of the year for her archery triumphs.
examples.zh: 她因在射箭項目上的輝煌勝利而榮獲年度最佳女運動員殊榮。

entries.definition: 女運動員；熱愛運動的女性。

explains.en: This noun refers to a man or woman who takes part in sports. The person may play on a team or compete alone. The term can describe a player.
It may also describe a person who enjoys sports as an activity. They may not compete professionally. The word is used for men or women in older English.
A student who joins school games can be called by this name. The person practices and follows a sport. The term identifies a sports participant.

examples.en: Electric vehicle sales have shown a steady upward trend this decade.
examples.zh: 近十年來電動車的銷售量呈現穩步上升的增長趨勢。

examples.en: The helicopter climbed upward through the dense alpine fog toward safety.
examples.zh: 搜救直升機穿透層層高山濃霧筆直向上爬升，朝向空曠安全的高空空域飛去。

examples.en: Expanding your vocational skills creates strong upward career mobility over time.
examples.zh: 持續不斷地自我進修精進職業專業技能，長遠來看能為你帶來強大的向上流動升遷契機。

explains.en: This adverb describes movement from a lower place toward a higher one. A kite rises from the ground into the sky. The direction is clear.
A line on a chart may show growing numbers. The amount increases over time. The word can describe direction or growth.
A person may climb from the bottom of a hill toward its top. They move to a higher point. Context shows physical direction or an increase.

examples.en: The licensed veterinarian performed a gentle physical checkup on the kitten.
examples.zh: 溫柔細心的執業獸醫師為初次來到診所的小奶貓進行了全面的健康檢查。

examples.en: You should consult a licensed veterinarian immediately if your pet refuses to eat.
examples.zh: 若你的毛孩連續多餐拒絕進食，應立即尋求合格獸醫師的專業診斷。

examples.en: She has dreamed of becoming a wildlife veterinarian since she was a little girl.
examples.zh: 她從小女孩時期起，就立志長大後要成為一名救治野生動物的獸醫。

examples.en: Licensed veterinarians perform complex orthopedic surgeries and preventive healthcare exams.
examples.zh: 領有國家專業執照的動物醫院獸醫師，專門執行複雜的骨科手術與日常預防醫學健檢。

examples.en: If your cat stops eating for more than twenty-four hours, consult a veterinarian immediately.
examples.zh: 如果您的貓咪超過二十四小時未進食，請立即諮詢獸醫師。

examples.en: The clinic employs three experienced veterinarians specializing in exotic animals and avian medicine.
examples.zh: 該診所聘請了三位經驗豐富的獸醫師，專精於特殊寵物與鳥類醫學。

explains.en: This is a doctor who cares for animals. The doctor checks pets when they are sick or hurt. The shorter form is common in everyday speech.
The doctor may examine a dog, treat a bird, or help a cat recover. Clinics often keep medicine and tools for animal care. This job focuses on health beyond human patients.
People bring pets for checkups and care when an animal feels ill. The professional may explain an animal’s condition to its owner. The title names this kind of doctor.

examples.en: The recipe uses a little whisky in the sauce.
examples.zh: 這道食譜在醬汁中加了一點威士忌。

examples.en: The famous distillery in Yilan produces award-winning single malt whisky.
examples.zh: 位於宜蘭的知名釀酒廠生產屢獲國際大獎的單一麥芽威士忌。

examples.en: Tourists visited the highland storehouse to learn how traditional whisky is distilled.
examples.zh: 遊客們參觀高地倉庫，了解傳統威士忌是如何蒸餾釀造的。

entries.definition: （名）威士忌；由穀物釀造的烈酒

explains.en: This is a strong alcoholic drink made from grain. It is aged in wooden barrels. Different places make it in different styles.
The spelling varies by country and maker. Some labels use an extra letter, while others leave it out. Both forms name a similar kind of drink.
People may serve it in a small glass or use it in cooking. It has a strong smell and taste. The drink is intended for adults.

examples.en: He became a widower after many years of marriage.
examples.zh: 結婚多年後，他成了鰥夫。

examples.en: The gentle widower planted a fragrant rose bush in memory of his late wife.
examples.zh: 這位溫和的鰥夫種了一株芬芳的玫瑰花叢來紀念他過世的妻子。

examples.en: Community volunteer circles help each recent widower adjust to independent daily life.
examples.zh: 社區志工圈協助每位剛喪偶的男士適應獨立的日常生活。

explains.en: This noun names a person whose spouse has died. The feminine form is used for a woman and the masculine form for a man. The term describes a change in family status.
A person may continue to use the term years after the loss. Friends and family may offer support. The word does not tell how long ago the spouse died.
The plural form can refer to several people who lost spouses. A community group may bring them together. The paired forms cover women and men.

examples.en: Miss Wang will teach us art today.
examples.zh: 王小姐今天會教我們美術。

examples.en: Miss Davis is always patient with her young students.
examples.zh: 戴維斯小姐對她年幼的學生總是非常有耐心。

examples.en: I miss my childhood friends in my hometown.
examples.zh: 我很想念家鄉童年的朋友們。

explains.en: This title is used before the family name of a woman. A school teacher may be addressed this way.
When you feel sad because friends are far away, you have warm thoughts about them. You may feel this way about people from your old home.
If you arrive too late for a bus, you do not catch it. You can also fail to hear a question or see a chance.

examples.en: Please keep the classroom clean and tidy.
examples.zh: 請保持教室乾淨整潔。

examples.en: The students hurried back to the classroom after the bell rang.
examples.zh: 鐘聲響起後，學生們匆忙跑回教室。

examples.en: There is an interactive digital whiteboard in our classroom.
examples.zh: 我們的教室裡有一塊互動式數位電子白板。

explains.en: Children learn and read in this room at school. Desks, chairs, and a board are often inside it.
A teacher may teach a lesson here. Students return here after a break.
This school space can have books or a digital board. Keep it neat for everyone who studies there.

examples.en: Taking the MRT is very convenient in Taipei.
examples.zh: 在台北搭捷運非常方便。

examples.en: Eating and drinking are strictly prohibited on the MRT.
examples.zh: 捷運系統內嚴格禁止飲食。

examples.en: Which MRT line should I transfer to for the night market?
examples.zh: 我應該轉乘哪條捷運路線去夜市？

explains.en: This is a city train system that travels on set routes. People ride it to reach places around town. It is a common way to travel in Taipei.
