Passengers enter a station and choose a line going toward their destination. Some parts of the system run underground. Signs help riders find where to go.
This public transport carries many people between stops. Riders may change to another line during a trip. Food and drinks are often not allowed inside.

examples.en: The sky turned gray before the thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 雷陣雨前天空變成了灰色。

examples.en: My grandfather has distinguished silver-gray hair.
examples.zh: 我爺爺有一頭顯眼的銀灰色頭髮。

examples.en: Concrete buildings lined both sides of the gray city street.
examples.zh: 灰暗的城市街道兩旁矗立著混凝土建築。

entries.definition: 灰色的；灰色（英式常用 grey）

explains.en: It is between black and white. Clouds, stones, and some hair can have this shade. A painter may mix black and white to make it.
As a noun, it names a shade. A coat in this shade may look quiet and simple. People also use it to describe a cloudy sky.
Use this adjective for something that is neither black nor white. The same word can also name that shade. A cloudy afternoon may make the whole sky look this way.

examples.en: What is your favorite color?
examples.zh: 你最喜歡什麼顏色？

examples.en: The garden is full of vibrant flowers in every color imaginable.
examples.zh: 花園裡開滿了各式各樣顏色鮮豔的花朵。

examples.en: The artist mixed blue and yellow to create a new green color.
examples.zh: 畫家將藍色與黃色調和以創造出嶄新的綠色。

explains.en: Red, blue, and green are examples of what we see in a rainbow. A painter may mix two kinds to make a new one.
A picture can look brighter when an artist adds bright shades. Crayons help children fill a drawing with them.
This can be a noun for a visual quality or a verb meaning to add that quality to a picture. Blue and yellow paint can make green.

examples.en: Put on your coat before you go out.
examples.zh: 出門前穿上你的大衣。

examples.en: He put on his running shoes and headed out for a jog.
examples.zh: 他穿上慢跑鞋，出門去慢跑。

examples.en: Put on a smile and be confident during the presentation.
examples.zh: 簡報時面帶微笑並展現自信。

explains.en: Move clothing onto your body before going outside. You may do this with a coat or shoes.
Place a hat or glasses on your body so you can wear them. This action can help you get ready for the day.
A person may show a happy face for others to see. The same phrase can describe wearing clothes or accessories.

examples.en: Please take off your hat inside the classroom.
examples.zh: 在教室裡請把帽子脫掉。

examples.en: The flight will take off from the runway in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 航班將在十分鐘內由跑道起飛。

examples.en: He took off his wet jacket as soon as he got home.
examples.zh: 他一回到家就立刻脫下了濕透的夾克。

explains.en: You do this when you remove a hat, coat, or other clothing. The item was on your body and is no longer there. People may do it when they get indoors.
An airplane does this when it leaves the ground and begins to fly. It moves along a runway first. Then it rises into the air.
The same phrase describes removing clothing or an aircraft beginning a flight. Look at the subject to know which meaning fits. One is done by a person, and the other by a plane.

examples.en: I have one brother and two sisters.
examples.zh: 我有一個哥哥和兩個妹妹。

examples.en: Please take one step forward so everyone fits into the frame.
examples.zh: 請向前一步，讓大家都能入鏡。

examples.en: Only one person at a time can use the elevator.
examples.zh: 電梯一次只能容納一人使用。

explains.en: It names the number after zero and before two. It can count a single person or thing. A hand has this many thumbs.
As a pronoun, it can stand for a person or thing already mentioned. Only a single person may enter at a time. Please choose a single item from the group.
This number tells how many when there is a single item. It can also mean a person or thing by itself. The first step in counting comes before two.

examples.en: There are two cats resting on the sofa.
examples.zh: 有兩隻貓正在沙發上休息。

examples.en: The train journey will take about two hours.
examples.zh: 火車車程大約需要兩小時。

examples.en: We ordered two cups of bubble milk tea to share.
examples.zh: 我們點了兩杯珍珠奶茶一起分享。

explains.en: One plus one makes this amount. It is an even number after one and before three.
A pair has this many things. A person has one on each side of the body, such as eyes or hands.
This number tells how many when you have one item and then one more. A short trip might last this many hours.

examples.en: We have three English classes every week.
examples.zh: 我們每週有三堂英文課。

examples.en: The traffic light displayed three distinct colors: red, yellow, and green.
examples.zh: 紅綠燈顯示了三種明顯的顏色：紅、黃、綠。

examples.en: Divide the cake into three equal pieces for everyone.
examples.zh: 把蛋糕切成均等的三塊分給每個人。

explains.en: This number comes after two and before four. A triangle has this many sides.
Count one, then two, then this amount. A group with this many things has two more than one.
You can share a cake into this many equal parts. It is also the number of wheels on some small bikes.

examples.en: A square has four equal sides.
examples.zh: 正方形有四條等長的邊。

examples.en: There are four seasons in a year: spring, summer, fall, and winter.
examples.zh: 一年有四季：春、夏、秋、冬。

examples.en: Four students worked together on the science experiment.
examples.zh: 四名學生分工合作完成自然科學實驗。

explains.en: This number comes after three and before five. A square has this many sides. You can count this many seasons in a year.
Use this number when counting people or things. It tells how many items there are. A group of this size has one more than three members.
This number can describe a time, such as the hour when school begins. It is also used for quantities and groups. Its numeral has a straight line and angled parts.

examples.en: High five! You did a wonderful job.
examples.zh: 擊掌！你做得太棒了。

examples.en: The convenience store is just a five-minute walk from here.
examples.zh: 便利商店距離這裡步行只要五分鐘。

examples.en: A human hand has five fingers including the thumb.
examples.zh: 人手包括拇指在內共有五隻手指。

explains.en: It is the number after four and before six. A hand has this many fingers when the thumb is included. People may raise an open hand to show this count.
This number can tell how many things there are. A short walk might take this many minutes. It comes after four in counting.
Use this number for a group of four with another added. People often raise an open hand to show it. It is less than six.

examples.en: The store opens at six o'clock every morning.
examples.zh: 這家店每天早上六點開門。

examples.en: An insect typically has six legs.
examples.zh: 昆蟲通常有六隻腳。

examples.en: We reserved a dinner table for six people at the restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們在餐廳預訂了一張六人晚餐桌。

explains.en: This number comes after five and before seven. It is the number of sides on a common cube-shaped game die.
An insect has this many legs. You can count them as three on each side.
A clock face shows this number at the bottom. It is also the number of points on a regular snowflake drawing.

examples.en: 7-Eleven is a very popular convenience store in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 7-Eleven 是台灣非常受歡迎的便利商店。

examples.en: There are seven days in every week.
examples.zh: 每個星期有七天。

examples.en: Rainbows are formed with seven vibrant colors in the sky.
examples.zh: 彩虹是由天空中七種鮮豔的色彩所組成。

explains.en: This number comes after six and before eight. A week has this many days.
Count five and then two more to reach this amount. A rainbow is often said to have this many colors.
It is one more than six and one less than eight. Some people celebrate a birthday when they reach this age.

examples.en: School starts at eight in the morning.
examples.zh: 學校在早上八點開始上課。

examples.en: An octopus has eight flexible arms called tentacles.
examples.zh: 章魚有八隻靈活的手腕，稱為觸手。

examples.en: She tries to sleep eight full hours every night.
examples.zh: 她每晚盡量睡滿整整八個小時。

explains.en: This number follows seven and comes before nine. An octopus has this many arms. A week has this many hours in a full night of sleep.
Use this number to tell a quantity or a time on a clock. It is one more than seven. Its numeral looks like two small circles joined together.
This number names a group larger than seven by one. It can count people, objects, or hours. There are this many legs on a spider.

examples.en: The package arrived at nine sharp.
examples.zh: 包裹在九點整準時送達。

examples.en: Cats are said to have nine lives in folklore.
examples.zh: 民間傳說中貓咪有九條命。

examples.en: The morning bell rings at nine o'clock for the first lecture.
examples.zh: 第一節課的早晨鐘聲在九點整響起。

explains.en: It is the number after eight and before ten. A week has this many days. A clock may show this hour in the morning.
This number tells a count one less than ten. People use it when naming an hour or counting a group. It comes after eight.
There are three groups of three in this number. It is also the number of days in a week plus two. In counting, it comes just before ten.

examples.en: Count from one to ten slowly.
examples.zh: 請從一慢慢數到十。

examples.en: It took only ten minutes to solve the math puzzle.
examples.zh: 解開這道數學謎題只花了十分鐘。

examples.en: She was among the top ten students in the grade.
examples.zh: 她名列年級前十名優秀學生之中。

explains.en: This number is one more than nine. It comes before eleven when counting.
A classroom may have this many children in a small group. A short wait can last this many minutes.
When counting, it comes after nine and before eleven. A perfect mark can be given for getting every question right on a quiz with this many points.

examples.en: The bookstore is next to the post office.
examples.zh: 書店就在郵局隔壁。

examples.en: May I sit next to you on the school bus?
examples.zh: 我可以坐在校車上你旁邊的位置嗎？

examples.en: Place the dictionary right next to your study notebook.
examples.zh: 把字典放在你研讀筆記本的正旁邊。

explains.en: If a chair is beside a table, the two are very close. There is no other seat between them.
A shop can stand right beside a post office. The two places share a nearby spot.
When you sit beside a friend, you are close on one side. This phrase tells where someone or something is.

examples.en: There is a big tree in front of our house.
examples.zh: 我們房子前面有一棵大樹。

examples.en: The teacher stood in front of the chalkboard and began teaching.
examples.zh: 老師站在黑板前開始講課。

examples.en: Please wait for me in front of the MRT exit number two.
examples.zh: 請在捷運二號出口前等我。

explains.en: This phrase tells that one thing is ahead of another. A tree may be on the street side of a house. The two things are close, with one facing the other.
A person standing here is between you and something farther away. For example, a teacher may be near the board while the class watches. It describes position.
Use this phrase to show where something is located. It means on the forward side of a place or object. People may wait here near a station exit.

examples.en: I need to send this parcel at the post office.
examples.zh: 我需要去郵局寄這個包裹。

examples.en: The post office closes at five o'clock in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 郵局在下午五點整關門。

examples.en: You can buy commemorative stamps at the central post office.
examples.zh: 你可以在總郵局購買紀念郵票。

examples.en: Chunghwa Post is Taiwan's official postal and banking service provider.
examples.zh: 中華郵政是台灣官方的郵政與儲匯服務機構。

examples.en: I need to stop by the post office to mail an international parcel.
examples.zh: 我需要順道去一趟郵局寄一件跨國包裹。

examples.en: The historical red-brick post office is located near the old train station.
examples.zh: 這座歷史悠久的紅磚郵局坐落在老火車站附近。

explains.en: It is a place where people send letters and parcels. Staff can sell stamps and help mail items. Some locations also offer basic banking services.
Go there to mail a package or buy postage. Workers sort letters so they can travel to other places. It often has a counter for customers.
This public service building handles mail. You can send a parcel from there to another city or country. It may also provide simple financial services.

examples.en: Almost every teenager has a cell phone nowadays.
examples.zh: 如今幾乎每個青少年都有手機。

examples.en: Don't look down at your cell phone while walking on the street.
examples.zh: 在路上行走時不要低頭滑手機。

examples.en: She downloaded a useful dictionary app onto her cell phone.
examples.zh: 她在手機上下載了一款實用的字典應用程式。

explains.en: People carry this small electronic device to call others, send messages, and use apps. It can connect to the internet without a wire.
Before walking across a street, put this device away and look around. You can use it to check a map when you are safely stopped.
A dictionary program can be installed on this portable device. It lets people talk to family even when they are far apart.

examples.en: We have a flag-raising ceremony every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 我們每週一早上舉行升旗典禮。

examples.en: Monday is the first day of the school week.
examples.zh: 星期一是一週上課日的第一天。

examples.en: I have to submit my math assignment next Monday.
examples.zh: 我下週一必須繳交數學作業。

explains.en: This is the day after Sunday and before Tuesday. Many children go back to school on this day.
It begins the usual school week in many places. People may plan their work for this day.
A calendar names this day at the start of the week. Some families have a regular activity on it.

examples.en: Taco Tuesday is a fun dinner idea.
examples.zh: 星期二吃塔可是個有趣的晚餐點子。

examples.en: We have two consecutive science classes on Tuesday morning.
examples.zh: 我們週二上午有連續兩節自然科學課。

examples.en: Our study group will meet at the library next Tuesday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們讀書小組下週二下午將在圖書館碰面。

explains.en: This is the day after Monday and before Wednesday. It is a weekday in many calendars. People may have school or work on this day.
A week has seven days, and this is the third one when counting from Sunday. It comes near the beginning of the workweek. Plans can be made for its morning or afternoon.
Use this name for one day of the week. It follows the first day many people return to work after the weekend. A regular class or meeting may happen then.

examples.en: Wednesday is the middle of the school week.
examples.zh: 星期三是一週上課日的中間點。

examples.en: School finishes an hour early every Wednesday afternoon in some countries.
examples.zh: 在某些國家，學校每週三下午會提前一小時放學。

examples.en: Can we reschedule our badminton match to Wednesday?
examples.zh: 我們能將羽毛球比賽改期至週三嗎？

explains.en: It is the day after Tuesday and before Thursday. In many places, it falls near the middle of the school week. Some schools finish early on this day.
This weekday comes between Tuesday and Thursday. People may plan a sports game or lesson for it. It is not part of the weekend.
There are two weekdays before it in a usual workweek and two after it. Many calendars place it in the center column. It follows Tuesday.

examples.en: We will have our science lab on Thursday.
examples.zh: 我們將在星期四進行自然科學實驗課。

examples.en: The school orchestra practices every Thursday after classes.
examples.zh: 學校管弦樂團每週四放學後都會進行團練。

examples.en: Is Thursday convenient for you to discuss the science project?
examples.zh: 星期四方便與你一起討論科學專案嗎？

explains.en: It comes after Wednesday and before Friday. Many schools have classes on this day.
There are seven days in a week, and this one is the fifth when counting from Monday. It begins with the same sound as the word for a day of thanks in the United States.
A weekly calendar places this day between the middle of the week and the last workday. Some people practice music after school on it.

examples.en: TGIF! Everyone is excited for Friday evening.
examples.zh: 感謝老天週五到了！大家對週五晚上都超期待。

examples.en: We always have our weekly spelling quiz on Friday morning.
examples.zh: 我們總是在週五早晨進行每週單字拼字測驗。

examples.en: My classmates and I love watching movies together on Friday night.
examples.zh: 我和同學們喜歡在週五晚上一起看電影。

explains.en: This is the day after Thursday and before Saturday. Many students look forward to it because the weekend is near.
It is the last school day of a usual week for many children. Some families watch a movie that evening.
A calendar places this day between Thursday and Saturday. People may have a spelling quiz in the morning.

examples.en: I like to sleep in on Saturday mornings.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在週六早晨睡到自然醒。

examples.en: We took a relaxing family cycling trip along the river on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我們週六全家沿著河濱進行了輕鬆愜意的單車旅行。

examples.en: The municipal library is crowded with students on Saturday afternoons.
examples.zh: 市立圖書館在週六下午擠滿了自習的學生。

explains.en: This is the day after Friday and before Sunday. Many people have a day off from school or work then. Families may spend time together.
It is one of the two days in the weekend for many people. Shops and libraries may be busy on this day. Some people sleep later in the morning.
Use this name for a day near the end of the week. It comes before the day many people use to rest before Monday. Trips and activities often happen then.

examples.en: My family usually has a big lunch together on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們全家通常在週日一起吃豐盛午餐。

examples.en: Sunday evening is the best time to organize your schoolbag for the new week.
examples.zh: 週日傍晚是為新的一週整理書包的最佳時間。

examples.en: Stores and restaurants in the night market are bustling on Sunday.
examples.zh: 夜市裡的店家和餐廳在週日熱鬧非凡。

explains.en: It is the day after Saturday and before Monday. Many people use it to rest or spend time with family. It is part of the weekend.
This day often brings family meals and free time. It comes just before the start of a new school or work week. Many calendars show it at one end of the week.
People may visit a market or prepare their school things on this day. It follows Saturday and comes before Monday. For many, it is a day off.

examples.en: January 1st is New Year's Day.
examples.zh: 一月一日是元旦新年。

examples.en: January is typically one of the coldest months of the year in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 一月通常是台灣一年當中最寒冷的月份之一。

examples.en: Many people set inspiring personal goals in early January.
examples.zh: 許多人在一月初為自己訂下激勵人心的目標。

explains.en: It is the first month of the year, just after the winter holidays. New Year’s Day falls on its first day.
In Taiwan, this month often brings cool weather. Many people make plans for the year near its beginning.
This month has 31 days and starts the calendar year. In the Northern Hemisphere, it is part of winter.

examples.en: Chinese New Year often falls in January or February.
examples.zh: 農曆新年通常落在一月或二月。

examples.en: February is a leap year month when it contains twenty-nine days.
examples.zh: 二月在閏年時會擁有二十九天。

examples.en: Lantern Festival celebrations illuminate towns across Taiwan in February.
examples.zh: 二月份的元宵燈會照亮了全台灣各大城鎮。

explains.en: This is the second month of the year. It usually has fewer days than the other months.
A leap year gives this month one extra day. In many places, winter weather can still be cold then.
Valentine’s Day takes place during this month. Lunar New Year sometimes falls around this time.

examples.en: Cherry blossoms start blooming in March.
examples.zh: 櫻花在三月開始綻放。

examples.en: Soldiers marched steadily in unison across the parade ground.
examples.zh: 士兵們整齊劃一地在閱兵場上大步邁進。

examples.en: Spring officially arrives as temperatures gradually rise in mid-March.
examples.zh: 隨著三月中旬氣溫逐漸回升，春天正式來臨。

explains.en: This is the month after February and before April. In the Northern Hemisphere, spring begins around this time. Its name starts with a capital letter when it names the month.
People do this when they walk together with firm, regular steps. Soldiers may move this way during a parade. The action can show order and purpose.
This word can name a month or a way of walking in a group. In the month sense, it comes early in the year. In the action sense, people move in steady steps.

examples.en: April Fools' Day is on April 1st.
examples.zh: 愚人節是在四月一日。

examples.en: Spring showers in April bring colorful flowers in May.
examples.zh: 四月的春雨為五月帶來了繽紛的花朵。

examples.en: Students in Taiwan enjoy a joyful spring break in early April.
examples.zh: 台灣的學生在四月初享有歡樂的清明兒童春假。

explains.en: It is the month after March and before May. In Taiwan, spring break may take place early in this month. Its name appears in the date of a spring holiday.
This month brings spring showers in many places. Flowers often bloom as the weather grows warmer. It comes between March and May.
Schools in Taiwan may have a short spring holiday during this month. It is the fourth month of the year. The next month is May.

examples.en: Mother's Day is celebrated on the second Sunday of May.
examples.zh: 母親節在五月的第二個星期日慶祝。

examples.en: May I borrow your English-Chinese dictionary for ten minutes?
examples.zh: 我可以借用你的英漢字典十分鐘嗎？

examples.en: White tung blossoms cover the hills like snow across Taiwan in May.
examples.zh: 五月份全台山頭油桐花盛開如雪。

explains.en: This is the fifth month of the year, after April and before June. Mother’s Day is celebrated during it in many places.
You can use this helping verb to politely ask for permission. For example, you might ask to borrow a book.
This helping verb can say that something is possible. Dark clouds suggest that rain could come later.

examples.en: The Dragon Boat Festival often takes place in June.
examples.zh: 端午節通常在六月舉行。

examples.en: High school graduation ceremonies are held across the country in June.
examples.zh: 高中畢業典禮於六月在全國各地舉行。

examples.en: The weather turns noticeably hot and sunny as June begins.
examples.zh: 六月伊始，天氣便明顯轉為炎熱且陽光普照。

explains.en: This is the sixth month of the year. In Taiwan, the Dragon Boat Festival often happens then.
Many students finish a school year during this month. The weather can feel hot and sunny.
It comes after May and before July. Some high school graduation ceremonies take place then.

examples.en: Summer vacation officially begins in July in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台灣的暑假在七月正式開始。

examples.en: Beaches in Kenting are crowded with enthusiastic tourists in July.
examples.zh: 七月份墾丁的海灘擠滿了熱情的觀光客。

examples.en: Tropical fruits like sweet mangoes and lychees ripen in July.
examples.zh: 像甜芒果和荔枝這樣的熱帶水果在七月熟成。

explains.en: This is the month after June and before August. It is the seventh month of the year. In Taiwan, summer vacation often begins around this time.
Many places in the Northern Hemisphere are warm during this month. People may visit beaches or enjoy summer fruit. Its name begins with a capital letter.
Use this name for a month in the middle of the year. It comes after the month with the longest days in many places. Schools may be on break then.

examples.en: Father's Day is celebrated on August 8th in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台灣在八月八日慶祝父親節。

examples.en: August is usually the height of typhoon season in the Western Pacific.
examples.zh: 八月通常是西太平洋颱風季的高峰期。

examples.en: We watched the Perseid meteor shower in the clear mountains in mid-August.
examples.zh: 我們在八月中旬前往晴朗山區觀賞英仙座流星雨。

explains.en: It is the month after July and before September. In Taiwan, Father's Day is celebrated during it. The Western Pacific often has many typhoons at this time.
This summer month is a time when people may watch a meteor shower. It follows July and comes before September. The weather can be hot in many places.
In Taiwan, a family holiday for fathers falls during this month. It is the eighth month of the year. Typhoons are common in the region around this time.

examples.en: The new school semester starts in September.
examples.zh: 新學期在九月開始。

examples.en: Teachers' Day is celebrated with great respect on September 28th.
examples.zh: 教師節在九月二十八日受到隆重慶祝。

examples.en: The autumn breeze brings welcome relief from the heat in late September.
examples.zh: 九月下旬微涼的秋風帶來了消暑的宜人愜意。

explains.en: It is the ninth month of the year, after summer break for many students. Its name begins with the same sound as “seven.”
This month has 30 days and includes the start of autumn in the Northern Hemisphere. In Taiwan, Teachers’ Day falls near its end.
The school year begins in this month in many places. It comes after August and before October.

examples.en: National Day in Taiwan is on October 10th.
examples.zh: 台灣的雙十國慶在十月十日。

examples.en: Children dress up in fun costumes for Halloween on October 31st.
examples.zh: 孩童們在十月三十一日穿上趣味變裝慶祝萬聖節。

examples.en: The pleasant weather in October makes it the perfect month for travel.
examples.zh: 十月宜人的天氣使其成為最適合旅遊的月份。

explains.en: This is the tenth month of the year. Taiwan celebrates National Day during it.
Halloween takes place near the end of this month. Children may wear costumes for the occasion.
It comes after September and before November. The weather is often pleasant for travel in Taiwan.

examples.en: The weather turns pleasantly cool in November.
examples.zh: 天氣在十一月變得涼爽宜人。

examples.en: Farmers harvest golden sweet rice crops during November.
examples.zh: 農民在十一月收割金黃稻穗。

examples.en: Marathon runners enjoy training in the cool morning air of November.
examples.zh: 馬拉松跑者喜歡在十一月清涼的晨風中訓練。

explains.en: This is the month after October and before December. It is the eleventh month of the year. Its name begins with a capital letter.
In some places, the weather becomes cooler during this month. Farmers may gather crops, and runners may enjoy the mild air. It comes near the end of the year.
Use this name for a month in autumn in the Northern Hemisphere. It has thirty days. The next month brings the end of the calendar year.

examples.en: Christmas is celebrated on December 25th.
examples.zh: 聖誕節在十二月二十五日慶祝。

examples.en: Huge crowds gather around Taipei 101 to countdown on December 31st.
examples.zh: 數十萬群眾在十二月三十一日聚集在台北 101 跨年倒數。

examples.en: December is a wonderful time to reflect upon the achievements of the year.
examples.zh: 十二月是回顧與省思這一年收穫的美好時刻。

explains.en: It is the month after November and before January. Christmas falls during it. Many people look back on the year as it ends.
Taipei holds a large New Year's Eve countdown near the end of this month. It is the last month of the year. The next month begins a new year.
Families may celebrate a winter holiday during this month. Crowds gather to welcome the coming year on its final night. It comes after November.

examples.en: We love eating mango shaved ice in summer.
examples.zh: 我們在夏天超愛吃芒果刨冰。

examples.en: Cicadas sing loudly in the green trees during long summer days.
examples.zh: 蟬鳴在漫長夏日茂密的綠樹間響亮鳴叫。

examples.en: Our school offers exciting outdoor adventure camps every summer.
examples.zh: 我們學校每年夏天都會舉辦令人興奮的戶外冒險營。

explains.en: It is the hottest season in many places, after spring and before fall. Children often have a long school break then.
Long sunny days and warm nights are common during this part of the year. People may go swimming or eat cold treats.
In Taiwan, this season brings hot weather and fruit such as mangoes. It comes between spring and autumn.

examples.en: Eating hot pot with family is great in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天跟家人一起吃火鍋最棒了。

examples.en: Mountain peaks in central Taiwan occasionally see snow during cold winter days.
examples.zh: 台灣中部的高山山頂在寒冬時節偶爾會降雪。

examples.en: Bears hibernate in warm underground caves throughout the freezing winter.
examples.zh: 熊在嚴寒的冬季期間會躲在溫暖的地洞中冬眠。

explains.en: This is the coldest season of the year in many places. It comes after autumn and before spring.
People may wear warm coats during this season. Some mountains receive snow then.
Families often enjoy hot food when the weather is cold. Bears may sleep through much of this season.

examples.en: I will stop by the bakery to buy some bread.
examples.zh: 我會順道去麵包店買些麵包。

examples.en: Can you stop by my office later to pick up the revised schedule?
examples.zh: 你等一下可以順道過來我的辦公室領取修改後的課表嗎？

examples.en: She stopped by her grandparents' house to say hello on her way home.
examples.zh: 她在回家途中順道去了祖父母家打個招呼。

explains.en: You do this when you visit a place for a short time, often on the way somewhere else. You might greet a friend or buy bread. The visit is usually brief.
A person may do this at a shop, office, or home. They arrive, take care of a small task, and then leave. It often happens during a trip to another place.
This phrase describes making a quick visit. You may go in to say hello or collect something. You do not plan to stay for long.

examples.en: Eating too much candy is not good for your teeth.
examples.zh: 吃太多糖果對你的牙齒不好。

examples.en: Children were thrilled to catch sweet candies during the festival parade.
examples.zh: 節慶遊行時孩子們開心地接著拋灑下來的甜美糖果。

examples.en: The old candy shop has sold traditional handmade sweets for fifty years.
examples.zh: 這家古老的糖果行販售傳統手工糖果已有五十年歷史。

explains.en: It is a sweet food made with sugar. People may enjoy a small piece as a treat. Too much can harm teeth.
Shops sell these sugary treats in many flavors and shapes. Some are soft, while others are hard. Children may receive them at a festival.
This sweet snack may come wrapped in a small piece of paper. It is often shared during holidays. Dentists suggest eating it in moderation.

examples.en: Mango ice cream is extremely popular in summer.
examples.zh: 芒果冰淇淋在夏天非常受歡迎。

examples.en: Two scoops of vanilla ice cream melted over the warm waffle.
examples.zh: 兩球香草冰淇淋在溫熱的鬆餅上漸漸融化。

examples.en: Nothing beats a cold ice cream cone on a scorching hot afternoon.
examples.zh: 炎炎夏日午後，沒有什麼比來上一支冰涼甜筒更棒的了。

explains.en: This cold, sweet dessert is made from milk or cream and often comes in a cone. Chocolate and mango are popular flavors.
People keep this treat frozen until they are ready to eat it. It melts quickly on a hot day.
A scoop of this creamy dessert can be served in a bowl or between two cookies. It is a favorite at many birthday parties.

examples.en: Speaking English with native speakers builds confidence.
examples.zh: 和母語人士說英語能建立自信。

examples.en: Our English teacher encourages us to read English storybooks every evening.
examples.zh: 我們的英文老師鼓勵我們每天晚上讀英文故事書。

examples.en: English has become a global language for international science and business.
examples.zh: 英語已成為國際科學與商務領域的通用語言。

explains.en: This language is spoken in places such as the United States and Britain. Students around the world study it.
A class about this subject may include reading, writing, and speaking. A book written in this language uses its words and grammar.
People use this language to talk across countries. The same word can describe something from England.

examples.en: We learn classical poetry in Chinese class.
examples.zh: 我們在國文課學習古典詩詞。

examples.en: Many international students visit Taiwan to learn traditional Chinese characters.
examples.zh: 許多國際學生造訪台灣學習繁體中文字。

examples.en: Delicious Chinese cuisine varies greatly across regional cultures.
examples.zh: 美味的中華料理在不同地域文化間展現豐富多樣的風貌。

explains.en: This is a language spoken by many people in China and Taiwan. It can also describe people, writing, food, or traditions from those places. In a school, it may name a class about the language.
People use this language to speak and write. Its writing system includes characters. The same word can describe things connected with China.
This word names a language and describes the culture or people linked to China. Students may study its poems and writing. A meal from that culture may also be described this way.

examples.en: We learned how to play the recorder in music class.
examples.zh: 我們在音樂課學會了吹直笛。

examples.en: Music class is on Wednesday afternoon in the audiovisual hall.
examples.zh: 音樂課在週三下午於視聽大樓舉行。

examples.en: During music class, students sang traditional Taiwanese ballads together.
examples.zh: 在音樂課上，同學們一起合唱了台灣傳統民謠。

explains.en: It is a school lesson about songs, sounds, and instruments. Students may sing or learn to play a recorder. They can also listen to different kinds of tunes.
In this lesson, children practice rhythm and melody. A teacher may introduce instruments and composers. Students sometimes perform together.
Schools set aside a period for learning about sound and song. Pupils may read notes, sing, or play instruments. The lesson can include music from many cultures.

examples.en: We played dodgeball during PE class yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們昨天在體育課玩了躲避球。

examples.en: Make sure you wear comfortable athletic shoes for PE class.
examples.zh: 上體育課時務必穿著舒適的運動球鞋。

examples.en: Regular PE classes help students stay active and physically fit.
examples.zh: 規律的體育課能幫助學生保持身心活力與體適能。

explains.en: At school, children run, play games, and exercise during this class. It helps them stay healthy and active.
Students may wear sneakers and comfortable clothes for this lesson. They might practice sports or learn movement skills.
This school subject gives children time to move their bodies. A teacher may lead games in a gym or outside.

examples.en: Please clean the whiteboard with the eraser.
examples.zh: 請用白板擦把白板擦乾淨。

examples.en: The teacher used blue and red dry-erase markers on the whiteboard.
examples.zh: 老師在白板上使用了藍色和紅色的白板筆。

examples.en: In modern smart classrooms, digital whiteboards connect directly to tablets.
examples.zh: 在現代智慧教室中，數位電子白板可直接與平板電腦連線。

explains.en: A teacher can write on this smooth board with special markers. The writing can be wiped away.
This classroom surface is usually white and easy to clean. A smart version may connect to a computer.
Students can look at notes or drawings on this board during a lesson. An eraser removes the marks from it.

examples.en: The whole family is chatting in the living room.
examples.zh: 全家人正在客廳裡聊天。

examples.en: We placed a cozy rug and a coffee table in the center of the living room.
examples.zh: 我們在客廳中央鋪了一張舒適的地毯並擺上一張茶几。

examples.en: Sunlight flooded into the living room through the large balcony windows.
examples.zh: 陽光透過大落地窗灑滿了整個客廳。

explains.en: This is a room at home where people sit and spend time together. It may have chairs, a sofa, and a table. Families often talk or relax there.
Guests may sit in this part of a house. People can read, chat, or watch a show there. It is usually arranged to feel comfortable.
This room is often near the entrance of a home. A rug and table may stand in its center. It is a shared place for relaxing with family.

examples.en: We gathered in the dining room for a feast.
examples.zh: 我們聚集在飯廳享用豐盛大餐。

examples.en: The wooden dining room table can comfortably seat eight guests.
examples.zh: 這張木製飯廳餐桌可以舒適地容納八位客人就座。

examples.en: Fragrant smells of roasted chicken filled the dining room before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐前烤雞的誘人香氣飄滿了整個飯廳。

explains.en: It is a room where people sit together to eat meals. A table and chairs are often inside it. Families may gather there for dinner.
Homes may have a special space for sharing food. It can hold a large table for guests. The kitchen is often nearby.
People use this room for breakfast, lunch, or dinner. It may have a table, chairs, and a cabinet for dishes. A family feast can take place there.

examples.en: We turned on the air conditioner because of the heat.
examples.zh: 因為天氣炎熱，我們打開了冷氣。

examples.en: Setting the air conditioner to twenty-six degrees saves electricity.
examples.zh: 將冷氣設定在二十六度可以有效節省用電。

examples.en: Clean the air conditioner filter regularly to ensure clean airflow.
examples.zh: 定期清洗冷氣濾網以確保吹出清淨的空氣。

examples.en: Set your home air conditioner to 26°C with an electric fan for energy saving.
examples.zh: 將家中冷氣溫度設定在 26 度並搭配電風扇以節約能源。

examples.en: Cleaning the dust filters of the air conditioner improves cooling efficiency.
examples.zh: 定期清洗冷氣機濾網能大幅提升冷房降溫效率。

examples.en: An inverter air conditioner maintains a consistent room temperature while using less power.
examples.zh: 變頻冷暖空調在耗費更少電力的同時能維持恆定的室溫。

explains.en: This machine cools a room when the weather is hot. A fan inside moves the cooled air around.
People may set this household appliance to a comfortable temperature. Its filter needs cleaning so air can flow well.
A home or car may have this powered cooling system. It helps people feel comfortable on a warm day.

examples.en: Throw the empty cup into the recycling trash can.
examples.zh: 把空杯子丟進資源回收垃圾桶。

examples.en: The street was very clean because trash cans were placed at every corner.
examples.zh: 這條街道非常乾淨，因為每個街角都設有垃圾桶。

examples.en: Empty the kitchen trash can daily to prevent unpleasant odors.
examples.zh: 每天清理廚房垃圾桶以防止產生難聞的異味。

explains.en: Put unwanted paper or food wrappers inside this container. It helps keep a room or street clean.
You may find one beside a desk or on a street corner. Some are made for things that can be recycled.
After a picnic, place rubbish in this bin. A family may empty the kitchen one each day.

examples.en: I need to make an important phone call.
examples.zh: 我需要打一通重要的電話。

examples.en: She answered an urgent phone call from her homeroom teacher.
examples.zh: 她接聽了導師打來的緊急通話。

examples.en: Phone calls are often much quicker than sending multiple text messages.
examples.zh: 通電話通常比傳送多則文字簡訊更加迅速高效。

explains.en: This is a conversation that people have by speaking through telephones. One person contacts another and they talk aloud. It can be quicker than sending written messages.
A person may make this to share news or ask a question. The other person answers and speaks back. It can be short or last a long time.
This kind of talk happens when people connect using phones. You may receive one from a teacher or family member. It lets people speak even when they are far apart.

examples.en: Lin Yun-ju is an outstanding table tennis star.
examples.zh: 林昀儒是傑出的桌球球星。

examples.en: Table tennis is an indoor game that tests hand-eye coordination and speed.
examples.zh: 桌球是一項考驗手眼協調與極致速度的室內運動。

examples.en: We placed a portable table tennis table in the community recreation room.
examples.zh: 我們在社區育樂室裡放置了一張便攜式桌球桌。

examples.en: Table tennis requires quick reflexes and sharp concentration.
examples.zh: 桌球需要敏捷的反應能力與高度專注力。

examples.en: Lin Yun-ju achieved outstanding results in international table tennis championships.
examples.zh: 林昀儒在國際桌球錦標賽事中取得了非凡出色的戰績。

examples.en: There are four green table tennis tables inside the community recreational center.
examples.zh: 社區休閒活動中心內設有四張綠色的桌球桌。

examples.en: Fast-paced table tennis rallies demand lightning-fast hand-eye coordination.
examples.zh: 節奏極快的桌球抽球對攻極度考驗選手電光石火般的敏銳手眼協調反應。

examples.en: The community activity center installed three new tables for seniors to play table tennis.
examples.zh: 社區活動中心新添購了三張國際標準球桌，供社區長輩們打桌球切磋球技。

examples.en: Applying varied top-spin and back-spin gives table tennis serves deceptive trajectories.
examples.zh: 施加不同角度的上旋與下旋球，賦予了桌球發球極具欺騙性的刁鑽飛行弧線。

explains.en: It is an indoor sport played with small paddles and a light ball. Players hit the ball across a table and over a net. Quick movement and focus help.
Two or four people can play this fast game. They stand at opposite ends of a table and rally a tiny ball. The ball must bounce on the playing surface.
This sport uses a net, paddles, and a small lightweight ball. Players try to send it past an opponent. It is also called ping-pong.

examples.en: The community swimming pool opens at 6:00 AM.
examples.zh: 社區游泳池早上六點開放。

examples.en: Always follow the lifeguard's safety instructions around the swimming pool.
examples.zh: 在游泳池畔務必遵循救生員的安全指引。

examples.en: The hotel features a rooftop heated swimming pool overlooking the harbor.
examples.zh: 該飯店設有一座俯瞰港灣的頂樓溫水游泳池。

examples.en: The community sports center has a heated indoor swimming pool.
examples.zh: 社區國民運動中心設有溫水室內游泳池。

examples.en: Lifeguards monitor swimmers closely at the crowded outdoor swimming pool.
examples.zh: 救生員在人潮擁擠的戶外游泳池旁密切監控泳客安全。

examples.en: The luxury hotel features a stunning rooftop infinity swimming pool.
examples.zh: 這間豪華飯店配有一座令人驚嘆的高空無邊際游泳池。

explains.en: People swim in this large place filled with water. A lifeguard may watch to keep everyone safe.
Some hotels have one on the roof, while schools may have one indoors. Swimmers should follow its safety rules.
Children can practice strokes and play in this specially built water area. It may be heated when the weather is cool.

examples.en: If you lose your purse, report to the police officer.
examples.zh: 如果遺失錢包，請向警察報案。

examples.en: The alert police officer directed heavy traffic during the rush hour.
examples.zh: 機警的警員在尖峰時段指揮疏導繁忙的車流。

examples.en: Police officers work around the clock to protect public safety.
examples.zh: 警察全天候二十四小時執勤以守護公共安全。

examples.en: Helpful police officers patrol community streets day and night.
examples.zh: 熱心助人的警察日以繼夜巡邏社區大街小巷。

examples.en: A brave police officer helped an elderly lost tourist find her hotel safely.
examples.zh: 一位熱心勇敢的警員耐心地協助一位迷路年長遊客平安返回下榻飯店。

examples.en: Traffic police officers directed crowded vehicle flow when traffic lights malfunctioned.
examples.zh: 當十字路口交通號誌故障停擺時，交通警員冒雨在路口中央指揮疏導車流。

explains.en: This person helps keep people safe and enforces the law. You can ask one for help if you are lost.
People in this job may direct cars at a busy crossing. They can also respond when someone reports a crime.
This public worker protects a community. A uniform often helps people recognize the worker.

examples.en: You should drink enough warm water every day.
examples.zh: 你每天應該喝足夠的溫開水。

examples.en: Students should review their lecture notes on the same day after class.
examples.zh: 學生應該在課後當天及時複習上課筆記。

examples.en: We should protect natural environments and reduce single-use plastic waste.
examples.zh: 我們應當保護自然環境並減少一次性塑膠垃圾。

explains.en: This helping verb gives advice about what is a good idea. A person may use it to tell someone what to do. It can also express what is expected.
Use this word before an action to suggest the right thing to do. Drinking water each day is a healthy choice. It sounds gentler than giving a strong order.
This small verb can show duty or a sensible plan. It often comes before the plain form of an action. A student may use it when talking about good study habits.

examples.en: Squeeze a pea-sized amount of toothpaste onto the brush.
examples.zh: 擠碗豆大小的牙膏在牙刷上。

examples.en: This fluoride toothpaste helps prevent cavities.
examples.zh: 這款含氟牙膏有助於預防蛀牙。

examples.en: Buy a fresh tube of mint toothpaste from the supermarket.
examples.zh: 去超市買一條新的薄荷牙膏。

explains.en: It is a soft cleaning product used on a toothbrush. People use it to clean their teeth and freshen their breath. It often comes in a tube.
Put a small amount of this minty paste on a brush before cleaning your teeth. Some kinds contain fluoride to help protect against cavities. Rinse your mouth afterward.
This product helps remove food and plaque from teeth. It may have a mint flavor and is squeezed from a tube. Use it with a toothbrush each day.

examples.en: My brother loves reading Japanese comic books.
examples.zh: 我弟弟喜歡看日本漫畫書。

examples.en: He has collected hundreds of comic books in his bedroom.
examples.zh: 他在臥室裡收藏了數百本漫畫書。

examples.en: Many popular superhero movies are based on classic comic books.
examples.zh: 許多受歡迎的超級英雄電影都是改編自經典漫畫書。

explains.en: This book tells a story through drawings and speech bubbles. It may feature heroes, funny characters, or adventures.
Readers follow pictures and short pieces of dialogue from one page to the next. Many children enjoy collecting these illustrated stories.
A story in this kind of book is told mainly with pictures and words inside balloons. It can be funny or full of action.

examples.en: Don't play video games for too long without resting.
examples.zh: 別玩電玩太久而不休息。

examples.en: Playing cooperative video games with friends is very exciting.
examples.zh: 和朋友一起玩合作型電玩遊戲非常刺激。

examples.en: Modern video games feature stunning graphics and complex storylines.
examples.zh: 現代電玩遊戲具備令人驚嘆的畫面與複雜的故事情節。

explains.en: People play this electronic game on a screen using a controller or keyboard. It may have a story or a set of challenges.
Friends can enjoy this kind of digital entertainment together. Players may guide characters through different levels.
A computer or game machine can run this activity. Some versions let many people play online.

examples.en: Happy birthday to you! Make three wishes.
examples.zh: 祝你生日快樂！許三個願望吧。

examples.en: She received a lovely handwritten card on her eighteenth birthday.
examples.zh: 她在十八歲生日時收到了一張溫馨的手寫卡片。

examples.en: We celebrated my grandfather's birthday with a family feast.
examples.zh: 我們用一場全家盛宴來慶祝我祖父的生日。

explains.en: This is the yearly date when a person was born. Friends may bring a cake and sing a song. People often celebrate it with family.
Each year, this special day marks how long someone has been alive. A card or party may be part of the celebration. It comes on the same calendar date each year.
Use this word for the day someone celebrates their birth. People may make wishes and receive gifts. Children often look forward to it.

examples.en: Camping in the mountains is very peaceful and scenic.
examples.zh: 在山中露營非常寧靜而且風景優美。

examples.en: Remember to bring a warm sleeping bag when you go camping.
examples.zh: 去露營時記得帶上保暖的睡袋。

examples.en: Many families enjoy weekend camping to escape the busy city.
examples.zh: 許多家庭喜歡在週末露營以遠離繁忙喧囂的城市。

explains.en: It is an outdoor activity where people sleep in tents or under the stars. They may bring sleeping bags and cook outside. Families often do it near a lake.
People take this trip to enjoy nature away from busy streets. They set up a tent and spend the night outdoors. A warm sleeping bag is useful.
This activity means staying outside overnight, often in a tent. Hikers may do it in the mountains or forest. It can be a peaceful way to spend a weekend.

examples.en: We went hiking on Elephant Mountain last Saturday.
examples.zh: 我們上週六去象山健行。

examples.en: Wear sturdy hiking boots to protect your ankles on rocky trails.
examples.zh: 在崎嶇石徑上健行時要穿著結實的登山鞋以保護腳踝。

examples.en: Morning hiking through the mist is refreshing and energizing.
examples.zh: 在晨霧中健行既提神又令人精力充沛。

examples.en: Hiking Elephant Mountain rewards visitors with a stunning Taipei view.
examples.zh: 健行象山步道能回報遊客絕美的台北全景。

examples.en: Wear sturdy waterproof boots when going hiking on mountain trails.
examples.zh: 前往高山登山步道健行時請穿著堅固防水的登山靴。

examples.en: Hiking through cedar forests is wonderful for improving lung capacity and peace of mind.
examples.zh: 在杉木森林中漫步健行對提升肺活量與沉澱心靈大有裨益。

examples.en: Hiking Taiwan's legendary 'Baiyue' (Top 100 Peaks) rewards climbers with cloud seas.
examples.zh: 挑戰攀登台灣百岳高山健行，沿途壯麗壯闊的翻騰雲海日出能洗滌所有登山者的疲憊。

examples.en: Bring trekking poles, rain jackets, and headlamps whenever you go hiking in remote backcountry.
examples.zh: 無論何時深入偏遠山林進行登山健行，請務必隨身攜帶登山杖、專業雨衣與頭燈備用。

examples.en: Weekend hiking on suburban trails allows busy office workers to reconnect with pristine nature.
examples.zh: 週末走入近郊登山步道健行，能讓終日忙碌的上班族徹底放鬆身心並回歸大自然的懷抱。

entries.definition: 健行；遠足；登山步道健行；登山健行；百岳健行

explains.en: People walk along paths through hills or forests for exercise and fresh air. Strong shoes help protect their feet.
A family may spend a morning walking on a mountain trail. They should bring water and watch their steps.
This outdoor activity takes people on foot through nature, sometimes uphill. It can lead to beautiful views.

examples.en: You can buy steaming hot dogs at convenience stores.
examples.zh: 你可以在便利商店買到熱騰騰的熱狗。

examples.en: Squeeze mustard and ketchup generously onto your hot dog.
examples.zh: 在你的熱狗上大方擠上黃芥末醬和番茄醬。

examples.en: Hot dogs are a classic treat served at American baseball games.
examples.zh: 熱狗是在美國棒球比賽中供應的經典美食。

explains.en: This popular snack is a sausage served inside a long soft roll. People often add mustard or ketchup.
You may buy this warm food at a ball game or convenience store. It is easy to eat by hand.
A cook places a cooked sausage in bread to make this meal. Some people enjoy it with onions or relish.

examples.en: I ordered a burger with a side of crispy French fries.
examples.zh: 我點了一個漢堡附帶一份酥脆薯條。

examples.en: Dip your hot French fries into tangy tomato ketchup.
examples.zh: 把熱呼呼的薯條沾上酸甜濃郁的番茄醬。

examples.en: Freshly fried French fries taste best when seasoned with salt.
examples.zh: 剛炸好的薯條撒上一點鹽巴調味時滋味最棒。

explains.en: These are long pieces of potato cooked in hot oil until soft inside and crisp outside. People often eat them beside a sandwich or burger. They may add salt or a dipping sauce.
A cook cuts potatoes into sticks and fries them in oil. The finished snack is usually served hot. Tomato sauce is a popular dip.
This popular side dish is made from sliced potatoes. The pieces turn golden and crunchy when cooked in oil. Many people sprinkle them with salt.

examples.en: Crispy fried chicken is irresistible and mouthwatering.
examples.zh: 酥脆的炸雞令人難以抗拒且垂涎三尺。

examples.en: Taiwanese salted crispy fried chicken is famous worldwide.
examples.zh: 台灣的鹹酥雞在全世界都享負盛名。

examples.en: We ordered a large bucket of fried chicken for the Friday party.
examples.zh: 我們為週五派對訂購了一大桶炸雞。

explains.en: It is chicken cooked in hot oil until the outside is crisp. The inside stays juicy when prepared well. People often eat it with rice or vegetables.
A cook coats pieces of poultry and fries them until golden. This popular meal may be seasoned with salt and spices. A family might share a bucket.
The dish has a crunchy outer layer and tender meat inside. It is served in many restaurants and at parties. Some versions are spicy.

examples.en: Glazed donuts pair perfectly with black coffee.
examples.zh: 糖霜甜甜圈與黑咖啡是絕配。

examples.en: The bakery offers chocolate-filled donuts every morning.
examples.zh: 這家麵包烘焙坊每天早晨都供應巧克力夾心甜甜圈。

examples.en: Children love donuts coated in colorful sugar sprinkles.
examples.zh: 小朋友們非常喜愛裹上繽紛彩色糖粒的甜甜圈。

explains.en: This round baked treat often has a hole in the middle and may have icing or sprinkles. Bakeries sell many flavors.
People sometimes eat this sweet pastry with a drink at breakfast. A chocolate filling can go inside it.
A ring-shaped cake made from fried dough is often covered with sugar. Children may choose one with colorful toppings.

examples.en: Pingtung produces the sweetest black pearl wax apples.
examples.zh: 屏東生產最甜的黑珍珠蓮霧。

examples.en: Wax apples are crisp, juicy, and perfect for hot weather.
examples.zh: 蓮霧清脆多汁，非常適合在炎熱天氣食用。

examples.en: Tourists from abroad are fascinated by the bell shape of wax apples.
examples.zh: 外國遊客對蓮霧鐘狀的獨特外形感到十分好奇著迷。

examples.en: Pingtung Black Pearl wax apples are prized for their crisp bite and floral sweetness.
examples.zh: 屏東林邊沿海以天然微鹹海水栽培出的黑珍珠蓮霧色澤黝黑發亮、口感清脆爽口、清甜多汁。

examples.en: Biting into a chilled wax apple provides instant hydration and refreshing tropical relief.
examples.zh: 大口咬下一顆冰鎮過的爽脆黑金剛蓮霧，清甜汁水瞬間爆發，帶來無比消暑沁涼的熱帶快感。

examples.en: Gift boxes filled with giant dark purple wax apples are among the most prestigious seasonal gifts.
examples.zh: 裝滿色澤黑紫透亮、個頭碩大的特級黑金剛蓮霧頂級水果禮盒，是逢年過節最顯尊貴大氣的頂級伴手禮。

entries.definition: 蓮霧；蓮霧（黑珍珠／黑金剛蓮霧）

explains.en: This bell-shaped tropical fruit has smooth skin and juicy flesh. It is crisp and refreshing when chilled.
Farmers in Taiwan grow this fruit, including dark purple kinds. People often enjoy it during warm weather.
A bite of this mild, juicy fruit can help quench thirst. Its shape is wide near the bottom and narrow near the stem.

examples.en: Red dragon fruit is packed with healthy fiber and vitamins.
examples.zh: 紅肉火龍果富含健康纖維和維生素。

examples.en: Dragon fruit smoothies have an eye-catching bright magenta color.
examples.zh: 火龍果冰沙擁有吸睛亮眼的艷紫紅色澤。

examples.en: You can easily peel a ripe dragon fruit by cutting it in half.
examples.zh: 把熟透的火龍果對半切開就能輕鬆剝皮。

examples.en: Vibrant crimson red-flesh dragon fruits are packed with antioxidant anthocyanins and dietary fiber.
examples.zh: 果肉艷紅如玫瑰花瓣的紅肉火龍果富含珍貴的天然抗氧化花青素與豐富水溶性膳食纖維。

examples.en: She blended frozen dragon fruit cubes into a brilliant magenta smoothie bowl for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她在早餐時將冷凍紅肉火龍果丁放入調理機攪打，做出一碗色澤驚艷奪目的芭比桃紅果昔碗。

examples.en: The striking scaly outer skin of the dragon fruit makes it one of the most distinctive exotic fruits.
examples.zh: 火龍果外表覆蓋著如同巨龍鱗片般醒目鮮綠的奇特萼片，是熱帶水果中最具辨識度的外貌擔當。

entries.definition: 火龍果；紅肉火龍果；紅龍果 (Pitaya)

explains.en: This tropical fruit has bright flesh with many tiny black seeds. Its thick skin is often pink with green tips. People can scoop out the soft inside and eat it.
The outside of this fruit looks unusual, with colorful scales. Inside, the flesh may be white or deep pink. It is often cut in half and eaten fresh.
This fruit grows on a cactus and has a mild, sweet taste. Its vivid inside adds color to drinks and snacks. A ripe one is easy to peel after cutting it open.

examples.en: Shilin Night Market is one of the most famous in Taipei.
examples.zh: 士林夜市是台北最著名的夜市之一。

examples.en: Touring night markets is an essential experience for visitors to Taiwan.
examples.zh: 造訪夜市是造訪台灣的外國旅客必備的體驗。

examples.en: Night market vendors serve sizzling pepper buns, oyster omelets, and bubble tea.
examples.zh: 夜市攤販供應著熱氣騰騰的胡椒餅、蚵仔煎與珍珠奶茶。

examples.en: Shilin Night Market attracts millions of international travelers each year.
examples.zh: 士林夜市每年吸引數百萬國際旅客造訪。

examples.en: Wandering through Taiwanese night markets is a wonderful culinary adventure.
examples.zh: 逛台灣夜市是一場美妙無比的美食冒險。

examples.en: Night market vendors start setting up their food stalls around 5 PM.
examples.zh: 夜市攤販大約在下午五點左右開始擺設美食攤位。

explains.en: It is an outdoor shopping area that becomes busy after dark. Visitors can buy snacks, clothes, and small goods. Many Taiwanese towns have one.
Stalls open in the evening and sell food and other items. People walk through the lanes, taste local dishes, and shop. The atmosphere is lively.
This evening marketplace is a popular place to eat and browse. Vendors may serve pepper buns, oyster omelets, and tea. Crowds often visit after sunset.

examples.en: We spent our rainy Sunday afternoon in the shopping mall.
examples.zh: 我們下雨的週日下午都在購物中心度過。

examples.en: The gigantic shopping mall includes department stores, restaurants, and a cinema.
examples.zh: 這座大型購物中心匯聚了百貨公司、餐廳與電影院。

examples.en: Many families visit the mall during weekends for dining and entertainment.
examples.zh: 許多家庭在週末前往商場用餐與從事休閒娛樂。

explains.en: This large building has many shops, places to eat, and sometimes a movie theater. Families visit it on rainy days.
People can buy clothes, books, and gifts in one place under a roof. There may also be a food court inside.
A city may have a big indoor center where shoppers visit many stores. Friends can eat and watch a film there too.

examples.en: May I try on this denim jacket?
examples.zh: 請問我可以試穿這件牛仔夾克嗎？

examples.en: You should always try on running shoes to check the fit and comfort.
examples.zh: 你買慢跑鞋時務必要試穿，以檢查合腳度與舒適感。

examples.en: She entered the fitting room to try on three elegant evening dresses.
examples.zh: 她走進試衣間試穿了三套高雅的晚禮服。

examples.en: May I try on these leather sneakers in size nine?
examples.zh: 我可以試穿這雙九號的真皮球鞋嗎？

examples.en: Always try on formal suits before buying them to ensure the right sleeve length.
examples.zh: 買正式西裝前務必試穿以確認袖長恰當。

examples.en: She tried on several hats before deciding on the wool beanie.
examples.zh: 她試戴了好幾頂帽子後才決定買下那頂羊毛毛帽。

entries.definition: 試穿（衣物、鞋子）；試穿；試戴

explains.en: Put a piece of clothing on briefly to see whether it fits. A fitting room is a good place to do this.
Before buying shoes, wear them for a moment and walk around. This helps you check their comfort.
A shopper may wear a jacket or hat for a short time in a store. Then the shopper can decide whether it feels right.

examples.en: Dad will pick me up at the school gate at 5:00 PM.
examples.zh: 爸爸下午五點會在校門口接我。

examples.en: Volunteers helped pick up plastic trash scattered along the coastal beach.
examples.zh: 志工們協助撿拾散落在海岸沙灘上的塑膠垃圾。

examples.en: Children pick up foreign languages quickly through immersive play.
examples.zh: 小孩子在沉浸式遊戲環境中能迅速學會外語。

explains.en: You do this when you lift something from a surface. A parent may also come in a car to collect a child. The surrounding words show which meaning is intended.
This phrase can mean gathering litter from the ground. It can also describe learning a new skill without much formal teaching. Context helps tell the sense.
Use these words for collecting a person or object and taking it somewhere. They may also describe learning through practice. A hand or vehicle often does the collecting.

examples.en: Taking the stairs instead of the elevator is great exercise.
examples.zh: 走樓梯代替搭電梯是很棒的運動。

examples.en: Walk down the flight of stairs carefully and hold the handrail.
examples.zh: 走下這段樓梯時要小心並握好扶手。

examples.en: She sat on the front porch stairs enjoying the cool evening breeze.
examples.zh: 她坐在前門門廊台階上享受著涼爽的晚風。

explains.en: They are a set of steps that lets people move between floors. A handrail can help someone climb safely. People may use them instead of an elevator.
These steps connect the ground floor with an upper level. Walk carefully and hold the rail when going down. A porch may have a few outside.
A building may have these steps inside or outside. They help people go up and down between levels. Climbing them can also be good exercise.

examples.en: Put your pens, pencils, and eraser into the pencil case.
examples.zh: 把你的原子筆、鉛筆和橡皮擦放進筆袋裡。

examples.en: She bought a stylish canvas pencil case for the new school semester.
examples.zh: 她為新學期買了一個時尚的帆布鉛筆盒。

examples.en: I forgot my pencil case at home and had to borrow a pen from a classmate.
examples.zh: 我把鉛筆盒忘在家裡，只好向同學借筆。

explains.en: Students keep pencils, pens, and an eraser in this small school item. It may have a zipper or snap.
This container fits inside a backpack and keeps writing tools together. Some are made of cloth or plastic.
A child may open this case at a desk to take out a pencil. It helps keep supplies from getting lost.

examples.en: You can track the bus arrival time using this app.
examples.zh: 你可以用這款 APP 查詢公車到站時間。

examples.en: Download our fitness app to record your daily running routes and calories.
examples.zh: 下載我們的健身 APP 來記錄每日慢跑路線與卡路里。

examples.en: Mobile banking apps make transferring money safe and effortless.
examples.zh: 行動銀行 APP 讓轉帳變得既安全又省力。

examples.en: Download the Taipei Bus app to check real-time arrival estimates.
examples.zh: 下載台北公車 App 以查詢即時預估到站時間。

examples.en: This language-learning app sends daily vocabulary reminders to your lock screen.
examples.zh: 這款語言學習 App 每天會發送單字提醒至你的鎖定畫面。

examples.en: Developers released a major app update to fix bugs and improve performance.
examples.zh: 開發團隊發布了重大的 App 更新以修復漏洞並提升效能。

explains.en: This program runs on a phone or tablet and helps with a task. One may show bus times or teach a language.
People download this kind of software to send messages or edit pictures. A small icon usually opens it.
A mobile device can use this program to check the weather. Updates may add features or fix problems.

examples.en: A smooth mouse pad helps you move the cursor accurately.
examples.zh: 一塊平滑的滑鼠墊能幫你精準移動游標。

examples.en: Gamers often choose oversized desk mouse pads for swift hand movements.
examples.zh: 電競玩家常選擇超大桌上滑鼠墊以便快速移動雙手。

examples.en: The ergonomic gel mouse pad provides comfortable wrist support during long hours.
examples.zh: 符合人體工學的凝膠滑鼠墊在長時間使用時提供舒適的手腕支撐。

explains.en: This flat mat sits on a desk under a computer pointing device. Its smooth surface helps the device move easily. Some have a soft cushion for the wrist.
A computer user moves a small hand device across this surface to guide a pointer on screen. It may be made of cloth, rubber, or gel. It can protect a desk from scratches.
This desk accessory gives a computer control device a steady place to slide. A larger one may leave room for a keyboard too. A padded edge can make long use more comfortable.

examples.en: Turn on the light when the room gets dark.
examples.zh: 天色變暗時請把電燈打開。

examples.en: It is boiling hot inside; please turn on the air conditioner.
examples.zh: 室內熱得受不了，請把冷氣打開。

examples.en: Press the power button to turn on your computer.
examples.zh: 按下電源按鈕以啟動電腦。

explains.en: Use this phrase when making a light or machine start working. Press a switch or button to do it. The opposite action stops it.
A dark room becomes bright after someone uses the wall switch. A fan can also start when its control is pressed. This action begins the flow of power.
Before using a computer, a person may press its power button. The same action can make an air conditioner run. It changes a device from off to working.

examples.en: Please turn off your mobile phone during the concert.
examples.zh: 音樂會進行時請關閉手機電源。

examples.en: Remember to turn off all electrical appliances before leaving home.
examples.zh: 出門前請記得關閉所有電器設備。

examples.en: Turn off the bedroom lamp so we can get some restful sleep.
examples.zh: 關掉臥室檯燈，這樣我們才能好好睡一覺。

explains.en: Press the button so a lamp stops shining. Do this before leaving the room to save power.
At a concert, people silence their phones by making the power stop. A bedroom becomes dark when the lamp is no longer on.
When a machine is no longer needed, use its switch to stop it running. Remember to do this before going out.

examples.en: Could you turn up the volume a little bit?
examples.zh: 能把音量稍微調大一點嗎？

examples.en: She turned up the heater because the winter wind was freezing.
examples.zh: 因為寒冬凜冽，她把電暖器溫度調高了。

examples.en: He didn't turn up for the morning meeting due to sudden traffic delays.
examples.zh: 由於突發的交通延誤，他沒有在早晨的會議上現身。

explains.en: Make the sound louder by moving a control higher. You can do this to a radio or television.
This phrase can also mean arriving at a place, sometimes unexpectedly. Friends may hope everyone comes to a party.
Move a heater setting higher when a room feels cold. A person who was missing may also show up at an event.

examples.en: Please turn down the music; grandma is sleeping.
examples.zh: 請把音樂關小聲點，奶奶正在睡覺。

examples.en: He had to turn down the job offer because the commute was too long.
examples.zh: 因為通勤路程太遙遠，他不得不婉拒那份工作邀約。

examples.en: Turn down the stove flame to a simmer after the soup boils.
examples.zh: 湯滾後把爐火轉小繼續燉煮。

examples.en: Please turn down the TV volume while the baby is sleeping.
examples.zh: 小寶寶在睡覺，請把電視音量調小聲一點。

examples.en: She politely turned down the overseas job offer because she wanted to stay near her parents.
examples.zh: 為了能常伴在年邁父母身旁盡孝，她極其婉轉客氣地婉拒了海外跨國企業的優渥邀約。

examples.en: Don't forget to turn down the stove gas burner once the hearty broth reaches a boil.
examples.zh: 當鍋內濃郁的高湯煮沸翻滾之後，切記隨手將瓦斯爐火轉為小火慢燉細煲。

explains.en: You do this to make music or a television quieter. You can also do it to an offer when you say no. The meaning depends on what comes after the phrase.
This phrase can mean lowering the heat from a stove. It can also mean refusing a job or invitation. In both uses, something is reduced or declined.
A person may use these words to ask for less sound. Someone may also use them when choosing not to accept an opportunity. The object in the sentence tells which idea fits.

examples.en: Plug in the toaster to make some crispy bread.
examples.zh: 插上烤麵包機電源來烤幾片酥脆麵包。

examples.en: Make sure your electric vehicle is plugged in to recharge overnight.
examples.zh: 確認電動車已插上充電插頭以便夜間充電。

examples.en: Plug in the headphones so you can listen to music without disturbing others.
examples.zh: 插上耳機，這樣你就能聽音樂而不打擾他人。

explains.en: Connect an appliance to electricity by putting its plug into a socket. A toaster needs this before it can work. Unplug it when it is not needed.
Headphones can be connected to a phone or computer with a cord. This lets sound reach the listener. Make sure the connector fits the opening.
Use this action to join a device to a power source. An electric car needs a cable before its battery can recharge. The connection supplies electricity.

examples.en: Did you remember to pack your phone charger?
examples.zh: 你有記得把手機充電器放進行李嗎？

examples.en: Carry a universal travel charger when traveling across foreign countries.
examples.zh: 出國旅遊跨國旅行時請攜帶萬用旅行充電轉接頭。

examples.en: This magnetic wireless charger powers your smart watch conveniently on the desk.
examples.zh: 這款磁吸式無線充電器能方便地在桌上為智慧手錶充電。

examples.en: Did anyone bring a USB-C phone charger I can borrow?
examples.zh: 有人帶了可以借我用的 Type-C 手機充電器嗎？

examples.en: Don't leave your phone charger plugged into the wall outlet overnight.
examples.zh: 切勿將手機充電器插在壁插上整夜不拔。

examples.en: Fast chargers can power up modern smartphone batteries to 80% in half an hour.
examples.zh: 快速充電器能在半小時內將現代智慧型手機電池充至 80%。

explains.en: This device stores power so a phone or tablet can work again after its battery runs low. It plugs into a wall socket.
Bring this small item on a trip when your phone needs power. One end connects to the device and the other to an outlet.
A cable may connect this accessory to a phone. It sends electricity into the battery.

examples.en: Is there free Wi-Fi available at this cafe?
examples.zh: 這家咖啡廳有提供免費無線網路嗎？

examples.en: What is the password to connect to the hotel lobby Wi-Fi?
examples.zh: 連接飯店大廳 Wi-Fi 的密碼是什麼？

examples.en: The public library provides fast, secure Wi-Fi for all visitors.
examples.zh: 這座公共圖書館為所有讀者提供快速且安全的無線網路。

examples.en: Free public Wi-Fi is accessible across Taipei MRT stations.
examples.zh: 台北捷運各站均提供免費公共 Wi-Fi 無線上網。

examples.en: Could you tell me the password for the cafe Wi-Fi network?
examples.zh: 請問能告訴我這家咖啡館的 Wi-Fi 無線網路密碼嗎？

examples.en: The laptop automatically reconnected to the home Wi-Fi upon opening.
examples.zh: 一打開螢幕，筆記型電腦就自動重新連上了家中的 Wi-Fi。

explains.en: This wireless connection lets phones and computers reach the internet. A password may be needed to join it.
A cafe or library may offer this network to visitors. Devices connect without a cable.
At home, this signal can link a laptop to the internet. Its name often appears in a device's network list.

examples.en: Good night! Sleep well and sweet dreams.
examples.zh: 晚安！睡個好覺，祝好夢。

examples.en: Ensure your bedroom is dark and quiet so you can sleep well.
examples.zh: 確保臥室陰暗安靜，這樣你才能睡個好覺。

examples.en: Exercising regularly helps people sleep well without needing medications.
examples.zh: 規律運動有助於人們睡得香甜而無需依賴藥物。

explains.en: These words wish someone a good, restful night. A person may say them before going to bed. They can also describe getting peaceful rest.
A quiet, dark room can help a person do this at night. The body rests while the person is asleep. Exercise and a regular bedtime may help.
Use this phrase to wish someone a peaceful night. It can also tell that someone rests comfortably. People often say it when saying good night.

examples.en: Be careful with the scissors so you don't cut yourself.
examples.zh: 拿剪刀時請小心，別割傷自己。

examples.en: He cut himself while slicing fresh tomatoes with a sharp kitchen knife.
examples.zh: 他在用鋒利菜刀切新鮮番茄時不慎割傷了自己。

examples.en: If you accidentally cut yourself, wash the small wound with clean water immediately.
examples.zh: 如果你不小心割傷自己，請立即用清水清洗小傷口。

explains.en: A person may accidentally make a small wound on their own skin with a knife or scissors. Clean the area with water and cover it. Be careful while preparing food.
This phrase describes causing an injury to your own body with a sharp object. A kitchen knife can do this while slicing vegetables. Wash the wound gently.
Someone can hurt their own skin while handling scissors. The injury may be small, but it should be cleaned. Ask an adult for help if it is serious.

examples.en: Put a band-aid on your scraped finger.
examples.zh: 在擦傷的手指上貼一張 OK 繃。

examples.en: The mother placed a cute cartoon band-aid on her daughter's grazed knee.
examples.zh: 母親在女兒擦破皮的膝蓋上貼了一張可愛的卡通 OK 繃。

examples.en: Keep a supply of sterile band-aids in your home first-aid kit.
examples.zh: 在家中的急救箱裡常備一些無菌 OK 繃。

examples.en: Stick a waterproof band-aid over your minor finger cut.
examples.zh: 在手指的微小割傷處貼上一塊防水 OK 繃。

examples.en: Carrying a few sterile band-aids in your backpack is always smart.
examples.zh: 在背包裡常備幾片無菌 OK 繃總是明智的做法。

examples.en: Temporary price subsidies are merely a band-aid solution to deep inflation.
examples.zh: 短期的物價補貼對於深層通膨問題只不過是治標不治本的權宜之計。

explains.en: Place this small sticky dressing over a minor cut to protect it. It has a soft pad in the center.
A child may choose one decorated with a cartoon after scraping a knee. It covers the sore spot while it heals.
Keep a few of these adhesive wound covers in a first-aid kit. They help protect small scrapes from dirt.

examples.en: The doctor called to share the good test results.
examples.zh: 醫生打電話通知良好的檢驗結果。

examples.en: Students waited anxiously for the university entrance exam test results.
examples.zh: 學生們焦急地等待著大學入學考試的成績揭曉。

examples.en: Routine blood test results help doctors assess your overall health profile.
examples.zh: 例行血液檢查結果有助於醫師評估你的整體健康概況。

explains.en: This is the score or finding shown after an examination. A student may check one after a quiz.
A doctor uses this information to understand a person's health. A lab may send it to a clinic.
It tells what an assessment discovered. The information may show a mark, number, or medical finding.

examples.en: Big sister helps take care of the puppy at home.
examples.zh: 姊姊在家幫忙照料小狗。

examples.en: You must learn to take care of yourself when living abroad independently.
examples.zh: 隻身在國外獨立生活時，你必須學會照顧自己。

examples.en: Experienced nursery nurses take care of newborn infants tenderly.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的育嬰護理師溫柔地照料新生嬰兒。

examples.en: Neighbors took care of our plants while we traveled abroad.
examples.zh: 我們出國旅遊期間，鄰居熱心幫忙照料陽台花草。

examples.en: Don't worry about tonight's dinner; I will take care of cooking and washing up.
examples.zh: 今晚的晚餐你完全不用操心，買菜下廚與飯後洗碗收拾全包在我身上。

examples.en: Drink plenty of warm water and take good care of your health during chilly weather.
examples.zh: 氣溫驟降寒流來襲時，請務必隨時多補充溫開水，悉心照料保養好自己的身體健康。

explains.en: You do this when you look after a person, animal, or plant. You make sure its needs are met. Feeding a puppy is one example.
This phrase can mean being responsible for a task. Someone may prepare dinner or water plants while others are away. It shows that the person will handle it.
Use these words when helping someone stay safe and well. Parents do this for children, and neighbors may do it for plants. It can also mean dealing with a job yourself.

examples.en: Who will look after your pet cat while you are away?
examples.zh: 你不在時誰會幫忙照料你的寵物貓？

examples.en: She kindly offered to look after her neighbor's plants during their vacation.
examples.zh: 她熱心主動提議在鄰居度假期間幫忙照料他們的盆栽。

examples.en: Parents work tirelessly to protect and look after their growing children.
examples.zh: 父母辛勤工作，以保護與悉心照顧逐漸成長的孩子。

examples.en: Big sister looked after her younger brother while parents worked.
examples.zh: 父母上班時，姊姊在家細心照顧年幼的弟弟。

examples.en: Can you look after my pet beagle for three days while I attend a conference in Taichung?
examples.zh: 我下週要去台中參加一場三天兩夜的學術研討會，你能幫忙照料一下我的米格魯愛犬嗎？

examples.en: Dedicated nurses work around the clock to look after newborn infants in the hospital nursery.
examples.zh: 愛心滿滿的專業護理人員日夜輪班值勤，在嬰兒室內無微不至地看顧剛出生的新生兒。

explains.en: Use this phrase when caring for a person, animal, or plant. A neighbor may water your flowers while you travel. Parents do this for their children.
A babysitter watches a child and makes sure the child is safe. Someone may also feed a pet and give it water. This is taking care of another living thing.
When a friend is sick, you can help them and make sure they have what they need. A gardener does this for plants. The phrase means caring for someone or something.

examples.en: What do you want to be when you grow up?
examples.zh: 你長大後想要做什麼工作？

examples.en: I grew up in a tranquil fishing village along the east coast.
examples.zh: 我在東海岸一個安寧純樸的漁村長大。

examples.en: Children grow up so fast before parents even realize it.
examples.zh: 在父母察覺之前，孩子們就已經飛快地長大成人了。

explains.en: Children become adults as the years pass. They may wonder what job they will have in the future.
She spent her childhood in a small seaside town. Her family lived there for many years.
People change as they get older and learn new things. Parents often say this happens very quickly.

examples.en: Hurry and get ready for school!
examples.zh: 快點準備好去上學！

examples.en: Put on your pajamas and get ready for bed.
examples.zh: 換上睡衣，準備上床睡覺囉。

examples.en: Athletes stretch thoroughly on the track to get ready for the 100-meter sprint.
examples.zh: 田徑選手在跑道上徹底拉筋暖身，為百米衝刺做好準備。

explains.en: Prepare yourself before school, bed, or a trip. You may pack a bag and put on your shoes.
Before an event begins, finish the things you need to do. Athletes stretch before a race.
This phrase tells someone to make preparations. Getting dressed can be one part of it.

examples.en: Always use the crosswalk when crossing the street.
examples.zh: 過馬路時務必走斑馬線。

examples.en: Drivers must yield right of way to pedestrians on crosswalks.
examples.zh: 駕駛在斑馬線上必須禮讓行人先行。

examples.en: The city repainted the bright white lines of the crosswalk outside the elementary school.
examples.zh: 市政府重新粉刷了小學校門口外明亮的斑馬線白色標線。

explains.en: This is a marked part of a road where people can walk across safely. Drivers should slow down and let them pass. White lines often show where it is.
People use this painted path to get from one side of a street to the other. It is often near a school or intersection. Cars must watch for people crossing.
This road marking shows a safe place for pedestrians to cross. It may have bright stripes on the pavement. Drivers are expected to yield there.

examples.en: Stop when the traffic light turns red.
examples.zh: 紅綠燈亮紅燈時請停下。

examples.en: The vehicle proceeded cautiously as the traffic light switched to green.
examples.zh: 當號誌燈轉為綠燈時，車輛謹慎前行。

examples.en: Smart traffic light systems adjust light cycles according to real-time traffic flow.
examples.zh: 智慧型交通號誌系統會根據即時車流量自動調整紅綠燈秒數週期。

explains.en: It is a road signal with colored lamps that tells drivers when to stop or go. Red means wait, while green allows movement. Walkers should also pay attention.
This device controls the flow of cars at a crossing. Its colors change in order to keep people safe. A red lamp tells vehicles to wait.
A signal at an intersection uses red, yellow, and green. Drivers follow it to know when to stop or continue. It can help prevent crashes.

examples.en: If you lose your purse, report to the police station.
examples.zh: 如果遺失皮夾，請去派出所報案。

examples.en: The local police station is situated right next to the town hall.
examples.zh: 當地的警察局就座落在鎮公所隔壁。

examples.en: Helpful police officers at the station assisted the lost tourist in finding her hotel.
examples.zh: 派出所熱心的警察協助迷路的外國觀光客找到了飯店。

examples.en: You can report a lost wallet at the nearest neighborhood police station.
examples.zh: 您可以在最近的社區派出所報案申報遺失皮夾。

examples.en: Local police stations offer round-the-clock assistance and warm tea to citizens in need.
examples.zh: 地方派出所全天候二十四小時為有需要的求助民眾提供即時協助與熱茶。

examples.en: A red light glowing above the neighborhood police station entrance signals safety.
examples.zh: 社區派出所門口高高懸掛的紅燈籠標誌散發著令人心安的守護溫暖。

explains.en: People go here to report a crime or ask officers for help. It is where police officers work.
If someone loses a wallet, they can tell the officers at this local building. The doors may be open day and night.
A lost child can wait here with a helpful officer while their family is found. The building serves the neighborhood.

examples.en: Fire trucks rushed out of the fire station quickly.
examples.zh: 消防車迅速駛出消防局。

examples.en: Local elementary school students visited the fire station on an educational field trip.
examples.zh: 當地的國小學生造訪了消防局進行教育性的校外教學參訪。

examples.en: The fire station operates twenty-four hours a day to safeguard the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 這座消防局全天候二十四小時運作以守護社區安全。

explains.en: Firefighters work at this building and keep their trucks there. They leave quickly when an alarm sounds.
People can visit this place to learn about fire safety. Its crew is ready to help during an emergency.
A town has this station for the team that puts out fires. The building may also hold rescue equipment.

examples.en: We need to stop by the gas station to fill up the tank.
examples.zh: 我們需要順道去加油站把油箱加滿。

examples.en: Modern gas stations often feature convenience stores and clean restrooms.
examples.zh: 現代化的加油站通常附設便利商店與乾淨的洗手間。

examples.en: Many gas stations now offer high-speed electric vehicle charging stations.
examples.zh: 許多加油站現在都增設了高速電動車充電樁。

examples.en: Stop at the highway service area gas station to refuel and take a break.
examples.zh: 在高速公路休息服務區的加油站稍作停留，順便為愛車加滿油並休息。

examples.en: We pulled into a 24-hour self-service gas station in the middle of nowhere to pump fuel.
examples.zh: 荒郊野外的深夜裡，我們把車輛緩緩開進一家二十四小時營業的無人自助加油站為油箱補足汽油。

examples.en: Many modern gas stations feature convenience stores, clean restrooms, and automatic car washes.
examples.zh: 許多現代大型加油站複合式經營，內部不僅附設大型連鎖便利商店、乾淨公廁，還配有全自動隧道洗車機。

explains.en: This is a place where drivers stop to put fuel in their vehicles. It may also have a small shop and restrooms. Some now provide charging for electric cars.
People bring cars or motorcycles here when the fuel tank is low. They can pay at a pump or inside a shop. Travelers may take a break there too.
This roadside business sells fuel for vehicles. Many locations also sell snacks and drinks. A driver may stop there during a long trip.

examples.en: There is an underground parking lot below the mall.
examples.zh: 購物中心地下設有室內停車場。

examples.en: The outdoor parking lot was completely filled to capacity on the holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 連假週末時室外停車場完全停滿了車輛。

examples.en: Customers who spend over a thousand dollars receive two hours of free parking lot validation.
examples.zh: 消費滿千元的顧客可獲得兩小時停車場免費折抵。

explains.en: It is an area where people leave their cars while they shop or work. Spaces are marked for each vehicle. Some are outside and others are underground.
Drivers pull into this place and stop their vehicles for a while. A mall may have a large one below the building. Signs show where to park.
This area provides spaces for cars near shops or offices. Customers may leave a vehicle there and walk to their destination. It can be full on a holiday.

examples.en: SOGO is a renowned department store chain in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 太平洋 SOGO 是台灣著名的連鎖百貨公司。

examples.en: Crowds gathered early for the department store's annual anniversary sale.
examples.zh: 大批人潮很早就聚集等待百貨公司的一年一度週年慶特賣。

examples.en: The top floor of the department store houses fine dining restaurants.
examples.zh: 這棟百貨公司的頂樓匯聚了多間高級精緻餐廳。

examples.en: Mitsukoshi is a famous department store chain in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 新光三越是台灣知名的連鎖百貨公司。

examples.en: We bought high-quality kitchenware on the eighth floor of the department store.
examples.zh: 我們在百貨公司的八樓買了高品質的廚房用品。

examples.en: The department store was packed with shoppers during the anniversary sale.
examples.zh: 週年慶特賣期間百貨公司擠滿了購物人潮。

explains.en: This large shop sells clothes, furniture, toys, and other goods on different floors. It may also have a restaurant.
Families can buy many kinds of household items in this city building. An elevator takes shoppers between its floors.
A shopper may visit several sections in one building, from clothing to kitchen goods. There may be a cafe upstairs.

examples.en: I prefer a window seat so I can see the clouds.
examples.zh: 我喜歡靠窗座位，這樣能看窗外的雲彩。

examples.en: Sitting in a window seat lets you admire the sparkling lights of the city below.
examples.zh: 坐在靠窗座位上能讓你欣賞下方城市閃爍璀璨的夜景。

examples.en: She requested a window seat when booking her bullet train ticket.
examples.zh: 她在訂高鐵票時特意要求劃了一個靠窗座位。

explains.en: This place to sit is beside a window. Travelers often choose it to see the view outside.
On a train or plane, you can look at clouds or scenery from this seat. It is next to the glass.
A person sitting here can watch the world pass by. It may be found on a bus, train, or in a room.

examples.en: An aisle seat is convenient for getting up during flights.
examples.zh: 靠走道座位在飛行途中方便起身走動。

examples.en: Tall passengers often prefer an aisle seat for extra legroom.
examples.zh: 身材高挑的乘客通常偏好靠走道座位以獲得更多伸展雙腿的空間。

examples.en: If you drink a lot of water, choose an aisle seat for easy restroom access.
examples.zh: 如果你喝很多水，選擇靠走道座位可以方便去洗手間。

explains.en: This is a seat beside the open path between rows on a plane, bus, or theater. A person can stand up without asking others to move. Some travelers find it convenient.
When you choose this place on a flight, you sit next to the walkway. It gives your legs a little more room to stretch. You can reach the restroom easily.
Rows of seats often have a passage along one side. The chair next to that passage makes it easy to get in and out. People who need to move around may prefer it.

examples.en: Have your passport and boarding pass ready at the gate.
examples.zh: 在登機門前請備妥護照與登機證。
