examples.en: Passengers can store their digital boarding pass on their mobile phones.
examples.zh: 乘客可以將電子登機證儲存在手機中。

examples.en: Check the boarding time and departure gate number printed on your boarding pass.
examples.zh: 請留意列印在登機證上的登機時間與登機門編號。

examples.en: You can save paper by downloading a digital mobile boarding pass.
examples.zh: 下載手機數位電子登機證既環保又能節省紙張。

examples.en: Keep your boarding pass handy as gate agents inspect it before you board.
examples.zh: 請將登機證放在隨手可取之處，登機門地勤人員登機前會進行查驗。

examples.en: The airline ground crew printed our boarding passes at the self-check-in kiosk.
examples.zh: 航空公司地勤人員在自助報到機前協助我們列印出了登機證。

examples.en: Save your mobile QR-code boarding pass to your smartphone Apple Wallet.
examples.zh: 將您的手機 QR Code 數位電子登機證存入智慧型手機的 Apple 錢包。

examples.en: The ground staff checked my passport and handed me a printed paper boarding pass.
examples.zh: 地勤人員仔細查驗完我的出國護照後，親切遞上印製精美的實體紙本登機證。

examples.en: Make sure to keep your boarding pass handy because you must show it before stepping onto the plane.
examples.zh: 登機前請務必將登機證拿在手上隨時備查，因為在踏入機艙前空服員將再次確認座位號碼。

examples.en: Save your digital mobile boarding pass to your smartphone wallet app.
examples.zh: 建議在完成線上預辦登機後，將電子登機證直接加入手機錢包 App 方便感應掃描。

examples.en: Make sure you don't lose your paper boarding pass after clearing airport security.
examples.zh: 通過機場出境安全檢查通道後，請務必妥善保管好印有登機門資訊的紙本登機證。

examples.en: The gate attendant scanned her mobile boarding pass before welcoming her aboard.
examples.zh: 登機門地勤人員用手持掃描器感應掃描了她的手機電子登機證條碼，親切引導她步入空橋。

entries.definition: 登機證；機場登機證（紙本或電子）

explains.en: It is a paper or digital document needed to get onto an airplane. It shows the passenger's seat, flight, and gate. Keep it ready at the airport.
Before entering a plane, travelers show this travel document to staff. It may be stored on a phone or printed on paper. It includes important flight details.
Airline passengers use this proof when they go through the gate. It names the flight and often gives a seat number. A passport may also be needed for travel.

examples.en: Let's take a quick selfie in front of Taipei 101!
examples.zh: 我們在台北 101 前面拍張快速自拍吧！

examples.en: He used a telescopic selfie stick to include all his friends in the photo.
examples.zh: 他使用伸縮自拍棒以便將所有朋友都納入合照中。

examples.en: Smiling selfies taken during vacations evoke wonderful nostalgic memories.
examples.zh: 度假期間拍攝的燦爛自拍照能喚起美好的溫馨回憶。

examples.en: Tourists love taking selfies in front of the colorful Rainbow Village.
examples.zh: 遊客們喜歡在色彩斑斕的彩虹眷村前拍照自拍。

examples.en: Extend the telescopic selfie stick to fit all your friends into the frame.
examples.zh: 伸長伸縮自拍棒，好把所有的朋友通通納入鏡頭畫面中。

examples.en: She snapped a quick selfie with her best friend at the cafe entrance.
examples.zh: 她在咖啡館門口與她最好的摯友拍了一張迅速的合照自拍。

explains.en: A person holds a phone at arm’s length and takes a picture of themself. Friends may squeeze into the frame too.
Travelers often take this kind of photo in front of a famous place. They can share it with friends.
The front camera on a phone makes it easy to capture a picture of your own face. A long stick can help fit a group in.

examples.en: Careless mistakes on the math test cost him points.
examples.zh: 數學測驗上的粗心錯誤讓他丟了分數。

examples.en: It was careless of me to leave my backpack behind at the cafe.
examples.zh: 把背包遺忘在咖啡館裡真是我太粗心大意了。

examples.en: Careless driving in bad weather easily leads to traffic accidents.
examples.zh: 在惡劣天候下草率粗心的駕駛容易釀成交通事故。

explains.en: Someone who does not pay enough attention may make easy mistakes. Leaving a bag behind can be one example.
This describes an action done without enough care. Such behavior can cause trouble or an accident.
A person may forget to check work before turning it in. That person was not careful enough.

examples.en: Talking loudly in movie theaters is very impolite.
examples.zh: 在電影院裡大聲說話是非常沒禮貌的。

examples.en: It is considered impolite to chew with your mouth open at the table.
examples.zh: 在餐桌上咀嚼食物時張開嘴巴被視為很不禮貌。

examples.en: Staring rudely at strangers is an impolite habit you should avoid.
examples.zh: 無禮地盯著陌生人看是一項你應該避免的不禮貌舉止。

explains.en: This describes behavior that is rude or does not show good manners. Speaking loudly during a movie can seem this way. It may make other people uncomfortable.
People may use this word for actions that are not respectful. Chewing with an open mouth at dinner is an example. Good manners help avoid such behavior.
This adjective describes someone who acts without courtesy. Staring at strangers or interrupting can have this effect. A person can choose kinder behavior instead.

examples.en: Don't get impatient while waiting in long lines.
examples.zh: 排長隊等候時不要變得焦躁不耐煩。

examples.en: The driver sounded his car horn impatiently in the traffic gridlock.
examples.zh: 司機在車陣大打結中焦躁不安地猛按汽車喇叭。

examples.en: Children often become impatient when waiting for their turn to open gifts.
examples.zh: 小孩子在輪候打開自己的禮物時往往會按捺不住焦急的心情。

explains.en: It describes someone who finds waiting hard and wants something to happen soon. A child may feel this while standing in a long line. Taking a deep breath can help.
A person with this feeling may become annoyed when a turn takes too long. The opposite feeling is calm willingness to wait. It can show in a voice or actions.
Use this adjective for someone who cannot wait calmly. A driver may honk when traffic moves slowly. Children may feel this before opening a present.

examples.en: Hardworking students usually achieve their academic goals.
examples.zh: 勤勉用功的學生通常能達成學業目標。

examples.en: My parents are hardworking farmers who rise before dawn every morning.
examples.zh: 我的父母是勤勞樸實的農民，每天天未亮就早早起床。

examples.en: The promotion recognized her as the most hardworking and dedicated employee in the division.
examples.zh: 這次晉升肯定了她是部門中最勤勉且最敬業的員工。

explains.en: A student who studies carefully and keeps trying shows this quality. Such a person puts steady effort into schoolwork.
Some people work hard each day and do not give up when a task is difficult. Their effort can help them reach goals.
A child who practices regularly and finishes tasks with care can be described this way. It also describes a dedicated worker.

examples.en: Listening to acoustic guitar music makes me feel relaxed.
examples.zh: 聆聽木吉他音樂讓我感到心情非常放鬆。

examples.en: The hotel lounge offers a quiet, relaxed atmosphere for reading and casual chatting.
examples.zh: 飯店交誼廳提供了一個安靜悠閒的放鬆氛圍供人閱讀與輕鬆聊天。

examples.en: After finishing the final exams, the high school students looked visibly relaxed.
examples.zh: 期末考結束後，高中生們個個看起來明顯放鬆了許多。

explains.en: A person feels calm and has little worry. Quiet music may create this feeling.
This describes a peaceful mood without stress. After an exam, students may feel this way.
A place can have an easy, comfortable atmosphere. People there do not feel tense or hurried.

examples.en: Step out of the train carefully when doors open.
examples.zh: 車門開啟時請小心踏出列車。

examples.en: The school water dispenser is temporarily out of order for routine maintenance.
examples.zh: 學校飲水機因例行保養維護目前暫時故障暫停使用。

examples.en: I am afraid we have run completely out of milk for coffee this morning.
examples.zh: 恐怕今天早上我們沖泡咖啡用的牛奶已經完全喝光了。

explains.en: This phrase can tell that someone moves from inside a place to the outside. It can also mean that no supply remains, such as when the milk is gone. The nearby words show the sense.
A person stepping from a train moves from its inside to the platform. The same words can describe something unavailable because none is left. They have several uses in sentences.
Use this phrase when leaving an enclosed place. It may also say that an item or supply has run out. A third use can describe something broken or not working.

examples.en: No one likes getting stuck in a traffic jam.
examples.zh: 沒有人喜歡塞在車陣之中。

examples.en: The classroom was completely silent because no one spoke during the exam.
examples.zh: 考試期間沒有人說話，因此教室裡一片寂靜。

examples.en: No one can predict what surprising technological advances will arrive next.
examples.zh: 沒有人能夠預料接下來會出現什麼令人驚喜的科技突破。

explains.en: This expression means that there is not any person. The room was empty, so nobody was there. It can be the subject of a sentence.
Use these words when nobody is present or involved. Not a single student answered the question. The phrase refers to people, not things.
If a place has no people in it, this expression can describe the situation. Nobody came to the meeting. It means not any person at all.

examples.en: Convenience stores are found everywhere in Taiwanese cities.
examples.zh: 在台灣各大城市，便利商店隨處可見。

examples.en: Colorful blooming azaleas blossom everywhere on the university campus in spring.
examples.zh: 春天時校園處處盛開著五彩斑斕的杜鵑花。

examples.en: Mobile technology connects people everywhere, bridging oceans and continents.
examples.zh: 行動科技將各地的民眾連結在一起，跨越了重洋與大陸。

explains.en: There are flowers in every part of the garden. You can see them all around.
A helpful store can be found in many places across a city. It seems to be in all directions.
When rain falls over the whole region, roads and rooftops become wet in many places. The word describes being in all places.

examples.en: There are lots of delicious food stands at the night market.
examples.zh: 夜市裡有許許多多美味的小吃攤位。

examples.en: Children had lots of fun splashing around in the public fountain pool.
examples.zh: 孩子們在公共噴泉戲水池裡玩得不亦樂乎。

examples.en: Planting lots of green trees in urban districts purifies city air effectively.
examples.zh: 在都會區廣植綠樹能非常有效地淨化城市空氣。

explains.en: This phrase means a large number or amount. A busy market may have many food stalls.
Use it when there is more than just a little. Children may have a great deal of fun at a fair.
It describes plenty of something, such as books, time, or people. The noun after it tells what there is much of.

examples.en: The stars shine brightly in the deep darkness of night.
examples.zh: 星星在漆黑的深夜中明亮地閃爍。

examples.en: He turned on his flashlight to navigate through the total darkness of the cavern.
examples.zh: 他打開手電筒在洞穴伸手不見五指的完全黑暗中引路前行。

examples.en: Morning dawn slowly banished the cold darkness of the winter night.
examples.zh: 晨曦破曉逐漸驅散了寒冷冬夜的漆黑與寂寥。

explains.en: This is the state when there is little or no light. At night, the sky may have this quality. A flashlight helps people see in it.
A cave can be hard to explore when it is completely without light. Morning makes the surroundings easier to see. This word names the absence of brightness.
When the sun goes down and lamps are off, a room may be filled with this. Stars or a torch can be seen against it. It is the opposite of brightness.

examples.en: She changed her mind and ordered bubble green tea.
examples.zh: 她改變了心意，改點了珍珠綠茶。

examples.en: You can always change your mind before signing the final rental agreement.
examples.zh: 在簽署最終租賃合約之前，你隨時都可以改變心意。

examples.en: After hearing the convincing evidence, he completely changed his mind.
examples.zh: 在聽完令人信服的證據後，他徹底改變了原有的想法。

explains.en: Use this phrase when someone decides to do something different from the first plan. A person may choose another drink after seeing the menu. New information can affect a decision.
Someone can make a different choice after thinking again. A traveler may decide to stay home instead of going out. The phrase describes a changed opinion or decision.
After hearing new facts, a person may no longer agree with an earlier idea. They might select a different option. This expression means deciding differently.

examples.en: I completely agree with your study schedule proposal.
examples.zh: 我完全同意你的讀書計畫提議。

examples.en: Spicy food does not always agree with everyone's digestive system.
examples.zh: 辛辣重口味的食物並不一定適合每個人的腸胃消化系統。

examples.en: Does your team leader agree with the proposed new project deadlines?
examples.zh: 你們的專案負責人同意所提議的新截止日期嗎？

explains.en: You can share someone’s opinion and say that it is right. You may also say that a food does not suit your stomach.
Two friends may have the same view about a plan. A certain spicy meal may make one person feel unwell.
This phrase can show that you have the same opinion as another person. It can also describe food that suits someone well.

examples.en: Our weekend picnic will depend on the weather forecast.
examples.zh: 我們週末的野餐將視天氣預報而定。

examples.en: Young children depend heavily on their parents for care and security.
examples.zh: 年幼孩童在照料與安全感方面極為依賴父母。

examples.en: You can always depend on true friends to support you through hardships.
examples.zh: 你永遠可以信賴真正的朋友陪伴你度過人生的艱難時刻。

explains.en: The plan may change because of the weather. The picnic will happen only if the sky stays clear.
A young child needs a parent for food and care. A person may count on a friend for help.
The result is decided by something else. Whether we go outside may be based on the rain.

examples.en: Does this colorful pencil case belong to you?
examples.zh: 這個色彩繽紛的鉛筆盒是你的嗎？

examples.en: These precious cultural artifacts belong to national history archives.
examples.zh: 這些珍貴的文化歷史文物歸屬於國家歷史檔案庫。

examples.en: She felt a profound sense of peace as if she belonged to nature.
examples.zh: 她感受到一種深層的心靈平靜，彷彿自己真正屬於大自然。

explains.en: These words show who owns something. If a pencil case is yours, it is connected with you as its owner. They can also describe being part of a group.
Use this phrase to ask whether an object is someone's property. It may also describe a person feeling connected to a place or community. The subject and context help.
A book may be owned by a student, or an artifact may be part of a collection. This phrase expresses that connection. It can also describe fitting in with a group.

examples.en: The school sports day will take place next Friday.
examples.zh: 學校運動會將於下週五舉行。

examples.en: The historic international summit took place in the grand conference hall.
examples.zh: 這場歷史性的國際高峰會在大會議廳內盛大舉行。

examples.en: Profound social and technological changes took place during the last decade.
examples.zh: 在過去十年間，發生了深刻的社會與科技變革。

explains.en: Use this phrase when an event happens at a certain time or location. A school sports day may be held on Friday. A meeting can happen in a hall.
A concert or ceremony can occur according to a plan. The phrase tells that an event happens. It does not mean picking something up.
When an event is held, this expression describes its happening. A festival may occur in a town square. It can also describe changes that happen over time.

examples.en: Never mind! We can easily try again tomorrow.
examples.zh: 沒關係！我們明天可以輕鬆再試一次。

examples.en: Never mind the minor delay; we will still arrive ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 別在意這點微小的延誤，我們依然會比預定時間提前抵達。

examples.en: Oh, never mind; I just realized I already found my sunglasses in my bag.
examples.zh: 喔，沒關係了，我剛剛才發現我的太陽眼鏡就在背包裡。

explains.en: Say this when someone worries about a small mistake and you want them not to worry. It can also mean to ignore something.
A friend drops a pencil, but you say there is no problem. You can use this phrase to tell them not to worry.
If you decide that a detail is unimportant, you may tell someone to forget it. The words can gently end a conversation too.

examples.en: Cheer up! Everything will turn out great in the end.
examples.zh: 振作起來！最後一切都會好起來的。

examples.en: A warm cup of hot chocolate helped cheer her up on the rainy afternoon.
examples.zh: 一杯溫熱的熱巧克力幫助她在下雨的午後振作起精神開朗起來。

examples.en: We brought humorous comic books to cheer up our sick classmate in hospital.
examples.zh: 我們帶了幽默詼諧的漫畫書去醫院探望並為生病的同學打氣。

explains.en: Say something kind to help a sad person feel happier. A funny story may lift someone's mood.
This phrase can encourage someone who feels down. A friend may offer comfort after a hard day.
It can tell a person to become more hopeful. A warm drink and a kind visit may make someone smile.

examples.en: Take three deep breaths to help yourself calm down.
examples.zh: 深呼吸三次以幫助自己冷靜下來。

examples.en: Please calm down and explain clearly what just took place.
examples.zh: 請冷靜下來，並清楚說明剛剛究竟發生了什麼事情。

examples.en: The gentle ocean breeze helped calm down his racing, anxious thoughts.
examples.zh: 溫柔的海風吹拂，撫平了他原本急促焦慮的思緒。

explains.en: You do this when you become quieter and less upset. Slow breathing can help after a frightening moment. A gentle voice may help someone feel peaceful.
This phrase can be used to ask someone to relax and speak clearly. It may also describe making a worried person feel less anxious. Taking a few breaths can help.
When feelings become strong, a person can pause and breathe slowly. This helps the body and mind become peaceful again. Friends may say these words to offer comfort.

examples.en: Hurry up, or we will miss the MRT train!
examples.zh: 快一點，不然我們要錯過捷運列車了！

examples.en: Tell him to hurry up because the movie starts in five minutes.
examples.zh: 叫他動作快點，因為電影再過五分鐘就要開演了。

examples.en: We had to hurry up packing our bags before the airport shuttle arrived.
examples.zh: 我們必須在機場接駁專車抵達前趕緊打包好行李。

explains.en: Say this when asking someone to move or act faster. A family may need to leave soon to catch a train. It can sound urgent.
This phrase tells a person not to take so much time. Pack quickly before the bus arrives. People use it when they are in a rush.
When time is short, someone may ask a friend to do something faster. It can be used as a command. The speaker may be worried about being late.

examples.en: Please slow down when driving through school zones.
examples.zh: 開車經過學校路段時請減速慢行。

examples.en: Slow down your speaking pace so non-native listeners can understand easily.
examples.zh: 放慢你的講話語速，這樣非母語聽眾才能輕鬆理解。

examples.en: Weekends provide a precious chance to slow down and savor life.
examples.zh: 週末提供了一個放慢腳步、細細品味人生的珍貴契機。

explains.en: A driver should use less speed near a school. This helps keep children safe.
When someone talks too quickly, ask them to speak more slowly. A careful pace makes the words easier to follow.
After a busy day, take your time and enjoy each moment. This phrase can also mean reducing speed.

examples.en: Watch out! A scooter is coming around the corner.
examples.zh: 當心！有輛機車正從轉角過來。

examples.en: Watch out for wet, slippery steps after the heavy rainstorm.
examples.zh: 暴雨過後請當心走在潮濕濕滑的台階上。

examples.en: Hikers must watch out for steep loose rocks along the ridge trail.
examples.zh: 登山者沿著山脊步道行走時必須當心陡峭鬆動的岩石。

explains.en: Pay attention because danger may be near. Someone might shout this when a bike approaches.
Be careful around wet steps or sharp objects. This phrase warns a person to notice a risk.
A hiker should stay alert near loose stones. These words can warn someone to take care.

examples.en: Hold on a second, let me grab a pen.
examples.zh: 稍等一秒鐘，讓我拿支筆。

examples.en: Hold on tight to the safety rail while riding the roller coaster.
examples.zh: 搭乘雲霄飛車時，請牢牢緊握安全扶手。

examples.en: Hold on to your dreams even when circumstances feel discouraging.
examples.zh: 即使環境令人氣餒沮喪，也請緊握並堅持你的夢想。

examples.en: Hold on a second; I'll transfer your call to the service department.
examples.zh: 請稍候片刻，我馬上幫您轉接至客服部門。

examples.en: Hold on tight to the handrail while the subway train negotiates high-speed curves.
examples.zh: 當捷運列車在高速通過急轉彎路段時，請務必雙手緊緊握牢車廂內的防護扶手。

examples.en: The coach shouted encouragement from the sidelines, urging exhausted players to hold on.
examples.zh: 總教練在場邊大聲吶喊鼓勁，聲嘶力竭地激勵已逼近體能極限的球員咬牙堅持挺住。

entries.definition: 稍等一下；堅持住；等一下；別掛斷

explains.en: These words can mean wait for a short time. They can also tell someone to grip something firmly so they do not fall. The situation makes the meaning clear.
A person on a bumpy ride should keep a tight grip on the rail. On a phone, someone may ask the other person to wait. The phrase has both uses.
Use this phrase to ask for a moment before continuing. It can also mean keeping a strong grip or not giving up. What is happening tells which sense is meant.

examples.en: Teenagers love to hang out at Ximending on weekends.
examples.zh: 青少年週末喜歡在西門町逛街聚會。

examples.en: Let's hang out at the cozy neighborhood coffee shop this Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們這週日去社區那家溫馨的咖啡館聚聚放鬆吧。

examples.en: She enjoys hanging out with friends who share her passion for photography.
examples.zh: 她喜歡與同樣熱愛攝影的朋友們聚在一起交流交流。

explains.en: Use this phrase when spending relaxed time with friends. They may talk at a cafe or walk around a neighborhood. There is no special task to finish.
After school, friends can meet and enjoy being together. They might listen to music or chat. The activity is casual.
People use these words for relaxing socially in a place. Teenagers may meet at a shopping area on weekends. It means spending free time together.

examples.en: Never give up on learning and speaking English.
examples.zh: 絕不要放棄學習和開口說英語。

examples.en: When the hiking trail became steep and rocky, he refused to give up.
examples.zh: 當登山路徑變得陡峭嶙峋時，他依然拒絕輕易認輸放棄。

examples.en: Quitting smoking requires determination, but you should never give up trying.
examples.zh: 戒菸需要莫大的毅力，但你絕不要放棄不斷嘗試。

examples.en: Never give up on your dreams, no matter how tough the path.
examples.zh: 無論道路多麼艱難，永遠不要放棄自己的夢想。

examples.en: He decided to give up sugary afternoon milk teas to improve his fitness and energy.
examples.zh: 他下定決心徹底戒掉下午茶常喝的高糖手搖奶茶，以改善個人體態與精神活力。

examples.en: Even when trailing by ten points, the basketball team refused to give up and fought on.
examples.zh: 即便在比數落後多達十分的劣勢下，籃球校隊全員依然堅決不放棄，奮戰至最後一秒。

explains.en: After many failed attempts, a person may stop trying to solve a puzzle. Someone may also stop a habit, such as smoking. In a contest, it can mean admitting defeat.
A person may decide to stop learning an instrument when practice feels difficult. Someone can also stop doing something unhealthy. The phrase can describe quitting a task or habit.
When a team is far behind, it may accept that it will not win. A person may also stop trying to reach a goal. It can describe giving in or quitting.

examples.en: You are doing great; keep going until the finish line!
examples.zh: 你表現得很棒，堅持下去直到終點線！

examples.en: Despite fatigue and sore muscles, the marathon runner kept going steadily.
examples.zh: 儘管身體疲憊且肌肉痠痛，馬拉松跑者依然步伐堅定地持續向前邁進。

examples.en: Life has challenges, but we must stay positive and keep going forward.
examples.zh: 人生充滿挑戰，但我們必須保持樂觀並堅定地向前邁進。

explains.en: Continue moving toward where you want to go. Do not stop before reaching the finish line.
These words can encourage someone to continue trying. A difficult task may take patience.
When you feel tired, a friend may tell you to continue. Small steps can help you reach your goal.

examples.en: I work out at the school gym three times a week.
examples.zh: 我每週在學校體育館健身三次。

examples.en: Don't worry; everything will work out perfectly in the end.
examples.zh: 別擔心，最後所有事情都會圓滿迎刃而解的。

examples.en: The mathematicians worked out the complex formula after hours of collaboration.
examples.zh: 數學家們經過數小時的合作推導，終於解出了那道複雜的公式。

explains.en: You do this when you exercise your body at a gym or elsewhere. The phrase can also mean that a plan ends well. In math, it may mean solving a problem.
People may do this to stay strong and healthy. A difficult situation can also do this when it reaches a good result. Context tells which meaning fits.
This phrase has several uses: exercising, finding an answer, or ending successfully. A person may do it with weights or by solving a sum. It can describe how events turn out.

examples.en: Together we can figure out the solution to this math problem.
examples.zh: 我們一起就能想出這道數學題的解法。

examples.en: It took me a while to figure out how to operate the new digital camera.
examples.zh: 我花了一點時間才搞清楚該如何操作這台新的數位相機。

examples.en: Scientists are working hard to figure out the mysteries of deep ocean currents.
examples.zh: 科學家們正努力解開深海洋流運行的奧秘。

examples.en: I finally figured out how to solve this tricky algebra equation.
examples.zh: 我終於弄清楚如何解出這道棘手的代數方程式了。

examples.en: It took the software engineers two sleepless days to figure out what caused the server crash.
examples.zh: 軟體研發團隊廢寢忘食鏖戰了整整兩天，才終於徹底查明弄清伺服器當機的根本原因。

examples.en: Let's sit down with the travel itinerary and figure out the most cost-effective train route.
examples.zh: 咱們不妨拿出旅遊行程表坐下來好好核算一下，理出最省錢也最快捷的鐵道路線。

entries.definition: 想出；弄明白；理解；弄清楚；算出

explains.en: Use this phrase when finding an answer by thinking carefully. A student may solve a math puzzle. Someone can also learn how a new camera works.
After studying clues, people may understand a mystery. This expression can mean discovering the answer. It can also describe calculating a result.
When a problem seems confusing, careful thought can help you understand it. A group may work together to find a solution. The phrase can also mean learning how something works.

examples.en: Check online to find out the train timetable.
examples.zh: 上網查詢以查明火車時刻表。

examples.en: We need to find out who organized this wonderful surprise celebration.
examples.zh: 我們需要查明究竟是誰籌辦了這場如此美好的驚喜慶祝活動。

examples.en: Read historical archives to find out more about the island's rich past.
examples.zh: 查閱歷史文獻檔案以深入發掘這座島嶼豐富悠久的昔日風華。

explains.en: Ask a question and search for the answer. A timetable can tell you when a train leaves.
A child may open a book to learn who built an old bridge. The phrase means to learn information that was not known.
You can ask around or read a reliable page to learn a fact. This phrase describes discovering something.

examples.en: I am looking for my English vocabulary flashcards.
examples.zh: 我正在尋找我的英文單字字卡。

examples.en: University graduates are actively looking for rewarding career opportunities.
examples.zh: 大學畢業生正積極尋找能發揮所長且具回報的職涯機會。

examples.en: Tourists wandered through the morning market looking for authentic local delicacies.
examples.zh: 遊客們漫步在早市中尋覓最道地的在地風味小吃。

explains.en: Search because you want to find something missing. A child may check under the bed for a toy.
A person may try to find a job or a good place to eat. This phrase describes searching for something wanted.
Walk around and check different places until you find what you need. You might do this for a lost key.

examples.en: Look up unfamiliar words in the English-Chinese dictionary.
examples.zh: 在英漢字典中查閱不熟悉的單字。

examples.en: Look up at the night sky and you can see the glowing Milky Way.
examples.zh: 抬頭仰望夜空，你便能看見璀璨閃爍的銀河。

examples.en: Business conditions for local tourism are finally starting to look up.
examples.zh: 當地觀光旅遊業的營商景氣終於開始顯現好轉起色。

explains.en: You do this when you search for information in a book or online. It can also mean raising your eyes toward something above you. A sentence shows which meaning is intended.
A dictionary helps you find the meaning of an unfamiliar word. You can also lift your gaze to the sky. This phrase describes either action.
Use these words for checking a fact in a reference source. They may also describe turning your eyes upward. Business or a situation can improve too, depending on the sentence.

examples.en: Turn around and look at the magnificent mountain view!
examples.zh: 轉過身來欣賞壯麗的山景吧！

examples.en: The company introduced bold new strategies to turn around its falling profits.
examples.zh: 該公司推行了大膽的新策略以扭轉持續下滑的獲利頹勢。

examples.en: Walk two blocks down the street and turn around at the red brick building.
examples.zh: 沿著街道走兩個街區，在紅磚大樓處轉身回頭。

explains.en: This phrase can mean changing direction to face the other way. A person may do it to see a mountain behind them. It can also mean improving a failing business.
A driver may reverse direction at a safe place. The words can also describe making a poor situation better. Context shows which meaning fits.
Use this expression when someone rotates to face behind them. A company may also improve its results after making changes. It has both physical and figurative uses.

examples.en: Go ahead and ask your question; teacher is listening.
examples.zh: 請便發問你的問題，老師正在聽。

examples.en: If everyone is ready, let's go ahead with the scheduled meeting.
examples.zh: 如果大家都準備就緒了，我們就按照排定議程著手進行會議吧。

examples.en: The city gave the green light to go ahead with the public library expansion project.
examples.zh: 市政府對公共圖書館擴建工程亮起綠燈批准進行。

explains.en: A teacher says these words to let a student begin asking a question. They can also invite someone to proceed.
When a group agrees to start a plan, they can begin without waiting longer. This phrase gives permission to continue.
At a doorway, a person may invite you to walk forward. The same words can encourage someone to start.

examples.en: Come on! You can finish the final lap of the run.
examples.zh: 加油！你能跑完最後一圈的。

examples.en: Oh, come on, don't be so hard on yourself for a tiny slip.
examples.zh: 哎，得了吧，別因為一點微不足道的小失誤就對自己如此苛刻。

examples.en: Come on inside where it's warm; dinner is served on the table.
examples.zh: 快進到屋裡暖和暖和，熱騰騰的晚餐已經端上桌了。

explains.en: These words can urge a friend to hurry or make an effort. A coach may say them during a race.
They can show disbelief or mild annoyance, as when a friend makes a silly excuse. Tone helps show the feeling.
A person may use this phrase to invite someone inside. It can also encourage someone who is trying.

examples.en: Thank you for helping me. — No problem!
examples.zh: 謝謝你幫我。— 沒問題（不客氣）！

examples.en: Can you give me a ride to the subway station? — No problem at all!
examples.zh: 你能順路載我到捷運站嗎？— 完全沒問題！

examples.en: Solving this simple software glitch is no problem for our IT specialist.
examples.zh: 修復這個簡單的軟體小問題對我們的資訊專員來說易如反掌。

explains.en: People say this to show that something is easy to do or not a bother. It is also a friendly way to answer when someone says thank you. It can reassure a person who asks for help.
When a friend asks for a ride, these words can mean yes. They can also tell someone that a small mistake is okay. The tone is usually relaxed and kind.
This short reply tells someone not to worry about a request. It may answer thanks or show willingness to help. People use it in everyday conversation.

examples.en: May I borrow your red pen? — Of course!
examples.zh: 我能借你的紅筆嗎？— 當然可以！

examples.en: Of course we will support you in pursuing your artistic dreams.
examples.zh: 我們理所當然會全力支持你追求藝術夢想。

examples.en: Are you tired after the long hike? — Of course not, I feel completely energized!
examples.zh: 長途健行後你累了嗎？— 當然不累，我感到精力充沛！

explains.en: Say this to show that something is certain or gladly allowed. If a friend asks to borrow a pen, you can agree this way. It can also mean naturally.
These words often answer a request with a friendly yes. They may also introduce something expected or obvious. Tone can make the reply sound warm or impatient.
Use this expression when agreeing without doubt. It can mean that something is plainly true. A speaker may say it before adding more information.

examples.en: By the way, what time does tomorrow's meeting start?
examples.zh: 順便問一下，明天的會議幾點開始？

examples.en: By the way, congratulations on winning first prize in the speech contest!
examples.zh: 對了順便一提，恭喜你在演講比賽中榮獲第一名！

examples.en: I ran into David yesterday; by the way, he sends his warmest regards.
examples.zh: 我昨天碰見大衛了，對了他向你轉達最誠摯的問候。

explains.en: Use these words when adding a new thought to a conversation. You might ask about tomorrow’s plans.
A speaker may use this phrase to remember one more thing to say. It can introduce a helpful detail.
You have finished talking about one subject, then recall another. These words smoothly bring it up.

examples.en: Taiwan has many high mountains, for example, Jade Mountain.
examples.zh: 台灣有許多高山，例如玉山。

examples.en: Citrus fruits, for example oranges and lemons, are rich in vitamin C.
examples.zh: 柑橘類水果，例如柳橙和檸檬，富含豐富的維生素 C。

examples.en: Many apps improve productivity; for example, digital flashcards make vocabulary learning fun.
examples.zh: 許多應用程式能提升效率，例如數位字卡讓單字學習變得趣味盎然。

explains.en: These words introduce one case that helps explain a larger idea. Many fruits, such as apples, have seeds.
Use this phrase before naming a sample from a group. A pet like a cat can be one case.
A speaker may give a particular item to make an idea clearer. This phrase signals that an illustration is coming.

examples.en: She speaks fluent English, and Japanese as well.
examples.zh: 她能說流利的英語，日語也同樣流利。

examples.en: Eating balanced meals is important, and regular exercise matters as well.
examples.zh: 均衡飲食非常重要，而規律運動也同樣不可或缺。

examples.en: If you are ordering a coffee, please get one for me as well.
examples.zh: 如果你要去點咖啡，請順便也幫我買一杯吧。

explains.en: These words mean that something is included too. If one person speaks English and another language, both are mentioned. They often come at the end of a sentence.
Use this phrase to add another person or thing to what was already said. A friend may ask you to get a drink for them too. It has a meaning like also.
This expression adds one more item or action. It can join a second idea to the first. It often appears after the added information.

examples.en: In fact, Taiwan is the birthplace of global bubble tea.
examples.zh: 事實上，台灣是全球珍珠奶茶的發源地。

examples.en: I thought the exam would be easy, but in fact it was quite demanding.
examples.zh: 我原以為測驗會很簡單，但事實上相當具有挑戰性。

examples.en: In fact, learning a new language rewires and strengthens brain neural connections.
examples.zh: 事實上，學習新語言能重塑並強化大腦的神經連結網絡。

explains.en: Use this phrase to introduce something that is really true. It may correct what someone first thought. It can add a surprising detail.
These words show that a statement matches reality. For example, a test may seem easy, but prove quite hard. They often emphasize the truth.
A speaker may say this before giving a true detail or correction. It means the real situation is as described. It can make a point stronger.

examples.en: You should drink at least two liters of water a day.
examples.zh: 你每天應該喝至少兩公升的水。

examples.en: Brush your teeth at least twice daily to maintain optimal dental hygiene.
examples.zh: 每天至少刷牙兩次以維持最佳的口腔衛生清潔。

examples.en: It will take at least thirty minutes to drive to the airport during morning traffic.
examples.zh: 晨間尖峰車潮期間，開車前往機場至少需要三十分鐘。

explains.en: If a recipe needs three eggs, two will not be enough. It needs this amount or a greater one.
A sign says children must be eight years old or older to enter. The rule sets a minimum age.
You need this amount of time before the bus arrives, and you may need longer. It means the smallest amount that is acceptable.

examples.en: The bus ride to the MRT station takes ten minutes at most.
examples.zh: 搭公車去捷運站至多只要十分鐘。

examples.en: The concert tickets will cost at most five hundred dollars for students.
examples.zh: 學生門票至多只需花費五百元。

examples.en: The quick oral quiz consists of five questions at most.
examples.zh: 這次隨堂口頭小考至多只有五道題目。

explains.en: This phrase gives the largest possible amount or number. The ride takes no more than ten minutes.
A price may be this amount or lower, but never higher. It sets an upper limit.
Use these words to say the greatest amount allowed. A quiz may have no more than five questions.

examples.en: We have learned one thousand practical vocabulary words so far!
examples.zh: 到目前為止我們已經學了一千個實用單字！

examples.en: How is your new semester going so far? — So far, so good!
examples.zh: 你新學期到目前為止過得如何？— 目前為止，一切都很好！

examples.en: So far, the company has raised millions of dollars for ocean cleanup projects.
examples.zh: 迄今為止，該公司已為海洋清理專案募集了數百萬美元。

explains.en: This phrase means up to the present time. It can tell how much has happened or been done until now. A semester may be going well up to this point.
Use these words when describing progress from the beginning until now. More may happen later. It often appears with a present perfect verb.
The expression can ask or tell how things are going at this moment in a period. It looks back over what has happened until now. The future is still open.

examples.en: Wishing you all the best on your upcoming English exam!
examples.zh: 祝你即將到來的英語考試一切順利！

examples.en: We said goodbye and wished each other all the best for the future.
examples.zh: 我們道別並互相祝福彼此未來萬事勝意、一切順遂。

examples.en: Send this festive card to convey our warmest congratulations and all the best.
examples.zh: 寄出這張賀卡以表達我們最熱烈的祝賀與最美好的祝福。

explains.en: People say this to wish someone success and happiness. It is a kind goodbye before an exam or a new journey. A card may include these warm words.
This expression sends kind wishes for someone's future. Friends may use it when parting. It can also end a friendly letter.
Say these words when hoping that another person does well. They suit a test, a new job, or a big change. The message is warm and supportive.

examples.en: Thank you for your dedication to learning English!
examples.zh: 感謝你對英語學習的投入與熱情！

examples.en: Thank you very much for taking the time to help me with my studies.
examples.zh: 非常感謝你撥空在課業上給予我寶貴的指導與協助。

examples.en: A heartfelt 'thank you' can brighten someone's entire day.
examples.zh: 一聲發自內心的「謝謝你」，能點亮某人一整天的心情。

explains.en: Say these polite words when someone gives you a gift or helps you. They show that you feel grateful.
A kind message can make a helper feel appreciated. These words are a simple way to express gratitude.
People often say this after receiving food, directions, or a present. It is a polite expression of appreciation.

examples.en: His parents are divorced, but they both love him deeply.
examples.zh: 他的父母雖然離婚了，但都深愛著他。

examples.en: After becoming divorced, she rediscovered her passion for solo international travel.
examples.zh: 在離婚恢單之後，她重新找回了自己熱愛獨自出國探索世界的熱忱。

examples.en: Counseling services assist divorced parents in co-parenting their children harmoniously.
examples.zh: 專業諮商協談機構協助離異的父母共同和諧撫養陪伴孩子成長。

explains.en: This describes two people whose marriage has legally ended. They may live in different homes.
A child may have two parents who no longer live as a married couple. Both can still care for the child.
This word tells that a husband and wife have ended their marriage by law. It describes their current relationship status.

examples.en: Programmers write clean code to build useful applications.
examples.zh: 程式設計師撰寫簡潔代碼以打造實用應用程式。

examples.en: Junior programmers collaborate with senior developers during daily code reviews.
examples.zh: 初階程式設計師在每日代碼審查時與資深開發者緊密協作。

examples.en: Becoming a proficient computer programmer requires logical thinking and perseverance.
examples.zh: 要成為一名熟練優秀的電腦程式設計師需要嚴密的邏輯思維與恆心。

entries.definition: 程式設計師；軟體工程師

explains.en: This person writes instructions that tell a computer what to do. The instructions can make apps or games work. Careful thinking helps with the job.
A person in this job creates and fixes computer code. They may work with others to build useful tools. Their work requires logic and patience.
Computers need clear instructions to perform tasks. The worker who writes those instructions may build websites or applications. This job often involves testing and correcting code.

examples.en: The flight attendant served hot tea and meal trays.
examples.zh: 空服員端送熱茶與餐盤。

examples.en: Friendly flight attendants ensure passengers understand safety evacuation procedures clearly.
examples.zh: 親切的空服員確保機上乘客充分清楚並掌握緊急逃生安全須知。

examples.en: She dreamed of becoming an international flight attendant and traveling globally.
examples.zh: 她夢想著成為一名國際線空服員，能夠一邊工作一邊環遊世界。

examples.en: The attentive flight attendant assisted elderly passengers with overhead bags.
examples.zh: 熱心細緻的空服員親切協助年長旅客將隨身隨行行李置入置物櫃。

examples.en: Flight attendants undergo rigorous emergency evacuation and first aid training before flying.
examples.zh: 空服員在正式上機執行客艙服務前，皆必須通過高強度的緊急逃生疏散演練與急救專業考核。

examples.en: The polite flight attendant brought a warm blanket and a glass of water to the shivering traveler.
examples.zh: 彬彬有禮的空服員主動為在機艙內瑟瑟發抖的旅客遞上一條溫暖毛毯與一杯溫開水。

entries.definition: 空服員；乘務員；空中乘務員

explains.en: This airline worker helps passengers during a trip in the sky. They show people how to use safety equipment and may serve drinks. They work inside the plane.
Before takeoff, this crew member explains important safety steps. During a journey, they help travelers find their seats. They may bring meals or tea.
A person with this job cares for passengers on an airplane. They answer questions and keep the cabin safe. The role includes serving food and drinks.

examples.en: Place the photo face down on the flatbed scanner glass.
examples.zh: 將照片朝下平放在掃描器玻璃板上。

examples.en: The supermarket cashier used a barcode scanner at checkout.
examples.zh: 超市收銀員在結帳時使用了條碼掃描器。

examples.en: This portable document scanner fits right inside your backpack.
examples.zh: 這款可攜式文件掃描器剛好能裝進你的背包裡。

examples.en: Security officers inspect laptops and electronics via advanced CT baggage scanners.
examples.zh: 機場安檢人員透過先進的斷層掃描 3D X 光機精準透視檢查背包內的筆電與電子產品。

examples.en: The office multifunction printer includes a high-speed flatbed scanner for digitizing documents.
examples.zh: 辦公室的多功能事務印表機配備了高速平台掃描器，能快速將紙本文件批量掃描為數位檔案。

examples.en: Modern 3D body scanners quickly detect concealed prohibited items without invasive physical contact.
examples.zh: 現代全身 3D 人體毫米波掃描儀能在不需肢體接觸的前提下，精準偵測旅客身上夾帶的違禁品。

examples.en: Warehouse operators use wireless handheld barcode scanners to register inbound packages instantly.
examples.zh: 倉儲理貨人員手持無線雷射條碼掃描槍，一秒精準刷讀條碼完成進貨入庫系統登記。

examples.en: If the optical scanner fails to read a smudged barcode, workers enter tracking IDs manually.
examples.zh: 若光學掃描器因外箱條碼髒污受損而無法辨識，作業員則需以手動輸入貨態追蹤碼。

examples.en: Modern Bluetooth ring scanners allow stockroom workers to keep both hands entirely free while sorting.
examples.zh: 新型藍牙指環式微型掃描器讓倉管人員在搬運分類包裹時，能完全空出雙手大幅提升作業效率。

entries.definition: 掃描器；X 光行李掃描儀；掃描機；手持式條碼掃描槍

explains.en: This machine makes a digital copy of a paper page or photograph. It may send the copy to a computer.
At a store, a cashier uses a small device to read the stripes on a product label. Airport staff may use larger machines to inspect bags.
A flatbed model can copy pictures and documents into a computer. A handheld one can read product codes.

examples.en: Create a new folder on the desktop for English notes.
examples.zh: 在電腦桌面上為英語筆記建立一個新資料夾。

examples.en: She organized all invoices neatly into a green plastic folder.
examples.zh: 她將所有發票整齊地歸檔在一個綠色塑膠資料夾中。

examples.en: You can drag and drop these photos directly into the shared folder.
examples.zh: 你可以直接將這些照片拖曳到共享資料夾中。

explains.en: Keep papers together inside this cover. A computer also uses one to organize digital files.
A student may place worksheets in a paper holder. On a screen, a similar place stores documents.
This item helps arrange files by topic. It may be made of paper or appear as an icon on a computer.

examples.en: Use a paper clip to fasten the worksheets together.
examples.zh: 用迴紋針把這些學習單固定在一起。

examples.en: Do you have a spare paper clip I could borrow?
examples.zh: 你有多餘的迴紋針可以借我一個嗎？

examples.en: He bent a small paper clip to reset the router.
examples.zh: 他把一枚小迴紋針扳直來重設路由器。

explains.en: This small bent piece of metal holds sheets of paper together. You can remove it without making holes. It is often kept on a desk.
Students use this object to fasten worksheets into a group. It can be bent into a new shape if needed. It does not use glue.
This office item has loops of thin metal. It keeps papers together until someone pulls them apart. It can also help press a tiny reset button.

examples.en: The stapler on the front desk is empty.
examples.zh: 櫃檯上的訂書機裡面沒有訂書針了。

examples.en: Can I borrow your stapler to bind these receipt pages?
examples.zh: 我可以借用你的訂書機來裝訂這些收據頁面嗎？

examples.en: This heavy-duty stapler can punch through fifty sheets at once.
examples.zh: 這台強力重型訂書機可以一次裝訂五十張紙。

explains.en: It is a small office tool that joins sheets of paper with a metal fastener. Press its top to push the fastener through the pages. Schools and desks often have one.
Use this device to bind papers together at a corner. It holds a strip of small metal clips inside. Press down firmly to attach them.
A teacher may use this tool to keep worksheets together. It pushes a short metal piece through paper and folds its ends underneath. Some models can join many sheets.

examples.en: Many college students bring laptops to lecture halls.
examples.zh: 許多大學生帶筆電去階梯教室上課。

examples.en: I forgot my laptop charger at the office yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天把筆電充電器忘在辦公室了。

examples.en: This lightweight laptop has impressive battery life.
examples.zh: 這款輕薄型筆電具備令人驚豔的電池續航力。

explains.en: This portable computer folds shut and can be carried in a backpack. Students use it to write, study, and browse the web.
A battery lets this computer work away from a desk for a while. Its screen and keyboard are attached.
People take this lightweight computer to class or work. It opens like a book and runs programs.

examples.en: He prefers working on a desktop with dual monitors.
examples.zh: 他偏好在雙螢幕的桌上型電腦上工作。

examples.en: There are too many shortcut icons cluttering your computer desktop.
examples.zh: 你的電腦桌面上堆滿了太多雜亂的捷徑圖示。

examples.en: Graphic designers often need powerful desktop computers for rendering.
examples.zh: 平面設計師通常需要效能強大的桌上型電腦來進行算圖渲染。

explains.en: A computer designed to stay on a desk is larger than a laptop. It often uses a separate screen and keyboard.
The main screen area of a computer shows icons and open windows. You may save a picture there.
This adjective describes something meant to sit on a desk. It can also name the background area on a computer screen.

examples.en: Log in with your school email to access online quizzes.
examples.zh: 用學校電子郵件登入以進行線上測驗。

examples.en: You need to log in before you can leave a comment on this forum.
examples.zh: 你必須先登入才能在這個論壇上留言。

examples.en: Please log in again because your session has expired.
examples.zh: 由於連線階段已逾時，請重新登入。

explains.en: You do this to enter an online account or computer system. You usually provide a name and secret password. Then you can use pages meant for account holders.
Before using a school website, a student may need to prove who they are. They type account details into a screen. This lets them reach private features.
This phrase describes starting access to a website or app with personal credentials. If a session ends, the person may need to do it again. It comes before taking part online.

examples.en: Remember to log out when using public library computers.
examples.zh: 使用公共圖書館電腦時記得要登出。

examples.en: She logged out of her work account before shutting down the PC.
examples.zh: 她在關閉電腦前登出了她的工作帳號。

examples.en: For security reasons, the banking app will automatically log you out after five minutes.
examples.zh: 基於安全考量，銀行應用程式在五分鐘後會自動將您登出。

explains.en: Use this phrase when ending a session in an app or account. It helps keep private information safe on a shared computer. A user may need to enter a password again later.
After using a public computer, choose the command that closes your account session. This action prevents the next person from seeing your messages. Banking apps may do it automatically.
A person can finish using an online account by selecting a sign-off option. This protects personal details. Remember to do it before leaving a library computer.

examples.en: Write a clear subject line so recipients know the purpose.
examples.zh: 寫一個清楚的主旨讓收件人明白來信目的。

examples.en: The email had an urgent subject line that caught my attention immediately.
examples.zh: 那封電子郵件有一個緊急主旨，立刻吸引了我的注意。

examples.en: Avoid using all capital letters in your email subject line.
examples.zh: 避免在郵件主旨欄中全使用大寫字母。

explains.en: A short phrase at the top of an email tells what the message is about. It helps the reader decide what to open.
Write a clear topic in this part of an email before sending it. It appears above the message text.
An email reader sees this brief heading in the inbox. It can show that a note is about a meeting or question.

examples.en: We exchanged business cards after the business forum.
examples.zh: 商務論壇結束後我們互相交換了名片。

examples.en: His business card includes his direct phone number and LinkedIn profile.
examples.zh: 他的名片上包含他的直撥電話與 LinkedIn 個人檔案。

examples.en: Always present your business card with both hands in Japanese culture.
examples.zh: 在日本文化中，遞名片時應雙手奉上。

examples.en: Present your business card respectfully with both hands during Asian meetings.
examples.zh: 在亞洲商務會議場合中，請習慣以雙手恭敬遞交您的商務名片。

examples.en: He keeps a stack of digital business cards on his phone to share via QR code.
examples.zh: 他在手機上保存了數位名片，方便隨時透過 QR 碼與人分享。

examples.en: Don't forget to exchange business cards before leaving the banquet hall.
examples.zh: 離開宴會廳前別忘了互相交換名片。

explains.en: This small printed card shares a person's name and contact details. People exchange them when meeting for work.
A worker may give one to a new customer. It often lists a phone number or company.
Keep this card in a wallet so others can reach you. Some versions are shared by scanning a code on a phone.

examples.en: Keep both hands firmly on the steering wheel while driving.
examples.zh: 開車時雙手請穩握方向盤。

examples.en: The luxury sports car features a leather-wrapped steering wheel.
examples.zh: 這款豪華跑車配備了真皮包覆的方向盤。

examples.en: She adjusted the steering wheel to a comfortable driving height.
examples.zh: 她將方向盤調整到舒適的駕駛高度。

explains.en: A driver holds this round control inside a car to guide it left or right. It is usually in front of the driver's seat. Both hands can rest on it.
Turning this part changes the direction a vehicle travels. It may be covered with leather for comfort. Drivers should keep a firm grip while moving.
This control is found inside cars and some other vehicles. The driver moves it to guide the vehicle along the road. It can be adjusted to a comfortable position.

examples.en: The speed limit on Taiwan's National Freeway No. 1 is 100 km/h.
examples.zh: 台灣國道一號的最高速限為每小時 100 公里。

examples.en: Drivers who exceed the speed limit will face heavy monetary fines.
examples.zh: 超速行駛的駕駛將面臨高額罰金處罰。

examples.en: Pay attention to the speed limit signs when entering school zones.
examples.zh: 進入學校周邊區域時請留意限速標誌。

explains.en: It is the fastest driving pace allowed on a road. Signs tell drivers the rule for that area. Going beyond it can lead to a fine.
A road sign may show the highest safe pace for vehicles. Drivers should follow it near schools and on highways. Police can give tickets for going too fast.
This rule sets how fast a vehicle may travel. It can change from street to street. Watch for signs and slow down when required.

examples.en: You must carry your driver's license when operating a car.
examples.zh: 開車上路時必須隨身攜帶駕照。

examples.en: She passed her road test on the first try and obtained her driver's license.
examples.zh: 她路考一次就通過並順利取得了駕照。

examples.en: The police officer asked to inspect the young driver's license.
examples.zh: 警員要求檢查這位年輕駕駛的駕照。

examples.en: Keep your original driver's license together with your passport when traveling.
examples.zh: 出國海外自駕時，請務必將本國實體駕照正本與護照一同妥善隨身攜帶。

examples.en: She was excited to finally pass the road driving test and earn her driver's license.
examples.zh: 她在歷經數週刻苦練車後終於順利通過了嚴格的路考測驗，興奮無比地領到了嶄新的汽車駕駛執照。

examples.en: Police officers will ask to see your driver's license and vehicle registration during routine road checks.
examples.zh: 在路口遭遇交警實施例行性臨檢盤查時，執勤警員會依法禮貌要求駕駛出示駕照與行照供現場查核。

entries.definition: 駕照；駕駛執照；駕照正本

explains.en: A person must pass a road test and be old enough before legally driving a car. This official card shows they may drive.
A police officer may ask a driver to show this document. It is kept with other important cards.
After learning road rules, a driver applies for this government permission card. It proves the person is allowed to operate a vehicle.

examples.en: Finding an available parking space in Taipei can be challenging.
examples.zh: 在台北市要找到可用的停車位可能頗具挑戰。

examples.en: Do not occupy the designated handicapped parking space without a permit.
examples.zh: 未經許可切勿佔用無障礙專用停車位。

examples.en: The modern apartment complex offers one underground parking space per unit.
examples.zh: 這棟現代化公寓大樓每戶皆配有一個地下停車位。

explains.en: This marked area is where one car may be left. Drivers look for an empty one near a building.
An apartment may include a place for a resident's car. Special markings can save a spot for a person with a disability.
At a busy store, drivers search for an open area to leave a vehicle. Each space is usually wide enough for one car.

examples.en: We were stuck in a heavy traffic jam on the freeway.
examples.zh: 我們在高速公路上被困在嚴重的車陣中。

examples.en: Bad weather and road construction often result in severe traffic jams.
examples.zh: 惡劣天候和道路施工經常導致嚴重的交通壅塞。

examples.en: Leaving early in the morning helps you avoid peak-hour traffic jams.
examples.zh: 清晨提早出門有助於避開尖峰時段的塞車車潮。

explains.en: This happens when too many vehicles fill a road and move very slowly or stop. Drivers may be delayed on a highway. Road work or bad weather can cause it.
Cars and buses can form a long line that barely moves. People may leave earlier to avoid the busiest time. The delay can last a while.
When roads are crowded with vehicles, travel slows down. Drivers may have to wait before moving forward. Construction and heavy travel often make this problem worse.

examples.en: The Taroko Express train offers a fast journey to Hualien.
examples.zh: 太魯閣號特快車提供前往花蓮的便捷旅程。

examples.en: Be sure to buy tickets in advance because express trains sell out early.
examples.zh: 請務必提早買票，因為特快車往往很早就售罄。

examples.en: Unlike local commuter trains, the express train skips smaller stations.
examples.zh: 與區間普通車不同，特快車不會停靠較小的車站。

explains.en: It is a fast passenger train that stops at fewer stations than a local service. Travelers can reach a distant town sooner. Some routes require advance tickets.
This rail service moves quickly between major stations. It skips many smaller stops along the way. Passengers often buy seats before travel.
A train of this kind offers a quicker trip by making fewer stops. It may connect large cities or tourist areas. A local train usually stops more often.

examples.en: The Taiwan High Speed Rail connects Taipei and Zuoying in 90 minutes.
examples.zh: 台灣高鐵在 90 分鐘內連結台北與左營。

examples.en: Taking the High Speed Rail is the most efficient way to travel across western Taiwan.
examples.zh: 搭乘高鐵是穿梭台灣西部走廊最高效的旅行方式。

examples.en: Discounted early-bird tickets are available on the High Speed Rail website.
examples.zh: 高鐵官方網站上提供限量的早鳥優惠折扣車票。

explains.en: A fast train carries passengers between cities along Taiwan’s west side. It stops at stations from the north down to the south.
Families can travel between Taipei and Kaohsiung by this express train. Booking early may cost less.
This rail service links major cities in western Taiwan. Its trains travel much faster than ordinary local trains.

examples.en: Place your heavy suitcases on the luggage rack near the door.
examples.zh: 將厚重行李箱放在靠近車門處的行李架上。

examples.en: He lifted his travel bag onto the overhead luggage rack.
examples.zh: 他把旅行提袋放到了頭頂上方的行李置物架上。

examples.en: Ensure all backpacks on the luggage rack are securely balanced before the train moves.
examples.zh: 列車啟動前，請確認行李架上的所有背包都已平穩放置。

explains.en: Travelers place suitcases on this support during a trip. It may sit above seats or near a doorway.
A train or hotel room may have this shelf for bags. Keep heavy cases balanced on it.
This raised holder keeps travel bags off the floor. Some vehicles have one over the seats.

examples.en: Complete online check-in twenty-four hours before departure.
examples.zh: 在起飛前二十四小時先完成線上報到。

examples.en: Hotel check-in typically begins after three o'clock in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 飯店入住手續通常在下午三點過後開始辦理。

examples.en: Long queues formed in front of the international airport check-in counter.
examples.zh: 國際機場報到櫃檯前排起了長長的隊伍。

entries.definition: 辦理登機／入住手續；報到

explains.en: This is the process of registering when you arrive at a hotel or airport. At a hotel, a guest receives a room key. At an airport, travelers prepare to board a flight.
Before a trip, passengers may complete this step online or at a counter. Hotel guests do it when they arrive. It confirms that they are ready to travel or stay.
This word names an arrival procedure. A traveler may show identification and receive important details. It happens before going to a room or boarding area.

examples.en: Pick up your checked suitcases at baggage claim carousel 3.
examples.zh: 請在三號行李轉盤處提領您的託運行李。

examples.en: We waited over half an hour at the baggage claim area for our luggage.
examples.zh: 我們在行李提領區等了半個多小時才拿到行李。

examples.en: Follow airport signs toward the baggage claim exit after clearing border control.
examples.zh: 通過邊境管制後，請沿著機場指示標誌前往行李提領出口。

examples.en: Follow overhead airport signs to the baggage claim hall after landing.
examples.zh: 飛機降落入境後，請沿著機場指示牌前往行李領取大廳。

examples.en: He realized his suitcase was missing after waiting an hour at baggage claim.
examples.zh: 他在行李領取區苦等了一小時後，才驚覺自己的行李箱遺失了。

examples.en: The baggage claim area was crowded with travelers returning from holiday vacations.
examples.zh: 行李領取大廳擠滿了剛結束美好度假返國的旅客人潮。

examples.en: Check the overhead monitors to locate your flight's baggage claim carousel.
examples.zh: 抬頭查閱大廳螢幕資訊以確認您所搭乘航班對應的行李提領轉盤號碼。

examples.en: Travelers waited anxiously by the baggage claim carousel hoping their suitcases wouldn't be lost.
examples.zh: 抵達旅客群聚在行李轉盤提領區旁引頸期盼，祈禱自己的行李箱能完好無損且毫無遺漏地順利送出。

examples.en: Oversized sports equipment like surfboards and golf clubs must be collected at the special baggage claim area.
examples.zh: 如衝浪板、高爾夫球袋等超大規格的運動器材，必須前往特殊的超規行李專屬領取處提取。

entries.definition: 行李提領處；行李領取處；行李提取區；行李提領區；行李轉盤處

explains.en: It is the airport area where travelers collect suitcases after a flight. Bags move around on a carousel. Signs point passengers there after customs.
After leaving the plane, passengers go here to find checked luggage. A moving belt carries bags past waiting travelers. Each belt may serve a different flight.
This airport area returns large bags to their owners. Travelers check the flight display and wait beside a moving belt. They pick up their cases before leaving.

examples.en: You will receive a confirmation code after completing your booking.
examples.zh: 完成預訂後，您將會收到一組確認代碼。

examples.en: The popular coastal resort is completely full, so early booking is essential.
examples.zh: 這座熱門的海濱度假勝地全部客滿，因此及早預訂非常重要。

examples.en: She made an online flight booking through the travel website.
examples.zh: 她透過旅遊訂票網站辦理了線上機票預訂。

explains.en: A traveler makes this arrangement to reserve a hotel room or flight. A confirmation message may arrive afterward.
Popular places can fill up, so arranging a room early is helpful. You may receive a code by email.
This is the act of reserving a seat, room, or ticket before a trip. It can be done online.

examples.en: The friendly hotel receptionist handed us the electronic room key cards.
examples.zh: 親切的飯店櫃檯人員將電子房卡遞交給我們。

examples.en: The dental clinic receptionist scheduled my next cleaning appointment.
examples.zh: 牙醫診所櫃檯人員為我排定了下一次洗牙預約。

examples.en: The corporate receptionist greeted visitors warmly in the main lobby.
examples.zh: 公司總機接待人員在大廳熱情迎接前來造訪的訪客。

explains.en: This worker welcomes visitors at the front desk of a hotel or clinic. The person may answer calls and arrange appointments.
When you arrive at an office, this staff member can tell you where to go. A friendly greeting is part of the job.
A hotel guest may ask this employee for a room key or directions. The worker handles questions at the entrance desk.

examples.en: I would like to book a quiet single room for two nights.
examples.zh: 我想預訂一間安靜的單人房住兩晚。

examples.en: The single room has a private bathroom and a work desk.
examples.zh: 這間單人房配有獨立衛浴與一張辦公桌。

examples.en: Solo business travelers often prefer a single room over sharing.
examples.zh: 單獨出差的商務旅客通常偏好單人房而非與人同住。

explains.en: This is a hotel room meant for one guest at a time. It may have a bed, desk, and private bathroom. A person can book it when traveling alone.
A traveler who wants a private place to sleep may choose this type of accommodation. It is designed for one person. Some have a work area too.
Hotels offer this kind of room for a guest who does not plan to share. It can include a bathroom and a desk. It is often chosen by someone on a business trip.

examples.en: The couple reserved a deluxe double room with ocean views.
examples.zh: 這對夫妻預訂了一間面海的豪華雙人房。

examples.en: All double rooms in the hotel are equipped with king-size beds.
examples.zh: 飯店內所有的雙人房都配有特大號雙人床。

examples.en: Is breakfast included in the rate for a double room?
examples.zh: 雙人房的房價有包含早餐嗎？

explains.en: It is a hotel room arranged for two guests, usually with a large bed. A couple may reserve one for a trip. Breakfast may or may not be included.
Hotels use this name for a room with a bed for two people. It may have an ocean view or a private bathroom. Check the price before booking.
Travelers can choose this room when sharing a stay with another person. It often has a single wide bed. Some hotels offer breakfast with the booking.

examples.en: My friend and I preferred a twin room with separate beds.
examples.zh: 我和朋友偏好兩張單人床的雙床雙人房。

examples.en: We requested a non-smoking twin room on a higher floor.
examples.zh: 我們要求了一間位於較高樓層的禁菸雙床房。

examples.en: Twin rooms are ideal for coworkers attending the trade show together.
examples.zh: 雙床房非常適合一同參加商展的同事們。

explains.en: Two travelers share one room that has two separate beds. They can sleep comfortably without sharing a mattress.
A hotel guest may request this room type when traveling with a friend. It usually has a pair of single beds.
This accommodation suits siblings or coworkers who want separate beds. It is made for two guests.

examples.en: Tap your electronic key card to open the hotel room door.
examples.zh: 感應電子房卡以開啟飯店房間門。

examples.en: I accidentally demagnetized my key card by placing it near my phone.
examples.zh: 我不小心把房卡放在手機旁導致磁條消磁了。

examples.en: Please return both key cards to the front desk when checking out.
examples.zh: 退房時請將兩張房卡交還給櫃檯。

explains.en: Hold this plastic card near a reader to unlock a hotel room. It can replace a metal key.
A guest taps this card on a door sensor to enter. Keep it safe until checkout.
This access card may open a building or room with a quick tap. The front desk can give one to a visitor.

examples.en: We ordered hot chicken soup through room service late at night.
examples.zh: 我們深夜透過客房服務點了熱雞湯。

examples.en: Room service is available twenty-four hours a day at this five-star resort.
examples.zh: 這間五星級度假村全天二十四小時提供客房服務。

examples.en: There is an extra delivery fee for room service breakfast.
examples.zh: 客房服務早餐需額外支付送餐服務費。

explains.en: At a hotel, this lets guests order food or drinks and have them brought to their room. It may be available late at night. A delivery fee can be added.
A guest can phone the hotel staff to request a meal without leaving the room. The staff bring the order to the door. Some hotels offer it all day and night.
This hotel service delivers meals to where a guest is staying. A person may use it when tired or unable to go out. The bill may include an extra charge.

examples.en: Please set a morning wake-up call for 6:00 AM.
examples.zh: 請幫我設定早上六點的電話叫醒服務。

examples.en: The hotel reception provided a friendly wake-up call right on time.
examples.zh: 飯店櫃檯準時提供了親切的電話叫醒服務。

examples.en: Missing his early flight was a serious wake-up call to manage time better.
examples.zh: 錯過早班飛機對他來說是個認真管理時間的嚴肅警鐘。

explains.en: It is a phone call arranged to help a hotel guest get up at a chosen time. A traveler may request one before an early flight. It can also mean a warning that makes someone notice a problem.
A hotel may ring a guest in the morning as requested. This service helps people rise on time. In another use, a serious mistake can be a warning to act.
Someone can ask the front desk to call at a set hour. That reminder helps them get ready for the day. Figuratively, a sudden problem may make a person pay attention.

examples.en: We ordered crispy spring rolls as our starter appetizer.
examples.zh: 我們點了香脆春捲作為開胃前菜。

examples.en: Cold appetizers were served along with sparkling cider.
examples.zh: 冰涼的開胃菜與氣泡蘋果西打一同上桌。

examples.en: Garlic bread and mushroom soup make a wonderful dinner appetizer.
examples.zh: 大蒜麵包與蘑菇濃湯是非常棒的晚餐前菜。

examples.en: Cold sliced drunken chicken with wolfberries served as a refreshing appetizer.
examples.zh: 冰鎮切盤的紹興醉雞卷佐以養生枸杞，作為令人食指大動的清爽開胃前菜。

examples.en: Crispy calamari rings with tartar sauce are my favorite restaurant appetizer.
examples.zh: 炸得金黃酥脆的深海花枝圈佐塔塔醬是我在餐酒館裡最無法抗拒的人氣開胃前菜。

examples.en: Small, flavorful appetizers awaken the taste buds and prepare guests for the meal.
examples.zh: 小巧精緻且風味明亮的開胃前菜能喚醒味蕾，為接下來的豐盛盛宴做好暖身。

entries.definition: 開胃菜；前菜；開胃前菜；開胃小品

explains.en: A small dish arrives before the main meal to wake up your appetite. Spring rolls or soup may be served this way.
At a restaurant, guests may share a tasty first course while waiting for dinner. It is usually smaller than the main dish.
Garlic bread can be brought to the table before the meal. This opening dish helps guests feel ready to eat.

examples.en: For the main course, I will have the grilled salmon fillet.
examples.zh: 主菜部分，我想要烤鮭魚排。

examples.en: What side dish comes with the steak main course?
examples.zh: 請問牛排主餐隨附的配菜是什麼？

examples.en: The waiter brought out the main course shortly after we finished our soup.
examples.zh: 我們喝完湯不久，服務生就端上了主菜。

explains.en: At a meal, this is the largest or most important food serving. It often comes after soup.
A diner may choose fish, chicken, or noodles for this part of dinner. Rice or vegetables may come beside it.
This is the central dish in a full meal. Dessert is usually served afterward.

examples.en: A 10% service charge is already included in the bill.
examples.zh: 帳單中已包含一成（10%）服務費。

examples.en: Upscale dining establishments usually add an automatic service charge.
examples.zh: 高檔餐廳通常會自動加收服務費。

examples.en: Does this total price include tax and the hotel service charge?
examples.zh: 這個總價有包含稅金與飯店服務費嗎？

explains.en: This is an extra amount added to a bill for the work staff do. A restaurant or hotel may include it automatically. Check the total before paying.
Customers may see this fee on a receipt after a meal. It pays for service provided by the business. The bill may show whether it is already included.
A business can add this amount to the cost of a meal or stay. It is connected with the help staff provide. It may be a percentage of the bill.

examples.en: Stir-fry the seasonal vegetables with minced garlic.
examples.zh: 用蒜末大火快炒時令蔬菜。

examples.en: Taiwanese stir-fry restaurants are popular gathering spots after work.
examples.zh: 台灣的熱炒店是下班後非常熱門的聚會場所。

examples.en: Stir-fry the sliced beef quickly to keep it tender and juicy.
examples.zh: 將牛肉片迅速大火快炒以保持軟嫩多汁。

examples.en: Taiwanese stir-fry eateries (Rechao) serve sizzling garlic clams.
examples.zh: 台灣街頭熱炒店供應著鑊氣十足、香氣撲鼻的蒜香炒九層塔蛤蜊。

examples.en: Heat the seasoned wok over high heat to quickly stir-fry fresh morning spinach.
examples.zh: 將鐵鍋燒至大火滾燙並迅速下鍋爆炒，短短數十秒即可炒出一盤青翠鮮嫩的現炒菠菜。

examples.en: A quick chicken stir-fry with peppers and cashew nuts is our go-to weeknight dinner.
examples.zh: 甜椒腰果快炒雞丁是我們平日下班回家後最常做的快手美味家常熱炒料理。

examples.en: Taiwanese hot-stir restaurants (Re Chao) stir-fry fresh water spinach with garlic.
examples.zh: 台灣百元熱炒店大廚以大火快炒蒜香空心菜，鑊氣十足、爽脆開胃。

examples.en: A traditional wok is the essential cooking tool needed to properly stir-fry vegetables.
examples.zh: 傳統雙耳中華鐵鍋是想要在烈火翻炒中完美烹調快炒青菜不可或缺的利器。

examples.en: We ordered a seafood stir-fry alongside draft beer for a relaxing Friday dinner.
examples.zh: 我們點了一道熱氣騰騰的快炒生猛海鮮拼盤搭配冰生啤酒，享受愜意的週五晚餐。

entries.definition: 快炒；熱炒；大火快炒；熱炒菜餚；炒菜

explains.en: Cook small pieces of food quickly in a hot pan while moving them around. A little oil and chopped garlic can add flavor. Vegetables stay crisp when cooked briefly.
This cooking method uses high heat and frequent stirring. Meat and vegetables are cut into small pieces first. The finished dish can be served over rice.
A cook prepares this dish by tossing ingredients in a hot pan. The food cooks quickly and keeps much of its color. Sauce or seasoning may be added near the end.

examples.en: Deep-fry the chicken cutlet until it turns golden brown.
examples.zh: 將雞排油炸至呈現金黃酥脆的顏色。

examples.en: Deep-fried tofu tastes best when dipped in thick garlic soy sauce.
examples.zh: 炸豆腐沾上濃郁蒜蓉醬油膏吃起來最美味。

examples.en: It is healthier to bake food rather than deep-fry it in oil.
examples.zh: 烘烤食物通常比用油酥炸來得更加健康。

examples.en: Deep-fry sweet potato balls until crispy golden on the outside and chewy inside.
examples.zh: 將地瓜球油炸至外皮金黃酥脆、內餡軟 Q 彈牙。

examples.en: Street stalls deep-fry salted crispy chicken tossed with fragrant Thai basil.
examples.zh: 夜市攤販熟練地大火酥炸外酥內嫩的台式鹹酥雞，起鍋前撒上一大把芳香撲鼻的九層塔。

examples.en: Maintain oil temperature at 170°C to deep-fry tempura prawns without greasy heaviness.
examples.zh: 將炸油油溫恆定控制在攝氏一百七十度，能炸出輕盈酥脆且絲毫不顯油膩的天婦羅炸蝦。

examples.en: Deep-fry the marinated squid rings until they turn a gorgeous golden brown.
examples.zh: 將事先醃漬入味的鮮甜深海魷魚圈放入滾燙油鍋中，酥炸至誘人的金黃色澤。

examples.en: Make sure the cooking oil reaches 180 degrees before you deep-fry the battered shrimp.
examples.zh: 在將裹上麵衣的鮮蝦下鍋油炸之前，請務必先確認油溫已精準達到攝氏 180 度。

examples.en: Street vendors deep-fry tofu squares until the exterior becomes completely crispy.
examples.zh: 夜市攤販將一塊塊臭豆腐放入滾燙油鍋酥炸，直到外皮完全變得金黃香脆。

explains.en: Put food into very hot oil until the outside becomes crisp and golden. Use care around the hot pan.
Cooks make crispy tofu or chicken by lowering pieces into bubbling oil. A draining rack removes extra oil.
This cooking method uses a deep pan filled with hot oil. The food becomes crunchy on the outside.

examples.en: Heat some olive oil in the non-stick frying pan.
examples.zh: 在不沾平底鍋中加熱少許橄欖油。

examples.en: Gently flip the pancake over in the hot frying pan.
examples.zh: 在熱平底鍋中將煎餅輕輕翻面。

examples.en: Clean the frying pan with a soft sponge to preserve the non-stick coating.
examples.zh: 用柔軟的海綿清洗平底鍋以保護不沾塗層。

explains.en: Cook eggs or pancakes in this shallow round pan on a stove. Its long handle stays away from the heat.
A cook uses this kitchen tool to brown food in a little oil. Some have a surface that food does not easily stick to.
This metal pan is useful for cooking food over direct heat. Wash it with a soft sponge to protect its coating.

examples.en: A carbon steel wok creates the authentic 'wok hei' aroma.
examples.zh: 碳鋼炒鍋能炒出最道地的鑊氣香氣。

examples.en: Heat the seasoned wok until it begins to smoke slightly.
examples.zh: 將開好鍋的炒鍋加熱至微微冒煙。

examples.en: Street food vendors toss fried rice skillfully in large iron woks.
examples.zh: 街頭小吃攤販在大型鐵鍋中熟練地翻炒炒飯。

explains.en: This is a deep, round cooking pan with a curved bottom and high sides. Cooks use it to stir-fry food quickly. It is common in many Asian kitchens.
A cook can toss rice and vegetables in this large pan over high heat. Its shape makes it easy to stir ingredients. It is often made from steel or iron.
This cooking tool is wider at the top and curves inward at the bottom. It works well for frying, steaming, or cooking noodles. Street vendors may use a very large one.

examples.en: Pop two slices of white bread into the electric toaster.
examples.zh: 將兩片白吐司放入烤麵包機中。

examples.en: The shiny four-slice toaster browns bread slices evenly and quickly.
examples.zh: 這台光亮的四片式烤麵包機能迅速均勻地烘烤吐司片。

examples.en: Unplug the toaster before trying to remove stuck bread crusts.
examples.zh: 在設法夾出卡住的吐司邊之前，請先拔掉烤麵包機插頭。

explains.en: It is a kitchen appliance that browns slices of bread with heat. Put the bread into its slots and lower the lever. Unplug it before removing stuck pieces.
People use this small machine to make warm, crisp bread for breakfast. A control lets them choose how brown it gets. Some models hold several slices.
This electric kitchen device heats bread until its surface is golden. The slices pop up when ready. Keep fingers away from the hot slots.

examples.en: Use the kitchen blender to make a creamy papaya smoothie.
examples.zh: 用果汁機打一杯濃郁滑順的木瓜冰沙。

examples.en: The high-speed blender can easily crush ice cubes and frozen berries.
examples.zh: 這台高速調理機能輕鬆絞碎冰塊與冷凍莓果。

examples.en: Rinse the blender pitcher immediately after preparing fruit juice.
examples.zh: 調製完果汁後應立即沖洗調理機攪拌杯。

explains.en: This electric kitchen machine spins blades to mix fruit into a drink. It can also crush ice.
Pour ingredients into its jar, close the lid, and press a button. The blades turn food into a smooth mixture.
A cook may use this appliance to puree soup or make a smoothie. Wash the jar after using it.

examples.en: She loves browsing stylish dresses in local fashion boutiques.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在當地的時尚精品小店瀏覽各式漂亮洋裝。

examples.en: The quaint boutique hotel offers personalized services for every guest.
examples.zh: 這家古雅的精品特色飯店為每位房客提供貼心客製化服務。

examples.en: They opened a chic floral boutique in the historic cultural district.
examples.zh: 他們在歷史文化街區開設了一間別緻的精品花藝店。

explains.en: This is a small shop that sells fashionable clothes or special goods. It may offer personal service.
Travelers may stay in a stylish small hotel with a unique design. The word can describe that kind of hotel too.
A shopper may find dresses or flowers in this charming, specialized store. It is often smaller than a department store.

examples.en: Grandma buys fresh tofu and bean sprouts from the corner grocery store.
examples.zh: 奶奶在街角雜貨店買新鮮豆腐與豆芽菜。

examples.en: Could you pick up some fresh eggs and milk from the grocery store?
examples.zh: 你能從食品雜貨店順便買些新鮮雞蛋和牛奶嗎？

examples.en: The small family-owned grocery store has served the neighborhood for decades.
examples.zh: 這家家族經營的街坊雜貨店已經為社區服務了數十年。

explains.en: This is a shop where people buy food and other things for the home. It may sell milk, eggs, vegetables, and soap. A small one can serve a neighborhood.
A family may visit this place to buy ingredients for dinner. Customers put items in a basket and pay at a counter. Fresh produce is often sold there.
People go here to get everyday food and household supplies. Some are small, while others have many aisles. A nearby shop may have served the same community for years.

examples.en: Put large boxes of detergent into your shopping cart.
examples.zh: 將大箱洗衣精放進你的購物推車中。

examples.en: One wheel on my shopping cart was squeaking and wobbling.
examples.zh: 我的購物推車有一個輪子一直吱吱作響且搖晃不穩。

examples.en: You can click on the shopping cart icon to review items before payment.
examples.zh: 您可以在付款前點擊購物車圖示以檢視選購商品。

explains.en: It is a wheeled basket that shoppers push through a store. People place groceries inside while they choose products. An online shop may show a small icon for selected goods.
Customers use this metal or plastic carrier to move purchases around a supermarket. It usually has a handle and several wheels. A child may sit in a safe seat section.
When buying food, shoppers push this container along the aisles. It holds items until checkout. Websites use a similar symbol to list products someone plans to buy.

examples.en: Grab a shopping basket near the entrance of the supermarket.
examples.zh: 在超級市場入口處拿一個購物提籃。

examples.en: Her shopping basket was filled with fresh vegetables, apples, and yogurt.
examples.zh: 她的購物提籃裡裝滿了新鮮蔬菜、蘋果與優格。

examples.en: If you only plan to buy a few items, a shopping basket is lighter than a cart.
examples.zh: 如果你只打算買幾樣東西，購物提籃比手推車輕巧得多。

explains.en: Take this handled container when you need only a few groceries. It is easier to carry than a wheeled cart.
A shopper can place apples and milk in this basket while walking through a store. Return it near the entrance.
This lightweight holder keeps small purchases together. It usually has a handle and fits in one hand.

examples.en: The self-checkout counters save customers plenty of time.
examples.zh: 自助結帳機台為顧客節省了大量時間。

examples.en: Standard hotel checkout is at 11:00 AM sharp.
examples.zh: 飯店的標準退房時間為上午十一點整。

examples.en: Remember to enter your discount voucher code before proceeding to checkout.
examples.zh: 在進入結帳程序前，請記得輸入您的優惠折扣碼。

explains.en: At a store, this is where customers pay for their items. Some shops let people scan and pay by themselves.
Hotel guests complete this process when they leave and return the room key. The front desk can explain the time.
An online shopper reaches this page before paying. A discount code may be entered there.

examples.en: The scanner reads the printed product barcode instantly.
examples.zh: 掃描器瞬間讀取印刷在商品上的條碼。

examples.en: If the barcode is damaged, the cashier can type in the serial number manually.
examples.zh: 如果條碼受損，收銀員可以手動輸入商品編號。

examples.en: Each medicine bottle has a unique barcode for tracking and safety.
examples.zh: 每一瓶藥物都有獨特條碼以供安全追蹤管理。

examples.en: Each carton carries a unique GS1 barcode encoding SKU, batch number, and expiration date.
examples.zh: 每個出貨外箱皆印有唯一的國際 GS1 條碼，完整記載商品料號、生產批號與有效保存期限。

examples.en: High-speed cameras read the barcode printed on moving boxes at speeds of three meters per second.
examples.zh: 架設於滾筒軌道上的高速視覺相機，能在包裹以每秒三公尺高速飛馳經過時瞬間精準判讀條碼內容。

examples.en: Printing high-contrast barcodes ensures scanning guns register package numbers with one quick pull.
examples.zh: 印刷高對比清晰黑白條碼，能確保理貨人員手持掃描槍在扣動扳機的瞬間，一鍵秒讀包裹貨號毫不費力。

examples.en: Handheld wireless barcode scanners update package tracking information instantly onto the consumer app.
examples.zh: 手持式無線條碼掃描槍，在貨物出庫刷條碼瞬間將包裹動態同步至客戶手機。

examples.en: Laser scanners read the two-dimensional barcode at a speed of five hundred items per minute.
examples.zh: 頂級全向雷射掃描機以每分鐘五百件的驚人速度，瞬間捕捉掃描高速掠過包裹上的二維條碼。

examples.en: A damaged, unreadable barcode on the carton required manual lookup by warehouse staff.
examples.zh: 瓦楞外箱上被磨損模糊的條碼標籤無法被機器識別，需由物流主管手動輸入快遞單號進行查核。

entries.definition: 條碼；商品條碼；條形碼；RFID 無線射頻與二維條碼貨物追蹤

explains.en: This printed pattern of dark lines or squares stores information about a product. A scanner reads it at a shop counter. It can help identify an item quickly.
A package often has this machine-readable mark on its label. The pattern connects to details such as the item's name or price. A damaged mark may need to be typed in by hand.
Stores and warehouses use this printed code to identify goods. A handheld reader can scan it in a moment. Some patterns also help track a package or medicine.

examples.en: Fresh mangoes are currently on sale for half price.
examples.zh: 新鮮芒果目前正以半價特價促銷中。

examples.en: The latest video game will go on sale starting tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 這款最新電玩遊戲將於明天早晨正式開賣。

examples.en: I always wait until my favorite sneakers go on sale before buying them.
examples.zh: 我總是等到我喜愛的球鞋打折特價時才下手購買。

explains.en: These words mean that a product is being sold at a lower price. A store may mark shoes with a discount. The phrase can also mean that tickets are available to buy.
A shop uses this phrase when an item costs less than usual. It may appear on a sign beside fruit or clothes. New tickets may also become available this way.
When a product has a special reduced price, a store may describe it with these words. A shopper can save money. For events, the phrase can mean tickets are ready for purchase.

examples.en: That lovely second-hand scooter is for sale.
examples.zh: 那輛可愛的二手機車正在對外求售。

examples.en: There are several vintage bicycles for sale in this garage shop.
examples.zh: 這間車庫小店裡有好幾台復古腳踏車待售中。

examples.en: The historic mansion by the lake is currently not for sale.
examples.zh: 湖畔那棟歷史悠久的宅邸目前並未對外出售。

explains.en: A shop puts a price tag on an item that customers can buy. A sign in the window may show this status.
A bicycle with a price can be bought by someone who wants it. The owner has offered it to customers.
A house may have a sign outside showing that a buyer can purchase it. This phrase describes something offered to buyers.

examples.en: Check your uniform invoices every two months for the lottery prizes.
examples.zh: 每兩個月核對一次統一發票以對獎。

examples.en: Scanning your electronic uniform invoice into an app makes tracking effortless.
examples.zh: 將電子統一發票載具刷入 App 能讓對獎變得毫不費力。

examples.en: Taiwan's uniform invoice lottery offers multimillion-dollar grand prizes.
examples.zh: 台灣統一發票開獎提供數百萬元的千萬特獎。

explains.en: In Taiwan, shops give customers this numbered receipt after a purchase. It can be checked in a prize drawing.
Keep this document from a store because its number may win money later. An electronic version can be saved in an app.
A shopper receives this official sales slip when paying. Its printed code is used for a local lottery.

examples.en: May I pay by credit card?
examples.zh: 請問我可以用信用卡付款嗎？
