examples.en: You earn cash rebates or airline miles whenever you swipe your credit card.
examples.zh: 每當你刷信用卡消費時都能累積現金回饋或航空里程。

examples.en: Please report immediately if your credit card is lost or stolen.
examples.zh: 若信用卡遺失或失竊，請立即通報掛失。

explains.en: This is a plastic or digital payment method that lets a person buy something now and pay the bill later. A bank or company provides it. The owner should report it if it is lost.
A shopper can use this card at a store or online instead of paying with cash. The amount is charged to an account. Some providers return part of the spending as a reward.
People use this payment card to buy goods and services. The bill is paid later, often each month. It should be kept safe from theft.

examples.en: The purchase amount is deducted directly from your debit card.
examples.zh: 購物金額會直接從您的簽帳金融卡扣款。

examples.en: Using a debit card prevents you from spending more money than you have.
examples.zh: 使用簽帳金融卡能防止你花費超出帳戶存款的金額。

examples.en: You can use your debit card to withdraw cash at any local ATM.
examples.zh: 你可以使用簽帳金融卡在任何在地提款機領取現金。

examples.en: When using a debit card, purchase funds are deducted immediately from your account.
examples.zh: 使用簽帳金融卡時，消費金額會直接即時從銀行存款中扣除。

examples.en: Debit cards are great tools for students learning to spend strictly within their means.
examples.zh: 簽帳金融卡是讓初學理財的學生量入為出、避免過度透支的好工具。

examples.en: I tapped my debit card at the supermarket checkout to pay for weekly groceries.
examples.zh: 我在超市結帳櫃檯輕輕嗶了一下簽帳金融卡，順利結清了一週的生活伙食。

entries.definition: 簽帳金融卡；Visa 金融卡

explains.en: It is a bank card that takes payment directly from the holder's account. People can use it in shops or at cash machines. Check the amount before entering a PIN.
When someone pays with this card, the money comes from an existing bank balance. It can also let a customer withdraw cash. Keep the PIN private.
This payment card is linked to a bank account. Purchases reduce the available balance. It is useful when a person wants to pay without cash.

examples.en: Mobile payment options like LINE Pay are very convenient in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣，像 LINE Pay 這樣的行動支付非常方便。

examples.en: More consumers now prefer mobile payments over carrying physical wallets.
examples.zh: 越來越多消費者現在偏好行動支付而非攜帶實體皮夾。

examples.en: Simply scan the QR code on your phone screen to complete the mobile payment.
examples.zh: 只需掃描手機螢幕上的 QR Code 即可完成行動支付。

explains.en: A shopper scans a square code with a phone and money moves from an account. No paper bills need to be handed over.
At a cafe, a customer can tap a phone to pay for lunch. The bank account is charged electronically.
This way of paying uses a smartphone or watch instead of cash. It is common at many shops.

examples.en: You can use your EasyCard to pay at convenience stores and MRT stations.
examples.zh: 您可以用悠遊卡在便利商店和捷運站進行扣款消費。

examples.en: Student EasyCards offer discounted transit fares on Taipei's bus network.
examples.zh: 學生悠遊卡在台北公車網絡上享有搭乘優惠折扣票價。

examples.en: You can top up your EasyCard using cash at any subway ticket machine.
examples.zh: 您可以在任何捷運售票機使用現金為悠遊卡加值。

explains.en: People tap this stored-value card to ride buses or trains in Taiwan. It can also pay at some shops.
A passenger may add money to this transit card at a station machine. Students can get special fare discounts.
This card makes travel around Taipei easier. Touch it to a reader when entering or leaving a station.

examples.en: Check the price tag to see how much this jacket costs.
examples.zh: 看看價格標籤就知道這件夾克多少錢了。

examples.en: High quality often comes with a hefty price tag attached.
examples.zh: 優異品質往往伴隨著高昂的價格代價。

examples.en: Remove the price tag carefully before wrapping the birthday gift.
examples.zh: 在包裝生日禮物之前，請小心取下標價籤。

explains.en: This small label on an item tells how much it costs. A shopper can read it before deciding to buy. It is often removed before a gift is wrapped.
Clothing and other goods may have this label attached. It shows the amount a customer must pay. Some stores attach it with a string.
A shop uses this label to display an item's cost. A high-cost object may have a large amount shown on it. People can take it off before giving the item as a present.

examples.en: The fitting rooms are located at the back of the store.
examples.zh: 試衣間位於店鋪後方。

examples.en: A customer took three pairs of trousers into the fitting room.
examples.zh: 一位顧客拿了三條長褲走進了試衣間。

examples.en: Is someone currently using the third fitting room on the left?
examples.zh: 左邊第三間試衣間目前有人在使用嗎？

explains.en: It is a small private space in a clothing store where customers try on garments. A mirror is usually inside. Return unwanted items to the staff afterward.
Shoppers use this room to see whether clothes fit before buying them. It may have a curtain or a locking door. Stores often place it near the back.
A customer can take clothes into this private area and try them on. There is usually a mirror and a hook for garments. Staff may help find another size.

examples.en: ATMs are readily accessible inside 7-Eleven and FamilyMart.
examples.zh: 7-Eleven 和全家超商內部都設有極為方便的 ATM。

examples.en: Insert your chip card into the ATM slot and enter your PIN.
examples.zh: 將晶片金融卡插入 ATM 卡槽並輸入個人密碼。

examples.en: The ATM machine was temporarily out of order for routine maintenance.
examples.zh: 這台自動提款機因例行維護暫時停止服務。

explains.en: This machine lets people take out cash or check their bank balance. A card and a secret code are usually needed.
Find one near a bank or convenience store when you need money. Keep your personal code private.
A customer inserts a bank card into this cash machine and follows the screen. It can also show how much money is in an account.

examples.en: There is a daily cash withdrawal limit of twenty thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 每日現金提款上限為兩萬元。

examples.en: Heavy alcohol withdrawal symptoms can be dangerous without medical supervision.
examples.zh: 嚴重酒精戒斷症狀若無醫療監督可能十分危險。

examples.en: The military announced the complete withdrawal of all foreign troops.
examples.zh: 軍方宣布所有外國軍隊已全面撤離完畢。

examples.en: Daily cash withdrawal limits protect account holders against unauthorized fraud.
examples.zh: 每日現金提款上限能保護帳戶持有人防範未經授權的詐騙盜領。

examples.en: The patient experienced acute caffeine withdrawal symptoms like headaches.
examples.zh: 這位戒斷咖啡因的患者出現了急性戒斷症狀，如劇烈頭痛。

examples.en: Signing the peace treaty led to the gradual military withdrawal of allied troops.
examples.zh: 和平協議的正式簽署促成了盟軍部隊從前線逐步有秩序地撤離。

examples.en: Daily ATM cash withdrawals are capped at one hundred thousand NT dollars.
examples.zh: 台灣各家銀行晶片金融卡在 ATM 自動櫃員機的每日累計現金提款上限為十萬元整。

examples.en: The bank charges a nominal transaction fee for international overseas ATM withdrawals.
examples.zh: 國人在海外貼有國際跨國提款標誌的 ATM 機台進行跨國提領外幣現鈔時，銀行會酌收手續費。

examples.en: She made a cash withdrawal at the counter to purchase fresh produce from the traditional market.
examples.zh: 她在銀行臨櫃辦理了小額現金提款，準備帶著充裕的零錢現鈔前往傳統市場採買生鮮蔬果。

entries.definition: 提款；撤退；提領；撤回；收回

explains.en: Taking cash out of a bank account is one meaning of this noun. An ATM can let a person do it.
It can describe a group of soldiers leaving a place. The same word may name the act of stopping a drug or habit.
A bank may set a daily limit on cash taken from an account. A person who stops using caffeine may also feel symptoms.

examples.en: It is wise to save part of your monthly salary in a savings account.
examples.zh: 將每月部分薪水存入活期儲蓄帳戶是明智的做法。

examples.en: You need to show your passport and second ID to open a savings account.
examples.zh: 開立活期儲蓄帳戶需要出示護照與第二證件。

examples.en: Online high-yield savings accounts offer much better interest rates.
examples.zh: 線上高利活儲帳戶提供好得多的活儲利率。

examples.en: A high-yield digital savings account offers better annual interest returns.
examples.zh: 高活存利率的數位儲蓄帳戶能帶來更佳的年化利息回報。

examples.en: Parents opened a special savings account to set aside tuition funds for their child.
examples.zh: 父母為孩子開立了一個專屬儲蓄帳戶，每月提撥儲備教育學費基金。

examples.en: Setting up automatic monthly transfers into a savings account makes saving effortless.
examples.zh: 設定每月薪資自動轉存至儲蓄帳戶，能讓存錢變得輕鬆毫不費力。

entries.definition: 活期儲蓄帳戶；儲蓄存款

explains.en: This is a bank account where a person keeps money for future use. The bank may add a little extra money over time. People can save for school or a trip.
Someone can put part of each paycheck in this kind of account. It is meant to help money grow safely. Opening one usually requires identification.
A person may use this bank account to set aside money instead of spending it now. Some banks pay interest on the balance. Automatic transfers can help build savings.

examples.en: Overseas migrant workers send remittances back home monthly.
examples.zh: 海外移工每月將薪資匯款寄回老家。

examples.en: Banks provide fast and reliable international remittance services.
examples.zh: 銀行提供迅速且可靠的跨國匯款服務。

examples.en: High transaction fees reduce the real value of small remittances.
examples.zh: 高昂的交易手續費會降低小額匯款的實質價值。

examples.en: Low-cost digital remittance apps reduce transfer fees for migrant workers sending funds home to families.
examples.zh: 費用低廉透明的數位跨境匯款 App，讓在台辛勤打拼的外籍移工能以最省的手續費將薪資秒匯回故鄉老家。

examples.en: Blockchain-based remittance networks complete international cross-border transfers within thirty seconds.
examples.zh: 奠基於去中心化分散式帳本技術的區塊鏈跨國清算網絡，能在三十秒內極速完成跨大洲國際資金匯款。

examples.en: The central bank tracks foreign currency remittance volumes to ensure balance of payments equilibrium.
examples.zh: 國家中央銀行密切動態監控全台外幣跨境匯出匯入款總量，以維護新台幣匯率與國際收支帳的長遠平衡。

entries.definition: 匯款；匯款額；跨境小額國際匯款

explains.en: It is money sent to another person, often in a different country. A worker may send part of a paycheck to family at home. Banks can help transfer it.
When someone sends funds to relatives far away, the payment is called this. A bank or money service may handle the transfer. Fees can reduce the amount received.
This is a sum of money sent from one place to another. People living abroad may send it to support family. It can cross national borders.

examples.en: Central banks adjust interest rates to maintain stable economic growth.
examples.zh: 各國央行調整利率以維持穩定的經濟成長。

examples.en: High interest rates make borrowing money for mortgages more expensive.
examples.zh: 高利率使得借貸房貸的成本變得更加沉重。

examples.en: Credit card companies often charge a steep interest rate on unpaid balances.
examples.zh: 信用卡公司通常對未清償餘額收取高昂的循環利率。

examples.en: Central banks adjust benchmark interest rates to combat rising inflation.
examples.zh: 各國央行透過調升或調降基準利率來對抗攀升的通貨膨脹。

examples.en: Fixed interest rate loans protect home buyers from fluctuating borrowing costs.
examples.zh: 固定利率房貸能讓購屋族免受市場借貸利息波動的財務風險。

examples.en: Car dealerships offered attractive zero-percent interest rate promotions on new models.
examples.zh: 汽車經銷商針對旗下最新車款推出了極具吸引力的零利率購車分期專案。

examples.en: Low mortgage interest rates make monthly home loan repayments manageable.
examples.zh: 享有長期優惠低利房貸利率讓成家青年每個月的房貸本息攤還金額維持在寬裕合理的範圍。

examples.en: The central bank raised its benchmark interest rate to curb persistent consumer inflation.
examples.zh: 中央銀行全體理監事會議決議宣布升息半碼，藉由調高基準重貼現率以抑制頑固通膨。

examples.en: Borrowers compare fixed interest rate options against variable rate packages before locking loans.
examples.zh: 房貸借款人在正式對保簽約前，通常會反覆精算比較固定利率與浮動利率方案的長期利息差異。

entries.definition: 利率；利息百分比；房貸利率；借款利息率

explains.en: A bank charges a percentage when someone borrows money. The amount affects how much must be paid back.
A home loan may cost more when this percentage is high. It tells borrowers the price of borrowing.
If you save money at a bank, this percentage may affect what you earn. It is written as a percent.

examples.en: Don't worry, I will pay you back tomorrow at school.
examples.zh: 別擔心，我明天在學校就會把錢還你。

examples.en: It took him five years of hard work to pay back his university loans.
examples.zh: 他花了五年的努力工作才清償了大學助學貸款。

examples.en: She promised to pay back every single cent she borrowed from her uncle.
examples.zh: 她承諾會把向叔叔借的每一分錢都如數償還。

explains.en: Return money that someone lent you. A person may promise to do this next week.
Someone who borrows money should give it back later. This phrase can also mean getting revenge, though that use is less friendly.
After borrowing from a relative, return the same amount. A student may do this after earning money from a job.

examples.en: Night markets offer a vast selection of affordable delicious food.
examples.zh: 夜市提供了多樣價格親民實惠的美味小吃。

examples.en: The city needs more affordable housing options for young working families.
examples.zh: 這座城市需要為年輕上班族家庭提供更多可負擔的合宜住宅。

examples.en: Taking the express train is both fast and remarkably affordable.
examples.zh: 搭乘特快車既快捷又相當經濟實惠。

explains.en: This describes something that costs little enough for someone to pay for it. A family may look for a home within its budget. It does not have to be the cheapest choice.
A meal or ticket with a reasonable price may fit a person's available money. People often seek this when planning a trip. The cost feels manageable.
Use this adjective for something that people can buy without spending more than they can manage. It may be a home, meal, or train ride. The price is within their budget.

examples.en: The New Taiwan Dollar thousand-dollar banknote features the Mikado pheasant.
examples.zh: 新台幣千元大鈔上印有帝雉圖案。

examples.en: Modern banknotes incorporate watermarks and holographic foils to deter counterfeiting.
examples.zh: 現代鈔票結合了水印與雷射全息箔膜以防偽造。

examples.en: He carefully flattened the crumpled banknotes inside his billfold.
examples.zh: 他小心翼翼地把皮夾裡皺巴巴的紙鈔撫平。

explains.en: It is a piece of paper money issued by a country's bank. It has a printed value and special marks to prevent copying. People use it to pay for goods.
Unlike coins, this form of money is made from paper-like material. It may show an important person, animal, or place. Watermarks help prove it is real.
A wallet can hold this kind of cash. Each one has a value printed on it. Modern versions include features that make fakes harder to produce.

examples.en: Drop green airmail postcards into the red and green postbox.
examples.zh: 將綠色航空明信片投進紅白或綠色的郵筒中。

examples.en: There was a stack of advertising flyers stuffed inside my apartment mailbox.
examples.zh: 我公寓的信箱裡塞了一大疊廣告傳單。

examples.en: Check your electronic mailbox regularly for university notifications.
examples.zh: 定期檢查你的電子郵件信箱以接收大學各項通知。

explains.en: Letters are delivered to this box outside a house or apartment building. A small door opens so people can collect them.
A carrier may leave a postcard in this container by the front gate. It can be checked for new messages.
Some buildings have a row of locked boxes for residents’ letters. Each home has its own one.

examples.en: Pick up your e-commerce parcels anytime at the smart parcel locker.
examples.zh: 隨時都能在智慧包裹櫃／智取店領取您的網購包裹。

examples.en: Enter your pickup SMS code on the screen to unlock the parcel locker.
examples.zh: 在螢幕上輸入簡訊取件碼即可解鎖包裹置物格。

examples.en: Smart parcel lockers provide secure twenty-four-hour delivery pickup for residents.
examples.zh: 智慧包裹取件櫃為居民提供全天二十四小時安全的收件服務。

explains.en: This secure cabinet holds packages for people to collect later. A text message may provide a code to open it.
Residents can pick up deliveries at any hour from this set of locked boxes. Enter a number on its screen to open one.
A delivery worker leaves a package in this electronic cabinet. The customer uses a pickup code to retrieve it.

examples.en: Choose express delivery if you want next-day arrival.
examples.zh: 如果您想要隔日送達，請選擇快捷宅配服務。

examples.en: We paid extra for express delivery so the flowers would arrive on Mom's birthday.
examples.zh: 我們額外支付了快遞費用，好讓鮮花能在媽媽生日當天送達。

examples.en: Express delivery options are available during checkout for urgent orders.
examples.zh: 結帳時可針對緊急訂單選用快捷快遞配送選項。

explains.en: This is a fast way to send a package so it arrives sooner than usual. It often costs more than regular shipping. People choose it when a parcel is needed quickly.
A shop may offer this option for an urgent order. The parcel is sent by a faster route. The buyer may pay an extra fee.
This delivery choice aims to bring a letter or package quickly. It may arrive the next day. Customers select it when time matters.

examples.en: Enter the 10-digit tracking number on the courier website.
examples.zh: 在快遞網站上輸入十位數的包裹追蹤號碼。

examples.en: You will receive an SMS containing your parcel tracking number once it ships.
examples.zh: 一旦包裹出貨，您將會收到一則包含包裹追蹤號碼的簡訊。

examples.en: Keep your tracking number handy when inquiring about package delivery status.
examples.zh: 查詢包裹遞送動態時，請隨手備妥您的追蹤號碼。

examples.en: Enter your twelve-digit parcel tracking number online to check status.
examples.zh: 在線上輸入您的十二碼包裹追蹤號碼以即時查詢配送進度。

examples.en: Customers immediately receive a tracking number via email as soon as the item ships out.
examples.zh: 只要商品一完成出貨打包，顧客就會立刻透過電子郵件收到專屬的物流追蹤碼。

examples.en: The customer service representative traced the delayed package using the unique tracking number.
examples.zh: 客服專員利用這組獨一無二的貨運追蹤單號，迅速查詢定位到了運送延誤的包裹。

entries.definition: 包裹追蹤號碼；包裹追蹤碼；貨運單號

explains.en: It is a code used to follow a parcel as it travels. Enter it on a courier's website to see delivery updates. Keep it until the package arrives.
After sending a package, a customer may receive this code by text. It helps the delivery company show where the parcel is. Use it when asking about a shipment.
Each shipment can have a special set of digits and letters for checking its progress. A website uses it to display updates. Save the code in case delivery is delayed.

examples.en: The dedicated postman rides a green scooter across the town.
examples.zh: 敬業的郵差騎著綠色機車穿梭全鎮送信。

examples.en: Our friendly neighborhood postman always greets us with a warm smile.
examples.zh: 我們社區親切的郵差總是帶著溫暖的微笑向我們打招呼。

examples.en: The postman blew his whistle before delivering the registered parcel.
examples.zh: 郵差在遞送掛號包裹前按響了喇叭。

explains.en: This worker brings letters and parcels to homes along a route. A bag or scooter may help carry the mail.
A person in a uniform may walk from door to door with envelopes. They deliver messages sent through the postal service.
When the mailbox is empty in the morning, this local worker may have already passed by. Their job is to deliver letters.

examples.en: Fill in the 3+3 digit postal code for faster mail sorting.
examples.zh: 填寫 3+3 碼郵遞區號有助於郵件更快速分揀。

examples.en: Always double check that the postal code matches the city district.
examples.zh: 請務必再次確認郵遞區號與所在行政區相符。

examples.en: Automated sorting machines read postal codes to speed up mail delivery.
examples.zh: 自動分揀機會讀取郵遞區號以加快信件配送速度。

explains.en: These numbers help sort mail and show which area it should go to. Write them beside an address.
A city district has its own set of digits for letters and packages. Adding them can help a delivery arrive faster.
Mail workers use this number code to send a letter to the correct place. Check it against the city and district.

examples.en: Online shopping platforms often host double 11 shopping festivals.
examples.zh: 線上網購平台經常舉辦雙十一購物節活動。

examples.en: The convenience of online shopping allows consumers to buy goods 24/7.
examples.zh: 網路購物的便利性讓消費者能夠全天候隨時買東西。

examples.en: Online shopping has grown tremendously among elderly consumers in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年來年長消費者群體中的網路購物比例大幅增長。

explains.en: This is buying goods through websites or apps instead of visiting a store. A person can compare items from home. The order is usually delivered later.
People browse products on a connected device and pay electronically. They may shop at any time of day. A package then comes to their home or a pickup point.
This way of buying lets customers use the internet to choose what they need. It is convenient for people who cannot visit nearby shops. Special sales may happen on websites.

examples.en: Orders over $500 are eligible for waived shipping fees.
examples.zh: 訂單滿五百元即可享有免運費優惠。

examples.en: International shipping fees can sometimes exceed the cost of the actual item.
examples.zh: 跨國國際運費有時甚至可能超過商品本身的價格。

examples.en: The shipping fee will be calculated automatically based on package weight.
examples.zh: 運費將根據包裹重量在結帳時自動計算。

explains.en: It is the cost of sending a purchased item to the buyer. The amount may depend on the parcel's weight and distance. Some shops waive it for large orders.
When goods are delivered, a customer may pay this extra charge. International delivery can cost more than local service. Check the total before ordering.
An online store may add this amount for packing and transport. Heavier parcels usually cost more to send. A shop may offer free delivery above a set purchase amount.

examples.en: Get free shipping on your first order this month!
examples.zh: 本月首次下單即可享有免運費好康！

examples.en: Many e-commerce stores offer free shipping when you purchase two items or more.
examples.zh: 許多電商店家在購買兩件或以上商品時提供免運費優惠。

examples.en: Enter the promotional coupon code to unlock free shipping on all books.
examples.zh: 輸入促銷折價代碼即可享有所有書籍免運費優待。

explains.en: When an online order arrives without an extra delivery charge, the buyer pays only for the goods. A store may offer this deal.
A shop may send a book to your home and charge nothing for delivery. The offer can encourage people to order.
Some websites remove the cost of sending a package to the buyer. This offer may apply only to certain orders.

examples.en: The injured driver was rushed to the hospital emergency room.
examples.zh: 受傷的駕駛被緊急送往醫院急診室。

examples.en: Emergency rooms prioritize treatment based on the severity of each case.
examples.zh: 急診室根據每個病患病情的嚴重程度來優先安排治療順序。

examples.en: Doctors and nurses in the emergency room work tirelessly under high pressure.
examples.zh: 急診室的醫師與護理師在高壓環境下不知疲倦地工作。

examples.en: Ambulances rushed injured car crash victims directly to the hospital emergency room.
examples.zh: 救護車將車禍受傷傷患第一時間火速載送至醫院急診室救治。

examples.en: Triage nurses assess patient urgency upon arrival at the busy emergency room.
examples.zh: 檢傷分類護理師在病患送達人滿為患的急診室時，立即進行傷病嚴重度分級。

examples.en: The emergency room was packed on New Year's Eve with holiday emergencies.
examples.zh: 跨年夜當晚的醫院急診室擠滿了各式各樣突發急症的就診人潮。

explains.en: Doctors and nurses treat people who need urgent medical help in this hospital area. An ambulance may bring someone there.
Patients with the most serious injuries are cared for first. The staff work quickly during emergencies.
If someone is badly hurt, this is the part of a hospital to visit. Medical workers check the patient and begin treatment.

examples.en: Taiwan's National Health Insurance system is globally acclaimed.
examples.zh: 台灣的全民健保制度受到全球高度讚譽。

examples.en: National Health Insurance ensures that all citizens have access to affordable healthcare.
examples.zh: 全民健康保險確保全體國民都能獲得負擔得起的醫療服務。

examples.en: Most prescription drugs and clinic visits are covered under National Health Insurance.
examples.zh: 大多數處方藥物與門診診療皆享有全民健保給付。

explains.en: This is a countrywide public system that helps people pay for medical care. Residents may use it for clinic visits and some medicine. It is funded through payments and public support.
People covered by this program can receive care without paying the full cost themselves. It helps make doctors and treatment available to many residents. A card may be shown at a clinic.
This public health program supports access to medical services across a country. It can help cover appointments and prescription drugs. People usually enroll and pay contributions to participate.

examples.en: Present your health insurance card at the clinic registration desk.
examples.zh: 在診所掛號櫃檯出示您的健保卡。

examples.en: Remember to bring your chip-enabled health insurance card to the pharmacy.
examples.zh: 前往藥局領藥時請記得攜帶晶片健保卡。

examples.en: If you lose your health insurance card, you can apply for a replacement online.
examples.zh: 若遺失健保卡，您可以透過線上申辦補發。

explains.en: It is a card that proves someone is covered by a medical insurance program. Patients show it when they visit a clinic. It helps staff check their coverage.
Bring this card to a doctor's office or pharmacy. It contains information used to confirm a person's health coverage. A lost card can usually be replaced.
Clinics may ask to see this personal card at registration. It links a patient to a health insurance plan. Some versions include an electronic chip.

examples.en: Poor sitting posture at desks often leads to lower backache.
examples.zh: 辦公桌前不良的坐姿往往會導致下背疼痛。

examples.en: Gentle yoga stretches can alleviate chronic muscle backache.
examples.zh: 溫和的瑜珈伸展操能舒緩慢性肌肉背痛。

examples.en: Lifting heavy cardboard boxes without bending your knees will cause a backache.
examples.zh: 搬運沉重紙箱若不彎曲膝蓋將會導致背痛。

explains.en: Carrying a heavy backpack for too long can make the back hurt. Rest and gentle stretching may help.
A person may feel soreness across the lower back after lifting a heavy box. Good posture can reduce this discomfort.
This ache affects the part of the body behind the belly and below the shoulders. A doctor can help if it lasts.

examples.en: Honey lemon water helps soothe an irritated sore throat.
examples.zh: 蜂蜜檸檬水有助於舒緩發炎的喉嚨痛。

examples.en: A scratchy sore throat is usually the first sign of a respiratory viral infection.
examples.zh: 喉嚨發癢疼痛通常是呼吸道病毒感染的最初徵兆。

examples.en: Gargling with warm salt water can ease the pain of a sore throat.
examples.zh: 用溫鹽水漱口有助於減緩喉嚨痛的不適感。

explains.en: This painful feeling in the neck can make swallowing hard. A cold may cause it.
Warm drinks with honey may ease this kind of throat pain. If it lasts, tell an adult or doctor.
A person with this problem may feel scratchiness when speaking. Rest and water can help the throat feel better.

examples.en: I used several paper tissues because of my runny nose.
examples.zh: 因為流鼻水，我用掉了好幾張衛生紙。

examples.en: Antihistamines help reduce nasal discharge from a runny nose.
examples.zh: 抗組織胺藥物有助於減少流鼻水的分泌物。

examples.en: Winter cold winds can instantly give you a runny nose.
examples.zh: 冬天寒冷的刺骨寒風會讓人瞬間流鼻水。

explains.en: This happens when clear or thick fluid keeps coming from a person's nostrils. A cold or allergies may cause it. People often use tissues to wipe it.
In cold weather, someone's nose may produce extra fluid. Allergy medicine can sometimes help. It can feel annoying during the day.
This common symptom makes a person wipe their nose often. It may come with a cold or reaction to dust and pollen. A tissue can help keep the face clean.

examples.en: Warm steam inhalations can help relieve a stuffy nose.
examples.zh: 吸入溫熱水蒸氣有助於緩解鼻塞。

examples.en: It is uncomfortable to sleep with a badly stuffy nose.
examples.zh: 嚴重鼻塞時睡起覺來非常不舒服。

examples.en: A nasal spray cleared his stuffy nose in just a few minutes.
examples.zh: 通鼻噴劑在短短幾分鐘內就緩解了他的鼻塞。

explains.en: It describes a nose that feels blocked and makes breathing hard. A cold or allergy can cause this problem. Warm steam may bring some relief.
When air cannot pass easily through the nose, a person may have this symptom. It can make sleeping uncomfortable. Some people use saline spray.
A person with this condition may need to breathe through the mouth. It often happens during a cold. Rest and fluids can help someone feel better.

examples.en: Riding the winding mountain bus made some passengers feel nauseous.
examples.zh: 搭乘蜿蜒的山路公車讓部分乘客感到噁心想吐。

examples.en: The spoiled milk smelled sour and made me feel nauseous.
examples.zh: 酸敗的牛奶聞起來有一股酸味，令我作嘔。

examples.en: Drinking ginger tea can help reduce nauseous sensations.
examples.zh: 飲用生薑茶有助於減輕噁心反胃的感覺。

explains.en: A person may feel sick in the stomach and think they might vomit. A winding bus ride can cause this feeling.
The smell of spoiled food can make someone feel unwell. Ginger tea may help settle the stomach.
This describes the queasy feeling some people get on a boat or after eating bad food. They may need to sit down.

examples.en: Wash raw fruits thoroughly to prevent acute diarrhea.
examples.zh: 生水果務必徹底洗淨以防急性腹瀉。

examples.en: Dehydration is the most dangerous consequence of severe diarrhea.
examples.zh: 脫水是嚴重腹瀉中最具危險性的併發症。

examples.en: Drink oral rehydration electrolyte solution if you experience travelers' diarrhea.
examples.zh: 若出現旅行者腹瀉症狀，請補充電解質口服補液鹽。

examples.en: Stay hydrated with oral rehydration salts when suffering from acute diarrhea.
examples.zh: 罹患急性腸胃炎腹瀉拉肚子時，應適度飲用口服電解質水溶液以防脫水與電解質失衡。

examples.en: Eating undercooked street food is a frequent cause of traveler's diarrhea.
examples.zh: 出國在路邊攤大膽食用未徹底煮熟加熱的生冷海鮮肉品，往往是引發旅人嚴重腹瀉的罪魁禍首。

examples.en: Contact a doctor if severe diarrhea persists for more than two consecutive days.
examples.zh: 若水瀉拉肚子症狀連續劇烈持續超過四十八小時且未見好轉，應儘速就醫接受止瀉與輸液治療。

explains.en: This illness causes frequent loose bowel movements. Drinking clean water is important when someone has it.
A person may lose too much water from the body during this stomach problem. Seek medical help if it is severe or lasts.
Undercooked food can sometimes cause this illness. Replacing lost fluids helps prevent dehydration.

examples.en: Exercise regularly to keep your blood pressure in a normal range.
examples.zh: 規律運動以將血壓維持在正常範圍內。

examples.en: High blood pressure is often referred to as a silent killer.
examples.zh: 高血壓通常被稱作沈默的健康殺手。

examples.en: The clinic nurse placed an inflatable cuff on my arm to measure my blood pressure.
examples.zh: 診所護理師在我手臂上綁上充氣壓脈帶以測量血壓。

explains.en: This measures how strongly blood pushes against the walls of a person's blood vessels. A nurse can check it with a cuff around the arm. Exercise can help keep it in a healthy range.
A clinic worker wraps an inflatable band around the upper arm to measure this. A result that stays too high can harm health. People may need regular checks.
This is the force of moving blood inside the body. A doctor can measure it during a visit. Healthy habits may help keep the reading normal.

examples.en: Apply antibacterial ointment gently over the superficial scratch.
examples.zh: 在表層抓傷處輕輕塗抹抗菌藥膏。

examples.en: Soothing herbal ointment provides fast relief from itchy mosquito bites.
examples.zh: 舒緩的草本軟膏能迅速緩解蚊蟲叮咬引起的搔癢。

examples.en: Put on sterile medical gloves before applying the medicated ointment.
examples.zh: 塗抹藥膏前請先戴上無菌醫療手套。

examples.en: Apply a thin layer of antibacterial ointment over minor cuts and scrapes.
examples.zh: 在表皮輕微擦傷破皮傷口處塗抹薄薄一層抗菌消炎藥膏以加速傷口癒合並防感染。

examples.en: The soothing herbal ointment relieved redness and burning sensation on sunburned shoulders.
examples.zh: 塗抹這款具有草本清涼舒緩成分的外用凝膠軟膏，迅速撫平了他肩膀上曬傷後的紅腫熱痛。

examples.en: Wash your hands thoroughly before and after smoothing healing ointment onto skin abrasions.
examples.zh: 在為皮膚破皮傷口擦抹醫療修復藥膏的前後，請務必先將雙手徹底清潔乾淨以保無菌。

entries.definition: 藥膏；軟膏；外用藥膏；消炎軟膏

explains.en: It is a thick medicine spread on the skin to soothe or protect it. A person may use it on a small scratch or insect bite. Apply a thin layer.
This soft topical medicine can help with itchy or irritated skin. Some kinds fight germs. Wash your hands before and after applying it.
A tube may contain this greasy treatment for a minor skin problem. Put it gently over the affected area. A doctor or pharmacist can explain how to use it.

examples.en: Drowsiness is a common mild side effect of cold medicine.
examples.zh: 嗜睡是感冒藥常見的輕微副作用。

examples.en: The clinical trials showed minimal adverse side effects in patients.
examples.zh: 臨床試驗顯示病患身上的不良副作用微乎其微。

examples.en: Read the medicine leaflet carefully to learn about possible side effects.
examples.zh: 請仔細閱讀藥品說明書以了解可能出現的副作用。

examples.en: Mild fever and muscle soreness are common temporary vaccine side effects.
examples.zh: 輕微發燒與肌肉痠痛是常見且短暫的疫苗接種副作用。

examples.en: Drowsiness is a well-known side effect of certain antihistamine allergy medicines.
examples.zh: 嗜睡昏昏欲睡是某些抗組織胺抗過敏藥物常見且人所皆知的副作用。

examples.en: The economic stimulus package produced unintended inflationary side effects.
examples.zh: 該項大規模經濟振興方案意外引發了通貨膨脹攀升的連鎖負面副作用。

examples.en: Minor drowsiness is a common harmless side effect of traditional cold syrups.
examples.zh: 些微想睡嗜睡是服用傳統綜合感冒止咳糖漿後常見且無害的暫時性副作用。

examples.en: Always ask your pharmacist about potential side effects when starting new prescription medications.
examples.zh: 每當開始服用一種全新的處方藥品時，請務必主動向專業藥師詢問可能伴隨的潛在副作用。

examples.en: The new clinical drug cured the symptoms without causing any adverse side effects.
examples.zh: 這款全新研發的臨床新藥在成功治癒疾病症狀的同時，幾乎沒有引發任何令人不適的不良反應。

explains.en: A medicine may help someone but also cause an unwanted result, such as sleepiness. Read the label to learn about it.
A treatment can have an extra effect that was not the main reason for taking it. Ask a pharmacist if you are unsure.
Feeling tired after taking cold medicine is one possible unwanted result. Doctors and pharmacists can explain what to expect.

examples.en: Teamwork and trusting your teammates lead to victory.
examples.zh: 團隊合作與信任隊友能導向最後勝利。

examples.en: He passed the basketball quickly to an open teammate under the hoop.
examples.zh: 他迅速將籃球傳給籃下無人防守的隊友。

examples.en: Teammates celebrated together with joyful high-fives and loud cheers.
examples.zh: 隊友們高興地互相擊掌並大聲歡呼慶祝。

explains.en: Someone on the same team as you can pass the ball or share a task. Group members work toward the same goal.
A basketball player may pass the ball to someone on the same side. That person is a fellow player.
People in a group share practice and effort. Each member can support the others during a game.

examples.en: Track and field events include sprinting, hurdles, and long jump.
examples.zh: 田徑項目包括短跑、跨欄與跳遠。

examples.en: She won gold medals in two different track and field categories.
examples.zh: 她在兩個不同的田徑競賽項目中皆奪得了金牌。

examples.en: School sports day features exciting track and field relay competitions.
examples.zh: 學校運動會安排了刺激精彩的田徑接力競賽。

explains.en: This is a group of sports that includes running, jumping, and throwing events. Athletes compete on a track or open field. A school sports day may include relays.
Runners race around an oval path, while other athletes may jump or throw. These events are often part of one sport program. Competitors can win medals.
This sport includes sprints, hurdles, and long jumps. Some events happen on a running track and others on a field. Schools often hold competitions in it.

examples.en: Morning jogging around Daan Forest Park is refreshing.
examples.zh: 清晨在大安森林公園周圍慢跑令人心曠神怡。

examples.en: Put on cushioned running shoes to protect your joints while jogging.
examples.zh: 慢跑時請穿上具避震效果的慢跑鞋以保護關節。

examples.en: She prefers light jogging at dusk when the summer heat begins to fade.
examples.zh: 她偏好在黃昏酷暑漸消時進行輕鬆慢跑。

explains.en: It is a form of running done at a steady, gentle pace for exercise. People may do it in a park before breakfast. Comfortable shoes protect their feet.
A person can move faster than walking but slower than racing. This activity helps keep the heart and body fit. Many enjoy it outdoors.
Put on supportive shoes and move along a path at an easy pace. Some people do this at dusk when the air is cooler. It is a popular way to exercise.

examples.en: Cycling around Taiwan (Huan Dao) is a popular dream trip.
examples.zh: 單車環島在台灣是一項非常熱門的夢想之旅。

examples.en: Dedicated riverside cycling paths provide scenic and safe riding experiences.
examples.zh: 專屬的河濱自行車專用道提供了風景秀麗且安全的騎乘體驗。

examples.en: Wear bright reflective clothing when cycling after dark.
examples.zh: 夜間騎自行車時請穿著明亮的反光衣物。

examples.en: Taiwan is a global paradise for road cycling, featuring the famous KOM Challenge.
examples.zh: 台灣是享譽全球的自行車騎乘天堂，其中太魯閣東進武嶺 KOM 登山王挑戰名揚國際。

examples.en: Daily cycling to work along protected riverside paths saves money and clears the mind.
examples.zh: 每天騎自行車沿著河濱專用自行車道悠閒通勤上班，既能節省開銷又能沉澱思緒。

examples.en: Wearing a safety helmet is an essential cycling precaution for both urban and mountain riding.
examples.zh: 配戴安全安全帽是無論在市區穿梭或挑戰陡峭山路時皆不可或缺的單車騎乘防護守則。

entries.definition: 騎自行車；單車運動；自行車運動；騎車兜風

explains.en: People ride a two-wheeled vehicle along roads or trails for exercise. A helmet helps protect the head.
A family may pedal beside a river on a weekend. This activity can be a hobby or a way to travel.
Some people ride in races, while others travel to school on two wheels. Wearing bright clothes helps drivers see them.

examples.en: Swimming is an excellent full-body cardio workout.
examples.zh: 游泳是一項絕佳的全身性有氧運動。

examples.en: Children learn swimming and water safety skills during summer camp.
examples.zh: 孩童在夏令營期間學習游泳技巧與水上安全常識。

examples.en: Swimming against the ocean current can be extremely dangerous.
examples.zh: 逆著海流強行游泳可能極其危險。

explains.en: This activity means moving through water using your arms and legs. It is also a popular way to exercise.
Children can learn water safety while practicing this sport. A pool is a common place to do it.
Some people enjoy moving through the sea or a pool for fun. It works many muscles in the body.

examples.en: Wear swimming goggles to protect your eyes from pool chlorine.
examples.zh: 佩戴泳鏡以保護雙眼不受泳池氯氣刺激。

examples.en: Chemistry students must wear protective goggles during laboratory experiments.
examples.zh: 化學系學生在實驗室進行實驗時必須佩戴防護護目鏡。

examples.en: Anti-fog swimming goggles give you clear underwater vision.
examples.zh: 防霧泳鏡能讓你在水中擁有清晰的視野。

explains.en: These are protective glasses that fit closely around the eyes. Swimmers wear them to keep pool water out. Lab workers use them to protect their eyes too.
A person wears this eye covering in a pool or science lab. It has a strap that holds it in place. Some kinds are made to prevent fogging.
This protective gear covers the eyes and fits snugly against the face. It helps people see underwater or stay safe during experiments. A good fit keeps water or splashes away.

examples.en: I need to re-string my carbon fiber badminton racket.
examples.zh: 我需要替我的碳纖維羽球拍重新穿線。

examples.en: Grip the tennis racket firmly but keep your wrist flexible.
examples.zh: 緊握網球拍但同時讓手腕保持靈活彈性。

examples.en: The sports store sells professional squash and tennis rackets.
examples.zh: 這家體育用品專賣店販售專業壁球拍與網球拍。

explains.en: It is a sports tool with a handle and a stringed or solid head. Players use it to hit a ball or shuttlecock. Tennis and badminton versions differ in shape.
Hold this piece of equipment firmly when playing a court sport. Its broad head sends a ball over a net. A shop may sell versions for squash too.
A player swings this handled frame to strike a small ball. It has strings stretched across its head. Keep the grip secure but relaxed.

examples.en: Smash the feather shuttlecock across the net with power.
examples.zh: 用力將羽毛球扣殺過網。

examples.en: Plastic shuttlecocks are durable and ideal for casual backyard play.
examples.zh: 塑膠羽毛球經久耐用，非常適合庭院休閒對打。

examples.en: The referee examined the tournament shuttlecock for damaged duck feathers.
examples.zh: 裁判檢查了比賽用球是否有破損的鴨毛羽管。

explains.en: In badminton, players hit this feathered object over a net with a racket. It has a rounded base and feathers or plastic fins.
A player serves this small flying piece across the court. It is lighter than a ball.
This object is used in a racket game and has a skirt of feathers. Players try to land it inside the other side of the court.

examples.en: Elementary students love playing energetic dodgeball games during recess.
examples.zh: 國小學生下課時間非常喜歡玩活力充沛的躲避球。

examples.en: He ducked swiftly to avoid being hit by the incoming dodgeball.
examples.zh: 他敏捷地低頭蹲下以避開飛來的躲避球。

examples.en: Dodgeball teaches children rapid agility, throwing accuracy, and team cooperation.
examples.zh: 躲避球運動教導孩子們敏捷的身手、投球準頭與團隊默契。

explains.en: Players throw a soft ball and try not to be hit. It is often played by schoolchildren in a gym.
In this team game, players dodge balls thrown by the other side. Quick movement and teamwork help.
A player may duck or jump to avoid a ball. The goal is to stay in the game while tagging opponents.

examples.en: Catch the high fly ball securely with your baseball glove.
examples.zh: 用你的棒球手套穩穩接住高飛球。

examples.en: Applying leather oil helps soften and break in a new baseball glove.
examples.zh: 塗抹皮革保養油有助於軟化並馴開全新棒球手套。

examples.en: My dad handed down his cherished vintage baseball glove to me.
examples.zh: 父親將他珍藏的古董復古棒球手套傳承給了我。

explains.en: This padded leather hand covering helps a player catch a ball in a field sport. It has a pocket between the fingers and thumb. A player wears it on one hand.
A fielder uses this piece of sports equipment to stop a fast ball safely. Leather oil can make the material softer. It may be kept as a treasured item.
This protective mitt is worn during a game with bases and bats. Its wide pocket makes catching easier. Players often choose one that fits their hand.

examples.en: The batter hit a spectacular grand-slam home run!
examples.zh: 打擊者擊出了一支精彩絕倫的滿貫全壘打！

examples.en: The baseball sailed over the outfield wall for a thrilling solo home run.
examples.zh: 棒球飛越了外野全壘打牆，形成了一記令人熱血沸騰的陽春全壘打。

examples.en: The sales campaign was a massive home run that exceeded all revenue forecasts.
examples.zh: 這次行銷活動大獲全勝，徹底超越了所有的營收預期。

examples.en: The cleanup hitter smashed a grand slam home run over the left-field fence.
examples.zh: 當家第四棒重砲手一棒揮出飛越左外野大牆、奠定勝局的滿貫全壘打。

examples.en: The marketing launch was an absolute home run, selling out product stock in minutes.
examples.zh: 這次新品上市行銷戰大獲全勝、一鳴驚人，短短幾分鐘內便將庫存搶購一空。

examples.en: Spectators scrambled to catch the flying home run ball landing in the right-field bleachers.
examples.zh: 看台上的球迷們紛紛爭相伸手搶接這顆落入右外野外野看台的全壘打紀念球。

explains.en: In baseball, this hit lets the batter circle all the bases and score. The ball usually travels beyond the field's outer wall. It can also mean a great success.
A batter can send the ball far beyond the playing area and earn a score. In everyday speech, this phrase describes an idea or project that succeeds very well.
This baseball hit brings the player all the way around to home plate. People also use it for an effort that is extremely successful.

examples.en: The ace pitcher recorded ten strikeouts during tonight's game.
examples.zh: 王牌投手在今晚的比賽中投出了十次三振。

examples.en: The batter swung and missed on a curveball, resulting in a strikeout.
examples.zh: 打擊者揮棒落空於變化球，吞下了三振出局。

examples.en: Striking out with the bases loaded was a heartbreaking moment for the home team.
examples.zh: 滿壘時遭到三振出局對主場球隊而言是個令人心碎的時刻。

examples.en: The stadium erupted in thunderous applause as the final batter struck out.
examples.zh: 當九局下半最後一名打者揮棒落空遭到三振出局時，整座球場瞬間陷入狂喜。

examples.en: He recorded a strikeout in his first plate appearance against the veteran curveball specialist.
examples.zh: 面對這名專投刁鑽曲球的資深老投手，他在生涯第一次站上打擊區時吞下了三振。

examples.en: High strikeout rates reflect a pitcher's dominance over opposing hitters.
examples.zh: 高奪三振率充分彰顯了一位頂尖強投面對敵隊打者時無與倫比的強大壓制統治力。

explains.en: A batter gets this result when a third strike ends the turn at bat. A pitcher earns one by throwing enough strikes. The scorekeeper records it in the game.
A batter may swing and miss or let a pitch pass. If three strikes end the turn, the scorekeeper records this result. It is credited to the pitcher.
In a scorebook, this result is recorded when three strikes end a batter’s turn. It can happen on a swing and a miss or a called strike.

examples.en: Always warm up properly for ten minutes before rigorous exercise.
examples.zh: 進行劇烈運動前務必充分熱身十分鐘。

examples.en: The orchestra played gentle scales to warm up their instruments before the concert.
examples.zh: 管弦樂團在音樂會前演奏平緩音階來為樂器暖身熱機。

examples.en: Drink a cup of hot ginger soup to warm yourself up after being out in the cold.
examples.zh: 在外頭受凍後，喝杯熱生薑湯讓身體溫暖起來。

explains.en: Do gentle movements before sports to prepare your body. Stretching can help your muscles get ready.
Musicians may play easy notes before a concert begins. This phrase also means making something warmer.
Before running, move lightly for a few minutes. A cup of soup can also make you feel less cold.

examples.en: Jog slowly and stretch to cool down after running laps.
examples.zh: 跑步圈數結束後慢跑並伸展以進行緩和運動。

examples.en: Let the baked pie cool down on the wire rack for twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 讓烘烤完成的餡餅在冷卻架上靜置散熱二十分鐘。

examples.en: Take a few deep breaths to cool down when you feel angry.
examples.zh: 當你感到憤怒時，深呼吸幾次讓自己冷靜下來。

explains.en: After exercise, you can walk slowly and stretch to help your body return to its usual state. Hot food may also do this while sitting on a rack. Taking deep breaths can help when upset.
These words can mean becoming less hot after cooking or exercise. They can also describe becoming less angry. The situation tells which meaning is intended.
A person may do this after running by slowing down and stretching. Soup or a pie can do this as it loses heat. Someone feeling angry may also become calmer.

examples.en: Doing twenty push-ups every morning strengthens chest muscles.
examples.zh: 每天早上做二十個伏地挺身能鍛鍊胸部肌肉。

examples.en: Keep your back straight and core engaged while performing push-ups.
examples.zh: 做伏地挺身時請保持背部挺直並收緊核心肌群。

examples.en: He increased his daily workout to fifty consecutive push-ups.
examples.zh: 他將每日訓練量提高到連續做五十個伏地挺身。

examples.en: Standard daily push-ups maintain upper-body pressing endurance anywhere without gear.
examples.zh: 每天堅持做五十下標準伏地挺身，無需任何器械輔助即可隨時隨地維持充沛的上肢推力耐力。

examples.en: Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels during every push-up.
examples.zh: 做伏地挺身時，從頭部到腳後跟應全程維持呈一直線的中立收緊狀態。

examples.en: Diamond push-ups place extra emphasis on triceps development compared to regular push-ups.
examples.zh: 相較於標準伏地挺身，鑽石式伏地挺身能給予手臂三頭肌更強烈的孤立刺激。

explains.en: It is a strength exercise done on the floor. A person holds the body straight and pushes up with the arms. It works the chest and shoulders.
To do this exercise, place your hands on the ground and lower your body. Then press through your arms to rise. Keep your back straight.
This fitness move uses the arms to lift the body away from the floor. It can strengthen the upper body. Beginners may start with their knees down.

examples.en: Sit-ups are effective for strengthening abdominal core muscles.
examples.zh: 仰臥起坐對強化腹部核心肌群非常有效。

examples.en: Don't pull on your neck with your hands when doing sit-ups.
examples.zh: 做仰臥起坐時切勿用雙手過度拉扯頸部。

examples.en: The military fitness test requires sixty sit-ups within two minutes.
examples.zh: 國軍體能測驗要求在兩分鐘內完成六十個仰臥起坐。

explains.en: Lie on your back with knees bent, then raise your upper body toward them. This exercise strengthens the stomach muscles.
A coach may ask athletes to repeat this floor exercise during a fitness test. Keep your hands gentle on your head.
This exercise starts with someone lying down and curling their torso upward. It is often part of a workout.

examples.en: He practiced on the playground bar to master five pull-ups.
examples.zh: 他在遊樂場單槓上練習以達成連續拉五下引體向上。

examples.en: Pull-ups are a supreme test of upper-body pulling strength.
examples.zh: 引體向上是對上半身拉力的極致考驗。

examples.en: Installing a doorway pull-up bar allows you to exercise easily at home.
examples.zh: 在門框上安裝室內引體向上單槓讓你能在家輕鬆鍛鍊。

examples.en: Strict bodyweight pull-ups create a broad, athletic V-taper back silhouette.
examples.zh: 標准無借力的自重引體向上是雕塑寬闊厚實、充滿力與美的倒三角背肌最佳王牌動作。

examples.en: He struggled to complete his first pull-up, but now he can do twelve in a row.
examples.zh: 他起初連一下標準引體向上都拉不上去，但現在已經能輕鬆連做十二下了。

examples.en: Adding weight with a dip belt turns regular pull-ups into a powerful strength builder.
examples.zh: 使用負重腰帶加掛槓片進行引體向上，能大幅提升上肢拉力與背肌維度。

entries.definition: 引體向上；單槓拉起；引體向上（正手上拉）

explains.en: This exercise uses a bar above your head. Hold it and lift your body until your chin reaches the bar.
A person hangs from a high bar and raises the body using arm strength. It works the shoulders and back.
Athletes may count how many times they can lift themselves on a bar. A strong grip helps with this movement.

examples.en: Lift light dumbbells to tone shoulder and arm muscles.
examples.zh: 舉起輕量啞鈴來緊實肩膀與手臂線條。

examples.en: She bought an adjustable dumbbell set for her home workout space.
examples.zh: 她為居家運動空間添購了一套可調節重量的啞鈴組合。

examples.en: The gym provides a wide rack of dumbbells ranging from two to thirty kilograms.
examples.zh: 健身房配有整排從兩公斤到三十公斤不等齊全的啞鈴架。

examples.en: Perform bicep curls using a pair of eight-kilogram dumbbells.
examples.zh: 使用一對各八公斤的啞鈴進行二頭肌彎舉肌力訓練。

examples.en: Adjustable dumbbells are an excellent space-saving investment for home fitness enthusiasts.
examples.zh: 快速可調重量式組合啞鈴，對於在有限居家空間打造個人健身角落的居家訓練愛好者而言是絕佳投資。

examples.en: Always return dumbbells to the weight rack after completing your strength training sets.
examples.zh: 每次做完重量訓練組數後，請務必發揮公德心隨手將啞鈴物歸原位整齊放回金屬器械架上。

examples.en: Adjustable dumbbells allow efficient upper-body shoulder presses at home.
examples.zh: 一組可快速調整重量的快調啞鈴讓居家健身族在家也能高效率完成肩推與二頭彎舉。

examples.en: She selected a pair of light dumbbells to perform lateral raises for shoulder isolation.
examples.zh: 她挑選了一對輕量啞鈴進行側平舉，以精準孤立鍛鍊肩膀側三角肌。

examples.en: Dumbbells allow a greater range of motion than fixed barbells during chest exercises.
examples.zh: 在胸部訓練中，啞鈴比起固定槓鈴能提供更深、更完整的動作行程。

explains.en: This short bar has a weight at each end and is lifted by hand for exercise. People use it to strengthen their arms and shoulders. A gym may keep many sizes on a rack.
A person can hold one in each hand while doing curls or presses. Some can be adjusted by changing the weights. It is useful for strength training at home.
This piece of exercise equipment is smaller than a long weightlifting bar. You lift it to work muscles in the arms, chest, or shoulders. Put it back on the rack after use.

examples.en: The National Palace Museum houses thousands of priceless historic treasures.
examples.zh: 國立故宮博物院收藏了數千件無價歷史國寶。

examples.en: Tourists marvel at the exquisite details of the Jadeite Cabbage at the National Palace Museum.
examples.zh: 遊客們在國立故宮博物院驚嘆於翠玉白菜的精緻細節。

examples.en: The Southern Branch of the National Palace Museum in Chiayi features Asian textiles and ceramics.
examples.zh: 位於嘉義的國立故宮博物院南部院區以亞洲織品與陶瓷器為特色展覽。

explains.en: It is a museum in Taipei with a large collection of Chinese art and historic objects. Visitors can see paintings, jade, and ceramics. A southern branch is in Chiayi.
This famous museum preserves treasures from many centuries. One well-known carving shows a cabbage made from jade. People visit to learn about history and art.
The institution has a main site in Taipei and another in southern Taiwan. Its galleries display old objects, paintings, and crafts. School groups often visit.

examples.en: The new animated movie was a huge box office success.
examples.zh: 這部新動畫電影在票房上取得了巨大的成功。

examples.en: You can buy remaining seats at the theatre box office before curtain call.
examples.zh: 您可以在演出開演前在劇院售票處購買剩餘座位。

examples.en: The summer blockbuster broke historical box office records across the country.
examples.zh: 這部暑期強檔大片打破了全美各地的歷史票房紀錄。

examples.en: The Taiwanese romance hit crossed three hundred million at the local box office.
examples.zh: 這部現象級台灣青春愛情電影在全台締造了破三億元的亮眼票房佳績。

examples.en: Strong word-of-mouth buzz propelled the low-budget suspense film to unexpected box office triumph.
examples.zh: 觀眾在社群平台上爆發出的強大口碑效應，有力推動了這部低成本小眾懸疑佳作在院線實現了不可思議的票房大逆襲。

examples.en: Pundits track opening weekend box office numbers closely to gauge public appetite for superhero sequels.
examples.zh: 票房財經分析師密切緊盯新片上映首週末的三日全台票房數據，以此作為精準衡量大眾對超英續集審美疲勞程度的風向標。

examples.en: The inspiring local sports drama broke domestic box office records within two weeks.
examples.zh: 這部勵志熱血的本土棒球傳奇電影在上映短短兩週內便勢如破竹打破全台本土電影票房紀錄。

examples.en: High box office earnings do not always correlate with positive artistic reviews from critics.
examples.zh: 一部電影在商業上狂攬的亮眼票房數字，並不必然等同於能收穫專業影評界同等高度的藝術評價。

examples.en: You can pick up your reserved cinema tickets directly at the automatic box office kiosk.
examples.zh: 你可以直接在電影院大廳擺設的自動售票機（Box Office Kiosk）掃描 QR Code 領取預售票。

entries.definition: 售票處；票房；電影票房；電影票房紀錄

explains.en: This is the place in a cinema where people buy tickets. It can also describe how many tickets a film sells.
Arrive early and buy a seat at the theater counter. Movie reviews sometimes discuss a film’s ticket earnings.
A theater worker may help you purchase admission here. A popular film can earn a lot from ticket sales.

examples.en: The cozy cafe invites a live jazz band every Saturday night.
examples.zh: 這家溫馨咖啡廳每週六晚上都會邀請現場爵士樂團演奏。

examples.en: Nothing beats the electric energy of dancing to a live rock band.
examples.zh: 沒有任何體驗比隨著現場搖滾樂團的演奏盡情起舞更令人熱血沸騰。

examples.en: The wedding reception featured a four-piece live band playing romantic covers.
examples.zh: 婚宴現場安排了一支四人現場伴奏樂團翻唱浪漫情歌。

explains.en: Musicians play songs in person while people listen. A group may perform at a cafe or wedding.
At a concert, singers and players make music onstage at that moment. The audience can hear the instruments directly.
A group of musicians performs before an audience instead of playing a recording. People may dance to the music.

examples.en: The poetic song lyrics touched the hearts of many listeners.
examples.zh: 這首歌曲富含詩意的歌詞觸動了無數聽眾的心弦。

examples.en: She knows all the English lyrics to her favorite pop albums by heart.
examples.zh: 她能把最喜愛的流行音樂專輯中所有的英文歌詞倒背如流。

examples.en: The songwriter spent weeks polishing the chorus lyrics until they rhymed naturally.
examples.zh: 這位詞曲創作者花了數週潤飾副歌歌詞，直到文字自然押韻為止。

explains.en: These are the words that people sing in a song. A listener may learn them by heart. A writer may adjust them so the lines rhyme.
A song has a tune and words that go with it. Fans may memorize the words to their favorite music. The writer creates them.
People read or sing these words along with music. They may tell a story or share feelings. The repeated part of a song often has memorable words.

examples.en: He strummed his acoustic guitar gently by the campfire.
examples.zh: 他在營火旁輕輕撥彈著他的木吉他。

examples.en: The warm, woody resonance of an acoustic guitar is perfect for indie folk music.
examples.zh: 木吉他溫暖醇厚的木質共鳴非常適合獨立民謠音樂。

examples.en: She bought a solid-wood acoustic guitar with money saved from her summer job.
examples.zh: 她用暑假打工存下來的積蓄買了一把全單板原聲木吉他。

explains.en: It is a stringed instrument that makes sound through its hollow wooden body. A player plucks or strums the strings. It does not need an amplifier.
Musicians use this instrument to play songs with a warm, natural sound. It usually has six strings and a sound hole. It is popular in folk music.
This guitar creates sound without electronic amplification. Its body helps the strings ring clearly. Someone can play chords by strumming or picking.

examples.en: The rock guitarist played an explosive solo on his electric guitar.
examples.zh: 搖滾吉他手用電吉他飆出了一段極具爆發力的獨奏。

examples.en: Plug your electric guitar into the amplifier using a heavy-duty cable.
examples.zh: 使用耐用音訊線將你的電吉他插上音箱擴大機。

examples.en: Heavy metal bands rely on distorted electric guitars for powerful riffs.
examples.zh: 重金屬樂團依賴破音效果的電吉他來演奏震撼有力的吉他樂句。

explains.en: This guitar uses electricity and an amplifier to make its sound louder. It is often heard in rock music.
A musician plugs this instrument into a speaker and can change its tone. It has strings like an acoustic guitar.
In a band, a player may use this instrument for powerful riffs and solos. A cable connects it to an amplifier.

examples.en: Japanese animation films enjoy widespread popularity in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 日本動畫電影在台灣享有極高的人氣。

examples.en: Computer animation studios use complex 3D software to bring characters to life.
examples.zh: 電腦動畫工作室使用複雜的 3D 軟體賦予虛擬角色鮮活性命。

examples.en: The teacher used animated graphics to explain complicated physics principles to students.
examples.zh: 老師使用動態動畫圖解向學生闡明複雜的物理原理。

examples.en: Taiwanese 3D animation studios have won prestigious international film awards.
examples.zh: 台灣本土的 3D 動畫團隊榮獲了多座國際知名影展大獎。

examples.en: The graphic designer added subtle UI button animations to make the app feel alive.
examples.zh: 介面設計師加入了細膩的按鈕微動畫，讓這款 App 充滿生動的互動感。

examples.en: Traditional hand-drawn 2D animation requires immense patience and craftsmanship.
examples.zh: 傳統手繪 2D 動畫需要極大的耐心與極致扎實的手藝技術。

examples.en: Pixar and Ghibli are beloved pioneers of heartwarming 3D and 2D animation.
examples.zh: 皮克斯與吉卜力皆為全球影迷無比熱愛的溫馨 3D 與 2D 動畫殿堂。

examples.en: Hand-drawn traditional cel animation possesses a warm, organic charm that synthetic algorithms struggle to replicate.
examples.zh: 逐格手繪的傳統賽璐珞手繪二維動畫，自帶一種溫潤靈動的質樸手作魅力，那是冰冷電腦生成演算難以企及的溫度。

examples.en: The enthusiastic speaker brought tremendous energy and animation to her presentation on marine conservation.
examples.zh: 這位受邀演講者在台上神采飛揚、手舞足蹈，以充沛的熱情與生氣勃勃的感染力發表了關於海洋環境保育的精彩倡議。

examples.en: Japanese animated series captivated millions of young fans worldwide.
examples.zh: 精彩絕倫的日本電視動畫影集深深吸引了全球數以百萬計的年輕動漫迷。

examples.en: She studied computer animation and now works as a visual effects designer.
examples.zh: 她在大學專攻電腦動畫設計，如今在一家頂尖視覺特效工作室擔任特效師。

examples.en: Hand-drawn animation has a unique charm that digital tools cannot easily replicate.
examples.zh: 純手繪的傳統動畫擁有獨特的藝術溫度與魅力，是純數位工具難以輕易取代的。

entries.definition: 動畫；動漫；生動生機；動畫片；動畫製作；生氣勃勃；動畫製作技術；活力

explains.en: This art makes drawings or models seem to move on a screen. Many cartoons use it.
Artists create a series of pictures that appear to move when shown quickly. Computer programs can help make them.
A lively person may speak with great energy and expression. The word also names moving images made for films or games.

examples.en: I love sci-fi movies about space exploration and time travel.
examples.zh: 我熱愛關於太空探索與時空穿越的科幻電影。

examples.en: Classic sci-fi literature often accurately predicted technologies we use today.
examples.zh: 經典的科幻文學往往精準預言了我們今日所使用的科技發明。

examples.en: The new sci-fi series depicts human civilization colonizing distant star systems.
examples.zh: 這部全新科幻影集描繪了人類文明在遙遠恆星系統建立殖民地的歷程。

explains.en: This kind of story imagines future technology, space travel, or life beyond Earth. It can appear in books, films, or television shows. Some stories explore what might happen to people in the future.
Writers create tales about robots, distant planets, and new inventions. These stories are often called science fiction. They may be exciting or make readers think.
A story in this genre may show people traveling through space or meeting aliens. It can be told in a book or on screen. The events are imagined rather than ordinary daily life.

examples.en: Fast car chases and martial arts stunts are typical in action movies.
examples.zh: 飛車追逐與武打特技是動作電影的經典元素。

examples.en: He munched on popcorn while watching the thrilling Hollywood action movie.
examples.zh: 他一邊吃著爆米花，一邊津津有味地看著刺激的熱血好萊塢動作片。

examples.en: The director is renowned for orchestrating explosive, high-octane action movies.
examples.zh: 這位導演以執導場面震撼、扣人心弦的爆破動作片而享譽業界。

explains.en: It is a film with exciting chases, fights, or daring rescues. The story often moves quickly. Viewers may watch heroes face danger.
This kind of film features stunts and fast-moving scenes. Cars may race through streets, or characters may practice martial arts. It is made to thrill an audience.
A director may fill this movie with explosions, adventure, and physical challenges. The main characters often fight to stop a danger. Many people enjoy its exciting pace.

examples.en: Watching scary horror movies late at night gave me goosebumps.
examples.zh: 深夜看恐怖鬼片讓我渾身起雞皮疙瘩。

examples.en: She covered her eyes with both hands during the scariest jump scenes in the horror movie.
examples.zh: 在恐怖片最嚇人的驚嚇鏡頭時，她用雙手緊緊遮住了眼睛。

examples.en: The abandoned hospital was the spooky setting for the indie horror movie.
examples.zh: 這座荒廢的醫院是這部獨立恐怖電影毛骨悚然的取景拍攝地。

explains.en: This kind of film is made to frighten viewers with ghosts, monsters, or suspense. People may cover their eyes during a scary scene.
A dark house and a sudden noise are common parts of this movie genre. Some viewers enjoy feeling scared safely.
The story may include a monster or mystery that makes the audience nervous. It is meant to be frightening.

examples.en: Turn on English subtitles to improve your listening skills while watching movies.
examples.zh: 看電影時開啟英文字幕以加強英語聽力技巧。

examples.en: The documentary features bilingual subtitles in both English and Mandarin.
examples.zh: 這部紀錄片配有英漢雙語對照字幕。

examples.en: Reading foreign movie subtitles quickly becomes second nature with practice.
examples.zh: 透過練習，快速閱讀外語電影字幕很快就會變成一種直覺習慣。

examples.en: Turning on English subtitles helps learners improve listening comprehension.
examples.zh: 開啟英文字幕能有效幫助英語學習者增進聽力理解能力。

examples.en: The foreign film was screened with dual traditional Chinese and English subtitles.
examples.zh: 這部外語電影放映時配上了繁體中文與英文雙語對照字幕。

examples.en: The book has an informative subtitle explaining its practical application.
examples.zh: 這本書帶有一個深具說明性的副標題，闡明了其具體的實務應用。

examples.en: Adding bilingual English and Chinese subtitles expands international viewership.
examples.zh: 加上中英雙語對照字幕能讓全球海外觀眾毫無語言隔閡地欣賞影片。

examples.en: Subtitle translators must condense dialogue cleverly to match strict reading speed constraints per frame.
examples.zh: 影視字幕翻譯師必須具備極強的凝練功力，巧妙壓縮字句以嚴格契合每秒畫面人類眼睛的極限閱讀速度限制。

examples.en: Foreign language films are enjoyed worldwide thanks to accurate and culturally nuanced subtitles.
examples.zh: 許多非英語系國家的優秀外語文藝片之所以能在全球收穫熱烈迴響，精準到位且融入在地文化韻味的字幕居功至偉。

examples.en: Bilingual subtitles allow global audiences to appreciate foreign language arthouse cinema.
examples.zh: 雙語字幕能讓全球跨國觀眾毫無語言隔閡地細細品味各國獨立外語藝術電影的深邃內涵。

examples.en: The film distribution company hired experienced translators to subtitle the dialect comedy into English.
examples.zh: 電影發行商重金禮聘深諳在地流行語的資深專業譯者，將方言喜劇精心翻譯製作成道地英文字幕。

examples.en: Turn on closed subtitles so elderly viewers can follow fast dialogue without missing key plot clues.
examples.zh: 開啟無障礙中文字幕能讓家中長輩輕鬆掌握連珠炮般的快嘴對白，絕不漏掉任何關鍵劇情線索。

entries.definition: 字幕；副標題；添加字幕；影視中英文字幕；加字幕

explains.en: Words shown at the bottom of a film help viewers follow spoken dialogue. They may be in another language.
A book or article can have a smaller heading beneath its main title. This word can also name that heading.
People who cannot hear every line may read text on the screen. A translator can create it for a foreign film.

examples.en: The movie's original soundtrack became a chart-topping hit album.
examples.zh: 該電影的原聲帶專輯榮登各大音樂排行榜冠軍。

examples.en: Ennio Morricone composed legendary instrumental soundtracks for Western cinema classics.
examples.zh: 顏尼歐·莫利克奈為多部經典西部電影譜寫了傳奇配樂原聲帶。

examples.en: I listen to the calming ambient movie soundtrack while studying in the library.
examples.zh: 在圖書館研讀功課時，我會聆聽這部電影平靜舒緩的原聲帶音樂。

examples.en: The emotional orchestral movie soundtrack topped global music streaming charts.
examples.zh: 感人肺腑的交響管弦電影原聲帶（OST）強勢橫掃全球音樂串流榜單。

examples.en: I listen to the acoustic guitar soundtrack whenever I need to focus and write.
examples.zh: 每當我需要屏除外界干擾、全神貫注提筆寫作時，我總習慣在耳邊播放那張優美恬靜的原聲木吉他電影配樂原聲帶。

examples.en: The vinyl record edition of the animated movie soundtrack sold out within hours of launch.
examples.zh: 這部超人氣長篇原創動畫電影的限量典藏版黑膠原聲唱片，在正式開賣後短短數小時內便被全網動漫影迷搶購一空。

entries.definition: 原聲帶；電影配樂；電影原聲帶；電影配樂 (OST)

explains.en: This is the recorded music and sounds that accompany a movie or show. A composer may create it to fit the scenes. People can listen to it while studying.
A film's songs, music, and other audio can be released together as an album. It helps create the mood of the story. It may be played on a record or online.
This recorded audio belongs with a movie, game, or television program. It can include songs or instrumental music. A calm one may help someone focus.

examples.en: Almost every adult in Taiwan owns a high-speed smartphone.
examples.zh: 台灣幾乎每位成年人都擁有一支高速智慧型手機。

examples.en: She uses her smartphone to scan QR codes for quick mobile payments.
examples.zh: 她使用智慧型手機掃描 QR Code 進行快速行動支付。

examples.en: Excessive smartphone use before bedtime can disrupt your natural sleep cycle.
examples.zh: 睡前過度使用智慧型手機會干擾你的自然睡眠週期。

explains.en: It is a mobile phone that can run apps and connect to the internet. People use it to take photos, send messages, and scan codes. It has a touch screen.
This handheld device combines calling with many computer features. It can show maps, play music, or make mobile payments. Too much screen time before bed may affect sleep.
A person can carry this small computer in a pocket. It can connect to the web and use applications. Many people rely on it for daily tasks.

examples.en: Tap the interactive touchscreen to place your fast food order.
examples.zh: 輕觸互動式觸控螢幕以點選速食餐點。

examples.en: Modern subway ticket kiosks feature multi-language touchscreens.
examples.zh: 現代地鐵售票機配有支援多國語言的觸控螢幕。

examples.en: Use a soft microfiber cloth to wipe fingerprints off the touchscreen.
examples.zh: 使用柔軟的超細纖維布擦拭觸控螢幕上的指紋。

examples.en: Control air conditioning, navigation, and music via the central 15-inch touchscreen.
examples.zh: 透過中控台中央十五吋高畫質彩色觸控螢幕即可輕鬆掌控車內恆溫空調與影音導航。

examples.en: The smartphone touchscreen remained completely responsive even when operated in the rain.
examples.zh: 這支智慧型手機的觸控螢幕即便在雨水噴濺下操作，依然維持著靈敏的觸控反饋。

examples.en: Many modern automakers have replaced traditional physical buttons with sleek touchscreens.
examples.zh: 許多當代新車製造商紛紛以俐落簡潔的大型觸控螢幕取代了傳統繁瑣的實體按鈕。

explains.en: Tap pictures and buttons on this display to control a phone or ticket machine. You do not need a mouse.
A clean, soft cloth can remove fingerprints from this interactive screen. It responds when a finger touches it.
Many cars use a large display to control maps and music. Drivers can select choices by touching the glass.

examples.en: Turn off app notifications during study hours to avoid distraction.
examples.zh: 讀書時間關閉 App 推播通知以避免分心。

examples.en: You will receive an instant push notification when your package arrives.
examples.zh: 當您的包裹送達時，您將會收到一則即時推播通知。

examples.en: The university posted an official notification regarding holiday campus closures.
examples.zh: 大學發布了關於連假期間校園閉館的正式公告通知。

examples.en: Turn on the bell notification to get immediate updates on new uploads.
examples.zh: 開啟小鈴鐺推播通知以獲取最新上片的第一手即時資訊。

examples.en: I disabled social media notifications while studying for my exam.
examples.zh: 準備考試期間，我關閉了所有社群媒體的推播通知。

examples.en: You will receive an SMS notification once your package arrives at the convenience store.
examples.zh: 一旦包裹抵達便利商店，您就會收到簡訊取貨通知。

entries.definition: 通知；推播通知；提醒訊息

explains.en: A phone may show a small message when something new happens. It can remind you about a meeting.
An official note tells people about an event or change. A school may send one to families.
This alert may appear on a screen when a package arrives. You can turn off these messages while studying.

examples.en: Go to phone settings to adjust your screen brightness.
examples.zh: 進入手機設定選單以調整螢幕亮度。

examples.en: You can manage your privacy settings to restrict who views your profile.
examples.zh: 您可以管理隱私權設定，限制誰能檢視您的個人檔案。

examples.en: Reset the router to its factory default settings to clear network errors.
examples.zh: 將路由器恢復原廠預設設定以排除網路設定錯誤。

explains.en: These are choices in a phone, app, or device that control how it works. You can change screen brightness or privacy there. A router may have factory choices too.
A user can open this part of a device to change its behavior. It may let you control who sees your profile. Returning everything to its original state can fix some problems.
This menu contains options for adjusting a device or app. You might use it to change the screen or network. It can also help protect personal information.

examples.en: Can you turn on your mobile hotspot so I can share your data?
examples.zh: 你能開啟手機行動熱點讓我分享網路嗎？

examples.en: The night market is a renowned tourist hotspot for authentic street food.
examples.zh: 這座夜市是品嚐道地街頭美食的著名觀光熱門景點。

examples.en: Using your smartphone as a personal hotspot drains battery life quickly.
examples.zh: 將智慧型手機作為個人熱點使用會快速消耗電池電量。

examples.en: You can turn your smartphone into a portable Wi-Fi personal hotspot.
examples.zh: 您可以將智慧型手機轉換為隨身可攜式的 Wi-Fi 個人熱點。

examples.en: Free public Wi-Fi hotspots are available at most MRT stations and cafes.
examples.zh: 多數捷運站與咖啡廳均提供免費公共 Wi-Fi 熱點。

examples.en: That coastal cafe has become a popular tourist hotspot on Instagram.
examples.zh: 那家濱海咖啡廳已成為 Instagram 上熱門的觀光打卡熱點。

entries.definition: 行動熱點；熱門地點；Wi-Fi 熱點；熱門景點

explains.en: It is a place or device that provides wireless internet access. A phone can share its mobile data with nearby devices. The battery may drain quickly.
Travelers may connect a laptop to this wireless access point. Cafes and libraries often provide one. The term can also mean a popular place to visit.
A mobile device can create a small area where others get online. A busy tourist spot may also be described this way. Passwords help keep the connection private.

examples.en: Turn on Bluetooth to pair your wireless earbuds with your phone.
examples.zh: 開啟藍牙以將無線耳機與手機進行配對。

examples.en: Bluetooth technology allows fast wireless audio transmission over short distances.
examples.zh: 藍牙技術允許在短距離內進行快速的無線音訊傳輸。

examples.en: Many modern cars connect seamlessly to smartphones via hands-free Bluetooth.
examples.zh: 許多現代汽車透過免持藍牙技術與智慧型手機無縫連線。

explains.en: This short-range wireless system connects a phone to headphones or a car. It works without a cable.
Turn on this feature to pair a device with a speaker nearby. The connection uses radio waves.
A phone can send music to earbuds through this wireless technology. Devices must be close to each other.

examples.en: This laptop has an impressive twelve-hour battery life.
examples.zh: 這款筆記型電腦擁有長達十二小時的優異電池續航力。

examples.en: Lowering screen brightness can significantly extend your smartphone's battery life.
examples.zh: 調低螢幕亮度可以顯著延長智慧型手機的電池續航時間。

examples.en: Over time, frequent overcharging can degrade overall battery life.
examples.zh: 隨著時間推移，頻繁過度充電會損耗整體電池的壽命與續航力。

explains.en: This tells how long a device can work before its power runs out. A phone may last many hours on one charge.
Lowering a screen's brightness can help a laptop stay on longer. The time between charges is important when traveling.
An electronic device with a strong battery can be used for a long time. This phrase describes that lasting time.

examples.en: Always carry a fully charged power bank when traveling abroad.
examples.zh: 出國旅遊時請隨身攜帶充飽電的行動電源。

examples.en: Airline safety rules prohibit placing power banks in checked baggage.
examples.zh: 航空安全法規嚴格禁止將行動電源放入託運行李中。

examples.en: This compact power bank can recharge a smartphone up to three times.
examples.zh: 這款輕巧型行動電源可為智慧型手機完整充電多達三次。

explains.en: This portable device stores electricity so a phone can be charged away from a wall outlet. Travelers often carry one. Airlines may have rules about where to pack it.
A small battery pack can give a smartphone extra energy when its battery is low. It can recharge a device more than once. Keep it in a bag while traveling.
People use this rechargeable device to charge phones or other electronics on the go. It is useful during trips. It should be carried in hand luggage on many flights.

examples.en: Save your presentation slides on a portable USB flash drive.
examples.zh: 將你的簡報投影片儲存於隨身攜帶的 USB 隨身碟中。

examples.en: He plugged the flash drive into the desktop computer to transfer files.
examples.zh: 他把隨身碟插進桌上型電腦以進行檔案傳輸。

examples.en: Encrypt sensitive documents stored on your USB flash drive for protection.
examples.zh: 為儲存在 USB 隨身碟中的機密文件進行加密以獲得保護。

explains.en: It is a small portable device for saving computer files. Plug it into a USB port to move documents between computers. Keep important files backed up.
Students may carry presentations on this tiny storage device. It has no moving parts and fits in a pocket. Some models protect files with a password.
This removable memory tool connects to a computer through a USB socket. It can store photos, music, or documents. Remove it safely before pulling it out.

examples.en: Wireless earbuds are lightweight and convenient for jogging.
examples.zh: 無線藍牙耳機輕巧便攜，慢跑時佩戴非常方便。

examples.en: She lost one of her wireless earbuds while rushing onto the subway train.
examples.zh: 她在匆忙衝上捷運列車時不慎弄丟了一隻無線耳機。

examples.en: Keep your earbuds in their charging case when not in use to avoid losing them.
examples.zh: 未使用時請將耳機放回充電盒內，以防不慎遺失。

entries.definition: 無線藍牙耳機；入耳式耳機

explains.en: These tiny speakers fit inside the ears and play music from a phone. Some models connect without a wire.
Keep a pair in a charging case when they are not being used. People wear them while listening to audio.
A commuter can listen to a podcast through small personal earphones. They may connect wirelessly to a phone.

examples.en: Swipe left to view the next photo in the album.
examples.zh: 向左滑動以查看相簿中的下一張照片。

examples.en: Simply swipe your staff ID badge across the sensor to unlock the office door.
examples.zh: 只需在感應器上刷一下員工證即可解鎖辦公室大門。

examples.en: The curious cat swiped its paw playfully at the dangling string.
examples.zh: 好奇的小貓伸出爪子頑皮地撥弄著懸掛的細線。

explains.en: Move a finger across a phone screen to see another picture. This motion can also unlock some devices.
Slide an ID card past a reader to open a door. A quick hand movement can also hit at something.
A phone user moves a finger left or right across the glass. The word may also describe a sweeping blow with a hand or paw.

examples.en: Pinch out on the touchscreen to zoom in on the map details.
examples.zh: 在觸控螢幕上向外雙指推開以放大地圖細節。

examples.en: The photographer zoomed in to capture the hummingbird sipping nectar.
examples.zh: 攝影師拉近變焦鏡頭以捕捉蜂鳥吮吸花蜜的瞬間。

examples.en: Let's zoom in on this specific marketing problem to find a root cause.
examples.zh: 讓我們聚焦放大深入探討這項具體的行銷難題以找出根本原因。

explains.en: You do this on a screen when you want to see a map or photo more closely. The image looks larger, though part of it may go off the screen. A camera can also do this to show a distant object.
Pinching a touchscreen can make details appear bigger. A photographer can adjust a lens to make a bird seem nearer. The same action can help focus on one part of a problem.
This phrase describes making a view closer or larger. It can help show small details in an image. People may also use it to focus attention on one issue.

examples.en: Zoom out to see the entire Taiwan railway route network.
examples.zh: 縮小畫面以檢視全台灣鐵路路線全圖。

examples.en: The director zoomed out to show the vast, solitary desert surrounding the traveler.
examples.zh: 導演將鏡頭拉遠縮小，呈現出圍繞著旅人的遼闊孤寂荒漠。

examples.en: Sometimes we need to zoom out and evaluate the big picture objectively.
examples.zh: 有時候我們需要拉遠視角，客觀審視整體大局發展。

explains.en: Use this camera command to show a wider view of a scene. The subject looks smaller as more surroundings appear. It can help someone see the whole picture.
On a map or screen, this action reveals a larger area. A director may use it to show a traveler in a vast desert. The opposite action makes the view closer.
A person can reduce the image size to see more around it. This can help when reading a large map. Figuratively, it means looking at a situation broadly.

examples.en: Click on the hyperlink to read the full news article.
examples.zh: 點擊超連結以閱讀完整的新聞報導。

examples.en: Blue underlined text usually indicates an active web hyperlink.
examples.zh: 藍色帶底線的文字通常表示這是一個可點選的網路超連結。

examples.en: The digital textbook includes hyperlinks directly connecting to external reference videos.
examples.zh: 這本數位教材包含直接連至外部參考教學影片的超連結。

explains.en: Click the blue underlined words on a web page to open another page. They connect readers to more information.
A digital book may include clickable text that opens a video or reference. This link joins one online resource to another.
When the pointer changes near colored text, selecting it can take you elsewhere on the internet. It is a web link.

examples.en: Google Chrome and Safari are widely used web browsers.
examples.zh: Google Chrome 與 Safari 是被廣泛使用的網路瀏覽器。

examples.en: Clear your internet browser cache if a website fails to load properly.
examples.zh: 若網站無法正常載入，請試著清理您的網路瀏覽器快取。

examples.en: Bookworms and browsers enjoyed wandering through the shelves of the second-hand bookstore.
examples.zh: 愛書人與隨興翻閱的瀏覽客們享受穿梭在二手書店書架間的樂趣。

examples.en: Clear your web browser cache if web pages fail to load correctly.
examples.zh: 若網頁無法正常載入顯示，請嘗試清除網路瀏覽器快取。

examples.en: Most modern web browsers support private browsing and custom extensions.
examples.zh: 多數現代網路瀏覽器皆支援無痕隱私瀏覽與自訂擴充套件。

examples.en: The browser crashed when I attempted to stream three videos at once.
examples.zh: 當我試圖同時串流播放三部影片時，瀏覽器當機了。

explains.en: This computer program opens websites and lets people read pages online. Chrome and Safari are two examples.
Clear this program's stored files if a website is not working well. It can also mean a person looking through books.
A user types a web address into this software to visit a page. A person who casually looks around a shop can also be described this way.

examples.en: Google is the most widely utilized search engine globally.
examples.zh: Google 是全球使用最廣泛的網路搜尋引擎。

examples.en: Search engines use complex algorithms to deliver relevant ranking results.
examples.zh: 搜尋引擎使用複雜演算法來呈現高度相關的排序搜尋結果。

examples.en: Optimizing website content helps improve visibility on popular search engines.
examples.zh: 最佳化網站內容有助於提升在主流搜尋引擎上的曝光能見度。

explains.en: This is a website or tool that helps people find information on the internet. You type words into a box and receive links. It sorts results to show useful pages.
A person can enter a question and get a list of websites. The tool looks through online information quickly. Popular examples are used around the world.
This online service helps users locate pages, images, or facts. It uses software to choose which results appear first. Good website content can help a page be easier to find.

examples.en: Type relevant keywords into the search bar to find answers quickly.
examples.zh: 在搜尋列輸入相關關鍵字以迅速找到解答。

examples.en: Identifying effective keywords is critical for running successful search ad campaigns.
examples.zh: 找出高效精準的關鍵字對於投放成功的搜尋廣告至關重要。

examples.en: Underline keywords in the reading passage to assist in summarizing paragraphs.
examples.zh: 在閱讀短文中畫出重點關鍵字，有助於概括歸納段落大意。

explains.en: It is an important word used to search for information online. Type it into a search box to find useful pages. Writers may mark these terms in a passage.
A search engine uses this word or phrase to find matching results. Choosing clear terms can make a search faster. An advertisement may also be linked to them.
This important search term helps locate a topic. Students can underline key terms before summarizing a reading. A good choice makes results more relevant.

examples.en: Instagram and Threads are trending social media platforms among youth.
examples.zh: Instagram 和 Threads 是在年輕人之間極具人氣的社群平台。

examples.en: Businesses leverage social media marketing to engage directly with consumers.
examples.zh: 企業善用社群媒體行銷與廣大消費者直接建立互動。

examples.en: Taking a break from social media can greatly benefit your mental health.
examples.zh: 適度遠離社群媒體暫時休息能為心理健康帶來莫大益處。

explains.en: People use online apps and websites to share pictures, messages, and videos with friends. Posts can reach a wide audience.
A person may take a break from these online community platforms to rest. Businesses also use them to talk with customers.
Users follow friends, post updates, and comment on content through these internet services. Some are designed for sharing short videos.

examples.en: The band broadcasted a live stream concert for global fans.
examples.zh: 該樂團為全球粉絲舉辦了一場線上直播演唱會。

examples.en: Thousands of viewers joined the live stream to ask real-time questions.
examples.zh: 數千名觀眾湧入線上直播間進行即時提問互動。

examples.en: The chef cooked braised beef noodles during an interactive live stream session.
examples.zh: 主廚在互動式直播節目中親自示範烹煮紅燒牛肉麵。

explains.en: A camera sends a show over the internet as it happens. Viewers can watch from different places.
A singer or cook may broadcast directly to fans online. People can sometimes ask questions while watching.
This online video is sent in real time instead of being watched later. The phrase can name the broadcast or the act of sending it.

examples.en: The funny dancing cat video went viral on TikTok overnight.
examples.zh: 那支搞笑的跳舞貓咪影片在一夜之間在 TikTok 上瘋傳爆紅。

examples.en: The marketing campaign went viral, attracting millions of organic website visits.
examples.zh: 這次的行銷宣傳活動迅速爆紅瘋傳，吸引了數百萬自然網站訪問人次。

examples.en: Doctors treated the child for a mild seasonal viral infection.
examples.zh: 醫生為這位孩童治療了輕微的季節性病毒感染。
