explains.en: This holiday takes place in the fifth month of the lunar calendar. People race long boats and eat rice dumplings.
Families may watch teams paddle decorated boats on a river. The celebration honors an ancient poet.
On this Taiwanese holiday, people often eat sticky rice wrapped in leaves. Some hang fragrant plants by the door.

examples.en: Rowers paddle vigorously in sync during the exciting dragon boat race.
examples.zh: 划手們在刺激的龍舟競賽中整齊劃一地奮力划槳。

examples.en: The front drummer beats a rhythmic tempo to guide the dragon boat crew.
examples.zh: 船頭的鼓手敲擊出節奏明快的鼓聲以統一步調指揮龍舟隊員。

examples.en: A skilled flag-catcher leans forward over the bow to grab the finish line flag on the dragon boat.
examples.zh: 身手矯捷的奪標手從龍舟龍頭前傾探出，在終點線瞬間奪下勝利旗幟。

explains.en: This long racing boat is decorated to look like a mythical creature. A team paddles together while a drummer keeps the beat. Races are held during a traditional festival.
Many rowers sit in one long craft and paddle in rhythm. A person at the front may beat a drum to guide them. The boat's head and tail often resemble an imaginary animal.
This narrow boat carries a crew who paddle at the same time. It is used in races, especially at a summer festival. A drummer helps keep everyone moving together.

examples.en: We wrap savory sticky rice, salted egg yolk, and mushrooms into rice dumplings.
examples.zh: 我們將香濃糯米、鹹蛋黃與香菇包入美味粽子裡。

examples.en: Northern and southern Taiwanese rice dumplings differ in their cooking and steaming techniques.
examples.zh: 台灣北部粽與南部粽在烹煮手法與水煮清蒸技法上各有千秋特色。

examples.en: Fragrant bamboo leaves impart a distinctive earthy aroma to every boiled rice dumpling.
examples.zh: 清香天然的竹葉為每一顆水煮粽子增添了獨特的自然香氣。

explains.en: It is a traditional food made by wrapping sticky rice and fillings in leaves. People often eat it during a summer holiday. Common fillings include egg yolk and mushrooms.
The ingredients are packed inside bamboo leaves and boiled or steamed. Northern and southern Taiwanese styles may differ. Unwrap the leaves before eating.
Families may prepare this savory bundle for a seasonal celebration. Sticky rice surrounds meat or other fillings. The leaf gives it a gentle aroma.

examples.en: On Moon Festival, people enjoy outdoor barbecues and gaze at the full moon.
examples.zh: 中秋節時，大家喜歡在戶外烤肉並賞圓月。

examples.en: Moon Festival is also known as Mid-Autumn Festival across Asian communities.
examples.zh: 中秋節在華人社會中又被普遍稱為「仲秋節」或「八月半」。

examples.en: Sharing boxes of gift mooncakes with business associates is customary before Moon Festival.
examples.zh: 中秋佳節前夕，贈送精美月餅禮盒予商業夥伴是十分常見的社交禮數。

explains.en: Families gather under the full moon in autumn and share round pastries. Children may carry lanterns outside.
This Taiwanese holiday falls on the fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month. People often barbecue and eat pomelo.
People look at the bright autumn moon and enjoy special filled cakes. It is a time for family gatherings.

examples.en: Sweet red bean paste and salted egg yolks are classic mooncake fillings.
examples.zh: 甜紅豆沙與鹹蛋黃是經典的廣式月餅內餡。

examples.en: Modern bakeries craft innovative snowy mooncakes stuffed with fruit ice cream.
examples.zh: 現代新穎烘焙坊研發出填入香濃水果冰淇淋的創新冰皮月餅。

examples.en: Slice the rich mooncake into small wedges to savor with a pot of hot oolong tea.
examples.zh: 將濃郁紮實的月餅切成小塊，搭配一壺現泡熱烏龍茶細細品嚐最對味。

explains.en: Families share this round pastry during the Mid-Autumn Festival. It may contain bean paste or salted egg yolk.
A bakery may make this rich treat with a sweet filling. Cut it into small pieces to enjoy with tea.
People often give this traditional pastry as a festival gift. New kinds may have icy fruit or cream inside.

examples.en: Madou pomelos are sweet, juicy, and popular during autumn.
examples.zh: 麻豆文旦柚酸甜多汁，在中秋時節極受歡迎。

examples.en: Playful children carve the thick green pomelo peel into funny helmets.
examples.zh: 調皮可愛的孩子們常把厚實翠綠的柚子皮剝切雕琢成趣味柚子帽。

examples.en: Fresh pomelo fruit segments provide a rich boost of dietary fiber and vitamin C.
examples.zh: 鮮甜多汁的柚子果肉富含豐富的膳食纖維與天然維他命 C。

examples.en: Sweet, juicy old-vine Wentan pomelos from Madou are the iconic Mid-Autumn festival treat.
examples.zh: 台南麻豆樹齡數十載的老欉文旦柚果肉細緻如玉、甘甜多汁，是中秋佳節最受歡迎的應景佳品。

examples.en: Children love peeling thick pomelo rinds and wearing the hollow green peels as playful hats.
examples.zh: 台灣小朋友最喜歡在中秋夜將厚厚綠色文旦柚子皮完整剝下，當作搞怪可愛的小帽子戴在頭上。

examples.en: Allow freshly picked pomelos to sit in a dry room for a week to let the rind soften and sugars concentrate.
examples.zh: 剛採收的文旦宜放在陰涼通風處常溫「辭水」（消水）一週，待果皮微皺變軟後果肉甜度達到巔峰。

entries.definition: 柚子；文旦；文旦柚；中秋文旦

explains.en: This large citrus fruit has a thick peel and juicy segments inside. It is often eaten in autumn. The peel can be made into a playful hat.
People may allow this fruit to rest after picking so its skin softens. It tastes sweet and refreshing. Its sections are full of juice and fiber.
This fruit is related to grapefruit but is usually larger. Its rind is thick and easy to peel. Families often enjoy it during the autumn festival season.

examples.en: The bright full moon symbolizes family unity and completeness.
examples.zh: 明亮的滿月象徵著家庭團圓與圓滿。

examples.en: Telescopes set up on the mountain ridge gave stargazers crisp views of the full moon craters.
examples.zh: 架設在山脊高處的望遠鏡讓觀星者清晰飽覽滿月表面的環形隕石坑。

examples.en: High ocean tides are strongest during periods of the full moon and new moon.
examples.zh: 海洋大潮在滿月與新月期間的潮位漲落最為顯著強勁。

explains.en: It is the lunar phase when the whole face of the Moon looks bright and round. It rises opposite the Sun. Some people connect it with high tides.
At this point in its monthly cycle, the Moon appears as a complete circle in the night sky. Families may enjoy looking at it together. It can shine very brightly.
The Moon's visible face is fully lit during this phase. It occurs about once each lunar month. The round shape is easy to recognize.

examples.en: Ghost Festival involves offering bountiful food feasts to wandering spirits.
examples.zh: 中元普渡包含準備豐盛的食物供品以祭祀孤魂好兄弟。

examples.en: During the seventh lunar month, many follow customs related to the Ghost Festival.
examples.zh: 在農曆七月期間，許多人都會遵循中元節相關的各項傳統禁忌習俗。

examples.en: Companies set up long banquet tables outside their lobbies for the annual Ghost Festival puja.
examples.zh: 各大公司行號會在辦公大樓大廳外擺設長條普渡祭拜供桌以祈求營運順遂。

explains.en: On a night in the seventh lunar month, some families prepare food and incense for wandering spirits. The custom is practiced in Taiwan.
Temples may hold ceremonies to honor unseen beings during this traditional summer observance. People often set out offerings.
A Taiwanese custom during the seventh lunar month includes food offerings and prayers for spirits. Some businesses hold ceremonies too.

examples.en: Many people try traditional bird divination fortune-telling near Longshan Temple.
examples.zh: 許多人在龍山寺地下街嘗試傳統的鳥卦算命占卜。

examples.en: Purple Star Astrology (Zi Wei Dou Shu) is a popular form of Chinese fortune-telling.
examples.zh: 紫微斗數在華人命理學中是一門廣受歡迎且體系嚴謹的算命占卜術。

examples.en: Some consider fortune-telling mere folklore, while others seek it for guidance.
examples.zh: 有些人將算命占卜純粹視為民俗娛樂，有些人則藉此尋求人生抉擇指引。

explains.en: Some people use cards, stars, or other signs to guess what may happen in the future. Others see it as a tradition.
A person may visit a temple area to hear predictions about life. Different cultures have different ways of doing this.
This practice tries to say what lies ahead. People may seek guidance, though its claims are not proven facts.

examples.en: The fortune teller interpreted the hexagram symbols in the I Ching.
examples.zh: 算命師依據《易經》卦象符號為客人解讀命理。

examples.en: A skilled fortune teller analyzed her birth date and time according to the lunar calendar.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的命理大師依據農曆排盤，細心剖析她的生辰八字與流年大運。

examples.en: Queues formed outside the famous fortune teller's modest booth in the underground market.
examples.zh: 地下街那位名聲響亮的算命大師簡樸攤位前排起了長長的問事隊伍。

explains.en: This person claims to tell what may happen in someone's future. They might use cards, symbols, or a birth date. People may visit one to ask questions.
A person may read a set of signs or numbers and offer ideas about someone's future. Some people seek advice from this worker. The predictions cannot be known for certain.
This is someone who says they can predict future events. They may use a calendar, cards, or other traditional methods. Their visitors often ask about work or relationships.

examples.en: Gifting clocks or sharp scissors is a traditional cultural taboo.
examples.zh: 送鐘錶或鋒利剪刀在傳統送禮文化中是一大禁忌。

examples.en: Discussing financial debts openly at the dining table is considered taboo in his household.
examples.zh: 在他家中，在餐桌上公開談論個人債務與金錢困境被視為一大禁忌。

examples.en: Wearing all-black apparel to a joyous wedding celebration is an absolute social taboo.
examples.zh: 參加喜氣洋洋的熱鬧婚宴若穿著一身全黑衣著，是極不恰當的社交大忌。

examples.en: Gifting clocks or sharp scissors is a traditional cultural taboo in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣民間傳統送禮習俗中，贈送時鐘或鋒利剪刀皆屬於常見的文化禁忌。

examples.en: Mental health issues were once considered taboo topics in many conservative societies.
examples.zh: 心理健康問題在過去許多保守社會中曾被視為不能公開談論的禁忌話題。

examples.en: Discussing politics at the dinner table was strictly taboo in their household.
examples.zh: 在他們的家庭裡，餐桌上談論政治是絕對被禁止的禁忌。

entries.definition: 禁忌；忌諱的；忌諱；禁忌的

explains.en: It is a subject or action that a culture considers forbidden or improper. Some families avoid discussing money at meals. Customs differ from place to place.
A social rule may make certain behavior unacceptable. For example, giving a sharp tool as a gift can be avoided in some traditions. People may feel strongly about it.
This noun describes a custom that people are expected not to break. It may concern food, clothing, or conversation. The adjective form describes something considered forbidden.

examples.en: The Earth God (Tudigong) is a widely venerated local neighborhood deity.
examples.zh: 土地公是深受各地社區街坊鄰里愛戴信奉的在地神祇。

examples.en: Wenchang Dijun is honored as the patron deity of scholarship and national exams.
examples.zh: 文昌帝君被莘莘學子尊奉為庇佑考運亨通與升學金榜題名的守護神祇。

examples.en: Ancient mountain shrines are erected to pay respect to the spiritual forest deity.
examples.zh: 古樸清幽的深山小祠堂旨在表達對守護山林自然山神靈性威嚴的崇敬。

explains.en: In a religion or story, this is a being that people worship or believe has special powers. Some cultures honor a land guardian.
People may pray to this sacred being for help or protection. A temple can be built in its honor.
A spiritual figure may be believed to watch over a place or help people. Different traditions have many such beings.

examples.en: Puppet theater (Budaixi) is an invaluable piece of Taiwanese intangible cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 布袋戲是台灣無比珍貴且具代表性的無形文化遺產。

examples.en: Preserving historic fortresses and red-brick streets protects our rich cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 妥善修復與保存歷史古堡與老街紅磚建築，是在守護我們豐富的文化資產。

examples.en: UNESCO designates extraordinary global monuments as protected world cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 聯合國教科文組織將世界上超凡卓絕的歷史古蹟評定列入受保護的世界文化遺產。

explains.en: Old buildings, stories, and customs passed down through generations form this shared history. Communities work to protect it.
A puppet show or historic street can be an important part of a people's past. Preserving such things keeps traditions alive.
This includes places and practices that a community values from earlier times. Some landmarks receive special protection.

examples.en: The mayor held a press conference to introduce new transport policies.
examples.zh: 市長召開記者會說明全新的大眾交通政策。

examples.en: Reporters crowded into the hotel ballroom for the director's press conference.
examples.zh: 各家記者蜂擁湧入飯店宴會廳，出席導演的新聞發布會。

examples.en: The tech executive answered critical questions calmly during the live press conference.
examples.zh: 科技公司高層主管在現場直播記者會上沉著冷靜地回答尖銳提問。

examples.en: Journalists from fifty media outlets gathered for the product press conference.
examples.zh: 來自五十家各大主流媒體的記者齊聚出席新品發布記者會。

examples.en: The health ministry held an emergency press conference to brief the public on the epidemic.
examples.zh: 衛福部門召開緊急電視新聞記者會，向廣大社會大眾詳盡說明最新疫情動態與防疫措施。

examples.en: The company president apologized publicly for the product recall during the televised press conference.
examples.zh: 企業總經理在電視現場直播的記者會上，親自向全體消費者就瑕疵產品召回事件鞠躬致歉。

examples.en: The health ministry held an emergency press conference regarding epidemic control.
examples.zh: 衛福部緊急召開全台電視直播新聞發布會，向國人說明最新防疫配套措施。

examples.en: Reporters shouted questions simultaneously during the tense post-game press conference.
examples.zh: 賽後氣氛緊繃的新聞發布會上，記者們紛紛爭相大聲提問。

examples.en: The tech CEO announced the brand-new flagship product at a global press conference.
examples.zh: 該科技公司執行長在全球記者會上隆重宣布了這款全新的旗艦產品。

explains.en: This is a public meeting where a person or group answers questions from reporters. A mayor may announce a new plan there. It can be shown live on television.
Journalists gather to hear important news and ask questions. A company leader may introduce a new product. The meeting helps explain information to the public.
A government office or business may hold this event to share news. Reporters ask questions in front of cameras. People can learn about decisions or announcements.

examples.en: The central city museum is open to the general public for free.
examples.zh: 市立美術館免費開放供一般社會大眾參觀。

examples.en: Health experts urged the public to stay hydrated during extreme heatwaves.
examples.zh: 衛生專家呼籲社會大眾在極端熱浪來襲期間務必隨時補充足夠水分。

examples.en: Opinion polls reveal what the general public thinks about educational reform.
examples.zh: 民意調查客觀呈現了一般社會大眾對於教育改革的真實看法。

explains.en: It means ordinary people in a community or society. A museum may open its doors to everyone. Experts often share health advice with them.
These words refer to people in general rather than one private group. A poll may ask what they think about schools. City services are meant for them.
The phrase names the members of society as a whole. Officials may share important news with everyone. It can also mean the people who use a service.

examples.en: Riding a scooter on pedestrian sidewalks is strictly illegal.
examples.zh: 在人行道上騎乘機車是嚴格禁止的違法行為。

examples.en: Downloading copyrighted movies without authorization is completely illegal.
examples.zh: 未經正式版權授權而任意非法下載受著作權保護的電影是違法的。

examples.en: Customs officers confiscated thousands of imported cartons of illegal smuggled cigarettes.
examples.zh: 海關關務人員依法查扣了數千箱企圖非法走私入境的未稅菸品。

explains.en: A person breaks a law by parking in a place where it is forbidden. The police may give a ticket.
Taking something that belongs to another person is against the law. It can lead to a penalty.
Rules say what people may and may not do. An action that goes against those rules can bring legal trouble.

examples.en: Taiwan produces the vast majority of advanced semiconductors.
examples.zh: 台灣生產了全球絕大多數的先進半導體晶片。

examples.en: Modern smartphones, electric cars, and AI servers rely on semiconductor chips.
examples.zh: 現代智慧型手機、電動車以及 AI 伺服器無一不仰賴先進半導體晶片。

examples.en: Hsinchu Science Park is globally revered as the heart of semiconductor innovation.
examples.zh: 新竹科學園區被國際公認為全球半導體創新研發與製造的心臟地帶。

examples.en: Taiwan’s world-leading semiconductor foundries manufacture the advanced 3nm chips powering global AI servers.
examples.zh: 台灣享譽全球的半導體晶圓製造生態系（如台積電），為全世界各大 AI 超級伺服器代工最先進的三奈米晶片。

examples.en: Silicon remains the foundation of modern electronics, although wide-bandgap semiconductors like SiC are growing rapidly.
examples.zh: 矽晶圓始終是當代半導體微電子的核心基石，然而碳化矽（SiC）等第三代寬能隙半導體材料正強勢崛起。

examples.en: A global semiconductor shortage in 2021 forced automotive assembly plants worldwide to pause vehicle assembly lines.
examples.zh: 二零二一年爆發的全球車用半導體晶片大缺荒，一度迫使歐美各大汽車製造廠全面暫停新車生產線運轉。

examples.en: Taiwan’s semiconductor manufacturing prowess powers everything from smartphones to satellite supercomputers.
examples.zh: 台灣獨步全球的半導體晶片製造實力，為智慧型手機至衛星超級電腦等尖端科技提供核心動能。

examples.en: Silicon remains the most widely utilized semiconductor material in modern electronics.
examples.zh: 矽依舊是當代微電子工業中最被廣泛採用的核心半導體基底材料。

examples.en: Government incentives encourage overseas tech giants to establish semiconductor research centers in Tainan.
examples.zh: 經濟部推出多項租稅與研發補助政策，大力吸引國際科技大廠在台南設立前瞻半導體研發中心。

entries.definition: 半導體；晶片製造；台灣半導體護國神山產業；台灣半導體晶片產業；半導體的

explains.en: This material lets electricity flow in a controlled way. Tiny parts made from it are inside phones and computers.
Factories use silicon to make small electronic components. Taiwan is known for producing many of these parts.
A chip inside a car or computer depends on this special electronic material. It is neither a simple conductor nor a full insulator.

examples.en: Advanced precision manufacturing sets Taiwan apart globally.
examples.zh: 先進精密製造業讓台灣在國際舞台上脫穎而出。

examples.en: Smart robotics and artificial intelligence are transforming traditional manufacturing.
examples.zh: 智慧機器人與人工智慧正深刻重塑並顛覆傳統製造業的運作模式。

examples.en: Taiwan's bicycle manufacturing expertise supplies premier racing bikes globally.
examples.zh: 台灣精湛深厚的自行車製造實力為全球供應頂級專業公路競速賽車。

explains.en: This is the process of making goods in factories, often with machines. A company may produce bicycles or phones this way. Robots are changing how some goods are made.
Workers and machines turn materials into products for people to use. This activity can happen on a large scale. It is important in many industries.
A factory may make items by shaping, joining, or assembling materials. This process supplies stores with goods. New technology can make it faster.

examples.en: Good customer service builds lasting loyalty among shoppers.
examples.zh: 優質貼心的客戶服務能建立顧客長久的忠誠度。

examples.en: You can call the 24-hour customer service hotline for instant card cancellation.
examples.zh: 您可以撥打二十四小時免付費客服專線，即刻辦理信用卡緊急掛失手續。

examples.en: The responsive customer service team resolved my billing issue in five minutes.
examples.zh: 服務親切迅速的客服團隊在短短五分鐘內就妥善解決了我的帳單爭議。

explains.en: It is the help a company gives to people who buy its products. Staff can answer questions or solve a billing problem. A phone line may be open all day.
When a shopper needs help with a card or order, they can contact this team. Good support can build trust. Workers may respond by phone or online chat.
A business provides this assistance before or after a sale. Workers may explain a product or fix a problem. Helpful treatment can encourage people to return.

examples.en: International tech investors showed great interest in local AI startups.
examples.zh: 國際科技投資人對本土的 AI 新創團隊表現出高度興趣。

examples.en: Prudent investors diversify their portfolios across bonds, equities, and gold.
examples.zh: 審慎穩健的投資人會將資產組合多元分散於債券、股票與黃金等多種標的。

examples.en: The CEO presented the quarterly roadmap clearly to reassure nervous institutional investors.
examples.zh: 執行長在法說會上條理分明地說明季度發展藍圖，以安撫緊張的機構法人投資人。

explains.en: A person gives money to a business hoping it will grow and return a profit. They may study the risks first.
Someone may buy shares in a company to support its plans and possibly earn money later. This person watches how the company performs.
People who put money into a business or project expect it to succeed. They can lose money if it does not.

examples.en: The Taiwan Stock Market (Taiex) reached a new historic milestone.
examples.zh: 台灣股市加權指數（台股）創下了全新的歷史里程碑。

examples.en: Global stock markets experienced fluctuations following the interest rate hike.
examples.zh: 在各國央行宣布升息政策後，全球主要股票市場均出現了震盪波動。

examples.en: Beginners should learn financial valuation basics before entering the stock market.
examples.zh: 投資新手在正式投身股票市場之前，應當先扎實研讀財務估值基本面知識。

explains.en: People buy and sell small shares of companies in this financial place. Prices can rise or fall each day.
A company may offer pieces of ownership to investors. News and business changes can affect their value.
This system lets buyers and sellers trade company shares. Beginners should learn about money and risk first.

examples.en: Creative marketing campaigns help brands gain viral popularity.
examples.zh: 富有創意的行銷活動能幫助品牌獲得病毒式的知名度。

examples.en: Digital marketing strategies rely heavily on search engine optimization (SEO).
examples.zh: 數位行銷推廣策略極度仰賴精準的搜尋引擎最佳化（SEO）技術布局。

examples.en: He accepted an internship in the global marketing department of an athletic brand.
examples.zh: 他順利獲選進入一家知名國際運動品牌的全球市場行銷部擔任實習生。

explains.en: This is the work of telling people about a product and helping a company sell it. It may include ads, websites, and special offers. A creative campaign can attract many customers.
A business studies what customers want and shares messages about its goods. Online posts are one tool. The goal is to help people notice and choose a product.
This business activity helps connect products with buyers. Workers may plan advertisements or events. It can take place online or in a shop.

examples.en: Read the contract terms carefully before clicking 'I Agree'.
examples.zh: 點擊「我同意」之前，請務必仔細閱讀合約條款。

examples.en: The two sides agreed to mutually acceptable payment and delivery terms.
examples.zh: 商業雙方就彼此均能完全接受的付款條件與交貨期限條款達成共識。

examples.en: He explained quantum physics in simple, accessible terms that children could grasp.
examples.zh: 他用深入淺出、孩童也能輕鬆聽懂的平實用詞講解深奧的量子物理。

explains.en: These are rules and conditions in an agreement. Read them carefully before accepting a contract. They may explain payment and delivery.
The expression can also mean the words used to explain an idea. A teacher may describe science in simple language. In a contract, it refers to the conditions people agree to.
When two sides make a deal, the details they accept are written here. Payment dates and responsibilities may be included. The same noun can mean vocabulary or expressions.

examples.en: The overseas container shipment arrived safely at Keelung Harbor.
examples.zh: 海外貨櫃輪出貨已平安抵達基隆港。

examples.en: You will receive an SMS tracking notification as soon as your shipment leaves the depot.
examples.zh: 您的商品貨物一旦自物流集散中心出貨出庫，您將立刻收到簡訊追蹤通知。

examples.en: Heavy storm swells delayed the cargo vessel carrying the vital medical shipment.
examples.zh: 兇猛的海上暴風狂瀾延誤了載運重要醫療緊急物資船班的出貨抵達時間。

explains.en: A group of boxes or goods travels by ship, truck, or plane to a store. A tracking message may show where it is.
When a shop orders products, the whole load arrives together. Bad weather can delay it.
A company sends a batch of goods to a customer or warehouse. This delivery may cross an ocean.

examples.en: E-commerce platforms and convenience stores are major retailers.
examples.zh: 電商平台與超商是台灣主要的重要零售通路商。

examples.en: Major fashion retailers launched seasonal clearance discounts ahead of autumn.
examples.zh: 各大知名連鎖流行服飾零售業者在秋季來臨前紛紛祭出換季出清特惠。

examples.en: Independent book retailers host intimate author readings to build local community.
examples.zh: 獨立特色書店零售商定期舉辦溫馨的作者新書朗讀會，緊密連結在地社區。

explains.en: This business sells goods directly to people who will use them. A bookstore is one kind.
A clothing shop buys products and sells them to customers. Online stores can do the same job.
Convenience stores and fashion shops are examples of businesses that serve shoppers. They sell items one at a time.

examples.en: The fruit wholesaler supplies fresh seasonal produce to restaurants.
examples.zh: 水果批發商為各大餐廳供應新鮮時令蔬果。

examples.en: Small flower shops place pre-dawn orders with the central flower market wholesaler.
examples.zh: 街角小花店清晨天未破曉便前往批發市場大盤商處搶先下單訂購鮮花。

examples.en: Wholesalers negotiate bulk discounts directly from large manufacturing factories.
examples.zh: 批發大盤商直接向大型生產製造工廠洽商取得最具競爭力的大宗進貨折扣。

explains.en: This business or person sells large amounts of goods to shops rather than directly to most shoppers. A fruit market may supply restaurants. Buying in bulk can lower the price per item.
A small flower shop may order many stems from this seller. Factories and makers provide goods in large groups. Stores then sell them one by one to customers.
This seller buys products in large quantities and supplies other businesses. A restaurant may get its produce this way. Shops often buy stock from one.

examples.en: The exclusive distributor imports official anime merchandise from Tokyo.
examples.zh: 獨家總經銷商從東京原裝進口官方正版動漫周邊。

examples.en: The beverage company relies on regional distributors to supply mountain convenience stores.
examples.zh: 這家知名飲料大廠仰賴各地區分銷經銷商，將飲品準時配送至偏遠山區超商。

examples.en: Film distributors decide which international theater screens will show the blockbuster.
examples.zh: 電影全球發行商全權負責規劃評估該年度大片將在哪些國際院線大銀幕上映。

explains.en: It is a company or person that supplies products to shops. A regional business may deliver drinks to small stores. Film companies also send movies to theaters.
After a factory makes goods, this business moves them to sellers. It may import merchandise from another country. Stores rely on it to keep shelves stocked.
This agent helps get products from makers to customers through shops. It can handle delivery and sales in a region. In film, it arranges where a movie is shown.

examples.en: Strict quality control ensures zero defects before products ship out.
examples.zh: 嚴格的品管把關確保產品出貨前達到零缺陷標準。

examples.en: Inspectors in the quality control department test food samples for bacterial safety.
examples.zh: 品質管制稽核部門檢驗員每日隨機抽檢食品樣本，嚴格把關生菌數安全。

examples.en: Every bicycle frame undergoes stress testing to meet international quality control standards.
examples.zh: 每一具出廠自行車車架均歷經嚴酷的疲勞應力測試，符合國際品管標準。

explains.en: Workers check products carefully to make sure they meet safety and quality rules. A factory may test samples before shipping.
A food company tests its goods for bacteria and correct packaging. This process helps prevent defects.
Inspectors look for problems in materials and finished products. Their checks help ensure customers receive reliable goods.

examples.en: The braised pork rice eatery holds a 4.8-star Google rating.
examples.zh: 這家滷肉飯小吃名店在 Google 地圖上擁有 4.8 顆星高分好評。

examples.en: Drivers with high customer service ratings receive bonus incentives on ride-hailing apps.
examples.zh: 在叫車平台 App 上維持超高顧客服務評分的優質司機能獲得額外獎勵金。

examples.en: The live sports championship finale shattered all television viewership ratings.
examples.zh: 萬眾矚目的體育總決賽實況轉播收視率一舉打破了歷年電視台收視最高紀錄。

explains.en: A score or set of stars shows how good a service or product is. Customers may leave one online.
A television program can receive a number showing how many people watch it. A driver may also get a customer score.
People use this measure to compare restaurants, apps, or performances. A higher score often means more approval.

examples.en: Listening actively to others shows genuine empathy and care.
examples.zh: 積極傾聽他人能展現出真誠的同理心與關懷。

examples.en: Doctors who demonstrate warm empathy put nervous patients at ease.
examples.zh: 能展現溫暖同理心的醫師能讓焦慮緊張的候診病患心情徹底放鬆。

examples.en: Reading diverse novels cultivates emotional empathy for people from all walks of life.
examples.zh: 廣泛閱讀多元各類小說能培養對不同人生際遇人群深刻的同理共情。

examples.en: Genuine empathy involves putting yourself in another person's shoes.
examples.zh: 真正的同理心在於懂得設身處地、站在對方的立場體會其真實感受。

examples.en: Nurses must demonstrate both clinical competence and deep emotional empathy.
examples.zh: 護理人員必須同時具備臨床專業技能與深厚的情感同理心。

examples.en: Reading literary fiction has been shown to increase interpersonal empathy in readers.
examples.zh: 閱讀文學小說已被證實能增強讀者對他人的人際同理能力。

examples.en: Great acting elicits deep human empathy, bridging different cultures and life experiences.
examples.zh: 登峰造極的精湛演技總能激發觀眾內心深處最真摯的同理共情，跨越文化與生命經歷的藩籬。

examples.en: Practicing active listening and demonstrating empathy are essential skills for healthcare social workers.
examples.zh: 隨時保持耐心傾聽並對患者的病痛展現出深切的同理心，是每一位第一線醫務社工人員的核心專業素養。

examples.en: The tragic story awakened genuine empathy in readers, motivating thousands to donate to the children's fund.
examples.zh: 這篇賺人熱淚的真實報導喚醒了社會大眾強烈的同理共情，激勵數以萬計的愛心民眾慷慨捐助偏鄉兒福基金。

examples.en: Practicing cognitive empathy allows us to understand why people hold beliefs radically different from our own.
examples.zh: 實踐認知「同理心」（Empathy），能讓我們深刻理解他人為何會做出與我們截然不同的價值抉擇與生命詮釋。

examples.en: A great pediatric nurse listens with patience and genuine emotional empathy to anxious young parents.
examples.zh: 一位優秀的小兒科護理師，總能以無比的耐心與真摯的同理心，溫柔傾聽焦慮新手爸媽的擔憂並給予專業指引。

examples.en: Fictional storytelling fosters interpersonal empathy by inviting readers to walk in the shoes of diverse protagonists.
examples.zh: 優秀的小說文學創作能極大地拓展跨越族群的人際同理心，引領讀者設身處地體驗不同背景主角的悲歡離合。

examples.en: Professional caregiving requires boundless empathy, infinite patience, and gentle physical touch.
examples.zh: 專業長照照護服務極度需要源源不絕的同理心、無比的耐心與溫柔輕緩的肢體撫慰。

examples.en: Practicing active listening helps counselors show genuine empathy toward grieving family members.
examples.zh: 熟練運用專注傾聽的技巧，能協助心理諮商師對陷入悲傷中的家屬表達出最真誠的同理心。

examples.en: Developing cultural empathy allows international exchange students to appreciate diverse worldviews without prejudice.
examples.zh: 培養跨文化同理心，能讓國際交換學生毫無成見地由衷欣賞並包容世界各地的多元世界觀。

examples.en: Learning languages builds cross-cultural empathy, helping us understand diverse lived experiences.
examples.zh: 學習外語在心中深植「跨文化同理心」（Empathy），讓我們能放下偏見，深刻理解全球多元文化的生命故事。

examples.en: Listening with genuine empathy builds unbreakable bonds of trust between friends and colleagues.
examples.zh: 帶著真誠的同理心傾聽他人心聲，能在朋友與工作夥伴之間建立起堅不可摧的互信紐帶。

examples.en: Customer support representatives must balance technical problem solving with sincere customer empathy.
examples.zh: 客服專員在為客戶迅速排查技術問題的同時，更必須展現發自內心的同理與關懷。

entries.definition: 同理心；共情能力；換位思考共感力；觀眾與角色的同理共情；共鳴；跨越立場同理共情能力；照服員細膩溫暖同理心；透過外語看見世界多元面貌之跨文化同理心

explains.en: This is the ability to understand how another person may feel. Listening carefully can show it. It helps people respond kindly to someone who is worried or sad.
A doctor can help a nervous patient feel understood by showing this quality. Reading stories may help people imagine another person's experience. It supports caring relationships.
When you try to see a situation from another person's point of view, you show this feeling. It can connect people from different backgrounds. Active listening helps build it.

examples.en: Asking for forgiveness takes humility and courage.
examples.zh: 請求對方的原諒需要謙卑的心與莫大的勇氣。

examples.en: True forgiveness allows both parties to heal and rebuild broken bonds.
examples.zh: 真正的寬恕能讓彼此撫平過往傷痕，重新修復築起原本斷裂的信任連結。

examples.en: She prayed for spiritual peace and forgiveness inside the sacred quiet sanctuary.
examples.zh: 她在靜謐肅穆的聖堂深處虔誠祈禱，祈求心靈的祥和寧靜與神聖赦免。

explains.en: It is the choice to stop feeling angry with someone who caused harm. Asking for it can take courage. It may help people repair a relationship.
After an apology, a person may decide to let go of hurt feelings. This can help both sides heal. It does not mean that the mistake was acceptable.
People may seek peace after they have hurt someone. Accepting an apology can restore trust. This noun names that act of pardoning.

examples.en: Clear wording prevents unnecessary misunderstandings in emails.
examples.zh: 清晰的措辭能避免電子郵件中不必要的誤會。

examples.en: The slight delay was caused by a minor misunderstanding regarding the meeting time.
examples.zh: 這次稍微延宕主要是由於對會議確切舉行時間產生了些許微小的誤解所致。

examples.en: Let's arrange a friendly phone call to clear up any lingering misunderstanding between us.
examples.zh: 咱們不妨通一通親切的電話，開誠布公地徹底化解彼此之間殘留的任何誤會。

explains.en: Two people understand a message in different ways, causing confusion. A friendly talk can help clear it up.
A note about a meeting time may be read incorrectly. The mistake can lead to missed plans.
When someone thinks a joke was serious, feelings may be hurt. Explaining what was meant can solve the problem.

examples.en: The pilot remained calm and composed during the emergency landing.
examples.zh: 機長在緊急迫降過程中始終保持冷靜與沉著鎮定。

examples.en: Under aggressive cross-examination, the witness stayed perfectly composed.
examples.zh: 在對方律師步步進逼的咄咄逼人嚴詞質問下，證人依舊應對沉著、泰然自若。

examples.en: Taking three deep, measured breaths helps you feel composed before a public speech.
examples.zh: 在即將登台公開演講前深呼吸三次放緩心跳，能迅速幫助你恢復沉著的心境。

entries.definition: 沉著的；鎮定的；泰然自若的

explains.en: A person who stays calm during trouble has this quality. Slow breathing can help before a speech.
A witness may speak steadily even when asked difficult questions. This describes someone who is not upset.
This word can describe a peaceful, self-controlled manner. The pilot kept that manner during a difficult landing.

examples.en: I will definitely join the weekend hiking trip to Yangmingshan!
examples.zh: 我這個週末一定會參加去陽明山的健行活動！

examples.en: If you visit Tainan, you should definitely try the famous beef soup for breakfast.
examples.zh: 如果你造訪古都台南，清晨早餐絕對必須品嚐遠近馳名的現沖溫體牛肉湯。

examples.en: She was definitely the most hardworking student in the entire chemistry class.
examples.zh: 毫無疑問地，她是整間化學課堂上公認平日讀書態度最認真刻苦的好學生。

explains.en: This adverb means that something is certain or clear. A person may use it to give a confident answer. It can make a suggestion sound strong.
If you are sure you will join a trip, you can answer with this word. It shows no doubt. It can also emphasize that something is true.
Use this word to say that an event will surely happen. It may also stress your opinion about something. The speaker feels confident.

examples.en: Could you possibly help me carry this heavy parcel upstairs?
examples.zh: 您能否可能幫我把這個沉重的包裹搬上樓？

examples.en: We cannot possibly finish this lengthy coding assignment before midnight tonight.
examples.zh: 我們無論如何都絕不可能在今晚午夜十二點鐘響前寫完這份龐大的程式作業。

examples.en: Could this ancient pottery shard possibly be from the prehistoric Neolithic era?
examples.zh: 這片在田野間偶然出土的古老陶器碎片，有沒有可能出自新石器時代史前遺跡？

explains.en: This adverb means that something may happen but is not certain. A person might ask if you can help carry a parcel. It can make a request sound polite.
Use it when a result is imaginable but unknown. A speaker may wonder whether an old object came from a past civilization. It can also soften a question.
A plan may work, though no one can be sure. This word expresses that uncertainty. In a request, it can sound courteous.

examples.en: You are absolutely right about the importance of daily practice.
examples.zh: 關於每日練習的重要性，你說得完全正確。

examples.en: The panoramic ocean view from the seaside cliff was absolutely breathtaking.
examples.zh: 從陡峭的濱海懸崖極目遠眺遼闊無垠的大洋，景致絕對令人屏息讚嘆。

examples.en: Do you agree that we need more bicycle paths? — Absolutely, without a doubt!
examples.zh: 你贊同我們市區應當增設更多自行車專用道嗎？— 絕對完全贊成，毫無疑問！

explains.en: Use this word to strongly say “yes” or show that something is completely true. It can answer a question with enthusiasm.
The view from the cliff was completely amazing. This word emphasizes how strongly you feel.
If a friend asks whether you agree, you can answer with a confident yes. It can also mean entirely.

examples.en: May I ask a question? — Certainly! Go right ahead.
examples.zh: 我可以問個問題嗎？— 當然可以！請便。

examples.en: Practicing daily listening will certainly improve your spoken English fluency over time.
examples.zh: 只要天天堅持練聽力，假以時日必定能大幅提升你的英語口語流利表達水準。

examples.en: I will certainly visit my grandparents during the upcoming long holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 在即將到來的連續假期長假期間，我必定會專程南下探望敬愛的阿公阿嬤。

explains.en: Use this word to say yes in a confident way. It can mean that something will happen for sure.
A person may answer this way when agreeing to help. Daily practice will surely improve a skill.
It can show that the speaker is very sure. For example, you may promise that you will visit a relative.

examples.en: I thought it was difficult, but it is actually quite straightforward.
examples.zh: 我原本以為很難，但實際上相當簡單明瞭。

examples.en: Did you know that tomatoes are actually fruits rather than vegetables botanically?
examples.zh: 你知道從植物學嚴謹分類上來看，番茄實際上屬於水果而非蔬菜嗎？

examples.en: She didn't fail the driving exam; she actually passed with a near-perfect score!
examples.zh: 她路考根本沒有被扣分不及格，事實上她居然以近乎滿分的超高成績順利通過！

explains.en: This word introduces what is really true, especially if it is different from what someone expected. A task may seem hard but turn out to be easy. It can correct a mistaken idea.
Use this adverb to show the real facts or to gently correct someone. A fruit that looks like a vegetable may belong to a different group. It adds a surprising detail.
A speaker may use this word before sharing what truly happened. It can show that an expectation was wrong. For example, someone thought a student failed, but the result was different.

examples.en: Winters in southern Taiwan are generally mild and dry.
examples.zh: 南台灣的冬季通常溫和且乾燥。

examples.en: Generally speaking, older generations prefer traditional tea to modern iced coffee.
examples.zh: 一般而言，長輩族群普遍偏好沖泡傳統溫熱茶葉，更甚於現代冰咖啡。

examples.en: Public transit across Taipei is generally recognized as exceptionally safe and clean.
examples.zh: 台北地區的大眾捷運運輸系統普遍被公認為具備極佳的整潔度與絕佳的治安。

explains.en: This adverb means usually or in most cases. Winters in the south may be mild. It can also introduce a broad statement.
Use it when describing what is true for most people or situations. A speaker may say that older adults prefer traditional tea. It does not mean every single person does.
The word can summarize a common pattern without claiming it is always true. Public transit in a city may be considered safe. It can also mean broadly speaking.

examples.en: Trains run frequently between Taipei and Banqiao stations.
examples.zh: 台北車站與板橋站之間的列車班次非常密集頻繁。

examples.en: Tourists frequently visit the historical temple to take photos and sample snacks.
examples.zh: 來自世界各地的觀光旅客經常頻繁造訪這座歷史宮廟，拍照打卡並品嚐在地小吃。

examples.en: Software developers frequently back up their code repositories to cloud storage.
examples.zh: 軟體工程師平日工作時會極為頻繁地將手頭的程式碼備份儲存至雲端代碼庫。

explains.en: A train may arrive many times each hour during busy periods. The service runs again and again.
She visits the library often, sometimes several times each week. The word describes repeated events.
Buses come at short intervals in the city center. A person may see them again and again throughout the day.

examples.en: It rarely snows in low-altitude areas of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台灣低海拔平地地區極為罕見下雪。

examples.en: He rarely eats fast food because he prioritizes fresh, home-cooked vegetables.
examples.zh: 他平時極少吃油炸速食，因為他總是堅持三餐必須攝取現煮新鮮蔬果。

examples.en: Endangered leopard cats are rarely spotted by daytime hikers in mountain woods.
examples.zh: 白天健行的登山客極其罕見能在深山密林中親眼目擊瀕臨絕種的石虎身影。

explains.en: This adverb means something happens only a few times. Snow seldom falls in low places in Taiwan.
A person who almost never eats fast food does it very little. It describes an uncommon event.
You may use this word when something is not often seen. A shy animal may appear only on a few occasions.

examples.en: After hours of patient climbing, we eventually reached the mountain peak.
examples.zh: 經過數小時的耐力攀爬，我們終於登上了山頂。

examples.en: Keep practicing your English dialogue every day and you will eventually become fluent.
examples.zh: 只要天天堅持開口練習英文日常對話，假以時日你終究必定能夠說得無比流利。

examples.en: Following long and arduous legal trials, justice was eventually served in court.
examples.zh: 歷經漫長且艱難的司法訴訟程序，正義公理最終在法庭上得到了昭雪與伸張。

explains.en: This word means that something happens after a period of time or effort. Climbers may reach a mountain top after many hours. It often tells the final result.
A person who keeps practicing may become fluent later. This adverb looks ahead to what happens in the end. It may follow a long wait.
Use this word when an outcome comes after delays or difficult steps. A legal case may take a long time before a decision. It points to what happened at last.

examples.en: Call the emergency 119 number immediately in case of fire.
examples.zh: 若發生火災請立即撥打 119 緊急報案電話。

examples.en: When you notice a scooter tire puncture, stop immediately in a safe parking area.
examples.zh: 當你察覺機車輪胎不慎被刺破漏氣時，應當立刻將車輛安全滑行停靠在路旁空地。

examples.en: She responded immediately to my text message with helpful directions to the cafe.
examples.zh: 她在收到我的求助簡訊後第一時間秒回訊息，指引我前往那家隱密咖啡館的捷徑。

explains.en: This adverb means without delay. Call emergency services right away if someone is in danger. A driver should stop at once after a tire problem.
When a person replies very soon after receiving a message, they respond with no wait. It can also describe doing something directly. Time is important in an emergency.
Use this word when an action needs to happen now. A patient may need help quickly. It can mean directly as well as promptly.

examples.en: Have you watched any good Taiwanese movies recently?
examples.zh: 你最近有看什麼好看的台灣本土電影嗎？

examples.en: The city government recently opened a new public library featuring outdoor gardens.
examples.zh: 市政府最近隆重啟用了一座嶄新的市立圖書館，內部規劃了優雅的戶外綠色庭園。

examples.en: Prices of fresh vegetables have risen slightly recently due to seasonal typhoons.
examples.zh: 受到接連幾場季節性颱風外圍環流影響，最近市場上的生鮮葉菜價格微幅上漲。

explains.en: A new library opened a short time ago. It is not something that happened long ago.
Prices have gone up in the past few days. This word refers to the near past.
Ask a friend whether they watched any good films lately. The word means within the recent past.

examples.en: In addition to free Wi-Fi, the hostel offers free morning breakfast.
examples.zh: 除了免費無線網路之外，這家青年旅館還提供免費早餐。

examples.en: In addition to high salaries, the technology company provides comprehensive health coverage.
examples.zh: 除了具備競爭力的高薪之外，這家知名科技企業還提供涵蓋全家的健全健保福利。

examples.en: She loves playing badminton; in addition, she swims thirty laps every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 她非常熱愛打羽毛球；此外，每逢週日早晨她還會雷打不動地到泳池游三十趟。

explains.en: These words introduce one more thing. The hostel has free internet, and it also serves breakfast.
A person may add another point after the first one. She plays badminton and also swims each week.
Use this phrase to say something extra is included. A company may offer health care as well as good pay.

examples.en: He studied diligently; as a result, he achieved top grades.
examples.zh: 他用功苦讀；因此，他取得了名列前茅的優異成績。

examples.en: The bridge suffered structural damage from the flood; as a result, traffic was rerouted.
examples.zh: 這座大橋在暴雨洪水中遭受了結構性損壞；結果，所有往來車輛被迫改道通行。

examples.en: She ate a balanced diet and slept eight hours; as a result, her energy levels soared.
examples.zh: 她維持均衡天然的清淡飲食並睡滿八小時；結果，整個人的精神活力大幅提升。

explains.en: These words introduce what happens because of an earlier event. A student studies hard, and good grades may follow. The phrase connects a cause with its outcome.
Use this expression to show the effect of something that happened before. A flood may harm a bridge, so cars must take another route. It links two related ideas.
This phrase signals a consequence. Eating well and sleeping enough may lead to more energy. It usually comes before the outcome of an action.

examples.en: Taiwan has many scenic peaks; for instance, Yushan and Hehuanshan.
examples.zh: 台灣有許多壯麗的高山；例如，玉山與合歡山。

examples.en: Citrus fruits, for instance oranges and grapefruits, are rich sources of vitamin C.
examples.zh: 柑橘類水果，舉例來說像柳橙與葡萄柚，都是富含天然維他命 C 的極佳來源。

examples.en: You can incorporate micro-habits into your routine; for instance, reading ten pages nightly.
examples.zh: 你可以在日常作息中融入微習慣；舉例來說，每晚睡前堅持翻閱閱讀十頁好書。

explains.en: This phrase introduces an example that helps explain an idea. Taiwan has many mountains, such as Yushan. It is similar in meaning to 'for example.'
A speaker can use these words before naming one case among many. Citrus fruit includes oranges and grapefruits. The details make a general point clearer.
When giving a sample, people may say this before listing it. A reader might add a small habit to a routine, like reading each night. It connects an example to an idea.

examples.en: Choose water instead of sugary sodas for better health.
examples.zh: 為了身體健康，請多喝白開水代替含糖汽水。

examples.en: Take the stairs instead of the crowded elevator to get a quick cardio workout.
examples.zh: 選擇走安全梯步級代替搭乘擁擠的電梯，順道為自己安排一次快速的心肺有氧。

examples.en: She decided to cook dinner at home instead of spending money eating out at a diner.
examples.zh: 她決定今晚親自下廚在家做飯，而不是花大錢到外頭的昂貴餐廳外食消費。

explains.en: Choose plain water, not a sweet fizzy drink. These words show that one option is chosen as a replacement for another.
A child walks up the stairs rather than waiting for a crowded lift. The phrase introduces the option chosen.
She eats at home and does not go to a restaurant. The two words connect her choice with the option she did not pick.

examples.en: The outdoor baseball game was postponed due to torrential rain.
examples.zh: 戶外棒球賽因為豪大雨而被迫延期舉行。

examples.en: Due to unforeseen mechanical problems, the train will arrive twenty minutes late.
examples.zh: 由於突發未料的機械機件故障問題，本次列車抵達終點站將會稍微延誤二十分鐘。

examples.en: The shop’s remarkable success was largely due to its warm, attentive customer service.
examples.zh: 這家烘焙小鋪之所以能取得令人矚目的成功，很大程度上得益於其親切周到的客服。

explains.en: This phrase gives the reason something happened. The game was delayed because heavy rain fell.
A train may arrive late because of a machine problem. The cause follows these words.
A shop may succeed because its staff are kind. Use this phrase to connect a result with its reason.

examples.en: Flights were temporarily delayed because of thick sea fog.
examples.zh: 航班因濃密海霧而暫時延誤起飛。

examples.en: The street concert was relocated indoors because of sudden afternoon thunderstorm warnings.
examples.zh: 由於氣象局發布了突發性午後大雷雨特報，街頭音樂會緊急移師至室內大廳舉行。

examples.en: She chose to study computer engineering because of her lifelong passion for video games.
examples.zh: 她之所以毅然決然選擇鑽研電腦資工，完全是起因於從小對電子遊戲的無限熱愛。

explains.en: This phrase gives the reason something happens and comes before a noun or noun phrase. Fog may delay an airplane. It answers the question why.
A concert may move indoors when a storm is expected. These words introduce the cause of that change. They are followed by the reason.
Use this expression to explain why an event or choice happened. A person may choose a subject because they love games. It connects a reason to an outcome.

examples.en: Thanks to your kind assistance, we finished the science project on time.
examples.zh: 多虧了你的熱心協助，我們才能按時完成科展專案。

examples.en: Thanks to modern high-speed rail, traveling between Taipei and Kaohsiung takes ninety minutes.
examples.zh: 幸虧有了現代化的高速鐵路，現在南北往返台北與高雄兩地僅僅只需九十分鐘。

examples.en: Thanks to early medical detection, the patient recovered completely from the illness.
examples.zh: 多虧了醫療儀器的早期篩檢與精準診斷，該名病患才得以從病痛中完全奇蹟康復。

explains.en: Use this phrase to say that someone or something helped make a good result happen. A team may finish a project because everyone worked together. It can also be sarcastic.
These words introduce the reason something positive occurred. Fast trains can make travel quicker. In a sarcastic sentence, the result may be unwanted.
A speaker may credit a person or cause for a helpful outcome. Early medical care may help someone recover. The phrase can also blame a cause ironically.

examples.en: In spite of the cold wind, we enjoyed our coastal stroll.
examples.zh: 儘管寒風刺骨，我們依然很享受海邊漫步的時光。

examples.en: He won the national table tennis tournament in spite of a lingering shoulder strain.
examples.zh: 儘管飽受肩膀拉傷舊疾的隱隱作痛困擾，他依然在全國桌球錦標賽中強勢登頂。

examples.en: In spite of repeated failures during experiments, the scientist refused to abandon her theory.
examples.zh: 儘管在實驗室研發過程中歷經了無數次的挫敗，這位科學家堅決不放棄自己的理論。

explains.en: The wind was cold, but the family still enjoyed their walk. These words show that something happened despite a difficulty.
A player’s shoulder hurt, yet they finished the match. The phrase introduces a fact that might have stopped them.
Rain fell all afternoon, but the children kept playing outside. This expression means that one thing did not prevent another.

examples.en: According to the weather forecast, tomorrow will be sunny and warm.
examples.zh: 根據氣象預報，明天將會是晴朗溫暖的好天氣。

examples.en: Assemble the bookshelf according to the step-by-step illustrations in the manual.
examples.zh: 請嚴格依照組裝說明書上標示的一步一步圖解步驟，組裝這座實木書架。

examples.en: According to recent public surveys, young professionals value work-life balance highly.
examples.zh: 依據最近出爐的各項民意問卷調查，當今年輕在職人士極度看重工作與生活的平衡。

explains.en: These words tell where information came from. The forecast says tomorrow will be sunny.
Follow the steps shown in a manual. The phrase points to a source or rule.
A survey may report what people think. This expression introduces the information being followed or quoted.

examples.en: You can achieve your goals as long as you stay persistent.
examples.zh: 只要持之以恆，你一定能夠實現自己的目標。

examples.en: You may borrow my bicycle as long as you promise to return it before sunset.
examples.zh: 只要你保證在今天傍晚太陽下山前物歸原處，你隨時都可以借騎我的公路自行車。

examples.en: As long as we stand united and support one another, no hardship is insurmountable.
examples.zh: 只要我們彼此團結一心、守望相助，世間便沒有任何無法跨越克服的艱難險阻。

explains.en: This phrase can mean provided that a condition is met. You may borrow a bike if you promise to return it. It can also describe something lasting for a period.
A person can reach a goal if they keep trying. These words introduce the condition that must be true. The same phrase can tell how much time something lasts.
Use this expression to say that one thing is allowed or possible under a condition. A promise may be required. It can also mean for the whole time that something happens.

examples.en: Call me as soon as you arrive safely at the station.
examples.zh: 你一平安抵達車站就馬上打電話給我。

examples.en: As soon as the final school bell rang, cheerful students dashed out onto the playground.
examples.zh: 當放學鐘聲劃破校園的那一瞬間，雀躍開朗的學童們立刻蜂擁奔向操場嬉戲。

examples.en: I will send you the updated PDF report as soon as the team finishes editing it.
examples.zh: 只要我們團隊把最後的文字排版校對完畢，我會第一時間立刻將更新後的 PDF 寄給您。

explains.en: This phrase means that one event happens immediately after another. Call when you arrive at the station. It links two actions in time.
A person may send a report right after the team finishes editing it. The first event follows the second without a long wait. This expression can begin a sentence.
Use these words to show that something happens at the earliest moment after another event. Students may run outside when the final bell rings. It often introduces a time clause.

examples.en: The breakfast set includes scrambled eggs as well as fresh fruit juice.
examples.zh: 這份早餐套餐包含炒蛋以及新鮮現榨果汁。

examples.en: She speaks fluent Japanese as well as conversational Spanish and French.
examples.zh: 她不僅能說一口流利道地的日語，同時還具備西班牙語與法語的日常會話能力。

examples.en: The workshop teaches practical coding techniques as well as effective team collaboration.
examples.zh: 本次研習工作坊不僅傳授實用的編程實作技術，同時亦深刻培養高效團隊協作技巧。

explains.en: A breakfast plate has eggs and fruit juice, and it has both items. This phrase joins two related things.
She speaks Japanese and Spanish. The expression connects the first skill with another one she also has.
A workshop teaches coding and teamwork. These words add another item to the list.

examples.en: Choose whichever dessert you like best from the menu.
examples.zh: 從菜單中挑選你最喜歡的任何一道甜點吧。

examples.en: Take whichever train arrives first; both lines stop directly at Taipei Main Station.
examples.zh: 無論哪一班列車先到站就搭哪一班，因為這兩條捷運路線都會直達台北車站。

examples.en: Pick whichever study method suits your learning style, whether flashcards or audiobooks.
examples.zh: 無論是單字卡還是有聲書，挑選任何最契合你個人學習風格的有效讀書方法即可。

explains.en: Choose any one from the options; your choice is fine. Both trains go to the same station.
Take either the first bus or the second one, depending on which arrives sooner. The best option depends on the timing.
You can select the study method that suits you best. The exact option does not matter.

examples.en: I look forward to visiting Kenting National Park this summer vacation.
examples.zh: 我十分期待今年暑假能去墾丁國家公園遊玩。

examples.en: We look forward to hearing your constructive thoughts during tomorrow's team presentation.
examples.zh: 我們由衷期盼在明天的專案成果簡報中，能聆聽到您寶貴的建設性看法。

examples.en: Children always eagerly look forward to opening lucky red envelopes on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 小朋友們總是在除夕夜圍爐時，無比熱切盼望著親手打開喜氣洋洋的壓歲錢紅包。

explains.en: You feel happy or excited because something will happen in the future. A person may feel this way about a summer trip. It is often followed by a noun or an action ending in -ing.
Students may feel eager about hearing their classmates' ideas tomorrow. This phrase expresses pleasant expectation. It is commonly used in letters and conversations.
Use these words when you are glad that an event is coming soon. Children may feel this about opening holiday gifts. The phrase is followed by the thing you expect.

examples.en: Don't put off until tomorrow what you can accomplish today.
examples.zh: 今日事今日畢，切勿拖延至明日。

examples.en: We had to put off our camping trip until next weekend because of the approaching typhoon.
examples.zh: 由於颱風暴風圈即將逼近，我們不得不將露營計畫順延至下個週末再行成行。

examples.en: Procrastinators often put off writing lengthy research reports until the final evening.
examples.zh: 有拖延習慣的人往往總是把篇幅冗長的研究報告拖延到最後交件前夕才挑燈夜戰。

explains.en: Use this phrase when moving an event to a later time. A storm may cause a family to delay a trip. It can also mean postponing a task.
Someone may decide to do homework tomorrow instead of today. This expression describes delaying an action. Putting work aside for too long can create stress.
A meeting may be moved because people are unavailable. The same words can describe delaying a decision. The event will happen later than planned.

examples.en: Scientists carried out field research on endemic tree frogs.
examples.zh: 科學家對本土特有種樹蛙進行了實地田野調查。

examples.en: The hospital medical staff carried out emergency surgery smoothly and saved the patient.
examples.zh: 醫院全體醫護團隊緊密配合，順暢執行了緊急搶救手術，成功化解病患危機。

examples.en: Soldiers are trained to carry out rescue orders with absolute precision during natural disasters.
examples.zh: 國軍官兵受過扎實嚴格訓練，能在各類天然災害肆虐時極其精準地貫徹搜救命令。

explains.en: A science team performed field research to learn about frogs. This phrase describes doing a planned task.
Hospital staff performed an emergency operation. They followed the necessary steps to finish the work.
Soldiers may follow orders to conduct a rescue mission. The phrase means to put a plan into action.

examples.en: We ran out of printer paper right before the class report.
examples.zh: 就在課堂報告前夕，我們的印表機紙張剛好用完了。

examples.en: Stop at the next highway service station before your car runs out of gasoline.
examples.zh: 在愛車的汽油徹底耗盡見底之前，趕緊在下一個高速公路服務區進站加油吧。

examples.en: The bakery ran out of fresh egg tarts within thirty minutes of opening its doors.
examples.zh: 這家名店烘焙坊早晨開門營業不到三十分鐘，剛出爐的現烤蛋塔就已全數被搶購一空。

explains.en: Use these words when there is no more of something left. We had no printer paper before class.
A car may use all its gasoline before reaching a station. Check the fuel before a long trip.
A bakery can sell every tart before closing. The phrase describes having none remaining.

examples.en: She gets along with all her roommates in the university dormitory.
examples.zh: 她與大學宿舍裡的所有室友都相處得十分融洽。

examples.en: Good active listening skills make it effortless to get along with diverse colleagues.
examples.zh: 擁有良好的傾聽與溝通同理心，能讓你在職場上與形形色色的同仁皆相處極為融洽。

examples.en: The new golden retriever puppy gets along wonderfully with the household cat.
examples.zh: 家中剛領養的黃金獵犬小幼犬，與原本傲嬌的家貓處得非常合拍、形影不離。

explains.en: These words describe having a friendly relationship with someone. Roommates may listen and cooperate. A puppy and a cat can also live happily together.
People who work well with different colleagues do this. Good listening can make the relationship easier. It means they are friendly and do not often argue.
Use this phrase when people have a peaceful relationship. A new pet may become friendly with another animal at home. It describes how well they live or work together.

examples.en: The team came up with a brilliant idea for the science fair.
examples.zh: 團隊為科展想出了一個絕妙的創意點子。

examples.en: Can you come up with a creative solution to reduce warehouse packing waste?
examples.zh: 你能想出一個既環保又有創意的巧思方案，用以減少物流倉庫的包裝耗材浪費嗎？

examples.en: After hours of intense brainstorming, the marketing designers came up with an iconic logo.
examples.zh: 歷經長達數小時的腦力激盪，行銷設計團隊終於發想提出了一款極具代表性的標誌。

explains.en: Use this phrase when thinking of an idea or solution. A team may create a plan for a science fair. It can also mean finding an answer.
After brainstorming, designers may invent a memorable logo. These words describe producing an idea. A student might suggest a way to reduce waste.
Someone can think of a new plan to solve a problem. The phrase is also used when a person finds the money or answer needed. Creativity can help.

examples.en: All team members showed up on time for the morning rehearsal.
examples.zh: 全體隊員均準時抵達參加早晨的排練。

examples.en: We waited for forty minutes at the cafe, but our study partner failed to show up.
examples.zh: 我們在咖啡館裡苦等了整整四十分鐘，然而那位說好要一起讀書的夥伴卻始終未曾露面。

examples.en: Over ten thousand passionate baseball fans showed up at the stadium to cheer on the team.
examples.zh: 超過一萬多名狂熱熱情的棒球迷湧入大巨蛋棒球場，現場為心愛的球隊吶喊助威。

explains.en: All the players arrived at the gym for practice. These words mean to come to a place, often as expected.
We waited at the cafe, but our friend did not arrive. The phrase describes appearing at a place.
Thousands of fans came to the stadium for the game. They were present at the event.

examples.en: Our scooter broke down on the mountain road, so we called for towing.
examples.zh: 我們的機車在山路上拋錨故障，於是打了通電話叫拖吊。

examples.en: The office color photocopier always seems to break down right before important deadlines.
examples.zh: 辦公室那台彩色影印機，總是挑在即將交件的緊要關頭莫名其妙地卡紙故障罷工。

examples.en: Exhausted from months of relentless stress, she finally broke down in tears of relief.
examples.zh: 歷經數個月排山倒海般的緊繃高壓摧殘，她在一切塵埃落定後終於忍不住如釋重負痛哭。

explains.en: A machine may stop working, such as a scooter on the road. It may need a repair.
A person under great stress may begin to cry and feel unable to cope. This phrase can describe that reaction.
A copier that no longer works has this problem. It can also mean becoming very upset after a hard time.

examples.en: The outdoor picnic was called off due to the typhoon warning.
examples.zh: 由於發布了颱風警報，戶外野餐活動宣告取消。

examples.en: The umpire decided to call off the baseball game when lightning illuminated the outfield.
examples.zh: 當刺目的閃電照亮外野夜空時，主審裁判果斷裁定立刻取消中止本場棒球賽事。

examples.en: Due to widespread transit strikes abroad, the music band had to call off three European tour dates.
examples.zh: 由於海外多國爆發大規模公共交通罷工潮，該樂團不得不痛心取消三場歐洲巡迴演唱。

explains.en: You do this when you decide that a planned event will not happen. A picnic may be stopped because of a storm warning. The event is canceled.
An official may decide not to let a game continue because lightning is nearby. A band may also cancel several performances. The phrase means to stop a plan.
Use these words when an arranged event or activity is canceled. A trip may not happen because of a strike. People who planned to attend are told it is off.

examples.en: Let's grab coffee this Saturday and catch up with each other!
examples.zh: 這週六我們一起喝杯咖啡敘敘舊吧！

examples.en: He sprinted with all his might across the station platform to catch up with his departing friends.
examples.zh: 他在車站月台上使出渾身解數奮力衝刺，終於趕上並追上了正準備啟程遠行的好友群。

examples.en: She studied three extra hours every evening to catch up with her classmates in chemistry.
examples.zh: 為了追趕上同班同學在化學實驗進度上的領先優勢，她每晚特意多挑燈夜戰三個小時。

explains.en: Use this phrase when reaching someone or something that is ahead. A runner may hurry to reach friends. It can also mean talking about recent news with a friend.
After missing lessons, a student may work to reach the same level as classmates. Friends who have not met can share what has happened in their lives.
The expression can describe closing a gap in progress. It also means meeting someone and sharing updates. Context shows which sense is meant.

examples.en: Read English news daily to keep up with current global affairs.
examples.zh: 每天閱讀英語新聞以跟上全球時事脈動。

examples.en: Jogging beside an experienced marathon runner is tough if you can't keep up with the pace.
examples.zh: 與資深馬拉松老將並肩晨跑頗具難度，如果你的體能完全跟不上對方的配速節奏的話。

examples.en: It takes continuous dedication for tech professionals to keep up with rapidly evolving AI tools.
examples.zh: 科技從業人員唯有日日保持求知若渴的學習熱忱，方能跟得上日新月異的 AI 工具浪潮。

explains.en: A runner moves at a steady pace so they do not fall behind a friend. This phrase means staying at the same speed.
Technology changes quickly, so workers keep learning new things. They want to stay informed about the latest tools.
If a class moves quickly through a book, a student may need to work hard to stay at the same progress. They do not want to fall behind.

examples.en: The police officer promised to look into the neighborhood theft.
examples.zh: 警員承諾將深入調查社區失竊案件。

examples.en: Our engineering team will immediately look into the database performance slowdown.
examples.zh: 我們的核心軟體工程團隊將第一時間深入排查，徹查資料庫運行效能驟降的箇中原委。

examples.en: Before investing your hard-earned savings, thoroughly look into the company's financial background.
examples.zh: 在把你辛辛苦苦積攢的血汗錢投入股市之前，務必事先徹底調查該公司的財務體質與背景。

explains.en: A police officer may examine a theft to learn what happened. The phrase means to investigate.
An engineer can study why a computer system is slow. A careful check may find the cause.
Before putting money into a company, learn more about its work and finances. This phrase describes that careful investigation.

examples.en: Young athletes look up to world-class Olympic medalists.
examples.zh: 年輕運動員們十分敬仰世界級的奧運得獎選手。

examples.en: Throughout my entire schooling, I have always looked up to my high school physics teacher.
examples.zh: 在我求學生涯的各個階段中，我內心深處始終無比敬仰我高中的物理啟蒙老師。

examples.en: Children naturally look up to their parents and mirror how they handle everyday conflicts.
examples.zh: 孩子們生來便會自然而然地仰望效仿父母，並潛移默化地模仿長輩處理日常矛盾的方式。

explains.en: You do this when you admire someone and respect the way they act. Young athletes may feel this about a champion. Children may feel it about their parents.
A student may admire a kind teacher who inspires them. This phrase describes respect and admiration. It is often followed by a person.
Use these words when someone is a good example to you. A young player may admire a famous athlete. The phrase tells that you respect that person.

examples.en: Never look down on anyone because of their background or job.
examples.zh: 絕不要因為他人的出身或職業而輕視任何人。

examples.en: A truly confident person never feels the arrogant need to look down on others.
examples.zh: 一個內心真正充盈強大且具備高度自信的人，絕不會自命不凡、心存輕慢地瞧不起別人。

examples.en: He was raised with humble values teaching him not to look down on simple, honest labor.
examples.zh: 他自幼深受質樸善良的家風薰陶，懂得凡是以汗水自食其力的誠實勞動皆神聖不可輕慢。

explains.en: Use this phrase when someone thinks another person is less important or worthy. It is unkind to judge people by their job. Everyone deserves respect.
A person may treat others as inferior because of their background. This expression describes a disrespectful attitude. A confident person does not need to act this way.
These words mean to feel superior to someone and show little respect. People should value honest work. The phrase can describe unfair judgment.

examples.en: He studied extra hard on weekends to make up for missed classes.
examples.zh: 他週末格外用功讀書以彌補之前缺課拉下的進度。

examples.en: No amount of money can truly make up for lost time away from your growing children.
examples.zh: 再多的金錢財富，都永遠無法真正彌補錯過陪伴年幼子女成長歷程的珍貴時光。

examples.en: The restaurant served complimentary handmade desserts to make up for the kitchen's slow service.
examples.zh: 為彌補廚房備餐上菜稍有延誤的疏失，餐廳主管主動奉上由甜點師現作的招待手作糕點。

explains.en: If a student misses class, they may study extra to balance what they lost. This phrase means to make a loss smaller.
After a long wait, a restaurant may offer a free dessert to improve the guest’s experience. It can help balance a poor experience.
No gift can fully replace time spent away from family. The phrase describes doing something to offset a problem.

examples.en: Does this English grammar explanation make sense to you?
examples.zh: 這段英文文法解說你聽得懂、覺得合理明白嗎？

examples.en: It makes complete economic sense to insulate your home attic before winter arrives.
examples.zh: 在冷冽冬季正式到來之前，為自家庭院閣樓加裝隔熱保溫層，在經濟效益上完全合理划算。

examples.en: His surprising career change didn't make much sense to his colleagues at first glance.
examples.zh: 他突然毅然跨界轉換職業跑道的驚人舉動，乍看之下讓身旁的同事同儕感到有些匪夷所思。

explains.en: An idea that is easy to understand and seems reasonable has this quality. The explanation was clear.
A plan may seem sensible after you hear the reasons. These words ask whether something is understandable.
A confusing sentence may not be clear at first. When the words fit together logically, they have this quality.

examples.en: Pay close attention to traffic lights when crossing the avenue.
examples.zh: 過馬路時請密切注意交通號誌。

examples.en: Students should pay undivided attention to the teacher during science laboratory demonstrations.
examples.zh: 自然科學實驗課進行操作示範時，全體同班同學應當心無旁騖、高度專注於老師的每一步驟。

examples.en: Pay attention to sudden weather alerts broadcasted on radio stations during mountain hikes.
examples.zh: 高山健行登山途中，務必隨時留心收聽廣播中播送的任何突發性區域極端天候警報。

explains.en: You do this when you carefully watch or listen to something. Students may focus on a teacher's directions. Drivers should notice signals on the road.
These words ask someone to focus their mind on a person or thing. A hiker should notice weather warnings. It means to listen or watch carefully.
Use this phrase when someone should notice information and think about it. It can be a sign, a lesson, or a sudden change. Careful focus is needed.

examples.en: I can't put up with the loud construction noise next door anymore.
examples.zh: 我再也無法忍受隔壁吵雜刺耳的施工噪音了。

examples.en: Commuters on morning subway trains patiently put up with cramped, crowded train cars.
examples.zh: 早晨尖峰時段搭乘捷運的通勤上班族，每日都耐著性子默默容忍車廂內的擁擠與狹窄。

examples.en: A professional customer support agent learns how to put up with frustrated, rude callers.
examples.zh: 一位合格成熟的專業客服人員，懂得如何在面對情緒失控且口氣不善的來電時保持克制。

explains.en: Use this phrase when tolerating something unpleasant. A commuter may bear a crowded train for a short ride. It can describe dealing patiently with noise.
A person may accept an annoying situation without stopping it. A support worker may remain calm with an angry caller. The phrase means endure.
When a neighbor makes loud noise, someone may have to tolerate it. These words describe accepting discomfort. It does not mean agreeing with the behavior.

examples.en: Let's set up a study group to prepare for the TOEIC exam.
examples.zh: 我們來組建一個讀書會一起準備多益測驗吧。

examples.en: The camping enthusiasts quickly set up their waterproof tents before nightfall.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的露營愛好者趕在夜幕完全低垂之前，乾淨俐落地搭好了各自的防風抗水帳篷。

examples.en: It takes only a few simple steps to set up two-factor authentication on your smartphone.
examples.zh: 只要跟隨螢幕指引操作幾個簡單設定步驟，就能在智慧手機上成功啟用雙重身分驗證。

explains.en: A group can start a club by choosing a name and inviting members. Campers put their tent together before dark.
A worker may arrange a new computer with an account and password. Friends can also plan chairs and tables for a party.
This phrase can mean to establish a business or organization. It can also mean to assemble equipment so it is ready to use.

examples.en: Her fluent spoken English made her stand out during the interview.
examples.zh: 她流利的英語口說讓她在面試中脫穎而出。

examples.en: The bright yellow raincoat stood out vividly against the misty, gray mountain fog.
examples.zh: 那件亮黃色的連帽雨衣，在一片白茫茫的灰濛深山雲霧中顯得格外的搶眼與醒目。

examples.en: Having diverse internship experience helps your job application resume stand out among applicants.
examples.zh: 擁有豐富多元且含金量高的實習經歷，能讓你的求職履歷在數百位競爭者中顯得出類拔萃。

explains.en: A bright coat is easy to notice in gray weather. A person with a special talent may also be noticed.
When one student has a unique idea, others pay attention. This phrase describes being more noticeable than the rest.
A yellow sign is very easy to see against a dark wall. A person's work can also be especially impressive.

examples.en: Hundreds of students took part in the annual campus charity run.
examples.zh: 數百名學生熱情參與了一年一度的校園慈善路跑。

examples.en: Would you like to take part in the citywide English speech contest next month?
examples.zh: 你有意願報名參加下個月即將在全市隆重登場的英語即席演講錦標賽嗎？

examples.en: Citizens are warmly encouraged to take part in open town hall discussions on public parks.
examples.zh: 市政當局極力鼓勵廣大市民朋友熱情走出家門，主動參與公共綠地公園規劃的公民論壇。

explains.en: You do this when you join an activity or event with other people. Students may enter a charity run. Citizens may join a public discussion.
This phrase describes being one of the people involved in something. You might join a contest or community meeting. It means participating.
Use these words when someone joins an event instead of only watching. People can join a race, class, or discussion. They contribute as members.

examples.en: Take full advantage of library resources to improve your vocabulary.
examples.zh: 充分利用圖書館資源來擴充你的英文單字量。

examples.en: Tourists should take advantage of the convenient Day Pass to tour Taipei on the MRT.
examples.zh: 造訪台北的觀光旅客應當好好善用便捷超值的一日通票，搭乘綿密的捷運暢遊各大景點。

examples.en: Be vigilant so unscrupulous vendors do not take unfair advantage of your kindness.
examples.zh: 出門在外請隨時保持警覺，切莫讓少數居心不良的無良商販有機可乘、佔了你善良的便宜。

explains.en: Use this phrase when making good use of an opportunity or resource. Students can borrow books to learn more. It can also mean unfairly using someone's kindness.
A traveler may make the most of a day pass to see a city. The same expression can describe exploiting another person. Context tells whether the meaning is positive or negative.
People can benefit from a chance that is available. Someone may also treat another person unfairly for personal gain. The phrase has both meanings.

examples.en: The difficult test turned out to be much easier than expected.
examples.zh: 那場原本看似艱難的考試結果比預期簡單許多。

examples.en: Don't worry prematurely; things often turn out much better than our worst fears.
examples.zh: 切勿杞人憂天過早焦慮；事情最終發展的結果，往往遠比我們心中最壞的設想好上許多。

examples.en: Thousands of cheerful music fans turned out for the outdoor summer jazz concert.
examples.zh: 數千名熱愛音樂的樂迷粉絲如潮水般熱情湧現到場，熱烈參與了這場夏日露天爵士音樂會。

explains.en: The trip seemed difficult at first, but it became fun in the end. This phrase describes the final result.
Thousands of fans came to the park for the concert. The same phrase can describe a crowd arriving at an event.
A small seed may become a tall plant after a few months. Use these words to describe how something finally proves to be.

examples.en: Watch out for slippery wet floors after the sudden afternoon downpour.
examples.zh: 午後陣雨過後請特別當心地面濕滑。

examples.en: Hikers along rocky mountain trails must watch out for venomous snakes and falling stones.
examples.zh: 攀爬穿梭於崇山峻嶺亂石步道間的登山客，務必時刻提高警惕提防毒蛇出沒與高空落石。

examples.en: Always watch out for speeding scooters when opening car doors on busy city streets.
examples.zh: 在車水馬龍的市區街道旁開啟汽車車門下車時，切記「兩段式開門」並當心後方機車。

explains.en: Stay alert for slippery floors after rain. These words warn someone to be careful about a danger.
A driver should pay attention to scooters before opening a car door. This phrase points to something risky nearby.
Hikers need to notice loose rocks on a trail. A warning can help them avoid getting hurt.

examples.en: As a matter of fact, I have lived in Tainan for over five years.
examples.zh: 事實上，我已經在台南居住了超過五年。

examples.en: I know him quite well; as a matter of fact, we were high school classmates.
examples.zh: 我和他彼此熟絡得很；事實上，我們在高中時代曾經同班同窗了整整三年。

examples.en: She didn't find the calculus test difficult; as a matter of fact, she scored one hundred!
examples.zh: 她一點都不覺得剛才那張微積分考卷很難；事實上，她竟然直接拿下了整整一百分的滿分！

explains.en: This phrase introduces something that is true, sometimes correcting an assumption. A person may say they know someone well and explain how they met. It can add a surprising fact.
Use these words to emphasize what is really the case. A difficult test may have been easy for a student. The phrase can introduce a detail that supports a statement.
This expression means in truth or actually. It often adds information that may surprise the listener. It can clarify what happened or what someone knows.

examples.en: I ran into an elementary school friend at the bookstore by accident.
examples.zh: 我在書店偶然巧遇了一位國小同學。

examples.en: Penicillin was discovered entirely by accident when mold contaminated a petri dish.
examples.zh: 青黴素（盤尼西林）的驚世問世，純粹是一次實驗培養皿意外遭黴菌汙染所促成的巧合。

examples.en: He deleted the draft document by accident, but luckily retrieved it from trash.
examples.zh: 他在整理資料夾時不小心失手誤刪了那份企劃初稿，所幸及時從資源回收筒中完整找回。

explains.en: This phrase means something happened unintentionally. You may meet an old friend while shopping without planning it. A deleted file can sometimes be restored.
An event that was not planned may happen this way. Scientists sometimes make a discovery while doing another experiment. It can describe an error too.
Use these words when an action happens unintentionally rather than by choice. Someone might spill water while reaching for a cup. It may lead to a lucky result.

examples.en: He didn't drop the cup on purpose; it just slipped from his hand.
examples.zh: 他不是故意摔壞杯子的；只是手滑不小心掉了。

examples.en: Did you hide my car keys on purpose, or did you honestly just misplace them?
examples.zh: 你到底是故意把我的汽車鑰匙藏起來惡作劇，還是真的自己隨手放忘記收在哪裡了？

examples.en: She arrived thirty minutes early on purpose to secure front-row seats for the seminar.
examples.zh: 為了能在萬人空巷的熱門大師講座中搶佔第一排黃金視野寶座，她特意提早半小時抵達。

explains.en: A child spills juice by accident, not because they meant to. These words mean doing something intentionally.
She set her alarm early so she would arrive before the doors opened. She planned to do it.
If someone moves a toy to surprise a friend, they chose to do so. The action was not an accident.

examples.en: In general, public transport in Taiwan is clean, punctual, and safe.
examples.zh: 一般而言，台灣的大眾運輸乾淨、準時且十分安全。

examples.en: In general, younger students acquire foreign accents faster than adult learners.
examples.zh: 總體而言，年幼的兒童學童在模仿吸收外語地道發音時的速度，普遍快於成年學習者。

examples.en: The food was delicious and the service was warm; in general, it was a wonderful dinner.
examples.zh: 菜餚精緻可口且侍者服務親切周到；總括來說，這是一場無比愉悅且賓主盡歡的美好晚宴。

explains.en: These words describe what is usually true for most cases. Buses are usually safe and clean in Taiwan.
A speaker may give a broad idea before mentioning details. Young children often learn new sounds quickly.
Use this phrase to talk about something as a whole. A meal may be tasty even if one dish is not.

examples.en: I love Taiwanese night markets, in particular the crispy fried chicken.
examples.zh: 我非常喜愛台灣夜市，特別是香脆多汁的鹽酥雞。

examples.en: The professor praised the entire project team, in particular the lead software architect.
examples.zh: 指導教授對全體專案小組成員給予了高度肯定，特別對主導開發的核心架構師讚譽有加。

examples.en: Is there any destination in particular that you would like to visit in eastern Taiwan?
examples.zh: 這次規劃造訪東台灣的深度慢活之旅中，是否有任何特別想去走走看看的私房景點嗎？

explains.en: These words point to one specific person or thing from a larger group. Someone may like many foods, especially one kind. The phrase focuses attention.
Use this expression to ask whether someone has one exact place in mind. It can also name the most important member of a group. It is similar to especially.
This phrase introduces a detail that deserves special attention. A team may be praised, especially its leader. It narrows a broad idea to one example.

examples.en: Book high-speed train tickets in advance during holiday seasons.
examples.zh: 連假期間請務必事先提前預訂高鐵車票。

examples.en: Please inform the hotel staff in advance if you have any severe food allergies.
examples.zh: 如果您本人對特定海鮮或堅果有任何嚴重的食物過敏史，請務必於入住用餐前事先告知。

examples.en: Paying your utility bills in advance ensures you never suffer unnecessary late fees.
examples.zh: 事先預繳或設定銀行帳戶自動扣繳水電瓦斯公用事業規費，能確保你絕不會產生逾期滯納金。

explains.en: Use this phrase to mean before a planned time or event. Travelers may buy train tickets early during a holiday. Giving the hotel notice early can also help.
People may pay a bill before its due date. Reserving seats early can prevent missing out. These words mean ahead of time.
When you tell someone about a need before arriving, you do it early. A hotel can prepare for food allergies. The phrase means beforehand.

examples.en: Please return to your seats at once; the bell is ringing.
examples.zh: 請立刻回到座位上，上課鐘聲響了。

examples.en: When the alarm sounded, all office employees evacuated the high-rise building at once.
examples.zh: 當大樓火警警報驟然響起的那一刻，全體辦公同仁立刻井然有序地從高層大廈全員疏散。

examples.en: Don't try to master all seven thousand vocabulary words at once; learn forty every day.
examples.zh: 千萬不要好高騖遠妄想著一口氣把七千個單字在一天之內背完；每天按部就班背四十個即可。

explains.en: The fire alarm rings and everyone leaves the room immediately. These words can mean without delay.
Two siblings may speak at the same time. The phrase can also describe things happening together.
When the teacher calls, return to your seat right away. This expression can mean immediately.

examples.en: We go hiking in the countryside once in a while.
examples.zh: 我們偶爾會去鄉村郊外健行踏青。

examples.en: She eats healthy salads every day, but enjoys a chocolate doughnut once in a while.
examples.zh: 她平日三餐都嚴格自律地享用低卡有機沙拉，但偶爾也會放縱自己吃上一顆香甜巧克力甜甜圈。

examples.en: Once in a while, it does you good to disconnect from digital screens and enjoy nature.
examples.zh: 偶爾讓自己完全遠離發光的數位螢幕、放下手機，走進大自然中深呼吸，對身心大有裨益。

explains.en: This phrase means something happens sometimes, but not often. We may hike in the hills on a few weekends.
A person may eat a sweet treat occasionally, even while choosing healthy food most days. The event is not part of a daily routine.
It is good to take a break from screens from time to time. The phrase describes an activity that is not regular.

examples.en: All of a sudden, heavy raindrops started tapping on the window.
examples.zh: 突然之間，豆大的雨滴開始敲打著窗戶。

examples.en: We were cycling peacefully along the river when all of a sudden a stray dog dashed across.
examples.zh: 我們正優哉游哉地沿著河濱微風騎行時，突然之間一隻小野狗冷不防從草叢中橫穿飛奔而出。

examples.en: The classroom fell into dead silence when all of a sudden the principal walked into the room.
examples.zh: 當校長出乎所有人意料突然邁步走進教室大門的那一刻，原本喧鬧的教室瞬間鴉雀無聲。

explains.en: This phrase describes something that happens unexpectedly and very quickly. Rain may begin while people are outside. A quiet room may suddenly become busy.
Use these words for an event that comes without warning. A dog may run across a path while people are cycling. It changes what is happening right away.
This expression means unexpectedly, with little or no warning. Someone may enter a room and surprise everyone. It often begins a sentence about a sudden event.

examples.en: Follow the recipe step by step to bake delicious pineapple cakes.
examples.zh: 按照食譜步驟一步步操作，就能烤出美味的鳳梨酥。

examples.en: Mastering a foreign language requires daily effort taken patiently step by step.
examples.zh: 想要真正精通一門外國語言，唯有日復一日、沉著冷靜地循序漸進方能水到渠成。

examples.en: The tutor explained the complex physics calculation step by step on the whiteboard.
examples.zh: 課輔家教在白板上條理清晰、一步一步地詳細拆解推導了那道高難度的高中物理計算題。

explains.en: This phrase describes doing something one stage at a time. A recipe may guide a cook from mixing to baking. Complex work can feel easier this way.
A tutor may explain each part of a calculation in order. Learning a language takes patience and steady practice. The phrase means gradually.
Follow each instruction in sequence instead of rushing ahead. A learner can build a skill slowly. This expression describes a careful process.

examples.en: How is your new semester going? — So far, so good!
examples.zh: 你的新學期過得如何？— 到目前為止一切都很順利！

examples.en: We have completed half of the marathon course and, so far so good, my knees feel fine.
examples.zh: 我們已經成功跑完了整場全馬賽程的一半路程，到目前為止一切安好，雙膝沒有絲毫不適。

examples.en: The software launch entered its third testing phase; so far so good, with zero bugs reported.
examples.zh: 這款大型軟體上線已順利進入第三測試驗收階段；到目前為止一切順遂，未接獲任何錯誤。

explains.en: A new class began this morning, and everything is going well until now. These words give a positive progress report.
Halfway through a trip, the car is running well and everyone feels fine. The speaker says things are okay up to this point.
