A team has tested its new game for several days without problems. They report that the progress is good until now.

examples.en: Practicing listening day after day leads to true fluency.
examples.zh: 日復一日堅持練習聽力能帶來真正的流利度。

examples.en: Day after day, the dedicated baker kneads fresh sourdough loaves with pride.
examples.zh: 日復一日，這位充滿職人敬業精神的烘焙師總是自豪滿滿地親手揉捏新鮮天然酸種麵糰。

examples.en: She showed up at the swimming pool day after day until she perfected her butterfly stroke.
examples.zh: 她日復一日風雨無阻地準時出現在市立游泳池苦練，直到徹底把蝶式泳姿雕琢到完美無瑕。

explains.en: This means something happens every day for a long time. Regular practice can build a skill.
A baker may prepare fresh bread each morning without stopping. The words describe repeated daily effort.
A swimmer may return to the pool each day to improve. This expression shows that the action continues over many days.

examples.en: Sooner or later, hard work and dedication will pay off.
examples.zh: 辛勤努力與全心投入遲早會帶來回報。

examples.en: If you neglect routine car maintenance, sooner or later an expensive breakdown will happen.
examples.zh: 如果你平日總是輕忽例行的汽車機油與剎車保養，車子遲早會發生耗費不貲的嚴重拋錨。

examples.en: Sooner or later, truth will emerge and clarify all unfounded neighborhood rumors.
examples.zh: 遲早事實的真相必定會大白於天下，徹底澄清巷弄街坊間流傳的一切捕風捉影無稽之談。

explains.en: This phrase means that something will happen at some time in the future, even if we do not know when. Hard work may bring success. A neglected car may eventually break down.
Use these words to say that an event is certain to happen eventually. It may take a while. The exact time is unknown.
This expression describes an outcome that will happen at some point. Truth may come out after a delay. It can be used for good or bad results.

examples.en: You are holding the map upside down!
examples.zh: 你把地圖拿反了（上下顛倒）啦！

examples.en: The sudden international move turned their quiet family routine upside down for months.
examples.zh: 這次突如其來的跨國搬遷外派調動，將他們原本安居樂業的家庭日常節奏徹底攪了個天翻地覆。

examples.en: Hang the freshly gathered herb bunches upside down in a dry cupboard to cure them.
examples.zh: 將剛採摘下來的翠綠新鮮香草束頭朝下倒掛在乾燥通風的櫥櫃之中，使其自然風乾脫水。

explains.en: Use this phrase when the top and bottom of something are reversed. A map may be held the wrong way. A person can turn a picture over.
An object placed with its bottom facing upward is in this position. Hanging herbs this way can help them dry. It can also mean completely changing someone's routine.
A cup is in this position when its opening faces the table. A sudden move may turn family life completely around. The phrase describes reversal.

examples.en: The hikers arrived home safe and sound after the typhoon passed.
examples.zh: 颱風過後，登山客們已平安無事、安然無恙返抵家中。

examples.en: Despite flight delays and stormy winds, all travelers landed safe and sound at Taoyuan Airport.
examples.zh: 儘管航程中遭遇了嚴重的氣流顛簸與班機延誤，所有旅客最終皆安然無恙平安降落桃園機場。

examples.en: We breathed a huge sigh of relief once the lost mountain rescue dog returned safe and sound.
examples.zh: 當那隻在搜救任務中失聯走散的高山搜救犬平安無事地自行返回營地時，所有人如釋重負。

explains.en: The lost puppy came home without an injury. Its family was relieved that it was unharmed.
After a stormy flight, all travelers arrived without trouble. Their friends were glad they were okay.
A child got back from camp with nothing wrong. The family was happy the child was well.

examples.en: Could you please give me a hand moving this wooden desk?
examples.zh: 能請你幫我一把，一起搬動這張木書桌嗎？

examples.en: Kind commuters gave the tourist a hand carrying her heavy baby stroller up the subway stairs.
examples.zh: 熱心善良的捷運通勤乘客紛紛主動伸出援手，合力幫忙帶著大包小包的遊客抬嬰兒車爬樓梯。

examples.en: Whenever classmates struggled with math homework, David was always willing to give them a hand.
examples.zh: 每當班上同學在面對艱澀高深的高中數學作業陷入苦戰時，大衛總是無比熱心伸出援手。

explains.en: Help a person carry a desk or finish a task. A classmate may do this when someone has too much to carry.
Kind people assist a tourist with a stroller on the stairs. These words ask someone to help.
When a friend has trouble with homework, offer support. The phrase means to help someone do something.

examples.en: Keep in mind that practice makes perfect in language learning.
examples.zh: 請牢記：熟能生巧是語言學習的不二法門。

examples.en: Keep in mind that museum galleries are strictly closed for cleaning on Mondays.
examples.zh: 請大家務必牢記於心：全市各大市立美術館與歷史博物館每逢週一皆固定休館進行大掃除。

examples.en: While drafting your speech, keep in mind the diverse interests and age of your audience.
examples.zh: 在撰寫你的公眾演講稿時，請時時刻刻將現場台下觀眾跨年齡層的多元興趣銘記於心。

explains.en: You do this when you remember an important fact while doing something else. A speaker may think about the audience. A student may remember that practice helps.
These words ask someone not to forget an idea. Museum visitors may need to remember opening days. The information may matter later.
Use this phrase when a fact should stay in someone's thoughts. It can be helpful advice before making a plan. It means to remember.

examples.en: She made up her mind to study computer science in college.
examples.zh: 她下定決心大學要攻讀資訊工程學系。

examples.en: He wavered for hours over the restaurant menu before finally making up his mind.
examples.zh: 他拿著豐富多元的餐館菜單猶豫不決反覆琢磨了良久，最後才終於下定決心點了招牌菜。

examples.en: Once you make up your mind to pursue a lifelong dream, pursue it with all your heart.
examples.zh: 一旦你真正下定決心去追逐自己一生的崇高志向，就請毫無保留、全心全意地勇敢奔赴。

explains.en: Use this phrase when finally deciding what to do. Someone may choose a subject to study after considering options. It can take time to decide.
After thinking carefully, a person may settle on a choice. A diner might select a meal after looking at the menu. The expression means reach a decision.
A person can stop being unsure and choose a path. They may decide to follow a dream. These words describe forming a firm decision.

examples.en: That minor rumor has nothing to do with the actual facts.
examples.zh: 那個微不足道的小謠言與實際事實毫無關聯。

examples.en: The cancellation of the flight had nothing to do with equipment error; it was purely due to fog.
examples.zh: 本次航班被迫取消與飛機機械故障沒有任何關係，純粹是因為機場跑道被特大濃霧所籠罩。

examples.en: Mind your own daily responsibilities and stay out of petty gossip that has nothing to do with you.
examples.zh: 專心做好自己手頭的本分工作，切莫去插手攪和那些與你本人八竿子打不著的無聊八卦。

explains.en: The broken cup was not caused by the rain outside. The two things are unrelated.
A rumor about a game has no connection to the truth. This phrase says there is no link.
If a problem concerns another person, you are not involved in it. These words can show that something is unrelated to you.

examples.en: Congratulations on completing the first 2,000 essential English words!
examples.zh: 恭喜您順利完成了前 2,000 個核心基礎英語單字！

examples.en: Heartfelt congratulations to the newlyweds on building a beautiful life together!
examples.zh: 向這對共結連理、攜手打造溫馨美好家庭的新婚夫婦致以最誠摯的由衷祝賀！

examples.en: Send a warm card expressing congratulations to your friend who just passed the bar exam.
examples.zh: 寄出一張精緻溫暖的祝賀卡片，向剛剛金榜題名通過國家律師高考的摯友表達熱烈祝賀。

explains.en: Say these words to show you are happy for someone's success. A friend may hear them after passing an exam.
People use this happy expression at a wedding or after a big achievement. It shows praise and good wishes.
Write a warm message to someone who has reached an important goal. These words tell them you are pleased for them.

examples.en: The interviewer asked insightful questions about my problem-solving ability.
examples.zh: 面試官就我的解決問題能力提出了深刻有見地的提問。

examples.en: Make friendly eye contact and nod attentively when the interviewer is speaking.
examples.zh: 當主考面試官發言時，保持親切眼神交會並專注點頭致意是極具教養的展現。

examples.en: A skilled interviewer creates a relaxed, conversational atmosphere to evaluate candidates.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的面試官懂得營造輕鬆自然的對話氛圍，藉以全面客觀評估應試者素質。

explains.en: This person asks questions during a job meeting or research conversation. They listen to answers and learn about the other person. A friendly manner can help people feel relaxed.
A candidate may speak with this person when applying for a job. The questioner learns about their skills and experience. The meeting can feel like a conversation.
This is the person who asks questions in an interview. They may be hiring someone or gathering information. Their questions help them evaluate the answers.

examples.en: The interviewee answered each question calmly and confidently.
examples.zh: 應試者從容自信地回答了每一道問題。

examples.en: The television host thanked the renowned documentary filmmaker interviewee warmly.
examples.zh: 電視訪談節目主持人熱情誠摯地向身旁的重量級紀錄片名導受訪者致謝道賀。

examples.en: The nervous interviewee took a sip of mineral water to collect her racing thoughts.
examples.zh: 緊張的應試者輕輕啜飲了一小口礦泉水，努力撫平內心起伏、重整紛亂的思緒。

explains.en: It is the person who answers questions during an interview. A job candidate may speak with a hiring manager. They should listen and respond clearly.
A television host may ask this guest about a film or career. The person being questioned should answer clearly. A calm reply can help.
During a hiring meeting, one person asks questions and another replies. The person giving replies has this role. It can also describe someone in a research interview.

examples.en: She is highly qualified to lead the international marketing team.
examples.zh: 她具備卓越資格，非常稱職帶領國際行銷團隊。

examples.en: Only qualified medical professionals should administer prescription vaccinations.
examples.zh: 唯有經過嚴格專業考試合格的註冊醫事專業人員，方具資格施打處方疫苗針劑。

examples.en: The inspector declared the newly renovated kindergarten completely safe and fully qualified.
examples.zh: 消防安全檢查員正式簽署報告，宣布這座全面整修完工的幼兒園安全驗收完全合格。

entries.definition: 合格的；具備資格的；稱職的

explains.en: A nurse has completed the required training to care for patients. She has the needed skills for the job.
A person may need a certificate and experience before doing certain work. They meet the requirements.
Only trained people should give medicine to patients. They have the proper knowledge and permission.

examples.en: Data analysis and bilingual communication are valuable modern skillsets.
examples.zh: 數據分析與雙語溝通是現代極具價值的實用技能組合。

examples.en: Learning Python and SQL expanded his technical skillset significantly.
examples.zh: 深入掌握 Python 與 SQL 資料庫查詢語言，大幅拓展了他個人的硬實力技術專長。

examples.en: Graphic design, video editing, and copywriting form a versatile digital skillset.
examples.zh: 平面設計排版、影音後製剪輯與行銷文案撰寫，構成了一套無往不利的數位多功能技能。

explains.en: This is the collection of things a person knows how to do. It may include design or computer skills.
Learning new tools can add to someone's abilities at work. A mix of talents is useful for many jobs.
A person's set of abilities can include speaking, writing, or data work. Different careers need different combinations.

examples.en: Campus recruitment drives offer fresh graduates direct interview chances.
examples.zh: 校園徵才博覽會為應屆畢業生提供了直接面試的良機。

examples.en: The human resources department improved its online recruitment portal for applicants.
examples.zh: 企業人資部門全面重構優化了線上徵才入口網站，提供應徵者更友善的投遞體驗。

examples.en: Early summer is a peak recruitment season for hospitality and tourism businesses.
examples.zh: 初夏畢業季前後向來是觀光餐飲與精品旅宿產業招兵買馬的黃金徵才高峰期。

explains.en: This is the process of finding and choosing people for jobs. A company may post openings online. New graduates can meet employers at a campus event.
A business looks for workers and invites them to apply. The human resources team may manage this process. Some seasons have more openings than others.
When an organization needs new employees, it searches for candidates and hires suitable people. This process includes applications and interviews. It helps a company build its team.

examples.en: An executive headhunter contacted him regarding a VP position.
examples.zh: 一位高階獵頭顧問主動與他聯繫洽談副總經理職缺。

examples.en: Corporate tech giants hire professional headhunters to scout rare semiconductor talent.
examples.zh: 跨國科技巨擘不惜重金聘請高階獵頭顧問，替公司在市場上延攬炙手可熱的半導體英才。

examples.en: Keep your LinkedIn profile polished and up-to-date so headhunters can find you easily.
examples.zh: 隨時精心維護更新個人 LinkedIn 領英職場檔案，能讓尋覓良才的獵頭顧問輕鬆找到你。

examples.en: Executive headhunters contacted the experienced software architect with lucrative overseas offers.
examples.zh: 跨國高階獵人頭顧問公司主動聯繫該位資深軟體架構師，遞出待遇優渥的海外跨國高薪聘書。

examples.en: Building relationships with specialized headhunters gives you early access to confidential executive roles.
examples.zh: 與特定產業領域專精的頂尖獵頭顧問保持良性互動，能讓你在第一時間掌握各家企業的機密高階職缺。

examples.en: The headhunter negotiated on behalf of the candidate, securing an additional equity grant in the package.
examples.zh: 專業獵頭顧問代表候選人與企業人資來回斡旋爭取，成功在最終核薪待遇中額外爭取到可觀的股票選擇權。

entries.definition: 獵人頭顧問；高階獵頭；獵人頭顧問公司；獵頭專員

explains.en: It is a recruiter who searches for skilled people to fill important jobs. A technology company may ask one to find an engineer. They may contact candidates directly.
This professional looks for experienced workers for a business. They often help fill senior positions. A polished online profile can help candidates be found.
Companies may hire this kind of recruiter to locate people with rare skills. The person approaches possible candidates and discusses jobs. It is common in executive hiring.

examples.en: Economic downturns often result in unexpected corporate layoffs.
examples.zh: 景氣低迷衰退往往會導致企業無預警的裁員。

examples.en: The struggling retail company laid off twenty percent of its workforce to avoid bankruptcy.
examples.zh: 這家苦苦苦撐的實體零售連鎖大廠裁減了兩成員工，以極力避免走上破產清算絕路。

examples.en: Severance packages and job placement counseling were offered to workers affected by the layoff.
examples.zh: 公司為受到本次結構性裁員衝擊影響的離職員工，提供了優渥的資遣補償與轉職諮詢。

explains.en: A company has less work and tells some employees their jobs are ending. This can happen when business is slow.
A worker loses a job because the company reduces staff. It is not necessarily due to that person’s actions.
When a business can no longer afford all its workers, it may dismiss some of them. The job loss is called this.

examples.en: New employees undergo a three-month probation period before permanent hiring.
examples.zh: 新進員工在轉正為正式職員前需經歷三個月的試用期。

examples.en: She passed her ninety-day probation with flying colors and received a pay adjustment.
examples.zh: 她以全體主管一致讚賞的優異表現順利通過九十天考核試用期，並獲得了正式調薪。

examples.en: The first-time minor offender was placed on one-year probation by the presiding judge.
examples.zh: 承審法官依法對這位初犯且深具悔意的微罪年輕被告宣告一年的緩刑觀察處分。

examples.en: The first-time offender was granted two years of probation and community service.
examples.zh: 初犯被告獲得法官給予宣告緩刑兩年並須配合執行義務勞務。

examples.en: If the convict violates any terms of probation, he will be sent directly to state prison.
examples.zh: 該名受刑人若在法定緩刑期間內違反任何行為規範或再犯，其緩刑將被撤銷並直接發監執行徒刑。

examples.en: Newly hired engineers are placed on a three-month probation period before receiving permanent contracts.
examples.zh: 新進錄取的軟體研發工程師均必須通過長達三個月的在職試用期考核，方能正式簽署全職聘用合約。

entries.definition: 試用期；見習期；緩刑；留校察看

explains.en: A new worker may have a trial period before getting a permanent job. The company checks how the person does.
A court may let someone stay in the community under rules instead of going to prison. Breaking those rules can have serious results.
A school may place a student on a period of careful review. This word can describe a trial period at work or a legal sentence.

examples.en: He landed a full-time position as a UI designer in Neihu Tech Park.
examples.zh: 他在內湖科技園區找到了一份 UI 設計師的全職工作。

examples.en: Working full-time while studying for evening graduate school tests one's endurance.
examples.zh: 白天從事全職工作、夜間還要挑燈攻讀在職在職專班碩士學位，極度考驗一個人的耐力。

examples.en: Full-time corporate employees are legally entitled to comprehensive health and labor insurance.
examples.zh: 依法規保障，企業內部的正職專任全職員工全面享有健全的勞工保險與全民健保保障。

explains.en: This describes work or study done for the usual full working week rather than just a few hours. A person may hold a regular job. It can also be used to say how someone works.
An employee in this kind of position works regular hours each week. Evening study can happen outside those hours. The opposite is part-time.
Use this adjective or adverb for a job that takes a person's main working hours. Benefits may come with it. It can also describe working in that way.

examples.en: College students often work part-time at boba tea shops.
examples.zh: 大學生經常在手搖飲料店從事兼職打工。

examples.en: She took a part-time job as an English tutor to earn extra spending money.
examples.zh: 她在課餘時間兼職接案擔任英語家教老師，替自己賺取充裕的零用錢與生活費。

examples.en: Many retirees enjoy working part-time in bookstores to stay socially active and engaged.
examples.zh: 許多步入晚年的退休人士熱愛在獨立書店打工兼差，保持與社會人群的熱絡互動交流。

explains.en: It describes work done for fewer hours than a full workweek. A student may tutor or work in a cafe. It can also be an adverb describing a schedule.
Someone with this kind of job does not work all day every weekday. Retired people may choose it to stay active. The opposite is full-time.
A worker may have a short weekly schedule and earn extra money. A shop can hire people this way during busy seasons. This adjective describes the job arrangement.

examples.en: As a freelance graphic designer, she manages her own schedule flexible.
examples.zh: 作為一名自由平面設計師，她能彈性自由安排自己的工作時程。

examples.en: Freelancers must budget carefully for their own insurance, taxes, and retirement savings.
examples.zh: 接案自由工作者必須極其自律地為自己的健保費、年度所得稅及退休老本精打細算。

examples.en: The digital agency collaborates with a trusted network of skilled freelance copywriters.
examples.zh: 這家數位行銷代理商與一群深具文案功底且合作默契極佳的自由撰稿人保持長期配合。

explains.en: A designer works for different clients and chooses when to do each project. This person is not a regular employee of one company.
A writer may take short jobs from several businesses. They manage their own schedule and work.
This worker offers skills to many customers and is paid for each project. They often work independently.

examples.en: Summer internships provide valuable hands-on corporate work experience.
examples.zh: 暑期實習為在校生提供了寶貴的企業實務工作經驗。

examples.en: His outstanding performance during the three-month internship earned him a permanent job offer.
examples.zh: 他在為期三個月的實習期間表現卓越奪目，畢業前夕便順利提前拿下了全職正式聘約。

examples.en: Students can earn university course credits by completing an approved summer corporate internship.
examples.zh: 學生凡至經過校方嚴格審核認證的知名企業完成暑期實習，即可抵免大學專業選修學分。

explains.en: A student may work at a company for a short time to gain experience. The job can help with future career plans.
During this temporary work period, a learner practices real tasks. Good work may lead to a longer job offer.
Universities may give course credit for this kind of workplace training. It helps students learn outside the classroom.

examples.en: Contact Human Resources if you have inquiries regarding paternity leave.
examples.zh: 若您對陪產假規定有任何疑問，請聯繫人資部門。

examples.en: Human Resources organized a weekend outdoor team-building workshop in Yilan.
examples.zh: 人力資源部門特別在宜蘭幽靜的度假莊園籌辦了一場豐富多彩的週末戶外員工向心力工作坊。

examples.en: The Human Resources department oversees recruitment, employee benefits, and workplace training.
examples.zh: 企業人資部門總括負責掌管全公司的人才招聘徵選、員工各項福利以及在職專業培訓。

explains.en: This is the department in a company that helps manage employees. It may arrange hiring, benefits, and training. Workers can contact it with questions about leave.
When a business needs new staff, this team helps find them. It may also organize activities that help coworkers work together. It supports people at work.
A company may have this office to handle employee matters. Its work includes hiring, workplace rules, and training. Workers ask it about benefits or policies.

examples.en: Delegating tasks helps balance the heavy team workload evenly.
examples.zh: 適度分派任務有助於合理平衡團隊繁重的工作負荷。

examples.en: An overwhelming workload during audit season left employees utterly exhausted.
examples.zh: 每逢年度查帳審計旺季排山倒海而來的巨大工作量，往往讓全體審計人員精疲力竭。

examples.en: Automated digital tools helped streamline tasks and cut down the administrative workload.
examples.zh: 引進智慧化數位自動化工具，大幅精簡了瑣碎繁雜的流程，減輕了第一線行政工作負荷。

explains.en: It is the amount of work a person or team must complete. Too much can make employees tired. Sharing tasks can make it more manageable.
A busy season may bring many duties and deadlines. A team leader can balance assignments among workers. This noun names the total work expected.
When someone has many tasks to finish, they have a heavy load of work. Digital tools may reduce paperwork. Planning helps prevent exhaustion.

examples.en: Working excessive overtime harms physical health and productivity.
examples.zh: 長期過度超時加班會損害身體健康並降低工作效率。

examples.en: Employees are entitled to statutory overtime compensation according to the labor law.
examples.zh: 依勞動基準法明文規定，員工依法加班均享有領取法定加成加班費補償的正當權利。

examples.en: The exciting basketball finals went into thrilling overtime after a buzzer-beater tie.
examples.zh: 在讀秒絕殺追平比數之後，這場萬眾矚目的籃球總決賽被逼入了扣人心弦的延長加時賽。

examples.en: The basketball game tied in regulation and went into overtime.
examples.zh: 雙方在正規比賽時間打成平手，比賽隨即進入緊張刺激的延長賽。

examples.en: The software engineer worked three hours of overtime every evening to deploy the critical patch.
examples.zh: 為了在期限前緊急發布關鍵系統修補程式，這名軟體工程師每天傍晚自願加班三小時。

examples.en: A buzzer-beater shot in triple overtime sealed an unforgettable championship victory.
examples.zh: 在歷經三次延長賽的慘烈鏖戰後，一顆讀秒絕殺壓哨球為球隊鎖定了載入史冊的總冠軍勝利。

entries.definition: 加班；超時工作；加班費；延長賽；加班地

explains.en: A worker stays at the office after their regular hours to finish a task. This extra work is beyond the usual schedule.
A tied basketball game continues after the regular playing time ends. This extra period decides the winner.
Some jobs pay extra for hours beyond the normal workday. In sports, the word can name an added period of play.

examples.en: Taking regular vacations prevents professional burnout and stress.
examples.zh: 定期休假放鬆能有效預防職業倦怠與過度工作壓力。

examples.en: Symptoms of burnout include chronic fatigue, cynicism, and loss of enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 職業倦怠身心耗竭的典型徵兆包括長期揮之不去的慢性疲勞、消極憤世以及熱情全失。

examples.en: Hospitals introduced wellness programs to combat emotional burnout among frontline doctors.
examples.zh: 各大醫學中心陸續推展身心舒壓輔導方案，積極防止第一線臨床醫師產生情緒耗竭。

examples.en: Taking scheduled vacations prevents severe workplace mental burnout.
examples.zh: 給自己安排定期的放鬆休假能有效防範長年累積引發的嚴重職場心理倦怠。

examples.en: Working 80 hours a week without rest inevitably leads to physical and emotional burnout.
examples.zh: 每週連續高壓工時長達八十小時且得不到休整，必然會導致身心耗竭。

examples.en: HR introduced mental health days to help employees recover from chronic burnout.
examples.zh: 人資部設立了心理健康充電假，以協助員工從長期的職業倦怠中復原。

examples.en: Chronic unpaid overtime without adequate rest leads to physical exhaustion and severe workplace burnout.
examples.zh: 長期無止境的無酬加班加上睡眠嚴重不足，極易導致身體免疫力崩潰與嚴重的職場過勞倦怠。

examples.en: Recognizing early warning signs of emotional burnout allows professionals to set healthier work boundaries.
examples.zh: 及早警覺並察覺自身情緒倦怠的初期求救信號，有助於專業人士及時為職場與生活劃定健康界線。

examples.en: Progressive companies mandate paid mental health days to combat pervasive burnout among developers.
examples.zh: 開明進步的外商企業明訂帶薪「心理健康調適假」，主動出擊化解工程研發團隊普遍面臨的過勞壓力。

entries.definition: 職業倦怠；身心耗竭；職場過勞倦怠症；精疲力竭

explains.en: A person who works too hard for too long may feel completely worn out. Rest and support can help.
Someone may lose energy and interest after constant stress at work. Taking breaks can prevent this condition.
Long hours without enough rest can leave workers tired in body and mind. Healthy limits may help them recover.

examples.en: Modern professionals prioritize healthy work-life balance and mental wellbeing.
examples.zh: 現代上班族格外重視健康良好的工作與生活平衡及心靈福祉。

examples.en: Companies that respect work-life balance experience much lower employee turnover rates.
examples.zh: 凡是能充分體諒並尊重同仁工作與生活平衡的良心企業，其員工離職率普遍低得多。

examples.en: Setting clear boundaries after working hours is essential to preserve your work-life balance.
examples.zh: 下班後為公務通訊軟體設立明確的界限邊界，是守護個人工作生活平衡的關鍵之道。

explains.en: This describes having enough time and energy for a job and for personal life. Rest and family time matter too. Companies may support it by respecting time away from work.
People may set clear limits after working hours so they can relax. A healthy balance can improve well-being. It can also help employees stay at a job.
This phrase means keeping work responsibilities and personal needs in a healthy relationship. A person should have time for family, friends, and rest. Employers can help by respecting boundaries.

examples.en: Cloud software enables seamless remote work from anywhere on Earth.
examples.zh: 雲端軟體使得從世界任何角落進行遠端辦公都能無縫銜接。

examples.en: Many software engineers prefer remote work because it eliminates long daily commutes.
examples.zh: 許多軟體工程師極力崇尚遠端辦公模式，因為這徹底免除了每日冗長折磨的舟車勞頓。

examples.en: Strong self-discipline and asynchronous messaging tools are essential for successful remote work.
examples.zh: 高度的個人自律精神以及高效的非同步溝通協作工具，是落實成功遠端辦公的基石。

explains.en: It is a job arrangement where people work away from the company's office, often at home. Cloud tools help teams share files. Workers need discipline and communication.
An employee may do office tasks from another place using the internet. This can remove a long daily commute. Teams often use messages and video calls.
People can complete their jobs from home or another location. They may coordinate with coworkers online. This arrangement offers flexibility but requires planning.

examples.en: Our company adopted a flexible hybrid work model: three office days, two home days.
examples.zh: 我們公司採取彈性混合辦公：三天進辦公室、兩天居家上班。

examples.en: A hybrid work arrangement offers the best of both worlds: collaboration and quiet focus.
examples.zh: 混合辦公模式兼具兩全其美之效：既保有面對面團隊激盪交流，又能享有居家專注時光。

examples.en: Surveys show that a majority of tech workers favor hybrid work over mandatory five-day office rules.
examples.zh: 調查研究顯示，絕大多數科技業工程師相比於強制五天到班，更壓倒性青睞混合辦公。

explains.en: An employee spends some days at home and other days at the office. This arrangement mixes two work locations.
A team meets in person a few days each week and works remotely on the others. People can collaborate while also focusing at home.
Some workers commute part of the week and stay home the rest. The schedule combines office and remote work.

examples.en: Flexible hours allow working parents to pick up children after school.
examples.zh: 彈性上下班工時讓雙薪父母能方便在放學時間接送孩子。

examples.en: Thanks to flexible hours, early risers can start at seven and finish work by mid-afternoon.
examples.zh: 拜彈性工時所賜，習慣早起的同仁可於清晨七點便開始上工，並於午後早早打卡下班。

examples.en: Offering flexible hours boosts employee morale and drastically reduces morning tardiness.
examples.zh: 企業推展彈性上下班制度能大幅鼓舞員工士氣，同時立竿見影地降低早晨遲到現象。

explains.en: A worker with this schedule can choose when to start and finish within set limits. It can help parents pick up children.
Some people begin work early and leave in the afternoon. This arrangement gives workers more choice about their schedule.
A company may let staff adjust their start time. Such a work schedule can fit different family needs.

examples.en: I used my remaining annual leave days to travel around Hualien and Taitung.
examples.zh: 我用掉了剩餘的特休年假天數到花蓮與台東環島旅遊。

examples.en: Employees accumulate additional days of statutory annual leave with every year of seniority.
examples.zh: 隨著在公司任職服務年資的增長，勞工依法享有累積更多天數的法定帶薪特休年假。

examples.en: Submit your annual leave request to your direct manager at least two weeks beforehand.
examples.zh: 若規劃請特休年假出遊，請務必至少提前兩週前向您的直屬主管正式遞出假單申請。

explains.en: This is paid time away from work that an employee can use for a trip or rest. Workers may collect more days as they stay longer at a job. A manager usually approves a request.
An employee can ask to take these days off during the year. They may use them to visit another city. A request is often sent ahead of time.
This workplace benefit gives staff planned days away from their job. The number of days may depend on how long they have worked. People submit a request before taking them.

examples.en: The project manager ensures team members deliver tasks on time.
examples.zh: 專案經理確保所有團隊成員如期交付工作任務。

examples.en: An agile project manager facilitates daily standup meetings to remove technical roadblocks.
examples.zh: 一位敏捷專案經理每日召開晨間站立會議，主動協助工程團隊排除技術障礙。

examples.en: Strong negotiation skills help the project manager balance competing budget priorities.
examples.zh: 沉著老練的協商溝通手腕，協助專案經理在相互競爭的多項預算優先級中取得平衡。

explains.en: This person plans a team's work and helps deliver a project on time. They track tasks, budgets, and problems. They may lead meetings.
A team leader coordinates people working toward a shared goal. They help remove obstacles and keep deadlines in view. Good communication matters.
Someone in this role balances schedules and resources. They check that each person completes assigned tasks. Negotiation can help when priorities compete.

examples.en: Seamless cross-department coordination ensures the product launch succeeds.
examples.zh: 各部門間無縫的協調配合確保了新產品發布會圓滿成功。

examples.en: Playing competitive badminton requires outstanding hand-eye athletic coordination.
examples.zh: 參與高強度羽球競賽，需要選手具備無比敏捷、精準出色的手眼肌肉協調能力。

examples.en: International disaster relief missions require high-level logistical coordination.
examples.zh: 跨國跨洲的國際災難人道救援行動，極度仰賴最高層級的後勤物流統籌協同配合。

explains.en: A drummer and guitarist must keep the same beat while playing together. Their movements and timing work well as a team.
Catching a ball takes eyes and hands working together. Practice can improve this skill.
A rescue team shares plans so each person knows what to do. The group’s actions are organized to work together.

examples.en: Taiwanese engineers collaborated with global designers on the laptop.
examples.zh: 台灣工程師與全球設計師通力合作研發這款筆記型電腦。

examples.en: Two university research labs will collaborate on an innovative cancer therapy study.
examples.zh: 兩所國立大學尖端實驗室將攜手合作，共同投入一項開創性的癌症免疫療法研究。

examples.en: The famous indie band collaborated with a classical string quartet on their new album.
examples.zh: 這支獨立樂團在發行的新專輯中，特邀古典弦樂四重奏大師跨界合作錄音。

examples.en: Two popular Taiwanese YouTubers collaborated on an epic cooking challenge.
examples.zh: 兩位人氣台灣 YouTuber 聯手合作拍攝了一場史詩級的料理挑戰。

examples.en: Scientists from five different countries collaborated to sequence the rare plant genome.
examples.zh: 來自五個國家的科學家攜手合作完成了珍稀植物的基因定序。

examples.en: Graphic designers and copywriters must collaborate closely on advertising campaigns.
examples.zh: 平面設計師與廣告文案撰稿人必須在廣告專案中緊密協同合作。

entries.definition: 合作；協同工作；合作拍片；聯名創作 (collab)

explains.en: Two groups work together on the same project. Designers and engineers may share ideas to make a new product.
Scientists from different places can join their efforts to study a problem. Each team contributes its knowledge.
Musicians may create a song together. This verb describes people working jointly toward a result.

examples.en: A cross-functional team combining marketing, engineering, and sales was formed.
examples.zh: 公司組建了一個結合行銷、研發工程與業務的跨職能專案團隊。

examples.en: Cross-functional workshops break down corporate silos and accelerate product delivery.
examples.zh: 定期舉辦跨職能專題研討會能有效打破部門間的本位主義穀倉，加速產品迭代交付。

examples.en: Agile product squads rely on daily cross-functional communication between UX and backend teams.
examples.zh: 敏捷產品開發小隊極度仰賴使用者經驗設計師與後端工程團隊間緊密的每日跨職能溝通。

explains.en: This describes a team or activity that brings together people with different kinds of jobs or skills. Engineers and sales workers may plan a product together. Sharing ideas can solve problems faster.
A project group may include people from design, marketing, and technology. They work across their usual department lines. This can help a product move forward.
Use this adjective for cooperation between different work areas. A team may include designers and developers. They communicate to reach a shared goal.

examples.en: We presented quarterly results to key company stakeholders and investors.
examples.zh: 我們向公司核心利害關係人與投資者簡報了季度營運成果。

examples.en: City planners organized public hearings to consult all community stakeholders on the transit line.
examples.zh: 都市計畫規劃師召開了多場公開公聽會，就新捷運路線廣泛徵詢所有社區利害關係人。

examples.en: Balancing the diverse expectations of company stakeholders requires transparent governance.
examples.zh: 妥善平衡企業各方利益相關人相異的期待與訴求，需要落實公開透明的公司治理。

examples.en: Keep all key stakeholders informed regarding major project milestone changes.
examples.zh: 每當專案重大里程碑時程發生調整時，請第一時間通知所有核心利害關係人。

examples.en: Shareholders, employees, and local communities are all vital corporate stakeholders.
examples.zh: 股東、員工以及在地社區皆是企業不可忽視的重要利害關係人。

examples.en: The CEO held an open forum to address stakeholder concerns about sustainability.
examples.zh: 執行長舉行了公開座談會，以回應利害關係人對永續經營議題的關注。

entries.definition: 利害關係人；利益相關方

explains.en: It is a person or group affected by a company's decisions. Workers, customers, and investors may all have an interest. Leaders should listen to them.
A city plan can affect residents and businesses nearby. Those groups have something important at stake. Meetings can gather their views.
People who care about the outcome of a project have this role. Their needs may differ, so clear communication is useful. A company may report results to them.

examples.en: Achieving a 20% user growth rate is our main marketing KPI.
examples.zh: 達成 20% 的使用者成長率是我們行銷團隊的核心 KPI。

examples.en: The customer service team tracks ticket resolution speed as a primary KPI.
examples.zh: 線上客服團隊將客服工單的平均問題排查處理時長，列為核心考核的重要關鍵績效指標。

examples.en: Every employee sat down with their manager to review quarterly KPI achievements.
examples.zh: 每一位員工在季度末均與直屬主管一對一深入面談，逐項檢視個人的季度 KPI 達成率。

examples.en: Monthly active user growth is our team's most critical core KPI.
examples.zh: 每月活躍用戶數（MAU）的穩健增長是我們團隊當前最關鍵的核心 KPI。

examples.en: Department heads meet every Monday morning to review quarterly progress against their assigned KPIs.
examples.zh: 各級部門主管固定於每週一清晨召開例會，逐一審視檢討各團隊本季預定目標 KPI 的實際執行進度。

examples.en: Setting unrealistic sales KPIs can demoralize employees and encourage risky short-term behavior.
examples.zh: 設定脫離現實、高不可攀的過苛銷售 KPI，不僅會重挫員工基層士氣，更往往會滋生鋌而走險的短期投機。

entries.definition: 關鍵績效指標 (KPI)；關鍵績效指標 (Key Performance Indicator)

explains.en: A shop tracks how many customers return each month to see whether it is doing well. This measurable goal helps judge progress.
A team chooses a number that shows whether its work is succeeding. Managers review it over time.
A company might measure delivery speed or customer satisfaction. Each measure helps check performance against a goal.

examples.en: The administrative assistant took detailed meeting minutes during the board meeting.
examples.zh: 行政助理在董事會會議期間詳實記錄了會議紀錄。

examples.en: Meeting minutes must be circulated to all participants within twenty-four hours.
examples.zh: 按照規範，正式的會議紀錄應於散會後的二十四小時內發送傳閱給所有與會人員確認。

examples.en: Check the official meeting minutes to confirm who volunteered to coordinate the event.
examples.zh: 查閱正式歸檔的會議紀錄，即可清楚確認當初究竟是由誰自願負責統籌這次大型活動。

explains.en: These notes record what people discussed and decided at a meeting. An assistant may write them down.
After a board meeting, participants can read this written record. It may list tasks and who will do them.
This document helps a group remember important decisions. It is shared with people who attended.

examples.en: Let's sit together and brainstorm catchy campaign slogans for the brand.
examples.zh: 大家一起坐下來，為品牌腦力激盪出吸睛好記的行銷標語吧。

examples.en: The design team gathered on comfy couches to brainstorm user interface improvements.
examples.zh: 產品體驗設計團隊圍坐在舒適的沙發上，一同腦力激盪如何進一步優化使用者介面。

examples.en: A productive brainstorming session welcomes unconventional ideas without premature judgment.
examples.zh: 一場卓有成效的腦力激盪發想會，應當包容各種跳脫框架的大膽創意且絕不預設立場。

explains.en: People do this when they quickly share many ideas to solve a problem or plan something. A team may suggest slogans or ways to improve an app. They can build on each other's thoughts.
A group can gather and offer ideas without judging them right away. This helps a design team think of improvements. It can be an activity or a meeting.
Use this word for creating lots of possible ideas together. A person can also do it alone. The ideas may later be sorted and chosen.

examples.en: The keynote presenter delivered an inspiring speech on AI trends.
examples.zh: 主講人就人工智慧最新趨勢發表了一場振奮人心的專題演說。

examples.en: A polished presenter engages the audience with relatable stories and humor.
examples.zh: 一位極具台風魅力的專業簡報演講者，懂得透過引發共鳴的生活故事與幽默抓住全場目光。

examples.en: The television presenter welcomed famous chefs from across the world to the cooking show.
examples.zh: 電視美食節目當家主持人熱情開場，隆重歡迎來自世界各地的頂級名廚蒞臨料理爭霸戰。

explains.en: It is a person who introduces a program or speaks to an audience. A television host may welcome guests. A good speaker keeps listeners interested.
At a conference, this person explains ideas or shares a speech. Stories and humor can make the talk engaging. A radio or TV program may also have one.
Someone leading a broadcast or event has this job. They may interview guests or introduce segments. Clear speech helps the audience follow along.

examples.en: Using bullet points makes complex information easier to digest.
examples.zh: 使用項目符號條列要點能讓複雜資訊更易於消化理解。

examples.en: Summarize each product feature in one clear bullet point on your sales sheet.
examples.zh: 在產品銷售型錄單張上，用簡潔明確的一行項目符號條列歸納每項獨家功能特點。

examples.en: Recruiters appreciate resumes that use clean bullet points to outline achievements.
examples.zh: 人資招募經理極度偏好採用乾淨條列式項目符號、條理陳述實質戰功成就的求職履歷。

explains.en: A report may show each key idea on a separate line with a small dot or dash. This makes the information easier to scan.
A shopping list can put one item on each marked line. Readers can quickly find what they need.
When writing notes, use short marked lines instead of a long paragraph. Each line presents one idea.

examples.en: Using infographics as visual aids helps clarify financial data.
examples.zh: 將資訊圖表作為視覺輔助工具能幫助釐清財務數據。

examples.en: The biology teacher brought physical plant models to class as interactive visual aids.
examples.zh: 生物老師特別將精緻的實體植物解剖模型帶入課堂，作為生動互動的視覺輔助教具。

examples.en: Effective visual aids support your speech without cluttering the screen with excess text.
examples.zh: 真正高明的視覺輔助工具能有力烘托演講主旨，而不會用密密麻麻的文字塞爆畫面。

entries.definition: 視覺輔助工具（圖表、實物）

explains.en: A picture, chart, or model helps people understand a talk. A teacher may show one during a lesson.
Speakers use images to make information easier to follow. Keep the screen clear and simple.
A physical object or diagram can support an explanation. It helps the audience see an idea.

examples.en: The colorful pie chart clearly shows the percentage of market share.
examples.zh: 色彩鮮明的圓餅圖清楚呈現了各大品牌的市場佔有率百分比。

examples.en: An intuitive pie chart breaks down monthly household expenses into rent, food, and savings.
examples.zh: 一張一目了然的圓餅圖將家庭每月支出精準拆解為房租、伙食費與定期儲蓄三大塊。

examples.en: The government report included a pie chart depicting the island's energy generation mix.
examples.zh: 能源主管機關的年度報告中附有一張圓餅圖，生動展示了全島當前各類發電結構佔比。

explains.en: This graph uses a circle divided into slices to show how parts make up a whole. Each slice represents a share or percentage. It can show how a family spends money.
A report may use this circular graph to compare different categories. The size of each piece shows its amount. It is useful for seeing proportions.
This type of diagram breaks a total into sections. A large slice means that category forms a bigger share. It can display market or energy information.

examples.en: A bar chart is great for comparing annual output across factories.
examples.zh: 長條圖非常適合用來比較各工廠之間的年度產量差異。

examples.en: The vertical bar chart compares monthly rainfall across six administrative districts.
examples.zh: 這張垂直長條圖精準對比了全市六大行政區在過去一整年當中的各月份降雨量分佈。

examples.en: Color-coded bar charts allow audience members to absorb comparative statistics instantly.
examples.zh: 採用不同顏色標記的長條統計圖，能讓現場聽眾在短短數秒內迅速消化吸收對比數據。

explains.en: It is a graph that uses bars to compare amounts in different groups. Taller bars show larger values. Colors can make categories easy to see.
A graph may use vertical or horizontal rectangles to display data. It helps compare rainfall, sales, or scores. Each bar represents a category.
This visual presents information as bars of different lengths. Readers can quickly compare groups. A chart title and labels explain what the values mean.

examples.en: Gasoline prices fluctuate depending on global crude oil supplies.
examples.zh: 汽油價格隨著全球原油供應狀況而上下波動。

examples.en: Mountain temperatures fluctuate dramatically between sunny noon and chilly midnight.
examples.zh: 高山地區的氣溫在艷陽高照的正午與寒氣逼人的深夜之間，往往呈現極大的劇烈溫差波動。

examples.en: Currency exchange rates fluctuate daily in response to international trade data.
examples.zh: 各國外匯匯率隨著國際經貿數據指標與央行利率決策的公布，每日都在金融市場劇烈起伏。

explains.en: The price of fruit rises and falls as the seasons change. It does not stay at one level.
A mountain can be warm at noon and chilly at night. The temperature varies up and down.
The amount of water in a river changes after rain and during dry weeks. It goes through repeated changes.

examples.en: Prioritize urgent customer support requests before replying to general mail.
examples.zh: 在回覆一般信件前，請先優先處理緊急的客戶支援需求。

examples.en: Working parents must learn how to prioritize family health over non-essential overtime.
examples.zh: 身兼父母重任的在職上班族必須學會取捨，將家人的身心健康排在非必要加班之上。

examples.en: When studying for exams, prioritize understanding foundational concepts before tricky edge cases.
examples.zh: 準備大考時，務必先將核心基礎概念的融會貫通排在最優先，切莫過早鑽研冷僻考題。

entries.definition: 優先處理；排定優先順序

explains.en: Choose which task is most important and do it first. A student may study key ideas before small details.
A busy parent may put family health ahead of extra work. This verb means setting an order of importance.
When many messages arrive, answer the urgent ones before the rest. Decide what matters most and handle it earlier.

examples.en: The final project deliverables include software source code and user manual.
examples.zh: 專案最終的交付成果包含軟體原始碼與使用者操作手冊。

examples.en: All agreed deliverables must undergo thorough quality control before client handover.
examples.zh: 所有在合約中敲定答應的應交付項目，在正式交付客戶驗收前必須通過嚴格的品管審核。

examples.en: The consultant listed key project milestones and expected deliverables in the contract proposal.
examples.zh: 企管顧問在合約企劃書中，鉅細靡遺地羅列了各階段的關鍵里程碑與預期具體產出成果。

explains.en: This is a piece of work or item that a person or team promises to provide for a project. It might be a report or a user guide. A client checks that it is finished.
A contract may list the products a consultant must hand over. Each one is expected by a certain date. Quality checks happen before delivery.
This project term names a result that must be completed and given to someone. It may be software, a document, or a design. Teams track it with milestones.

examples.en: We submitted a weekly progress report detailing newly completed features.
examples.zh: 我們提交了一份每週進度報告，詳列了最新開發完成的系統功能。

examples.en: The general contractor presented a monthly progress report on the skyscraper construction.
examples.zh: 營造統包工程大廠向業主呈遞了一份詳盡的月進度報告，報告摩天大樓當前的施工進展。

examples.en: Keep your progress report concise, highlighting completed goals and upcoming milestones.
examples.zh: 撰寫專案進度報告時務求重點清晰扼要，著重列出已達標的成果與即將攻堅的下階段目標。

explains.en: It is a written update about what work has been completed and what remains. A team may send one each week. It can mention upcoming goals.
A contractor may describe how much of a building is finished. Teachers also use this kind of update for student learning. It should be clear and brief.
This document tells readers whether a project is on schedule. It lists completed tasks and next steps. Managers use it to follow work.

examples.en: The engineer gave a brief 5-minute status update during morning standup.
examples.zh: 工程師在每日早晨站立會議中進行了五分鐘的簡要進度更新。

examples.en: Send me a quick status update via Slack as soon as you speak with the vendor.
examples.zh: 你一旦與外部協力廠商接洽溝通完畢，請第一時間透過 Slack 傳個簡短進度回報給我。

examples.en: Daily status updates ensure every member of the remote engineering team stays aligned.
examples.zh: 維持每日簡明扼要的現況更新，能確保分散各地的跨國軟體工程團隊永遠步調高度一致。

explains.en: A project leader tells the team what has been finished and what remains. This brief report shares current progress.
After speaking with a supplier, send a quick message about what happened. People use these words for a progress report.
At a morning meeting, a worker explains whether a task is on schedule. The team gets the latest information.

examples.en: I will follow up with the client regarding contract revisions tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天會主動與客戶聯繫，跟進合約修改的相關事宜。

examples.en: Doctors always follow up with recovering patients two weeks after hospital discharge.
examples.zh: 病患平安康復出院兩週後，主治醫師團隊均會依例致電病患進行例行的後續復原追蹤。

examples.en: Remember to follow up with an email thanking the interviewer for their time.
examples.zh: 面試結束步出考場後，切記在二十四小時內發送一封致謝信，感謝主考官撥冗面談。

explains.en: After speaking with a customer, contact them again about the next steps. An email can continue the conversation.
A doctor may check on a patient after treatment. This phrase means taking another action later.
Send a thank-you note after a job interview. It is a later step that keeps the matter moving.

examples.en: Schedule a follow-up meeting next Tuesday to evaluate pilot results.
examples.zh: 安排下週二召開後續追蹤會議，以評估試行計畫的成效。

examples.en: Sending a polite follow-up email bumped the delayed invoice back to the top of accounting's inbox.
examples.zh: 寄出一封言辭客氣的後續追蹤跟進郵件，順利讓延宕未付的請款發票重回會計信箱頂端。

examples.en: Routine medical follow-up exams ensure that no surgical complications develop unnoticed.
examples.zh: 術後定期回診進行例行的後續追蹤檢查，能確保任何潛在併發症不會在不知不覺中惡化。

examples.en: Send a prompt follow-up summary email within two hours after the meeting.
examples.zh: 請於會議圓滿結束後的兩小時內迅速發送一封會議紀要與待辦後續追蹤信。

examples.en: The doctor scheduled a follow-up appointment for next Tuesday afternoon.
examples.zh: 醫生為下週二下午安排了一次回診追蹤檢查。

examples.en: I will follow up with the logistics partner regarding the delayed shipment tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天會與物流合作夥伴跟進確認延遲出貨的後續處置情況。

entries.definition: 後續追蹤；後續的；跟進處理；追蹤的

explains.en: This is an action or meeting that happens after an earlier event to check progress or add information. A doctor may schedule another visit. A polite message can ask about a delayed order.
After a meeting, someone may send a summary email. A patient may return to see how healing is going. It continues or checks on what happened before.
Use this term for a later contact, exam, or step connected to an earlier one. A worker may ask a partner about a shipment. It helps make sure nothing is missed.

examples.en: A fast customer feedback loop allows developers to fix bugs rapidly.
examples.zh: 敏捷快速的客戶回饋機制讓開發人員能迅速修復軟體錯誤。

examples.en: Establishing a continuous feedback loop between teachers and students boosts engagement.
examples.zh: 在師生之間建立暢通且持續的良性雙向反饋循環機制，能大幅激發課堂上的互動參與感。

examples.en: Lean startup methodology relies on tight build-measure-learn feedback loops to validate ideas.
examples.zh: 精實創業心法極度強調打造「開發—量測—學習」的高頻閉環回饋機制，藉以驗證商業模式。

explains.en: It is a repeated process where results are shared and used to make improvements. Teachers can hear from students and adjust lessons. Quick responses help.
A team gathers comments, makes a change, and checks the result again. This cycle helps developers fix problems quickly. It can improve a product over time.
When information about an outcome guides the next action, the process repeats. A startup may build, measure, and learn. The cycle supports improvement.

examples.en: Outdated server hardware became a major performance bottleneck.
examples.zh: 老舊的伺服器硬體成為了系統整體效能的主要瓶頸。

examples.en: Road construction narrowed the busy avenue down to a single lane, creating a severe traffic bottleneck.
examples.zh: 道路開挖施工將原本寬闊的主要幹道縮減為單線通車，造成了極其嚴重的交通瓶頸。

examples.en: Senior management approval delays became the primary bottleneck slowing down app deployment.
examples.zh: 高階管理決策層層核決的冗長延宕，成為了嚴重拖垮行動應用程式正式部署上線的首要瓶頸。

explains.en: A narrow road makes cars wait in a long line during rush hour. The narrow part slows all traffic.
An old computer can keep a whole team from finishing work quickly. This obstacle limits the speed of the process.
Only one worker can approve every request, so many tasks wait. This point creates a delay for everything behind it.

examples.en: Event organizers prepared a contingency plan in case of outdoor rain.
examples.zh: 活動主辦單位準備了完善的雨天應變備用計畫。

examples.en: Every nuclear plant operates with a multi-layered emergency contingency plan.
examples.zh: 每一座核能發電廠均配備並定期演練極其嚴密的多層次全方位緊急災害應變計畫。

examples.en: Always maintain a flexible contingency plan when traveling abroad during volatile monsoon seasons.
examples.zh: 在氣候捉摸不定的梅雨與季風季節赴海外自助旅行時，務必隨時備妥一套彈性應變方案。

entries.definition: 應變計畫；備用方案 (Plan B)

explains.en: This backup plan prepares people for a problem that may happen. An outdoor event may need one for rainy weather.
A traveler can decide what to do if a train is canceled. Having another option ready is useful.
A factory may plan how to respond to an emergency. This plan helps people act when the expected plan fails.

examples.en: We streamlined the checkout process to improve online customer conversion.
examples.zh: 我們精簡了結帳付款流程以提升線上顧客的購買轉換率。

examples.en: Upgrading to cloud invoicing helped the company streamline accounting procedures significantly.
examples.zh: 全面導入雲端電子發票開立系統，協助企業顯著精簡了繁複耗時的會計日常沖銷作業。

examples.en: Modern aerodynamic car bodies are shaped to streamline airflow and reduce highway drag.
examples.zh: 當代符合空氣動力學的高鐵與汽車流線型外觀，旨在優化氣流通過並大幅降低風阻。

entries.definition: 精簡；使效率化；簡化流程

explains.en: You do this when you make a process simpler and more efficient. A store may remove extra steps from checkout. A company can make its paperwork easier too.
A business can organize its work so it takes less time and effort. Cloud tools may help with invoices. A smoother process reduces wasted steps.
This verb means to improve a system by removing unnecessary parts. A car's shape can also be designed to move through air more easily. The goal is greater efficiency.

examples.en: Successful policy implementation requires broad community support.
examples.zh: 政策要能成功落實執行，需要獲得社會大眾廣泛的支持。

examples.en: The rapid implementation of online learning platforms kept classrooms running during epidemics.
examples.zh: 迅速落地實行遠距線上教學平台，確保了重大公衛疫情停課期間各級學校依然停課不停學。

examples.en: Thorough staff training is crucial during the implementation phase of new enterprise software.
examples.zh: 在導入全新型企業大型 ERP 軟體的實施階段中，對全體第一線同仁落實扎實教育訓練至關重要。

explains.en: It is the process of putting a plan or policy into action. Staff may need training when a new system begins. Support can help it succeed.
After making a decision, a group carries out the planned steps. A school may introduce online lessons this way. Careful preparation matters.
This noun describes making an idea real through action. A company may install new software across its offices. The process can take time.

examples.en: Our battery life benchmark exceeded that of competing smartphones.
examples.zh: 我們的電池續航力基準測試數據超越了同級競爭的手機品牌。

examples.en: Taiwan's world-class National Health Insurance system is revered as a global public healthcare benchmark.
examples.zh: 台灣首屈一指的健保制度被國際公共衛生領域奉為兼顧普惠與高效率的世界級標竿。

examples.en: Engineers run specialized diagnostic scripts to benchmark processor performance under extreme loads.
examples.zh: 晶片架構工程師運行專業的系統診斷腳本，在高壓滿載情境下對處理器效能進行基準測試。

examples.en: Companies compare their water and energy efficiency against world-class sustainability benchmarks.
examples.zh: 企業定期將自身的工廠製程用水回收率與節能表現，與全球同業最高標準的頂尖永續標竿（Benchmark）進行比對。

examples.en: The new graphics card shattered every standard gaming performance benchmark in lab tests.
examples.zh: 這款旗艦級次世代電競獨立顯示卡，在專業媒體實驗室跑分評測中徹底粉碎打破了所有既定遊戲效能基準標竿。

examples.en: School districts use standardized reading comprehension exams to benchmark student progress annually.
examples.zh: 教育局每年定期實施標準化國語文閱讀理解成就評量測驗，藉此客觀衡量評估各學區學子的學習成就進步幅度。

entries.definition: 基準；標竿；進行基準測試；全球同業減碳標竿標準

explains.en: A school compares this year’s reading scores with last year’s to see how students are doing. It gives a point of comparison.
A phone maker tests how quickly its new model runs tasks and compares it with other phones. The test helps measure performance.
A team sets a standard result to compare future progress against. The standard helps show whether something has improved.

examples.en: Artificial intelligence revolutionizes medical diagnosis and automated translation.
examples.zh: 人工智慧徹底革新了醫療診斷與自動翻譯領域。

examples.en: Ethical guidelines are needed to govern the rapid development of artificial intelligence.
examples.zh: 需要制定道德倫理準則以規範人工智慧的快速發展。

examples.en: Many software applications now integrate generative artificial intelligence features.
examples.zh: 許多應用軟體現在都整合了生成式人工智慧的功能。

explains.en: Computer systems can learn patterns and perform tasks that usually need human thinking. Some can translate or recognize pictures.
A phone may use this technology to answer questions or sort photos. People are discussing how to guide its development.
This field teaches computers to do tasks such as understanding language. Many apps now include tools built this way.

examples.en: Machine learning models predict traffic congestion patterns accurately.
examples.zh: 機器學習模型能精準預測道路交通壅塞模式。

examples.en: She is taking an online course to understand the fundamentals of machine learning.
examples.zh: 她正在修習線上課程以理解機器學習的基本原理。

examples.en: Financial institutions rely on machine learning to detect credit card fraud.
examples.zh: 金融機構依賴機器學習來偵測信用卡詐騙交易。

explains.en: This is a way for computer programs to find patterns in information and improve at a task. It can help predict traffic or spot fraud. The program learns from examples.
A computer can study many examples and use them to make a guess or decision. Banks may use this method to notice unusual spending. It is part of artificial intelligence.
This field teaches computers to recognize patterns from data. An online course may explain its basic ideas. The results can help with predictions and problem solving.

examples.en: Social media feeds use sorting algorithms to recommend relevant video content.
examples.zh: 社群動態牆運用排序演算法向用戶推薦相關影片內容。

examples.en: The search engine updated its core algorithm to filter out low-quality websites.
examples.zh: 該搜尋引擎更新了核心演算法以過濾低品質網站。

examples.en: Engineers are developing a faster algorithm to process large datasets.
examples.zh: 工程師正在開發更快速的演算法來處理龐大的資料集。

examples.en: Understanding how the platform algorithm works helps boost video impressions.
examples.zh: 深入了解平台演算法推薦機制有助於大幅提升影片曝光觸及率。

examples.en: Streaming services recommend songs using collaborative filtering algorithms.
examples.zh: 音樂串流服務透過協同過濾演算法向聽眾精準推薦喜愛的曲目。

examples.en: Tech companies continuously tweak search algorithms to fight disinformation.
examples.zh: 科技公司持續微調優化搜尋演算法以積極打擊不實假訊息傳播。

entries.definition: 演算法；運算法則；推薦推薦機制

explains.en: It is a set of ordered steps a computer follows to solve a problem. Search engines use such rules to sort results. Some suggest videos to watch.
A programmer can design instructions for processing information. The steps may help find a route or organize data. Faster methods can save time.
This procedure tells a machine how to perform a task. It can sort a list or identify patterns. Social media platforms use it to choose what appears in a feed.

examples.en: App developers gathered at the annual international hackathon competition.
examples.zh: 應用程式開發者齊聚於一年一度的國際黑客松競賽。

examples.en: The senior developer spent the afternoon reviewing code written by interns.
examples.zh: 資深軟體開發工程師花了一整個下午審查實習生編寫的程式碼。

examples.en: A local property developer plans to build a new shopping complex downtown.
examples.zh: 當地一家不動產建商計劃在市中心興建一座新的購物商場。

examples.en: Property developers are investing in green smart homes near science parks.
examples.zh: 房產建商正積極在科學園區周邊投資興建綠能智慧宅。

examples.en: A leading software developer resolved the critical security bug within an hour.
examples.zh: 一位資深頂尖軟體開發工程師在短短一小時內就修復了重大的資安漏洞。

examples.en: Environmental activists protested against private developers building luxury resorts on wetlands.
examples.zh: 環保倡議團體走上街頭，強烈抗議民間開發商在珍貴濕地上興建奢華度假村。

entries.definition: 軟體開發者；程式設計師；建商；房地產建商；土地開發商

explains.en: A programmer writes and improves apps or websites. This person may also fix problems in the code.
A company that builds homes or shopping centers plans how land will be used. The business has this name too.
One kind creates computer programs; another plans new buildings and neighborhoods. Both turn plans into finished projects.

examples.en: Python is one of the most popular programming languages for beginners.
examples.zh: Python 是最受初學者歡迎的熱門程式設計語言之一。

examples.en: Logical thinking skills can be greatly sharpened through computer programming.
examples.zh: 透過電腦程式設計能大幅鍛鍊邏輯思考能力。

examples.en: The museum organized a weekend programming workshop for teenagers.
examples.zh: 博物館為青少年舉辦了一場週末程式設計工作坊。

explains.en: Write instructions that tell a computer what to do. Beginners often learn with Python.
People create software by using a computer language. This work can help develop games or websites.
A person who makes a program plans steps and enters commands. Logical thinking is useful for this activity.

examples.en: Store your study notes on cloud storage so you can access them anywhere.
examples.zh: 將你的讀書筆記存放在雲端硬碟，方便隨時隨地查閱。

examples.en: Many cloud storage providers offer free limited space for basic users.
examples.zh: 許多雲端儲存服務商為一般用戶提供免費的有限空間。

examples.en: Automated synchronization with cloud storage prevents accidental data loss.
examples.zh: 與雲端儲存自動同步能防止檔案因意外而遺失。

explains.en: This is a way to keep digital files on internet-connected computers so you can reach them from different devices. Study notes can be saved there. Copies can help prevent loss.
A person can save photos or documents online instead of only on one computer. Many providers offer a small amount of space for free. Files can sync automatically.
This online service keeps files on remote computers. You can open them from many places when connected to the internet. It can protect against losing data on one device.

examples.en: Cloud computing allows enterprises to scale computing power dynamically.
examples.zh: 雲端運算使企業能夠動態擴展靈活強大的運算效能。

examples.en: The rise of cloud computing has transformed traditional corporate IT infrastructure.
examples.zh: 雲端運算的興起翻轉了傳統企業的資訊科技基礎架構。

examples.en: Cost reduction and flexibility are major incentives for adopting cloud computing.
examples.zh: 降低成本與彈性是企業導入雲端運算的主要誘因。

explains.en: It is a way to use computer storage and processing over the internet. A business can increase capacity when needed. Files can be reached from different devices.
Instead of keeping everything on one local computer, people use online servers. This approach can help companies scale their services. It requires a network connection.
Online services can provide software, storage, and computing power. Organizations may pay for the amount they need. It has changed how many companies manage technology.

examples.en: Financial institutions invest heavily in advanced cybersecurity systems.
examples.zh: 金融機構投入巨資建構先進嚴密的網路資安防護系統。

examples.en: The seminar emphasized the importance of individual cybersecurity awareness.
examples.zh: 該講座強調了培養個人網路資安防範意識的重要性。

examples.en: A major cybersecurity breach forced the company to reset all passwords.
examples.zh: 一起重大資安外洩事件迫使該公司重設所有密碼。

examples.en: Robust corporate cybersecurity protects sensitive user databases against attacks.
examples.zh: 健全強大的企業網路資安能保護敏感的使用者資料庫免受網路攻擊。

examples.en: The university offers professional certificate programs in cloud cybersecurity.
examples.zh: 這所大學提供雲端網路資訊安全方面的專業證照培訓課程。

examples.en: Investing in cybersecurity is essential for any modern digital enterprise.
examples.zh: 對任何現代數位企業而言，投資於網路資訊安全都是不可或缺的。

entries.definition: 網路資訊安全；資安；網路資安；資訊安全

explains.en: A company protects its computers and private information from online attacks. Workers use strong passwords and safety tools.
A bank guards customer accounts against thieves who use the internet. Staff learn how to spot suspicious messages.
Keeping computers, networks, and data safe from digital harm is important. Experts help block intruders and protect information.

examples.en: The IT team installed patches to block dangerous malware infections.
examples.zh: 資訊部門安裝了安全修補程式以阻擋危險惡意軟體的感染。

examples.en: Downloading pirated software often introduces spyware and malware onto your PC.
examples.zh: 下載盜版軟體常會將間諜軟體與惡意軟體引入個人電腦。

examples.en: Modern antivirus solutions detect malware by analyzing anomalous file behaviors.
examples.zh: 現代防毒軟體透過分析異常檔案行為來偵測惡意軟體。

examples.en: Never download attachments from unknown senders to prevent malware infection.
examples.zh: 切勿隨意下載開啟來路不明寄件者的信件附件，以防感染惡意軟體。

examples.en: The IT department scanned the workstation and removed several strains of malware.
examples.zh: 資訊部門掃描了該工作站並清除了數種惡意軟體。

examples.en: Ad-blocking extensions can help reduce the risk of downloading malware.
examples.zh: 廣告攔截擴充功能有助於降低下載到惡意軟體的風險。

examples.en: The hospital's electronic health databases were locked overnight by aggressive ransomware malware.
examples.zh: 醫院的電子病歷資料庫在一夜之間慘遭強烈勒索病毒惡意軟體全面綁架加密。

examples.en: Endpoint detection tools isolated the infected laptop before the stealthy malware could traverse the network.
examples.zh: 終端資安偵測防護系統在數秒內精準隔離染疫筆記型電腦，成功防堵隱密惡意程式橫向擴散至內網。

examples.en: Cybercriminals continually rewrite malware source code to evade detection by traditional antivirus scanners.
examples.zh: 跨國黑客組織不斷動態重構惡意程式底層原始碼與特徵碼，以規避傳統防毒軟體的靜態特徵碼比對。

entries.definition: 惡意軟體；有害程式；勒索病毒惡意程式勒索加密

explains.en: This harmful computer program can damage files or steal private information. Do not open unknown attachments.
A security team may scan a laptop to find dangerous software. Some kinds lock files and demand money.
Downloading an unsafe file can put harmful code on a computer. Protection tools can help detect it.

examples.en: Ransomware attacks lock files until the victim pays a crypto ransom.
examples.zh: 勒索軟體攻擊會鎖死檔案，直到受害者支付加密貨幣贖金。

examples.en: Hospitals are frequent targets of ransomware extortion schemes.
examples.zh: 醫院常成為勒索軟體勒索企圖的目標攻擊對象。

examples.en: Maintaining offline backup copies is the most reliable defense against ransomware.
examples.zh: 保存離線備份副本是抵禦勒索軟體最可靠的防線。

examples.en: The hospital's patient files were encrypted by malicious ransomware extortionists.
examples.zh: 該醫院的病患電子病歷資料遭到惡意勒索軟體集團全面加密勒索贖金。

examples.en: The company refused to pay the ransom and restored data from offline backups.
examples.zh: 該公司拒絕支付贖金，並從離線備份中還原了所有資料。

examples.en: Ransomware attacks have increased dramatically against municipal utilities.
examples.zh: 針對市政公用事業的勒索軟體攻擊近年來大幅增加。

explains.en: This is harmful software that locks a computer's files and demands money to unlock them. Hospitals and businesses can be targets. Offline copies can help restore lost files.
A computer may be unable to open its documents after this kind of attack. Criminals ask the owner to pay. Keeping safe backup copies is an important defense.
This malicious program blocks access to files, often by scrambling them. The attacker demands payment to restore access. Organizations protect themselves with backups and security tools.

examples.en: Beware of fake phishing text messages claiming your parcel is delayed.
examples.zh: 當心假借包裹配送延誤為由的假冒釣魚簡訊詐騙。

examples.en: The company conducts regular phishing simulation drills for its employees.
examples.zh: 公司為員工定期舉辦釣魚郵件模擬演練。

examples.en: Phishing websites imitate banking portals to steal login credentials.
examples.zh: 釣魚網站模仿銀行登入入口以竊取使用者的帳密憑證。

examples.en: Beware of phishing emails pretending to be official postal delivery notices.
examples.zh: 嚴加提防假冒郵局包裹郵遞通知名義寄發的惡意網路釣魚詐騙信件。

examples.en: Employees participated in simulated phishing drills to improve vigilance.
examples.zh: 員工們參加了模擬釣魚演練，以提高資安警覺性。

examples.en: He accidentally entered his credentials on a convincing phishing website.
examples.zh: 他不小心在一個外觀極為逼真的釣魚網站上輸入了自己的帳號密碼。

examples.en: Spear-phishing emails containing malicious invoice attachments fooled accounting staff into leaking passwords.
examples.zh: 夾帶惡意發票附檔的魚叉式網路釣魚信件，誘騙會計人員點擊並洩漏公司管理員帳密。

examples.en: Regular employee awareness training teaches staff to spot disguised URLs used in deceptive phishing schemes.
examples.zh: 企業定期舉辦的全員資安防詐演練，教導員工如何精準辨識偽冒銀行或主管名義發出的釣魚郵件連結。

examples.en: Multi-factor authentication blocks unauthorized logins even when users fall for sophisticated phishing traps.
examples.zh: 全面強制導入雙因子多重驗證機制，即便員工不慎誤入精心偽裝的釣魚陷阱，駭客依然無法登入系統。

entries.definition: 網路釣魚；釣魚詐騙；網路釣魚詐騙；釣魚信件；魚叉式網路釣魚詐騙帳密攻擊

explains.en: It is an online scam that tricks people into sharing passwords or bank details. Fake messages may claim a parcel is delayed. Check links before opening them.
A criminal may copy a bank website to steal login information. Companies train workers to spot suspicious emails. Never share a code with an unknown sender.
This kind of fraud uses messages or websites that look real. The goal is to take private information. Be cautious of urgent requests for account details.

examples.en: A robust enterprise firewall filters unauthorized network traffic.
examples.zh: 堅固的企業級防火牆能有效過濾未經授權的網路流量。

examples.en: Make sure your personal firewall is turned on whenever connecting to public Wi-Fi.
examples.zh: 連線至公共 Wi-Fi 時，請確保個人防火牆已開啟。

examples.en: The network engineer adjusted the firewall rules to allow remote access.
examples.zh: 網路工程師調整了防火牆規則以允許遠端連線訪問。

examples.en: The corporate network firewall blocks suspicious inbound traffic automatically.
examples.zh: 企業內部網路防火牆會主動攔截並封鎖所有可疑的外來連線傳輸流量。

examples.en: You need to configure the firewall settings to allow this database connection.
examples.zh: 你需要配置防火牆設定以允許此資料庫連線。

examples.en: Both hardware firewalls and software firewalls provide layered security.
examples.zh: 硬體防火牆與軟體防火牆相結合能提供多層次的安全防護。

explains.en: A computer safety tool blocks unwanted connections from entering a network. It can help protect private files.
At home, this protection feature can warn about strange internet traffic. A network worker may adjust its rules.
It may be a wall that slows a real fire, or software that guards a computer network. Both keep danger from spreading.

examples.en: Messaging apps encrypt user chats end-to-end for privacy.
examples.zh: 通訊軟體對使用者的通話聊天進行端對端加密以保護隱私。

examples.en: You should encrypt confidential business contracts before emailing them.
examples.zh: 在透過電子郵件寄出機密商業合約前應先進行加密。

examples.en: The device uses advanced algorithms to encrypt stored biometric data.
examples.zh: 該裝置採用先進演算法對儲存的生物特徵數據進行加密。

examples.en: Messaging apps encrypt all text messages and voice calls automatically.
examples.zh: 即時通訊軟體會自動將用戶所有的文字訊息與語音通話進行加密處理。

examples.en: Make sure to encrypt external hard drives containing client records.
examples.zh: 請務必將包含客戶記錄的外接硬碟進行加密處理。

examples.en: This web tool allows users to encrypt confidential PDF documents with passwords.
examples.zh: 這個線上工具讓使用者能以密碼對機密 PDF 文件進行加密。

explains.en: Change a message into a secret code so only the right person can read it. This protects private chats.
A person can use a password to protect a document. The computer changes its contents into coded information.
Before sending a private file, use a tool to hide its meaning from strangers. Only someone with the key can read it.

examples.en: SSL encryption secures credit card numbers during online transactions.
examples.zh: SSL 加密技術確保了線上刷卡交易時信用卡號的安全。

examples.en: Without proper decryption keys, the strongest encryption cannot be broken.
examples.zh: 若沒有正確的解密金鑰，最強的加密演算法也無法被破解。

examples.en: Privacy advocates support default encryption on personal electronic devices.
examples.zh: 隱私倡導者支持在個人電子設備上預設啟用加密功能。

examples.en: Strong 256-bit AES encryption keeps your online banking payments safe.
examples.zh: 強大的 256 位元 AES 資料加密技術能確保您的網路銀行交易萬無一失。

examples.en: Cloud storage providers use encryption to protect files stored on remote servers.
examples.zh: 雲端儲存服務商使用加密技術保護儲存在遠端伺服器上的檔案。

examples.en: Without proper encryption, confidential messages could be intercepted easily.
examples.zh: 若沒有適當的加密，機密訊息很容易被第三方攔截竊聽。

examples.en: End-to-end 256-bit AES data encryption safeguards confidential banking passwords and card tokens.
examples.zh: 採用銀行最高規格的 AES 256 位元端對端高強度資料加密技術，能滴水不漏守護用戶帳密與代碼化憑證。

examples.en: Modern messaging apps employ public-key encryption so only the intended recipient can read the chat.
examples.zh: 當代私密通訊軟體採用非對稱非對稱公私鑰加密演算，確保只有通話對象雙方的裝置能夠解密閱讀訊息。

examples.en: If an employee loses a company laptop, whole-disk hardware encryption blocks unauthorized access to client files.
examples.zh: 即便員工在出差途中不慎遺失公司商務筆電，全硬碟硬體加密技術亦能嚴密阻絕不肖人士竊取客戶機密。

examples.en: Breaking the multi-layered database encryption required months of high-performance cluster computing.
examples.zh: 破解犯罪集團多層結構的高強度資料庫加密，耗費了超級電腦叢集數月的運算解密。

examples.en: Modern end-to-end messaging encryption presents severe technical hurdles for lawful police surveillance.
examples.zh: 當代通訊軟體普遍採用的端對端高強度加密協議，為司法機關執行合法的刑事偵查帶來了巨大科技屏障。

examples.en: Ransomware operators use military-grade AES-256 encryption algorithms to lock corporate server files.
examples.zh: 跨國勒索軟體黑客組織採用軍規等級的 AES-256 對稱加密演算法，鎖定並癱瘓跨國企業的伺服器檔案。

examples.en: Tech giants are rolling out Kyber post-quantum encryption to secure web browsing sessions worldwide.
examples.zh: 全球高科技巨頭正全面導入 Kyber 後量子加密標準，為全球數十億網民連線提供安全防護。

examples.en: Implementing forward secrecy encryption stops adversaries from hoarding encrypted traffic for future quantum decryption.
examples.zh: 導入前向保密加密機制，能徹底粉碎敵對勢力企圖「先攔截封存、待未來量子電腦解密」的險惡圖謀。

examples.en: NIST officially standardized primary post-quantum encryption schemes to safeguard global communications.
examples.zh: 美國國家標準暨技術研究院（NIST）正式公告後量子加密主要標準規範，全面保衛全球通訊安全。

entries.definition: 加密；密碼化技術；資料加密；密碼技術；銀行級高規格資料加密；端對端加密通訊軟體對話紀錄破譯；NIST 後量子加密標準 (ML-KEM / Kyber)

explains.en: This is a way to change information into a secret form so others cannot easily read it. A key is needed to turn it back. It helps protect messages and bank details.
A computer can scramble a file before sending it online. The intended reader uses a special key to understand it. This keeps private information safer.
This security method hides data from people who should not see it. Messaging apps may use it to protect conversations. Without the right key, the text is unreadable.

examples.en: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) on your bank account for safety.
examples.zh: 為您的銀行帳戶啟用雙重身分驗證（2FA）以確保資金安全。

examples.en: Two-factor authentication requires both your password and a verification code.
examples.zh: 雙重身分驗證需要輸入密碼以及手機驗證碼。

examples.en: Adding two-factor authentication drastically reduces the chance of account takeover.
examples.zh: 加入雙重身分驗證能大幅降低帳號遭盜用的機率。

examples.en: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) on your Google and social accounts.
examples.zh: 請務必為您的 Google 信箱與各大社群平台帳號開啟雙重認證（2FA）。

examples.en: When logging in with two-factor authentication, you will receive a code on your phone.
examples.zh: 使用雙重認證登入時，您會在手機上收到一組驗證碼。

examples.en: The IT department made two-factor authentication mandatory for all remote workers.
examples.zh: 資訊部門強制要求所有遠端辦公的員工必須啟用雙重認證。

entries.definition: 雙重身分驗證 (2FA)；雙重認證 (2FA)

explains.en: It is a security step that asks for two different proofs of identity. A password and a phone code are common examples. It makes account theft harder.
When signing in, a person may enter a password and then confirm with a code. The extra check protects a bank account. Keep verification codes private.
This account protection combines something you know with another proof, such as a device. A stolen password alone may not be enough. Many services offer it in settings.

examples.en: Modern border control gates use biometric passport scanning technology.
examples.zh: 現代化機場自動通關閘道採用生物辨識護照掃描技術。

examples.en: Biometric authentication methods include fingerprint scanners and iris recognition.
examples.zh: 生物特徵辨識方式包括指紋掃描機與虹膜識別。

examples.en: High-security facilities rely on biometric access control to prevent intrusion.
examples.zh: 高規格安全機構仰賴生物特徵門禁管制以防止未經授權闖入。

examples.en: Modern smartphones use biometric facial and fingerprint sensors for quick unlocking.
examples.zh: 現代智慧型手機採用生物辨識臉部辨識與指紋感測器實現秒速安全解鎖。

examples.en: The research lab requires biometric palm scans to gain entry.
examples.zh: 該研究實驗室需要進行手掌生物辨識掃描才能進入。

examples.en: Privacy advocates raised concerns regarding how biometric data is stored.
examples.zh: 隱私倡導人士對生物特徵資料的儲存方式提出了關切。

examples.en: Biometric facial recognition authenticates high-value wire transfers securely without passwords.
examples.zh: 透過高安全度的 3D 生物特徵人臉辨識掃描進行轉帳授權，無需死記複雜密碼即可安全完成大額匯款。

examples.en: Border control e-gates utilize biometric iris scanning to process international passengers in ten seconds.
examples.zh: 國際機場出境自動查驗通關閘門運用尖端生物特徵虹膜辨識技術，能在短短十秒內快速通關完成驗證。

examples.en: Storing biometric fingerprint templates locally on secure hardware chips prevents cloud data leaks.
examples.zh: 將使用者的指紋特徵加密資料嚴密儲存於手機硬體獨立安全晶片中，能徹底杜絕雲端資料遭駭客竊取的風險。

examples.en: Touch ID fingerprint biometric sensors unlock financial apps in a fraction of a second.
examples.zh: 輕觸指紋辨識感測器（Touch ID），不到零點一秒即可安全解鎖並秒速登入個人網路銀行。

examples.en: Law enforcement agencies cross-reference biometric facial imaging to identify suspects captured on street cameras.
examples.zh: 刑事司法偵查機關透過高解析度生物特徵人臉比對演算技術，在海量路口監視器中秒速比對查明嫌疑犯。

examples.en: High-security data centers require both biometric palm-vein scans and badge credentials for server room entry.
examples.zh: 國家最高安全等級的雲端超算中心，規定工程師進入核心機房必須同時通過手掌靜脈生物辨識與實體門禁卡。

entries.definition: 生物辨識的；生物特徵的；生物特徵辨識的；生物特徵辨識驗證的 (人臉/指紋)；指紋與人臉等生物特徵的

explains.en: A phone may recognize a person by the pattern on a fingertip. This kind of check uses a body feature to confirm identity.
Some doors open after a camera matches a person’s face. The system checks a physical trait.
A fingerprint, face, or eye pattern can help prove who someone is. This technology uses personal body measurements.

examples.en: Unlock your smartphone swiftly using instant fingerprint recognition.
examples.zh: 使用秒速指紋辨識功能快速將智慧型手機解鎖。

examples.en: Fingerprint recognition sensors are often embedded beneath the smartphone screen.
examples.zh: 指紋辨識感測器通常嵌入於智慧型手機螢幕下方。

examples.en: Wet fingers can sometimes hinder the accuracy of fingerprint recognition.
examples.zh: 手指潮濕有時會影響指紋辨識的精準度。

explains.en: A phone can check the unique lines on a person's finger to unlock. This method identifies who is using it.
Some sensors read a fingertip when someone touches the screen. Wet fingers may make the check less accurate.
This security method compares a finger's pattern with saved information. It can let the owner open a device quickly.

examples.en: Facial recognition allows hands-free payment and building access.
examples.zh: 人臉辨識技術實現了免動手刷臉支付與大樓門禁進出。

examples.en: Some cities test facial recognition cameras in train stations for public safety.
examples.zh: 部分城市在火車站測試人臉辨識監視器以維護公共安全。

examples.en: Privacy critics voice concerns over mass surveillance via facial recognition.
examples.zh: 隱私倡導團體對透過人臉辨識進行大規模監控表示擔憂。

examples.en: Travelers clear automated e-Gates in seconds using biometric facial recognition.
examples.zh: 旅客在桃園國際機場出入境時只需透過生物特徵人臉辨識即可數秒快速通關。

examples.en: Smartphone users unlock their devices conveniently in the dark using 3D facial recognition sensors.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機用戶即便身處完全漆黑的臥室中，亦能透過 3D 結構光人臉辨識感測器秒速解鎖隨身手機螢幕。

examples.en: Privacy advocates express concerns that unregulated facial recognition technology could be abused for mass tracking.
examples.zh: 個資隱私權倡議團體提出嚴正關切，憂心若缺乏完善法律規制，人臉辨識演算法恐有遭濫用於大規模社會監控之虞。

entries.definition: 人臉辨識；面部識別；人臉辨識技術

explains.en: This technology identifies a person by looking at the shape and features of their face. A phone may use it to unlock. Some airports use it to check travelers.
A camera compares someone's face with saved information to confirm who they are. It can make entry faster. People also raise privacy concerns about its use.
This computer method checks a face to identify or verify a person. It may allow hands-free payment or building access. Rules can limit how cameras use the information.

examples.en: Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS are mainstream operating systems.
examples.zh: Windows、macOS、Android 與 iOS 是主流作業系統。

examples.en: An operating system manages computer hardware and executes user software programs.
examples.zh: 作業系統負責管理電腦硬體資源並執行使用者應用程式。

examples.en: Linux is the preferred operating system for web servers worldwide.
examples.zh: Linux 是全球網路伺服器最普遍偏好採用的作業系統。

explains.en: It is the main software that manages a computer's hardware and runs its apps. Windows, Android, and Linux are examples. A device needs it to work.
This software helps programs communicate with a computer's parts. It manages files, memory, and user commands. Phones and laptops each have one.
A computer's core software controls how other programs run. Different devices use different kinds. Some servers rely on Linux.

examples.en: The newly redesigned user interface is intuitive and clean.
examples.zh: 重新改版設計的使用者介面十分直覺且乾淨俐落。

examples.en: Programmers interact with cloud services using an application programming interface (API).
examples.zh: 程式設計師透過應用程式介面（API）與雲端服務進行互動溝通。

examples.en: The audio interface connects professional microphones directly to a laptop.
examples.zh: 這款音訊介面（錄音卡）可將專業麥克風直接連接至筆記型電腦。

examples.en: Plug professional XLR microphones into a multi-channel USB audio interface.
examples.zh: 將專業 XLR 錄音麥克風直接接入多軌 USB 錄音介面以確保最佳無損音質。

examples.en: The software features an intuitive user interface that is easy for beginners to navigate.
examples.zh: 這款軟體擁有直覺好用的人機介面，初學者也能輕鬆上手操作。

examples.en: You need an audio interface to convert analog sound signals into digital data.
examples.zh: 你需要一台錄音介面，將類比聲音訊號轉換為電腦可識別的數位音訊資料。

examples.en: A minimalist, uncluttered user interface makes managing stock investments intuitive and stress-free.
examples.zh: 乾淨清爽、視覺無負擔的極簡手機 App 操作介面，讓查看即時股市行情與買賣下單變得無比直覺輕鬆。

examples.en: The software engineer built an API interface connecting internal databases with third-party payment gateways.
examples.zh: 資深軟體工程師搭建起高強度的 API 連接介面，無縫串聯內部會員核心資料庫與國際第三方金流閘道。

examples.en: Oil and water form a distinct boundary interface because the two liquids do not mix together.
examples.zh: 在化學物理實驗中，純水與沙拉油在燒杯中會形成清晰可辨的接觸交界面，因為兩者互不相溶。

examples.en: The USB-C audio interface features studio-grade analog preamps that convert voices into 24-bit pristine digital audio.
examples.zh: 專業 USB-C 錄音介面搭載錄音室等級前級放大器，將溫暖人聲轉為二十四位元純淨數位音訊。

examples.en: The user interface of the mobile banking app was redesigned to make money transfers faster and simpler.
examples.zh: 行動網路銀行應用程式的操作介面經過全面改版重塑，讓日常跨行轉帳變得更快速直覺。

examples.en: Connecting your electric guitar into the audio interface lets you utilize realistic digital amplifier simulations.
examples.zh: 將電吉他導線直接插上專業錄音介面高阻抗插孔，即可隨心所欲暢玩各種逼真的數位音箱模擬音色。

examples.en: Non-invasive neural brain-computer interfaces let paralyzed individuals manipulate spatial windows mentally.
examples.zh: 非侵入式「神經人機介面」（Interface），讓行動不便者能直接透過意念流暢操控三維空間視窗。

examples.en: Designers revamped the mobile banking interface to ensure intuitive navigation for elderly customers.
examples.zh: 設計師徹底重新規劃了行動網銀的使用者介面，確保長者也能直覺順暢地操作。

examples.en: The payment gateway must interface securely with multiple domestic bank clearing networks.
examples.zh: 該金流閘道系統必須與多家本國銀行的清算網路進行安全無虞的介面串接。

entries.definition: 介面；操作介面 (UI)；連接埠；錄音介面；音效卡；使用者介面；手機操作軟體介面 (UI)；專業 USB-C 錄音介面錄音卡；非侵入式神經腦機介面 (意念直接操控)

explains.en: Buttons and menus on a phone let a person use its apps. These parts form the user’s way to interact with the device.
A cable or sound card can connect a microphone to a computer. The word can name a joining point between two systems.
A clear screen layout helps people find settings and complete tasks. In technology, the same word can mean a connection between devices.

examples.en: Optimizing app load speed greatly enhances user experience.
examples.zh: 優化應用程式的載入開啟速度能大幅提升使用者體驗。

examples.en: Designers conduct in-depth interviews to understand the customer user experience.
examples.zh: 設計師進行深度訪談以了解消費者的實際使用者體驗。

examples.en: Confusing navigation buttons create a frustrating user experience for shoppers.
examples.zh: 令人困惑的導覽按鈕會給購物顧客帶來挫折的使用者體驗。

explains.en: This describes how someone feels while using an app or website. Fast loading can make it better.
