Designers ask people questions to learn whether a product is easy to use. Clear buttons help shoppers find things.
Confusing menus can frustrate people who use a service. This term names the whole feeling and ease of using it.

examples.en: Streaming 4K movies requires sufficient internet network bandwidth.
examples.zh: 串流播放 4K 高畫質電影需要充裕順暢的網路頻寬。

examples.en: The internet service provider throttled our bandwidth during peak evening hours.
examples.zh: 網路服務業者在晚間尖峰時段限制了我們的頻寬速率。

examples.en: I don't have enough mental bandwidth to take on another project this week.
examples.zh: 我這週實在沒有多餘的心力負荷再去接下另一項專案。

examples.en: Direct-to-cell satellite connectivity delivers emergency SMS bandwidth during natural earthquake disasters.
examples.zh: 衛星直連手機（Direct-to-Cell）前沿通訊技術，能在強烈地震基地台全毀時提供緊急簡訊頻寬。

examples.en: Streaming 4K video requires substantial internet bandwidth to prevent buffering and lag.
examples.zh: 串流播放 4K 高畫質影片需要充裕的網路頻寬，以避免畫面停頓與卡頓延遲。

examples.en: The telecom provider upgraded optical cables to expand broadband bandwidth for tech park enterprises.
examples.zh: 電信營運商升級了光纖骨幹網路，以擴充科學園區各企業所需的高速頻寬。

entries.definition: 頻寬；網路速度；個人心力負荷；衛星網路傳輸頻寬

explains.en: This measures how much information an internet connection can carry in a certain time. More of it can help a movie play without pauses. The word can also mean someone's mental capacity for more work.
A network needs enough of this to stream a high-quality film smoothly. A person may also say they lack it when they have too many tasks. Context shows which meaning fits.
This term describes a connection's ability to move data. A provider may increase it to serve more users. Informally, it can describe how much attention or energy someone has.

examples.en: Taiwan boasts one of the world's most accessible fiber broadband networks.
examples.zh: 台灣擁有全球普及率最高的光纖寬頻上網環境之一。

examples.en: Fast broadband connectivity is essential for families working and studying from home.
examples.zh: 高速寬頻連線對於在家工作與學習的家庭而言至關重要。

examples.en: The telecom company rolled out affordable broadband packages for students.
examples.zh: 電信公司針對學生族群推出了實惠經濟的寬頻專案。

examples.en: Gigabit fiber optic broadband delivers blazing-fast 4K video downloads.
examples.zh: Gb 級極速光纖寬頻網路為全家提供順暢無比的 4K 超高畫質影音即時下載體驗。

examples.en: Government subsidies helped extend high-speed broadband wireless access to remote mountain villages.
examples.zh: 政府偏鄉專案數位通訊補助款的大力挹注，成功將高速光纖寬頻無線網路鋪設延伸至全島最偏僻的高山原鄉部落。

examples.en: Reliable home broadband internet is an absolute necessity for telecommuters working full-time from home.
examples.zh: 穩定且永不斷線的高品質居家寬頻網路，對於全天候在家遠端上班辦公的遠距工作者而言是絕對不可或缺的基本生活必需品。

entries.definition: 寬頻網路；寬頻的；光纖寬頻；高速寬頻網路

explains.en: It is a high-speed internet connection that can carry a lot of data. Families use it for video calls and online lessons. Fiber lines can make it fast.
A home connection of this kind lets several devices go online at once. It supports streaming and work from home. A provider may offer different plans.
This term describes fast internet access. It can use fiber, cable, or other technology. Reliable access is useful for studying and working online.

examples.en: 5G technology offers ultra-fast data speeds and seamless IoT connectivity.
examples.zh: 5G 科技提供了極速傳輸與物聯網無縫連網能力。

examples.en: The remote mountain cabin had poor mobile connectivity.
examples.zh: 那座深山小木屋的手機行動網路連線訊號極差。

examples.en: Bluetooth connectivity allows the earbuds to link with two devices at once.
examples.zh: 藍牙連線功能允許耳機同時配對連結兩台設備。

examples.en: Taiwan's strategic maritime position provides seamless air-sea logistics connectivity across Asia.
examples.zh: 台灣得天獨厚的亞太地理樞紐位置，提供了串聯東北亞與東南亞無縫接軌的海空物流互聯互通優勢。

examples.en: Investing in 5G private networks provides uninterrupted warehouse connectivity for autonomous mobile robots.
examples.zh: 斥資部署高頻寬低延遲的 5G 企業專網，為全天候穿梭作業的立體無人搬運機器人提供零斷線的連網環境。

examples.en: Expanding direct rail freight improved overland logistics connectivity between inland production hubs and seaports.
examples.zh: 開拓專用鐵路貨運班列，大幅升級了內陸重點工業製造基地與沿海萬噸深水良港間的陸運互聯互通。

examples.en: Dense maritime shipping networks maintain unbroken economic connectivity across every continent.
examples.zh: 密集綿密的全球海運航線網絡，維繫著各大洋各大洲之間緊密不可分割的經濟貿易連結。

examples.en: Upgrading regional port infrastructure bolsters trade connectivity among developing island nations.
examples.zh: 全面擴建與升級區域深水商港基礎建設，能顯著帶動開發中海島國家之間的邊境貿易互聯互通。

examples.en: Reliable ocean freight routes provide the physical connectivity that sustains modern globalized industries.
examples.zh: 穩定可靠、風雨無阻的遠洋貨運定期航線，為現代全球化跨國分工體系構築起最強韌的實體貿易連結。

entries.definition: 連網能力；連通性；全球物流互聯互通；連結性；串聯各大洋各大洲之緊密全球貿易連結

explains.en: A phone in a remote cabin has a weak signal and cannot reach the internet reliably. This describes how well devices connect.
Wireless headphones link with a phone so music can play. A stable connection makes them easy to use.
Ports, roads, and networks can link places and people. The word describes the ability or condition of being connected.

examples.en: A brief technical glitch caused the online registration to freeze.
examples.zh: 短暫的技術小故障導致線上報名系統出現畫面卡頓。

examples.en: The development team promptly resolved the audio glitch in the video game.
examples.zh: 開發團隊迅速修復了電子遊戲中的音訊異常小毛病。

examples.en: Aside from a minor software glitch, the launch event ran smoothly.
examples.zh: 除了微小的軟體小毛病外，發表會進行得非常順利。

explains.en: A small problem may briefly stop a website or game from working. A team can fix it.
A short sound problem in a game can be called this. The event usually continues after it is repaired.
During online signup, a technical error may freeze the page. This word describes a small unexpected fault.

examples.en: Developers use specialized testing tools to debug computer code.
examples.zh: 開發人員使用專業的測試工具來為電腦程式碼進行除錯。

examples.en: It took hours of patient debugging to trace the root cause of the memory leak.
examples.zh: 花費了數小時耐心除錯才追查出記憶體洩漏的根本原因。

examples.en: Before shipping new features, engineers thoroughly test and debug every component.
examples.zh: 在交付新功能之前，工程師會徹底測試並為每個模組元件除錯。

explains.en: You do this when you find and fix mistakes in a computer program. Developers test parts of the code to locate the problem. It can take patience.
A software maker may use testing tools to discover why a program fails. After finding the cause, they correct it. This process happens before new features are released.
This verb describes removing errors from computer instructions. Engineers may spend hours tracking down a memory problem. Testing confirms that the fix works.

examples.en: Always make an automated external backup of your important thesis files.
examples.zh: 務必為重要的畢業論文檔案建立自動化的外部硬碟備份。

examples.en: The hospital operates backup generators in case of electrical power failure.
examples.zh: 醫院備有備用發電機以防遭遇電力中斷。

examples.en: If our primary supplier cannot fulfill the order, we have a reliable backup ready.
examples.zh: 若主要供應商無法交貨，我們已準備好了可靠的備用方案。

explains.en: It is an extra copy of important files kept in case the originals are lost. A second supplier can also serve as a reserve. Keep copies in a safe place.
A business may save a duplicate of its records on an external drive. If a computer fails, the files can be restored. The word can also mean extra support.
This noun describes a spare plan, copy, or source of help. Hospitals may keep generators ready for a power cut. A reliable reserve can prevent trouble.

examples.en: Try rebooting your Wi-Fi router to resolve slow internet speeds.
examples.zh: 嘗試將 Wi-Fi 無線路由器重新開機以解決網路連線緩慢問題。

examples.en: The operating system prompt instructed the user to reboot the laptop.
examples.zh: 作業系統畫面提示使用者將筆記型電腦重新開機。

examples.en: A brief walk outside helped reboot his exhausted brain.
examples.zh: 到戶外散個步有助於讓他疲憊的腦袋重新開機。

explains.en: If a router stops working, unplug it and start it again. This may help restore the internet connection.
A computer can be shut down and started again to fix a problem. A short walk can also help a tired mind feel fresh.
When a device freezes, power it off and then start it again. This is a common first step for fixing trouble.

examples.en: The old graphic software is incompatible with the latest operating system.
examples.zh: 這套老舊的繪圖軟體與最新的作業系統版本並不相容。

examples.en: Their differing work styles made them fundamentally incompatible as business partners.
examples.zh: 他們不同的做事風格使他們在商業合作夥伴關係上根本合不來。

examples.en: Incompatible file formats prevented the program from importing the dataset.
examples.zh: 不相容的檔案格式導致程式無法匯入該資料集。

explains.en: Two computer programs may not work together because their formats are different. They do not match.
People with very different habits may find it hard to work as partners. This describes things that do not fit together.
An old program may not run on a new system. The two are unable to work together properly.

examples.en: Keyboards, mice, and webcams are essential computer peripherals.
examples.zh: 鍵盤、滑鼠與網路攝影機是不可或缺的電腦周邊設備。

examples.en: He plugged several external peripherals into the multi-port USB hub.
examples.zh: 他將數個外部周邊配件插上了多功能 USB 集線器。

examples.en: Let us focus on the core argument rather than getting distracted by peripheral issues.
examples.zh: 讓我們聚焦於核心論點，而不要被次要周邊瑣事分散了注意力。

entries.definition: 電腦周邊設備（鍵鼠、螢幕）；周圍的

explains.en: This describes something that is connected to a computer but is not part of its main unit, such as a keyboard or mouse. It can also mean less central or important. Context tells which sense fits.
A webcam or keyboard can be plugged into a computer as an extra device. The word can also describe an issue that is not at the center of a discussion. It means outer or secondary.
Use this adjective for an accessory connected to a computer, or for something on the edge of the main subject. A USB hub may connect several devices. A side issue is less central.

examples.en: Young tech-savvy students adopt new digital tools effortlessly.
examples.zh: 熟悉科技 3C 的年輕學生能毫不費力地快速上手全新數位工具。

examples.en: Companies actively recruit tech-savvy talent to drive automated workflows.
examples.zh: 企業積極招募精通數位科技的人才以推動工作流程自動化。

examples.en: My grandmother became remarkably tech-savvy after receiving an iPad.
examples.zh: 我祖母收到一台 iPad 後變得對 3C 科技產品非常精通。

entries.definition: 精通科技的；熟悉 3C 產品的

explains.en: It describes someone who understands modern devices and software well. A grandparent may learn to use a tablet. Companies value workers with these skills.
A person with this quality can use digital tools confidently. They may learn new apps quickly. It is useful in many jobs.
Use this adjective for someone comfortable with computers and other technology. They can solve common device problems. Students may have this skill too.

examples.en: Traditional industries embrace digital transformation to boost productivity.
examples.zh: 傳統產業積極推動數位轉型以大幅提升營運生產力。

examples.en: Cloud adoption and data analytics are central pillars of corporate digital transformation.
examples.zh: 導入雲端技術與數據分析是企業數位轉型的核心支柱。

examples.en: Successful digital transformation requires cultural change alongside technological upgrades.
examples.zh: 成功的數位轉型除了科技升級之外，更需要組織文化的變革配合。

explains.en: A paper store begins using online orders, electronic records, and data tools. The business changes how it works with technology.
A factory adds connected machines and computer systems to improve its work. Workers may also need to learn new skills.
A company moves services onto digital tools and changes its processes. This can affect the whole organization.

examples.en: Content creators spend hours editing videos to entertain audiences.
examples.zh: 內容創作者花費數小時精心剪輯影片以娛樂觀眾。

examples.en: Becoming a full-time content creator requires persistence and creativity.
examples.zh: 成為全職內容創作者需要極大的堅持與源源不絕的創意。

examples.en: The workshop teaches aspiring content creators how to pitch brand deals.
examples.zh: 這場工作坊教導有抱負的創作者如何洽談品牌商業合作。

explains.en: This person makes videos, pictures, or posts for people to enjoy online. Creativity helps with the work.
A person may plan and edit material for social media. Some earn money through sponsors or viewers.
Someone who shares useful or entertaining material on the internet has this kind of job. It can take many hours.

examples.en: The YouTube channel celebrated reaching one million subscribers.
examples.zh: 該 YouTube 頻道盛大慶祝訂閱人數突破百萬大關。

examples.en: Paid subscribers receive access to exclusive behind-the-scenes footage.
examples.zh: 付費訂閱會員可享有專屬幕後花絮的觀看權限。

examples.en: Magazine subscribers enjoy home delivery every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 該雜誌訂閱戶每週一早晨都能收到專人送府的刊物。

explains.en: This person signs up to receive a service or content regularly. They may pay to watch special videos or have a magazine delivered. A channel may count how many it has.
Someone who chooses to follow a magazine, website, or video channel can be counted this way. Some access is free, while other services require payment. They receive new material regularly.
A person may join a service to get regular access to its content. They could receive a magazine at home or watch extra online videos. They can usually cancel later.

examples.en: Check the YouTube trending tab to discover popular music releases.
examples.zh: 查看 YouTube 發燒影片榜單以探索最新熱門音樂發行。

examples.en: The hashtag related to the solar eclipse became trending worldwide.
examples.zh: 與日食相關的主題標籤迅速登上全球熱門發燒趨勢。

examples.en: Fashion retailers quickly stock up on trending autumn styles.
examples.zh: 快時尚零售商迅速進貨上架最熱門流行的秋季款式。

explains.en: It describes a topic or style that is becoming very popular right now. A hashtag may appear on many posts. Shops may quickly stock popular clothing.
When many people discuss a song or event online, it may be this. The interest can rise quickly and then fade. Check a site's popular topics list.
Use this adjective for something receiving a lot of attention at the present time. Videos or fashion styles can fit. It may spread around the world.

examples.en: The indie band will livestream their acoustic concert tonight.
examples.zh: 這支獨立樂團將於今晚線上直播他們的不插電演唱會。

examples.en: Over ten thousand people tuned in to watch the SpaceX rocket launch livestream.
examples.zh: 超過一萬人上線同步收看了 SpaceX 火箭升空的現場直播。

examples.en: She often livestreams her pottery making sessions on Sunday mornings.
examples.zh: 她經常在週日早晨開直播展示她的陶藝製作過程。

examples.en: The gaming streamer attracted twenty thousand concurrent viewers on his livestream.
examples.zh: 這位人氣遊戲實況主在今晚的實況直播中吸引了超過兩萬名粉絲同時在線觀看。

examples.en: She scheduled a special livestream for Friday night to answer fan questions directly.
examples.zh: 她排定了週五晚上的特別直播，準備親自即時回答粉絲的各種提問。

examples.en: Many musicians performed via livestreams during the pandemic lockdowns.
examples.zh: 許多音樂家在疫情封城期間紛紛透過網路直播舉辦線上音樂會。

entries.definition: 直播；線上直播；實況；網路直播；實況開台；進行直播

explains.en: A musician performs online while viewers watch at the same time. People can send comments during the show.
A gamer shares a live video of a game with people on the internet. The audience watches as it happens.
A pottery artist may show each step of making a bowl through a live online broadcast. Viewers can tune in from home.

examples.en: The popular gaming streamer interacts warmly with fans via live chat.
examples.zh: 這位人氣遊戲實況主透過即時聊天室與粉絲熱情互動。

examples.en: Full-time streamers rely on viewer donations and brand sponsorships.
examples.zh: 全職實況主主要依靠觀眾抖內贊助與品牌贊助為生。

examples.en: Colorful paper streamers decorated the birthday party hall.
examples.zh: 五顏六色的彩帶將生日派對會場裝點得喜氣洋洋。

explains.en: A person broadcasts games or other shows online for viewers. Fans may chat during the show.
A colorful strip of paper can hang as a party decoration. The same word can name someone who shares videos online.
This person talks to an audience through live video on the internet. Some earn money from viewers or sponsors.

examples.en: Fans actively reposted the celebrity's charity appeal on Threads.
examples.zh: 粉絲們在 Threads 上熱心轉發了這位名人的慈善公益呼籲。

examples.en: Please ask for permission before you repost original artwork online.
examples.zh: 在轉發網路上的原創藝術作品前，請先徵得原作者授權。

examples.en: The cooking video received thousands of reposts within an hour.
examples.zh: 這支烹飪教學影片在一小時之內就獲得了數千次轉發分享。

explains.en: You do this when you share someone else's online message or artwork again on your own page. Ask permission before sharing a creator's work. A popular post may be shared many times.
This action sends an existing online item to your followers. Fans may share a charity message to help more people see it. The item can spread quickly.
A person may share a photo, video, or message again on social media. It can also name the shared item itself. Respecting the original creator is important.

examples.en: Use descriptive hashtags like #TaiwanTravel to increase post visibility.
examples.zh: 使用 #TaiwanTravel 等主題標籤能大幅增加貼文的曝光度。

examples.en: The protest movement organized rallies around a unified social media hashtag.
examples.zh: 該倡議抗議運動圍繞著一個統一的社群標籤組織起集會活動。

examples.en: Avoid cluttering your captions with dozens of irrelevant hashtags.
examples.zh: 避免在文字說明欄堆疊數十個毫無關聯的主題標籤。

explains.en: It is a word or short phrase written with a number sign before it on social media. People tap it to find related posts. It helps organize a topic.
Users add this symbol and label to a post so others can search for similar content. A travel tag may gather photos from Taiwan. Avoid adding too many.
This social media label begins with the hash symbol. It connects posts about the same subject. A group may use one to share event news.

examples.en: A bright, eye-catching thumbnail attracts higher video click-through rates.
examples.zh: 明亮吸睛的封面縮圖能帶來更高的影片點閱率。

examples.en: Graphic designers use bold typography and expressive faces in YouTube thumbnails.
examples.zh: 平面設計師會在 YouTube 封面縮圖中使用鮮明文字與誇張表情。

examples.en: Click any photo thumbnail in the gallery to expand it to full size.
examples.zh: 點選相簿中任何照片縮圖即可放大檢視完整尺寸。

examples.en: A high-contrast, expressive thumbnail dramatically boosts click-through rates.
examples.zh: 一張構圖鮮明吸睛、表情生動張力十足的客製化影片縮圖能大幅拉升點閱率。

examples.en: Designers often test different thumbnail designs to see which one attracts more viewers.
examples.zh: 設計師通常會測試不同的縮圖樣式，看看哪一種設計更能吸引觀眾點擊。

examples.en: Don't use misleading thumbnails that promise content you don't actually deliver.
examples.zh: 千萬不要使用名不符實的標題黨欺騙性縮圖，以免辜負了觀眾的信任。

entries.definition: 影片縮圖；預覽圖；預覽小圖

explains.en: A small preview picture helps viewers decide whether to open a video. It may show a person or scene from it.
A photo gallery displays tiny versions of pictures before a person taps one to see it larger. The preview loads quickly.
A clear preview image can help people find a video among many choices. Creators choose colors and faces for it.

examples.en: She uploaded a daily food vlog exploring Tainan traditional breakfasts.
examples.zh: 她上傳了一支探索台南道地傳統早餐的一日美食 Vlog。

examples.en: The couple recorded a travel vlog documenting their backpacking trip across Europe.
examples.zh: 這對情侶錄製了一支旅遊 Vlog，記錄他們橫跨歐洲的背包客旅程。

examples.en: Editing a twenty-minute video vlog takes nearly eight hours of post-production.
examples.zh: 剪輯一支二十分鐘的影音 Vlog 需要花費近八小時的後製時間。

explains.en: This online video journal may show someone's daily life or a trip. The maker may film and edit it.
A person can record a food tour and share it with viewers. This kind of video diary is popular online.
A creator may use a camera to tell a story about an outing. The word can name the video or the act of making one.

examples.en: I love listening to English learning podcasts during my morning commute.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在早晨通勤途中收聽英語學習的 Podcast 節目。

examples.en: The tech podcast features weekly discussions on semiconductor trends.
examples.zh: 這個科技播客節目每週深度探討半導體產業發展趨勢。

examples.en: They set up soundproof acoustic panels to record their new podcast series.
examples.zh: 他們架設了專業吸音隔音板來錄製全新的播客節目系列。

examples.en: Millions of commuters listen to weekly business and comedy podcasts on trains.
examples.zh: 數百萬上班族通勤族習慣在捷運火車上收聽每週更新的商業與幽默脫口秀播客節目。

examples.en: He hosts a popular podcast where he interviews leading technology entrepreneurs.
examples.zh: 他主持了一個熱門播客節目，在節目中專訪頂尖的科技創業家。

examples.en: I downloaded several podcast episodes to listen to during the long flight.
examples.zh: 我下載了幾集播客節目，準備在長途飛行途中收聽。

examples.en: Millions of commuters tune into weekly true-crime narrative podcasts during their morning train rides.
examples.zh: 數百萬上班通勤族在搭乘捷運時，熱衷收聽每週定期更新的高品質深度敘事型播客節目。

examples.en: She launched an independent culinary podcast interviewing local organic farmers and artisan bakeries.
examples.zh: 她創立了一個獨立的美食文化播客音訊節目，親自走訪產地深度專訪友善耕作小農與在地烘焙職人。

examples.en: Download your favorite audio podcast episodes before boarding the international flight for offline listening.
examples.zh: 在登上國際長途班機前，記得預先下載好喜愛的播客單集音訊檔案，以便在沒有網路時離線收聽。

entries.definition: 播客；數位廣播節目；播客節目；錄製播客；故事敘事型 Podcast 播客節目

explains.en: This is a recorded audio program that people can listen to online. It may have weekly talks about technology or food. A person can save episodes for a trip.
A host records conversations or stories and shares them on the internet. Listeners can play each episode when they like. It may be a series about news, comedy, or learning.
People often listen to this kind of program during a commute. It may be audio only or include video. Hosts can interview guests or discuss a topic.

examples.en: Creators can monetize their channels through memberships and digital merch.
examples.zh: 創作者可透過頻道會員與數位周邊商品來實現流量變現。

examples.en: The startup found a clever way to monetize its free mobile application.
examples.zh: 這家新創團隊找到了一種巧妙為其免費 App 變現的商業模式。

examples.en: Many hobby bloggers eventually learn how to monetize their site through affiliate links.
examples.zh: 許多業餘部落客最終學會了如何透過聯盟行銷連結將網站流量變現。

entries.definition: 變現；營利；將…轉化為收入

explains.en: It means making money from a product, service, or online channel. A creator may earn income through memberships. A free app can also bring in revenue.
A business can turn its website or hobby into a source of income. Advertising links may help a writer earn money. The verb describes that process.
When a person finds a way to earn from something they made, they do this. A video channel may sell merchandise. It often involves a business plan.

examples.en: In-stream advertising provides a steady stream of content monetization.
examples.zh: 影片插播廣告為內容創作提供了穩定的變現營利來源。

examples.en: The game developer explored alternative monetization strategies that avoid pay-to-win mechanics.
examples.zh: 該遊戲開發商探索了避免「花錢獲勝」機制的替代營利模式。

examples.en: Platforms have lowered the entry threshold for channel monetization.
examples.zh: 影音平台降低了創作者開通頻道營利變現的門檻標準。

examples.en: Creators explore diversified monetization, including brand deals and online courses.
examples.zh: 頂尖創作者積極拓展多元化的流量變現模式，涵蓋品牌跨界代言與線上付費課程。

examples.en: Successful monetization of free mobile apps often relies on in-app purchases and ads.
examples.zh: 免費手機應用程式若要成功變現獲利，通常仰賴應用程式內購與廣告置入。

examples.en: Content platforms set strict criteria before enabling channel monetization features.
examples.zh: 影音內容平台在為頻道開通商業變現獲利功能之前，會設定嚴格的審查門檻。

entries.definition: 變現機制；營利模式；流量變現；商業獲利機制

explains.en: A video maker adds ads or sells subscriptions to earn money from online content. This turns an audience into income.
A free phone game may offer optional items for sale. The company earns money from the game this way.
A website can make money from ads, memberships, or paid features. This describes how it earns revenue.

examples.en: Tech fans eagerly watched the unboxing video of the newest flagship smartphone.
examples.zh: 科技迷們熱切觀看最新款旗艦智慧型手機的實體開箱影片。

examples.en: The toy collector posted a live unboxing of rare vintage action figures.
examples.zh: 這位玩具收藏家直播開箱了極其珍貴的絕版復古公仔手辦。

examples.en: Unboxing videos offer potential buyers an authentic first impression of package contents.
examples.zh: 開箱影片為潛在買家提供了包裝內含物的真實第一手開箱印象。

examples.en: Tech enthusiasts love watching detailed smartphone unboxing and benchmark tests.
examples.zh: 廣大 3C 科技發燒友最愛觀看各大科技達人針對旗艦新機所拍攝的詳盡實機開箱評測。

examples.en: Her unboxing video revealed the luxury packaging and sleek accessories inside.
examples.zh: 她的實機拆箱影片完整展示了精緻奢華的包裝盒以及裡面附贈的精美配件。

examples.en: Unboxing toys has become a surprisingly popular genre among younger YouTube audiences.
examples.zh: 拆開玩具的開箱影片在 YouTube 年輕受眾族群中已經成為一門極受歡迎的熱門題材。

entries.definition: 開箱；開箱評測；開箱影片；拆箱評測

explains.en: A person opens a new package on camera and shows what is inside. Viewers may watch to see a product.
A toy collector may film the first opening of a box. This kind of video gives buyers a look at the contents.
People enjoy watching a creator reveal new items from their packaging. The video may show the box and accessories.

examples.en: Follow this step-by-step video tutorial to learn photo editing skills.
examples.zh: 跟著這部逐步教學指南影片來學習實用的修圖技巧。

examples.en: The coding platform includes interactive tutorials for total beginners.
examples.zh: 該程式設計學習平台為零基礎初學者提供了互動式教學課程。

examples.en: She published an online tutorial showing how to knit woolen winter scarves.
examples.zh: 她在網路上發布了一篇教人如何編織保暖羊毛圍巾的手作教學指南。

entries.definition: 教學指南；自學影片課程

explains.en: This is a lesson that shows how to do something step by step. It may be a video about editing photos. Beginners can follow along to learn.
An online guide may teach someone how to knit or use a computer program. It explains each action in order. A person can pause and try the steps.
This kind of instructional material helps a learner practice a skill. It may be interactive or shown in a video. It explains the process clearly.

examples.en: Streaming platforms transformed how global audiences consume movies.
examples.zh: 影音串流平台徹底改變了全球觀眾觀看電影與影集的習慣。

examples.en: Several competing streaming platforms now bid millions for exclusive broadcast rights.
examples.zh: 數家競爭的串流平台如今豪擲重金競標熱門節目的獨家播映權。

examples.en: You can download shows directly from the streaming platform for offline travel viewing.
examples.zh: 你可以直接從串流平台上預先下載影集，方便旅途離線觀看。

explains.en: It is an online service where people watch movies or listen to music without downloading the whole file first. Users may pay a monthly fee. Different companies offer their own catalogs.
Viewers can choose shows from a website or app and play them over the internet. Some services let users save programs for travel. They compete for exclusive content.
This digital service delivers video or audio as it plays. People can watch on a phone or television. A subscription may be required.

examples.en: I stayed up late to binge-watch the entire Taiwanese mystery series.
examples.zh: 我熬夜狂追，一口氣把整部台灣懸疑推理台劇看完了。

examples.en: Rainy weekends are ideal for curling up on the sofa and binge-watching comedies.
examples.zh: 陰雨連綿的週末最適合窩在沙發上連續追看爆笑喜劇影集。

examples.en: Many people binge-watch new shows in a single weekend instead of waiting weekly.
examples.zh: 許多人喜歡在一個週末內一口氣追完整部新劇，而不想苦等每週更新。

examples.en: Fans binge-watched all eight thrilling episodes of the mystery series in one night.
examples.zh: 熱血影迷在週五深夜一口氣通宵連看八集，完成了一場欲罷不能的懸疑台劇馬拉松式追劇。

examples.en: When holiday breaks arrive, people love to binge-watch entire seasons of their favorite sitcoms.
examples.zh: 每逢連假春節假期到來，窩在沙發上一口氣刷完整季最心愛的經典情境喜劇是無數劇迷的快樂泉源。

examples.en: Streaming networks release all episodes at once to satisfy viewers who prefer to binge-watch over a weekend.
examples.zh: 串流影音巨頭選擇在週五將整季影集所有集數一次性全數上線，以充分迎合現代劇迷週末熬夜連環追劇的偏好。

entries.definition: 追劇；一口氣連續觀看；馬拉松式連續追劇；一口氣刷劇

explains.en: Someone watches many episodes of a show one after another in a short time. They may finish a whole season over a weekend.
On a rainy day, friends watch several comedy episodes without stopping for long. This phrase describes their viewing habit.
A streaming service releases every episode together, and a viewer watches them all in one weekend. The viewer keeps going from one episode to the next.

examples.en: The mystery episode ended on a shocking cliffhanger!
examples.zh: 這集懸疑劇在令人震撼且吊足胃口的懸念中戛然而止！

examples.en: Authors use clever cliffhangers at the end of chapters to keep readers turning pages.
examples.zh: 作家在章節結尾處巧妙埋下懸念鉤子，讓讀者欲罷不能地讀下去。

examples.en: The election was a nail-biting cliffhanger right up until the final ballot count.
examples.zh: 這場選戰一路緊張膠著，直到最後一張選票開完前都勝負懸殊難料。

entries.definition: 懸念；吊胃口的刺激結尾

explains.en: A story may stop at a very exciting moment, leaving readers eager to know what happens next. This ending creates suspense.
At the end of a chapter, an author may leave a mystery unsolved. Readers then want to continue.
A close election may remain uncertain until the final count. The word can describe that tense ending too.

examples.en: Spoiler alert: don't scroll social media if you haven't watched the finale!
examples.zh: 劇透警告：如果你還沒看大結局，請千萬別滑社群媒體！

examples.en: He accidentally revealed a major movie spoiler during our lunch conversation.
examples.zh: 他在我們吃午餐聊天時不小心劇透爆雷了電影的核心關鍵劇情。

examples.en: Online forums often use spoiler tags to protect fans from ruined surprises.
examples.zh: 網路討論區通常會使用防雷劇透遮罩標籤，以免毀了粉絲的驚喜。

explains.en: This is information that tells an important surprise or ending in a story before someone has seen it. It can ruin the fun for a viewer. Online pages may hide such details.
A person may accidentally tell who wins in a show. Fans often use a warning before discussing the ending. This information is better kept from people who have not watched.
This word names a detail that reveals a plot twist or ending. Sharing it too early can spoil a movie for others. A tag can help hide it online.

examples.en: The famous Japanese animation was dubbed into fluent Mandarin.
examples.zh: 這部著名的日本經典動畫被專業配音為流利的國語版本。

examples.en: Some foreign films lose nuances when they are dubbed rather than subtitled.
examples.zh: 某些外語電影在經過語音配音後，往往不如原音搭配字幕來得傳神細膩。

examples.en: The media dubbed him the fastest runner in high school track history.
examples.zh: 媒體讚譽封他為高中田徑史上跑得最快的天才飛人。

explains.en: It means replacing the original voices in a film with speech in another language. A Japanese animation may be given Mandarin voices. It can also mean giving someone a title.
A movie may be made easier to understand by adding new spoken lines in a different language. The original soundtrack is replaced. People may also use this verb for naming someone.
Film studios can record actors speaking translated dialogue over a movie. Viewers hear the new voices. As a second meaning, it can label a person as something.

examples.en: Talented voice actors breathe life and emotion into anime characters.
examples.zh: 才華洋溢的專業配音員賦予了動漫角色生動的情感與靈魂。

examples.en: She auditioned for a competitive voice actor role in a Pixar animation.
examples.zh: 她報名參加了皮克斯動畫電影一場競爭極為激烈的配音員角色甄選。

examples.en: A successful voice actor can alter tone, accent, and pitch effortlessly.
examples.zh: 優秀成功的配音員能游刃有餘地切換調整自己的語氣、口音與音高。

examples.en: Famous Japanese voice actors bring charismatic anime protagonists to life.
examples.zh: 享譽盛名的日本超人氣一線聲優配音員以其極富感染力的聲線賦予動漫主角靈魂。

examples.en: She hired a versatile professional voice actor to narrate her audio documentary.
examples.zh: 她聘請了一位聲線多變、音質溫厚的資深專業配音員為歷史有聲紀錄片錄製旁白導讀。

examples.en: Fans cheered enthusiastically when the voice actor delivered iconic catchphrases on stage.
examples.zh: 當心愛的聲優名家在見面會舞台上原音重現經典成名台詞時，台下粉絲激動尖叫歡呼。

explains.en: This performer speaks the lines for a cartoon character. They use their voice to show feelings and personality.
A narrator records words for an audiobook or animated film. Viewers hear the performance but may not see the performer.
In animation, one performer may sound like a brave hero or a silly animal. This person brings characters to life through speech.

examples.en: Spectacular computer visual effects brought mythical creatures to life.
examples.zh: 炫目震撼的電腦視覺特效讓神話生物活靈活現地躍然銀幕上。

examples.en: The sci-fi movie earned an Academy Award nomination for Best Visual Effects.
examples.zh: 這部科幻鉅作榮獲了奧斯卡最佳視覺特效獎的提名肯定。

examples.en: Independent film creators leverage accessible 3D software to produce indie visual effects.
examples.zh: 獨立電影製作者善用平易近人的 3D 軟體也能打造出高質感的視覺特效。

examples.en: Cutting-edge visual effects (VFX) brought mythical fantasy dragons to life.
examples.zh: 尖端頂尖的視覺特效（VFX）技術讓東方神話中的巨龍栩栩如生躍然銀幕。

examples.en: The film won the Oscar for Best Visual Effects due to its revolutionary underwater simulations.
examples.zh: 該片憑藉著在水下流體力學與海洋微粒模擬領域所取得的革命性突破，毫無懸念地斬獲了奧斯卡最佳視覺效果大獎。

examples.en: Combining miniature physical models with digital visual effects produces remarkably convincing destruction scenes.
examples.zh: 將精心雕琢的實體微縮景觀模型與尖端數位視覺特效相結合，能在大銀幕上製造出令人嘆為觀止的逼真災難毀滅場面。

explains.en: Computers can add imagined creatures or places to a film. These images make scenes look magical or exciting.
Movie makers may combine real sets with digital pictures. A team creates sights that could not easily be filmed.
A fantasy dragon on a screen can be created with computer tools. This part of filmmaking shapes what viewers see.

examples.en: Wearing a VR headset immerses users in interactive 360-degree worlds.
examples.zh: 戴上 VR 頭戴式顯示器能讓使用者完全沉浸在 360 度互動世界中。

examples.en: Flight training schools utilize virtual reality simulators to train student pilots safely.
examples.zh: 飛行駕訓學校利用虛擬實境模擬機安全高效地培訓學員飛行員。

examples.en: Medical students practice complex surgical techniques using virtual reality equipment.
examples.zh: 醫學生運用先進的虛擬實境設備反覆模擬練習複雜的外科手術操作。

explains.en: This technology uses a headset to make a person feel inside a computer-created world. A pilot can practice flying in a safe simulation. Medical students may practice procedures this way.
A person wears special equipment and sees a three-dimensional digital place around them. They can look around and interact with it. It is used for games and training.
This computer experience can make a user feel surrounded by a made-up environment. A headset often displays the scene. Flight schools and hospitals use it for practice.

examples.en: Mobile AR games blend digital gaming graphics with the real environment.
examples.zh: 手機 AR 遊戲將數位圖像元素無縫疊加於真實環境中。

examples.en: Furniture retail apps use augmented reality to let customers visualize sofas at home.
examples.zh: 家具零售 App 運用擴增實境技術讓顧客在家中虛擬預覽沙發擺設效果。

examples.en: Museum visitors engaged with historical relics via interactive augmented reality glasses.
examples.zh: 博物館參觀者透過佩戴互動式 AR 眼鏡，親身感受歷史文物的生動講解。

explains.en: It is technology that adds digital images or information to a view of the real world. A phone app may place a virtual chair in a room. Games can use it too.
With this technology, a screen shows computer-made objects over a live camera picture. A shopper can preview a sofa at home. Museums may add details to exhibits.
A person looks at the real surroundings through a phone or special glasses. Digital graphics appear on top of the view. It blends physical and computer-made scenes.

examples.en: Virtual concerts and avatars thrive inside the expansive metaverse.
examples.zh: 虛擬演唱會與數位虛擬化身在廣袤的元宇宙中蓬勃發展。

examples.en: Global tech companies invest billions to develop interoperable metaverse platforms.
examples.zh: 全球科技大廠斥資數十億美元打造可互通運作的元宇宙平台生態系。

examples.en: Users can socialize, work, and purchase digital assets in the metaverse.
examples.zh: 用戶能在元宇宙虛擬空間中進行社交互動、協同辦公並購買數位資產。

explains.en: People enter a shared computer-generated world using an avatar. They can meet friends or attend a virtual concert there.
A person may use a headset to explore a digital place and interact with others. Companies are building connected virtual spaces.
This online world lets users create characters, visit places, and sometimes buy digital objects. It aims to feel like a shared space.

examples.en: Professional esports tournaments fill massive indoor stadiums worldwide.
examples.zh: 職業電競錦標賽在世界各地的巨型室內體育館座無虛席。

examples.en: Becoming an esports champion requires lightning reflexes and intense teamwork.
examples.zh: 成為電競世界冠軍需要具備如閃電般的敏銳反應與緊密無間的團隊配合。

examples.en: Universities now offer athletic scholarships for elite esports players.
examples.zh: 許多知名大學現在也針對頂尖電競選手頒發專屬的體育獎學金。

examples.en: Taipei Arena hosted the thrilling world championship esports grand finals.
examples.zh: 台北小巨蛋盛大舉辦了熱血沸騰的全球英雄聯盟電子競技（Esports）世界總決賽。

examples.en: Professional esports athletes undergo rigorous daily training regimens similar to Olympic athletes.
examples.zh: 頂尖職業電子競技運動員每天皆需經歷長達十數個小時高強度的抗壓反應與團隊技戰術操練。

examples.en: The university established a dedicated esports arena and offered competitive gaming scholarships.
examples.zh: 這所科技大學斥資興建了專業電競競賽館，並正式設立了獎勵優秀電競專長選手的獎學金。

entries.definition: 電子競技；電競運動；電子競技 (Esports)；電競大賽

explains.en: Players compete in video games as part of organized events. Large audiences may watch a tournament.
A team practices strategy and quick reactions before a digital competition. Some colleges offer support to skilled players.
This kind of competition uses computer or console games. Top players may train much like athletes in other sports.

examples.en: Viewers can buy featured snacks instantly during interactive livestream shopping.
examples.zh: 觀眾在互動式的直播帶貨過程中能即時搶購下單特色零食。

examples.en: Livestream shopping generated billions in revenue during the holiday e-commerce festival.
examples.zh: 直播帶貨在節慶電商狂歡購物節期間創造了數以十億計的驚人營收。

examples.en: Hosts offer limited-time discounts to create urgency in livestream shopping sessions.
examples.zh: 直播主在帶貨直播現場祭出限時折扣優惠，以營造搶購的緊迫感。

explains.en: In this kind of online sale, a host shows products on a live video while viewers watch. People can ask questions and buy items during the show. Limited offers may appear.
A presenter demonstrates snacks or clothing in a real-time broadcast. Viewers can interact and order what they see. This combines entertainment with buying.
People watch a seller present goods through a live internet stream. They may purchase the featured items right away. A host can answer questions as they come in.

examples.en: We carefully planned a five-day round-island railway travel itinerary.
examples.zh: 我們精心規劃了一套為期五天的鐵道環島旅遊行程。

examples.en: Our tour guide distributed a printed daily itinerary to all participants.
examples.zh: 導遊向所有參團團員發放了列印好的每日行程表。

examples.en: Bad weather forced the mountaineering group to alter their summit itinerary.
examples.zh: 惡劣天候迫使登山隊伍臨時變更了登頂行程安排。

examples.en: Create a flexible driving itinerary allowing plenty of time for coastal photography.
examples.zh: 規劃一份彈性充裕的自駕行程表，預留充沛時間在沿海景點拍照打卡。

examples.en: The tour guide handed each traveler a printed daily itinerary outlining sightseeing schedules and dinner locations.
examples.zh: 專業隨團導遊向每位團員發放了一份排版精美的每日行程手冊，詳盡列出觀光景點門票時間與特色晚宴地點。

examples.en: Because the typhoon disrupted ferry schedules, we had to adjust our travel itinerary on short notice.
examples.zh: 鑑於突如其來的強烈颱風打亂了往返離島的所有客輪船班，我們被迫在極短時間內緊急重新調整了旅遊行程表。

entries.definition: 旅遊行程；旅行計畫表；旅遊行程表；旅行路線計劃

explains.en: It is a plan that lists the places and activities for a trip. A tour guide may hand out a daily schedule. Bad weather can force changes.
Travelers use this document to see where they will go each day. It may include times, transport, and hotel details. Keep it handy during a tour.
A group can organize a journey with this travel plan. It shows stops in order. Someone may change it if the weather is poor.

examples.en: Budget backpackers love staying at friendly youth hostels near night markets.
examples.zh: 小資背包客非常喜愛入住鄰近夜市且人情味濃厚的青年旅館。

examples.en: The hostel common room was packed with international backpackers swapping travel stories.
examples.zh: 青旅的交誼廳擠滿了來自各國的背包客，熱絡交換著彼此的旅行經歷。

examples.en: As an experienced backpacker, she travels with only a lightweight 40-liter rucksack.
examples.zh: 作為一名經驗老到的背包客，她只背著一個四十公升的輕便背包四處旅行。

explains.en: A traveler carries clothes and supplies in a pack and often chooses low-cost lodging. They may visit many places on a small budget.
At a youth hostel, travelers share stories about their trips. Some carry all their belongings on their backs.
This independent traveler packs lightly and plans an affordable journey. They may stay in hostels rather than hotels.

examples.en: The National Palace Museum is a world-class cultural tourist attraction.
examples.zh: 國立故宮博物院是一座世界級的文化觀光景點。

examples.en: Taipei 101 observatory is undoubtedly the most iconic modern tourist attraction in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台北 101 觀景台無疑是台灣最具代表性的現代地標觀光景點。

examples.en: Historic Lukang town features numerous preserved heritage tourist attractions.
examples.zh: 歷史名鎮鹿港保留了許多完好無損的古蹟文化景點。

explains.en: Visitors go to this interesting place while traveling. A museum or famous tower can be one.
A historic town may draw many people who want to see old buildings. It is a popular place to visit.
Travelers often add a well-known landmark to their plans. It gives people a reason to visit an area.

examples.en: Sun Moon Lake is widely praised as Taiwan's premier scenic spot.
examples.zh: 日月潭被各界譽為台灣首屈一指的風景名勝區。

examples.en: Photography enthusiasts gather at this coastal scenic spot to capture golden hour sunsets.
examples.zh: 攝影愛好者齊聚這處沿海風景名勝，爭相捕捉黃金時刻的日落餘暉。

examples.en: Taroko Gorge features dramatic marble cliffs and stunning riverbed scenic spots.
examples.zh: 太魯閣峽谷擁有壯麗的大理石絕壁與令人屏息的河谷風景區。

explains.en: This is a place that visitors go to enjoy a beautiful view or natural feature. A lake or gorge may attract photographers. People often take pictures there.
Travelers may visit this location to see mountains, coastlines, or other striking scenery. It can become a popular tourist destination. The view is the main attraction.
A well-known place with an attractive landscape can be described this way. Visitors may come at sunset to take photos. It often appears in travel guides.

examples.en: Japanese travelers can enter Taiwan on a ninety-day visa-free stay.
examples.zh: 日本籍旅客可享有停留九十天的免簽證來台待遇。

examples.en: Many European countries offer reciprocal visa-free entry to international tourists.
examples.zh: 許多歐洲國家向國際觀光客提供對等的免簽證入境便利待遇。

examples.en: Expanded visa-free policies have given a huge boost to the local tourism industry.
examples.zh: 擴大免簽政策為在地觀光旅遊產業帶來了巨大的推動效益。

examples.en: Taiwan passport holders enjoy generous visa-free entry access to over 140 destinations.
examples.zh: 持中華民國晶片護照享有前往全球超過一百四十個國家與地區的免簽證入境待遇。

examples.en: Traveling to Japan is seamless because Taiwanese tourists can enter visa-free for ninety days.
examples.zh: 台灣民眾前往日本自由行極為便捷，可享有長達九十天免簽證觀光入境待遇。

examples.en: Make sure to check local immigration rules even when traveling under a visa-free agreement.
examples.zh: 即使是在享有免簽互惠待遇的國家旅行，啟程前仍應詳閱當地移民局對入境目的與天數的最新規範。

entries.definition: 免簽證的；享有免簽待遇的

explains.en: It describes travel to a country without first getting an entry visa. Visitors may still need a passport and must follow the allowed stay limit. Rules depend on nationality.
Some countries allow tourists to enter without applying for a visa beforehand. This policy can make travel easier. Travelers should check current requirements.
Use this adjective for a trip that does not require a visa for entry. A visitor may stay for a limited number of days. Other border rules still apply.

examples.en: Ensure your passport has at least six months of remaining validity before flying.
examples.zh: 出國搭機前請務必確認您的護照具備至少六個月以上的剩餘效期。

examples.en: The immigration officer verified the legal validity of my work permit documents.
examples.zh: 移民官仔細審查並確認了我工作許可文件的合法有效性。

examples.en: Scientists raised doubts about the scientific validity of the experimental results.
examples.zh: 科學家們對該實驗結果的科學有效性提出了合理質疑。

explains.en: A passport must still be accepted on the day someone travels. Check the date printed inside before a trip.
A scientist checks whether a test measures what it is supposed to measure. This is about how sound or reliable the result is.
A document may be accepted only for a certain period. The word can describe whether it remains legally or logically acceptable.

examples.en: Travelers love buying fragrances and cosmetics at the airport duty-free shop.
examples.zh: 旅客們喜歡在機場免稅商店選購香水與專櫃化妝品。

examples.en: Remember to bring your passport when shopping inside the airport duty-free shop.
examples.zh: 在機場免稅商店購物結帳時，請記得出示您的個人護照。

examples.en: Duty-free shops often bundle popular confectioneries into discounted gift packs.
examples.zh: 免稅商店常將熱門精選糖果點心包裝為特惠伴手禮盒組合。

explains.en: Travelers can buy some goods at an airport without certain taxes. A passport may be needed to shop there.
Perfume and snacks are often sold in this airport store. Travelers usually shop before an international flight.
This airport store sells goods with some local taxes removed. It may offer gift sets for people going abroad.

examples.en: International tourists can claim an instant VAT tax refund at department stores.
examples.zh: 國際觀光客可在各大百貨商場直接辦理現場退稅服務。

examples.en: Keep all your purchase receipts and official invoices to process the airport tax refund.
examples.zh: 請妥善保存所有購物明細收據與正式發票，以便在機場辦理退稅手續。

examples.en: The automated tax refund kiosk processed our refund in less than two minutes.
examples.zh: 自動化退稅機台在不到兩分鐘內就幫我們辦妥了退稅手續。

explains.en: This is money returned to a person after they paid more tax than they owed. A visitor may claim it after shopping. Receipts are often needed to prove the purchase.
Some travelers can get part of a purchase tax back at an airport or shop. A kiosk may process the request quickly. Keep the official receipt.
When someone has paid too much tax, the extra amount can be given back. Stores may help tourists claim it. Rules and proof of purchase are required.

examples.en: Strict border plant quarantine prevents foreign agricultural pests from entering.
examples.zh: 嚴格的邊境動植物檢疫能防堵境外農業有害生物入侵。

examples.en: Pets imported from abroad must undergo a mandatory veterinary quarantine period.
examples.zh: 從境外輸入的寵物必須依法接受強制性的動物檢疫隔離期。

examples.en: Health authorities ordered travelers showing fever symptoms into quarantine.
examples.zh: 衛生機關下令對出現發燒症狀的入境旅客進行隔離檢疫措施。

examples.en: Strict agricultural quarantine measures protect Taiwan from devastating African Swine Fever.
examples.zh: 桃園機場執行滴水不漏的嚴格動植物防檢疫措施，成功將非洲豬瘟等境外重大疫病阻絕於境外。

examples.en: Arriving pets must undergo mandatory rabies quarantine before entering the country freely.
examples.zh: 從海外攜帶貓狗伴侶動物返國時，毛孩必須依規定在指定檢疫舍完成狂犬病抗體隔離檢疫程序。

examples.en: Quarantine officers inspected the imported fruit crates thoroughly for agricultural pests.
examples.zh: 動植物防檢疫人員在貨運航空站開箱仔細抽驗大宗進口水果木箱，嚴查有無夾帶外來害蟲卵塊。

examples.en: All newly arrived fishes spend thirty days in the strict bio-secure quarantine facility before joining main tanks.
examples.zh: 所有新引進的水族生物，在入主展缸前必須在「嚴格檢疫隔離中心」（Quarantine）觀察三十天。

examples.en: Public health officials imposed mandatory hotel quarantine on international arrivals during the epidemic.
examples.zh: 衛生防疫主管機關在重大傳染病流行期間，要求所有境外入境旅客必須在合格防疫旅館落實隔離檢疫。

examples.en: Plants intercepted at border customs underwent strict phytosanitary quarantine to stop invasive insect pests.
examples.zh: 在海關機場邊境查獲的未申報活體植株，必須依法接受嚴格動植物防檢疫處理以全面阻絕外來害蟲入侵。

entries.definition: 檢疫；隔離；進行檢疫；動植物防檢疫；隔離檢疫；新進魚類三十天強制檢疫隔離觀察缸

explains.en: It is a period when a person, animal, or plant is kept apart to prevent disease from spreading. Imported pets may need observation. Health officials can order it.
A sick traveler may stay separate from others for a time. Plants entering a country can also be checked for pests. This noun can also be a verb.
Keeping someone or something isolated helps protect others from infection or pests. A person may be watched for symptoms. Authorities set the rules.

examples.en: Please proceed to boarding gate B7 thirty minutes before flight departure.
examples.zh: 請於班機起飛前三十分鐘前往 B7 登機門候機。

examples.en: An airport announcement notified passengers that the flight boarding gate had changed.
examples.zh: 機場廣播即時通知候機旅客該航班的登機門已臨時變更。

examples.en: Duty-free shopping areas are strategically placed along the path to the boarding gate.
examples.zh: 免稅購物商場巧妙地規劃在前往登機門的沿途動線上。

examples.en: Passengers on flight CI-100 should proceed immediately to boarding gate B7.
examples.zh: 搭乘中華航空 CI-100 班機的旅客請立即前往 B7 號登機門候機。

examples.en: The boarding gate will close twenty minutes prior to scheduled departure.
examples.zh: 候機大廳的登機閘口將於班機表定起飛時間前二十分鐘準時關閉、不再受理登機。

examples.en: Passengers gathered near the boarding gate as the airline announced the commencement of boarding.
examples.zh: 當廣播宣布即將開放登機時，候機室內的旅客紛紛起身往登機門驗票口前方排隊聚集。

explains.en: After security, passengers wait at a numbered place in the airport before entering the plane. Check the screen because the number may change.
An announcement tells travelers to walk to the correct area when their flight is ready. Staff scan tickets there.
People line up here when it is time to enter an aircraft. Arrive before the doors close.

examples.en: Economy class tickets usually include a twenty-three-kilogram checked luggage allowance.
examples.zh: 經濟艙機票通常包含一件二十三公斤的免費託運行李額度。

examples.en: Weigh your bags at home to avoid exceeding the strict airline luggage allowance.
examples.zh: 出發前先在家稱量行李重量，以免超過航空公司嚴格的行李限額。

examples.en: Frequent flyer status grants members additional luggage allowance free of charge.
examples.zh: 高階會員飛行常客資格享有額外贈送的免費行李託運額度。

entries.definition: 行李限額；免費行李額度

explains.en: An airline sets a weight or number of bags each traveler may bring. Check it before packing.
A ticket may include a certain amount of checked baggage at no extra cost. A frequent traveler might receive more.
Weigh your suitcase before a flight so it stays within the airline's permitted amount. Extra bags may cost more.

examples.en: Place your lightweight carry-on bag into the overhead storage bin.
examples.zh: 將輕便的隨身登機手提行李放置在頭頂上方的行李艙中。

examples.en: Ensure all liquid containers in your carry-on bag comply with the 100ml limit.
examples.zh: 請確保隨身手提行李中的所有液體容器皆符合 100 毫升之限制。

examples.en: Flight attendants help passengers find remaining bin space for their carry-on bags.
examples.zh: 空服員熱心協助登機乘客尋找頭頂行李櫃剩餘的放置空間。

explains.en: This is a small piece of luggage that a traveler takes onto an airplane and keeps in the cabin. It fits in an overhead bin or under a seat. Liquids may have limits.
Passengers bring this bag through the airport and keep it with them during the flight. It should fit in the storage space above the seats. Airlines set size rules.
A traveler does not check this luggage into the airplane hold. They keep it nearby and place it in a cabin compartment. It is useful for important items.

examples.en: Check oversized heavy suitcases at the airline check-in counter.
examples.zh: 在航空公司報到櫃檯將大型沉重行李箱辦理託運。

examples.en: Remember to remove lithium battery power banks from your checked baggage.
examples.zh: 請切記將鋰電池行動電源從託運行李中取出，改放隨身攜帶。

examples.en: Baggage handlers carefully transfer checked baggage into the airplane cargo hold.
examples.zh: 地勤行李搬運員小心翼翼地將託運行李裝載送入飛機貨艙中。

explains.en: It is luggage that an airline takes from the counter and stores in the plane's cargo hold. Passengers collect it after landing. Keep batteries and valuables with you.
Large suitcases are handed to airline staff before boarding. They travel separately from the passenger cabin. Travelers pick them up at the airport belt.
A traveler gives these bags to the airline before a flight. They are carried below the passenger area. Remove power banks before handing them over.

examples.en: Travelers waited patiently beside carousel number four for suitcases.
examples.zh: 旅客們在四號行李轉盤旁耐心等候自己的行李箱出現。

examples.en: Luggage bags circled on the airport carousel until owners picked them up.
examples.zh: 行李箱在機場旋轉轉盤上緩緩繞圈，直到失主主人將其提走。

examples.en: Children cheered with delight as they rode the colorful amusement park carousel.
examples.zh: 孩子們歡呼雀躍地坐上了遊樂園裡五彩繽紛的旋轉木馬。

examples.en: Collect your checked suitcases from baggage carousel 6 according to your flight number.
examples.zh: 請依照機場大螢幕上的航班代號指示，前往六號行李轉盤前耐心等候提領託運行李箱。

examples.en: Luggage emerged slowly onto the moving conveyor carousel after the plane landed.
examples.zh: 飛機落地滑行停妥後不久，全機旅客的託運行李便陸續由行李輸送帶滾上旋轉行李轉盤。

examples.en: The child smiled joyfully while riding the vintage musical carousel in the amusement park.
examples.zh: 小朋友坐在遊樂園裡閃爍著七彩霓虹燈的復古音樂旋轉木馬上，綻放出燦爛幸福的笑容。

entries.definition: 行李輸送轉盤；旋轉木馬；行李轉盤

explains.en: After landing, travelers wait beside a moving belt where checked suitcases arrive. A screen shows which flight’s bags are coming.
Children sit on painted horses that move in circles at an amusement park. Music may play as they ride.
At the airport, a rotating belt brings luggage around for people to collect. At a fair, the same word names a round ride.

examples.en: Take the complimentary hotel shuttle bus directly from the airport terminal.
examples.zh: 從機場航廈可直接搭乘飯店提供的免費接駁巴士。

examples.en: The national park operates eco-friendly electric shuttle buses during peak seasons.
examples.zh: 國家公園在觀光旺季期間提供環保電動接駁專車服務。

examples.en: The university provides free shuttle bus services linking campuses and metro stops.
examples.zh: 大學提供免費校園接駁車，穿梭連接各校區與捷運地鐵站。

entries.definition: 機場接駁車；區間接駁公車

explains.en: This bus travels back and forth between a few nearby places. A hotel may carry guests from the airport.
A park can use a small bus to move visitors between stops. It often runs on a regular route.
Universities may provide this ride between two campuses. Passengers can take it without paying a fare.

examples.en: We enjoyed a six-hour daytime layover in Tokyo between flights.
examples.zh: 我們在兩段航班之間於東京進行了六小時的白天轉機觀光停留。

examples.en: A long overnight layover gives budget travelers time to nap in airport sleep pods.
examples.zh: 漫長的過夜轉機等待時間讓小資旅人能在機場睡眠艙補眠歇息。

examples.en: The airline offered complimentary meal vouchers during our eight-hour flight layover.
examples.zh: 在長達八小時的轉機過境期間，航空公司提供了免費餐券補償。

examples.en: We booked a cheap ticket with a convenient three-hour layover in Tokyo.
examples.zh: 我們預訂了一張在中途東京成田機場轉機停留三小時的超值特惠機票。

examples.en: During our long layover at Changi Airport, we rested in a comfortable transit lounge.
examples.zh: 在新加坡樟宜機場漫長悠閒的轉機過境待機空檔中，我們在舒適奢華的過境休息室好好洗了個熱水澡。

examples.en: Because our layover was very tight, we barely had ten minutes to run between terminals.
examples.zh: 由於兩段班機間的轉機待機時間非常緊迫，我們幾乎只有不到十分鐘在兩座不同航廈間拔腿狂奔。

examples.en: We booked a cheap ticket with a relaxing four-hour layover in Tokyo Narita.
examples.zh: 我們預訂了在東京成田國際機場中途轉機停留四小時的特惠機票，順道在機場大啖拉麵。

examples.en: During an eight-hour layover, many travelers venture out of the airport into the city center.
examples.zh: 面對長達八小時的中途轉機停留空檔，許多旅人會選擇搭乘快線電車進市區展開一場微旅行。

examples.en: The long layover gave her enough time to catch up on work emails inside the quiet lounge.
examples.zh: 充裕的轉機中停等候時間，讓她得以在安靜舒適的機場貴賓室內從容處理完所有緊急商務信件。

entries.definition: 轉機停留；中途短暫過境；轉機過境停留（短時間待機）；中途轉機停留時間（通常24小時以內）

explains.en: This is a waiting period at an airport between one flight and the next. A traveler may have a few hours to rest. Some people leave the airport if there is enough time.
A trip may include a stop in another city before the next plane. The passenger waits there before continuing. A long one may allow a meal or nap.
When there is time between connecting flights, a traveler has this kind of stop. They may wait in a lounge or explore nearby. A short one requires moving quickly between gates.

examples.en: Allow at least two hours between connecting flights to ensure smooth transfers.
examples.zh: 兩段銜接班機之間請至少預留兩小時以確保轉機順利。

examples.en: Because our inbound departure was delayed, we barely made our connecting flight.
examples.zh: 由於前段出發班機延誤，我們差一點就趕不上後續的轉接航班。

examples.en: The ground agent rebooked us onto the next connecting flight to London.
examples.zh: 地勤人員迅速協助我們改簽轉乘下一班前往倫敦的銜接航班。

examples.en: Run to Gate C12 to catch your connecting flight to New York.
examples.zh: 請加快腳步前往 C12 號登機門以順利銜接轉乘前往紐約的接駁班機。

examples.en: If your first departure is delayed, the airline will rebook you on the next available connecting flight.
examples.zh: 若第一段航程因天候延誤，地勤將第一時間主動為您免費改簽並安排後續最快起飛的銜接接駁班機。

examples.en: Checked bags were checked through to the final destination so we didn't need to recheck them for our connecting flight.
examples.zh: 託運行李已在首發機場直掛抵達最終目的地，因此在過境中轉時我們完全無須提領行李重新辦理託運。

entries.definition: 轉接航班；銜接班機；轉機接駁航班

explains.en: It is a later airplane trip a passenger takes after changing planes at an airport. Leave enough time between flights. A delay can make the transfer difficult.
Travelers may need to leave one plane and board another to reach their destination. The second leg is this kind of flight. Ask staff for help if time is short.
When a journey uses more than one airplane, passengers transfer between trips. Check the gate and schedule carefully. A delayed first flight may cause a missed transfer.

examples.en: Flying a non-stop direct flight from Taipei to San Francisco saves travel time.
examples.zh: 搭乘台北直飛舊金山的直航航班能省下許多寶貴時間。

examples.en: The new direct flight route makes traveling between the two capitals much more convenient.
examples.zh: 這條全新的直航航線使兩國首都之間的往返差旅變得更為便捷。

examples.en: Although direct flights can be slightly more expensive, they eliminate transfer fatigue.
examples.zh: 雖然直飛航班票價可能稍高一些，但省去了轉機奔波的舟車勞頓。

explains.en: Passengers travel between two cities without changing planes along the way. The trip may be shorter and easier.
A family boards one aircraft in Taipei and leaves it after reaching its destination. They do not transfer to another plane.
This flight route connects two airports with no plane change. It can save travelers time during a trip.

examples.en: Drink plenty of water and adapt to local time to conquer jet lag.
examples.zh: 多喝水並儘早適應當地作息以克服跨時區的時差疲勞。

examples.en: After crossing eight time zones, he suffered from terrible jet lag for three days.
examples.zh: 橫跨八個時區後，他連續三天飽受嚴重的時差反應折磨。

examples.en: Getting sunlight in the morning is a proven natural remedy for jet lag.
examples.zh: 晨間多接觸自然戶外陽光是已被科學證實能緩解時差的天然良方。

examples.en: Adjusting sleeping routines quickly helps overcome transatlantic jet lag.
examples.zh: 抵達目的地後迅速調整作息時間有助於克服跨越時區的時差疲憊感。

examples.en: Drinking plenty of water and walking outside in morning sunlight helps reset your internal clock against jet lag.
examples.zh: 保持體內水分充沛並在早晨戶外多曬溫暖自然陽光，有助於重新校準生理時鐘以快速擺脫時差困擾。

examples.en: Severe jet lag left him feeling groggy and disoriented for three straight days after arriving in London.
examples.zh: 嚴重的跨時區長途時差反應，讓他在飛抵倫敦後的整整前三天始終感到頭昏腦脹、渾身無力。

examples.en: Morning sunlight and light hydration help ease tired jet lag after long flights.
examples.zh: 抵達目的地後多曬清晨溫暖陽光並多補充純水，有助於迅速調適長途跨洋飛行的時差反應。

examples.en: Traveling eastward across several time zones typically induces worse jet lag than traveling west.
examples.zh: 跨越多個時區向東飛行往往比向西飛行更容易引發更嚴重的生理時鐘錯亂與晝夜時差綜合症。

examples.en: He took a brisk walk in the park to fight off afternoon jet lag exhaustion.
examples.zh: 下飛機當天午後他特地前往附近的綠意公園快步慢跑散步，以克服睡意昏沉的時差疲憊感。

entries.definition: 時差疲勞；時差反應；跨時區時差反應；時差綜合症

explains.en: After a long flight across time zones, a person may feel tired at the wrong time of day. Sleep can be difficult.
Traveling far east or west can confuse the body's usual clock. Morning sunlight may help a traveler adjust.
A traveler may feel sleepy or awake at unusual hours after crossing many time zones. Drinking water and resting can help.

examples.en: The captain turned on the seatbelt sign due to sudden mid-air turbulence.
examples.zh: 由於空中突遇氣流顛簸亂流，機長開啟了安全帶警示燈。

examples.en: The flight experienced bumpy turbulence while passing over a tropical storm.
examples.zh: 飛機在飛越熱帶風暴上方時遭遇了強烈的氣流顛簸亂流。

examples.en: Economic turbulence led several major commercial banks to merge.
examples.zh: 劇烈的經濟動盪風暴促使數家大型商業銀行展開合併整併。

examples.en: The aircraft encountered unexpected clear-air turbulence over the Pacific.
examples.zh: 飛機在太平洋高空巡航時遭遇了突如其來的晴空亂流與輕微顛簸。

examples.en: The captain asked all passengers to return to their seats immediately due to anticipated severe turbulence.
examples.zh: 鑑於前方航路即將面臨嚴重的氣流顛簸，正機長透過廣播敦請全體乘客立即停止走動並回座坐好。

examples.en: Modern radar technology allows pilots to detect storm clouds and fly around areas of violent turbulence.
examples.zh: 現代先進氣象都卜勒雷達能敏銳探測遠方積雨雲層，讓機師提早繞道避開劇烈亂流顛簸空域。

examples.en: The aircraft experienced momentary severe clear-air turbulence over the mountains.
examples.zh: 飛機在飛越高聳山脈上空時遭遇了短暫劇烈的晴空亂流顛簸，機長隨即啟動安全廣播。

examples.en: Keep your seatbelt loosely fastened even when the turbulence sign is switched off.
examples.zh: 即使頭頂上的安全帶指示燈已經熄滅，建議在座位上休息時仍全程繫妥安全帶以防突發亂流。

examples.en: Flight attendants paused beverage service immediately due to unexpected sudden turbulence.
examples.zh: 由於遭遇突如其來的強烈顛簸氣流，客艙空服員立即暫停了走道上的推車冷熱飲品派送服務。

examples.en: Gentle circular pouring introduces controlled turbulence, ensuring every coffee particle extracts evenly.
examples.zh: 緩慢由內向外均勻畫圈注水，製造出恰到好處的水流擾動，讓每顆咖啡粉均勻萃取。

examples.en: Excessive pouring turbulence agitates heavy fines downward, causing the filter paper to choke and stall.
examples.zh: 過度劇烈的衝擊性水流擾動會把微細粉衝向下層，進而堵塞濾紙孔洞導致粉層積水不退。

examples.en: Swirling the brewer during the draw-down phase creates gentle turbulence that flattens the coffee bed.
examples.zh: 在最後水流滴濾階段輕柔晃動搖晃濾杯，能在粉層表面製造微幅擾動並留下一張平坦如鏡的粉床。

entries.definition: 亂流；氣流顛簸；晴空亂流；顛簸氣流；溫柔畫圈注水產生之均勻水流擾動

explains.en: This is rough, uneven movement in air or water. An airplane may shake when it flies through it. A pilot may ask passengers to sit and fasten their belts.
A plane can bump during a storm or when air moves in different directions. Coffee can also be stirred by moving liquid. The word describes disorderly motion.
People feel this during a bumpy flight when air is moving roughly. Pilots may steer around storm clouds. In liquids, it means irregular swirling movement.

examples.en: Please keep your airplane seatbelt fastened securely while seated.
examples.zh: 就座時請務必全程將飛機安全帶確實扣緊繫好。

examples.en: Wearing a car seatbelt significantly reduces the severity of injuries in crashes.
examples.zh: 乘坐汽車繫妥安全帶能大幅減輕車禍撞擊時的傷害嚴重程度。

examples.en: The flight attendant walked down the aisle to verify that all seatbelts were fastened.
examples.zh: 空服員沿著客艙走道逐一檢查並確認所有乘客的安全帶皆已扣好。

explains.en: It is a safety strap that keeps a person in a car or airplane seat. Fasten it before the vehicle moves. It can reduce injuries in a crash.
Passengers should secure this belt across their lap and shoulder. Flight crews check that everyone is buckled before takeoff. It helps keep people safely seated.
This strap holds a traveler in place during sudden stops. It is required in cars and used on airplanes. Always fasten it properly.

examples.en: Passengers seated in emergency exit rows must assist during evacuations.
examples.zh: 坐在緊急逃生出口走道座位的旅客須具備協助疏散的能力。

examples.en: Bright green illuminated signs mark the location of every emergency exit.
examples.zh: 鮮綠色發光的標示清楚指引出每一處緊急逃生出口的位置。

examples.en: Never block the corridors leading toward the building emergency exits.
examples.zh: 絕不可堆放雜物堵塞通往建築物緊急避難逃生出口的走道。

examples.en: Passengers seated in the emergency exit row must assist crew in emergencies.
examples.zh: 坐在緊急逃生門出口座位的旅客在面臨緊急狀況時須協助機組人員。

examples.en: Luminous floor track lighting guides trapped passengers directly toward the nearest emergency exit.
examples.zh: 機艙地板兩側鋪設的螢光夜光逃生指示燈條，能在濃煙中精準指引受困旅客奔向最近的逃生門。

examples.en: Never block the designated emergency exit doors or hallways with heavy backpacks or coats.
examples.zh: 千萬切莫用沉重的隨身雙肩包或厚重大衣阻擋堵塞法定的緊急逃生門通道或機艙走道。

entries.definition: 緊急逃生出口；緊急逃生門

explains.en: A bright sign points to a door people can use to leave a building during a fire or other danger. Keep the path clear.
On an airplane, passengers may be seated near a special door used if people must leave quickly. Follow the crew’s directions.
This marked doorway gives people a way out when normal routes are unsafe. Do not block it with bags or furniture.

examples.en: Airlines provide special vegetarian and halal in-flight meals upon request.
examples.zh: 航空公司可依旅客特殊飲食需求提供素食或清真飛機餐。

examples.en: Many carriers now partner with Michelin-starred chefs to elevate in-flight meals.
examples.zh: 許多航空公司如今與米其林星級名廚跨界合作，以升級機上餐飲水準。

examples.en: Flight attendants distributed hot in-flight meals shortly after cruising altitude was reached.
examples.zh: 飛機達到巡航高度後不久，空服員便開始分發熱騰騰的機上餐點。

explains.en: Passengers may receive food while traveling on an airplane. A special vegetarian choice can be requested.
A flight attendant brings lunch or dinner during a long journey in the sky. Some airlines offer several options.
People can ask for a special meal before flying. The food is served during the trip.

examples.en: Youth hostels offer shared communal kitchens where travelers mingle and exchange stories.
examples.zh: 青年旅館設有公共廚房，讓旅人們能彼此交流旅行故事。

examples.en: Backpacking through Southeast Asia is made affordable by abundant youth hostels.
examples.zh: 東南亞各地隨處可見的青年旅館讓背包客窮遊變得輕鬆可負擔。

examples.en: The youth hostel organized a free walking tour of the historic district.
examples.zh: 這家青旅為各國住客舉辦了歷史老城街區的免費漫步導覽之旅。

explains.en: This is a low-cost place for travelers to sleep, often with shared rooms and a kitchen. Visitors may meet other people there. It suits people traveling on a budget.
Backpackers can stay in this lodging while visiting another country. Guests may cook together and share stories. It costs less than many hotels.
A traveler may book this simple accommodation for an affordable trip. It often has shared spaces and rooms. Staff may organize tours of nearby places.

examples.en: Hostels provide comfortable bunk beds equipped with individual reading lamps and curtains.
examples.zh: 青旅提供配備個人專屬閱讀燈與隱私拉簾的舒適上下舖床位。

examples.en: The brothers shared a wooden bunk bed in their cozy childhood bedroom.
examples.zh: 兩兄弟童年時期在溫馨的臥房裡同睡一張雙層木製上下舖。

examples.en: Climbing the ladder to reach the top bunk bed requires extra caution.
examples.zh: 爬梯爬上雙層床的上舖床位時需要格外留意小心。

explains.en: It is a bed frame with one sleeping space above another. A ladder helps someone reach the top. Siblings may share one in a small room.
Hostels use this space-saving furniture to fit more guests. Each person has a separate mattress at a different height. Climb carefully to the upper bed.
Two beds are stacked vertically in this design. It is useful in a shared bedroom or camp cabin. A ladder is often attached.

examples.en: We stayed at a cozy countryside guesthouse in Yilan surrounded by rice paddies.
examples.zh: 我們入住了一間座落於宜蘭稻田間的溫馨鄉村民宿。

examples.en: The friendly owners of the seaside guesthouse prepared a homemade breakfast.
examples.zh: 這家濱海民宿熱情親切的主人為住客精心準備了手作道地早餐。

examples.en: Booking a traditional guesthouse offers a closer look at local everyday living.
examples.zh: 預訂傳統日式民宿讓旅客能更貼近體會當地居民的日常生活。

explains.en: A traveler sleeps in a small home-like place run by a local host. Breakfast may be included.
In Yilan, visitors might stay at a family-run lodging near rice fields. The owners may prepare a homemade meal.
This small place offers travelers rooms and a friendly local welcome. It may feel more personal than a large hotel.

examples.en: A rural aboriginal village homestay offers authentic tribal cultural immersion.
examples.zh: 在原住民部落村落體驗在地深度寄宿能深刻感受原鄉文化。

examples.en: During his exchange semester in Spain, David lived with a welcoming homestay family.
examples.zh: 在西班牙進行交換學生學期期間，大衛寄宿在一個熱情好客的寄宿家庭。

examples.en: The homestay host taught travelers how to weave traditional bamboo baskets.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭主人親自指導各方旅人如何動手編織傳統竹簍工藝。

entries.definition: 寄宿家庭；在地深度體驗宿屋

explains.en: A traveler lives in a local family's home for a short time. This can help the visitor learn about daily life.
A student studying abroad may stay with a welcoming family. The hosts might teach local customs or cooking.
Visitors in a village can experience local culture while staying in a family's home. This arrangement offers a personal trip.

examples.en: Ask the hotel front desk clerk for extra pillows and local sightseeing maps.
examples.zh: 向飯店櫃檯服務人員索取額外的枕頭與在地觀光地圖。

examples.en: You can leave your luggage at the front desk before check-in time.
examples.zh: 在辦理入住時間前，您可以先將隨身大件行李寄放在飯店櫃檯。

examples.en: Dial zero on the room telephone to contact the 24-hour front desk.
examples.zh: 拿起客房分機電話撥打「0」即可隨時聯繫二十四小時客服櫃檯。

explains.en: This is the counter in a hotel where guests can ask for help or check in. Staff may provide pillows or maps. They are often available all day.
A visitor can leave luggage here before entering a room. Hotel workers answer questions at this counter. A room phone may connect directly to it.
This hotel area is usually near the entrance. Guests can get keys, ask for assistance, or call staff from there. It is an important place for service.

examples.en: Guests can check in to their hotel rooms starting from 3:00 PM.
examples.zh: 房客可自下午三點起開始辦理飯店客房入住手續。

examples.en: Arrive at the airport three hours early to check in for your international flight.
examples.zh: 請於班機起飛前三小時抵達機場辦理國際航班報到手續。

examples.en: We used our mobile phones to check in online twenty-four hours before departure.
examples.zh: 我們在飛機起飛前二十四小時就先利用智慧型手機完成了線上預先報到。

explains.en: Use this phrase when registering at a hotel or confirming you are taking a flight. A guest may do it at the front desk. Online options are common.
At an airport, travelers confirm their trip and receive a boarding pass. Hotel guests give their details when they arrive. This completes their arrival registration.
A traveler may register at a hotel and receive a room key. Airline passengers can confirm their flight by phone. The phrase has both travel uses.

examples.en: Remember to return your electronic room keycard when you check out.
examples.zh: 辦理退房手續時請記得歸還電子房卡。

examples.en: Hotel check-out time is strictly set at 11:00 AM unless late departure is approved.
examples.zh: 飯店退房時間嚴格訂為上午十一點，除非事先獲准辦理延遲退房。

examples.en: The front desk settled our room charges quickly as we prepared to check out.
examples.zh: 當我們準備退房時，櫃檯服務人員迅速為我們結清了房內消費帳目。

explains.en: Before leaving a hotel, guests pay their bill and return the room key. Ask the front desk if you need more time.
A traveler finishes the stay and settles any room charges. The hotel records that the room is available again.
When leaving a hotel, return the key card and take your bags. This phrase describes completing the departure process.

examples.en: Print out your booking confirmation email to present at the front desk.
examples.zh: 將訂房確認電子郵件列印出來以利在櫃檯出示查驗。

examples.en: We received an automated SMS confirmation immediately after submitting the order.
examples.zh: 送出訂單後，我們立刻收到了系統自動發送的簡訊確認通知。

examples.en: The lab awaits final confirmation of the test results before issuing the medical report.
examples.zh: 實驗室正在等待檢驗結果的最終確認，隨後才會正式出具醫療報告。

explains.en: An email or text may prove that a hotel room has been booked. Keep it for check-in.
A message tells you that an order was received. This word can also mean proof that something is true.
After sending a request, you may get a note saying it is accepted. A lab may also wait for proof before sharing results.

examples.en: Review the hotel's free cancellation policy before confirming the reservation.
examples.zh: 在確認送出預訂前，請先仔細查看飯店的免費取消條款。

examples.en: Sudden heavy snow caused the widespread cancellation of all domestic flights.
examples.zh: 突如其來的暴風大雪導致國內線所有航班全面被迫取消。

examples.en: The concert organizer offered full ticket refunds following the sudden cancellation.
examples.zh: 在演出突遭取消後，演唱會主辦單位承諾全額退還門票費用。

examples.en: Severe snowstorms forced widespread flight cancellations across northern Japan.
examples.zh: 日本北部遭遇罕見的特大暴風雪襲擊，迫使新千歲機場數十架航班無奈宣布全數取消。

examples.en: The airline offered full refunds or free ticket changes following the sudden route cancellation.
examples.zh: 針對此條突發航線調整取消，航空公司為受影響旅客提供了全額無條件退款或免費改票服務。

examples.en: Travelers should check travel insurance terms regarding compensation for unforeseen flight cancellations.
examples.zh: 出國行前應詳閱海外旅遊不便險之理賠條款，了解針對班機突發取消時可申請的各項衍生補償。

entries.definition: 取消；作廢；班機取消；作廢取消

explains.en: This is the act of deciding that a planned event, trip, or booking will not happen. Snow may stop flights. Customers may receive their money back after a concert is called off.
A hotel reservation or ticket may be ended before the event. A storm can cause many travel plans to change. Insurance may explain what costs are returned.
When an arrangement is stopped and will no longer take place, this action has happened. It can affect flights or shows. A refund may follow.

examples.en: Guests enjoy complimentary bottled water and daily high-speed Wi-Fi.
examples.zh: 住客享有免費贈送的瓶裝礦泉水與全日高速無線網路。

examples.en: The restaurant served complimentary dessert to celebrate our anniversary.
examples.zh: 餐廳主動為我們端上了免費招待的精緻甜點以慶祝我們的結婚紀念日。

examples.en: The reviewer wrote highly complimentary remarks about the author's new biography.
examples.zh: 評論家在書評中對該傳記作者的新作給予了極高的讚賞評價。

explains.en: It can describe something given for free, such as water in a hotel room. It can also mean expressing praise. Context shows which sense fits.
A restaurant may offer a small dessert without charging. In another use, a review may contain kind and admiring comments. The adjective has two common meanings.
Guests may receive this item at no extra cost. A speaker can also make a positive remark about someone's work. The word can mean free or praising.

examples.en: Joining a guided tour of the National Palace Museum enriches your historical knowledge.
examples.zh: 參加故宮博物院的專人深度導覽能豐富您的歷史人文知識。

examples.en: The wildlife reserve offers early morning guided tours led by veteran naturalists.
examples.zh: 野生動物保護區提供由資深自然生態專家親自帶隊的清晨導覽團。

examples.en: Audio headphones were provided during the multilingual guided tour.
examples.zh: 在多語種專人導覽行程中，主辦方為每位遊客配發了無線語音耳機。

explains.en: A museum worker leads visitors through the exhibits and explains what they see. The group follows a planned route.
At a nature reserve, a trained guide points out birds and plants along the path. Visitors can ask questions.
People visit a historic building with someone who shares stories and facts. The leader helps the group understand the place.

examples.en: The licensed bilingual tour guide shared fascinating stories of old temples.
examples.zh: 領有執照的雙語專業導遊娓娓道出古老廟宇的動人傳說。

examples.en: A knowledgeable tour guide pointed out rare alpine flora along the mountain path.
examples.zh: 博學多聞的導遊沿著崎嶇山徑為大家指認罕見的高山特色植物。

examples.en: Tourists applauded our enthusiastic tour guide at the conclusion of the trip.
examples.zh: 在旅程圓滿畫下句點時，遊客們向熱忱專業的導遊報以熱烈掌聲。

explains.en: This person shows visitors around a city or museum and shares information. The guide may speak more than one language.
A knowledgeable helper can point out plants or landmarks on a trip. Travelers may ask questions along the way.
Visitors follow this person through a historic place. The person explains what they are seeing.

examples.en: Sun cakes from Taichung and ox-tongue biscuits from Yilan are famous local delicacies.
examples.zh: 台中太陽餅與宜蘭牛舌餅皆為名聞遐邇的在地特色美食名產。

examples.en: Visitors to Tainan should not miss savory milkfish congee, a beloved local delicacy.
examples.zh: 造訪台南的遊客千萬別錯過鮮美虱目魚粥這道極具人氣的在地道地小吃。

examples.en: Night markets across the island offer hundreds of mouthwatering local delicacies.
examples.zh: 全台各地的特色夜市匯集了數百種令人垂涎欲滴的在地風味傳統美食。

entries.definition: 在地特色名產；道地美食

explains.en: This is a special food that people in one place are proud of. A city may be known for a sweet cake or fish dish. Visitors often want to try it.
A regional dish can be popular with residents and travelers. It may be a kind of soup, pastry, or snack. Night markets often sell many.
Use this phrase for a food specialty associated with a particular town or region. It may have a traditional recipe. Tourists may seek it out.

examples.en: Open a designated bank account to receive monthly direct salary deposits.
examples.zh: 開立一個指定的銀行帳戶以接收每月薪資入帳。

examples.en: You can check all recent transactions by logging into your digital bank account.
examples.zh: 登入數位網銀帳戶即可隨時查看所有近期交易明細記錄。

examples.en: Never reveal your secret bank account PIN code to strangers over the phone.
examples.zh: 絕不可在電話中將您的秘密銀行帳戶提款密碼透露給陌生人。

explains.en: It is a record kept by a bank for a customer's money. People can deposit pay and check recent transactions. Keep passwords and PINs private.
A person can open this account to save money or receive a salary. A digital service lets them see deposits and payments. Never share secret access details.
Banks keep track of the funds a customer owns or owes. The customer can use a card or online service to manage it. Direct deposits often go there.

examples.en: Business owners issue commercial checks drawn on their checking account.
examples.zh: 企業負責人開立由其支票帳戶扣款的商業支票。

examples.en: The accountant reconciled the company checking account balance at month-end.
examples.zh: 會計師在月底核對沖銷了公司支票帳戶的所有借貸餘額。

examples.en: Most people use checking accounts for everyday bills and debit card spending.
examples.zh: 大多數人主要利用經常支票帳戶來處理日常繳費與金融卡消費扣款。

explains.en: A person can deposit pay and use a debit card or checks to pay everyday bills. Money can be taken out when needed.
A business reviews its bank records each month to make sure payments match. This type of account is used for regular spending.
This bank account lets a customer pay bills and withdraw money often. It usually comes with a card for purchases.

examples.en: Compound interest is often called the eighth wonder of the economic world.
examples.zh: 複利常被譽為經濟理財世界中的「世界第八大奇蹟」。

examples.en: Starting to invest in your twenties maximizes the compounding effect of compound interest.
examples.zh: 從二十幾歲開始早早投入理財，能將複利增值的滾雪球效益發揮到極致。

examples.en: Reinvesting stock dividends harnesses compound interest to accelerate wealth building.
examples.zh: 將每期獲發的股票股息持續滾入再投資，能善用複利威力加速財富累積。

explains.en: When saved money earns interest, that interest can earn more later. The amount can grow over time.
Starting to save early gives money more time to grow. Reinvesting earnings creates this effect.
A bank or investment may add earnings to the original amount. Future earnings are then based on both parts.

examples.en: Paying bills on time maintains an excellent personal credit score.
examples.zh: 按時繳納各項帳單能維持極佳的個人信用評分。

examples.en: A low credit score can result in higher mortgage loan interest rates.
examples.zh: 過低的個人信用分數往往會導致銀行調高房貸核貸利率。

examples.en: Keeping credit card utilization below thirty percent helps raise your credit score.
examples.zh: 將信用卡額度使用率壓低在三成以內，有助於穩步拉高信用評分。

examples.en: Paying credit card balances on time maintains a pristine 800-point credit score.
examples.zh: 養成每期全額準時繳清信用卡帳單的良好習慣，能維持高達八百分的滿分聯徵個人信用評分。

examples.en: Lenders check your credit score before determining the interest rate on personal car loans.
examples.zh: 銀行在核定信用貸款或汽車貸款的放款利率時，會首先調閱聯徵中心評估個人信用評分水準。

examples.en: Maintaining a low credit utilization ratio helps boost your overall credit score quickly.
examples.zh: 隨時保持低比例的信用卡額度使用率，是快速拉升並優化個人聯徵信用評分的實用秘訣。

entries.definition: 信用評分；信用分數；個人聯徵信用評分 (JCIC)

explains.en: This number summarizes how reliably someone has borrowed and repaid money. Banks may use it when deciding whether to lend. Paying bills on time can help it.
A lender checks this record when someone applies for a loan. A lower result may mean higher interest. Responsible use of borrowing can improve it.
This measure helps a bank judge a person's borrowing history. It can affect the cost of a home or car loan. Paying debts promptly may raise it.

examples.en: You can request a temporary increase in credit limit before traveling abroad.
examples.zh: 出國旅遊前可向發卡銀行申請調高臨時信用卡刷卡額度。

examples.en: Maxing out your credit limit hurts your financial standing with creditors.
examples.zh: 將信用卡額度全數刷爆會損害你在金融放款機構心中的信用評價。

examples.en: The bank upgraded her card to platinum and doubled her monthly credit limit.
examples.zh: 銀行將她的信用卡尊榮升級為白金卡，並將每月的信用額度直接翻倍。

explains.en: It is the most money a bank allows someone to borrow on a credit card. Spending beyond it may be declined. A customer can ask the bank about changes.
A card issuer sets this maximum amount for purchases. Using all of it can affect a person's financial standing. Check the available amount before a trip.
This limit controls how much a cardholder may borrow. Banks may raise or lower it after reviewing an account. Paying bills on time can help.

examples.en: Apple Pay, Line Pay, and EasyCard are popular contactless payment methods.
examples.zh: Apple Pay、LINE Pay 與悠遊卡皆為極普及的感應式行動支付方式。

examples.en: Contactless payment terminals make transit subway turnstiles move much faster.
examples.zh: 感應式行動支付刷卡機大幅提升了地鐵捷運出入閘門的通關通行效率。

examples.en: The pandemic accelerated the global public adoption of hygienic contactless payment.
examples.zh: 疫情加速了全球各國大眾對衛生便捷的感應式支付技術的廣泛普及與採納。
