explains.en: A shopper taps a card or phone near a reader to pay. The device does not need to touch the terminal.
On a bus, a rider taps a travel card at the gate and enters quickly. This way of paying uses a short-range signal.
A customer can use a watch or phone to pay without inserting a card. The terminal reads it from nearby.

examples.en: Mobile banking allows users to transfer funds, pay bills, and invest easily.
examples.zh: 行動網銀讓使用者動動手指即可輕鬆轉帳、繳費與投資理財。

examples.en: High security standards in mobile banking rely on fingerprint or face logins.
examples.zh: 行動網銀極高的安全防護標準依賴生物辨識指紋或臉部辨識登入。

examples.en: Rural residents without physical branches nearby benefit immensely from mobile banking.
examples.zh: 附近沒有實體銀行分行的偏鄉居民從無遠弗屆的行動網銀中獲益良多。

explains.en: Use a phone to check an account or pay a bill. Strong passwords and secure logins help protect it.
A customer can send money without visiting a bank branch. Finger or face checks may help keep the account safe.
People in rural areas can manage money through a bank's phone service. They can transfer funds from home.

examples.en: Check favorable foreign exchange rates before exchanging Japanese yen.
examples.zh: 在兌換日幣現鈔前，先留意觀察優惠的外匯匯率走勢。

examples.en: Central banks maintain substantial foreign exchange reserves to stabilize currency value.
examples.zh: 各國央行持有充裕龐大的外匯存底，以隨時維持本國貨幣匯率平穩。

examples.en: Specialized mobile apps let travelers lock in attractive foreign exchange quotes.
examples.zh: 專業外匯行動 App 讓各國旅人能在匯率漂亮時即時鎖定優惠換匯價格。

explains.en: This is the process of changing one country's money into another country's money. Travelers may compare rates before trading cash. Banks keep reserves of different currencies.
Someone visiting another country may need to swap their money. A mobile app can show how much one currency is worth in another. The rate changes over time.
This term describes currency trading between countries. A traveler may change money before a trip. Banks also hold currencies to support international payments.

examples.en: The exchange rate between New Taiwan Dollar and US Dollar remains stable.
examples.zh: 新台幣與美金之間的匯率走勢保持平穩。

examples.en: A sudden fluctuation in the currency exchange rate impacted export profits.
examples.zh: 貨幣匯率的突發劇烈波動直接衝擊了出口貿易商的實質獲利。

examples.en: Tourists benefited from a favorable exchange rate when traveling across Europe.
examples.zh: 觀光客在歐洲各地自助旅行時，受惠於當時極為優惠划算的換算匯率。

explains.en: It tells how much of one country's money is worth in another currency. Travelers check it before changing cash. It can rise or fall.
When exchanging dollars for another currency, this value determines how much you receive. Banks and exchange offices display it. Changes can affect businesses too.
This figure compares the value of two currencies. A favorable value can make a trip cheaper. It changes with markets and economic conditions.

examples.en: Stock dividends and rental properties generate reliable monthly passive income.
examples.zh: 股票股利與出租房產能創造出穩健可靠的每月被動收入。

examples.en: Building an automated online store is one creative way to earn passive income.
examples.zh: 打造一套自動化線上商店是開創源源不絕被動收入的創意途徑之一。

examples.en: Relying entirely on active wages without passive income makes retirement difficult.
examples.zh: 若完全只依賴主動薪資收入而無任何被動收入，將讓退休規劃變得相當吃力。

examples.en: Building multiple streams of passive income frees your time for personal passions.
examples.zh: 打造涵蓋股票股息與不動產租金的多元被動收入來源，能將寶貴時間留給真正熱愛的事物。

examples.en: Rental properties and dividend stocks are proven pillars of reliable passive income.
examples.zh: 收租不動產與優質高股息指數基金，被公認為建構家庭長期穩定被動現金流的兩大核心支柱。

examples.en: Writing a bestselling e-book can generate royalty-based passive income for years to come.
examples.zh: 撰寫並上架一本叫好又叫座的暢銷電子書，能在未來數年間持續為作者帶來穩定的版稅被動收入。

entries.definition: 被動收入；被動收入（股息、房租、版稅）

explains.en: A person earns money from a rented room each month while someone else lives there. The income does not require daily work.
An author may continue earning royalties after writing a book. The money comes in over time from earlier work.
Dividends from shares can provide money without a person working each day for it. This is income earned with little ongoing effort.

examples.en: Many young professionals pursue early retirement and true financial freedom.
examples.zh: 許多青年上班族致力於追求及早退休與真正的財務自由。

examples.en: Disciplined spending, frugal living, and continuous investing lead to financial freedom.
examples.zh: 紀律嚴明的消費原則、簡樸生活與持之以恆的投資是通往財務自由的捷徑。

examples.en: Achieving financial freedom allowed her to pursue her passion for oil painting full-time.
examples.zh: 實現財務自由讓她能夠毫無後顧之憂地全心投入自己熱愛的油畫創作。

explains.en: A person with enough savings and income can make choices without worrying about every bill. Careful spending can help.
Some people save and invest for many years so they can choose how to spend their time. This is a money goal.
Living within a budget and saving steadily can help someone feel secure. They may have more choice about work and life.

examples.en: Novice investors often start by dollar-cost averaging into global mutual funds.
examples.zh: 投資新手常從定期定額買進全球共同基金開始起步。

examples.en: Professional portfolio managers oversee stock allocations within the mutual fund.
examples.zh: 專業資產配置投資經理人親自操盤監管該共同基金內部的各項持股權重。

examples.en: Look into the fund's expense ratio before buying shares in any mutual fund.
examples.zh: 在申購任何一檔共同基金份額前，請務必先仔細查閱其內扣管理費用率。

entries.definition: 共同基金；共同信託基金

explains.en: This is an investment that collects money from many people and uses it to buy a group of assets. A professional manager may choose the investments. Investors share the gains or losses.
Many people put money into one pooled fund. A manager buys shares or bonds with it. The value can rise or fall with the market.
This investment option lets people own a small part of a larger collection. It may hold stocks from many companies. Check its fees before investing.

examples.en: Broad-market index ETFs like 0050 provide diversified exposure to top companies.
examples.zh: 如 0050 等全市場型指數 ETF 能提供分散投資頂尖企業的良好管道。

examples.en: ETFs trade conveniently on stock exchanges just like regular company shares.
examples.zh: 指數股票型基金（ETF）在證券交易所公開掛牌交易，買賣手續如同一般普通股股票般便捷。

examples.en: High dividend yield ETFs are exceptionally popular among Taiwanese retail investors.
examples.zh: 高股息殖利率 ETF 在台灣廣大散戶投資人族群中享有極高的人氣。

examples.en: Taiwanese retail investors heavily favor broad-market index ETFs like 0050 and 006208.
examples.zh: 台灣廣大小資存股族極為推崇元大台灣卓越50（0050）與富邦台50（006208）等大盤市值型 ETF。

examples.en: An ETF trades continuously on stock exchanges just like an individual company stock.
examples.zh: 指數股票型基金（ETF）在證券集中市場上掛牌上市交易，能隨盤中股價波動隨時撮合買賣。

examples.en: Investing in a low-cost global equity ETF instantly spreads risk across thousands of firms.
examples.zh: 買進一檔極低內扣管理費的全球全市場股票型 ETF，即可在一秒之內將風險分散至數千家跨國企業。

entries.definition: 指數股票型基金 (ETF)；指數股票型基金 (Exchange-Traded Fund)

explains.en: It is an investment product whose shares are bought and sold on a stock exchange. It may hold many companies at once. Investors can trade it like a share.
This fund can track a market index or group of assets. Its units are traded during market hours. It may help spread investment across companies.
People can buy this listed fund through a brokerage. It often offers a simple way to invest in a basket of assets. Its value can go up or down.

examples.en: Selling stock shares at a higher purchase price results in a capital gain.
examples.zh: 以高於買進成本的價格賣出股票持股將產生資本利得收益。

examples.en: Long-term property owners celebrated substantial capital gains during the housing boom.
examples.zh: 長期持有房產的屋主在房地產景氣繁榮熱潮中享受到了豐厚的資產增值利益。

examples.en: Different tax jurisdictions apply varying tax rates to realized capital gains.
examples.zh: 不同國家與法域對已實現的資本利得收益課徵不同比例的資本利得稅。

examples.en: Selling shares after huge appreciation generates substantial long-term capital gains.
examples.zh: 在持股大幅上漲波段獲利了結賣出後，能為長線投資人帶來豐厚可觀的資本利得價差收入。

examples.en: Most jurisdictions tax long-term capital gains at lower rates than ordinary labor income.
examples.zh: 大多數已開發國家的稅法對持有超過一年的長期資本利得，往往提供比一般勞動薪資更優惠的稅率。

examples.en: Capital gains from real estate appreciation boosted their retirement nest egg significantly.
examples.zh: 過去數十年間不動產長線升值所累積的豐厚資本利得，為這對夫婦的晚年退休養老金增色不少。

entries.definition: 資本利得；資產增值收益；價差買賣獲利

explains.en: Someone buys a share for one price and later sells it for more. The difference is a profit from selling an asset.
A homeowner sells a property for more than they paid. The increase in value may be taxed.
If an investment grows in value before it is sold, the owner may earn this kind of profit. Tax rules depend on the place.

examples.en: Prolonged economic deflation can discourage business investment and spending.
examples.zh: 長期的通貨緊縮可能會抑制企業投資意願與民眾消費信心。

examples.en: Consumer prices dropped for the fifth consecutive month, signaling lingering deflation.
examples.zh: 消費者物價指數連續五個月呈現負成長下滑，顯示通縮陰霾依舊揮之不去。

examples.en: Central banks fear persistent deflation because it depresses consumer demand.
examples.zh: 各國中央銀行極力防範頑固的通貨緊縮，因為它會嚴重壓抑整體市場消費動能。

explains.en: When prices across a country keep falling, people may delay buying things. Businesses can then earn less.
A long period of falling prices can make companies cautious about investing. It may also lower demand.
This economic condition means the general cost of goods is decreasing. Central banks try to prevent it from lasting too long.

examples.en: Higher salaries increase consumer purchasing power for durable goods.
examples.zh: 薪資實質增長能提升消費者對於耐久財的購買力。

examples.en: When local currency depreciates against the dollar, import purchasing power declines.
examples.zh: 當本國貨幣對美元匯率走貶時，進口商品與原物料的實質採購力便會下滑。

examples.en: The index measures the relative purchasing power of blue-collar workers across cities.
examples.zh: 該經濟指標客觀衡量了各主要城市藍領基層勞工的相對實質購買力水準。

explains.en: This describes how much a person's money can buy. A higher salary may let someone purchase more goods. Rising prices can reduce it.
When prices go up, the same amount of money may buy fewer things. A currency's value also affects what people can afford from abroad. This is a measure of buying ability.
Use this phrase for the amount of goods and services that money can purchase. It may change with wages and prices. Economists compare it across places.

examples.en: Purchasing life insurance offers peace of mind and protection for dependents.
examples.zh: 投保人壽保險能為家庭摯愛受撫養者提供安心無虞的經濟防護網。

examples.en: The family received a payout from their father's life insurance policy.
examples.zh: 該家庭順利獲發了其已故父親生前投保之人壽保險身故理賠保險金。

examples.en: Financial planners recommend term life insurance for primary household earners.
examples.zh: 專業理財顧問極力建議家中的經濟頂樑柱主力支柱應優先規劃定期壽險。

explains.en: It is an agreement that pays money to chosen family members if the insured person dies. It can help support dependents. Policies have different costs and rules.
A person may buy this protection so relatives receive financial help later. A planner can explain the policy. Read its terms carefully.
This kind of insurance provides a payment to beneficiaries after someone's death. Families may use it to cover expenses. The amount depends on the policy.

examples.en: Location and transport links determine the long-term value of real estate.
examples.zh: 地段與交通便利性決定了不動產房地產的長期保值增值潛力。

examples.en: Commercial real estate in downtown Taipei attracts heavy institutional investment.
examples.zh: 台北市精華蛋黃區的商用不動產吸引了眾多國內外法人機構的重金注資。

examples.en: He obtained his license to practice as a certified commercial real estate broker.
examples.zh: 他經過嚴格國家考試考核，順利取得了合格不動產經紀人的執業證照。

examples.en: Real estate near convenient metro stations tends to retain value strongly.
examples.zh: 緊鄰捷運站出口、生活機能完善的捷運宅房地產往往具備極佳的保值性。

examples.en: He decided to invest in commercial real estate after selling his tech startup.
examples.zh: 在賣掉創立的科技新創公司後，他決定將資金投資於商用不動產市場。

examples.en: The real estate market cooled down following government regulations on speculation.
examples.zh: 在政府祭出各項打擊短期炒作的房市調控措施後，房地產市場逐漸降溫回歸理性。

entries.definition: 房地產；不動產；不動產物業

explains.en: A family buys a house and the land beneath it. Homes, shops, and other buildings are part of this market.
A broker helps someone find an apartment or office to buy. The business involves land and buildings.
Property near a train station may be valuable to buyers. This term includes land and the buildings on it.

examples.en: Many young couples aspire to become proud homeowners before forty.
examples.zh: 許多青年夫妻期盼能在四十歲前圓夢晉升為自住屋主。

examples.en: Subsidized interest rates make mortgage loans more accessible to first-time homeowners.
examples.zh: 政府優惠利率補貼措施使首購族青年成家自住屋主能更輕鬆取得房貸。

examples.en: Homeowners are personally responsible for repairing plumbing leaks and roof upkeep.
examples.zh: 自有房屋屋主必須親自承擔維護修繕水管漏水與屋頂防水保養的所有責任。

explains.en: This person owns the house or apartment where they live. The owner is responsible for repairs.
A couple may save money to buy their first home. After buying it, they become the people who own it.
If a pipe leaks in your own house, you may need to arrange repairs. This word names the owner of a home.

examples.en: Saving a 20% home down payment requires years of disciplined budgeting.
examples.zh: 存下兩成的購屋頭期款需要數年如一日紀律嚴明的儲蓄規劃。

examples.en: The dealership required a five-thousand-dollar down payment before delivering the electric car.
examples.zh: 汽車經銷商要求在正式交付該輛全新電動車前，必須先繳足五千美元首期付款。

examples.en: Parents often gift financial assistance toward their adult children's apartment down payment.
examples.zh: 父母往往會提供部分財務贊助，協助成家立業的成年子女支付買房自備款。

examples.en: Saving a 20% down payment is the first major step toward homeownership.
examples.zh: 踏實存下相當於總房價兩成的購屋自備款頭期款是實現買房成家夢想的第一大步。

examples.en: They lived frugally for six years to accumulate the required down payment for their flat.
examples.zh: 他們省吃儉用努力奮鬥了整整六年，終於如願存到了心目中理想成家小窩的足額購屋頭期款。

examples.en: Once the down payment is wired to escrow, the home purchase agreement becomes legally binding.
examples.zh: 一旦購屋自備款頭期款正式全數匯入履約保證專戶，不動產買賣契約便具備完全法律效力。

entries.definition: 頭期款；首期付款；訂金；購屋自備款

explains.en: This is the first part of a large price that a buyer pays before borrowing the rest. Someone buying a home may save for years. The remaining amount is paid later.
A car dealer may ask for this amount before handing over a vehicle. It lowers how much money must be borrowed. The buyer pays the balance over time.
When purchasing an expensive item, a person may pay some money at the beginning. A home agreement may require it before the sale continues. It is part of the total cost.

examples.en: The electronic appliance store offers twelve-month zero-interest installments.
examples.zh: 該家電量販商場提供十二期零利率信用卡分期付款優惠。

examples.en: He pays his smartphone plan and device cost in twenty-four monthly installments.
examples.zh: 他將智慧型手機月租費與空機購機款拆分為二十四期每月分期攤還。

examples.en: Readers waited in eager anticipation for the next installment of the serialized fantasy story.
examples.zh: 忠實讀者們滿心期盼地守候著這部人氣奇幻長篇連載故事的下一期最新回數。

examples.en: Budgeting ensures your monthly mortgage installment does not exceed one-third of income.
examples.zh: 做好家庭收支規劃，確保每個月繳納的房屋貸款分期金額不超過家庭每月總收入的三分之一。

examples.en: The retailer offered a twelve-month zero-interest installment plan for the new smartphone.
examples.zh: 該 3C 連鎖旗艦門市針對最新款旗艦手機推出了為期十二期零利率信用卡分期付款優惠。

examples.en: Paying off each monthly installment punctually improves your personal credit rating.
examples.zh: 每個月按時全額繳清各項消費分期期數款項，能在聯合徵信中心逐步累積優質的個人信用。

entries.definition: 分期付款；每期還款額；分期連載；每月分期付款額；分期

explains.en: It is one payment in a series used to pay for something over time. A buyer may pay for a phone monthly. A story released in parts can also have these.
Instead of paying the full cost at once, a customer pays smaller scheduled amounts. A novel may also come out chapter by chapter. Each part is this.
This noun can name a regular payment toward a purchase. It can also mean one section of a serialized story. The next part may arrive later.

examples.en: Schools now offer dedicated workshops to support student mental health.
examples.zh: 學校現在開設了專屬工作坊以全力支持學生的心理健康。

examples.en: Work-life balance plays a vital role in sustaining long-term mental health.
examples.zh: 工作與生活間的平衡對於維持長期的身心健康扮演著關鍵角色。

examples.en: Open discussions help break the stigma surrounding mental health issues.
examples.zh: 公開坦誠的討論有助於破除社會對心理精神健康議題的刻板偏見。

explains.en: Feeling calm, managing stress, and asking for help are all part of caring for the mind. It matters at every age.
Schools may offer counselors for students who feel worried or sad. These services support emotional well-being.
Talking with someone trusted can help a person cope with difficult feelings. Looking after the mind is as important as looking after the body.

examples.en: Professional psychological counseling provides a safe space to share feelings.
examples.zh: 專業心理諮商能提供一個安心安全的空間傾訴內心感受。

examples.en: The university career center offers free resume counseling for graduating seniors.
examples.zh: 大學就業輔導中心為應屆畢業生提供免費的履歷健檢諮商輔導。

examples.en: Marriage counseling helped the couple resolve deep-seated communication barriers.
examples.zh: 婚姻諮商協助這對夫妻化解了根深蒂固的溝通障礙。

explains.en: A trained person listens and helps someone talk through a problem. It can support mental health.
A student may meet an adviser to discuss careers or school choices. Couples may also seek help together.
This guided conversation can help people manage feelings or relationships. A university may offer it for free.

examples.en: Focus on slow breathing if you experience symptoms of a panic attack.
examples.zh: 若察覺出現恐慌發作的生理徵兆，請先專注於緩慢吐氣吸氣。

examples.en: During a sudden panic attack, her heart raced and she felt dizzy.
examples.zh: 在突發的恐慌發作過程中，她心跳劇烈加速並且感到一陣暈眩。

examples.en: Learning grounding grounding techniques can help manage the onset of a panic attack.
examples.zh: 學習著陸定心技巧有助於妥善應對恐慌發作初期的不適反應。

explains.en: This is a sudden period of intense fear that can make a person's heart race or cause dizziness. Slow breathing and grounding can help. A health professional can offer support.
Someone may feel terrified even when there is no immediate danger. Their body can shake or feel short of breath. Learning calming techniques may help manage it.
This sudden wave of fear can bring strong physical feelings. A person may feel dizzy or have a fast heartbeat. Support and treatment are available.

examples.en: Avoiding screen time before bedtime helps treat chronic insomnia.
examples.zh: 睡前避免滑手機使用 3C 螢幕有助於改善長期慢性失眠。

examples.en: High work stress and excessive caffeine intake often lead to frustrating insomnia.
examples.zh: 沉重的工作壓力與攝取過量咖啡因常會引發令人煩悶的失眠困擾。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed mild herbal teas to relieve her temporary insomnia.
examples.zh: 醫師建議飲用溫和的草本花草茶，以緩解她短暫的失眠困擾。

examples.en: Reducing blue light screen exposure before bed helps overcome chronic insomnia.
examples.zh: 睡前一小時停止滑手機、減少螢幕藍光刺激有助於改善長期困擾的失眠症與多夢。

examples.en: Chronic insomnia can impair memory, weaken the immune system, and increase anxiety.
examples.zh: 長期為慢性失眠所苦不僅會嚴重削弱大腦記憶力，還會破壞人體免疫系統並加劇焦慮。

examples.en: She tried herbal chamomile tea and relaxing bedtime reading to manage her insomnia.
examples.zh: 她嘗試在每晚睡前沖泡一杯溫熱洋甘菊茶並伴著柔和燈光閱讀紙本書，藉此改善失眠難眠。

examples.en: Cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) effectively cures sleeplessness without pills.
examples.zh: 針對慢性失眠症推行的「失眠認知行為治療」（CBT-I），能無需長期仰賴安眠藥物徹底根治失眠。

examples.en: She suffered from acute insomnia for weeks following the sudden loss of her beloved grandmother.
examples.zh: 在至親祖母意外離世後的數週內，她身陷嚴重的急性失眠痛苦之中，整夜難以闔眼。

examples.en: Eliminating late-night screen time and heavy meals is the first practical step in overcoming insomnia.
examples.zh: 戒除深夜滑手機的惡習並避免睡前暴飲暴食，是告別反覆失眠、重拾甜美睡眠的第一步關鍵行動。

entries.definition: 失眠；失眠症；入睡困難；慢性失眠症；失眠失調

explains.en: It is a condition that makes it hard to fall asleep or stay asleep. Stress and caffeine can contribute. A doctor may suggest ways to improve rest.
Someone with this problem may lie awake for a long time at night. Avoiding screens before bed can help some people. Ongoing trouble should be discussed with a doctor.
This sleep problem can leave a person tired during the day. It may be temporary or last a long time. A health professional can offer advice.

examples.en: Modern fitness clubs emphasize holistic wellness, combining yoga and nutrition.
examples.zh: 現代健身中心強調結合瑜珈與營養的全人身心健康理念。

examples.en: Corporate wellness programs offer gym subsidies and ergonomic desk setups.
examples.zh: 企業員工健康福祉專案提供健身房補助與人體工學升降辦公桌椅配備。

examples.en: Taking a weekend retreat in nature can restore your emotional wellness.
examples.zh: 到大自然中度過一趟週末靜修之旅，能有效重啟並修復你的情緒健康。

examples.en: Holistic wellness integrates physical fitness, balanced nutrition, and peaceful mindfulness.
examples.zh: 全方位身心健康福祉完美整合了規律運動、均衡原型飲食與安詳平靜的正念冥想。

examples.en: The company opened an employee wellness center equipped with a fitness gym and nap pods.
examples.zh: 幸福企業在總部大樓內打造了員工身心活力健康中心，配備了頂級健身器材與靜音充電睡眠艙。

examples.en: True wellness encompasses not just the absence of disease, but a vibrant state of mind.
examples.zh: 真正的全人身心健康境界絕非僅僅代表著身體毫無疾病，更象徵著內心充滿豐盈活力與幸福感。

examples.en: Sleep is the foundational cornerstone underpinning all physical health, mental clarity, and holistic wellness.
examples.zh: 充足優質的好眠是支撐身體強健免疫、心靈平靜樂觀與全方位身心健康平衡不可動搖的最高基石。

examples.en: Corporate employee wellness programs often provide gym subsidies, counseling services, and nutrition talks.
examples.zh: 現代企業推行的員工全人健康福祉計畫，涵蓋了健身房月費全額補助、心理諮商管道與健康飲食講座。

examples.en: True holistic wellness involves cultivating emotional resilience, social bonds, and physical fitness in balance.
examples.zh: 真正意義上的全人健康福祉，在於心智韌性、溫暖人際社會連結與身體生理機能三者間取得動態完美平衡。

examples.en: Purified indoor air and circadian lighting systems support daily employee cognitive wellness and vitality.
examples.zh: 透過深度過濾淨化室內空氣與晝夜節律仿日光照明，全面提升員工每日的思考專注力與身心福祉。

examples.en: Attaining the international WELL certification confirms the company’s investment in staff physical wellness.
examples.zh: 獲得嚴苛的國際 WELL 健康建築金級認證，印證了這家科技企業對員工生理健康福祉的高度承諾。

examples.en: Natural views of trees and blue sky from desks markedly enhance mental wellness and creative thinking.
examples.zh: 辦公桌放眼望去能眺望蓊鬱綠樹與蔚藍天空的景觀設計，能顯著提振員工的心理福祉與創意思維。

examples.en: Enrichment toys and varied sensory stimuli support the holistic psychological wellness of captive dolphins.
examples.zh: 提供豐富化益智玩具與多元感官刺激，全面保障水族館海豚與海獅的心理「健康與生活福祉」（Wellness）。

examples.en: The corporate retreat included morning yoga and mindfulness seminars focused on employee wellness.
examples.zh: 該企業年度員工共識營貼心安排了清晨晨曦瑜伽與正念靜心講座，全力守護同仁的身心靈全人健康。

examples.en: Proper sleep, balanced nutrition, and regular exercise are cornerstones of lifelong personal wellness.
examples.zh: 充足高質量的睡眠、均衡營養的飲食與規律運動習慣，是打造終身長效健康與美好生活的黃金基石。

entries.definition: 身心健康；全人健康福祉；全人福祉；全方位身心健康平衡狀態；國際 WELL 健康建築認證之身心福祉；全方位海洋動物身心健康福祉指標

explains.en: Eating balanced meals, sleeping well, and moving the body support a healthy life. This idea includes more than simply not being sick.
A workplace may offer exercise classes and quiet rooms to support employees’ health. Such programs aim to help people feel well.
Taking care of the body, feelings, and social connections can improve overall well-being. Rest and healthy habits are part of it.

examples.en: Eating a balanced diet with whole grains and vegetables prevents lifestyle diseases.
examples.zh: 攝取包含全穀雜糧與充足蔬菜的均衡飲食能預防各類文明病。

examples.en: A balanced diet should include adequate proteins, healthy fats, and fiber.
examples.zh: 均衡健康的飲食應涵蓋足量的優質蛋白質、好油脂肪與膳食纖維。

examples.en: School lunch programs must adhere strictly to balanced diet nutritional guidelines.
examples.zh: 各級學校的營養午餐菜單設計必須嚴格遵守均衡飲食的營養指引標準。

explains.en: Eating different kinds of healthy food gives the body what it needs. Include grains, vegetables, and protein.
A meal plan with enough nutrients can support good health. It should not rely on just one kind of food.
Whole grains, fruits, vegetables, and healthy fats can all be part of a healthy way of eating. Variety matters.

examples.en: Adequate sleep and regular exercise strengthen your body's immune system.
examples.zh: 充足優質的睡眠與規律運動能增強人體自身的免疫系統防護力。

examples.en: A weakened immune system makes individuals more vulnerable to seasonal flu.
examples.zh: 虛弱低下的免疫系統會讓個體更容易遭受季節性流感病毒的感染。

examples.en: Chronic lack of rest takes a heavy toll on the human immune system.
examples.zh: 長期缺乏睡眠休養會對人體的免疫防護防線造成嚴重的慢性折損。

explains.en: This is the body's defense network that helps fight germs and illness. Sleep and exercise can support it. A weakened one makes a person more likely to get sick.
The body uses cells and organs to protect itself from infections. Rest helps this defense work well. Doctors may check it when someone is often ill.
This system recognizes and fights harmful germs. It helps keep people healthy. Good sleep and nutrition support its work.

examples.en: Vaccinations help human bodies develop protective immunity against viruses.
examples.zh: 接種疫苗能幫助人體建立起對抗致命病毒的保護性免疫力。

examples.en: Diplomatic immunity protects accredited foreign envoys from local prosecution.
examples.zh: 外交豁免權保障了派駐當地的外國使節官員免受在地法律的刑事追訴。

examples.en: Natural immunity acquired after recovering from measles lasts a lifetime.
examples.zh: 罹患麻疹康復痊癒後所獲得的天然自體免疫力通常能終身維持。

explains.en: It is the body's ability to resist a disease. Vaccines can help build protection against viruses. The word can also mean legal freedom from a rule.
After recovering from some illnesses, a person may have protection against getting them again. Diplomats can have special legal protection. Context tells the meaning.
A healthy body can defend itself against germs. A vaccine may help the body prepare. This protection helps prevent illness.

examples.en: Childhood vaccination programs protect the public from severe epidemics.
examples.zh: 幼童常規疫苗接種計畫保護廣大社會大眾免於嚴重傳染病威脅。

examples.en: High community vaccination rates create robust herd protection against disease.
examples.zh: 崇高的社區疫苗接種普及率能築起抵禦傳染病擴散的群體免疫防線。

examples.en: Bring your official yellow immunization card when attending vaccination clinics.
examples.zh: 前往衛生所或診所接種施打疫苗時，請隨身攜帶兒童健康手冊與黃卡。

examples.en: Annual rabies vaccinations and core booster shots keep your dog healthy.
examples.zh: 每年定期施打公費狂犬病預防疫苗與核心多合一疫苗能確保愛犬身體健康。

examples.en: Puppies require a series of basic vaccinations starting at six to eight weeks of age.
examples.zh: 幼犬在出生後六至八週起，就需要陸續施打一系列基礎預防針疫苗。

examples.en: Always keep your pet's vaccination record booklet up to date for travel and boarding.
examples.zh: 請妥善保存並隨時更新毛孩的預防接種疫苗手冊，以備外出寄宿或搭機時查驗。

examples.en: Routine core vaccinations protect kittens against deadly feline panleukopenia and respiratory viruses.
examples.zh: 按時依時程施打核心三合一疫苗，能有效保護幼貓遠離致命的貓瘟與各類上呼吸道傳染病毒。

examples.en: The shelter ensures every rescued dog receives initial vaccinations before being put up for adoption.
examples.zh: 收容所確保每隻獲救狗狗在開放認養前，均已完成基礎疫苗接種。

examples.en: Keep an updated vaccination certificate handy whenever you travel with your pet across borders.
examples.zh: 攜帶寵物跨國境旅行時，請務必隨身攜帶最新的疫苗接種證明。

entries.definition: 疫苗接種；打預防針；預防針疫苗接種；預防針疫苗施打；免疫接種

explains.en: A health worker gives a shot to help a person’s body learn to fight a disease. Bring the child’s health record to the clinic.
A pet receives a preventive shot at the vet to protect it from illness. The date is written in its record book.
This medical step helps protect a community from infections. Doctors and nurses provide it according to local health guidance.

examples.en: Reducing salt and fried food intake helps manage high blood pressure (hypertension).
examples.zh: 減少鹽分與油炸重鹹食物攝取有助於控制高血壓（hypertension）。

examples.en: If left untreated, severe hypertension increases the risk of stroke and heart disease.
examples.zh: 若任其發展不加妥善治療，長期嚴重高血壓會大幅增加中風與心臟病風險。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a low-dose medication to stabilize his hypertension.
examples.zh: 醫師開立了溫和低劑量的降血壓藥物，以協助穩定他的高血壓病情。

examples.en: Managing hypertension requires a low-sodium diet and regular aerobic exercise.
examples.zh: 控制與改善慢性高血壓需要嚴格落實少鹽低鈉飲食，並配合每週規律的有氧慢跑運動。

examples.en: Hypertension is known as a silent killer because it often displays no obvious warnings.
examples.zh: 高血壓常被醫界冠上「隱形殺手」的稱號，因為它在悄悄破壞血管前往往沒有明顯症狀。

examples.en: Regular morning blood pressure readings help monitor how well hypertension drugs are working.
examples.zh: 養成每天早晨起床後量測並記錄血壓的良好習慣，能清楚反映降血壓處方藥物的控壓成效。

entries.definition: 高血壓；高血壓 (High Blood Pressure)

explains.en: This health problem means the force of blood against artery walls stays too high. A doctor can check it.
Eating less salty food and exercising may help manage this condition. Many people do not notice clear signs.
A medical professional may prescribe medicine and suggest regular checks. Treating this condition can lower the risk of heart trouble.

examples.en: Childhood obesity has become a major public health concern globally.
examples.zh: 兒童肥胖症已演變成全球公共衛生領域的一大關注焦點。

examples.en: Replacing sugary soft drinks with plain water is a simple step to fight obesity.
examples.zh: 用純淨白開水全面取代含糖汽水飲料，是有效對抗肥胖的關鍵第一步。

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise combined with portion control reduces the risk of obesity.
examples.zh: 規律的有氧體能鍛鍊搭配每餐份量控制，能顯著降低過度肥胖的風險。

explains.en: This is a health condition in which a person has too much body fat for good health. It can raise the risk of illness. Healthy food and activity can help prevent it.
Doctors may use a person's height and weight to assess this condition. Sugary drinks and too little exercise can contribute. Support from health professionals can help.
This medical term describes unhealthy excess body fat. Regular movement and balanced meals can lower the risk. It can affect both children and adults.

examples.en: The doctor ordered a routine blood test to check liver and kidney function.
examples.zh: 醫師安排了例行常規抽血檢驗以評估肝腎各項功能指數。

examples.en: You must fast for eight hours before taking an accurate fasting blood test.
examples.zh: 為了確保空腹抽血檢驗的精準度，受檢前必須先嚴格禁食八小時。

examples.en: The lab completed the urgent blood test within two hours.
examples.zh: 檢驗醫學實驗室在短短兩小時內便火速完成了這項緊急抽血檢驗報告。

explains.en: It is a medical check that examines a small sample of blood. Doctors use it to learn about health, such as liver function. A person may need to fast first.
A nurse takes a sample from a vein and sends it to a lab. The results can help diagnose illness. Follow the clinic's instructions beforehand.
This test measures substances in a person's blood. It may show how organs are working. Results usually come from a medical laboratory.

examples.en: The orthopedic surgeon took an X-ray to check for hairline wrist fractures.
examples.zh: 骨科醫師安排照了 X 光片以檢查手腕是否有隱匿性微細骨折。

examples.en: Dental clinics take panoramic X-rays to assess wisdom tooth growth.
examples.zh: 牙醫診所拍攝全口環景 X 光片以評估智齒的生長與埋伏生長走向。

examples.en: Airport security uses X-ray scanners to inspect all carry-on baggage.
examples.zh: 機場安檢處運用先進的 X 光行李掃描儀全面透視檢查所有隨身登機行李。

explains.en: A dentist uses a special picture to see teeth beneath the gums. Doctors may use one to check a broken bone.
At an airport, bags pass through a machine that makes pictures of what is inside. The image helps staff inspect luggage.
The picture uses a small amount of radiation to show bones or objects inside a bag. A doctor explains the result.

examples.en: Expectant mothers look at clear fetal ultrasound scans with pure joy.
examples.zh: 準媽媽們滿懷無比喜悅看著清晰的胎兒產檢超音波影像。

examples.en: The physician ordered an abdominal ultrasound to examine the gallbladder.
examples.zh: 內科醫師安排了腹部超音波檢查以詳細檢視膽囊內部是否有結石病變。

examples.en: Bats navigate and hunt insects in total darkness using high-frequency ultrasound.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠在漆黑無光的深夜中，巧妙利用自身發射的高頻超音波定位飛行並捕獵昆蟲。

examples.en: Abdominal ultrasound scans showed healthy kidneys and normal liver structure.
examples.zh: 透過高解析度腹部超音波詳細掃描確認毛孩的雙側腎臟與肝臟結構均呈現健康無異狀。

examples.en: The veterinarian used an ultrasound machine to check whether the pregnant dog was healthy.
examples.zh: 獸醫師運用獸用超音波儀器詳細掃描，確認即將分娩的懷孕母犬與胎兒皆狀況良好。

examples.en: Ultrasound is a safe, painless, non-invasive imaging tool commonly used in pet diagnostics.
examples.zh: 腹部超音波是一種安全、無痛且不具侵入性的高階影像檢驗工具，廣泛應用於寵物醫療診斷。

examples.en: Pocket-sized handheld ultrasound probes allow emergency doctors to assess internal trauma right at the bedside.
examples.zh: 口袋大小的掌上型手持式無線超音波（Ultrasound），讓急診醫師能在病床旁一秒評估腹腔內出血。

examples.en: Expectant parents held hands and smiled with joy as the obstetrician shared live 4D fetus ultrasound images.
examples.zh: 滿懷期盼的準爸媽在婦產科診間緊緊牽著手，看著螢幕上婦產科主任分享的四維超音波胎兒即時動態微笑。

examples.en: Bats navigate pitch-black caves effortlessly by emitting and listening to ultrasonic pulses beyond human hearing.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠在伸手不見五指的幽暗洞穴中高速穿梭自如，全憑發射並接收人耳不可聽見的高頻超音波回聲定位。

entries.definition: 超音波檢查；超音波；腹部超音波檢查；超聲波；掌上型手持式無線超音波 (POCUS)

explains.en: Doctors use sound waves to make pictures of parts inside the body. A parent may see an image of a baby before birth.
A veterinarian can use this painless scan to check a pet's organs. Bats also use very high sounds to find insects in the dark.
This medical test helps a doctor look inside the body without surgery. It can show a baby's movement or a person's gallbladder.

examples.en: The anesthesiologist administered general anesthesia before the procedure began.
examples.zh: 麻醉專科醫師在手術開始前為病患施作了全身麻醉。

examples.en: Dental patients often receive local anesthesia before cavity fillings or extractions.
examples.zh: 牙科病人在接受蛀牙補牙或拔牙療程前，通常會先施打局部麻醉針。

examples.en: She felt groggy and thirsty as the effects of the anesthesia wore off.
examples.zh: 當麻醉藥劑的藥效逐漸退去時，她感覺頭昏腦脹且喉嚨異常口渴。

examples.en: Isoflurane inhalation anesthesia with full vital monitoring ensures painless surgical safety.
examples.zh: 採用頂級氣體吸入式麻醉並搭配全程生理監視器監控，能確保毛孩手術過程安全無痛。

examples.en: Before placing a pet under anesthesia, vets perform comprehensive pre-op blood panels.
examples.zh: 在為寵物施打氣體麻醉之前，獸醫師一定會先進行全面的術前血液生化檢驗把關風險。

examples.en: The dog groggily woke up from anesthesia wrapped in warm blankets inside the recovery kennel.
examples.zh: 狗狗在術後保溫恢復病房內被厚實溫暖的毛毯包裹著，漸漸從麻醉狀態中清醒過來。

examples.en: Continuous brain wave monitoring ensures the patient remains in safe, deep anesthesia throughout surgery.
examples.zh: 麻醉專科醫師全程透過腦電波深度監控儀，確保病患在整場大手術中維持絕對安全且安睡無痛的麻醉狀態。

examples.en: The dentist applied local anesthesia to numb the upper gum before performing the root canal procedure.
examples.zh: 牙醫在展開顯微根管治療前，先在上顎牙齦周圍進行局部麻醉注射，使神經完全麻木以確保療程全程無痛。

examples.en: Fasting for eight hours prior to surgery prevents pulmonary aspiration during general anesthesia induction.
examples.zh: 術前嚴格恪守空腹禁食八小時規範，是防止全身麻醉誘導插管時因胃內容物嘔吐反流引發致命吸入性肺炎的關鍵。

entries.definition: 麻醉；麻醉狀態；氣體麻醉監控；手術全身麻醉深度監測

explains.en: This is medicine that stops a person from feeling pain during an operation or dental procedure. It may numb one small area or make someone sleep. A trained doctor monitors the patient.
Before surgery, a medical worker may give this so the patient does not feel pain. Its effects wear off afterward. The person may feel sleepy or thirsty as they wake.
This medicine helps prevent pain during a procedure. Some types affect only one part of the body, while others make a person unconscious. Doctors carefully watch the patient.

examples.en: Critical patients receive 24-hour constant monitoring in the intensive care unit.
examples.zh: 重症病患在加護病房內接受二十四小時全天候精密監護照護。

examples.en: Relatives waited anxiously outside the doors of the intensive care unit.
examples.zh: 家屬們心急如焚地在加護病房緊閉的大門外焦急守候。

examples.en: The patient made steady progress and was moved from the intensive care unit to a regular ward.
examples.zh: 病患各項生命體徵穩步好轉，順利從加護病房轉至一般普通病房繼續休養。

explains.en: It is a hospital area for people who are very ill or badly injured. Nurses and doctors watch patients around the clock. Machines may help them breathe.
A patient who needs close medical attention may stay in this special ward. Families often wait nearby. Staff monitor health carefully.
This hospital department treats people with serious conditions. Medical teams provide constant care. A person may move to a regular ward after improving.

examples.en: Learning basic first aid techniques enables you to save lives in crises.
examples.zh: 學習基礎急救技巧能讓你在危急意外關頭挽救寶貴生命。

examples.en: The scout leader administered first aid to the hiker who scraped his elbow.
examples.zh: 童軍團長為登山途中不慎擦傷手肘的登山同伴進行了初步急救敷裹。

examples.en: All lifeguards must hold valid certifications in cardiopulmonary first aid.
examples.zh: 所有合格救生員均必須持有仍在有效效期內的急救心肺復甦合格證照。

explains.en: If someone gets a small cut, clean it and cover it while waiting for more help. These early care steps can reduce harm.
A scout leader helps a hiker with a scraped elbow before a doctor is needed. Learning basic care can be useful in an accident.
People can learn how to help someone who is hurt or suddenly ill. Call emergency services for serious problems.

examples.en: Every household and classroom should have an easily accessible first aid kit.
examples.zh: 每個家庭與學校教室內都應配備放置於顯眼易取處的急救箱。

examples.en: We packed bandages, antiseptic wipes, and tweezers into our hiking first aid kit.
examples.zh: 我們在登山急救包裡備齊了彈性繃帶、無菌消毒棉片以及專用小鑷子。

examples.en: Inspect your car first aid kit annually to replace any expired medication.
examples.zh: 每年定期開箱檢視車用急救箱，以即時淘汰並更換任何過期常備藥品。

explains.en: This box holds bandages and other supplies for small injuries. Keep one at home or in a car.
A hiker may pack wipes and bandages in this emergency box. Check that the medicine inside has not expired.
If someone gets a minor cut, supplies from this box can help. Schools and homes should keep one easy to find.

examples.en: Performing continuous chest compressions (CPR) keeps blood flowing to the brain.
examples.zh: 持續施行胸外按壓心肺復甦術（CPR）能維持大腦血液供氧。

examples.en: Bystanders acted heroically by performing CPR until paramedics arrived on the scene.
examples.zh: 熱心目擊民眾見義勇為，在救護人員趕抵現場前接力持續施行 CPR。

examples.en: The community center hosts free CPR and AED practical training sessions.
examples.zh: 社區活動中心定期舉辦免費的心肺復甦術（CPR）與 AED 實作訓練課程。

explains.en: This emergency action uses chest presses and sometimes breaths to help keep blood moving when someone's heart stops. A trained bystander may begin before paramedics arrive. Taking a class helps people learn safely.
If a person is not breathing normally, someone trained in this lifesaving method can press on the chest. This may keep oxygen moving to the brain. Emergency services should also be called.
This first-aid technique is used when a person's heart has stopped. Chest compressions help move blood through the body. Community classes can teach it along with a defibrillator.

examples.en: Public metro stations in Taiwan are all equipped with automated external defibrillators (AEDs).
examples.zh: 台灣各大捷運車站均全面普及設置了 AED 自動體外心臟電擊器。

examples.en: The automated defibrillator delivers a guided electric shock to restore regular heart rhythm.
examples.zh: 自動電擊去顫器能釋放精準語音引導的電擊，協助心臟恢復正常跳動心律。

examples.en: Clear voice instructions guide lay rescuers on how to use the portable defibrillator.
examples.zh: 設備內建極其清晰明瞭的真人語音指示，引導非專業施救者正確操作攜帶型電擊器。

entries.definition: 自動體外心臟電擊去顫器 (AED)

explains.en: It is a medical device that can give an electric shock to help restore a normal heartbeat. Some public places have a portable one. Follow its voice instructions in an emergency.
A rescuer uses this machine when a person's heart rhythm is dangerously irregular. It guides the user through each step. It can be found in stations and schools.
This device checks the heart and may deliver a shock if needed. Portable versions are made for emergency use. Call for medical help as well.

examples.en: Press a sterile gauze pad firmly onto the cut to stop bleeding.
examples.zh: 將無菌紗布塊緊緊按壓在傷口上方以迅速達到止血效果。

examples.en: Medical-grade cotton gauze absorbs fluids without sticking to healing skin.
examples.zh: 醫療級無菌棉紗布能充分吸附組織液，且不會沾黏撕裂癒合中的脆弱傷口。

examples.en: She applied antibiotic ointment directly onto the sterile gauze before dressing the burn.
examples.zh: 在包紮燙傷傷口前，她先將抗生素消炎藥膏直接擠在無菌紗布墊上。

explains.en: Place this soft, open-weave medical cloth over a wound to absorb blood. A clean pad can help protect the area.
A nurse may use a roll of this thin fabric to cover a burn. It lets air pass through.
This light cotton material is often kept in a first-aid kit. It can cover a cut after it is cleaned.

examples.en: Spray medical alcohol disinfectant to sanitize high-touch doorknobs.
examples.zh: 噴灑醫用酒精消毒液對經常觸摸的門把進行環境清消。

examples.en: Hospitals use hospital-grade chemical disinfectants to clean surgical suites.
examples.zh: 醫院內部採用高規格醫療級化學消毒劑對外科手術室進行徹底清消。

examples.en: Wash the minor scrape with mild disinfectant before applying an adhesive bandage.
examples.zh: 在貼上透氣防水 OK 繃前，先用溫和不刺激的消毒藥水清洗輕微擦傷處。

explains.en: This cleaner kills germs on a counter or other surface. Read the label before using it.
Hospital staff may wipe a table or door handle with this liquid. It helps reduce germs on objects.
Some products are made for floors, while others are safe for food-preparation surfaces. The label explains how to use them.

examples.en: Wearing ill-fitting hiking boots caused painful blisters on my heels.
examples.zh: 穿著不合腳的登山靴導致我的腳後跟磨出了疼痛的水泡。

examples.en: Do not pop water blisters with needles, as intact skin protects against infection.
examples.zh: 切勿自行拿縫衣針刺破水泡，完整無損的表皮是防止細菌感染的最佳天然防線。

examples.en: Rowers often develop thick calluses over time after dealing with hand blisters.
examples.zh: 划船隊選手在長期經歷雙手摩擦起水泡後，手掌上漸漸磨出了厚實的硬繭。

examples.en: Apply hydrocolloid blister pads at the first friction hot spot to prevent tears.
examples.zh: 一旦察覺腳跟或腳趾出現發熱摩擦微痛點，立即貼上人工皮水泡貼片以防表皮摩擦磨破起水泡。

examples.en: Breaking in new hiking boots on local hills prevents painful heel blisters on the big trip.
examples.zh: 剛買的新登山靴務必先在近郊郊山走幾趟進行訓鞋磨合，能有效預防在長途縱走時磨出劇痛水泡。

examples.en: Never pop a fluid-filled blister on the trail because exposed raw skin invites serious bacterial infection.
examples.zh: 在野外健行途中千萬切忌隨意挑破充滿組織液的水泡，因為真皮裸露極易導致嚴重的細菌感染發炎。

entries.definition: 水泡；起水泡；腳底摩擦水泡

explains.en: This is a small pocket of fluid that forms under the skin after rubbing or a burn. New shoes can cause one on a heel. It is usually best not to break it open.
A person may get this sore spot after walking in poorly fitting boots. The unbroken skin helps protect against germs. A padded patch can reduce rubbing.
This word names a raised bubble on the skin and can also mean to form such a sore. It may happen when a shoe rubs the foot. Keeping it covered helps protect it.

examples.en: Apply ice packs and elevate your leg if you sprain your ankle playing basketball.
examples.zh: 打籃球不慎扭傷腳踝時，請立即冰敷並將患肢適度抬高。

examples.en: It took three full weeks of rest for his severe ankle sprain to heal.
examples.zh: 他嚴重的腳踝關節扭傷足足休養了整整三個星期才徹底痊癒。

examples.en: Wearing supportive high-top athletic shoes can reduce the risk of a sprain.
examples.zh: 穿著具備良好支撐防護的高筒專業運動鞋能大幅降低運動扭傷的機率。

examples.en: The basketball player suffered a Grade 2 ankle sprain after landing awkwardly.
examples.zh: 這位籃球校隊主力在搶籃板搶下落地不慎踩空，導致右腳踝二級韌帶扭傷。

examples.en: Follow the R.I.C.E. protocol—Rest, Ice, Compression, and Elevation—immediately after an ankle sprain.
examples.zh: 關節不慎急性扭傷當下，應立刻恪遵休息、冰敷、壓迫包紮與抬高患部的急救黃金原則處理。

examples.en: She wore a supportive brace for three weeks to let her severe wrist sprain heal fully.
examples.zh: 她整整戴了三週具備硬質支撐條的醫療級護腕支架，以確保受傷的手腕韌帶得以徹底癒合。

entries.definition: 扭傷（關節、腳踝）；扭傷；扭到關節

explains.en: It is an injury to a joint caused by stretching or tearing a ligament. An ankle may be hurt during basketball. Rest and ice can help.
A person may twist a wrist or ankle and damage the tissue around it. The area can swell and hurt. A doctor can advise on care.
This injury happens when a joint is forced too far. Supportive shoes may lower the risk during sports. Seek medical advice if it is severe.

examples.en: Physical rehabilitation helps stroke patients regain limb mobility gradually.
examples.zh: 物理復健能幫助中風病患逐步重新恢復肢體靈活活動能力。

examples.en: The injured pitcher spent six grueling months in physical rehabilitation before throwing again.
examples.zh: 這位手肘受傷的王牌投手在復健中心歷經了整整六個月的艱辛復健訓練才重返投手丘。

examples.en: The community shelter runs addiction rehabilitation programs to support homeless individuals.
examples.zh: 社區庇護所積極開辦成癮戒斷復健輔導課程，協助無家可歸者重返社會生活。

examples.en: Professional sports rehabilitation restored the pitcher's shoulder mobility safely.
examples.zh: 專業的運動復健物理治療幫助王牌投手安全修復肩關節旋轉肌群並重返巔峰身手。

examples.en: Following surgery on his torn ligament, the striker spent six months in intensive rehabilitation.
examples.zh: 在經歷了韌帶撕裂修補手術後，這位明星前鋒投入了長達半年的密集物理復健治療。

examples.en: Modern rehabilitation programs emphasize active resistance movements over passive bed rest.
examples.zh: 當代前瞻運動醫學復健觀念強調透過主動式負重阻力運動，來取代消極被動的臥床靜養。

examples.en: Robotic exoskeleton gait trainers guide stroke survivors through repetitive walking rehabilitation exercises.
examples.zh: 穿戴式外骨骼機器人步態訓練機，能引導中風偏癱長輩進行高強度、安全規律的下肢行走復健（Rehabilitation）。

examples.en: After knee reconstruction surgery, the athlete spent six months in rigorous physical rehabilitation.
examples.zh: 在順利完成前十字韌帶重建手術後，這位職業足球員在專業體能訓練中心度過了整整半年高強度的運動復健。

examples.en: The correctional system emphasizes prisoner vocational education and social rehabilitation rather than mere punishment.
examples.zh: 現代進步的監獄矯正體系更側重於受刑人的技職教育培訓與心理輔導，期盼協助其重返社會並達成真正的更生復健。

examples.en: Gamified VR rehabilitation programs motivate stroke patients to regain arm mobility through playful challenges.
examples.zh: 結合遊戲化挑戰的「虛擬實境復健療程」（Rehabilitation），激勵中風患者在趣味互動中重新恢復手臂活動力。

examples.en: After knee ligament reconstruction, the professional basketball player completed six months of physical rehabilitation.
examples.zh: 接受膝蓋韌帶重建手術後，這名職業籃球員接受了長達半年的嚴格物理復健。

examples.en: The municipal urban renewal agency supervised the historic brick warehouse rehabilitation into creative studios.
examples.zh: 市府都更專責機構監督老舊紅磚倉庫的活化整建修復工程，將其轉型為文創藝術工作室。

entries.definition: 復健；康復訓練 (rehab)；復健治療；運動醫學康復 (Rehab)；外骨骼機器人中風行走復健；結合遊戲化互動獎勵之中風肢體動作虛擬復健

explains.en: After a stroke, a person may practice walking and moving their arms with a therapist. This helps them regain abilities.
An athlete follows exercises after surgery to safely return to the game. Recovery takes time and care.
People recovering from illness, injury, or addiction may receive professional support and training. The goal is to help them function well again.

examples.en: He attends physical therapy sessions twice a week for lower back pain.
examples.zh: 他每週前往診所進行兩次物理治療以改善長年的下背痛問題。

examples.en: Gentle stretching guided by a physical therapy professional relieves muscular tension.
examples.zh: 在專業物理治療師的親自引導下進行溫和拉筋，能舒緩長期緊繃的深層肌肉。

examples.en: After joint surgery, completing your assigned physical therapy exercises is essential for recovery.
examples.zh: 關節置換手術後，按部就班切實完成規定的物理治療復健運動對術後康復至關重要。

explains.en: A patient does guided movements to help the body recover after an injury. A trained professional may lead the exercises.
Gentle stretches can help ease tight muscles. This treatment may be part of healing after an operation.
A person with back pain may visit a specialist and practice safe movements. The goal is to move better and regain strength.

examples.en: Taiwan's higher education system emphasizes science, technology, and engineering.
examples.zh: 台灣的高等教育體系格外重視理工與工程領域。

examples.en: Many governments offer grants to make higher education accessible to low-income families.
examples.zh: 許多國家政府提供專案補助，使低收入家庭學子也能享有接受高等教育的機會。

examples.en: Globalization has prompted universities to adapt their higher education programs to international standards.
examples.zh: 全球化浪潮促使各大專院校調整其高等教育課程體系以接軌國際標準。

entries.definition: 高等教育；大學與研究所教育

explains.en: This is study at a college or university after secondary school. Students may focus on science, art, or another subject. Grants can help families pay for it.
A young person may continue studying after finishing school. Universities and colleges provide this level of learning. It can prepare students for a career.
This term describes advanced study at universities and other colleges. It may include a degree program. Governments sometimes provide financial aid so more people can attend.

examples.en: Postgraduate researchers conducted advanced clinical trials in the lab.
examples.zh: 研究所碩博士生在實驗室內進行了高階臨床試驗。

examples.en: After working in finance for three years, he applied for postgraduate studies in London.
examples.zh: 在金融界工作三年後，他毅然申請前往倫敦攻讀研究所課程。

examples.en: The department provides generous stipends for full-time postgraduate students.
examples.zh: 該學系為全職研究生提供了優渥的生活獎助學金。

entries.definition: 研究生；碩博士生；研究所的

explains.en: It describes study or a student after completing a university degree. A researcher may continue advanced work in a laboratory. Some programs award a master's or doctoral degree.
A person with a bachelor's degree may continue studying at a higher level. These courses often involve research. Universities may provide funding.
This term refers to advanced education after a first university qualification. Students can specialize in a subject. The word can be a noun or adjective.

examples.en: He spent five years of rigorous academic research earning his doctorate.
examples.zh: 他歷經五年嚴謹專注的學術研究後順利取得博士學位。

examples.en: Candidates defending their doctorate must demonstrate original contributions to their field.
examples.zh: 參加博士學位論文答辯的候選人必須證明自己對該學術領域具有原創性貢獻。

examples.en: Upon completing her doctorate, she was offered an assistant professorship.
examples.zh: 順利完成博士學位學程後，她立即獲得了大學助理教授的聘書。

explains.en: A university student completes advanced study and original research to earn this highest academic degree. It can take several years.
A person may defend a long research project before receiving this degree. The person can then use a title after their name.
This degree shows deep knowledge in a field such as biology or history. A professor may hold one.

examples.en: High school seniors prepare intensively for the national college entrance exam.
examples.zh: 高三應屆畢業生全力以赴準備大學學科能力測驗（學測）。

examples.en: Cram schools are packed with students drilling practice questions for the entrance exam.
examples.zh: 升學補習班擠滿了為了各類入學大考夜以繼日狂刷歷屆模擬題的學子。

examples.en: Passing the medical school entrance exam requires exceptional dedication and discipline.
examples.zh: 通過醫學院入學特考需要付出異於常人的專注力與高度自律。

explains.en: Students take this test to try to enter a school or university. It may cover many subjects.
High school seniors may study hard before this important admission test. Good preparation takes time.
A student must pass this assessment to get into a certain school. It often has questions from several classes.

examples.en: I plan to major in electrical engineering and minor in foreign languages.
examples.zh: 我計畫主修電機工程學系，並輔修外國語文學系。

examples.en: She decided to major in psychology because she wants to become a child counselor.
examples.zh: 她決定主修心理學，因為她的志願是成為一名兒童心理諮商師。

examples.en: Students who major in computer science are in high demand in the tech industry.
examples.zh: 主修資訊工程與電腦科學的畢業生在科技產業中炙手可熱。

explains.en: You do this when you choose one subject as your main area of study at a college or university. Someone may focus on psychology or engineering. Another subject can be studied less deeply.
A student may choose computer science as the main field for a degree. This phrase describes that choice. It can help prepare someone for a career.
Use these words to describe concentrating on one subject in college. A person may pick a field that interests them. They take many classes in it.

examples.en: Minoring in business management complements her main design major nicely.
examples.zh: 輔修企業管理學系與她原本的主修設計學系形成了良好的互補。

examples.en: He chose to minor in Japanese to boost his chances of working in Tokyo.
examples.zh: 他選擇輔修日語學程，以增加日後前往東京外派就業的競爭優勢。

examples.en: You need twenty additional credits to complete an academic minor in mathematics.
examples.zh: 你需要額外修滿二十個學分才能達到取得數學輔系資格的要求。

explains.en: Use this phrase when studying a secondary subject alongside a main field at college. A design student might also take business classes. Extra credits may be required.
A university student may choose an additional area of study that is smaller than the main one. Learning Japanese can support a career plan. It appears on an academic record.
Students can add another subject to their main degree program. They complete a set of courses in it. This option may broaden their skills.

examples.en: Calculus I is a mandatory prerequisite course for Advanced Physics.
examples.zh: 微積分（一）是選修高等物理學的必修先修科目。

examples.en: Fluent conversational English is an essential prerequisite for this overseas position.
examples.zh: 流利的英語口語溝通表達能力是應聘這項海外職缺不可或缺的必備先決條件。

examples.en: The academic portal prevented him from enrolling because he lacked the prerequisite.
examples.zh: 由於尚未修畢先修課程，校務選課系統自動限制了他選修該進階課的權限。

entries.definition: 先修科目；先決條件；先修的

explains.en: Students must pass basic algebra before taking an advanced math class. The earlier class is required first.
A job may require a training certificate before someone can apply. This is a condition that must be met.
A student cannot enroll in a course without first completing a required class. The earlier course is needed beforehand.

examples.en: Maintaining a high cumulative GPA opens doors for overseas study exchange.
examples.zh: 維持優異的累積 GPA 平均成績能為爭取海外交換學生敞開大門。

examples.en: Top investment banks set strict minimum GPA requirements for summer internships.
examples.zh: 頂尖華爾街投資銀行對暑期實習申請者設有極為嚴格的最低 GPA 成績門檻。

examples.en: She raised her semester GPA to 3.9 through disciplined study habits.
examples.zh: 她憑藉著高度自律的苦讀學習習慣，將該學期 GPA 平均績點大幅拉升至 3.9。

entries.definition: 學業平均成績 (Grade Point Average)

explains.en: This number shows a student's average school marks. A higher one can help when applying for study programs.
Schools calculate this measure from grades in different classes. It can change each semester.
A student may work hard to raise this academic average. Colleges sometimes consider it when reviewing applications.

examples.en: Defending a doctoral dissertation is the final milestone before graduation.
examples.zh: 博士論文答辯口試是順利畢業取得學位前的最後一項重要里程碑。

examples.en: Her 300-page doctoral dissertation focused on Taiwanese semiconductor history.
examples.zh: 她長達三百頁的厚重博士論文專門聚焦於台灣半導體產業發展史。

examples.en: The academic committee thoroughly questioned the methodologies used in the dissertation.
examples.zh: 學術口試委員針對該博士論文中所採用的研究方法論進行了層層深入盤問。

explains.en: This is a long piece of academic writing about a subject a student has researched deeply. A doctoral student may present it to a committee. It is often required near graduation.
A graduate student studies one question and writes a detailed report about the findings. Professors may ask questions about the methods. Completing it can be a major milestone.
This academic document presents a student's original research. It may be hundreds of pages long. The writer explains the question, methods, and conclusions.

examples.en: Students collaborated on a research paper regarding microplastic pollution.
examples.zh: 學生們通力合作撰寫了一篇關於塑膠微粒海洋污染的學術研究論文。

examples.en: Writing a comprehensive literature review is the first step of a research paper.
examples.zh: 撰寫嚴謹的文獻探討回顧是著手展開任何學術研究論文寫作的起手式。

examples.en: The professor praised the research paper for its thorough methodology and lucid writing.
examples.zh: 教授高度讚賞該篇學術研究論文結構方法嚴密且文字邏輯清晰流暢。

explains.en: It is a written school or university assignment based on careful study of a topic. Writers use sources and explain their findings. A bibliography usually appears at the end.
Students investigate a question and present what they learned in an organized document. It may include evidence and citations. Clear writing helps readers follow the work.
A scholar can describe an investigation in this formal piece of writing. It often begins with a question and supports a conclusion with sources. Teachers may assign one.

examples.en: Their breakthrough discovery was published in a prestigious international academic journal.
examples.zh: 他們的突破性研究發現發表在國際頂尖的知名學術期刊上。

examples.en: University libraries subscribe to thousands of digital academic journals for student research.
examples.zh: 大學圖書館採購訂閱了數以千計的數位電子學術期刊以供全校師生檢索研究。

examples.en: Publishing original work in an academic journal enhances a scholar's career reputation.
examples.zh: 在權威學術期刊上公開發表原創研究成果，能顯著提升學者在學術界的聲望。

explains.en: Researchers publish studies in this scholarly periodical after other experts review the work. University libraries often keep many issues.
A scientist may share new results in a publication read by teachers and researchers. Articles include sources and evidence.
Students can find detailed studies in these subject-focused publications. They are written for academic readers.

examples.en: Scientific articles undergo rigorous double-blind peer review before publication.
examples.zh: 科學論文在正式發表前皆需通過嚴格的雙盲同儕審查機制。

examples.en: Honest peer review ensures that only valid, high-quality research is disseminated.
examples.zh: 客觀公正的同儕審查機制確保只有經得起檢驗的高品質研究成果得以傳播發表。

examples.en: The researchers revised their statistical calculations following suggestions from peer review.
examples.zh: 研究團隊在收到同儕評審委員的反饋建議後，認真修正了論文中的統計推導算式。

explains.en: Experts in the same field read a research paper before it is published. They check its ideas and evidence.
Other scientists may suggest changes to a study. This careful checking helps improve the work.
A research article is examined by people who know that subject well. Their feedback can help make it stronger.

examples.en: Format all academic citations accurately using APA or MLA citation styles.
examples.zh: 請使用 APA 或 MLA 格式標準準確標註所有文獻引用出處。

examples.en: High citation counts reflect the wide influence of a published paper in its discipline.
examples.zh: 高文獻被引用次數客觀反映了已發表論文在該學術領域中的深遠影響力。

examples.en: The heroic firefighter received a formal city citation for braving the flames.
examples.zh: 這位奮不顧身闖入火場英勇救人的消防隊員榮獲了市政府頒發的正式嘉獎表彰。

explains.en: This is a note that gives credit to a book, article, or other source used in writing. A school paper may follow a set style. The word can also mean an official award or notice.
Writers add this information so readers can find the source of an idea. Research papers often include many. A firefighter may also receive an official honor with this name.
Use this term for a reference that points to a source. It may follow rules such as APA or MLA. It can also name formal recognition for brave service.

examples.en: Attach a complete alphabetical bibliography at the end of your essay.
examples.zh: 在論文報告文末請按字母順序附上完整的參考文獻書目清單。

examples.en: The author spent months assembling a comprehensive historical bibliography.
examples.zh: 作者耗費數月時間精心彙編了一份內容詳實的歷史主題專題參考書目。

examples.en: Software reference managers format bibliographies automatically to match journal guidelines.
examples.zh: 文獻管理軟體工具能自動排版參考文獻清單，以完全契合各期刊的投稿規範。

explains.en: It is a list of books, articles, and other sources used for a project. It often appears at the end of an essay. Entries may be arranged by author.
A writer records the materials consulted while researching. Readers can use the list to find those works. Reference software can format it.
This list gives details about sources behind a book or report. It helps readers check where information came from. The entries usually follow a style guide.

examples.en: Academic plagiarism is strictly forbidden and results in disciplinary penalty.
examples.zh: 學術抄襲剽竊行為在校園內是嚴格禁止的，違者將面臨重大處分。

examples.en: Universities deploy sophisticated software to check student submissions for plagiarism.
examples.zh: 各大學均普遍導入先進的文本比對查重系統，以嚴格審查學生報告是否有抄襲嫌疑。

examples.en: Always paraphrase ideas properly and credit the original author to avoid plagiarism.
examples.zh: 務必用自己的文字妥善改寫觀點並註明原作者出處，以防觸犯學術抄襲。

explains.en: Copying another writer’s words or ideas and claiming them as your own is dishonest. Give credit to the original source.
A student uses a paragraph from a website without naming the writer. Schools may treat this as a serious academic mistake.
When you use another person’s research, cite where it came from. Presenting it as your own work is not acceptable.

examples.en: The research methodology section describes data gathering tools clearly.
examples.zh: 論文的方法論章節清楚詳述了數據資料收集的各項研究工具。

examples.en: Critics questioned whether the sampling methodology used in the poll was biased.
examples.zh: 評論家們提出質疑，認為該民意調查中所採用的抽樣方法論是否存在偏誤。

examples.en: Adopting an agile project management methodology improved development velocity.
examples.zh: 團隊全面導入敏捷專案管理方法論後，顯著提升了軟體開發與產品交付效率。

explains.en: This describes the steps and tools used in a study. A report may explain how information was collected.
Researchers choose a plan for gathering and checking facts. The section tells readers how they did the work.
A project may use a particular way of organizing its tasks. This word names the system or set of methods.

examples.en: Theories must be supported by empirical data gathered from real-world observations.
examples.zh: 理論推導必須獲得來自真實世界觀察所得的實證數據支持。

examples.en: The economist presented compelling empirical evidence linking tax cuts to job growth.
examples.zh: 經濟學家提出了極具說服力的實證研究數據，論證了減稅與就業成長間的直接關聯。

examples.en: Relying on empirical research is far more dependable than trusting mere intuition.
examples.zh: 仰賴科學實證研究遠比單純盲信個人主觀直覺要可靠得多。

entries.definition: 實證的；經驗主義的；實驗依據的

explains.en: This describes information learned from careful observation or experiments in the real world. Researchers collect data instead of relying only on guesses. Evidence can support a theory.
A scientist may test an idea and record what happens. The findings are based on what can be observed. This kind of evidence is more than intuition.
Use this adjective for knowledge gained by experience, measurement, or testing. Economists may study actual results. It helps check whether an idea matches reality.

examples.en: Quantitative research analyzes numerical data using statistical software.
examples.zh: 量化研究運用統計分析軟體對數值數據進行深度演算分析。

examples.en: The market survey generated rich quantitative figures on weekly spending.
examples.zh: 這項市場調查收集到了關於消費者每週支出金額的豐富量化數據資料。

examples.en: Researchers combined quantitative survey results with open-ended feedback.
examples.zh: 研究人員將量化調查問卷統計結果與開放式質性回饋進行了深入對照分析。

entries.definition: 數量的；量化的；定量分析的

explains.en: It describes information that can be measured or counted with numbers. A survey may compare how much people spend each week. Statistics help analyze the results.
Researchers use numerical data to answer a question. This adjective contrasts with descriptions based on words or opinions. Software can help with analysis.
Use this term for research that measures amounts or counts. A report may show figures in a table. It can combine numbers with written comments.

examples.en: Qualitative research gathers rich insights through in-depth personal interviews.
examples.zh: 質化研究透過深度個別訪談來蒐集豐富細膩的質性觀點。

examples.en: Focus groups provide valuable qualitative data on how shoppers perceive new packaging.
examples.zh: 焦點訪談小組為了解消費者對新外包裝設計的心理感受提供了極佳的質性數據。

examples.en: There has been a discernible qualitative improvement in the school's teaching standards.
examples.zh: 該校的整體師資教學水準在近年來出現了肉眼可見的實質品質提升。

entries.definition: 質化的；定性的；品質上的

explains.en: Researchers ask people open questions about how they feel about a new package. Their answers describe qualities rather than counts.
A study may collect stories and opinions through interviews. It looks at meaning and experience.
A teacher describes the quality of a student’s writing instead of giving only a number. This kind of description focuses on qualities.

examples.en: A large and diverse sample size ensures statistical accuracy and reliability.
examples.zh: 龐大且多元的樣本規模能確保統計推論的精準度與信度。

examples.en: With a sample size of only ten participants, the survey results cannot be generalized.
examples.zh: 在受訪樣本數僅有十位參與者的情況下，該調查所得結論無法被普遍推論推廣。

examples.en: Increasing the trial sample size reduced the statistical margin of error.
examples.zh: 擴大臨床實驗的抽樣樣本數顯著縮小了統計運算時的抽樣誤差範圍。

explains.en: This tells how many people or items are included in a study. A very small group may not represent everyone.
A survey's results may be less reliable if only a few people answer. Researchers often try to include more participants.
In an experiment, count the number of people or things being tested. That number can affect how dependable the results are.

examples.en: Many foreign exchange students fall in love with Taiwanese night markets.
examples.zh: 許多外籍國際交換學生都深深愛上了台灣熱鬧溫馨的夜市文化。

examples.en: She spent a rewarding semester as an exchange student at a university in Kyoto.
examples.zh: 她以國際交換學生的身分在京都一所知名大學度過了收穫滿滿的一個學期。

examples.en: The local host family organized a welcome barbecue for the visiting exchange student.
examples.zh: 當地接待家庭特地為剛抵達的交換學生舉辦了一場溫馨熱鬧的迎新烤肉派對。

explains.en: This is a student who studies in another country for a limited time as part of a learning program. They may live with a host family. It can be a rewarding experience.
A young person may travel to a different country and attend classes there for a semester. The program lets students learn about another culture. Local families may welcome them.
This learner temporarily attends a school or university away from home. They can make friends and practice another language. They often stay with a host family.

examples.en: Studying abroad expands global horizons and fosters personal independence.
examples.zh: 出國留學深造能開拓寬廣的國際視野並培養獨立自主的生活能力。

examples.en: Many university students save money from part-time jobs to study abroad in Europe.
examples.zh: 許多大學生利用課餘兼職打工存錢，為日後前往歐洲留學深造做好準備。

examples.en: The university holds annual fairs to inform students about opportunities to study abroad.
examples.zh: 該大學每年舉辦留學博覽會，向在校生詳細介紹豐富多元的出國進修管道。

explains.en: Use this phrase when a student goes to another country for education. A university may offer a program in Europe. The experience can build independence.
Learners can take classes in a foreign country for a term or longer. They may practice a language and meet new people. Planning finances is important.
A student may leave home to attend a school overseas. This can expand cultural knowledge. Universities hold fairs to explain the options.

examples.en: Graduates tossed their academic caps joyfully at the commencement ceremony.
examples.zh: 畢業生們在隆重熱鬧的畢業典禮上歡欣雀躍地拋起學士帽。

examples.en: The tech CEO delivered an inspiring keynote address at the university commencement.
examples.zh: 科技巨頭執行長在大專院校畢業典禮上發表了一場鼓舞人心的主題演講。

examples.en: The commencement of the high-speed rail project marked a new era in island transit.
examples.zh: 高速鐵路工程建設的正式動工開端，標誌著全島交通運輸邁向了全新的嶄新紀元。

entries.definition: 畢業典禮；開始；學位授予儀式

explains.en: Graduates wear gowns and listen to speeches before receiving their diplomas. Families attend the university ceremony.
A new road project begins with workers and equipment at the site. The word can also mean a beginning.
Students celebrate the completion of their studies at a formal ceremony. A speaker may offer advice for the future.

examples.en: Japanese and Taiwanese interior design share similar natural wooden aesthetics.
examples.zh: 日式與台式室內設計皆共享著相似的自然原木審美觀。

examples.en: The architectural movement challenged established classical aesthetics of the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 這場建築思潮運動挑戰了十九世紀確立的傳統古典審美體系。

examples.en: Courses in film aesthetics teach students how lighting and framing evoke emotion.
examples.zh: 電影美學課程深入指導學生如何巧妙透過燈光與鏡頭構圖勾勒內心情感。

examples.en: The sweeping roofs and delicate carvings embody the harmonious philosophical aesthetics of traditional architecture.
examples.zh: 飛揚展翅的屋脊飛簷與精雕細琢的樑柱木雕，完美體現了東方傳統建築天人合一的工藝美學。

examples.en: Traditional courtyard homes reflect an organic spatial aesthetics that balances public hospitality and private intimacy.
examples.zh: 傳統三合院空間格局體現了兼顧熱情待客與內斂私密性的有機哲學美學。

examples.en: Understanding classical East Asian aesthetics helps tourists appreciate why temple roofs swoop toward the sky.
examples.zh: 深入理解東亞古典建築美學，有助於旅人領會為何宮廟燕尾屋脊會如羽化登仙般昂揚翹向天際。

entries.definition: 美學；審美觀；東方宮廟傳統建築工藝美學

explains.en: This area of study looks at beauty and art. People may discuss what makes a building pleasing to see.
A designer thinks about color, shape, and feeling when planning a room. These ideas concern how things look.
Different cultures may value different styles of music or buildings. This field explores ideas about beauty and taste.

examples.en: The Taipei Fine Arts Museum showcases thought-provoking contemporary art installations.
examples.zh: 台北市立美術館展出了許多發人深省的當代藝術裝置作品。

examples.en: Collectors from around the globe attended the annual contemporary art exposition.
examples.zh: 來自世界各地的藝術收藏家盛裝出席了一年一度的國際當代藝術博覽會。

examples.en: Contemporary art frequently addresses pressing ecological and social justice topics.
examples.zh: 當代藝術作品經常深刻觸及當前迫切的生態環保與社會公平正義議題。

explains.en: This is art made by artists living and working in the present period. It may use unusual materials or explore social topics. Museums often show it in many forms.
A gallery may display recent paintings, sculptures, or installations. These works can comment on the world today. Visitors may find them thought-provoking.
This term describes art created in our own time. It can include many styles and media. Some pieces address the environment or fairness in society.

examples.en: Visitors gathered around the abstract modern art oil painting.
examples.zh: 參觀者聚集在抽象現代藝術油畫前仔細品味。

examples.en: The museum's permanent modern art collection includes works by Picasso and Matisse.
examples.zh: 該美術館的常設現代藝術館藏涵查了畢卡索與馬蒂斯等大師名作。

examples.en: She took a weekend workshop to learn the origins of modern art movements.
examples.zh: 她報名參加了週末專題研習班，深入探究現代藝術思潮流派的源流脈絡。

explains.en: It is artwork made in relatively recent times, often exploring new ideas and styles. Some pieces use abstract shapes. Museums may display works by Picasso.
Artists in this movement may challenge traditional ways of painting or sculpting. A gallery can show many different approaches. Viewers may interpret a work in their own way.
This broad category includes creative works from the late nineteenth century onward. It can include painting, sculpture, and mixed media. Some pieces look very different from older art.

examples.en: The museum curator carefully selected indigenous weaving artifacts for display.
examples.zh: 博物館策展人悉心挑選了原住民傳統織布工藝品進行特展。

examples.en: An experienced guest curator organized the retrospective exhibition of the late sculptor.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的特邀策展人一手精心策劃了這位已故雕塑大師的生平回顧展。

examples.en: As chief curator, she oversees artifact acquisitions and educational outreach programs.
examples.zh: 作為首席策展人，她統籌負責全館文物典藏收購與公眾教育推廣專案。

examples.en: The chief curator conceptualized a groundbreaking exhibition exploring Asian silk road cultural exchanges.
examples.zh: 美術館總策展人以獨到視野精心策劃了一場探索古代絲路跨文化交流的重磅年度國際大展。

examples.en: She worked closely with private collectors as the senior curator of modern sculpture.
examples.zh: 作為現代雕塑資深策展人，她與多位民間頂尖藝術品收藏家展開了深度密切的借展合作。

examples.en: The museum appointed an innovative curator to reimagine its permanent indigenous arts collection.
examples.zh: 博物館聘請了一位極具創新思維的青年策展人，重新詮釋並活化其台灣原住民族常設藝術典藏。

entries.definition: 策展人；博物館館長；博物館策展人；館長；典藏研究員

explains.en: A museum worker chooses objects for an exhibition and explains their history. They may care for the collection too.
A gallery leader plans which paintings visitors will see. This person researches and looks after the artworks.
The person who selects and organizes a museum collection may write labels for each display. They help visitors understand it.

examples.en: Chinese landscape paintings convey peace through misty mountain vistas.
examples.zh: 傳統水墨山水畫透過雲霧繚繞的山巒意境傳遞寧靜致遠的意涵。

examples.en: The European landscape painting captured rolling green hills under golden afternoon sunlight.
examples.zh: 這幅歐洲古典風景油畫細膩捕捉了午後金黃陽光灑落在翠綠起伏丘陵上的靜謐。

examples.en: Traditional landscape paintings often include small human figures to emphasize nature's vastness.
examples.zh: 傳統山水風景畫中常巧妙點綴渺小的人物身影，藉以襯托浩瀚大自然的雄偉博大。

explains.en: An artist may paint mountains, rivers, or fields in this kind of artwork. People or houses may appear very small.
A misty mountain scene can show the beauty of nature. Some paintings of this kind come from China.
This artwork focuses on outdoor scenery instead of a person or object. It may show rolling hills under the sun.

examples.en: Renowned calligraphers write auspicious spring couplets during New Year.
examples.zh: 知名書法大師在農曆新年期間現場揮毫書寫吉祥春聯。

examples.en: The master calligrapher demonstrated distinct cursive and regular script styles.
examples.zh: 這位書法大師在現場親自向學員示範草書奔放與楷書端莊的筆墨風格差異。

examples.en: An apprentice spent a decade learning stroke balance under the veteran calligrapher.
examples.zh: 這位學徒在老書法名家的門下苦心鑽研了整整十年，方領悟運筆佈局之精要。

explains.en: This is a person who writes letters and characters in a beautiful, careful style. They may create New Year decorations. Learning the art takes years of practice.
An experienced writer may show different brush styles. A learner practices balancing strokes and spacing. Their work can be displayed as art.
This artist uses a brush or pen to create elegant writing. They may write poems or decorative couplets. Careful control of each stroke is important.

examples.en: Yingge Old Street is worldwide famous for delicate ceramics and teapots.
examples.zh: 鶯歌老街以其精緻細膩的陶瓷茶壺與陶藝作品享譽國際。

examples.en: The craft studio offers weekend workshops where travelers can throw ceramics on wheels.
examples.zh: 這間工藝手作坊提供週末體驗課程，讓旅人親手在拉坯機上體驗陶藝創作樂趣。

examples.en: Archaeological excavations uncovered primitive ceramics dating back three millennia.
examples.zh: 考古發掘現場出土了距今三千多年前的新石器時代原始陶器文物。

examples.en: Yingge is globally renowned as Taiwan's ceramics capital, famous for high-temperature celadon glazes.
examples.zh: 新北鶯歌享譽全球「台灣陶瓷之都」美名，以千度高溫柴燒青瓷釉藥與精湛手拉胚茶具聞名於世。

examples.en: Modern tea masters appreciate the earthy textures and unrepeatable ash marks of wood-fired ceramics.
examples.zh: 當代品茶名家無不深深著迷於柴燒陶瓷器皿那質樸原始的粗獷手感與自然落灰熔融結晶。

examples.en: The town's historic ceramics museum exhibits magnificent pottery vessels dating back over two centuries.
examples.zh: 座落於老街旁的鶯歌陶瓷博物館，常年展出兩百多年來台灣製陶歷史與璀璨精湛的代表性古陶器皿。

entries.definition: 陶瓷；陶藝；陶瓷製品；陶瓷工藝；陶藝製品

explains.en: These are objects made from clay or other materials hardened by heat. Potters shape bowls and teapots on a wheel. Archaeologists may find ancient pieces.
A studio can teach people to form clay vessels and fire them in a kiln. The finished objects may be useful or decorative. This craft has a long history.
Plates, jars, and tiles can be made this way. The material becomes hard after firing. People also create artistic works from it.

examples.en: Local culinary artisans bake pineapple pastries using pure winter melon and fruit.
examples.zh: 在地糕餅職人堅持使用純冬瓜與新鮮土鳳梨精心烘焙鳳梨酥。

examples.en: Generations of dedicated artisans preserved the complex technique of lacquerware polishing.
examples.zh: 世代傳承的匠人職人堅守並傳承了繁複精微的漆器多道推光打磨技藝。

examples.en: The farmers market featured organic artisan cheeses made from grass-fed goat milk.
examples.zh: 農夫假日市集上展售了由放牧草飼山羊乳精心手工發酵熟成的頂級職人起司。

examples.en: The dedicated artisan spends forty hours hand-carving a single sculptural rocking chair.
examples.zh: 這位心無旁騖的木藝工匠職人，耗費整整四十小時手工雕鑿打磨出一張線條如流水般的搖椅。

examples.en: Visiting the weekend artisan market in Taichung allowed us to buy handmade ceramics and organic soaps.
examples.zh: 週末造訪台中綠園道旁的手作職人文創市集，讓我們買到了許多獨一無二的手捏陶器與天然手工皂。

examples.en: The crusty sourdough bread was baked early this morning by a local French artisan baker.
examples.zh: 這款外脆內韌的天然酸種法式歐包，是由當地的法籍職人烘焙師於今天破曉清晨新鮮手工出爐的。

examples.en: The dedicated model artisan spends months researching historical photographs before cutting a single plastic sprue.
examples.zh: 這位追求極致的模型達人職人，在下刀剪開零件前會耗費數月考證泛黃歷史照片。

examples.en: The sleepy hillside village is renowned for skilled artisans who weave intricate bamboo baskets and hats.
examples.zh: 這座掩映在翠綠山林間的幽靜山村，以村內多位身懷絕技、能親手編織出巧奪天工竹籃與竹笠的竹編手工藝匠人而名聞遐邇。

examples.en: Supporting local food artisans preserves ancestral cheese-making and bread-baking culinary traditions.
examples.zh: 大力支持在地友善小農與傳統食品手工工匠，能有效保護世代相傳的天然乳酪發酵與古法歐式麵包烘焙文化遺產。

entries.definition: 工匠；手藝人；職人；畢生專注木藝創作的工匠職人；畢生熱愛微縮模型之模型達人職人

explains.en: A skilled person makes pottery or furniture by hand. Their work may use techniques learned over many years.
At a market, a craft maker sells handmade soap and ceramics. The products are made with care and skill.
This worker creates things such as woven baskets or carved chairs. Each item may take many hours to finish.

examples.en: Huashan 1914 Creative Park is a bustling hub for cultural and creative brands.
examples.zh: 華山 1914 文創園區是眾多本土文創品牌齊聚的熱門聚落。

examples.en: The government actively funds youth entrepreneurship in the cultural and creative industries.
examples.zh: 政府當局積極編列專案預算，大力資助青年投入文化創意產業創業圓夢。

examples.en: Souvenirs from cultural and creative markets blend Taiwanese nostalgia with witty humor.
examples.zh: 來自文創市集的伴手禮巧妙融合了濃濃的台灣復古情懷與新世代幽默創意。

explains.en: This describes work that uses ideas, art, and local traditions to make useful or interesting things. A shop may sell handmade goods.
A market can offer products that mix Taiwanese history with new design. This term describes that kind of creative industry.
A brand using stories, art, and tradition in its products works in this area. Governments may support these businesses.

examples.en: Biographies and self-help guides fall under the non-fiction book section.
examples.zh: 名人傳記與心靈勵志指南皆歸類於非虛構紀實圖書專區。

examples.en: Readers looking for factual investigative reporting enjoy non-fiction bestsellers.
examples.zh: 偏好真實深度調查報導的廣大讀者群體，普遍熱愛閱讀各類非虛構紀實暢銷書。

examples.en: The author won a major journalism award for her compelling non-fiction expose.
examples.zh: 該名深度調查記者憑藉著其震撼人心的非虛構紀實專著榮獲了重量級新聞大獎。

explains.en: This kind of book or writing is about real people, events, or information rather than an invented story. Biographies belong to this group. It can teach readers about the world.
A reader may choose factual reporting or a guide to learn about a real subject. Authors use evidence and research. It is different from made-up stories.
This term describes writing that presents facts and real events. It includes biographies, history, and self-help books. A writer may investigate a subject before publishing.

examples.en: The National Concert Hall features world-class acoustics for classical symphonies.
examples.zh: 國家音樂廳擁有世界一流頂級聲學音響設計，專供交響樂演奏。

examples.en: Thousands of music lovers filled the concert hall for the legendary cellist's recital.
examples.zh: 數千名愛樂聽眾將整座音樂廳擠得水洩不通，只為朝聖傳奇大提琴家的獨奏盛宴。

examples.en: Mobile phones must be set to silent mode before entering the concert hall.
examples.zh: 在邁入莊嚴神聖的音樂大廳前，全體觀眾皆必須將手機設定為靜音模式。

explains.en: It is a large building or room designed for live music performances. The sound is shaped to carry clearly to the audience. Visitors should silence their phones.
Orchestras and solo musicians perform on a stage in this venue. Rows of seats face the performers. Good acoustics help listeners hear every instrument.
Music lovers gather here to hear a symphony or recital. The room is built to make the sound rich and clear. Some famous venues host world-class artists.

examples.en: The actors stepped onstage with great energy and confidence.
examples.zh: 演員們意氣風發、信心十足地大步登上舞台。

examples.en: The stage lighting illuminated the lead singer as she walked onstage.
examples.zh: 當主唱優雅信步走上舞台時，璀璨耀眼的舞台聚光燈瞬間照亮了她的身影。

examples.en: Performing onstage in front of a live audience cured his childhood shyness.
examples.zh: 登台站在成千上萬的現場觀眾面前演出，徹底治好了他童年時期膽怯害羞的性格。

explains.en: The singer walks onto the platform where the audience can see the performance. Bright lights shine on the performer.
Actors perform in front of the crowd during a play. They may feel nervous before stepping into view.
A dancer appears before the audience and begins the show. The word describes being on the performance area.

examples.en: Glove puppetry master Huang Hai-tai preserved folk storytelling traditions.
examples.zh: 掌中戲大師黃海岱先生畢生守護了台灣珍貴的民間說唱敘事傳統。

examples.en: Modern Taiwanese glove puppetry incorporates digital visual effects and rock soundtracks.
examples.zh: 台灣現代霹靂布袋戲大膽融合了前衛的數位 3D 視覺特效與熱血搖滾配樂。

examples.en: Tourists were spellbound by the puppeteer's rapid finger movements during glove puppetry.
examples.zh: 觀光客在觀賞掌中布袋戲演出時，被操偶師出神入化的快手十指身段深深迷住了。
