explains.en: A performer puts a small puppet over one hand and moves it on a stage. The puppet may tell a folk story.
In Taiwan, skilled performers use their fingers to make cloth figures act. Some modern shows add music and lights.
This traditional show features hand-controlled puppets. The performer moves each character while telling a story.

examples.en: Cloud Gate Dance Theatre is an internationally acclaimed modern dance troupe.
examples.zh: 雲門舞集是名揚海內外、享譽國際的台灣現代舞團。

examples.en: The folk dance troupe performed traditional tribal dances at the international festival.
examples.zh: 這支民間民俗舞蹈團在國際藝術嘉年華舞台上深情展演了傳統部落祭典樂舞。

examples.en: Touring with a premier dance troupe requires rigorous athletic stamina and discipline.
examples.zh: 隨同頂尖知名現代舞團展開跨國巡迴公演，需要具備如運動員般極其嚴苛的體魄與自律。

explains.en: This is a group of performers who practice and present dances together. They may perform traditional or modern styles. Touring with the group takes energy and discipline.
A set of dancers may travel to festivals to present a show. They train together and move in time. Some groups specialize in folk dances.
These performers work as a team on stage. They may tour and present dances from their culture. Practice helps them perform in a coordinated way.

examples.en: Lin Hwai-min is an iconic Taiwanese contemporary dance choreographer.
examples.zh: 林懷民先生是台灣當代現代舞最具代表性的標竿編舞大師。

examples.en: The guest choreographer introduced fluid contemporary movements to the ballet company.
examples.zh: 特聘客座編舞家為這家歷史悠久的芭蕾舞團注入了行雲流水般的當代現代舞語彙。

examples.en: Award-winning choreographers spend months matching steps to complex symphonic rhythms.
examples.zh: 獲獎無數的知名編舞大師耗費數月心血，將每一個舞蹈步伐與交響樂節拍完美契合。

explains.en: It is a person who creates dance movements for performers. They match steps to music and teach the group. A ballet company may invite a guest to make a new work.
Someone in this role plans how dancers move on stage. They may spend months shaping a performance. The job combines creativity and practice.
A dance production needs a person to design its steps and formations. They work with performers and sometimes composers. The result may tell a story through movement.

examples.en: The choreography seamlessly blends martial arts movements with ballet grace.
examples.zh: 這套舞蹈編排巧妙融合了東方武術剛勁身段與西方芭蕾的優雅。

examples.en: Music video directors work closely with dancers to polish high-energy pop choreography.
examples.zh: 音樂錄影帶導演與舞者密切配合，反覆打磨流行歌曲熱力四射的齊舞編舞。

examples.en: The figure skater earned maximum technical points for her creative routine choreography.
examples.zh: 花式滑冰選手憑藉著其獨具匠心、極富感染力的節目編舞，奪下了全場最高技術分。

examples.en: Martial arts fight choreography required three months of rigorous weapon rehearsal.
examples.zh: 該部武俠史詩大片的武術動作指導與兵器套路設計耗時三個月的高強度封閉式實戰排練。

examples.en: The fluid dance choreography in the musical film synchronized flawlessly with the brass melody.
examples.zh: 這部歌舞大片中行雲流水般的曼妙群舞編排，與背景音樂中熱情激昂的銅管旋律達成了天衣無縫的契合。

examples.en: Hong Kong cinema pioneered intricate swordfight choreography that influenced action movies worldwide.
examples.zh: 八九零年代傳統香港功夫電影所開創的精妙套招過招打鬥動作設計，深遠影響了全球動作大片的運鏡理念。

examples.en: The high-energy tap-dance choreography required months of synchronized daily footwork drills.
examples.zh: 這段熱力四射、節奏明快的踢踏群舞編排（Choreography），需要全體舞者歷經數月每天上千次的同步排練。

examples.en: Lin Hwai-min’s groundbreaking Cloud Gate choreography combines modern dance, martial arts, and meditation.
examples.zh: 林懷民為「雲門舞集」所開創的跨界編舞美學，將現代舞的靈動、東方太極武術的沉穩與靜心內觀融為一體。

examples.en: Pop music videos invest heavily in slick street-dance choreography to attract viral views on TikTok.
examples.zh: 當紅流行偶像音樂錄影帶在街舞編舞設計上下足重金，期盼以洗腦俐落的舞步在社群平台上引爆模仿狂潮。

entries.definition: 編舞藝術；舞蹈編排；武術動作指導；編舞；舞蹈編舞設計；舞步編排

explains.en: A dancer plans the steps and movements for a song or show. The performers practice until they move together.
An action movie team carefully plans how actors pretend to fight. Every movement is rehearsed for safety.
A musical may have a series of dance moves designed for the song. The arrangement is practiced by the cast.

examples.en: The emotional theatrical performance earned a prolonged standing ovation.
examples.zh: 感人肺腑的精湛戲劇演出贏得了全場觀眾起立鼓掌長久致敬。

examples.en: At the end of the graduation speech, the entire class rose to give a standing ovation.
examples.zh: 在畢業典禮感人演講結束之際，全體應屆畢業生自發肅立，報以經久不息的起立鼓掌。

examples.en: The tenor bowed repeatedly as the audience erupted into a rapturous standing ovation.
examples.zh: 在全體樂迷陷入狂熱起立鼓掌的歡呼聲中，世界著名男高音歌唱家頻頻向觀眾鞠躬致意。

explains.en: After a wonderful show, the audience may rise and clap for a long time. This is a strong sign of praise.
People stood to applaud a speaker after a moving speech. The performer may bow to thank them.
At the end of a concert, the crowd may get to its feet and clap. This shows great appreciation.

examples.en: Enthusiastic fans chanted 'Encore!' until the rock band returned to play.
examples.zh: 熱情的歌迷不斷高喊「安可！」，直到搖滾樂團重返舞台加演。

examples.en: The violinist prepared two delightful encore pieces to treat the passionate audience.
examples.zh: 這位小提琴名家特地預先準備了兩首輕快精巧的安可加演曲目以回饋熱情樂迷。

examples.en: The stadium exploded in cheers when the superstar walked back out for an unexpected encore.
examples.zh: 當超級巨星出人意料地再度步出後台重返舞台加演安可曲時，整座體育場瞬間沸騰。

examples.en: Shouts of 'Encore!' brought the legendary rock band back to the stage for three bonus songs.
examples.zh: 在全場歌迷瘋狂整齊高喊「Encore！」的熱情呼喚下，傳奇樂團再度重返舞台加碼熱唱三首安可曲。

examples.en: As an unannounced encore, the world-famous cellist performed Bach’s serene Cello Suite No. 1.
examples.zh: 作為現場即興加碼的驚喜安可加演曲目，這位世界級大提琴大師獨自重返舞台，靜謐演奏了巴哈第一號大提琴無伴奏組曲。

examples.en: The audience stamped their feet and clapped in rhythm, demanding an encore from the exhausted cast.
examples.zh: 意猶未盡的熱情觀眾整齊劃一地跺腳並依循節拍拍手呼喊，強烈渴望台上精疲力竭的演員能再度出場安可謝幕。

entries.definition: 安可！加演曲目；安可加演曲目；高喊安可

explains.en: After a performance ends, the audience may shout this to ask for another song or dance. The performers may return to the stage. It can also mean the extra performance itself.
Fans may clap and call for more after a band leaves. The group can come back and play a bonus song. This word names that request or performance.
Use this exclamation to ask performers to come back and do more. It can also name an extra piece played after the planned show. The audience may cheer loudly.

examples.en: The red-brick historical street preserves rich architectural charm.
examples.zh: 這條紅磚歷史老街完整保留了深厚迷人的建築風貌與魅力。

examples.en: The city held an international architectural competition to design the new opera house.
examples.zh: 該城市舉辦了一場高規格的國際建築競圖大賽，以徵選新歌劇院的設計方案。

examples.en: Strict architectural regulations prevent modern towers from blocking views of the castle.
examples.zh: 嚴格的都市建築天際線法規禁止興建過高的摩天大樓，以免遮擋古堡景觀。

explains.en: It describes something connected with the design and construction of buildings. Rules may protect the look of an old street. A competition can choose a design for an opera house.
This adjective relates to how buildings are planned or shaped. A city may set rules about towers and historic views. It can also describe a building's style.
Use this word for features of buildings or the work of designing them. Brick facades can have special charm. Architects create plans before construction begins.

examples.en: Civil engineering breakthroughs enabled the construction of Hsuehshan Tunnel.
examples.zh: 土木工程技術的重大突破促成了雪山隧道的成功開鑿貫通。

examples.en: A degree in civil engineering prepares graduates to design dams, bridges, and highways.
examples.zh: 取得土木工程學位能培養畢業生具備設計水壩、跨海大橋與高速公路的專業能力。

examples.en: Modern civil engineering increasingly emphasizes seismic resilience and eco-friendly concrete.
examples.zh: 現代土木工程學科越來越重視抗震韌性設計與低碳綠色混凝土材料的應用。

explains.en: Engineers plan and build bridges, roads, dams, and tunnels. They study how structures can stay strong and safe.
A university student in this field learns to design public buildings and transportation routes. Math and science are important.
When a new bridge is planned, specialists calculate how it will carry weight. Their work helps build infrastructure.

examples.en: Civil engineers inspected bridge pylons after the strong earthquake.
examples.zh: 土木工程師在強烈地震發生後立即全面檢查橋樑橋墩結構。

examples.en: The lead civil engineer presented soil stability reports before excavation began.
examples.zh: 首席土木工程師在大型地基開挖前，向審查委員會提交了詳實的土層穩定性分析報告。

examples.en: Becoming a licensed civil engineer requires passing rigorous national qualification exams.
examples.zh: 考取國家執照的專業土木技師需要通過難度極高且嚴格的國家高等考試。

explains.en: This professional plans and checks bridges, roads, and other public structures. Safety is an important part of the job.
A person in this career may study soil before a building project begins. A license may be required.
These engineers help design useful structures for communities. They may inspect a bridge after an earthquake.

examples.en: Always wear a hard safety hat when inspecting an active construction site.
examples.zh: 視察正在施工的建築工地時，請務必全程佩戴防護安全帽。

examples.en: Dust barriers and acoustic screens were erected around the downtown construction site.
examples.zh: 施工單位在市中心營造工地周圍架設了高規格的防塵圍籬與隔音屏障。

examples.en: The project supervisor conducted morning safety briefings at the construction site.
examples.zh: 工地主任每天清晨在建築施工現場召集全體工班進行晨間安全衛生講習。

explains.en: This is a place where workers are building or repairing a structure. People should wear safety equipment when entering. Barriers keep dust and noise inside.
A project supervisor may give workers a safety talk at this location. Machines and building materials can be present. Visitors must follow safety rules.
This area is where a new house, road, or other structure is being built. It may be noisy and dusty. Only authorized people should enter.

examples.en: Architects reviewed the structural blueprint before pouring concrete.
examples.zh: 建築師在灌漿澆置混凝土之前仔細核對了結構施工藍圖。

examples.en: The business proposal serves as a practical strategic blueprint for international expansion.
examples.zh: 這份商業企劃書為企業邁向國際市場拓展提供了極具執行力的策略藍圖。

examples.en: DNA provides the biological blueprint that guides the development of living organisms.
examples.zh: 去氧核醣核酸（DNA）提供了指導一切生命體生長發育的精密生物學藍圖。

examples.en: Structural engineers reviewed the architectural blueprints before breaking ground on the tower.
examples.zh: 結構技師在大樓正式開工動土前，閉門逐一嚴謹審查全套建築藍圖與耐震力學計算書。

examples.en: The city council released an ambitious economic blueprint to boost local technological innovation.
examples.zh: 市議會正式對外公布了一份雄心勃勃的經濟發展藍圖，以全面刺激在地科技創新產業。

examples.en: Keep a printed set of construction blueprints on-site for daily inspections by city code officials.
examples.zh: 在建築工地現場隨時備妥一套完整裝訂的施工藍圖圖紙，便於建管處官員每日到場查驗。

entries.definition: 藍圖；建築施工圖；詳細規劃藍圖；建築藍圖；詳細施工規劃圖

explains.en: It is a detailed plan used to build a structure. Architects review it before construction begins. The word can also mean a plan for a business or project.
A drawing shows the parts and measurements of a building. Workers use it to guide their work. In a broader sense, it is a model for success.
This plan may show how rooms, walls, and supports fit together. A company can also create a strategy to guide future growth. It outlines what to do.

examples.en: Most apartment buildings in Taiwan are constructed with reinforced concrete (RC).
examples.zh: 台灣大部分的集合公寓住宅大樓皆採用鋼筋混凝土（RC）工法興建。

examples.en: Engineers test the tensile strength of steel rebar used in reinforced concrete slabs.
examples.zh: 土木結構工程師嚴格抽樣檢驗鋼筋混凝土樓板中所使用的抗拉耐震鋼筋強度。

examples.en: Bridges built with high-performance reinforced concrete withstand harsh coastal conditions.
examples.zh: 採用高性能鋼筋混凝土建造的跨海大橋，能長年抵禦嚴苛的沿海高鹽分環境侵蝕。

explains.en: Builders place steel bars inside concrete to make a strong building material. It is often used for bridges and apartments.
A structure uses both hard cement material and metal rods for added strength. Engineers test how well it can handle forces.
Steel rods inside this building material help it resist pulling and bending. Many buildings use it.

examples.en: Modern buildings adhere to strict earthquake-resistant structural codes.
examples.zh: 現代新建大樓均嚴格遵循高標準的耐震抗震建築法規。

examples.en: Installing seismic isolation bearings makes historical schools completely earthquake-resistant.
examples.zh: 導入先進隔震墊阻尼支承技術，能使老舊校舍校舍搖身一變具備極佳的耐震防護力。

examples.en: Taiwanese developers highlight earthquake-resistant features as major selling points for new homes.
examples.zh: 台灣建商在推展新建案時，普遍將高規格的耐震抗震設計列為核心主打賣點。

explains.en: A building designed this way can better withstand shaking from an earthquake. Strong supports help protect people.
Engineers use special structures so a school is safer when the ground moves. New homes may include such features.
This describes a building made to resist damage during an earthquake. Building rules explain how to make it safer.

examples.en: Taipei 101's massive 660-tonne tuned mass damper stabilizes the skyscraper.
examples.zh: 台北 101 重達 660 公噸的巨型風阻尼球能有效穩定整棟超高摩天大樓。

examples.en: Modern hospital towers install hydraulic seismic dampers between beams to absorb shock waves.
examples.zh: 現代化大型醫院醫療大樓在各樓層樑柱間加裝油壓減震阻尼器，以有效吸收地震能量。

examples.en: Tourists can view the golden spherical seismic damper suspended inside Taipei 101.
examples.zh: 參觀觀景台的各國旅客能親眼目睹懸吊在台北 101 核心筒內部的金黃色巨大阻尼球。

explains.en: This device helps a tall building move safely during an earthquake by absorbing some of the shaking. A large one may hang inside a skyscraper. It protects the structure from strong motion.
Engineers place this equipment between parts of a building to reduce earthquake forces. It can act like a shock absorber. Visitors may see a huge one in a tower.
This building safety tool reduces movement caused by ground shaking. It may use heavy weights or hydraulic parts. It helps protect people and structures.

examples.en: The historical street restored its elegant Baroque architectural facades.
examples.zh: 歷史老街精心修復了其典雅華麗的巴洛克式立面外牆。

examples.en: Behind a cheerful, polite facade, he concealed deep sorrow and loneliness.
examples.zh: 在開朗親切且彬彬有禮的待人門面外表下，他內心深處隱藏著無盡的悲傷與孤獨。

examples.en: Modern office buildings incorporate double-skin glass facades to optimize energy savings.
examples.zh: 現代綠能辦公大樓廣泛導入雙層玻璃呼吸外牆帷幕技術，以追求極致的節能減碳。

examples.en: The historical red-brick facade was preserved while modernizing the interior office tower.
examples.zh: 建築團隊精心完整修復保留了日治時期古典紅磚外觀立面，同時將內部全面改建為智慧辦公大樓。

examples.en: Terracotta louvers along the western facade block intense afternoon sunshine passively.
examples.zh: 沿著建築西向外立面整齊排列的陶板遮陽百葉格柵，能以被動節能方式阻隔午後熾烈的西曬高溫。

examples.en: Behind his confident, smiling facade, he was deeply anxious about the company's financial future.
examples.zh: 在他平日示人那副自信滿滿、笑容可掬的外表假象背後，內心深處實則對公司的財務前景極度憂慮。

examples.en: Cascading plants on the architectural facade absorb urban carbon dioxide while dampening street noise.
examples.zh: 披覆在建築外牆立面上的垂直森林植生牆，如瀑布般綠意盎然，既能吸碳又能大幅阻絕車流噪音。

examples.en: Automated drip-irrigation networks nourish vertical plant tapestries covering the building facade.
examples.zh: 隱藏在立面植生槽背後的自動智慧滴灌管網，全天候為覆蓋高樓外牆的立體綠植提供精準水養。

examples.en: The living facade transforms seasonally, displaying blazing autumn colors across twenty floors.
examples.zh: 這座垂直森林活體立面隨四季流轉變換風貌，深秋時分整整二十層樓的外牆換上絢爛如火的紅葉。

entries.definition: 建築正面外牆；門面；假象；建築外觀立面；外表假象；垂直森林立面綠化植生牆 (陶朱隱園)

explains.en: It is the front face of a building, often its most decorated side. A historic street may have elegant stone fronts. The word can also mean a false appearance.
Architects design the outer face that people see from the street. In another use, a cheerful appearance may hide sadness. Context reveals the meaning.
A building's front wall can have windows, doors, and decorative details. People also use this word for a false show of feelings or behavior.

examples.en: Minimalist interior design maximizes space in compact urban apartments.
examples.zh: 極簡主義室內設計能讓空間有限的都會小宅達到空間最大化利用。

examples.en: She studied Scandinavian interior design known for light colors and natural materials.
examples.zh: 她赴歐專攻以明亮大地色系與純天然溫潤材質著稱的北歐斯堪地那維亞室內設計。

examples.en: Good interior design harmonizes aesthetic beauty with daily functional convenience.
examples.zh: 真正優秀的室內設計能巧妙地將視覺美感與日常生活起居的實用機能融為一體。

examples.en: Minimalist Japandi interior design blends Nordic warmth with Japanese simplicity.
examples.zh: 融合北歐溫馨木質調與日式質樸美學的無印極簡風室內設計近年深受年輕人喜愛。

examples.en: We hired an interior design studio to create smart custom storage throughout our condominium.
examples.zh: 我們委託了一家專業室內設計公司，為全室電梯大樓量身規劃完善高機能的收納美學。

examples.en: Good interior design harmonizes natural lighting, airflow, color palettes, and daily functionality.
examples.zh: 卓越的室內空間設計能將天然採光、室內通風、配色層次與實用生活機能巧妙融為一體。

entries.definition: 室內設計；室內裝潢；室內空間美學

explains.en: A designer chooses colors, lights, furniture, and storage for rooms. The goal is to make a space useful and pleasant.
A small apartment may feel larger with smart shelves and bright colors. Planning how a room looks and works can help.
People arrange furniture and lighting to make a home comfortable and attractive. This work shapes the inside of a building.

examples.en: We hired an interior designer to remodel our thirty-year-old apartment.
examples.zh: 我們聘請了一位專業室內設計師來為我們三十年的老屋重新翻修裝潢。

examples.en: The interior designer suggested open shelving to make the small kitchen feel larger.
examples.zh: 室內設計師建議在廚房採用通透的開放式層架設計，讓原本侷促的小空間顯得更為開闊。

examples.en: Experienced interior designers coordinate contractors, carpenters, and electricians seamlessly.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的室內設計師能游刃有餘地無縫統籌協調泥作包商、木作木工與水電師傅。

explains.en: This professional plans how the inside of a home or office should look and work. They may choose shelves and colors.
A small kitchen can feel larger with open shelving. A design specialist may suggest that change.
These specialists coordinate workers and choose materials for indoor spaces. They help make rooms useful and attractive.

examples.en: The young couple decided to renovate an old wooden house into a cozy cafe.
examples.zh: 這對年輕夫妻決定將一棟老舊木造老屋翻新改造為溫馨的咖啡館。

examples.en: The city allocated funds to renovate the historic public bathhouse into a community center.
examples.zh: 市政府編列專案統籌經費，將具有百年歷史的公有老公共澡堂翻新改建為社區里民活動中心。

examples.en: It is often much cheaper to renovate an existing home than to construct a new one from scratch.
examples.zh: 將既有中古屋重新翻修改裝，整體花費往往遠比從無到有平地起新樓要經濟實惠得多。

explains.en: You do this when you repair and improve an old building or room. A couple may turn a wooden house into a cafe. It can cost less than building a new one.
A city may update a historic bathhouse so people can use it again. Workers repair parts and make improvements. It keeps the structure while making it useful.
This verb means to fix up a house or public building. The work can include new paint, floors, or wiring. It makes an old place better for use.

examples.en: The historic station reopened after extensive historical building renovation.
examples.zh: 這座歷史悠久的古蹟車站歷經全方位古蹟整建修復後風華重現。

examples.en: Kitchen and bathroom renovations typically yield the highest return on property value.
examples.zh: 重新修繕翻新廚房流理台與衛浴乾濕分離設備，通常能帶來最高的中古屋保值增值效益。

examples.en: During hotel renovations, guests were relocated to nearby luxury suites.
examples.zh: 在飯店客房進行封閉式大規模內部裝修期間，住客被妥善改安排入住鄰近的高級套房。

examples.en: Comprehensive old-house renovation included replacing all plumbing and electrics.
examples.zh: 這場耗時數月的老屋翻新全室裝修工程徹底更換了全戶所有的水電老舊管線。

examples.en: The museum is temporarily closed for architectural renovation until next spring.
examples.zh: 該公立博物館因配合建築結構整修與內部修繕工程，暫停對外開放至明年春季。

examples.en: Setting aside a contingency buffer in your renovation budget protects against unforeseen repairs.
examples.zh: 在居家裝潢修繕預算中預留一成預備金，能從容因應拆除後意外浮現的追加修繕開銷。

entries.definition: 翻修工程；室內裝修；整建；房屋裝修；老屋翻新；修繕

explains.en: It is the work of repairing or improving an old building or room. A kitchen may get new cabinets. Historic stations can reopen after major repairs.
Owners may update a bathroom or fix a roof. This project can increase a home's value. Guests may need another room while a hotel is being improved.
A building project can restore a worn space and make it more useful. It may include new floors, paint, or plumbing. Older homes often need it.

examples.en: Urban renewal transforms aging neighborhoods into modern, safer communities.
examples.zh: 都市更新（都更）能將老舊街區脫胎換骨為現代化且更安全的宜居社區。

examples.en: The municipal government launched an urban renewal initiative to replace decaying walk-up flats.
examples.zh: 市政府啟動了全面的公辦都更招商專案，積極改建結構老化的無電梯老舊步登公寓。

examples.en: Balancing historic cultural preservation with economic urban renewal is a delicate policy task.
examples.zh: 如何在保護歷史文化街區紋理與推動經濟性都市更新之間取得雙贏，是一項高難度政策課題。

entries.definition: 都市更新；老舊社區重建 (都更)

explains.en: A city improves old buildings, streets, and shared spaces in a neighborhood. Residents may discuss how the changes affect them.
A local plan repairs aging homes and adds safer public areas. Historic buildings may be preserved as part of the work.
An older district may receive new buildings and better sidewalks. City planners try to improve the area while considering the people who live there.

examples.en: Urban zoning laws separate quiet residential zones from heavy industrial areas.
examples.zh: 都市土地使用分區法規將寧靜住宅區與重工業區予以明確劃分。

examples.en: City planners proposed zoning revisions to permit commercial cafes in residential alleys.
examples.zh: 都市規劃學者提出分區放寬修正草案，擬有條件允許文青咖啡館在靜巷住宅區合法進駐經營。

examples.en: Strict coastal zoning regulations prevent destructive overdevelopment along pristine beaches.
examples.zh: 嚴格的沿海海岸分區管制法令，強力遏止了在原始純淨海岸線上盲目進行破壞性過度開發。

entries.definition: 都市土地分區管制法規

explains.en: City rules divide land into areas for homes, shops, or factories. These rules guide how a place may be used.
A town may keep noisy factories away from quiet homes. This planning system controls what can be built in each area.
Before opening a cafe, owners may need to check local land-use rules. These rules separate different kinds of places.

examples.en: Green buildings utilize solar power, rainwater collection, and natural airflow.
examples.zh: 綠建築充分善用太陽能發電、雨水回收循環與自然對流通風設計。

examples.en: The new corporate headquarters was designed as a certified net-zero carbon green building.
examples.zh: 這棟全新的跨國企業企業總部被精心設計為一座獲國際認證的淨零碳排生態綠建築。

examples.en: Government incentives encourage commercial developers to construct certified green buildings.
examples.zh: 政府祭出容積獎勵等優惠措施，大力鼓勵民間建商積極興建取得合格標章的節能綠建築。

examples.en: Certified green buildings incorporate rooftop solar arrays, rainwater collection, and natural airflow.
examples.zh: 榮獲鑽石級標章認證的現代綠建築全面整合了屋頂太陽能板、雨水回收系統與自然對流通風。

examples.en: Designing a certified green building lowers energy bills while dramatically reducing carbon footprints.
examples.zh: 規劃興建符合永續標準的認證綠建築，在顯著降低長期水電開銷的同時更能大幅削減碳足跡。

examples.en: The municipal library achieved diamond-level green building status for its eco-friendly timber construction.
examples.zh: 這座市立總圖書館憑藉其全木構環保工法與節能設計，成功榮獲最高等級鑽石級綠建築認證。

entries.definition: 綠建築；生態節能建築；綠建築（EEWH / LEED 節能環保標章）

explains.en: This is a structure designed to use less energy and cause less harm to the environment. It may collect rainwater or use sunlight for electricity. Natural air can help cool it.
Architects can design an office or library with solar panels and good airflow. This can lower energy bills. It also reduces the building's environmental impact.
A building made with energy and resource saving in mind can be described this way. It may use sunlight and rainwater. Such design helps reduce pollution.

examples.en: The office tower earned the highest Platinum LEED green building certification.
examples.zh: 這座頂級辦公大樓榮獲了最高等級的 LEED 白金級綠建築國際認證。

examples.en: Teachers must obtain official national teaching certification before holding tenure.
examples.zh: 專任教師在正式取得學校終身教職聘任資格前，必須先依法取得國家合格教師證書。

examples.en: Organic farm produce carries rigorous third-party inspection and certification seals.
examples.zh: 通過嚴格檢驗的有機農產品包裝袋上，皆清晰加印著第三方客觀檢驗認證標章。

examples.en: Strict organic certification requires zero synthetic chemical pesticides and synthetic fertilizers.
examples.zh: 嚴格的國立有機農產品認證標準明令要求耕作全程零化學農藥、零合成化肥與零重金屬污染。

examples.en: Achieving international fair-trade certification opened lucrative export markets for small farmers.
examples.zh: 順利取得國際公平貿易標章認證，為純樸山區的獨立小農叩開了高附加價值的外銷市場大門。

examples.en: Inspectors conducted an unannounced farm audit before renewing the organic soil certification.
examples.zh: 驗證機構稽核員在核發土壤有機更新認證證書前，專程進行了一場突擊式的無預警現場抽檢。

examples.en: Passing the PMP project management certification opens doors to multinational leadership roles.
examples.zh: 考取國際專案管理師（PMP）專業證照認證，能為晉升外商跨國企業管理階層開啟大門。

examples.en: Obtaining a cloud architect certification significantly boosts an engineer's salary negotiating power.
examples.zh: 考取國際大廠的原廠雲端架構師頂級證照，能顯著提升資深工程師在求職時的核薪談判籌碼。

examples.en: Renewing medical safety certification requires attending mandatory refresher courses every two years.
examples.zh: 醫護從業人員每隔兩年皆必須按時回訓參加強制性進修時數，以展延專業急救安全資格認證。

examples.en: Strict annual third-party inspections are mandatory to maintain official organic farm certification.
examples.zh: 農場每年必須通過公正第三方機構派員親赴現場採樣檢驗，方能獲頒並維持國家級有機認證。

examples.en: She proudly hung her newly earned ISO quality auditor certification on her office wall.
examples.zh: 她神采奕奕地將剛考取通過的 ISO 國際品質管理系統主導稽核員證書認證，端正掛在個人辦公室牆上。

examples.en: Purchasing coffee bearing Fair Trade certification ensures that smallholder farmers receive dignified compensation.
examples.zh: 選購印有國際公平貿易認證標章的精品咖啡，能實質確保第三世界弱勢小農獲得尊嚴合理的勞動報酬。

entries.definition: 認證；證書；執照；有機農產品標章認證；證明書；國際專業證照認證；證明；嚴格公正之有機農產品認證標章

explains.en: It is an official document or status showing that someone or something meets a standard. Teachers may need it before working in a school. Farms can earn an organic label.
A professional may pass a test to receive proof of training. Buildings can also earn a rating for environmental design. The process checks set requirements.
This formal approval confirms that a person, product, or service meets certain rules. It may involve inspection or study. Keep the document as proof.

examples.en: Installing double-glazed energy-efficient windows keeps indoor temperatures stable.
examples.zh: 安裝雙層真空節能氣密窗能有效維持室內恆溫並隔絕外界熱度。

examples.en: Energy-efficient inverter air conditioners drastically reduce summer electricity consumption.
examples.zh: 一級能效的變頻節能冷氣能顯著減少炎炎夏日家庭冷氣用電量。

examples.en: The government offers cash subsidies for households replacing old appliances with energy-efficient models.
examples.zh: 政府針對汰換老舊家電、改買高能源效率一級節能機種的家庭提供實質的現金退稅補貼。

explains.en: A new refrigerator uses less electricity to keep food cold than an older one. This can lower power use.
Good window seals help a home stay warm in winter and cool in summer. That saves energy.
An appliance designed to do its job while using less power has this quality. It can help reduce electricity bills.

examples.en: Proper roof insulation lowers summer air conditioning electricity bills.
examples.zh: 屋頂做好完善的隔熱防護工程能顯著降低炎夏開冷氣的電費開銷。

examples.en: Heavy fiberglass insulation installed within walls reduces highway traffic noise.
examples.zh: 在輕鋼架隔間牆內填塞厚實的岩棉玻璃纖維吸音隔熱棉，能大幅阻絕快速道路車流噪音。

examples.en: Stripped electrical insulation wires pose a severe electrocution and fire hazard.
examples.zh: 塑膠絕緣外皮剝落裸露的帶電電線會構成極其嚴重的觸電致死與電線走火火災隱患。

examples.en: An inflatable sleeping pad with an R-value of 4.5 blocks freezing ground chill.
examples.zh: 挑選隔熱值（R-value）高達 4.5 以上的充氣防潮睡墊能徹底阻絕冰冷地表寒氣直透背脊。

examples.en: Installing double-glazed windows provides superior thermal insulation for mountain cabins.
examples.zh: 在高山避難山屋安裝雙層中空隔音隔熱玻璃氣密窗，能為室內提供卓越的鎖溫防寒隔熱效果。

examples.en: High-grade closed-cell foam provides reliable puncture-proof insulation for budget backpackers.
examples.zh: 高品質閉孔蛋巢型發泡防潮睡墊耐磨且絕無刺破漏氣風險，是小資背包客最可靠的防寒保暖底墊。

examples.en: High-performance fiberglass thermal insulation locks indoor cool air inside during scorching summer heatwaves.
examples.zh: 在牆體內部填充高效能玻璃纖維隔熱保溫層，能在酷暑熱浪中有效阻絕戶外熱氣並鎖住室內冷氣。

examples.en: Electricians checked the rubber cable insulation to ensure no copper wires were exposed to moisture.
examples.zh: 甲級電氣技師逐一仔細檢視所有電力電纜的耐高溫橡膠絕緣外皮，嚴防銅線裸露受潮引發短路意外。

examples.en: Living in a quiet rural cabin provided him with welcome emotional insulation from corporate office politics.
examples.zh: 遠離塵囂隱居在群山環抱的原木度假小屋，為他構築了一層隔絕商場辦公室爾虞我詐的心靈保護防護罩。

examples.en: Dense rockwool exterior wall insulation keeps modern apartments cool during scorching summer heatwaves.
examples.zh: 在外牆鋪設高密度天然岩棉隔熱保溫層，能讓現代公寓在酷暑熱浪中維持室內清涼。

examples.en: Blown-in cellulose insulation fills attic cavities, stopping heat from transferring down from the roof.
examples.zh: 將回收纖維素隔熱保溫棉吹灌進閣樓夾層，能有效阻斷頂樓鐵皮或水泥屋頂向下傳導的酷熱。

examples.en: Proper thermal insulation reduces condensation behind drywall, preventing dangerous indoor mold growth.
examples.zh: 施作得當的斷熱保溫層能消除石膏板內側的溫差結露，從源頭根絕室內發霉滋生病菌的隱憂。

entries.definition: 隔熱材料；隔音保溫層；絕緣；隔熱防寒絕緣層；隔音；建築隔熱保溫層；高效奈米岩棉阻熱隔熱保溫層

explains.en: A layer inside a wall can keep a home warm or cool. It may also make a room quieter.
Rubber around an electric wire helps stop the current from escaping. This material adds safety.
A sleeping pad can reduce the cold that comes from the ground. This protective layer may also block noise.

examples.en: Good cross ventilation prevents indoor moisture and mildew buildup.
examples.zh: 良好的室內對流通風設計能防止潮濕積聚並避免牆壁發霉生黴。

examples.en: Modern classrooms are equipped with mechanical heat recovery ventilation systems.
examples.zh: 現代化智慧教室普遍全面安裝全熱交換機械換氣通風系統，確保室內氧氣充足。

examples.en: Miners rely on powerful ventilation shafts to pump fresh air into underground tunnels.
examples.zh: 深入地下坑道的採礦工人仰賴大功率通風豎井風機將地表新鮮空氣源源不絕打入地底。

examples.en: Running a small oscillating fan ensures active air ventilation to discourage fungal growth.
examples.zh: 在室內植物架旁開啟小型擺頭循環扇保持空氣對流通風，能有效抑制惱人的真菌與黴菌滋生。

examples.en: Adequate room ventilation dries out wet topsoil steadily and discourages annoying fungus gnats.
examples.zh: 良好的室內對流通風環境能讓澆水後的表層泥土平穩乾爽，杜絕滋生惱人的黑翅蕈蚋小黑飛。

examples.en: Open balcony windows daily to provide fresh outdoor breeze and superior air ventilation.
examples.zh: 每天定時打開陽台窗戶引進戶外新鮮微風，為室內盆栽打造空氣對流極佳的通風環境。

examples.en: Strategically positioned floor-to-ceiling windows create natural cross-ventilation, reducing air conditioning use.
examples.zh: 在客廳與陽台巧妙配置對稱式通風落地窗，能引導涼爽穿堂風自然對流通風，大幅減少開冷氣時間。

examples.en: Adequate kitchen ventilation hoods remove greasy cooking fumes rapidly to safeguard indoor air quality.
examples.zh: 廚房料理區安裝大排風量深罩式抽油煙機，能迅速抽離爆炒油煙，悉心守護全家人長期的呼吸道健康。

examples.en: Deep underground tunnel construction requires massive mechanical ventilation blowers to supply oxygen to workers.
examples.zh: 雪山長公路隧道深層開挖工程，必須架設巨型強效軸流式機械通風抽送風機，日夜不間斷輸送新鮮氧氣。

examples.en: Designing open corridors promotes natural cross-ventilation, cutting reliance on air conditioning in spring.
examples.zh: 巧妙配置開敞式通風廊道引導自然穿堂對流通風，在春秋兩季完全無需開啟冷氣。

examples.en: The thermal stack effect pulls cool air from underground ducts, creating passive ventilation throughout the atrium.
examples.zh: 建築熱壓煙囪效應從地下通風管吸入涼爽地底空氣，在整座挑高中庭創造出自然的被動式對流通風。

examples.en: Adequate natural ventilation prevents indoor carbon dioxide buildup, keeping office workers alert and focused.
examples.zh: 充沛良好的自然對流通風能杜絕室內二氧化碳濃度超標，使辦公室員工整天保持神清氣爽與專注。

entries.definition: 通風；通風系統；換氣；通風良好；空氣對流循環；自然對流通風換氣；通風設備；順應季風之自然穿堂風浮力對流通風

explains.en: This is the movement of fresh air into and stale air out of a room or tunnel. Open windows can provide it. Good airflow helps prevent dampness and stuffiness.
A fan or system can bring clean air into a classroom. Underground workers need it to breathe safely. It can also remove cooking smoke.
Use this term for air moving through a building. It may happen naturally through windows or by machines. Proper airflow keeps indoor spaces safer and more comfortable.

examples.en: The rooftop garden lowers urban heat island temperatures effectively.
examples.zh: 大樓頂樓的空中花園能有效緩解並降低都市熱島效應溫度。

examples.en: Employees enjoy lunch breaks among flowers and potted herbs in the company rooftop garden.
examples.zh: 員工們在午休用餐時間喜歡漫步於公司頂樓空中花園的花草盆栽間放鬆心靈。

examples.en: Architects designed a rainwater-irrigated rooftop garden atop the municipal library.
examples.zh: 建築師在市立圖書館平頂屋頂上方精心規劃了一座由雨水回收系統自動灌溉的空中綠花園。

explains.en: It is a planted green space on top of a building. People may grow herbs there and enjoy a lunch break. Plants can help cool a city.
A library or office may have flowers and vegetables growing above its rooms. Rainwater can be collected for watering. Visitors can relax among the plants.
This garden uses a building's roof for plants and outdoor space. It can reduce heat and provide a pleasant place to rest. Some designs include seating.

examples.en: Rainwater harvesting systems supply water for community garden irrigation.
examples.zh: 雨水回收蓄水系統為社區花園植栽提供了充沛的澆灌水源。

examples.en: In arid drought-prone regions, rural households rely on rainwater harvesting for survival.
examples.zh: 在常年乾旱少雨的偏遠乾旱缺水地區，農村家庭全賴雨水集蓄系統維繫日常生計。

examples.en: Installing a rooftop rainwater harvesting barrel is a simple DIY sustainability project.
examples.zh: 在自家庭院屋簷下裝設雨水收集儲水桶是一項非常簡單好上手的居家環保 DIY 專案。

explains.en: A family collects water from the roof in a tank and uses it to water plants. This can save tap water.
Gutters guide rain into a storage barrel for later use in a garden. A simple system can be set up at home.
A building may catch rainfall and store it for cleaning or irrigation. The stored water should not be used for drinking unless treated.

examples.en: In a smart home, you can control lights and air conditioning with voice commands.
examples.zh: 在現代智慧宅中，您只需透過語音指令即可輕鬆操控全家燈光與冷氣。

examples.en: Smart home security cameras stream live high-definition video directly to your smartphone.
examples.zh: 智慧家庭雲端保全監視器能將現場高畫質影像即時串流同步傳輸至您的智慧型手機。

examples.en: Automated smart home scenes adjust indoor blinds and lighting when the sun goes down.
examples.zh: 自動化智慧家庭情境模式會在夕陽西下日落時分自動為您緩緩降下電動窗簾並點亮室內氣氛燈。

explains.en: Lights, air conditioning, or locks can be controlled by a phone or voice. This setup makes a house connected.
A camera may send video to a phone while the owner is away. Automated settings can adjust blinds at sunset.
Home devices can work together to make daily tasks easier. A person might ask a speaker to turn on the lights.

examples.en: Home automation systems turn off all unused electrical appliances automatically.
examples.zh: 家居自動化系統能自動關閉所有閒置未使用的家用電器設備。

examples.en: Robotic automation on semiconductor assembly lines increases chip manufacturing yields.
examples.zh: 半導體晶圓封裝測試產線上的機器人自動化作業大幅提升了晶片生產良率。

examples.en: Office workflow automation tools eliminate tedious manual data entry tasks.
examples.zh: 辦公室工作流程自動化工具徹底消除了枯燥繁瑣且容易出錯的手動人工作業鍵入。

examples.en: Greenhouse roof vents and automated shade curtains adjust based on external sunlight sensors.
examples.zh: 溫室天窗通風扇與自動化遮陰捲簾會依據室外光照強度感測器數據自動展開升降。

examples.en: Increasing farm automation helps resolve chronic labor shortages during seasonal harvests.
examples.zh: 大幅導入智慧農業自動化設備，能有效緩解農忙採收期長期面臨的農業缺工問題。

examples.en: Robotic packaging automation swiftly weighs, seals, and labels produce for supermarket distribution.
examples.zh: 機器人包裝自動化產線能極速完成蔬果的精準秤重、熱壓封口與產銷標籤貼合作業。

examples.en: Intelligent workflow automation frees administrative workers from repetitive data entry, boosting creativity.
examples.zh: 導入智慧流程自動化（Automation）能將上班族從繁瑣重複的貼表格工作中解脫，將精力投注於高價值創新。

examples.en: Factory floor automation utilizes robotic arms and automated guided vehicles to assemble laptops twenty-four hours a day.
examples.zh: 智慧工廠產線自動化透過六軸機械手臂與無軌 AGV 無人搬運車，全天候二十四小時不間斷精準組裝筆記型電腦。

examples.en: Fears that office automation will cause mass structural unemployment have prompted renewed calls for workforce retraining.
examples.zh: 針對辦公室白領自動化浪潮恐將引發結構性失業的普遍焦慮，產官學界紛紛大力疾呼應全面加速推動全民在職數位再培訓。

examples.en: Robotic laboratory automation accelerates genetic strain engineering while eliminating human manual error.
examples.zh: 導入全自動「實驗室機器人自動化平台」（Automation），在消除人為操作誤差的同時大幅加速菌株演化。

examples.en: Warehouse automation featuring autonomous sorting robots tripled express fulfillment throughput.
examples.zh: 導入全自動分揀機器人的大型物流倉庫自動化系統，讓電商快捷出貨處理效率足足翻了三倍。

examples.en: Home automation systems allow homeowners to adjust air conditioning and lighting remotely via mobile apps.
examples.zh: 智慧居家自動化系統讓屋主身在外頭，也能透過手機應用程式隨時隨地遠端調控冷暖空調與室內照明。

entries.definition: 自動化；自動化控制；自動化運作；認知型辦公室全自動化；聲波微滴液體處理全自動機械手臂平台

explains.en: This is the use of machines or software to do tasks with little human effort. A home system can control lights. Factories use robots to pack products.
A computer program can handle repeated office work such as entering data. This saves workers time. It can also control farm equipment.
This process lets technology perform jobs that people once did by hand. Machines can assemble products all day. It can make work faster but may change some jobs.

examples.en: Unlock your digital lock effortlessly with fingerprint recognition or passcode.
examples.zh: 使用指紋辨識或專屬密碼即可毫不費力輕鬆開啟智慧電子門鎖。

examples.en: Never worry about losing physical house keys again after switching to a digital lock.
examples.zh: 換裝了智慧電子門鎖之後，出門再也不用擔心把實體家門鑰匙不慎遺忘反鎖在家裡。

examples.en: You can generate temporary guest entry codes on your smartphone for the digital lock.
examples.zh: 您可隨時利用手機 App 為來訪的親友或房客產出一組限定時間使用的電子門鎖臨時密碼。

explains.en: It is a door lock opened with a code, fingerprint, or phone instead of a metal key. Owners can make temporary entry codes for guests. Keep codes private.
A home may use this electronic device to control entry. It can recognize a fingerprint or accept a passcode. People need not carry a physical key.
This security device uses electronics to unlock a door. Some versions connect to a phone app. A temporary code can let a visitor enter.

examples.en: MRT stations prioritize universal accessibility with tactile paths and ramps.
examples.zh: 捷運各車站高度重視通用無障礙環境，全面設置導盲磚與斜坡道。

examples.en: Web developers optimize website accessibility so that screen readers can parse content for blind users.
examples.zh: 網頁前端工程師全面優化網站無障礙友善度，使視障者使用的螢幕閱讀器能順暢朗讀網頁文字。

examples.en: The new public library building is praised for its comprehensive wheelchair accessibility.
examples.zh: 這棟全新落成的市立公共圖書館因其極致貼心、全方位到位的輪椅無障礙動線設計而深獲各界盛讚。

examples.en: Barrier-free accessibility ensures wheelchair users navigate hallways and thresholds effortlessly.
examples.zh: 落實全室無門檻的無障礙全齡通用設計，能確保輪椅長輩與推車在家中各空間進出暢行無阻。

examples.en: Web developers optimize digital accessibility so that visually impaired citizens can use screen readers.
examples.zh: 前端網頁工程師全力優化無障礙數位訪問體驗，使視障朋友能夠透過螢幕閱讀輔助軟體輕鬆瀏覽。

examples.en: Modern subway networks prioritize universal accessibility by installing wide fare gates and spacious elevators.
examples.zh: 現代捷運交通網絡將通用無障礙環境列為重中之重，廣設超寬型感應閘門與大容量無障礙電梯。

entries.definition: 無障礙友善環境；可及性；無障礙通用設計；可達性

explains.en: A library has ramps and elevators so wheelchair users can reach every floor. These features make the building easier for everyone to use.
A website’s buttons have labels that a screen reader can read aloud. This helps people with low vision use it.
Clear paths, captions, and ramps help more people take part. The word describes how easy something is to reach or use.

examples.en: The community hall added a gentle wheelchair ramp at the front entrance.
examples.zh: 社區活動中心在前門入口處加設了坡度平緩的無障礙輪椅斜坡道。

examples.en: Handrails along the wheelchair ramp provide stability for elderly visitors and caregivers.
examples.zh: 沿著無障礙輪椅斜坡道兩側加裝的防滑扶手，為銀髮長輩與推車照顧者提供了穩固的支撐。

examples.en: Building codes mandate specific slope angles to keep wheelchair ramps safe and easy to climb.
examples.zh: 建築法規嚴格規範了輪椅斜坡道的特定坡度限制，以確保輪椅推行時的安全與省力平順。

explains.en: This sloped path lets someone using a wheelchair enter a building. Handrails can help people move safely.
A hall may add a gentle slope near its front door. It makes the entrance easier for wheelchair users.
Building rules set how steep this access path can be. Caregivers may also use its railings for support.

examples.en: Yellow tactile paving along sidewalks guides visually impaired pedestrians safely.
examples.zh: 人行道上鋪設的黃色導盲磚能安全引導視障朋友安心前行。

examples.en: Raised bumps on tactile paving alert pedestrians that they are approaching a road intersection.
examples.zh: 導盲地磚上隆起的圓點警示突起能即時提醒視障行人前方即將抵達馬路十字路口。

examples.en: Never park bicycles or motorcycles on tactile paving, as it obstructs blind individuals.
examples.zh: 絕不可將自行車或機車隨意違規停放在黃色導盲磚人行通道上，這會嚴重阻礙視障者前行。

entries.definition: 導盲磚；視障觸覺引導地磚

explains.en: These raised patterns on a sidewalk help people with vision loss find their way. Different bumps can warn that a road is near. Bicycles should not block them.
A person can feel the textured path underfoot or with a cane. It guides them along a sidewalk and warns before a crossing. Keeping it clear is important.
This textured pavement helps blind or low-vision pedestrians move safely. Raised bars can show a direction, while bumps may signal danger ahead. It should remain free of obstacles.

examples.en: High-grade soundproofing ensures a peaceful and quiet recording studio.
examples.zh: 高級專業隔音工程確保了錄音室內部極致寧靜的聲學品質。

examples.en: Triple-pane acoustic windows provide remarkable soundproofing against urban traffic noise.
examples.zh: 三層真空防音氣密膠合玻璃窗展現了卓越的隔音效果，徹底阻隔了繁華市區的車水馬龍噪音。

examples.en: We added thick rubber underlayment beneath hardwood floors to improve floor soundproofing.
examples.zh: 我們在實木地板底下加鋪了一層高密度彈性橡膠隔音墊，以有效降低樓上跑跳對樓下的衝擊音。

examples.en: Quality window soundproofing blocks street traffic noise during rush hours.
examples.zh: 打造高等級的隔音工程能將尖峰上下班時段馬路上呼嘯而過的大車噪音完全阻隔於窗外。

examples.en: The music producer installed acoustic soundproofing panels in his home recording studio.
examples.zh: 這位音樂製作人在自家宅錄錄音室四壁安裝了專業的高密度吸音降噪隔音吸音板。

examples.en: Flooring underlayment materials provide effective impact soundproofing against children running.
examples.zh: 木地板底下鋪設的高性能減震隔音墊，能有效阻隔小朋友奔跑跳躍產生的衝擊撞擊聲。

examples.en: Installing triple-pane soundproofing windows shields bedrooms from bustling traffic rumble.
examples.zh: 臥室全面換裝三層膠合雙真空超靜音氣密隔音窗，能徹底隔絕窗外車水馬龍的都會車流噪音。

examples.en: Recording studios add dense acoustic rockwool insulation inside drywall partitions for soundproofing.
examples.zh: 專業錄音室在雙層石膏板隔間牆內填滿高密度吸音岩棉，以達成嚴格專業的錄音室隔音標準。

examples.en: Heavy blackout curtains with soundproofing linings reduce street noise and block morning sun simultaneously.
examples.zh: 挑選加厚且內附消音夾層的高遮光隔音窗簾，能在阻隔戶外街角喧囂人聲的同時完美遮擋刺眼晨光。

entries.definition: 隔音工程；防音材料；防噪吸音；隔音吸音工程；隔音防護

explains.en: It is material or construction that keeps outside noise from entering a room. Thick windows can reduce traffic sounds. Studios often need a quiet space.
Builders may add special layers to walls and floors to reduce noise. This helps musicians record clearly. Rubber underlayment can improve it.
A room can be made quieter by blocking sounds from nearby streets. Panels and sealed windows may help. It is useful in recording spaces.

examples.en: The wooden pavilion boasts timeless elegance and exceptional aesthetic appeal.
examples.zh: 這座原木涼亭散發出歷久彌新的典雅氣質與卓越的視覺美感魅力。

examples.en: Landscaping along the riverbank enhanced the aesthetic appeal of the historic waterfront.
examples.zh: 沿著河岸展開的綠化景觀美化工程大幅提升了這處歷史水岸街區的整體景觀審美吸引力。

examples.en: Designers strive to strike the perfect balance between practical utility and visual aesthetic appeal.
examples.zh: 頂尖產品設計師無不竭盡所能，在產品的實用機能與視覺美感魅力之間追尋最完美的黃金平衡。

entries.definition: 美學吸引力；視覺美感魅力

explains.en: A wooden pavilion looks beautiful beside the river. Its visual style attracts visitors.
Designers choose colors and shapes that make a room pleasant to look at. This quality can matter as much as usefulness.
Flowers and trees make an old waterfront more attractive. The phrase describes how pleasing something looks.

examples.en: Smart farming uses IoT drones to monitor crop growth and soil moisture.
examples.zh: 智慧農業運用物聯網無人機監控作物生長與土壤濕度。

examples.en: Young agricultural entrepreneurs adopt smart farming techniques to maximize seasonal crop yields.
examples.zh: 返鄉青年農民積極導入智慧農業科技，使各季農作物的採收產量達到最大化。

examples.en: Government subsidies help smallholders invest in smart farming automated irrigation systems.
examples.zh: 政府專案補助款全力扶持在地小農投資建置智慧農業自動化節水灌溉系統。

explains.en: Farmers can use sensors and flying cameras to check crops and soil. This helps them decide when to water.
New tools can measure how wet the soil is. A grower can use the information to care for crops.
This way of growing food uses technology to watch plants and fields. It can help farms use water wisely.

examples.en: Clean hydroponics allows year-round pesticide-free lettuce cultivation in cities.
examples.zh: 純淨的水耕栽培讓都市中全年皆能穩定栽種無農藥生菜。

examples.en: Commercial hydroponics uses ninety percent less water than conventional soil farming.
examples.zh: 商業化水耕栽培所消耗的水資源比傳統土壤農耕足足節省了百分之九十。

examples.en: Urban rooftops are ideal locations to install modern vertical hydroponics towers.
examples.zh: 都會區建築大樓平頂屋頂是搭建現代垂直立體水耕栽培塔的理想場所。

examples.en: Vertical hydroponics grows crisp leafy lettuce indoors using mineral nutrient solutions.
examples.zh: 垂直多層水耕栽培技術在室內植物工廠中利用精密調配的礦物營養水溶液培育鮮脆萵苣。

examples.en: Urban rooftops transformed by hydroponics produce fresh vegetables with ninety percent less water.
examples.zh: 經過水耕農法改造的都會大樓屋頂菜園，能以省水高達百分之九十的驚人效率生產新鮮蔬菜。

examples.en: Hydroponics allows farmers to grow fresh produce in arid desert environments where soil is barren.
examples.zh: 無土水耕栽培技術讓農民得以在土地貧瘠乾旱的荒漠環境中，全年生產純淨新鮮的蔬果。

examples.en: Closed-loop LED hydroponics supplies astronauts with fresh crisp lettuce, crunchy radishes, and sweet strawberries.
examples.zh: 閉環式 LED 水耕栽培系統，為駐站太空人源源不絕供應新鮮生菜、水蘿蔔與草莓。

examples.en: Nutrient-rich water mist delivered through automated hydroponics nourishes plant roots without needing any soil.
examples.zh: 透過微電腦自動化水耕噴霧系統輸送的微量元素營養液，能在完全無需泥土的情況下滋養作物根系。

examples.en: Expanding orbital hydroponics facilities will reduce the expensive cargo mass required for deep-space resupply flights.
examples.zh: 大規模擴展軌道水耕溫室農場，能大幅削減由地球發射的長途深空補給貨運飛船所伴隨的昂貴載荷重量。

entries.definition: 水耕栽培；水培法；水耕栽培技術；無土栽培；太空站無土無重力水耕蔬果栽培系統

explains.en: This is a way to grow plants with water and nutrients instead of soil. It can save water and work on a rooftop. Lettuce is often grown this way.
Plant roots receive mineral-rich water while growing without earth. A farmer can use this method in a dry place. It allows fresh food to be produced indoors.
This growing method uses water to feed roots rather than soil. Lights can help plants grow inside. It is useful where farmland is limited.

examples.en: Organic farming avoids synthetic chemicals to protect soil microbiology.
examples.zh: 有機農業避免使用化學合成農藥，以守護土壤微生物生態。

examples.en: Many tea growers transitioned to organic farming to meet growing international demand.
examples.zh: 眾多在地茶農紛紛轉型投入有機農業耕作，以滿足蓬勃成長的國際市場需求。

examples.en: Certifying an organic farming operation requires three years of pesticide-free soil testing.
examples.zh: 取得有機農業生產認證需要歷經長達三年的嚴格零農藥土壤重金屬檢測期。

explains.en: It is a way of growing crops without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers. Farmers care for soil and use natural methods. Certification may require years of testing.
Growers may avoid artificial chemicals to protect soil and wildlife. This method can help meet demand for natural produce. It takes careful planning.
A farm can use compost, crop rotation, and pest controls from nature. The soil is managed without many synthetic chemicals. Some farms seek official approval.

examples.en: Strict regulations limit chemical pesticide residues on market fruits.
examples.zh: 嚴格的法規限制市售水果上化學農藥的殘留標準。

examples.en: Biological pest control uses beneficial insects instead of toxic chemical pesticides.
examples.zh: 生物防治技術善用益蟲天敵來防治害蟲，以徹底取代劇毒化學農藥。

examples.en: Agricultural inspectors test cabbage leaves routinely for unauthorized pesticide residues.
examples.zh: 農業檢驗員定期對高麗菜葉進行常態抽檢，以查核是否有未授權農藥殘留。

examples.en: Organic gardeners prefer natural cold-pressed neem oil sprays over synthetic chemical pesticides.
examples.zh: 崇尚有機植栽的植友偏好使用冷壓天然苦楝油乳化液噴灑葉背，替代化學合成農藥殺蟲劑。

examples.en: Wear gloves and a mask whenever you apply systemic pesticides to outdoor plants.
examples.zh: 無論在戶外對花草噴灑任何系統型殺蟲農藥，請務必佩戴好橡膠手套與防護口罩。

examples.en: Excessive use of broad-spectrum pesticides can inadvertently harm beneficial pollinators like bees.
examples.zh: 過度頻繁濫用廣效性化學農藥殺蟲劑，可能會在無意間誤傷蜜蜂與瓢蟲等有益昆蟲。

examples.en: Certified organic produce guarantees zero synthetic chemical pesticide residues, ensuring pure safety.
examples.zh: 榮獲標章認證的有機生鮮蔬果保證零化學農藥殘留，為全家人餐桌提供最安心的純淨保障。

examples.en: Farmers who adopt biological pest controls significantly reduce their annual expenses on commercial pesticide sprays.
examples.zh: 轉型導入生物防治農法的小農，其每年採購市售化學殺蟲劑農藥的開銷支出大幅減少。

examples.en: Strict lab inspections ensure that tea exports adhere to international thresholds on chemical pesticide tolerance.
examples.zh: 嚴謹的實驗室精密檢驗確保台灣精品外銷茶葉，完全符合各進口國對化學農藥殘留容許量的嚴苛標準。

entries.definition: 農藥；殺蟲劑；農藥殺蟲劑；除蟲劑；零化學合成農藥殘留

explains.en: A farmer may spray a crop to control insects that damage leaves. Use these products carefully and follow the label.
Some gardeners choose natural ways to protect plants from pests. Chemical products can affect helpful insects too.
This product is used to kill or control insects and other organisms that harm crops. Keep it away from children and pets.

examples.en: Consumers prefer purchasing certified pesticide-free vegetables at farmer markets.
examples.zh: 消費者更青睞在小農市集採買具檢驗認證的無農藥蔬菜。

examples.en: The certified pesticide-free strawberries can be enjoyed straight from the vine.
examples.zh: 獲得嚴格驗證的無農藥草莓從藤架上現摘即可安心大口享用。

examples.en: Sustainable farms proudly market their juicy fruit harvests as 100% pesticide-free.
examples.zh: 堅持友善土地的永續農場自豪地將其採收的鮮甜水果標榜為百分之百無農藥。

entries.definition: 無農藥的；零農藥殘留的

explains.en: These vegetables are grown without chemicals used to kill insects. Wash them before eating.
A farm may sell berries grown without using crop-killing sprays. Customers can enjoy them after rinsing.
This describes food made without insect-killing chemicals. Some people choose it to avoid pesticide residue.

examples.en: The historical Chia-Nan Canal supplies comprehensive farmland irrigation.
examples.zh: 歷史悠久的嘉南大圳為廣袤農田提供了完善充沛的灌溉水源。

examples.en: Automated micro-irrigation delivers water and liquid nutrients straight to plant roots.
examples.zh: 自動化微噴灌系統能將水分與液態營養精準滴灌直達植物根系深處。

examples.en: Without proper canal irrigation, crops wither quickly during long rainless summers.
examples.zh: 若缺乏完善的水圳灌溉系統，農作物在炎炎無雨的盛夏很快便會乾枯凋萎。

examples.en: Solar-powered drip irrigation delivers micro-droplets of water directly to plant root zones.
examples.zh: 太陽能驅動的智慧精準微量滴灌系統能將每一滴寶貴水資源與液肥精準送達作物根系深處。

examples.en: Building modern irrigation canals transformed dry parched fields into fertile farmland.
examples.zh: 修築現代化的水利灌溉溝渠灌溉網絡，將原本乾涸龜裂的貧瘠荒地變身為良田沃土。

examples.en: Automated irrigation systems monitor real-time soil moisture sensors before activating water valves.
examples.zh: 自動化智慧灌溉系統在開啟電動給水閥門之前，會實時讀取土壤水分感測器回傳的濕度數據。

entries.definition: 灌溉；水利設施；精準灌溉；農田水利

explains.en: This is the process of bringing water to crops or gardens through canals, pipes, or sprinklers. It helps plants during dry weather. Sensors can control when water flows.
A farmer may use a system to send water to plant roots. Drip tubes deliver small amounts directly. This is useful when rain is scarce.
Fields need water to grow healthy crops. A canal or hose can carry it across dry land. Modern systems can check soil before turning on.

examples.en: Terraced tea plantations cover the misty hillsides of Alishan.
examples.zh: 阿里山雲霧繚繞的山坡上遍佈著層層疊疊的梯田茶園。

examples.en: Tourists can take scenic hiking trails wandering through centuries-old tea plantations.
examples.zh: 觀光客可沿著秀麗的步道漫步穿梭於歷史悠久的百年老茶園之間。

examples.en: Sun Moon Lake is home to famous black tea plantations surrounded by tranquil lakes.
examples.zh: 日月潭周邊座落著許多被寧靜湖光山色所環抱的著名頂級紅茶茶園。

explains.en: It is a large area of land where tea bushes are grown. Terraced fields can cover misty hillsides. Visitors may walk among the plants.
Farmers care for rows of tea plants on a hillside. Leaves are picked and later processed into a drink. Some scenic areas welcome tourists.
This farm grows bushes whose leaves are made into tea. Cool mountain weather may suit certain varieties. Workers harvest the leaves by hand or machine.

examples.en: Tea picking ladies wearing floral hats harvest tender two-leaf buds at dawn.
examples.zh: 採茶阿姨頭戴花布斗笠，於清晨破曉時分採摘一心二葉嫩芽。

examples.en: Traditional hand tea picking requires gentle dexterity so leaves are not bruised.
examples.zh: 傳統手工採茶需要極其輕巧細緻的指尖手感，以避免茶葉嫩芽遭受擠壓碰傷。

examples.en: Visitors can participate in hands-on tea picking tours during the spring harvest festival.
examples.zh: 遊客可在春季採茶文化節期間親身體驗戴斗笠穿花衣下田採茶的樂趣。

explains.en: Workers carefully remove young leaves from tea bushes during the harvest. The leaves are taken to be processed.
Visitors may join a spring activity in which they gather tender leaves by hand. Gentle handling helps keep them intact.
In the hills, harvesters collect leaves from rows of tea plants. The work often starts early in the day.

examples.en: Controlling fermentation temperature creates distinctive Oolong tea fragrances.
examples.zh: 精準掌控發酵溫度能孕育出烏龍茶獨特迷人的天然花果香。

examples.en: Bakeries rely on natural sourdough yeast fermentation to produce crusty bread.
examples.zh: 手工烘焙坊仰賴天然酸種酵母的緩慢發酵，烤製出外脆內軟的歐式硬麵包。

examples.en: Black tea undergoes complete enzymatic fermentation, giving it a deep amber color.
examples.zh: 紅茶在製程中歷經完全的全發酵氧化作用，從而造就出其深邃晶亮的琥珀色茶湯。

examples.en: Overnight cold fermentation in the refrigerator develops deep complex grain flavor.
examples.zh: 將打好的麵團放入冰箱進行十八小時低溫冷藏發酵，能醞釀出層次極為深邃的麥香。

examples.en: Yeast converts simple sugars into carbon dioxide and alcohol during dough fermentation.
examples.zh: 在麵團發酵過程中，酵母菌會將單糖分解轉化為膨脹氣體二氧化碳與微量酒精香氣。

examples.en: Precise temperature control is vital for steady, predictable bread fermentation.
examples.zh: 精準嚴格的環境溫濕度控管，對於維持麵包穩定且可預測的發酵節奏至關重要。

examples.en: Partial 20% fermentation gives Baozhong tea its signature fresh lilac fragrance and golden liquor.
examples.zh: 百分之二十的輕發酵工藝，賦予文山包種茶標誌性的撲鼻優雅花香與澄澈金黃蜜綠茶湯。

examples.en: Sourdough bread development relies on slow natural wild yeast fermentation to build depth of flavor.
examples.zh: 歐式天然酵母酸種麵包的迷人口感，全憑長時間野生酵母與乳酸菌的緩慢自然低溫發酵醞釀而成。

examples.en: Taiwan's Hakka pickled mustard greens achieve rich savory umami through months of earthen crock fermentation.
examples.zh: 傳統客家庄老蘿蔔乾與福菜，經過陶甕內數月密封發酵熟成，轉化出醇厚回甘、令人回味無窮的甘醇鹹香。

examples.en: Inoculating natural fruit yeast into the fermentation tank controls acidity levels with scientific precision.
examples.zh: 在發酵槽中接種特選天然水果酵母，能以科學精準度掌控酸值曲線演化。

examples.en: Extended cold fermentation unlocks delicate wine-like nuances without producing pungent vinegar notes.
examples.zh: 採用低溫延長發酵工藝，能為咖啡豆引出如勃艮第紅酒般的優雅香氣，且絕不產生刺鼻醋酸敗筆。

examples.en: The master processor measures pH and Brix levels hourly throughout the critical fermentation window.
examples.zh: 專業後製處理大師在發酵關鍵數十小時內，每小時以精密探針量測發酵液的 pH 酸鹼值與糖度變化。

examples.en: Precision fermentation brews animal-free milk proteins and egg whites identical to traditional dairy.
examples.zh: 「精準發酵工藝」（Precision Fermentation），利用微生物直接釀造出與傳統乳製品分子結構完全一致的純淨乳蛋白。

examples.en: Traditional kimchi undergoes slow lactic acid fermentation in buried earthenware jars throughout winter.
examples.zh: 正宗韓式泡菜在深埋地下的大陶甕中歷經漫長冬日，藉由緩慢的天然乳酸菌發酵熟成出絕妙酸香。

examples.en: Breweries rely on controlled yeast fermentation to transform malt sugars into crisp pilsner beer.
examples.zh: 精釀啤酒廠嚴格管控低溫酵母發酵環境，將大麥麥芽中的糖分完美轉化為口感清爽的金黃皮爾森啤酒。

entries.definition: 發酵；發酵工藝；麵團發酵過程；發酵作用；茶葉發酵氧化度；精密菌種接種與低溫受控發酵工序；精準發酵工藝 (酵母菌直接釀造無牛牛奶與卵白)

explains.en: Yeast can change sugar into gas and alcohol in bread or drinks. The process may create new flavors.
Tea leaves or vegetables can change as tiny living organisms work on them. Temperature affects the result.
A baker lets dough rest while yeast makes bubbles. In some foods, this process creates a sour or rich taste.

examples.en: Dongding Oolong is famous for its rich, charcoal-roasted woody aroma.
examples.zh: 凍頂烏龍茶以其濃郁醇厚、炭焙焙火的木質香氣著稱。

examples.en: The street vendor sold paper bags filled with freshly roasted sweet chestnuts.
examples.zh: 街邊小販沿街叫賣著裝滿剛出爐熱氣騰騰的現炒現烤糖炒栗子。

examples.en: She loves sipping roasted barley tea on warm summer afternoons.
examples.zh: 在微風徐徐的初夏午後，她最愛靜靜啜飲一杯清涼解渴的炭焙麥茶。

explains.en: This describes food or beans cooked with dry heat, often in an oven or over a fire. Chestnuts can be prepared this way. Tea leaves may also be heated to create a warm aroma.
A cook uses this method to brown food without boiling it. The result may have a rich smell. Chestnuts sold by a street vendor are a common example.
Use this adjective for something cooked or heated until it develops a deeper flavor. Barley tea is made from heated grains. A woody scent can come from this process.

examples.en: Alishan High Mountain Tea yields a sweet, floral, and lingering brew.
examples.zh: 阿里山高山茶茶湯清澈甘甜，散發優雅持久的高冷花香。

examples.en: High Mountain Tea thrives under cool mountain fog and intense ultraviolet sunlight.
examples.zh: 台灣高山茶在高山涼爽雲霧繚繞與充沛紫外線照射下生長茁壯。

examples.en: Connoisseurs brew High Mountain Tea in purple clay pots to accentuate delicate aromas.
examples.zh: 品茶行家習慣使用宜興紫砂壺來沖泡高山茶，以完美激發出其幽微細膩的茶香。

explains.en: It is a Taiwanese tea grown in high-elevation areas. Cool air and mountain mist can give it a delicate aroma. Alishan is a famous growing region.
The tea plants grow far above sea level in Taiwan's mountains. The leaves may produce a floral and sweet drink. Many people brew it in a clay pot.
Farmers cultivate this variety in cool upland conditions. Its flavor can be light and fragrant. Visitors may buy it from mountain tea farms.

examples.en: Taiwan produces the world's finest semi-fermented Oolong tea varieties.
examples.zh: 台灣出產全球品質最為頂級卓越的半發酵烏龍茶品種。

examples.en: Drinking hot Oolong tea after an oily meal aids digestion and refreshes the palate.
examples.zh: 在享用油膩大餐後飲上一杯溫熱烏龍茶，能去油解膩並讓口氣清新爽口。

examples.en: The tea master shared rare vintage Oolong tea aged for twenty years.
examples.zh: 製茶大師慷慨與大家分享珍藏長達二十年之久的陳年老烏龍茶。

examples.en: Dong Ding Oolong tea delivers a rich, roasted honey flavor and golden liquor.
examples.zh: 經典鹿谷凍頂烏龍茶散發著迷人的熟果蜜香與碳焙甘醇，茶湯呈現澄澈琥珀金黃。

examples.en: Semi-oxidized Oolong tea strikes a balance between fresh green and robust black teas.
examples.zh: 屬於半發酵青茶的烏龍茶，完美兼具了綠茶的鮮爽清香與全發酵紅茶的濃郁醇厚。

examples.en: Drinking a warm cup of roasted Oolong tea after meals aids digestion pleasantly.
examples.zh: 在大快朵頤享用豐盛大餐後，來上一杯溫潤的慢火炭焙烏龍茶有助於解膩助消化。

entries.definition: 烏龍茶；半發酵茶；半發酵青茶

explains.en: This Taiwanese tea is partly oxidized, giving it a taste between fresh green and dark black varieties. It may have a roasted or floral flavor.
A tea maker rolls and heats the leaves to create a fragrant drink. Dong Ding is one well-known style.
People often drink this warm tea after a meal. It is made from leaves processed to an intermediate level of oxidation.

examples.en: Oriental Beauty tea develops natural honey and ripe peach aromas from leafhoppers.
examples.zh: 東方美人茶經小綠葉蟬叮咬後散發出天然蜜香與熟果香。

examples.en: Queen Victoria praised Oriental Beauty tea for its exquisite appearance and sweet fragrance.
examples.zh: 英國維多利亞女王盛讚東方美人茶在水晶杯中宛如絕美佳人起舞，甘醇芬芳。

examples.en: Producing Oriental Beauty tea requires zero chemical sprays to protect tiny green leafhoppers.
examples.zh: 製作頂級東方美人茶必須堅持全程不噴灑農藥，以保護小綠葉蟬著涎吸食。

examples.en: Oriental Beauty tea is bitten by green leafhoppers, creating a natural muscatel honey aroma.
examples.zh: 經小綠葉蟬叮咬著涎的東方美人茶帶有獨一無二的天然純粹蜜糖香與熟果香。

examples.en: Queen Victoria was so impressed by Oriental Beauty tea that she bestowed its elegant name.
examples.zh: 維多利亞女王在品嚐此茶後驚艷讚賞其晶瑩茶湯，因而賜予其優雅動人的「東方美人」美名。

examples.en: The leaves of authentic Oriental Beauty tea display five vibrant shades: white, green, yellow, red, and brown.
examples.zh: 正宗優質東方美人茶的乾茶葉呈現白、綠、黃、紅、褐五色斑斕交織的瑰麗光澤。

entries.definition: 東方美人茶；白毫烏龍；白毫烏龍茶

explains.en: This Taiwanese tea is known for a honey-like smell. Tiny leafhoppers help create its special flavor.
The leaves can show shades of white, green, yellow, red, and brown. A British queen is said to have admired it.
Farmers avoid chemical sprays so small insects can feed on the tea leaves. This gives the drink a sweet aroma.

examples.en: Wenshan Baozhong tea is lightly oxidized, crisp, and wonderfully floral.
examples.zh: 文山包種茶發酵程度輕，口感清香甘醇，帶有幽雅的花香。

examples.en: The elongated twisted leaves of Baozhong tea brew into an emerald golden liquid.
examples.zh: 文山包種茶外觀條索緊結墨綠，沖泡後呈現澄澈透亮的蜜綠金黃茶湯。

examples.en: Families in Pinglin have preserved Baozhong tea processing techniques for generations.
examples.zh: 坪林茶鄉的茶農家族世世代代悉心傳承著繁複細緻的文山包種茶製茶手藝。

explains.en: This lightly oxidized tea from Taiwan has twisted leaves and a fresh floral smell. It brews into a clear golden-green drink. Families in Pinglin have made it for generations.
Tea makers gently process these leaves so the flavor stays light and fragrant. The dry leaves are long and curled. The drink has a clean taste.
This Taiwanese tea is known for its delicate aroma and pale color. Its leaves are shaped into narrow twists. It is produced in areas such as Pinglin.

examples.en: Sun Moon Lake Ruby Black Tea No. 18 boasts cinnamon and mint notes.
examples.zh: 日月潭紅玉紅茶（台茶 18 號）蘊含天然肉桂與薄荷香氣。

examples.en: English afternoon tea pairs strong black tea with fresh milk and warm scones.
examples.zh: 英式傳統下午茶習慣將濃郁全發酵紅茶調和鮮奶，並搭配新鮮溫熱的司康鬆餅。

examples.en: Artisanal black tea harvested in Hualien offers rich honey undertones.
examples.zh: 花蓮在地精製的花蓮蜜香紅茶帶有濃郁甘甜的天然熟果與荔枝蜜香。

explains.en: It is a fully oxidized tea with a darker color and strong flavor. People may add milk in an afternoon cup. Taiwan's Sun Moon Lake is known for a local variety.
Tea leaves are processed until they become dark and develop a rich taste. Some blends are enjoyed with milk and scones. Hualien grows flavorful kinds.
This drink has a deep color and can taste malty or brisk. It is popular around the world. A local Taiwanese variety may have notes of cinnamon and mint.

examples.en: Tea connoisseurs appreciate the subtle differences in mountain terroir.
examples.zh: 品茗行家懂得細細品鑑不同山頭氣山場風土的細膩差異。

examples.en: The art connoisseur instantly identified the Renaissance painting as a rare original.
examples.zh: 這位資深藝術鑑賞家一眼便看出這幅文藝復興畫作是極為罕見的大師真跡。

examples.en: He is a recognized coffee connoisseur who roasts single-origin beans at home.
examples.zh: 他是朋友圈中公認的精品咖啡行家，平日裡習慣親自在自家烘焙單品咖啡豆。

examples.en: Tea connoisseurs can identify the mountain peak harvest region from a single sip.
examples.zh: 資深品茗行家只需輕啜一口茶湯，便能精準辨識出該批茶葉出自哪座高山茶區。

examples.en: As an art connoisseur, she frequently travels abroad to attend prestigious gallery auctions.
examples.zh: 作為一名眼光獨到的藝術鑑賞名家，她經常飛往歐美各地參加頂級藝術畫廊拍賣會。

examples.en: The wine connoisseur praised the vintage for its velvety balance and long finish.
examples.zh: 這位品酒行家由衷讚嘆該年份紅酒單寧如絲絨般圓潤平衡，尾韻悠長回味無窮。

entries.definition: 品茗行家；鑑賞家；行家；鑑賞名家；品鑑家

explains.en: A person who knows a great deal about tea can notice small differences in smell and taste. Others may ask for this person’s opinion.
Someone who studies paintings can recognize the work of an artist. This person has expert taste in that area.
A coffee lover may learn about beans, roasting, and flavor. The word describes a knowledgeable judge of fine things.

examples.en: Practicing Gongfu tea ceremony cultivates inner calm and mindfulness.
examples.zh: 研習功夫茶道茶藝能修身養性，培養內心的寧靜與專注。

examples.en: The traditional Japanese tea ceremony follows rigorous rituals of hospitality and respect.
examples.zh: 傳統日本茶道恪守著「和、敬、清、寂」的嚴謹待客迎賓禮法。

examples.en: The cultural pavilion hosted a peaceful tea ceremony demonstration for foreign guests.
examples.zh: 台灣文化館特地為遠道而來的外賓舉辦了一場氛圍恬靜清雅的茶道茶席展演。

explains.en: People prepare and serve tea through a careful set of steps. The host welcomes guests with respect.
In Japan, this tradition follows quiet rules and graceful movements. It can help people feel calm.
A cultural center may show visitors how to prepare tea. Guests learn about the customs and care involved.

examples.en: The boiling water unlocked rich floral aromas from the dry leaves.
examples.zh: 滾燙的熱水瞬間喚醒了乾茶葉中所蘊含的濃郁花香。

examples.en: The comforting aroma of freshly ground espresso filled the quiet morning air.
examples.zh: 剛研磨好的義式濃縮咖啡豆散發出撫慰人心的迷人香氣，瀰漫在靜謐晨曦中。

examples.en: Scented candles released a soothing lavender aroma throughout the bedroom.
examples.zh: 香氛精油蠟燭在臥房中緩緩散發出舒緩身心緊繃的天然薰衣草芳香。

examples.en: Freshly ground roasted coffee beans release an intoxicating chocolate aroma.
examples.zh: 剛研磨破壁的新鮮烘焙咖啡熟豆瞬間在空氣中釋放出令人陶醉的濃郁黑巧克力香氣。

examples.en: The sweet floral aroma of blooming night jasmine filled the warm summer garden.
examples.zh: 盛開的夜來香所散發出的清甜高雅花香，瀰漫在溫暖怡人的夏夜花園中。

examples.en: Inhaling the herbal aroma of boiling peppermint tea cleared his blocked sinuses.
examples.zh: 深吸一口滾燙薄荷茶所蒸騰出的清新草本香氣，頓時讓他阻塞的鼻腔倍感通暢舒緩。

examples.en: Inhaling the dry aroma cup releases intoxicating layers of honey, gardenia, and roasted almond.
examples.zh: 輕輕將聞香杯靠近鼻尖深呼吸，濃郁迷人的天然蜜香、梔子花香與堅果焦香層層綻放。

examples.en: The comforting aroma of freshly ground espresso filled the quiet bookstore cafe every morning.
examples.zh: 每天清晨，現磨義式濃縮咖啡豆烘焙出的溫暖香濃氣息，飄散在整間靜謐溫馨的獨立書店咖啡館中。

examples.en: Alpine cedar forests release a crisp, resinous aroma that refreshes weary hikers immediately.
examples.zh: 漫步於阿里山紅檜神木步道間，四周高聳雲杉散發出清新怡人的天然芬多精清香，令人神清氣爽。

examples.en: The warm, intoxicating buttery aroma floating from the oven makes it impossible to resist buying a loaf.
examples.zh: 剛出爐那一股溫暖迷人、撲鼻而來的發酵奶油麥香，讓人忍不住駐足買下一整條剛出爐的長棍。

examples.en: Roasted almonds and dark cocoa release an irresistible toasted aroma throughout the entire kitchen.
examples.zh: 現烤杏仁堅果與莊園級黑可可膏在烤箱中散發出令人難以抗拒的烘烤濃香，瀰漫整間甜點工坊。

examples.en: As the crust cools on wire racks, it emits a subtle wheaty aroma that signals flawless fermentation.
examples.zh: 當麵包出爐排放在冷卻鐵網架上呼吸散熱時，空氣中飄散著純淨迷人的天然麥香，印證了發酵的完滿。

examples.en: Cold-distilled cucumber water releases an intense, pure aroma that awakens the guest's nasal palate.
examples.zh: 低溫蒸餾出的黃瓜純露散發出極致純淨的「清新香氣」（Aroma），瞬間喚醒食客的鼻腔嗅覺感官。

examples.en: Freshly ground roasted coffee beans filled the cozy neighborhood cafe with an irresistible morning aroma.
examples.zh: 現磨現煮的深烘焙咖啡豆，讓整間社區街角咖啡館瀰漫著令人難以抗拒的迷人晨間芳香。

examples.en: Sommelier students learn to identify subtle fruit aromas like blackcurrant and plum in aged red wines.
examples.zh: 侍酒師專業學員努力練習從陳年紅酒中，細細嗅辨出黑醋栗與成熟李子等微妙的果實芳香。

entries.definition: 香氣；芳香；茶香；茶香咖啡香；茶葉天然高雅花果香氣；剛出爐撲鼻而來之誘人奶油麥香；低溫減壓蒸餾完整鎖住之新鮮香草揮發性香氣

explains.en: This is a pleasant smell, often coming from food, flowers, or a drink. Fresh coffee can fill a room with it. A candle may also give off a soft one.
When tea leaves are placed in hot water, a lovely smell may rise. People can notice it before tasting the drink. It can also come from flowers.
Use this word for a rich or enjoyable scent. Peppermint tea may have a fresh one. It can make a kitchen or garden feel inviting.

examples.en: Premium high-mountain tea leaves a sweet, refreshing aftertaste in your throat.
examples.zh: 優質高山烏龍茶在喉頭留下綿長清甜、生津止渴的回甘餘韻。

examples.en: Dark chocolate with sea salt leaves a pleasant bitter-sweet aftertaste on the tongue.
examples.zh: 頂級海鹽黑巧克力在舌尖味蕾上留下了一股美妙愉悅、苦中帶甜的迷人餘韻。

examples.en: The spicy hotpot broth left a lingering tingling aftertaste that lasted for minutes.
examples.zh: 重慶麻辣鍋香濃的湯底在唇齒間留下了一股久久不散的微麻回味後勁。

examples.en: The Geisha coffee left a lingering jasmine aftertaste that lasted for minutes.
examples.zh: 這杯極品藝妓手沖在入喉之後留下了悠長久遠的茉莉花香餘韻，令人回味無窮。

examples.en: High-quality dark chocolate leaves a clean, pleasant aftertaste without bitterness.
examples.zh: 頂級黑巧克力在喉頭融化後會留下乾淨甘醇的悠揚餘韻，絲毫沒有令人不悅的苦澀。

examples.en: Some artificial sweeteners leave an unpleasantly metallic aftertaste on the tongue.
examples.zh: 某些廉價人工代糖在吞嚥之後會在舌尖殘留一股化學金屬般的怪異後味。

examples.en: The long-lasting sweet aftertaste lingers on the palate for minutes after swallowing.
examples.zh: 吞下溫熱茶湯後，喉頭深處源源不絕湧現出令人驚豔的生津回甘（Aftertaste），口齒留香。

examples.en: Artisanal dark chocolate has a complex bitter-sweet aftertaste with subtle hints of red berries.
examples.zh: 手工精品高純度黑巧克力在口中緩緩融化後，在舌尖留下一抹帶有野生蔓越莓果酸的迷人苦甜餘韻。

examples.en: The synthetic cough syrup left a chemical, chalky aftertaste that required drinking two glasses of water to clear.
examples.zh: 那款人工調製的兒童感冒糖漿帶有一股刺鼻的化學藥水味與粉狀粉質感餘味，讓人得狂灌兩大杯溫水才能散去。

examples.en: High-grown mountain coffees leave a clean aftertaste reminiscent of white peach and orange blossoms.
examples.zh: 真正頂級的高山咖啡，在喝完後會在喉頭留下如白桃與橙花般清甜優雅、持久不散的回甘餘韻。

examples.en: A harsh, drying aftertaste indicates poor roasting technique or green bean insect defects.
examples.zh: 吞嚥後喉頭若殘留刺喉、收斂乾澀的刮舌尾韻，通常代表烘焙火候失控或是生豆存在蟲蛀瑕疵。

examples.en: The sweet chocolate finish displayed an astonishing aftertaste that persisted for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 吞下這口精品濃縮咖啡後，齒頰間留存著香甜濃郁的黑巧克力尾韻，悠揚迴盪整整十分鐘之久。

entries.definition: 餘韻；回甘；後味；回甘尾韻；喉韻生津回甘 (Hui Gan)；餘味；唇齒留香、優雅悠長之花果香餘韻

explains.en: It is a flavor that remains in the mouth after eating or drinking. Dark chocolate may leave a slightly bitter note. Fine tea can finish sweetly.
A spicy broth may leave a tingling sensation for a short time. This lingering flavor comes after the food is swallowed. It can be pleasant or unpleasant.
Some drinks leave a long-lasting taste on the tongue. People may describe it as floral, sweet, or sharp. It is the flavor that stays afterward.

examples.en: Brew loose tea leaves with 95°C water for forty-five seconds.
examples.zh: 使用攝氏九十五度熱水沖泡散裝茶葉約四十五秒。

examples.en: Local craft breweries brew seasonal beers using Taiwanese tropical fruits.
examples.zh: 在地精釀啤酒廠善用台灣盛產的熱帶水果，精心釀造獨特風味的季節限定啤酒。

examples.en: Dark storm clouds gathered over the horizon, signaling that a typhoon was brewing.
examples.zh: 遠方天際線烏雲滾滾密布翻騰，預示著一場暴烈颱風正悄然在海面上醞釀成形。

explains.en: Put tea leaves in hot water and wait for the flavor to come out. Small craft companies also make beer this way.
Dark clouds form over the hills before a storm begins. This verb can describe preparing a drink or developing.
A coffee shop steeps leaves in hot water to make a warm drink. The same verb can mean producing beer.

examples.en: Hold the small porcelain teacup gently by the rim.
examples.zh: 用指尖輕輕捏握住小巧精緻的白瓷品茗茶杯邊緣。

examples.en: The host filled every teacup with hot amber Oolong tea.
examples.zh: 主人熱情地為每位圍坐茶席的賓客斟滿了熱氣騰騰的琥珀色溫潤烏龍茶。

examples.en: Hand-thrown ceramic teacups keep your hands warm on chilly winter mornings.
examples.zh: 純手工手拉坯柴燒陶杯在寒意料峭的冬日清晨為雙手傳遞了滿滿的溫暖。

examples.en: Guests sip hot tea from small celadon porcelain teacups that cool the liquid to the ideal drinking temperature.
examples.zh: 賓客手捧溫潤青瓷品茗杯細啜慢飲，杯身小巧能讓茶湯迅速降溫至最適合入口的甘醇溫度。

examples.en: The museum's antique collection includes an imperial blue-and-white porcelain teacup from the Ming court.
examples.zh: 博物館典藏庫房中珍藏著一只明代宣德官窯青花雲龍紋壓手品茗杯，釉色濃豔青翠。

examples.en: She cradled the warm ceramic teacup with both hands while gazing out at the rain over Taipei.
examples.zh: 她雙手輕輕捧著溫暖手捏陶杯，出神地凝望著窗外大台北盆地煙雨濛濛的迷人景致。

entries.definition: 茶杯；品茗杯；精緻品茗杯；品杯

explains.en: This small cup is made for drinking tea. Hold it gently near the rim.
A host may pour warm oolong into a little porcelain vessel. The small size helps the tea cool before drinking.
A delicate ceramic cup can keep a drink warm in your hands. Museums may display old ones made for tea.

examples.en: Tainan was officially designated a City of Gastronomy by international critics.
examples.zh: 台南這座歷史古都獲得國際美食評論家公認為美食之都。

examples.en: French gastronomy has been recognized by UNESCO as intangible cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 法國美食大餐與深厚烹飪文化已被聯合國教科文組織列入非物質文化遺產。

examples.en: Culinary tourists travel across continents to experience authentic regional gastronomy.
examples.zh: 各國美食饕客不惜跨越重洋長途跋涉，只為親身體驗世界各地的在地美食文化。

examples.en: Tainan was designated a City of Gastronomy for its rich culinary heritage.
examples.zh: 台南市憑藉其淵遠流長的深厚飲食文化底蘊，獲評為國際美食之都。

examples.en: French gastronomy has been officially recognized as an intangible cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 法國美食學已被聯合國教科文組織正式列為非物質文化遺產。

examples.en: Students flock to San Sebastian to study the art and science of modern gastronomy.
examples.zh: 眾多學生湧向聖賽巴斯提安，研習現代美食學的精湛技藝與科學原理。

examples.en: Avant-garde molecular gastronomy deconstructs familiar dishes using laboratory physics and chemistry.
examples.zh: 前衛「分子美食學」（Molecular Gastronomy），運用物理化學原理將傳統經典料理大膽解構重組。

examples.en: Food critics travel across Europe to explore the cutting edge of contemporary French gastronomy.
examples.zh: 美食評論家走訪歐洲各地，深入探尋當代法國美食學的最前端浪潮。

examples.en: The university offers an interdisciplinary program examining the cultural history and science of gastronomy.
examples.zh: 這所大學開設跨領域課程，專門探討烹飪美食學的文化歷史與科學成因。

entries.definition: 美食學；美食文化；烹飪法；烹飪美學；精緻餐飲文化；結合物理化學與烹飪藝術之現代分子美食學

explains.en: This is the study and enjoyment of good food and cooking. A city may become famous for its local dishes. Students can learn about food's culture and history.
Travelers may visit a place to taste its regional cooking. This subject explores how food is prepared and enjoyed. It can combine science and culture.
Use this word for the art and knowledge of food. A university course may explore recipes and traditions. Critics can praise a city for its dining culture.

examples.en: Taiwan's culinary innovation blends traditional street food with modern fine dining.
examples.zh: 台灣的精緻廚藝創新將傳統街頭小吃與現代高端餐飲完美揉合。

examples.en: The aspiring young chef enrolled in a renowned European culinary institute.
examples.zh: 這位懷抱料理大夢的青年主廚毅然遠赴歐洲頂尖名門廚藝學院深造。

examples.en: Fresh aromatic herbs and garlic are essential staples of Italian culinary tradition.
examples.zh: 新鮮芳香的各類西式香草與大蒜是義大利傳統廚藝烹飪傳統中不可或缺的靈魂。

examples.en: Le Cordon Bleu trained him in exquisite French and Asian culinary arts.
examples.zh: 藍帶廚藝學院的扎實訓練鍛造了他融合法式經典與亞洲風貌的卓越廚藝。

examples.en: Traveling through Italy was an unforgettable culinary journey filled with rustic flavors.
examples.zh: 走訪義大利是一場令人難忘的美食之旅，充滿了樸實道地的風味。

examples.en: The cooking school helps young enthusiasts develop professional culinary skills.
examples.zh: 這所廚藝學校幫助年輕的美食愛好者培養專業的烹飪技能。

examples.en: Farm-to-table restaurants showcase the natural sweetness of fresh root vegetables using simple culinary techniques.
examples.zh: 產地到餐桌特色餐廳運用返璞歸真的料理手法，將現拔新鮮蘿蔔與地瓜的原汁原味發揮到淋漓盡致。

examples.en: She decided to enroll in a prestigious French culinary academy to master pastry arts and dessert creation.
examples.zh: 她下定決心報名前往享譽盛名的巴黎頂級藍帶廚藝學院進修，全心專研精緻法式甜點與烘焙藝術。

examples.en: Taiwan's bustling night markets are celebrated worldwide as vibrant epicenters of diverse street-food culinary culture.
examples.zh: 台灣熱鬧非凡的各大在地觀光夜市，被全球國際旅人譽為百花齊放、充滿無限創意的庶民街頭小吃料理文化聖地。

examples.en: The young chef dedicated his youth to mastering traditional and modern culinary techniques.
examples.zh: 年輕主廚將整個青春奉獻於磨練傳統與現代「頂級廚藝美學」（Culinary Arts），追求極致風味。

examples.en: Graduating from a renowned culinary academy opened international career doors for aspiring pastry makers.
examples.zh: 從頂尖廚藝名校畢業，為這群有志成為甜點師的年輕人打開了通往國際伸展台的大門。

examples.en: Taiwan's night markets offer an extraordinarily vibrant culinary landscape celebrated by worldwide tourists.
examples.zh: 台灣夜市擁有無比豐富多元的庶民美食景觀，深受來自世界各地觀光客的熱烈讚譽。

entries.definition: 烹飪的；餐飲的；廚藝的；美食餐飲的；堅持原型食材本味之料理廚藝；米其林三星頂級烹飪藝術與廚藝美學的

explains.en: It describes cooking, food preparation, or the skills of a chef. A school may teach these skills. Taiwan blends traditional street food with new styles.
A restaurant's food culture can be described this way. Fresh herbs are important in many dishes. A chef may study at a special institute.
Use this adjective for matters connected with kitchens and cooking. It can describe a tradition or an education program. The word often appears in discussions of food.

examples.en: Several innovative Taipei and Taichung restaurants received three Michelin stars.
examples.zh: 台北與台中的數家創新精緻餐廳榮獲了米其林三星最高殊榮。

examples.en: Earning a Michelin star is the crowning professional honor for any talented chef.
examples.zh: 摘下一顆米其林星級殊榮是全世界所有優秀主廚終其一生追求的崇高職業榮耀。

examples.en: Food enthusiasts must make reservations months in advance at Michelin-starred bistros.
examples.zh: 饕客們若想一嚐摘星滋味，通常必須提前數月在米其林星級精緻餐廳官網搶訂座位。

explains.en: A restaurant may receive one, two, or three stars from a famous dining guide. Chefs consider this a major honor.
Food lovers often book months ahead to eat at a highly rated restaurant. The guide’s award is shown as a small star.
A chef may feel proud when a respected restaurant guide gives the place this award. It recognizes excellent cooking.

examples.en: Crispy scallion pancakes and stinky tofu are iconic Taiwanese street foods.
examples.zh: 香酥蔥油餅與現炸臭豆腐皆為經典最具代表性的台灣街頭小吃。

examples.en: Food critics travel to Southeast Asia specifically to sample mouthwatering street food.
examples.zh: 眾多國際知名美食家專程飛往東南亞各國，只為大啖令人垂涎三尺的道地街頭小吃。

examples.en: Clean and affordable night market street food is beloved by locals and tourists alike.
examples.zh: 衛生乾淨、價格實惠且富有人情味的夜市街頭小吃深獲在地鄉親與各國旅人的一致喜愛。

examples.en: Taiwan is internationally famous for vibrant, budget-friendly street food.
examples.zh: 台灣以多元澎湃、物美價廉且極具在地特色的道地街頭小吃享譽全球。

examples.en: Bangkok's night alleys are packed with tourists sampling sizzling street food.
examples.zh: 曼谷深夜的街頭巷弄擠滿了前來品嚐現炒熱呼呼街頭美食的觀光客。

examples.en: Exploring authentic street food allows travelers to connect with local living cultures.
examples.zh: 品嚐最道地的街頭小吃讓旅人能最直接地貼近在地常民的生活文化脈動。

entries.definition: 街頭小吃；夜市小吃；街頭美食

explains.en: Small stands sell ready-to-eat snacks along a busy road or night market. These foods are often affordable.
Visitors can try pancakes or tofu from an outdoor stall. A clean market makes eating more comfortable.
Travelers may learn about local life by tasting food sold outside. Each city has its own popular snacks.

examples.en: The bistro serves fresh farm-to-table salads harvested this morning in Yilan.
examples.zh: 這家餐酒館供應今日清晨自宜蘭農園產地直送的無毒生菜沙拉。

examples.en: The farm-to-table movement strengthens ties between urban diners and rural growers.
examples.zh: 「從產地到餐桌」的綠色餐飲風潮拉近了都市食客與鄉村小農之間的緊密情感連結。

examples.en: Organic restaurants emphasize seasonal farm-to-table dining to reduce food miles.
examples.zh: 有機蔬食餐廳大力提倡當季旬味從產地到餐桌理念，以大幅降低食材運輸碳足跡。

examples.en: The farm-to-table dining concept celebrates fresh morning-harvested vegetables served at dinner.
examples.zh: 「從產地到餐桌」（Farm-to-Table）的美食哲學推崇將清晨露水未乾現採的鮮蔬於當晚端上餐桌。

examples.en: Diners love the transparent storytelling behind every ingredient in this farm-to-table bistro.
examples.zh: 老饕們深深著迷於這間產地直送私房餐酒館在每一道佳餚背後所深情講述的食材產地人文故事。

examples.en: Promoting farm-to-table values fosters deeper connections between urban dwellers and rural agriculture.
examples.zh: 大力提倡產地到餐桌的飲食理念，能重新牽起都市都會居民與鄉村土地農業之間失落已久的深厚連結。

entries.definition: 從產地到餐桌的；在地直送的；產地到餐桌的；新鮮直送的

explains.en: This describes food that is grown on a farm and served fresh at a nearby restaurant. Diners may learn where each ingredient came from. It can reduce long-distance shipping.
A restaurant may use vegetables picked that morning from a local grower. This idea connects farmers directly with the people who eat the food. It often highlights seasonal ingredients.
Use this adjective for dining that brings fresh ingredients from nearby farms to a meal. It supports local growers. The menu may change with the season.

examples.en: Supermarkets set up dedicated green aisles showcasing certified organic produce.
examples.zh: 超級市場設立了專屬的綠色專區陳列各項具認證的有機生鮮農產。

examples.en: Eating seasonal organic produce minimizes exposure to toxic synthetic pesticides.
examples.zh: 養成食用當季新鮮有機生鮮農產的好習慣，能將攝入化學農藥殘留的風險降至最低。

examples.en: Community farmers bring freshly picked organic produce to the weekend bazaar.
examples.zh: 在地社區友善小農在每週末將剛採收下來的新鮮無毒有機蔬果帶到市集展售。

explains.en: It is fresh food grown without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers. Farmers may sell it at a weekend market. Shoppers can look for an official label.
Fruit and vegetables raised using natural methods are often sold in a special section of a store. Seasonal choices may be fresher. Growing them can protect soil.
This food comes from farms that limit artificial chemicals. People may choose it to reduce exposure to pesticides. Farmers bring it to local markets.

examples.en: Stringent food safety inspections protect consumer health across restaurants.
examples.zh: 嚴謹細緻的食品安全抽檢全面把關各大餐飲業者的衛生與健康。

examples.en: Cold-chain logistics ensures milk and meat adhere to the highest food safety standards.
examples.zh: 完善無縫的低溫冷鏈物流體系確保生鮮乳品與溫體肉品符合最嚴格的食安衛生標準。
