examples.en: The government updated food safety regulations after the tainted oil incident.
examples.zh: 歷經黑心油食安風暴之後，政府主管機關全面大幅翻修並收緊了食品安全衛生法規。

explains.en: Restaurants keep cold foods chilled and cook meat thoroughly to protect diners. Clean hands and tools also matter.
A family checks expiration dates and stores milk in the refrigerator. Careful handling helps prevent illness.
Inspectors check kitchens and food storage to lower the chance of people getting sick. The topic concerns preparing and keeping food safely.

examples.en: Scan the QR code on the fruit box to view complete farm traceability.
examples.zh: 掃描水果外箱上的 QR Code 即可一覽完整的產銷履歷溯源資訊。

examples.en: Food traceability allows authorities to recall contaminated batches immediately.
examples.zh: 健全的食品可追溯性產銷履歷制度使主管機關能在突發狀況時迅速下架回收受污染批次。

examples.en: Modern agricultural supply chains utilize cloud databases for full farm-to-shelf traceability.
examples.zh: 現代農業供應鏈充分整合雲端資料庫技術，落實從產地田間到賣場貨架的全程透明溯源。

examples.en: Taiwan's TAP food traceability label ensures full transparency from farmland to dining table.
examples.zh: 台灣產銷履歷農產品（TAP）標章能確保從產地採收、用藥紀錄到餐桌銷售的全然透明公開。

examples.en: Blockchain technology enhances supply chain traceability for premium organic coffee beans.
examples.zh: 導入區塊鏈技術能顯著提升精品有機咖啡豆在跨國供應鏈全程的可追溯性與防偽性。

examples.en: Strict traceability guidelines reassure consumers regarding safe livestock feed and animal welfare.
examples.zh: 嚴格落實的食品溯源體系能讓消費者完全放心牲畜飼料配方安全與人道動物福祉保障。

examples.en: Scanning the agricultural traceability QR code verifies the tea farm’s exact slope and pesticide-free lab results.
examples.zh: 手機掃描茶葉外包裝上的產銷履歷 QR 碼，能清楚查閱茶園產地地號、茶農姓名與三百項零農藥殘留檢驗報告。

examples.en: Blockchain protocols improve supply chain traceability from raw bean harvest to overseas retail shelves.
examples.zh: 導入去中心化區塊鏈技術顯著強化了農產供應鏈的可追溯性，從高山生豆採摘到海外專櫃皆一目了然。

examples.en: Food safety legislation mandates full batch traceability across meat processing facilities.
examples.zh: 衛生福利部食安法規強制規範，全台所有大型肉品分切加工廠皆必須落實嚴格的批次生產履歷溯源。

examples.en: Scanning the QR code on the packaging reveals the farm's harvest date and full production traceability.
examples.zh: 用手機掃描蔬果包裝上的 QR 碼，立即清楚呈現生產農民姓名、採收日期與完整的產銷溯源。

examples.en: Blockchain technology provides immutable traceability for high-value pharmaceuticals throughout shipping.
examples.zh: 導入去中心化區塊鏈技術，為高單價溫控生技藥品在跨國冷鏈運輸配送全程提供不可竄改的溯源追蹤紀錄。

examples.en: Complete supply chain traceability reassures international consumers about the ethical origins of organic cocoa.
examples.zh: 建立透明透明的供應鏈全溯源履歷機制，能讓全球消費者對有機可可豆的公平貿易來源完全放心。

examples.en: End-to-end blockchain supply chain traceability verifies that timber and coffee were ethically sourced.
examples.zh: 導入區塊鏈端對端產銷溯源系統，能百分之百驗證原木與咖啡豆來自合規永續產地。

examples.en: Food safety laws mandate item-level traceability for imported frozen poultry and seafood.
examples.zh: 現代食品安全衛生管理法規明確規範，所有進口冷凍水產與禽肉皆必須具備精確到單箱的嚴密產銷履歷。

examples.en: Enhanced digital traceability enables pharmaceutical brands to recall contaminated pill batches within minutes.
examples.zh: 全面升級的數位產銷溯源網絡，能協助跨國製藥大廠在數分鐘內精準鎖定並召回受污染批次的瑕疵藥品。

entries.definition: 產銷履歷；產品可追溯性；產銷履歷制度；可溯源性 (TAP)；農產品產銷履歷溯源；可追溯性；產銷履歷 TAP 與產地 QR 碼溯源；區塊鏈全程不可篡改供應鏈產銷履歷

explains.en: A shopper can use a code to learn which farm grew some fruit. This quality lets a product's path be checked.
If a food batch is unsafe, officials can find where it came from. Records help follow each step from farm to shop.
A package may show its farm and harvest date. This system helps people check a product's history.

examples.en: Modern food processing factories adhere to international ISO and HACCP standards.
examples.zh: 現代化食品加工廠全面嚴格遵循國際 ISO 與 HACCP 衛生標準。

examples.en: Advanced thermal food processing techniques preserve vitamins while eliminating harmful bacteria.
examples.zh: 先進的瞬間高溫殺菌食品加工技術能在徹底消滅有害細菌的同時完好鎖住維生素。

examples.en: The food processing sector drives significant rural economic employment in agriculture.
examples.zh: 發達的食品加工製造業為農村偏鄉地區提供了充沛的就業機會並活絡在地農業經濟。

explains.en: This is the work of preparing food in factories so it can be safely stored or sold. Heating can remove harmful germs. It may preserve nutrients too.
Companies use machines and methods to clean, cook, or package ingredients. These steps help food last longer. They follow safety standards.
Raw ingredients are changed into products people can buy. The process may include washing, cutting, heating, and packing. It supports the food industry.

examples.en: These handcrafted pineapple cakes contain zero chemical preservatives.
examples.zh: 這些純手工製作的土鳳梨酥保證絕不添加任何化學防腐劑。

examples.en: Salt and vinegar have been used for centuries as natural food preservatives.
examples.zh: 食鹽與白醋數百年來一直被民間智慧視為最天然天然且無害的食品防腐保存保鮮劑。

examples.en: Consumers increasingly check ingredient lists for hidden artificial preservatives.
examples.zh: 越來越多重視健康的現代消費者在購物時會仔細閱讀食品成分表以揪出隱藏的防腐劑。

explains.en: It is a substance added to food to slow spoilage. Salt and vinegar have been used this way for a long time. Read ingredient labels if you have concerns.
A food maker may add this ingredient to help a product last longer. It can prevent mold or changes in color. Some are natural and others are artificial.
This additive helps keep food safe or fresh for a longer period. Packaged cakes may contain it. People can check the label to see what's included.

examples.en: Health-conscious shoppers avoid snacks containing artificial color additives.
examples.zh: 重視健康養生的消費者會主動避開含有過多人工色素添加物的零嘴。

examples.en: Food regulations specify the maximum safe limits for any chemical additive.
examples.zh: 食品衛生法規對各類化學食品添加物的容許安全添加上限設有極為嚴格的標準。

examples.en: Natural plant extracts are replacing synthetic additives in clean-label foods.
examples.zh: 天然植物萃取精華在當前風行全球的潔淨標章純淨食品中，正加速全面取代化學合成添加劑。

explains.en: A small amount of a substance may be mixed into food to preserve it or change its color. Check the label for what was added.
A baker may use an ingredient to keep bread fresh longer. Rules limit how much can be used.
Some packaged snacks contain a substance added for flavor, texture, or shelf life. Natural ingredients can serve the same purpose.

examples.en: Enjoying fresh seasonal fruits like mangoes in summer ensures optimal sweetness.
examples.zh: 夏天品嚐芒果等當季時令水果能享受到最頂級濃郁的甜美滋味。

examples.en: The chef crafts an innovative seasonal menu showcasing winter truffles.
examples.zh: 這位明星名廚精心設計了一套大膽創新的當季限定套餐，主打珍貴的冬季頂級黑松露。

examples.en: Farm laborers depend heavily on seasonal employment during the grape harvesting period.
examples.zh: 許多農村移工在葡萄採收旺季期間，高度依賴這類短期季節性採果打工維持生計。

examples.en: Eating seasonal produce guarantees peak nutritional value and unmatched natural sweetness.
examples.zh: 遵循大自然節氣享用當季當令盛產的在地蔬果，營養價值最為充沛且風味甘甜多汁。

examples.en: Ski resort lodges hire hundreds of temporary seasonal workers during snowy winter peaks.
examples.zh: 位於高山雪原的滑雪度假山莊，每逢大雪紛飛的冬季旅遊旺季便會招募數百名短期季節性員工。

examples.en: Seasonal allergies triggered by spring cedar pollen cause sneezing and watery eyes.
examples.zh: 初春時節隨風飄散的杉木花粉所引發的季節性過敏反應，常讓人止不住打噴嚏、眼眶泛紅流淚。

entries.definition: 當季的；時令的；季節性的；當季在地的

explains.en: Mangoes taste best during the part of year when they grow naturally. This word describes food available at that time.
Some workers get jobs only during the grape harvest. The work depends on a certain time of year.
Spring pollen can cause sneezing for some people. This describes a problem that returns with a particular season.

examples.en: The chef's specialty dish is slow-braised pork belly with bamboo shoots.
examples.zh: 這位主廚的招牌拿手私房菜是慢火細燉的筍絲東坡滷肉。

examples.en: Every family restaurant in town has its own secret recipe for their signature specialty dish.
examples.zh: 鎮上的每家私房老餐館對於自家傳承數十載的當家招牌菜，都有著不外傳的獨門秘方。

examples.en: We ordered the house specialty dish, crispy roasted duck with delicate pancakes.
examples.zh: 我們欣然點了這家餐廳的當家鎮店招牌菜：外皮酥脆油亮的招牌烤鴨佐手工荷葉薄餅。

explains.en: This is a meal or food that a restaurant is especially known for. It may use a secret family recipe. Guests often order it first.
A chef may prepare one particular recipe better than anything else. Diners may ask what the restaurant is famous for. The answer is its signature food.
Use this phrase for a restaurant's best-known food item. It could be roast duck or a local stew. Each place may have its own.

examples.en: Braise the pork belly with soy sauce, rock sugar, and five-spice powder.
examples.zh: 將五花肉加入純釀造醬油、冰糖與五香粉一起文火慢燉紅燒滷製。

examples.en: Grandma taught me how to braise firm tofu until it absorbs all the savory broth.
examples.zh: 外婆手把手教我如何細火慢燉紅燒板豆腐，直到每一塊豆腐都吸飽了濃醇鮮甜的滷汁。

examples.en: The French recipe instructs cooks to brown the beef shank before letting it braise in red wine.
examples.zh: 這道經典法式食譜指引料理者先將牛腱肉兩面煎至金黃焦香，再加入頂級紅酒文火慢燉。

examples.en: Slow-braise pork belly with soy sauce, rice wine, rock sugar, and star anise.
examples.zh: 將精選五花肉搭配純釀醬油、米酒、冰糖與八角辛香料，以文火慢燉慢滷入味。

examples.en: The culinary recipe instructs chefs to braise the lamb shanks for three full hours.
examples.zh: 食譜指南要求廚師們將新鮮羊小腿以小火慢燉足足三小時直至軟爛。

examples.en: Grandmother knows how to braise tofu and eggs so that the spices seep to the core.
examples.zh: 奶奶深諳如何滷製豆腐與滷蛋，能讓中藥辛香老滷汁完全滲透至最核心。

explains.en: Cook food slowly with a small amount of liquid in a covered pot. Pork belly becomes tender this way. Brown the meat first for deeper flavor.
A cook may simmer tofu in savory broth until it absorbs the taste. This method uses gentle heat over a longer time. Tough cuts of meat can soften.
Food is first browned and then cooked slowly in liquid. Wine or soy sauce can add flavor. Keep the lid on so moisture stays inside.

examples.en: High Mountain Oolong offers a smooth, silky mouthfeel with sweet fragrance.
examples.zh: 高山烏龍茶帶給味蕾如絲般順滑醇厚的口感與清雅幽香。

examples.en: Full-fat Jersey milk creates a rich, velvety mouthfeel in specialty cafe lattes.
examples.zh: 頂級全脂澤西鮮乳為精品咖啡館調製的手沖拿鐵帶來濃郁如絲絨般柔滑的厚實口感體驗。

examples.en: Wine tasters evaluate tannins based on the dry, astringent mouthfeel they produce.
examples.zh: 專業品酒師透過紅酒在口腔中產生的微澀緊縮口感，客觀評鑑單寧酸的熟成品質。

examples.en: The handmade noodles boast a silky smoothness and springy mouthfeel.
examples.zh: 這家老字號麵店純手工現拉的手工拉麵具備滑順細膩且極富彈性的迷人口感。

examples.en: Ice cream makers carefully adjust fat content to achieve a rich, creamy mouthfeel.
examples.zh: 頂級冰淇淋工匠精準調配天然乳脂比例，以達成極致濃醇厚實的綿密口感。

examples.en: The sparkling bubbles add a refreshing, tingling mouthfeel to the chilled cider.
examples.zh: 豐沛綿密的細緻氣泡為這杯冰鎮蘋果西打增添了清爽微刺的口腔觸感體驗。

examples.en: Natural processed beans often produce a heavy, syrupy, velvet mouthfeel.
examples.zh: 日曬處理法與蜜處理生豆往往能在口腔中呈現出如糖漿般濃郁綿密的絲滑口感。

examples.en: Full-fat milk contributes a rich, creamy mouthfeel to specialty milk tea drinks.
examples.zh: 優質全脂鮮乳能為特調精品鮮奶茶帶來極致香醇厚實、柔滑濃郁的滑順口感。

examples.en: The crisp effervescence of the sparkling water provides a pleasant, tingling mouthfeel.
examples.zh: 氣泡水中綿密細緻的微氣泡在舌尖跳躍，帶來清爽微麻、令人愉悅的豐富口感層次。

entries.definition: 口感；口中質地體驗；口腔觸感與質地；口腔觸感厚度

explains.en: A creamy drink feels thick and smooth on the tongue. Tasters notice this sensation as they sip.
The tiny bubbles in sparkling water make the drink feel fizzy in the mouth. It is a part of tasting.
Noodles may feel springy, silky, or chewy when eaten. This word describes the texture sensed in the mouth.

examples.en: The artisanal soy sauce has a complex flavor profile of umami and sweetness.
examples.zh: 這款手工純釀醬油蘊含著鮮味與甘甜交織的豐富風味層次。

examples.en: Single-origin Ethiopian coffee beans feature a bright citrus and floral flavor profile.
examples.zh: 來自衣索比亞的單品耶加雪菲咖啡豆展現出明亮活潑的柑橘果酸與雅緻茉莉花香風味特徵。

examples.en: Adding star anise and cinnamon sticks enriches the overall savory flavor profile of the stew.
examples.zh: 在燉肉鍋中加入幾顆八角與肉桂棒，能讓整鍋紅燒燉肉的鹹甜香氣層次變得更為飽滿立體。

explains.en: This describes the different tastes and smells in a food or drink. A stew may have sweet and savory notes.
Coffee from one place may taste bright and floral. These details make up its overall character.
Spices such as cinnamon can add depth to a dish. The mix of tastes is what this term describes.

examples.en: Taiwan plays an indispensable pivotal role in the global tech supply chain.
examples.zh: 台灣在全球高科技供應鏈中扮演著不可或缺的關鍵樞紐角色。

examples.en: Geopolitical tensions have forced multinational corporations to diversify their supply chains.
examples.zh: 地緣政治緊張局勢迫使跨國企業積極推動供應鏈多元化分散風險。

examples.en: Severe semiconductor shortages disrupted automobile supply chains worldwide.
examples.zh: 嚴重的半導體晶片短缺打亂了全球汽車產業的正常供應鏈運作。

examples.en: Diversifying suppliers across Southeast Asia strengthens corporate supply chain resilience against disruptions.
examples.zh: 在東南亞多國佈局多元供應商，能大幅強化企業供應鏈抵禦斷鏈危機的韌性。

examples.en: Shortages of semiconductor chips paralyzed the entire automotive supply chain for nearly two years.
examples.zh: 先進半導體車用晶片的全球大缺貨，曾讓全球汽車供應鏈陷入長達近兩年的嚴重減產停滯。

examples.en: Companies audit tiers of their supply chain to guarantee ethical sourcing of raw minerals.
examples.zh: 跨國品牌全面稽核其深層多級供應鏈廠商，以確保各項關鍵工業礦產皆來自合規道德產地。

entries.definition: 供應鏈；全球高韌性端對端供應鏈

explains.en: This is the connected path that goods follow from raw materials to a store or buyer. Many companies help move or make each part. A shortage can slow it down.
A product may pass through factories, warehouses, and shops before reaching a customer. These connected steps form a system. Companies plan them to avoid delays.
This network includes the people and businesses that make and deliver products. It starts with materials and ends with a buyer. A disruption can affect many companies.

examples.en: Efficient warehousing logistics ensures same-day parcel delivery across the island.
examples.zh: 高效的倉儲物流管理確保了全島當日配送到府服務。

examples.en: The company invested millions of dollars to upgrade its international cold-chain logistics.
examples.zh: 該公司投入數百萬美元資金全面升級其國際冷鏈物流系統。

examples.en: Poor logistics planning can lead to delayed deliveries and dissatisfied customers.
examples.zh: 不良的物流規劃往往會導致出貨嚴重延誤並招致顧客強烈不滿。

examples.en: E-commerce giants invest heavily in smart logistics to achieve six-hour island-wide delivery.
examples.zh: 電商龍頭投入巨資升級智慧物流運籌系統，力拼全台都會區六小時內極速到貨。

examples.en: Effective logistics management ensures fresh produce travels from farm to grocery shelves within 24 hours.
examples.zh: 高效的物流管理確保生鮮蔬果能在二十四小時內從產地農場直送超市貨架。

examples.en: The university launched a master's program dedicated to digital supply chain engineering and global logistics.
examples.zh: 該國立大學設立了專門培育數位供應鏈工程與全球運籌物流專業人才的碩士學程。

examples.en: Temperature-controlled smart cold-chain logistics ensure premium Taiwanese mangoes arrive fresh in Japan.
examples.zh: 智慧溫控冷鏈物流確保台灣頂級愛文芒果在運抵日本東京各大超市時，依然維持鮮美多汁。

examples.en: Managing e-commerce logistics during double-eleven shopping festivals requires tremendous server capacity and warehouse staffing.
examples.zh: 在雙十一購物節期間處理電商物流，需要龐大的伺服器運算能力與充足的倉儲人力配置。

examples.en: Third-party logistics providers offer comprehensive warehousing, customs clearance, and last-mile delivery services.
examples.zh: 第三方物流業者提供涵蓋倉儲管理、報關檢驗及最後一哩路配送的整合性服務。

examples.en: Smart freight logistics relies on real-time GPS tracking and automated warehousing to speed up shipping.
examples.zh: 智慧貨運物流高度仰賴 GPS 即時追蹤與自動化立體倉儲，全面加速跨國運輸配送。

examples.en: She managed the regional logistics network, coordinating hundreds of daily truck departures.
examples.zh: 她負責掌管區域綜合物流調度網絡，統籌每天數百班長途貨運卡車的準點發車作業。

examples.en: Disruptions in global logistics during typhoons can delay manufacturing across several continents.
examples.zh: 颱風季節引發的全球物流鏈受阻，可能會導致橫跨數大洲的尖端科技製造業面臨缺料停工。

examples.en: Multinational shipping carriers test quantum algorithms to solve complex fleet routing and freight logistics.
examples.zh: 跨國海運集團正著手測試量子運算，以解決數萬艘貨輪與港口複雜的全球調度物流難題。

examples.en: Solving traveling salesperson problems through quantum logistics minimizes delivery fuel consumption.
examples.zh: 藉由量子物流運籌演算法精確求解「旅行推銷員問題」，能將大型貨運車隊的燃油耗損降至最低。

examples.en: Modern semiconductor physical layout and wire routing benefit from advanced quantum logistics math.
examples.zh: 現代先進半導體晶片內部的數百億電晶體實體佈局與自動繞線，高度受惠於前沿量子物流數學模型。

entries.definition: 物流；運籌管理；後勤；物流運籌學；物流配送管理；智慧冷鏈物流；後勤物流行程；現代國際綜合物流供應鏈管理；全球貨輪排程與半導體繞線量子物流最佳化

explains.en: It is the planning and movement of goods, equipment, or people from place to place. Warehouses and delivery schedules are part of it. Poor planning can delay packages.
A company must organize storage and transportation so products arrive on time. Cold goods need special care. Good planning keeps customers satisfied.
This work coordinates supplies, shipping, and delivery. A business may invest in better systems to manage it. Careful organization saves time and money.

examples.en: Kaohsiung Harbor is Taiwan's largest commercial port of entry.
examples.zh: 高雄港是全台灣吞吐量最大的國際商務通商港口。

examples.en: All passengers arriving from abroad must pass through border customs at their port of entry.
examples.zh: 所有由海外抵達的旅客都必須在入境通商口岸依規定通過邊境海關查驗。

examples.en: Strict agricultural quarantine checks are enforced at every designated port of entry.
examples.zh: 政府在每一處指定的入出境口岸均嚴格執行各項動植物防檢疫措施。

explains.en: Travelers arriving from another country show their documents to border officers at the airport. Officials inspect what people bring in.
A seaport may be an approved place for ships and goods to enter a country. Customs officers work there.
After an international flight, passengers go through passport checks at a designated border location. This place handles arrivals.

examples.en: Governments impose import tariffs to protect domestic agricultural industries.
examples.zh: 各國政府透過課徵進口關稅以保護本土農產品產業。

examples.en: The bilateral trade treaty gradually eliminates customs tariffs on thousands of industrial goods.
examples.zh: 這項雙邊經貿協定將逐步分期取消數千項工業產品的進口海關關稅。

examples.en: Heavy punitive tariffs were placed on imported steel products to counter dumping.
examples.zh: 政府對低價進口鋼鐵製品課徵高額懲罰性關稅，以反制海外惡意傾銷行為。

examples.en: Luxury leather handbags imported from Europe are subject to statutory import tariffs and VAT.
examples.zh: 從歐洲空運進口的高級名牌真皮精品包款，依法須繳納法定進口關稅與百分之五營業稅。

examples.en: Reducing preferential trade tariffs lowered the domestic retail price of imported electric vehicles.
examples.zh: 降低特定雙邊優惠關稅稅率，能顯著帶動海外進口純電動車在國內實體門市的降價讓利。

examples.en: Free trade agreements often eliminate reciprocal tariffs across agricultural and industrial commodities.
examples.zh: 簽訂自由貿易協定通常能在締約國之間全面免除絕大多數農工產品的進口關稅，促進貿易繁榮。

examples.en: Carbon tariffs penalize high-polluting foreign goods to prevent domestic manufacturing carbon leakage.
examples.zh: 課徵邊境「碳關稅」（Carbon Tariff）能防範高碳排商品傾銷，並避免本土傳統重工業外移產生碳洩漏。

examples.en: The government imposed a temporary 15% tariff on imported automobiles to shield local assembly jobs.
examples.zh: 經濟部對進口外國整車課徵百分之十五的臨時保護性關稅，以捍衛本土汽車組裝廠數萬名基層工人的飯碗。

examples.en: Lowering international trade tariffs fosters cross-border commerce and lowers consumer retail prices.
examples.zh: 透過雙邊貿易談判大幅調降國際進出口關稅，能顯著活絡跨國經貿往來並有效壓低一般民眾的消費物價。

entries.definition: 關稅；進口關稅率；價目表；進口關稅；關稅稅率；邊境碳關稅課徵

explains.en: A government may charge money on goods brought into a country. This can make imported items cost more.
When a product crosses a border, a business may need to pay this tax. It can affect shop prices.
A fee on imported steel or cars can protect local factories. The word can also mean a list of prices for a service.

examples.en: Electronic customs clearance speeds up international parcel processing.
examples.zh: 電子化線上報關能大幅加速國際網購包裹的通關時程。

examples.en: Missing commercial documents delayed the customs clearance of the electronic shipment.
examples.zh: 缺少必備商業單據導致這批電子零件貨件的通關審驗流程嚴重延宕。

examples.en: The express courier offers expedited customs clearance for cross-border e-commerce orders.
examples.zh: 快捷快遞公司為各類跨境電商零售包裹提供急速通關的專業便捷服務。

explains.en: This is the process of checking goods as they enter or leave a country. Officials review documents and may inspect a package. Missing papers can cause delays.
A parcel sent across a border must pass this official check. Electronic forms can make the process faster. A courier may help with it.
Before an international shipment can continue, it may need approval from border officials. They check the goods and paperwork. This step helps enforce import rules.

examples.en: The licensed customs broker assisted the exporter with paperwork filing.
examples.zh: 領有執照的專業報關行協助出口商完成各項報關文件申報。

examples.en: Hiring an experienced customs broker minimizes unexpected import delays and penalty fines.
examples.zh: 委託經驗豐富的報關行能將進口過程中的無預警延誤與法規罰款降至最低。

examples.en: Our customs broker advised us on the proper commodity classification codes for the new gadgets.
examples.zh: 我們的報關行針對這批新上市科技產品的正確商品海關稅則號列提供了專業諮詢。

explains.en: This professional helps importers and exporters complete border paperwork. They classify goods and make sure duties are correct. Their advice can prevent delays.
A business may hire this specialist to move products through customs. They prepare documents and explain import rules. They know the relevant regulations.
When goods cross a country's border, this agent helps clear them. They may file forms and advise on product codes. Experience can reduce costly mistakes.

examples.en: The shipping company released the cargo upon receiving the original bill of lading.
examples.zh: 航運公司在收到正本海運提單（B/L）後正式放行貨物。

examples.en: The ocean bill of lading serves as a title of ownership and a contract of carriage.
examples.zh: 海運提單具備貨物物權所有權憑證以及海上運輸運送契約的雙重法律效力。

examples.en: Always verify that the quantities on the commercial invoice match the bill of lading exactly.
examples.zh: 務必仔細核對商業發票上的商品數量是否與提單上所列明細完全一致。

explains.en: A shipping company gives the sender a document listing goods loaded onto a vessel. It also records where the cargo is going.
When a container arrives, the carrier may ask for this transport paper before releasing the goods. Keep its details accurate.
The shipper and carrier use a document that describes the cargo and journey. It can also show who may claim the goods.

examples.en: The commercial invoice specifies unit pricing, quantities, and total valuation.
examples.zh: 商業發票上清楚詳載了商品的單價、數量與申報總金額。

examples.en: Customs inspectors rejected the shipment because the commercial invoice was not signed.
examples.zh: 由於商業發票上欠缺負責人親筆簽章，海關檢驗官員當場退回了該批貨物。

examples.en: Sellers must attach three copies of the commercial invoice to the outer packing carton.
examples.zh: 賣方必須依海關規定在最外層的外包裝紙箱牢固附上三份正本商業發票。

explains.en: This paper lists the goods being shipped and how much they cost. Customs workers may check it.
A seller includes this document with an international order. It shows prices and quantities for the shipment.
If this shipping paper is missing a signature, officials may hold the goods. It gives details about a sale.

examples.en: Customs inspectors checked gross weights against the official packing list.
examples.zh: 海關查驗官員依據官方裝箱明細單逐一核對各箱總毛重。

examples.en: The detailed packing list enumerates the net weight and dimensions of every single crate.
examples.zh: 詳盡的裝箱明細表逐一列明了每一個包裝木箱的淨重以及外箱長寬高尺寸。

examples.en: Please email me the warehouse packing list so our receiving team can prepare storage space.
examples.zh: 請先將出庫裝箱明細單寄至我的信箱，好讓我們的收貨驗收組預留倉儲空間。

explains.en: This is a document that names the items inside a box or shipment. A warehouse can use it to prepare for the delivery. It may show each crate's size or weight.
Workers compare the goods with this written record when a package arrives. It helps them know what is inside. A supplier may email it before shipping.
This list describes what has been packed into a shipment. It can include the number of items and their sizes. Customs workers may check it.

examples.en: Importers presented a certificate of origin to qualify for tariff discounts.
examples.zh: 進口商出具了原產地證明書（C/O）以爭取適用優惠關稅減免。

examples.en: The local chamber of commerce issued a certified certificate of origin for the agricultural produce.
examples.zh: 當地商工總會針對這批在地農特產品正式核發了具法定效力的原產地證明書。

examples.en: Without a valid certificate of origin, your goods may be denied preferential duty treatment.
examples.zh: 若未能出具有效合規的原產地證明，您的貨物恐將無法享受優惠關稅待遇。

explains.en: It is an official document that states where goods were made or grown. An importer may need it to receive a lower tax. A trade group can issue one.
This paper identifies the country that produced a shipment. Customs officials may use it to decide import duties. Keep it with shipping documents.
Exporters provide this proof of a product's source. It can help a buyer qualify for trade discounts. The document must be accurate.

examples.en: High tariffs and strict quotas act as restrictive international trade barriers.
examples.zh: 高額關稅與嚴格配額構成了具限制性的國際貿易壁壘。

examples.en: The international trade agreement aims to dismantle unnecessary regulatory trade barriers.
examples.zh: 該國際經貿協定的終極目標旨在破除不必要且繁瑣的各項行政管制貿易壁壘。

examples.en: Subsidies given to local producers can sometimes create unfair technical trade barriers.
examples.zh: 政府對本國製造商所發放的巨額專案補貼，有時會形成不公平的技術性貿易壁壘。

explains.en: A country may charge a tax on goods brought in from abroad. This can make imported products more expensive.
A limit on how many items may enter a market can make selling harder for foreign businesses. Rules like these restrict trade.
When two countries add strict rules to buying and selling across their borders, products may cost more or arrive slowly. Businesses may sell fewer goods across borders.

examples.en: Signing bilateral free trade agreements (FTAs) boosts cross-border commerce.
examples.zh: 簽署雙邊自由貿易協定（FTA）能顯著促進跨國經貿繁榮發展。

examples.en: The proposed free trade agreement will eliminate import quotas between both neighboring nations.
examples.zh: 這項研議中的自由貿易協定將全面撤除鄰近兩國之間長年存在的進口配額限制。

examples.en: Economists predict that the comprehensive free trade agreement will create thousands of export jobs.
examples.zh: 經濟學家樂觀預測，該項全方位自由貿易協定將為外銷產業創造數千個工作機會。

explains.en: Two or more countries may sign a deal to lower taxes on goods they sell to each other. This can make trading easier.
A trade deal can reduce limits on goods crossing borders. Businesses may then sell more products abroad.
When countries agree to remove some import taxes, shoppers may find more choices. Such a deal can also create jobs.

examples.en: Taiwan became an official member of the World Trade Organization (WTO) in 2002.
examples.zh: 台灣於 2002 年正式加入世界貿易組織（WTO）成為會員。

examples.en: The World Trade Organization settles complex trade disputes among member states.
examples.zh: 世界貿易組織肩負公正調解與裁決會員國之間複雜跨國經貿爭端之重責大任。

examples.en: Multilateral tariff reduction negotiations are conducted within the World Trade Organization framework.
examples.zh: 涉及眾多國家的多邊關稅調降回合談判，皆在世界貿易組織的法規架構下進行。

explains.en: This is an international group that helps countries set rules for trade and discuss disagreements. Taiwan joined it in the early 2000s. Members can work together on trade issues.
Representatives from different countries use this organization to talk about tariffs and trade rules. It can help settle disputes. Many governments belong to it.
This group supports cooperation in buying and selling goods between countries. It provides a place to negotiate rules. Member nations can raise trade concerns there.

examples.en: Cross-border e-commerce enables Taiwanese brands to sell directly to global shoppers.
examples.zh: 跨境電子商務讓台灣本土優質品牌能直接行銷全球消費者。

examples.en: Cross-border payments have become faster and cheaper thanks to innovative financial technology.
examples.zh: 得益於創新金融科技的飛速發展，跨境資金匯款支付變得更為迅捷且手續費低廉。

examples.en: Police forces from both jurisdictions collaborated closely to crack down on cross-border fraud rings.
examples.zh: 兩地檢警執法單位展開跨國緊密偵查合作，聯手徹底瓦解了大型跨境跨國詐騙集團。

explains.en: It describes activity that goes between two or more countries. Online stores can sell to shoppers overseas. Police may work together across national boundaries.
A payment or business deal involving different nations can be described this way. New technology has made some transfers faster. Rules may vary by country.
Use this adjective for trade, travel, or crime that crosses national boundaries. Companies may reach customers around the world. Governments sometimes cooperate on investigations.

examples.en: Automated fulfillment centers pack thousands of online orders every hour.
examples.zh: 自動化電商倉儲履約中心每小時能高效揀貨包裝數千筆線上訂單。

examples.en: The global retail giant built a state-of-the-art fulfillment center near Taoyuan International Airport.
examples.zh: 這家全球零售巨擘在桃園國際機場周邊興建了一座具備尖端設備的倉儲物流履約中心。

examples.en: Advanced robotic sorters move heavy palettes inside the smart fulfillment center.
examples.zh: 先進智慧搬運揀貨機器人在這座現代化履約中心內部靈活穿梭搬運沉重的貨物棧板。

entries.definition: 倉儲履約中心；電商發貨中心

explains.en: Workers store online orders in a large warehouse and pack them when customers buy something. Trucks then carry the packages away.
Robots may move shelves and boxes inside this building. Staff prepare parcels for delivery.
An online shop keeps its products here until an order arrives. Workers pick, pack, and send each item.

examples.en: Trucks depart from the northern distribution center to restock retail branches.
examples.zh: 大貨車每日清晨由北部物流配送中心出發為各連鎖分店補貨。

examples.en: The central distribution center coordinates inventory supply for over one hundred supermarkets.
examples.zh: 位於中部的物流總倉統籌調度並配送全台一百多家連鎖超級市場的貨架庫存。

examples.en: Heavy seasonal snowstorms temporarily halted shipments leaving the regional distribution center.
examples.zh: 突如其來的嚴重暴風雪一度迫使該區域物流中心對外發車的所有長途車隊暫停出車。

entries.definition: 物流配送中心；物流總倉

explains.en: Trucks carry boxes from this large building to shops. It helps stores keep products in stock.
A grocery company may organize goods in one central warehouse. Workers send supplies from there to many branches.
Snow can stop deliveries from this regional storage and shipping place. It coordinates where goods should go.

examples.en: Electric scooters make eco-friendly last-mile delivery possible in congested cities.
examples.zh: 電動機車讓擁擠都會區中環保快捷的最後一哩路配送成為可能。

examples.en: High fuel costs and urban traffic jams account for most of the expenses in last-mile delivery.
examples.zh: 高昂的燃油成本與市區尖峰大塞車構成了末端配送環節中最龐大的物流開銷。

examples.en: Many courier companies are experimenting with autonomous delivery drones for last-mile delivery.
examples.zh: 眾多國際快遞公司正積極測試利用自動飛行無人機來落實偏遠地區的最後一哩配送。

entries.definition: 最後一哩路配送；末端配送

explains.en: This is the final part of sending an order from a local depot to the person who bought it. A courier may use a small vehicle in a busy city. It can be costly.
After a package reaches a nearby station, a driver takes it to the customer's door. Companies may try bikes or small robots for this step. Traffic can make it difficult.
Use this term for the final trip a parcel makes before reaching its receiver. It begins close to the destination. Efficient routes can lower costs.

examples.en: The express courier delivered the signed legal documents within two hours.
examples.zh: 快捷快遞員在兩小時內將簽署好的法律文件迅速送達。

examples.en: She entrusted the irreplaceable antique necklace to a bonded international courier.
examples.zh: 她將那條價值連城且不可替代的古董項鍊託付給受保額保障的國際專業快遞。

examples.en: The company hired a private motorcycle courier to transport urgent medical specimens to the lab.
examples.zh: 該生技公司專程聘請機車快遞員將急需檢驗的醫療檢體以最快速度送達化驗室。

examples.en: Courteous delivery couriers ring doorbells to deliver heavy parcels directly into living rooms.
examples.zh: 態度親切親民的黑貓宅急便配送司機熱情按響門鈴，親自將沉重的生活日用品包裹扛上樓送到家。

examples.en: The courier called my mobile number before ascending the stairway to confirm someone was home.
examples.zh: 宅配外送司機在爬樓梯上樓前先撥通了我的手機號碼，確認家中有人能即時開門簽收。

examples.en: During monsoon storms, dedicated couriers wear waterproof gear to ensure our packages arrive on schedule.
examples.zh: 即使碰上豪雨颱風天，敬業的快遞宅配員依然穿戴全套專業雨具穿梭風雨，使命必達準時送交。

entries.definition: 快捷快遞公司；快遞員；宅配司機外送員

explains.en: It is a person or company that delivers packages quickly. A motorcycle rider may carry urgent documents across a city. Some services handle valuable goods.
When an important parcel needs fast delivery, a business can hire this service. The driver takes it directly to the recipient. International firms may transport jewelry or samples.
A worker in this job brings letters and packages from sender to receiver. Companies use the service for urgent shipments. Delivery can be by bike, van, or plane.

examples.en: Your online book order is currently in transit and arrives tomorrow.
examples.zh: 您在網路書店訂購的書籍目前正在運送途中，預計明日送達。

examples.en: The delicate fragile crystal vase was unfortunately damaged while in transit.
examples.zh: 那只做工精巧易碎的水晶花瓶非常不幸地在長途貨運途中遭受了碰撞碎裂。

examples.en: Fresh strawberries must be kept cold in transit to prevent early spoilage.
examples.zh: 剛採摘的新鮮草莓在長途運輸途中必須全程維持低溫冷藏，以防果肉提早腐爛變質。

explains.en: A parcel has left the store but has not yet arrived at the buyer’s home. It is moving between places.
A vase travels in a truck from one city to another. Pack it carefully so it stays safe along the way.
A shipment may be delayed by a storm while traveling. The goods have not reached their destination yet.

examples.en: The tracking page shows the package is out for delivery today.
examples.zh: 物流追蹤頁面顯示該包裹今天已經由外送員出車派送中。

examples.en: Please make sure someone is at home because your parcel is currently out for delivery.
examples.zh: 請確保家中有人能夠簽收，因為您的貴重掛號包裹目前司機已出車派送中。

examples.en: The delivery driver sent a text message alerting the recipient that the order was out for delivery.
examples.zh: 物流司機在出發前發送了一則簡訊，溫馨提醒收件人所訂購的商品今日即將送達。

explains.en: A tracking page may show that a package is on its way to your home today. The driver has it.
Someone may need to stay home to receive a parcel. A text can say the delivery is happening soon.
After leaving a warehouse, a package travels with a driver toward its address. This status appears online.

examples.en: The package was successfully delivered to your neighborhood convenience store.
examples.zh: 包裹已成功送達您指定的社區巷口便利商店以供取件。

examples.en: All purchased furniture pieces were delivered and assembled by technicians in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 所有訂購的居家大型家具已於午後由專業技師順利送達並現場組裝完畢。

examples.en: The keynote speaker delivered an inspiring address to thousands of university graduates.
examples.zh: 受邀的主講嘉賓在畢業典禮上向數千名即將步入社會的大學畢業生發表了鼓舞人心的演講。

explains.en: This form can describe a package that has arrived at its destination. It can also describe a speech given to an audience. The surrounding words show which meaning fits.
A courier may have brought furniture to a home. A speaker may have presented a message to graduates. The same form is used in both cases.
Use this word when something was brought to a person or place. It can also describe giving a talk. A package or an address may come before it.

examples.en: The strategic procurement department negotiates bulk raw material discounts.
examples.zh: 策略採購部門負責洽談大宗原物料採購的批量折扣優惠。

examples.en: Transparent government procurement rules prevent bribery and encourage fair market competition.
examples.zh: 公開透明的政府機關採購法規能有效防杜私相收受賄賂，並促進自由市場良性競爭。

examples.en: She holds extensive professional expertise in global semiconductor parts procurement.
examples.zh: 她在全球半導體零組件戰略採購領域深耕多年，累積了極為深厚專業的採辦經驗。

examples.en: Global tech brands mandate 100% green energy procurement across all tier-one component suppliers.
examples.zh: 國際科技一線品牌全面將「百分之百綠電使用」納入核心供應商的綠色永續採購合約（Procurement）必備條款。

examples.en: Public defense procurement of naval patrol ships requires transparent competitive tendering.
examples.zh: 國防海巡巡防艦艇建造政府採購招標案，全程遵循嚴格的政府採購法規公開透明競標程序辦理。

examples.en: The hospital streamlined pharmaceuticals procurement to eliminate emergency shortages of essential medications.
examples.zh: 該醫學中心全面整合並優化了全院藥品採購倉儲物流流程，徹底根除急救重症關鍵處方藥物的缺藥中斷風險。

entries.definition: 採購；採購管理；採辦；綠色永續供應鏈採購要求

explains.en: It is the process of buying goods and services for a business or government. A department may negotiate prices for materials. Clear rules can prevent bribery.
An organization compares suppliers and purchases what it needs. Good planning can lower costs. Public agencies often follow strict rules.
This work includes choosing vendors and obtaining supplies. A company may seek fair prices for parts. It can also consider environmental standards.

examples.en: Establishing long-term mutual trust with key component suppliers is vital.
examples.zh: 與核心零組件供應商建立長期互信合作關係至關重要。

examples.en: The company terminated its contract with the overseas supplier due to chronic quality defects.
examples.zh: 由於海外供貨廠商長期存在嚴重品質瑕疵，該公司最終決定斷然終止合作合約。

examples.en: Finding an alternative supplier of clean industrial chemicals proved to be difficult.
examples.zh: 要在短時間內尋覓到另一家具備合格認證的純淨工業化學品替代供應商實屬不易。

explains.en: A bakery buys flour from a company that provides it regularly. The business can compare price and quality.
A factory depends on another company to deliver parts it needs to make products. This partner provides materials.
If one company cannot deliver packaging, a business may find another provider. The word names a person or company that provides goods.

examples.en: Extreme typhoons caused severe disruptions to international sea cargo.
examples.zh: 強烈颱風對國際遠洋海運貨物運送造成了嚴重的斷鏈與延誤。

examples.en: Artificial intelligence is creating profound disruption across the financial and healthcare industries.
examples.zh: 人工智慧的突飛猛進正對全球金融界與醫療保健產業帶來翻天覆地的深遠顛覆性變革。

examples.en: A sudden strike by dock workers brought about widespread disruption to port loading operations.
examples.zh: 碼頭工人無預警發起的突擊式罷工，給整座港口的貨物裝卸作業帶來了大範圍的癱瘓與混亂。

explains.en: A typhoon may interrupt ship deliveries and cause delays. This word describes a break in normal activity.
A dock workers' strike can stop goods from moving through a port. Many businesses may be affected.
A sudden change can make usual services difficult to continue. This may happen in schools, travel, or business.

examples.en: High-grade copper and silicon are essential raw materials for chipmaking.
examples.zh: 高純度銅材與矽晶圓是製造半導體晶片不可或缺的關鍵原物料。

examples.en: Spikes in the global prices of raw materials have squeezed profit margins for manufacturers.
examples.zh: 全球大宗原物料價格的急遽飆升，嚴重壓縮了各大下游製造商的獲利利潤空間。

examples.en: The developing nation relies heavily on exporting raw materials like iron ore and timber.
examples.zh: 這個發展中國家的國家外匯收益高度仰賴鐵礦砂與原木等天然初級原物料的出口。

explains.en: These are natural or basic substances used to make products. Copper and silicon are used to make computer chips. Their prices can affect factories.
Before a factory makes an item, it needs basic substances such as wood or metal. A country may sell these to other places. They are changed into finished goods.
This term names the starting substances used in production. They may come from mines, forests, or farms. Manufacturers turn them into useful products.

examples.en: Robotic arms work alongside technicians on the automated assembly line.
examples.zh: 機械手臂在全自動化組裝生產線上與工程技師緊密協同作業。

examples.en: Henry Ford famously revolutionized factory manufacturing by introducing the moving assembly line.
examples.zh: 亨利·福特引進了現代化的移動式組裝流水線，徹底革新了工業工廠的大規模量產模式。

examples.en: Workers monitor each station on the assembly line to prevent defective items from moving forward.
examples.zh: 作業工人在流水線的各個站點嚴密把關，堅決防止任何有瑕疵的半成品流入下一道工序。

entries.definition: 組裝生產線；裝配流水線

explains.en: It is a factory process where a product moves through stations as workers or machines add parts. Each station has a task. This can make production faster.
Cars and electronics may be built this way. A moving belt carries items past technicians and robotic arms. Checks at each stage help catch defects.
A factory arranges work in a sequence of stations. Each person or machine completes one step before the item moves on. Careful monitoring improves quality.

examples.en: Ordering custom parts early shortens manufacturing lead time considerably.
examples.zh: 提前預訂客製化零件能大幅縮短整體產品的製造交期時間。

examples.en: Because of the global container crunch, shipping lead time extended from two weeks to two months.
examples.zh: 由於全球海運貨櫃嚴重短缺，這批貨物的海上運送交貨週期由兩週拉長到了整整兩個月。

examples.en: Improving factory scheduling allowed the company to cut order lead time by forty percent.
examples.zh: 精進工廠排程排班管理，使該製造大廠成功將客戶訂單的生產前置時間大幅削減了四成。

examples.en: Optimizing local warehouse automation shortened customer order lead times from three days to eight hours.
examples.zh: 全面升級區域物流中心自動化設備，成功將消費者從下單到收到貨的交貨前置期由三天縮減為八小時。

examples.en: Disruptions at raw material ports doubled our manufacturing lead time unexpectedly this quarter.
examples.zh: 上游原物料港口突發罷工封港，導致我們工廠本季的成品生產與出貨前置期被迫整整翻倍延宕。

examples.en: Customers appreciate manufacturers that provide accurate and reliable estimations for custom furniture lead times.
examples.zh: 當消費者訂購手工客製化實木家具時，工廠若能給予精確誠實的製作交期與交貨預估，將大獲好評。

entries.definition: 前置交期時間；交貨週期；訂單交貨前置期；生產交期

explains.en: A customer orders a desk, and the maker needs several weeks before it is ready to ship. This is the waiting period between ordering and delivery.
A factory tells a buyer how long custom parts will take to make. Ordering early can prevent delays.
From placing an order until receiving the product, time passes while it is made and shipped. Companies try to estimate this period accurately.

examples.en: The popular ergonomic office chair is temporarily out of stock.
examples.zh: 那款熱銷的人體工學辦公椅目前庫存售罄、暫時缺貨中。

examples.en: I wanted to buy that new novel, but the bookstore owner said it was completely out of stock.
examples.zh: 我原本想購買那本剛出版的暢銷小說，但書店老闆告知我目前全店已經完全斷貨。

examples.en: Customers can register their email address to be notified when the item is no longer out of stock.
examples.zh: 喜愛的顧客可於官方網頁留下電子信箱，以便在商品補貨到庫不再缺貨時第一時間收到通知。

explains.en: A shop has sold every copy of a popular book, so none can be bought now. More may arrive later.
A customer can leave an email address and wait for a message when an item returns. The shelf is empty for now.
A store cannot sell a product if its supply has run out. This status may appear beside an online item.

examples.en: The newest gaming console was placed on backorder due to high demand.
examples.zh: 由於市場需求空前熱烈，最新款遊戲主機已改為缺貨待補預購。

examples.en: Our customer service team notified all buyers that backordered items will ship in three weeks.
examples.zh: 我們的客服團隊逐一致電通知所有買家，目前待補出貨的商品預計將於三週後陸續發貨。

examples.en: The online store does not charge your credit card until the backordered merchandise is ready to ship.
examples.zh: 該線上電商平台採取良善政策，直到缺貨待補的預購商品完全備妥準備寄出時才會正式扣款。

entries.definition: 缺貨待補訂單；延期交貨

explains.en: This is an order for an item that a store does not have in stock yet. The seller will send it when more arrive. The buyer may wait several weeks.
A popular game device may sell out, so customers place orders to be filled later. A shop can notify them when it is ready to ship. They may not be charged until then.
Use this noun or verb when a customer orders something unavailable now. The store records the request and sends the item later. It happens when demand is high.

examples.en: Corporate buyers receive a 15% wholesale discount on bulk orders.
examples.zh: 企業採購客戶進行大宗批量訂購時享有八五折的批發優惠。

examples.en: The university placed a bulk order for five hundred office desks and swivel chairs.
examples.zh: 這所大學總務處一口氣大宗採購下訂了五百套辦公書桌與活動旋轉椅。

examples.en: Placing a bulk order helps businesses reduce per-unit shipping fees and packaging waste.
examples.zh: 採取大宗下單策略有助於企業顯著攤提單件商品的物流運送費用並減少包裝耗材浪費。

explains.en: It is a purchase of many units at the same time. A school may buy desks for every classroom. Sellers often give a discount for large quantities.
A business can purchase a large amount of one product in a single order. This may lower the cost per item. It can also reduce packaging.
When many products are bought together, the seller may offer a lower price. A university might purchase hundreds of chairs. Plan storage before buying.

examples.en: The factory set a minimum order quantity (MOQ) of 500 units for custom logos.
examples.zh: 原廠針對客製化印刷商標設定了五百件的最低起訂量（MOQ）。

examples.en: Small retail startups often struggle to satisfy the high minimum order quantity required by overseas manufacturers.
examples.zh: 初創期的小型零售品牌往往很難達到海外大廠所開出的高門檻最低起訂量限制。

examples.en: You can negotiate a lower minimum order quantity if you agree to pay a slightly higher unit price.
examples.zh: 若您願意在單價上做出適度讓步接受稍高的報價，通常有機會與廠家協商調降最低起訂量。

explains.en: A factory says a buyer must purchase at least 500 cups to print a custom logo. This is the smallest allowed order.
A small shop may want only a few boxes, but the maker requires a larger first purchase. Ask if the limit can be lowered.
Before a custom product can be made, a business may require customers to buy a set number of items. Ask the seller what rule applies.

examples.en: Ordering in larger volumes lowers the individual unit price.
examples.zh: 提高單次下單採購數量能有效壓低各單項產品的平均單價。

examples.en: The purchasing manager bargained hard to reduce the component unit price by five cents.
examples.zh: 採購部經理在談判桌上據理力爭，全力將每只零件的採購單價壓低了五美分。

examples.en: Check the receipt to verify whether the billed unit price matches the promotional catalog.
examples.zh: 請仔細核對收銀結帳單據，確認結帳系統所收取的單價是否與特惠促銷型錄標示相符。

explains.en: This tells how much one item or one measure of a product costs. Compare it before buying a large package.
A store may sell a box of many parts for less per item. Check the receipt to see the cost for each one.
The total amount is divided by how many goods there are. This helps shoppers compare different package sizes.

examples.en: Standard international payment terms include 30% deposit and 70% upon shipment.
examples.zh: 標準國際貿易付款條件包括三成訂金與出貨時支付七成尾款。

examples.en: The buyer requested more favorable payment terms of net sixty days to ease cash flow.
examples.zh: 買方為了舒緩公司短期現金流週轉壓力，懇切提出放寬為六十天期付款條件的請求。

examples.en: Before signing any binding supply agreement, always scrutinize the penalty clauses and payment terms.
examples.zh: 在正式簽署任何具法律約束力的供貨合約之前，務必仔細審閱各項違約罰則與付款條款。

entries.definition: 付款條件；付款方式條款

explains.en: These are the agreed rules for when and how a buyer pays a seller. A contract may ask for part of the money first and the rest later. Read them carefully.
A company may ask to pay an invoice within a certain number of days. These rules can affect its cash flow. They are written into an agreement.
This phrase describes the schedule and conditions for paying a bill. It may include a deposit or a due date. Both sides agree before signing.

examples.en: Banks guarantee export payments securely using documentary letters of credit.
examples.zh: 銀行運用跟單信用狀（L/C）為出口商提供穩健有保障的付款擔保。

examples.en: The buyer's bank issued an irrevocable letter of credit to ensure seamless international trade.
examples.zh: 買方往來銀行開立了一紙不可撤銷信用狀（L/C），以確保整趟跨國貿易交易順利推進。

examples.en: Exporters must submit accurate shipping documents before the letter of credit expires.
examples.zh: 出口廠商必須在信用狀規定的有效履約期限截止前，迅速提交毫無缺漏的整套船務單證。

explains.en: It is a bank's promise to pay a seller when required trade documents are provided. It helps protect buyers and exporters. International deals often use one.
A buyer's bank can guarantee payment if the seller follows the agreement. This document reduces risk in overseas trade. Both sides must meet its conditions.
Businesses use this financial promise when shipping goods between countries. The bank pays once the correct papers are shown. It can build trust between companies.

examples.en: The overseas client sent the balance payment via international wire transfer (TT).
examples.zh: 海外客戶透過國際電匯（TT）將合約尾款全額匯出結清。

examples.en: Wire transfers are commonly used for large commercial transactions because they are rapid and secure.
examples.zh: 由於電子電匯快速且高度安全，因此在各類大宗商業跨國交易中被極其廣泛地採用。

examples.en: Please double-check the recipient's SWIFT code and account number before authorizing the wire transfer.
examples.zh: 在確認授權執行跨國電匯扣款前，請務必再三核對受款銀行的 SWIFT 代碼與受款帳號。

explains.en: A customer asks a bank to send money electronically to another person’s account. Check the account details carefully.
A company pays an overseas seller by sending funds from one bank account to another. It may take some time to arrive.
Instead of mailing cash, a person can ask the bank to move money directly between accounts. The bank needs correct account information.

examples.en: Exporters use currency contracts to guard against foreign exchange fluctuations.
examples.zh: 外銷出口商透過遠期外匯合約以防範外匯匯率劇烈波動的風險。

examples.en: Violent fluctuations in global crude oil prices affect international aviation and transportation costs.
examples.zh: 國際原油市場價格的劇烈跌宕波動，直接牽動著全球航空業與貨運物流業的營運成本。

examples.en: Seasonal temperature fluctuations can impact the delicate flowering cycles of highland fruit orchards.
examples.zh: 季節更迭之際氣溫的急劇劇烈起伏，可能會嚴重衝擊高山果園嬌貴果樹的花期孕蕾。

explains.en: Prices may go up and down over time. This change can affect the cost of travel or fuel.
The weather can vary between warm and cool from one day to another. This word names such changes.
A business may watch currency values rise and fall. Farmers also notice changes in seasonal temperatures.

examples.en: Financial hedging strategies protect overseas profits from currency risks.
examples.zh: 妥善的財務避險策略能保護海外營業利潤免受匯差虧損侵蝕。

examples.en: Major commercial airlines engage in fuel price hedging to stabilize operational operating expenditures.
examples.zh: 大型民航航空公司普遍採取燃油價格避險避險操作，以穩定全年的飛航營運成本支出。

examples.en: By using futures contracts as a hedging instrument, the agricultural cooperative mitigated commodity price drops.
examples.zh: 農業產銷合作社善用期貨契約作為風險避險金融工具，成功化解了大宗農作物價格崩跌的危機。

explains.en: This is a financial method for reducing the risk of losing money when prices or currency values change. An airline may plan for fuel costs. Farmers may protect against falling crop prices.
A business can use an agreement to offset possible losses in another investment. It helps make costs more predictable. This strategy does not remove every risk.
Use this term for actions taken to protect against price changes. A company may plan for the cost of fuel or foreign money. It can reduce uncertainty.

examples.en: Both companies agreed to submit their contractual disagreements to international arbitration.
examples.zh: 兩家公司同意將合約履約爭議提交國際商務仲裁法庭進行公正裁決。

examples.en: Commercial arbitration offers a private and faster alternative to courtroom litigation.
examples.zh: 相較於曠日費時且公諸於世的法院訴訟，商務仲裁程序提供了高度隱密且更有效率的解決方案。

examples.en: The arbitration tribunal rendered a legally binding ruling that both parties were required to honor.
examples.zh: 仲裁法庭做出了具備法律約束力的最終裁決，要求爭議雙方均必須嚴格遵守並履行。

explains.en: It is a way to settle a disagreement by asking an independent person or group to decide. Businesses may use it instead of going to court. The decision can be binding.
Two companies can ask a neutral expert to hear both sides of a contract dispute. The process is often private. The parties agree to follow the ruling.
When people cannot resolve a disagreement themselves, a neutral decision-maker may help. This process can be faster than a trial. It is common in commercial disputes.

examples.en: Corporate sustainability reports outline eco-friendly business goals.
examples.zh: 企業永續發展報告書詳述了公司邁向環保營運的各項目標。

examples.en: Promoting agricultural sustainability ensures that future generations will have fertile soil.
examples.zh: 推廣農業永續經營能確保未來的子孫後代依然擁有肥沃富饒的土地。

examples.en: The city's sustainability plan focuses on reducing municipal landfill waste.
examples.zh: 這座城市的永續發展藍圖重點聚焦於大幅削減市政垃圾掩埋總量。

examples.en: Embracing circular farming methods ensures long-term agricultural sustainability for generations to come.
examples.zh: 積極擁抱零廢棄資源循環農法，能確保這片美麗寶島的農田土壤享有生生不息的農業永續性。

examples.en: Corporate ESG audits evaluate energy conservation, carbon neutrality, and long-term business sustainability.
examples.zh: 嚴格的企業永續 ESG 稽核指標，全方位綜合評估節能減排、碳中和進度與公司治理的長遠永續發展能力。

examples.en: Utilizing renewable solar and geothermal power is fundamental to national environmental sustainability.
examples.zh: 全面大舉普及乾淨無染的太陽光電與深層地熱發電，是奠定國家長治久安與生態永續發展的戰略基石。

examples.en: Long-term architectural sustainability balances ecological conservation, social equity, and economic prosperity.
examples.zh: 真正的建築永續發展，在生態保育、社會正義與經濟繁榮之間取得跨世代的完美平衡。

examples.en: Incorporating renewable solar energy systems is a fundamental step toward urban sustainability.
examples.zh: 大規模導入太陽能光電與儲能微電網系統，是都會邁向實質永續發展不可或缺的關鍵基石。

examples.en: True sustainability looks beyond simple efficiency ratings to embrace complete cradle-to-cradle material cycles.
examples.zh: 真正的永續理念絕不僅止於冷氣設備省電標章，而是追求全面貫徹「從搖籃到搖籃」的循環再生哲學。

examples.en: Geothermal energy offers a perpetual gift of clean power, advancing global climate sustainability goals.
examples.zh: 地熱能是地球母親賜予人類取之不盡的永恆禮物，堅定推進了全人類氣候「環境永續發展」（Sustainability）。

examples.en: Corporate sustainability reports evaluate greenhouse gas reduction, labor ethics, and environmental governance.
examples.zh: 現代企業定期發布的 ESG 企業永續經營報告書，全方位嚴格檢視企業在節能減碳、勞工福祉與公司治理的落實。

examples.en: Practicing sustainable agriculture ensures that fertile soil and pure groundwater are preserved for future generations.
examples.zh: 堅持實踐尊重土地的友善永續農業耕作，能確保肥沃的土壤與純淨的地下水源長長久久留給後代子孫。

examples.en: Microbial synthesis offers true environmental sustainability by producing petroleum-free textiles and polymers.
examples.zh: 利用微生物合成製造完全無石油成分的紡織纖維與高分子，為地球實現真正的「綠色環保永續」（Sustainability）。

examples.en: Corporate sustainability reports evaluate renewable energy usage, greenhouse emissions, and waste recycling.
examples.zh: 現代企業社會責任與永續發展年報中，嚴格評估全公司的綠電使用佔比、溫室氣體碳排量與資源回收率。

examples.en: The island community balances fishery harvest with conservation to protect long-term economic sustainability.
examples.zh: 這座島嶼漁村社群在經濟捕撈與海洋生態保育間取得微妙平衡，誓言守護沿岸漁業經濟的長遠永續發展。

examples.en: Hydrogen closes the clean loop, providing long-term climate sustainability for international trade and transport.
examples.zh: 氫能串聯起零碳閉環，為全球國際貿易、航運與重工業奠定了長期堅實的「氣候環境永續性」（Sustainability）。

examples.en: Responsible timber forestry practices maintain ecological sustainability by replanting two trees for each one felled.
examples.zh: 負責任的林業經營管理實踐兼顧大自然生態永續性，嚴格落實每在林班地砍伐一棵樹木便就地親手補植兩株原生健壯樹苗。

examples.en: Financial sustainability requires balancing operating budget expenditures strictly against recurring operational revenues.
examples.zh: 任何非營利機構想要實現長遠健全的財務永續經營，必須嚴格將每年度的各項經常性業務支出控制在穩定經常性收入之內。

entries.definition: 永續性；永續發展；土地生生不息之農業永續共好；跨世代永續共榮綠色城鄉發展方針；守護後代子孫之長遠環境永續發展承諾；以生物製造全面取代石化塑料之綠色永續承諾；守護地球氣候之交通與重工業永續發展願景

explains.en: A farm protects healthy soil and water so it can keep growing food for many years. It also considers the people who depend on it.
A company tries to use less energy and reduce waste while remaining successful. It considers effects over the long term.
A community plans ways to meet today’s needs while protecting resources for people in the future. This includes clean water and healthy soil.

examples.en: Leading tech giants pledge to make all manufacturing carbon neutral by 2030.
examples.zh: 頂尖科技巨頭承諾在 2030 年前讓旗下所有製造工廠達成碳中和。

examples.en: The university designed a carbon neutral library powered entirely by geothermal and solar energy.
examples.zh: 這所大學規劃設計了一棟完全由地熱與太陽能供電的零碳中和圖書館。

examples.en: Purchasing verified carbon offsets helps commercial airlines offer carbon neutral flights.
examples.zh: 購買經過第三方認證的碳權抵換，有助於民航航空公司推出碳中和綠色航班。

explains.en: A company may balance the pollution it creates by supporting clean energy. It aims to add no net carbon to the air.
A building powered by sun or earth heat can reduce the gases it releases. Some organizations also pay for offsets.
Airlines may support tree planting or clean energy to balance their emissions. This describes that goal.

examples.en: Taiwan set ambitious milestones to transition toward net-zero emissions by 2050.
examples.zh: 台灣設立了雄心勃勃的政策目標，期盼在 2050 年達成淨零碳排。

examples.en: Achieving net-zero requires massive investments in carbon capture technology and clean energy.
examples.zh: 達成淨零轉型需要對碳捕捉封存技術與乾淨清潔能源進行規模龐大的資金投資。

examples.en: The newly constructed office tower was engineered to meet net-zero carbon building standards.
examples.zh: 這棟剛竣工的現代化企業辦公大樓完全按照淨零碳建築的嚴苛標準進行規劃設計。

examples.en: The flagship research laboratory achieved Net-Zero Energy status by producing more electricity than it consumes.
examples.zh: 這棟國家級旗艦綠能研發中心達成「淨零耗能建築」（Net-Zero Energy）目標，全年發電量超越自身總耗電量。

examples.en: Major multinationals committed to reaching net-zero greenhouse gas emissions across all supply chains by 2050.
examples.zh: 全球各大跨國企業巨頭紛紛公開宣示，承諾於二零五零年以前在旗下所有供應鏈上下游達成淨零碳排標準。

examples.en: Combining heat pumps, superinsulation, and rooftop solar makes single-family net-zero homes increasingly affordable.
examples.zh: 整合超高效熱泵熱水器、高規格外牆隔熱氣密與滿鋪屋頂光電板，使獨棟住宅達成淨零耗能不再遙不可及。

entries.definition: 淨零排放 (Net Zero)；淨零耗能建築的；淨零的

explains.en: This describes balancing the amount of greenhouse gases released with the amount removed or avoided. A building may make as much clean energy as it uses. Countries set goals to reach this balance.
A company can reduce pollution and remove the rest from the air to balance its total. Solar panels and better insulation can help. It is a goal for energy and emissions.
Use this term for having no overall addition of greenhouse gases to the atmosphere. It may require clean energy and capturing carbon. Buildings and nations can aim for it.

examples.en: Burning fossil fuels releases massive amounts of greenhouse gases (GHG).
examples.zh: 燃燒石化燃料會釋放出巨量加劇氣候變遷的溫室氣體。

examples.en: Governments are negotiating binding international targets to slash industrial greenhouse gas emissions.
examples.zh: 各國政府正在多邊談判中積極制定具法律約束力的工業溫室氣體減排硬指標。

examples.en: Methane emitted from livestock farming is an extremely potent greenhouse gas.
examples.zh: 畜牧業反芻牲畜所排出的甲烷氣體，是一種溫室效應極其強烈的溫室氣體。

explains.en: It is a gas in the air that traps heat near Earth. Carbon dioxide and methane are examples. Burning fossil fuels releases more of them.
These gases help warm the planet by holding heat in the atmosphere. Too much can change the climate. Governments set targets to reduce emissions.
A gas from farming, transport, or industry can add to global warming. Methane from livestock is one example. Reducing these emissions can help.

examples.en: The circular economy promotes repairing, remanufacturing, and recycling resources.
examples.zh: 循環經濟倡導產品維修保養、再製造與資源全面循環回收利用。

examples.en: By turning agricultural waste into bio-plastics, the factory embraces the circular economy model.
examples.zh: 透過將農業農廢殘渣提煉轉化為生物可分解塑膠，該工廠深耕落實了循環經濟模式。

examples.en: A successful circular economy minimizes reliance on newly extracted raw mineral resources.
examples.zh: 健全成功的循環經濟體系能將產業對新開採天然礦物原物料的過度依賴降至最低。

explains.en: A phone is repaired and used longer instead of being thrown away. Materials from old products can become new ones.
A clothing company collects worn garments and turns their fibers into fabric. It aims to keep materials in use.
Businesses design products that can be repaired, reused, or recycled. This reduces the need to take new resources from nature.

examples.en: Rooftop solar power panels convert bright Taiwanese sunshine into electricity.
examples.zh: 屋頂太陽能光電板將台灣充沛燦爛的陽光轉化為乾淨綠電。

examples.en: The remote mountain monitoring station is powered entirely by independent solar power units.
examples.zh: 這座偏遠的高山水文氣象監測站完全由獨立運作的太陽能光電儲能系統供應電力。

examples.en: Subsidies encouraged rural farmers to install solar power collectors on their warehouse roofs.
examples.zh: 政府專案補助鼓勵農村農民在閒置農機倉庫屋頂鋪設太陽能發電集光板以售電增收。

explains.en: Panels on a roof can turn sunlight into electricity. A remote station may use this source of energy.
Farmers can place collectors on a warehouse to use the sun. This power can run lights and equipment.
A sunny day provides energy without burning coal. Homes and schools can use panels to make electricity.

examples.en: Giant offshore wind turbines spin gracefully along the western coast.
examples.zh: 沿著台灣西海岸海面上，巨型離岸風力發電機正優雅迎風運轉。

examples.en: Modern wind turbines can generate clean electricity even under gentle sea breezes.
examples.zh: 現代化先進風力發電機技術精良，即便在微弱徐緩的海風吹拂下亦能穩定輸出潔淨電力。

examples.en: Routine maintenance ensures that offshore wind turbines can survive powerful seasonal typhoons.
examples.zh: 嚴謹的定期海上檢修維護，確保了這些離岸風機能在夏季強烈颱風的狂風巨浪中安然無恙。

explains.en: This tall machine has blades that spin when the wind blows. The movement makes electricity. Many stand along coasts or offshore.
A group of these machines can make clean power for homes. Their blades turn in a breeze. Engineers check them so they work safely.
This device changes wind movement into electric energy. It may be built at sea or on land. Regular care helps it withstand storms.

examples.en: Volcanic heat in Datun provides abundant geothermal energy potential.
examples.zh: 大屯火山群蘊含的豐富地熱為發展地熱發電提供了絕佳潛力。

examples.en: Unlike intermittent solar and wind, geothermal energy provides reliable round-the-clock baseload power.
examples.zh: 與間歇性的太陽能或風力不同，地熱能具備全天候二十四小時不間斷穩定發電的基載優勢。

examples.en: Yilan has successfully developed experimental geothermal energy plants to power local hot spring resorts.
examples.zh: 宜蘭地區近年已成功興建多座示範型地熱發電廠，為鄰近溫泉觀光園區提供零碳電力。

explains.en: It is power made from heat beneath Earth's surface. Hot water or steam can turn a turbine to make electricity. Volcanic areas may have useful sources.
This renewable power comes from underground heat. A plant can use steam to generate electricity. It can provide energy day and night.
Some regions tap warm water deep below the land. The heat can supply buildings or produce electricity. It is not dependent on sunlight.

examples.en: Sun Moon Lake pumped-storage hydroelectric plants balance peak electrical demand.
examples.zh: 日月潭抽蓄水力發電廠在用電尖峰時刻發揮關鍵調度平衡功能。

examples.en: The mountain canyon is an ideal geographic location for building a large hydroelectric dam.
examples.zh: 該處陡峭險峻的高山峽谷地形，是築壩興建大型水力發電水庫壩體的絕佳天然地理環境。

examples.en: Hydroelectric power generation produces very low lifecycle greenhouse gas emissions.
examples.zh: 就整體產品生命週期而言，水力發電所產生的溫室氣體碳排總量極低且環境友善。

explains.en: A dam uses moving water to turn machines that generate electricity. Rain and rivers help supply the force.
Water flowing downhill spins a turbine at a power station. The electricity can then travel to homes.
A mountain plant may use the movement of water to make power. It does not burn fuel to produce it.

examples.en: Transitioning away from polluting fossil fuels protects the global biosphere.
examples.zh: 逐步汰除高污染的石化燃料發電能有效守護全球生物圈環境。

examples.en: Heavy reliance on imported fossil fuels makes island nations vulnerable to geopolitical crises.
examples.zh: 高度仰賴進口化石燃料發電，使海島型國家在面對國際地緣政治衝突時顯得極其脆弱。

examples.en: Burning fossil fuels like gasoline and diesel releases harmful smog into urban skies.
examples.zh: 汽油與柴油等石化燃料的燃燒排放，在繁華都市上空籠罩了一層危害呼吸道的有害霧霾。

entries.definition: 化石燃料（煤炭、石油、天然氣）

explains.en: Coal, oil, and natural gas come from ancient plants and animals. Burning them releases gases into the air.
Cars and power stations often use these underground energy sources. Using less can help protect the environment.
This type of energy comes from materials formed over a very long time. It can cause pollution when burned.

examples.en: Say no to single-use plastic cutlery when ordering takeout lunches.
examples.zh: 訂購外送便當午餐時，請主動勾選不索取一次性塑膠免洗餐具。

examples.en: The municipal government banned single-use paper cups in all government office buildings.
examples.zh: 市政府已明令公告，所屬各級行政機關辦公大樓內全面禁止使用一次性拋棄式紙杯。

examples.en: Hospitals rely on sterile single-use syringes to prevent cross-contamination between patients.
examples.zh: 現代醫療院所仰賴無菌的一次性拋棄式注射針筒，以徹底防止病患之間的交叉感染。

explains.en: This describes an item made to be used one time and then thrown away. Plastic cutlery is an example. A reusable spoon can replace it.
A hospital may use a sterile syringe once and then discard it. Governments may ban disposable cups to reduce waste. The adjective tells how long an item is meant to last.
Use this adjective for something designed for only one use. It is convenient but can create a lot of rubbish. Reusable objects can reduce that waste.

examples.en: Beverage shops comply with the government plastic cup ban by using paper.
examples.zh: 各大手搖飲料店全面配合政府一次用塑膠飲料杯禁令，改用環保紙杯。

examples.en: Environmental activists campaigned for an all-inclusive plastic bag ban across retail supermarkets.
examples.zh: 環保倡議團體長期奔走發起運動，期盼在各大連鎖生鮮超市全面推行購物用塑膠袋禁令。

examples.en: Since the national plastic ban took effect, coastal beach cleanup volunteers have found fewer straws.
examples.zh: 自從全國限塑令正式上路施行以來，參與淨灘活動的志工在海灘上撿到的塑膠吸管大幅減少。

explains.en: It is a rule that stops people or businesses from using certain plastic items. Shops may replace bags or cups with paper. The goal is to reduce waste.
A government can prohibit plastic bags or straws in some places. Businesses must find other materials. The policy may help keep beaches clean.
This environmental policy limits the use of disposable plastic products. Stores may provide reusable or paper options. It aims to reduce rubbish.

examples.en: Plant-based PLA straws are biodegradable under industrial composting conditions.
examples.zh: 以植物澱粉製成的 PLA 環保吸管在工業堆肥環境下可完全生物分解。

examples.en: Scientists invented a biodegradable packaging film made entirely from discarded crab shells.
examples.zh: 科學家發明了一種完全由廢棄蟹殼幾丁聚醣提煉製成的生物可降解保鮮包裝膜。

examples.en: Unlike synthetic polymers, fallen autumn leaves are fully biodegradable and enrich garden soil.
examples.zh: 與人工合成高分子聚合物不同，秋季飄落的枯葉完全可生物分解，並能深層滋養庭園沃土。

explains.en: Some food packaging is made from plant material that breaks down with help from tiny living organisms. Conditions matter.
A fallen leaf decays into the soil over time. Certain materials can break down in a similar way.
This kind of material can be decomposed by nature instead of staying as litter for a very long time. Some materials need special conditions to break down.

examples.en: Food containers made from sugarcane bagasse are 100% compostable.
examples.zh: 採用甘蔗渣植物纖維製成的外帶餐盒具備百分之百可堆肥分解特性。

examples.en: Ensure you throw food scraps into certified compostable bags rather than regular garbage bags.
examples.zh: 請務必確認將日常廚餘剩飯裝入經過認證的可堆肥環保袋中，而非一般不可分解垃圾袋。

examples.en: Compostable tableware breaks down into organic matter within months when buried in damp soil.
examples.zh: 各類可堆肥環保餐具在深埋於濕潤肥沃的土壤後數月內，即可徹底分解轉化為天然腐植質。

entries.definition: 可堆肥降解的；可作堆肥的

explains.en: A bag made from this material can break down into soil under the right conditions. It should go in a suitable compost bin.
Food scraps and this kind of container can turn into organic matter. Check the label before throwing it away.
Some plant-based plates can break down in damp soil over time. This word describes things that can become compost.

examples.en: Plastic bottles take hundreds of years to decompose in natural landfills.
examples.zh: 傳統塑膠寶特瓶在自然掩埋場環境中往往需要數百年才能徹底分解。

examples.en: Fallen tree trunks slowly decompose in old-growth forests, providing nutrients for moss and fungi.
examples.zh: 原始森林中倒下的枯倒巨木隨歲月慢慢腐爛分解，為青苔地衣與野生真菌提供充沛養分。

examples.en: High heat and moisture help bacteria decompose kitchen waste much more rapidly.
examples.zh: 高溫與充足的水氣濕度能顯著活化土壤細菌，進而大幅加速廚餘有機物的生物分解過程。

explains.en: You use this verb for natural material that breaks down into simpler parts over time. Fallen leaves do this in a forest. Warm, damp conditions can speed it up.
A piece of food waste may change as bacteria break it down. This returns nutrients to the soil. Plastic takes much longer.
This word describes how dead plants or other matter decay naturally. The process can enrich soil. It usually happens slowly with help from tiny organisms.

examples.en: Keep a foldable eco-bag in your backpack for grocery shopping convenience.
examples.zh: 在隨身背包裡放一個輕巧摺疊環保購物袋，採買生活用品更便利。

examples.en: Department stores hand out branded linen eco-bags as gift rewards for loyal VIP shoppers.
examples.zh: 百貨公司週年慶特別致贈印有品牌燙金標誌的麻質環保購物袋，作為回饋貴賓的專屬好禮。

examples.en: Using a sturdy canvas eco-bag prevents thousands of plastic carrier bags from ending up in oceans.
examples.zh: 養成出門自備耐磨帆布環保購物袋的好習慣，能防止成千上萬的廢塑膠袋流入蔚藍海洋。

entries.definition: 環保購物袋；帆布購物袋

explains.en: It is a reusable shopping bag made to reduce the need for disposable plastic bags. Keep a foldable one in a backpack. Cloth versions can be used many times.
Shoppers carry this bag to bring groceries home. A sturdy canvas version can replace many single-use carriers. Some stores give them as gifts.
This reusable carrier helps reduce plastic waste. It can be made from cloth or another durable material. Wash it when needed and use it again.

examples.en: The zero waste movement encourages buying unpackaged bulk grains and spices.
examples.zh: 零廢棄生活運動鼓勵民眾前往無包裝商店裸裝採買五穀雜糧與香料。

examples.en: The eco-friendly family adopted a zero waste lifestyle by composting everything and avoiding packaging.
examples.zh: 這個踐行環保的家庭透過落實家戶全堆肥與拒絕所有塑膠包裝，全面擁抱零廢棄生活哲學。

examples.en: Achieving total zero waste is difficult, but taking small sustainable steps makes a huge difference.
examples.zh: 想要做到百分之百的零垃圾雖非易事，但每個人日常邁出的微小永續步伐都能匯聚成巨大改變。

entries.definition: 零廢棄；零浪費生活哲學

explains.en: A family brings cloth bags and reusable containers to avoid throwing away packaging. They also sort scraps for compost.
A shop sells food in bulk so customers can use their own jars. The goal is to send very little to the trash.
People repair, reuse, and recycle items instead of discarding them. This way of living tries to create as little rubbish as possible.

examples.en: Creative designers turn discarded billboard banners into trendy upcycled backpacks.
examples.zh: 創意設計師將退役廢棄的活動廣告帆布升級再造成時尚潮牌後背包。

examples.en: Upcycling transforms unwanted industrial scrap metal into stunning interior sculptures.
examples.zh: 升級再造工藝能化腐朽為神奇，將被棄置的工業金屬廢料轉化為極具視覺震撼的室內雕塑。

examples.en: Unlike basic downcycling, creative upcycling creates items that possess higher artistic value.
examples.zh: 有別於一般的降級回收，發揮巧思的創意升級再造能夠賦予二手廢棄物更高的藝術市場價值。

examples.en: Creative designers use denim upcycling to transform discarded jeans into trendy patchwork totes.
examples.zh: 充滿巧思的設計師運用舊衣升級改造工法，將淘汰的舊牛仔褲化為極富潮流感的拼接托特包。

examples.en: Upcycling breathes new life into unwanted textiles without requiring extensive chemical reprocessing.
examples.zh: 舊物升級改造無需耗費繁複的化學重製程序，就能為廢棄布料注入嶄新的生命。

examples.en: She won a sustainable design contest by showcasing upcycling techniques on vintage garments.
examples.zh: 她在永續設計大賽中大放異彩，憑藉為二手老舊古著進行升級改造的精湛手法奪冠。

entries.definition: 升級再造；創意再生；舊衣升級改造

explains.en: Designers can turn an old banner into a useful backpack. The new item may be more valuable than the material before.
A person may remake worn jeans into a colorful bag. This creative reuse gives old things a new purpose.
Scrap metal can become a sculpture instead of being thrown away. This practice makes something attractive from unwanted items.

examples.en: Diligent waste sorting is a deeply ingrained cultural habit across Taiwan.
examples.zh: 嚴謹細緻的垃圾分類是台灣社會高度普及且深植人心的公民美德。

examples.en: Schools conduct regular educational workshops to teach young children proper waste sorting.
examples.zh: 各級中小學定期舉辦校園環保宣導工作坊，從小扎根教育孩童正確的資源垃圾分類要領。

examples.en: Incorrect waste sorting can contaminate entire batches of recyclable plastic bottles.
examples.zh: 錯誤的混雜垃圾分類投放，往往會造成整批原本可回收再利用的塑膠容器受到嚴重油脂污染。

explains.en: This is separating rubbish into groups such as recycling, food scraps, and trash. Schools may teach children how to do it. Keeping materials apart helps recycling work.
People put different kinds of waste into the right bins. This can stop dirty items from spoiling recyclable materials. Many communities practice it at home.
Use this phrase for dividing discarded items by type before collection. Bottles and food leftovers may go in different places. It helps reduce waste.

examples.en: Items that cannot be recycled should be placed into general waste bags.
examples.zh: 無法回收再利用的物品應放入政府專用的一般垃圾袋中交由垃圾車清運。

examples.en: Dirty tissues and greasy pizza boxes must be disposed of as general waste.
examples.zh: 擦拭過髒污的衛生紙巾以及沾滿油膩起司的披薩外帶紙盒，均必須按規定歸類為一般垃圾。

examples.en: Residents in Taipei must purchase official blue trash bags to discard general waste.
examples.zh: 台北市市民必須依規定在便利商店購買印有防偽標籤的專用藍色垃圾袋來盛裝一般生活廢棄物。

explains.en: It is rubbish that cannot go into recycling or food-scrap bins. Dirty tissues and greasy food boxes may belong here. Follow local sorting rules.
Some discarded items cannot be reused or recycled. Residents place them in the regular trash bag. Check city guidance for special materials.
This category includes everyday rubbish that is not recyclable. A greasy box may go into it. Local rules explain which bag to use.

examples.en: Clean plastic bottles, aluminum cans, and paper are valuable recyclables.
examples.zh: 沖洗乾淨的塑膠瓶、鋁箔罐與廢紙張皆為高價值資源回收物。

examples.en: Please rinse your drink bottles thoroughly before tossing them into the recyclable bin.
examples.zh: 在將各類飲料空瓶投入資源回收桶之前，請務必先用清水徹底將瓶身內部沖洗乾淨。

examples.en: Glass bottles are infinitely recyclable without any loss in pure chemical quality.
examples.zh: 玻璃瓶罐具備近乎可無限次熔融重製循環再利用的物理特性，且化學純度絲毫不會劣化衰退。

explains.en: Clean paper, glass, and some cans can be processed and made into new products. Check local sorting rules.
Rinse a bottle before placing it in the correct collection bin. The material may be used again.
A material that can be collected and turned into another product should be sorted according to local guidance. Collection rules vary by area.

examples.en: Recycling diverted tons of solid trash away from overflowing urban landfills.
examples.zh: 全民資源回收讓成千上萬噸固體廢棄物免於堆滿飽和的都市垃圾掩埋場。

examples.en: Decomposing organic matter trapped in underground landfills generates volatile methane gas.
examples.zh: 深埋在地下掩埋場中封閉厭氧分解的各類有機質垃圾，會長期蓄積並釋放出易燃的甲烷氣體。

examples.en: The municipality converted the abandoned suburban landfill into a blooming ecological public park.
examples.zh: 市政府發揮巧思進行土地復育，將這座早已封場廢棄的郊區垃圾掩埋場改造成百花齊放的生態公園。

explains.en: A city may bury rubbish in this large place. Too much waste can fill it up.
Old food can make gas as it breaks down underground. Some towns turn closed waste sites into parks.
Recycling keeps some trash away from this disposal area. Methane may form under the buried rubbish.

examples.en: Modern waste incinerators generate electricity through waste-to-energy systems.
examples.zh: 現代化大型垃圾焚化廠透過廢棄物轉化能源技術發電回饋電網。

examples.en: Strict emission scrubbers prevent toxic dioxins from escaping the chimney of the municipal incinerator.
examples.zh: 煙囪頂端加裝的高效洗滌除塵設備，嚴密防止劇毒戴奧辛氣體從市政焚化爐煙囪排入大氣。

examples.en: Taiwan's Beitou incinerator features a famous rotating restaurant atop its tall smokestack.
examples.zh: 台灣知名的台北北投垃圾焚化廠別具特色，其高聳彩繪煙囪頂部設有一座極負盛名的景觀旋轉餐廳。

explains.en: This is a large furnace where rubbish is burned at high temperatures. Some facilities use the heat to make electricity. Filters help keep harmful smoke from escaping.
A city may send waste to this plant instead of burying it. Workers control pollution from its chimney. A tall building may have a restaurant above it.
This machine burns trash to reduce its volume. The process can produce energy. Special equipment cleans the smoke before it leaves.

examples.en: Electric vehicles produce zero tailpipe exhaust emissions in crowded cities.
examples.zh: 純電動車在擁擠繁華的都會區中行駛時達到零廢氣尾氣排放。

examples.en: Government subsidies and tax incentives motivate taxi fleets to transition to electric vehicles.
examples.zh: 政府祭出高額購車補助款與各項稅捐減免誘因，積極鼓勵廣大計程車車隊全面汰換升級為電動車。

examples.en: Developing longer-lasting batteries is crucial for accelerating the worldwide adoption of electric vehicles.
examples.zh: 研發具備更長續航里程與更長使用壽命的動力電池，是加速推動全球電動車普及化的關鍵核心。

examples.en: The government offers tax subsidies to encourage drivers to switch to electric vehicles.
examples.zh: 政府提供汰舊換新貨物稅減免補助，積極鼓勵駕駛人換購綠能電動車（EV）。

examples.en: Driving an electric vehicle produces zero tailpipe emissions on city roads.
examples.zh: 駕駛電動車在市區道路行駛時不會產生任何排氣管廢氣排放。

examples.en: Global sales of electric vehicles have broken records for five consecutive years.
examples.zh: 全球電動車銷量已連續五年刷新歷史最高紀錄。

explains.en: It is a car or other road vehicle powered by electricity stored in a battery. It produces no exhaust from a tailpipe while driving. Drivers recharge it at a station.
Instead of using gasoline, this vehicle runs on electric motors. A longer-lasting battery can help it travel farther. Some governments offer purchase incentives.
People plug this kind of car into a charger to restore its battery. It can reduce street exhaust. Many cities are adding charging stations.

examples.en: Scooter riders enjoy six-second battery swapping at thousands of urban stations.
examples.zh: 電動機車騎士在全台數千座換電站享受六秒快速抽換電池的極致便利。

examples.en: The network operator deployed intelligent battery swapping cabinets outside convenience stores and metro stops.
examples.zh: 營運商在全台各大便利超商門市與捷運站出口外，廣泛佈設智慧化公眾換電櫃機組。

examples.en: Fast battery swapping eliminates range anxiety for food delivery couriers who ride all day.
examples.zh: 迅捷無比的快速換電服務，徹底消除了整天在外奔波送餐的外送快遞員對電池續航力竭的焦慮。

entries.definition: 電池交換系統；換電模式

explains.en: A scooter rider brings an empty battery to a station and exchanges it for a charged one. The rider can continue the trip quickly.
Delivery workers may use cabinets at shops to get a charged power pack. This avoids waiting for a long recharge.
Instead of plugging in a vehicle for hours, a rider trades its low-power battery for a ready one. The empty pack can recharge at the station.

examples.en: Highways and department stores install fast DC charging stations for EVs.
examples.zh: 國道高速公路服務區與各大百貨公司普遍廣設電動車直流快充站。

examples.en: The smartphone app directs drivers to the nearest unoccupied electric vehicle charging station.
examples.zh: 智慧手機專屬 App 能精準導航電動車駕駛前往周邊距離最近且目前尚有空位的充電站。

examples.en: Expanding the public charging station infrastructure encourages more drivers to go electric.
examples.zh: 持續擴建公有路邊與公共停車場充電樁基礎設施，能吸引帶動更多傳統車主毅然換開純電動車。

examples.en: Highway rest stops installed 350kW ultra-fast EV charging stations for travelers.
examples.zh: 國道高速公路各大服務區休息站皆廣設 350kW 超高速電動車充電站供用路人使用。

examples.en: You can use a smartphone map app to check the real-time availability of nearby charging stations.
examples.zh: 你可以打開手機地圖 App，即時查詢周遭各家充電站目前是否有空置充電樁。

examples.en: Shopping malls attract EV owners by offering free parking alongside dedicated charging stations.
examples.zh: 許多大型購物商場透過在專屬充電站旁提供免費停車優惠，來吸引電動車主前來消費。

entries.definition: 電動車充電站；充電站；超級充電站

explains.en: Drivers can plug an electric car into this place to add power to its battery. Some are beside highways.
A phone app may show which nearby chargers are free. Shopping centers sometimes offer them to visitors.
Fast equipment at a rest stop can give an electric vehicle more power. Public access can encourage people to use electric cars.

examples.en: Taiwan's dense mountainous terrain supports astonishing biological diversity (biodiversity).
examples.zh: 台灣高聳綿延的高山地形孕育出令人驚嘆的豐富生物多樣性。

examples.en: Deforestation in the Amazon rainforest causes an alarming irreversible collapse in biodiversity.
examples.zh: 亞馬遜熱帶雨林遭到非法大肆砍伐，引發了全球生物多樣性令人心驚且不可逆轉的急劇崩解。

examples.en: Preserving coastal coral reefs is essential because they host tremendous marine biodiversity.
examples.zh: 傾力維護沿海珊瑚礁群落至關重要，因為它們孕育並庇護著海洋中極其繁茂驚人的生物多樣性。

examples.en: Eco-friendly rice paddies foster rich wetland biodiversity, sheltering frogs and waterbirds.
examples.zh: 堅持不灑農藥的有機友善水稻田復育了生氣盎然的濕地生物多樣性，成為台北赤蛙與水鳥的樂園。

examples.en: Protecting fragile tropical coral reefs preserves vital marine biodiversity against climate change.
examples.zh: 竭力守護嬌弱敏感的熱帶珊瑚礁生態系，能為海洋維繫抵禦全球氣候變遷衝擊的關鍵生物多樣性。

examples.en: Monoculture tree plantations support far less native biodiversity than natural old-growth rainforests.
examples.zh: 單一樹種的人工商業林木造林地所能承載的原生生物多樣性，遠遠低於動植物共生的天然原始雨林。

examples.en: Deep ocean seamounts harbor astonishing levels of undiscovered genetic biodiversity.
examples.zh: 沉睡在深海的孤立海山，蘊藏著超乎人類想像、宛如外星世界的龐大未發現生物多樣性。

examples.en: Protecting fragile marine biodiversity requires strict international treaties prohibiting deep-sea trawling.
examples.zh: 保護脆弱珍稀的深海生物多樣性，迫切需要跨國簽署嚴格禁止公海深海破壞性底拖網捕撈的國際公約。

examples.en: Each new deep submersible expedition identifies dozens of bizarre new species, expanding known global biodiversity.
examples.zh: 每一次科研載人深潛器的成功下潛探勘，總能發現數十種前所未見的奇異新物種，大幅擴展地球生物多樣性版圖。

examples.en: Rooftop nectar gardens create vital urban green stepping stones that nurture pollinator biodiversity.
examples.zh: 在各頂樓打造原生蜜源花園，串連成都會綠色生態跳島，滋養蜜蜂與蝴蝶等豐富的生物多樣性。

examples.en: Integrating diverse native tree species across public parks boosts local insect and bird biodiversity.
examples.zh: 在都會公共公園中廣泛栽種多元化的台灣原生種喬木與灌木，能迅速繁衍在地鳥類與昆蟲生物多樣性。

examples.en: Urban biodiversity is heavily depleted when developers replace diverse brush with sterile turfgrass lawns.
