examples.zh: 若建商將豐富的原生荒野灌木叢全數剷平鋪上單一死寂的進口草皮，都市中的生物多樣性將遭受重創。

examples.en: Taiwan's steep elevation gradients create a globally recognized biodiversity hotspot teeming with unique life.
examples.zh: 台灣極大的海拔垂直高差，孕育出全球公認、生機盎然的「生物多樣性熱點」（Biodiversity Hotspot）。

examples.en: Protecting regional biodiversity requires strict limits on urban expansion into sensitive mountain foothills.
examples.zh: 保護區域生物多樣性需要嚴格限制都市開發擴張進入敏感的淺山丘陵。

examples.en: Marine protected areas play a crucial role in safeguarding coastal biodiversity from commercial overfishing.
examples.zh: 海洋保護區在捍衛沿岸生物多樣性免受過度商業捕撈方面扮演著關鍵角色。

examples.en: The deep ocean harbors astonishing biological biodiversity that holds secrets to the evolution of life on Earth.
examples.zh: 黑暗深海蘊藏著令人驚嘆的「生物多樣性奇蹟」（Biodiversity），封存著地球生命起源與演化的終極奧秘。

examples.en: Protecting rainforest biodiversity requires establishing connected ecological corridors for wandering wildlife.
examples.zh: 守護熱帶雨林豐富的生物多樣性，關鍵在於為穿梭遷徙的野生動物建立相互連通的生態保育廊道。

examples.en: Organic farming practices foster greater insect biodiversity compared to industrial chemical monoculture.
examples.zh: 相較於施用農藥化肥的單一化工業農業，有機友善農法能顯著豐富田間各類有益昆蟲的生態多樣性。

entries.definition: 生物多樣性；農業生物多樣性；物種多樣性；浩瀚深海未解生物多樣性寶庫；種植台灣原生蜜源誘鳥誘蝶複層生態植栽；寶島台灣豐富獨特之生物多樣性熱點；九成尚未命名的深海神秘生物多樣性奇蹟

explains.en: This is the variety of living things in a place, including plants, animals, and tiny organisms. Forests and reefs can have many kinds. Protecting habitats helps keep them.
A region with many different species has a rich range of life. Farming only one crop can reduce it. Nature reserves help protect it.
Use this word for the variety of life in an ecosystem. Mountain areas may contain many unique species. Human actions can either protect or reduce it.

examples.en: The Formosan black bear and leopard cat are rare endangered species.
examples.zh: 台灣黑熊與石虎皆為極度珍貴稀有、急需全民保護的瀕危物種。

examples.en: Habitat destruction has pushed several endemic bird varieties onto the endangered list.
examples.zh: 原生棲息地遭受人類開發持續破壞，已將數種台灣特有種鳥類逼入了即將瀕危的危險名單邊緣。

examples.en: International conservation funds provide critical financial support to protect critically endangered rhinos.
examples.zh: 國際野生動物保育基金會提供至關重要的專案資金挹注，全力救援處於極度瀕危狀態的珍稀犀牛。

explains.en: It describes a species that may disappear because very few are left. Habitat loss can put animals at risk. Conservation groups work to protect them.
A plant or animal in this condition has a high risk of extinction. Protecting forests can help. Laws may limit hunting.
When a species' numbers become dangerously low, it receives this label. Scientists and communities work to keep it alive. The Formosan black bear is one example.

examples.en: Mountain reforestation projects prevent landslides during torrential summer typhoons.
examples.zh: 山區植樹造林復育水土保持工程能在夏季強颱暴雨時有效預防土石流。

examples.en: Local volunteers planted native saplings as part of a nationwide coastal reforestation campaign.
examples.zh: 在地熱心志工齊聚海邊親手種下一株株台灣原生樹苗，共襄盛舉參與全國海岸防風林造林復育運動。

examples.en: Decades of steady reforestation helped restore the degraded watershed around the mountain reservoir.
examples.zh: 數十年如一日堅持不懈的高山造林綠化，成功讓這座高山重要蓄水水庫周邊劣化的集水區重現生機。

explains.en: Volunteers plant native young trees on a hillside where many trees were lost. Over time, the area can grow greener.
A damaged forest is restored by planting trees and caring for the land. This may help reduce soil erosion.
A community plants trees in an area that has been cleared. The new growth can provide homes for wildlife.

examples.en: Rising seawater temperatures cause catastrophic coral bleaching in southern waters.
examples.zh: 海水溫度異常上升導致南部與離島海域爆發嚴重的珊瑚白化危機。

examples.en: Divers documented severe coral bleaching along the offshore reefs of Kenting National Park.
examples.zh: 專業潛水員在墾丁國家公園周邊近海珊瑚礁群中，詳實拍攝記錄了大規模白化的沉痛影像。

examples.en: Reducing local water pollution gives coral reefs a fighting chance to recover from coral bleaching.
examples.zh: 大幅減少沿岸陸源廢水污染排放，能為受損的珊瑚礁爭取寶貴喘息生機，從白化浩劫中復原。

explains.en: When ocean water becomes too warm, colorful coral can turn white. This change can harm the reef.
Divers may see pale coral after sea temperatures rise. Reducing pollution can help reefs recover.
Reefs lose their bright color when stressed by heat. Scientists watch this problem in warm waters.

examples.en: Scientists found tiny microplastics inside deep ocean marine food chains.
examples.zh: 科學家在深海海洋食物鏈中檢測出微細的塑膠微粒殘留。

examples.en: Washing synthetic clothing sheds invisible microplastics into municipal sewage networks.
examples.zh: 用洗衣機清洗化學合成纖維衣物時，常會脫落肉眼難辨的微塑膠並排入都會生活污水管網。

examples.en: Filter feeders like oysters and clams frequently ingest hazardous airborne and aquatic microplastics.
examples.zh: 牡蠣與文蛤等濾食性海洋貝類生物，極易在濾食海水過程中將有害的微塑膠碎屑吞入體內。

examples.en: Microplastics floating across oceanic food webs accumulate in oysters and predatory pelagic tuna.
examples.zh: 漂浮在各大洋中的海洋微塑膠，正透過食物鏈悄悄累積於牡蠣與大型洄游黑鮪魚體內。

examples.en: Washing synthetic fleece garments releases thousands of tiny microplastics into municipal wastewater systems.
examples.zh: 清洗化纖刷毛衣物會將成千上萬個細微微塑膠纖維釋放到都會污水系統中。

examples.en: Environmental scientists are developing advanced biofilters capable of trapping microplastics before they reach rivers.
examples.zh: 環境科學家正在研發先進的生物濾芯，能在微塑膠流入河川水體之前將其有效攔截。

entries.definition: 塑膠微粒；微塑膠；海洋微塑膠微粒污染

explains.en: These are extremely small pieces of plastic found in water, soil, and even food chains. Washing synthetic clothes can release some. Filters may keep them out of rivers.
Tiny plastic fragments can be eaten by oysters or other animals. They may move through the ocean food web. Scientists study how to remove them.
This term names small plastic particles that can be hard to see. They come from larger plastic items or synthetic fabric. Better filters can catch them before they spread.

examples.en: Green consumerism encourages shoppers to buy carbon-labeled certified items.
examples.zh: 綠色消費主義理念鼓勵消費者優先選購印有碳足跡標籤的環保產品。

examples.en: The rise of green consumerism has driven retailers to eliminate excess plastic wrapping.
examples.zh: 現代綠色消費主義意識的覺醒，有力驅使各大實體零售商積極設法剔除過度浮誇的塑膠包裝。

examples.en: Practicing green consumerism means considering the ethical and ecological impact of every product you buy.
examples.zh: 身體力行踐行綠色消費，意味著在掏錢購買任何商品之前，皆會深思其背後的倫理與生態衝擊。

entries.definition: 綠色消費；綠色採購理念

explains.en: It is the habit of choosing products with less environmental harm. Shoppers may look for recycled packaging or carbon labels. Their choices can influence stores.
A buyer considers how a product affects nature before purchasing it. Reusable packaging is one example. Businesses may respond by reducing plastic.
This idea encourages people to shop with the environment in mind. It includes choosing durable, responsibly made goods. Consumers can ask companies to improve.

examples.en: Turning off unused lights and computers is essential for energy conservation.
examples.zh: 隨手關閉閒置未使用的電燈與電腦是落實節能省電的日常基本功。

examples.en: Smart thermostats optimize air conditioning usage in large commercial buildings for energy conservation.
examples.zh: 智慧型恆溫控制器能精準調控大型商用辦公大樓的空調冷房效率，以達到絕佳的節約能源成效。

examples.en: The manufacturing company invested heavily in heat recovery systems to promote factory energy conservation.
examples.zh: 這家製造企業大手筆投資引進工業廢熱回收系統，以全力推動工廠內部的全方位節約能源目標。

explains.en: Turn off lights in an empty room and unplug devices that are not being used. Small habits can lower power use.
A factory captures heat from machines instead of wasting it. This can help reduce energy use.
Using a thermostat wisely and choosing efficient appliances can reduce electricity use. This helps save power over time.

examples.en: Air purifiers filter out fine particle pollutants like PM2.5 efficiently.
examples.zh: 空氣清淨機能高效過濾 PM2.5 等空氣中微細懸浮顆粒污染物。

examples.en: Industrial chemical pollutants dumped illegally into the river poisoned thousands of wild fish.
examples.zh: 不肖業者將未經處理的工業化學污染物惡意偷排入河川，造成下游數以萬計的野生魚類暴斃。

examples.en: Stricter vehicle inspection policies help eliminate harmful exhaust pollutants from city streets.
examples.zh: 嚴格落實汽機車定期排氣檢驗制度，有助於從都會大街小巷中根除刺鼻有害的尾氣污染物。

explains.en: Tiny particles from cars can make city air unhealthy. This word names a harmful substance in air or water.
Factories may release chemicals into a river. These substances can hurt fish and plants.
A car inspection can reduce harmful material in exhaust. The substance that causes pollution has this name.

examples.en: Digital marketing combines SEO, content strategy, and paid social ads.
examples.zh: 數位行銷整合了搜尋引擎最佳化、內容策略與社群付費廣告。

examples.en: Small businesses leverage digital marketing to reach customers across the globe on modest budgets.
examples.zh: 小型企業善用數位行銷以精簡預算精準觸及全球潛在目標顧客。

examples.en: She enrolled in an online certificate course to advance her career in digital marketing.
examples.zh: 她報名參加了線上認證進修課程，以期在數位行銷專業領域更上層樓。

explains.en: This is promoting products or services through websites, apps, and social media. A small shop can reach people in many places. Online ads and videos are common tools.
A business may use search results, email, or social posts to find customers. An online course can teach these methods. It helps a company share its message widely.
Use this phrase for advertising and selling through internet channels. A company can use videos and websites on a small budget. It can reach customers around the world.

examples.en: The bubble tea brand launched a creative summer marketing campaign.
examples.zh: 這家珍珠奶茶品牌推出了一場極具創意的盛夏行銷宣傳活動。

examples.en: The marketing campaign generated thousands of new leads across multiple social channels.
examples.zh: 這波行銷宣傳戰役在各大社群媒體管道成功吸引並創造了數以千計的新潛在客戶名單。

examples.en: Measuring return on investment is crucial before approving a multi-million-dollar marketing campaign.
examples.zh: 在正式核准數百萬美元的龐大行銷專案前，審慎評估投資報酬率至關重要。

entries.definition: 行銷宣傳活動；行銷戰役

explains.en: It is a planned set of activities that promotes a product or service. A tea shop may launch a summer campaign. Teams track how many new customers respond.
A company can use ads, social media, and events to reach buyers. Each activity supports the same goal. Results help decide what to do next.
This organized effort spreads a message about a brand. It may run across several channels. A team measures whether it attracts customers.

examples.en: A distinctive logo and uniform colors reinforce solid brand identity.
examples.zh: 獨具特色標誌與一致色彩體系能強化並穩固品牌識別形象。

examples.en: The company updated its brand identity to appear more modern and approachable.
examples.zh: 該公司全面更新了品牌視覺識別系統，展現出更富現代感與親和力的企業形象。

examples.en: Consistent typography and tone of voice help establish an unmistakable brand identity.
examples.zh: 一致的字體排版美學與對話語調，有助於塑造鮮明且令人過目難忘的品牌識別度。

explains.en: A company uses the same logo, colors, and style on its website and packaging. Customers can recognize it.
A new business chooses a name, symbol, and voice that show what it stands for. These choices create a recognizable image.
When signs, products, and messages all look consistent, people can identify the company more easily. A memorable symbol may help.

examples.en: Sponsoring major esports tournaments dramatically raised brand awareness.
examples.zh: 贊助大型電競電玩賽事讓該品牌的市場知名度大幅飆升。

examples.en: Distributing free samples at train stations is an effective way to boost local brand awareness.
examples.zh: 在人潮熙攘的火車站周邊發放免費試用品，是快速打響在地品牌知名度的絕佳方式。

examples.en: The newly launched startup spent heavily on outdoor billboards to build initial brand awareness.
examples.zh: 這家剛成立的新創品牌斥資投放戶外巨幅廣告看板，以迅速打開初期的市場品牌知名度。

explains.en: People recognize a company name or product when they see it. Ads can help more shoppers remember it.
A new business may put signs near a station so customers learn its name. This knowledge can grow over time.
Free samples or event sponsorships can help people remember a product. This term describes how familiar a brand is to the public.

examples.en: Exceptional after-sales service fosters enduring customer brand loyalty.
examples.zh: 卓越貼心的售後服務能培養並鞏固長久的顧客品牌忠誠度。

examples.en: Apple has cultivated incredible brand loyalty among consumers who eagerly buy every new product.
examples.zh: 蘋果公司在廣大消費群體中建立了驚人的品牌忠誠度，每逢新品上市總能引發瘋狂搶購潮。

examples.en: Frequent discounts alone rarely build genuine brand loyalty among price-sensitive shoppers.
examples.zh: 單靠頻繁的削價促銷，極難在對價格高度敏感的買家心中建立起真正牢固的品牌忠誠度。

explains.en: This is when customers keep choosing the same company's products over time. Good service can help build it. Some people wait eagerly for each new product.
A shopper may prefer one company's goods even when other choices are available. Discounts alone may not create this feeling. Trust and quality can help.
Use this phrase for a customer's continued preference for one maker's products. Good support can strengthen it. It can lead people to buy again.

examples.en: The corporate public relations team handled the crisis with honesty.
examples.zh: 企業公共關係（公關）團隊以誠懇透明的態度妥善處理解決危機。

examples.en: Good public relations is about building mutual trust rather than spinning the truth.
examples.zh: 優質良好的公共關係著重於與大眾建立雙向互信，而非刻意曲解掩蓋事實真相。

examples.en: The airline hired a top public relations agency to manage press communications after the strike.
examples.zh: 該航空公司在突發罷工事件後，緊急聘請頂尖公關顧問團隊統籌所有媒體新聞發布。

explains.en: It is the work of building a good relationship between an organization and the people who hear about it. Staff may respond to news questions. Honesty helps during a crisis.
A company may communicate with reporters and the community to earn trust. A team can explain decisions after a difficult event. Clear messages matter.
This field manages how an organization shares information and maintains its reputation. Agencies may help with press communication. Trust is more valuable than hiding facts.

examples.en: The tech startup issued an official press release regarding funding.
examples.zh: 這家科技新創團隊針對最新一輪融資成果發布了官方新聞稿。

examples.en: Journalists received the embargoed press release twenty-four hours before the official announcement.
examples.zh: 各大主流媒體記者在官方正式發布會召開前二十四小時，便收到了附有限時保密條款的新聞通稿。

examples.en: An effective press release contains clear quotes, factual data, and PR contact information.
examples.zh: 一份專業有效的新聞稿應當包含清晰的高層引言、詳實客觀的數據以及公關窗口聯絡方式。

examples.en: The tech company issued a formal press release announcing its latest smartphone.
examples.zh: 該跨國科技巨擘正式發布官方新聞稿，隆重宣布旗下新一代旗艦智慧手機。

examples.en: PR agencies distribute press releases to journalists to generate media buzz.
examples.zh: 公關公司將新聞稿廣泛分發給各大媒體記者，以掀起話題與報導熱潮。

examples.en: The joint press release clarified details regarding the strategic business alliance.
examples.zh: 雙方聯合發布的新聞稿詳細說明了策略商業聯盟的各項合作細節。

entries.definition: 新聞稿；新聞發布稿；官方公關聲明

explains.en: A company sends journalists a prepared statement about a new product or event. It may include quotes and contact details.
A school shares an official announcement with local news outlets. The message gives clear facts for reporters.
When an organization wants to tell the public important news, it may prepare this written announcement. Reporters can use it as a source.

examples.en: Gen Z college students are the primary target audience for this app.
examples.zh: Z 世代的大學年輕學子是這款社群 App 最核心鎖定的目標受眾（TA）。

examples.en: Understanding the specific pain points of your target audience ensures better product design.
examples.zh: 深刻洞察並精準掌握目標受眾的真實痛點，才能開發出切中需求的優質產品。

examples.en: The horror movie was not suitable for a broad family target audience.
examples.zh: 這部驚悚恐怖片情節過於血腥駭人，顯然並不適合闔家觀賞的家庭目標觀眾群。

explains.en: This is the group of people a company hopes will use its product. A phone app may be made for college students.
Designers learn what a particular group needs before building a product. Knowing those people helps the design.
A scary film may be made for older viewers rather than small children. This term names the intended group.

examples.en: Analyzing online consumer behavior helps optimize checkout steps.
examples.zh: 深入分析線上消費者行為有助於精準優化結帳結單各步驟流程。

examples.en: The pandemic triggered dramatic long-term shifts in grocery consumer behavior toward online ordering.
examples.zh: 疫情衝擊引發了生鮮採買消費者行為模式的長期劇烈轉變，線上訂購生鮮蔚為主流風潮。

examples.en: Psychologists study consumer behavior to understand why people make impulsive purchases.
examples.zh: 消費心理學家深入探究各類消費者行為心理學，以解開人們為何總是會產生衝動性消費衝動。

explains.en: This describes the choices people make when they shop or use services. Researchers study why someone buys one product instead of another. Online steps can affect those choices.
A family may change where it buys groceries after a big event. Psychologists study how shoppers make decisions. This pattern can help stores plan their websites.
Use this phrase for the way customers think and act when buying things. A person might make an unplanned purchase. Businesses analyze these habits.

examples.en: Precise market segmentation allows customized messaging for distinct groups.
examples.zh: 精準的市場區隔策略讓品牌能針對不同族群客製專屬行銷訊息。

examples.en: Geographic and demographic segmentation revealed untapped sales potential in southern cities.
examples.zh: 地理分佈與人口統計學區隔分析顯示，南部主要都會區尚蘊含著龐大未被開發的銷售潛力。

examples.en: Effective customer segmentation enables businesses to allocate marketing resources efficiently.
examples.zh: 高效細緻的客戶族群區隔，使企業能夠將有限的行銷預算資源配置發揮到極致。

explains.en: It is the process of dividing a large market or audience into smaller groups with shared needs. A company can tailor messages for each group. Age and location may matter.
A business studies customers and separates them by interests or habits. This helps it choose the right products to promote. Different groups may respond to different messages.
Marketers break a broad audience into smaller sections for planning. They may compare location, age, or buying behavior. The result can guide advertising.

examples.en: The product appeals strongly to the 25-to-34 young professional demographic.
examples.zh: 該項產品深受二十五至三十四歲青年都會上班族族群的青睞喜愛。

examples.en: Advertisers use census demographic data to predict where new suburban branches will thrive.
examples.zh: 廣告投放專家善用戶政人口統計學特徵大數據，以精準預測新開郊區連鎖門市的展店商機。

examples.en: The video platform observed a steady demographic shift toward older viewers over recent years.
examples.zh: 該熱門影音分享平台近年來觀察到，整體用戶年齡人口結構正穩步朝向熟齡中老年族群擴展。

entries.definition: 人口統計學的；族群特徵數據

explains.en: A store studies the ages and interests of people who may buy its products. This information helps it understand its customers.
A survey shows that more older adults are watching a video service. The data describe a group of people.
Researchers collect facts about age, family size, or location. These characteristics help describe a population group.

examples.en: Publishing helpful informative blogs is the backbone of content marketing.
examples.zh: 定期發布實用有深度的知識部落格文章是做好內容行銷的核心基石。

examples.en: Rather than pushing direct sales pitches, content marketing builds trust by providing genuine value.
examples.zh: 內容行銷並非一味強推硬性推銷話術，而是藉由持續輸出高含金量專業價值來贏得顧客信賴。

examples.en: A successful content marketing campaign generates qualified inbound leads over time.
examples.zh: 一套運作成熟成功的內容行銷策略，能為企業細水長流地帶來源源不絕的優質自來客名單。

explains.en: A business shares helpful articles or videos to attract people. It builds trust instead of only asking them to buy.
A company may post useful advice online so people learn about its products. This plan can bring interested visitors over time.
This kind of promotion offers information that customers want to read. Helpful blog posts are one example.

examples.en: Persuasive copywriting turns casual website browsers into paying customers.
examples.zh: 具說服力的精準文案撰寫能將瀏覽訪客成功轉化為實質付費顧客。

examples.en: Good copywriting uses concise, engaging language that evokes emotional resonance.
examples.zh: 真正出色的文案創作善用精煉俐落且富感染力的字句，瞬間激發讀者內心的強烈情感共鳴。

examples.en: She revised the headline several times to test different styles of promotional copywriting.
examples.zh: 她反覆修改推敲產品首頁的主標題，以交叉測試各種不同風格的宣傳廣告文案轉化成效。

entries.definition: 文案撰寫；廣告文案創作

explains.en: This is writing used in advertisements or on websites to persuade people to take action. A short headline may encourage someone to buy. Writers choose clear and engaging words.
A person in this job creates messages for businesses. They may write product descriptions or ads. The goal is to connect with customers.
This kind of writing promotes a service or product. It may appear on a website, poster, or email. Strong words can help turn a visitor into a buyer.

examples.en: The creative copywriter crafted catchy headlines for the outdoor billboard.
examples.zh: 創意文案師為戶外巨幅廣告看板設計了朗朗上口、吸睛的標題文案。

examples.en: A talented freelance copywriter can earn a lucrative living writing sales emails for online brands.
examples.zh: 實力深厚的自由接案文案師，專門為電商品牌撰寫高成交率銷售信即可獲得豐厚回報。

examples.en: The advertising agency is hiring an experienced tech copywriter who understands SaaS software.
examples.zh: 這家跨國廣告代理商正在積極招募一位深入理解雲端 SaaS 軟體生態的資深科技文案撰稿人。

explains.en: It is a person who writes words for advertisements, websites, or sales emails. They create clear headlines that catch attention. Some work independently.
An advertising company may hire this writer to make a product sound appealing. The work can include slogans and short descriptions. Strong writing is useful.
This professional writes persuasive text for a business. They may prepare billboard messages or web pages. The goal is to help readers understand or buy something.

examples.en: 'Think Different' remains Apple's most famous inspirational brand tagline.
examples.zh: 「Think Different（非同凡想）」至今仍是蘋果最具代表性的經典標語。

examples.en: A memorable company tagline should summarize the brand's core mission in just a few words.
examples.zh: 一句令人過目難忘的經典企業標語，應當能用寥寥數語精準凝練出品牌最核心的崇高使命。

examples.en: The sports apparel company launched a refreshed marketing campaign with an uplifting new tagline.
examples.zh: 這家運動服飾大廠推出了一波全新行銷活動，並搭配了一句極富振奮感染力的全新品牌標語。

explains.en: A short memorable phrase appears beside a company’s logo. It helps people remember what the company stands for.
An advertisement uses a few catchy words to sum up a product. This phrase may stay in people’s minds.
A sports brand chooses a brief message for its campaign. The words express the brand’s idea.

examples.en: A bold orange 'Buy Now' button serves as an effective call to action (CTA).
examples.zh: 顯眼的亮橘色「立即購買」按鈕發揮了極佳的號召性點擊引導功能。

examples.en: Every persuasive marketing email should conclude with a single, unambiguous call to action.
examples.zh: 每封具高說服力的行銷電子郵件結尾，都應當置入一個明確清晰且毫不含糊的行動號召按鈕。

examples.en: Changing the call to action from 'Submit' to 'Get Your Free Guide' significantly improved clicks.
examples.zh: 將行動號召按鈕文案從單調的「送出」改成「立即領取免費指南」，讓點擊率獲得顯著攀升。

explains.en: A website may show a button that tells visitors what to do next. It might ask them to sign up.
A marketing email often ends with one clear request. A bright button may lead people to a guide.
These words name a message that encourages a next step, such as buying or joining. Clear wording can help people respond.

examples.en: The product landing page clearly highlights customer reviews and discounts.
examples.zh: 該產品活動登陸頁面醒目呈現了真實顧客五星好評與限時折扣優惠。

examples.en: Removing navigation clutter from your landing page keeps visitor attention focused on converting.
examples.zh: 剔除登陸頁面上多餘且干擾的導航選單，能讓訪客的全副注意力牢牢聚焦於下單轉換流程。

examples.en: A mobile-optimized landing page loads instantly and displays clean contact forms.
examples.zh: 針對智慧型手機完美適配優化的登陸頁面不僅能秒速載入，還能優雅呈現簡潔的諮詢表單。

explains.en: This is the first web page someone sees after clicking an advertisement or link. It focuses on one product or action. Clear reviews and contact forms can help visitors.
A business may direct a customer to this page to learn about a special offer. It should make the next step easy. Extra menus can distract people.
Use this term for a web page designed around one goal, such as signing up or buying. It may load quickly on a phone. It highlights useful information.

examples.en: Slow website loading speeds often lead to an unacceptably high bounce rate.
examples.zh: 網頁開啟載入速度過慢往往會導致極高且不理想的網站跳出率。

examples.en: If visitors leave without interacting with your page, your site will register a high bounce rate.
examples.zh: 若廣大訪客剛進入網頁尚未產生任何點擊互動便匆匆關閉離開，網站跳出率數據便會居高不下。

examples.en: Relevant content and intuitive site navigation help lower your e-commerce bounce rate.
examples.zh: 提供切題高質量的內容與清晰直覺的站內導覽動線，能有效壓低電商平台的首頁跳出率。

explains.en: It is the share of website visitors who leave after viewing only one page. Slow loading can make it rise. Clear links may encourage people to explore more.
A web page records a high percentage when visitors arrive and then leave without interacting. Useful content can keep them interested. Site owners monitor this measure.
This website measure shows how often visitors leave quickly. Easy navigation may lower it. A confusing or slow page may drive people away.

examples.en: Streamlining the checkout process increased the store's e-commerce conversion rate.
examples.zh: 簡化購物車結帳流程讓該網路商店的電商成交轉換率顯著提升。

examples.en: Even a 1% improvement in conversion rate can generate millions in additional annual revenue.
examples.zh: 哪怕只是將全站轉換率微幅拉升一個百分點，每年亦能為企業創造出高達數百萬元的額外營收。

examples.en: Adding customer testimonials and security badges boosted the subscription conversion rate.
examples.zh: 頁面上增添真實顧客口碑見證與第三方支付安全認證標章，顯著帶動了付費訂閱轉換率。

explains.en: A website counts how many visitors actually buy something. This percentage helps the store see whether its page works well.
Many people visit a shop page, but only some place an order. The share who complete the action is measured.
A team tests a simpler checkout page to see if more visitors become customers. This number compares actions with visits.

examples.en: Marketers map every touchpoint across the digital sales conversion funnel.
examples.zh: 行銷專家細緻描摹出數位銷售轉換漏斗中的每一個關鍵接觸點。

examples.en: Bottlenecks in the checkout funnel caused many shoppers to abandon their carts.
examples.zh: 購物車結帳漏斗環節中的卡頓與繁瑣步驟，導致大量消費者在最後一刻憤而棄單離去。

examples.en: Nurturing leads at the top of the funnel builds awareness before offering paid solutions.
examples.zh: 在行銷轉換漏斗的最頂端細心培育潛在名單，能在正式推出付費方案前建立深刻品牌認知。

explains.en: This kitchen tool has a wide top and a narrow tube for pouring liquid into a bottle. It prevents spills.
A business may draw a shape showing how shoppers move from learning about a product to buying it. This model narrows at each step.
Oil can be poured through this cone-shaped object. Marketers also use the same shape to describe steps toward a sale.

examples.en: Optimizing web page titles and metadata improves organic SEO rankings.
examples.zh: 優化網頁標題與中繼資料能有效提升在 Google 上的自然搜尋引擎排名。

examples.en: Good SEO requires creating high-quality, comprehensive content that thoroughly answers user queries.
examples.zh: 做好 SEO 搜尋引擎最佳化需要產出高質量、全方位的內容，以徹底解答用戶的搜尋疑問。

examples.en: The agency conducted a technical SEO audit to fix broken hyperlinks and indexing errors.
examples.zh: 專業顧問團隊為該官網進行了深入的技術端 SEO 體檢，全面修復死連結與搜尋引擎索引錯誤。

entries.definition: 搜尋引擎最佳化 (Search Engine Optimization)

explains.en: This is the work of helping a website appear higher in unpaid search results. Clear titles and useful information can help. Broken links should be fixed.
A business may improve its website so people can find it through an online search. High-quality pages are important. This practice does not mean paying for an advertisement.
Use this abbreviation for methods that improve a page's visibility in search engines. It can include fixing technical problems. Good content answers what people are looking for.

examples.en: Conducting keyword research reveals what exact search terms buyers use.
examples.zh: 深入進行關鍵字研究分析能精準掌握買家在搜尋框中所輸入的詞彙。

examples.en: Effective keyword research helps content writers identify low-competition search queries with high intent.
examples.zh: 扎實的關鍵字研究能協助內容撰稿者精準挖掘出搜尋意圖強烈且競爭度相對偏低的利基關鍵字。

examples.en: We used keyword research tools to uncover seasonal trends in winter jacket searches.
examples.zh: 我們善用專業的關鍵字研究分析工具，精準洞察出每年入冬之際保暖羽絨外套的搜尋週期趨勢。

explains.en: It is the process of finding words people type into a search engine. Writers can use the results to plan useful pages. Seasonal searches may reveal trends.
A business studies what phrases customers use online. This helps content writers choose relevant topics. Tools can show how often people search.
Before creating web content, a team can discover common search terms. Low-competition phrases may be easier to rank for. The findings guide planning.

examples.en: High-quality educational blog articles drive consistent organic traffic.
examples.zh: 優質且富含乾貨的知識部落格文章能持續帶來穩定源源不絕的自然流量。

examples.en: Unlike paid ads that stop delivering when the budget runs out, organic traffic provides lasting value.
examples.zh: 與預算耗盡便立刻中斷歸零的付費廣告不同，自然搜尋流量能為網站沉澱持久長遠的商業價值。

examples.en: Search engine ranking updates caused a temporary dip in organic traffic last month.
examples.zh: Google 搜尋演算法在上個月進行的核心排名大更新，一度導致官網自然搜尋流量出現短暫震盪下滑。

entries.definition: 自然搜尋流量；非付費流量

explains.en: People find a website through unpaid search results rather than an advertisement. Helpful articles can bring visitors over time.
A reader searches for a recipe and clicks a regular result. The site did not pay for that visit.
Search engines send people to a page naturally when it matches what they want. These visits come without paid ads.

examples.en: Running Google Search ads generates immediate targeted paid traffic.
examples.zh: 投放 Google 搜尋關鍵字廣告能在短時間內引進精準的付費廣告流量。

examples.en: When launching a brand-new website, paid traffic can test user conversion before SEO kicks in.
examples.zh: 剛上線全新品牌官方網站時，善用付費廣告流量能在自然搜尋效益發酵前快速驗證商業模式。

examples.en: Allocating budget strategically across different platforms prevents wasting money on low-intent paid traffic.
examples.zh: 在各大廣告聯播網平台間採取策略性預算分配，能有效防止資金白白浪費在低購買意圖的付費流量上。

explains.en: A website can receive visitors after a company pays to show ads. Search ads are one way to do this.
A new business may buy online promotion to bring people to its site. It can check whether those visitors become customers.
Some online visitors arrive by clicking an advertisement. Spending money wisely can bring people who are interested.

examples.en: Advertisers only pay when a prospective customer clicks on a PPC ad.
examples.zh: 廣告主只有在潛在客戶實際點擊廣告時，才需要為 PPC 點擊付費。

examples.en: Managing a profitable PPC campaign requires ongoing bid optimization and negative keyword filtering.
examples.zh: 維繫一個能穩定獲利的 PPC 廣告專案，需要持續不斷進行出價競價優化與排除否定關鍵字。

examples.en: PPC advertising allows businesses to appear prominently at the very top of search engine results pages.
examples.zh: PPC 每次點擊付費廣告能讓企業的商品連結瞬間搶佔搜尋引擎搜尋結果頁的最頂部黃金版位。

explains.en: This online advertising model charges a business when someone clicks its ad. The ad may appear near the top of search results. The advertiser can adjust its bid.
A company pays only after a potential customer clicks the advertisement. It must manage spending carefully. The letters name a common way to buy online ads.
Use this term for an ad campaign where each click has a cost. Businesses may choose words that shoppers search for. They monitor results to stay within budget.

examples.en: Competitive financial keywords typically have a high cost per click (CPC).
examples.zh: 競爭極為激烈的金融理財類關鍵字通常具有較高昂的單次點擊成本。

examples.en: Improving your ad quality score can significantly reduce your average cost per click.
examples.zh: 大幅提升廣告關聯度品質分數，能為廣告主有效壓低每一筆點擊所產生的平均單次點擊成本。

examples.en: The marketing manager monitored daily cost per click metrics to keep campaign expenses within budget.
examples.zh: 行銷經理每日緊盯後台各項單次點擊成本指標數據，確保整體廣告投放開銷嚴格維持在預算範圍內。

explains.en: It is the amount an advertiser pays each time someone taps an online ad. Better ad quality can lower the charge. A marketing team tracks it daily.
When a person clicks a digital advertisement, the company may pay this fee. Popular search terms can make it high. It helps measure campaign spending.
This advertising metric shows the price of each user click. A business can compare it across ads. Keeping the amount low can control expenses.

examples.en: The digital ad campaign delivered a remarkable 300% return on investment (ROI).
examples.zh: 這次數位廣告投放專案創造了高達 300% 的亮眼投資報酬率（ROI）。

examples.en: Before approving modern automation machinery, executives calculated the projected return on investment.
examples.zh: 在正式拍板核准引進現代化自動化機械設備之前，高層主管已詳盡試算了預期投資報酬率。

examples.en: Upgrading employee skills through professional training yields an impressive long-term return on investment.
examples.zh: 透過系統化專業在職培訓持續厚植基層員工專業技能，能為企業帶來長遠且豐碩的綜合投資回報。

explains.en: A shop compares the money earned from an ad campaign with what it spent. This helps judge whether the campaign was worthwhile.
A company buys new machines and later checks how much value they created. Managers compare the gain with the cost.
Before training employees, a business estimates whether the future benefits justify the money spent. Managers consider both gains and costs.

examples.en: E-commerce brands target a minimum ROAS of 4x to ensure healthy margins.
examples.zh: 電商賣家通常設定至少四倍以上的廣告投報率（ROAS）以確保獲利空間。

examples.en: By pausing underperforming ad sets, the media buyer raised the account's overall return on ad spend.
examples.zh: 廣告投放操作人員透過果斷暫停成效欠佳的廣告受眾組合，成功拉高了全帳戶的整體廣告投報率。

examples.en: High product discounts may boost sales volume but can negatively impact your return on ad spend.
examples.zh: 過度頻繁且過深的商品跳樓折扣雖能衝高營業額，卻往往會對整體的廣告投資報酬率造成負面侵蝕。

explains.en: A business compares money earned from ads with the money spent on them. This helps judge if the ads work.
If an online campaign brings many sales for a small cost, this measure may be high. Discounts can change the result.
Marketers look at this number to see how much revenue each advertising dollar brings. It helps compare campaigns.

examples.en: Micro-influencers often maintain higher engagement rates and authenticity.
examples.zh: 追蹤人數幾千至數萬的微網紅通常擁有更高的互動率與真實信任感。

examples.en: Collaborating with a dozen micro-influencers can often be more cost-effective than hiring a celebrity.
examples.zh: 廣泛與十幾位小而美、深具黏著度的微網紅合作，其帶貨成效往往遠比單獨重金聘請巨星更加划算。

examples.en: The local coffee brand partnered with neighborhood foodie micro-influencers to promote its new roast.
examples.zh: 這家本土烘豆品牌專程與社區周邊的美食獵人文青微網紅結盟，共同力推全新嚴選烘焙配方豆。

explains.en: This is an online creator with a smaller audience who shares posts about a topic. Their followers may trust their honest advice. A local cafe might work with one.
A business may partner with several neighborhood food reviewers instead of a famous star. Each creator has a modest number of followers. Their audience may be very engaged.
This person shares content online for a focused group of followers. They can introduce a product to people in their community. Their recommendations may feel personal.

examples.en: Creators must clearly disclose sponsored content with tags like #ad.
examples.zh: 創作者依規定發布商業業配合作內容時必須清楚標註贊助標籤。

examples.en: The professional esports tournament was proudly sponsored by leading hardware manufacturers.
examples.zh: 這場世界級頂尖職業電競錦標賽，由全球各大頂級電腦硬體製造龍頭企業提供榮譽贊助。

examples.en: Sponsored articles published in business magazines must adhere to ethical editorial disclosure standards.
examples.zh: 刊登在商業財經雜誌上的各類企業付費贊助專題報導，均必須嚴格遵守誠實揭露的專業新聞倫理標準。

explains.en: It describes content or an event paid for by a company or supporter. Creators should clearly say when a post is an advertisement. A tournament may have a brand's support.
A business may provide money or goods in exchange for public attention. The support should be disclosed. It can fund sports or online posts.
Use this adjective when a person or organization pays to support an activity. A magazine article may be paid for by a brand. Clear labels help readers understand.

examples.en: Genuine comments and shares signify a healthy audience engagement rate.
examples.zh: 真實踴躍的留言互動與轉發分享代表著極為健全優質的受眾社群互動率。

examples.en: Brands prioritize working with accounts that maintain high engagement rates over those with inflated follower counts.
examples.zh: 品牌端在尋求商業合作時，往往優先鎖定高互動率的優質帳號，而非那些充斥虛假殭屍粉的空殼大號。

examples.en: Hosting interactive weekly Q&A sessions noticeably lifted the community's overall engagement rate.
examples.zh: 官方粉專每週定期舉辦互動式即時問答直播，顯著帶動並拉升了整個社群粉絲群體的整體互動熱度。

entries.definition: 社群互動率（讚／留言／分享）

explains.en: A page counts likes, comments, and shares compared with how many people saw a post. The number shows how actively viewers respond.
A creator asks a question and many followers reply. This measure helps describe audience interaction.
A brand compares reactions on two posts to learn which one gets more responses from viewers. The number can guide future posts.

examples.en: An appealing headline dramatically improves email click-through rate (CTR).
examples.zh: 搶眼吸睛的標題設計能大幅有效提升電子郵件的點閱率（CTR）。

examples.en: The ad designer conducted experiments with bright contrast colors to boost the banner click-through rate.
examples.zh: 廣告設計師大膽嘗試運用高對比度的鮮豔明亮配色方案，成功拉抬了活動橫幅看板的點閱率表現。

examples.en: A low click-through rate usually signals that your promotional ad copy does not resonate with the audience.
examples.zh: 低迷的點擊率通常意味著您的廣告文案訴求完全無法打動當前受眾，或是廣告投放對象出現嚴重偏差。

explains.en: This percentage tells how many people click an online ad or link after seeing it. A clear headline may raise it.
A designer can test different colors to see which attracts more clicks. This measure helps show what works.
If few viewers open a promotion, its text may not interest them. This number tracks the share who click.

examples.en: Subscribe to our weekly tech newsletter for curated industry insights.
examples.zh: 歡迎免費訂閱我們的每週科技電子報，掌握精選的產業最新趨勢剖析。

examples.en: The marketing department publishes an informative monthly newsletter for enterprise software clients.
examples.zh: 企業行銷部門每月定期發行內容紮實專業的電子刊物，向所有企業級軟體客戶同步最新產業報告。

examples.en: Over fifty thousand active subscribers receive her daily culinary recipe newsletter every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早晨，有超過五萬名忠實熱愛料理的訂閱用戶準時收悉她親筆撰寫的每日私房食譜美食電子報。

explains.en: This is a regular message or small publication sent to a group of readers. It may share news, recipes, or useful updates. People can sign up to receive it.
A company may send this by email every week or month. It gives subscribers information they might like. It can include articles and links.
Use this word for a recurring bulletin from a group or business. A technology team may share industry news. Readers may choose to subscribe.

examples.en: Personalized subject lines increase marketing email open rates by 25%.
examples.zh: 個人化客製化的郵件主旨能將行銷電子郵件的開信率提升二成五。

examples.en: Sending emails on Tuesday mornings typically results in a higher promotional open rate.
examples.zh: 將信件排程於每週二清晨寄發，通常能讓商業促銷郵件收穫更為亮眼的電子郵件開啟率。

examples.en: If your sender reputation drops, your emails may land in spam folders, plummeting your open rate.
examples.zh: 一旦您的發件人信譽評分遭到系統降級，所發郵件極易落入垃圾郵件匣，導致整體開信率雪崩式下滑。

entries.definition: 開信率；電子信箱開啟率

explains.en: It is the percentage of email recipients who open a message. A clear subject line may help more people read it. Marketers compare results over time.
This email measure counts how many messages are opened by their receivers. Sending at a good time may improve it. Spam placement can lower it.
A campaign may track the share of people who open its emails. Personal greetings can make a message more inviting. The number is often shown as a percent.

examples.en: Users can easily click unsubscribe at the footer of any promotional email.
examples.zh: 使用者只需點擊每封促銷信件最下方的連結即可一鍵輕鬆取消訂閱。

examples.en: Complying with email privacy laws requires providing a simple, one-click mechanism to unsubscribe.
examples.zh: 嚴格遵循國際電子郵件個資與反垃圾郵件法規，必須向所有收件人提供簡易直觀的一鍵退訂機制。

examples.en: She decided to unsubscribe from commercial retail newsletters after her inbox became overwhelmed.
examples.zh: 在個人電子郵箱被成堆鋪天蓋地的促銷廣告信徹底淹沒後，她毅然決定將所有電商廣告信一律取消訂閱。

explains.en: If a newsletter arrives too often, click the link at the bottom to stop receiving it. You can sign up again later.
A reader no longer wants promotional messages from a store. They use the email option to remove their address from the list.
This action ends future messages from a mailing list. The sender should stop sending those emails.

examples.en: Understanding the customer journey from discovery to purchase drives sales.
examples.zh: 深刻理解消費者從認知發現到最終下單的顧客歷程是帶動業績的關鍵。

examples.en: UX researchers mapped the complete customer journey to eliminate friction during account onboarding.
examples.zh: 使用者體驗研究員深入繪製了完整的顧客旅程地圖，以全力消除新用戶註冊開戶時的一切卡關阻力。

examples.en: Every step in the omnichannel customer journey should offer a seamless, consistent brand experience.
examples.zh: 在全通路消費旅程中的每一個關鍵互動接觸點，品牌都應當為消費者提供無縫銜接且一致的尊榮體驗。

entries.definition: 顧客旅程；消費者決策歷程

explains.en: A shopper may first hear about a product, compare choices, and then buy it. These steps form a path.
Researchers study what a person experiences from discovering a store to finishing a purchase. They try to remove confusing parts.
A company should make every step easy, whether online or in a shop. This term describes the buyer's experience over time.

examples.en: Excellent loyalty reward programs improve long-term user retention.
examples.zh: 優質厚道且吸引人的會員集點回饋制度能顯著拉高長期的用戶留存率。

examples.en: In SaaS businesses, customer retention is often far more profitable than continuously chasing new acquisitions.
examples.zh: 在訂閱制 SaaS 雲端軟體商模中，悉心做好既有顧客留存往往遠比無休止耗費巨資拓客更加獲利豐厚。

examples.en: The mobile game introduced weekly community events to boost 30-day player retention rates.
examples.zh: 這款熱門手機遊戲每週定期舉辦限時社群挑戰活動，成功大幅提振了三十天的玩家長期留存率。

examples.en: Fast-paced editing and dynamic B-roll maintain high audience retention.
examples.zh: 明快的剪輯節奏搭配豐富多變的輔助畫面（B-roll）能全程維持極高的觀眾續看留存率。

examples.en: The company introduced better staff benefits to improve employee retention rates.
examples.zh: 公司推出了更優渥的員工福利，以提高優秀人才的員工留任率。

examples.en: Good study habits promote long-term retention of complex academic material.
examples.zh: 良好的讀書習慣有助於長久記憶與牢固掌握複雜的學術知識。

examples.en: Urban flood retention basins store excess stormwater runoff during typhoons, preventing city street inundation.
examples.zh: 闢建於都會區的多功能生態滯洪池（Retention Basin），在颱風天能蓄積暴雨逕流以防市區淹水。

examples.en: Offering competitive salaries, comprehensive healthcare, and flexible hours boosts employee retention in hospitals.
examples.zh: 提供具競爭力的薪資福利、完善醫療保障與彈性排班機制，能極為顯著提升大型區域醫院的護理師留任率。

examples.en: Regular review quizzes improve long-term memory retention of foreign language vocabulary among middle schoolers.
examples.zh: 定期進行間隔式自我小測驗，能顯著強化國高中生在學習第二外語單字時的長期大腦記憶保留效果。

entries.definition: 顧客留存；客戶維繫；保留；觀眾續看留存率；記憶力；滯洪池蓄洪池

explains.en: This is the ability to keep people, customers, or information over time. A company may improve it by offering good service. Quizzes can help students remember what they learn.
A business wants customers to stay instead of leaving for another service. Schools want lessons to remain in students' memory. The word describes keeping or holding on to something.
Use this noun for continuing to have employees, users, or knowledge. Better benefits may help a hospital keep its workers. Review can help with memory.

examples.en: The streaming service reduced monthly subscriber churn rate through fresh content.
examples.zh: 影音串流平台透過持續推出原創精彩節目，成功壓低了每月訂戶流失率。

examples.en: A sudden spike in churn rate signaled that the latest software update contained frustrating bugs.
examples.zh: 平台訂閱用戶流失率的無預警陡增，強烈警示著最新發布的軟體更新版本中存在令人崩潰的系統錯誤。

examples.en: Calculating customer churn rate allows businesses to forecast recurring subscription revenue accurately.
examples.zh: 精確精算顧客流失率指標，能讓企業高層科學且嚴謹地預測未來各季度的循環經常性訂閱營收走向。

explains.en: It is the share of customers who stop using a service during a period. Fresh shows may help a streaming company keep subscribers. Businesses track this loss.
A sudden rise can mean customers are unhappy with a new update. Companies compare the number over weeks or months. Keeping users can support steady income.
This measure shows how many subscribers leave a service. Helpful support and new features may reduce it. It is common for subscription businesses.

examples.en: High customer lifetime value justifies investing more in initial onboarding.
examples.zh: 較高的顧客終身價值（LTV）證明了在前置引導體驗上投入資源是值得的。

examples.en: Offering relevant product upgrades increases customer lifetime value significantly over the years.
examples.zh: 持續為既有客戶量身推薦切題的高階升級方案，能在數年時間內顯著成倍擴增客戶的終身商業價值。

examples.en: To build a sustainable subscription business, customer lifetime value must comfortably exceed acquisition cost.
examples.zh: 若想打造一門長治久安的訂閱制企業，顧客終身價值（LTV）必須遠遠大幅超越前期的獲客成本（CAC）。

explains.en: A shop estimates how much one customer may spend over many years. This helps it decide how much to spend on customer service.
A subscriber pays a small amount each month for a long time. The business calculates the total value of that relationship.
Companies look at expected purchases from the time someone first buys until they stop. The estimate helps guide plans.

examples.en: We ran A/B testing on two checkout button colors to see which converted better.
examples.zh: 我們針對兩種結帳按鈕顏色進行 A/B 測試，以數據實證何者成效更佳。

examples.en: The product growth team used A/B testing to compare user sign-up rates across two landing page headlines.
examples.zh: 產品成長團隊善用 A/B 測試實驗，嚴密對比兩組不同登陸頁主標題文案對新用戶註冊率的真實影響。

examples.en: Rigorous A/B testing eliminates guesswork by relying on statistically significant behavioral data.
examples.zh: 嚴謹的 A/B 雙盲對照測試以具備統計顯著性的真實行為大數據說話，徹底終結了主觀瞎猜的決策模式。

explains.en: A team compares two versions of a page to see which one works better. One might have a blue button and one an orange one.
A company can show two headlines to different groups of people. It then checks which leads to more sign-ups.
This experiment uses two choices and measures people's responses. The results help a team make decisions using evidence.

examples.en: Developing a detailed user persona aligns product design with user needs.
examples.zh: 建立清晰具體的人物誌畫像能讓產品功能設計與使用者真實需求無縫對齊。

examples.en: The team created a user persona named 'Commuter Kevin' to represent busy professionals using transit apps.
examples.zh: 產品企劃團隊精準塑造了一個名為「通勤族凱文」的目標人物誌，生動代言依賴交通 App 的上班族。

examples.en: Referencing the target user persona prevents engineers from building features nobody actually wants.
examples.zh: 在產品研發週期中隨時回溯對照目標用戶畫像，能堅決防止工程團隊閉門造車開發出無人問津的雞肋功能。

entries.definition: 用戶人物誌；目標受眾畫像

explains.en: This is a made-up profile that represents a typical customer or user. A design team may give the profile a name and daily habits. It helps them make useful products.
Before building an app, a team describes a person who might use it. This profile keeps real needs in mind. It can stop designers from adding unwanted features.
Use this design tool to imagine a target user with goals and challenges. A team can refer to the profile while planning. It helps decisions fit the intended audience.

examples.en: Tech companies heavily invest in protecting valuable intellectual property (IP).
examples.zh: 科技大廠投入巨資以全面捍衛其珍貴的核心智慧財產權（IP）。

examples.en: The university established a technology transfer office to commercialize academic intellectual property.
examples.zh: 這所大學設立了技術移轉產學合作辦公室，以積極將學術智慧財產轉化為商業價值。

examples.en: Stealing corporate intellectual property can lead to devastating criminal charges and civil damages.
examples.zh: 惡意竊取企業核心智慧財產，恐將招致毀滅性的刑事罪名起訴與巨額民事損害賠償。

explains.en: It is a creation of the mind that the law may protect, such as an invention, song, or logo. Owners can control how it is used. Copying without permission can be illegal.
A company may protect its designs, software, and brand names. Universities can help researchers bring inventions to market. These rights support creators.
This legal category covers creative works and inventions. A writer owns a book's text, while a company may own a product design. Rules differ by country.

examples.en: The secret milk tea recipe is protected as a strictly confidential trade secret.
examples.zh: 該獨門奶茶調配配方被列為嚴格保密的營業秘密予以周密保護。

examples.en: Departing engineers are reminded that taking proprietary source code violates trade secret laws.
examples.zh: 人事部門再三提醒即將離職的工程師，私自攜帶公司專屬原始碼將觸犯營業秘密保護法。

examples.en: Coca-Cola's legendary beverage formula is perhaps the world's most famously guarded trade secret.
examples.zh: 可口可樂流傳百年的傳奇飲料原汁配方，堪稱全世界保密最為嚴密且最負盛名的營業秘密。

explains.en: A bakery keeps its special spice mixture private so other shops cannot copy it. The recipe gives the business an advantage.
A company protects a process that helps it make a unique product. Only a few workers may know the details.
A recipe, formula, or method may be kept confidential by a business. It helps the business stand out from competitors.

examples.en: Unauthorized music downloads constitute copyright infringement.
examples.zh: 未經合法授權任意下載商業音樂檔案已構成嚴重的著作權侵權違法。

examples.en: The electronics maker was ordered to pay twenty million dollars for willful patent infringement.
examples.zh: 這家電器製造商因被法院認定蓄意惡意侵害他人專利，被判決須連帶賠償兩千萬美元。

examples.en: Using famous cartoon characters on product packaging without permission is trademark infringement.
examples.zh: 未經原廠書面授權便私自將知名動漫卡通角色印在商品包裝盒上，已屬嚴重的商標侵權。

explains.en: Using someone's song or picture without permission can break a legal right. This act may lead to a fine.
A company may use another person's invention without approval. This can violate a patent.
Putting a famous cartoon character on a product without permission may break the creator's rights. The law protects such work.

examples.en: Copying source code directly may infringe upon third-party copyrights.
examples.zh: 直接複製貼上開源軟體原始碼可能會侵害第三方的軟體著作權。

examples.en: The new smartphone design was carefully reviewed to ensure it does not infringe on existing patents.
examples.zh: 這款新推出的智慧型旗艦手機外觀經過律師嚴密審查，確保其絕未侵犯同業現存的設計專利。

examples.en: Citizens protested that the excessive surveillance cameras infringe upon their constitutional right to privacy.
examples.zh: 廣大市民群起上街抗議，質疑街頭廣設過密的人臉辨識監視器恐將嚴重侵犯憲法賦予人民的隱私權。

explains.en: You do this when you break a rule or interfere with someone else's rights. Copying another person's code may cause a legal problem. Using a camera too freely can affect privacy.
A company may be accused of using an invention without permission. People may also object when surveillance interferes with personal rights. The verb means to violate or encroach.
Use this word when an action crosses a legal or personal boundary. A design must not violate an existing patent. Excessive cameras may violate privacy.

examples.en: Customs officers confiscated thousands of counterfeit luxury leather handbags.
examples.zh: 海關查驗官員當場查扣了數千件企圖闖關的仿冒名牌精品皮包。

examples.en: Modern banknotes incorporate sophisticated holographic watermarks to deter counterfeit money.
examples.zh: 現代中央銀行發行的各國紙幣均融入了極其精密的雷射防偽水印技術，以嚴密防範偽造假鈔。

examples.en: Selling counterfeit prescription medicine online is a dangerous crime that jeopardizes human life.
examples.zh: 在網路上兜售假冒的處方劣藥屬於嚴重危害他人生命安全的重特大犯罪行為。

explains.en: It describes a fake product or document made to look real. A copied handbag may be seized by customs officers. Selling false medicine can be dangerous.
Someone may produce imitation money or goods and pass them off as genuine. Holograms and watermarks help protect banknotes. Buying such products may support crime.
Use this adjective for something made to deceive people about its true origin. Fake luxury bags are one example. The verb means to make such a copy.

examples.en: Digital piracy undermines the livelihood of musicians, authors, and artists.
examples.zh: 數位網路盜版猖獗嚴重損害了音樂人、作家與藝術家的正當生計。

examples.en: The film studio implemented robust encryption software to combat online video piracy.
examples.zh: 電影製片大廠導入了強悍嚴密的水印加密軟體技術，以全力打擊猖獗的網路影音盜版行為。

examples.en: Armed international naval patrols protect commercial cargo ships against maritime piracy in the gulf.
examples.zh: 各國海軍荷槍實彈的聯合巡邏艦隊在海灣水域嚴密巡弋，全力護衛商用貨輪免遭海上武裝海盜洗劫。

explains.en: Copying a movie or song without permission can hurt the people who made it. Sharing illegal copies is a form of this behavior.
Long ago, armed sea robbers attacked ships and stole cargo. The word also describes unauthorized copying of creative work.
A person downloads a paid game from an unlawful copy site. This harms the creators and may break local law.

examples.en: Quoting a brief passage for academic educational review falls under fair use.
examples.zh: 為了學術教育評論目的節錄引用簡短文章段落符合合理使用原則。

examples.en: The documentary filmmaker relied on fair use principles to include short archival news clips.
examples.zh: 紀錄片導演依據著作權法的合理使用原則，在影片中穿插引用了幾段珍貴的歷史新聞檔案片段。

examples.en: Claiming fair use does not automatically protect you if you reproduce an entire artistic illustration.
examples.zh: 若您未經許可便將他人的完整藝術插畫全文全圖轉載，主張合理使用原則往往無法在法庭上站得住腳。

entries.definition: 合理使用原則（著作權法）

explains.en: Copyright rules may allow a short quote for teaching or review. The amount and reason matter.
A filmmaker may include a small part of a news clip in a documentary. Using a whole artwork may not be allowed.
This legal idea permits limited use of protected work in certain cases. It does not automatically allow copying everything.

examples.en: Works by classical authors entered the public domain and can be freely used.
examples.zh: 古典古代作家的傳世著作已進入公有領域，大眾皆可自由免費用於創作。

examples.en: Once the seventy-year copyright protection term expires, creative works enter the public domain.
examples.zh: 一旦創作者逝世後七十年的著作權法定保護年限屆滿，原創作品即正式回歸進入公共領域。

examples.en: The game developer utilized public domain orchestral recordings for the background soundtrack.
examples.zh: 這家獨立遊戲開發團隊在自製遊戲的背景配樂中，大量運用了已進入公共領域的古典交響樂錄音。

explains.en: This describes creative work that people can use freely because copyright no longer applies or never did. Old recordings may be included. A game maker can use them without asking permission.
When legal protection ends, a book or piece of music may enter this category. People can copy or adapt it. Rules can vary by country.
Use this term for works that are free for anyone to use. It can include classical writing or music. A creator may use such material in a new project.

examples.en: Read the software license agreement before installing the computer program.
examples.zh: 在電腦安裝應用程式前，請務必先詳細閱讀軟體使用授權合約條款。

examples.en: Commercial enterprises must purchase a multi-seat license agreement to deploy the software legally.
examples.zh: 商業公司行號必須依規定採購多用戶數的企業授權協議，方能在內部電腦上合法部署該專業軟體。

examples.en: The patent license agreement grants the overseas factory exclusive manufacturing rights for five years.
examples.zh: 這份專利技術授權合約正式賦予該海外代工廠長達五年的獨家特定產品製造代理權。

entries.definition: 授權協議；軟體使用授權合約

explains.en: It is a contract that gives permission to use software, a patent, or another protected work. Read it before installing a program. It may limit how many devices can use it.
A company may buy the right to use a creator's invention. The contract explains what is allowed and for how long. Both sides must follow its terms.
This legal document sets rules for using a product or idea owned by someone else. A factory may receive permission to make a patented item. Check the conditions carefully.

examples.en: Sign an NDA before reviewing the confidential project architecture plans.
examples.zh: 在查閱這份高度機密的專案系統架構圖之前，雙方必須先簽署保密協定。

examples.en: Both corporate parties signed a mutual NDA to ensure trade secrets remain strictly confidential during talks.
examples.zh: 雙方企業代表在正式展開策略結盟洽談前簽署了雙向互惠 NDA，確保所有商業機密絕不外流。

examples.en: Leaking prototype product specifications violates the legally binding NDA you signed upon joining the company.
examples.zh: 私自外洩未公開原型機的規格參數，已直接違反了您在入職報到當天所親筆簽署的法定保密協議。

explains.en: Before discussing a private project, two people may sign a document promising not to share its details. It protects confidential information.
A new worker agrees to keep a company’s plans private. The written agreement explains that duty.
Businesses may ask partners to sign this kind of agreement before revealing a secret recipe or design. The promise helps keep details private.

examples.en: Employees must uphold strict confidentiality regarding customer personal data.
examples.zh: 全體員工皆必須恪遵嚴格的保密義務，絕不外洩任何客戶個人隱私資料。

examples.en: Doctors and psychologists are bound by medical ethics to maintain absolute patient confidentiality.
examples.zh: 執業主治醫師與臨床心理諮商師受制於崇高醫療倫理規範，負有維繫病患病情絕對隱私與保密責任。

examples.en: Breaching client confidentiality can result in immediate termination of employment and legal sanctions.
examples.zh: 嚴重背棄與外洩客戶委託機密資料者，將面臨立即遭到公司開除解雇以及隨之而來的司法嚴厲制裁。

examples.en: Doctors uphold strict patient medical record confidentiality under the law.
examples.zh: 全體醫護從業人員依法恪守崇高的希波克拉底誓詞，嚴格保護病患病歷隱私與保密義務。

examples.en: A breach of medical confidentiality can result in severe legal penalties and license revocation.
examples.zh: 任何非法洩漏或擅自窺探病患個人醫療病歷隱私的違法行為，皆會面臨巨額罰金與吊銷執照。

examples.en: All personal health details are handled with the highest level of professional confidentiality.
examples.zh: 醫療院所對於病患所有的個人健康病況資料與體檢數據，皆採取最高規格的保密機制安全防護。

entries.definition: 機密性；保密義務；醫療保密義務

explains.en: A doctor must keep a patient's private health details secret. This duty protects personal information.
An employee may be required to guard customer records. Sharing them without permission can have serious results.
People trust a counselor with private feelings. This principle means keeping shared information from others.

examples.en: Check the box to agree to the platform's terms and conditions.
examples.zh: 請勾選方框以表示您已閱讀並完全同意該平台的使用者服務條款。

examples.en: Users rarely read the lengthy terms and conditions before downloading modern smartphone apps.
examples.zh: 絕大多數使用者在下載安裝智慧手機 App 之前，極少有耐心完整逐字閱讀那些冗長的使用條款。

examples.en: The bank revised its credit card terms and conditions to clarify overseas transaction fees.
examples.zh: 發卡銀行全面修訂了信用卡會員權益使用條款細則，進一步釐清海外跨國刷卡手續費的計費標準。

explains.en: These are the rules a person agrees to follow when using an app, bank card, or service. They may explain fees and responsibilities. Read them before checking the agreement box.
A company writes these rules to explain how its service works. A bank may update them to clarify charges. Users often see them before signing up.
This phrase names the conditions for using a product or service. It may cover payments, privacy, or account rules. A user accepts them before continuing.

examples.en: The updated privacy policy explains how user cookie tracking data is utilized.
examples.zh: 最新修訂的隱私權政策清楚說明了網站將如何妥善運用使用者 Cookie。

examples.en: Global data protection laws mandate that every website display an easily accessible privacy policy.
examples.zh: 國際個資保護法規明文要求，任何商業營利網站都必須在首頁顯著版位提供直觀易閱的隱私權政策。

examples.en: Parents should review the privacy policy before allowing their young children to play online games.
examples.zh: 家長在允許年幼孩童註冊遊玩連線線上遊戲之前，應當審慎檢閱該遊戲平台所公告的個人隱私保護政策。

explains.en: It is a website document explaining what personal information is collected and how it is used. Parents should read it before a child joins a game. Laws may require it.
An online service describes how it handles cookies and user data in this document. People can learn what information is shared. It should be easy to find.
This statement tells users how a company protects or uses their personal details. Review it before creating an account. It may explain data storage and sharing.

examples.en: Failing to deliver goods on the agreed date constitutes a contract breach.
examples.zh: 未能在約定期限內如期交付商品已構成了實質上的違約行為。

examples.en: A catastrophic data breach exposed the private passwords of over ten million online accounts.
examples.zh: 一起災難性的重大資料外洩資安事件，導致超過一千萬筆線上註冊帳戶的私密密碼慘遭公開洩露。

examples.en: The military commander was court-martialed for committing a serious breach of official discipline.
examples.zh: 該名軍事指揮官因涉嫌嚴重違反軍隊內部保密與操守軍紀，隨即被移送軍法機關依法接受軍法審判。

explains.en: A company fails to follow an agreed promise to deliver goods on time. This is a failure to meet the contract.
A hacker enters a computer system and exposes private files. This can put users’ information at risk.
A soldier breaks an important rule or an organization fails to keep private data safe. The word can mean a break or violation.

examples.en: Either party may terminate the lease by giving a thirty-day advance written notice.
examples.zh: 租賃雙方任一方均可於三十天前以書面通知對方提前解除租約。

examples.en: The company decided to terminate the problematic distributor's exclusive sales contract.
examples.zh: 鑑於該經銷商履約狀況頻出且信譽堪憂，該公司最終毅然決定提前終止其獨家經銷總代理合約。

examples.en: The contractor's failure to meet safety standards prompted the government to terminate the project immediately.
examples.zh: 承包營造商多次未能通過關鍵公共安全檢測，促使主管機關當機立斷、立即依法終止了該工程專案。

explains.en: A person may end a rental agreement by giving notice. This formal word means to bring something to an end.
A company can stop a contract if a partner does not follow safety rules. This is a formal ending.
An organization may decide that a project should stop. The word is often used in official situations.

examples.en: If signed under fraud or threat, the signed agreement is declared null and void.
examples.zh: 若是在遭受詐欺或脅迫下所簽署的協議，依法宣告自始無效。

examples.en: The judge ruled that the disputed testamentary will was null and void due to lack of witnesses.
examples.zh: 承審法官認定該份引起家族遺產紛爭的自書遺囑因欠缺合法見證人簽名，依法裁定自始完全無效。

examples.en: Altering numbers on a certified bank check without authorization makes the instrument null and void.
examples.zh: 未經授權擅自塗改受銀行認證支票上的受款金額數字，將直接導致該張法定票據瞬間作廢且毫無效力。

explains.en: This describes an agreement or document that has no legal effect. A judge may decide it does not count because a rule was broken. It cannot be enforced.
If a contract was signed through fraud or threat, it may be treated as invalid. A missing witness can also affect a will. The phrase means it has no force.
Use these words when a document or agreement is legally invalid. It no longer creates rights or duties. A court may make this decision.

examples.en: Both electronic signatures and handwritten seals create legally binding agreements.
examples.zh: 不論是數位電子簽章還是實體印鑑用印，皆能產生具法律約束力的契約。

examples.en: Although verbal agreements can be considered legally binding, proving their exact terms in court is notoriously difficult.
examples.zh: 儘管口頭承諾在法律上亦可能被認定具備法律拘束力，但在法庭上舉證其確切條款內容卻極度困難。

examples.en: Once ratified by parliament, international climate treaties become legally binding national commitments.
examples.zh: 跨國氣候公約一旦獲得國會議會正式三讀批准生效，即成為該國依法必須履行且具法律效力的承諾。

explains.en: It describes an agreement that the law requires people to follow. A signed contract may have this force. Courts can enforce its terms.
When a deal has legal force, both sides must meet its conditions. Verbal promises can sometimes count too. Proving the details may be hard.
A treaty or contract with this status creates duties under the law. Once approved, a government may need to carry it out. The phrase means enforceable by law.

examples.en: The plaintiff presented solid written evidence to support their claim.
examples.zh: 原告律師向法庭呈交了確鑿詳實的書面物證以佐證其主張。

examples.en: The burden of proof in civil lawsuits typically rests upon the plaintiff.
examples.zh: 在一般的民事侵權賠償訴訟中，基本的舉證法律責任通常依法由提告的原告一方負擔。

examples.en: After hearing arguments from both sides, the jury awarded substantial monetary compensation to the injured plaintiff.
examples.zh: 在詳細聆聽雙方法律攻防答辯後，民事陪審團做出了裁定被告須向受害原告支付巨額損害賠償金的決定。

explains.en: In a civil court case, this person says someone else caused harm and asks a judge for help. Both sides can present their accounts.
A person brings a claim to court after an injury. The other person responds to the claim.
When a dispute goes before a civil court, the person who starts the case is called this. A judge hears the arguments.

examples.en: The public prosecutor indicted the suspects on charges of financial fraud.
examples.zh: 地檢署檢察官依涉犯重大金融詐欺取財罪嫌將全案被告提起公訴。

examples.en: The district prosecutor called several key forensic witnesses to the stand to testify.
examples.zh: 地檢署承辦公訴檢察官在法庭上傳喚了數名關鍵法醫鑑識專家輪流出庭具結作證。

examples.en: Prosecutors must prove guilt beyond a reasonable doubt to secure a criminal conviction.
examples.zh: 刑事檢察官肩負舉證責任，必須提出毫無合理懷疑的確鑿鐵證，方能在法庭上成功定罪被告。

explains.en: This lawyer presents a case against someone accused of a crime. The lawyer must show evidence in court.
A public lawyer may call witnesses to speak before a judge. The goal is to prove that a crime happened.
In a criminal trial, this legal worker represents the government. The accused person's lawyer speaks for the defense.

examples.en: The legislative committee scheduled a public hearing on AI safety regulations.
examples.zh: 立法委員會安排召開了一場關於人工智慧安全法規的公聽會聽證會。

examples.en: The judge scheduled a bail hearing for tomorrow morning to decide whether the suspect can be released.
examples.zh: 承審法官裁定於明晨九時準時召開保釋審查庭，以審慎研議評估是否准予涉案重大嫌疑人交保候傳。

examples.en: Regular medical audiometry tests help detect early signs of occupational hearing loss in noisy factories.
examples.zh: 定期接受醫院耳鼻喉科專業聽力檢測，有助於早期察覺並防範在吵雜高噪音工廠環境中的職業性聽力受損。

explains.en: This is an official meeting where a court or committee listens to information and arguments. A judge may decide whether someone can be released. A medical check can also test how well a person hears.
A public group may meet to discuss a safety rule. A court can hold one before making a decision. Doctors also test people's ability to hear sounds.
Use this noun for a formal session to listen to a case or issue. It can also mean the sense that lets people notice sound. Context shows the meaning.

examples.en: The expert witness's forensic testimony proved crucial to the judge's decision.
examples.zh: 鑑識鑑識專家的專業證詞對承審法官的最終判決發揮了關鍵影響。

examples.en: The victim delivered a deeply emotional testimony recounting the traumatic home invasion robbery.
examples.zh: 受害當事人在法庭上發表了真情流露且令人動容的親身證詞，字字血淚回憶那場驚悚的入室搶劫。

examples.en: The dramatic turnaround of the struggling brand stands as a shining testimony to the team's resilience.
examples.zh: 這家一度瀕臨破產的老字號品牌成功浴火重生的大逆轉，正是團隊堅韌不拔精神的最佳有力見證。

examples.en: The DNA analyst delivered compelling expert witness testimony explaining probability statistics to jurors.
examples.zh: 資深 DNA 分析官在法庭上發表深具說服力的專家證人證詞，向陪審員詳盡解說統計機率。

examples.en: Eyewitness testimony can sometimes be unreliable due to extreme stress and distorted perception during trauma.
examples.zh: 目擊證人的當庭證詞有時會因事發當下承受極大心理創傷與知覺扭曲，而出現不可靠的指認誤差。

examples.en: The pathologist's direct testimony clarified that the injuries could only have been caused by heavy machinery.
examples.zh: 法醫病理學專家在證人席上的堅定證言，向法庭清楚闡明死者傷勢絕非摔傷、唯有重型機具撞擊方能造成。

entries.definition: 證詞；口供；見證；鑑識專家證人出庭法庭專業證詞

explains.en: It is a statement given by a witness, often in court. An expert may explain evidence. A person's account can help a judge decide a case.
Someone who saw an event may describe it under oath. A victim can share what happened. The word can also mean evidence of a quality.
In court, a witness answers questions about what they know. This formal statement can influence a decision. A team's success may also be described as proof of hard work.

examples.en: Civic education empowers citizens to actively protect their democratic civil rights.
examples.zh: 公民教育賦予人民積極站出來捍衛自身民主公民權利的能力與自覺。

examples.en: Leaders like Martin Luther King Jr. fought tirelessly to secure equal civil rights for all citizens.
examples.zh: 如馬丁·路德·金恩等偉大民權領袖，傾盡畢生心血日夜奮戰，只為替全體人民爭取平等的公民權利。

examples.en: Discriminating against job applicants based on gender or race directly violates basic civil rights statutes.
examples.zh: 在求職招聘審查中基於性別、年齡或種族身分對求職者進行不公正差別待遇，公然踐踏了基本公民權益保障法。

explains.en: People should have equal treatment and basic freedoms under the law. These protections include being treated fairly.
Leaders have worked so people of different backgrounds can vote, learn, and use public services equally. These are basic citizen protections.
A person should not be denied fair treatment because of their race or gender. The phrase names freedoms and protections held by citizens.

examples.en: Respecting human rights and dignity is the cornerstone of democratic society.
examples.zh: 尊重基本人權與人性尊嚴是健全民主法治社會不可動搖的基石。

examples.en: International organizations send human rights observers to inspect conditions in foreign refugee camps.
examples.zh: 聯合國等國際人權組織常年指派獨立人權觀察員，親赴戰亂海外難民營實地嚴密稽查人道生活處境。

examples.en: Ensuring access to clean drinking water, education, and healthcare is a fundamental human rights objective.
examples.zh: 確保偏鄉與邊緣弱勢群體享有純淨飲用水、基礎義務教育以及健全醫療照護，是普世基本人權的核心目標。

explains.en: Every person deserves safety, education, and clean water. These basic protections belong to all people.
Observers may visit a camp to check how people are treated. This idea includes dignity and fair treatment.
A community should respect people's freedom and access to care. These protections are considered important for everyone.

examples.en: Freedom of speech allows citizens to express diverse opinions without fear.
examples.zh: 言論自由保障全體人民在無所畏懼的環境下自由抒發多元觀點。

examples.en: While the constitution protects freedom of speech, it does not protect hate speech that incites violence.
examples.zh: 儘管國家憲法最高原則誓死捍衛全民言論自由，但此項自由絕不涵蓋煽動實體暴力與仇恨言論的違法行徑。

examples.en: Independent journalists rely on robust protections for freedom of speech to expose government corruption.
examples.zh: 秉持良知的獨立調查記者仰賴國家法律對言論自由的堅固保護，方能無所畏懼地深度揭露官商勾結貪腐弊案。

explains.en: This is the right to share opinions and ideas without unfair punishment. Journalists rely on it to report on leaders. It does not allow someone to encourage violence without limits.
Citizens may express different views under this principle. A constitution can protect it. The right has limits when words directly cause harm.
Use this phrase for the liberty to speak, write, or share ideas. It helps people discuss public issues. Laws may set boundaries to protect others.

examples.en: Starlux Airlines and EVA Air are world-class international airline carriers.
examples.zh: 星宇航空與長榮航空皆為享譽國際的世界級頂尖航空公司。

examples.en: The regional airline carrier expanded its flight network to include direct routes to Southeast Asia.
examples.zh: 這家區域型航空公司積極拓展其航網版圖，增設了多條直飛東南亞熱門旅遊城市的新航線。

examples.en: Passengers can compare ticket prices across multiple airline carriers using travel booking platforms.
examples.zh: 旅客可透過旅遊機票比價平台，輕鬆橫向比對數家不同航空載運業者所開出的各項票價優惠。

entries.definition: 航空公司；空運載運業者

explains.en: It is a company that transports passengers by plane. Travelers compare ticket prices among different companies. A regional firm may add new routes.
People book flights with this business to travel between cities or countries. It operates airplanes and schedules trips. Some serve only a small region.
This company carries passengers through the air. It may offer direct flights to other countries. Customers can compare fares online.

examples.en: Tigerair Taiwan is a popular low-cost carrier (LCC) for weekend trips to Japan.
examples.zh: 台灣虎航是國人前往日本進行週末輕旅行時最喜愛搭乘的平價廉航。

examples.en: Low-cost carriers keep base airfares cheap by charging extra for checked baggage and seat selection.
examples.zh: 低成本廉航透過將託運行李額度與預選座位改為額外使用者付費，進而壓低基礎機票價格。

examples.en: Many backpackers prefer flying with low-cost carriers to save money for destination accommodations.
examples.zh: 許多精打細算的年輕背包客偏好選搭廉價航空，將省下的機票旅費撥充至當地的特色住宿體驗。

explains.en: This airline offers lower base fares and may charge extra for checked bags or choosing a seat. Compare the total cost before booking.
Travelers can save money on a flight by bringing only a small bag. Optional services may cost extra.
The company keeps ticket prices low by offering fewer included services. It is an airline model used by many travelers.

examples.en: Passengers are strictly prohibited from entering the secure aircraft cockpit.
examples.zh: 一般乘客一律被嚴格禁止擅自進入具高安防級別的飛機駕駛艙。

examples.en: The cockpit is equipped with an array of complex digital instruments and navigation screens.
examples.zh: 現代客機駕駛艙內密集配備了一整套令人眼花繚亂的高科技數位儀表與衛星導航顯示螢幕。

examples.en: Aviation investigators recovered the cockpit voice recorder to determine the cause of the emergency descent.
examples.zh: 空難事故調查官在殘骸中尋獲了黑盒子座艙語音記錄器，以深入釐清客機突發緊急迫降的真實肇因。

examples.en: Dual pilots run thorough pre-flight instrument diagnostic checklists inside the cockpit.
examples.zh: 兩位正副駕駛在機長駕駛艙內嚴謹逐一執行起飛前各項航電儀表與氣象雷達自我診斷。

examples.en: High-security armored doors prevent unauthorized entry into the aircraft cockpit during flight.
examples.zh: 飛機駕駛艙配備了高防禦強度的防彈裝甲門鎖，嚴防飛行途中任何未經授權人員擅入駕駛艙。

examples.en: Modern glass cockpit designs replace mechanical dials with intuitive multi-function displays.
examples.zh: 現代新世代客機普遍採用一體化玻璃駕駛艙設計，以高畫質液晶觸控螢幕取代了繁複的傳統機械指針。

examples.en: The minimalist digital cockpit features dual 15-inch touchscreens and voice-controlled AI assistants.
examples.zh: 極簡科技感十足的數位座艙（Digital Cockpit）配備了雙十五吋超大觸控螢幕與聲控 AI 語音助理。

examples.en: Captain and first officer performed mandatory pre-flight instrument checks inside the airliner's cockpit.
examples.zh: 民航機正副機長在飛機封閉駕駛艙內，按部就班執行起飛前各項儀表開關與航電系統確認清單。

examples.en: Ergonomic cockpit seating with ventilation and massage functions relieves fatigue during cross-island journeys.
examples.zh: 人體工學高包覆性數位座艙座椅內建通風加熱與多點按摩功能，大幅舒緩長途縱貫全島行車疲勞。

entries.definition: 駕駛艙；機長座艙；機長駕駛艙；座艙；數位座艙

explains.en: Pilots sit in this part of an airplane and control the flight. It has instruments and screens.
Only the flight crew may enter this secure area. They check the controls before takeoff.
An investigator may listen to recordings from this part of a plane after an emergency. It is where pilots work.

examples.en: Families traveling with small infants enjoy early priority boarding.
examples.zh: 攜帶幼童嬰兒出遊同行的家庭旅客享有提前登機的優先登機權益。

examples.en: Business class travelers and frequent flyer elite members are invited to use priority boarding.
examples.zh: 商務艙尊榮貴賓與各大航空同盟常旅客金卡會員，受邀經由專屬通道享受優先登機服務。

examples.en: Adding priority boarding to your budget ticket guarantees overhead bin space for your carry-on luggage.
examples.zh: 在購買廉航特惠機票時加購優先登機服務，能百分之百確保您隨身登機箱有充裕的頭頂行李箱空間。

explains.en: This lets certain passengers get onto a plane before most others. Families with babies or business travelers may be invited first. Some tickets include it for an extra fee.
A traveler who buys this option can enter the aircraft earlier than the general group. It may help them find space for a bag. Airlines offer it to some customers.
Use this term for being allowed to board a plane ahead of other passengers. It can be part of a higher-priced ticket. It makes boarding more convenient.

examples.en: Place your roller carry-on suitcase wheels-first into the overhead bin.
examples.zh: 請將您的登機滾輪行李箱以「滾輪朝內」方向平放進機艙上方行李箱。

examples.en: When the flight is completely full, flight attendants may ask you to check bags if overhead bins are packed.
examples.zh: 當航班客滿且頭頂行李置物櫃全數爆滿時，客艙乘務員可能會協調將旅客行李移交免費託運。

examples.en: Be careful when opening the overhead bin after landing, as heavy items might have shifted during flight.
examples.zh: 班機順利著陸開啟頭頂行李置物櫃時請務必格外小心，以免飛行途中位移的重物意外滑落砸傷。

explains.en: It is a storage compartment above passenger seats on an airplane. Travelers place small bags inside. Open it carefully after landing because items may shift.
A cabin has these lockers over the rows of seats. A flight attendant may ask passengers to move bags if they are full. Keep heavy objects secure.
Passengers store carry-on luggage in this space above them. Put the suitcase in wheels first. Make sure it closes before takeoff.

examples.en: Please stow and latch your seatback tray table securely for landing.
examples.zh: 飛機降落準備著陸前，請務必將座椅後方的折疊餐桌收起並扣緊。

examples.en: She lowered her tray table to set down her laptop and get some work done during the flight.
examples.zh: 她輕輕放下座椅前方的折疊小餐桌，將筆記型電腦平穩放好，準備在飛行途中處理緊急公務。

examples.en: Cleaning crews wipe down every individual seatback tray table between passenger turnarounds.
examples.zh: 機艙清潔地勤團隊在班機前後換班接載的短暫空檔內，逐一用酒精仔細擦拭每一張乘客座椅折疊桌。

entries.definition: 飛機折疊餐桌；座椅托盤桌

explains.en: A passenger folds down a small surface from the seat in front to hold a drink or snack. Put it away when the crew asks.
During a flight, a traveler may rest a tablet or meal on this hinged surface. It folds flat against the seat.
Before landing, cabin crew ask everyone to lock this small table upright. It is attached to the back of the seat ahead.

examples.en: Return to your seat and fasten your seatbelt when the warning sign illuminates.
examples.zh: 當機艙上方安全帶指示燈亮起時，請立即回座並扣緊您的安全帶。

examples.en: Even when the sign is turned off, passengers are strongly advised to keep their seatbelts fastened while seated.
examples.zh: 即便安全帶警示燈已熄滅，機長仍強烈建議旅客在座位上休息時全程保持安全帶繫緊。

examples.en: The flight attendant walked down the aisle ensuring all passengers had fastened their seatbelts properly.
examples.zh: 空服員緩步穿梭在走道兩側，逐一嚴格確認每位旅客腹部的安全帶皆已牢固扣緊並鎖上。

explains.en: When an airplane sign lights up, connect the belt across your lap. Keep it closed while seated.
A flight attendant may ask passengers to secure the safety strap before takeoff. It should fit snugly.
Even when the sign is off, it is wise to keep the belt around your waist in a seat. Pull the loose end tight.

examples.en: If cabin pressure drops, pull down the yellow oxygen mask firmly.
examples.zh: 若機艙發生失壓狀況，請將自動落下的黃色氧氣面罩用力往下拉戴上。

examples.en: Always put on your own oxygen mask first before attempting to help children or others.
examples.zh: 在伸出援手協助身旁的年幼孩童或他人前，請務必先將自己的氧氣面罩完全戴妥並正常呼吸。

examples.en: Oxygen masks will automatically deploy from the ceiling compartments in the event of decompression.
examples.zh: 一旦機艙遭遇高空意外減壓失壓，隱藏在天花板暗格內的黃色氧氣面罩將會立即自動彈出垂落。

explains.en: This face covering supplies breathable gas to someone who needs extra help. Airplane passengers may find one above their seat if cabin pressure drops. Put your own on before helping others.
A person can place this over the nose and mouth to breathe more easily. It may automatically drop from an airplane ceiling. It is also used in medical care.
This safety equipment delivers air to a person's face. It can help during an emergency on a flight. Instructions explain how to fit it securely.

examples.en: Your inflatable life vest is located directly underneath your passenger seat.
examples.zh: 您的充氣式專用救生衣就放置在您乘客座椅的正下方夾層內。

examples.en: Remember to inflate your life vest only after exiting the aircraft through the door.
examples.zh: 請牢記安全指引：唯有在完全走出飛機艙門來到機外時，方可拉開拉環將救生衣充氣膨脹。

examples.en: Demonstrating how to whistle and activate the locator light on the life vest is standard safety protocol.
examples.zh: 示範如何吹響高音求救哨子以及啟動救生衣頂端的海水自動定位警示燈，是客艙標準安全示範程序。

explains.en: It is a buoyant garment worn in water to help a person float. Airplanes keep them under passenger seats. Inflate it after leaving the plane.
A person wears this safety item over their clothes in a boat or airplane. It helps keep the head above water. Follow the crew's instructions.
This piece of emergency equipment can help someone stay afloat. It may have a whistle and a small light. Do not inflate it inside an airplane cabin.

examples.en: The Boeing 787 reached a smooth cruising altitude of 36,000 feet.
examples.zh: 波音 787 夢幻客機平穩順利爬升至三萬六千英尺的高空巡航高度。

examples.en: Flying at high cruising altitudes allows passenger jets to consume significantly less aviation fuel.
examples.zh: 在平流層的高空巡航高度飛行，空氣阻力大幅降低，能讓大型噴射客機大幅節省航空燃油消耗。

examples.en: Once the airliner settled into its cruising altitude, the flight crew began meal and drink service.
examples.zh: 一旦民航客機順利進入穩定平穩的萬米巡航高度後，客艙機組人員便隨即展開餐飲推車服務。

explains.en: After takeoff, an airplane climbs to a steady height for the main part of its trip. The pilot may announce it to passengers.
A passenger jet travels high above most weather and terrain once it has climbed. It stays near this height until descent.
The plane reaches a stable level in the sky and continues along its route. Later it begins to descend toward the airport.

examples.en: Passengers enjoyed movies via the personal touch-screen in-flight entertainment system.
examples.zh: 旅客透過個人觸控式機上娛樂系統觀賞最新上映的院線強檔電影。

examples.en: You can purchase high-speed in-flight satellite internet access to send messages during the journey.
examples.zh: 旅客可在高空中付費選購高速機上衛星寬頻網路，於整趟飛行航程中隨時與親友保持通訊。

examples.en: Airlines take great pride in curating authentic Taiwanese delicacies for their long-haul in-flight meals.
examples.zh: 國籍航空公司在長程國際航班的機上飛機餐菜單中精心融入道地台灣經典小吃，深受各國旅客讚賞。

explains.en: Movies or meals offered while an airplane is traveling are available during the trip. This adjective describes them.
