A passenger may use wireless internet in the air. The service is offered while the plane is flying.
Some airlines serve local dishes during a long journey. The food is provided aboard the aircraft.

examples.en: Request dietary special meals like vegan or halal online 24 hours prior.
examples.zh: 如需全素或清真認證等特殊飛機餐，請於起飛二十四小時前線上預訂。

examples.en: Parents ordered child-friendly special meals featuring cartoon-shaped pasta for their toddler.
examples.zh: 貼心的父母特地為隨行的年幼學步兒預訂了印有卡通造型造型通心粉的兒童專屬特殊飛機餐。

examples.en: Diabetic passengers can pre-order low-sodium and sugar-free special meals for long international flights.
examples.zh: 患有糖尿病或慢性病的旅客可在出發前預選低鈉無糖特殊餐點，確保長途國際飛行的飲食健康無虞。

entries.definition: 特殊飛機餐（素食／無麩質／兒童餐）

explains.en: This is food prepared to meet a traveler's dietary needs or preferences. An airline may offer a vegan or low-salt option. It should be requested before the trip.
A passenger who cannot eat certain foods may order a different meal in advance. Children may also receive food they like. The airline prepares it specially.
Use this phrase for a meal made for a particular diet or age group. It may be halal, vegetarian, or sugar-free. Travelers usually choose it when booking.

examples.en: Passengers purchased Taiwanese Kavalan whisky and perfumes duty-free onboard.
examples.zh: 旅客在機艙內以免稅優惠價格選購了台灣噶瑪蘭威士忌與名牌香水。

examples.en: International airports feature luxurious duty-free boutiques selling designer watches and cosmetics.
examples.zh: 現代國際機場航廈廣設奢華免稅精品名店街，薈萃全球頂級名牌手錶與高端美妝保養品。

examples.en: Be sure you do not exceed the statutory duty-free alcohol and tobacco limits when entering the country.
examples.zh: 請務必留意各國入境海關規定，切勿超額攜帶超出免稅法定額度的菸酒免稅商品以免遭罰款沒收。

examples.en: Travelers browse luxury fragrances and Taiwanese pineapple cakes at duty-free shops.
examples.zh: 旅客在登機前悠閒逛著免稅商店，挑選國際奢華香水與台灣在地冠軍鳳梨酥伴手禮。

examples.en: You can buy duty-free spirits and local souvenirs after clearing international departure security.
examples.zh: 順利通過出境安檢查驗後，旅客可以在候機長廊上的免稅精品店購買洋酒名牌包與紀念品。

examples.en: Remember that duty-free items still count toward your arriving destination's customs import limits.
examples.zh: 請注意，在免稅店採買的免稅菸酒與高價精品，入境目的國時依然受到該國入境免稅額度的限制。

explains.en: It describes goods sold without certain taxes or import duties. Travelers may buy perfume at an airport shop. Rules limit how much alcohol can enter a country.
Some airport stores sell products with no customs tax added. Check the local allowance before buying drinks or tobacco. The adjective can also be used as an adverb.
A shopper may purchase goods at an airport without paying certain taxes. These stores are common for international travelers. There are limits on what can be brought home.

examples.en: Fill out the customs declaration form accurately to declare luxury goods.
examples.zh: 誠實且詳盡填寫海關申報單以申報隨身攜帶的高價應稅精品或現金。

examples.en: Travelers carrying more than the legal limit of cash must submit a formal customs declaration.
examples.zh: 旅客隨身攜帶超出法定限額的大額現金或有價證券入境時，必須依法主動向海關提出書面申報。

examples.en: Many international airports have transitioned from paper cards to digital customs declaration kiosks.
examples.zh: 全球眾多現代化國際機場已全面淘汰傳統紙本卡片，改設數位自助海關申報多功能機台。

explains.en: A traveler lists items they are bringing into a country on a paper or digital form. Follow the instructions from border officials.
Some countries ask visitors to report certain goods or large amounts of cash. The information is provided on an official form.
At an airport, a person may need to state what is in their luggage. Answer the questions honestly and check current rules.

examples.en: Travelers submit digital arrival cards on their phones before landing.
examples.zh: 旅客在班機降落前事先於手機上完成數位線上入境申報填寫手續。

examples.en: Flight attendants hand out paper arrival cards to international passengers as the plane approaches its destination.
examples.zh: 在客機即將抵達目的地降落前夕，空服員在走道上為有需要的國際旅客發放紙本入境入國卡。

examples.en: When completing your arrival card, make sure to write your hotel name and local contact number clearly.
examples.zh: 在逐欄填寫外國入境卡時，請務必以清晰工整的英文正楷填妥下榻飯店名稱與當地聯絡電話。

entries.definition: 入境卡；入國紀錄卡 (Visit Japan Web)

explains.en: Travelers may fill out this form before entering a country. It asks for details such as where they will stay.
A flight attendant may hand passengers a paper form before landing. Some places let people complete it online.
Immigration staff use this document to record a visitor's entry. Write the hotel name and local contact clearly.

examples.en: Many travelers enjoy a complimentary two-day city stopover in Singapore.
examples.zh: 許多長途旅客把握機會在新加坡轉機並享受為期兩天的免費城市漫遊。

examples.en: The airline allows one free stopover in Dubai on round-trip tickets between Asia and Europe.
examples.zh: 這家跨國航空公司在歐亞往返機票中，免費贈送旅客一次在杜拜中途停留超過二十四小時的停點權利。

examples.en: We turned our business trip into a mini-vacation by booking a 48-hour stopover in Istanbul.
examples.zh: 我們在伊斯坦堡安排了一次長達四十八小時的深度轉機停留，順道將出差行程變成了充實的微度假。

entries.definition: 中途停留（超過 24 小時之轉機）

explains.en: This is a planned stay in a city during a longer trip before traveling onward. An airline may allow a free visit for a day or two. It can feel like a short vacation.
A traveler may pause in another country before continuing to the final destination. A long pause gives time to explore. It is part of the travel plan.
Use this word for a break in a journey that lasts longer than changing planes. A traveler may stay overnight or several days. They then continue the trip.

examples.en: Go straight to the international transfer desk to print your next boarding pass.
examples.zh: 抵達過境大廳後請直行前往國際轉機服務櫃台領取下一段航程登機證。

examples.en: A long queue formed at the airline transfer desk after several incoming flights arrived late.
examples.zh: 由於數個入境航班因雷雨延誤抵達，機場航空公司的轉機服務專屬櫃台前隨即排起了長長的人龍。

examples.en: The customer service agent at the transfer desk handed out hotel accommodation vouchers for missed connections.
examples.zh: 轉機服務櫃台的地勤人員親切地為因前段班機延誤而錯失接駁班機的旅客發放了過境星級飯店住宿券。

explains.en: It is an airport counter where passengers get help changing to another flight. Staff may print a new boarding pass. Go there if a connection is missed.
Travelers can ask questions about their next plane at this service counter. An agent may give hotel information after a long delay. Queues can form when many flights are late.
After landing, a passenger with another flight may visit this counter. Staff can explain where to go next. They may help with a missed connection.

examples.en: Report forgotten jackets immediately at the airport lost and found office.
examples.zh: 若將保暖外套遺忘在候機室，請立即前往機場失物招領處登記尋找。

examples.en: A good Samaritan returned my lost wallet containing all my credit cards to the railway station's lost and found.
examples.zh: 一名拾金不昧的熱心好心人，親自將我遺落在列車座椅上裝有全部證件與信用卡的皮夾送至車站失物招領處。

examples.en: Items turned into the subway lost and found are held securely for up to six months before auction.
examples.zh: 凡被拾獲繳交至捷運失物招領中心的各類遺失物，均會被妥善封存保管長達六個月直至辦理公告招領。

explains.en: A traveler leaves a jacket at the station and asks staff where forgotten items are kept. The office may record the item.
Someone turns in a wallet they found on a train. Its owner can contact the place that keeps unclaimed belongings.
At a museum, a visitor can ask staff about a missing umbrella. This place collects items people leave behind.

examples.en: Reserving a hybrid SUV from the airport car rental desk was effortless.
examples.zh: 在機場租車櫃台預約一輛油電混合休旅車進行自駕過程輕鬆又便捷。

examples.en: Comparing rates across several car rental companies online saved us substantial money on our road trip.
examples.zh: 出發前在線上對比數家知名跨國汽車租賃公司的各項套票方案，為我們的自駕公路之旅省下了大筆預算。

examples.en: Make sure to inspect the exterior for existing scratches before driving away from the car rental lot.
examples.zh: 在把車輛正式駛離租車中心交車停車場前，請務必先繞車一圈仔細檢查車身既有刮痕並拍照存證。

entries.definition: 租車服務；汽車租賃公司

explains.en: Travelers can pay to use a vehicle for a short time. Compare companies online before booking.
A visitor may pick up a vehicle at an airport desk. Check it for scratches before driving away.
This service lets someone borrow a car for a trip in exchange for money. Some plans include a hybrid vehicle.

examples.en: Apply for an international driving permit (IDP) before touring North America.
examples.zh: 前往美加北美地區自駕公路旅行前，請務必先在國內監理站申辦國際駕照。

examples.en: Rental counters will refuse to release vehicles if you fail to show a valid international driving permit.
examples.zh: 若您在國外租車臨櫃現場無法及時出具有效的國際駕照正本，租車櫃台將依法斷然拒絕交車。

examples.en: An international driving permit must be accompanied by your home country's original driver's license.
examples.zh: 國際駕照（IDP）在國際法規上本質為多國語言譯本，必須同時搭配您本國由政府核發的原件實體駕照方具效力。

explains.en: This document helps a traveler drive legally in another country when carried with their home license. Rental companies may ask to see it. Apply before leaving home.
A visitor may need this translation of their driving information to rent a vehicle abroad. It does not replace their original license. Some countries require both documents.
Use this travel document with the license from your own country. It helps local officials understand your driving credentials. Check the rules before a trip.

examples.en: Taiwanese tourists must present an official Japanese license translation to rent cars.
examples.zh: 台灣旅客前往日本自駕租車時，必須同時出具駕照日文譯本與本國駕照。

examples.en: You can easily obtain a certified Japanese driver's license translation at any motor vehicle office in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 國人出國前只需前往台灣各區公路監理所，即可隨到隨辦、花費一百元快速取得合法的駕照日文譯本。

examples.en: Do not forget to carry both your Taiwanese license and the official license translation when driving in Okinawa.
examples.zh: 前往沖繩自駕自由行時，千萬切記要隨身同時攜帶台灣駕照實體正本以及這份官方日文譯本以備交警查驗。

explains.en: Some places may ask travelers to show a translated version of their driving permit. Rules depend on the destination and the traveler’s license.
An official translation helps local staff read a driver’s license written in another language. It is normally carried with the original permit.
Before renting a car abroad, check which documents the local authorities and rental company accept. A translated permit may be required.

examples.en: Purchasing Collision Damage Waiver (CDW) protects against accidental vehicle dent costs.
examples.zh: 購買碰撞損害免責保險（CDW）能在車輛發生意外擦撞損傷時免除賠償責任。

examples.en: The resort required all participants to sign a liability waiver before taking scuba diving lessons.
examples.zh: 海島度假村明文規定，所有學員在正式下水參加深潛水肺潛水教學前均必須親筆簽署責任免責聲明書。

examples.en: Adding a damage waiver gives you peace of mind so you won't be charged for minor fender benders.
examples.zh: 加購車輛損壞免責附加條款能讓您開得毫無後顧之憂，即使發生輕微保險桿刮蹭亦無須自掏腰包承擔鉅額修復費用。

explains.en: Before a climbing lesson, a participant may sign a form explaining possible risks. Read it carefully before agreeing.
A customer gives up a particular right by signing a written document. The details can depend on the agreement.
A form may release an organization from some responsibility if an activity has risks. Ask questions if the terms are unclear.

examples.en: Road trippers prefer rental packages offering unlimited daily mileage.
examples.zh: 喜愛長途自駕旅行的玩家最偏好選擇包含每日不限里程的超值租車方案。

examples.en: Hybrid compact cars offer exceptional gas mileage, making them budget-friendly for long highway trips.
examples.zh: 油電混合掀背小車具備極其出色的低油耗每公升行駛里程表現，是自駕跑長途最省荷包的經濟首選。

examples.en: Frequent travelers redeem accrued airline mileage for complimentary business class upgrades.
examples.zh: 經常出差旅行的商務常客，最喜歡將平時累積的巨額飛行里程數兌換成長程航線的尊榮商務艙升等。

examples.en: The used electric sedan has low mileage and pristine battery health.
examples.zh: 這部優質中古二手電動房車總行駛里程數極低，且大電池健康度依然接近全新。

examples.en: Compact city cars usually achieve excellent gas mileage on flat urban roads.
examples.zh: 緊湊型市區小車在平坦的都會道路上通常能繳出極佳的油耗里程成績。

examples.en: Be sure to check the odometer to verify the vehicle's true accumulated mileage.
examples.zh: 購車時務必仔細檢查儀表板里程表，以確認該車輛真實的累積行駛里程數。

entries.definition: 行駛里程數；每加侖英里數；總行駛里程數；油耗表現

explains.en: This tells how far a vehicle has traveled. A used car's odometer shows the total.
A car that uses little gasoline for each distance gets good fuel efficiency. The word can also describe miles earned by an airline traveler.
A rental plan may let a driver travel without a distance limit. Check the number on the odometer when buying a used car.

examples.en: The built-in car GPS navigation system supports multilingual English voice prompts.
examples.zh: 該車輛內建之車用 GPS 衛星導航系統支援多國語言與清晰的英文語音提示。

examples.en: If your phone loses cellular signal in deep mountains, a reliable vehicle navigation system is essential.
examples.zh: 當您駕車深越高山深山峽谷且手機完全收不到行動網路訊號時，一台靠譜的車載導航機將是救命神器。

examples.en: Modern dashboard navigation systems display real-time highway traffic updates and detour suggestions.
examples.zh: 現代化先進車聯網中控導航大螢幕能即時顯示前方的路況擁塞預警，並主動推薦最佳繞道替代路線。

explains.en: This device or program uses maps and location information to help drivers find a route. It may speak directions aloud. It can also show traffic delays.
A driver enters a destination and receives a suggested path. A built-in car screen may display turns and road updates. It can still work when phone service is weak if it has stored maps.
Use this tool to find your way from one place to another. It can give spoken prompts and suggest detours. Some cars have one built into the dashboard.

examples.en: Take the express toll road to avoid heavy downtown morning traffic jams.
examples.zh: 選擇行駛快捷的收費高速公路以避開市區早晨繁雜壅塞的車陣。

examples.en: The toll road fee was automatically deducted as our rental car passed beneath the gantry.
examples.zh: 當我們的租賃車輛平穩高速通過門架感應區時，高速收費公路的通行過路費已完成全自動線上扣繳。

examples.en: Many travelers take scenic coastal secondary roads instead of paying steep fees on the toll road.
examples.zh: 許多熱愛自由行且時間充裕的慢遊旅人，寧願選擇沿著風景壯麗的沿海一般公路漫步，也不願行駛收費昂貴的收費公路。

entries.definition: 收費道路；收費高速公路

explains.en: It is a road drivers pay to use. A fee may be charged at a gate or automatically by a sensor. It can help avoid city traffic.
Some highways require payment before or after travel. A rental car may deduct the fee electronically. Scenic routes without charges are another option.
Drivers use this route by paying a charge. Signs show the cost and where to pay. It may offer a faster journey.

examples.en: Renting an ETC card reader card makes highway toll payments seamless.
examples.zh: 租借高速公路專用 ETC 卡片能讓您通過國道電子收費站時免停車扣款。

examples.en: Taiwan was among the first countries to implement a fully electronic, multilane free-flow ETC system nationwide.
examples.zh: 台灣是全世界最早在全境國道全面成功推行無柵欄、多車道自由流智慧型電子道路收費（ETC）的先驅國家之一。

examples.en: Don't forget to return the rental ETC card and settle toll fees when returning the car.
examples.zh: 在租車歸還愛車辦理退租手續時，千萬切莫忘記繳回租借的專用 ETC 卡片並當場結清這幾天累計的國道通行費用。

entries.definition: 電子道路收費系統 (Electronic Toll Collection)

explains.en: A small device in a car can let it pass a highway toll point without stopping to pay cash. The toll is charged electronically.
Drivers pass under a reader that detects a tag in the vehicle. A bill or stored balance covers the road fee.
This road system collects tolls automatically as cars move through a gate or open lane. Check the rental company’s payment instructions.

examples.en: Most car rental agreements require you to refuel fully before vehicle return.
examples.zh: 絕大多數租車合約皆嚴格規定還車時必須將油箱全數加滿油後歸還。

examples.en: Pilots calculate the exact fuel load required to complete the flight without needing to divert and refuel.
examples.zh: 飛行員在起飛前依載重與航線嚴密精算所需燃油總量，確保客機一路飛抵目的機場而無須中途轉降加油。

examples.en: After hiking uphill for three grueling hours, we sat under a pavilion to refuel with trail mix and bananas.
examples.zh: 在烈日下奮力苦爬了整整三個小時的高山陡坡後，我們紛紛在山腰涼亭內卸下背包，大口享用堅果果乾補充體能。

explains.en: A driver stops at a station to put gasoline in a car. A traveler may also eat a snack after a tiring walk.
Before a long trip, make sure the vehicle has enough fuel. This verb can also mean restoring your energy with food.
An airplane may need more fuel before continuing its flight. A hungry hiker can take a break and eat to regain energy.

examples.en: The compact hybrid car runs on 95 regular unleaded gasoline.
examples.zh: 這款小巧省油的油電掀背車使用的是 95 無鉛常規汽油。

examples.en: Be careful not to put diesel into a rental car engine that requires unleaded petrol.
examples.zh: 在海外加油站自助加油時請務必看清油槍標籤，千萬切莫誤將柴油灌進只吃無鉛汽油的汽油車油箱中。

examples.en: Global environmental bans on leaded additives made clean unleaded fuel the universal automotive standard.
examples.zh: 國際環保法規全面淘汰劇毒四乙基鉛添加劑，使潔淨的無鉛汽油徹底普及成為全球汽車運行的通用標準。

explains.en: This describes fuel made for cars without the harmful metal once added to gasoline. Most modern vehicles use it. Check the owner's guide before filling the tank.
A rental car may require this kind of petrol instead of diesel. It became common after countries stopped adding lead. The fuel is safer for people and the environment.
Use this adjective for vehicle fuel that does not contain lead additives. It is now the usual choice for many cars. Putting in the wrong type can damage an engine.

examples.en: Call the 24/7 emergency roadside assistance hotline if your vehicle breaks down.
examples.zh: 若車輛在半路不慎拋錨故障，請立即撥打二十四小時全天候道路救援專線。

examples.en: The automobile association provides complimentary roadside assistance including towing, jump-starts, and lockouts.
examples.zh: 汽車駕駛人協會為會員提供全方位的免費道路救援服務，涵蓋長途故障拖吊、電瓶接電啟動與開鎖救援。

examples.en: Our rental car contract includes roadside assistance anywhere across the island in case of mechanical issues.
examples.zh: 我們的租車合約包含了全島零死角全年無休的道路緊急救援保證，一旦發生任何突發機械故障均能即時馳援。

explains.en: It is help given to drivers when a vehicle breaks down on the road. A service may tow the car or jump-start its battery. Call the number in your rental contract.
A motor club can send a worker when a car has a flat tire or locked doors. The service may include towing. It helps travelers continue safely.
Drivers can request this support if their vehicle will not run. Workers may bring fuel or help with a battery. Many insurance plans include it.

examples.en: Learn how to change a flat tire safely on highway shoulders.
examples.zh: 學習如何在高速公路路肩安全熟練地更換漏氣消氣的破損輪胎。

examples.en: A sharp rusty nail on the construction roadway caused a sudden flat tire.
examples.zh: 遺落在施工路段路面上的一顆鋒利生鏽鐵釘，直接刺破了外胎導致車輛無預警瞬間爆胎漏氣。

examples.en: The tire pressure monitoring sensor flashed red on the dashboard, warning the driver of a dangerous flat tire.
examples.zh: 汽車儀表板上的胎壓偵測警示燈突然亮起刺目紅光，嚴厲警示駕駛員當前某個車輪出現危險消氣漏氣。

explains.en: A sharp nail punctures a car tire and the air escapes. The driver should find a safe place before changing it.
A bicycle wheel suddenly feels soft because its inner tube has lost air. A repair kit may help.
When a vehicle tire loses most of its air, it cannot roll safely. Pull over away from traffic and get help.

examples.en: Check that the trunk holds a fully inflated emergency spare tire and jack.
examples.zh: 出發前請先檢查後車廂是否配備有氣壓充足的應急備胎與千斤頂。

examples.en: Most modern compact spare tires are intended only for temporary low-speed driving to the nearest repair shop.
examples.zh: 絕大多數現代轎車隨車附贈的小型應急備用輪胎，僅供在時速八十公里以下低速臨時行駛至鄰近輪胎行更換。

examples.en: Some newer vehicle models omit the physical spare tire entirely in favor of an aerosol puncture repair kit.
examples.zh: 許多追求極致輕量化與車室空間的新款車型，已徹底取消實體鋼製備胎，取而代之的是輕巧的自動補胎打氣劑。

explains.en: A car may carry an extra wheel in its trunk in case another one gets a flat. Check that it is filled with air.
This emergency wheel is meant for a short trip to a repair shop. Some newer cars use a repair kit instead.
Drivers can use this extra wheel after a tire is damaged. A jack is often needed to change it.

examples.en: Driving along the Pacific Coast Highway is an unforgettable bucket-list road trip.
examples.zh: 沿著加州一號太平洋海岸公路兜風是一場令人終生難忘的夢幻公路旅行。

examples.en: We packed our tent, cooler, and hiking poles into the trunk for a two-week cross-country road trip.
examples.zh: 我們將露營帳篷、行動保冷箱與登山杖通通塞滿休旅車後車廂，興高采烈展開為期兩週的橫跨大陸自駕遊。

examples.en: Creating a collaborative playlist of favorite songs made our coastal road trip even more memorable.
examples.zh: 全車好友共同在串流軟體上編輯創建專屬自駕歌單，讓整趟沿海公路旅行的歡聲笑語變得更添美好回憶。

entries.definition: 公路旅行；開車長途旅行

explains.en: This is a journey made by car, often over a long distance with stops along the way. Friends may pack food and music. They can visit places on the route.
A family may drive across a region for a holiday. A playlist and cooler can make the ride fun. The trip includes the drive itself as part of the adventure.
Use this phrase for traveling by car from one place to another, often for fun. People may camp or explore different towns. Planning the route is part of it.

examples.en: The winding mountain pass offers breathtaking panoramic ocean scenic drives.
examples.zh: 蜿蜒盤旋的山路能欣賞到一望無際、壯闊無比的蔚藍太平洋景觀公路風光。

examples.en: Taiwan's Provincial Highway 11 along the eastern coast is widely praised as one of Asia's most stunning scenic drives.
examples.zh: 緊鄰太平洋蔚藍海線的台灣東部台十一線省道，被國內外無數自駕愛好者譽為全亞洲最令人窒息的絕美景觀公路之一。

examples.en: We pulled off into designated roadside viewing lookouts along the scenic drive to take panoramic landscape photos.
examples.zh: 沿著蜿蜒起伏的景觀公路行駛，我們頻頻將車輛靠停於路旁特設的景觀觀景台，用相機記錄下浩瀚山海壯麗全景。

entries.definition: 景觀公路駕駛路線；風景公路

explains.en: It is a road trip along a route with beautiful views. A mountain pass may overlook the ocean. Drivers can stop at marked lookouts for photos.
Travelers follow this kind of route to enjoy landscapes along the way. Taiwan's eastern coast has a famous example. Allow time for safe stops.
A road known for its natural beauty can make a trip special. Curves may pass through hills or beside the sea. Lookouts let visitors take pictures.

examples.en: Vehicles inside the traffic roundabout have right of way over entering cars.
examples.zh: 已經在交通圓環內行進的車輛享有優先行駛路權，進環車輛必須禮讓。

examples.en: Signal your intention to exit before gently turning off the circular traffic roundabout.
examples.zh: 在準備駛離環狀交通圓環前的最後一個出口前，請務必提早開啟方向燈向後方來車示意。

examples.en: European cities favor roundabouts because they reduce fatal head-on intersection collisions dramatically.
examples.zh: 歐洲許多歷史名城極其推崇圓環十字路口設計，因為實務數據證明它能極大幅度消弭傳統路口的正面致命對撞車禍。

explains.en: Cars travel around a circular junction to reach a different road. Drivers should watch signs and other vehicles.
A city replaces a crossroads with a central island and a ring of road. This can help organize traffic flow.
In a playground, a rotating platform lets children ride in circles. The same word can name a circular road junction.

examples.en: Motorists must come to a complete stop before occupied pedestrian crossings.
examples.zh: 汽機車駕駛人在接近有行人通行的斑馬線行人穿越道前必須完全停讓。

examples.en: In Taiwan, drivers face severe fines and license demerits if they fail to yield at pedestrian crossings.
examples.zh: 在台灣，任何汽機車若行經行人穿越道未停讓行人優先通過，將面臨高額法規重罰並吊扣違規記點。

examples.en: Illuminated flashing beacons alert speeding drivers to pedestrians using the crossing after dark.
examples.zh: 斑馬線兩端加裝的夜間高亮度感應發光警示道釘，能在夜幕降臨時強烈警示遠方車輛減速禮讓正通過的行人。

explains.en: People walk across a road here, often between painted white lines. Drivers should stop for them.
Flashing lights can warn drivers that someone is crossing after dark. This marked place helps people cross safely.
A person on foot uses this marked part of the street to get to the other side. Cars must yield.

examples.en: Look up at the giant LED scoreboard to see game highlights.
examples.zh: 抬頭看著中央巨型 LED 電子計分板即可重溫剛才的精彩慢動作重播。

examples.en: The scoreboard flashed the final score as fans erupted into deafening cheers.
examples.zh: 當電子計分螢幕定格顯示最終比賽比分時，全場主場球迷瞬間爆發出震耳欲聾的勝利歡呼。

examples.en: A technical glitch on the digital scoreboard temporarily confused both teams regarding the remaining time.
examples.zh: 數位計分板突如其來的短暫電子故障，一度讓場上對壘的雙方球員對剩餘比賽時間感到困惑。

explains.en: This display shows the points or progress in a game. Fans look up to see who is winning. It may also show the time remaining.
A digital screen at a sports field can flash the final result. A malfunction may confuse players. Spectators use it to follow the match.
Use this word for a board that records a team's points. It may be electronic or manual. The display helps everyone know the current result.

examples.en: Marching bands performed dynamic music during the halftime show.
examples.zh: 樂旗隊在中場半場休息時間帶來了氣勢磅礴的動感音樂演奏表演。

examples.en: The coach gave an inspiring motivational speech in the locker room during halftime.
examples.zh: 總教練在中場休息時間踏入球員更衣室，發表了一席慷慨激昂、鼓舞士氣的談話。

examples.en: Grab a hot dog and a drink during halftime before the third quarter begins.
examples.zh: 趁著半場休息時間趕快去球場走道買份熱狗堡與無糖飲料，準備迎接下半場第三節激戰。

entries.definition: 半場休息；中場休息時間

explains.en: It is the break in the middle of a sports game. Players rest and coaches give advice. A marching band may perform during it.
After the first part of a match, teams pause before continuing. Fans may buy snacks during this interval. The coach can discuss a new plan.
This interval divides a game into two halves. Players leave the field to rest. The next period begins afterward.

examples.en: The triumphant team paraded through city streets waving to ecstatic fans.
examples.zh: 凱旋榮歸的冠軍隊伍在市區盛大遊行，向夾道狂歡的球迷揮手致意。

examples.en: She flashed a triumphant smile after breaking the longstanding school swimming record.
examples.zh: 在奮力打破高懸多年的全校游泳歷史紀錄後，她對著看台綻放出一抹勝利自豪的燦爛笑容。

examples.en: The army made a triumphant return to the capital following months of defensive warfare.
examples.zh: 在歷經數月艱苦卓絕的邊境防衛戰後，英勇受閱的軍隊邁著整齊步伐凱旋榮歸首都接受歡呼。

entries.definition: 勝利的；凱旋的；耀武揚威的

explains.en: The team wins the final match and smiles as fans cheer. They feel proud of their success.
A student finishes a difficult contest and raises a medal happily. The expression on the student’s face shows victory.
After many months of work, the group completes its goal. They return proudly because they have succeeded.

examples.en: Finishing as the world tournament runner-up was an incredible achievement.
examples.zh: 在競爭激烈的世界大賽中榮獲亞軍殊榮已是一項無比非凡的重大成就。

examples.en: Although disappointed to finish as runner-up, the tennis star vowed to come back stronger next year.
examples.zh: 儘管屈居亞軍難免令人感到遺憾，但這位網球名將誓言明年定將以更強大的姿態重返巔峰。

examples.en: The silver medal went to the runner-up, who finished just a fraction of a second behind the winner.
examples.zh: 銀牌頒發給了第二名亞軍得主，他在終點線前僅以幾百分之一秒的微弱差距惜敗於金牌冠軍。

explains.en: The player who finishes second in a contest earns this place. The winner comes first.
A tennis player may be proud of reaching the final even without winning. The person who comes second receives a silver medal.
This person or team loses only to the winner. It describes the second-place finisher.

examples.en: Gold, silver, and bronze medalists stood proudly on the award podium.
examples.zh: 金、銀、銅牌得主並肩自豪地挺身站在奧運頒獎台上接受喝采。

examples.en: Standing atop the Olympic podium as the national anthem played was the proudest moment of his life.
examples.zh: 當國旗歌莊嚴響徹全場、昂首佇立在奧運最高頒獎台上時，那是他此生最引以為傲的榮耀時刻。

examples.en: The company CEO walked up to the podium to deliver the keynote address at the annual summit.
examples.zh: 企業執行長邁著自信從容的步伐走上發言講台，在年度全球科技高峰會上發表重要主旨演講。

examples.en: Standing atop the gold medal podium brought proud tears to the champion's eyes.
examples.zh: 當雄赳赳站上象徵最高榮譽的金牌第一名領獎台時，冠軍選手不禁熱淚盈眶。

examples.en: All three medalists stepped onto the podium as their national anthems echoed through the arena.
examples.zh: 三位奪牌好手一同登上頒獎台，國歌旋律在整座宏偉的體育館內莊嚴迴盪。

examples.en: The guest lecturer stepped up to the podium and greeted the enthusiastic auditorium crowd.
examples.zh: 特邀客座講師穩步走上講台，親切地向台下熱情滿座的聽眾致意問好。

entries.definition: 頒獎台；講台；指揮台；領獎台

explains.en: This is a raised platform where winners stand to receive medals. A speaker may also stand at one to address a crowd. It can be at a sports event or a meeting.
At an awards ceremony, the top competitors stand on different levels of this platform. A company leader may speak from one as well. It puts the person in view of the audience.
Use this word for a small raised stage or stand. Medal winners may gather there. A lecturer may speak from behind one.

examples.en: The point guard sank both clutch free throws to win the game.
examples.zh: 明星控球後衛在關鍵時刻穩穩罰進兩顆罰球，一舉逆轉奪勝。

examples.en: Players practice hundreds of repetitions every day to achieve high free throw accuracy.
examples.zh: 職業籃球員每天在無人防守的罰球線上反覆練習投擲數百次，以淬煉出精準無比的罰球命中率。

examples.en: A technical foul gives the opposing team one uncontested free throw and possession of the ball.
examples.zh: 一旦被吹判技術犯規，對手隊伍將立即獲得一次無干擾輕鬆罰球機會以及接下來的前場球權。

explains.en: It is an unopposed shot awarded to a basketball player after certain fouls. The player stands at a marked line. Practice can improve accuracy.
A foul may give a player a chance to score without defenders blocking the shot. The team earns this chance under the rules. The ball must reach the basket.
During a basketball game, a player may shoot from a fixed line after a penalty. It is important to concentrate. A successful attempt adds points.

examples.en: The Taitung Triathlon challenges endurance along the picturesque east coast.
examples.zh: 台東國際鐵人三項賽沿著風景如畫的東部海岸線挑戰極限體能耐力。

examples.en: Competing in a full Ironman triathlon involves swimming, cycling, and running in a single grueling day.
examples.zh: 報名參加一場極限大鐵超級鐵人三項賽，意味著必須在漫長的一天內依序完成游泳、自行車與路跑。

examples.en: She bought an aerodynamic road bike to improve her cycling split time during the upcoming triathlon.
examples.zh: 她特地添購了一輛頂級空氣動力學破風公路自行車，期盼在即將到來的鐵人三項賽中縮短騎乘分段時間。

examples.en: The Taitung Ironman triathlon attracts world-class athletes to eastern Taiwan.
examples.zh: 一年一度在台東活水湖盛大登場的超級鐵人三項賽吸引了全球頂尖耐力王者齊聚一堂。

examples.en: Training for an Olympic-distance triathlon requires balancing swimming, cycling, and running sessions.
examples.zh: 為奧運標準距離鐵人三項備戰，必須精準分配時間在游泳、單車與路跑三大項目之間。

examples.en: Completing his first triathlon fulfilled a personal dream ten years in the making.
examples.zh: 終於成功跨越個人首座鐵人三項終點拱門，圓滿實現了他長達十年的夢想清單。

entries.definition: 鐵人三項（游泳、單車、路跑）；鐵人三項（游泳、自行車、路跑）

explains.en: An athlete swims, rides a bike, and then runs in one race. Training for all three parts takes planning.
Competitors finish three different endurance events in a row. Each event tests stamina in a different way.
A person may swim in open water, cycle along a road, and run to the finish. The combined race has three sports.

examples.en: Thirty minutes of daily cardio keeps your heart and lungs healthy.
examples.zh: 每天進行三十分鐘中等強度的有氧心肺運動能常保心肺機能健康。

examples.en: Combining brisk walking with jump rope provides an effective low-impact cardio session.
examples.zh: 將戶外快走慢跑與輕快跳繩相互結合，能構成一組高效且不易磨損膝蓋關節的低衝擊有氧運動。

examples.en: You should always include cardio workouts in your fitness plan to manage blood pressure effectively.
examples.zh: 在規劃個人每週健身運動菜單時，應當適度融入有氧心肺訓練，以科學且長效地維持血壓穩定。

examples.en: Combining weight training with twenty minutes of steady-state cardio optimizes fat loss.
examples.zh: 將大重量重訓與二十分鐘中低強度心肺有氧運動相結合，能達成極致高效的燃脂效果。

examples.en: Doing excessive cardio without proper nutrition can cause unwanted muscle loss.
examples.zh: 在營養不足的情況下進行過量有氧運動，可能會導致寶貴的肌肉流失。

examples.en: Low-intensity steady-state cardio is easy on the joints and aids active recovery.
examples.zh: 低強度恆速有氧運動對關節衝擊極小，並且有助於重訓後的動態主動恢復。

entries.definition: 心肺有氧運動；心臟的；有氧運動；心肺耐力訓練

explains.en: Brisk walking or jumping rope can make the heart and lungs work harder. This kind of exercise supports heart health.
A fitness plan may include steady movement that raises the heartbeat. Start gently and rest when needed.
Some exercises help build endurance by making breathing faster. Walking and dancing can be examples.

examples.en: Regular strength training increases bone density and builds lean muscle.
examples.zh: 規律進行肌力重量訓練能有效提升骨質密度並增加緊實精壯肌肉。

examples.en: Older adults benefit immensely from strength training because it helps prevent accidental falls.
examples.zh: 銀髮族長輩定期投入肌力阻力訓練能收穫巨大健康益處，因為它能極大幅度預防年長者意外跌倒。

examples.en: You don't need heavy machinery for strength training; bodyweight push-ups and squats are fantastic.
examples.zh: 進行肌力訓練並非一定非得仰賴昂貴器械，日常進行標準伏地挺身與自重深蹲即具備極佳鍛鍊效果。

explains.en: This is exercise that makes muscles stronger by working against resistance. A person can lift weights or do push-ups. It can also help older adults stay steady.
People use weights or their own body to build muscle and bone strength. Heavy machines are not always needed. Regular practice can help prevent falls.
Use this phrase for exercises that make the body stronger. Squats and push-ups are examples. It can be done at home or in a gym.

examples.en: A proper ten-minute dynamic warm-up prevents unexpected muscle sprains.
examples.zh: 運動前先進行十分鐘充分的動態暖身熱身能有效預防肌肉拉傷扭傷。

examples.en: Jumping jacks, leg swings, and arm circles are popular exercises for an athletic warm-up.
examples.zh: 開合跳、鐘擺式擺腿以及雙臂大迴環伸展，皆是田徑運動員在賽前普遍採用的經典動態暖身動作。

examples.en: Skipping the warm-up before lifting heavy weights significantly increases your risk of joint injury.
examples.zh: 在進行大重量槓鈴深蹲臥推前若僥倖省略暖身環節，將會成倍拉高肌腱韌帶與關節意外受傷的風險。

examples.en: Perform ten minutes of dynamic warm-up drills before starting heavy squats.
examples.zh: 在進行大重量槓鈴深蹲訓練之前，請務必先落實十分鐘全身動態伸展暖身。

examples.en: A dynamic warm-up elevates your core body temperature and primes your nervous system.
examples.zh: 動態暖身能提高身體核心溫度，並活化你的神經系統做好運動準備。

examples.en: Skipping your warm-up significantly increases the risk of pulled muscles and joint sprains.
examples.zh: 跳過暖身步驟會大幅增加肌肉拉傷和關節扭傷的風險。

entries.definition: 暖身運動；熱身；暖身熱身運動；熱身的

explains.en: It is gentle movement or activity done before exercise. Jumping jacks can prepare the muscles. It may lower the chance of injury.
Athletes often start with arm circles and leg swings before lifting weights. This prepares the body for harder work. It can also describe an opening activity before a show.
Before a game, players move lightly to get ready. A short practice can help them focus. The phrase can also mean a preview or first attempt.

examples.en: Never skip post-workout static stretching and cool-down routines.
examples.zh: 劇烈高強度運動訓練結束後，切勿略過靜態收操拉筋放鬆環節。

examples.en: A five-minute easy jog followed by deep stretching serves as an ideal post-race cool-down.
examples.zh: 進行五分鐘緩和慢跑並搭配全身各大肌群的深層靜態伸展，是賽後最理想的收操放鬆程序。

examples.en: A gradual cool-down allows your elevated heart rate to return gently to resting levels.
examples.zh: 循序漸進的緩和收操程序，能讓劇烈運動後飆升的心率與血壓平緩溫和地回落至日常靜態水準。

examples.en: Finish intense interval workouts with a light five-minute jog cool-down.
examples.zh: 在結束高強度間歇衝刺訓練後，請進行五分鐘輕度慢跑作為緩和收操放鬆。

examples.en: Skipping your post-run cool-down can lead to dizziness and excessive muscle tightness.
examples.zh: 跑步後若省略了緩和收操拉筋步驟，可能會導致心率驟降引發頭暈與肌肉過度僵硬。

examples.en: A comprehensive cool-down routine gradually brings your heart rate back to resting levels.
examples.zh: 一套完整扎實的運動後緩和收操，能讓狂跳的心率平穩漸進地回到正常靜態區間。

examples.en: A proper post-workout cool-down gradually lowers elevated heart rates safely.
examples.zh: 訓練結束後落實充分的靜態伸展緩和收操運動，能讓劇烈飆升的心率安全漸進回落。

examples.en: Incorporating static stretching into your cool-down can alleviate post-exercise tightness.
examples.zh: 在收操時加入靜態伸展，有助於緩解運動後的肌肉緊繃感。

examples.en: Take five minutes for a light jog and deep breathing as a cool-down after your sprint workout.
examples.zh: 衝刺訓練結束後，花五分鐘慢跑並深呼吸來作為緩和收操。

entries.definition: 收操伸展；冷靜下來；緩和收操運動；冷卻的

explains.en: After a hard run, walk slowly and stretch so your body can return to a resting state. Take a few minutes before stopping.
A light jog after fast running helps your breathing and heartbeat slow gradually. Stretching can follow.
When a disagreement becomes heated, take a pause and speak calmly. This phrase can mean relaxing after exercise or calming down.

examples.en: Planks and Pilates effectively strengthen deep abdominal core muscles.
examples.zh: 棒式平板支撐與皮拉提斯運動能強效鍛鍊深層腹部核心肌群。

examples.en: Strong core muscles provide stability, preventing chronic lower back discomfort during long runs.
examples.zh: 擁有強健有力的核心肌群能為身體提供堅若磐石的穩定度，防止長跑時腰椎深處產生慢性不適。

examples.en: Engaging your core muscles before lifting a heavy box protects your lower back.
examples.zh: 在彎腰抱起沉重的快遞大紙箱前，先深吸一口氣收緊並啟動腹部核心肌群，能周密保護下背部。

explains.en: These muscles around the belly and back help keep the body steady. A plank can make them stronger.
The muscles in the center of the body support balance and movement. They help protect the lower back.
Pilates and similar exercises work the muscles around the middle of the body. They help someone stay stable while lifting.

examples.en: Delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS) typically peaks two days after workouts.
examples.zh: 延遲性肌肉痠痛（DOMS）通常會在激烈運動後的第四十八小時達到高峰。

examples.en: Soaking in a warm hot spring bath soothed the painful muscular soreness in his calves.
examples.zh: 將疲憊的身軀完全浸泡在溫暖滑潤的天然溫泉池中，徹底舒緩了他雙腿小腿肌肉的腫脹痠痛。

examples.en: Expect mild muscle soreness after trying an unfamiliar exercise routine for the very first time.
examples.zh: 當您生平第一次嘗試一組此前從未練過的全新重訓動作課表時，隔天出現輕微肌肉痠痛實屬常態。

examples.en: Delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS) usually peaks forty-eight hours post-workout.
examples.zh: 運動後引發的延遲性肌肉痠痛（DOMS）通常會在高強度重訓後的四十八小時達到頂峰。

examples.en: Taking a warm epsom salt bath helps alleviate chronic leg soreness after cycling.
examples.zh: 在長途騎乘單車後浸泡溫暖的瀉鹽熱水澡，有助於舒緩雙腿深層的肌肉痠痛疲憊。

examples.en: Gentle walking and foam rolling can stimulate blood flow to reduce acute soreness.
examples.zh: 輕度散步活動與使用滾筒筋膜放鬆能促進血液循環，從而有效減輕急性肌肉痠痛。

examples.en: Delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS) peaked 48 hours after heavy leg day.
examples.zh: 瘋狂練腿日結束四十八小時後，強烈的延遲性肌肉酸痛（DOMS）達到高峰，連下樓梯都腿軟。

examples.en: Mild muscle soreness indicates that muscle tissue has experienced new micro-tears and stimulation.
examples.zh: 適度的肌肉微酸感代表肌纖維組織經歷了全新的微小撕裂刺激並準備成長。

examples.en: Light swimming and contrast showers can help ease intense leg soreness after long workouts.
examples.zh: 進行輕鬆的水中漫遊與冷熱水交替浴，能顯著舒緩重訓後雙腿劇烈的痠痛不適。

explains.en: This is a mild pain or tenderness in the muscles after hard or unfamiliar exercise. It may feel strongest a day or two later. Gentle movement can help.
Someone may notice this in their legs after cycling or trying a new workout. A warm bath can feel soothing. It is different from a sudden sharp injury.
Use this noun for the aching feeling that can follow exercise. Rest and light activity may ease it. It often goes away after a few days.

examples.en: Proper hydration is essential when hiking in humid sub-tropical climates.
examples.zh: 在悶熱潮濕的亞熱帶山林登山健行時，適時補足水分至關重要。

examples.en: Maintaining optimal cellular hydration keeps your skin glowing and prevents midday fatigue.
examples.zh: 維繫體內細胞水分充沛的最佳保濕補水狀態，能讓肌膚水潤透亮並徹底驅散午後的昏睡疲倦感。

examples.en: Runners set reminders on their GPS smartwatches to maintain steady water hydration throughout the race.
examples.zh: 專業長跑選手在智慧 GPS 運動手錶上設定定時提醒，確保整場賽程中每隔兩公里皆能按時定量補水。

examples.en: Maintain proper hydration by sipping water every twenty minutes during hikes.
examples.zh: 在烈日下登山健行時，請養成每二十分鐘小口飲水補充水分的良好補水習慣。

examples.en: Severe dehydration impairs cognitive focus and causes rapid athletic fatigue.
examples.zh: 嚴重的體內脫水會大幅損害大腦思維專注力，並加速運動過程中的體力衰竭。

examples.en: Adequate daily hydration keeps skin elastic and supports healthy kidney function.
examples.zh: 每天攝取充足均衡的水分能維持肌膚水嫩彈性，並維持腎臟良好的代謝排毒機能。

examples.en: Managing high 80% dough hydration produces an open, custard-like interior crumb.
examples.zh: 熟練駕馭高達百分之八十的高含水量麵團，能烤出內部濕潤如卡士達般化口的大氣孔麵包。

examples.en: Beginners should start with a modest 65% hydration dough to practice shaping skills easily.
examples.zh: 剛接觸歐包的新手建議從百分之六十五的溫和含水量起步練習，整型操作起來更易上手。

examples.en: Proper hydration is also essential for athletes during intense marathon training in the summer.
examples.zh: 在酷暑盛夏進行高強度的馬拉松長跑訓練時，隨時補充足夠的水分與水合作用同樣至關重要。

examples.en: High hydration dough at eighty percent creates a tender, custard-like crumb packed with open air pockets.
examples.zh: 高達百分之八十的高含水量麵團，能烤出外脆內潤、如布丁般濕潤 Q 彈的大氣孔組織。

examples.en: Handling sticky dough with high hydration requires practiced hand techniques and wet bench knives.
examples.zh: 操作高含水量的黏手麵團，需要純熟的推拉手感以及沾濕的刮板輔助操作。

examples.en: Novice bakers often start with sixty-five percent hydration before tackling wetter mixtures.
examples.zh: 初學烘焙新手通常建議先從百分之六十五的中度水合開始練習，再逐步挑戰高含水麵團。

entries.definition: 水分補充；保濕；體內含水量；麵團水合含水量比；水合作用；80% 高含水量麵團比例；水合度

explains.en: It is the process of getting enough water into the body. Hikers need to drink often in hot weather. This helps prevent tiredness.
Cells and skin need water to function well. Runners may carry a bottle during a race. Drinking steadily helps replace lost fluids.
This word describes the body's water level or the act of supplying water. A plant also needs it to stay healthy. A reminder can help someone drink regularly.

examples.en: Drink electrolyte beverages to replenish sodium and potassium lost in sweat.
examples.zh: 飲用電解質運動飲料以即時補充電解質與隨大量汗水流失的鈉與鉀。

examples.en: Severe heat exhaustion depletes essential body electrolytes, causing painful cramps.
examples.zh: 在烈日下嚴重中暑虛脫會急劇耗盡人體維持神經傳導所需的電解質，進而誘發難忍的肌肉痙攣抽筋。

examples.en: Coconut water is a delicious natural beverage rich in hydrating minerals and electrolytes.
examples.zh: 天然純椰子水是一種富含人體所需微量礦物質與天然電解質的絕佳消暑生津補水飲品。

examples.en: Replenish lost sodium and electrolytes with sports drinks after heavy sweating.
examples.zh: 大量出汗後適度飲用等滲透壓運動飲料，能即時補充流失的鈉與微量電解質。

examples.en: Cramping during endurance races is frequently caused by a sharp electrolyte imbalance.
examples.zh: 馬拉松與鐵人三項競賽中的突發小腿抽筋，往往是由於體內電解質急遽失衡所誘發。

examples.en: Coconut water is a natural beverage rich in potassium and vital electrolytes.
examples.zh: 新鮮天然椰子水是一種富含鉀離子與人體必需微量電解質的絕佳天然補給飲品。

examples.en: Drink electrolyte beverages during long summer runs to prevent painful muscle cramping.
examples.zh: 在炎炎夏日戶外長跑時適度補充電解質運動飲料，能有效預防因大量排汗流失鈉離子引發的抽筋。

examples.en: Sweating excessively during hot yoga depletes vital electrolyte stores in the body.
examples.zh: 在熱瑜珈課程中瘋狂大汗淋漓會迅速耗盡體內儲存的重要電解質礦物質。

examples.en: Replenishing sodium and potassium with electrolyte tablets quickly restores proper muscle contractions.
examples.zh: 透過電解質發泡錠及時補充鈉離子與鉀離子，能迅速恢復肌肉神經的正常收縮傳導。

entries.definition: 電解質；電解液；電解質（鈉、鉀、鎂）；電解質（鈉、鉀、鎂離子）

explains.en: Sweat carries minerals such as sodium and potassium out of the body. Drinks may replace them after long exercise.
These dissolved minerals help the body’s muscles and nerves work. A doctor can advise people about health concerns.
A sports drink may contain salts that dissolve in water. The body needs the right balance of these minerals.

examples.en: Fitness enthusiasts consume whey protein shakes post-workout for muscle repair.
examples.zh: 健身愛好者習慣在重訓課表結束後立即飲用乳清高蛋白飲以助肌肉修復。

examples.en: Blending frozen bananas, oats, and peanut butter makes a nutritious homemade protein shake.
examples.zh: 將冷凍香蕉切片、大燕麥片與濃郁花生醬放入果汁機打勻，即可調配出一杯營養滿點的自製蛋白奶昔。

examples.en: Drinking a protein shake between meals is a convenient way to meet daily dietary protein goals.
examples.zh: 在每日三餐正餐之間穿插飲用一杯高蛋白飲品，是忙碌現代人輕鬆達標每日蛋白質攝取目標的便捷良方。

entries.definition: 高蛋白飲品；乳清蛋白奶昔

explains.en: Blend milk, fruit, or powder to make this drink. Some people have it after exercise.
A banana and peanut butter can go into a thick drink with extra protein. It can be a quick snack.
This beverage may help someone reach a daily protein goal. Check the ingredients and choose a healthy amount.

examples.en: Building muscle mass boosts your daily resting basal metabolism rate.
examples.zh: 增加全身骨骼肌肉量能有效提升日常靜止時的基礎新陳代謝率。

examples.en: Getting adequate deep sleep is critical for regulating hormone levels and healthy metabolism.
examples.zh: 每晚享有充足的高品質深層睡眠，對於穩定人體內分泌荷爾蒙濃度與維持健康新陳代謝不可或缺。

examples.en: Regular brisk walking helps kick-start a sluggish digestive metabolism.
examples.zh: 飯後養成出門快走健走的好習慣，能有效喚醒並啟動因久坐而趨於緩慢遲滯的腸胃消化代謝功能。

examples.en: Building lean muscle mass elevates your resting basal metabolism rate.
examples.zh: 積極增肌鍛鍊增加骨骼肌質量，能有效拉高人體在靜止狀態下的基礎新陳代謝率。

examples.en: Thyroid hormones play an indispensable role in regulating human metabolism and energy levels.
examples.zh: 甲狀腺荷爾蒙在調節人體日常新陳代謝速率與維持精力充沛方面扮演著關鍵角色。

examples.en: Crash dieting often slows down your metabolism, making future weight rebound much more likely.
examples.zh: 極端節食往往會大幅拖慢自身的新陳代謝，導致日後體重更容易出現報復性反彈復胖。

entries.definition: 新陳代謝；基礎代謝；基礎代謝率 (BMR)

explains.en: This is the set of processes that turns food into energy and helps the body grow and function. Sleep and hormones affect it. It can vary from person to person.
The body breaks down food and uses it to power movement and keep warm. Muscles use energy even at rest. This process is important for health.
Use this term for the body's chemical activity that uses nutrients. It supports breathing, growth, and other functions. A healthy routine can support it.

examples.en: Regular exercise and clean eating lower body fat percentage steadily.
examples.zh: 規律運動結合乾淨原型食物飲食能循序漸進穩定降低體脂率。

examples.en: Excess visceral body fat surrounding internal organs poses significant cardiovascular risks.
examples.zh: 堆積包覆在腹腔各大內臟器官周遭的過量內臟脂肪，會對人體心血管系統帶來不可忽視的健康隱患。

examples.en: Elite athletes often maintain single-digit body fat levels during peak competitive seasons.
examples.zh: 頂級菁英運動健兒在迎戰重大賽季的高峰期，全身骨骼肌外層的體脂率常年保持在驚人的個位數百分比。

examples.en: Combining resistance workouts with balanced diet lowers body fat percentage safely.
examples.zh: 重訓阻力運動搭配均衡原型食物飲食，能在不流失肌肉的前提下安全降低體脂率。

examples.en: The bioelectrical impedance scale measures bone density, skeletal muscle, and body fat.
examples.zh: 這款雙頻體脂計能精準分析骨質密度、骨骼肌質量與全身各部位的體脂肪率。

examples.en: Male marathon runners often maintain a lean body fat percentage between six and ten percent.
examples.zh: 男子菁英馬拉松頂尖選手的體脂肪率通常長年維持在百分之六到十的極致精實區間。

entries.definition: 體脂肪；體脂率；體脂肪率；體脂百分比

explains.en: It is the fat stored in a person's body. Too much around internal organs can harm health. Exercise and balanced meals can help manage it.
This tissue stores energy and protects the body, but high levels may increase health risks. Athletes sometimes monitor its percentage. A healthy range differs by person.
Doctors may measure how much of a person's weight comes from stored fat. It is one part of body composition. Healthy habits can affect the amount.

examples.en: Certified personal trainers design customized workout routines for beginners.
examples.zh: 領有國際證照的健身私人教練為剛起步的新手量身打造專屬健身課表。

examples.en: Working out alongside a qualified personal trainer ensures proper lifting form and safety.
examples.zh: 在受過專業培訓的合格私人教練隨側指導下練槓鈴，能確保動作軌跡標準精確並免於運動傷害。

examples.en: She hired a personal trainer to help her regain core strength following spine rehabilitation.
examples.zh: 她在完成脊椎術後物理復健後，專程聘請了一位經驗豐富的私人教練協助她科學恢復深層核心肌力。

explains.en: A fitness coach creates exercises for one client and checks their form. This can help someone learn safely.
A person who wants to build strength may hire a coach to plan workouts. They can encourage good habits.
This professional works with an individual to set fitness goals and practice exercises. Training can be adjusted to that person.

examples.en: The 24-hour fitness center offers flexible monthly gym memberships.
examples.zh: 這間二十四小時全天候健身中心提供極具彈性的月繳型健身房會員會籍。

examples.en: He signed up for an annual gym membership as part of his New Year resolution.
examples.zh: 作為自己落實新年健康新希望的一部分，他下定決心報名辦理了一張連鎖健身房年度會員卡。

examples.en: Read the contract cancellation policy carefully before committing to a multi-year gym membership.
examples.zh: 在衝動簽署長達數年的高額健身房綁約會籍合約之前，請務必先看清合約背面的退費與終止條款細則。

explains.en: Paying for this plan lets someone use a fitness center. Some plans last a month or a year.
Before joining, read the rules about ending the agreement. A gym may offer different payment periods.
A person may pay regularly for access to exercise equipment and classes. It can be part of a New Year's goal.

examples.en: Running on the electric treadmill allows indoor training during rainy days.
examples.zh: 雨天在室內電動跑步機上慢跑讓運動訓練不受天候影響照常進行。

examples.en: You can adjust the incline angle on the motorized treadmill to simulate steep mountain hikes.
examples.zh: 您可以自由調升電動跑步機的坡度揚升角度，在冷氣房內擬真體驗高海拔陡峭登山爬坡訓練。

examples.en: After working non-stop for months, he felt trapped on a relentless corporate treadmill.
examples.zh: 在日復一日無休止高壓加班數月之後，他深切感到自己宛如一隻被困在企業無盡旋轉跑步機上的白老鼠。

examples.en: Setting the treadmill incline to 12% delivers an intense low-impact fat burn.
examples.zh: 將室內跑步機坡度調高至百分之十二並進行快走，能提供高燃脂且低關節衝擊的有氧體驗。

examples.en: She walked at a brisk pace on the treadmill while catching up on an informative podcast.
examples.zh: 她在跑步機上快步健走，一邊收聽充滿知識性的 Podcast 節目充電。

examples.en: When outdoor weather is rainy and cold, running on an indoor treadmill is a great alternative.
examples.zh: 當室外天氣陰雨寒冷時，在室內的跑步機上慢跑是個絕佳的替代訓練方案。

entries.definition: 跑步機；單調繁重的工作

explains.en: This is an exercise machine with a moving belt that lets a person walk or run indoors. The speed or slope can be changed. It is useful on rainy days.
A gym may have many of these machines for running in place. A person can change the incline to make exercise harder. It can also mean a tiring routine that never seems to end.
Use this equipment when you want to walk or run without going outside. It has a belt that moves under your feet. Some people use it while listening to a show.

examples.en: Load weighted plates onto the olympic barbell for heavy bench presses.
examples.zh: 將重訓槓片穩穩裝載至奧林匹克槓鈴桿上準備進行大重量臥推。

examples.en: Learning to balance the barbell evenly across your shoulders is fundamental for back squats.
examples.zh: 掌握將重訓槓鈴桿平穩對稱地架在肩背斜方肌上的平衡技巧，是練好槓鈴後深蹲最核心的基本功。

examples.en: The heavy steel barbell dropped onto the rubber floor mat with a loud thud.
examples.zh: 沉重堅硬的實心鋼製槓鈴重重砸落在加厚橡膠防震減噪地墊上，發出了一聲低沉厚重的悶響。

examples.en: Olympic barbells weigh twenty kilograms and hold cast-iron weight plates.
examples.zh: 健身房標準奧林匹克長槓鈴空槓淨重二十公斤，兩側可自由加掛鑄鐵槓片。

examples.en: He loaded two heavy plates on each side of the barbell for his next deadlift set.
examples.zh: 他在槓鈴兩側各加掛了兩片大槓片，準備進行下一組硬舉。

examples.en: Always secure collar clamps onto the barbell to prevent plates from sliding off during lifts.
examples.zh: 訓練時請務必在槓鈴兩側鎖上槓夾，以防槓片在舉起時晃動滑落。

entries.definition: 槓鈴；奧林匹克標準大槓

explains.en: It is a long metal bar with heavy plates added to each end. People lift it to build strength. Use proper form and a spotter for heavy weights.
Weightlifters hold this exercise tool across their shoulders for squats. The load should be balanced. Beginners can start with a light one.
This piece of gym equipment has a grip between two weighted ends. Athletes use it for presses and lifts. Plates can be added or removed.

examples.en: Taiwan's rugged Central Mountain Range offers world-class mountaineering routes.
examples.zh: 台灣壯麗險峻的中央山脈提供了世界級百岳攀登登山健行路線。

examples.en: Winter mountaineering requires crampons, ice axes, and specialized avalanche rescue beacons.
examples.zh: 挑戰高山雪季冬季高山攀登時，冰爪、冰斧以及專業的雪崩搜救定位訊號器皆為不可或缺的保命裝備。

examples.en: Respecting the unpredictable mountain weather is rule number one in alpine mountaineering.
examples.zh: 發自內心敬畏高山捉摸不定的詭譎天候變化，是從事任何高山攀登探險運動永遠不可違背的第一守則。

examples.en: High-altitude mountaineering demands physical endurance, navigation skills, and mental grit.
examples.zh: 攀登三千公尺以上的高山百岳極度考驗充沛的心肺體能、精準的離線地圖導航與強大心理素質。

examples.en: She took a comprehensive mountaineering safety course before planning her first expedition.
examples.zh: 在規劃自己的首場百岳遠征縱走之前，她報名參加了完整的高山登山安全訓練課程。

examples.en: Taiwan's rugged central ridge offers world-class mountaineering terrain for adventurous hikers.
examples.zh: 台灣險峻高聳的中央山脈主脊樑，為熱愛冒險的山友提供了世界級的壯麗高山攀登地形。

examples.en: Alpine mountaineering in Taiwan's Central Mountain Range demands thorough training and endurance.
examples.zh: 挑戰攀登台灣中央山脈險峻高山縱走，需要扎實體能訓練與強大耐力。

examples.en: She took courses in technical mountaineering before attempting her first winter expedition.
examples.zh: 在嘗試生平第一次雪期遠征之前，她先報名參加了技術性登山訓練課程。

examples.en: Mountaineering clubs organize multi-day treks through the Shei-Pa mountain wilderness each autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，各登山社團都會在雪霸國家公園的崇山荒野中籌辦數日長途縱走。

entries.definition: 登山健行運動；高山攀登；高山登山運動；百岳攀登；百岳縱走攀登

explains.en: Climbers prepare carefully before traveling up high peaks. They may need maps, warm clothes, and special safety equipment.
A group hikes through steep mountain areas and learns to manage weather and routes. This activity requires training.
Going into high mountains can involve rocky paths and changing conditions. Experienced leaders help plan safe trips.

examples.en: The well-maintained hiking trail in Yangmingshan offers scenic valley views.
examples.zh: 陽明山國家公園內維護完善的登山步道能飽覽壯麗的火山山谷景致。

examples.en: Signs along the hiking trail indicate distance markers and estimated walking hours.
examples.zh: 沿著國家步道兩側設立的木質指標牌，清楚標註了每一段里程碑距離與預估徒步所需時間。

examples.en: Volunteers spent the weekend repairing eroded stone steps along the historic hiking trail.
examples.zh: 熱心愛山的修路志工利用週末假期，自備工具悉心修復這條百年古道上因雨水沖刷坍塌的砌石階梯。

explains.en: Walkers follow this marked route through hills or a forest. Signs may show how far it is.
Volunteers can repair worn steps along a mountain path. Hikers use it to enjoy nature.
A well-kept route may lead to a valley or viewpoint. Check the signs for distance and walking time.

examples.en: Ascend mountains gradually to prevent headaches caused by altitude sickness.
examples.zh: 登山時採取漸進式上升步調，以有效防範高山症所引發的劇烈頭痛。

examples.en: Symptoms of acute altitude sickness include nausea, dizziness, insomnia, and shortness of breath.
examples.zh: 急性高山症（AMS）的典型發病症狀包括噁心嘔吐、頭重腳輕、夜間輾轉難眠以及呼吸急促急喘。

examples.en: If altitude sickness worsens, the safest and only effective cure is immediate descent to a lower elevation.
examples.zh: 若病患高山症症狀持續惡化，最安全且唯一具備根本療效的救命解方就是果斷立即下撤至低海拔地區。

entries.definition: 高山症；高海拔缺氧反應

explains.en: This is an illness some people feel at high places where the air has less oxygen. A headache, nausea, or dizziness may happen. Going up slowly can help prevent it.
A climber may feel unwell after going too high too quickly. The safest help is to move down to a lower place. Rest and water may also help.
Use this term for symptoms caused by being high above sea level. A person may feel short of breath or dizzy. It can become serious and needs care.

examples.en: River tracing through Hualien's Golden Canyon includes swimming and cliff jumping.
examples.zh: 在花蓮黃金峽谷進行溯溪探險活動涵蓋了深潭游泳與刺激的跳水挑戰。

examples.en: Wear felt-soled aquatic boots and a certified helmet for protection during river tracing.
examples.zh: 參加溯溪探險時，請務必換穿抓地防滑的專用菜瓜布底溯溪鞋並全程佩戴合格攀岩防護頭盔。

examples.en: Our river tracing expedition navigated turbulent rapids and slippery waterfalls safely.
examples.zh: 我們的溯溪冒險探險隊在資深合格教練的悉心帶領下，順利且平安地征服了湍急白浪與濕滑險峻的瀑布岩壁。

explains.en: It is an outdoor activity where people walk, swim, or climb along a stream. Wear a helmet and proper shoes. Waterfalls and slippery rocks require care.
Adventurers follow a waterway through a canyon. They may swim through pools and climb over rocks. A guide can help keep the group safe.
This activity takes people through a river's path and surrounding rocks. Some routes include deep pools or small cliffs. Check conditions and use safety gear.

examples.en: Green Island and Kenting are internationally famous for pristine scuba diving.
examples.zh: 綠島與墾丁以其清澈湛藍的海水與世界級水肺潛水景點聞名於世。

examples.en: You must complete classroom theory and open-water dives to obtain your scuba diving license.
examples.zh: 您必須完整修習室內學科理論課程並通過多項開放水域下潛考核，方能順利考取國際水肺潛水執照。

examples.en: While scuba diving, keep a safe distance from delicate corals to avoid damaging the reef ecosystem.
examples.zh: 在進行深海水肺潛水漫遊時，請務必與脆弱的珊瑚礁保持安全距離，堅決避免踢觸破壞海洋生態。

examples.en: Green Island and Kenting are renowned destinations for vibrant coral scuba diving.
examples.zh: 綠島與墾丁是名揚四海的水肺潛水勝地，海底坐落著五彩斑斕的熱帶魚群與珊瑚礁。

examples.en: Divers must complete certified training before they can rent gear and go scuba diving.
examples.zh: 潛水同好必須先考取國際認證的開放水域潛水員證照，方能租賃裝備展開水肺潛水。

examples.en: We hovered weightlessly above a colorful reef during an unforgettable scuba diving session.
examples.zh: 在一趟令人難忘的水肺潛水旅程中，我們宛如太空漫步般輕盈無重力地懸浮在七彩珊瑚礁上方。

explains.en: A diver swims underwater while carrying a tank of air and special breathing equipment. Training is important before going into open water.
People explore a coral reef below the sea using a mask, fins, and an air tank. They should avoid touching the coral.
A certified instructor teaches how to check equipment and breathe underwater. Divers follow safety practices with a buddy.

examples.en: Snorkeling in Xiaoliuqiu allows swimmers to observe sea turtles up close.
examples.zh: 在小琉球體驗浮潛讓泳客能近距離靜靜欣賞優雅悠游的野生綠蠵龜。

examples.en: Put on a silicone mask and snorkel tube to breathe easily while looking down at coral reefs.
examples.zh: 戴上貼合臉型的矽膠浮潛面鏡並含緊呼吸管，即可讓您漂浮在海面上輕鬆呼吸、低頭飽覽海底珊瑚世界。

examples.en: Shallow protected lagoons provide a safe, calm environment for beginners trying snorkeling.
examples.zh: 風平浪靜且水深及腰的受庇護淺水潟湖海灣，為剛接觸浮潛的新手提供了極度安全安心的下水環境。

examples.en: Tourists loved snorkeling with wild green sea turtles in crystal-clear Xiaoliuqiu waters.
examples.zh: 遊客在小琉球清澈見底的湛藍海水中與悠游的野生綠蠵龜一同浮潛同樂。

examples.en: Even young children can enjoy snorkeling with a mask, breathing tube, and life vest.
examples.zh: 即便是年幼的孩童，只要戴上面鏡、呼吸管並穿妥救生衣，也能輕鬆享受浮潛的樂趣。

examples.en: The calm, shallow bay provided a safe environment for first-time visitors to try snorkeling.
examples.zh: 這處風平浪靜、水質清澈的淺灣為初次體驗浮潛的遊客提供了一個絕佳安全的環境。

explains.en: Swimmers use a mask and breathing tube to look beneath the water's surface. A life vest helps keep beginners safe.
In a calm bay, visitors may see fish and turtles near a reef. Stay with a guide and do not touch sea life.
This water activity lets people watch underwater life while floating. A protected shallow area is a good place to learn.

examples.en: Wushi Harbor in Yilan is Taiwan's most popular surfing destination.
examples.zh: 宜蘭頭城烏石港是全台灣人氣最旺且浪況極佳的衝浪運動勝地。

examples.en: Surfing enthusiasts monitor offshore wave forecasts to catch clean swells at sunrise.
examples.zh: 熱愛追浪的衝浪好手每日緊盯專業即時海況浪況預報，只為在破曉日出時分搶先迎接最完美乾淨的定點長浪。

examples.en: Maintaining core balance on a foam surfboard requires patience and practice.
examples.zh: 想要在初學者泡棉軟板上穩穩站起並維持身體核心重心平衡，需要傾注極大的耐心與反覆落水嘗試。

examples.en: Yilan's Waiao Beach offers perfect breaking ocean waves for weekend surfing.
examples.zh: 宜蘭頭城外澳海灘擁有得天獨厚的綿延浪況，是北部衝浪客週末逐浪的衝浪勝地。

examples.en: Learning to pop up smoothly on a surfboard takes balance, practice, and paddling power.
examples.zh: 學會敏捷流暢地在衝浪板上迅速起乘站立，需要良好的平衡感、反覆練習與划水臂力。

examples.en: Surf camps in Taitung teach ocean wave safety and paddling fundamentals to beginners.
examples.zh: 台東東河的專業衝浪學校為初學者深入傳授辨識海浪安全知識與基礎划水起乘基本功。

explains.en: This is a water sport in which a person rides on a board across ocean waves. It takes balance and practice. Beginners learn how to stay safe in the water.
A person paddles out and stands on a board as a wave carries them toward shore. Coastal beaches can be popular places for this activity. Camps teach the basics.
Use this noun for riding waves on a board. People watch wave forecasts before going out. It is a popular sport in some beach towns.

examples.en: Stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) on calm Sun Moon Lake at dawn is magical.
examples.zh: 清晨破曉時分在波平如鏡的日月潭體驗 SUP 立式划槳如夢似幻。

examples.en: Balancing on the wide inflatable paddleboarding board is surprisingly easy for beginners.
examples.zh: 站在寬大厚實的充氣式立式划槳充氣板上維持平衡，對初次下水體驗的新手而言其實出乎意料地容易上手。

examples.en: Coastal resorts offer guided sunset paddleboarding tours along limestone cliffs.
examples.zh: 濱海海濱度假村推出了由合格教練隨行護航的日落黃昏立槳行程，引領遊客沿著壯麗石灰岩懸崖悠閒巡航。

explains.en: It is a water sport where a person stands on a wide board and moves with a long paddle. Calm lakes are good places to try it. Beginners can take a lesson.
A rider balances on a board and uses a pole with a blade to travel across the water. Resorts may offer sunset trips. A life jacket is important.
People enjoy this activity on lakes or along a coast. The board is broad enough to stand on. A paddle helps steer and move forward.

examples.en: Always wear a snug certified life jacket when participating in water sports.
examples.zh: 參與任何水域休閒運動時，請務必全程正確穿妥合格浮力救生衣。

examples.en: The kayak rental operator refuses to rent equipment to anyone not wearing a fastened life jacket.
examples.zh: 獨木舟獨木舟租賃業者明文宣導，凡是未依規定完整穿好並繫緊防護救生衣者，一律嚴詞拒絕租借設備。

examples.en: Bright orange life jackets are equipped with reflective strips for high visibility in open water.
examples.zh: 採用鮮豔亮橘色高辨識度布料縫製的專業救生衣，在雙肩均加貼了高反光條，確保在開闊水域能第一時間被搜救發現。

explains.en: Wear this buoyant vest when boating or paddling. It can help keep a person afloat in water.
A bright orange vest with straps should fit snugly before entering a kayak. Keep it fastened.
Children should wear this safety item near water and on boats. It helps support the body if someone falls in.

examples.en: Rock climbers clip ropes securely through forged steel carabiners.
examples.zh: 攀岩好手將主繩索安全確實地扣入高強度鍛造鋼製登山安全扣環中。

examples.en: Always inspect your screw-lock carabiner to confirm the safety gate is tightly fastened.
examples.zh: 在懸空離地前請務必再三檢查旋鎖式安全扣環的保險螺帽，再三確認防脫開口安全閥門已徹底旋緊鎖死。

examples.en: Backpackers clip metal carabiners to their shoulder straps to carry water bottles and sandals.
examples.zh: 戶外背包客常在雙肩背包胸前扣帶上掛上輕巧的鋁合金快扣扣環，隨手扣掛個人環保水壺或拖鞋。

explains.en: This metal clip can attach a water bottle to a backpack. Climbers use stronger kinds to connect ropes.
Check that the small gate closes before putting weight on this safety clip. Some have a screw lock.
A hiker may use this metal fastener to hold gear. Climbers inspect theirs carefully before use.

examples.en: A reliable waterproof LED headlamp is mandatory for overnight alpine treks.
examples.zh: 一支性能可靠且防水的 LED 登山頭燈是進行高山過夜縱走必備裝備。

examples.en: Switching your headlamp to red-light mode preserves night vision inside shared camping tents.
examples.zh: 在多人共享的山屋帳篷內休息時，請主動將頭戴式登山頭燈切換為暗紅光模式，既照明又保護他人夜視力。

examples.en: Always pack extra lithium batteries or a portable power bank for your rechargeable headlamp.
examples.zh: 攀登百岳高山前，千萬切記要為您的充電式高流明頭燈在背包急救包中多預備一組鋰電池或行動電源。

examples.en: Inspect your 400-lumen headlamp and carry extra lithium batteries before early dawn departures.
examples.zh: 在凌晨兩點摸黑起登出發前，請務必再三檢查四百流明高亮度登山頭燈電量並備妥備用電池。

examples.en: Using a headlamp keeps your hands completely free to hold trekking poles and scramble up rocky ledges.
examples.zh: 佩戴頭燈能徹底解放雙手，讓登山者能從容握持登山杖並手腳並用抓握岩壁攀爬直上。

examples.en: Switching your headlamp to red-light mode preserves night vision inside crowded mountain huts.
examples.zh: 在深夜或凌晨進出擁擠的山屋時將頭燈切換至紅光低光模式，能保護夜視力且絕不打擾山友睡眠。

examples.en: The waterproof LED headlamp casts a bright 400-lumen beam for 3:00 AM alpine summit pushes in the dark.
examples.zh: 凌晨三點摸黑出發攻頂時，戴在額頭上的高亮度防水登山頭燈照亮腳下的崎嶇山路。

examples.en: Switch your headlamp to red-light mode inside shared huts to avoid blinding sleeping mountaineers.
examples.zh: 在避難山屋內部請務必將頭燈切換至紅光模式，以免刺眼的白光照醒正在沉睡的山友。

examples.en: Pack spare lithium batteries in a warm inner pocket because sub-zero cold drains headlamp power quickly.
examples.zh: 將備用鋰電池放置在貼身保暖內袋中，因為零下低溫會讓頭燈電力以驚人速度衰減。

entries.definition: 登山頭燈；頭戴式手電筒；登山必備高亮度頭燈；400 流明紅光夜間行進登山頭燈

explains.en: This is a small light worn on a person's head with a strap. It keeps both hands free while walking in the dark. Hikers should carry extra batteries.
A camper can wear this light while setting up a tent at night. Some have a red setting that is easier on night vision. It shines where the wearer looks.
Use this device when you need light and both hands for climbing or walking. It is strapped around the head. Waterproof versions are useful outdoors.

examples.en: Adventurous backpackers explore uncharted mountain trails with enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 充滿冒險探索精神的背包客懷抱無限熱忱探訪鮮為人知的秘境山徑。

examples.en: Trying exotic street delicacies in night markets is fun for adventurous foodies.
examples.zh: 勇於大膽品嚐夜市各類在地罕見特色街頭風味小吃，對於熱愛冒險的美食老饕而言是一大人生樂事。

examples.en: She lived an adventurous life, solo backpacking across fifty different countries on five continents.
examples.zh: 她擁有令人艷羨的精彩冒險人生，曾獨自一人揹著行囊單槍匹馬闖蕩遊歷了全球五大洲的五十多個國家。

entries.definition: 喜愛冒險的；充滿刺激的

explains.en: It describes someone who enjoys trying new or exciting activities. A traveler may explore an unfamiliar trail. A person can also enjoy tasting unusual foods.
A person with this quality is willing to take some risks and discover new places. Backpackers may seek remote routes. They often welcome a challenge.
Use this adjective for people who like exciting experiences. Trying a new dish or visiting another country may appeal to them. It can also describe an exciting life.

examples.en: Ang Lee's groundbreaking filmmaking won two Academy Awards for Best Director.
examples.zh: 李安導演開創性的電影執導製作藝術二度榮獲奧斯卡最佳導演獎。

examples.en: Digital cameras and accessible editing software have democratized independent filmmaking.
examples.zh: 數位攝影機的普及與剪輯軟體的親民化，大幅降低了獨立電影拍攝製作的門檻。

examples.en: She enrolled in a summer cinema workshop to master the fundamental grammar of filmmaking.
examples.zh: 她報名參加了暑期電影實務工作坊，專注學習並掌握電影製作中最核心的視聽語言文法。

explains.en: A team plans a story, records scenes with a camera, and edits the footage into a movie. Many people help make a film.
Students may learn lighting, sound, and editing at a summer media workshop. They practice creating short movies.
The process includes planning, acting, filming, and putting scenes together. A director guides much of the work.

examples.en: The witty screenplay received unanimous acclaim at the film festival.
examples.zh: 這部節奏明快、對白詼諧的電影劇本在國際影展上獲得評審一致盛讚。

examples.en: Writing a compelling screenplay requires sharp dialogue, tight pacing, and well-developed characters.
examples.zh: 創做出一部扣人心弦的電影劇本，需要有鋒利睿智的對白台詞、緊湊明快的節奏與立體飽滿的角色。

examples.en: The original screenplay was nominated for an Academy Award thanks to its unexpected twist ending.
examples.zh: 這部原創電影劇本憑藉著片尾令人拍案叫絕的大反轉結局，強勢入圍了奧斯卡金像獎最佳原創劇本提名。

examples.en: The original screenplay earned the prestigious Golden Horse Award for Best Writing.
examples.zh: 這部深刻描繪台灣在地家庭情感的原創電影劇本榮獲金馬獎最佳原著劇本大獎。

examples.en: Adapting a complex seven-hundred-page historical novel into a tight two-hour screenplay took two years.
examples.zh: 將厚達七百頁的複雜歷史長篇小說改編為兩小時精煉電影劇本，耗費了編劇整整兩年心血。

examples.en: The screenwriter revised the dialogue in the screenplay to enhance natural pacing and comedic timing.
examples.zh: 編劇反覆推敲修改劇本中的角色台詞，以提升整場對白的生活節奏感與幽默喜感。

entries.definition: 電影劇本；腳本；劇作腳本

explains.en: This written plan tells actors what to say and do in a film. It includes dialogue and scenes.
A writer may adapt a long book into a shorter story for the screen. Careful words help the story flow.
Before filming, the director and actors use this document to understand each scene. It can contain an unexpected twist.

examples.en: Talented screenwriters adapt classic novels into compelling movie scripts.
examples.zh: 才華橫溢的優秀編劇將經典文學名著改編為扣人心弦的電影劇本。

examples.en: The television screenwriter spent months researching medical terminology for the hospital drama series.
examples.zh: 這位資深電視影集編劇花費數月深入醫院田野調查，為即將開拍的醫療旗艦大戲搜集專業醫學術語。

examples.en: Thousands of screenwriters went on strike to demand fair residual payments from streaming giants.
examples.zh: 數以千計的好萊塢職業編劇集體發起歷史性大罷工，嚴正要求國際串流媒體巨頭支付合理的重播版稅酬勞。

explains.en: This person writes the words and scenes for a movie or television show. They may adapt a book into a script. Research helps make the story believable.
A writer creates the story that actors perform on screen. They may spend months preparing it. Some focus on television series or films.
This job involves writing dialogue and actions for a movie. The writer may work with a director. Their script guides what happens in each scene.

examples.en: Animators drew detailed storyboards to visualize complex action sequences.
examples.zh: 動畫師繪製了極為細緻的分鏡圖，以視覺化呈現複雜的武打動作場面。

examples.en: The director reviewed the drawn storyboard sketches to plan camera angles and lighting setups.
examples.zh: 導演在開拍前逐一審閱精心手繪的分鏡草圖，以預先規劃各個分鏡的鏡頭機位與打光佈置。

examples.en: Creating a scene-by-scene storyboard saves valuable time and budget during actual production days.
examples.zh: 在前期繪製出鉅細靡遺的分鏡腳本，能在劇組正式進駐片場開機拍攝時節省大量的寶貴時間與製作預算。

examples.en: Animators sketched detailed storyboards to plan complex superhero action sequences.
examples.zh: 動畫師與動作指導精心繪製出上百張詳盡的分鏡腳本，以預先規劃複雜的超能力打鬥運鏡。

examples.en: Reviewing the illustrated storyboard helps the entire crew visualize camera angles and lighting setups.
examples.zh: 逐格檢視圖文並茂的分鏡腳本圖稿，能幫助全體劇組直觀預視攝影鏡位與燈光打光佈局。

examples.en: The director pinned dynamic storyboard sketches onto the studio production wall to brief the camera operators.
examples.zh: 導演將動態分鏡草圖一張張釘在攝影棚會議室牆面上，向全體攝影團隊詳細解說運鏡軌跡。

entries.definition: 分鏡腳本；分鏡圖；故事板圖稿

explains.en: It is a series of drawings that shows how scenes in a film or animation will look. Directors use it to plan camera angles. It can save time during production.
Before filming, a team may sketch each important scene in order. This visual plan helps everyone understand the action. Animators often make one.
A creator draws panels to map out a video or movie. The pictures show what happens from scene to scene. It can guide the camera crew.

examples.en: Hundreds of aspiring actors showed up for the leading role audition.
examples.zh: 數百名懷抱星夢的年輕演員前來參加男女主角公開選拔試鏡。

examples.en: She practiced her Shakespeare monologue for weeks before walking nervously into the theater audition.
examples.zh: 她將莎士比亞經典獨白反覆苦練了數週之久，才深呼吸走進令所有演員屏息緊張的劇團甄選試演會。

examples.en: The prestigious orchestra audition evaluated sight-reading, musicality, and technical precision.
examples.zh: 這場頂級國家交響樂團的正式團員甄選考核，全方位評測了應試者的視奏能力、音樂性與技巧精準度。

examples.en: Over five hundred aspiring actors attended open auditions for the teenage role.
examples.zh: 超過五百位懷抱演藝夢想的青年演員積極參加了這部青春校園熱血電影的公開主角試鏡。

examples.en: She felt nervous before her Broadway musical audition, but her vocal performance brought goosebumps.
examples.zh: 在百老匯音樂劇試鏡開始前她手心直冒冷汗，但一開口驚艷絕倫的高音唱腔震撼全場評委。

examples.en: He was invited to audition for the role of the enigmatic detective after the director saw his indie short.
examples.zh: 導演在看過他在獨立短片中的亮眼表現後，主動邀請他前來參加神秘偵探一角的試鏡。

examples.en: Over five hundred aspiring dancers attended competitive open auditions for the international musical tour.
examples.zh: 超過五百位懷抱舞台夢想的優秀舞蹈家齊聚一堂，爭取百老匯年度跨國巡迴音樂劇的少數錄取席位。

examples.en: She practiced her musical solo for three straight weeks before stepping into the casting director's audition room.
examples.zh: 為了在選角導演面前展現實力，她足足閉關苦練自選音樂劇詠嘆調長達三週，全力衝刺這場關鍵試鏡。

examples.en: Producers invited seasoned voice actors to audition for the main character in the animated feature.
examples.zh: 動畫長片製作團隊力邀多位資深實力派配音演員參與公開試音試鏡，期盼為主角挑選最具感染力的靈魂聲線。

entries.definition: 試鏡；試演；參加試鏡；演員試鏡；參加試鏡遴選；劇團演員公開試鏡徵選

explains.en: An actor performs a short scene so a director can decide whether to choose them for a part. Musicians may do the same for an orchestra.
A singer practices a song before meeting the casting team. The performance helps decide who will get a role.
A dancer shows their skills in front of judges when applying for a show. They hope to be selected.

examples.en: The story follows a resilient female protagonist overcoming family hardship.
examples.zh: 故事主線圍繞著一位堅毅不拔、勇敢克服家庭逆境的女主角展開。

examples.en: Unlike traditional heroic protagonists, the movie features a morally ambiguous antihero as its central character.
examples.zh: 與傳統高大全的正義英雄主角不同，該部電影大膽採用了一位道德邊緣遊走的非典型反英雄作為核心主角。

examples.en: Readers deeply empathize with the young protagonist as he navigates grief and newfound courage.
examples.zh: 廣大讀者在閱讀中與這位年少主人公產生了深刻的共情，陪伴他一同走過喪親之痛並重拾面對未來的勇氣。

examples.en: The shonen protagonist never gives up fighting to protect cherished companions.
examples.zh: 經典熱血少年漫的主角無論面臨多麼絕望的逆境，也絕不輕言放棄保護摯愛同伴。

examples.en: An endearing protagonist must show vulnerability and undergo meaningful emotional growth.
examples.zh: 一位深得人心的主角不能總是完美無瑕，必須展現出人性的脆弱並經歷深刻的心智成長。

examples.en: The novel is told through the perspective of a thoughtful and observant young protagonist.
examples.zh: 整本小說皆是透過這位心思細膩、觀察入微的年輕主人公的第一人稱視角娓娓道來。

examples.en: The courageous protagonist fights relentlessly against systemic corruption to rescue her hometown.
examples.zh: 這位堅毅勇敢的女主角（Protagonist）為了拯救心愛的故鄉小鎮，不畏強權展開了一場壯烈的抗爭。

examples.en: Unlike flawless storybook heroes, modern audiences gravitate toward a flawed, relatable protagonist.
examples.zh: 有別於傳統完美無瑕的童話英雄，現代劇迷更偏愛有弱點、有血有肉且貼近常人心理的核心主角。

examples.en: Readers follow the protagonist from his humble village origins to becoming an influential community reformer.
examples.zh: 讀者跟隨故事主角的生命步伐，見證他如何從偏鄉農村的清貧學子逐步成長為推動社會改革的時代領航者。

entries.definition: 主角；男／女主角；熱血男／女主角；故事靈魂核心主角

explains.en: This is the main character in a story. Readers follow what happens to this person.
A brave young person may face a difficult problem in a novel. The character at the center of the story is this one.
Some stories have a hero with flaws who changes over time. This word names the central character.

examples.en: A charismatic antagonist makes superhero movies much more captivating.
examples.zh: 一個充滿個人魅力與複雜層次的反派角色能讓超級英雄電影更具張力。

examples.en: The psychological thriller pit a brilliant detective against a calculating and cold-blooded antagonist.
examples.zh: 這部心理驚悚鉅作讓一位明察秋毫的刑警偵探，與一位心機深沉、冷酷無情的幕後反派展開智力對決。

examples.en: Great storytellers ensure that the main antagonist possesses believable motivations rather than cartoonish evil.
examples.zh: 頂級的故事大師總會賦予核心反派人物合情合理且極具說服力的心理動機，而非單薄臉譜化的純粹作惡。

examples.en: A compelling antagonist with tragic backstory adds profound narrative depth.
examples.zh: 一位身世背景複雜且充滿悲劇色彩的深刻反派角色能為整部史詩作品增添厚重層次。

examples.en: The dynamic rivalry between the fearless hero and cunning antagonist drives the entire narrative.
examples.zh: 英勇無畏的主角與城府極深的反派宿敵之間宿命般的強強碰撞，推動了整個故事情節。

examples.en: Rather than being purely evil, the best antagonists act upon believable motivations and beliefs.
examples.zh: 真正優秀立體的經典反派往往並非單純臉譜化的殘酷邪惡，而是堅守著自身深信不疑的信念。

examples.en: A multi-dimensional antagonist evokes complex empathy rather than simple hatred from the audience.
examples.zh: 一位塑造層次豐富、有血有肉的反派角色（Antagonist），往往能引發觀眾更深層的情感共鳴與人性反思。

examples.en: The gripping conflict between the idealistic detective and the cunning antagonist forms the narrative backbone.
examples.zh: 滿懷理想正義的青年刑警與深藏不露的狡黠反派之間的智勇交鋒，構築了全劇扣人心弦的敘事脊梁。

examples.en: In pharmacology, an antagonist is a compound that binds to cell receptors to block biological actions.
examples.zh: 在生醫藥理學中，「拮抗劑」（Antagonist）是指能特異性結合細胞受體進而阻斷特定生理效應的化學分子。

examples.en: Administering an IL-6 receptor antagonist promptly halted severe inflammation and broke the patient's fever.
examples.zh: 即時注射 IL-6 受體「單株抗體拮抗劑」（Antagonist），在數小時內迅速撲滅全身性急性發炎並退燒。

examples.en: The gripping detective novel pitted the clever detective against a ruthless mastermind antagonist.
examples.zh: 這本引人入勝的懸疑推理小說，生動刻劃了機智敏銳的名偵探與冷血狡猾的反派大魔頭之間的生死鬥智。

examples.en: Pharmacologists formulated an opioid antagonist spray that rapidly reverses narcotics overdoses in emergency rooms.
examples.zh: 藥理學家成功研發出一款鴉片受體拮抗劑鼻噴劑，能在急診室第一時間快速逆轉麻醉止痛藥過量休克。

entries.definition: 反派角色；主要對手；宿敵大魔王；戲劇反派對立角色；對手；IL-6 受體單株抗體救援拮抗劑 (托珠單抗)

explains.en: In a story, this is a person or force that opposes the main character. Their actions create conflict. They can have understandable reasons for what they do.
A detective may face a clever rival in a mystery. This opposing character drives the plot. In science, the same word can name a substance that blocks an effect in the body.
Use this term for a character who stands against the hero's goals. The person need not be purely evil. In medicine, it can also mean a compound that blocks another's action.

examples.en: He won the Golden Horse Award for Best Supporting Actor.
examples.zh: 他憑藉著入木三分的精湛演技榮獲金馬獎最佳男配角獎殊榮。

examples.en: An exceptional supporting actor can often steal the scene from the main leads with nuanced acting.
examples.zh: 一位演技爐火純青的頂級配角演員，往往能憑藉細膩傳神的眼神與微表情在關鍵場次中技驚全場。

examples.en: The Academy nominated five veteran performers for the Best Supporting Actor category this year.
examples.zh: 美國電影學院今年在奧斯卡最佳男配角獎項中，隆重提名了五位在各大佳作中表現亮眼的資深實力派戲骨。

explains.en: It is a performer with an important role that is not the main character. The person may win an award for strong work. A good performance can draw attention.
A film has central characters and other significant roles. Someone in this role helps develop the story. Their acting can be memorable.
This performer helps tell the story alongside the lead actors. The role may be brief but meaningful. Awards recognize work in this category.

examples.en: The famous pop singer made a surprise cameo appearance as a barista.
examples.zh: 華語流行天王在電影中驚喜客串飾演一名咖啡館店長彩蛋。

examples.en: Film buffs cheered when the creator of the comic book series made his signature cameo in the subway scene.
examples.zh: 當原著超級英雄漫畫創作者在熱鬧的地鐵車廂場景中完成其招牌式客串彩蛋時，全場漫威影迷起立歡呼。

examples.en: She agreed to do a brief one-minute cameo in her director friend's debut feature film.
examples.zh: 為了力挺摯友導演的長片處女作，她欣然答應在片中客串出演一個時長僅有一分鐘的驚喜短鏡頭。

examples.en: The famous pop singer made a humorous two-minute cameo appearance as a barista.
examples.zh: 超人氣金曲歌王在電影中驚喜客串演出了兩分鐘幽默風趣的咖啡店吧檯咖啡師。

examples.en: Comic book creator Stan Lee was famous for his delightful cameo appearances in Marvel blockbuster films.
examples.zh: 漫威之父史丹李以在各大超級英雄漫威大片中驚喜客串亮相彩蛋而深受全球影迷津津樂道。

examples.en: She wore a delicate antique cameo brooch pinned to the lapel of her tailored wool coat.
examples.zh: 她在合身羊毛大衣翻領上別了一枚雕工精細入微的古董浮雕貝殼胸針，盡顯高雅品味。

entries.definition: 客串演出；彩蛋客串；名人驚喜客串演出；浮雕首飾

explains.en: A well-known actor appears briefly in a movie, sometimes playing themself. Viewers may be surprised to see them.
A comic artist makes a short appearance in a film based on their characters. The role lasts only a little while.
A famous singer plays a small part in a friend’s movie. This brief appearance is easy to miss.

examples.en: Dangerous motorcycle chase scenes were performed by a skilled stunt double.
examples.zh: 驚險萬分的重機街頭追逐搏命鏡頭皆由專業特技替身演員親自上陣。

examples.en: The stunt double wore identical costume and makeup to seamlessly match the lead actress during action scenes.
examples.zh: 在火爆激烈的動作打鬥戲份中，特技替身演員換上了與女主角毫無二致的戲服妝容以確保畫面剪輯天衣無縫。

examples.en: Hollywood stunt doubles receive specialized combat, gymnastic, and precision driving training.
examples.zh: 好萊塢專業特技替身演員長年接受高強度的特工格鬥防身、高空體操空翻以及極限特技精準駕駛嚴格培訓。

explains.en: This trained performer acts in place of a movie star during a dangerous scene. A costume helps them look alike.
A skilled driver or gymnast may do an action scene that could hurt an actor. The camera makes the change hard to see.
Film makers use this performer for risky jumps or fights. Special training helps keep the person safe.

examples.en: Mark Lee Ping-bing's poetic cinematography captures natural light masterfully.
examples.zh: 李屏賓大師詩意典雅的電影攝影美學巧妙捕捉了自然光影的極致之美。

examples.en: The breathtaking cinematography of the high alpine landscapes elevated the entire film's visual poetry.
examples.zh: 片中那一幕幕壯闊窒息的高山雪峰畫面，其絕美的電影攝影構圖將整部作品的視覺美學意境推向了巔峰。

examples.en: Students in the film academy analyze classic black-and-white cinematography to understand light and shadow.
examples.zh: 電影學院的攝影系學子深入反覆臨摹影史經典黑白電影攝影大作，以徹底悟透黑白明暗與光影雕刻的精髓。

examples.en: Breathtaking natural lighting cinematography captured the misty mountain vistas.
examples.zh: 巧奪天工、全然採用天然光線的電影攝影美學，將台灣群山雲霧繚繞的意境完美凝結於銀幕。

examples.en: The film won several awards for its innovative cinematography and dynamic camera movements.
examples.zh: 該片憑藉開創性的電影攝影美學與動態流暢的運鏡調度，橫掃多項國際大獎。

examples.en: Masterful cinematography uses shadow, color palettes, and perspective to build emotional depth.
examples.zh: 精湛入微的電影攝影巧妙運用光影明暗、色彩基調與透視構圖，建構出深邃的角色情感。

entries.definition: 電影攝影術；攝影美學風格；電影攝影美學

explains.en: This is the art of choosing and recording images for a movie. Camera movement, light, and color help tell the story. Students may study how shadows create a mood.
A film's visual style depends on how the camera captures each scene. A skilled team uses light and perspective. Their choices can make a landscape look poetic.
Use this term for the camera work and visual design of a film. It includes lighting and framing. Good choices can add emotion to a story.

examples.en: The intense close-up revealed silent tears glistening in her eyes.
examples.zh: 緊湊深情的臉部特寫鏡頭捕捉到了她眼眶中閃爍噙著的無聲淚水。

examples.en: The director used an extreme close-up of the suspect's twitching finger to convey inner panic.
examples.zh: 導演在審訊高潮特意切換了一個嫌犯手指不自覺微微顫抖的極限大特寫，淋漓盡致地傳遞出其內心的極度崩潰恐慌。

examples.en: Unlike stage plays where gestures must be large, film close-ups capture microscopic emotional shifts.
examples.zh: 與舞台劇肢體動作必須誇張放大不同，大銀幕上的面部特寫鏡頭能將演員最微小細膩的情感波動展現無遺。

examples.en: An extreme close-up of trembling hands revealed the detective's hidden terror.
