explains.en: It is a robot that can move around a workplace without following a fixed track. Cameras and sensors help it avoid obstacles. Warehouses may use several.
Hospitals or factories can use these mobile machines to carry supplies. They map their surroundings and choose a path. Unlike older vehicles, they can go around objects.
This kind of robot moves independently through a building. It can transport materials between work areas. It uses sensors to navigate safely.

examples.en: High-speed sortation cross-belt systems sort 30,000 packages every single hour.
examples.zh: 高速交叉帶自動分揀系統每小時可精準分揀高達三萬件各大超商網購包裹。

examples.en: Barcode scanners integrated into the sortation conveyor direct parcels to their designated city postal bins.
examples.zh: 與分揀輸送帶緊密整合的高速條碼掃描相機，能精準將飛馳而過的外送包裹分流彈射至對應的各縣市郵遞格位。

examples.en: Investing in automated sortation machinery reduced order processing bottlenecks ahead of the Double 11 shopping festival.
examples.zh: 大手筆投資引進全自動高速分揀機械流水線，成功在一年一度的雙十一電商購物狂歡節前夕徹底消弭了出貨卡關瓶頸。

explains.en: A warehouse scans parcels and sends each one toward the correct delivery route. Conveyor belts may help move them quickly.
Workers separate packages by their destination before trucks leave. A scanner reads each label.
A large center uses belts and machines to direct parcels into different bins. This step helps prepare orders for delivery.

examples.en: Luggage rolls smoothly from airplane cargo holds onto the airport conveyor belt.
examples.zh: 託運行李自飛機貨艙平穩卸下並直接送上航廈行李輸送帶轉盤供旅客提領。

examples.en: Diners seated around the revolving sushi counter pick up fresh sashimi plates from the moving conveyor belt.
examples.zh: 環繞著旋轉壽司吧檯而坐的老饕食客，隨心所欲從眼前緩緩流轉的食材傳送帶上取下剛捏好的新鮮生魚片握壽司。

examples.en: Technicians inspect goods along the factory conveyor belt to catch cosmetic flaws before packaging.
examples.zh: 品管檢驗技師駐守在工廠傳送帶兩側，在商品進入裝盒打包工序之前，全神貫注剔除任何有微小外觀瑕疵的半成品。

explains.en: Suitcases move along this wide moving surface at an airport. Passengers wait beside it to collect their bags.
A factory uses a moving strip to carry products between workers. The equipment keeps goods traveling in order.
At a sushi restaurant, plates may pass beside diners on a circular moving band. Workers can check goods as they travel.

examples.en: Taipei was ranked among global top ten smartest cities for digital governance.
examples.zh: 台北市憑藉卓越的數位治理與智慧市民服務名列全球前十大智慧城市。

examples.en: Key indicators of a thriving smart city include real-time public transit tracking, digital citizen services, and green energy.
examples.zh: 衡量一座繁榮發展之智慧城市的關鍵核心指標，涵蓋即時公車動態追蹤、一站式數位便民服務以及普及的潔淨綠能。

examples.en: Singapore is widely recognized as a pioneering model for international smart city development.
examples.zh: 新加坡在善用數據科技治理城市方面的卓越開創性實踐，被各國公認為當代全球智慧城市規劃建設的典範標竿。

explains.en: This is a city that uses digital tools and data to improve services such as transportation and energy. People may track buses in real time. Clean power can be part of the plan.
A city may use technology to make public services easier to access. Digital systems can help residents renew documents. Good planning also includes parks and efficient transport.
Use this term for an urban area that applies technology to solve everyday problems. Sensors may help manage traffic. The goal is to improve life for residents.

examples.en: Transparent data-driven urban governance optimizes city budget allocations.
examples.zh: 以數據為導向的透明市政都市治理能最大程度精準優化市府預算資源分配。

examples.en: Sound corporate governance establishes clear ethical guidelines and prevents conflicts of interest among board directors.
examples.zh: 健全卓越的企業公司治理架構能確立清晰嚴明的商業道德準則，並徹底防杜董事會成員之間發生任何利益衝突。

examples.en: Citizens demand democratic accountability and participatory governance at all levels of public administration.
examples.zh: 現代成熟公民社會強烈要求各級公法人行政機關，在施政過程中必須切實落實民主監督制衡與全民參與式治理。

examples.en: International AI governance frameworks establish safety standards for high-risk autonomous systems.
examples.zh: 國際組織全面制定「人工智慧治理」（AI Governance）框架，針對自駕車與醫療高風險領域設立嚴格安全紅線。

examples.en: Strong corporate governance and independent board oversight protect minority shareholder investments.
examples.zh: 健全規範的公司治理制度與具備超然獨立性的獨立董事監督機制，能切實保護廣大小股東的合法投資權益。

examples.en: Transparent public governance builds long-term civic trust between democratic institutions and citizens.
examples.zh: 公開透明的公共治理方針與開放政府資訊平台，是建立民主憲政體制與全體公民之間深厚信任的堅實基石。

examples.en: Establishing an independent Sustainability Committee ensures strong boardroom climate governance.
examples.zh: 在董事會轄下設立獨立運作的「永續發展委員會」，能確保企業高層具備高瞻遠矚的氣候治理決策力（Governance）。

examples.en: Good public governance requires upholding the rule of law, protecting press freedom, and preventing corruption.
examples.zh: 卓越健全的國家民主公共治理體系，在於堅定恪守憲政法治、保障新聞言論自由，並堅決防止公務官僚體系貪腐。

examples.en: The decentralized open-source community votes on protocol upgrades through democratic on-chain governance.
examples.zh: 去中心化開源區塊鏈技術社群，透過全體代幣持有人投票的鏈上鏈上民主治理投票，自主決策底層協議的升級路線。

entries.definition: 治理；管理機制；統治；人工智慧倫理治理與法規；管理；董事會永續氣候治理決策架構

explains.en: It is the way an organization or city is directed and managed. Clear rules can help prevent conflicts. Citizens may ask leaders to be accountable.
A company uses policies and decision-making structures to guide its actions. Good management can set ethical standards. The term also applies to public administration.
This noun describes how leaders make decisions and oversee an organization. Transparency can build trust. It may include rules, responsibilities, and oversight.

examples.en: Smart traffic lights adjust green light duration dynamically based on queue length.
examples.zh: 智慧動態號誌紅綠燈能根據路口車流排隊長度即時微調綠燈秒數以疏解車潮。

examples.en: AI-powered smart traffic lights prioritize approaching fire engines and ambulances automatically.
examples.zh: 導入人工智慧視覺辨識的智慧交通號誌，能主動感應並全自動為緊急馳援的消防車與救護車開啟綠燈優先通行。

examples.en: Installing smart traffic lights along major commuter boulevards reduced average morning commute times by fifteen percent.
examples.zh: 沿著市區多條主要通勤林蔭大道全線廣設智慧動態號誌燈後，成功將早尖峰市民平均通勤耗時大幅削減了一成五。

explains.en: A road signal uses cameras or sensors to notice how many cars are waiting. It can adjust its timing to the traffic.
An ambulance approaches, and the signal system may help give it a clear route. Sensors provide information to the controller.
Instead of following the same timing all day, a road signal can respond to changing traffic. It may help reduce long waits.

examples.en: Expanded metro MRT lines successfully relieved downtown road congestion.
examples.zh: 捷運新路線網絡的不斷延伸與擴建成功大幅緩解了市中心道路交通壅塞。

examples.en: Using a saline nasal spray helps clear up severe sinus congestion during winter colds.
examples.zh: 在冬季罹患重感冒時使用溫和的生理食鹽水噴鼻劑沖洗鼻腔，有助於迅速緩解令人痛苦不堪的鼻竇鼻塞腫脹。

examples.en: Congestion pricing in central London encourages drivers to switch to public transit during peak hours.
examples.zh: 英國倫敦市中心所推行的高額交通壅塞費政策，極為有效地促使廣大車主在早晚尖峰時段果斷改搭大眾運輸工具。

explains.en: Too many cars on a road can make travel slow. A longer train line may help reduce it.
A person's nose may feel blocked during a cold. Saline spray can sometimes help clear it.
This word can describe crowded roads or a blocked nose. The surrounding sentence shows which meaning is intended.

examples.en: High-definition surveillance cameras protect neighborhood security across the city.
examples.zh: 高畫質治安監視錄影機（CCTV）全天候默默守護著全台各社區鄰里的公共安防。

examples.en: Traffic police reviewed surveillance camera footage to determine the exact cause of the intersection collision.
examples.zh: 交通警察透過反覆調閱十字路口高空監視錄影機的超清監視畫面，迅速精準還原並釐清了擦撞事故的真實肇因。

examples.en: Modern surveillance cameras feature night-vision infrared sensors and cloud motion alerts.
examples.zh: 現代化先進居家監控攝影機全面配備了紅外線夜視感應功能，並能在偵測到異常人形移動時秒發雲端警訊。

entries.definition: 閉路監視攝影機；天眼監視器 (CCTV)

explains.en: This is a camera placed to watch a public or private area for safety. Police may review its recording after an accident. Some can see in the dark.
A shop or street may have this device to monitor activity. It records what happens and can help identify a problem. It may send alerts when it detects movement.
Use this phrase for a camera that observes an area to help keep it safe. Traffic workers can check its video after a collision. It may have night vision.

examples.en: The national smart grid integrates solar, wind, and battery storage seamlessly.
examples.zh: 國家智慧電網能將太陽光電、風力發電與大型儲能系統進行無縫智慧調度。

examples.en: When extreme weather threatens the power line, the smart grid automatically reroutes electricity around the damage.
examples.zh: 當極端強烈暴風雨肆虐毀損某處高壓電塔輸電線路時，智慧電網能毫秒級自動繞道切換迴路以保障下游民生供電。

examples.en: Smart grids allow homeowners with solar panels to sell surplus electricity back to the municipal utility company.
examples.zh: 智慧電網具備雙向供電特性，讓家戶屋頂裝有太陽能光電板的尋常百姓能將白晝發出的富餘綠電反向售回給台電公司。

explains.en: It is an electricity network that uses digital tools to manage power. It can combine solar panels, wind, and battery storage. It may reroute electricity around damage.
Sensors help this network respond when a power line fails. Homes with solar panels may send extra electricity back. It connects energy producers and users.
A modern power system can monitor electricity use and adjust distribution automatically. This may improve reliability. It can support renewable sources.

examples.en: Installing a home smart meter allows residents to track hourly power usage online.
examples.zh: 家中安裝智慧電表能讓住戶隨時在手機線上查看每小時即時用電量與電費。

examples.en: The power utility company uses digital smart meters to read consumption remotely without sending technicians to houses.
examples.zh: 國營電力公司全面推廣數位智慧電表，後台電腦遠端即可自動完成抄表作業，徹底淘汰了挨家挨戶人工抄表的傳統模式。

examples.en: Analyzing data from your smart meter helps you identify power-hungry appliances that inflate your electric bill.
examples.zh: 透過智慧手機 App 深度剖析智慧電表回傳的每小時用電大數據，能精準揪出暗中推高您家昂貴夏季電費的吃電怪獸家電。

explains.en: A digital device records how much electricity a home uses and can send readings to the utility. Residents may view their use online.
This device helps track power use at different times of day. A technician may be able to read it remotely.
A household can see its energy use without someone checking a dial by hand. The utility receives readings electronically.

examples.en: The hospital's emergency generators kicked in within seconds during the power outage.
examples.zh: 醫院內的緊急備用發電機在無預警突發停電發生的數秒之內立即自動啟動供電。

examples.en: The massive earthquake severed high-voltage transmission lines, plunging three million households into a sudden power outage.
examples.zh: 毀滅性強烈大地震震斷了山區超高壓主要輸電線路，瞬間導致全台超過三百萬戶城鄉家庭陷入一片漆黑的突發大停電。

examples.en: Keep emergency flashlights, bottled water, and battery-powered radios handy in case of an unexpected summer power outage.
examples.zh: 平時在家中應當常備充飽電的應急強光手電筒、瓶裝飲用水與吃電池的手搖收音機，以防酷夏無預警停電事故。

explains.en: A storm or earthquake may stop electricity from reaching homes. Keep a flashlight and water ready.
When the lights go off in a hospital, a backup generator can start quickly. This event can affect many houses.
A sudden loss of electrical service may happen after wires are damaged. Battery-powered radios are useful then.

examples.en: Small businesses embrace cloud digitalization to streamline order processing.
examples.zh: 中小企業與傳統老店積極擁抱雲端數位化轉型以全面簡化接單與出貨流程。

examples.en: Digitalization of hospital medical records allows doctors to access patient health history across clinics instantly.
examples.zh: 全國各大醫院病歷資料庫的全面數位化連線，使主治醫師在跨院看診時能秒速調閱病患過往完整的歷史就診用藥紀錄。

examples.en: The government's digitalization initiative enables citizens to renew passports and pay taxes entirely online.
examples.zh: 政府積極推動的全面數位化便民新政，讓廣大國民足不出戶即可在線上完成護照換發申請與綜合所得稅試算申報。

explains.en: This is changing paper records or other work into digital forms that computers can use. A hospital may put patient files online. Citizens can renew documents on a website.
A business can move orders and records from paper to computer systems. This may make work faster. People can access information across different offices.
Use this noun for adopting digital technology in services and work. A government may let residents pay taxes online. It can make information easier to reach.

examples.en: Taiwan's Open Data portal provides free real-time transit and air quality datasets.
examples.zh: 台灣政府資料開放平台提供免費的高品質即時大眾運輸動態與空氣品質開放數據。

examples.en: App developers utilized government open data to create popular real-time bus tracking and rainfall alert applications.
examples.zh: 許多民間優秀軟體開發團隊善用政府釋出的開放資料 API，成功打造出多款大受民眾歡迎的即時公車到站與降雨警示 App。

examples.en: Publishing public budget figures as structured open data increases government transparency and discourages corruption.
examples.zh: 將各級政府機關的年度公共預算編列與執行細目以標準化格式向全社會完全開放，能極大化提升政務透明度並防遏貪腐弊端。

entries.definition: 政府開放資料；公共開放數據

explains.en: It is information that anyone can access and reuse, often from a government website. Developers may build bus-tracking apps with it. Sharing budgets can improve transparency.
Public organizations sometimes provide free datasets about transit or air quality. People can download them and create useful tools. The files should be easy to use.
This information is made available for people to view and reuse. It may include public spending or weather records. Sharing it can help communities understand decisions.

examples.en: Responsible digital citizens verify news facts before sharing viral online posts.
examples.zh: 具備高度素養的現代數位公民在社群轉發熱門貼文前皆會嚴謹查證新聞真實性。

examples.en: Teaching schoolchildren how to be safe, respectful digital citizens is a core goal of the modern media literacy curriculum.
examples.zh: 從小教導中小學生如何在浩瀚網路世界中保護個人隱私並成為彼此尊重的優質數位公民，是當代媒體識讀教育的核心主旨。

examples.en: Active digital citizens participate in online public forums to propose and debate new civic policies.
examples.zh: 具備公共意識的熱心數位公民，積極踴躍在政府公共政策網路參與平台上針對各項新政提出富有建設性的公民建言。

explains.en: A person checks whether an online story is true before sharing it. They treat others respectfully on the internet.
Students learn to protect private information and be kind in online discussions. These are responsible online habits.
Someone participates in internet communities and follows safe, respectful practices. This person has a role in the digital world.

examples.en: Engineers built a 3D digital twin of the city to simulate flood evacuation routes.
examples.zh: 工程專家為整座城市構建了 3D 數位雙生虛擬模型以精準模擬洪澇疏散路線。

examples.en: The semiconductor foundry created a digital twin of its cleanroom to optimize wafer manufacturing yields.
examples.zh: 頂尖晶圓代工龍頭為旗下先進無塵室廠房打造了高擬真數位分身，以極致優化十二吋晶圓的整體量產良率。

examples.en: Operating a real-time digital twin allows technicians to detect invisible machinery vibrations before a factory line breaks.
examples.zh: 運作高精度即時數位雙生系統，能讓工程技師在產線機台發生致命停機故障前，敏銳探測並揪出肉眼難辨的微小異常機械震動。

entries.definition: 數位雙生；數位分身模型

explains.en: Engineers may build a computer model of a real city to test flood routes. The model can copy how things work.
A factory may create a detailed copy of a machine on a computer. This helps workers notice problems early.
This virtual model shows a real object or place. It can help people plan changes before trying them in real life.

examples.en: Flight simulation software prepares pilots for extreme crosswind landings safely.
examples.zh: 飛行模擬機軟體讓機師能在百分之百安全的環境下進行極端側風著陸特訓。

examples.en: Computer fluid dynamic simulations help aerospace engineers design aerodynamic race cars.
examples.zh: 尖端電腦流體力學數位模擬試驗，有力協助頂級航太工程師設計出風阻係數極低且極富下壓力的頂級競賽賽車車體。

examples.en: Doctors practice difficult laparoscopic surgical procedures on computer simulations before operating on real patients.
examples.zh: 年輕住院醫師在正式踏手術台為真實病患執刀之前，必須先在高度逼真的電腦腹腔鏡虛擬模擬器上反覆苦練數百次。

examples.en: Sunrise simulation wake-up lights gently increase illumination thirty minutes before the chime rings.
examples.zh: 日出模擬喚醒鬧鐘會在設定鬧鈴響起前半小時，從微弱紅光漸進模擬晨曦亮光，溫柔喚醒身心。

examples.en: The laboratory uses environmental chamber simulation to test material durability in Arctic conditions.
examples.zh: 國家級材料科學實驗室透過環境模擬艙，精準模擬北極極端零下急凍低溫以檢驗複合材料耐久性。

examples.en: Dusk simulation features gradually dim the bedside reading lamp, lulling children into peaceful slumber.
examples.zh: 智慧床頭燈內建的日落漸暗模擬功能會在三十分鐘內徐徐調暗光線，溫柔陪伴孩子在微光中平穩入睡。

examples.en: Robots train across millions of physics-accurate simulation scenarios in parallel before entering the real world.
examples.zh: 機器人在正式進入真實世界前，先在超級電腦的物理模擬環境中同步經歷數百萬種意外碰撞情境的極限訓練。

examples.en: Flight crew recruits logged hundreds of hours inside full-motion cockpit flight simulators before flying actual jets.
examples.zh: 民航培訓飛行員在正式坐進真實波音客機駕駛艙前，必須在六軸全動式模擬機艙內累積數百小時的模擬飛行時數。

examples.en: Supercomputer climate simulations forecast typhoon intensity and landfall tracks with unprecedented precision.
examples.zh: 國家級超級電腦氣象預報物理模擬系統，能以無與倫比的高精確度提前預警強颱的路徑走向與中心最大風速。

examples.en: Accurate quantum molecular chemistry simulation will accelerate the discovery of carbon-capture room catalysts.
examples.zh: 高精準度的量子分子化學模擬，將大幅加速常溫碳捕捉高效催化劑的重大科學發現。

examples.en: Simulating quantum systems using classical supercomputers suffers from an exponential memory wall.
examples.zh: 使用傳統超級電腦模擬微觀量子多體系統時，會遭遇記憶體隨粒子數呈指數級爆炸的物理內存牆。

examples.en: Feynman famously proposed that simulating nature requires building computational machines that are quantum.
examples.zh: 物理學大師費曼曾發表名言：想要真實模擬大自然，你就必須打造真正依循量子力學運作的機器。

examples.en: Computer simulation models sound wave propagation, predicting echo patterns before construction begins.
examples.zh: 透過先進的電腦「聲學數值模擬」（Simulation），在動工興建前即可精準預測全場各座位的聲波擴散路徑。

examples.en: Pilot trainees spend hundreds of flight hours practicing emergency landings inside a flight cockpit simulation.
examples.zh: 培訓民航飛行員必須在全動態飛行駕駛艙模擬器中完成數百小時嚴格訓練，反覆熟練緊急迫降應變SOP。

examples.en: Climate scientists run supercomputer climate simulation models to project sea level rise over the next century.
examples.zh: 氣候科學家運用超級電腦運算全球氣候模擬預測模型，以精確推估下個世紀全球海平面上升幅度。

entries.definition: 虛擬模擬；電腦模擬試驗；日出漸進模擬光線；模擬；物理引擎虛擬模擬環境；量子分子化學精準模擬 (合成高效催化劑)；3D 虛擬音樂廳聲學波場高精度電腦數值模擬

explains.en: This is a model that copies how a real situation might happen. A pilot can practice a landing without flying a real plane. Scientists use computer models to study weather.
A computer program can recreate a process so people can test ideas safely. Doctors may practice an operation this way. It can help engineers design cars.
Use this word for a practice or model version of a real event. It may copy an environment or system. It lets people learn without facing the real danger.

examples.en: AI-powered predictive maintenance detects equipment wear before breakdowns occur.
examples.zh: 結合 AI 人工智慧的預測性維護技術能在工廠機台零件故障前提前發出預警。

examples.en: Predictive analytics algorithms help retail managers forecast holiday shopping demand with remarkable accuracy.
examples.zh: 結合大數據的預測性分析演算法，能協助連鎖零售通路主管以令人驚嘆的精準度提前預估各大連假檔期的備貨需求。

examples.en: Doctors use predictive genetic testing to assess an individual's long-term risk of developing chronic diseases.
examples.zh: 專業醫師善用高科技預測性基因檢測，全方位深入評估個別患者在未來數十年內罹患各類家族遺傳慢性病的高風險機率。

explains.en: It describes a method that uses information to estimate what may happen later. A store can forecast holiday demand. Machines can be checked before they break.
Software may study earlier patterns to make a forecast. A doctor can assess health risks. The result is not always certain.
Use this adjective for tools that anticipate future events from data. A business may plan inventory with them. Weather services also make forecasts.

examples.en: Cloud hosting providers guarantee 99.99% system uptime for global services.
examples.zh: 頂級雲端伺服器託管服務商為全球客戶提供高達 99.99% 的系統超高妥善率保證。

examples.en: Redundant server architecture helped the financial portal maintain flawless 100% uptime during market trading hours.
examples.zh: 具備多重備份的雙活伺服器叢集架構，有力保障了該金融股票交易大盤在開盤交易時段內始終保持百分之百的零中斷完美運行。

examples.en: Even thirty seconds of unexpected server downtime can cost millions of dollars in lost transaction uptime.
examples.zh: 在瞬息萬變的高頻跨國金融交易中，哪怕只是三十秒的伺服器突發當機中斷，都將造成難以挽回的數百萬美元鉅額交易損失。

entries.definition: 系統正常運作時間；妥善運轉率

explains.en: A website stays available for people to use during the day and night. The amount of time it works is important to its users.
A company tracks how often its servers are running properly. Short outages reduce this measure.
When a service is online and functioning, customers can access it. A reliable system aims to keep this time high.

examples.en: Scheduled database maintenance was performed late at night to minimize downtime.
examples.zh: 核心資料庫例行性維護排定於深夜離峰時段進行以將停機時間降至最低。

examples.en: The unexpected power failure caused four hours of expensive factory downtime.
examples.zh: 突如其來的外電斷電意外事故，直接造成整座自動化晶圓廠長達四個小時、損失以數億元計的昂貴停機中斷。

examples.en: Taking scheduled downtime on weekends allows busy corporate professionals to recharge mental energy.
examples.zh: 在忙碌緊繃的週間工作之餘，懂得在週末給自己排定完全遠離電子信箱的放空休整期，能讓職場菁英迅速滿血復活。

entries.definition: 停機時間；系統當機中斷期；休息

explains.en: A factory may stop working while machines are being repaired. This lost work time can be expensive.
Someone can take a break from a busy week to rest. The word also describes time when a system is unavailable.
A company may schedule maintenance at night so fewer customers are affected. It plans for this pause in service.

examples.en: IT engineers worked overnight to troubleshoot the network firewall error.
examples.zh: 資訊工程師通宵達旦值班以迅速排解修復企業網路防火牆所回報的異常錯誤。

examples.en: When the smart TV failed to connect to the home Wi-Fi, he followed the online manual to troubleshoot the issue.
examples.zh: 當客廳的智慧型電視突發無法連上家中 Wi-Fi 無線網路時，他耐著性子對照官方線上說明手冊逐一步驟排查解決問題。

examples.en: Experienced auto mechanics can troubleshoot mysterious engine noises in just a few minutes.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的資深老黑手汽車維修技師，往往只需側耳傾聽幾分鐘，即可精準揪出並排除引擎室內部傳來的古怪異響。

entries.definition: 疑難排解；排除故障問題

explains.en: You do this when you look for the cause of a problem and try ways to fix it. A technician may check why Wi-Fi will not connect. A mechanic may investigate an engine sound.
When a computer program stops working, a person checks each part to find the cause. They follow a manual and test possible fixes. It helps restore normal use.
Use this verb for finding and solving technical problems. An engineer may inspect a network or machine. It takes patience and step-by-step tests.

examples.en: High fault tolerance ensures the banking server keeps running even if one node fails.
examples.zh: 高度完善的容錯機制確保了銀行伺服器叢集即使單一節點損壞仍能持續穩健運作。

examples.en: Space probes heading to outer solar system destinations are engineered with exceptional hardware fault tolerance.
examples.zh: 遠征太陽系外圍深空的天文深空探測器，其機載核心硬體電路在設計之初便具備超乎尋常的極致容錯容災冗餘能力。

examples.en: Implementing distributed database clusters provides superior fault tolerance against localized hardware crashes.
examples.zh: 在企業內部全面部署現代化分散式資料庫叢集架構，能為核心業務提供抵抗單一伺服器突發硬體故障的絕佳容錯能力。

entries.definition: 容錯能力；系統容錯機制

explains.en: It is a system's ability to keep working when a part fails. A bank server may stay online if one computer stops. Backup components can help.
Engineers design machines so a single breakdown does not stop the whole service. Space probes need this reliability. Extra servers can provide it.
This quality helps a computer system continue operating despite errors or damaged hardware. Distributed servers can reduce downtime. Testing helps find weak points.

examples.en: Edge computing processes camera sensor data locally without latency delays.
examples.zh: 邊緣運算能在地端設備端直接秒速處理影像感測數據，無需回傳雲端無延遲。

examples.en: In autonomous vehicles, edge computing microchips make millisecond braking decisions without relying on cloud connections.
examples.zh: 在自動駕駛汽車的核心運算單元中，邊緣運算晶片能夠在毫秒之內自主做出緊急制動煞車決策，完全無須依賴外界雲端網路連線。

examples.en: Smart factories deploy edge computing nodes alongside manufacturing robots to detect defective parts in real time.
examples.zh: 現代化智慧工業無人工廠在組裝機器人手臂身側廣泛部署了邊緣運算模組，能在生產線上毫無延遲地即時揪出外觀瑕疵零件。

explains.en: A camera analyzes what it sees on a nearby computer instead of sending all the information far away. This can make a response faster.
A car’s computer processes sensor information while the vehicle is moving. It does not need to wait for a distant server.
Small computers near a factory machine handle data close to where it is made. This can reduce delays.

examples.en: Ultra-low 5G latency enables instantaneous real-time cloud gaming streaming.
examples.zh: 5G 超低延遲傳輸特性讓玩家能享受零卡頓、即時無縫的雲端遊戲極致體驗。

examples.en: Financial traders spend millions laying dedicated fiber cables across oceans to shave microseconds off network latency.
examples.zh: 華爾街頂級高頻量化交易機構豪擲數千萬美元在各大洲海底鋪設專屬直連光纜，只為在跨國網路數據延遲中搶下幾微秒先機。

examples.en: High audio latency can make conducting musical rehearsals over online video conference software very frustrating.
examples.zh: 過高的音訊訊號延遲往往會讓樂團成員透過線上視訊會議軟體進行遠端合奏排練時，感到節拍完全無法對齊的極大挫折。

examples.en: Low Earth orbit architectures achieve latency under thirty milliseconds, ideal for high-definition video calls.
examples.zh: 距離地面極近的低軌衛星架構創造出低於三十毫秒的超低延遲，視訊通話與線上對戰流暢無比。

examples.en: Hardcore competitive gamers invest in ultra-fast fiber internet to minimize ping latency during tournaments.
examples.zh: 電競職業選手投資申裝超高速光纖網路，以在緊張激烈的電競錦標賽中將網路延遲壓至極低。

examples.en: High-frequency trading algorithms depend on sub-millisecond network latency to execute orders ahead of rivals.
examples.zh: 華爾街高頻交易演算法高度依賴亞毫秒級的極低網路延遲，以便在競爭對手前幾微秒搶先下單。

examples.en: Minimizing motion-to-photon latency prevents dizziness by matching visual updates to head rotation instantly.
examples.zh: 將動作到光子的「系統延遲」（Latency）降至微秒級，讓畫面隨頭部轉動同步更新，消除頭暈感。

examples.en: Financial trading firms invest heavily in fiber-optic lines to reduce data transmission latency.
examples.zh: 金融高頻交易公司斥巨資鋪設光纖線路，以盡可能降低資料傳輸延遲。

examples.en: Severe network latency caused the video conference call to freeze intermittently.
examples.zh: 嚴重的網路延遲導致視訊會議畫面斷斷續續卡頓。

entries.definition: 網路延遲；延遲時間；低軌衛星超低延遲極速傳輸；延遲；動暈症消除之微秒級動作到光子極低延遲；潛伏

explains.en: A video call may have a delay between speaking and hearing the reply. A faster connection reduces it.
A game can feel slow when commands take too long to reach a server. Players notice this delay.
Sound may arrive after a musician plays a note online. This term describes the time between an action and the response.

examples.en: Police and firefighters collaborate closely to uphold public safety.
examples.zh: 警察與消防救護人員緊密協同作業以全心全力捍衛社會公共安全與祥和。

examples.en: Installing bright LED streetlamps in dark alleyways noticeably improved public safety for night commuters.
examples.zh: 在原本幽暗狹窄的市區巷弄全面加裝高流明節能 LED 路燈，顯著提升了夜歸女性與通勤市民的夜間公共安全感。

examples.en: Stringent building codes regarding earthquake resistance are enacted strictly to preserve public safety.
examples.zh: 政府主管機關頒布並嚴格貫徹建築物高耐震係數法規標準，其唯一的終極目的就是為了誓死守護全體國民的公共生命安全。

explains.en: This is the work of keeping people safe in shared places. Police and firefighters help with it. Building rules can protect people during earthquakes.
Streetlights can make it safer for people who walk at night. Emergency workers support this goal. Cities plan services to reduce danger.
Use this phrase for protecting a community from crime, accidents, and emergencies. Safe roads and buildings are part of it. Government workers help provide it.

examples.en: The 119 emergency center dispatched three ambulances to the highway accident.
examples.zh: 119 緊急勤務救災指揮中心立即緊急調派三輛救護車趕赴高速公路事故現場。

examples.en: The courier company will dispatch your order immediately from the northern logistics warehouse.
examples.zh: 物流快遞公司將在收到您的付款憑單後第一時間，直接自北部智慧物流總倉將商品火速出貨派遣發送。

examples.en: Foreign correspondents were dispatched to the border region to report on the emerging refugee crisis.
examples.zh: 國際知名通訊社資深戰地特派記者被火速派遣趕赴邊界前線，就正在急劇升溫發酵的國際人道難民危機展開第一手報導。

examples.en: Intelligent dispatch algorithms calculate optimal delivery routes to avoid downtown gridlock traffic.
examples.zh: 智慧派工調度系統，利用演算法為貨運車隊即時規劃最佳配送路徑以避開市區塞車。

examples.en: The fleet manager pressed the dispatch button to release fifty delivery vans into morning traffic.
examples.zh: 車隊營運總監按下一鍵派工調度確認鍵，排程出發的五十輛宅配物流車隨即井然有序開入早晨車流。

examples.en: Real-time traffic alerts fed directly into the automated dispatch system to dynamically reroute delivery vans.
examples.zh: 即時路況事故通報數據直接回傳串接至自動派工系統，第一時間為在途物流車智慧重新規劃最佳避堵路徑。

examples.en: Centralized traffic control dispatch operators manage real-time train movements across all twelve stations.
examples.zh: 高鐵行控中心的「中央行車調度員」（Dispatch Operators），在巨型螢幕牆前即時掌握全線十二座車站列車動態。

examples.en: The fire department received the emergency 119 call and agreed to dispatch three fire engines immediately.
examples.zh: 消防局一一九救災救護指揮中心接獲火警報案後，第一時間火速指派調度三輛消防水庫車趕往現場救援。

examples.en: The foreign war correspondent transmitted her latest news dispatch from the capital city by satellite phone.
examples.zh: 派駐前線戰地的外國戰地特派記者，透過加密衛星電話自衝突發生國首都傳回第一手現場新聞特稿。

entries.definition: 派遣；調度；發送；急件；AI 演算法智慧最佳化車隊排程派工；行控中心 (OCC) 全線中央行車自動化調度

explains.en: Use this verb when sending people or goods somewhere quickly. Emergency crews may send ambulances to an accident. A delivery company can ship an order.
A manager may assign workers or vehicles to a location. Reporters can be sent to cover a story. The noun can mean an urgent message.
This action sends something out to its destination. A warehouse may ship a package right away. In emergencies, a center sends help.

examples.en: Community volunteers participate in civil defense and disaster response drills.
examples.zh: 社區熱心里民志工積極踴躍參與民防整備與災害應變搜救實兵演練。

examples.en: Maintaining stockpile emergency rations and basic medical supplies is a key component of civilian civil defense.
examples.zh: 平時在居家儲備充足的應急口糧、瓶裝水與急救止血醫藥包，是落實基層民間民防安全整備最核心的一環。

examples.en: The national civil defense agency educates citizens on how to locate designated shelters during emergencies.
examples.zh: 國家民防防救主管機關印發文宣手冊，普及教育全體國民如何在突發天災或緊急事態降臨時，第一時間精準尋獲周遭防空避難處所。

entries.definition: 民防整備；民防防護體系

explains.en: Neighbors practice where to go during an earthquake or typhoon. They learn how to help keep the community safe.
A city prepares shelters, supplies, and emergency lessons for residents. People may join drills.
Volunteers and public services plan how to protect people during disasters. They may help with warnings and evacuation.

examples.en: Building resilient urban infrastructure helps cities withstand extreme climate events.
examples.zh: 打造具備高度韌性的都市基礎建設能讓現代城市抵禦極端氣候天災的嚴峻衝擊。

examples.en: The resilient young entrepreneur dusted herself off after business failure and founded another successful startup.
examples.zh: 這位堅韌不拔的年輕創業家在經歷了前一次事業慘澹收場的挫敗後毫不氣餒，重整旗鼓再次打造出另一家極其成功的新創公司。

examples.en: Developing a flexible, resilient mindset enables individuals to navigate unpredictable life transitions with grace.
examples.zh: 在內心深處修煉出一種兼具彈性與韌性的強大心理韌性，能讓人在面對充滿未知動盪的人生轉折時始終從容優雅、處變不驚。

entries.definition: 具韌性的；適應力強的；能迅速復原的

explains.en: A city with strong bridges and safe roads can better handle severe weather. This describes the ability to recover.
A young business owner may try again after a failure. People who adapt and recover show this quality.
Life can bring unexpected changes, but some people regain their strength and continue. This word describes that ability.

examples.en: Taiwan continues to advance as a globally competitive high-tech smart nation.
examples.zh: 台灣持續昂首闊步邁進，化身為具備全球頂尖競爭力的高科技智慧國家。

examples.en: Becoming a smart nation requires bridging the digital divide so seniors can access public services effortlessly.
examples.zh: 邁向智慧國家發展藍圖的關鍵核心，在於全面弭平城鄉數位落差，讓銀髮長輩也能零門檻輕鬆享受數位公共服務的極致便利。

examples.en: Investments in AI semiconductors and green computing form the strategic cornerstone of our smart nation blueprint.
examples.zh: 在人工智慧先進半導體製程與綠色低碳運算基礎設施上的持續龐大投資，構成了我們智慧國家戰略藍圖中最不可動搖的基石。

explains.en: This describes a country that uses technology to improve daily life and public services. Digital tools can help older people reach government services. Clean computing can support growth.
A country may invest in computers, communications, and science to help its people. It should also make sure everyone can use these services. Technology can support a stronger economy.
Use this phrase for a nation that builds skills and services around modern technology. It may invest in artificial intelligence and green energy. The goal is to improve life and remain competitive.

examples.en: Software developers patched the critical security vulnerability within 24 hours.
examples.zh: 軟體開發團隊在二十四小時內火速發布更新以修補這項重大安全漏洞。

examples.en: Regular code reviews help engineers discover system vulnerabilities early.
examples.zh: 定期進行程式碼審查有助於工程師及早發現系統漏洞。

examples.en: Outdated operating systems often contain unpatched vulnerabilities.
examples.zh: 過時未更新的作業系統往往潛藏著未被修補的安全弱點。

examples.en: Mapping supply chain geographic vulnerability prevents single-point manufacturing disruptions during floods.
examples.zh: 繪製供應鏈全球地理氣候脆弱度（Vulnerability）風險圖，能防範單一海外代工廠因暴雨淹水導致全球斷鏈。

examples.en: Cybersecurity engineers quickly patched a critical zero-day security vulnerability in the router firmware.
examples.zh: 網路資安工程團隊漏夜加班，緊急發布安全性修補程式以修復無線路由器韌體中遭駭客利用的零日安全漏洞。

examples.en: Sharing personal struggles with close friends requires courage and emotional vulnerability.
examples.zh: 敞開心扉向摯友傾訴自己內心深處的挫折與脆弱掙扎，需要莫大的心理勇氣與展現真實情感脆弱面的包容心。

entries.definition: 系統漏洞；安全弱點；脆弱性；供應鏈氣候極端風險脆弱度

explains.en: It is a weakness that can be harmed or attacked. A software flaw may let hackers enter a system. Developers should fix it quickly.
A person or system may be open to danger because it lacks protection. Old programs can have security gaps. Regular reviews help find them.
This noun describes a point of weakness. A team may discover one during a code review. It can also mean being emotionally open to harm.

examples.en: Covert spyware secretly tracked user keystrokes and bank account numbers.
examples.zh: 隱匿的間諜軟體在背景秘密側錄並追蹤使用者的鍵盤輸入與銀行帳密。

examples.en: She noticed her phone battery draining fast due to hidden spyware.
examples.zh: 由於隱藏間諜軟體的運作，她注意到手機電池消耗得特別快。

examples.en: Run an anti-malware scan to check if your computer is infected with spyware.
examples.zh: 執行反惡意軟體掃描以檢查您的電腦是否感染了間諜軟體。

explains.en: A hidden program watches what someone does on a phone or computer without permission. It may collect private information.
If a device acts strangely, a security scan may find harmful software that secretly tracks activity. Keep programs updated.
This software can record keystrokes or browsing habits and send them to someone else. Avoid installing apps from unknown sources.

examples.en: Disguised as a free game, the Trojan horse opened a backdoor into the PC.
examples.zh: 這支特洛伊木馬程式偽裝成免費小遊戲，暗中在電腦開啟後門通道。

examples.en: The user unknowingly ran a Trojan horse embedded in an email attachment.
examples.zh: 該使用者不知不覺中執行了嵌入在郵件附件中的特洛伊木馬。

examples.en: Antivirus software immediately quarantined the dangerous Trojan horse file.
examples.zh: 防毒軟體立即將該危險的特洛伊木馬檔案隔離起來。

entries.definition: 特洛伊木馬程式；木馬病毒

explains.en: A harmful computer program may pretend to be a free game. It can secretly open a way into a computer.
Someone might open an unsafe email attachment without knowing it carries dangerous code. Security software can isolate it.
This threat hides inside a program that looks useful. It may let an attacker enter a device.

examples.en: Keep your resident antivirus definition database updated to the latest version.
examples.zh: 請將您電腦中的常駐防毒軟體病毒碼特徵資料庫隨時保持在最新版本。

examples.en: An efficient antivirus program runs quietly in the background without slowing down your PC.
examples.zh: 一款高效的防毒軟體會在背景默默運行，而不會拖慢電腦速度。

examples.en: He scheduled a weekly full-system antivirus scan every Sunday night.
examples.zh: 他將全系統防毒掃描排程在每週日晚上自動執行。

explains.en: This is computer software that looks for harmful programs and helps remove or block them. It may scan files each week. Keeping it updated improves protection.
A person can use this program to check a computer for dangerous code. It may run quietly in the background. A scan can find threats.
Use this word for a tool that protects computers from malicious software. It can warn users about suspicious files. Updates help it recognize new dangers.

examples.en: Authorized users hold the secret mathematical key required for data decryption.
examples.zh: 唯有獲得授權的合法使用者方持有進行資料解密所需的專屬數位金鑰。

examples.en: The decryption process took several hours due to the file's massive size.
examples.zh: 由於檔案容量龐大，解密過程耗費了數個小時。

examples.en: Security researchers demonstrated the decryption of legacy encoded files.
examples.zh: 資安研究人員展示了對舊型編碼檔案的解密過程。

explains.en: It is the process of turning coded information back into readable form. An authorized person needs the correct key. Large files may take time.
Security researchers can restore access to data that has been encoded. Only someone with permission should do it. The reverse process hides the information.
A computer uses a key to make secret data understandable again. This may take a while for a large file. It allows the intended user to read it.

examples.en: End-to-end encryption ensures only you and your recipient can read messages.
examples.zh: 端對端加密（E2EE）技術確保通訊內容僅有您與收件方雙方能夠閱讀。

examples.en: We implemented an end-to-end testing pipeline for our e-commerce platform.
examples.zh: 我們為電子商務平台建置了端對端的自動化測試流程。

examples.en: The logistics firm provides end-to-end tracking from factory to doorstep.
examples.zh: 這家物流公司提供從出廠到送達門口的端對端全程追蹤服務。

explains.en: A private message is scrambled on the sender’s device and only becomes readable on the receiver’s device. Other people cannot easily read it while it travels.
A delivery company can track a package from the factory until it reaches a home. The service covers every part of the journey.
A software team tests every step from entering an order to receiving the product. The phrase describes a full process.

examples.en: Two-factor authentication adds an indispensable extra layer of account security.
examples.zh: 雙重身分驗證能為您的個人網路帳號增添一層不可或缺的安全防護網。

examples.en: Biometric authentication using fingerprints makes login both fast and secure.
examples.zh: 使用指紋的生物身分驗證讓登入流程既快速又安全。

examples.en: The server rejected the request because the authentication token had expired.
examples.zh: 由於驗證權杖已過期，伺服器拒絕了該請求。

examples.en: Enabling two-factor authentication (2FA) blocks hackers from accessing your online investment account.
examples.zh: 啟用兩步驟雙重身分安全驗證（2FA）機制，能有效阻絕駭客利用釣魚密碼非法登入你的證券帳戶。

examples.en: SMS one-time passcodes and hardware security keys are widely used methods of identity authentication.
examples.zh: 手機簡訊動態密碼（OTP）與實體硬體安全金鑰，是當前金融機構廣泛採用的高強度身分安全認證機制。

examples.en: Always verify server SSL certificate authentication before entering sensitive financial credentials on any portal.
examples.zh: 在任何網頁登入入口輸入敏感銀行帳號密碼前，切記務必確認伺服器 SSL 數位憑證認證的真實性。

entries.definition: 身分驗證；認證程序；雙重身分安全驗證 (2FA)；認證

explains.en: A website may ask for a password and a phone code to check who is signing in. This protects an account.
A fingerprint can prove that the person opening a phone is its owner. The server may also check a security token.
This process checks that a person or computer is really who it claims to be. Use it before entering private details online.

examples.en: Enterprise systems enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) for remote workers.
examples.zh: 企業內部系統嚴格要求所有遠距居家辦公的員工皆須通過多因子驗證（MFA）。

examples.en: Multi-factor authentication requires at least two independent forms of identification.
examples.zh: 多因子驗證需要至少兩種獨立形式的身分證明資訊。

examples.en: Banking apps rely on multi-factor authentication to prevent unauthorized wire transfers.
examples.zh: 銀行應用程式依賴多因子驗證來防止未經授權的轉帳交易。

explains.en: This is a login safety method that asks for two or more kinds of proof before allowing access. A bank app may ask for a password and a phone code. It helps keep accounts safe.
A user may prove who they are with a password and a fingerprint. Using separate checks makes it harder for someone else to enter. Companies may require it for remote workers.
Use this phrase for checking identity with multiple steps. One step could be a secret word and another a code. It helps prevent unauthorized access.

examples.en: Enter the 6-digit one-time password (OTP) sent to your mobile phone via SMS.
examples.zh: 請在結帳頁面輸入經由手機簡訊即時發送給您的六位數一次性動態密碼（OTP）。

examples.en: A one-time password is only valid for three minutes before it expires.
examples.zh: 一次性動態密碼的有效時間僅有三分鐘，逾時即失效。

examples.en: Never share your one-time password with anyone over the phone.
examples.zh: 絕不要在電話中向任何人透露您的一次性動態密碼。

explains.en: It is a temporary code that can be used only once to confirm a person's identity. A bank may send it by text. Never share it with strangers.
A service may send a short code that expires after a few minutes. It adds protection when signing in. Enter it only on the real website.
This security code works for a single login or transaction. It may arrive by text message or an app. Do not tell it to callers.

examples.en: Smishing messages claiming unpaid highway tolls trick victims into entering credit cards.
examples.zh: 宣稱國道通行費逾期未繳的簡訊釣魚詐騙（Smishing）誘騙受害者盜刷個資。

examples.en: Banks warn customers that they never send smishing texts asking for password resets.
examples.zh: 銀行警告客戶，他們絕不會發送要求重置密碼的釣魚簡訊。

examples.en: Do not tap links inside unknown text messages to avoid smishing scams.
examples.zh: 請勿點擊陌生簡訊中的連結，以避免遭遇簡訊釣魚詐騙。

explains.en: A text claims that a toll is unpaid and asks you to tap a link. Check through the official service instead of replying.
A fake bank message asks for a password or card number. Do not use the link; contact the bank using a known number.
Scammers may send a phone message with a dangerous link to steal private details. Delete unexpected messages and report them.

examples.en: Investment group chat scams lure victims with promises of guaranteed high returns.
examples.zh: 投資通訊群組詐騙常以保證獲利、穩賺不賠的高額話術誘騙受害民眾上鉤。

examples.en: She realized it was a scam and hung up the phone immediately.
examples.zh: 她意識到這是一場騙局，並立刻掛斷了電話。

examples.en: Shady websites often scam shoppers by selling counterfeit electronics.
examples.zh: 可疑網站經常藉由販售仿冒電子產品來欺詐消費者。

explains.en: A dishonest offer may promise a prize to trick someone into sending money. Hang up if a caller asks for bank details.
An online store may take payment but never send the product. Check reviews before buying.
A person can fool shoppers by selling fake electronics. This noun names the dishonest plan, and the verb means to trick people.

examples.en: Scammers frequently pretend to be police officers or bank representatives on phone calls.
examples.zh: 詐騙分子經常在電話中假冒成檢警法官或銀行理財專員藉此騙取信任。

examples.en: The clever scammer tricked the elderly resident out of her life savings.
examples.zh: 那名狡猾的騙子騙走了那位年長居民一生的積蓄。

examples.en: Police arrested an international gang of online scammers operating overseas.
examples.zh: 警方破獲並逮捕了一個在境外運作的國際網路詐騙集團。

explains.en: This person tricks others to steal money or private information. They may pretend to work for a bank or the police. Be careful with unexpected calls.
Someone may use a fake story to get a person's savings. Online criminals can target people in many places. Report suspicious messages to the authorities.
Use this noun for a dishonest person who tries to cheat someone. They may ask for passwords or money. Never share private details with an untrusted caller.

examples.en: Dial the 165 national anti-fraud hotline immediately if you suspect suspicious calls.
examples.zh: 若接獲任何可疑來電，請第一時間撥打警政署 165 反詐騙諮詢專線查證。

examples.en: The government launched an anti-fraud campaign across community centers.
examples.zh: 政府在各社區中心展開了大規模的反詐騙宣導活動。

examples.en: The bank upgraded its anti-fraud detection algorithms to catch suspicious transfers.
examples.zh: 銀行升級了其防詐偵測演算法，以攔截可疑的轉帳交易。

explains.en: It describes actions or tools designed to stop scams and dishonest activity. A bank may improve its detection software. People should call a hotline if a message seems suspicious.
A campaign can teach people how to recognize fake calls. A financial company may watch for unusual transfers. These measures protect customers.
Use this adjective for systems that help prevent people from being tricked. A hotline can offer advice. Detection programs can identify suspicious behavior.

examples.en: Fraud rings impersonate famous celebrities on social media to promote fake investments.
examples.zh: 詐騙集團在社群媒體上冒名頂替知名財經名人以大肆宣傳虛假投資。

examples.en: It is a federal crime to impersonate a law enforcement officer.
examples.zh: 冒充執法人員屬於聯邦重罪。

examples.en: The caller attempted to impersonate her grandson asking for emergency cash.
examples.zh: 來電者企圖假冒是她的孫子並緊急索取現金急用。

explains.en: A caller pretends to be someone’s grandchild and asks for emergency money. Verify the person’s identity another way.
Someone copies a celebrity’s profile to trick fans into buying a fake investment. Report the account.
This verb means pretending to be another person, often to deceive someone. It may also describe an actor playing a real person.

examples.en: Caller ID spoofing allows scammers to falsify government phone numbers overseas.
examples.zh: 來電號碼偽造（Spoofing）技術讓境外詐騙集團能隨意竄改顯示官方電話。

examples.en: Email spoofing tricks recipients into believing a message came from their CEO.
examples.zh: 電子郵件地址偽造會讓收件人誤以為信件是執行長親自寄出的。

examples.en: Network engineers implemented anti-spoofing filters to block forged packets.
examples.zh: 網路工程師部署了防偽冒過濾器以阻擋偽造的數據封包。

examples.en: Cryptographic signal authentication prevents dangerous spoofing attacks designed to mislead maritime vessels.
examples.zh: 導入數位密碼學驗證機制，能徹底防範旨在誤導貨輪航向的惡意「偽造訊號欺騙攻擊」（Spoofing）。

examples.en: Cybersecurity engineers warned staff about email spoofing tactics that mimic corporate executive requests for wire transfers.
examples.zh: 企業資安長召開內部安全宣導，嚴厲警示全體同仁慎防偽冒公司高層電子郵件詐騙指示匯款的偽冒釣魚郵件。

examples.en: Modern military receivers utilize multi-element antennas to detect and reject deceptive spoofing signals instantly.
examples.zh: 現代先進軍規 GPS 接收終端配備多單元陣列天線，能即時辨識入射電磁波異常並果斷剔除虛假欺騙訊號。

entries.definition: 號碼偽造；網路欺騙偽冒；防範假造衛星訊號誘騙攻擊之加密反欺騙安全防護

explains.en: A caller may make a phone number look like it belongs to a government office. This tricks people into trusting the call.
A message can be made to look as though it came from a company leader. Email filters can block these false messages.
Computer networks can reject packets that pretend to come from a trusted source. This kind of online deception is dangerous.

examples.en: Social engineering attacks manipulate human trust rather than cracking complex code.
examples.zh: 社交工程攻擊善於操弄人性的信任與恐懼弱點，而非單純破解程式代碼。

examples.en: Training staff to recognize social engineering tactics prevents data leaks.
examples.zh: 培訓員工識別社交工程手段能有效防止資料外洩。

examples.en: Tailgating into a secure office building is an example of physical social engineering.
examples.zh: 尾隨他人進入安全管制辦公大樓就是實體社交工程的一個例子。

entries.definition: 社交工程攻擊（心理誘騙）

explains.en: This is a trick that uses trust or pressure to make someone reveal information or allow access. A criminal may pretend to be a bank worker. Training can help people notice it.
Instead of breaking computer code, an attacker may persuade a person to share a password. A fake phone call is one example. Staff can learn warning signs.
Use this phrase for manipulating people to get information or enter a secure place. Someone might follow a worker through a locked door. Awareness can prevent data leaks.

examples.en: The retailer informed customers about a database breach involving hashed passwords.
examples.zh: 該零售購物網站主動發布聲明通知顧客發生了資料庫外洩與帳密風險。

examples.en: A major data breach can lead to regulatory penalties and lost consumer trust.
examples.zh: 重大的資料外洩事件可能導致法規罰款並失去消費者的信任。

examples.en: The company hired forensic investigators to determine how the data breach occurred.
examples.zh: 該公司聘請了鑑識調查員來查明資料外洩究竟是如何發生的。

entries.definition: 資料外洩事件；個資外洩

explains.en: It is an incident where private information is accessed or stolen without permission. Customers may need to change their passwords. Companies should investigate how it happened.
A hacker may expose names, emails, or account details from a database. This can damage trust and lead to penalties. Experts examine the system afterward.
When a company's confidential files become available to outsiders, this serious event has occurred. Investigators look for the cause. Affected users should protect their accounts.

examples.en: Criminals used stolen national ID numbers to commit bank identity theft.
examples.zh: 不法之徒利用非法取得的身分證字號向銀行申辦人頭帳戶進行身分盜用。

examples.en: Victims of identity theft often spend years restoring their damaged credit ratings.
examples.zh: 身分盜用的受害者往往要花費數年時間來修復受損的信用評分。

examples.en: Shredding financial documents before disposal helps prevent identity theft.
examples.zh: 在丟棄財務文件前先將其粉碎有助於預防身分盜用。

explains.en: A criminal uses another person’s private information to open an account or buy things. Keep important documents secure.
Someone finds unfamiliar charges after a stranger uses their personal details. The victim may need to contact the bank.
Shred old bills before throwing them away and be careful with account numbers. These steps can help prevent misuse of someone’s identity.

examples.en: Attackers tried millions of dictionary words in a brute force password attack.
examples.zh: 攻擊者利用暴力破解字典檔程式在短時間內嘗試了數百萬組常見弱密碼。

examples.en: Account lockout policies effectively mitigate brute force login attempts.
examples.zh: 帳號鎖定政策能有效防範暴力破解登入的嘗試。

examples.en: Using a complex passphrase makes brute force cracking computationally infeasible.
examples.zh: 使用複雜的長密碼句能讓暴力破解在運算上變得不切實際。

entries.definition: 暴力破解法；強行密碼窮舉

explains.en: A computer may try a huge number of possible passwords until one works. A long passphrase makes this harder.
Account limits can stop repeated login attempts. This method tests many guesses instead of finding a weakness.
A security team can make passwords difficult to guess by using several kinds of characters. This protects against repeated guessing.

examples.en: A massive DDoS attack flooded the public transit ticketing server, causing outages.
examples.zh: 巨量的分散式阻斷服務攻擊（DDoS）癱瘓了台鐵訂票伺服器造成當機。

examples.en: Cloudflare provides automated DDoS protection to absorb malicious traffic spikes.
examples.zh: Cloudflare 提供自動化 DDoS 防護，以吸收惡意流量的高峰衝擊。

examples.en: The gaming servers went offline after suffering a sustained DDoS assault.
examples.zh: 遊戲伺服器在遭受持續性的 DDoS 攻擊後陷入離線狀態。

explains.en: This is an online attack that sends so many requests to a website that real users cannot reach it. A ticket site may stop working. Protection services can absorb the extra traffic.
A group of computers can flood a server with unwanted messages. The system becomes too busy to answer normal visitors. A game site may go offline.
Use this abbreviation for a service-disruption attack carried out through many devices. It overwhelms a server with traffic. Security tools can help keep a site available.

examples.en: Hackers hijacked thousands of infected IoT webcams to build a powerful botnet.
examples.zh: 駭客劫持了數萬台遭感染的家用智慧攝影機，串聯組成龐大的殭屍網路。

examples.en: Cybersecurity firms collaborated with law enforcement to take down the botnet.
examples.zh: 資安公司與執法單位聯手合作瓦解了該殭屍網路。

examples.en: A botnet can send billions of spam emails every single day.
examples.zh: 一個殭屍網路每天就能發送數十億封垃圾郵件。

entries.definition: 殭屍網路；受控傀儡電腦群

explains.en: It is a group of infected computers or cameras controlled remotely by a criminal. The devices may send spam or attack websites. Owners may not know they are infected.
Hackers can take control of many connected devices and use them together. Security companies work with police to shut the network down. Update device software regularly.
This hidden network of compromised machines can send huge numbers of messages. It may also overload a website. Strong passwords help protect devices.

examples.en: Security researchers discovered a zero-day flaw before it could be exploited.
examples.zh: 資安研究員搶在駭客發動零時差攻擊前，及時發現並通報了零日漏洞。

examples.en: Zero-day exploits can fetch hundreds of thousands of dollars on underground markets.
examples.zh: 零時差漏洞利用程式在地下黑市交易中價值可達數十萬美元。

examples.en: The vendor pushed an out-of-band security patch to resolve the zero-day exploit.
examples.zh: 原廠發布了例行排程外的緊急安全修補程式，以解決該零日漏洞。

entries.definition: 零日漏洞的；零時差攻擊

explains.en: A computer flaw is discovered before the company has time to prepare a fix. Hackers may try to use it.
Security teams rush to protect devices when a new weakness has no patch yet. Install updates when they become available.
Software makers may not know about a hidden problem until attackers exploit it. Experts work to create a repair quickly.

examples.en: Banks hire certified white-hat experts to conduct annual penetration testing.
examples.zh: 商業銀行定期聘請專業白帽資安團隊進行年度系統滲透測試以檢驗防禦。

examples.en: Penetration testing reveals hidden flaws in web applications before deployment.
examples.zh: 滲透測試能在系統上線前揭示網路應用程式中的隱藏缺陷。

examples.en: The report generated from penetration testing outlines critical remediation steps.
examples.zh: 滲透測試產生的評估報告詳細列出了關鍵的修復補救步驟。

explains.en: Banks hire security experts to look for weak spots in their websites. The experts report how to fix them.
Before a new app is released, specialists may try to break into it safely. This reveals problems early.
A company asks trained testers to check whether its systems can be attacked. Their report lists important fixes.

examples.en: Strict role-based access control restricts confidential files to authorized managers.
examples.zh: 嚴謹的基於角色存取控制（RBAC）確保機密文件僅限特定主管查閱。

examples.en: Biometric door locks form part of the physical access control system.
examples.zh: 生物辨識門鎖是實體出入管制系統的一部分。

examples.en: Good access control follows the principle of least privilege.
examples.zh: 良好的存取權限控制遵循最小權限原則。

entries.definition: 存取權限控制；出入管制

explains.en: This is a way of deciding who may enter a building or use certain files. A door lock may check a fingerprint. Computer roles can limit private information.
A company can give different workers permission to use different documents. A secure door may open only for approved people. This protects important spaces and data.
Use this phrase for rules and tools that limit entry to approved people. It may include a badge or password. Giving only needed permissions improves safety.

examples.en: Use a trusted VPN when connecting to free public Wi-Fi at airports.
examples.zh: 在機場或咖啡館連接免費公共 Wi-Fi 時，建議使用受信任的 VPN 加密連線。

examples.en: Employees connect to the corporate VPN to securely access internal resources.
examples.zh: 員工連線至公司企業 VPN 以安全存取內部資源。

examples.en: A VPN masks your real IP address and encrypts your internet traffic.
examples.zh: VPN 能隱藏你的真實 IP 位址並為你的網路傳輸流量加密。

entries.definition: 虛擬私人網路 (Virtual Private Network)

explains.en: It is a service that encrypts internet traffic and sends it through a protected connection. Employees may use it to reach company files. Choose a trusted provider.
When connected to airport Wi-Fi, a person may use this tool to protect data. It can hide an internet address. It does not make every online action safe.
This private network service can secure a connection between a device and the internet. Companies use it for remote access. It may help protect information on public Wi-Fi.

examples.en: Look for the lock icon and 'HTTPS' in the browser address bar before paying.
examples.zh: 在線上刷卡付款前，請先確認瀏覽器網址列是否有安全鎖頭標誌與 HTTPS。

examples.en: Search engines rank HTTPS websites higher because they provide secure connections.
examples.zh: 搜尋引擎會給予採用 HTTPS 的網站更高的排名，因為它們提供安全連線。

examples.en: All confidential data transmitted over HTTPS is encrypted against eavesdropping.
examples.zh: 透過 HTTPS 傳輸的所有機密資料都會經過加密以防範竊聽。

explains.en: Before paying online, check that the browser shows a secure connection and the correct website address. Never rely only on a lock symbol.
A protected web connection scrambles information as it travels between your browser and a site. This helps guard passwords and payment details.
Websites use a secure communication method to protect data sent between devices. Keep software updated and avoid suspicious pages.

examples.en: Browsing in incognito mode prevents search history from being saved on public PCs.
examples.zh: 在公用電腦開啟無痕瀏覽模式能防止個人搜尋瀏覽紀錄被電腦本機儲存。

examples.en: She opened an incognito mode tab to compare flight prices without tracking cookies.
examples.zh: 她打開無痕模式分頁以在不受追蹤 Cookie 影響下比對機票價格。

examples.en: Keep in mind that incognito mode does not hide your web activity from your network provider.
examples.zh: 請記住，無痕瀏覽模式並不會向你的網路服務供應商隱藏上網動態。

entries.definition: 無痕瀏覽模式；私密瀏覽

explains.en: A browser can open a private window that does not save local search history. It does not hide activity from an internet provider.
Someone may use this setting to compare flight prices without saving cookies. Other people using the device may not see the history.
This browsing option keeps some information off the computer after the window closes. It does not make a person invisible online.

examples.en: Using a secure password manager allows you to generate unique complex passwords.
examples.zh: 使用安全可靠的密碼管理工具能為每個網站自動生成互不相同的強密碼。

examples.en: A master passphrase protects all the vault entries stored in your password manager.
examples.zh: 一組主密碼就能保護儲存在密碼管理軟體保險庫中的所有帳號憑證。

examples.en: Password managers automatically autofill credentials across devices.
examples.zh: 密碼管理軟體可以在各裝置間自動填寫登入憑證。

explains.en: This is an app that stores login details in a protected place. It can create a different secret code for each website. A main passphrase opens the stored list.
People use this tool to remember many account passwords. It can fill them in automatically on different devices. Choose a strong master secret.
Use this program to keep website logins organized and protected. It can generate hard-to-guess codes. The user remembers one main passphrase.

examples.en: A strong complex password combines uppercase letters, numbers, and symbols.
examples.zh: 一組高強度的安全密碼應綜合包含大寫英文字母、數字與特殊符號。

examples.en: Never reuse the same complex password across multiple banking platforms.
examples.zh: 絕不要在多個銀行平台重複使用同一組複雜密碼。

examples.en: The system prompts users to choose a complex password with at least twelve characters.
examples.zh: 系統提示使用者選擇長度至少為十二個字元的高強度複雜密碼。

explains.en: It is a secret login phrase made harder to guess with a mix of character types. Use capital and small letters, numbers, and symbols. Do not reuse it.
A long passcode with different symbols can protect an online account. Each service should have its own. A manager app can store them safely.
This login secret is difficult to guess because it combines several kinds of characters. A website may require a certain length. Keep it private.

examples.en: Never click on suspicious links sent from unknown WhatsApp contacts.
examples.zh: 收到來自陌生通訊軟體聯絡人發送的可疑連結時，千萬不要輕易點擊。

examples.en: Hover over the hyperlinked text to inspect the actual destination URL before clicking.
examples.zh: 在點擊之前將滑鼠懸停在超連結文字上，以檢查真實的目標網址。

examples.en: The email gateway flagged the attachment because it contained a suspicious link.
examples.zh: 電子郵件閘道攔截並標記了該附件，因為它包含了一個可疑連結。

explains.en: An unexpected text asks you to claim a prize by tapping a web address. Check the sender before opening it.
An email address looks strange and the message demands urgent action. Do not follow its link or enter private information.
A web address from an unknown person may lead to a fake sign-in page. Type the official address yourself instead.

examples.en: Raising cyber awareness is the most effective defense against modern social phishing.
examples.zh: 全面提升全民資安意識與防詐警覺性是防範各類新型釣魚詐騙的最強防線。

examples.en: Schools conduct annual workshops to instill cyber awareness among teenagers.
examples.zh: 學校每年舉辦研習講座，以向青少年灌輸網路資安意識。

examples.en: Ongoing training keeps employees' cyber awareness sharp against evolving threats.
examples.zh: 持續的在職培訓使員工面對不斷演變的威脅時能保持敏銳的資安警覺性。

explains.en: A student who notices suspicious links and messages has good online safety knowledge. Schools can teach these skills.
Employees attend workshops to learn about phishing and password safety. Regular practice helps them spot threats.
Knowing how to protect accounts and information is important. Training can keep people alert to new risks.

examples.en: Attending industry conferences is a great way to expand professional networking.
examples.zh: 出席產業研討峰會是大幅拓展個人專業職場人脈網絡的絕佳途徑。

examples.en: She joined an alumni group to do some networking with fellow software engineers.
examples.zh: 她加入了校友會群組，以便與其他軟體工程師建立人脈關係。

examples.en: Effective networking requires maintaining genuine long-term relationships rather than just collecting contacts.
examples.zh: 有效的人脈拓展需要維持真誠長遠的關係，而不僅僅是收集名片聯絡人。

examples.en: Active networking at industry conferences uncovers valuable unadvertised executive job openings.
examples.zh: 在各類跨國產業年會中積極參與人脈拓展交流，往往能挖掘到獵頭尚未公開的頂級高階職缺。

examples.en: Professional networking on LinkedIn involves sharing meaningful industry insights rather than superficial self-promotion.
examples.zh: 在 LinkedIn 上經營專業職場人脈網絡，關鍵在於無私分享深度的產業洞見而非單純自我吹捧。

examples.en: Building genuine mutual connections makes business networking feel authentic, enjoyable, and collaborative.
examples.zh: 懷抱真誠利他的心態與同業結下良緣，能讓原本生硬的商務人際交流變得極其自然、愉快且富有意義。

entries.definition: 建立人脈；職場社交活動；職場人脈網絡拓展；人際交流

explains.en: This is meeting and staying in contact with people who share a job or interest. At a conference, someone may meet future coworkers. Good relationships take time.
A person may join an alumni group to connect with other engineers. They can share useful ideas and opportunities. Collecting names alone is not enough.
Use this noun for building professional or social connections. People may meet at events or online. Keeping in touch sincerely helps the relationships grow.

examples.en: Prepare a concise 30-second elevator pitch summarizing your startup's value.
examples.zh: 準備一段精準扼要的三十秒電梯簡報，清楚呈現您新創項目的核心價值。

examples.en: During the investor showcase, each founder had one minute to deliver an elevator pitch.
examples.zh: 在投資人發表會上，每位創辦人都有一分鐘的時間進行精簡扼要的電梯簡報。

examples.en: A compelling elevator pitch immediately hooks listeners and sparks curious questions.
examples.zh: 一段吸引人的電梯簡報能立刻吸引聽眾並激發對方好奇發問。

entries.definition: 電梯簡報；三十秒重點行銷話術

explains.en: It is a very short speech that explains an idea or business clearly. A founder may use it when meeting an investor. It should hold the listener's interest.
Someone can present a startup's value in about half a minute. A clear opening may spark questions. The message should be concise.
This brief introduction describes a project and why it matters. People use it at networking events. Prepare it before meeting a potential supporter.

examples.en: Making friendly small talk about the weather helps put international clients at ease.
examples.zh: 透過聊聊日常天氣等輕鬆閒聊破冰，能讓初次見面的外國客戶感到放鬆自在。

examples.en: She is naturally talented at initiating small talk with strangers at cocktail parties.
examples.zh: 她天生就擅長在雞尾酒會上與陌生人開啟輕鬆閒聊。

examples.en: While some find small talk superficial, it plays an important social role in building rapport.
examples.zh: 雖然有些人覺得閒聊很膚淺，但它在建立融洽人際關係中扮演著重要角色。

explains.en: Two people waiting for a bus chat about the weather or weekend plans. The conversation is light and friendly.
At a party, a guest asks someone where they are from. This kind of easy conversation can help people feel comfortable.
Coworkers may talk about a local festival before a meeting begins. They are not discussing a serious topic.

examples.en: The seminar host used a fun quiz game as an effective icebreaker.
examples.zh: 研習工作坊主持人運用了一場趣味問答小遊戲作為炒熱氣氛的破冰利器。

examples.en: Asking about travel plans serves as an easy icebreaker when meeting new colleagues.
examples.zh: 與新同事相遇時，詢問近期的旅遊計畫是個很好的破冰話題。

examples.en: The arctic icebreaker forged a safe pathway through the frozen strait.
examples.zh: 北極破冰船在結冰的海峽中開闢出了一條安全通道。

entries.definition: 破冰話題；破冰遊戲；破冰船

explains.en: A host may start a meeting with a fun question so people feel comfortable talking. It helps strangers relax.
Asking someone about travel plans can begin a friendly conversation. A short quiz can also help a group get started.
A game at the beginning of a workshop can help people meet one another. A ship that clears frozen water has the same name.

examples.en: The sales manager established good rapport with clients by listening attentively.
examples.zh: 業務主管透過全神貫注認真傾聽，與廣大客戶建立了極佳的融洽信任關係。

examples.en: It takes time and empathy to build a strong rapport with team members.
examples.zh: 與團隊成員建立深厚的融洽互信關係需要時間與同理心。

examples.en: Teachers who develop good rapport with their students often achieve better learning outcomes.
examples.zh: 能與學生建立良好融洽關係的老師往往能取得更好的教學成果。

entries.definition: 融洽關係；互信和諧關係

explains.en: This is a friendly and trusting connection between people. A manager can build it by listening to clients. Teachers often work well with students when it is strong.
Team members may take time to understand each other. Mutual respect helps create an easy relationship. It can improve how well people work together.
Use this word for a warm understanding between two people. It grows when they listen and show care. It makes conversations feel comfortable.

examples.en: Long-lasting business partnerships are built upon honesty and mutual trust.
examples.zh: 歷久彌堅的長期商務夥伴關係皆牢牢建立在真誠誠信與相互信任的基石之上。

examples.en: Transparent communication between founders fosters mutual trust within a startup.
examples.zh: 創辦人之間的透明溝通能促進新創團隊內部的相互信任。

examples.en: Without mutual trust, delegating critical responsibilities becomes nearly impossible.
examples.zh: 若缺乏相互信任，要向下授權關鍵職責幾乎是不可能的。

explains.en: It is confidence that two people or groups have in each other. Honest communication can build it. A business partnership needs it to last.
When each side believes the other will act fairly, a strong relationship can form. Founders can support it by sharing information openly. Without it, teamwork is hard.
This feeling goes both ways between people. It helps coworkers share important tasks. Being honest and dependable can strengthen it.

examples.en: Maintaining open body language conveys confidence, sincerity, and openness.
examples.zh: 維持開放放鬆的肢體語言能自然傳遞出自信、真誠與樂於交流的友善態度。

examples.en: Crossing your arms may inadvertently signal defensive body language.
examples.zh: 雙手環抱胸前可能會在無意間傳達出防衛性的肢體語言。

examples.en: The interviewer paid close attention to the candidate's posture and body language.
examples.zh: 面試官密切注意應徵者的儀態與肢體語言。

entries.definition: 肢體語言；身體姿態語言

explains.en: A person smiles, sits upright, and faces a speaker while listening. These movements can show attention.
Crossed arms or looking away may give clues about how someone feels, but do not always mean the same thing. Consider the setting too.
People communicate with their face, posture, and gestures as well as with words. Watch the whole situation to understand them.

examples.en: Making steady eye contact while speaking demonstrates honesty and focus.
examples.zh: 說話時保持穩定自然的眼神接觸目光交流展現出誠懇與高度專注。

examples.en: He felt shy and struggled to hold direct eye contact during the presentation.
examples.zh: 他感到害羞，在簡報過程中很難保持直接的眼神接觸。

examples.en: In many Western business contexts, avoiding eye contact can be seen as evasive.
examples.zh: 在許多西方商務情境中，避開眼神接觸可能被視為閃爍其詞或心虛。

explains.en: Looking at a speaker while they talk can show attention. Some people feel shy doing this.
A person may look toward someone's eyes during a conversation. In some cultures, this can show confidence.
When speaking to a group, glance at listeners to seem engaged. Staring too long may feel uncomfortable.

examples.en: A firm handshake and a warm smile create a positive initial impression.
examples.zh: 堅定有力且恰到好處的握手搭配溫暖微笑能留下極佳的第一印象。

examples.en: The two presidents sealed the historic agreement with a handshake.
examples.zh: 兩位總統以握手致意象徵正式簽署這項歷史性協議。

examples.en: Avoid squeezing too tightly when offering a professional handshake.
examples.zh: 在進行專業商務握手時，避免過度用力緊握對方的手。

explains.en: This is a greeting or agreement made by holding and briefly moving another person's hand. A warm smile can make a good first impression. Do not squeeze too tightly.
Two leaders may use this gesture to show that they have agreed. People also use it when meeting someone for the first time. It should be firm but comfortable.
Use this noun for a brief hand greeting between people. It may mark the start of a professional meeting. It can also show an agreement.

examples.en: Understanding dining and business etiquette is crucial for overseas trips.
examples.zh: 熟稔國際商務與餐桌禮儀對於出國洽公拓展外銷業務至關重要。

examples.en: Proper email etiquette includes writing clear subject lines and polite greetings.
examples.zh: 正確的電子郵件禮儀包括撰寫清晰的主旨與有禮貌的問候語。

examples.en: The HR department distributed a handbook detailing office etiquette rules.
examples.zh: 人資部門發放了一本手冊，詳細說明了辦公室日常禮儀規範。

explains.en: It is the polite behavior expected in a situation. Table manners are one example. Clear and courteous emails are also important at work.
People follow social rules when dining or meeting others. A handbook may explain office customs. Different cultures may have different expectations.
This word describes good manners and proper conduct. It can guide how to greet someone or write a message. Learning local customs helps travelers.

examples.en: Staff strictly observed diplomatic protocol when welcoming visiting foreign guests.
examples.zh: 全體接待人員在盛大迎接外國貴賓來訪時皆嚴格恪遵國際外交禮儀規範。

examples.en: Following safety protocols in chemical laboratories prevents serious accidents.
examples.zh: 在化學實驗室中恪守安全規範守則能預防嚴重工安事故。

examples.en: TCP/IP is the foundational network protocol governing internet communication.
examples.zh: TCP/IP 是規範整個網際網路通訊架構的基礎網路通訊協定。

examples.en: Strict adherence to the study protocol ensures patient safety and reliable scientific conclusions.
examples.zh: 嚴格遵循人體試驗委員會核准的「臨床試驗計畫書」（Protocol），是保障受試者生命安全與數據真實的基石。

examples.en: The hospital updated its infection control protocol to require N95 respirators in isolation suites.
examples.zh: 該醫學中心全面升級院內感控防護作業準則，硬性規定所有負壓隔離病房醫護皆須配戴 N95 口罩。

examples.en: Internet routers exchange data packets using the standardized TCP/IP transmission protocol.
examples.zh: 全球網路路由器依循標準化的 TCP/IP 通訊協定規範，在伺服器與用戶端之間高速交換數據封包。

examples.en: NTRIP is the universal internet protocol that streams live RTK correction messages to thousands of connected clients.
examples.zh: NTRIP 是全球通用的標準「網路傳輸協定」（Protocol），能向數萬台聯網載具實時串流差分數據。

examples.en: Strict diplomatic protocol dictates seating arrangements and greeting formalities during international state banquets.
examples.zh: 繁複嚴謹的外交禮儀規範，嚴格規範了在元首級國際國宴場合各國使節座次安排與握手寒暄的正式規格。

examples.en: Hospital staff followed rigorous sanitation protocol to decontaminate surgical tools between complex operations.
examples.zh: 醫學中心手術室護理團隊嚴格落實無菌消毒感控標準作業程序，在每場大型手術之間對器械徹底滅菌。

examples.en: Fueling algorithms follow the strict SAE J2601 protocol, calculating ramp rates dynamically in real time.
examples.zh: 加氫控制演算法完全遵循國際「SAE J2601 標準協定」（Protocol），動態調節注氣壓力爬升斜率。

examples.en: The research laboratory enforces a strict chemical waste disposal protocol to safeguard local groundwater.
examples.zh: 這座化學研究實驗室嚴格貫徹執行危險事業化學廢棄物分類清運作業標準協定，守護周遭地下水土安全。

examples.en: Internet communication relies on TCP/IP protocol layers to route data packets across millions of global servers.
examples.zh: 現代網際網路無遠弗屆的數據通訊，高度仰賴 TCP/IP 通訊協定架構精準將封包路由分發至全球數百萬台伺服器。

entries.definition: 禮節規範；外交禮儀；協定；人體試驗倫理委員會核准之臨床試驗計畫書；網際網路傳輸差分校正資料串流協定 (NTRIP)；協議；國際標準 SAE J2601 智慧加氫控溫控壓標準通訊協定

explains.en: At a formal banquet, guests follow rules about greetings and where to sit. These customs help the event run smoothly.
A science team follows written steps to keep an experiment safe and consistent. A network also follows rules for sending data.
A computer network uses agreed rules so devices can exchange information. In a laboratory, the same word can mean an approved procedure.

examples.en: Punctuality is deeply valued across Taiwanese, Japanese, and German workplaces.
examples.zh: 準時守時在台灣、日本與德國職場文化中皆被視為極受尊重的核心美德。

examples.en: His punctuality earned him a reputation as an extremely reliable colleague.
examples.zh: 他的守時習慣為他贏得了極具可靠度的好同儕口碑。

examples.en: Strict punctuality is required for all morning departure train schedules.
examples.zh: 所有早班出發的列車時刻表均要求嚴格遵守準點率。

examples.en: Taiwan High Speed Rail is globally renowned for its exceptional ninety-nine point eight percent punctuality record.
examples.zh: 台灣高鐵以高達 99.8% 的「世界級極致準點率」（Punctuality）聞名全球，平均每班車誤點不到十秒。

examples.en: Strict professional punctuality is regarded as a vital mark of respect when attending corporate business meetings.
examples.zh: 在出席正式商務會議與客戶拜訪時，嚴守約定時間準時赴約向來被視為極其重要的基本職場尊重。

examples.en: High school teachers emphasize punctuality, marking students tardy if they arrive after the morning warning bell.
examples.zh: 高中各班導師特別重視守時習慣，凡是在早晨朝會預備鐘響畢後才進教室的學生皆會被記遲到。

entries.definition: 準時；守時美德；99.8% 舉世驚嘆之極致準點率 (平均誤點小於十秒)

explains.en: Arriving at work or a meeting on time shows respect for other people. Trains may also be expected to follow their schedules.
A colleague who is always on time is seen as reliable. This habit matters at school and work.
Teachers may mark students late if they arrive after the bell. This quality means being on time.

examples.en: The modern tech company adopted a smart casual dress code policy.
examples.zh: 這家現代科技公司採取了兼具專業感與舒適度的商務休閒著裝規定。

examples.en: The gala invitation specified a black-tie dress code for all attendees.
examples.zh: 晚會邀請函明確規定所有出席嘉賓皆須穿著正式晚禮服。

examples.en: Employees are permitted to follow a casual dress code on Summer Fridays.
examples.zh: 員工在夏季的每週五可以依循休閒穿著規範前來上班。

explains.en: This is a set of rules about what clothes people should wear in a place or at an event. A gala may ask guests to wear formal clothes. Some offices allow casual outfits.
A company or school may explain what clothing is appropriate. The rules can be relaxed on certain days. A party invitation may specify a formal style.
Use this phrase for guidelines about clothing. It tells people what is suitable for work or a special occasion. The rules can require a uniform or a certain level of formality.

examples.en: Wear formal business attire when representing the firm at legal hearings.
examples.zh: 代表公司出席重要法律聽證會或正式商務談判時請穿著端莊的商務正裝。

examples.en: Traditional festive attire was worn by villagers during the lunar celebration.
examples.zh: 村民們在農曆新年慶祝活動期間穿上了傳統節慶服飾。

examples.en: The dress rehearsal required actors to perform in full stage attire.
examples.zh: 總彩排要求全體演員必須穿著完整的舞台戲服進行演出。

explains.en: It is clothing worn for a particular occasion. A person may choose a suit for a legal hearing. Actors wear special outfits on stage.
This noun means clothes, often in a formal setting. A celebration may call for traditional garments. A rehearsal can require a full costume.
People choose what to wear based on an event or job. Business meetings may require smart clothes. The word can sound more formal than 'clothing.'

examples.en: Managing international teams requires high cross-cultural empathy and tact.
examples.zh: 領導跨國跨地域團隊需要具備高度的跨文化同理心與老練圓融的溝通技巧。

examples.en: The university organized cross-cultural workshops to celebrate international students.
examples.zh: 這所大學舉辦了跨文化工作坊，以歡迎並慶祝國際留學生的多元文化。

examples.en: Cross-cultural misunderstandings can often be resolved through patient dialogue.
examples.zh: 跨文化的誤解往往可以透過耐心的溝通與對話來妥善化解。

explains.en: An international team learns how colleagues in different places prefer to communicate. Patience can prevent misunderstandings.
Students from several countries share food and traditions at a school event. They learn about one another’s cultures.
A manager works with people whose customs differ from their own. Listening carefully helps the team work together.

examples.en: The goal of ethical business collaboration is to create a win-win outcome.
examples.zh: 秉持誠信的商業跨界合作旨在為合作雙方共同創造出互利互惠的雙贏局面。

examples.en: We reached a win-win solution that satisfied both the vendor and the client.
examples.zh: 我們達成了一個讓供應商和客戶雙方都十分滿意的雙贏解決方案。

examples.en: Establishing partnerships should always focus on long-term win-win cooperation.
examples.zh: 建立合作夥伴關係應始終著眼於長期的雙贏合作。

explains.en: A solution that helps both sides is good for everyone. A vendor and a customer may both be satisfied.
Two groups can work together so each gets something useful. This describes a result with benefits for all.
A partnership can bring good results to both people over many years. It is better than one side losing.

examples.en: Having multiple supplier alternatives gives buyers tremendous negotiating leverage.
examples.zh: 手握多個可替代的合格備選供應商能賦予採購方極為強大的談判籌碼優勢。

examples.en: The startup decided to leverage artificial intelligence to automate customer service.
examples.zh: 這家新創公司決定善加利用人工智慧技術來實現客服自動化。

examples.en: High financial leverage increases risks when economic conditions turn volatile.
examples.zh: 當經濟情勢轉趨動盪時，過高的財務槓桿會大幅增加風險。

entries.definition: 談判籌碼；優勢；善加利用

explains.en: This can mean power or advantage that helps someone get a better result. Several suppliers may help a buyer negotiate. In business, people may also use a tool or resource effectively.
A startup can apply artificial intelligence to improve its service. A buyer with other options may have a stronger position in talks. The word has business and financial uses.
Use this word for gaining an advantage or making effective use of something. A company may apply technology to improve its work. Borrowing can also create financial risk.

examples.en: Large retail chains wield strong bargaining power when procuring stock.
examples.zh: 大型連鎖量販通路在進行貨品進貨採購時往往擁有極為強大的議價能力。

examples.en: When demand outstrips supply, sellers gain significant bargaining power.
examples.zh: 當需求大於供給時，賣方將獲得顯著的議價優勢。

examples.en: Joining a purchasing cooperative helps small clinics enhance their bargaining power.
examples.zh: 加入聯合採購合作社有助於小型診所提升採購藥品的議價能力。

entries.definition: 議價能力；討價還價能力

explains.en: It is the ability to negotiate for better prices or conditions. A large store may have strong influence with suppliers. Small clinics can join together to gain more.
When demand is greater than supply, sellers may have more influence in a deal. Buyers may combine their orders. This can help them negotiate.
A person or organization with this strength can ask for favorable terms. Volume purchases can increase it. It depends on what each side needs.

examples.en: Five percent profit margin is our absolute bottom line in this bidding project.
examples.zh: 在本次專案投標競爭中，保留百分之五的營業毛利率是我們絕不退讓的底線。

examples.en: The bottom line is that we must complete the migration before Friday midnight.
examples.zh: 最根本的關鍵底線是，我們必須在週五午夜之前徹底完成系統遷移。

examples.en: Cutting administrative overhead directly improved the company's bottom line.
examples.zh: 削減行政間接支出直接提振了該公司的淨利表現。

entries.definition: 底線；不可退讓的條件；損益淨利

explains.en: After adding costs and income, a shop checks whether it made a profit or loss. This is the final financial result.
A manager may say that a plan must finish by Friday, even after discussing details. The phrase can introduce the main point.
A bidder tells the team the lowest price they can accept. This is the firm limit in a negotiation.

examples.en: Negotiations hit a temporary deadlock over intellectual property ownership.
examples.zh: 雙方談判因智慧財產權專利所有權的歸屬爭議而一度陷入僵持不下的僵局。

examples.en: A mediator was invited to intervene and help break the political deadlock.
examples.zh: 獨立調解人受邀介入斡旋，以協助打破這場政治僵局。

examples.en: In computer science, a deadlock occurs when processes wait indefinitely on locked resources.
examples.zh: 在電腦科學中，當行程無止盡等待被彼此鎖定的資源時就會發生死結。

explains.en: Two groups may disagree so strongly that no one can move forward. A mediator may help them find a way out.
In a computer, programs can wait forever for resources held by each other. This problem stops work.
A political discussion may get stuck over an important issue. Everyone needs a new idea to continue.

examples.en: She gave tactful feedback that highlighted strengths while suggesting improvements.
examples.zh: 她給予了極為得體圓融的建設性回饋，在肯定優點的同時委婉提出優化建議。

examples.en: It was very tactful of him not to mention her earlier presentation blunder.
examples.zh: 他很得體地沒有在公開場合提及她先前在簡報中的口誤。

examples.en: Being honest doesn't mean being blunt; one can always choose to be tactful.
examples.zh: 誠實並不代表說話要魯莽直衝；人們隨時都可以選擇更為圓融得體的表達方式。

entries.definition: 說話得體的；圓融圓滑的；機智的

explains.en: This describes a way of speaking that is honest but careful not to hurt someone's feelings. A person may point out a problem kindly. It shows good judgment.
