examples.en: Smart automated budgeting tools foster true financial empowerment and long-term financial security.
examples.zh: 善用手機內建的智慧記帳與自動儲蓄工具，能幫助年輕世代實現掌握個人財富自主權的實質賦能。

examples.en: Microfinance lending programs in rural villages provide economic empowerment to thousands of independent women.
examples.zh: 深入偏鄉落實的微型農民信貸專案，為成千上萬名農村婦女開創了經濟獨立自主的實質賦權。

examples.en: The company culture encourages employee empowerment, allowing frontline workers to resolve client complaints immediately.
examples.zh: 該卓越企業大力推行充分信任員工的充權授權文化，讓第一線客服同仁擁有在當下免請示直接解決客戶抱怨的權限。

examples.en: Speaking global English brings a deep sense of empowerment, putting you in control of your own future.
examples.zh: 掌握國際共通英語為你帶來深沉的「自信賦權感」（Empowerment），讓你牢牢掌握自己人生的主導權。

examples.en: Vocational education and financial literacy initiatives provide sustainable economic empowerment to women.
examples.zh: 職業技能培訓與普惠金融理財計畫，為偏鄉婦女群體提供了得以自立更生的經濟賦權與支持。

examples.en: Giving frontline employees authority to solve client complaints creates an atmosphere of trust and empowerment.
examples.zh: 授權第一線基層同仁及時妥善解決客戶問題，能在企業內部營造出高度互信與賦權的優良文化。

entries.definition: 培力；賦權；賦予能力；社區充權賦能；賦權 (Empower)；個人財務自主掌控賦能；掌握國際共通語言帶來之強大自信賦權感

explains.en: It is the process of giving people the skills or authority to make choices for themselves. Education can help a community gain confidence. Leaders can support team members.
A program may help women gain more control over their finances. Workers can be given tools to make decisions. This can increase independence.
When people gain the ability and confidence to shape their lives, this process is happening. Training and support may help. It can happen in a workplace or community.

examples.en: Gourmet coffee shops in Taipei source single-origin Alishan beans.
examples.zh: 台北精品手沖咖啡名店嚴選來自阿里山高海拔產區的原生單品莊園咖啡豆。

examples.en: As a dedicated gourmet, he travels across continents simply to dine at renowned bistros.
examples.zh: 身為一名狂熱的美食家，他甚至跨越大洲只為在著名的餐酒館品嚐佳餚。

examples.en: The luxury hotel gift basket was packed with gourmet chocolates and artisan cheeses.
examples.zh: 該奢華飯店的迎賓禮籃中裝滿了精緻手工巧克力與頂級起司。

entries.definition: 老饕；美食家；精緻美味的

explains.en: A cook prepares a carefully made meal with high-quality ingredients. The food may be special or refined.
A person knows a lot about fine foods and enjoys comparing their flavors. Friends may ask this person for restaurant suggestions.
A hotel gives guests a box of carefully chosen cheeses and chocolates. These foods are made for people who enjoy excellent flavors.

examples.en: Earning three stars in the Michelin Guide represents the pinnacle of dining.
examples.zh: 榮獲法國米其林紅色美食指南三星最高榮譽代表了頂級餐飲的巔峰成就。

examples.en: Food enthusiasts consult the Michelin Guide whenever they explore international cities.
examples.zh: 美食愛好者探索國際大都會時，總會翻閱米其林指南尋找推薦餐廳。

examples.en: The chef wept with joy when his bistro was included in the latest Michelin Guide.
examples.zh: 當這家小餐館被收錄進最新版米其林指南時，主廚喜極而泣。

entries.definition: 米其林指南；紅色美食聖經

explains.en: Food lovers use this book to find restaurants around the world. It gives ratings and descriptions.
A chef may feel proud when a restaurant appears in this well-known dining guide. Travelers use it to choose where to eat.
People exploring a new city may check this guide for places to dine. Its stars are famous among restaurants.

examples.en: Many humble night market vendors proudly earned Bib Gourmand recognition.
examples.zh: 許多隱身於夜市巷弄的平民傳統攤販，皆光榮榮獲了必比登推介榜單肯定。

examples.en: The Bib Gourmand category highlights great food offered at moderate, reasonable prices.
examples.zh: 必比登推介專門推薦價格親民合理且物超所值的優質美味餐廳。

examples.en: Following the Bib Gourmand list is the best way to discover authentic local street fare.
examples.zh: 跟著必比登推介名單走是尋訪道地在地街頭平價美食的最佳捷徑。

entries.definition: 必比登推介（平價優質美食）

explains.en: This is a food guide recognition for restaurants that serve very good meals at reasonable prices. Small night-market shops may receive it. Visitors use the list to find local food.
A restaurant can earn this mark when its food is excellent but not too expensive. It helps travelers discover neighborhood places. The honor comes from a famous dining guide.
Use this name for a category that highlights good-value dining. The meals are praised for quality and fair cost. It can help people choose where to eat.

examples.en: The restaurant's signature dish is crispy roast duck served with sweet sauce.
examples.zh: 該餐廳名揚海內外的招牌代表菜是外皮烤至金黃香脆、搭配甜麵醬的脆皮烤鴨。

examples.en: Every newcomer is strongly advised to try the house signature dish before ordering desserts.
examples.zh: 每位新客人都被強烈建議在點甜點前一定要先品嚐店裡的當家招牌菜。

examples.en: The chef spent months perfecting his signature dish to showcase local seafood flavors.
examples.zh: 主廚耗時數月精心改良其招牌代表料理，以完美呈現在地現撈海鮮的鮮甜。

entries.definition: 招牌菜；招牌代表作料理

explains.en: It is a restaurant's most famous or representative meal. A chef may spend months perfecting it. Visitors often try it first.
A cook may create a special recipe that shows their style. Crispy duck with a house sauce can be one example. It is associated with a restaurant.
This popular menu item is closely linked to a particular chef or restaurant. It may feature local seafood. Guests are often encouraged to order it.

examples.en: Deep-fried stinky tofu served with pickled cabbage is an iconic local delicacy.
examples.zh: 外酥內嫩的金黃油炸臭豆腐搭配爽脆台式泡菜，是極具代表性的在地佳餚。

examples.en: Black truffles are considered a rare and costly delicacy in Mediterranean dining.
examples.zh: 黑松露在地中海精緻餐飲界被視為極其珍稀且身價不菲的頂級珍饈。

examples.en: The coastal fishing port is famous for dried mullet roe, a prized lunar new year delicacy.
examples.zh: 這座海濱漁港以出產烏魚子聞名，烏魚子是農曆春節期間極受歡迎的珍貴年菜佳餚。

entries.definition: 佳餚珍饈；在地名產特產

explains.en: A coastal town is known for a special dish made with fresh seafood. Visitors come to try it.
A rare, carefully prepared treat may be served at a celebration. It is considered especially fine food.
Some people enjoy a local specialty such as stinky tofu or dried mullet roe. The word can mean a valued dish.

examples.en: Fragrant braised pork rice (Lu Rou Fan) is Taiwan's ultimate comfort food.
examples.zh: 淋上濃郁鹹香肉燥醬汁的熱騰騰滷肉飯，是全台灣人心目中的靈魂國民美食。

examples.en: We ordered a plate of assorted braised tofu, dried seaweed, and marinated hard-boiled eggs.
examples.zh: 我們點了一盤包含滷豆干、滷海帶與滷蛋的綜合台式黑白切滷味拼盤。

examples.en: Tender braised beef brisket practically melts in your mouth after hours of slow cooking.
examples.zh: 鮮嫩多汁的紅燒牛腩在經過數小時文火燉煮後，幾乎入口即化。

explains.en: This describes food cooked slowly in a little liquid. Pork or tofu may become tender this way.
A cook may simmer beef for hours until it is soft. The long, gentle cooking adds flavor.
This cooking style uses low heat and a covered pot. It can make meat tender and rich.

examples.en: Sizzling oyster omelets drizzled with savory-sweet pink sauce are mouth-watering.
examples.zh: 鐵板上滋滋作響的鮮蚵蚵仔煎淋上特調甜辣粉紅海山醬，令人垂涎三尺。

examples.en: Dad prepared a fluffy breakfast omelet stuffed with diced ham, mushrooms, and cheese.
examples.zh: 父親貼心準備了包入香濃火腿丁、野菇與熔化起司的鬆軟西式美式煎蛋捲。

examples.en: The hotel chef customized omelets to order at the bustling morning breakfast buffet.
examples.zh: 飯店主廚在熱鬧的晨間自助早餐吧依照客人的喜好現點現做專屬歐姆蛋。

explains.en: This is a dish made by cooking beaten eggs in a pan, often folded around other ingredients. A cook may add cheese, ham, or mushrooms. It is popular for breakfast.
A chef can prepare this egg dish with fillings chosen by the customer. It may be served with vegetables or bread. The outside is cooked until set.
Use this word for a flat egg dish cooked in a pan. It can be plain or filled with food. Many hotels offer it in the morning.

examples.en: Freshly pressed golden sweet potato balls are delightfully chewy and airy.
examples.zh: 剛在大油鍋中反覆壓炸起鍋的金黃地瓜球外酥內 Q、口感蓬鬆彈牙。

examples.en: Night market customers happily queue up to buy a paper bag of freshly fried sweet potato balls.
examples.zh: 夜市裡的排隊常客開心地耐著性子排隊，只為了買上一包剛起鍋的香脆地瓜球。

examples.en: The vendor presses down on each sweet potato ball multiple times to make it expand with air.
examples.zh: 攤販在油鍋中反覆按壓每一顆地瓜球，好讓它吸入空氣變得蓬鬆中空又酥脆。

explains.en: It is a chewy fried snack made from starchy vegetable dough. Night market vendors often serve it in a paper bag. It becomes airy when cooked well.
A cook shapes a root vegetable mixture into small balls and fries them until golden. The outside can be crisp while the inside stays chewy. It is popular in Taiwan.
This Taiwanese treat is made from a starchy vegetable and flour. Vendors may press the pieces while frying so they expand. They are best eaten warm.

examples.en: Taiwanese popcorn chicken seasoned with fragrant fried basil is addictive.
examples.zh: 撒上胡椒鹽並佐以酥炸九層塔葉的台式鹽酥雞，香氣逼人讓人一口接一口。

examples.en: Late-night cram school students often pick up popcorn chicken on their walk home.
examples.zh: 深夜補習班下課的學生們常常會在漫步走回家的路上順道買份鹽酥雞打牙祭。

examples.en: You can choose your desired level of chili powder when buying hot popcorn chicken.
examples.zh: 購買熱騰騰的鹽酥雞時，你可以自由挑選微辣、中辣或大辣的辣椒粉辣度。

explains.en: Small pieces of seasoned chicken are coated and fried until crisp. In Taiwan, vendors may add basil and pepper.
Students often buy this hot snack from a night-market stall. It is usually served in a paper bag.
The bite-sized fried chicken is easy to share with friends. Customers may choose how spicy it should be.

examples.en: Taiwan invented bubble tea, which is now a global beverage phenomenon.
examples.zh: 台灣原創發明的珍珠奶茶如今已席捲全球各大洲，掀起席捲全球的波霸風潮。

examples.en: Customers can customize their bubble tea by selecting sugar levels and ice amounts.
examples.zh: 顧客在購買手搖珍珠奶茶時，可以完全客製化調整個人偏好的甜度與冰塊量。

examples.en: Trendy bubble tea shops have opened across London, Tokyo, and New York.
examples.zh: 時尚前衛的手搖珍珠奶茶專賣店已如雨後春筍般進駐倫敦、東京與紐約街頭。

explains.en: This Taiwanese drink can have chewy tapioca balls inside. Customers choose how sweet or icy it is.
A tea shop may offer this popular beverage with milk and pearls. It began in Taiwan and spread to many countries.
Some people choose fruit flavors, while others prefer milk tea. The round chewy pieces are usually added at the bottom.

examples.en: Enjoying sweet mango shaved ice topped with condensed milk beats the summer heat.
examples.zh: 在酷暑炎夏大啖一碗鋪滿新鮮愛文芒果、淋上濃郁煉乳的芒果刨冰最消暑。

examples.en: We ordered a giant bowl of traditional shaved ice loaded with red beans, pearls, and taro.
examples.zh: 我們點了一大碗堆滿蜜紅豆、粉圓與九份芋圓配料的傳統古早味黑糖挫冰。

examples.en: Finely textured milk shaved ice melts instantaneously on your tongue like snow.
examples.zh: 質地極致細膩的雪花冰送入口中時，如同初雪般瞬間在舌尖曼妙融化。

explains.en: This dessert is made from very finely shaved frozen water and topped with fruit, beans, or syrup. It melts quickly on the tongue. People enjoy it on hot days.
A shop may serve a bowl with mango, red beans, or chewy toppings. The ice is lighter than hard cubes. Sweet sauces add flavor.
Use this phrase for a cold dessert of thin ice curls with toppings. It may be made with milk for a creamy taste. It helps people cool off in summer.

examples.en: Foreign travelers booked a guided evening night market food tour in Shilin.
examples.zh: 歐美外國背包客預訂了由在地導遊帶領的士林夜市深度小吃踩點美食巡禮。

examples.en: A walking food tour through Tainan introduces visitors to historic snacks and desserts.
examples.zh: 漫步穿梭於府城台南舊城區的美食小旅行，帶領遊客逐一探訪老字號點心與甜品。

examples.en: Our food tour host explained the cultural significance of every single street dish.
examples.zh: 帶領我們展開美食巡禮的導遊熱情講解了每道街頭經典料理背後的在地文化淵源。

entries.definition: 美食巡禮；小吃踩點之旅

explains.en: It is a guided walk or trip where people sample local dishes. A host may explain the history of each snack. Visitors can explore a night market.
Travelers visit several places to taste regional specialties. A guide may take them through historic streets in Tainan. The tour can include desserts and savory food.
This activity combines sightseeing with trying food. A local host may share cultural stories about each dish. It is a fun way to explore a city.

examples.en: Department store basement food courts offer an enormous variety of Asian meals.
examples.zh: 百貨公司地下美食街匯聚了豐富多元的台式、日式與各國平價精緻餐飲。

examples.en: The university food court is packed with students enjoying affordable lunches.
examples.zh: 大學的美食廣場中午時分總是擠滿了享受物美價廉午餐套餐的年輕學子。

examples.en: Airport food courts allow transit passengers to sample local food before boarding.
examples.zh: 機場轉機區的美食廣場讓過境旅客在登機離境前能輕鬆品嚐在地名產。

entries.definition: 百貨美食街；大型美食廣場

explains.en: A shopping center has many small counters where people can choose different meals. Shared tables are nearby.
Students pick noodles, rice, or sandwiches from several vendors and eat in one area. It is often found in a mall.
At an airport, travelers can buy food from several restaurants and sit together. Each person can choose a different meal.

examples.en: Hungry customers queued patiently outside the Michelin-recommended bakery.
examples.zh: 慕名而來的饕客們在米其林推介的人氣烘焙糕餅名店門外耐心排隊等候。

examples.en: It is considered extremely rude to jump the queue at ticket counters or bus stops.
examples.zh: 在火車站售票櫃台或公車站插隊插前被視為極其無禮不文明的行為。

examples.en: A long queue formed down the block before the popular bubble tea store even opened.
examples.zh: 在那家人氣手搖珍奶名店尚未開門營業前，排隊人龍就已沿著街角延伸至巷尾。

explains.en: People wait in a line for a ticket or a snack. It is rude to go ahead of those already waiting.
A crowd may form outside a bakery before it opens. Customers wait their turn to buy bread.
This word can name a line of people or mean waiting in one. A popular shop may have a long line.

examples.en: Whenever I feel homesick studying overseas, I crave hot beef noodle soup.
examples.zh: 每當我在海外留學想家孤單時，心裡總會無比渴望來一碗熱騰騰的紅燒牛肉麵。

examples.en: Expectant mothers often crave unusual flavor combinations like pickles and ice cream.
examples.zh: 懷孕的準媽媽們經常會嘴饞想吃一些奇妙的組合，例如酸黃瓜配冰淇淋。

examples.en: After completing the grueling marathon, he craved an ice-cold fizzy soda.
examples.zh: 在跑完艱辛漫長的全程馬拉松後，他極度渴望痛快暢飲一杯沁涼透心涼的氣泡汽水。

explains.en: You do this when you want something very strongly, often a particular food. A traveler may long for a familiar soup. After a long run, someone may want a cold drink.
An expectant parent might desire an unusual mix of tastes. The feeling can be strong and hard to ignore. It is often used for food.
Use this verb for having a powerful wish or need. A person may want a certain snack after exercise. It can also describe wanting attention or comfort.

examples.en: Sizzling scallion pancakes filled with cheese and egg look mouth-watering.
examples.zh: 鐵板上熱騰騰剛起鍋、夾入起司與香蔥的現煎蔥抓餅看起來令人垂涎三尺。

examples.en: A mouth-watering aroma drifted out from the bakery as the fresh sourdough came out of the oven.
examples.zh: 當剛出爐的天然酵母酸種麵包起鍋時，一陣陣令人食指大動的烘焙香氣撲鼻而來。

examples.en: The glossy food photographs in the magazine made every gourmet course look mouth-watering.
examples.zh: 雜誌上印刷精美、光澤誘人的美食特寫照片讓每一道精緻餐點都顯得令人垂涎三尺。

entries.definition: 令人垂涎三尺的；令人食指大動的

explains.en: It describes food that looks or smells so delicious that you want to eat it. Fresh bread can fill a bakery with an inviting scent. A glossy photo may have the same effect.
A sizzling pancake with cheese may make people hungry just by looking at it. This adjective can describe its appearance or aroma. It is often used in food writing.
Use this adjective for a dish that seems extremely tasty. The smell of warm sourdough can draw people into a shop. A picture can also make food seem appealing.

examples.en: Take your time to savor every subtle nuance of the chef's tasting menu.
examples.zh: 請放慢用餐節奏，細細品味名廚精心研發的品嚐套餐中每一道料理的細膩層次。

examples.en: She closed her eyes to savor the rich dark chocolate melting across her palate.
examples.zh: 她輕輕閉上雙眼，全神貫注地細細品味頂級黑巧克力在口腔溫度中慢慢化開的美妙感受。

examples.en: Enjoy your graduation trip and savor every remaining moment spent together with classmates.
examples.zh: 盡情享受你們的畢業旅行，細細體會並珍惜與同窗好友相聚的每一個珍貴時光。

examples.en: Close your eyes to slowly savor the lingering mountain sweetness on the back of your tongue.
examples.zh: 閉上雙眼，靜下心來慢慢細品舌根深處不斷回湧的高山甘甜茶韻。

examples.en: After years of relentless sacrifice, the retiring founder took time to travel and savor life’s peaceful moments.
examples.zh: 歷經數十年商場征戰的辛勞奉獻後，榮退的創辦人終於有充裕時間攜伴環遊世界，細細品味慢活的寧靜美好。

examples.en: The authentic beef noodle soup had a savory depth and rich herbal savor that won over critics.
examples.zh: 這碗承襲三代配方的老字號紅燒牛肉麵湯頭濃醇回甘，蘊含濃郁漢方辛香料的誘人滋味，征服了各大美食家。

entries.definition: 細細品味；慢慢享用；體會；慢啜細品茶韻；滋味

explains.en: Eat a small piece of chocolate slowly and notice its rich taste. Enjoy the moment instead of rushing.
A person takes time to appreciate the sweetness of tea after a long walk. This can mean enjoying an experience deeply.
During a graduation trip, friends pay attention to each happy moment together. They want to remember and enjoy it.

examples.en: Brown sugar boba tapioca pearls are cooked until perfectly soft and chewy (Q).
examples.zh: 手炒黑糖慢火熬煮的波霸珍珠粉圓被精準燉煮至完美軟嫩又極富 Q 彈嚼勁。

examples.en: Freshly baked bagels should have a crisp golden crust and a delightfully chewy center.
examples.zh: 剛出爐的新鮮美式貝果應當擁有金黃薄脆的外皮與扎實富嚼勁的內層組織。

examples.en: Traditional Taiwanese mochi is deliciously chewy and coated with aromatic peanut powder.
examples.zh: 傳統現做客家麻糬口感軟糯彈牙、極富嚼勁，外層再裹上一層厚厚的香濃花生粉。

entries.definition: Q 彈的；有嚼勁的；彈牙的

explains.en: A bagel may feel firm and take time to bite through. This describes that texture.
Mochi is soft but needs a little more chewing than pudding. Many people enjoy this feel.
Tapioca balls in a drink may feel springy and take effort to chew. This word describes food with that texture.

examples.en: Steamed savory turnip radish cake is a staple breakfast favorite in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 煎至兩面金黃微焦的古早味客家蘿蔔糕是全台傳統中式早餐店的鹹香人氣首選。

examples.en: Some people prefer sweet breakfast pancakes, while others favor savory bacon and eggs.
examples.zh: 有些人早餐喜歡吃淋上蜂蜜的甜煎餅，而另一些人則偏愛鹹香可口的培根加煎蛋。

examples.en: The bakery offers both sweet fruit tarts and savory mushroom quiches.
examples.zh: 這家烘焙坊既販售酸甜水果塔，也供應香氣濃郁的鹹香法式野菇鹹派。

entries.definition: 鹹香可口的；鮮美開胃的

explains.en: This describes food with a salty or rich flavor rather than a sweet one. Radish cake is often eaten this way. It may contain meat or mushrooms.
Some people prefer eggs and bacon to pancakes with syrup. This adjective describes that kind of taste. Mushroom quiche is another example.
Use this word for a dish that is not sweet. It may have herbs, cheese, or vegetables. A bakery can sell both sweet and this kind of food.

examples.en: Dried shiitake mushrooms and sun-dried bonito flakes are rich in natural umami.
examples.zh: 日曬埔里乾香菇與柴魚片富含天然純粹的谷氨酸鮮味，能大幅提升高湯風味。

examples.en: Parmesan cheese and ripe tomatoes naturally contain high levels of savory umami.
examples.zh: 帕瑪森陳年乳酪與熟成番茄天生就蘊含著豐富醇厚且令人垂涎的天然鮮味。

examples.en: Adding a dash of fermented soy sauce unlocks deep layers of umami in the stew.
examples.zh: 在慢火燉菜中加入少許純釀造甘醇醬油，能瞬間激發出深層而豐富的鮮美風味。

examples.en: Concentrating aged kombu kelp and sun-dried mushrooms unlocks an overwhelming explosion of deep umami.
examples.zh: 將陳年昆布與日曬香菇濃縮提煉，在舌面上釋放出令人欲罷不能、深沉澎湃的「極致鮮味」（Umami）。

examples.en: Japanese culinary tradition defines umami as the savory fifth taste alongside sweet, sour, salty, and bitter.
examples.zh: 日本傳統料理學界將鮮味定義為獨立於甜、酸、鹹、苦之外的第五種基本味覺層次。

examples.en: Adding a splash of aged fish sauce or fermented paste elevates the underlying umami of braised meats.
examples.zh: 在紅燒燉肉時滴入幾滴老牌陳年純魚露或豆瓣發酵醬，能瞬間昇華肉品深層的天然鮮甘味底蘊。

entries.definition: 鮮味（第五種味覺）；熟成昆布與帕瑪森起司之天然谷氨酸極致鮮味

explains.en: It is a savory taste found in foods such as mushrooms, tomatoes, and aged cheese. It is often described as a fifth basic taste. Fermented soy sauce can add it to soup.
Some foods have a deep, rich flavor that is not simply sweet, sour, salty, or bitter. Parmesan and ripe tomatoes are good examples. It makes broth taste fuller.
This taste is common in dried mushrooms and bonito flakes. A little soy sauce can add depth to a stew. It is one of the basic taste sensations.

examples.en: Marinate tender beef slices overnight in soy sauce, sesame oil, and garlic.
examples.zh: 將鮮嫩牛肉薄片浸泡於香醇醬油、純麻油與蒜碎特調醬汁中冷藏醃漬一整夜。

examples.en: Be sure to marinate the chicken wings for at least two hours before grilling them.
examples.zh: 在把雞翅放上烤肉架炙烤前，請務必先將其置入特調醃料中浸泡入味至少兩小時。

examples.en: Acidic ingredients like lemon juice or yogurt help tenderize and marinate tough meats.
examples.zh: 檸檬汁或原味優格等微酸性食材能有助於軟化肉質纖維，使醃漬過程更加入味。

explains.en: Put chicken in a mixture of herbs and sauce for a while before cooking. The flavors soak into the food.
A cook leaves beef in soy sauce and garlic before grilling it. This can add flavor and soften the meat.
Some recipes use lemon juice or yogurt with spices. The food rests in the mixture before it is cooked.

examples.en: Adjust the soup seasoning with a pinch of white pepper and sea salt.
examples.zh: 在出鍋裝碗前加入一小撮香濃白胡椒粉與海鹽輕輕攪拌，為鮮湯微調風味。

examples.en: Natural seasonings like minced garlic, shallots, and ginger enhance any savory dish.
examples.zh: 蒜碎、紅蔥頭與生薑等天然辛香調味料能讓任何鹹香熱菜的香氣倍增。

examples.en: The barbecue dry rub seasoning blend contains paprika, brown sugar, and cumin.
examples.zh: 這款美式燒烤專用乾醃香料調味粉融合了紅椒粉、純黑糖與芳香孜然粉。

examples.en: Proper wood seasoning in temperature-controlled kilns reduces moisture content to prevent internal stress.
examples.zh: 在溫控木材乾燥窯中進行嚴謹的木材乾燥，將含水率降至8%，徹底釋放內部應力。

examples.en: Add a pinch of sea salt and freshly cracked black pepper as final seasoning before serving the steak.
examples.zh: 在牛排端上桌擺盤之前，撒上一小撮天然海鹽與現磨黑胡椒作為最後的調味提味。

examples.en: Natural air seasoning of thick timber planks can take up to two years in well-ventilated dry sheds.
examples.zh: 在將厚重的原木大板放置在通風良好的乾燥棚內進行自然陰乾風乾，往往需要長達兩年時間。

entries.definition: 調味料；調味粉；原木天然風乾與窯乾乾燥工序

explains.en: Salt, pepper, or garlic can add taste to a soup or steak. Use a little at a time.
A mix of spices may make food smell and taste better. Minced ginger and shallots are common in cooking.
Wood can be dried carefully before it is used to build furniture. This word can name that process too.

examples.en: Essential table condiments include garlic soy sauce paste and sweet chili dip.
examples.zh: 台灣餐桌必備的靈魂沾醬佐料包含甘甜的蒜蓉醬油膏與微辣的海山甜辣醬。

examples.en: Mustard, ketchup, and mayonnaise are standard condiments served with French fries.
examples.zh: 黃芥末醬、番茄醬與美乃滋是佐薯條食用的常見西餐經典佐料醬汁。

examples.en: The breakfast diner keeps a carousel of condiments on each customer booth table.
examples.zh: 這家中式傳統早餐店在每張顧客用餐隔間餐桌上都擺放了一整套各式沾醬佐料。

explains.en: This is a sauce or seasoning added to food at the table. Mustard and ketchup are examples. People use it to add flavor.
A diner may keep several bottles on each table. Garlic soy sauce or chili dip can go with a meal. Guests add only as much as they like.
Use this noun for something placed on food to improve its taste. It may be salty, spicy, or tangy. It is served alongside a dish.

examples.en: Gua Bao (Taiwanese pork belly burger) is generously topped with fresh cilantro.
examples.zh: 經典台式傳統刈包（虎咬豬）夾入厚切控肉後會大方撒上花生粉與鮮嫩香菜。

examples.en: Some people possess a genetic variation that makes cilantro taste like soap to them.
examples.zh: 部分族群體內攜帶特定的嗅覺受體基因變異，導致他們覺得香菜吃起來宛如肥皂水。

examples.en: Garnish the warm bowl of thick oyster vermicelli with a sprig of green cilantro.
examples.zh: 在熱氣騰騰的香濃大腸蚵仔麵線最上方，點綴上一小撮翠綠新鮮的香菜提味。

explains.en: It is a fresh green herb often sprinkled on pork buns or noodle soup. Some people say it tastes like soap to them. Rinse it before chopping.
This leafy herb adds a bright flavor to many dishes. It is common in Taiwanese snacks. Chop it just before serving.
A sprig of this plant can garnish soup or a sandwich. Its taste is strong and fresh. Individual preferences differ.

examples.en: Star anise adds an irreplaceable, aromatic fragrance to Taiwanese beef stews.
examples.zh: 八角是為台式紅燒牛肉麵與老滷汁注入無可取代誘人中草藥複合香氣的核心。

examples.en: Chinese five-spice powder is made from grinding cinnamon, cloves, fennel, star anise, and peppercorns.
examples.zh: 中華五香粉是由肉桂、丁香、茴香、八角大茴香與花椒研磨混合調配而成。

examples.en: Toss two whole pods of star anise into the boiling pot to eliminate gamey odors from the broth.
examples.zh: 丟入兩顆完整的乾燥八角茴香進滾水中，能有效祛除高湯中多餘的肉腥羶味。

explains.en: This brown, star-shaped spice adds a sweet licorice-like smell to soups and stews. It is often used in five-spice seasoning.
A cook drops a whole dried pod into broth to add fragrance. Remove it before serving if desired.
The spice has pointed arms and a strong aroma. It can flavor Taiwanese beef noodle soup.

examples.en: The French-Taiwanese fine dining restaurant features an 8-course tasting menu.
examples.zh: 這家融合法式技法與台灣在地風土的頂級餐廳推出精緻的八道式品嚐套餐。

examples.en: Ordering the seasonal tasting menu allows diners to experience the chef's full creativity.
examples.zh: 點選當季限定主廚品嚐套餐能讓老饕一飽口福，全方位體驗大廚的極致藝術創意。

examples.en: Wine pairings are carefully curated to complement each individual dish on the tasting menu.
examples.zh: 侍酒師為品嚐套餐中的每一道獨立特色佳餚都量身精選了絕妙的佐餐名酒搭檔。

entries.definition: 主廚品嚐套餐；試菜套餐

explains.en: A restaurant may serve several small dishes chosen by the chef. Each one shows a different idea.
Guests can try a series of foods instead of choosing one large dish. Drinks may be selected to go with each part.
This meal lets diners experience the chef's cooking across multiple courses. The dishes often change with the season.

examples.en: Guests chose between pan-seared cherry valley duck breast and ribeye for their entrée.
examples.zh: 貴賓在主菜部分可自香煎宜蘭櫻桃鴨胸與美國特選肋眼牛排中自由二選一。

examples.en: The waiter explained that each entrée comes with roasted seasonal potatoes and greens.
examples.zh: 服務人員親切說明，每道精緻主菜皆會隨餐附上烤得香軟的時令馬鈴薯與鮮甜嫩綠時蔬。

examples.en: In American dining parlance, the entrée refers to the principal, most substantial course.
examples.zh: 在美式英語餐飲慣用語境中，entrée 專指整個套餐裡最為核心厚重的精華主菜。

entries.definition: 主菜（美式英語）；前菜（法式）

explains.en: In the United States, this is the main dish of a meal. A restaurant may offer duck or steak as choices. In some other places, the word can mean a small dish served first.
A waiter may explain what comes with the main course. Diners choose one from the menu. The meaning can differ between countries.
Use this word for a course in a restaurant meal. American menus usually use it for the largest dish. In some countries, it refers to a starter.

examples.en: A scoop of tart lemon sorbet served as an invigorating palate cleanser.
examples.zh: 一小球酸甜冰涼的清爽義式檸檬雪酪及時送上，為味蕾帶來喚醒清爽的清口體驗。

examples.en: Between heavy fish and red meat courses, the server presented an icy herbal palate cleanser.
examples.zh: 在味道濃郁的鮮魚與紅肉兩道主菜接替空檔，侍者端上了冰鎮草本風味清口冰沙。

examples.en: A good palate cleanser removes lingering greasy flavors and resets your sensory tastebuds.
examples.zh: 好的清口小品能掃除口腔中殘留的油膩餘味，讓味蕾徹底歸零以迎接下一道美味。

entries.definition: 清口雪酪；清口小品冰沙

explains.en: It is a small food or drink served between courses to refresh the mouth. Lemon sorbet is a common choice. It helps clear lingering flavors.
An icy herbal sip may be offered between fish and meat dishes. This lets diners taste the next course more clearly. It is usually light.
A restaurant may serve something tart and cold to remove rich flavors. This helps reset the sense of taste. Sorbet can work well.

examples.en: The certified sommelier recommended an aromatic dry white wine to pair with seafood.
examples.zh: 專業認證的侍酒師為海鮮主菜推薦了一款香氣清雅、酸度明亮的頂級白葡萄酒。

examples.en: Passing the rigorous examinations to become a Master Sommelier takes years of study.
examples.zh: 通過極為嚴格艱澀的術科考核以晉升為大師級侍酒師，需要投注多年的深入苦讀與品鑑。

examples.en: The sommelier expertly decanted the vintage red wine to let it breathe before serving.
examples.zh: 侍酒師動作優雅專業地將陳年典藏紅酒倒入醒酒器中醒酒，使其香氣徹底綻放。

explains.en: At a restaurant, this trained worker suggests wine that goes well with the meal. They may describe its taste and origin.
A guest orders seafood, and a knowledgeable wine professional recommends a suitable drink. They may also open the bottle.
This dining expert studies wine and helps customers choose what to serve. Some have passed difficult professional exams.

examples.en: The famous food critic praised the restaurant's creative fusion of local ingredients.
examples.zh: 知名美食評論家大力撰文盛讚該餐廳巧妙融合在地小農食材的卓越前瞻創意。

examples.en: Chefs often feel nervous when they spot a renowned food critic sitting anonymously in the dining room.
examples.zh: 當大廚發現某位名聞遐邇的美食評論家悄悄隱身於外場包廂用餐時，無不神經緊繃。

examples.en: A glowing five-star review from an influential food critic can double bookings overnight.
examples.zh: 具強大話語權的知名食評家撰寫的一篇五星好評，往往能讓餐廳預訂量在一夜之間暴增。

explains.en: This writer visits restaurants and tells readers what the food is like. A strong review may bring more customers.
A restaurant owner may feel nervous when a well-known reviewer arrives. The writer may describe the service and dishes.
People read this person's opinion before choosing a place to eat. The writer may praise a creative dish.

examples.en: Preserving indigenous culinary heritage passes ancient tribal recipes to youth.
examples.zh: 悉心傳承台灣原住民傳統飲食文化遺產，能將古老的部落野菜智慧世代傳遞。

examples.en: Taiwan's diverse immigration history created an exceptionally unique and rich culinary heritage.
examples.zh: 台灣多元豐富的移民開拓歷史造就了獨樹一幟、博採眾長的深厚飲食文化遺產底蘊。

examples.en: Documenting century-old baking techniques helps safeguard the nation's precious culinary heritage.
examples.zh: 筆錄並拍攝保存百年傳統製餅老手藝，有助於完整捍衛守護國家珍貴的飲食文化遺產。

entries.definition: 飲食文化遺產；傳統美食底蘊

explains.en: This is the collection of food traditions and recipes passed down through generations. A community may keep old cooking methods alive. It reflects a region's history.
Families can teach traditional dishes to younger people. Immigrants and local groups may shape a place's food culture. Recording recipes helps preserve it.
Use this phrase for a community's cooking traditions, dishes, and food knowledge. It can include indigenous recipes. Protecting it helps future generations learn.

examples.en: Taiwan's electronics manufacturers supply critical automotive semiconductors worldwide.
examples.zh: 台灣電子科技製造大廠向全球供應不可或缺的車用車載半導體晶片。

examples.en: The German company is a world leader in automotive engineering and luxury vehicles.
examples.zh: 這家德國企業在汽車工程與豪華車輛製造領域位居全球領導地位。

examples.en: Rapid advancements in battery technology are reshaping the entire automotive sector.
examples.zh: 電池技術的突飛猛進正在重塑整個汽車製造業的生態版圖。

examples.en: The global automotive industry is undergoing a massive shift from fossil fuels to electric propulsion.
examples.zh: 全球汽車工業正迎來百年一遇的重大歷史變革，由傳統燃油動力全面轉向純電驅動。

examples.en: Leading automotive suppliers in Taiwan provide advanced semiconductor chips and precision wire harnesses.
examples.zh: 台灣頂尖的車用電子供應鏈廠商，向全球大廠供應先進車用晶片與高階精密線束。

examples.en: After earning his engineering degree, he joined an automotive research laboratory focusing on battery chemistry.
examples.zh: 在取得工程學位後，他加入了一家專注於鋰電池化學材料開發的汽車工程研發實驗室。

entries.definition: 汽車的；車輛製造的；汽車工業的；車輛工程的

explains.en: It relates to cars and the industry that designs and builds them. Engineers work on vehicles and their parts. Electric batteries are changing this field.
A company may make chips for cars or study how vehicles are built. This adjective describes that industry. Engineering programs may prepare students for it.
Use this word for technology, businesses, or work connected with motor vehicles. New battery designs are changing the sector. It can describe parts and manufacturing.

examples.en: High-density lithium-ion battery packs allow modern EVs to travel 500 kilometers.
examples.zh: 高能量密度的鋰離子電池模組讓現代電動車單次充飽電具備超過五百公里的續航。

examples.en: Most consumer laptops and smartphones are powered by rechargeable lithium-ion cells.
examples.zh: 大多數消費型筆記型電腦與智慧型手機皆由可重複充電的鋰離子電芯供電。

examples.en: Scientists are researching ways to make lithium-ion batteries charge faster and degrade less.
examples.zh: 科學家正積極研發如何讓鋰離子電池充電速度更快且壽命衰減更緩慢。

explains.en: Many phones use rechargeable cells that are light and hold a lot of energy. Handle damaged batteries carefully.
An electric car stores power in a pack made from a common rechargeable battery chemistry. Researchers work to improve safety and charging.
This battery type is found in laptops and cameras. It can be recharged many times, but should not be overheated.

examples.en: A widespread charging network relieves driver range anxiety during cross-island road trips.
examples.zh: 遍布全島的密集充電網絡徹底消除了駕駛在環島長途旅行時的電量里程焦慮。

examples.en: Improvements in battery capacity have helped consumers overcome initial range anxiety.
examples.zh: 電池容量技術的大幅進步有效幫助消費者克服了起初購車時的里程焦慮。

examples.en: Cold winter weather can decrease driving range, slightly increasing driver range anxiety.
examples.zh: 寒冷的冬日氣候會稍微降低純電續航里程，略微加深駕駛者的電量里程焦慮。

entries.definition: 里程焦慮（擔心電量不足）

explains.en: An electric car driver may worry that the battery will run out before reaching a charger. A larger battery can help.
More charging stations along a highway can make drivers feel safer. Cold weather may shorten the distance a car can travel.
This worry may happen when someone is unsure how far an electric vehicle can go. Planning charging stops can ease it.

examples.en: New residential condominium buildings must pre-install EV charging pile wiring.
examples.zh: 現代新建住宅公寓大樓法令規定管線皆須預留電動車充電樁專用獨立配線。

examples.en: Homeowners can install a smart AC charging pile in their private parking space.
examples.zh: 透天厝與獨立產權車主可以在其私人停車格內安裝智慧型慢充家用充電樁。

examples.en: The city plans to add hundreds of curbside charging piles along downtown avenues.
examples.zh: 市府計畫沿著市中心主要幹道兩側增設數百座路邊公共充電樁。

explains.en: This is a fixed place where electric vehicles plug in to receive power. A new apartment building may install wiring for one. Cities can add them along streets.
A driver can park beside this equipment and connect an electric car. Homeowners may have one in a private parking space. It supplies electricity to the battery.
Use this term for a station or post that recharges an electric vehicle. Some are installed in parking garages. More public ones help drivers travel farther.

examples.en: DC fast charging adds 200 kilometers of driving range in just fifteen minutes.
examples.zh: 直流（DC）快速充電僅需短短十五分鐘即可為車輛迅速補充兩百公里的續航里程。

examples.en: Frequent reliance on extreme fast charging can slightly accelerate battery degradation over time.
examples.zh: 長期頻繁依賴超高速快充，隨著時間推移可能會稍微加快電池健康度的衰退速度。

examples.en: Road-trippers depend on fast charging plazas located near major freeway interchanges.
examples.zh: 自駕長途出遊的旅人格外仰賴設置在主要高速公路交流道周邊的快充休息站。

entries.definition: 直流快速充電 (DC 快充)

explains.en: It is a way to add energy to an electric car's battery quickly at a powerful station. A short stop may add many kilometers of range. Frequent use can cause some wear.
Drivers on a long trip may use a high-power charger near a highway. It can refill a battery much faster than a home outlet. Check compatibility first.
This method uses strong electrical power to recharge a vehicle in less time. Stations are often placed along major roads. Too much can affect battery life.

examples.en: Taiwan adopted CCS2 and NACS as standard high-speed EV charging connectors.
examples.zh: 台灣各大充電營運商主要採用 CCS2 與特斯拉 NACS 作為主流快充連接器規格。

examples.en: Drivers often carry adapters to ensure compatibility with different charging connectors.
examples.zh: 許多電動車主隨車攜帶轉接頭，以確保能相容於各種不同規格的充電槍連接器。

examples.en: Inspect the rubber seals inside the charging connector before plugging it into your car.
examples.zh: 在將充電槍插頭插入車輛充電孔前，請先檢視連接器內部的橡膠防水密封圈。

examples.en: Universal charging adapters bridge CCS1 and Tesla NACS charging connectors seamlessly.
examples.zh: 隨車攜帶通用充電轉接頭，能在美規 CCS1、歐規 CCS2 與特斯拉 NACS 各大充電槍規格間無縫切換。

examples.en: Ensure the charging connector is fully clicked into the vehicle inlet port before tapping your RFID card.
examples.zh: 在感應充電扣款卡或啟動手機 App 之前，請務必先確認充電槍接頭已完整確實卡入車身充電插孔。

examples.en: Gold-plated audio connectors prevent signal interference and static hum in high-end sound studio equipment.
examples.zh: 專業錄音室頂級音響器材一律採用鍍金音源接頭，徹底杜絕雜訊干擾、電磁雜音與接觸不良底噪。

entries.definition: 充電連接器；充電插頭規格；電動車充電槍接頭規格；連接器

explains.en: A cable has a plug at each end that joins an electric car to a charging station. Check that they fit before plugging in.
A small metal part joins two wires or pieces of equipment. In music gear, it may help carry a sound signal.
A device or fitting links one thing to another. Some charging stations and cars need an adapter to connect.

examples.en: One-pedal driving uses regenerative braking to recapture kinetic energy down mountains.
examples.zh: 單踏板模式運用動能回充煞車系統，在下坡山路行駛時將動能轉化為電能回收。

examples.en: Regenerative braking reduces mechanical friction wear on conventional brake pads.
examples.zh: 動能回充煞車系統能大幅減輕傳統機械煞車來令片在行駛時的磨擦損耗。

examples.en: Drivers can adjust the sensitivity of regenerative braking to match their driving style.
examples.zh: 駕駛人可以自由微調動能回收煞車的阻尼力道強弱，以貼合個人開車操駕習慣。

explains.en: An electric car can slow down and send some energy back to its battery. This can reduce wear on the brakes.
When a driver releases the accelerator, the motor can help slow the car. The battery stores some of that energy.
This system captures energy while a vehicle slows down. Drivers may adjust how strongly the car slows when they lift their foot.

examples.en: The electric SUV comes standard with an 80 kilowatt-hour (kWh) battery pack.
examples.zh: 這款豪華純電休旅車標配了高達 80 千瓦小時（度電 kWh）的大容量電池組。

examples.en: Charging rates are billed at nine New Taiwan Dollars per kilowatt-hour during peak hours.
examples.zh: 在尖峰時段，該快充站的充電費率為每千瓦小時（每度電）九元新台幣。

examples.en: Household power meters measure monthly electrical energy usage in kilowatt-hours.
examples.zh: 一般家用電表皆是以千瓦小時（度）為單位，來精準計算每月份的用電度數。

entries.definition: 千瓦小時；度（電量單位 kWh）

explains.en: This is a unit for measuring how much electrical energy a home or device uses. An electric car battery may hold many of them. A power bill can charge for each one.
A household meter records energy use in this unit. The price may be higher during busy hours. It measures energy over time, not just power at one moment.
Use this measurement when talking about electricity consumed or stored. A car battery is often described with it. Homes may see the amount on a monthly bill.

examples.en: Cities aim to convert municipal bus fleets entirely to zero-emission electric buses.
examples.zh: 各大都會區全力推動將市區公車車隊全數汰換為百分之百零排放的純電電動公車。

examples.en: Hydrogen fuel cell vehicles are another promising class of zero-emission mobility.
examples.zh: 氫燃料電池車輛是另一種深具發展潛力且備受矚目的零排放綠能移動方案。

examples.en: Transitioning to zero-emission transportation significantly cleans up urban air quality.
examples.zh: 全面過渡至零碳排綠色運輸工具能大幅改善都會區長年的空氣品質。

explains.en: It describes a vehicle or process that releases no exhaust gases while operating. Electric buses are one example. This can help clean city air.
Some vehicles use batteries or hydrogen fuel cells and do not produce tailpipe pollution. Cities may switch their bus fleets to them. The adjective describes that result.
Use this term for transport or technology that produces no direct exhaust. It can reduce pollution on busy streets. Hydrogen-powered vehicles are another option.

examples.en: Electrifying heavy transport is vital for national net-zero decarbonization goals.
examples.zh: 重型運輸工具的全面電動化是達成國家 2050 淨零排放去碳化目標的關鍵樞紐。

examples.en: Heavy industries are investing billions into renewable energy and industrial decarbonization.
examples.zh: 各大重工業集團正斥資數十億巨資投入再生能源佈局與製造業脫碳轉型。

examples.en: Achieving rapid decarbonization requires close cooperation between government and private industry.
examples.zh: 想要迅速實現全面去碳化，需要政府公部門與民間產業界維持緊密的政策合作。

examples.en: Electrifying city public bus fleets accelerates urban decarbonization and cleans metropolitan air.
examples.zh: 全面將都會市區公車汰換為國產智慧純電動巴士，大幅加速交通運具去碳化並淨化城市空氣品質。

examples.en: Heavy industries like steel and cement require green hydrogen to achieve complete industrial decarbonization.
examples.zh: 鋼鐵冶煉與水泥製造等重工業排放大戶，必須積極引進綠氫冶煉技術，方能落實深度的產業脫碳轉型。

examples.en: Taiwan's net-zero 2050 pathway sets ambitious milestones for transportation sector decarbonization.
examples.zh: 台灣二零五零淨零排放路徑藍圖，為公路大眾運輸與私人家用車輛的去碳化設定了極具雄心的階段里程碑。

examples.en: Maritime decarbonization accelerates as global shipping lines order green methanol dual-fuel container vessels.
examples.zh: 隨著全球各大航商大批訂購綠色甲醇雙燃料貨輪，國際海運脫碳淨零轉型全面加速。

examples.en: Installing wind-assisted rotor sails on cargo ships contributes to fleetwide decarbonization goals.
examples.zh: 在遠洋散裝貨輪甲板上加裝旋翼風帆輔助推進系統，為達成船隊整體脫碳減排目標貢獻具體成果。

examples.en: The United Nations set ambitious 2050 targets for complete maritime shipping decarbonization.
examples.zh: 聯合國國際海事組織針對全球國際海運業，制定了於西元二零五零年實現航運完全脫碳的雄偉藍圖。

examples.en: Hydrogen is the essential missing puzzle piece required for deep industrial and maritime decarbonization.
examples.zh: 潔淨氫能是實現重化工業、水泥鋼鐵與遠洋航運「深度脫碳工程」（Decarbonization）不可或缺的關鍵拼圖。

examples.en: The government announced subsidy programs to accelerate national economy-wide decarbonization by 2050.
examples.zh: 行政院正式拍板公布多項旗艦產業補助措施，全面加速推動全島各產業部門邁向 2050 淨零碳排深度脫碳轉型。

examples.en: Corporate decarbonization strategies include investing in rooftop solar panels and electrifying delivery van fleets.
examples.zh: 現代前瞻跨國企業的內部減碳脫碳策略，涵蓋全面鋪設自發自用屋頂型太陽能光電與將全公司公務貨車全面純電車化。

entries.definition: 去碳化；脫碳轉型；交通運具淨零去碳化；脫碳；綠色甲醇與生質柴油船舶航運脫碳轉型；難以電氣化之重工業與遠洋航運深度脫碳工程

explains.en: A bus company replaces diesel vehicles with electric ones to cut emissions. Factories can also use cleaner energy.
A steel plant looks for ways to make products with less carbon pollution. This change can take time and investment.
Communities use renewable power and efficient transport to reduce carbon emissions. The goal is to slow climate change.

examples.en: Dual electric motors deliver an instantaneous, all-wheel-drive powertrain experience.
examples.zh: 雙電動馬達系統提供了隨傳隨到、靈敏迅捷的全時四輪驅動純電動力傳動系統。

examples.en: An electric powertrain has far fewer moving parts than a traditional combustion engine.
examples.zh: 相較於傳統內燃機引擎，純電動力總成的機械活動零件數量要少得多。

examples.en: Automotive engineers tuned the powertrain to deliver a smooth and whisper-quiet ride.
examples.zh: 車輛工程師精心調校了動力傳動系統，以提供平順流暢且靜謐無聲的行路質感。

examples.en: The advanced 800V electric powertrain delivers lightning-fast throttle response and blistering acceleration.
examples.zh: 採用先進的八百伏特高電壓架構純電動力總成系統，帶來零遲滯的油門動力踏板加速反應。

examples.en: The car warranty guarantees the battery pack, inverter, and electric motor powertrain for eight years.
examples.zh: 原廠新車保固白紙黑字承諾，針對高壓電池模組、逆變器與驅動馬達等動力總成提供長達八年保固。

examples.en: Engineers redesigned the hybrid powertrain to squeeze out twenty-five kilometers per liter in city traffic.
examples.zh: 動力工程師全面重新優化了油電複合動力總成系統，使其在市區停停走走環境下創下一公升行駛二十五公里的佳績。

entries.definition: 動力傳動系統；動力總成；車輛動力總成系統；三電系統

explains.en: The motor, battery, and other parts work together to move a car. Electric vehicles may have fewer moving pieces.
Engineers tune the parts that send power to the wheels for a smooth ride. A hybrid uses both a motor and an engine.
This vehicle system includes the engine or electric motor and the parts that drive the wheels. It affects how the car feels.

examples.en: The sports EV generates over 500 horsepower, launching effortlessly from zero.
examples.zh: 這輛純電性能跑車能爆發出超過五百匹強悍馬力，靜止起步加速毫不費力。

examples.en: Enthusiasts often modify vehicle turbochargers to unlock additional horsepower.
examples.zh: 性能車改裝狂熱玩家常透過升級渦輪增壓套件，來壓榨出更多的峰值馬力。

examples.en: One metric horsepower is equivalent to approximately 735.5 watts of mechanical power.
examples.zh: 一公制馬力在物理學上大約等同於 735.5 瓦特的機械功率輸出。

examples.en: Dual electric motors pump out 500 horsepower, rocketing the performance sedan from 0 to 100 in 3.5 seconds.
examples.zh: 前後雙永磁電動馬達綜效輸出高達五百匹強悍最大馬力，零百加速僅需短短三點五秒即可破百。

examples.en: Heavy agricultural tractors require enormous low-end horsepower and torque to pull deep field plows.
examples.zh: 重型現代農業耕耘機需要無比龐大的低轉速大馬力與強勁扭矩，才能在深厚泥濘農地中拉動沉重犁頭。

examples.en: Buyers often obsess over peak horsepower numbers, but chassis tuning is equally critical for lap times.
examples.zh: 購車新手往往過度執著於紙面上的峰值最大馬力數據，然而底盤懸吊的調校對於賽道圈速同樣至關重要。

entries.definition: 馬力 (HP)；車輛引擎最大馬力；馬力

explains.en: This is a unit used to describe how much work an engine can do. A sports car with more of it may accelerate quickly. Tractors need it to pull heavy loads.
People compare vehicles using this measure of engine power. It tells something about how strongly a motor can work. It is not the only thing that affects how a car handles.
Use this unit when talking about the power of an engine or motor. A high value can help a car move quickly. Farmers need strong tractors to pull equipment.

examples.en: Electric motors provide maximum torque instantly without needing gear shifts.
examples.zh: 電動馬達無須經過傳統變速箱換檔即可瞬間爆發出百分之百的最大峰值扭力。

examples.en: Heavy trucks require tremendous low-end torque to pull massive freight loads uphill.
examples.zh: 重型拖車頭需要極其充沛的低轉速大扭力，才能在陡峭爬坡路段輕鬆拉動巨型貨櫃。

examples.en: Mechanics use a calibrated torque wrench to tighten wheel lug nuts to exact specifications.
examples.zh: 技師使用經過精準校準的扭力扳手，依照原廠規範磅數鎖緊輪圈螺絲螺帽。

examples.en: Electric vehicles deliver instantaneous peak torque from zero RPM, offering thrilling push-back power.
examples.zh: 純電車從起步零轉速瞬間即可全額爆發最大峰值扭力，帶來強烈而暢快的推背貼背加速感。

examples.en: Mechanics used a precision torque wrench to tighten wheel lug nuts to exact manufacturer specifications.
examples.zh: 保修廠技師熟練拿起經過定期校正的數位扭力扳手，嚴格依照原廠規定磅數將輪圈螺絲鎖緊到位。

examples.en: Massive diesel engine torque enables commercial semi-trucks to haul heavy shipping containers up mountain grades.
examples.zh: 巨型柴油渦輪引擎所輸出的源源不絕強悍扭矩，讓重型貨櫃拖車能輕鬆拖拽數十噸貨物征服陡峭山路坡道。

entries.definition: 扭力；轉矩 (Nm)；峰值扭力；扭矩

explains.en: It is the turning force a motor or engine produces. Electric motors can provide strong force right away. It is measured in newton-meters.
A truck needs a lot of this force to pull a heavy load uphill. Mechanics may tighten wheel nuts with a special wrench. It causes an object to rotate.
When a force makes something turn around an axis, this quantity describes it. Vehicle engines are rated for it. More can help with pulling power.

examples.en: The EV's blistering 0-to-100 km/h acceleration takes merely 3.5 seconds.
examples.zh: 該純電車款從零加速至時速一百公里（0-100 km/h）僅需驚人的 3.5 秒。

examples.en: Passengers felt pushed back into their leather seats under rapid highway acceleration.
examples.zh: 在高速公路大腳油門急加速下，乘客們感受到了強烈貼背感的推背力道。

examples.en: Smooth throttle acceleration prevents cars from skidding on wet, rain-slicked asphalt.
examples.zh: 溫和細膩的油門加速踩踏能防止車輛在雨天潮濕打滑的柏油路面上失控打滑。

examples.en: Linear, whisper-quiet electric acceleration delivers effortless highway overtaking power.
examples.zh: 線性順暢且無聲無息的純電加速性能，讓高速公路變換車道超車變得從容自信且游刃有餘。

examples.en: The supersonic jet subjected test pilots to four gravities of dizzying acceleration during vertical climbs.
examples.zh: 超音速戰鬥機在垂直仰角急速爬升過程中，使試飛員承受高達四個 G 重力加速度的強大體能負荷。

examples.en: Venture capital funding fueled the swift acceleration of the healthcare startup's clinical trial rollout.
examples.zh: 國際創投資金的大舉注資入股，大幅加速推進了這家生技醫療新創第三期人體臨床試驗的推進腳步。

entries.definition: 加速；加速度表現；瞬間加速力道；加速度

explains.en: A car speeds up quickly when the driver presses the accelerator. Passengers may feel pushed back in their seats.
A new company adds customers and opens more clinics in a short time. Its growth is happening faster.
In science, this describes how quickly speed changes. A vehicle’s dashboard may show its rate of speeding up.

examples.en: Highway cruising speed is maintained effortlessly using intelligent cruise control.
examples.zh: 在國道一號高速公路行駛時，開啟智慧定速巡航能輕鬆維持每小時百公里巡航速度。

examples.en: The commercial airplane reached its designated cruising speed of 900 kilometers per hour.
examples.zh: 這架民航客機順利攀升並達到了每小時九百公里的表定高空巡航速度。

examples.en: Driving at a steady cruising speed maximizes energy efficiency and conserves battery power.
examples.zh: 保持平穩均勻的定速巡航速度行駛，能將能源效率最大化並節省電池電量。

explains.en: A car may travel at a steady pace on the highway. Cruise control can help maintain it.
An airplane reaches a regular speed high above the ground during a long flight. It keeps that pace for much of the trip.
Driving steadily can save energy. This term describes the pace a vehicle keeps once it is moving smoothly.

examples.en: A low center of gravity gives electric sedans exceptionally stable cornering handling.
examples.zh: 低重心的底盤電池配置賦予了純電房車在過彎時無比沉穩扎實的極佳操控性能。

examples.en: Sport suspension and wide performance tires dramatically sharpen vehicle handling.
examples.zh: 運動化硬朗懸吊與高性能寬胎的搭配能大幅強化車輛過彎時的犀利操控性能。

examples.en: Test drivers praised the compact hatchback for its nimble handling in downtown traffic.
examples.zh: 試駕媒體大力稱讚這輛掀背小車在擁擠市區車流穿梭時靈活刁鑽的操控動態。

entries.definition: 操控性能；底盤指向反應

explains.en: This describes how a car responds when a driver turns or steers it. Wide tires can make it feel more stable. Drivers may praise a small car for moving easily through traffic.
A vehicle with good control feels steady in a turn. Suspension and tires affect it. Test drivers often compare how different cars move.
Use this noun for the way a vehicle is controlled and responds to steering. A sport model may feel nimble. The road and tires can change the experience.

examples.en: The unified skateboard chassis integrates batteries, motors, and suspension modules.
examples.zh: 創新的滑板式底盤將高壓電池、電動馬達與懸吊轉向模組一體化高度整合。

examples.en: A rigid high-strength steel chassis improves passenger crash safety ratings.
examples.zh: 剛性卓越的超高強度鋼材車身底盤結構大幅提升了乘客在碰撞測試中的安全評級。

examples.en: Mechanics thoroughly inspected the vehicle's rusty underside chassis for structural cracks.
examples.zh: 汽車維修技師仔細檢查了車輛生鏽的底盤骨架下方，以防出現結構性裂紋。

examples.en: The dedicated skateboard EV chassis houses flat battery packs under the floor for a low center of gravity.
examples.zh: 專屬純電滑板底盤將平整化大容量電池包深埋於車底板下方，營造出極低重心的絕佳過彎操控感。

examples.en: High-performance aluminum suspension arms are bolted directly onto the reinforced subframe chassis.
examples.zh: 輕量化高強度鍛造鋁合金懸吊連桿，直接鎖固在經過結構強化的前後副車架底盤剛性結構上。

examples.en: Rustproofing the vehicle chassis prevents corrosion from salty sea winds along coastal highways.
examples.zh: 為新車底盤噴塗專業防鏽底漆塗層，能有效抵禦行駛於台灣濱海省道公路上潮濕海風與鹽霧的鏽蝕。

examples.en: Engineered baker’s yeast serves as a versatile microbial chassis organism for producing fragrances.
examples.zh: 經過基因改造的麵包酵母菌，扮演著生產頂級天然香精與藥物的萬能「微生物底盤生物」（Chassis）。

examples.en: Mechanics inspected the truck chassis carefully for rust and structural stress cracks after long hauling.
examples.zh: 技師在長途重載行駛後仔細檢查卡車底盤，排除任何金屬生鏽或結構應力裂紋隱患。

examples.en: The electric vehicle platform uses an innovative skateboard chassis that houses battery cells flatly.
examples.zh: 該款電動車模組化平台採用創新的滑板式底盤設計，將鋰電池芯平整鋪設於車身底部。

entries.definition: 車輛底盤；機底骨架；純電滑板底盤；底盤架構；承載外源人工基因之微生物底盤生物 (如大腸桿菌)

explains.en: It is the main frame of a vehicle that supports its engine, wheels, and body. Mechanics inspect it for rust or cracks. Electric cars may use a flat design.
A car's structure underneath holds important parts together. It must be strong to protect passengers. A new design can place batteries below the floor.
This frame carries the vehicle's weight and connects its components. Mechanics check it for damage. It can be made of high-strength steel.

examples.en: Streamlined aerodynamics reduce highway wind noise and improve battery efficiency.
examples.zh: 流線型的車身空氣動力學設計能大幅降低高速風阻噪音並提升整體用電續航效率。

examples.en: Flush door handles and active grille shutters are engineered to optimize aerodynamics.
examples.zh: 隱藏式平整門把手與主動式進氣格柵葉片皆是為了極致優化空氣動力學而量身設計。

examples.en: Formula 1 race cars rely heavily on aerodynamics to generate extreme high-speed downforce.
examples.zh: F1 一級方程式賽車高度仰賴空氣動力學套件，以在高速狂飆時產生巨大的地面下壓力。

explains.en: A smooth car shape lets air move around it more easily. This can help the car use less energy at high speeds.
Designers shape an airplane wing so moving air can help it fly. Engineers study how air flows around objects.
A race car uses a low shape and special wings to manage air as it moves. This branch of science studies those forces.

examples.en: The panoramic glass sunroof fills the passenger cabin with natural sunlight.
examples.zh: 超大視野的全景玻璃天窗讓柔和溫暖的自然採光灑滿整個寬敞舒適的座艙空間。

examples.en: We tilted open the power sunroof to let the fresh autumn mountain breeze into the car.
examples.zh: 我們輕按按鈕掀起電動天窗，讓秋天清爽怡人的高山微風徐徐吹入車內。

examples.en: The glass sunroof features special UV-blocking coatings to prevent cabin overheating.
examples.zh: 這面玻璃天窗塗佈了高規格抗紫外線防曬隔熱塗層，以防車室座艙過度悶熱。

explains.en: A glass panel on top of a car can open to let in air and sunlight. Some roofs block harmful rays.
Passengers can tilt this vehicle feature to feel a cool breeze. It is found above the seats.
This opening in a car's roof lets people see the sky. A glass version can make the cabin feel brighter.

examples.en: The responsive infotainment system supports Apple CarPlay and Android Auto seamlessly.
examples.zh: 反應極為靈敏的車載資訊娛樂系統無縫支援無線 Apple CarPlay 與 Android Auto。

examples.en: Drivers can stream podcasts and access satellite radio directly through the vehicle infotainment.
examples.zh: 駕駛人可直接透過車載資訊娛樂系統隨心串流收聽各類 Podcast 節目與衛星廣播。

examples.en: A fast processor ensures that the dashboard infotainment interface operates without lag.
examples.zh: 搭載高速處理器能確保中控儀表影音資訊娛樂系統在滑動操作時絲滑順暢不卡頓。

entries.definition: 車載影音娛樂系統 (Info + Entertainment)

explains.en: This is the screen and controls in a car that provide information and entertainment. Drivers may use it for maps or music. A fast system responds without delay.
A vehicle may let people connect a phone to play podcasts. The dashboard can also show directions. This combined system should be easy to use while driving.
Use this word for a car's digital features for media and information. It can include radio, navigation, and phone connection. Drivers should use it safely.

examples.en: A high-resolution digital dashboard displays real-time tire pressure and speed.
examples.zh: 高解析度全數位液晶儀表板即時清晰顯示當前車速、導航路線與各輪獨立胎壓。

examples.en: A yellow warning lamp illuminated on the car dashboard signaling low windshield washer fluid.
examples.zh: 汽車儀表板上亮起了一盞黃色警示燈，提示雨刷水箱中的清潔液存量過低。

examples.en: The project management dashboard gives executives a quick glance at quarterly revenue trends.
examples.zh: 專案管理數位儀表板讓企業高層主管能一眼綜觀當季營收與關鍵指標走向。

explains.en: It is the panel in a car that shows speed and warning lights. A digital version can display tire pressure. The word also describes a screen that summarizes business data.
Drivers look at this panel to see how fast they are going. Project managers may use an online screen to track sales. It gathers key details in one place.
A vehicle's front control panel holds gauges and indicators. In a computer program, a summary page with charts has the same name. It helps users see important information quickly.

examples.en: The windshield heads-up display projects turn-by-turn navigation directly in sight.
examples.zh: 前擋風玻璃全彩抬頭顯示器（HUD）將逐向轉彎導航箭頭直接投影於前方視線中。

examples.en: Fighter jet pilots originally used heads-up displays to track flight instruments during combat.
examples.zh: 戰鬥機飛行員最初仰賴抬頭顯示器，以便在激烈空戰中眼睛不離前方監控飛行儀表。

examples.en: Having a heads-up display helps drivers keep their eyes on the road ahead at all times.
examples.zh: 配備抬頭顯示器能幫助駕駛人的視線始終保持專注注視前方路況，無須低頭看儀表。

explains.en: A car projects speed and simple directions onto the windshield so the driver can see them ahead. Keep attention on the road.
A pilot reads key flight information on a transparent screen near eye level. This reduces the need to look down.
A small display shows navigation or speed in the driver’s line of sight. Some cars and aircraft use it.

examples.en: The automaker rolled out improved autopilot algorithms via an overnight OTA update.
examples.zh: 車廠透過夜間遠端無線軟體升級（OTA），神不知鬼不覺為車主更新了輔助駕駛系統。

examples.en: Thanks to OTA capability, owners don't need to visit a dealership just to patch software bugs.
examples.zh: 多虧具備了 OTA 遠端無線更新功能，車主無須特地開車回原廠保養廠只為了修復軟體漏洞。

examples.en: Connected smart vehicles receive regular OTA updates that add new infotainment features.
examples.zh: 連網智慧車輛能定期接收遠端 OTA 升級推播，為車主解鎖各項全新影音娛樂功能。

explains.en: A connected car can receive software changes through a wireless network. Owners do not need to visit a repair shop.
A phone or vehicle may install a new version overnight. This method sends updates through the air.
When a car receives a software fix without a cable, it uses this kind of update. It can add features or correct errors.

examples.en: Keyless entry unlocks doors automatically as you approach carrying your smartphone.
examples.zh: 具備免鑰匙進入功能的手機數位鑰匙在您攜帶手機靠近車身時便會自動解鎖感應。

examples.en: Passive keyless entry is wonderfully convenient when your hands are full of heavy grocery bags.
examples.zh: 當你雙手提滿沉重的大賣場購物袋時，免鑰匙感應開門功能顯得格外方便貼心。

examples.en: Modern keyless entry systems use encrypted rolling codes to thwart car thieves.
examples.zh: 當代免鑰匙感應門鎖系統採用加密滾動防盜代碼，以有效防範不法竊賊攔截訊號。

entries.definition: 免鑰匙進入系統；智慧感應門鎖

explains.en: This lets a person unlock a car or door without putting a key into a lock. A phone or small fob can send a signal. Encrypted codes help keep it secure.
When someone's hands are full, the door may open as they approach. The system recognizes a nearby device. It is convenient but should be protected from theft.
Use this term for a lock that opens electronically without a metal key. A smartphone may act as the key. Some systems unlock automatically when the owner comes near.

examples.en: Use the mobile companion app to remote start air conditioning before boarding.
examples.zh: 上車前可透過手機專屬 App 遠端提前啟動車內冷氣空調，預先降溫消暑。

examples.en: In frigid winter mornings, drivers love using remote start to preheat cabin defrosters.
examples.zh: 在天寒地凍的冬日清晨，車主們喜愛使用遠端發動功能預先替座艙暖車並除霜。

examples.en: The car key fob includes a dedicated button to remote start the engine from fifty yards away.
examples.zh: 汽車感應鑰匙遙控器上配有一顆專屬按鍵，讓車主在五十碼外就能遠端遙控發動引擎。

entries.definition: 遠端遙控發動；手機預先開冷氣

explains.en: It is a car feature that lets a driver start the engine from a distance with a key fob or phone. It can warm the cabin on a cold morning. Use it safely.
A person can start a vehicle before getting inside. This may cool the air conditioner on a hot day. The button works from nearby.
This feature turns on a car's engine from outside it. Drivers may use it to warm or cool the cabin before a trip. Follow local safety rules.

examples.en: Blind spot monitoring radar flashes an orange warning light when cars pass.
examples.zh: 盲點偵測警示系統在相鄰車道有車輛快速逼近切入時會在後視鏡亮起警示黃燈。

examples.en: Always turn your head to check your side mirror blind spot before changing lanes.
examples.zh: 在變換車道前，切記務必擺頭微轉視線，確認兩側後視鏡的視覺死角無來車。

examples.en: Large cargo trucks have extensive blind spots along their passenger side and rear bumper.
examples.zh: 大型聯結貨卡車在副駕駛座一側與後保險桿正後方皆存在著極為龐大的視野死角。

examples.en: Flashing LED mirrors and audible chimes warn drivers of vehicles hidden in their blind spot.
examples.zh: 當變換車道時後方死角有來車逼近，盲點偵測系統（BSM）會在後視鏡亮起警示燈並發出警音。

examples.en: Always turn your head to check your vehicle's physical blind spot before merging across highway lanes.
examples.zh: 在國道變換車道前，除了看後視鏡外，切記務必擺頭確認視線死角盲區內是否有隱蔽機車或車輛。

examples.en: Overconfidence in past victories can create dangerous strategic blind spots for corporate leadership.
examples.zh: 對過往成功戰績過度盲目自信，往往會成為企業高層決策者在面對市場新威脅時最危險的戰略盲點。

entries.definition: 後視鏡盲點；死角；後視鏡死角盲點；視線盲區

explains.en: A car beside you may disappear from the side mirror before you change lanes. Turn your head and check carefully.
A large truck has areas around it that the driver cannot see directly. Keep a safe distance.
A person may overlook a weakness in their own plan. The phrase can also mean an unseen area beside a vehicle.

examples.en: Active lane keeping assist gently steers the steering wheel to stay centered.
examples.zh: 主動式車道維持輔助系統（LKA）會微幅修正方向盤，確保車輛穩穩維持在車道中線。

examples.en: Lane keeping systems use front-facing windshield cameras to track faded white road stripes.
examples.zh: 車道維持輔助系統利用前擋風玻璃上的光學鏡頭，精準辨識地面磨損的白色車道標線。

examples.en: If you drift over markings without signaling, the lane keeping alarm beeps instantly.
examples.zh: 若你在未打方向燈的情況下車身偏離壓線，車道維持警示蜂鳴器會立刻發出嗶嗶聲。

explains.en: A car can use a camera to notice road lines and help stay in the middle. The driver must still pay attention.
If a vehicle drifts over a painted stripe without a signal, an alert may sound. This safety feature can gently steer.
This driving aid helps a car remain between the lines on a road. It does not replace a careful driver.

examples.en: Adaptive cruise control (ACC) automatically maintains safe following distance in jams.
examples.zh: 全速域主動車距調節巡航系統（ACC）在塞車走走停停時能自動主動跟車防追撞。

examples.en: Turning on cruise control helps drivers avoid speeding accidentally on long road trips.
examples.zh: 開啟定速巡航功能有助於駕駛人在長途自駕長征中避免因疲倦而不慎超速違規。

examples.en: Stepping firmly on the brake pedal instantly disengages the vehicle's cruise control.
examples.zh: 只要腳踩煞車踏板，車輛的定速巡航系統便會在瞬間立即自動解除解除定速。

explains.en: This car feature keeps a chosen speed without the driver holding the accelerator. It is useful on a long, open road. Pressing the brake turns it off.
A driver can set a steady speed for highway travel. Some newer versions also keep a safe distance from the car ahead. It can reduce tiredness on long trips.
Use this system to maintain a selected vehicle speed automatically. The driver can cancel it with the brake. It is not a substitute for paying attention.

examples.en: Automated parking sensors parallel-park the car effortlessly in tight spaces.
examples.zh: 全自動智慧停車輔助系統能在極度狹窄的市區路邊車位輕鬆完成自動倒車入庫。

examples.en: Warehouses employ automated guided vehicles to transport pallets between aisles.
examples.zh: 現代化物流倉儲調度無人自動搬運導引車，在各貨架走道之間穿梭搬運棧板貨品。

examples.en: Automated driving technology continues to progress closer to full autonomy every year.
examples.zh: 全自動駕駛輔助科技每年都在大步邁進，朝向完全無人自駕的境界加速演進。

examples.en: Fully automated wafer mega-fabs run 24/7 with robotic arms loading FOUP containers flawlessly.
examples.zh: 具備高度全自動化（Automated）運作的超大型晶圓廠，由全自動機械手臂全天候無休精準裝卸晶圓。

examples.en: The bank installed automated teller machines that accept cash deposits and issue new debit cards.
examples.zh: 該商業銀行在各主要捷運站全面升級智慧自動提款機，支援大額現鈔無卡存款與即時換發感應金融卡。

examples.en: Smart logistics centers utilize automated guided vehicles (AGVs) to sort and route thousands of parcels hourly.
examples.zh: 現代化智慧物流發貨中心全面導入 AGV 無人搬運搬運車，每小時高效自動分揀並配送數萬件電商快遞包裹。

examples.en: Rail-mounted automated cranes stack incoming containers in precise rows without human cab operators.
examples.zh: 軌道式全自動起重機無需駕駛員坐鎮，即可在堆場將卸下的貨櫃精準碼放整齊。

examples.en: The new terminal boasts fully automated gates equipped with high-speed optical camera scanners.
examples.zh: 全新智慧貨櫃碼頭全面啟用全自動感應管制閘口，搭載高速光學攝影辨識相機。

examples.en: Automated stacking yards reduce labor injuries while delivering round-the-clock operating consistency.
examples.zh: 全自動化無人貨櫃堆場不僅大幅杜絕了碼頭工安職災風險，更實現了全天候不間斷的超高裝卸效能。

entries.definition: 自動化的；全自動的；全自動無人智慧關燈工廠的；軌道式全自動門式防搖起重機的

explains.en: It describes a task done by machines or software with little human effort. Parking sensors can guide a car into a space. Factories use it to move pallets.
A process may run automatically after being set up. Warehouses use guided vehicles to carry goods. Technology can reduce repeated manual work.
Use this adjective for a system that performs tasks by itself. A machine may sort packages or control lights. It still needs people to design and supervise it.

examples.en: The 360-degree surround view camera eliminates all dangerous parking blind spots.
examples.zh: 360 度全景環景鳥瞰影像輔助系統徹底消除了在狹小巷弄穿梭與倒車時的所有死角。

examples.en: Selecting reverse automatically triggers the ultra-wide surround view display.
examples.zh: 排入倒車 R 檔時，中央觸控螢幕便會自動切換顯示清晰直觀的超廣角環景影像。

examples.en: Surround view monitors synthesize feeds from four exterior cameras into a bird's-eye view.
examples.zh: 環景影像監控系統將車外四顆高畫質廣角鏡頭的畫面即時無縫拼接成一張鳥瞰俯視圖。

explains.en: Several small cameras around a car combine their pictures to show the area nearby. This helps a driver park.
When a driver backs up, the screen may show a view from above the vehicle. Look around as well as at the display.
The system joins images from cameras on different sides of a car. It can reveal objects close to the vehicle.

examples.en: Proper tire pressure ensures optimal fuel economy and maximum wet grip.
examples.zh: 保持標準標準的正常輪胎胎壓能確保最佳油耗電耗表現並發揮雨天最佳抓地力。

examples.en: The tire pressure monitoring system warned that the rear left tire was losing air slowly.
examples.zh: 胎壓偵測系統（TPMS）發出警告訊息，提示左後輪胎壓正在緩慢漏氣降低。

examples.en: Check your vehicle's cold tire pressure using a digital gauge at least once a month.
examples.zh: 建議每個月至少使用一次數位胎壓計，在冷胎狀態下準確檢查愛車的胎壓數值。

explains.en: A gauge can show how much air is inside a car's tires. Check it each month when the tires are cool.
Too little air can make a car use more fuel and grip the road poorly. A dashboard system may warn the driver.
Keeping the correct amount of air in each tire helps with safe driving. A digital tool can measure it.

examples.en: Electric scooters with instant battery swapping are ubiquitous across Taiwan cities.
examples.zh: 具備六秒秒速換電便利性的電動機車（如 Gogoro）在台灣各大都市的大街小巷隨處可見。

examples.en: Commuting on an electric scooter helps reduce carbon emissions in crowded metropolitan areas.
examples.zh: 騎乘電動機車通勤上下班有助於大幅降低擁擠都會生活圈中的各類碳廢氣排放。

examples.en: High school graduates celebrate turning eighteen by getting a license to ride an electric scooter.
examples.zh: 許多高中畢業生在年滿十八歲時，迫不及待考取駕照體驗騎乘電動機車的自由。

explains.en: This is a small two-wheeled vehicle powered by a battery. A person stands or sits while riding it. It can be used for short trips around a city.
Some riders use this vehicle instead of a car to travel through busy streets. Its motor produces no exhaust while moving. The rider may need a license depending on local rules.
Use this phrase for a scooter that runs on electricity rather than gasoline. It can help with a commute. Some cities let riders swap its battery.

examples.en: Battery swapping takes less than ten seconds at thousands of nationwide stations.
examples.zh: 在全台數千座換電站進行智慧電池交換只需不到十秒鐘即可滿電再出發。

examples.en: Gogoro revolutionized urban mobility by popularizing its smart battery swapping ecosystem.
examples.zh: Gogoro 透過普及推廣其智慧電池交換生態系統，徹底顛覆了現代都會移動方式。

examples.en: The platform allows instant asset swapping between different decentralized digital tokens.
examples.zh: 該去中心化平台支援不同數位代幣資產之間秒級快速的無縫換取與跨鏈調換。

explains.en: It is the act of exchanging one item for another. Drivers may exchange a used battery for a charged one. The same idea applies to digital assets.
Two people can give each other something they have. A battery station may make this process very fast. The noun describes the exchange.
When users trade one item for a different one, they are doing this. It can happen with cards, goods, or stored energy. Online systems may make it instant.

examples.en: Shared mobility services like YouBike and iRent reduce downtown parking demand.
examples.zh: YouBike 公共自行車與 iRent 共享汽車等共享移動服務大幅降低了市中心停車負擔。

examples.en: Younger generations increasingly embrace shared mobility rather than purchasing personal vehicles.
examples.zh: 年輕一代的生活型態日益擁抱共享移動服務，而非堅持斥資購買私人自用車輛。

examples.en: Urban planners promote shared mobility to decrease traffic congestion and air pollution.
examples.zh: 都市規劃專家積極推廣多樣化的共享交通方案，以紓解道路壅塞並減緩空污。

entries.definition: 共享移動；共享交通工具服務

explains.en: A person rents a bicycle or scooter for a short trip instead of owning one. They return it when finished.
Neighbors book a car through an app and use it only when needed. This service gives access without buying a vehicle.
Cities offer bicycles, scooters, or cars that many people can use in turn. It can reduce the need for private vehicles.

examples.en: YouBike 2.0 stations are located conveniently near almost every metro station exit.
examples.zh: YouBike 2.0 智慧公共自行車租賃站便利地設立在幾乎每個捷運站出口與學校旁。

examples.en: You can rent a YouBike simply by tapping your EasyCard or scanning with your phone app.
examples.zh: 你只要輕逼一下悠遊卡或直接開啟手機 App 掃碼，就能秒速借還一輛 YouBike。

examples.en: Riding a yellow YouBike through riverside park cycling trails is a favorite weekend activity.
examples.zh: 騎著黃色的 YouBike 沿著水岸河濱公園的專用自行車道迎風暢遊，是極受歡迎的週末休閒。

entries.definition: YouBike 微笑單車（台灣公共自行車）

explains.en: Taipei has public bicycles that people can borrow from stations. Riders can use a transit card or phone.
A visitor can rent a yellow bike near a metro station and return it elsewhere. It is a popular way to travel by river parks.
This public bike service is common across Taiwan. Check a station before setting out for a ride.

examples.en: Coworkers carpool together to utilize high-occupancy vehicle (HOV) freeway lanes.
examples.zh: 住在同社區的同事們相約拼車共乘上下班，以便行駛國道高乘載專用車道（HOV）。

examples.en: Organizing a neighborhood carpool helps parents share the duty of driving kids to school.
examples.zh: 組織社區鄰里共乘車隊能讓家長們輪流分擔開車接送孩子上下學的日常負擔。

examples.en: Joining a workplace carpool cuts down on commuting gas costs and monthly parking fees.
examples.zh: 加入公司同仁的共乘拼車行列能顯著分攤通勤油資開銷與昂貴的月租停車費。

explains.en: People do this when they share one car to travel to the same place. Parents may take turns driving children to school. It can save fuel and parking money.
Coworkers can ride together instead of each driving alone. A group may use a faster lane on the highway. They share the driving duties.
Use this noun or verb for sharing a vehicle with others on a regular trip. It reduces the number of cars on the road. It can save money too.

examples.en: Taiwan's freeway eTag electronic toll collection system operates without toll booths.
examples.zh: 台灣國道高速公路全面實施無收費站的 eTag 遠距多車道電子計程收費系統。

examples.en: Electronic toll systems detect moving vehicles via overhead RFID sensors at highway speeds.
examples.zh: 電子收費系統透過高架龍門上的無線射頻感測器，在車輛高速狂飆時瞬間精準感應扣款。

examples.en: Drivers can link their bank account or credit card for automatic electronic toll bill payments.
examples.zh: 駕駛人可以將自己的銀行帳戶或信用卡與 eTag 綁定，享受通行費自動儲值扣繳服務。

entries.definition: 電子收費；計程收費系統 (ETC / eTag)

explains.en: It is a road charge collected automatically as a vehicle passes a sensor. Drivers do not need to stop at a booth. A tag or account can pay it.
Highway cameras or radio sensors can identify cars moving beneath a gantry. The fee may be taken from a linked card. This system keeps traffic flowing.
Some roads collect payment without gates or cash. A small tag in the car connects to a billing account. The system charges drivers as they pass.

examples.en: Smart highway ramps optimize traffic flow during busy Lunar New Year holidays.
examples.zh: 智慧高快速公路交流道匝道儀控系統在農曆春節返鄉尖峰時段有效調控國道車流。

examples.en: Synchronized green lights along major boulevards ensure smooth, uninterrupted traffic flow.
examples.zh: 市區主要景觀大道上的智慧綠波號誌聯鎖控制，確保了車輛川流不息的順暢交通車流。

examples.en: Road construction blocked two lanes, severely impeding traffic flow heading toward the bridge.
examples.zh: 道路施工封閉了兩線車道，嚴重阻礙了開往跨海大橋方向的晨間交通車輛流通量。

entries.definition: 交通車流動態；車輛通行流量

explains.en: Cars move smoothly through a street when signals and lanes are working well. A blocked lane can slow everyone down.
Engineers study how vehicles move through an intersection at busy times. They may change signal timing.
Road work closes a lane, and cars back up toward a bridge. This describes the movement and amount of traffic.

examples.en: Quiet and smooth electric buses significantly reduce urban street noise pollution.
examples.zh: 行駛平穩安靜的電動公車大幅降低了市區主要幹道旁惱人的柴油排氣與噪音污染。

examples.en: Municipalities subsidize bus companies to replace aging diesel fleets with modern electric buses.
examples.zh: 各地方政府提供高額購車補貼，協助客運業者將老舊柴油大客車全面汰換為電動公車。

examples.en: The city's electric bus fleet charges overnight at central depots powered by solar energy.
examples.zh: 該市的電動公車車隊每逢深夜都在配備太陽能發電設備的中央客運總站進行夜間充電。

explains.en: This city vehicle runs on electricity instead of diesel. It can make less noise on busy streets.
A bus company may replace old vehicles with ones that plug in overnight. Solar panels can provide power.
Passengers ride this quiet vehicle around town. Its battery is charged at a depot.

examples.en: Youth volunteering in remote rural schools enriches both mentors and kids.
examples.zh: 青年學子前往偏鄉部落小學進行課輔志工服務，同時豐富了自身與孩子的心靈。

examples.en: Volunteering at the local animal shelter taught her valuable lessons about responsibility.
examples.zh: 在在地動物收容所進行志工服務讓她學到了關於責任感的寶貴課題。

examples.en: Engaging in corporate volunteering builds strong team camaraderie outside the office.
examples.zh: 參與企業志工服務活動能在辦公室之外建立深厚的團隊情誼。

explains.en: This is giving time and help to others without being paid. A student may assist at a school in a village. It can teach responsibility.
People may help at an animal shelter or community group. They do it because they care, not for wages. Teams can build friendships through it.
Use this noun for freely helping a person or organization. Someone may teach children or care for animals. It benefits both the helpers and community.

examples.en: Non-profit foundations provide free nutritious lunches to lonely elders daily.
examples.zh: 諸多在地非營利公益慈善基金會每日為社區獨居長者提供免費熱騰騰的營養午餐。

examples.en: She left her corporate banking job to work for an environmental non-profit organization.
examples.zh: 她辭去了商業銀行的工作，轉而為一家環保非營利機構服務。

examples.en: As a non-profit entity, any surplus funds are reinvested into community projects.
examples.zh: 作為一個非營利組織，任何結餘資金都會全數重新投入社區公益專案中。

entries.definition: 非營利的；非營利機構 (NPO / NGO)

explains.en: It describes an organization that uses extra money to support its mission instead of paying owners. A foundation may provide meals to older people. It can have paid staff.
A group may work on education or environmental goals. Any surplus is put back into its programs. Donations can support its work.
This kind of organization serves a social purpose rather than distributing profits to owners. It may run community projects. Financial records still matter.

examples.en: Corporate philanthropy funded scholarship programs for disadvantaged college students.
examples.zh: 企業熱心推動的公益慈善事業資助了眾多清寒優秀大學生的全額獎學金計畫。

examples.en: The tech billionaire devoted the second half of his life to global health philanthropy.
examples.zh: 這位科技富豪將自己的後半生全心奉獻於全球公共衛生的慈善事業上。

examples.en: Strategic philanthropy focuses on addressing the root causes of systemic poverty.
examples.zh: 策略性慈善著重於從根本上解決造成結構性貧困的深層病因。

explains.en: A business funds scholarships for students who need help paying for school. The money supports a public good.
A person donates time or money to improve health and education. This generous work can help many people.
A group gives resources to address poverty or disease. The goal is to benefit others.

examples.en: The online crowdfunding charity campaign raised two million dollars in a week.
examples.zh: 這場線上公益群眾募資專案在短短一週之內便成功籌得了逾兩百萬元的善款。

examples.en: Students baked cookies and cupcakes for the school library fundraising drive.
examples.zh: 學生們親手烘烤了手工餅乾與杯子蛋糕，為學校圖書館的籌款活動出力。

examples.en: Successful fundraising depends on compelling storytelling that moves donors' hearts.
examples.zh: 成功的公益募款活動仰賴能深深打動捐款人心靈的動人真實故事。

explains.en: Students may sell cookies to collect money for a school library. This activity supports a cause.
A charity shares a story to encourage people to donate. Planning well helps collect more money.
A group may organize a drive to bring in money for a hospital. This process helps pay for its work.

examples.en: Celebrities and philanthropists gathered at the annual charity gala for medical research.
examples.zh: 各界影視名流與大慈善家齊聚年度慈善晚宴，攜手為罕見疾病醫學研究籌募經費。

examples.en: Guests dressed in glamorous evening gowns and tuxedos for the museum's opening gala.
examples.zh: 賓客們身著華美晚禮服與筆挺燕尾服出席博物館的開幕盛大慶祝晚宴。

examples.en: The charity gala raised hundreds of thousands of dollars through an exciting live auction.
examples.zh: 這場慈善晚會透過扣人心弦的現場愛心拍賣籌募了數十萬美元的善款。

explains.en: This is a large, formal celebration or special event. Guests may dress in evening clothes. A charity may raise money there with an auction.
A museum might hold one to celebrate its opening. People gather, enjoy food, and support a cause. It is more formal than an ordinary party.
Use this noun for a festive event with special guests. It may include dancing or a fundraiser. People often dress elegantly for it.

examples.en: Community food banks distribute rice, canned food, and cooking oil to families.
examples.zh: 在地社區食物銀行每週定期向邊緣弱勢家庭分發愛心白米、罐頭與食用油。

examples.en: Supermarkets partner with the food bank to minimize food waste by donating surplus bread.
examples.zh: 超市連鎖店與食物銀行攜手合作，透過捐贈當日即期麵包來減少食物浪費。

examples.en: Volunteers packaged thousands of holiday meal boxes at the regional food bank.
examples.zh: 志工們在地區食物銀行裡齊心打包了數千份溫馨的節慶愛心食物箱。

entries.definition: 食物銀行；食物物資庫存中心

explains.en: It is a community organization that collects and gives food to people who need help. Volunteers may pack meal boxes. Stores can donate extra bread.
Families can receive rice, canned goods, and cooking oil from this service. Supermarkets may give away food before it spoils. Volunteers help sort it.
This charity gathers donated food and distributes it to local households. It can reduce waste and support people facing hardship. Donations help keep shelves stocked.

examples.en: Volunteers chop fresh vegetables early in the morning at the church soup kitchen.
examples.zh: 愛心志工大清早便在教會開辦的愛心共餐廚房裡忙著清洗切削新鮮時蔬備料。

examples.en: During the cold winter storm, the downtown soup kitchen served hundreds of hot meals.
examples.zh: 在寒冬暴風雪肆虐期間，市中心的愛心廚房提供了數百份熱氣騰騰的愛心餐點。

examples.en: Working at a soup kitchen taught him deep humility and gratitude for everyday blessings.
examples.zh: 在愛心廚房擔任義工讓他體會到了深刻的謙卑，並更加感恩日常所擁有的一切。

entries.definition: 愛心共餐廚房；免費施粥所

explains.en: Volunteers prepare free hot meals for people who cannot afford enough food. Guests may eat at tables together.
A church opens its doors during cold weather to serve warm soup and bread. Donations help pay for the meals.
Community members cook and share meals with neighbors in need. People can volunteer to prepare and serve food.

examples.en: Universities host campus blood drives to replenish critical hospital blood banks.
examples.zh: 大學校園定期熱烈舉辦校園捐血活動，及時為各大醫院補充告急的醫療血庫。

examples.en: A mobile blood drive bus parked outside the city hall attracted dozens of willing donors.
examples.zh: 一輛巡迴捐血車停靠在市政府廣場前，吸引了數十位熱心的市民踴躍挽袖。

examples.en: Donating during a community blood drive is a simple way to directly save someone's life.
examples.zh: 參與社區捐血活動是一種最直接、最純粹能拯救寶貴性命的善舉。

explains.en: A school may invite people to give blood at a special event. Hospitals use it to help patients.
A mobile bus can visit city hall so volunteers can donate. One person's gift may save a life.
Communities organize this event to collect blood for hospitals. People should meet the health rules before donating.

examples.en: Winter emergency shelters open their doors to keep homeless citizens warm and safe.
examples.zh: 寒冬避寒庇護所全面敞開大門，確保露宿街頭的無家者街友獲得溫暖與安頓。

examples.en: The city launched a housing-first initiative to help chronic homeless individuals rebuild stability.
examples.zh: 該市推出了「住房優先」輔導計畫，協助長年無家可歸者重新找回生活的安穩。

examples.en: Charities distributed warm fleece sleeping bags to the homeless sleeping in the park.
examples.zh: 慈善團體向露宿在公園的街友們分發了保暖的刷毛防寒睡袋。

entries.definition: 無家可歸的；街友；無家者

explains.en: This describes people who do not have a safe, permanent place to live. A winter shelter may offer warmth. Housing programs can help people rebuild stability.
Someone without a home may sleep in a park or shelter. Charities can provide warm bags and other support. The word can describe a person or group.
Use this adjective for a person who lacks a place to live. Communities may help them find housing. It can also be used as a noun for such people.

examples.en: The foundation provides free music lessons to underprivileged youth.
examples.zh: 該文教基金會為經濟弱勢家庭的青年學子提供完全免費的一對一專業樂器課程。

examples.en: Educational technology initiatives bridge the digital divide for underprivileged students.
examples.zh: 數位教育推廣計畫有效消弭了弱勢家庭學童在科技學習資源上的數位落差。

examples.en: Doctors volunteered in underprivileged communities that lack access to modern clinics.
examples.zh: 醫師們自發前往缺乏現代化診所醫療資源的偏鄉貧困社區進行義務巡迴義診。

explains.en: It describes people who have fewer resources or opportunities than others. A charity may provide free music lessons to young people. Access to clinics can also be limited.
A student from a low-income family may not have the same tools for learning. Programs can help bridge that gap. Support can improve opportunities.
Use this adjective for people or communities facing poverty or other disadvantages. They may have less access to education. Community groups can offer help.
