examples.en: Social welfare programs aim to protect marginalized groups from extreme poverty.
examples.zh: 健全的社會福利扶助政策旨在保障社會邊緣弱勢群體免於陷入赤貧與飢餓。

examples.en: Human rights organizations fight to give marginalized populations an equal political voice.
examples.zh: 人權倡議團體全力奮戰，旨在讓被社會邊緣化的族群享有平等的政治發聲管道。

examples.en: Children from marginalized backgrounds often face multiple barriers to higher education.
examples.zh: 來自邊緣化弱勢家庭背景的孩子在追求高等教育時往往面臨重重的現實屏障。

explains.en: Some families have fewer chances to access good schools or jobs. Community programs can help reduce these barriers.
A group may be left out of decisions that affect its neighborhood. Listening to its members can help them take part.
People facing unfair barriers may have less access to services and opportunities. They deserve to be heard and included.

examples.en: High-standard nursing homes provide round-the-clock professional medical and physical care.
examples.zh: 評鑑優良的優質護理之家為失能與高齡長輩提供二十四小時專業醫療照護。

examples.en: Grandfather enjoys playing chess with his fellow residents at the sunny nursing home.
examples.zh: 祖父在採光充足的安養護理之家裡，每天開心地與其他住民爺爺們下棋切磋。

examples.en: Therapy dogs visit local nursing homes every month to bring joy to lonely seniors.
examples.zh: 狗醫生治療犬每月定期前往在地養老院探視，為孤寂的銀髮長輩帶來歡笑與慰藉。

entries.definition: 護理之家；安養長照機構

explains.en: Older adults who need daily help may live in this care center. Nurses and other workers assist them.
Residents may play chess or enjoy visits from a therapy dog. Staff provide support day and night.
This place offers older people care and a home when they cannot live alone. It may include medical help.

examples.en: Certified guide dogs are legally welcomed on public transit and inside eateries.
examples.zh: 通過專業受訓認證的導盲犬受法律保障，可自由進出大眾運輸與各類餐飲場所。

examples.en: Remember never to pet, feed, or distract a working guide dog wearing its harness.
examples.zh: 切記千萬不要隨意撫摸、餵食或呼喊佩戴導盲鞍正在專注執勤的合格導盲犬。

examples.en: Her loyal Labrador guide dog guided her safely across busy multi-lane city streets.
examples.zh: 她忠心耿耿的拉布拉多導盲犬陪伴引導她安全無虞地穿越繁忙的大馬路十字路口。

explains.en: This is a trained dog that helps a person with vision loss travel safely. It may lead its handler across a busy street. People should not distract it while it works.
A person with limited sight may rely on this animal to navigate sidewalks. It wears a harness. It can enter many public places with its handler.
Use this phrase for a specially trained animal that guides someone who cannot see well. It helps them avoid obstacles. When it is working, do not pet or feed it.

examples.en: Certified sign language interpreters accompany government press conferences live.
examples.zh: 官方電視直播記者會現場皆配置專業認證的手語翻譯員進行即時手語翻譯。

examples.en: She enrolled in a weekend evening course to learn conversational Taiwanese Sign Language.
examples.zh: 她報名參加了週末夜間研習班，認真學習日常生活實用的台灣手語溝通技巧。

examples.en: Sign language allows the deaf and hard-of-hearing community to communicate with nuance.
examples.zh: 手語讓聽損者與聾人族群能生動、細膩且精準地傳遞複雜豐富的情感與思維。

explains.en: It is a language that uses hand shapes, movement, and facial expression instead of spoken sounds. Interpreters may help at a news conference. Different countries have different systems.
Deaf and hard-of-hearing people can communicate with their hands and face. Learners may take a class to practice everyday conversation. It has its own grammar.
This visual language allows people to share ideas through gestures and expressions. A skilled interpreter can translate a speech. It is not the same everywhere.

examples.en: Compassionate social workers visit struggling single-parent households weekly.
examples.zh: 富有同理心與耐心的專業社工師每週定期訪視關懷經濟困難的單親家庭。

examples.en: The certified social worker helped the victim apply for emergency protective orders.
examples.zh: 專業合格社工師及時協助家暴受害者向法院申請緊急民事保護令以策安全。

examples.en: Hospitals employ social workers to assist discharged patients with long-term care plans.
examples.zh: 醫療院所配置專業醫務社工，協助即將出院的病友媒合與規劃長照出院照護計畫。

explains.en: A trained professional helps families find housing, health services, or support at school. They listen and connect people with resources.
A hospital worker may help a patient plan care after leaving. The person can explain available community services.
Someone facing a difficult home situation may talk with this professional. The worker helps them find support and make a plan.

examples.en: The bakery operates as a social enterprise, hiring and training young people with autism.
examples.zh: 這家手工烘焙坊作為一家社會企業營運，專門聘僱並培訓自閉症青年自立更生。

examples.en: Social enterprises balance financial sustainability with solving environmental or social problems.
examples.zh: 社會企業在追求商業財務自給自足的同時，肩負著解決環境或社會痛點的使命。

examples.en: This social enterprise produces reusable cloth bags from recycled coastal marine plastic.
examples.zh: 這家綠色社會企業利用回收海洋廢棄寶特瓶塑料，精心縫製耐用的環保手提布包。

entries.definition: 社會企業（兼顧獲利與社會目的）

explains.en: This business tries to earn enough money while also helping people or the environment. A bakery may train young workers.
Some companies make useful products from plastic collected near the coast. Their work supports a social goal.
A shop can hire people who have difficulty finding a job. It balances financial needs with helping the community.

examples.en: Impact investors support startups that generate positive measurable social impact.
examples.zh: 影響力投資人積極注資那些能為弱勢與環境創造可衡量正面社會影響力的新創。

examples.en: The company evaluates success not just by revenue, but by its overall social impact.
examples.zh: 該公司衡量成功的維度不僅看營業額數字，更看重其為在地帶來的整體社會影響力。

examples.en: Youth volunteers achieved lasting social impact by teaching coding to rural teenagers.
examples.zh: 青年志工們透過利用課餘遠距教導偏鄉青少年寫程式，創造了深遠的正面社會效應。

entries.definition: 社會影響力；正面社會效應

explains.en: This is the effect that a company or project has on people's lives and communities. A coding program for rural teens can create lasting benefits. Investors may measure it along with profit.
A business may ask whether its work improves life for people. Teaching skills or creating jobs can have a positive effect. It is more than making money.
Use this phrase for changes a project brings to society. A nonprofit may help a neighborhood grow stronger. The results can be measured over time.

examples.en: Taiwan dispatched medical teams and humanitarian supplies to international earthquake zones.
examples.zh: 台灣第一時間緊急派遣國際搜救醫療隊並空運人道救援物資馳援海外強震災區。

examples.en: The United Nations arranged safe humanitarian corridors for civilians fleeing the conflict.
examples.zh: 聯合國積極斡旋協調開闢安全人道走廊，供逃離戰火衝突的平民老弱婦孺撤離。

examples.en: Dedicating his medical career to treating refugees made him a respected global humanitarian.
examples.zh: 將個人行醫生涯全心奉獻於救治無家可歸的各國難民，使他成為受人景仰的人道主義者。

entries.definition: 人道主義的；人道救援者

explains.en: It describes helping people who are suffering or in danger. Medical teams may travel after an earthquake. Supplies can include food and medicine.
A person who works to improve human welfare may have this role. Aid groups help refugees and disaster survivors. The adjective describes caring actions.
Use this word for work that protects people's lives and dignity. It can describe a relief worker or emergency supplies. Kindness and service are central.

examples.en: The government established a dedicated emergency disaster relief fund.
examples.zh: 行政院第一時間火速提撥專款成立特別賑災救助專戶，全方位協助災民重建生活。

examples.en: NGOs mobilized thousands of volunteers to deliver food, blankets, and water for disaster relief.
examples.zh: 各大公益組織動員數千名志工投入前線賑災，及時配送熱食、保暖毛毯與飲用水。

examples.en: Efficient coordination among logistics agencies is critical for successful disaster relief.
examples.zh: 各民間救災與物流單位之間高效緊密的協調合作，是災後緊急救援成功的關鍵樞紐。

explains.en: After a flood, volunteers bring food, blankets, and clean water to families. Aid may also include shelter.
A community raises money to help people whose homes were damaged by an earthquake. Workers coordinate supplies.
Emergency teams deliver medicine and meals after a typhoon. These efforts help people recover from the disaster.

examples.en: The Red Cross Society delivers emergency first aid training to high school students.
examples.zh: 中華民國紅十字會長期走入高中校園推廣 CPR+AED 緊急急救救護專業訓練。

examples.en: The International Red Cross remains neutral to deliver life-saving aid across war zones.
examples.zh: 國際紅十字會始終嚴格秉持人道中立立場，跨越戰線烽火為戰區平民運送救命物資。

examples.en: Dedicated Red Cross volunteers distributed hygiene kits to displaced flood survivors.
examples.zh: 熱心敬業的紅十字會志工向因洪患流離失所的受災居民發放急需的個人衛生防疫包。

entries.definition: 紅十字會（國際人道救援組織）

explains.en: This international aid group gives emergency help during wars and disasters. Volunteers may also teach first aid.
Workers can bring supplies to families after a flood. The organization tries to help people without taking sides.
Students may learn basic emergency care from this humanitarian group. It also delivers aid in dangerous places.

examples.en: Abandoned puppies received medical checkups at the dedicated animal rescue center.
examples.zh: 遭棄養的幼犬在專業動保救援收容中心裡接受了妥善的醫療除蟲與健康檢查。

examples.en: Marine biologists rehabilitated the stranded sea turtle at the coastal rescue center.
examples.zh: 海洋生物學家在海濱野生動物救援中心裡細心照護並治療擱淺受傷的保育類綠蠵龜。

examples.en: Families interested in pet adoption are warmly welcomed to tour the cat rescue center.
examples.zh: 誠摯歡迎有意以領養代替購買的家庭前來貓咪救援收容中心參觀並互動認養。

entries.definition: 救援收容中心；中途之家

explains.en: This is a place where injured or abandoned animals receive care. Workers may help puppies recover. Families can visit to adopt a pet.
A sea turtle that is hurt may be brought here for treatment. Biologists help it recover before returning it to the ocean. Visitors may learn about animal care.
Use this phrase for a facility that protects animals in danger. Staff give food and medical help. Some animals later find a permanent home.

examples.en: Mobile medical clinics conduct healthcare outreach across mountainous villages.
examples.zh: 巡迴偏鄉行動醫療車深入中央山脈偏遠部落，落實第一線基層衛教與醫療外展。

examples.en: The university library expanded its digital outreach to senior citizens in the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 大學圖書館擴大了其針對鄰近社區銀髮銀髮長者的數位生活輔導外展服務。

examples.en: Street outreach teams connect with youth at risk to offer vocational training counseling.
examples.zh: 街頭社工外展小隊走入街角與迷惘的高關懷青少年建立連結，提供職訓生涯輔導。

entries.definition: 外展服務；深入基層社區關懷

explains.en: It is work that brings services or information to people in the community. A mobile clinic may visit mountain villages. Libraries can help older residents use the internet.
An organization may go out to meet people who cannot easily visit its office. Youth workers can offer training. This work connects people with support.
Programs can take education or health services directly to neighborhoods. Staff may visit residents and explain available help. The goal is to reach more people.

examples.en: Prominent law firms provide pro bono legal counsel to low-income clients.
examples.zh: 知名大型律師事務所定期指派資深合夥律師為低收入弱勢族群提供免費公益法律諮詢。

examples.en: The senior architect took on the disaster community rebuilding project completely pro bono.
examples.zh: 這位資深建築師以完全不收費的義務公益形式，主動接下災後社區重建規劃專案。

examples.en: Many professional associations require members to perform annual pro bono service.
examples.zh: 許多專業公會制度化鼓勵會員每年投入一定時數的義務公益專業服務回饋社會。

entries.definition: 免費公益的；義務法律諮詢的

explains.en: A lawyer gives legal help without charging a client who cannot afford it. The service supports the community.
An architect donates professional time to help rebuild a neighborhood center. The organization does not pay for the work.
Some professionals volunteer their skills for a public benefit. This phrase describes work done without a fee.

examples.en: Industry executives offered one-on-one mentorship to aspiring first-generation college grads.
examples.zh: 業界高階主管為第一代就讀大學的弱勢清寒學子提供一對一的人生職涯導師輔導。

examples.en: Good mentorship guides young professionals through complex workplace dynamics.
examples.zh: 優良的職場導師制度能引領初入職場的新鮮人從容應對複雜的職場人際與技能挑戰。

examples.en: The incubator pairs startup founders with seasoned mentors through its mentorship initiative.
examples.zh: 這家創業孵化育成中心透過其導師制度專案，為新創創辦人媒合經驗豐富的創業前輩。

examples.en: Junior designers flourish under patient one-on-one mentorship from seasoned creative directors.
examples.zh: 新進初階設計師在資深創意總監耐心的一對一導師制度（Mentorship）引導下迅速蛻變成長。

examples.en: The university's alumni mentorship initiative connects eager undergraduates with corporate executives.
examples.zh: 母校推行的資深傑出校友導師領航計畫，積極將充滿熱忱的大學部學弟妹與各界企業高階主管進行配對。

examples.en: Providing mentorship is a deeply rewarding experience that sharpens senior managers' emotional intelligence.
examples.zh: 擔任職場青年導師是一段收穫滿滿的利他旅程，在傳授經驗的同時亦能反向磨練高階主管的傾聽情商。

entries.definition: 導師指導制度；引導傳承；職場良師益友制度；導師關係

explains.en: An experienced worker may guide someone who is new to a career. They can meet regularly to share advice.
A university can connect students with graduates who have more experience. This relationship helps young people plan.
A senior designer may help a new colleague learn workplace skills. Providing guidance can also help the senior person grow.

examples.en: Volunteer tutoring helps disadvantaged elementary students catch up in mathematics.
examples.zh: 大學生志工利用課餘時間進行愛心課後輔導，陪伴弱勢學童奠定扎實的數學基礎。

examples.en: After-school tutoring programs provide struggling readers with targeted literacy practice.
examples.zh: 放學後的課後輔導加強班為閱讀有困難的孩子提供量身打造的識字循序練習。

examples.en: Online peer tutoring gained popularity as a convenient way to study foreign languages.
examples.zh: 線上同儕互助課業輔導作為一種極其便利的語言學習交流管道，日益受到歡迎。

explains.en: This is extra teaching given to one student or a small group. A volunteer may help children with math. Online sessions can teach languages too.
A learner who is having trouble reading may get focused help after school. A tutor explains and practices skills. It can happen in person or online.
Use this noun for instruction outside a regular class. A student can receive help with a subject. It gives more time to practice.

examples.en: The organic farming revolution began as a small grassroots movement among local farmers.
examples.zh: 台灣友善有機農耕的風潮最初源自於一群在地小農由下而上自發推動的草根運動。

examples.en: The political candidate built her campaign through vibrant grassroots community support.
examples.zh: 這位政治候選人憑藉深耕基層、扎實接地氣的草根鄉親熱情支持展開競選。

examples.en: Real lasting social change often springs from persistent grassroots activism at the local level.
examples.zh: 真正深遠長久的社會變革，往往孕育發軔於地方基層公民持之以恆的草根倡議運動。

entries.definition: 草根基層的；由下而上的在地運動

explains.en: It describes a movement that begins with ordinary people in a community. Local farmers may organize around a shared goal. It grows from the bottom up.
Residents can build support for a local cause without starting from national leaders. A campaign may spread through neighbors. Community involvement is central.
Use this adjective for action that starts among local people. Volunteers may support a candidate or social change. It often relies on community effort.

examples.en: Voting thoughtfully in democratic elections is an essential civic duty.
examples.zh: 在民主自由選舉中秉持理性投下神聖的一票，是每一位現代國民不可推卸的公民責任。

examples.en: Serving on a jury when called is considered an important civic duty in the legal system.
examples.zh: 當接獲法院傳票出任國民法官陪審團時，被視為履行一項極為神聖的公民義務。

examples.en: Responsible citizens fulfill their civic duty by sorting garbage and recycling diligently.
examples.zh: 具備良好素養的現代市民藉由認真做好垃圾分類與資源回收，來體現日常公民責任。

explains.en: People learn about local issues and take part in their community. Helping neighbors is one example.
When eligible, a person may vote in an election or attend a public meeting. These actions help a community make decisions.
Residents can follow local rules, keep shared spaces clean, and help one another. These are responsibilities of community members.

examples.en: Microloan programs contribute significantly to global poverty alleviation efforts.
examples.zh: 鄉村小額信貸扶貧計畫在推動全球貧窮緩解與消除飢餓方面扮演了極具關鍵的貢獻。

examples.en: The physical therapy clinic specializes in the pain alleviation of chronic back injuries.
examples.zh: 這間專業物理治療所專門致力於協助患者減輕與緩解長年慢性背部運動傷害的頑疾。

examples.en: Building new drainage culverts is necessary for the alleviation of local seasonal flooding.
examples.zh: 疏濬並增建雨水下水道大型箱涵，對於徹底緩解該地區梅雨季節的淹水災情至關重要。

explains.en: A new drain may help reduce flooding in a neighborhood. This term means making a problem less severe.
A therapy clinic may help lower a person's back pain. A small loan program can also ease poverty.
Building drainage channels may make seasonal floods less harmful. This word describes relief from difficulty or pain.

examples.en: Microfinance enables rural female artisans to start small craft cooperatives.
examples.zh: 微型金融為偏鄉女性傳統手工藝人提供了小額創業啟動基金，協助她們成立合作社。

examples.en: Muhammad Yunus pioneered modern microfinance through Bangladesh's famous Grameen Bank.
examples.zh: 穆罕默德·尤努斯透過孟加拉舉世聞名的鄉村銀行，開創了現代微型金融小額信貸的先河。

examples.en: Providing accessible microfinance empowers impoverished families to break the poverty cycle.
examples.zh: 提供免抵押的友善微型金融服務，賦予了許多貧困家庭打破代際貧窮惡性循環的能力。

entries.definition: 微型金融；小額信貸扶貧

explains.en: This is a service that offers very small loans or financial help to people with limited income. A craft worker may use it to start a small business. It can support families.
A rural group may borrow a modest amount to buy tools. These services help people who cannot use regular banks. The goal can be to improve livelihoods.
Use this term for small-scale banking and loans for people with few resources. It can help someone open a shop. Some programs also offer savings accounts.

examples.en: Purchasing fair trade coffee guarantees fair wages for smallholder farmers.
examples.zh: 選購具有公平貿易認證的有機精品咖啡豆，能切實保障產地小農獲得合理的勞動報酬。

examples.en: Consumers can look for the green and blue fair trade certified logo on cocoa products.
examples.zh: 消費者在採購巧克力與可可製品時，可認明包裝上的藍綠雙色公平貿易認證標章。

examples.en: The university campus store pledged to sell exclusively fair trade tea and chocolate.
examples.zh: 這所大學的校園福利社公開宣誓，將全面專營並販售符合公平貿易規範的茶葉與巧克力。

explains.en: It is a way of buying goods that aims to give producers fair pay and safe conditions. Coffee farmers may receive a better price. Look for a recognized label.
A company may pay smallholder farmers fairly for their crops. Shoppers can check a package for a certification mark. The goal is more ethical trade.
This approach tries to make international buying fairer for workers and growers. It can cover tea, chocolate, and coffee. Buyers may support it through their choices.

examples.en: Conscious consumerism encourages buying eco-friendly, locally made products.
examples.zh: 覺醒的道德綠色消費主義鼓勵大家多選購環保減碳且支持在地小農的優質產品。

examples.en: Critics argue that rampant consumerism during holiday shopping sprees generates huge waste.
examples.zh: 評論家指出，節慶購物狂歡節背後失控氾濫的過度消費主義製造了巨量的資源浪費。

examples.en: Ethical consumerism motivates shoppers to boycott brands that exploit overseas factory labor.
examples.zh: 具備社會意識的道德消費主義激勵廣大消費者抵制那些殘酷剝削海外代工勞工的不良品牌。

entries.definition: 消費主義；消費者權益保護

explains.en: People may buy many new things even when they do not need them. This habit can create waste.
Some shoppers choose durable local products instead of buying cheap items often. They think about how buying affects people and nature.
Advertisements can encourage people to spend for status or pleasure. Critics discuss the effects of a society focused on buying goods.

examples.en: One small act of kindness creates an inspiring ripple effect across society.
examples.zh: 一個看似微不足道的發自內心的善意舉動，能在整個社會激盪起溫暖動人的漣漪效應。

examples.en: The collapse of the investment bank caused a disastrous financial ripple effect worldwide.
examples.zh: 該大型投資銀行的突然崩潰倒閉，在整個全球金融體系中引發了災難性的連鎖骨牌效應。

examples.en: Educating girls produces a powerful multi-generational ripple effect for developing communities.
examples.zh: 為偏鄉發展中小女孩提供平等的受教權，能為整個在地社區孕育深遠的跨世代正面漣漪效應。

entries.definition: 漣漪效應；連鎖正面反應

explains.en: One kind act can inspire another person to help someone else. The good result spreads outward.
A bank failure may affect companies around the world. One event can cause many later effects.
Teaching girls can benefit their families and communities for years. This term describes effects that spread from one action.

examples.en: Millions of proud citizens cheered for Taiwanese athletes during the Paris Olympics.
examples.zh: 數百萬國人守在電視機前齊心為巴黎奧運賽場上奮戰的台灣健兒熱血吶喊。

examples.en: The city spent billions upgrading public transit in preparation for hosting the Olympics.
examples.zh: 該城市斥資數十億美元全面升級大眾交通路網，以迎接主辦奧運盛會。

examples.en: Competing at the Summer Olympics is the lifelong dream of track and field competitors.
examples.zh: 能站上夏季奧運會的競技舞台，是所有田徑運動員終其一生的崇高夢想。

explains.en: This is a major international sports event held every few years. Athletes from many countries compete in summer or winter sports. Cities prepare by improving transportation and venues.
Competitors train for years to represent their country at this event. Fans cheer for them from around the world. It takes place in a different host city each time.
Use this plural name for a large global sports competition. Track runners and many other athletes take part. Hosting it can require major planning.

examples.en: The marathon runner achieved a new personal best (PB) of under three hours.
examples.zh: 這位馬拉松業餘好手在台北馬拉松成功跑出了三小時內的全新個人最佳紀錄（PB）。

examples.en: He celebrated hitting a personal best by bench pressing 120 kilograms at the gym today.
examples.zh: 他今天在健身房臥推達到 120 公斤，開心地慶祝自己達成了個人歷史新紀錄。

examples.en: Focused training in cold weather helped the swimmer clock a stunning personal best.
examples.zh: 在寒冷天氣下的專注苦練幫助這名泳將在計時賽中飆出了令人驚艷的個人最佳成績。

explains.en: It is the best result an athlete has ever achieved in an event. A runner may reach a new time in a marathon. Training can help improve it.
A swimmer may record their fastest performance so far. They celebrate reaching this mark. It can be shortened to two initials.
Use this phrase for someone's top performance in a sport or task. A weightlifter may raise more than before. It is a goal many athletes pursue.

examples.en: Good nutrition and quality sleep are essential for rebuilding athletic stamina.
examples.zh: 充足均衡的優質營養攝取與深度睡眠是迅速恢復運動員體能充沛活力的核心。

examples.en: Midfield soccer players need extraordinary stamina to run twelve kilometers per match.
examples.zh: 足球隊的中場球員需要無比驚人的體力與充沛體能，才能在單場比賽中奔跑逾十二公里。

examples.en: Gradually increasing your weekly running mileage builds strong cardiovascular stamina.
examples.zh: 循序漸進地每週增加路跑累積里程數，能有效構築強大且持久的心肺耐力。

examples.en: Climbing steep cliffs consumes character stamina; rest on ledges to recharge.
examples.zh: 攀爬陡峭懸崖絕壁會持續消耗角色的體力耐力條，請適時停在岩壁平台上休息回體。

examples.en: Long-distance marathon runners require exceptional cardiovascular stamina and mental grit.
examples.zh: 全程馬拉松長跑選手需要具備超凡的心肺耐力、肌肉體能以及堅不可摧的鋼鐵意志。

examples.en: When your in-game stamina depletes completely, your avatar will become exhausted and slow down.
examples.zh: 當遊戲中角色的耐力精力值完全見底歸零時，角色會氣喘吁吁陷入短暫力竭減速狀態。

entries.definition: 充沛體力；精力；持久體能；體力條；耐力精力值 (Stamina)

explains.en: A runner trains gradually so they can keep going over a long distance. Rest and food help support endurance.
Soccer players run throughout a match and need lasting energy. Regular practice can build it.
A hiker walks uphill for hours without tiring quickly. This ability to continue physical activity is useful.

examples.en: Jogging and swimming are classic aerobic exercises that burn calories efficiently.
examples.zh: 慢跑與游泳皆屬於能高效率燃燒多餘脂肪熱量的經典全身性有氧運動。

examples.en: Doctors recommend thirty minutes of moderate aerobic activity at least five days a week.
examples.zh: 醫師建議每週至少維持五天、每次進行三十分鐘以上中等強度的規律有氧運動。

examples.en: Aerobic capacity measures how efficiently heart and lungs supply oxygen during workouts.
examples.zh: 最大有氧攝氧量是衡量心臟與肺部在運動過程中向全身肌肉輸送氧氣效率的核心指標。

explains.en: Jogging and swimming make the heart and lungs work harder. These exercises use oxygen to support movement.
Doctors may recommend moderate activity for half an hour several days a week. It helps build endurance.
This describes exercise that raises breathing and heart rate over time. It can strengthen the heart and lungs.

examples.en: Sprinting and heavy deadlifts are powerful anaerobic strength builders.
examples.zh: 百米全力衝刺與大重量硬舉是能快速刺激肌肉生長的強力無氧爆發力訓練。

examples.en: Anaerobic metabolism produces lactic acid when muscles work without sufficient oxygen.
examples.zh: 當肌肉在極限高強度、缺乏充足氧氣供應下劇烈收縮時，無氧代謝會產生大量乳酸。

examples.en: High-intensity interval training (HIIT) blends short anaerobic bursts with brief recovery periods.
examples.zh: 高強度間歇訓練（HIIT）將短暫的極限無氧爆發衝刺與簡短的間歇緩和動態休息完美融合。

examples.en: Anaerobic fermentation in oxygen-free stainless steel tanks yields intense cinnamon and bubblegum aromatics.
examples.zh: 在無氧不銹鋼密封發酵槽中進行厭氧發酵，創造出肉桂辛香與泡泡糖的迷人風味。

examples.en: Purging oxygen with carbon dioxide creates an anaerobic environment favored by specialized lactic bacteria.
examples.zh: 在密封發酵桶中灌入二氧化碳排擠氧氣營造純厭氧環境，引導乳酸菌群進行特化發酵代換。

examples.en: Judges at the barista championship were blown away by the wild tropical notes of this anaerobic lot.
examples.zh: 世界咖啡師大賽評審團，被這款雙重厭氧處理微批次豆所散發出的狂野百香果熱帶香氣深深震撼。

entries.definition: 無氧的；高強度的；厭氧密封發酵與二氧化碳浸漬發酵的

explains.en: This describes exercise or a process that happens without enough oxygen. Sprinting uses short, powerful bursts of energy. Some bacteria also grow in oxygen-free places.
A person may lift heavy weights in brief efforts that use stored energy. Muscles can produce a by-product during intense activity. Fermentation can happen this way too.
Use this adjective for activity or living things that do not rely on oxygen. A short sprint is an example of this kind of exercise. Some food processes use it.

examples.en: Olympic gold-medal weightlifting requires explosive power and impeccable technique.
examples.zh: 奧運金牌級的舉重抓舉與挺舉競技需要極致的瞬間爆發力與無懈可擊的槓鈴技巧。

examples.en: Incorporating weightlifting into your weekly routine prevents age-related muscle loss.
examples.zh: 將重量訓練融入日常每週規律運動中，能有效防止隨著年齡增長而發生的肌少症肌肉流失。

examples.en: Proper footwear with a raised heel provides stability during heavy weightlifting movements.
examples.zh: 穿著具備硬底與微墊高鞋跟的專業舉重鞋，能為大重量舉重深蹲動作提供絕佳的腳底穩定度。

explains.en: It is a sport or exercise that involves lifting heavy weights. Athletes use careful technique for safety. Strong shoes can help provide stability.
People train their muscles by lifting a bar with weights attached. Olympic competitions test power and skill. Beginners should learn proper form.
This strength activity can help prevent muscle loss as people age. A coach may teach safe movements. Practice builds power over time.

examples.en: Proper hip hinge form during deadlifts protects the lower spine from injury.
examples.zh: 在進行槓鈴硬舉時維持正確的髖關節鉸鏈發力姿勢能有效保護腰椎免於受傷。

examples.en: The powerlifter managed to deadlift more than two and a half times his body weight.
examples.zh: 這名力量舉重健力好手成功硬舉拉起了超過自身體重兩點五倍的大重量槓鈴。

examples.en: Incorporating the deadlift builds formidable posterior chain and grip strength.
examples.zh: 規律將硬舉訓練納入課表中能鍛造強悍無比的後側動力鏈與驚人的前臂握力。

examples.en: Conventional deadlifts build unmatched posterior chain strength in the back and glutes.
examples.zh: 傳統硬舉動作能全方位建構無比強大的後側動力鏈，深層強化整個背部肌群與臀大肌。

examples.en: Brace your abdomen and keep the bar close to your shins when you deadlift.
examples.zh: 硬舉拉起槓鈴時，腹部應全力繃緊閉氣，並讓槓鈴緊貼小腿迎面骨而上。

examples.en: He set a personal record by pulling a 200-kilogram deadlift without straps.
examples.zh: 他在不使用拉力帶的情況下拉起了兩百公斤的硬舉，打破了個人紀錄。

entries.definition: 硬舉；硬拉；拉起地面槓鈴

explains.en: A weightlifter bends at the hips and lifts a bar from the floor while keeping a stable posture. Learn the movement with a coach.
This strength exercise works the legs, back, and hips as a person raises a loaded bar. Start with light weights and good form.
A trainer watches someone lift a barbell from the ground. The lifter keeps the back controlled and stands upright.

examples.en: Dynamic stretching before workouts warms up cold joints and elastic muscles.
examples.zh: 運動前確實落實五到十分鐘的動態伸展，能預先喚醒緊繃關節並提升肌肉彈性。

examples.en: Ten minutes of gentle static stretching before bed relieves tension built up during the workday.
examples.zh: 睡前進行十分鐘輕柔的靜態伸展拉筋，能舒緩消除一整天久坐辦公累積的緊繃與疲勞。

examples.en: Gymnasts and dancers dedicate hours every day to intensive flexibility stretching.
examples.zh: 競技體操選手與芭蕾舞者每天皆投入數小時進行極具強度的身體柔韌度伸展訓練。

explains.en: Gentle movements can help loosen tight muscles before a workout. Dancers may practice them every day.
A person can reach their arms and legs to reduce tension after work. Move slowly and do not force the body.
Athletes often prepare their joints with easy movements before exercise. A short session can help them feel ready.

examples.en: A certified personal trainer customizes workout plans tailored to your goals.
examples.zh: 擁有專業國際證照的私人一對一健身教練能根據您的個人體態目標量身訂製課表。

examples.en: The dolphin trainer used positive reinforcement whistles during the aquatic show.
examples.zh: 海豚訓練師在海洋公園水上表演中運用口哨正向增強法引導海豚完成跳躍。

examples.en: She bought a sturdy new pair of running trainers before starting her half-marathon prep.
examples.zh: 在展開半馬備賽訓練前，她特地添購了一雙支撐性與緩震俱佳的專業慢跑運動鞋。

examples.en: A certified personal trainer ensures correct exercise form to prevent sports injuries.
examples.zh: 擁有國際四大證照的私人健身教練能全程指導標準動作，確保安全無傷訓練。

examples.en: Working with a trainer helped him break through a plateau and set a new personal record.
examples.zh: 與教練合作幫助他突破了訓練瓶頸，並創下了新的個人最佳紀錄。

examples.en: The gym trainer designed a customized four-day split routine tailored to her fitness goals.
examples.zh: 健身房教練為她量身打造了一套四天分化訓練計畫，以達成她的健身目標。

entries.definition: 健身教練；訓練員；球鞋；私人健身教練 (PT)

explains.en: This person teaches others how to exercise or perform a sport. They can design a plan to fit someone's goals. A dolphin worker can also be called this.
At a gym, a certified coach may show how to lift safely. Someone may also buy running shoes with this name in some places. The context gives the meaning.
Use this noun for a person who teaches a skill or prepares someone for activity. They may work with athletes or animals. It can also mean a kind of athletic shoe in British English.

examples.en: Runners followed the 4-hour balloon pacer to manage their race rhythm.
examples.zh: 許多全馬跑者全程緊跟著頭戴四小時氣球的專業配速員，精準掌控比賽節奏。

examples.en: Official pacers run with remarkable accuracy, crossing timing mats within seconds of schedule.
examples.zh: 官方配速員具備驚人的精準巡航能力，每次跨過感應計時地墊的秒差都在原廠計畫內。

examples.en: An elite pacer led the front pack through the first 30 kilometers at world-record speed.
examples.zh: 頂尖菁英配速兔子引領著領先集團以打破世界紀錄的凌厲速度狂飆跑完前三十公里。

explains.en: It is a runner who keeps a steady speed to help others reach a target time. A balloon may mark them in a race. They guide the group.
Some runners follow this athlete to manage their rhythm during a marathon. The person aims to cross timing points on schedule. It can help others finish.
A skilled runner may lead a pack at a planned speed. Others try to stay nearby. This role helps them avoid starting too fast.

examples.en: Crossing the marathon finish line after grueling training brought immense joy.
examples.zh: 歷經數月艱苦備戰後終於昂首衝過馬拉松終點線的那一刻，內心湧現無比激動與喜悅。

examples.en: Spectators cheered enthusiastically as the tired runners sprinted toward the finish line.
examples.zh: 夾道圍觀的熱情群眾大聲加油吶喊，為精疲力竭卻全力衝向終點線的跑者熱烈打氣。

examples.en: We are finally approaching the finish line of this arduous six-month engineering project.
examples.zh: 歷經長達半年日以繼夜的艱辛奮戰，我們終於迎向了這項龐大工程專案的最後完工終點線。

explains.en: Runners aim for a stripe across the road at the end of a race. Friends may cheer as they reach it.
Spectators applaud tired athletes as they sprint toward the final marker. Crossing it completes the race.
After months of work, a team is close to completing its project. This phrase can also mean the final point of a race.

examples.en: Endorphin release during long runs induces a blissful, energized runner's high.
examples.zh: 長距離路跑過程中大腦大量分泌腦內啡與多巴胺，帶來通體舒暢的跑者愉悅感。

examples.en: After passing the 15-kilometer mark, she felt an effortless wave of runner's high wash over her.
examples.zh: 在跑過十五公里標誌牌後，她感受到一股毫不費力、神采飛揚的跑者愉悅感油然而生。

examples.en: Many dedicated distance athletes describe the runner's high as an addictive natural euphoria.
examples.zh: 許多長跑老手將這種跑步帶來的愉悅感形容為一種令人難以抗拒且純天然的精神亢奮。

entries.definition: 跑者愉悅感 (腦內啡多巴胺分泌)

explains.en: After a long run, a person may feel unusually happy and full of energy. Some runners describe it as a natural lift.
An athlete may feel light and joyful after passing many kilometers. This pleasant feeling can come during exercise.
People sometimes feel a wave of happiness after steady running. The body's natural chemicals may play a part.

examples.en: Trail running through Yangmingshan forests combines nature exploration with fitness.
examples.zh: 穿梭於陽明山國家公園原始古道森林中的越野路跑，兼具了大自然探索與極致體能鍛鍊。

examples.en: Unlike road running, trail running demands constant agility to hop over tree roots and slippery mud.
examples.zh: 不同於路面平整的一般公路路跑，越野山徑野跑需要極佳的靈敏敏捷度以跳越樹根與泥濘。

examples.en: Equip yourself with trail running shoes featuring aggressive rubber lugs for rocky terrain grip.
examples.zh: 請穿著搭載深齒痕粗獷大底的專業越野跑鞋，以應對崎嶇碎石與濕滑山路的地表抓地力。

explains.en: This is running on natural paths through forests or mountains instead of on roads. Runners need to step over roots and rocks. Shoes with rough soles help grip the ground.
A person may run along a muddy track in the hills. It requires balance and attention. Some people enjoy the scenery as much as the exercise.
Use this phrase for running on paths outdoors. The ground can be uneven and slippery. Runners often wear special footwear for better grip.

examples.en: Indoor bouldering gyms offer color-coded problem routes for beginner climbers.
examples.zh: 室內抱石攀岩館為新手與進階岩友規劃了以不同顏色岩塊標註等級的抱石路線。

examples.en: Bouldering is a climbing discipline performed on short walls over thick safety crash pads.
examples.zh: 抱石攀岩是一種在離地數公尺矮牆上進行、底下鋪滿厚實安全防墜軟墊的無繩攀岩運動。

examples.en: Solving complex bouldering routes requires creative problem-solving, finger grip, and core tension.
examples.zh: 成功解開高難度抱石路線需要發揮靈活的解題思維、強大的指力與全身核心張力。

entries.definition: 抱石攀岩（無繩索低高度）

explains.en: It is a type of rock climbing on short walls without ropes. Thick safety mats are placed below. Climbers solve routes using balance and grip.
Indoor gyms mark holds with colors to create different climbing challenges. The walls are low enough for mats to catch a fall. Strong fingers help.
People climb short rock faces close to the ground. They plan hand and foot movements to reach the top. A partner can watch for safety.

examples.en: Practicing martial arts like Judo and Taekwondo develops discipline and self-defense.
examples.zh: 修練柔道與跆拳道等傳統武術格鬥技藝能培養嚴謹自律品格並具備防身自衛能力。

examples.en: The legendary martial arts master demonstrated fluid sword forms to his disciples.
examples.zh: 這位享譽武林的傳奇武術宗師向門下親傳弟子示範行雲流水、氣吞山河的太極劍法。

examples.en: Mixed martial arts (MMA) blends boxing, Muay Thai, wrestling, and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu.
examples.zh: 綜合格鬥技（MMA）博採眾長，融合了西洋拳擊、泰拳、自由式角力與巴西柔術。

explains.en: Students practice kicks, blocks, and forms in a class such as judo or taekwondo. Respect and discipline are part of training.
Some fighters combine boxing, wrestling, and other styles in a sport. Beginners learn safely with a qualified teacher.
A person can learn techniques for movement and self-defense. Classes may use belts or levels to show progress.

examples.en: The Taiwanese pommel horse specialist won Olympic silver with flawless routines.
examples.zh: 台灣鞍馬王子在奧運競技體操舞台上以行雲流水、零瑕疵的完美落地榮獲銀牌。

examples.en: Gymnastics builds incredible full-body strength, spatial awareness, and muscular control.
examples.zh: 體操訓練能培養令人驚嘆的全身協調力量、敏銳空間感知力與極致的肌肉精準控制度。

examples.en: Young children in tumbling gymnastics develop extraordinary balance and flexibility.
examples.zh: 自幼參與滾翻體操啟蒙班的小朋友能培養出超凡的身體平衡感與肢體柔軟度。

entries.definition: 體操競技；鞍馬跳馬體操

explains.en: This sport includes moves such as tumbling and balance exercises. It builds strength and control.
Children can practice on mats with a coach. They learn how to move safely and keep their balance.
Athletes perform routines on equipment such as a bar or beam. Flexibility and strength are useful.

examples.en: The city built modern affordable housing projects to support young families.
examples.zh: 市政府積極推動興建高品質現代化社會住宅，以減輕年輕青年成家居住負擔。

examples.en: Expanding the supply of affordable housing is a key priority for urban planners.
examples.zh: 擴大平價社會住宅的整體供給量是當前都市規劃者亟需解決的重中之重。

examples.en: Qualified low-income residents can enter a lottery for subsidized affordable housing units.
examples.zh: 符合資格條件的弱勢低收入市民可以參加抽籤，申請入住享有租金補貼的合宜公宅。

entries.definition: 社會住宅；合宜平價住宅

explains.en: This is a home priced so that people with lower incomes can pay for it. Cities may build apartments to support young families. Residents may qualify based on income.
A family may enter a lottery for a subsidized apartment. The goal is to make sure people can find a safe place to live without spending too much. Urban planners work on this issue.
Use this phrase for homes offered at a cost people with limited income can manage. Governments may help pay for them. More supply can help families find a place.

examples.en: Young professionals enjoy renting cozy studio apartments close to tech hubs.
examples.zh: 年輕上班族偏好在離科技園區與商務核心區不遠處租一間採光良好的溫馨獨立套房。

examples.en: Her studio apartment features a combined living and sleeping area with a compact kitchenette.
examples.zh: 她的單身開放式套房融合了客廳與臥室機能，並附帶一組精緻迷你的小巧流理台廚房。

examples.en: Clever modular furniture maximizes available floor space inside a small studio apartment.
examples.zh: 巧妙運用多功能變形收納家具，能將小型獨立套房的每寸空間利用率發揮到淋漓盡致。

entries.definition: 獨立套房；開放式單身套房

explains.en: It is a small home where the living and sleeping areas share one open room. A compact kitchen may sit along one wall. Young workers often rent one.
This kind of apartment combines the bedroom and living room in a single space. Modular furniture can make it more useful. It may suit one person.
A small unit may have one main room plus a bathroom. The kitchen is often compact. Clever storage helps save floor space.

examples.en: Modern residential condominiums provide 24-hour security guards and elevators.
examples.zh: 現代化優質電梯大樓華廈社區提供二十四小時全天候保全警衛門禁與磁扣電梯。

examples.en: Buying a condominium in Taipei offers convenient underground parking and trash collection.
examples.zh: 在台北購置電梯大樓社區住宅，能享有便利的地下室專屬平面車位與免追垃圾車服務。

examples.en: The newly completed luxury condominium overlooks the lush greenery of Daan Forest Park.
examples.zh: 這棟嶄新落成的頂級豪宅電梯大樓坐擁大安森林公園無遮蔽的壯闊綠意景觀。

entries.definition: 電梯大樓公寓；華廈社區 (Condo)

explains.en: A family buys an apartment in a building and shares hallways and other spaces with neighbors. A building association may care for common areas.
Residents live in separate homes but may share an elevator, lobby, and garden. They pay fees for building maintenance.
A city apartment may include shared facilities such as a gym or security desk. People own their individual units.

examples.en: Many families in central and southern Taiwan prefer spacious multi-story townhouses.
examples.zh: 許多中南部大家庭在置產時特別偏好產權獨立、附私家庭院車庫的寬敞透天厝。

examples.en: Their three-story suburban townhouse has a garage on the ground floor and a rooftop garden.
examples.zh: 他們座落於郊區的三層連棟透天別墅一樓規劃有室內車庫，頂樓則開闢了一座空中花園。

examples.en: Living in a detached townhouse eliminates complaints from downstairs neighbors about running footsteps.
examples.zh: 居住在獨門獨院的透天厝裡，完全不用擔心樓下鄰居前來抱怨小朋友奔跑的腳步聲。

explains.en: Families may live in a narrow house joined to others on both sides. Some have more than one floor.
A home in the city may have a garage below and a small garden above. Neighbors share side walls.
This kind of house is often part of a row of homes. It can give a family several levels of space.

examples.en: A licensed professional realtor showed us three three-bedroom apartments today.
examples.zh: 一位專業熱心的持照房仲經紀人今天帶領我們實地參觀了三間三房兩廳的優質物件。

examples.en: Working with an honest realtor helps first-time buyers navigate complex legal contracts safely.
examples.zh: 與誠懇信賴的專業房仲合作，能協助首購族安全無虞地審閱繁複的買賣定型化契約。

examples.en: The realtor researched neighborhood price history to help the seller set an attractive listing.
examples.zh: 房仲詳實調查了該社區過去實價登錄的歷史成交行情，協助屋主訂定合理的開價。

entries.definition: 房屋仲介經紀人；房仲 (Estate Agent)

explains.en: This is a licensed professional who helps people buy, sell, or rent homes. They may show apartments and explain contracts. They can research neighborhood prices.
A first-time buyer may ask this person to guide them through a home purchase. They know about local listings. An honest one explains the process clearly.
Use this noun for a property professional who works with clients. They may help a seller choose a price. A license is required in many places.

examples.en: Schedule an afternoon house viewing to inspect natural interior sunlight.
examples.zh: 建議預約晴朗午後時段實地預約看屋賞屋，以便親自檢驗室內採光與通風對流。

examples.en: We attended a weekend private viewing of the newly listed loft apartment near the park.
examples.zh: 我們在週末參加了一場位於公園旁、剛開盤上市的挑高樓中樓物件的私人賞屋會。

examples.en: Bringing a small flashlight and measuring tape is helpful when conducting a detailed apartment viewing.
examples.zh: 在進行仔細的實地看屋時，隨身自備手電筒與捲尺能大幅方便勘查樑柱與暗處屋況。

explains.en: It is a scheduled visit to look at a house or apartment before renting or buying it. Bring a tape measure and check the sunlight. Ask about repairs.
A potential renter may walk through a home to see its condition. They can look at rooms and windows. Booking a time is often necessary.
People arrange this visit to inspect a property before making a decision. A flashlight can help check dark corners. Take notes about what needs fixing.

examples.en: The spacious master bedroom suite measures approximately eight ping (26.4 m²).
examples.zh: 這間寬敞方正的主臥大套房室內實坪面積約為八坪（約相當於 26.4 平方公尺）。

examples.en: Property listings in Taiwan clearly distinguish between total building ping and actual indoor ping.
examples.zh: 台灣房屋買賣物件資訊都會清楚載明權狀登記總坪數與室內主建物的實際室內實坪。

examples.en: An average single-family home in the residential district covers roughly thirty-five ping.
examples.zh: 該住宅重劃區內標準三房的家庭住宅，室內加上附屬建物約落在三十五坪左右。

entries.definition: 坪（台灣房地產面積計算單位，約3.3平方公尺）

explains.en: Property listings in Taiwan may measure floor area with a local unit of size. One unit is about 3.3 square meters.
A home listing may show a number for the apartment’s indoor area using a common local measurement. It is often used in Taiwan.
When comparing apartments, buyers may see this area unit on local listings. It measures space rather than distance.

examples.en: Demolition workers carefully removed non-loadbearing brick walls to open the space.
examples.zh: 拆除工程工班小心翼翼打除客廳與廚房之間非承重牆隔間，打造開闊開放式大空間。

examples.en: Building demolition permits must be acquired from city authorities before heavy machinery arrives.
examples.zh: 在大型重機械進場開挖拆除前，必須先依法向市府主管機關取得正式建築拆除執照。

examples.en: Workers wore industrial dust masks and ear protection during the noisy bathroom demolition.
examples.zh: 在敲除舊磁磚與清運廢土的噪音衛浴拆除工區中，師傅們均佩戴防塵面罩與降噪耳罩。

examples.en: Heavy demolition crews removed old bathroom tiles and outdated plumbing during week one.
examples.zh: 專業打除拆除施工團隊在開工第一週便迅速將老舊衛浴磁磚、廢棄木作與生鏽水電管線全數拆除。

examples.en: Safety nets and dust curtains are legally required during structural building demolition.
examples.zh: 在市區進行建築主體結構拆除工程時，依法必須搭設嚴密的高空防墜安全網與防塵防躁水霧屏障。

examples.en: The crowd watched from a safe distance as the condemned chimney was brought down in a controlled demolition.
examples.zh: 大批群眾在圍戒線外的安全距離駐足圍觀，目睹被判定為危樓的老煙囪在定向爆破拆除下瞬間應聲倒塌。

entries.definition: 拆除工程；打除舊隔間；打除拆毀

explains.en: Workers may remove old bathroom tiles before replacing them. Heavy machines can help take down an unsafe building.
A city must approve the removal of a building before work begins. Workers wear masks to avoid dust.
A crew can carefully bring down an old chimney. Safety nets keep people away from falling pieces.

examples.en: Lightweight drywall partitions with sound-absorbing rockwool create quiet study rooms.
examples.zh: 填塞吸音岩棉的輕鋼架雙層石膏板輕隔間牆為孩子打造出安靜舒適的獨立書房空間。

examples.en: Glass sliding door partitions divide the master bedroom from the walk-in closet gracefully.
examples.zh: 鋁框長虹玻璃推拉門隔斷優雅地將主臥睡眠區與更衣室梳妝動線巧妙劃分開來。

examples.en: The open-plan office used low wooden partitions to give coworkers personal privacy.
examples.zh: 開放式辦公大廳採用矮木質屏風隔板，為每位員工營造出舒適不壓迫的獨立辦公隱私。

examples.en: Frosted glass sliding partitions divide the study while maintaining visual brightness.
examples.zh: 採用霧面長虹玻璃鐵件拉門作為半開放隔間牆，既能保留書房獨立私密，又兼具通透採光。

examples.en: Modern office spaces use modular fabric partitions that absorb conversational noise between cubicles.
examples.zh: 現代智慧共享辦公空間廣泛採用模組化吸音布面活動隔板，能有效吸收不同隔間辦公桌之間的說話干擾。

examples.en: The peace treaty formally established a border partition dividing the contested territory into two nations.
examples.zh: 這份國際和平停戰條約正式劃定了邊界分割分界線，將昔日爭議領土正式劃分為兩個主權國家。

entries.definition: 輕隔間牆；隔板；隔開；隔間牆；分割

explains.en: This is a divider that separates one room or area into smaller spaces. A low one can give office workers privacy. It can also mean dividing a place into parts.
A home may have a sliding glass panel between a bedroom and closet. A peace agreement may also divide territory. The word can be a thing or an action.
Use this noun for a wall or screen that divides a room. It can also name the act of splitting an area. Fabric panels may reduce noise.

examples.en: Waterproof SPC laminate wood flooring was installed seamlessly throughout the flat.
examples.zh: 全室直鋪具備防水抗刮特性的優質超耐磨 SPC 石塑木地板，美觀且極易日常維護清潔。

examples.en: Natural teak hardwood flooring gives living rooms an inviting and luxurious warm feel.
examples.zh: 鋪設天然緬甸柚木實木地板賦予了寬敞客廳溫暖宜人且歷久彌新的頂級奢華質感。

examples.en: Ensure the concrete subfloor is level and dry before installing click-lock vinyl flooring.
examples.zh: 在拼接卡扣式石塑卡扣地板前，務必先確認下層水泥素地平整乾燥、無高低落差。

entries.definition: 地板建材；木質地板鋪設

explains.en: It is the material used to cover the floor of a room. Wood, tile, and vinyl are common choices. The surface below should be level and dry.
A home may have teak boards or waterproof laminate underfoot. Choosing the right material affects comfort and appearance. Installation can take time.
This term names the surface people walk on inside a building. It may be made from wood or synthetic planks. Some types resist water.

examples.en: Fresh white wall repainting instantly brightened up the dimly lit hallway.
examples.zh: 為全家牆面重新粉刷純白環保乳膠漆油漆，瞬間讓原本昏暗的走廊煥然一新明亮照人。

examples.en: The exterior facade repainting of the apartment complex restored its modern appearance.
examples.zh: 社區大樓外牆磁磚拉皮與防水晴雨漆的全面重新上漆，讓建築重現現代摩登風華。

examples.en: Professional surface sanding and patch filling are vital steps prior to final repainting.
examples.zh: 在進行最後一道面漆刷塗前，徹底進行牆面批土打磨平整是油漆工程至關重要的前置作業。

entries.definition: 重新粉刷油漆；重新上漆

explains.en: A hallway looks brighter after workers sand rough spots and apply fresh paint. This can refresh an old wall.
Before adding a new coat of color, repair cracks and cover the floor. Let each coat dry as directed.
An apartment building may update its outside walls with a new layer of paint. Proper preparation helps it last.

examples.en: Upgrading old galvanized plumbing to durable stainless steel pipes prevents rust.
examples.zh: 將四十年老舊鍍鋅鐵水管全數升級汰換為耐壓不銹鋼管，能徹底杜絕水管生鏽漏水。

examples.en: Faulty concealed plumbing beneath the floor tiles caused damp spots on downstairs ceilings.
examples.zh: 埋設在地磚下方暗處的給水配管施工瑕疵，導致樓下天花板出現大片壁癌濕氣水漬。

examples.en: Call a licensed technician to inspect your household gas and water plumbing every few years.
examples.zh: 建議每隔數年請合格的水電技師到府全面檢視家中的瓦斯與給排水水電管線系統。

entries.definition: 水電管線系統；衛浴配管工程

explains.en: Pipes carry water through a home to sinks and showers. A leak may need a licensed worker to fix it.
Old metal pipes can rust over time. Hidden water lines may cause damp spots in a downstairs room.
A household system includes pipes for fresh water and waste. It may need repair if a sink does not drain.

examples.en: Applying multiple elastomeric coats ensures flawless bathroom waterproofing.
examples.zh: 在浴室濕區底層塗佈多道彈性水泥防水塗料，能確保衛浴防水工程滴水不漏萬無一失。

examples.en: Rooftop waterproofing needs regular maintenance and reapplying every five to seven years.
examples.zh: 頂樓露台的聚氨酯彈性防水漆層需要定期維護，建議每隔五至七年重新滾塗施作。

examples.en: Thorough flood testing for 48 hours is required to verify the success of waterproofing.
examples.zh: 在進行泥作貼磚前必須進行長達四十八小時的蓄水試水測試，以嚴格檢驗防水層品質。

explains.en: This is work that keeps water from entering a bathroom, roof, or other surface. Workers may apply several protective layers. They can test it by filling an area with water.
A roof may need this treatment every few years. It prevents leaks from damaging a building. Careful testing checks whether it worked.
Use this noun for materials or work that stop water from passing through. Bathrooms and rooftops often need it. Regular checks help prevent leaks.

examples.en: Professional thermal cameras detected the hidden bathroom pipe water leakage.
examples.zh: 抓漏達人運用高科技紅外線熱影像儀迅速揪出隱藏在牆壁深處的暗管水管漏水點。

examples.en: The gas company responded swiftly when neighbors reported a suspected fuel pipe leakage.
examples.zh: 當鄰居通報聞到濃重瓦斯氣味懷疑管線滲漏洩漏時，天然氣瓦斯公司迅速派員搶修。

examples.en: Untreated roof water leakage can damage reinforced concrete and cause concrete spalling.
examples.zh: 若長期放任屋頂裂縫漏水不予理會，水氣會滲蝕鋼筋導致嚴重的混凝土塊剝落結構損壞。

explains.en: It is the escape of liquid or gas through a hole or weak place. A pipe may let water into a bathroom. Repair it before more damage occurs.
A roof can let rain enter a house. Gas escaping from a line can be dangerous. Call a professional to find the source.
This noun describes something leaking from a container or system. A thermal camera may help find hidden water. Fixing the problem early prevents damage.

examples.en: Custom floor-to-ceiling cabinetry maximizes storage capacity in small city flats.
examples.zh: 頂天立地的量身訂製客製化系統櫃將都會小宅的垂直收納空間效益發揮至極致。

examples.en: The kitchen cabinetry is crafted from European E0-grade moisture-resistant boards.
examples.zh: 全套歐化廚具系統櫥櫃皆採用符合歐洲頂級 E0 等級低甲醛防潮環保板材打造。

examples.en: Soft-close hinges and drawer slides ensure that the cabinetry closes quietly and smoothly.
examples.zh: 採用知名進口奧地利緩衝鉸鏈與抽屜滑軌，確保每次關閉系統門片時安靜無聲又順暢。

examples.en: Custom floor-to-ceiling cabinetry conceals clutter behind sleek push-to-open seamless panels.
examples.zh: 量身訂製的高質感頂天立地系統收納櫃體，將居家雜物巧妙隱藏於極簡拍拍手無把手門片後方。

examples.en: The carpenter built exquisite cherry wood cabinetry for the home library.
examples.zh: 資深木作工藝大師為家庭圖書館書房精工打造了一整面氣派高貴的頂級櫻桃木原木書櫃木作。

examples.en: Integrated LED strip lighting under upper cabinetry brightens kitchen countertops effectively.
examples.zh: 在上層廚房吊櫃下方嵌入隱藏式 LED 線型燈條照明，能極其均勻明亮地照亮料理備料工作檯面。

entries.definition: 系統櫃訂製；櫥櫃家具工程；客製化系統櫃體；櫥櫃木作

explains.en: A carpenter builds storage cupboards and drawers for a kitchen. They can be made to fit the room.
Tall built-in shelves hide household items and keep a small apartment tidy. Doors can have soft-closing hinges.
A home designer plans cupboards under counters and along walls. These built-in storage units can be custom-sized.

examples.en: Stain-resistant engineered quartz countertops are durable and easy to wipe clean.
examples.zh: 耐刮耐磨且抗油污滲透的進口人造石英石流理檯面，經久耐用且極易日常擦拭保養。

examples.en: Never place piping hot cast-iron skillets directly onto an acrylic solid surface countertop.
examples.zh: 剛起鍋滾燙的鑄鐵煎鍋切記不要直接擺放在人造壓克力實體檯面上，以免高溫燙傷留痕。

examples.en: The spacious kitchen island countertop serves double duty as a casual breakfast dining bar.
examples.zh: 寬敞大器的開放式中島吧檯檯面同時兼具備料輕食料理台與晨間溫馨早餐吧的多功能。

examples.en: Heat-resistant sintered stone countertops withstand boiling pans and razor-sharp chef knives without scratching.
examples.zh: 耐高溫抗刮磨的進口頂級岩板廚房檯面能從容耐受滾燙熱鍋與鋒利主廚刀，長保歷久彌新。

examples.en: Wipe the marble countertop gently with pH-neutral soapy water to protect the porous stone sealant.
examples.zh: 平日清潔保養大理石檯面時請使用中性溫和肥皂水輕拭，以保護大理石天然毛細孔防護密封層。

examples.en: White quartz countertops offer uniform contemporary elegance with practically zero maintenance.
examples.zh: 純白石英石結晶廚房流理檯面兼具當代極簡洗練的美感，且抗污耐滲色、幾乎完全無需費心保養。

entries.definition: 流理檯面；中島檯面；廚房檯面；流理台面

explains.en: This flat kitchen surface is used for preparing food. It is easy to wipe clean after cooking.
A cook should not put a very hot pan on some surfaces. Stone and other materials are used to make it.
A kitchen island may have a large work surface that also serves as a breakfast bar. Marble needs gentle cleaning.

examples.en: A high-suction range hood is essential for high-heat Taiwanese stir-fry cooking.
examples.zh: 配備大吸力、深罩式的排油煙機能在大火快炒時秒速吸走油煙，保持居家空氣清新。

examples.en: Remember to clean or replace the grease filter on your range hood every few months.
examples.zh: 養成每隔數個月定期拆卸清洗或替換排油煙機不銹鋼集油網的良好廚房清潔習慣。

examples.en: Modern concealed range hoods retract seamlessly flush beneath custom upper cabinetry.
examples.zh: 當代隱藏式排油煙機在不使用時能完全收折收納於上方系統吊櫃下方，維持極簡美觀。

explains.en: This is an appliance above a stove that pulls away smoke, steam, and cooking smells. It has a filter that should be cleaned. Strong airflow helps during frying.
A kitchen may have this device under a cabinet. It removes greasy air while food cooks. Some models retract when they are not being used.
Use this term for a venting appliance installed above a cooktop. It helps keep the kitchen air clean. Cleaning its filter regularly is important.

examples.en: Frameless induction cookers provide safe, flameless heating for modern kitchens.
examples.zh: 無明火且加熱神速的平面式嵌入型 IH 感應爐是現代無明火安全美型廚房的人氣標配。

examples.en: An induction cooker heats ferrous pots directly using electromagnetic magnetic fields.
examples.zh: IH 爐利用高頻電磁感應渦電流原理直接加熱鍋底金屬，熱轉換效率極高且表面不燙手。

examples.en: Cleaning an induction cooker is as simple as wiping a smooth, flat sheet of ceramic glass.
examples.zh: 清潔平面 IH 爐面無比輕鬆寫意，只需拿抹布輕輕擦拭整片平整的光滑黑晶微晶玻璃即可。

entries.definition: IH 電磁感應爐；IH 爐

explains.en: It is a stove that heats a pot using magnetic energy rather than an open flame. The glass surface is easy to wipe. The cookware must be suitable.
This kitchen appliance heats compatible metal pots directly. It can be fast and safe because the surface stays cooler. Clean it after cooking.
An electric field warms the pot on this smooth cooking surface. It has no visible flame. Use cookware that a magnet can stick to.

examples.en: Installing a built-in dishwasher saves valuable evening family leisure time.
examples.zh: 家中安裝一台大容量嵌入式自動洗碗機徹底免除飯後洗碗辛勞，大幅提升家庭幸福感。

examples.en: Modern dishwashers sanitize tableware using high-temperature water jets and hot air drying.
examples.zh: 當代全嵌式洗碗機透過攝氏七十度高溫強力水柱噴淋與熱風烘乾，達成全方位高溫除菌。

examples.en: Make sure to scrape large food remnants off plates before loading them into the dishwasher.
examples.zh: 在把碗盤餐具依序擺入洗碗機洗碗籃架前，請先將盤面大塊骨頭殘渣刮除乾淨。

explains.en: Place dirty plates, cups, and forks inside, then start the machine. Scrape off large food pieces first.
Hot water sprays the dishes and rinses away food. Some models also dry them.
A built-in kitchen appliance cleans tableware while the family relaxes. Arrange items so water can reach them.

examples.en: Heated smart bidet toilet seats provide comfort during cold winter mornings.
examples.zh: 冬日寒冬清晨坐上具備溫水沖洗與暖座功能的智慧免治馬桶座，備感溫暖貼心舒適。

examples.en: Using a bidet with warm water spray is hygienic, soothing, and reduces toilet paper use.
examples.zh: 使用免治馬桶溫水柔膚沖洗不僅潔淨衛生、舒緩溫和，更能大幅減少衛生紙砍樹浪費。

examples.en: Many travelers fall in love with electronic bidets when visiting hotels in Tokyo and Taipei.
examples.zh: 許多歐美觀光客在入住東京與台北的現代化飯店時，對功能一應俱全的免治馬桶讚不絕口。

explains.en: This bathroom fixture sprays warm water to clean the body after using the toilet. Some have heated seats.
A traveler may find this electronic seat in a hotel in Japan or Taiwan. It can reduce the need for paper.
A nozzle sends a gentle stream of water for washing. Many modern bathrooms have this feature built into the toilet.

examples.en: High-end property management maintains building cleanliness and security 24/7.
examples.zh: 優質專業的物業管理服務全天候守護社區治安門禁並維持公共區域一塵不染。

examples.en: The property management company oversees mechanical elevator maintenance and fire safety.
examples.zh: 社區物業管理團隊全權統籌監督大樓電梯機械巡檢、自來水塔清洗與消防申報安檢。

examples.en: Residents voiced satisfaction with the friendly front-desk staff hired by property management.
examples.zh: 全體住戶對物業管理公司派駐在一樓大廳親切專業的秘書服務團隊表達了高度肯定。

explains.en: This is the work of caring for a building and helping its residents. A company may arrange elevator repairs and security. Staff can keep shared spaces clean.
An organization may look after a home or office building for its owner. It handles maintenance and helps answer resident questions. A front desk may be part of its service.
Use this phrase for the daily care and operation of buildings. Workers may check fire safety or arrange repairs. Residents contact them when something needs attention.

examples.en: Residential basement recycling stations make daily trash sorting effortless.
examples.zh: 大樓地下室規劃完善的二十四小時資源回收集中場讓住戶免追垃圾車、輕鬆落實分類。

examples.en: Diligent household sorting of paper, plastic, and food scraps conserves valuable resources.
examples.zh: 居家日常落實紙類、塑膠寶特瓶與廚餘的細部回收分類，能將寶貴資源永續循環再利用。

examples.en: Automated optical sorting machines help modern recycling centers separate plastics by resin type.
examples.zh: 自動化光學分揀機台能協助現代資源回收處理中心依照塑料材質種類精準分離各類回收物。

examples.en: Cross-belt sorting machines scan barcodes and divert 20,000 packages per hour by zip code.
examples.zh: 交叉帶式高速自動分揀機透過頂部條碼相機，每小時將兩萬件包裹依郵遞區號自動分流至專屬滑道。

examples.en: Efficient parcel sorting reduces turnaround times and prevents misrouted delivery shipments.
examples.zh: 高度精準的包裹自動分揀能大幅縮短轉運時效，並徹底防止送錯營業所導致的錯運繞路延誤。

examples.en: The newly opened hub features three levels of high-speed mechanical sorting conveyor tracks.
examples.zh: 全新啟用的旗艦轉運轉運中心配備了三層立體高速機械分揀輸送軌道，具備超強全天候吞吐量。

examples.en: Rigorous source waste sorting diverts 90% of household recyclables away from municipal incinerators.
examples.zh: 推動源頭家戶垃圾細緻資源分類（Sorting），成功將九成以上的可回收資源從垃圾焚化爐中攔截拯救。

examples.en: Automated optical sorting machines use infrared cameras to separate clear glass from colored bottles instantly.
examples.zh: 高速自動光學分選機利用多光譜紅外線鏡頭即時辨識材質，瞬間以精準氣閥將無色透明玻璃與有色酒瓶精準分離。

examples.en: She spent the entire Saturday sorting through old photo albums, organizing precious memories chronologically.
examples.zh: 她在週六花了一整天時間悉心整理分類翻拍泛黃的老照片相簿，依年份時間軸井然有序地歸檔珍藏家庭回憶。

entries.definition: 資源回收分類；整理挑選；自動化高速包裹分揀；分類；家戶垃圾細緻資源分類；整理

explains.en: It is the act of putting items into groups by type, color, or size. Households can separate paper and plastic for recycling. Machines also sort parcels.
Workers organize materials so similar items are together. A recycling center may use cameras to separate different plastics. Clear bins make it easier.
This process arranges objects or information into categories. People can group books by subject. A machine may sort packages by destination.

examples.en: Building amenities include a heated swimming pool, modern gym, and rooftop lounge.
examples.zh: 該豪華指標建案的公共設施公設包含了溫水景觀泳池、重訓健身房與空中花園交誼廳。

examples.en: Hotel amenities such as plush robes, high-speed Wi-Fi, and espresso machines delight guests.
examples.zh: 頂級飯店房間內提供的厚織親膚浴袍、極速無線網路與義式膠囊咖啡機深受房客喜愛。

examples.en: When evaluating properties, consider whether the community amenities justify the public area ratio.
examples.zh: 在挑選中古屋或預售屋時，應冷靜評估各項社區公設配備是否物有所值、符合自身日常需求。

entries.definition: 公共設施；生活便利配備 (公設)

explains.en: A hotel offers guests Wi-Fi, fresh towels, and a coffee maker. These extra features make a stay more comfortable.
A new apartment building may have a gym, shared garden, or lounge. Residents can use these shared facilities.
When choosing a hotel or home, people may compare the helpful features it provides. These can include a pool or laundry room.

examples.en: The land registry office issued the official real estate title deed upon settlement.
examples.zh: 地政事務所於交屋過戶結清完稅當日正式核發蓋有鋼印的建物與土地所有權狀。

examples.en: Keep your property title deed stored safely alongside other irreplaceable legal certificates.
examples.zh: 請將名下房產的不動產所有權狀地契妥善收藏保管在防潮保險箱中，切勿隨意摺疊遺失。

examples.en: The conveyancer verified that the title deed was completely clean and unencumbered by liens.
examples.zh: 承辦地政士代書在簽約前徹底查核土地登記謄本，確認該權狀產權清白、絕無任何二胎抵押。

entries.definition: 房屋建物所有權狀；地契權狀

explains.en: This legal paper shows who owns a piece of land or a home. Keep it in a safe place.
A land office may issue this document after a property sale. It proves a person's ownership.
A lawyer checks this important certificate before a house is bought. It shows the legal owner.

examples.en: Municipal property taxes are levied annually on residential and commercial buildings.
examples.zh: 地方稅捐稽徵處每年五月份會依法針對名下各類住宅與商用不動產課徵房屋稅。

examples.en: Homeowners can apply for self-use residential property tax rates to reduce annual tax burdens.
examples.zh: 設籍自住的自住型屋主可向稅務局申請適用千分之十二的自用住宅優惠稅率以節省稅金。

examples.en: Remember to pay property taxes before the statutory deadline to avoid late payment penalties.
examples.zh: 請記得在法定期限截止日前如期繳納年度地價稅與房屋稅，以避免產生滯納金加徵罰款。

explains.en: This is money that a homeowner pays to a local government because they own a house or building. The amount may be due each year. Paying late can lead to a fee.
A city may charge owners based on the value of their homes or land. Some people can apply for a lower rate if they live there. The bill has a deadline.
Use this term for a local tax on buildings or land. Owners pay it to support public services. The amount depends on local rules and property value.

examples.en: The bank performed an on-site property valuation to approve the mortgage limit.
examples.zh: 銀行房貸專員偕同專業鑑價師親赴房屋現場進行實地鑑價，以核定最高房貸額度。

examples.en: The independent appraiser provided a detailed market valuation report based on recent sales.
examples.zh: 獨立不動產估價師依據周邊鄰近區域最新實價登錄成交行情，出具了詳盡的市場鑑價報告。

examples.en: A higher bank valuation allowed the buyers to secure an eighty percent loan-to-value ratio.
examples.zh: 銀行給予較高且合理的鑑價評估結果，讓買方順利爭取到了高達八成成數的成家房貸額度。

explains.en: It is an estimate of how much a house or other property is worth. A bank may need one before approving a loan. An appraiser checks recent sales.
A professional may inspect a home and compare it with similar places nearby. The report helps a buyer or lender understand its market price.
This estimate gives a likely price for a property. It may affect how much a bank will lend. An independent expert can prepare it.

examples.en: Government subsidies provide preferential loan rates for first-time homebuyers.
examples.zh: 政府新青安房貸政策提供極具競爭力的利率補貼，全方位力挺年輕首購族成家置產。

examples.en: Savvy homebuyers visit neighborhoods during both daytime and heavy rainstorms to check drainage.
examples.zh: 聰明用心的購屋者往往會在晴朗白天與暴雨豪雨過後分別實地走訪社區，確認有無漏水積水。

examples.en: First-time homebuyers should budget extra funds for deed transfer taxes, brokerage fees, and appliances.
examples.zh: 第一次買房的首購族切記要額外預留一筆規費預算，以支應契稅代書費、房仲服務費與基礎家電。

explains.en: A family visits several neighborhoods before choosing a house to purchase. They compare prices and nearby schools.
Someone buying their first home may ask the bank about a loan. They should also plan for other costs.
A couple tours an apartment and checks whether it fits their needs. They are preparing to become the owners.

examples.en: Achieving homeownership gives young families a deep sense of permanence and security.
examples.zh: 順利成家置產、擁有屬於自己溫暖的一方天地，為年輕家庭帶來無比踏實的歸屬感與安定感。

examples.en: High housing price-to-income ratios in major metropolises make homeownership difficult for youths.
examples.zh: 首都各大都會區過高的房價所得比讓現代許多剛出社會打拼的年輕世代感嘆買房門檻過高。

examples.en: Favorable government savings accounts and lending terms help turn the dream of homeownership into reality.
examples.zh: 善加運用政府推出的青年自購住宅優惠貸款政策與補貼方案，有助於將買房成家的夢想化為現實。

entries.definition: 擁有自有住宅；成家置產擁房率

explains.en: A family may save money so they can own the place where they live. This can feel secure.
High house prices can make it difficult for young people to buy a home. This term describes owning one's home.
Some government programs help families purchase a house. Becoming an owner can be an important goal.

examples.en: The two co-hosts share great comedic chemistry and banter effortlessly.
examples.zh: 兩位搭檔共同主持人默契十足、火花四射，在節目中幽默風趣的互虧吐槽笑料不斷。

examples.en: She invited a guest expert to co-host the weekly financial news discussion.
examples.zh: 她邀請了一位客座專家一同搭檔主持每週的財經新聞座談。

examples.en: My co-host was feeling unwell, so I had to host the radio show by myself.
examples.zh: 我的搭檔主持人身體不適，所以我只好獨自一人主持這檔廣播節目。

explains.en: This person shares the job of presenting a show or event with another person. They may take turns speaking. They can invite a guest together.
Two presenters may lead a radio program as a team. If one is ill, the other may continue alone. The word can name a person or an action.
Use this term for someone who helps another person host a program. They share the work and talk with guests. It can also describe performing that role.

examples.en: Studio-grade condenser mics capture crisp, warm, and broadcast-ready vocals.
examples.zh: 專業錄音室等級的電容式麥克風能精準捕捉清晰通透、溫暖醇厚的主播人聲。

examples.en: A condenser mic is extremely sensitive and requires a quiet recording space.
examples.zh: 電容式麥克風極為靈敏，因此需要安靜無雜音的錄音空間。

examples.en: He invested in a quality condenser mic to significantly improve his voiceover clarity.
examples.zh: 他投資買了一支高品質電容麥克風，大幅提升了配音旁白的清晰度。

entries.definition: 電容式麥克風；專業收音麥克風

explains.en: It is a sensitive microphone often used in a recording studio. It captures clear vocals and needs a quiet room. Some models require external power.
A singer or voice actor may use this studio microphone to record detailed sound. It can pick up quiet noises. A stand helps keep it steady.
This professional audio device is designed to capture delicate sounds. Keep it away from loud handling noise. It is useful for podcasts and music.

examples.en: Attach a mesh pop filter to prevent harsh popping noises on 'P' and 'B' sounds.
examples.zh: 在麥克風前安裝雙層防噴罩濾網能有效消除發「P」與「B」爆破音時惱人的噴麥聲。

examples.en: The pop filter is positioned about two inches away from the condenser microphone.
examples.zh: 防噴罩安裝在距離電容麥克風大約兩英吋的位置。

examples.en: Without a pop filter, your vocal recordings may contain distracting bursts of air.
examples.zh: 若沒有使用防噴罩，錄製的人聲可能會夾雜令人分心的氣流爆破音。

explains.en: A mesh screen sits between a singer and a microphone. It reduces bursts of air from sounds like “p” and “b.”
Place this small screen in front of the mic when recording a voice. It helps make the sound clearer.
A thin filter catches strong puffs of breath before they reach the microphone. Keep it close to the speaker.

examples.en: Uplifting acoustic guitar BGM enhances the emotional mood of the travel vlog.
examples.zh: 輕快悠揚的純木吉他背景音樂（BGM）為這支旅遊 Vlog 增添了無比療癒的溫馨氛圍。

examples.en: Make sure the volume of the BGM is low enough so it doesn't drown out the speech.
examples.zh: 請務必確認背景音樂音量適中，避免蓋過講者的講話人聲。

examples.en: She spent hours choosing the perfect BGM to match the lively pace of the video.
examples.zh: 她花了數個小時挑選最合適的背景音樂，以契合影片輕快的剪輯節奏。

explains.en: Soft music played behind a video can create a mood. Keep it quiet enough so viewers hear the speaker.
A creator may choose a lively tune to match a travel clip. This music plays in the background.
A video may have music under the spoken words. It can make a scene feel exciting or calm.

examples.en: Podcasters publish an RSS feed to distribute episodes to Apple and Spotify.
examples.zh: 播客主持人設定好 RSS 節目源，即可將最新單集同步分發至各大主流串流平台。

examples.en: Submit your podcast's RSS feed to directories so listeners can find your show.
examples.zh: 將你的播客節目 RSS 來源提交至各大目錄，聽眾就能搜尋並訂閱你的節目。

examples.en: Whenever you publish a new episode, the RSS feed updates your subscribers automatically.
examples.zh: 每當你發布新單集時，RSS 訂閱源都會自動同步更新給所有訂閱者。

explains.en: This is a file that lets an app receive new posts or episodes from a website automatically. A podcast service can use it to share new shows. It updates when something is published.
A creator provides this digital list to directories so listeners can find each new episode. Subscribers may get updates without checking the website. It helps distribute content.
Use this term for a regularly updated web file that sends new items to a reader or app. It can carry podcast episodes. People can follow it to stay current.

examples.en: High-definition 4K webcams with autofocus ensure razor-sharp video quality.
examples.zh: 配備自動對焦功能的 4K 超高畫質視訊鏡頭能確保直播主在螢幕前隨時展現清晰畫質。

examples.en: She covered her laptop webcam with a sliding sticker for extra privacy protection.
examples.zh: 她用滑蓋貼紙遮住了筆電的視訊鏡頭，以加強保護個人隱私。

examples.en: Make sure your webcam is positioned at eye level for professional video meetings.
examples.zh: 進行專業視訊會議時，請確認視訊鏡頭架設在與視線水平等高的高度。

explains.en: It is a small camera that sends video to a computer or the internet. People use it for video meetings. Place it near eye level.
A laptop may have this camera built into its screen. Some people cover it when they are not using it. High-quality models show a clearer picture.
This device captures live video for online calls or broadcasts. It may sit on top of a monitor. Good lighting helps the picture look clear.

examples.en: Customize your dynamic stream overlay with subscriber alerts and chat boxes.
examples.zh: 精心設計專屬的動態直播圖層框體，整合即時訂閱跳通知特效與側欄聊天室。

examples.en: The graphic artist created an animated overlay with transparent borders for Twitch streamers.
examples.zh: 視覺設計師為 Twitch 實況主打造了帶有半透明邊框的精美動態視窗圖層。

examples.en: A cluttered stream overlay can block important game details on screen.
examples.zh: 過於雜亂擁擠的直播圖層可能會遮擋住螢幕畫面上重要的遊戲細節。

entries.definition: 直播視窗圖層；框體版面

explains.en: A streamer places the chat box and alerts on top of a video image. Keep them away from important game details.
A map appears over the camera picture on a car screen. The added layer gives extra information.
Designers may place transparent text or graphics over a photo. The extra image does not replace the picture beneath it.

examples.en: Chroma key compositing removes the studio green screen background in real time.
examples.zh: 透過先進的即時色鍵綠幕去背扣像技術，能將實況主身後的綠幕完美替換為遊戲場景。

examples.en: Film studios use chroma key effects to place actors into magical fantasy worlds.
examples.zh: 電影製片廠運用色鍵去背特效，將演員無縫置入奇幻的魔法世界之中。

examples.en: Proper studio lighting is crucial to achieve a clean chroma key without green spill.
examples.zh: 專業均勻的棚內燈光是取得乾淨綠幕去背且不產生綠邊溢色的關鍵。

entries.definition: 綠幕去背；色鍵去背扣像

explains.en: Film makers can remove a bright green background and add another image behind an actor. Even lighting helps.
A studio uses this method to place a person in a fantasy world. The background color is replaced later.
Weather presenters may stand before a colored wall while maps appear behind them. This technique combines images.

examples.en: Loyal fans send generous super chats to highlight their questions on screen.
examples.zh: 熱情忠實的鐵粉紛紛發送醒目的付費置頂超級留言（Super Chat）以向實況主提問。

examples.en: The YouTuber expressed sincere gratitude whenever a viewer sent a big super chat.
examples.zh: 每當有觀眾發送大額超級留言時，該 YouTuber 都會表達誠摯的感謝。

examples.en: Sending a colorful super chat guarantees your message will stay pinned on the chat feed.
examples.zh: 發送色彩鮮豔的付費留言能確保你的訊息在聊天室訊息流中維持置頂高亮。

entries.definition: 超級留言；付費置頂打賞 (Super Chat)

explains.en: This is a paid message during a live online broadcast that stands out on the screen. Viewers use it to highlight a question. The host may notice it more easily.
A fan can send money with a colorful message while a creator is streaming. It may stay near the top of the chat. The creator often thanks the sender.
Use this term for a highlighted message that a viewer pays to send during a live show. It can help a question get noticed. The amount is chosen by the viewer.

examples.en: Chat moderators keep the livestream chat friendly by removing spam and trolls.
examples.zh: 盡職的聊天室管理員（房管）隨時巡邏，及時清理洗版廣告並維持良好的互動氛圍。

examples.en: The panel discussion featured a knowledgeable moderator who guided the conversation well.
examples.zh: 該場座談會由一位博學的主持引言人引導，讓對談進行得十分流暢且深入。

examples.en: She was promoted to senior moderator after volunteering on the community forum for two years.
examples.zh: 她在社群論壇擔任志工兩年後，被拔擢為資深討論區管理員。

entries.definition: 聊天室管理員 (Mod / 房管)；公道人

explains.en: It is a person who guides a discussion or keeps an online community respectful. They may remove spam from a livestream. A panel discussion also needs one.
A host can give each speaker a turn and keep a conversation on topic. In a forum, this person enforces rules. They may handle unwanted posts.
Someone in this role leads a group conversation. They can ask questions and manage time. Online, they help keep messages appropriate.

examples.en: Optimizing the video title and cover boosted average CTR from 4% to 9%.
examples.zh: 重新微調優化影片標題與吸睛封面縮圖後，成功將平均點閱率（CTR）由 4% 推升至 9%。

examples.en: Digital marketers track CTR closely to measure how effectively ads attract clicks.
examples.zh: 數位行銷人員密切追蹤點閱率，藉此評估廣告吸引點擊的成效好壞。

examples.en: An engaging subject line can significantly increase your email campaign CTR.
examples.zh: 吸引人的電子郵件主旨能顯著提高行銷信件的點閱率與轉換率。

entries.definition: 點閱率；點擊轉化率 (Click-Through Rate)

explains.en: An email is sent to many readers, and some click its link. This percentage helps show whether the subject line works.
An online ad is shown many times, but only some viewers open it. Marketers compare the clicks with the views.
A video maker tests two cover pictures to see which one gets more viewers to open the video. The result is measured as a percentage.

examples.en: End every educational short with a clear CTA urging viewers to leave thoughts.
examples.zh: 在每支知識型短影音片尾皆加上清晰明確的行動呼籲（CTA），引導粉絲在底下留言。

examples.en: A well-designed website should place its primary CTA button above the fold.
examples.zh: 設計精良的網頁應該將最關鍵的行動呼籲按鈕置於首屏醒目位置。

examples.en: His video concluded with a friendly CTA reminding viewers to like and subscribe.
examples.zh: 他的影片結尾附上親切的行動呼籲，提醒觀眾順手按讚並訂閱頻道。

entries.definition: 行動呼籲 (Call To Action；如按讚訂閱)

explains.en: A website button may ask visitors to sign up or learn more. This short prompt encourages a next step.
A video maker may invite viewers to like or subscribe at the end. The request should be clear.
A page can guide a visitor with a button placed near the top. This message tells people what action to take.

examples.en: Independent board game designers successfully launched their game via crowdfunding.
examples.zh: 獨立桌遊研發團隊透過在群眾募資平台發起預購專案，成功募集了首批全額量產資金。

examples.en: Crowdfunding empowers creative inventors to raise initial production funds directly from public backers.
examples.zh: 群眾集資平台讓富有創意的發明家能直接向大眾支持者募集產品初期的量產資金。

examples.en: Their environmental documentary campaign reached its crowdfunding goal within just forty-eight hours.
examples.zh: 他們的環保紀錄片募款專案在短短四十八小時之內便順利達成了預設的群募目標金額。

examples.en: A successful crowdfunding campaign raised two million dollars to restore the dilapidated Japanese dormitory.
examples.zh: 一場打動人心的線上群眾募資專案在一個月內募得兩百萬元，成功將荒廢的日式木造老宿舍活化修復。

examples.en: Cultural heritage teams turn to online crowdfunding to bypass slow municipal bureaucratic funding cycles.
examples.zh: 文資搶救團隊往往透過公開網路群眾募資平台發起倡議，突破政府公共預算冗長緩慢的行政審核程序。

examples.en: Enthusiastic backers received miniature engraved roof tiles as commemorative rewards for their crowdfunding support.
examples.zh: 每一位出資贊助老屋修復的熱血網友，皆獲得了一塊以老屋原拆紅瓦精心雷射雕刻的手工紀念磚瓦回饋禮。

entries.definition: 群眾募資；群眾集資；群眾募資平台支持創生；眾籌

explains.en: This is collecting small amounts of money from many people online to support a project. A game designer may use it to pay for production. Backers may receive a reward.
An inventor can ask the public to contribute toward making a new product. The campaign has a goal and a time limit. Many people each give a little.
Use this noun for raising money from a large group, often through a website. A documentary team may use it to pay for filming. Supporters can follow its progress.

examples.en: Always use licensed royalty-free music in monetized commercial video projects.
examples.zh: 在所有涉及商業營利變現的影片專案中，請務必使用合法授權的免版稅公播音樂。

examples.en: She sourced high-resolution royalty-free photos from a stock photography library.
examples.zh: 她從專業圖庫網站中下載了多張高解析度免版稅商用圖檔作為設計素材。

examples.en: Paying once for royalty-free audio tracks lets you use them in multiple video productions.
examples.zh: 購買一次免版稅音效音軌授權，就能讓你在後續多支影片製作中重複安心使用。

entries.definition: 免版稅的；無版權限制公播的

explains.en: It describes music or pictures that can be used after paying a fee or meeting a license rule, without paying each time. Check the license before using them commercially.
A creator may pay once to use an audio track in several videos. The term does not always mean free of charge. Read the permissions carefully.
These images or sounds can be used under a license without repeated payments to the owner. A business video still needs proper rights. Check any restrictions.

examples.en: Multi-camera setups allow seamless switching between close-ups and wide shots.
examples.zh: 多機位拍攝配置能讓導播在主持人大特寫與全景鏡頭之間行雲流水般即時無縫切換。

examples.en: The television talk show relies on a multi-camera production system to capture reactions.
examples.zh: 這檔電視談話性娛樂節目仰賴多機位攝影系統，即時捕捉每位來賓細微的面部反應。

examples.en: Setting up a multi-camera live broadcast requires careful cable management and video switchers.
examples.zh: 架設多鏡頭多機位的現場即時直播，需要井然有序的線路整理與多訊號導播切換器。

entries.definition: 多機位的；多鏡頭切換的

explains.en: A concert is filmed by several cameras from different places. An editor can switch between close views and the whole stage.
A talk show uses more than one camera to record the host and guests. This helps show their reactions.
A live program needs careful planning so different camera angles can be changed smoothly. The production uses several cameras.

examples.en: Set an optimal video bitrate to ensure silky-smooth livestream playback.
examples.zh: 設定適當且充足的影像傳輸位元率（Bitrate）以確保直播畫面流暢無卡頓與馬賽克。

examples.en: A higher audio bitrate results in clearer sound but consumes significantly more bandwidth.
examples.zh: 較高的音訊位元率能帶來更細膩豐富的高音質，但同時也會耗費更多傳輸頻寬。

examples.en: If your video looks pixelated during action scenes, try increasing the recording bitrate.
examples.zh: 如果你的影片在快速移動動作場景時出現模糊馬賽克，請嘗試拉高錄製的編碼位元率。

explains.en: A video file sends a certain amount of information each second. A higher amount can make the picture clearer.
Clearer sound may use more internet data. This measurement describes how much information moves in a second.
If a moving scene looks blocky, a recording setting may need adjustment. This term refers to its data flow rate.

examples.en: Fast optical broadband eliminates annoying video buffering circles completely.
examples.zh: 申辦極速光纖寬頻網路能徹底告別在線上追劇看片時惱人轉圈圈的影片緩衝等待。

examples.en: The stream stopped momentarily due to constant buffering caused by poor Wi-Fi reception.
examples.zh: 由於 Wi-Fi 訊號微弱接收不良導致頻繁緩衝載入，網路直播畫面一度中斷停擺。

examples.en: Lower the video streaming quality to 720p if you experience excessive buffering.
examples.zh: 若在播放過程中遇到嚴重頻繁的緩衝延遲轉圈，建議將影片畫質調降至 720p。

explains.en: This is a delay that happens when an online video pauses while more information loads. A slow Wi-Fi connection can cause it. Lowering the picture quality may help.
When a stream keeps stopping, a circle may appear on the screen. The device is collecting enough data to continue. Faster internet can reduce the wait.
Use this noun for the wait while a video or song loads. It can interrupt viewing. Better reception or a lower quality setting may make it less frequent.

examples.en: Professional audio mastering balances volume levels across all podcast platforms.
examples.zh: 專業的音訊母帶後期處理能精準平衡音量響度，確保在各大耳機上皆有最佳聆聽體驗。

examples.en: Mastering a foreign language requires consistent daily practice and cultural immersion.
examples.zh: 精通掌握一門外語需要持之以恆的每日練習與深度的文化沉浸。

examples.en: The album is currently in the final mastering stage and will be released next Friday.
examples.zh: 這張全新概念音樂專輯目前已進入最後的母帶後期製作工序，預計下週五正式發行。

examples.en: Final album mastering optimizes tonal balance and matches global streaming loudness standards.
examples.zh: 專輯發行前的母帶後期處理，全面優化整體音色平衡並對齊各大串流平台的標準響度規範。

examples.en: Mastering a difficult foreign language requires daily immersive listening practice and conversational courage.
examples.zh: 想要徹底精通掌握一門艱深的外語，需要持之以恆的每日沉浸式聽力輸入與敢於開口對話的勇氣。

examples.en: Renowned mastering engineers use ultra-transparent analog outboard gear to add polish to recorded mixes.
examples.zh: 享譽業界的母帶後期工程大師運用極致純淨通透的頂級類比外接硬體設備，為錄音混音作品錦上添花。

entries.definition: 音訊母帶後期處理；精通；母帶後期處理 (平衡響度與音色)
