explains.en: In audio production, it is the final process of balancing volume and tone across songs. It helps an album sound consistent. An engineer checks different speakers.
Before an album is released, a specialist adjusts the final sound. This makes tracks play smoothly together. The word can also mean becoming very skilled at a language.
A sound engineer prepares recorded music for release by polishing its overall level and clarity. In another use, people speak of gaining complete command of a skill.

examples.en: Accurate subtitle syncing ensures captions match the speaker's vocal timing.
examples.zh: 精準無誤的字幕同步對齊工法能確保中文字幕與講者的語音發音節奏毫無秒差完全吻合。

examples.en: Cloud syncing keeps all your notes and documents up to date across all devices.
examples.zh: 雲端資料同步功能可確保你在手機與電腦等所有個人裝置上的筆記與文件始終保持最新狀態。

examples.en: He spent hours syncing the multi-camera footage before starting the video edit.
examples.zh: 他在正式開始剪輯影片之前，花了數個小時校準並對齊各個不同機位的拍攝素材。

explains.en: The captions appear at the same time as the speaker’s words. Check the timing before sharing the video.
Notes saved on a phone also appear on a laptop after the devices connect. This keeps the files up to date.
A video editor lines up images from several cameras before cutting the scenes together. The timing needs to match.

examples.en: Dominating a passionate niche audience is better than pleasing everyone mildly.
examples.zh: 牢牢深耕並主導一個充滿熱情忠誠度的小眾利基族群，遠勝過面面俱到卻平庸無奇。

examples.en: The boutique café found its profitable niche by serving artisanal single-origin pour-overs.
examples.zh: 這家質感精品咖啡館主打職人手沖單一產區精品豆，成功開闢出利基市場。

examples.en: After experimenting with various careers, she finally found her niche in educational software.
examples.zh: 在嘗試過各行各業之後，她終於在教育科技軟體研發領域找到了最適合發揮的定位。

entries.definition: 利基市場；小眾特定的；合適的定位

explains.en: A small group of customers may be interested in a special product. A shop can focus on serving them well.
A person may find the kind of work that suits their talents. This word can describe that good position.
A market may be made for a specific group instead of everyone. The word can also describe something specialized.

examples.en: Motion-tracked anime avatars bring virtual YouTubers (VTubers) vividly alive.
examples.zh: 透過先進的面部與動態捕捉技術，二次元動漫造型的虛擬實況主（VTuber）活靈活現。

examples.en: That popular VTuber celebrated reaching one million subscribers during a five-hour live concert.
examples.zh: 該知名人氣 VTuber 在長達五小時的個人虛擬線上演唱會中慶祝頻道突破百萬訂閱大關。

examples.en: VTubers combine expressive voice acting with real-time facial capture technology.
examples.zh: 虛擬實況主巧妙結合了生動多變的聲優配音演出與即時精準的面部表情捕捉科技。

entries.definition: 虛擬實況主；虛擬偶像 (Virtual YouTuber)

explains.en: This online performer uses a digital animated character to appear in videos or live shows. The character may move when the person speaks. Fans can watch and send messages.
A creator's face and body movements can control an illustrated avatar. The performer may sing or chat during a broadcast. Some have millions of followers.
Use this word for a video creator who appears as a virtual character. Special tracking technology copies their expressions. They can host concerts or talk to viewers.

examples.en: Independent podcasting grants full creative freedom without corporate interference.
examples.zh: 獨立自主製作播客節目賦予了創作者全然無拘無束、不受商業贊助干預的極致創作自由。

examples.en: The director chose an indie studio because it offered complete creative freedom over the script.
examples.zh: 這位鬼才導演選擇加盟獨立製片廠，是因為對方願意賦予他對電影劇本百分之百的創作自由。

examples.en: Having the creative freedom to explore innovative ideas makes the project deeply rewarding.
examples.zh: 能夠享有毫無束縛的創作自由去探索創新大膽的點子，讓整個專案過程充滿滿滿成就感。

entries.definition: 創作自由；無拘無束的藝術表達

explains.en: It is the ability to make artistic choices without too many restrictions. An independent studio may let a director shape a script. This can encourage new ideas.
A creator may choose a style or topic without corporate control. This independence can make a project rewarding. It still helps to plan the work.
Artists may feel free to explore unusual ideas. A podcast producer can choose the format and stories. This freedom supports original expression.

examples.en: Dogs and cats are beloved companion animals treated as true family members.
examples.zh: 狗狗與貓咪是全家無比疼愛的伴侶動物，被視為家中不可或缺的真家人。

examples.en: Studies show that living with a companion animal can lower blood pressure and reduce stress.
examples.zh: 研究顯示，與伴侶動物共同生活能有效降低血壓並減輕心理壓力。

examples.en: The housing association voted to allow residents to keep certified companion animals.
examples.zh: 社區管委會投票通過允許住戶在公寓大樓內飼養合格登記的伴侶動物。

explains.en: A family dog lives indoors and shares daily life with its people. The animal provides companionship.
A cat can be a loved member of the household. Owners should provide food, care, and a safe home.
Some people keep rabbits or birds as pets and form close bonds with them. These animals live with people for companionship.

examples.en: Implanting an ISO microchip ensures lost pets can be scanned and returned home.
examples.zh: 依法為毛孩植入國際標準微晶片並完成寵物登記，能確保走失時被順利掃描尋回。

examples.en: The animal shelter scans every stray animal for a microchip to locate its owner.
examples.zh: 收容所會為每一隻進所的流浪動物掃描體內微晶片，以期儘快聯繫上失主。

examples.en: Getting your dog a microchip is a quick and relatively painless procedure.
examples.zh: 帶狗狗前往動物醫院植入微晶片是一項快速且近乎無痛的微創注射程序。

examples.en: Implanting a tiny RFID microchip under the scruff ensures lost pets return home safely.
examples.zh: 在毛孩頸部皮下植入米粒大小的 RFID 寵物身分晶片，能確保走失毛孩被掃描後平安返家。

examples.en: The vet scanned the stray cat's microchip and instantly located the registered owner's phone number.
examples.zh: 獸醫掃描了這隻流浪貓的晶片，立刻查到了登記飼主的電話號碼。

examples.en: Updating your contact information in the national pet registry is essential after moving to a new address.
examples.zh: 搬到新地址後，務必記得在全國寵物登記管理系統更新您的聯絡資訊。

entries.definition: 寵物晶片；植入微晶片登記；寵物晶片植入；微晶片

explains.en: A tiny electronic tag can be placed under a pet's skin. A shelter can scan it to find the owner.
This small electronic part stores or processes information. It may also help reunite a lost dog with its family.
A veterinarian can place a small identification device under a dog's skin. Keep the registration details current.

examples.en: Neutering male cats prevents territorial spraying and reduces stray overpopulation.
examples.zh: 及時為公貓安排結紮絕育手術能有效改善亂噴尿標記地盤習性並減少浪貓過度繁衍。

examples.en: Animal welfare organizations encourage owners to neuter their pets at an early age.
examples.zh: 各大動保倡議團體積極鼓勵飼主在適當時機儘早為自家寵物辦理絕育結紮。

examples.en: The male dog recovered quickly after being neutered at the veterinary clinic.
examples.zh: 這隻公狗在獸醫診所順利完成結紮手術後，短短幾天內就精神奕奕地康復了。

examples.en: Neutering male dogs significantly reduces roaming urges and aggressive territorial behaviors.
examples.zh: 替公犬適時安排結紮手術能大幅降低發情期離家出走衝動與強烈護地盤等攻擊焦慮行為。

examples.en: The animal welfare association runs subsidized programs to neuter community stray animals.
examples.zh: 動保協會推動補助專案，協助替社區街貓與流浪動物進行結紮。

examples.en: Most veterinarians recommend neutering young puppies once they reach six months of age.
examples.zh: 多數獸醫師建議幼犬滿六個月大時便可評估安排絕育手術。

entries.definition: 結紮（尤指公畜）；去勢；寵物結紮絕育手術；閹割

explains.en: A veterinarian does this operation to prevent an animal from having babies. It can reduce some behaviors in male pets. The animal needs time to recover.
Pet owners may choose this procedure for a young male dog or cat. It helps prevent unwanted litters. Animal groups sometimes offer it at a lower cost.
This verb describes a veterinary operation that stops a male animal from reproducing. It can help control the number of stray animals. Ask a vet about care afterward.

examples.en: Spaying female puppies before their first heat cycle protects against uterine infections.
examples.zh: 在母幼犬第一次發情前完成絕育母畜結紮手術，能大幅降低日後子宮蓄膿的風險。

examples.en: The vet clinic offered a discounted spay and neuter program for community cats.
examples.zh: 這家獸醫診所推出了針對社區浪貓的優惠結紮與母畜絕育公益專案。

examples.en: After being spayed, the young dog needed several days of quiet rest to heal her stitches.
examples.zh: 接受母犬絕育手術之後，這隻年輕小狗需要幾天安靜休養以使腹部縫線順利癒合。

examples.en: Spaying female cats before their first heat cycle eliminates risks of pyometra.
examples.zh: 在母貓第一次發情前完成絕育手術（Spay），能徹底杜絕日後致命子宮蓄膿與乳腺腫瘤風險。

examples.en: She booked an appointment to spay her puppy as part of responsible pet ownership.
examples.zh: 她為自家母幼犬預約了結紮手術，落實負責任飼主的基本義務。

examples.en: Recovery from spay surgery usually takes about ten to fourteen days of quiet rest.
examples.zh: 母犬絕育手術後的傷口復原通常需要約十至十四天的靜養休護。

entries.definition: 絕育（尤指母畜卵巢切除）；母犬貓子宮卵巢摘除絕育手術

explains.en: It is a surgery that prevents a female animal from having babies. A veterinarian performs it. The pet needs quiet rest while healing.
A clinic may perform this operation on a female dog or cat. It can prevent unwanted litters and some health problems. Follow the vet's care instructions.
This medical procedure removes reproductive organs from a female pet. Afterward, she may need several days to recover. A veterinarian can explain the benefits and risks.

examples.en: Regular puppy deworming eliminates dangerous intestinal parasites completely.
examples.zh: 定期落實幼犬體內外驅蟲療程能徹底清除潛在致命的消化道線蟲等寄生蟲。

examples.en: The rescue kitten underwent deworming treatment to ensure healthy weight gain.
examples.zh: 剛被救援回來的流浪小貓接受了體內驅蟲治療，以確保能健康增重發育。

examples.en: Ask your vet about the proper deworming schedule for outdoor cats.
examples.zh: 請向你的家庭獸醫師諮詢適合經常在戶外活動的貓咪的定期驅蟲排程。

explains.en: A veterinarian may check a puppy for worms and recommend suitable care. Ask the vet how often treatment is needed.
A rescue kitten receives a health check before joining a family. The clinic may discuss ways to prevent parasites.
This care helps remove certain parasites from an animal’s body. A veterinarian can choose what is appropriate for the pet.

examples.en: Ticks and fleas are external parasites that transmit blood-borne diseases.
examples.zh: 壁蝨與跳蚤是常見的體外寄生蟲，極易在草地上叮咬毛孩並傳播血液傳染病。

examples.en: Preventive topical medication stops dangerous parasites from nesting in your dog's coat.
examples.zh: 定期點滴預防性體外驅蟲滴劑，能杜絕惱人的寄生蟲寄生於愛犬濃密的毛髮間。

examples.en: Intestinal parasites can rob growing puppies of essential nutrients and vitamins.
examples.zh: 腸道內的體內寄生蟲會掠奪發育中幼犬所需的重要營養與維生素。

examples.en: External parasites like ticks can transmit dangerous blood-borne infections to puppies.
examples.zh: 躲藏在草叢中的壁蝨等體外寄生蟲叮咬可能會將危險的艾利希體與焦蟲症傳染給活潑幼犬。

examples.en: Intestinal parasites can lead to severe malnutrition and weight loss in young rescue kittens.
examples.zh: 體內腸道寄生蟲可能導致剛獲救的幼貓嚴重營養不良與消瘦脫水。

examples.en: Microscopic stool examinations help identify invisible parasite eggs residing in the gut.
examples.zh: 透過顯微鏡進行糞便檢查，有助於查明潛伏在腸道中的肉眼難見寄生蟲卵。

examples.en: Freshwater dips and microscopic smear checks eliminate external skin parasites from wild-collected specimens.
examples.zh: 進行短暫淡水浴與顯微抹片檢查，能徹底清除野生引進個體體表與鰓部潛在的「微小寄生蟲」（Parasites）。

examples.en: Ticks and fleas are common external parasites that irritate household dogs and transmit blood infections.
examples.zh: 壁蝨與跳蚤是常見的體表外寄生蟲，不僅會引發家犬皮膚搔癢紅腫，更容易傳播萊姆病等血液傳染病。

examples.en: The selfish relative acted like a social parasite, refusing to work while living off his family’s savings.
examples.zh: 這名遊手好閒的親戚宛如社會寄生蟲般，長年不願踏實工作，只會一味榨取揮霍長輩辛苦積攢的養老金。

entries.definition: 寄生蟲；寄生動物；顯微鏡鰓部與皮膚微小體外寄生蟲精密篩檢

explains.en: A tick can live on a dog and take blood from it. This kind of organism can spread disease.
A tiny living thing may use another animal for food and shelter. It can take nutrients from a puppy.
A vet can check a pet for fleas or ticks. Some of these organisms live on or inside another creature.

examples.en: Administering monthly heartworm chewables prevents mosquito-transmitted worm larvae.
examples.zh: 每個月準時給予一顆肉塊狀心絲蟲預防藥，能徹底阻斷蚊子叮咬所傳播的幼蟲。

examples.en: Heartworm is a potentially fatal condition that severely damages canine hearts and lungs.
examples.zh: 犬心絲蟲症是一種可能致命的嚴重疾病，會對犬隻的心臟與肺動脈造成不可逆損害。

examples.en: Blood tests are conducted annually to ensure the dog is heartworm-free before refilling medication.
examples.zh: 每年在領取新一季預防藥之前，獸醫都會先抽取血液篩檢查驗是否感染心絲蟲。

examples.en: Mosquito-borne heartworm larvae migrate to pulmonary arteries, causing severe heart failure.
examples.zh: 經由蚊子叮咬傳播的心絲蟲幼蟲會寄生於毛孩肺動脈與右心室，造成極度嚴重的呼吸心衰竭。

examples.en: Treating an established heartworm infection is both costly and physically taxing on canine patients.
examples.zh: 治療已感染的心絲蟲病不僅費用高昂，對狗狗的身體負擔也極其沉重。

examples.en: Because mosquitoes are active year-round in subtropical climates, heartworm prevention cannot be skipped.
examples.zh: 由於亞熱帶氣候蚊子終年活躍，每月預防心絲蟲的投藥絕不能有一絲中斷。

entries.definition: 犬心絲蟲；心絲蟲症；犬貓心絲蟲（蚊子叮咬傳播）

explains.en: This is a parasite spread by mosquitoes that can seriously harm a dog's heart and lungs. A veterinarian can test for it. Preventive medicine helps protect pets.
Dogs can become sick when tiny worms grow inside their bodies after a mosquito bite. Regular checks and prevention are important. Treatment can be difficult.
Use this word for a serious worm infection in pets. Mosquitoes can carry the young parasites. A vet may recommend regular prevention.

examples.en: Choose premium grain-free kibble formulated with real deboned salmon.
examples.zh: 挑選以新鮮去骨純鮭魚肉為首要成分、無添加穀物的高品質特級寵物乾飼料。

examples.en: She poured a measured scoop of crunchy kibble into the stainless steel bowl.
examples.zh: 她用定量量匙舀了一勺香脆的顆粒乾飼料，倒入不鏽鋼寵物食盆中。

examples.en: Storing dry kibble in an airtight container keeps it crisp and preserves its freshness.
examples.zh: 將寵物乾糧妥善密封存放在防潮保鮮桶中，能保持乾糧酥脆並鎖住天然鮮度。

examples.en: Grain-free salmon kibble supports healthy skin and a shiny lustrous fur coat.
examples.zh: 添加深海鮭魚油的低敏無穀鮮肉乾飼料（Kibble），能有效改善皮膚敏感並使毛髮柔順亮麗。

examples.en: Mixing warm water or bone broth into dry kibble encourages fussy eaters to finish their meals.
examples.zh: 在乾燥乾糧中拌入少許溫水或天然熬煮骨高湯，能引發挑嘴毛孩旺盛的食慾。

examples.en: Seal the open bag of kibble tightly in an airtight container to preserve freshness and crunchiness.
examples.zh: 將開封後的乾飼料妥善封存在密封儲糧桶中，以維持新鮮香脆度並防潮變質。

explains.en: It is dry food made in small pieces for pets. Pour a measured amount into a bowl. Keep it in an airtight container to stay fresh.
Dogs or cats may eat these crunchy pellets each day. Different recipes suit different ages and needs. Ask a vet about a pet's diet.
This kind of pet food is dry and easy to store. It can contain meat, grains, or other nutrients. Close the bag or container after use.

examples.en: Some dog owners prefer a balanced raw diet rich in natural vitamins and enzymes.
examples.zh: 部分專業毛爸媽崇尚富含天然鮮肉維生素與活性酵素的均衡低溫殺菌生肉飲食（BARF）。

examples.en: Preparing a safe raw diet requires careful hygiene and balanced nutritional formulas.
examples.zh: 自製安全的寵物生肉飲食需要極度講究食材保鮮衛生與均衡的營養配比。

examples.en: Consult a veterinary nutritionist before switching your adult pet to a raw diet.
examples.zh: 在決定將成年毛孩全面換成生肉生食餐單之前，建議先諮詢專業寵物營養師。

explains.en: Some pet owners feed uncooked meat and other ingredients to their dogs. Talk with a veterinarian about nutrition and food safety first.
A person prepares unheated food for a pet instead of using cooked meals. Proper handling is important to reduce health risks.
This feeding choice uses uncooked ingredients for an animal. A veterinary professional can help assess whether the food is balanced.

examples.en: Mixing pet probiotics into meals improves digestion and firms loose stools.
examples.zh: 在罐頭正餐中適量拌入犬貓專用寵物益生菌粉能顯著改善腸胃吸收並改善軟便。

examples.en: The vet recommended daily probiotics to restore healthy gut flora after antibiotic treatment.
examples.zh: 獸醫師建議在抗生素療程結束後每日補充寵物專用益生菌，以重建腸道健康菌群。

examples.en: High-potency probiotics can boost the immune system of senior dogs and cats.
examples.zh: 高活性益生菌配方有助於提升高齡老犬與老貓的腸胃防禦力與整體免疫機能。

entries.definition: 益生菌；腸胃道保健菌群

explains.en: These helpful bacteria may support digestion in people or pets. A vet might recommend them after medicine.
Some pet owners add these tiny living organisms to food. They can support a healthy gut.
A doctor or veterinarian may suggest a supplement to support digestion. It contains friendly bacteria.

examples.en: Regular professional pet grooming keeps long-haired dogs smelling fresh and clean.
examples.zh: 定期帶長毛犬至專業寵物美容沙龍進行洗澡修毛與大修，能常保毛髮蓬鬆清香。

examples.en: Routine grooming sessions help detect skin issues, lumps, and fleas early.
examples.zh: 定期細心的寵物日常美容護理有助於及早察覺皮膚紅疹、異常腫塊或跳蚤寄生。

examples.en: Professional grooming involves bathing, blow-drying, ear cleaning, and hair trimming.
examples.zh: 專業寵物美容服務涵蓋溫水洗沐、吹乾拉毛、深層清耳與精緻毛髮修剪。

entries.definition: 寵物美容洗澡；毛髮修剪護理

explains.en: This is cleaning and caring for an animal's coat, ears, and nails. A professional may bathe and trim a dog. Regular checks can spot skin problems.
A pet may visit a worker who washes, dries, and brushes its fur. This care keeps the animal clean. It can help find fleas or lumps early.
Use this noun for taking care of an animal's appearance and hygiene. It can include a bath and a trim. Cats and dogs may both receive it.

examples.en: The certified pet groomer skillfully trimmed the poodle's fluffy coat into a teddy bear shape.
examples.zh: 擁有專業證照的資深寵物美容師熟練地將貴賓犬蓬鬆的毛髮修剪成可愛的泰迪熊造型。

examples.en: A patient pet groomer knows how to calm down anxious dogs during the bath.
examples.zh: 耐心十足的專業寵物美容師懂得運用溫柔技巧，安撫在洗澡過程中焦慮緊張的狗狗。

examples.en: We booked an appointment with our favorite mobile groomer for next Tuesday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們向深受好評的預約制行動寵物到府美容師敲定了下週二下午的洗剪檔期。

examples.en: The certified pet groomer skillfully trimmed the poodle's fluffy coat into a stylish teddy bear cut.
examples.zh: 技術純熟的專業寵物美容師以俐落剪刀手藝，將貴賓犬蓬鬆的毛髮修剪成超萌的日系泰迪熊造型。

examples.en: A patient groomer knows how to desensitize nervous rescue animals to noisy blow dryers.
examples.zh: 有耐心的美容師懂得如何運用減敏技巧，安撫對巨大吹風機噪音感到恐慌的毛孩。

examples.en: Make appointments with your regular groomer well in advance before major holiday seasons.
examples.zh: 在過年農曆春節等熱門連假前夕，務必提早數週向熟悉的常去美容師預約洗剪檔期。

entries.definition: 寵物美容師；專業寵物美容師；整理毛髮者

explains.en: It is a person who washes, trims, and cares for an animal's coat. A poodle may need a regular haircut. A patient worker helps nervous dogs feel calm.
Pet owners may book this professional to bathe and brush a dog. They can trim nails and shape fur. Some travel to a customer's home.
Someone in this job keeps pets clean and comfortable. They may use clippers and brushes. Gentle handling is important during the bath.

examples.en: Careful nail clipping avoids cutting the sensitive pink blood vein (the quick).
examples.zh: 在替狗狗修剪指甲時務必格外小心，避免剪到指甲深處敏感且微細的血管神經（快線）。

examples.en: Regular nail clipping prevents your dog's paws from slipping on hardwood floors.
examples.zh: 定期修剪過長的腳指甲，能防止毛孩在光滑的木地板上打滑甚至傷及關節。

examples.en: If nail clipping makes your pet nervous, try giving tiny treats after each claw.
examples.zh: 如果剪指甲讓你的寵物感到焦躁不安，不妨每剪完一隻指甲就賞給牠一小塊肉乾零食。

explains.en: Trim a dog’s claws carefully so they do not grow too long. Stop if the animal seems frightened.
A groomer uses a small tool to shorten a pet’s nails. Treats can make the process calmer.
Some pets need help keeping their claws at a safe length. Ask a vet or groomer to show you how.

examples.en: Stainless steel deshedding brushes remove dense dead undercoat during spring.
examples.zh: 在春季換毛期使用不銹鋼寵物專用除毛梳，能輕鬆梳理出深層死毛與大量廢毛。

examples.en: An intensive deshedding treatment at the salon reduced floating fur all over our house.
examples.zh: 在寵物美容沙龍進行深層除廢毛大工程後，家中四處飄散的漫天毛絮大幅減少。

examples.en: Regular deshedding keeps double-coated dogs cool and comfortable throughout humid summers.
examples.zh: 定期替雙層毛犬種梳理深層廢毛，能讓牠們在炎熱潮濕的夏季裡倍感涼爽透氣。

explains.en: A brush can remove loose fur from a dog, especially in spring. It helps keep the coat comfortable.
Regular salon care can reduce fur around the house. A special tool removes the thick undercoat.
Dogs with two layers of fur may need extra brushing in warm weather. This grooming step removes loose hair.

examples.en: Scoop the clumping cat litter box twice daily to keep felines happy.
examples.zh: 養成早晚各清理鏟除一次凝結貓砂盆的良好習慣，能讓愛乾淨的貓咪心情愉悅。

examples.en: Place the litter box in a quiet and easily accessible corner of the apartment.
examples.zh: 請將貓砂盆放置於公寓內安靜無噪音且便於貓咪隨時進出走動的通風角落。

examples.en: If a cat suddenly stops using its litter box, it may be signaling a urinary tract infection.
examples.zh: 若貓咪突然無預警地拒絕在貓砂盆內上廁所，往往可能是下泌尿道感染的警訊。

explains.en: This is a tray filled with special material where a cat can go to the toilet indoors. It should be kept clean. A quiet, easy-to-reach place works well.
A cat may use this container when it cannot go outside. Owners scoop it regularly. If a cat stops using it, the animal may need a vet check.
Use this phrase for the indoor toilet provided for a cat. It holds litter that absorbs waste. Put it in a calm place the cat can reach.

examples.en: Providing sturdy sisal scratching posts protects your leather sofas from sharp claws.
examples.zh: 在客廳多擺放幾組耐磨結實的天然劍麻繩貓抓板柱，能保護昂貴的真皮沙發免遭利爪破壞。

examples.en: Cats naturally use a scratching post to shed old claw sheaths and mark territory.
examples.zh: 貓咪抓磨貓抓板是為了磨去老舊指甲外殼並藉由肉墊氣味標記個人地盤。

examples.en: Make sure the vertical scratching post is tall enough for your cat to stretch fully.
examples.zh: 請確保直立式貓抓柱的高度足夠讓成貓在站立伸展筋骨時能完全舒展身軀。

explains.en: It is a tall or flat surface that lets a cat sharpen its claws. Sisal rope is a common covering. It can protect a sofa from damage.
Cats stretch and scratch on this pet item to remove old claw layers. Choose one tall enough for the animal to extend fully. A sturdy base helps.
A cat may use this object to mark its territory and care for its claws. It can be vertical or horizontal. Place it near a favorite resting spot.

examples.en: Rubbing organic dried catnip on toys makes energetic cats roll around in bliss.
examples.zh: 在玩偶抱枕上撒上一小撮天然有機乾燥貓薄荷碎葉，會讓興奮的貓咪幸福得在地上打滾。

examples.en: Not all cats respond to catnip, as sensitivity to the plant is inherited genetically.
examples.zh: 並非所有貓咪都對貓薄荷有興奮反應，因為對這種植物的敏感度是由基因遺傳決定的。

examples.en: She bought a plush mouse filled with organic catnip to entertain her bored indoor cat.
examples.zh: 她買了一隻裡面塞滿天然有機貓薄荷的絨毛小老鼠，用來陪伴無聊的室內家貓玩耍。

explains.en: This fragrant plant can make some cats roll or rub against a toy. Not every cat reacts to it.
A cloth mouse may be stuffed with dried leaves from this plant. A cat may bat it around.
Some cats enjoy the smell of a herb used in toys. Keep the plant or toy where your pet cannot eat too much.

examples.en: Always keep your energetic dog on a secure leash when walking near busy roads.
examples.zh: 在車水馬龍的馬路邊遛狗散步時，請務必隨時牢牢繫好安全牽繩以防驚嚇爆衝。

examples.en: Many national parks require all visiting pets to remain on a sturdy six-foot leash.
examples.zh: 許多國家公園明文規定所有進入園區的毛孩必須全程繫上不超過六英尺的牽繩。

examples.en: She attached the leather leash to the collar before opening the front door.
examples.zh: 在轉動門把開門走出家門之前，她熟練地將真皮牽引繩扣緊在狗狗項圈上。

examples.en: Always keep dogs on a sturdy leash when walking through busy urban traffic intersections.
examples.zh: 牽著毛孩漫步於車水馬龍的市區十字路口時，請務必隨時牢牢繫上強韌防斷的遛狗牽繩。

examples.en: A non-slip hands-free leash attaches comfortably around your waist for morning jogging.
examples.zh: 多功能防滑免手持牽引繩可舒適環繞繫於飼主腰間，非常適合晨間晨跑慢跑。

examples.en: Retractable leashes should be used with caution in crowded public areas to prevent tripping hazards.
examples.zh: 在人潮擁擠的公共場所使用伸縮牽繩需格外謹慎，以防纏繞行人造成絆倒危險。

entries.definition: 牽繩；狗繩；用牽繩繫住；牽狗繩；繫住

explains.en: Attach this strap to a dog’s collar before walking near a road. Hold the other end firmly.
Many parks ask pet owners to keep their dogs connected to a lead. A sturdy one helps keep the animal safe.
This strap lets a person guide a dog during a walk. It can also be used as a verb for connecting the strap.

examples.en: Fenced municipal dog parks allow pups to sprint freely and socialize safely off-leash.
examples.zh: 設有雙層安全門禁圍籬的市立狗狗專屬運動公園讓愛犬能在草地上盡情奔跑社交放電。

examples.en: We visit the local dog park every Saturday morning so our puppy can play with friends.
examples.zh: 我們每逢週六早晨都會帶毛孩造訪社區狗狗公園，讓小狗能與其他狗同伴開心玩樂。

examples.en: The new dog park includes separate fenced play areas for large and small dogs.
examples.zh: 這座新建的狗狗運動公園貼心規劃了大型犬與小型犬專屬的獨立圍籬草皮活動專區。

entries.definition: 狗狗專屬運動公園；毛孩樂園

explains.en: This is a fenced outdoor area where dogs can run and play off leash. Owners may bring their pets to meet others. Some places have separate areas for large and small animals.
A person can take a puppy here to play safely with other dogs. The fence keeps pets inside. It is a good place for exercise and socializing.
Use this phrase for a public play space made for dogs. Pets can run without a leash inside the fence. Rules often ask owners to clean up waste.

examples.en: Comfortable pet strollers allow senior or disabled dogs to enjoy outdoor fresh air.
examples.zh: 寬敞避震的專用寵物推車讓行動不便的高齡老犬也能舒適外出吹吹微風、享受大自然。

examples.en: The folding pet stroller fits easily into the trunk of a compact car for road trips.
examples.zh: 這款輕量可折疊的寵物手推車能輕鬆收折放入小轎車後車廂，非常適合出遊踏青。

examples.en: Many crowded department stores require pets to stay inside zipped strollers at all times.
examples.zh: 許多人潮擁擠的百貨公司與商場規定進場寵物必須全程待在拉好拉鍊的推車內。

examples.en: Shock-absorbing pet strollers let senior dogs enjoy park breezes without overexerting arthritic joints.
examples.zh: 搭載高彈性避震大輪子的多功能寵物推車，讓患有關節炎的老犬也能迎著微風舒適遊覽公園。

examples.en: Multi-pet owners rely on heavy-duty foldable strollers to navigate busy MRT train concourses comfortably.
examples.zh: 同時飼養多隻毛孩的家長依靠堅固耐重折疊推車，能從容優雅地穿梭於捷運擁擠的站廳人流中。

examples.en: Mesh ventilation windows on the stroller keep cats cool while shielding them from outdoor frights.
examples.zh: 寵物推車周圍配備的高透氣紗網窗，既能維持內部涼爽通風，又能遮蔽外界刺激給予滿滿安全感。

entries.definition: 寵物推車；嬰兒推車；避震型寵物推車

explains.en: It is a small wheeled carriage used to push a baby or pet. A folding model fits in a car trunk. Older dogs may ride in one outdoors.
Parents use this wheeled seat to take a young child on a walk. Some stores require pets to stay inside a zipped version. It can fold for storage.
This movable carrier lets someone push a child or animal instead of carrying them. Padded wheels can make the ride smoother. Lock the wheels when stopped.

examples.en: Taiwan boasts hundreds of pet-friendly restaurants, luxury hotels, and cafes.
examples.zh: 台灣全島坐落著數百家歡迎毛小孩一同入座用餐的優質寵物友善餐廳、飯店與特色咖啡館。

examples.en: The seaside resort offers pet-friendly rooms equipped with dog beds and food bowls.
examples.zh: 這家濱海渡假渡假村特別規劃了專屬寵物友善客房，房內貼心備有舒適睡墊與專用食碗。

examples.en: We chose a pet-friendly hiking trail where dogs are welcome to explore alongside owners.
examples.zh: 我們挑選了一條寵物友善的森林健行步道，歡迎主人牽著愛犬一同漫步探索大自然。

examples.en: Taiwan boasts hundreds of pet-friendly cafes providing complimentary water bowls and dog treats.
examples.zh: 台灣各地林立著數以百計的寵物友善咖啡廳，主動提供免費新鮮飲用水碗與手作無添加肉乾。

examples.en: We searched for pet-friendly hotels near the national park so our golden retriever could travel along.
examples.zh: 我們搜尋了國家公園附近的寵物友善民宿，這樣全家就能帶上黃金獵犬一同出遊過夜。

examples.en: This pet-friendly outdoor mall features pet drinking fountains and dedicated grassy rest zones.
examples.zh: 這座戶外購物商場採取全區友善寵物政策，隨處設有毛孩專屬飲水機與毛孩草皮休憩區。

entries.definition: 寵物友善的；友善寵物的；歡迎毛孩的

explains.en: A hotel allows guests to bring their dog and may provide a bed or water bowl. Check the property’s rules before booking.
A cafe welcomes people with pets and has a safe place for them to rest. Keep the animal close to you.
A hiking path may allow dogs if they stay on a leash. Ask about local rules before taking a pet there.

examples.en: The five-star pet boarding hotel provides webcam monitoring for traveling parents.
examples.zh: 頂級五星級寵物寄宿旅館為出國在外的毛爸媽提供二十四小時隨時在線的視訊即時監看。

examples.en: During the Chinese New Year holidays, pet boarding facilities fill up weeks in advance.
examples.zh: 每逢農曆新年連續長假，各大優質寵物寄宿旅館與安親班往往在數週前就已被預訂一空。

examples.en: Boarding your dog at a reputable kennel ensures they receive scheduled meals and walks.
examples.zh: 將愛犬託付給評價優良的專業寵物旅館寄宿，能確保牠們獲得按時供餐與專人帶遛散步。

examples.en: Luxury pet boarding facilities feature climate-controlled private suites and spacious play yards.
examples.zh: 頂級精品寵物寄宿旅館配備二十四小時獨立恆溫空調套房與上百坪大草皮奔跑遊戲區。

examples.en: When choosing a pet boarding kennel, ensure all guest animals are verified for up-to-date vaccines.
examples.zh: 挑選優質寵物寄宿店家時，請務必確認所有入住毛孩均需出示完整最新疫苗證明。

examples.en: Bring along familiar blankets and home kibble to ease stress during short-term boarding stays.
examples.zh: 寄宿時帶上毛孩熟悉的味道毛毯與平時常吃乾糧，能大幅減輕陌生產生的適應壓力。

entries.definition: 寵物寄宿安親；寄宿；登機；寄宿旅館

explains.en: A pet may stay at a kennel while its family travels. Staff provide meals and walks.
This service gives a dog a safe place to stay for a few days. Bring a familiar blanket to help it feel at ease.
Airline passengers get on a plane before it leaves. The word can also mean a pet staying away from home.

examples.en: We hired a trustworthy professional pet sitter to feed and comfort our cats at home.
examples.zh: 我們在連假出遊期間預約了值得信賴的專業到府寵物保姆定時到府餵食鏟砂陪伴貓咪。

examples.en: A dedicated pet sitter visits twice daily to administer medication and refresh water.
examples.zh: 盡職細心的到府寵物保姆每天早晚各來訪一次，按時餵藥、換新鮮飲水並陪貓玩耍。

examples.en: Many busy pet owners prefer in-home sitters because pets stay relaxed in familiar surroundings.
examples.zh: 許多忙碌的飼主更偏好預約到府保姆，因為毛孩待在熟悉的居家環境中最為放鬆自在。

explains.en: This person cares for a pet while its owner is away. They may visit the home to give food and medicine. The animal can stay in a familiar place.
A busy owner may ask this worker to check on cats twice a day. They refresh the water and offer comfort. They are paid for the care.
Use this noun for someone who looks after an animal for a short time. They may stay at the home. Pets can remain relaxed in their usual surroundings.

examples.en: Modern humane dog trainers use positive reinforcement with treats and gentle praise.
examples.zh: 現代人道訓練師秉持正向增強科學訓練法，以美味零食肉乾與溫柔鼓勵引導狗狗學習。

examples.en: Consistent positive reinforcement builds mutual trust between dogs and their handlers.
examples.zh: 始終如一的正向增強獎勵機制能在狗狗與訓犬師之間建立深厚互信的情感橋樑。

examples.en: Rewarding calm behavior immediately provides clear positive reinforcement for puppies.
examples.zh: 當幼犬展現安靜冷靜的穩定狀態時立即給予肉乾獎勵，能提供立竿見影的正向增強效果。

examples.en: Positive reinforcement training rewards desired calm behaviors with clicker cues and treats.
examples.zh: 現代正向增強訓練法提倡以響片清脆提示聲結合高價值美味零食，耐心獎勵毛孩冷靜正確行為。

examples.en: Consistent positive reinforcement builds immense trust between rescue dogs and their human handlers.
examples.zh: 持之以恆落實正向增強獎勵機制，能在受虐流浪狗與訓練員之間建立起深厚的安全感與信任。

examples.en: Timely reinforcement immediately following a successful command accelerates potty training success.
examples.zh: 在狗狗達成指定指令後的瞬間給予精準增強獎勵，能以驚人速度縮短定點如廁的學習歷程。

examples.en: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) aligns raw models to be helpful, honest, and harmless.
examples.zh: 結合人類反饋的強化學習（RLHF）訓練機制，能引導原始模型展現出樂於助人、誠實可信且無害的安全回答。

examples.en: Positive reinforcement techniques like praise and healthy treats encourage puppies to learn commands quickly.
examples.zh: 採用口頭稱讚與健康小零食等正向增強強化學習技巧，能有效引導活潑小幼犬在短時間內學會坐下指令。

examples.en: Engineers installed thick steel carbon-fiber reinforcement jackets around the old bridge piers to resist earthquakes.
examples.zh: 土木結構工程師在老舊跨河橋樑橋墩外側包裹厚實的高強度碳纖維鋼板補強包覆，以全面抵禦強烈地震考驗。

entries.definition: 正向增強；強化獎勵；正向增強獎勵機制；強化；人類反饋強化學習 (RLHF)

explains.en: It is a reward or response that makes a behavior more likely to happen again. Trainers may praise a dog for staying calm. It can also mean extra support.
Giving a puppy a treat after quiet behavior encourages it to repeat that behavior. In construction, added materials can make a structure stronger. Context matters.
This term can mean strengthening a habit with praise or rewards. It can also name extra material used to support a wall or bridge. Both senses add strength.

examples.en: Pressing the training clicker marks the exact microsecond a dog performs correctly.
examples.zh: 按壓訓練響片發出清脆聲響能精準在狗狗做對動作的瞬間完成行為標記與即時獎勵。

examples.en: Clicker training helps bridge communication by pinpointing the precise moment of good behavior.
examples.zh: 響片訓練能透過精準捕捉毛孩做對行為的微秒瞬間，搭建起人寵之間清晰的溝通橋樑。

examples.en: Always follow each sound from the clicker with a delicious, high-value training treat.
examples.zh: 請記住在按響響片發出「喀噠」聲之後，務必在第一時間補上一顆極具誘惑力的獎勵肉乾。

entries.definition: 響片（動物行為訓練工具）

explains.en: A trainer presses this small device to make a short sound when a dog follows a cue. A treat can follow the sound.
The brief sound marks the exact moment a pet does the desired behavior. This helps the animal connect the action with a reward.
Some people use a hand-held sound maker while teaching a dog new tricks. Give praise or a treat after the sound.

examples.en: Leaving interactive puzzle toys helps soothe a rescue dog's separation anxiety.
examples.zh: 出門上班前留下一顆塞滿起司肉泥的益智抗憂鬱漏食玩具能有效緩解毛孩的分離焦慮。

examples.en: Dogs suffering from separation anxiety may whine, drool, or chew doors when left alone.
examples.zh: 患有嚴重分離焦慮症的狗狗在獨自留在家中時，可能會出現悲鳴、流口水或抓咬大門。

examples.en: Gradual desensitization training can effectively cure moderate cases of separation anxiety.
examples.zh: 透過循序漸進的脫敏離家時間訓練，能有效改善並治癒中度程度的分離焦慮問題。

explains.en: A dog may feel very worried when left alone at home. Puzzle toys can help keep it busy.
Some pets whine or chew a door when their owner leaves. Training can help them feel safer.
A gradual plan can teach a dog that its family will return. This condition causes distress during time apart.

examples.en: The rescued tabby cat began to purr contentedly while resting on her lap.
examples.zh: 這隻被收養的溫馴虎斑貓在女孩溫暖的膝蓋上舒服地瞇上眼睛，發出沉穩滿足的呼嚕聲。

examples.en: A cat's purr vibrates at a soothing frequency that helps promote bone and tissue healing.
examples.zh: 貓咪發出呼嚕聲的低頻振動頻率具有神奇的舒緩效果，甚至有助於促進骨骼組織自我修復。

examples.en: Hearing the kitten purr softly in the quiet bedroom put the baby straight to sleep.
examples.zh: 在寂靜的臥室裡聽著小貓發出輕柔放鬆的呼嚕聲，讓襁褓中的小寶寶安然進入香甜夢鄉。

entries.definition: 呼嚕聲；發出滿足的呼嚕呼嚕聲

explains.en: A cat makes this soft, vibrating sound when it feels calm or content. The sound may help a person relax. Kittens can make it too.
You can feel a cat's throat gently shake as it makes a quiet sound. Some pets do this while resting on someone's lap. It may soothe a baby.
Use this word for the low, steady sound cats make. It often means they feel comfortable. A person may hear it in a quiet room.

examples.en: Kittens knead soft blankets with their front paws when feeling cozy and secure.
examples.zh: 貓咪在柔軟毛毯上用兩隻前爪反覆踩踩踏踏，代表牠此刻內心感到無比安心與被愛。

examples.en: She smiled as the fluffy white cat began to knead her belly before curling up for a nap.
examples.zh: 看著蓬鬆雪白的愛貓在蜷曲身子小睡前對著自己的肚子認真踏踏，她忍不住溫柔微笑。

examples.en: Cats knead instinctual rhythmic motions that originate from nursing as tiny kittens.
examples.zh: 貓咪有節奏地規律踩踩踏踏（做麵包）是一種源自幼貓時期吸吮母乳的本能天性表現。

entries.definition: 踩踩踏踏；踏踏（貓咪踏奶動作）；揉麵團

explains.en: Press and fold dough with your hands to make it smooth before baking bread. A baker works it on a floured surface. Cats also press their paws rhythmically on a soft blanket.
This verb describes working flour and water into a smooth mixture by pushing and folding it. A pet may make a similar motion with its front paws when relaxed.
A cook pushes and folds bread mixture until it has the right texture. A kitten may press its paws into a cushion as it settles down. The word describes both actions.

examples.en: Regular grooming minimizes massive Shiba Inu fur shedding during seasonal transitions.
examples.zh: 養成每天勤奮梳毛的好習慣能大幅減少柴犬在春秋換季時宛如蒲公英般漫天飛舞的大掉毛。

examples.en: Cat shedding naturally increases during spring as felines lose their thick winter coats.
examples.zh: 貓咪在春季時分掉毛量會明顯增加，因為牠們需要褪去保暖厚重的深層冬毛。

examples.en: Investing in a robot vacuum cleaner helps keep heavy dog shedding under control.
examples.zh: 購置一台吸力強勁的掃拖機器人，能有效將家中掉落一地的旺盛寵物毛髮打理得井井有條。

explains.en: A cat loses loose hair as the seasons change. Brushing can help collect the fur.
Some dogs leave hair on sofas and clothes as their coats renew. A vacuum can help clean it up.
Regular grooming removes loose fur from a pet’s coat. Certain breeds lose more hair at some times of year.

examples.en: Toy poodles and bichons have non-shedding, hypoallergenic curly coats.
examples.zh: 玩具貴賓犬與比熊犬擁有不易掉毛且低致敏性的捲曲毛髮，非常適合過敏體質家庭飼養。

examples.en: Families with mild pet allergies often search for hypoallergenic dog and cat breeds.
examples.zh: 家中有過敏體質成員的家庭，往往會優先尋找不易致敏的低過敏性犬貓品種飼養。

examples.en: Even hypoallergenic pets produce dander, so regular baths and air purifiers are still recommended.
examples.zh: 即使是低過敏品種毛孩依然會產生皮屑，因此定期洗澡與使用高效空氣清淨機仍不可少。

examples.en: Allergy sufferers sleep sneeze-free using hypoallergenic silk quilts and bamboo pillowcases.
examples.zh: 易過敏體質族群換用低致敏天然純蠶絲被與抗菌竹纖維枕頭套後，整夜不再噴嚏連連或鼻塞發癢。

examples.en: The hotel offers hypoallergenic rooms equipped with medical-grade HEPA filters and wooden floors.
examples.zh: 該精品酒店特別規劃了全面鋪設木質地板並配備醫療級 HEPA 濾網空氣清淨機的「抗過敏防塵客房」。

examples.en: Natural wool bedding is inherently hypoallergenic, repelling dust mites and moisture simultaneously.
examples.zh: 純天然羊毛寢具天生具備低致敏與高透氣特性，能在天然調節被窩濕度的同時自然排斥塵蟎附著。

entries.definition: 低過敏性的；不易致敏的；低致敏抗過敏的；溫和的

explains.en: Some materials or animals may be less likely to cause an allergic reaction. They can still affect sensitive people.
A hotel room with a special filter may reduce dust and pollen. It is made for people with allergies.
Wool or silk bedding can be less likely to bother some sleepers. This word describes something designed to cause fewer allergies.

examples.en: Adopted mixed breed dogs (Taiwan Dogs) are renowned for high intelligence and loyalty.
examples.zh: 台灣本土收養的米克斯土狗（台灣犬）以智商極高、忠心護主且身體強壯無遺傳病聞名。

examples.en: Mixed breed pets frequently inherit hybrid vigor and suffer fewer hereditary health problems.
examples.zh: 米克斯混種毛孩通常享有顯著的雜交優勢，罹患純種犬常見遺傳性疾病的機率低上許多。

examples.en: She proudly adopted a rescued mixed breed cat from the municipal animal shelter.
examples.zh: 她驕傲地從公立市立動物之家領養了一隻個性親人、花色獨一無二的米克斯花貓。

explains.en: This describes a pet whose parents come from different kinds of dogs or cats. The animal may have features from both. Many shelters have them for adoption.
A dog may have parents from several different kinds. It can be healthy and loyal like any other pet. A shelter may help it find a home.
Use this phrase for an animal that does not come from just one pure breed. Its parents have different ancestry. It may have a unique appearance.

examples.en: Ensure purebred puppies come from certified ethical breeders rather than puppy mills.
examples.zh: 若選擇飼養純種犬貓，請務必慎選政府合法評鑑特優的良心舍，嚴拒非法繁殖場。

examples.en: Certain purebred dogs are genetically prone to respiratory difficulties or hip dysplasia.
examples.zh: 部分純種犬在基因上有較高機率遺傳特定疾病，例如短吻呼吸道阻塞或髖關節發育不良。

examples.en: He researched the specific exercise needs and temperament of the purebred German Shepherd.
examples.zh: 他在決定飼養純種德國牧羊犬前，深入研究了該犬種所需的每日運動量與性格特質。

entries.definition: 純種的；血統純正的毛孩

explains.en: It describes an animal whose parents are from the same recognized breed. A breeder should care for the animals responsibly. Some breeds have inherited health risks.
Dogs with a known family line may be described this way. Research the breed's exercise needs before bringing one home. Choose an ethical breeder.
This adjective refers to an animal bred within one established breed. Some can have health problems passed down through families. Responsible care matters.

examples.en: Geriatric veterinary care focuses on managing chronic kidney disease and arthritis.
examples.zh: 高齡老犬老貓的安寧長照醫療主要聚焦於長期慢性腎臟病控管、心臟病與關節疼痛舒緩。

examples.en: As pets enter their geriatric years, they require softer bedding and biannual checkups.
examples.zh: 隨著毛孩步入高齡老年期，牠們需要更柔軟的減壓睡墊以及每半年一次的深度健康檢查。

examples.en: The geriatric cat needs stairs to reach his favorite sunny spot on the sofa comfortably.
examples.zh: 這隻高齡老貓需要透過寵物防滑斜坡階梯，才能輕鬆走上沙發享受牠最愛的溫暖陽光。

examples.en: Geriatric pet care focuses on pain management, joint mobility, and kidney protection.
examples.zh: 高齡老犬貓醫療照護重點聚焦於關節疼痛控制管理、維持日常活動能力與慢性腎臟指數守護。

examples.en: The clinic's geriatric wellness program includes blood pressure tracking and early cancer screenings.
examples.zh: 該院推行的高齡毛孩銀髮健檢專案，涵蓋了定期血壓監測與早期腫瘤癌症高規格篩檢。

examples.en: Special orthopedic memory foam beds provide crucial skeletal support for geriatric canines.
examples.zh: 特殊醫療級高密度記憶釋壓睡墊，能為骨骼關節退化的高齡老犬提供關鍵的支撐與保護。

entries.definition: 高齡老年醫學的；老年的；高齡寵物醫學的；老年期的

explains.en: An older cat may need softer bedding and more frequent checks with a vet. The care focuses on age-related needs.
A clinic helps elderly pets manage stiff joints and other long-term health problems. Families discuss comfort with the veterinarian.
This term describes medical care or needs related to old age. Older animals may need adjustments at home.

examples.en: Joint supplements with green-lipped mussel relieve stiffness in dogs with arthritis.
examples.zh: 定期補充含有紐西蘭綠唇貝精華與非變性二型膠原蛋白的保健品能顯著緩解老犬關節炎。

examples.en: Cold and damp winter weather can aggravate the painful joint inflammation of arthritis.
examples.zh: 寒冷濕涼的冬日氣候往往容易引發或加劇老狗關節炎所導致的僵硬與慢性疼痛。

examples.en: The vet prescribed anti-inflammatory pain medication to help manage the senior dog's arthritis.
examples.zh: 獸醫師開立了溫和的消炎止痛處方藥物，以幫助改善高齡老犬長期退化性關節炎的不適。

examples.en: Monthly monoclonal antibody injections offer relief for dogs suffering from severe hip arthritis.
examples.zh: 定期施打最新單株抗體止痛針劑，能為罹患嚴重退化性髖關節炎的毛孩顯著緩解骨骼關節疼痛。

examples.en: Installing anti-slip rugs along slippery hardwood floors prevents painful arthritis flare-ups.
examples.zh: 在光滑拋光石英磚地板上全面鋪設止滑地墊，能預防關節炎老犬滑倒加劇急性疼痛發作。

examples.en: Swimming provides excellent low-resistance exercise for dogs dealing with progressive spinal arthritis.
examples.zh: 溫水游泳是極佳的零重力低阻力全身性運動，能有效鍛鍊患有進行性脊椎關節炎的老犬肌力。

entries.definition: 關節炎；退化性關節病變；退化性骨關節炎

explains.en: This joint problem can make a dog stiff or sore. A veterinarian may suggest medicine.
Cold, damp weather may make joint pain feel worse. Swimming can offer gentle movement.
An older pet may have painful joints and need help getting around. A vet can plan treatment.

examples.en: The faithful companionship of a dog eases loneliness during difficult times.
examples.zh: 在人生低潮失意與孤單之際，愛犬不離不棄的忠誠默默陪伴給予了主人最堅強的力量。

examples.en: Seniors living alone often cherish the warm companionship that a small cat provides.
examples.zh: 獨居的高齡長輩往往格外珍視身邊小貓所帶來那份安靜、溫暖且撫慰人心的相伴相隨。

examples.en: True friendship is built on mutual respect, trust, and comforting companionship.
examples.zh: 真正的友誼奠基於彼此真誠的尊重、無條件的信任與風雨同行的長久默契陪伴。

examples.en: The quiet nighttime companionship of a purring cat brings soothing solace to solitary city living.
examples.zh: 深夜孤身一人時身旁傳來貓咪溫熱安靜的打呼嚕陪伴，為繁忙孤獨的現代都會生活帶來撫慰靈魂的平靜。

examples.en: After retiring, he found deep purpose and joyous companionship in walking his rescue golden retriever.
examples.zh: 退休之後，每天清晨牽著領養的黃金獵犬漫步河畔，成為他重獲生命熱情與溫暖陪伴的泉源。

examples.en: Lifelong companionship with animals teaches young children boundless empathy and compassionate respect.
examples.zh: 在孩童成長發育過程中享有動物長年真誠的陪伴，能深層啟蒙他們無限的同理心與生命關懷。

examples.en: Loving companionship and mutual support make the journey through old age deeply comforting and sweet.
examples.zh: 老伴之間數十年如一日的相濡以沫與真情陪伴，讓走過風雨的晚年旅途無比踏實溫暖。

examples.en: Adopting a playful rescue golden retriever brought joyous companionship into the lonely widow's quiet home.
examples.zh: 領養一隻活潑開朗的流浪黃金獵犬，為獨居老奶奶原本清冷寂靜的家中帶來了滿溢的歡笑與陪伴。

examples.en: True companionship involves listening patiently without judgment when someone is going through hardships.
examples.zh: 真正的知心陪伴，是在摯友歷經人生坎坷低谷時，靜靜守候在身旁傾聽而毫無任何批判。

entries.definition: 陪伴；情誼；相伴相隨；溫暖的心靈陪伴；老伴與親友溫暖相伴相守

explains.en: This is the comfort and friendship people or animals give by being together. A dog can help an older person feel less lonely. It includes trust and mutual care.
A cat may keep someone company during a quiet evening. Friends listen when someone faces a hard time. This close connection can bring comfort.
Use this noun for having someone beside you and sharing time together. Pets and people can provide it. It can make life feel less lonely.

examples.en: The award-winning barista calibrated the grinder meticulously for morning espresso.
examples.zh: 冠軍咖啡師大清早便全神貫注精細校準磨豆機刻度，以萃取出完美的黃金濃縮。

examples.en: She trained for months to become a skilled barista at the specialty café.
examples.zh: 她在精品咖啡館接受了數個月的嚴格培訓，成為一名手藝精湛的專業咖啡師。

examples.en: A friendly barista greeted each customer by name and remembered their usual drink order.
examples.zh: 親切熱情的咖啡師親切地稱呼每位顧客的名字，並熟記他們平時習慣點的咖啡。

examples.en: The master barista adjusts the grinder calibration three times a day to compensate for humidity shifts.
examples.zh: 追求極致的專業咖啡師，每天依據天氣濕度變化細心校正磨豆機刻度三次。

examples.en: Behind the counter, the world champion barista prepares competition routines with clinical precision.
examples.zh: 在吧台後方，奪得世界冠軍榮銜的傳奇咖啡師，以宛如外科手術般的臨床精準度演練比賽流程。

examples.en: A great barista combines thorough chemical knowledge with graceful customer service skills.
examples.zh: 一位真正頂尖優秀的吧台咖啡師，完美兼具了深厚的萃取化學理論與溫暖典雅的待客服務魅力。

entries.definition: 咖啡師；專業吧檯咖啡調理師；融合科學與藝術的世界級專業咖啡師

explains.en: It is a person trained to prepare coffee drinks in a cafe. They may adjust a grinder to make good espresso. Friendly service helps guests feel welcome.
A worker in this job makes drinks such as lattes and cappuccinos. They may remember regular customers' orders. Practice helps them steam milk well.
This cafe professional prepares coffee and serves customers. Some train for months to learn espresso techniques. A skilled one can create patterns in milk foam.

examples.en: A double shot of espresso forms the rich, aromatic base for cappuccinos.
examples.zh: 一份雙份義式濃縮咖啡（Double Espresso）是調製香濃卡布奇諾的靈魂基底。

examples.en: He ordered a quick single espresso at the counter before heading to his morning meeting.
examples.zh: 他在吧檯前點了一杯單份義式濃縮咖啡一飲而盡，隨後精神奕奕地前往晨會。

examples.en: Authentic Italian espresso is brewed under high pressure to create a thick golden crema.
examples.zh: 正宗的義式濃縮咖啡在高壓高溫下萃取而成，表面浮現一層厚實細密的金黃咖啡油脂（Crema）。

examples.en: A balanced double espresso extracted under nine bars of pressure delivers intense, syrup-like body.
examples.zh: 在九大氣壓下精準萃取出的雙份義式濃縮，質地濃稠如糖漿且層次極為豐富。

examples.en: Sipping a well-pulled espresso reveals bright acidity seamlessly woven into dark chocolate richness.
examples.zh: 細啜一口黃金萃取的單品濃縮咖啡，能感受到明亮果酸與深邃黑巧克力的醇厚風味交織融合。

examples.en: High water pressure emulsifies insoluble coffee oils into a thick, concentrated twenty-five-milliliter shot.
examples.zh: 強大的九巴水壓將不溶於水的天然咖啡油脂徹底乳化，濃縮凝結為一杯二十五毫升的精華瓊漿。

entries.definition: 義式濃縮咖啡；九巴大氣壓黃金萃取雙份義式濃縮

explains.en: A small, strong coffee is made by forcing hot water through finely ground beans. It often has a foamy top.
A cafe may serve this concentrated drink alone or use it in a cappuccino. The flavor can be rich and intense.
Baristas use a machine to make a short coffee with pressure. It can be the base for other drinks.

examples.en: Pour-over coffee highlights the delicate floral and citrus notes of Geisha beans.
examples.zh: 手沖咖啡能極致放大並完美展現藝妓咖啡豆細膩雅緻的白花香與柑橘果酸。

examples.en: She enjoys the relaxing ritual of brewing fresh pour-over coffee every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 她十分享受每個週日早晨為自己沖泡一杯新鮮手沖滴濾咖啡的療癒儀式感。

examples.en: Pour-over brewing allows for precise extraction control through water flow and temperature.
examples.zh: 手沖咖啡沖煮法能藉由細膩控制水流速度與沖泡水溫，精準調整咖啡的萃取風味。

explains.en: Hot water is slowly poured over ground coffee in a filter. This method can bring out gentle flavors.
A coffee lover may use a kettle with a narrow spout to control the water. Brewing can feel like a calming ritual.
This drink is made by pouring water through coffee grounds by hand. The person controls the flow and temperature.

examples.en: The iconic conical V60 dripper allows precise control over water extraction speed.
examples.zh: 經典的錐形 V60 螺旋肋骨手沖濾杯讓咖啡師能精準掌控注水萃取流速與節奏。

examples.en: Ceramic and glass coffee drippers retain heat better than plastic ones during brewing.
examples.zh: 陶瓷與耐熱玻璃製成的手沖濾杯在沖煮過程中比塑膠濾杯更具備優異的保溫蓄熱性。

examples.en: Place a folded paper filter securely inside the conical dripper before adding ground beans.
examples.zh: 在倒入研磨咖啡粉之前，先將摺疊好的專用濾紙妥善服貼平整地置入錐形濾杯中。

explains.en: This is a small coffee-making tool that holds a paper filter above a cup. Hot water passes through the grounds and drips below. A cone-shaped one lets the brewer control the flow.
A person places ground coffee inside a filter set in this device. Water pours over it and drains into a mug. Ceramic and glass versions hold heat well.
Use this noun for the holder used to make pour-over coffee. It may be shaped like a cone. Place a filter inside before adding grounds.

examples.en: Precision burr grinders produce uniform grounds with minimal powdery fines.
examples.zh: 高精密的錐刀與平刀磨豆機能研磨出粒徑極為均勻的咖啡粉，大幅減少細粉干擾。

examples.en: Clean the coffee grinder blades regularly to prevent stale coffee oils from altering taste.
examples.zh: 定期細心清理磨豆機的研磨刀盤，能避免殘留的陳舊咖啡油脂氧化變質影響風味。

examples.en: He bought a manual conical grinder for fresh coffee during outdoor camping trips.
examples.zh: 他特地添購了一台便攜手搖錐刀磨豆機，方便在戶外露營野炊時隨時研磨現泡咖啡。

examples.en: The low-RPM single-dose coffee grinder retains virtually zero leftover grinds between different beans.
examples.zh: 低轉速單劑量電動磨豆機，在更換不同莊園咖啡豆時能做到近乎零殘粉滯留。

examples.en: Cleaning your electric grinder with compressed air prevents stale coffee oils from tainting morning cups.
examples.zh: 定期使用專用吹塵球清潔電動磨豆機殘粉通道，能徹底杜絕氧化油耗味污染每一杯新鮮清晨咖啡。

examples.en: Hand grinders with premium stainless steel bearings allow backpackers to brew fresh coffee on peaks.
examples.zh: 搭載頂級雙不鏽鋼軸承的高精度手搖磨豆機，讓山友在百岳稜線上也能隨時現磨現煮頂級精品咖啡。

entries.definition: 磨豆機；研磨機；零殘粉單劑量高均勻度電動磨豆機

explains.en: It is a tool or machine that crushes beans or other materials into smaller pieces. Coffee lovers use one before brewing. Clean the blades regularly.
A hand-operated device can turn coffee beans into grounds. Freshly crushed beans keep more flavor. Some models are small enough for camping.
This appliance breaks hard items into fine particles. In a kitchen, it may prepare coffee. In workshops, it can sharpen or shape materials.

examples.en: Coffee lovers appreciate single-origin beans sourced directly from Alishan farms.
examples.zh: 頂級老饕由衷讚賞直接採購自阿里山特富野部落的高海拔單品莊園咖啡原豆。

examples.en: Single-origin coffees express the distinct terroir and climate of a specific region.
examples.zh: 單品產區莊園咖啡能清晰傳遞出特定種植產地獨特的風土條件與高山微氣候特色。

examples.en: The shop specializes in single-origin chocolate bars made from Venezuelan cocoa beans.
examples.zh: 這家精品小店專營以委內瑞拉特定可可莊園產地豆純手工精製的頂級單品黑巧克力。

entries.definition: 單品產區的；單一莊園的

explains.en: A coffee bag names one country, region, or farm where its beans were grown. The flavor can reflect that place.
A chocolate bar is made with cacao from a single region instead of mixing beans from many places. Its label may name the farm.
A tea seller identifies the estate or area that produced the leaves. The product comes from one source.

examples.en: Master coffee roasters carefully monitor bean temperature and drum airflow.
examples.zh: 專業資深咖啡烘豆師在烘焙過程中全程緊盯爐溫變化曲線與鍋爐風門抽風數據。

examples.en: The local coffee roaster supplies fresh whole beans to restaurants throughout the city.
examples.zh: 這家地方獨立咖啡烘焙豆廠為全城市數十家優質餐廳提供每週現烘新鮮咖啡豆。

examples.en: She invested in a cast-iron drum roaster to start her own small-batch roasting business.
examples.zh: 她購置了一台專業鑄鐵滾筒式小型烘豆機，正式開啟了她的自家微型手作烘豆事業。

examples.en: The master roaster monitors exhaust gas sensors and drum temperatures inside the cast-iron roaster.
examples.zh: 烘豆大師在鑄鐵雙層滾筒烘豆機旁，緊盯排氣熱風溫度與鍋爐轉速。

examples.en: Heavy double-walled steel drums inside the roaster ensure radiant, even heat transfer to every bean.
examples.zh: 烘豆機內部厚實的雙層不鏽鋼滾筒，確保柔和穩定的熱傳導與輻射熱均勻包裹每一顆旋轉中的生豆。

examples.en: After dropping the hot roast into the cooling tray, high-power fans cool the beans down in sixty seconds.
examples.zh: 一鍵出鍋落入下層冷卻盤後，大功率抽風馬達在六十秒內迅速將滾燙熟豆抽風冷卻定格風味。

entries.definition: 咖啡烘豆師；大型烘豆機；半熱風鑄鐵雙層滾筒數位烘豆機；烘豆師

explains.en: This person watches the heat and color while coffee beans are being prepared. They can work at a small shop.
A coffee shop may use a large metal machine to heat beans evenly. The word can name the machine or the worker.
The operator checks bean temperature and airflow. Fans cool the hot beans after they are ready.

examples.en: Professional Q-graders scored the green coffee beans during official blind cupping.
examples.zh: 擁有國際 Q-Grader 認證的專業杯測師在嚴格的盲測杯測會上為各莊園生豆評分。

examples.en: Coffee cupping involves slurping brew from a spoon to aerate aromas onto the palate.
examples.zh: 專業咖啡杯測需要運用杯測匙用力吸啜咖啡液，讓香氣在鼻腔口腔中充分霧化感知。

examples.en: We attended an educational coffee cupping workshop to train our sensory palates.
examples.zh: 我們報名參加了一堂專業咖啡感官杯測體驗課程，藉此鍛鍊味蕾對細微風味的敏銳度。

examples.en: Blind sensory tea cupping evaluates appearance, liquor clarity, aroma profile, and leaf integrity.
examples.zh: 盲測評茶（Tea Cupping）嚴格依照國家標準，從茶乾外觀、茶湯水色、香氣層次與葉底活性逐項評分。

examples.en: Traditional Chinese medicine cupping therapy applies suction cups on sore back muscles to improve blood flow.
examples.zh: 中醫傳統拔罐療法（Cupping）透過在緊繃痠痛的背部穴位施加負壓吸力，以促進局部血液循環與活血通絡。

examples.en: Coffee buyers conduct rigorous morning cupping sessions to score microlots from Ethiopian cooperatives.
examples.zh: 國際精品生豆買家每天清晨展開極為嚴謹的杯測評比，為來自衣索比亞小農合作社的微批次咖啡豆打分。

examples.en: Coffee buyers slurp loudly from cupping spoons to spray liquid across all sensory taste receptors.
examples.zh: 尋豆師手持特製杯測匙大力吸啜，在標準杯測評鑑中讓咖啡液霧化噴灑在整個舌面感官上。

examples.en: Standardized cupping protocols mandate sniffing dry fragrance, wet aroma, and slurping at three temperatures.
examples.zh: 國際標準杯測規範嚴格要求依序評定乾香氣、濕香氣，並在滾燙、微溫與冷卻三種溫層進行啜吸評分。

examples.en: Cupping dozens of unlabeled mystery samples removes brand bias and highlights raw agricultural quality.
examples.zh: 對數十碗無標籤的匿名樣品進行盲測杯測，能徹底消除品牌既定偏見，唯讓純粹生豆品質說話。

entries.definition: 咖啡杯測；風味品評會；國家級專業評茶 (Tea Cupping)；國際 SCA 標準專業盲測杯測評鑑流程

explains.en: This is a formal tasting method used to compare coffee or tea. People smell the dry leaves and the brewed drink. Traditional medicine also uses cups that create suction on the skin.
Coffee buyers may sip many samples without knowing their brands. They compare flavor and quality. In another setting, this word names a therapy using suction cups.
Use this noun for a tasting session that follows set steps. People evaluate aroma and flavor. It can also refer to a treatment that places cups on the body.

examples.en: High-altitude washed African coffees feature refreshing, wine-like crisp acidity.
examples.zh: 高海拔水洗非洲精品咖啡帶有令人愉悅提神、宛如紅酒般的清脆明亮果酸。

examples.en: Adding a squeeze of fresh lemon juice balances the richness by adding bright acidity.
examples.zh: 擠上一點新鮮檸檬汁能為濃郁的肉料理增添一抹清新明亮的酸度解膩。

examples.en: Soil acidity plays a major role in determining which plants thrive in a mountain garden.
examples.zh: 土壤的酸鹼度（酸性指數）是決定高山農場花卉與作物能否茁壯生長的核心要素。

examples.en: Ethiopian washed Yirgacheffe is celebrated for its sparkling, lemon-lime citric acidity.
examples.zh: 著名的衣索比亞水洗耶加雪菲，以其如檸檬萊姆般活潑明亮、令人生津的晶瑩果酸質聞名全球。

examples.en: Pleasant malic acidity brings crisp green apple freshness that makes the mouth water.
examples.zh: 怡人多汁的天然蘋果酸質為杯中帶來如咬下青蘋果般的爽朗脆度，令人舌底生津回味無窮。

examples.en: Over-roasted dark coffees lose their sparkling acidity, leaving only dull roasty and ash-like bitterness.
examples.zh: 過度深焙的咖啡會將生豆中珍貴活潑的果酸質全數扼殺殆盡，僅留下單調死沉的煙燻焦炭苦感。

entries.definition: 果酸酸質；酸度；明亮多汁之柑橘檸檬與蘋果果酸感

explains.en: It is the level of acid in a substance. Lemon juice has a sharp sour taste. Soil levels can affect which plants grow well.
Coffee may have a bright, crisp flavor that people describe this way. A squeeze of lemon adds it to a dish. It is measured in chemistry too.
This quality can describe sourness in food or the amount of acid in a liquid. Soil testing helps gardeners understand it. Different plants need different levels.

examples.en: Steaming fresh milk to 60°C creates velvety microfoam perfect for latte art.
examples.zh: 將優質鮮乳精準加熱打發至攝氏六十度能產生宛如絲綢般綿密細緻的拉花微奶泡。

examples.en: Submerging the steam wand correctly creates fine microfoam without visible large bubbles.
examples.zh: 將蒸氣噴管正確浸入鮮奶液面適當深度，能打發出毫無粗大氣泡的極細緻微奶泡。

examples.en: Silky microfoam integrates seamlessly with espresso to produce a balanced, sweet cup.
examples.zh: 絲滑柔順的微奶泡能與義式濃縮完美交融，呈現出口感溫潤平衡、甜感充盈的拿鐵。

examples.en: Steaming fresh milk into silky microfoam creates a glossy wet-paint texture ideal for free-pour latte art.
examples.zh: 用高溫蒸氣將鮮奶打發成如絲綢般綿密細緻的微氣泡奶泡，泛著如亮光漆般的迷人光澤。

examples.en: Submerging the steam wand tip slightly below the surface incorporates air into velvety microfoam.
examples.zh: 將蒸氣噴嘴尖端巧妙浸入液面下方數毫米處帶動旋渦進氣，將全脂鮮奶打發成極致絲滑的微氣泡。

examples.en: Large dry bubbles must be tapped and swirled out of the pitcher to leave only uniform, shiny microfoam.
examples.zh: 在桌面上輕敲鋼杯並優雅晃動旋轉，震破粗大乾燥的空氣泡泡，僅留下質地如絲緞般的液態微奶泡。

entries.definition: 綿密細緻微奶泡；蒸氣奶泡；蒸氣旋渦打發細緻綿密如絲綢熱奶泡

explains.en: A barista steams milk until it has very tiny bubbles and a smooth texture. This helps create latte art.
The milk looks glossy and pours smoothly over a strong coffee. Avoid large, dry bubbles.
Hot milk is gently aerated to make a fine, creamy foam. It can form patterns on a cappuccino.

examples.en: The barista poured a symmetrical Rosetta leaf pattern in the glossy latte art.
examples.zh: 咖啡師手腕靈活擺動，在咖啡杯表面輕巧勾勒出線條對稱優雅的經典壓紋樹葉拉花。

examples.en: Mastering latte art requires months of steady hand-eye coordination and practice.
examples.zh: 熟練掌握拿鐵拉花藝術需要經過數個月持之以恆的手部穩定度與眼手協調苦練。

examples.en: Customers love photographing the intricate swan latte art before taking their first sip.
examples.zh: 顧客們在啜飲第一口熱拿鐵之前，總是興奮地拿起手機為杯中精緻的天鵝拉花拍照。

entries.definition: 拿鐵拉花藝術（天鵝、鬱金香、愛心）

explains.en: A barista pours milk foam into coffee to make a leaf or heart shape. Customers often take pictures.
A steady hand helps create a small design on a cup of coffee. This skill takes practice.
Some drinks have a swan or flower made from milk foam. Learning this craft can take many months.

examples.en: Steeping coarse coffee grounds in cold water for sixteen hours yields smooth cold brew.
examples.zh: 將研磨咖啡粉浸泡於冰水中長達十六小時低溫慢速冷萃，能產出低酸滑順的冷萃咖啡。

examples.en: Bottled cold brew coffee has become an essential refreshment during hot summer days.
examples.zh: 瓶裝即飲的冷萃黑咖啡已成為炎炎夏日消暑解熱不可或缺的熱門提神飲品首選。

examples.en: Because cold brew is brewed with room temperature water, it has significantly lower acidity.
examples.zh: 由於冷萃咖啡全程採用常溫或冰水長時間慢速萃取，因此其酸質表現極為圓潤溫和。

examples.en: Steep loose oolong leaves in cold bottled water overnight for a refreshing, sweet cold brew.
examples.zh: 將高山茶葉置入冷開水瓶中放入冰箱低溫冷藏慢萃十二小時，即可享用完全不苦不澀的消暑甘甜冷泡茶。

examples.en: Cold brew coffee extracts fewer acidic oils over twenty-four hours, yielding a silky, stomach-friendly drink.
examples.zh: 低溫冷萃咖啡歷經二十四小時緩慢萃取，溶出的酸性油脂顯著降低，口感圓潤順口且較不易刺激腸胃。

examples.en: During sweltering July afternoons, local tea stands sell bottles of chilled cold brew Baozhong straight from the fridge.
examples.zh: 逢炎夏七月溽暑午後，老街茶行店門口冰桶裡擺滿了現取的冰鎮冷泡文山包種茶，沁涼解渴大受歡迎。

entries.definition: 冷萃咖啡；冷泡咖啡；清爽甘甜冷泡茶；低溫萃取

explains.en: This is a drink made by steeping coffee or tea leaves in cool water for many hours. It has a smooth taste. People enjoy it chilled on hot days.
A person can leave coarse grounds in bottled water overnight. The next day, the drink is ready. It may taste less sharp than a hot-brewed one.
Use this phrase for coffee or tea prepared with room-temperature or cold water. It takes a long time to steep. It is often served from the refrigerator.

examples.en: Enjoy a soothing warm cup of decaf latte without worrying about sleep insomnia.
examples.zh: 在悠閒的夜晚來一杯香濃溫熱的無負擔低因拿鐵，完全不必擔心影響夜晚深度睡眠。

examples.en: She switched to decaf coffee during pregnancy on her doctor's advice.
examples.zh: 懷孕期間聽從婦產科醫生的衛教建議，她將平日的黑咖啡全面更換為無負擔的低因咖啡。

examples.en: Most coffee shops offer Swiss Water process decaf that preserves natural bean flavors.
examples.zh: 大多數精品咖啡館皆提供採用瑞士水處理法脫因的低因咖啡，完整保留了咖啡豆原香。

entries.definition: 低因咖啡；去除咖啡因的

explains.en: It is coffee or tea with most of its caffeine removed. Someone may choose it in the evening. It can still have a familiar flavor.
A person who wants less caffeine can order this drink. Some shops use water to remove the stimulant. It may help avoid trouble sleeping.
This informal noun names coffee with little caffeine. The adjective describes a drink that has had most of it removed. Many cafes offer it.

examples.en: High-grade whole tea leaves unfurl gracefully in boiling spring water.
examples.zh: 頂級的高山一心二葉手採原葉茶葉在滾燙純淨山泉水中優雅緩慢舒展綻放。

examples.en: Traditional tea masters judge harvest quality by smelling and inspecting dry tea leaves.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的傳統茶道大師透過仔細嗅聞與撫摸乾燥茶葉的外觀來評斷採收年份品質。

examples.en: Discard the spent tea leaves onto the garden compost after multiple infusions.
examples.zh: 在多次沖泡出味完畢後，可以將泡開後的茶渣茶葉倒入花園花盆中作為天然堆肥。

explains.en: Loose leaves are placed in hot water to make a fragrant drink. A strainer can keep them out of the cup.
Some tea shops sell whole dried leaves instead of tea bags. They can be steeped more than once.
After brewing, the softened leaves can be added to compost. Choose fresh water and follow the tea maker’s directions.

examples.en: Grown above 1,000 meters altitude, Taiwanese high-mountain tea is prized globally.
examples.zh: 種植於海拔一千公尺以上高山帶的台灣高山茶以清香甘醇、喉韻極佳享譽全球。

examples.en: The cool climate and dense mountain fog produce high-mountain tea with gentle sweetness.
examples.zh: 高海拔涼冷清幽的氣候與瀰漫常年的濃霧，孕育出台灣高山茶清甜回甘的頂級滋味。

examples.en: We served freshly brewed Alishan high-mountain tea to our overseas visiting guests.
examples.zh: 我們為遠道而來的外國貴賓沏上一壺熱氣騰騰、清香撲鼻的阿里山原產高山茶。

entries.definition: 台灣高山茶（海拔1000公尺以上）

explains.en: This Taiwanese tea grows high above sea level, where the air is cool. It often has a gentle sweetness.
Dense mountain fog can shape the taste of leaves grown on a high slope. Visitors may enjoy a fresh cup.
Farmers grow this tea in elevated areas. A cool climate helps create its special flavor.

examples.en: Sun Moon Lake Ruby Black Tea (No. 18) features hints of natural cinnamon and mint.
examples.zh: 享譽國際的日月潭紅玉紅茶（台茶十八號）茶湯散發著天然肉桂與薄荷的雅緻清香。

examples.en: Many people enjoy black tea with a splash of fresh milk and a spoonful of honey.
examples.zh: 許多人喜歡在濃醇的熱紅茶中注入一勺新鮮鮮奶與天然蜂蜜，調製成香濃奶茶。

examples.en: Fully fermented black tea produces a dark amber liquor with deep malty undertones.
examples.zh: 經過全發酵工藝揉捻精製的紅茶，茶湯呈現深沉典雅的琥珀酒紅，帶有濃郁麥芽香氣。

entries.definition: 全發酵紅茶；日月潭紅茶

explains.en: This tea is made from leaves that are fully oxidized, giving the drink a dark color and rich flavor. People may add milk or honey. Sun Moon Lake is known for a variety.
The leaves are processed until they become dark and develop a strong taste. The brewed drink can be amber. It is enjoyed plain or with milk.
Use this phrase for a fully oxidized tea with a deep color. Its flavor is often malty. It is a common choice for breakfast.

examples.en: Sanxia Bi Luo Chun is an unfermented green tea packed with fresh grassy sweetness.
examples.zh: 新北三峽碧螺春屬於完全不發酵的鮮嫩綠茶，口感鮮爽甘甜、富含清幽豆香。

examples.en: Green tea is celebrated worldwide for its high content of natural antioxidant catechins.
examples.zh: 綠茶因富含天然高活性兒茶素與強效抗氧化物，在世界各地被譽為頂級健康飲品。

examples.en: Brew delicate green tea with water cooled to 80°C to avoid scorching the tender leaves.
examples.zh: 沖泡鮮嫩頂級的綠茶時建議使用降溫至攝氏八十度的溫熱水，以免燙傷嬌嫩茶芽。

entries.definition: 不發酵綠茶；三峽碧螺春

explains.en: It is a drink made from leaves that are heated soon after picking to limit oxidation. It has a light, fresh taste. Brew it with water that is not boiling.
This unfermented tea can contain natural antioxidants. Some Taiwanese varieties have a grassy flavor. Hot water that is too hot may make it bitter.
A cup of this tea may taste delicate and vegetal. The leaves are processed differently from darker varieties. Let boiled water cool before pouring it over them.

examples.en: Skilled tea pluckers harvest the tender 'one tip, two leaves' at daybreak.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的採茶阿姨在破曉清晨俐落採摘最鮮嫩的一心二葉頂級茶菁嫩芽。

examples.en: Hand plucking ensures that only undamaged, young leaves are selected for processing.
examples.zh: 人工手採採茶工序能確保只有完整無損、最鮮嫩肥厚的嫩葉才會被挑選送入茶廠精製。

examples.en: The timing of tea plucking depends heavily on daily weather and dew evaporation.
examples.zh: 春茶採摘的黃金時機高度仰賴當天的晴朗天氣與晨露蒸發完全的時間點。

explains.en: Harvesters gently pick the tender new leaves from tea bushes. The selected leaves are taken for processing.
The best leaves may be gathered by hand at dawn. Workers handle them gently so they stay whole.
A grower removes young leaf buds from the plant for making tea. Weather and harvest timing can affect quality.

examples.en: Solar withering under mild morning sunshine reduces moisture inside freshly picked leaves.
examples.zh: 將剛採下的茶菁在溫暖柔和的晨曦下進行日光萎凋，能均勻蒸發茶葉內部多餘水分。

examples.en: Indoor withering allows enzymatic reactions to develop complex floral aromas slowly.
examples.zh: 室內靜置萎凋能促使茶葉細胞內的天然酵素溫和轉化，慢慢生發出迷人的清雅花香。

examples.en: Careful control during the withering phase is essential for producing aromatic oolong tea.
examples.zh: 在製茶的萎凋階段進行精準的溫濕度控管，是產出頂級高香烏龍茶的關鍵基礎。

examples.en: Solar withering under gentle morning sunshine evaporates excess leaf moisture and awakens floral scents.
examples.zh: 攤放在竹篩上的茶菁在溫和晨光下進行日光萎凋，使水分適度蒸散並喚醒茶葉深層花香。

examples.en: After solar exposure, indoor withering allows uniform moisture redistribution across the bamboo trays.
examples.zh: 結束室外日光萎凋後，隨即移至室內萎凋架靜置，使茶葉水分均勻走水並重新平衡內部含水率。

examples.en: The CEO addressed the committee's hostile questions with a single withering look of contempt.
examples.zh: 面對董事會個別成員充滿敵意的無理質疑，執行長僅投以一道極具殺傷力且充滿輕蔑的冰冷眼神回應。

entries.definition: 茶葉萎凋；日光萎凋；茶葉日光萎凋；走水凋萎

explains.en: After picking, tea leaves may rest in sunlight to lose some moisture. This helps develop a floral smell.
Leaves can be left on trays indoors so moisture moves evenly. Careful timing affects the final tea.
A tea maker lets fresh leaves soften before the next step. This process reduces water inside them.

examples.en: Controlling oxidation levels determines whether tea becomes green, oolong, or black.
examples.zh: 精準控制茶葉發酵氧化程度的深淺，是決定製成綠茶、烏龍茶或全發酵紅茶之關鍵。

examples.en: Enzymatic oxidation transforms bitter polyphenols into sweet and fragrant compounds.
examples.zh: 茶葉內部的酵素氧化作用能將生澀的茶多酚分子轉化為甘甜醇厚且芬芳的香氣成分。

examples.en: Unlike oolong, green tea leaves undergo rapid pan-firing to stop oxidation completely.
examples.zh: 與烏龍茶不同，綠茶採摘後會立即送入高溫炒鍋中殺青，以徹底中止酵素氧化作用。

explains.en: This is a chemical process that happens when a substance reacts with oxygen. It can change tea leaves' color and flavor. Some makers stop it quickly to keep leaves green.
Enzymes in leaves can react with oxygen and change bitter compounds. The result may be sweeter and more fragrant. Different teas are processed for different amounts of time.
Use this noun for a reaction with oxygen. It can happen to metals or food. In tea making, it affects the final taste and color.

examples.en: Heavy machine rolling twists oolong leaves into tight, semi-spherical jade pearls.
examples.zh: 透過反覆布球揉捻塑形工法，將烏龍茶葉揉捻成顆粒緊結、宛如翠玉珍珠般的半球型。

examples.en: The mechanical rolling process ruptures leaf cells and brings essential oils to the surface.
examples.zh: 機械反覆加壓揉捻能適度破壞茶葉表面細胞壁，使茶葉天然芳香油脂均勻溢出附著。

examples.en: Artisan tea makers inspect the firmness of the tea pellets throughout the rolling process.
examples.zh: 專業製茶師傅在整個繁複的揉捻過程中，會隨時解塊並仔細檢查茶球的緊實度與成型。

examples.en: Low rolling resistance EV tires reduce friction on asphalt, extending single-charge travel distance.
examples.zh: 換裝電動車專屬低滾動阻力靜音輪胎，能大幅減少路面行駛滾阻摩擦力並延長單次充電續航。

examples.en: The scenic road trip winded through lush rolling green hills in central Nantou county.
examples.zh: 這趟風景如畫的自駕公路輕旅行，優雅穿梭於南投縣境內如浪濤般起伏綿延的翠綠茶園丘陵之間。

examples.en: Engineers tested wheel bearings under load to minimize mechanical friction and rolling resistance.
examples.zh: 汽車研發工程師在高負載運轉條件下精密測試輪軸軸承，致力於將機械摩擦損耗與滾動阻力降至最低。

examples.en: Cloth-wrapped ball rolling shapes whole tea leaves into tight, jade-green pearl spheres.
examples.zh: 透過多道熱布球反覆包覆揉捻成球工序，將整片茶葉緊密塑形為翠綠渾圓的半球型高山茶粒。

examples.en: Repeated mechanical rolling breaks tea leaf cell walls, allowing aromatic juices to coat the surface.
examples.zh: 反覆進行的機械揉捻工藝能適度破壞茶葉細胞壁結構，讓豐富茶汁溢出並均勻附著於茶葉表面以利沖泡。

examples.en: Thunderous rolling waves crashed rhythmically against the basalt sea cliffs along the Penghu coast.
examples.zh: 澎湖海岸邊白浪滔滔，波瀾壯闊的滾滾海浪伴隨如雷巨響，規律猛烈拍打著柱狀玄武岩海蝕崖。

entries.definition: 揉捻成形；揉茶；輪胎滾動阻力；滾動的；布球熱團揉揉捻成球；滾動

explains.en: In tea making, it is the step where leaves are twisted or pressed into shapes. Oolong leaves may become tight pearls. The process releases flavorful oils.
A machine or maker can turn leaves into small pellets by applying pressure. This also breaks some cells inside them. Workers check the shape as they work.
This word can name the shaping step used in tea production. It can also describe a wheel or object moving along a surface. In tea, the leaves are formed into balls.

examples.en: Traditional charcoal roasting over longan wood imparts a deep, smoky sweetness.
examples.zh: 遵古法採用天然龍眼木炭慢火炭焙茶葉，能賦予茶湯深沉甘美、溫潤厚實的炭焙韻味。

examples.en: Master roasters monitor the charcoal embers day and night to maintain steady baking heat.
examples.zh: 焙茶大師日以繼夜輪班照看炭火盆中的微弱炭火餘燼，以維持極為恆定的文火慢焙。

examples.en: The subtle charcoal notes linger pleasingly in the mouth long after the cup is finished.
examples.zh: 慢火炭焙所轉化出的迷人木質炭香，在整杯茶飲盡之後依然在口齒間久久繚繞不散。

explains.en: Wood is heated with little air until it becomes a black fuel. It can be used for grilling.
A painter may use a soft black stick to draw dark lines. The same material can be used for cooking.
Some tea makers roast leaves over glowing pieces of burned wood. This can add a smoky flavor.

examples.en: Brewing Gongfu tea requires precise water temperatures, short steeps, and mindful focus.
examples.zh: 沖泡傳統功夫茶席需要掌握滾水高溫、短秒數多次快沖以及全神貫注的靜心品鑑。

examples.en: The Gongfu tea ceremony is a revered art form that honors hospitality and craftsmanship.
examples.zh: 功夫茶茶藝是一門推崇深厚待客之道與極致匠人精神、備受推崇的傳統東方藝術。

examples.en: Practicing Gongfu tea encourages participants to slow down and savor each unique infusion.
examples.zh: 靜心修習工夫茶能引導品茗者放慢繁雜的心緒步調，逐一細細品味每一泡茶湯的幽微變化。

explains.en: This way of preparing tea uses small amounts of water and short steeping times. It encourages careful attention.
A host may serve many small cups and welcome guests with care. People enjoy each infusion slowly.
Precise water temperature and timing help bring out a tea's flavor. This traditional practice values patience.

examples.en: A porcelain Gaiwan allows tea appraisers to examine wet leaf aromas directly.
examples.zh: 白瓷蓋碗能真實還原茶湯原味不奪香，方便評茶師掀開碗蓋直接聞香鑑賞葉底。

examples.en: Using a Gaiwan gives the brewer complete control over steep time and pouring speed.
examples.zh: 熟練使用蓋碗沖茶能讓泡茶者對茶葉浸潤秒數與出湯傾倒流速擁有百分之百的掌控。

examples.en: The traditional Gaiwan consists of three pieces: a saucer, a bowl, and a fitting lid.
examples.zh: 傳統標準蓋碗由三個部分組裝而成：承托托盤、盛水杯碗本體以及貼合嚴密的碗蓋。

explains.en: This traditional tea vessel has a bowl, lid, and saucer. The lid helps keep leaves inside while pouring. Tea tasters use it to examine aroma.
A person can steep tea in this small lidded cup and pour the drink from under the lid. It gives control over steeping time. It has three separate pieces.
Use this term for a Chinese tea-brewing vessel. It is made of a cup, a cover, and a saucer. The shape makes it easy to smell the leaves.

examples.en: Premium Taiwanese oolongs maintain rich flavor through seven consecutive infusions.
examples.zh: 頂級台灣高山烏龍茶極其耐泡，連續沖泡回沖七次以上依然茶香四溢、甘甜不減。

examples.en: Each subsequent infusion reveals deeper mineral notes and nuanced fruit sweetness.
examples.zh: 隨後的每一泡回沖茶湯皆會逐層綻放出更深邃的岩韻礦物感與細膩豐富的熟果甜感。

examples.en: A hot chamomile infusion before bedtime helps calm nerves and promotes restful sleep.
examples.zh: 在就寢前喝上一杯熱騰騰的純天然洋甘菊舒壓草本茶飲，能平撫神經並幫助一夜好眠。

examples.en: Premium high-mountain tea leaves unfurl slowly, yielding eight flavorful infusions without thinning out.
examples.zh: 頂級手採高山茶葉在壺中緩緩舒展綻放，即使連續回沖八道茶湯依然甘甜濃郁、韻味不減。

examples.en: The nurse set up an intravenous saline infusion to keep the dehydrated patient properly hydrated.
examples.zh: 臨床護理師熟練地為這名脫水發燒的急診病患架設生理食鹽水靜脈輸液（Infusion），以維持體液平衡。

examples.en: A massive infusion of state subsidies revitalized solar panel and semiconductor manufacturing hubs.
examples.zh: 國發基金與各項政策補貼資金的大舉注資挹注，為太陽能光電與第三代半導體產業基地注入了強大動能。

examples.en: Slow hot milk infusion extracts the floral essential oils from whole Earl Grey tea leaves.
examples.zh: 將整片皇家伯爵茶葉放入滾燙鮮奶中進行低溫慢速浸泡萃取，完美提煉出天然佛手柑芬芳香氣。

examples.en: Overnight cold infusion of roasted coffee beans in dairy cream creates a fragrant ganache base.
examples.zh: 將現磨中深焙咖啡豆浸泡在頂級鮮奶油中低溫冷萃隔夜，能調配出風味層次絕佳的甘納許多酚基底。

examples.en: Steeping crushed cardamom and mint leaves created an aromatic herbal infusion for summer fruit tarts.
examples.zh: 將拍碎的綠荳蔻與新鮮薄荷葉投入鮮乳浸泡萃取，為初夏水果塔注入一股沁人心脾的草本清香。

examples.en: The patient received an intravenous infusion of living CAR-T cellular therapy over thirty quiet minutes.
examples.zh: 病患在三十鐘內透過靜脈點滴順利完成活體 CAR-T 細胞的「靜脈回輸療程」（Infusion）。

examples.en: Brewing chamomile herbal infusion calms racing minds and promotes restful sleep before bedtime.
examples.zh: 沖泡一杯溫熱的洋甘菊草本舒緩花草茶，能平撫焦躁思緒並在睡前營造一夜香甜好眠。

examples.en: The injection of a substantial venture capital infusion allowed the biotech startup to build manufacturing suites.
examples.zh: 成功引進關鍵創投機構的大額資金注資挹注，讓該生技新創公司得以順利興建自營 GMP 生產廠房。

entries.definition: 泡茶回數；茶湯沖泡；注入；沖泡次數；茶湯回沖；香草莢與伯爵茶高溫鮮奶浸泡萃取；改造後活體 CAR-T 細胞靜脈回輸體內療程

explains.en: It is a drink made by soaking leaves, flowers, or herbs in hot water. Chamomile is a common example. Tea leaves can be steeped several times.
A cup can gain flavor when herbs sit in warm water. Each steep may reveal a different taste. The word can also mean introducing something gradually.
This drink is prepared by leaving plant material in hot water. A later steep of the same leaves may taste different. Some people enjoy one before bed.

examples.en: The high-mountain tea reveals an enchanting orchid floral bouquet in the scent cup.
examples.zh: 將聞香杯湊近鼻尖輕嗅，高山茶湯散發出如高雅幽蘭般清麗脫俗的迷人花香。

examples.en: She wore a breezy summer dress decorated with delicate floral prints.
examples.zh: 她身上穿著一襲輕柔飄逸的純棉夏日連身裙，裙擺點綴著雅緻細膩的碎花印花圖案。

examples.en: The honey carried a subtle floral fragrance gathered from spring wildflower blossoms.
examples.zh: 這瓶純天然蜂蜜蘊含著工蜂從春天百花野花叢中所採集而來的清幽淡雅花香。

explains.en: A tea may smell like orchids or spring flowers. The scent is light and sweet.
A summer dress has a pattern of roses and leaves. The design is inspired by flowers.
Honey can carry the fragrance of blossoms visited by bees. This word describes a flower-like smell or design.

examples.en: 'Huigan' refers to the delightful sweet aftertaste rising in your throat after swallowing.
examples.zh: 「回甘」（Huigan）是指吞下微苦茶湯後，喉嚨深處自然湧現轉化出的甘甜回韻感受。

examples.en: Connoisseurs judge exceptional Taiwanese oolong teas primarily by the depth of their Huigan.
examples.zh: 頂級評茶行家在評鑑台灣高山烏龍茶的優劣時，往往將喉韻回甘的深度與持久度列為首要標準。

examples.en: A strong Huigan leaves your palate feeling refreshed and naturally sweet for long afterwards.
examples.zh: 勁道十足的茶氣回甘能讓整個口腔與喉嚨感覺清爽生津，長久停留著天然的甘美清甜。

entries.definition: 回甘（茶道術語，甘甜回味）

explains.en: After swallowing tea, a gentle sweetness may rise in the throat. Tea drinkers value this lingering taste.
A good cup can leave the mouth feeling fresh and naturally sweet. This word names that pleasant aftertaste.
Some tea lovers judge a drink by the sweet flavor that returns after each sip. The feeling may last for a while.

examples.en: Well-crafted tea transforms pleasant mild astringency into immediate mouth-watering sweetness.
examples.zh: 製作精良的優等茶能將初入口時的微弱茶澀感秒速化為滿口生津的大回甘。

examples.en: Over-steeping black tea brings out harsh astringency that dries out your tongue.
examples.zh: 浸泡時間過長的濃紅茶會析出過量粗澀的單寧酸，使整個舌面感到乾澀緊繃。

examples.en: Unripe persimmons contain heavy astringency that tastes chalky and puckering.
examples.zh: 尚未完全成熟脫澀的生柿子含有高濃度的可溶性單寧，吃起來口感極為乾澀麻舌。

examples.en: A well-crafted oolong balances initial pleasant astringency with instantaneous throat sweetness.
examples.zh: 一泡發酵焙火得宜的上乘烏龍茶，入口微帶清爽收斂澀感後，舌底瞬間化開生津。

examples.en: Excessive water temperatures above 95°C can highlight harsh astringency in delicate green teas.
examples.zh: 沖泡嬌嫩的低發酵綠茶若水溫超過攝氏九十五度，往往會瞬間放大並逼出過於尖銳刮舌的苦澀收斂感。

examples.en: Unripe persimmons possess extreme astringency due to soluble tannins that coat the tongue uncomfortably.
examples.zh: 尚未完全脫澀成熟的野生柿子含有高濃度水溶性單寧酸，一咬下去會帶來令人舌面緊繃麻木的強烈澀感。

entries.definition: 茶澀感；收斂性澀味；茶湯收斂澀感；澀味

explains.en: This is a dry, puckering feeling in the mouth caused by certain foods or drinks. Strong tea can create it if steeped too long. Unripe fruit may feel this way too.
Some teas have a pleasant drying sensation followed by sweetness. Too much heat can make the taste harsh. Tannins in fruit can also cause it.
Use this noun for the sensation that makes the mouth feel dry or tight. It can come from unripe persimmons. In tea, careful brewing keeps it mild.

examples.en: Tourists enjoy drinking fragrant oolong at historic lantern-lit Jiufen teahouses.
examples.zh: 國內外觀光客在紅燈籠高掛、古色古香的九份山城老字號茶藝館悠閒品茗賞景。

examples.en: The tranquil hillside teahouse overlooks sweeping vistas of misty terraced valleys.
examples.zh: 這間隱身於青翠半山腰的清幽茶坊，能飽覽層層疊疊、雲霧繚繞的壯麗梯田山景。

examples.en: We spent a rainy afternoon chatting and tasting different teas inside a quiet traditional teahouse.
examples.zh: 我們在一個細雨霏霏的午後，躲進古樸溫馨的傳統茶藝館裡悠哉品茶、促膝長談。

explains.en: It is a place where people sit and drink tea. A hillside one may overlook misty valleys. Visitors can sample different varieties.
Guests may spend a quiet afternoon talking over fragrant tea. Historic towns in Taiwan have traditional places like this. Some also serve snacks.
This shop or gathering place specializes in serving tea. People can enjoy a pot while looking at the scenery. It often has a calm atmosphere.

examples.en: Professional tea appraisal competitions award coveted Champion Prizes annually.
examples.zh: 全台各地農會每年盛大舉辦嚴謹的優良茶評鑑比賽，由評茶專家盲測選出特等獎。

examples.en: The bank conducted a thorough appraisal of the property before approving the mortgage.
examples.zh: 銀行在正式核發購屋房屋貸款之前，派遣專業估價師對該不動產進行了全面的價值鑑價。

examples.en: Annual performance appraisal provides employees with constructive career feedback.
examples.zh: 公司每年度舉辦的員工考績績效評核能為同仁提供具建設性的職涯反饋與晉升建議。

examples.en: Professional auction house appraisals value the imperial blue-and-white vase at twenty million dollars.
examples.zh: 國際蘇富比拍賣行資深專家為該只明代青花瓷瓶完成權威估價評估，市場身價高達兩千萬美元。

examples.en: The bank demanded an independent fine art appraisal before approving collateral on the loan.
examples.zh: 在核准該筆高額商業擔保貸款前，銀行嚴格要求出具一份由第三方權威公證機構完成的藝術品鑑價報告。

examples.en: The collector sought an antique porcelain appraisal from Sotheby's after inheriting a wooden chest of curios.
examples.zh: 在繼承了一整箱長輩留下的珍品古董後，這位收藏家主動尋求國際拍賣行的專業古瓷鑑賞估價。

entries.definition: 茶葉評評鑑；品質鑑定；藝術品估價價值評估；鑑定

explains.en: A trained taster compares tea leaves by smell, color, and flavor. A property expert may also estimate a home’s value.
A bank asks an independent person to estimate how much a house is worth. A manager may also review an employee’s work.
A specialist examines an artwork and estimates its value. The word can also mean a careful evaluation of quality.

examples.en: Connoisseurs always prefer loose-leaf tea over mass-market commercial tea dust.
examples.zh: 真正懂茶的茶道愛好者始終偏好沖泡散裝完整原葉茶，而非市售機械碎茶末茶包。

examples.en: Loose-leaf tea allows you to adjust the leaf-to-water ratio according to your preference.
examples.zh: 購買散裝原葉茶能讓泡茶者根據自己的濃淡口味喜好，隨心所欲自由調配茶水比例。

examples.en: Store your loose-leaf tea in an opaque, airtight canister away from heat and direct sunlight.
examples.zh: 請將珍貴的原葉散裝茶妥善存放在避光且密封防潮的不透光茶葉鐵罐中，避免受熱與日曬。

explains.en: Tea leaves can be bought in a tin instead of small paper bags. A person can choose how much to brew.
Store these leaves in a closed, dark container away from heat. They can be steeped in a pot or infuser.
Some tea drinkers prefer whole leaves to tiny pieces. This kind is sold without individual bags.

examples.en: Pyramidal corn-starch tea sachets let whole leaves expand completely in mugs.
examples.zh: 玉米澱粉環保材質製成的三角立體原葉茶包能讓大茶葉在馬克杯中全然舒展萃取。

examples.en: She placed a lavender-scented sachet inside her wardrobe to keep her clothes smelling fresh.
examples.zh: 她在自家衣櫥抽屜裡放進了一個薰衣草芳香小香包，讓所有換季衣物常保芳香芬芳。

examples.en: Single-serve tea sachets make it convenient to enjoy high-quality oolong at the office.
examples.zh: 單包裝的原葉立體隨身茶包非常方便好攜帶，讓上班族在辦公室也能輕鬆沖泡現飲好茶。
