explains.en: This is a small sealed bag that holds tea, herbs, or scented material. A pyramid-shaped one can let leaves spread out. A lavender one can make clothes smell fresh.
A single serving of tea may come in this small packet. It is easy to use at an office. The material lets water pass through.
Use this noun for a little bag of tea or fragrance. It may be put in a wardrobe or a mug. Some are shaped to give whole leaves room.

examples.en: The minimalist tea room created an atmosphere of pure tranquility and timeless serenity.
examples.zh: 充滿東方侘寂極簡美學的人文茶席空間營造出一種超脫塵俗、純淨安詳的沉靜祥和。

examples.en: Walking through the quiet bamboo forest filled her spirit with peace and serenity.
examples.zh: 漫步穿梭於寂靜幽深的翠綠竹林步道之間，讓她的心靈瞬間充滿了平靜與祥和之感。

examples.en: The calm lake reflected the mountains at sunrise, creating a scene of breathtaking serenity.
examples.zh: 清晨平靜無波的湖面如鏡子般倒映著連綿的遠山朝陽，構成一幅令人摒息的空靈寧靜畫卷。

examples.en: Slipping into cool linen sheets brings a wave of sublime peace and grateful evening serenity.
examples.zh: 輕輕鑽進冰涼柔順的亞麻被窩閉上雙眼，內心湧現出無比感恩、純粹且極致放鬆的晚安寧靜。

examples.en: Mountain hikers pause atop misty peaks to take in the silent dawn and timeless serenity of nature.
examples.zh: 攀登百岳的登山者佇立於雲海繚繞的中央山脈之巔，靜靜凝望壯闊晨曦，感受大自然永恆不朽的空靈寂靜。

examples.en: Deep rhythmic breathing exercises quickly restore your inner serenity amidst chaotic boardroom debates.
examples.zh: 在唇槍舌劍、爭吵激烈的董事會辯論僵局中，做幾次深長均勻的腹式呼吸能助你瞬間找回內心的從容平靜。

examples.en: Sitting on the veranda sipping warm oolong tea, the elder enjoys a profound inner serenity.
examples.zh: 悠然坐在陽台搖椅上細啜溫潤烏龍茶，歷經歲月沉澱的長輩心中享有無比恬淡平靜的寧靜祥和。

examples.en: The morning mist hanging over the mountain lake created an atmosphere of absolute silence and serenity.
examples.zh: 清晨輕籠在翠綠高山湖面上的裊裊薄霧，營造出一種空靈超脫且萬籟俱寂的極致平靜。

examples.en: Cultivating mental serenity through daily meditation helps calm nervous anxiety before major presentations.
examples.zh: 每天透過靜坐冥想涵養沉靜平穩的心境，有助於平撫在大型商務簡報前產生的焦慮與緊張情緒。

entries.definition: 沉靜安寧；寧靜祥和之美 (Zen)；內心純粹極致寧靜；安詳平靜；歷經歲月洗禮的平靜恬淡心境

explains.en: It is a peaceful and calm feeling or scene. A quiet lake at sunrise may create it. A simple room can feel restful.
Someone may feel this after walking through a bamboo forest. It describes deep quiet without worry. Meditation can help people find it.
A calm place with little noise can have this quality. The word may describe a person's peaceful state of mind. It is often used about nature.

examples.en: Readers browse the latest chapters of weekly Shonen manga on mobile apps.
examples.zh: 廣大漫畫迷每週準時在手機官方漫畫 App 上追看最新連載的少年漫畫。

examples.en: He collected every single volume of the classic martial arts manga series.
examples.zh: 他將這部經典熱血格鬥武俠漫畫系列的全套單行本一本不漏地完整珍藏。

examples.en: Reading manga with Japanese text and furigana is a fun way to practice language skills.
examples.zh: 閱讀帶有假名標註的日文原版漫畫，是一種既有趣又有效的自主語言學習方式。

entries.definition: 日本漫畫；日式黑白漫畫

explains.en: This style of comics from Japan is read in books or on phone apps. Many stories are drawn in black and white.
A reader follows illustrated stories about sports, friendship, or adventure. Some books are published a chapter at a time.
The characters and speech bubbles tell a story through pictures. This Japanese comic style has many genres.

examples.en: Independent creators sell original doujinshi art books at Fancy Frontier (FF).
examples.zh: 眾多獨立繪師在開拓動漫祭（FF）現場熱情擺攤販售自創的原創插畫同人誌。

examples.en: Doujinshi events provide aspiring amateur illustrators with a launchpad for careers.
examples.zh: 同人誌展銷盛會為眾多懷抱夢想的新星業餘繪師提供了邁向職業生涯的絕佳跳板。

examples.en: She published a heartwarming comedy doujinshi based on her favorite sci-fi characters.
examples.zh: 她以自己最熱愛的科幻作品主角為靈感，創作並出版了一本溫馨爆笑的同人本。

entries.definition: 同人誌；二次創作同人刊物

explains.en: Fans or independent artists may make a small book using characters from a favorite story. Some create their own characters.
Artists sell these fan-made books at events in Japan and Taiwan. They often include comics or illustrations.
A creator may publish an original story based on a popular game or film. This kind of work is made outside a large publisher.

examples.en: Talented digital illustrators share stunning fan art on Twitter and Pixiv.
examples.zh: 才華橫溢的數位電繪插畫家在社群平台上熱情分享精美絕倫的同人角色二次創作。

examples.en: The author was touched to see so much creative fan art dedicated to her characters.
examples.zh: 原作作者看到社群網路上湧現如此多描繪筆下角色的同人二創作品，深感溫暖感動。

examples.en: Creating fan art is a wonderful way for passionate fans to express love for an anime.
examples.zh: 繪製同人二創插畫是廣大熱血粉絲向心愛的動漫作品與角色表達由衷喜愛的極佳方式。

entries.definition: 同人繪圖；粉絲二創插畫

explains.en: This is a drawing, story, or other creation made by someone who loves a book, game, or show. The artist may depict favorite characters. People share it online.
A person may create an illustration to show how much they enjoy an anime. The author may feel touched by it. It can be made with paint or digital tools.
Use this phrase for creative work inspired by a popular story or character. Fans make it to express their interest. It may appear on websites or social media.

examples.en: Passionate cosplayers spend weeks handcrafting screen-accurate armor costumes.
examples.zh: 熱血的 Cosplayer 往往耗費數週時間純手工精心打造還原度極高的精緻鎧甲裝束。

examples.en: Cosplay allows enthusiasts to step into the shoes of their beloved fictional characters.
examples.zh: 角色扮演活動讓動漫愛好者得以化身為心目中摯愛的二次元虛擬角色。

examples.en: She decided to try cosplay for the first time at the upcoming summer anime fair.
examples.zh: 她決定在即將到來的暑期大型動漫嘉年華上，迎來人生中第一次的 Cosplay 嘗試。

explains.en: It is dressing as a character from a game, movie, or comic. Fans may make their own armor and costumes. It is popular at anime fairs.
People wear outfits and act like favorite fictional characters at events. Some spend weeks crafting detailed clothes. The hobby can include photos and performances.
This activity lets fans step into the look of a character they admire. A convention may bring many together. Costumes are often handmade.

examples.en: Hundreds of talented cosplayers posed for photographers outside the exhibition hall.
examples.zh: 數百位盛裝打扮的優秀 Cosplayer 在展覽館外廣場大方擺出經典姿勢供攝影師拍照。

examples.en: A dedicated cosplayer studies character postures and facial expressions carefully.
examples.zh: 一位敬業細心的 Coser 玩家在出角前會反覆推敲並揣摩角色的招牌站姿與神態眼神。

examples.en: She is a famous international cosplayer with hundreds of thousands of followers online.
examples.zh: 她是一位享譽國際的知名實力派 Coser，在各大社群平台上坐擁數十萬死忠粉絲。

explains.en: A fan dresses as a character from a game or comic and may copy the character’s poses. Some people make the costume themselves.
At a convention, visitors take photos with people dressed as heroes and fantasy characters. This hobby celebrates favorite stories.
A person carefully makes a costume and acts like a character at a fan event. They may share photos online.

examples.en: Cosplayers booked a moody ruin set for their post-apocalyptic photo shoot.
examples.zh: Coser 們特別預訂了充滿廢墟工業風的專業攝影棚，進行末日題材的外拍棚拍。

examples.en: The fashion model spent six hours in hair and makeup before the outdoor photo shoot began.
examples.zh: 時尚模特兒在戶外寫真外拍正式開拍前，花了整整六個小時梳化妝造打理細節。

examples.en: The photographer adjusted the lighting reflectors to capture natural highlights during the photo shoot.
examples.zh: 專業人像攝影師細心微調反光板與補光燈的角度，以在外拍寫真中捕捉最自然的輪廓光。

entries.definition: 外拍寫真；棚拍外景攝影

explains.en: A photographer takes a planned set of pictures of a model or a family. Lighting and poses are prepared.
A fashion model may spend time getting ready before the camera begins. The pictures may be taken outdoors.
People arrange a day to create portraits or product images. The photographer adjusts lights to make them look natural.

examples.en: Mobile and cloud gaming represent the fastest-growing entertainment sectors.
examples.zh: 手機手遊與雲端串流電玩遊戲已躍居全球數位娛樂產業中成長最為迅猛的核心領域。

examples.en: He spent his rainy Saturday afternoon immersed in retro gaming classics.
examples.zh: 在一個陰雨綿綿的週六午後，他沉浸在經典復古懷舊老遊戲的世界中度過了美好時光。

examples.en: Modern cloud gaming technology lets you play console games on any smartphone.
examples.zh: 現代先進的雲端串流遊戲技術讓玩家只需一台普通智慧手機，即可隨時暢玩主機級大作。

entries.definition: 電玩遊戲；電子遊戲產業

explains.en: This is playing video games, often on a phone, computer, or console. People may enjoy old arcade titles. Online services let players use different devices.
A rainy afternoon can be spent playing classic video games. Some newer services stream games from the internet. It is a large form of entertainment.
Use this noun for the activity or industry of playing digital games. It can happen on a phone or console. Players may compete or cooperate online.

examples.en: Hardcore gamers invest in high-refresh-rate 240Hz monitors for competitive edges.
examples.zh: 重度硬核電競玩家不惜重金投資 240Hz 超高更新率電競螢幕以搶佔競技毫秒先機。

examples.en: As a casual gamer, she enjoys solving light puzzle games during her daily commute.
examples.zh: 作為一名輕鬆玩玩的輕度休閒型玩家，她最喜歡在每天搭車通勤時玩幾局益智解謎小品。

examples.en: Millions of gamers tuned in simultaneously to watch the global game release stream.
examples.zh: 數以百萬計的全球電玩玩家在同一個夜晚守在螢幕前，共同見證年度遊戲新作盛大首播。

explains.en: It is a person who enjoys playing video games. Some play casually on a commute. Others compete using fast monitors.
A player may spend time solving puzzles or joining online matches. Millions watch skilled players stream games. The word can describe a hobbyist or competitor.
People who play electronic games are often called this. They may use a console, computer, or phone. Some compete professionally.

examples.en: Next-generation graphics cards render ray-traced lighting and reflections smoothly.
examples.zh: 次世代頂級獨立顯示卡（GPU）能流暢即時運算光線追蹤特效與逼真水面反射倒影。

examples.en: You need a dedicated graphics card with ample VRAM to run modern 3A game titles.
examples.zh: 若要流暢運行當前最熱門的 3A 級次世代電腦大作，配備獨立顯示卡與充裕顯存必不可少。

examples.en: Upgrading your graphics card is the fastest way to boost game frame rates.
examples.zh: 升級換裝效能更強悍的獨立顯卡，是立竿見影大幅拉升遊戲每秒畫面幀數的最佳途徑。

explains.en: A computer part processes images for games and videos. A powerful one can show detailed scenes smoothly.
When a player upgrades this component, a game may display more frames each second. It handles visual calculations.
A computer uses this card to create pictures on the monitor. Some computers have one built into the main processor.

examples.en: Handheld consoles let players enjoy blockbuster RPG adventures during train rides.
examples.zh: 便攜式掌上型遊戲主機能讓玩家在搭乘高鐵火車旅途中隨時暢玩 3A 級角色扮演大作。

examples.en: The new handheld gaming PC packs desktop-class graphics performance into a compact body.
examples.zh: 全新推出的便攜掌上型電競電腦將桌機級的強大顯示運算效能凝聚於一手可握的機身中。

examples.en: Handheld ultrasound scanners allow rural doctors to perform mobile examinations anywhere.
examples.zh: 手持式掌上型超音波掃描儀讓偏鄉行動醫療隊的醫師能在各部落隨時隨地替長輩進行檢查。

entries.definition: 掌上型的；掌上型遊戲主機

explains.en: This small game device can be held while traveling on a train. It fits in two hands.
A doctor may use a portable scanner during a visit to a rural clinic. It can be carried easily.
Some computers have a screen and controls in one compact unit. A person can hold it while using it.

examples.en: Free-to-play mobile games utilize gacha banners to summon rare 5-star characters.
examples.zh: 免費下載的手機遊戲通常採用機率抽卡轉蛋池機制，吸引玩家抽取稀有五星限定角色。

examples.en: She saved up in-game premium gems for six months to guarantee her favorite gacha pull.
examples.zh: 她在遊戲中默默積攢免費虛寶抽卡寶石長達半年，只為在本次限定池中保底抽中心儀角色。

examples.en: Remember to set strict spending limits when playing games with gacha mechanics.
examples.zh: 在體驗含有轉蛋抽卡機制的線上遊戲時，請務必建立理性消費心態並設定嚴格的預算上限。

entries.definition: 抽卡轉蛋機制；抽角系統

explains.en: This is a game feature where players spend in-game currency for a random character or item. Saving gems may guarantee a favorite reward. Set a spending limit.
A player may use tokens to receive a surprise character from a selection. Rare items can be hard to get. Some games encourage repeated tries.
Use this noun for a random-reward system in a video game. Players may spend virtual gems to get items. A guaranteed pull can require many saved tokens.

examples.en: Classic Japanese RPGs feature epic hundred-hour storylines and turn-based combat.
examples.zh: 經典日系角色扮演遊戲（JRPG）以動輒百小時的史詩浩瀚劇情與回合制戰鬥著稱。

examples.en: In an action RPG, dodging enemy strikes and timing attacks requires sharp reflexes.
examples.zh: 在動作角色扮演遊戲（ARPG）中，閃避敵方致命招式與抓準時機反擊極度考驗即時反應。

examples.en: She loves table-top RPGs like Dungeons & Dragons where players craft their own tales.
examples.zh: 她無比著迷於《龍與地下城》等桌上型跑團角色扮演遊戲，讓玩家靠想像力共創傳奇冒險。

explains.en: It is a video or tabletop game where players develop characters and follow a story. Some use turn-based battles. Others let players explore a large world.
Players may take on roles and make choices that affect the adventure. A group can create its own story around a table. Characters often gain new abilities.
This game genre focuses on characters, quests, and a developing plot. Some versions are played with dice and friends. Digital versions may have long adventures.

examples.en: The open-world adventure allows players to climb every mountain and explore freely.
examples.zh: 這款無接縫開放世界冒險大作允許玩家自由攀爬視野所及的每一座山峰與神廟。

examples.en: Gamers can spend hundreds of hours discovering hidden secrets across the vast open-world map.
examples.zh: 玩家可以在廣袤無垠的開放世界地圖中隨心探索數百小時，挖掘隱藏在地表各處的秘密。

examples.en: Environmental storytelling makes traveling through this seamless open-world feel truly alive.
examples.zh: 細緻入微的環境敘事與生動的生態系統，讓穿梭於這座壯麗無接縫大世界的旅程栩栩如生。

entries.definition: 開放世界的；無接縫大世界的

explains.en: Players can travel through a large game map and choose where to go. They may discover side quests while exploring.
A game lets players climb hills, visit towns, and choose many activities in any order. The map is not limited to a single path.
Instead of following only one narrow route, players can explore a broad landscape freely. They decide which places to visit.

examples.en: Minecraft is the world’s most popular sandbox game for creative construction.
examples.zh: 《當個創世神》（Minecraft）是全球最受歡迎、啟發無數創造力的開放式沙盒遊戲。

examples.en: Children love building intricate castles in the seaside sandbox at the playground.
examples.zh: 孩子們最喜歡在公園遊戲區的細緻沙坑裡，用小鏟子與模具建造宏偉的沙雕城堡。

examples.en: Software security researchers test potentially malicious files inside an isolated sandbox.
examples.zh: 資安研究人員會在一個相互隔離的安全沙盒（Sandbox）受限虛擬環境中分析可疑檔案。

examples.en: The regulatory sandbox lets fintech innovators test cutting-edge blockchain products in a safe environment.
examples.zh: 金管會推行「金融科技監理沙盒」（Regulatory Sandbox）機制，讓新創團隊在受控環境中安心測試創新實驗。

examples.en: Children built towering castles and deep trenches inside the neighborhood playground sandbox.
examples.zh: 社區公園兒童遊樂場的專屬大沙坑裡，小朋友們手拿塑膠小鏟子興高采烈堆砌起高聳的城堡與護城河。

examples.en: Software developers execute untrusted code snippets within an isolated virtual sandbox to safeguard the operating system.
examples.zh: 資深軟體工程師將來源不明的可疑程式碼放入虛擬隔離沙盒環境中運行測試，嚴防惡意軟體侵害本機作業系統。

entries.definition: 沙盒遊戲；沙坑；安全隔離環境；金管會金融科技創新監理沙盒

explains.en: Children can build castles in this box or area filled with sand. Some video games also let players create freely.
A computer security team may run an unsafe file in an isolated place. It cannot easily affect the rest of the system.
This kind of game lets people construct things without following a fixed story. The word also names a protected testing area for software.

examples.en: One hundred players parachute onto a shrinking island in intense battle royale matches.
examples.zh: 一百名玩家同時空降跳傘至一座安全區不斷縮小的孤島上，展開激烈的大逃殺吃雞對決。

examples.en: Survival instincts, stealth, and spatial awareness determine victory in battle royale shooters.
examples.zh: 生存求生意志、隱蔽身形與對四周槍聲腳步聲的敏銳空間感知是贏得大逃殺吃雞的關鍵。

examples.en: The battle royale mode received a massive update featuring new weapons and tropical storm hazards.
examples.zh: 該款射擊遊戲的大逃殺模式迎來了震撼賽季大更新，加入全新空投武器與熱帶風暴毒圈。

entries.definition: 大逃殺生存射擊遊戲 (吃雞)

explains.en: This is a video game mode where many players compete until only one player or team remains. The playing area may get smaller over time. Players gather supplies to survive.
A large group begins on an island and tries to be the last one standing. They use strategy and stay alert. A game update may add new equipment.
Use this phrase for a competition in which many players fight to survive. The safe area can shrink during the match. The winner is the last remaining player or team.

examples.en: Team coordination and warding are vital to winning 5v5 MOBA matches.
examples.zh: 隊友之間的默契配合與地圖視野插眼是贏得五對五 MOBA 競技對決的致勝關鍵。

examples.en: Popular MOBA games feature diverse champion rosters with unique magical abilities.
examples.zh: 廣受歡迎的 MOBA 競技遊戲擁有數百位風格迥異、技能各具特色的英雄角色陣容。

examples.en: In a competitive MOBA, winning lane priority gives your team early control of objectives.
examples.zh: 在高水準的職業 MOBA 對局中，取得對線推線優勢能為團隊在遊戲早期爭奪小龍創造主動權。

entries.definition: 多人線上戰鬥競技遊戲 (MOBA)

explains.en: It is a team video game where players control heroes and work together to defeat the other side. Matches often take place on a shared arena map.
Two teams cooperate in this competitive genre. Each player chooses a character with special abilities. Strategy and teamwork can decide the match.
Players defend their base while trying to reach and destroy the opposing team's base. They control different heroes. Communication is important.

examples.en: Tactical first-person shooters (FPS) reward pinpoint crosshair aiming accuracy.
examples.zh: 戰術第一人稱射擊遊戲（FPS）極度考驗玩家準星預瞄的精準度與架槍反應速度。

examples.en: He prefers third-person shooters because they provide a wider panoramic field of view.
examples.zh: 他更偏好第三人稱越肩視角射擊遊戲，因為第三人稱視角能提供更寬闊的周遭環顧視野。

examples.en: The arcade shooter features cooperative two-player combat against alien hordes.
examples.zh: 這款大型電玩懷舊街機射擊遊戲支援雙人投幣合作闖關，共同對抗排山倒海的外星異形。

explains.en: In this kind of video game, players aim at targets and try to hit them. Some titles show the action through the character’s eyes.
An arcade game has players aim at moving objects on a screen. Friends may compete for a high score.
This game genre focuses on aiming and firing at virtual targets. It can be played alone or with a team.

examples.en: Brave adventuring parties conquer multi-level dungeons filled with traps.
examples.zh: 英勇的冒險者小隊齊心協力勇闖機關重重、怪物遍布的多層迷宮副本地下城。

examples.en: The medieval castle's dark dungeon once held political prisoners centuries ago.
examples.zh: 這座中世紀古堡深處陰森潮濕的地下監牢地牢，數百年前曾關押過無數重要政治犯。

examples.en: Players team up to challenge the newly released endgame dungeon for powerful artifacts.
examples.zh: 玩家們在線上組隊挑戰全新上線的高難度團隊副本，爭奪通關後掉落的頂級神器寶物。

explains.en: In a castle story, this dark underground room may hold prisoners. A video game may have a level like it.
Players can explore a series of rooms filled with traps and challenges. They may search for treasure.
This underground space was once used to keep prisoners. Fantasy games often place monsters inside one.

examples.en: Slain elite monsters dropped rare gold legendary loot and crafting gemstones.
examples.zh: 成功討伐擊敗菁英怪物後，地表爆出了滿滿的金色傳奇裝備與稀有鍛造寶石戰利品。

examples.en: Pirates hid their stolen treasure loot in a secret sea cave on the deserted island.
examples.zh: 凶狠的海盜將洗劫劫掠而來的大批金銀財寶戰利品，深藏在荒無人煙的海島秘密水蝕洞內。

examples.en: Defeating the world boss rewards all participating players with valuable upgrade loot.
examples.zh: 齊心合力擊殺世界首領後，系統會依照貢獻度慷慨發放豐厚的強化升級材料戰利品寶箱。

entries.definition: 戰利品裝備；掉落物；搜刮

explains.en: This is treasure or useful equipment that players receive after defeating an enemy in a game. Pirates may also steal valuables from a place. Context shows which meaning fits.
A game may reward players with gold or gems after a difficult fight. The word can also mean goods taken by force. It may be used as a noun or a verb.
Use this word for valuable items gained in a game or stolen during a raid. A world boss may drop rare equipment. The action can also describe stealing property.

examples.en: Allocate your earned talent points wisely across the magician skill tree.
examples.zh: 將升級獲得的寶貴天賦點數妥善分配於魔法師的元素、召喚或輔助技能樹分支中。

examples.en: The branching skill tree lets players customize their combat styles toward archery or stealth.
examples.zh: 豐富多元的分支技能樹設計，允許玩家根據個人偏好自由打造弓箭狙擊或潛行暗殺流派。

examples.en: Unlocking the final node on the defensive skill tree grants temporary invulnerability.
examples.zh: 成功解鎖防禦天賦技能樹最末端的終極大招節點，能使角色在危急時刻獲得短暫無敵狀態。

explains.en: It is a branching menu in a game where players choose abilities to improve a character. Some paths focus on defense, while others develop archery.
A player may earn points and spend them on new powers. The branches allow different play styles. Reaching the final node can unlock a special ability.
This game feature shows choices for developing a hero's abilities. Players select a path that suits their strategy. Some branches require earlier choices first.

examples.en: The autosave system creates a safe respawn checkpoint before tough boss arenas.
examples.zh: 遊戲的自動存檔機制會在踏入高難度首領戰鬥房間前自動建立安全的重生記錄點。

examples.en: Drivers must slow down when approaching the border security checkpoint for inspection.
examples.zh: 駕駛人在駛近邊境安檢查驗站與收費檢查哨時，必須依規定減速停車接受人員盤查。

examples.en: Reaching this mountain checkpoint confirmed that the hiking team was halfway along the trail.
examples.zh: 順利抵達半山腰這座地標檢查站記錄點，證實健行登山隊伍的行程進度已順利完成過半。

examples.en: Tumors hide by activating the PD-1 immune checkpoint, effectively putting the brakes on killer T cells.
examples.zh: 狡猾的腫瘤藉由結合 PD-1「免疫檢查點」（Checkpoint），硬生生踩下煞車讓殺手 T 細胞失去攻擊力。

examples.en: Police set up a sobriety checkpoint along the boulevard to deter hazardous drunk driving over the weekend.
examples.zh: 交通警察週末在主要大道上設置酒駕攔檢點，以強力遏止危險的酒後駕車行為。

examples.en: Hikers stamped their national park permits at the ranger checkpoint before ascending the alpine trail.
examples.zh: 登山客在攀登高山百岳前，紛紛在國家公園檢查哨依序蓋章驗證入山入園許可證。

entries.definition: 存檔記錄點；檢查站；免疫檢查點受體 (解除癌細胞對免疫細胞煞車)

explains.en: A game saves a player’s progress at a certain place. If they lose a life, they may continue from there.
Travelers stop at a border station where officials check documents. Follow the signs and instructions.
A hiker reaches a marked spot along a trail and records the team’s progress. It can also be a place where access is checked.

examples.en: The skilled gamer completed an any-percentage speedrun of the game in 42 minutes.
examples.zh: 頂尖高玩高手僅耗時四十二分鐘便成功完成了這款硬核大作的無限制快速通關紀錄。

examples.en: Speedrun communities constantly discover ingenious sequence breaks and glitch shortcuts.
examples.zh: 全球競速通關 Speedrun 同好社群不斷挖掘出各種匪夷所思的跳關技巧與穿牆良性漏洞。

examples.en: Charity speedrun marathons raise millions of dollars for humanitarian causes every year.
examples.zh: 每年舉辦的全球慈善競速破關馬拉松直播大會，皆為國際人道救援組織募得數百萬善款。

explains.en: A player tries to finish a game as fast as possible. Groups may share their times online.
Some players find clever shortcuts to reach the end quickly. A charity event may include these fast attempts.
This activity focuses on completing a game in a short time. Players practice routes and techniques.

examples.en: Game developers hid a funny Easter egg reference to vintage arcade classics.
examples.zh: 遊戲主創團隊在隱秘角落暗藏了一個向八零年代經典街機致敬的幽默隱藏彩蛋。

examples.en: Children search excitedly through the backyard garden during Sunday's Easter egg hunt.
examples.zh: 小朋友們每逢復活節週日最愛在後院草坪花叢間興奮尋找色彩斑斕的彩繪復活節彩蛋。

examples.en: Typing a secret cheat code into the main menu reveals a hidden credits Easter egg.
examples.zh: 在遊戲主畫面依序敲下一組隱藏秘技代碼，就能意外觸發一段主創團隊的搞笑幕後彩蛋。

explains.en: In a game or movie, this can be a hidden joke or surprise placed by its creators. Players may find one by entering a secret code. The term also names a decorated egg for a spring holiday.
A director may hide a small reference to an old arcade game in a film. Children also hunt for painted eggs during a holiday. Context shows which meaning is meant.
Use this phrase for a secret feature or reference hidden inside a game or website. It can also mean a decorated egg in a springtime tradition. Discovering one can be fun.

examples.en: Photorealistic real-time cutscenes seamlessly bridge action gameplay and emotional plot.
examples.zh: 宛如好萊塢電影般逼真的即時過場動畫將流暢打擊操作與扣人心弦的劇情無縫串聯。

examples.en: The dramatic cutscene revealed the tragic backstory behind the warrior's quest for revenge.
examples.zh: 這段張力十足的劇情過場動畫深刻揭開了主角背負家仇國恨、踏上復仇征途的淒美過往。

examples.en: Players have the option to skip dialogues and cutscenes during subsequent playthroughs.
examples.zh: 遊戲貼心提供了跳過功能，讓玩家在進行二周目多周目遊玩時能自由略過過場動畫與對話。

entries.definition: 遊戲過場動畫；劇情演算畫面

explains.en: It is a short movie shown during a video game to move the story forward. It may reveal a character's past. Players can sometimes skip it later.
A game may pause player control to show an important event. The scene can explain the plot or introduce a new challenge. It often uses animation.
This non-interactive part of a game tells story information between sections of play. It may show a dramatic reveal. Some games let players watch it again.

examples.en: The sweeping orchestral OST became a streaming hit on global music charts.
examples.zh: 氣勢磅礡浩瀚的交響樂遊戲原創配樂（OST）上架後隨即橫掃各大串流音樂榜單。

examples.en: Listening to the emotional game OST always brings back memories of epic battles.
examples.zh: 每當耳畔再次響起那首感人至深的原聲配樂，心中總能瞬間勾起當年熱血奮戰的冒險記憶。

examples.en: The original soundtrack (OST) was recorded by a prestigious ninety-piece symphony orchestra.
examples.zh: 這部史詩級巨作的原創音樂大碟（OST）是由享譽盛名的九十人編制頂級交響樂團實地錄製。

explains.en: A movie’s music is released as an album with songs and background themes. Fans may listen after seeing the film.
A composer writes music for a game, and the publisher releases the tracks separately. The album brings back scenes from the story.
A film or game may have a collection of songs and instrumental pieces made for it. The music can be sold or streamed.

examples.en: The deluxe collector's edition includes a hardcover book of concept art.
examples.zh: 該豪華典藏版套裝內附一本印刷精美的精裝版遊戲世界觀概念美術與角色原畫設定集。

examples.en: Concept art guides the visual direction of environment models and costume designs.
examples.zh: 概念美術設計原稿為後續 3D 場景建模師與服裝造型師提供了清晰明確的整體視覺導向。

examples.en: Fans marveled at the early concept art sketches showing how the dragon design evolved.
examples.zh: 看到早期草圖階段的概念設計原稿展示出遠古惡龍如何一步步演變至今，玩家們嘖嘖稱奇。

entries.definition: 概念美術設計；原畫設定稿

explains.en: Artists draw early ideas for characters, places, or clothes before a film is made. These sketches guide the team.
A collector's book may show how a movie creature changed during planning. The drawings help set the visual style.
A game designer may create pictures of a fantasy world before building it. Early sketches help everyone imagine the result.

examples.en: Otaku enthusiasts collect intricately sculpted scale figurines of anime heroines.
examples.zh: 動漫公仔模型收藏家熱衷於收藏作工極致精細、造型優雅的等比例角色手辦模型。

examples.en: The porcelain angel figurine stood gracefully on the antique fireplace mantelpiece.
examples.zh: 那尊精緻純白的手工瓷製小天使公仔雕像優雅靜立在古色古香的壁爐展示架上。

examples.en: High-end anime figurines feature detailed hand-painted shading and dynamic action poses.
examples.zh: 頂級收藏級動漫手辦模型擁有極為細膩入微的純手工塗裝陰影與張力十足的戰鬥姿態。

examples.en: Expressive Koji pottery figurines perched on wall friezes tell dramatic tales of ancient loyalty and righteousness.
examples.zh: 鑲嵌於廟宇水車堵壁面上的交趾陶人物塑像，生動演繹著桃園結義等忠孝節義歷史傳奇。

examples.en: Collectors marvel at how tiny ceramic figurines capture subtle human emotions through delicate smiles.
examples.zh: 骨董收藏家無不讚嘆這些掌中陶偶竟能透過眉眼微笑，傳神捕捉人世間的微妙喜怒哀樂。

examples.en: Vandals once damaged two antique warrior figurines, prompting tighter security installations.
examples.zh: 過去曾有不良人士破壞屋簷上的兩尊武將陶偶，促使管委會全面升級紅外線防盜監控。

entries.definition: 公仔模型；手辦雕像 (Figure)；水滸傳與三國傳奇交趾陶人物塑像

explains.en: This is a small model of a person, animal, or character, often made for display. Collectors may paint or arrange them. It can be made from porcelain or clay.
A tiny ceramic figure can show a warrior or an angel. Collectors enjoy the detailed expressions and poses. It may stand on a shelf.
Use this noun for a small decorative statue. It can depict a person or creature. Some are carefully hand-painted.

examples.en: Unboxing collectible designer blind boxes brings the thrilling joy of surprise.
examples.zh: 拆開未知的設計師聯名限定盲盒能為公仔愛好者帶來心跳加速的驚喜抽盲盒樂趣。

examples.en: She bought an entire carton of twelve blind boxes hoping to pull the rare secret edition.
examples.zh: 她豪邁地端走了一整套十二入的盲盒大箱，滿心期待能幸運抽中機率極低的隱藏款。

examples.en: Designer blind boxes have become a massive commercial craze among urban youth.
examples.zh: 潮流玩具設計師聯名盲盒在當代都市年輕族群中掀起了一股勢不可擋的現象級收藏熱潮。

explains.en: It is a sealed package that hides which toy or collectible is inside. Buyers discover the item after opening it. Some versions include rare figures.
A shopper chooses a package without knowing its contents. This surprise can make collecting exciting. People may trade duplicates with friends.
The product inside is kept secret until the wrapper is opened. Collectors may buy several to find a special edition. It has become popular with young adults.

examples.en: Inserting two 50-dollar coins into the gachapon machine drops a mystery capsule toy.
examples.zh: 將兩枚五十元硬幣投入街頭日式扭蛋機轉動轉盤，一顆驚喜膠囊玩具便應聲滾落。

examples.en: Akihabara stations are lined with hundreds of colorful gachapon machines.
examples.zh: 東京秋葉原車站大廳與街角兩側整齊排列著數百台色彩繽紛、種類繁多的日式扭蛋機台。

examples.en: Collecting a complete set of miniature animal gachapon toys became his fun weekend hobby.
examples.zh: 收集整套做工逼真可愛的擬真動物系列扭蛋模型，成了他每個週末放鬆身心的療癒嗜好。

explains.en: Insert coins into a machine and turn its handle to receive a small toy inside a capsule. The toy is a surprise.
Rows of colorful machines in a Japanese shop contain collectible figures. Each turn gives one sealed capsule.
A customer pays and receives a random miniature figure in a plastic ball. Collectors may try to find a complete set.

examples.en: Many blockbuster anime adaptations originate from bestselling light novel series.
examples.zh: 許多現象級的爆款電視動畫影集最初皆改編自銷量破百萬冊的超人氣輕小說原作。

examples.en: Light novels feature fast-paced dialogue, fantasy themes, and vibrant full-color illustrations.
examples.zh: 輕小說以節奏明快洗練的對話、引人入勝的奇幻世界觀以及全彩精美插圖而廣受青睞。

examples.en: He reads an exciting chapter of his favorite fantasy light novel on the train each morning.
examples.zh: 他習慣在每天早晨搭火車通勤的半小時空檔中，翻讀一章精彩絕倫的奇幻冒險輕小說。

explains.en: This kind of Japanese book often has lively dialogue and pictures. Many popular anime shows began as these stories.
Readers can follow a fast fantasy adventure on a train. Colorful illustrations may appear between chapters.
A young reader may enjoy a short, easy-to-read story with pictures. It often has a fantasy setting.

examples.en: Reincarnating into a fantasy magical realm is the staple trope of the isekai genre.
examples.zh: 轉生穿越至充滿劍與魔法的奇幻異界是當前大受歡迎的「異世界」題材核心設定。

examples.en: In many isekai stories, ordinary office workers wake up as legendary heroes in other worlds.
examples.zh: 在眾多異世界轉生題材作品中，平凡的社畜上班族一覺醒來竟化身為異界威風凜凜的救世勇者。

examples.en: The isekai anime boom shows no signs of slowing down among international viewers.
examples.zh: 席捲全球的異世界題材動漫改編熱潮至今方興未艾，在海內外受眾中持續保有極高人氣。

entries.definition: 異世界題材；異世界轉生作品

explains.en: This is a story type where an ordinary person travels to or wakes up in another world, often a fantasy realm. The person may become a hero. It is common in anime and books.
A character may leave everyday life and find themselves in a magical place. They might need to learn new rules. Many stories use this idea.
Use this word for fiction about a person entering a different world. An office worker may become a legendary hero. It appears in novels, comics, and shows.

examples.en: The jaw-dropping season finale plot twist stunned viewers completely.
examples.zh: 第一季季終集那段令人瞠目結舌、始料未及的劇情超大神反轉讓全體影迷徹底驚呆。

examples.en: A well-crafted plot twist recontextualizes earlier clues without feeling like a cheap trick.
examples.zh: 設計巧妙高明的神級劇情大反轉能讓伏筆豁然貫通，絕非憑空捏造的廉價惡意反轉。

examples.en: The psychological thriller kept us guessing right up until the unexpected final plot twist.
examples.zh: 這部高智商心理驚悚電影始終懸念迭起，緊緊抓牢觀眾的好奇心直至結尾終極大反轉。

explains.en: It is a surprising change in a story that makes the audience see earlier events differently. A season finale may reveal a hidden secret. Good clues make it feel fair.
A writer may reveal that a trusted character had a secret plan. This unexpected turn can change the whole story. It keeps viewers guessing.
When a story suddenly takes an unexpected direction, this event can surprise the audience. Earlier details may make more sense afterward. Thrillers often use one.

examples.en: The popular manga spawned an animated spin-off focusing on the comedic sidekick.
examples.zh: 這部人氣長篇漫畫推出了以搞笑配角為核心主角的獨立日常喜劇番外篇外傳動畫。

examples.en: The sci-fi movie franchise launched a successful television spin-off exploring alien bounty hunters.
examples.zh: 該大型科幻電影宇宙成功衍生出了一部深耕外星賞金獵人日常的熱門外傳電視影集。

examples.en: The research laboratory became a commercial spin-off company funded by venture capital.
examples.zh: 該頂尖大學的研究實驗室在創投資金注資下，成功孵化並獨立為一家商業化衍生新創公司。

explains.en: A popular story gets a new series about a side character. It takes place in the same fictional world.
A research group forms a new company to sell technology it created. The business comes from an existing organization.
A television show focuses on one character from an older program. The new story is related but can stand alone.

examples.en: The passionate fandom gathers annually to celebrate character birthdays together.
examples.zh: 充滿熱情凝聚力的粉絲同好圈每年皆會盛大相約齊聚，為心愛的二次元角色慶生。

examples.en: Belonging to a welcoming fandom allows people to share creative energy with fellow fans.
examples.zh: 置身於一個溫暖互助的粉絲圈子裡，能讓同好們毫無保留地揮灑創作靈感與熱情。

examples.en: Online fandoms frequently organize charity drives and community events in honor of idols.
examples.zh: 網路同好社群經常以心愛偶像名義自主號召並發起跨國公益募款與各項志工愛心活動。

explains.en: People who love the same show or character may form a group. They share art and celebrate special dates.
An online community can bring fans together to plan a charity event. Members enjoy their common interest.
This group may gather at a convention or in a chat room. People talk about a favorite singer, game, or story.

examples.en: Taiwanese indie games like 'Detention' received global acclaim for cultural depth.
examples.zh: 台灣原創獨立遊戲團隊打造的《返校》等大作憑藉深刻的在地文化底蘊榮獲國際盛讚。

examples.en: Indie game development teams take creative risks that massive publishers often avoid.
examples.zh: 獨立遊戲小團隊勇於大膽嘗試各種新穎前衛的創新玩法，跳脫商業巨頭常規的束縛。

examples.en: The digital distribution platform holds seasonal festivals showcasing innovative indie games.
examples.zh: 數位發行平台每季定期盛大舉辦獨立遊戲嘉年華，全方位向玩家展示匠心獨具的原創佳作。

entries.definition: 獨立遊戲（小型工作室原創）

explains.en: This is a video game made by a small team or individual rather than a large publisher. The creators can take unusual creative risks. Some become popular around the world.
A small group may design and sell a game themselves. They have more freedom to choose the story. Online stores can help players find it.
Use this phrase for a game produced independently from a major company. A small studio may create it. A digital festival can showcase new titles.

examples.en: Lightweight full-frame mirrorless cameras have revolutionized modern travel photography.
examples.zh: 輕量小巧的全片幅無反單眼相機（Mirrorless）徹底顛覆並革新了現代旅遊攝影。

examples.en: Electronic viewfinders on mirrorless bodies display real-time exposure previews accurately.
examples.zh: 無反相機機身搭載的高解析度電子觀景窗，能即時且精準地呈現最終曝光效果預覽。

examples.en: She switched from a bulky DSLR to a compact mirrorless system for her overseas assignments.
examples.zh: 為了出國執行外景採訪任務的輕便性，她毅然將沉重笨重的傳統單眼換成了輕巧的無反系統。

entries.definition: 無反光的；無反單眼相機的

explains.en: It describes a digital camera designed without the mirror mechanism found in older single-lens cameras. This can make the body lighter. An electronic viewfinder shows the image.
Photographers may switch to this compact camera system for travel. The screen can preview exposure as they shoot. It can still use interchangeable lenses.
A modern camera of this type has no internal mirror. Its lighter body is convenient for assignments abroad. The viewfinder displays an electronic preview.

examples.en: An 85mm focal length is widely considered the gold standard for flattering portraits.
examples.zh: 85mm 鏡頭焦段被全球人像攝影師公認為雕塑人物立體五官與完美散景的黃金標準。

examples.en: Choosing a 24mm focal length lets landscape shooters include dramatic foreground rocks.
examples.zh: 選用 24mm 超廣角焦段能讓風景攝影愛好者將前景紋理分明的奇岩怪石納入構圖中。

examples.en: The versatile zoom lens covers a broad focal length range from 24mm to 70mm.
examples.zh: 這支多功能標準變焦鏡頭涵蓋了從 24mm 廣角至 70mm 中望遠的常用實用焦段範圍。

explains.en: A lens with a shorter number shows more of a landscape, while a longer one brings a distant subject closer. Photographers choose based on the scene.
Portrait photographers may choose a lens that frames one person without showing too much background. This measurement affects the view.
A lens setting changes how wide or close the picture appears. A wide view suits scenery, while a narrow view can isolate a subject.

examples.en: Opening the lens aperture to f/1.4 allows maximum light for low-light night shots.
examples.zh: 將鏡頭光圈全開至 f/1.4 超大光圈能導入最充沛的進光量，輕鬆駕馭昏暗夜景微光。

examples.en: A narrow aperture like f/11 ensures sharp detail throughout the entire landscape photo.
examples.zh: 縮小光圈至 f/11 等較小光圈，能確保風景照片從前景到遠景皆呈現出極致銳利的細節。

examples.en: Adjusting the lens aperture directly controls the depth of field in your photograph.
examples.zh: 調節鏡頭光圈葉片的開合大小，能直接掌控畫面景深的深淺與背景虛化的程度。

explains.en: A camera lens has an opening that controls how much light enters. A wider opening helps in a dark place.
Photographers adjust this setting to keep more of a landscape in focus. It is often shown as an f-number.
A small opening lets in less light and can make more of a picture look sharp. This camera part affects depth and brightness.

examples.en: The sparkling city night lights dissolved into gorgeous circular bokeh bubbles.
examples.zh: 繁華都市璀璨絢麗的霓虹夜景在淺景深大光圈下化為一顆顆夢幻迷人的圓形光斑散景。

examples.en: Premium portrait lenses with rounded aperture blades produce smooth, creamy bokeh.
examples.zh: 配備多片圓形光圈葉片的頂級人像鏡頭，能渲染出極致柔順滑潤、宛如奶油般的散景。

examples.en: The delicate flower stood out sharply against a dreamlike background of soft bokeh.
examples.zh: 嬌豔欲滴的野花在柔和夢幻的光斑背景散景映襯下，顯得格外鮮明立體動人。

entries.definition: 散景；背景虛化夢幻光斑

explains.en: This is the soft, blurry look of lights or shapes outside the sharp focus of a photograph. City lights may appear as circles. A camera lens affects the effect.
A portrait can show a clear person against a dreamy, blurred background. Rounded lens openings often make the light shapes smoother. Photographers use it creatively.
Use this photography term for the pleasing blur in the background of an image. It can make a flower stand out. The shape depends on the lens.

examples.en: Fast 1/2000s shutter speeds freeze fast-flying hummingbirds crisply in midair.
examples.zh: 高達兩千分之一秒（1/2000s）的極速快門能將空中高速振翅的蜂鳥動作凝結於半空。

examples.en: Slow down your shutter speed to two seconds to blur water cascading over river stones.
examples.zh: 將快門速度調慢至兩秒左右，能拍出溪水潺潺流過鵝卵石時如絹絲般滑順的動態模糊。

examples.en: Use a tripod whenever your shutter speed falls below one-sixtieth of a second to prevent camera shake.
examples.zh: 當手持拍攝快門速度低於六十分之一秒時，務必架設三腳架以防止相機手震模糊。

explains.en: It is the length of time a camera's shutter stays open to capture light. A fast setting can freeze a hummingbird in flight. A slow one can blur flowing water.
Photographers adjust this setting to control motion and brightness. Use a tripod when it is slow to avoid camera shake. It is measured in fractions of a second.
This camera setting controls how long light reaches the sensor. A short exposure captures action sharply. A long exposure can create a smooth effect.

examples.en: Check the realtime digital histogram to prevent clipping bright highlight details.
examples.zh: 拍攝時養成隨時查看相機螢幕即時色階分佈圖（直方圖）的習慣，以防高光過曝死白。

examples.en: A well-balanced histogram features a smooth curve concentrated across the midtones.
examples.zh: 一張曝光均勻適當的照片，其色階直方圖通常呈現出一道平緩集中於中間調的優美曲線。

examples.en: If the histogram bunches heavily against the right edge, your photo is overexposed.
examples.zh: 如果直方圖的大量像素資料緊貼在最右側邊緣形成斷崖，說明照片的高光已經嚴重過曝。

explains.en: A camera shows a graph with dark areas on one side and bright areas on the other. Photographers use it to check exposure.
The bars on this chart show how many pictures fall into different brightness levels. A crowded edge can warn that details are lost.
A data chart groups values into ranges, such as test scores or photo brightness. The bars help show their distribution.

examples.en: High dynamic range sensors capture both bright sunlit clouds and deep shadowy valleys.
examples.zh: 具備高寬容度的高動態範圍感光元件能同時完整保留高光雲層細節與深谷陰影層次。

examples.en: Landscape photographers value wide dynamic range to prevent blown skies during sunrises.
examples.zh: 風景攝影師極度重視寬廣的動態範圍寬容度，以防止日出拍攝時天空晨曦高光死白。

examples.en: Exposure bracketing can expand effective dynamic range beyond what a single shot achieves.
examples.zh: 透過包圍曝光連拍後進行 HDR 合成，能突破單張拍攝所能呈現的動態範圍極限。

explains.en: A camera can capture detail in bright clouds and dark valleys at the same time. This ability helps landscape pictures.
A sensor with a wide range can keep both light and shadow from losing detail. Photographers value this in a sunrise.
Taking several pictures at different brightness levels can extend what one image can show. This term describes that span.

examples.en: AI-powered real-time eye autofocus locks tenaciously onto running pets and children.
examples.zh: 搭載 AI 深度學習演算法的即時眼部自動對焦功能能死死鎖定奔跑中的毛孩與活潑幼童。

examples.en: Modern autofocus systems track fast-moving sports cars across the entire frame.
examples.zh: 現代頂級自動對焦追焦系統能精準追蹤在賽道上風馳電掣的跑車，全程不脫焦。

examples.en: Switch to continuous autofocus mode when shooting birds in active flight.
examples.zh: 在戶外拍攝空中盤旋掠過的飛鳥生態時，請務必切換至連續自動追焦（AF-C）模式。

explains.en: This camera feature adjusts the lens so a person or object looks sharp. It can follow a moving pet or child. Photographers may choose a setting for action.
A camera can automatically focus on a person's eye. Sports photographers use it to keep a moving subject clear. It saves the photographer from adjusting the lens by hand.
Use this word for a camera's ability to focus without manual adjustment. It can track birds in flight. A different mode may work better for still objects.

examples.en: Astrophotographers use manual focus magnification to pinpoint distant bright stars.
examples.zh: 拍攝深空星空銀河的天文攝影師習慣開啟放大手動對焦模式，精準對焦於遠方恆星。

examples.en: Macro photographers often rely on manual focus for razor-thin depth of field adjustments.
examples.zh: 微距生態攝影師往往依賴手動對焦微調，以便在薄如蟬翼的極淺景深中精準捕捉焦點。

examples.en: Turn the smooth lens ring to achieve precise manual focus on the dewdrop.
examples.zh: 緩慢轉動阻尼滑順的鏡頭對焦環，即可在放大畫面中將焦點分毫不差地對準晶瑩水珠。

explains.en: It is a camera setting where the photographer turns a ring to make the subject sharp. It helps with tiny subjects or stars. A steady hand is useful.
Instead of letting the camera choose what looks clear, the photographer adjusts the lens. This is useful for close-up nature photos. Magnification can help.
A person controls the lens to sharpen the desired subject. Photographers use this when automatic settings struggle. A tripod helps keep the image steady.

examples.en: Train tracks and winding mountain roads serve as powerful leading lines in photos.
examples.zh: 筆直延伸的鐵道軌道與蜿蜒綿延的山徑公路常被巧妙運用為引導視線的引導線構圖。

examples.en: Use the edges of the curved bridge as leading lines pointing toward the distant mountain.
examples.zh: 巧妙運用跨海大橋優美的弧形邊緣作為視覺引導線，將觀看者的目光自然引向遠山。

examples.en: Leading lines create a compelling sense of visual depth that draws observers into the scene.
examples.zh: 引導線構圖手法能在二維平面照片中營造出強烈的縱深立體感，引人身臨其境。

explains.en: A road curves from the bottom of a photo toward a mountain. The viewer’s eyes follow it through the picture.
Fence rails point toward a person standing far away. This composition guides attention to the subject.
A bridge edge or row of trees can direct the viewer’s gaze toward the main subject. It also adds depth to a photograph.

examples.en: Framing the iconic temple through blooming cherry blossom branches adds poetic depth.
examples.zh: 巧妙透過盛開粉嫩的櫻花枝枒作為前景自然邊框來框架古剎，增添了詩意深邃的層次。

examples.en: Using an arched stone doorway for framing gives the street scene an old-world charm.
examples.zh: 運用歐風拱形石門作為構圖邊框框架老街街景，賦予了畫面濃厚的古典歷史韻味。

examples.en: Natural framing with tree silhouettes emphasizes the bright full moon in the center.
examples.zh: 以兩側茂密樹影剪影構成天然框架，能強烈襯托並凸顯畫面正中央的一輪皎潔明月。

explains.en: Branches around a temple can draw the viewer's attention to the building. A doorway may also create a border in a picture.
A photographer can place an arch around a street scene. This arrangement makes the view feel older.
Tree shapes can surround a bright moon in the picture. The natural border guides the eye toward the center.

examples.en: Utilizing generous negative space gives minimalist landscape imagery a calm mood.
examples.zh: 大膽運用大面積天空或海面的留白負空間構圖，能賦予極簡風景照寧靜祥和的意境。

examples.en: The lone boat in a vast white ocean demonstrated the elegant power of negative space.
examples.zh: 蒼茫遼闊的一汪碧海中漂泊著一葉孤舟，淋漓盡致地展現了極簡留白構圖的震撼力。

examples.en: Leaving negative space around the portrait subject creates room for viewer contemplation.
examples.zh: 在人像主體四周保留充裕的留白負空間，能為畫面營造出耐人尋味的沉思呼吸空間。

explains.en: This is the empty area around the main subject in a drawing or photograph. Leaving room around a boat can create a calm feeling. It helps viewers focus.
An artist may leave part of a page blank instead of filling every space. This gives the subject room to stand out. It can make an image feel simple.
Use this art term for the open area that surrounds the main object. A clean design can use it well. It is an important part of composition.

examples.en: Landscape photographers wake up early to capture morning mist during golden hour.
examples.zh: 風景攝影同好總是不畏辛勞起大清早，搶在破曉日出黃金時刻捕捉晨霧沐浴在金光中的絕美。

examples.en: The warm amber sunlight during golden hour bathes portraits in a flattering, soft glow.
examples.zh: 日落前黃金時刻溫暖柔和的琥珀色斜陽，為人物臉龐鍍上了一層溫潤迷人的金色光暈。

examples.en: We arrived at the scenic coastal cliff just in time to shoot the sunset golden hour.
examples.zh: 我們頂著海風及時趕抵斷崖觀景平台，恰好趕上了落日時分最夢幻動人的黃金魔幻時刻。

entries.definition: 黃金時刻（日出破曉／日落魔幻時刻）

explains.en: It is the short period after sunrise or before sunset when light looks warm and soft. Portraits can appear flattering. Landscape photographers often plan for it.
Low sunlight casts a gentle amber glow across a scene. A photographer may wake early to capture mist. The light is brief.
During this time, the Sun sits low and colors look warm. It is popular for outdoor portraits and landscapes. Arrive early to set up.

examples.en: Cityscapes look magical during the blue hour when street lamps glow against indigo skies.
examples.zh: 暮色降臨後的藍調時刻是拍攝都會天際線的最佳時機，街道暖黃華燈與深藍夜空相映成趣。

examples.en: The blue hour lasts for only twenty minutes right after sunset, so plan setups early.
examples.zh: 日落後的藍調時刻通常僅短暫持續約二十分鐘，因此務必提前架好腳架調好參數待命。

examples.en: The cool cobalt hue of the blue hour contrasts beautifully with warm glowing storefronts.
examples.zh: 藍調時刻天空深邃靜謐的群青靛藍冷調，與街邊小店溫馨亮起的暖色櫥窗形成絕妙對比。

entries.definition: 藍調時刻（日落後二十分鐘天空深藍）

explains.en: After sunset, the sky turns deep blue while streetlights begin to glow. Photographers often plan to work during this brief light.
The city looks cool and blue just before night becomes dark. Warm shop windows can stand out against the sky.
This short time after sunset can make buildings and roads look dramatic. Arrive early to set up the camera.

examples.en: Overcast cloudy skies provide natural, flattering diffused light for outdoor portraits.
examples.zh: 陰天厚實的雲層宛如一面天然的超大無影柔光罩，為戶外人像攝影提供了柔和細膩的漫射光。

examples.en: She placed a sheer white curtain across the window to create soft diffused lighting.
examples.zh: 她在向陽的大落地窗前拉上一層純白透光薄紗窗簾，營造出溫柔雅緻的室內柔光漫射光效。

examples.en: Diffused light minimizes harsh shadows under the eyes and evens out skin tones nicely.
examples.zh: 柔和的漫射光源能最大程度消除眼窩與鼻翼下方生硬的濃黑陰影，使人物膚質顯得柔嫩均勻。

explains.en: Clouds spread sunlight evenly, so portraits have fewer dark shadows. This kind of light looks gentle.
A thin white curtain can soften sunlight coming through a window. The light falls more evenly on a face.
This describes light that has been spread out instead of coming from one strong point. It can make pictures flattering.

examples.en: Sunset backlight turned the coastal fishermen into striking black silhouettes.
examples.zh: 落日餘暉強烈的逆光將沿海牽罟捕魚的漁民身影勾勒成一幅幅極富張力的黑色剪影。

examples.en: The couple stood hand-in-hand against the bright sunset, forming a romantic silhouette.
examples.zh: 這對年輕伴侶牽手並肩佇立於橘紅色的晚霞餘暉前，勾勒出一抹無比浪漫的身影剪影。

examples.en: Expose for the bright sky background if you want to turn your subject into a crisp silhouette.
examples.zh: 如果想要拍出線條分明的俐落人物剪影，請以明亮的天空背景作為測光基準進行曝光。

examples.en: Oversized boxy silhouettes provide an effortless, relaxed streetwear aesthetic.
examples.zh: 落肩寬鬆的箱型服裝剪裁輪廓能營造出一種隨性不羈、率性自在的現代街頭潮流氛圍。

examples.en: The A-line silhouette of the vintage dress flatters a wide range of body types.
examples.zh: 這件復古洋裝的經典 A 字型剪裁輪廓，對於修飾各種不同體型皆非常友善。

examples.en: High-waisted trousers create a sleek, elongated silhouette that accentuates your waistline.
examples.zh: 高腰剪裁的打褶長褲能勾勒出挺拔修長的下半身輪廓，凸顯纖細腰線線條。

entries.definition: 剪影輪廓；黑影剪影；服裝剪裁輪廓；外觀線條

explains.en: This is the dark outline of a person or object seen against a brighter background. Sunset light can make fishermen look like shapes. A dress can also have a certain overall outline.
A couple standing before a bright sky may appear as a single dark shape. Fashion can use this word for the outline of clothing. Backlighting helps create it.
Use this noun for the visible shape around the edge of a subject. It may be dark against a bright sky. It can also describe the cut or outline of a garment.

examples.en: A sturdy carbon-fiber tripod is essential for shake-free night cityscape exposures.
examples.zh: 一支穩固堅韌的碳纖維三腳架是拍攝超長曝光、確保畫面分毫不晃動的必備夜景重裝。

examples.en: Adjust the extendable legs of the tripod to level your camera on uneven mountain slopes.
examples.zh: 在高低不平的崎嶇山坡岩石上拍攝時，可分別調節三腳架各腳管的伸縮長度來抓水平。

examples.en: Lightweight travel tripods fold down compactly enough to fit inside your carry-on luggage.
examples.zh: 輕量化的便攜旅行碳纖三腳架收合長度極為小巧，可輕鬆收納進隨身登機背包側袋中。

explains.en: It is a three-legged stand that holds a camera steady. Photographers use one for long exposures at night. The legs can be adjusted on uneven ground.
A lightweight model can fold into a travel bag. Extend the legs and level the camera before taking a picture. It helps prevent blur.
This support has three legs and a mount for a camera. It is useful in low light or for landscape photos. A sturdy one stays stable on slopes.

examples.en: Handheld motorized gimbals allow videographers to capture cinematic walking tracking shots.
examples.zh: 手持式三軸電子穩定器（Gimbal）能讓動態錄影師在快步走動運鏡時拍出行雲流水的電影感鏡頭。

examples.en: Balancing your camera body and lens properly on the gimbal prevents motor overheating.
examples.zh: 在啟動三軸穩定器電源前，先細心手動調平機身與鏡頭重心，能避免馬達過載發熱發燙。

examples.en: Using a three-axis gimbal eliminates distracting hand jitters when filming active sports.
examples.zh: 善用三軸電子防震穩定器，能在跟拍劇烈運動追逐奔跑場景時徹底消除手持抖動晃動。

entries.definition: 三軸穩定器；防手震雲台

explains.en: A camera sits on a motorized handle that helps keep the picture steady while someone walks. It can turn smoothly.
Before filming, balance the camera and lens on this stabilizing device. The motors then reduce hand shake.
A videographer uses this tool to capture smooth movement while running or walking. It works with small electric motors.

examples.en: High-speed V90 SD cards handle continuous high-bitrate 4K video recording flawlessly.
examples.zh: 寫入速度高達 V90 等級的超高速 SD 記憶卡能從容因應高碼率 4K 影片的連續不掉幀錄製。

examples.en: Always format your SD card inside the camera before starting an important shoot.
examples.zh: 在開展重大商業拍攝活動之前，請務必先將 SD 記憶卡放入相機機身中進行原廠格式化。

examples.en: Dual SD card slots allow wedding photographers to back up precious photos in real time.
examples.zh: 機身搭載的雙 SD 卡槽設計，讓婚禮紀錄攝影師能在按下快門的同時進行雙卡同步即時備份。

explains.en: This small memory card stores pictures and video in a camera. Check its speed before recording a long movie.
Some cameras have two slots so wedding pictures can be copied safely. Format the card inside the camera first.
A photographer may use a fast version to save clear video. It stores files from a camera.

examples.en: Shooting in uncompressed RAW preserves maximum sensor data for flexible post-processing.
examples.zh: 堅持使用未經壓縮的 RAW 原生無損格式拍攝，能為後期暗房修圖保留最充沛的調整寬容度。

examples.en: RAW image files take up significantly more storage space than standard compressed JPEGs.
examples.zh: 未經破壞性壓縮的 RAW 原生圖檔容量十分龐大，比起一般 JPEG 圖檔耗費數倍硬碟空間。

examples.en: Processing RAW photos allows photographers to recover shadow details without degrading quality.
examples.zh: 在電腦上解讀並微調 RAW 原檔，能讓攝影師在拉亮大片陰影時完全不產生畫質劣化斷階。

entries.definition: RAW 原生無損格式；生鮮的

explains.en: This is a camera file format that keeps much of the original image information from the sensor. Photographers can adjust shadows later. The files need more storage than compressed pictures.
A photographer may save an uncompressed image to have more choices when editing. It can preserve details in dark areas. The format takes up more space.
Use this format when you want maximum flexibility to adjust a photo after taking it. It keeps extra image data. A computer program is usually needed to process it.

examples.en: Adjusting manual white balance corrects yellowish indoor tungsten lighting casts.
examples.zh: 手動微調自訂白平衡（White Balance）能精準校正室內鎢絲燈泡所產生的偏黃暖色調偏色。

examples.en: Setting auto white balance works well under natural daylight but can struggle under mixed lighting.
examples.zh: 機身自動白平衡在室外自然白晝表現不俗，但在複雜的多光源混合環境下偶爾會判定失準。

examples.en: Use a gray card to set a custom white balance for accurate product catalog photography.
examples.zh: 在進行商業靜物商品攝影時，建議使用標準十八度灰卡進行自訂白平衡校準以確保零色差。

explains.en: It is a camera setting that adjusts colors so white objects look white under different lights. Indoor lamps can make pictures yellow. A gray card helps set it.
A photographer may change this setting for daylight or tungsten bulbs. Correct adjustment keeps colors natural. Automatic settings can struggle with mixed light.
This control helps a camera interpret the color of the light in a scene. Setting it accurately improves product photos. It prevents unwanted color casts.

examples.en: Cinematic color grading applies cool teal shadows and warm orange skin tones.
examples.zh: 電影感調色工法巧妙將陰影暗部渲染為清爽的青藍冷色調，並為人物膚色賦予溫暖橙光。

examples.en: The film editor spent two weeks perfecting the mood of the scenes through color grading.
examples.zh: 調色師花了整整兩週時間在專用調色軟體中精雕細琢，藉由色彩調性傳達各場景的情緒張力。

examples.en: Proper color grading ties disparate shots together into a visually unified aesthetic.
examples.zh: 專業細膩的影視調色工序能將不同機位與不同天氣下拍攝的鏡頭素材，串聯成視覺風格統一的佳作。

entries.definition: 影視與照片調色；色彩風格化

explains.en: An editor adjusts colors, brightness, and shadows to give scenes a consistent look. This can make a film feel warm or cool.
A photographer may make the sky darker and skin tones warmer after taking a picture. Careful editing sets the mood.
Colors in separate scenes are adjusted to match one another. This step helps create a visual style.

examples.en: Photography influencers sell custom Lightroom presets to give photos signature film vibes.
examples.zh: 知名攝影網紅紛紛推出個人專屬的 Lightroom 色調預設集（Preset），重現經典底片質感。

examples.en: Applying a retro preset with fine grain gave her digital vacation snapshots an analog feel.
examples.zh: 套用帶有細膩微粒的復古風修圖預設濾鏡，瞬間讓數位相片散發出濃濃的文青底片韻味。

examples.en: You can create and save your own editing presets to speed up batch workflow.
examples.zh: 你可以將自己精心調製的參數儲存為個人專屬預設集，以極大提升大批量照片的批次修圖效率。

entries.definition: 風格色調預設集 (Preset)；預設參數

explains.en: A photographer can save a set of editing choices and use them again. This makes many pictures faster to adjust.
An online artist may sell a saved color style for a photo app. Applying it can give pictures a film look.
A user can save preferred settings for future editing. The term can also name the saved group of settings.

examples.en: Subtle skin retouching removes temporary blemishes while preserving natural pore texture.
examples.zh: 細膩的人像精修手法能在消除皮膚暫時性痘疤瑕疵的同時，完整保留真實自然的毛孔紋理。

examples.en: High-end commercial retouching requires hours of careful frequency separation work.
examples.zh: 頂級時尚雜誌與商業廣告精修大片，往往需要耗費數小時進行專業的高低頻分離細緻工法。

examples.en: Overdone digital retouching can make human skin look plastic, fake, and lifeless.
examples.zh: 過度磨皮美顏的數位精修修圖，會使人物的皮膚質地看起來宛如塑膠假人般僵硬假面。

entries.definition: 人像精修修圖；修飾美化

explains.en: This is making small changes to a photograph after it has been taken. A person may remove a temporary spot from a portrait. Too much can make skin look unnatural.
A photo editor adjusts details such as light or blemishes. Commercial images may need careful work. Overdoing it can make people look unreal.
Use this noun for improving or correcting an image with editing tools. It can smooth small flaws while keeping a natural look. Skilled work takes time.

examples.en: Boosting color saturation too high makes natural skin tones look unnatural and orange.
examples.zh: 若將色彩飽和度調得過高，會讓原本自然白皙的人體膚色顯得過於濃烈死板偏橘。

examples.en: Adjust the color saturation slightly to make the autumn forest foliage look vibrant.
examples.zh: 輕微調高色彩飽和度數值，能讓秋日漫山遍野的楓紅與金黃銀杏林木顯得格外絢爛奪目。

examples.en: Reducing saturation converts vibrant color photographs into moody, timeless monochrome compositions.
examples.zh: 將畫面飽和度降至零，能將五彩繽紛的彩色照片瞬間轉化為沉靜耐看、永恆經典的黑白純色。

explains.en: It is how strong or vivid colors look in a photo. Turning it too high can make skin look unnatural. Lowering it can create a muted style.
A camera editor can adjust this setting to make autumn leaves appear richer. Reducing it all the way removes color. Small changes often look natural.
This color quality describes how intense a hue appears. It can make a forest look bright or muted. In chemistry, the same word has other meanings.

examples.en: Full-frame cameras feature larger sensors that gather more light in dim conditions.
examples.zh: 全片幅相機擁有面積更大的感光元件，在微光昏暗環境下能吸收更多光子、呈現純淨畫質。

examples.en: Upgrading to a full-frame body provides shallower depth of field and richer tones.
examples.zh: 機身升級換成全片幅規格後，能帶來更具視覺張力的淺景深虛化效果與更細膩的階調過渡。

examples.en: Full-frame lenses are specifically designed to cast an image circle covering the 35mm sensor.
examples.zh: 全片幅專用鏡頭經過精密光學設計，其成像圈能完整無裁切地涵蓋整個 35mm 尺寸感光晶片。

entries.definition: 全片幅感光元件的 (35mm 等效)

explains.en: A camera sensor is the same size as a traditional 35mm film frame. It can gather more light than many smaller sensors.
Photographers may choose this camera body for low-light pictures or a blurred background. The sensor inside is relatively large.
Lenses designed for this format cover the whole sensor area. A smaller camera may use a different size.

examples.en: Check the camera's shutter count when purchasing pre-owned photography gear.
examples.zh: 在選購二手中古相機機身時，請務必先透過專業軟體檢測相機已按壓的快門釋放次數。

examples.en: The professional body had a shutter count of barely 5,000 actuations and was in mint condition.
examples.zh: 這台專業旗艦機身的快門釋放次數僅僅五千多次，整體外觀與機件功能近乎全新。

examples.en: Most modern mechanical camera shutters are rated for at least two hundred thousand clicks.
examples.zh: 絕大多數現代專業級相機的精密機械快門簾結構，其官方設計使用壽命皆達二十萬次以上。

entries.definition: 快門次數；快門使用壽命

explains.en: This number shows how many times a camera has taken a picture. It can help when buying used equipment.
A camera has a part that opens and closes to let light reach the sensor. Its total actions show how much it has been used.
Most camera makers rate this part for many uses. A small number may mean the camera has seen less work.

examples.en: Wildlife photographers use heavy 600mm telephoto lenses to photograph nesting eagles.
examples.zh: 鳥類生態攝影師架設重達數公斤的 600mm 超望遠大砲定焦鏡頭以遠距離記錄黑鳶育雛。

examples.en: A telephoto lens compresses perspective, making distant background mountains appear closer.
examples.zh: 長焦望遠鏡頭具有強烈的空間壓縮感光學特性，能讓畫面後方遠在天邊的雪山顯得無比貼近。

examples.en: He attached a compact 70-200mm telephoto lens to capture candid portraits from across the street.
examples.zh: 他在機身上接上一支便攜的 70-200mm 望遠變焦鏡頭，站在馬路對街輕鬆抓拍自然的街頭神態。

entries.definition: 望遠的；超望遠大砲鏡頭

explains.en: This describes a camera lens that makes faraway subjects appear closer. Wildlife photographers use one to capture birds without approaching them. It can also compress the look of distance.
A long lens can take a close picture of an eagle in a nest. It may make distant mountains look nearer to a person in front. It is useful for portraits from far away.
Use this adjective or noun for a lens designed to photograph distant objects. It helps keep a safe space from animals. The picture may show a narrow view.

examples.en: Dedicated 1:1 macro lenses reveal dew drops glistening on spider webs.
examples.zh: 專業的一比一放大倍率微距鏡頭能細膩捕捉清晨蛛網上晶瑩剔透、折射光芒的晨露水珠。

examples.en: In macro photography, maintaining steady hands is critical because slight movements blur details.
examples.zh: 在微距攝影的微觀世界中，保持雙手絕對穩定至關重要，任何微小晃動都會使細節脫焦模糊。

examples.en: She captured the intricate compound eyes of a dragonfly using an extreme macro setup.
examples.zh: 他運用高倍率專業超微距攝影套組，將蜻蜓宛如蜂巢般精密複雜的複眼構造分毫不差地放大拍下。

entries.definition: 微距攝影的；微距鏡頭；宏觀的

explains.en: It describes photography that shows very small subjects in great detail. A close view can reveal dew on a spiderweb. Steady hands help keep it sharp.
A special lens can photograph an insect's tiny eyes. This type of close-up work makes small details appear large. Movement can blur the image.
This adjective can describe a lens or photographic style for making small subjects fill the frame. It is useful for flowers and insects. The word can also mean large-scale in other contexts.

examples.en: Mt. Hehuan Dark Sky Park is Taiwan's premier sanctuary for astrophotography.
examples.zh: 合歡山國際暗空公園是全台灣最具指標性、最受全球星空同好推崇的天文攝影聖地。

examples.en: Astrophotography requires tracking mounts to counteract Earth's rotation during long exposures.
examples.zh: 進行深空天文攝影時通常需要架設精密的赤道儀追星儀，以抵消地球自轉所導致的星點拖線。

examples.en: Enthusiasts stayed awake all night braving freezing temperatures to photograph the Milky Way.
examples.zh: 星空攝影愛好者頂著高山零下低溫通宵未眠，只為將壯麗銀河橫跨天際的浩瀚景象定格於鏡頭。

entries.definition: 深空天文攝影；星空攝影

explains.en: A photographer uses a camera and a long exposure to capture stars and galaxies. A dark location helps.
Some people stay up late to photograph the Milky Way above a mountain. A tripod keeps the camera still.
The camera records faint objects in the night sky, such as star clusters. Special tracking equipment can help.

examples.en: Drone aerial photography reveals geometric tea plantations from a bird's-eye perspective.
examples.zh: 無人機空拍攝影從高空鳥瞰視角完美展現了如幾何圖形般整齊排列的高山梯田茶園之美。

examples.en: The city offers helicopter aerial tours for breathtaking panoramic views of the skyline.
examples.zh: 該濱海城市推出了直升機高空觀光遊覽行程，帶領旅客以全景鳥瞰視角俯瞰壯麗的都會天際線。

examples.en: An aerial view showed the full extent of the flooded farmland after the typhoon passed.
examples.zh: 颱風暴雨過境後，空拍機傳回的高空鳥瞰畫面完整揭示了沿河農田大面積積水受災的真實景象。

entries.definition: 空中的；空拍鳥瞰的；航空的

explains.en: A drone can take pictures from high above a tea field. This view shows the whole area.
A helicopter may carry visitors over a city for a wide view. The picture is taken from the sky.
After a typhoon, a picture from above can show how much farmland flooded. This adjective describes a view from the air.

examples.en: Award-winning photojournalism documents human resilience during historic crises.
examples.zh: 榮獲普立茲獎的新聞攝影作品以震撼人心的鏡頭語言記錄了人類在重大歷史危機中的堅韌人性。

examples.en: Photojournalism demands strict adherence to truth, prohibiting manipulative staging or digital alteration.
examples.zh: 新聞紀實攝影要求對客觀真實恪守崇高準則，嚴厲禁止任何形式的人為擺拍演出或惡意後製竄改。

examples.en: Her compelling photojournalism on climate change was featured on the magazine's front cover.
examples.zh: 她深入極地拍攝針對全球氣候變遷危機的深度紀實專題報導，榮登國際權威雜誌的跨頁封面。

entries.definition: 新聞攝影；紀實攝影新聞學

explains.en: This is reporting news and real events through photographs. A picture can show how people survive a crisis. The photographer should present what really happened.
A news photographer records important events with images. They should not stage a scene or change it misleadingly. Their work may appear on a magazine cover.
Use this term for journalism that tells stories through photographs. It can document climate events or human struggles. Truth and fairness matter.

examples.en: Curating a printed photobook gives digital pictures a lasting, tangible presence.
examples.zh: 精心挑選作品編排並印刷一本有溫度的實體精裝攝影集，能賦予數位影像永恆的觸感與生命。

examples.en: He spent months choosing fine archival paper and cloth binding for his debut photobook.
examples.zh: 他花費數月時間為個人首部獨立攝影集挑選頂級無酸藝術紙與細膩溫潤的手工布質精裝包邊。

examples.en: The photobook documents ten years of traditional craftsmen working in old Tainan neighborhoods.
examples.zh: 這部厚實的人文攝影集詳盡記錄了過去十年間默默在台南老城街坊間堅守老手藝的傳統匠人。

entries.definition: 攝影集；精裝相本寫真書

explains.en: It is a printed book that presents photographs. A family may collect pictures from a trip. Archival paper can help them last.
A photographer may arrange images into a bound volume about a place or subject. It gives digital pictures a physical form. The pages can tell a story.
This book is made mainly of photographs. A craftsperson may choose fine paper and cloth binding. It can document years of local history.

examples.en: Great visual storytelling transcends technical sharpness, touching human hearts.
examples.zh: 卓越感人的視覺敘事力量遠遠超越了器材像素銳利度的追求，能深深直擊並觸動人心。

examples.en: Campfire storytelling has been a cherished human tradition for tens of thousands of years.
examples.zh: 圍坐在跳躍溫暖的營火旁聆聽長老口耳相傳說故事，是人類文明延續了數萬年的珍貴傳統。

examples.en: Documentary photography relies on narrative storytelling to shed light on marginalized communities.
examples.zh: 深度紀實人文攝影仰賴深刻動人的敘事力量，讓社會大眾關注並理解各角落弱勢族群的處境。

examples.en: Compelling brand storytelling connects urban tea drinkers with misty Alishan organic plantations.
examples.zh: 透過打動人心的品牌故事力（Storytelling），將都會品茗愛好者與雲霧繚繞的阿里山有機茶園深刻連結。

examples.en: Authentic storytelling reveals the dedication of multi-generational farming families cultivating heritage rice strains.
examples.zh: 真摯動人的文史敘事記錄了數代農民家族百年守護本土原生米種的心路歷程與堅持。

examples.en: Museums are shifting toward interactive storytelling to make regional archaeology engaging for younger audiences.
examples.zh: 現代博物館逐步導入互動式沉浸敘事手法，讓生硬的在地考古文物與地方文史對年輕世代更具吸引力。

examples.en: Memorable gastronomy is an art of emotional storytelling that evokes childhood memories with every bite.
examples.zh: 令人終生難忘的頂級美饌，是一門動人的「說故事藝術」（Storytelling），用滋味勾起食客心底最溫暖的鄉愁。

examples.en: The indigenous elder used oral storytelling around the hearth fire to preserve tribal history and folklore.
examples.zh: 原住民部落耆老圍坐在營火炭火旁，藉由口述長老的口傳說故事傳統，世代傳承部落歷史與古老神話。

examples.en: Great advertising campaigns rely on compelling brand storytelling rather than aggressive sales slogans.
examples.zh: 真正撼動人心的廣告宣傳行銷企劃，仰賴扣人心弦的品牌情感敘事力，而非廉價刺耳的推銷口號。

examples.en: Masterful storytelling in English lets you introduce our night markets, mountains, and values to international friends.
examples.zh: 用流利英語展現動人的「說故事藝術」（Storytelling），向世界自豪介紹台灣夜市、高山美景與人情價值。

examples.en: Compelling visual storytelling transformed the non-profit campaign into a viral global movement.
examples.zh: 扣人心弦的視覺化敘事藝術，將這項公益倡議專案打造成席捲全球社群的現象級運動。

examples.en: Effective marketing leaders use emotional storytelling to forge authentic connections with customers.
examples.zh: 傑出的行銷領導人擅長運用真情實感的敘事手法，與目標受眾建立起真實深刻的情感共鳴。

entries.definition: 敘事表達；用影像說故事；地方文史敘事力；說故事；透過每道菜餚訴說風土與兒時記憶之說故事藝術；向世界各國朋友熱情分享台灣風土故事之說故事藝術

explains.en: A photo essay shows how a family rebuilt after a flood. The images share events and feelings.
A grandparent tells a tale around a fire to pass down family history. People have shared stories this way for generations.
A restaurant may explain the farms and traditions behind its dishes. This helps guests understand the meal’s meaning.

examples.en: Taiwan's National Health Insurance (NHI) provides affordable, world-class healthcare.
examples.zh: 台灣全民健康保險（NHI）為全體國民提供了平價普及且享譽全球的頂級醫療照護。

examples.en: Access to quality healthcare is a fundamental human right for every citizen.
examples.zh: 享有優質普及的醫療照護服務是每一位公民不可剝奪的基本人權。

examples.en: The government increased public spending to improve rural healthcare facilities.
examples.zh: 政府大幅擴大公共財政投資規模，以全面改善升級偏鄉地區的基層醫療照護硬體設施。

examples.en: Taiwan's universal healthcare system is globally acclaimed for its exceptional efficiency, accessibility, and quality.
examples.zh: 台灣全民健康保險智慧醫療體系以其卓越的覆蓋率、極佳便利性與高水準醫療品質享譽全球。

examples.en: Investing in preventative healthcare reduces long-term hospitalization costs across aging societies.
examples.zh: 大力投資發展預防醫學與基層健康保健，能顯著降低高齡化社會長期的公立醫院住院醫療支出。

examples.en: Dedicated healthcare workers sacrificed family time during the pandemic to staff quarantine wards.
examples.zh: 滿懷崇高使命感的第一線醫事與醫療保健工作人員，在疫情肆虐期間犧牲天倫之樂日夜留守隔離病房。

entries.definition: 醫療照護；全民健保制度；全民智慧醫療體系；醫療保健

explains.en: People visit doctors or hospitals to keep well or treat illness. Taiwan offers a national system for this care.
Preventing sickness may cost less than staying in a hospital for a long time. Rural areas need good clinics too.
Nurses and doctors support people during a pandemic. This field includes medical services and prevention.

examples.en: Register online in advance to avoid waiting at the hospital outpatient department.
examples.zh: 建議提前透過手機網路掛號系統預約，以節省在醫學中心大醫院門診大廳排隊的時間。

examples.en: Minor cosmetic surgeries are usually performed in outpatient clinics without overnight stays.
examples.zh: 輕微的醫美整型微創手術通常直接在門診診所進行，術後當天即可返家不需留院過夜。

examples.en: The outpatient pharmacy dispenses hundreds of prescriptions to visiting patients daily.
examples.zh: 醫院門診藥局每天為前來回診看診的廣大門診病患調劑並核發數以百計的處方藥物。

explains.en: This is a person who receives medical care at a clinic or hospital but does not stay overnight. A minor operation may be done this way. They go home afterward.
Someone may visit a clinic for an exam or treatment and leave the same day. The pharmacy may serve these visitors. No hospital bed is needed overnight.
Use this noun or adjective for care that does not require a patient to sleep in the hospital. A person returns home after an appointment. Clinics often provide it.

examples.en: Inpatient wards provide 24-hour nursing care and monitoring after major surgery.
examples.zh: 現代化住院病房在重大手術後提供二十四小時不間斷的細緻護理照護與生命徵象監測。

examples.en: The doctor recommended an inpatient stay of at least three days for observation.
examples.zh: 主治醫師建議病患至少留院住院觀察三天，以便隨時評估術後各項指標恢復狀況。

examples.en: Inpatient treatment allows medical staff to manage complex infections with intravenous therapies.
examples.zh: 住院治療能讓專業醫護團隊透過靜脈注射等積極療法，嚴密控管複雜嚴重的全身性感染。

explains.en: It refers to someone who stays in a hospital overnight or longer for treatment. Nurses monitor them around the clock. A doctor may recommend this after surgery.
A person receiving care inside a hospital ward may need several days there. Staff can give medicine through a vein. This adjective describes that treatment.
Someone may remain in a medical facility while doctors manage a serious illness. They receive care day and night. This describes that person's hospital status.

examples.en: Emergency room nurses perform triage to treat life-threatening traumas immediately.
examples.zh: 急診室護理師第一時間進行專業檢傷分類，以確保危及生命的重症病患獲得即刻搶救。

examples.en: Effective emergency triage categorizes arriving patients by medical urgency rather than arrival time.
examples.zh: 高效的急診檢傷分級制度依據病情的緊急與危急程度排序救治，而非先來後到的排隊順序。

examples.en: During disaster relief operations, medical triage helps allocate limited resources where most needed.
examples.zh: 在突發重大災難救援現場，精準的醫療檢傷分類有助於將有限的急救資源集中於最危急者。

examples.en: Automated emergency triage systems prioritize chest pain patients showing early signs of heart attacks.
examples.zh: 智慧急診檢傷分類系統（Triage）會將出現急性心肌梗塞徵兆的胸痛急症病患自動列為最高優先搶救等級。

examples.en: During mass casualty transportation accidents, experienced triage nurses categorize injured victims within seconds.
examples.zh: 在重大集體交通事故現場，資深急診護理師依據檢傷標準在數秒內迅速為傷患繫上紅黃綠黑檢傷分類手環。

examples.en: The tech support manager had to triage incoming bug tickets during the critical holiday software rollout.
examples.zh: 在電商年終購物節旗艦版本軟體上線之際，資深資訊主管必須親自對雪片般湧入的系統通報進行緊急分級優先處理。

entries.definition: 急診檢傷分類；檢傷分級；急診智慧五級檢傷分類；分診

explains.en: At a busy emergency room, staff check patients and decide who needs help most urgently. People with serious problems are seen first.
After a large accident, medical teams quickly sort injured people by how urgently they need care. This helps organize treatment.
A technical support manager may sort computer problems by importance. Doctors use a similar process for patients.

examples.en: Pediatricians monitor infant developmental milestones and administer routine vaccines.
examples.zh: 專業小兒科醫師定期評估嬰幼兒的生長發育里程碑，並按時施打各項公費常規疫苗。

examples.en: The caring pediatrician comforted the crying toddler with a colorful puppet toy.
examples.zh: 充滿愛心與耐心的小兒科醫師拿出色彩繽紛的手偶玩偶，輕聲安撫嚎啕大哭的小寶寶。

examples.en: New parents should choose a reliable pediatrician located close to their home.
examples.zh: 初為人父母的新手爸媽，在挑選小兒科家庭醫師時最好優先考慮離家近且評價優良的診所。

explains.en: This doctor cares for babies, children, and teenagers. Parents may visit for vaccines or checkups.
A gentle medical professional can comfort a toddler during a visit. Choose a clinic close to home.
When a child is ill, this specialist checks their health. The doctor also watches how children grow.

examples.en: Consult a board-certified dermatologist for persistent eczema and allergic rashes.
examples.zh: 若皮膚出現頑固難纏的濕疹反覆發作或急性過敏紅疹，請儘速諮詢專業皮膚科醫師。

examples.en: The dermatologist examined the unusual mole on his shoulder to rule out melanoma.
examples.zh: 皮膚科專科醫師使用皮膚鏡仔細放大檢查他肩膀上形狀異常的黑痣，以排除黑色素瘤。

examples.en: She visited her dermatologist to receive a customized treatment plan for acne scars.
examples.zh: 她專程前往皮膚專科診所尋求醫師協助，針對青春痘凹疤量身規劃專屬的雷射修復療程。

explains.en: This is a doctor who specializes in skin, hair, and nail problems. They can check an unusual mole. They may suggest a plan for acne or eczema.
A person with a lasting rash may visit this kind of doctor. The doctor examines the skin and recommends treatment. They can also check a spot for danger.
Use this noun for a medical specialist who cares for skin conditions. They help with acne and allergic rashes. Ask one about changes in a mole.

examples.en: Regular visits to the ophthalmologist detect early glaucoma and macular degeneration.
examples.zh: 定期至眼科診所接受眼底檢查能及早發現青光眼與黃斑部病變等潛在視力威脅。

examples.en: The ophthalmologist performed delicate laser eye surgery to correct her severe myopia.
examples.zh: 眼科名醫親自操刀執行極其精細的飛秒準分子近視雷射手術，一舉矯正了她的高度近視。

examples.en: Diabetic patients should have their retinas examined annually by an ophthalmologist.
examples.zh: 糖尿病病友每年皆應至少接受一次眼科專科醫師的散瞳視網膜檢查，防範視網膜病變。

explains.en: It is a doctor who specializes in the eyes and vision. Regular visits can help find glaucoma early. This doctor may also perform eye surgery.
Someone with this medical specialty can examine the retina and treat eye diseases. Patients with diabetes may need yearly checks. They can prescribe treatment.
This physician cares for conditions affecting sight and the eyes. They may use a laser to correct vision. Do not confuse the role with a glasses fitter.

examples.en: Nurses record vital signs, including body temperature, pulse, and blood pressure.
examples.zh: 護理人員定時測量並記錄病患的體溫、脈搏跳動、呼吸頻率與血壓等四大生命徵象。

examples.en: Stable vital signs indicate that the critically ill patient is responding well to treatment.
examples.zh: 幾項生命徵象數值逐漸回歸穩定正常範圍，表明重症病患對當前的醫療處置反應良好。

examples.en: Electronic monitors track the patient's vital signs continuously during intensive care.
examples.zh: 加護病房床頭的高階生理監視器二十四小時即時連線，不分晝夜監測病患各項生命徵象。

entries.definition: 生命徵象（體溫、脈搏、呼吸、血壓）

explains.en: A nurse checks body temperature, pulse, breathing, and blood pressure. These measurements help show how the body is doing.
A monitor tracks a patient’s heartbeat and breathing in a hospital. Staff watch for changes.
Doctors may check these basic body measurements during an exam. A high fever or fast pulse can be important to notice.

examples.en: The doctor placed the cold stethoscope on his chest to listen to lung sounds.
examples.zh: 醫師將聽診器貼在病患胸口與背部，仔細聆聽肺部呼吸音與心臟跳動雜音。

examples.en: A physician carries a stethoscope around her neck as an indispensable diagnostic tool.
examples.zh: 每一位內科醫師脖子上總是隨身掛著一副聽診器，作為臨床問診觸診時不可或缺的利器。

examples.en: Through the stethoscope, the doctor detected a faint heart murmur during the examination.
examples.zh: 在聽診過程中，醫師透過聽診器靈敏地捕捉到了心臟瓣膜處傳來的一絲微弱心雜音。

explains.en: A doctor places this tool on a person's chest to listen to the heart or lungs. It has earpieces.
A physician may wear this around the neck during an exam. It helps hear sounds inside the body.
This medical tool makes quiet heart sounds easier to hear. A doctor can use it to check a patient.

examples.en: Applying an ice pack reduces localized tissue swelling and acute inflammation.
examples.zh: 在受傷初期適度冰敷能有效緩解局部軟組織腫脹並抑制急性發炎反應。

examples.en: Chronic systemic inflammation has been linked to heart disease and premature aging.
examples.zh: 醫學研究證實，人體長期的慢性全身性低度發炎與心血管硬化及早衰現象息息相關。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed oral anti-inflammatory pills to reduce joint swelling and inflammation.
examples.zh: 醫師為關節紅腫熱痛的病患開立了口服消炎處方藥物，以抑制局部組織發炎並減緩疼痛。

explains.en: This is the body's response to injury or infection, often causing redness, warmth, or swelling. A doctor may suggest care to ease it. Long-lasting cases can affect health.
When a joint or patch of skin becomes swollen and sore, the body may be responding this way. Medicine can sometimes reduce it. A health professional can explain the cause.
Use this noun for a body's reaction that makes tissue hot, swollen, or painful. It can happen after an injury. Treatment depends on the cause.

examples.en: Resting in a dark, quiet room alleviates severe throbbing migraine attacks.
examples.zh: 在昏暗無聲的安靜房間內閉目靜養能顯著減輕劇烈抽痛的搏動性偏頭痛發作。

examples.en: Bright flashing lights and intense workplace stress often trigger her painful migraines.
examples.zh: 刺眼的閃爍強光與高壓窒息的職場工作壓力，往往是誘發她單側搏動性偏頭痛的導火線。

examples.en: Modern migraine prescription treatments target specific pain receptors to stop episodes early.
examples.zh: 當代最新一代的偏頭痛處方標靶針劑能專一性阻斷疼痛受體，在發作早期迅速中止劇痛。

entries.definition: 偏頭痛；血管搏動性頭痛

explains.en: It is a severe headache that may throb and come with nausea or sensitivity to light. A dark, quiet room can help. Stress may trigger an episode.
Some people experience a painful attack after bright flashing lights. A doctor can discuss treatments. Resting away from noise may bring relief.
This condition can cause strong head pain and make everyday tasks hard. Some medicines target the pain. Speak with a health professional if it happens often.

examples.en: The pancreas produces natural insulin to regulate glucose absorption in the blood.
examples.zh: 人體胰臟會自然分泌胰島素荷爾蒙，以調控血液中葡萄糖的吸收與代謝平衡。

examples.en: Type 1 diabetics require daily subcutaneous insulin injections to maintain proper health.
examples.zh: 第一型糖尿病患者由於自體免疫因素無法自行合成胰島素，因此必須終身每日施打皮下胰島素。

examples.en: Improved insulin sensitivity through strength training helps control post-meal blood spikes.
examples.zh: 透過每週規律的肌力重量訓練提升全身骨骼肌的胰島素敏感度，有助於平抑飯後血糖飆升。

explains.en: The pancreas makes a hormone that helps move sugar from the blood into the body’s cells. Some people need medicine when their bodies cannot make enough.
A doctor may prescribe injections or another form of treatment to help manage blood sugar. Follow the clinician’s instructions.
This hormone helps control the amount of glucose in the blood. People with diabetes may need medical care involving it.

examples.en: Strictly follow the recommended medicine dosage; never exceed two tablets per day.
examples.zh: 請嚴格恪遵藥袋上標註的建議劑量服用，切勿為了求快而自行加倍劑量或超量服用。

examples.en: The pediatrician calculated the precise liquid medicine dosage based on the toddler's weight.
examples.zh: 小兒科醫師嚴謹地依據幼兒的體重公斤數，精準換算出口服退燒藥水的毫升數安全劑量。

examples.en: Doubling your dosage will not speed up recovery and could cause dangerous toxic poisoning.
examples.zh: 擅自將每次服藥劑量加倍不僅絲毫無法加速病體痊癒，甚至極可能引發嚴重的肝腎藥物中毒。

explains.en: Read the label to learn how much medicine to take. A doctor may choose an amount based on a child's weight.
