examples.en: Cinch the waist belt tightly to create an elegant hourglass silhouette with your trench coat.
examples.zh: 將風衣腰帶隨性扣緊打結，能立即勒出優雅迷人的沙漏型腰身比例與俐落線條。

explains.en: It is a long, often double-breasted raincoat with a belt. The design began as military clothing. It is now popular in cities.
This coat can protect someone from chilly autumn rain. It often has buttons and a waist belt. It looks stylish with jeans or a suit.
A person may wear this belted outer garment over other clothes. It is usually made from water-resistant fabric. A collar can be turned up in wind.

examples.en: Pair an unstructured navy blazer with white sneakers for Friday office meetings.
examples.zh: 在輕鬆的週五便服日，以深藍色軟呢休閒西裝外套混搭簡約小白鞋，展現得體幹練。

examples.en: She tossed an oversized tweed blazer over her shoulders for an effortlessly chic look.
examples.zh: 她將一件微墊肩落肩粗花呢西裝外套隨意披在肩頭，營造出漫不經心的時髦優雅。

examples.en: A black tailored blazer can transition smoothly from daytime business meetings to evening cocktails.
examples.zh: 一件黑色合身剪裁休閒西裝外套，能無縫切換白天的商務會議與晚間的餐敘酒會。

entries.definition: 休閒西裝外套；便服西裝

explains.en: A person wears this smart jacket over a shirt to make an outfit look neat. It can be less formal than a matching suit.
A navy jacket with buttons works for a school event or office meeting. It pairs well with trousers or jeans.
This tailored outer layer can be worn with clothes of a different color. It adds a polished look.

examples.en: Keep a cozy knit cardigan on your office chair to combat freezing air conditioning.
examples.zh: 在辦公室椅背上常備一件柔軟親膚的開襟針織小外套，隨時應對室內超強冷氣房低溫。

examples.en: He buttoned up his chunky wool cardigan and sat by the crackling fireplace.
examples.zh: 他扣好身上厚實粗棒針開襟羊毛衫的鈕扣，悠閒地坐在噼啪作響的壁爐旁取暖。

examples.en: A cropped pastel cardigan adds a sweet, feminine touch when paired with high-waisted denim.
examples.zh: 短版馬卡龍粉彩色開襟針織衫搭配高腰牛仔褲，能為整體休閒穿搭增添甜美溫柔氣質。

entries.definition: 開襟針織羊毛衫；針織外套

explains.en: This knitted sweater opens down the front and usually has buttons. It can keep someone warm in an office.
A person may wear this wool garment over a shirt beside a fireplace. It is easy to take off.
A cropped version can go with jeans. The open front makes this sweater different from one pulled over the head.

examples.en: A heavyweight fleece-lined hoodie is the ultimate comfort wear for weekend lounging.
examples.zh: 內裡加絨加厚的厚磅連帽衛衣（帽 T）是週末在家放鬆追劇或下樓買咖啡最舒適的慵懶單品。

examples.en: He pulled the drawstring on his oversized gray hoodie to block out the chilly morning wind.
examples.zh: 他拉緊寬鬆灰色帽 T 上的抽繩，抵擋清晨迎面吹來的刺骨冷風。

examples.en: Layering a denim jacket over a hooded sweatshirt creates a timeless casual street look.
examples.zh: 在連帽衛衣外面疊穿一件刷色丹寧牛仔夾克，是經典永恆、充滿青春氣息的街頭風格。

entries.definition: 連帽衛衣 (帽 T)；連帽衫

explains.en: This is a casual sweatshirt with a hood, often with a front pocket. People wear it to stay warm while relaxing. It can have strings around the hood.
A soft fleece-lined top may be worn on a chilly morning. Pulling the hood over the head blocks some wind. It is common casual clothing.
Use this noun for a comfortable top with a hood. It may be zipped or pulled over the head. It pairs well with jeans.

examples.en: A slim black turtleneck layered beneath an overcoat exudes Parisian sophistication.
examples.zh: 在長版毛呢大衣內搭一件合身顯瘦的黑色高領打底衫，舉手投足間散發法式優雅知性美。

examples.en: Roll the collar of your wool turtleneck down neatly to frame your jawline.
examples.zh: 將羊毛高領毛衣的領口工整向下折疊翻捲，能漂亮修飾俐落的下顎線條。

examples.en: Wearing a merino turtleneck keeps your neck warm without needing an extra scarf outdoors.
examples.zh: 在戶外穿著一件美麗諾高領打底衫能為頸部鎖住溫暖，省去了額外圍圍巾的麻煩。

explains.en: It is a sweater or shirt with a high collar that covers the neck. Wool can keep someone warm outdoors. The collar may fold down.
A person can wear this top under an overcoat in cold weather. It removes the need for a scarf. The neck is covered by fabric.
This garment has a close collar reaching up around the neck. It can be made from merino wool. Some versions are thin enough to layer.

examples.en: High-waisted flowing culottes elongate legs while allowing effortless movement.
examples.zh: 高腰垂墜感極佳的西裝及踝闊腿寬褲能在視覺上極致拉長腿部比例，且走起路來步履生風。

examples.en: Linen culottes are a comfortable, airy choice for sweltering summer city walks.
examples.zh: 純亞麻材質的七分闊腿褲在酷熱盛夏的城市漫步中，是無比清涼透氣且舒適的穿搭首選。

examples.en: She paired pleated culottes with pointed-toe heels for a modern, architectural silhouette.
examples.zh: 她以打褶闊腿裙褲搭配一雙俐落尖頭細高跟鞋，勾勒出極具現代建築感的俐落立體廓形。

entries.definition: 寬版及膝裙褲；闊腿寬褲

explains.en: These wide-legged bottoms look like a skirt but have separate legs. They are comfortable for walking.
A person pairs pleated, loose-fitting pants with heels for a smart outfit. The fabric moves freely.
This clothing style has broad legs and often reaches the knees or calves. It combines the look of a skirt with the ease of pants.

examples.en: Vintage denim overalls paired with striped tees create a playful, retro vibe.
examples.zh: 刷色復古經典的丹寧牛仔吊帶褲內搭一件法式條紋 T 恤，營造出俏皮活潑的減齡復古感。

examples.en: The mechanic slipped into a pair of durable cotton overalls before servicing the car engine.
examples.zh: 汽車維修技師在動手檢修汽車引擎之前，穿上了耐磨防油污的厚棉連身工作服。

examples.en: Roll up the cuffs of baggy overalls to show off colorful socks and retro skate shoes.
examples.zh: 將寬鬆吊帶褲的褲管隨意往上翻折兩折，剛好露出一截亮眼跳色短襪與復古滑板鞋。

entries.definition: 丹寧吊帶褲；工作連身褲

explains.en: This work outfit has a bib and straps over the shoulders. A mechanic may wear it to protect clothes.
Some people wear denim trousers with straps for a playful look. The cuffs can be rolled up.
A worker may put on this durable one-piece garment before repairing a car. It has many pockets.

examples.en: Classic leather horsebit loafers add an air of polished refinement to work attire.
examples.zh: 經典馬銜扣黑色真皮樂福鞋能為日常通勤辦公穿搭增添一抹精緻講究的學院英倫紳士風範。

examples.en: Suede penny loafers slip on effortlessly without the hassle of tying shoe laces.
examples.zh: 絨面麂皮便士樂福鞋穿脫極為輕鬆隨性，完全省去了反覆彎腰繫綁鞋帶的瑣碎麻煩。

examples.en: Pair dark brown loafers with tailored cropped trousers for an elegant collegiate Ivy look.
examples.zh: 以深棕色樂福鞋搭配九分打褶西裝長褲，能完美演繹優雅雋永的美式常春藤學院風。

explains.en: These are low shoes that slip on without laces. Leather ones can look polished at work. Suede styles go well with casual clothes.
A person can put on this footwear quickly because it has no shoelaces. Some have a small decoration across the front. They are popular with office clothes.
Use this plural noun for a kind of comfortable slip-on shoe. It can be made from leather or suede. The shoe is easy to wear with trousers.

examples.en: Elastic-sided Chelsea boots slip on easily and resist rainy winter puddles.
examples.zh: 兩側附有高彈性織帶的真皮雀爾喜短靴穿脫極為便捷，雨天出門踩水也能常保帥氣乾爽。

examples.en: Black leather Chelsea boots are versatile footwear that complements slim-fit jeans and wool suits alike.
examples.zh: 黑色真皮雀爾喜靴是極度百搭的必備鞋款，無論是搭合身牛仔褲還是毛呢西裝都極為合適。

examples.en: The pull-tab at the heel helps you slide smoothly into your Chelsea boots in seconds.
examples.zh: 靴筒後側貼心設計的提鞋拉耳，能讓你在短短數秒內輕鬆順滑地穿進雀爾喜靴中。

entries.definition: 雀爾喜靴；鬆緊側帶短踝靴

explains.en: They are ankle-high leather boots with elastic panels on the sides. A heel tab helps someone pull them on. They are easy to wear with jeans.
This style of short boot has stretchy side pieces instead of laces. The design can resist rain. It works with casual or formal clothes.
A person can slide into these ankle boots using a loop at the back. They often have smooth leather and a simple shape. The side panels stretch.

examples.en: A durable organic cotton canvas tote holds laptops, books, and grocery goods.
examples.zh: 厚實耐磨的純棉帆布大托特包容量超大，能輕鬆裝入十五吋筆電、書籍與超市採買小物。

examples.en: Many bookstores give away printed canvas totes to promote literacy and reduce single-use bags.
examples.zh: 許多獨立文青書店會贈送印有文宣字樣的帆布托特包，以提倡閱讀並減少一次性塑膠袋。

examples.en: A structured leather tote bag is the quintessential work bag for modern professionals on the move.
examples.zh: 一款外觀俐落立體的真皮公事托特包，是現代職場商務人士通勤奔波時最無懈可擊的百搭包款。

explains.en: A person carries books and groceries in a large open bag with two handles. Some are made of cloth.
A bookstore gives customers a reusable bag to carry their purchases. It can hold a laptop too.
This roomy carryall is easy to take to work or shopping. A leather version can look more formal.

examples.en: Compact leather crossbody bags keep your hands free during lively night market strolls.
examples.zh: 輕巧隨身的小巧真皮斜背包能解放雙手，讓您在熱鬧的台灣觀光夜市逛街吃小吃毫無負擔。

examples.en: Adjust the wide strap of your crossbody bag so the pouch sits comfortably on your hip.
examples.zh: 調節好斜背包的寬版減壓背帶長度，讓包身恰到好處、舒適地貼靠在骨盆髖部兩側。

examples.en: A lightweight nylon crossbody bag is an ideal companion for safeguarding passports while traveling abroad.
examples.zh: 一款防潑水且超輕量的尼龍斜背包，是出國旅遊時貼身保管護照與重要證件的最佳神隊友。

explains.en: A small purse with a long strap can rest across the chest. It keeps both hands free.
Adjust the strap so a bag sits comfortably near the hip. This style is useful in a crowded market.
A traveler may wear a light bag across one shoulder and the body. It helps keep important items close.

examples.en: Traditional aboriginal artisans sew exquisite beadwork and vibrant geometric embroidery.
examples.zh: 台灣原住民族工藝大師以精巧雙手在一針一線中縫製出華美絢麗的圖騰琉璃珠與立體幾何刺繡。

examples.en: Intricate floral embroidery adorned the collar and cuffs of the silk bridal blouse.
examples.zh: 細緻繁複的立體繁花刺繡優雅裝飾在絲綢新娘襯衫的衣領與袖口處，盡顯工藝之美。

examples.en: She picked up thread embroidery as a mindful hobby to unwind after stressful workdays.
examples.zh: 她在下班後將傳統針線刺繡作為療癒身心的手作嗜好，藉此在緊繃的生活節奏中徹底放鬆。

examples.en: Master embroiderers stitch glistening golden threads onto silk banners for temple processions.
examples.zh: 鹿港傳統繡莊刺繡名家一針一線將閃耀金線細密縫繡於真絲神明彩布上，展現華麗立體的八仙彩圖騰。

examples.en: The vintage wedding gown featured delicate floral embroidery handcrafted over three hundred hours.
examples.zh: 這件復古華麗手工嫁紗上綴滿繁複典雅的花卉刺繡，耗費了資深繡工整整三百多個小時的心血結晶。

examples.en: Lukang's silk embroidery workshops are revered nationwide for their three-dimensional religious artistry.
examples.zh: 鹿港歷史悠久的八仙彩繡莊工坊，以其精湛絕倫、浮凸立體的立體神明刺繡技藝享譽全台灣。

entries.definition: 刺繡工藝；刺繡圖樣；傳統刺繡工藝；金線刺繡

explains.en: This is decoration made by sewing colored thread into cloth. It may form flowers or geometric patterns on a shirt. Skilled makers can add shiny threads.
A person uses a needle and thread to create pictures or designs on fabric. The work may decorate a collar or cuffs. It can be a relaxing hobby.
Use this noun for stitched designs on clothing or other fabric. A wedding dress may have delicate flowers. Some traditions pass these skills down through families.

examples.en: Inspect double-reinforced stitching along jeans pocket corners for long-lasting durability.
examples.zh: 挑選牛仔褲時請仔細檢查褲袋邊角的雙道加固縫線車工，以確保耐磨耐穿、長久不脫線。

examples.en: Contrast yellow stitching along the welt is an iconic hallmark of Dr. Martens boots.
examples.zh: 鞋底沿條邊緣標誌性的亮黃色對比車縫線，是馬汀大夫靴最深入人心的經典招牌標記。

examples.en: Precise machine stitching guarantees that the leather seams will not unravel under heavy tension.
examples.zh: 針腳細密均勻的精密機械車縫工藝，能確保整塊真皮拼接接縫在長期拉扯下絕不脫線崩裂。

explains.en: It is the thread work that joins pieces of fabric together. Strong rows of thread can help jeans last longer. Check corners for loose threads.
A sewing machine creates lines of small loops along a seam. Bright thread can add decoration to boots. Careful work keeps leather joined.
This term describes the threads or technique used to sew material together. Reinforced areas can resist wear. Inspect a seam if it begins to unravel.

examples.en: Take long suit trousers to a master seamstress for professional hem alteration.
examples.zh: 將褲長過長的全新西裝長褲送至專業老經驗修改師傅手中，進行精準量身的褲腳修改。

examples.en: Minor waist alterations can transform an off-the-rack dress into a bespoke-fitting masterpiece.
examples.zh: 只要針對腰圍進行微幅細緻的修改，就能讓成衣架上的量產洋裝展現如高級訂製服般的合身體態。

examples.en: The bridal salon offers complimentary seam alterations before the final wedding gown fitting.
examples.zh: 這家婚紗禮服專門店在婚禮前最後一次試穿驗收前，提供免費貼心的修改縫線服務。

explains.en: A tailor shortens trousers or takes in a jacket so it fits better. Bring the clothes in for a fitting.
A wedding dress may need its waist adjusted before the ceremony. The seamstress pins the fabric first.
A change to the size or shape of clothing can make it fit one person. The same word can mean any change.

examples.en: The neighborhood seamstress expertly replaced the broken coat zipper in minutes.
examples.zh: 巷口修改衣服的資深裁縫阿姨手腳俐落，三兩下功夫便為羽絨外套換上了全新的 YKK 拉鍊。

examples.en: An experienced seamstress pinned the fabric along the waist to measure an exact taper.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的女裁縫師俐落地沿著腰線別上大頭針定位，以量出分毫不差的收腰比例。

examples.en: Her mother worked as a talented seamstress in a high-fashion atelier for over thirty years.
examples.zh: 她的母親曾在一間高級女裝高級訂製工坊擔任資深裁縫師，默默耕耘長達三十餘年。

explains.en: This clothing worker can repair a broken zipper or adjust a coat. The person measures fabric carefully.
A skilled worker may shape a dress to fit someone's waist. This job involves sewing by hand or machine.
Someone in this job can mend clothes and create garments. They may work in a small shop or a fashion studio.

examples.en: Delicate silk shirts and heavy wool overcoats require professional dry cleaning.
examples.zh: 細緻的天然真絲襯衫與厚重純羊毛大衣必須交由信譽良好的專業洗衣店進行溫和乾洗。

examples.en: She dropped off her husband's wool business suits for dry cleaning on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 她在週一清晨上班前，將丈夫平時開會穿的羊毛西裝外套打包送去專業洗衣店乾洗。

examples.en: Certain petroleum-based solvents used in traditional dry cleaning are being replaced by eco-friendly alternatives.
examples.zh: 傳統乾洗過程中使用的某些石油系溶劑，目前正逐步被更天然無毒的環保洗滌劑所取代。

explains.en: This is a way of cleaning clothes with special liquids instead of washing them in water. Delicate silk or wool may need it. A shop handles the process.
A person can take a suit or coat to a professional cleaner. The fabric is treated with a solvent. Some newer methods are kinder to the environment.
Use this phrase for professional cleaning of clothing without using water as the main cleaner. It is often used for delicate garments. Check the label before choosing it.

examples.en: A handheld garment steamer quickly smooths out stubborn wrinkles from linen shirts.
examples.zh: 隨手拿起輕巧的手持式蒸氣掛燙機，數秒內即可撫平亞麻襯衫上頑固惱人的皺褶。

examples.en: Travel steamers are compact enough to pack into carry-on luggage for business trips.
examples.zh: 便攜折疊式旅行掛燙機體積十分輕盈小巧，能輕鬆收納進登機箱中伴隨商務出差同行。

examples.en: Unlike traditional flat irons, a vertical steamer relaxes fabric fibers without crushing their texture.
examples.zh: 與傳統重磅熨斗不同，直立式蒸氣掛燙機藉由高溫蒸氣舒展纖維，絕不會壓扁織物原有蓬鬆紋理。

entries.definition: 手持式掛燙機；蒸鍋；汽船

explains.en: It can be a handheld device that uses hot vapor to remove wrinkles from clothes. It can also mean a pot for cooking food with steam. Some older ships used steam power.
Travelers may pack this small garment device to smooth linen shirts. In a kitchen, the same noun names cookware for vegetables. Context shows the meaning.
This word may name an appliance that sends hot vapor through fabric. It can also describe a cooking pot or a steam-powered boat. A vertical model is easy to pack.

examples.en: Balcony gardening brings fresh greenery and peaceful mindfulness to city apartments.
examples.zh: 在公寓陽台打造專屬陽台園藝花草綠化，能為緊湊忙碌的都市生活注入滿滿綠意與靜心療癒。

examples.en: She spent Saturday afternoon doing gardening and repotting fragrant herb planters.
examples.zh: 她在週六下午從事園藝種植，並為香氣撲鼻的香草盆栽進行換盆移栽。

examples.en: Gardening is a wonderful outdoor activity that reduces stress and encourages healthy movement.
examples.zh: 園藝是一項美妙的戶外活動，能有效減輕心理壓力並促進身體健康活動。

entries.definition: 園藝種植；花草盆栽綠化

explains.en: A family plants herbs in pots on a balcony and waters them. This hobby can bring greenery to a home.
A person spends Saturday pulling weeds and caring for flowers. Gloves and simple tools can help.
People grow vegetables or flowers in a yard or container. It is a relaxing outdoor activity for many.

examples.en: Indoor plant enthusiasts collect rare aroids and swap cuttings at weekend botanical markets.
examples.zh: 室內觀葉植物熱愛者（植友）熱衷於在週末假日花市收集罕見天南星科品種並交流交換枝條。

examples.en: As a vintage car enthusiast, he spends his spare time restoring classic automobiles.
examples.zh: 作為一名老爺車狂熱愛好者，他把業餘時間都花在修復經典骨董車上。

examples.en: Tech enthusiasts lined up outside the flagship store to buy the newly released gadget.
examples.zh: 科技發燒友們在品牌旗艦店外大排長龍，搶購最新發布的旗艦科技新品。

entries.definition: 熱愛者；綠植發燒友 (Plant Parent)

explains.en: A person who loves growing plants may collect rare leaves and trade cuttings. This word names someone with a strong interest.
Someone who loves old cars may spend free time repairing them. A technology fan may also be one.
People with a deep interest in a hobby often learn a lot about it. They may meet others who enjoy the same thing.

examples.en: Snake plants and pothos are low-maintenance houseplants that purify indoor air.
examples.zh: 虎尾蘭與黃金葛是生命力極強、極好照顧且能高效淨化室內空氣甲醛的入門室內盆栽。

examples.en: Placing a lush houseplant on your desk makes your workspace feel calm and inviting.
examples.zh: 在書桌上擺放一盆生機盎然的室內觀葉盆栽，能讓工作環境顯得沉靜而溫馨。

examples.en: Overwatering is the most common mistake beginners make when caring for a new houseplant.
examples.zh: 澆水過於頻繁是綠植新手在照料新買的室內植物時最常犯下的錯誤。

entries.definition: 室內觀葉盆栽；室內植物

explains.en: This is a plant grown inside a home or office in a pot. Snake plants and pothos are common examples. It can make a desk feel more welcoming.
A person keeps this kind of plant indoors rather than in a garden. It needs the right amount of light and water. Too much water can harm it.
Use this noun for a plant kept inside a building. Some need very little care. Others need a sunny place and regular watering.

examples.en: Monsteras are famous for their giant fenestrated leaves and lush tropical foliage.
examples.zh: 瑞士乳酪黃金龜背芋以其巨大開背裂葉與油亮濃綠的茂盛熱帶觀葉枝葉而享譽全球。

examples.en: In autumn, the forest foliage turns into a stunning sea of golden and red hues.
examples.zh: 入秋時分，整片森林茂密的枝葉轉化為一片令人讚嘆的金色與火紅交織的壯闊海洋。

examples.en: Wipe the large foliage with a damp cloth periodically to remove dust and maximize photosynthesis.
examples.zh: 定期使用微濕的軟布輕輕擦拭寬大葉片，能除淨灰塵並最大化光合作用效率。

explains.en: It is the leaves and small branches of plants or trees. Forest leaves turn red and gold in autumn. Wipe dust from houseplant leaves.
A tropical plant may have broad, lush greenery. Gardeners clean its leaves so they can receive light. The word describes plant growth as a group.
This noun refers to leaves on trees or plants. A thick green canopy can look beautiful. It can change color with the seasons.

examples.en: Highly sought-after Monstera Albo features dramatic white-and-green marble variegation.
examples.zh: 身價不斐、一葉難求的白斑龜背芋擁有宛如大理石紋路般黑白對比強烈的華麗斑葉錦化。

examples.en: Bright indirect light helps maintain vibrant variegation without causing white patches to brown.
examples.zh: 明亮的散射光有助於維持斑斕的錦化紋理，並能防止缺乏葉綠素的白斑處焦枯發黑。

examples.en: Plants with stable genetic variegation command high prices among international botanical collectors.
examples.zh: 具有穩定基因斑葉錦化特徵的珍稀植物，在國際植物收藏家圈子中往往享有極高身價。

entries.definition: 葉片錦化；斑葉白斑現象

explains.en: A leaf has patches of cream and green instead of being one solid color. Plant collectors may prize this pattern.
Some houseplants show pale streaks or spots on their leaves. Give them suitable light and care.
The leaves of a plant can have different colors or patterns. This natural variation makes each one distinctive.

examples.en: Succulents store water inside fleshy leaves and thrive in warm, sunny windowsills.
examples.zh: 多肉植物將充沛水分儲存於肥厚飽滿的肉質葉片中，極其喜愛溫暖乾燥且陽光充足的窗台。

examples.en: She arranged several colorful succulents in a shallow clay bowl as a centerpiece.
examples.zh: 她在一個淺陶盆中錯落有致地組合了幾株色彩斑斕的多肉植物，作為餐桌中央的造景亮點。

examples.en: The chef served a succulent roast chicken seasoned with fragrant rosemary and garlic.
examples.zh: 主廚端上了一道以迷迭香和大蒜精心烘烤、鮮嫩多汁的美味烤雞。

explains.en: This kind of plant stores water in thick leaves and needs little watering. It grows well in a sunny window.
A small fleshy plant can make a nice table decoration. Put several in a shallow clay bowl.
The word can also describe juicy, tender food such as roast chicken. Context shows whether it is a plant or food.

examples.en: Desert cacti require gritty, fast-draining soil mixes and minimal winter watering.
examples.zh: 沙漠仙人掌需要透氣極佳的高顆粒快乾介質，且在寒冷冬季只需極少量澆水即可安穩度冬。

examples.en: Be careful when handling the cactus because its sharp spines can easily prick your fingers.
examples.zh: 拿取或照護仙人掌時務必格外小心，因為其銳利的尖刺很容易刺傷手指。

examples.en: Some rare cactus species produce breathtaking, fragrant blossoms that open for only one night.
examples.zh: 某些罕見的仙人掌品種會綻放出令人屏息的芬芳花朵，且往往只在夜間短暫盛開一晚。

explains.en: This is a plant that often grows in dry places and stores water in its thick stem. Sharp spines protect it. Some produce beautiful flowers.
A desert plant of this kind needs soil that drains quickly. It usually needs little water in winter. Handle it carefully because of its sharp points.
Use this noun for a water-storing plant with spines. It can survive in hot, dry environments. Its flowers may open for only a short time.

examples.en: Caudex plants like Pachypodium gracilius develop thick swollen trunks that store water.
examples.zh: 象牙宮與惠比須笑等當紅珍奇塊根植物擁有圓滾肥大如酒瓶般的蓄水膨大莖幹塊根。

examples.en: The unique sculptured shape of a desert caudex resembles living contemporary art.
examples.zh: 荒漠塊根植物獨特的雕塑感奇特造型，宛如大自然孕育出的鮮活當代立體藝術品。

examples.en: Avoid overwatering your caudex during its dormant winter season to prevent interior rotting.
examples.zh: 在塊根植物冬季落葉休眠期間切忌頻繁澆水，以免引起內部塊莖腐爛發黑。

entries.definition: 塊根植物；肥大膨大莖塊

explains.en: It is a thickened stem or root that stores water in some plants. Desert species may have swollen trunks. Avoid too much water during winter rest.
Certain drought-adapted plants grow a large, sculpted base. It helps store moisture. The unusual shape can look like a piece of art.
This plant structure becomes thick as water is stored inside it. It is common in some dry-region species. Too much watering can cause rot.

examples.en: Staghorn ferns develop impressive antler-like fertile fronds and shield fronds.
examples.zh: 鹿角蕨能生長出極具觀賞價值、宛如雄鹿犄角般霸氣分岔的孢子葉與圓形包覆臉葉。

examples.en: Delicate maidenhair ferns thrive in humid environments like bathrooms and shaded terrariums.
examples.zh: 細緻優雅的鐵線蕨在浴室或有遮陰的密閉玻璃缸等高濕度環境中生長得格外茂盛。

examples.en: Ancient ferns reproduce through microscopic spores rather than blooming colorful flowers.
examples.zh: 古老的蕨類植物是透過葉背微小的孢子來繁衍後代，而非依靠綻放艷麗的花朵受粉。

explains.en: This leafy plant has delicate fronds and grows well in many shady, moist places. It reproduces with spores instead of flowers.
A staghorn variety has leaves shaped like antlers and can grow mounted on a board. Keep it in conditions suited to the plant.
Some ancient-looking garden plants unfurl new fronds from curled tips. They do not make flowers or seeds.

examples.en: Mounting staghorn ferns onto rustic cedar wooden planks mimics their natural arboreal habitat.
examples.zh: 將鹿角蕨以透明魚線與水苔綁紮固定於天然碳化杉木板上板，能完美還原其在雨林樹幹附生的姿態。

examples.en: Using clear fishing line for mounting ensures a neat appearance on your display board.
examples.zh: 使用透明釣魚線進行鹿角蕨上板，能確保成品在展示木板上呈現乾淨俐落的視覺美感。

examples.en: The botanical workshop taught participants the proper techniques for plant mounting.
examples.zh: 這場植藝工作坊向所有學員傳授了附生植物上板固定的標準專業技法。

explains.en: A fern can be attached to a wooden board so it grows like it would on a tree. Clear line keeps the display neat.
A plant workshop may teach how to attach roots and moss to a board. This way of displaying a plant needs care.
A plant can be fixed to a piece of wood for display. The method should give it room to grow.

examples.en: Premium Chilean sphagnum moss retains moisture while maintaining airy porosity for roots.
examples.zh: 頂級智利特級水苔具備極佳的保水吸水性，同時能為附生植物根系提供充沛的透氣空隙。

examples.en: Soak dried moss in clean water and squeeze out excess moisture before packing it around roots.
examples.zh: 使用前將乾燥水苔浸泡在清水中徹底吸飽水份，並輕輕擰乾多餘水分後再包裹根部。

examples.en: Velvety green moss covers the damp stones along the tranquil forest hiking trail.
examples.zh: 翠綠如茵的絲絨苔蘚覆蓋在幽靜森林健行步道兩側潮濕的青石板上。

explains.en: This is a small green plant that grows in damp places on soil, stones, or tree trunks. It holds water. Gardeners also use it around plant roots.
A soft green layer may cover rocks in a shady forest. It grows well where moisture stays. Some varieties help keep roots from drying out.
Use this noun for a tiny, low-growing plant without flowers. It can cover stones and tree bark. It prefers damp, shady conditions.

examples.en: Mix perlite, pumice, and bark chips to formulate a chunky, well-aerated aroid substrate.
examples.zh: 將珍珠石、火山石、赤玉土與發酵樹皮塊均勻混拌，即可調配出透氣瀝水的觀葉顆粒專用介質。

examples.en: The right substrate prevents moisture retention problems and promotes robust root networks.
examples.zh: 選擇配比得當的栽培介質能有效防止積水悶根問題，並促進健康發達的根系生長網絡。

examples.en: Orchid growers use coarse pine bark as the primary substrate for healthy epiphytic growth.
examples.zh: 蘭花栽培專家習慣使用粗顆粒松樹皮塊作為主要的介質基質，以利附生根健康呼吸。

examples.en: Multi-layer ABF substrates support immense electrical bandwidth for cloud server processors.
examples.zh: 多層 ABF 高階封裝載板（Substrate）為雲端超級伺服器處理器提供了海量資料傳輸所需的特高頻寬。

examples.en: The chemical reaction occurs when the enzyme binds specifically with its complementary molecular substrate.
examples.zh: 在生物生化反應中，催化酵素必須與其高度互補特異性的反應物受質底物（Substrate）緊密結合方能啟動催化。

examples.en: Taiwanese substrate manufacturers lead global production of high-end IC carrier boards for data center GPUs.
examples.zh: 台灣載板製造大廠（如欣興、南電）在全球高階 IC 晶片載板市場獨占鰲頭，全力供應全球資料中心頂級 GPU。

entries.definition: 調配介質；基質；土壤配方；ABF 高頻高密度封裝載板；基底

explains.en: It is the material plants grow in, such as soil, bark, or perlite. A loose mix lets air reach the roots. Different plants need different blends.
Orchid growers may use coarse bark instead of ordinary garden soil. The growing material helps water drain. Choosing the right mix supports healthy roots.
This base material can support a plant's roots. A cactus needs a mix that drains quickly. In science, the word can have other meanings.

examples.en: Adding porous pumice stones improves root aeration and prevents soil compaction.
examples.zh: 在培養土中拌入孔隙豐富的天然白火山浮石能大幅提升根系透氣性並防止土壤板結硬化。

examples.en: Pumice does not break down or decompose over time, making it an enduring soil amendment.
examples.zh: 浮石火山石即使長年使用也不會腐爛或崩解碎化，是經久耐用的優質土壤改良介質。

examples.en: Rinse powdery dust off your pumice before incorporating it into your bonsai soil blend.
examples.zh: 在將浮石混入盆景專用土之前，先用清水篩洗掉表面多餘粉塵以保持顆粒純淨透氣。

explains.en: This light, porous rock forms when gas-rich lava cools quickly. It can help make potting soil drain better.
A gardener mixes small volcanic stones into soil so water can pass through. Rinse off loose dust first.
The rough, lightweight stone can smooth hard skin or be added to a plant mix. It has many tiny holes.

examples.en: Ensure every flowerpot has adequate bottom drainage holes to prevent standing water.
examples.zh: 確保每個花盆盆底皆有充足暢通的排水孔，能有效避免多餘水分滯留盆底造成積水。

examples.en: Poor drainage leads to stagnant water and suffocates plant roots rapidly.
examples.zh: 盆栽排水不良會導致底層積水停滯，迅速使植物根部因缺氧而窒息壞死。

examples.en: Placing a layer of coarse stones or mesh over the hole improves overall pot drainage.
examples.zh: 在盆底排水孔上方墊上一層盆底排水網或粗陶粒，能大幅優化花盆整體的排水流暢度。

entries.definition: 盆器排水透氣性；排水系統

explains.en: A flowerpot needs holes at the bottom so extra water can leave. Standing water can hurt roots.
A garden with poor water flow may become soggy. Add openings or a layer of coarse stones.
This system carries extra water away from a place. Good flow helps keep plant roots healthy.

examples.en: Porous terracotta pots allow soil walls to breathe and evaporate excess moisture quickly.
examples.zh: 具備天然透氣微孔的紅陶素燒盆能讓盆壁自然呼吸透氣，幫助多餘水分快速蒸發防爛根。

examples.en: Natural terracotta develops an attractive vintage patina as minerals accumulate on the exterior.
examples.zh: 質樸的天然紅陶盆外壁會隨著礦物質和水氣沉積，自然醞釀出極具歲月質感的斑駁包漿。

examples.en: Because terracotta dries out quickly, plants grown in it may require more frequent watering in summer.
examples.zh: 由於紅陶盆水氣蒸散速度極快，在炎熱盛夏種植在陶盆中的植株可能需要更頻繁地補水。

explains.en: This is a reddish-brown clay material that has been baked until hard. It is used for flowerpots and tiles. Its surface can let water evaporate.
A pot made from this material dries out quickly, so plants may need more frequent watering. It can develop an aged look. Some buildings use it for decoration.
Use this noun or adjective for baked clay with a warm orange-red color. It is common in pots and roof tiles. Artists can shape it before firing.

examples.en: Spring is the ideal season for repotting root-bound Monsteras into larger containers.
examples.zh: 溫暖的春季是為根系盤結過滿的龜背芋進行換盆移栽至大號花盆的最佳黃金時機。

examples.en: Loosen the tangled outer root ball gently during repotting to encourage outward growth.
examples.zh: 進行換盆移栽時，先輕柔地理開外圈緊密纏繞的根系盤結，以刺激新根向外舒展生長。

examples.en: Water thoroughly after repotting to help the roots settle comfortably into the fresh substrate.
examples.zh: 換盆完成後請立即澆透一次定根水，有助於根系與周圍嶄新的顆粒介質緊密貼合。

explains.en: It is moving a plant into a new or larger pot. Spring is a good time if roots fill the old container. Loosen tangled roots gently.
A gardener may transfer a root-bound plant to fresh growing material. Water it afterward to help the roots settle. Choose a slightly larger pot.
This gardening task gives a plant more space to grow. Remove it carefully and place it in a clean container. Fresh soil can help it thrive.

examples.en: When roots circle densely outside drainage holes, the plant is completely root-bound.
examples.zh: 當發現大量白根從盆底排水孔密密麻麻鑽出並盤根錯節時，代表植株已經徹底滿根需要換盆。

examples.en: A root-bound plant absorbs water sluggishly because there is little soil left to retain moisture.
examples.zh: 處於滿根盤結狀態的盆栽吸水速度會變得極度遲緩，因為盆內幾乎已無土壤可蓄水。

examples.en: Gently prune the coiled lower roots before transferring a root-bound shrub into a bigger pot.
examples.zh: 在將滿根盤繞的灌木移入更大口徑的花盆前，先輕輕修剪掉底部過度盤旋的老根。

entries.definition: 根系盤結過密的；滿根的

explains.en: A plant’s roots have filled the pot and circle around inside it. Moving it to a larger container may help.
Water may run straight through a crowded root ball because little soil remains. Check whether the plant needs a new pot.
When roots grow tightly around one another and out of the drainage holes, the plant may need more space. Handle the roots gently.

examples.en: Overwatering drowns plant root tips by cutting off vital oxygen supplies in the soil.
examples.zh: 過度頻繁澆水會讓盆土長期處於泥濘缺氧狀態，進而活生生悶死根系末梢微細的吸收根。

examples.en: Check soil moisture depth with a wooden skewer before watering to prevent accidental overwatering.
examples.zh: 每次澆水前可先將竹籤插入盆土深處檢查乾濕度，能有效避免手癢過度頻繁澆水。

examples.en: Yellowing leaves accompanied by moist potting mix are the classic signature of overwatering.
examples.zh: 葉片大面積發黃發軟且底層泥土依然潮濕黏重，是典型過度頻繁澆水的明確警訊。

explains.en: Too much water can leave plant roots without enough air. Yellow leaves may be a sign.
Check the soil with a wooden stick before adding more water. A wet mix may not need any.
Keeping a potting mix soaked can harm delicate roots. Let the top layer dry when appropriate.

examples.en: The peace lily displays dramatically droopy leaves whenever it gets thirsty for water.
examples.zh: 嬌嫩的白鶴芋只要盆土一乾缺水，整株葉片便會戲劇化地垂頭喪氣、整片下垂萎靡示警。

examples.en: A deep drink of water usually revives droopy foliage within just a few short hours.
examples.zh: 一次徹底澆透補水通常在短短數小時之內，就能讓垂頭萎靡的葉片重新挺拔昂揚。

examples.en: Droopy stems can also occur if plants suffer sudden shock from freezing winter drafts.
examples.zh: 如果盆栽突然遭受冬季門窗縫隙灌入的強烈冷風吹襲，枝條也可能會出現萎靡下垂的凍傷現象。

entries.definition: 葉片下垂萎靡的；無精打采的

explains.en: This describes a plant's leaves or stems when they hang down because they need water or have been shocked. A good drink may help the leaves lift again. Frost can cause this look too.
A flower may look limp after sitting in the sun. Watering it can help if it is thirsty. A freezing draft can also make its stems sag.
Use this adjective for leaves or flowers that bend downward instead of standing upright. It can show that a plant is thirsty. Check the soil before watering.

examples.en: Bright indirect light filtered through sheer curtains prevents scorching delicate foliage.
examples.zh: 透過純白薄紗窗簾過濾後的明亮溫柔散射光，能提供充沛光合作用光照且絕不灼傷嫩葉。

examples.en: Most tropical rainforest plants thrive in bright indirect light rather than blazing direct sunshine.
examples.zh: 絕大多數熱帶雨林底層觀葉植物偏愛明亮的間接散射光照，而非炎炎夏日的強烈直射烈日。

examples.en: An east-facing window provides gentle morning light that functions as bright indirect illumination throughout the afternoon.
examples.zh: 朝東向的窗邊能迎來溫和的晨光撫照，並在午後轉為舒服且光量充沛的明亮間接散射光。

explains.en: It describes light that reaches a plant after bouncing off a wall or passing through a curtain. This can protect delicate leaves from scorching. Many tropical plants prefer it.
A room may receive bright but softened daylight instead of harsh sun. Plants can grow well near a sheer curtain. The light is not aimed straight at them.
Use this adjective for a route or effect that does not happen in a straight way. In gardening, it describes softened light. A plant may need this to avoid burns.

examples.en: Full-spectrum LED grow lights keep indoor tropical plants vibrant throughout cloudy winters.
examples.zh: 在陰雨綿綿的寒冬中開啟全光譜 LED 植物生長燈進行定時補光，能常保觀葉植物生氣盎然。

examples.en: Mount the grow light twelve inches above the canopy on a twelve-hour automatic timer.
examples.zh: 將植物補光燈架設在植物頂部葉冠上方約三十公分處，並設定每日定時補光十二小時。

examples.en: Modern energy-efficient grow lights emit warm natural spectrums that blend pleasingly into home decor.
examples.zh: 現代節能省電的植物生長燈能散發出柔和舒適的暖白光光譜，能自然融入居家生活裝潢。

entries.definition: 全光譜 LED 植物生長燈

explains.en: A lamp gives indoor plants light when a sunny window is not enough. Place it according to the maker’s directions.
During a cloudy winter, a plant owner uses a special lamp to help houseplants grow. Timers can control the light period.
This artificial light is designed for plants kept indoors. It can support growth when natural light is limited.

examples.en: Healthy green leaves capture light energy to drive vital biochemical photosynthesis.
examples.zh: 翠綠健康的葉片吸收光能以進行核心生化光合作用，將水與二氧化碳轉化為生長養分。

examples.en: During photosynthesis, chlorophyll converts carbon dioxide and water into nourishing glucose.
examples.zh: 在光合作用進行過程中，葉綠素能將二氧化碳與水分順利轉化為滋養植株生長的葡萄糖。

examples.en: Insufficient light slows down photosynthesis, causing foliage to lose its vibrant green pigment.
examples.zh: 光照長期嚴重匱乏會大幅減緩光合作用的進行，進而導致葉片逐漸褪色發黃、失去生機。

explains.en: Green leaves use sunlight, water, and air to make food for a plant. This process helps plants grow.
A leaf takes in light and turns it into sugar. Plants also release oxygen during this process.
Plants need light to change water and carbon dioxide into food. Without enough light, they may grow poorly.

examples.en: Sprinkle slow-release fertilizer pellets on top of the soil for continuous three-month feeding.
examples.zh: 在盆土表面均勻撒上一小匙魔肥或好康多緩釋肥料顆粒，能長達三個月源源不絕緩慢釋放養分。

examples.en: Coated slow-release granules release nitrogen and phosphorus gradually whenever you water.
examples.zh: 包膜樹脂緩釋肥顆粒在每次澆水溶解時，會隨土壤溫度漸進均勻釋放氮、磷、鉀養分。

examples.en: Using slow-release fertilizers eliminates the recurring chore of mixing liquid plant feeds every week.
examples.zh: 使用長效緩釋肥能徹底省去每週都需要繁複量取調配液體肥料的瑣碎養護麻煩。

entries.definition: 緩釋型的；慢速釋放養分的

explains.en: This describes fertilizer that gives nutrients to a plant little by little over time. Pellets can feed it for several months. It means fewer applications are needed.
Water passes over coated granules and carries out small amounts of plant food. The coating controls how quickly it comes out. Gardeners use it to avoid mixing liquid feed every week.
Use this adjective for a product designed to provide its effect gradually. A garden product may last for months. It saves repeated work.

examples.en: Dab cotton swabs dipped in 75% rubbing alcohol directly onto pesky white mealybugs.
examples.zh: 拿棉花棒沾取百分之七十五的消毒藥用酒精，直接精準點塗在葉腋處白色絨毛狀的粉介殼蟲上。

examples.en: Mealybugs hide deep inside tightly folded new leaves and suck sugary plant sap.
examples.zh: 惱人的粉介殼蟲最喜歡隱匿在未展開的蜷曲新芽縫隙深處，瘋狂刺吸多汁的植物汁液。

examples.en: Isolate infested plants immediately to prevent insidious mealybugs from spreading to neighbors.
examples.zh: 一旦發現任何盆栽遭受蟲害，應立即搬移至隔離區，防止粉介殼蟲向周遭鄰近植物蔓延。

explains.en: It is a tiny white insect that feeds on the sap of houseplants. It may hide inside new leaves. Wipe it away with a cotton swab.
These pests gather on stems and leaves and can weaken a plant. Separate an affected plant from nearby ones. Check the undersides of leaves.
A gardener may find small white insects in folded leaves. They feed on plant sap. Clean tools after treating an affected plant.

examples.en: Fine webbing beneath dusty leaves indicates an active spider mite infestation.
examples.zh: 發現乾燥葉背蒙上一層細微蜘蛛絲薄網並出現黃色斑點，代表植株正遭受紅蜘蛛葉蟎侵襲。

examples.en: Increasing air humidity discourages tiny mites that multiply rapidly in dry indoor winter air.
examples.zh: 提升環境空氣相對濕度能有效抑制葉蟎族群擴散，因其最喜在乾燥溫暖的密閉環境大量繁殖。

examples.en: Thoroughly spray the undersides of leaves with horticultural soap to eradicate persistent mites.
examples.zh: 使用稀釋後的窄域油或園藝肥皂水徹底噴透葉片背面，能有效清除頑固附著的蟎蟲害蟲。

examples.en: High-density microfiber zippered mattress encasements block microscopic dust mites completely.
examples.zh: 採用物理微孔高密度防蟎面料的全包覆式拉鍊床墊套，能百分之百阻隔肉眼看不見的微細塵蟎滋生。

examples.en: Washing bedsheets weekly in 60°C hot water effectively neutralizes allergen proteins left by the dust mite.
examples.zh: 每週固定使用攝氏六十度熱水洗滌被套床單，能徹底消滅微細塵蟎並分解其排泄物中的過敏原蛋白。

examples.en: Investing in a UV-C vacuum cleaner extracts deeply embedded dead mites and dander from fabric sofas.
examples.zh: 選購配備 UV-C 紫外線殺菌燈的拍打除蟎吸塵器，能深層震出並吸除深陷布沙發底層的塵蟎與皮屑。

entries.definition: 紅蜘蛛葉蟎；蟎蟲 (Spider Mites)；塵蟎（主要居家過敏原）

explains.en: Fine webs under a leaf can be a sign of tiny plant pests. Check the undersides of leaves carefully.
Very small organisms may live in house dust and trigger allergies in some people. Wash bedding regularly.
A gardener may notice pale speckles on leaves and seek help identifying the cause. Some of these tiny creatures live on plants, while others live in dust.

examples.en: Stem cutting propagation in clean water is a rewarding way to multiply your pothos.
examples.zh: 剪取帶有氣生根節點的枝條插在清水玻璃瓶中進行水培扦插繁殖，能輕鬆一生十無比有成就感。

examples.en: Air layering is an effective propagation method for thick rubber trees and monsteras.
examples.zh: 高壓空中壓條法是為粗壯的印度橡膠樹與大龜背芋進行無損分株繁殖極為穩妥的技巧。

examples.en: Springtime offers warm ambient temperatures that dramatically increase propagation success rates.
examples.zh: 春暖花開時節溫潤的環境氣溫，能大幅提升各種觀葉植物扦插繁殖生根的成功率。

explains.en: A gardener can grow a new pothos from a piece of its stem. This is one way to make more plants.
Some growers bend a branch so it forms roots before cutting it from the main plant. Spring can be a good time.
This process makes new plants from seeds or cuttings. Warm conditions may help young roots grow.

examples.en: Make a clean diagonal cut just below the stem node containing a dormant growth eye.
examples.zh: 使用消毒剪刀在帶有生長芽點與氣生根的枝條生長節點（Node）下方斜剪一刀以利發根。

examples.en: New aerial roots and foliage shoots emerge exclusively from healthy botanical nodes.
examples.zh: 觀葉植物嶄新的氣生根與後續萌發的側芽新葉，皆無一例外是從健康的莖幹節點處孕育萌出。

examples.en: Always verify that your cutting includes at least one intact node before placing it in water.
examples.zh: 在將剪下的枝條插入水培瓶之前，務必仔細確認枝條上至少保留有一處完整無損的生長節點。

examples.en: Moving from the 3nm to the 2nm process node boosts computing power by 15% while cutting power use by 30%.
examples.zh: 從三奈米升級至兩奈米先進製程節點（Node），能在提升一成五運算效能的同時大幅降低三成功耗。

examples.en: The telecommunication network experienced heavy congestion at its central routing node during the storm.
examples.zh: 遭到強烈颱風外圍強風豪雨侵襲期間，全區電信通訊網路在中央核心路由交換節點發生嚴重雍塞塞車。

examples.en: Lymph nodes throughout the human body swell as immune cells fight off localized bacterial infections.
examples.zh: 當人體免疫淋巴細胞群起奮勇對抗局部細菌感染時，分佈於頸部與腋下的淋巴結往往會出現紅腫微痛。

entries.definition: 莖幹生長節點（生長點與氣根處）；先進製程節點 (如 2nm / A16 埃米)；節點

explains.en: This is a point where parts of a plant stem meet and new growth can begin. It can also mean a connection point in a computer or phone network. In the body, a small bean-shaped gland can swell during illness.
A cutting needs this part of a stem to grow new leaves or roots. In technology, devices may connect through one central point. The same word also names small parts of the immune system.
Use this noun for a joint or connection point. A plant's growth eye may be found there. Computers and the human body have their own kinds too.

examples.en: Regular pruning of yellowed bottom foliage redirects valuable energy to fresh new leaves.
examples.zh: 定期剪除底部老化發黃的殘枝老葉，能將寶貴的養分與光合作用能量重新導向頂端新芽生長。

examples.en: Strategic spring pruning encourages bushier lateral branches on outdoor rose shrubs.
examples.zh: 在春季針對戶外玫瑰灌木進行策略性疏枝修剪，能有效促使側芽萌發並長得更為繁密茂盛。

examples.en: Always sanitize cutting blades between each plant pruning to prevent cross-contamination.
examples.zh: 在修剪不同植株的間隙，請務必先擦拭消毒刀刃，以防植物病毒與真菌病害交叉感染。

explains.en: It is cutting away dead or unwanted branches and leaves from a plant. This can encourage healthy growth. Clean the blades between plants.
A gardener may trim roses in spring to help them grow more branches. Remove yellow leaves to redirect the plant's energy. Use sharp, clean shears.
This garden task shapes plants and removes unhealthy growth. It may help a shrub bloom better. Sanitize tools to prevent disease from spreading.

examples.en: Keep your Japanese bypass pruning shears razor-sharp and disinfected with alcohol.
examples.zh: 保持日本進口園藝修枝剪刀刀口鋒利如刃，並在修剪不同盆栽前以酒精擦拭消毒防交叉感染。

examples.en: Heavy-duty garden shears cut through thick woody branches smoothly without crushing bark.
examples.zh: 重型專業花剪能乾淨俐落地切斷粗壯的木質化枝幹，且完全不會壓碎或撕裂樹皮組織。

examples.en: Store oiled shears in a dry toolbox to prevent rust and corrosion on the carbon steel blades.
examples.zh: 將保養上油後的修枝大剪刀妥善收納在乾燥工具箱中，能有效防止高碳鋼刀刃生鏽受潮。

entries.definition: 園藝專業修枝大剪刀；剪刀

explains.en: These large cutting tools have two blades and long handles. A gardener uses them to trim branches.
Clean and dry the blades after cutting plants to help keep them in good condition. They can cut thicker stems than small scissors.
A gardener grips both handles and closes the blades around a branch. Keep them safely stored when not in use.

examples.en: Fresh emerald green baby leaves sprout joyfully from the top of the fiddle-leaf fig.
examples.zh: 翠綠欲滴、充滿生命力的嫩綠新葉從琴葉榕頂端生長點歡欣萌芽破苞而出。

examples.en: Sunflower seeds sprout quickly when kept moist under warm, dark conditions.
examples.zh: 葵花子種子在溫暖避光的濕潤環境中催芽，短短數天內便會快速破殼萌芽。

examples.en: Seeing new lime-green shoots sprout after a long dormant winter brings profound joy.
examples.zh: 在熬過漫長嚴寒冬眠後親眼看見翠綠新芽破土萌發，能帶給園藝愛好者由衷的欣慰與感動。

explains.en: A tiny green shoot can appear from a seed kept warm and damp. Sunflower seeds do this quickly.
New leaves may grow from the top of a houseplant after winter. This word can name the young plant too.
A seed begins to grow when it has water and warmth. The first green part may be small and tender.

examples.en: Transplant fragile tomato seedlings into larger raised beds after the spring frost passes.
examples.zh: 當春季氣溫回暖穩定後，將育苗盤中茁壯健康的牛番茄實生幼苗小心翼翼移栽至大菜畦中。

examples.en: Protect tender green seedlings from ravenous snails and harsh afternoon downpours.
examples.zh: 悉心保護幼嫩翠綠的蔬菜小苗，防止遭受貪吃蝸牛啃食或午後雷陣雨無情摧折打落。

examples.en: Provide adequate lighting so that developing seedlings do not become weak and leggy.
examples.zh: 在室內育苗階段務必給予幼苗充足的光照補光，避免幼苗因缺光而徒長長成弱不禁風的豆芽菜。

explains.en: This is a very young plant that has just started growing from a seed. It can be moved into a larger garden bed. Protect it from snails and strong rain.
A tiny green plant may need extra light so its stem grows strong. Gardeners can move it after the frost has passed. It needs gentle care.
Use this noun for a new plant in its early stage. It may have only a few leaves. Give it enough light and water.

examples.en: Raised garden beds improve soil drainage and save gardeners from aching backs.
examples.zh: 採用架高式木製種植菜畦槽不僅排水透氣極佳，更能讓農友免去長時間彎腰蹲地的腰酸背痛。

examples.en: Fill the cedar raised bed with rich organic compost and worm castings for healthy root development.
examples.zh: 在雪松木打造的高架種植箱內填滿肥沃的黑金有機堆肥與蚯蚓土，能提供強韌發育環境。

examples.en: Raised beds warm up faster in early spring, allowing earlier vegetable crop planting.
examples.zh: 高架菜畦土壤在早春回溫速度明顯較快，使農友得以比傳統地面菜園更早一步搶先播種定植。

entries.definition: 架高種植菜畦槽；高架木箱

explains.en: It is a garden box or planting area built above ground level. It can improve drainage and save a gardener's back. Fill it with rich soil.
A wooden container holds soil for vegetables and flowers. Its height makes planting easier. It warms up quickly in spring.
This elevated garden plot gives plants a defined space. It may be made from cedar boards. Compost and loose soil help roots grow.

examples.en: Composting vegetable kitchen scraps enriches garden soil with rich organic nutrients.
examples.zh: 將生鮮廚餘菜葉果皮進行發酵有機堆肥化處理，能轉化為滋養花園沃土的最佳黑金有機養分。

examples.en: Turn the compost pile regularly with a pitchfork to introduce oxygen and speed up microbial breakdown.
examples.zh: 定期使用鐵叉翻動通氣堆肥堆，引入充足氧氣以加速好氧微生物進行高溫腐熟分解。

examples.en: Dark, earthy finished compost smells delightful and conditions heavy clay garden soils.
examples.zh: 完全腐熟發酵後的黑金有機堆肥散發迷人的泥土芳香，能根本改善黏重土壤的團粒結構。

examples.en: Layering fallen dry leaves and cow manure creates rich compost that revitalizes depleted garden beds.
examples.zh: 將枯枝落葉、米糠與牛糞均勻層疊進行高溫好氧發酵，產出能喚醒貧瘠土地活力的優質有機堆肥。

examples.en: Many eco-conscious households compost raw fruit peels and vegetable scraps directly in kitchen bins.
examples.zh: 許多重視環保減碳的家庭，直接在廚房放置密閉廚餘桶將生鮮果皮與菜葉殘渣製作成天然有機堆肥。

examples.en: Composted kitchen waste generates valuable organic plant fertilizer while slashing household landfill garbage.
examples.zh: 將家中的生鮮廚餘全面堆肥化，既能產出肥沃無毒的園藝天然肥料，又能大幅減少送往焚化爐的家庭垃圾。

entries.definition: 有機堆肥；廚餘堆肥化；高溫好氧發酵微生物有機堆肥

explains.en: Fruit peels and dry leaves can break down into dark material for garden soil. Turn the pile sometimes to let air enter.
A family puts vegetable scraps in a container instead of throwing them away. The finished material can help plants grow.
Gardeners mix this decayed organic material into soil. It can be made from leaves and suitable food scraps.

examples.en: Odorless worm castings deliver gentle, non-burning microbial nutrients to delicate roots.
examples.zh: 完全無臭無味的天然蚯蚓糞有機肥能為細嫩的新根提供最溫和、絕不燒根的活性微量元素。

examples.en: Top-dressing your houseplants with a handful of worm castings provides steady organic feeding.
examples.zh: 在室內盆栽的土表撒上一小把純天然蚯蚓糞土作為追肥，能為植株提供源源不絕的養分。

examples.en: Worm castings contain beneficial soil microbes that enhance plant resilience against disease.
examples.zh: 蚯蚓糞中富含大量有益的土壤活性益生菌群，能大幅增強植物抵抗根系土傳病害的免疫力。

explains.en: Earthworms leave dark, crumbly material in soil that can feed plants. Gardeners mix it into pots.
A small handful of this natural fertilizer can nourish a houseplant. It contains helpful soil organisms.
Gardeners use this rich material left by worms to improve soil. It releases nutrients gently.

examples.en: Growing seasonal greens on your rooftop is a step toward becoming self-sufficient.
examples.zh: 在自家庭院屋頂親手種植當令有機小白菜與萵苣，是邁向綠色永續自給自足生活的踏實第一步。

examples.en: The remote eco-homestead is completely self-sufficient with solar panels and rainwater harvesting.
examples.zh: 這處隱世偏遠的環保農莊憑藉太陽能光電板與雨水回收淨化系統，達成了完全的自給自足。

examples.en: Being self-sufficient in fresh herbs and culinary vegetables brings deep satisfaction and resilience.
examples.zh: 在日常辛香料與新鮮蔬菜上實現自給自足，能為生活帶來深沉的安心踏實感與幸福感。

explains.en: This describes a person or place that can meet its own needs without much outside help. A home may use solar power and collect rainwater. A rooftop garden can provide some food.
A remote homestead may make its own electricity and grow vegetables. It does not depend heavily on others for supplies. This quality can make it resilient.
Use this adjective for someone or somewhere able to provide what is needed. Growing herbs at home is a small step. A fully independent home may use its own energy and water.

examples.en: A sealed glass terrarium cycles water and oxygen in a self-sustaining miniature biome.
examples.zh: 一只密封的玻璃微景觀生態瓶在內部形成完美自給自足、水氣自我循環的迷你綠色微生態系。

examples.en: Tropical mosses and miniature jewel orchids thrive inside the high humidity of a glass terrarium.
examples.zh: 嬌嫩的雨林苔蘚與迷你珍稀寶石蘭，在玻璃微景觀生態瓶的高濕度密閉微氣候中蓬勃生長。

examples.en: Keep your enclosed terrarium away from direct midday sunlight to avoid overheating the glass chamber.
examples.zh: 切記將密閉式玻璃生態缸遠離正午直射烈日曝曬，以防止玻璃容器內部溫度驟升悶死植物。

entries.definition: 密閉玻璃微景觀生態瓶

explains.en: It is a glass container used to grow small plants in a miniature garden. Moss and orchids may thrive in its humid air. Keep it out of direct midday sun.
A sealed glass vessel can hold a tiny ecosystem. Water moves through the air and soil inside. Small tropical plants often grow well there.
People arrange plants and stones inside a clear container to make a miniature landscape. It may be closed or open. Too much sunlight can overheat it.

examples.en: Ancient Japanese juniper bonsai trees embody decades of patient wire wiring and pruning.
examples.zh: 百年真柏造型盆栽藝術凝結了園藝大師數十年來日復一日耐心以鋁線雕塑纏繞與修剪的心血。

examples.en: Practicing the meditative art of bonsai cultivates deep patience and appreciation for natural forms.
examples.zh: 研習充滿禪意的東方盆景造型藝術，能涵養人沉穩的心性並昇華對大自然造化之美的體悟。

examples.en: Carefully water your outdoor bonsai daily because the shallow ceramic dish dries out swiftly.
examples.zh: 每天務必悉心替戶外的盆景澆透水，因為精緻淺碟陶盆內的微量顆粒土在晴天極易乾透。

entries.definition: 盆栽藝術；造型迷你盆景

explains.en: A gardener shapes a small tree in a shallow pot by trimming and wiring its branches. Caring for it takes patience.
This Japanese art grows miniature trees that look like full-sized trees. Each plant needs attention over many years.
A tiny pine or juniper may be shaped to look like a tree in nature. Place it where its species gets suitable light.

examples.en: Strolling through the Taipei Botanical Garden offers shade under towering century-old trees.
examples.zh: 悠閒漫步於台北植物園的綠蔭步道下，參天百年古木與幽靜荷花池為酷暑帶來陣陣清涼。

examples.en: The university library preserves antique botanical illustrations hand-painted by early explorers.
examples.zh: 大學圖書館珍藏著早期博物學探險家親手繪製的十九世紀古董植物學手繪插畫手稿。

examples.en: Botanical research helps scientists discover natural plant compounds for modern medicine.
examples.zh: 深入的現代植物學科研工作，能協助全球科學家在野生草木中發掘應用於現代醫藥的寶貴成分。

explains.en: A garden with trees and flowers may teach visitors about plants. This adjective describes things related to plants.
Old drawings of leaves and flowers may be kept in a university library. Researchers use them to learn about plant life.
Scientists study natural chemicals in plants for medicine. This work is connected with the study of plants.

examples.en: The French patissier trained in Paris constructs breathtaking multi-layered entremets.
examples.zh: 曾於巴黎藍帶深造的法式甜點主廚以精湛技藝層層堆疊出宛如藝術品般的法式慕斯蛋糕。

examples.en: The head patissier demonstrated the intricate technique of sugar pulling at the masterclass.
examples.zh: 甜點主廚在大師培訓講堂上親自示範了精細繁複的手工拉糖工藝技巧。

examples.en: Every dessert created by the renowned patissier is a harmonious blend of flavor and elegance.
examples.zh: 這位享譽盛名的甜點大師所創作的每一道精緻甜品，皆是風味與優雅美學的極致融合。

entries.definition: 法式甜點主廚；甜點大師

explains.en: This is a chef who specializes in making cakes, pastries, and other desserts. They may create layered treats for a bakery. Careful technique makes the desserts look beautiful.
A dessert chef can demonstrate how to pull sugar or shape dough. They often study the art of baking for years. Their work may combine flavor and decoration.
Use this noun for a professional maker of French-style pastries and desserts. They may work in a restaurant or bakery. Precision is important in the job.

examples.en: Naturally fermented sourdough bread is easier to digest due to long lactic acid fermentation.
examples.zh: 經過長時間乳酸菌發酵的天然酸種麵包（Sourdough）風味純粹微酸且更易於人體消化。

examples.en: She toasted a thick slice of sourdough and topped it with smashed avocado and sea salt.
examples.zh: 她將一片厚切天然酸種麵包烤得酥脆，再抹上濃郁的酪梨泥並撒上細微海鹽。

examples.en: Baking authentic sourdough requires immense patience throughout the long fermentation process.
examples.zh: 烘烤正宗天然酵母酸種麵包，在漫長發酵的每個環節中皆需要無比的耐心等待。

examples.en: A proper loaf of sourdough requires only three simple ingredients: unbleached flour, pure water, and salt.
examples.zh: 一顆完美的天然酸種麵包，僅需未漂白小麥麵粉、純淨水與海鹽三種純粹原料即可烘烤而成。

examples.en: Long fermentation breaks down gluten structures, making artisan sourdough easier on sensitive stomachs.
examples.zh: 長達數十小時的緩慢發酵能分解麩質大分子，讓工藝酸種麵包更易於腸胃消化吸收。

examples.en: Toasting thick slices of sourdough unlocks deep caramel notes and a pleasant acidic tang.
examples.zh: 將厚切酸種麵包片烘烤至金黃，能激發出深層的焦糖麥香與迷人回甘的微酸風味。

entries.definition: 天然酵母酸種麵包；酸麵團；舊金山天然酸種麵包

explains.en: It is bread made with a starter that ferments naturally over time. The long process gives it a tangy flavor. A thick slice tastes good toasted.
Bakers use flour and water with natural yeast and bacteria to make this loaf. It takes patience to prepare. The crust is often crisp.
This bread develops a mild sour taste during slow fermentation. Its starter can be kept and fed over many days. Avocado is a popular topping.

examples.en: Feed your active sourdough starter daily with equal parts organic flour and spring water.
examples.zh: 每天按時以等比例的有機麵粉與純淨水餵養活性極強的天然酸種酵母起種（魯邦種）。

examples.en: A healthy sourdough starter bubbles vigorously and doubles in volume within four hours.
examples.zh: 活性充沛健康的天然酸種起種會充滿密集的活力氣泡，並在四小時內膨脹至兩倍大。

examples.en: For our anniversary dinner, we ordered crispy calamari as a savory starter.
examples.zh: 在我們的結婚週年紀念晚餐上，我們點了香酥炸魷魚圈作為開胃前菜。

examples.en: Ferrocerium fire starters shower 3,000°C sparks to ignite tinder even in rain.
examples.zh: 鎂塊打火棒（Fire Starter）能在刮刀刮擦下瞬間噴射出三千度高溫火星，雨天也能點燃引火柴。

examples.en: Strike the fire starter firmly against dry cotton balls infused with petroleum jelly for instant fire.
examples.zh: 拿刮刀用力朝向事先浸泡過凡士林的乾燥棉花球快速刮動打火棒，數秒內即可成功引燃烈火。

examples.en: The car wouldn't turn on because the electrical engine starter motor had worn out.
examples.zh: 汽車停在路邊突然無法發動點火，經過原廠技師檢測發現是底盤發電機啟動馬達老化損壞。

entries.definition: 酸種酵母起種 (Levain / 魯邦種)；開胃菜；鎂棒打火棒 (Fire Starter)；發動機

explains.en: A small jar of flour and water contains bubbling natural yeast used to raise bread. Feed it regularly before baking.
At dinner, a small dish of crispy seafood arrives before the main course. It begins the meal.
A small rod creates sparks to light dry tinder outdoors. In a car, a motor also helps begin the engine.

examples.en: Kneading develops strong gluten networks that trap expanding carbon dioxide bubbles.
examples.zh: 耐心揉麵能催化出強韌的麵筋網絡，牢牢鎖住發酵時不斷膨脹的微細二氧化碳氣孔。

examples.en: People diagnosed with celiac disease must strictly avoid wheat products containing gluten.
examples.zh: 經確診患有乳糜瀉疾病的患者，日常飲食中必須嚴格杜絕攝取含有麩質的小麥製品。

examples.en: Over-mixing muffin batter develops excess gluten, resulting in a dense, tough texture.
examples.zh: 攪拌馬芬蛋糕麵糊時過度劇烈攪拌會產生多餘筋度，導致烤出的蛋糕口感紮實生硬。

examples.en: Stretching a small piece of dough to see if it forms a translucent gluten windowpane confirms optimal mixing.
examples.zh: 輕輕拉開一小塊麵團進行手套膜薄膜測試，能確認麵筋是否達到最佳延展擴展階段。

examples.en: High-protein bread flour contains the gluten potential needed to hold expanding yeast gases.
examples.zh: 高筋小麥麵粉蘊含充沛的優質麩質潛力，能形成堅固網狀氣囊以支撐酵母產生的二氧化碳。

examples.en: If the gluten network tears prematurely during the windowpane test, the dough requires further folding.
examples.zh: 若在薄膜拉伸測試中麵膜過早破裂產生鋸齒缺口，代表麵筋結構仍需進一步折疊強化。

entries.definition: 麵筋；麩質蛋白；麵筋薄膜擴展測試 (手套膜)；麩質

explains.en: This protein in wheat helps dough stretch and hold bubbles from yeast. Some people must avoid it.
Mixing flour and water can make a stretchy network in bread dough. Too much mixing may make muffins tough.
People with celiac disease need food without this wheat protein. Bakers use flour containing it for bread.

examples.en: Dust the cane banneton with rice flour before resting the shaped dough overnight.
examples.zh: 在天然藤編發酵籃（Banneton）內均勻撒上防沾黏的在來米粉，再放入整型好的麵團。

examples.en: The natural cane ribs of the banneton imprint a beautiful spiral pattern onto the loaf crust.
examples.zh: 天然藤籃內部一圈圈的立體藤條紋理，會在麵包外皮上烙印出優雅古樸的螺旋環狀紋路。

examples.en: Using a cloth liner inside the banneton prevents sticky, high-hydration dough from clinging.
examples.zh: 在發酵藤籃內鋪上一層防沾棉麻內襯布，能有效防止高含水量的濕黏麵團沾黏在藤籃上。

entries.definition: 藤籃發酵圈；藤編發酵籃

explains.en: This is a basket used to hold shaped bread dough while it rises before baking. It can leave a spiral pattern on the loaf. A cloth liner can stop sticky dough from clinging.
A baker may dust this woven container with flour and let dough rest in it overnight. The ribs leave marks on the crust. It helps the dough keep its shape.
Use this word for a proofing basket used in bread making. It supports the dough as it rises. Rice flour can help keep it from sticking.

examples.en: The 45-minute autolyse stage allows enzymes to break down starches naturally.
examples.zh: 揉麵前進行四十五分鐘「水解法」（Autolyse）靜置，能讓小麥酵素自然軟化麵筋並提升延展性。

examples.en: Applying an autolyse rest makes the wet dough noticeably smoother and more extensible.
examples.zh: 導入水解靜置工法後，濕潤的生麵團質地會變得顯著光滑細膩且具備極佳的延展拉伸性。

examples.en: Mixing only flour and water during the initial autolyse encourages effortless gluten formation.
examples.zh: 在最初的水解靜置階段僅混勻麵粉與純水，能在完全不費力揉麵的狀態下自發形成良好麵筋。

examples.en: Allowing flour and water to autolyse for sixty minutes relaxes proteins, making subsequent kneading effortless.
examples.zh: 將麵粉與水混合均勻水解自溶靜置一小時，能軟化小麥蛋白質，讓後續揉麵輕鬆出筋。

examples.en: Adding salt only after the autolyse phase prevents tightening gluten too early in the mixing process.
examples.zh: 堅持在水解自溶工序結束後才加入海鹽，能避免麵筋過早緊繃收縮影響延展。

examples.en: During autolyse, natural enzymes activate and convert starches into fermentable simple sugars.
examples.zh: 在麵粉自溶水解期間，天然酵素被充分活化，將小麥澱粉分解轉化為酵母所需的發酵糖分。

entries.definition: 水解靜置法（麵粉與水預先水合）；麵粉與水預先水解自溶靜置工序

explains.en: It is a bread-making rest when flour and water sit together before other ingredients are added. Enzymes soften the mixture. The dough becomes smoother.
A baker may mix only flour and water, then let them rest. This encourages gluten to develop naturally. The mixture becomes easier to stretch.
During this early bread step, flour hydrates before salt or yeast is added. The dough gains strength. It can make kneading easier.

examples.en: High oven steam creates a blistered, crackling, mahogany-brown artisanal bread crust.
examples.zh: 烘烤初期注入飽滿蒸氣能烤出表面佈滿細緻脆泡、色澤誘人如琥珀般的極致酥脆脆皮。

examples.en: Some children prefer soft white sandwich bread with the outer brown crust removed.
examples.zh: 有些挑食的小朋友更偏好吐司內部鬆軟的白麵包，吃三明治時總要求將外圍的深色吐司邊切除。

examples.en: Geologists study the thick oceanic crust that forms the outer rocky shell of planet Earth.
examples.zh: 地質學家深入探勘研究構成地球最外層堅硬岩石圈結構的厚實大洋地殼。

examples.en: The dark golden blistered crust crackles loudly with a hollow thud when tapped with a knuckle.
examples.zh: 烤至深金黃色、帶有細小酥脆氣泡的麵包外皮，用指節輕敲時發出清脆響亮的空洞聲響。

examples.en: Generous steam injection during the initial bake phase keeps the crust flexible so it can expand fully.
examples.zh: 入爐前段灌注充沛蒸氣能延緩外皮結殼硬化，給予麵包充分舒展伸張的黃金時間。

examples.en: Connoisseurs prize the smoky bitterness of an artisan loaf’s deeply caramelized dark mahogany crust.
examples.zh: 真正懂麵包的老饕最迷戀那烤至深紅褐色的焦脆外殼，品嚐其微苦回甘的純粹焦糖香。

examples.en: Thick ferromanganese crusts coating the flanks of seamounts contain critical rare-earth elements for batteries.
examples.zh: 沉積覆蓋在海山斜坡上的厚重富鈷鐵錳結殼，富含製造綠能電池不可或缺的關鍵稀土元素。

examples.en: The oceanic crust is constantly being created at mid-ocean ridges and recycled in subduction trenches.
examples.zh: 大洋地殼在洋中脊處源源不斷新生誕生，並在萬米深邃的隱沒海溝處重新俯衝熔化重返地函。

examples.en: Stripping the mineral crust from underwater mountains poses severe threats to rare deep-sea fish nurseries.
examples.zh: 強行從海底山坡剝除金屬礦物結殼，將對珍貴稀有的深海魚類育苗棲地帶來不可抹滅的致命威脅。

examples.en: Deep drilling probes may one day melt through Europa's frozen ice crust to reach the warm salty ocean beneath.
examples.zh: 熱融鑽探探測器有朝一日將融化木衛二厚達數十公里的冰層外殼，探訪下方溫暖深邃的地下海洋。

examples.en: Cracks and red mineral streaks on the surface indicate dynamic tidal flexing within the icy crust.
examples.zh: 縱橫交錯在冰原表面的紅色礦物條紋裂隙，揭示了木星巨大潮汐引力在冰殼內部引發的劇烈地質活動。

examples.en: Radar sounders mounted on the orbital probe penetrated through the top kilometers of the frozen crust.
examples.zh: 搭載於軌道探測衛星上的穿透雷達測高儀，成功穿透並透視了冰封外殼頂層數公里深的地質結構斷面。

examples.en: A deep golden crust forms quickly, locking in the succulent, evenly cooked interior juices.
examples.zh: 牛排表面迅速形成一層深金黃色且香氣四溢的「酥脆焦香外皮」（Crust），牢牢鎖住內層鮮美肉汁。

examples.en: Sourdough bakers pride themselves on baking artisan loaves with blistered, caramelized crusts.
examples.zh: 酸種烘焙師以烤出帶有焦香脆泡、金黃焦化的職人手作歐包脆皮為榮。

examples.en: Geologists study tectonic plate collisions that push continental crust upward into majestic mountain chains.
examples.zh: 地質學家深入研究地殼板塊的劇烈擠壓碰撞，正是這種推力將大陸地殼抬升成雄偉山脈。

examples.en: Mining companies target thick ferromanganese cobalt crusts coating the flanks of dormant seamounts.
examples.zh: 採礦企業將目光鎖定在覆蓋於休眠海山斜坡上厚達數十公分的「富鈷鐵錳金屬結殼」（Cobalt Crust）。

examples.en: Earth's rocky outer crust floats atop the semi-fluid mantle layer beneath our feet.
examples.zh: 地球堅硬多岩石的表層地殼，浮游在我們腳下深處半流體的地函岩漿層之上。

examples.en: She spread strawberry jam over the freshly toasted bread crust for a quick morning breakfast.
examples.zh: 她在現烤出爐的吐司香脆邊緣抹上一層草莓果醬，當作忙碌早晨的快速營養早餐。

entries.definition: 麵包金黃酥脆外皮；地殼；焦香酥脆金黃脆皮外殼 (帶微氣泡)；富鈷鐵錳結殼；海底地殼；外皮；木衛二地下數十公里厚之極硬冰層外殼；牛排表面金黃酥脆焦香誘人之香脆外皮；覆蓋在海山岩石表面之富鈷鐵錳金屬結殼

explains.en: The outside of a loaf becomes brown and crisp in the oven. Some people remove it from a sandwich.
The rocky outer layer of Earth lies beneath our feet. Scientists study how this layer changes.
A cooked steak may have a browned outer surface, while a loaf can have a firm outside too. The word names an outer layer.

examples.en: Sourdough bakers take pride in achieving a glossy, airy, open crumb structure.
examples.zh: 頂級酸種麵包師以能烘烤出內部如蜂巢般晶瑩剔透、輕盈大氣孔的組織結構為榮。

examples.en: She swept the bread crumbs off the dining table with a wooden brush after breakfast.
examples.zh: 享用完早餐後，她拿起一把精巧的木質小毛刷，輕輕拂去餐桌上掉落的麵包屑。

examples.en: A dense, uniform crumb is desirable when baking sturdy sandwich sandwich loaves.
examples.zh: 在烘烤質地紮實耐切的三明治專用方塊吐司時，細密均勻無大氣孔的組織結構更受青睞。

examples.en: Slicing the cooled loaf reveals an open, airy honeycomb crumb glistening with natural moisture.
examples.zh: 待麵包完全放涼後俐落切開，展現出如蜂巢般大氣孔開闊、泛著絲綢般水亮光澤的內部組織。

examples.en: Gentle shaping preserves gas pockets so the crumb structure remains open rather than dense.
examples.zh: 溫柔輕巧的最後整形手法能完整保留發酵氣室，使烤出的麵包心呈現開闊而非緊實死硬。

examples.en: A gummy, wet crumb usually indicates underbaking or cutting the loaf before it completely cooled down.
examples.zh: 若切開時麵包內部呈現黏牙濕潤的口感，通常代表烘烤時間不足或是尚未放涼便急躁下刀。

entries.definition: 麵包內部氣孔組織；麵包屑；蜂巢狀大氣孔柔軟內部麵包心組織

explains.en: When a loaf is cut open, its soft inside shows small air holes. Bakers call this structure by a special name.
Tiny pieces of bread may fall onto the table after breakfast. Sweep them away with a brush.
A light, airy loaf has a soft center with open spaces. This word can also mean a small piece of bread.

examples.en: Precise scoring with a sharp razor blade guides where the loaf expands during baking.
examples.zh: 使用極度鋒利的專業割包刀在麵包表面俐落劃出優雅弧線，能精準引導麵包在烤箱內爆裂膨脹。

examples.en: Creative bakers use intricate wheat stalk patterns when scoring their sourdough boules.
examples.zh: 充滿創意的歐包烘焙師在為圓形酸種麵包割線時，喜歡劃出繁複生動的麥穗圖騰紋路。

examples.en: The basketball star led the league in scoring throughout the entire regular season.
examples.zh: 這位當家籃球明星在整個正規賽季中技壓群雄，高居全聯盟個人總得分排行榜榜首。

examples.en: Precise angled scoring with a sharp razor blade allows steam to escape, producing a prominent crispy ear.
examples.zh: 用鋒利的割線刀在麵團表面進行精準斜切割線劃痕，能引導蒸氣爆發並烤出金黃挺立的脆耳。

examples.en: Without proper surface scoring, the expanding loaf may rupture awkwardly along the bottom rim.
examples.zh: 若未在表面劃出導引出氣孔的割線，急速膨脹的麵包很可能在底部側邊產生醜陋爆裂。

examples.en: Intricate decorative scoring transforms everyday rustic loaves into stunning works of edible art.
examples.zh: 繁複華麗的麥穗與藤蔓幾何裝飾性割線，能將質樸的鄉村麵包昇華為令人驚嘆的餐桌藝術品。

entries.definition: 割線割包；得分；割線剃刀劃開麵包頂部脆耳刻痕

explains.en: In bread making, this is cutting the surface of dough with a sharp blade before baking. The cuts guide where the loaf opens as it expands. In sports, it can mean earning points.
A baker may make a wheat pattern on a loaf before it enters the oven. This controlled cut helps steam escape. The same word can refer to points in a game.
Use this noun for adding cuts to shaped dough or for gaining points in a sport. Bread cuts can create a decorative pattern. A basketball player can lead the league in points.

examples.en: Traditional French baguettes contain only four pure ingredients: flour, water, salt, and yeast.
examples.zh: 遵循法國傳統工法的法式長棍麵包堅持僅使用小麥麵粉、純水、海鹽與酵母四種純粹原料。

examples.en: He picked up two fresh, crackling baguettes from the Paris boulangerie for dinner.
examples.zh: 他在傍晚下班途中順道在巴黎街角傳統麵包店買了兩根剛出爐、外皮脆響的法式長棍。

examples.en: Cut the crusty baguette diagonally to prepare crunchy garlic crostini appetizers.
examples.zh: 將脆皮法式長棍麵包斜切成均勻厚片，烤成金黃香脆的義式蒜香烤麵包前菜脆片。

explains.en: It is a long, narrow French loaf with a crisp crust. Flour, water, salt, and yeast are common ingredients. Slice it for dinner.
A bakery may sell this golden loaf fresh in the morning. Its inside is soft while the outside crackles. It can be made into garlic crostini.
This traditional French bread is shaped like a long stick. People may carry it home under an arm. A crunchy crust is a sign of good baking.

examples.en: A golden butter croissant boasts hundreds of paper-thin, crispy honeycomb layers.
examples.zh: 一只剛出爐的金黃法式可頌切開後內部呈現出無比完美、薄如蟬翼的蜂巢狀立體層次。

examples.en: Enjoying a warm flaky croissant alongside a hot cafe au lait is an iconic French morning ritual.
examples.zh: 早晨坐在街角露天咖啡座享用一隻溫熱酥脆的可頌與一杯熱法式歐蕾咖啡，是極具法式浪漫的儀式感。

examples.en: Creating artisanal croissants requires multiple rounds of chilling, rolling, and laminating butter sheets.
examples.zh: 親手製作職人級千層可頌需要經歷多輪繁複嚴謹的冷藏、擀壓以及反覆裹油折疊工序。

examples.en: Biting into a pristine French butter croissant yields an audible crunch followed by rich melting butter.
examples.zh: 輕輕咬下一口剛出爐的法式經典奶油可頌，先是一聲清脆酥響，隨即迎來濃郁發酵奶油的融化香氣。

examples.en: Slicing a cross-section of a high-quality croissant displays a flawless, uniform honeycomb interior structure.
examples.zh: 橫切剖開一顆頂級可頌，斷面展現出如精密蜂巢般均勻舒展、薄如蟬翼的氣孔網狀結構。

examples.en: She enjoyed dunking the tip of her warm croissant into a bowl of cafe au lait at the corner bistro.
examples.zh: 她最喜歡坐在轉角露天小酒館，將剛出爐的溫暖可頌尖角輕輕沾著香濃法式歐蕾咖啡品嚐。

entries.definition: 法式經典可頌牛角麵包；蜂巢氣孔十六層法式經典奶油可頌

explains.en: This French pastry has many thin, buttery layers and a curved shape. It is often eaten for breakfast.
A baker folds butter into dough several times, then bakes the pastry until flaky. It goes well with coffee.
A warm crescent-shaped treat has a crisp outside and soft inside. Some people fill it with chocolate.

examples.en: French cultured butter imparts a rich, hazelnutty aroma to laminated pastries.
examples.zh: 頂級法國諾曼第發酵奶油（Cultured Butter）帶有迷人的榛果香氣與天然乳酸芬芳。

examples.en: Cultured butter is made by fermenting fresh sweet cream with active lactic acid bacteria.
examples.zh: 發酵奶油是透過在新鮮香甜的生乳鮮奶油中接入活性乳酸菌種，經長時間低溫慢速發酵製成。

examples.en: Spreading chilled cultured butter onto warm crusty bread highlights its deep dairy complexity.
examples.zh: 將冰涼的頂級天然發酵奶油抹在剛烤出爐的脆皮歐式麵包上，能極致烘托出深邃迷人的乳香層次。

entries.definition: 發酵奶油（天然乳酸發酵）

explains.en: Cream is mixed with helpful bacteria and left to develop a tangy taste. Bakers use it in pastries.
This butter can add a rich, nutty smell to a croissant. It is made by fermenting cream.
Spread a cold piece on warm bread to enjoy its deep dairy flavor. Its tang comes from natural bacteria.

examples.en: Skilled dough lamination requires maintaining butter and dough at identical cool temperatures.
examples.zh: 製作千層可頌的摺疊裹油工法（Lamination）極度考驗將奶油與麵團精準維持在相同的冰涼溫度。

examples.en: Flawed lamination causes butter to melt into the dough, ruining the crispy separation of layers.
examples.zh: 若裹油折疊溫控失誤，會導致奶油融化被麵團吸收，從而徹底破壞烘烤後層次分明的酥脆結構。

examples.en: Industrial plastic lamination protects important identity cards and paper certificates from water damage.
examples.zh: 工業塑膠護膜熱壓工藝（Lamination）能保護重要的身分證件與紙本獲獎證書免受受潮損毀。

examples.en: Perfect butter tourage lamination encloses paper-thin layers of chilled cultured butter between delicate sheets of dough.
examples.zh: 頂級開酥裹油折疊工藝，將冰涼發酵奶油片均勻包裹在麵團層中，反覆三折出數十層黃金酥皮。

examples.en: Keeping dough cold between turns prevents butter from melting into the flour during lamination.
examples.zh: 在每次折疊開酥工序之間將麵團送入冷藏降溫，能徹底防止奶油因室溫融化而滲入麵粉。

examples.en: Modern bakeries use automated dough sheeters to maintain millimeter consistency throughout the lamination process.
examples.zh: 現代精品烘焙坊引進精密自動壓麵機，在裹油延壓全程確保酥皮厚薄達到毫米級的一致性。

entries.definition: 摺疊裹油千層工藝；層壓；奶油裹油折疊開酥壓延工藝

explains.en: In baking, this is folding layers of dough and butter together to create a flaky pastry. Keeping both cool helps the layers stay separate. Plastic sheets can also be joined this way.
A baker rolls chilled dough and butter into many thin layers. If the butter melts, the pastry may not become crisp. The word also describes covering paper with protective plastic.
Use this noun for creating layers in dough or protecting a card with a plastic film. Croissants use layered pastry. A laminating machine can seal an identity card.

examples.en: Rich brioche dough is packed with whole eggs and butter, creating a featherlight bun.
examples.zh: 奢華加入大量新鮮全蛋與濃郁奶油烘烤而成的法式布里歐麵包，口感極致柔軟如雲朵。

examples.en: Gourmet burger joints serve juicy grilled patties on toasted golden brioche buns.
examples.zh: 頂級精品手作漢堡名店偏好以微烤金黃的布里歐漢堡包，夾入多汁現烤的熟成牛肉漢堡排。

examples.en: Day-old brioche slices make decadent French toast when soaked in sweet cinnamon egg custard.
examples.zh: 將隔夜的布里歐麵包切片浸泡在肉桂香草蛋奶液中煎製，能做出極度銷魂誘人的經典法式吐司。

examples.en: Enriched with eighty percent European butter and golden egg yolks, brioche toast melts like velvet on the tongue.
examples.zh: 奢侈揉入高達八成天然發酵奶油與新鮮蛋黃的法式布里歐修，在舌尖展現如絲絨般化開的濃郁奶香。

examples.en: Thick slices of day-old brioche make the most decadent, custard-soaked French toast imaginable.
examples.zh: 將隔夜的厚切布里歐修吐司浸透香草蛋奶液煎烤，能製成極致香濃、入口即化的頂級法式吐司。

examples.en: The baker kneads butter into the brioche dough slowly until the mixture becomes silky and elastic.
examples.zh: 烘焙師以極度耐心分次將軟化奶油揉進布里歐麵團中，直到整體麵團呈現絲緞般的延展光澤。

entries.definition: 法式布里歐麵包（高奶油高蛋黃）；濃郁奶香法式布里歐修金黃吐司

explains.en: It is a soft French bread enriched with eggs and butter. The crumb is light and rich. A burger may be served on a toasted bun made from it.
This golden loaf has a tender texture because its dough contains butter and eggs. Bakers may use it for sweet French toast. It is richer than plain bread.
A cook can make a soft, slightly sweet roll from this enriched dough. It pairs well with savory fillings. The crust turns golden in the oven.

examples.en: Boiling raw dough in malt water before baking yields a delightfully chewy bagel.
examples.zh: 在進烤箱前先將麵團放入麥芽糖滾水中汆燙數十秒，能賦予手作貝果極富嚼勁的彈牙外皮。

examples.en: She ordered a toasted sesame bagel filled with smoked salmon and herb cream cheese.
examples.zh: 她在早午餐店點了一份烘烤得外脆內軟的香濃白芝麻貝果，內餡夾滿挪威燻鮭魚與蒔蘿乳酪抹醬。

examples.en: New York-style bagels are famous worldwide for their glossy exterior crust and dense crumb.
examples.zh: 經典紐約風格美式貝果以其表面晶亮光澤的薄脆外皮與扎實飽滿、極富嚼勁的內裡聞名遐邇。

entries.definition: 美式貝果麵包；水煮烘烤圈

explains.en: This round bread has a hole in the middle and a chewy texture. It is often sliced and filled with cream cheese.
A baker briefly boils the ring-shaped dough before baking it. Sesame seeds may cover the outside.
People eat this chewy bread with smoked fish, eggs, or jam. It is popular for breakfast.

examples.en: Japanese Shokupan milk bread is prized for its pillowy softness and edible crust.
examples.zh: 風靡全台的頂級日式生吐司以入口即化的綿密如絲口感與連吐司邊都軟嫩清甜而著稱。

examples.en: Artisan bakers use high-fat Hokkaido cream and the Yudane method to craft luxurious Shokupan.
examples.zh: 烘焙名師採用北海道高乳脂頂級鮮奶油結合日式湯種工法（Yudane），精心烘烤出奢華生吐司。

examples.en: Tearing into a freshly baked loaf of warm Shokupan reveals moist, cloud-like feathery strands.
examples.zh: 徒手撕開一整條熱氣騰騰的現烤生吐司，內部呈現出如雲朵般濕潤牽絲、細緻拉絲的羽毛紋理。

entries.definition: 日式生吐司 (Shokupan)；鮮奶生吐司

explains.en: This Japanese milk bread has a soft, fluffy inside and a light crust. It is often eaten at breakfast.
A baker may use rich cream and a special dough method to make this tender loaf. It can be pulled apart warm.
People enjoy this soft square bread with butter or jam. The inside has delicate strands.

examples.en: Freshly baked cinnamon rolls are smothered in gooey vanilla cream cheese icing.
examples.zh: 剛出爐熱氣騰騰的香濃手作美式肉桂捲上淋滿了絲滑濃郁的香草奶油乳酪白糖霜。

examples.en: The cozy cafe fills with an intoxicating aroma of brown sugar and spice from warm cinnamon rolls.
examples.zh: 溫馨文青咖啡館內瀰漫著剛出爐肉桂捲中黑糖、焦糖與濃郁香料交織的銷魂香氣。

examples.en: Savoring an indulgent frosted cinnamon roll paired with black coffee is the ultimate weekend treat.
examples.zh: 週末點上一顆淋上誘人糖霜的厚肉桂捲搭配一杯無糖黑美式，是犒賞自己一週辛勞的極致享受。

entries.definition: 美式肉桂捲；肉桂蝸牛卷

explains.en: This is a soft, sweet pastry filled with cinnamon and sugar, then rolled into a spiral. It may have creamy icing on top. Cafes often serve it warm.
A baker spreads spiced sugar on dough and rolls it up before baking. The finished pastry has a swirl inside. Coffee is a popular drink with it.
Use this phrase for a sweet baked spiral with cinnamon filling. It can be topped with vanilla frosting. The warm smell often fills a cafe.

examples.en: Baked in beeswaxed copper molds, caneles have a caramelized crunchy shell and custard interior.
examples.zh: 在塗滿天然蜂蠟的純銅模中高溫烘烤的可麗露外殼焦香酥脆，內部軟嫩如香草卡士達布丁。

examples.en: Authentic Bordeaux caneles require resting the vanilla rum batter in the fridge for forty-eight hours.
examples.zh: 正宗法國波爾多可麗露麵糊必須先加入天然香草莢與蘭姆酒，並低溫冷藏靜置熟成四十八小時。

examples.en: Achieving a deep dark mahogany color without burning the shell is the true mark of a skilled canele baker.
examples.zh: 烘烤出深沉如琥珀黑檀木般的焦脆光澤外殼且完全不烤焦發苦，是評斷烘焙師技術的最高指標。

explains.en: It is a small French pastry with a dark, crisp outer shell and soft custard center. It is traditionally baked in a fluted mold. It comes from Bordeaux.
A baker rests vanilla and rum batter before baking it in a beeswaxed mold. The result is crunchy outside and tender within. A deep brown color is desired.
This small cake has ridged sides and a creamy inside. Its shell caramelizes in the oven. Skilled bakers avoid burning the outside.

examples.en: Delicate almond macarons feature ruffled feet and rich dark chocolate ganache fillings.
examples.zh: 精巧雅緻的法式馬卡龍擁有完美的蕾絲裙邊外圈，中間夾入濃郁絲滑的法芙娜黑巧甘納許。

examples.en: Macarons are notoriously temperamental pastries that require strict humidity and temperature control.
examples.zh: 法式馬卡龍是烘焙界出了名嬌貴難伺候的甜點，製作過程對空氣濕度與烤溫掌控有極苛刻的要求。

examples.en: The Parisian boutique arranged pastel-colored macarons in exquisite gift boxes.
examples.zh: 這間巴黎精品甜點沙龍將馬卡龍粉彩色系的小圓餅，精心陳列在緞帶燙金禮盒中。

examples.en: The pastel-pink rose macaron boasts a delicate crisp shell with a chewy almond meringue center.
examples.zh: 散發夢幻淡粉色澤的玫瑰法式馬卡龍，擁有外層酥脆、內裡濕潤黏韌的迷人杏仁蛋白霜裙邊。

examples.en: Baking a successful macaron requires letting piped batter dry until a dull skin forms on top.
examples.zh: 成功烘烤馬卡龍的關鍵竅門，在於擠出圓形麵糊後必須靜置結皮，直到表面觸摸不黏手方可入爐。

examples.en: Each box contained twelve colorful macarons ranging from salted caramel to black currant flavors.
examples.zh: 精裝禮盒中整齊排列著十二顆繽紛馬卡龍，口味從海鹽焦糖到酸甜黑醋栗一應俱全。

entries.definition: 法式馬卡龍（少女的酥胸）；少女酥胸雙色法式杏仁馬卡龍

explains.en: Two smooth almond meringue shells hold a soft filling in the middle. The small French treat comes in many colors.
A baker pipes small circles of egg-white and almond mixture, then fills them with cream. They can be delicate to make.
A pastel cookie has a crisp shell and chewy center. Flavors may include chocolate or fruit.

examples.en: Fresh lemon zest madeleines rise with a signature rounded bump in shell molds.
examples.zh: 現烤出爐的清新檸檬皮屑瑪德蓮蛋糕在貝殼模具中完美鼓起標誌性的可愛圓潤小肚臍。

examples.en: Marcel Proust famously described how tasting a tea-soaked madeleine unlocked vivid childhood memories.
examples.zh: 法國大文豪普魯斯特在巨作中生動描繪了當咬下一口浸過紅茶的瑪德蓮時，童年記憶瞬間翻湧而出。

examples.en: Glazing the warm madeleines with a thin citrus sugar syrup gives them a sweet crunchy sheen.
examples.zh: 在微溫的瑪德蓮表面刷上一層薄透的檸檬柑橘糖霜，能為外層增添一層甜脆爽口的光澤。

explains.en: This small French cake is baked in a shell-shaped mold. Lemon peel can add a bright taste.
A warm little cake may have a rounded bump on its back. A French writer remembered childhood after tasting one.
Dip this shell-shaped treat into tea for a soft, buttery snack. A thin sugar coating adds sweetness.

examples.en: Golden almond financiers gain their nutty depth from clarified browned hazelnut butter.
examples.zh: 烘烤至金黃酥脆的杏仁費南雪金磚蛋糕其銷魂香氣來自於將無鹽奶油高溫熬煮成的榛果焦化奶油。

examples.en: French bankers in the Paris stock district loved financiers because they did not soil their suits.
examples.zh: 巴黎證券交易所附近的銀行家熱愛隨手享用費南雪金磚蛋糕，因為食用時完全不會弄髒訂製西裝。

examples.en: A great financier has crisp caramelized rectangular edges and an unbeatably moist almond crumb.
examples.zh: 一只出色的頂級費南雪金磚蛋糕外圈金黃微焦酥脆，內裡則保持著濕潤柔軟的濃厚杏仁奶香。

entries.definition: 費南雪金磚蛋糕；金融家

explains.en: This is a small French almond cake with a moist center and crisp edges. It is often baked in a rectangular mold. Browned butter gives it a nutty flavor.
The little cake is made with almond flour, egg whites, sugar, and butter. Its shape can look like a small gold bar. Cafes serve it with tea or coffee.
Use this noun for a delicate almond cake from France. It has a golden outside and soft middle. Bakers often serve it with tea or coffee.

examples.en: A glossy fruit tart filled with vanilla cream is topped with glazed strawberries.
examples.zh: 一只外殼酥脆的法式水果塔擠滿香草卡士達，表面鋪滿晶瑩剔透淋上鏡面果膠的新鮮大草莓。

examples.en: The patisserie's signature lemon tart has a perfectly tart curd balancing a buttery crisp crust.
examples.zh: 這家法式甜點專賣店的招牌檸檬塔以酸香明亮凝乳內餡，完美平衡了牛油香濃郁的酥脆塔殼。

examples.en: Granny Smith green apples possess a pleasantly tart flavor that holds up well during pie baking.
examples.zh: 翠綠的澳洲青蘋果帶有討喜明亮的微酸爽口風味，在進烤箱烘烤蘋果派時能保持極佳的口感與酸度。

examples.en: The refreshing lemon meringue tart balances zesty, sour lemon curd with sweet toasted meringue tips.
examples.zh: 這款經典的法式檸檬塔，以酸香濃郁的現榨黃檸檬凝乳完美中和了微炙蛋白霜的香甜。

examples.en: Seasonal strawberries glazed with red currant jelly sat atop the almond cream tart base.
examples.zh: 刷上薄薄紅醋栗果凍光澤膠的新鮮當季草莓，整齊簇擁盛裝在濃郁的杏仁奶油甜塔皮底座上。

examples.en: The chef created a savory heirloom tomato tart garnished with aged balsamic glaze and goat cheese.
examples.zh: 主廚巧具匠心地端出一款經典傳家寶番茄鹹塔，佐以陳年巴薩米克酒醋與新鮮山羊乳酪。

entries.definition: 法式甜塔；水果塔；酸澀的；法式黃檸檬凝乳蛋白霜甜塔；酸的

explains.en: It is a baked pastry with a shallow crust and a filling, often fruit or lemon. A glossy strawberry version may have vanilla cream. The adjective can also mean sour.
Bakers fill a crisp shell with fruit, custard, or lemon curd. Granny Smith apples have a sharp flavor. The word can describe that taste too.
This dessert has an open pastry base instead of a top crust. It may be sweet or savory. As an adjective, it can describe something sour.

examples.en: Chocolate eclairs are slender choux pastries filled with espresso mocha cream.
examples.zh: 經典法式閃電泡芙（Éclair）由修長酥脆的泡芙麵團製成，內部灌入香濃義式摩卡咖啡鮮奶油。

examples.en: The sweet pastry gets its French name because people devour the delicious treat in a flash.
examples.zh: 這道法式精緻甜點之所以得名「閃電」，是因為它太過美味誘人，以至於人們總是如閃電般迅速掃光。

examples.en: Each delicate eclair is dipped into glossy dark chocolate fondant icing for a mirror finish.
examples.zh: 每一根細長的閃電泡芙頂部皆會浸裹上一層晶亮的苦甜黑巧克力糖霜，散發出如鏡面般的光澤。

examples.en: Filled with rich Madagascar vanilla bean custard, the shiny chocolate eclair is a beloved French tea treat.
examples.zh: 灌滿香濃馬達加斯加香草卡士達醬、表面淋上晶亮黑巧克力的長條閃電泡芙，是下午茶的絕配。

examples.en: The baker piped an even baton of choux dough onto perforated silicone mats to ensure straight eclairs.
examples.zh: 麵包師以鋸齒花嘴在透氣矽膠烤墊上擠出筆直均勻的長條泡芙糊，確保烘烤時不彎曲變形。

examples.en: Dipping the surface into mirror-like dark chocolate icing gives the eclair its glossy signature finish.
examples.zh: 將金黃酥脆的泡芙表面輕巧沾上一層鏡面黑巧克力淋醬，為閃電泡芙賦予招牌的耀眼光澤。

entries.definition: 閃電泡芙 (Éclair)；經典法式長條閃電泡芙 (卡士達內餡)

explains.en: A long pastry made from choux dough is filled with cream and topped with chocolate icing. It is sold in bakeries.
