examples.zh: 輕量小巧的真空冷凍乾燥飯只需注入滾燙熱水悶煮十分鐘，瞬間還原成熱氣騰騰的美味拌飯。

examples.en: Freeze-dried berries retain ninety-seven percent of their original vitamins and antioxidant nutrients.
examples.zh: 經過先進超低溫真空冷凍乾燥技術處理的藍莓與草莓乾，完整保留了高達九成七的原生維生素。

examples.en: Carrying freeze-dried hiking rations dramatically shaves pack weight on remote multi-day routes.
examples.zh: 在挑戰無補給的高山長天數縱走路線時全程背負冷凍乾燥乾燥飯，能極致減輕登山背包總重量。

examples.en: Freeze-dried trekking meal pouches are featherlight, rehydrating into steaming chicken risotto after ten minutes.
examples.zh: 超輕量的急速凍乾料理包，注入滾水燜泡十分鐘即可化為一碗熱氣騰騰的香濃燉飯。

examples.en: Packing freeze-dried rations cuts pack weight dramatically on seven-day wilderness expeditions.
examples.zh: 在為期七天的高山縱走中攜帶凍乾糧食乾燥飯包，能戲劇性地減輕背包的總負重負擔。

examples.en: Pour boiling water directly into the freeze-dried foil pouch and stir well before resealing.
examples.zh: 將滾燙開水直接注入鋁箔凍乾餐袋中，以長柄湯匙徹底拌勻後密封等待享用。

entries.definition: 低溫真空凍乾的；乾燥飯；凍乾輕量高熱量登山乾燥飯料理包的

explains.en: This food is made very light by removing water in a vacuum. Add hot water before eating it.
A pouch of fruit prepared this way keeps much of its flavor and nutrients. Hikers carry it to save weight.
Travelers can pour boiling water into the meal bag and wait a few minutes. This food is easy to pack for a long trip.

examples.en: Munching on trail mix with roasted almonds and dried cranberries maintains steady energy.
examples.zh: 在行進間隨手抓一把包含低溫烘焙杏仁果、核桃與蔓越莓乾的綜合行動糧能持續提供穩定熱量。

examples.en: Custom homemade trail mix with dark chocolate chips and walnuts satisfies sweet cravings.
examples.zh: 親手將高純度苦甜黑巧克力豆與生核桃混拌而成的自製能量行動糧，能及時滿足高山上的甜食渴望。

examples.en: Keep a ziplock bag of salty trail mix accessible in your hip belt pocket while moving.
examples.zh: 在登山背包腰帶的小拉鍊袋中常備一包加入少許海鹽的綜合果乾堅果，邊走邊吃隨時補充電解質。

entries.definition: 登山綜合果乾堅果行動糧

explains.en: This snack combines nuts, dried fruit, or seeds. It is easy to carry on a walk. A small handful can give someone energy.
Ella packed raisins and almonds before the hike. She shared some with her brother at a rest stop. They saved the rest for later.
Some people add cereal or chocolate pieces. Ingredients can change to suit different tastes. Keep the snack in a closed bag.

examples.en: Hollow-fiber membrane water filtration removes 99.999% of bacteria and protozoa from mountain streams.
examples.zh: 採用中空絲膜微孔過濾技術的隨身野外濾水器，能徹底濾除溪水中百分之九十九以上的病菌與原蟲。

examples.en: Gravity water filtration systems allow mountaineering groups to filter four liters without manual pumping.
examples.zh: 採用重力自流式的吊掛式戶外大容量濾水系統，讓登山隊伍無需費力手動按壓即可快速淨化四公升水源。

examples.en: Inspect the filtration cartridge regularly to prevent sediment clogging after dipping in silted pools.
examples.zh: 定期逆向反洗檢查微孔濾芯濾膜，能有效防止在泥沙淤積的微濁看天池取水時發生濾芯堵塞。

examples.en: Squeezing murky river water through a 0.1-micron hollow-fiber filtration device removes bacteria and protozoa.
examples.zh: 將混濁的山澗溪水擠過 0.1 微米中空纖維微孔過濾器，能在瞬間濾除 99.9% 細菌與原蟲。

examples.en: Reliable water filtration protects long-distance hikers against debilitating giardia infections.
examples.zh: 隨身攜帶可靠的登山濾水器過濾水源，能保護長程健行者免於罹患令人虛脫的梨形鞭毛蟲症。

examples.en: Backflush your filtration cartridge regularly with clean water to prevent silt from clogging the flow.
examples.zh: 定期使用乾淨清水對濾水器濾芯進行反向沖洗，可避免泥沙沉積阻塞出水流量。

examples.en: Syringe filtration captures shed skin cells, scales, and mucus containing genetic material onto micro-pore discs.
examples.zh: 透過針筒「微孔過濾膜」（Filtration），在野外瞬間捕捉水中脫落的動物皮屑、鱗片與黏液基因樣本。

examples.en: Ultra-fine water filtration removes silt and suspended algae before genetic extraction begins.
examples.zh: 超細孔徑水質過濾能在基因萃取程序展開前，有效濾除溪水中的泥沙顆粒與懸浮藻類。

examples.en: Portable field filtration kits allow scientists to process river samples immediately on remote mountain banks.
examples.zh: 攜帶式野外過濾套組讓科研團隊能在偏遠的溪畔第一時間處理採集的水樣。

examples.en: Continuous mechanical sand filtration removes suspended debris to maintain crystal-clear water clarity.
examples.zh: 二十四小時持續運轉的「石英砂機械過濾槽」（Filtration），濾除微小雜質以維持如水晶般清澈的水質。

examples.en: Upgrading municipal filtration plants ensures that suburban households receive clean drinking tap water.
examples.zh: 全面升級自來水廠的多段式濾砂過濾淨水設施，能確保廣大都會郊區家庭享有純淨的自來水。

examples.en: High-efficiency HEPA air filtration traps microscopic dust and pollen allergens inside hospital wards.
examples.zh: 醫療院所病房內部配置的高效能 HEPA 空氣過濾設備，能精準捕捉空氣中微米級粉塵與花粉過敏原。

entries.definition: 野外微孔濾水過濾；中空纖維高山溪水過濾除菌器；野外無菌針筒濾膜高山溪流快速過濾；多段式大型石英砂與活性碳高壓過濾桶槽

explains.en: It is the process of passing water or air through material that removes unwanted particles. A hollow-fiber filter can remove many germs from a stream. Check the cartridge regularly.
A device may clean water by sending it through a special barrier. Hikers use portable systems. Replace the filter when the maker recommends.
This process separates dirt or other substances from a liquid or gas. A blocked filter may work poorly. It is used in water treatment and many machines.

examples.en: Chlorine dioxide water purification tablets neutralize waterborne viruses in murky puddles.
examples.zh: 二氧化氯水質淨化消毒錠能在三十分鐘內徹底滅活看天池微濁積水中的各類水生有害病毒。

examples.en: Boiling untreated surface water vigorously for three minutes provides complete viral purification.
examples.zh: 將戶外野外採集到的未經處理生水持續劇烈沸騰滾煮三分鐘以上，能達成完全殺菌的水質淨化。

examples.en: Practicing mindfulness meditation is a psychological purification ritual that eases modern mental clutter.
examples.zh: 每天規律進行正念呼吸冥想，是一場洗滌心靈塵埃、淨化現代人繁雜思緒的精神沉澱儀式。

explains.en: A filter removes dirt from water before it is used. Follow instructions to make water safe to drink.
Some camping tablets treat collected water, but people should use them as directed. Clean water is important outdoors.
A treatment process removes unwanted substances from water. Different methods work for different contaminants.

examples.en: Practicing the seven Leave No Trace (LNT) principles preserves wild trails pristine.
examples.zh: 身體力行恪守「無痕山林」（Leave No Trace）七大準則，是每一位山友守護原始山林的最高信仰。

examples.en: Standing firm on personal moral principles is vital when navigating workplace dilemmas.
examples.zh: 當在職場中面臨利益誘惑與複雜倫理兩難時，堅守個人的道德原則底線顯得尤為重要。

examples.en: The core principles of backcountry ethics require hikers to respect wildlife and camp on durable surfaces.
examples.zh: 無痕山林的核心準則明確要求登山者務必尊重野生動物習性，並始終在堅硬耐久地表上紮營。

entries.definition: 無痕山林準則 (LNT)；道德原則

explains.en: Hikers may follow rules to leave nature clean and protect animals. These guidelines help keep trails wild.
A person may hold moral beliefs that guide choices at work. Such beliefs help during hard decisions.
These basic ideas guide how someone behaves. They can also describe rules for respecting nature outside.

examples.en: Pack all food wrappers, fruit peels, and toilet paper into sealed trash pouches.
examples.zh: 將所有泡麵包裝袋、果皮廚餘與使用過的衛生紙全數裝入防臭密封垃圾袋，親自背負下山。

examples.en: A mother kangaroo keeps her newborn joey safe and warm inside her marsupial pouch.
examples.zh: 袋鼠媽媽將剛剛誕生不久的脆弱袋鼠寶寶，妥善保護在溫暖安全的腹部育兒袋中。

examples.en: Keep your passport and cash tucked securely inside a water-resistant neck security pouch.
examples.zh: 在出國自助旅行時，將護照證件與備用現金妥善收納在貼身防潑水防搶掛頸證件暗袋中。

examples.en: Seasoned cuts of wagyu beef are vacuum-sealed inside a food-grade pouch with fresh thyme and butter.
examples.zh: 將調味好的頂級和牛與百里香、發酵奶油一同裝入「食品級真空密封袋」（Pouch）中徹底抽氣封口。

examples.en: The marathon runner carried energy gels inside a waterproof zippered pouch around his waist.
examples.zh: 馬拉松跑者將能量果凍妥善收納在繫於腰間的防潑水拉鍊隨身小袋中。

examples.en: Mother kangaroos shelter their newborn joeys securely within their soft abdominal pouch.
examples.zh: 母袋鼠將剛出生的幼獸安全呵護在柔軟溫暖的腹部育兒袋中。

entries.definition: 密封袋；小袋子；育兒袋；食品級耐高溫真空密封保鮮袋；小袋

explains.en: A small soft bag holds coins, keys, or other little things. It may close with a zipper or drawstring. Some attach to a belt.
A baby kangaroo stays in a pocket of skin on its mother. It is warm and protected there. The young animal leaves when it grows older.
Some foods and drinks come in small sealed bags. A corner can be opened for pouring or sipping. These containers are light to carry.

examples.en: An emergency reflective bivvy sack prevents rapid heat loss during unexpected bivouacs.
examples.zh: 一只僅重百餘克的鋁箔反射式輕量緊急求生避難袋，在深山被迫迫降過夜時能有效防止致命失溫。

examples.en: Waterproof breathable bivvy bags allow solo alpine climbers to sleep safely on tiny cliff ledges.
examples.zh: 具備防水透氣性能的單人露宿袋，讓獨攀阿爾卑斯式攀登者得以在狹窄險峻的岩壁縫隙安全露宿。

examples.en: Always tuck an ultralight bivvy bag into your daypack before venturing onto technical trails.
examples.zh: 在踏上具有地形技術難度的百岳攀爬路線前，務必將一只超輕量緊急避難袋塞進攻頂小包備用。

entries.definition: 輕量緊急防風避難袋 (Bivvy Bag)

explains.en: It is a very light emergency shelter or bag used by hikers and climbers. It helps protect someone from wind and cold. Pack one on a remote trail.
A solo climber may sleep in this waterproof cover on a narrow ledge. Reflective material can help reduce heat loss. It is small enough to carry.
This compact outdoor shelter can help someone survive an unexpected night outside. It may cover a sleeping bag. Keep it in a daypack on technical routes.

examples.en: A compact stainless steel multi-tool features pliers, scissors, and a razor-sharp blade.
examples.zh: 一把精密的折疊式不鏽鋼多功能工具鉗整合了強大鉗口、小剪刀與銳利小刀，能應對各種維修。

examples.en: He used the wire cutters on his pocket multi-tool to repair broken camping stove brackets.
examples.zh: 他抽出隨身多功能工具鉗上的斜口剪線鉗配件，俐落修復了高山爐具被石塊砸凹變形的支架。

examples.en: A quality multi-tool is the most versatile EDC pocket companion for wilderness adventurers.
examples.zh: 一把作工精良的多功能工具鉗是荒野探險家日常隨身攜帶（EDC）最具實用多工價值的身邊好物。

entries.definition: 多功能折疊工具鉗（含小刀）

explains.en: This pocket-sized tool folds out pliers, scissors, and a small blade. Keep sharp parts closed when carrying it.
A camper may use one compact device for simple repairs or cutting cord. It should be handled carefully.
A small folding tool combines several useful parts in one handle. Store it safely and follow local rules.

examples.en: Two-way satellite communicators transmit SOS coordinates without mobile cell coverage.
examples.zh: 雙向衛星通訊求救儀（如 inReach）在完全無手機基地台訊號的深山能發射 SOS 座標簡訊。

examples.en: The team used their satellite communicator to send brief check-in messages to anxious family members.
examples.zh: 登山團隊每晚在偏遠鞍部營地紮營後，透過衛星通訊發報機向山下牽掛的家屬發送平安報備簡訊。

examples.en: A satellite communicator provides an indispensable safety net during solo wilderness expeditions.
examples.zh: 在進行挑戰極限的深山獨攀冒險遠征時，一只雙向衛星通訊儀是不可或缺的最後保命安全底牌。

examples.en: The handheld satellite communicator sends two-way text messages and SOS distress coordinates from dead zones.
examples.zh: 掌上型衛星救命通訊機，在無手機訊號的深山中隨時可發送衛星簡訊與 SOS 求救座標。

examples.en: Family members tracked his solo wilderness progress in real time via the connected communicator.
examples.zh: 牽掛的家人透過通訊機傳回的即時衛星定位點，在家中就能隨時追蹤他獨攀的平安進度。

examples.en: In life-threatening emergencies, pressing the SOS button on your communicator summons helicopter rescue.
examples.zh: 面臨攸關性命的危急險境時，按壓通訊機上的 SOS 救援按鈕即可迅速召喚空勤搜救直升機。

entries.definition: 雙向衛星通訊器 (Garmin inReach)；雙向低軌衛星 SOS 應急救命通訊機

explains.en: A hiker in a place without cell service can use this device to send a short message. It can also send an emergency signal.
A small satellite unit lets a family follow someone's progress in the wilderness. It can call for help in an emergency.
This device sends messages where a phone has no signal. Press its emergency button if someone is in danger.

examples.en: Activating a Personal Locator Beacon (PLB) sends a distress signal directly to rescue centers.
examples.zh: 拔開安全插銷啟動個人定位信標（PLB），求救訊號將透過國際搜救衛星直接傳送至國家搜救中心。

examples.en: The lighthouse beacon shone its bright beam across the treacherous stormy ocean waves.
examples.zh: 屹立在海角崖壁上的燈塔發射出穿透濃霧的璀璨引航信標光芒，照亮狂風巨浪中的航行船隻。

examples.en: Unlike satellite messagers requiring annual subscriptions, a PLB links directly to military SAR satellites for free.
examples.zh: 與需要每年繳納月租費的商用衛星發報器不同，專用 PLB 信標能直接與全球軍用搜救衛星免費連線。

examples.en: Triggering the personal locator beacon broadcasts a 406 MHz emergency signal directly to search-and-rescue satellites.
examples.zh: 一旦遭遇重大山難啟動個人應急示標，即刻向國際搜救衛星發射 406MHz 高功率救援信號。

examples.en: A dedicated emergency beacon has dedicated battery power guaranteed for years without recharging.
examples.zh: 專用的緊急救難定位示標具備原廠封裝長效電池，保證數年之內無需反覆充電隨時待命。

examples.en: Rescuers tracked the beacon's homing frequency to locate the injured climber in dense fog.
examples.zh: 搜救人員循著示標發出的定向導引頻率穿透濃霧，迅速尋獲受傷受困的登山客。

examples.en: Ground-mounted transponder beacons calibrate the train's precise odometer location every few kilometers.
examples.zh: 安裝在軌道中央的「應答器信標」（Transponder Beacons），在列車掠過時即時校正公里里程定位。

examples.en: The lighthouse atop the rocky coastal cliff served as a reassuring beacon for lost fishermen during storms.
examples.zh: 矗立在海蝕岩壁頂端的百年燈塔，在暴風雨驚濤駭浪中是海上迷航漁民心中最安心溫暖的指路明燈。

examples.en: Throughout centuries of struggle, the small democracy stood as a shining beacon of human freedom.
examples.zh: 歷經數個世紀的奮鬥與堅持，這座小而堅韌的民主國度始終是全球人類追求尊嚴與自由的閃亮燈塔。

examples.en: Let your passion for English shine as a brilliant beacon that illuminates the path for others to follow.
examples.zh: 讓你對英語的熱愛化為一座「耀眼的智慧燈塔」（Beacon），照亮身邊更多人勇敢前行的學習之路。

examples.en: The historic lighthouse stood as a safe beacon guiding ships through dense fog and stormy waters.
examples.zh: 這座矗立百年的歷史燈塔化身為安全的明燈指引，引領著往來海輪穿透濃霧與暴風雨平安進港。

examples.en: Taiwan's vibrant democracy serves as an inspiring beacon of freedom and human rights across Asia.
examples.zh: 台灣蓬勃成熟的民主自由制度，已然成為全亞洲地區捍衛人權、平等與進步價值的耀眼啟發燈塔。

entries.definition: 個人緊急定位發射器 (PLB)；燈塔；個人應急指位無線電求救示標 (PLB)；軌道中線安裝之應答器 (向列車傳輸位置校準訊號)；成為自主學習與永續成長之耀眼燦爛燈塔

explains.en: A bright signal helps people see a place or find a safe route. It may come from a tower near the sea. Ships can use its light at night.
The rescue team switched on a small radio device on the mountain. It sent a signal that helped rescuers locate the hikers. The group waited in a sheltered spot.
A tall building can shine as a sign of hope for a community. It may guide people toward help or safety. The image is often used in stories.

examples.en: The National Airborne Service Corps hoisted the injured hiker safely into the helicopter.
examples.zh: 內政部空中勤務總隊黑鷹直升機以精湛飛行技術頂風懸停，成功將受傷山友以鋼索安全吊掛上機。

examples.en: Construction cranes slowly hoist massive steel I-beams up to the forty-second floor.
examples.zh: 工地重型塔式起重吊車緩緩開動鋼索，將數十噸重的主體鋼骨工字鋼樑穩穩吊升至四十二層高樓。

examples.en: After securing the rescue harness, the airborne paramedic signaled the pilot to initiate the cable hoist.
examples.zh: 在確認將傷患妥善固定進搜救吊籃吊帶後，空勤搜救員向機長打出手勢信號，正式啟動鋼索起吊回收。

entries.definition: 直升機鋼索吊掛；吊起提升

explains.en: It means lifting something heavy, often with a rope or machine. Rescue workers may raise an injured hiker into a helicopter. Cranes move steel beams.
A crew can pull a person or object upward using a cable. Secure the load before lifting. Construction workers use cranes for heavy materials.
This verb describes raising something with equipment or effort. A rescue team can lift a person from a ravine. The noun can name the lifting action or machine.

examples.en: Summertime alpine hikers aim to reach shelters before hazardous 1 PM thunderstorms hit.
examples.zh: 夏季攀登百岳請務必養成摸黑早起出發的習慣，爭取在午後一點高山劇烈雷陣雨降臨前抵達山屋。

examples.en: Deafening lightning strikes during a mountain thunderstorm make exposed rocky summits deadly.
examples.zh: 在高山劇烈雷陣雨肆虐期間震耳欲聾的雷擊頻發，使毫無遮蔽的開闊岩石山頂成為極度致命的雷擊區。

examples.en: When an unexpected thunderstorm strikes an open ridge, descend immediately away from metal gear.
examples.zh: 當在開闊的無遮蔽山脊稜線突遭強烈雷雨襲擊時，應立即迅速下撤並將登山杖與金屬器械卸下放置遠處。

explains.en: Dark clouds, strong rain, thunder, and lightning can arrive together. Go indoors when you hear thunder.
A mountain hike may become dangerous when lightning appears nearby. Check weather reports before leaving.
This storm brings heavy rain and loud rumbles from the sky. Stay away from open fields and tall isolated trees.

examples.en: Cold air trapped in the valley created a breathtaking sea of clouds inversion.
examples.zh: 谷底沉積的冷空氣形成大氣逆溫層，在山腰翻湧成一片波瀾壯闊、宛如仙境般的壯美雲海。

examples.en: Standing on the peak, we looked down at a vast fluffy cloud inversion stretching across the horizon.
examples.zh: 佇立在三千公尺頂峰極目遠眺，我們居高臨下俯瞰著一片綿延至天際盡頭的無垠棉花糖翻騰雲海。

examples.en: Meteorological inversions trap morning valley moisture, keeping high mountain peaks clear and dry.
examples.zh: 氣象逆溫層效應將濃重的水氣死死鎖在山谷盆地之中，反而讓高聳的山頂終日維持晴朗乾燥與純淨。

examples.en: A spectacular sea of clouds caused by a temperature inversion rolled over the mountain pass at sunset.
examples.zh: 傍晚因高空逆溫形成的萬頃壯麗雲海與奔騰雲瀑，在夕陽餘暉映照下如金色浪濤翻滾。

examples.en: Trapped cooler air in the valley created a cloud inversion that stretched to the horizon.
examples.zh: 山谷中滯留的冷空氣釀成了高空逆溫層，催生出一望無際、蔓延至天際線的壯麗雲海。

examples.en: From the high peak, looking down at a vast cloud inversion feels like gazing across a foaming ocean.
examples.zh: 佇立在三千公尺高峰俯瞰波瀾壯闊的逆溫雲海，宛如居高臨下凝視著翻騰洶湧的白色汪洋。

entries.definition: 壯觀逆溫層雲海 (Cloud Inversion)；傍晚萬丈金光壯麗高山雲海雲瀑奇景

explains.en: At sunset, cool air in a valley can be trapped under warmer air above. The result may look like a sea of clouds.
A temperature change can keep moisture low in a valley while mountain peaks stay clear. The sky may appear unusual.
Climbers may look down from a summit at a blanket of cloud. This weather pattern happens when air layers switch temperature order.

examples.en: The mountain top offers an uninterrupted 360-degree alpine panorama of Taiwan's central spine.
examples.zh: 佇立在三千九百公尺的高山三角點頂峰，全景三百六十度無遮蔽俯瞰台灣中央山脈脊樑的雄偉大景。

examples.en: From the observation tower, visitors marveled at the scenic panorama of the glittering harbor.
examples.zh: 登上高聳的高空觀景台，遊客們紛紛為眼前波光粼粼、千帆競發的海港壯闊全景發出陣陣讚嘆。

examples.en: She adjusted her camera's wide-angle lens to capture the sweeping mountain panorama at sunrise.
examples.zh: 她熟練調整單眼相機的超廣角鏡頭焦距，力求在破曉黎明時分完整捕捉山川連綿的壯麗全景大片。

entries.definition: 三百六十度全景壯麗大景

explains.en: A wide view shows a large area all at once. From a high place, people may see mountains and towns together. A camera can capture the scene.
We climbed the tower and looked across the bay. Boats seemed tiny below us. The whole coast filled our view.
A picture made by joining many views can show a broad landscape. It is often displayed in a long shape. Careful stitching hides the joins.

examples.en: Golden dawn sunlight broke through the horizon, setting the surrounding peaks ablaze.
examples.zh: 清晨第一道金燦燦的破曉曙光穿透東方雲海地平線，瞬間將周遭連綿起伏的百岳群峰染成一片璀璨金黃。

examples.en: Hikers woke up at 3:30 AM to hike the final mile to watch the sunrise above the clouds.
examples.zh: 熱血山友們在凌晨三點半從睡袋中翻身起床，摸黑完成最後一公里衝刺，只為在雲海之上迎候金色日出。

examples.en: The vibrant orange and purple tones of the sunrise reflected beautifully across the mountain tarn.
examples.zh: 破曉日出時分絢爛奪目的橘紅與紫粉色彩霞，倒映在高山靜謐的看天池冰斗湖面，美得令人窒息。

examples.en: Tears of joy welled up as golden morning sunbeams illuminated the peaks during the mountaintop sunrise.
examples.zh: 當清晨第一道璀璨金光穿破雲海、照亮群峰頂端時，佇立在山頂迎候百岳日出的每個人心中熱淚盈眶。

examples.en: Hundreds of early risers bundled in down jackets waited patiently for the magnificent mountain sunrise.
examples.zh: 數百名清晨摸黑起身的登山者裹著厚羽絨外套，屏氣凝神等候那氣勢磅礡的崇山日出。

examples.en: The eastern horizon turned brilliant orange moments before the dazzling alpine sunrise broke through the mist.
examples.zh: 在奪目的百岳日出破霧而出前的一剎那，東方地平線被渲染成一片萬丈絢爛的金橙色彩。

entries.definition: 高山金色日出；晨曦破曉；站在百岳稜線上迎接第一道璀璨日出

explains.en: It is the time in the morning when the Sun first appears above the horizon. Hikers may climb a ridge to watch it. The sky can glow orange and pink.
As the day begins, sunlight spreads across the landscape. Early travelers may see clouds and mountain peaks turn gold. Arrive before it happens.
This morning event brings the first visible light from the Sun. It can reflect across a mountain lake. Colors change quickly as daylight grows.

examples.en: Shared hardships on rain-swept trails forge unbreakable lifetime bonds of mountain camaraderie.
examples.zh: 在狂風驟雨的泥濘山徑中彼此扶持、同甘共苦的深厚經歷，鍛造出終身難忘的山友革命情誼。

examples.en: Gathering around the camp stove to cook a communal dinner cultivates genuine camaraderie.
examples.zh: 深夜圍坐在高山露營爐具旁合力烹煮一鍋熱騰騰的共享羊肉爐，最能醞釀出發自肺腑的溫暖同袍情誼。

examples.en: True team camaraderie means looking out for the slowest hiker and pacing the group together.
examples.zh: 真正的團隊患難革命情誼，體現在主動放慢腳步體貼照看走在隊伍最後方的山友，始終同進同退。

examples.en: Shared campfires and helping each other across difficult scree slopes forge lifelong mountain camaraderie.
examples.zh: 一起圍坐在寒夜營火旁喝熱茶、在險峻斷崖相互拉一把，淬鍊出患難與共、一生難忘的真摯隊友情誼。

examples.en: The grueling five-day expedition strengthened camaraderie among teammates who started as total strangers.
examples.zh: 艱苦卓絕的五天四夜重裝縱走，讓原本互不相識的萍水山友結下了生死與共的深厚情誼。

examples.en: Genuine camaraderie shines when someone voluntarily shoulders extra group gear for an exhausted partner.
examples.zh: 當看見隊友體力透支時有人主動分擔公裝與帳篷，這份情義正是山野間最純粹動人的隊友愛。

entries.definition: 患難與共的山友情誼；同袍之誼；患難與共生死相依之登山隊友情誼

explains.en: Hikers share food and help one another across a rocky path. These experiences can create a strong friendship.
A team carries extra supplies for a tired member. Working together builds trust and closeness.
People who face difficult tasks together may feel a lasting bond. They look out for one another.

examples.en: Standing beneath towering ancient peaks instills deep reverence and quiet personal humility.
examples.zh: 佇立在巍峨雄偉的億萬年古老群山腳下，令人自發湧現出對大自然的敬畏與內心深處的謙卑。

examples.en: Approaching challenging high mountains with humility keeps climbers safe from reckless decisions.
examples.zh: 始終對巍峨險峻的高山懷抱敬畏與謙卑之心，能時刻提醒登山者杜絕狂妄自大並遠離魯莽冒險的抉擇。

examples.en: Despite his Nobel Prize achievements, the elderly scientist spoke with remarkable modesty and humility.
examples.zh: 儘管榮獲諾貝爾獎等無數至高殊榮，這位德高望重的老科學家在公眾面前發言時始終保有極致的謙遜。

examples.en: Intellectual humility is acknowledging that our current knowledge is always partial and open to correction.
examples.zh: 具備「知識謙遜」（Humility）的大學者始終銘記：自身所知永遠只是浩瀚真理的一小部分，隨時虛心受教。

examples.en: Despite winning the prestigious Nobel Prize in Chemistry, the humble professor treated every freshman with warmth and humility.
examples.zh: 儘管榮獲全球學術界最高榮譽諾貝爾化學獎，這位老教授在面對大一新鮮人提問時依然無比親切謙遜、虛懷若谷。

examples.en: Facing a devastating clinical diagnosis taught the arrogant surgeon a profound personal lesson in humility.
examples.zh: 在自己不幸親身遭遇重症的沉重打擊後，這位昔日自命不凡的名醫徹底上了一堂震撼靈魂的謙卑人生必修課。

examples.en: Standing beneath towering 3,000-meter peaks instills profound humility before the awesome power of nature.
examples.zh: 仰望著巍峨聳立的三千公尺崇山峻嶺，在浩瀚壯麗的大自然面前，每個登山者心中油然而生由衷的謙卑。

examples.en: Experienced mountain guides preach humility, reminding trekkers that the mountain always calls the shots.
examples.zh: 閱歷豐富的百岳老嚮導始終奉行謙卑心態，提醒隊員山林永遠是不可冒犯的最終主宰。

examples.en: Surrendering your ego and walking with quiet humility turns every alpine trek into a spiritual pilgrimage.
examples.zh: 放下傲慢執念、心懷謙卑踏出每一步，會讓每一次的高山遠征昇華為淨化心靈的朝聖之旅。

entries.definition: 謙遜謙卑之心；虛心；虛懷若谷的知識謙遜；謙虛；仰望崇山峻嶺之由衷謙卑敬畏

explains.en: A climber who respects a powerful mountain will not take foolish risks. This attitude shows modesty.
A famous scientist may speak kindly and listen to young students. Success does not make the person boastful.
Someone may admit that they do not know everything and are willing to learn. This quality is important in research.

examples.en: Indigenous Bunun hunters treat sacred mountain forests with ancestral respect and reverence.
examples.zh: 世代守護山林的布農族高山嚮導以祖靈信仰為引導，對神聖山林草木始終懷抱最深沉的敬畏。

examples.en: Mountaineers bow their heads in silent reverence before the imposing face of the great mountain.
examples.zh: 攀登好手在巍峨聳立的巨大神山岩壁腳下肅穆佇立，深情低下頭顱致以最純粹虔誠的敬仰與尊崇。

examples.en: The ancient temple was preserved with immense reverence by generations of dedicated local monks.
examples.zh: 這座依山而建的千年古老寺院，在世代虔誠出家僧眾的悉心照拂下，被無比莊嚴虔誠地完整傳承保存至今。

examples.en: Indigenous carvers offer prayers before harvesting fallen trees, demonstrating profound reverence for the forest spirits.
examples.zh: 原住民傳統雕刻師在取用倒伏巨木前必先虔誠祈福，展現對山林萬物生靈由衷的虔誠敬畏。

examples.en: Temple visitors bowed their heads in quiet reverence as monks chanted sacred Buddhist mantras.
examples.zh: 當寺廟中的僧侶齊聲唱誦神聖的梵音佛經時，前來參拜的信眾無不肅然起敬、低頭合十虔誠敬拜。

examples.en: His deep lifelong reverence for natural ecosystems inspired him to dedicate his career to environmental law.
examples.zh: 他自幼對浩瀚自然生態系統懷抱著深切的虔誠敬畏，促使他一生全心投入環境法規倡議領域。

examples.en: Indigenous elders enter sacred alpine forests with prayers, demonstrating eternal reverence for the mountain spirits.
examples.zh: 原住民耆老在踏入高山神聖祖靈地前虔誠祈福，對守護這座島嶼千萬年的山靈展現永恆的虔誠敬畏。

examples.en: We should approach wild places with quiet reverence, recognizing that we are merely respectful guests.
examples.zh: 我們應當心懷由衷的崇敬踏入山林聖境，時刻自覺我們不過是這片神聖土地上短暫駐足的謙卑過客。

examples.en: His mountain photography reflects deep reverence for fragile alpine flora and untamed natural ecosystems.
examples.zh: 他的高山攝影作品洋溢著對脆弱高山植被與原始生態系統的深厚敬仰與無限溫柔。

entries.definition: 敬畏尊崇；虔誠敬意；對千年山林神木的虔誠敬畏之心；對守護這座島嶼高山聖靈的永恆敬仰

explains.en: A deep feeling of respect may be shown quietly. People can feel it toward nature or something sacred. They may speak softly or bow.
Before entering the old memorial, the class stood still for a moment. Their guide explained why the place mattered. The children listened with care.
Respect can be shown through actions as well as words. A person may protect a special place from harm. Small acts can show a serious feeling.

examples.en: Smart spatial planning maximizes natural daylight and storage efficiency in compact apartments.
examples.zh: 巧妙精密的空間規劃能在寸土寸金的小坪數都會公寓中，將天然採光與收納效能發揮到極致。

examples.en: Video game designers create stunning three-dimensional spatial soundscapes to immerse players.
examples.zh: 現代遊戲音效工程師精心打造出令人驚豔的三度空間立體環繞音場，讓玩家完全身歷其境。

examples.en: Architects must possess outstanding spatial reasoning skills to translate 2D floor plans into 3D structures.
examples.zh: 建築師必須具備極為敏銳卓越的三維空間思維能力，才能將平面圖紙精準轉化為立體建築。

examples.en: Spatial audio tracks dynamically track head movements, making movie footsteps sound like they are right behind you.
examples.zh: 搭載頭部動態追蹤的 3D 空間音訊，讓電影中由遠及近的腳步聲彷彿就在身後悄然響起。

examples.en: Architecture students develop strong spatial reasoning skills by building complex three-dimensional models.
examples.zh: 建築系學生透過親手搭建精密複雜的實體 3D 比例模型，磨練並培養出卓越的空間感知與幾何思考維度。

examples.en: The virtual reality headset delivers incredible visual fidelity and pinpoint spatial sound localization.
examples.zh: 這款旗艦級虛擬實境頭戴顯示器，提供了令人驚嘆的視覺細膩度與分毫不差的 3D 空間音效定位。

examples.en: Spatial computing seamlessly blends digital content into the physical room surrounding the user.
examples.zh: 「空間運算」（Spatial Computing），將虛擬數位內容天衣無縫融入使用者身處的真實物理空間中。

examples.en: Architects use spatial audio and 3D modeling tools to evaluate how sound travels through a new concert hall.
examples.zh: 建築師利用空間音訊與 3D 建模工具，評估聲音在新建音樂廳內部的傳遞效果。

examples.en: Young children develop spatial awareness by playing with building blocks and navigating obstacle courses.
examples.zh: 幼童透過玩積木與走障礙路線，逐步培養出良好的空間認知能力。

entries.definition: 空間的；空間維度的；3D 沉浸式空間音訊立體聲場的；打破實體與數位藩籬之空間運算的

explains.en: It describes how objects relate to space, distance, and position. Architects use this thinking to turn a flat plan into a building. Games create sounds around the player.
A person with strong skills in this area can picture shapes in three dimensions. This helps with maps and design. It can also describe audio that seems to surround listeners.
Use this adjective for the arrangement of objects in an area. A small apartment needs smart planning. Sound can also have a three-dimensional quality.

examples.en: High-strength reinforced concrete (RC) ensures excellent structural stability during typhoons.
examples.zh: 採用高強度鋼筋混凝土（RC 結構）施工，能確保建築本體在強烈颱風與豪雨中穩如泰山。

examples.en: The bank installed a reinforced steel door to protect the subterranean vault from break-ins.
examples.zh: 這家商業銀行在地下金庫安裝了一道加厚重型鋼筋加固防爆鋼門，嚴密防範任何破壞入侵。

examples.en: Heavy work gloves with reinforced leather palms protect hands while handling rough timber.
examples.zh: 手掌部位採用雙層真皮補強加固的重型防護手套，在搬運粗糙木材時能有效保護雙手免受刺傷。

explains.en: A door has extra steel inside so it is harder to break. Builders add support to make it stronger.
Thick gloves have stronger material across the palms to protect the hands. This added strength helps during rough work.
A concrete wall contains steel bars that help it bear weight. The structure has been strengthened.

examples.en: Taiwan building codes enforce strict seismic resistance standards to withstand major earthquakes.
examples.zh: 台灣現行最新建築法規強制實施極為嚴格的耐震抗震標準，以從容抵禦強烈地震考驗。

examples.en: Seismic monitoring stations recorded minor underwater tremors off the eastern coast of Hualien.
examples.zh: 氣象署地震測報中心的各處地震監測站在花蓮外海深處觀測並記錄到了數次微小海底餘震。

examples.en: Upgrading older brick schools with steel seismic braces ensures the safety of thousands of students.
examples.zh: 為老舊磚造校舍全面加裝外掛式鋼構防震斜撐骨架，能切實守護校園數千名師生的人身安全。

explains.en: This describes things related to earthquakes. Engineers test buildings to see if they can withstand shaking.
Sensors recorded small movements under the sea near Hualien. They measure activity in the ground.
Steel braces can make an older school safer when the earth moves. Building rules may require strong structures.

examples.en: Taipei 101's 660-tonne tuned mass damper sways visibly to counteract typhoon winds.
examples.zh: 懸掛於台北 101 大樓內重達六百六十公噸的金色巨型風阻尼球能大幅吸收並抵消強風晃動。

examples.en: The automotive mechanic replaced the worn hydraulic shock dampers on the rear vehicle suspension.
examples.zh: 汽車修配廠技師熟練為客戶車輛更換了後輪懸吊系統中漏油老化的液壓避震減震阻尼筒。

examples.en: Bad economic news put a damper on the lively holiday celebration atmosphere downtown.
examples.zh: 突如其來的慘澹經濟衰退消息，給市中心原本熱鬧喜慶的跨年狂歡節慶氛圍潑了一盆冷水。

examples.en: Lateral yaw dampers suppress unwanted oscillatory movements, guaranteeing rock-solid stability.
examples.zh: 轉向架兩側安裝的「抗蛇行液壓阻尼器」（Yaw Damper），徹底抑制任何可能發生的微小橫向晃動。

examples.en: Heavy monsoon rains put a dampener on outdoor picnic plans, forcing everyone inside the living room.
examples.zh: 連綿不絕的梅雨季豪雨狠狠澆熄了原本興高采烈的戶外野餐興致，迫使大家轉移到客廳聚會。

examples.en: Taipei 101 features a massive golden tuned mass damper suspended inside to counter typhoon sway.
examples.zh: 台北 101 摩天大樓內部懸掛著一顆巨大的金色風阻尼球，專門用以平衡強風颱風吹襲時的大樓搖擺。

entries.definition: 風阻尼球；減震器；調諧質量阻尼器；消除高速轉向架左右搖擺之抗蛇行液壓減震阻尼器

explains.en: A heavy moving weight can reduce a building’s shaking in strong winds or earthquakes. It swings to balance some movement. Engineers place it high inside a tower.
A car part helps soften bumps from the road. It keeps the wheels steadier as the car moves. A mechanic checks it when the ride feels rough.
A small device can slow movement in a machine. It makes motion smoother and quieter. Different designs suit different jobs.

examples.en: Rooftop photovoltaic solar panels generate clean renewable electricity for community elevators.
examples.zh: 安裝於社區頂樓的太陽能光電板（PV）能將豐沛陽光轉化為乾淨綠電，供應公設電梯運轉。

examples.en: Subsidies encourage homeowners to install grid-tied photovoltaic systems on their sunlit roofs.
examples.zh: 政府補助政策積極鼓勵一般透天住戶在日照充足的屋頂安裝與市電併網的太陽能光電發電系統。

examples.en: Technological breakthroughs in photovoltaic efficiency have lowered the cost of solar energy globally.
examples.zh: 太陽能光電轉換效率在材料科學上的突破性躍進，已讓全球太陽能清潔能源發電成本大幅降低。

examples.en: Building-integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) facade glass panels generate clean electricity from morning sunlight.
examples.zh: 建築整合型太陽能光電玻璃，將大樓外牆帷幕化身為能發電的綠能發電機。

examples.en: Integrating photovoltaic solar cells directly into roof slates preserves the building's aesthetic integrity.
examples.zh: 將太陽能光電晶片直接整合燒結於斜屋頂瓦片中，能兼顧發電功能與傳統建築外觀的純粹美感。

examples.en: The rooftop photovoltaic array generates sufficient electricity to power the entire electric vehicle charging fleet.
examples.zh: 頂樓鋪設的超高效率太陽光電發電模組，產生的潔淨綠電足以供應全社區電動車充電樁全數使用。

entries.definition: 太陽能光電的；光伏發電板；建築整合型太陽能光電玻璃 (BIPV) 的

explains.en: It describes technology that changes sunlight directly into electricity. Panels on a roof can power elevators. New designs can lower the cost.
A solar cell uses light to produce electric current. Homes may install arrays of these cells. They provide renewable power.
Use this adjective for devices that turn sunlight into electricity. Some glass windows can include the technology. It is used in clean energy systems.

examples.en: Rainwater harvesting cisterns supply automated drip sprinklers for rooftop sky gardens.
examples.zh: 地下室大型雨水回收儲水槽能將收集過濾後的天然雨水自動加壓供應空中花園滴灌澆花。

examples.en: Simple rooftop rainwater harvesting setups provide non-potable water for car washing and toilet flushing.
examples.zh: 安裝於屋頂的簡易雨水回收收集蓄水桶，能為日常洗車打掃與衛生間沖馬桶提供免費次級用水。

examples.en: Combine harvesters work through wheat fields, harvesting hundreds of bushels of grain each hour.
examples.zh: 大型自走式聯合收割機穿梭於金色麥浪之間，以每小時採收收割數百蒲式耳穀物的高效率作業。

examples.en: Schoolchildren eagerly joined the summer rice harvesting, cutting ripe golden stalks with small hand sickles.
examples.zh: 學童挽起褲管、赤腳踏入金黃稻田中體驗收割割稻，手持小鐮刀割下一把把沉甸甸的稻穗。

examples.en: Giant offshore wind turbines are deployed for harvesting kinetic energy from relentless maritime breezes.
examples.zh: 在波濤洶湧的台灣海峽外海豎立起巨型離岸風機，專門用於高效擷取大自然源源不絕的強勁海風動能。

examples.en: Careful manual grape harvesting at dawn prevents fruit skin breakage before crushing in the winery.
examples.zh: 清晨拂曉時分小心翼翼進行純人工葡萄採摘收穫，能有效避免脆弱果皮在送入酒莊壓榨前發生破裂變質。

examples.en: The basement rainwater harvesting cistern stores 200 metric tons of rainwater for public street cleaning.
examples.zh: 大樓地下筏基配置的雨水貯留收集水槽，儲存兩百噸雨水作為洗街澆灌之用。

examples.en: Rainwater harvesting reduces municipal tap water consumption while buffering urban runoff spikes.
examples.zh: 雨水貯留回收利用不僅大幅降低對自來水資源的依賴，更能在暴雨來襲時緩衝都市排水管網壓力。

examples.en: Sand filters remove leaves and debris during initial rooftop rainwater harvesting cycles.
examples.zh: 多介質石英砂過濾器在屋頂雨水回收初期，能自動攔截並排掉屋頂落葉與浮塵雜物。

entries.definition: 雨水回收收集；採收；金黃稻浪赤腳親手割稻體驗；地下百噸雨水貯留收集筏基水槽

explains.en: A roof collects rain in a tank so the water can be used for gardens or cleaning. This can reduce tap-water use.
Farm workers cut ripe grain from a field and bring it in for storage. Machines can help with the task.
People gather fruit, crops, or rainwater for later use. The word describes collecting something that is ready.

examples.en: Strategic north-facing daylighting illuminates office desks without generating uncomfortable solar heat.
examples.zh: 巧妙配置朝北面的大面積天然採光落地窗，能在導入充沛明亮自然光的同時避免室內悶熱西曬。

examples.en: Incorporating light wells and clerestory windows optimizes natural daylighting in dense row houses.
examples.zh: 在長型街屋透天中巧妙開闢天井與高側窗，能極致優化密集住宅區內部幽暗空間的天然採光。

examples.en: Effective architectural daylighting reduces daytime artificial lighting demand by forty percent.
examples.zh: 匠心獨運的建築自然採光規劃，能使整棟辦公大樓在白天的室內人工照明電力需求銳減四成。

examples.en: Central glass atriums optimize natural daylighting, significantly reducing artificial daytime electrical lighting.
examples.zh: 大樓中央的大型挑高玻璃天井將自然光採光引向深處，大幅減少日間室內開燈電費。

examples.en: Strategic daylighting designs direct morning sunshine deep into windowless interior workstations via light tubes.
examples.zh: 巧妙的自然光導引技術透過高反射導光管，將清晨陽光深引至無對外窗的深層室內工作區。

examples.en: Balanced daylighting enhances worker productivity while lowering overall corporate electricity bills.
examples.zh: 柔和勻稱的自然日光採光不僅大幅提升員工工作效率，同時能顯著削減企業整體照明耗電。

entries.definition: 天然採光設計；日光引入；挑高中庭採光天井引導自然光

explains.en: A light well can bring sunlight into a dark room. This design may lower the need to turn on lamps.
North-facing windows can brighten desks without making a room too hot. Good design brings natural light inside.
An atrium with glass can brighten the middle of a building. This approach may reduce electricity use during the day.

examples.en: Double-glazed Low-E glass curtain walls reflect external solar glare while insulating temperature.
examples.zh: 採用雙層中空 Low-E 低輻射節能玻璃帷幕外牆，能反射刺眼烈日強光並維持室內恆溫涼爽。

examples.en: Wind tunnel testing ensures that the exterior curtain wall resists violent hurricane gusts.
examples.zh: 建築模型在風洞實驗室接受嚴苛風洞測試，以確保外掛式帷幕外牆能承受強烈颶風的猛烈風壓。

examples.en: High-rise skyscrapers utilize lightweight curtain walls hung from the structural concrete frame.
examples.zh: 當代摩天高樓廣泛採用輕量化單元式玻璃帷幕外牆，將其牢固懸掛於建築主體結構梁柱之外。

explains.en: A building’s outer covering may be made of glass or metal panels. It keeps out wind and rain but does not hold up floors. A frame supports each section.
Sunlight entered the office through the tall glass outside. Workers could see the street while staying indoors. The panels were cleaned from special platforms.
Architects plan this outer layer to suit the building’s look and climate. Good seals help keep rooms comfortable. It is attached to the main structure.

examples.en: The dramatic cantilevered observation deck juts out twenty meters above the valley.
examples.zh: 氣勢非凡的無柱懸臂梁景觀觀景台大膽向外懸挑懸空延伸二十公尺，俯瞰壯麗深邃峽谷。

examples.en: Frank Lloyd Wright famously engineered dramatic cantilevered balconies over waterfalls at Fallingwater.
examples.zh: 建築大師萊特在其傳世巨作「落水山莊」中，大膽採用向外懸挑的鋼筋混凝土懸臂陽台橫跨瀑布。

examples.en: The modern home features an unsupported cantilever that shades the car driveway below.
examples.zh: 這棟前衛現代住宅設計了一處無立柱支撐的二樓懸挑懸臂量體，巧妙為下方的車庫車道遮陽擋雨。

explains.en: It is a beam or structure fixed at one end and extending outward without support beneath the other end. A balcony may use this design. Engineers calculate its strength.
An observation deck can project over a valley while being held from one side. This structure needs careful planning. The word can also be a verb.
A building may have an unsupported overhang that reaches outward from its main structure. A bridge can use the same engineering idea. It must bear its own weight.

examples.en: Sunlight streams down through the glass skylight of the eight-story central hotel atrium.
examples.zh: 溫暖明亮的陽光穿透頂層巨型透明採光天窗，灑落在高達八層樓的氣派五星級飯店挑高中庭。

examples.en: Mature indoor ficus trees and cascading water fountains decorate the airy corporate atrium.
examples.zh: 枝繁葉茂的室內大榕樹與潺潺流淌的景觀瀑布，將這座跨國企業大樓挑高中庭點綴得綠意盎然。

examples.en: The university library features an open, multi-tier atrium surrounded by quiet reading lounges.
examples.zh: 大學總圖書館中央規劃了一處開闊挑高的多層次立體中庭，四周環繞著幽靜舒適的沙發閱讀區。

explains.en: A hotel has a tall open space in the center with a glass roof. Guests can look up at several floors.
A library may have balconies around a bright central hall. Plants and seating decorate the space.
This large open area is often found inside a public building. Light may enter through a high skylight.

examples.en: Installing a roof skylight transforms a dim attic space into a sun-drenched studio.
examples.zh: 在斜屋頂上開闢一扇高氣密採光天窗，瞬間將昏暗壓迫的閣樓改造成陽光灑落的明亮工作室。

examples.en: Raindrops drummed rhythmically against the heavy tempered glass skylight above the bed.
examples.zh: 清脆連綿的雨滴有節奏地敲擊在主臥床鋪正上方厚實的鋼化雙層天窗玻璃上，伴人入眠。

examples.en: Motorized shades can close the high skylight when afternoon sunlight becomes too bright.
examples.zh: 當盛夏午後頂部烈日直射過於熾熱刺眼時，可透過遙控電動遮陽簾將挑高採光天窗完全關閉。

examples.en: Domed glass roof skylights flood central library atriums with warm, welcoming ambient sunshine.
examples.zh: 圖書館中央挑高中庭上方開闢的圓頂透光玻璃採光天窗（Skylight），讓溫暖明亮的自然陽光灑落全場。

examples.en: We looked up through the bedroom skylight at midnight to watch twinkling constellations from bed.
examples.zh: 午夜時分躺在頂樓主臥室的大床上，透過屋頂傾斜開闢的透明觀景天窗，即可靜靜仰望夜空中璀璨閃爍的繁星。

examples.en: The architect installed motorized blinds on the south-facing skylight to block intense midday summer heat.
examples.zh: 建築師在朝南採光天窗內側加裝了感應式電動遮陽捲簾，在盛夏正午陽光熾熱時自動關閉以阻隔輻射熱。

entries.definition: 採光天窗；天窗玻璃；自然採光天窗；天井

explains.en: A window built into a roof can brighten a dark attic. It may have a shade for sunny afternoons.
Rain can tap on the glass above a bed. At night, a person may see stars through it.
An architect may place this roof window over a library. It lets daylight reach the rooms below.

examples.en: Engineered oak hardwood flooring delivers natural wood warmth and dimensional moisture stability.
examples.zh: 鋪設多層實木海島型超耐磨橡木木地板，既能展現天然木質紋理溫度，更能抵抗台灣海島潮濕。

examples.en: Handcrafted solid hardwood dining tables can last through multiple generations with simple care.
examples.zh: 純手工打造的北美白橡實木大餐桌，只要平日給予定期上油維護，歷經數個世代依然堅固完好。

examples.en: Polishing the scratched maple hardwood floors restored their lustrous golden amber glow.
examples.zh: 專業師傅為略有細紋刮痕的楓木實木地板進行細緻重新打磨與拋光，重現如琥珀般溫潤純淨的光澤。

explains.en: This strong wood comes from certain broad-leaved trees. It is used for floors, furniture, and tools. Many kinds have attractive patterns.
The carpenter chose oak boards for the table. He sanded them smooth and sealed the surface. The finished piece felt sturdy.
Wood from some trees is harder than wood from others. The name describes a group of trees, not every board’s strength. It can last for years with care.

examples.en: Polished nostalgic green terrazzo floors evoke fond memories of vintage Taiwanese homes.
examples.zh: 經師傅手工細緻打磨拋光的復古翠綠磨石子水磨石地板，喚起了無數人童年老家的溫暖記憶。

examples.en: Modern terrazzo tiles incorporate colorful marble chips and glass fragments in epoxy resin.
examples.zh: 當代改良型水磨石地磚將繽紛的天然大理石碎石與再生玻璃碎粒混入環氧樹脂中，時尚感十足。

examples.en: Seamless cast-in-place terrazzo is an exceptionally durable flooring option for busy train stations.
examples.zh: 整體無縫現場灌注水磨石地坪耐磨抗壓且極易清潔打理，是人潮洶湧的高鐵與捷運車站地坪首選。

entries.definition: 水磨石工藝；磨石子地板

explains.en: It is a hard surface made from small pieces of marble or glass set in cement or resin. The surface is polished smooth. Old Taiwanese homes often have it.
Builders mix colorful stone chips into a floor material. After it hardens, they polish it to reveal patterns. It is durable in busy stations.
This decorative flooring contains visible bits of stone or glass. Modern tiles can use bright colors. A smooth finish is made by polishing.

examples.en: Artisans applied textured mineral plaster to create organic, breathable living room walls.
examples.zh: 專業泥作大師手工鏝抹天然礦物藝術灰泥與珪藻土，打造出質樸溫潤且具調節濕度機能的牆面。

examples.en: Venetian lime plaster is hand-troweled in thin layers to mimic the look of honed marble.
examples.zh: 威尼斯石灰灰泥經師傅以不鏽鋼鏝刀層層薄抹壓光，能在牆面上呈現出宛如天然大理石般的絲滑光澤。

examples.en: The doctor wrapped the broken forearm carefully in a rigid white fiberglass plaster cast.
examples.zh: 骨科醫師小心翼翼地為骨折的前臂打上厚實堅固的白色玻璃纖維石膏固定繃帶以防骨頭位移。

examples.en: Pouring liquid Hydrocal plaster into rubber rock molds creates lightweight, highly detailed cliff faces.
examples.zh: 將超硬石膏漿料注入矽膠岩石模具中，脫模後即可組合成重量輕且紋理極其立體的壯麗懸崖峭壁。

examples.en: The emergency physician applied a rigid white plaster cast around the teenager’s fractured wrist.
examples.zh: 急診室主治醫師熟練地用浸濕的白色醫用石膏繃帶，將這位骨折少年的受損手腕牢牢包覆固定。

examples.en: Traditional artisans spread lime plaster smoothly across interior walls to provide breathable humidity regulation.
examples.zh: 傳統手作泥作匠人將天然熟石灰石膏灰漿均勻推抹於室內牆壁上，提供兼具呼吸透氣與天然防潮的優質壁面。

entries.definition: 礦物灰泥塗料；珪藻土；抹灰石膏；雕刻石膏懸崖岩壁造景；熟石膏

explains.en: A builder spreads a wet mixture over a wall and lets it dry smooth. A doctor may also use a rigid cast to support a broken arm.
An artist pours this white material into a mold to make a small sculpture. It hardens as it dries.
A bandage-like cast can hold an injured arm still while it heals. The same word names a wall coating.

examples.en: Hidden LED warm cove strips provide soft, glare-free ambient lighting along ceilings.
examples.zh: 隱藏於天花板間接照明層板內的暖色調 LED 燈帶，為客廳提供了柔和無眩光的基礎環境氛圍光。

examples.en: The soothing ambient noise of ocean waves helped the restless patient drift into deep sleep.
examples.zh: 播放清脆柔和的大自然海浪拍岸環境音白噪音，幫助心緒煩亂失眠的病患安然進入深度睡眠。

examples.en: Keep wine bottles stored in a cellar where ambient temperature remains steadily around 14°C.
examples.zh: 將收藏的頂級葡萄酒妥善平放儲藏在私人酒窖中，確保周圍環境室溫常年穩定維持在攝氏十四度上下。

examples.en: Layering subtle ambient sounds of forest rain and distant thunder deepens emotional immersion.
examples.zh: 巧妙疊加山林細雨滴落與遠方隱隱雷鳴的環境氛圍音，能瞬間加深聽眾身歷其境的沉浸感。

examples.en: Smart home lighting systems automatically adjust ambient room brightness to match evening sunset colors.
examples.zh: 智慧居家照明系統會靈巧感應室外天色，自動調整室內周遭環境燈光亮度以呼應黃昏夕陽晚霞。

examples.en: Ambient noise in the busy coffee shop was muffled effectively by her high-end noise-canceling headphones.
examples.zh: 人潮熙攘的熱鬧咖啡館內嘈雜紛亂的周遭環境背景噪音，被她配戴的高階降噪耳機隔絕得微乎其微。

entries.definition: 基礎環境氛圍的；周圍的；環境現場底噪自然氛圍音的

explains.en: This describes sounds or light that are already around us. Ocean waves can create a calming background sound.
Hidden lights along a ceiling can make a room feel soft and welcoming. They give the room a gentle glow.
A cellar should stay at a steady temperature. This word describes the temperature of the surrounding place.

examples.en: Anti-glare recessed downlights illuminate art pieces without distracting visible fixtures.
examples.zh: 挑選具備深防眩光光學設計的微邊框內嵌式筒燈（嵌燈），只見光不見燈，視覺乾淨俐落。

examples.en: Space your ceiling downlights evenly to prevent harsh shadows on office work surfaces.
examples.zh: 在天花板施工時均勻排列規劃內嵌筒燈的間距，能有效消除書桌與辦公桌面上惱人的刺眼陰影。

examples.en: Dimmable LED downlights allow homeowners to adjust room mood from bright daytime to cozy evening.
examples.zh: 可無極調光的智慧 LED 嵌燈系統，讓屋主能隨心所欲將室內氛圍從白天明亮切換為夜晚溫馨微光。

explains.en: A ceiling light shines downward from a small opening. It can brighten a kitchen or hallway. Several are often spaced across the ceiling.
The family installed small lights above the counter. They could see clearly while cooking. The fixtures blended into the ceiling.
Some models use less electricity than older bulbs. A dimmer can change the room’s brightness. Good placement helps avoid dark corners.

examples.en: A sparkling Bohemian crystal chandelier hangs above the grand formal dining room table.
examples.zh: 一座璀璨奪目的波希米亞頂級手工水晶大吊燈優雅垂掛於十人座大理石長型宴會餐桌上方。

examples.en: The opera house ceiling features a magnificent golden chandelier weighing two tons.
examples.zh: 國家歌劇院挑高穹頂正中央懸掛著一座重達兩噸、金碧輝煌氣勢磅礡的巴洛克風枝形大吊燈。

examples.en: Cleaning the hundreds of intricate crystal droplets on the chandelier requires hours of careful wiping.
examples.zh: 細緻擦拭並逐一清理水晶吊燈上懸掛的數百顆繁複切割水晶吊墜玻璃珠，需要耗費數小時的耐心。

entries.definition: 奢華水晶大吊燈；枝形吊燈

explains.en: It is a large decorative light that hangs from the ceiling, often with many arms or crystals. An opera house may have one. Dust it carefully.
A dining room can have this hanging lamp above the table. Glass pieces catch the light. Cleaning all the parts takes time.
This ceiling fixture holds several bulbs and can be made from crystal or metal. It may be a grand feature in a hall. It shines over a room.

examples.en: The apartment embraces a serene color palette of warm taupe, linen, and creamy white.
examples.zh: 整間寓所採用了令人心情放鬆沉靜的中性色彩盤，以溫暖灰褐、亞麻大地色與燕麥奶白為主調。

examples.en: The artist squeezed dots of oil paint onto her wooden palette before beginning the portrait.
examples.zh: 油畫家在正式提筆揮灑人物肖像畫之前，先將各色油畫顏料均勻擠在傳統橢圓木質調色盤上。

examples.en: Choosing a cohesive color palette ensures visual unity across all branding materials and packaging.
examples.zh: 確立風格嚴謹統一的品牌主視覺配色盤，能確保所有文宣設計與外包裝呈現高度的一致感。

examples.en: The artist applied vivid turquoise oil paint across the canvas using a flexible stainless steel palette knife.
examples.zh: 畫家手握富有彈性的不鏽鋼油畫刮刀（Palette Knife），俐落將鮮豔孔雀藍顏料刮抹於畫布上。

examples.en: The designer selected a warm autumn color palette of burnt orange, mustard yellow, and chestnut brown.
examples.zh: 視覺設計師為這套品牌識別挑選了焦糖橘、芥末黃與暖栗棕等充滿大地氣息的溫暖秋日調色盤配搭。

examples.en: Squeezing fresh dollops of cobalt blue onto the wooden palette, the landscape painter began his morning study.
examples.zh: 在原木調色盤邊緣擠上一顆顆新鮮溫潤的鈷藍與群青顏料，風景油畫家隨即專注展開了他的清晨寫生習作。

examples.en: A homemade wet palette with moist sponge paper keeps mixed acrylic paints workable for three days.
examples.zh: 鋪有濕海綿與烘焙紙的保濕濕調色盤，能讓調配好的水漆在三日內維持濕潤不結塊。

examples.en: The interior designer recommended a neutral color palette featuring warm beige, off-white, and natural wood tones.
examples.zh: 室內軟裝設計師向屋主大力推薦一套以溫潤米白、大地淺灰與天然原木色為主的百搭中性色彩調色盤配色方案。

examples.en: The classical painter loaded oil paints onto his wooden thumb-hole palette before starting the portrait.
examples.zh: 這位古典油畫大師在正式動筆繪製人物肖像之前，從容將各色油畫顏料整齊擠在手握的胡桃木指孔調色盤上。

entries.definition: 色彩搭配盤；調色板；調色盤；油畫刮刀 (Palette Knife)；水漆保濕濕調色盤 (數天不乾)

explains.en: A painter squeezes colors onto a flat board and mixes them before working. A flexible metal tool can spread thick paint.
A designer chooses warm beige and cream for a room. These colors form a coordinated set.
A color set can make a brand look consistent across signs and packaging. Artists also use a surface to hold paint.

examples.en: Japandi interior styling pairs Scandinavian hygge comfort with Japanese wabi-sabi simplicity.
examples.zh: 「Japandi 風格」完美揉合了北歐 Hygge 的溫馨舒適感與日式侘寂（Wabi-sabi）的質樸極簡美學。

examples.en: Incorporating low wooden furniture, paper lanterns, and muted colors creates an authentic Japandi vibe.
examples.zh: 巧妙配置低矮溫潤的實木家具、和紙燈籠吊燈與低飽和大地色系，能營造出道地純粹的日式侘寂風。

examples.en: The growing popularity of Japandi design reflects a desire for tranquil, clutter-free domestic spaces.
examples.zh: 北歐日式風在當代居家裝潢中的強勢盛行，體現了都市現代人對於靜謐、遠離雜亂居家空間的深切渴望。

explains.en: This home style mixes simple Japanese design with cozy Scandinavian touches. It uses soft colors and natural wood.
Low furniture, paper lamps, and less clutter can make a room feel calm. This style combines two traditions.
People may choose this look when they want a quiet, simple home. It blends comfort with clean design.

examples.en: Sleek matte-black bathroom fixtures contrast elegantly against pure white marble walls.
examples.zh: 線條極簡俐落的消光霧黑抗指紋衛浴五金龍頭配件，與純白卡拉拉大理石壁磚形成優雅對比。

examples.en: The electrician wired all ceiling lighting fixtures before the drywall contractors arrived.
examples.zh: 水電工班師傅在木作封板天花板施工之前，搶先將全室所有燈具固定底座與電路管線預埋就緒。

examples.en: When purchasing a new property, verify which built-in kitchen fixtures are included in the sale contract.
examples.zh: 在購置中古屋簽約時，務必與屋主仔細清點並確認合約中載明附贈的所有嵌入式廚房固定五金設備。

entries.definition: 衛浴五金配件；固定裝置

explains.en: A fixed item in a room, such as a sink or ceiling light, stays in place. It is part of the building. A plumber or electrician may install it.
The old tap dripped, so the family chose a new one. A plumber connected it to the pipes. The bathroom worked better afterward.
A regular event or team can also be something visitors expect to see. It is a familiar part of a place. The meaning depends on the setting.

examples.en: A gentle concrete entrance ramp provides smooth access for strollers and seniors.
examples.zh: 大樓正門貼心規劃坡度平緩的無障礙止滑斜坡道，方便長輩拄杖行走與嬰兒推車輕鬆推行。

examples.en: Skaters practiced kickflips and grinds on the plywood halfpipe ramp at the skatepark.
examples.zh: 青年滑板好手在極限滑板公園的膠合板半管斜坡道上，反覆練習高難度的尖翻跳躍與卡台動作。

examples.en: Vehicles accelerate briskly along the highway on-ramp to match the flow of freeway traffic.
examples.zh: 汽車在駛入國道高速公路匝道加速車道時順暢深踩油門，以迅速融入主線呼嘯奔馳的車流速中。

examples.en: Portable threshold ramps smooth out door steps, allowing wheelchairs to glide in and out effortlessly.
examples.zh: 在家門玄關鋪設可收折的輕量化門檻無障礙斜坡板，讓輪椅長輩進出家門暢行無阻。

examples.en: The subway station renovated its exits by adding a gentle ramp alongside the traditional staircases.
examples.zh: 捷運站進行出入口整建工程，在傳統階梯旁增設了坡度平緩的無障礙坡道。

examples.en: Skateboarders gathered at the extreme sports park to perform aerial tricks on the concrete half-pipe ramp.
examples.zh: 滑板愛好者齊聚在極限運動公園，在水泥製的半管型斜坡上展現高超的凌空特技。

entries.definition: 無障礙斜坡道；坡道；門檻無障礙斜坡板

explains.en: It is a sloped surface that lets people or vehicles move between different heights. A gentle entrance can help wheelchair users and strollers. Skaters may practice on one.
A road may curve upward to join a highway. At a building, this sloping path can make entry easier. Keep it clear for safe access.
This inclined structure connects a lower place to a higher one. It may be used at a doorway or in a skate park. Vehicles use it to join a freeway.

examples.en: The young couple remodeled a 40-year-old traditional apartment into a stylish modern loft.
examples.zh: 年輕夫妻將一間屋齡長達四十年的傳統老公寓徹底全室翻修重塑，蛻變為充滿質感的現代 Loft。

examples.en: Remodeling the outdated kitchen and adding an island dramatically increased the home's resale value.
examples.zh: 徹底翻修改造動線不良的老舊廚房並加設一座中島吧檯，大幅拉升了這間中古屋的未來轉手增值空間。

examples.en: They lived with relatives for three months while the whole-house remodel was underway.
examples.zh: 在這棟透天老宅進行全室翻修大動工的三個月工期裡，全家人暫時借住在親戚家中方便監工。

entries.definition: 老屋翻修整建；重新改建

explains.en: A couple changes an old kitchen by adding new cabinets and lights. The work updates the home.
Workers remove a wall and make a larger living area. The owners plan where furniture will go during the project.
A family changes the layout of an older apartment and replaces worn finishes. The house becomes more suited to them.

examples.en: Government incentives accelerate dangerous old building urban renewal for community safety.
examples.zh: 政府推出各項危老重建與都市更新（都更）容積獎勵政策，加速老舊危樓重建並守護公共安全。

examples.en: He received a reminder in the mail regarding passport renewal before his upcoming flight.
examples.zh: 在即將搭機飛往海外出差前夕，他收到了外交部領事事務局寄發的護照換發到期更新提醒信函。

examples.en: Urban renewal must balance rapid modernization with preserving neighborhood memories and local culture.
examples.zh: 推動都市更新建設必須在大刀闊斧的現代化與深耕在地鄰里共同記憶與歷史人文紋理之間取得精準平衡。

entries.definition: 都市更新 (都更)；重建復興

explains.en: A city may rebuild unsafe old buildings while improving the neighborhood. It should also protect local memories.
A passport must be replaced before it expires. This process gives it a new period of use.
A community can improve its buildings and public spaces while keeping its history. This process can be called neighborhood revitalization.

examples.en: Urban regeneration projects breathe vibrant cultural life into abandoned harbor warehouses.
examples.zh: 都市街區活化再生專案成功為昔日荒廢的高雄港邊老舊碼頭倉庫注入了朝氣蓬勃的文創生命力。

examples.en: Salamanders have an extraordinary biological capacity for cellular limb regeneration after injury.
examples.zh: 兩棲類蠑螈體內蘊含著令人稱奇的強大生物再生機能，在斷肢受損後能自體完整進行細胞肢體再生。

examples.en: The redevelopment of old industrial brownfields sparked economic regeneration across the entire district.
examples.zh: 昔日污染廢棄老工業區棕地（Brownfields）的轉型重塑，為整座行政區引爆了強勁的經濟繁榮與新生。

explains.en: Renewing a worn area can bring homes, shops, and parks back to life. Local people may help plan the changes. The work can take years.
An empty factory became a library and art space. Neighbors began visiting again. New trees made the street more welcoming.
Some living things can grow back a lost body part. This natural process helps them recover from injury. Different species can do it in different ways.

examples.en: Adaptive reuse transformed the historic tobacco factory into the world-famous Songshan Cultural Park.
examples.zh: 透過空間活化再利用（Adaptive Reuse）手法，昔日的松山菸廠成功變身為國際知名的松山文創園區。

examples.en: Bring your own canvas bags and reusable tumblers to practice sustainable plastic reuse.
examples.zh: 出門購物請隨身自備環保帆布購物袋與不鏽鋼環保隨行杯，將塑膠容器的重複使用理念落實於日常。

examples.en: The architect's creative reuse of reclaimed railroad timber gave the cafe an authentic rustic charm.
examples.zh: 建築設計師發揮巧思將拆除退役的舊鐵道枕木回收再利用，賦予了這間咖啡廳獨一無二的溫潤質樸韻味。

entries.definition: 歷史建築活化再利用；重複使用

explains.en: It means using an item again instead of throwing it away. A canvas bag can replace many plastic carriers. Old timber may become part of a cafe.
People can wash and refill a tumbler many times. Architects may also give an old factory a new purpose. This helps reduce waste.
Use this verb when an object is used again for the same or a different purpose. A jar can hold pencils. A historic building can become a park.

examples.en: Illuminated skyscrapers create a dazzling nocturnal skyline along the Tamsui River.
examples.zh: 燈火通明的現代摩天大樓群沿著淡水河畔勾勒出璀璨迷人、宛如鑽石般閃耀的都會夜景天際線。

examples.en: From Elephant Mountain, hikers can capture the most famous postcard view of Taipei's iconic skyline.
examples.zh: 登上象山六巨石觀景步道，國內外登山遊客能在此定格拍下全台灣最為經典明信片般的台北天際線全貌。

examples.en: Construction cranes dominate the expanding city skyline as economic growth continues to surge.
examples.zh: 隨著高科技經濟引擎強勁飆升，一座座高聳入雲的塔式起重吊車勾勒出這座繁華都市不斷拔高的壯闊天際線。

entries.definition: 都會天際線；地平線輪廓

explains.en: Tall buildings make a recognizable outline against the sky above a city. A river view may show it at night.
From a hill, photographers can capture rooftops and towers along the horizon. Construction cranes may change the view.
The shape of a city’s buildings can be seen from far away. Lights make the outline bright after dark.

examples.en: European cities are celebrated for their highly walkable, human-scale street grids.
examples.zh: 許多經典歐洲古城以其街廓尺度極其友善舒適、處處充滿漫步驚喜的宜居步行城市而享譽全球。

examples.en: Living in a walkable neighborhood means running daily errands without having to drive a car.
examples.zh: 居住在一個具備完善散步路網的生活圈中，意味著日常採買買菜與辦事完全無需開車出門受塞車之苦。

examples.en: Shaded arcades and wide sidewalks make this district one of the most pleasant, walkable areas in town.
examples.zh: 遮陽避雨的台灣騎樓建築與平整寬敞的人行道規劃，使本街區成為全城最宜居舒適的漫步生活天堂。

entries.definition: 適合步行的；散步宜居的

explains.en: A neighborhood with wide sidewalks and nearby shops is easy to explore on foot. People may not need a car.
Shaded paths make it pleasant to walk to school or buy groceries. This describes a place designed for walkers.
This district has safe sidewalks and short distances between errands. Residents can go around without driving.

examples.en: Shaded pocket parks offer bench seating and blooming flowers along dense residential alleys.
examples.zh: 在高樓林立的密集住宅巷弄轉角打造綠樹成蔭的社區口袋公園，為周遭鄰里提供偷閒歇腳處。

examples.en: Converting an abandoned vacant lot into a pocket park brought neighbors together for community gardening.
examples.zh: 將社區閒置髒亂的三角畸零空地改造成口袋微型綠地公園，成功凝聚了街坊鄰里一同種花美化的向心力。

examples.en: Office workers step out to the nearby pocket park during lunch breaks to catch some fresh air.
examples.zh: 附近的上班族在忙碌的午休時間最喜歡走出辦公室，來到街角口袋公園長椅上曬曬太陽、呼吸新鮮空氣。

entries.definition: 社區口袋公園；街角綠地

explains.en: A tiny public green space can fit between buildings or along a street. It may have a bench or trees. Neighbors can stop there to rest.
Workers turned an empty corner into a shady place with flowers. People began eating lunch there. The change brought the block together.
These small spaces add nature to crowded neighborhoods. They are open to everyone nearby. A simple path can make the area easy to enter.

examples.en: A thoughtfully designed home serves as a calm, restorative sanctuary from the noisy world.
examples.zh: 一座充滿溫度、精心打磨的質感居所，是洗滌一身疲憊、阻絕外界喧囂擾攘的心靈安歇避風港。

examples.en: The coastal wetland nature reserve acts as a protected sanctuary for thousands of migratory spoonbills.
examples.zh: 這處沿海濕地國家級自然保留區，宛如數千隻遠道而來度冬的珍稀黑面琵鷺最安全無虞的庇護聖地。

examples.en: Escaping to the mountain cabin provided an unplugged sanctuary where she could write her novel in peace.
examples.zh: 週末暫別手機遠離網路隱居到靜謐的高山小木屋中，為她提供了一處能心無旁騖專心創作小說的心靈聖所。

examples.en: Establishing marine sanctuaries creates no-take replenishment zones that replenish dwindling fish stocks.
examples.zh: 劃設禁漁海洋生態保護區能建立天然繁衍庇護所，讓瀕危魚種在此安心產卵並充實周邊漁場資源。

examples.en: The island established a coral reef sanctuary where anchoring and motorized watercraft are banned.
examples.zh: 這座美麗小島劃定了國家級珊瑚礁保護區，區內全面嚴禁各類船隻下錨與水上摩托車競速。

examples.en: Patrol boats guard the borders of the marine sanctuary to deter poachers from setting illegal gillnets.
examples.zh: 動員巡邏艇日夜嚴密在海洋生態保護區周遭警戒巡防，強力嚇阻不肖違法漁民摸黑前來盜撒三層流刺網。

examples.en: Quiet museum halls provide a contemplative cultural sanctuary away from hurried modern daily routines.
examples.zh: 莊嚴靜謐的美術館大廳是一座能讓現代人暫時抽離繁忙日常、靜心沉澱心靈的精神文化殿堂。

examples.en: The Kenting coastal reserve serves as a protected ecological sanctuary for rare migrating birds and sea turtles.
examples.zh: 墾丁國家公園海濱濕地保護區是一處受到嚴密法律維護的生態庇護所，為稀有過境冬候鳥與海龜提供棲地。

examples.en: When life became overwhelmed with deadlines, his quiet greenhouse garden became his personal sanctuary.
examples.zh: 當生活被雪片般飛來的公務期限壓得喘不過氣時，頂樓那座草木扶疏的小溫室便成了他個人的心靈療癒避難所。

examples.en: Marine sanctuaries establish strict no-take zones allowing damaged pelagic populations to recover.
examples.zh: 依法劃設國家級海洋保護區並落實核心禁漁，能讓遭受過度捕撈的近海魚群休養生息。

examples.en: The tranquil mountain temple served as a peaceful spiritual sanctuary away from bustling city stress.
examples.zh: 這座寧靜的山間古剎成為遠離繁忙都會壓力的心靈避風港庇護所。

examples.en: Rangers patrol the wildlife sanctuary day and night to protect endangered birds from illegal poaching.
examples.zh: 巡護員日夜在野生動物保護區內巡邏，保護瀕危鳥類免受非法盜獵侵害。

examples.en: The tranquil temple inner courtyard serves as a spiritual sanctuary for weary city souls seeking peace.
examples.zh: 祥和寧靜的廟宇大殿深處，是一座撫慰無數疲憊都會心靈、帶來平靜祥和與庇佑的神聖心靈避風港。

examples.en: Escaping the bustling downtown noise, she entered the sanctuary to pray quietly for family health.
examples.zh: 暫時逃離市中心喧囂的人潮車流，她步入大殿深處合十默禱，為全家祈求平安無恙。

examples.en: The ancient temple grounds remain a sanctuary of calm amidst a rapidly modernizing metropolis.
examples.zh: 這座古意盎然的廟宇園區，在急速摩天化現代都會叢林中，宛如一處安撫心神的心靈避風港。

examples.en: The lush central courtyard offers residents a tranquil biophilic sanctuary away from bustling traffic.
examples.zh: 綠意盎然的社區中庭空中花園，為住戶在車水馬龍的喧囂水泥叢林中提供了一處洗滌心靈的綠洲庇護所。

examples.en: Stepping out onto the rooftop greenery provides an immediate mental sanctuary from daily office fatigue.
examples.zh: 偷得浮生半日閒步入頂樓生機勃勃的植生空中花園，瞬間為緊繃疲憊的都會上班族帶來心靈避風港。

examples.en: This quiet wooden library surrounded by moss gardens serves as a peaceful urban sanctuary.
examples.zh: 這座被翠綠苔蘚庭園與林蔭環抱的木構沉靜圖書館，成為都會心靈暫時逃離塵囂的靜謐綠色庇護所。

examples.en: The sprawling mountain basin was officially gazetted as a protected wildlife sanctuary free from logging.
examples.zh: 這片綿延的中央山脈森林流域，被依法正式劃設為全面禁止伐木與開發的「野生動物保護區」（Sanctuary）。

examples.en: The marine sanctuary serves as a peaceful nursing haven for mother sea turtles and newly hatched young.
examples.zh: 海洋生態保護區為產卵的海龜媽媽與剛孵化的小海龜提供了免受人為干擾的平靜繁衍避風港。

examples.en: Strict security controls prohibit unauthorized tourists from entering the core wilderness sanctuary.
examples.zh: 嚴格的保護區出入管制措施，嚴禁未經許可的遊客擅自進入核心荒野保育庇護區。

examples.en: Modern aquariums serve as an educational sanctuary and conservation ark for disappearing coral reef species.
examples.zh: 現代水族館肩負重任，已成為瀕危海洋物種繁衍生息、對抗滅絕的「蔚藍方舟與安全庇護所」（Sanctuary）。

examples.en: The peaceful temple grounds provide a quiet spiritual sanctuary away from the deafening city traffic.
examples.zh: 古剎廟宇寧靜清幽的庭院禪房，為奔波勞碌的都會人提供了一處遠離滾滾紅塵與車馬喧囂的心靈避風港庇護所。

examples.en: The coastal wetlands were declared a national wildlife sanctuary to protect endangered migratory spoonbills.
examples.zh: 該片沿海濕地正式被依法劃設為國家級野生動物保護區，全力守護全球瀕危的珍稀過境黑面琵鷺。

examples.en: The dark oceanic abyss is a sacred, timeless sanctuary that has sheltered mysterious life for billions of years.
examples.zh: 漆黑深邃的深海平原是一座萬古永恆的「神聖生命庇護所」（Sanctuary），在數十億年間默默庇護著生命演化。

examples.en: The mountain wetland was officially gazetted as a protected nature sanctuary for migratory black-faced spoonbills.
examples.zh: 這片高山濕地已被政府正式公告為受嚴格法律保護的自然生態保護區，作為瀕危黑面琵鷺冬候鳥的度冬庇護所。

examples.en: Finding a quiet corner in the university library provided a peaceful study sanctuary during mid-term exams.
examples.zh: 在期中考週期間，於大學總圖書館尋得一處安靜靠窗的角落，無疑是全心苦讀備考的最佳心靈避風港。

examples.en: Stepping inside the quiet hall feels like entering a sacred sanctuary dedicated entirely to the beauty of sound.
examples.zh: 踏入這座極致靜謐的大廳，宛如走進一座遠離塵囂、完全獻給純淨聲音美學的「神聖音樂殿堂」（Sanctuary）。

examples.en: The wildlife sanctuary provides a secure breeding habitat for endangered Formosan black bears and serows.
examples.zh: 這處國家級野生動物重要棲息環境生態保護區，為瀕臨絕種的台灣黑熊與台灣長鬃山羊提供了安全的繁殖庇護所。

examples.en: Her cozy home study with a garden view serves as a peaceful quiet sanctuary after stressful corporate days.
examples.zh: 窗外坐擁滿庭綠意的溫馨居家書房，是她在經歷高壓緊繃的職場會議後最放鬆舒壓的避風港聖殿。

entries.definition: 心靈避風港；庇護所；聖所；海洋生態保護區；沉澱心靈的文化藝術殿堂；海洋生態資源保護區；撫慰萬千信眾心靈之神聖心靈殿堂；喧囂水泥叢林中的綠意森活心靈避風港；依法劃設之國有林野生動物重要棲息環境；守護瀕危海洋物種之現代蔚藍方舟與避難所；萬古靜謐、孕育地球生命起源之深海神聖庇護所；隔絕塵世繁雜喧囂之純淨天籟音樂神聖殿堂

explains.en: It can be a safe place where people or animals are protected. A wetland may shelter migratory birds. It can also mean a peaceful place to rest.
A nature reserve gives wildlife a protected home. Someone may also call a quiet cabin a safe retreat from noise. The word can refer to a sacred place as well.
This place offers safety or peace. It may protect endangered animals or provide a calm room for someone to write. A church can also have one.

examples.en: Annual rabies vaccination is legally mandated in Taiwan to safeguard public health.
examples.zh: 依法飼主每年皆必須帶毛小孩至動物醫院施打狂犬病疫苗並領取當年度專屬防鏽金屬頸牌。

examples.en: Rabies is a fatal viral disease that affects the central nervous system of mammals.
examples.zh: 狂犬病是一種會侵襲哺乳動物中樞神經系統的致命病毒性疾病。

examples.en: The city animal protection office organizes free rabies immunization drives in remote villages.
examples.zh: 市立動保處在偏遠鄉鎮定期舉辦巡迴免費狂犬病疫苗預防施打活動。

entries.definition: 狂犬病（人畜共通傳染病）

explains.en: This serious virus can spread through bites from infected mammals. Avoid touching wild animals and contact a health professional after a bite.
Dogs, bats, and other mammals can carry a dangerous disease that affects the brain and nerves. Vaccination programs help protect animals and people.
A veterinarian can explain how to protect pets from this infection. Seek medical advice quickly after a possible exposure.

examples.en: Ultrasonic dental scaling removes stubborn tartar, reversing smelly breath and periodontal disease.
examples.zh: 安排全身麻醉超音波洗牙能徹底清除牙齦深處的頑固牙結石，消除口臭並根治早期牙周病。

examples.en: Blood tests were performed prior to dental scaling to confirm anesthesia safety for the older dog.
examples.zh: 術前特別進行血液檢查，以評估高齡犬進行洗牙麻醉的身體安全性。

examples.en: Regular tooth brushing at home reduces the frequency with which your cat needs professional scaling.
examples.zh: 平常在家落實每日刷牙，能大幅降低貓咪需要接受專業麻醉洗牙的頻率。

examples.en: Temperature and pressure drops cause mineral scaling, coating the insides of surface pipes with silica.
examples.zh: 溫度與壓力驟降會引發嚴重的「礦物結晶結垢」（Scaling），在金屬管道內壁沉積厚重的二氧化矽硬垢。

examples.en: The intrepid mountaineer continued scaling the steep snowy face toward the windy mountain ridge.
examples.zh: 勇敢無畏的高山攀登隊員頂著呼嘯的寒風，腳踏冰爪堅定不移地沿著白雪皚皚的陡峭冰壁向主稜線攀登攀爬。

examples.en: Fast-growing software startups encounter complex organizational challenges when scaling up their engineering team.
examples.zh: 業務爆發性增長的網路科技新創公司，在急速擴大研發團隊編制規模時往往會遭遇嚴峻的管理與溝通挑戰。

entries.definition: 寵物超音波洗牙；除齒結石；管道內部二氧化矽與碳酸鈣結晶結垢阻塞；結垢

explains.en: A veterinarian may use sound waves to remove tartar from a pet's teeth. Blood tests can check if anesthesia is safe.
Minerals can build up inside a water pipe when pressure and temperature change. The buildup narrows the passage.
A climber may move up a snowy rock face toward a ridge. A growing company may also increase its size.

examples.en: Administering tasty chewable monthly preventatives guards dogs against fleas, ticks, and worms.
examples.zh: 每月固定餵食一顆香濃牛肉口味的口服全效預防驅蟲藥，能全方位抵禦跳蚤、壁蝨與各類絛蟲。

examples.en: Consistent application of topical preventatives keeps outdoor cats protected from mites.
examples.zh: 定期點擦外用滴劑型預防用藥，能保護常在陽台玩耍的貓咪免受耳疥蟲侵擾。

examples.en: Consult your veterinarian to select the most appropriate multi-spectrum preventative for your pet.
examples.zh: 請向您的家庭獸醫諮詢，為家中愛寵挑選最合適的廣泛全效預防藥物。

explains.en: Something intended to stop a problem before it starts is used in advance. Regular hand washing is one example. It can lower the chance of illness.
The vet gave the dog medicine on a regular schedule. This helped protect it from parasites. The owner wrote the dates on a calendar.
As a noun, this can mean a medicine or treatment used to prevent illness. As an adjective, it describes an action taken early. It aims to reduce future harm.

examples.en: Finicky senior cats devour creamy chicken liver canned pate with great enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 牙口不好或挑嘴的高齡貓咪對質地綿密絲滑的鮮雞肉慕斯肉泥主食罐（Pâté）總是吃得津津有味。

examples.en: Smooth pate textures make it effortless to conceal liquid medication or crushed antibiotic pills.
examples.zh: 質地綿密的慕斯肉醬便於完美隱藏液體藥水或磨碎的抗生素藥粉。

examples.en: We transition sick cats to nutrient-dense pate formulations when they struggle with dry biscuits.
examples.zh: 當生病虛弱的貓咪難以咀嚼乾硬餅乾時，我們會換成營養密度極高的慕斯肉泥。

explains.en: It is a smooth paste made from meat or liver, often served as a spread. Some pet foods have this soft texture. It can hide medicine for a cat.
A chef may serve this rich meat mixture on bread. A smooth version can be easy for an older cat to eat. Store it safely after opening.
This food is finely ground and soft. It may be made from liver or other ingredients. In pet food, the texture is moist and easy to eat.

examples.en: Adding daily veterinary probiotics relieves loose stools and improves sensitive gut digestion.
examples.zh: 每日在飼料中添加一包獸醫專利寵物專用活菌益生菌，能迅速緩解軟便腹瀉並建立健康腸道菌叢。

examples.en: Probiotic powder can be sprinkled over wet food to restore microflora after antibiotic treatment.
examples.zh: 在抗生素療程結束後，可將益生菌粉末灑在濕食中以重建腸道良性益菌菌群。

examples.en: Regular use of specialized probiotics strengthens intestinal immunity against dietary upsets.
examples.zh: 長期適量補充專用益生菌，能增強腸道黏膜抵抗力，減少因換糧引起的不適。

entries.definition: 寵物專利益生菌；益生的

explains.en: Some foods contain helpful living microorganisms, such as certain yogurts. Ask a clinician before using supplements for health problems.
A pet product may include microorganisms intended to support digestion. A veterinarian can help decide whether it is suitable.
This term describes microbes or products containing them. Scientific evidence and effects can vary by product.

examples.en: Sturdy vertical sisal rope scratching posts prevent cats from clawing upholstered sofa leather.
examples.zh: 在客廳角落擺放一座結實穩固的天然劍麻繩垂直貓抓柱，能滿足貓咪磨爪天性並拯救皮沙發。

examples.en: Scratching allows felines to shed dead outer claws while marking their territory with scent glands.
examples.zh: 磨爪動作能幫助貓咪褪下老舊脫落的外層爪鞘，同時透過腳掌腺體標記領地氣味。

examples.en: Place scratching boards near favorite nap spots to encourage healthy claw maintenance.
examples.zh: 將貓抓板擺在牠們平時最愛的睡窩旁，能自然引導牠們養成健康的磨爪好習慣。

explains.en: A post wrapped in sisal rope lets a cat sharpen its claws without damaging a sofa. Place it near a favorite sleeping spot.
Cats use their paws on a rough surface to remove old claw layers. They may also leave a scent behind.
A board or post can give a cat a safe place to use its claws. This helps protect furniture.

examples.en: Gentle conditioning sprays assist the painless dematting of tangled long Persian fur.
examples.zh: 在梳理波斯貓打結糾纏的長毛前噴上天然植萃開結順毛噴霧，能進行無痛深層開結梳理。

examples.en: Severe dematting can cause pain, so heavily felted undercoats sometimes require gentle clipping instead.
examples.zh: 嚴重的毛結硬塊梳開時會引發劇烈扯痛，因此重度毛球結塊有時直接細心剃除更為人道。

examples.en: Daily brushing prevents tight clumps from forming, eliminating the stressful need for harsh dematting.
examples.zh: 養成每天替長毛寵物梳毛的好習慣，就能完全免除日後痛苦費力的開結拆毛程序。

entries.definition: 寵物深層開結梳毛；梳理毛結

explains.en: Removing tight knots from an animal’s fur takes patience and care. A comb or special tool can help loosen them. Pulling too hard may hurt the animal.
The groomer held the cat gently while working through a small knot. She stopped when the cat became uneasy. Short breaks kept the visit calm.
Long fur can tangle when it is not brushed often. Regular grooming helps prevent large mats. Severe tangles may need a professional.

examples.en: Soothing organic paw balm moisturizes cracked foot pads after walking on hot asphalt.
examples.zh: 在夏日柏油路上散步後，替狗狗塗抹一層含有乳木果油的有機肉球護掌霜，修護乾裂腳掌。

examples.en: Applying lick-safe beeswax balm protects a dog's nose leather from harsh dry winter winds.
examples.zh: 塗抹可舔食級天然蜂蠟香膏，能有效保護狗狗嬌嫩鼻頭肌膚不受凜冽寒冬乾風吹裂。

examples.en: Massage the herbal balm gently into coarse elbow calluses every evening before bedtime.
examples.zh: 每晚就寢前，取少許草本護膚膏輕柔按摩前肘粗糙的增生老繭與硬皮組織。

explains.en: It is a soothing ointment rubbed onto the skin. Pet owners may apply a safe kind to dry paw pads. Beeswax versions can protect a dog's nose.
This soft cream can ease dry or cracked skin. Put a small amount on elbows or paws. Check that a product is safe for animals before use.
A scented ointment may be used to soothe skin or lips. Some varieties protect a pet's nose from dry weather. Follow the directions on the container.

examples.en: Underwater treadmill hydrotherapy rebuilds hind leg muscles in post-surgery corgis without joint impact.
examples.zh: 讓術後柯基犬在恆溫溫水水中跑步機上進行水療復健運動，能在零關節衝擊下重建後腿肌肉。

examples.en: Heated pool hydrotherapy sessions enhance circulation and alleviate chronic stiffness in senior canines.
examples.zh: 溫水水療池的規律運動能增進血液循環，顯著舒緩年邁老犬全身關節慢性僵硬疼痛。

examples.en: A certified hydrotherapy specialist guides the paralyzed dachshund through gentle flotation exercises.
examples.zh: 領有專業證照的水療復健師在一旁悉心托扶，引導後腿癱瘓的臘腸狗進行漂浮肢體運動。

explains.en: A therapist may guide a patient through gentle movement in a warm pool. Water can support the body during exercise.
Some rehabilitation centers use an underwater treadmill for pets recovering from an injury. A trained professional supervises.
This treatment uses water in a therapy setting. A qualified clinician decides whether it fits a person’s or animal’s needs.

examples.en: A certified canine behaviorist resolved the rescue dog's severe fear of thunderstorms.
examples.zh: 專業國際犬類行為治療師透過系統減敏與反制約療法，成功治癒了流浪收容犬對雷聲的恐懼。

examples.en: Rather than relying on punishment, the feline behaviorist modified litter box avoidance through environmental enrichment.
examples.zh: 貓咪行為學家並非採用處罰，而是藉由環境豐富化與貓砂位置調整解決亂尿問題。

examples.en: Consulting an animal behaviorist helped the family integrate their new puppy alongside their territorial resident cat.
examples.zh: 諮詢專業動物行為專家的建議，順利協助一家人讓新來幼犬與原住地盤老貓和平共處。

entries.definition: 動物行為治療師；行為學家

explains.en: This animal specialist can help a dog overcome fear of storms. They study how animals act.
A cat that avoids its litter box may need a change in its surroundings. This expert can suggest one.
Families may ask this professional for help introducing a puppy to a resident cat. The specialist understands animal behavior.

examples.en: Early socialization exposes young puppies to diverse sounds, strangers, surfaces, and friendly dogs.
examples.zh: 掌握幼犬三到十四週的社會化黃金期，讓牠們溫和接觸吸塵器聲、陌生人與友善狗伴，培養自信。

examples.en: Inadequate early socialization often manifests as extreme fear or defensive aggression later in adulthood.
examples.zh: 成長發育期缺乏充分社會化訓練，日後成年時往往容易表現出極度膽小或防禦性攻擊。

examples.en: Enrolling in puppy socialization classes provides structured opportunities to learn proper canine etiquette.
examples.zh: 報名參加專業幼犬社會化專門課程，能提供循序漸進且安全的環境學習正確犬類社交禮節。

entries.definition: 幼犬幼貓社會化黃金期；社交化

explains.en: Learning how to interact with other people is part of growing up. Children practice sharing, listening, and taking turns. Family and school both help.
A puppy meets friendly people and calm dogs in safe settings. It learns that new sights and sounds are not frightening. Short, positive visits help.
People learn the rules and customs of groups around them. These habits can differ from one community to another. They help everyone live together.

examples.en: Gentle trade games prevent resource guarding of raw meat bones and favorite toys.
examples.zh: 透過「拿更好吃的肉乾跟毛孩等價交換」的溫和練習，能有效預防並改善護食與護玩具行為。

examples.en: Growling when approached while eating indicates an escalating pattern of food guarding.
examples.zh: 當有人靠近正在進食的毛孩而牠發出低吼時，代表其護食防禦戒心正在逐步升溫。

examples.en: A trainer taught the owners never to physically snatch items, thereby curing the guarding behavior.
examples.zh: 訓練師指導主人切勿徒手強硬奪取牠口中物品，從根本上瓦解了因恐慌失去而引起的護物行為。

explains.en: It is behavior where a dog protects food or a favorite object and may growl when someone approaches. Trade games can teach safer habits. Do not grab items away.
A pet may become tense when a person comes near its bowl or toy. This behavior can escalate. A trained professional can help the owner respond safely.
Some dogs protect objects they value. A trainer can teach owners to exchange a toy for a treat rather than take it by force. Watch for warning signs.

examples.en: A relaxed full-body tail wagging indicates pure joy and friendly greeting intentions.
examples.zh: 伴隨著全身肌肉放鬆、大幅度左右平順搖動的搖尾巴肢體語言，代表狗狗純粹的喜悅與友善招呼。

examples.en: Fast, stiff tail wagging accompanied by rigid posture can actually signal high tension or warning.
examples.zh: 緊繃僵硬且快速的高頻擺尾配合僵直站姿，事實上可能是高度緊張或發出攻擊警戒的訊號。

examples.en: The golden retriever's whole backside began wagging enthusiastically the moment his owner walked in.
examples.zh: 當主人推開家門的瞬間，黃金獵犬連同整個屁股都開始熱情澎湃地瘋狂左右擺動。

explains.en: A relaxed dog moves its tail loosely when greeting a familiar person. Look at its whole posture to understand its mood.
A stiff body and a fast tail movement may mean a dog feels tense. Give it space and ask an adult for help.
A puppy’s tail moves from side to side when it sees its owner. Dogs communicate in many ways, not only through this movement.

examples.en: Soft rhythmic purring vibrations while cuddling on your lap signal deep contentment.
examples.zh: 當貓咪安靜蜷縮在主人溫暖大腿上時所發出均勻低沉的節奏性呼嚕呼嚕聲，代表極致的安心滿足。

examples.en: In addition to expressing happiness, cats sometimes rely on low purring as self-soothing when injured.
examples.zh: 除了表達幸福愉悅外，貓咪在身體受傷不適時，有時也會藉由低頻呼嚕聲達到自我療癒。

examples.en: Listening to the gentle purring of a rescue cat helped lower her owner's resting heart rate.
examples.zh: 靜靜聆聽獲救貓咪耳邊傳來的溫柔呼嚕聲，不可思議地撫平了飼主一整天的焦慮並降低心率。

entries.definition: 貓咪放鬆呼嚕聲；發出咕嚕聲

explains.en: A relaxed cat may make a soft, steady sound while sitting on a person's lap. It often shows contentment.
An injured cat may also make this low vibration to comfort itself. The sound does not always mean happiness.
A gentle cat sound can help an owner feel calm. The cat may be resting close by.

examples.en: Fenced dog parks allow energetic golden retrievers to sprint safely in off-leash play areas.
examples.zh: 設有雙層安全防逃閘門的專屬狗狗公園，能讓精力旺盛的黃金獵犬在不繫牽繩區盡情狂奔放電。

examples.en: Dogs should only be allowed off-leash once they possess a rock-solid, reliable recall command.
examples.zh: 只有在毛孩具備百分之百隨傳隨到的完美召回能力下，才適宜在開闊安全處解開牽繩。

examples.en: The city ordinance fines owners who let pets roam off-leash along public riverbank trails.
examples.zh: 市府法規明文重罰在河濱步道等公眾未圍欄場所放任毛孩不繫牽繩隨處亂跑的違規飼主。

entries.definition: 不繫牽繩自由奔跑的；放開牽繩

explains.en: A dog can move without a lead attached to its collar in a safe area. It should come back when called. Fenced parks often allow this.
At the enclosed field, Ben let his dog run freely. He kept watching and called it back near the gate. Other visitors had space.
Local rules may limit where pets can roam freely. Owners should check signs and keep animals under control. Busy roads are unsafe places.

examples.en: 'Adopt, Don't Shop' campaigns urge the public to give shelter animals loving forever homes.
examples.zh: 「支持領養代替購買」（Adopt, Don't Shop）的動保理念呼籲大眾給予公立收容所無辜浪浪一個永遠溫暖的家。

examples.en: The animal rescue group conducted a thorough home visit prior to finalizing the puppy adoption.
examples.zh: 動保志工團隊在正式批准幼犬送養手續前，會進行嚴謹的居家訪視以評估家庭環境安全。

examples.en: Choosing shelter adoption saves two lives: the animal you bring home and the next one taking its spot.
examples.zh: 選擇自收容所認養流浪動物等於拯救了兩條寶貴生命：帶回家的那一隻，以及空出床位獲得庇護的下一隻。

explains.en: It is the process of giving a child or animal a permanent family. A shelter may visit a home before placing a puppy. The new family provides care.
A person can welcome a shelter animal into their home. The rescue group checks that the family is ready. This choice can save a life.
This process makes someone or an animal part of a new family. It involves important legal steps for children. For pets, shelters often check the home first.

examples.en: Loving owners learn to administer daily subcutaneous fluids at home for cats with chronic kidney disease (CKD).
examples.zh: 偉大飼主在獸醫指導下學會每天在家為罹患慢性腎衰竭（CKD）的愛貓進行皮下點滴輸液補充水分。

examples.en: The vet showed us how to gently tent the loose neck skin before delivering the subcutaneous injection.
examples.zh: 獸醫細心指導示範如何在頸背鬆弛皮膚處捏起帳篷褶皺，以便精準無痛地刺入皮下輸液針頭。

examples.en: Regular subcutaneous fluid therapy flushes metabolic toxins and combats feline dehydration effectively.
examples.zh: 定期在家施打皮下輸液能有效沖刷代謝蓄積的尿毒素，顯著改善貓咪慢性脫水倦怠症狀。

entries.definition: 皮下注射輸液的；皮下的

explains.en: A medicine is given into the soft layer just under the skin. A health professional can explain how it is done safely.
A veterinarian may teach an owner about fluids for a pet with a chronic illness. Follow the clinic’s instructions.
This term describes something located or delivered beneath the skin. Only use medical procedures with professional guidance.

examples.en: The policy provides an 80% reimbursement rate for covered emergency hospitalization fees.
examples.zh: 這張高規格寵物保單針對承保範圍內的緊急住院手術費用，提供高達百分之八十的實支實付理賠率。

examples.en: Submit veterinary invoices and full diagnostic records online to expedite claim reimbursement.
examples.zh: 透過線上系統拍照上傳詳細就醫收據與全套病歷診斷書，能大幅加快保險金核銷審核與理賠撥款。

examples.en: Our insurance reimbursement arrived within five business days, easing the financial burden of surgery.
examples.zh: 保險理賠金在五個工作天內便迅速入帳，及時緩解了高額急診手術給家庭財務帶來的沉重負擔。

entries.definition: 保險理賠退款；報銷補償
