examples.zh: 國內外許多知名跨國大企業在篩選新鮮人履歷時，皆將具有公信力的多益實體測驗成績列為初審標準。

examples.en: He completed thirty practice sets to boost his TOEIC listening comprehension before the upcoming test.
examples.zh: 為了在即將到來的多益公開測驗中拔得頭籌，他連續一個月每日扎實刷完一回聽力閱讀全真模擬題本。

explains.en: People take this English test to show how well they can use the language at work. Companies may ask for a score.
A student can practice listening and reading before taking this workplace English exam. Different scores show different skills.
Many international companies check applicants' results from this test. It measures English used in business settings.

examples.en: University graduate programs in the UK require an overall IELTS band score of 7.0 or higher.
examples.zh: 申請英國名校碩士研究所課程，通常要求出具總分達到雅思（IELTS）7.0 級分以上的學術組成績。

examples.en: The IELTS speaking exam involves a live, face-to-face conversation with an international certified examiner.
examples.zh: 雅思國際英語測驗的口說部分，是由全球認證外籍考官與考生進行實體一對一真人面對面互動應試。

examples.en: Practicing academic graph description essays prepares candidates for the rigorous IELTS writing module.
examples.zh: 平常落實學術性長條圖與折線圖的圖表分析寫作訓練，是攻克雅思寫作第一大題拿到高分的關鍵基本功。

explains.en: This English test is used by many schools and employers. It checks listening, reading, writing, and speaking. People may need a certain score to apply.
Lina practiced describing pictures and answering questions aloud. She also read articles and wrote short essays. Her teacher helped her prepare.
Test takers choose a date and location for the exam. Results show how well they can use English. Organizations set their own score requirements.

examples.en: Scoring over 100 on the TOEFL iBT fulfills English requirements for Ivy League US universities.
examples.zh: 在托福網路測驗（TOEFL iBT）中考取一百分以上的高分，即可輕鬆達到美國頂尖長春藤盟校的入學門檻。

examples.en: The integrated speaking task in TOEFL tests your ability to synthesize information from reading and listening.
examples.zh: 托福考試中獨特的綜合題型，高度考驗考生在短時間內融會貫通閱讀短文與學術聽力資訊的整合能力。

examples.en: Familiarizing yourself with academic lectures is essential for navigating the fast-paced TOEFL listening section.
examples.zh: 平日多方涉獵多元領域的北美大學課堂錄音，是順暢應對快節奏、長篇幅托福學術聽力測驗的致勝秘訣。

explains.en: It is an English test often used by universities to check the language skills of applicants. It includes reading and listening. Some versions also test speaking and writing.
Students who want to study in the United States may need to take this exam. It measures academic English. Practice with lectures can help.
This standardized test checks how well a person can understand and use English in academic settings. Colleges may require a score. It has several sections.

examples.en: Passing the GEPT High-Intermediate test satisfies the graduation benchmark at most Taiwanese colleges.
examples.zh: 通過由 LTTC 舉辦的全民英檢（GEPT）中高級檢定初複試，能輕鬆通過全台各大頂尖大學的英文畢業門檻。

examples.en: The GEPT examination evaluates reading, listening, writing, and speaking competencies across distinct tiers.
examples.zh: 全民英檢（GEPT）分級檢定體系完整嚴密，分初試與複試全方位客觀檢驗國人的聽說讀寫四大面向實力。

examples.en: High school teachers often encourage students to take GEPT Intermediate as a milestone for college applications.
examples.zh: 許多高中英文老師積極鼓勵高一學生報考全民英檢中級，作為學習歷程檔案中極具含金量的官方證明。

explains.en: Learners in Taiwan can take an English test that checks reading, listening, writing, and speaking. It has different difficulty levels.
A student may prepare for a local language exam as a milestone in learning English. Teachers can explain which level to take.
This English proficiency test is familiar to many Taiwanese students. Its sections assess several communication skills.

examples.en: Taking timed full-length mock tests every Saturday simulates real exam pressure and builds stamina.
examples.zh: 每逢週六嚴格計時完成一回全真模擬試題模考，能完美模擬考場高壓氛圍並訓練長達兩小時的專注耐力。

examples.en: Analyzing incorrect answer choices after each mock test reveals chronic weaknesses in grammar mastery.
examples.zh: 每次做完模擬試題模考後，踏實花兩小時逐題檢討所有錯題，是揪出文法盲點與盲猜漏洞的最快路徑。

examples.en: The language institute offers computerized mock tests that mirror the exact user interface of the official exam.
examples.zh: 專業外語培訓中心提供高仿真的上機全真模擬機考，畫面介面與題型操作與正式官方大考如出一轍。

entries.definition: 全真模擬試題模考；實戰模考

explains.en: Students can take a timed practice exam on a computer. It helps them learn the real test format.
After finishing a practice paper, look at every wrong choice to find weak areas. Students can learn from their mistakes.
A language school may provide a trial exam that looks like the official test. Students can build confidence before exam day.

examples.en: Digital Anki flashcards leverage spaced repetition algorithms to memorize thousands of advanced idioms.
examples.zh: 善用數位 Anki 單字記憶卡與間隔重複演算法，能高效率在腦海中牢固記住數千個高級英文單字與慣用語。

examples.en: Adding example sentences and personal audio clips to your vocabulary flashcards accelerates long-term retention.
examples.zh: 在每張自製單字卡中隨手附上真實例句與母語發音音檔，能大幅提升大腦長期記憶的牢固度與鮮活感。

examples.en: Reviewing fifty smart flashcards during your subway commute turns idle downtime into rich learning moments.
examples.zh: 善用每日搭乘捷運通勤的零碎十分鐘複習五十張單字卡，能巧妙將無聊滑手機時間轉化為超高效充電。

entries.definition: 數位單字記憶卡 (如 Anki)；閃卡

explains.en: A small card shows a question or word on one side and a clue or answer on the other. Learners use it to practice remembering. Cards can be paper or digital.
Noah wrote a new word on one side and its meaning on the back. He reviewed a few each evening. Soon he remembered more.
Pictures and example sentences can make study cards more helpful. A learner can sort them by topic. Short practice sessions are easy to repeat.

examples.en: Speech shadowing native podcast recordings trains speech organs to produce natural English intonation.
examples.zh: 每天選取英語 Podcast 進行十分鐘「影子跟讀法」（Shadowing）同步朗讀，能精準訓練道地母語語調起伏。

examples.en: Beginners should start shadowing with short audio clips played at slightly slower playback speeds.
examples.zh: 初學者剛嘗試跟讀訓練時，建議從短篇生活對話開始，並適度調降播放語速以跟上講者的嘴型節奏。

examples.en: Consistent daily shadowing eliminates sluggish hesitation and transforms English speaking into an automatic reflex.
examples.zh: 持之以恆落實每日跟讀練習，能徹底戒除開口說英語時的結巴猶豫，將英文發音徹底轉化為直覺反射。

explains.en: It is a language practice where learners repeat speech immediately after hearing it. A short podcast clip works well. Slower playback can help beginners.
A student listens to a speaker and copies the words, rhythm, and intonation. Daily practice can reduce hesitation. Start with brief recordings.
This speaking exercise helps learners imitate natural pronunciation. They repeat each phrase soon after it is heard. It can make speech more fluent.

examples.en: Creating an English immersion bubble by switching phone interfaces and watching Netflix without subtitles accelerates learning.
examples.zh: 將手機介面切換為純英文並嘗試關閉中文字幕看美劇，為自己打造全天候全英語沉浸式學習環境。

examples.en: Spending a semester in an immersion home stay program rapidly boosted his conversational confidence.
examples.zh: 前往海外展開為期一學期的純英語寄宿家庭沉浸式生活體驗，讓他的日常口語表達自信呈爆炸性成長。

examples.en: True cultural immersion involves participating in local community rituals and dining alongside neighborhood residents.
examples.zh: 真正深度的文化沉浸體驗，在於敞開心胸走入在地常民生活，與社區居民一同參與百年祭典、共進家常便飯。

examples.en: Direct-to-chip and two-phase immersion cooling slash data center electricity consumption by thirty percent.
examples.zh: 導入雙相「浸沒式液冷散熱」（Immersion Cooling）技術，能將龐大 AI 資料中心的冷卻耗電量一口氣大降三成。

examples.en: Total language immersion in a local homestay is recognized as the fastest way to achieve conversational fluency.
examples.zh: 全天候與在地寄宿家庭同住的全沉浸式語言學習環境，被公認為能在短時間內說出一口道地流利外語的最好方法。

examples.en: The high-density AI server chassis is fully submerged in non-conductive synthetic dielectric fluid for silent immersion cooling.
examples.zh: 高功率密度 AI 超級伺服器主機板完全浸泡於不導電的專用合成介電冷卻液中，實現無風扇極致靜音液冷散熱。

examples.en: High-fidelity audiovisual rendering produces breathtaking immersion, transporting users to Martian plains.
examples.zh: 高擬真的視聽呈現帶來極致震撼的「感官沉浸感」（Immersion），彷彿親身踏上火星赤紅荒原。

examples.en: Language immersion camps help young learners acquire fluent conversational skills in English rapidly.
examples.zh: 全英語沉浸式營隊幫助青少年學員在短時間內迅速掌握流利的英語會話能力。

examples.en: The theater director focused on lighting and acoustics to create an atmosphere of complete dramatic immersion.
examples.zh: 舞台劇導演著力於燈光與音效設計，營造出完全引人入勝的戲劇沉浸氛圍。

examples.en: Constant cultural and media immersion makes vocabulary absorption effortless and natural.
examples.zh: 透過影音與閱讀融入全方位的「語言環境沉浸」（Immersion），讓單字吸收變得如呼吸般自然輕鬆。

examples.en: Total language immersion during a study abroad program accelerates practical speaking abilities.
examples.zh: 留學期間全天候的語言沉浸體驗，能以驚人的速度促進實際口語會話能力的進展。

examples.en: He created an English immersion environment at home by switching all his device settings to English.
examples.zh: 他把所有手機與電腦系統語言切換成英語，在家中為自己打造出沉浸式的英語環境。

entries.definition: 全英語沉浸式學習法；沉浸；資料中心全浸沒式液冷散熱；身臨其境之完全感官沉浸感 (Immersion)；將英語融入生活每一刻之自然全方位沉浸

explains.en: A learner lives with a host family and uses English throughout the day. Regular conversation helps them practice.
A computer component is placed in a special cooling liquid to carry heat away. The fluid must be made for electronics.
Visitors join local meals and community activities while learning customs. In technology, the same word can mean fully placing equipment in liquid.

examples.en: Embracing a growth mindset reframes grammatical mistakes as exciting opportunities for mastery.
examples.zh: 擁抱「成長型思維模式」（Growth Mindset），將開口說英文時犯下的文法小錯誤視為邁向精通的寶貴養分。

examples.en: Cultivating an agile entrepreneurial mindset helps executives navigate sudden industry disruptions.
examples.zh: 培養積極敏捷的創業家思維心態，能協助企業高階經理人在面臨突如其來的產業劇變時冷靜破局。

examples.en: A fixed mindset discourages taking bold creative risks because of the irrational fear of public failure.
examples.zh: 墨守成規的「定型心態」往往因過度恐懼失敗受挫，而讓人畫地自限、不敢大膽嘗試任何創新突破。

examples.en: Adopting a growth mindset transforms fear of failure into an exciting hunger for learning and skill development.
examples.zh: 擁抱成長型思維模式，能將對失敗的恐懼轉化為渴望探索新知與精進技能的強烈熱情。

examples.en: Breaking through difficult career plateaus requires shifting from a passive employee mindset to proactive ownership.
examples.zh: 想要突破職場生涯停滯不前的瓶頸平台期，必須將被動交差的心態轉變為主動當責的創業家思維。

examples.en: Innovators embrace an agile entrepreneurial mindset that tests ideas quickly and adapts without hesitation.
examples.zh: 卓越的創新先驅始終懷抱敏捷靈活的創業思維，敢於迅速驗證構想並毫不猶豫地果敢調整方向。

entries.definition: 成長型思維模式；心態；擁抱挑戰持續進步的成長型思維

explains.en: A student can treat grammar mistakes as chances to learn. This way of thinking welcomes effort.
A business leader may adapt quickly when an industry changes. This attitude helps with new problems.
Some people avoid risks because they fear failing. Changing how they think can help them try new ideas.

examples.en: Language mastery requires patient daily perseverance rather than occasional weekend cramming.
examples.zh: 真正精通一門外語靠的是日積月累、每天堅持不懈的三十分鐘恆毅力，而非考前偶爾熬夜死記硬背。

examples.en: Through quiet perseverance and countless hours at the workbench, the watchmaker restored the antique clockwork.
examples.zh: 憑藉著過人的堅毅耐力與工作台前數千個日夜的專注，老鐘錶匠終於完美修復了百年骨董精密機械鐘。

examples.en: Developing mental perseverance in marathon training prepares athletes to withstand grueling career trials.
examples.zh: 在全馬長跑耐力訓練中磨礪出的堅韌毅力，為運動員在日後人生職涯中跨越各種艱鉅試煉打下了底氣。

examples.en: Your remarkable perseverance carried you across 140 continuous batches to the very peak.
examples.zh: 你那令人欽佩的「堅定毅力」（Perseverance），帶領著你跨越整整一百四十批單字，登上學習頂峰。

examples.en: Through patience and sheer perseverance, the young athlete qualified for the upcoming Olympic Games.
examples.zh: 憑藉著耐心與無比堅韌的毅力，這位年輕運動員終於成功取得進軍奧運的參賽資格。

examples.en: Success in complex research projects depends far more on perseverance than on raw talent alone.
examples.zh: 在複雜深奧的科學研究專案中取得成功，往往取決於不懈的毅力，而非單純仰賴天賦。

entries.definition: 堅持不懈的恆毅力；毅力；滴水穿石、持之以恆之一百四十批堅毅耐力

explains.en: Continuing to work toward a goal despite difficulty shows patience. Progress may be slow at first. Regular effort can help.
The puzzle was hard, but Mei tried one clue at a time. She took a break and returned to it. At last, she solved it.
Learning a skill takes practice, and mistakes are normal. A person can improve by trying again. Help from others can make the effort easier.

examples.en: Morning sunlight exposure resets your master circadian rhythm, boosting daytime alertness.
examples.zh: 清晨起床出門照射十五分鐘明亮陽光，能精準校正人體大腦核心晝夜節律並提振白天精神。

examples.en: Irregular shift work disrupts the body's circadian clock, leading to metabolic imbalances.
examples.zh: 頻繁輪班且作息混亂的生活型態會打亂人體生理時鐘，進而誘發嚴重的代謝失調問題。

examples.en: Melatonin supplements help cross-timezone travelers synchronize their circadian patterns quickly.
examples.zh: 適量補充外源性褪黑激素，能協助跨時區長途飛行的旅客快速校準體內的晝夜生理時鐘。

examples.en: Aligning your sleep schedule with natural circadian light-dark cycles improves immune function.
examples.zh: 讓作息時間與大自然晝夜光暗的晝夜節律同步，能全面強化人體免疫防禦力。

examples.en: Traveling across twelve time zones disrupts your internal circadian clock, causing severe jet lag.
examples.zh: 跨越多達十二個時區搭乘長途越洋航班，會徹底打亂內在晝夜生理時鐘，造成嚴重的時差疲倦。

examples.en: Night-shift workers often struggle with circadian misalignment, leading to higher risks of metabolic fatigue.
examples.zh: 長期輪值大夜班的從業人員經常面臨晝夜節律失調的困擾，進而增加代謝機能低下與慢性疲勞風險。

entries.definition: 晝夜生理時鐘節律的；晝夜的；晝夜二十四小時生理時鐘節律的

explains.en: It describes the body's roughly daily rhythm of sleep and wakefulness. Morning sunlight can help reset it. Irregular work shifts may disrupt it.
People's energy and alertness change across a day according to an internal clock. Travel across time zones can disturb that pattern. Regular sleep helps.
This adjective relates to a cycle that repeats about every twenty-four hours. It affects when someone feels awake or sleepy. Light and routines can influence it.

examples.en: The brain's pineal gland secretes melatonin as ambient dusk light dims into darkness.
examples.zh: 當黃昏周遭環境光線逐漸轉暗，大腦松果體便會自然啟動分泌高濃度褪黑激素以催化睡意。

examples.en: Blue light emitted by smartphone screens suppresses natural melatonin production before bed.
examples.zh: 睡前智慧型手機螢幕散發出的刺眼藍光，會強力抑制大腦松果體自然合成與分泌褪黑激素。

examples.en: Older adults often produce less melatonin, which contributes to lighter and shorter nighttime sleep.
examples.zh: 銀髮族長輩體內自行合成的褪黑激素往往隨年齡遞減，這也是高齡者容易早醒且淺眠的主因。

examples.en: Dimming blue phone screens two hours before bed allows natural melatonin to signal it is time to sleep.
examples.zh: 睡前兩小時將手機藍光調暗，能讓大腦松果體順利分泌天然褪黑激素引導香甜入夢。

examples.en: Frequent travelers sometimes take low-dose melatonin supplements to adjust to international time differences.
examples.zh: 經常跨國出差的商務人士有時會適量補充低劑量褪黑激素保健品，以協助身體適應海外時差。

examples.en: Bright indoor fluorescent lighting in the late evening suppresses the pineal gland's secretion of melatonin.
examples.zh: 深夜室內強烈的白光螢光燈照明，會直接抑制大腦松果體正常分泌褪黑激素的天然節律。

entries.definition: 褪黑激素（松果體分泌助眠荷爾蒙）；松果體夜間分泌天然褪黑激素

explains.en: A gland in the brain makes a hormone that helps regulate the body’s sleep-wake timing. Darkness can affect when it is released.
Some people ask a clinician about supplements when traveling across time zones. Do not start a supplement without suitable advice.
This natural hormone is involved in the body’s daily rhythm. Light and darkness can influence its production.

examples.en: Cortisol levels naturally peak thirty minutes after waking to mobilize energy for the day.
examples.zh: 人體體內的皮質醇濃度在早晨醒來後半小時會達到自然波峰，全面喚醒身體機能並供應全天活力。

examples.en: Chronic workplace stress keeps circulating cortisol abnormally elevated, interfering with deep sleep.
examples.zh: 長期背負過重職場高壓會使血液中皮質醇濃度持續居高不下，進而嚴重干擾夜間深層睡眠。

examples.en: Gentle yoga and mindful breathing help lower evening cortisol, preparing the body for rest.
examples.zh: 睡前練習溫和的伸展瑜伽與深長正念呼吸，能顯著抑制傍晚皮質醇分泌，引導身體平靜入眠。

examples.en: Chronic high levels of cortisol weaken immune responses and disrupt restorative sleep quality.
examples.zh: 體內長期居高不下的皮質醇壓力荷爾蒙，會悄悄削弱免疫系統並破壞深層睡眠品質。

examples.en: Cortisol levels naturally peak shortly after waking up in the morning to help you feel alert and ready.
examples.zh: 人體內的皮質醇濃度在早晨剛甦醒後不久會自然達到峰值，以喚醒身體感官進入警覺就緒狀態。

examples.en: Practicing deep abdominal breathing helps bring elevated cortisol levels back down to a healthy baseline.
examples.zh: 經常練習深長緩慢的腹式深呼吸，能有效促使體內居高不下的皮質醇迅速回落至健康的基準線。

entries.definition: 皮質醇（壓力荷爾蒙；晨間喚醒素）；腎上腺分泌過量壓力荷爾蒙皮質醇

explains.en: This hormone can help the body feel alert after waking. Long-term stress may keep its level high.
Deep breathing or gentle yoga may help lower this stress hormone in the evening. That can prepare the body for rest.
A doctor may explain why this hormone changes during the day. It helps the body respond to stress.

examples.en: Stage 3 non-REM sleep is vital for muscle tissue recovery, immune strengthening, and cellular repair.
examples.zh: 第三階段的非快速動眼期深層睡眠（NREM），對於肌肉骨骼修復、免疫力強化與細胞再生至關重要。

examples.en: During deep non-REM periods, heart rate and blood pressure drop to their lowest daily levels.
examples.zh: 在非快速動眼期的深層慢波睡眠階段，人體心率與血壓會自然降至一整天中的最低安全基準線。

examples.en: Athletes prioritize extending slow-wave non-REM cycles to accelerate physical healing between competitions.
examples.zh: 頂尖運動員在密集賽事間格外重視延長慢波非快速動眼期睡眠，以全力加速受損肌肉組織修復。

explains.en: During this kind of sleep, the eyes do not move rapidly under the eyelids. The body passes through several stages. Deep stages help the body rest.
After a busy day, Ben slept quietly for several hours. His body rested while his breathing stayed steady. He woke refreshed.
Sleep includes phases that repeat during the night. Some are light and others deeper. The brain and body change during each phase.

examples.en: Vivid dreams occur during REM sleep, a stage crucial for emotional regulation and memory consolidation.
examples.zh: 栩栩如生的夢境發生於快速動眼期（REM），此階段對於梳理日間複雜情緒與固化長期記憶無可取代。

examples.en: Alcohol consumption severely inhibits REM sleep, leaving you feeling mentally foggy the following morning.
examples.zh: 睡前飲酒過量會大幅扼殺下半夜的快速動眼期睡眠，使人大腦在隔天早晨感到昏昏欲睡且思緒混沌。

examples.en: Brain wave activity during REM phases mirrors waking consciousness while skeletal muscles stay temporarily paralyzed.
examples.zh: 在快速動眼睡眠期間，人體腦波活躍程度與清醒時極為相似，而全身骨骼肌則處於暫時麻痺放鬆狀態。

examples.en: Rapid Eye Movement (REM) sleep is essential for creative problem-solving and processing difficult emotions.
examples.zh: 快速動眼期睡眠是激發創新靈感、鞏固複雜記憶與修復負面情緒創傷的關鍵黃金時刻。

examples.en: Vivid dreams accompanied by temporary muscle paralysis occur predominantly during the REM sleep phase.
examples.zh: 情節生動鮮明的情境夢境並伴隨全身骨骼肌暫時放鬆癱瘓，主要發生在快速動眼期睡眠階段。

examples.en: Alcohol consumption before bed fragments sleep cycles and significantly suppresses restorative REM duration.
examples.zh: 睡前飲用過量酒精會撕裂打碎整夜的睡眠週期，並顯著壓抑具有大腦修復功能的快速動眼期長度。

entries.definition: 快速動眼期 (Rapid Eye Movement)；快速動眼期睡眠 (夢境與情緒整合)

explains.en: It is a stage of sleep when the eyes move quickly and vivid dreams often occur. The brain is active while most muscles are temporarily still. It supports memory and emotions.
During this sleep phase, people may have vivid dreams. Alcohol can reduce time spent in it. The letters name the eye movement seen in this phase.
This part of the sleep cycle has active brain waves and fast eye movements. It helps with memory and emotional processing. The body is mostly still.

examples.en: Chronic sleep deprivation weakens immune defenses, accelerates aging, and impairs judgment.
examples.zh: 長期習慣性睡眠剝奪與熬夜會嚴重削弱人體免疫防禦力、加速皮膚衰老並使大腦決策判斷力遲鈍。

examples.en: Driving under extreme sleep deprivation poses accident risks equivalent to drunk driving.
examples.zh: 在極度嚴重睡眠匱乏狀態下疲勞駕駛，其肇事風險與酒精濃度超標的酒後駕車不相上下。

examples.en: University students cramming for finals often suffer from acute sleep deprivation and burnout.
examples.zh: 大學期末考週前夕熬夜抱佛腳的學子們，往往深受急性睡眠匱乏與身心精力透支之苦。

examples.en: Chronic sleep deprivation impairs judgment, slows reflexes, and increases food cravings for junk sugars.
examples.zh: 長期睡眠剝奪不僅會引發思緒遲鈍的腦霧，更會顯著削弱專注力並讓人渴望甜食。

examples.en: Severe sensory deprivation in dark underground chambers can cause disorientation and auditory hallucinations.
examples.zh: 在漆黑封閉的地底密室中經歷嚴重的感官剝奪，極易引發時空定向感迷失與聽覺幻覺。

examples.en: The humanitarian aid organization delivered emergency food and clean water to alleviate extreme deprivation.
examples.zh: 國際人道救援組織緊急空投賑濟乾糧與潔淨飲用水，全力緩解災區人民所面臨的極度物資匱乏。

entries.definition: 睡眠剝奪；長期睡眠不足；匱乏；長期睡眠剝奪導致腦霧疲憊

explains.en: Students who sleep too little may find it hard to focus and remember lessons. Rest is important for the body.
A person kept without light or sound for a long time may feel confused. The word describes a lack of something needed.
When a family cannot get enough food or clean water, it faces a serious shortage. Lack of sleep can also affect daily life.

examples.en: Loud snoring and sudden choking gasps are hallmark symptoms of obstructive sleep apnea.
examples.zh: 夜間震耳欲聾的打呼鼾聲與半夜突然窒息嗆醒，皆是「阻塞型睡眠呼吸中止症」的典型危險徵兆。

examples.en: Untreated sleep apnea significantly elevates the risk of high blood pressure and cardiac arrhythmias.
examples.zh: 若對長期的睡眠呼吸中止症置之不理，將會大幅倍增罹患頑固性高血壓與致命心律不整的風險。

examples.en: Overweight individuals can often alleviate sleep apnea symptoms through gradual weight loss.
examples.zh: 體重過重的患者透過健康飲食與規律運動減去多餘脂肪，往往能顯著改善呼吸道塌陷中止的症狀。

entries.definition: 睡眠呼吸中止症；呼吸暫停

explains.en: A sleeping person may stop breathing for short moments during the night. Loud snoring can be a sign.
A doctor may suggest treatment if a person wakes up choking or gasping. Extra weight can make this problem worse.
This condition causes breathing to pause while someone sleeps. A medical professional can help manage it.

examples.en: Wearing a continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) mask keeps airways open during sleep.
examples.zh: 夜間睡覺時配戴正壓呼吸器（CPAP）鼻罩，能以溫和氣流持續撐開塌陷呼吸道，改善血氧濃度。

examples.en: Modern CPAP devices operate with whisper-quiet motors and humidified heated tubing.
examples.zh: 當代高階正壓呼吸器配備超靜音馬達與恆溫加濕管路，大幅提升夜間配戴入睡的整體舒適度。

examples.en: Many patients report dramatic increases in daytime alertness after just one week on CPAP therapy.
examples.zh: 許多中重度患者在連續配戴呼吸器治療僅僅一週後，便驚喜發現白天的嗜睡與疲勞感完全一掃而空。

explains.en: This machine gently sends air through a mask during sleep. It helps keep a person’s breathing passage open. A doctor decides whether it is needed.
A patient put on the face mask before bed and turned on the machine. The steady airflow helped with breathing. The nurse showed how to clean it.
The mask should fit comfortably and the device needs regular care. People can ask a health professional about problems. It is used during sleep.

examples.en: High nighttime heart rate variability (HRV) indicates excellent autonomic nervous system recovery.
examples.zh: 夜間監測到較高的心率變異度（HRV），代表自律神經副交感神經活性良好且身體獲得充分深層恢復。

examples.en: Fitness trackers analyze heart rate variability to advise athletes whether to train hard or rest.
examples.zh: 智慧穿戴裝置透過精密演算心率變異度數值，精準建議運動員今日宜進行高強度操練還是放鬆修復。

examples.en: Chronic anxiety and systemic inflammation suppress baseline variability over extended periods.
examples.zh: 長期處於心理焦慮與體內慢性發炎狀態下，會顯著壓抑心率變異度的基準數值，反映身體過載。

examples.en: Deployable acoustic banners provide the hall with high operational variability for diverse musical genres.
examples.zh: 可升降吸音旗幟賦予了這座多功能音樂廳強大的「聲學可變彈性」（Variability），完美相容各類演出型態。

examples.en: Extreme rainfall variability across seasons poses significant challenges for municipal water reservoir management.
examples.zh: 四季之間極端懸殊的降雨量季節波動變化性，為全島各地民生水庫的水資源蓄水調度帶來了巨大的嚴峻挑戰。

examples.en: Agricultural scientists study the genetic variability within wild wheat varieties to breed drought-tolerant crops.
examples.zh: 農業遺傳科學家深入研究野生小麥原生種內部豐富的基因遺傳變異性，以培育出耐乾旱極端氣候的優質新品種。

entries.definition: 心率變異度 (HRV 自律神經指標)；變化性；可在交響樂、歌劇與演講間自由切換之可變聲學彈性

explains.en: It is the amount of change or difference in something. In heart measurements, changes between beats can show how the body is recovering. Fitness watches may track it.
A number or result that shifts over time has this quality. Heart measurements can help athletes decide whether to rest. Stress may lower the reading.
This noun describes how much something varies. It can refer to heart rhythms or differences in a set of data. Context shows what is changing.

examples.en: Establishing a 60-minute evening wind-down routine signals your brain to transition into rest.
examples.zh: 每晚固定建立一小時關閉工作群組、調暗燈光的「睡前放鬆儀式」，能明確提醒大腦準備進入睡眠。

examples.en: Reading paper books under warm amber light serves as a wonderful wind-down ritual.
examples.zh: 坐在暖黃色檯燈下安靜閱讀紙本書籍三十分鐘，是一段無比愜意且能迅速沉澱思緒的睡前舒壓儀式。

examples.en: Turning off all work notifications at 9 PM creates necessary mental space for evening wind-down.
examples.zh: 每晚九點準時關閉手機所有公司公務群組推播通知，為自己保留一段不受打擾的睡前放鬆時光。

entries.definition: 睡前放鬆儀式；逐漸冷靜放鬆

explains.en: A quiet evening routine helps the body prepare for rest. Reading a paper book under soft light can be calming.
Turn off work notifications and take a few slow breaths after a busy day. Give yourself time to relax.
A family may speak softly and play gentle music before bedtime. This gradual shift helps people settle.

examples.en: Thick triple-weave blackout curtains block nocturnal streetlight glare to create pitch-black conditions.
examples.zh: 臥室裝設厚實的三層織造全遮光防光窗簾，能徹底阻絕窗外刺眼都會路燈強光，營造極致純黑環境。

examples.en: Hotel rooms with high-grade blackout shades help travelers combat jet lag across foreign time zones.
examples.zh: 配備全遮光防漏光百葉窗簾的頂級飯店客房，能幫助跨國商務旅客在白天安穩補眠、快速克服時差。

examples.en: Even a sliver of light peeking through blackout blinds can disturb light-sensitive sleepers.
examples.zh: 即便只是從遮光窗簾縫隙中透進來的微弱路燈亮光，也足以干擾對光線極度敏感的淺眠體質者。

explains.en: Thick curtains can block streetlights so a bedroom becomes very dark. Hotels may use them for sleeping.
A storm can cause a citywide loss of electricity. Keep a flashlight ready for this event.
The word can mean heavy window covers or a sudden loss of power. The context tells which meaning is intended.

examples.en: Soft silicone earplugs muffle loud neighbors and distant ambulance sirens throughout the night.
examples.zh: 配戴柔軟舒適的食品級矽膠慢回彈隔音耳塞，能安靜過濾隔壁鄰居走動聲與遠處深夜救護車呼嘯。

examples.en: Travelers carry high-attenuation foam earplugs inside carry-on luggage for quiet red-eye flights.
examples.zh: 經常長途飛行的商務旅客總會在隨身行李中準備高降噪係數海綿耳塞，以便在紅眼航班上安靜休息。

examples.en: Roll the tapered earplug tightly between your fingers before inserting it deep into the ear canal.
examples.zh: 在將子彈型慢回彈耳塞推入耳道前，先以手指將其均勻搓細成圓柱狀，以利耳塞在耳道內完美膨脹貼合。

explains.en: A small soft piece fits into the ear to lower noise. People may use it while sleeping or swimming. It should be clean before use.
The hotel room faced a busy street, so Jo used soft inserts. Traffic sounded quieter. She slept through the night.
Some kinds are made of foam and others of silicone. They come in different sizes. Follow the package directions for safe use.

examples.en: A white noise machine playing soothing steady ocean wave sounds masks sudden disruptive noises.
examples.zh: 播放柔和平穩天然海浪拍岸聲的「白噪音助眠機」，能巧妙遮蔽外界突如其來的尖銳干擾雜音。

examples.en: Parents frequently use gentle white noise generators to soothe crying infants to sleep in nurseries.
examples.zh: 新手父母經常在嬰兒房內放置溫和的白噪音播放器，以安撫啼哭的初生寶寶順暢滑入甜美夢鄉。

examples.en: The gentle hum of a bedroom air purifier serves as natural white noise that promotes steady slumber.
examples.zh: 臥室角落空氣清淨機低速運轉時發出的均勻平穩微弱低鳴，正是極具安神舒眠效果的天然白噪音。

entries.definition: 白噪音（平穩均勻環境背景音）

explains.en: It is a steady sound containing many pitches that can mask sudden noises. A machine may help a baby sleep. A purifier's hum can have a similar effect.
A continuous even sound can cover traffic or voices. People sometimes play it at bedtime. It can help some listeners focus.
This constant background sound may make a room feel quieter by hiding sharper noises. Some devices produce it. It can also help people study.

examples.en: The optimal bedroom temperature for deep uninterrupted sleep is between 18°C and 20°C.
examples.zh: 科學研究證實，最有利於人體進入不間斷深層睡眠的臥室黃金最佳室溫介於攝氏十八至二十度之間。

examples.en: Maintaining an optimal sleeping posture prevents excessive compression on spinal nerves.
examples.zh: 保持端正且符合人體工學的最佳自然睡姿，能有效預防整夜壓迫頸部脊神經引起的肩頸僵硬發麻。

examples.en: Finding the optimal balance between mattress firmness and plush comfort ensures pain-free mornings.
examples.zh: 在床墊的堅實支撐力與表層雲端包覆感之間取得最佳平衡，是確保清晨醒來告別腰痠背痛的秘訣。

entries.definition: 最理想黃金最佳的；最佳條件

explains.en: A dark, quiet bedroom helps many people sleep well, but comfort needs can differ. Choose what works for you.
A plant grows best when it gets suitable light, water, and soil. The right conditions depend on the plant.
There may be a best setting for a task, such as a comfortable room temperature. It depends on the purpose and person.

examples.en: Diffusing French lavender aromatherapy oil before bed calms racing thoughts and lowers pulse rates.
examples.zh: 睡前在水氧機中滴入純天然法國真正薰衣草精油進行芳香療法，能有效平復繁雜思緒並減緩心跳。

examples.en: Clinical studies demonstrate that sweet orange aromatherapy reduces dental procedure anxiety in patients.
examples.zh: 臨床醫學研究證實，在候診室擴香甜橙天然精油芳療，能顯著降低病患看牙醫前緊繃的焦慮情緒。

examples.en: Incorporating soothing aromatherapy into your nightly bath creates a luxurious home spa retreat.
examples.zh: 將純淨植萃精油芳療融入睡前溫水泡澡時光，能瞬間在自家浴室打造出頂級沙龍級的居家 Spa 享受。

explains.en: A person may breathe in lavender oil before bed to feel calmer. This wellness practice uses pleasant scents.
Some clinics use sweet orange oil to help patients feel less worried. The scent may make a bath feel relaxing.
Essential oils are used for their smell during a massage or bath. Choose a safe product and follow its instructions.

examples.en: Sipping warm decaf chamomile tea with honey promotes muscle relaxation before turning in.
examples.zh: 睡前慢啜一杯熱騰騰、無咖啡因且添加微量純蜂蜜的德國洋甘菊茶，能促進全身緊繃肌肉舒展放鬆。

examples.en: Dried chamomile blossoms contain apigenin, an antioxidant that binds to brain receptors to induce sleepiness.
examples.zh: 乾燥洋甘菊小花富含天然芹菜素抗氧化物，能與大腦受體結合發揮安神鎮定、催生自然睡意的功效。

examples.en: Keep a canister of organic chamomile tea bags on your nightstand for stress-filled workdays.
examples.zh: 在床頭櫃常備一罐無農藥殘留的有機洋甘菊茶包，隨時為高壓緊繃的忙碌工作日撫平神經。

entries.definition: 德國洋甘菊草本茶；洋甘菊

explains.en: This plant has small flowers with pale petals and yellow centers. Its dried flowers are often used to make an herbal drink. Some people enjoy it before bed.
Grandma poured warm water over dried blossoms. She let the drink steep, then added honey. The kitchen smelled sweet.
The plant can also grow in a garden. Bees visit its flowers in warm weather. People dry them for tea or decoration.

examples.en: Taking bioavailable magnesium glycinate before bed alleviates nighttime leg cramps and restlessness.
examples.zh: 睡前補充吸收率極高的高純度甘胺酸鎂（Magnesium），能顯著改善夜間小腿抽筋並平撫神經焦躁。

examples.en: Dark chocolate and roasted pumpkin seeds are excellent dietary sources of elemental magnesium.
examples.zh: 苦甜黑巧克力與天然烘烤南瓜籽，皆是日常飲食中攝取豐富天然礦物質鎂元素的絕佳原型食材。

examples.en: Magnesium regulates neurotransmitters that calm the central nervous system after intense workouts.
examples.zh: 礦物質鎂能有效調節大腦神經傳導物質，幫助高強度重訓健身後的交感神經快速冷靜放鬆。

entries.definition: 礦物質甘胺酸鎂（放鬆神經助眠）

explains.en: It is a mineral needed by the body for muscles and nerves to work. Pumpkin seeds and dark chocolate contain it. Supplements should be discussed with a doctor.
People get this mineral from foods such as nuts and leafy greens. It supports many body processes. Too much from supplements can be harmful.
This nutrient helps the body regulate muscles and nerve signals. Some people take a supplement, but food is a good source. Ask a health professional first.

examples.en: Contoured memory foam cradles shoulders and hips, relieving pressure points across the body.
examples.zh: 緊密貼合身形的太空慢回彈記憶棉能溫柔包覆肩部與臀部，均勻釋放沉積在全身骨骼各處的壓力點。

examples.en: Gel-infused memory foam dissipates excess body heat to keep sleepers pleasantly cool all night.
examples.zh: 注入水冷凝膠微粒的清涼記憶棉能及時導散人體多餘體熱，讓燥熱體質者整夜維持乾爽舒適不悶熱。

examples.en: Memory foam pillows adapt slowly to the weight of your head, easing chronic tension headaches.
examples.zh: 慢回彈太空記憶枕能感應人體頭頸部重量緩慢下沉貼合，顯著舒緩因睡姿不良引發的慢性頸源性頭痛。

explains.en: A soft material slowly changes shape to match the weight of a person’s head or shoulders. It returns to shape after the person gets up.
A pillow made from this material may support the neck. People have different comfort needs.
Some mattresses use a slow-response foam that molds around the body. A cool room can help if the material feels warm.

examples.en: Eco-friendly natural latex mattresses offer bouncy orthopedic support and natural dust-mite resistance.
examples.zh: 採用天然橡樹汁液製成的純天然乳膠床墊具備高回彈支撐力，且天生具備防蟎抗菌透氣的優異特性。

examples.en: Harvested sustainably from rubber tree sap, natural latex is biodegradable and free of chemical off-gassing.
examples.zh: 自天然橡膠樹樹皮永續割取的純天然乳膠可自然生物降解，絕無化學合成泡棉刺鼻的有毒揮發氣體。

examples.en: Pin-core ventilation holes molded throughout the latex layer provide continuous airflow during warm nights.
examples.zh: 乳膠床墊內部在發泡模具上一體成型佈滿數萬個立體透氣微孔，即便在潮濕悶熱的夏夜也能保持通風對流。

explains.en: This natural material comes from rubber tree sap. It can be used to make a soft mattress.
Some people may be allergic to this stretchy rubber material. It is used in gloves and other products.
A mattress made from this plant material can feel springy. Its tiny holes help air move through it.

examples.en: Orthopedic doctors recommend medium-firm mattress firmness to prevent spinal misalignment.
examples.zh: 骨科專業醫師一致推薦選購軟硬適中（Medium-Firm）的堅挺床墊，以防止睡眠時脊椎過度下陷變形。

examples.en: The showroom label indicates a firmness rating of seven out of ten, suitable for stomach sleepers.
examples.zh: 門市展示架上的規格吊牌標註此款床墊軟硬度為偏硬的七級，非常適合習慣趴睡與仰睡的族群。

examples.en: Adding a plush feather topper softens excessive mattress firmness without sacrificing core support.
examples.zh: 在過硬的木板或彈簧床墊上加鋪一層厚實的羽絨薄墊，能在不犧牲底層支撐力下增添雲端般軟綿觸感。

explains.en: How hard or soft a mattress feels can affect comfort. Some people prefer a soft surface, while others need more support. Trying it can help someone choose.
At the store, Dad pressed each bed with his hand. He chose one that felt supportive but comfortable. The family arranged delivery.
The word can also mean being steady and strong in how someone acts. A calm, clear voice may show resolve. Context tells which meaning is intended.

examples.en: An adjustable cervical support pillow maintains the neck's natural C-curve lordosis.
examples.zh: 具備高度調節機能的人體工學頸椎枕能完美填補頸部懸空凹陷，長久維護頸椎自然的健康 C 型弧度。

examples.en: Chronic cervical spine stiffness often stems from slouching over smartphones throughout the day.
examples.zh: 現代人長期的慢性頸椎僵硬痠痛，往往源自於白天長時間低頭滑手機所造成的嚴重骨骼重壓負荷。

examples.en: The ergonomic groove in the cervical pillow cradles the skull while gently stretching tight neck muscles.
examples.zh: 頸椎人體工學枕中央微凹的下陷凹槽能穩固包覆頭顱，同時在側邊隆起處輕柔延展牽引緊繃頸肌。

entries.definition: 頸椎人體工學的；子宮頸的

explains.en: It relates to the neck or to the lower part of the uterus. A supportive pillow may help keep the neck comfortable. A doctor may use the term for a health check.
This adjective can describe bones in the neck or a part of the reproductive system. Context shows which meaning is intended. Medical advice can clarify it.
A product label may use this word for neck support. In medicine, it can also relate to the cervix. The meanings are different.

examples.en: 100% long-staple Egyptian cotton sheets become softer and silkier with every laundry wash.
examples.zh: 百分之百頂級埃及長絨棉床包被套透氣吸汗，且隨著每一次水洗觸感愈發絲滑柔軟如奶油般親膚。

examples.en: Hand-harvested along the Nile River, genuine Egyptian cotton boasts extra-long fibers of unmatched durability.
examples.zh: 沿著尼羅河畔全人工細心採摘的正宗埃及長絨棉，以其超長纖維韌性與歷久彌新的耐磨度享譽全球。

examples.en: Luxury five-star resorts dress guest suites exclusively in crisp, breathable Egyptian cotton duvet covers.
examples.zh: 頂級五星級奢華渡假酒店全館套房指定採用潔白如雪、透氣親膚的頂級埃及棉被套招待貴賓。

entries.definition: 頂級埃及長絨棉的；埃及人

explains.en: A warm-weather crop produces cotton with especially long fibers. The fabric can be soft and durable.
A hotel may use bedding made from this premium long-staple cotton. Check the label for its origin.
This cotton is named for a country along the Nile and is known for its long fibers. It is often used in luxury sheets.

examples.en: Luxurious 600 thread-count sateen weave sheets offer a cool, silky drape against bare skin.
examples.zh: 高達六百織紗支密度（600TC）的奢華貢緞緞紋織造被單，為肌膚帶來冰涼如絲的極致親膚垂墜感。

examples.en: Don't be fooled by inflated thread count numbers; fiber quality and weave technique matter far more.
examples.zh: 切勿盲目被不肖廠商標榜破千的虛標織紗支數迷惑；棉紗纖維品質與精湛紡織工藝才是好壞關鍵。

examples.en: A 400 thread-count percale sheet provides a crisp, hotel-crisp feel ideal for hot summer evenings.
examples.zh: 四百織紗支密度（400TC）的平紋精梳棉床單具備爽脆挺括的五星飯店質感，極度適合悶熱夏季。

explains.en: This number tells how many threads are woven into a square inch of a sheet. The material also matters.
A high number does not always mean the cloth feels better. The fiber and weave can be more important.
Cotton sheets may feel crisp or silky depending on how they are woven. This number describes their thread density.

examples.en: Silky 100-count Tencel lyocell bedding naturally wicks moisture, keeping hot sleepers blissfully cool.
examples.zh: 採用奧地利蘭精一百支頂級天絲（Tencel）製成的絲滑寢具吸濕導熱極快，讓體質燥熱者整夜清爽不悶汗。

examples.en: Sourced sustainably from eucalyptus wood pulp, Tencel fibers are celebrated for their eco-friendly footprint.
examples.zh: 萃取自永續管理尤加利樹桉樹木漿纖維的蘭精天絲，以其對大自然極度友善的閉環環保製程備受讚譽。

examples.en: The cool-to-the-touch sensation of Tencel pillowcases prevents friction frizz across curly hairstyles.
examples.zh: 頂級天絲枕頭套宛如絲綢般冰涼柔順的親膚觸感，能大幅減少翻身摩擦，預防晨起捲髮毛躁打結。

explains.en: This brand name is used for a fabric fiber made from wood pulp. The cloth often feels smooth and soft. It is used in clothes and bedding.
Maya chose a cool, soft shirt for a warm day. The fabric felt gentle against her skin. She checked the label before washing it.
Care instructions depend on how the cloth is made. Some items need a gentle wash. Read the tag to help them last.

examples.en: A plush Hungarian goose down duvet provides cloud-like loft and breathable winter warmth.
examples.zh: 一床輕盈蓬鬆的頂級匈牙利白鵝絨羽絨被（Duvet）宛如躺在雲朵裡，提供透氣不壓身的冬日溫暖。

examples.en: She shook and fluffed the lightweight duvet each morning to restore its airy insulating volume.
examples.zh: 每天早晨起床後隨手輕輕抖動拍鬆輕盈的羽絨被胎，能讓被內空氣充分流通並重現蓬鬆保暖立體感。

examples.en: Baffle-box construction inside the duvet prevents feathered down clusters from shifting to the edges.
examples.zh: 羽絨被內部精密的立體車格「立體立襯棋盤格結構」（Baffle-box），能徹底防止內部絨朵滑動位移。

explains.en: It is a soft, thick bed covering filled with feathers or another insulating material. It keeps someone warm at night. Shake it to fluff it up.
This bedding is often lighter than several blankets but still warm. Its filling stays inside stitched sections. It can be placed inside a removable cover.
A person may pull this warm covering over them while sleeping. Down provides light insulation. Box-shaped stitching can keep the filling in place.

examples.en: A 15-pound weighted blanket uses deep pressure stimulation to soothe nervous system anxiety.
examples.zh: 重達七公斤的微重力舒壓毯透過「深層觸壓安撫刺激」（DPS），如溫柔擁抱般安撫緊繃焦慮神經。

examples.en: The heavy glass microbeads sewn inside the weighted quilt distribute comforting weight uniformly.
examples.zh: 均勻縫合密封在重力被內部成千上萬顆的無毒微細玻璃珠，能將沉穩扎實的包覆重力均勻分散全身。

examples.en: Occupational therapists recommend choosing a weighted blanket approximately ten percent of your body weight.
examples.zh: 職能治療師建議選購重力毯時，應以約佔個人總體重百分之十左右的黃金重量作為最佳適配標準。

explains.en: A blanket filled with small beads feels heavier than an ordinary one. Ask a health professional whether it is suitable for you.
A gym exercise may use a vest with added weight. Choose equipment that fits and can be used safely.
This kind of blanket should be chosen with care, especially for children or people with health concerns. Consult a qualified professional.

examples.en: Because caffeine has a 6-hour half-life, avoid espresso shots after 2 PM for undisturbed slumber.
examples.zh: 由於咖啡因在人體內的代謝半衰期長達六至八小時，下午兩點後切勿飲用濃縮咖啡以防深夜數羊。

examples.en: Pharmacists explain medication half-life to help patients time their doses accurately.
examples.zh: 專業藥師向慢性病患者詳盡解說各類口服處方藥的體內代謝半衰期，以協助精準掌握服藥間隔時間。

examples.en: The long elimination half-life of sleeping pills can cause residual daytime drowsiness and sluggishness.
examples.zh: 長效型安眠藥物由於在體內的代謝半衰期極長，容易在隔天清晨留下昏沉遲鈍、反應變慢的宿醉感。

entries.definition: 咖啡因半衰期 (約6至8小時)

explains.en: Caffeine remains in the body for hours, so late coffee can affect sleep. This term describes the time for half of a substance to leave.
A pharmacist may explain how quickly medicine leaves the body. Take each dose at the correct time.
After several hours, about half of a substance may be gone. This measure helps people understand how long it can act.

examples.en: Waking from deep Stage 4 sleep triggers severe sleep inertia, leaving you disoriented for hours.
examples.zh: 若在深層慢波睡眠中被刺耳鬧鐘強行吵醒，會引發嚴重的「睡眠慣性昏沉感」（Sleep Inertia），久久無法清醒。

examples.en: Splashing cold water on your face and drinking a glass of water helps shake off morning sleep inertia.
examples.zh: 早晨醒來用冰涼清水潑臉並慢啜一大杯溫開水，能迅速喚醒全身神經系統、驅散早起的睡眠慣性。

examples.en: Sleep inertia diminishes rapidly once natural morning sunlight strikes the retina and shuts down melatonin.
examples.zh: 當清晨自然陽光穿透視網膜進入大腦並關閉褪黑激素分泌時，惱人的睡眠昏沉遲鈍感便會迅速消退。

entries.definition: 睡醒昏沉遲鈍感 (Sleep Inertia)；慣性

explains.en: A person may feel slow and foggy for a short time after waking from deep sleep. It can take a while to feel alert. Light and movement may help.
When Sam’s alarm rang, he sat up but still felt sleepy. He opened the curtains and drank water. Soon he was ready for breakfast.
In science, an object tends to keep resting or moving unless a force changes it. A ball stays still until someone pushes it. This tendency is a basic idea in physics.

examples.en: Understanding your biological chronotype reveals whether you thrive as a morning lark or night owl.
examples.zh: 深入了解個人天生的生理時鐘型態（Chronotype），能明白自己是精力充沛的晨型百靈鳥還是夜貓子。

examples.en: Flexible workplace schedules accommodate diverse employee chronotypes to optimize productivity.
examples.zh: 採取彈性彈性上下班工時制度，能充分體恤並順應各類員工天生的作息型態，極大化日常工作產能。

examples.en: Genetic factors heavily influence your individual chronotype, dictating peak focus hours throughout the day.
examples.zh: 先天的基因遺傳基因深刻決定了每個人獨一無二的生理時鐘型態，並主宰著一天中專注力巔峰時刻。

entries.definition: 個人天生生理時鐘型態 (早起鳥/夜貓)

explains.en: It is a person's natural pattern of feeling alert or sleepy at different times of day. Some people wake early, while others focus better at night. Genes can influence it.
Someone may be a morning person or a night owl. This personal rhythm can shape when they work best. Flexible schedules can suit different people.
This term describes when a person naturally prefers to sleep and be active. It differs from person to person. Light and habits can affect it too.

examples.en: Waking up naturally without an alarm leaves you feeling remarkably rested, energized, and refreshed.
examples.zh: 伴隨著自然晨光自然甦醒、無需鬧鐘驚嚇，會讓人感到全身體力充沛、神清氣爽且容光煥發。

examples.en: A brisk morning stroll through the dew-drenched botanical garden left her refreshed and optimistic.
examples.zh: 清晨在掛滿晶瑩晨露的植物園林蔭步道間漫步深呼吸，讓她感到通體舒暢、神清氣爽且滿懷希望。

examples.en: The weekend camping trip in the cedar forest allowed the tired developers to return feeling completely refreshed.
examples.zh: 在鬱鬱蔥蔥的紅檜森林中度過兩天一夜的野營時光，讓平日疲憊不堪的工程師全員煥然一新重獲新生。

entries.definition: 睡醒精神充沛神清氣爽的

explains.en: After a good night’s sleep, a person may wake with more energy and a clear mind. A calm walk can also feel restorative.
A weekend outdoors helps tired workers return to their tasks feeling rested. A break may improve their mood.
She drinks water and rests after a long hike, then feels alert again. The word describes feeling renewed.

examples.en: Eight hours of restorative sleep allows the brain's glymphatic system to flush away toxic metabolic proteins.
examples.zh: 每夜享有八小時高質量的深度修復性睡眠，能啟動大腦膠狀淋巴排毒系統，洗滌清除整天累積的代謝廢物。

examples.en: The spa resort specializes in restorative mineral spring therapy designed to relieve chronic muscle fatigue.
examples.zh: 這處溫泉養生度假村專精於推行深層修復性碳酸氫鈉泉水療課程，專門瓦解現代人深層慢性肌群疲憊。

examples.en: Disconnecting completely from digital devices over the weekend provides deeply restorative mental recovery.
examples.zh: 週末期間徹底關閉所有手機筆電展開數位排毒斷捨離，能為枯竭的心靈帶來深層而療癒的身心修復。

entries.definition: 深度修復性的；促進復原的

explains.en: A good night's sleep can help the brain and body recover. This describes something that renews energy.
A mineral spring treatment may ease tired muscles. A weekend away from screens can help a person feel refreshed.
This adjective describes rest or care that helps someone regain strength. It can apply to sleep, food, or a break.

examples.en: Uninterrupted nocturnal sleep is nature's most potent elixir for cellular repair and physical rejuvenation.
examples.zh: 毫無中斷的夜夜好眠是大自然賜予人體最神奇的天然補藥，能促進細胞全面修復並重煥年輕朝氣。

examples.en: The herbal bath infusion stimulates microcirculation, leaving the weary skin glowing with youth and rejuvenation.
examples.zh: 含有艾草與生薑的草本漢方泡澡藥浴能溫熱刺激末梢微循環，讓暗沉疲憊的肌膚重拾紅潤青春生機。

examples.en: Coastal wellness retreats emphasize physical detoxification and holistic emotional rejuvenation.
examples.zh: 坐落於東海岸的自然養生靜修中心，著重於透過原型飲食進行深層排毒，達到全方位的身心活力回春。

entries.definition: 身心修復煥發青春活力；回春

explains.en: Rest or care that makes someone feel fresh and energetic again can help after a tiring week. People may relax outdoors or enjoy a quiet activity. The effect can be renewing.
After a long walk, Aunt May rested in the garden. She drank water and listened to birds. She felt ready to continue her day.
A worn place can also be improved so it feels lively again. New trees and repaired paths can help. Neighbors may enjoy using the area.

examples.en: Cool dim ambient lighting creates a tranquil bedroom atmosphere conducive to effortless dreaming.
examples.zh: 冰涼安靜、微光昏暗的臥室營造出無比祥和寧靜的舒眠氛圍，引導身心不知不覺悄然滑入甜美夢鄉。

examples.en: We spent a tranquil afternoon canoeing along the still waters of Sun Moon Lake at sunrise.
examples.zh: 清晨在日月潭如鏡面般無波的平靜湖面上划著獨木舟，我們享受了一段與世隔絕、空靈靜謐的午後光景。

examples.en: The courtyard garden features a trickling stone fountain that fosters a tranquil meditative sanctuary.
examples.zh: 傳統日式庭園中竹筒水缽水滴輕敲石頭的清脆流水聲，營造出一處沉澱心緒、純粹超凡的冥想淨土。

entries.definition: 寧靜沉靜祥和的；平靜的

explains.en: It describes a place or feeling that is calm and peaceful. Soft lighting can make a bedroom restful. A still lake may have this quality.
A person can enjoy a quiet afternoon in a canoe on calm water. A garden fountain may create a soothing atmosphere. The adjective means peaceful.
Use this word for a place with little noise or disturbance. A dim room may help someone relax. It can also describe a calm state of mind.

examples.en: The exhausted mountaineer sank into deep, undisturbed slumber inside the cozy alpine cabin.
examples.zh: 跋涉整天的登山客換上乾爽衣服，在溫暖避難山屋的羽絨睡袋中沉沉陷入了無比安詳的深層長眠。

examples.en: Soft lullabies playing in the quiet room gently coaxed the restless toddler into peaceful slumber.
examples.zh: 靜謐臥室中輕柔流淌的古典搖籃曲旋律，溫柔安撫著原本哭鬧不休的幼兒緩緩進入甜美無憂的夢鄉。

examples.en: Shielding your eyes with a padded silk eye mask guarantees dark, uninterrupted slumber until dawn.
examples.zh: 睡前戴上一副透氣遮光的頂級純蠶絲加厚眼罩，能確保雙眼沉浸在純黑寧靜中一路安睡直至破曉天明。

entries.definition: 安詳恬靜的深沉睡眠；安睡

explains.en: After a long hike, the climber sleeps deeply in a quiet cabin. Soft music helps a toddler settle for the night.
A person rests peacefully through the dark hours without waking often. A comfortable, quiet room can help.
The child closes their eyes and drifts into a gentle sleep. The word can also describe sleeping.

examples.en: Cutting-edge research vessels utilize satellite oceanography to map dynamic Kuroshio current eddies.
examples.zh: 頂尖海洋研究船運用高階衛星海洋學測繪技術，精準分析黑潮暖流沿台灣東岸北上的動態渦流。

examples.en: She pursued a doctorate in chemical oceanography to study ocean acidification and carbon sequestration.
examples.zh: 她攻讀化學海洋學博士學位，專門投入海洋酸化機制與大洋深層碳封存潛力的前沿科學研究。

examples.en: Advances in robotic oceanography allow scientists to collect deep-sea temperature profiles year-round.
examples.zh: 自主水下機器人海洋探勘技術的突破，使科學家得以全天候終年不間斷監測深海海溫與鹽度剖面。

examples.en: Modern physical oceanography investigates deep ocean current conveyer belts regulating global climate systems.
examples.zh: 現代物理海洋學致力研究深海溫鹽環流輸送帶，揭示其如何深刻調節全球氣候。

examples.en: Studying biological oceanography reveals how marine carbon sinks trap atmospheric greenhouse gases.
examples.zh: 鑽研生物海洋學的學術成果，能揭開深海生物碳幫浦如何將大氣中的溫室氣體長年封存於萬米海底。

examples.en: She pursued a doctoral degree in chemical oceanography to analyze deep abyssal water chemistry.
examples.zh: 她毅然攻讀化學海洋學博士學位，全心投入分析太平洋萬米深淵底層水體的化學組成與同位素。

entries.definition: 海洋學；海洋科技探勘；物理化學生物深海海洋科學

explains.en: Scientists study currents, sea life, and the chemistry of the ocean. Research boats collect information.
Some researchers learn how ocean water stores carbon. This field can help explain climate.
Robots can gather deep-sea temperatures throughout the year. This science studies the ocean and its parts.

examples.en: Earning a PADI Open Water scuba certification unlocks breathtaking underwater coral kingdoms.
examples.zh: 考取國際 PADI 開放水域水肺潛水證照，能讓潛水員自由徜徉於五彩斑斕的夢幻水下珊瑚王國。

examples.en: Check your scuba cylinder pressure gauge regularly before descending into deeper ocean trenches.
examples.zh: 在向更深的海底大斷層下潛前，務必隨時低頭檢視隨身水肺氣瓶的殘壓表指針確認氣量。

examples.en: Scuba enthusiasts from around the world flock to Green Island for its pristine undersea volcanic formations.
examples.zh: 來自世界各地的水肺潛水狂熱者紛紛湧向綠島，親身探索清澈透亮的海底火山岩柱與大教堂景觀。

examples.en: Equipped with full-face communication scuba gear, divers speak live to excited audiences during feeding shows.
examples.zh: 配備全罩式水下無線通話「水肺裝備」（Scuba Gear），潛水員在餵食秀現場能即時與玻璃窗外的觀眾生動對話。

examples.en: Earning her international open-water scuba certification opened up a vibrant underwater world of discovery.
examples.zh: 順利考取國際開放水域水肺潛水證照，為喜愛海洋的女孩打開了一扇探索繽紛水下世界的夢想大門。

examples.en: Pre-dive checks verify that scuba regulator hoses and air pressure gauges are functioning safely.
examples.zh: 每次潛水前嚴格的裝備雙重檢查，確保水肺調節器呼吸管線與殘壓表皆處於百分之百正常運作狀態。

entries.definition: 水肺潛水 (SCUBA)；水下自攜氣瓶；搭載全罩式面罩水下無線通話水肺裝備

explains.en: A person can swim underwater using a tank of breathing gas and special equipment. Training teaches safe ways to dive. Divers explore reefs and shipwrecks.
On vacation, Sam took a beginner lesson in a pool. The instructor showed him how to check the gear. He practiced breathing slowly underwater.
A mask helps a diver see clearly, and fins help with movement. A partner stays nearby during a dive. Safety rules must be followed.

examples.en: The first-stage regulator reduces 200-bar high cylinder pressure into smooth, breathable air.
examples.zh: 專業一級頭調節器能將氣瓶內高達兩百巴的高壓壓縮空氣，精準調節為人體輕鬆呼吸的常壓氣流。

examples.en: Rinse your dive regulator thoroughly with fresh tap water after every salty ocean excursion.
examples.zh: 每次完成海水潛水上岸後，切記務必使用乾淨自來水徹底沖洗呼吸調節器上的殘留海鹽結晶。

examples.en: The technician inspected the secondary backup regulator to ensure it supplies effortless airflow in emergencies.
examples.zh: 專業裝備技師仔細檢測備用二級頭調節器（章魚頭），確保在深水緊急狀況下能瞬間順暢供氣。

entries.definition: 潛水呼吸調節器；調節閥

explains.en: It is a diving device that reduces air pressure from a tank so a diver can breathe safely. Rinse it with fresh water after a sea dive. Check it before use.
A scuba diver uses this equipment to receive breathable air underwater. A backup unit provides extra safety. A technician should inspect it.
This valve controls the flow and pressure of air from a diving tank. It lets a diver breathe. Rinse it after salt water and maintain it regularly.

examples.en: Mastering neutral buoyancy allows divers to hover effortlessly without damaging fragile coral branches.
examples.zh: 熟練掌握完美的水下中性浮力，能讓潛水員如太空人般靜止懸浮於水中，完全不觸碰脆弱珊瑚。

examples.en: Inflating the buoyancy compensator vest brings you safely and smoothly back to the ocean surface.
examples.zh: 輕按充氣閥向浮力調整背心（BCD）微量充氣，能讓潛水員平穩省力地緩緩上升回到海面上。

examples.en: Fine adjustments using gentle lung breath control provide instantaneous trim and vertical buoyancy.
examples.zh: 透過肺部呼吸深淺吐納的細膩微調，能在水中達到瞬間精準的姿態平衡與垂直微浮力控制。

examples.en: Syntactic foam provides positive buoyancy without compressing under tens of thousands of pounds of pressure.
examples.zh: 微型玻璃空心微珠複合固態浮力材料，在數萬磅極限重壓下依然不變形並提供穩定浮力。

examples.en: Releasing steel descent weights creates net positive buoyancy, allowing the submersible to float home.
examples.zh: 拋棄底部配重鐵塊能產生淨正浮力，使深潛器在無需引擎推進的情況下自然緩慢浮回海面。

examples.en: Careful buoyancy trimming ensures the underwater robot stays neutrally suspended in the water column.
examples.zh: 精細的浮力配平調校，能確保水下機器人在特定深度水層中保持中性懸浮而不上浮下沉。

entries.definition: 浮力；水下中性浮力 (Neutral Buoyancy)；耐萬米水壓之微珠複合固態浮力材料

explains.en: A swimmer floats more easily when air is trapped in a life vest. A diver adjusts equipment to stay at a chosen depth.
A sealed foam material can help an underwater vehicle stay afloat. Its density and the water around it matter.
This force from water helps an object float or rise. Divers carefully control their position underwater.

examples.en: A 3mm thermal neoprene wetsuit keeps divers warm and protected in subtropical waters.
examples.zh: 穿著一件三毫米厚度的彈性氯丁橡膠潛水防寒衣，在亞熱帶海水中能提供絕佳保暖防寒與防刮防護。

examples.en: Flexible neoprene dive booties shield your feet from sharp volcanic basalt and spiky sea urchins.
examples.zh: 質地厚實耐磨的氯丁橡膠防滑潛水膠鞋，能完美保護腳掌免受鋒利火山玄武岩與尖銳海膽刺傷。

examples.en: Over time, prolonged sun exposure can cause natural synthetic neoprene to lose its elasticity.
examples.zh: 長期置於烈日高溫曝曬下，會使合成氯丁橡膠材質老化硬化，並逐漸失去原有的柔韌彈性。

entries.definition: 氯丁橡膠潛水防寒衣料；合成橡膠

explains.en: This flexible synthetic rubber can make a wetsuit keep divers warm. It also protects their feet from rocks.
Long exposure to sunlight can make this material lose its stretch. It is often used for diving clothes.
Boots made from this material protect the feet near sharp volcanic rocks. The rubber stays flexible in water.

examples.en: Always conduct a 3-minute safety stop at 5 meters to prevent dangerous decompression sickness.
examples.zh: 上升回水面前務必在水深五米處進行三分鐘「安全停留」，讓體內氮氣安全排出以防減壓病。

examples.en: The modern dive computer calculates real-time no-decompression limits based on depth and bottom time.
examples.zh: 當代高階腕式潛水電腦錶能依據即時水深與水底停留時間，精準演算免減壓極限倒數計時。

examples.en: Severe decompression injury requires immediate evacuation to an onshore hyperbaric medical facility.
examples.zh: 嚴重的急性減壓病傷害，必須第一時間緊急後送至陸上醫學中心的專業高壓氧艙進行加壓救治。

entries.definition: 潛水減壓；減壓病 (潛水夫病)

explains.en: When a diver rises from deep water, pressure around the body decreases. A careful ascent gives the body time to adjust. Divers follow a planned schedule.
After the dive, the group rose slowly and paused as instructed. Their guide checked the time and depth. Everyone reached the boat safely.
Rising too quickly can cause a dangerous illness. Divers learn how to reduce this risk before entering the water. A trained partner and working equipment matter.

examples.en: Families rent masks and dry snorkels to observe colorful damselfish in shallow tidal pools.
examples.zh: 爸爸媽媽帶著小朋友租借全乾式呼吸管與面鏡，在清澈的淺灘潮池中興奮觀察游弋的雀鯛。

examples.en: Clear any trapped seawater from your snorkel with a single, sharp exhale of breath.
examples.zh: 當呼吸管管身不慎進水時，只需用力向上短促吐出一口氣，即可瞬間將積水經排水閥排除。

examples.en: Snorkel tours along the calm coast of Kenting are a wonderful introduction to ocean ecology for children.
examples.zh: 沿著墾丁避風海灣展開的休閒浮潛生態導覽，是帶領孩童親近認識浩瀚海洋生態的最佳啟蒙之窗。

explains.en: It is a breathing tube used at the water's surface while a person looks underwater. A mask helps them see fish. Blow sharply to clear trapped water.
Families can use this tube with a mask to watch fish in shallow pools. Keep the top above the water. A guided trip can be a gentle introduction.
A swimmer breathes through this curved tube while floating face down. It lets them observe marine life without scuba equipment. Always follow water safety rules.

examples.en: Elevated seawater temperatures caused by global warming trigger catastrophic coral bleaching events.
examples.zh: 全球暖化引發的夏季海水持續異常高溫，導致墾丁與澎湖海域爆發嚴重的珊瑚大規模白化危機。

examples.en: During intense bleaching, corals expel the symbiotic algae that provide them with vibrant colors and nutrients.
examples.zh: 在劇烈的海水高溫白化過程中，珊瑚蟲會被迫排出提供繽紛色彩與九成光合養分的共生藻。

examples.en: Marine conservation zones showed faster recovery from thermal bleaching compared to heavily fished reefs.
examples.zh: 與過度捕撈的衰退海域相比，管理良好的海洋保育區珊瑚礁在熱浪白化後的自我修復復原速度顯著更快。

examples.en: Keeping chiller water temperatures below twenty-six degrees prevents thermal stress and deadly coral bleaching.
examples.zh: 將冷水機水溫嚴格維持在攝氏二十六度以下，能徹底防止熱壓力引發致命的「珊瑚白化現象」（Bleaching）。

examples.en: Widespread coral bleaching events during hot El Niño summers have decimated reefs across the tropics.
examples.zh: 在炎熱的聖嬰現象夏季所爆發的全球性大規模珊瑚白化事件，已重創了熱帶各大洋的大片珊瑚礁。

examples.en: If water temperatures cool quickly, bleached corals can reacquire algae and recover before starvation sets in.
examples.zh: 若海水溫度能在短時間內迅速回涼，白化的珊瑚有機會重新吸納微藻並在因饑餓死亡前奇蹟康復。

entries.definition: 珊瑚白化危機；漂白；控溫攝氏二十五度嚴格防範高溫珊瑚白化

explains.en: When ocean water stays unusually warm, corals may lose the tiny algae that give them color. The reefs can look pale.
Some corals can recover if conditions improve, but severe heat can harm them. Reducing pollution and protecting reefs may help.
This process makes colorful reefs turn white after corals lose their algae. Climate warming can make it more common.

examples.en: National parks encourage tourists to switch to mineral reef-safe sunscreen to protect marine life.
examples.zh: 國家公園大力倡導遊客下海浮潛時換用不含二苯甲酮的物理性「海洋友善防曬乳」，守護珊瑚礁。

examples.en: Chemical ingredients like oxybenzone in conventional sunscreen disrupt larval coral development.
examples.zh: 傳統化學防曬乳中含有的二苯甲酮與辛氧酸酯成分，會嚴重阻礙珊瑚幼蟲的健康著床與骨骼發育。

examples.en: Generously apply non-nano zinc oxide sunscreen twenty minutes prior to outdoor beach exploration.
examples.zh: 在踏上海灘展開烈日戲水前二十分鐘，均勻塗抹足量的非奈米二氧化鈦物理防曬霜以保護肌膚。

entries.definition: 海洋友善防曬乳；防曬霜

explains.en: Mineral cream can help protect coral and other sea life from the sun. Apply it before going to the beach.
Some chemical ingredients may harm young coral. A reef-friendly product is a safer choice.
Rub this lotion onto your skin before exploring outdoors. Apply it again as the label recommends.

examples.en: Graceful giant manta rays glide like oceanic birds, filtering plankton with wide cephalic fins.
examples.zh: 翼展超過五公尺的溫和巨大鬼蝠魟在水下如大鳥般優雅翱翔滑行，張開頭鰭溫柔濾食微小浮游生物。

examples.en: Encountering a resident manta ray cleaning station is on the bucket list of every globetrotting diver.
examples.zh: 在深海礁石旁親眼目睹鬼蝠魟排隊接受清潔蝦理療的「清潔站」奇觀，是每位國際潛水員的夢幻清單。

examples.en: Unlike stingrays, the harmless manta possesses no poisonous barb along its broad, muscular tail.
examples.zh: 與帶有劇毒尾刺的魟魚截然不同，個性溫馴善良的鬼蝠魟在細長的尾部末端完全沒有毒刺。

explains.en: This very large sea animal has wide, flat fins like wings. It swims through warm oceans. It eats tiny drifting plants and animals.
A diver watched the graceful animal glide above the reef. Small fish swam nearby. The diver kept a respectful distance.
Its broad mouth helps it gather tiny food from the water. It is related to rays. Some people call it a devil ray.

examples.en: Microscopic marine plankton generates over half of the oxygen produced on planet Earth.
examples.zh: 漂浮在浩瀚大洋中的微小海洋浮游生物透過光合作用，供應了地球全人類呼吸所需的半數以上氧氣。

examples.en: Nocturnal plankton bioluminescence makes the breaking waves glow with ethereal turquoise fairy dust.
examples.zh: 夜間微小夜光蟲等浮游生物的受激發光，讓拍擊海岸的碎浪綻放出夢幻如藍眼淚般的青藍色星芒。

examples.en: Changes in ocean temperature directly alter the blooming schedules of primary producer phytoplankton.
examples.zh: 宏觀海洋表層水溫的些微劇變，會直接劇烈打亂海洋食物鏈最底層浮游植物的春季爆發時程。

entries.definition: 海洋浮游生物；微小浮游植物

explains.en: It is a group of tiny organisms that drift in oceans or lakes. Some are plants and some are animals. They are food for many sea creatures.
These small living things float with water currents. Plant-like kinds produce much of Earth's oxygen. Many fish depend on them for food.
A lot of marine life begins with these drifting organisms. Some glow at night. Changes in ocean temperature can affect how many grow.

examples.en: Waving purple sea anemone tentacles provide a safe, immune home for territorial clownfish.
examples.zh: 隨波逐流輕柔搖曳的紫海葵觸手，為不怕其刺絲胞毒素的橘白相間小丑魚提供了最安全的家。

examples.en: Touching a sea anemone barehanded can trigger painful burning rashes due to venomous harpoon cells.
examples.zh: 徒手直接撫摸野生海葵可能引發劇烈灼痛紅腫，因為其觸手表面密布著極具殺傷力的刺絲胞毒素。

examples.en: The mouth of the carnivorous sea anemone sits at the central hub surrounded by undulating rings of tentacles.
examples.zh: 肉食性海葵的口器位於身體中央凹陷處，周圍被數圈如花瓣般不斷擺動捕食的柔軟觸手所環繞。

explains.en: This sea animal has soft, waving tentacles and lives on the ocean floor. Some small fish shelter among them.
A gardener may grow a colorful flower with a similar name. It can brighten a garden bed.
In the sea, a clownfish may live near this animal. Its tentacles can sting other creatures.

examples.en: Underwater photographers love spotting microscopic, brightly colored nudibranchs among sea sponges.
examples.zh: 水下微距攝影愛好者最熱衷在海綿與珊瑚縫隙間尋找色彩瑰麗如寶石般的微小海蛞蝓。

examples.en: Many nudibranch species absorb toxins from poisonous sponges and use them for personal chemical defense.
examples.zh: 許多品類的海蛞蝓能巧妙吸收有毒海綿中的化學毒素，化為自身抵禦掠食性魚類攻擊的強效防衛。

examples.en: The tiny nudibranch navigates the ocean seabed using specialized sensory antennas called rhinophores.
examples.zh: 這隻指甲蓋大小的繽紛海蛞蝓在海床上緩緩爬行，依靠頭部一對特化的嗅角感測周遭水流氣味。

entries.definition: 水下海蛞蝓（海中寶石）；裸鰓類

explains.en: This tiny sea animal has bright colors and lives among sponges. Underwater photographers enjoy finding it.
Some kinds take chemicals from poisonous sponges to protect themselves. They move along the ocean floor.
A small ocean creature uses special feelers to sense its surroundings. Its vivid colors make it look like a jewel.

examples.en: The historic steel shipwreck off Green Island became a thriving artificial reef home to thousands of fish.
examples.zh: 沉睡在綠島外海深處的鋼鐵沉船遺跡已蛻變為生機勃勃的人工魚礁，吸引成千上萬熱帶魚群聚集。

examples.en: Penetrating dark interior corridors inside an intact shipwreck requires advanced technical wreck training.
examples.zh: 想要穿越游入結構完好但漆黑幽閉的沉船內部艙道，必須受過嚴格的高階技術沉船潛水特訓。

examples.en: Marine archaeologists uncovered ancient ceramic cargo within the 300-year-old wooden merchant shipwreck.
examples.zh: 水下文化資產水下考古學家在一艘三百年前沉沒的古木造貿易商船遺址中，發掘出上萬件古董青花瓷。

entries.definition: 水下沉船遺跡；沉船潛水；遭遇海難

explains.en: The remains of a sunken vessel can be explored by divers. Fish may live around it. Visitors must not remove objects.
The old vessel rested on the sea floor. Colorful fish moved through its broken frame. The guide asked divers not to touch it.
A boat can also be destroyed in an accident at sea. The crew may have to leave it. Storms and hidden rocks can cause such events.

examples.en: Powerful dual underwater strobes restore vibrant natural crimson and yellow colors lost at depth.
examples.zh: 配備雙邊高瓦數專業水下閃光燈能瞬間還原深海中被水分子吸收殆盡的艷麗紅色與明亮黃色。

examples.en: Adjust the strobe arms outward to prevent floating particle backscatter from clouding your underwater photo.
examples.zh: 將水下閃燈支臂向兩側斜角展開，能巧妙避開水下懸浮浮游微粒反射強光造成的雜亂雪花回光。

examples.en: High-speed recycling strobes ensure underwater photographers capture lightning-fast predatory moments.
examples.zh: 具備超快回電速度的頂級水下閃光燈，能確保水下生態攝影大師精準定格掠食者電光石火的捕食瞬間。

entries.definition: 水下外接閃光燈；頻閃燈

explains.en: It is a bright light that flashes quickly, often used with a camera. Underwater photographers use it to bring back natural colors. Aim it away from floating particles.
A studio or underwater camera may use this device to add a short burst of light. It can freeze fast movement. Some models recycle quickly between flashes.
This lamp produces very brief, repeated flashes. It can illuminate a dark scene or photograph. In clubs, it may create a moving effect.

examples.en: Kenting's calm south coast boasts exceptional 30-meter visibility, creating crystal-clear water conditions.
examples.zh: 墾丁南灣與後壁湖在避風季節擁有高達三十公尺以上的超清能見度，宛如置身湛藍水晶玻璃水之中。

examples.en: Heavy monsoon rains and agricultural runoff often reduce inshore diving visibility down to five meters.
examples.zh: 盛夏強烈的西南氣流豪雨與泥沙沖刷入海，往往會讓近岸潛點的水下能見度驟降至五米以內。

examples.en: Divers maintain buddy contact by keeping close proximity when horizontal visibility drops in murky harbors.
examples.zh: 當混濁港灣內的水下水平能見度驟降時，潛水同伴間必須縮短彼此間距，始終保持肢體可及的戒護。

entries.definition: 水下能見度；清晰度 (玻璃水)

explains.en: A diver cannot see very far when rain clouds the water. Staying close to a buddy can be important.
Fog makes it hard for a driver to see the road ahead. Slow down and follow local safety guidance.
The distance a person can see through air or water can change. Clear conditions make it easier to notice objects.

examples.en: The mighty Kuroshio Current carries warm tropical waters and migratory tuna northward along Taiwan's east coast.
examples.zh: 磅礡奔騰的黑潮暖流沿著台灣東海岸北上，為沿岸帶來溫暖水溫與豐富洄游黑鮪魚及旗魚漁汛。

examples.en: Marine biologists track whale migrations using acoustic hydrophones anchored along the Kuroshio channel.
examples.zh: 海洋生物研究團隊在黑潮主流深水水域錨泊水下水聽器陣列，長年追蹤大型鬚鯨與抹香鯨的遷徙歌聲。

examples.en: The fast-flowing Kuroshio represents a monumental renewable kinetic resource for deep ocean turbine generation.
examples.zh: 日夜滾滾奔騰的深海黑潮蘊藏著浩瀚無窮的天然水流動能，是台灣發展深海黑潮渦輪發電的無價瑰寶。

entries.definition: 黑潮暖流 (太平洋最大暖流)

explains.en: This warm current flows north along Taiwan's eastern coast. It carries tropical water and tuna.
Scientists use underwater microphones to study whales traveling through this current. It moves quickly across the Pacific.
Ocean engineers study the moving water as a possible source of clean energy. It is one of the world's largest warm currents.

examples.en: Commercial overfishing threatens ocean ecosystem stability and destroys predatory pelagic species.
examples.zh: 工業化大型拖網漁船的長期過度捕撈嚴重摧毀了海洋生態金字塔，導致頂級掠食性魚類急遽銳減。

examples.en: Implementing strict seasonal fishing quotas is necessary to reverse decades of chronic overfishing.
examples.zh: 依法嚴格制定並執行禁漁期與捕撈配額制度，是挽救過去數十年來海洋資源慢性過度枯竭的必行之舉。

examples.en: Consumer seafood guides help shoppers choose sustainably caught species instead of victims of overfishing.
examples.zh: 推廣永續海鮮消費採購指南，能引導大眾優先挑選產量穩定的底層海鮮，拒吃面臨過度捕撈的瀕危魚種。

explains.en: Catching too many fish can leave too few to reproduce. This harms ocean life and fishing communities. Limits can help populations recover.
A lake had fewer fish each year because people caught them too quickly. The town set seasons when fishing was allowed. Numbers later improved.
Young fish need time to grow and lay eggs. If too many are taken, the population may shrink. Careful rules protect future supplies.

examples.en: Thousands of citizens joined the coastal beach cleanup, collecting three tons of PET bottles in a single day.
examples.zh: 數千名熱心民眾踴躍報名參加全台海岸淨灘行動，在短短一天內齊心協力清除了三噸海漂寶特瓶。

examples.en: The university diving club organized an underwater harbor cleanup to remove rusted batteries and tires.
examples.zh: 大學潛水社團主動發起港灣海底水下淨海行動，合力打撈清運出大量長年沉積的生鏽廢電池與廢輪胎。

examples.en: Recording the types of collected trash during each beach cleanup helps policymakers track pollution sources.
examples.zh: 在每次淨灘行動中落實國際淨灘 ICC 垃圾分類統計建檔，能提供環保主管機關第一手精確的污染源追溯。

entries.definition: 淨灘活動；淨海行動；清理

explains.en: It is an activity where people remove rubbish from a beach or other place. Volunteers may collect bottles and record what they find. This helps reduce pollution.
A community group can meet to pick up litter along the coast. Divers may also remove trash from a harbor. Sorting the waste can help identify its source.
After an event, people may work together to make an area clean again. Schools and clubs often organize one. It can improve a park or shoreline.

examples.en: High-tech offshore cage aquaculture withstands typhoon swells while cultivating premium grouper.
examples.zh: 澎湖外海引進的抗颱沈水式圓形深海箱網智慧水產養殖系統，能穩定培育頂級無毒龍膽石斑與海鱺。

examples.en: Recirculating land-based aquaculture systems recycle 95% of water through multi-stage bio-filtration.
examples.zh: 現代化陸上封閉式循環水養殖系統（RAS），透過多道精密生物濾槽淨化，達到循環再利用九成五以上的水源。

examples.en: Sustainable seaweed aquaculture sequesters dissolved nitrogen while creating nutritious food ingredients.
examples.zh: 大力推動永續大型海藻與裙帶菜人工水產養殖，能在吸收海水中多餘溶解氮磷的同時供應營養膳食食材。

examples.en: Typhoon-resistant submersible offshore aquaculture cages cultivate premium kingfish in crystal Penghu waters.
examples.zh: 引進抗強颱沈水式外海深海箱網水產養殖，在澎湖無污染海域中培育頂級生鮮海鱺。

examples.en: Inland freshwater aquaculture farmers in Tainan utilize automated water quality monitors to optimize milkfish health.
examples.zh: 台南內陸淡水水產養殖戶運用自動化水質監控設備，以最佳化虱目魚的生長健康。

examples.en: Sustainable aquaculture provides a vital source of protein while easing immense pressures on wild fishery stocks.
examples.zh: 永續水產養殖提供了重要的蛋白質來源，同時大幅減輕了野生漁業資源的耗損壓力。

entries.definition: 智慧水產養殖；水產科技；智慧深海箱網水產養殖

explains.en: A farmer raises fish or shellfish in ponds, tanks, or ocean pens. This provides food for people.
Some fish farms monitor water quality with sensors. Good care helps keep the animals healthy.
Seaweed can be grown in ocean farms as food or material. This industry raises aquatic organisms for use.

examples.en: Taiwan is internationally acclaimed as the grouper breeding kingdom, pioneering giant grouper fry techniques.
examples.zh: 台灣被國際譽為「石斑魚王國」，在龍膽石斑人工繁殖育苗與無用藥養殖技術上享譽全球。

examples.en: Steamed giant grouper fillets garnished with scallions and ginger are a beloved banquet delicacy.
examples.zh: 鋪滿青蔥絲與老薑絲的原汁清蒸頂級龍膽石斑魚片，是各大飯店婚宴辦桌上最受歡迎的尊貴大菜。

examples.en: Healthy groupers lurk motionlessly under coral overhangs before ambushing passing crabs with lightning speed.
examples.zh: 棲息於天然礁岩洞穴中的健康石斑魚平日靜止不動伏臥，一旦獵物螃蟹經過便以迅雷不及掩耳之勢突襲吞食。

explains.en: This large fish is raised on farms in Taiwan. It may be steamed with ginger and onions.
A fish can hide under a coral ledge before catching a passing crab. Restaurants may serve its tender meat.
Farmers in Taiwan developed ways to raise this fish. A healthy one may wait under the reef for small prey.

examples.en: Deep-sea trench exploration revealed fascinating volcanic hydrothermal vent ecosystems on the seabed.
examples.zh: 深海潛水器深入數千公尺的海底火山熱泉噴口探勘，揭示了完全無需陽光的奇異海底熱液生態系。

examples.en: Seismic monitoring sensors anchored to the seabed detect underwater earthquake tremors within seconds.
examples.zh: 牢固錨定在台灣周邊萬米深海海底的地震監測感測儀，能在海溝強震爆發的數秒內即時回傳預警信號。

examples.en: Mining valuable rare earth nodules from the abyssal seabed poses unpredictable environmental hazards.
examples.zh: 貿然向數千公尺深海深洋底層開採極具經濟價值的稀土錳結核礦石，將帶來不可逆的深海環境浩劫。

explains.en: The ground beneath the sea may be sand, mud, or rock. Plants and animals live on or near it. Deep parts can be hard to explore.
A research team lowered a camera below the waves. It showed crabs walking across the dark bottom. The scientists recorded what they saw.
Some cables and pipes rest on the ocean floor. Maps help people know where they are. Strong currents can move sand around them.

examples.en: Transpacific subsea optical fiber cables transmit 99% of international cloud internet data.
examples.zh: 橫跨太平洋底的超高速海底光纖電纜，乘載了全台灣百分之九十九以上的國際網際網路雲端數據傳輸。

examples.en: Robotic submersibles inspect the protective armored jackets of subsea optical communications lines.
examples.zh: 無人深海潛水載具沿著海底光纜鋪設路徑巡弋，定期仔細檢測光纜外層防鯊鋼鎧甲是否遭受磨損。

examples.en: Laying high-bandwidth optical cables between remote islands guarantees uninterrupted medical teleconsulting.
examples.zh: 在偏遠離島與本島間鋪設雙迴路高頻寬海底光纖電纜，能確保離島居民享有零延遲的遠距智慧醫療會診。

entries.definition: 海底光纖光學的；光學的

explains.en: It describes light, vision, or devices that use light. A cable can send internet information as pulses of light. A lens is used in a camera.
The science of how light moves is related to this adjective. Glasses and cameras have lenses. Fiber cables can carry data between islands.
Use this word for equipment or effects involving light. A microscope can help people see tiny objects. A communications cable may use light to carry information.

examples.en: Subsea engineering teams deploy robotic crawlers to bury high-voltage cables beneath the seafloor.
examples.zh: 水下工程團隊出動重型水下載具履帶車，將離線風場特高壓電纜安全深埋於海底沙層下方。

examples.en: Specialized diving chambers allow deep technicians to conduct subsea pipeline hyperbaric welding safely.
examples.zh: 特製的深海高壓作業潛水鐘，能讓深水專業工程潛水員在海底油氣管線旁安全進行高壓乾式焊接修復。

examples.en: Continuous subsea surveillance systems monitor the physical integrity of offshore energy infrastructure.
examples.zh: 全天候運作的水下主被動聲納監控系統，隨時守護著離岸風電與海纜等重大關鍵基礎設施的實體安全。

explains.en: Engineers lay power cables beneath the ocean floor to connect distant places. Special machines can inspect them.
A robot moves along the seabed to check a pipeline. The equipment is designed to work underwater.
Oil or wind projects may use pipes and cables under the sea. Technicians monitor them for damage.

examples.en: Remotely Operated Vehicles (ROVs) equipped with robotic arms retrieve geological core samples from depths.
examples.zh: 配備精密多軸機械手臂的水下無人遙控潛水器（ROV），能深入數千米深海精準抓取地質岩心樣本。

examples.en: Offshore engineers can monitor and control substation turbines remotely from onshore control rooms.
examples.zh: 離岸風電工程師坐在陸地中央監控中心的螢幕前，即可跨海全天候遠端遙控數十公里外的變電站與風機。

examples.en: Exploring volcanic chimneys remotely protects human oceanographers from scalding acidic fluids.
examples.zh: 透過無人水下載具進行遠端熱泉探勘，能讓海洋學家免於暴露在深海數百度滾燙酸性高壓熱液的極度危險中。

explains.en: A scientist can control an underwater robot from a room on shore. This avoids danger in deep water.
Engineers at a land station may adjust a turbine offshore. The machine is controlled from far away.
Researchers can study hot volcanic water without entering it. This way of working is done from a distance.

examples.en: Multibeam sonar bathymetry maps high-resolution 3D contours of undersea volcanoes and canyons.
examples.zh: 搭載多音束水下聲納測深儀的研究船，能以高解析度 3D 立體建模完整重現海底火山與大峽谷地形。

examples.en: Navy ships utilize passive listening sonar to detect the distant propeller signatures of submarines.
examples.zh: 海軍現代化反潛驅逐艦運用被動水下監聽聲納陣列，在數十海浬外精準辨識潛艦螺旋槳的特有音頻噪聲。

examples.en: Fishermen monitor fish-finding sonar screens to locate schooling pelagic mackerel below their hull.
examples.zh: 近海漁船船長聚精會神緊盯駕駛台上的高頻彩色魚探聲納螢幕，掌握船底深處大群鯖魚的游動軌跡。

examples.en: Multibeam sonar sweeps acoustic soundwaves across the dark seafloor, generating accurate 3D topographic maps.
examples.zh: 多音束聲納系統向漆黑海床發射聲波掃描，精準繪製出三維海底立體地形圖。

examples.en: Forward-looking obstacle avoidance sonar warns pilots of towering underwater cliffs hidden in pitch darkness.
examples.zh: 前向避障聲納能在伸手不見五指的萬米黑暗中，提前對駕駛員發出前方巍峨海底斷崖的警訊。

examples.en: Side-scan sonar revealed the scattered metallic debris of a sunken nineteenth-century steamship.
examples.zh: 側掃聲納傳回的高對比度聲學影像，清晰揭露了一艘沉沒於十九世紀蒸汽船散落的金屬殘骸。

entries.definition: 水下聲納探測系統；聲波定位；多音束深海高解析水深側深聲納

explains.en: A device sends sound through water and listens for echoes. It can help find objects or measure depth. Ships use it to navigate.
The boat sent out a sound pulse and waited for its echo. The screen showed a rocky shape below. The captain changed course.
Some systems listen quietly for sounds made by boats or animals. Others send signals. Both use sound to learn about what is underwater.

examples.en: Massive 14-megawatt offshore wind turbines harness howling Taiwan Strait breezes to generate clean power.
examples.zh: 矗立在彰化與苗栗外海重達數千噸的十四百萬瓦離岸風力渦輪發電機，將強勁海風轉化為潔淨電力。

examples.en: The rotating rotor blades of the wind turbine span a diameter wider than a commercial airliner's wingspan.
examples.zh: 現代離岸巨型風機的巨大旋轉葉片掃掠面積直徑，甚至超越了波音巨無霸民航客機的翼展寬度。

examples.en: Regular grease lubrication and gearbox inspections ensure that each offshore turbine runs continuously.
examples.zh: 嚴格定期指派海事工程師攀上百米高塔進行齒輪箱潤滑檢修，確保每一座離岸渦輪風機終年穩定旋轉。

examples.en: Subsea current turbines harness the steady, perpetual flow of the Kuroshio to generate clean baseload electricity.
examples.zh: 沉浸在東海岸外海深處的黑潮水下渦輪發電機，日夜擷取奔騰洋流動能轉換為源源不絕的綠色基載電力。

examples.en: Offshore wind farm technicians ride specialized vessels to perform scheduled maintenance on wind turbine blades.
examples.zh: 離岸風場的專業技師搭乘特種運維船，定期登上高空對風力發電機葉片進行保養檢修。

examples.en: High-pressure steam spins the turbine rapidly inside thermal power plants to drive electric generators.
examples.zh: 火力發電廠內的高壓蒸氣高速推動渦輪機旋轉，帶動發電機源源不絕地產生電力。

examples.en: Next-generation fifteen-megawatt wind turbines stand over two hundred meters above the sea surface.
examples.zh: 新世代單機容量達十五千瓩（15MW）的巨型風力發電機組，矗立在海平面兩百公尺高空。

examples.en: A single rotation of the massive turbine generates enough clean electricity to power an average home for a day.
examples.zh: 這座龐大風機葉輪僅需在大風中旋轉一圈，所產生的潔淨綠電就足以供應一戶普通家庭整整一天的用電。

examples.en: Sensor systems inside the wind turbine continuously monitor vibration and gearbox temperature.
examples.zh: 內嵌在風力發電機組內部的密集感測器陣列，全天候即時監控主軸震動與齒輪箱油溫狀態。

examples.en: High-pressure steam spins the stainless steel blades of the geothermal turbine at 3,600 revolutions per minute.
examples.zh: 高壓乾蒸汽以每分鐘三千六百轉的高速，吹動「地熱蒸汽渦輪機」（Steam Turbine）的不銹鋼葉片旋轉。

examples.en: Massive three-bladed wind turbines turn slowly on breezy offshore ridges to supply clean grid power.
examples.zh: 矗立在迎風海濱山脊上的三葉片大型風力發電機風輪渦輪，隨風徐徐轉動為國家電網輸送潔淨綠能。

examples.en: Jet engine turbines suck in freezing outside air and compress it before injecting aviation fuel for thrust.
examples.zh: 噴射客機發動機內部的多級高壓渦輪風扇急速吸入機外高空冷空氣並強力壓縮，隨後噴射航空燃油產生巨大推力。

entries.definition: 離岸風力渦輪機發電機；渦輪機；黑潮深海低速洋流發電機渦輪；15MW 巨型離岸風力發電機組 (風機)；驅動發電機發電之耐腐蝕大型地熱蒸汽渦輪機

explains.en: It is a machine with blades that spin when moved by wind, steam, or water. The spinning motion can produce electricity. Offshore wind farms use large ones.
A generator can make power when this machine turns. Wind pushes its blades. Engineers inspect gearboxes and lubricate moving parts.
This device changes moving air or water into rotational power. It may drive a generator. Steam can also turn one in a power plant.

examples.en: Double bubble curtains provide noise mitigation during pile-driving to protect marine mammals.
examples.zh: 離岸風電打樁時在周遭海域施放「雙層水下氣泡幕」進行噪音減緩防護，以降低對鯨豚聽力的干擾。

examples.en: Environmental regulations mandate strict acoustic mitigation protocols whenever seismic surveys occur.
examples.zh: 國家海事環評法規嚴格規定在海域進行震波地質測勘時，必須採取嚴格的水下聲學噪音減緩防護措施。

examples.en: Effective flood mitigation infrastructure along coastal lowlands saves village homes from tidal surges.
examples.zh: 沿著低窪濱海鄉村興建的防洪閘門與大型自動抽水站等減災工程，能有效抵禦大潮與暴潮引發的倒灌淹水。

examples.en: Coastal flood barriers provide vital climate risk mitigation protecting seaward industrial zones.
examples.zh: 興建加高加固的海堤防波閘門，為濱海工業區提供了防範海平面上升與風暴潮的關鍵風險緩釋對策（Mitigation）。

examples.en: Planting hillside cover crops serves as an effective soil erosion mitigation technique along steep orchards.
examples.zh: 在陡峭果園山坡上廣泛種植香根草等覆蓋作物，是極佳的水土保持工法，能發揮顯著減緩土壤流失沖刷的效果。

examples.en: Early arbitration and open communication facilitated dispute mitigation before lawsuits reached the court.
examples.zh: 及早引入中立仲裁機制並保持理性通暢的雙向溝通，有效化解了合約分歧，達成了訴訟開庭前的爭端緩解與和解。

entries.definition: 水下噪音減緩防護；減輕緩和；氣候實體與轉型風險緩釋對策

explains.en: A barrier of air bubbles can reduce the loud sound of construction under water. This helps protect nearby sea animals.
Planting crops that hold soil in place can lessen erosion on a hillside. The action reduces harm.
After a flood, a town may improve drainage and raise electrical equipment. These steps can limit future damage.

examples.en: Pods of agile spinner dolphins leap and spin three times in the air alongside tour boats.
examples.zh: 在花蓮外海成群結隊的飛旋海豚活潑伴隨賞鯨船乘浪前進，在空中連續旋轉三圈半躍出水面。

examples.en: Observing spinner dolphins performing acrobatic aerial corkscrews is a magical hallmark of eastern Taiwan.
examples.zh: 親眼目睹成群野生飛旋海豚在空中上演宛如芭蕾舞般優美的高難度縱軸旋轉，是台灣東海岸最震撼的生態奇蹟。

examples.en: The spinner dolphin feeds on small lanternfish in deep open waters during pitch-black nights.
examples.zh: 習性獨特的飛旋海豚每當夜幕低垂漆黑之際，便會聯手潛入大洋深層合力獵食垂直洄游的小型發光燈籠魚。

entries.definition: 飛旋海豚（空中旋轉躍起）；紡紗者

explains.en: This playful dolphin can leap and turn in the air beside a tour boat. It feeds on small fish at night.
Visitors in eastern Taiwan may see these dolphins make acrobatic jumps. They spin as they rise above the water.
A group of these sea mammals may leap several times before returning to the ocean. Their graceful turns are easy to recognize.

examples.en: Ecologists lead children on night walks through the rich intertidal zone to discover nocturnal crabs.
examples.zh: 生態專家帶領學童在退潮夜間走入生機盎然的潮間帶，打著手電筒尋找夜行性饅頭蟹與海兔。

examples.en: Organisms residing in the intertidal zone must withstand scorching midday sun and crushing tidal wave action.
examples.zh: 生活在潮間帶極端環境中的藤壺、笠螺與海藻，必須天生具備抗高溫日曬與狂暴碎浪拍擊的頑強生命力。

examples.en: Coastal development must tread carefully to prevent permanent destruction of fragile intertidal ecosystems.
examples.zh: 濱海公路興建與遊憩港灣開發必須經過周詳環評，以全力避免對極其脆弱珍貴的潮間帶生態造成毀滅性破壞。

entries.definition: 潮間帶生態的；潮間帶的
