examples.zh: 完善便捷的捷運路網與公共運輸基礎建設，將外圍郊區與市中心就業機會緊密相連，促進社會經濟階層向上流動。

examples.en: High-speed trains provide green, low-carbon regional mobility that slashes highway traffic congestion.
examples.zh: 高速鐵路帶來了環保低碳的「綠色大眾移動力」（Mobility），大幅紓解了國道高速公路的擁塞與碳排放。

examples.en: Physical therapy exercises helped the octogenarian grandfather regain leg mobility after his hip surgery.
examples.zh: 規律耐心的物理治療肌力訓練，幫助高齡八旬的老爺爺在人工髖關節置換手術後重新找回雙腿獨立行走的能力。

examples.en: Integrated smart ticketing cards enhance urban mobility by linking metro, public bike, and bus trips smoothly.
examples.zh: 全國一卡通與悠遊卡多卡通智慧票證整合，無縫串聯捷運、公共自行車與公車路網，大幅增進都會大眾綠色移動力。

entries.definition: 智慧移動服務 (MaaS)；流動性；重塑城際通勤生活之綠色低碳軌道移動力

explains.en: A wheelchair helps someone move around their home and community. Ramps and wide doors can make travel easier.
A city app combines bus, train, and shared-bike trips in one place. People can choose how to get around.
Physical therapy may help someone move their legs more easily after an injury. Public transit can also connect people to jobs.

examples.en: Ventilated ceramic composite brake discs provide fade-free high-speed braking in mountain hairpins.
examples.zh: 通風打孔陶瓷複合煞車通風碟盤在高山九彎十八拐連續下坡時，依然能維持絕不衰退的強勁制動力。

examples.en: Wet road surfaces increase vehicle braking distances dramatically, requiring larger safety margins.
examples.zh: 傾盆大雨後的積水柏油路面會造成車輛煞車制動距離大幅拉長，駕駛必須拉大與前車的安全跟車距離。

examples.en: Emergency automatic braking engaged within a split second, bringing the SUV to a complete halt before the intersection.
examples.zh: 主動式緊急自動煞車系統在千分之一秒內火速介入，在十字路口斑馬線前將休旅車完全穩穩煞停。

examples.en: Blended regenerative and pneumatic disc braking brings the 500-ton train to a gentle halt from full speed.
examples.zh: 結合「電能回生與氣壓煞車」（Blended Braking），能讓重達五百公噸的高速列車在三公里內平穩煞停。

examples.en: Wet leaves on wet asphalt drastically increase the required braking distance for motorcycles.
examples.zh: 鋪滿潮濕落葉的柏油路面摩擦係數驟降，會大幅拉長機車緊急煞車所需的平穩滑行制動距離。

examples.en: Anti-lock braking systems prevent dangerous wheel lockup when drivers stomp on the pedal during emergencies.
examples.zh: 防鎖死煞車系統（ABS）能在駕駛人遭遇緊急危急狀況重踩踏板時，防止輪胎瞬間鎖死失控打滑。

entries.definition: 車輛制動煞車性能；煞車；電能回生制動與通風碳陶通風煞車碟盤

explains.en: A vehicle slows down when its brakes press against moving parts. Good stopping ability helps protect people on the road. Wet pavement can make stopping take longer.
Some electric vehicles turn part of their motion back into stored energy as they slow. This can help the battery, though ordinary brakes are still important.
A mechanic checks how well a car can stop. Worn parts may need repair. Drivers should leave enough space to slow safely.

examples.en: The streamlined teardrop body profile slices through oncoming air currents smoothly.
examples.zh: 極具未來科技感的水滴超流線型車體輪廓能優雅切開迎面而來的強大氣流，兼具美感與極低風阻。

examples.en: The bank introduced a streamlined online loan application process that takes only five minutes on a phone.
examples.zh: 該商業銀行推出了極簡化線上信貸申辦流程，免跑實體分行，手機上操作短短五分鐘內即可搞定。

examples.en: High-speed rail bullet trains sport a streamlined duckbill nose to dampen tunnel sonic booms.
examples.zh: 高速鐵路子彈列車車頭特別採用流線型鴨嘴獸流體力學設計，以大幅消除高速穿入隧道時的微氣壓波噪音。

entries.definition: 超流線型低風阻的；簡化高效的

explains.en: A shape designed to move easily through air or water has this quality. Smooth curves reduce resistance. Boats and aircraft often use such forms.
The new train had a long, smooth nose. It moved quickly through the air. Engineers tested its shape in a tunnel.
A process made simpler and more efficient can also be described this way. The office removed unnecessary steps. Customers finished the form faster.

examples.en: Attending live performing arts venues allows audiences to share unfiltered human emotion.
examples.zh: 親臨現場走入表演藝術殿堂，能讓觀眾近距離感受台上演員毫無保留、真摯澎湃的情感張力。

examples.en: The government established cultural grants to support independent performing arts troupes during difficult times.
examples.zh: 文化部設立專案藝文補助基金，在景氣低迷時期全力扶植民間中小型獨立表演藝術團隊度過難關。

examples.en: She dedicated her youth to performing arts, training rigorously in classical ballet and contemporary drama.
examples.zh: 她將全部青春熱血奉獻給表演藝術，長年接受高強度的古典芭蕾舞姿與當代戲劇表演專業訓練。

entries.definition: 表演藝術的；演奏表演的

explains.en: Singers and actors do their work in front of an audience. They may use music, movement, or speech to tell a story. This adjective relates to live artistic work.
A student plays a violin on stage while families watch. The event is part of the arts, not simply practice at home. It involves presenting work to an audience.
The school offers lessons in acting, dance, and music. These subjects teach students how to present art live. They belong to a field focused on stage and show work.

examples.en: Superb hall acoustics allow pure, unamplified violin notes to reach back-row balcony seats clearly.
examples.zh: 頂級殿堂聲學設計讓小提琴純淨未經擴音的細膩琴音，能清晰溫潤地傳遞至三樓最後一排包廂。

examples.en: Architectural sound engineers adjusted curved wall panels to optimize speech acoustics for musical theater.
examples.zh: 建築聲學工程團隊反覆微調弧形擴散吸音壁板角度，致力於為音樂劇演出打造完美的語言清晰度與殘響。

examples.en: The ancient stone amphitheater in Greece is world-renowned for its uncanny natural acoustics.
examples.zh: 希臘這座依山而建的古羅馬半圓形露天劇場，因其神奇絕倫的天然聲音反射聲學效果而聞名於世。

examples.en: Treating the home studio with tailored acoustic panels creates balanced, reflection-free room acoustics.
examples.zh: 在居家錄音室牆面加裝專用調音吸音板，能打造出頻率均衡、無多餘反射雜音的優異室內聲學。

examples.en: The world-renowned concert hall was designed with impeccable acoustics so acoustic instruments carry to the top balcony.
examples.zh: 這座享譽國際的國家級音樂廳具備無懈可擊的建築聲學設計，使不插電原聲樂器的細緻音色能清晰傳遞至頂層看台。

examples.en: She enrolled in a master's program to study architectural acoustics and environmental noise control.
examples.zh: 她報名攻讀碩士學位學程，專研建築聲學物理與都會環境噪音防治工程。

entries.definition: 廳堂建築聲學；音響效果；錄音室建築聲學設計；聲學

explains.en: A concert hall lets violin notes reach the back seats clearly. Curved walls can affect how sound travels.
A music studio uses soft panels to reduce echoes. This helps recordings sound balanced.
People study how sound moves and reflects in rooms. A theater may be designed so speech is easy to hear.

examples.en: The classic proscenium arch frames theatrical action like a living, breathing oil painting.
examples.zh: 傳統經典的鏡框式舞台（Proscenium），宛如一幅巨大的活體油畫框將舞台上的喜怒哀樂優雅框住。

examples.en: Heavy velvet curtains parted slowly behind the ornate golden proscenium arch to reveal the opening set.
examples.zh: 沉重華貴的酒紅色絲絨大幕在雕花金箔台口鏡框後徐徐拉開，揭開第一幕震撼人心的開場布景。

examples.en: Unlike arena theaters with 360-degree sightlines, a proscenium stage separates audience and actors cleanly.
examples.zh: 與三百六十度環繞的四面台劇場不同，鏡框式舞台在舞台與觀眾席之間劃定了一道清晰的「第四面牆」。

explains.en: A framed opening separates the audience from the acting area in some theaters. People watch the play through this opening. Curtains may cover it before the show.
Actors perform behind a large frame at the front of a stage. The audience sits on the other side and looks toward the scene. Lights can shine through the opening.
A theater designer plans the shape of the frame and the space around it. Scenery can be placed behind it. This arrangement helps define where the performance happens.

examples.en: A motorized rotating turntable shifts complex palace sets to battlefield ruins in twenty seconds.
examples.zh: 舞台下方電動大型旋轉台（Turntable）在短短二十秒暗景中，流暢將金碧輝煌的宮殿無縫切換為戰場廢墟。

examples.en: Audiophiles swear by the warm, analog richness that comes from spinning vinyl on a high-end turntable.
examples.zh: 黑膠發燒友深信，唯有透過頂級黑膠唱片機旋轉唱針讀取的純類比音質，才能散發出真實溫潤的韻味。

examples.en: The choreography utilized a rotating center turntable to create a mesmerizing visual sense of passing time.
examples.zh: 編舞指導巧妙結合舞台中央的慢速旋轉台走位，營造出時光飛逝、人海茫茫交錯的詩意視覺張力。

examples.en: The heavy belt-driven turntable spins smoothly on magnetic levitation isolation feet.
examples.zh: 重裝打造的皮帶驅動黑膠唱盤，懸浮在磁浮避震腳墊上以每分鐘三十三又三分之一轉極靜旋轉。

examples.en: The railway maintenance yard utilizes an enormous circular turntable to reverse the heading of diesel locomotives.
examples.zh: 鐵路維修機廠中央設置了一座巨大的圓形鐵路轉車盤轉盤，用以調轉柴油機車頭的行駛朝向。

examples.en: A strobe light pattern around the turntable platter helps listeners calibrate rotational speed precisely.
examples.zh: 黑膠唱盤金屬轉盤邊緣刻有的精密頻閃測速紋路，能協助音響迷利用頻閃燈精準校正轉速。

entries.definition: 舞台旋轉台；黑膠唱片機；發燒級精密減震黑膠唱盤

explains.en: A round platform rotates so a record can play under a needle. A motor turns it at a steady speed. Music comes from the record’s grooves.
Grandpa placed a black disc on the spinning platform. He lowered the needle and music filled the room. The family listened together.
In a theater, a large rotating floor can move scenery into view. Actors may stand on it. It helps change a scene quickly.

examples.en: Crew members in black outfits move heavy set pieces backstage with whisper-quiet precision.
examples.zh: 全身著黑衣的後台工作人員在黑暗中以極其安靜且俐落的身手，精準就定位搬動巨大的布景機關。

examples.en: Fans lucky enough to secure VIP passes met the lead singer backstage after the encore performance.
examples.zh: 幸運搶到特等 VIP 通行證的熱情歌迷，在安可曲圓滿落幕後前往劇院後台與主唱近距離合影留念。

examples.en: What looks seamless under the lights requires chaotic coordination backstage among dozens of technicians.
examples.zh: 舞台聚光燈下看似行雲流水的完美演出，全賴後台數十位機電、音響與換裝技術人員分秒必爭的高效協調。

explains.en: Actors wait behind the curtain before they enter the stage. Crew members move props where the audience cannot see them. This area is part of a theater.
The public sees the show from their seats, while workers prepare out of view. They change costumes and arrange equipment during the performance. This word describes the hidden area or activity.
A singer may thank the people who helped away from the audience. They handled lights, sound, and clothing. Their work happened behind the scenes.

examples.en: Broadway stars warm up vocal cords before illuminated dressing room vanity mirrors.
examples.zh: 百老匯男女主角在後台明亮的專屬梳妝化妝鏡前開嗓練唱，做足登台前的一切準備。

examples.en: Flower bouquets and congratulations telegrams filled the prima ballerina's dressing room after opening night.
examples.zh: 首演之夜大獲成功後，各界名流送來的祝賀花籃與手寫卡片塞滿了首席芭蕾女伶的專屬化妝室。

examples.en: Quick-change stations were set up just offstage so actors did not need to run back to the distant dressing room.
examples.zh: 舞台側翼特地搭建了緊急快速換裝區，免除演員在短短兩分鐘內來回奔跑回遠處後台化妝室的困擾。

explains.en: Actors change costumes and apply makeup in a private room behind the stage. A mirror with bright lights may be there.
A performer returns here after a show to hang up clothes and pack. Staff keep costumes organized.
The cast waits in this backstage room until it is time to go on. Some theaters have one for each performer.

examples.en: The antique sword used as a central dramatic prop was handcrafted by master blacksmiths.
examples.zh: 在劇中扮演關鍵推動情節的古董寶劍道具（Prop），是由資深打鐵工藝大師純手工精心鍛造打磨。

examples.en: Prop masters meticulously catalog every teacup, revolver, and letter used throughout the three acts.
examples.zh: 專業道具管理師嚴謹造冊登記全劇三幕中所涉及的每一只青花茶杯、老式手槍與機密手寫信件。

examples.en: They used a sturdy wooden beam as a prop to hold open the heavy barn door while unloading grain.
examples.zh: 工人在卸下滿車金黃稻穀時，就地取材拿了一根堅固的木樁作為支撐物，牢牢頂住厚重的穀倉木門。

entries.definition: 舞台專用戲劇道具；支撐物

explains.en: A small object used by an actor helps make a scene look real. A pretend letter or cup may be carried on stage. The object is part of the performance.
Workers arrange objects that actors use during a show. They return each one to the right place after the scene. Careful handling keeps the play running smoothly.
A beam or post can hold up a roof or another heavy part. Builders place it where support is needed. In a theater, an object used in a scene has another meaning.

examples.en: The sound engineer balances twenty-four wireless microphones seamlessly at the central soundboard.
examples.zh: 音響工程師坐在觀眾席中央的數位調音控制台前，熟練監控並調和全場二十四支無線微型麥克風音量。

examples.en: Digital soundboards store pre-programmed equalization presets for different scenes and vocal timbres.
examples.zh: 現代數位調音台內建多組預設等化器參數，能針對不同舞台場景與演員聲線特色進行一秒切換。

examples.en: Fine vibrations throughout the spruce soundboard give acoustic grand pianos their deep, singing resonance.
examples.zh: 整塊嚴選雲杉木音響響板的均勻細緻共振，賦予了演奏級三角平台鋼琴深沉宏亮、歌唱般的動人音色。

examples.en: The soundboard acts as the speaker cone of the guitar, converting string tension into audible sound waves.
examples.zh: 纖薄的「共鳴面板」（Soundboard）如同吉他的喇叭盆體，將琴弦的物理振動高效轉化為動人聲波。

examples.en: Hand-planing the soundboard edges thinner than the center enhances bass response and sonic warmth.
examples.zh: 製琴師以手工將共鳴面板周圍刨削得比中心稍薄，能顯著提升低音動態彈性與音色溫潤感。

examples.en: A minor hairline crack running through the spruce soundboard was repaired with internal spruce cleats.
examples.zh: 雲杉面板上出現的一道細如髮絲的木材乾裂，經製琴師在琴內黏貼微型菱形木片得到完美修復。

entries.definition: 專業音響調音控制台；厚度僅兩毫米之高靈敏吉他與提琴共鳴面板

explains.en: A control panel lets an engineer adjust microphones and music during a show. Sliders change volume and tone. Speakers carry the mixed sound to the audience.
The operator raised the singer’s microphone and lowered the drums. The band sounded balanced. People in the hall could hear clearly.
A wooden board inside a string instrument helps its sound grow louder. It vibrates when the strings move. Makers choose the wood carefully.

examples.en: As the house lights dimmed, the orchestra struck up the dramatic opening overture.
examples.zh: 當全場觀眾席燈光緩緩暗下，樂池中指揮家優雅揮棒，奏響了預告劇中各大主題旋律的震撼開場序曲。

examples.en: The sweeping musical overture wove together memorable leitmotifs heard later in the production.
examples.zh: 氣勢磅礡的開場管弦序曲，巧妙串聯起稍後全劇各幕中將陸續由主角深情吟唱的經典主題旋律片段。

examples.en: Both countries made discreet diplomatic overtures in an attempt to de-escalate tensions along the border.
examples.zh: 兩國高層外交官在檯面下釋出了審慎而務實的接觸試探（Overture），期盼藉此平息邊境劍拔弩張的軍事對峙。

entries.definition: 揭開序幕之管弦樂序曲

explains.en: An orchestra may play an opening piece before an opera begins. It introduces musical ideas from the show. The audience listens before the curtain rises.
A government may send a friendly offer to begin talks with another country. It is an attempt to open a discussion. This meaning comes from the same word used in music.
The concert started with a short instrumental work before the singers appeared. Its melody gave listeners a taste of what was coming. It served as the musical opening.

examples.en: The leading lady’s soaring emotional ballad brought the entire auditorium to tears.
examples.zh: 女主角在第二幕深情高亢演唱的情感大抒情慢歌（Ballad），極具穿透力的嗓音令全場兩千名觀眾感動拭淚。

examples.en: Folk singers strummed acoustic guitars, sharing ancient Celtic ballads about doomed star-crossed lovers.
examples.zh: 民謠歌手在老街小酒館輕撫木吉他，悠悠吟唱著古老塞爾特傳奇中那些命途多舛的淒美愛情抒情敘事詩。

examples.en: The album balanced hard-hitting rock anthems with gentle acoustic ballads praising rural island life.
examples.zh: 這張概念專輯在震撼重擊的硬搖滾主打歌與溫柔空靈的木吉他抒情慢曲之間，取得了完美的聆聽平衡。

entries.definition: 深情動人抒情慢歌獨唱曲

explains.en: A singer performs a slow, emotional song about love or loss. The melody may be gentle.
Folk musicians sing an old story about two lovers who face trouble. The song tells a tale.
A soft song with a strong melody can make listeners feel moved. It may be sung alone with a guitar.

examples.en: Their romantic rooftop duet showcased breathtaking vocal harmony and undeniable on-stage chemistry.
examples.zh: 兩位男女主角在屋頂星空下的深情雙人二重唱，展現出天衣無縫的完美高低和聲與無比炙熱的化學反應。

examples.en: The brother and sister performed a flawless piano duet on a grand Steinway at the recital.
examples.zh: 姊弟兩人在畢業音樂會上共同在一台史坦威大鋼琴上四手聯彈，完成了一首默契絕佳的古典鋼琴雙人二重奏。

examples.en: Pop stars from Taiwan and South Korea collaborated on a bilingual romantic duet that topped streaming charts.
examples.zh: 來自台灣與韓國的流行歌手破天荒攜手合作雙語浪漫抒情對唱情歌，迅速攻佔各大數位串流排行榜冠軍寶座。

entries.definition: 雙人深情男女重唱二重唱

explains.en: Two singers perform a song together, sharing the music. Their voices may take turns or sing at the same time. A pianist can accompany them.
Two musicians play a piece written for them both. Each has a part to contribute. They listen closely to stay together.
A teacher asks two children to sing one song as a pair. One begins, and the other joins for the next line. Their voices blend.

examples.en: Traditional Taiwanese glove puppetry tells legendary martial arts sagas with acrobatic wooden puppets.
examples.zh: 台灣揚名海內外的傳統掌中布袋戲，操偶師僅憑一雙靈巧巧手即可賦予木雕戲偶凌空翻滾的絕世武功。

examples.en: Modern puppetry companies blend classic hand puppets with computerized LED lighting and rock soundtracks.
examples.zh: 霹靂布袋戲等當代偶藝劇團，大膽將傳統掌中戲偶與現代電腦 3D 特效、LED 舞台燈光及搖滾重金屬配樂完美結合。

examples.en: The international puppet festival brought master artisans of shadow, string, and rod puppetry together.
examples.zh: 這場年度國際偶戲藝術節盛會，匯聚了來自世界各地的皮影戲、懸絲偶與杖頭木偶工藝大師同台切磋交流。

entries.definition: 台灣傳統布袋戲偶藝；木偶戲

explains.en: A performer uses figures to tell a story. The figures may move by hand, strings, or rods. Voices and music bring them to life.
The children watched a small puppet show at the library. A fox and a farmer spoke to each other. Everyone laughed at the ending.
Some traditions use carved figures and colorful costumes. A skilled performer moves each character carefully. Shows can entertain and teach.

examples.en: Taiwanese Gezai Opera combines traditional folk melodies with dazzling modern stage technology.
examples.zh: 台灣本土孕育的歌仔戲劇團（如明華園），將傳統四句聯唱腔與當代聲光特效融合出極致東方美學。

examples.en: Grandmothers and grandchildren alike gathered in the temple courtyard to watch outdoor Gezai Opera during festivals.
examples.zh: 每逢農曆神明誕辰建醮酬神廟會，阿嬤總帶著雀躍的小孫子在廟埕廣場板凳前搶位欣賞熱鬧非凡的野台歌仔戲。

examples.en: Master performers of Gezai Opera train for decades to master stylized singing, falsetto, and water-sleeve choreography.
examples.zh: 歌仔戲國寶級資深藝師往往必須苦練數十年基本功，方能精通七字調道地唱腔、優雅假音與水袖翩翩的身段功夫。

explains.en: This traditional Taiwanese stage art combines singing, speech, and acting. Performers often wear colorful costumes and tell stories with music. It developed in Taiwan.
A local theater form uses a distinctive Taiwanese style of song and dialogue. Actors perform stories on stage, sometimes with traditional instruments. It is an important part of the island’s culture.
In this folk drama, performers sing lines and act out a tale for the crowd. Costumes and music help bring the story to life. The form grew from Taiwanese traditions.

examples.en: Martial actors perform breathtaking acrobatic flips and spear tricks across the stage.
examples.zh: 傳統戲曲武生演員在台上接連施展令人目不暇給的騰空後空翻與迴旋槍花特技身段，博得滿堂彩。

examples.en: The Cirque du Soleil show featured acrobatic aerialists performing high above the audience without nets.
examples.zh: 太陽馬戲團享譽全球的頂級大秀中，身手矯健的高空特技演員在毫無安全防護網的挑高空中優雅盤旋翻滾。

examples.en: Gymnasts spend years perfecting acrobatic floor routines to compete in the Olympic Games.
examples.zh: 競技體操國手耗費數年日以繼夜苦練各類高難度翻騰與落地動作，只為在四年一度的奧運賽場上一展身手。

entries.definition: 雜技特技翻滾的；身手矯健的

explains.en: A performer flips and balances on a stage during a circus show. They practice carefully for safety.
Gymnasts spend years learning difficult jumps and turns. Their routines need strength and control.
An actor may leap and spin while performing a fight scene. These agile movements take training.

examples.en: During the 20-minute intermission, patrons enjoy sparkling champagne and discuss the dramatic plot twists.
examples.zh: 在中場二十分鐘休息時間（Intermission），觀眾紛紛走出廳堂來到前廳享用香檳並興奮熱議劇情反轉。

examples.en: Chimes rang through the theater hallways signaling that the intermission was drawing to a close.
examples.zh: 清脆優雅的電子提示鐘聲迴盪在劇院各大走廊長廳，提醒所有正在休息交談的觀眾中場休息即將結束回座。

examples.en: Unlike modern cinema screenings, classic live operas almost always include at least one formal intermission.
examples.zh: 有別於現代電影院一氣呵成的連續放映，大型古典歌劇與史詩音樂劇幾乎必定安排至少一次正式的中場休息。

entries.definition: 劇院中場休息時間（二十分鐘）

explains.en: A performance may pause so the audience can stretch or use the restroom. The lights often come on during this break. People return before the next part begins.
At a theater, the show stops between sections for a short rest. Ushers may guide people through the lobby. A bell can signal that it is time to go back.
A concert has a pause after several pieces. Listeners chat quietly and buy a drink. The musicians return when the break ends.

examples.en: Elegant crystal chandeliers illuminate the spacious theater foyer where excited ticket holders gather.
examples.zh: 璀璨的水晶吊燈照亮了兩廳院挑高氣派的迎賓前廳（Foyer），滿場手持票券的觀眾在此期待入場。

examples.en: Patrons deposited their heavy winter coats at the coat check station situated right off the main foyer.
examples.zh: 來看夜戲的觀眾在步入主表演廳前，順手將厚重的冬日大衣與雨傘寄存於前廳旁的專業衣帽寄存處。

examples.en: The modern residential condominium building features a double-height marble entrance foyer.
examples.zh: 這棟位於市中心的當代精品豪宅大樓，特別規劃了挑高兩層樓、通體鋪設義大利大理石的迎賓接待大廳。

entries.definition: 劇院挑高迎賓前廳大廳

explains.en: The entrance hall of a theater or large building gives visitors room to gather. People may wait there before a show. Tickets are often checked nearby.
The family met beneath a bright chandelier before the play. They found their seats after the doors opened. The hall was busy.
A home can also have a small entry space just inside the front door. Coats and shoes may be kept there. It connects the entrance to other rooms.

examples.en: Families often prefer attending the Saturday afternoon matinee rather than late evening performances.
examples.zh: 許多帶著長輩與小朋友的家庭，更偏好購買週六週日下午場（Matinee）的票券，以便看完悠閒享用晚餐。

examples.en: Actors must conserve their vocal stamina when performing both a matinee and an evening show on the same day.
examples.zh: 當同一天內必須連續應付下午場與晚場兩場高強度連軸演出時，舞台劇演員必須格外懂得保留嗓音體力。

examples.en: Discounted student tickets are frequently available for weekday school matinee presentations.
examples.zh: 各大劇院通常會針對週三週四等平日下午特別場次，釋出價格平易近人的青年學生文化推廣優惠票。

explains.en: A theater may offer a show in the afternoon instead of at night. Families can attend while it is still daylight. The ticket is for an early performance.
On Saturday, a movie theater schedules a screening before dinner. The showing begins during the day. Some people choose it instead of a late evening film.
A play begins at two o’clock for people who prefer an earlier time. The actors give the same performance later that night. This word names the daytime show.

examples.en: Fast-paced comedic improvisation relies on quick wit and unscripted audience suggestions.
examples.zh: 節奏緊湊的即興喜劇漫才演出，極度仰賴喜劇演員臨場敏銳的機智應變與觀眾拋出的突發笑梗。

examples.en: When a prop cup dropped and shattered unexpectedly, the actors saved the scene through witty improvisation.
examples.zh: 當桌上的道具陶瓷杯不慎失手滑落摔得粉碎時，兩位資深老戲骨憑藉幽默風趣的即興現編對白巧妙化解危機。

examples.en: Jazz musicians showcase their virtuosic technique and theoretical mastery during spontaneous solo improvisation.
examples.zh: 頂尖爵士樂手在現場不按樂譜的即興獨奏（Improvisation）段落中，淋漓盡致展現神乎其技的指法與和聲掌控。

entries.definition: 即興演出發揮；臨場應變

explains.en: Actors invent funny lines during a scene instead of following a written script. The audience may suggest a topic.
Jazz musicians create a new solo while the band keeps playing. They listen closely to one another.
When a prop breaks, performers make up a response and keep the scene going. This skill helps in unexpected situations.

examples.en: A profound silence of emotional resonance hung over the auditorium before thunderous cheers erupted.
examples.zh: 在全場爆發震耳欲聾的歡呼聲前，整座音樂廳沉浸在全體觀眾心靈深處巨大共鳴的屏息感動中。

examples.en: The poet's verses about migrant homesickness strike a deep emotional resonance with overseas Taiwanese students.
examples.zh: 這位本土詩人描寫外地遊子思鄉情切的深情詩句，在遠赴海外打拼求學的台灣留學生心中激起了無比深沉的共鳴。

examples.en: Acoustic engineers fine-tuned the wooden sound reflecting canopy to achieve maximum vocal resonance.
examples.zh: 音響工程師精密微調了懸吊在舞台上方的大型木質反響天花反音板，以期達到最佳的聲樂人聲擴散共鳴。

examples.en: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans soft brain tissues without exposing patients to ionizing radiation.
examples.zh: 磁振造影（MRI）在完全零游離輻射的環境下，能高解析度清晰掃描大腦神經與軟組織病變。

examples.en: Her impassioned commencement speech about social equity achieved immense emotional resonance with graduates.
examples.zh: 她在全校畢業典禮上關於社會公平與弱勢關懷的真情演說，在全體畢業生心中激起了巨大的情感共鳴。

examples.en: Structural engineers tuned the suspension bridge dampeners to counteract destructive aerodynamic wind resonance.
examples.zh: 橋樑結構工程師精準調校長跨度懸索吊橋內部的阻尼抗風阻尼器，徹底消除強風引發的破壞性氣動共振現象。

examples.en: Touching living wood evokes a primal emotional resonance connecting humans back to primordial forests.
examples.zh: 輕撫有生命的實木紋理，在每個人心靈深處喚起一股與遠古原始森林血脈相連的深刻心靈共鳴。

examples.en: The author's poignant memoir about growing up in rural Taiwan struck an immediate emotional resonance with readers.
examples.zh: 這位知名作家描述在台灣鄉村農村成長點滴的真情回憶錄，立刻在各個世代讀者心中激起了強烈共鳴。

examples.en: Tuning forks vibrate in acoustic resonance when struck at identical natural frequencies.
examples.zh: 當兩個音叉被調諧至完全相同的自然頻率時，敲擊其中一個即會引發另一個產生強烈的聲學共振。

examples.en: The solid spruce top produces rich acoustic resonance that vibrates right through the guitarist’s chest.
examples.zh: 實木雲杉吉他面板爆發出飽滿有力的物理共鳴，讓琴弦震動直接穿透彈奏者的胸膛。

examples.en: The politician's speech on economic fairness struck a powerful chord of emotional resonance with young voters.
examples.zh: 這位政治家針對社會公平正義所發表的感人演說，在廣大青年選民心底激起了強烈的心理共鳴與認同。

examples.en: Bridges must be engineered carefully to avoid dangerous structural resonance induced by marching troops or strong winds.
examples.zh: 大型跨海大橋在設計結構力學時必須經過精密風洞計算，以防強烈陣風或大軍齊步通過時誘發致命的結構共振。

examples.en: Standing in the silent colonnade, one feels an emotional resonance echoing from generations past.
examples.zh: 靜靜佇立在斑駁古老的紅磚迴廊中，心靈深處彷彿能聽見數百年前先民跨越時空傳來的深刻歷史共鳴。

examples.en: The solemn bronze temple bell strikes with a rich resonance that echoes across the misty valley.
examples.zh: 破曉時分大殿渾厚的古銅鐘敲響，悠揚深邃的鐘聲共鳴迴盪在整座薄霧繚繞的山谷之中。

examples.en: Oral folk songs possess deep emotional resonance for elderly villagers recounting their youth.
examples.zh: 悠揚婉轉的鄉土民謠，在老阿公老阿嬤耳中激起了對往昔純樸歲月難以言喻的心靈共鳴。

examples.en: Acoustic testing tunes the top and back plates so their combined resonance produces a singing soprano tone.
examples.zh: 透過聲學測試微調面板與背板厚度，使其耦合產生的「聲學共鳴」（Resonance）散發如女高音般的歌唱嗓音。

examples.en: The poet's poignant verses about exile found emotional resonance across thousands of displaced refugees.
examples.zh: 這位流亡詩人筆下字字泣血、描寫離鄉背井的蒼涼詩篇，在成千上萬漂泊異鄉的難民心頭激起強烈共鳴。

examples.en: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provides doctors with detailed cross-sectional views of soft internal organs.
examples.zh: 磁振造影（MRI）醫療掃描儀器為臨床醫師提供了人體內部大腦、神經與軟組織極致細膩的斷層切片影像。

examples.en: Tuned Helmholtz resonance cavities behind wooden slats absorb problematic mid-bass frequencies smoothly.
examples.zh: 隱藏在木格柵後方的「亥姆霍茲共振腔體」（Resonance Cavities），能平穩吸收干擾聽感的特定中低頻駐波。

examples.en: The deep resonance of the cello filled the stone cathedral with a profound and somber warmth.
examples.zh: 大提琴深沉悠揚的醇厚共振琴音，讓整座石造大教堂瀰漫著一股莊嚴肅穆又溫暖動人的氛圍。

examples.en: The historic novel found extraordinary emotional resonance among young readers navigating modern life transitions.
examples.zh: 這部厚重的歷史小說，在正面臨人生階段轉折起伏的年輕讀者群中引發了極為強烈的心靈共鳴。

examples.en: Great music performed in such pure acoustics evokes a deep, unforgettable spiritual resonance.
examples.zh: 在如此純淨天籟的聲學殿堂中聆聽偉大樂章，能在每位聽眾心底激盪起久久不散的「精神情感共鳴」（Resonance）。

examples.en: Magnetic resonance imaging provides detailed anatomical views without exposing patients to ionizing radiation.
examples.zh: 磁振造影（MRI）醫療掃描能在完全不讓病患暴露於游離輻射的前提下，呈現人體軟組織細膩的高解析影像。

examples.en: The activist’s call for universal healthcare equality struck a powerful chord of public resonance nationwide.
examples.zh: 這位社會倡議家為落實全民就醫平等而發出的真摯呼籲，在全國各階層社會大眾心中激盪起極為強烈的共鳴迴響。

entries.definition: 全場觀眾心跳共振共鳴；迴響；磁振造影檢查 (MRI)；共振；人心與大自然原木的心靈共鳴；共鳴；原木音箱與琴體天然物理共鳴；古蹟空間跨越時空與後人的心靈共鳴；敲擊面板聆聽自然震動之木材共鳴音色；調諧大廳自然空腔共鳴頻率 (消除低頻駐波)；音樂穿透耳膜觸動心靈深處之精神情感共鳴

explains.en: A sound can grow stronger when an object vibrates at a matching rate. A singer may make a glass ring with a clear note. The shape and material affect the sound.
A bell keeps sounding after it is struck because it vibrates. The sound seems to fill the room. Walls can reflect it back.
An idea may create a strong feeling because it connects with people’s experiences. A story about friendship can touch many readers. The word can describe this emotional connection too.

examples.en: Watching the legendary musical performed live in Taipei was an unforgettable milestone for our family.
examples.zh: 在台北國家戲劇院親眼目睹這部傳奇世界名劇現場演出，成為我們全家人一生難忘的珍貴回憶。

examples.en: Backpacking along the pristine East Coast Trail gave us unforgettable memories of sea cliffs and sunrises.
examples.zh: 背著行囊沿著壯麗的花東阿朗壹古道健行跋涉，為我們留下了太平洋海蝕懸崖與旭日東昇難忘的壯闊回憶。

examples.en: The singer thanked her devoted fans for an unforgettable evening filled with shared tears and laughter.
examples.zh: 這位實力派情歌天后在小巨蛋演唱會謝幕時，由衷感謝全場歌迷朋友共同締造了這一夜歡笑與熱淚交織的難忘時光。

entries.definition: 烙印一生的難忘劇院體驗

explains.en: An experience that is very special and stays in someone’s memory has this quality. It may be exciting or moving. People often tell others about it.
The class watched the sun rise from a hilltop. They shared warm bread and took photos. The trip stayed in their minds.
A kind act can also leave a strong memory. Years later, someone may still recall how it felt. Personal moments can matter most.

examples.en: Masterful symphonic climaxes transport the listening soul toward moments of spiritual transcendence.
examples.zh: 偉大交響樂章在高潮時排山倒海而來的壯麗音浪，引領著聆聽者的靈魂抵達昇華超脫的崇高境界。

examples.en: The philosopher wrote extensively about humanity's innate longing for spiritual transcendence and cosmic connection.
examples.zh: 這位當代哲學家在其巨著中深入論述了人類靈魂深處對於精神超脫超越、以及與浩瀚宇宙融為一體的內在渴望。

examples.en: Her awe-inspiring solo dance performance achieved an ethereal quality of physical transcendence over gravity.
examples.zh: 她那場令人肅然起敬的現代獨舞專場演出，展現出一種超脫肉體極限、彷彿完全克服地球重力的空靈昇華境界。

examples.en: Dedicating one's life to humanitarian service offers a sublime sense of spiritual transcendence.
examples.zh: 將有限的生命全心奉獻於人道救援與公共福祉，能獲得昇華超越小我（Transcendence）的崇高精神體驗。

examples.en: The breathtaking choral symphony finale lifted listeners into a realm of pure emotional transcendence.
examples.zh: 當氣勢磅礡的合唱交響曲演奏至最神聖壯麗的終章樂段，將全場愛樂聽眾引領進純粹情感昇華超脫的非凡意境。

examples.en: Through profound selfless love and sacrifice, parents experience a transformative form of personal transcendence.
examples.zh: 透過毫無保留的無私大愛與默默奉獻，天下為人父母者在撫育新生命的歲月中經歷了一場深刻的心靈自我超越與昇華。

examples.en: The final choral movement swept the audience into an overwhelming state of spiritual transcendence.
examples.zh: 貝多芬第九號交響曲終曲合唱響徹大廳的瞬間，將全場觀眾帶入一種難以言喻的「靈魂昇華超越境界」（Transcendence）。

examples.en: Great literature achieves philosophical transcendence by addressing universal human longings across eras.
examples.zh: 真正不朽的偉大文學經典之所以能超越時空維度，正在於其直指千百年來人類心靈共通的愛恨渴求與終極追尋。

examples.en: Mountain climbers reaching the misty Himalayan summit experienced moments of breathtaking mental transcendence.
examples.zh: 登山家歷經千辛萬苦終於登上雲霧繚繞的喜馬拉雅極峰之巔時，身心體會到了一種無與倫比、超脫塵世的靈魂昇華。

entries.definition: 昇華靈魂的超越境界；卓越；昇華利他超越小我之境界；聆聽終曲全場合唱之靈魂昇華超越感

explains.en: Some thinkers describe going beyond ordinary limits or everyday experience. A person may feel connected to something greater than the self. This idea appears in religion and philosophy.
An artist may try to rise above familiar rules and ways of seeing. The work suggests a higher or more complete state. This noun names the act of moving beyond limits.
Meditation can help people feel that they have passed beyond ordinary thoughts. They may describe a deep spiritual experience. It points to reaching beyond normal human concerns.

examples.en: Live theater is a living, breathing art form that exists uniquely in the magic of the present moment.
examples.zh: 現場戲劇是一種活生生、充滿呼吸心跳的活體藝術形式，其最迷人之處就在於稍縱即逝的當下魔力。

examples.en: The ancient indigenous tribal village functions as a living museum where ancient weaving rituals persist today.
examples.zh: 這座深山裡歷史悠久的泰雅族傳統部落宛如一座鮮活的活態生態博物館，千百年的編織手藝至今依舊代代相傳。

examples.en: Skyrocketing housing rent and food prices pushed the local cost of living to historic highs across the capital.
examples.zh: 首都都會區不斷飆漲的房屋租金與外食餐飲物價，將一般市井小民的生活物價成本推升至歷史新高水準。

entries.definition: 充滿生命力的活體當下藝術

explains.en: A stage performance happens in front of an audience and can change a little each night. The art exists in the moment.
A village keeps old weaving customs in use today. Visitors can see the traditions practiced.
A family earns money through teaching and selling crafts. The word can also describe their livelihood.

examples.en: High-mountain oolong cultivated above 1,500 meters yields a floral aroma and sweet aftertaste.
examples.zh: 生長在海拔一千五百公尺高山雲霧間的高山烏龍茶，散發高雅幽蘭清香且喉韻回甘綿長。

examples.en: Dong Ding oolong from Nantou is renowned for its amber liquor and rich, roasted flavor.
examples.zh: 產自南投鹿谷的凍頂烏龍茶，以其澄澈金黃偏琥珀色茶湯與醇厚甘潤的炭焙熟果香聞名遐邇。

examples.en: Overseas tourists often purchase vacuum-sealed tins of Taiwanese oolong as premium souvenirs.
examples.zh: 許多遠道而來的國際觀光客，特地指名選購真空罐裝的頂級台灣高山烏龍茶作為餽贈親友的伴手禮。

entries.definition: 烏龍茶（如高山烏龍、凍頂烏龍）

explains.en: This tea is made from leaves that are partly oxidized before they are dried. Its taste can fall between green and dark tea. The flavor changes with how it is prepared.
A tea maker rolls and warms the leaves to develop their smell and taste. Different methods create different aromas. People often drink it without milk.
A cup may have a floral, roasted, or fruity scent. The leaves are steeped in hot water for a short time. The color can range from light gold to deep amber.

examples.en: Tiny green leafhoppers bite tea leaves, triggering the natural honey aroma of Oriental Beauty tea.
examples.zh: 微小的小綠葉蟬叮咬著涎幼嫩茶芽，促使茶樹啟動防禦機制合成出東方美人茶獨特的天然蜜香。

examples.en: Tea farmers avoid chemical pesticides so that beneficial green leafhoppers can thrive in their orchards.
examples.zh: 堅持生態友善的有機茶農嚴格杜絕化學農藥噴灑，讓小綠葉蟬能夠在茶園生態系中自然繁衍生息。

examples.en: The natural defensive reaction of plants bitten by the leafhopper produces rare sweet aromatic terpenes.
examples.zh: 茶樹嫩葉在遭到小綠葉蟬叮咬後所誘發的天然防禦代謝反應，合成了極其罕見芬芳的天然蜜香單萜類化合物。

entries.definition: 小綠葉蟬（小綠葉蟬叮咬產生蜜香）

explains.en: This small insect lives on plants and jumps when disturbed. It feeds by sucking liquid from leaves. Some kinds affect crops.
A farmer spotted tiny green insects under the tea leaves. He checked the plants carefully. The insects had made small marks.
Some varieties feed on tea plants and can change the leaves’ aroma. Farmers monitor them closely. Their effects depend on the plant and growing conditions.

examples.en: Expert harvesters carefully collect hand-picked tender shoots consisting of two leaves and a bud.
examples.zh: 採茶阿姨戴著斗笠穿梭茶園，以純熟手藝採集「一心二葉」頂級純手工採摘嫩芽。

examples.en: High-mountain tea requires hand-picked harvesting because steep rocky terraces make mechanical picking impossible.
examples.zh: 阿里山與梨山等高海拔茶區由於地形陡峭險峻，無法使用採茶機作業，完全仰賴採茶師傅純手工採摘。

examples.en: The festival organizers featured a hand-picked selection of indie bands from across the island.
examples.zh: 音樂祭策展主辦團隊從全島數百組報名樂團中，精挑細選出一組組最具原創魅力的獨立樂團登場獻藝。

entries.definition: 純手工採摘一心二葉的

explains.en: A worker chooses each fruit carefully instead of gathering it with a machine. The best pieces are selected one by one. This describes careful personal selection.
A coach chooses a small group of players after watching them closely. Each person is selected for a particular reason. The group was chosen with care.
A shop owner selects special items from many choices. The collection reflects the owner’s judgment. Nothing is chosen at random.

examples.en: Rhythmic bamboo tray tossing gently bruises leaf edges, promoting controlled enzymatic oxidation.
examples.zh: 製茶師傅徹夜以雙手規律搖晃竹篩進行「浪茶做青」，使茶葉邊緣碰撞摩擦並展開適度酵素氧化。

examples.en: The tea master stayed up all night, alternating tossing and resting intervals based on ambient humidity.
examples.zh: 製茶大師整夜未眠守候在製茶廠，依據半夜溫濕度變化敏銳調整浪青與靜置的頻率與力道。

examples.en: He spent an anxious night tossing and turning in bed, unable to sleep before the job interview.
examples.zh: 在即將迎來關鍵求職面試的前一晚，他整個人焦慮地在床上輾轉反側、徹夜難以成眠。

entries.definition: 浪茶做青；搖青工法；拋擲

explains.en: A tea maker gently shakes leaves in a bamboo tray so their edges become bruised. This step helps develop flavor.
A person moves a blanket back and forth in bed while unable to sleep. The word also describes restless movement.
A player throws a ball lightly to a teammate. The verb can describe throwing or moving something gently.

examples.en: High-temperature panning fixation halts enzyme activity, locking in fresh botanical flavors permanently.
examples.zh: 將萎凋發酵完成的茶葉放入高溫滾筒進行炒熱「殺青」（Fixation），能及時鈍化酵素以鎖定茶香。

examples.en: Precise timing during fixation ensures that green tea retains its vibrant emerald shade without scorching.
examples.zh: 殺青炒茶時對鍋溫與時間的精準掌控至關重要，能確保碧螺春綠茶保有翠綠鮮嫩色澤且不致焦苦。

examples.en: The tech executive had an unhealthy fixation on tracking real-time daily stock ticker fluctuations.
examples.zh: 這位科技公司高層對每天即時股價走勢的漲跌震盪產生了一種近乎病態的執著與焦慮關注。

entries.definition: 殺青炒青（高溫高溫鍋炒滅酶）

explains.en: Tea leaves are heated soon after picking to stop the natural changes that would continue inside them. This keeps their color and flavor from changing too much. The leaves may then be rolled and dried.
A tea maker places fresh leaves in a hot pan and moves them quickly. The heat slows an enzyme in the leaves. Timing affects the final taste.
In science, this word can mean stopping a natural process by heat or chemicals. It also has other meanings, such as a strong repeated focus. The field gives the clue.

examples.en: Traditional charcoal roasting over aged longan wood infuses Tieguanyin with deep smoky caramelized notes.
examples.zh: 遵循百年古法採用老龍眼木炭慢火細烘，賦予正欉鐵觀音醇厚濃郁的熟果炭香與焦糖風味。

examples.en: Specialty coffee shops take pride in small-batch roasting to accentuate single-origin citrus notes.
examples.zh: 精品獨立自家烘焙咖啡館堅持小批量精密烘豆，致力於完美凸顯單一產區咖啡豆特有的柑橘花果香。

examples.en: The holiday feast featured sweet honey-glazed ham and slow roasting root vegetables in the oven.
examples.zh: 年終感恩節豐盛晚宴上，烤箱裡端出了蜜汁慢烤金黃火腿與滋味鮮甜的慢火烘烤根莖時蔬。

examples.en: Light profile roasting preserves delicate floral aroma precursors without introducing smoky charred tastes.
examples.zh: 精準的淺度曲線烘焙，完整保留生豆纖細的花果芳香物質且完全無焦苦煙燻雜味。

examples.en: Advanced software plots real-time roasting curves, helping artisans replicate award-winning profiles consistently.
examples.zh: 先進數位烘豆軟體即時繪製升溫曲線，協助烘豆名師在每批烘焙中分秒不差重現冠軍烘焙曲線。

examples.en: Roasting transforms raw, grassy green seeds into aromatic, brittle brown beans brimming with volatile oils.
examples.zh: 烘焙工藝將青澀生硬的咖啡生豆，化腐朽為神奇蛻變為散發誘人芳香、飽含芳香揮發油的熟成咖啡豆。

entries.definition: 龍眼木炭焙烘焙；烘烤；數位曲線精準烘焙工藝 (RoR 升溫速率調控)

explains.en: Cooking food with dry heat in an oven or over a fire is this method. Vegetables and meat can be prepared this way. The outside may turn brown.
Dad placed potatoes in a hot oven with oil and herbs. They became tender inside. The family ate them with dinner.
Coffee beans are also heated to develop their flavor. The time and temperature change the taste. After heating, the beans are cooled.

examples.en: Professional tea tasters brew delicate oolongs in a thin white porcelain gaiwan for neutral tasting.
examples.zh: 專業評茶師愛用胎薄細膩的景德鎮純白瓷蓋碗，能不搶味地真實展現茶葉最純粹的花果原味。

examples.en: Tilting the gaiwan's saucer and lid allows a steady stream of amber tea to pour without splashing.
examples.zh: 巧妙運用拇指與中指扣住蓋碗邊緣並微調碗蓋縫隙，即可讓澄澈琥珀茶湯平穩傾瀉而出而不噴濺。

examples.en: Unlike clay teapots, an enamel gaiwan does not retain aromas, allowing brewers to switch teas freely.
examples.zh: 與容易吸味的紫砂陶壺不同，高溫白瓷蓋碗完全不吸附茶香殘味，讓茶師能隨心所欲輪替沖泡各類茶品。

entries.definition: 白瓷蓋碗（精準評茶與聞香）

explains.en: This lidded Chinese cup is used to steep and drink tea. Its small saucer helps protect the hands from heat. The lid can hold back the leaves while sipping.
A tea drinker places leaves in a bowl-shaped cup and adds hot water. A cover keeps the leaves inside as the drink is poured. The vessel comes from China.
Traditional tea service may use a small cup with a lid and matching dish. The drinker can lift the cover slightly while taking a sip. It is designed for preparing tea.

examples.en: First infusion steeping takes exactly forty-five seconds before pouring into cups.
examples.zh: 第一泡茶湯浸泡四十五秒後俐落出湯，能完美釋放茶葉初次舒展時最芬芳高雅的頭道香氣。

examples.en: Extending steeping time excessively extracts bitter tannins, overpowering the tea's natural sweetness.
examples.zh: 倘若浸泡時間過長，會將茶葉深層苦澀單寧酸過度萃取出來，進而掩蓋掉高山茶先天的甘甜喉韻。

examples.en: Traditional herbal remedies often require prolonged hot water steeping to dissolve active botanical compounds.
examples.zh: 傳統漢方草本養生茶包，通常需要以保溫杯長時間滾水悶泡，方能充分溶出根莖植物的有效活性成分。

explains.en: Leave tea leaves in hot water for a short time, then pour the drink into cups. Longer soaking can change the taste.
A cook places herbs in hot water so their flavor enters the liquid. Strain the pieces before serving.
This process lets a food or herb rest in liquid to release its flavor. Follow the recipe for the right time.

examples.en: True Oriental Beauty delivers a distinct sweet muscatel grape and wild blossom flavor notes.
examples.zh: 正宗頂級新竹北埔東方美人茶，入口散發令人陶醉的天然麝香葡萄熟果香與野蜂蜜甜香。

examples.en: Darjeeling second-flush black teas are celebrated around the globe for their rare muscatel character.
examples.zh: 印度大吉嶺著名的夏摘次採紅茶，同樣因其在特定天候下孕育出的稀世珍貴麝香葡萄熟果蜜香而享譽全球。

examples.en: Wine tasters detected refreshing muscatel grape undertones in the chilled sparkling white wine.
examples.zh: 專業侍酒師在這款冰鎮白氣泡酒中，敏銳捕捉到了清新爽朗的麝香葡萄果香與白花芬芳底蘊。

entries.definition: 東方美人麝香葡萄熟果蜜香的

explains.en: A sweet smell like ripe grapes or musk can describe some tea aromas. Tasters use this word for a rich fruity scent. The flavor may remind them of honey.
A grape variety with a fragrant, sweet taste is used for some wines and raisins. Its name can describe that grape or a wine made from it. The scent is distinctive.
A tea drinker notices a ripe fruit aroma with a honey-like note. The smell lingers after a sip. The tasting term describes this kind of scent.

examples.en: Naturally rich L-theanine amino acids promote alpha brain waves, inducing calm and focused clarity.
examples.zh: 茶葉中富含的天然「茶胺酸」（L-theanine），能激發大腦α波，營造放鬆卻高度專注的寧靜心境。

examples.en: Japanese matcha green tea contains high concentrations of theanine because tea bushes are shaded before harvest.
examples.zh: 日本宇治頂級抹茶粉之所以蘊藏極高濃度的茶胺酸，關鍵在於採收前數週茶樹經過嚴格的黑網遮光覆蓋。

examples.en: Health supplements combine theanine with natural caffeine to provide steady mental energy without coffee jitters.
examples.zh: 現代機能性保健食品將天然茶胺酸與適量咖啡因黃金配搭，能在提神醒腦的同時徹底消除心悸與焦躁感。

entries.definition: 茶胺酸（促進大腦放鬆專注）

explains.en: This amino acid occurs naturally in tea leaves. Researchers study how it may affect relaxation and attention. Tea contains different amounts.
Maya drank green tea while reading. She liked its mild taste. Her teacher explained that leaves contain many natural substances.
Shade-grown tea leaves may have more of this compound. Food studies examine its effects carefully. It is not a replacement for medical care.

examples.en: Green tea polyphenols and catechins provide powerful cellular antioxidant protection against aging.
examples.zh: 未發酵三峽碧螺春綠茶中蘊含豐富的天然兒茶素（Catechin），具備極佳的抗氧化與促進新陳代謝功效。

examples.en: Clinical nutrition studies show that daily catechin intake can assist in body weight and visceral fat management.
examples.zh: 臨床營養醫學實證研究顯示，每天定量攝取天然兒茶素多酚，有助於調節生理機能並輔助體脂管理。

examples.en: High water temperatures rapidly extract catechin compounds from dry whole tea leaves during brewing.
examples.zh: 滾燙的沸水能在短時間內高效率萃取出原片茶葉中的兒茶素精華，為茶湯注入豐富天然植化素。

entries.definition: 兒茶素 (EGCG 抗氧化多酚)

explains.en: This natural plant compound belongs to a group of substances found in tea leaves. Scientists study it for its effects on the body. Green tea contains it.
A cup of green tea provides a plant-based substance that researchers examine. It is one kind of flavonoid. The compound also occurs in some fruits.
Plants make this antioxidant, and tea is a familiar source. It may help protect cells from damage in laboratory studies. Researchers continue to investigate its health effects.

examples.en: Pairing roasted Tieguanyin with traditional pineapple cakes balances rich butter with brisk tea tannins.
examples.zh: 以濃香炭焙鐵觀音佐以微酸土鳳梨酥，茶湯中的天然單寧酸能巧妙解膩，形成相得益彰的茶點絕配。

examples.en: The sommelier suggested an exquisite cheese and wine pairing for the anniversary dinner course.
examples.zh: 專業侍酒師為這場結婚週年浪漫紀念晚宴的法式主菜，推薦了令人驚艷的陳年乳酪與熟成紅酒風味餐酒搭。

examples.en: Bluetooth pairing between your smartphone and the wireless noise-canceling headphones completes in seconds.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機與最新款真無線降噪耳機之間的藍牙配對（Pairing），只需輕開充電盒蓋短短數秒內即自動連線。

examples.en: Food pairing algorithms suggest combining white chocolate and caviar because both share trimethylamine molecules.
examples.zh: 「食材科學風味搭配學」（Food Pairing），發現白巧克力與魚子醬因共享三甲胺分子而能碰撞出絕妙和諧。

examples.en: The certified sommelier suggested an impeccable wine pairing of dry Riesling with spicy Sichuan seafood.
examples.zh: 認證侍酒師精準推薦了絕佳的餐酒搭配：以干型麗絲玲白酒佐搭鮮辣濃郁的川味海鮮。

examples.en: Bluetooth pairing between your smartphone and the wireless noise-canceling headphones takes just seconds.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機與抗噪無線耳機之間的藍牙配對連線，只需短短數秒鐘即可順利完成。

entries.definition: 茶點佐茶美食搭配美學；基於氣味分子化學質譜之食材風味科學搭配學；配對

explains.en: A tea shop suggests serving a roasted drink with pineapple cake because the flavors balance. The combination can make each taste better.
A restaurant expert recommends a dry drink with spicy seafood. The two flavors work well together.
A phone connects to wireless headphones after the user selects them from a list. The devices become linked.

examples.en: Simple bamboo utensils and handmade cups exude understated oriental elegance.
examples.zh: 簡約質樸的天然竹製茶則與手捏陶杯，在茶席間散發出低調內斂、韻味悠長的東方古典優雅美學。

examples.en: The elderly ballerina walked into the room with an upright posture and effortless natural elegance.
examples.zh: 雖然年過八旬，這位傳奇芭蕾女伶步入會場時依然身姿挺拔修長，舉手投足間流露出一種渾然天成的優雅氣質。

examples.en: The mathematician solved the complex topology theorem with breathtaking algebraic elegance.
examples.zh: 這位數學大師以極其洗鍊優美且無懈可擊的代數推導邏輯，漂亮解開了困擾學界半世紀的複雜拓撲學猜想。

examples.en: The flowing silver roof sweeps gracefully across the landscape with majestic architectural elegance.
examples.zh: 衛武營銀白色的流線屋頂如巨浪般在平原上優雅起伏，展現出極致的「現代建築優雅美感」（Elegance）。

examples.en: She walked down the gala staircase with effortless dignity and timeless personal elegance.
examples.zh: 她步下晚宴中央旋轉樓梯時儀態雍容大方，舉手投足間流露出一股歷久彌新、優雅迷人的高貴氣度。

examples.en: The mathematician solved the unsolved riddle using a proof praised by peers for its simplicity and elegance.
examples.zh: 這位青年數學大師成功破解了懸而未決的千古幾何難題，其論證過程因質樸精純而深獲同儕讚譽其優雅無雙。

entries.definition: 茶藝生活雅緻品味；優雅；衛武營如巨大白浪翻湧起伏之建築曲線優雅美感

explains.en: A person or object can have graceful beauty without looking busy or showy. Smooth lines and simple details may create this effect. Good manners can show it too.
A dancer moves with ease and balance across the room. The gentle steps look refined. The audience watches quietly.
A clear solution can use very few steps to solve a hard problem. People may admire its simplicity and clever design. The word can describe this quality.

examples.en: Experienced tea tasters possess a refined palate capable of identifying slight harvest elevations.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的資深評茶大師擁有極其敏銳的味蕾鑑賞力，僅憑一口茶湯便能分辨出茶園海拔高度差異。

examples.en: Cleansing your palate with iced soda water between wine courses ensures unbiased taste discrimination.
examples.zh: 在不同產區美酒佳餚品嚐之間以冰氣泡水漱口清口，能恢復味蕾靈敏度以確保品評不受前道菜干擾。

examples.en: The hot melted mozzarella cheese on the freshly baked pizza burned the delicate roof of his palate.
examples.zh: 剛從高溫石窯端出來的現烤披薩上滾燙融化的莫札瑞拉起司，不小心燙傷了他嬌嫩的上顎黏膜。

examples.en: A sharp, herbaceous citrus granite serves as an icy palate cleanser between heavy courses.
examples.zh: 一球冰涼酸爽的青檸香草碎冰，在厚重主菜轉換之間扮演著洗滌並喚醒「味蕾敏銳度」（Palate）的關鍵角色。

examples.en: Master blenders develop a refined palate capable of discerning microscopic differences in scotch cask aging.
examples.zh: 首席調酒大師培養出了極其敏銳細緻的品味味覺，能精準洞察威士忌在不同橡木桶陳釀間的細微差別。

examples.en: Spicy chili paste overwhelmed his gentle palate, making it impossible to taste the subtle seafood seasoning.
examples.zh: 辛辣的生辣椒醬完全麻痺了他纖細敏感的味蕾，使他根本無法品嚐出海鮮湯頭中清雅的天然甘甜。

entries.definition: 敏銳味蕾品味鑑賞力；上顎；上主菜前喚醒並洗滌味蕾之青檸羅勒雪酪；味蕾

explains.en: The roof of the mouth helps with tasting and speaking. The word can also mean someone’s sense of taste. A food expert may have a trained one.
The doctor asked the child to open wide and looked inside the mouth. She checked the roof for soreness. The child felt better afterward.
A cook may develop a taste for subtle flavors. Trying new foods can broaden it. Water between samples helps keep flavors clear.

examples.en: Infuse freshly boiled water across twisted leaves to release their hidden fragrance.
examples.zh: 將剛煮沸的純淨滾水沿著壺壁輕柔注入，喚醒蜷曲茶葉中深藏的千百種芬芳分子。

examples.en: The charismatic new school principal worked tirelessly to infuse fresh enthusiasm and creativity into the curriculum.
examples.zh: 這位滿懷遠大教育熱忱的新校長親力親為，努力為沉悶傳統的校園課程注入全新的活力與跨領域創新。

examples.en: The bartender infused premium London dry gin with fresh rosemary twigs and cucumber slices for forty-eight hours.
examples.zh: 調酒師將頂級倫敦琴酒與新鮮迷迭香枝條及清爽黃瓜片一同浸漬封存四十八小時，萃取出芬芳草本底蘊。

entries.definition: 注入滾水沖泡；浸潤灌輸

explains.en: Place tea leaves in hot water so their taste moves into the drink. The water takes on their color and flavor. You can remove the leaves before serving.
A cook leaves herbs in warm oil to give it a new taste. The liquid slowly absorbs the herbs’ flavor. Time helps the transfer happen.
A teacher may try to fill a class with confidence and curiosity. These qualities can be passed into the group over time. The verb can also mean to introduce a feeling or quality.

examples.en: Watch tight tea spheres gently unfurl into whole, emerald green leaves inside the glass pot.
examples.zh: 透過透明玻璃茶壺，靜靜欣賞緊結的茶球在熱水中如花朵般緩緩舒展綻放為完整的翠綠嫩葉。

examples.en: The crew climbed the ship's rigging to unfurl massive canvas sails as favorable trade winds picked up.
examples.zh: 當宜人的順風信風驟然揚起，甲板上的水手們俐落攀上高聳桅杆繩梯，奮力展開巨大的帆布風帆啟航。

examples.en: A breathtaking mountain panorama unfurled before our eyes as the morning mist lifted from the peak.
examples.zh: 當清晨高山上的濃重雲霧隨風漸漸散去，一幅壯麗非凡的中央山脈連峰全景在我們眼前徐徐展開。

entries.definition: 茶葉在熱水中緩緩舒展綻放

explains.en: Tight tea leaves slowly open in hot water and reveal their whole shape. The change is easy to watch in a glass pot.
A crew climbs a ship’s rigging and opens the large sails when the wind is right. The cloth spreads out.
Morning mist lifts to reveal a wide mountain view. The scene gradually opens before the hikers.

examples.en: Years of clean cellar storage made the aged tea exceptionally mellow and smooth on the throat.
examples.zh: 歷經多年無異味通風乾燥儲存，這款陳年老烏龍茶湯口感變得格外溫潤醇厚、絲滑順喉。

examples.en: As he matured into his fifties, his youthful fiery temper mellowed into gentle, patient wisdom.
examples.zh: 隨著年歲邁入沉穩知天命的五十歲，他早年剛烈急躁的火爆脾氣逐漸轉化為慈眉善目的謙和與包容智慧。

examples.en: Mellow acoustic guitar melodies played softly in the background while diners enjoyed dinner.
examples.zh: 溫暖醇厚的原聲木吉他旋律在餐廳背景中如流水般輕柔流淌，營造出無比放鬆愜意的用餐氛圍。

entries.definition: 茶湯口感溫潤醇厚圓融的

explains.en: A flavor or sound can be soft, smooth, and not harsh. A ripe fruit may taste gentle and sweet. A quiet guitar can have a warm tone.
As a person becomes calmer and kinder over time, their temper may soften. Friends notice that they react less angrily. Experience can change someone.
A maker can let tea or another food rest until its sharp taste becomes smoother. Time may soften strong flavors. The result feels round and gentle.

examples.en: Spring Bi Luo Chun delivers a crisp, lively morning freshness bursting with green energy.
examples.zh: 早春採摘的三峽碧螺春帶有一股鮮爽明亮、生氣蓬勃的草木鮮綠氣息，為早晨注入滿滿活力。

examples.en: We took an early morning walk through the tea orchard, breathing in the crisp mountain air.
examples.zh: 清晨一大早我們漫步在雲霧飄渺的茶園步道間，深深呼吸著略帶寒意卻極致純淨的高山清新冷空氣。

examples.en: The chef served golden, crisp Taiwanese fried chicken cutlets dusted with fragrant white pepper and basil.
examples.zh: 主廚端上剛起鍋、炸至金黃酥脆的經典台式大雞排，撒上滿滿香濃白胡椒鹽與酥炸九層塔，令人食指大動。

entries.definition: 春茶鮮爽清新明亮的；脆的

explains.en: Food that breaks with a fresh, firm snap has this quality. A newly picked apple may feel that way. The opposite is soft or soggy.
The child bit into a fresh carrot. It made a sharp crunch. She dipped the pieces in hummus.
The word can also describe cool, fresh air or a clear sound. Autumn mornings often feel cool and fresh. A clear photo may show sharp details.

examples.en: Rapid urbanization requires smart transit planning and expanded green parks to maintain livability.
examples.zh: 面對快速都市化進程，必須透過完善的大眾運輸規劃與開闢都會綠地公園以維繫宜居生活品質。

examples.en: Over the last four decades, rapid urbanization transformed quiet farming hamlets into bustling tech suburbs.
examples.zh: 在過去四十年間，飛速推進的都市化發展將原本純樸寧靜的傳統農業小村落蛻變為熱鬧非凡的科技副都心。

examples.en: Sociologists analyze how rural migration and rapid urbanization impact intergenerational living arrangements.
examples.zh: 社會學學者深入探討農村青年人口外移與都市化擴張趨勢，如何重塑當代跨世代家庭居住與奉養模式。

explains.en: As people move from villages to towns, cities grow larger. New homes, roads, and services are built to meet their needs. This change turns rural areas into more city-like places.
A farming village may become a busy town with factories and apartments. More people live close together and use city services. This process changes how a region is settled.
When a country develops, its cities may expand into nearby land. Many residents leave rural communities to find work. The growth of city life is described by this term.

examples.en: Permeable asphalt pavement absorbs torrential monsoon rainwater, recharging underground aquifers.
examples.zh: 鋪設於人行道與停車場的透水瀝青鋪面，能在瞬間吸收傾盆豪雨並涵養地表地下水源。

examples.en: Installing permeable interlocking bricks in parking plazas eliminates standing puddles after heavy storms.
examples.zh: 在商業購物廣場戶外停車場全面鋪設高透水性連鎖磚，徹底消除了夏季午後雷陣雨過後的積水坑窪。

examples.en: Biological cell membranes are selectively permeable, allowing essential nutrients to enter while blocking toxins.
examples.zh: 生物細胞膜具備高度精密的選擇性半透性（Permeable），能在吸收關鍵營養分子的同時堅決阻隔有害毒素。

examples.en: Paving sidewalks with porous permeable interlocking pavers allows heavy rainfall to soak straight into aquifers.
examples.zh: 人行道全面改鋪多孔隙透水連鎖磚，讓豪雨能瞬間滲透至地底補注地下水層。

examples.en: Installing a permeable gravel driveway prevents stormwater from ponding around garage doors.
examples.zh: 在車道鋪設多孔隙透水碎石基底，能徹底防止強烈暴雨水在車庫大門周邊產生積水倒灌。

examples.en: Permeable pavements filter hydrocarbons naturally while recharging depleted local groundwater reserves.
examples.zh: 透水鋪面透氣透水，在過濾道路表面殘留碳氫油污的同時，默默滋養回補乾涸的地下蓄水層。

entries.definition: 透水鋪面人行道的；可滲透的；多孔隙透水瀝青與透水連鎖磚鋪面的

explains.en: Rain passes through porous pavement and soaks into the ground instead of forming puddles. This can help water drain.
A cell membrane lets some nutrients enter while keeping other substances out. It controls what can pass through.
Garden soil with small spaces lets water and air move through it. A solid surface does not allow this as easily.

examples.en: Underground storage cisterns collect filtered rooftop rainwater for landscape irrigation and toilet flushing.
examples.zh: 埋設於地下室的大容量雨水回收蓄水池（Cistern），將屋頂過濾雨水收集用於中庭花草澆灌與沖廁。

examples.en: Ancient Mediterranean fortresses relied on massive rock-cut cisterns to survive prolonged enemy sieges.
examples.zh: 建造在險峻懸崖上的古地中海軍事要塞，全賴在堅硬岩層中鑿出的大型地下蓄水槽來度過敵軍數月圍城。

examples.en: The plumber inspected the float valve inside the gravity-fed toilet cistern to resolve continuous leaking.
examples.zh: 水電師傅拆開檢查安裝於馬桶重力進水水箱內部的浮球進水閥，迅速排除了馬桶水箱持續漏水的問題。

entries.definition: 雨水回收蓄水池；貯水槽

explains.en: A large tank stores water for later use. It may collect rain from a roof or sit underground. People can use the saved water for gardens or washing.
An old town may keep water in a stone chamber during dry months. Workers carry it from the tank when needed. A cover helps keep dirt out.
A toilet may have a tank that holds water until the handle is pressed. The water then moves into the bowl. A float helps refill the tank.

examples.en: Exterior motorized aluminum louvers tilt automatically to block harsh glare while channeling indirect light.
examples.zh: 安裝於大樓外牆的電動鋁合金遮陽百葉（Louver），會隨太陽角度自動旋轉傾斜遮陽並漫射柔光。

examples.en: Modern wooden louvers on bedroom windows offer adjustable privacy without restricting cool night breezes.
examples.zh: 主臥房落地窗外側裝設的質感實木調整型百葉窗，能自由調節採光隱私，且絲毫不阻礙晚間涼爽夜風吹拂。

examples.en: Heavy industrial generator rooms require intake louvers with acoustic baffling to suppress machinery noise.
examples.zh: 大型高壓發電機機房通風進氣口必須加裝具備消音減震隔音片的外牆百葉，以有效抑制低頻運轉噪音。

examples.en: Motorized exterior louvers adjust angles automatically following the sun's trajectory to block direct glare.
examples.zh: 自動追日的智慧電動外遮陽百葉，能隨太陽角度靈活調整開合，俐落阻擋刺眼西曬熱量。

examples.en: Horizontal aluminum louvers shade south-facing windows, lowering indoor air temperatures in midsummer.
examples.zh: 安裝於朝南窗戶外側的水平鋁合金外遮陽百葉，在仲夏正午時分能有效降低室內溫度。

examples.en: Architects integrated perforated wooden louvers into the facade to ensure privacy without sacrificing airflow.
examples.zh: 建築師將穿孔木質遮陽百葉巧妙融入建築立面，在保障私人隱私的同時絲毫不犧牲微風對流。

entries.definition: 建築外遮陽百葉導光板；百葉窗；智慧感應外遮陽電動百葉窗 (擋西曬)

explains.en: Angled slats in a window or vent let air pass while blocking some sun or rain. They can be adjusted to change the light. Buildings use them on walls and windows.
The family tilted the window slats to let in a breeze. They kept the afternoon sun out. The room stayed comfortable.
Some models move automatically as the sun changes position. Others are fixed in place. Their angle affects airflow and shade.

examples.en: Practicing architectural circularity means designing modular walls that can be dismantled and reused entirely.
examples.zh: 實踐循環建築（Circularity）核心理念，意味著採用模組化乾式施工，讓建材在拆卸後可百分之百回收再利用。

examples.en: The fashion conglomerate adopted resource circularity by collecting old garments to spin recycled yarns.
examples.zh: 這家跨國時裝集團全面擁抱資源循環再生模式，在全台門市設置舊衣回收箱，將廢棄布料熔融重抽再生紗。

examples.en: Circularity principles prioritize durable product lifespans, easy repairability, and cradle-to-cradle recycling.
examples.zh: 搖籃到搖籃的循環經濟三大準則，極度強調產品經久耐用、易於拆解維修，以及生命週期終點的無限循環。

examples.en: Designing building joints for disassembly promotes circularity, allowing steel beams to be repurposed decades later.
examples.zh: 將梁柱接頭設計為易拆卸螺栓接合，實踐了營建循環經濟，五十年後鋼樑仍可拆卸完整重複使用。

examples.en: Emphasizing circularity eliminates the traditional 'take-make-waste' model in commercial real estate.
examples.zh: 倡導營建循環性理念，徹底顛覆了傳統不動產開發中「開採、製造、丟棄」的資源浪費線性模式。

examples.en: Circularity demands that every building material can be recycled or composted safely at the end of its life.
examples.zh: 建築循環經濟明確要求，每一件建材在建築物生命週期終結拆卸後，皆能安全回歸回收或堆肥再生。

entries.definition: 循環建築與建材回收思維；循環性；循環營建可拆解模組化循環經濟

explains.en: Products are designed so their materials can be repaired, reused, or recycled. This reduces waste and the need for new resources. The idea is central to a circular economy.
A builder plans walls that can be taken apart and used again elsewhere. Materials stay useful instead of being thrown away. This approach supports a repeating use of resources.
A clothing company collects old garments and makes new fabric from them. Materials return to production after use. This system keeps resources moving through repeated cycles.

examples.en: The self-sufficient eco-village operates its own smart solar microgrid equipped with backup battery storage.
examples.zh: 這座自給自足的綠色生態示範社區建置了專屬太陽能智慧微電網（Microgrid），並配備大型儲能系統。

examples.en: During island-wide power grid outages, the mountain clinic's microgrid kept critical vaccine freezers running.
examples.zh: 在全台無預警大規模分區停電期間，偏鄉深山衛生所的獨立自主微電網自動切離孤島運轉，確保疫苗不斷電。

examples.en: Integrating local rooftop solar with community microgrids strengthens regional energy resilience during typhoons.
examples.zh: 將社區屋頂太陽能分散式綠能與社區微電網深度融合，能顯著強化遭逢強烈颱風重創時的區域能源自主韌性。

examples.en: Island microgrids with rooftop solar and battery banks maintain continuous power during typhoon blackouts.
examples.zh: 離島與偏鄉原鄉部落建立的光儲一體智慧微電網，在颱風外線中斷時依然能獨立供電無虞。

examples.en: The university campus operates a standalone research microgrid that can disconnect from the utility grid at will.
examples.zh: 大學城校區內建一座前瞻實驗性獨立智慧微電網，在主電網跳電時可隨時無縫切換至孤島離網模式自保。

examples.en: During disaster relief, portable emergency microgrids supply power to hospitals and shelter centers.
examples.zh: 在重大地震災害緊急救援期間，機動型貨櫃式應急微電網能立即進駐為野戰醫院與避難所供應電力。

entries.definition: 智慧社區分散式微電網；偏鄉光儲一體智慧微電網 (自給自足)

explains.en: A village combines solar panels and batteries to make some of its own electricity. It can keep important services running during a blackout.
A clinic uses local power equipment to stay open when the main electricity network fails. The system can operate on its own.
A campus links nearby power sources and buildings in a small local network. It may connect to the larger grid or work separately.

examples.en: Peak shaving strategies discharge stored batteries during high-demand afternoon hours to prevent blackouts.
examples.zh: 實施智慧用電「削峰填谷」（Peak Shaving）策略，在夏季午後用電尖峰釋放儲能電力以防電網過載跳電。

examples.en: Using shaving foam and a triple-blade razor prevented skin irritation during his early morning grooming.
examples.zh: 在清晨梳洗時搭配綿密保濕刮鬍泡與三刀頭安全刮鬍刀，能有效避免面部肌膚產生紅腫刺痛感。

examples.en: Semiconductor fabrication plants participate in automated demand-response shaving to earn substantial power rebates.
examples.zh: 竹科大型半導體晶圓廠積極配合台電推動的需量反應削峰降載計畫，在減輕供電壓力的同時賺取高額電費扣減。

examples.en: Peak shaving discharges stored green electricity between 6:00 PM and 9:00 PM to replace dirty fossil generators.
examples.zh: 儲能削峰填谷在傍晚夜尖峰用電最高峰時釋放綠電，成功取代老舊高污染燃油發電機組。

examples.en: Industrial manufacturers deploy on-site batteries for peak shaving, cutting expensive contracted demand tariffs.
examples.zh: 大型鋼鐵與電子製造大廠在廠區自建儲能系統執行削峰填谷，大幅削減昂貴的超約附加基本電費。

examples.en: Peak shaving flattens load curves, allowing utilities to defer capital investments in redundant thermal turbines.
examples.zh: 透過儲能進行全網負載削峰填谷能平滑整體用電曲線，讓電力公司無需被迫擴建備而不用的大型火力機組。

entries.definition: 智慧用電削峰填谷；刮鬍子；尖峰用電削峰填谷轉移夜尖峰電力

explains.en: A person uses a blade or electric tool to remove short hairs from the face. Warm water can soften the skin first. Care helps prevent small cuts.
Tiny pieces are removed from wood or metal with a sharp tool. The worker checks the surface as the material comes off. Protective glasses keep the eyes safe.
A power company may lower its highest electricity use for a short time. This can ease pressure on the supply system. Homes can help by using less power during busy hours.

examples.en: Ground-source geothermal heat pumps utilize constant underground soil temperatures for ultra-efficient cooling.
examples.zh: 地源熱泵系統利用地下深處長年恆定的土壤溫度進行熱交換，為整座綠建築提供極致節能的中央空調。

examples.en: Taiwan’s volcanic Datun mountain range holds vast untapped potential for deep geothermal baseload electricity.
examples.zh: 台灣北部大屯火山群地底下蘊藏著龐大豐沛的深層地熱能源潛力，堪稱全天候穩定發電的天然潔淨基載電廠。

examples.en: The geothermal hot spring resort in Jiaoxi attracts thousands of weekend vacationers seeking mineral therapy.
examples.zh: 坐落於宜蘭礁溪以無色無味碳酸氫鈉泉著稱的地熱溫泉渡假聚落，每逢週末吸引大批旅客前來舒壓泡湯。

examples.en: Ground-source geothermal heat pumps leverage stable underground earth temperatures for efficient cooling.
examples.zh: 地源熱泵地熱系統，善用地底全年恆溫特性提供超高效率的冬暖夏涼空調。

examples.en: Drilling geothermal boreholes beneath the parking garage provides clean baseline heating throughout winter.
examples.zh: 在地下停車場下方鑽設地源熱泵垂直埋管，能在寒冬季節源源不絕提供零碳排放的基礎恆溫暖氣。

examples.en: Geothermal heating reduces heating energy bills by sixty percent compared to conventional gas boilers.
examples.zh: 與傳統燃氣鍋爐相較，地源熱泵系統能為大型公共設施省下高達六成的暖房空調能源開支。

examples.en: Geothermal power plants harness heat trapped deep inside the Earth to generate continuous electricity.
examples.zh: 「地熱發電廠」（Geothermal Power Plants），汲取地底深處的高溫熱能，二十四小時源源不絕產出電力。

examples.en: Iceland heats nearly ninety percent of its homes using clean municipal geothermal hot water systems.
examples.zh: 冰島全境近九成的家庭住宅暖氣，皆全面仰賴城市潔淨地熱溫泉水管網進行低碳供暖。

examples.en: Volcanic regions across the Pacific Rim offer ideal geological conditions for developing geothermal energy.
examples.zh: 遍布環太平洋火環帶的火山地質區域，為大力開發深層地熱潔淨能源提供了絕佳的天然地質條件。

entries.definition: 地源熱泵淺層地熱的；地熱的；地源熱泵地熱恆溫空調系統的；零碳排全天候穩定發電之地熱能源的

explains.en: Heat from deep underground can warm water or buildings. Some power stations use it to make electricity. It is a natural energy source.
A town used hot water from below the ground to warm a public pool. Visitors swam even on cool days. The system used little fuel.
In some areas, heat from Earth can provide steady power. Engineers study the ground before building a plant. Careful design protects nearby land.

examples.en: Centralized magnetic-bearing water chillers cool twenty commercial buildings with optimal energy efficiency.
examples.zh: 導入磁懸浮離心式大型冰水主機（Chiller）建立區域集中供冷系統，能源運轉效率比個別分離式冷氣高出一倍。

examples.en: Facility managers perform monthly maintenance on central centrifugal water chillers before the hot summer begins.
examples.zh: 商業辦公大樓機電廠務主管在酷熱夏季降臨前，提早針對中央離心式冰水主機展開全系統清洗保養。

examples.en: Movie lovers enjoyed a suspenseful murder-mystery chiller that kept everyone guessing until the final scene.
examples.zh: 週末影迷齊聚一堂欣賞了一部情節緊湊、扣人心弦的懸疑驚悚電影（Chiller），令人手心冒汗回味無窮。

entries.definition: 區域集中智慧大型冰水主機；冷卻器

explains.en: A large machine removes heat from water so a building can stay cool. Pipes carry the cooled water to rooms. It is part of an air-conditioning system.
In a big office, one central unit cools water for many floors. The water moves through pipes to help control the temperature. The equipment is used for cooling.
A factory may use a device to lower the temperature of liquid in a process. It takes heat away and sends the chilled fluid onward. This kind of machine is a cooling unit.

examples.en: Life cycle assessment calculated that timber framing halved the school building's total carbon footprint.
examples.zh: 經嚴謹的建築全生命週期碳盤查評估，改採木構結構工法使整座小學校舍的總碳足跡直接減半。

examples.en: Hiking groups practice 'Leave No Trace' ethics to leave only footprints and preserve untouched wilderness.
examples.zh: 登山健行愛好者嚴格遵守「無痕山林」（LNT）最高守則，在山林間只留足跡不留垃圾，守護原始荒野。

examples.en: The compact desktop computer has a tiny physical footprint that occupies very little space on crowded desks.
examples.zh: 這款迷你桌上型電腦主機體積極為精巧，在擁擠狹窄的辦公桌面上僅佔據極小面積的實體佔用空間。

examples.en: Geothermal power stations boast a minimal land footprint compared to sprawling solar farms or wind fields.
examples.zh: 相較於廣大佔地的太陽能光電場或風場，地熱發電廠擁有極小、極友善環境的「地表佔地足跡」（Footprint）。

examples.en: Switching from red meat to seasonal plant-based proteins lowers an individual's personal carbon footprint.
examples.zh: 在日常飲食中減少紅肉攝取並改吃在地當季植物性蛋白，能顯著降低個人的生活碳足跡。

examples.en: Fresh muddy bear footprints marked the damp soil along the edge of the rushing mountain creek.
examples.zh: 巡山員在湍急高山溪流旁的潮濕泥濘地上，清晰發現了幾枚剛留下的新鮮巨大台灣黑熊腳印足跡。

entries.definition: 建築全生命週期碳足跡；足跡；佔地極小可與周遭森林農業共融之地表足跡

explains.en: Walking on a muddy path leaves marks in the soil. Hikers try to avoid damaging the wild area.
A school measures how much carbon its buildings and travel produce. It can look for ways to reduce that impact.
A small computer takes up little desk space, while a large factory may use much more land. The word can describe size or impact.

examples.en: Sourcing local Taiwanese timber reduces the embodied carbon generated during transoceanic shipping.
examples.zh: 優先採購台灣在地林場疏伐認證木材，能大幅降低跨國遠洋航運所產生的建材「蘊含碳排」（Embodied Carbon）。

examples.en: Architects choose fly-ash concrete and recycled structural steel to minimize overall embodied carbon in high-rises.
examples.zh: 綠建築大師精選高爐飛灰綠混凝土與電爐回收環保鋼骨，竭力壓低現代摩天大樓結構中的整體隱含蘊含碳。

examples.en: The wise retired judge embodied integrity, compassion, and unwavering dedication to social justice throughout his career.
examples.zh: 這位受人景仰的德高望重退休大法官，一生身體力行具體體現了公正不阿、悲天憫人與捍衛正義的高尚情操。

examples.en: Swapping Portland cement for mass timber slashes the structure’s upfront embodied carbon by forty percent.
examples.zh: 將傳統波特蘭水泥置換為重型木構建材，能直接削減整棟建築前期四成的建材隱含碳。

examples.en: As operational energy efficiency improves, embodied carbon in building structures becomes the dominant emission source.
examples.zh: 隨著建築日常營運耗電能效大幅改善，隱藏在建材生產製造與運輸中的隱含碳排逐漸成為總碳排的最大元兇。

examples.en: Selecting locally harvested stone minimizes embodied carbon emissions tied to international freight transport.
examples.zh: 在地就地取材選用鄰近採石場的天然石材，能大幅降低因跨國海運貨櫃運輸所衍生的建材隱含碳。

entries.definition: 建材開採製造蘊含碳排的；隱含碳 (建材開採製造運輸所產生碳排) 的

explains.en: The energy used to make and move a building material is already part of its environmental cost. A heavy stone may need much fuel for transport. Builders compare these hidden costs.
An idea can be shown clearly through a person’s actions. A kind character helps a neighbor without being asked. The behavior makes the quality easy to see.
A sculpture gives a shape to an idea or feeling. Viewers can see the artist’s thought in the material. The idea becomes present in a real object.

examples.en: Continuous daylight-harvesting dimming automatically adjusts indoor light bulbs based on outdoor sun levels.
examples.zh: 具備晝光感應功能的智慧無段調光系統（Dimming），會隨窗外晴雨天候自動增減室內燈具亮度。

examples.en: Smart LED light dimming allows homeowners to toggle smoothly from bright work lighting to cozy movie atmospheres.
examples.zh: 智慧家庭無段調光功能，能讓屋主在手機上流暢切換自如，從明亮的居家辦公冷白光無縫調至溫馨浪漫的劇院暖黃光。

examples.en: The sudden dimming of stage chandeliers signaled to theatergoers that the curtain was about to rise.
examples.zh: 演藝廳挑高圓頂水晶大吊燈燈光的緩緩減暗轉弱，向在場觀眾發出了全劇即將拉開大幕的正式觀劇信號。

entries.definition: 智慧感應無段平滑調光；變暗

explains.en: Making a light less bright is this change. A control lets people choose a softer level. It can make a room feel calm.
Before the movie, Dad lowered the lights in the living room. The screen became easier to see. Everyone settled on the sofa.
Some systems change lamp brightness as daylight changes. This can save energy and keep a room comfortable. Sensors measure the light outside.

examples.en: Builders painted classrooms with certified low-VOC non-toxic waterborne coatings to safeguard kids.
examples.zh: 幼兒園裝修全面指定採用榮獲綠建材標章認證的無毒、低揮發性有機化合物（Low-VOC）水性環保漆。

examples.en: Parents insist on purchasing non-toxic wooden toys treated with natural beeswax rather than synthetic lacquers.
examples.zh: 講究育兒安全的家長堅持選購僅以天然蜂蠟封層、絕不使用化學合成金屬亮光漆的無毒純原木益智玩具。

examples.en: Organic gardeners use a non-toxic spray made of diluted neem oil and mild dish soap to repel garden pests.
examples.zh: 友善生態的有機小農調配天然苦楝油與中性洗碗精稀釋水，製成對人體完全無毒的天然驅蟲噴劑來驅除菜青蟲。

entries.definition: 綠建材標章無毒環保的

explains.en: A safe household paint does not contain poisonous substances. Children can use it with less risk when directions are followed. This describes a product that is not harmful by poison.
Some cleaning materials are made without ingredients that can poison people or animals. They still need to be used as the label says. The adjective describes their safety from poison.
A gardener chooses a plant treatment that will not poison pets when used properly. It is designed to avoid toxic effects. This word means free from poisonous harm.

examples.en: Sound-absorbing ceiling baffles and floor underlayment provide acoustic privacy in multi-family apartments.
examples.zh: 天花板吸音隔板與木地板下方鋪設的隔音減震防音墊，能徹底阻隔樓上腳步聲，保障優質居住寧靜。

examples.en: The singer played a poignant folk tune accompanied only by the soft fingerpicking of an acoustic guitar.
examples.zh: 民謠創作歌手獨自坐在高腳椅上，僅憑一把溫暖純木吉他的輕柔指彈伴奏，深情款款吟唱著動人的詞句。

examples.en: Architects specified heavy solid-core doors to meet strict acoustic dampening requirements between offices.
examples.zh: 建築師在設計施工圖面中指定安裝重型實心隔音防火木門，以達成各主管獨立辦公室之間極佳的隔音隱私標準。

examples.en: Master luthiers select resonant tone-woods to produce rich acoustic sustain and vibrant midrange warmth.
examples.zh: 頂級製琴大師嚴選風乾數十年的頂級共鳴音木，打造出音色甜美醇厚、泛音豐富的手工原木民謠吉他。

examples.en: Soundproofing foam panels were installed along the walls to optimize the acoustic quality of the recording booth.
examples.zh: 錄音室牆面四周全面鋪設了高密度吸音海綿板，以最佳化人聲配音錄音間的聲學吸音品質。

examples.en: Marine scientists use specialized acoustic listening devices to detect whale songs hundreds of miles away.
examples.zh: 海洋科學家在深海投放特製的聲學水下監聽收音儀，能清晰探測到數百浬外鯨魚群悠揚的鯨歌。

examples.en: Placing recycled rubber mats beneath timber floorboards satisfies high multi-family acoustic standards.
examples.zh: 在重型木構樓板下方加鋪一層再生橡膠隔音墊，能達到五星級住宅頂級的樓板隔音防噪標準。

examples.en: Specialized acoustic baffles hung from the tall timber ceiling absorb reverberant office chatter.
examples.zh: 懸掛於挑高大跨距木天花板下方的高效能聲學吸音飾板，能溫柔吸收開放式辦公空間中的說話回音。

examples.en: Acoustic insulation prevents footsteps from carrying through the ceiling into lower-level apartments.
examples.zh: 鋪設在樓板內的專業聲學隔音減震墊，能徹底阻隔樓上腳步踩踏撞擊聲穿透傳導至樓下住戶。

examples.en: Acoustic Doppler current profilers measure the speed and direction of bottom currents across the trench.
examples.zh: 水下「聲學多普勒流速儀」（Acoustic Profiler），精準測量深海海溝底部洋流的流速與方向。

examples.en: The singer played an intimate acoustic guitar ballad under soft candlelight at the local cafe.
examples.zh: 創作民謠歌手在街角咖啡館柔和燭光下，以一把木吉他深情自彈自唱溫暖的抒情民謠。

examples.en: Architects installed perforated acoustic ceiling panels to dampen harsh noise echoes inside the university lecture hall.
examples.zh: 建築設計師在大學階梯大講堂天花板加裝多孔吸音板，有效吸收並減低室內刺耳的回音干擾。

examples.en: Acoustic liquid handlers use sound energy pulses to shoot precise nanoliter droplets between assay plates.
examples.zh: 「聲波液體處理儀」（Acoustic Liquid Handlers），利用高頻聲波脈衝以非接觸方式精準彈射奈升級微滴。

examples.en: Recording studios install angled acoustic baffling on studio walls to achieve pristine vocal capture.
examples.zh: 專業錄音室在吸音牆面上加裝特定角度的隔音吸音障板，以確保人聲收音純淨無雜訊干擾。

examples.en: Submarines rely on passive acoustic listening devices to detect surface vessels without revealing their location.
examples.zh: 柴電潛艦在巡航時仰賴被動式水下聲學監聽聲納，在完全不暴露自身匿蹤位置的前提下探知水面艦艇。

examples.en: World-class acoustic engineering ensures that every musical note reaches the furthest balcony seat clearly.
examples.zh: 世界級「建築聲學工程」（Acoustic Engineering），確保每個微小音符皆能清晰傳遞至最遠的三樓包廂。

examples.en: The folk trio performed an unplugged acoustic concert that captivated the entire university audience.
examples.zh: 這支民謠三重唱樂團舉辦了一場不插電原聲音樂會，以純粹真摯的樂聲深深打動全場大學師生。

examples.en: Recording engineers treated the studio walls with acoustic foam to eliminate harsh room flutter.
examples.zh: 錄音工程師在錄音室牆面鋪設專業聲學吸音泡棉，徹底消除室內刺耳的顫動回音干擾。

entries.definition: 樓板防音隔音降噪舒適的；頂級手工原木民謠吉他聲學的；重型木構樓板超靜音吸音減震層的；水下超短基線高精度聲學定位與測流儀的；聲學的；聲波非接觸式微滴分配射出技術 (奈升級精度) 的；頂級交響音樂廳建築聲學工程設計的；原聲的

explains.en: A guitarist plays without plugging into an amplifier. The instrument’s body makes the sound.
Apartments use special panels and floor layers to reduce noise between homes. Engineers measure how sound travels.
An underwater device uses sound waves to detect currents. The same adjective can describe sound or a non-electric instrument.

examples.en: Wide shaded sidewalks and barrier-free curb ramps enhance neighborhood walkability for elderly strollers.
examples.zh: 寬敞平整的林蔭人行道與全無障礙斜坡道設計，大幅提升了社區長輩推輪椅與散步時的行人友善宜走性。

examples.en: Real estate listings highlight a high walkability score, noting that subway stations and parks are minutes away.
examples.zh: 房屋仲介售屋廣告特別標榜該物件擁有高達九十分的極高步行宜居生活評分，步行至捷運站與綠地僅需三分鐘。

examples.en: Pedestrianizing downtown streets transforms commercial corridors, boosting foot traffic and community walkability.
examples.zh: 將老舊市中心傳統街道劃設為假日行人徒步專用區，徹底活化了商圈人潮與街道兩旁店家的商業宜走繁榮度。

entries.definition: 友善行人步行空間宜走性

explains.en: A neighborhood is easy to travel through on foot when sidewalks and crossings are safe. Nearby shops and parks make walking useful. Good paths help people of many ages.
City planners study whether people can comfortably reach daily places without a car. They look at crossings, shade, and distances. Small changes can make streets friendlier.
A street with smooth sidewalks and safe crossings invites children to walk. Drivers slow down near the school. Families feel more comfortable going outside.

examples.en: Mature camphor tree canopies cast refreshing shade across asphalt roads, lowering ground heat by 5°C.
examples.zh: 街道兩旁高聳茁壯的百年樟樹茂密樹冠層（Canopy），在柏油路上灑落大片濃蔭，有效使地表降溫達五度。

examples.en: Campers sheltered underneath a waterproof nylon canopy while a sudden afternoon downpour passed overhead.
examples.zh: 露營愛好者紛紛躲入搭建完備的高抗水防撕裂蝶形天幕帳棚底下，悠閒聆聽頭頂上滂沱午後雷雨淅瀝拍打。

examples.en: The tropical rainforest boasts multi-tiered tree canopies that shelter countless rare orchid and parrot species.
examples.zh: 亞熱帶原始雨林擁有層次分明的茂密高聳樹冠層結構，為無數台灣原生特有種附生蘭花與鳥類提供安全庇護。

examples.en: Expanding the urban tree canopy along pedestrian boulevards shields strollers from harsh solar radiation.
examples.zh: 在人行步道兩側擴建蓊鬱茂密的林蔭樹冠層，為推嬰兒車的散步民眾遮擋烈日曝曬。

examples.en: A dense leaf canopy intercepts heavy rain before droplets hit bare soil, preventing surface erosion.
examples.zh: 茂盛濃密的喬木樹冠層能率先攔截豪雨水滴的重力衝擊，保護表土免於遭受沖刷流失。

examples.en: Cities with high tree canopy coverage enjoy significantly lower cooling energy costs in hot summers.
examples.zh: 擁有高比例人行道林蔭樹冠覆蓋率的永續城市，在炎炎夏日能為全體市民省下大筆冷氣空調開支。

examples.en: Infrared sensors pierce gaps in the forest canopy to reveal sleeping flying squirrels perched high on branches.
examples.zh: 熱成像感測器穿透「森林樹冠層」（Canopy）微小縫隙，清晰揭露棲息在高聳枝頭沉睡的白面鼯鼠。

examples.en: The dense rainforest canopy intercepts harsh downpours and shelters delicate epiphytic orchids.
examples.zh: 茂密繁盛的熱帶樹冠層攔截了猛烈的暴雨沖刷，為脆弱的附生蘭花提供了天然綠色庇護。

examples.en: Scientists constructed rope walkway platforms across the cloud forest canopy to study arboreal insects.
examples.zh: 科學家在霧林帶樹冠層間搭建懸空繩索步道，以便深入研究棲息於高空林冠的特有昆蟲。

examples.en: Lowering the acoustic canopy over the stage allows chamber musicians to hear each other with precision.
examples.zh: 降下舞台正上方的「聲學調音天篷」（Acoustic Canopy），能讓室內樂演奏家在舞台上清晰聆聽彼此的配合。

examples.en: Monkeys and colorful parrots leap between branches high up in the dense tropical rainforest canopy.
examples.zh: 靈巧的猴群與羽色華麗的金剛鸚鵡，在熱帶雨林高聳茂密的樹冠層枝椏間歡快跳躍穿梭。

examples.en: Wedding guests mingled happily beneath the white striped fabric canopy pitched on the lawn.
examples.zh: 參加戶外婚禮的親朋好友，在草坪上搭建的白條紋歐風遮陽帳篷天篷下開心地互相寒暄敬酒。

entries.definition: 茂密行道樹林蔭樹冠層；帳篷；蓊鬱綠蔭人行道林蔭樹冠層；遮篷；穿透濃密亞熱帶森林樹冠層偵測熱源；樹冠；舞台上方可調高低之交響樂團聲音反射天篷；天篷

explains.en: The upper branches and leaves of trees form a roof over a forest. It gives shade to plants and animals below. Birds may live among the branches.
The hikers walked beneath tall trees. Their leaves blocked much of the hot sun. Small birds called from above.
A cloth cover over a tent, stage, or doorway can also provide shelter. It keeps off rain or sunlight. Strong supports hold it up.

examples.en: The neighborhood composting station turns kitchen scraps into rich fertilizer for community vegetable gardens.
examples.zh: 社區設置無臭廚餘生質堆肥處理機（Composting），將生熟廚餘轉化為營養豐富的黑金有機肥料供菜園使用。

examples.en: Home gardeners balance brown dry leaves with green food waste to maintain odor-free aerobic composting.
examples.zh: 居家園藝愛好者細心拿捏枯枝落葉等乾性碳質材料與果皮生廚餘的黃金比例，確保好氧發酵堆肥全程無臭無味。

examples.en: Municipal green programs provide subsidized backyard composting bins to discourage landfill waste.
examples.zh: 各縣市環保局大力推動減廢專案，提供高額補貼鼓勵民眾申購透氣庭院堆肥桶，從源頭大舉減少進入焚化爐的垃圾。

entries.definition: 社區廚餘生質堆肥再利用；堆肥

explains.en: Food scraps and dry leaves can break down together in a bin. The result becomes dark material that helps soil. This is a way to turn organic waste into garden food.
A family puts vegetable peels into a container with yard waste. Tiny living things break the mixture down over time. The finished material can enrich plants.
Instead of sending all kitchen scraps to a landfill, a community lets them decay in a managed pile. The rich result is added to soil. This process recycles organic matter.

examples.en: Solar-powered street trash compactors compress paper cups automatically, holding eight times more volume.
examples.zh: 設置於熱鬧商圈的太陽能自動壓縮智慧垃圾桶（Compactor），容量比傳統垃圾桶大八倍且不易滿溢。

examples.en: The heavy asphalt road compactor rolled back and forth to ensure the newly laid highway was rock solid.
examples.zh: 重達二十噸的大型雙鋼輪瀝青道路壓路機在國道施工現場來回重壓碾平，確保全新鋪設的柏油路面密實平整。

examples.en: Installing a kitchen waste compactor under the counter reduces the number of trips needed to take out the trash.
examples.zh: 在廚房流理台下方巧妙嵌裝一台高壓家庭廚餘垃圾壓縮機，能大幅減少上班族追著黃色垃圾車跑的奔波頻率。

entries.definition: 太陽能智慧壓縮垃圾桶；壓路機

explains.en: This street bin presses cups and paper down to make more room. Some models use power from a solar panel.
A road crew rolls a heavy machine over fresh pavement to make it firm. The machine has a wide drum.
A kitchen appliance compresses rubbish so it takes up less space. A road machine with a heavy roller can also have this name.

examples.en: Treated sink greywater is channeled through UV purifiers to safely supply outdoor courtyard fountains.
examples.zh: 將洗手台與淋浴間收集的「中水」（Greywater）經過生物砂濾與紫外線消毒後，安全回用於中庭景觀噴泉。

examples.en: Plumbers routed washing machine greywater into outdoor sub-surface pipes to irrigate the drought-tolerant lawn.
examples.zh: 水電技術團隊將洗衣機排出的微量洗滌中水導流至地底滲水涵管系統，直接為庭院耐旱草坪提供灌溉水源。
