examples.en: Grinding roasted nuts with caramelized sugar on stone mills produces smooth, aromatic praline paste.
examples.zh: 將現烤堅果與琥珀焦糖送入石磨機中慢速細磨，能提煉出香氣四溢、絲滑濃郁的堅果巴芮醬。

entries.definition: 焦糖香脆榛果巴芮脆片夾心 (Praline)

explains.en: A sweet filling or candy can combine nuts with cooked sugar. It tastes crunchy and rich. Bakers use it in cakes and chocolates.
A pastry contains a layer of crisp hazelnut and caramel pieces. The filling adds a sweet crunch. It can be covered with chocolate.
A small candy is made by coating nuts in caramelized sugar. The sugar hardens around them. Recipes differ from place to place.

examples.en: Topping choux pastry with a disc of craquelin cookie dough yields perfectly round, ultra-crispy cream puffs.
examples.zh: 在法式泡芙麵糊頂端覆蓋一片菠蘿酥皮，進爐烘烤出圓滾滾、外皮極致酥脆的修女泡芙。

examples.en: The choux dough must be cooked thoroughly on the stove to gelatinize flour starches before adding eggs.
examples.zh: 泡芙生麵團入爐前必須先在鍋中充分受熱燙熟，使麵粉澱粉徹底糊化後方可分次攪入全蛋液。

examples.en: Steam generated inside the hollow choux buns during baking creates the cavity for cream fillings.
examples.zh: 烘烤時泡芙內部水分蒸發產生強大水蒸氣，撐開中空的大氣孔內腔，以容納香濃飽滿的卡士達醬。

entries.definition: 菠蘿脆皮法式修女泡芙 (泡芙麵糊)

explains.en: A light dough is cooked before eggs are added, then baked into hollow pastries. It can be filled with cream. The outside may be crisp.
The baker piped small rounds onto a tray. They puffed up in the hot oven. Later, she filled them with custard.
The same dough makes cream puffs and long pastries. It must be mixed carefully. Steam helps the shells rise.

examples.en: The classic mille-feuille layers three sheets of caramelized puff pastry with silky diplomat pastry cream.
examples.zh: 享譽世界的法式千層酥拿破崙，由三層烤至香脆焦糖化的千層酥皮夾著香滑卡士達慕斯。

examples.en: Slicing through a delicate mille-feuille requires a sharp serrated knife to avoid crushing the layers.
examples.zh: 分切結構精細脆弱的千層酥蛋糕時，必須使用特製鋒利鋸齒刀如拉鋸般輕剖以防壓扁壓裂酥皮。

examples.en: The traditional top icing of a mille-feuille features a white fondant glaze with elegant feathered chocolate stripes.
examples.zh: 傳統拿破崙千層頂部會淋上一層白色糖霜翻糖，並以竹籤拉花勾勒出典雅的羽狀巧克力紋路。

entries.definition: 焦糖酥脆千層酥拿破崙蛋糕

explains.en: This French dessert has many thin crisp pastry layers with cream between them. Its name means a thousand leaves. The top is often decorated with icing.
A baker stacks delicate sheets of puff pastry and custard to make a tall sweet. The layers crunch when cut. It is also called a Napoleon pastry.
A rectangular cake combines crisp pastry and smooth cream in many layers. A patterned icing covers the top. The dessert is famous in France.

examples.en: Blind baking the buttery pâte sablée crust ensures it stays crisp even after being filled with juicy berries.
examples.zh: 將散發濃郁發酵奶油香氣的沙布列塔皮預先盲烤至金黃，能確保填入新鮮莓果後依然維持酥脆。

examples.en: Rubbing cold butter cubes into flour until it resembles sandy breadcrumbs is the secret to tender pâte sablée.
examples.zh: 用手指指腹將冰涼奶油丁與麵粉搓磨成細砂質地，是烤出酥鬆化口沙布列塔皮的不二秘訣。

examples.en: Perforated tart rings allow steam to escape, keeping sablée tart shells razor-sharp and flat.
examples.zh: 搭配透氣微孔塔圈盲烤能讓水氣全面逸散，使出爐的沙布列塔殼邊角俐落垂直、平整不縮水。

entries.definition: 酥脆法式沙布列奶油甜塔皮 (Pâte Sablée)

explains.en: A baker presses a buttery crumbly pastry dough into a tart pan. It becomes crisp after baking.
A fruit tart has a sweet, delicate shell made from a French-style dough. The crust holds its shape.
This French pastry dough makes a rich, crumbly tart shell. It is often baked before adding the filling.

examples.en: The velvety white chocolate matcha mousse dissolves effortlessly on the palate with a refreshing green tea finish.
examples.zh: 這款如絲絨般輕盈綿密的白巧克力抹茶慕斯，入口即化並在唇齒間留下回甘悠長的高雅茶香。

examples.en: Folding whipped cream gently into the warm fruit puree preserves the light, airy texture of the mousse.
examples.zh: 將打發至六分發的鮮奶油輕柔切拌入溫熱果泥中，能完好留住慕斯輕盈如雲朵般的細緻質地。

examples.en: Dark chocolate mousse chilled in crystal dessert cups makes a timeless dinner party finale.
examples.zh: 盛裝在精緻水晶杯中冰鎮冷藏的純黑巧克力慕斯，是任何星級晚宴歷久不衰的終極甜點句點。

entries.definition: 絲絨般輕盈滑順之法式冷藏慕斯

explains.en: A chilled dessert is whipped until it feels light and airy. It may be made with chocolate or fruit. It is served cold.
A spoon sinks into a soft, foamy sweet made with cream and flavoring. The texture is smooth rather than chewy. It needs time in the refrigerator.
A cook folds whipped ingredients gently so the dessert keeps its bubbles. The mixture becomes soft and light. It can be served in a small cup.

examples.en: Cutting into the modern entremets reveals five harmonious layers of sponge, crunchy praline, fruit coulis, and mousse.
examples.zh: 切開精緻的法式現代慕斯蛋糕，剖面展現出海綿蛋糕、榛果脆片、水果庫利與慕斯五重奏。

examples.en: Crafting an award-winning entremets requires hours of precision assembly using silicone molds and blast chillers.
examples.zh: 製作一款奪得國際甜點金牌的頂級法式慕斯蛋糕，需要藉由矽膠模具與急凍冷鏈耗時數日精準拼裝。

examples.en: Each slice of the gourmet entremets offers an interplay of acidity, sweetness, crunch, and creaminess.
examples.zh: 每一口頂級法式慕斯切片，都在唇齒間交織出酸甜平衡、酥脆與絲滑的極致味蕾協奏曲。

entries.definition: 多層次法式現代冷藏精緻慕斯蛋糕

explains.en: A carefully layered French dessert may combine mousse, cake, fruit, or crunchy pieces. It is often chilled before serving. Each slice shows several layers.
The pastry chef cut the round cake to reveal pink fruit filling and soft cream. Guests admired the neat layers. They shared small slices.
Making this dessert takes planning and careful cooling. Bakers use molds to shape it. Different flavors can be combined.

examples.en: A tart raspberry fruit coulis insert cuts through the richness of the dark chocolate mousse.
examples.zh: 蛋糕核心包入一層酸爽甜美的天然覆盆子果凍庫利夾心，能完美化解純黑巧克力的濃郁厚重感。

examples.en: The chef simmered ripe mangoes and passion fruit to create a vibrant tropical coulis sauce.
examples.zh: 主廚將熟透的愛文芒果與埔里百香果文火細熬，調配出酸甜濃郁、充滿陽光風情的熱帶水果庫利。

examples.en: Gelatin sets the fruit coulis into a firm disc that can be easily centered inside the cake mold.
examples.zh: 添加微量吉利丁凝固水果庫利果泥，使其凝結成厚度平整的圓形夾層凍，便於精準嵌入慕斯中央。

entries.definition: 酸甜現熬覆盆子紅醋栗果凍庫利夾心

explains.en: A cook simmers berries into a smooth tart sauce and pours it over dessert. The strained fruit adds bright flavor. It can also fill a sweet pastry.
A chef blends cooked red berries and strains out seeds to make a smooth sauce. The fruit mixture can decorate a plate. This thin puree is served with desserts.
Fresh fruit is cooked and pressed into a silky sauce. A pastry chef uses it as a filling or topping. This word names the smooth fruit preparation.

examples.en: Guests squeeze the tiny liqueur pipette inserted into the pastry to infuse orange brandy just before eating.
examples.zh: 品嚐甜點前，賓客親手擠壓插在蛋糕上的微型風味滴管，將君度橙酒瞬間注入蛋糕核心增添香氣。

examples.en: Adding a mini espresso pipette to the dessert plate lets diners customize their tiramisu's intensity.
examples.zh: 在甜點盤上附上一支迷你義式濃縮咖啡滴管，能讓饕客隨心所欲調整提拉米蘇的咖啡濃郁濃度。

examples.en: The pipette prevents alcohol from making the delicate sponge cake soggy before presentation.
examples.zh: 運用風味調味滴管能在出餐上桌前將酒液獨立封存，避免精緻的海綿蛋糕因久放而過度吸水浸濕軟爛。

entries.definition: 甜點風味滴管 (注入君度橙酒或糖漿)

explains.en: A cook squeezes a tiny dropper to add a little flavoring to a dessert. It controls the amount carefully.
In a lab, a student transfers a drop of solution into a test tube. The narrow tip helps control the amount.
A scientist moves a small amount of liquid from one tube to another with a narrow tool. Careful control helps avoid spills.

examples.en: Fresh compressed block yeast yields clean, dependable rising action without artificial chemical aftertastes.
examples.zh: 選用高品質新鮮塊狀濕酵母，能提供溫和穩定的發酵動力，完全無化學添加物的異味。

examples.en: Dissolving fresh yeast in lukewarm water wakes up the dormant single-celled fungal organisms.
examples.zh: 將新鮮濕酵母切碎溶解於微溫開水中輕柔攪勻，能溫柔喚醒處於休眠狀態的單細胞真菌酵母群。

examples.en: Instant dry yeast can be blended straight into dry flour, offering immense convenience for commercial kitchens.
examples.zh: 速發乾酵母能直接均勻倒入乾麵粉中混合攪拌，為大型中央烘焙廚房帶來極大的備料便利性。

entries.definition: 緩慢發酵之新鮮塊狀濕酵母；酵母

explains.en: Tiny living cells help bread dough rise by making gas as they use sugar. The dough grows bigger and softer. Warmth helps the process.
A baker adds a small amount of fresh, soft blocks of this ingredient to flour and water. The mixture begins to bubble. It is ready for the oven later.
This living organism is also used to make some drinks and foods. Different kinds work at different speeds. It is sold fresh or dried.

examples.en: Savoring a rich triple-chocolate truffle tart is an indulgence of pure culinary decadence.
examples.zh: 在悠閒午後細細品嚐一塊濃郁的三重黑巧克力松露塔，是一場無可救藥、令人感到無比幸福的奢華享受。

examples.en: Layered with gold leaf and Tahitian vanilla bean cream, the dessert reached the pinnacle of luxury and decadence.
examples.zh: 點綴著閃爍純金金箔並填滿大溪地香草卡士達醬，這款奢華甜點達到了極致奢華與銷魂享受的頂點。

examples.en: Once in a while, treating oneself to such buttery decadence is the sweetest reward for hard work.
examples.zh: 偶爾讓自己沉浸在如此濃郁罪惡的奶油甜點世界中，是對平日辛勤打拚生活最甜美的溫柔犒賞。

entries.definition: 奢華精緻甜點帶來的極致誘惑享受

explains.en: Rich comfort or excessive luxury can be described by this noun. A very creamy dessert may feel like a special treat. It can also describe wasteful behavior.
The family shared a rich chocolate cake after dinner. Everyone enjoyed the sweet treat. They saved a small piece for tomorrow.
In history, people may criticize a society for too much luxury. In food, the word can simply praise a rich flavor. Context changes its tone.

examples.en: The Mariana Trench plunges nearly eleven kilometers deep at Challenger Deep, the lowest point on Earth.
examples.zh: 馬里亞納海溝中的挑戰者深淵深達近十一公里，是地球上最深的地質極限。

examples.en: Geological subduction creates a steep submarine trench where one oceanic plate dives beneath another.
examples.zh: 板塊板塊構造隱沒作用在海底形成了陡峭深邃的深海海溝，大洋板塊在此向下俯衝進入地函。

examples.en: Extreme pressure and freezing cold define the harsh environment inside this Pacific trench.
examples.zh: 令人粉身碎骨的極限水壓與接近冰點的刺骨低溫，構成了這條太平洋海溝內部嚴酷的物理環境。

explains.en: The deepest known part of the ocean lies far below the surface in the western Pacific. The water pressure there is enormous. It is a long, narrow underwater valley.
A long ditch is dug into the ground for drainage or defense. Workers may line it with stones. This word can also name a very deep ocean feature.
A research vessel explores a narrow depression in the sea floor. The area is far deeper than the surrounding ocean. This kind of underwater valley is among Earth’s deepest places.

examples.en: The historic steel bathyscaphe Trieste made the first manned dive to the ocean floor in 1960.
examples.zh: 歷史著名的鋼製載人深海潛艇的里雅斯特號，於一九六零年首度成功載人潛入萬米海床。

examples.en: Gasoline was used inside the bathyscaphe's float chamber because it is lighter than water and resists compression.
examples.zh: 早期深海探測潛艇的浮力艙採用輕質汽油作為填充液，因其比水輕且在萬米高壓下不易被壓縮。

examples.en: Designing an ultra-deep bathyscaphe required thick forged steel spheres to withstand bottom pressures.
examples.zh: 設計一艘能抵禦萬米水壓的超深水深海潛水艇，需要鍛造極厚的高強度合金鋼球形耐壓艙。

entries.definition: 載人深海探測潛水艇；深海潛艇

explains.en: A deep-sea vessel descends far below the ocean surface with researchers inside. Its strong chamber protects them.
A crew uses a special submersible to explore a deep trench. It can withstand great water pressure.
This is a deep-diving craft built to carry people underwater. Its pressure-resistant chamber keeps them safe.

examples.en: Unmanned deep-sea probes operate for weeks mapping hydrothermal vents along underwater volcanic ridges.
examples.zh: 水下無人探測載具能在海底火山脊持續巡航數週，精準測繪熱泉噴口分佈。

examples.en: Deploying an unmanned autonomous vehicle reduces human risk while exploring hazardous underwater volcanoes.
examples.zh: 部署水下無人自主航行探測器，在探測危險的海底活火山時能徹底免除科研人員的人身風險。

examples.en: The unmanned crawler gathered thousands of sediment core samples without requiring diver intervention.
examples.zh: 這台履帶式水下無人海床巡航車在無人潛航員干預下，順利採集了數千份海床沉積物岩芯樣本。

entries.definition: 水下無人自主巡航探測的

explains.en: A small underwater vehicle travels without a person inside. It follows a planned route and sends pictures to a ship. It can explore places too deep for divers.
A remote aircraft has no pilot aboard. Someone on the ground controls it or a computer follows instructions. Rules limit where it may fly.
A spacecraft can operate without a crew on board. It gathers information and sends it back to Earth. The adjective means no person is present to drive it.

examples.en: The pilot skillfully controlled the robotic manipulator arm to retrieve fragile volcanic rock samples.
examples.zh: 駕駛員熟練操控七軸液壓水下機械手臂，溫柔夾取珍貴而脆弱的海底火山岩樣本。

examples.en: Delicate force-feedback sensors on the manipulator prevent crushing delicate glass sponges during sampling.
examples.zh: 機械手臂指尖搭載的精密力回饋感測器，能防止在抓取採集脆弱的玻璃海綿時將其捏碎破壞。

examples.en: Specialized rotary cutters can be fitted onto the manipulator to slice through subsea steel cables.
examples.zh: 水下機械手臂前端可快速更換為專用旋轉切割鋸片，輕鬆切斷纏繞的水下鋼纜障礙物。

examples.en: The pilot maneuvers the hydraulic manipulator arm gently to pluck a delicate glass sponge without breaking it.
examples.zh: 潛航員熟練操控多關節「液壓機械手臂」（Manipulator Arm），極其溫柔地夾取脆弱的玻璃海綿標本。

examples.en: Beware of cunning emotional manipulators who distort facts to make others feel unwarranted guilt.
examples.zh: 在職場與人際互動中切莫輕信情緒操控者，他們擅長扭曲客觀事實，藉此誘發他人無端負疚。

examples.en: Automotive assembly plants employ high-speed robotic manipulators to weld steel car doors precisely.
examples.zh: 現代化汽車製造組裝產線全面導入高速六軸工業機械手臂，分毫不差地精準焊接車門鈑金。

entries.definition: 七軸液壓水下機械手臂 (採集樣本)；水下多關節高精度液壓機械手臂採樣爪

explains.en: A machine arm can hold or move objects where people cannot reach. It may have joints and grippers. Operators control it from a safe place.
The underwater robot used its metal arm to pick up a rock sample. The pilot watched a camera screen. The sample went into a box.
A person who unfairly controls others can also be called this. That meaning is negative. The mechanical meaning is neutral.

examples.en: Deep-sea gear must withstand crushing hydrostatic pressure exceeding one thousand atmospheres at the seabed.
examples.zh: 萬米深海設備必須能抵禦海床底端超過一千個大氣壓的毀滅性靜水壓力。

examples.en: Engineers test instrument casings inside hydrostatic pressure chambers before deploying them into trenches.
examples.zh: 在正式下放海溝前，工程師會將儀器外殼放入超高壓靜水壓力模擬試驗艙中進行破壞性檢驗。

examples.en: Special silicone oils equalize hydrostatic pressure within the sub's external electronic junction boxes.
examples.zh: 外部電子接線盒內部充填專用矽油進行壓力平衡，使其能在極端靜水壓力下維持電氣絕緣。

entries.definition: 一千個大氣壓之毀滅性靜水壓力的

explains.en: Water resting still exerts force on objects beneath it. The deeper an object goes, the greater the pressure becomes. This adjective relates to pressure in a stationary liquid.
A deep-sea vehicle must withstand the force of water pressing equally around it. The liquid is not flowing quickly. This term describes pressure from a resting fluid.
Engineers test how a tank handles pressure from still water. The force increases with depth. This describes pressure created by a fluid at rest.

examples.en: The spherical titanium pressure hull protects researchers from the violent forces of the deep ocean.
examples.zh: 鍛造一體的球形鈦合金耐壓艙體，為潛航員築起隔絕萬米深海狂暴水壓的安全避風港。

examples.en: Ultrasound scans inspect the weld seams of the submersible hull for micro-fractures after every deep dive.
examples.zh: 每次完成萬米深潛作業後，技術團隊都會使用超音波探傷儀仔細檢測潛艇艙體焊縫是否存在微裂紋。

examples.en: The outer hydrodynamic fiberglass hull streamlines the vehicle's descent through strong currents.
examples.zh: 外層符合流體力學的玻璃纖維外殼，讓潛水器能順暢破水穿透強勁洋流快速下潛。

entries.definition: 球形鈦合金耐壓抗壓載人艙體；船體

explains.en: The outer body of a boat pushes through the water. A crack can let water inside.
A submarine has a strong metal shell that protects its crew from pressure. Engineers test it carefully.
This is the main outer structure of a ship or boat. It supports the vessel and keeps water out.

examples.en: Towering black smokers form towering mineral chimneys as dissolved metallic sulfides precipitate into ice-cold water.
examples.zh: 當溶解的金屬硫化物遇冰冷海水瞬間沉澱結晶，堆疊出高聳如摩天大樓的黑煙囪礦柱。

examples.en: White smokers release cooler, silica-rich solutions that create chalky, chimney-like spires.
examples.zh: 與黑煙囪不同，白煙囪噴出溫度較低、富含二氧化矽的白濁熱液，凝結成粉筆般的白色結晶柱。

examples.en: The robotic arm broke off a chimney fragment from an active smoker to analyze its mineralogy.
examples.zh: 水下機械手臂折斷了一截活性黑煙囪頂端的礦物結晶殘片，帶回母船實驗室進行礦物成分化驗。

entries.definition: 硫化物沉澱堆疊之黑煙囪柱體；抽煙者

explains.en: A deep-sea opening releases hot mineral-rich water that forms a dark plume. Tiny creatures live around it. Scientists study these unusual places.
A person who uses tobacco may be described by this noun. Smoking can harm health. Support is available for those who want to stop.
A covered cooker uses wood or charcoal to give food a smoky taste. The cook watches the heat for a long time. The word has several meanings.

examples.en: In sunless abyssal ecosystems, life thrives via chemosynthesis by converting hydrogen sulfide into cellular energy.
examples.zh: 在永無陽光的深海世界中，生命透過神奇的化學合成作用將硫化氫轉化為生存能量。

examples.en: Unlike plants that require sunlight, chemosynthesis allows specialized bacteria to manufacture sugars from minerals.
examples.zh: 與需要陽光光合作用的綠色植物不同，化學合成作用讓特化深海細菌得以將無機礦物轉化為葡萄糖。

examples.en: The entire benthic food web around the volcanic fissure is built upon microbial chemosynthesis.
examples.zh: 海底火山裂縫周圍龐大奇特的底棲食物鏈網，完全建立在微生物化學合成作用的基石之上。

examples.en: Chemosynthesis replaces photosynthesis in the abyss, fueling thriving ecosystems without any sunlight.
examples.zh: 「化學合成作用」（Chemosynthesis）取代了光合作用，在無光深海中支撐起生機盎然的完整食物鏈。

examples.en: Specialized deep-sea microbes carry out chemosynthesis by deriving biological energy from chemical bonds.
examples.zh: 特化的深海微生物透過打破無機化學鍵釋放生物能量，順利完成自主化學合成作用。

examples.en: Astrobiologists suspect alien life on Europa's ice-covered ocean floors might rely on similar chemosynthesis.
examples.zh: 天文生物學家推測，木衛二冰封海洋底層若存在外星生命，極可能同樣依賴化學合成維生。

entries.definition: 黑暗無光硫化氫化學合成作用；黑暗深海微生物利用硫化氫之化學合成作用

explains.en: Some microbes make food using energy from chemicals instead of sunlight. This process supports life near deep-sea vents. It is different from photosynthesis.
In the dark ocean, tiny bacteria used chemicals from a hot vent to make food. Small animals fed on them. A whole community lived nearby.
Plants use sunlight to make sugars, but these microbes use chemical energy. Scientists study them in deep water. They can live in extreme places.

examples.en: Bizarre deep-sea crab communities cluster densely around the warm thermal vent to graze on thick bacterial mats.
examples.zh: 奇特的海底盲蟹族群密密麻麻聚集在溫暖的熱液噴口四周，大口啃食厚厚的細菌生物薄膜。

examples.en: Acidic fluids rich in hydrogen sulfide vent constantly from fissures along the tectonic ridge.
examples.zh: 富含高濃度硫化氫的強酸性礦物熱液，持續不斷從板塊構造海脊的深層岩石裂縫中噴湧而出。

examples.en: Biologists collected genetic samples from creatures living only a few centimeters from the superheated vent.
examples.zh: 生物學家從生活在距離灼熱噴口僅幾公分之遙的奇特生物體內，採集了珍貴的遺傳基因樣本。

examples.en: Deep-sea shrimp swarm around the volcanic hydrothermal vent to graze on thick mats of bacteria.
examples.zh: 成群盲蝦密密麻麻聚集在「海底熱液噴孔」（Hydrothermal Vent）周圍，啃食厚厚的細菌生物膜。

examples.en: Ensure the dryer exhaust vent is free of lint build-up to eliminate household fire hazards.
examples.zh: 請定期清理烘衣機外部排氣風管內的棉絮積垢，徹底消除引發居家火災的安全隱患。

examples.en: She called her closest friend to vent her frustration after an exhausting day dealing with difficult clients.
examples.zh: 在經歷了一整天應對難纏客戶的疲憊工作後，她撥通摯友電話抒發宣洩內心的無奈與委屈。

entries.definition: 海底熱液噴口區；通風口；發洩；噴發礦物熱泉之海底地熱火山口排氣孔

explains.en: A crack in the ocean floor releases hot mineral-rich water from deep underground. Strange animals live near the warm flow. The opening is part of an underwater volcanic area.
A room has a grille that lets air move in or out. Workers open it to improve airflow. The same noun can also mean an opening for steam or gas.
A person may speak about anger to release strong feelings. The verb can mean letting an emotion out. In geology, a gap may release heat or gas.

examples.en: Mining companies eye seafloor massive sulfide deposits for their rich concentrations of copper, zinc, and silver.
examples.zh: 國際採礦巨頭高度關注海底塊狀硫化物礦床，因其富含高品位銅、鋅與金銀。

examples.en: Hydrothermal fluids carry high amounts of dissolved iron and lead sulfide out of the Earth’s mantle.
examples.zh: 循環湧升的地底熱液，將地函中大量溶解的硫化鐵與硫化鉛等金屬硫化物源源不絕帶上海床。

examples.en: Solidified metal sulfide mounds around extinct vents provide habitats for deep cold-water corals.
examples.zh: 熄火死噴口周圍凝固沉積的金屬硫化物丘陵，為深海冷水造礁珊瑚群落提供了堅固的附著基質。

examples.en: Polymetallic massive sulfide deposits forming around vents represent concentrated reserves of copper and gold.
examples.zh: 環繞熱泉噴口堆積形成的「多金屬硫化物礦床」（Sulfide Deposits），蘊含極高品位的銅與黃金。

examples.en: Hydrogen sulfide gas emits an unmistakable odor reminiscent of rotten eggs near active volcanic fumaroles.
examples.zh: 在活躍的火山硫氣噴孔周圍，硫化氫氣體散發出一股極易辨識且令人作嘔的腐爛臭蛋味。

examples.en: Metallurgists refine copper sulfide ores through flotation and smelting processes in modern smelters.
examples.zh: 冶金工程師在現代精煉廠中，透過浮選與高溫熔煉工藝從硫化銅礦石中提煉高純度銅。

entries.definition: 海底多金屬塊狀硫化物沉積礦床；富含銅鋅金銀重金屬之海底塊狀多金屬硫化物

explains.en: A mineral sample contains sulfur combined with metals such as copper or zinc. It may form near underwater vents.
Miners examine dark rocks that contain sulfur and metal. The minerals can be valuable resources.
This is a compound made from sulfur and another element. Some metal ores contain it.

examples.en: Cold seeps release plumes of methane bubbles from deep geological reservoirs without violent heat.
examples.zh: 寧靜的海底甲烷冷泉滲漏區，從地底岩層中緩緩釋放天然氣甲烷氣泡，孕育獨特生態。

examples.en: Chemotrophic mussels thrive near hydrocarbon seeps by consuming methane-derived nutrients.
examples.zh: 特化的化能自營深海貽貝簇擁生長在碳氫化合物冷泉口周圍，藉由共生菌吸收甲烷養分茁壯。

examples.en: Toxic petrochemical compounds seep slowly through seafloor fissures, nurturing dense mussel beds.
examples.zh: 富含有機成分的天然氣化合物沿著海床裂隙緩慢滲出，滋養了一片片密密麻麻的深海貽貝岩層。

entries.definition: 深海低溫天然氣甲烷冷泉滲漏區；滲漏

explains.en: Water slowly passes through a tiny opening in soil or rock. A dark wet patch may appear on the other side. Fixing the crack can stop it.
A little oil escapes from a loose pipe joint over time. The mechanic dries the area and checks again. Slow leaks can be hard to notice.
Cool gas can slowly escape from cracks under the sea floor. Tiny organisms may use chemicals from the water. Researchers map these areas.

examples.en: Giant red-plumed tubeworms reach lengths of over two meters, living symbiotically with sulfur-oxidizing microbes.
examples.zh: 頭頂鮮紅羽鰓的巨型熱泉管蟲身長可達兩公尺以上，完全仰賴體內共生菌獲取養分。

examples.en: Having no mouth, gut, or digestive system, the tubeworm relies entirely on its internal bacterial colony.
examples.zh: 巨型管蟲一生沒有嘴巴、腸道或任何消化器官，其生存完全仰賴體內共生硫化菌提供的化學養分。

examples.en: Stiff chitinous tubes shield the delicate red bodies of tubeworms from acidic hydrothermal chemicals.
examples.zh: 堅硬的幾丁質白色保護管鞘如鎧甲般，保護管蟲柔軟嬌嫩的紅色肉體免受強酸性熱泉腐蝕。

examples.en: Crimson-plumed giant tubeworms grow over two meters long, anchoring themselves directly to boiling chimney rocks.
examples.zh: 頂著鮮紅羽冠的「巨型管蟲」（Tubeworm）可長達兩公尺，牢牢攀附在滾燙黑煙囪周圍的岩壁上。

examples.en: Lacking a mouth and gut, the deep-sea tubeworm relies completely on symbiotic bacteria in its trophosome tissue.
examples.zh: 由於缺乏口腔與消化道，深海管蟲完全仰賴體內滋養體組織中共生菌供應養分。

examples.en: Marine biologists filmed dense colonies of tubeworms flourishing in complete darkness along the oceanic ridge.
examples.zh: 海洋生物學家拍攝到沿著大洋中脊深處，大片茂密的管蟲群落於萬古黑暗中茁壯繁衍。

entries.definition: 巨型熱泉管蟲 (體內共生硫化菌)；兩公尺長無口無消化道之深海巨型紅冠管蟲

explains.en: A long marine animal lives inside a hard tube attached to the sea floor. Some kinds live near hot vents. They depend on helpful bacteria for food.
The divers saw a cluster of white tubes near a warm underwater vent. Red plumes waved in the water. They took photos from a distance.
These animals have no mouth or stomach. Bacteria inside them help provide food. They are adapted to life in deep water.

examples.en: Giant scavengers known as hadal amphipods swarm decomposing whale carcasses on the pitch-black trench floor.
examples.zh: 被稱為超深淵端足類的巨型海蚤，如飢似渴地聚集在海床上啃食沉降的鯨落殘骸。

examples.en: Unlike tiny shoreline sand hoppers, deep-sea amphipods can grow larger than a human hand.
examples.zh: 與沙灘上跳躍的微小跳蝦截然不同，生活在萬米深淵底部的端足類體型甚至能比人類手掌還要巨大。

examples.en: Traps baited with fresh mackerel captured hundreds of translucent amphipods at ten thousand meters.
examples.zh: 以新鮮鯖魚作為誘餌的深海採樣誘捕籠，在萬米深處成功捕獲了數百隻通體半透明的端足類甲殼動物。

entries.definition: 超深淵端足類甲殼動物 (巨型深海海蚤)

explains.en: A tiny crustacean lives in the deepest ocean trenches. It has many legs and resembles a small shrimp. Some kinds grow unusually large in cold deep water.
Scientists find a pale, shrimp-like animal in dark ocean depths. It has a curved body and swims near the sea floor. This small crustacean belongs to a group with many species.
A deep-sea creature with a flattened body and pairs of legs feeds on scraps. It is related to shrimp but is not a true shrimp. This animal lives in ocean sediment.

examples.en: The delicate Mariana snailfish thrives under colossal pressures at depths exceeding 8,000 meters.
examples.zh: 通體粉紅透明、骨骼如膠質般的馬里亞納獅子魚，在八千公尺極限水壓下悠然游動。

examples.en: Lacking hard scales and rigid skeletons, the flexible snailfish relies on gel-like tissues to absorb pressure.
examples.zh: 由於缺乏堅硬鱗片與硬質骨骼，獅子魚仰賴充滿凝膠質彈性的特化軟組織從容吸收外界水壓。

examples.en: Cameras on the benthic lander recorded a curious snailfish brushing against the bait arm in the dark.
examples.zh: 著陸在萬米深海著陸器上的高畫質攝影機，拍下了一隻好奇的獅子魚在漆黑中輕拂誘餌手臂的珍貴畫面。

entries.definition: 萬米深淵超深海獅子魚 (透明膠質)

explains.en: A small pink fish lives in the cold, dark water of a deep ocean trench. Its body is soft.
Scientists photograph a pale fish far below the surface where pressure is immense. It has adapted to that habitat.
This family of deep-sea fish includes species with soft bodies. Some live at extraordinary depths.

examples.en: Eerie blue flashes of bioluminescence light up the midnight zone as startled jellyfish evade predators.
examples.zh: 當受到驚嚇的深海水母躲避捕食者時，身上閃爍出如夢似幻的幽藍生物冷光。

examples.en: Over ninety percent of creatures living in the mesopelagic zone utilize some form of bioluminescence.
examples.zh: 棲息在水深兩百至一千公尺中層帶的大多數深海生物，都演化出了利用自體生物冷光溝通獵食的能力。

examples.en: Luciferin reacting with luciferase enzymes generates cold bioluminescence with virtually no wasted heat.
examples.zh: 螢光素與螢光酵素在體內發生氧化反應釋放出神奇冷光，轉化效率極高且幾乎不浪費任何熱能。

entries.definition: 深海生物冷光自體發光奇觀

explains.en: Some living things make their own light through a chemical reaction. Fireflies use it to signal in the dark. Deep-sea animals may glow too.
A wave leaves blue points of light as tiny sea organisms move. The glow can be seen at night. Visitors should avoid disturbing the water.
A scientist studies a glowing animal in a dark tank. The creature produces light without a lamp. Different species use the glow for different reasons.

examples.en: Anglerfish dangle a glowing photophore organ like a fishing lure above their needle-sharp fangs.
examples.zh: 鮟鱇魚在頭頂懸掛著一顆如釣竿般閃爍發光的發光器，誘惑盲目游過的小魚自投羅網。

examples.en: Lanternfish arrange photophore rows along their bellies to blend with faint sunlight from above.
examples.zh: 燈籠魚在腹部整齊排列著微型發光器矩陣，發出微弱光芒與上方微光融為一體以達成消影偽裝。

examples.en: Shutter-like muscle flaps can cover the photophore in milliseconds to hide from pursuing squid.
examples.zh: 如同快門般的特化肌肉瓣膜能在數毫秒內遮蔽發光器，在被巨型烏賊追捕時瞬間遁入黑暗。

entries.definition: 深海燈籠魚發光器 (誘食警戒求偶)

explains.en: A small body part produces light in some deep-sea animals. It may help attract food or communicate. The glow is called bioluminescence.
A fish in a dark tank had a tiny glowing spot near its head. Smaller fish swam closer. The light helped it find prey.
Different species place these light-making parts in different locations. Some use them to hide from predators. Scientists study how the light is made.

examples.en: Ocean bottom seismometers deployed along the subduction zone provide early warnings for catastrophic tsunamis.
examples.zh: 佈設在板塊隱沒帶海床上的海底地震儀，為沿海城市爭取毀滅性海嘯來襲前的寶貴預警時間。

examples.en: Deep subsea seismology maps the subterranean magma chambers feeding active underwater volcanoes.
examples.zh: 深海地震學的精密觀測網絡，能精確繪製出為海底活火山源源供應炙熱岩漿的地底深層岩漿庫。

examples.en: Sudden acoustic tremors recorded by global seismology networks revealed a massive submarine landslide.
examples.zh: 全球海洋地震監測網記錄到的突發異常低頻震動，揭露了一起發生在遠洋海溝處的巨大海底山崩。

examples.en: Passive micro-earthquake seismology monitors underground rock movements during hydraulic stimulation.
examples.zh: 被動式微震「地震波監測學」（Seismology），在水力刺激壓裂過程中即時追蹤地下深處岩石裂隙微震。

examples.en: Research institutions invest heavily in observational seismology to provide automated earthquake early warnings.
examples.zh: 國家地震科研院所大力投資觀測地震學研究，成功打造出能在強震來襲前數秒發送手機警報的預警系統。

examples.en: Advances in planetary seismology revealed the existence of a liquid iron core inside Mars.
examples.zh: 行星地震學探測技術的重大突破，證實了火星地表深處同樣存在著一個液態鐵鎳合金的核心構造。

entries.definition: 海底地震觀測網與板塊構造地震學；微震被動式地震波地熱裂隙走向監測學

explains.en: Scientists study earthquakes, how they begin, and the waves they send through Earth. Sensors on land and under the sea record shaking. This field helps explain moving plates.
A network of instruments listens for tiny ground movements near a geothermal site. Researchers use the signals to map cracks underground. This science studies vibrations in Earth.
Researchers compare earthquake waves to learn about the planet’s inner layers. They place measuring devices on the ocean floor and on land. This branch of science examines earthquakes.

examples.en: Intense friction at the tectonic plate subduction zone generates mega-thrust earthquakes and deep ocean trenches.
examples.zh: 構造板塊交界處的板塊隱沒作用，在劇烈擠壓摩擦中孕育出萬米深海溝與毀滅性大地震。

examples.en: As one plate slips beneath another in the subduction zone, immense strain builds up over centuries.
examples.zh: 當一個板塊在隱沒帶緩慢向另一個板塊下方俯衝時，斷層交界面在數百年間累積了令人窒息的巨大應力。

examples.en: The Pacific Ring of Fire is defined by continuous subduction zones that give birth to coastal volcanic arcs.
examples.zh: 環太平洋火山地震帶正是由一連串綿延不絕的板塊隱沒帶所構成，因而催生出環繞大洋的火山島弧鏈。

entries.definition: 板塊碰撞向下隱沒帶 (引發海溝強震)

explains.en: One large piece of Earth’s crust slides beneath another. The movement can cause earthquakes and volcanoes.
A deep ocean trench forms where one plate moves under its neighbor. The process happens slowly over time.
This is the sinking of one tectonic plate below another. It shapes the surface of Earth.

examples.en: Seafloor spreading occurs when molten magma welled up from the mantle hardens into fresh oceanic crust.
examples.zh: 當熾熱的高溫地下岩漿從地函湧出接觸冰冷海水凝固，在大洋中脊不斷誕生全新的大洋地殼。

examples.en: Submarine eruptions freeze liquid magma into smooth, bulbous pillow basalt formations on the seabed.
examples.zh: 海底火山的噴發使灼熱岩漿遇冰水急冷，在海床上凝結成一顆顆光滑圓潤的枕狀玄武岩。

examples.en: Seismic sensors detected the subterranean movement of molten magma beneath the deep-sea caldera.
examples.zh: 佈設在深海破火山口周圍的微震感測器，靈敏捕捉到了地下深層熔融岩漿流動遷移的脈動。

examples.en: Shallow molten magma chambers beneath dormant volcanoes heat surrounding rocks to extreme temperatures.
examples.zh: 休眠火山下方數公里的淺層「熔融岩漿庫」（Magma Chambers），將周遭地層加熱至數百度極端高溫。

examples.en: Rising magma forced its way through subterranean fissures, causing harmonic volcanic tremors.
examples.zh: 地底深處熾熱的熔融岩漿沿著地殼構造斷裂帶劇烈向上擠壓湧動，引發持續規律的火山諧波震動。

examples.en: When liquid magma erupts onto the Earth's surface, it is classified scientifically as lava.
examples.zh: 當地下高溫黏稠的液態岩漿突破火山口噴湧衝出地表時，在地球科學上便被正式定義為熔岩流。

entries.definition: 地函湧升超高溫流動熔融岩漿；淺層活躍火山地函岩漿庫天然巨大熱源

explains.en: Very hot melted rock lies beneath the ground or a volcano. Pressure can push it upward. If it reaches the surface, it is called lava.
A scientist studies dark, melted rock beneath a volcano. Tiny crystals may form as it cools. The material can move through cracks underground.
Deep under Earth’s surface, heat melts rock into a thick liquid. It may collect in a chamber before an eruption. Gas can build up inside it.

examples.en: Seafloor spreading pushes continental tectonic plates apart at a rate of several centimeters every year.
examples.zh: 大洋中脊的海床擴張運動，正以每年數公分的速度悄然推動著兩側大陸板塊向外漂移。

examples.en: Symmetrical magnetic stripes recorded in basalt rock prove the historic reality of seafloor spreading.
examples.zh: 對稱排列於洋中脊兩側玄武岩中的地磁倒轉條帶，以鐵證證實了海床擴張學說的地質歷史真實性。

examples.en: At the mid-ocean spreading center, new lithosphere is forged continuously from upwelling volcanic materials.
examples.zh: 在大洋中脊的海床張裂擴張中心，湧升的地函火山物質正源源不絕鍛造出全新的海洋岩石圈。

entries.definition: 大洋中脊板塊張裂海床擴張的

explains.en: The ocean floor can grow wider as hot rock rises and cools. New crust forms near long underwater ridges. The movement takes place very slowly.
Scientists found matching bands of rock on each side of an ocean ridge. The pattern showed that the seafloor had moved apart. They studied the rocks’ ages.
Tectonic plates move a little each year. Their motion can change the shape of ocean basins. The process takes millions of years.

examples.en: Starfish, sea cucumbers, and glass sponges populate the silent, dark benthic boundary ecosystem.
examples.zh: 海星、深海海參與玻璃海綿，共同棲息在永恆寂靜的深海底棲帶泥質沉積物海床上。

examples.en: Heavy fishing trawlers drag huge nets across the seabed, causing severe devastation to sensitive benthic habitats.
examples.zh: 沉重的大型底拖漁網在海床上肆意刮除拖行，對極度脆弱敏感的底棲生物棲地造成不可逆的浩劫。

examples.en: Sampling the benthic sediments revealed thousands of unclassified microscopic nematode worm species.
examples.zh: 從海床泥樣中採集分析底棲沉積物，鑑定出數以千計科學界從未記載分類過的微型線蟲新物種。

examples.en: Benthic organisms survive crushing pressures and near-freezing water temperatures on the sea bottom.
examples.zh: 「底棲帶生物」（Benthic Organisms），在數百大氣壓與接近冰點的深海海床上頑強生存。

examples.en: Oceanographers collect core samples from benthic mud layers to study prehistoric climate patterns.
examples.zh: 海洋學家從海底底棲帶泥層採集柱狀沉積樣本，用以深入探究史前氣候變遷週期。

examples.en: Trawling nets dragged across the seafloor cause catastrophic destruction to vulnerable benthic communities.
examples.zh: 沿著海床拖曳的重型底拖漁網，會對極度脆弱的海底底棲生態群落造成毀滅性破壞。

entries.definition: 數千米深海海床底棲帶生態系群落的；承受數百大氣壓極端環境之深海底棲帶的

explains.en: Some animals live on or near the ocean floor, far below the bright surface. They include worms, crabs, and small fish. This adjective describes that sea-floor habitat.
A research team studies life among rocks and mud at the bottom of the sea. The organisms there must live with darkness and great pressure. They belong to the lowest marine zone.
A deep-sea sponge grows on the seabed rather than swimming in open water. Scientists examine the community around it. This word describes life at the bottom of a body of water.

examples.en: Pelagic predators like tuna and oceanic sharks hunt across vast stretches of sunlit open blue ocean.
examples.zh: 鮪魚與遠洋鯊魚等大型掠食者，自由穿梭在陽光灑落、無邊無際的開闊大洋水層中巡航捕食。

examples.en: Pelagic ecosystems depend on microscopic phytoplankton floating near the surface to produce energy.
examples.zh: 開闊大洋表層水體生態系統，高度仰賴漂浮在陽光透光層的微型浮游植物進行光合作用提供初級能量。

examples.en: Migratory birds fly thousands of miles across pelagic waters without ever setting foot on land.
examples.zh: 遠洋海鳥在開闊無垠的大洋水域上空振翅翱翔數千英里，數月之間足跡未曾踏足任何陸地。

entries.definition: 遠洋開闊無垠水層 (遠離陸地與海床) 的

explains.en: A tuna swims far from shore in open ocean water. It searches for smaller fish.
A researcher studies animals that live in the sea away from the coast and seabed. Some move through the water column.
This adjective describes life in the open ocean. It contrasts with habitats near shore or on the bottom.

examples.en: Safeguarding the pristine hadal seafloor from destructive commercial seabed mining is a global moral duty.
examples.zh: 保護歷經億萬年純淨無暇的原始深海海床免受破壞性採礦摧殘，是全人類的共同道德責任。

examples.en: The remote abyssal plain remained completely pristine until synthetic microplastics began sinking into the sediments.
examples.zh: 這片遙遠深邃的萬米深海平原億萬年來純淨原始，直到人造塑膠微粒開始悄悄沉澱進入深海沉積物。

examples.en: Marine sanctuaries aim to keep these pristine underwater habitats untouched for scientific study.
examples.zh: 劃設公海深海海洋自然保護區的核心目標，正是為了將這些純淨無暇的水下原始棲地永久封存供科學探索。

entries.definition: 億萬年未受任何人工干擾之原始深海的

explains.en: A beach with no litter and clear water looks clean and untouched. Visitors help keep it that way by carrying their rubbish away. Few people have changed it.
A museum displays a book in excellent condition, with its pages neat and unmarked. It has been carefully stored for many years. The item appears almost new.
A forest far from roads has little sign of human activity. Trees and streams remain in a natural state. Protecting it keeps the area intact.

examples.en: Beneath the calm ocean surface lies a colossal, three-dimensional water expanse larger than all dry continents.
examples.zh: 在平靜的海面之下，隱藏著一個比地球所有陸地加總還要遼闊數倍的深藍廣袤大洋空間。

examples.en: The research vessel drifted alone on the vast expanse of the open blue Pacific Ocean.
examples.zh: 孤單的海洋科研船靜靜漂泊在開闊無垠、浩瀚壯闊的深藍太平洋萬里海天之中。

examples.en: Looking into the empty blue expanse of the ocean reminds humans of how small our planet's dry land truly is.
examples.zh: 凝視著空曠深邃、無邊無際的湛藍廣袤大洋，時刻提醒著人類陸地在整顆藍色水星上是多麼渺小。

entries.definition: 浩瀚無垠深不可測之深藍廣袤大洋

explains.en: A wide open area of land, sea, or sky is this. It may seem to stretch far in every direction. A desert can have one.
The boat crossed a broad stretch of calm water. No land was visible nearby. The crew watched the horizon.
The word can describe a large area or amount. A broad field of stars filled the telescope’s view. It suggests great size.

examples.en: Cross-laminated timber (CLT) panels provide fire-resistant strength capable of replacing steel beams.
examples.zh: 正交膠合集成板具備卓越的抗火與耐震承重力，足以取代傳統大跨距鋼樑。

examples.en: Factories press multi-layered boards perpendicular to one another to produce rigid cross-laminated panels.
examples.zh: 自動化工廠將多層乾燥木板依直角紋理垂直交錯膠合加壓，製造出質地堅韌的厚重正交膠合板。

examples.en: Using cross-laminated timber allows builders to assemble multi-story floor slabs in mere hours.
examples.zh: 採用正交膠合集成板施工，工班僅需短短數小時就能吊裝完成一整層大跨距的耐震木樓板。

entries.definition: 正交膠合集成材 (CLT 耐火抗震) 的

explains.en: Builders glue layers of timber so that each one runs at a right angle to the next. This makes a strong panel for walls and floors. The structure can be used in tall buildings.
A wooden construction panel is made from boards stacked in alternating directions. The layers help it resist bending and shaking. This engineered material can be fire resistant.
Large solid panels are formed by bonding lumber with the grain turned across each layer. The design adds strength and stability. Builders use them as structural walls.

examples.en: Curved glulam roof arches create soaring, column-free airport terminals with natural warmth.
examples.zh: 優美彎曲的膠合木樑拱頂結構，為挑高無柱的機場航廈營造出溫暖優雅的原木氛圍。

examples.en: Glulam beams can span tens of meters across sports arenas without requiring intermediate steel pillars.
examples.zh: 膠合集成木樑能大跨距橫跨數十公尺體育場館上方，且全程無需立下任何礙眼的鋼筋中繼立柱。

examples.en: Waterproof adhesives bond graded lumber laminations together to produce reliable glulam arches.
examples.zh: 耐候防水型高分子接著劑將嚴選規格材緊密膠合成型，打造出耐重抗彎的結構膠合集成拱樑。

entries.definition: 膠合集成木樑 (大跨距曲線優美)

explains.en: A builder joins layers of wood with glue to make a strong curved beam. The beam can span a large room.
An engineered timber arch supports the roof of a sports hall. Several boards are bonded together.
This structural material is made from glued layers of wood. It can be shaped into long beams.

examples.en: The eco-friendly corporate headquarters achieved LEED Platinum certification for its net-zero energy design.
examples.zh: 這棟前衛環保的企業總部大樓，憑藉卓越的淨零耗能規劃勇奪美國 LEED 最高白金級認證。

examples.en: Earning a Platinum rating requires scoring top points in water efficiency, carbon neutrality, and materials.
examples.zh: 想要摘下白金級認證桂冠，必須在節水能效、碳中和目標以及低碳環保建材評分上拿下頂尖高分。

examples.en: International tech giants mandate that all new regional offices must attain LEED Platinum standards.
examples.zh: 國際跨國科技巨頭明文規定，其所有新落成的區域營運中心皆必須符合 LEED 白金級綠建築標準。

examples.en: Encased in solid 950 platinum, the hefty watch feels cool, reassuring, and undeniably luxurious on the wrist.
examples.zh: 錶殼採用密度極高的「950 純白金」（Platinum）鍛造，佩戴在手腕上沉穩冰涼，散發出低調奢華質感。

examples.en: The couple exchanged timeless wedding rings forged from durable platinum that will never tarnish over decades.
examples.zh: 新人在親友的衷心祝福下互換了由純鉑金打造的結婚對戒，象徵彼此的愛戀歷經數十載歲月也永不褪色褪質。

examples.en: Automobile catalytic converters utilize precious platinum nanoparticles to convert toxic exhaust emissions into harmless gases.
examples.zh: 現代環保汽車排氣管內部配置的三元觸媒轉化器，利用珍貴的鉑金奈米顆粒將有害廢氣淨化為無害二氧化碳與水。

examples.en: A single 500-meter metallic asteroid contains more industrial platinum than has ever been mined in human history.
examples.zh: 單單一顆五百公尺直徑的金屬小行星，其蘊藏的「工業鉑金」（Platinum）便超越了人類歷史上的開採總量。

examples.en: Hydrogen fuel cell vehicles rely on platinum catalysts to split hydrogen molecules and generate clean electricity.
examples.zh: 氫燃料電池純電車在電堆正負極上高度仰賴稀缺的貴金屬鉑金作為催化劑，以高效分解氫分子進行電化學反應。

examples.en: The bride selected an elegant wedding band crafted from durable platinum that resists tarnishing over decades.
examples.zh: 準新娘挑選了一枚由質地堅硬、歷經數十年歲月依然純白如新的頂級天然鉑金白金打造的優雅定情婚戒。

entries.definition: 美國 LEED 白金級綠建築最高認證的；950 純白金貴金屬手工拋光錶殼；白金；單顆金屬小行星蘊藏價值數兆美元之工業用鉑金

explains.en: This rare silvery metal is used in jewelry and some medical devices. It resists corrosion. It can also help certain chemical reactions happen.
A ring made from a valuable pale metal stays bright for a long time. Jewelers shape it carefully. The material is heavier than many other metals.
A record company may give a top award when an album sells extremely well. The award’s name comes from a precious metal. Its exact rules can vary.

examples.en: On-site graywater recycling systems treat sink water to flush toilets and irrigate rooftop gardens.
examples.zh: 社區內建的中水回收再利用系統，將洗手水過濾淨化後用於沖馬桶與花園澆灌。

examples.en: Separating blackwater from kitchen and shower graywater simplifies biological treatment processes.
examples.zh: 將糞尿黑水分流，單獨收集浴室洗澡水與洗手台中水，大幅簡化了後續生物膜濾淨處理流程。

examples.en: Dual plumbing pipes route treated graywater directly into landscaped pond fountains.
examples.zh: 社區雙軌式給排水管線，將淨化合格的再生中水直接導入中庭景觀水池與造景噴泉作為水源。

entries.definition: 中水回收再利用系統 (沖馬桶與灌溉)

explains.en: Water from sinks, showers, or washing machines may be reused after treatment. It is not toilet waste. Some homes use it for plants or flushing.
The family collected water from the shower in a safe system. They reused it to water garden shrubs. They followed local rules.
Separate pipes keep this water apart from drinking water. Filters remove some dirt and soap. The system must be maintained carefully.

examples.en: Roadside vegetated bioswales filter toxic motor oil and sediment before runoff enters local rivers.
examples.zh: 設置在馬路兩旁的生態植草溝，利用土壤與草皮根系自然過濾街道逕流中的泥沙與油污。

examples.en: Deep-rooted native rushes in the bioswale slow down rushing stormwater, encouraging deep infiltration.
examples.zh: 生態植草溝中種植的深根性原生燈心草，能有效減緩暴雨逕流衝擊，促進水分深層滲透。

examples.en: Municipalities replace concrete curbs with roadside bioswales to naturally beautify suburban streets.
examples.zh: 市政當局以路緣生態植草溝逐步取代生硬的水泥邊溝，在自然排水的同時美化郊區街景綠意。

entries.definition: 生態植草溝 (自然過濾街道泥砂逕流)

explains.en: A planted channel beside a road catches rainwater and lets it soak into the ground. Soil and roots filter dirt from runoff. It also helps reduce flooding.
Rain flows into a shallow garden trench instead of straight into a drain. Plants slow the water and capture pollutants. This green feature manages stormwater naturally.
A street landscape includes a long planted dip that collects water after a storm. The soil filters it before it reaches local streams. This drainage feature uses plants to clean runoff.

examples.en: Incorporating indoor waterfalls and lush greenery embraces biophilia, lowering stress for office workers.
examples.zh: 在辦公室內大量引入植栽景觀與流水日光，體現了熱愛生命的親生物性設計，撫慰員工身心。

examples.en: Modern biophilia focuses on connecting urban residents with natural daylight, fresh breezes, and organic textures.
examples.zh: 當代親生物建築理念聚焦於拉近都市居民與大自然的距離，巧妙引進微風、暖陽與天然原木石材。

examples.en: Interior spaces grounded in biophilia have been shown to speed patient recovery times in hospitals.
examples.zh: 醫療院所的研究證實，融入親生物性綠化設計的病房空間，能顯著加速病患術後的身心復原速度。

entries.definition: 親生物性設計 (將陽光綠意引入室內)

explains.en: A worker feels calmer in an office with plants and daylight. People often enjoy being near living things.
A child spends time in a garden and feels connected to nature. This preference can shape building design.
This idea describes people’s attraction to living things and natural places. Designers may bring nature indoors.

examples.en: Installing precision-engineered modular bathroom pods cuts on-site construction timelines in half.
examples.zh: 在工廠精準預製一體成型的模組化整體衛浴，直接吊裝進場能讓現場工期縮短一半。

examples.en: Modular wooden housing blocks can be stacked like building blocks to form stylish student dorms.
examples.zh: 模組化木構住宅單元能如積木般在現場迅速堆疊拼裝，在極短時間內築起時尚前衛的學生宿舍。

examples.en: Strict factory tolerances in modular manufacturing eliminate common on-site alignment errors.
examples.zh: 模組化工廠在精密控管下生產的構件公差達到毫米級，徹底消除了傳統工地現場施工的人為對位誤差。

entries.definition: 異地工廠預製模組化整體衛浴與構件的

explains.en: A design made from separate units can be changed by adding or moving parts. A shelf may grow as a family needs more space. Each unit fits with the others.
A building is made from sections prepared in a factory and joined at the site. This can speed up construction. The parts must fit together.
A computer program can be divided into smaller pieces that work together. A programmer may update one part without changing all the others.

examples.en: Off-site prefabrication reduces construction waste, dust pollution, and neighborhood noise disturbances.
examples.zh: 採用先進的異地預製預鑄工法，能將工地現場的廢棄物、粉塵污染與噪音降至最低。

examples.en: Quality control is vastly superior in indoor prefabrication plants unaffected by bad weather.
examples.zh: 設在室內不受刮風下雨影響的自動化預鑄工廠，在鋼筋綁紮與混凝土養護品管上遠勝傳統野外工地。

examples.en: Advanced robotic prefabrication produces customized timber trusses in a fraction of traditional build times.
examples.zh: 高精度機器人預製加工中心，能在極短時間內按照 3D 圖面精準切割出客製化的複雜木構桁架。

entries.definition: 乾式預鑄工法 (零工地粉塵噪音廢棄物)

explains.en: Making parts of a building in a factory before bringing them to the site is this method. Workers assemble the pieces later. It can reduce construction time.
The wall sections were built indoors while the ground was prepared outside. A truck carried them to the site. Workers joined them together.
Factory work can happen in dry conditions and use materials carefully. The finished parts must fit precisely. Planning is important.

examples.en: Digital forensics experts recovered deleted chat logs from the suspect's water-damaged hard drive.
examples.zh: 數位鑑識專家成功從嫌犯泡水的報廢硬碟中，還原出關鍵的加密通訊刪除對話紀錄。

examples.en: Developments in DNA forensics have solved cold cases that had baffled detectives for decades.
examples.zh: DNA 鑑識科學的飛躍進展，讓許多曾讓老刑警苦思數十年不得其解的歷史懸案迎刃而解。

examples.en: The police department established a specialized mobile forensics unit for fast on-site data extraction.
examples.zh: 警察局成立了高規格行動鑑識實驗車隊，能在第一時間趕赴重大現場進行即時數位採證提取。

entries.definition: 數位鑑識與法醫鑑識科學

explains.en: Investigators examine clues from a crime scene to learn what happened. They may study fingerprints, computer files, or body evidence. This scientific work supports legal cases.
A specialist checks a laptop for deleted messages after a crime. Another examines physical traces in a laboratory. These methods use science to answer legal questions.
Doctors and scientists may examine a body to learn how a person died. Digital experts can also recover evidence from devices. This field applies careful analysis to investigations.

examples.en: Dusting volcanic ash powder over the smooth glass table revealed three distinct latent fingerprints.
examples.zh: 在光滑玻璃桌面上輕輕刷掃磁性粉末，顯現出三枚肉眼難辨的清晰潛伏指紋。

examples.en: Cyanoacrylate fuming chambers visualize faint latent prints left on oily aluminum drink cans.
examples.zh: 透過三秒膠三聚氰胺熱燻氣化顯影箱，能在油膩的鋁箔飲料罐上清晰顯現出微弱的潛伏指紋。

examples.en: The latent fingerprint on the steering wheel matched the missing driver’s biometric file.
examples.zh: 方向盤上刷顯出來的這枚潛伏指紋，經指紋比對與失蹤駕駛的生物辨識建檔完全吻合。

entries.definition: 磁性粉末刷顯潛伏指紋的；潛在的

explains.en: A hidden mark on a glass becomes visible when powder is brushed over it. It was there but could not be seen before.
A person has an ability that has not yet been developed. Practice may help it appear.
This adjective means present but not yet visible, active, or developed. It can describe clues or abilities.

examples.en: Automated fingerprint databases matched the suspect's thumbprint within twenty seconds of scanning.
examples.zh: 全國指紋資料庫在掃描輸入二十秒內，即精準比對出嫌疑人的大拇指指紋。

examples.en: Every human fingerprint possesses unique whorls, arches, and ridges that remain unchanged through life.
examples.zh: 每個人的手指指紋都擁有獨一無二的斗型紋、弓型紋與箕型紋，且終生保持恆定不變。

examples.en: The technician took digital fingerprint impressions from all arrested suspects at the precinct.
examples.zh: 鑑識技術員在分局偵訊室中，使用高階光學滾動感測器為所有被捕嫌疑人建立數位指紋檔。

entries.definition: 指紋自動比對辨識系統 (AFIS)；指紋

explains.en: The lines on a person’s fingertip form a pattern that can help identify them. No two people have exactly the same pattern. A scanner can read it.
A detective finds a smudged mark on a glass and compares it with known records. The mark may show who touched the object. It is one clue, not proof by itself.
A phone may unlock when its owner touches a small sensor. The sensor checks the unique ridges on the finger. A passcode is still useful.

examples.en: Spraying luminol solution onto the scrubbed floor triggered an eerie blue chemical glow revealing washed blood.
examples.zh: 將魯米諾試劑噴灑在擦洗過的地板上，瞬間激發出幽藍螢光，揭露出被清洗過的血跡。

examples.en: Even after bleach was used to sanitize the bathtub, luminol detected trace iron hemoglobin molecules.
examples.zh: 即便兇手試圖使用高濃度漂白水刷洗浴缸滅證，魯米諾試劑依然靈敏測出了微量血紅素鐵離子。

examples.en: Investigators documented the luminol glow using long-exposure photography in total darkness.
examples.zh: 鑑識小組在伸手不見五指的完全漆黑環境中，利用長時間曝光攝影將魯米諾螢光反應完整定格拍照。

entries.definition: 魯米諾試劑潛血反應螢光檢驗

explains.en: A chemical used by investigators can glow blue when it reacts with tiny traces of blood. The glow is not always proof of a crime. It helps find places to test.
The dark room lit up faintly after a specialist sprayed a solution. She marked the glowing spots for further tests. The team wore protective gear.
Some cleaners can also cause a reaction. Investigators use other tests to check what they find. Trained experts handle the chemical.

examples.en: Bloodstain splatter analysis established that the victim was seated when the blunt attack occurred.
examples.zh: 透過精密的血跡噴濺形態分析，鑑識專家推斷受害者遇襲時正坐在椅子上。

examples.en: High-velocity impact splatter patterns on the bedroom ceiling were consistent with gunshot wounds.
examples.zh: 天花板上呈現的高速衝擊細微血霧噴濺形態，與近距離致命槍擊所產生的創口特徵完全吻合。

examples.en: Angle calculations derived from the elongated blood splatter indicated the killer’s exact standing position.
examples.zh: 鑑識人員利用長橢圓形噴濺血滴進行撞擊角度反向推算，精準標定出兇手行兇時的站立位置。

entries.definition: 血跡噴濺形態動力學分析；噴濺

explains.en: A liquid can hit a surface and scatter into many small drops. Investigators study the marks to understand how an event happened. This pattern may help show direction.
A child flicks paint onto paper, leaving drops and spots. The verb means to scatter liquid in this way. The noun can describe the marks left behind.
When a small object strikes a puddle, water spreads across nearby stones. The scattered drops form a pattern. Scientists can analyze such marks.

examples.en: Ballistics examiners matched microscopic barrel rifling grooves on the fired lead bullet to the seized pistol.
examples.zh: 彈道學專家在顯微鏡下比對彈頭上的微細膛線擦痕，確認正是查扣的手槍所擊發。

examples.en: Trajectory lasers placed across the shattered window helped ballistics teams map the shooter’s line of fire.
examples.zh: 橫跨碎裂落地窗架設的紅色彈道雷射光束，協助彈道專家精確標繪出狙擊手的開槍射擊路徑。

examples.en: The ballistics report confirmed that both victims had been targeted using the same customized rifle.
examples.zh: 刑事局彈道鑑定報告正式出爐，確認兩名死者均是遭同一把經過改裝的制式步槍所射殺。

entries.definition: 彈道學膛線擦痕與彈頭比對

explains.en: Investigators compare a bullet with marks left by a firearm. The evidence may help identify its source.
A scientist studies how an object moves after being launched. Speed and direction matter.
This field studies the motion of projectiles and related evidence. It can be used in science and investigations.

examples.en: The robotic metal detector located a spent nine-millimeter brass casing hidden under tall lawn grass.
examples.zh: 金屬探測器在草坪深處成功尋獲一顆槍擊案現場遺留的九毫米黃銅彈殼。

examples.en: Firing pin indentations stamped on the brass casing provide distinctive microscopic toolmarks.
examples.zh: 撞針猛烈擊發時在黃銅底火彈殼上烙下的凹痕特徵，宛如槍枝獨一無二的微觀身分指紋。

examples.en: Investigators recovered five ejected cartridge casings scattered near the victim's abandoned car.
examples.zh: 鑑識刑警在被害人遭棄置的轎車旁地面，陸續拾獲了五枚退膛散落的黃銅彈殼。

examples.en: Threaded corrosion-resistant steel casing protects shallow drinking aquifers from deep geothermal brine.
examples.zh: 螺紋旋緊的抗腐蝕「合金鋼管套管」（Steel Casing），能百分之百隔絕深層地熱滷水，保護淺層飲用水源。

examples.en: The sausage maker stuffed seasoned minced pork into a natural collagen casing.
examples.zh: 遵循古法手工灌香腸的老字號肉舖師傅，熟練地將調味醃漬好的黑豬絞肉均勻灌入天然薄透的腸衣中。

examples.en: Anodized aluminum outer casing shields the internal electronics of the laptop from impact damage.
examples.zh: 陽極氧化航太鋁合金打造的堅固筆電金屬外殼，能有效保護內部微處理器與主機板免受外部撞擊損壞。

entries.definition: 槍擊現場遺留之黃銅彈殼；外殼；灌漿固井之抗強酸腐蝕合金鋼管套管

explains.en: A protective outer cover keeps a machine or tool’s inner parts safe. It may be made of plastic or metal. Screws hold it in place.
A factory forms an outer shell around a product. The cover keeps out dust and makes the item easier to hold. Workers check that it fits.
A sausage has a thin outer skin that holds its filling together. It may be natural or made for food production. The surrounding sentence shows which kind of cover is meant.

examples.en: The official post-mortem autopsy determined that death resulted from internal hemorrhaging rather than drowning.
examples.zh: 正式執行的法醫病理解剖相驗，確認死者死因為內出血而非落水溺斃。

examples.en: Performing a systematic forensic autopsy includes toxicological screening of liver and vitreous fluid.
examples.zh: 執行標準法醫解剖程序時，必須常規採集死者的肝臟組織與眼球玻璃體液進行毒物化驗。

examples.en: The autopsy revealed that the fatal stab wound had pierced the victim's left ventricle.
examples.zh: 遺體病理解剖報告證實，致命的一刀由肋骨間隙刺入並直接穿透了受害者的左心室。

entries.definition: 法醫病理解剖相驗鑑定；解剖

explains.en: A medical examination after death can help find how a person died. A trained doctor studies the body. The findings may answer questions for a family.
A pathologist carefully examined the body to learn why the person had become ill. The report helped doctors understand what happened. It was handled respectfully.
This examination may be requested by officials or a family. It can involve tests of organs and tissues. Laws guide when it may be done.

examples.en: Gas chromatography toxicology screening detected lethal concentrations of cyanide inside the wine glass.
examples.zh: 氣相層析儀毒物化學篩檢，在高腳酒杯殘液中檢驗出致死劑量的氰化物劇毒。

examples.en: The coroner sent blood and urine samples to the central toxicology lab to check for fentanyl overdose.
examples.zh: 法醫相驗官迅速將死者血液與尿液檢體直送法醫毒物實驗室，檢驗是否涉及強效止痛藥芬太尼過量。

examples.en: Negative toxicology results confirmed that the driver was entirely sober at the moment of the crash.
examples.zh: 全面呈陰性的血液毒物化驗報告，有力證實肇事駕駛在車禍撞擊發生的瞬間處於完全清醒狀態。

entries.definition: 毒物化學分析 (檢驗血液毒藥物殘留)

explains.en: A laboratory tests blood to find alcohol, medicines, or poison. The results may help explain a person’s illness or death. This science studies harmful substances.
Experts examine a sample to learn whether a chemical harmed someone. They identify and measure substances in the body. This field connects chemistry with health and safety.
A doctor may request tests for drug levels after a suspected poisoning. Specialists interpret the results. This area studies how poisons and medicines affect living things.

examples.en: Detectives collected a sterile buccal swab from the volunteer to rule out genetic contamination at the scene.
examples.zh: 刑警採集在場人員的無菌口腔棉棒黏膜拭子，以排除現場遺留基因遭受人為污染。

examples.en: Technicians swabbed the gear shift lever to collect epithelial skin cells left behind by the car thief.
examples.zh: 鑑識技術員使用無菌拭子反覆擦拭排檔桿表面，採集偷車賊握持時脫落的微量上皮細胞。

examples.en: Each cotton swab is air-dried in a laminar flow hood to prevent fungal mold from destroying DNA.
examples.zh: 每根採集完畢的棉花拭子皆放入超淨工作台中自然陰乾，以防潮濕長霉分解破壞脆弱的 DNA。

entries.definition: 無菌口腔黏膜拭子採樣；用拭子擦拭

explains.en: A nurse rubs a soft-tipped stick inside a patient’s cheek to collect a sample. The test may look for infection.
A cleaner uses a small absorbent stick to wipe liquid from a narrow space. It reaches places a cloth cannot.
This small tool collects or applies liquid with a soft tip. The verb means to clean or sample with it.

examples.en: Investigative genetic genealogy identified the serial killer through distant third-cousin DNA public profiles.
examples.zh: 辦案團隊運用司法基因譜系學，透過遠房三代堂表親的公開 DNA 資料庫鎖定真兇。

examples.en: Genetic genealogy combines commercial genealogy databases with traditional family tree research.
examples.zh: 司法遺傳譜系學將民間商業尋根基因庫與傳統族譜調閱深度結合，開創了現代辦案新紀元。

examples.en: By triangulating family lines through genetic genealogy, detectives narrowed down thousands of suspects to two brothers.
examples.zh: 透過司法譜系學進行跨世代家族族譜三角定位比對，辦案刑警奇蹟般地將數千名嫌疑人縮小至一對親兄弟。

entries.definition: 司法遺傳基因譜系學 (偵破冷案)

explains.en: A family record shows how parents, children, and earlier relatives are connected. Names and dates help build the tree. Old letters can provide clues.
A student interviews grandparents and draws a chart of relatives. They discover that two branches share an ancestor. The study of family history helps organize the facts.
Researchers may trace the history of a family or a group of living things. They compare records and shared features. Each branch shows relationships over time.

examples.en: International cybercrime rings use encrypted networks to siphon millions from online banking users.
examples.zh: 跨國網路犯罪集團，利用暗網與加密通道盜領全球網路銀行用戶數百萬美元。

examples.en: Specialized task forces coordinate global raids to dismantle syndicated cybercrime infrastructure.
examples.zh: 跨國科技打詐專案小組透過跨國警政合作展開同步突襲，一舉瓦解龐大的組織型網路犯罪伺服器網絡。

examples.en: Ransomware and identity theft have become the most financially devastating branches of cybercrime.
examples.zh: 勒索軟體攻擊與個人身分盜用冒名詐貸，已成為當今全球經濟損失最慘重的科技網路犯罪樣態。

entries.definition: 跨國組織型網路犯罪集團；網路犯罪

explains.en: An illegal act carried out using computers or the internet is this. It may involve stealing money or private information. Strong passwords can help protect people.
A stranger sent a message pretending to be a bank. The family did not share its password. They reported the message.
Online crimes can cross borders. Police may work together to investigate them. Never open suspicious links or files.

examples.en: Federal agents executed a court-approved search and seizure warrant at the fraudulent crypto company.
examples.zh: 執法人員持法院核發的合法搜索扣押令，突襲查扣虛擬貨幣詐騙公司的伺服器。

examples.en: All mobile devices and ledgers collected during the seizure were immediately secured in faraday bags.
examples.zh: 執行扣押搜索過程中查扣的所有涉案智慧手機與帳冊，立即被封入防信號洩漏的法拉第屏蔽袋內。

examples.en: Unlawful evidence seizure without probable cause leads to immediate suppression by the trial judge.
examples.zh: 未經法院核發令狀或欠缺合理懷疑的違法搜索扣押，將導致取得的證物遭審理法官依法全數排除剔除。

entries.definition: 依法院核發令狀合法搜索扣押；沒收

explains.en: With a court’s permission, officers may take property as part of an investigation. They follow legal rules when collecting it. This is the official taking of items.
Authorities remove goods that were used illegally or obtained through crime. A judge may approve the action. The property is taken under the law.
Police carry a warrant while searching a home and collecting evidence. The items may be held for a court case. This legal action takes possession of property.

examples.en: Attaching a hardware write-blocker ensures that connecting the hard drive does not alter a single byte of data.
examples.zh: 接上硬體防寫保護轉接器，確保在讀取嫌犯硬碟時絕不改動到任何一個位元組資料。

examples.en: Using an external write-blocker maintains digital evidence integrity during investigative examinations.
examples.zh: 透過外接專用硬體防寫轉接器接入電腦，能在鑑識檢視過程中完全保全數位電子證據的原始性。

examples.en: The forensic examiner verified that the write-blocker’s LED signal confirmed read-only operation mode.
examples.zh: 數位鑑識官反覆檢視防寫器上的指示燈狀態，百分之百確認目前處於唯讀禁止寫入安全模式。

entries.definition: 硬體防寫防竄改讀卡轉接器；阻礙者

explains.en: A computer user installs a device that prevents changes to a storage drive during examination. It protects the original data.
A basketball player stands in front of an opponent to stop a shot. The player acts as an obstacle.
This person or device prevents something from passing or happening. The exact use depends on the context.

examples.en: Calculating matching SHA-256 hash values proves mathematically that the digital evidence remained untouched.
examples.zh: 計算前後完全吻合的 SHA-256 密碼雜湊值，在數學上鐵證數位證物未遭任何竄改。

examples.en: Any modification of a single file character completely scrambles the resulting MD5 hash output.
examples.zh: 即使僅對檔案中的單一空白字符進行改動，重新計算所產生的 MD5 雜湊值將徹底發生雪崩巨變。

examples.en: The court verified the forensic report by comparing the hash value taken at seizure with the lab image hash.
examples.zh: 法院審理時透過嚴格比對查扣當下計算之雜湊值與鑑識實驗室鏡像雜湊值，確認證物完全同一。

entries.definition: SHA-256 密碼雜湊值 (確保證物原封未動)

explains.en: A computer turns information into a short code that can help check whether a file changed. The same input usually gives the same result. It is not meant to reveal the original text.
A cook chops food into small pieces and mixes it with seasoning. The dish is often served warm. Recipes vary by family.
A service can replace a password with a fixed digital code for storage. The code helps protect the account. A strong system handles stolen codes carefully.

examples.en: Capturing live volatile RAM memory before shutting down the computer preserves active encryption keys.
examples.zh: 在拔掉電腦電源前即時提取暫存於揮發性動態記憶體中的數據，能搶救出解密金鑰。

examples.en: Once the machine is unplugged from the wall, all volatile data stored inside memory chips is lost forever.
examples.zh: 一旦直接拔掉主機電源插頭，暫存在揮發性記憶體晶片中的所有即時連線與加密金鑰將永久灰飛煙滅。

examples.en: Forensic specialists connect a portable drive to run triage tools that dump volatile memory structures.
examples.zh: 鑑識專家在現場迅速插上便攜開機磁碟，執行現場快篩腳本將珍貴的揮發性記憶體資料結構全數導出。

examples.en: Asteroidal ice and trapped carbon volatiles can be converted directly into rocket propellants in deep space.
examples.zh: 小行星封存的水冰與有機「氣體揮發分」（Volatiles），未來可在深空中直接提煉轉化為火箭發射燃料。

examples.en: Geopolitical instability in oil-producing regions created a highly volatile global crude oil commodity market.
examples.zh: 主要產油國地緣政治危機風雲變色，在國際能源市場上引發了劇烈波動、令人捉摸不定的國際原油期貨走勢。

examples.en: Chemical storage rooms must be properly ventilated to prevent the dangerous buildup of toxic volatile fumes.
examples.zh: 化學實驗室化學品儲藏間必須維持全天候良好抽風排氣通風，嚴防揮發性有毒有機溶劑蒸氣在密閉室內過度積聚。

entries.definition: 揮發性 RAM 動態記憶體現場即時提取的；蘊藏在深層岩石孔隙中可提煉為火箭燃料之揮發分；揮發性的

explains.en: A liquid that changes into vapor easily has this quality. Some computer memory also loses stored information when power is turned off. The meaning depends on the topic.
The lab kept the liquid tightly closed because it evaporated quickly. Workers used it in a safe, airy room. They wore gloves.
A changing situation can also be described this way. A small event may cause a quick change. Handle dangerous materials only with trained adults.

examples.en: Extracting image metadata revealed the precise GPS coordinates and camera serial number of the photograph.
examples.zh: 解析照片檔案中的元數據，直接揭露出拍攝當下的精確 GPS 經緯度座標與相機機身序號。

examples.en: Email metadata headers trace the global path of messages across intermediate relay mail servers.
examples.zh: 電子郵件表頭內嵌的伺服器元數據，能清晰追蹤信件在跨國轉發郵件伺服器間傳遞的真實路由軌跡。

examples.en: The document metadata showed the contract had been authored three days after the victim purportedly died.
examples.zh: 扣押合約 Word 檔案的後台元數據鐵證如山地顯示，該份協議竟然是在被害人身亡後三天始由他人建立。

entries.definition: 數位照片 EXIF 拍攝時間與 GPS 元數據

explains.en: A digital photo can store the date, camera settings, and location where it was taken. This information describes the file rather than the picture itself. It helps organize and search images.
A music file may include the song title, artist, and album name. These details help a player sort the collection. They are information about the data.
A computer file has extra details about its author, size, and creation time. Software can use them to find and manage the file. This is descriptive information attached to data.

examples.en: The suspect denied visiting the dock, but the geotag embedded in his selfie proved his physical presence.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人矢口否認曾去過碼頭，但他自拍照中內嵌的地理定位標籤鐵證他當時人就在現場。

examples.en: Investigators extracted cellular tower geotags from call logs to track the kidnapper’s flight path.
examples.zh: 辦案人員從通聯通話紀錄中提取手機基地台地理標籤紀錄，精準勾勒出綁匪逃亡時的移動路線。

examples.en: Social media photos uploaded without disabling geotags inadvertently exposed the fugitive’s hideout address.
examples.zh: 逃犯在社群平台發布照片時因未關閉相機地理定位標籤功能，不慎將自己藏匿的偏僻別墅地址暴露無遺。

entries.definition: 手機基地台與相片地理定位標籤；打卡標記

explains.en: A photo stores the place where it was taken. A map app can show the location.
A traveler adds a location label to a picture online. Friends can see which city it came from.
This is location information attached to digital content. It can help organize photos or posts.

examples.en: Forensic labs deploy GPU clusters to execute brute-force dictionary attacks against locked wallet files.
examples.zh: 鑑識實驗室調用高效能顯示卡叢集，對加密冷錢包檔案執行每秒億次運算的暴力密碼破解。

examples.en: Setting eight-character simple passwords makes accounts vulnerable to rapid automated brute-force attacks.
examples.zh: 僅設定八碼純數字或簡單英文密碼，會讓網路帳戶在自動化暴力密碼窮舉攻擊下瞬間遭到攻破。

examples.en: The brute-force software systematically tried billions of character combinations every single second.
examples.zh: 暴力破解軟體以每秒數十億組字元排列組合的驚人運算速度，日夜不休地測試解鎖涉案硬碟主密碼。

entries.definition: 暴力密碼破解運算叢集的；暴力破解

explains.en: A computer can try many possible passwords one after another until it finds a match. Strong, long passwords make this harder. A lockout can slow repeated guesses.
An attacker may use repeated guesses to break into an account. Security tools can limit attempts. People should choose passwords that are hard to guess.
Someone solves a puzzle by testing every possible choice instead of using a clever shortcut. This takes a lot of time. The phrase describes a direct, forceful method.

examples.en: Prosecutors issued a legal subpoena demanding email header logs from the multinational cloud provider.
examples.zh: 檢察官依法向跨國雲端服務供應商核發調閱傳票，強制調取涉案電子郵件的伺服器紀錄。

examples.en: The bank compliance officer testified under judicial subpoena regarding suspicious wire transfers.
examples.zh: 銀行法遵主管在接獲法院正式傳票後出庭作證，就帳戶內涉及的數億可疑跨國洗錢電匯進行說明。

examples.en: Failing to comply with a federal grand jury subpoena leads to immediate contempt of court charges.
examples.zh: 收到大陪審團法定傳票卻無故拒絕提供涉案帳冊資料，將立即面臨嚴重的藐視法庭刑事罪名起訴。

entries.definition: 依法傳票傳喚調閱雲端伺服器紀錄；傳票

explains.en: A legal order may require someone to appear in court or provide records. Ignoring it can have consequences. A lawyer can explain what to do.
A witness received an official paper asking them to attend a hearing. They spoke with a lawyer about the date. The court expected a reply.
This order may ask for documents as well as a person’s presence. It comes from a legal authority. The exact rules depend on the place.

examples.en: The judge ruled that the digital evidence gathered without a warrant was legally inadmissible in court.
examples.zh: 法官依法嚴正裁定，未經合法令狀違法取得的通訊監聽錄音，在法庭上完全不具證據能力。

examples.en: Following strict forensic standards ensures collected biological specimens remain fully admissible before the bench.
examples.zh: 嚴格遵循標準鑑識規範提取與封存，能確保現場採集的生物檢體在法官面前具備完備的證據能力。

examples.en: Hearsay statements are generally inadmissible in criminal trials unless they meet narrow statutory exceptions.
examples.zh: 傳聞證據在刑事審判中原則上完全不具證據能力，除非符合法律所明文列舉的極少數例外要件。

entries.definition: 具備法庭訴訟證據能力與證明力的

explains.en: A judge allows certain evidence to be considered during a trial. It must follow legal rules and be relevant. This adjective means permitted in court.
A recording can be used in court only if it meets rules for proof. The judge decides whether it may be presented. This describes evidence that is acceptable under law.
A witness’s statement is checked before the jury hears it. If it follows the rules, the court can consider it. This word means legally allowed as evidence.

examples.en: After twenty-five years of wrongful imprisonment, post-conviction DNA testing brought complete legal exoneration.
examples.zh: 歷經長達二十五年的冤獄煎熬，最新次世代 DNA 重驗鑑定終於為無辜受冤者洗刷罪名、平反昭雪。

examples.en: The Innocence Project works tirelessly to achieve legal exoneration for innocent individuals convicted of crimes.
examples.zh: 冤獄平反組織長年不懈奔走，致力於藉由最新科學鑑識重驗，為遭受誤判冤獄的無辜人民爭取昭雪獲釋。

examples.en: Tears flowed freely across the courtroom as the judge announced the long-delayed official exoneration.
examples.zh: 當法官當庭莊嚴宣讀延遲數十載的官方平反無罪判決時，法庭旁聽席上所有人激動得熱淚盈眶。

entries.definition: 新 DNA 鑑定洗刷冤屈平反昭雪無罪獲釋

explains.en: A new test shows that a convicted person did not commit the crime. The court clears the person’s name.
A review finds that an employee followed the rules after being blamed. The decision removes the accusation.
This is the act of officially clearing someone from blame. New evidence may lead to it.

examples.en: Maintaining digital vigilance protects our personal privacy and financial assets from modern cyber threats.
examples.zh: 保持高度的資安警覺性，能保護個人隱私與數位金融資產免受新型網路詐騙侵害。

examples.en: Constant vigilance by border customs officials stopped thousands of counterfeit items from entering.
examples.zh: 海關查緝關員日夜不懈的高度警覺與機警查驗，成功將數以萬計的走私違禁品攔截於國門之外。

examples.en: Security teams urge vigilance regarding suspicious text links asking for credit card verification codes.
examples.zh: 警政署反詐騙諮詢專線一再呼籲全體國民提高警覺，切莫輕信要求提供信用卡 OTP 驗證碼的可疑釣魚簡訊。

entries.definition: 打擊新型科技犯罪之高度警覺與防範

explains.en: A crossing guard watches traffic carefully while children cross the street. They stay alert for cars turning nearby. Attention helps prevent accidents.
A nurse checks a patient for new signs of illness. Regular observation can catch a problem early. The care team responds if anything changes.
A person guards a campsite and listens for danger through the night. They remain watchful even when things seem quiet. This steady attention is important.

examples.en: Giant STS gantry cranes line the concrete deepwater quay ready to unload arriving mega-vessels.
examples.zh: 巍峨的超大型岸邊橋式起重機在深水碼頭岸壁上整齊排列，準備為抵港巨輪卸載貨櫃。

examples.en: Forklifts and yard trucks moved rhythmically along the bustling commercial wharf quay.
examples.zh: 堆高機與港區牽引車在繁忙喧囂的碼頭岸壁作業區上，宛如精密發條般規律流暢穿梭穿梭。

examples.en: Reinforcing the reinforced concrete quay allows it to bear the extreme weight of modern shore cranes.
examples.zh: 全面加固鋼筋混凝土深水碼頭岸壁基樁，能使其穩穩承受現代巨型岸邊橋吊的極限垂直重壓。

entries.definition: 水深十八米深水重載碼頭岸壁；碼頭

explains.en: A strong platform beside water lets ships load and unload cargo. Cranes may stand along it. Workers move goods between land and vessel.
The cargo ship tied up beside the concrete edge. Workers moved boxes onto trucks. The harbor was busy.
The word is pronounced like “key.” It refers to a built landing place along a harbor or river. Ships stop there to transfer people or goods.

examples.en: Automated stacking systems pack containers six tiers high to maximize limited waterfront real estate.
examples.zh: 全自動高密度堆疊系統，將貨櫃整齊向上堆疊至六層樓高，極致利用寸土寸金的港區土地。

examples.en: Wind warning sensors limit high-tier empty container stacking during coastal typhoon alerts.
examples.zh: 陣風預警超音波風速計在颱風警報發布時，會強制啟動安全防風協議，限制空櫃堆疊高度。

examples.en: Sophisticated stacking logic ensures that containers leaving first are always placed on top.
examples.zh: 精密的堆垛邏輯演算法能確保預定最先裝船出港的貨櫃永遠碼放在最上層，免除繁瑣翻櫃。

entries.definition: 六層高密度自動化精準貨櫃堆疊

explains.en: A port crane places freight boxes one above another to save space. Workers arrange them carefully so the pile stays stable. This process organizes cargo vertically.
An automated yard stores containers in several levels. Machines put each box in a planned position. This method uses space efficiently.
A machine lifts heavy shipping boxes and sets them into rows. They are arranged in layers at a terminal. This is the action of piling them safely.

examples.en: Upgrading terminal automation boosted annual container throughput by twenty-five percent.
examples.zh: 引進先進全自動化裝卸設備後，該國際樞紐港的全年貨櫃吞吐量大幅躍升兩成五。

examples.en: The bustling Asian port achieved a historic record throughput of twenty million shipping containers.
examples.zh: 這座繁忙的亞洲指標性港口創下歷史新高，全年貨櫃總吞吐量強勢衝破兩千萬個標準貨櫃大關。

examples.en: Enhancing customs clearance software increased truck gate throughput to six hundred vehicles per hour.
examples.zh: 升級智慧海關自動放行軟體，使卡車檢查哨出入閘口的車流通行吞吐量達到每小時六百輛次。

entries.definition: 全年數千萬 TEU 貨櫃吞吐量；產出量

explains.en: A factory makes more items each hour after a faster machine is installed. The total output has increased.
A port measures how many containers pass through in a year. This helps compare capacity.
This is the amount of work or material handled in a given time. It can describe networks, factories, or transport.

examples.en: Intermodal freight networks transfer shipping containers directly from cargo ships onto freight trains.
examples.zh: 多式聯運網絡，能將進口海運貨櫃無縫直接吊裝上火車貨運列車奔馳內陸。

examples.en: Using standardized intermodal containers eliminates the need to unpack goods when switching vehicles.
examples.zh: 採用標準規格的海陸空多式聯運貨櫃，在輪船、火車與卡車轉換交接時完全無需開箱重裝。

examples.en: The inland intermodal rail terminal handles hundreds of imported shipping containers every evening.
examples.zh: 這座內陸海鐵聯運鐵路貨運轉運站，每天傍晚高效處理從沿海港口鐵路專線抵達的數百只海運貨櫃。

entries.definition: 海陸空海鐵海空多式聯運無縫轉運的

explains.en: A delivery may travel by truck, train, and ship while staying in the same container. Workers move the container between vehicles. This saves time in transport.
A shipment moves from rail to a truck at a terminal. The goods stay packed inside one large box. Different travel methods work together.
A city trip uses a bus and then a train. Riders transfer between forms of transport. Planning makes the journey smoother.

examples.en: The original ocean bill of lading serves as a definitive title document proving cargo ownership.
examples.zh: 正本海運提單，是國際貿易中代表貨物物權、不可或缺的法定所有權憑證。

examples.en: Banks release letter of credit financing only after inspecting an unendorsed clean bill of lading.
examples.zh: 押匯銀行唯有在嚴格審核無瑕疵的清潔海運提單正本後，方始依約撥付信用狀款項。

examples.en: Modern digital bills of lading use cryptographic tokens to replace vulnerable paper documents.
examples.zh: 現代區塊鏈數位電子提單採用高強度加密憑證技術，全面取代易遭仿冒與遺失的傳統紙本單據。

entries.definition: 國際海運提單物權所有權憑證 (B/L)

explains.en: A shipping document lists goods carried on a vessel and the terms for their transport. It can serve as proof of receipt. Businesses use it when moving cargo.
A freight document lists what is being carried and where it should go. It helps track ownership and delivery. Keep it with other trade papers.
A shipping record helps track cargo ownership and delivery. It lists goods and their destination. Keep it with other trade papers.

examples.en: Importers incur heavy demurrage penalties if containers sit in the port terminal past the free-time window.
examples.zh: 若進口商在免費提領期限過後仍未將貨櫃提走，將被港務當局課徵高昂的逾期滯留費。

examples.en: Port congestion during the holiday rush caused skyrocketing demurrage costs for retail importers.
examples.zh: 歐美年底購物旺季期間碼頭塞港癱瘓，導致大型零售進口商背負飆升上億的貨櫃超期滯留罰金。

examples.en: To avoid mounting demurrage fees, the distributor hired extra third-party truckers to evacuate boxes.
examples.zh: 為了徹底止血不斷累積的巨額延滯費用，經銷商緊急加價僱用外部第三方卡車車隊漏夜提領疏運。

entries.definition: 貨櫃逾期未提之碼頭滯留費與延滯費

explains.en: A shipping company charges money when a container stays at a port longer than the free time allowed. Importers try to collect goods promptly. This fee covers a delay.
A business leaves a cargo box at a terminal past the agreed deadline. The port charges for the extra days. This is a late-use fee in shipping.
A shipper must pay when goods remain in a port or container yard too long. The charge encourages quick pickup. It is a delay cost for cargo handling.

examples.en: Freight forwarders negotiate shipping space, arrange insurance, and handle overseas trucking logistics.
examples.zh: 專業國際貨運承攬業者，為進出口廠商代訂海空運艙位並安排跨境卡車報關。

examples.en: An experienced freight forwarder can find alternate air routes when sea ports are strike-bound.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的貨代攬貨業者在海運港口遭遇罷工癱瘓時，能以最快速度規劃出替代航空應急專案。

examples.en: Selecting a forwarder with established customs networks speeds up border clearance for exporters.
examples.zh: 挑選在目的港擁有成熟深厚海關人脈網絡的頂級承攬商，能為出口商大幅加速跨國邊境通關放行。

entries.definition: 國際海空運貨運承攬業者 (攬貨商)

explains.en: A business arranges shipping, storage, and paperwork for goods moving between countries. It coordinates several carriers.
A small maker asks a logistics company to plan the journey of a large order. The company handles transport details.
This agent organizes the movement of cargo from one place to another. It may arrange shipping and customs paperwork.

examples.en: Plugging high-tech reefer containers into terminal power outlets keeps premium beef frozen at minus twenty.
examples.zh: 將高科技冷凍冷藏貨櫃插上碼頭專用受電插座，能讓頂級冷鮮牛肉在零下二十度維持冰封。

examples.en: Reefer vessels are fitted with dedicated backup generators to power thousands of refrigerated units.
examples.zh: 現代全冷凍冷藏貨櫃輪搭載專用的大功率備用柴油發電機組，為航行中的數千只冷凍箱全天候供電。

examples.en: Technicians inspect the cooling compressor of each reefer before loading sensitive produce.
examples.zh: 專業冷凍電機技師在裝載嬌嫩鮮果之前，會逐一檢測每只冷凍貨櫃的壓縮機運轉效能與風道循環。

entries.definition: 恆溫插電冷凍冷藏貨櫃 (溫控箱)

explains.en: A truck or shipping container with cooling equipment carries food that must stay cold. The temperature is checked during the trip. This protects fresh goods.
A driver loads chilled vegetables into a temperature-controlled trailer. A monitor records the cold air. The goods can travel a long distance.
In informal speech, this word can refer to a marijuana cigarette. The meaning depends on the conversation. Laws about the drug vary by place.

examples.en: Exporting delicate perishable tropical fruits requires rapid customs clearance and cold warehousing.
examples.zh: 外銷台灣頂級易腐生鮮蔬果，仰賴綠色通道快速報關與低溫保鮮冷鏈倉儲。

examples.en: Highly perishable seafood shipments are prioritized for early discharge upon docking.
examples.zh: 具備高時效性與易腐特性的高價遠洋黑鮪魚海鮮漁獲，在貨輪靠泊時享有優先進港卸貨的綠色特權。

examples.en: Dedicated express cargo flights transport sensitive perishables directly to premium Asian grocery markets.
examples.zh: 專線直飛的全貨運包機將這批極易變質的珍稀生鮮農特產，直送東京與首爾頂級精品超市搶鮮上架。

entries.definition: 台灣金鑽鳳梨與愛文芒果等生鮮易腐的

explains.en: Food that spoils quickly unless kept cool or used soon has this quality. Fresh fish and milk are examples. Refrigeration can slow spoilage.
The grocer placed fresh berries in a cooler. Customers bought them quickly. The shop checked their condition each day.
Medicine and flowers may also need special storage. Labels show how to keep them safe. Do not use food that smells or looks spoiled.

examples.en: Heavy-duty steel racking reaches the warehouse ceiling, quadrupling pallet storage density per square meter.
examples.zh: 拔地而起高達二十五公尺的重型鋼製立體貨架，將每平方公尺的棧板倉儲容積放大四倍。

examples.en: Seismic safety inspections check whether tall storage racking can withstand sudden earthquake shaking.
examples.zh: 港區結構技師定期進行嚴苛的抗震安全檢測，確保超高立體倉儲貨架能抵禦強烈地震劇烈搖晃。

examples.en: Drive-in pallet racking systems maximize floor area by eliminating empty access aisles between lanes.
examples.zh: 貫通式車入棧板重型貨架系統徹底消除了貨架間多餘的通道，將倉儲空間利用率推升至極限境界。

entries.definition: 二十五米高架立體自動化倉儲重型貨架

explains.en: A warehouse uses tall steel shelves to store heavy goods in many levels. Machines move items up and down the aisles. This system saves floor space.
Boxes are placed on high shelves in an automated storage building. A lift retrieves them when needed. The shelving structure is called this.
A distribution center has strong frames that hold pallets above the floor. Workers can store goods vertically. This equipment forms a warehouse storage system.

examples.en: Plugging berthed ships into high-voltage shore-power allows onboard diesel engines to shut down completely.
examples.zh: 靠泊貨輪插上碼頭高壓岸電系統，能讓船上柴油副發電機完全熄火，杜絕港區空污。

examples.en: Port authorities invest in heavy electrical substations to deliver megawatt shore-power to cruise ships.
examples.zh: 國際港務當局斥資興建大型高壓變電所，為靠港的巨型萬人郵輪提供數兆瓦的高壓岸電直供。
