A child receives praise for putting away toys and begins doing it more often. The reward shapes the behavior. This learning method uses consequences to influence actions.
A veterinary team gives an animal a small treat after it calmly accepts an examination. Repeating this builds a helpful habit. This is a training process based on rewards.

examples.en: Specialized veterinary teams perform regular underwater ultrasounds to monitor pregnant sea turtles.
examples.zh: 專業「水族獸醫團隊」（Veterinary Team），定期攜帶防水水下超音波為即將臨盆的綠蠵龜進行產檢。

examples.en: She enrolled in veterinary medicine to fulfill her childhood ambition of caring for injured wildlife.
examples.zh: 她毅然報考獸醫學系，只為實踐從小立志拯救並悉心醫治受傷流浪動物與野生生靈的童年夢想。

examples.en: The mobile veterinary clinic provides free vaccinations and health checks to pets in remote rural villages.
examples.zh: 巡迴流動獸醫診療車每週開進偏遠偏鄉部落，為山區弱勢家庭的貓狗寵物提供免費狂犬病疫苗注射與健檢。

entries.definition: 專業大型海洋與水族動物臨床獸醫醫療的

explains.en: A doctor examines a sick dog and explains its treatment to the family. This kind of care is for animals.
A clinic gives vaccines to cats and checks their health. The staff are trained to care for animals.
This adjective describes medicine and services for animals. A professional in this field treats pets and other creatures.

examples.en: Delicate moon jellyfish drift like floating ghosts under rotating multicolor LED lights in the dark gallery.
examples.zh: 嬌柔透明的海月「水母」（Jellyfish），在幽暗展廳繽紛變幻的 LED 燈光下如夢似幻地悠游漂浮。

examples.en: Bathers along the coast were warned to avoid swimming near swarms of stinging box jellyfish.
examples.zh: 海灘救生員透過廣播鄭重提醒在海邊戲水的泳客，切勿靠近可能出沒著劇毒箱形水母的淺水礁石區。

examples.en: Despite having no brain or heart, jellyfish have thrived successfully across world oceans for millions of years.
examples.zh: 儘管身體內部完全沒有大腦、心臟與骨骼構造，水母卻已在浩瀚各大洋中繁衍生息了數億年之久。

entries.definition: 圓形環流水母缸中優雅漂浮之海月水母；水母

explains.en: A soft sea animal has a bell-shaped body and long tentacles. Some can sting, so swimmers should keep away. It drifts with the water.
A clear animal floats near the ocean surface and catches tiny food with its arms. It has no bones. Many kinds glow in the dark sea.
A beach lifeguard warns swimmers after seeing one near shore. People move to a safer area. Some kinds cause painful stings.

examples.en: Guests watch the mesmerizing, pulsating motions of translucent medusa bells expanding and contracting peacefully.
examples.zh: 觀眾屏息凝視著透明水母傘狀體如催眠般「規律收縮跳動」（Pulsating），心靈瞬間獲得極致平靜。

examples.en: The city center was electrified by pulsating bass rhythms booming from the open-air techno concert.
examples.zh: 露天電子音樂祭現場舞台巨型音響重低音節奏狂暴震撼脈動，讓整個市中心廣場瞬間沸騰瘋狂。

examples.en: The emergency beacon flashed a pulsating amber strobe to warn motorists of the road hazard ahead.
examples.zh: 國道工務巡邏車在故障拋錨車輛後方開啟規律閃爍跳動的琥珀色警示燈，提醒後方駕駛人及早變換車道。

entries.definition: 如催眠般規律收縮跳動之透明傘狀體的

explains.en: A steady movement that expands and contracts again and again can be described this way. A jellyfish moves gently in the water. A drum beat may have a similar rhythm.
The clear sea animal opened and closed its soft bell as it swam. Its repeated motion carried it forward. The diver watched quietly.
A light or sound may also rise and fall in a regular pattern. The changing beat filled the hall. It felt energetic.

examples.en: Golden sunlight filters through towering giant kelp stalks reaching three stories high in the cold-water tank.
examples.zh: 金色陽光穿透高達三層樓的「加州巨藻林水槽」（Giant Kelp Forest），在冷水波光間搖曳生姿。

examples.en: Coastal kelp forests provide critical nursery habitats and protection for juvenile sea otters and rockfish.
examples.zh: 沿岸海域茂密的天然海藻森林，為初生的野生小海獺與各種岩礁幼魚提供了遮蔽庇護與安全育苗溫床。

examples.en: Japanese culinary broths utilize sun-dried kombu kelp to extract deep, naturally savory umami notes.
examples.zh: 日式精緻高湯料理精選天然日曬的厚實昆布海帶（Kelp），慢火細熬萃取出甘醇濃郁的極致鮮味精華。

entries.definition: 陽光穿透三層樓高之巨型加州巨藻林展示槽

explains.en: A giant brown sea plant grows in cool coastal water and can form an underwater forest. Fish and sea otters find food and shelter among its long blades. This plant is harvested for food too.
A public aquarium may display tall marine algae reaching toward the surface. Sunlight passes through its leaves. Many ocean animals live in this habitat.
This large seaweed grows quickly in shallow, sunny water. It can reach several meters tall and provide shelter for wildlife. People also use it in food products.

examples.en: Master lutherie bridges the boundary between acoustic physics and fine woodworking artistry.
examples.zh: 「手工弦樂器製琴工藝學」（Lutherie），完美架起了聲學物理與精緻木工藝術的橋樑。

examples.en: Aspiring artisans travel to Cremona to study the centuries-old secrets of traditional Italian lutherie.
examples.zh: 懷抱夢想的木工學徒遠赴義大利克雷莫納，潛心研習傳承數百年的古典製琴工藝精髓。

examples.en: Innovations in carbon fiber have introduced intriguing experimental methods into contemporary lutherie.
examples.zh: 碳纖維等複合新材料的問世，為現代前衛製琴工藝領域引進了引人注目的實驗性工法。

entries.definition: 提琴與吉他手工製琴弦樂器工藝學

explains.en: A craftsperson shapes wood and fits strings to make a violin. The work requires careful listening and skill.
A maker repairs a guitar’s body and adjusts its neck. This craft combines woodworking and music.
This is the craft of making and repairing stringed instruments such as violins and guitars. It combines woodworking with knowledge of sound.

examples.en: The dedicated luthier taps each carved wedge of spruce to listen for its natural resonant pitch.
examples.zh: 追求極致的「手工製琴大師」（Luthier），輕敲每塊刨削好的雲杉木以聆聽其天然共振基頻。

examples.en: A skilled luthier adjusted the bridge height to eliminate fret buzzing on the vintage Spanish guitar.
examples.zh: 技藝精湛的製琴名師細心微調琴橋高度，完美消除了老西班牙吉他在高把位的打品雜音。

examples.en: Visitors to the quiet studio watched the master luthier meticulously apply oil varnish with a brush.
examples.zh: 踏入靜謐工坊的訪客，屏息注視著製琴大師手持天然鬃毛刷，聚精會神地為琴身刷上油性琴漆。

entries.definition: 頂級手工古典吉他與小提琴製琴大師

explains.en: A craftsperson builds and repairs instruments such as violins and guitars. They shape wood and adjust strings. Small changes affect the sound.
A musician brings a worn violin to a skilled maker for repair. The worker checks its body, bridge, and strings. The instrument can then be played again.
A person who makes stringed instruments chooses suitable wood and carves it carefully. They test the sound as they work. Their craft combines music and woodworking.

examples.en: Seasoned tonewood stored in climate-controlled attics vibrates with exceptional acoustic richness.
examples.zh: 在溫濕度受控環境下自然風乾數十年的「高等級共鳴木」（Tonewood），展現出絕佳的聲學共振。

examples.en: European violin makers prize high-altitude tonewood harvested during freezing winter months.
examples.zh: 歐洲傳奇提琴大師極其珍視在寒冬休眠期砍伐的高山共鳴木，因其木質纖維最為緊密均勻。

examples.en: Sustainable forestry certifications ensure that rare tropical tonewood is harvested responsibly without depleting rainforests.
examples.zh: 國際永續林業認證嚴格把關珍稀熱帶共鳴木的永續採伐，杜絕非法濫伐破壞原始雨林生態。

entries.definition: 自然風乾數十年之阿爾卑斯山高等級共鳴木

explains.en: Wood chosen for the sound it makes in a musical instrument has this name. Makers select it carefully. It can affect the instrument’s tone.
The violin maker tapped two boards and listened to their sounds. She chose one for the instrument. The wood had been dried for years.
Different trees have different patterns and qualities. A light, strong piece may suit a guitar or violin. The maker shapes it by hand.

examples.en: Brazilian rosewood delivers unmatched bass projection, crystal trebles, and a sweet floral aroma.
examples.zh: 國寶級「巴西玫瑰木」（Rosewood），賦予古典吉他無可比擬的深沉低音、晶瑩高音與芬芳香氣。

examples.en: International CITES treaties strictly regulate commercial cross-border shipments of endangered rosewood furniture.
examples.zh: 華盛頓瀕危野生動植物國際貿易公約（CITES），嚴格管制瀕危玫瑰木原木與家具的跨境商業貿易。

examples.en: The master woodcarver sculpted an intricate chess set from alternating pieces of ivory and dark rosewood.
examples.zh: 雕刻大師利用溫潤的白象牙與深色玫瑰木交相輝映，雕刻出一套工藝繁複精美的大師級西洋棋。

entries.definition: 珍稀巴西黑黃檀玫瑰木 (吉他側背板之王)

explains.en: A dark, richly colored tropical hardwood is used for fine furniture and musical instruments. Its grain can be beautiful. Some kinds are protected because they are rare.
A guitar maker chooses a dense wood for the back and sides of an instrument. It can add warmth to the sound and has a dark appearance. The timber comes from tropical trees.
An expensive reddish-brown wood is prized for its color and durability. Craftspeople use it for furniture and instrument parts. Trade in some species is restricted.

examples.en: Classical fan bracing supports string tension while allowing the lower bout to pump air freely.
examples.zh: 經典托雷斯「扇形音梁結構」（Bracing），在承受琴弦數十公斤拉力的同時，讓下半部面板自由泵動發聲。

examples.en: Steel cross-bracing reinforces the bridge structure against powerful hurricane-force crosswinds.
examples.zh: 跨海大橋鋼結構採用高強度交叉支撐斜撐加固，以有效抵禦強烈颱風橫向側風的劇烈搖晃。

examples.en: The dental surgeon fitted orthodontic bracing to gently align the teenager's crowded front teeth.
examples.zh: 齒顎矯正專科醫師為牙齒排列擁擠的青少年安裝客製化金屬牙套牙齒矯正器，溫和調整齒列。

entries.definition: 托雷斯傳統扇形音梁與碳纖維網狀音梁結構

explains.en: A frame inside a guitar supports the wood against the pull of the strings. It also affects the sound.
Workers add diagonal supports to keep a wall from bending. The extra pieces strengthen the structure.
This support helps a structure resist force. In a guitar, internal wooden pieces support the soundboard.

examples.en: Carving individual spruce struts tunes the soundboard's flexibility for sweet, balanced frequency response.
examples.zh: 細心雕刻修削每一根雲杉「音梁支柱」（Struts），能精準調整面板軟硬度以營造甜美平衡的音頻響應。

examples.en: Steel struts supporting the temporary scaffolding were bolted securely into the masonry facade.
examples.zh: 支撐外牆臨時施工鷹架的高強度鋼製支柱構件，被以重型膨脹螺栓牢牢鎖入石造建築立面結構。

examples.en: The proud peacock spread its dazzling tail feathers and began to strut across the garden lawn.
examples.zh: 驕傲美麗的雄孔雀在如茵的草坪上完全展開璀璨奪目的翠綠屏羽，邁著昂首闊步的自信步伐。

entries.definition: 精密手工雕刻削薄之雲杉木音梁支柱骨架

explains.en: A bird walks with its chest pushed forward and head held high. Its steps look proud. People may imitate this way of walking.
A metal support holds a roof or frame in place. Builders bolt it firmly so the structure stays steady. The piece carries weight.
A dancer moves proudly across a room with long, confident steps. On a machine, a strong brace can also hold two parts apart. The word has both uses.

examples.en: Thousands of miniature colored wood tiles form the intricate mosaic rosette decorating the soundhole.
examples.zh: 由數千片微小彩色木條拼接而成的精美「拼木幾何鑲花」（Rosette），環繞點綴在圓形音孔周遭。

examples.en: The prize-winning stallion wore a blue rosette ribbon pinned to its bridle after the equestrian show.
examples.zh: 榮獲馬術障礙超越賽冠軍的純種駿馬，其馬籠頭上驕傲別著一枚象徵最高榮譽的藍色緞帶圓花飾。

examples.en: Succulent rosette plants store rainwater inside fleshy leaves to survive prolonged desert droughts.
examples.zh: 外型如蓮座般層疊開展的多肉植物，利用肥厚多汁的葉片儲存珍貴雨水，以熬過乾旱沙漠酷暑。

entries.definition: 吉他音孔周圍精美手工拼木同心圓鑲花

explains.en: A small round decoration made of petals or a ribbon is this. It may be pinned to clothing after a contest. It can also decorate a musical instrument around its sound opening.
The winner wore a blue ribbon decoration on her jacket. It showed that she had earned a prize. Her family took a photo.
Some guitars have a circular pattern around the hole in the body. It may be made from small pieces of wood. Makers choose colors and shapes.

examples.en: The circular soundhole projects Helmholtz air resonance frequencies that provide deep, warm bass notes.
examples.zh: 圓形「音孔」（Soundhole）將琴體內部的赫姆霍茲空氣共振頻率向外投射，釋放出深沉溫暖的低音。

examples.en: Traditional jazz archtop guitars feature dual f-shaped soundholes rather than a single center hole.
examples.zh: 經典爵士空心電吉他通常在琴身兩側雕琢雙 f 型音孔，而非採用傳統民謠吉他的單一中央圓孔。

examples.en: A luthier inspects the soundboard interior by inserting a mirror and flashlight through the soundhole.
examples.zh: 製琴師將小巧的牙醫檢查鏡與細長手電筒伸入音孔內部，仔細檢視琴身腔體內部的音梁結構膠合。

entries.definition: 吉他圓形音孔空氣共鳴腔投射窗口

explains.en: A round opening in the top of an acoustic guitar lets the body’s air vibrate. The sound comes out more clearly through this hole. It sits beneath the strings.
A musician looks at the circular opening under the strings before tuning a guitar. It helps the hollow body produce sound. The instrument’s resonance can be heard there.
A hollow string instrument needs an opening in its wooden top. The air inside moves as the strings vibrate. This round window helps project the sound.

examples.en: Flexible three-ply maple and ebony purfling inlaid along violin edges prevents side-impact cracks.
examples.zh: 沿著小提琴邊緣開槽手工鑲入的三層黑白「防裂飾線」（Purfling），能有效防止琴身撞擊開裂。

examples.en: Cutting a razor-sharp purfling groove by hand requires a steady double-bladed purfling cutter.
examples.zh: 手工開鑿深度均勻且邊緣俐落的飾線嵌槽，高度仰賴雙刃劃線刀與製琴大師極其穩健的刀工。

examples.en: The delicate contrast of black and white purfling accentuates the violin's graceful body outline.
examples.zh: 黑白相間的纖細木質飾線在琴身邊緣形成鮮明對比，將小提琴優雅曼妙的曲線輪廓勾勒得淋漓盡致。

entries.definition: 提琴與吉他邊緣防撞防裂三層黑白實木鑲邊

explains.en: A violin has thin decorative lines set into the wood near its edge. They can also help prevent cracks from spreading.
A craftsperson fits narrow strips around the edge of an instrument’s top. The border creates a neat finish.
These thin inlaid strips decorate and protect the edges of a string instrument. They can help stop small cracks from spreading.

examples.en: Flamed koa wood binding seals end-grain pores while highlighting the elegant curves of the guitar body.
examples.zh: 採用夏威夷相思木進行的「實木包邊飾條」（Binding），封閉木材毛孔並勾勒出琴身優雅的腰身線條。

examples.en: The antique book was bound in goatskin leather with gold-leaf binding along the spine.
examples.zh: 這本保存完好的羊皮紙珍本古籍採用柔軟的山羊皮裝訂成冊，書脊處燙印著華麗典雅的純金金箔飾邊。

examples.en: Both parties signed the legally binding contract in the presence of authorized notaries.
examples.zh: 買賣雙方在法院公證人嚴肅見證下，親筆簽署了具有完全民法法律約束力的正式股權轉讓契約。

entries.definition: 琴身外緣保護性實木包邊飾條；裝訂

explains.en: A strip of material covers the edge of a book or blanket. It holds loose layers together. A strong seam helps it last.
A legal promise or agreement must be followed by the people who made it. They accepted the terms. The agreement has force.
A book’s cover joins its pages along one side. A person can choose cloth, leather, or paper for it. The word describes the part that holds the pages.

examples.en: Flexible notched kerfing lining the internal rims expands the gluing surface between sides and top.
examples.zh: 沿著琴身內部側壁黏合的「三角鋸齒襯條」（Kerfing），大幅增加了側板與面板之間的膠合接觸面積。

examples.en: Basswood kerfing bends smoothly along guitar waist contours without snapping delicate wood fibers.
examples.zh: 質地輕柔的椴木鋸齒內襯條能順應吉他腰身的急劇弧度服貼彎折，絕不致折斷細微木材纖維。

examples.en: The carpenter cleaned excess dried hide glue from the kerfing before clamping the backplate.
examples.zh: 製琴師在合攏背板並鎖緊木工夾具之前，細心用溫水小刮刀清除了襯條縫隙溢出的乾涸皮膠。

entries.definition: 連接側板與面板之三角形鋸齒實木襯條

explains.en: Small notched strips of wood are fixed inside a guitar body to join its sides to the top or back. The cuts help the strip bend. Glue holds it in place.
The maker bent a flexible strip around the curved inside edge of the instrument. It fit without breaking. He attached the top panel.
A row of small cuts lets the wood curve smoothly. The hidden support makes the instrument stronger. It is part of careful handcraft.

examples.en: Skillful side bending requires moistening the wood evenly before shaping it over the hot iron.
examples.zh: 純熟的「手工側板熱彎工藝」（Bending），需在熱鐵管前均勻濕潤木材，憑手感感知纖維軟化彎曲。

examples.en: The gymnast demonstrated incredible spinal flexibility by bending backward into a bridge stance.
examples.zh: 體操選手展現出令人驚嘆的脊椎柔韌度與核心力量，在平衡木上輕鬆做出後屈下腰大下橋動作。

examples.en: Avoid bending metal tubing too rapidly to prevent kinks from obstructing fluid flow.
examples.zh: 在彎折金屬空調銅管時切忌動作過於急躁劇烈，以防止管壁產生死折癟痕而阻礙冷媒流動。

entries.definition: 銅管高溫手工燙彎側板優雅弧度工藝；彎曲

explains.en: A craftsperson heats a thin strip of wood and slowly curves it around a form. The piece must not crack. This technique shapes a guitar’s side.
Warmth and moisture can make a board easier to curve. The worker presses it against a mold and lets it cool. This process creates a smooth arc.
A copper tube is gently curved without breaking its walls. In a workshop, heat and careful pressure help shape the metal. This word names the act of making something curve.

examples.en: Modern acoustic guitars conceal an internal steel truss rod that fine-tunes neck relief with an Allen wrench.
examples.zh: 現代吉他內部隱藏著一根雙向可調鋼製「琴頸力矩桿」（Truss Rod），可用六角板手微調琴頸彎曲度。

examples.en: The roof framework was constructed from triangular timber trusses engineered to carry heavy winter snowfall.
examples.zh: 體育館的挑高屋頂骨架採用三角形工程木桁架結構精準搭建，足以穩穩承受冬季厚重積雪負載。

examples.en: Turning the truss rod clockwise flattens the fretboard to correct unwanted forward neck bowing.
examples.zh: 使用專用內六角扳手順時針旋轉力矩調節螺桿，能調直琴頸弧度並校正琴頸前傾彎曲變形。

entries.definition: 內置於琴頸內部之雙向可調鋼質力矩桿；桁架

explains.en: A bridge uses a frame of connected triangles to carry heavy loads. The shape distributes force.
A wooden roof has a strong framework made from joined beams. It keeps the roof steady.
This is a supporting framework made from connected bars or beams. A guitar may also have an adjustable metal rod inside its neck.

examples.en: Leveling and crowning each nickel-silver fret eliminates fret buzz across the entire fretboard spectrum.
examples.zh: 細心整平並重新倒圓每一根「白銅音階品絲」（Frets），能徹底消除全把位任何微小打品雜音。

examples.en: Concerned parents often fret needlessly about minor childhood milestones instead of enjoying everyday growth.
examples.zh: 焦慮的家長往往會為孩子成長過程中的些許小事過度操心煩躁，反而忽略了陪伴孩子成長的快樂。

examples.en: The guitar technician polished the fret crowns with jeweler's rouge until they gleamed like chrome.
examples.zh: 專業吉他技師使用拋光膏將每根品絲頂部細心研磨拋光，直到金屬品絲如嶄新鍍鉻般璀璨耀眼。

entries.definition: 手工整平倒角拋光之白銅合金琴桁音階品絲；煩躁

explains.en: A musician presses strings against the raised metal bars on a guitar’s neck to change the notes. Each position makes a different pitch. Beginners practice moving their fingers.
A worried person thinks repeatedly about a problem. Talking with someone may help. Rest can make the worry easier to handle.
A worker cuts a thin piece of material into a detailed shape with a small saw. The tool follows a narrow line. This craft use is less common.

examples.en: The luthier radiused the dark ebony fretboard to sixteen inches for effortless bar chord fingering.
examples.zh: 製琴師將烏木「音階指板」（Fretboard）手工研磨出十六吋微弧度，讓封閉和弦按壓極致輕鬆流暢。

examples.en: Conditioning dry rosewood fretboards with natural lemon oil prevents wood shrinkage and cracking.
examples.zh: 定期在乾燥的玫瑰木指板上塗抹少量天然檸檬油進行滋潤保養，能有效防止木材乾縮開裂。

examples.en: Mother-of-pearl position markers inlaid into the fretboard guide guitarists during rapid live shifts.
examples.zh: 嵌鑲在指板品位上的天然白蝶貝音位記號標記，能在昏暗的舞台燈光下引導吉他手快速換把位。

entries.definition: 具備舒適演奏弧度之精密烏木音階指板

explains.en: The long, flat part of a guitar neck has metal bars that mark where fingers press the strings. Musicians use it to change notes. It is usually made of hard wood.
The student placed her fingers between the metal bars. The guitar played a higher note. She practiced changing hand positions.
Oils and dirt can collect on this surface. A musician cleans it carefully. The spacing helps players find notes.

examples.en: Polished boxwood tuning pegs fit snugly inside tapered pegbox holes, holding pitch under tension securely.
examples.zh: 拋光的黃楊木「調音弦軸」（Tuning Pegs），緊密嵌合在錐形軸孔內，在巨大張力下穩定維持音準。

examples.en: Campers hammered wooden pegs into the grassy turf to secure tent guy-lines against coastal winds.
examples.zh: 露營愛好者手持膠槌將木質營釘深深釘入綠草如茵的泥土中，拉緊防風繩以抵禦海邊呼嘯的強風。

examples.en: Applying specialized peg drops prevents wooden friction pegs from slipping loose during humid seasons.
examples.zh: 滴上少許專用提琴弦軸膏，能防止純木質摩擦弦軸在潮濕梅雨季節發生打滑跑音或卡死的窘境。

entries.definition: 精緻黃楊木提琴調音旋鈕弦軸；栓

explains.en: A violin player turns a small wooden knob at the top of the instrument to tighten a string. The string’s pitch changes. This part helps tune the instrument.
A craftsperson makes tiny tuning knobs from hard boxwood. Each one holds a string and can be turned. The piece is fitted near the scroll of a violin.
A small pin sticks into a board and holds an item in place. On a violin, a similar part turns to adjust string tension. It is a short rounded fastener.

examples.en: The violin fingerboard is carved with subtle lengthwise scoop so strings clear the board when vibrating.
examples.zh: 小提琴「烏木指板」（Fingerboard）表面雕刻有微小的縱向內凹弧度，確保琴弦震動時不會拍擊指板。

examples.en: Cellists develop strong fingertip calluses from years of pressing thick steel strings against the fingerboard.
examples.zh: 大提琴家歷經漫長歲月的琴房苦練，指尖在堅硬的烏木指板上反覆按壓粗琴弦而磨出厚實的指繭。

examples.en: Regular wiping with a microfiber cloth removes rosin dust from the polished ebony fingerboard.
examples.zh: 每次練完琴後使用超細纖維布輕輕擦拭，能及時清除沉積在光亮烏木指板表面的白色松香粉末。

entries.definition: 具備微小縱向內凹弧度之無品格提琴烏木指板

explains.en: A violin player presses strings against the long board on the neck to change notes. The surface is usually dark wood.
A guitar player places fingers on a flat strip beneath the strings. Each position changes the pitch.
This is the part of a string instrument where the player presses strings to change notes. Each position creates a different pitch.

examples.en: Italian luthiers call the spruce soundpost "anima" or soul because its position dictates the instrument's power.
examples.zh: 義大利製琴師將立於琴內的雲杉「音柱」（Soundpost）稱為靈魂之柱，其微米移動決定了全琴的發聲靈魂。

examples.en: Moving the soundpost a millimeter closer to the bridge brightens the treble response immediately.
examples.zh: 將音柱朝琴橋方向向前挪動僅僅一毫米，就能瞬間讓小提琴高音域的歌唱性與穿透力大幅增強。

examples.en: A luthier uses an S-shaped brass soundpost setter to gently wedge the pine post between top and back.
examples.zh: 製琴師手持 S 型黃銅音柱安裝叉，透過 f 孔將纖細的雲杉音柱巧妙且精準立於面板與背板之間。

entries.definition: 提琴內部直立之音柱 (義大利語稱靈魂之柱)

explains.en: A small wooden stick inside a violin transfers vibrations between its top and back. Its position affects the instrument’s tone. A repairer adjusts it carefully.
A luthier opens an instrument to place a thin support inside the body. It helps the wood vibrate in a balanced way. The part is hidden from view.
A violin makes music when the strings vibrate and the body carries the sound. A small internal post helps connect the two wooden plates. It must fit well.

examples.en: Modern lightweight carbon fiber tailpieces minimize dampening, letting the body ring with maximum sustain.
examples.zh: 現代超輕量碳纖維「提琴拉弦板」（Tailpiece），將聲音阻尼減至最低，使琴體釋放出最大延音長度。

examples.en: Built-in micro-adjuster fine tuners on the tailpiece allow violinists to tune steel E-strings effortlessly.
examples.zh: 整合在拉弦板上的微調器旋鈕，能讓小提琴家在舞台上極其優雅且迅速地微調最纖細的 E 弦音高。

examples.en: The tailpiece is anchored to the lower endpin using a durable nylon or Kevlar tailgut loop.
examples.zh: 拉弦板藉由一條極度堅韌的尼龍或克維拉防彈纖維尾繩套環，牢牢固定在琴身底部的尾柱上。

entries.definition: 懸掛琴弦末端之輕量化烏木小提琴拉弦板

explains.en: A small part at the end of a violin holds the strings in place. Some have tiny adjusters for tuning. It attaches near the bottom of the instrument.
The violinist turned a small screw to make a string sound right. The strings were anchored near the instrument’s base. Her teacher listened.
On other instruments, the part may have a different shape. It helps keep strings secure. A repair expert can replace it.

examples.en: An ergonomically sculpted rosewood chinrest allows the violinist to support the instrument comfortably.
examples.zh: 符合人體工學曲線的玫瑰木「小提琴腮托」（Chinrest），讓小提琴家能長時間舒適夾琴演奏。

examples.en: Selecting the right chinrest height prevents chronic neck stiffness and shoulder strain in musicians.
examples.zh: 挑選高度與下顎曲線完美契合的腮托，能有效預防職業音樂家長年累月排練所引發的頸部肩頸僵硬。

examples.en: Padded cork footings protect delicate varnish from pressure marks where the metal chinrest clamps attach.
examples.zh: 腮托金屬固定腳夾下方貼有柔軟的軟木緩衝墊，以全力保護琴邊嬌貴名貴的琴漆免受金屬夾傷壓痕。

entries.definition: 符合人體工學之防過敏小提琴專用腮托

explains.en: A violin player rests the jaw on a shaped piece attached to the instrument. It helps hold the violin comfortably. The part is often made from wood or plastic.
A musician adjusts a small support beside the strings so the instrument does not press directly on the neck. It can reduce discomfort. This accessory supports the lower face.
A violin has a curved pad where the player’s jaw can rest while performing. It helps keep the instrument steady. The support is fixed to the body.

examples.en: Dissolving blonde shellac flakes in pure alcohol yields an eco-friendly, ultra-resonant classical instrument finish.
examples.zh: 將天然淺金色「蟲膠薄片」（Shellac）溶於純酒精中，能調配出最環保、透光性極高且極致共鳴的琴漆。

examples.en: Confectioners sometimes coat chocolate candies with food-grade shellac to give them a glossy sheen.
examples.zh: 高級手工巧克力烘焙坊有時會採用符合食品安全規範的天然食用蟲膠，為松露巧克力表面增添迷人光彩。

examples.en: Shellac finishes can be touched up seamlessly because new layers chemically fuse with underlying coats.
examples.zh: 天然蟲膠漆面具備無與倫比的局部修復性，因為新塗抹的酒精蟲膠液能與原有漆層完美融為一體。

entries.definition: 溶於純酒精之天然蟲膠薄片 (透光性極高)

explains.en: A craftsperson brushes a natural coating onto a wooden table to give it shine. It dries into a protective layer.
Flakes from an insect-made resin are dissolved in alcohol and used to finish furniture. The coating is thin.
This is a natural resin used as a glossy finish for wood or in some foods and products. It dries into a thin protective layer.

examples.en: Haute horology transforms hundreds of microscopic gears into living mechanical poetry.
examples.zh: 「高級製錶鐘錶學」（Haute Horology），將數百顆微米級金屬齒輪化為在手腕上跳動的機械詩篇。

examples.en: Collecting vintage pocket watches sparked his lifelong passion for the historical science of horology.
examples.zh: 收藏早期古董懷錶的機緣，點燃了他對橫跨數百年鐘錶精密機械科學歷史的無盡熱情。

examples.en: Museums across Switzerland display exquisite historical artifacts that showcase the evolution of modern horology.
examples.zh: 遍布瑞士各地的鐘錶博物館展示著無數珍貴的歷史文物，生動呈現了現代精密鐘錶學的演進歷程。

entries.definition: 頂級高級製錶與精密機械鐘錶學藝術

explains.en: The study and craft of clocks and watches includes how they keep time. Makers learn about gears and springs. Collectors may study old designs.
A technician opens a small watch to inspect its moving parts. Each gear must fit precisely. Careful cleaning helps the timepiece work.
A museum displays clocks from different centuries. Visitors see how people measured hours before modern devices. The field explores timekeeping instruments.

examples.en: The independent master horologist handcrafts every single screw and wheel in his alpine atelier.
examples.zh: 瑞士「獨立製錶大師」（Horologist），在阿爾卑斯山工作室親手手工車削每一顆螺絲與齒輪。

examples.en: A certified horologist carefully dismantled the century-old grandfather clock to oil its worn brass pivots.
examples.zh: 領有認證執照的專業鐘錶技師小心翼翼地拆解這座百年老爺鐘，為其磨損的黃銅軸尖洗油潤滑。

examples.en: Young apprentices trained under the master horologist for seven years before assembling their first tourbillon.
examples.zh: 年輕的製錶學徒在資深製錶大師門下苦學整整七年，方才獲准親手組裝人生第一枚陀飛輪機芯。

entries.definition: 瑞士獨立製錶協會 (AHCI) 頂級製錶大師

explains.en: A person who makes or repairs clocks and watches is this specialist. They work with tiny parts and tools. The job requires patience.
The repairer opened the old clock and cleaned its small gears. She replaced a worn spring. The clock began ticking again.
Some experts study the history of timekeeping devices. Others build new ones by hand. Their work can take many hours.

examples.en: Invented by Breguet, the spinning tourbillon cage rotates constantly to neutralize gravitational rate errors.
examples.zh: 由寶璣大師發明的「陀飛輪旋轉框架」（Tourbillon），持續自轉以抵消地心引力對走時精準度的干擾。

examples.en: Collectors appreciate the dynamic aesthetic of a flying tourbillon exposed through an open-worked skeleton dial.
examples.zh: 鐘錶收藏家無比傾心於透過鏤空面盤展露無遺、優雅旋轉起舞的飛行陀飛輪那極具動態的美感。

examples.en: Regulating a multi-axis tourbillon requires dozens of hours of delicate manual adjustments under microscopes.
examples.zh: 在高倍顯微鏡下精確微調多軸立體球體陀飛輪，需要製錶大師數十個小時屏息專注的手工調校。

entries.definition: 飛行陀飛輪 (旋轉框架抵消地心引力誤差)

explains.en: A tiny rotating cage in a mechanical watch carries the balance wheel. Its motion helps reduce timing errors caused by gravity. The part is a sign of fine watchmaking.
A watchmaker places the escapement inside a turning frame. The frame rotates once every minute in some designs. This mechanism aims to improve accuracy.
A small assembly in a luxury timepiece slowly turns as the watch runs. It keeps the balance wheel moving in different positions. This device counters a positional timing effect.

examples.en: The Swiss lever escapement meters out energy impulses from the mainspring to maintain balance vibrations.
examples.zh: 「瑞士槓桿擒縱機構」（Escapement），以微小脈衝精準釋放發條盒能量，維繫擺輪規律擺動。

examples.en: Innovative silicon escapement wheels reduce friction dramatically and operate without liquid oil lubrication.
examples.zh: 革命性的單晶矽擒縱輪大幅降低了零件間的摩擦係數，甚至能實現完全無需任何液體潤滑油的無油運作。

examples.en: The distinctive ticking sound heard from mechanical wristwatches is produced by the rhythmic escapement locking.
examples.zh: 從機械腕錶內部傳出的清脆悅耳滴答聲，正是由擒縱叉瓦與擒縱輪齒規律鎖定釋放所敲擊出的節奏。

entries.definition: 瑞士槓桿式擒縱機構 (擒縱輪與紅寶石叉)

explains.en: A clock uses a small mechanism to release the gear one step at a time. This helps keep steady time.
A watch’s moving parts control how energy from its spring is released. The device makes the hands advance regularly.
This mechanism controls the release of energy in a clock or watch. It helps regulate the movement of the gears.

examples.en: The microscopic silicon hairspring breathes concentrically, unaffected by magnetic fields or temperature shifts.
examples.zh: 纖如髮絲的抗磁「單晶矽游絲」（Hairspring），以同心圓完美呼吸收縮，絲毫不受磁場與溫差干擾。

examples.en: Bending the terminal curve of an overcoil hairspring by hand requires the touch of a seasoned artisan.
examples.zh: 純手工挑彎寶璣雙層末端曲線游絲，高度考驗資深製錶師那宛如神之手般細膩微弱的指尖觸覺感知。

examples.en: A magnetized hairspring causes the watch to run frantically fast, gaining dozens of minutes daily.
examples.zh: 機械腕錶內部的金屬游絲一旦不慎受磁，會導致手錶走時瘋狂變快，每日誤差甚至高達數十分鐘。

entries.definition: 抗磁性單晶矽游絲 (精密呼吸震盪核心)

explains.en: A tiny coiled spring in a mechanical watch helps its balance wheel move regularly. Its shape must be very precise. Damage can affect timekeeping.
A watchmaker studies a fine spiral inside a watch. The small part expands and contracts with each tick. It helps keep the rhythm steady.
A delicate spring is made from thin metal and sits near the center of a timepiece. A specialist handles it with tweezers. The watch may stop if it breaks.

examples.en: Cathedral gongs wrap twice around the movement to produce a rich, lingering acoustic chime.
examples.zh: 圍繞機芯整整兩圈的教堂級音簧，在音錘敲擊下迸發出悠揚深遠、如天籟般的「報時鳴響」（Chime）。

examples.en: Wind chimes suspended from the garden veranda tinkle melodiously whenever summer ocean breezes blow.
examples.zh: 懸掛在庭院涼亭廊簷下的精緻風鈴，每當盛夏清涼的海風拂過便會發出清脆悅耳的叮咚旋律。

examples.en: The wall clock struck midnight with a resonant brass chime that echoed through the quiet house.
examples.zh: 懸掛在客廳牆面上的骨董老掛鐘在午夜整點敲響，深沉悠揚的黃銅鐘聲在寂靜的深夜屋內久久迴盪。

entries.definition: 悅耳如教堂鐘聲般之雙音階鳴響報時；鐘聲

explains.en: A clear ringing sound from small bells or metal bars is this. A clock may make one on the hour. The word can also mean to ring softly.
The little clock made a gentle sound at noon. The family looked up from lunch. The sound faded quickly.
Wind can move hanging tubes and make them ring. Their notes may differ in pitch. A breeze brought music to the porch.

examples.en: The watchmaker tunes the hardened steel sound gong by filing its base with microscopic diamond files.
examples.zh: 製錶大師手持微米鑽石銼刀修整「高碳鋼音簧」（Gong）底座，以調諧出音準完美的 Do-Mi 雙音階。

examples.en: Monks struck the enormous bronze temple gong to signal the start of dawn meditation rituals.
examples.zh: 寺廟執事僧侶奮力撞擊庭院中沉重的巨大青銅梵鐘，宣告莊嚴清晨破曉禪修早課正式拉開序幕。

examples.en: In martial arts rings, sounding the metal gong officially opens each round of competitive fighting.
examples.zh: 在格鬥擂台賽事現場，金屬鳴鑼清脆的一聲震響，正式標誌著每一回合激烈肉搏搏擊的展開。

entries.definition: 圍繞機芯周圍手工淬火之高碳鋼音簧；銅鑼

explains.en: A large round metal disk makes a deep ringing sound when struck. The sound can carry across a room. It is used in music and ceremonies.
A clock may use a curved steel spring around its mechanism to create a chime. A hammer hits it to mark the time. This metal sound-producing part differs from the percussion instrument.
A performer strikes a hanging bronze disk with a padded mallet. A rich tone vibrates through the air. This percussion instrument is common in ensembles.

examples.en: A perpetual calendar automatically adjusts for months with 28, 30, or 31 days through the year 2100.
examples.zh: 巧奪天工的「萬年曆機制」（Perpetual Calendar），能自主辨識大小月與閏年二月，直到西元 2100 年無需調校。

examples.en: The majestic snow-capped Himalayan peaks stand cloaked in an aura of perpetual winter tranquility.
examples.zh: 巍峨雄偉、直插雲霄的喜馬拉雅白雪群峰，長年籠罩在彷彿永無止境的皚皚白雪與萬籟俱寂的寧靜之中。

examples.en: Early inventors spent lifetimes attempting to build impossible perpetual motion machines that defy physics.
examples.zh: 歷史上許多著魔的古代發明家耗盡畢生精力，妄圖打造出違背熱力學定律的永動機，終歸徒勞一場。

entries.definition: 自動辨識大小月與四年一次閏年之萬年曆的

explains.en: A calendar program keeps working year after year without needing a new setup. It continues indefinitely.
The moon seems to move in a repeating cycle that never ends for observers on Earth. The motion continues.
This adjective means continuing forever or for an unlimited time. It can describe a process or device.

examples.en: The poetic moonphase complication tracks the lunar waxing and waning cycle across deep blue sky.
examples.zh: 充滿詩意的「天文級月相顯示盤」（Moonphase），在深藍夜空中精準描繪月亮的陰晴圓缺變化。

examples.en: Artisans paint golden stars and craters onto the miniature moonphase disc using single-hair brushes.
examples.zh: 彩繪大師手持僅有一根毫毛的特製微型畫筆，在微小圓潤的月相盤面上悉心手繪金光璀璨的月球隕石坑。

examples.en: Ancient farmers scheduled crop sowing around the celestial cycles displayed on early moonphase clocks.
examples.zh: 古代農耕社會的祖先們，習慣依據天文鐘面上清晰指示的月相運行盈虧週期來安排節氣播種。

entries.definition: 122 年僅誤差一天之天文級精密月相顯示盤

explains.en: A watch may show the changing shape of the Moon during its monthly cycle. A small window displays the bright part. The display is decorative and useful.
The Moon seems to change from a thin curve to a full circle and back again. A calendar tracks this pattern. People once used it to mark time.
A dial shows whether the Moon looks new, half-lit, or full in the sky. A gear moves the picture each day. This feature adds a sky detail to the watch.

examples.en: Natural lapis lazuli dotted with golden pyrite flecks forms a breathtaking cosmic backdrop for the dial.
examples.zh: 佈滿天然黃鐵礦金色斑點的「深藍青金石」（Lapis Lazuli），為手錶面盤營造出璀璨的浩瀚星空。

examples.en: Renaissance painters ground precious lapis lazuli stone to create radiant ultramarine oil paints.
examples.zh: 歐洲文藝復興全盛時期的大師們，將昂貴的天然青金石原石研磨成粉，調製出歷經數百年依舊耀眼的群青顏料。

examples.en: The royal pharaoh's funerary mask was richly inlaid with turquoise, carnelian, and deep lapis lazuli.
examples.zh: 埃及法老王黃金圖坦卡門純金陪葬面具上，奢華鑲嵌著天然綠松石、紅玉髓與深邃如夜的頂級青金石。

entries.definition: 鑲嵌黃金繁星之天然青金石星空面盤

explains.en: This deep blue stone has been used in jewelry and art for thousands of years. Tiny gold-colored flecks may appear in it. Artists once ground it into blue paint.
The museum displayed a polished blue stone beside an ancient necklace. Gold specks glittered in its surface. Visitors admired the color.
It comes from mines in a few parts of the world. Jewelers cut it into beads or shapes. This gemstone is often called lapis.

examples.en: Traditional thermal bluing over hot brass filings transforms grey steel screws into a royal cornflower blue.
examples.zh: 在熱黃銅屑上進行手工「高溫烤藍工藝」（Bluing），將原本冷灰色的鋼質螺絲蛻變為尊貴的矢車菊藍。

examples.en: Gunsmiths apply chemical bluing solutions to rifle barrels to create an oxidation barrier against outdoor moisture.
examples.zh: 槍械修護技工在步槍槍管外壁均勻施作化學冷烤藍氧化鈍化塗層，以打造抵禦戶外露水潮氣的抗鏽防護層。

examples.en: Achieving a uniform shade of violet during manual thermal bluing demands precise temperature monitoring.
examples.zh: 在炭火手工烤藍加熱過程中若想精準呈現出均勻溫潤的紫羅蘭金屬光澤，需要對溫度變化具備分秒不差的極致掌控。

entries.definition: 攝氏三百度炭火手工高溫烤藍防鏽工藝

explains.en: A watchmaker heats a steel screw until it turns blue, forming a thin protective surface. The color also decorates the part. This traditional craft helps resist rust.
A steel component is heated over charcoal until it develops a deep blue tone. The thin finish helps protect it from corrosion. It is done carefully by hand.
Metal can be given a blue-black surface through heat treatment. The process creates a decorative color and some protection. Watchmakers use it on small parts.

examples.en: Hand-polished steel pinions mesh perfectly with gold-plated brass wheels to transfer spring energy.
examples.zh: 手工拋光的精鋼「微型齒軸」（Pinions），與鍍金黃銅齒輪完美嚙合，精準傳遞發條動能。

examples.en: The automobile rack-and-pinion steering system translates the driver's steering wheel turns into lateral wheel motion.
examples.zh: 現代汽車的齒輪齒條轉向系統，能將駕駛者雙手轉動方向盤的角度精準轉換為前輪的左右轉向角度。

examples.en: Inspecting tiny pinion leaves under twenty-power magnification reveals whether burrs need polishing.
examples.zh: 在二十倍放大鏡下仔細檢視微型齒軸的每一片齒葉輪廓，能敏銳辨識出是否有細微毛邊需要進一步手工修光。

entries.definition: 嚙合傳遞動能之微型高精度淬火齒軸；副翼

explains.en: A small gear turns a larger wheel in a machine. The teeth fit together.
A mechanic replaces a tiny toothed wheel in a clock. The part transfers motion to another gear.
This is a small gear that meshes with a larger one. It can also mean the wing of a bird.

examples.en: Overlapping circular perlage spotting applied with pegwood creates a shimmering fish-scale pattern.
examples.zh: 用旋轉研磨棒手工重疊壓印出的「魚鱗珍珠紋」（Perlage），在金屬表面綻放出如波光粼粼的珍珠光彩。

examples.en: Beneath the bridges, the entire surface of the baseplate is decorated with tight, uniform perlage.
examples.zh: 在機芯夾板覆蓋的幽暗深處，整個主底板表面皆以手工密密麻麻打磨出排列整齊、間距均勻的魚鱗珍珠紋。

examples.en: Applying perlage demands a steady hand to maintain perfectly identical diameter circles across the metal.
examples.zh: 施作魚鱗打磨極度考驗打磨師的手部穩定度，必須確保金屬板面上每一個微小圓點的直徑與重疊度分毫不差。

entries.definition: 純手工旋轉研磨棒重疊壓印之魚鱗珍珠圓點紋

explains.en: A watchmaker makes tiny overlapping circles on a metal surface inside a watch. The pattern catches the light. It is a careful decorative finish.
The inside of a clock has a plate covered with small circular marks. The design looks like rows of scales. A craftsperson creates it with a special tool.
A collector opens a watch and sees neat circles on its movement plate. The decoration does not change how it tells time. It shows skilled finishing.

examples.en: Master decorators spend hours executing hand-chamfered anglage along every curved edge of the bridges.
examples.zh: 頂級打磨師耗費數小時，使用龍膽木沾鑽石膏沿著夾板每一道弧線進行「手工鏡面倒角」（Anglage）。

examples.en: Impeccable anglage catches light at oblique angles, framing the matte movement components in brilliant silver ribbon.
examples.zh: 完美無瑕的四十五度鏡面倒角能在光線斜射時捕捉耀眼光芒，宛如一條銀白絲帶優雅勾勒出機芯部件線條。

examples.en: Mechanical machines can cut crude chamfers, but sublime mirror anglage can only be achieved by human hands.
examples.zh: 數控車床機具雖然也能車削出平整倒角，但如明鏡般通透無瑕的極致鏡面倒角，至今仍唯有雙手才能實現。

entries.definition: 純手工龍膽木挫刀 45 度倒角鏡面拋光

explains.en: A watchmaker carefully bevels and polishes the edge of a tiny metal part. This decorative finish catches the light. It also shows skilled handwork.
The craftsperson used a small file to shape the edge of a metal bridge. Then she polished it until it shone. The work took hours.
Fine watches may have many finished edges inside. They are difficult to see without a magnifier. Careful detail reflects the maker’s skill.

examples.en: The heavy 22-karat gold oscillating rotor harnesses the natural motion of the wearer’s wrist to wind the watch.
examples.zh: 沉甸甸的 22K 實金「自動上鍊擺陀」（Rotor），藉由佩戴者手腕的日常擺動為發條自動補充電能。

examples.en: Helicopter rotor blades spun furiously, kicking up dust as the rescue flight prepared to take off.
examples.zh: 直升機頂部的旋翼葉片高速旋轉發出震耳欲聾的轟鳴，在草地上捲起陣陣狂暴塵土，準備起飛執行搜救。

examples.en: A platinum winding rotor delivers superior winding inertia compared to lighter stainless steel alternatives.
examples.zh: 與傳統輕質不鏽鋼相比，高密度的純鉑金自動擺陀能帶來更為強大的旋轉慣性力矩，大幅提升上鍊效率。

entries.definition: 二十二 K 實金高比重自動上鍊擺陀 (自動陀)

explains.en: An automatic watch has a weighted semicircle that turns as the wearer moves. Its motion winds the spring inside. This part helps power the clock without daily winding.
A machine has a part that spins around a central point. In a watch, a heavy metal weight moves with the wrist and winds the mechanism. This rotating component is called this.
A wind turbine uses blades to turn a central assembly. In a timepiece, a small golden weight turns to wind the mainspring. This is a rotating part.

examples.en: Ceramic ball bearings inside the winding mechanism ensure smooth, bi-directional energy transfer.
examples.zh: 自動上鍊機制內部的陶瓷滾珠軸承，確保每一次手腕擺動皆能實現超高效率的「雙向上鍊」（Winding）。

examples.en: The coastal road is a scenic winding highway offering stunning panoramic views of crashing ocean waves.
examples.zh: 這條沿著懸崖峭壁依山傍海修築的濱海公路蜿蜒曲折、風景如畫，飽覽白浪拍擊礁岩的壯麗海景。

examples.en: Manual winding watches establish an intimate daily mechanical ritual between the timepiece and its owner.
examples.zh: 手動上鍊機械腕錶每天早晨在指尖輕輕旋動錶冠的親暱觸感，在時間載體與佩戴者之間建立起深刻的日常儀式感。

entries.definition: 雙向高效率陶瓷滾珠微型自動上鍊輪系；曲折

explains.en: A narrow road curves back and forth up the hill. Drivers follow it slowly.
A watch spring is turned so it stores energy. The action prepares the mechanism to run.
This adjective describes a twisting path. The noun can also mean turning a spring or thread around something.

examples.en: Passing fifteen days of grueling tests in five positions earned the movement certified chronometer status.
examples.zh: 歷經五種不同方位與溫差考驗整整十五天，該機芯成功榮獲瑞士官方「天文台精密時計認證」（Chronometer）。

examples.en: Historic marine chronometers allowed 18th-century sea navigators to calculate longitude with unprecedented accuracy.
examples.zh: 航海天文鐘在十八世紀的橫空出世，讓古代遠洋航海先驅終於得以在茫茫大海中精確測算經度，改寫世界地圖。

examples.en: The dial proudly bears the inscription "Official Chronometer" beneath the manufacturer's coat of arms.
examples.zh: 面盤十二點鐘方向的名廠家徽下方，自豪地鐫刻著「官方認證天文台時計」（Chronometer）的尊貴字樣。

entries.definition: 瑞士官方天文台檢定認證頂級精密時計 (COSC)

explains.en: A timepiece has been tested and shown to keep very accurate time. Ships once used such instruments to help find their position. Precision matters.
A watchmaker checks an instrument at different temperatures and positions. The results must meet strict standards. It earns a special label if it passes.
A ship’s crew compares a precise clock with the Sun to estimate where they are at sea. Reliable time helps navigation. The instrument must stay accurate.

examples.en: Clamping a 10x magnification loupe to his eye, the watchmaker adjusted the delicate hairspring coils.
examples.zh: 製錶大師將十倍高倍率「製錶放大鏡」（Loupe）夾在眼眶前，凝神屏息微調纖細游絲的間距。

examples.en: The gemologist inspected the diamond's internal inclusions through a precision achromatic loupe.
examples.zh: 珠寶鑑定大師手持消色差高倍寶石鑑定放大鏡，巨細靡遺檢視天然鑽石內部包裹體的純度與切工瑕疵。

examples.en: Collectors carry pocket loupes to auction previews to examine vintage dials for signs of repainting.
examples.zh: 鐘錶收藏專家參加春季名錶預展時必隨身攜帶高倍放大鏡，仔細辨識古董面盤是否經過不當的後製翻寫。

entries.definition: 製錶大師必備十倍高倍率雙眼目鏡放大鏡

explains.en: A small magnifying glass helps someone see tiny details. Jewelers and watch repairers use one. It may fit over an eye.
The jeweler held a tiny lens close to the ring. She checked the stone for a scratch. The customer waited.
Different strengths make details look larger. A scientist may use one to inspect an insect. Keep it clean for a clear view.

examples.en: Anti-magnetic brass tweezers allow the artisan to handle tiny gears without scratching mirror-polished surfaces.
examples.zh: 採用抗磁黃銅「精密鑷子」（Tweezers），讓工匠能夾取微型零件且絕不在鏡面拋光表面留下任何刮痕。

examples.en: The nurse used sterile stainless steel tweezers to remove the wooden splinter from the child's thumb.
examples.zh: 學校健康中心護理師手持無菌金屬鑷子，溫柔且熟練地將扎進小學童大拇指裡的小木刺徹底夾出拔除。

examples.en: Watchmakers dress and stone the tips of their tweezers daily to ensure parallel, needle-sharp gripping alignment.
examples.zh: 頂級製錶師每天晨會都會使用油石精細打磨鑷子尖端，確保夾具兩側尖頭維持絕對平行且精準對齊。

entries.definition: 裝配游絲專用超細抗磁鈦合金鑷子

explains.en: A watchmaker uses a very fine pair of metal tools to place a tiny spring. The tips meet precisely without touching it by hand. The tool helps with delicate assembly.
A jeweler holds a small gem with two narrow arms that close when pressed. The instrument gives a careful grip. It is used to pick up tiny objects.
A technician chooses a light, nonmagnetic tool to adjust a small watch spring. The pointed ends can reach tiny spaces. This tool holds small parts for repair.

examples.en: Scratch-proof sapphire crystals coated with anti-reflective treatments are so clear the glass appears invisible.
examples.zh: 鍍有雙面防眩光塗層的抗刮「藍寶石水晶鏡面」（Sapphire Crystal），清澈通透得彷彿感受不到玻璃存在。

examples.en: The royal engagement ring featured a mesmerizing, twelve-carat royal blue Ceylon sapphire gemstone.
examples.zh: 這枚令世人矚目的皇室訂婚戒指正中央，鑲嵌著一顆重達十二克拉、產自斯里蘭卡的絕美矢車菊藍天然藍寶石。

examples.en: Synthetic sapphire boules grown from pure alumina powder are sliced with diamond saws to make crystals.
examples.zh: 以高純度氧化鋁粉末結晶生長出的合成人造藍寶石晶柱，隨後以金剛石鑽石線鋸切割打磨成耐磨錶鏡。

entries.definition: 雙面防眩光抗刮頂級藍寶石水晶玻璃錶鏡；藍寶石

explains.en: A blue gemstone shines in a ring. It is very hard and can be used in watches.
A scratch-resistant crystal covers the face of a fine watch. The material is clear and durable.
This precious stone is usually blue, though it can have other colors. Synthetic versions are used in technology.

examples.en: An exhibition sapphire caseback invites connoisseurs to admire the mesmerizing heartbeat of the balance.
examples.zh: 透明「藍寶石水晶錶背底蓋」（Caseback），讓鐘錶鑑賞家能隨時飽覽機芯內部擺輪如心跳般的美妙律動。

examples.en: A screw-down solid metal caseback with rubber O-rings provides deep-sea diving watches with water resistance.
examples.zh: 旋入式實心不鏽鋼金屬底蓋內嵌專用氟橡膠防水 O 形環，賦予專業深海潛水腕錶深達千米的防水性能。

examples.en: The commemorative pocket watch featured a family crest engraved into its polished gold caseback.
examples.zh: 這枚紀念祖父八十壽誕的傳家純金懷錶，在其拋光如鏡的金屬底蓋背面手工鐫刻著尊貴的家族徽章。

entries.definition: 透視藍寶石水晶錶背 (直視機芯精密跳動)

explains.en: The rear cover of a watch protects its inner gears. Some covers are clear so owners can see the movement. A gasket helps keep water out.
A repairer unscrews the back of a timepiece to reach the battery or mechanism. They use the correct tool. The cover is put back securely.
A watch has a metal panel on its underside. It may carry a maker’s name or number. This part seals the case.

examples.en: Unlike wind or solar, geothermal energy provides reliable, uninterrupted baseload power day and night.
examples.zh: 不同於易受天候影響的風力或太陽能，地熱能日夜提供穩定不中斷的「全時基載電力」（Baseload Power）。

examples.en: Electric utilities require steady baseload generation to prevent voltage drops during peak evening demand.
examples.zh: 電力調度中心高度需要源源不絕的穩定基載電力，以防止入夜後用電尖峰時刻出現電網電壓驟降。

examples.en: Nuclear reactors historically supplied the steady baseload capacity required by heavy industrial factories.
examples.zh: 在傳統能源結構中，大型核電廠長期承擔供應重工業聚落全天候生產營運所需的穩定基載發電容量。

entries.definition: 24/7 不受天候干擾之全時基載電力的

explains.en: The steady amount of electricity needed at all times is this level of power. Utilities plan for it day and night. Other sources can meet extra demand.
Even late at night, homes and hospitals still need electricity. A power station supplies a steady amount. Other plants turn on when use rises.
Energy from underground heat can provide constant power. Wind and sunlight change with weather. A reliable system uses several sources.

examples.en: Regions with a steep geothermal gradient require shallower, less expensive drilling to hit boiling rock.
examples.zh: 擁有高「地溫增溫梯度」（Geothermal Gradient）的地質區域，只需鑽探較淺深度即可觸及高溫熱岩。

examples.en: The heavy freight train struggled to ascend the steep five-percent mountain railway gradient.
examples.zh: 滿載重型貨物的長編組貨運列車在攀爬坡度高達千分之五十的陡峭高山鐵道時，柴電機車引擎全力轟鳴。

examples.en: Color gradient backgrounds give modern mobile user interfaces a vibrant, three-dimensional look.
examples.zh: 巧妙運用柔和流暢的漸層色彩漸變背景，能賦予現代智慧型手機應用程式介面生動而富有深度的視覺立體感。

entries.definition: 每公里增溫數十度之地溫增溫梯度；坡度

explains.en: A mountain road rises gradually as it travels uphill. Engineers measure how much height changes over a distance. This amount is the slope of the road.
Temperature inside Earth increases as depth increases. Scientists measure the change over each kilometer. This describes how warmth changes with depth.
A map shows a steep hill with closely spaced contour lines. The land’s incline changes from place to place. This word describes a slope or gradual change.

examples.en: Downhole temperature sensors lowered into the borehole measured three hundred degrees Celsius at depth.
examples.zh: 將耐高溫儀器垂降深入四千公尺的「探勘鑽孔井深」（Borehole），在井底測得攝氏三百度的驚人高溫。

examples.en: Groundwater hydrologists sampled water from the agricultural borehole to check for pesticide contamination.
examples.zh: 地下水水文地質學家從深層農業灌溉水井鑽孔中抽取水樣，送往實驗室化驗是否含有劇毒農藥殘留。

examples.en: Acoustic logging tools lowered down the borehole record rock density and fracture orientation.
examples.zh: 測井工程師將聲波測井儀器垂降深入鑽孔深處，精確連續記錄岩層密度與隱蔽裂隙走向。

entries.definition: 四千公尺高溫高壓探勘鑽井深井鑽孔

explains.en: Workers drill a narrow deep opening into the ground to reach water or collect samples. Sensors can be lowered inside.
A scientist studies rock layers through a drilled hole. The opening provides access beneath the surface.
This is a deep, narrow hole drilled into the earth for investigation or extraction. Workers may lower tools or sensors inside.

examples.en: The 1,500-horsepower automated drilling rig operates around the clock, penetrating hard volcanic basalt.
examples.zh: 搭載一千五百匹馬力的自動化「大型地熱鑽機」（Drilling Rig），二十四小時不間斷鑿穿堅硬玄武岩。

examples.en: Offshore oil workers live for weeks on the floating production rig located fifty miles offshore.
examples.zh: 遠洋離岸鑽井平台的工程技師與工班在遠離海岸五十浬的外海浮動平台上，過著數週一輪的輪班生活。

examples.en: Stagehands helped the aerial acrobats rig safety harnesses before opening night of the circus show.
examples.zh: 舞台工作人員在馬戲特技首演登場前，細心協助高空飛人特技演員組裝與固定高空防墜安全吊帶。

entries.definition: 現代化大型液壓頂驅自動化深層地熱鑽機；設備

explains.en: A truck has a frame and equipment set up for a special job. A camera crew may use a vehicle with lights and tools. The word can mean the whole setup.
A sailor adjusts ropes and poles on a boat so its sails catch the wind. The crew checks each line. The arrangement helps the vessel move.
A diver wears a set of tanks and gear before entering the water. They check every connection with a partner. The word can name the equipment.

examples.en: High-temperature thermal cementation bonds the casing firmly to the borehole wall, preventing leaks.
examples.zh: 進行高溫特種水泥「固井灌漿工序」（Cementation），將鋼管與井壁緊密黏合，徹底防範高壓流體洩漏。

examples.en: Over millions of years, natural chemical cementation turns loose beach sand into hard sandstone strata.
examples.zh: 歷經漫長數百萬年的地質歲月，碳酸鈣與二氧化矽的天然膠結礦化作用將鬆散海灘沙粒凝固成堅硬沉積砂岩。

examples.en: Specialized expanding cement formulations ensure leak-proof wellbore cementation in extreme conditions.
examples.zh: 配方專利的微膨脹耐熱特種水泥漿，確保深層地熱井在攝氏三百度的極端熱應力下依然維持完美密封固井。

entries.definition: 隔絕地下水層之高溫耐熱特種水泥灌漿工序

explains.en: A process joins loose grains or parts with a binding material. Natural minerals can turn sand into solid rock. Builders also use cement to connect pieces.
Over a long time, minerals filled spaces between grains on the beach. The loose sand became hard stone. Geologists studied the layers.
A repair worker may inject special material into a crack to strengthen a structure. It hardens in place. The right product depends on the job.

examples.en: Enhanced Geothermal Systems (EGS) create artificial permeability in deep hot dry rock via fluid injection.
examples.zh: 「增強型地熱系統」（Enhanced Geothermal Systems EGS），透過人工注水壓裂在深層乾熱岩中創造導流通道。

examples.en: The luxury vehicle was equipped with an enhanced safety package featuring automated collision avoidance.
examples.zh: 這款進口頂級豪華旗艦轎車選配了全方位升級安全套件，整合了全速域自動緊急煞車與主動防撞功能。

examples.en: Modern digital hearing aids utilize artificial intelligence to provide enhanced speech clarity in noisy restaurants.
examples.zh: 最新款數位助聽器導入 AI 深度學習晶片進行降噪運算，在吵雜喧鬧的餐廳中帶來清晰動人的語音增強表現。

entries.definition: 增強型地熱系統 (人工水力注水壓裂 EGS) 的

explains.en: Engineers pump water into hot rock beneath the ground to create an improved geothermal system. The water collects heat and returns to the surface. The adjective describes a system that has been expanded or improved.
A power plant injects water into deep cracks in hot rock. The heated water can produce steam for electricity. This type of geothermal system has been strengthened by engineering.
Heat from underground rock is made more usable by adding wells and fluid circulation. The system gains capacity through human design. This describes something made better or more powerful.

examples.en: Hydraulic fracturing opens microscopic fractures, enabling cold water to circulate through hot granite.
examples.zh: 「水力壓裂刺激工法」（Fracturing），在高壓下撐開花崗岩微小裂隙，使注入的冷水能順暢流經高溫熱岩。

examples.en: Severe physical impact caused multi-fragment bone fracturing that required orthopedic surgery.
examples.zh: 劇烈的外力撞擊導致骨骼發生粉碎性骨折，急診創傷小組緊急將傷患推進手術室進行骨科內固定手術。

examples.en: Micro-seismic monitoring arrays verify that hydraulic fracturing remains contained within deep targeted zones.
examples.zh: 地表高密度微震監測陣列隨時嚴密監控，確保水力壓裂過程中的微小岩石裂隙完全被限制在預定的深層地質層中。

entries.definition: 水力壓裂刺激地下緻密高溫乾熱岩裂隙；破裂

explains.en: Engineers pump fluid into rock to create tiny cracks so trapped resources can move. The process is carefully controlled.
A rock breaks along small lines under pressure. The new cracks change how liquid flows through it.
This is the process of creating cracks in a material. It can happen naturally or be done to rock during energy production.

examples.en: Dense crystalline granite heated by radioactive isotope decay serves as an ideal thermal battery.
examples.zh: 受到地殼放射性同位素衰變持續加熱的深層緻密「花崗岩體」（Granite），如同大自然龐大的地下熱蓄電池。

examples.en: The kitchen island was covered with a polished grey granite countertop resistant to knife scratches.
examples.zh: 豪宅開放式廚房的中島料理台鋪設了一整面進口深灰花崗石檯面，不僅耐高溫且耐刮耐磨損。

examples.en: Mountain climbers ascended the sheer vertical face of the giant El Capitan granite monolith.
examples.zh: 極限攀岩運動員歷經數十小時徒手挑戰，成功征服了優勝美地國家公園那座近乎九十度垂直的巨型花崗岩巨石。

entries.definition: 埋藏於地下深處高溫緻密無水之花崗岩；花崗石

explains.en: A hard rock with visible grains is often used for kitchen counters and monuments. It forms deep underground. Its colors can include gray, pink, or black.
A builder cuts a block of speckled stone to make steps. The material lasts a long time outdoors. Heavy tools are needed to shape it.
A mountain face contains crystals that formed as melted rock cooled slowly. Geologists examine the minerals. The rock is strong and coarse-grained.

examples.en: Increasing rock permeability ensures that circulating water absorbs maximum heat during transit.
examples.zh: 大幅提升地下岩層的「流體滲透率」（Permeability），確保循環水在穿行過程中能充分吸收岩石熱能。

examples.en: Impervious concrete pavements destroy soil permeability, exacerbating severe urban flash flooding.
examples.zh: 到處過度鋪設不透水柏油路面破壞了都市土壤天然滲透保水能力，加劇了午後暴雨引發的短暫淹水災情。

examples.en: Magnetic permeability describes the degree of magnetization that a material obtains in an external field.
examples.zh: 在電磁學物理領域中，材料的磁導率精準描述了該物質在外部磁場作用下所獲得的磁化響應強度。

entries.definition: 人工提升地底深處岩層透水性與滲透率

explains.en: How easily water or air passes through a material is this property. Sandy soil lets water flow quickly. Clay holds it longer.
The gardener poured water onto two soil samples. It drained quickly through one and slowly through the other. The samples had different textures.
Rock with tiny connected spaces may let water pass through. This matters for wells and plants. Scientists measure the flow.

examples.en: Total sustainable reinjection prevents subsidence and guarantees the geothermal reservoir never runs dry.
examples.zh: 實施百分之百「尾水全數回灌」（Reinjection），不僅能徹底防止地層下陷，更確保地下水資源永不枯竭。

examples.en: Closed-loop reinjection pipelines are constructed from insulated alloys to conserve residual warmth.
examples.zh: 封閉式全回灌專用管線採用頂級保溫隔熱合金鋼管包裹，最大程度保留水體殘餘熱能以降低地底加熱耗損。

examples.en: Environmental impact assessments require full fluid reinjection to protect surface wetlands from mineral runoff.
examples.zh: 環評主管機關嚴格要求地熱電廠落實全流體閉環深層回灌，杜絕富含礦物質的地熱水隨意排入周邊天然濕地。

entries.definition: 百分之百尾水全回灌 (維持地層水壓零耗竭)

explains.en: After heat is taken from geothermal water, the cooled liquid is pumped back underground. This helps maintain pressure and reduce waste. The return flow supports the reservoir.
A power station sends used water back into the hot rock formation. Replacing the liquid helps keep the underground supply balanced. This step can prevent depletion.
The fluid that has produced steam is returned to the same underground area. Operators aim to preserve water levels and pressure. This is the act of pumping it back in.

examples.en: Balanced fluid management avoids pressure depletion, extending the operational life of the power station.
examples.zh: 保持進出平衡的水量管理，能避免地層「壓力與熱能耗竭」（Depletion），讓地熱電廠可持續服役數十年。

examples.en: Unregulated commercial trawling caused severe fish stock depletion throughout coastal fishing waters.
examples.zh: 缺乏嚴格監管的過度底拖網商業濫捕，導致近海沿岸天然魚類漁業資源面臨近乎枯竭崩潰的嚴峻危機。

examples.en: Prolonged sleeplessness leads to severe physical exhaustion and neurotransmitter dopamine depletion.
examples.zh: 長期連續熬夜與睡眠不足會引發嚴重的身心慢性透支，甚至導致大腦多巴胺神經傳導物質的嚴重消耗與耗竭。

entries.definition: 嚴格避免地熱儲集層壓力與溫度過早耗竭衰減

explains.en: A lake loses water during a long drought. Its level falls as supplies are used.
A battery’s power drops after a phone is used all day. The remaining energy becomes low.
This is a reduction in the amount of something available. It can describe natural resources, energy, or supplies.

examples.en: Geothermal brine contains dissolved minerals like silica and lithium that can be extracted commercially.
examples.zh: 深層高溫「地熱滷水」（Brine）富含多種溶解礦物質，未來甚至能從中提煉高價值的電池級鋰金屬。

examples.en: Pickling cucumbers in spiced salt brine transforms them into crunchy homemade savory dill pickles.
examples.zh: 將鮮採小黃瓜浸入調配了蒔蘿香料的濃鹽水中慢醃發酵，能醃漬出酸香爽脆、風味絕佳的手工醃黃瓜。

examples.en: High-salinity brine discharged from desalination plants must be dispersed carefully into open ocean currents.
examples.zh: 海水淡化廠產出的高濃度濃鹽水在排放回大海時必須經過妥善稀釋與漫流擴散，以保障沿岸珊瑚礁生態。

entries.definition: 蘊含豐富礦物質之深層高溫地熱滷水；鹽水

explains.en: Salt mixed into water makes a liquid used to preserve food. Cucumbers can soak in it before becoming pickles. The mixture can be very salty.
A cook places meat in salty water before roasting it. This can add flavor and moisture. The food is rinsed or cooked as directed.
Water under the ground can contain much more salt than seawater. Scientists measure it near some deep ocean openings. The word names this salty liquid.

examples.en: Advanced titanium and nickel alloys withstand severe acid corrosion from volcanic chloride fluids.
examples.zh: 採用先進鈦合金與高鎳合金材料，能抵禦火山強酸性氯化物氣體所帶來的「高溫腐蝕」（Corrosion）。

examples.en: Applying primer paint prevents metallic oxidation and surface rust corrosion on wrought iron gates.
examples.zh: 在鍛鐵庭園大門表面均勻刷塗防鏽底漆，能杜絕金屬與空氣中水氣氧化接觸，全面防止鐵鏽蝕化腐爛。

examples.en: The spread of institutional corruption causes a slow, toxic corrosion of public trust in democratic systems.
examples.zh: 買官賣爵等貪腐行徑的蔓延，如同慢性毒藥般在無形中嚴重侵蝕與腐蝕著社會大眾對民主體制的互信基石。

entries.definition: 抵禦火山強酸性流體對金屬管道之高溫腐蝕

explains.en: Metal can slowly wear away after reacting with water, air, or chemicals. Rust is one example. Paint can protect some surfaces.
The old gate had orange marks after years in the rain. The owner cleaned it and added a protective coat. It looked better.
Salt water can damage some metals more quickly. Workers choose materials that resist it. Regular checks can find damage early.

examples.en: The vertical cyclone separator spins the mixture to isolate dry steam from mineral-dense liquid brine.
examples.zh: 垂直旋風式「汽水分離器」（Separator），利用離心力將乾燥純蒸汽與高濃度液態滷水完美分離。

examples.en: Centrifugal milk separators spin dairy at high speed to divide skim milk from rich heavy cream.
examples.zh: 乳品加工廠利用高速離心乳水分離機，能在數秒內將新鮮生乳完美分離為脫脂牛奶與濃郁純鮮奶油。

examples.en: The glass separator screen provides acoustic privacy between quiet office booths in the library.
examples.zh: 裝設在圖書館自修室個人座位間的磨砂隔音玻璃隔板屏風，為讀者營造出互不干擾的專注閱讀隱私環境。

entries.definition: 汽水分離器 (分離高溫純蒸汽與液態滷水)

explains.en: Hot geothermal liquid contains steam and mineral water. A vessel divides the vapor from the liquid before power is produced. This equipment separates the two phases.
At a geothermal plant, a tank lets steam rise while salty water stays below. The vapor drives a turbine. This machine makes the separation.
A pipeline carries a mixture of hot liquid and gas. A piece of equipment divides the steam from the water. This allows each part to be used appropriately.

examples.en: Binary cycle plants utilize heat exchangers to transfer energy from moderate-temperature water to a secondary fluid.
examples.zh: 「雙循環地熱發電廠」（Binary Plant），透過熱交換器利用百餘度的中低溫溫泉熱水進行高效發電。

examples.en: Digital computers process all instructions using basic binary code made up entirely of zeros and ones.
examples.zh: 現代數位電子計算機內部所有的複雜運算與指令處理，本質上皆完全奠基於由 0 與 1 組成的二進位代碼。

examples.en: Astronomers observed a distant binary star system where two twin suns orbit their shared gravitational center.
examples.zh: 天文學家運用高倍望遠鏡觀測到一個遙遠的雙星聯星系統，兩顆孿生恆星圍繞著共同的質量中心規律互繞。

entries.definition: 雙循環有機朗肯發電系統 (利用中低溫熱水) 的

explains.en: A computer stores information using two symbols: zero and one. All its data can be represented this way.
A machine offers two choices, such as on or off. The options form a pair.
This adjective means involving two parts or choices. In computing, it refers to a system based on two digits.

examples.en: The shell-and-tube heat exchanger transfers geothermal energy to the power cycle without mixing fluids.
examples.zh: 採用抗腐蝕鈦合金打造的「高效熱交換器」（Heat Exchanger），在完全不混合流體的前提下高效率傳遞熱能。

examples.en: Travel desks offer automated currency exchanger kiosks where tourists can swap foreign banknotes for local dollars.
examples.zh: 國際機場出境大廳設有多台全自動外幣兌換機智慧機台，方便抵達的各國旅客隨時將外幣現鈔兌換為新台幣。

examples.en: Regular maintenance flushes scale deposits from internal copper tubes of the heat exchanger unit.
examples.zh: 工廠維修團隊定期使用弱酸清洗劑清洗管殼式熱交換器內部的紫銅管束，徹底清除積累的熱阻硬垢。

entries.definition: 鈦合金抗腐蝕高效板式熱交換器單元

explains.en: A machine transfers heat from one liquid or gas to another without mixing them. It may warm water in a building. Clean surfaces help it work well.
A car radiator moves heat from hot engine fluid into the air. The parts have many thin channels. This keeps the engine from overheating.
In a factory, warm and cool streams pass through separate pipes close together. Heat moves between them. The device saves energy.

examples.en: Drilling into supercritical geothermal zones unlocks fluids under extreme pressure holding ten times more energy.
examples.zh: 鑽入深層「超臨界地熱區」（Supercritical Zone），能獲取蘊含十倍以上能量的攝氏四百度極端高壓流體。

examples.en: Supercritical carbon dioxide is utilized in industrial processes to decaffeinate green coffee beans gently.
examples.zh: 現代食品加工業廣泛運用超臨界二氧化碳萃取技術，在不破壞咖啡原有香氣的前提下溫和去除咖啡因。

examples.en: At supercritical temperatures and pressures, substances exhibit properties of both liquids and expanding gases.
examples.zh: 當物質處於超越臨界點的超臨界狀態時，其物理性質將兼具液體的高密度溶解力與氣體的高擴散流動性。

entries.definition: 攝氏四百度高壓超臨界流體 (能量密度增十倍) 的

explains.en: A material above a certain temperature and pressure can take on properties of both a liquid and a gas. Scientists call this state unusual. It is used in some industrial processes.
The class saw a diagram showing a substance under high pressure and heat. It no longer behaved like an ordinary liquid. The teacher explained the state.
This condition can help extract flavor or clean materials. Machines must control pressure and temperature carefully. It is studied in chemistry.

examples.en: Closed-loop reinjection systems produce near-zero greenhouse gas emissions, delivering genuinely clean energy.
examples.zh: 全密閉式回灌發電系統，達成近乎「零溫室氣體排放」（Zero Emissions），是真正純淨的潔淨能源典範。

examples.en: Strict automotive regulations mandate drastic reductions in diesel truck exhaust emissions to protect air quality.
examples.zh: 嚴格的環保排氣法規強制要求柴油大貨車加裝微粒過濾器，以大幅削減氮氧化物等有害排氣廢氣排放。

examples.en: The international climate treaty sets legally binding targets to reduce industrial greenhouse gas emissions by half.
examples.zh: 聯合國國際氣候公約制定了具備法律約束力的減碳目標，要求各締約國在目標年前將工業溫室氣體排放量減半。

entries.definition: 全密閉式發電達成近乎零溫室氣體碳排放

explains.en: A sealed power plant releases very little greenhouse gas into the air. Its output is measured to check environmental impact. Such gases are monitored as environmental output.
Cars and factories may send gases into the atmosphere. Measuring the amount helps people understand pollution. This word names substances released into the air.
A geothermal station uses closed pipes to keep most gases contained. Officials monitor what leaves the facility. Officials measure what enters the air.

examples.en: Distributed geothermal microgrids enhance local energy resiliency during severe typhoons and earthquakes.
examples.zh: 在地分散式地熱微電網，能在遭遇強烈颱風與劇烈地震時，大幅提升偏遠山區聚落的「電力供電韌性」（Resiliency）。

examples.en: Emotional resiliency allows healthcare workers to bounce back from difficult stressful emergency room shifts.
examples.zh: 良好健全的心理心理復原韌性，協助第一線急診醫護人員在高壓緊繃的輪班工作後迅速調整心態重新出發。

examples.en: The agricultural ministry promotes crop varieties with high genetic resiliency against extreme seasonal heatwaves.
examples.zh: 農業部積極輔導培育並推廣具備高抗逆耐候基因韌性的水稻抗旱新品種，以因應極端氣候熱浪侵襲。

entries.definition: 強化海島偏鄉分散式在地電網供電韌性

explains.en: A town restores electricity soon after a storm damages power lines. The community recovers quickly.
A rubber band returns to its shape after being stretched. It can recover from change.
This quality means being able to recover after difficulty or change. It applies to people, systems, and materials.

examples.en: Revolutionary millimeter-wave energy drilling vaporizes ultra-hard rocks, reaching ten kilometers deep.
examples.zh: 革命性的毫米波能量「無接觸熱融鑽井新技術」（Drilling），能融化極硬岩石直達地底十公里深處。

examples.en: The dentist performed careful tooth drilling before placing a tooth-colored composite resin filling.
examples.zh: 溫柔細心的牙醫師在填補複合樹脂蛀牙齒色填充物之前，先以高速牙科鑽針小心磨除受損的齲齒結構。

examples.en: Offshore exploratory oil drilling involves high financial risks combined with complex oceanic engineering.
examples.zh: 遠洋深水離岸油氣探勘鑽探工程伴隨著數以億計的龐大財務風險，高度考驗極端海洋工程的技術極限。

entries.definition: 毫米波無接觸高溫融岩定向鑽井新科技

explains.en: A machine cuts a narrow hole into rock to find water, oil, or minerals. Workers check the equipment and surrounding ground. Safety rules are essential.
A dentist uses a small spinning tool to remove damaged material from a tooth. The patient may receive numbing medicine. The work is done carefully.
A crew bores into the seafloor to collect a sample. The core shows layers of rock. Scientists study the material.

examples.en: Wearable spatial computing liberates users from rectangular glass smartphone and laptop screens.
examples.zh: 穿戴式「空間運算技術」（Computing），將人類徹底從手機與筆記型電腦的長方形玻璃螢幕中解放。

examples.en: Quantum computing promises to solve complex logistical equations in seconds rather than years.
examples.zh: 量子運算可望在數秒內解開繁複的物流運籌方程式，而不再需要耗費數年。

examples.en: The university offers an intensive certificate program in cloud computing and data architecture.
examples.zh: 這所大學提供雲端運算與資料架構的密集培訓證照課程。

entries.definition: 穿戴式空間三維人機互動運算；運算

explains.en: Using computers to store, process, and share information is this activity or field. It includes programming and data work. Many jobs use it.
The class used computers to sort a list of animals. They made a chart from the results. The teacher showed them how to save the file.
New forms may combine digital tools with the space around a person. A headset can place images into a room. The technology continues to develop.

examples.en: The aluminum and curved-glass headset rests comfortably against the face with adjustable braided straps.
examples.zh: 採用鋁合金與曲面玻璃打造的「混合實境頭戴裝置」（Headset），透過編織頭帶貼合人體面部。

examples.en: The customer service representative adjusted her noise-canceling headset before taking the next incoming call.
examples.zh: 客服專員在接聽下一通來電前，調整好她的降噪耳麥。

examples.en: Players put on the lightweight wireless headset to immerse themselves in virtual reality games.
examples.zh: 玩家戴上輕量化無線頭戴裝置，讓自己完全沉浸在虛擬實境遊戲中。

entries.definition: 輕量化混合實境 (MR) 頭戴式顯示器；耳機

explains.en: A person wears a light device over the eyes to see digital images mixed with the real room. It can track head movement. The display creates a mixed-reality experience.
A worker looks through a wearable screen that adds virtual labels to real objects. The device sits on the head and leaves the hands free. It can also play sound through ear speakers.
A game player wears a screen close to the eyes and headphones over the ears. The device shows a computer-made world. It is a wearable display system.

examples.en: High-resolution video passthrough reconstructs the external world in real time with twelve-millisecond latency.
examples.zh: 高解析度「全彩影像透視」（Passthrough），以僅十二毫秒的極低延遲即時還原真實外在世界。

examples.en: Thanks to full-color passthrough, users can easily read smartphone messages without removing their goggles.
examples.zh: 受惠於全彩影像透視功能，使用者無需摘下護目鏡即可輕鬆閱讀手機訊息。

examples.en: The latest firmware update improved passthrough clarity under low-light evening conditions.
examples.zh: 最新的韌體更新提升了夜間低光源環境下的影像透視清晰度。

entries.definition: 12 毫秒超低延遲高畫質即時全彩影像透視

explains.en: A headset shows the real room while adding digital labels and objects. The user can still see the surroundings.
A device sends a signal through to another system without changing it much. The original content continues onward.
This feature lets outside information or signals pass through a device. In mixed reality, it can show the real environment through cameras.

examples.en: Diffractive optical waveguides bounce projected micro-LED images directly into the wearer's pupil.
examples.zh: 全像繞射「光學波導鏡片」（Waveguides），將微型投影光束精準折射進佩戴者的瞳孔中。

examples.en: Engineering teams must achieve micron-level precision when etching nanostructures onto the glass waveguide.
examples.zh: 工程團隊在玻璃波導鏡片上蝕刻奈米結構時，必須達到微米級的精準度。

examples.en: Advanced waveguide displays allow augmented reality spectacles to remain thin and fashionable.
examples.zh: 先進的光波導顯示技術讓擴增實境智慧眼鏡得以維持纖薄且兼具時尚外觀。

entries.definition: 全像繞射微型光波導鏡片 (極致輕薄如眼鏡)

explains.en: A narrow channel directs radio waves or light from one place to another. It may be built into a device. The shape helps keep the signal on course.
A microwave oven uses a metal passage to carry energy from its source into the cooking area. The walls guide the waves. The door keeps energy inside.
A fiber carries light signals through glass over long distances. The light stays inside as it moves. Engineers design the path to reduce loss.

examples.en: Foveated rendering allocates graphics horsepower exclusively to the exact spot where your eyes focus.
examples.zh: 「注視點渲染技術」（Foveated Rendering），將圖形運算效能精準集中在視線焦點，大幅節省算力。

examples.en: By using a foveated rendering algorithm, mobile chipsets can drive demanding virtual worlds smoothly.
examples.zh: 藉由採用注視點渲染演算法，行動晶片組也能流暢驅動高負載的虛擬世界。

examples.en: Developers observed a forty percent drop in GPU power consumption after enabling foveated processing.
examples.zh: 開發者發現啟用注視點處理功能後，GPU 功耗降低了百分之四十。

entries.definition: 眼球追蹤注視點渲染技術 (大幅節省 GPU 算力) 的

explains.en: A screen or image may show the sharpest detail only where a person is looking. This saves computer power. The rest can appear less detailed.
The game kept the center of the player’s view sharp while lowering detail at the edges. The picture still felt clear. The device used less energy.
Eye-tracking sensors can follow where someone looks. The system updates that part quickly. This method helps display large virtual scenes.

examples.en: Ultra-smooth frame pacing prevents simulator motion sickness during fast virtual flying experiences.
examples.zh: 極致流暢的畫面幀率，徹底預防了在虛擬飛行體驗中因視覺與前庭衝突引起的「動暈症」（Motion Sickness）。

examples.en: Several passengers took herbal medicine to relieve nausea caused by car sickness on the mountain highway.
examples.zh: 好幾位乘客在行經蜿蜒山路前服用了草本成藥，以緩解暈車引起的噁心不適。

examples.en: The company introduced paid leave policies for employees coping with chronic family sickness.
examples.zh: 公司推出了帶薪照顧假政策，協助需要照顧家中慢性病患的員工。

entries.definition: 消除前庭感覺衝突引發之虛擬動暈症；疾病

explains.en: A person wearing a virtual-reality display may feel dizzy when the eyes see motion but the inner ear does not. Some people feel nauseated. This discomfort can be reduced with better design.
A passenger feels ill when a boat rocks, even while looking at a steady object. The body’s balance system is confused. This condition can include nausea and dizziness.
A game moves quickly on screen while the player sits still. The eyes sense motion but the body does not, which can make someone feel unwell. This is a form of motion-related nausea.

examples.en: Real-time spatial mesh generation enables digital characters to hide realistically behind physical couches.
examples.zh: 即時生成的「空間幾何網格」（Spatial Mesh），能讓虛擬角色逼真地躲藏在真實沙發背後。

examples.en: We installed wire mesh fencing around the vegetable patch to protect young shoots from wild rabbits.
examples.zh: 我們在菜園周圍裝設鐵絲網圍欄，以保護幼嫩的菜苗免遭野兔啃咬。

examples.en: His practical business skills mesh remarkably well with his partner's artistic design vision.
examples.zh: 他的務實商業營運能力與合夥人的藝術設計遠見配合得相得益彰。

entries.definition: 房間實體環境 3D 幾何空間三角網格模型；網狀物

explains.en: A net made of crossing threads catches leaves in a garden pond. Water can still pass through the holes.
A computer creates a network of connected points to represent a 3D object. The surface is divided into small shapes.
This is a network of crossing lines or connected pieces. It can be physical netting or a digital model.

examples.en: Dynamic hand occlusion allows your real fingers to pass in front of floating virtual application windows naturally.
examples.zh: 「動態深度遮蔽技術」（Occlusion），讓使用者的真實雙手能自然出現在懸浮虛擬視窗的前方。

examples.en: Coronary artery occlusion can restrict oxygen flow to heart tissues and trigger sudden chest pain.
examples.zh: 冠狀動脈阻塞會限制心肌的氧氣供應，並誘發突發性胸口劇痛。

examples.en: Computer vision algorithms must solve object occlusion when tracking pedestrians through crowded crosswalks.
examples.zh: 電腦視覺演算法在擁擠斑馬線上追蹤行人時，必須克服人體相互遮擋的難題。

entries.definition: 數位物件與真實雙手之即時深度前後遮蔽

explains.en: A dentist checks how upper and lower teeth meet when the mouth closes. A poor fit may cause discomfort. Small adjustments can help.
A camera view is blocked when one object hides another. The hidden part cannot be seen. Artists use overlap to show depth.
A blood vessel may become partly blocked and reduce blood flow. Doctors use tests to find the cause. Treatment depends on the person.

examples.en: Advanced neural networks synthesize a photorealistic persona avatar mimicking subtle facial expressions.
examples.zh: 先進神經網路即時捕捉微表情，為使用者生成如照片般逼真的「個人化數位分身」（Avatar）。

examples.en: Gamers spend hours customizing the clothing, hairstyle, and armor of their virtual gaming avatar.
examples.zh: 電玩玩家花費數小時精心自訂虛擬遊戲替身的服飾、髮型與盔甲裝備。

examples.en: In ancient mythology, the divine hero was regarded as an avatar of courage and righteousness.
examples.zh: 在遠古神話中，這位神話英雄被奉為勇氣與正義的無瑕化身。

entries.definition: 照片級高擬真個人化數位分身阿凡達；化身

explains.en: A picture or character represents a person in a game or online space. People can choose its clothes and face. It stands in for them.
Miko picked a blue-haired character for her game. She changed its jacket and added a backpack. Her friends recognized it.
The word can also mean someone who represents an idea or role. In a story, a hero may stand for courage. The context tells the meaning.

examples.en: Holographic telepresence allows remote coworkers to collaborate in the same virtual room across continents.
examples.zh: 「全像即時傳真技術」（Telepresence），讓跨越大洋的同事如圍坐在同一張實體會議桌旁協同辦公。

examples.en: Robotic telepresence units permit hospitalized children to attend school classes and interact with peers.
examples.zh: 機器人遠端臨場裝置讓長期住院的學童得以同步參與學校課程，並與同儕互動。

examples.en: High-bandwidth 5G connections make smooth corporate telepresence meetings possible without lag.
examples.zh: 高頻寬 5G 行動通訊讓流暢無延遲的跨國企業視訊臨場會議成為可能。

entries.definition: 遠端全像即時傳真 (千里之外如坐對面)

explains.en: A doctor can meet a patient through a life-size screen from far away. The image and sound make the exchange feel close. This technology creates a sense of being present remotely.
A robot in another city shows a live picture of a person who controls it. People can talk and look around as if they were there. This is remote presence.
A large display shows a distant speaker in real time at nearly life size. The people in the room can speak naturally with them. The technology makes a faraway person seem nearby.

examples.en: Acoustic raytracing models sound reverberation differences between carpeted bedrooms and marble hallways.
examples.zh: 聲學「光線追蹤技術」（Raytracing），精準模擬地毯臥室與大理石長廊之間截然不同的回音殘響。

examples.en: Hardware-accelerated raytracing generates photorealistic light reflections on puddles and wet pavements.
examples.zh: 硬體加速光線追蹤技術在積水水窪與潮濕路面上呈現出照片級的光影倒影。

examples.en: Game developers leverage real-time raytracing to craft lifelike shadows cast by multiple dynamic light sources.
examples.zh: 遊戲開發者善用即時光追運算，精準刻劃出由多重動態光源投射出的生動陰影。

entries.definition: 根據房間材質即時計算之聲波光線追蹤技術

explains.en: A computer follows paths of light to make reflections look realistic in a game. The image takes more work to calculate.
A designer simulates how sound travels and bounces around a room. The model shows where echoes may occur.
This technique traces paths from a source through a scene to predict light or sound behavior. It can create realistic images.

examples.en: Microfluidic haptic gloves inflate tiny air pockets to simulate the physical resistance of grasping a solid cup.
examples.zh: 微流體「觸覺回饋手套」（Haptic Gloves），透過微型氣囊膨脹，模擬手握實體水杯時的物理阻力。

examples.en: Smartphone touchscreens deliver subtle haptic vibrations to confirm keystrokes when typing messages.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機觸控螢幕在打字輸入時提供細微的觸覺震動，確認每一次按鍵觸碰。

examples.en: Surgical training simulators integrate haptic motors so students can feel tissue resistance while cutting.
examples.zh: 手術培訓模擬器結合了觸覺反饋馬達，讓學員在切割過程中真切感受人體組織阻力。

entries.definition: 微流體氣壓式觸覺回饋手套 (摸到虛擬物體) 的

explains.en: A phone gives a small vibration when someone taps a button. The touch signal confirms that the action happened. The user can sometimes turn it off.
A game controller shakes when a car hits a wall on screen. The vibration makes the event feel more real. Designers adjust how strong it is.
A wearable device uses touch or pressure to send a message to the skin. It may help someone navigate without looking at a screen. The adjective refers to touch feedback.

examples.en: Surface electromyography detects microvolt electrical signals traveling from the brain to wrist muscles.
examples.zh: 表面「肌電圖技術」（Electromyography EMG），能在手腕處捕捉由大腦傳遞至手指肌肉的微伏特神經信號。

examples.en: Neurologists perform electromyography tests to diagnose nerve damage and neuromuscular disorders.
examples.zh: 神經科醫師透過肌電圖檢查來診斷神經損傷與神經肌肉病變疾患。

examples.en: Bionic prosthetic hands equipped with electromyography sensors respond instantly to muscle twitches.
examples.zh: 配備肌電感測器的仿生義肢手部，能對微弱的殘肢肌肉顫動做出即時敏捷反應。

entries.definition: 腕帶表面肌電圖 (EMG 讀取神經運動訊號)

explains.en: A medical test records electrical signals from muscles. A small sensor may be placed on the skin or a thin needle used. Doctors use results to study nerves and muscles.
The technician attached small sensors to the patient’s arm. The screen showed signals when he moved his hand. The doctor explained the test.
The shortened name is EMG. A health professional decides when it is needed. Ask them about preparation and what results mean.

examples.en: Balancing battery weight on the rear strap achieves optimal ergonomics, eliminating pressure on the nose bridge.
examples.zh: 將電池移至後方頭帶以達到完美前後配重，符合極致「人體工學設計」（Ergonomics），徹底解放鼻樑負擔。

examples.en: Office workers investing in lumbar chairs and standing desks reduce back fatigue through better ergonomics.
examples.zh: 上班族添購人體工學椅與升降辦公桌，藉由優良的人體工學改善腰背疲憊。

examples.en: The industrial tool manufacturer redesigned power drills based on hand and wrist ergonomics.
examples.zh: 該工業工具大廠根據手掌與手腕人體工學，重新改良了電動電鑽握把設計。

entries.definition: 前後配重平衡消除鼻樑壓迫之人體工學設計

explains.en: A headset is balanced so it does not press painfully on the bridge of the nose. Designers consider comfort and how people use the device. This field studies fitting tools to people.
A chair is adjusted to support the back during long hours of work. The design reduces strain. This area examines comfort, safety, and human movement.
