A product is shaped to fit the human body and make tasks easier. Designers test how weight and controls feel. This is the study of designing for people.

examples.en: Mixed reality enables architectural students to inspect a hollow skyscraper model standing on a living room rug.
examples.zh: 「混合實境」（Mixed Reality），讓建築系學生能圍繞著矗立在客廳地毯上的摩天大樓模型仔細剖析。

examples.en: The flight school deployed mixed reality trainers combining physical cockpit switches with digital views.
examples.zh: 飛行學院導入了結合實體駕駛開關與全景數位視野的混合實境訓練模擬艙。

examples.en: The retail store is testing mixed reality dressing mirrors that let shoppers try on coats digitally.
examples.zh: 這家服飾旗艦店正在測試混合實境試衣鏡，讓顧客無需穿脫即可數位試穿各款大衣外套。

entries.definition: 虛擬數位與真實世界天衣無縫結合之混合實境的

explains.en: A drink combines juice and water. The two liquids are blended together.
A student sees digital shapes placed over a real desk through special glasses. Both kinds of images appear at once.
This adjective means made from different things combined. It may also describe a technology that blends real and digital views.

examples.en: Medical surgeons rotate a floating 3D organ hologram in mid-air before commencing complex surgery.
examples.zh: 外科手術醫師在動刀前，在手術室半空中徒手旋轉病患器官的「3D 全像立體投影」（Hologram）。

examples.en: The pop star surprised thousands of concert fans by appearing as an interactive singing hologram.
examples.zh: 這位流行巨星以逼真互動式全像立體投影現身演唱會，讓現場上萬歌迷驚呼連連。

examples.en: Scientists displayed a detailed hologram of the solar system during an interactive youth lecture.
examples.zh: 科學家在青少年科普講座中，投影出細膩生動的太陽系立體全像圖解。

entries.definition: 懸浮在空中可徒手旋轉之 3D 全像立體投影

explains.en: A special image appears to have depth when viewed from the right angle. Light patterns create the effect. Some security labels use it.
A museum display shows a three-dimensional-looking picture that shifts as visitors move. The image seems to float in space. It is made with light.
A bank card has a shiny security picture that changes color when tilted. The effect is difficult to copy. It helps show that the card is genuine.

examples.en: Volumetric video captures live musical concerts, allowing viewers to walk around performers on stage.
examples.zh: 「容積動態攝影」（Volumetric Video），讓觀眾能自由走上舞台，從任意角度近距離觀看歌手的現場演出。

examples.en: Digital studios set up one hundred calibrated cameras in a green dome for volumetric actor capture.
examples.zh: 數位特效工作室在綠幕圓頂穹頂下架設百台校準相機，進行演員的容積立體動態捕捉。

examples.en: Doctors examine volumetric computed tomography scans to evaluate bone fracture healing progress.
examples.zh: 醫師檢視容積電腦斷層掃描成像，仔細評估複雜骨折部位的骨痂癒合生長進度。

entries.definition: 容積攝影 (百台相機 360 度捕捉真人動態) 的

explains.en: A picture or recording that shows depth and shape in three dimensions has this quality. Many cameras may capture a moving person from different angles. Viewers can look around the scene.
The studio used cameras placed in a circle to record the dancer. A computer built a three-dimensional image. Viewers could see it from different sides.
A measurement involving volume can also be described this way. Scientists calculate the space an object takes up. The meaning depends on the subject.

examples.en: High-resolution photogrammetry faithfully reconstructs historical ancient temples with sub-millimeter precision.
examples.zh: 高解析「實景照相測量技術」（Photogrammetry），以毫米級精準度在虛擬世界中永久保存歷史古蹟。

examples.en: Drone operators used drone photogrammetry to map coastal erosion following the tropical typhoon.
examples.zh: 空拍無人機飛手利用空拍照相測量技術，在強烈颱風侵襲後詳細繪製海岸線侵蝕地圖。

examples.en: Game artists rely on photogrammetry scans of real mossy cliffs to create breathtaking game wilderness.
examples.zh: 遊戲美術設計師仰賴真實苔蘚岩壁的照片建模掃描資料，打造出栩栩如生的遊戲野外場景。

entries.definition: 實景空拍百萬張照片 3D 照相測量建模

explains.en: A drone takes many overlapping pictures of a building from different angles. Software compares them to create a three-dimensional model. This method measures shapes from photographs.
Surveyors use hundreds of aerial images to map a hillside. The computer finds matching points in each picture. It builds a measurable 3D model.
A team photographs an ancient site from the air and uses software to calculate its shape. The images become a detailed model. This technique makes measurements from photographs.

examples.en: Spatial simulation training allows pilot trainees to master emergency engine failures in complete physical safety.
examples.zh: 空間「高擬真模擬訓練」（Simulation Training），讓實習飛行員能在絕對安全的環境下反覆演練引擎空中熄火。

examples.en: The company mandates annual cybersecurity awareness training for all new remote staff members.
examples.zh: 公司規定所有新進遠距工作同仁，每年皆必須完成例行的資安防護意識培訓課程。

examples.en: Endurance athletes maintain rigorous cardiovascular training schedules before entering the marathon.
examples.zh: 耐力型運動員在正式參加馬拉松大賽前，維持著極為嚴謹規律的心肺耐力訓練課表。

entries.definition: 外科心臟手術與太空航行零風險高擬真模擬訓練

explains.en: A new pilot practices emergency steps in a simulator before flying. Repeated practice builds skill.
A dog learns to follow simple commands through regular lessons and rewards. The sessions improve behavior.
This is the process of learning or teaching skills through practice. It can apply to people, animals, or computer systems.

examples.en: The thermal immersion circulator maintains water temperature within zero point one degree Celsius.
examples.zh: 數位高精度「恆溫水循環舒肥機」（Circulator），將水槽溫度嚴格鎖定在正負零點一度的極限誤差內。

examples.en: Commercial kitchens install heavy-duty water circulators to guarantee uniform cooking throughout large briskets.
examples.zh: 營業用廚房安裝營業級恆溫水流循環機，確保大塊牛胸肉通體受熱完全均勻。

examples.en: Clamp the compact immersion circulator to the side of any stockpot to begin precise sous-vide cooking.
examples.zh: 只要將輕巧的浸入式舒肥棒夾在任何湯鍋邊緣，便能立即展開精準的低溫烹調。

entries.definition: 數位高精度恆溫水循環低溫慢煮舒肥機

explains.en: A pump moves hot water through pipes and radiators in a building. It keeps the liquid moving around the system. A technician checks it if the heat is uneven.
A microwave device sends signals around a circuit in one direction. It keeps energy from returning to the source. Engineers use it in communication equipment.
A bus repeatedly travels around a set route, picking up passengers along the way. The vehicle makes a regular circuit. In engineering, the word can name a pump or signal part.

examples.en: Quick searing in a smoking-hot cast iron skillet produces a flavorful browned surface after sous-vide.
examples.zh: 舒肥完成後，在冒煙的極熱鑄鐵鍋中進行數十秒的快速「高溫香煎」（Searing），瞬間封住肉汁。

examples.en: Firefighters braved searing heat to rescue residents trapped on the burning apartment balcony.
examples.zh: 消防隊員冒著灼熱難耐的高溫烈火，奮勇救出受困在失火公寓陽台上的住戶。

examples.en: The investigative journalist published a searing critique exposing corporate financial fraud.
examples.zh: 調查記者發表了一篇言辭犀利深刻的嚴厲批判報導，揭露這起跨國企業金融詐欺弊案。

entries.definition: 鑄鐵鍋高溫瞬間梅納反應反向香煎封汁；灼熱的

explains.en: Cooking food quickly on very high heat can brown its outside. This action is often done before slow cooking. The noun can name the cooking step.
The chef placed the steak in a hot pan. Its surface browned quickly. She finished cooking it in the oven.
The adjective can describe intense heat or pain. The sun felt extremely hot at midday. The word can also mean burning.

examples.en: Spherification encapsulates fruit juices inside translucent gel spheres that burst playfully in the mouth.
examples.zh: 經典「球化成型技術」（Spherification），將鮮美果汁封裝進半透明晶球中，在舌尖帶來趣味爆漿體驗。

examples.en: Ferran Adrià pioneered basic spherification at El Bulli, revolutionizing modern dessert presentations.
examples.zh: 廚藝傳奇名廚費蘭·阿德里亞在鬥牛犬餐廳首創基礎球化技術，徹底顛覆了現代餐點風貌。

examples.en: Mastering direct spherification requires precise measurement of acidity and calcium bath concentration.
examples.zh: 熟練掌握直接球化成型技術，必須精確調控果汁酸鹼度與凝膠鈣化水槽濃度。

entries.definition: 海藻酸鈉直接球化成型技術 (人工魚子醬)

explains.en: A cook drops flavored liquid into a bath that forms a thin skin around each drop. The result looks like tiny caviar. This modern cooking method creates edible spheres.
A chef uses a seaweed-based ingredient to turn juice into small round beads. They burst when bitten. This technique changes liquid into soft spheres.
Fruit liquid is shaped into little balls with a delicate outer layer. They can decorate a dessert or savory dish. This process is used in modern cuisine.

examples.en: Dissolving food-grade sodium alginate into puree creates a viscous liquid ready for calcium bath drops.
examples.zh: 將天然褐藻提煉的「海藻酸鈉」（Sodium Alginate）均勻溶於果泥中，即可滴入鈣離子水浴展開反應。

examples.en: Dentists use seaweed-derived alginate impressions to create exact molds of orthodontic patients' teeth.
examples.zh: 牙醫診所利用褐藻海藻酸鈉印模材，為齒列矯正患者精準壓印出全口牙齒模型。

examples.en: Medical manufacturers produce sterile alginate dressings to accelerate wound healing and moisture retention.
examples.zh: 醫療衛材廠商生產無菌海藻酸鹽敷料，以加速患處傷口肉芽生長並長效鎖住濕潤環境。

entries.definition: 褐藻提取之天然無味海藻酸鈉水溶性膠體

explains.en: A cook mixes a seaweed-based powder into fruit juice to make tiny gel spheres. The spheres keep their shape.
A dentist uses a soft material to take an impression of a patient’s teeth. The material comes from algae.
This substance comes from brown seaweed and can thicken or form gels. It is used in food and medical products.

examples.en: The microscopic gel membrane is imperceptibly thin, melting away with zero rubbery chewiness.
examples.zh: 包裹液體的「微米級凝膠薄膜」（Membrane）薄如蟬翼，在口中瞬間化開，毫無橡膠般的韌澀咀嚼感。

examples.en: Biological cells regulate nutrient and waste exchange through a selectively permeable lipid membrane.
examples.zh: 生物活細胞透過具有選擇通透性的雙層脂質細胞膜，嚴密調控營養物質與代謝廢物的進出。

examples.en: High-tech waterproof trekking jackets feature a breathable Gore-Tex membrane to repel driving rain.
examples.zh: 高階防水登山防風外套採用高透氣薄膜技術，兼具卓越防水性能與優良排汗透氣感。

examples.en: The solid polymer electrolyte membrane allows positively charged protons to pass while blocking gas crossover.
examples.zh: 固態聚合物「質子傳導膜」（Membrane），讓帶正電的質子順暢穿透，同時百分之百阻隔氣體混合。

examples.en: Desalination plants use semi-permeable reverse osmosis membrane filters to purify seawater into drinking water.
examples.zh: 濱海大型海水淡化廠利用孔徑極細的半透性逆滲透膜濾心，將苦澀海水過濾為甘甜純淨的民生飲用水。

examples.en: A waterproof Gore-Tex membrane inside hiking boots keeps feet dry while allowing internal sweat to evaporate.
examples.zh: 專業高筒登山鞋內嵌的防水透氣薄膜，能在抵禦涉水雨水侵入的同時迅速排出腳掌汗氣。

entries.definition: 包裹晶瑩果汁之微米級極薄半透彈性凝膠膜；薄膜；全氟磺酸固態聚合物電解質質子傳導膜

explains.en: A thin layer separates two areas while allowing some materials to pass through. Cells use such layers to control what enters and leaves. It can be flexible.
A waterproof sheet keeps rain out of a roof while letting some vapor escape. Builders place it under tiles. The layer protects the structure.
A tiny layer inside the ear vibrates when sound reaches it. The movement helps people hear. The word is used for many thin barriers in nature and technology.

examples.en: Chefs pour smoking liquid nitrogen tableside to freeze herbal olive oil creams into crunchy pearls.
examples.zh: 主廚在餐桌旁緩緩傾倒翻騰白煙的「液態氮」（Liquid Nitrogen），將羅勒橄欖油慕斯瞬間凍成香脆珍珠。

examples.en: Nitrogen makes up roughly seventy-eight percent of the air we breathe in Earth's atmosphere.
examples.zh: 在地球的大氣層中，氮氣大約佔據了人類呼吸空氣總體積的百分之七十八。

examples.en: Farmers apply balanced nitrogen fertilizers to stimulate lush vegetative growth in green tea plantations.
examples.zh: 專業茶農施用均衡配方的氮肥，藉以促進高山茶園茶樹枝繁葉茂、嫩芽勃發。

entries.definition: 零下 196 度超低溫液態氮瞬間極速急凍；氮

explains.en: A gas makes up most of the air around Earth. Plants need it to grow, but they cannot use it directly from the air. It is also found in soil.
The class learned that most of the air is made of this gas. They looked at a chart of the atmosphere. Plants also need it.
In liquid form, it is extremely cold and can freeze things quickly. Trained adults use it with protective gear. It must never be handled casually.

examples.en: Flash freezing at minus 196 degrees prevents cellular damage, preserving pristine herbaceous aromatics.
examples.zh: 零下 196 度的「極速急凍技術」（Flash Freezing），能防止植物細胞膜破裂，完整鎖住新鮮香草的芳香。

examples.en: Mountain hikers bundled up in thermal woolens as the temperature dropped below freezing on the peak.
examples.zh: 隨著主峰氣溫驟降至冰點以下，高山登山客紛紛裹緊保暖羊毛衣物抵禦嚴寒。

examples.en: Commercial fishing trawlers rely on deep freezing chambers to preserve fresh tuna catches during sea voyages.
examples.zh: 遠洋商業漁船仰賴船載深層急凍冷凍庫，在漫長的遠洋作業途中妥善保存現撈黑鮪魚。

entries.definition: 液態氮極速急凍 (完整鎖住食材鮮甜與香氣)；冰凍的

explains.en: A cook uses extremely cold liquid nitrogen to freeze a dessert quickly. The fast cooling helps keep a smooth texture. This is a rapid way to turn liquid into solid.
Food is chilled very quickly so its flavor and texture stay fresh. Tiny ice crystals form when the temperature drops. This process makes a liquid or food solid with cold.
A chef pours a cold mixture into a special machine and it hardens. The temperature falls below the point where water stays liquid. This is the process of becoming frozen.

examples.en: Pressurizing purees inside a stainless steel cream siphon produces warm, velvety vegetable mousses.
examples.zh: 在不銹鋼「高壓發泡虹吸槍」（Siphon）中注入氧化亞氮氣體，能擠出溫熱細緻、如絲絨般的根芹慕斯。

examples.en: The mechanic used a clear plastic tube to siphon gasoline safely from the old tractor fuel tank.
examples.zh: 技師使用透明塑膠軟管，將老舊農用牽引機油箱裡的殘油安全虹吸抽引出來。

examples.en: Traditional coffee houses brew aromatic morning blends using an elegant glass vacuum siphon pot.
examples.zh: 傳統精緻咖啡館常使用優雅剔透的玻璃雙球真空虹吸壺，手工萃取出香氣馥郁的單品咖啡。

entries.definition: 高壓一氧化二氮充氣虹吸發泡槍；虹吸管

explains.en: Water flows through a bent tube from a higher container into a lower one. The movement continues once started.
A cook uses a pressurized bottle to add foam to a dessert. Gas pushes the liquid through a nozzle.
This tube or device moves liquid using pressure and gravity. The verb means to draw liquid through such a tube.

examples.en: Ultrasonic homogenizers create a silky emulsion of browned butter and fresh yuzu juice.
examples.zh: 超音波均質機將焦化奶油與新鮮柚子汁打成「奈米級安定乳化醬汁」（Emulsion），質地極致絲滑且絕不分層。

examples.en: Mayonnaise is a classic culinary emulsion formed by whisking oil into egg yolk and lemon juice.
examples.zh: 美乃滋是烹飪史上最經典的乳化醬汁之一，由沙拉油慢慢打發融入蛋黃與檸檬汁而成。

examples.en: The dermatologist formulated a soothing hydrating emulsion designed for extremely dry sensitive skin.
examples.zh: 皮膚科醫師研發了一款溫和舒緩的長效保濕乳液，專為極度乾燥敏感的肌膚設計。

entries.definition: 安定不油水分離之奈米級細緻均質乳化醬汁

explains.en: Oil and water are mixed into tiny droplets that stay spread through a liquid. Salad dressing may need shaking before use. Cream is another familiar example.
A photographer uses a light-sensitive coating on film to capture an image. The chemicals form a thin layer. Light changes it during exposure.
A cook slowly adds oil to egg yolk while whisking. The mixture becomes smooth and creamy. The liquid contains tiny droplets held together.

examples.en: Natural plant emulsifiers bond lipid and water molecules tightly, creating smooth hollandaise sauces.
examples.zh: 天然植物「乳化劑」（Emulsifier），將油脂與水分子緊密鍵結，調製出細膩滑順且久置不析出的荷蘭醬。

examples.en: Ice cream manufacturers incorporate food emulsifiers to maintain smooth consistency during cold storage.
examples.zh: 冰淇淋食品大廠添加天然食品乳化劑，以維持產品在低溫冷凍儲運期間滑順均勻的質地。

examples.en: Without an effective emulsifier, oil and vinegar dressings quickly separate into distinct liquid layers.
examples.zh: 若缺乏合適的乳化助劑，油醋醬在靜置數分鐘後便會迅速分層拆解為油水兩層。

entries.definition: 天然大豆卵磷脂界面活性天然乳化劑

explains.en: An ingredient helps oil and water stay mixed instead of separating. It is used in foods such as sauces and ice cream. Some are made from plants.
The cook added a small ingredient to the dressing and shook the jar. The oil and vinegar stayed mixed longer. The salad tasted smooth.
A mixer can help ingredients blend, but this substance keeps them together. Food labels may list it. Different recipes use different kinds.

examples.en: A tiny pinch of sunflower lecithin allows chefs to whip aromatic carrot juice into stable air bubbles.
examples.zh: 僅需加入一小撮「向日葵卵磷脂」（Lecithin），就能用手持攪拌棒將胡蘿蔔汁打發成綿密持久的橘紅泡沫。

examples.en: Chocolate makers blend soy lecithin into molten cocoa to lower viscosity and achieve glossy sheen.
examples.zh: 巧克力工坊在融化的可可漿中混入大豆卵磷脂，以降低稠度並賦予巧克力絲綢般的亮麗光澤。

examples.en: Health stores sell soy lecithin granules as dietary supplements to support healthy brain function.
examples.zh: 保健食品專賣店陳列販售大豆卵磷脂顆粒，作為維護思緒靈活與日常營養補給的膳食補充品。

entries.definition: 富含磷脂質之天然大豆與向日葵卵磷脂

explains.en: This natural substance is found in soybeans and sunflower seeds. It helps oil and water mix smoothly in foods. It is a kind of fat-like nutrient.
A baker adds a seed-derived ingredient to chocolate so it stays smooth. The substance helps blend fats and liquids. It is also present in egg yolks.
Food makers use this phospholipid from plants to keep mixtures from separating. It can come from soy or sunflower. This natural emulsifier is called this.

examples.en: Modern chefs use natural hydrocolloids to modify sauce viscosity without altering pure ingredient flavors.
examples.zh: 現代名廚善用天然「親水膠體」（Hydrocolloids），在完全不稀釋食材原味的前提下隨心所欲調整醬汁濃稠度。

examples.en: Food scientists explore seaweed hydrocolloids as biodegradable packaging alternatives to petroleum plastic.
examples.zh: 食品科學家積極研究海洋紅藻親水膠體，期望開發出能取代傳統石油塑料的生物可分解包裝包材。

examples.en: Hydrocolloids like pectin and locust bean gum stabilize commercial fruit fillings during baking.
examples.zh: 果膠與刺槐豆膠等天然親水膠體，能在高溫烘烤過程中穩定水果派餡料的稠度與形態。

entries.definition: 三仙膠與寒天等天然植物水溶性親水膠體

explains.en: A food scientist adds a thickener to soup so it stays smooth. The ingredient changes the texture.
A gel dressing keeps a wound moist while protecting it. Its material holds water.
This substance forms a gel or thick mixture when combined with water. It is used in foods and medical products.

examples.en: Xanthan gum suspends herbs evenly throughout vinaigrettes without imparting heavy floury thickness.
examples.zh: 少量「三仙膠」（Xanthan Gum）能讓香草碎粒均勻懸浮在油醋汁中，同時保持清爽如水的純淨流動感。

examples.en: Gluten-free bakeries rely on xanthan gum to provide structural elasticity usually supplied by wheat gluten.
examples.zh: 無麩質專業烘焙坊極度仰賴三仙膠，以取代小麥麵筋在麵團發酵中扮演的結構支撐與彈性。

examples.en: Only half a gram of xanthan powder is required to thicken an entire liter of savory gravy.
examples.zh: 僅需微量的半公克三仙膠粉末，就能恰到好處地增稠整整一公升的美味烤肉原汁肉汁。

entries.definition: 三仙膠黃原膠 (提供高剪切稀化極佳流動感)

explains.en: A powder made by bacteria is added to sauces to make them thicker. Only a small amount is needed. It can help keep ingredients mixed.
A cook stirs this food additive into salad dressing so it does not separate quickly. It works in hot or cold recipes. The label lists it among the ingredients.
A gluten-free baker adds a little thickening gum to dough. It helps the bread hold together. Too much can make the texture sticky.

examples.en: Red seaweed agar-agar sets into firm, crystal-clear jellies that stay solid even when served hot.
examples.zh: 萃取自天然紅藻的「瓊脂洋菜膠」（Agar-Agar），能凝結成耐熱八十度的透明晶凍，熱食依然保持固態。

examples.en: Microbiologists pour sterilized agar solution into Petri dishes to cultivate bacterial colonies.
examples.zh: 微生物學家在無菌培養皿中倒入滅菌瓊脂培養基溶液，作為培養細菌菌落的基底。

examples.en: Traditional Asian confectionery shops prepare sweet red bean jelly using natural boiled agar strips.
examples.zh: 傳統日式和菓子老舖使用天然水煮洋菜條，手工熬製凝固口感緊實甘甜的紅豆羊羹。

entries.definition: 耐高溫攝氏八十度不融化之天然紅藻瓊脂洋菜膠

explains.en: A jelly-like substance from seaweed can make food set or help grow microbes in a lab. It stays firm at warm temperatures. It is often used instead of gelatin.
The cook mixed a powder from seaweed into fruit juice. It cooled into a clear jelly. The children ate it after lunch.
Scientists pour a prepared gel into flat dishes to grow tiny organisms. The gel gives them a surface and nutrients. Lab workers follow clean procedures.

examples.en: Gelification techniques transform concentrated beef broth into translucent, flexible savory noodles.
examples.zh: 精湛的「凝膠塑型工藝」（Gelification），將濃郁牛肉清湯轉化為一根根半透明、具彈性的鹹香分子麵條。

examples.en: Rapid gelification occurs as soon as the warm agar mixture cools below forty degrees Celsius.
examples.zh: 一旦溫熱的瓊脂混合液降溫至攝氏四十度以下，便會立即發生迅速的凝膠化固化反應。

examples.en: Modern pastry chefs apply sheet gelification to create delicate fruit films wrapped around mousse cakes.
examples.zh: 現代法式甜點主廚善用薄片凝膠工藝，製作出薄如蟬翼的水果凝凍軟片包裹在慕斯蛋糕外層。

entries.definition: 精準溫控之流體凝膠化與分子麵條塑型工藝

explains.en: A chef carefully changes a liquid into a soft gel by controlling its temperature and ingredients. The result can be shaped like a noodle. This is a modern food technique.
A cook uses a gelling agent to turn a sauce into a firm but soft texture. Careful heat control matters. This process forms a gel.
A liquid becomes a gel when its molecules form a soft network. Chefs can use the change to create new textures. This technique is part of molecular cooking.

examples.en: Freeze-thaw agar clarification strips cloudiness, producing a broth clear as spring water yet bursting with flavor.
examples.zh: 冷凍融解「瓊脂澄清技術」（Clarification），濾除所有微小懸浮濁質，滴出如山泉般透明卻鮮味爆棚的清高湯。

examples.en: The spokesperson issued a public clarification to correct misunderstandings regarding the company's fiscal report.
examples.zh: 發言人發表了一份公開聲明澄清啟事，以導正大眾對於公司年度財務財報數據的各項誤解。

examples.en: Water treatment plants use sand filtration and chemical clarification to produce potable municipal tap water.
examples.zh: 自來水淨水廠透過石英砂過濾與化學混凝澄清製程，將原水淨化為符合國家安全標準的飲用水。

entries.definition: 高速離心與冷凍融解之水晶晶瑩清高湯澄清技術

explains.en: A cook filters a cloudy broth until it becomes clear. Small particles are removed.
A teacher gives another example after students say the directions were confusing. The extra explanation makes the task clearer.
This is an explanation or process that makes something easier to understand. It can also mean making a liquid clear.

examples.en: The crystalline tomato consommé arrived glowing like melted gold in a delicate porcelain cup.
examples.zh: 晶瑩剔透的「法式番茄澄清高湯」（Consommé），盛裝在精緻骨瓷杯中，在燈光下泛著如融化黃金般的光芒。

examples.en: Classical French culinary apprentices spend months perfecting clarified beef consommé using egg white rafts.
examples.zh: 傳統法餐學徒必須花費數月苦練，才能純熟掌握利用蛋白餅吸附雜質、澄清牛肉清湯的真功夫。

examples.en: Chilled consommé with diced summer vegetables makes an exceptionally refreshing first course in July.
examples.zh: 冰鎮法式澄清清湯搭配切碎的鮮甜夏令時蔬，在盛夏七月是一道無比開胃清爽的開胃頭盤。

entries.definition: 如琥珀般晶瑩剔透、滴油不沾之法式澄清湯

explains.en: A cook simmers meat and vegetables to make a clear, flavorful soup. The liquid is strained until it looks bright. It is often served in a small bowl.
A restaurant serves a light golden broth before the main meal. It has a rich taste without solid pieces. Careful preparation makes it clear.
A chef slowly clarifies a stock so that bits are removed. The finished soup is transparent and delicate. It may be served warm.

examples.en: The rotary evaporator distills eucalyptus leaves under vacuum, isolating delicate volatile fragrance.
examples.zh: 「旋轉真空蒸發儀」（Rotary Evaporator），在低溫真空下溫和蒸餾尤加利葉，完美萃取出純淨芬芳精華。

examples.en: Traffic flowed smoothly through the newly constructed four-lane rotary intersection outside the terminal.
examples.zh: 航廈外圍新建的四線道圓環樞紐通車後，尖峰時刻的車流運轉十分順暢無阻。

examples.en: Rotary drilling rigs bore deep into geothermal bedrock to harvest subterranean steam power.
examples.zh: 旋轉鑽井機具一路深鑽進地熱硬岩基岩中，藉以汲取深層地下豐富的高溫地熱蒸汽能源。

entries.definition: 旋轉真空減壓蒸餾濃縮儀 (低溫萃取植物香氣) 的

explains.en: A machine or object that turns around a center is described this way. A fan moves its blades in a circle. Some road junctions have a roundabout.
The lab tool spun a small bottle while removing liquid from it. The motion helped separate the mixture. The scientist wore safety glasses.
The word can describe a turning device or movement. A wheel is one example. A circular junction is another.

examples.en: Operating the flash evaporator at room temperature prevents heat from destroying fresh pine aromas.
examples.zh: 在室溫下操作真空「旋轉蒸發器」（Evaporator），能徹底防止高溫破壞新鮮松針中嬌嫩的揮發性芬多精。

examples.en: Technicians checked the evaporator coil on the industrial chiller to ensure optimal refrigeration performance.
examples.zh: 技師仔細檢查大型工業冷凍冰水主機的蒸發器盤管，以確保全場最佳的冷卻製冷效能。

examples.en: Sugar refinery plants boil cane juice in a multi-stage steam evaporator to crystallize molasses.
examples.zh: 現代製糖精煉廠在多級蒸汽蒸發濃縮槽中熬煮甘蔗汁，使糖漿逐步濃縮並析出晶瑩糖晶。

entries.definition: 廚房實驗室旋轉蒸發器 (分離純化清澈芳香液體)

explains.en: A chef places liquid in a spinning glass flask while lowering the air pressure. The liquid turns to vapor at a lower temperature. This machine can separate a clear, fragrant extract.
A laboratory device rotates a flask in a warm bath and removes vapor with a cooling tube. It helps purify liquids without overheating them. This is used in kitchens and labs.
A cook wants to remove water from a mixture while keeping delicate flavors. A turning chamber and vacuum help the liquid evaporate gently. This machine performs the task.

examples.en: The eighteen-course sensory tasting menu takes guests on a theatrical culinary journey through the seasons.
examples.zh: 長達十八道菜的「主廚感官品嚐套餐」（Tasting Menu），帶領食客展開一場穿越四季的味覺沉浸式劇場。

examples.en: The boutique winery invited club members to an exclusive cellar tasting of unreleased vintage reserves.
examples.zh: 精品精品酒莊熱情邀請尊榮會員深入地窖，專屬品鑑尚未正式公開上市的珍藏年份限量紅酒。

examples.en: Olive oil tasting requires slurping warm oil off a spoon to coat the tongue and evaluate peppery pungency.
examples.zh: 品鑑特級初榨橄欖油時需要用湯匙吸啜溫熱油液，讓油膜均勻包覆舌面以評估其微辛與果香。

entries.definition: 結合視覺、聽覺與嗅覺之主廚多道盲測試吃盛宴；品嚐

explains.en: A chef offers small bites so guests can compare several cheeses. Each sample has a different flavor.
A person carefully tries a new soup and notices its saltiness and texture. They pay attention to the food.
This is the act of trying food or drink to judge its flavor. It can also describe a small sample menu.

examples.en: Chefs use surgical tweezers for precision plating, placing single micro-greens onto delicate pastry tarts.
examples.zh: 廚師手持精密料理鑷子進行極致講究的「精緻擺盤」（Plating），將微型幼苗一片片點綴在精巧塔皮上。

examples.en: The vintage silver teapot required fresh electro-plating to restore its mirror-like antique luster.
examples.zh: 這只具備百年歷史的古董純銀茶壺需要重新進行精細電鍍，以徹底重現其溫潤如鏡的光澤。

examples.en: Modern restaurants invest in custom ceramic dishware specifically designed to showcase creative plating.
examples.zh: 當代前衛餐廳不惜重金向陶藝名家訂製手工陶盤，專門用以完美烘托主廚獨創的擺盤構圖。

entries.definition: 料理鑷子精準點綴食用金箔與三色堇擺盤工藝

explains.en: A watchmaker decorates a metal surface with a very thin layer of another metal. The coating can change its color or protect it. The layer may wear away.
A cook arranges food neatly on a plate before serving it. Colors and portions are balanced. The presentation can make a meal inviting.
An engineer covers a part with a thin metal layer using an electrical process. The coating can reduce rust. Its thickness is checked.

examples.en: Tasting the caramelized roasted fig paired with goat cheese foam triggered pure sensory ecstasy.
examples.zh: 嚐到焦糖烤無花果搭配溫羊乳酪泡沫的瞬間，口腔中爆發出令靈魂震撼昇華的「純粹感官狂喜」（Ecstasy）。

examples.en: The stadium erupted in ecstatic cheering when the underdog striker scored the winning goal in stoppage time.
examples.zh: 當不被看好的黑馬前鋒在傷停補時最後一分鐘踢進致勝球時，整座十萬人體育場爆發出近乎瘋狂的狂喜歡呼。

examples.en: Listening to the live philharmonic performance of Beethoven's Ninth Symphony brought tears of joyful ecstasy.
examples.zh: 現場親耳聆聽愛樂管弦樂團現場演奏貝多芬第九號交響曲，那種澎湃崇高的音樂美感令人感動到淚流滿面。

entries.definition: 入口瞬間靈魂昇華、淚光閃爍之純粹感官狂喜

explains.en: A feeling of great joy or excitement is this. People may feel it after wonderful news. It can be overwhelming.
The team scored in the final seconds. Fans cheered and jumped with joy. The players hugged one another.
The word may also describe an intense feeling of delight. A beautiful song moved the listener deeply. It is stronger than ordinary happiness.

examples.en: Hot mineral ions precipitate immediately upon contacting four-degree seawater, forming dark clouds.
examples.zh: 滾燙金屬離子在接觸攝氏四度冰冷海水的瞬間「化學沉澱結晶」（Precipitate），化為滾滾黑煙。

examples.en: The unexpected resignation of the prime minister threatened to precipitate a constitutional government crisis.
examples.zh: 內閣總理無預警請辭下台，恐將直接引發一場席捲政壇的憲政危機。

examples.en: White calcium carbonate precipitate formed at the bottom of the beaker after adding the test reagent.
examples.zh: 滴入檢驗試劑後，燒杯底部迅速凝結生成了一層厚厚的白色碳酸鈣化學沉澱物。

entries.definition: 金屬離子遇冰冷海水瞬間沉澱結晶；沉澱物

explains.en: When two dissolved chemicals meet, they may form a solid that sinks out of the liquid. The solid can collect at the bottom. This is a chemical change.
A metal in ocean water meets a very cold liquid and forms tiny crystals. The particles settle onto the seafloor. This verb describes a solid forming from a solution.
Chemists mix two clear liquids and wait. Tiny solid pieces appear and sink. This solid forms when dissolved substances react.

examples.en: Specialized bacteria oxidize toxic hydrogen sulfur gas to produce organic sugars for host tubeworms.
examples.zh: 特化深海古菌氧化有毒「硫化氫」（Sulfur），將化學能量轉化為有機養分供應宿主管蟲吸收。

examples.en: Yellow brimstone deposits of bright elemental sulfur encrust the rocky rims of active volcanic craters.
examples.zh: 鮮黃色的單質天然硫磺沉積物，層層包裹覆蓋在活火山火山口的險峻岩石邊緣。

examples.en: Match heads and gunpowder formulas have historically relied on powdered sulfur as a key igniting ingredient.
examples.zh: 在歷史上，火柴頭引火藥與傳統黑火藥配方皆高度仰賴純硫磺粉作為核心起火成分。

entries.definition: 滋養深海古菌群落之劇毒硫化氫氣體；硫磺

explains.en: A yellow mineral has a strong smell when it burns. The element is found in nature.
Volcanoes release a gas containing a yellow nonmetal element. It is also used to make some materials.
This chemical element is yellow and occurs in minerals and gases. It has the symbol S.

examples.en: The potato-sized nodules contain high concentrations of valuable manganese, nickel, and copper.
examples.zh: 這些馬鈴薯大小的結核蘊藏著高濃度的「錳金屬」（Manganese）、鎳與銅，具有龐大戰略價值。

examples.en: Metallurgists add manganese to molten iron to remove impurities and increase structural steel hardness.
examples.zh: 鋼鐵冶煉師在鐵水中加入錳元素以去除雜質，並大幅增強結構用鋼材的硬度與抗拉耐磨度。

examples.en: Dietary manganese is an essential trace mineral required for bone formation and metabolic enzyme activity.
examples.zh: 飲食中的微量元素錳是人體骨骼生長與關鍵代謝酵素正常運作不可或缺的必需礦物質。

entries.definition: 鋼鐵工業與電動車電池關鍵戰略金屬錳

explains.en: This metal is added to steel to make it stronger and more useful. It is also found in some batteries. Workers handle its dust carefully.
A mineral in soil helps plants grow when present in small amounts. Too much can be harmful. Farmers may test the ground.
A scientist measures a gray metal in a rock sample. It can occur in minerals and is used in manufacturing. The body needs only a little of it.

examples.en: Seafloor crusts contain more cobalt than all terrestrial mining reserves on the continents combined.
examples.zh: 海底富鈷結殼中所蘊藏的「鈷金屬」（Cobalt），甚至超過了全球陸地所有已知礦藏的總和。

examples.en: Cobalt blue pigments have been prized by porcelain artists for centuries to create vivid ceramic glazes.
examples.zh: 數百年來，濃郁深邃的鈷藍色顏料備受陶藝大師青睞，用以燒製色澤飽滿生動的青花瓷釉。

examples.en: Battery engineers are researching cathodes with lower cobalt content to reduce supply chain dependency.
examples.zh: 動力電池研發工程師積極開發低鈷正極材料配方，藉此降低對地緣政治礦產供應鏈的過度依賴。

entries.definition: 支撐全球潔淨能源電池轉型之深海稀缺鈷金屬

explains.en: A hard metal is used in some batteries and blue paints. It is found in rocks and must be mined. It can be valuable.
The artist mixed a bright blue pigment into her paint. It came from a mineral containing a certain metal. The color stood out.
Some rechargeable batteries use this material. Recycling helps recover it. Mining can affect the environment, so careful sourcing matters.

examples.en: Underwater currents colliding with extinct volcanic seamounts drive nutrient-rich upwellings that sustain corals.
examples.zh: 深海洋流撞擊海底「熄滅火山海山」（Seamount），引發強勁湧升流，滋養著綿延千里的深海珊瑚林。

examples.en: An isolated seamount serves as an essential navigational feeding station for migrating pelagic sharks and whales.
examples.zh: 孤立挺立的深海海山，是遠洋巡游的鯊魚與大型鯨豚遷徙途中極為重要的覓食補給站。

examples.en: Sonar exploration located a newly identified seamount rising three thousand meters above the ocean basin floor.
examples.zh: 聲納探測在深海盆地海床上，精準定位出一座高聳三千公尺的新發現巨型海底海山。

entries.definition: 聳立於深海中孕育萬千生命之海底海山

explains.en: A mountain rises from the ocean floor but does not reach the surface. Many fish and corals can live around its slopes. It forms an underwater habitat.
Researchers map a tall peak hidden beneath deep water. Currents bring nutrients to the area, attracting sea life. This mountain sits on the seabed.
A large underwater hill can rise thousands of meters from the ocean floor. It remains covered by water. Scientists often explore its rich ecosystem.

examples.en: Robotic heavy seabed crawlers vacuum up nodule rocks while driving across the delicate ocean floor.
examples.zh: 重達百噸的「全自動深海採礦機器人」（Crawler），在脆弱海床履帶行駛並高壓真空吸取錳結核。

examples.en: Search engine crawlers continuously index billions of web pages to ensure updated online query results.
examples.zh: 搜尋引擎網路爬蟲機器人日夜不息地檢索索引數十億個網頁，確保線上查詢結果即時最新。

examples.en: The baby has become an enthusiastic crawler, exploring every corner of the carpeted living room.
examples.zh: 小嬰兒最近學會了興致勃勃地爬行，開心地探索著鋪有地毯的客廳每一個角落。

entries.definition: 重達百噸履帶式深海全自動採礦機器人；爬行者

explains.en: A robot with tracks moves slowly across the ocean floor to collect samples. Its body can cross rough ground.
A small software program visits web pages to gather information. It follows links automatically.
This can mean a machine or program that moves through an area or network. A tracked vehicle is one example.

examples.en: Heavy collection machinery compacts the soft, powdery abyssal sediment that took millions of years to accumulate.
examples.zh: 沉重的採礦機具壓實了沉睡數百萬年、質地如粉末般細緻的「深海平原沉積物」（Sediment）。

examples.en: Decanting the vintage red wine carefully prevents natural bitter sediment from pouring into the glass.
examples.zh: 謹慎地為老酒進行醒酒換瓶，能防止陳年過程中析出的天然苦澀酒石酸沉澱物倒入酒杯中。

examples.en: River dams trap nutrient-rich river sediment, depriving coastal deltas of vital replenishment soil.
examples.zh: 河道攔河水壩阻擋了富含有機質的河流泥沙沉積物，導致下游沿海三角洲失去泥土補充來源。

entries.definition: 採礦機履帶擾動沉睡萬年之深海細軟沉積物

explains.en: Sand, mud, or tiny bits settle at the bottom of water. Over time, layers can form rock. Rivers carry this material toward the sea.
A glass of muddy water sits still until particles collect at the bottom. The clearer liquid stays above. Filters can remove more of them.
A river slows as it reaches a lake and drops soil it was carrying. Plants may grow on the new land. The settled material is called this.

examples.en: Discharge pipes create artificial turbidity plumes that block light and disorient midwater bioluminescent creatures.
examples.zh: 採礦尾水管道噴出濃密泥漿，形成長達數十公里的「深海混濁濁流」（Turbidity Plume），阻礙發光生物。

examples.en: Heavy rainfall caused extreme water turbidity in the reservoir, prompting temporary drinking water boil advisories.
examples.zh: 暴雨沖刷導致水庫原水混濁度飆高，自來水公司緊急呼籲民眾飲水前務必徹底煮沸。

examples.en: Water treatment engineers measure nephelometric turbidity units to evaluate municipal filtration efficiency.
examples.zh: 自來水廠工程師嚴密測量水質混濁度指數，以精準評估各水槽沉澱過濾系統的淨水效率。

entries.definition: 採礦尾水懸浮排放引發之深海大面積混濁濁流

explains.en: How cloudy water is because of tiny particles is this measure. Mud or algae can make it high. Water workers test it.
After the storm, the river looked brown and cloudy. The town checked the water before treating it. People waited for an update.
Clear water lets more light pass through. Fine soil, pollution, or tiny organisms can make water less clear. The level changes over time.

examples.en: Scientists worry that settling dust clouds will cause deadly smothering of filter-feeding glass sponges.
examples.zh: 生態學家深切擔憂，擴散漂移的沉積泥沙雲沉降後會造成濾食性玻璃海綿「窒息掩埋致死」（Smothering）。

examples.en: Firefighters threw a thick fire blanket over the grease stove flare-up, smothering the flames instantly.
examples.zh: 消防員將厚實的專用防火毯迅速蓋上失火的廚房油鍋，瞬間阻絕空氣撲滅火勢。

examples.en: Overprotective parenting can feel smothering to teenagers seeking independence and self-identity.
examples.zh: 過度保護的直升機式教養方式，往往會讓渴望獨立自主與個人認同的青少年感到喘不過氣。

entries.definition: 嚴防深海懸浮泥沙沉降掩埋窒息深海海綿；窒息

explains.en: Fine mud can settle onto a deep-sea sponge and cover its surface. The animal may struggle to filter water. This choking effect harms life on the seabed.
A plume of underwater sediment falls over delicate animals and blocks their feeding areas. The layer can make it hard for them to breathe or function. This harmful covering effect is described here.
If too much dust covers an ocean sponge, water cannot pass through its body easily. The animal may be buried. This noun describes the suffocating effect.

examples.en: Nations debate draft regulations before approving full-scale commercial seafloor exploitation.
examples.zh: 各國代表在聯合國大會激烈辯論環保法規，審慎評估是否放行全面性的「深海商業開採」（Exploitation）。

examples.en: Labor unions advocate strict statutory laws to eliminate the unfair exploitation of factory migrant workers.
examples.zh: 勞工權益工會大聲疾呼推動嚴格專法修法，誓言根除工廠外籍移工遭受不當剝削的陋習。

examples.en: Unchecked exploitation of virgin forests leads to irreversible biodiversity loss and landslides.
examples.zh: 毫無節制地濫伐原始珍貴森林，勢必將引發無可挽回的物種滅絕浩劫與致命山崩土石流。

entries.definition: 嚴格規範公海海底礦產商業開採活動；開採

explains.en: A company takes too much from a forest without protecting the habitat. Local people may be harmed.
A worker is forced to work unfairly for someone else’s benefit. Authorities investigate the abuse.
This is unfair use of people, animals, or resources for gain. It can also mean making practical use of something.

examples.en: Dozens of countries advocate an immediate precautionary moratorium on deep seabed mining.
examples.zh: 數十個沿海國家與科學機構連署倡議，呼籲全球立即對深海採礦實施「預防性暫停令」（Moratorium）。

examples.en: The city council enacted a five-year moratorium on new hotel construction to ease traffic gridlock.
examples.zh: 市議會表決通過對新建觀光飯店實施為期五年的暫緩興建凍結令，以舒緩市中心嚴重的交通瓶頸。

examples.en: Financial institutions announced a temporary loan repayment moratorium for flood disaster victims.
examples.zh: 銀行公會緊急宣布針對南部暴雨洪澇受災戶，提供房貸與信用貸款暫緩還本息的紓困措施。

entries.definition: 全球環保團體與多國連署呼籲暫停深海採礦；暫停

explains.en: A government pauses certain activities for a set time. The break lets people review the rules. It may later be renewed or ended.
A city temporarily stops approving new building plans in one area. Officials study traffic and water needs. The pause gives them time to decide.
A group agrees not to use a resource for several years. The temporary ban protects it while a plan is made. The decision has a time limit.

examples.en: The crew cabin is forged from solid titanium alloy to resist thousands of tons of inward hydrostatic pressure.
examples.zh: 潛艇人員座艙由高強度「鈦合金」（Titanium）一體鍛造，抵禦深海數萬公噸向內擠壓的毀滅性水壓。

examples.en: Orthopedic surgeons implant biocompatible titanium screws and plates to stabilize complex bone fractures.
examples.zh: 骨科權威醫師在臨床上廣泛植入生物相容性極佳的純鈦骨釘與鋼板，以固定粉碎性骨折患處。

examples.en: Aerospace manufacturers prefer titanium for jet engine turbine blades due to its high strength-to-weight ratio.
examples.zh: 航空航天引擎製造商偏好使用航太級鈦合金打造渦輪葉片，看中的正是其超高強度重量比優勢。

entries.definition: 抵禦六百大氣壓極端水壓之厚鈦合金載人耐壓球艙

explains.en: A strong, lightweight metal is used in aircraft, sports gear, and some medical parts. It resists rust. It can be expensive.
The dentist placed a small metal part to support a replacement tooth. The material was strong and light. The patient followed care instructions.
Some bicycles use this metal for their frames. It also appears in spacecraft and jewelry. It must be shaped with special tools.

examples.en: Ultrasonic transducers prevent microbial biofouling from obscuring sensitive camera glass on deep moorings.
examples.zh: 超音波驅除裝置能防止細菌生物膜「生物附著附生」（Biofouling），確保深海觀測站鏡頭長年清晰。

examples.en: Marine engineers apply non-toxic anti-fouling coatings to ship hulls to reduce dragged resistance from biofouling.
examples.zh: 海事工程師在大型貨輪船底外殼塗抹無毒防污塗料，大幅減低因藤壺附生阻力所造成的燃油浪費。

examples.en: Offshore wind turbine foundations require regular diver inspection to remove heavy barnacle biofouling.
examples.zh: 離岸風電鋼管水下基礎每年皆需安排潛水工程團隊定期巡檢，刮除厚重藤壺與貝類的海洋生物附著。

entries.definition: 長期深海錨泊儀器表面防海洋生物附生污染

explains.en: After months underwater, barnacles and algae can attach to a scientific instrument. The growth may block sensors or make a surface heavier. This buildup is a problem for ocean equipment.
A sea sensor left in the water becomes covered with living organisms. Researchers clean it so measurements remain accurate. They remove this unwanted marine growth.
Shellfish and microbes grow on the outside of a docked device. The unwanted growth can affect its use. This term describes organisms attaching to equipment in water.

examples.en: The precautionary approach mandates that deep-sea mining should not proceed until risks are understood.
examples.zh: 國際公認的「預防性原則」（Precautionary Approach），要求在徹底明瞭生態衝擊前絕不可貿然進行商業開採。

examples.en: The chemical plant executed a precautionary shutdown after monitoring sensors detected a micro gas leak.
examples.zh: 化工廠工安監測儀器一探測到管線有微量氣體洩漏，廠方隨即果斷啟動預防性全廠緊急停機程序。

examples.en: Coastal municipalities distributed sandbags as a precautionary measure ahead of the approaching super typhoon.
examples.zh: 沿海低窪地區鄉鎮公所趕在強烈颱風暴風圈觸陸前，預防性發放數千只防汛沙包供居民領取堆疊。

entries.definition: 科學明朗前絕不輕易破壞之嚴格預防性原則的

explains.en: A team waits for safety tests before using a new chemical. They act carefully because the risks are uncertain.
A hiker carries extra water and checks the weather before a long trip. These steps help prevent trouble.
This adjective describes actions taken to prevent harm before all facts are known. Extra checks can reduce possible risks.

examples.en: The Cas9 endonuclease acts as a molecular scissor, unwinding and cutting target double-stranded DNA.
examples.zh: Cas9「核酸內切酶」（Endonuclease）如同精準的分子剪刀，能解開雙螺旋並精準剪斷目標 DNA。

examples.en: Restriction endonucleases allow molecular biologists to cut plasmid vectors at specific palindromic sites.
examples.zh: 限制性核酸內切酶讓分子生物學家能夠在質體載體的特定回文序列位點進行專一性剪切。

examples.en: Engineered endonuclease enzymes are undergoing preclinical evaluation for treating sickle cell anemia.
examples.zh: 經過基因工程改良的工程化核酸內切酶，目前正接受治療鐮刀型貧血症的臨床前試驗評估。

entries.definition: 依據導航 RNA 精準切割雙股 DNA 之核酸內切酶

explains.en: A protein cuts a DNA strand at a particular place. Scientists use it to study or edit genetic material. The exact target depends on the enzyme.
A lab tool recognizes a short pattern in DNA and cuts the molecule inside the strand. Researchers can compare the resulting pieces. The process requires careful control.
Cells use special proteins to cut genetic material when needed. The cuts happen within the chain rather than only at its ends. This helps manage DNA.

examples.en: Sequence-specific cleavage creates a clean double-strand break precisely three base pairs upstream.
examples.zh: 序列專一性「DNA 精準切割」（Cleavage），在目標位點上游三個鹼基處製造出乾淨的雙股斷裂。

examples.en: Mineralogists identify gemstone crystals by observing their characteristic smooth cleavage planes.
examples.zh: 礦物學家透過細心觀察寶石結晶特有的平整解理面，來精準鑑定未知礦物的晶體結構。

examples.en: The evening gala gown featured an elegant sweetheart neckline accentuating tasteful cleavage.
examples.zh: 這襲晚宴名貴禮服採用高雅的心形領口剪裁，恰到好處地襯托出優雅得體的頸肩曲線。

entries.definition: 雙股 DNA 專一性精準斷裂切割位點；劈開

explains.en: The way a mineral breaks along smooth flat surfaces is this property. Some crystals split in clear directions. A geologist can use it to identify them.
The student tapped a mineral sample gently. It split into flat shiny faces. She added the observation to her notebook.
In biology, the term can also mean cell division in an early embryo. The meaning depends on the subject. A textbook explains the context.

examples.en: A modified Cas9 nickase creates a single-stranded nick, reducing dangerous genomic rearrangements.
examples.zh: 基因突變改造的「單股切口酶」（Nickase），只切開單股 DNA 鏈，大幅降低了染色體非預期重組風險。

examples.en: Paired nickase strategies require two separate guides to generate cohesive ends for precise insertion.
examples.zh: 雙切口酶成對協同策略需要兩段獨立的導向 RNA，以產生具黏性末端的缺口實現精準插入。

examples.en: Enzymatic assays confirmed that the engineered nickase lacked double-strand cutting activity entirely.
examples.zh: 體外酵素活性分析證實，該工程突變切口酶已完全喪失了剪斷 DNA 雙鏈的切割活性。

entries.definition: 突變切口酶 (僅切斷單股 DNA 大幅降低突變)

explains.en: A gene-editing protein can cut only one side of a DNA ladder. This may lower the chance of unwanted changes. Scientists use it to make precise edits.
Researchers alter an enzyme so it makes a single-strand cut instead of cutting both DNA strands. The cell can repair the small opening. This tool is used in genetic engineering.
A molecular tool recognizes a chosen DNA sequence and nicks just one strand. The method may reduce errors compared with a full cut. This modified enzyme performs that action.

examples.en: Comprehensive sequencing confirmed that the engineered enzyme produced zero off-target genomic cuts.
examples.zh: 全基因體高深度定序證實，該工程化酵素在人體細胞中達成了完美的零「非目標脫靶剪切」（Off-Target Cuts）。

examples.en: The striker's shot went wide and completely off-target, flying into the enthusiastic stadium crowd.
examples.zh: 這位前鋒的臨門一腳力道過猛且完全偏離球門目標，足球直接飛進了熱情吶喊的觀眾席中。

examples.en: Regulatory agencies mandate rigorous off-target mutation assessments before approving gene therapy trials.
examples.zh: 藥物監管主管機關明文規定，在核准人體基因治療臨床試驗前，必須提交嚴密的脫靶突變評估報告。

entries.definition: 徹底消除非目標基因意外剪切之脫靶效應的

explains.en: A medicine affects healthy cells as well as the intended ones. Researchers try to reduce these unwanted effects.
An archer’s arrow lands beside the marked circle. The shot missed its intended place.
This describes an effect or result that misses the intended target. In science it can refer to unintended changes.

examples.en: Targeted gene knockout permanently disables the viral entry receptor, conferring immunity against disease.
examples.zh: 透過「標靶基因敲除」（Gene Knockout），永久關閉細胞表面的病毒受體，賦予宿主對致命病毒的免疫力。

examples.en: The heavyweight boxer delivered a devastating right hook, scoring a dramatic fifth-round knockout.
examples.zh: 重量級拳擊好手揮出一記毀滅性的重磅右勾拳，在第五回合以戲劇性的擊倒獲勝贏得金腰帶。

examples.en: The beauty pageant winner walked onto the runway in a stunning, absolute knockout evening gown.
examples.zh: 選美大賽冠軍身著一襲驚豔全場、無比美豔絕倫的晚禮服優雅步上伸展台，令人嘆為觀止。

entries.definition: 標靶基因敲除 (徹底關閉特定有害致病基因表現)；擊倒

explains.en: A boxer wins when an opponent cannot continue after a blow. A referee stops the match. The injured person needs a safety check.
A team removes a particular gene from an animal or cell to learn what it does. Scientists compare the result with a normal sample. Careful rules govern the research.
An object or person is extremely impressive in casual speech. The same word can also mean a sudden sports victory. Context helps reveal which use is intended.

examples.en: Precise therapeutic knockin inserted a healthy hemoglobin gene into patient stem cells safely.
examples.zh: 精準的「治療性基因敲入」（Gene Knockin），將一段健康的血紅蛋白基因安全嵌入病患造血幹細胞中。

examples.en: Researchers created a fluorescent reporter knockin mouse model to track neural lineage differentiation.
examples.zh: 研究團隊培育出帶有螢光報告基因敲入的小鼠模型，藉以即時追蹤神經細胞的譜系分化歷程。

examples.en: High knockin efficiency requires optimized delivery vectors and specialized chemical inhibitors.
examples.zh: 達成高水準的基因敲入成功率，仰賴高度最佳化的遞送載體與專屬的化學抑制劑協同作用。

entries.definition: 標靶基因敲入 (在特定位點精準嵌入全新外源基因)

explains.en: In genetics, a chosen piece of DNA is added at a specific location in a cell’s genetic material. Researchers use it to study a gene. The work requires a laboratory.
Scientists inserted a fluorescent marker into a particular gene in a mouse cell. The marker helped them track where the gene was active. They followed strict rules.
This method differs from removing or switching off a gene. It adds selected genetic information. Trained researchers carefully check the result.

examples.en: CRISPR activation recruits transcription machinery to amplify the expression of silent tumor suppressor genes.
examples.zh: 運用 CRISPRa 技術招募「轉錄活化複合體」（Transcription），能重新喚醒人體沉睡已久的抑癌基因。

examples.en: Automated AI transcription software converted the three-hour audio interview into text within minutes.
examples.zh: 自動化人工智慧語音辨識轉錄軟體，在數分鐘內便將長達三小時的採訪錄音精準轉為逐字稿。

examples.en: RNA polymerase binds to promoter regions to initiate the transcription of genetic code into messenger RNA.
examples.zh: RNA 聚合酶牢牢結合至啟動子區域，正式啟動將 DNA 遺傳密碼轉錄為信使 RNA 的轉錄過程。

entries.definition: CRISPRa 人工轉錄活化因子 (調高有益基因表達)；轉錄

explains.en: A cell copies information from DNA into a temporary RNA message. The message can then guide the making of proteins. This copying step is part of gene expression.
A gene is switched on when a cell makes an RNA copy of its instructions. Scientists can also use an activating protein to raise gene activity. This term names the copying step.
A special protein can help a cell produce more RNA from a useful gene. The message carries instructions for later use. This is a key step in gene expression.

examples.en: Epigenetics editors add chemical tags to silence disease genes without altering the underlying DNA sequence.
examples.zh: 「表觀遺傳修飾編輯」（Epigenetics），在完全不改動 DNA 原始字元的前提下添加化學標籤來關閉致病基因。

examples.en: Lifestyle factors such as chronic stress and diet exert profound epigenetics influences on gene activity.
examples.zh: 長期精神壓力與不良飲食習慣等後天生活型態，會對人體基因調控產生深遠的表觀遺傳學影響。

examples.en: Breakthroughs in cancer epigenetics reveal how histone modifications turn tumor protective genes off.
examples.zh: 癌症表觀遺傳學的重大突破，揭示了組蛋白化學修飾是如何在後天悄悄關閉抑癌保護基因的。

entries.definition: 在不改動 DNA 字母序列下調控基因開關之表觀遺傳學

explains.en: A plant’s genes stay the same, but growing conditions change which ones are active. The changes affect its traits.
Scientists study chemical marks that control gene activity without changing the DNA letters. These marks can change over time.
This field studies changes in gene activity that do not alter the DNA sequence itself. Environmental conditions can affect these patterns.

examples.en: Targeted cytosine methylation durable silences hyperactive inflammatory genes for generations of cell divisions.
examples.zh: 透過專一性「DNA 胞嘧啶甲基化」（Methylation），能讓過度活躍的發炎基因在細胞分裂中長期維持沉默。

examples.en: Aberrant promoter hyper-methylation is a well-established molecular biomarker in early cancer detection.
examples.zh: 啟動子區域異常的過度甲基化修飾，在現代臨床醫學中被廣泛認定為早期癌症篩檢的重要生物標誌。

examples.en: DNA methylation patterns change predictably with age, forming the foundation of biological clocks.
examples.zh: 人體基因體 DNA 的甲基化分佈圖譜隨年齡規律遞變，構成了推算生理年齡生物時鐘的科學基石。

entries.definition: 標靶 DNA 胞嘧啶甲基化 (長期穩定沉默基因表現)

explains.en: A small chemical group attaches to DNA or another molecule. This can affect how a gene is used without changing its letters. Researchers study the pattern.
Cells add a tiny chemical tag to a section of genetic material. The tag can help control activity. The process plays a role in development.
A chemistry lab tracks how a molecule changes when this group is added. The change may affect its behavior. Scientists measure it with special methods.

examples.en: Adding synthetic DNA plasmids directly to the clear cell lysate triggers instant protein synthesis.
examples.zh: 將人工合成質體 DNA 直接滴入清澈的「細胞裂解液」（Lysate）中，即可在數分鐘內啟動蛋白質合成反應。

examples.en: Centrifuging crude cell lysate at high speed pellets membrane fragments, yielding a clear supernatant.
examples.zh: 將粗製細胞裂解液進行超高速離心，能使沉重的細胞膜碎屑沉澱，獲得極為澄澈的上清液。

examples.en: The freeze-thaw cycle effectively ruptures cell walls to release target enzymes into the lysate solution.
examples.zh: 反覆冷凍融解循環能破壞細胞壁，使細胞內部的大量目標酵素順利釋放至裂解液溶液中。

entries.definition: 完整保留轉錄與轉譯分子機構之清澈細胞裂解液

explains.en: A liquid mixture made when cells are broken open is this. It contains material from inside the cells. Researchers use it in experiments.
The lab worker opened the cells in a tube and separated the liquid. She labeled the sample clearly. It was ready for testing.
This mixture may contain proteins and other cell parts. It can help scientists study how cells work. Protective equipment is used in the lab.

examples.en: High-speed liquid dispensers transfer reagents into 1536-well microplates in a matter of seconds.
examples.zh: 超高速「微量自動分液儀」（Liquid Dispenser），在短短數秒內即可將試劑均勻分配至 1536 微孔板中。

examples.en: The hospital installed wall-mounted touchless hand sanitizer dispensers beside every patient elevator.
examples.zh: 綜合醫院在每一座病患專用電梯口旁，皆全面裝設了感應式無接觸酒精乾洗手自動噴霧機。

examples.en: The office break room features an automated cold brew coffee dispenser that accepts contactless payments.
examples.zh: 員工茶水休息室引進了一台全自動冰滴冷萃咖啡機，支援悠遊卡與行動支付無感感應結帳。

examples.en: The smart fuel dispenser communicates with the vehicle tank via infrared signals to monitor temperature.
examples.zh: 智慧「加氫機台」（Dispenser），透過紅外線訊號即時讀取車載儲罐溫度，達成最高效安全充填。

examples.en: Commercial restrooms provide touchless soap dispensers to promote hygiene and prevent bacterial transfer.
examples.zh: 百貨公司公共洗手間全面配置感應式無接觸泡沫洗手乳給皂機，維護公共衛生並杜絕細菌交叉傳播。

examples.en: The kitchen pantry includes a rotating grain dispenser that measures out exact cups of white rice.
examples.zh: 居家廚房櫥櫃角落擺放了一台按壓計量式旋轉儲米桶自動分糧機，能分毫不差地定量倒出一米杯白米。

entries.definition: 奈升級無接觸超高速精準微量移液自動分液儀；分發器；搭載紅外線即時通訊之自動加氫槍分流器機台

explains.en: A lab machine transfers tiny amounts of liquid into many small wells without touching them. It measures each drop very accurately. This automated tool saves time.
A station provides fuel through a hose and directs different vehicles to the correct lane. It releases the liquid when the user activates it. The word can name a device that supplies something.
A robot moves a pipette above a plate and releases measured drops. It can handle quantities too small for hand pouring. This device gives out liquid precisely.

examples.en: Inserting an artificial seven-gene pathway allows yeast to brew precious anti-malarial medication.
examples.zh: 植入一條由七個外源基因構成的「人工生物合成途徑」（Pathway），讓酵母菌能直接發酵出珍貴的抗瘧疾特效藥。

examples.en: A paved stone pathway meanders through the Japanese garden, connecting koi ponds and tea pavilions.
examples.zh: 一條鋪設整齊的卵石步道蜿蜒貫穿整座日式庭園，優雅串聯起錦鯉池畔與古樸的木造茶亭。

examples.en: Earning an industry vocational certification provides a practical pathway to high-paying software jobs.
examples.zh: 考取含金量高且獲業界認可的專業技術證照，為非本科青年提供了一條通往高薪軟體工程師的捷徑。

entries.definition: 由十多種酵素精密串聯之人工生物合成途徑；途徑

explains.en: A trail through the woods leads hikers to a lake. Signs mark the route.
A series of chemical steps inside a cell helps it turn food into energy. Each step depends on the previous one.
This can mean a route or a sequence of steps. In biology, it describes connected reactions in a cell.

examples.en: Optimizing enzymatic flux prevents the buildup of toxic intermediate metabolites inside the engineered cell.
examples.zh: 精確調控各步驟的「代謝物質流動通量」（Metabolic Flux），能防止有毒中間產物在工程菌體內過度堆積。

examples.en: Global energy markets experienced tremendous uncertainty and flux following sudden geopolitical tensions.
examples.zh: 隨著國際地緣政治局勢驟然緊繃，全球原油與天然氣能源市場陷入了前所未有的劇烈震盪與動盪。

examples.en: The electronics solder wire contains an inner core of chemical flux that cleans metal surfaces during soldering.
examples.zh: 這款電子專用焊錫絲內部包覆著化學助焊劑核心，能在高溫焊接過程中自動清除金屬表面氧化物。

entries.definition: 基因調控平衡細胞內部碳源物質流動通量；流動

explains.en: A river carries a steady flow of water past a bridge. The amount can rise after rain. Engineers measure it to plan safely.
A magnetic field through a surface can be measured as a total amount. Scientists use the value in electrical and physics problems.
People and vehicles move in and out of a busy station all day. The continual movement changes by the hour. This word can describe a flow or a state of change.

examples.en: Reassigning stop codons throughout the entire genome prevents synthetic strains from sharing DNA with wild microbes.
examples.zh: 在全基因體中將終止「遺傳密碼子」（Codon）重新編碼賦予新功能，能徹底防止人工菌株與自然界野生菌交換基因。

examples.en: Each triplet codon along the messenger RNA transcript specifies a unique corresponding amino acid building block.
examples.zh: 信使 RNA 序列上的每一個三聯體遺傳密碼子，皆專一性對應編碼著某種特定的人體必需氨基酸單元。

examples.en: Synonymous codon changes do not alter protein amino acid sequence but can influence translation speed.
examples.zh: 同義密碼子突變置換雖然不會改變蛋白質最終的氨基酸排列，卻可能對細胞內的轉譯速率產生深遠影響。

entries.definition: 全基因體重新編碼置換之遺傳密碼子

explains.en: Three DNA or RNA letters in a row can tell a cell which amino acid to use. This small instruction is part of the genetic code. Many are read during protein building.
The class used colored blocks to model a three-letter code. Each group of three stood for a building piece. The model helped explain proteins.
Some codes signal the cell to begin or stop making a protein. A change can affect how the protein is built. Scientists study these instructions.

examples.en: Multi-layered genetic biocontainment ensures synthetic organisms cannot survive in natural outdoor ecosystems.
examples.zh: 多重「基因生物防護屏障機制」（Biocontainment），確保合成工程菌一旦離開實驗室特定營養液便會自動凋亡。

examples.en: Biosafety level 4 laboratories operate under negative atmospheric pressure to maintain airtight biocontainment.
examples.zh: 全球最高規格的第四級生物安全實驗室始終處於負壓抽氣狀態，以維持萬無一失的嚴密生物防護隔離。

examples.en: Regulatory panels audit university biocontainment facilities annually to prevent unintentional microbial release.
examples.zh: 主管機關生安審查委員會每年定期抽查各大學生安防護設施，嚴防任何未經許可的基因改造微生物外洩。

entries.definition: 基因安全保險開關 (離開實驗室即自我凋亡防護)

explains.en: Scientists design a modified organism to stop growing if it leaves the laboratory. A built-in safety switch can cause it to die outside controlled conditions. This protects people and nature.
A lab strain may depend on a nutrient that is only supplied inside the facility. Without it, the cells cannot survive. This method keeps engineered life contained.
Researchers add a genetic safeguard so a microbe cannot thrive beyond its approved setting. The system limits accidental release. This is a form of biological safety.

examples.en: International biosecurity screening protocols flag dangerous toxin sequences before automated gene printers run.
examples.zh: 國際「生物安全審查協議」（Biosecurity），在自動化 DNA 合成儀列印前即時掃描並攔截潛在危險病原體序列。

examples.en: Strict border biosecurity measures prevent invasive agricultural pests and diseases from entering the island.
examples.zh: 國境海關嚴密落實動植物邊境檢疫與生物安全防範措施，嚴防境外具破壞力的有害農林害蟲與疫病入侵全島。

examples.en: Public health agencies updated domestic biosecurity standards to safeguard regional water supply reservoirs.
examples.zh: 國家公共衛生主管機關全面修訂升級了國家生物安全指引標準，嚴格保障區域民生自來水水庫水源安全。

entries.definition: 商業 DNA 基因合成訂單全面病原體資安審查

explains.en: A lab checks who can enter and how dangerous samples are stored. The rules help prevent harm.
A country monitors farms for animal diseases and controls how samples move. These measures protect health.
This is the protection of people, animals, and plants from biological threats. It includes safety and security practices.

examples.en: Designing synthetic genomes is a breathtaking demonstration of human scientific ingenuity.
examples.zh: 親手設計並編程全合成生命基因組，是二十一世紀人類「卓越科學智慧與創造力」（Ingenuity）的驚豔展現。

examples.en: With remarkable resourcefulness and mechanical ingenuity, the stranded sailors repaired their broken rudder.
examples.zh: 憑藉臨危不亂的過人應變力與高超的機械修護智慧，受困海員在怒海中順利修復了斷裂的船舵脫險。

examples.en: Architectural ingenuity transformed a cramped, triangular city plot into an award-winning modern residence.
examples.zh: 建築師巧奪天工的空間規劃智慧，成功將市中心一塊狹窄畸零的三角形建地轉型為屢獲大獎的現代住宅。

entries.definition: 人類解碼並重寫生命程式碼之無窮科學智慧

explains.en: A child uses a paper clip to fix a broken zipper pull. The simple idea works well. Creative problem-solving can use everyday objects.
An engineer designs a bridge using fewer materials while keeping it strong. The clever plan saves money. Careful testing proves it is safe.
A family finds a new way to store toys in a small room. Their solution is clever and practical. This quality helps people solve problems.

examples.en: The high-speed rail network connects major urban centers, shortening travel times across the island.
examples.zh: 「高速鐵路網絡」（High-Speed Rail），串聯全台各大都市生活圈，將南北一日往返化為日常。

examples.en: Fiber-optic cables deliver ultra-reliable, high-speed broadband internet directly to remote households.
examples.zh: 光纖寬頻海纜將穩定無比的高速上網網路直接牽入偏鄉家戶中，消弭了城鄉數位落差。

examples.en: Traffic police installed high-speed cameras along the expressway to deter reckless illegal street racing.
examples.zh: 交通警察在快速道路易肇事路段裝設高解析高速測速照相機，嚴厲取締危險違規飆車行為。

entries.definition: 貫穿台灣西部走廊時速三百公里之高速鐵路的

explains.en: Moving or operating very quickly is described this way. Trains and internet connections can have this quality. Safety and reliability matter.
The train traveled between cities in a short time. Passengers remained seated as it crossed the countryside. The ride was smooth.
A data connection can also carry information quickly. It helps people stream video or download files. The phrase describes rapid movement or operation.

examples.en: Precision precast concrete track slabs are laid onto concrete roadbeds with shock-absorbing circular pads.
examples.zh: 高強度「預鑄混凝土軌道版」（Precast Slabs），安裝於基底並搭配橡膠抗震墊以隔絕下層結構震動。

examples.en: Modular bridge construction relies heavily on precast concrete beams cured under controlled factory conditions.
examples.zh: 現代化橋梁模組化工法高度仰賴在工廠嚴密恆溫環境中養護完成的預鑄鋼筋混凝土預力梁。

examples.en: Using precast facade panels shortened the skyscraper's exterior construction timeline by several months.
examples.zh: 採用高品質預鑄外牆帷幕飾板，將整座摩天大樓外立面施工工期大幅縮短了整整數個月。

entries.definition: 廠內高精度精密製造之預鑄鋼筋混凝土軌道版的

explains.en: Concrete pieces are made in a factory and carried to a railway site for installation. The controlled setting allows precise production. This adjective describes components formed before they arrive.
Workers pour concrete into reusable molds indoors. After it hardens, the finished track slab is transported to the construction area. It was made ahead of installation.
A bridge uses sections formed away from the building site. Cranes place each hardened piece into position. This construction method saves time on location.

examples.en: Over seventy percent of the high-speed route runs along elevated concrete viaduct spans across valleys.
examples.zh: 高鐵全線超過七成路段行駛於巍峨壯觀的「高架混凝土長橋」（Viaduct），平穩跨越平原與溪流。

examples.en: The centuries-old stone Roman aqueduct viaduct still stands majestically across the river gorge.
examples.zh: 這座歷經數百年風霜的羅馬石造高架水道橋，如今依然威風凜凜地橫跨在湍急的河谷峽谷兩端。

examples.en: Civil engineers inspected the elevated freeway viaduct pillars for concrete spalling after the earthquake.
examples.zh: 土木結構技師在強震過後迅速趕往現場，仔細檢視國道高架長橋橋墩是否有任何混凝土剝落龜裂。

entries.definition: 跨越高屏平原與丘陵之連續高架混凝土長跨距橋梁

explains.en: A long bridge carries a railway across a valley. Trains pass above the ground.
Drivers cross a raised roadway supported by arches or pillars. It spans a low area.
This is a bridge-like structure that carries a road or rail line over a valley or other obstacle. Its supports may stand high above the ground.

examples.en: Perforated aerodynamic tunnel hood structures dissipate pressurized air waves as trains enter.
examples.zh: 隧道口設置的「喇叭形開孔減壓遮罩洞門」（Tunnel Hood），能在列車衝入瞬間有效化解壓縮空氣波。

examples.en: The mechanic popped open the car hood to check the battery terminals and engine oil level.
examples.zh: 汽車修車廠技師掀開引擎蓋，逐一仔細檢查電瓶接頭樁頭與引擎機油的存量及油質。

examples.en: She pulled the warm fleece hood over her ears to shield her face from the biting winter wind.
examples.zh: 她順手將羽絨連帽大衣厚實的抓絨兜帽拉過雙耳，遮擋冬日街頭刺骨撲面的陣陣寒風。

entries.definition: 開孔喇叭形低微氣壓波隧道口洞門遮罩設計；頭巾

explains.en: A cloth or padded cover protects a person’s head from rain or cold. It may be attached to a coat. A drawstring can tighten it.
A metal cover sits above a car engine. It can be lifted for repairs. A latch holds it shut while driving.
A large cover above a kitchen stove draws smoke and steam away. A fan sends the air outside. The word has several meanings.

examples.en: The single-arm aerodynamic pantograph presses against the overhead wire with constant upward force.
examples.zh: 輕量化低風阻「單臂集電弓」（Pantograph），以恆定推力緊貼上方電車線，實現高速穩定集電。

examples.en: Draftsmen historically utilized a mechanical pantograph to duplicate technical drawings at different scales.
examples.zh: 在沒有電腦繪圖的年代，製圖工程師常利用機械式縮放儀，依不同比例尺精準複製技術圖面。

examples.en: Ice buildup on the electric locomotive pantograph caused intermittent electrical sparking in freezing weather.
examples.zh: 冬天嚴寒天候下電力機車頭集電弓表面結冰結霜，導致滑行受流時出現斷續的刺眼電弧火花。

entries.definition: 降噪碳纖維單臂集電弓 (時速三百高頻受流)

explains.en: A train uses a raised metal frame to collect electricity from an overhead wire. The spring-like device stays in contact as the train moves. It powers the engine.
The driver looked up at the equipment above the train. It touched a cable along the track. The electric motor carried passengers forward.
A drawing tool with linked arms can copy a picture at a different size. The same word names that tool. Context identifies the meaning.

examples.en: An overhead catenary wire supplies 25,000 volts of alternating electricity to power the bullet train motors.
examples.zh: 「架空電車線系統」（Catenary Wire），源源不絕向車廂輸送兩萬五千伏特高壓交流電驅動全車馬達。

examples.en: Strong typhoon winds brought down a fallen branch onto the rail catenary, causing minor delays.
examples.zh: 颱風帶來的狂風吹斷路旁大樹殘枝砸落在鐵路電車線上，造成部分區間短暫減速延誤。

examples.en: Architectural suspended roofs mimic the natural mathematical catenary curve of a hanging chain.
examples.zh: 當代大跨距懸索屋頂建築設計，刻意借鑑了懸掛鐵鏈在自然重力下呈現的完美懸鏈線數學幾何。

entries.definition: 兩萬五千伏特高張力懸臂架空電車線系統

explains.en: A railway uses strong overhead wires to carry electric power to trains. Curved supports hold the line above the track. This system supplies electricity to moving vehicles.
A train draws power from a wire suspended above the rails. The supporting arms keep it at the right height. This is an overhead electric line system.
High-voltage wires run above a railway and feed current to trains through a contact strip. Poles and arms keep the wire steady. This overhead system powers electric trains.

examples.en: Onboard IGBT traction inverters convert high-voltage line current into variable-frequency power for motors.
examples.zh: 現代「牽引變流器」（Traction Inverters），將高壓電精準轉化為可調頻率交流電以精準控制車速。

examples.en: Snow tires with deep treads provide superior tire road traction when driving on icy winter mountain roads.
examples.zh: 胎面刻有深花紋溝槽的雪地胎，在冰雪覆蓋的冬日高山公路上行駛時能提供卓越的抓地牽引力。

examples.en: The tech startup’s mobile payment service gained rapid commercial traction among college students nationwide.
examples.zh: 這家金融科技新創團隊研發的行動支付應用程式，在全國大專院校青年學生間迅速打開市場口碑。

entries.definition: 絕緣柵雙極電晶體 (IGBT) 變頻變壓牽引變流器；牽引力

explains.en: A tire grips the road so a car can turn safely in rain. Good grip helps prevent slipping.
A rescue team pulls a sled across snow using a strong rope. The pulling force moves it forward.
This word can mean grip between surfaces or the force that pulls something forward. Context determines the sense.

examples.en: The bolsterless bogie frame isolates passengers from high-frequency wheelset track vibration.
examples.zh: 先進的「無搖枕轉向架底盤」（Bogie），能完全隔絕高速旋轉輪對與鐵軌碰撞產生的劇烈高頻震動。

examples.en: Railway workshops utilize automated cranes to hoist locomotive bodies off their wheel bogie assemblies.
examples.zh: 鐵路修造廠運用全自動天車吊架，將巨大的電力機車頭車體與下方的輪對轉向架底盤平穩分離。

examples.en: Engineers conduct stress tests on welded steel bogie components to verify structural fatigue limits.
examples.zh: 機械工程師對焊接成型的鋼製轉向架各零組件進行應力加壓測試，精確驗證其抗金屬疲勞極限。

entries.definition: 吸收輪軌劇烈衝擊之高性能無搖枕轉向架底盤

explains.en: A rail vehicle has a wheeled frame beneath each carriage that supports its weight and helps it follow curves. Springs can soften bumps.
A mechanic inspects the wheel frame beneath a train carriage after hearing an unusual sound. Worn parts may need repair.
In some varieties of English, the word can also mean a passenger carriage. The railway meaning is a frame with wheels under a carriage.

examples.en: Rigorous dynamic engineering prevents high-speed truck hunting oscillation from developing on straight tracks.
examples.zh: 嚴密的車體動力學設計，徹底防範列車在高速直線行駛時發生危險的輪對「自激蛇行振盪」（Oscillation）。

examples.en: Pendulum clock timekeeping relies on the constant periodic harmonic oscillation of a swinging brass weight.
examples.zh: 古典擺鐘的精準計時，完全仰賴懸掛黃銅鐘擺在重力作用下永恆規律的簡諧週期擺動振盪。

examples.en: Sudden economic oscillation between runaway inflation and recession poses serious policy dilemmas.
examples.zh: 經濟景氣在惡性通貨膨脹與蕭條衰退之間劇烈擺盪震盪，為央行貨幣決策帶來了艱鉅的兩難挑戰。

entries.definition: 消除輪對高速自激蛇行晃動失穩現象；振盪

explains.en: A repeated movement back and forth is this motion. A swing moves this way. Some clocks use a steady repeated motion to keep time.
The pendulum moved from one side to the other at a steady pace. The children counted each pass. Their teacher explained the motion.
A sound wave or electric signal can also rise and fall repeatedly. Engineers measure its speed and size. The motion may be very small.

examples.en: Forged steel wheelsets are profiled with micro-precise conical tread geometry to self-center along rails.
examples.zh: 實心鍛造的高強度「鋼製輪對」（Wheelsets），雕琢出微米級錐形踏面，在鐵軌中央實現完美的自動定心。

examples.en: Depot technicians use laser profilometers to measure wheelset flange wear after thousands of operational kilometers.
examples.zh: 機廠維修檢驗員在列車行駛數萬公里後，利用雷射輪廓儀精確量測輪對輪緣的微米級磨耗程度。

examples.en: Replacing worn wheelsets on freight wagons prevents uneven track friction and extends rail lifespan.
examples.zh: 定期更換重載貨運列車磨損的輪對組，能有效防止軌面不均勻摩擦，進一步延長全線鋼軌壽命。

entries.definition: 錐形踏面實體整體鍛造高強度特種鋼高速輪對

explains.en: A train axle carries two strong steel wheels that roll together on the rails. Their tapered shape helps a vehicle stay centered on curves. The pair is part of a railcar.
A rail vehicle has wheels fixed to each end of an axle. The heavy forged steel parts must withstand great weight. This assembly rolls along the track.
Two matching wheels and their connecting axle form one unit under a train. The shape helps guide the vehicle safely. This part is designed for rail travel.

examples.en: Flash-butt rail welding fuses two-hundred-meter steel segments into seamless ribbons stretching for miles.
examples.zh: 透過「閃爍對焊工藝」（Flash-Butt Welding），將兩百公尺長的鋼軌在高溫熔接成數十公里無縫巨龍。

examples.en: Shipyard apprentices must wear certified tinted face shields to protect their eyes during arc welding.
examples.zh: 造船廠培訓學徒在進行電弧焊接作業時，必須佩戴經認證的深色遮光防護面罩以維護眼部安全。

examples.en: Ultrasonic weld testing guarantees that industrial pipe welding meets stringent nuclear safety standards.
examples.zh: 透過高規格超音波探傷檢測，確保石化工業管線焊接接頭百分之百符合極嚴苛的核能安全標準。

entries.definition: 移動式閃爍對焊與高溫鋁熱無縫接軌銲接工藝；銲接

explains.en: A worker joins two metal pieces using intense heat. Protective goggles shield the eyes.
A factory fuses sections of rail so trains can travel smoothly. The joint must be strong.
This process joins metal parts by heating them, sometimes with added material. The joint can become strong after it cools.

examples.en: High-speed turnouts allow trains to switch onto passing sidings at speeds up to 160 km/h smoothly.
examples.zh: 頂級「高速道岔」（Turnouts），讓列車在不停車的情況下以時速一百六十公里平穩切換至待避側線。

examples.en: Despite the chilly morning rain, voter turnout at the municipal election surpassed sixty-five percent.
examples.zh: 儘管清晨陰雨連綿、氣溫微涼，本屆地方公職人員選舉的全市公民投票率依然突破了六成五。

examples.en: Over five thousand tech enthusiasts formed an enthusiastic turnout for the annual developer symposium.
examples.zh: 超過五千名熱血軟體工程師與科技愛好者踴躍進場，盛況空前出席了一年一度的開發者年會。

entries.definition: 具備可動心軌允許時速 160 公里側向通過之高速道岔

explains.en: Many people attend a school concert, so the audience is large. Organizers are pleased that so many came. The number of attendees is high.
A road curves away from the main route into a small stopping area. Drivers can pull over safely. A sign may mark the place.
An emergency worker checks thick protective clothing before a fire call. It must fit and close properly. The term can also refer to the number who attend.

examples.en: Digital train signaling transmits continuous speed limit curves directly onto the driver’s cab dashboard.
examples.zh: 現代「數位鐵路號誌系統」（Signaling），將即時允許行車速度曲線直接傳送至駕駛座數位儀表板。

examples.en: Cellular signaling pathways regulate how biological human cells respond to incoming environmental hormones.
examples.zh: 複雜的細胞訊息傳遞路徑，細膩調控著人體活細胞如何對外在環境荷爾蒙刺激做出即時反應。

examples.en: Upgrading traditional track circuits to radio-based signaling expands network train throughput significantly.
examples.zh: 將傳統軌道電路號誌全面升級為無線電通訊行車號誌系統，能顯著擴增全線鐵路每小時的發車班次容量。

entries.definition: 數位自動列車控制與車載號誌系統 (D-ATC / ETCS)

explains.en: Sending information from one place or cell to another is this process. Trains use systems to show when tracks are safe. Cells also send chemical messages.
A colored light told the train driver to slow down. The control center watched the track. The train stopped safely.
In the body, cells send signals that guide growth or movement. Scientists study these messages. Different systems use different signals.

examples.en: Moving-block signaling reduces minimum service headway to three minutes during peak holiday rush hours.
examples.zh: 移動閉塞號誌技術，將春節疏運尖峰時段的最小「發車班距」（Headway）極限壓縮至短短三分鐘一班。

examples.en: Despite working through the night, the research team made little headway on solving the complex math proof.
examples.zh: 儘管全體研究團隊挑燈夜戰苦思整晚，但在解開這個深奧複雜的高等數學難題上依然進展甚微。

examples.en: Subway networks operate with a tight two-minute headway during the morning eight o'clock office commute.
examples.zh: 捷運高運量路網在早晨八點上班尖峰通勤時段，以極為緊湊密集的兩分鐘發車班距疏運龐大人潮。

entries.definition: 尖峰時刻每三分鐘一班車之密集發車班距；間距

explains.en: A transit agency measures the time between buses arriving at the same stop. During rush hour, a short gap means frequent service. This interval helps plan schedules.
Trains leave a station every few minutes on a busy line. The time gap between vehicles is carefully managed. It is important to service quality.
A rider waits for a bus, then another arrives three minutes later. The time gap between vehicles is important to service quality. This word names that interval.

examples.en: Bullet train sets return to the maintenance depot nightly for rigorous mechanical and electrical inspections.
examples.zh: 結束全天營運的高鐵列車每晚返回「維修總機廠」（Maintenance Depot），接受最嚴密徹底的機電安全體檢。

examples.en: City transit buses return to the municipal central depot after completing their final late-night routes.
examples.zh: 城市聯營大眾公車在跑完深夜最後一班收班班次後，紛紛依序開回市郊公車總調度站兼停車場。

examples.en: The logistics multinational built a massive distribution freight depot adjacent to the international seaport.
examples.zh: 這家跨國物流巨頭在國際海港貨櫃碼頭旁，斥資打造了一座佔地廣袤的現代化海空聯運發貨集散中心。

entries.definition: 燕巢總機廠全列車解體大修維修基地；車庫

explains.en: Buses return to a large building at night for cleaning and repairs. The vehicles are stored there.
A train waits at a railway yard where workers inspect it. Supplies may also be kept on site.
This is a place where vehicles, equipment, or supplies are stored and maintained. Buses may return there at night.

examples.en: Periodic level-four overhaul disassembles the entire train down to the frame to inspect every component.
examples.zh: 定期進行的第四級「全車解體大修」（Overhaul），將車體完全拆解至鋼架結構，逐一翻新每顆微小零件。

examples.en: The government announced a comprehensive overhaul of national healthcare insurance reimbursement rates.
examples.zh: 衛生福利部正式宣布，將針對現行全民健保各項醫療給付支付標準進行全面性的通盤檢討與結構性改革。

examples.en: The shipwright pulled the fishing trawler onto the dry dock for a complete hull and engine overhaul.
examples.zh: 造船師傅將遠洋漁船拖上乾塢修船廠，展開為期一個月的船體除銹防漏與主柴油引擎全面解體大修。

entries.definition: 每行駛百萬公里全車解體大修翻新維護；檢修

explains.en: A mechanic takes a machine apart, repairs worn pieces, and puts it back together. The work makes it run reliably again. It can take several days.
A school reviews its schedule and changes many parts of it. Teachers and families share their ideas. The new plan is a major update.
A train engine receives new parts and careful testing after many years of use. The repair is more thorough than a quick fix. Workers document each step.

examples.en: Specialized rail grinding trains operate overnight to smooth microscopic surface cracks along the rails.
examples.zh: 專用「鋼軌打磨維護車」（Rail Grinding），在深夜閉塞時段出動，以微米級精度修平鋼軌微小疲勞裂紋。

examples.en: Freshly roasted whole bean coffee requires uniform burr grinding to produce perfect espresso extraction.
examples.zh: 現烘現焙的新鮮整顆咖啡豆需要平刀磨豆機進行極致均勻的研磨，方能萃取出 crema 濃郁的濃縮咖啡。

examples.en: Millions of rural refugees endure grinding poverty and chronic food scarcity in conflict zones.
examples.zh: 數以百萬計流離失所的戰亂難民，在衝突戰火廢墟中長年忍受著赤貧如洗與食物匱乏的殘酷煎熬。

entries.definition: 鋼軌打磨車微米級修整輪軌接觸面幾何輪廓；打磨

explains.en: Rubbing or cutting a hard surface to make it smoother or smaller is this process. A tool can sharpen metal. Coffee beans are also ground.
The worker used a machine to smooth the rail surface. Sparks flew as the rough spot disappeared. The track was checked afterward.
A mill breaks grain into flour. A coffee grinder makes small pieces for brewing. Use the correct tool and safety gear.

examples.en: Trackside seismometers transmit instant cutoff signals to substations whenever ground accelerations exceed limits.
examples.zh: 沿線密集安裝的「強震地震儀」（Seismometer），在地面震動加速度超標時零點幾秒內自動切斷電車線供電。

examples.en: Volcanologists monitor digital seismometer records closely to detect rising magma vibrations beneath the caldera.
examples.zh: 火山地質學家全神貫注緊盯數位微震觀測儀圖譜，嚴密捕捉破火山口深處岩漿上升時引發的規律震顫。

examples.en: The university geology department deployed a sensitive ocean-bottom seismometer array to map undersea fault slips.
examples.zh: 大學地球科學系在海域佈設高靈敏度海底地震儀觀測陣列，用以精確描繪海底隱伏斷層的活動滑移。

entries.definition: 沿線密集佈設之強震即時自動預警地震儀

explains.en: A sensor placed beside railway tracks detects strong shaking and sends an alert quickly. The system can warn operators before a train reaches danger. This device measures ground motion.
A scientific instrument records vibrations from an earthquake. It can send data automatically to a warning center. The record helps officials understand the shaking.
A network of sensors along a rail line measures sudden movement in the ground. Staff receive alerts in real time. This instrument detects seismic waves.

examples.en: InSAR satellite radar and deep sensors monitor regional land subsidence to protect viaduct pillar alignment.
examples.zh: 結合衛星雷達與深井感測器，嚴密監控「區域地層下陷」（Subsidence），確保高架橋墩幾何線形絕對垂直。

examples.en: Excessive agricultural groundwater pumping in coastal lowlands exacerbated severe ground land subsidence.
examples.zh: 沿海低窪鄉鎮過去長年過量抽取地下水進行水產養殖，加劇了沿海地層大面積嚴重下陷與海水倒灌。

examples.en: Structural engineers recommended underpinning the apartment building foundation after noticing wall cracks from soil subsidence.
examples.zh: 結構技師在察覺地基土壤不均勻沉陷導致牆面開裂後，立即建議對該棟住宅大樓進行地基灌漿托底補強。

entries.definition: 嘉南平原沿線地下水位與地層下陷精準監控；下陷

explains.en: The ground sinks after water is pumped out from below a city. Buildings may tilt.
A road surface gradually drops as the soil beneath it moves. Engineers monitor the change.
This is the sinking of land or a surface. It can happen when underground support is removed.

examples.en: Steel rails pulse with vibrant energy, serving as an indispensable transportation artery for our modern society.
examples.zh: 雙向鋼軌隨列車奔馳澎湃脈動，成為維繫現代社會繁榮運作不可或缺的「交通大動脈」（Artery）。

examples.en: Healthy lifestyle choices and regular exercise help prevent the dangerous narrowing of the coronary artery.
examples.zh: 保持清淡健康飲食習慣並維持每週規律有氧運動，能有效防止供應心肌血流的冠狀動脈產生致命狹窄硬化。

examples.en: The central boulevard acts as the primary commercial artery of downtown, bustling with cafes and department stores.
examples.zh: 市中心貫穿南北的林蔭大道是繁華市區的商業核心大動脈，兩側林立著時髦咖啡館與各大知名百貨商場。

entries.definition: 串聯全台南北數千萬旅客之現代鋼鐵交通動脈；動脈

explains.en: A blood vessel carries blood away from the heart to the body. Its walls are strong and elastic. Healthy habits help protect it.
A doctor explains that a blocked vessel can reduce blood flow to an organ. Tests can show where the problem is. Treatment depends on its cause.
The main road through a town carries traffic into nearby streets. It is called this by comparison with a body’s major blood vessel. The context gives the meaning.

examples.en: A two-second reverberation time lends orchestral music rich warmth and majestic spaciousness.
examples.zh: 長達兩秒的「滿座殘響時間」（Reverberation Time），賦予管弦交響樂宏大深邃的溫暖空間感。

examples.en: In the tiled bathroom, her singing voice gained pleasant reverberation that sounded like a cathedral.
examples.zh: 在鋪滿磁磚的浴室裡，她的歌聲獲得了悅耳生動的自然殘響回音，宛如置身宏偉大教堂一般。

examples.en: Sound engineers installed heavy velvet drapes to reduce excessive reverberation during lecture presentations.
examples.zh: 音響工程師加裝厚重天鵝絨布幔，以大幅抑制大型演講廳內過長的混濁殘響時間。

entries.definition: 滿座兩秒之交響音樂廳最佳殘響時間 (RT60)

explains.en: A sound continues briefly after its source stops because it bounces around a space. A large hall may have a long echo. Soft materials can reduce it.
The singer stopped, but her voice seemed to remain in the hall. The sound bounced off the walls. The audience listened to the fading echo.
A bathroom with hard surfaces may make a voice ring. Curtains and carpets absorb some sound. Room shape affects what people hear.
